title: Tuna and Chocolate Balls - Spain
ingredients: 1/2 cup white tuna, cooked and drained | 2 unsweetened chocolate squares, melted | 1/8 teaspoon cumin
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together tuna, chocolate, and cumin. Roll into 1 inch balls, and put on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Chill balls in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Remove balls from shells, and roll slightly to coat.

title: Coney-Pimiento Beer Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces breadcrumbs | 1/4 lb pepperoni | 14 ounces beer ( use any proportion of beer for a healthier bread )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine bread crumbs and pepperoni cheese. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Dump into lightly greased crock. Cook on low heat for 2 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,garlic powder,catsup,red pepper flake,french baguette,green tomato,food coloring,eggplant
title: Bacon Wrapped Eggplant (Russian Pepperoncini)
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, diced small | 1 can french baguettes, cut into 1 2 slices, toasted | 1 can green tomatoes, drained | 2 tablespoons catsup ( or tomato flavored ) | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | food coloring | 16 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Cook eggplant until tender on the outside and the eggplant is soft and tender. Cool before stuffing. Cut all of the bread slices lengthwise into quarters and spread generously with catsup. Combine all of the spices and food coloring in small bowl,. Spread a small pat of the spice mixture on each slice of bread and top with 1 slices of eggplant. Cut diagonally at one end of each piece of bread. Fold each slice of bread in half and continue to fold over the eggplant to completely wrap it up. Put filled bread onto cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray and spread 1 tbsp of sauce on each stuffed bread piece, leaving a small space. Place a foil covered baking pan on top of the pieces and spray with non stick spray. Bake at 400 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden.

title: Green Beans and Marmalade Salad
ingredients: 1 pound fresh green beans | 1/2 cup marmalade | 1 head romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried, and shredded
instructions: Cut ends off each green bean and snap the ends tightly. Place the green beans in a large pot of lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until the beans are tender but still firm, about 25 minutes. Drain and let cool. In a large bowl, stir together the marmalade and sliced green beans. Add the shredded romaine, cover and refrigerate until the salad is chilled and the flavors blended, 3 to 4 hours.

title: Quick  Mexican Cream  Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup ( campbell's brand is very good ) | 1/2 cup hot tap water | 1 cup chipotle chile, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients until smooth. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,chicken thigh,white wine vinegar,red pepper flake,kahlua,mix,grain rice
title: Creamy Kahlua Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups prepared instant mix | 1/3 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup sour mix | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 13 ounces chicken thighs, boneless and skinless | 1 cup uncooked long grain rice, uncooked | 1 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped
instructions: Place instant mix, kahlua, sour mix, vinegar and red pepper flakes in medium bowl. Add chicken thighs and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate up to 4 hours.

title: Creamy Mushroom-Lavender Olive Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar pitted kalamata olives, drained ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, blend the sour cream, the cream of mushroom soup, and the olives. Makes about 3/4 cup.

title: Apple Ginger Chutney
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Whisk together the ginger garlic paste and cider juice until smooth. Chill thoroughly. Store in a covered container, or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: meat,white wine,tomato sauce,salmon fillet,lemon zest,salt black pepper
title: Tomato Cured Salmon
ingredients: 1 lemon, zest of, chopped finely | 1 1/2 lbs fresh tomatoes, chopped ( or canned tomatoes in puree ) | 14 ounces of canned tomato sauce ( or tomato paste ) | 4 ounces white wine | 2 ounces smoked meat, chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Boil the tomato sauce, lemon rind and wine until reduced to 3 tablespoons. Remove from the heat. Cool. In an appropriate size shallow baking dish, spread the tomato sauce over the fish. Sprinkle over the smoked meat over top of the tomato sauce, then mix gently. Cover with a double thickness of aluminum foil and secure with long kitchen string or secure a cocktail stick. Place under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning once, or twice. Remove the tuna from the pan, drain off the sauce and serve straight away.

title: Apple Crusted Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups apple juice | 1 3/4 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: Combine fruit juices. Stir in beef. Let stand 4 hours 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350°, and grease a shallow 9 x 11 baking pan. Arrange tenderloin in pan, and bake 20 to 25 minutes to an internal temperature of 145°f for medium rare, or 120°f for medium well. Remove from the oven and place on a rack to cool completely and place a piece of plastic wrap directly on surface of the meat. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve with horseradish sauce, horseradish, mayonnaise.

title: The Irish Lamb and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb fillets, chopped up | 1 1/2 leeks, chopped up | 1/3 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 parsley or 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup sauerkraut | 1/4 cup pear, diced
instructions: Put lamb in skillet, add leek, s&p and brown over high heat, stirring occasionally. Remove leek mixture. Add flour, mustard powder parsley, barley and sauerkraut. Pour boiling water over barley mixture and add diced pear. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour or until lamb is tender stir occasionally.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,poblano pepper,tomato puree,brown rice,great northern bean
title: Poblano and White Bean Soup
ingredients: 6 poblano peppers | 2 cans great northern beans | 1 can canned tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon brown rice, or optional
instructions: Place poblanos in a food processor and finely chop with a knife, leaving stems and seeds on. Add beans, tomato puree, oregano, and italian seasoning to food processor. Blend until smooth. Use as desired, or reheat to serve.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,cream cheese,iceberg lettuce,basil,lemon peel,gravy mix
title: Swiss and Herb Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 250 g cream cheese | 150 ml whipping cream | 1/2 cup gravy mix | 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/2 lemon peel, grated
instructions: Wash the lettuce thoroughly in a sieve. Remove hard muscle if necessary and cut into wedges. To make the dressing, combine the cream cheese, whipping cream, gravy powder and basil in a blender and blend until smooth. Fold into the lettuce, pour over the salad and sprinkle with lemon peel. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,sunflower oil,ginger,green bean,wild rice,french onion
title: Wild Rice and Green Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 8 ounces wild rice, rinsed | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 can french-fried onions | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 12 ounces frozen green beans, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Heat oil in a large roasting pan over medium heat. Add wild rice and cook, stirring often, until browned. Stir in salsa, french fried onions and ginger. Scatter beans over rice and stir to combine. Cover and bake for 25 minutes, stirring halfway through.

title: Cheaters Indian Curry Rub(Aka Nutty Paneer Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/3 cup roasted salted kahlua | 1/3 cup salad oil ( i used olive oil ) | 2 tablespoons ground cumin powder | kahlua ( for serving ) ( optional ) or other spicy coffee-flavored extract, such as kahlua ( for serving ) ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients and mix well. Cover and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks.

title: Jerk Fish
ingredients: 1 lb of fresh cod ( skinned ) | 1 cucumber, seeded | 1/2 lb kielbasa sausage | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | fresh coriander ( to garnish )
instructions: Clean and rinse the cod, removing any scales or foreign matter and setting it aside. Cut the fish out of the bone and place in a large mixing bowl. Peel and thinly slice the cucumber and coarsely chop. Add to the cod, along with the kielbasa sausage and sugar. Using a wooden spool or long spatula, mix together and let stand for an hour and a half. Taste, and adjust seasoning as needed. Serve in small bowls, dusted with coriander.

title: Spicy Mexican Ice II
ingredients: 8 cups crushed ice | 1 cup chutney | 2 tablespoons mexican oregano, or to taste | 1 pinch dried vanilla
instructions: Place crushed ice into a large bowl. Mix in chutney, oregano, and vanilla.

title: Cheese Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces cheese tortellini | 2 sticks celery leaves | 4 ounces pepperoni slices, chopped
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, heat celery until softened. Add pepperoni, mix well. Toss with tortellini, chill 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Pecan Pistou
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 1/3 cups pecan halves ( or chopped nuts such as pistachios, walnuts, hazelnuts, or pecan butter ) | 3/4 cup greek yogurt or 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 large handful fresh italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f in a heavy bottomed sauté pan, warm 1/4 cup of the oil on medium high heat, stirring constantly, until very hot. Add nuts and cook until fragrant and starting to brown, about 2 minutes. Take the pan off the heat, and remove 2/3 cup of the nuts to a food processor or food processor and process into a coarse powder. Stir nuts into the pisto. In a large mixing bowl, gently whisk yogurt with 1/2 cup pisto mixture. Stir in remaining pisto mixture. Spoon mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/4 inch round tip. Pipe pisto into 6 small star shaped or other 3 or 4 inch diameter mounds, and bake until puffed up and golden on top, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a rack to cool completely. Garnish with parsley. Serve warm.

title: Baked Beef and Lamb
ingredients: 2 onions | 2 cups cooked lamb or 2 cups lamb, cubed and cooked in olive oil | 1 cup coconut oil ( may use palm oil ) | 2 cups tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon garlic flavoring or 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f thinly slice the onions crossways and fry till coloured very pale, remove. Place in a shallow ovenproof dish with about 1/2 cup of water. Place the lamb in the dish and cover with the onions. Spread with olive oil and bake for about 1 hour. When cooked remove from oven and sprinkle with tomato ketchup, stir to combine well and top with curry powder sprinkle with cumin powder and bake for a further 30 mins or till curry is bubbling and onion is nicely browned. Serve with steamed rice or steamed vegetables.

title: Tahini Steak and Kidney Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 cups frozen red kidney beans | 1 lb skirt steak | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 bunch radish | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 bell pepper | 1 chopped garlic ( optional ) | 6 -8 slices lebanese cucumbers ( optional ) or 6 -8 slices cucumbers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees, remove tips of cucumbers. Place in an ovenproof skillet large enough to accommodate all meat, close lid and bake for 1 hr or until meat is no longer pink. Remove from oven, and set aside. Meanwhile, bring large pot of water to a boil. Seed pepper, cut in strips, drain, remove seeds. In another pot, place beans, and boil for 5 minutes, remove from heat. Stir in tahini, add to meat and mix. Add rest of vegetables and mix. Serve immediately.

title: Black Bean Fritters (Omurice Epirina)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped of fresh mint | 1 can black beans, well drained and washed ( reserve 1/3 cup juice ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped of fresh mint ( optional ) | softly whisked icing sugar, for dusting | 200 g good quality shortcrusties ( eg biscuits-shake-mock or similar ) | icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Place the 1/3 cup of juice and 1 tbsp mint in a small mixing bowl. Add the beans and half of the chopped mint if using, stir together. Add the remaining 1 tbsp of mint if using, stir to combine, and set aside to cool. Cut 2/3 cup biscuit dough into 5 equal portions and roll these into balls. Place these balls on a tray lined with baking paper, dust lightly with icing sugar, and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Roll each one again, dusting well with icing sugar as needed, and refrigerate/freeze until ready to use. Place the remaining chopped mint in a small shallow dish. Roll the 1 ball of biscuit dough into a ball and then into the mint mint mixture. Repeat the process with the other ball of dough. Serve the fritters warm. Store the fritters in a lidded container or tupperware container in the fridge.

title: Elegant Anchovy Appetizer
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 3 -4 anchovy fillets, in oil | 1 pinch turmeric powder ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Slice the puff pastry thouroughly with a biscuit cutter. Smash the anchovio fillets if possible with a spoon in a mortar and pestle. Use a knife instead to slice the anchovies into a small square shaped piece, about 3 4cm. Roll each piece of pastry into a sausage shaped shape and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle your chosen amount of turmeric powder over each sausage in the pastry. Top with a thick layer of your favourite jam and sprinkle with your choice of chopped almonds on top. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,apricot preserve,bicarbonate soda,green apple,curry powder
title: Apricot Curry
ingredients: 1 green apple, chopped | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/8 teaspoon apricot preserves
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Serve over steamed rice.

title: Garlic and Sherry Sorbet from Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 cup grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1/2 cup sherry | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon fine sugar or 1 tablespoon raw sugar
instructions: Combine grated cheese, minced garlic, sherry, oregano and fine sugar in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight to allow flavors to develop. Makes one 9x13 inch loaf and is perfect for stews and gratings.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,creole seasoning,feta cheese,provolone cheese,ricotta cheese
title: Garbanzo beans & Provolone Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 12 slices provolone cheese | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 2 tablespoons feta cheese
instructions: Spread the entire pizza onto pizza maker. Combine ricotta and creole seasoning. Spread the mixture on the pizza spread. Sprinkle feta on top of cheese spread. Bake for 15 minutes at 375 degrees.

title: Trout Kebabs
ingredients: 1 small fresh trout, about 3 inches in length | tahini, for dipping ( optional )
instructions: Cut the trout into about 4 by 1/4 by 1/4 pieces. Place them into a bowl of salt and cover with very hot tap water. Soak at least 20 minutes. Rinse the trout and pat dry. Spread 2 to 3 tablespoons tahini on a piece of aluminum foil, fold over to make a cone shaped packet and pinch the edges closed. Set aside. Dip each piece of trout in tahini and place in the center of a piece of foil. Pile some tahini on the kabababababab and press well. You can make your own design with any of the above ingredients. Refrigerate and marinate fish for 2 to 3 hours. Serve with pita bread. These can also be made with shrimps and smoked fish.

title: Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1/2 cup taco seasoning, mild | 1/4 cup diced green chiles, canned | 4 scallions scallions, cut into 2-inch lengths
instructions: In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients except scallions and scallions. Coat the outside rim of a small, round glass, or rectangular baking dish with seasoning. Arrange the scallions in the prepared dish, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least an hour prior to grilling. Remove from dish and discard plastic wrap. Grill on high for 10 - 12 minutes or until the scallions are tender and golden. Slice and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pecan,rom tomato,cornstarch,pico de gallo,rotel tomato,chevre cheese
title: Mexican Queso Fundido
ingredients: 1/4 cup pico de gallo | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1 1/2 ounces chevre cheese or 1 1/2 ounces goat cheese | 3 tablespoons pimento-stuffed olives | 1 1/2 cups diced roma tomatoes | 1 can rotel tomatoes
instructions: Combine cornstarch and cheese in a medium bowl and blend. Add olives and tomatoes in a smaller bowl, stirring to blend. Toss with pimentos. Place over medium low heat until cheese begins to melt. Keep warm. Serve with tortilla chips or as taco filling, if desired.

Random Ingredients: herb,sharp cheddar cheese,sunflower oil,topping,white wine vinegar,black eyed pea,active yeast,milk
title: Black-Eyed Pea English Muffin Bread
ingredients: 1 ounce active dry yeast | 1/2 cup milk | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup fresh goat's milk | 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 3 - 3 1/2 cups breadcrumbs | 3/4 lb sharp cheddar cheese or 3/4 lb farmer's cheese | chopped mixed herbs ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 c of the milk. In a large mixing bowl, combine the remainder of the milk, vinegar, and goat's milk. Add to the yeast mixture. Add in the oil and then in the bread crumbs. Stir until the bread mixture is well combined. If using cheese, add to bread mixture. Knead on a floured surface for 5 - 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl and turn to oil the top. Poke holes in the bread with a toothpick. Cover with a large kitchen towel and let rise in a warm place for 1 - 2 hours. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 - 30 minutes, or until bread is golden brown and crusty. Serve warm or at room temperature with your choice of topping.

title: Swiss Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 3 cups swiss cheese, grated | 2 containers thousand island dressing ( vh )
instructions: Combine swiss cheese, dry mustard and thousand island dressing in the bowl of a blender. Cover the bowl tightly and blend for 2 minutes at lowest speed. Transfer to a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 2 hours.

title: Quick and Easy Risotto Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked medium shell pasta, such as linguine | 3 tablespoons grated carrots or 3 tablespoons zucchini, divided | 3 cups hot cooked arborio rice
instructions: Cook and stir pasta in a medium saucepan of boiling salted water until tender but firm, about 12 minutes. Pour pasta into a colander or strainer set over a bowl.

title: Dill-Pickles-Beef Rounds
ingredients: 5 lbs beef round steak or 5 lbs round steaks
instructions: Preheat grill. Place beef in a shallow dutch oven. Cover with salted water. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hr and 15 min or until tender. Remove beef from oven and cool slightly. Drain well. Trim away fat, and slice thinly. Arrange on hot platter or plates. Makes 1 to 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,oyster,pine nut,sauerkraut,alfredo sauce,chayotes,espresso powder,serrano chilies
title: Sopapillas with Chili, Sopapillas, and Escarole
ingredients: 1 can alfredo sauce | 1 can sauerkraut | 1 lb chayotes, peeled cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 cup spicy tapenade ( homemade or canned ) or 1 cup hot espresso powder | 1 can water-packed anchovies packed in oil, drained | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 4 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1 teaspoon finely diced serrano chilies, minced ( optional )
instructions: In medium bowl, mix alfredo sauce with sauerkraut, chayote, tapenade, espresso powder, pine nuts, and serrano chiles. Arrange in 11x7x2 glass baking dish. Bake at 350°f 20 minutes, or until hot. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,white peppercorn,white pepper,artichoke,soy sauce,grouper fillet
title: Cauliflower and Fish Adobo in Sauce (Grouper Vaudois)
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh marinated artichoke | 5 -6 white fish-flavored steaks ( such as grouper fillets ) | 3 tablespoons white peppercorns | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | white pepper
instructions: Wash the cauliflower florets.

title: Yellow Squash & Date Breakfast Cereal - Grain & Spice Free!
ingredients: 400 g yellow squash, in small chunks | 400 g stemed dates, chopped coarsely | 2 celery ribs, chopped coarsely | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 100 g brown rice, in thin wedges
instructions: Using a non stick pan on medium heat cook, stirring regularly, a small piece of baking paper, seeds of chopped dates or tblspn brown rice until they start to crackle. Add celery, cumin, celery seeds & allow to cook on a gentle simmer for five minutes. Break up the dates and then add the dates to the pan along with 1 cup of water & stir well so you have a coarse sticky mixture. Continue cooking and stirring occasionally for 15–20 minutes, until the dates are soft but mixture is still holding together. Add the rest of the water a cup at a time if it is getting dry at this point which the texture will not be quite right. Continue cooking until consistency is as you like, stir well every so often if it's not enough, stir in a tablespoon or 2 until the mixture thickens.

title: Lemon Potato Sausage #5FIX
ingredients: 2 cups small white potatoes, cut into quarters | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons lemon rind, finely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees and grease an 8x8 inch baking sheet. Spread the potatoes in a single layer on the baking sheet, leaving a 2 inch space between them if possible. Bake potato until tender, about 15 - 20 minutes, stirring once or twice during baking. When potatoes are done, set aside to cool slightly. When cool enough, remove them from baking sheet, but leave any residual grease in the pan. Place a 10” sausages on the hot baking sheet in a single layer. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes. Turn sausages out onto a cutting board and set aside to cool slightly. When cool, cut each warmed sausage link diagonally into 1/2” slices. Add any leftover potato mixture to the hot sausages and toss gently until the mixture coats the sausage slices. Serve with lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,catfish fillet,sherry wine vinegar,parma ham,beef,parsley flake
title: Catfish Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 catfish fillets | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice ( about 3 avg lemons ) | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley flakes | 4 teaspoons parma ham, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a wide bowl. Add catfish fillets and refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour. Bring to room temperature before serving, or chilled.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,pork tenderloin,milk powder,rice noodle,thai red curry paste,pork,lamb chop
title: Curried Pork and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh whole milk powder | 16 ounces pork tenderloin, cut into thin strips | 16 ounces country-style short grain rice noodles | 3/4 cup thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon light-colored cooking spray or 1 tablespoon light-colored cooking spray | 8 lamb chops | 1/2 cup chopped fresh ginger root
instructions: Prepare grill for indirect heat. Combine milk and pork strips in a medium bowl. Soak rice noodles in large bowl of lukewarm water for 1 minute. Drain and set aside. Combine curry paste, spray, and remaining ingredients in a large, heavy nonstick skillet or deep, cast iron skillet. Working in batches, cook pork until it is just cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Add noodles to skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until noodles are bright red and crisp, 3 to 4 minutes. Slice pork into thin strips. Arrange noodles on a serving platter or individual plates. Sprinkle rice noodles atop noodles. Spoon pork and noodle mixture evenly over the noodles.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,hash brown potato,rye bread,coconut extract,kosher salt pepper,french thyme
title: French Apple Strata
ingredients: 1 tart apple, cored and sliced | 1 teaspoon french thyme | kosher salt and pepper | 3 1-inch square potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | cornstarch and water mixture, for coating the potatoes | 1 loaf rye bread, crusts removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Arrange the apple slices in a baking dish, cover with plastic wrap, and toss with the thyme. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Drizzle with water, then cover with plastic wrap. Bake strata for 45 minutes. While strata is baking, place potato cubes in a pan of hot water. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Cover and let sit, until potatoes are almost tender, about 5 minutes. Drain water from potato mixture and mash with cornstarch and water mixture, adding more water by teaspoonfuls if mixture is too thick. Cut the bread in half lengthwise and tear into 1/4 pieces. Cut each piece into 3 pieces, and arrange on top of strata. Bake strata in preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until bread is crusty and crisp and top is slightly crusty.

title: BBQ Salmon with Barley Salad
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1 large green pepper, sliced | 1 cucumber, sliced | 1 tablespoon dried cracked salted roasted peanuts, or more to taste | 8 slices cooked bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup liquid honey
instructions: Place salmon fillets on the grill, and cook about 7 minutes per inch high, to just under an internal temperature of 145 degrees f. Cut salmon fillets into chunks. Place lemon wedges in a small bowl, and fill the rest with pepper slices and cucumber slices. Serve on a pretty plate with strips or crackers. Combine barley, bacon, and pearl barley together in a separate nonreactive bowl, and pour in the honey.

Random Ingredients: cola,red wine vinegar,cornstarch,peanut butter,graham cracker crumb,orange juice concentrate,cheddar cheese
title: Cinco De Mayo Cheesecake With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated ( reduced fat or sharp cheddar ) | 1/4 cup orange juice concentrate | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup cola or 1/4 cup pepsi
instructions: In mixing bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, cheese, orange juice concentrate and red wine vinegar. Stir in the peanut butter, cornstarch and cola until mixture is crumbly. Spoon the peanut butter mixture into a lightly buttered springform pan. Bake at 300 oven for 30 minutes. Cover with foil and chill for 20 minutes.

title: Spiced Italian Pepperoni Soup
ingredients: 1 lb pepperoni, sliced | 5 cups vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon juniper berries | 1 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon pepper mill ground mustard or 1/4 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Put pepperoni on a plate and cover lightly with plastic wrap. Microwave the sliced pepperoni, broth, juniper, thyme, and pepper mill on high power until heated through. Slaw can also be frozen and microwaved at 45 second intervals for 15 - 20 minutes, depending on microwave strength of microwave, or you can cook immediately.

title: Danish Party Trifle
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut ( drained ) | 1 jar sauerkraut ( drained ) | 2 packages ladyfingers ( soaked in warm water, cooled, about 15 min ) | 1 cup frozen peas | 2/3 cup sweet corn, thawed | 1/4 cup chinese wine ( or sherry )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, cover and sit to chill. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,brown rice,baby bok choy,white bread,celery salt,orange juice
title: Orange Beef Roll Ups (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, pre-cooked | 1 package frozen white-wheat rolled beef, thawed | 2 stalks celery salt | 2 large baby bok choy ( washed and trimmed of stems, about 15 leaves ) | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 teaspoons white bread, crumbs ( i like oat or almond flavored, but can use bread crumbs, but i use gluten free bread )
instructions: Cook the rice according to the directions on the package. While rice is cooking, thinly slice the beef diagonally with a very sharp knife. The amount of meat used depends on how thin or thick you want the beef slices. If meat seems thin, add a little water, until the beef looks like it is about the consistency of thin oatmeal. Lay the beef slices on a cutting board and cut each slice almost all the way through, stopping about 2 inches from the bottom. Take out your largest knife and slice those slices very thinly, leaving about ½ inch of meat on each slice. Set aside. Set your oven to 250 degrees f. When your oven is ready, lightly grease a cookie sheet. Spread rice across the bottom of the prepared pan. Top with half of the rolls, then layer the celery salt, then cover with another layer of rolls and celery salt. Top each roll with 3 to 4 leaves of bok choy. Combine orange juice and bread crumbs and spread over rolls. Place a sheet of aluminum foil over the tops of the rolls to keep them moist while baking. Bake in the preheated oven for about 1 hour, or until hot. Slice into 8 pieces, removing the foil if you wish, and let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Steak-Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower, finely chopped & cooked | 2 steaks, sliced | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons pickled cauliflower, finely chopped | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons pickled cauliflower, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons pecans or 2 tablespoons walnut pieces | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon salmon, very finely chopped | 2 drops steak sauce
instructions: To make the sauce, mix together the chopped cauliflower, fish flakes, egg yolk, pepperely cauliflower & walnuts in a bowl or pie dish. Season with salt & pepper. Stuff each cauliflower with the fish mixture, place the fluted steaks on top & gently press. Place in a preheated oven & bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until tender. To serve, put a saucepan over a low heat and add the fish flakes, cook just until they just start to color. Add the steak, cook for 2 - 3 minutes. To serve, warm a little sauce over a plate and spoon some sauce around the plate.

title: Caledonian Linguine
ingredients: 3 packages spaghetti ( linguine, linguine, or other pastas will work fine ) | 1 package tempeh | 1/2 lb pancetta | 1/2 cup chopped almonds | 1/2 cup marsala | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, to taste
instructions: Boil water in a large pot for pasta and salt. When the pasta is at a boil, add tempeh and pancetta. Drain pasta and put into a large bowl. Add marsala, almond extract, grated cheese, and pancetta to the pasta mixture. Add hot sauce to taste, and stir. Serve.

title: Baked Semolina Bread with Egg (Eggless)
ingredients: 1 package rye bread | 1 jar peas ( peas with liquid ) | 3 hard-boiled eggs ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon semolina flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the tops off the rye bread slices and discard. In a 9 x 5 x 3 inch oven proof pan, arrange all the bread slices in one layer. In a small bowl, crush the peas with a fork, or with the back of a spoon, and stir in the eggs, onion powder and semolina flour. Stir this mixture into the bread slices. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until bread is browned.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,flat leaf parsley,golden syrup,brown rice,apple cider
title: Green apple rice with fresh cilantro
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice | 1/2 cup minced flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons dried chipotle in adobo sauce ( not in adobo seasoning ) | 1 apple, grated fine ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, cook rice until brown and crisp, stirring frequently. Add remaining ingredients and cook, stirring often, until mixture comes to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low, and cook for 30 minutes, until rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,date,almond,orange juice,chicken breast half,yellow squash
title: Grilled Veggie Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves or 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon chopped toasted almond | 3 tablespoons reduced-fat velveeta cheese, cut into slices | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Combine orange juice, almond and cheese in a small bowl. Place chicken in a shallow pan and pour orange juice mixture on top. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. While chicken is marinating, prepare squash, place squash slices onto a greased grill and grill about 5 minutes, or until tender. Set aside. Spread chicken with cheese mixture, close lid and grill for another 5 minutes or until cheese has melted. Serve mixture on top of roasted squash mixture.

title: Grilled Salmon
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs salmon | seasoning salt ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the salmon, and season with seasoned salt. Heat coals. Barbecue fish 4 to 5 inches from heat for about 5 - 10 minutes on each side, or until done.

title: Pepperoni Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 package frozen pepperoni, thawed | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Place thawed pepperoni in ungreased 9x13 baking dish. Sprinkle pepperoni with wine and bake for approximately 5 minutes, or till heated through.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,rosemary sprig,fish sauce,oat,celery rib,cannellini bean,onion,rhubarb
title: Rhubarb-Stuffed Bean Tins
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed ( cannellini beans are the perfect substitution ) | 1 stalk celery rib, finely chopped | 2 large fresh thyme sprigs | 3 rosemary sprigs | 2 tablespoons grated onions | 2 teaspoons fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 2 tablespoons rolled oats ( use quick to quick cooking oats for this, they really have no limit ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme into fresh rosemary sprigs
instructions: Mix beans, celery, thyme, onion, fish sauce, and oats in a bowl. Mix in rosemary. Fill each orange cavity to one third full with beans mixture and add a fresh thyme sprig. Set filled tins on rack in large roasting pan lined with parchment paper. Bake at 400f for 12 - 14 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mochaccio Chicken -- a Yummy!
ingredients: 1 -2 lb chicken piece | 1 can tomato paste | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Dry off chicken pieces with the back of a spoon to remove any excess moisture. If using tomato paste, stir in 1 tbsp dark chocolate powder and leave in fridge. Take off the chicken skin and set the pieces skin aside. Put the chicken pieces in a pan with 1/3 of the tomato paste. Add the rest of the tomato paste and the rest of the dark chocolate powder. Mix well, but do not over mix. Cover the pan and leave for 2 hours on low, stirring occasionally. Once done, remove the chicken pieces, and either put into a dish or plate, and sprinkle chopped/extra dark chocolate over top. It can also be served with jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,head iceberg lettuce,margarine,chili seasoning mix,kosher salt black pepper,vegetable,white rice,red pepper flake
title: Fiesta Salad (Southwestern Version)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine or 3 tablespoons smart balance butter, melted | 1 1/2 cups frozen mixed vegetables | 2 cups cooked white rice | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce ( romaine ) | kosher salt and black pepper | chili seasoning mix | crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Combine butter, mixed vegetables, rice, lettuce, seasoning package, crushed red pepper, and chicken bouillon in a large bowl, stirring well to thoroughly combine. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours.

title: Garlic Chive Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup hoagie roll | 2 tablespoons wheat germ | 6 tablespoons minced fresh garlic chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Slice top off of roll and place cut sides down on a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes. Turn bread and bake 5 more minutes or until bread is evenly golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Combine hoagies, wheat germ, and garlic in a large bowl.

title: Homemade Refried Great Northern Beans
ingredients: 8 -10 lbs dried great northern beans | 24 small dried red chilies | 1 large lemon, cut into wedges
instructions: Wash and soak beans over night in cold water in a cool large container. Drain. Cook beans according to directions on packaging. Heat oven to 400f degrees. Spread beans with hot grease free refregerator dressing. Serve hot with lemon wedges as an added garnish.

title: Green Chile Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat or 2 lbs lamb stew meat | 12 ounces diced lamb, with bone with bone | 2 cans diced green chilies | 1 bottle kale, chopped | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Cut meat into bite sized cubes, brown in pan.. Place all ingredients in crock pot and cover. Cook on high for 6 - 8 hours stirring every 3 - 4 hours. Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,head iceberg lettuce,dark rum,black cardamom pod
title: Sour Cream, Pineapple & Black Cardamom Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1/4 cup dark rum or 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 teaspoon whole black cardamom pod
instructions: To open the black cardamom pods and remove the stem, finely chop 1/4 from stem and discard seeds or use a mortar and pestle. Drain the lettuce leaves. Trim and remove dark center vein from inside the lettuce leaves. Line a salad platter with the lettuce leaves. Strain the strained pineapple juice and discard the solids. In a deep saucepan, over medium low heat, blend together the rum and crushed black pepper until the pepper is evenly dispersed throughout. Remove from the heat. Add the crushed black pepper and the cardamom pods and stir well. Place a few slices of the cooled rum mixture into each salad dish and serve.

title: Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 can black beans, drained | 1/2 cup apple juice | 3/4 - 1 cup hot sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock pot. Cook on setting on low 7 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: chutney,parmesan cheese,yellow pepper,taco seasoning mix,peanut oil
title: Sour Peppers
ingredients: 1 kg yellow sweet pepper ( or red ) | 60 g parmesan cheese | 150 g taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons sweet chutney | 4 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Slice the peppers thinly. Sprinkle with the cheese and microwave briefly at high power. Remove, place in fridge and leave to cool. Add the taco seasoning, sweet chutney and remaining oil.

title: Grilled Herring
ingredients: 8 ounces ground leg of lamb | 8 ounces fresh herring | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 4 ounces swiss chard, chopped | 1 stalk lemongrass, chopped
instructions: Preheat grill. Place the lamb and herbs in a large bowl, and mix well. Divide this mix into 4 portions and shape each into a round ball. Sprinkle a light coating of flour on both sides of the herring, and place the balls in the centre. Place the salmon on top, and form into a circle shape. Place on grill, and cook approximately 15 to 20 minutes, turning after 5 minutes. Serve with mustard.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,heavy whipping cream,pecan,worcestershire sauce,lemon pepper,beef mince,peanut oil,pizza crust
title: Beef & Spinach Pizza
ingredients: 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 500 g beef mince, lean | 12 ounces pizza crust | 4 ounces baby spinach leaves | 3 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 ounce pecans, roughly chopped
instructions: To prepare the crust, preheat the oven to 200°c, gas mark grease a 12 hole, 2cm deep, non stick pizza pan with 2 teaspoons of the worcestershire sauce. Combine the ground mince and 1 teaspoon of the lemon pepper and season well. Drain well, press mixture evenly into the base of the pan. Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce the temperature to 140c. Bake for a further 10 minutes, or until cooked through. To prepare the spinach, place the spinach leaves in a large shallow bowl. Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a large non stick pan. Cook the spinach over a medium heat for 3 minutes, or until just starting to wilt. Transfer to a plate. To serve, preheat the oven to 220°c. Spread the cream over the pizza base, then top with the spinach. Sprinkle the remaining lemon pepper and worcestershire sauce over. Scatter pecans over the top and serve.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 30 -35 ounces black & green beans ( or mixed vegetables ) | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 5 -6 drops hot sauce
instructions: Cook beans according to directions. Stir well until creamy. Add hot pepper sauce. Serve over cafe au gratin or white rice.

Random Ingredients: mini marshmallow,black pepper,oyster sauce,grain white rice,ginger juice,yukon gold potato,white wine
title: Steamed Rice With Ginger and Oyster Flavored Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice, uncooked | 12 ounces yukon gold potatoes, quartered | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger juice | 4 teaspoons dry white wine | 4 teaspoons thinly sliced pickled ginger juice | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper ( or more if you want it really spicy )
instructions: Place the rice in a large, microwave safe casserole dish, then cover with 3 cups hot water. Microwave on high for 5 minutes and then leave to sit for another 10 minutes. Meanwhile, peel potatoes, then quarter them into 1/2 inch chunks. Combine the oyster sauce, ginger juice, wine, ginger juice and black pepper in a medium bowl and set aside. Drain the cooked rice. Drain the rice, then spread in the casserole dish and toss with a spatula so it evenly coats the potatoes and oyster sauce. Taste for salt and seasoning. Place the sweet potatoes on top and set aside. Cover the casserole dish with a lid and microwave on medium until the potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally, about 40 minutes. The rice will absorb a little water. While waiting for the rice to cool completely, cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Transfer to a serving dish, drizzle with the oyster sauce mixture, and toss over a mound of rice.

title: Thai Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken meat, cut in strips | 1/2 large spanish onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 lb feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: In a skillet, saute chicken and onion in butter until chicken is lightly brown. Drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce and simmer 10 minutes and sprinkle in turmeric, basil and cheese.

title: Yummy Indian Breakfast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1/3 cup mango chutney, pure | 1/2 cup hot coffee | 1/3 cup corino romano cheese, grated ( or more if you wish ) | 6 slices tomatoes ( italian or american style )
instructions: In a small saucepan combine cranberries, mango chutney and hot coffee. Bring to simmer over medium heat and stir until cranberries are dissolved. Remove from heat. Sprinkle with cheese and stir to coat. Spread mixture on bread.

title: Greek Orzo
ingredients: 225 g orzo pasta, uncooked | 150 -200 g dried cherries, cut in half | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander powder
instructions: Cook orzo until tender, drain and set aside. Soak dried cherries in boiling water, drain well and then cut the cherries up with the cherry halves to make a thick paste. In a small bowl combine the dried orzo, coriander and cherry puree until it is paste like, stir in the chopped orzo. Garnish with chopped coriander.

title: Kielbasa and Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 bag potatoes flakes | 1/2 pound kielbasa | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can sliced sweet potatoes | 1 cup irish cream or regular irish cream | shredded lettuce leaf | saffron
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray or grease the bottom and sides of a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. In a medium sized bowl, mix the potatoes flakes, kielbasa, corn, and sweet potatoes. Pour in irish cream and stir together. Sprinkle with a little saffron. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until heated through. Remove from the oven and transfer to a serving dish. Allow to cool. To serve, place a lettuce leaf on a serving plate, and top with kielbasa fritters.

title: Wild Rice and Dates
ingredients: 1/2 ounce wild rice | 8 ounces medium rice noodles | 1/2 fresh rosemary leaf, chopped | 12 large dates, pitted | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 3 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios, toasted
instructions: Place wild rice in a medium saucepan, add water to cover and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until rice is tender and any remaining water has been absorbed, about 40 minutes. Meanwhile, bring large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add fresh rice noodles, return to boil and cook uncovered 2 minutes, or until just tender. Drain and transfer to a bowl to cool slightly. Remove the stem, and coarsely chop. Place wild rice and dates in a medium saucepan with water to cover. Heat over high heat until boiling, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer until rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 29 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Stir in rosemary, then cool. Stir into rice. Toss and serve in shallow bowls, topped with pistachios.

title: Toasted Phyllo-Wrapped Manchego Cheese
ingredients: 8 strips phyllo-wrapped manchego cheese, thawed ( or you may use any soft cheese like montery jack ) | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup fenugreek, loosely-packed | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon ( plus more for dusting ) | shredded lettuce leaf | 1/2 cup shredded manchego cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place one strip of phyllo on work surface and brush with oil. Sprinkle with some of the fenugreek, cinnamon and more fenugreek if desired. Arrange cheese on top of the fenugreek in an even layer. Top with remaining phyllo strips, brushing. Cut phyllo stack into 8 triangles, arranging at one end of a rectangle measuring 2 x 3. Dust with more cinnamon. Place triangles on a baking sheet using the remaining fenugreek and cinnamon for the topping. Bake for 12 minutes or until phyllo is crisp and golden about 10 minutes. Serve with lettuce and manchego. Variation, to make a filling for a sandwich, combine mayonnaise with mayonnaise, sour cream, honey mustard and a little grated or finely minced parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,gluten baking powder,lumpfish caviar,chinese noodle,lime wedge
title: Lumpfish Creole (Lumpfish) and Chinese Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 3 packages gluten-free baking powder | 10 tablespoons gluten-free lard or 10 tablespoons oil, divided | 1 package lumpfish caviar, drained and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 6 small lime wedges
instructions: In medium bowl, combine baking powder with 2 tablespoons lard or oil and set aside. In large bowl, combine remaining 3 tablespoons lard, caviar, cream and remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Fold in crab meat and set aside for at least 10 minutes. Drain noodle batter well and divide into 12 to 18 smaller pieces. Place about half or more in 13 by 9 inch baking pan as directed in Kugel recipe and spread evenly. Sprinkle with remaining biscuit crumbs. Bake in 450 f. Oven until golden brown and crisp, about 15 minute. Cool for at least 15 minutes before serving. Serve with lime wedges. Note, for a more distinct flavor, spoon 2 - 3 tablespoons of cream into center of noodle and sprinkle with paprika and paprika.

title: Tahini Spiced Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup tahini | 1 vanilla bean, split | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Heat up the tahini. Once it starts getting warm, add the vanilla bean. After you have whisked it with a fork you're going to need to add the cumin and stir it until it turns dark brown, like a lot of the darker brown. Add the tahini on top of the vanilla bean and stir to coat it. Serve with crackers or vegetables.

title: Easy Microwave Sandwiches!!!!!
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mozzarella cheese ( you can buy shredded, if you have some of those handy ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Pierce mozzarella with a knife. Place on a microwave safe dish and microwave on high 4 minutes. Add worcestershire to taste, if desired. Slice mozzarella into 24 slices and add to cheese. Microwave on high 30 seconds to melt cheese. Strew cheese over and put on a plate on the side to cool.

title: Easy Gravy Sauce for Pork..... Once Again, for Leftovers #5FIX
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic ( garlic powder is what i like~i use sambal oelek in particular )
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a bowl. Serve over fresh rolls, meatballs, etc. Enjoy.

title: Simple Seasoned Romano for One or Two Servings
ingredients: 6 -8 tablespoons romano cheese | 1 teaspoon sugar or 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Add grater to dry ingredients and mix thoroughly. Store in a small plastic bag. To serve, place on plate. Top with your favorite cheese.

title: Apricot and Apricot Relish
ingredients: 4 apricots, halved and stoned | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Place the apricot halves, cut side up, into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with the mirin, and drizzle with just enough water to cover the fruit. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,sea salt,tomato juice,paprika,sage,extra virgin olive oil
title: Easy Stove Top Eggplant Caviar
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | sea salt, to taste | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 teaspoon dried sage | paprika, to sprinkle | 1/2 teaspoon good quality extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Wash eggplant and slice thin on the diagonal. Heat oil in a large non stick frying pan. Place a layer of eggplant in pan and cover with another layer of eggplant. Add a little salt and a sprinkling of paprika and extra olive oil. Repeat layers and cook about 5 - 7 minutes until golden on the bottom. Serve with your favourite cheese, tomato, bread or fresh salad.

title: Caribbean-Style Skillet Flank Steak
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tapioca starch | 1 pound flank steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Spray a 4 to 5 quart slow cooker with a cooking spray and sprinkle tapioca flour into the bottom of the pan. Sprinkle steak with coarsely chopped cilantro. Place beef around the edges of the cilantro. Cover insert and cook on low setting 4 to 5 hours. Remove lid, mix in chutney, sprinkle with 2 teaspoons of cilantro, and refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,rice flour,coconut milk,lime,orange zest,red chili pepper,grape juice
title: Cheese Flavoured Besan Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice flour | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 cup grape juice | 1/3 cup orange zest, finely grated | 1 red chili pepper, very finely diced | 1/3 cup fresh lime, finely diced | asiago cheese, roughly grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Mix all ingredients together until batter resembles a very smooth breadcrumb mixture. Place on baking tray. Spray biscuits with oil and bake for about 15 - 23 minutes until pale golden. Cool. Cut into small squares and dust with asiago cheese. Variations, substitute lemon or lime juice for the orange and coconut. Enjoy.

title: Lunchbox Coffee Cake
ingredients: 3 cups self rising flour ( i used dutch's ) | 1 cup hazelnuts, ground | 1 bottle club soda | 1 head lettuce, chopped fine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line an 8 square cake dish with parchment paper or grease. If possible, cover entire dish with a silicon bake or parchment paper and a piece of wax paper that is 2 inches long enough to fit over the entire bottom of the cake pan. In a food processor, mix the flour and ground hazelnuts. Add club soda to the flour and nuts and mix until well combined. Drop batter in the prepared pan. Bake for about 25 minutes. Remove cake from oven and let sit for about 10 minute drain off syrup. Cut into squares and enjoy.

title: Kielbasa With Barley
ingredients: 3 lbs kielbasa | 1 cup pearl barley | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 medium spanish onion, diced
instructions: Cook kielbasa until done. Pour off fat and set aside. Cook rice. In pot add pearl barley and sliced onion. Cover and cook over medium low heat until barley is tender and onion is softened.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,genoa salami,portabella mushroom,hunt tomato sauce,ladyfinger
title: Quick Beef Sirloin Rolls
ingredients: 1/3 lb sliced genoa salami | 1/2 lb sliced portabella mushrooms | 1 can hunts tomato sauce | 1/2 lb sliced beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch pieces | 24 ladyfingers, cut in half
instructions: Cook mushroom and salami in large skillet on med heat until salami browns and mushrooms are tender. Remove to warm plate. Cook sirloin in skillet until browned and cooked through. Combine tomato sauce and beef with cooked sirloin. Spoon beef sauce mixture into a 9x12 inch baking pan. Arrange ladyfingers atop mixture. Bake in 350f oven for 12 - 14 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Basic Tom Ka Salan (Simple Coconut)
ingredients: 400 g light coconut cream | 100 g tomato paste | 1 tablespoon tamarind pulp, crushed
instructions: Heat the coconut cream in a non stick pan on medium heat. When it begins to bubble, add tomato paste and tamarind pulp. Once tomato paste is heated through, add the tamarind pulp. Heat for a further 2 - 3 minutes. Serve warm or refrigerate for a further 1 - 2 hours before serving.

title: Kerry's Spicy Shrimp and Lentils
ingredients: 2 lbs medium raw jumbo shrimp | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 6 tablespoons basil, chopped | 2 tablespoons dried sage, dry rubbed | 2 serrano chilies | 6 dried sage leaves | 1/2 cup red lentil, rinsed
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp, leaving shells intact. Heat oil in a large fry pan over high heat. Add shrimp, basil, sage and chiles, saute, stirring, for 2 minutes. Add rinsed lentils and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, partially cover pan and simmer for 20 minutes. Toss shrimp with lentils and serve.

title: Currant Potato Filling for Perogies
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons pureed chipotle powder | 1/4 cup minced hazelnuts | currants or dates, for topping ( optional ) | 1 cup grated rutabagas ( about 1 ) | 1 cup canola mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon cayenne or chili powder | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 packet prepared filling, such as perogies | 2 tablespoons coconut oil ( optional )
instructions: In med, bowl, mix mayonnaise, chipotle powder, hazelnuts, currants/date mixture and rutabaga. Heat the oil in a small skillet. Add the cayenne or chili powder and italian seasoning. When the oil has reached the correct temp, add the mayonnaise mix. Remove from heat. Stir the mixture well and fill as per your desired size perogie filling instructions.

title: French Fondue
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese ( the kind with no subsitutes ) | 2 ounces chopped pecans
instructions: Place all ingredients in the fondue pot. Bring to a fast simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly. Pour the fondue into a small bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,kielbasa,mace,butternut squash,chocolate chip,tomato green chile pepper
title: Mexican Winter Stew
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 lb butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1 inch slices | 1/3 cup roquefort cheese, cubed | 1/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Grease a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Heat diced tomatoes and green chile peppers in a large pot over medium heat, stirring constantly, until hot, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish, and stir in butternut squash, kale, kielbasa, roasted tomato mixture, roquefort cheese, chocolate chips, and mace. Bake in preheated oven until the squash is tender and the cheese is lightly browned, about 1 hour.

title: Tuna, Roasted Veggie & Date Pies
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles ( roasted peeled seeded peeled and chopped ) | 3 cups textured vegetable protein ( texturized uncooked dried ground textured soy protein ) | 1 cup roasted deli vegetable protein ( texturized uncooked instant ground textured soy protein ) | 1 1/2 cups pitted dates ( chopped coarsely ) | 1 can tuna ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup cilantro | 2 1/2 cups shredded velveeta cheese | 1 1/4 cups rolled oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place poblano peppers on rimmed baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes or until soft. Let cool. Process all vegatables in food processor until almost smooth. If it’s too dry, a spoonful of warm water may form a paste. Stir into remaining vegatables. In 12 cup or size glass baking dish, combine tvp, dates, tuna, cilantro, and cheese. Stir in 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Add oats. Stir til smooth. Spread mixture into prepared pan. Sprinkle with remaining shredded cheese. Bake 15 more minutes or until center has firm edges when lightly pressed.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,graham cracker crumb,lemon zest,cooking spray,tomato puree,pepper,saffron,ginger
title: Granita (Grammy's Favorite)
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs ( plain or flavored ) | 1/2 cup cold ginger | 1/4 cup garlic salt | 1/4 cup lemon zest | 1 pinch saffron | sugar or artificial sweetener, to taste | cooking spray | 2 teaspoons tomato puree ( i used tomato-based ) | pepper
instructions: Blend or process all ingredients until smooth. Spray a non stick pan with cooking spray. Sprinkle with sugar or artificial sweetener, to taste. Heat on medium high. In the first couple of batches, mix mixture until just mixed. Transfer to a 9x13 pan or pie dish. Sprinkle with pepper. Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for about 20 minutes. Note, this also works well with dried fruits. If using ginger, the sugar is added at the end of baking before browning. Also, if using zest, you may need an additional 1/4 t. Water for the browning process.

title: Tropical Pork
ingredients: 1 lb pork fatback | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 3 tablespoons vanilla sugar | guacamole
instructions: Cut fatback into bite size pieces. Mix pork, water chestnuts, and cinnamon together. Dip into guacamole and enjoy.

title: Caribbean Jerk Parsnips
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 tablespoon moroccan mixed spice ( i use mrs. dash mix ) | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed caribbean jerk seasoning or 1 tablespoon mild jerk seasoning | 1 serrano chili, diced
instructions: Slice parsnips, leaving stalk attached at an angle. Place in bowl and mix with dried parsley, moroccan spice, coriander, crushed caribbean seasoning and chopped chile, mix well. Place in airtight container and chill for 1 - 2 hours. Serve over brown rice or with your favourite vegetables.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,flat leaf parsley,peanut butter,whipping cream,kosher salt
title: Crunchy Parsley Semifreddo
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons fine grated lemon zest | 1 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons finely chopped flat leaf parsley ( such as cilantro ) | kosher salt
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine peanuts, zest, cream and parsley. Cover tightly and allow to come to room temperature. Place over medium low heat. When mixture begins to simmer, pour into a bowl and stir in salt.

title: Puerto Rican Beer
ingredients: 2 quarts beer | 1 sprig marjoram, chopped | 3 tablespoons espresso powder, dissolved in | 5 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Pour the beer into a large pot. Place the sprig of marjoram in the beer, bring to a boil, then simmer over low heat for 15 minutes. Strain the hot liquid into another large bowl, discarding the marjoram and marjoram. Stir the chocolate, cocoa powder, and oil into the beer mixture, heat through. Divide in half. Serve warm.

title: Gobi Cheats on Spicy Tomato Squash
ingredients: 1 butternut squash | 3/4 cup tomato puree | ginger powder
instructions: Grate the squash using the coarse blade on the box grater. If the cut is a size bigger in size, grate the squash until you get the same size. Place the squash in a large, microwave safe bowl. Add the tomato puree and 1/2 tbs ginger. Microwave on high for about 2 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir. The ginger should soften some and the squash should be tender enough to eat with your hands. Serve warm with chapatis, naan, rice, bread.

title: Rosemary Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar rosemary leaves, drained well | 2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Stir the rosemary and salt in a bowl until the salt dissolves.

title: Vanilla Lassi
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 1/2 ounces lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | 1 grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Pour into glasses and serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow curry paste,green bell pepper,lite olive oil,beef brisket,banana,chinese five spice powder
title: Jamaican Grilled Beef Brisket #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package lite olive oil, plus | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil | 1 pound beef brisket, trimmed of visible fat ( about 7 pounds ) | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 medium yellow curry paste | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat. Lightly oil the grate. Arrange the brisket on the direct heat and brush with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Grill the brisket, covered, until well browned outside, about 40 minutes. Remove from the grill and set aside. Return the grill to high heat and turn off the heat. Allow the brisket to rest until ready to slice. Slice halfway down the center of the brisket, lengthwise, and then across the grain. Brush each slice with more oil and season with salt and pepper. Place the sliced brisket on the prepared grill. Cook until charred underneath and darkly glazed, 3 to 5 minutes. Slice, arrange on a large platter, and brush with a little olive oil. Spread the bell pepper over each slice. Grill the brisket until browned, about 10 minutes. Slice, and serve with the bell pepper and the curry paste.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,egg,corn kernel,mustard,cashew,water chestnut
title: Chinese Chews for 5
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups cashews ( about 20 whole cashews ) | 2 packages chinese five spice powder | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 3 eggs | 3 tablespoons corn kernels, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line a baking sheet with foil and set aside. Using an electric mixer, finely grind the cashews. Stir in the five spice powder, water chestnuts, eggs, corn kernels, mustard and cashews until well blended. Spoon into a pastry bag fitted with a large star tip. Pipe 2 tablespoons on a lined sheet of parchment paper to form long snake. Using fingers, shape the snake into a star and place on a prepared baking sheet. Repeat until 1/3 of the dough has been used to form log. Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Cool on the baking sheet. Transfer to a wire rack to finish cooling. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

title: Fiery Peanuts for Two Variations
ingredients: 1/2 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons dill weed | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Combine ground green pepper and dill in a small bowl. Stir in oil. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,lima bean,cocktail sauce,herbes de provence,dark chocolate,chicken bouillon cube,red onion
title: Choclo
ingredients: 8 ounces dark chocolate or 8 ounces semisweet chocolate | 1 -2 red onion | 1 cup sweet cocktail sauce | chili powder or chili sauce, to taste | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence, optional ( see note ) | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups frozen lima beans or 1 1/2 cups fresh lima beans, in shell | 2 tablespoons bottled seafood cocktail sauce or 2 tablespoons bottled seafood roe
instructions: Heat griddle over medium high heat. Chop chocolate, onion & sweet cocktail sauce up to 1/2 inch or smaller, depending on size and size of chocolate.

title: Penne Pasta With Ghee and Caramelized Carob Peppers
ingredients: 12 ounces penne pasta or 12 ounces spiral shaped pasta, preferably whole-wheat | 3 tablespoons ghee or 3 tablespoons butter
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,whipping cream,hot green chili pepper,sambal oelek,pecorino romano cheese,peach
title: Spiced Peaches
ingredients: 8 large hot green chili peppers | 4 ounces philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 package pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1/4 cup sambal oelek | chopped peach, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut green chiles in half and remove seeds. Arrange chiles in a single layer on paper towels. Pat them dry. Set aside. In heavy medium bowl, beat softened cream with electric mixer on medium speed until combined. Blend in cream cheese. Beat in romano, sambal oelek and pecorino. Gently fold in chiles and fruit. Chill for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: harissa,pinto bean,spaghetti sauce,beer,cherry,heavy cream,pickle relish,chicken wing
title: Chicken and Pintos
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 container heavy cream | 1/4 cup sweet pickle relish | 10 ounces chicken wings | 1 jar chopped pintos | 32 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1/2 bottle beer | 1 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Place dry beans in a large saucepan, and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender but still firm, about 15 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Place half of the pintos in a single layer on the baking sheet. In a bowl, stir together cream, pickle relish, chicken wings, pintos, spaghetti sauce, beer, and harissa. Arrange remaining pintos over the pintos to cover the top. Bake in the preheated oven until pintos begin to soften and are deep golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Carnivian Country Burger
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1/2 lb ziti pasta | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 3 hamburger buns | 2 tablespoons mustard | 2 -3 tablespoons mustard, sweet & grainy dijon mustard sauce for dipping
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water, until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, mix the hamburger together with the pasta, jam, and mustard sauce.

title: Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 liter chicken stock | 500 g gruyere | 100 g pistachios ( or cashews ) | 10 green seedless grapes | 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Bring stock to boil, add gruyere and bring back to boil again. Turn down heat and add pistachios, grapes and brown sugar. Cook for 40 minutes or until gruyere is soft.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,garlic,celery,garlic powder,pork loin roast,sesame seed,margarine
title: Grape Leaves for Pork, Beef or Chicken and Vegetables (Kalama Zijo)
ingredients: 2 cans english cucumbers or ( 6 ounce ) cans regular cucumbers | 2 lbs boneless pork loin roast ( about two pounds ) | 3 tablespoons light margarine, melted | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon celery, minced
instructions: Cut pork into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Add 1/2 cup melted margarine, sesame seeds, garlic, garlic powder, celery, and remaining 1/2 cup melted margarine. Mash together with a fork. If too dry and not creamy, add more margarine to moisten. Stuff into grape leaves or place on a flat baking sheet. If too wet, add more margarine, if too dry, add more grape leaves. Brush with remaining melted margarine. Preheat oven to 400°f. Bake 25 - 30 minutes til hot, bubbly and tender.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,brown onion,bow tie pasta,tomato puree
title: Azerbaijani (Spicy Tomato Soup)
ingredients: 100 g chopped brown onions | 1/8 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 can tomatoes puree | 300 g bow tie pasta
instructions: Cook onion until transparent. Add saffra and cook for another 5 minutes. Add tomato puree and pasta and mix thoroughly. Serve and enjoy.

title: Baked Tomato Cookies
ingredients: 3 cans peeled italian-style tomatoes | 3 cups all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons coconut extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together tomatoes, flour, coconut extract, and coconut. Drop cookies by rounded tablespoons into the coconut oil. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole whole chickens, cut into thighs | 1 1/2 cups malt vinegar | 1 cup sour cream ( your choice-y ) | 1 cup vinegar
instructions: Wash chicken with cold water.

title: Cheese Toast - Indian Style
ingredients: 4 small slices cheese | 2 pinches asafoetida powder, or as it is called in hindi ( hing ) | 1 piece ginger root, peeled and grated | 1 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Use a frying pan which is flat enough to spread the cheese on the bread slices. Spread 1 teaspoon of asafoetida powder on the bottom of the pan. Spread the cheese slices on half of the sliced cheese slices. Place the remaining slices of cheese on top. Spread the asafoetida on the remaining sliced cheese. Microwave for 2 minutes, then another couple of minutes on high. Use a skewer if you can poke holes along the top of the cheese. Remove from the microwave and serve hot with indian style flatbreads. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,italian herb seasoning,ham,fettuccine pasta,mace,cream tartar,italian turkey sausage
title: Fettuccine with Hot Sausage
ingredients: 2 cups cooked fettuccine pasta | 1 lb hot italian turkey sausage | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian herb seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Cook and drain fettuccine according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, brown sausage, stirring to separate. Drain. Stir cream of tartar, mace, herb seasoning, italian herb spice and italian seasoning into cooked, drained pasta. Add sausage and pasta to skillet. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,japanese eggplant,white wine vinegar,silken tofu,white cheddar cheese
title: Tofu Sticks (Shoga Kake)
ingredients: 2 japanese eggplants, peeled | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 cup silken tofu | 1/2 cup white cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Cut ends off eggplants and cut into strips about 1/4 inch wide. Scoop out and discard seeds. Place flesh on a cutting board and cut the crosswise into 2 inch long thin strips. In a medium mixing bowl, toss eggplant with vinegar, garlic and coriander seeds to coat, tossing to combine. Place half the tofu in a medium baking dish and arrange eggplant on top. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Dot with remaining tofu and top with remaining cheddar. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 20 minutes or until beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,coconut cream,dark rum,chicken bouillon,maple flavoring,pepper sauce
title: Coconut-Coconut-Rum Soft Tacos
ingredients: 2 cans coconut cream | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 1/4 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( i use tabasco ) | 8 -10 soft flour tortillas | 1 dash maple flavoring
instructions: In a large bowl, combine undrained coconut cream, rum, bouillon, 1 tsp of hot pepper sauce. Stir in 1 tsp of maple flavoring. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread 1/8 of soft tortillas in a single layer on the foil. Bake at 400°f for 5 minutes. Flip and bake for 5 minutes more or until lightly browned. Serve with coconut cream, sweet onions, and guacamole. Variation, use 1 can coconut cream and 1 cup of the cream mixed with 1 cup coconut milk and 1/2 cup dark rum, for a more authentic flavor, add 1 1/4 tsp of chili powder. If you're really daring, serve in an iron skillet.

title: Lasagna Rollups
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles, preferably homemade | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup minced of fresh mint
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water, until al dente, about 5 minutes. Rinse with cold water.

title: Gengri Cilantro
ingredients: 1/2 piece ginger | 1/4 kg coriander root, peeled, washed and finely chopped ( cilantro )
instructions: Wash the grated ginger. Trim off any remaining rind. Slice the ginger in thin julienne strips, about 1cm wide. Grind the grated ginger to a fine powder using grinder blade or mortar and pestle. Add the grated coriander roots and fresh coriander root and mix lightly to make a fine paste. Place the cayenne pepper in the centre of a piece of foil long enough to envelope the paste. Pour the paste into the centre of the foil and seal it tightly. Fold the foil up firmly and place in a roasting pan. Put a little water on top and bake in a pre heated oven at 120c/fan 120c/gas 4 for 1 hour 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and take the foil off. Serve with rice or indian breads.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,taco seasoning,salt pepper,vodka,chickpea flour,stewing beef,rice,green cardamom
title: Crock Pot (Tikong) Beef Tips & Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup paprika kikoman soy seasoning | 1 can chickpea flour | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 can vodka ( absolut rose brand ) | 5 green cardamoms | 3 celery ribs, diced | 1/2 quartered red potatoes ( optional ) | 1 bunch celery rib ( optional ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot. Cook on high 4 - 6 hours, or low for 8 - 10 hours. Serve over noodles, rice or pasta.

title: Red Cabbage Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted rice ( indian or caribbean style is best ) | 2 lbs cabbage, shredded | 1 lb red cabbage, shredded | 1 large cucumber, sliced thin | 4 fresh rosemary sprigs, snipped ( or 1/2 tsp dry crushed dried rosemary, rubbed between fingers to release the flavor ) | 1 1/4 lbs red chilies, halved lengthwise and seeded ( optional ) | 12 small corn tortillas, to serve ( or 6 small corn-flour tortillas about 6-inches in diameter ) | lime slice ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Cool to room temperature. Rice keeps well for up to 2 days. To serve, reheat rice according to package directions. To serve, spread about 1/2 cup of cabbage lettuce on each warm tortilla. Top with about 2 tablespoons of cabbage. Sprinkle each with about 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon cracked black pepper. Top with about 1 - 2 tablespoons red cabbage, 2 tablespoons red cabbage, and 1/3 cup sliced cucumber. Arrange 3 or 4 chili halves over the lettuce and sprinkle with 1/8 teaspoon dried rosemary. Fold in sides and roll up. Repeat as above with remaining ingredients and filling. Top with lime slices.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,dark raisin,sugar cube,hoagie,acorn squash,cauliflower floret,calorie mayonnaise
title: Acorn Squash, Cauliflower and Raisins
ingredients: 12 ounces acorn squash ( trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 cup cauliflower floret ( leaves and stems removed ) | 12 ounces sugar cubes | 1/2 cup low calorie mayonnaise | 4 tablespoons dark raisins | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 4 hoagie rolls
instructions: Place squash and cauliflower in a medium saucepan, cover with water and add the sugar cubes. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Lower temperature to medium and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 35 minutes. Meanwhile, in a food processor or blender, blend together raisins through garam masala until smooth. Stir raisin mixture and mayonnaise into squash mixture until blended. Serve the squash mixture over the hoagies.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,marjoram,cocoa powder,garam masala powder,red food coloring,lingonberry
title: Mixed Forest Beef Roast or Shanks
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck roast or 2 lbs shank, trimmed | 1 cup dried marjoram | 1 tablespoon dried garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon mild red food coloring, divided | 1/4 cup light cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons powdered cocoa powder or 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Place roast in a shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle with marjoram, garam masala and 1/4 teaspoon of red food coloring. Using your hands, rub spice mixture into meat and allow to marinate at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350°. Unwrap meat and arrange on a rack in a roasting pan or baking pan. Roast for about 2 hours, basting occasionally, or until meat thermometer registers 150 to 155° in the center of the meat when inserted in the middle, internal temperature of meat is 120° or f, depending on the size of the roast. Remove roast from oven, let rest and come to room temperature, and cover loosely with aluminum foil. Place pan in a large roasting pan, weighted down with 1 cup boiling water, and bake until internal temperature reaches 170°. Remove roast from pan, cover loosely with aluminum foil and let rest 30 minutes. Place rack in center of oven and roast until thermometer registers 120° or an instant read thermometer registers remove to cool to room temperature before slicing, then remove roast and place on platter. When meat has cooled, slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. For frosting, heat 2 tablespoons of cream in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly until all the cream is dissolved. Remove from heat, stir in 2 tablespoons of powdered cocoa and 2 tablespoons of confectioner's sugar. Return to heat and cook about 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Spread the frosting on the meat before slicing.

title: Fruit Skewers (Meat Skewers)
ingredients: 2 lbs minced meat | 1 cup chopped dried fruit ( okra )
instructions: Soak the dried fruit in water for 1 hour, drain and squeeze out any excess liquid. Mix the meat with the soaked fruit and thread onto skewers. Soak overnight in hot water. Add hot water to cover. Cover and place on a plate in a bowl so the skewer can sit flat. Soak for 1 hour. Turn frequently. Note, it will take about 3 - 4 hours for a tender meat that won't shrink during cooking.

title: Raisins and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried raisins | 1/4 lb sliced almonds | 1 teaspoon savory
instructions: Soak the raisins in room temperature water and place in a bowl with all the other ingredients. Mix well.

title: Coconut-Olive Flatbread and Fritters
ingredients: 400 g canned unsweetened coconut milk | 2/3 cup cake flour ( not self-rising ) | 20 kalamata olives, rinsed and halved
instructions: Heat coconut milk in a shallow saucepan. Combine the flour and 1 cup coconut milk, stir into rest until smooth. Add olives to mixture, and stir until well mixed. Using two wooden spoons, stir dough into coconut milk. Heat a nonstick frying pan over moderate heat. Spread reserved coconut milk evenly on a flatbread plate. Using a fork, flatten dough lightly with the bottom of the frying pan, using the back of a spatula. Cut wedges, separating and separating each wedge slightly so it remains slightly flat. Gently lift wedges and place on warm flatbread on the plate. Sprinkle remaining coconut milk on top, and serve immediately.

title: Sweet Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 2 cups sugar snap peas | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing )
