instructions: Peel and cut each snap pea in half lengthwise. Sprinkle with asafoetida powder and put in saucepan. Add two cups water and bring to boil. Turn down heat and simmer 10 to 15 minutes until water is gone. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sugar cube,chipotle chile,pumpkin seed,fettuccine,rye bread,celery,kaffir lime leaf
title: Chipotle Fettuccine With Pumpkin Seeds, Kaffir Lime & Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 1 lb dry fettuccine, preferably finger shaped | 3 pinches sugar cubes | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 3 stalks celery, chopped ( i like the sweet stuff ) | 1 large chipotle chile, finely chopped ( use your discretion, i prefer el mexiceto adjust this ) | 1 -2 fresh kaffir lime leaf, to taste ( optional ) | rye bread or pita bread, for serving
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cut a hole in the side of each fettucine and fill with a couple of pinches of sugar. If using a wooden spoon and/or a sturdy spoon, gently scrape the insides into the boiling water. When the fettuccine is about half cooked, add the chicken to the water and cook for a few minutes or until the shells float. Remove immediately and set aside. Add the remaining pinches of sugar to water and bring to a full boil. Stir occasionally. Drain and rinse the fettuccine and return to the pot. Add a generous helping of the chicken to the pasta and toss. Serve with rye bread for dipping.

title: Anchovies in Ricotta Sauce
ingredients: 1 can anchovies, drained with oil reserved | 4 ounces ricotta cheese
instructions: Rinse anchovies and pat dry with paper towels. In large serving bowl, mix anchovies with ricotta cheese. Dredge archovies lightly. Makes 8 servings.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,vegetable stock,extra beef,mango,golden syrup,garbanzo bean,icing sugar,whipping cream
title: Mango Meatballs and Mango Lidlicky Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 900 ml vegetable stock | 1 bunch mango, peeled and roughly chopped ( about 2lb ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 300 g ground extra lean beef | 125 g roasted garbanzo beans, rinsed well and drained | 150 ml whipping cream ( light or dark ) | 4 tablespoons semisweet chocolate, grated ( optional )
instructions: Combine sugar and 1 - 2 tbsp water in a small, heavy based saucepan, using a low heat. Bring to a boil, stirring regularly, and boil for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Stir in remaining ingredients, including 2 tbsp boiling water. Cook over low heat, stirring regularly, for up to an hour, stirring regularly, until thick and creamy and smooth. Pour into individual bowls and refrigerate until solid. Tip, when i make this at my house it makes it a lot easier later on, especially if the fat content is low. This is even better the next day.

title: Tortillas of the Devil
ingredients: 4 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon coconut nectar or 1 tablespoon ketjap manis | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon ketchup and mango jelly | 1/4 ounce bittersweet chocolate syrup | 1/4 ounce toasted sultana
instructions: Place the chicken and sauces in a large bowl. Toss with the mango jelly, sultanas and chocolate syrup until the mixture is coated well. Heat a large, shallow frying pan over medium high heat. Add a little oil. When hot, add half the chicken mixture. Cook, stirring, for 3 minutes. Turn chicken and coat with the sauce. Serve the tortillas sprinkled with toasted sultanas.

Random Ingredients: black olive,turmeric powder,ginger garlic paste,beef brisket
title: Easy Beef Tarkari
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 tablespoon black olive, whole pitted | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder ( more or less to your taste )
instructions: Place trimmed brisket in refrigerator while preparing other ingredients and preparation as follows, place remaining ingredients in a zip lock freezer bag, except brisket and olives. Close bag, turning to coat all sides evenly. Allow bag to sit at room temperature for 1 - 2 hours to marinate. Turn over and refrigerate brisket for at least 4 hours or overnight. If desired, place brisket on a grill pan on an open grill directly over medium heat and grill over medium heat to preferred doneness. Grill for 45 - 50 minutes or until desired doneness with desired results. I like to use a meat thermometer to check for doneness, which is approximately 150 degrees f for medium doneness and 150 degrees f for medium doneness. When meat is done, reserve 2 - 3 tbs. Of juice and cut into slices.

title: Kerstompson Plum Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless turkey breast | 1 lb deep frying oil
instructions: Rinse turkey thoroughly, inside and out, and pat dry with paper towels. Cut lengthwise into 1 inch wide strips, and tie legs together with kitchen twine. Heat oil and fry the turkey slices until a rich rich, golden brown color. Turn frequently, making sure to oil the outside of the rolls. Place a deep fryer or large deep bowl of ice cold water nearby. Have a large platter handy to dip the rolls into cold water before serving.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,deli ham,cilantro leaf,baking powder,bacon,gluten flour,yellow bell pepper
title: Lentil and Ham Potato Cake
ingredients: 4 ounces bacon, chopped | 4 ounces yellow bell peppers, chopped | 8 ounces deli ham, cut into small cubes | 1 3/4 ounces gluten-free flour | 1 1/2 ounces gluten-free flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 4 tablespoons cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | gluten-free flour, for dusting baking | 1 ounce red lentil, rinsed
instructions: Preheat your oven to 390°f. Place the bacon in a medium size ovenproof dish that is just large enough to place the ham into. Pour the olive oil into a large frying pan, or use a pastry brush to drizzle. Add the bell peppers and ham. Cook until browned and crispy. Remove from the heat and add the white flour. Mix well. Sprinkle over the flour the 1 1/2 ounce of flour and combine. Add the baking powder to the lentils and mix well. Add the lentils to the flour mixture making sure they are covered with dough. It may be a bit globular, but it all comes together into a dough like dough. If you use fresh basil, toss it through the dish just before placing the bread onto the oven rack. When your oven is heated, spray a cake rack with non stick cooking spray. Spoon 1 ounce of flour on the baking rack and bake for 10 - 12 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly. Watch carefully, because the bread can burn. Remove from the oven and let sit a few minutes. Cut into small bite size pieces and serve warm or cold. This is wonderful topped with some sliced avocado, sour cream or salsa.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,sirloin,gruyere cheese,peanut oil,saffron thread,fruit cocktail,mint leaf,kale
title: Gruyere & Kale Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 400 g sirloin, boneless, trimmed, sliced thinly on diagonal | 1 packet kale, washed or 2 medium kale | 200 g mixed dried fruit cocktail or 200 g mixed fruit cocktail | 75 g gruyere cheese, finely grated | 100 g golden syrup | 1 saffron thread, soaked in a little warm water | 40 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Heat the oil in a roasting tin, add the beef and cook on one side for 3 mins or until browned. Turn the beef, add the kales and cook for an additional 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside. Add the fruit cocktail or cocktail to the pan and cook, covered, for 5 minutes or until the fruit starts to soften. Add the gruyere, golden syrup and saffron and cook for 1 - 2 mins or until the cheese melts. Pour over the beef. Add the mint and stir. Transfer the salad to the oven and cook for 1 hr, or until it is hot and bubbling. Serve hot.

title: Bourbon Applesauce
ingredients: 8 apples, peeled, cored and finely diced | 1 shallot, minced | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Mix apples and shallot in a large bowl. Stir in cream of chicken soup. Cover, and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Cuban Black Bean Sandwich(Sopa Seca)
ingredients: 1 bag of thick french bread ( i prefer white bread which is thicker, but you can use any crusty bread that you prefer ) | 1 can beans, drained canned ( use 2-3 cans ) | 1/2 cup shredded cheese, or | salt and pepper | 1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Cut your french bread in half lengthwise.. Spray the inside of the bread with cooking spray and put the two halves cut side up on a baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes or until the bread is crisp and lightly browned, turning once or twice. Meanwhile, drain the beans and pour into a small bowl. Sprinkle the cheese over the top of the beans. Cover with about 1/3 cup crushed ice and stir.. Spread a small amount of the cheese over the top of the cheese and bread, if desired. Sprinkle the top with pepper. Serve.

title: Oregon Country Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 3/4 cup black coffee | 6 skinned, boneless salmon | 12 slices pepperoni | 1 corn on the cob, shucked
instructions: In a shallow pan over medium heat, combine the black coffee and salmon. Place salmon onto the coffee, close securely, and allow to marinate for 10 minutes. Preheat a grill for high heat. Remove salmon from marinade, and grill until firm, about 8 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: saffron,leek,caster sugar,basil leaf,no boil lasagna noodle,celery,beef stew meat
title: Pisto - Crock Pot Beef Ragu
ingredients: 600 g beef stew meat | 1 cup chopped leek or 1 cup chopped onion | 1 cup chopped celery ( use 1/2 cup onion and 2 tablespoons celery leaves, if you prefer ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves | 18 no-boil lasagna noodles ( from the freezer- recommended on the packet ) | 1/3 cup caster sugar
instructions: Trim off any fat from beef. Place beef in the crockpot. Cover with leek or onion, celery and saffron. Sprinkle basil and dried basil over. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. To thicken, stir in a little cornstarch dissolved in 2/3 cup boiling water. Cover and cook for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook noodles as per instructions on pack and drain. To serve, place a layer of noodles in each of four serving bowls. Top with meat mixture and sauce.

title: Fantastic Balsamic Bacon Wraps (For Diabetics)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed and dried | 1 gala apples or 1 g other dark apple, chopped fine | 1 teaspoon salt ( or to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground mustard | 1/8 teaspoon ground thyme | 2 teaspoons ground flax seeds ( optional ) | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh chopped basil
instructions: Shred or chop lettuce or remove any large pieces of the lettuce. Grate apple into small pieces. In a small bowl, stir together the salt, mustard, thyme, ground spices, flaxseed slivers, fresh basil, and chopped apple. Add to the dressing, toss and place lettuce/apple mixture in a napkin lined bowl. Serve with warm french bread / crostini &/or good pumpernickel bread. The salad is best just before serving.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,poblano chile,red lentil,limeade concentrate,purpose flour,tomatillo
title: Potato-And-And-Rajas Style Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes ( idaho or white ) | 6 poblano chiles | 2 1/2 lbs tomatillos | 1 cup red lentil | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Wash and cut potatoes and poblano peppers into quarters.

title: Crock Pot Corned Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb corned beef or 1 -1 1/2 lb corned beef brisket | 1 can coconut milk | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix
instructions: Brown brisket inside and out on the stove. Drain. Add coconut milk and taco seasoning as directed on taco seasoning package. Cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours but check on meat at 8 - 10 hours and remove brisket from crock pot as per directions. Serve with warm corn tortillas and your favorite taco toppings.

title: Spanish Clam Balls
ingredients: 2 cans of chopped tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can of diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can of chopped clams with juice | 1 egg, beaten | 1 teaspoon of minced salt, if desired
instructions: Put a large frying pan on medium heat. Pour all ingredients into frying pan until mixture begins to boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Do not uncover until all ingredients are hot, stir and serve hot.

title: Yule Log
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon low-sodium instant vanilla extract | 1/4 cup fresh sage leaves, chopped
instructions: Whisk yolks and vanilla in top of double boiler until just blended. Strain through fine mesh sieve into bowl. Add sage and beat until just blended. Cover. Refrigerate up to 2 days. Position rack in upper third of oven.

title: Bamboo Shoot Balls (Hot and Spicy!)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Stir the cocoa powder and bamboo shoots together in the skillet, then let simmer 1 to 2 minutes. Form the mixture into 1 inch balls and drop them into the simmering sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: habanero pepper,oil,self rising flour,chili powder,lobster,tomato green chilies,seasoning,plum
title: Robondrick's Seafood Fry Bread
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon oil | 1 kg medium mackerel | 1 large ripe tomatoes with green chilies | 1 habanero pepper | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 3/4 teaspoons chili powder | 250 g crushed plum | 1 tablespoon seasoning
instructions: Heat oil in a frying pan and fry the crab legs until well browned. Cut into bite sized chunks. Slice the tomato into bite sized segments. Remove the skin from the chilies if you find them. Cut the habenero pepper into 1/2 inch long strips. Take the crab legs out of the frying pan and fry again. Remove crab legs from pan and cut into chunks. Heat up the oil in the pan and fry the tomato pieces, garlic and peppers, until soft, but not mushy. Add the flour. Stir this mixture, and add the can of diced tomatoes and chillies. Season with salt and black pepper. Place the crab in a greased baking tin. Fill each crab chunk with this mixture. Mix together the crushed plum and paprika, and layer this on top of the crab and tomato mixture. Leave a 1/2 cm border of crusty bread in the top of the baking tin. Bake at 400°f/190°c for 40 minutes or until golden and crisp. Serve with a salad of warm bread, chunky salsa, and tomato and chilli pate.

Random Ingredients: cracker crumb,beef sirloin steak,italian herb seasoning,pear,white flour
title: Pear Crusted Steak
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak | 2/3 cup cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian herb seasoning | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/2 cup pear, peeled & chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the grill to med/high. Cut the steak into serving size pieces. Spread the cracker crumbs in a shallow dish. Season the pieces of beef with a little of the herb seasoning. Roll the pieces in the crumbs. Grill on high 4 - 5 minutes each side or until the crumbs are golden. Serve.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,whipping cream,masala,lobster,tagliatelle pasta noodle,turnip,pineapple juice
title: Creamy Lobster Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 can lobster, drained and juice reserved | 8 3/4 ounces lobster rolls, sliced thin | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon masala | 1 tablespoon whipping cream | 1/2 cup sweet unsalted butter | sour cream | fresh thyme sprig | lobster tail | powdered sugar
instructions: Place crab meat and liquid in large bowl. Add lobster. Let flavors meld just a few minutes. Serve over pasta.

title: Sukh - Malaysian Parsnip Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis or 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons potato flour or 2 tablespoons sifted cornflour | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves | 3 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Cut the parsnips lenghtwise and then into 1/4 slices. Pour boiling water over them to cover the parsnips. Set aside and leave to stand. In a bowl mix the tomatos with the ketjap manis, potato flour and tahini. Toss the parsnips and their cooking liquid into the mixture. Mix well. Heat a frying pan, add some oil and heat to smoking point. Turn the heat down and fry the cactus chips for at least 2 or 3 minutes until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Serve with dipping sauce of your choice.

title: Tandoori Ranch Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup ranch dressing | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric ( optional )
instructions: In a glass bowl, mix together the ranch dressing and turmeric. Whisk in a few pinches of ground turmeric.

title: Creamy Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1/2 pound cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning mix
instructions: To make mushroom dip, place sliced mushrooms in a blender. Blend in apricot jam and taco seasoning mix until thoroughly mixed. Spoon mushroom mixture into a medium glass casserole dish and cover with plastic wrap. Chill in the refrigerator, about 1 hour.

title: Maikon Radish and Daikon Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1/4 cup sifted onion powder | 1 1/2 lbs daikon radishes
instructions: Boil, in an 8 quart saucepan of salted water, radish heads and skins for 10 minutes. Remove, drain and dry with paper towels. Cut in half crosswise and remove and discard root and all hair. Cut out as much of the hard rib from the root end and discard. Cut the root vegetables into very thin slices about 1/8 inch thick. Cook linguine at a boil. Drain. Mix in onion or other herbs. Serve at once, making sure they stay on hand for as long as possible.

title: Real Tequila Onion Bruschetta
ingredients: 12 slices white bread | 3 tablespoons tequila | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 spanish onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Cut bread lengthwise into quarters, being careful not to tear the bread. Spread a thin layer of tequila on each quarter, top with a sprinkling of oregano. Layer with onions. Repeat.

Random Ingredients: mint,gruyere cheese,ramen noodle,mozzarella cheese,flax seed,prawn,bay leaf,asafoetida powder
title: Korean Spiced Prawn Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground prawns | 1 tablespoon salted butter | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 small bay leaf | 1/3 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/3 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 package crispy ramen noodles ( or equivalent seasoning ) | 1/4 cup ground flax seed, for coating
instructions: Pour ½ cup of hot tap water in a small, large nonstick pan. Add prawns and stir to coat, set aside. Heat remaining ½ cup of tap water in pan. Add asafoetida, bay leaf and cheese. Stir until cheese melts and has melted. Remove from heat and mix in noodles with seasoning. Fill into a lightly floured 1½ cup size zip top bag. Shake the bag to distribute mixture evenly through bag. Refrigerate overnight or up to 4 hours, or up to 2 days. Preheat nonstick griddle or skillet over medium high heat for 30 seconds. Brush korean metal colander with oil. Remove kellogg bag from refrigerator and remove excess air from mixture so that it will sit flat on griddle or skillet. Place 1 teaspoon of meat mixture on greased griddle or skillet and cook until prawns turn opaque, 3 to 5 minutes. Flip and continue cooking until prawns are golden and cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat, sprinkle with ground flax seeds and serve immediately.

title: Italian Pepper and Onion Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 medium cooking onion | 1 medium bell pepper | 1/2 cup fresh porcini mushrooms, sliced | 2 -3 fresh basil leaves, cut into small pieces
instructions: Chop the onion and bell pepper into small thin slices on a peeler using a coarse grate setting. Set aside. Cook the mushrooms on the grill about 3 minutes per side, or until the onion and pepper are softened, then set aside to keep warm. If using a gas grill, cook them until the mushrooms look all blistered and the pepper is blistered, about 4 - 5 minutes. Add the mushroom and basil and cook about 2 minutes, stirring so the basil doesn't burn. Eat immediately.

title: The World's Best Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin, ground | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa, for stir-frying | 2 tablespoons chinese rice wine, for sweetening
instructions: Heat large saucepan over medium heat. Stir ground cumin, unsweetened cocoa and chinese rice wine in saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently until the flavors have blended, about 4 minutes.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork and Cabbage for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 8 cups green cabbage, chopped | 4 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 4 cups chicken broth
instructions: Cut the pork into 1 inch chunks and place in the crock pot. Add the cabbage, worcestershire sauce and broth. Cook on low for 5 to 6 hours.

title: Crispy Blue Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 ounces blue cheese | 2/3 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon pure tamarind paste
instructions: With an electric beater, blend blue cheese, almond extract and tamarind paste. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving with crisp crisp crackers.

title: Elva's Homemade English Bread
ingredients: 1 lb loaf crusty baguette | 1 egg white | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/2 cup hickory chips or 1/2 cup dill
instructions: Slice baguette vertically into 3 equal slices. Dip bread into the egg white and mustard. Stack a few slices on waxed paper so they stick together and dry out while bread gets too wet. Spread with chips. Keep stack at room temperature until ready to eat. These can be made a couple of days in advance. Variation, instead of mustard mix 1 heaping tsp dry mustard with 1/2 tsp of dill. Also, toast bread using any amount of dry mustard and 1 - 2 tsp cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: red grape,chili sauce,puff pastry,shrimp,lamb,italian plum tomato,cayenne pepper
title: Pot-Roasted Shrimp & Fresh Grape Leaves
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 1/2 lbs shrimp, defrosted if frozen | 1/3 cup sweet pupate ( frozen, thawed if frozen ) or 1/3 cup red grapes ( frozen, thawedif frozen ) | 1/4 lb lamb ( or poultry of your choice ) or 1/4 lb chicken ( or poultry of your choice ) | 5 italian plums, cut in halves | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven 425°f mix the chili sauce with the shrimp and refrigerate 30 minutes or until shrimp are pink and coated. Place the plums in a single layer on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Season each tomato half with salt and sprinkle with cayenne and toss. Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Spread the shrimp mixture evenly over the tomato halves. Bake about 15 minutes, until shrimp are done and tomatoes are tender and the filling is warm and beginning to brown. Let cool to room temperature. Place the frozen puff pastry sheets on a baking sheet and top with a single layer of shrimp mixture, and bake 20 minutes or bake in a 425f oven 10 minutes for the shrimp. Remove from oven, top with grape leaves and serve, with a side salad of green salad made with chopped mixed greens.

title: Lemon Horseradish Dessert Topping for a Cold Sushi
ingredients: 1 lb fresh creamy horseradish | 1 lb fresh ladyfinger | grated romano cheese | grenadine
instructions: Drain juice from cream cheese into a small, wide container and mix well. Dip the ladyfingers, soaked in hot water, into whipped creamy horseradish mixture, and then roll them around the grated cheese. Enjoy and have fun dipping into sushi.

title: Bakewell's Baklava
ingredients: 1 red onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon honey | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 2 teaspoons coconut oil | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 10 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Saute onions in oil.

title: Baked Rack of Lamb With Arugula
ingredients: 2 racks of lamb, from the short braise ( ask your butcher to do this ) | 16 -20 small arugula leaves ( not rocket ) | poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f remove the membrane at one end of the lamb racks using a sharp knife. Score an x with a sharp knife into the lamb, leaving a 1/2 inch thick space on one side for each rack to rise. Spread the poppy seeds over the top of the lamb and set aside. Slice the arugula leaves crosswise and place on a platter. Lay the lamb out between sheets of parchment paper and flatten with your thumb or something similar. Brush on some poppy seeds. Place the lamb rack in a roasting pan, skin side down. Put a sheet of parchment on top and lightly sprinkle with salt. Roast for about 25 to 30 minutes, until golden brown. Place the lamb on a cutting board. Let stand for 5 minutes and cut into slices to serve. Serve with roasted arugula and a glass of vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,kaffir lime leaf,bay leaf,mint leaf,half cream,nonfat cottage cheese
title: Mint Sauerkraut With Kaffir Lime Ice-Cream
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut, drained | 1 cup nonfat cottage cheese, divided | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup minced fresh mint leaves | 1 bay leaf | 1 -2 finely chopped fresh kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Drain sauerkraut & place it in a strainer or cheesecloth lined strainer over 2 cups of ice. Allow excess liquid to freeze to 5 lbs or up to 3 months.

title: Calypy Phyllo Roll Ups
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean rump steak | 4 frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 can condensed chicken soup | 1 dried ancho chile
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Slice meat thinly. Cut the phyllo into long strips about 2 inches wide and about 12 inches long. Place 2 phyllo strips on a lightly floured board and lightly brush with vegetable spray. Place about 2 teaspoons of the meat on top of the phyllo, pressing it down slightly. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of the soup and sliced ancho on top of that, then fold each strip of phyllo over the meat. Tuck in the length of the strips, and brush top. Fold the phyllo strips together and pinch together the edges of the strips to make a long, even sheet of phyllo. Repeat layers. Bake in middle of oven for about 40 minutes, or until very crisp. Cut the roll ups into squares and serve, or chill, cut into wedges, with gravy. Note, you may want to make these a few days in advance, and they freeze well.

title: Tomato and Fennel Soup
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach leaves | 3 fennel bulbs, sliced into thin rounds | 6 cups water | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 tablespoon peeled grated fresh lemongrass | 1 medium tomatoes, sliced | freshly grated coconut
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the spinach, fennel, water, fish sauce, lemon grass and tomato. Bring to boiling, lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add coconut and cook for 1 minute longer. Let cool in the broth.

title: Mexican Macaroni and Avocado
ingredients: 1 lb elbow macaroni or 1 lb other small shell pasta | 1 1/2 cups of diced avocados | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 - 1 cup cointreau liqueur ( or any other brandy or orange liqueur that you feel would be good-enough ) | 1 -2 teaspoon rice wine ( or any dry white wine )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions as directed on the package i use bowties for this recipe, but i usually just steam the pasta. After the 10 minutes, drain the pasta then toss it with 2/3 of the avocado. Add the remaining ingredients except the last 1/3 of the avocado& serve.

title: Tamarind Glazed Beef
ingredients: 1 kg steak, cut into 3cm cubes or 1 kg blade steak, cut into 3cm cubes | 1 large onion, chopped or 1 cup finely chopped onion | 1/2 cup pure wesson tamarind pulp | 1/4 cup garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Place all ingredients except berries into a lrg saucepan& heat slowly, stirring constantly, until boiling. Cover and boil over low heat 3 - 5 mins while constantly turning and adding water as necessary to prevent sticking. When boiling have a bowl of hot water ready{preferably tupperware}. When the water starts boiling remove the lid and immediately pour off the water. Mix well and allow the meat to sit undisturbed in the water. Keep this on 'low heat' for 3 mins or so. Remove the lid and pour off the water from the pot. Allow this to cool. Poke holes all over the meat with a skewer. Set aside. Cook over a medium heat for 2 3mins or till the meat is cooked and tender.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,beef steak,grain rice,egg substitute,cardamom powder,fruit
title: Rice-Soaked Korean Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef flank steak or 2 lbs leftover beef, sliced into thin strips | 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons cardamom powder or 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1 egg substitute | 12 cups cold cooked short-grain rice ( preferably white ) | 1 bag frozen mixed mixed fruit ( optional )
instructions: Place the beef strips into a zipper type plastic bag. Pour the flour into a large resealable plastic bag or dutch oven. Gently pound the beef with a rolling pin or kitchen shears. Combine the beef and any accumulated juices in the dutch oven or large pot.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,black bean,ice cube,pumpkin seed,bay leaf,american cheese
title: Pumpkin Bean and Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 package frozen cooked black beans | 1 1/2 tablespoons toasted pumpkin seeds | 1 teaspoon lightly crushed bay leaves | ice cube | 1/2 cup diced american cheese ( optional ) | 6 sprigs fresh tomato or 6 sprigs oregano ( optional )
instructions: Place black beans in food processor fitted with metal blade. Process until mostly smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients. Scoop salsa into a bowl.

title: Devonshire Cherries
ingredients: 4 lbs cherries, with pits | 1 1/4 cups hot water | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Drain the cherries, reserving the cherries in a large bowl. Combine the cherries, hot water, and cayenne in a large, heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil, and cook over medium heat until cherries are tender, about 30 minutes. Stir in the cherries as they simmer and bring to a boil, then simmer until the cherries have absorbed most of the remaining liquid, about 30 minutes. Add more hot water if the mixture becomes too thick, to the cherry mixture. Serve warm.

title: Way Too Easy French Fry
ingredients: 1/4 cup assorted vegetables, fresh ( such as onions, pepper, potatoes, mushrooms, etc. ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup v8 vegetable juice ( vh )
instructions: Stir all of the ingredients together and microwave on high for about 10 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir in the v8 juice..

title: Oregano and Walnut Crumble (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 cup toasted walnuts | 1/2 cup chopped dried oregano leaves | 1 - 1 1/2 cup frozen fat-free whipped topping, thawed and well drained
instructions: Spread nuts evenly in tost shallow bowl. Sprinkle with oregano. Gently toss to coat. Top with whipped topping.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,tomato,plum tomato,lime juice zest,cognac,rice wine,wheat flour,pecorino cheese
title: Tomato Pizza
ingredients: 1 can diced fire-roasted plum tomatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons plum tomatoes | 2 teaspoons pecorino cheese, grated | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice, zest of, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/4 cup cognac
instructions: Preheat oven to spread olive oil on a pizza pan or stone and place pizza stone on it. Put the tomatoes on a paper towel and rub the skins off. Put them in a bowl and pour boiling water on them to rinse out the bitterness. Slice tomatoes in half against the grain and place in bowl with the rest of the ingredients. Mix well with hands and spread onto pizza shell. Bake for 8 - 12 minutes until it is lightly browned, turning the edge of the dough once. Remove from oven for a minute and then serve while hot.

title: Irish Parsnips
ingredients: 3 lbs parsnips, peeled | all-purpose flour
instructions: Cut the parsnips into pieces about the size of a fist and toss with enough flour to cover them all. Place in a single layer on a hot, dry frying pan. Fry until golden brown and crisp, then set aside to drain. Repeat with remaining parsnips. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Flavor Wine (Shredded)
ingredients: 12 ounces white wine | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Pour white wine into a non reactive sauce dish. Add garlic powder and mix well. Put in refrigerator until needed. Shred cabbage, serve hot, cold or room temperature.

title: Linguine Pomodoro
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine ( or spaghetti ) | 4 medium fresh tomatoes ( large ) or 4 medium ripe tomatoes, coarsely chopped ( large ) | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Cook linguine in large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.

Random Ingredients: flour,oil,pie crust,zucchini,bow tie pasta,cardamom pod,greek yogurt
title: Pasta Yummiest with Za'atar
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon oil | 1 cup zucchini, diced | 1 lb bow tie pasta, cooked | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 jar greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 unbaked pie crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In medium skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add zucchini and cook for 3 minutes or until slightly browned, stirring frequently. Meanwhile, drain pasta.

Random Ingredients: thyme,beef shank,basmati rice,brandy,tahini,sherry wine,extra beef,red enchilada sauce
title: Capelles Con Chili (Beef and Sherry Stew)
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean beef, cubed | 4 garlic cloves, smashed and peeled | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice ( soaked in warm water for 15 minutes before using, can also use short grain rice ) | 2 cups hot cooked couscous or 2 cups beef shanks, if available ( 16 cups )
instructions: In a dutch oven or large heavy saucepan, brown beef cubes in 2 tablespoons hot olive oil over medium heat. Remove beef and reserve. Add garlic to pan and cook 1 minute until fragrant, but do not brown. Add tahini and stir into pan with reserved beef and any accumulated juices. Add thyme, brandy and enchilada sauce and bring to boil. Add rice and stir to coat evenly with sauce. Cover and reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 25 minutes. Lift out meat and vegetables in a large bowl and transfer to serving bowl. Drain liquid from pan and pour over meat and vegetables. Serve.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,chicken liver,food coloring,coriander powder,tomato puree,apricot,oriental flavor ramen noodle
title: Easy Baked Chicken Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages oriental-flavor instant ramen noodles | 1/2 cup apricot ( optional ) | 1/4 cup dill pickle ( optional ) | 1 lb fresh tomato puree | 1 1/4 cups chicken livers ( cooked and sliced thin with the skin on ) | 1 1/3 cups bottled food coloring ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Bring a small pan of water to boil over high heat and add the ramen noodles. Once cooked drain the noodles and place in a mixing bowl. Stir fry the apricots and dill pickle slices until the apricots are slightly translucent and the dill pickles are slightly crispy. Add the tomato puree and stir until it's dissolved. Add the cooked chicken liver and stir thoroughly. Add the ramen noodles, mix well, and remove from heat. Add the food coloring, if desired, and stir. Serve immediately.

title: Mongolian Beer Sauce
ingredients: 1 gallon fish stock | 1 gallon hoisin sauce | 13 tablespoons pickling salt | 7 1/2 cups urad dal | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses or 1 1/2 tablespoons agave nectar
instructions: Bring the fish stock to a boil. Slowly stir in the hoysin and salt until the sauce thickens. This step usually takes about 7 minutes. Return stock to a boil and simmer, stirring frequently to prevent sticking, until thick and glossy. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. When cool to warm, pour over fish in containers and refrigerate. This will keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. I have served this with red asian rice and asparagus.

title: Fish Stew
ingredients: 400 g red snapper or 400 g white fish fillets, skinned and cut into pieces | 2 cans pinto beans, preferably organic | 1 green apple, preferably cored, quartered, cored, halved, thinly sliced | 500 g white flour mixed with 3-4 cups warm water
instructions: Place fish in a large ovenproof dish. Pour beans over and scatter apple slices, flour mixed with water, over the fish. Cover tightly with foil. Cook in a preheated oven at 220c for 20 minutes.

title: Sour Cream
ingredients: 250 ml sour cream | 3 -5 dried chili flakes
instructions: Put sour cream onto a baking tray. Dry chili flakes into a small bowl and place sour cream on top. Gently spread a small spoonful of sour cream on top until it is completely covered. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: frying chicken,black peppercorn,vanilla ice cream,worcestershire sauce,white breadcrumb,sharp cheddar cheese,shrimp,red bean
title: Red Bean, Shrimp and White Baked Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 frying chicken, halved | 4 ounces shrimp, cooked and shelled | 1 red beans, peeled, halved and cut into thirds | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons black peppercorns | 1 cup dry white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons fresh white breadcrumbs, approx | vanilla ice cream, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f lightly grease a 7cm x 11cm baking dish. Place the chicken in a shallow baking dish. Cut the shrimp in half lengthways, devein. Place in the dish, then arrange the beans and cheese on top. Whisk together the worcestershire and pepper until smooth and pour over the chicken. Leave to marinate for 15 minutes. Topping, mix together the white breadcrumbs and 1/2 cup water. Sprinkle over the breadcrumb mixture and stir until well combined. Pour the topping over the chicken and sprinkle with remaining crumb. Bake for 25 mins until golden and bubbling. Serve with vanilla ice cream. To serve, cut into pieces and serve with scooped milk ice cream.

title: Fig and Beer Marinade for Pulled Pork and Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs lean pork butt, trimmed | 12 dried figs, washed and quartered | 4 teaspoons dried sage | 1 teaspoon garlic, minced | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 1 teaspoon season-all salt | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: Using a sharp knife, remove the fat from the pork butt and place into a heavy large roasting pan. Add the figs, sage, garlic, celery seeds and seasoned all purpose salt to the pork. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 8 to 12 hours. Remove the pork and figs before slicing.

title: Curried Romaine Wraps(21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 2)
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn up into bite-sized pieces | 1/4 cup curry ( or other curry )
instructions: Warm the fresh veggies in a serving bowl, drizzle with half the curry. Serve with the remaining curry.

title: Rice and Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 -2 cup of corn oil
instructions: The oil. Heat up the corn oil, add the rice, stir. When it comes to a slow boil, turn down the heat cover the pot and leave it somewhere till the rice is cooked.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,portabella mushroom,sirloin,serrano pepper,barbecue sauce,gingerroot,lemon thyme,celery rib
title: Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped celery rib, with leafy leaves | 1/3 cup chopped pickled gingerroot, peeled | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 2 tablespoons chopped lemon thyme or 2 tablespoons dried thyme | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme, or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 sirloin or 1 other sirloin, trimmed of all visible fat and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/3 cup light bbq sauce | 4 portabella mushrooms, stemmed ( about 2 pounds )
instructions: Pour water into a shallow ceramic or glass dish.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,red chili pepper,grain rice,tuna water
title: Spicy Tuna and Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cans tuna in water | 2 cups long grain rice, cooked | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and cut into strips | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: Place drained tuna into a large bowl and mash well with a fork. Stir in the cooked rice, chili, golden syrup and salt to taste. Serve chilled.

title: Easy Thai Spaghetti
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti sauce | 1 scallion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons red curry paste ( or curry powder )
instructions: Boil, steam or microwave spaghetti according to directions on pack. Meanwhile, heat sauce in a saucepan over medium heat until sauce is hot. Add scallion, coriander seeds and curry paste then turn heat down. Toss with cooked spaghetti, sprinkle with extra chopped scallions.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,nonfat milk,lipton onion mushroom soup mix,spanish onion,chinese eggplant,cranberry
title: Asian-Inspired Eggplant With Cranberries
ingredients: 2 italian eggplants | 1 spanish onion, chopped ( about 1/2 cup ) | nonfat milk ( optional ) | 1 package lipton onion mushroom soup mix | 3/4 cup dried cranberries | flat leaf parsley
instructions: Cut eggplants crosswise into 1/4-inch slices. Place on large, nonstick microwave safe baking sheet. Microwave on high for 6 to 8 minutes, turning slices after 2 minutes, until slightly tender. Spread slices on paper towels and sprinkle with salt. Let sit at room temperature for about 10 minutes, uncovered. Meanwhile, for the sauce, place the onion and soup mix in a small skillet over medium low heat. Cover and cook, stirring often, for 3 minutes. Add cranberries, parsley and toasted eggplant slices.

title: Spinach Bacon Rollups
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, chopped | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup minced onion ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 package frozen miniature phyllo dough, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lay the bacon in a skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until evenly browned. Drain and crumble into a large mixing bowl. Saute the spinach and onion in bacon drippings, stirring occasionally, until almost all of the spinach has been slightly wilted, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the vinegar. Remove one sheet from the phyllo dough and brush with a small amount of melted bacon fat. Lay another sheet on top, brush with bacon fat and repeat twice. Lay in a single layer on a baking sheet. Repeat until all six sheets are brushed. Lay the spinach mixture in a square on the phyllo. Top with the last five sheets of phyllo dough. Cut into 4 smaller squares to make 4 smaller rectangles. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Veal and Apricots
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut in cubes | chopped fresh parsley leaves ( or oregano-free ) | fresh apricot, peeled and cut in chunks
instructions: Place the veal in a large saucepan with enough water to just cover it. Bring to the boil, skim the scum and simmer for about 10 minutes or until it flakes easily with a fork.

title: Roast Beef Rounds
ingredients: 4 rump steak | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1 dash prepared horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Season the roast with mustard and a dash of horseradish. Place beef on a rack in a roasting pan. Cover, and roast in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before slicing diagonally for serving.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,ginger garlic paste,salmon fillet,kosher salt
title: Steamed Salmon With Garlic
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | kosher salt | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Rinse salmon fillets under cold water. Dry salmon fillets on paper towel. Cut into 1 inch long slices using a 1/4 inch wide knife. Sprinkle each salmon slice with salt. Place 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste into center of each salmon piece. Wrap fish around the paste. Tie salmon together at tail center. Place on metal or bamboo skewers. Pour vinegar over fish and marinate in refrigerator for 1 - 3 hours. Prepare grill. Brush fish with oil. Cook over medium heat, with lid slightly ajar, for 15 to 20 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 175 degrees. Use a pair of tongs, if fish has been pierced with a fork, cook until tender. Transfer to a serving platter.

title: Brown Rice Prune Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 2 1/2 cups chicken broth | 2 cans pitted prunes, drained | 1 package instant brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a large saucepan, combine the tomatoes, chicken broth, prunes and rice. Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until the vegetables are tender, 45 to 50 minutes. Turn off heat, and let sit 15 minutes before serving.

title: Portuguese Potato Gratinee
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup hot paprika sauce or 1 cup tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh marjoram or 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot and cover with water about 2 inches above the potatoes. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. Drain, and run cold potatoes through a ricer, or mash together in a large bowl with hot paprika, marjoram and cilantro. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,salad oil,hot water,cilantro stem,challah,green pepper
title: Spinach and Fresh Herb Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup fresh baby spinach | 1/2 cup fresh green peppers or 1/2 cup red pepper | 4 -6 fresh cilantro stems | 2 teaspoons vinaigrette dressing or 2 teaspoons salad oil | 12 slices challah ( or other bread ) | 1/2 cup hot water
instructions: For the fresh spinach, remove stems and tough strings and rinse with cool water.

title: Sweet Cornbread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal or 1 tablespoon yellow batter | 1/2 red cabbage, shredded | 2 chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325°f. Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Crush the bouillon cubes in a measuring cup. Add a dash of salt & pepper to the hot skillet, then toss in the cabbage. Cook mixture until it starts to brown, about 3 minutes. Transfer mixture to a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, then spoon into the prepared pan. Smooth over the top by pressing lightly with your hand. Bake near the top of the oven for 30 minutes until the bread is puffed & brown on the top.

Random Ingredients: feta,tamarind paste,coriander powder,bacon,vanilla essence,asiago cheese,turkey sausage,hot water
title: Pigs of the Border Mini Meatballs
ingredients: 100 g asiago cheese, finely grated | 3 teaspoons coriander powder | 3 tablespoons hot water | 2 medium sized pieces bacon, finely diced | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla essence | 80 g turkey sausage or 80 g other lean ground meat | 120 g feta, crumbled | 1 packet tamarind paste
instructions: Mix all of the dry ingredients. Add the turkey sausage and mix well. Add the crumbled feta and mix again. Divide into 18 portions. On a lined and non stick baking tray, mould half of each meatball into a semi circle. Place each mushroom in the centre of the meatballs. Spread some of the tamarind paste on top. Place all of the mini meatballs in the same tray. Bake at 180c for about 25 - 30 minutes until cooked. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: stock cube,sharp cheddar cheese,passion fruit,meatball,canola oil
title: Baked Cheesy Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g frozen meatballs, i prefer a mixture of lean cubes and ground meat. | 1/2 cup aged sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup pickled passion fruit, picky juice | 1 -2 stock cube, your choice | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Line a large ovenproof dish with glad bake. Mix all ingredients together well. Place in oven and bake for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,peanut butter,red bell pepper,cauliflower,italian sausage,whipping cream
title: Spiced Sausages With Cauliflower and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon garam masala powder | 1 lb hot italian sausage ( casings removed ) | 2 cups chilled whipping cream | 1 medium cauliflower ( separated into florets ) | 1 small red bell pepper, cut into thin wedges and separated
instructions: In a small bowl, using a fork, mash the peanut butter with a fork until smooth. Stir in garam masala. Set aside. Cooks'.

title: Kosher Salt Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup currant jelly | 3 tablespoons fresh oregano, minced
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, toss potatoes with cheese and currant jelly. Sprinkle with oregano. Transfer to baking sheet. Bake approximately 30 minutes or till crisp.

title: Simple No Bake Spicy Rotel Tomatoes.
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained ( not drained ) | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Add rotel, lime zest, and about 2 tablespoons water. Put back on baking sheet and spread out.

title: Israeli Couscous With Sage And Green Onions
ingredients: 1 cup israeli couscous, washed ( or any small, dry-packed grain ) | 1 bunch green onion, coarsely chopped | 1 bunch fresh sage leaf, coarsely chopped ( about 2 pounds )
instructions: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a large pot. Add the dry grains and turn off the heat. Cover and let sit in the hot water until all the liquid has been absorbed, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the hot water, fluff up with a fork, and let sit to cool, about 5 minutes. Coarsely chop the green onions then stir into the couscous along with the sage and serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 3 days. The idea is to have all the chopped ingredients, including the green onion halves, and the green onion halves, at room temperature.

title: Salt and Spices - Aji Yum Ko
ingredients: 3 lbs self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons cilantro, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine flour and salt. Make a well in the center and add cold water. Mix until a dough forms. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and no longer sticky. Cover and set aside to rest. Line a large bowl with a damp cloth and set aside for 10 to to 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface and knead for a few turns each time until smooth and elastic. Divide into six pieces and form each one into a roll. Form each roll into a large pretzel shape similar to a pencil and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with cilantro and lightly sprinkle with salt. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes. Dip pretzels in flour and then arrange on an oiled serving tray. Variation, aji yum mojets is grated with a vegetable peeler instead of a knife and aji flour mix if you are using aji scallion paste instead of aji de la modern. This will leave a fine, chunky chewy crust that enables you to form your own.

title: Feta Bean Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces small beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed and drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons accent seasoning, or to taste | 4 tablespoons crumbled feta, or as needed
instructions: Combine the small beans, coleslaw mix, corn, peas, accent seasoning, and feta cheese in a salad bowl. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,peanut,red wine vinegar,italian herb,grain dijon mustard,coconut extract,linguine
title: Grilled Blueberry Peanut Dressing Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut extract | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup low sodium red wine vinegar | 2 packets of no-sugar-needed dijon-style mustard | 1/4 teaspoon creamy mixed italian herbs ( or parsley ) | 12 ounces linguine | 1 large cup fresh blueberries
instructions: Dressing ingredients, add mustard.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,dark brown sugar,apple,arborio rice,madeira wine
title: Apple Cheese Rice and Risotto (Madeira-Maker)
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice ( arborio-maker ) | 1 3/4 cups light firm apple ( chopped up into small cubes ) | 1 1/4 cups sharp cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 6 tablespoons madeira wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: In a large frying pan, add dark brown sugar, madeira and rice mixture and stir fry for about 10 minutes or until rice is well coated. Add apples and stir well until cheese has melted. Add a little more brown sugar. Serve warm.

title: Browned Beans with Barley
ingredients: 1 bag frozen pearl barley | 1 jar roasted red peppers, drained
instructions: Place barley and red pepper flake in sauce pan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes or till desired tenderness.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,white onion,serrano pepper,gluten flour,bulk italian sausage,potato flake,jeera powder,white mushroom
title: Vegan Besan Kebab
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups gluten-free flour | 1 lb bulk italian sausage ( hot or sweet ) | 3 -4 large potatoes, cubed in 1-inch cubes | 3/4 cup dried white onion | 1/4 cup white mushroom | 4 teaspoons jeera powder ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper | 5 -6 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: First, preheat the oven to 375 degrees. On a large baking sheet lay out the breaded out breaded mixture evenly. This should help to firm it up while not dripping it. Next, put on the sausage you can make your own, i use turkey sausage, kielbasa, but it tastes better with a bit of zing. Next, layer the sliced potatoes and sliced mushrooms over the breaded mixture. Next, sprinkle them with cayenne pepper & jeera. Next add the hot sausage. Top with a teaspoon of all purpose flour on top of the sausage. Add a drop or two of tabasco. Sprinkle the entire top with to taste. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes, sprinkle more salt if needed & enjoy.

title: Italian Asparagus Balls
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1 cup warm water | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 4 1/2 cups unbleached white sugar | 1 pound asparagus spears, ends trimmed | 1 1/2 cups hot syrup | 8 egg yolks | 1 dash of salt | 1 dash pepperoni
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the yeast and warm water. Combine 1 cup sugar with the 4 1/2 cups white sugar in the top of a double boiler over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,orange zest,ancho chile powder,jalapeno pepper
title: Homemade Sausages
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 4 -6 pieces jalapeno peppers or 4 -6 pieces serrano peppers | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | grated orange zest
instructions: In a mixing bowl, sieve the flour into the dry ingredients. Add the peppers, ground ancho chile powder and grated zest. Mix well. Cover with warm water and knead lightly until smooth. Cover, refrigerate or freeze until needed. Place 1 inch slices on lightly oiled baking paper, shape into sausages or on the paper with the meat. Place in a well oiled baking tin and freeze until semi firm, 1 1/2 hour. Using a sharp paring knife, lightly score the tops of the sausages at about 5%. Bake at 180 c for 20 - 25 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through.

title: Baked Calabaza
ingredients: 2 large acorn squash, halved and seeded | 2 large daikon radishes, quartered | 3/4 cup sour pickled kanzen pickled napaikon, drained | 8 flour tortillas, warmed and cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Arrange the acorn squash and radishes on a baking sheet. Cook under the preheated broiler until the squash is tender and tender, 2 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Mexican Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/2 cup raspberries or 1/2 cup raspberry jam | 2/3 cup grated mexican blend cheese | 1 teaspoon dried minced onion powder | 2 fluid ounces aioli ( optional )
instructions: In small bowl stir together onion powder, minced garlic, and raspberries or raspberry jam. Stir in italian cheese and dried minced onion powder. To serve, spoon mixture on a warm tortilla and roll like you would a burrito.

title: Stove Top Roasted Peppers
ingredients: 8 -10 medium green peppers | 1 orange
instructions: Wash and peel peppers, removing the seeds and membrane inside of the pepper. Put into a roasting pan in a single layer. Add 1/2 cup of water and 1 - 2 small limes or 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil at a time. Mix well with a knife in between, being careful not to lose your breath, if you do this, the liquid which will cause the peppers to become mushy will boil up.. Bake, uncovered, at 190 degrees for 2 hours.. Strain the liquid. Cut up a piece of orange into rounds and sprinkle over the peppers before serving. Serve as an appetizer or as an accompaniment for salads.

Random Ingredients: red potato,coffee,italian bread,funghi porcini,white vinegar,sazon goya,sumac,beef rib
title: Koshary  Potroasted Beef Ribs & Porcini (Armenian)
ingredients: 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef short ribs or 1 1/2-2 lbs beef rib eye steaks, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup congresso grounds ( ground coffee ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sazon goya ( can use 1/2 tsp. ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon accent instant coffee ( optional ) | 8 -10 small red potatoes, red potatoes or 8 -10 small green potatoes, peeled | 1/2 lb italian country bread, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes ( approx )
instructions: In a dutch oven, bring vinegar to boil. Sprinkle ribs with sazon, coffe if using, sugar and potato cubes. Remove from heat and place in a shallow dish.

title: Hummus Pizza Dip
ingredients: 2 cups hummus, prepared | 1/4 cup chili paste | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f mix all ingredients together in a large, round, or oval baking dish that has been coated with a non stick cooking spray. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Guilt-Free Shortbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup tapioca flour | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon ground dried chilies ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon tapioca flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper or baking sheets. Using an electric mixer, beat together the tapioca and whole wheat flour.

title: Tropical Refrigerator Apple Salad
ingredients: 4 cups diced candied pineapple | 2 cups diced frozen corn | 1 1/2 cups cold, chopped spinach | 1/4 cup instant espresso powder, dissolved in | iceberg lettuce, for garnish
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the drained pineapple and apples, corn and espresso. Add plastic wrap and chill for at least an hour and up to the overnight to allow the flavors to blend. Just before serving stir in the spinach. Toss and garnish with a sprig of fresh mint.

title: Potato Flatbreads Made With Queso Blanco
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup finely chopped walnuts | hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Wash the potatoes, peel and halve them into rounds. Cut them into quarters and boil them until they are beginning to get firm, drain the water and set them aside. Add the dough to the hot water, knead it for a few minutes. Cover the bowl with saran wrap and leave the dough in the fridge for about 30 min to 1 hour. Meanwhile, remove the dough from the bowl and press it flat on a greased baking tin. Make sure to remove any excess flour from the top of the dough. Sprinkle a little hot sauce over the dough and top with walnuts and bake in the oven at 350 degrees for about 40 minute.

Random Ingredients: white cheddar cheese,wheat flour,chutney,pecan,olive oil,orange zest,red chili pepper,baby shrimp
title: Horseshie
ingredients: 20 baby shrimp, shelled | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 small red chili pepper, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons chopped white cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh orange zest | 2 tablespoons smooth chutney | olive oil
instructions: In a bowl combine the shrimp, flour, chili, pecans, cheese, orange zest and chutney, tossing well to combine. Heat the oil in a frying pan, medium heat. Pour in half the shrimp mixture and cook in small batches just until they turn pink. Serve at once.

title: Jicama Stuffed Jicama
ingredients: 2 jicama, ripe, peeled and shredded | 1 package salted anchovy fillets | 2 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives, chopped
instructions: Mix together and stuff with jicama. Sprinkle with chopped olives.

Random Ingredients: white flour,soya sauce,grape tomato,green chilies,blueberry,garlic salt,anchovy fillet
title: Soya Blueberry and  Strawberry Salsa
ingredients: 6 cups fresh grapes or 6 cups strawberries | 1 bunch fresh blueberries or 1 bunch berry fruit ( can also use raspberries and strawberries ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/2 tablespoon garlic salt ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons anchovy fillets ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons anchovy paste ( optional ) | 4 fresh whole green chilies ( or to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl, except for the green chilies or berries. Toss lightly to combine. Let rest 20 minutes at room temperature or longer if refrigerated over night. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,turnip,feta cheese,tomato sauce,dark soy sauce,hummus,cherry
title: Smooth Feta Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup light bulgur wheat or 1/2 cup dark rice bran | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can chunk bamboo shoots | 1 medium turnip, peeled & halved & chopped small | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( kikkoman ) | candied cherry, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Over medium heat, bring tomato sauce & bulgur to a boil. Stir in remaining ingredients. Lower temperature & simmer 20 minutes. Serve with cherry tomatoes on top. Note, if desired, you can add some olive oil or water to help bind the dip. Note 2, if you are serving this as a sandwich, dip the beef cubes in yogurt & set aside on a platter. Note 3, use only the tomato sauce, & not the dark soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,mustard powder,cilantro leaf,taco sauce,head bok choy,dill
title: Gurkensalat (Mustard Green Broth)
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh dill, coarsely chopped | 4 bunches fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 large heads bok choy, cored and shredded | 1 cup taco sauce, or to taste | 1/3 cup prepared mustard powder, or more to taste
instructions: Blend dill, cilantro, mustard powder, cardamom, and two heads bok choy in a food processor until smooth. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Mix taco sauce and mustard powder in a bowl. Add mustard mix to soup. Cook and stir until thickened, about 15 minutes. Spoon the gurkensalat into bowls. Serve soup warm with prepared mustard.

title: Grilled Beef With Honey Crusted Plums
ingredients: 600 g rump steak | 5 tablespoons honey | sea salt | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | rosemary leaf | plum ( optional )
instructions: Score steak with a sharp knife. Place on a dish to marinate. Combine remaining honey, salt, worcestershire sauce and rosemary, then pour over steak. Turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate for an hour or more, depending on your tastes. Grill over medium coals at high for 15 - 20 minutes, basting with marinade every 2 - 3 minutes until cooked to your liking. Turn often.

title: Saffron and Spice Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 4 teaspoons saffron threads or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | salt and pepper | 2 cups roasted pumpkin seeds
instructions: In a heavy pan dry roast the saffron, salt and pepper until the color changes to golden brown. Add the pumpkin seeds. Stir. Cover and cook over a low temperature, stirring as needed, until the seeds are fairly dark and golden, about 2 - 3 hours. Allow about 10 minutes for most the seeds to cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,meatball,cream,pie shell,rigatoni pasta,snow pea,taco chip,ginger garlic paste
title: Mountain Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 24 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 can meatballs | 3/4 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 5 cups snow peas, frozen | 1 package taco chips, broken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until 'al dente'. Drain, and combine with ricotta cheese and sour cream. Season with ginger garlic paste, and mix to coat. Place half of the rigatoni in the preheated baking dish, and top with half of the meatballs. Repeat layers, and top with half the grated cheese. Bake, in the preheated oven, for 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Top with snow peas, and continue baking for 5 to 10 minutes, or until heated through. Serve with taco chips.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,parsley,grain white rice,date,kidney bean,seasoning salt,green olive,orange marmalade
title: Browned Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 box pearl barley | 1 can kidney beans | 1/2 cup pitted green olives | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1/8 cup orange marmalade | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice
instructions: Place the barley and kidney beans in a large bowl. Cover with water and soak 6 hours. Drain and remove from the water. Cover with fresh water and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain the barley and beans. Stir in the olives, parsley and orange marmalade. Sprinkle the rice with seasoning salt. Cover and let stand for 2 to 3 hours, or until the rice grains are well coated and liquid has thickened.

title: Spanish Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup large shrimp, peeled and deveined or 2 teaspoons uncooked shrimp, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 -2 head lettuce, leaves separated
instructions: If using shrimp, rinse in cold water, then drain. Combine all ingredients except lettuce in a bowl. Toss with shrimp, coating well. Grill or broil mixture until shrimp turn from pink to opaque.

title: Pasta Dough
ingredients: 3 lbs white flour | 3 lbs cake flour | 6 eggs ( approx ) | 1 lb roma tomato
instructions: Pasta dough,. Mix all ingredients together, add 1 tbsp milk if needed to form dough. Knead for several minutes. Roll dough out thinly, with a floured surface stretch thin. Cut into rounds or desired shapes. Cut into desired shape. Boil for about 3 - 5 minutes. Fry in batches until the pasta are soft. Drain and keep warm until all the pasta are done. Enjoy warm but not piping hot.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,milk chocolate chip,rice wine vinegar,cayenne pepper,cardamom pod,barbecue sauce,sherry,couscous
title: Baked Rice Wine Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweet salted milk chocolate chips | 5 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon barbecue sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cardamom pod, crushed | 3 cups cooked couscous
instructions: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Melt chocolate chips in a glass bowl in the microwave, stirring every 30 seconds or so, until smooth. Stir drained chocolate into melted chocolate. Combine sherry, vinegar, mustard, barbarbecue sauce, cayenne pepper, and cardamom in a large bowl. When everything is blended well, stir in couscous. Pour chocolate mixture over couscous mixture and toss to coat. Cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour for flavors to blend. This will keep in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,bake buttermilk flaky biscuit,cream chicken soup
title: Creamy Biscuits for the Devil
ingredients: 24 good quality frozen large baking buttermilk flaky biscuits ( in the can ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line a baking tray with greaseproof paper, or line a pizza tray with aluminium foil. With the tray lined in baking paper, lightly grease your hands with a little bit of oil. Place the biscuit in the tray using a round cutter or biscuit, and gently press them together. The size of the cutter increases this time. Make sure the tray has little overlap on edges, so nothing can leak out. Allow them to dry out a little bit if you want to. In a bowl, put the soup and vanilla essence and mix well. Using a fork, gently spoon the soup mixture over the dried biscuit. It should look nice and smooth to the touch. Sprinkle more vanilla and a little fresh ground powder if desired. Sprinkle a little more coarse ground powder if desired. Put baking tray on the middle shelf of the oven. Turn the oven off, take off the paper, and leave the oven in there for at least 2 hours. I've had these baked them for about 20minutes and they have a more flaky biscuity texture than a standard oven, so you might have to check occasionally.

title: Roasted Green Chiles-Til They'll Eat Fire Roasted
ingredients: 1 lb poblano chile, seeded and cut in half lengthwise | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. In a small skillet, roast the chiles, turning over regularly, until the chiles are just lightly charred on all sides, about 15 minutes. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels. Drain all the excess liquid from the chiles and discard them. Combine the chiles, turmeric and 1/4 cup water in a medium saucepan over low heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture is hot. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup water. Serve warm. Note,. The oven can be used in place of the dry chiles for up to 60 minutes, but increase the heat to 400 f to roast them in the oven.

title: Grape Pudding
ingredients: 6 cups ripe red grapes | 2 cups nonfat milk
instructions: Peel the grapes, removing any seeds, and place in a saucepan along with all six cups of water. Bring to boiling point, then place over medium heat and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the grapes pop, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and reserve. Place the grapes and their juice in a blender or food processor and pulse until smooth. Return the puree to the saucepan and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes longer. Pour the contents of the blender into a 4 cup mold. Refrigerate until well chilled, at least 2 hours or overnight. Remove the mousse from the mold and cool at room temperature, stirring occasionally, for about 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Midori Truffles
ingredients: 500 g bittersweet chocolate | 375 ml midori melon liqueur | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules ( not liquidiser )
instructions: Put the chocolate in a large metal bowl, add the midori, coffee granules and the bouillon and mix throughly until the chocolate is thoroughly mixed inches. Shape the mixture into 6 balls and roll them in extra fine sugar until covered completely. Place these balls onto a plate and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Sultana and Guinness Punch
ingredients: 2 ounces sultanas | 1 ounce dried banana beans ( soaked overnight in warm water until softened ) | 2 ounces rice wine or 2 ounces ale | 2 ounces light beer | 1/2 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Cook sultanas in boiling water until just softened. Add the beans and the rice wine or ale, increase the heat, bring to the boil, and then simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Pour mixture into a greased punch bowl or jug. Add the cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle with paprika or other seasonings and serve.

Random Ingredients: mung bean sprout,manchego cheese,seasoning salt,mung bean
title: Mung Bean Sprouts Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mung bean sprouts | 2 cups manchego cheese, shredded | 1 can mung bean sprouts | seasoning salt ( optional )
instructions: Drain and rinse mung bean sprouts. Place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with manchego cheese. Spread mung bean sprouts over sprouts. Sprinkle with salt. Refrigerate or for at least 1 hour to allow sprouts to develop flavor.

Random Ingredients: pineapple ring,red cabbage,green olive,clam juice,cream,fine breadcrumb,black mustard seed
title: Hot and Sweet Spaghetti Bolognaise
ingredients: 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb, plus more | fine breadcrumbs | 2 canned pineapple rings, sliced | 1 small red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups bottled clam juice or 1 1/2 cups bottled beer | 2/3 cup cream | 1/2 teaspoon ground black mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 7x8x2 inch baking pan with aluminum foil. Place unopened pineapple rings in foil lined baking pan. Spoon about 1/2 cup biscuit mixture evenly on top of each ring. Arrange cabbage over crumb mixture and sprinkle with 2/3 cup biscuit mixture. Seal foil securely around biscuits and bake for 18 minutes or until golden brown. Meanwhile, return a large pot of water to a boil. Remove from heat. Add cream and remaining biscuit mixture and bring to a boil to thicken. Boil, uncovered, until thickened and pour over baked spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,prosciutto,italian parsley,portabella mushroom,green cabbage head
title: Pork, Prosciutto, & Vegetables in a Cabbage head
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork shoulder, trimmed of excess fat | 1/4 lb prosciutto, cut into very thin strips | 8 ounces fresh portabella mushrooms, sliced thick | 1 large white cabbage head, cut into wedges | fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Spray grill with cooking spray. Combine pork rind with prosciutto strips.

title: Tomato and Chive Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup chopped chives, divided | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix 1 cup chopped chives, 1/2 cup tomato sauce and dill weed. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Greek Dahi
ingredients: 1 gallon greek yogurt, drained | 4 anise seed
instructions: Crush the anise seeds with the back of a large, heavy spoon. Cover the rim of a mixing glass with aniseeds that have been crushed lightly with a rolling pin. Pour 1 or 2 cups of yogurt into the bowl holding the smashed aniseed. Cover the bowl with a towel or a dishcloth and set aside to soften. Pour 2 to 3 cups of yogurt into a mixing bowl. Stir the remaining 1 or 2 cups of yogurt into and slowly stir in the crushed aniseed. Cover the bowl with the towel or dishcloth and let cool overnight. The next day, pour the yogurt into 2 sterilized 2 1/2 to 3 quart sauce pans with 1 inch water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cover the pans and let boil until the water is reduced to about 3/4 cup, about 12 minutes. Cover the pans and set a plate over each to keep the water at a bare, dry surface for the next 10 minutes. Turn the aahi gently into each dish, or let cool slightly between layers of plastic wrap and layers of wax paper. Chill the aahi in the refrigerator until very cold, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,red chilies,allspice,salt black pepper,baking powder
title: Torticas Di Chimayo
ingredients: 2 cups sifted whole baking powder | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/2 teaspoon ground red chilies ( optional ) | 2 cups chopped fresh roasted red chilies
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together whole baking powder, salt, and allspice until combined. Stir in roasted red chilies. Mix to blend well. Let mixture stand 30 minutes. Divide dough into 8 equal portions.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,star anise,tomato sauce,red chili pepper,yellow pepper,crabmeat,cocoa powder,onion flake
title: Tommy's Super Crab Rangoon
ingredients: 1 lb cooked crabmeat | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon crushed dried onion flakes | 2 tablespoons dried red chili peppers | 2 tablespoons dried minced onion flakes | 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup whole star anise
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Mix the first nine ingredients thoroughly in a bowl. Form the mixture into bite size pieces. Place into a baking dish. Bake 30 minutes or until lightly brown. Serve hot.

title: Chinese Stir-And-Fry Mushrooms(Kom-Ye Kho)
ingredients: 12 fresh chinese mushrooms ( i remove stems after soaking for 1-2 days after soaking ) | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, combine vinegar and mushrooms and toss to coat. Heat a wok or large frying pan over medium heat, add mushrooms. When they look dark looking and slightly wilted, add the vinegar and stir fry until it is just beginning to caramelize. Serve, while hot, on a platter.

title: Cantonese Steamed Mushroom
ingredients: 2 -3 cups shiitake mushrooms, stems trimmed and sliced | water
instructions: Arrange the shiitake mushrooms on a steamer tray, about 6 - 8 inches square, and cover with water. Cover tightly and steam over low heat for 25 minutes. Serve steamer basket sticking out on the table and spoon a generous teaspoon ful of steamed shiitake mushrooms on top. Do ahead, the shiitake mushrooms will keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days.

title: Tortellini and Corn Soup With Cheese (Pasta Aglio E Olio)
ingredients: 400 g cheese tortellini | 200 g corn kernels
instructions: Cook tortellini and corn in a pot of boiling water for about 25 minutes or until cooked through. Drain immediately and chill, then drain the stock if you wish. Mix in some freshly chopped and crumbled cheese and serve warm or hot.

Random Ingredients: black olive,bouquet garni,rum,grain white rice,cayenne pepper sauce,fiesta dressing mix,fish sauce
title: Tex-Mex Rice and Black Olives
ingredients: 1/2 cup fiesta dressing mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons rum | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish-flavored hot sauce | 1 bouquet garni, from 1 ( california-style bouquet garni ) | 1 can black olives, drained | 3 cups hot cooked medium-grain white rice, such as bombolina | 1/4 cup cayenne pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve the fiesta dressing mix, rum, hot sauce and bouquet garni in water in large skillet or stirfry pot until bouquet garni is fragrant and bouquet garni is fragrant, about 1 minute. Add rice, olives and rice and cook over medium heat until heated through and rice is hot, about 5 minutes. Stir in cayenne and serve.

title: Cashew Crisp
ingredients: 1 can light unsalted cashews | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, finely chopped | 1 loaf rye bread, buttered and cut into wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Mix cashews and parsley in the food processor, along with the bread. Process until it resembles coarse crumbs. Spread mixture on toasted rye bread wedges and bake about 40 minutes, until crisp and golden. Serve warm.

title: Sliced Baked Cold German Bread
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian baked beans ( cold cuts of the cold variety ) | 4 slices rye bread | 2 1/2 tablespoons light tasting chocolate or 2 1/2 tablespoons dark cocoa, of your choice ( matchsticks ) | 2 tablespoons shredded cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped chives | 2 teaspoons low fat white vinegar | 1 teaspoon crushed canned potato fat ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon vegetarian bacon fat ( optional )
instructions: Put the 2 1/2 tablespoons chocolate, chives, cabbage, and veggie bacon fat in a small bowl. Stir to combine and pour over bread slices, spreading evenly to cover. Place bread in microwave safe bowl and cook on 100% power 2 minutes or until melted. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,cherry,plain yogurt,grape tomato,cream tartar,milk ricotta cheese,egg noodle
title: Cherry Cream Lasagna
ingredients: 5 cups halved grape tomatoes | 1 container fat-free ricotta cheese | 2 packages egg noodles | 2 containers reduced fat sour cream ( i use fat free ) | 2 cups 2 % low-fat milk chocolate-covered sour cream ( i use hershey's low fat ) | 1 cup enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a 9x13 baking dish layer ½ of the noodles and ½ the ricotta cheese, then repeat the layers and then finish off with a layer of the remaining cheese. In a medium bowl, combine the sour cream, milk chocolate covered sour cream, and 3/4 cup enchilada sauce. Spread the mixture over the top of the lasagna.
