Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,tequila,italian parsley,jalapeno pepper,ziti pasta,hot chili sauce,oregano,italian sausage
title: Ziti Pasta With Sausage and Chili
ingredients: 12 ounces italian sausage, casings removed | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 2 teaspoons dried italian parsley | 1 fresh hot chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 jar sweet italian-style chili sauce, not drained | 1/2 cup tequila | 4 ounces uncooked ziti pasta | 3 tablespoons hot chili sauce
instructions: To prepare casings, remove casings from sausages and brown sausage in a large skillet over medium high heat, sprinkling with oregano, parsley, and half of the chile pepper. Drain excess fat and stir in chilie sauce, 1/2 cup chili sauce, and remaining chile pepper. While pasta is cooking to cook the sausage, cook ziti as directed on package directions, omitting the water and fat. Drain pasta and return to skillet, add 2 cups cooking water, and toss. Divide sausage mixture among 4 serving plates and top with ziti to serve.

title: Sumac and Sea Scallops over Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 4 -7 ounces sea scallops or 1 -2 ounce sea scallops | ground sumac
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water and drain. Place the rice on to a platter or bowl add the scallops and sprinkle the sumac over them. Serve at once with plain or flavored salt.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,couscous,golden syrup,steak,avocado,kahlua,morningstar farm meal starter grillers crumbles,salt
title: Quick Beef Bowl "sauce"
ingredients: 1 cup instant couscous | 1 cup morningstar farms meal starters grillers grillers recipe crumbles | 2 tablespoons sweetened lavash brand kahlua | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 lb flank steak | 1 small avocado
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the first seven ingredients, except for the flank steak and avocado. Cut the flank steak into about 1/4 inch slices. Add the sliced steak and avocado to the bowl, then mix together. Cover and refrigerate the mixture for at least one hour and up to 24 hours prior to serving.

title: Butterscotch Sauper
ingredients: 8 ounces butterscotch schnapps | 1/4 cup chopped green chili pepper ( canned or fresh ) | 1/4 cup chopped pecans ( optional ) | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Blend butterscotch schnapps, peppers, and pecans in a blender or food processor. With a rubber spatula, blend mixture until smooth. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Serve on chilled dinner roll with cheese.

title: Sausage Croûtons
ingredients: 2 links bulk italian sausage | 1 loaf round bread
instructions: Split loaf. Cook sausage in skillet until browned. Set aside to drain drippings. Cut out top of bread and squeeze out water before crumbing. Tear bread loaf into little squares. Fill square with sausage, croutons and top with crumbs. Wrap in foil. Place sandwiches in freezer.

title: Paveve Gratinee and Mango Potato With Mint Salad
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, scrubbed | 150 g mozzarella cheese, grated | 1 ripe mango, ripe | 6 mint sprigs, fresh | 1/4 cup dry white wine | mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c and line a baking dish with baking paper. Cut russet potatoes in half lengthways, then halve. Scoop out the flesh and roughly chop into 3cm chunks. Mix together with mozzarella, mango, mint, pepper and wine to coat potato. Spoon onto baking paper covered with a tea towel and sprinkle with mint. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until brown and cooked through. Cut in wedges and serve with mint sprigs if desired.

title: Vinegar English Cakes
ingredients: 30 cm rice papers | 25 g creme fraiche | 25 g ground cloves | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Wrap the rice paper, cloves and vinegar in cling film and place on a paper line in the refridgerator for 5 hours. Rinse, wipe dry and dry. Place on a plate in a single layer and sprinkle with creme fraiche and ground cloves. Re roll up and eat in two paper thin parcels. Serve with milk or cream.

Random Ingredients: white,swiss chard,mango,cilantro,chipotle chile adobo,pesto sauce,cilantro leaf,bell pepper
title: Smooth Swiss Chard with Mango and Chipotle
ingredients: 1 cup firm white swiss chard, stems trimmed | 1/4 cup pickled mixed sweet bell peppers, drained reserving some for garnish | 1/2 cup bell pepper, diced small | 6 leaves sweet basil ( about 2-1/2 in. length ) | 1 cup mango | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, with seeds removed and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons packed fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup bottled pesto sauce
instructions: Trim ribs from chard, if necessary, and discard ribs attached to leaves. Cut crosswise into 1 1/2 inch wide strips, discarding any tough ribs or membrane attached to leaves. Wash chard and dry completely in a paper towel. Cut into 1/2 inch wide strips, discarding ribs and membrane. Combine bell peppers, basil, mango, chipotle and 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro in a medium bowl. Add chard and mix thoroughly. Spread pesto over chard.

title: Easy White Bean Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces plain yogurt | 8 ounces greek yogurt | 2 cans white beans | oil, for frying
instructions: Chop your beans and fry with 2 inches oil in the pan. When golden brown put them into the bowl of a food processor and combine them. Add the yogurt a little at a time until you have the mixture thick and smooth. Pour this mixture into a serving bowl and put into the refrigerator until it thickens. You can either eat and enjoy with pita chips. Delicious with bread, pita, etc. Also great with crackers.

title: Simple and Delicious Italian Sauce
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes with tomato paste | 3 tablespoons simple syrup ( such as heinz )
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a large bowl, stirring gently until combined.

title: Green Chili Rub in a Jar
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried mustard powder | 1 red pepper, finely minced | 1 can diced green chiles, drained | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves, finely minced
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the mustard powder, red pepper, chopped green chiles and cilantro. Use this to coat fish.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,almond,cornflour,cooking onion,pork rib,arugula leaf,cream chicken soup,ice
title: Arugula-Shrimp Pastries
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs bone-in country-style pork ribs or 5 -6 lbs pork shoulder, coarsely chopped | 4 large cooking onions, peeled | 3 packages shrimp paste | 12 -15 arugula leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 cup ground almonds | cornflour ( optional ) | whipped cream ( optional ) or sour cream ( optional ) | 4 -5 cups ice
instructions: In a large crockpot or deep skillet, combine all ingredients except the ice and cook, stirring often, on low for 8 or 10 hours. Turn the temperature up to high. Remove ribs as they are done and stir in the cornflour. Cook on low for 15 - 20 more minutes stirring occasionally. The sauce should thicken slightly and the ribs are well coated with the fat. Serve over prepared arugula leaves.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,pam cooking spray,ham,raisin,curry powder
title: Quick and Easy Curried Ham
ingredients: 1/4 cup onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce rum ( optional ) or 1/8-1/4 fluid ounce cognac ( optional ) | 2 -3 slices ham, depending on how much you like your ham | pam cooking spray
instructions: Mix onion soup mix and curry powder together in a small bowl. Brush pan with some cooking spray, add ham, and turn until pieces are browned/well coated. Spray again with any remaining cooking spray and pour spice mixture over ham. Cover pan and cook for 30 minutes on low, stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: baguette,bonito flake,green,tomato juice,alfalfa sprout,pecorino romano cheese
title: Earl's Baguette
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut in half lengthwise and thinly sliced | 2 cans alfalfa sprouts | 1/4 cup chopped pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup chopped green | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1 ounce bonito flakes
instructions: In a large bowl or resealable plastic bag, combine the sprouts and cheese. In a small bowl, mix together the tomato juice and bonito flakes. Place the bagette slices on a baking sheet and bake at 450 degrees f., covered, for about 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned. Top with the sprouts and cheese mixture and serve.

title: Wild Rice and Apricots (Australian)
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice | 200 g salted scallops | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, cut in half | 1 large spring onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Rinse and dry wild rice and scallops. Place in a medium sized oven proof dish with apricots and spring onion. Mix baking powder with some water and pour over the scallops and rice. Bake in a pre heated oven 190°c for 30 minutes or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: bulgar wheat,nonfat milk,puff pastry,onion powder,apple cider vinegar
title: Apple Onion Tarte Tatin Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgar wheat | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 3 teaspoons onion powder | 3 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 1 1/3 cups frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Mix bulgur, milk, onion powder, and vinegar in a bowl. On a floured board, roll out pastry until it is about 1/4 thick. With a 2 inch cutter, cut pastry into three rows 1 1/2 inch wide by 3 1/2 inch long. Put a teaspoon of filling near one end of each pastry strip. Fold edges over filling so that they meet at the center of the dough. Press edges together lightly with a fork, then stretch pastry around the edge with a knife dipped in water to seal. Bring the two long sides of the pastry together, and pinch to seal. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Brush tops with water about half way through. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 25 minutes, or until pastry is crisp and golden brown.

title: Truffles En Recado (Carne Guisada)
ingredients: 1 pound beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped tomatoes with green chiles | ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place beef cubes in a wide, shallow bowl, and coat with pistachios. Sprinkle with black pepper. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Heat a wok over high heat. Add enough oil to cover the bottom and sides of the pan. Arrange the coated meat in an even layer. When oil is hot, and meat sizzling, pour in 2 or 3 tablespoons of the reserved meat water. Turn meat and let excess oil drip off. Transfer the meat to the oil.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,cod,virgin olive oil,red capsicum,chili paste,romano cheese,chicken broth
title: Portuguese Cod With Chilli (Grilled)
ingredients: 250 g cod | 1 teaspoon virgin olive oil | 2 -3 red chilies | 2 teaspoons sweet chili paste | 250 ml chicken broth | 2 romano cheese slices, halved | 1 red capsicum
instructions: Cut the cod fillets in to strips, 1 cm long. Grill or pan fry the cod pieces on both sides. Drain oil from oil. Mix chilli paste with the broth and pour over the fish pieces with the cheese slices. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. When ready to serve, grill the capsicum, cut in half and slice thinly on the bias. Serve the fish laid out with capsicum. Pour over the chilli sauce.

title: Artichoke Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 green pepper, chopped
instructions: Heat oven brown meat. Stir in artichokes and green pepper. Cover and heat through, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,pearl barley,tomato basil oregano garlic,red pepper flake,white corn flour,red capsicum,taco seasoning mix,mustard seed
title: Mexican Corn Baked Beans & Tofu
ingredients: 1 can white corn flour | 1 can diced tomatoes with basil and oregano garlic | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons instant pearl barley ( dry white rice ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds or 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard mixed with a teaspoon of olive oil | 1/3 cup red capsicum
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Combine corn flour, canned tomato goods, seasoning mix, pepper flakes & barley mix in a saucepan and bring to boil, stirring until creamy. Pour into baking dish, sprinkle with mustard seeds & red capsicum & bake 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Onion Cheese Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely minced or shredded queso fresco | 2 tablespoons finely minced shallots | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese ( about 2 ounces ) | 2 teaspoons finely chopped or shredded queso fresco ( about 2 ounces ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together queso fresca, shallots, 2 tablespoons of the mozzarella cheese and onion. Evenly spread queso fresca topping on cut sides of quesadilla and then sprinkle on remaining mozzarella cheese. Preheat a griddle or heavy skillet over medium heat. Cut queso fresco into about 3/4 inch thick pieces. Cook cheese pieces in the hot pan until lightly browned, 5 to 10 minutes, then transfer to a serving plate. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons mozzarella cheese and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,banana,sesame oil,maple syrup,lemon juice zest,curry paste
title: Quick & Easy Banana Chutney
ingredients: 2 large ripe bananas | 1/2 tablespoon pure maple syrup | 1/2 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 teaspoons lemon juice and zest of | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon curry paste ( or ketchup )
instructions: Cut bananas in half lengthwise, scoop out all of the pulp and then coarsely mash with a fork. Add all the ingredients and mix together using your hands, until everything is evenly mixed the batter will be fairly runny if the batter is too thick, add extra milk to make it thinner.

title: Classic French Mayonnaise Dressing
ingredients: 4 large egg yolks | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 1 cup heavy whipping cream ( whipping )
instructions: Set bowl over bowl of cold water. Beat yolks in mixer until lemon colored. Add the mayonnaise, thyme, and chives and beat until blended. Fold in whipping cream just until blended.

title: Basmati Pork and Roast Pork Rice
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb roast pork, cut into strips ( i've used pork ribs too or you can use pork roast in its broth ) | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 cup basmati rice
instructions: Cook rice. Saute pork strips in oil till brown. Add basmati rice and brown thoroughly. Place cooked chicken on top of rice and continue to cook. To make rice, spoon contents of rice into a bowl or cake pan. Cover with a damp cloth and put in refrigerator to chill. When you're ready, remove from refrigerator, uncover, sprinkle with white sauce.

title: Tortillas (Aka Fried Green Onions )
ingredients: 8 green onions or 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 2 sprigs fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Separate the tips from remaining white and green parts of onions. Slice off the tops of onions just below the bottoms and discard the hard outer layer. Carefully separate tips from bottom of onion. Finely chop and place in a large bowl. Chop parsley leaves into smaller pieces. Add all the parsley and green onion and mix. Towels. Heat non stick frying pan, on medium flame, and add a few tablespoons of oil and green onion/parsley mixture. When they are just slightly crispy, they should be lightly browned. Remove and drain on paper towels. Serve.

title: Easy Pesto Pizza Bread from Your Own Pizza Kitchen
ingredients: 2 cups dry breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups fresh basil leaves | 4 ounces ready to use pizza dough
instructions: Place your pizza dough on a lightly floured surface and lightly sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake for 10 minutes at 400 degrees. Allow the bread to cool slightly then slice with a pizza cutter into bite sized pieces. Allow the bread to cool uncovered again until completely cold before removing and allowing to cool completely on a baking sheet using an oven fork. Allow the bread pieces to cool on the baker's counter for 10 - 15 minutes then break them up with your hands to make the pesto. Serve with a dipping sauce or a good crusty salad. Note, you may use a pre prepared pizza dough for a shortcut meal or just sprinkle the bread with the crumbs. It is wonderful this bread is so easy to make and it is quick to make and easy to make and bake.

title: Cabbage Calabrese
ingredients: 1 cup whole pumpkin | 1 1/2 cups low sodium soy milk ( low sodium ) | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 1/2 cup provolone cheese, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons breadcrumbs or 1 1/2 teaspoons grated gruyere cheese ( vegetarian ) | 1 small savoy cabbage, cored and cut in 5cm chunks
instructions: Place the pumpkin in a steamer along with a small piece of cheese on top and water just below the top. Steam for 20 minutes, cover, and steam a further 8 minutes until fork tender and mushy. Remove from steamer and set aside. In a medium bowl, whisk together the milk, sugar, gruyere, provolone, and breadcrumbs. Add the cooked pumpkin mixture and place in a warm, covered plate or baking dish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,ice cube,ziti pasta,barbecue sauce,chicken,sultana,butter,golden raisin
title: My Chilled BBQ Pasta With Chicken
ingredients: 500 g dry ziti pasta, approx | 5 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 cup sultanas, golden raisins | 1/4 cup dark beer or 1/4 cup chicken stock | 6 cups cooked chicken | 1 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup butter, diced margarine or 1/4 cup butter, melted | 2 ice cubes
instructions: For the glaze, combine all ingredients and blend with a whisk until thick, creamy and free of graininess. For the chicken, bring a large saucepan of water to the boil over high heat, add the pasta and cook until just tender. Drain pasta and transfer to a large bowl. Coat with glaze, tossing to coat. Transfer to a dinner plate, add the butter and freeze until firm. To serve, spoon some of the chicken and sauce onto plate, arrange with ziti and drizzle with sauce.

title: Jamaica Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes, peeled | 2/3 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line baking sheet with parchment paper, spray with cooking spray. Cut potatoes lengthwise in quarters, then again into quarters. Place potatoes on sheet and spray with cooking spray and sprinkle with salt. Arrange in a single layer on prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven 50 - 55 minutes, or until tender. Drain off excess oil. Meanwhile combine coconut milk, onion, seasoned salt, marjoram, kaffir lime leaves and sliced mushrooms. Pour over potatoes. Bake, covered, 30 minutes. Uncover, bake 5 - 10 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: tequila,beef bouillon granule,cauliflower floret,mushroom stem,vegetable stock,meat,bicarbonate soda
title: Tequila Beef and Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 1 lb meat, diced | 2 teaspoons vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 cups mushrooms stems and pieces | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets | 4 teaspoons tequila
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 350°f. Heat two tablespoons of oil in a saucepan, and add the meat and all other ingredients. Stir and heat for 10 minutes. Strain and pour into an ovenproof casserole. Bake in pre heated oven for 45 minutes, then stir to mix. Serve hot with corn flour or fresh breadcrumbs.

title: Mika's Yellow Split Pea and Leek Bread
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split peas | 1 leek, sliced | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 2 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the split peas over a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: summer squash,tart apple,taco seasoning mix,shiitake mushroom,chicken wing,crabmeat,rice vinegar,cheddar cheese
title: Grilled Hawaiian Style Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 package chicken wings | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 cups cooked shredded summer squash | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 can crabmeat, drained | 4 slices cheddar cheese | 1 tart apple, cored and chopped
instructions: Preheat a grill for medium high heat. Lightly oil the grill. Place chicken wings on the grill, and cook 4 to 6 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear. Combine the vinegar, taco seasoning mix, and cooked chicken in a bowl, and stir to coat. Set aside, and cool to room temperature. Brush grill grate with oil. Place chicken wings on the grill, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, or until the chicken is no longer pink in the center. Brush the cooked chicken wings with oil, and place the mushrooms and crabmeat on the grill. Cook until the mushrooms are tender, and the crabmeat is hot. Sprinkle the chicken with cheese, and continue to grill until the cheese is melted. Top with the chicken wings.

title: French Cherry Tomatoes and Bacon on Endive (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, halved crosswise, or more to taste | 4 cherry tomatoes, or more to taste | 4 ounces stilton cheese, coarsely crumbled | 6 pieces provolone cheese, or more to taste, divided | 3/4 cup freshly shredded gruyere cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat an outside grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Place the bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain excess grease, about 3 tablespoons. Fry cherry tomatoes in the bacon oil until they become very hot and begin to soften, about 1 minute per side. Remove the cherry tomatoes with a slotted spoon and place on a plate. Sprinkle each slice with crumbled stilton cheese, 1 tablespoon of provolone cheese, 2 to 4 slices of gruyere cheese, remaining bacon slices, and bacon slices. Cover skillet and return lid to the grill.

title: Stuffed Italian Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 lb shortening | 1 lb mozzarella cheese, finely grated ( about 4 cups ) | 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a large bowl, cream together shortening, mozzarella cheese, bread crumbs and salt. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Form 12 long strips of meat and arrange on lightly greased baking sheet. Using 2 forks, separate the meat from the breadcrumbs. Lightly brush tops with oil and sprinkle with coarse salt. Bake at 400° f for 35 minutes, or until golden on outside and heated through in the center.

title: Easy Thai Peanut Butter Chicken Wings
ingredients: 500 g frozen lemonade concentrate ( thawed ) | 250 g jicama ( or mixed spring vegetables of your choice ) | 200 g peanut butter | 3 tablespoons mixed herbs ( i like a lot of basil, rosemary and oregano all together but it has no effect ) | 1 -2 gallon chicken wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Place the lemonade concentrate in microwave safe bowl. Whisk in peanut butter and herbs until blended. Cover bowl and place in the fridge until the mixture has chilled. Bake the chicken wings, brushing them with the lemonade concentrate. Heat chicken in oven until cooked and cooked through. You may need to place a piece of foil on top to keep from drying out. Serve hot with rice.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,chicken wing,veal cutlet,french green bean,cayenne
title: Veal With Green Beans
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped lemongrass ( see note at intro ) | 1/2 cup lemon juice ( zest of 1 lemon ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 lbs veal cutlets | 1 1/2 lbs french style green beans, trimmed and cut on diagonal into 3 inch pieces
instructions:
Note at medium size, lemongrass is also called fresh lemongrass and is used in all types of southeast indian dishes and many supermarkets use it to call for the herb names as such. The lemongrass is the dried herb 
    - 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest. Combine lemon peel and 1/4 cups water in a small bowl. Stir together lemon juice and zest in a 3 quart saucepan to blend. Rinse cutlets under cold running water and pat dry. Dry meat, if desired, and place in a shallow dish. Pour lemon peel mixture over chops and marinate for up to 4 hours in refrigerator. Grill cutlets, brushing with reserved marinade, until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 8 - 10 minutes per side. Remove cooked chops, but leave the cooking liquid in the dish. Cook beans in a large pot of boiling salted water, just till crisp tender, about 4 - 5 minutes. Drain and transfer to a platter. Add more cooking liquid if necessary to cover beans. Serve with meat, vegetables and potatoes.

title: Vegetarian Hamburgers
ingredients: 2 ounces panir | 1 tablespoon dried hijrais, soaked for 1 hour ( can use 1-in. sachet of dried chickpeas ) ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 pinch saffron | 3 tablespoons light soy sauce | lettuce, for serving | nutmeg, for grating
instructions: In a bowl, mash the paneer with a fork with the dried chickpeas, and mix with the dried hijrais, the caraway seeds and the saffron. Use salt and pepper to taste, as the harissa can get really unpleasant. Stir in the soy sauce, and refrigerate until needed. Shape the mixture into 6 patties, and press a pinch of nutmeg into the centre of each patty to cover. Grill the burgers for 8 - 10 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve with lettuce, and a simple syrup.

title: Rabo De Toro
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb lean sausage | 1 teabagas | 2 shots tequila
instructions: First, slice sausage into 1/4 inch slices against the grain. Soak the tea with 2 cups of water for a few minutes in an 8 qt saucepan before heating. You'll want to have some tea towels handy to keep the mixture moist as you go. Once you have done this, pour the water over the sausage and let it sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Now, pour the tequila with the tea in and let the tea sit for about 2 minutes to evaporate excess liquid. Stir in the sausage, then heat until warm and serve.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,salsa,ruby port,prune,chili pepper flake,cooking onion
title: Drink-Free Hot Sauce for Hot Dogs and Fruit
ingredients: 225 g pitted prunes | 2 tablespoons ruby port | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1 bay leaf | 1 small cooking onion | cooking onion, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/400°f. Using a food processor, purée together all of the ingredients except for the onion. Transfer to an ovenproof bowl with a lid or baking paper and add the onions and coat them well with the sauce. Bake for 30 minutes until the onion is golden and the sauce is reduced and syrupy.

title: Fiesta Lentils
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lentils ( french green or long green lentils ) | 1 cup snow peas | 3 tablespoons fontina cheese ( shredded ) | 1 1/4 cups low-fat natural yogurt | 1 apple
instructions: Wash and rinse lentils under cold water for several minutes until the water is clear. Drain lentils, place in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to boil, reduce heat and boil gently for about 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the water is almost all absorbed. While lentils are cooking, shred the apple and place in a large bowl along with the cheese. Mash the cheese with a fork. When lentils are done, drain and place in a small bowl along with the apple. Stir well. Stir in the cheese mixture and allow to sit for 10 minutes or so to allow flavors to blend. If you are serving the lentil mixture in the style of your choice, you may want to put the lentil mixture in bowls to serve while still hot.

title: Golden Syrup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups simple syrup or 1 1/2 cups honey | 2 tablespoons golden syrup or 2 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: In saucepan combine syrup, golden syrup and honey and bring to boil. Turn off heat and stir until all the syrup is disolved. Pour into hot, sterilized jars. Let sit for 1 - 2 days in a cool dark place before using.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cinnamon,lime juice,corn oil,palm sugar
title: Mexican Chocolate and Cinnamon-Cinnamon Pouch
ingredients: 16 leaves unsweetened chocolate ( mexican chocolate is also known as toritos in stores and usually in the sweets aisle at the grocery store ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 ounces grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons powdered palm sugar | 1/2 lime, juice of
instructions: Place chocolate in a bowl with the cinnamon, oil and cheese. Mix well, but do not stir. With a spoon mix in the palm sugar and lime juice. Store in a covered dish until ready to use. It will keep for 3 - 4 months. When you are ready to serve, simply remove the cinnamon and cheese from the chocolate and dip it into the chocolate until coated completely. This will keep covered and keep in the fridge 1 - 3 months.

Random Ingredients: turbinado sugar,baking powder,vanilla ice cream,wine vinegar,almond paste,chicken bouillon,white bean
title: Easy White Bean & Cheese Icebox
ingredients: 2 quarts vanilla ice cream | 1 can white beans, drained | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1/2 cup turbinado sugar | 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1/2 cup instant chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons clear vanilla ice cream
instructions: Drain the white beans, rinse well and put in bowl with baking powder. Set aside. In pan with vinegar, dissolve boullion in water, add salt and vanilla, stir until dissolved. Remove from heat and add to ice cream with vinegar mixture. Stir until blended. Pour into 9x9 baking pan. Freeze until firm then break away using fork or spoon. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast meat,fruit,chow mein noodle,cucumber,cantaloupe,barbeque sauce,red bell pepper,pork tenderloin
title: Spicy Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 cup cooked barbeque sauce | 1 cup chopped cooked chicken breast meat | 1/2 cup chopped cooked pork tenderloin | 1/4 cup chopped cucumber, with the peel | 2 tablespoons prepared fruit, cut into thirds | 1/4 cup finely chopped red bell pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped cantaloupe | 1 package chow mein noodles
instructions: In shallow nonmetal baking dish, combine barbeque sauce, chicken, pork, cucumber, fruit and bell pepper. Top with chow mein noodles. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,pizza sauce,chili powder,cardamom pod,margarita mix,mayonnaise,molasses
title: Fiber-Free Pesto
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated reduced pina sandwich prepared pesto spread ( found at trader joe's market or in the italian ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup shredded parmesan mix | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods | 2 -3 pinches crushed pineapple nuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to spread pesto on bottom and sides of pizza pan or baking stone. Mix remaining ingredients together. Spread on pizza base evenly. Drain pineapple, if desired, and evenly distribute on top of sauce. Bake for 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Spread remaining pesto on top of pizza, then sprinkle with paprika if desired. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Simple Manchego Cheese Foldovers
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pie shells | 3 tablespoons grated manchego cheese | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a small bowl combine grated cheese and italian seasoning.

title: Gourmet Magazine Style Ladyfingers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons orange rind, grated | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, diced ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup flour | 1 whole orange, split, pith removed, washed thoroughly
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a baking sheet with cooking parchment. Combine orange peel and 2 tbsp orange juice. Set aside. Place bell pepper and flour in a food processor fitted with metal blade.

title: Homemade Indian Dahi (Fish Tarkari
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ghee or 3 tablespoons light oil | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet. When oil is hot, add the black ghee and stir continuously for a few seconds. Stir in white pepper. Dahi will be very flaky so stir and fry until it becomes crisp and slightly dark brown. This will be very quick. Drain onto absorbent cloth and serve immediately. It really is wonderful with white rice. It also freezes well for upto 7 months.

title: Chinese Peanut Oil
ingredients: 1 cup peanut oil or 1 cup vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon clam juice
instructions: If using clam juice, reserve for topping your hot sauces, or use empty clam juice can or can to juice the clams. Otherwise, pour oil in a wok, or deep skillet and heat over medium flame until a drop of water bounces off when drops dance on surface. When the oil is hot, carefully place clam meat into center, leaving space for shaking. As soon as they appear to be cooking, pour in the clam juice. A few seconds later, add the remaining oil. If the oil still clams before the oil begins smoking, drain them in a sieve or strainer lined with a paper towel. Serve hot. Cook's note, the oil can also be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for about 3 months. This oil can also be frozen for up to 2 months if desired.

Random Ingredients: tahini,chinese egg noodle,sultana,edam cheese,bacon,onion soup mix,oregano
title: Cheese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces chinese egg noodles | 4 ounces of salted edam cheese, cubed | 1/2 bunch sultana | 1/4 cup sultana | 1/4 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons instant onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon oregano
instructions: In the morning add the edam cheese, sultanas, tahini, and instant onion soup powder. Mix well. Pour salad over rice sticks and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sultana,red cabbage,safflower oil,cayenne pepper,creamy peanut butter,feta cheese,white
title: Easy Peanut Butter Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon safflower oil | 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup sultana | 1 -2 tablespoon feta cheese ( or feta if you prefer ) | 1 -2 tablespoon grated raw almonds or 1 -2 tablespoon desiccated coconut | 2 -3 cups thinly sliced red cabbage
instructions: Chop sultanas, peanuts and coconut if using and toss with salad greens and dressing. Serve.

title: Southern Style Italian Pork
ingredients: 4 pounds pork roast | 4 zucchini, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Put the pork roast into a large dutch oven or crockpot. Layer zucchini over the roast, and lay out a large plate on top of the pork. Carefully pour 1/2 cup of water into the pan, and just so the water doesn't separate. Cover, and simmer over medium low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the pork is fork tender. When the internal temperature of the meat is 160 degrees f, and the zucchini is soft enough to slice, remove the lid, and continue cooking until the zucchini is as soft as you want it to be, about 2 hours more. Remove the cooked meat, and slice into 1/4 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,beef stock,yellow cornmeal,cocoa powder,habanero pepper
title: Mexican Chocolate Gravy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2/3 cup beef stock | 1 habanero pepper, diced
instructions: Combine flour, cornmeal and cocoa in medium skillet. Cook over medium heat until mixture begins to bubble, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add beef stock and habanero. Cool completely. Transfer to covered container and refrigerate overnight to allow flavours to blend.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,anise seed,jalapeno chile pepper,tomato puree,pork shoulder
title: Pancho Villa-Style Pork
ingredients: 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 pound chicken breast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jalapeno chile pepper, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 can tomato puree | 1 tablespoon anise seed
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and coat with cooking spray. Place all the pork and chicken into the bottom of a dutch oven or large saucepan, and season with chili powder and salt. Pour the tomato puree over all, and sprinkle with anise seed. Cover and cook for one hour, until all liquid has been absorbed and pork is tender. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,limeade concentrate,cold water,fontina cheese,turnip,wheat flour tortilla
title: Turnip-Turnip Burritos International
ingredients: 3 large turnips, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch matchsticks | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 cup cold water | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup packed fontina cheese, finely shredded | 4 soft whole wheat flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place turnips in a large pot and cover with lightly salted water. Bring water to a boil and cook until tender but still firm, about 40 minutes. Drain, return to pot and mash using potato masher or potato whisk. Place turnips and limeade concentrate in food processor and pulse until mixture is smooth. Stir in cold water until mixture is moistened. Reserve 2 cups mash. Pour remaining mashed turnip mixture into a greased 8x8 inch baking dish. Spread evenly with 1/4 cup of graham cracker crumbs. Sprinkle with fontina cheese and top with whole wheat flour tortillas to enclose filling. Bake in the preheated oven until filling is hot, 10 to 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Spam® Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 cubes bouillon | 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the bouillon. Stir in the cheddar cheese until melted. Pour into a blender, close the lid, and process until smooth. Pour into soup bowls and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,white chocolate,beef broth,egg substitute,mandarin orange segment,curry powder
title: Maurice's Mandarin Orange Meatballs
ingredients: 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained | 1/2 cup egg substitute, or as needed | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/3 cup low-sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 cup white chocolate, grated ( optional )
instructions: Blend mandarin oranges, egg, curry powder, and beef broth in a blender on high for 1 minute, then blend for 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,cold water,basil,vegetable choice,cornstarch,cardamom,goat cheese,egg
title: Stuffed Goat's Cheese Wraps
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable, mixed fresh vegetables ( eg onions, carrots, celery, mushrooms ) | 150 g goat cheese | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1 cup cold water | 2 large eggs | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom, preferably freshly ground
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place vegetables evenly in 4 greased, shallow ovenproof bowls. Spoon half goats' cheese over vegetables. Combine corn starch, chilli powder and eggs and pour into bowl, whisking in to combine. Stir through flour, then add water until mixture is thick and creamy. Spoon onto goats' cheese and vegetables. Sprinkle with cheese and herbs. Bake on 180c/350f/gas 4 for 30 - 40 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pear,espresso powder,flat leaf parsley,cayenne pepper,rosemary,coffee,bamboo shoot
title: Pear and Rosemary Grilled Cheese With a Kick
ingredients: 4 pears, cut into 3/4-inch wide slices and placed in a bowl of warm water, about 8 ounces, for brushing | 8 leaves fresh rosemary, about 3/4 pound ( or use dried or finely chopped fresh rosemary ) | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder ( optional, or substitute 1/8 teaspoon instant espresso granules and 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee or 1/8 teaspoon espresso ) | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 ounces canned bamboo shoots, drained | 1/3 cup strong coffee, room temperature ( or strong coffee liqueur )
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high. Brush the pears with some oil and arrange them on a grill rack lined with the cut side of the oven shelf. Grill until slightly charred on the top, about 4 minutes for the pears and 3 for the rosemary. Turn once. Place the pan over direct heat. Grill until the pears begin to break into small bits, about 3 minutes. The pears should be crisp when you are ready. Transfer the cooled pears to a bowl. Add the rosemary leaves, fresh rosemary leaves, espresso and cayenne.

title: English Parsnips Diced Oranges and Fruit Salad W-Parsley Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg parsnips, peeled and cut into segments | 1 tablespoon dried fruit, of your choice ( such as raisins, cranberries, dates and candied cherries )
instructions: Place the parsnips in a steamer basket large enough to hold them in a single layer. Cover, and steam over a brisk heat for 15 minutes. Turn them over and steam for another 15 minutes longer or until they are cooked completely. Stir in the dried fruit. Serve with crusty bread, crackers or toast.

title: Dynamite-Marinated Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken, cut into quarters | 1 cup milk | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Place chicken pieces in a non metallic bowl and cover with milk. Cover and marinate in fridge for 1 hour or longer. Remove chicken from marinade. Dreg well and place in shallow ovenproof dish. Combine cornflour and honey, stir until combined. Sprinkle mixture over chicken and bake uncovered at 180 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Champagne Pecan Pie
ingredients: 12 egg yolks | 1/2 cup mirin | 6 cups dark brown sugar | 1 cup fresh pecans, finely chopped | 12 cups champagne | blueberries or other seasonal fruit, as desired
instructions: Place 1st 9 ingredients in large bowl and beat with mixer until well mixed. Pour 1 cup mixture into 9 inch pie pan. Repeat process. Pour remaining mixture into pie pan and place in freezer. Freeze for at least 2 hours. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh blueberries or other seasonal fruit.

title: Apricot-Marinated Antipasto
ingredients: 6 firm apricots, peeled and quartered | 1 bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup palm sugar | 1/4 cup sambal oelek | 6 strips prosciutto
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a sealable container and shake well.

Random Ingredients: greek seasoning,turmeric powder,white bread,nut,pea,snow pea,fennel seed,tortilla
title: Vegetable Tacos
ingredients: 2 fresh tortillas | 1/4 cup frozen peas | 1/4 cup frozen cut snow peas | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon italian seasoning | 2 slices white bread, crumbled | 6 tablespoons chopped nuts
instructions: Mix together the italian seasoning and spread evenly over the inside of each tortilla. Next, place about 3 tablespoons of peas and the frozen slice of bread between each tortilla. Place a teaspoon of fennel seeds, a cup of snow peas, and a teaspoon of turmeric in the center of each.

title: Easy Zucchini and Nuts
ingredients: 1 zucchini | 1 cup canola oil | 1 tablespoon canola oil, extra-virgin | 1/4 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 4 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1/4 cup pecans
instructions: Cut zucchini into 1 inch pieces and steam until they are slightly tender, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and transfer to a large bowl. Cut zucchini into 1 inch cubes. Blend canola oil, ketchup, vegetable broth and sesame seeds in food processor until smooth. Add zucchini and blend until well mixed and just combined. Stir in pecans and season to taste with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,italian seasoning,italian sausage,vanilla essence,graham cracker,curry powder,catsup
title: Sausage Curry Noodles With Caramelized Onions and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 600 g sweet italian sausage | 1/4 cup chili-garlic infused catsup | 1/4 cup finely chopped curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 4 large eggs and 1 egg white | 1 box egg noodles | graham cracker, crushed
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1cm cubes. Put the fatback into a deep pan with a lid, and add the catsup, curry, spices and mix well. Cook this until the meat is cooked all the way through. Add the beaten egg to this mixture. Bring to a low boil and then leave the mixture to simmer for 3 minutes. Meanwhile, make the chips. Break the egg up a little with a fork and beat it until really fluffy without it separating anymore. Stir into the meat mixture and heat through. Put the noodles on to boiling water with one corner of the noodle on the bottom to get rid of any excess water. After the noodles are cooked, drain them well, and put them into a dish with a lid. Pour the sausage mixture over the noodles and top with crushed graham cracker crumbs. Set into the fridge, and allow to set for 30 minutes. Serve.

title: Homemade Vegetable Mix for Feta Cheese
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Place the frozen vegetables into a dutch oven or other small saucepan. Fill with enough water to cover the vegetables completely. Heat over medium high heat until bubbling. Cover pan tightly and reduce heat to medium low. Cook for 1 hour. Remove from heat and remove lid. Allow to cool 10 minutes before mixing with your preferred feta cheese.

title: Fresh Raspberries With No-Tomato Vinaigrette
ingredients: 350 g fresh raspberries | 2 tablespoons fresh raspberry oil or 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 ripe mangoes, peeled and cut in 1/4-inch dice | 1 1/2 cups no-salt-added tomato puree ( or one 8 oz can )
instructions: Pour the raspberry oil or oil over the fresh fruit until coated. Let stand at room temp for 5 to 10 hours stirring occasionally. Meanwhile cook the semi frozen mango over medium hot high heat until it is just starting to soften, about 2 to 3 minutes each side. Drain the mango and set aside. Drain the tomatoes and mango well and transfer to a blender. Add the mango and tomato puree or puree, and puree to desired consistency. Taste and season with salt and pepper if required. Place in a pretty salad bowl or platter, and serve immediately with french bread, chips, or other crackers. The raspberries can be substituted for the fresh berries. This recipe may also make a larger or smaller amount of raspberries. Note, if you prefer, you may add a few frozen raspberries.

title: Cashew Stuffing
ingredients: 2 lbs green apples | 2 cups cashews | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Mix all of the above ingredients and store in a dry container.

title: Simple Basil Chips
ingredients: 8 cups mixed fresh basil leaves, rinsed and dried | 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Line a large colander with several layers of paper towels. Place the basil leaves on the paper towels, and shake the basil until the water leaves the food. Soak the basil for 15 minutes. Drain the basil leaves and place them in the bowl of a food processor. Add the chocolate chips and process until smooth. Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch square pan, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Linguine W-Tofu
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 1 package linguine | 2 bay leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon red chili powder | 2 tablespoons sliced green peppers | 1 package fried salami | tortilla
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and fry tofu until light brown. Add the red chili powder and toss well. Saute one minute for color and to absorb the spices. While the tofu is cooking, cook the linguine according to package directions. Drain and add to the pan, along with the green pepper slices. Pour in the tofu mixture and heat thoroughly. Taste for seasoning and adjust. Serve with tortillas.

title: Bread Machine Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 teaspoon of bread machine yeast | 1/3 cup fish sauce | 1/3 cup chicken stock or 1/3 cup fish sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Put all ingredients into the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Set crust on medium and program for the dough cycle.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,green chili,beef stew meat,cottage cheese,onion powder,gruyere cheese,hot italian sausage,red chilies
title: German Style Sausage and Lamb Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage | 2 lbs lamb shank | 1 lb beef stew meat | 2 lbs lamb shanks | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon ground red chilies | 1 jar chopped green chili | 1 package low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Cut sausage into 1 inch cubes. Peel and cut lamb into 1 inch cubes. Peel and cut beef into 1 inch cubes. Combine sausage, lamb, stew meat, onion powder, chili and chilies. Pour half of meat mixture into an ungreased 13x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with half of the cottage cheese. Add remaining meat mixture, then cheese. Drizzle with remaining flour. Cover with foil. Bake for 3 hours or until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 4 large tortillas | 1 jar of sliced pepperoncini peppers, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Wrap tortillas in aluminum foil and place on cookie sheet.

title: Spicy Kale Blend
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup chopped toasted almond, chopped ( i use an almond that has been crushed with my mortar and pestle ) | 2 teaspoons hot paprika | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/2 teaspoon hot dry mix, such as spicy kale | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( i use a mixture of the green and regular stems )
instructions: Wash and trim kale. Cut into 4 wedges. Place kale and onion in a large bowl. Sprinkle with almonds. Toss to mix. Sprinkle with paprika, cardamom, and hot mix. Toss gently to blend. Cover, and set aside for a few hours. Combine kale mixture, cilantro, and kale at meal time.

title: Baked Meatballs With Cinnamon
ingredients: 6 meatballs, precooked ( small or medium, depending on size of meat ) | 3 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon ( or as much as you like )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Using two 3 1/2 x 3 1/2 inch cookie sheets, arrange precooked meatballs on each sheet. Sprinkle with a little more cinnamon. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until the meat is cooked and the top is nicely browned. Cut each meatball in half and serve with hot buttered bread. This also freezes well.

title: Dessert Salad
ingredients: 2 bananas, sliced thin | 1/2 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 ounces farmer's cheese
instructions: Dab banana slices with paper towel. Mix yogurt and juice and set aside. Layer half of the banana slices, 1/2 cup cheese and 3/4 cup yogurt mixture in the first layer of ingredients in a casserole. Repeat steps 6 and 7 several more times lay the remaining bananas on top. Pour yogurt mixture over bananas and cheese. Cover and chill for at least 45 minutes before serving immediately.

title: Tocook (Fried Chicken)
ingredients: 1 chicken breast ( sliced thin ) | ham ( thinly sliced ) | lettuce leaf ( or green leaf ) | green cabbage ( sliced )
instructions: Fry the chicken in a little oil along with the ham for about 10 minutes. When the chicken is half way cooked, throw in all the lettuce and cabbage. Serve with white rice.

title: Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 150 g monterey jack cheese, grated | 6 eggs | 1 tablespoon crushed chili pepper | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: Beat the cheese, eggs and crushed chili pepper until smooth. Add coriander, stir. Pour into a greased and lined 20cm loaf pan, bake in a moderately hot oven for 45 minutes, or until set. Cool on a wire rack and cut into 16 slices.

title: Italian Grilled Pepper on a Gas Range
ingredients: 1/2 bell pepper, sliced into 4 thin strips | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, coarsely ground
instructions: Prep grill fire or preheat gas grill. Add pepper strips and pepper flakes to grill. Remove pepper mixture from grill. Brush mixture all over with pepper using a paper towel. Grill pepper on grill until lightly charred, 3 to 5 minutes on one side each side.

title: Soup of Salmon
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups low sodium beef broth, divided | 1 cup beetroot, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch chunks or 1 cup courgette, cut into 1/4-inch chunks | 1 1/2 tablespoons lard ( optional ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 salmon, each cut into 6-7 thick pieces | 1/2 cup lightly packed cilantro leaf
instructions: In a large pot, bring 1 cup broth, 2 cups water and remaining ingredients to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Stir salmon into soup. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Saurkål (Swiss Meatball)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meat | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 cans red chile, paste | 2 tablespoons vanilla beans, split length-wise | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast
instructions: Drain the chiles and set aside. Put the remaining ingredients in a bowl and add a little water if you need it. Pour over the meat mixture and stir to coat well. Let the batter rest for 15 minutes to relax the flavors and develop a nice thick texture to the meat balls. Scoop or put into the freezer and bake in a 350f degree oven.

title: Peanut Butter Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 package penne rigate | 1 cup frozen peas | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 cups cooked white rice
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Drain thoroughly. Set aside. Heat oil in large skillet. Add peas and cook until heated through and starting to brown. Remove peas. Add rice and warm through. Add peanut butter and stir until butter melts.

title: Tamarind and Chocolate Shortbread
ingredients: 200 g plain flour or 200 g gluten-free flour | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste ( to marinate ) | 200 g chocolate, melted
instructions: Mix together the flour and tamarind paste in a large bowl. Gradually add the melted chocolate. Mix well with hands until dough resembles fine breadcrumbs. If you’re using gluten free flour, add a little extra so dough won’t stick to fingers – but if it does, knead the dough to a soft dough. If dough is too crumbly, knead briefly. Pat dough into a ball and place on a floured board. Cut into small triangles with a cookie cutter or on a baking paper dusted surface. Using about a teaspoon of dough, coat the top of each triangle with a little bit of the melted chocolate. Cook in moderate oven. If you’re freezing these… just pop them into your freezer the next day and store in airtight tins.

title: Cornmeal and Onion Rolls (For Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 packet dried apricot jam ( or apricot jam ) | 1 packet of quick-rise active dry yeast ( or envelope dry yeast ) | 1/2 cup apricot jam ( or apricot jam ) | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: In the bread machine pan, sprinkle the yeast over 1/2 cup warm water. Put the remaining dry ingredients in a mixing bowl, add the olive oil, and combine well. Put the dough in the bread machine pan. To test, poke the top and see if it's baked or not, if the crust is browning too quickly, cover with plastic wrap. If it's baked, put in the bread machine. Press the mix button, then restart, and test for when the dough is firm. Let dough rest for 5 minutes before cutting. When you remove the bread from the bread machine, spread the jam over the top. If the jam does not spread out, make more with less water, as directed above.

title: Homemade Bran
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey | 1 tablespoon allspice | 1 tablespoon bran cereal
instructions: Brown ground turkey, adding more seasoning if needed. Add allspice. Drain thoroughly on paper towels. Add cereal. Break up as necessary.

title: Saffron Truffles
ingredients: 12 ounces bittersweet chocolate, broken into 3 pieces | 1/4 cup toasted sesame oil | 1/3 cup chopped pitted black olives | 1/4 teaspoon sage | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaves, minced | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: Melt the chocolate, sesame oil, black olives, sage, basil, and saffron over low heat. Do not boil. Remove from heat. Roll into small balls with hands, then coat with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Almond Cabbage
ingredients: 1 pound red cabbage, finely shredded | 1/16 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup slivered almonds ( optional )
instructions: Line a colander with a double thickness of kitchen towels. Place cabbage in the center of the towels, and sprinkle almond extract evenly over the cabbage. Cover with cloth, and twist to drain any excess moisture. Repeat with remaining cabbage. Set aside to dry for 1 hour. Line a colander with a cotton cloth, and place over a bowl. Pour cabbage onto cloth, and gently squeeze to drain. Cut slits in cabbage to allow steam to drain. Sprinkle with slivered almonds, if desired. Serve warm or cold.

title: Chinese Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach | 1 cup fresh snow peas, trimmed and snapped | 1/3 cup chopped red onion
instructions: Place spinach in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,pearl barley,tamari,tuna vegetable oil,icing sugar,beef liver,head cabbage,yellow onion
title: Beef and Guinness Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef | 1/2 yellow onion | 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 3/4 cups canned guinness stout beer ( don't use any other spirit ) | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 1 bunch baby pearl barley | 1 cup shredded cabbage
instructions: Brown meat in oil and onions, then place in crockpot. Add all other ingredients except cabbage. Cook on high for 10 hours.. Add cabbage. Stir and cook 15 minutes longer.

title: Quick and Easy Sourdough French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread | 2 cups chunky salsa ( i also like pace )
instructions: Cut ends off the bread and pull out the inside. In a 9 x 13 glass casserole dish, arrange the bread in a horizontal even layer. Spoon the salsa over the bread and allow to sit to soak in the juices for 1 hour. Serve at once. You can also spoon them over ice cream when serving it to make dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,flat leaf parsley,dashi,raspberry,white pepper,pimento pepper,celery rib,italian salad dressing
title: Soupa Kystensuppe
ingredients: 1/2 cup dashi | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup celery rib, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pimento pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing, of your choice | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 cup raspberries, washed and chopped
instructions: To make sauce, boil dashi in a pot with lemon juice, until thickened. Stir in parsley, celery, pimento, italian dressing, white pepper, and raspberries. Pour over cooked and cooled soupa.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,mint leaf,water artichoke heart,taco seasoning mix
title: Easy Crock Pot Texas Hot Pot
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket, fully trimmed | 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and rinsed | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( i use the one that comes in the can section ) | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a 3 - 4 or 4 - 3 1/2 quart crock, place brisket fat side up. Spread the artichoke hearts evenly over the brisket. Cover and bake on high heat for about 3 - 4 hours or on low for 6 - 8 hours until tender. Remove from the crock.

title: Prosciutto Ham and Corn
ingredients: 4 pieces prosciutto ham, sliced thick from the center out | 1 -2 tablespoon dried gingerroot, crushed | 1 can creamed corn, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place prosciutto slices on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle with ginger and bake for 15 minutes or so. Drain liquid from pan, stir in corn and bake for a further 10 minutes, or until heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white,tortilla chip,tomato sauce,red pepper,oregano leaf,green capsicum,yellow pea,rice vermicelli
title: Napa Dave's Vegetarian Nachos
ingredients: 3 teaspoons yellow split peas | 3 teaspoons green capsicum, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons red peppers, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 250 g rice vermicelli | 2 cups white breadcrumbs ( or as required ) | 20 g tortilla chips
instructions: To make a simple white sauce mix together all the vegetables, tomato sauce and oregano in a skillet. Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until the sauce has thickened slightly. Cook the rice noodles in boiling water for 2 mins, then drain. Spread a tablespoon of the white sauce onto the noodles, then roll them up until completely covered. Spoon the remaining sauce over each serving and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,rice noodle,pancetta bacon,dark sesame oil,thyme sprig,green grape
title: Rice Noodle Salad With Red Cabbage and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 red cabbage ( about 1lb. ) or 1 other mild red cabbage, cored and cut into thin strips ( about 1lb. ) | 10 green seedless grapes or 10 other green seedless grapes, cut into 1/2-inch wide sticks | fresh thyme sprig, plus additional ( to garnish ) | 1/2 lb pancetta bacon, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch strips | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 12 ounces fresh rice noodles, preferably white, preferably al dente
instructions: Cook the cabbage in a 5 to 6 quart pot of boiling salted water until just tender, 4 to 5 minutes, and cool in medium bowl. Transfer to bowl with cold water and let stand, about 5 minutes. Drain well and let cool, about 10 minutes more. Chop coarsely. Meanwhile, warm 1/3 cup water in small saucepan until just boiling. Remove from heat. Add the grapes and thyme stalks. Season with salt and pepper and let stand, 5 minutes. In 1 minute increments, stir in 1/2 cup cabbage and 1 tablespoon pancetta. Cook noodles in hot water until just tender, 3 to 2 minutes.

title: Tasty Easy Mashed Potatoes (With Cheese and Chili Too!)
ingredients: 8 ounces low-fat cottage cheese | 2 cups bread flour | 1 tablespoon rice flour or 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 can refried beans | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon chili | 1 teaspoon gravy | 8 ounces tofu, mashed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and knead until mixture is smooth. Cover with plastic wrap, refridgerator overnight. Roll out on floured board in long, thin sheets. Cut into desired shape and fill with desired filling. Freeze. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,chinese five spice powder,wheat bread,orange juice,chicken breast half,chili powder,sherry wine,thai chili sauce
title: Chinese Chicken in Bamboo Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves, with thighs | 6 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 4 teaspoons chili powder, divided | 60 ml sherry wine | 1/4 cup orange juice | 60 ml chinese five-spice powder, divided | 500 g bok choy, washed and roughly chopped | 80 ml sweet chili sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c, 400f, gas mark place the chicken in a baking dish. Combine the five spice, chilli and the sherry in a small bowl, stir in the orange juice, 2 teaspoons of the spice powder and the remainder of the spice powder. Pour over the chicken and leave to marinate for around 1 hour. Bake for 40 minutes, covered. Remove from the oven and drain any excess fat from the chicken. Add the bok choy and fry for 3 to 4 minutes until coated with the spice mixture. Spoon over the chicken and serve.

title: Roasted Mixed-Fruit and Tahini Dip
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 cups mixed dried fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spray a small shallow baking dish with vegetable oil spray. Spread tahini on the foil in a single layer to absorb any excess oil. Spread the fruit over the tahini, then sprinkle with remaining tahini. Bake for 16 to 18 minutes, or until the dip turns light brown. Store dip in tightly covered container for up to 2 weeks.

title: The Orange Tahini Refries
ingredients: 1/3 cup plain peanut butter | 1/3 cup tahini | 2 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1 1/4 cups dried beans, rinsed well & patted dry | 1 cup ice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well, adding ice. Put in glass for a light refresh or snack.

title: Pork Stuffed Chicken Breasts (Crocus Fashoulia)
ingredients: 12 boneless skinless pork shoulder | 12 chicken breasts | 8 ounces gouda cheese, sliced or shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place pork fat side up on paper towels and pat dry. Wrap a slice or two of gouda cheese inside each breast, and secure with toothpicks. Place breasts on a wire rack, about 15 or twenty feet long. Place on a rack in a roasting pan large enough to hold them in a single layer. Brush breasts with a mixture of the remaining mixture. Roast covered for 45 minutes, and then turn breasts over and roast an additional 30 minutes, or until internal temperature of the meat registers 160 degrees f for about 2 to 3 hours. Allow breasts to rest 15 minutes before slicing and serving. Serve with a side of rice and vegetables.

title: Sopa De Arroz Doce (Arroz Verde)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken stock | 4 serrano peppers, finely chopped | nonstick cooking spray, for the skillet
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Cover with a lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the flavors are well blended. Serve warm.

title: Tilapia with Chilean Beef Pilaf #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages ready-to-serve beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 pounds boneless chicken pieces, cut into 1-inch pieces | 4 large baking potatoes | 1 cup almond meal | 1 package tilapia fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Arrange beef, chicken, potatoes and almond meal in a layer in the prepared pan. Finish with a layer of tilapia.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,whipping cream,spring onion,parmesan cheese,chili powder
title: Parmesan & Chilli Sour Cream
ingredients: 150 ml tomato juice | 250 ml whipping cream | 3 spring onions, finely sliced | 1 tablespoon instant chili powder | 2/3 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Heat the tomato juice, cream, spring onions and chilli powder in a saucepan over gently simmering water and cook for 2 mins or until the cream reduces. Stir in half the parmesan and serve.

Random Ingredients: cantaloupe,baby bok choy,canola oil,basmati rice,palm sugar,black pepper,clove,cauliflower
title: Quick and Easy Vegetable Rice Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup basmati rice ( not instant ) or 3/4 cup jasmine rice | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon palm sugar or 3/4-1 teaspoon light brown sugar | 1 package frozen cauliflower, thawed and cut into bite size pieces | 1 can baby bok choy, sliced | 1/4 cup canola oil ( i like grapeseed oil ) | 2/3 cup cantaloupe ( optional but works well ) or 2/3 cup guinea ( optional but works well ) | 10 whole cloves | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: In a 9 x 9 x 2 baking pan, in 1/2 inch increments microwave rice, sugar, cauliflower, bok choy, canola oil and cloves until hot, tossing to coat. Sprinkle with pepper. Cover and microwave until rice is cooked and vegetables are heated through, stirring once or twice, about 11 minute check for doneness, adding more pepper if needed..

title: Easy Easy Baked Mushroom
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup ( undiluted ) | 1/2 lb white mushroom, sliced | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a baking dish and mix well. Sprinkle top with parmesan cheese.

title: Pumpkin Seeds and Sultanas
ingredients: 2 cups sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 3 tablespoons pumpkin seeds ( pumpkin-coconut, pudina, etc. ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon cubes or 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules | 1/2 - 3/4 cup salad oil
instructions: Place sultananas in a large bowl. Add the other ingredients and toss to coat. Let sit for an hour to blend flavours. Pour off excess liquid, if necessary. Store in an airtight container in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,prosciutto,corn kernel,cilantro leaf,thai basil,angel hair pasta
title: Pasta with Cilantro & Prosciutto
ingredients: 8 ounces dried angel hair pasta | 1/2 cup loosely packed cilantro leaves, chopped divided | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 8 ounces baby corn kernels, blanched until just tender | 1/2 cup fresh-grated country-style prosciutto | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro leaves | 2/3 cup torn fresh thai basil
instructions: Place pasta in a large pot and cover with 3 inches of water. Set over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then stir occasionally. Cook until al dente, about 12 minutes. Drain in a colander and immediately transfer to a warm serving bowl. Meanwhile, place 1 tablespoon cilantro, caraway seeds and corn kernels in a medium size skillet over medium heat. Cook, shaking the skillet regularly, until the kernels are softened, about 2 minutes. Stir in the prosciutto and 2 tablespoons cilantro until well combined. Add the remaining cilantro and basil. Place the pasta back in the pot, add the prosciutto mixture and stir well to blend. Serve immediately.

title: Cheese and Barley Flour Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup stone's original cheese, such as gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup barley flour, all-purpose | 1 teaspoon dried italian parsley, leaves
instructions: In medium bowl, combine the cheese, barley flour, and dried parsley. Mix well. Using a 2 round cookie cutter, cut dough into rounds. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Ethiopian Lemon Bread
ingredients: 3 3/4 cups buckwheat flour, or more if needed ( besan ) | 1 piece lemon zest
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, grind lemon zest into a smooth paste. Mix the buckwheat flour and lemon zest together in a bowl, and mix in a cup of water with a fork. Knead on a floured work surface, and knead until dough becomes smooth, supple and elastic, and no longer sticky. Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Punch down the dough slightly, and roll it into a rough 11 inch circle. Brush all over with a thin film of oil. Cut the dough into 12 wedges, and arrange the wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the bread has puffed, browned, and has absorbed the oil, 30 to 40 minutes. Cool, and store in an airtight container.

title: Tostadas from the Plaza Hotel
ingredients: 1 package pita bread | 1 1/2 cups lettuce | 8 small new potatoes, thinly sliced | 12 lollipop sticks, each about 6 inches long | 2 cups milk | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 2 pounds uncooked large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Prepare the pita bread according to recipe on package. Place the lettuce into a large serving bowl. Cover with warm, salted water, and refrigerate until chilled, about 30 minutes. Drain. Place potato slices on a baking sheet and brush with maple syrup. Using a slotted spoon, place the shrimp in a single layer on top of the potatoes. Place pita bread pockets on top of the shrimp and lettuce and refrigerate until ready to serve. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the remaining ingredients. Return to a boil, reduce heat to medium, and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Season the cooked shrimp with salt and pepper and divide evenly among bread pockets. Serve with warmed, freshly cooked shrimp.

title: Spicy Noodles With Pineapple-Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1/3 cup pasta sauce ( bottled or home made, you choose ) | 1 teaspoon red chili paste | 3 ounces medium noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a saucepan, bring to a boil until reduced to half it, stirring frequently. Remove from heat, stir in the noodles and cover, let stand 5 minutes. Serve over your favourite pasta or with your favourite vegetable accompaniment.

title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup red roasted garlic | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons icing sugar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup taco sauce
instructions: Combine the garlic, pistachios, vinegar and icing sugar in a bowl. Mix well. Add the taco sauce as desired. Serve over hot greens. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Baby Carrots (Baby Carrots)
ingredients: 3 lbs baby carrots | 1 cup worcestershire sauce
instructions: Remove the thick outer layer of green outer layer from the carrots. You want the outer layer to be as flat as possible. Place the carrots in a bowl and cover with water. Let sit for an hour. Drain. Place carrots in a large pot and add worcestershire sauce. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Note, for those who need the carrots a bit dryer, add 1 1/2 cups hot water to the carrots to soften. If the carrots are still softer after 30 minutes, add another 1/2 cup hot water, and stir. The last time i made this recipe was, i made a few substitutions for the worcestershire sauce, and that was the right mix.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,vegetable oil cooking spray,chachere seasoning,artichoke heart,broccoli,heavy whipping cream
title: Cajun Style Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and patted dry | 1 head broccoli, cut into florets | 2 tablespoons all-purpose jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons chachere's original mccormick seasoning | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet and saute the artichoke hearts with broccoli until they begin to soften, then add rice. Cook and stir while rice cooks over high heat until rice is light brown, about 2 minutes. Add the chachere's seasoning, cream, and artichoke hearts.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,italian herb,coffee creamer blueberry,peanut oil,cheddar cheese
title: Creamy Cajun Mushrooms and Cheddar
ingredients: 1 bag regular cremini mushrooms | 7 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 1 packet coffee creamer ( with bitter blueberries, vanilla or oj ) | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 2 teaspoons mixed italian herbs ( such as basil, parsley )
instructions: Place mushrooms into a food processor and chop fine. Add both creamer's blueberries and pecorino romano cheese. Process on low speed until all cheese is incorporated. The sauce should be thick, but still with bits with chunks of pecorino rind. Set aside in fridge for at least 1 hour. Remove crème fraîche from refrigerator and add 1/2 tsp mixed italian herbs. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Taste for Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 teaspoons tamari ( or soy sauce, and maybe some more! ) | 4 -6 cups cooked short-grain rice
instructions: Note, i like to use tamari in place of soy sauce in lieu of soy sauce. Instead, use regular tamari in lieu of the 2 - 3 teaspoons of tamari.

title: Danish Apricot Sauce (Dansk)
ingredients: 1 jar apricot preserves ( about 17 ounces ) | whipped cream of tartar
instructions: If you are using a non sweet apricot jam, use it as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,arrowroot,coffee,rice wine vinegar,eggplant,adobo seasoning,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Eggplant (Aubergine)  and Monterey Jack Slice
ingredients: 2 eggplants | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 2 teaspoons arrowroot or 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup brewed coffee | 1/8 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 10 g golden syrup
instructions: Slice eggplants into 1 inch thick rounds with a mandolin or very sharp knife. Sprinkle eggplant with adobo and cook in nonstick skillet over low heat 5 minutes, turning once or twice, until lightly browned and tender. Add remaining ingredients, except golden syrup, and cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted. Remove from heat, stir in golden syrup and serve slices hot.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,black pepper,cubanelle pepper,dark chocolate,swiss cheese,red capsicum,lentil,linguine
title: Lentils & Swiss Cheese Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black pepper | 1 tablespoon red capsicum, diced | 1 cup lentils, rinsed | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, grated | 2 cubes smoked dark chocolate | 10 large red peppers, halved and seeded | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon powdered swiss cheese, to sprinkle
instructions: Place the black pepper, capsicum, lentils & cheese in a pan over a medium low heat & stir until everything is combined. Increase the heat & bring to the boil then simmer for 2 – 3 minutes or until the lentils are just soft. Stir through the chocolate & remove from heat when melted. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the lentils mixture into each bell pepper half. Sprinkle with some powdered swiss cheese & serve.

title: Crispy Oranges
ingredients: 24 sheets rice paper | 1/2 cup candied orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place a baking sheet inside the oven. Fill each rice paper sheet with about 2 teaspoons of orange peel per sheet. Lay the rice paper sheets on the lined baking sheet without touching. Bake in the preheated oven until dry, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Low Fat Italian Pepperon Barley Welsh Rarebit
ingredients: 1/3 cup pearl barley, uncooked | 2 egg yolks | 2 -3 tablespoons skim italian dressing | 1/4 cup coriander leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Cook barley until almost tender. Mix well with egg yolks and salad dressing. Add coriander and stir till combined.

title: Tastes With Avocado and Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo dough | 3 hass avocados, peeled cubed ( ripe ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, fresh grated | 1/4 cup cognac ( may sub brandy or rum ) ( optional )
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough at room temperature until phyllo can be unfolded by layering. Take pieces of phyllo pastry and brush some melted butter on top. Coat bottom of baking sheet with a small amount of melted butter, lightly coat top with more melted butter. Preheat oven 425 f degrees. Pour avocado slices along edge of phyllo sheets, being careful not to over saturate, in a spiral. Sprinkle with cheese and cognac if using. Bake until bottom layer is lightly browned about 5 minutes. Slide spatula carefully off top layer. Let cook until bottom layer is lightly browned, 2 - 3 minutes, then transfer to cutting board. Let rest 10 - 15 minutes. Cut into squares, with sharp knife or serrated knife. This is a delicious appetizer served warm. This is a little messy but it's very well worth it. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mirin,vegetable oil,newman italian salad dressing,apricot jam,hungarian paprika
title: Aunt Mary's Apricot Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1/2 cup hungarian paprika | 1 jar apricot jam
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender or food processer and blend well.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,dijon mustard,beef bouillon granule,asparagus spear
title: Herbed Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus spears, trimmed | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | salt & pepper
instructions: Place asparagus in bowl. Add remaining ingredients & mix well. Marinate in refrigerator for several hours or overnight, tossing every now and then to coat. Serve at once.

title: Asian-Style Parsley
ingredients: 4 leaves fresh italian parsley ( or another bunch of the same parsley such as arugula ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil
instructions: Wash and clean the parsley leaves and remove any stems and thick stems. Cut each leaf in half lengthwise. Put into an oiled pan with the sesame seed oil and allow to lightly brown. If parsley begins to color too dark, add a few tablespoons of water while cooking. Do not burn.

title: Pesto Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup margarine | 4 boneless chicken parts, cut in half | 1/3 cup kalamata olives, pitted and quartered
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, mix the cream cheese, margarine, and olive pieces until smooth. Spread some of the pesto on each chicken piece and secure with a toothpick. Arrange the chicken on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the chicken juices run clear, and the tops are lightly browned.
