Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,baby corn,flat leaf parsley,apple juice,asiago cheese,adobo sauce,coconut,black olive
title: Acapulco Baby Corn Salad (Salat Iz Pomidorias)
ingredients: 15 1/2 ounces canned baby corn, drained well | 10 3/4 ounces apple juice, chilled ( or apple cider ) | 1/3 cup sweet pickled sweet chili sauce, chilled ( peruvian aji or habanero hot sauce ) | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese | 1/2 cup unsweetened shredded coconut | 1/3 cup minced fresh flat-leaf parsley | 4 tablespoons asiago cheese, finely shredded ( for garnish ) | 1 tablespoon minced fresh sweet chili sauce ( peruvian aji or habanero hot sauce ) | 1 teaspoon adobo sauce ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped black olives | 2 tablespoons freshly snipped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced fresh flat-leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: Drain the canned baby corn in a colander under cold running water. Remove the corn kernels from the colander and place in a salad bowl. Cut or dice 2 of the sliced baby corn kernels. In a bowl whisk together the apple juice, sweet pickled sweet chili sauce, asiago cheese, coconut, and parsley. Stir the juice mixture into the salad with the asiago cheese and toss well. Cover, and chill until ready to use. Just before serving, stir in the olives. To serve, mound the baby corn salad onto serving plates and top with the shredded coconut, then sprinkle on the toasted chopped parsley and garnish with chopped green peppers, sliced asiago cheese, and adobo sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: clam,butter,tabasco sauce,taco seasoning,nutmeg,cauliflower floret,ginger garlic paste
title: Cauliflower Curry with Clams
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret, chopped | 1 tablespoon butter | 3 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/8 teaspoon grated nutmeg | fresh clams | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a steamer basket over boiling water, and cover, and steam until cauliflower is crisp tender. Remove from the steamer, and set aside. Heat butter in a curry grinder, and stir in ginger garlic paste until it turns a fragrant paste. Stir in tabasco and nutmeg. Add clam juice or a few tablespoons of water if necessary to get the mixture moving. Taste and adjust seasoning. Put the cauliflower in the serving dish. Garnish with clams, and serve with your favorite curry.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,sesame seed,onion salt,dark soy sauce,chili paste
title: Thai Sesame-Seed Sauce for Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup onion salt | 1/3 cup sesame seeds, lightly toasted | 1 teaspoon chili paste | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Whisk dark soy sauce, onion salt, sesame seeds, chili paste, salt, and pepper together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,granny smith apple,corn oil,red wine vinegar,sticky rice,sriracha asian garlic sauce chili oil,calamari
title: Sweet Glazed Granny Smith Apples
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sriracha asian garlic sauce ( or other fiery hot chili oil ) | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 3/4 lbs granny smith apples, peeled cored and sliced 1/8-inch thick | 2 tablespoons sriracha asian garlic sauce ( or other hot chili oil ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup water | 1 package sticksy rice
instructions: Combine rice wine vinegar, 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce and 2 tablespoons corn oil in a small bowl.

title: Spicy Artichoke and Crab
ingredients: 10 -12 small fresh artichokes, scrubbed | 1 large cucumber | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon hot chili-garlic sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | freshly crushed graham cracker
instructions: Cut the ends off of the cucumber. With a vegetable peeler, peel and cut cucumber lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Cut each slice in half lengthwise and crosswise to form two 1/2 inch slices. Cut the crab into 1 inch pieces and soak in cold water as you do so to remove the bitterness. Drain. Cut the cucumber into 1 inch slices and squeeze out excess liquid. Dry the crab pieces on paper towels or in a fine mesh strainer. Arrange the crab pieces on the bottom of a microwave safe bowl. Cover the crab with the cucumber slices, then with a layer of the mustard. Sprinkle on the chili garlic sauce and orange juice. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 5 minutes or until very hot and lightly bubbling. Garnish with crumbs.

title: Lebanese Beef Kebabs - Skewers
ingredients: 750 g stew meat | 1 -2 teaspoon chinese vinegar or 1 -2 teaspoon rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons mustard oil | 2 teaspoons ground white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod | 4 slices peeled english cucumbers
instructions: Slice the meat into long, thin strips about 3 x 2 cm. Toss all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Thread meat using pieces that are soaked in the mixture. Cover and leave for 15 minutes. Thread the meat onto skewers. Grill skewers over hot coals and oil turning once or twice during cooking. Nice served with a simple sauce.

title: Grilled Greek Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb beef burger, 1 inch thick | 2 tablespoons greek seasoning | 2 tablespoons black olives, sliced | 1 serrano pepper, minced
instructions: Combine ground beef, greek, salt, pepper, and olives in a bowl. Shape into 4 patties. Grill, 1 - 2 minutes per side for medium rare.

title: Prosciutto and Mussels in Rice, and Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh mussels | 4 ounces prosciutto, sliced thin | 2 cups crispy rice or 2 cups crisp rice
instructions: First, remove the mussels and let them open up. When they have opened, discard any they haven't opened yet. Rinse them under cold water to remove any sand that might have lodged in them. Toast the slices on both sides until they are lightly browned. This will take about 5 - 8 minutes depending on the size of your mussels. Then, pour ice into a large serving bowl and then add the prosciutto slices. Stir gently so that the garlic doesn't burn. Place the mussels on top of the prosciutto and pour the rice over the top. Sprinkle the top with salt. Serve immediately.

title: Guacamole With Rice Wine
ingredients: 14 ounces hominy | 1 lb garlic sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes | 6 -8 almonds, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1/2 cup extra firm silken tofu or 1/2 cup soy milk | 1 lb cooked rigatoni pasta ( angel hair, or other pasta ) | 1 bottle guacamole | ice, broken for garnish
instructions: Soak the sausages in water to cover for 1 hour. Drain and reserve the broth. Mash the sausages and reserve it. Add the tomato juice, almonds and rice wine to strained juice in a medium sized saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer until the liquid has reduced to about 1/4 cup. Place about 1/3 of the heated cooking liquid in a blender or food processor and add the blended ingredients. Process until the mixture is smooth and creamy. In a separate medium sized pot of boiling water, boil or cook the rigatoni until al dente. Drain pasta well and return to pot. Add the tofu or soy milk and stir well. Add the reserved cooking liquid to the soup and stir well. Taste and adjust seasonings. Garnish with extra chopped nuts, and serve with chips.

title: Saliqli Kafta (Shanks)
ingredients: 4 - 6 lbs chicken breasts, with bones | 4 tablespoons cardamom ( or one small piece of dried cardamom )
instructions: If using chicken breasts, break them into pieces with hands. Place on a platter in a single layer and sprinkle them lightly with salt or pepper. Sprinkle liberally with additional salt or pepper, and sprinkle lightly with cardamom. Cover and let marinate in a draughy cupboard for at least 2 days and up to 6 hours. Drain off the marinade. Discard any unused marinade. Sprinkle a piece of aluminum foil with salt and pepper on top, if desired. Using a heavy skillet, heat the marinade up over medium high heat until you can smell it. Turn the heat to low and add the pieces of chicken.

title: Egyptian Beef and Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 lb beef steak, raw and frozen, thawed
instructions: Place cumin seeds in a dry skillet or frypan and toast over low heat for about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Pound the sizzling black pepper into the beef with 2 tablespoons or more of water. When the beef is almost cooked, add the oil and salt and pepper to taste and boil rapidly for 2 minutes or so, then pour the water into the pan, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,baby spinach,zucchini,roquefort cheese,malt vinegar,irish cream,cherry tomato,potato chip
title: A Kiwi Warrior Kartoffel
ingredients: 1 kg potato chips | 2 small zucchini, washed, chopped and squeezed dry | 1 -2 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 3 teaspoons malt vinegar or 3 teaspoons cider vinegar | 200 g sliced mushrooms | 240 ml cherry tomatoes | 2 tablespoons chopped basil leaves | 400 g roquefort cheese
instructions: Place potato chips in a large bowl, pour over worcestershire sauce and toss well to coat. Drain off any excess liquid and arrange the potato chips on a plate. Place mushrooms, zucchini, tomatoes, basil and roquefort cheese in a large bowl, then top each with half a cup of salad dressing. Toss to combine and serve.

title: Dijon Mustard, Celery ribs & Dijon for Dogs
ingredients: 4 celery ribs, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Preheat grill to medium low. Arrange celery leaves in a shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle dijon on top. Place in preheated grill & grill until celery is tender and mustard is crisply browned, about 8 minutes.

title: Zucchini(Mexican)
ingredients: 2 zucchini | 2 green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Wash and peel the zucchini. Cut them lengthwise into long, thin strips. Cut them in rounds, using an apple corer if available. Place a layer of zucchini in a nonstick skillet and scatter one or two teaspoons of sage over it. Sprinkle with about 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Repeat until all of the zucchini is in the skillet. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes, or until zucchini is tender. Remove the zucchini from the skillet. Repeat with the remaining zucchini and sage. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Zipper Star Bread for Gift giving
ingredients: 4 slices bread ( any type ) | 1 -2 teaspoon lemon extract | lime juice, a few drops
instructions: Spread bread with lime and lemon extracts. Then add 2 tsp. Of lime juice.

title: Colombian Recipes
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup coconut flavored sour cream ( if needed, can use coconut milk ) | 1/2 cup self rising flour ( more can be used, depending on the amount amount of flour ) | seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients well together. Form into walnut sized balls or any size you prefer. Bake on cookie sheet or in fry pan at medium heat turning frequently until puffy and light brown.

title: Pollo Con Pollo
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs roasting chickens, trimmed | 8 -10 cups good long-grain rice ( such as arborio, carnaroli, or vialone nano ) | 12 -16 wood skewers
instructions: Preheat your broiler. If the oven starts to get too hot, leave it in all directions near the fire until the fire is ready. If it does not immediately go on immediately, you can tent it with foil. If you do not have a broiler, line a broiler pan with aluminum foil. Wash the chicken, trim off most of the fat and discard. Put the chicken in the pan and sprinkle with about 1 teaspoon or more of each salt and pepper. Add the rice and turn the chicken so that it is coated with the salt and pepper. Add enough water just to cover the chicken, about 3 inches over the top. The water should just come up to the top of the chicken. Cover tightly and place in oven. The pan should be about 3 feet full when you put it in the oven. If the water is not coming to just above the top of the poultry, turn the rack down to 1/2. Check after 2 hours, to make sure it is not burning underneath, and make sure the chicken isn't over done at this time. If it is, turn the oven off. When the oven is hot and the door is just beginning to smell dry, put the chicken in the oven. Turn the chickens over and leave for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the meat falls off the bone. Let the chicken cool, unwrap and refrigerate for 4 - 6 hours. When it is completely cool, pull the meat off the bone and shred it. If you are using the rice for stuffing, take a fork and mash it into a paste. You can leave the chunks whole if you like, depending on how much salt you like your food.

title: Spicy Sopa Baked With Baked Noodles

title: Grilled Garlic Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds whole head garlic, peeled | 1/3 cup whole milk | 1/4 cup grated lemon peel | 3 tablespoons seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Place whole head of garlic in a large bowl. Mix the milk, lemon peel, and seasoned salt into the milk mixture until it is well mixed. title: Rice with Orange Zest, Marsala and Coriander
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups arborio rice or 2 3/4 cups valencia ri rice, rinsed well and drained | 3/4 cup orange zest | 1/4 cup fresh coriander or 1/4 cup fresh parsley | 1/4 cup dry marsala ( or any flavor that has alcohol in it ) | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Prepare the rice using the rinsing already out of the arborio or valencia rinsing it. If you have a rice cooker, do not use the rice cooker liner. ingredients: 2 cans fat-free extra-virgin tuna in water, drained | 12 fresh gouda cheese or 12 gruyere cheese sticks | 2 cans fat-free cottage cheese | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 4 large poblano chiles ( or red anaheim chiles ) | 8 large white mushrooms, preferably baby chanterelles, cleaned and stemmed ( or crimini ) | confectioners'sugar, optional ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain all cans of tuna with cold water.

title: Gourmet Party Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple pie filling | 1 tablespoon prepared oyster mushroom ( sliced ) | 1 teaspoon minced garlic, | 1 tablespoon dried apricot jam | 1/2 lb peeled prawns | 1 kaiser roll
instructions: Spread filling evenly over the roll. Place in freezer until ready. Saute garlic and prawns till pink. Mix in jam and serve over the shrimp.

Random Ingredients: mini chocolate chip,russet potato,picante sauce,chunky salsa,paprika
title: Paprika Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes | 1 cup picante sauce | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip | paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Peel potatoes and dice into 1/4 inch cubes. Place in bowl and mash with a potato masher. Add picante, salsa and chocolate chips, mix well. Spread mixture into a pastry lined baking tray and sprinkle with paprika. Bake in 425°f oven for 20 minutes.

title: Tandoori Capsicum Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat yogurt, beaten | 1 tablespoon chopped ginger | 2 tablespoons tamari or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 fresh capsicum, deseeded and chopped ( chile ) | 8 -10 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Beat yogurt to a smooth paste with a pinch of salt until it is smooth and lighter in colour. Fold in sambar, ginger and chopped capsicum and sage leaves. Serve cold.

title: Scottish Sausages and Cream
ingredients: 2 lbs sausages | 1 pint whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly butter 12 x 8 inch slice pan or deep casserole to prevent sticking. Arrange sausages in pan and bake 15 to 20 minutes with pan partially covering. Increase heat to 400f and bake 15 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove from oven and pour cream over hot sausages. Serve at once.

title: Taco Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 1 medium white onion | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 can mild chili powder | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables
instructions: Cook onion and chili powder till clear. Drain onions. Add tomato sauce and frozen mixed vegetables. Cook in microwave for 5 minutes or bake covered at 350f till vegetables are soft and vegetables are slightly cooked.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,coconut,spring onion,frying chicken,adobo seasoning,gruyere cheese
title: Cheese Fried Chicken
ingredients: 6 frying chickens, halved | 5 tablespoons adobo seasoning, divided | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 1 bunch spring onions, chopped | 1 can shredded coconut | 4 ounces shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange chicken legs and breast halves in a baking dish. Place 2 tablespoons of the adobo seasoning over the chicken and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. While the chicken is marinating, heat a medium skillet over medium heat. Cook the sausage in the skillet until crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink in the center. Remove the sausage from the skillet and drain on paper towels. Set aside. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Bake the chicken for 40 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove chicken from the oven, and keep warm in the oven. Heat another skillet over medium heat, and add the remaining 2 tablespoons of adobo marinade. Cook, stirring frequently, until sausages are warm and coated with adobo seasoning. To serve, arrange chicken pieces on a plate. Spread a thin layer of shredded coconut on the plate. Place a few sprinkles of gruyere cheese on top of the shredded coconut. Place the chicken pieces on top, then top with the sauteed sausage and sliced spring onions.

title: Coconut and Kidney Beans(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans coconut milk | 1 tablespoon cornmeal
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the coconut milk with the beans and cornmeal.

Random Ingredients: tuna water,olive,clear honey,sazon goya coriander annatto,onion soup mix,pepper onion,sauce,vegetable oil
title: Tuna Blackened With Honey Nuts and Spices
ingredients: 1 packet sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 1 packet onion soup mix | 500 ml tuna in water | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 packet mixed fresh vegetables ( ie, cauliflower, peas, green beans ) | pepper and onion salt | clear honey
instructions: To prepare the tuna spread out on a plate and spread with the seasoning. Place the mixed vegetables and tuna in a wide bowl. Spread with the sazon. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and add the onion soup mix. Stir well and cook until the onion is transparent over a moderate heat. Pour over the tuna, vegetables and honey. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Beef with Peanut and Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 package dried beef | 1/2 cup margarine, room temperature | 1 tablespoon flour | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Place the dried beef in a bowl, cover with water, and set for 2 hours. Drain, and remove the excess water. Remove and discard any tough pieces of the beef. Reserve 1/2 cup soaking liquid and shred the remaining beef with your hands. Melt the margarine in a saucepan over medium heat. Gradually stir in the flour until the mixture darkens in color, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in the reserved water, and heat, stirring often, until thickened and bubbly, about 20 minutes. Taste and adjust seasonings, and adjust if necessary. Serve warm over rice.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,barbecue seasoning,dressing,taco seasoning mix,soba noodle,chicken thigh,walnut half
title: Mexican Skillet Chicken
ingredients: dressing : | 1/2 cup light soy or regular light soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon barbecue seasoning ( mccormick montreal steak seasoning ) | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 24 large walnut halves
instructions: Combine soy sauce, lemon peel, dry barbecue seasoning, and taco seasoning mix in medium bowl. Add chicken.

title: Maple-Glazed Roasted Temaki Eggs
ingredients: 1 pound mixed salad oil | 1 egg | 4 teaspoons maple syrup | 8 stalks hijiki seaweed, chopped | 8 drops yellow food coloring | ground cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Grease an 8x8 glass baking dish. Break the eggs into a bowl of cold water, and place into a saucepan with cold water. Cover, and bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately remove from heat. Cover, and let eggs stand in hot water for 15 minutes. Remove from the hot water, cool to room temperature, and peel. Place the eggs into a pan of a roasting dish, and coat with the salad oil. Pour in the egg water, and mix with a metal spoon so that the egg covers the sides of the pan by an inch. Drizzle with maple syrup, and sprinkle with a few drops of yellow food coloring for a riot of color. Drizzle with some of the water, as desired. Sprinkle more of the food coloring, if desired. Drizzle with more maple syrup if desired, and sprinkle with cayenne to serve.

title: Naughty Curried Sponge Cake
ingredients: 15 ounces sponge cake | 15 ounces butterscotch chips | 2 tablespoons curry powder
instructions: Slice the sponge cake into two equal pieces, or leave one as is, cut side on. Spread one half of the chips over the cake, then scatter over the curry powder. Cut the other half of the cake into squares, then cut each square into three squares. Put onto a greased tray and keep in an airtight tin.

Random Ingredients: mexican cornbread mix,vanilla extract,green chili pepper
title: Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1.5 boxes mexican cornbread mix | 1/2 cup pure vanilla extract | 1 green chili pepper, diced or 1 -3 teaspoon hot green chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.

title: Chilli Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon shortening | 3 large fresh red chilies, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 can beef consomme
instructions: Heat shortening in a large skillet over moderate heat. Brown beef on all sides. Place in a covered baking dish in a single layer. Put chilies and 1 can of beef consommé over beef.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,celery,goat cheese,chili pepper,italian plum tomato,pepper,garlic salt
title: Tomato & Goat Cheese Pizzas
ingredients: 4 italian plum tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt ( or to taste ) | pepper ( to taste ) | 4 ounces goat cheese | 1/2 small chili pepper ( minced, not chunky ) | 2 -3 leaves celery ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato puree
instructions: Slice italian tomatoes, lengthwise, and core.. Add to blender along with garlic salt. Blend until smooth. Cut goat cheese into chunks, removing any excess crumbs, and mix with chile. Roll each tomato in tomato puree. Place into a small nonstick cooking pan, then cover with foil. Place on stove over low heat. Keep covered until the cheese begins to melt, then remove from the heat. Place the pizzas in the pan. Allow to completely cool before placing into preheated oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. When pizzas are toasted, place on a plate and keep warm in the oven for 10 minutes. Serve the pizza hot.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,cottage cheese,active yeast,large shrimp,lime,golden raisin,onion flake
title: Spicy Shrimp (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 3 )
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dry active yeast ( can sub 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh yeast, 3 1/4 cups ) | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt ( can sub up to 3/4 tsp. each ) | 5 cups unbleached fat-free cottage cheese | 1 1/2 lbs medium tail-on large shrimp, peeled and deveined ( about 5 medium ) | 2 tablespoons instant onion flakes | 1/2 cup golden raisin, divided | 1 lime, cut into 4 wedges
instructions: Combine 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a large bowl. Stir in 1/2 cup of the cottage cheese and 1 cup of the shrimp and set aside. Stir remaining cottage cheese, remaining 1/2 cup flour and 1/2 cup of the shrimp in a large bowl. Stir in the onion flakes and 1/3 cup of the golden raisins and set aside. Drain shrimp and reserve the liquid for dressing. Spoon drained shrimp into a large bowl and add remaining 1/3 cup of the raisins and 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro. Stir. Add in remaining shrimp, 1/3 cup cottage cheese mixture and 1/2 cup of remaining golden raisins and 1 teaspoon kosher salt. Stir to mix. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for about 10 minutes, or until mixture is bubbling. Using spoon, spread 1/8 cup of prepared honey mustard on dough. Turn dough over in bowl and transfer to a parchment sheet, sprayed with cooking spray. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit overnight at room temperature to rise. For dough that’s room temperature, place a 9 inch metal cake pan on a cookie sheet. Turn dough onto parchment and spray with cooking spray. Transfer dough to pan. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature until doubled, about 2 hours. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until top is golden brown. Remove from oven and cut into wedges. Serve with sour cream, honey mustard or salsa of your choice. Also excellent with jasmine rice and chopped fresh cilantro.

title: Crispy Hazelnut Rice
ingredients: 2 cups hazelnuts, whole, shelled | 1 1/4 cups minute rice | 1 3/4 cups steamed rice
instructions: Spread 1/4 cup of steamed rice on a flat surface. Spread hazelnuts in a single layer and top with 1/4 cup of steamed rice. Spread remaining 1 3/4 cups of steamed rice on hazelnuts. Spread remaining 1 3/4 cups of steamed rice on top. Let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate overnight for flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,cream cheese,oat,mineral water,black turtle bean,baking chocolate,chocolate chip
title: Black Bean and Chocolate Scones
ingredients: 4 ounces semisweet baking chocolate | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped oat | 1/2 cup mineral water | 6 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 1 can black turtle beans, drained | 1 roma tomato, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon rolled oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place a baking sheet into the preheated oven and toast the baking sheet. In a medium bowl, whisk together the oat and mineral water until smooth. Stir in the cream cheese, black beans, and tomato. Spread the scone mixture onto the baking sheet in a thin layer. Sprinkle the rolled oats onto the scone mixture. Place 1 tablespoon of semisweet chocolate onto each half of the scone. Bake in the preheated oven until the scone topping is bubbling, 10 to 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tofu,broth,semolina,crimini mushroom,egg beater substitute,italian salad dressing mix,lard
title: Savory Pasta
ingredients: 3 cups egg beaters egg substitute | 3 cups semolina or 3 cups cornmeal | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons bacon fat, melted | 1 box italian salad dressing mix ( such as good seasons ) | 2 ounces firm tofu, drained ( reserve juices ) | 1 cup broth | 1 package crimini mushrooms
instructions: Cut mushrooms into bite size pieces, then saute in butter or margarine until lightly browned. In bowl, mix eggs, and then add semolina, cheese, salad dressing mix, and broth. Beat with rotary beater or whisk, then set aside. In 8x8 pyrex dish or casserole dish, spread mixture on top and sides. Pour sliced tofu on top. Bake at 400 degrees until top is browned, about 20 minutes. For vegetarian, omit tofu fat and use vegetable broth.

title: Garlicky Chickpeas (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, undrained | 1 jar yellow squash, drained | 2 cups tomato juice
instructions: Combine garbanzo beans and squash in a 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker. Combine tomato juice and remaining ingredients in a blender.

title: Basic Beef or Turkey Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried minced onion seeds ( from 1 envelope ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the oregano, garlic powder and beef bouillon. Pour into a saucepan. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, stirring often. Serve over cooked hot rice.

Random Ingredients: avocado,white sugar,red chili powder,double cream,triple sec,mustard,lemon pepper
title: Devil's Blood Guilt Guacamole
ingredients: 2 avocados, peeled and seeded | 10 fluid ounces double cream | 2 fluid ounces double cream | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Mash avocados with 3/4 cup double cream, chilli powder, sugar, dry mustard and lemon pepper in a bowl. Serve immediately with pumpernickel crackers.

Random Ingredients: baby back rib,garlic powder,dark brown sugar,tarragon vinegar,chicken broth,parsnip
title: Southern Style Baby Back Ribs
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chicken broth, divided | 2 parsnips, peeled | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the parsnips for 3 to 4 minutes, or until tender. Drain. Meanwhile, combine 2 cups of broth with the remaining 1/2 cup of broth in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced to about 3/4 cup. Add the brown sugar, mustard, garlic powder, and tarragon vinegar. Boil for 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Place the ribs in a slow cooker and pour in the broth mixture. Cook on low for 5 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,ginger juice,irish cream,jalapeno,bacon dripping,extra virgin olive oil,rosemary
title: Golden Jubilee Sausages
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1/2 jalapeno, minced | 1 teaspoon ginger juice | 1/2 teaspoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, minced | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary, minced
instructions: In a heated skillet, add bacon drippings and fry until brown. Do not over cook. Add garlic jalapeno, ginger juice, golden syrup, rosemary and olive oil. Stir until combined and heat through. This will make approximately 20 sausages. Remove from heat. Serve with your favourite condiments of bread, or crackers.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,bulk italian sausage,mirin,ice water,white vinegar
title: Quick Sausages and Barley
ingredients: 8 ounces bulk italian sausage | 1 1/4 cups pearl barley | 3 1/4 cups ice water | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, break up italian sausage into small pieces. Cook for 10 minutes or until browned. Drain off any fat. Stir in barley, and toss until blended. Bring to boil, and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in vinegar and mirin. Cover, and allow to stand for 20 minutes until it is slightly syrupy. Serve with fried rice if desired.

title: King Prawns
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw king prawns, shelled | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1/2 medium onion, chopped
instructions: Throw all the ingredients in the crock pot. Stir. Cook on high for 2 hours watching the level of the liquid. Stir before serving if you don't want it to burn. Variation, you can substitute 1 can Rotel tomatoes with 1/2 of a can of diced tomatoes, drained. Or you can take the whole can of rotel tomatoes and add to mixture. Enjoy.

title: Linguine With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 16 ounces linguine ( spaghetti or linguine ) | 8 ounces refried beans | 1/4 cup maple syrup | sour cream, to serve
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. While cooking, combine refried beans, refried beans and maple syrup in a saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally. When all ingredients are heated, serve immediately, with sour cream.

title: Gourmet  Beef Strips
ingredients: 4 -6 slices of lean chuck | 4 tablespoons tomato juice ( from container of chopped tomatoes )
instructions: Take 1/3 of tomato juice that's been strained from the can and add it to the saucepan with the beef strips. Add the rest of the juice to the pan and heat to boiling. Add additional tomato juice if needed. Serve in a bowl over cooked rice, or in a bowl in sandwiches.

title: Lebanese Radish Lentil Soup
ingredients: 2 large bunches radishes, washed, white part only, peeled and sliced thinly | 6 ounces fresh lentils | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder
instructions: Wash the radishes and cut them into slices. Bring 4 1/2 cups water to a boil. Add the radishes and simmer for about 3 minutes, or until the radishes are soft. Drain the lentils, then put them in a large bowl. Add the chicken bullion, mix well, then add the radish slices. You can serve with bread. You can also serve this cold.

title: Herbes De Provence Beans
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans or 1 lb kidney bean | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 2 -3 lbs ground veal
instructions: Cook beans thoroughly. If using dried beans, add 2 3/4 cups water at the end and cook at medium heat. Turn down to low heat and cook, covered, for 2 - 3 hours, or until thickened and tender. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped green onions and crumbled hard boiled eggs or fried potatoes. Delicious at room temperature just cover tightly and keep warm in a crockpot. Variation, stir 2 chopped onions with 2 tsp olive oil. The flavor can be enriched by putting mushrooms in a dry pan, covering, and adding a few 1/4 tsp dried thyme or rosemary to the sauce. Another variation is to add 1 - 4 tsp dried oregano to 1/4 tsp dried basil, a tsp dried minced garlic or 2 teaspoons oregano, and 1/4 tsp dried rosemary to the sauce.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,poppy seed,lasagna noodle,chunky peanut butter,ghee
title: Nanebika
ingredients: 12 large lasagna noodles | 250 g chunky peanut butter | 250 g ghee | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | 100 g poppy seeds, crushed
instructions: Boil the noodles in plenty of water for 10 minutes until al dente. Drain well under running water and set aside. Place the peanut butter in a food processor and process until completely smooth. Heat the ghee in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the peanut butter mixture and mix well. Cook for a minute. Reduce the heat to low and add the dry noodles mixing well. When the noodles have turned a light brown colour, the oil will start to separate from the noodle mixture. When almost brown, stir in the crushed poppy seeds. Remove from the heat. Spoon the noodles into a large shallow ovenproof dish. Cover generously with waxed paper. Place in the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, shaking the dish after 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and immediately pour hot peanut mixture all over. Return to the oven for a further 15 minutes or until the noodles are heated through and the noodle mixture has thickened.

title: Easy-Noodle (Beef or Pork)
ingredients: 1 package of dry udon noodles | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato ( packed in oil. )
instructions: Heat non stick saucepan, cover bottom with boiling water, cook noodles according to package directions, drain, add tomatoes, then cover and simmer on low heat for 3 minutes, or until hot, stir well and serve immediately.

title: Tomato and Chili Slather
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon horseradish or 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 beef brisket, large, very fresh | 400 g mixed chopped tomatoes and green capsicum | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 green capsicum
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 2 tbsp warm water. Sprinkle generously over brisket and leave to rise in a warm place for 30 minutes. When cool enough to handle, scrape off the rough surface and shred into chunks with your hands. Mix in the rest of the ingredients except capsicum and chilli. Leave in a warm place for 2 - 3 hours to rise slightly. Stir the capsicum around the sides of the shredded brisket and place in a roasting tin. Cover and bake at slow 150c for 1 hour 20 minutes. Transfer the brisket onto a carving board, cut off the top of the fat and leave to stand.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,kosher salt black pepper,bacon,kahlua,lite olive oil,carrot,lime zest,pistachio
title: Ancho Chile Bacon-And-Pistachio Viva Madrid
ingredients: 2 cups raw smoked bacon, chopped | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 lb valencian carrots or 1 lb arugula, coarsely grated | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 ounce unsalted pistachios, lightly toasted
instructions: Place the bacon in a large deep, heavy pan and cook over moderate heat, turning frequently, until it is cooked all around, about 10 minutes. Drain the bacon, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings. Add the oil to the drippings in the pan, scraping up any browned bits and bacon bits and adding the lime peel. Sprinkle the ground chile powder over the bacon and reduce the heat to low. Scrape the bacon and chile powder into the pan. Add the carrots and cook, stirring every now and then, until very tender and tender about 20 minutes. Stir in about 2 teaspoons salt and ¼ cup water if the mixture seems dry. Stir in the pistachios. Serve right away at room temperature or refrigerate for up to 2 days. Serve hot.

title: Ginger Marmalade
ingredients: 2 cups mango powder | 2 tablespoons lime juice, preferably fresh squeezed ( from about 3 small limes ) | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red chile, crushed
instructions: Pour mango into a shallow bowl, and stir in lime juice. Add thyme and chili. Let stand at room temperature for 10 - 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,dark brown sugar,hot pepper,vodka,beef brisket,apple cider vinegar,milk
title: Lola Alma's Sweet Chili Brisket
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket ( not frozen ) | 1 quart hot pepper ( i have used jalapeno, habanero, bell pepper, habanero, etc. ) | 1 large vidalia onions or 1 large sweet onion, diced or 1 large sweet onion, diced | 1 can evaporated milk ( not evaporated skim milk ) | 1/2 cup tomato-based chili sauce ( not heinz ) | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to place everything in to a medium size roasting pan or dutch oven, cover tightly with foil and bake for approximately 3hours or until onions are semi tender. Remove and discard the hot peppers, cut meat in cubes and return to the pan, and drizzle the chili sauce over and simmer for 15minutes.

title: Cranberry Salsa
ingredients: 3 -4 cups fresh cranberries | 1 large red onion, finely chopped | 6 tablespoons sour cream or 6 tablespoons yogurt | 1 pinch white pepper | 1 pinch marjoram
instructions: In a food processor or blender, puree the chopped cranberries, onion and sour cream. Add the rest of the ingredients and process until smooth. It will be thick but pourable. Let sit in refrigerator for about an hour then serve over your chosen dish. Serve immediately.

title: Champinones De Palmitos  (Piquillo Pepper Shooters)
ingredients: 2 large piquillo peppers ( stemmed and seeded ) | 1/2 cup finely slivered bamboo shoot, drained | 2 tablespoons red chilies, finely chopped | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: Slice piquillo pepper lengthwise, remove seeds and stems from peppers, set aside to drain on paper towels. Remove and discard stems from sambal peppers, cut each pepper in half lengthwise and clean off course outer skin with a sharp knife, remove seeds. Add 1/2 cup sliced pepper to processor add chilies, blender can or beer with 1/2 cup water, process until it is mixed well. Cover and chill 2 hours. Fill empty pepper canning jar with piquillo mixture. Add enough vodka to make a 1/2 inch thick, place pepper halves in jar, add enough vodka to make a 1/2 inch edge in jar, seal tight and process 2 minutes, remove from oil. Pipe 3 or 4 small ball size balls from vodka to make a dozen balls, place on top of a small square of wax paper covered with towel and a little salt. Let chill until set, 2 or 3 days.

title: Praline-Cured Pork Loin
ingredients: 5 cups pecans, coarsely chopped | 8 pounds pork loin roast
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack at about 6 inches from the heat source. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Place pecans in a bowl and press them into the preheated oven. When the pecans turn dark red, about 20 minutes, remove from the oven. Slide the pork roast, still partially frozen, onto a baking sheet and broil in the preheated oven until a meat thermometer inserted in the center of the loaf registers at least 145 degrees f, about 10 minutes per pound. Watch carefully, because the loin should easily slide out of the oven. Bread the loin every 2 to 3 hours for medium rare, or about 8 pounds for medium, and about 12 pounds for well done. When the loin will be cool enough to handle, cut or pull off some of the thick, dark stuff and discard any remaining pieces of meat.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,clove,pineapple juice,golden raisin,pesto sauce,golden syrup,penne pasta,sea salt pepper
title: Pesto Penne with Pineapple-Mint Chunk
ingredients: 2 cups packed golden syrup | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 cup packed pineapple concentrate | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon minced lime zest | 1 box penne pasta, cooked and drained | sea salt and pepper | 3 whole cloves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until mixture begins to bubble, 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Roasted Pepper With Saffron Cream
ingredients: 2 fresh yellow bell peppers ( or any combination ) or 2 any combination ( or any combination ) | 5 -8 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 f. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil, and line it with a piece of aluminum foil. Place the bell peppers on the baking sheet, and put the entire sheet into the oven. After 15 to 20 minutes, carefully stir the bell peppers so that they are all coated with the saffron cream. After 10 to 15 minutes, turn the peppers over, close the foil, and broil them for 5 minutes until tender and slightly blackened. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Tenderloin with Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons cognac, or to taste | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh basil | 1/4 jar pico de gallo ( or to taste )
instructions: Place the tenderloin in a resealable plastic bag, and shake to coat with honey. Let stand at room temperature while preparing the meat. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Whisk together the cognac, basil, and pico de gallo in a bowl. Coat tenderloin with pico de gallo, then place in the bread pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, then broil until the meat is browned, about 10 minutes to seal in the juices.

title: Pimento Strips
ingredients: 4 ounces pimento peppers, finely chopped, without membrane | 1 cup cognac
instructions: Mix the pimentos and cognac together in a bowl.

title: Curtido - Cheese With Celery and Yogurt
ingredients: 200 g greek yogurt ( balkan style ) | 1 bunch celery, chopped | 125 g muenster cheese ( or other aged farmer cheese, if you can't find it )
instructions: Firstly take the cheese and place in a bowl. Add the celery stalks. Add a handful of salt, mix that and then put aside. Put another handful of salt and some more salt to the water in a separate bowl. Mix that once the yogurt is nice and sticky, mix it with the yogurt. Add some other handful of salt and more salt, mix that and put aside. The finished cheese will be like a cottage cheese that you haven't had any left. You can make the cheese balls out of the mixture. It's really up to you how much salt you like, but feel free to add whatever you like. When you're working with smaller sized pieces of cheese, go for those which are smaller, then larger pieces of cheese that you can mold it into a cylinder. Cut the cylinder in half. Scoop out the middle, get the pieces out of the center as well, and make a nice cylinder. The center stays on the cylinder. You want the outside to stick to the bottom, to hold it down. Place something on the bottom to hold it together. Take a plate, and dip the cylinder into the bowl of salt, and press it back into the center. Repeat this until you have a nice little log. I like to dip an egg, right and left, right and left, right and right, and left, right and left. Place in a ziploc freezer bag, and repeat this with the eggs. To eat, take a handful of cheese, and dunk it into the yogurt, then dunk in the oil, then eat it with a spoon, or use as you're eating it….

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,sun tomato oil,thyme leaf,beet,almond,mustard powder,chicken stock
title: Beetroot Mustard Soup
ingredients: 4 small beet, washed and chopped | 1 1/2 liters chicken stock ( or vegetable stock ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 3 teaspoons sesame seeds ( optional ) | 3 ounces blanched almonds
instructions: Put the beetroot in a pan with the stock. Bring to boil, cover and simmer for 30 minutes without raising the heat. Add the sesame seeds, mustard powder, dried thyme, sesame seeds, blanched slivered almonds. Cook for a further 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Stuffed Turnips with Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 teaspoons anise seed | 1 loaf french bread, cut into thick slices | 2 small turnips, cut into wedges | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh sage
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine salsa, honey and anise seeds. Let stand 20 minutes. Place bread on a rimmed baking sheet. Using a slotted spoon, fill each bread slice with salsa mixture. Top with turnips.

title: Spanish Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( or whole wheat if not available ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 8 ounces rotelle pasta | 3 ounces poblano chiles | 1 avocado | 1 tablespoon marmalade
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water and rinse to prevent sticking. Rinse to cool. Cut into small pieces. Peel chiles, cut lengthwise in half, and remove seeds. Slice avocado in half and remove pit and black skin, but not throughly. Cut chiles into small pieces. Set aside. Cook rigatoni pasta according to package directions until just al dente not too soft. Drain. Toss all ingredients together, except for avocado. Add avacado and marmalade to taste or use as topping.

title: Grilled Yellow Squash
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 5 yellow squash, washed, ends trimmed, and cut into 1-inch long sticks
instructions: Preheat grill or broiler. In a ceramic baking dish or roasting pan, mix soy sauce and squash sticks. Arrange pieces on grate.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,cocoa powder,greek yogurt,salmon,italian sausage,winter squash,kernel corn
title: Italian Pumpkin Dip With Sausage
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 sweet italian sausage, removed from casing and crumbled into small bits | 1 winter squash, sliced | 8 ounces smoked salmon, cut into chunks ( can sub a mix of fish and sea bass ) | 4 ounces whole kernel corn ( canned or frozen ) | 1/4 cup fat-free greek yogurt | 1/4 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sausage, and reduce heat to low. Cover, and cook until browned, about 10 minutes. Add the squash, and cook for 3 more minutes. Toss the salmon and corn with the sausage mixture. Cover, and cook 15 minutes more. Stir in just enough yogurt to dilute. Spoon into a serving bowl. Drizzle with the cocoa powder. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Sicilian-Style Chickpea Flour Pizza
ingredients: 500 g green beans ( trimmed ) | 50 g chickpea flour | 1 -2 hot chili pepper ( mild, seeded and finely diced ) | 1/4 cup escarole
instructions: Boil the beans in salted water for 5 minutes, drain when cooked & cool a little. Tip out the boiled beans & spread them on a baking sheet. Combine the chickpea flour, chili and 1/2 the beans in a bowl & add to the chickpea flour mixture and mix well until the dough forms. Remove from the oven & knead for 2 - 3 mins to form the dough. Roll into a 10 round, place on the baking sheet & prick the outer edge with a fork. Pile on your favourite pizza sauce / relish / marinade & cook in the oven, until crispy.

title: Mexican Beans and Rice
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans | 1 jar chopped frozen peas and carrots | 1 container cooked corned beef or ( 5 ounce ) package vegetarian ground beef | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place pinto beans and peas in a large saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,lemon wedge,beef tenderloin steak
title: Beef Tenderloin, With Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 lbs beef tenderloin steaks, cut 3/4-inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Whip cream with electric mixer. Rub steak with heavy cream mixture and place on large jelly roll pan. Bake in oven for 15 minutes, turn, and bake 15 minutes more, or until internal thermometer reads 130°f for rare, 140°f for medium rare, 155°f for medium well.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,rice noodle,graham cracker crumb,portabella mushroom
title: Savory Sun Dried Tomato Rice Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 6 ounces rice noodles | 6 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, undrained ( can use another type if desired, i do not drain and use the oil-packed ) | 2 portabella mushrooms, sliced thin ( or use 6 ounces fresh mushrooms ) | 1 cup crumbled graham cracker crumbs ( about 24 )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook rice noodles according to package directions, drain. Arrange cooked noodles in a lightly greased 2 quart casserole dish. Stir the sun dried tomatoes into the noodles. Layer mushrooms over noodles and sprinkle with the crumb crumbs. Bake, uncovered, at 350f about 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Seared Pork Ribs in Red Onion Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs | 1 medium red onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat a griddle or frying pan over medium high heat. Rub the outside of the rack with a little bit of olive oil, and arrange the pork ribs to make a bed of red onions on the griddle and side by side. Griddle them, turning often, on the onions until they're medium golden brown. Be careful as the pan dripping can easily burn you. Continue cooking the pork until it is very well seared. Remove from the pan and set aside. Heat the skillet and sear the rack briefly on both sides, but no more than a second on each side. Remove to oven racks, and cut across the ribs into serving pieces. Serve with some more red onion sauce to taste for dipping.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,cardamom seed,pepperidge farm stuffing,walnut,alfredo sauce,taco seasoning mix,anchovy paste,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Muir Glen Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 box pillsbury fat free alfredo sauce ( i usually add 1/3 each ) | 3/4 cup alfredo sauce ( i usually use paul newman's own alfredo sauce ) | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup walnuts ( or pecans ) | 1 anchovy paste | colored sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven melt 3 tablespoons oil in a small pan. Add cardamom seeds. When they crackle a tiny pop, and then it smells nutty. Reduce to a low heat, and add a teaspoon of the alfredo sauce. Stir occasionally until it starts to thicken. Meanwhile warm all the taco seasoning in a small bowl. Set aside. When heated through, remove from heat. Mix the rest of the sauce with the hot alfredo sauce. When well mixed, pour into a bowl, and roll the walnuts or pecans into the mixture. Place evenly in one layer on cookie sheet. Put another cookie sheet on top of each other, and brush lightly with a few drops of olive oil or milk. Sprinkle with the chopped parsley and chopped anchovy paste and colored sprinkles. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the walnuts turn a light brown.

title: Polenta Cakes With Okra
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked okra | 1 cup polenta | 2 egg whites
instructions: Put the okra in a bowl with cold water to cover. Let soak for about 1/2 hour. Drain the okra. Put the polenta in a bowl and make a well in the center. Break an egg into it and add enough okra water to make it bind the mix together. Heat a non stick frying pan, preferably non stick, on medium heat. Drop the egg mixture by tablespoonfuls into the pan and spread them out in a circle. Cook for about 3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown on all sides. Spray the cake pan with cooking spray and spread the okra in one flat layer on the paper. Place remaining okra slices on top of the okra and spread them out again. Heat the remaining okra in a small frying pan for about 15 minutes. Spread hot okra on its own and let it dry in a warm oven for about 10 minutes, or until it turns very crispy. Cut the cake into wedges, then cut them wedges in half and serve warm with jam, sour cream, and salsa or use as a cake filling for grilled chicken strips.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,yogurt,yellow onion,anchovy,chicken thigh,green bell pepper,green pepper
title: Pesto Chicken
ingredients: 10 ounces chicken thighs ( bone in and skin on ) | 1 green bell pepper | 1 yellow onion | 1 red bell pepper | 1 cup pesto sauce ( homemade pesto ) | 1 can anchovies ( drained ) | 1/4 cup yogurt
instructions: Chop chicken into 3 inch cubes. Brown chicken in a skillet. Remove chicken with a slotted spoon and cover with the rest of the ingredients. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Peach, Almond  and Peach Fritters
ingredients: 200 g peach slices | 1/4 cup almond flour | 1/2 cup mussels ( canned ) or 1/2 cup fish sauce, for flavoring
instructions: Place the peach, almond flour, mussels and fish sauce in a plastic bag and shake to mix, then leave to stand while preparing the fritters. Heat a non stick frying pan, add the mixture to the pan and cook for 5 minutes on each side until evenly browned and crispy. Serve with fresh mango or pineapple slices for a fresh summer salad.

title: Homemade Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 3 cups flour | 2 packages chili oil
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together into a large bowl. Use sparingly as this tends to change the taste of the seasonings, but it will eventually pay off extras in flavor.

title: Easy Mexican Salsa Dip
ingredients: 2 cups salsa | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Spoon salsa into a medium bowl. Chop cilantro and mix together. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,balsamic vinegar,cool whip lite,tomato puree,white onion,oregano,filling,sesame oil
title: Cuban Pork Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4 thick slices | 3/4 cup tomato puree | 1/8 cup white onion, minced | 4 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 4 sheets filling | 1 container cool whip lite
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a shallow ovenproof dish, combine the pork, tomato puree, onion, vinegar, oil and oregano. Let mixture stand for 15 minutes while waiting for pork to marinate. Place a damp towel in a roasting pan or in a cookie sheet. Stir the filling into the filling, pressing mixture into pork. Bake for 30 minutes or until pork is done. Remove pork rolls from oven. Pour cooled cake mixture over top.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,chipotle powder,chicken thigh,marjoram,salami,graham wafer crumb
title: Crock Pot Chipotle Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 10 chicken thighs | 1/8 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3 tablespoons chipotle powder | 1 cup graham wafer crumbs | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/8 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 slices salami
instructions: Sprinkle salt over chicken. Place chicken thighs into crock pot. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Cook on low for 8 hours. Remove chicken and slice. Arrange on a platter or a large serving dish and serve with a side of salsa and sour cream.

title: Cocktel De Moron (Chocolates)
ingredients: 4 ounces kosher dill pickles, chopped | 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 cup gelatin, softened
instructions: In a food processor, combine dill pickles.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,sherry,almond extract,red chile,ginger garlic paste,bonito flake,cherry syrup
title: Korean Almond Balls
ingredients: 2 cans bamboo shoots, drained and chopped ( kimchee ) | 1/4 cup cherry syrup | 1 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chile, minced | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | fat ( for frying )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the cherry syrup, ginger garlic paste, chile, almond extract and sherry. Stir in the bamboo shoots making sure to thoroughly coat. Using hands, form a ball and roll around the sides in the glaze. Garnish with red chiles if desired.

title: Vanilla
ingredients: 1 large ripe avocado | 12 tablespoons dark rum, to taste
instructions: Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit. Remove all the flesh from the membranes and remove the flesh. Mash the flesh with a fork or potato masher. Add the rum and mix well. Serve on a large plate.

title: Beef on Toast
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, thinly sliced | 4 slices bacon, cooked | 6 fresh wild mushrooms | crushed ice
instructions: Heat skillet on medium high heat. Cook the bacon until it is completely crispy browned. Add beef and mushroom into a bowl and stir fry until beef is done. Drain off fat. In a sandwich size pan, layer the beef & mushroom mixture on the bottom. Slice the sirloin steak across the grain into thin slices. Place in a single layer on top of the beef & mushrooms. Sprinkle with crushed ice.

title: Beef With Coconut
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck or 1 1/2 lbs rump roast | sunflower oil | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 1/2 cups sweetened flaked coconut
instructions: Cut meat into approximately 1 inch cubes. Heat 1 - 2 tablespoons oil in skillet over medium high heat. Brown meat cubes in oil on all sides. Stir in enchilada sauce and brown sugar. Cover and cook over medium high heat for about 10 minutes or until meat juices run clear. Sprinkle shredded coconut over meat. Recover and cook for 10 - 15 minutes longer or until heated through.

title: Pinchos (Shredded Japanese Cookies)
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups asian chili-garlic sauce | 2 lbs asian-style peel
instructions: Rinse peel well and let dry completely with a towel. Dry peel completely and cut in 1 1/2 squares, then in strips about 2 x 2 inches about 5 inches wide. Arrange in single layer on foil lined baking sheet. Bake in a 350 degree f. Oven for about 6 minutes or until very lightly colored, then stir and bake 8 more minutes. Cool. Spoon about 1 tablespoon of shredded sichuan peppercorn seeds into small bowl and add enough of the chili-garlic sauce to cover. Use the back of a spoon or spoon to crush lightly and mix inches.

title: Achari (Thai Spicy Dry Fried Crisp)
ingredients: 1/4 cup palm sugar | 3/4 tablespoon corn flakes | 1/4 tablespoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon oil ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons soy sauce ( or braggs aminos )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, except soy sauce, and mix well. Pour in soy sauce to form a thin paste. If using braggs, break apart into bits with your hands.

title: Tamari Dhal
ingredients: 1 cup yellow lentils | 1/4 cup tamari or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted pistachios | 1 teaspoon orange peel
instructions: Bring salted water to a boil in a pot. Add yellow lentils and bring to a boil again. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes or until tender. If desired, drain and discard water. If desired, stir in tamari. Add pistachios. Toss with cooked yellow lentils until well mixed. Serve immediately, or refrigerate in a small bowl, cover, and store at room temperature for up to 2 days.

title: Curried Chorizo Pasta
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated fusilli pasta | 1 pound ground pork | 1 tablespoon curry | 1 teaspoon crushed ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon minced fresh sage | 2 cups merlot or 2 cups plain yogurt | 1/4 cup grated prosciutto
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, about 12 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet over medium heat, stir the ground pork with curry and chile power. In a small bowl, mix the sage, cheese, and cooked pasta with the spice mixture. Add the yogurt and prosciutto and mix with the pasta. Serve warm.

title: Pork Marinade for Pork Tenderloin or Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pork tenderloin or 2 1/2 cups chicken tenderloins | 1/2 cup bamboo shoot, shredded ( canned or cooked ) | 1/4 cup chopped mint | 2 tablespoons chopped mint | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1 dash marjoram | 1 dash cocoa | 1 dash of sakura brand chili liquor or 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour over meat and marinate overnight or at least 8 hours. Note, if sauce is too thick, thin it out with a little more water.

title: Red Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup green lentils | 1 cup milk
instructions: Wash the lentils, soak for at least two hours. Drain the lentils, boil them in salted water for about 45 - 50 mins until soft. Drain and place them in a blender with enough milk to create frothy consistency. Cook slowly for a longer and frothy consistency.

title: Cracker Cracker Salad
ingredients: 1 cup crackers | 1 small spring onion, finely chopped | 1 fresh lime
instructions: Combine the crackers, finely chopped spring onion and lime juice in a large bowl. Garnish with sprigs of freshly dried parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: anise flavoring,kasuri methi,yellow pepper,cheddar cheese,phyllo pastry,green curry paste
title: Cheddar Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed if frozen | 2/3 cup mild cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 teaspoon anise flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon kasuri methi ( ground dried fenugreek leaves ) | 2 teaspoons yellow peppers, finely sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients and set aside. Preheat oven to 375°f cut a 10 inch round in the center of a large sheet of plastic wrap. Brush with oil and lightly sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place 2 or 3 phyllo rounds in the middle of the packet and brush with oil and sprinkle with salt. In a small bowl, combine the other 2 phyllo sheets, stretching them to form a rectangle large enough to wrap one of the sheets in place. Working with 1/2 of the phyllo at a time, wrap a 2 by 1/2 inch length of the phyllo tightly around the package, using the tapered ends. Lay this sheet in the center of the sheets. Repeat with the remaining phyllo and phyllo. Working with 3 or 4 phyllo sheets at a time, place a 1/4 cup of cheddar and 1/4 cup of green curry sauce in a small bowl.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ketchup
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Enjoy over cooked chicken or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,hash brown,white bean,tabasco sauce,lemon zest,coriander powder,part mozzarella cheese,green olive
title: Nuclear Melt on the Cheeseburger
ingredients: 1 lb lean hash brown, cut into 2-inch | 1 cup white beans, drained | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder or 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander | 6 green olives, pitted | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium oyster sauce | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat grill to high. Brush large nonstick skillet with oil. Spray with cooking spray. Add potato and stir fry until golden. Add next 5 ingredients. Stir until hot. Add cheese, toss until melted. Serve with tabasco. Goes well with a green vegetable that can also be dressed with such as chives or greens as desired.

title: Teriyaki Tofu & Rice
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu, cut into 8 slices | 3 -4 garlic cloves, pressed or minced | 2 tablespoons pernod ( optional ) | 1 package of prepared wild rice | 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Heat a skillet. You can leave the tofu whole if preferred. Dip tofu slices into a medium sized bowl of garlic. Dredge in pernod. Then in cheese. Fry tofu slices in vegetable oil until browned, about 2 minutes on each side. Be careful not to burn the cheese.

Random Ingredients: egg beater substitute,white sugar,sorrel,baking chocolate,semolina,bay leaf,red food coloring
title: Pixie Dust Cookies
ingredients: 2/3 cup semolina | 1/3 cup white sugar | 1/3 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1 cup sorrel ( substitute ) | 1 bay leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking chocolate | 2 1/2 teaspoons red food coloring
instructions: Mix the semolina, sugar, egg beaters, fish/herbs, safflower oil, and bay leaf together until well combined. Stir in red food coloring. Using hands, roll teaspoonful of batter into balls, using about 2 teaspoons per ball. Place balls on parchment paper lined cookie sheets. Flatten ball with your thumb and then set aside. Continue rolling cookie batter until batter is used up, taking care not to overcrowd pan, as these cookies spread more as they cool. Let cookies cool.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,parmigiano reggiano cheese,orange marmalade,serrano chilies,carrot
title: Carrot Arrabiata
ingredients: 2/3 cup orange marmalade | 3/4 cup long-grain rice ( arborio, parmigiano, and river rice italiano ) | 10 -12 pieces fresh serrano chilies, stems removed ( may substitute with jalapeno ) | 3 carrots, cut into medium-size chunks ( about 4 cups, with more on the diagonal ) | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, plus more for passing
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f combine the orange marmalade with 1/4 cup of water in a small saucepan. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to 2 days. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Add the carrots, then cook, stirring, until they are just beginning to soften but still hold their shape, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add 2/3 cup warm water, plus 2 tablespoons more, to the pan. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bring the arrabiata to room temperature. Transfer the arrabiata to a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle with the cheese. Bake until it is brown, about 8 minutes. Remove from the oven, remove the parchment, and let cool slightly. Cut into wedges.

title: Baked Whole Wheat Chapati (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs whole wheat flour ( or more if desired ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons white pepper ( or to taste )
instructions: Put flour in medium size bowl and add white pepper. In a medium size bowl dissolve whole wheat flour in warm water. Using your fingers, rub and mix flour and pepper over the bowl of the dry ingredients. Add the dry ingredients to the flour and combine all together. This takes about 10 - 15 minutes. You should have an unsticky dough. Add more flour as needed to make a stiff dough that comes together but isn't sticky. Turn dough out onto a well floured surface and knead thoroughly until smooth, about 3 - 4 minutes. Dough may be covered and refrigerated for up to 8 hours.. Place the dough on a lightly floured surface and pat the dough into a round about 3 inches thick. You may also roll the dough out into a circle using a pizza roller, a pizza cutter or a rolling pin. If you have a pizza cutter, cut 3 - 3 inch round circles from the dough using a 4 - 5 1/2 inch star shaped cutter. Put rounds onto a lightly floured board and form patties about 3/4 inch in diameter. Flour the tops with more flour if necessary. Bake in a hot skillet on a panini bread cycle while bread baking, if you have one, or a light colored, medium sized, cast iron skillet if not you will be working on this at this point. These will also bake for a couple of hours on a panini, or just leave them out on the panini bread cycle for up to 1 hour before baking time. They should be a golden color and should sound a toned more hollow when tapped down. Remove from the panini bread and place on a cooling rack and cool completely. Serve warm with olive oil, butter, jam or cheese.

title: Apple Beef Tenderloin With Zucchini and Apples
ingredients: 1 granny smith apples or 1 other firm white sweet apple, such as a granny smith | 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 1 lb zucchini, cut lengthwise into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Peel apples and cut into 2 inch thick slices. Place beef in a large resealable freezer bag. Cut 1 inch wide slits in top of beef. Pour contents of bag into a 6 qt crockpot. Insert a thin sharp knife parallel to the top of the beef. Cover crockpot with aluminum foil. Cook on high 3 hours, high 5 hours.. Slice tenderloin crosswise into 1/4 thick slices. Serve warm or at room temperature with zucchini or applesauce.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,celery seed,fennel bulb,honey,portabella mushroom,granny smith apple
title: Honey Glazed Portabella Apples
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and cut into eighths | 8 large portabella mushrooms | 1 tablespoon ground fennel seed | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/2 teaspoon honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare a 8 x 8 baking dish by lining with parchment paper. Place fennel bulb on a large cutting board and trim fronds, then use a knife to core the fennel bulb, leaving it whole. Slice fennel bulb crosswise into 3/4 inch thick slices. Place apple in a bowl of cold water to loosen skin, then drain. Cut each fennel slice in half, then cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Arrange the fennel, fennel core, and portobello mushrooms in the baking dish. In a small bowl, stir together fennel seed, minced garlic, and honey until well combined. Drizzle in the honey mixture, and toss to coat evenly. Sprinkle the mixture over the top. Bake the vegetable mixture until the vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil,active yeast,onion,potato flour,rose water,lime wedge,monterey jack cheese
title: Onion Calzones
ingredients: 1 lb of grated monterey jack cheese | 1 small onion, chopped | 4 cups of potato flour | 1/4 cup of crushed basil | 2 1/2 teaspoons powdered rose water | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 4 limes or 4 lemons | rose water, garnish ( optional )
instructions: Grease two round or oval tins and set aside. Mix together the grated cheese, onion, flour, basil, rose water, yeast and lime juice to form a dough. Knead for about 8 minutes then divide it into two pieces. On a floured board, roll each piece into an x shape about about 8 inches long and 4 inches wide. Spread the dough out on wax paper and stretch the dough into two 1 inch x 2 inch thin round loaves. Press the seams together with a fork. Put the loaves onto the lightly greased tins. Cover and place in a warm place to rise. Let rise to double in bulk. About 40 minutes before finished rising, preheat the griddle. Brush the tops of the loaves with rose water and turn once. Cover with a towel and let rise 20 - 30 minutes. Take them out of the tins and cut into thin strips. Reheat them in the warm place 5 - 10 minutes. Serve in a warm dish and decorate as desired.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,chunky peanut butter,italian sausage link,asparagus spear,black pepper,salt pepper,ricotta cheese
title: Shredded Italian Sausage
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage links, casings removed | 16 fresh asparagus spears, trimmed | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon salt-and-pepper blend | 1 pinch garlic salt | 1 pinch black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the italian sausage links between two sheets of wax paper, and pound with a meat mallet. Cut each sausage link lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Place slices onto a baking sheet, and bake in the preheated oven until the meat is no longer pink inside, and the juices run clear, about 15 to 20 minutes. Cool, and slice across the grain. Discard the skins. Trim asparagus into 1/2 inch pieces, and steam in boiling lightly salted water until tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Drain. Arrange asparagus onto a large serving platter, and toss with the peanut butter, ricotta cheese, salt, pepper blend, garlic salt and pepper. Top with the thinly sliced meat.

title: Avocado, Lobster, Swiss Cheese Balls
ingredients: 3 avocados - peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup italian-style seasoned bread crumbs | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 package imitation oysters, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dijbuie, liquor
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine avocado, kidney beans and swiss cheese in a bowl. Stir in bread crumbs, flour and imitation oysters. Mix until well blended. Shape into 1 inch balls and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove and allow to cool slightly, remove from cookie sheets and roll up. Serve immediately.

title: Gluten Free French Bread
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups gluten free bread mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Preheat oven to in small bowl mix dry mix, salt, and flours well. Place mixture onto bread dough and form into loaf, approximately 4 x 4 inches. Let in a baking tin. Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes. Then, cut into slices to serve.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,lima bean,serrano pepper jalapeno
title: Easy & Easy Mexican Lima Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup ( i recommend campbell's ) | 1 can lima beans | 1/2 jalapeno, minced ( optional )
instructions: Mash up lima beans and set aside. Blend together cream of chicken soup, lima beans and minced jalapeno. Serve with tortilla chips or pita bread.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,baby spinach leaf,kaffir lime leaf,baking potato
title: Spinach Potato Gratin With Kaffir Lime and Cinnamon
ingredients: 1 large baking potato, peeled and finely grated ( about 8 ounces per potato ) | 1 1/2 lbs baby spinach leaves | 4 -5 kaffir lime leaves | 8 ounces mascarpone cheese, room temperature
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a roasting pan, place the grated potato, approximately 8 ounces/2oz. Cups, on top of a piece of oiled wire cake tin. Bake the potato until very tender and pale golden and soft. About 6 - 8 minutes, depending on the grating of the grated potato. Set potatoes aside. Place the spinach leaves on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Add a little water just to cover the leaves and to help wilt the leaves. Wash the kaffir lime leaves and dry thoroughly using kitchen paper towels. Drain well. Cut potato in half lengthwise. Carefully slide the halves onto the leaves, spacing evenly apart. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the spinach/spinach mixture into each potato half. Place a kaffir lime leaf on top. Using a very sharp knife, cut the halves diagonally into 3 or 4 slices. Place the slices in a single layer on top of the spinach/spinach mixture. Sprinkle evenly with a little of the mascarpone. Use the remaining spinach filling to generously cover the top of the cheese. Bake about 20 minutes until cheese is golden and puffed, and potatoes are tender. Remove the potato gratin from the oven and let cool slightly. Cut into pieces or rounds and serve immediately, or cover tightly and refrigerate for up to a week. Re heat before serving. Note, to use a piece of parchment paper as a guide for removing the edges, cover the gratin with foil or wax paper and set over a pan of boiling water to cool. When sufficiently cold, remove the paper and parchment and unwrap. Place under a hot grill and grill the gratin for 1 - 2 minutes until crisp, turning it often to brown evenly.

title: Homemade Pasta - Oven for Freezing and Spices
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour or 1 cup white whole wheat flour | 1 cup white whole wheat flour or 1 cup white spelt flour | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour or 1 tablespoon white spelt flour | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: The dough can be made a couple hours in advance and refrigerated. Bring to room temperature before proceeding with recipe. In a large bowl combine all the ingredients. Pinch off tiny bits of workable dough at a time and drop about 1 tsp full into the mix. Use your hands to work the dough as dry as you can. The dough should be moist enough to hold together and stick together, not sticky. Cover with a towel and let rest 45 minutes at room temperature or in the fridge. Baking. Meanwhile, pre heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Using a sharp, round knife, score a cross in the top of the pasty with a razor blade. If the flour doesn't already stick to the knife, mix a small amount of flour with melted butter. If the flour dries out, mix a minute or two of water with a fork and quickly knead the dough in the flour with a fork. Use a pastry bladed knife dipped in flour, if needed, to make decorative designs. The pasta dough can also be formed a lattice type dough by sprinkling it over the top of the dough. Sprinkle about 1 teaspoon of pasty or cheese flour across the top. If desired, use a vegetable peeler to peel strips of dried green or white on top of the cheese. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes on a baking sheet on a lower rack, until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly. Note, make sure the cheese does not melt too quickly, so watch carefully. Once it is cool and hard, you can freeze it.

Random Ingredients: coconut extract,chicken stock cube,coleslaw mix,grape,barbecue sauce,green plantain,bread dough
title: Sweet Potato Patties
ingredients: 4 large green plantains, halved lengthways and cut into very thin slices | 1/4 cup chicken stock cube, dissolved in | 2 cups chicken stock cubes | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce, thickened with half water | 1 tablespoon coconut extract | 2 1/2 - 3 cups packaged shredded coleslaw mix | 4 -6 8 ounces frozen bread dough, thawed ( you may use the packet instructions for a store bought loaf )
instructions: Heat the grill to high. Brush a non stick frying pan with oil and heat the oil. Cook the plantains for 2 - 3 mins each side, depending on their colour, and then place on a paper towel lined plate to drain, and return to the preheated oven for 10 minutes to crisp. Remove. Whisk the dissolved chicken stock, barbeque sauce and coconut extract in a jug to dissolve the chicken stock. Place the coleslaw mix in a large mixing bowl. Add the coleslaw, plantains and crumbed bread to the coleslaw and toss to combine. Serve in a shallow bowl with the hot grill for the beef and pork mince, or with a salad and crusty bread loaf.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,ice cube,dark sesame oil,self raising flour,saffron,chili oil,kahlua
title: Mexican Chocolate Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 2 cups ice cubes | 1/4 cup sifted self-raising flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili oil | 3 1/2 ounces kahlua | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon ice cube
instructions: Place the chilli oil, 1 oz of the liqueur and the saffron in a small saucepan over a medium heat, stir until the saffron has dissolved then set aside to cool completely. Add 1 tbls of the ice cold water into the dry ingredients until the mixture comes together and then work in the ice cube. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Make the cakes up to 2 hours in advance to allow the cakes to freeze. Heat a large nonstick fry pan, when very hot enough lightly coat the surface with olive oil and add 1 tbsp of the ice cold batter. Cook until the top of the cake has a nice golden brown colour and when pressed lightly with a spatula turn the cake around, brown the other side. Let cool for a few moments and remove the cakes and serve with whipped cream or extra chocolate curls on top.

title: Baked Zucchini With Penne
ingredients: 350 g penne pasta | 400 g zucchini, sliced | 1/4 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | chili flakes, to taste ( optional ) | pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven 200c. Cook the pasta. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan and fry the zucchini slices for a few minutes. Remove zucchini and drain on kitchen paper. Add the pasta to the pan and mix well. Spread the sauce on the pasta and sprinkle the zucchini with icing sugar. Toss together and return to the oven for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve immediately, sprinkled with chilly flakes and black pepper or lemon wedges for a fruity taste.

Random Ingredients: lamb steak,kidney bean,raisin,sauerkraut,lard crisco,white cheese,ginger ale
title: Lamb & Sauerkraut Casserole
