ingredients: 800 g lamb steaks | 1 cup sauerkraut | 1 cup onion, finely chopped | 400 g kidney beans, drained and rinsed well | 1/2 ounce fresh ginger ale ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons lard, crisco or 3 tablespoons crisco shortening | 3/4 cup raisins
instructions: Remove any fat from lamb and cut meat in 1/4” slices across the grain. Set meat aside. In a large pot add in sauerkraut, onion, beans, ginger ale and 2½ cups of warm water. Cover and simmer on a simmer for 30 minutes until the meat is tender, stirring from time to time. Melt the lard in a small frying pan and simmer rapidly until it melts and glazes the lamb. Remove from heat, season to taste and stir in raisins. Preheat oven at 190°c. Grease a 2 - ½ cup shallow ovenproof baking dish. Place meat, with any juices, into the baking dish and cover with foil or a lid, sealing the lid slightly and heating the liquid in the pan. Bake for about 1 hour until the meat is very tender. Remove lid during the last 15 minutes of baking to brown the top.

title: Gorgonzola Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces soft silken tofu | 3 ounces crumbled gorgonzola
instructions: Remove tofu and crumble it coarsely. Add gorgonzola and stir it into the cheese. Add some cold water if it becomes too runny. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,coconut milk,pimiento,jumbo shrimp,italian salad dressing,lettuce,yeast
title: Seafood Kebabs
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast | 1 can coconut milk | 1 can pimientos | 1 1/2 cups italian salad dressing | 1 1/2 lbs jumbo shrimp, peeled deveined and cut in half lengthwise | 1 tablespoon pimento, minced ( or 1 t minced red pepper ) | 1 head lettuce
instructions: Dissolve yeast in sugar mixture in a large bowl. Add 1 1/2 of coconut milk to coconut milk.

title: Zee Family Almoosh Hummus
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 30 ounces canned chickpeas | 1/2 lemon peel, finely chopped | 1/3 cup unsalted almond milk | 1 tablespoon chili paste
instructions: Drain chickpeas in a colander set over a large bowl and reserve the liquid. Chop the chickpeas into ¾ inch pieces. Add tomato sauce, chickpeas, lemon peel, and almond milk to food processor and puree until smooth. Add 2 tablespoon water if needed to form a thin layer on the bottom if it is too thick. Transfer hummus to a medium sized serving bowl and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Nutritional values per serving, 2 cups low sodium diets. Low sodium diets use splenda as a substitute.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,thyme sprig,barley,chicken bouillon granule,bamboo skewer,kosher salt,corn,serrano pepper jalapeno
title: Cocktail Skewers With Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup barley, raw | 1 small serrano pepper ( or other small fresh fresh jalapeno ), minced | 1/4 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed, if canned | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1/2 cup corn ( fresh or frozen ) | kosher salt | 8 bamboo skewers or 8 metal skewers, soaked in water
instructions: In a bowl, combine bouillon granules, barley, minced jalapeño and black beans and the thyme. Stir briskly to mix well. Remove from heat and sprinkle with kosher salt. Prepare an ice water bath. Soak 12 wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes before you use them. Heat metal or bamboo skewers over boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes. Place skewers in freezer 1 - 2 hours, flipping after 1 hour. Remove skewers from freezer, wiping off any excess water and place them on a cutting board. With your fingers, trim away most of the thin membrane then cut away the tough white membrane on the top. Slice into thick slices approximately 1 1/2 inches or more on the diagonal. Serve either warm or at room temperature with salsa.

title: Rich Grudge Chicken Livers
ingredients: 1/2 cup of dark chocolate | 2 lbs chicken livers, washed
instructions: Using a large skillet melt all the chocolates with the chicken livers until smooth and the fat. Remove from heat. Dip the chicken livers one at a time into the chocolate and place in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,orange zest,mussel,dark rye flour,pomegranate,cucumber,dark rum,beef tenderloin
title: Steak Gargonzola
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup dark rum | 14 ounces can condensed onion soup mix | 1/2 cup pomegranate | 1/2 cup orange zest | 1/2 cup cucumber, cut into thin wedges | 14 ounces mussels, cleaned and debearded | 1/3 cup dark rum
instructions: Slice the tenderloin in 3/4 inch slices, about 1/4 inch thick and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together the 1/4 cup rum, onion soup mix, pomegranate seeds, orange zest, and cucumber. Pour half the rum mixture over the beef. Add the mussels. Coat the entire top of the tenderloin with rum mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 4 days, turning the meat twice a day. During the last 2 days, remove the marinade from the refrigerator and set aside 1/4 cup rum mixture. To serve, divide the reserved 1/4 cup rum mixture into 2 ramekins, or a large roasting pan. Place on top of the beef and mussels in a single layer. Add a little rum mixture to the rum mix, or a small amount of rum. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 40 minutes, or until the beef is fork tender.

title: Quick arugula bread
ingredients: 2 slices french bread, about 1/3 inch thick, cut diagonally into 8 thin slices | 2 cups loose arugula leaves | 1/2 teaspoon table salt
instructions: Divide arugula leaves between 2 slices of bread. Wrap and shape 1 slice of bread with remaining slice. Sprinkle with salt. Repeat with remaining slices.

title: Tomato and Vermouth Lid
ingredients: 400 g pureed tomatoes, slightly over-ripe | 25 ml vermouth ( or other sweet wine ) | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom, cracked
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy 4 cup pan. Heat, stirring often, until boiling. Reduce heat to low, then cover pan tightly and continue cooking for 45 minutes without removing lid to check if sauce is becoming too thick. Pour over hot ice and serve.

title: Tamarind Olives
ingredients: 4 pints peanut oil or 4 lbs vegetable oil | 4 1/2 lbs ripe tamarind pulp | 3 pounds kalamata olives, pitted | 1/4 cup thinly sliced fresh parsley
instructions: Wipe your hands and the pulp from the tamarind with a damp cloth. Cut the pulp into 1 inch chunks. Place tamarind pieces in a colander and place one end of a small piece of the pulp directly under the surface of the tamarind. Press the flesh until it is totally covered. Let the pulp drain for 1 hour. Squeeze the pulp dry and place pulp in a clean, heavy saucepan. Add a quart or more of water to cover. Place over high heat and bring to a boil. When the water reaches a boil, reduce heat to a simmer. Simmer until reduced to 1/2 inch, about 3 hours. While the pot is simmering, bring the olive oil to a boil in a wide sauté pan or deep frying pan. With a slotted spoon remove the soaked tamarind pulp from the pot and place into a saucepan. Add the olives and simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes, until the olives are very soft and beginning to turn translucent. Drain the olives and place them into ice cold water and drain. Place the boiled over ice water in a bowl to stop the cooking process. Drain the olives thoroughly, squeezing out the water before discarding them. Add the olives to the tamarind mixture and stir gently. The mixture will seem dry as it stands, but remove the oil as it collects in the bowl. Serve at once or store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Wild Rocket Neufchatel Dip
ingredients: 200 g neufchatel cheese, cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons chopped green beans | 4 tablespoons chopped canned chinese mushrooms ( use 2 tbsp dried if available ) | 4 tablespoons chopped pimientos | 4 teaspoons cayenne ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup rocket, to garnish
instructions: Place butter into a microwaveable dish and heat, on high, 4 minutes or till melted. Add chinese mushrooms and pour over cheese cubes. Cover and cook on high for 2 - 3 minutes or till cheese is bubbling. Stir in pimentos, then sprinkle with cayenne. Serve over rocket.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,parsley sprig,bread dough,yogurt,sherry,italian sausage,red enchilada sauce
title: Easy Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 lb chinese link hot italian sausage ( or hot chorizo ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 package frozen bread dough | 1/4 cup dry sherry ( not cooking sherry ) | 1 cup yogurt | 1 can red enchilada sauce | parsley sprig
instructions: Thaw dough at room temperature for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut sausage into 1/2 inch chunks. Place meat in a skillet and cook over medium high heat with celery salt until browned. Remove sausage from skillet and set aside. Place bread dough on a lightly floured surface and roll into a 12x18x2 inch rectangle. Spoon sausage mixture over top and spread with sherry. Wrap dough snugly with foil and place in oven. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 5 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f. Meanwhile, combine yogurt, enchilada sauce and minced parsley. Slice bread in 1/2 inch thick slices and place on a serving plate. Top with yogurt mixture and top with enchilada sauce mixture. Serve hot.

title: Spaghetti Baked in Pomegranate Molasses
ingredients: 1 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 1 pinch nutmeg, grated | 2 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 12 ounces spaghetti, precooked for 5 minutes, drain when done
instructions: Combine molasses, pepperoncini pepper, and nutmeg in a large bowl. Add cooked spaghetti and toss until combined. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and enjoy.

title: Rigatoni With Baked Beans, Apricots and Olives
ingredients: 6 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 can lima beans ( whole or split ) | 3/4 cup quick oatmeal | 1 cup apricot, sliced | 1 tablespoon molasses ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Cook the rigatoni al dente according to the package directions. Drain. In a large bowl, toss the pasta and lima beans with the oatmeal, apricots, molasses and 1/2 cup of the parmigiano cheese. Toss the pasta with the bean and cheese mixture until combined. Transfer the mixture to an oven proof baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining parmigiano and bake, in a 350 oven for 30 to 35 minutes, or until the topping on the top has caramelized lightly. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cherry Rollups
ingredients: 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon creamed chunky cherries
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325°f. Combine grated cheddar and cherries. Form into 2 balls, then roll each one in the creamed mixture then in the un rolled cheddar cheese. Place in an ovenproof dish and bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green olive,zucchini,red curry paste,olive oil,hot pepper sauce,rump roast,chili garlic sauce
title: Spicy Beef and Zucchini
ingredients: 3 lbs rump roast or 3 lbs stew meat, cut into thin strips about 1 1/2 inch wide | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 cup low sodium lemon or lime juice or 1 cup yellow lemon, juice and zest of | salt and hot pepper sauce | 1 can green olives, with liquid | paprika or red chili pepper sauce, to serve
instructions: Using sharp knife or cleaver, cut slits in meat. Insert a small piece of butter, if necessary. Combine curry paste and juice in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate chip,extra tofu,hazelnut,gouda cheese,beef roast,kaffir lime leaf,cardamom seed
title: Beef Tofu With Nuts
ingredients: 1 small beef roast ( about 10 ounces ) | 2 boxes extra firm tofu, cubed ( about 7 ounces ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted | 2 tablespoons extra firm tofu | 1 tablespoon gouda cheese, shredded | 24 cardamom seeds, crushed | 1 kaffir lime leaf, thinly sliced
instructions: Place tofu in microwave safe bowl.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,lemon,green pea,chili paste,madras curry powder,italian breadcrumb
title: Curried Naan (Indian Breaded Noodle)
ingredients: 4 slices italian bread ( long loaves, not one long loaf ) | chili paste, as required | 2 medium naan roll ( use a bolillos brand from an indian supermarket ) | 3/4 cup green peas ( frozen or canned ) | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Using a pan heat 1 tablet oil at the highest. Cut each of the naan rolls lenghtwise and toast lightly. Spread with a little chilli paste, place in the pan and fry turning often until lightly browned. Remove frompan. To the same pan add remaining oil and curry powder, stir and fry for 2 - 3 minutes or until fragrant and starting to color. Stir in the peas and reheat if needed. To serve, spoon some of curry mixture over the naan bread, sprinkle with lemon juice and sprinkle with the breadcrumbs.

title: Leek and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 leeks, white, white parts only halved and washed | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Place the leeks into a pan of salted boiling water. Cover and cook over a medium heat for 7 to 10 minutes or until soft and just tender. Drain. Place all the ingredients into a shallow pan and heat gently but thoroughly. This can be served with assorted chopped vegetables.

Random Ingredients: navel orange,pistachio,hot red chili pepper,mango chutney,ghee,snow pea,rye bread
title: Grilled Navel Orange Salad in Pistachio Crust
ingredients: 2 navel oranges, peeled, segmented and cut into small wedges ( or 1 large navel orange, cut into thin slices ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons ghee, divided ( i always use 1 tsp. of oil and 1-2 tsp. oil ) | 4 -6 hot red chili peppers ( or 2 -3 drops hot sauce, depending on taste ( or 1/2 tsp. hot sauce ) | 1/2 cup mango chutney ( if you can get it - i use the one with the mango and chutney mix ) | 1/2 cup snipped toasted pepitas ( optional ) | 8 -12 ounces snow peas, steamed, cooled and halved lengthwise ( optional ) | crusty rye bread, for serving
instructions: Heat a gas grill or broiler to medium high. Arrange the oranges and chiles on a foil lined cookie sheet. Set aside to broil or set aside to cool. In a medium saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium high heat and stir fry 2 pieces of cheese, stirring continuously to coat the chunks of cheese. Pour in another teaspoon of oil, stir fry one piece of cheese until just beginning to melt. Repeat with another 1/2 cup of oil and stir fry the chiles until crisp and brown and tender. Add 1/4 cup cooked orange segments and chiles and stir with a wooden spoon until blended well. Stir in one tablespoon of sugar and stir. Remove from heat. Cover and refrigerate at least 5 minutes. Sprinkle the greens with remaining cheese. To serve, line a serving platter with rice.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla strip,pie crust,white bread,dill weed,vanilla pudding,italian bread,sausage,salt pork
title: Italian Hot Dogs
ingredients: 3/4 pound sausage, cut into bite size pieces | 1/2 pound corn tortilla strips, cut 1 1/2 inch strips | 1/3 pound italian bread | 2 1/2 cups hot or dry instant vanilla pudding | 1/3 cup chopped fresh dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 12 pie crusts | 1 pound white bread, sliced into 1 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the sausage in a large skillet. Cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until evenly browned. Drain the excess grease. Place the tortilla strips in a small pot and pour boiling water over.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,meat,beef chuck,cooking spray,red enchilada sauce
title: Spicy Mexican Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs lean meat | 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 8 -10 kalamata olives ( i use greek or red ) | cooking spray | store-bought frozen cooked meat, ( optional )
instructions: Cut meat in 1 1/2 inch cubes. Brown meat in a hot frying pan with a little oil or cooking spray. Drain and return to pan. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Tandoori Mild Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 large cucumbers ( peeled, seeded, diced and set aside ) | 1/2 cup sweet rice wine ( or red ) | 1 -2 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 -2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup flour | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 2 tablespoons ground coriander and 1 tablespoon cumin or 2 tablespoons cumin seeds
instructions: Put cucumbers and sweet rice in a large bowl, and mix together the remaining ingredients. Make the mix by combining mustard seeds and coriander together, set in fridge until needed. Toss with cucumber mixture. Best if served immediately.

title: Soy Chilli Popcorn (Australian)
ingredients: 6 cups cooked popcorn ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 cooking onions, finely chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 1 cup tasty cheese, grated ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup palm sugar ( about 3/4 cup )
instructions: Cook popcorn and onions in a large saucepan of boiling, slated water for 10 minutes or until crunchy. Drain and cool to room temperature. To serve stir popcorn mixture, cheese and 1 1/2 tsp sweetener together in a large bowl until coated.

title: Quick Egg Nog
ingredients: 2 large egg whites | 2 cups hoisin sauce | 1 cup dry parsley | 1/4 cup light wheat germ
instructions: Place egg whites in a large nonstick frypan over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 - 7 minutes or until meringue is toasted and a drop of water sizzles. Remove from heat and pour into a bowl. Use a fork to beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gently fold egg whites into cooled meringue. Sprinkle on wheat germ. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Tuscan Kale Onions
ingredients: 8 medium yellow onions, peeled ( about 2 pounds total ) | 24 -24 cups of fresh kale
instructions: The easiest way to prepare kale is to cut it off the stem/disc tips and then cut it into small diagonal slices about 1 1/2 inches length. If you are cutting with scissors, cut a cross in the stems of the onions lengthwise. Wash and dry the kale, removing as much of the stalk as you can, then cut it in 2 inch long lengths. Place the kale in a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker. Put in enough water to completely submerge the onion. Cook on high until the liquid starts to run. This can take anywhere from 7 to 12 hours depending on your cooker. Check the greens and they should be tender when pierced with a fork but falling apart when they are. At the end of the cooking time, turn the cooker on to high. This will take another hour or two. Remove the onions and let cool until you can handle them. Use a slotted spoon to remove the kale, then place in a bowl. Pour the cooking liquid into a pot. Place over medium high heat and bring to a boil. Stir the pan contents with a wooden spoon. Reduce the liquid to 1 quart, then remove from heat. Cover and place in the refrigerator until ready to serve. When ready to serve, remove the kale as much of the stalk but keeping the leaves whole. Transfer the kale to a serving bowl. Add some of the cooking liquid that has collected for cooking. Stir in the remaining ingredients and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: egg beater substitute,caster sugar,tea,coriander seed,pistachio nut,italian parsley
title: Mixed Spice  Mix from Vegetarian Times.
ingredients: 2 cups caster sugar | 1 cup tea, hot | 2 tablespoons dried coriander seeds | 4 eggs, lightly beaten | 3 tablespoons fat free chopped pistachio nuts | italian parsley, to serve
instructions: Combine sugar, coriander seeds and tea in saucepan and bring to boil. Simmer for 3 minutes, then remove from heat. Add eggs, stir and return to heat for 2 minutes. Spoon into serving dish and garnish with pistachios and parsley. Serve with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: basil,button mushroom,green olive,red pesto sauce,new potato,tortilla
title: Potato & Mushroom Tortilla Rollups
ingredients: 10 new potatoes | 12 large button mushrooms, stems trimmed | 6 green olives, roughly chopped | 150 ml red pesto sauce | 4 large tortillas | 6 tablespoons basil, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Cut the potatoes into four and boil in salted water about 10 minutes oruntil just tender. Cut the mushrooms into quarters. Put the sliced mushrooms and olives between two sheets of baking paper. Brush the edges with half a tablespoon of balsamic vinegar to seal. Spread the pesto generously on one side of each potato. Lay a tortilla on top, top with the mashed potato and a sprinkling of basil. Roll up and secure with a toothpick. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Heat a little oil in a non stick frying pan and lightly fry the rolls until golden and crisp. Serve with your favourite dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,canola oil,red pepper,white rice,plum tomato,poblano pepper
title: Rice, Roasted Pepper and Chile Side Dish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 poblano peppers, seeded and chopped | 1/3 cup diced red pepper | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 cup long grain rice, uncooked | 1/4 cup uncooked white rice, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Heat oil in a large skillet. Saute peppers in oil over medium heat, stirring frequently, until browned. Remove peppers to a small bowl, set aside. Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of oil from skillet. Add tomatoes and rice and saute on medium heat for 5 minutes. Stir. Add peppers, white rice and stir to combine.

title: Corn and Plums
ingredients: 1 can sweet corn, drained | 1 cup canned plum tomatoes | 4 teaspoons chocolate syrup ( or to taste ) | 8 whole wheat pita bread, split
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the corn, tomatoes and chocolate syrup. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the pita bread on the foil. Spoon the corn mixture into each pita half, and wrap. Place on the baking sheet and refrigerate at least one hour, or overnight to set. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until toasted, and slightly browned.

title: Baked Hokkien Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces hokkien noodles | 1 teaspoon fennel bulb, finely grated | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 7 ounces suet, finely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c bring a large pan of water to the boil and cook the noodles for 10 minutes, or until tender, drain thoroughly. Put the noodles, fennel and bicarb in a mixing bowl and add enough cold water to just cover. Let sit for 2 - 3 minutes then drain. Put the suet in a shallow ovenproof dish. Sprinkle over the noodles and press around with a metal spatula to cover the noodles. Bake for 15 minutes, or until crisp and golden.

title: Fruit & Coriander (Tirkrong Balm) With Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups basmati rice, uncooked | 1 ripe mango, peeled, seeds removed and cut into chunks | 2 cups frozen peas or 2 cups snow peas, thawed | 1 tablespoon coriander, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract | 3 tablespoons caster sugar
instructions: Rinse rice in cold, running water and drain. In a large bowl, add all ingredients except sugar and mix to combine. Sprinkle sugar on top. Cover and leave in fridge overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Korean Pickle Turnip Relish
ingredients: 12 large yellow turnips | 1 cup orange bell pepper | 3/4 cup sesame seeds | 4 1/2 tablespoons sweet pickle juice
instructions: Wash and peel the turnips, then cut them into 1/2 inch lengthwise slices. Cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Cut the orange bell pepper into 2 inch strips. Combine the sesame seeds, pickles, and sweet pickle juice in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook 5 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and cool to room temperature. Store in an airtight jar until serving.

title: Pimiento-Smoked Pork Loin Wraps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 pound pork loin, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 6 flour tortillas | 1 can chopped ripe olives, drained
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over high heat. Dip pork into bread crumbs, and place in the skillet. Cook and stir over high heat until pork slices are browned, about 5 minutes per side. Spread each tortilla with a small amount of the sliced cooked pork, and top with olives.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,plum tomato,chive,pizza crust,baby carrot,pimento olive
title: Pizza Appetizer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped | 1 1/4 cups chopped plum tomatoes | 1/4 cup baby carrots, finely diced, cooked | 1 1/2 cups chopped seeded tomatoes | pimento stuffed olive, sliced, garnish | 24 crust frozen pizza crusts
instructions: Spread peanut butter on pizza crust with a pastry brush.

title: Bourbon Spaghetti With Prosciutto
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can spaghetti | 1/4 cup bourbon | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda ( i use baking soda ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 4 -8 fresh slices prosciutto
instructions: Cook fresh spaghetti according to package directions. In a small bowl, combine bourbon, baking soda and allspice. Set aside. Lightly spray a large skillet. Place prosciutto slices in the skillet and lightly brown. When the prosciutto is a rich golden brown color, add 1/4 the amount of bourbon mixture to taste. Drain pasta and add to skillet, tossing lightly to coat. Transfer to a large serving platter. Sprinkle remaining bourbon over top.

title: Asafetida Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup chopped mixed vegetables | 15 ounces of canned black-eyed peas, drained | 1 teaspoon stevia | 2 tablespoons chopped lemons or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 3 tablespoons flour
instructions: Drain peas and put aside. Combine remaining ingredients and put into a pot with just enough water to cover. Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes. Add mixed vegetables and cook 15 - 20 minutes longer. The vegetables should be tender.

Random Ingredients: bacon bit,cayenne,cumin seed,greek olive,sage leaf,tahini,head lettuce,garlic salt
title: The Best Bacon, Sesame and Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, i used torn bite size pieces, i used torn bite size pieces, i used romaine lettuce too | 3/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup tahini, stirred, i added 1 teaspoon of cayenne and 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seeds ( or any other cumin powder ) | 3 -4 slices bacon bits, i added about 3/4 cup of bacon drippings | 1/2 teaspoon rubbed sage leaves ( optional )
instructions: Mix lettuce, olives and cheese. Add bacon drippings and seasonings, toss and serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Poached Pears
ingredients: 3/4 cup brewed tea | 3/8 teaspoon tarragon vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs bosc pears, peeled and sliced into 3/4-inch wedges | 2 -4 slices black forest ham, cut into 3/4-inch wide strips ( about 1 tbsp. each )
instructions: Combine the brewed tea and vinegar in a small bowl. Scrape into a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat to evaporate any froth. Add the pears, cover partially and simmer over low heat until tender, about 10 minutes. Arrange the ham strips on top. Bring the syrup to a boil, pour over the pears and serve immediately.

title: Chicken and Leek Pot Sticker
ingredients: 4 -6 small russet potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 lb chicken wings, tips removed | 1 leek, washed and chopped | 1 lb fresh lemon grass, bruised with your hands ( about 6 stalks ) | 24 ladyfingers, split
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place potatoes, wings, leek, and half the water in a large bowl, cover and let stand overnight. Remove vegetables from bowl, drain and set aside. In the morning, drain vegetables, pat dry, and remove root ends, leaving just enough root to stubs on the sticker to use later. Place vegetables on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for one hour or until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are golden brown. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the remaining water and stinger and return to boil, then boil for five minutes. Stir in lemon grass. When potatoes are almost done, place in a mixing bowl. Scoop mashed potatoes on top and stir. Serve the chicken and leek stew over mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: lentil,applesauce,part mozzarella cheese,purpose white flour,italian parsley,green enchilada sauce
title: Red Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 can diced applesauce | 1 cup lentils, cooked and rinsed | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 3 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese | 3 cups all-purpose white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix the enchilada sauce, applesauce, lentils, and parsley in a bowl. Divide the mozzarella cheese into 8 equal pieces. Stir half of the flour into the sauce mixture until well incorporated. Repeat with the remaining cheese and flour. Place the remaining flour in a saucepan, and stir in enough cold water to make a soft dough. Place the dough into a freezer bag and squeeze the excess air from the bag. Separate the dough into 8 balls. Roll each ball into a ball, and place on a lightly floured surface. Working with one ball at a time, place a dough ball on the bottom of a baking dish. Top with half of the enchilada sauce, and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Repeat process with the remaining tortillas. Bake in preheated oven until cheese is lightly browned.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 jar sliced pimientos | 1 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Place the peppers and lettuce on a baking sheet. In a small bowl, stir together the ground luncheon meat and the pimiento slices. Spread onto the vegetables. Cover and bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until pimentos are hot and lettuce is tender.

title: Apple Refresher Barbecue Beans
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans | 1 cup double cream | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 cup sliced apple ( your favourite )
instructions: Serve apple slices on the side. Keep refregerating until ready to serve. This can be done up to an hour ahead of time and refrigerated, covered. Combine apple juice and cream in large pan, on med high heat. Pour apple cream mixture over beans. Cook for 2 minutes without breaking. If top begins to bubble, cover and cook 2 minutes. Serve beans topped with apple slices.

title: Beef Brisket and Corn Niblets (Australian)
ingredients: 4 lbs corned beef brisket | 1 can chicken wings | 1 package frozen corn niblets | 2 cups icing sugar | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: Put the brisket in a 6 quart dutch oven and cover with water. Bake at 325 degrees f for 2 hours, remove meat from liquid and reserve liquid. Turn meat over and pour off the water. Place in a large bowl, cover and refrigerate. Shred the meat and reserve liquid. Chop or tear the corned beef into bite size pieces and return the meat, along with 1 cup of the corn, the chicken wings and 1 cup of remaining liquid. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. The corned beef can now be frozen and kept frozen on the counter for 20 days, if frozen. The next day, place the corn niblets in a medium saucepan and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook for about 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse well under cold water and drain again. Transfer to a bowl, add the icing sugar and buttermilk, and stir well. Add this to the corned beef and corn mixture, stirring just until thoroughly mixed. Cover and chill for at least 2 days or overnight. Bring to room temperature and serve with bread.

title: Prawn and Potato Curry
ingredients: 1 kg peeled prawns, shelled and with shells on | 300 g thai curry paste | 500 g red bliss potatoes, peeled, halved lengthways | 1/3 cup saffron, soaked in | 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Marinate the prawns in the thai curry paste. Marinate for at least an hour in the fridge. Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Bake the prawns on a tray on a high oven shelf for about 40 mins or until cooked. Shred the prawns coarsely. Serve with the potatoes.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,pie shell,black sesame seed,currant,french green bean
title: Pasteles de Commercy
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs french style green beans, ends trimmed | 2 -3 medium spanish onions, peeled and cut into chunks ( approx 4-5 inches in diameter ) | 1 1/2 lbs frozen pitted currants or 1 1/2 lbs raisins | 1 cup black sesame seeds | 0.5 unbaked pie shell
instructions: Note, you can also use fresh green beans or beans, if you have them, but i prefer to cook green beans whole first. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add salt if desired. Add the green beans and cook until tender, about 8 - 10 minutes. Drain and reserve. Meanwhile, peel the onions. Slice the bottom layer off a 4 - 5 - 6 head end of the beans, removing the seeds if you prefer, but leaving enough to make a nest later. Place the remaining beans into a medium skillet or dutch oven over medium heat until warmed through but not hot, stirring occasionally. Stir in the currants and sesame seeds. Remove the beans from the heat and allow to sit until cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes. You don't want them so soft you can handle easily. The filling should be just about hot enough to make your filling fluffy but not runny. The filling should not be too soft to stuff once it is cooled enough and holds their shape. Remove the seeds from the bean nest and discard. Fill the pie shell the rest of the way with the filling and add a little warm water or water. Cover partially with foil and bake in a 400 degree f oven for about 20 minutes, or until heated through. Allow 2 crusts for each serving, then cut a slit in the top layer to see if it is partially baked. These are nice served with whipped cream or yogurt if not available.

title: French Herbs & Wine
ingredients: 1 bottle good quality white wine or ( 750 ml ) bottle ale, chilled according to packet instructions | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs ( cilantro, oregano, rosemary, basil, etc. ) | onion salt, to taste
instructions: Stir the wine into the lemon/oil combination. Stir in the herbs and lemon zest. Cover, place in a cool dark place for 1 - 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat, place in a bowl and allow to cool. Serve at room temperature with poultry entree or bread crumbs.

title: Lime and Citrus Velveeta
ingredients: 1 lemon, washed and thinly sliced | 1/2 lime, juice of | 2 lbs velveeta cheese | orange slice
instructions: Mix up together lemon and lime in small bowl, add cheese and mix together. Cut a thin slice off top of velveeta, cut into 3/4 cubes. Place in wide frying pan and cook on low about 20 min's or until cheese is melted and bubbly. Strain and pour cheese into dish with lemon and lime mixture. Top with orange slices to garnish.

title: Mushroom Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1/2 cup mushroom, sliced thin | 2 tablespoons walnuts, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh dill pickle, chopped | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup butter | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/4 cup vegetable broth
instructions: In a bowl combine beef mince, mushrooms, walnuts, dill pickle, oil and 1/4 cup or a little water. Shape into 4 patties, about the same size as your burgers. Broil burger 4 inches from heat for 5 minutes on each side or until no longer pink. Brush cut sides of burger with a little melted butter or oil. Serve on hot buns. If desired you can also broil them a little on the grill, about 3 - 5 minutes each side, or a little longer depending on thickness of burger. Great served with maple sauce, lettuce.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon cube,poblano pepper,paprika,lime wedge,rice wine vinegar,kaffir lime leaf
title: Kaffir Lime Colados
ingredients: 1 paprika | 1/2 vegetable bouillon cube, such as knorr | 1 lime wedge | 3 kaffir lime leaves, finely cut, rinsed | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 small poblano pepper, deseeded and finely diced
instructions: Place the paprika in a mortar and pound with the vegetable bouillon cube until finely crushed. Stir in the remaining lime wedge, lime rind, rice wine vinegar and poblano. Serve at once by pouring the Colados into small glasses.

title: Prosciutto Del Diablo
ingredients: 1 sprig thyme | 1 1/2 - 3 lbs prosciutto | 1 1/4 cups coffee powder
instructions: Cut the prosciutto into thin slices by holding it over a bowl or dropping the pieces into a food processor. Heat the coffee until almost boiling and pour it into a shallow pot over the prosciutto. Place a damp cloth onto the prosciutto and let it sit for 10 minutes. Roll the prosciutto slices around the coffee until it is saturated. Wrap the garlic around the drip in your drip. Let the whiskey come to a boil. As the whiskey begins to boil, add the coffee to your whiskey. When it's at a boil, add the prosciutto slices. Let sit for 10 minutes or more, then pour.

title: Guacamole Copycat Recipe(Vegan)
ingredients: 4 ripe avocados | butter-flavored cooking spray
instructions: Cut the avocados in half lengthwise through the pit. Remove the pit, and scoop out the flesh into a large mixing bowl. Use your hands to squeeze the avocado pulp as you scoop up the flesh. You should now have a pulp that resembles mashed potatoes with chunks. Spray a skillet with cooking spray. Place over medium heat. Slice the avocados in half lengthwise, and remove the pit. Cut the scooped avocado pulp into 1/4 inch pieces. Spray the pan with cooking spray. Place the avocado pieces in the pan. Cook until lightly brown on the edges, then flip over. Cook on the other side until lightly browned. Transfer the chunks to serving plates, and drizzle with the banana and butter mixture.

Random Ingredients: pea,red pepper,turmeric,french onion soup mix,ice cube,cooking oil,lamb
title: Budget Stove Top Lamb Stew
ingredients: 8 -10 stewing lamb, cut into approximately 1 inch cubes | 2 cups french onion soup mix | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 tablespoon pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 liter of thick oil or 1 liter frying oil | 6 ice cubes
instructions: Add enough oil or oil to just cover the lamb cubes on top of the stock or saucer. Saute the lamb about 10 minutes or until golden brown on all sides in hot oil or in a heavy bottomed casserole dish. Add remaining ingredients to the dish and mix well, cover and allow to simmer in its own juices for 2 hours or more. The beef should be falling off the bone when cooking.

title: Linguine With Coriander and Chillies
ingredients: 400 g linguine | 500 g bacon, strips | 2 tablespoons coriander powder | 4 garlic cloves, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon margarine | 4 red chilies, finely chopped
instructions: Cook the linguine in a large saucepan of boiling water for 8 - 10 mins or until al dente. Meanwhile, fry bacon and chillies in a dry frying pan for 6 - 8 mins or until golden brown. Add garlic and mix well, cook for 2 - 3 mins. Drain pasta and add to saucepan. Whilst boiling, add margarine and coriander and mix well. Add chillies and stir, then add linguine and toss thoroughly. Serve straight away.

title: Sauce for Chicken Italiano
ingredients: 1 can marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons white sugar ( optional )
instructions: Boil marinara sauce in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add sugar.

title: Grenadine Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 1/4 teaspoon salt-free garlic and herb seasoning
instructions: Rinse your rice according to package directions. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. When your rice is done, add all of the ingredients to a large mixing bowl. Mix well. Pour the mixture into two well buttered oven safe oven safe baking dishes. Bake at 200 degrees f for 10 minutes or until the couscous is dry and the edges of the couscous begin to look golden. Enjoy.

title: Basic Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for double-crust chicken, for each person | 1 can chicken stock | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºc. Pour the chicken stock into the crockpot, add thyme. Add ovenproof roasting pan to the oven, and cook for 4 hours. Transfer the chicken to a carving platter, cover loosely with foil, and keep warm in a low oven. Increase the oven temperature to 220ºc and cook for a further 15 minutes, then tip the chicken into a serving dish. Reduce the stock by 50%, then pour into a gravy boat. Serve over cooked, sliced potatoes.

title: Ajeenar (Ethiopian Spice Paste)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground mixed spice ( berberi, cumin, paprika, etc. ) | 1/2 tablespoon garlic paste ( hsiobshi or shiraz )
instructions: Mix together the ground mixed spice with the garlic paste. Store the paste in airtight jars in a cool dry place and use. Will keep up to a year.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,sherry wine,banana,baby spinach leaf,kaffir lime leaf,nutmeg,olive
title: Mulled Chocolate & Caramelised Tofu With Vegetables
ingredients: 180 g dark chocolate, chopped | 3 -4 kaffir lime leaves ( see notes ) | 4 kaffir lime leaves, extra | 2 cans chopped mixed salad vegetables ( such as aubergines, courgettes and tomatoes ) | 90 g sliced ripe olives, drained | 4 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 nutmeg, grated | 100 g baby spinach leaves
instructions: Place a double layer of dampened cheesecloth over a large, shallow pan. Line the paper with reynolds wrap and top with 2 tbsp of melted chocolate. Add kaffir limes, lime leaves, salad vegetables, olives and any other trimmings to the pan. Shake the pan really well to combine everything and set aside to cool. Cut 2 x 2cm strips off the top of each serving and scoop out the pulp with a melonballer or small spoon before rolling. Place each round on the cheesecloth and roll up. Cover the ends with tin foil, pressing it snugly as you can and leave the wrapped tofu rolls in there. Chill covered for 30 minutes. When ready to serve, remove the tofu rolls from the fridge and unwrap. Place the baby spinach leaves on 4 dinner plates. Cut the remaining 2 strips of chocolate into pieces and scatter over the spinach leaves. Heat a heavy based frypan over medium heat, add the extra melted chocolate and stir until melted and smooth. Remove pan from heat and add to serving bowls and sprinkle with nutmeg. Serve with a wedge of lime.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,guava,brandy,baking soda,red potato,tomato,golden mushroom soup
title: Guava and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 package dried guava, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 medium red potatoes, thinly sliced | 3 tomatoes, diced | 1 cup canned tomato soup, undiluted | 1 cup long grain white rice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can diced tomatoes, undrained | 1/3 cup brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place guava pieces in a single layer on a 13 in. X 9 in. X 2 in. Baking dish or baking sheet and bake, covered tightly with foil, for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand, covered, 5 minutes. Meanwhile, arrange potatoes over 1/2 inch of boiling water and cook, uncovered, 10 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and set aside. Increase oven temperature to 400°f. Combine sauteed guava, potatoes, tomatoes, soup, rice, soda and tomatoes in a large bowl. Spread half of mixture in the bottom of a 13 in. X 9 in. X 2 in. Baking dish. Add guava mixture and brandy and stir to combine. Bake, covered, 15 minutes or until heated through and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,brussels sprout,sage,seasoning,sun tomato oil,cotija cheese,dark soy sauce,rice wine
title: Yogurt with Fried Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu ( pressed through a press-packed paper towel ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( or hoisin sauce ) | 3 -4 cups brussels sprouts, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese ( optional ) | any seasoning, such as paprika, granulated garlic | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons extra firm tofu, pressed ( optional )
instructions: Dice tofu into 1 1/2 inch squares and place on cutting board. With a vegetable peeler, remove rind from sun dried tomatoes and cut into 1/3 inch slices. Heat wok over high heat until hot. Add 1 tablespoon of the oil and swirl to coat. Add half of the sprouts and stir fry for 1 minute. Add remaining sprouts and continue to stir fry for 1 minute. Add tofu, breaking up tofu with back of spoon. Add soy sauce. Stir fry for 3 - 5 minutes until sprouts are limp. Add rice wine, sage, and cotija, if using. Stir fry for 1 minute. Transfer to platter and sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil across top. Serve hot or cold.

title: Ancho Chile Arroz
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup arborio rice, or other short-grain rice, such as arborio | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder ( optional )
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat until the oil shimmers, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the rice. Season with the ancho chile powder and stir until the rice grains release their fragrance, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,beef tenderloin,spaghetti sauce,bean sprout,cream cheese
title: Beef Tenderloin Rollups
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 16 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: Place tenderloin on a cutting board, and pound with a meat mallet or a rolling pin or your preferred method. Spread cream cheese over the beef, and let stand, at least 15 minutes. Spread some of the spaghetti sauce over the top, and spread bean sprouts over the cream cheese. Starting at the narrow end, roll the meat like a jelly roll. Cut into 1/2 inch slices before serving.

title: Sesame Meatballs
ingredients: 1 package ground meat | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Mix ground meat with sesame oil and turmeric.

title: Green Chili Pork Ribs
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs country-style pork ribs | 4 cans green enchilada sauce ( i prefer hot ) | 6 -12 cans enchilada sauce ( i prefer la victoria and green enchilada sauce )
instructions: Bag and place in crockpot. Add 1 can of enchilada sauce. Cook for about 2 hours on low.. Remove ribs, shred meat, and stir in remaining enchilada sauce. Heat thru, then serve over white rice and garnish as desired. Makes a wonderful burritos or serve with mexican style beans. Note, i usually add red onion, green pepper, cilantro, and tomatoes while shredding. I usually do not add salt at all but it has been suggested to add that additional element of flavor for some. Note, this can be eaten as is, or topped with shredded lettuce, enchilada sauce, black beans, sliced cheese, or as is, or topped with sour cream, sour cream, jalapeno slices, etc.

title: Tunisian Style Potato and Coriander Potatoes
ingredients: 5 yukon gold potatoes | 2 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c line a baking tray with baking paper. Peel and thinly slice potatoes. Add potatoes to a large bowl and coat with coriander and toss to combine. Transfer to the tray and bake for 30 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Serve hot with dips. Variations you can add blackcurrant to the potato mix, sprinkle 1/2 tsp black pepper onto the potatoes and toss before adding currants serve with plain yogurt for a greek style snack.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,coriander seed,mirin,marjoram leaf,skirt steak,russet potato,oyster sauce,seasoning salt
title: Beef Stir Fry With Crisp Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak | 1 1/2 tablespoons cilantro marjoram leaves | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 lb russet potato | 1/2 cup mirin or 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon tobiko oyster sauce, as needed | 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese, as needed
instructions: Heat a large nonstick wok or nonstick skillet over high heat. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the marjoram, coriander and seasoned salt and add the beef. Stir fry 30 seconds. Remove beef and set aside. In another nonstick wok or skillet, heat the oil over moderately high heat until a deep fry thermometer registers 125 degrees f or until oil just touches the surface of the beef. Meanwhile, in a small bowl combine the potatoes, mirin, oyster sauce, and 1/4 cup water. Stir fry the beef over moderately high heat until cooked to desired doneness, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain the beef on a cutting board and divide among four dinner plate. Top with the potato mixture. Sprinkle the cheese over the potato mixture and serve immediately.

title: Chicken and Rocket Salad
ingredients: 300 g thick white rice | 250 g rocket | 2 chicken breasts, cubed | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 tablespoon pistachios, chopped
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water, until just tender. Rinse rice and set aside to cool. Chop rocket, cook chicken in a pan, covered, in a separate pan with 1 tablespoon lime zest, stirring until cooked through. When cool, shred chicken using a fork. Place cooked rice in a bowl. Add chicken and rocket to rice. Sprinkle with pistachios. Serve.

title: Chicken Breasts with Saffron (Mutabbal
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into 5 pieces | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, ground
instructions: Combine the turkey with the turmeric and leave to marinate in the fridge overnight. Place the chicken in the pot with 2 qt of water and bring to the boil. Then reduce the heat, cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Uncover the pot, stir the fish, cover again and cook for 15 minutes longer. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,cocoa powder,kielbasa,tarragon,kosher salt,new york strip steak,cream mushroom soup,brandy
title: Crock Pot Swiss Steak and Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package sliced fresh bratwursts, thawed or ( 12 ounce ) package frozen bratwursts, thawed | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup reduced-fat sour cream | 1 cup crumbled kielbasa, divided | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon, crushed | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Combine cream of mushroom soup, sour cream, kielbasa, cocoa, tarragon, salt, and brandy in crock pot. Stir in bratwurst.

title: Passover Matzo (Passover Beef Soup)
ingredients: 2 cups matzo, uncooked, cut in 4 slices
instructions: Line a colander with cheese cloth and put into the sink. Place one piece of matzo in the cheese cloth and squeeze out excess moisture. Spread the matzo on the plastic wrap and press lightly into the cheese cloth to prevent it from getting soggy. Repeat with the remaining matzo. Bring 6 cups of water to a boil and add matzo. Cook 5 to 7 minutes or until matzo is tender. Serve hot.

title: Spanish Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 200 g refried beans | 1 teaspoon grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 pinch turmeric | 1 pinch chili flakes | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: First, put the sugar and olive oil into the grill or a frying pan and place the pan on high heat. When the sugar is bubbling and turning brown and tan, flip the pork.

title: Swiss Chard
ingredients: 3 cups packed fresh swiss chard | 1/2 cup sliced almonds ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons pure almond extract | 2 cups chopped turnips | 12 fresh basil leaves
instructions: Chop greens small or coarsely grate them. Combine swiss chard, almonds and almond extract. Add turnips and basil. Refrigerate until needed.

title: Kitchen Kouture - Seasoned Salt for Salted Fish & Chips
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( msg ) | 1 large pinch dried fenugreek leaves | 1 lime wedge
instructions: In a small bowl, combine gurkure powder, fenugreek leaves, and lime wedge. Sprinkle with monosodium glutamate and mix to coat. If fish is salted, break into pieces before coating. Allow to sit at room temperature, covered, for 10 minutes at least, and up to 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: cream,dijon mustard,corn tortilla chip,grape tomato,sauce,wood ear mushroom
title: Beef & Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks or 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1 package corn tortilla chips | 1 jar grape tomatoes, quartered | 1 can wood ear mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup light sour cream | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/2 cup prepared hot sauce
instructions: Trim fat from steak.

title: Wild Duck Salad
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons water chestnut, finely chopped | 1/3 cup leek, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 2 ounces mixed dried fruit, finely chopped
instructions: Combine mayonnaise sauce, water chestnuts, leeks and bouillon in medium bowl.

title: Salsa-Rific Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup salsa | 1 ounce caster sugar | 1/3 cup broccoli floret | 1/3 teaspoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Leave overnight or longer. If you want to serve them later, store in an airtight container.

title: The Broccolini
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh broccoli florets | 1 1/2 fluid ounces tequila | 2 dried red chilies | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon sparkling water | 4 sheets nori | 5 tablespoons boiling water
instructions: Wash or steam the broccoli until tender, about 15 minutes. Slice into flowers and arrange on a serving dish. Combine the remaining ingredients and pour over the broccoli and toss.

title: Easy Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 10 1/2 ounces taco sauce with green chile peppers | 1 packet dry fajita seasoning mix
instructions: Combine taco sauce, fajita seasoning mix, and water.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,kalamata olive,tomato,fish sauce,white wine vinegar,chinese egg noodle,vanilla essence
title: Thai Noodles
ingredients: 400 g small dried chinese egg noodles | 1 -2 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 medium tomatoes, seeded and finely chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | kalamata olive, halved
instructions: Bring a pot of water to the boil and add the noodles. Leave them for 4 to 5 minutes until the water starts to boil. Drain well in a colander, then shake very well to remove any bits that are stuck to the base. Place in a large bowl and set aside. Mix together the tomato, vinegar, fish sauce and vanilla essence in a small bowl. Toss through the noodles, ensuring all are coated. Divide among 4 salad bowls, top with olives and serve with plain steamed rice.

title: Spicy Tofu Bake
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 1/2 cup raw unsalted cheese | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water | 1 pinch clear honey | freshly grated cheese ( optional ) | topping, of choice ( optional )
instructions: Put the tofu and its excess water in a food processor and process, stopping occasionally, until the mixture resembles an oily paste. Add the sugar, grated cheese, orange blossom water, and salt and process until smooth. Place the tofu mixture in a casserole dish and spread it out to cover the tofu with thin layer film of cheese. Pour over the honey and sprinkle with a bit of the crumbly cheese. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°c/ 400°f for 15 minutes or until golden. Serve immediately, cut into squares and drizzling with extra honey, if desired.

title: Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bone-in skinless chicken thighs ( about 3 large thighs ) | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/2 cup cashews, plus | 1 tablespoon cashews, for garnish
instructions: Place the chicken thighs in a 5 by 5 by 1/2 inch rimmed baking dish, and sprinkle with the salt. In a bowl, thoroughly whisk the cream, cream, and seasoning salt. Add the cashews to the chicken, and toss to coat them. Transfer the chicken to the oven, and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove the chicken to a serving platter. Pour the sauce over it, sprinkle with remaining cashews, and serve. This dish can be made up to 3 days ahead of serving.

title: Blueberry Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 cans blueberries | 2 scallions, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme sprigs | 1/4 cup chopped kalamata olives | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | ground black pepper to taste | 7 ounces uncooked spaghetti, broken into thirds
instructions: Place the blueberries, scallions, thyme, kalamata olives, and ginger in a food processor. Blend until the mixture is a smooth consistency. Season with pepper. Place the broken spaghetti in a large pot of lightly salted, boiling water. Cook until the pasta is al dente, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coconut pecan frosting,garlic powder,pepperoncini pepper,cardamom seed,guacamole
title: Coconut Pepperoni Spread
ingredients: 6 ounces guacamole | 8 ounces pepperoncini peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 cup coconut pecan frosting | 3 dashes garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Mix all together. Keep refrigerated until serving.

title: Sausage and Cherry Pasta
ingredients: 8 links sweet italian sausage, sliced | 1 package hot roll-shaped frozen peppers or ( 7 ounce ) package yellow hot roll-shaped frozen peppers, thawed ( 8 ounces ) | 1 jar barbecue sauce | 1 1/2 lbs penne pasta | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons veggie oil | 1/4 cup prepared yellow mustard
instructions: Cook sausage until browned on outside. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. To pan, add meat, bell peppers, barbecue sauce and mustard.

title: Tortilla Crisps
ingredients: 1 small onion, quartered | 1 cup toasted pecans | 1 bag round roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. Place onion and pecans onto parchment paper line cookie sheet or parchment paper. Cut a 1 1/4 inch wide strip off top of roll. With sharp knife, cut slice roll into 5 wedges. Arrange wedges on cookie sheet, and bake for 4 minutes, or until lightly browned, and onions are soft. Remove from oven, and spread pecan mix evenly on top of roll. Return to oven for one more minute. Sprinkle on more pecan mix, if desired. Let cool 10 minutes, then break apart with fork.

title: Manicotti With Strawberry and Cardamom Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces marinated plain sliced strawberries | 1 lb fresh manicotti | 1/2 cup uncooked long grain rice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 3/4 cup boiling water | 1 loaf italian bread, sliced in 1/2 inch thick slices
instructions: Saute' noodles until lightly browned. Drain. Rinse and drain. Set aside. Combine sliced strawberries and rice. Mix well, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. Preheat broiler. Arrange half of the noodles in a greased 13x9 in. Pan. Arrange manicotti in same manner.

title: Strawberries in Chili Oil (Yoshinoya)
ingredients: fresh strawberries, washed, dried and sliced | 2 teaspoons tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon sake | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon graham cracker ( to taste )
instructions: Rinse the strawberries and remove the hulls. Mix the tarragon through the lemon juice. Spoon the oil with the strawberry and tarragon mixture into small bowls and decorate with a few crumbled graham crackers if you like.

title: Lard Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon | 1/4 cup lard
instructions: Wash salmon, remove the pin bones and all visible skin from the outside. Slice into 3 equal size pieces. In a large frying pan melt the lard, then brown the salmon on all sides. Remove and set aside on paper towels so you don't get soggy. Remove all your bacon fat from the smoking pan with your fingers, then place in your hand and place your hand under the skin to make you clean the grease well. Put the salmon back in the pan. With the grease at your finger press out the juices then add more fat. Turn the heat up and put the lid back on the pan. Cook for around 10 minutes or until the salmon is cooked but not hard. Serve hot, straight from the pan with a potato masher.

title: Grilled Lobster With Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lobster, shelled ( fresh or frozen and thawed ) | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts ( salted, husk or dried )
instructions: Cut the lobster shells from the head to expose the meat, leaving the heads intact. If using fresh claws, clean the outer shells and clean the rind off thoroughly. Rinse the meat and pierce each clam skin or fish piece with a sharp knife several times. Set aside. Soak the peanuts, covered, in water for 30 minutes to 1 hour, until softened. Remove the peanuts from the water, place on a paper towel, and pat dry. Put the peanuts on a flat surface, on a large frying pan or griddle. Preheat the broiler. Cut a wedge out of the shell to use for dipping in the dipping sauce, this goes quickly. Drop the lobsters into a saucepan of warm water and cover. Cook, covered, for about 1 hour, or until the meat is tender and the tails curl from the shell. Carefully remove the lobsters from the water, transfer them to a serving dish, and serve them with the peanut dipping sauce.

title: Chile Paste
ingredients: 32 dried hot serrano chili peppers | 1 tablespoon cayenne
instructions: Make a double slit along stem end of each chili pepper and place a small piece of cayenne pepper in each slit, making each piece about 3 inches long at the stem end of the chili pepper and about 3 inches apart. Place a paper towel between the 2 chile peppers to help them sweat. Place the chili peppers in a bowl and sprinkle with a little of the cooking oil and the salt. Gather the sides of the chili peppers and press down using a towel. Place the chilies in a nonstick pan with water to cover, and bring to the boil. Turn down heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. When cool, transfer the chilies and the cooking oil to a food processor or blender, and give them a whir until the paste is pureed. Strain through a fine or clean paper bag, pressing in a few dryened seeds as you go to get a smooth paste. Store in an airtight container.

title: Spafe Spanish Coffee ( Espresso Blanco)
ingredients: 4 green cardamom pods, crushed | 3 tablespoons brewed espresso coffee | 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso-flavored coffee
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the espresso and brewed espresso coffee. Let stand for 10 minutes. Pour into a coffee filter fitted with a fine mesh tube and filter into cups, or a coffee maker. Float a card on the top of each cup and serve.

title: Homemade Salt
ingredients: 2 teaspoons anchovy fillets | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Mix together the anchovies and allspice. Transfer to an air tight container and store for up to 2 months.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces pasta, of choice | 1/2 cup peas ( frozen or fresh ) | 1/4 cup pico de gallo ( see below ) | 1/4 cup kidney bean ( see below ) | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 ounce semisweet chocolate | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing
instructions: Note that these measurements are approximate. Add the peas to the pasta and allow to thaw/mash the beans slightly before adding the next ingredient. Chop the cinnamon stick and grate the chocolate. Shake the dressing ingredients together and pour over the pasta mixture. Cook pasta until tender. Add chopped, cooled, and flamed peas. Sprinkle with cinnamon stick and serve.

Random Ingredients: lentil,purpose flour,sparkling water,french bread,chipotle chile adobo,pork tenderloin
title: Chipotle Crock Pot Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry lentils ( about 15 ounces ) | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup finely chopped chipotle chile in adobo, from can of chipotles in adobo plus 1/4 cup of sauce ( from a can ) | 1 1/2 lbs bone-in pork tenderloin, cut into 4 serving-size pieces | 10 1/2 ounces french bread, crusts removed | hot tap water
instructions: Combine lentils, flour and chiles in a bowl. Add pork and turn to coat. Arrange pork in crock pot. Top with bread slices. Pour garlic chipotle sauce over all.

title: Souvlakia (Spicy Ethiopian Spice Mix)
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground almonds | 4 1/2 cups finely crushed pepperoncini peppers, drained | 8 1/2 ounces sherry wine vinegar with anchovies, oil-packed
instructions: Combine almonds and peppers and roll into 1/2 x 3/4 inch sticks. Roll meat sticks in 1/2 cup sherry vinegar.

title: Vietnamese Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin or 2 lbs rib eye steaks | 1 jar sliced fresh sweet pimento | 1/2 cup red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh galangal or 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley | 1 bottle premium quality vodka
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise in half and pound each half to 1/4 inch thickness using mallet or rolling pin. Cut steaks into three equal halves and slice across the grain. Transfer to a shallow glass dish, cover and refrigerate. In a food processor or blender jar, place sweet pimentos, red pepper flakes, and 2 tablespoons of chopped galangal or cilantro. Blend until smooth. To taste, stir in vodka. Pour over meat, cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. About 5 hours before serving, drain marinade from meat and discard. Preheat grill to high heat. Oil hot grill grate. Place meat halves on greased grates or on soaked or wooded grill and cook, turning once, until desired doneness, painting grill with juice when finished, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,picante sauce,red chile powder,oregano leaf,chevre goat cheese,tuna,ginger garlic paste
title: Moroccan-Spiced Tuna
ingredients: 3 cans tuna | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons red chile powder | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1 1/2 pounds chevre goat cheese
instructions: Drain the tuna, reserving liquid, and combine with the picante sauce, ginger garlic paste, chili powder, oregano, and rosemary in a large bowl. Grate the chevre goat cheese into the liquid, and stir until the cheese has absorbed the flavor, 2 to 3 minutes. Chill the sauce overnight in the refrigerator to allow the flavors to blend. Serve the chilled chevre sauce on the side to dip sandwiches.

title: Polish Sausages
ingredients: 300 g polish sausage | 3 tablespoons date, pitted and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 cups dates, pitted and chopped | 2 tablespoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon bacon or 1 teaspoon bacon fat, melted
instructions: Combine the sausage, dates, garlic, bacon/pork fat in a large non stick pan over low to medium heat. Cook stirring frequently for about 20 minutes or until the sausage and dates have softened and meat is cooked through. Remove the pan from the heat. Allow sausage mixture to cool in the pan. Discard any un used sausage and dates before storing in the refrigerator.

title: Chili Cheese (Portokalária)
ingredients: 20 olives, pitted and sliced | 1/2 cup port wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour olive oil in a pan. Cook olives over medium heat until the olives are golden, being careful not to burn them. Add port and chili powder. Remove from heat, stirring frequently, to blend.

title: Baked Cod With Soy Rice
ingredients: 200 g cod | 1 tablespoon rice | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Cut the skin off the cod and rinse well under cold water. Put in a baking dish with the skin side up. Sprinkle rice on cod and cover with plastic wrap about ¾” on it. Bake 30 minutes in a 375f degree oven or until cooked through. Serve sprinkled with soy sauce.

title: Makrout - Algerian Peanut Stew - Rice Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry unsweetened coconut | 2 cups fresh roasted peanuts | 1 cup crushed dried orange rind | 2 cups vanilla ice cream | 4 saffron threads, lightly crushed | 1/4 cup cornflour
instructions: In a cereal bowl, combine all the ingredients, except the cornflour, and mix well. Coat a non stick frypan with oil and set to medium setting. Carefully form the mixture into balls and brown on all sides. Using a slotted spoon, remove the balls from the pan and place on a plate. To serve, serve with plain creme fraiche or vanilla yogurt.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,red chili sauce,lentil,granny smith apple,herb
title: Easy Mexican Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb lentils | 2 ounces chorizo sausage | 4 granny smith apples, peeled, cored, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs | 2/3 cup red chili sauce
instructions: Fry chorizo and apples in a little olive oil over medium high heat until golden. Add lentils, sugar, herbs, and other ingredients. When lentils are soft, remove from heat and transfer to a crockpot. Serve hot.

title: Vanilla Pizzelles
ingredients: 400 g tomato puree | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all together. Pour into small ovenproof jug, or 2 tall oven dish dishes lined with baking paper to form pints. Bake at 150c for 60 minutes.

title: Pimiento-Bacon Bits
ingredients: 4 slices uncooked bacon, cut into bite-size bits | 1 jar pimientos, chopped packed in juice | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place bacon bits into a medium baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until crisp, about 10 minutes. Remove bacon from oven and drain on a paper towel lined plate. Stir pimentos into the bacon drippings and add baking soda. Continue cooking until heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Pea Pods With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 lb pea pods
instructions: In a small saucepan, simmer the grand marnier in the worcestershire sauce until very very thick, about 15 minutes. Add the pea pods and simmer until very tender, about 10 minutes more. Serve immediately.

title: Lamb and Pita Bread With Ouzo & Ginger Yogurt
ingredients: 100 g of good quality greek yogurt | 100 g lamb | 1/2 teaspoon ouzo or 1/2 teaspoon yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon ginger paste ( or 1/4 tsp other dried ginger ) | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 medium pita bread, cut into 2 triangles | 1 lemon
instructions: Cut the lamb lamb into 1cm long chunks & slice the halves across the grain into thin strips. The pieces of meat should be roughly 5 cm wide & be about the same thickness as a finger tip or so. Cut the yogurt into 1/3 & then mix it with the lamb and spices. Chill in the fridge for about an hour. Preheat the oven to 200c/170c fan forced. Line the pita bread triangles w/foil. Place the lamb and yogurt in a shallow, ovenproof dish. Dribble on about 1/3 of the oil the lemon zest & toss in. Squeeze the lemon juice, but don't throw out all the flavor. Put the pita breads on a tray & bake for 15mins, or up to 30 mins, or until crisp. Eat with a scoop of yoghurt, drizzled with a little extra ouzo or sesame oil.

title: Spicy Bok Choy Wedges
ingredients: 2 bunches bok choy, trimmed | 1 cup plain flour | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 2 limes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c. To make the pastry, place the bok choy in a large roasting tin and place in the oven. Turn every so often. When all the bok choy has been roasting, heat a griddle pan to medium heat and turn the griddle pan so that the griddle stays hot. Using a pastry brush, mix the flour and sugar together in a bowl and then divide the mixture in half. Dived the flour and sugar mixture evenly amongst the bok choy halves. Pour the juice of the limes half over the bok choy, season with salt and place on the grill to cook. Turn once during cooking to brown on the edges.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,picante sauce,chinese five spice powder
title: Spicy Steak Rub
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chinese five-spice powder | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns | 1 cup picante sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Rub onto steak and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,sherry wine,cake flour,cream celery soup,corn niblets
title: Quick Creamy Chicken With Celery
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 1/4 cups cake flour ( not self-rising ) | 1 cup chopped celery ( not self-raising ) | 2 cans corn niblets, drained ( reserve 2/3 cup juice for gravy )
instructions: Place soup, wine, flour and celery in the bowl of a stand mixer. Mix until it forms a dough. You may not need all the flour, this is just an estimate on the amount of flour needed. Fold in corn juice and remove from the batter. You will need to do more than this once. Let rest a few minutes and divide into 3 balls. Use cookie scoop to flatten the dough into rounds about 1/2 inch thick. Use a knife to dip all 3 round side. Cook in a deep fryer or a lint free skillet that has been sprayed with cooking oil. They get done in about 5 minutes on each side, although it can be eaten after they are heated up and are quite crispy, if served hot. Drain well on paper towels and serve with celery gravy.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,asafoetida powder,cremini mushroom,jalapeno juice,ancho chili,beef bouillon cube,lemon juice zest,beef
title: Crock Pot  Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, cut into small bite sized pieces | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1 large beef bouillon cube | 4 -5 dried ancho chili, seeded and sliced diagonally into 1/2 - 3/4 pieces ( to taste ) | 4 -5 fresh cremini mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, to taste | 1 teaspoon jalapeno juice, to taste | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground ancho chili
instructions: Put all ingredients in your crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours until meat is tender.

title: Sweet and Creamy French Salad Sandwich
ingredients: 3 large french bread, loaf | 3 tablespoons honey | 6 leaves fresh french dressing or 6 leaves fresh salad dressing
instructions: Cut french bread into 4 equal pieces, then place on a wire rack until needed. Remove stems from lettuce. Using 2 forks, pull the leaves into a bowl of cold water. Using the back of a spoon, squeeze the lettuce leaves with the water until they are limp. Reserve. Cut the bread into thin slices or chunks. Pour 1 tbsp of the honey into a bowl. Dip bread slices into warm honey for a minute or two on each side, until the slices are nicely toasted, but not soggy. Fill a large bowl with cold water, and place the french toast slices on top of it. Dip a lettuce leaf into the hot honey, then gently squeeze out excess. Arrange lettuce in a circular design atop each of the sandwiches. Serve at once.

title: Spinach and Cilantro Soup
ingredients: 1 can nonfat beef broth | 1 bunch fresh cilantro | 1 package fresh spinach, washed, chopped
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions, and drain. When cool, chop and combine everything in a large pot. Mix well. Heat and serve.

title: Squash With Tequila Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash, peeled and sliced | 2 ounces tequila | 3/4 ounce yoghurt | 1/3 ounce dark brown sugar | grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat the grill or grill pan to high. Put butternut squash into a large roasting tin. Prick holes all over with a skewer or a fork. In a small bottle, combine the remaining ingredients and shake well, until the sugar has dissolved. Pour over the squash, sprinkle with parmesan, and grill/grill for about 10 - 15 minutes, or until the squash is tender and starting to char around the edges. Serve warm. Enjoy.

title: Salsa Con Queso (Spanish Spice Mix)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon lime powder or 1 tablespoon melted margarine | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and store in airtight container. The longer the longer it keeps, the more flavorful the product. To prepare with salsa con queso, heat over heat first, add some salsa to a bowl of ice and stir until mixed.

Random Ingredients: vodka,vanilla bean,tomato green chilies,dashi,chili powder,half cream
title: The Blender
ingredients: 1 quart dashi | 3/4 cup vodka | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: In a large cooking pot put dashi and vodka and let simmer for 30 minutes. Add tomatoes and chili powder, let simmer another 20 minutes. Add half and half and vanilla bean stir well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,red curry paste,sultana,marjoram,margarine,red pepper flake,pudding,salmon fillet
title: Threesies Curried Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup sultana | 1/2 cup dried cranberry jam or 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | salt and dried marjoram or other herbs, to taste | pepper, to taste | crushed red pepper flakes, to taste | 5 ounces salmon fillets or 5 ounces salmon steaks, cut into 4 equal portions | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Place sultanas and cranberry jam in a bowl and gently toss for 5 minutes or until jam has softened slightly. Stir into mixture, season to taste with salt, pepper, crushed red chillies and grated red pepper flakes. Spoon mixture into a shallow dish or casserole. Cover and chill. In a non reactive skillet, melt margarine or oil together. Add salmon and cook over a moderate heat, turning gently, until cooked through, about 5 minutes or so. Serve salmon with jam and sultanas. Note, the salmon can be frozen, vacuum sealing in clingfilm, if desired, to use later, then reheated.

title: Bahian Clam Cocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce gin | 4 ounces scotch sonoma clam bisque or 4 ounces dry sherry | 10 fresh basil | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons crumbled dried oregano or 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon thine fresh orange basil or 1/4 teaspoon fresh italian seasoning | 2 -4 fresh basil ( for garnish ) | 6 whole whole garlic chilies
instructions: Shake with ice and strain into a cocktail shaker. Place all the ingredients except the basil in a blender jar or the serving dish and blend well. Place on bottom rack of blender and add enough ice to fill the blender just before it starts to bubble. Cover the lid and turn on high for 2 minutes. Strain through wine bottles and return to the liquor jar. Garnish with an orange or basil leaf.

title: Cheese Bread Filled With Parsley and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour | 2 slices sourdough bread or 2 slices whole wheat bread, cut into 1-inch slices, 2 x 1/4-inch sticks | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 1/3 cups coarsely chopped parsley | 1/4 teaspoon ground green pepper | 2 medium green peppers, cut lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1-inch strips
instructions: Combine 1 3/4 cups flour and nutmeg in a shallow dish or plate. Coat bread and flour generously with flour mixture. Dip in parsley and green pepper strips. Melt remaining tablespoon flour in a 9 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add bread and fry, pressing with a spatula to separate slices, until lightly golden on both sides, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer bread to a platter and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,broth,cornflour,rotel tomato chilies,white breadcrumb,dark chocolate chip,white wine vinegar
title: Mexican Tomato Chilies
ingredients: 6 medium green chilies | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil, for frying | 60 g good quality dark chocolate chips | 60 g white breadcrumbs | 1 can ro-tel diced tomatoes and chilies
instructions: Halve the chilies lengthways, seed and chop the flesh into thin strips. Place the chilies in a mixing bowl. Combine the cornflour, vinegar, oil and chilies in a small jug. Add to the chilies, stir to combine. Season, cover and refrigerate overnight. Combine the ro tel and breadcrumbs in a bowl. Preheat the oven to 180c. Dip the chilled chilies into the batter and roll them in the crumbs. Spray a non stick baking tin with cooking oil and heat the pan. Add half the chilies, reserving the remaining batter. Cook the chilies in the pan for 3 - 4 minutes on each side, until golden. Transfer the chilies onto a paper towel lined plate. Repeat until all the chilies have been cooked. Transfer the chilies to a warm oven, allow to rest for 3 minutes, sprinkle with the chocolate and cut into small pieces. Serve immediately, or transfer to an airtight container.

title: Basic Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 400 g wholemeal raw peanuts | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 cup stevia | 100 g minced parsley | 1 star anise
