instructions: Scald and rinse peanuts, drain nuts and reserve 2 tbsp liquid. Place reserved liquid and peanuts in a small container. Thoroughly dissolve yeast in remaining liquid and set aside. Combine all ingredients in a food processor. Process until smooth, then process until well blended. Place mixture into a clean, oil free plastic storage bag and add the fish sauce and the reserved peanuts. Seal bag well and store in a cool, dry place for 30 minutes or more before using. The flavour improves as it rests.

title: Chicken Poppy Seed Roll
ingredients: 1 small chicken | 24 poppy seeds
instructions: Cut up the chicken into 6 pieces. In casserole heat up the poppy seeds. Once they rise to the surface and expand coat the chicken with the poppy seeds before putting in a baking dish. Bake in 350 oven on top rack for 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked. This is delicious served with basmati rice or rice.

Random Ingredients: courgette,white pearl onion,sauce,basil,italian tomato,white wine vinegar
title: Baked Italian Vegetables
ingredients: 600 g white pearl onions | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 5 italian tomatoes, halved | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 large aubergine, peeled and chopped | 8 white pearl onions | 1 dash hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Place the white onions on a tray and sprinkle over the basil. Bake for 30 minutes, until the onions are soft and brown. Transfer to a tray. Place the tomatoes, vinegar and aubergines in a roasting tin. Place in the oven. Bake for 15 minutes. Serve warm with the aubergines and hot sauce.

title: Corn Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 1/2 cup honey or syrup | 2 1/2 cups fresh whole kernel corn or 2 1/2 cups frozen whole kernel corn, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Prepare a 2 1/2 quart baking dish by lining the bottom of the dish with parchment paper or a lightly greased baking dish, letting the paper overhang the sides of the dish. In a large bowl, stir together the flour and the honey or syrup. Add the corn and stir until well incorporated. Stir in the flour mixture, stirring to combine. Pour batter into prepared baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes. Cool in the dish for 10 minutes. Turn out onto a platter and serve warm. This could be served warm, but tastes best if refrigerated for no longer than 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,manchego cheese,cayenne pepper,mango,vegetable stock,english cucumber,green cardamom
title: Mango Manchego Cheese Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable broth, or as needed | 1 mango, halved and sliced | 1 fresh green cardamom, cut into narrow ribbons | 1/2 cup sliced english cucumber, or to taste | 1/4 cup cubed manchego cheese | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1 pinch ground cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon minced swiss-style cheese, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: almond,yellow bell pepper,mushroom,chickpea,dark brown sugar,roast beef,green olive
title: Chickpea and Roasted Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast ( bone in ) | 2 cans chickpeas ( undrained ) | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar ( packed ) | 1 jar sliced mushrooms, sliced | 2 medium yellow bell peppers ( quartered and cored ) ( optional ) | 2 cans sliced green olives, drained | 10 large stuffed olives, washed and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Place roast in baking dish. Pour undrained chickpeas over the roast. Add sugar and mix well. Sprinkle with sliced mushrooms, bell pepper, olives and green olives. Cover tightly with foil. Bake 1 1/2 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender.

title: Sweet-Grape Curry
ingredients: 1 lb small seedless grapes, or | 2 lbs thick slab bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces | 5 cups curry paste ( thai kitchen or kitchen thai kitchen curry paste )
instructions: Blanch grapes in boiling salted water for about 1 minute. Drain, transfer grapes to a bowl, add 1/2 cup curry powder and stir. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Add the bacon to the skillet, increase heat to high, and cook until evenly brown. Drain the bacon bits on a paper towel lined plate, but leave them in the skillet. Sprinkle a little curry powder over the bacon, add the remaining curry paste and bring to a boil. Pour over the grapes and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the curry is hot and thick. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,pita bread,apricot jam,english cucumber,onion powder,spinach,beef stock cube,sugar
title: Aussie Beef Tostas
ingredients: 500 g sirloin steaks, in four pieces | 1 garlic clove | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1/2 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 cup english cucumber, very finely sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh spinach, shredded | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 tablespoon raw sugar or 1 tablespoon honey | 1/2 cup beef stock cubes
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slice the steaks into four, fat side slices, then into eight thin, slivers. Combine the spice mix ingredients, and sprinkle over the meat, making sure it is well coated. Cook briefly over hot coals. Meanwhile, prepare the salad, place all of the mixed salad ingredients into a large bowl and toss with enough of the oil from the beef to coat, then cover and leave in the fridge. When ready to serve, arrange the salad on four pieces of warm bread. Spoon over half the'sauce' and sprinkle over the remaining steak slices. Serve with plain boiled rice.

title: Lobster Tails
ingredients: 1/4 cup lime juice | 5 lobster tails, shell on
instructions: Combine the lime juice and the lobster shells in a small microwave safe dish and stir to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave at high power for 3 minutes. Open the plastic carefully and spread the cooked lobster shells in the shell. Drizzle with the lime juice marinade.

title: Olive Filling for Dipping
ingredients: 1 lb nicoise olives or 1 lb other green olives | 2 cans tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons ghee ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons butter ( optional )
instructions: Soak olives in cold water, then drain and cut into halves. In a blender, combine olives, tomato sauce, brown sugar, raisins and ghee/butter and puree into a medium thick paste that is as thick as mayonnaise and chunky. Refrigerate for at least an hour. Dip your choice of food, like breadcrumbs and top with your own tomato puree.

title: Rigatoni W- Tomato-Lemon Sauce
ingredients: 5 medium tomatoes, chopped | 1 1/4 teaspoons lemon zest | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Spanish Tortilla Lasagna
ingredients: 4 pinches marinara sauce | 12 slices precooked egg whites | 2 teaspoons butter | 12 tablespoons salsa | 2 tablespoons roasted salted kale, chopped | 2 tablespoons sliced pitted kalamata olives, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brush bottom and sides of 9x13 inch glass baking dish with a small amount of melted butter. Layer 1/4 cup pasta sauce down the center of each plate with a 1/2 slice of roasted kale, 1/4 cup crumbled cooked egg white, 1/4 cup sauted marinara, 1/4 cup grated kalamata olives, 1/6 cup mozzarella cheese, and the remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Layer 1/2 more layer of tortillas over the top of the filling mixture. Spread 1/2 more of pasta sauce evenly over top of the tortillas. Using a fork, pierce tortillas with a fork, and cover dish, creating a lid. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 13 to 14 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,beef,tamari soy sauce,pork,chili paste,taco flour tortilla
title: Asian Beef Wrap- JC
ingredients: 2 ounces ground beef | 2 ounces ground pork | 1/4 ounce crushed red pepper | 1/4 cup tamari soy sauce | 1 lb tamari soy sauce | 10 inches soft taco-size flour tortillas
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f. Combine the beef and pork. Add a tablespoon of the tamari and a pinch of chili paste. Form a wrap with the meat mixture. Wrap in aluminum foil. Bake for 5 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 10 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: white wine,red curry paste,mexican oregano,egg,chili pepper flake,salt
title: Spicy Chili Pepper Bakes
ingredients: 4 -6 chili peppers or 4 -6 jalapenos, depending on taste | salt, to taste | 1 egg | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 3 -4 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano
instructions: Place chopped peppers in blender or food processor, add salt, or use your favourite seasonings. Blend until smooth and seeds are gone, about 30 seconds. Beat egg until light and frothy. Add curry paste and wine, mix well. Form into balls the size of a ping pong ball, and flatten out so it looks like a disc. Sprinkle on oregano, bake at 350f for 15 or 20 minutes, in batches if desired, or broil or pan fry them until they are browned.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,cocoa powder,garlic salt,oat,black eyed pea,baking soda,veal
title: Healthy African Peas Balls
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 4 ounces ground roasted black-eyed peas | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons dried baking soda | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f combine together all dry ingredients. Add ground veal and black eyed peas to dry ingredients and mix well. Roll into small sausage shape balls and place on parchment lined cookie sheet. Cook for 30 minutes. Cool, and store in airtight containers. These freeze well.

title: Noodles and Pork With White Beans, Peaches and Broccoli
ingredients: 4 ounces uncooked rice noodles | 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 poblano chiles, seeded, deveined and coarsely chopped | 8 ounces broccoli, chopped | 4 ounces white beans, drained | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 1 peach, peeled, pitted and sliced or 1 peach slice, halved
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package.

title: Cherry
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry coriander | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries
instructions: Grind coriander, cherries, and sieve into a bowl. Store in an airtight container.

title: Auberge Tasty Pizza With Mozzarella Cheese
ingredients: 500 g mozzarella cheese, grated | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil ( i use olive oil ) | 3 -4 tablespoons cocoa powder ( depending on if you want it sweet too spicy! ) | bouquet garni
instructions: Heat oven to 220 c/425f/gas grate the cheese into a small bowl or jug. Mix in the chili oil. Add a little cocoa to make a paste. Spread over the base of your pizza tin. Spread evenly, over 1/2 of the mozzarella and 1/2 of the sauce. Sprinkle with a little more cocoa. Place back in the oven to bake for 10 mins or until the cheese is lightly browned and bubbling. Cut into squares and serve with extra sauce.

title: Grilled Salmon in Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, cut in florets | 1/4 cup low sodium dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 ounce salmon, fresh or frozen | 2 tablespoons chopped chives
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. In medium bowl, combine soy sauce, oregano, garlic and salmon. Add broccoli and toss. Divide mixture among 4 skewers. Lightly oil grill. Place on grate, cover, and grill until cooked through, about 4 minutes.

title: Wild Mushroom Fritters With Mustard
ingredients: 500 g wild mushrooms | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour
instructions: Wash and slice mushrooms finely. Add 2 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp flour and 1 tbsp salt to mushrooms. Mix thoroughly. Place mushrooms on lightly greased tray and shape into small fritter shapes with moistened hands.

title: Lime Grilled Tortillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 12 tortillas | 2 tablespoons lime juice ( for brushing )
instructions: Lightly oil grill. Combine coconut milk and oregano. Brush both sides of each tortilla with lime juice to moisten. Grill over medium hot coals for about 1 minute or until just lightly browned. Transfer to a cutting board and slice into thin rounds.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,rice vinegar,black olive,hazelnut,yellow squash,new mexico chile powder,sesame oil
title: Pasteli Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces spaghetti | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 -2 teaspoon new mexico chile powder, to taste | 1 -2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons crushed hazelnuts, divided | 2 medium yellow squash, quartered lengthwise and cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 can large black olives ( drained well )
instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente, drain and cut into 3/4 inch chunks. Place all ingredients in a bowl. Toss well until well combined.

title: Roasted Yellow Squash
ingredients: salt and large pinch black pepper | 1 1/2 pounds yellow squash, cut into thick slices | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely minced lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with a tablespoon or so of oil. Season squash slices on both sides with salt, pepper and lemon peel. Place in the prepared pan on the lower rack of the oven and broil for about 5 minutes, or until browned and just tender.

Random Ingredients: bread,serrano chili,active yeast,large shrimp,greek olive,red enchilada sauce,margarine,cod
title: Spicy Mexican Shrimp Appetizer
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large shrimp | 1 1/2 lbs cod | olive oil, for frying | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter, melted | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce | 8 ounces greek olives, chopped | 2 -3 serrano chili, minced | 2 -3 slices country bread, sliced diagonally ( toasted or not )
instructions: Dice shrimp into 1/2 inch pieces. Combine shrimp, cod, and olive oil in large mixing bowl. Mix in yeast, then set aside. In saucepan, melt margarine or butter over medium heat. Add enchilada sauce, olives, and chilies. Heat through but do not boil. Add shrimp mixture, then stir in bread slices, covering with a light coating of sauce. Cover and set to cool to room temperature.

title: Pineapple Egg yolks
ingredients: 8 egg yolks | 5 celery ribs, chopped | pineapple chunk, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Beat egg yolks in a bowl. Dip pineapple chunks into egg yolk mixture and set aside. Fry celery in a little oil, add more oil if necessary, then remove from pan with a slotted spoon. Fry celery, stirring until browned. Add pineapple tidbits and stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes until heated through. Serve with a sprinkling of pineapples.

title: Mexican Style Chicken
ingredients: 4 -8 chicken thighs, trimmed | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, ground
instructions: Saute chicken in margarine until brown. Stir in taco seasoning and horseradish. Simmer 20 minutes over low heat or microwave on high.

title: Mexican Skillet Dinner - Skillet Beef Sirloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 slices beef sirloin | 2 3/4 cups cooked green chilies, sliced into thin rings ( i use ortega ) | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup crushed butterscotch chips
instructions: Melt butter in skillet on medium heat. Add meat.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,basil,bulk italian sausage,chicken broth,dill,paprika,caper,extra large egg
title: Basil and Sausage Stew
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/4 cup capers | 5 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon paprika | 8 fresh kaffir lime leaves ( i used bottled ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1 egg ( optional )
instructions: Brown the sausage in a large, heavy sauce pan over medium heat until cooked through, breaking up chunks as it cooks, about 10 minutes, breaking into small pieces as it browns. Drain the sausage and return it to the pan. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine the chicken stock, paprika, kaffir lime leaves, dill and basil and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the boiled sausage and egg. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,cremini mushroom,mozzarella ball,napa cabbage,skewer,lasagna noodle,apricot
title: Crocodile in Napa Fireball Lasagna
ingredients: 12 large lasagna noodles ( you will have 12 balls, each about 2 x 3 inches long ) | 1 medium napa cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese ( like light, smooth, plain yogurt or sour cream ) | 1/3 cup canned sliced apricots | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 3 whole fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced thin | 8 soft young mozzarella balls, about 7 ounces ( or more if desired )
instructions: Preheat over to 375 degrees f. Arrange a circle of parchment paper on a baking sheet. Tightly cover it with foil, and leave the door slightly ajar to let steam escape. Drain any excess water from the napa. Cut out the paper, then use elsewhere. Place 2 noodles on a clean towel and pat dry with paper towel. Place the napa in a bowl, and toss with salt, and let rest a few minutes. Spread 1/2 of the napa in the bottom of a 13 x 9 baking dish. Spread 1/2 cottage cheese or yogurt over the noodles, then spread 1/4 of the apricots and 1/4 of the mushrooms over it. Repeat layering, ending with the cheese on top. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting into squares or wedges to serve.

title: Truffles Aux Pois (French Cheese Pastries)
ingredients: 1 kg mascarpone cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground white pepper | 1 teaspoon hot paprika
instructions: Using a medium bowl mix together mascarpone and pepper using an electric mixture until it has a creamy consistency. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Roll dough out to about 16 x 20 cm and cut with cookies cutter until thin. Sprinkle them with a little flour just to keep them from sticking. Bake for about 15 minutes in a preheated oven set at 175 deg. Oven. As soon as you take the truffle out of the oven, spread some melted butter on the bottom of each pastry bowl and sprinkle with a pinch of paprika. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Sparkling Italian Soda
ingredients: 2 cups ice water | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | sparkling water ( to taste )
instructions: In a medium, non reactive bowl or tall glass, mix the ice water, vinegar and sparkling water. Stir just until smooth. Pour into two tall glasses and serve.

title: Whip Cream Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint whipping cream | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Pour cream into 2 pie dishes. Mix 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder with 1 teaspoon dry mustard. Pour on cream. Put on the other 2 teaspoons dry mustard powder. Blend well. Cool mixture a little. Pour over chilled cream dessert mixture. Chill.

title: Sour Mango Chutney (Serve With Pickles)
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon hot mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir until well combined. Serve as a condiment or as a sandwich filling.

title: Pasta Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 4 cups semolina flour | 2/3 cup almond meal
instructions: Stir the semolina flour into the almond meal, then set a large oven rack on the rack in the pan. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Pour the semolina flour into a medium bowl, and form a well in the center. Pour enough boiling water into the bottom of the well to form a thick, liquid crust. Turn the bowl over just once to collect the dough. Press to release any air pockets, and knead it gently for 5 minutes. Shape the dough into a long cylinder, and roll into a tube with a tight fitting lid that reaches about 1/2 inch of the way up the tube length of the dough. Wrap the tube tightly around the lid, and place in the pan with enough water to reach 2 inches of the rim. Let stand for 30 minutes. While the tortilla stands, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Slowly drop the tortilla into the boiling water, and quickly remove as soon as it floats to the top. Remove from the pan with a slotted spoon, and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain. Repeat until all the tortillas are drained. Gently rewrap the tortillas, and slice into thin slices. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Hamburger Wraps With Radicchio and Onions
ingredients: 2 hamburger | 1 cup radicchio, chopped | 1/2 turnip, chopped | 3 leaves radishes, chopped | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tortillas
instructions: Remove fat from hamburger. Sprinkle with salt. Brown hamburger in a frying pan. While this is cooking brown onions, corn and radishes in a little olive oil. Remove hamburger from pan and place in the pan with the hamburger. Once hamburger is lightly browned add the rest of the ingredients except for tortillas. Cook over medium to low heat for 10 minutes. Warm tortillas in the microwave or wrap up in foil and place on cookie sheet. You may have to do this in batches depending on your oven. Allow to cook for another 5 - 10 minutes. Serve with refried beans or any other side dishes..

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,french,stew meat,chipotle chile adobo sauce,chicken stock cube,cilantro,mustard powder
title: Baked Chipotle Beef & Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1/4 cup chicken stock cube | 3 tablespoons dry mustard powder | 3 tablespoons cilantro | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo sauce, finely minced | 1 1/2 cups shredded velveeta cheese | 1 french roll, cut in half
instructions: Soak rolls in water for one hour.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,oregano leaf,chili sauce,mexican oregano,flounder fillet,red potato,apricot
title: Albondigas
ingredients: 3 lbs flounder fillets | 2 lbs red potatoes, halved | 6 small red onions, halved | 12 dried apricots | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | flour, for dredging | 2 cups chili sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler. Rinse fillets and pat dry. Lay on broiler rack 3 inches from heat. Broil for 8 to 10 minutes for medium rare or until the fish flakes easily when tested. Transfer the fillets to a covered plate to keep warm. Boil potatoes in salted boiling water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Remove skins with fingers. Dice potatoes and return to saucepan. Add onions and cook until soft, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, toast apricots in hot oil in a heavy, ovenproof skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until golden, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl. Add oregano, oregano and 3/4 cup apricot syrup to onions and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes. Spread potatoes over fish and sprinkle with salt. Replace cover and broil about 10 minutes, until fish is cooked through. Spoon onion mixture over top and serve with steamed or steamed red grapes.

title: Fried Plantains (Plate Plantains)
ingredients: 4 plantains | 3 cans crescent rolls
instructions: Cut the plantains in half lengthwise and then into 1 inch strips. Slice the strips in half widthwise and then slice crosswise in half. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. If using a cast iron frying pan, pour in enough oil to cover the edges, about halfway inch deep. Turn the plantains over and press down slightly to make them flatter. Sauté the plantain strips until golden brown, about about 3 minutes per side. If necessary, add more hot oil as necessary. Allow plantains to cool slightly before opening can. Place one can of crescent dough in a separate bowl. Fill one can with water, just to cover the bottom. Dip plantains first into the flour and then roll them into the remaining can of crescent dough. Set aside. Repeat with the other cans of dough. Heat oil in the skillet. If using cast iron frying pan, you may need to add a little oil. If using regular frying pan, add about 1/2 cup of oil to the pan at a time to keep dough from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Add the plantains about halfway into the oil, then cook about 3 and a half minutes, turning once or twice. They are done when fork tender and golden brown. Add more oil if necessary. Remove cooked plantains when cooked through and drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

title: Mexican-Style Cornbread
ingredients: 1/2 lb white bread | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons light sriracha sauce | 1 -2 cup tomato juice | 1 cup frozen corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut bread into cubes and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Smash cottage cheese into the bread cubes with a fork. Spread cottage cheese into a large microwavable bowl. Heat the sriracha in microwave oven while bowl is heating. Mix tomato juice with 1/4 cup water in microwave safe measuring cup. Stir tomato and water mixture into the cottage cheese mixture so it is absorbed. Spread this mixture into a sprayed 13x7 pan. Place frozen corn on top of mixture. Spread the remaining cottage cheese mixture on top of the corn. Bake 50 minutes or until cornbread is heated through and the topping is crisp. Allow to cool 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Slow-cooker Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 bag dill pickle-style soft cocktail beans | 2 cups frozen celery salt, thawed | 2 teaspoons celery salt | 1/2 cup currants | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1 tablespoon capers | 4 pounds boneless beef roast, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 10 bamboo skewers
instructions: In a slow cooker, mix the dill pickle style soft cocktail beans, celery salt, currants, currants and capers. Place beef on top. Cover, and cook on high for 6 to 7 hours. Soak bamboo skewers in a bowl of water to prevent burning, for about 5 minutes or until they are flexible. Place the meat on a cutting board, and cut into 1/2 slices. Arrange the meat on skewers, or leave whole. Serve the buns wrapped with pickle style beans with sour cream, or drizzled with melted butter and ranch dressing.

title: Greek Dressing for Hair Volume
ingredients: 3/4 cup fat free greek yogurt or 3/4 cup plain low fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram, chopped ( or use dried ) | 1/3 cup fresh orange juice | 3 tablespoons tamarind pulp or 3 tablespoons crushed tamarind | spinach ( to garnish )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and process until creamy and smooth. Pour onto a salad and garnish with chopped parsley or cherries & maraschino cherries if desired. This dressing is great served over greens, as well as vegetables for use with chopsticks, or on vegetables for nibbles, etc. The yogurt is best enjoyed with the greens for a short time just so that they can absorb the flavor.

title: The Great Canadian Cheese Dip
ingredients: 225 g plain yogurt ( you may use sour cream if you do not have sour cream ) | 2 tablespoons hot sauce ( i prefer frank's red hot ) | 1 tablespoon minced pimiento ( optional )
instructions: Mix everything together, but dip is not too thick. Makes about 2 cups dip. Note, if you use sour cream and hot sauce, then you have to heat the dip and eat immediately. Also it will keep for up to a week, but is not as flavorful. It does not turn into a dip if it is refrigerated. If you do not like the dip, do not mix the dip, but spread over your hot dogs, veggie crusted biscuits, etc.., enjoy.

title: Chocolate Beef Strips
ingredients: 600 g stewing beef, cut into strips | 1 teaspoon kirsch ( optional ) | 1/4 cup semolina | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 150 g chocolate
instructions: Boil the beef in water until it is tender. Melt the semolina and chili powder. Add to the beef and simmer for 10 minutes add the chocolate and chocolate and stir until melted and combined.

title: Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 1 kg pork shoulder | 2 lbs good quality pork fat | 3 scallions, finely chopped | 30 small pimientos, finely chopped | 1 loaf fresh white bread, crumbed
instructions: Cut the pork into smaller portions, about the size of your index finger. Put the pork in a non stick frying pan, with enough water to cover and a few good grindings of sugar. Simmer for 2 - 3 hours. Remove the pork from the water and put the meat in a clean cloth bag and set aside to cool. When cooled, slice into thin slices. Drain the pork juices and reserve. Place the pan on a low heat, and add the scallions, pimentos, bread crumbs and pork fat. Stir to mix, cover loosely and simmer on a low heat for 35 minutes. Serve with your favourite side dish.

title: Mustard seed Salmon With Parsley, Fruit and Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet | 4 tablespoons mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons flour | 3 -5 tablespoons fresh fruit, chopped to serve
instructions: Place the mustard seeds in a baking tray in a single layer. Heat on low until popping, but not burning. When very hot, spread the pepper evenly on both sides of the fish, then sprinkle with the parsley. Place the fish in a baking dish with the parsley and mustard seeds. Sprinkle over the flour and bake at 190° for 25 - 30 minutes or until cooked through. Thickly slice the salmon and serve with the thick mustard over the fish.

Random Ingredients: bacon,confectioner ' sugar,almond paste,sesame seed,dill pickle relish,vanilla extract,red chilies
title: Spicy Sesame Pickle Spread
ingredients: 10 slices bacon | 8 tablespoons sesame seeds | confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons dill pickle relish | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 12 whole fresh red chilies, halved crosswise | 3 tablespoons blanched almond paste
instructions: In a large skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Remove from heat, and crumble. Reserve. Drain on paper towels, and set aside. Place the sesame seeds in a small bowl, and press into a pestle with a rolling pin. Spread them out to release excess liquid. Sprinkle a few at a time with confectioners' sugar, and allow to sit until all the sesame seeds are coated. Place the relish in a small bowl, and stir in the sesame seeds, vanilla, and chiles. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the relish to your serving plate, and sprinkle with almonds. Serve immediately. For more delicious results, try adding a teaspoon of almond paste into a small bowl filled with crushed ice before blending, and add the relish before proceeding with the recipe.

Random Ingredients: butter bean,lemon extract,frying chicken,beef cube,bulb garlic,fruit,black eyed pea,chili pepper flake
title: Baked Chicken with Black-Eyed Peas, Fries, and Fruit
ingredients: 1 lb cubed beef round steak or 1 lb chicken breast | 1/4 cup butter beans ( drained & mashed ) | 1/4 lb dried fruit ( i used canned yellow beans & cranberries ) | 1/4 lb dried lima beans ( roasted, cut in halves or quarters ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | frying chicken | 1/4 cup finely chopped lemon extract
instructions: Heat oven to 275°f. Heat butter beans.

Random Ingredients: garlic crouton,beef stock,kidney bean,beef stew meat,japanese eggplant
title: Beef and Eggplant Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb japanese eggplant, peeled and cubed | 64 ounces beef stock | 1/2 cup garlic-flavored croutons or 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 5 quart crock pot. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 9 to 11 hours.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,plain yogurt,fish sauce,oregano leaf,curry powder
title: Spiced Yogurt With Golden Onions
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt ( do not use whipped cream ) | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1 -2 teaspoon fish sauce or 1 -2 teaspoon light soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 teaspoons grand marnier ( or other orange-flavored liqueur ) ( optional )
instructions: Beat yogurt until creamy with electric mixer. In small bowl, stir together curry powder, fish sauce, oregano and grand marnier. Mix well. Spoon over yogurt and chill well. Serve cold or room temperature.

title: Easy Chicken Oregano
ingredients: 6 bone-in chicken breast halves | 1 medium yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 1 package dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano leaves | 2 1/2 cups water
instructions: Place chicken in a large soup pot or dutch oven. Add yellow pepper, oregano and water. Bring to a boil.

title: Spanish Style - Halibut With Prosciutto Ham
ingredients: 4 -6 slices prosciutto ham ( thin slices ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chili flakes | 1 1/2 lbs halibut steaks, boneless or 1 1/2 lbs halibut steak
instructions: In a large skillet saute ham slices in hot fat to your liking. Turn as needed while grilling. Grill until tender and then cut into thin slices. Place ham on serving plate, top with a slice of prosciutto, sprinkle with chili flakes.

title: Chinese Crispy Pancake
ingredients: 1 cup rye flour | 1/2 teaspoon powdered ginger | 1 1/2 teaspoons bottled minced ginger | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1/3 cup dry roasted sesame oil
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Dissolve chinese seasoning and oils in hot oil in a small bowl, then add to dry. Spread onto a greased sheet of parchment paper and bake in a 350f oven until golden brown and crisp, about 10 minutes. Cool and cut into squares or rectangles. Variation, toast each square on a baking sheet lined with wax paper or on a rack.

title: Grill Lobster
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lobsters | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Grill lobsters until browned, about 10 minutes per side. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Place the lobsters in the grill and brush with the sauce.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine pasta,fine sea salt,kaiser,kaffir lime leaf,beef steak,rose water,dill
title: Kaffir Lime-Dilled Beef Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 package fresh fettuccine pasta, cooked | 1 1/2 lbs center-cut beef steaks, cut into 3/4 inch thick strips | 3 tablespoons fine sea salt | 1 1/3 cups fresh kaffir lime leaves | 1 1/3 cups chopped fresh dill | 1 1/2 cups rose water or 1 1/2 cups thai red curry paste | 1/3 cup kaffir lime leaf, loosely packed | coarse sea salt
instructions: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package directions. Drain well and keep warm. Meanwhile, in a large skillet coated generously with cooking spray, cook beef over high heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm. Add lime leaves and 3 tbls. Of the dill to the skillet and stir over moderate heat until just wilted, about 1 minute. Add the remaining dill and curry and stir. Add steak to skillet. Stir in lime leaves and kaffir lime leaves. Bring to a simmer. Reduce heat and simmer about 5 minute. Season with salt. Pour half of the skillet mixture over the fettuccine along with 1/2 c. Of water. Cover and simmer. Stir until heated through. To serve, spoon over the remaining sauce and sprinkle with the remaining dill and lime leaves.

title: Lemon Date Glazed Date
ingredients: 200 g pitted dates, roughly chopped | 2 shallots, finely chopped | 60 g granulated sugar, packed | 1 teaspoon ground lemon zest
instructions: Combine the dates and shallots in a small bowl, and pour boiling water over. Leave the bowl at room temperature for 30 minutes. Drain the mixture, and stir in sugar and lemon zest. Cover and leave to stand overnight. Bring to room temperature during the next day. Cook on your favourite bbq, grill, or barbecue rack for 10 - 15 minutes or until just starting to turn golden and crisp. Serve drizzled with glaze.

title: Curried Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs filet of beef | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1/3 cup port wine, can use other dry white wine to make a nice dipping sauce
instructions: Pierce the beef all over, then place the meat in a non metallic dish and pour over about half the wine. Cover and marinate overnight in the refrigerator. When ready to cook, drain the meat, reserving the marinade. Brown the meat over high heat in a large skillet with some of the cooking marinade. Turn the meat and brown for about 10 minutes. Season with salt. Pour a little of the cooking wine into the skillet and scrape the browned bits from the bottom to brown the wine.

title: Nacho Style Slaw
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red cabbage, thinly sliced with the core removed | 3 tablespoons finely chopped serrano peppers
instructions: In a large bowl combine the cabbage and chilies.

title: Asian Country-Style Edamame Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shelled edamame | 1 bunch radish, cut into 2 inch lengths | 10 medium fresh coriander ( cilantro ) | 2 -3 chicken wings, trimmed | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 4 tablespoons peanuts | 5 tablespoons mixed salad greens ( i use baby lettuce leaves ) or 5 tablespoons asian style peanut sauce ( i use baby lettuce leaves ) | 2 -3 leaves escarole
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and put in the edamame and radish. Cover and bring to a boil. Cook until tender, no more than 3 - 4 minutes. Drain and allow to cool. Cut into 2 inch lengths. Remove and discard core and white part of each coriander stalk. Wash and dry coriander and cut stalks off into 2inch lengths. Stack upright. Place coriander and radish in separate piles on a plate or large platter. Dip chicken wings into 1/2 cup hot water and coat in peanut, coating evenly. Remove and discard skin and veins, then fry in a large skillet, turning occasionally, for 5 minutes or until cooked through. Drain on paper towels and allow to cool slightly. Cut coriander and radish into bite sized pieces. Place 2 tablespoons peanut sauce into a small bowl. Add salad greens and toss to coat. Toss with remaining peanut sauce and garnish with escarole leaves and peanuts.

title: Roasted Beef and Fresh Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless lean beef chuck roast, trimmed and cut into bite size pieces | 4 plum tomatoes, cut into quarters | 1/3 cup shredded unsweetened coconut
instructions: In heavy duty plastic bag, combine the beef, tomatoes and coconut. Marinate covered in refrigerator for 10 to 30 minutes or until hot, tossing every now and then.

title: Faux Sour Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rapeseed oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 cup molasses or 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 3/4 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/4 lb fresh cherry, halved or 1/4 lb cranberry beans, trimmed
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a heavy 4 quart saucepan. Add molasses, celery seed and cook, stirring, until mixture thickens and begins to brown, about 5 minutes. Add the beans and cherries and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, just until heated through. Transfer to warmed fondue pot and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube powder,macadamia nut,walnut,icing sugar,flour tortilla,crisp bacon,peanut oil,mexican oregano
title: Pigs in Honey & Garlic Cream With Nuts
ingredients: 8 slices crisp bacon, very finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or olive oil ) | 3 teaspoons walnut oil ( or other cooking oil, you mayn't need this ) | 3 garlic cloves, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon mexican oregano ( or other mexican oregano ) | 1 chicken stock cube powder ( i've found that a vegetable base would do just as good ) | flour tortilla, for serving | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, chopped ( about 2 handfuls ) | 1/4 cup icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Crisp bacon with a little oil in a frying pan, just enough to keep oil from getting soggy. When it is crispy, add your chopped garlic, and fry briefly so the garlic doesn't burn. Add your oregano and stir it in, for about half a minute. Turn your oven on to 200°c/400°f. Make sure your woks have a baking paper lined cookie sheet or cookie tray. Drain your macadamia nuts, then stir them into your garlic mixture until chopped finely or use a food processor to crush the nuts and mix well. Fry up your bacon and drain off any excess oil on the paper or cookie sheet. Pour this mixture into your woks and stir until thoroughly mixed, then set aside. Spray them with olive oil or you may spray them again. Spread your tortillas with the remaining oil. Place approximately the tablespoon of the mixture onto each tortilla. Roll the tortillas up, starting at the wide edges and pinching one end slightly to seal. Repeat with the rest of the tortillas and filling. Spread the nuts on the tortillas and sprinkle them with your mexican oregano. Roll up and transfer them to a plate. Dust with icing sugar and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,havarti cheese,chicken thigh,rye flour,tomato paste,stewing beef
title: Quick Beef 'n' Cheese Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 cans tomato paste | 2 cans orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted | 6 slices havarti cheese, divided | 4 tablespoons thawed frozen egg substitute | 1 package rye flour ( or other grain flavor enhancer )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spray a large slow cooker with cooking spray. Cut meat into chunks.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,basmati rice,english cucumber,red chili paste
title: Cucumber Cabbage Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups basmati rice or 2 1/2 cups other long grain rice, soaked in hot water, rinsed | 1 chinese cucumber | 2 dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 red chili paste | 2 tablespoons red chili paste, hot
instructions: Cut the cucumber lengthwise into 1/8's and then crossways into spears 3 - 4 inches long. If using shiitake mushrooms then cut into 3 - 4 inch lengths. Slice the chili paste hot in a pestle and mortar well to dissolve chili paste into oil, then stir fry with the chili paste for 1 minute. Stir in the cooked rice, mushrooms, and cucumber into the hot water then let stand 30 minutes till liquid is absorbed.

title: Quick Okra and Vodka
ingredients: 2 lbs baby carrots ( sliced or julienned ) | 1/2 cup dry quinoa | 1 can baby okra | 1/3 bottle vodka | 3 teaspoons white sugar | 4 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Add all ingredients to a large bowl, apart from the okra. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. After marinading, add the okra right before service.

title: Peanuts
ingredients: 1 cup peanuts, shelled and chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2 teaspoons allspice | 4 cups of stock or 4 cups broth
instructions: Combine peanuts, coriander and allspice in the biggest skillet you have. Fry slowly, stirring constantly until the mixture comes away from the sides and turns pale brown. Add the stock and stir until it boils away. Add salt to taste. Serve warm with curry.

title: Roti Canai (Spinach Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 cup spinach, chopped | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Mince the spinach with a fork and then mix with the ground masala. Wet your fingers with water and lightly knead dough. Cover with a clean towel and let rest for 20 minutes. Heat a non stick pan or flat griddle. Spread spinach mixture on the griddle. It should not spread out. When it is crisp on top, flip it over once only. It should take about 10 seconds each side. Turn the pancakes over halfway through. Spread 2 tablespoons spinach mixture on the underside with a knife. Fold the pancakes in half. Keep on a clean cloth lined plate in a warm oven. Keep warm till all the mixture is gone and you eat them.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,red cherry,creamy peanut butter,active yeast
title: Pixie Magic
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/4 cups sour cream | 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Add all ingredients to bread machine in order listed, select sour cream and peanut butter setting and start.

title: Chile Paste in a Bottle
ingredients: 300 g iceberg lettuce ( about 150g ) | 15 g chili pepper ( cayenne ) | 3 -5 g ginger-garlic paste ( ginger powder )
instructions: Remove large leafy green leafy white portion of lettuce. Wash and trim. Cut off large hard stalks from the outer stalks so you will be able to maintain head of lettuce. Cut away the thick heart shape from the outer stalks. Cut out and discard any large leaves. Separate and use a knife to shred the lettuce leaves but cut out any large leaves. Wash and trim all leaves. Cut the chili pepper in half. Crush the ginger garlic in a mortar or small mixing bowl and add it to the garlic. Add the chili pepper and mix well. Add salt to taste.. The chili pepper will be slightly spongy so you may have to use the mortar if the mixture is too liquid. This is optional, but is still a fun ingredient in my opinion. The mix will be difficult to mix because of the ginger garlic. Put the lettuce into the bottle with the chili pepper and mix well. Refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: ice water,white sugar,coffee ice cream,ginger garlic paste
title: Ginger Fluff
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 1/3 cup water | 2 cups coffee ice cream, softened | 2 teaspoons white sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the grated ginger garlic paste with the water. Set aside. In a blender, blend the coffee ice cream with the sugar until smooth. Strain the coffee mixture through a fine mesh strainer lined with a coffee filter, pressing on the solids with any strained coffee into the coffee ice cream and stirring to ensure that the coffee dissolves into the mix. Return the coffee ice cream mixture to the blender to blend. Cover and process in batches until smooth.

title: Simple and Delicious Mocha Frosting
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons coffee liqueur | 1/3 cup simple syrup ( optional )
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and coffee liqueur together. Mix in simple syrup, if using, and store in a cool place until serving.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,deli ham,stewing beef,white pepper,plum tomato,garlic,flour tortilla
title: Quick and Easy Enchiladas
ingredients: 6 lbs stewing beef | 1 3/4 lbs deli ham | 3 lbs plums in heavy whipping cream | 8 ounces flour tortillas ( if flour tortillas are not available, use corn tortilla flour in place of flour tortillas ) | 2 cloves garlic | white pepper | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Dice stewing beef and ham, if using. Slice plums, garlic, and white pepper, if using. In deep skillet, brown meat in garlic. Do not drain. Add cream and heavy cream. Cook on med high heat, stirring frequently, until it is thick about 3 hours. In small casserole, make a meat sauce of your choice, i use a rotisserie sauce. Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Add meat, cheese, etc to white sauce. Mix well. Bake 20 minutes or until meat and cheese are heated through. May also sprinkle on top of mozzarella cheese while baking or roll tortillas, if desired.

title: Easy English Style Corn Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1/2 red onion, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Mix the cornmeal, red onion and worcestershire sauce together. Mold onto parchment paper lined cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes or until browned.

Random Ingredients: olive,egg noodle,skirt steak,apple juice,tomato sauce,italian salad dressing,veal cutlet,orange juice
title: Veal Skirt Steak With Noodles
ingredients: 4 thick cut veal cutlets | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup veal fisket steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 5 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 4 tablespoons tomato sauce | 2 cups hot cooked egg noodles ( or your favourite pasta ) | 1/2 cup ripe olives, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles in pot of boiling water or microwave until just tender, and drain. Remove skillet from heat. Place veal and juices in a zip lock bag. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Drain juice from bag and reserve. Mix pasta, veal, onion and dressing. Place in 4 quart casserole. Top with vegetables. Cover. Bake 350°f 20 to 30 minutes or until meat is warmed through. Garnish with olives.

title: Fennel Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, very thickly sliced | 1 cup italian-style salad dressing
instructions: Heat fennel in a skillet over medium heat until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain fennel and rub fennel with italian style dressing.

title: Cilantro Ranch Dressing #RSC
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup ranch salad dressing ( your favorite. you can also use a low fat or fat free )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a tightly covered container & shake well so ingredients are evenly distributed. Serve with chips.

title: Chinese Five-Spice Jelly
ingredients: 100 g bottled maraschino cherries, drained | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Pour all the ingredients into a small pan and bring to the boil. Simmer over low heat until the jelly dissolves. Turn off heat, pour jelly into sterilized 20mm/1 inch non aluminium jar. Leave jelly in the pan on the counter for about 4 - 8 weeks in a warm place before opening it to allow all the excess water in the jelly to evaporate. It will become firmer and thicker. Pour the jelly into clean jelly jars, seal with a clean lids and store in the jam jar in a cool place or into the freezer. Any longer than that will cause the jelly to become hard, and you will have to increase the heat a little. If you want it more sweet, reduce the heat. Leave the chillie in the fridge for at least 2 - 3 weeks, so that the jelly can mature and mature for up to 7 months.

title: Reubens, Sauerkraut and Yellow Pepper Hash
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 packet sauerkraut | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables ( see instructions below ) | 2 tablespoons minced cucumbers | 1 yellow pepper, chopped, to taste | 2 cups frozen rye bread, cubed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch with 1/2 cup of water. Drain sauerkraut.

title: Nacho Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 can condensed nacho cheese soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup chopped pitted green olives
instructions: Mix in a medium bowl and mix thoroughly, or stir in a little water if you like a thinner consistency.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,salad dressing,rigatoni pasta,tuna,beef stock,monosodium glutamate
title: Spicy Tuna Beef Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb tuna, cut into chunks | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 quart beef stock | 1 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( msg ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb penne pasta, cooked according to package directions | 1/2 cup salad dressing
instructions: Tuna is already cooked. Cook pasta as directed on package. Drain. Mix tuna, stewed tomatoes, beef stock, msg, and monosodium glutamate in large bowl. Add cooked pasta. Cover, and chill in the refrigerator 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice,pearl barley,sugar,green enchilada sauce,green olive brine,white pepper,orange juice
title: Frijoles a La Mexicana - Green Beans With Barley
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen pearl barley | 12 ounces frozen green enchilada sauce, thawed | 12 ounces cranberry juice | 12 ounces orange juice | 12 ounces granulated sugar | white pepper | sugar ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook barley according to package directions. Do not overcook. In a seperate bowl pour sauce ingredients. Cover with lid and chill. In another bowl mix ingredients for sauce for several minutes with a whisk or hand held mixer. Pour over hot and stir constantly for 2 - 3 minutes at medium heat until bubbly. Serve garnished with sugar.

Random Ingredients: greek seasoning,lemon gelatin,demerara sugar,orange juice zest,black pepper,fine breadcrumb,lemon pepper seasoning,arugula
title: Quick Italian Wedding Salad
ingredients: 4 cups arugula | 1/2 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon lemon gelatin | 1 tablespoon demerara sugar | 2 teaspoons fresh strained orange juice ( from about 1/2 of orange, in a small nonreactive bowl ) | 1/2 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Wash, remove, tear, and toss the arugula in a mixing bowl. To make the dressing, combine the fine dry bread crumb, lemon pepper seasoning, 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper, orange zest, lemon gelatin, demerara sugar, 1 cup orange juice, 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper, 1 1/4 tsp lemon pepper, 1/4 teaspoons lemon pepper, 1/2 teaspoon grated orange zest.

title: Pea Bissie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crisco | 14 ounces frozen peas | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/2 lb pepperoni, chopped
instructions: In a 2 quart saucepan with tight fitting lid, melt crisco. Add peas, stock cubes, and pepperoni. Tie with kitchen string, and place on top of lid. Cover pan, and simmer over low to medium heat for 20 minutes.

title: Nasi Goreng (Rice With Cashews)
ingredients: 1/4 cup white onion ( finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup cashews ( finely ground ) | 1/2 cup wheat bran | 1/2 small white onion ( finely minced ) | 1/4 cup whole wheat bran
instructions: Finely mince the onion and cashewnuts. Combine the rice grains, white onion and cashewnuts. Sprinkle bran onto the grains and toss until coated. Put in the fridge if not using right away.

title: Quinoa and Mozzarella With Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils, rinsed and picked over in a food processor | 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 garlic clove, minced | 3 3/4 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded and divided | 2 medium jicama ( about 1 lb total )
instructions: Note, you can also use the quinoa and quinoa in small batches in a rice cooker. Rinse the quinoa and quinoa in a colander until water runs clear. Combine in serving bowl and set aside. If using quinoa and quinoa, heat 2 cups of water and 1 tsp of salt in a large pot. Bring to a boil, and add quinoa and quinoa. Lower heat to medium if starting to scorch and quinoa will become dry. Simmer until all the liquid is absorbed and quinoa tender, about 25 - 30 minutes. While quinoa is cooking, cut the jicama into 1/2 inch cubes. Heat 1/2 cup of cheese in small skillet over medium heat. Sauté 1/2 the jicama until crisp and just starting to color, about 2 minutes. Drain on a paper towel lined plate and season with salt and pepper. Remove the jicama from the pan when it has turned a nice golden brown color, and set aside. Cut the remaining jicama into 1/2 inch cubes, keeping the slices roughly the same size, and place in same skillet with the cheese. Add about 3/4 cup of the cheese to the cheese, and stir until the cheese is well incorporated. Remove the quinoa mixture from the heat. Stir the quinoa and quinoa into the cheese mixture. Add 4 - 5 cups of water and 1 tsp salt. Bring to boil, and then cover, and simmer until the quinoa is tender and the water is absorbed, about 10 - 15 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Curry Milk (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon curry
instructions: Whisk or whip your milk with curry. Dissolve the soy milk and curry in the last few seconds of whisking.

Random Ingredients: yeast,garlic powder,ricotta,red chile pepper,chuck roast,kiwi,pineapple juice
title: Chef John's Hawaiian Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 (.25 ounce ) packages active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice, divided | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 1/2 pounds chuck roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 pounds kiwi, quartered | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic flavored vodka | 15 whole fresh pineapple slices for garnish
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 tablespoons of the pineapple juice. Let stand until creamy, 15 minutes. Bring remaining pineapple juice to a boil. Pour into a large bowl and add garlic powder, beef, kiwis, and chili garlic vodka. Stir until well coated. Drain the meat, reserving some of the liquid and meat juices. Transfer to a lightly oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside the rest of the pineapple juice. Cover the bowl with a cloth, and let sit at room temperature until the fat in the skillet drips, about 2 hours. Heat grill to medium high. Grill meat cubes for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned evenly and cooked to your liking. Allow to rest 10 minutes, then slice against the grain. Serve with your favorite hot sauce, and top with reserved pineapple juice. To make spicier, add 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1/4 teaspoon salt, or 1/4 teaspoon pepper.

title: Guisado Con Crema
ingredients: 1 can white beans, rinsed and drained | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon sherry wine, plus additional, if desired
instructions: Place rinsed beans in small bowl. Stir in cinnamon and drizzle with sherry. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,worcestershire sauce,spring onion,celery rib,squid,almond extract
title: Baked Calamari
ingredients: 1/2 kg beef tenderloin | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1 spring onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 pinch ground dried mushroom ( optional ) | 1 dash almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c. Slice beef into thin slices. Combine all ingredients to a bowl. Place meat in a baking tray. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes, basting frequently with the marinade, until browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: cool whip,red capsicum,calrose rice,chinese five spice powder,fish sauce,yellow pea
title: Chinese Pesto Rice
ingredients: 3 cups rice ( i use minute rice ) | 200 g yellow peas | 2/3 red capsicum, chopped ( bell pepper ) | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 1/2 cups fish sauce, low sodium | 100 g cool whip
instructions: Wash rice well and drain. Place rice and peas in your kitchen aid mixer/maker. Grind with hands and mix for 30 seconds and put water in the cooker while rice is cooking. Combine rice with all ingredients, mixing thoroughly. Pour into individual serving glasses or decorative bowls, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours. Toss it every so often and check it is well drained. When ready to eat, give a bite. Enjoy the south side of your south side.

Random Ingredients: ouzo,zucchini,amaretto liqueur,sesame ginger salad dressing,green chilies,marshmallow biscuit,tapioca flour
title: Ouzo Vegetable Puffs
ingredients: 3 ripe zucchini | 2 tablespoons ouzo | 1/4 cup miniature marshmallow biscuits | 1/4 cup miniature zucchini | 1 tablespoon fresh green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon sesame ginger salad dressing | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 1 tablespoon amaretto liqueur | 1 teaspoon sesame ginger salad dressing
instructions: Slice zucchini lengthwise about 1/4 inch thick. Cut zucchini lengthwise in half lengthwise until each slice is cut 4 long. In a large bowl, combine the ouzo, marshmallows, chilies, sesame ginger, and 1 tablespoon of the ouzo for the filling. Place half of the filling in a small plastic bag, and marinate the filling for 15 minutes. Drain the zucchini slices and pat dry with paper towels. Place half of them, cut side down, on the cookie sheet and bake at 325 degrees f for 12 - 15 minutes. Remove and allow to cool. Repeat. Remove zucchini from the oven, and coat the cut side with 1/4 teaspoon of the ouzo mixture, and allow to cool. Place the remaining half of the zucchini in the same bowl, and cover with the zucchini filling. Gently shape the zucchini slices in the baking bowl, and top with the remaining filling mixture. Drizzle 1/2 teaspoon of the ouzo mixture on top, and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of sesame salad dressing. Serve with toasted cashews or crackers. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chili without bean,salad green,brown basmati rice,anchovy fillet,tomato sauce,pork sparerib,pork loin chop,chipotle pepper
title: Baked Spanish Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup brown basmati rice | 1 pound pork loin chops, cut into thin strips | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 can anchovy fillets, rinsed and coarsely chopped | 4 links pork spareribs, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 can pork-flavored salad greens | 2 chipotle peppers, minced, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cover the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with a layer of rice. Layer half of the pork strips over rice, then half of tomato sauce, anchovies, and ribs. Repeat layers until dish is full. Cover with a layer of water, sprinkle with chipotle peppers, and place baking dish on high in oven to quickly begin the baking. Bake until the rice is tender, about 1 hour. Remove baking dish from oven and spoon contents of pan over rice.

Random Ingredients: berry,chocolate chip,kielbasa,cocoa powder,white wine vinegar,spaghettini,linguine,chicken breast meat
title: Cajun Spaghettini with Chicken and Chocolate
ingredients: ribollita ( spaghettini ) | 1 pound dry spaghettini | 12 ounces chicken breast meat, thinly sliced | 1 package smoked kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 4 ounces white wine vinegar | 4 ounces semi-sweet chocolate chips, melted | 4 ounces berry berries ( optional ) | 4 ounces thin chocolate chips, melted
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil over high heat, about 45 seconds. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the spaghettini, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Lebanese Mint Soup
ingredients: 900 g parmesan cheese, finely grated ( the blocky type of cheese ) | 3/8 cup bread, torn into chunks | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon | 3 tablespoons fresh mint leaves | 3 lime leaves
instructions: Place everything in a saucepan and heat, stirring constantly until the garlic and mint leaves are all softened. Then, bring to a boil. Pour into a bowl and garnish with thin slices of lime.

title: Lavender Chapati
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon dried lavender
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Stir the chickpea flour and lavender into the chick pea flour in a bowl until the chick pea flour dissolves. Form the dough into small balls, about 5 inches in diameter, using about 1 tablespoon of dough per ball. Place about 2 inches of water in a baking dish. Cover the baking dish with parchment paper, and spray or grease the parchment paper. Arrange the chapati in the pan, and bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the edges are golden brown. Let cool in the pans for at least 10 minutes before cutting into wedges.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,egg noodle,shaoxing wine,white pepper,self raising flour,green peppercorn,natural yoghurt
title: Noodle & Cheese Cake, 361cals Per Serve
ingredients: 350 g instant egg noodles | 150 g shredded mexican blend cheese | 150 g white pepper | 150 g green peppercorns | 1/4 cup shaoxing wine | 1/2 cup natural yoghurt | 1 tablespoon self raising flour | white pepper
instructions: Boil water, add noodles, cook for 10 minutes, drain thoroughly. Mix in other ingredients in a bowl then transfer to a greased and paper lined 20 cm tart tin. Bake at 160c for 45 - 60 minutes or until well cooked.

title: Stuffed Dates
ingredients: 1 lb roast beef, in cubes approx | 2 -3 green chilies, chopped | 1 can water chestnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 tablespoon coriander | 1 tablespoon dates, chopped
instructions: Place the roast in a pot with the green chilly, water chestnuts, raisins, coriander and dates. Cover, simmer on low heat for about 25 minutes or until the meat is tender. Take the lid off of the pot and simmer for an additional 15 - 20 minutes. You can add the dates just before served if you want more spice or crunch.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,yellow mustard,cremini mushroom,apple juice concentrate,greek yogurt
title: Grilled Cremini Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 large cremini mushrooms | 14 1/2 ounces cream of mushroom soup ( or half and half, or both ) | 1/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1/4 cup apple juice concentrate | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Spray grill with vegetable cooking spray or lightly sprinkle with oil. Place mushrooms, cut sides down, on a large platter. In a medium bowl, combine soup, yogurt, apple juice concentrate, and xanthan gum. Pour soup mixture over mushrooms. Gently press between fingers to coat mushrooms with mixture. Let cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,purpose flour,pistachio,red chilies,mango,parsnip,kashmiri chili powder,poppy seed
title: Nepalese Paratha Breads
ingredients:
1 kg split gourd gram flour 
    - 6 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 large greek dried red chilies | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 cup mashed pumpkin ( optional ) | 2 medium parsnips | 1/2 cup chopped mango | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 2 pinches kashmiri chili powder
instructions: Firstly start by preparing the dough. For this, take a sieve, and rinse out all the yogurt and keep aside. Take 1 1/2 cups of the gram flour and wash it with 2 cups of water to remove all the lumps. Keep this for 30 minutes. Take out a large bowl. Sift kashmiri chilli powder and make a thin paste by mixing it with the gram flour. Keep aside. Peel the prawns and remove the stalks and cut into small pieces. Take half the gram flour, half the poppy seeds, half the mashed pumpkin and half the dried red chillies. Knead the ingredients very well using your palms. Take half the prawns. Mix all these with the gram flour and then knead well. Make a round dough. Cover and keep aside for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, peel all the prawns in thin slices. Take a deep frying pan. Heat a little oil. Carefully, add half the prawns and cook them till they turn pink and they are partially cooked. Add the remaining prawns and fry them till the prawns are fully cooked. Take out the pan. Remove the prawns from the oil. Now, for the paratha, take a large pot. Put 1/2 cup of the gram flour and the kashmiri chilli powder. Mix well. Stir in the prawns. Add the 1 cup of water and mix well. Spread the cooked prawns in this. Keep aside. Take a pan. Put 1/2 cup of water. Let it boil. Stir in the remaining gram flour, then add the kashmiri chilli and poppy seeds. Allow it to cook for 10 minutes or until the gravy comes to a boil. Now, start making these breads. First, take each prawn and prawn slice vertically. Use a spoon, spoon or your fingers to spread it thinly. Place prawns in a bowl. Add 1/4 cup of the mango, 1/4 cup of pistachios and 1 teaspoon of kashmiri chilli powder. Mix well. Heat little oil in a frying pan. Add the same. When the oil is hot, add the half the prawns. Carefully, throw the fried prawns in the pan and stir it till its evenly coated in the masala. Cover it with a lid. After 5 - 10 minutes, flip the paratha upside down. Allow to cook for a minute or two. Remove from heat. Garnish with pistachios and serve with raita and rotis.

title: Award-Winning Lamb
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb salt pork, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb kale, chopped | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons cinnamon | 1/4 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Sprinkle salt pork cubes with cinnamon. Toss in bread cubes with 2/3 of the marinara. Cover with keil and refrigerate. Marinate overnight. Drain the marinara from the lamb and the salt pork. Thread the lamb onto skewers. Place on the rack of a broiler pan and broil with the meat about 6 inches from the top until browned, about 3 minutes per side. Serve with remaining marinara sauce and rice and a green vegetable.

title: Italian Halibut
ingredients: 4 skinless halibut fillets | 1/2 cup italian dressing | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed peppercorn | 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place in 9 inch springform pan. In medium mixing bowl, blend italian dressing, corn syrup, crushed peppercorns and bread crumbs. Spread evenly onto and over fillets. Cover and marinate for 1 - 2 hours in refrigerator. Remove from marinade and place on rack in baking dish. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested. Transfer to wire rack. Paint with warm italian dressing. Serve immediately or cold.

Random Ingredients: sultana,cream chicken soup,cream tartar,salt pepper,bourbon,guinness stout,cucumber,corn tortilla
title: Guiness Sour Cream Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 corn tortillas | 3 tablespoons sultanas | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 2 tablespoons bourbon | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | salt and pepper to taste | 1 cucumber, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a casserole dish. Cut the tortillas into 3 inch lengths and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together the sultanas, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, guinness, bourbon, cream of tartar and salt and pepper to taste. Layer the tortilla strips in the prepared casserole dish or casserole dish. Spoon 1/3 of the batter over the tortillas. Spoon 1/3 of the remaining batter over the tortillas. Repeat layers twice, ending with a layer of tortillas. Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Greek Bean Dip
ingredients: 1/2 pound dry pinto beans | 1/2 cup barley | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons kalamata olives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Rinse the beans and remove any foreign objects. Soak beans over night. Drain beans, place in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until tender, about 1 1/4 hours. Drain and set aside. Combine the barley and Greek yogurt in a bowl and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours. Stir in the thyme and olives, place the bean mixture into a food processor or blender and process until smooth, 20 to 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,balsamic vinegar,sugar,flat noodle,fenugreek seed,farfalle pasta
title: Fake Sesame Farfalle
ingredients: 9 ounces farfalle pasta | 1 onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon cenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon greek dried onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place farfalle in pot and cook 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Yummy and Simple Avocado Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fat-free pistachio nuts, chopped | 6 tablespoons heavy cream, divided | 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenders, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 large ripe avocado, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 package fat-free sugar substitute | 1 -2 tablespoon green bird's eye chile scallion tops, finely chopped
instructions: Soak the pistachio nuts in a small bowl of hot water for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium heat proof bowl, combine the cream and 2 tbls. Of the pistachio nuts. In another bowl, place the chicken, 3 tbls. Of the cream, the 2 tbls. Of the nuts and the 1/2 cup of the cream mixture. Mix well. Thread the chicken, 4 pieces per skewer, onto a skewer. Place on two baking sheets and set the other baking sheet aside. In a small bowl or cup, combine the remaining cream with the remaining 1 1/4 tbls. Of pistachio nuts and set aside. Place the remaining cream and 2 tbls. Of pistachio nuts in a small saucepan over low heat. Heat until the nuts are hot, about 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside. In a small bowl, mash the avocado with a fork, removing the seeds and membrane. Transfer the avocado, chopped green onions and 1/2 cup of sour cream to a medium bowl. Stir in the remaining 1 tbls. Of pistachio nuts and adjust seasoning to taste. Set aside. Dip each chicken skewer into the remaining sour cream, letting excess sour cream drip off and coating the chicken in the pistachio nuts. Place the skewers on a plate and cover with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: catsup,oregano,hot paprika,black pepper,no boil lasagna noodle,tabasco sauce,ice,walnut oil
title: No Salt Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | ice | walnut oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet on a medium heat. Spread 1/2 a teaspoon of walnut oil in a 9x13 baking dish. In a small bowl, stir together catsup, oregano, worcestershire sauce, tabasco, and pepper. Spread 1/2 a teaspoon of catsup mixture on the bottom of the baking dish. Layer 1 tomato slice on top of catsup mixture, and repeat with the remaining ingredients. Dip spoon into ice and lay flat on top of the lasagna, using a spatula. Place 12 no-boil lasagna noodles on top, and cover the dish. Place directly on a burner and allow to sit undisturbed for 2 - 3 minutes, then flip the lasagna. Place uncovered on foil or a cookie sheet to catch any drips. Remove foil and top with remaining sauce. Let stand an additional 10 minutes to set up. Let cool to room temperature. This sauce keeps well in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,tomato puree,arborio rice,coconut cream
title: Rice & Tomato Cake
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups vegetable shortening or 1 1/4 cups lard | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice or 1 1/4 cups carnaroli rice, rice flour can be substituted | 1 can tomato puree or ( 28 ounce ) can chopped tomatoes in tomato sauce | 1/2 cup coconut cream
instructions: Rub the shortening/lard from the oil into the rice flour until completely mixed into a fine sieved mixture. Add the tomato puree if using the tomatoes heat gently for 3 to 5 minutes or until heated through. Transfer mixture to a greased, but not too oily pan/kettle with a round tip fitted with a round handle. Sprinkle the coconut cream around the base. Sprinkle half the rice into the base and side of the cake, and sprinkle over a little more rice. Pour a layer of tomato and coconut creme on top of the rice. Return pan/kettle to the boil over medium heat, then immediately reduce heat and cover with lid. Cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and leave to stand for 15 minutes. Turn onto a lightly greased plate. Sprinkle on a little sugar if desired. Serve with a light dusting of brown sugar.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,egg substitute,kernel corn,oil,rosemary leaf,banana,table salt
title: Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups potato flakes or mashed potatoes | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1 egg substitute | 2 teaspoons minced, fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/3 cup light-colored jamaica mashed banana | rosemary leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Blend potato flakes with 1/2 teaspoon salt in a blender or food processor. Whisk together egg substitute, ginger. Stir egg substitute mixture into potato flakes with mashed potato until blended. Combine mashed potato mixture with mashed potato mixture until well blended. Stir in banana. Fork and rosemary leaves to taste. Garnish with optional rosemary leaves. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Rice Beef With Amaretto Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces dried arborio rice | 1 cup beef stew meat or 1 cup lean ground beef | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 1 cup crema ( or more! )
instructions: Soak the arborio rice for 30 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Over low heat brown the beef and add the arborio rice and apricot jam. Heat slowly until it comes to a boil and the broth starts to thicken up a little bit. Serve with a sprinkling of crema.

title: Sweet Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans | 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 2 tablespoons chili paste, or to taste
instructions: Place the black beans into a large pot, and cover with several inches of water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium, and simmer until tender, about 1/2 hour. Remove from heat, and drain beans. Place cabbage into a large pot, and pour over enough hot water to cover. Bring the cabbage to a boil, and cook 5 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and place in a bowl. Pour the chili sauce into the mixture, and mix with about 1/2 cup of beans, or to taste.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,worcestershire sauce,cumin seed,yellow squash,tomato green chile pepper
title: Spicy Yellow Squash, Tomato and Chile Dip
ingredients: 2 large yellow squash, cut into chunks | 1 can crushed tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin seeds | 1/4 teaspoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a roasting pan. Layer squash chunks in the bottom of the roasting pan and season with salt. Sprinkle the squash with the tomato sauce, worcestershire sauce, cumin, and parmesan cheese. Bake the mixture for 1 hour in the preheated oven, until the vegetables are tender and the sauce is bubbly.

title: Tropical Hazelnut Dip
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 3/4 cup tamari soy sauce
instructions: Place the nuts in a large bowl and pour over enough tamari soy sauce to cover. Mix well until all the nuts are coated. Cover and refrigerate until needed, about 3 hours. Stir the dip occasionally while chilling.

title: Pumpernickel Rounds
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon anise seeds | 1/4 lb velveeta cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 3 tablespoons maple syrup
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a large, shallow skillet, toast the anise seeds over medium, stirring constantly, until they begin to pop. About 1 minute. Remove from heat, let cool, and stir in the cheeses and baking soda. Form the mixture into small rounds about 1 inch in diameter. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Broil for 5 minutes, until the tops are lightly browned.

title: Salad With Coconut Cream and Fresh Chillies
ingredients: 1 packet mixed salad greens | 600 g coconut cream, cut into small dice | 1 fresh jalapeno chile, deseeded and finely diced ( optional )
instructions: Place the mixed greens and coconut into a bowl. Dice the jalapeño and stir it into the salad. Divide the salad between 4 serving plates. Whip the coconut cream until it reaches the desired consistency. Serve with the chillies if desired.

title: Spiral Pasta With Ham and Coconut
ingredients: 10 black peppercorns, cracked | 1 cup shredded coconut | 1 lb spiral shaped pasta, cooked, drained and kept warm | 12 cups warm salad greens, such as bok choy, green leafy parts and baby greens | 1/2 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 1/3 cup diced cooked ham
instructions: In large bowl, mix cracked peppercorns, coconut, and warm salad greens. Toss together in sugar, cornmeal, and ham. If desired, sprinkle with some black pepper. Serve in shallow bowls.

Random Ingredients: duck breast,cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,spanish onion,plain nonfat yogurt,ladyfinger
title: Duck and Swiss Casserole
ingredients: 8 duck breasts, skinless, boneless | 8 ladyfingers ( any flavor, i prefer ladyfinger ) | 1 jar spanish style onions, drained and sliced | 1 container fat-free plain nonfat yogurt | cheese | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a 9x13 inch dish. Spread evenly. Sprinkle cheese on top. If desired, bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: glutinous rice,tomato ketchup,ginger garlic paste,black bean,cocoa,pork loin chop
title: Filipino Pork Spareribs with Chilli
ingredients: 2 lbs pork loin chops, sliced thinly across the grain | 1/2 cup tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup unbleached cane syrup or 1/4 cup glutinous rice, with 100 ml water | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon cocoa, powdered | 1 can black beans or ( 15 ounce ) can kidney beans
instructions: Combine everything except the black beans and black beans in a heavy bottomed skillet, stirring well.
