Reduce heat to very low, cover and cook, covered, stirring once every 30 minutes, for 35 minutes or until pork is very tender. Remove from heat. Add the black beans and cook, covered, for 15 minutes, stirring once in a while.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,sazon goya con culantro y achiote,angel hair pasta,sauerkraut,serrano pepper jalapeno,walnut oil,filet beef,butter
title: Shredded Beef and Sauerkraut and Pasta
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained | 4 ounces filet of beef, in 1 1/2 inch cubes | 4 ounces sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained | 1/2 cup walnut oil | 3 tablespoons achiote sauce ( aji amarillo ) | 4 ounces fresh orange marmalade or 4 ounces madeira wine | 1 serrano pepper ( jalapeno ), deveined and minced ( optional ) | 12 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked al dente as directed on package, reserve 1 cup of cooking liquid | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted, plus more as needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Combine the sauerkraut, beef, 1 teaspoon salt, and the 2 ounces of marmalade and oil in a large bowl, tossing gently to coat and evenly distribute them. Transfer the beef mixture to a baking sheet and roast in the middle of the oven stirring once halfway through cooking, until the beef is lightly browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate, cover with foil and keep hot. Add the remaining marmalade to the hot skillet and stir until foamy, about 2 minutes. Add the achiote, serrano, and remaining 1/2 cup of cooking liquid and stir to combine. Add the pasta and remaining 1/2 cup of cooking liquid and stir to mix well, breaking up the spaghetti with a wooden spoon. Add the beef and vegetables and heat until heated through, about 3 minutes.

title: Frijoles Charros
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans ( the kind in the freezer section ) | 1/4 cup dried currants
instructions: The dried currants give the beans some color which goes away as they're dry. Be sure to keep the currants in the freezer. Place the pinto beans in a pot and cover with water by 2 inches. Add enough salt to the water so that they're just barely covered. Cook on low heat. After about 1 1/2 hours, check water level, and cook until they're tender. They'll be soft but can be cooked a second day. If they're not tender all the way, but still soft, you can take them out of the heat and stir them in the currants. The beans should be creamy, but you can mash them if you like.

title: Baked Roast Beef (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lbs roast beef ( eye round or sirloin ) | 2 dried red chilies | 2 tablespoons aged shaoxing wine | 1 -2 tablespoon light teriyaki sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut roast diagonally across grain in 1/4 inch slices. Place slices on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Drizzle with olive oil and cover with foil. Bake at 400 degrees f for 5 hours or until meat thermometer registers 140. Remove from oven. Pour off fat from pan, discard pan juices. Place dried chiles in a dry skillet over medium heat until soft, 5 to 7 minutes. Turn chiles over and place in a sieve to remove excess moisture. Using slotted spoon, transfer chiles to a bowl. Place roast in the pan and sear 3 to 4 minutes on each side, remove from heat and set aside, covered, in refrigerator, 20 minutes. Discard fat remaining in pan. Using a fine mesh sieve set over a bowl, pick out as many chiles as desired and reserve. Cook chiles in reserved fat in skillet over high heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant and slightly darkened, about 1 minute. Stir in wine and cook, stirring constantly, until liquid is reduced by half. Add chile mixture to beef. Remove from heat and let rest 15 minutes. Meanwhile, remove roast from oven, cover with foil, and let rest 15 - 30 minutes. Place beef on plates and surround with sauce.

title: Coconut Macaroon
ingredients: 5 -6 firm, ripe coconuts or 4 -6 macaroons | 1 can coconut milk ( coconut milk is more authentic )
instructions: Put coconut milk in a pan big enough to hold the macaroon mixture. Bring to a boil or simmer gently until liquid is absorbed. Add macaroons. Stir for about 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Cool macaroon mixture to room temperature. Cover the macaroon mixture with plastic wrap. Freeze macaroon mixture till needed. Serve with a tall glass of coconut milk.

title: Mushroom Ricotta
ingredients: 1 cup sourdough starter | 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh mushrooms | 1 1/4 pounds ricotta cheese | 1 can tomato paste | 1 green giant, chopped spinach leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve the starter under running water and let it foam. Stir in mushrooms, ricotta cheese, tomato paste and green giant. Cook 5 minutes over medium heat, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Lamb Shank in Barley
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shank or 1 kg lamb shank | 300 -400 ml chicken stock or 300 -400 ml thickened chicken soup | 400 g dried chickpeas, soaked over night | barley ( to garnish )
instructions: Place beef and chickpeas in a bowl. Pour hot boiled stock over and set for at least 5 hours. Cut up lamb and cook in the crockpot for at least 90 minutes. Garnish with barley.

title: Kebabs with Onions
ingredients: 2 lbs vidalia onions, cut in half | 1/2 bunch coriander seed, cracked to release flavor | 1 1/2 tablespoons black peppercorns, crushed & ground | kalamata olive, halved
instructions: Place onion halves and cracked corriander seeds in a large bowl. Rinse onion under cold water for 5 - 10 minutes. Rub onion with salt, to rinse out excess moisture, and place in a glass bowl or plate and set aside 30 minutes drain onion in a colander set over a bowl, rinse with cold water and then drain again. Place onions and cracked corriander seeds in a mortar& pestle and grind until finely ground. Add remaining ingredients and grind for 10 - 15 grinds. Form patties about 2 inch thick. Grill over medium coals, basting occasionally, until hot and cooked through, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,pastry flour,malt vinegar,red cabbage,vanilla bean
title: Sweet Wine and Mascarpone Cheese for the Holidays
ingredients: pastry flour, for dusting | 12 ounces red cabbage, finely shredded | 1 large vanilla bean, split lengthways | 4 ounces sweet malt vinegar, warmed | 7 ounces fresh-made mascarpone cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f lightly dust the dough cloth lightly with flour and roll out. Divide the cabbage among the 4 oz ramekins and put a piece of the vanilla bean on top of each. Whisk together the sweet mavarpone with about a tbsp or so of olive oil and some malt vinegar to form a soft, creamy cream. Spoon the cream mixture into the ramekins and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until the surface is just lightly golden. Dust with the remaining flour and serve straight away.

title: Pork Tofu
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 1/2 cup minced fresh coriander, leaves ( cilantro ) | 1 lb thick-cut pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 lb tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Toss the tofu and coriander into a large resealable plastic zipper bag. Add pork and brown in hot oil in a large frying pan. Remove from skillet. Reserve hot oil. Stir in tomatoes and white pepper. Return pork to skillet, saute approximately 15 minutes, or until pork is browned.

title: Lebanese Green Olives
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons green olives, drained and chopped ( kalamata olives ) | 3 teaspoons adobo sauce
instructions: Mix the yogurt, olives, and adobo sauce in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight to develop the flavors. Serve chilled.

title: Chipotle Salsa - Mexican Restaurant
ingredients: 6 scallions, large, chopped | 4 dried chili peppers, i use chili flakes | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight. My note, the original recipe called for 1/4 tsp of crushed red pepper flakes only and i'm not sure how much i can get from it. As mentioned in the article, the author seems to find that it is not all the same taste. The author did play with the dried chili flakes a lil and had none of that on his salad. By the way, when i make this, i have to keep the dried chili flakes in a jar until dinner time. When buying canned chipotle peppers, you can get a double batch once you open and use 1 - 2 tsp of chili powder instead if the recipe read needs it. After all, the dried chili flakes can be difficult to break apart as well. I used this instead of chipotle flake and i didn't have to use the dried chili flakes. It's a hot pepper dip that has a very spicy mexican flavor that just about any other brand will do. Also, when you're buying dried chipotle peppers, you can get a double batch of that when you open it, it should last about 4 - 5 days in the fridge. The original recipe says to use fresh, chopped chile peppers and minced cilantro, but i've never had that come out anywhere near that. The recipe editor did her job fine. I have been told that a chipotle can can be refrigerated for 6 months.

title: Italian Porcini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb dried porcini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Cover porcini mushrooms with boiling water. Cover and leave in fridge for 48 hours. Drain water and cover with dry towel. Microwave for 4 minutes at high. Uncover and stir, microwave for 3 additional minutes. Drain porcini mushrooms and dry. Use immediately or store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,green chili pepper,mango chutney,cream celery soup
title: Chili Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 lbs bulk sweet italian sausage | 6 cans cream of celery soup ( fat free is okay ) | 3 -4 tablespoons mango chutney | 1/2 - 3/4 cup chopped chiles ( more to your own liking )
instructions: Cook the mild italian sausage in a skillet until it is mostly browned, then drain the fat. Return the sausage to the skillet and add cream of celery soup, mango chutney and chili to taste, mixing well. Simmer on low heat for about 20 minutes to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: mango,pea pod,brown rice,iceberg lettuce,chicken bouillon cube,sharp cheddar cheese,canola oil
title: Chicken Rice Salad With Mango and Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup fresh mango, very ripe, peeled, sliced in thick half rounds ( i use a combination of different mangos which are found frozen in an ice cube tray, sliced in 1 wide pieces ) | 1 cup mango puree or 1 cup canned peaches, cubed | 1 cup frozen peas pods, thawed | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, torn | 1 whole chicken bouillon cube | 1/3 cup brown rice or 1/3 cup jasmine rice | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese ( or a combination of both ) or 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese ( or a combination of both ) | 1/4 cup low-fat canola oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: In large bowl, toss rice and green lettuce. Add mango and chicken bouillon cube and combine. Add rice mixture, then cheddar cheese. Toss lightly to mix. Serve.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,mascarpone,green mango,extra tofu,icing sugar,green plantain,zucchini,chervil
title: Tofu Zucchini Tiramisu (No Fat and Noolesterol)
ingredients: 9 ounces mascarpone or 9 ounces lactose-free cream cheese ( or 1 1/2 14oz container whipped cream cheese, cut up ) | 6 tablespoons icing sugar ( confectioners'sugar, for dusting ) | 1/2 cup pitted green mangoes | 1 2/3 cups packed low-fat mascarpone or 1 2/3 cups other low fat mascarpone cheese | 1 large green plantain ( peeled, cut into 1/8 inch thick slices ) | nonstick cooking spray | 2 large zucchini ( very thinly sliced lengthwise into 3/4 inch strips ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chervil
instructions: Make sure the oven racks are in the upper and lower thirds of the oven. Prepare all cake ingredients, excluding the zucchini and chervil, by placing the grated or sliced mango in a bowl. Combine cheese, mascarpone, plantains, and a spoonful of marscapone mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. If the mascarpone is too thick, add a little water. Line a 9 inch springform pan with plastic wrap or foil which has been lightly oiled and sprinkled with icing sugar. Dip each zucchini strip in the mascarpone mixture, allowing the excess to drip back into the bowl. Using a very sharp knife, slice each piece in half, then remove the zucchini from the mascarpone mixture. Place a zucchini slice on the prepared springform pan, then top with some of the mango slices, then sprinkle with some chervil to serve.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,half cream,rice,lemon zest,couscous,green chilies,parmesan cheese,maple syrup
title: Spicy Mexican Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 cup quick cooking couscous | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 2 cups diced green chilies, drained | 1/2 cup grated extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup fresh grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 3 -4 cups hot cooked rice
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions, using the half and half in the measuring cup if necessary. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, cook the green chilies, cheddar, and 2 tbls. Of the parmesan in a little oil over high heat, stirring, for about 3 minutes or until cheese is melted and starting to turn golden. Turn mixture into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cornish hen,milk chocolate,confectioner sugar,baby red potato,riesling wine,jiffy corn muffin mix,treacle,brown rice
title: Frog in a Pond
ingredients: 2 lbs cleaned and trimmed cornish hens | 2 1/2 cups milk chocolate, melted | 1 cup treacle | 1 3/4 cups brown rice ( preferably jasmine ) | 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 2 boxes jiffy corn muffin mix | 2 1/2 cups baby red potatoes, boiled and cut in half | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar dissolved in 1/3 cup treacle
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f with rack at the lower middle. Place hens on a foil lined baking sheet and place in preheated oven. Bake for 25 minutes, then remove and let cool. Whisk melted chocolate into melted treacle, then dip hens in chocolate mixture and bake for another five minutes. Cool completely. Mix confectioners' sugar with 1 cup flour, then stir in remaining flour. Serve with boiled potato halves and blintzes.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,seasoning salt,coconut milk,vanilla,black mustard seed,seasoning,tart apple,feta cheese
title: Coco-Cola Salad
ingredients: 3 medium tart apples, such as granny smith, cut into 1/2 inch chunks ( such as golden delicious, or other tart apples ) | seasoning salt, to taste | 1/2 cup fat-free coconut milk | 2 teaspoons real vanilla | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning ( e.g. mrs. dash ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 3 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Line an 11 1/2x7 1/2 inch baking dish with plastic wrap, which has been lightly sprinkled on the top of the apples. Combine the apples, sprinkle with seasoning salt and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. In a blender, combine coconut milk, vanilla, mustard seeds, seasoning mix and feta cheese and purée until smooth. Spoon apple topping over the apples and sprinkle with parsley.

title: Apple Macaroni
ingredients: 1 cup egg noodles, uncooked, | 6 ounces apple juice | 3/4 cup macaroni, uncooked, uncooked
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions before draining. In a sauce pan, combine apple juice with macaroni and cook until macaroni is dry. Add noodles and stir to coat.

title: Basic Love Food's Basic Recipe for Dry Rub for Vegetables and Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 3 tablespoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Mix everything except for the fish and dry fish. Cover and store in refrigerator until ready to serve. When ready to use, coat fish with the rub.

Random Ingredients: lentil,black olive,saffron thread,extra virgin olive oil
title: Lentils With Olives (Mediterranean style)
ingredients: 350 g lentils, lentils only | 100 g black olives | 6 -8 saffron threads | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Wash the lentils. Rinse them well in water. Place lentils in a large pot. Add 5 - 8 cups of water. Add saffron and bring to boil. Then add olives and cover pot. Cook until lentils are soft but not mushy. The time will vary considerably depending on saltiness of saltiness in lentils and olives. Serve with bread, croutons or fried potato crisps. Variation, for a change.

title: Chinese-Style Milk
ingredients: 4 cups non-salt whey ( see note ) | 1/2 cup sweetened soy milk
instructions: Pour non fat yogurt into a small bowl. Pour about 1/4 cup soy milk into the yogurt bowl. Stir until yogurt is homogeneous. Cover bowl and refrigerate until very cold, about 1 hour. Stir once or twice. Uncover bowl, add remaining soy milk and stir gently until it has been absorbed into soy milk. Serve with plain rice.

title: Marinated Carnitas
ingredients: 4 lbs beef flank steak | 4 lbs ground pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons oregano leaves
instructions: In plastic bag, place carnitas and contents of bag. Add 2 tbsp oregano. Close bag tightly and refrigerate 24 to 48 hours. Drain well. Note, you may use any number of ingredients. Use 1 1/2 cups of carnitas per lb of meat.

title: Rice Ring (Kosher)
ingredients: 1 box dry arborio rice | 1 package lemonade mix | celery salt
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold running water. Drain well and place in a large bowl or plastic bag. Add about 1 1/2 tbsp of lemonade mix. Squeeze and mix well. Add the remaining lemonade mix. Mix well until all ingredients are incorporated and the rice is evenly coated.. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 3 - 4 hours, stirring the rice every 30 - 45 minutes. Do not leave this longer. Towards the end of the 3 hours and the rice is very firm, remove from the refrigerator and place on a large platter. Use as much of the remaining marinade as you like and stir into the rice. Sprinkle with celery salt.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,white sugar,tamarind paste,butter,lobster meat,italian seasoning
title: Lobster Sauce II
ingredients: 4 tablespoons butter | 2 pounds fresh lobster meat, cubed | 1 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook lobster meat in butter, stirring frequently, until no longer pink and juices run clear. Combine picante sauce, sugar, tamarind concentrate and italian seasoning into lobster mixture. Heat through.

title: Peppered Pork With Prunes and Cherry (Pfirni Prikote)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, fat trimmed | 32 prunes | 12 -16 fresh cherries | 2 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 vanilla bean, split and scraped
instructions: Cut pork tenderloins in half lengthwise with a serrated knife. Remove any fat. Sprinkle pork generously with salt and pepper. Place prunes and cherries, cut sides down, in a shallow roasting pan large enough to hold meat. Pour beef broth into pan.

title: Guacamole Sticks
ingredients: 1 cup guacamole, fresh | 2 tablespoons cilantro, fresh chopped | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, ground | 1 grape leaf, dried, to serve
instructions: Soak the dried grape leaves a little. Drain well then dry on paper towel. Place the guacamole in a bowl, using a spoon mix well. Add the cilantro, flour, cardamom and the fresh grape leaves then gently mix with fingers. The oil in the bowl should cling to it. Dish up the sticks either by shaking them off with a spoon or folding them into sticks of desired size. Serve it immediately with salsa.

title: Japanese Furikake
ingredients: 1/2 sheet nori, cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1 quart cold water | 2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Line the nori lengthwise with a sheet of nori. Bring 1 quart of cold water and garlic powder to a boil in a large pot of rapidly boiling water. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat, drop in the nori strips and allow to soak for 1 hour. Drain well and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,tuna,cinnamon raisin bread,green chile pepper
title: Mexican Pork Sausage and Tuna Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf cinnamon raisin bread | 1 pound pork sausage | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 2 cans tuna, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the rolls in half, and hollow out the inside of the bread. Place the bread inside a large skillet over medium high heat, and cook the sausage until evenly brown.

title: Quick Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried red kidney beans, washed, picked over and soaked overnight | 1 large bell pepper, seeded and diced ( red, green or yellow ) | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Place the beans in a heavy saucepan. Add enough water to cover them by 1/ place over high heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until tender, about 1 hour drain the beans and transfer them to an electric blender or food processor place in a large casserole dish. Add the bell pepper and zest and puree until smooth. Pour the liquid over the beans and simmer, stirring often until the beans and pepper are hot. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,grand marnier,yellow cornmeal,vegetable oil cooking spray,ha avocadoes
title: Averna's Averna-Pancho Guacamole
ingredients: 4 medium hass avocadoes, peeled, seeded, and cut into 24 slices | 3 tablespoons yellow cornmeal | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 cups vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange a 1 1/2 cup gratin dishes in a roasting pan large enough to accommodate all of the avocado slices in a single layer. Spray pans lightly with cooking spray. Place chile slices in the bottom of one of the grates, about 1/2 inch in diameter. Place 1 potato slice on the grates, leaving about 1/2 inch of dough around the edge for spreading.

title: Steamed Corned Salmon
ingredients: 1 corned salmon | 1 -2 cup mustard, to taste | 1 smoked beef brisket
instructions: Open corned salmon and cut across the grain, about half way through. Slice brisket across the grain at an angle. Place corned salmon on a plate with a piece of smoked beef brisket, but leave the bones on. Cover the brisket with salt, cover with clean cold water, and put in a roasting pan or steamer. Bake in a boiling, covered pan for 15 minutes. Remove the brisket and place on a platter with a smoked beef roast bone and some of the accumulated water on top. Cover the pan tightly and steam for at least 3 hours. Remove the brisket and skim off the fat. Strip the fat from the pan and thicken the cooking liquid with a mixture of a little mustard salt and a little flour. Reheat the liquid over medium heat briefly to bring it to a simmer. Taste and add more mustard salt if needed. If needed remove the brisket from the pan before serving.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,tomato paste,cheese,vegetable broth,carnation milk,stewing beef,butternut squash,lime juice
title: Stampede Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 1 lime, juice of | 10 ounces tomato paste | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 can carnation evaporated milk | 2 cups butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 8 tablespoons shredded cheese, if desired | 1/4 cup grated chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Combine meat, lime juice, tomato paste, vegetable broth and evaporated milk in slow cooker and stir. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 15 hours, or on high for 4 to 5 hours. Add squash, cheese and chocolate and stir.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,pasta sauce,snow pea,lemon zest,dark rum,sirloin tip roast,linguine,cheese tortellini
title: Beef Tortellini W- Lemongrass
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-sodium pasta sauce | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 -2 teaspoon lemon zest ( optional ) | 1 lb sirloin tip roast or 1 lb rib eye roast | 1 1/2 cups fresh cheese tortellini or 1 1/2 cups dried tortellini | 1/2 cup chopped lemongrass ( green onion ) | 1/4 cup thawed frozen sliced snow peas ( optional ) | fresh basil leaf, shredded for garnish
instructions: Place the pasta sauce, rum, zest and if using, lemon juice in a small non reactive saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover, heat to simmer, and cook until the beef is browned and tender. title: Slow-Cooker Vietnamese Pork
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1/2 - 3/4 cup nuoc nam ( fish sauce ) | 2 -3 tablespoons garam masala | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes | 3 1/2 - 4 1/2 cups low sodium broth | 2 -3 lbs pork tenderloin, strings removed, cut into 1 1/2 to 2 inch pieces
instructions: Trim and discard some of the fat from the roast if desired, then cut into 1 1/2 to 2 inch pieces. You might like to dice the meat smaller. Arrange the meat in a single layer on top of the mixture in the slow cooker. Do not stir. Set the cooker on the highest setting and give everything a stir. Turn down the heat to low when the cooker starts to whistle, but gently plug in a 2 1/2 to 3 pound heatproof cutting thermometer. It should read exactly 118 degrees f. Check the pork in the center, if it is browned outside but tender inside, the meat is done. Set the cooker to high and cook for one hour, or until the meat is tender and the meat is falling apart when inserted with a fork. The pork will need to sit for at least 5 to 6 hours, then serve the pieces immediately..

title: Basic French Bread

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,snow pea pod,penne pasta,serrano chili,maraschino cherry
title: Penne Al Limone Con Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 packages dry penne pasta | 3 maraschino cherries | 16 snow pea pods | 1 whole serrano chili | 2 drops vanilla extract
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil, salt heavily and stir in the penne. Cook until el dente. Drain well and return to same pot. Stir in the cherries, snow peas, serrano chili, vanilla extract and cherries. Cook gently until mixture turns bright red and cherry flavors blend. Serve garnished with a spoonful of fresh or dried cherries.

title: Rice, Peppers, and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 package pepperoni, sliced | 1 package mixed dried fruit
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, slice pepperoni.

title: Low Fat Zucchini, Burgers, Fritters, Pancakes, and    Caramelized Fritters
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, grated | 1 pinch allspice | 1 pinch white pepper | 1 pinch xanthan gum | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground allspice | 4 -6 tablespoons flour ( or more if desired ) | 200 g hamburger | 1 dash salt, to taste | 1 dash salt, to taste | 200 g pancake mix flour or 200 g pancake mix ( or more if desired ) | 3/4 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Mix all the ingredients, except flour and cook in a frying pan on high, stirring from time to time, until the zucchini is cooked but still have a bit of texture. This should take 2 to 5 minutes with low medium heat. While this is cooking, mix together the ingredients for the caramelized fritters and place in your belgian flatout/pancake mix to make patties, flipping once so each side develops a nice 'gluten' shape. The burgers usually take about 5 or 6 minutes cooking, but you can cook them on a foreman type griddle.

title: Eggplant (Aubergine) Spread
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, unpeeled and cut lengthwise into 1/4 slices ( about 3 ounces each ) | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1 tablespoon margarine ( can use unsalted, or a combination of both ) or 1 tablespoon olive oil ( can use unsalted, or a combination of both ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened salsa ( medium sized, low sodium ) | 4 tablespoons teapsoon brewed quinoa, drained, rinsed ( i use progresso roasted spanish rice )
instructions: Place 2 oven racks in upper third of oven and preheat oven to 450°f. Place eggplant slices on racks and lightly spray them with cooking spray. Bake until browned, about 35 to 40 minutes. Transfer to large bowl. With a rubber spatula, press down on slices to release juices. Set aside. Place eggplant in food processor or blender. Add next 3 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,rice powder,walnut,rye flour,caster sugar,puff pastry,egg white,channa dal
title: Spicy Broccoli and Rice Kwas Wraps
ingredients: 180 g frozen puff pastry | 1 1/2 cups channa dal, chopped | 1 1/2 cups broccoli florets | 1/2 cup sweet potato's wholemeal rice powder | 1/2 cup walnuts, roughly chopped | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1 egg white | 1 sheet puff pastry
instructions: Preheat a large non stick frying pan or girdle over medium high heat/onion etc for a couple of minutes. Add the chillies and cook for about five minutes, then mix in the rice until it becomes translucent. Add water, a pinch or two of salt, and chillies and bring to the boil. Once mixture reaches boiling stage, add the peas, sweet potato's wholemeal rice, walnuts and caster sugar and cook for another three minutes. Remove from heat. Place 1 sheet of pastry on a flat surface and with a slightly damp towel, gently lightly dust the sheet with rice powder. Then place half of the rice mixture in a line down the middle of the pastry, and spread evenly. Place another one over that. Cut the roll into 12 even sized pieces, wrap in a plastic wrap and then in more foil/seal that is just damp and secure. Repeat steps four 5 with the rest of the pastry and filling. Cook the wraps in a large saucepan of boiling water for about 15 minutes until they float. If not all cooked well, they can be kept in an airtight container for up to a couple of days. Serve hot or warm.

title: Curried Celery
ingredients: 1/2 cup red curry paste | 1 small stick celery | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom seeds ( optional )
instructions: Saute celery in curry paste over medium heat for about 7 minutes, or until tender. Sprinkle with cardamom.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,coleslaw,chicken bouillon cube,yam 'suran,beef shank,yellow cornmeal,caster sugar,dill weed
title: Gazpacho
ingredients: 1 lb beef blade chuck or 1 lb boneless chuck | 2 beef shanks | 1 large yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon dill weed | 1 beef soup bone ( i use maggi ) or 1 soup chicken bouillon cube ( i use maggi ) | 4 ounces coleslaw mix ( green onion ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 teaspoon fresh dill weed or 1 teaspoon dried dill weed ( optional )
instructions: Trim excess fat from the chuck and cut meat in 1/2 cubes. Mix beef, shanks, cornmeal, dill weed, stock and sugar in a medium bowl. Mix until all the meat is broken into smaller chunks and add meat to onion. Mix well and cover with clean water. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Put a pan of boiling water on to boil for gumboza. When water comes to a boil add the gumboza and stir well. Cook for 1 minute. If you see some bits of gumboza floating to the top of the gumboza, you know that it's done. If not, cook additional 5 - 6 minutes. Drain and serve gumboza with a side of boiled potato wedges, cabbage or fried plantains.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,grain white rice,lemon peel,cumin seed,active yeast
title: Arabic Spiced Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup short-grain white rice, washed ( not instant ) | 1 3/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 1 1/4 teaspoons orange zest, minced | 1/4 teaspoon lemon peel, minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. In a 3 1/2 to 4 quart bowl combine the rice, yeast, cumin, orange zest and lemon peel. Mix thoroughly with a wire whisk. Pour the mixture into 2 baking sheets coated with cooking spray, then bake until a brown, puffy loaf of sticky white rice forms on top, 25 to 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes, then cut into 1 1/2 inch slices.

title: Cheesy Hot Pepper Queso Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely-chopped fresh hot pepper, such as kirbys ( or 2-3 jalapeno peppers ) | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar ( i use sucanat ) | 2/3 cup shredded mexican blend cheese, or to taste ( can use cheddar cheese )
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, place 3/4 cup shredded cheese and minced hot peppers. Stir until well blended, then bring to a simmer. Stir in sugar.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,vegetable oil cooking spray,half,eggplant,mustard,cardamom pod
title: Mantwo Cakes
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and cubed on a bias | vegetable oil cooking spray | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Place eggplant in a dutch oven or saucepan and pour boiling water over it. Cover and cook over medium low heat until eggplant is tender, about 20 minutes. Let cool, then squeeze out excess water. Place eggplant in a bowl, reserving liquid. In a microwave safe bowl, combine tomato paste, half and half, mustard and cardamom pod. Heat for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Pour over cooled eggplant.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,caster sugar,asparagus,sesame seed,cheddar cheese,turnip,fenugreek seed,madeira wine
title: Turnip Cheese and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed | 5 ounces grated cheddar cheese | 3 ounces raw turnips | 2 ounces chopped fenugreek seeds | 2 saffron strands | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 2 teaspoons caster sugar
instructions: Steam asparagus for 3 - 4 minutes, until tender, but don't overcook. Put cheese, turnips and fenugreek in a large bowl. Toss with the saffron, sesame seeds and madeira in a little extra virgin olive oil. Fold in the cheese mixture just before serving. Sprinkle over the sesame seeds and serve.

title: Cousins Style Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 4 ears corn, in the shell ( shucked, with tender kernels or kernels left intact ) | 1/8 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 bouquet garni | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh lettuce leaves
instructions: Prepare the corn and remove entrails from the corn kernels and discard the husks. Sprinkle the corn with bicarb soda and place a corn cob in the centre of the cob. Bring the sides of the corn towards the centre of the corn, and roll up the corn to enclose the corn in a loose packet. Tie tightly and place in an ice chest plastic bag or lid and freeze for an hour or so. Place the frozen corn packet on a plate large enough to contain everything and gently pound the corn. Sprinkle with chopped lettuce leaves and squeeze a little water onto the lettuce to moisten. Serve with a sprinkling of fresh coriander or mixed herbs.

title: The Best Orecchiette
ingredients: 400 g orecchiettes | 400 g mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Cook the orecchiette in boiling water for 9 - 10 minutes. Drain very well. Serve.

title: Italian Okra Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs frozen okra ( or fresh ) | 2 tablespoons mixed spice | 2 tablespoons cumin | 1 1/2 cups dry spaghettini | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley | 1 1/2 cups honey ( or agave syrup )
instructions: Cut okra into 1 inch pieces. Place in a 6 qt crockpot. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp of each of the mixed spice and cumin. Cover and cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or until okra is soft. If planning on serving right away, refrigerate well and reheat if necessary. Cook spaghettini according to package directions. Drain well and return to pot. Stir in honey and reheat, uncovered, for 5 more minutes. Serve immediately or allow to cool and serve cold. Note, if using frozen okra, defrost in microwave for 3 minutes. Add okra to stew during last five minutes of cooking.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,baby spinach leaf,cilantro leaf,cilantro,pickling spice,lemon,flour,pinto bean
title: Chili-Seasoned Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon pickling spices | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons flour | 12 ounces baby spinach leaves, packed | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: In a dutch oven or other heavy pot with a tight fitting lid or crockpot, brown stew meat until brown.

title: Spaghetti Squash - Zwt Three Cheese and Bread Loafing
ingredients: 1 cup diced plum ( dry ) | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm water ( about 130 degrees f. ) | 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti squash ( approx 3 pounds ) | 4 cups bread, finely crumbled & divided | 12 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese | 2 tablespoons diced pimento-stuffed plum ( optional )
instructions: Add a small amount of oil to a large pot of boiling water, and add the yeast and sugar. Let sit until foamy, about 2 minutes. Dump everything into the mixer bowl of a standing mixer with the rapid mixing feature and mix on medium until a dough forms, about 5 minutes. Pour in the warm water to dough. Turn dough onto a floured board and knead to smooth out the dough. When the dough gets smooth and elastic, divide it into 5 equal portions. Divide each into thirds to make 3 loaves. Set oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9 x 5 loaf pan. Working one third of the way, pat the dough into the loaf pan and smooth the top. Top with the 3 remaining loaves, pressing forward to flatten them slightly. Cut three slits across the top with a sharp knife. Brush the 4 pieces of bread with the rest of the oil and sprinkle evenly with the crumbled feta cheese. Loaves should fit easily into the loaf pan. Bake until light brown in color, 40 - 50 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes on a rack and slice into 10 - 12 squares. Sprinkle the sliced plums over top and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,red pepper flake,ketchup,portabella mushroom,oregano leaf,red onion,farfalle pasta
title: Garlicky Pasta With Portabella, Red Pepper & Kalamata Sauce
ingredients: 300 g farfalle pasta or 300 g bow tie pasta | 120 g sliced portabella mushrooms ( the mushrooms with juices ) | 150 g diced red peppers, halved | 1 red onion, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Cook the pasta following the packet instructions, drain. Meanwhile, heat a nonstick frypan over high heat, add 2 tbsp oil and mushrooms then cook, stirring, for 5 minutes until golden. Add pepper, onion, dried oregano and ketchup, stir and cook for 3 minutes, until onion has softened. Drain pasta and return to the pan, add onion mixture and remaining oil and stir well. Serve, warm or at room temperature.

title: Italian Baby Cherry Crumb Eggs
ingredients: 4 large eggs | 1 cup italian style dry breadcrumbs | 1 can pitted cherries or ( 28 ounce ) can other canned cherry fillings
instructions: In a double line of waxed paper, lightly beat together the eggs and the bread crumbs. Remove the waxed paper and add cherry fillings. Keeping the waxed paper over the top of the eggs, using a rubber spatula and starting with the waxed paper, mix the egg mixture, scraping down the sides. Use a pastry brush to dip each egg back into the bowl. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Heat a large griddle over medium high heat. Turn paper around until evenly coated with cooking spray and allow excess to drip off. Place eggs on the griddle in batches and cook until just set, about 3 minutes. Carefully place each egg onto a piece of waxed paper and cover with a clean kitchen towel. Allow to sit for a few minutes. Place the griddle over medium heat. Repeat with remaining eggs. Serve, allowing each egg to be scooped into a serving bowl.

title: Homemade Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup salad oil | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 2 -4 teaspoons minced fresh red chili peppers
instructions: In small bowl put salad oil, garlic powder and fresh chilies and mix well.

title: Chinese Take-Out Hot and Sweet Bai Rang Chilling Recipe
ingredients: 1 package bacon wrapped in aluminum foil | 5 -6 bamboo shoots, drained ( can substitute canned )
instructions: Mix the bacon and bamboo in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours. When ready to use, wipe off the bacon grease, unwrap the bacon and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Heat a wok until hot. Quickly pour oil into the pan.

title: Canned Mexican Fries
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs mirliton, cut into thin strips ( cut from stem to lower portion )
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, toss the mirliton strips until evenly coated. Cover and put in the freezer for about 20 minutes, turning often to get even coating. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Place the drained mirliton strips onto a floured surface and roll them up into 4 long, narrow strips. Transfer to a baking sheet lined with foil. Bake, stirring every 20 minutes for about 1 hour. The french fries will be tender. Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,italian turkey sausage link,apple juice,oyster
title: Roasted Sausages
ingredients: 4 ounces italian turkey sausage links | 4 sprigs thyme leaves | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f place sausage in 13x9 baking dish. Pour 1/4 cup apple juice over sausage. Top with thyme and remaining apple juice. Bake 30 minutes, basting every 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Roasted Red Chile Chilies
ingredients: 16 dried red chilies, pods seeded and patted dry | 2 tablespoons romano cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chilies on a lightly greased oven proof baking pan.

title: Bamboo Shoot Chowder
ingredients: 2 bunches mixed greens ( about 2-1/2 lbs ) | 6 cups canned bamboo shoots | 4 cups canned plum tomatoes | 1 1/2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 3 cups raw chicken stock or 3 cups broth
instructions: Wash greens, remove any tough stems, then cut in half lengthwise. Scrub cores from bamboo shoots, removing any remaining seeds. Chop leaves separately, discarding any tough outer stems. Place chowder in a large soup pot, add 1 1/2 cups water or stock. Wash and discard leaves, keeping water, cut green leaves into 1 inch pieces and rinse with cold water. Place in the soup pot. Add remaining ingredients, except greens and stock, and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer over low heat until greens are tender, about 1 hour. If mixture becomes too thick, stir in enough water to reach desired consistency. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Lamb and Gruyère Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb, cut into cubes ( leg ) | 1 lb cannellini beans or 1 lb other white beans ( or other white beans ) | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese | 3/4 cup grated greek pomegranate ( pomegranate seeds ) or 3/4 cup orange zest ( pomegranate seeds ) | 1/4 cup sweet paprika or 1/4 cup
instructions:

title: Beef Broccoli with Stout (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 bag frozen broccolini, cleaned and chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 lb round steak | 1 can light cream of mushroom soup | 2 bottles dark beer ( stout can or dark beer will do to do ) | 1 package frozen peas | liquid smoke
instructions: Clean and chop the beef. Combine the beef, worchestershire sauce, and dark beer, making sure it is completely mixed in. Pour vegetables into crock pot. Do not drain. Cook on low for 8 to 12 hours. Stir well. Pour undrained contents into shallow soup crock pot. Cover, and allow to heat 3 to 4 hours. If serving on day of eating, just stir and serve with noodles.

title: Italian Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 bone-in beef brisket, or as needed | 2 tea bags | 2/3 cup orange marmalade | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Open a shallow roasting pan, and place brisket on the pan. Open one tea bag and drop into the pot, allowing the air to circulate around the roast. Pour in enough marmalade to completely submerge brisket, making sure the marmalade covers the meat. Sprinkle zest and seasonings into the roast. Cover pan tightly with aluminum foil, then place roasting pan into roasting pan. Bake in the preheated oven until brisket is very tender, about 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Allow to stand 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,marinara sauce,dark soy sauce,lemon juice zest
title: Soy Sauce for Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 4 ears corn kernels, husked ( about 2 1/2 quarts ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice and zest | 1/3 cup commercial marinara sauce
instructions: Place corn on a large rimmed baking sheet. Coarsely chop the kernels.

title: Broke Guy's Fried Steak
ingredients: 4 fresh steaks, pounded thin, if the meat is too thin | 3 tablespoons butter | 7 bay leaves | butter ( for frying ) | 1 cup whole grain cereal
instructions: Heat up butter and fry the meat on both sides until brown. Drain on paper towels and slice into thin strips or serve in a large bowl with fried bay leaves and whole grain cereal for dipping.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,shortening,pizza crust,frank sauce,kidney bean,portabella mushroom
title: Spicy Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 teaspoons shortening or 2 teaspoons margarine | 10 ounces fresh kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 1 teaspoon frank's hot sauce | 1 unbaked pizza crust
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Melt the margarine in a large skillet on low heat. Add the kidney beans to skillet and stir until coated with margarine. Add the mushrooms, chipotle pepper, and hot sauce and cook 5 minutes or until tender. Add the beans to the skillet, mix well, and heat for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and top the pizza crust with the bean mixture and cover the pizza crust with a piece of waxed paper for a few moments to help it bake. Bake for 5 minutes at 350 degrees or until crust is crisp and lightly browned. Serve and enjoy.

title: Sausage and Celery Bites
ingredients: 4 links sweet italian sausage, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 4 celery, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 shallot, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh radishes | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning, from canned adobo concentrate | 2 1/2 cups plain flour, plus more if needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f grease a 5 1/2 x 3 1/2 loaf pan.

title: Sarasota's Salsa With Noodles and Radishes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 packet dry cellophane noodles | 1 -2 tablespoon italian salad dressing | 1/2 teaspoon malt extract | 2 1/2 ounces jar salsa, any thickness desired | 1/4 cup sliced radish
instructions: Prepare noodles, rinse under cold water and drain thoroughly. Cook 1 cup noodles in 2 quarts boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Drain noodles and rinse with cold water.

Random Ingredients: shallot,sesame seed,avocado,creme fraiche,green bean,gruyere cheese,lemon juice zest,dark soy sauce
title: Avocado-Shredded Green Bean Salad - Guy Fieri
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, from 3 to 4 lemons | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 2 cans small green beans, drained | 2 large ripe avocados, peeled seeded and julienned | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Combine lemon juice, soy sauce, honey, shallots, beans and avocados in a container.

title: Irish Collard Greens
ingredients: 1 lb collard greens | 1/3 cup low sodium malt vinegar | 4 tablespoons tomato-flavored broth | 8 1/2 ounces mixed greens, such as mustard greens, cormellini or arugula
instructions: Rinse collard greens well with water, drain. Place greens in a nonstick skillet or dutch oven with 2 tablespoons water.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,thyme sprig,grand marnier,courgette,mutton,lettuce leaf,half,red pepper flake
title: Steamed Mutton in Garlic and Thyme
ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo dough ( or 6 sheets other flat leaf pasta ) | 5 g of chopped asafoetida powder ( indian spice blend ) | 2 lbs mutton, washed and cut into medium sized slices | 2 tablespoons sieved garlic and thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 cup half-and-half | lettuce leaf, to serve | 1/2 cup grand marnier ( or other brandy )
instructions: First clean and prepare the garlic and thyme sprigs. Wash and soak the asafoetida powder in 1 - 2 tbsp warm water for about 20 minutes. Cut the meat into small pieces as it is cut. Steam the meat until it becomes semi firm and cooked, adding more water as needed. Add the sieved garlic and thyme leaves and saute for a couple of minutes. Add the pepper flakes and saute for another minute. Add the half and half and stir well. Add a handful of torn up lettuce leaves in just before serving. Remove the thyme sprigs.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,egg noodle,salami,parsley,liquid smoke,elderberry wine vinegar,masa harina,cumin seed
title: Elderberry Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb salami | 1/2 lb sirloin steak | 1/2 cup elderberry wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons mild liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon coarse ground cumin seed | 2 cups raw baby'nests'masa harina | 3 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with about 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Cut the salami up into cubes. Cut the steak into 1/2 cubes as well as the sirloin. Dice the beef into tinyish pieces as well as the steak. Soak the elderberry vinegar to soften it, and put it in a large mixing bowl and add in the chopped salami, grated sirloin, and sliced beef chunks. Mix them together in a separate bowl, and add in the minced parsley, liquid smoke, vinegar, vanilla sugar, cumin, and chopped fresh herbs. Stir well. In a separate bowl, mix in the masa harina and cornstarch until the cornstarch becomes pasty. Put the hot water into a medium saucepan, and then turn on medium heat. Stir every 5 to 10 minutes, just until the dough is very well cooked. You will be tempted to add water, so test it every 10 minutes to make sure it cooks evenly after adding in flour and cornstarch mixture. Keep stirring until the dough pulls off the sides of the pan. It is very important to not let the dough cook this long, or the dough will become very hard and dry. Cover the bowl with a damp towel and set it aside in a warm place for 15 minutes. After 5 minutes, take out the dough, uncover it, and fluff it with a fork. Put the mixture in a casserole dish, piling it like you did before. Cover the dish with cloth, and put it back into the warm place. Serve it hot.

title: Rotel Pizzas
ingredients: 3 cans rotel | 1 tablespoon garlic ( finely minced ) | 1 tablespoon buttermilk
instructions: Place all ingredients into a ziplock bag. Add one can of rotels at a time. Place on a cookie sheet for each to drop. Bake at 350 for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Quick Mexican Manicotti
ingredients: 24 manicotti | 5 cups fresh broccoli, chopped | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning
instructions: Fill pasta pot with water and heat to boiling. Saute broccoli just until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, steam manicotti noodles until tender, but still firm. Cook bacon grease until crispy, stir in soup, syrup, seasonings and pour over prepared noodles. I just toss it all together,. Serve with fresh grated cheese, shredded lettuce, tomatoes and basil and top with sliced cheddar cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: cod,chocolate chip,asafoetida powder,italian cheese,potato gnocchi,cauliflower,red wine
title: Potato Free Crust Fish Focaccia
ingredients: 1 cup italian cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons red wine, 2 1/2 cans, divided | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 lb potato gnocchi | 1 1/2 lbs cod, sliced in 1 1/2 inch thick pieces | 1 head cauliflower, cut in florets | 3/4 cup chocolate chips
instructions: In large bowl combine cheese, 2 tablespoons red wine, and asafoetida. On lightly oiled rack of a large cookie sheet, toss potato gnocchi with the seasoned cheese blend until coated. Spread over bottom of an 11 x 7 baking dish. Arrange fish on top, then set aside to marinate at room temperature while preparing the sauce. Cook potatoes gnocchi and cauliflower in boiling salted water for 10 minutes or until tender, drain. Remove from heat. Spread 1/2 cup red wine on the bottom of a greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Arrange fish on top of red wine, then sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup red wine. Drizzle reserved 1 tablespoons red wine on top. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Remove from refrigerator 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,cannellini bean,tart apple,egg,beefy mushroom soup,oyster sauce
title: Beefy Mushroom Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cans condensed beefy mushroom soup ( i use campbell's, i like the low fat version, can also use half & half ) | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 - 1 1/2-1 cup cooked cannellini beans ( reserve liquid for later ) or 1/2-1 cup other white beans ( reserve liquid for later ) | 4 large eggs | 1 small tart apple ( peeled and chopped if desired, i like them to be slightly fleshed ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a sauce pan, except the cannellini beans, and heat over low heat. In another bowl, beat the eggs slightly, then fold them into the mushroom mixture. Put the chopped apple into the soup mixture, stir well and place over low heat. If desired, mix in some of the reserved bean liquid to get an orange color egg soup consistency and serve over noodles with lots of crisp fresh chives and crusty french bread.

title: Red Beans and Sage
ingredients: 12 ounces red beans, cooked ( or beans of choice ) | 2 teaspoons sage leaves
instructions: Chop the fresh sage leaves.

title: Soy Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground beef bouillon powder | 3 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 3 tablespoons vinegar ( white wine vinegar preferred ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: Put all ingredients into a jar and shake well until sugar dissolves. Refrigerate. Enjoy.

title: Cashew and Coca-Cola Lassi
ingredients: 500 g unsweetened plain low-fat yogurt | 200 g cashew nuts, roasted, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup coca-cola | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender. Process until just mixed.

title: Easy Shredded Corned Beef
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef corned beef brisket | 2 teaspoons whole jeera powder | 1/2 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Place corned beef in large dutch oven. Sprinkle with adobo and remaining spice. Pour 3/4 cup water on top and stir to coat evenly. Cover with lid and simmer for 3 hours or until fork tender. Allow room to rest before slicing and serving.

title: Salmon & Cream Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet, about 6 ounces | 2 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | salad greens
instructions: Using a paring knife or sharp knife, slice fish on the diagonal into 3/4 wide strips. Add cream cheese to a small plate and turn up the heat slightly. When the cream cheese is melted, dip the salmon strips into the mixture. Gently stir the strips into the cheese. Pour the buttercream onto the bed of salad greens. Serve with hot cooked sahéed salmon.

title: Mint, Romaine and Mint Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn | 1 cup chopped fresh mint
instructions: Tear off the top and bottom of the romaine lettuce head. Tear off a 5 pound piece of romaine lettuce, if desired. Lay onto one large platter or cutting board and layer with the chopped lettuce, and sprinkle with chopped mint. Repeat with another bunch of lettuce to make 2 salad pans. Serve.

title: Crock Pot  Pecan Onion  Relish  for Beef  (Pecans)
ingredients: 4 large vidalia onions, cut in half ( about 4 1/2'sections ) | 8 -10 ounces pecan nuts ( optional )
instructions: Place onions in crock pot, sprinkle with pecans, and cover. Cook on low setting for 8 - 12 hours. Enjoy with your favorite crackers.

title: Grilled Indian Stuffed Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 1 loaf italian breadcrumbs | 1/2 lb salt pork ( or other ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 6 lime wedges or 6 lemon wedges
instructions: Preheat grill. Place salt pork in a mixing bowl with turmeric. In 1 gallon bag, fill 1/4 with bread crumbs. Shake to mix. Dip salt pork in bread crumbs, place on grill rack and sprinkle with a little bit of salt. Grill over medium coals about 10 minutes, turn, and brush with a little bit of oil. Cook just until bread crumbs turn golden brown, about 5 minutes. Repeat to make more 8 servings.

title: Cheddar Cheese & Chunky Onion Relish
ingredients: 6 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Melt cheese in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Cha Trai (Thitian Pork Shoulder)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder ( boston butt ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 baking potatoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Cut the meat up into 1 inch pieces removing the bone and any fat. Place the meat and potatoes in a bowl and pour in the fish sauce. Stir to coat and place in the refrigerator. Let the meat marinate for 2 hours or so at room temperature.

title: Danish Sauerkraut Balls
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 4 tablespoons light cream | 1/4 cup sweet sherry | 1 pinch ground nutmeg | 1 pinch grated nutmeg | chocolate shavings ( optional )
instructions: Place sauerkraut, graham cracker crumbs, light cream, sherry, nutmeg, and grated nutmeg in a bowl. Roll into 1 inch balls using the help of a fork. Cover and chill until firm. Place chocolate shavings on wax paper, or place under broiler for a few seconds until the chocolate is just melted. Place balls in the chocolate and return to microwave for about 20 seconds or until balls are warm and beginning to brown. Dip balls in chocolate and place on a serving plate with chocolate shavings, if desired.

title: Chickpeas With Aniseed
ingredients: 500 g canned chickpeas | 2 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients well and allow to sit for at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Chinese Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cream | 1 teaspoon finely chopped garlic or 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let mix for 20 minutes. Store in fridge.

title: Pork Chops in a Pink Pan (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 1 pork chop, sliced crosswise into thick strips | 1/3 cup dried mixed fruit | 4 radishes, sliced 1/8 inch ( about 1/2 pound ) | 2 bay leaves | 1/8 yellow bell pepper, sliced
instructions: In a large skillet, combine chopped pork chops with dried fruit, radishes, bay leaves, and sliced bell pepper.

title: Crock Pot Sauerkraut and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 package sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 1 container sweet chili sauce | 2 cups apple juice | 1 package farfalle pasta | shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef in 5 qt crock pot on high until beef is cooked through. Dump all ingredients in crock pot and mix well. Turn crock pot to low, and cook for about 11/2 to 13 hours, or until ingredients are tender and sauce is thick and bubbly.

title: Canadian Bacon, Pumpkin Seed & Chive Chive Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces diced canadian bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1 1/2 cups roasted pumpkin seeds | 8 ounces grated romano cheese, divided ( about 2 cups ) | 1 -2 teaspoon hot chives
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Serve with your favourite chips or as garnish on pasta.

title: Kaffir Lime Chips
ingredients: 2 cups ground hazelnuts | 4 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 1 teaspoon bouillon | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced sazon con azafran jalapeno peppers or 1 1/2 teaspoons other hot pepper | 2 -3 teaspoons minced adobo sauce or 2 -3 teaspoons chipotle hot sauce | 3 finely chopped kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Place hazelnuts on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until skin cracks and has light brown specks, about 25 - 30 minutes. Cool. Remove hazelnuts, place in a medium bowl. Add enough olive oil to the hazelnuts to make 2 cups. Stir to coat nuts. Set aside. In a mortar or coffee grinder grind the nuts until fine with only a few large pieces. Add other ingredients and blend well.

title: Cashew Baked Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice or 2 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/4 cup pecans ( optional ) | peanut oil or sunflower oil ( for frying ) | fresh ginger, peeled and minced | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 4 teaspoons grated orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Wash rice in large colander, then place in large nonstick frypan or pot with lid, with 3 cups boiling water. Bring to boil over high heat.

title: Mexican Chicken Cheese Bites
ingredients: 4 large ounces four-cheese mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup irish cream | 1/4 cup orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1/2 cup cooked chicken, torn into bite-size pieces
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, combine the four cheese mexican blend cheese, irish cream, orange peel, mexican oregano, and chicken pieces. Stir to combine. Pack cheese mixture into 9 x 13 inch glass casserole dish or equivalent.

title: Savory Swiss Chard with Covered Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, tough stems removed, chopped | 1/4 cup cream cheese | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning | 3/4 cup shaved reduced-fat provolone cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dark chocolate chips | cooking oil

ingredients: 1 pound pork stew meat | 2 cans sliced olives | 2 cans sliced ripe olives | 14 slices bread, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 can baby corn, drained | 1 jar brandy | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning, or to taste | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, or more to taste | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables

title: Fennel Beer Can Fry, Too.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 small fennel bulb, halved and cored | 1/2 - 3/4 lb lean ham, thinly sliced | bottled mild taco sauce | 3/4 cup good aged beer ( like guinness or another dark beer ) | 4 cups good-quality good-quality taco sauce | 2 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the fennel and, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, cook until it's tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Add the taco sauces and hot sauce and stir well. Transfer the cooked fennel to a warmed serving bowl and serve with warmed tortilla chips or tortilla chips.

title: Chinese Buffet Roly Poly - Roly Poly Mix for Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups rice flour ( can use up to 1/2 cup ) | anchovy paste
instructions: Put all ingredients in the bread machine as per the directions on the packaging, i used my bread machine. Mine will be the same from 5 minutes and has a very firm texture.. Random Ingredients: red chilies,plain flour,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,mirin
title: Chipotle Red Chilli Biscuits
ingredients: 12 red chilies, deseeded and de-seeded | 2 ounces plain flour | 2 ounces chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, coarsely chopped ( i like the mild and add a few of the seeds ) | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Preheat the oven 190c/374f/gas lightly grease a baking tin and line with baking paper or greaseproof paper. title: Pico de Gallo Pizza Pie
ingredients: 1 lb raw pasta ( rigatoni or rotini ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil, plus | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated lemon peel | 1 teaspoon soy sauce ( regular is ok ) | 1/4 teaspoon meat tenderizer | 2 tablespoons creme de cassis, warmed | 2 tablespoons pico de gallo, mexican style | 1 tablespoon cake yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Lightly oil a large, rimmed baking sheet or use a pizza stone. Cook pasta according to package directions and drain before stirring into the sauce. title: Broccoli Salad

instructions: Cook the broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes or until it starts to soften. Drain well. title: Delicious Black Forest Meat

title: Quick & Easy Mexican Meat Sauce

instructions: Simmer meat until falling off the bone. Mix beer, buttermilk and meat until well blended. Remove from heat, stir in buttermilk mixture and place in fridge until ready to serve.

title: Quick Berry Salad

instructions: Drain any excess moisture from frozen fruit.

title: Prosciutto Poppy Seed Bruschetta

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Lightly coat a nonstick baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray and line with parchment paper or a silpat. title: Rigatoni With Ginger, Lime Sauce and Lime

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and stir. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Sausage and Mozzarella Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles or 1 package fresh lasagna noodle | 1 package lean pork sausage links, halved crosswise, casings removed | 1 cup apricot preserves | 1 cup diced mango | 1 cup chopped hazelnuts | 2 cups hot cooked long grain rice
instructions: Cook pork sausage in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until heated through, about 3 minutes. Stir in apricot preserves, mango and nuts until heated through. Layer lasagna with sausage mixture and rice in the slow cooker crock. Cover and cook on low for 4 - 2 1/2 hours, or until heated through and sauce is slightly thickened around the edges.

title: Traditional Arabic Semolina Bread
ingredients: 4 cups semolina ( i prefer semolina! ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f, then mix 3 cups of the semolina and 1/2 tsp cream of tartar in a large bowl. The key is the mixing so the texture and flour gets absorbed evenly through the bread. Dough will not stick to the sides, but it should eventually turn into a smooth, smooth, soft porridge dough. With your hands, gather the dough into a ball shape on a board. Wrap in a piece of foil, or oiled cling film, and place in the oven. The temperature will drop, and your oven won't be too hot, so if you turn the oven off, you can return the dough to the oven for an additional 5 to 10 minutes. The dough should be a little soft and springy, but not completely firm.. At this point, your khoubz can then be placed on a floured surface, and lightly kneaded for a few minutes as you work, until the texture is almost fully blended and the dough becomes smooth. It helps prevent it from sticking to your hands. Return the dough to a lightly floured surface, and knead for about 10 minutes, until it becomes smooth and springy. This will take about 4 - 5 minutes. Remove from bowl and place on a floured surface, then knead for about 10 minutes, until the dough has reached the smoothness you desire. It does not have to be perfectly smooth but it should have a smooth, round texture with minimal lumps of bumps and grooves. If your dough is too loose and crumbly, you may want to add 1/2 tsp cream of tartar to the dough. Cut into 4 equal pieces. Turn the bread out onto a floured surface and flatten slightly to fit into a 9 by 9 inch glass pan. This should take less than 5 1/2 15 minutes. The bread should break into smallish pieces when it's throughly cut. It probably won't even be fully broken, not even close enough. Cut four slits along the top of the bread, and prick each side with a skewer. Bake in a preheated 400f oven for 15 minutes, until it's firm all over. Remove from oven, and let cool slightly before serving.

title: Yoghurt Marinated Orange Pepper and Yogurt Dip

instructions: Whisk yogurt into creamy orange juice. Stir in the chopped bell peppers. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

title: Avocado and Peppers With Burrata
ingredients: 7 ounces asadero cheese | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed, divided | 1 large red bell pepper ( optional ) | 6 firm avocados or 6 green bell peppers, roasted, seeded, peeled and seeded, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | fresh dill weed, for sprinkling | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained, rinsed and drained | 2 ounces red wine, room temperature
instructions: Finely shred cheese with 1 tablespoon dill, and set aside. Peel and seed peppers and slice into rounds 3/4 inch thick. Arrange on a serving platter. title: Danish Beef Salad

title: German Mushroom, Sauerkraut & Sauerkraut Salad

instructions: Place cottage cheese, vermouth and vinegar in food processor.

title: Coriander Crusted Beef Tenderloin

instructions: Trim the fat from the beef. Place the beef tenderloin in a shallow shallow pan. Toss the coriander with the roquefort, chile, and salt and pepper to your taste. title: Potato Roll With Cottage Cheese and Bacon

title: Simple and Easy Sausage and Mushrooms

instructions: Drain the sausage from its casing and discard casing. Cook sausage over low heat, crumbling the sausage as it cooks, until brown, about 10 minutes. Remove sausage from pan. title: Poblano Chiles (Pickled Italian Style)

Place chilies in your machine's top container, fill with vinaigrette, cover with plastic wrap, and place in the refrigerator to marinate for 4 to 6 hours. Cook 1/2 lb of the italian dressing in a small pan over moderate heat.

title: Mock Turkey Appetizers

instructions: First combine all the ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth adding some more water if necessary.

Drain brisket slices. Add to roasting pan. Drizzle with mustard oil dressing. Bake at 300°f for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until meat is fork tender.

title: Miso Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons reduced sodium miso | 1 lb button mushroom, cleaned and cut into 1/4 `` diagonal slices | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Combine miso, mushrooms, cornstarch and 2 tbsp water in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high, stirring twice, 30 seconds or until bubbly.

title: Matzo and Olives Cakes With Garlic (Passover)
ingredients: 6 large eggs, at room temperature | 16 ounces fresh black olives | 8 cups matzo meal | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly butter a baking sheet and set aside. Beat all of the ingredients into a medium bowl with a fork or electric mixer. If you need to do this in batches, you can just beat the ingredients together. Form the mixture into small oval cakes about 3 to 5 inches long, about 1 1/2 inches wide and 2 inches across. Lightly grease your pans. Pour the mixture onto the baking sheet and bake 20 to 25 minutes, until puffy and toasted. Cool cakes in the pan on a rack.

title: Matzoh-Type Corned Beef on Basmati
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped cilantro or 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 3 lbs corned beef brisket, cut crosswise into 4 portions | 4 teaspoons dry matzo meal ( matzoh meal )
instructions: Place the corned beef pieces in a 13 x 9 inch single layer in a dutch oven or other heavy, ovenproof skillet. Sprinkle with the cilantro and cover with water. Bring to a boil over moderate heat, covered, and simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until meat is tender. Add the matzoh meal mixture and simmer until the mixture is slightly thickened, about 10 minutes. Remove the meat from the pan.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,andouille sausage,purple onion,raspberry,egg yolk,pizza crust,sourdough bread
title: Sausage and Sweet Onion Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1 tablespoon sourdough bread ( crust removed ) | 2 ounces andouille sausage | 1/2 cup purple onion, thinly sliced | 1 pinch coarse sea salt | 4 egg yolks ( hard boiled ) | 1/3 cup purple onion, julienned | fresh raspberry, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 550° f. Spread the crust with sourdough bread. Arrange sausage over the bread and top with the onion and salt. In a small bowl, combine the egg yolks and stir in a small amount of water. Add the egg mixture to the sauage mixture. Spoon mixture over the bread. Bake at 550 f for ten minutes. Garnish with fresh raspberry slices.

Random Ingredients: spicy pork sausage,italian salad dressing,cantaloupe,bread crumb,hard egg,chunky salsa,ginger juice
title: Mexican Style Cantaloupe Sausage With Hard-Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 1 package pork sausage | 1 can spicy pork sausages | 1 cup italian salad dressing | 1 cup fresh bread crumbs | 1/2 cup fresh ginger juice | 1 cup chunky salsa | 3 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove casings from sausage, and tear into large chunks. Cut sausage up into ½ inch pieces. Place sausage into a bowl, add italian dressing, bread crumbs, ginger juice, salsa, and hard boiled eggs. Mix all ingredients thoroughly together. Transfer to a baking pan. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Spinach Pie Pasta
ingredients: 1 package gemelli pasta | 1 container cool whip | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the gemelli, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm but still slightly firm, about 13 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Whisk the cool whip and seasoning together in a bowl until just blended well, then gently fold in the pasta. Transfer to a 9x5 inch baking dish.

title: Truffle-Style Lamb
ingredients: 2 lamb fillets | 1 tablespoon fine salt | 2 tablespoons caramels in the jar | 1 can sweet corn | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: In food processor or large bowl, combine lamb, salt and caramels. Process until mixture forms a smooth paste. Spread sauce over the top of the lamb. Wrap with plastic wrap, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, but no longer than 1 day, turning once. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Unwrap the lamb. Place the meat in a roasting pan, and roast in the preheated oven 20 minutes, basting occasionally with the pan juices. Remove from oven, and tent loosely with foil. Set it aside at room temperature for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and discard the salt inside the roasting pan. Stir cornstarch into the juices until well mixed and return to oven, stirring to thicken. Arrange the lamb on a platter, and spoon sauce over.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,chinese five spice powder,cornflour,arborio rice,caper,french bread,chicken leg,tomato sauce
title: Chicken Rissettes
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken legs, with skin | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 slice french bread | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | grated parmesan cheese, to serve
instructions: Place chicken legs in a large frypan with enough water to come 1/2 of the way up the chicken legs. Put chicken legs over water and bring to the boil, then lower the heat and cover. Cook for 1 1/2 hours, skimming off any scum that rises to the surface, skimming as necessary. Remove chicken from the pan and keep warm. Skim excess fat from cooking broth. Measure out the broth, and use to make risé with the remaining broth and seasoning. Bring the pan back to the boil, then add the rice, bring back to the boil, cover and reduce heat. Cook for a further hour or until the rice is cooked. Preheat the oven to 220c/425°f rub 3 tbsp of the cornflour onto the arborio rice, then mix with half the tomato sauce. Divide the rice between 2 ovenproof, shallow, ovenproof bowls, then place equal amounts of the chicken risotto on each, then spread about 1/2 tbsp of the reserved tomato sauce mixture on each, then cover with the bread. Bake in the oven for 10 mins, then set a serving plate on top and serve with extra tomato sauce, capers and parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,mustard seed,lemon juice zest,pork loin
title: Homemade Kidney Beans
ingredients: 300 g pork loin | 300 g dry kidney beans | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Wash the pork loin in cold water and dry. Put the lemon rind and juice inside the beans. Wash the beans thoroughly and put into the pan with the pork. Bring to the boil. When it reaches the boil, allow it to simmer for one hour until the pork is cooked. Turn off the heat and add mustard seeds. Serve.

title: Linguine with Spinach & Spinach
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 600 g swiss chard ( leaves picked over, stalks torn into bite size pieces )
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pan of boiling salted water according to packet instructions. Meanwhile, combine pasta with chard stalks and pour over lots of plenty of cold water, making sure to stir it around. Cover and leave to stand until pasta is tender and tender. Serve immediately.

title: Pasty Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 6 sheets phyllo pastry | 3 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c put enough flour on you tray to make a rectangle of about 8 x 5 x 2 inches square. Place a sheet of phyllo on top and brush over the flour. Repeat with four sheets of pastry. Bake for 20 minutes until golden brown. Cool in the tins for 5 minutes. Unroll and leave to cool completely. Store in an airtight container with a damp cloth on it. Variation, add 1/2 to 3/4 cup mixed frozen vegetables, ie peas, chopped cauliflower or spinach.

title: Aussie Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 2 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, cut into 8 slices | 1/4 cup shallot, minced
instructions: Combine the colby jack cheese and minced shallots. Place in a baking dish coated with cooking spray and lightly sprinkle with paprika if desired. Bake at 400 degrees f for 8 minutes or until crisp and light brown,.

title: Bistro Poached Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, scaled and without skin | 4 slices bread, cut to 1/2 inch thick
instructions: Take each piece of salmon, and, using two sharp knives, cut in half lengthwise. Using a long sharp knife, cut out the centre bone in each piece of salmon. This makes it slightly easier to slice and cook in the oven. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Place each piece of salmon on an oven tray, and spread with one slice of bread. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,zucchini,garlic clove,beef oxtail,fenugreek seed,walnut,pecan
title: Taco Meat & Pecan Skillet
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef oxtails | 1 cup walnuts | 1/2 cup pecans | 1 garlic clove | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1 1/2 taco seasoning mix | 1 small zucchini
instructions: Cut large chunks of oak, charcoal, wood, apple or wood chips into large chunks. I use a wood grill. Cook all the above ingredients in a saucepan on medium heat, covered, for about 1 hour. Remove from heat, add the nuts and pecans, cover and refrigerate, tightly covered, turning occasionally, for about 1 more hour. Heat a grill pan or skillet on medium low heat, brush it with a little oil, and sear the oxtails on all sides, about 6 minutes, or until brown. Add the nuts and nuts to the oxtails and let them cool for 3 to 4 minutes. Return the meat to the pan, and stir in the taco seasoning and walnuts. Slice the zucchini in half and place on top of the meat.

Random Ingredients: veal,pearl barley,white bean,mint,garlic clove,beef sirloin steak
title: Beef With White Beans and Herbs
ingredients: 2 beef sirloin steaks, trimmed | 6 ounces dried white beans | 3 tablespoons pearl barley | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1 ounce fresh mint, chopped | 1/2 ounce veal, chopped
instructions: Place the beans in a pan with water and bring to the boil, then simmer for 8 minutes until the beans are tender. Place the steaks in a shallow, ovenproof dish and pour over the beans. Add the garlic, mint and veal to the beans and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the meat is tender. Cover and reheat the beans for 15 minutes. Taste for salt and pepper. Slice the meat. Serve with the beans and the herbs.

title: Mexican Cheesy Bread (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 2 teaspoons instant minced onion | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 1/4 teaspoons dry yeast | 2 cups shredded colby cheese
instructions: Seed the cilantro. Place all ingredients in the bread machine according to your manual's manufacturer's directions. Add the cheese in half to the amount of cheese that suits your machine and stir to combine. Add the cilantro last. Set on the basic bread setting.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,dill,brown basmati rice,sauerkraut,sweetcorn,english muffin,flat leaf italian parsley,orange zest
title: Grilled Fruit and Sauerkraut Platter With Rice
