ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut ( drained ) | 1 tablespoon light brown mustard seeds | 1/2 cup finely chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange zest | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons packed light brown basmati rice | 2 teaspoons packed light brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons packed light brown basmati rice | 1 tablespoon packed medium-brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1 english muffin, sliced | 1/3 cup finely chopped sweetcorn, drained
instructions: Drain and rinse sauerkraut.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,vinegar,peanut,chipotle chile adobo,plain flour,chickpea,vanilla essence,red capsicum
title: Chipotle Peanut Pizza
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 red capsicum, chopped | 200 g low fat plain flour | 1 bay leaf | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons vanilla essence | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place in microwave safe bowl and cover with boiling water. Microwave on high for 3 minutes, stir, cover and cook on high for 2 - 4 minutes, remove lid and microwave on high for 2 minutes to evaporate excess water. Mix in chickpeas, capsicum and cook for further 7 - 8 minutes or until heated through. Stir through vinegar, vanilla and chopped peanuts. Serve from the baking tray or onto a warm pizza base with a topping of shredded parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,red pepper,green onion,brandy,cooking polenta
title: Spicy Red Pepper Tarts
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup quick-rising polenta ( or medium-dairy ) | 1/2 cup chopped roasted red pepper | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients except brandy and stir until creamy. Add brandy.

title: Baked Pumpkin & Chickpea Scrolls -- Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 lb fresh chickpeas or 1 lb canned pumpkin | 1 fresh rosemary sprig | 20 sheets frozen puff pastry ( 1/2 inch thick ), thawed & precooked
instructions: Pour into pressure cooker or rice cooker. Add rosemary and bring to high pressure over high heat, then reduce heat to just under 2 inches. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat & let steam escape. Once rested, remove from pressure cooker & transfer to flat ovenproof dish. Pressurize with rice cooker if necessary, then set dish aside to cool slightly before cutting into strips. Place frozen dough into a small bag & allow to thaw completely. Roll out dough to rectangle of about 12 inches long, then cut into 6 pieces & sprinkle each rectangle on a work surface with salt, pepse & the fresh rosemary. Roll into long log & lay one on top of the other. Cut log crosswise into six slices, then gently pinch ends together. Transfer slices to baking sheet & bake in preheated oven at 375 degrees for 1 hr or until golden & crisp. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Sweet Raisin Snack
ingredients: 100 g shortcrust pastry ( i used shortcrust pastry ) | 300 g golden raisins ( or currants of your choice ) | 200 g flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to gas 4/170c. Roll out dough onto floured board to 12 x 2 x 1/2 inch. Cut out a hole in the middle. Scoop out excess pastry and line baking sheet with baking paper. Punch down dough, knead lightly and cut out biscuits about 30cm long x 20 cm wide. Place biscuits on parchment paper lined tray and lightly brush with egg/margarine or cream sherry. Bake for 10 - 20 minutes. Leave tray in oven for a few minutes, then remove from oven and remove the biscuits. Leave to stand a few minutes before serving. They should be a little crispy outside and soft inside. Try not to eat with any of your hands this one time.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,bamboo shoot,cheese,pineapple chunk,sea salt,bacon grease,stewing beef
title: Tasty Beef Carnitas for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 slices bacon grease | 14 ounces pork stewing beef, cut into medium dice | 5 ounces pineapple chunks, drained ( optional ) | 5 ounces bamboo shoots, drained and cut into chunks ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground beef drippings or 1/2 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 bag shredded cheese
instructions: Put all ingredients except cheese in a slow cooker. Place lid on and stir to combine. Cover and keep on low for 8 hours, or on high for 5 to 6 hours. Stir well before serving.

title: Brazilian Chickpea Salad (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 6 ounces can chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons canola orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1/4 cup toasted flaked coconut
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: black bean,five spice powder,taco seasoning mix
title: Rice Cookers Black Bean Tacos
ingredients: 1 can black beans | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix ( i make my own, www.recipezaar.com's mexican seasoning mix ) | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder
instructions: Rinse and drain black bean beans. Drain black beans. Place in a glass container with the taco spices and stir to mix. I find the taco seasoning mix can be difficult to crumble, so we have a few adjustments here. Store in a glass jar in the refrigerator. It makes a ton over 10 tacos.

Random Ingredients: chocolate curl,bread,chocolate,mustard powder,dill,lima bean,orange peel,bell pepper
title: Fruity Fondue (Gourmet and Non Alcoholic)
ingredients: 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate or 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped | 6 tablespoons chopped fresh dill ( or 1/4 cup chopped dillweed ) | 1/4 cup orange peel, minced | 1 tablespoon mustard powder ( or 1 more tbsp if you wish ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill ( or 1/4 cup chopped fennel ) | 1 1/2 cups lima beans, fresh or canned, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup sweet onion, minced ( vidalia, sweet onion is recommended ) or 1/4 cup chopped yellow onion ( vidalia, sweet onion is recommended ) | 2 breadsticks or 2 loaves country bread | chocolate curls or grated chocolate
instructions: Pour the chocolate into a small saucepan, heat over low heat, stirring till melted. Stir in the 4 tbsp of chopped dill or 1/4 cup chopped fennel or 1/4 cup chopped dillweed, the orange peel, mustard powder, and the 1 tbsp of chopped dill or 1/4 cup chopped fennel. Set the fondue pot over a medium flame or heat resistant bowl and stir the reserved chocolate mixture slowly while you are stirring. Stir in the beans. Add the onions or sweet onions. Set the fondue pot over low heat and stir gently till warm. If making into a loaf, turn the fondue pot upside down on the counter and warm it for only about 1 minute. Stir the fondue pot again. If using loaves of bread, soak the bread in cold water for 10 minutes. Cut into cubes and dip the bread in the chocolate, allowing some of the excess liquid to drip off.

title: Chinese Style Broccoli Chicken over Garlic and Oil
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 head fresh broccoli, cut on floret | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: In a hot wok, add 1 tbsp oil and stir fry chicken for 5 - 7 minutes, or until brown. Add broccoli and continue stir frying on medium heat for 3 mins or until broccoli is tender. Drain fat/oil. Add tabasco sauce and stir, over heat until chicken is warm. Serve over egg noodles with garlic and chillies.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,italian bread,gruyere cheese,cider vinegar,anchovy paste,olive
title: Anchovy Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons anchovy paste | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon wedge | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated | 12 -16 olives ( pitted ) | bread, crusts cut off and cut into 4 pieces | olive, shavings or garlic bread ( optional )
instructions: Combine anchovy paste and vinegar, add lemon wedge, cheese, olives and optional bread pieces for sprinkling over salad if you wish.

title: Dried Spices
ingredients: 1 cup dried shredded coconut | 1/2 cup szechuan peppercorns, very finely ground
instructions: Grind the peppercorns in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle. Grind coconut and szechuan peppercorns in mortar and pestle or food processor or place in a small bowl and add salt. Store the mixture in a cool, dry place.

title: Lebanese Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups yellow lentils | 400 ml sour yogurt | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese or 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1 small cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 pink salmon ( cooked if skin is not removed )
instructions: Cook the lentils in plenty of water by boiling for 25 minute drain and rinse with cold water. Set aside. In a serving bowl add the sour yogurt, drained lentils, cheese and cabbage to the yogurt mixture and stir until blended. Taste a bit of hummus for taste and add more cheese if desired. Spoon this mix into serving bowls and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,mango chutney,turmeric powder,garlic,italian breadcrumb,potato traditional
title: Baked Mango Chutney Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large potato | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons mango chutney, store-bought or 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared mango chutney ( such as major greys ) ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons italian seasoned breadcrumbs, unseasoned | cooked penne pasta, for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper or use aluminum foil.

title: Horseradish-Crusted Beef Pie
ingredients: 1/2 pastry crust, unbaked | 1 -2 tablespoon prepared horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Mix the horseradish with a little water to make a runny paste. Line a glass pie plate with pastry dough. Spread with horseradish mix. Roll out pastry thinly. Cut into strips or rectangles to make 4 circles. Transfer to pie plate. Trim edges with scissors. Bake at 425f until browned, puffy and crust is golden brown, about 25 - 30 mins. Serve as is, or allow to cool before cutting into squares.

title: Beef and Kiwi Skewers (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1/2 cup liquid honey | 500 g lean chuck, trimmed of fat, cut into chunks | 1 beef sirloin, trimmed of excess fat | 3 kiwi fruits, peeled, sectioned, and halved lengthways | 4 kiwi fruits, peeled and quartered lengthways | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 10 -12 dried figs, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes
instructions: Put the honey in a saucepan and set it over a low medium heat for about 3 minutes until it's bubbling and starting to thicken.. Add the meat and continue to cook for about 20 minutes, or until the meat is cooked to your liking. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly. Tear all the fruit into bite sized pieces. Put the meat in a bowl, pour the sweetener and stir until the meat is evenly coated. Thread the meat onto the soaked, soaked figs and kiwis. Place 5 - 6 soaked figs in the centre of each skewer. Cook in the honey mixture for 45 minutes, or until the skewers are cooked and the figs just starting to soften. Leave for 30 minutes if you like a more crispy beef skewer.

title: Spinach Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh spinach | 1 1/4 lbs white onions or 1 1/4 lbs red onions, sliced | 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 10 tablespoons shaoxing wine | 4 tablespoons bourbon | 4 tablespoons pizza crusts, prepared
instructions: Cook onion in 2 tbl spn of syrup in a skillet until they are translucent and starting to brown. Add 3 tbl. Bourbon to onion and cook 2 - 3 minutes longer until the aroma of the alcohol is released on onions. Set the sauce aside and cool to room temperature. Wash and dry spinach and pat dry using paper towels. Cut off and discard thick stems and shreds. Peel onions and slice into half moons. Mix remaining tblsp. Golden syrup with shaoxing wine and put aside. Put a small amount of the sauce in a dish. Preheat oven 425. Place the dough on a well floured surface. Roll it out as thinly as you can. If the dough is very thin, you may need to add extra sauce. If it's too thin, add water. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thickness. Cut out 2 circles about 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Fill each circle with some the spinach mixture. Add 3 tblsp. Of your reserved sauce. Make 4 more circles. Place 2 tblsp. Of the remaining spinach on top and sprinkle with a small amount of remaining sauce. Place a second pie on top. Spread the remainder of the sauce on the pizza. Sprinkle the dough with more sauce. Using a fork, poke and pinch 3 holes in the dough on the top of the crust. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until crust is nicely browned. Let stand for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges with a pizza cutter.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,sirloin steak,green enchilada sauce,garlic clove,avocado
title: Green Chile Beef and Avocado Dip
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut up | 1 -2 garlic clove, chopped | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 jar mild picante sauce | 1 medium avocado, peeled and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray bottom of dish with non stick cooking spray. In large bowl, mix beef and garlic. Stir in enchilada sauce, picante sauce and avocado. Spread cheese mixture on the top. Cover dish and bake for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Easy Japanese Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour ( white ) | white vinegar
instructions: Whip rice flour in a bowl to the consistency of mayonnaise.

Random Ingredients: salami,reg,salt pepper,teriyaki sauce,margarita mix,italian plum,irish whiskey
title: Smoked Italian Plums
ingredients: 3 italian plums, halved and seeded | 1/4 cup margarita mix | 3 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup shredded smoked salami | 1/2 cup shredded reg ; spicy italian cheese blend | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1 dash salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place plums on a foil lined baking sheet and broil 3 - 4 inches from heat 3 - 5 minutes, turning once or twice.

title: Mexican Lobster Dinner
ingredients: 1/2 lb lobster tail, finely chopped or 1/2 lb cooked shrimp | 1/2 lb pork, diced | 1/2 lb asparagus, chopped or 2 green onions, chopped | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, grated or 1/2 teaspoon fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pimiento, finely diced | 1/4 - 1/3 cup pickled asparagus, sliced, for garnish
instructions: To make the dressing, combine all ingredients except for the asparagus, pimiento and asparagus. Combine well. Chill and serve with the noodles if desired. Garnish with the sliced asparagus.

title: Ancho Chili Powder Mix II
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup tapioca
instructions: The chile powder should be enough to moisten a small jar of chili powder.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,canola oil,dark brown sugar,ghee,yellow squash,chicken breast,beef stew meat
title: Yemeni Chicken, Yellow Squash and Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 cup beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 large chicken breast cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons ghee, divided | 1 3/4 cups dark brown sugar, packed | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f heat ghee in 3 quart pan over medium high. Add squash and cook, tossing, about 3 minutes. Place beef and chicken cubes in pan.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,season salt,cream cottage cheese,filet beef,olive,mace,soya sauce
title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb filet of beef | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 dash hot chili sauce | 3/4 cup cream-style cottage cheese | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon olive ( optional )
instructions: Remove steak from refrigerator and allow to come to room temp. Cut into thin strips. Set aside. Mix cream style cottage cheese with seasoning salt. Heat olive oil and saute beef until brown. Add seasoned cream cheese, soya sauce and chili sauce. Simmer on low heat for at least 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Beef Rouladen
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat | 1/2 cup buttermilk, or as needed | 4 cloves garlic oil, chopped | 2 sage leaves
instructions: Cut the beef meat into 1 inch cubes. Place cubes in a slow cooker, and pour in enough buttermilk to cover. Tear the sage leaves in half and roll each piece into a round bundle. Layer the pieces of beef into the crock of a slow cooker. Cover.

Random Ingredients: pepper,coriander powder,active yeast,white wine,egg yolk,pasta,serrano pepper
title: Portabella Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup white wine | 1 egg yolk | 1 envelope active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 2 1/4 teaspoons white wine | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried hot pepper | 2 cups cooked pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine wine, egg yolk, yeast, coriander powder, red pepper flakes, and pepper flakes in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,cooking spray,beef tenderloin steak,dripping,french bread,pizza sauce,black olive,salt cod fish
title: Baked Fish With Salsa Crust
ingredients: 250 g bread, sliced | cooking spray | 1/4 cup hot pizza sauce | 90 g sirloin steaks, cut into 5cm pieces | 1 teaspoon drippings | 250 g crispy red pepper sandwich pepper jam jars and lids ( available in other specialty food stores ) | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1/2 cup shredded french bread or 1/2 cup bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c lightly grease four shallow baking dishes/lasagna pans. Remove bread from bread and place on paper towel. Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a fry pan over medium high heat. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the bread slices to the pan and spray with cooking spray. Spread the bread evenly with pizza sauce and place in the oven. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes, or until crisp and golden. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 2 teaspoons of oil in a fry pan over medium high heat. Add steak and saute for 3 minutes or until browned. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,heavy whipping cream,lemon,lima bean,white sugar,garlic granule
title: Lima Bean Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 can lima beans - drained, but not rinsed, reserving liquid | 3/4 cup white sugar | 2 cloves garlic granules | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 lemon, juiced
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the lima beans, sugar, garlic, tamarind paste, and reserved liquid. Cover and chill 4 hours or overnight. When ready to serve, beat reserved liquid into cream in a medium size mixing bowl until thoroughly blended. Place in freezer for several hours until the cream begins to stiffen. Transfer cream to ice cream maker and follow manufacturer's instructions. After 4 hours, remove cream from freezer and skim off any foam that rises to the top. Cover and return to freezer until cream is slightly stiffer, about 1 hour. While cream is chilling, preheat oven to 325 degrees f. When cream is cold, stir cream into lima bean mixture. Transfer to an ice cream maker and follow manufacturer's instructions. When cream is complete, transfer to an ice cream maker and follow manufacturer's instructions once more.

Random Ingredients: olive,butter,coffee powder,vegetable broth,black bean,anise seed,lemon juice,garlic salt
title: Black Beans With Lemon Juice
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans, soaked in water overnight and drained ( preferably shoe-peg or navy beans ) | 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemon rind | 3 teaspoons vegetable broth | 2 teaspoons dried anise seeds | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 teaspoons freshly squeezed lemon juice | 2 teaspoons coffee powder
instructions: In heavy saucepan, place soaked beans in water to cover and cook until tender, about 1 hour. Drain beans and return to same saucepan and add remaining ingredients. Return to boil and reduce heat.

title: Black Plums With Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 kg black plums ( about 1 pkg. ) | 1/2 liter unsalted chicken stock or 1/2 liter unsalted broth | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 100 ml heavy whipping cream
instructions: Clean the plums removing pesticide, wash them, then halve them lengthwise. Remove the pit and clean the plums. Add 1/2 litre of chicken stock, the cumin, and the cream to the plums. Heat and simmer covered for 1 hour. Serve them warm with basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,scallop,caraway seed,lemongrass,dark beer,anise extract,pimiento,green onion
title: Lemongrass and Beer Glazed Scallops
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 2 tablespoons fresh ground anise extract | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon dark beer | 1 green onion, chopped | 3 small shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 fresh lemongrass, white part only or 1 teaspoon frozen lemongrass | vegetable stock, for cooking
instructions: Toast caraway seeds in medium hot skillet over medium heat for about 10 min or until fragrant. Toast anise extract in a medium skillet over medium heat for about 1 minute or until fragrant. Place caraway seeds and anise extract in mortar or small bowl. With pestle or spice grinder, crush or grind caraway seeds until coarsely ground. In a medium skillet, combine vegetable broth with beer, chopped onions, shrimp and fresh lemon grass or lemongrass. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until shrimp are just cooked. Serve at once with scallops.

title: Tasty Mexican Quinoa
ingredients: 2 quinoa, rinsed | 1 whole chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Place the quinoa in a medium saucepan and add enough cold water to cover the quinoa by at least 1/2 inch. Bring to a boil and let cook until the quinoa comes away from the skin and most of the moisture has been absorbed, 5 to 7 minutes depending on the saltiness. Remove from heat. Stir the chopped chipotle pepper into the quinoa and fold in completely, using a fork to do so. Store, covered, in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,french bread,cream,heavy whipping cream,palm sugar,oil,dark sesame oil
title: Lori's Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lo sirloin | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 6 tablespoons palm sugar | 6 cups heavy whipping cream | 12 slices french bread | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Cube the lo sirloin into medium sized rectangular pieces about 4 inches long and 2 inches wide. In a skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of the oil on medium heat until fragrant. Place 1 piece of the lo sirloin in the oil, sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of sesame oil & 1 tablespoon of palm sugar. Fry on both sides until browned. Turn off the heat & transfer the lo sirloin to a plate to keep warm. Wipe the pan clean & return it to the stove. To the skillet add 2 tablespoons of oil and place 1 cup of cream and bring to a boil. Add 6 more pieces of lo sirloin & stir until well mixed. Simmer for one minute. Stir in 2 tablespoons of cream. Continue to heat until cream thickens a little, remove from heat. In a large serving bowl, pour about 1 cup of the cream, pour over the beef & add the 3rd cup of heavy whipping cream & stir to combine well. Serve the sauce separately & garnish with fresh chopped parsley & more sesame oil.

title: Shir Kurma® Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 6 ounces cream cheese, soften at room temperature | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Beat cream cheese and half and half in a bowl until creamy. Stir in the red chili flakes. Spread on a slice of toasted pita bread or crackers and chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chile pepper,meat,roasting chicken,cucumber,corn syrup,french bread,kimchi
title: The Ultimate Kimchi Sandwich
ingredients: 1 roasted chicken, meat, and shredded | 1 head green and white onions ( cut in half ) | 2 anaheim chile peppers, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 cups frozen cubed cucumbers, unpeeled | 1/2 cup thickly sliced kimchi | 1 1/2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Prepare your chicken and vegetable preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the chicken, onions, peppers, cucumber, kimchi, and corn syrup in a mixing bowl, and stir to combine. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and generously grease with cooking spray. Bake at 350 degrees f for 50 minutes, remove from oven, and top with kimchi to make sandwiches. Continue baking until the chicken is cooked through and tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Slice diagonally to serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic,chicken,garlic clove,cauliflower floret,italian salad dressing mix,grainy mustard,peanut,shortening
title: Chicken Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups chicken, grilled and cut into bite-size | 3 cups cauliflower florets | 1/4 cup light italian salad dressing mix, kraft's | 1/4 teaspoon garlic, minced | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1/4 cup dry unsalted dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 2 -4 teaspoons grainy mustard
instructions: In large bowl, mix together chicken, cauliflower, dressing, garlic, garlic, shortening, peanuts, and mustard. Transfer to serving dish, and decorate with remaining peanuts, if desired.

title: Garlic Zucchini, Zucchini with Egg
ingredients: 1 large head of garlic, lightly chopped | 1 large zucchini, about 10 inches long and 2-inch-thick in diameter, sliced into 1/4 inch rounds ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle the garlic and zucchini liberally with salt. Place 1 inch of water in a 4 qt saucepan. Cover with the pan's lid and gently boil 5 minutes, or until the water is absorbed. Drain, rinse with cold water, drain again and blot dry. Arrange the zucchini around the edge of the pan, pressing lightly. Bring the water to a boil and cook over moderate heat, uncovered, 3 - 4 minutes or until the zucchini is tender, and beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,caraway seed,broccoli,vodka,chinese five spice powder,flat leaf parsley,anchovy
title: Smoked Caraway Burgers
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 3 cloves anchovies | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Place all ingredients except the olive oil in a large bowl and mix well with your hands to mix. Shape into burgers. Brush the grill with olive oil and heat on medium. Brush oil on the grill and fry on both sides until browned.

title: Blackberry Potato Cakes With Russets
ingredients: 4 cups freshly shelled blackberries ( about 2 pounds ) | 4 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut lengthwise in thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine the blackberries with the potato slices and gently fold in half the crumbled berry mixture. Shape into sixteen six 1 1/2 by 6 inch cakes about 1 inch in diameter and place on parchment paper lined baking sheets. Press the sides of the dough into each cake to flatten slightly. Bake until crusts are golden brown and baked through, about 25 minutes. Serve immediately or cool and freeze for later use. Note, although this recipe yields approximately 9 cakes, can be made in a 5 quart or larger baking dish or in batches by stirring the potato mixture into the potato mixture, and arranging 6 slices on top of each other as a spoke. Bake until the crumbs are browned and the tops are crisp, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,confectioner ' sugar,vegetable oil,sugar snap pea,parsley leaf,mint sprig,soymilk
title: Creamy Thai Filled Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar, sifted | 1 tablespoon soymilk | 1 jalapeno, seeded ( if not available ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1/4 cup reduced sodium soy milk | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, plus | additional vegetable oil, for frying | 8 cups vegetable snap peas | 1 teaspoon coarse sugar ( optional ) | fresh mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: To make the syrup, place the 1 tablespoon sugar in a small bowl and stir in the soy milk. Let stand 2 minutes or until thickened. Transfer to a medium nonreactive bowl. Finely chop the jalapeño. Set aside. Combine the sweetener, 1 tablespoon soy milk, and olive oil. Toss with the peas until coated. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar. Toss well. Cover and let stand about 20 minutes. Prepare your sugar snaps, heat oil in a large heavy pan over medium high heat until shimmering but not smoking. Working in batches, add your sugar snap pea sprouts and fry, shaking the pan and turning once, until they are slightly crisp and golden, about 2 minutes. Remove and drain on paper towels using a slotted spoon. Serve hot with the spiced sugar snaps for dipping.

title: Homestyle Chicken & Stuff
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs whole chickens, your choice, i like the family size cut pieces of chicken and the ones with the stuffing. | 1 can beef gravy | 3 teaspoons chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Put 1 quart jars of gravy in a pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Simmer until gravy has thickened a little, about 2 - 3 minutes. Turn off the heat, and place the chicken pieces into a big bowl. Toss with broth and bouillon until covered evenly. It will take at least 2 days in the refrigerator. It's even better after 8 hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,double cream,thai peanut sauce,spinach,jalapeno pepper,black mustard seed,salmon fillet
title: Smoked Salmon Florentine
ingredients: 3 tablespoons jalapeno pepper pickled jalapeno peppers | 3 tablespoons tomato juice, strained out | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 tablespoon black mustard seed | 1 tablespoon thai peanut sauce | 2 tablespoons spinach, finely chopped | 2 lbs skinless salmon fillets, cut into 6 8 pieces
instructions: For the sauce, in a small bowl mix together the crushed red pepper pickled jalapenos, cream, mustard seed, peanut sauce and spinach. Place salmon in a glass dish and pour the sauce over the pieces. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate salmon for 1 hour. Line plates with foil, allowing the fish to unmold on the edges. Place salmon on plate, pour the rest of the sauce over and serve.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,baby spinach,white button mushroom,icing sugar,yeast,fava bean,palm oil,snow pea
title: Faux Potatoes (Greek Christmas Pizza)
ingredients: 1 kg baking potato, peeled and cubed | 400 g white button mushrooms, halved | 125 g baby spinach, cooked in boiling water, drained | 200 g fava beans, thawed | 1 tablespoon palm oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 3 tablespoons palm oil, extra virgin | 2 tablespoons icing sugar, extra | 2 tablespoons dried yeast, extra
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 deg c/400 deg f/gas mark 4, or just below its hottest temperature on a hot, dry potato tava. Place potato and mushrooms in large bowl, pour boiling water over, cover, and leave to stand for about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, mix together chopped spinach, fava beans and extra virgin olive oil, adding sugar and enough icing sugar to make a thick paste. When potatoes are just cooked add mash and stir through. Serve warm on a large, flat, round cake or into wedges with a little extra icing sugar mixed in.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,beet,potato,chicken bouillon cube,spring onion,cream mushroom soup,shrimp
title: Shrimp and Beet Bake
ingredients: 1 lb fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 lb beet | 6 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup chopped spring onion | 2 1/2 cups potatoes, cooked and cubed
instructions: Cut the shrimp into halves lengthwise and devein.

Random Ingredients: paprika,green chili,marinara sauce,black bean,beef chuck steak
title: Crock Pot Mexican Beef Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck steaks, cut into 1- 1/2 x 1/2-inch strips ( or use sirloin ) | 1 cup marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon paprika ( or other season seasoning ) | 1/2 cup canned diced green chili ( optional ) | 1 can small black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: In 4 1/2 to 6 qt crock pot on high heat, add the beef.

title: Spice Powder for Grilling Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon jalapeno, chopped ( or other jalapeno )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Rub on meat and broil until cooked. Will last up to 3 - 4 days. Can also be used as basting.

title: Mango Chop
ingredients: 6 tablespoons chopped coriander seed | 4 tablespoons chopped coriander leaves | 1/2 cup chopped parsnip | 2 scallions, chopped | 500 g chopped raw mango ( or equivalent ) | 1 tablespoon puree or 3 teaspoons hot sauce | 3 teaspoons chicken stock powder | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed
instructions: Heat 4 tblsp oil in a wok over high heat. Add the coriander and parsnip and stir fry for about 3 minutes. Stir in the scallions and cook for another 2 minutes stirring from time to time. Remove from heat, cool completely and crush coarsely with a rolling pin. Combine mango, coriander and stock powder and stir into wok, mix well to thoroughly combine. Transfer to serving bowl and sprinkle with poppy seeds. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: coconut rum,filling,worcestershire sauce,lavender bud,anise seed,palm sugar
title: Greek Easter Rum Torte
ingredients: 1 can coconut rum | 3 ounces lavender buds ( or 10 -12 leaves from about 24-24 lavender buds ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh lavender, sprigs ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh sage ( or a little more in taste ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon palm sugar or 1 -1 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 -4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce ( to taste )
instructions: First, make the rum, mix all ingredients and shake. Add a few ice cubes for serving, garnish with lime wedges or candied lavender sprigs if you wish, and serve rum in small cups.

title: Sweet Potato and Two-Pea Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat vanilla yogurt or 2 cups fat-free sour cream | 1 1/2 cups sugar snap peas, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons half-and-half ( optional )
instructions: Stir together yogurt and sugar snap peas in a small bowl. Stir in half and half, if desired. Spoon into serving bowl. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Sunflower
ingredients: 1/4 cup sunflower seeds | 1/4 lemon, juice of
instructions: Put all ingredients into a food processor. Process until the seeds are of the desired consistency, adding lemon juice as needed.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,eggplant,yellow pepper,mushroom,banana,baking soda,coconut milk
title: Banana Eggplant (Aubergine) Patties
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk | 4 bananas, roughly chopped | 1 eggplant | 1 yellow pepper | 1 ounce mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Drain the coconut milk, and allow to cool. Chop the bananas, eggplant, and peppers into bite size pieces, and place each in your blender, pulsing until smooth. Add soy sauce, coconut milk, and dark soy sauce. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Stove top, make the coconut mixture into the palm of your hand and flatten into a patty shape about 1/4 inch thick. Fry up in a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium heat, until lightly browned. Remove from the pan and serve immediately.

title: Champagne Breadcrumb Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh white breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons champagne ( can use canned ) | 1/2 tablespoon tamari
instructions: Combine breadcrumbs and sherry in a bowl and combine. Dress with a spoon. Add tamari if using.

title: Balsamic Vinegar Infused Chilies
ingredients: 3 fresh anaheim chilies, slit lengthwise, seeds removed | 1 1/2 cups dark rum | 3/4 cup white balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place chilies on a baking sheet. Roast in a 375 degree f oven for 10 minutes. Turn chilies over and roast an additional 10 minutes or until dark toasted, turning once. Transfer chilies to a blender or food processor and blend until the chilies are very finely minced. Place chilies in a bowl and add rum, vinegar and the dark rum. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,bread cube,yellow cornmeal,buttermilk,watermelon,mint,green chili pepper,pernod
title: Chef John's Polenta With Watermelon and Fennel
ingredients: 2 cups watermelon, chopped | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup pernod ( optional ) | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup plain bread cubes | 1/4 cup fresh green chili pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh sage leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh mint, chopped | 1/4 cup buttermilk ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh ginger
instructions: Bring 2 cups watermelon and cornmeal to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,rice wine,beef shank,romaine lettuce heart,mexican chocolate,bread crumb
title: Beef Shanks Wrapped in Wrapped Chiles
ingredients: 12 beef shanks, with bone attached | 1/3 cup seasoned rice wine | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar or 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 romaine lettuce hearts or 1 other lettuce | 1/3 cup dry bread crumbs | 2 ounces mexican-style chopped chiles ( about 1/3 cup )
instructions: Set aside 1/4 cup per bowl of rice wine vinaigrette, set the other 1/4 cup aside. Arrange the shanks on a rack in a shallow baking pan with a lip. Pour the remaining 1/4 cup of vinaigrette over the shanks and turn them to coat.

title: Coconut (Iceland) Cream (No Mayonnaise)
ingredients: 1 can light coconut rum | 1/2 cup full fat half-and-half or 1/2 cup whole milk | freshly-grated sea salt, to taste
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend the coconut rum and 3/4 cup of milk until smooth and creamy. Pour the mixture into an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. After chilling, stir the mixture well before using. Serve ice cream in small, shallow bowls and sprinkle with sea salt. For best results, refrigerate covered for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,hot red pepper flake,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 jar chopped hot red peppers ( or 1 package fresh green chili peppers ) | 1 package hot red peppers, minced or 1 package pickled hot red peppers, minced
instructions: Combine ingredients. Spoon into a shallow 3 qt baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until bubbly. Serve warm with tortilla chips. Note, do not use the red and green chile peppers.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,chorizo sausage,cornish hen
title: Mexican Grilled Cornish Game Hens
ingredients: 2 cornish hens, with or without bone | 4 slices chorizo sausage | 4 slices colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Wake hens skin side down on a barbecue grill, about 8 inches long and about 1/2 inch thick. Cook approximately 5 minutes on each side or until browned. Remove from grill. Turn on broiler. Preheat broiler. Place a slice of cheese on one side of each piece of chorizo and top evenly with 1 piece of onion and 1/4 of the breaded side of the sausage. Place 6 to 8 hens of the cheese side down on a broiler proof plate and top with the second piece of cheese and onion and sausage. Close tightly with the top piece of chorizo. Place under broiler just long enough to melt the cheese and melt the sausage. Serve.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,cherry,granny smith apple,sage leaf,plain white flour,kosher salt black pepper,corn syrup,pepperoni
title: Cherry Apple Galette
ingredients: 6 ripe granny smith apples, preferably organic | 6 hot pepperoni, sliced ( or other spicy pepper ) | 1 tablespoon plain white flour | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 lime, juice and zest of | 1/2 bunch fresh sage leaf, torn ( or 1/4 tsp dried ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | handful cherries, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: First of all, place the apple into a small, ovenproof baking dish, overlapping the slices slightly, like sandcups. Lightly dust the apple with flour, then gently press it into the apple using your fingertips. Pour some corn syrup into a small bowl, then add lime rind and juice. Whisk to combine, then drizzle over the top of the apple. Sprinkle the sage leaves over the top. Roast in a moderate oven for 50 - 50 minutes, or until the apple is just starting to fall away from the sides of the pan. Garnish with cherries, if you wish.

Random Ingredients: apricot,curry powder,anise extract,orange juice,coriander seed,mustard seed,tomato soup
title: Easy Tomatoes Dried Apricots
ingredients: 6 apricots, diced | 10 ounces condensed tomato soup | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon anise extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 5 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Put diced apricots, soup, curry powder, mustard, anise, and coriander seeds in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Boil for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring constantly, and stirring in the orange juice. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hot chili pepper,kirsch,chicken breast half,salt pepper
title: Johndekål - Chicken With Hot Pepper
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breast halves | 1 hot chili pepper | salt and pepper, to taste | 1 ounce kirsch, to taste
instructions: Place chicken breasts in ovenproof dish which has been placed in the oven to pre heat. Cut chili in half, remove seeds and finely slice the skin. Mix salt, pepper, and kirsch with the kirsch. Sprinkle the chicken with the marinade. Cook in the oven for 30 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Cranberry Mushroom Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 package wild mushrooms | 1 pint double cream | 1 can tomato juice | 1 package taco sauce | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Melt ¾ cup of the butter in a small skillet on medium heat. Add the mushrooms to the pan and sauteé until lightly browned, stirring constantly. Combine the mushrooms with the cream, stir to combine. Heat the remaining ¾ cup of butter in a medium saucepan on medium to high heat. Add the tomato juice and stir until mixed. Add the taco sauce to the pan and stir to incorporate. Reduce the heat to low, stir in the cranberries and cook for one minute. Scoop out ¾ cup of mushroom mixture and set aside. Repeat until all the mixture is used. Using your tortilla press or a 2 inch round baking dish pour the creamed mixture into the tortillas, roll up and arrange in a casserole dish. Sprush the casserole with remaining melted butter, bake in the 350º oven for ½ - 15 minutes. Serve with a garden salad.

title: Conch and Conch Casserole - Mexican
ingredients: 1 can conch, drained but reserve 1 cup liquid, and flaked | 1/2 spanish onion, diced fine | 16 ounces low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat reserved conch liquid in frypan. Saute onion over medium heat until translucent. Place drained conch into a large bowl and add enough conch water to make 2 cups. In a seperate large bowl, mash reserved conch liquid with cottage cheese to blend. Add to bowl with shredded conch and set aside for 10 - 15 minutes. Spray 12 x 9 baking dish with cooking spray. Spoon mixture into dish and bake 45 mins or until golden.

title: Tomatillo and Pomegranate Polenta
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro stems | 6 fresh tomatillos, husked, rinsed | 1 cup pomegranate juice | 4 dried lemons, halved | 1 tablespoon frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | ground dried rosemary, or flat-leaf parsley flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Process cilantro, tomatillos, pomegranate juice, lemonade concentrate, and halved lemons in food processor until chopped. Pour 1 cup cornmeal in 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle rosemary over mixture and transfer to oven. Bake until top is brown and bubbly, about 30 minutes. Spoon polenta onto plates, drizzle with remaining 1/2 cup cornmeal and sprinkle with rosemary.

title: Low Fat Broccoli - Low Fat
ingredients: 2 teaspoons nonfat milk | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 2 1/4 cups frozen broccoli florets | 1/4 cup black pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons skim sodium nonfat milk
instructions: Combine 1 teaspoon nonfat milk and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a medium saucepan over medium heat.

title: Homemade Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 cups sour cream | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Stir sour cream, vinegar, and flour together in a bowl until well blended. Cover bowl, and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, or overnight. The longer you refrigerate, the more sour cream will form.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,white vinegar,beef bouillon cube,sandwich bun,sugar substitute
title: Homemade Taco Nachos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground beef ( i use 90/10 % of fat free ) | 1 can of petite diced tomatoes seasoned with chipotle powder and garlic ( i use 3/4 cups of petite diced tomatos that the petitos have a 'hot'flavour ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded shredded mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup white vinegar ( i use white vinegar which adds moisture but not a hugegie ) | 1 beef base instant granules | 1/4 cup sugar substitute
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet. Drain excess fat from skillet. Combine beef, tomatoes, cheese, vinegar, and sugar in medium bowl. Pour into crockpot and cook on high for 3 hours or low for 6 hours. Stir meat mixture well before serving. Note, if you can find a copycat recipe for this right away or you can make a homemade filling by combining 1 small can of petitos and 2 - ½ cups of cheese or sour cream. Store in refrigerate for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,mozzarella cheese,radicchio,cod fish,dill,chili sauce,water chestnut,canadian bacon
title: Canadian Bacon Sliders
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon, chopped | 3/4 cup finely chopped salted water chestnuts | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted ( about 8 to 10 ) | 1/4 cup fresh dill, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs cooked cod fish, shredded | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 1/2 cups radicchio, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Combine first 7 ingredients and add fish. Divide fish mixture evenly among 24 sheets of heavy duty foil. Bake until golden, about about 10 to 15 minutes for white, about 15 to 20 minutes for browned, about 15 to 18 minutes for dark. Remove to a platter and cover with foil. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Combine chili sauce and cheese in a small bowl and stir in until cheese is melted. Top each hot biscuit with a dollop of sauce. Top with dollops of cheese.

title: Chipotle Lassi
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla frozen yogurt, plain | 1 tablespoon instant espresso | 2 ounces chipotle chiles, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor. Blend on high until smooth. Pour into tall glass and serve.

title: Ramen Noodle Soup
ingredients: 8 cups chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed cashews | 1/4 - 1/2 cup clam juice | 3 -4 ramen noodles, crushed
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken broth, garam masala, cashews, and clam juice. Bring to slight boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer until flavors are blended. Turn off heat, and add ramen noodles. Let stand about 2 minutes. Pour into serving bowl, and serve.

title: Thai Pork Roast
ingredients: 600 g pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c place the pork shoulder in an oven proof casserole dish with the soya sauce. Pour over enough water to cover the pork. Leave to rest in the fridge for 5 minutes. Remove the meat from the fridge and pat dry. Place the roasting tin on the tray and place in the oven, on the middle rack, in the oven. Cook for around 35 mins, then check for the temperature has started to change and the liquid has been reduced by half. Turn and cook for a further 30 mins, until the liquid has reduced slightly and has thickened. Remove the meat from the oven, scatter the soya on top and return to the oven for 40 mins or until the sauce has reduced and caramelized.

title: Sweet Peppercorn Chicken II
ingredients: 6 -12 ounces frozen chopped or canned corn in syrup | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced in half | 2 teaspoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup
instructions: Combine everything except for the corn syrup in a saucepan on med high heat, stirring well. Bring to a boil uncovered then reduce heat and simmer for about an hr., or until the sauce is reduced by about 1/ stir occasionally.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,apple juice,vodka,egg yolk,chicken wing,applesauce,banana liqueur,tomato juice
title: Brazilian Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, cut in bite-size pieces | 1/3 cup apple juice | 1/4 cup apple liqueur | 1/8 cup vodka | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 4 bananas, sliced | 1 1/2 cups instant chicken wings, cooked and cut up | 2 egg yolks | applesauce
instructions: Place the sirloin in the pan with the juices, apple liqueur, and vodka. Slice the bananas into pieces and stir in. Stir in the chicken wings, egg yolks, and applesauce. Bring to boil, stir. Turn the heat down and cook for about 5 minutes. Serve as is or with cooked rice.

title: Beef Steak With Broccolini and Broccoli
ingredients: 16 ounces cube steaks | 8 ounces broccolini
instructions: Pre heat oven to 1/2. Spray a piece of baking paper with non stick spray. Slice the steaks about 1´´´´´´´ thick and place them in paper lined pan. Spray all of the steak with non stick spray and pour the beef over evenly. Sprinkle broccolini over the top. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: proof rum,clam juice,fish,apricot,hamburger bun,chicken wing,cinnamon sugar
title: Quick and Easy Portuguese Clam Soup
ingredients: 4 lbs fish, cut into chunks | 14 -16 chicken wings, in one half | 14 1/2 fluid ounces bottled clam juice, with 1 cup water mixed with | 6 cinnamon sugar | 1 teaspoon whole cloves | 4 slices hamburger buns | 10 teaspoons proof rum
instructions: In a gallon sized zip top plastic bag, place fish, chicken and wings. Combine clam juice, cinnamon sugar, cloves and rum in a medium pot and bring to a boil. Turn down to a simmer and simmer for 15 minutes. Discard chicken and veggies. Divide pork and chicken mixture between buns and serve with rum.

title: Honeydew Melon Tea
ingredients: 1/4 cup cracked black tea | 10 honeydew melon, seeds removed
instructions: Brew tea with 1/4 cup cracked black tea for 5 minutes.

title: Fresh Fruit and  Lime  Melted Mango  Cheese Dessert
ingredients: 4 ounces mangoes, cut & pitted ( reserve 1 c of each mango's ) | 2/3 cup margarine, softened | 4 ounces fresh strawberries, sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Using a blender or food processor, process the mango and 1/3 cup of margarine until combined. Transfer mixture into a medium bowl. Stir in the strawberries. Add the lime juice, stir. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 hour or up to 3 days. Remove the bowl from the refrigerator.

title: Lek and Turkey (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 leeks ( white parts only ) | 2 lbs lean ground turkey
instructions: In a large saucepan, cover leeks with water, add about 2/3 cup water & reduce heat to medium.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,chickpea flour,salt pepper,shiitake mushroom,bay seasoning tm,elbow macaroni,lime
title: Chinese Macaroni & Chickpea Flour Fried Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 quart elbow macaroni or 1 quart rotini pasta, cooked and drained | 1 cup canned whole mixed vegetables, undrained | 2 cloves mushrooms, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chickpea flour ( or chickpea flour mixed in 1 tbs water ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon salt & fresh ground pepper | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning tm ( optional ) | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: In a saucepan, combine cooked pasta, mixed vegetables, mushrooms and chickpea flour. Season with salt, pepper & old bay. Stir in the lime wedges. Do not mash the potatoes as they should still have a bite.

title: Cheesy Monkey Bread
ingredients: 1 cup shredded muenster cheese | 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 4 tablespoons grated sweetened coconut | xanthan gum
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Place one chicken breast between sheets of parchment paper. Flatten with a mallet. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of coconut and 1 tablespoon xanthan gum. Roll up, tucking in all sides. Place on a baking sheet. Repeat with remaining breasts, pressing down to flatten. Bake for an hour, or until thermometer registers 165f degrees. Cool for 15 minutes, then sandwich with bread. Serve with your favourite sauce or horseradish.

title: Bread Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 4 -6 boneless chicken breasts or 8 -10 chicken thighs | 2 loaves pumpernickel bread dough, made into dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place pumpernickel bread dough on work surface. Place chicken in the freezer and thaw it for at least an hour. Cut off the end of the loaf and remove the soft top layer from the bread dough leaving about a 1 inch shell.. Lay the chicken breast under the bread dough and place seam side down on top in the bread dough. You may have to do this in several batches depending on the size of the chicken breast. If your chicken is too big cut it down and tear it into pieces as you like. Place bread dough in a muffin tray and cover evenly with shredded cabbage. Top with the crispy chicken pieces. Cover the chicken and cabbage with a damp paper towel and place in the preheated oven. Bake for 30 minutes, then turn oven to broil and brown chicken pieces for 5 to 10 minutes, depending on how nicely done you like your pieces.

title: Cheese and Saffron Burritos
ingredients: 1 whole packet burrito-size flour tortilla | margarine ( for frying ) | 500 g velveeta cheese, cut into thin slices | 10 saffron or 1 teaspoon ground saffron | 1 tablespoon sake | 1 1/2 cups plain flour
instructions: Heat the margarine/margarine in a cast iron frying pan/pot on medium to low heat and fry the tortilla for a few minutes till slightly crispy. Remove the tortilla from the pan, and set aside. Add the saffron to the same pan and fry for a few minutes on low until the saffron has dissolved. Add the cheese, stir for 1 minute, and stir till the cheese has melted. Add the saffron mixture and 1/2 cup boiling water to the cheese mixture, stir, and then pour the flour into the cheese and stir to incorporate and then add the remaining water and stir thoroughly. Turn off the heat and mix quickly. Add the flour mixture to the cheese and stir over fairly high heat for 2 minutes till it starts to thicken. Let it sit for a few minutes. Place the burrito on a cookie sheet lined with wax paper, and cover with plastic wrap. Place in your fridge to marinade, overnight. Drain all or most of the excess water from the cheese and reserve. Cook the burritos in a pan /pot on the low heat, covered. For 10 - 15 minutes, till they are cooked but not too soft. Remove from the pot, garnish with chopped cilantro, and serve hot.

title: Salsa Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb roasting chickens, cut-up | 1/4 cup safflower oil | 1/4 cup dried chipotle salsa ( from mexican table ) | 1 pinch safflower oil | 1 star anise | 1 bunch fresh basil, leaves picked | 1/2 cup cotija cheese, crumbled
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup safflower oil in a 10 nonstick skillet over medium high heat until foaming. Add the chicken, and, turning once, cook until golden brown on all sides, about 15 minutes total. Add the chipotle salsa, and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced, about 3 minutes. Turn chicken and spread mixture in crock of a slow cooker. Let cool about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, while the chicken cooks, heat 1/4 cup safflower oil in a small skillet over medium heat until foaming. Add the star anise. Remove the chicken from the slow cooker and pour the hot oil into a small dish to make a glaze. Return the chicken to the slow cooker and sprinkle with the crumbled cheese. Let cool about 15 minutes before removing from the cooker.

Random Ingredients: cashew nut paste,swiss cheese,rice cracker,beef brisket
title: Re-Foil Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 1/2 cup cashew nut paste | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, grated | 1 package rice crackers
instructions: Remove rind from brisket of excess fat. Place brisket on broiler pan. Coat with cashew paste and layer top of brisket with cheese. Broil brisket 5 to 10 minutes for rare, 15 to 20 minutes for medium rare, 20 to 25 minutes for well done. Serve on a bed of rice crackers.

title: Crock Pot Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes, with skin on | 4 tablespoons rock salt | 2 tablespoons dried apricots, finely ground | 3 bay leaves | 1 cup chicken stock | dill or parsley, to serve | 1/2 romano cheese or 1/2 swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Put all but the meat and the cheese in the crock. Sprinkle over with salt and pepper if using from a goulash bag. Add the apricots and bay leaves. Pierce the meat with a fork and stir. Add the chicken stock. Cook on high for 5 hours or low for 1 1/2 hours. Turn the crock pot on high again about 20 minutes before the end of cooking. The meat should be falling apart. Stir well and place in a warm oven until done. Sprinkle with dill or parsley. Serve with cooked noodles or with goulash and vegetables.

title: Almond Raita
ingredients: 6 tablespoons extra hot tahini | 1/4 teaspoon almond essence | 1 tablespoon grated smoked gouda cheese | 1/4 lb gouda cheese, grated fine | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Mash the tahini with the almond essence in a small bowl and stir in the gouda, grated cheese and parmesan. Line an 8 inch glass baking dish with parchment paper and spoon in the mixture. Bake at 350°f for 30 minutes.

title: Pinto Beans and Cod
ingredients: 1 pound salt cod fish, cut into 3 pieces | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Place potato and cod in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the cod has easily flaked with a fork, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pear,stir fry sauce,part mozzarella cheese,eggplant,lettuce leaf,ladyfinger
title: Easy Eggplant Rollups
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, about 1 3/4 lbs | 2 cans sliced pear, drained | 1 jar stir-fry sauce | 1 package dried fat-free ladyfingers | 4 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 12 lettuce leaves, optional
instructions: Preheat broiler. Slice each eggplant crosswise in half lengthwise. Spray a 9x13x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Arrange eggplant slices on the baking dish, cut side down. Broil 1 to 2 inches from the heat until slightly browned and tender but not charred, about 8 minutes. Turn slices, and broil 3 minutes longer or until a knife incerted into the center of one slice of eggplant, almost completely enclos it, and the peel is slightly charred. Remove from oven. Spray a 1 1/2 to 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Set aside. Mix together sauce, 1 package of ladyfingers, and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese in a bowl. Spoon 1/4 of sauce into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish or 9x13x2 inch pan. Arrange 8 eggplant slices over sauce, overlapping slices slightly to cover. Top with 8 slices of remaining sauce. Arrange remaining 8 slices of eggplant atop.

Random Ingredients: beef,self raising flour,salami,prosciutto,gemelli pasta,cabbage,fast rising yeast
title: Bread Machine Calzone
ingredients: 225 g gemelli pasta | 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon fast rising yeast | 3/4 cup shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup thinly sliced ham | 1/2 cup sliced salami | 1/2 cup shredded cooked cabbage | 1/2 cup sliced prosciutto
instructions: Place all ingredients in the pan with the macromane dough setting on the bread machine pan or in the oven chamber. Set bread machine for the rapid medium/white/normal/white/white/bread cycle.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,cream cottage cheese,thyme sprig,asiago cheese
title: Easy Cheese Filling
ingredients: 3 teaspoons cream-style cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh asiago cheese | 1 bay leaf, tied together with a piece of cheesecloth
instructions: Stir cheese, thyme, and asiago together in a bowl. Add bay leaf.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Dates
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces prosciutto, cut into thin strips | 2 -3 dates, stemmed, seeded, and cut into 1/4-inch long strips
instructions: Line the rim of a baking pan with a piece of prosciutto to hold the dates. Place the dates in the center of the prosciutto. Top with strips of prosciutto, making sure each date is completely covered. Cover the dates loosely with aluminum foil. Place a heavy pan or cast iron frying pan over medium heat. Add enough water to cover the dates almost completely. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, until the dates are tender. Drain, and run a spoon under cold water to loosen the skins. Cut the dates into wedges to serve warm. Or arrange on your serving platter, and cover with prosciutto strips.

title: Tandoori Spiced Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes | 2 teaspoons curry paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rubbed sage
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 degrees f. Wash, peel and cube the potatoes. Place into a roasting pan. In a bowl, toss the curry paste and dried sage together. Rub over the potatoes. Cover with foil and roast for 45 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Rosti
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 - 1/2 cup kahlua ( or sweetened whipped cream )
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk the heavy cream until stiff peaks form. Mix in all the remaining ingredients and whisk until well combined. Transfer the rosti mixture into a piping bag lined with parchment paper and snip off a star shaped pattern, set aside 1 star shaped piece of rosti, refrigerate the rosti for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve cold or warm.

title: Swedish Apple Cider Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 2 fluid ounces apple cider
instructions: Heat the cider in a small saucepan on the stovetop. If the cider has been left in the saucepan, strain it through a cheese cloth, or use a fine mesh strainer lined with cheese cloth. Sift the flour into a large bowl. Make a well in the middle. Pour in the cider and apple cider and stir to make a thick paste. Mix until the flour forms a firm, heavy dough. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface. Knead lightly, about 10 times, to develop gluten. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm. Divide into 8 pieces. Roll into balls, then flatten slightly. Use tips of your fingers to gently press out and shape a round, even circle. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium heat and dry each fritter briefly without overcrowding. Cook 1 fritter for about 1 minute per side, or until the underside of the fritters appear to be starting to browned. Slide the fritters onto a clean work surface. Keep warm covered with foil until all the fritters are cooked. Variation with raw veggies or other protein, you may substitute equal amounts of chicken, turkey or pork in this recipe.

title: Lazy Irishman's Favourite Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces double cream | 2 1/2 ounces smoked sweet italian sausage | 1/3 cup boiled potatoes | 1/4 cup mixed peppercorns, drained | 2 -3 tablespoons flour tortillas | 8 slices french loaf or 8 slices gluten-free bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Put the sausage into a pan over a medium heat and cook until browned, breaking the meat into small chunks with a wooden spoon. Drain the fat from the pan and discard the sausage pieces. Put the bacon fat into a small frying pan set over a medium high heat and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden. Meanwhile, tear off the rinds from the olives. Put the olives into a bowl and mix with the cream. Add the sweet italian sausage pieces, stir to combine and pour the mixture into a baking dish or bowl lined with aluminium foil. Add the potatoes to the tin, stir and cover with foil or baking paper. Transfer the dish to the oven and leave for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the potatoes are cooked and golden. The sausage filling, put everything into a frying pan and cook gently over a medium heat for 5 minutes, until the mixture thickens. To serve, remove the foil and bake briefly, uncovered for the last 5 minutes of cooking. Arrange 6 to 8 warm burritos on each warmed plate. Garnish with the grated cheese.

title: Orange Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 cups rye flour or 2 cups old-fashioned flour | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 1 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 1 orange ( about 14 slices peeled from 1 orange ) | 2 tablespoons fresh mint or 2 tablespoons fresh basil
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 from the heat source and set a large baking sheet in it. Place flour, seed, cocoa, and tarragon in a small bowl and stir to blend. Cut enough thin slices from the orange into 1/4 inch thick slices. Cut 4 slices of orange crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips. Cut half of the strips crosswise into pieces about 1 inch wide. Place the orange slices into a small bowl of cold water to prevent browning and keep covered. Place a small spoonful of the rye flour mixture into a small bowl and add 1 tablespoon orange or other orange flavorings and 1 tablespoon mint or basil. Stir to blend. Place remaining rye flour mixture in a 2x4 inch loaf pan. Dip the rye flour in the flour mixture and arrange in a single layer on the baking sheet, pressing it to adhere. Cut half of the remaining slices into quarters and place in a single layer over the rye flour mixture. Sprinkle top of loaf with remaining tablespoon of orange flavorings and chopped basil and cover with remaining rye flour mixture. Set in a warm spot until bread is firm and springy to the touch, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Bake bread until golden and golden brown about 15 minutes.

title: Mongolian Chilli Paste Seasoning
ingredients: 1 cup chili paste ( or 1 tbsp. of kaffir lime chilli ) | crushed ice cube
instructions: Grind chilli paste and ice cube to your liking in a blender. Store in a jar. Keep away from light and air.

title: Indian Pork Tenderloin With Shrimp
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons unsalted ghee or 2 -3 tablespoons clarified butter | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 lbs shrimp, peeled and deveined | 5 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the ghee over medium heat.

title: Roasted Mexican Chicken for Two
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 1 can refried beans | 1 jar mango chutney | 1 can rotel | 1 teaspoon white flour | 1 lime
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place all ingredients into an oven safe pan or casserole dish, spreading the mixture in an even layer. Cover with foil and bake for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Turn dish and bake for another 15 minutes. After a chicken has been removed from the oven, slice into pieces and serve over rice or pinto beans.

title: Black Onions With a Twist
ingredients: 1 bag frozen yellow onions | 1 whole black or pink peppercorn, crushed
instructions: Preheat oven at 300 degrees f. Using your sharp knife, remove the strings and cut off any large stems from the onions. You should now be able to remove most of the visible fat from the onions. Rinse them and cut in half lengthwise, discarding any hard or blemishes. Cut half of the onions into approximately 1 1/2 inch wide half moons. Arrange them lightly in an 8x8 inch rectangle on a baking sheet, or line with parchment paper. Bake for about 50 minutes until browned and soft, stirring them every 15 minutes or so. Remove from oven and allow to cool about 20 minutes before serving. Store in an airtight container.

title: Portuguese Pork in a Crockpot
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 8 ounces country style boneless pork, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 package frozen yellow split peas | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons catsup
instructions: Sprinkle pork with mexican oregano and allspice. Place in slow cooker. Top with split peas. Combine picante sauce, stock and catsup in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: parchment paper,chipotle powder,parmigiano reggiano cheese,rotel,lasagna noodle,chili paste,thai basil,basil
title: Crispy Smoked Linguine
ingredients: 1/2 lb lasagna noodles | 8 ounces smoked rotel | 5 tablespoons chili paste | 2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 12 ounces fresh basil, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder | 2 sheets thick parchment paper
instructions: First soak lasagna noodles in water at least 6 hours or overnight in refrigerator. While waiting, chop smoked linguini. Combine 1/4 cup of basil with 1 tablespoon of chipotle powder and set aside. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine 1/4 cup chipotle powder with 2 tablespoons of basil and set aside. Remove noodles from boiling water and set aside. In a blender or food processor, combine 1/4 cup of basil, 1 tablespoon of chipotle powder, 1/4 cup basil and 1 tablespoon of basil with chile paste using 1 teaspoon of basil mixture. Blend until creamy. Set aside. In a food processor or by hand, combine 1/4 cup of basil and half the chile paste, blending on high speed until smooth. Remove a little bit of chile paste from blender and set aside. Lay out the two thin parchment covered sheets of parchment over pasta. Fill parchment with some pasta and spread out to cover. Fill the middle of the parchment with one third of the chile paste mixture. Layer pasta into the pan and repeat layers until all ingredients have been used/filled. Do this again with the 2nd pan of pasta, leaving empty space between each layer. Cover with another layer of parchment and continue until the entire top layer of pasta is filled/tamelsized. Fold in the corners to create a package and pinch to seal. Heat a large frying pan over high heat for 2 minutes. Add a bit of oil to coat the pan. Place lasagna pan in the pan and fry on both sides until golden, 2 - 5 minutes per side. Note, if you use smoked linguini, you'll need to add more oil when they hit the pan with the smoke. Remove to a paper towel lined plate and allow to drain. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,steak,tuna steak,dijon mustard,margarine,baby green,french baguette,tomato
title: Steak Bruschetta
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks, 1 inch thick | 1 cup baby greens | 1 tomatoes, ripe | 3/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 tablespoons margarine, plus extra for melting | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 6 slices french baguettes
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Grill steaks to desired doneness, about 3 to 5 minutes per side for rare, 6 to 8 minutes per side for medium and 12 to 15 minutes for medium well.

title: The McCuddy's Sauté with Barribs
ingredients: 1/4 ounce slab bacon | 1 3/4 teaspoons grated lime zest | 2 1/2 cups cold water | 1 bunch kale, tough leaves removed
instructions: Soak slab bacon in 2 t. Of the lime juice until it's limp & flexible. Reserve lime juice. Combine lime rind, water& lime juice in a heavy skillet & cook over medium heat, stirring, until almost syrupy. Add kale and 1 tsp. Salt, cover & cook gently until kale is just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain any excess water& serve.

Random Ingredients: sherry vinegar,thai fish sauce,roasting chicken,fast rising yeast,cocoa,red chili pepper,pork rib
title: Soy and Chili Rubbed Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken or 1 lb pork ribs | 2 cups cooked ham or 2 cups cooked pork fat | 1 medium roasting chickens | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa ( preferably dutch ) | 2 ounces thai fish sauce | 1 ounce sherry vinegar | 1 -2 canned fresh hot red chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Trim excess fat and excess fat from chicken or pork if preferred. Combine bread and food, and put in crockpot. Make sure the neck is clean and neck is open, or you may have to use a knife to stab it. Set the chicken or pork on the bones. Add rest of ingredients, and mix thoroughly. Set on low. After 6 hours, remove chicken from breads and place on platter. Use toothpicks to attach toothpicks to it. Place bread in a plastic bag and flatten it so it flattens to a nice and flattened loaf. Return to crockpot, and cook for at least 3 hours..

Random Ingredients: sirloin,cocoa powder,allspice,thyme sprig,garlic red chile paste,prawn
title: Garlic Chili Prawns
ingredients: 2 lbs uncooked prawns | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons allspice | 1 teaspoon garlic and red chile paste | 4 tablespoons thyme sprigs | garlic and red chile paste, extra spice
instructions: Shell and devein prawns. Set aside. Combine all remaining ingredients except prawns in a large frying pan. Fry over low heat, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes or until thick and hot.

title: Cajun Oyster Dip
ingredients: 1 pound oysters, shucked and shucked, divided | 1 can tomato juice, divided | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Stir half of the shucked oysters, 2/3 cup of the tomato juice, and the cajun seasoning together in a 9x9 inch serving dish. Pour in half of the remaining tomato juice. Transfer to the oven.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,beef sirloin steak,brown rice,apple cider,chili paste,sausage
title: Steak and Sausage With Brown Rice
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef top sirloin steak, cut 1 inch thick | 1 lb hot dog, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 lb smoked sausage, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup chili paste | 1 cup brown rice, cooked
instructions: Heat a large skillet on medium high heat. Sear meat about 5 minutes on each side until seared. Transfer meat to individual plate. Increase heat to high, add sasuage and sausages to skillet, then transfer mixture to plate. Deglaze skillet with apple cider and stir in chili paste. Cook and stir 3 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove and set aside. Serve meat mixture and rice over sauce.

Random Ingredients: table salt,italian parsley,chipotle chile adobo,salad oil,green cardamom pod,monterey jack cheese,red curry paste,tortilla chip
title: Chipotle-Lime Salad
ingredients: 1 cup restaurant-style shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup minced bottled chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh italian parsley | 4 tablespoons extra-virgin salad oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 teaspoon salt, divided | 2 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 16 cups crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large bowl, toss the cheese and chiles with the chopped parsley, salad oil, curry paste, 1/4 teaspoon each of salt and cardamom. Arrange the salad on an oiled large jelly roll pan. Broil until the cheese is bubbly and beginning to brown, stirring occasionally, about 2 minutes. Drizzle the remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt down the inside of each bowl. Remove the baking sheet from the broiler and spray lightly with cooking spray. Immediately sprinkle the tortilla chips inside the bowl of the cheese mixture to coat, shaking off excess. Spoon the chips into the oven and toast until crispy and golden, 10 to 15 minutes. Drizzle the reserved cooking oil over the chips and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,red potato,bread flour,coriander seed,coffee,greek olive,farfalle pasta
title: Greek Olive Fritters With Farfalle
ingredients: 1/2 lb farfalle pasta | 3 large red potatoes | 1 white onions or 1 yellow onion, finely chopped, to taste | 7 ounces greek olives ( or other mild oil-cured cured olives ) | 2 tablespoons ground coffee ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons strong coffee plus 1 teaspoon strong coffee powder ( optional, my addition ) | 2 tablespoons bread flour ( for dusting )
instructions: Cook farfalle in a large pan of boiling water until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes, drain and set aside. Wash, scrub, rinse and cube potatoes. Cut onions and olives into 1/4 inch cubes. Heat olive oil and fry potato and onion until golden and soft, remove from heat. Drain farfalle and return to pan, add potato onion mixture, hot coffee and coffee. Mix well to mix. Serve fritters with a sprinkling of bread.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,banana liqueur,dill,lime wedge,vanilla essence,red wine,salt water,black cardamom pod
title: Classic Banana Daiquiri
ingredients: 6 -8 red bananas ( depending on your personal taste, you may want to leave the skins on if you prefer ) | 1/8 - 1/4 cup black banana liqueur ( a good quality brand, such as kahlua, amaretto and i'm not sure what this really calls for ) | 2 -3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon red wine or 1 -1 1/2 tablespoon white rum | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh dill | 2 -3 garlic cloves | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 pinch salt ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon black cardamom pod | lime wedge ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the sliced bananas in a large serving bowl.. Add the liqueur to taste. Add the whipping cream and stir until combined. You may not need to use all the cream. Add the red wine, if used, and stir until well blended. Add the dill, garlic and vanilla. Stir well. Add the salt, sugar, pepper, and cardamom. Stir for another 30 seconds. Pour the mixture over the bananas in the serving bowl. Serve with a wedge of lime.

title: Easy Microwave Rice Ball (For Wonton Toss)
ingredients: 2 quarts instant basmati rice | 1/3 cup catsup | 2 teaspoons dried parsley | 1 bag corn chips, crushed
instructions: Place rice into large bowl or a 4 quart microwavable bowl. Add catsup, bread crumbs, parsley, and crushed chips. Mix well. Roll dough into large ball, then in chopped nuts or pecans. Microwave on high 10 minutes or longer. Let cool. Store in air tight container.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,shrimp,italian sausage,vermicelli,ziti pasta,half
title: Cajun Shrimp Rotini
ingredients: 16 ounces ziti pasta ( or any pasta that has a lot of bite ) | 1 lb italian sausage | 1 package dry vermicelli | 12 shrimp, cooked, peeled and deveined ( optional ) | 1 package italian salad dressing mix, packet | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cover ziti pasta and cook until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,maui onion,chili pepper,pizza crust,onion soup mix,white breadcrumb,fennel seed,rice noodle
title: Rice Noodle Beef Burgers
ingredients: 4 slices white breadcrumbs | 1 egg | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 medium onion, diced | 1 small chili pepper, seeded, diced | 1 lb pizza crust
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Combine bread crumbs, egg, onion soup mix and fennel seed. Add beef and mix well. Shape into four patties. Place on lightly greased foil and bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine onion, chili pepper and bread crumbs mixture. Mix well. Spread onto pizza crust and top with meat mixture. Top with a second pizza crust and bake for 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,orange liqueur,salt,tamari,kalamata olive,turmeric,icing sugar
title: Orange Zest Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup chopped pitted kalamata olive | 1/4 cup orange flavored liqueur | 1 bag icing sugar | 1 dash tamari
instructions: Prepare soup, add salt, turmeric, onions and olives to slow cooker. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Serve warm with toasted bag of biscuits. Note, i prefer to use fresh biscuits instead. Also, after adding toasted bag of biscuits, i usually tear out of the bag of biscuits with a fork and put back in the crockpot. This goes very well with fish, chicken, or even tuna. Enjoy.

title: Granny Smith Apples With Apple Stock and Cinnamon
ingredients: 4 granny smith apples ( just enough to cover tops of apples ) | 1 liter chicken stock or 1 liter vegetable stock
instructions: Peel and wash apples.

title: Cousin Pete's Penne
