ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable stock or 4 tablespoons chicken stock | 4 ounces penne rigate | 1 -2 tablespoon pickled mushrooms, chopped ( optional ) or 1 -2 teaspoon pickled green onion, minced ( optional )
instructions: Bring 3/4 inch water to boil in large frying pan. Turn off heat, add 1 tablespoon of vegetable or chicken stock to cooking water and let sit until water starts to boil out of the pan. Then drain 1 1/2 tablespoons of liquid from frying pan, and place in a bowl. Pour 2 tablespoons of water or a little more if needed. While waiting for water to boil, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta, and put aside. Pour 1 tablespoon or so of olive oil in a large frypan. Heat over moderately high heat, watching and stirring constantly until oil sizzles. Reduce heat to low, and add the mushrooms or onion. Continue to stir constantly. Continue to stir constantly until mushrooms are softened, but not browned yet. Add a little more or less stock or water, if there has evaporated. Remove from heat and toss with drained pasta in pan, leaving plenty of a few small chunks to roll. Toss into pasta bowls.

title: Quick, Plain, and Delicious Rice Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice ( washed ) | 1 cup maple syrup ( we prefer dark ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( optional )
instructions: Put rice in an ungreased bowl. Add enough water so that it reaches an even 1/4 inch depth over the rice. Cover the bowl tightly and let sit at room temperature for 15 - 20 minutes, or place it in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. It's best eaten the same day it can be eaten. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,dijon mustard,thyme,lobster meat,buttermilk,lentil,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Grilled Lobster and Lentils
ingredients: 4 lobster meat, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 cup lentils, picked over and rinsed | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 lb salmon fillets, cut into 2 inch pieces | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/3 cup buttermilk
instructions: Spray grill with cooking spray.

title: Hazelnut & Parsley Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons mayonnaise ( or more if using non-fat mayo ) | 1 tablespoon pure chili paste ( or to taste ) | 2 fluid ounces apple-flavoured cranberry juice | 1/2 teaspoon tamari ( or to taste ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 4 -5 tablespoons roasted hazelnuts, chopped ( can use walnuts instead ) | 1 parsley sprig ( optional ) | iceberg lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the dressing ingredients in a small bowl. Serve in lettuce leaves topped with nuts and parsley. Note, the hazelnuts can be finely chopped into small pieces after peeling and chopping them if using walnuts.

title: Beef Cubes and Kiwi Noodle Soup
ingredients: 4 lbs beef cubes | 3 lbs chicken wings, cut into 3 inch pieces | 10 cups raw rice noodles, soaked in water overnight | 1 -2 kiwi fruit, thinly sliced or can sliced fruit, drained
instructions: Place the cubes and chicken wing pieces in large stockpot or dutch oven. Add enough water to cover meat by 1/2 inch. Bring to a boil and skimming off the scum that rises to the surface. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 1½ to 2 hours or until meat is very tender. Remove chicken bones and chicken wings and discard. Discard bones. Add noodles and kiwi fruit and heat through. Serve hot with salt and freshly ground black pepper.

title: Ghorayen
ingredients: 4 bunches fresh dill seeds | 2 ounces ghee ( clarified butter ) | 2 ounces mirin | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Place the dill in a small saucepan with water. Bring to a boil over medium heat.

title: Sesame Pastry Wedges
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1/2 pound prosciutto, sliced | 1 package dry pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Press the sesame seeds onto a baking sheet and set aside. Use an apple corer or a very sharp knife to slice the prosciutto slices into very fine slices.

Random Ingredients: french bread,yellow onion,sharp cheddar cheese,orange zest
title: Onion Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 french bread | 2 yellow onions, sliced | 2 oranges, zest of | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Cut the ends off the french bread and make slices of bread from both ends leaving a 1/4 inch thick shell. Slice the onion thick crosswise. Arrange the sliced bread on a cookie sheet, leaving the bread on the side if needed. Brush the top with a little olive oil. Sprinkle the slices lightly with the orange zest. Sprinkle the slices on top of the bread with the cheddar. Broil for 5 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and browned. Serve immediately.

title: Chilled Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 cup yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill thoroughly before serving. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,white rice,rice flour,pecan,swiss cheese,dark rum,thyme,bread flour
title: Cheese Stuffed Oyster Cakes
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups bread flour ( king arthur ) | 3 1/2 cups white rice | 4 cups swiss cheese, coarsely grated | 1 cup toasted pecans | 1 cup oyster sauce | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme | 2 teaspoons dark rum | 1 1/4 cups bread flour | 1 1/2 cups white rice flour
instructions: For the dough, place 1 1/2 cups bread flour and 3 1/2 cups rice flour into the bowl of a food processor, fitted with steel blade. Process until dough forms a ball. Transfer dough to a lightly floured work surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Transfer dough to a floured work surface and knead in remaining 3 1/2 cups bread flour and 1 1/2 cups rice flour to form a dough. Divide the dough into 6 pieces and shape into balls with your hands. Transfer dough rounds to a floured peel and gently press out dough rounds on a floured work surface to about 1/2 inch thick. Cut a slit along the sides of a round from the top to bottom of the dough and, using a fork, scrape out the inside of the round.

Random Ingredients: mini chocolate chip,rock salt,beet,monterey jack cheese,mint leaf,garlic salt,sherry wine
title: Microwave  Strawberry Chiles in Salt on Crackers or Chips
ingredients: 16 ounces mini chocolate chips | 1/2 cup sherry wine or 1/2 cup marsala | 1/2 teaspoon rock salt ( or salt ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 12 medium beets ( cooked peeled and sliced into thin rounds ) | 1/2 lb monterey jack cheese, grated | 10 mint leaves
instructions: Line large cookie sheet with wax paper. Microwave chips and sherry in 2 to 3 minutes on high until chips begin to soften. Stir until melted, 3 to 5 minutes, if desired. Stir in salt, garlic salt, beets. Sprinkle cheese over chips and top with mint leaves. Cover and microwave on high power about 5 minutes. Flip and remove mint leaves before serving.

title: Grilled Sea Scallops
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sea scallops | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 2 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Sprinkle the scallops with 1/4 t. Asafoetida and lightly dust with the cornstarch. Heat the grill. Grill the scallops, 4 at a time, until the flesh flakes easily with a fork, about 3 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a platter or the plates, sprinkle with minced garlic and serve.

title: Mexican Barley Pudding
ingredients: 1 jar brown and serve cocktail pearl barley | 3 cups reduced-sodium evaporated milk | 1 chipotle chile, chopped | 1/3 cup molasses
instructions: In medium size saucepan. Rinse barley. In saucepan, stir together barley, evaporated milk, chipotle, molasses and chipotle. Heat to boiling. Stir until combined, about 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: egg beater substitute,adobo seasoning,irish whiskey,yogurt,tahini,baby carrot,chicken thigh,carrot
title: Slow Cooker Smothered Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/3 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1 tablespoon yogurt | 2 tablespoons old bay seasoning | 3 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1 medium carrot, peeled and sliced | 1 cup baby carrots
instructions: In a bowl combine tahini, egg beaters, yogurt, old bay seasoning and whiskey. Place the chicken thighs in the slow cooker. Pour the sauce over the top and cover with the lid or a lid secured with plastic wrap. Cook on low for 8 hours or on high for high for 4 to 5 hours. To serve, place baby carrots on a bed of baby carrots on a platter. Wrap individually with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,cumin powder,bacon bit,cucumber,iceberg lettuce,butter,shortcrust pastry
title: Grilled Lettuce Lettuce, Bacon and Lime Pie Appetizers
ingredients: 600 g lettuce or 600 g iceberg lettuce | 200 g bacon bits | 4 teaspoons butter | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 tablespoons lime juice | iceberg lettuce | butter-flavoured shortcrust pastry, for serving
instructions: Grate your lettuce or iceberg and keep it whole until ready to use. Chop your bacon bits and fry them in butter until lightly browned. Add the cumin powder and lime juice. Tear the lettuce or iceberg into bite size pieces. Roll out the pastry and cut out two circles. Cover the two circles with each other and a bit of pastry to make a lid. Brush the edges of the pasty with water. Place a lettuce or iceberg lettuce piece down onto your pie. Add the bacon/cilantro/butter mixture and top with your favourite sandwich fillings and cut into desired shapes.

title: Potato and Cantaloupe Soup
ingredients: 1 pound russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 pound cantaloupe, cubed | 1 package cottage cheese, cubed
instructions: Place the russet potatoes into a pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, and stir the russet potatoes and cantaloupe into the simmering soup. Continue simmering until the potatoes and cantaloupe are cooked through and the flavors begin to blend, about 5 more minutes. Stir in the cottage cheese until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,coriander,almond extract,thai red chili pepper,ramen noodle,anise seed
title: Red Kidney Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces ramen noodles, uncooked | 1 cup low-fat yogurt | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon thai red chili pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1 teaspoon anise seeds
instructions: Soak ramen noodles in hot water to soften and macerate. Combine all ingredients in a large casserole dish and bake at 350f for 15 - 20 minutes or until noodles are warmed and slightly firm. Variation, you can use any combination of dried fruit for this recipe and add 3/4 cup low fat yogurt for a thicker dressing. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,red potato,sirloin steak,white vinegar,walnut oil,tomato paste,garlic oil
title: Bifanas of Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon garlic oil | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon guajillo chilies ( or other chili ) | 1/2 cup walnut oil | 1 teaspoon distilled white vinegar | 1 teaspoon potato powder or 1 teaspoon dried potato flakes
instructions: Make a marinade of onion, garlic, tomato paste, chili and 1/2 cup of water in a glass jar. Put the contents into a freezer bag. When ready to use the mixture can be frozen. The marinade can be heated or refrigerated up to several days. In a large frying pan, heat the walnut oil. Add the steak in batches and fry about 2 minutes each side, or until browned and cooked through. When all sides are well browned or about 3/4 of the way cooked, remove to a plate to drain off any excess oil. Pour into a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate. This can also be prepared in the crockpot. Serve with the reserved marinade poured over the meat.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,chili pepper flake,mustard seed,parsley
title: Spicy Salt-Roasted Parsley Side Scallops
ingredients: 6 tablespoons dry mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons dried parsley | 2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 12 -16 ounces peanut oil or 12 -16 ounces vegetable oil ( to cover the bottom of saucepan )
instructions: Rinse and dry the scallops, making sure they are dry, and dredge them well in the dry seeds and parsley. Over high heat, heat the oil in a skillet that has a tight fitting cover and put the scallops in just one layer. Turn the scallops when one side is crisp, then remove and drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with remaining dry ingredients, then serve accompanied by rice, pasta or as an entree to pass at the table.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,chocolate,xanthan gum,topping,cheddar cheese,anaheim chilies,dark sesame oil,turkey bacon
title: Chile & Apple Enchilidas (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1/2 small fresh anaheim chilies ( small hot chile ) | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil, divided | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum | 8 ounces turkey bacon ( lean ) | 1/2 lb shredded cheddar cheese, divided | 1/4 cup low-fat yogurt ( low fat or non-fat can be used ) or 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream ( low fat or non-fat can be used ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho-flavored gelatin or 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 cup shaved fat-free cheddar cheese, for garnish
instructions: Using a sharp knife, slit each chile lengthwise down the center lengthwise. Remove seeds and ribs and cut chile into 1/4 inch rings. Set aside. Meanwhile, combine 1 tablespoon of the oil and the apple juice in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Add the chile rings and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer until the chiles begin to soften, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a strainer, and stir in enough milk to loosen the chiles from their skin.. Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium high heat until lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels, crumble and set aside. Heat the remaining oil in a small saucepan over medium high heat. Add the chile meat and cook until heated through and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in 3/4 cup of the cheese. Cook another 3 minutes, making sure it doesn't burn. Stir the yogurt into the skillet, and stir until it is mixed well. Stir the cheese into the sauce and stir until melted. To serve, spoon about 2 to 3 tablespoons of the filling onto the chile mixture and top with a spoonful of the bacon and cheese.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,egg,cilantro leaf,italian parsley,corn,gruyere cheese
title: French Potato Patties
ingredients: 3 eggs, beaten | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 4 cups grated gruyere cheese | 2 ears fresh corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and lightly oil a 9x13 baking dish, or spray with cooking spray. Combine the eggs, onion soup mix, parsley, and cilantro. Add gruyere cheese and egg mixture. Stir until well blended. Place the corn on the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Carefully break the corn kernels off of the cob into the baking dish. Sprinkle corn with cheese. Carefully pour the egg mixture over the cheese mixture, spreading it into an even circular shape. Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes, until golden brown, and the top is golden.

Random Ingredients: clove,farfalle pasta,green banana,sharp cheddar cheese,hazelnut,salmon steak,black olive,taco sauce
title: Salmon and Hazelnut Tortilla Rollups
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta ( bow tie pasta ) | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | 1/3 cup green beans, chopped | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped hazelnuts | 1/3 cup sliced black olives | 4 salmon steaks, each about 3 oz. and 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1/3 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Add hazelnuts and green beans.

title: Homemade Buttermilk Substitute
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 3/4 teaspoon chili powder ( or to taste )
instructions: Place buttermilk in small saucepan, add 3/4 tsp of chili powder or to taste. Add remaining tbsp or more. Heat slowly until warm, but do not boil, being careful to not boil the liquid as the fat in the buttermilk can separate. Serve.

title: Taste Flavored Salt Body Polish
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable grated fresh yeast ( or 1 teaspoon ground dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons tamari or 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and the bicarb in 2 1/4 cups water. Cool the water and add the yeast mixture stir to dissolve, cover and let stand for 24 hours. The longer the wait, the stronger the flavour and the texture. Strain and use as required. If you don't have an airtight jar store in an airtight jar, they are probably sealed but if you want to use water in place of the water used with the water it might not dissolve either.

title: Honey Ginger Root Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs peeled and cut honey ginger root | 1 stalk celery root, diced
instructions: Boil water in a large saucepan until it is thick, about 8 minutes. Add ginger root, celery root and bring back to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pear,spicy sausage,mango chutney,lettuce leaf,pork loin chop
title: Spicy Sausage Sandwich with Mango Chutney
ingredients: 4 thick slices pork loin chops | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 2 tablespoons spicy sausage, chopped | 8 lettuce leaves | 4 firm pears, wedged
instructions: Combine mango chutney with spicy sausage in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,heavy whipping cream,coconut flake,kosher salt
title: Swiss Cheese With Smoked Coconut
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs swiss cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream | kosher salt | 1/3 cup coconut flakes
instructions: Grate 1/4 lbs swiss cheese with the rinds in a heavy 3 - 4 quart gratin. Add the cream and salt, mix well. Sprinkle with coconut flakes. Put the gratin in a roasting pan and bake on the tops of the stove over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until the cheese is bubbly and golden, about 30 minutes.

title: Tortilla, Tomato and Chicken Soup W-Green Chile Cream Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh tortillas, torn into chunks | 1 garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots or 2 tablespoons scallions | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained and chopped
instructions: Combine the chopped tortilla, minced garlic, chopped shallot and diced green chilies in large saucepan. Over medium high heat, cook for 5 - 10 minutes or until heated through. Stir in tomatoes and simmer for about 5 minutes. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Savory Spinach (Beef) With Polish Sausage
ingredients: 4 polish sausage, sliced 1/4 inch thick on the diagonal | 4 cups washed fresh spinach | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed ( optional ) | french roll | shredded cheese ( or your favourite roll )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. In a large, heavy saucepan, add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Add the spinach and stir. Sprinkle in mustard and stir. Reduce heat until all moisture is absorbed, about 8 - 10 minutes. While that is cooking sprinkle in the brandy, aniseed salt, and stir to blend well. Place the rolls onto a rack. Place sausage on top of rolls, close the lid and place back into oven. Bake until the rolls are dark and sizzling, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

title: Thai Basil(Ayam Pia Muk)
ingredients: 12 leaves fresh thai basil ( i use the leaf in the jar ) | 1 -2 teaspoon coriander powder ( cilantro )
instructions: Place all the ingredient in your mortar and pestle or mortar and mix well. Enjoy i like to use this sauce in my recipe for chili phad Thai basil.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,mint leaf,anise seed,sesame seed,sushi rice,coriander powder
title: Nam Prik Num
ingredients: 3 cups prepared sushi rice ( nam pla ) | 6 baby bok choy | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 4 tablespoons chopped mint leaves | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Steam the bok choy and the mint leaves in a steamer over boiling water until tender, about 6 - 10 minutes. Set aside. Drain the bok choy and mint leaves into a bowl and set aside. Put the sesame seeds and anise seed in a small dry frying pan set over medium low heat and toast the seeds until just beginning to darken. Add the coriander and remove from the heat while warm. In a large serving bowl, add the rice, bok choy and mint leaves and sesame seeds. Add the sesame seeds and anise seed and stir to distribute. Serve garnished with coriander sprigs.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,red wine vinegar,hungarian paprika,vodka,yogurt,chicken bouillon,tuna
title: Tuna Viennese
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh tuna | 8 -10 tablespoons mustard powder ( optional ) | 1 ounce vodka | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon powdered chicken bouillon | 1 bunch yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Boil up tuna in water with mustard powder until tender. Reserve. Add vodka and vinegar to tuna. Chop onion, garlic, peppers fine. Add potatoes to tuna. Slightly smash tuna with a fork while in the process so they don't mash too much. Take 2 tablespoons of olive oil and place in a small frying pan and brown tuna. Add onions, garlic pepper, garlic powder to tuna. When tuna is done take off the heat and place on serving dish in a medium oven for 15 minutes at 300 degrees. Serve with paprika on the side.

title: Orange Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest
instructions: Cook beans in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes or until tender crisp. Drain.

title: Spice Mix - Beets in Milk
ingredients: 8 medium beets | 4 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 4 teaspoons currants | 2 tablespoons milk powder, mixed with water
instructions: Place all the above ingredients into a greased pan and cook over a low heat for 2 hours or until the mixture is cooked. Test to see if it is ready.

Random Ingredients: pre mozzarella cheese,hamburger,splenda granular,graham cracker crumb,white sugar,yogurt
title: Gyro - My Grandma's Copycat Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger ( lean hamburger meat is my view ) | 1 cup quick-mexican low-fat yogurt | 1 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon splenda granular | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 cups pre-shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well and shape into 4 balls. Bake in a 350 degrees f oven for 15 minutes or until browned. Serve hot on toothpicks or pita chips.

title: Spicy Fried Lamb and Cucumbers (Arroz Doce)
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb shoulder, cubed | 1 cucumber | 3 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce from roast or 2 tablespoons salsa, from jar
instructions: Combine cubed lamb with 1/4 cup adobo sauce and toss to coat. Sprinkle with remaining adobo sauce, cover, refrigerate overnight or for up to 5 days. Preheat the oven to 500°. Remove lamb from refrigerator, discard marinade. Cook lamb on a lightly oiled rack in oven for 3 to 4 minutes for medium rare. Slice lamb for 1/2 inch thick slices, and serve with cucumber salsa.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,tomatillo salsa,tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce,cremini mushroom,red curry paste,lemon juice
title: Yogurt Quesadilla for One
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 8 -10 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with salsa | 2 green jalapenos or 2 red jalapenos, with seeds, minced | 4 -6 drops tabasco brand hot sauce ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 cup yogurt ( thick ) or 1 cup plain yogurt ( thick )
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and saute until cooked and lightly browned. Add the tomatoes including the liquid, jalapenos, tabasco, curry paste, and simmer on low for five to five minutes. Remove from heat. To stir the mixture to prevent sticking, pour over your choice of protein and serve warm.

title: Homemade Applesauce for Meat Filling
ingredients: 5 tablespoons applesauce | 1 tablespoon chopped scallion | 1 egg white, plus extra to coat | 1/4 cup cointreau liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare four 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch metal loaf pans by lining with parchment paper, then generously oil the paper. Stir the applesauce, scallions, egg white, and cointreau together in a large bowl. Pour into the loaf pans, then place on baking sheets. Using a sharp knife, make three diagonal slits on the top of each loaf to allow steam to escape. Bake in the preheated oven until the applesauce is bubbling and the loaf is firm, about 40 minutes.

title: Green Chilies Stufati
ingredients: 2 medium green chilies, deseeded and chopped or 1 large red chili | 2 cups low fat cottage cheese, cubed | 1 1/2 teaspoons green chili, de-seeded and chopped ( i use an chilli paste )
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan on medium high flame. Toss in the chilies and fry for a few seconds. Toss in the cottage cheese and fry it with the green chillies. Stir fry for about 2 minutes. Add the chilli puree. Toss in the chopped chilli and serve hot with chapatis.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas or 1 package flour tortillas | 1 can tomatoes, drained, chopped and well drained | 1 cup cranberries ( can also use dried cranberries ) | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 6 teaspoons peppercorns
instructions: Heat in an iron skillet a tortilla until just starting to melt but do not let it sizzle. Turn over. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well coated. Spread onto tortilla and let sit on the counter for about 5 minutes. Cut into 6 wedges. Serve immediately.

title: Texas-Inspired Beef Brisket
ingredients: 4 pounds beef brisket | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 cup watermelon, cut into cubes
instructions: Place brisket into a slow cooker. Sprinkle chili powder and catsup over brisket. Cover, and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours. Remove brisket from the slow cooker after 9 hours. Using two forks, shred meat into strips. Return to slow cooker, stir in watermelon, and cook on high for 1 to 2 hours, until the sauce has thickened a little, and the meat has fallen apart. Allow to rest for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Mama D's Cuban Ham Salad
ingredients: 8 thick slices country ham | 1/2 cup cranberry juice | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 -3 lime wedges, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Lay the ham slices on flat surface and sprinkle the cranberry juice and white wine vinegar on top. Cut one lime wedge across the ham and slice into thin strips. Arrange the sliced ham on the salad with the lime wedges. Serve immediately.

title: Chili Con Carne With Beer
ingredients: 2 cups chopped chile ( i actually use a california blend ) | 1 cup beer, dark and full-bodied ( i use guiness ) | sauce | chili powder | cumin, toasted and coarsely ground ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat beer and chili powder in a small saucepan over medium low heat.

title: Quick Steak Ole Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, cut 3/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons peanut oil, divided | 4 skewers, 3 to 4 inches long | 8 ounces frozen baby corn, thawed | 1/4 cup sliced pimiento, drained | 1 package old fashioned oats, puffed and drained
instructions: Toss beef with 1 tablespoon oil.

title: Ensalada de Alentejana (Served Cold)
ingredients: 6 small corn tortillas or 6 small flour tortillas, torn in half | 6 shallots, chopped | fresh maraschino cherry ( or canned cherry tomatoes ) | 1 cup mixed celery, cut in 1-inch strips on the diagonal | 3 oranges, peeled and sliced into segments ( or a little zest ) | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 2 drops mustard seeds
instructions: On a clean surface, lay out 6 torn tortilla halves as you do so. Top 6 with a little of the chopped shallots, cherries to taste, celery sticks, orange segments, the rest of the chopped shallots, cherries, mustard seeds. Roll the tortillas tightly, then fold in the remaining torn tortillas. Gently press and shape them so that all of them are completely coated with batter. Set the ensalada on a plate and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,honey,lemon peel,yellow bell pepper,rib eye steak,cooking oil
title: Roasted Beef Steak on Lemons
ingredients: 3 -3 lbs rib eye steaks | 1/4 cup honey | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh lemon peel | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt or 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 1 large yellow bell pepper, seeded, finely chopped
instructions: Arrange steak on 2 rack of a broiler pan coated with cooking spray. In a small bowl, stir together honey and lemon peel.

title: Deep Fried Coriander Nibbles
ingredients: 1 kg bread flour | 6 small dried red chilies, or more to taste
instructions: Whisk the flour, chilies, and salt together in a large bowl. Add water so that the mixture forms a coarse, thick batter that leaves the bowl clean. Heat a 12 inch heavy skillet over medium heat. When the skillet is hot, ladle about 1/3 cup of batter into the center.

title: Ziti With Cardamom Cream
ingredients: 400 g ziti pasta | 100 ml double cream | 30 -50 cardamom seeds
instructions: Boil the water in a large pot. Then add the ziti and cook for 10 minutes until they are just pink in the middle. Meanwhile, in another pot, boil the cream to reduce by half. Take the ziti and reduce it down to your preference. Strain the ziti and return to the pot, adding the cardamom seeds a little at a time, tasting for saltiness and adding more salt if necessary. Then pour in the reduced cream and serve.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,oregano leaf,vegetable oil,gin,margarine,ice water,monterey jack cheese
title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup margarine | 2/3 cup soya sauce | 2 tablespoons gin | 2 cups ice water | 1 pinch dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 package shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: With an electric mixer, cream the margarine and soy sauce until light. Beat in the gin and water. Pinch in the oregano, and mix well. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 hours. Stir the cheese every so often, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hot pepper flake,sumac,mozzarella cheese,spring onion,red wine vinegar,pearl barley
title: Barley & Mozzarella Salad With Sumac Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons finely diced spring onions | 2 tablespoons ground sumac | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes | chopped hot pepper flakes ( for topping )
instructions: Place barley in a saucepan and cover with 5 cups of hot water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer approximately 30 minutes or until tender. Drain, return barley to pan, and set aside to cool slightly. Drain the liquid from the barley, reserving the liquid. Place the barley & 1 1/2 cups of the cooking liquid in a bowl & stir in salt & pepper to taste. Cool for an hour or so, then stir to combine. Place the cheese, onion, sumac & pepper flakes in a bowl & mix well. To serve, pile mixture onto plates & drizzle generously with sumac vinaigrette. If desired, garnish with fresh sweet peppers to taste.

title: Baked Shells in the Oven
ingredients: 2 cans condensed tomato soup | 1/2 lb phyllo dough, thawed | 1 romaine lettuce, cut into 6 wedges | 1 avocado | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray 4 individual ovens or 9x13 baking dishes with vegetable spray. In a large bowl, mix together tomato soup and shredded lettuce. Cut the top off of the pastry sheet. Remove 4 sheets and brush with cooking spray. Repeat process, brushing each sheet with cooking spray as you work. Place the 4 sheets in the bottom of the prepared pans. Cover with a layer of the tomato soup mixture. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Cover and bake for 45 minutes, remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before cutting. This is very hot so make sure to stir before removing from the oven.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,rotini pasta,taco sauce,vanilla essence
title: Quick and Easy Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 500 g rotini pasta or 500 g penne, cooked, in plenty of salted lots | 1 -2 tablespoon ra el hanout spice mix | 1/2 - 1 cup taco sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon prepared taco sauce
instructions: Mix together the rest of the ingridients in a large bowl with a pestle and a rotary beater. Chop the pasta into small pieces and pour them over the pestle mix. Serve warm with warmed taco sauce.

title: Easy Chinese Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed white onion soup ( or homemade ) | 10 ounces cooked rice noodles ( dried or fresh ) | 1 large celery rib, diced | 1/2 lb oat ( optional.. really )
instructions: Drain soup from cans. Add onions soup to soup and heat until soup boils. Add noodles and heat, stirring frequently. I like to use a small pot with water just so i do not have to stir. Garnish with more optional toppings if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,cumin powder,white flour,rosemary,anise extract,tarragon vinegar,jalapeno pepper
title: Spicy Beef Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 2 teaspoons jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon of minced rosemary | 1 teaspoon anise extract | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 1/2 cups white flour
instructions: Mix ingredients together and form into meatballs or patties. Spray pan with pam olive oil spray. Brown for a nice crust. Serve. This recipe freezes very well.

title: Orange Butter Ices
ingredients: 4 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons sugar syrup | 4 cups orange juice
instructions: Put butter in a heavy duty mixer. Add sugar syrup and juice and beat well until butter has turned dark orangey. Pour into a glass serving dish. Cut a 1/8 inch slice from side of plastic wrap and place near edge of butter mixture. Roll up and eat immediately, while the butter mixture is still hot. Refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,tart apple,caster sugar,sun tomato oil,coconut oil,guajillo chile,curry powder,mexican chocolate
title: Grilled Fruit With Chocolate and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 400 g good quality coconut oil | 2 guajillo chiles, deseeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons mild curry powder | 400 g guajillo chilies, sliced thinly | 1 tart apple, cored and cut into wedges | 200 g guajillo chiles, sliced thinly | 1/3 cup dried blueberries
instructions: Make the chile paste, heat the sun dried tomatoes in the oil in a large pan over medium high heat for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. When ready to use, press the tomatoes through a sieve to remove seeds. Heat the chile paste and remaining oil in another pan over medium heat. Add half the chiles, sugar and curry powder. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring until fragrant. Using a slotted spoon, drain chiles and spread out in a large flat shallow dish. Add half the guajillo chiles, pineapple slices, apples and remaining chiles. Combine all and pour over the chile paste. Serve at room temperature, with a sprinkling of chopped fresh oreo and a few teaspoons of sugar stirred into the chopped chiles. Enjoy.

title: Caramel - Indian Sugar Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander powder ( ceylon powder. also called coriander fenu ) | 2 tablespoons brown sugar ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine coriander powder and brown sugar in a small bowl. Add a few tablespoons of water to the bowl and mix. Add more water if mixture becomes too dry. Cover and chill in the refrigerator. Enjoy after you are ready to make your caramel.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,salmon,hash brown potato,red cabbage,carrot,garam masala,sparkling water
title: Potatoes and Fish with Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 1/2 lbs red cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 1/2 lbs frozen mixed hash brown potatoes | 1 lb frozen smoked salmon | 1/4 cup spiced sparkling water | 2 cups finely shredded peeled carrots
instructions: To prepare the sugar water, stir together 1/4 cup water and sugar in saucepan over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Stir until sugar dissolves and sugar is dissolved. Increase heat to high and boil until syrup thickens slightly and candy thermometer reads 140 degrees f about 5 minutes. Stir in potatoes, salmon and garam masala. Cook uncovered about 4 minutes or until potatoes are tender but still firm. Transfer to serving bowl. Pour remaining 1 1/2 cups water into empty roasting pan. Add potatoes to pan and toss with a fork to coat. Scatter vegetables over potatoes. Drizzle with sugar water and serve warm.

title: Thai Spiced Fish Sauce (Nua Nuoc Mam)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brandy ( i prefer kå laphda, but can sweeten to your taste before measuring ) | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon anise seed ( crushed if fresh ) | nutmeg, ground
instructions: Mix the dry spices in a small, non reactive bowl or zip lock bag. Add the brandy, fish sauce and anise seed. Mix well. Enjoy.

title: Filipino Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked english peas | 1 cup frozen chopped english pea | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground veal | 1/2 cup green beans, cut into 2 inch lengths | 3/4 cup light coconut milk ( unsweetened ) | 1 cup broth | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 3 cups spinach leaves, rinsed and chopped
instructions: Cook peas in a 2 qts. Soy saucepan of boiling water 3 minutes or until tender. Drain. Place peas in a 3 qt. Saucepan. Cover.

title: Lemon Burgers
ingredients: 12 hamburger buns | 1 jar lemonade
instructions: Heat lemonade in saucepan to boiling point, stirring frequently. Add hamburgers to boiling mixture and lower heat, and cook for a few minutes, or until just cooked through. Spoon into lettuce leaves, drizzle with lemonade, and serve.

title: Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 2 quarts vegetable stock | 2 roma tomatoes, seeded and diced | 3 tablespoons thinly sliced green onions | 8 leaves frisee, with stems removed
instructions: Combine the vegetable stock and tomatoes in a large pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low. Cook until soup is slightly thickened. Stir the green onion into the soup. Ladle into soup bowls.

Random Ingredients: pork,butterscotch schnapps,plain flour,bicarbonate soda,ginger,table salt,maple syrup,nut
title: Pork Gravy from Lamington
ingredients: 250 g minced pork | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 150 ml butterscotch schnapps | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon table salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/4 cup chopped nuts ( your choice )
instructions: In a small pan, stir together the schnapps, soda, bicarbonate of soda, and salt. Heat over low heat. Add minced pork and stir gently until just cooked. Stir in maple syrup. Serve with grated cheese.

title: Red Pepper & Wakame Salty Home Fries
ingredients: 30 g wakame seaweed, coarsely chopped | 1/2 red pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup red capsicum, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Combine the wakame, red pepper and capsicum in a large frypan. Sprinkle with the bicarbonate of soda. Cook over medium heat, stirring regularly, for a couple of minutes before removing from the heat. Leave to cool.

title: Mama Marie's Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 1/4 cup saffron threads | 1/4 cup minced scallion | 3 tablespoons grated cooked lamb | 1 tablespoon grated yellow pepper | 3 lbs boneless leg of lamb | fresh broccoli floret | 1 bunch chopped fresh fig, for garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, combine saffron, scallions, and lamb. Thread lamb onto 2 skewers or bamboo skewers. Grill kababs over moderate heat, brushing with saffron mixture, about 5 minutes per side, until well browned. Briefly steam broccoli, then slice into 1/4 inch pieces. Divide lamb among plates and garnish with figs.

Random Ingredients: spinach,chicken broth,rosemary sprig,tomato paste,sugar snap pea
title: Quick Italian Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 7 -8 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth ( may have to reduce during cooking ) | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1 teaspoon granulated sugar snap pea, finely chopped | 2 -3 fresh rosemary sprigs ( or 1/2 teaspoon dried ) | 1 bag fresh spinach
instructions: Combine broth, tomato paste, sugar, snap peas, and fresh rosemary. Stir well. Bring to boiling. Add spinach. Return to boiling.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,pearl barley,cocoa powder,mango juice,mozzarella cheese,red onion,aubergine
title: Mango and Aussie Cuisine
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large aubergines, sliced in half lengthways, then sliced in half lengthways | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder, sifted | 1/2 red onion, finely diced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped jalapeno, seeds and stems removed, finely chopped | 7 fluid ounces mango juice | 1 lb mozzarella cheese, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 cup pearl barley, cooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300f/150c, gas mark 2 put the sliced aubergine on a greased oven proof dish. Sprinkle with the cocoa powder, toss well and cook in the hottest oven for 15 minutes, then turn the temperature up to 400f/200c and cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until tender and starting to brown. Cool a little. Put the onion, jalapeños and mushrooms, and the mango juice in the pan and bring to a simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and stir in the boiled mushrooms and the cooked aubergine. Place half the yoghurt on each plate. Add the aubergines and mushrooms and then top with parmesan if using. Pour in the remaining yoghurt and scatter over coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,pecan,egg noodle,spinach,peanut oil,mustard powder,pecorino romano cheese,chili pepper flake
title: Beef   Noodle With Spinach
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 ounces egg noodles, uncooked | 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 2 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese or 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, fresh grated | 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese | 2 lbs fresh spinach, chopped | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup sun-dried-corn-starch mixed with 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato oil
instructions: Pound chilli flakes into paste with meat. In a wok, heat 3/4 tbs of the oil and stir fry the beef over high heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Add the remaining oil and when the oil is hot add the paste and stir fry for a minute. Add the peas and spinach and stir fry until spinach is wilted. Stir in the cheese, mix well and remove from heat. In a small bowl, mix the mustard and the remaining 1/2 tbs salt and then add it to the vegetables. Cook the noodles according to package directions. Toss with the mixed salad dressing until coated. Place on serving dish and garnish with the sun dried tomato oil.

title: Spicy Red Curry Beans
ingredients: 1 package frozen great northern beans | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 -3 dashes hot pepper ( i use jalapeno for the kick )
instructions: Drain the beans and microwave them on high for 8 - 10 minutes. While the beans are still warm cut them into 2 - 3 - 4 sections lenghwise. Place them on a nonstick fry pan and add the curry paste. Add the hot pepper as it's coming to a boil and cook for a few seconds. Add the beans and cook for 3 - 4 minutes until the curry paste has begun to smell fragrant. Serve on a bed of rice.

title: Pizza Sauce II
ingredients: 4 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 10 small onions, sliced | 1 small onion salt, chopped ( medium ) | 2 tablespoons brown onion salt | 1 teaspoon sage leaf ( dried ) | 1 teaspoon pepperoni | 1 1/4 tablespoons flour
instructions: Heat clarified butter in a 10 nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add onions.

title: Slow Cooker Beef Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup ketjapas ( indonesian teriyaki sauce ) | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup fresh tarragon, chopped or 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 4 cups elbow macaroni | 3 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, sliced ( i used eckrich's brand ) | 1 1/2 cups turnips, peeled & sliced into 1/4 inch rounds | 1 1/2 cups turnips, peeled & sliced into 1/4 inch rounds
instructions: Combine beef, teriyaki sauce, nutmeg, tarragon, and 2 cups water in slow cooker. Cover. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Add macaroni, cover and continue cooking until macaroni is tender. Drain macaroni well and return to slow cooker. Add greens, return to slow cooker, cover and continue cooking until greens are done. Stir once. Serve over jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,pork,tomato juice,thai red chili pepper
title: Pork and Tomato Stew
ingredients: 250 g ground lean pork | 300 ml tomato juice | 30 ml dried thyme sprigs | 2 thai red chili peppers, seeded, minced
instructions: Combine the pork, tomato juice, thyme, and chilies in a medium saucepan. Bring to the boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer. Simmer for 1 hour, or until the pork is cooked through. Serve with steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: white onion,creamy peanut butter,miracle whip,corn kernel,horseradish
title: Corn and Horseradish Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup miracle whip | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon finely chopped white onion | 1/2 cup corn kernels
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in food processor. Process until creamy. If too thick add a little water.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,salsa verde,flat leaf parsley,kernel corn,cheese,chili oil,margarine
title: Corn and Jack Cheese Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cheese ( jack, cheddar, muenster, fontina ) | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 -2 tablespoon salsa verde ( mild, medium-hot or mexican style salsa verde ) ( optional ) | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Sprinkle cheese with parsley and chile oil. Place in a small nonstick skillet on top of the stove. Heat for 1 - 2 minutes, or until the cheese starts to turn golden brown. Pour in the taco sauce, sour cream, salsa and corn. Heat for another 1 - 2 minutes, or until the taco sauce is heated through. Stir. Divide the mixture among four dinner plates. Serve immediately.

title: Hijiki (Dairy Bean Spread)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower seeds, shelled | 3 -4 tablespoons sweet and spicy sauce | 1 tablespoon chili, finely chopped ( or you could add a generous amount of jalapeno, jalapeno powder, dried chili flakes, dried parsley flakes ) | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest ( zest of 1 large lemons or limes ) | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa | 1 3/4 cups dry haricot beans or 1 3/4 cups white flour, preferably a very dry, unsalted blend | 1 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Toast, rinse and soak the sunflower seeds until they become fragrant. Soak seeds in water for 1 hour, then drain. Combine the rest of the ingredients, adding about a 1/2 cupful of the soaking soaking water, if needed, to mix well. If using a dry bean, add more of the soaking water and add as much beans as necessary to make a thick paste. Add enough water as necessary to achieve a thick paste. Refrigerate paste overnight and stir occasionally. The paste will be quite watery. Serve sprinkled with a bit of cocoa and chopped fresh coriander.

title: Grilled Nori Nori (Nori Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon grated lemon extract | 1 package nori ( dry seaweed seaweed )
instructions: Whisk brown sugar, corn syrup, oregano, and lemon extract together in a large glass bowl until smooth. Remove the nori seaweed from plastic containers and submerge to coat with the sugar mixture until the nori is completely coated. Let dry at room temperature for 30 minutes. Place nori on a clean cutting board and cut into 10 squares. Place 1 nori square at a time onto a bamboo sushi roller and make one or two horizontal cuts, keeping each slice about 1/2 inch from edge. Sprinkle nori squares with more brown sugar mixture. Using your hands, press seaweed into rice flavored sugar mixture about 1/8 inch thick. Allow nori to dry at room temperature a few minutes, then cut into 2 1/2 inch wide pieces using a small knife dipped in warm water. Repeat with remaining nori squares.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,chili green,cotija cheese,green olive,grain rice
title: Spanish Rice With Spiced Olives, Green Olives, and Cotija
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long-grain rice | 2 1/2 cups hot cotija cheese, shredded ( about 1 1/2 c. ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped pitted green olives ( about 1/2 t. ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chili ( hot green peppers, such as serrano, chipotles ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons coarsely chopped allspice berries, coarsely crushed
instructions: Set a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the rice and toast it, stirring it constantly until it begins to turn golden, about 1 minute. Scatter the cheese, olives, green chili, and allspice evenly over the rice.

title: Frozen Peaches
ingredients: 4 firm ripe but ripe peach, such as golden delicious | 1 tablespoon good quality kirsch | 2 tablespoons good quality balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup grated palm sugar | 1/4 cup finely chopped celery | 1 large cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Halve the peaches and remove the pits. Cut out the stones. Place the peaches in a freezer bag, remove the peel, cut on the diagonal into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Place in the freezer for 15 minutes to allow the shells to defrost. Remove the shell carefully. Mash the peaches and pour into a freezer bowl or container. Pour kirsch over the peach, add ghee and stir until smooth. Pour over the peach shells to cover completely.

title: Warm Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 5 cups shredded cabbage | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange cabbage on a baking sheet. Drizzle with oil. Bake, covered, for 15 minutes, stirring once. Remove from oven. Let cool until cabbage is cool.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,currant,paprika,orange juice concentrate,dark chocolate,basil pesto,white pearl onion
title: Minty Pesto and Orange Burgundy Onions With Chocolate
ingredients: 1 lb white pearl onion, peeled ( approximately 2 medium onions ) | 1 ounce dark chocolate | 1/3 cup basil pesto | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon orange juice concentrate ( concentrated ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon dried basil or 1 teaspoon fresh basil, minced chives | 3 tablespoons dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 450ºf. In large, shallow roasting pan, heat onions in a single layer until golden, about 15 minutes. Place in a single layer and transfer to a baking sheet. Bake onions in oven until just beginning to turn pale golden, about 50 minutes. Meanwhile, stir together the parmesan, vinegars and orange juice until blended. Drain the onions and spread out on a piece of plastic wrap. Roast onions until dark golden, about 18 minutes. Set onions aside to cool. Using a slotted spoon, remove to a bowl.

title: Simple Beef Stir Fry(Or Broccoli for Two)
ingredients: 1 lb skirt or 1 lb sirloin | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Slice steak crosswise. Combine other ingredients and mix with steak, stir fry 2 minutes or so, serve.

title: Thai Noodles
ingredients: 5 heads radishes | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Thoroughly wash and dry the radishes. Cut into matchsticks. Arrange in a bowl and allow to sit for 20 minutes. Heat a large skillet over high heat. Quickly stir in the radish sticks and fish sauce. Cook and stir until the radish pieces are just softened, about 8 minutes.

title: Beef and Pork Hamburgers
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil | 600 g beef oxtail, steamed | 2 cups lettuce leaves | 3 slices bread | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 -2 teaspoon chili | 50 g crisp fried french bread, cubes
instructions: Heat oil in large pan, add oxtail and cook until browned. Remove from pan, drain. Reheat pan and add lettuce, cook until wilted. Add meat, cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat, add chilli, bread cubes and stir together. Replace lid. Place in oven, 180c for 30 minutes. Serve with boiled rice.

title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 large yellow squash, halved | 2 medium jicama, chopped into 1/4 inch cubes | 4 -6 celery ribs, chopped into 1/8 inch | 3 fresh basil leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 cup olive | 1/2 cup finely chopped dried garbanzo beans or 1/2 cup any dried harissa | 1 - 1 1/2 lb penne, cooked to desired tenderness
instructions: Toss together the squash with the desired salad ingredients and set aside. Drain the excess olive oil from the canned garbanzo. Place all other ingredients in medium serving bowl and toss together with the olives. Serve warm or cold.

title: Marinade for Pork or Chicken
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh lime juice | 6 teaspoons ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning tm
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a jar and pour over pork or chicken pieces.

title: Peanut Butter Frosting
ingredients: 6 ounces salted butterworths syrup | 4 ounces peanut oil, for greasing
instructions: Sieve all the ingredients and beat with a metal or wooden spoon til smooth. Sieve over a warm buttered bowl or spread with greaseproof paper and store in an airtight tin for upto 4 days.

title: Celery Seed
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely crushed celery seeds | 2 teaspoons coarse sea salt
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly combine the celery seeds, sea salt and celery seeds. Using an electric spice grinder or mortar and pestle, grind and mix to a coarse powder. Store in a tightly closed glass jar with a tight fitting lid. Variation, replace 2 teaspoons celery seeds with 1/2 teaspoon celery seeds and 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves.

Random Ingredients: egg,fontina cheese,stevia powder,bamboo skewer,baby spinach,ramen noodle,cream,beet
title: Easter Kebabs
ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach | 2 cups baby beets | 14 ounces fat free sour cream ( fat free if your can ) | 1 cup fontina cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon stevia powder | 8 ounces chicken-flavored ramen noodles | 8 bamboo skewers ( optional )
instructions: Boil water in a large pot for the ramen noodles. Once they start to cook, add the beets and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Add the spinach and stir well. Remove the kababs, draining every few minutes just until all the liquid comes out of the beet. Once cooked, add the sour cream and stir well. In a large serving bowl, sprinkle the fontina cheese, stevia powder, ramen noodles, and bamboo skewers. Spoon the beet and sour cream mixture onto the noodles. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Brunch Pastry Pinwheels
ingredients: 10 ready to rollout puff pastry | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur ( recommend amaretto liqueur # 2 ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 jicama, sliced thinly on the diagonal | 6 slices provolone cheese ( about 2 ounces ) or 6 slices fontina cheese ( about 2 ounces )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees. Unroll puff pastry and using a pastry wheel or fork, cut evenly into 12 equal pieces. On a lightly floured surface, pat each piece into a rectangle. Brush each piece of pastry with amaretto liqueur, pressing lightly onto both sides to coat the pieces. On a rimmed baking sheet lined with parchment paper, place the puff pastry and any pastry leftover on the baking sheet. Using a pizza rolling pin, trace 9 circles out of the pastry. Using an ice cream scoop, carefully lift about 1 1/2 teaspoons of mixture from pastry onto the pastry, keeping the mixture at a 50 degree angle so that the edges form a rim on the table. Place the jicama slices on top of the puffed pastry, pressing lightly to adhere. If using fontina cheese, sprinkle the grated cheese evenly over the jicama slices and then place the fontina cheese on top of the cheese. Place baking sheet on oven and bake for 25 minutes. Remove baking sheet from oven and remove parchment paper. Serve warm or at room temperature. Letting the cheese slightly melt the cheese will give a nutty flavor to the puff pastry.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,mace,part mozzarella cheese,cilantro leaf,banana pepper,caper,picante sauce,purpose flour
title: Papaya Banana Pepper Cheese (Papaya)  With Cilantro-Salsa
ingredients: 4 firm ripe banana peppers, seeded and cut into 4 squares | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon whole coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 cup bottled picante sauce or 1 cup purchased picante hot sauce | 1/2 cup drained capers | 1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the banana peppers and 2 tablespoons of the flour in a small skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes, or until the banana pepper slices soften slightly. Move the bananas to a bowl and stir the remaining flour into the skillet with the peppers. Increase the heat to medium high and quickly stir in the coriander and mace. Cook and stir for 20 seconds. Add the picante sauce, capers, cheese, and remaining 1 tablespoon flour and stir until well mixed. Spoon into a baking dish and top with the cilantro. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the papaya is heated through and the topping is browned around the edges.

title: Rice Salad With Tahini Butter
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white rice | 3 ounces tahini ( or melted butter ) | 1 orange, juice of | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 small green pepper, chopped ( or any other hot pepper ) | 1 small turnip, chopped | 1/2 lb jarlsberg cheese, cubed ( or a mixture of any flavor )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients together, except cheese, in a large bowl. Stir in cheese. Place the whole pot in a large roasting pan and bake for about 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly. Take out of oven and let cool.

title: Foolproof Tzatziki
ingredients: 1/2 cup instant coffee, such as kahlua | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon chopped serrano chilies | 3 cups finely ground pork ( optional ) | 1 cup frozen corn, defrosted and drained ( optional ) | tzatziki for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together coffee, cumin, cardamom and onion powder until coffee is dissolved. Stir in the chilies.

title: Creamy Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 200 g shiitake mushrooms | 300 ml chicken stock ( for mushroom soaking if using the water ) or 300 ml water ( for mushroom soaking if using the water ) | 4 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Clean shiitake mushrooms and slice thinly at an angle or in halves if using a fan shape. If using a fan shaped mushroom, soak for 5 to 10 minutes in some cold water. Drain well and leave for 2 to 3 minutes. Strain and keep aside. Combine chicken stock or water and cream to make a pourable liquid. Chop mushrooms thinly and add to simmering liquid, simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.

title: Blueberry Taco Sauce With Chilies & Chili
ingredients: 1 cup blueberries or 1 cup strawberries | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup chopped red chilies
instructions: Mix together and use immediately or refrigerate and use later.

title: Chinese Brunch Nachos
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate ( i use a mix of 70 percent and 80 percent chocolate ) | 1/2 small chinese cabbage, outer leaves removed | 80 g raw cashews ( or other nuts ) | served warm or cold as they are called in the asian supermarket
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a bowl over a pan of just barely simmering water. Chop the cabbage finely and spread it over the top of the melted chocolate. Pour melted chocolate over the chopped cabbage and nuts. Serve at once.

title: Creamy Sweet Potato
ingredients: 5 sweet potatoes | 1 large banana pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste, to taste-not hot
instructions: Pierce all over with fork and fry in oil over medium heat for 5 minutes or until soft. Meanwhile, peel and slice potatoes. Add peppers to potatoes in fry pan and cook 5 more minutes, stirring to cook evenly. Add curry paste and cook for one minute, stirring. Serve.

title: Greek Roast Beef With Olives
ingredients: 1 teaspoon black kalamata olive ( pitted if desired ) | 4 tablespoons beef fat ( from a piece of beef, or just use any olive oil you may have )
instructions: First remove the beef and slice it thinly at an angle.

title: Steaming Clam Parfait
ingredients: 1 can chopped tomatoes with puree | 1/2 ounce unflavored gelatin ( use knox gelatin or 3 oz. powder, dissolved in 1/4 cup chilled water ) | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 1 cup chopped onion | 2 cups bottled clam juice ( bottled or fresh ) | 1 package rolled oats
instructions: Pour tomato puree into a medium microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle gelatin over mixture and stir to dissolve. Heat on high until gelatin has melted and is clear. Add chopped onion and clam juice and stir until combined. Put in refrigerator for at least 1 hour and up to 24 hrs. Pour mixture into four parfait glasses. Top with oats.

title: Aglio E Olio
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mozzarella ball | 1/3 cup water chestnut ( sliced thinly ) | 1/2 small lemon, juice of or 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon allspice berry ( crushed )
instructions: Cut mozzarella in 1 wide bite size pieces and place in a mixing bowl. Add water chestnuts and lemon juice. Mix well and then sprinkle with crushed allspice berry. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Drain and serve cold.
