Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,feta cheese,chicken bouillon cube,tomatillo salsa,splenda sugar substitute
title: Low Fat, Low Carb Feta Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 4 teaspoons splenda sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon tomatillo salsa ( mild or hot, to taste ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon feta cheese
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut into medium chunks. Bring a large pot of water to boil, add 2 teaspoons of salt and 2 teaspoons of splenda and set aside.. Drop the potatoes by tablespoons into the boiling water and quickly simmer until fork tender. Add the tomatillo paste to the potatoes and mash with a potato masher or fork, adding splenda, tomatillo salsa and feta cheese. Simmer, covered, another two minutes, taste to see if any more splenda is in the mix or not. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mace,molasses,parmigiano reggiano romano cheese,green onion,halibut fillet,grain rice,chocolate chip,sambal oelek
title: Alfredo Baked in Chocolate with Halibut
ingredients: 3 cups medium-grain rice | 5 3/4 lbs halibut fillets or 5 3/4 lbs haddock fillets, skinned | 8 ounces unsweetened chocolate chips, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground mace, divided | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped green onion, white and light green parts only | 4 tablespoons light molasses | 2 cups grated parmigiano-reggiano-reggiano cheese | 4 tablespoons sambal oelek ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with oil. Rinse rice under running water in a sieve until water runs clear, and drain well. Set aside, and arrange the fish fillets on a large lipped cutting board with a generous thickness. Using a sharp knife, cut the fillets crosswise through the base of the fillet in 1 long lengths. Place in a baking dish, and cover completely with the chocolate. Heat the molasses in a small saucepan, and stir constantly to make a thick, smooth paste. Pour over the fish fillets, and sprinkle evenly with the pepper, mace, onion, cheese, and sambal oelek. Bake the fish in lower third of the oven 20 minutes, basting once, and spooning any remaining sauce over the fish before browning.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,fine breadcrumb,rye bread,cider vinegar,black caviar
title: Battered Rydbergs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 4 teaspoons black caviar ( homemade is best, but bottled will do ) | 8 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons garlic powder or 2 teaspoons garlic powder or 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together.. Dip the rydbergs in the vinegar for about a minute on each side to lightly brown and help absorb the excess juice. Place on a heated rack in a baking dish and put in a 400 degree oven. Bake for 15 minutes or until slightly crisp and lightly browned on the outside and golden in color on the inside. Serve warm. If desired, dip tops in honey or browned jam or dip into jelly if desired.

Random Ingredients: sultana,chicken stock beef,malibu rum,cake flour,heavy whipping cream,barbecue sauce,chicken wing
title: Dynamite Chicken Wings
ingredients: 200 g chicken wings | 2 1/2 tablespoons cake flour | 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups beef stock | 400 g barbecue sauce ( chris & pitt's ) | 2 tablespoons malibu rum | 150 g sultanas | 200 g heavy whipping cream
instructions: Dip wings in 1 tbsp flour, then coat in cake. Fry in hot oil. Drain, then put into a large ovenproof dish. Bake in moderate oven for 40 - 45 mins until tender, and golden. Drain off oil, and remove chicken from bones. Increase the oven temperature to 200c/fan 170c/gas heat stock with the bbq sauce to make a sauce. Heat through, then stir in sultanas. To serve, pour over chicken, and serve with cream.

Random Ingredients: passion fruit pulp,chocolate bar,manzanilla olive,horseradish,yellow pea,white wine
title: Sweet Pea and Honey Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces manzanilla olives | 1 ounce yellow split peas, shelled | 12 ounces white wine | 4 ounces passion fruit pulp ( kernals ) | horseradish | chocolate bar, to serve
instructions: Slice the manzanilla olives in half and put into a food processor with the split peas and half the wine. Process till smooth. Transfer to a pan, season and stir in the passionfruit pulp. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 mins, remove from the heat. Spoon into sterilized jars, leaving 1 space at the top, seal and leave for 1 - 2 weeks then store in the fridge.

title: Lebanese Tarator - Tasty Patties (For Ramen)
ingredients: 250 g tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon tamari | 500 g quick-cooking rolled oats | 250 g lard ( or other soft oil ) | 50 g green gram ( mung beans ) | 1 lemon, juice of, and grated rind of
instructions: First of all, put water on the steaming tray and put the steaming tray on it to boil. Next, put the rolled oats into a bowl and add 1 teaspoon of tamarind concentrate and 1 teaspoon of tamari paste, stir a few times or until they absorb the water. Soak them in water for at least 30 minutes. Take them out and leave to cool. After the steaming tray has cooled completely, mix them well with the oats and tamarind paste. Add the water in which the tamarind was soaked, the 1 teaspoon of tamarind concentrate and 1 teaspoon of tamari paste, mix together very well. Mix in the green gram until it just covers the mixture with air bubbles in the mixture. Let it rest for about 1 hour, and now prepare the seasoning. For the stuffing, put the lard into a bowl and add the chopped green gram. Mix well with your hands. The quantity of green gram may vary. I usually use about 1 1/2 to 2 cups. Spread the stuffing over the tamarind filling mixture, using 2 fingers. Now you should have a patty. Place the patty in a steamer. Steam it for 10 minutes, checking the progress as required, or until it is cooked. Remove from the steamer and drain off all but 2 tablespoons. To serve, put a little water on the pot lid, close the lid, and steam until it has cooled down. Then serve with pickls, pita bread or bread slices, and pickled cucumber.

title: Spinach Moghul
ingredients: 300 g fresh spinach leaves, washed | 1 cup rice milk ( i use almond milk ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | salt
instructions: Place the fresh spinach in a colander and lightly wash over a bowl. Keep this to one side. Put the rice in a saucepan. Add some of the water which absorbed in the rice milk and enough water to make a thick mixture. Add 1/2 tbsps. Of salt and the rest of the ingredients to the hot spinach. Bring this to a boil and cook on high heat for 2 minutes. Reduce heat, cover and cook on medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring intermittently. Stir the spinach once every 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Pastries
ingredients: 250 g red peppers | 2 teaspoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Place the rinsed peppers along the length of the pepper and secure with kitchen string. Place on a baking tray and sprinkle with the flour and cayenne. Roast in preheated oven for 30 min 1hour. Cool slightly then transfer the peppers and roasted red peppers to serving dish.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil oregano garlic,hot sauce,icing sugar,black eyed pea,brandy
title: Italian Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained ( can use navy beans ) | 1 tablespoon chopped brandy | 1/2 tablespoon icing sugar | hot sauce, dash | tomato basil oregano and garlic, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and stir until smooth.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,kosher salt,galangal,bean sprout,dark molasses,ghee
title: Bean Sprouts Salad With Ginger
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark molasses | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon powdered galangal ( thai ginger root ) | 8 leaves fresh ginger, thinly sliced and divided into halves | 1 cup bean sprouts ( fresh or frozen ) | 4 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Warm the molasses in a small skillet over low heat until it is just warm. Stir in the vinegar, ginger, bean sprouts and salt. Serve warm, or cool.

title: Bread and Pumpkin Seed Snack - Snack Mix from India
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups bread, torn up | 1 cup dry roasted pumpkin seeds | 12 -18 green cardamom seeds
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except the bread, together with the bread, and store the mixture in an airtight container. Note, if using the bread, you can prepare an ice cream maker for this recipe, fill the bread to the top and freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions. After freezing bread, give bread a quick stir again before using.

Random Ingredients: chia seed,ketchup,cream cheese,spring onion,avocado,ancho chile powder,mace,kielbasa
title: Creamy Chia Dip
ingredients: 5 kielbasa ( italian sausage ) | 1 small avocado, peeled and chopped | 3 spring onions, chopped | 2 fresh ancho chiles, chopped | 1/2 cup chunky ketchup | 3 ounces cream cheese | 1/4 cup chia seeds | 1/4 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace, or to taste
instructions: Grill kielbasa over desired heat, turning as needed to evenly brown. Cut into 6 slices. Set sausage aside to cool, then slice thinly, discarding casings. Place the chopped avocado, chopped spring onions, ancho chiles, ketchup, cream cheese, chia seeds, ancho chile powder, and mace in a blender or food processor, cover the blender, and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass or ceramic pie plate, cover, and chill in the refrigerator at least 4 hours or overnight. Serve with crackers and warm pita bread.

Random Ingredients: red burgundy wine,thai red curry paste,ladyfinger,fruit,bok choy,dark corn syrup
title: Spicy Sang Thai Trifles
ingredients: 12 ounces bok choy, stalks sliced lengthwise | 18 ladyfingers | 14 ounces red burgundy wine ( you can sub any other dry red wine, but i recommend that balsamic is the best ) | 1/4 cup light dark corn syrup | 3 1/2 teaspoons thai red curry paste ( or to taste, and if desired, 1 teaspoon soy sauce ) | 12 strawberries
instructions: Separate the lady fingers, and dry them on paper towels. Set them aside. Put the choy stalks, the lady fingers and wine in a bowl and stir. Set aside until ready to serve. In a small saucepan, combine the corn syrup and the curry paste. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until the mixture comes to a boil, and then remove from heat. Pour over the chilled lady fingers.

title: Baked Fruit Pie
ingredients: 2 pie crusts, unbaked | 12 ounces mixed dried fruit | 4 fluid ounces brandy | 10 fluid ounces tabasco sauce
instructions: Remove the crusts from the bottom of each pie shell and prick with a fork. Spray with cooking spray, then cover the bottoms with the fruit, and finally with the brandy. Mix well until all ingredients are blended, then pour into the pie case. Bake, uncovered at 375 for 20 - 25 minutes or until the fruit is thoroughly glazed.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,gouda cheese,red chile,kidney bean,chutney,dutch cocoa,black peppercorn,liquid honey
title: Chocolate Mambo and Cheese Chili
ingredients: 3 ounces chutney beans | 2 ounces canned kidney beans | 15 whole black peppercorns | 10 ounces sour cream-style corn | 1 ounce dutch-processed cocoa | 10 ounces shredded gouda cheese | 3 ounces liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon red chile
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450°. Drain and rinse the chuggahtchae. Combine the beans, peppercorns, corn and cocoa in a food processor. Process until it becomes a chunky chunky batter. You don’t want it like an oil paste. Spread the chili batter on the bottom of a small casserole dish and top with the shredded cheese and chutney beans. Bake for about 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese starts to melt. While the chili bakes, mix the honey, chilli pepper and crushed black pepper. Serve over rice and a side dish with steamed greens.

title: Seared Beef Tenderloin with Apple Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon steak sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, grated | sauce
instructions: Preheat over to 375 degrees. Combine crumbs and ground ginger in a shallow dish. Dredge beef tenderloin in crumb mixture and place in a glass dish. Combine apple juice, steak sauce and grated fresh ginger and pour over the beef, turning meat so it gets coated with the sauce. Marinate for 1 hour. Cook at 375 degrees for 2 hours, basting often.

title: Chinese Chicken With Black Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns | 4 garlic cloves, peeled | 1 lb chicken, boned | 2 -3 tablespoons black sesame seeds
instructions: Combine peppercorns and 3/4 cup water in a small heavy skillet. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Add chicken and cook, basting with remaining cup of water, until chicken is cooked, about 10 minutes. Turn over halfway through cooking, basting with water remaining in skillet. Sprinkle with sesame seeds, cover and let cook 2 - 3 minutes longer, or until chicken is golden brown.

title: Acapulco Dip
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 lb ice, crushed | 2 green onions, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour prior to serving.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,butterscotch schnapps,dark brown sugar,italian parsley,island dressing,bean
title: Butterscotch Schnapps Slice
ingredients: 2 ounces unsalted butter, melted | 2 teaspoons gelatin | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup island dressing | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate chipotles in schnapps | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Put melted butter in jelly mould. Add gelatine mix, brown sugar, dressing chocolate chipotles& parsley mix well. Press mixture into the base of a slice tin. Chill for 1 hour in the fridge. Remove slice from tin, cut in half horizontally leaving centre of slice to one side.

title: Cascadia Filling With Sun-Dried Tomato and Blackberry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pancetta, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, very thinly sliced | 1/4 cup blackberry, washed and drained | red food coloring
instructions: Place pancetta in a heatproof bowl.

title: Omelette With Okra
ingredients: 8 okra, washed | 8 large eggs | 7 ounces bean sprouts | 1/4 cup cognac | 1 tablespoon cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Put the eggs in a pan, scramble them and mix with the okra. Make a mixture out of the okra mixture and pour over the eggs. Stir the okra into the eggs. Dribble over the cocoa if using. Allow to cook, stirring, until the omelette has set. Do not over cook the eggs. When it's cool enough to handle break into pieces. It should not be runny the same shape as the okra. Store at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,russet potato,green olive,rose water,sugar,veal stock,tomato oil,lime
title: Roasted Spanish Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs russet potatoes, scrubbed and halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons tomato oil | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice, chopped | 1 cup sugar | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 - 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1/2 cup sliced green olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Place potatoes in a large shallow baking pan.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,beef tenderloin,apple cider,blueberry,anchovy fillet,ice water,red pepper,walnut
title: Blueberry-Apple Crumbing Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries ( or frozen frozen ) | 2 tablespoons walnuts ( toasted ) | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper | 1 can anchovy fillets, undrained ( or equivalent ) | 1/3 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs or 1/3 cup breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons apple cider | 1 tablespoon ice cold water ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f trim fat from beef, as desired. Using 1/2 teaspoon meat tenderizer, pound the tenderloin between sheets of waxed paper on a meat tenderloin to 1/2 inch thickness. Spread each with blueberries, walnuts, crushed red pepper and anchovies. Starting at 1 inch from end, roll each in bread crumbs, coating evenly. Arrange in one layer on a non stick roasting pan. Deglaze roasting pan with the apple cider or water and pour over the rolled meat. Seal with a tight fitting lid or aluminum foil. Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight remove meat from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Preheat grill to medium heat. Place 3 - 4 inch diameter piece of foil large enough to line the edges and the long edge of the meat. Place one short metal spatula under the foil, next to it the beef, using long metal spatula, so that the foil overshoes the sides of the pan. Remove foil with spatula and add meat to grill, leaving at least 2 inches from the top of the meat. Close lid and cook until temperature reaches 130°f on an instant reading thermometer, about 25 minutes. Turn beef over and close the top of foil. Close the grill and continue cooking until instant read thermometer reads 130°f for medium rare or 130°f for medium well. Slide foil edges under tinfoil, and remove foil with spatula. Let stand until meat is warm to the touch and is hot, about 10 minutes.. Remove meat from oven and let rest 5 minutes.

title: BBQ Turkey with Basil and Peppers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shredded coconut, or as needed | 1 jar pepperoncini peppers, drained, or as needed | 8 slices fresh-tender deli ham ( optional ) | 2 ounces turkey ( optional ) | 1 jar barbeque sauce, or as needed | 1/2 cup thai basil, or to taste
instructions: Mix coconut into pepperoncini peppers.

title: Creamy Veal Spread With Chickpeas, Artichokes, and Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 3/4 - 1 cup canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni | 14 4-ounce packages cream cheese, cut into cubes | 2 -3 dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill several hours. Serve hot or chilled.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,kaffir lime leaf,russet potato,turkey,parsnip,herman sourdough starter,active yeast
title: Crispy Chicken-Turkey Focaccia
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm mashed potato ( not plain ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons herman sourdough starter | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 3/4 cup warm turkey fat ( not just fat or oil ) | 1 large russet potato, peeled cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 large parsnip, peeled cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 large zested kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Combine the potato, yeast, and sourdough starter in bowl of an electric mixer. Stir in the guar gum, water, and the 2 tablespoons fat. Stir in half of the turkey fat. Add the potato mixture, the remaining turkey fat, parsnip, zest, and lime. Mix gently until the dough forms into a thick but sticky consistency. If you make the dough too sticky, add more flour. Turn dough out on a lightly floured surface and knead until the dough is smooth and elastic, adding more of the turkey fat if necessary. Place dough in a greased bowl, turning to grease the top. Cover with plastic wrap, and set in a warm spot to rise until doubled in volume, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Punch down the dough and shape into a 14 inch round. Place on parchment lined baking sheets. Cover with a greased towel and let rise until doubled. Preheat oven to 425° and bake for 25 minutes, or until puffy. Cool on racks.

title: Easy Shrimp Baka!
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 lb shrimp ( cleaned )
instructions: Toss the shrimp with turmeric and salt to taste in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Prepare the baka by putting the shrimp on a cutting board, spoon shrimp over shrimp and let them sit for 1 minute until the shrimp turn pink. The skin will be on the shrimp. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,chilies,sultana raisin,rice noodle,monterey jack cheese,maple syrup,salad oil
title: Cheesy Chilies Rissoles
ingredients: 6 -12 canned chipoltes in syrup | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 packages rice noodles, medium ( about 1 1/2 cup ) | 2 red capsicums, cut into long strips ( red shallots may be used instead ) | 1/2 cup sultana raisin | 1 can ro-tel chopped chilies, drained ( may use a combination of hot green and red peppers ) | 1 cup packed grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Drain canned chiles thoroughly, chop chiles roughly and place in large mixing bowl, cover with very hot tap water and let soak 30 to 60 minutes or drain chiles and rinse well. When ready to use, drain chiles and pat dry with paper towels. Drain chiles on paper towels and set aside. Rinse rice noodles by pouring hot water over them to soften. Rinse until cold and drain again. Set aside. Heat salad oil over medium heat in a wide nonstick skillet or deep pan. Cook noodles until just softened, about 3 minutes to soften, about 2 to 3 minutes. Drain on kitchen paper and set aside to cool.. Place remaining ingredients except cheese in a mixing bowl, cover with a lid and let stand for 10 to 15 minutes. Portion noodles in 4 or 6 portions and place evenly in 4 serving bowls. Divide mushroom mixture evenly among 4 of the bowls. Divide remaining mushroom mixture evenly among 4 bowls. Top each with cheese and remaining noodles and serve immediately. Note, these may be prepared ahead and refrigerated for up to 2 days. Reheat the chilies until hot and serve with cheese.

Random Ingredients: italian spice,half,plain yogurt,cottage cheese,fruit sauce,breadstick,mint,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheddar and Fruit Grissini Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 cup 2 % fat cottage cheese or 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/3 cup 2 % low-fat sour cream | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 1 teaspoon dried fruit-flavored hot italian spices | 1 tablespoon half-and-half | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 7 -8 breadsticks ( each about 3 to 4 inches long )
instructions: Place cottage cheese in a medium size bowl, sprinkle yogurt all over, then stir to combine. Set aside. To make the topping, combine pesto ingredients.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,savory,pickle relish,bay leaf,marshmallow,corn kernel
title: Pennsylvania Dutch Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1 tablespoon sweet pickle relish | 1 can creamed corn kernels | one 4 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast half | 2 bay leaves | 24 miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix savory, relish, creamed corn, and chicken breast together in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 25 to 35 minutes. Cut a pocket into breast, and place a marshmallow in the middle of the pocket. Place the pocket under the chicken to form a pocket, and fill with water to just barely cover it. Spoon some of the water into the pocket.

Random Ingredients: lime,salmon fillet,espresso powder,red chili pepper flake,russet potato
title: Alaskan Spicy Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 9 ounces frozen russet potatoes, thawed with 2 tbsp. cool water | 1 -2 tablespoon instant espresso powder | 2 tablespoons finely-chopped fresh red chili pepper flakes | 3/4 cup finely-chopped red chili pepper ( anaheim, or new mexico red chile ) | 2 lbs boneless middle-cut salmon fillets
instructions: Position oven rack 6 inches from broiler element and heat broiler. Line a 13x9 inch baking dish with foil. Put potatoes in large bowl. Bring 1 cup water to boil in small saucepan with espresso powder and chili flakes.

title: Korean Beef and Wakame
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 package refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 can wakame, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl, combine beef, wakame and sesame meal. Separate crescent roll dough sheets and place on a greased cookie sheet. Spread beef mixture evenly over dough and top with crescent rolls. Bake covered for 1 hour. Uncover and bake for an additional 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: french bread,gluten,vegetable broth,savoy cabbage,cake flour,bacon grease
title: Savoy Crispy Savoy
ingredients: 6 slices bacon grease | 1/2 cup gluten, free bread | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1 savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 loaf french bread, cut in half lengthswise
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 °f. Cut savoy cabbage into half lengthwise then cut in 1 half lengthwise. Grease a non stick pan with a small dash of olive oil. Cut bread into 1/2 slices, place on a baking tray with sides touching. Lightly spray the bread slices with olive oil, then spray with more of olive oil and brown in a hot pan. Place savoy cabbage in a large bowl with the cheese, bacon grease, flour, and vegetable broth. Wrap bread slices in aluminum foil and place in to oven to heat thru. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, or until bread is golden brown, crisp and crunchy.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,pineapple juice,breadcrumb,worcestershire sauce,mint,blackberry jam,garlic clove,mango chutney
title: Kittencal's Fruit Salad Imitation
ingredients: 8 -10 -12 large firm prawns, shelled and cooked ( depending on size ) | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 4 tablespoons natural mango chutney | 4 tablespoons pineapple juice | 4 tablespoons lemon juice or 4 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon blackberry jam ( optional ) | 2 large garlic cloves, finely minced
instructions: Mix together the mango chutney, pineapple juice, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, blackberry jam and garlic in a small bowl. In a large serving bowl, place the prawns with all of the ingredients except the mango chutney mixture, and mix together lightly. Then, add the mango chutney mixture to the prawns and mix together, coating each prawn evenly with this mixture. Refrigerate at least 1 hour, or overnight. Serve chilled or at room temperature. Enjoy.

title: Tilapia in Turmeric Shellfish Masala
ingredients: 1/4 pound tilapia fillets | 1 onion, chopped | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric, or to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook fish in boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain. Transfer fish to a mixing bowl. Reserve cooking water. Stir onion and turmeric into cooked fish. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Baked Fish with Polenta
ingredients: 5 hard-cooked eggs | 3/4 cup polenta, coarsely ground | 1 pinch poultry seasoning | 1 pinch crushed red pepper | 12 ounces halibut fillets
instructions: Rinse eggs under cold water.

title: Irish Raisin Chive Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chives | 1 tablespoon garlic chives | 1/2 lb raisins | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey, not sweetened | 1 garlic chive | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: In a mixing bowl, roughly chop the chives. Add the remaining ingredients and combine well. Place in refrigerator for an hour or so before serving.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Spice - Aka Garlic and Asafoetida
ingredients: 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 teaspoon pure pure garlic powder ( from asian food shops or asian shops )
instructions: Crush garlic with asafetida and puree the raw taste with garlic powder and puree to form a thick paste. Add powdered garlic powder to the oil and heat until the fragrance of the spice begins to rise in the oil. Fry the onion in oil for 3 minutes on medium high heat till translucent. Turn off heat. Serve hot or cold. I like this with any vegetables. It can also be used to spice rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,sauce,lettuce leaf,marsala wine,part mozzarella cheese,onion salt,horseradish sauce
title: Easy Italian Beef Sandwiches - Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef roast or 2 lbs blade roast | 1/3 cup prepared horseradish sauce | 1/2 cup australian sweet-and-sour sauce or 1/2 cup australian steak sauce, any flavor | 1 ounce fresh horseradish sauce | 1 teaspoon onion salt | 6 -12 large lettuce leaves or 6 -12 large red leaf lettuce | 4 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded and divided
instructions: Trim off all visible fat from the roast. Slice beef thinly. Place in a 3 to 4 quart crock pot. Combine the horseradish sauce, sweet and sour sauces, onion salt and 1 teaspoons salt. Pour this mixture over the beef. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours. Serve on bed of lettuce and top with 1 ounce of mozzarella cheese. To warm sandwiches you should have enough of the shredded mozzarella cheese to lightly coat the crock pot.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,cream chicken soup,cream mushroom soup,broccoli
title: Quick Creamy Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 lb frozen chopped broccoli, thawed | 1 package cream cheese ( or celery and onion flavored )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in slow cooker. Cook on high for 15 minutes. Chill several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Filling for St. Nikola
ingredients: 1 lb bacon | 1 lb prune | 1 tablespoon french mustard | 1 teaspoon dried de provence | 1 package refrigerated biscuits | 1/4 cup melted butter or 1/4 cup margarine
instructions: Filling, in a large skillet, cook bacon and prunes until soft. Set aside. In a separate bowl, stir together the mustard and the spices and set aside. In a 3 or 4 quart pan or pie plate, pour approximately half of the mustard mixture. Spread the prunes on the mustard mixture, then top with a biscuit piece. Continue layering until you've used up all the prunes. Top with remaining mustard mixture. Sprinkle top with melted butter or margarine. Bake in centre of 350° oven 12 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy English Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1/2 cup whole milk beer ( can be beer or a beer of your choice. my tweak is 3/4 c and 1/2 c. ) | bell pepper ( optional ) | 4 ounces wide egge noodles
instructions: Pour beer into pot and place on stove over medium heat. When bubbles start to form on the water's surface, sprinkle potatoes, and stir/saute for 7 minutes. Taste and adjust with salt as needed. Add peppers and noodles. Turn heat to low, cover and cook for 25 minutes. Serve with sour cream, grated cheese and a green vegetable like a carrot.

title: Easy Turnips
ingredients: 5 pounds turnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 package provolone cheese
instructions: Place turnips into boiling salted water. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until just tender, about 30 minutes.

title: The Best Cottage Cheese in the World!!!!
ingredients: 1 lb cottage cheese or 250 g cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | 1 sprig thyme leaves
instructions: Prepare cheese according to instructions on box. Pour mixture into a dish and put in fridge till cool. Cut cottage cheese into square or rectangular pieces and put into a bowl. Add arrowroot to give the cheese a creamy texture and creamy flavour. Decorate with thyme leaves and serve with bread. Enjoy.

title: Pepperoni Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 2 teaspoons chili oil | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 package pepperoni, diced
instructions: Cook and drain egg noodles. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine ginger garlic paste and chili oil. Cook and stir over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Add onion and mix well. Drain pasta and add mixture to cooked noodles. Serve warm.

title: Easy Garlic Aioli Dip
ingredients: 1 can sliced garlic, or to taste | 2 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Stir together the garlic, hot sauce, and hot sauce in a bowl. Refrigerate the mixture until cold.

Random Ingredients: walnut,cider vinegar,orange bell pepper,self rising flour,sauerkraut,fig,onion powder
title: Halloween Fig and Sauerkraut Cake
ingredients: 1 lb dried apricots, chopped | 1/2 lb dried pitted figs, chopped | 1/2 lb orange bell pepper, chopped | 1 cup walnuts, chopped | 1/4 cup cider vinegar or 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons onion powder | 1/3 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Line and cook the figs, the orange peppers, and the nuts. Allow to cool. Place the fruit, nuts, vinegar, onion powder, and flour in a food processor and pulse until combined. Pour in the fig mixture and stir thoroughly until mixed. Spoon mixture into a deep, greased bundt pan, cover tightly with foil, and bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 35 minutes. Cool the cake in the pan for 30 minutes, then loosen the sides carefully with a knife.

title: Easy Low Fat Penne Rigate, Dairy-Free
ingredients: 1 box penne rigate | 4 ounces fat free mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Cook penne rigate according to package instructions. Mix the mozzarella cheese and the vanilla in a small bowl. Drain pasta and cheese mixture and add cheese mixture. Mixture should just be moist enough to stick to the spoon. Serve hot.

title: Moroccan Spiced Peppered Salami (Anticuchos Manjares)
ingredients: 4 slices salami | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed ( you can use cumin powder if you don't have time ) | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Heat a nonstick frying pan or skillet over high heat. Sprinkle the cumin seeds on a dry towel to remove excess oil and moisture. Soak the ground cumin until it turns aromatic. Remove it from heat and allow to cool. Dry the salami out onto a paper towel to dry slightly. Cut each piece using a serrated knife or a cookie cutter. Add the salami to the hot frying pan and fry for about 2 minutes, turning over once or twice until crisp and lightly brown on both sides. Remove from heat and let sit for 2 1/2 minutes. Sprinkle the coconut on top and serve.

title: Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 corn tortilla chips or 3 large flour tortillas ( about 12.5 ounce ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut and arrange corn chips on a buttered baking sheet and bake until lightly browned and crisp, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and carefully break up the chips with a fork. Spray a baking dish with non stick cooking spray and spread with tomato paste, making sure the dish is totally coated. Sprinkle with salt. Transfer the baking dish to the middle rack of the oven and bake uncovered until cheese is bubbly, about 8 minutes. Let cool slightly before cutting and serving.

title: Nectarine Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can nectarines, drained | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 2 flour tortillas, cut on a diagonal ( about 4-5 pieces per tortilla )
instructions: Combine nectarines and beans in a large saucepan and heat until hot but not boiling. Serve with tortillas.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,ginger garlic paste,chicken stock vegetable,plain flour,coconut,pepperoni,pork rib,snow pea
title: Pork Short Ribs
ingredients: 750 g pork short ribs, cut into 2 inch pieces | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 300 g snow peas | 2/3 cup chicken stock or 2/3 cup vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 25 g plain flour | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups fresh shredded coconut | pepperoni, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c or 170c fan forced. Toss pork in the flour to coat. Heat 2 tbs oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Cook pork in batches, turning until browned on all sides and just cooked through about 10 minutes. Transfer to a large oven proof fry pan, add snow peas and stock. Cover and cook in oven for about 40 minutes. In a food processor or blender, beat remaining oil with ginger garlic paste. Add pork and coconut and process to a smooth paste. Sauce should have the consistency of a thickened sauce. Season with salt and pepper and if necessary, add a little additional stock. Stir fry over medium heat for 3 minutes. Serve with hot buttered bread and pepperoni, if using.

Random Ingredients: pear,masa harina,jasmine rice,chicken thigh fillet,soba noodle,ice,milk,beef bouillon cube
title: Arroz Caldo
ingredients: 500 g chicken thigh fillets, skinless | 1 tablespoon masa harina | 3 cups jasmine rice, cooked | 2 tablespoons peas from can, frozen or fresh | 3 cups canned whole milk | 1/4 beef bouillon cube | 4 frozen beef bouillon cubes | 12 ice, trimmings | 4 packets dry soba noodles
instructions: Place chicken in freezer bag and refrigerate until ready to use. Preheat barbecue grill. Remove chicken from freezer bag and place on grill. Cook until cooked, about 10 minutes. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. Remove from grill. In a large bowl combine, peas from can, uncooked rice, beef drippings from beef cube, 6 cups of milk, stock cubes, peas from can and 2 1/2 hours refrigerate. Cook soba noodles according to instructions. Drain noodles and add to chicken. Heat remaining milk and boullion over low heat until hot, add noodles and simmer about 1 minute. Stir soba through the meat mixture until heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Chef John's Nori Rollups
ingredients: 2 cups plain fat-free ricotta cheese, drained and pressed | 1 cup diced bell pepper | 2 tablespoons diced fresh ginger | 3 tablespoons snipped fresh oregano leaves, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed sesame seeds, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 4 sheets nori
instructions: Place the ricotta cheese in a large bowl and mix in the bell pepper, ginger and 2 teaspoons of the oregano. Stir in the remaining oregano and the sesame seeds. Spread the cheese mixture in a small mound in the center of each nori strip. Roll up the nori wrapper. Chill for 1 hour before slicing into 24 slices.

title: Sweet Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 package sweet italian sausage | 5 cans beef stock | 2 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 1 tablespoon stevia | 2 teaspoons ground mace
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f. Spray 10 to 12 inch ovenproof nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Place sausage in skillet.

title: Caliya (Colourful Lamb Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup coca-cola | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Put cacio in bowl. Dip lamb in cola, drain and coat with icing sugar, set aside. Mix yogurt and yogurt, combine with the cilantro and mix well. Refrigerate for 2 days before serving.

title: Pumpkin Roasted With Olives & Raisins
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut pumpkin | olive oil, for brushing | 1/2 cup golden raisin, dried | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cut the pumpkin lengthwise into 3/4 inch slices. Brush both sides with olive oil, arrange on a baking sheet. Bake them, cut side down, until tender and browned, about 45 minutes. Spread the cooked pumpkin slices on a platter. Remove the peels from the pumpkin slices with a large teaspoon, then brush each with olive oil. In the bowl of a food processor, mix the golden raisins and olives. Add to the food processor the olives and raisins and process until a paste forms. Serve, cut side up, with the peeled and roasted pumpkin.

title: Quick 'n' Easy One-Dish Bread for One
ingredients: 3 cups bread, plain, crusts trimmed ( we used progresso italian bread for one which was perfect but if you have the time, it provides that extra moisture for dipping ) | 1/4 cup water chestnut, sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. If using water chestnuts, place in a bowl and add a squeeze of their liquid. Stir to combine then mix in the parmesan flakes.

title: Green Rice (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1 cup rice ( short or medium grain ) | 2 cups thinly sliced fresh spinach leaves | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. In a small serving bowl, combine the spinach and cilantro and stir until spinach is wilted. To serve, pile rice and spinach mixture on large platter or platter, garnish with cilantro mixture.

title: Cumin-Spiced Gruyère
ingredients: 4 teaspoons dried parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 4 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaves | 2 teaspoons ground cumin seed
instructions: Combine 2 teaspoons of dried parsley leaves and 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed in a small bowl, and stir to combine. Combine 2 tablespoons cheese, 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves, 2 teaspoons cumin seed, and 1 teaspoon of cumin seed in a skillet over medium heat, and stir to combine, until cheese is melted and cheese is well combined. Spread the cheese on a plate while still hot, and sprinkle with remaining 2 teaspoons parsley leaves.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,ladyfinger,spanish onion,red wine,rice noodle,heavy whipping cream,pumpkin,pecan
title: Pumpkin and Pine Nut Rice Nests With Onion-Pecan Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 package rice noodles, about 1-1/4 ounces | 20 yellow ladyfingers | 1 1/2 cups spanish onions, sliced | 1 1/2 cups sweet fresh pumpkin, cut into 2-inch pieces ( about 1 cup ) | 1 cup red wine | 1/2 cup pecans, finely chopped | 1/2 cup sweet italian sausage, cooked ( such as jimmy dean )
instructions: Rice noodles,. In a bowl, mix whipping cream and salt. Soak rice noodles in cream mixture, about 15 minutes, until softened but not mushy. Line the 15 x 10 x 2 inch jelly roll pan with plastic wrap. With a sharp knife, cut noodles into 24 - 18 lengths. Lay half the noodle pieces flat on a towel covered plate, cover and refrigerate. Arrange half the soaked rice noodles on the towel lined pan, trimming any overlap. Arrange half the onion mixture over the rice noodles, sprinkle with half the pecan pieces, half the sliced sausage and half the wine. Repeat layers of rice noodles and onion mixture, ending with the pecan slices. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, or overnight. Top with remaining pecan slices. Prep time does not include 4 hours marinating. Overnight. Heat oven to 325°f. Remove plastic wrap on top of noodles and bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes. Cool 1 minute. Transfer to a platter and let rest about 10 minutes. Unmold and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,sherry wine,green bell pepper,caerphilly cheese,phyllo pastry,tomato,barbecue sauce,bay leaf
title: Cheese Brik
ingredients: 3 sheets phyllo pastry | 100 ml sherry wine | 4 -6 tomatoes | 2 large green bell peppers | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 bay leaf | 75 g caerphilly cheese, cut into thick strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c. Line a 20 x 30cm baking dish with a piece of parchment paper. Spray with cooking spray. Place 1 sheet phyllo in dish and spray with cooking spray. Repeat with another phyllo sheet and spray with cooking spray. Repeat steps 7 9, 8, etc until all sheets are used. Cut tomatoes into rings, then cut into wedges. Cut bell peppers into thin strips. Place tomato pieces and bell peppers in the base of the pastry over top, making sure the vegetables are not touching. Pour bbq sauce over, then sprinkle over the sugar and bay leaf. Top with remaining phyllo sheets. Sprinkle with combined cheese, pressing gently so it doesn't break. Bake for 40 minutes, until it is bubbly and hot. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Steak with Anise Oil (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 6 ounces steak, thin cut | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 12 fresh red chilies | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed herbs or 1 1/2 teaspoons rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon tomato puree
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pound steak slightly between your palms to make a cut about 3/4 inch thick by pounding the meat. Brush oil over both sides of the steak with oil. Place in a baking pan and roast for 45 minutes, or until cooked to your liking. Meanwhile, mix together chillies, xanthan gum, herbs and tomato puree, and serve with steak.

title: Aloe Vera's French Amaretto
ingredients: 2 large yellow onions, peeled and diced finely | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla essence | 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy non reactive pan and allow to simmer over medium heat for approximately 30 minutes, stirring periodically. Add more amaretto if mixture becomes too thick.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,corn oil,kernel corn,rock salt
title: Sweet Corn Chips  - Non Alcoholic Cookbook
ingredients: 8 cups corn oil | 2 tablespoons rock salt | 4 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Heat corn oil in a deep pot until a drop of water sizzles immediately at the top. When the temperature reaches 350 degrees f, stir in salt and splenda. Continue heating the oil and splenda until the oil reaches 170 degrees f and the chips begin to crisp up, about 15 minutes. Remove the corn chips from the oil with a slotted spoon and place onto a paper towel lined baking sheet. Let drain for 5 minutes or until they are cool enough to touch. Transfer to a serving dish and set aside to dry completely. Note, if you are not using a cooking oil for frying the chips, you can use 1/2 cup corn oil, 1/2 cup cornstarch, 1 1/2 tbs baking powder, 1 tbs of flour, and 1/2 tsp of salt. Dry the corn chips on paper towels to remove excess sand and let them dry completely before dipping these inches. My note, i prefer to use the non alcohol version for some reason.

Random Ingredients: custard powder,chicken broth,marshmallow,flat leaf parsley,cherry,cooking oat,cake flour,lemon zest
title: Cherry, Lemon & Hazelnut Filled Oatcakes
ingredients: 250 g cake flour ( all-purpose ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon baking fat cooking oats | 170 g large marshmallows | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley ( fresh ) | 75 g dried cherries
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Grease a 6 hole muffin tin & line base wih grease paper. Sift flour, lemon zest, nutmeg & a pinch of salt into another bowl & set aside. Using an electric mixer, cream oats. Melt copha & parsley together in a small saucepan over a gentle simmer, stirring to combine, before moving to a wire rack to cool. Stir butter, reserved baking fat, lemon juice & oatcakes into oatcake mixture, then spoon mixture into prepared muffin tins cases and carefully transfer them to the prepared tin. Bake for 15 - 20 mins, allowing the cakes to cool in their tin. Eat warm whilst still warm, with butter, if you like.

title: Quinoa Milkshake - Seva Chomeur
ingredients: 1 cup skim milk | 1/2 cup uncooked quinoa | 1/2 cup dates, seeded and chopped | 1 nori ( seaweed ) sheets, torn into strips
instructions: Place the quinoa in a saucepan with the date and nori.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,strawberry,purpose flour,olive oil,stewing beef,worcestershire sauce,amaretto
title: Purslane Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 '' cubes | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 2 teaspoons madras curry powder | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons amaretto | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 8 -10 fresh strawberries, coarsely sliced
instructions: Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium high heat. Stir in curry powder, then beef. Cover and brown beef on top. Add worcestershire sauce and amaretto. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 30 - 40 minutes. Stir in flour and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Serve over fresh strawberries.

Random Ingredients: kale,chile,star anise,rice vermicelli,red onion,red pepper,rump roast
title: Kale and Beef Wraps
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red onion, minced | 3 serrano chile, seeded, minced | 1 star anise, pod cut into thin slivers | 1 tablespoon roasted red pepper, minced | 2 cups cooked rice vermicelli | 1 cup shredded kale | 3 ounces thinly sliced rump roast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Mix the onion, chile, star anise, and red pepper in a bowl with the rice vermicelli noodles if using. Spread 1/2 cup of the kale in the center of each sheet of foil slightly overlapping. Divide the noodle mixture evenly over the kale.

title: Corn Soup
ingredients: 24 ears fresh corn, shucked | 4 sprigs fresh thyme
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add corn, and cook until kernels have popped open about 5 minutes. Drain corn kernels, and cut kernels into bite sized pieces. Place corn, thyme, and 1/2 cup water in a blender, and blend until desired thickness. Serve hot.

title: Potato and Prosciutto Enchilada
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups peeled, diced potatoes | 1 tablespoon finely chopped prosciutto | 1 can red enchilada sauce
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add diced potatoes, prosciutto and enchilada sauce. Heat to a boil, stirring occasionally, 3 to 5 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,celery rib,egg,mozzarella cheese,white onion spring,napa cabbage,peach
title: Grilled Peach Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 peach, peeled and cut into 8 wedges | 2 celery ribs, cut into 2 wedges | 1 small white onions or 1 small onion, cut into 8 wedges | 4 large leaves napa cabbage or 4 large leaves red cabbage | 8 ounces frozen mozzarella cheese, thawed | 4 large eggs, hard-boiled and sliced into wedges
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Garnish with hard boiled eggs.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,pork butt,rice,gingerroot,cocoa,wheat pita bread,romaine lettuce
title: Gingered Pork Gyros from the Canadian Living Magazine
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, rinsed, dried and torn | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons shredded fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa | 1 lb lean boneless pork butt, trimmed of excess fat | 6 whole wheat pita bread | 2 tablespoons low-sodium prepared rice
instructions: Place lettuce, pesto, ginger, cocoa, and pork in a food processor.

title: Baked Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs whole fish ( firm fleshed fish ) | 1 cup thick coconut cream | 1 cup pizza sauce ( low fat ) | 2 teaspoons ground fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Cut fish into pieces approximately 3 inches in size with bones, but leave some bones. Bake in middle of oven about 1 hour or more, until the fish flakes easily when picked out of the bones. Transfer fish to warmed ovenproof serving dish, add coconut cream, pizza sauce, fenugreek and cardamom.

title: Zucchini with Queso Fresco
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini, halved and thinly sliced | sea salt | 1/4 cup good quality queso fresco | 1 package cheese, room temperature | 3/4 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Place zucchini in a large bowl of cold salted water and rinse briefly under cold running water. Slashing zucchini at regular intervals with scissors and using a plastic bag, gently pound with the flat side of a meat mallet. If this doesn’t work, pound in a food processor or a knife the following day. Drain the zucchini well and arrange in a single layer on the counter.

title: Spanish Fish
ingredients: 1 can of flaked cod | 1 cup of grated mexican cheese | 2 tablespoons of chopped chives
instructions: Mix the chive with the sour cream and set aside. Preheat toaster oven to 400 degrees. Place the cod in a casserole dish. Dot with mozzarella cheese. Top with chives. Bake for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: half,demerara sugar,white sugar,oxtail,nonfat milk,stuffing mix,tarragon vinegar
title: Tarragon-Spice Oxtail
ingredients: oxtails : | 1/4 cup prepared dry stuffing mix | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon light demerara sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet tarragon vinegar | 1 tablespoon half-and-half | 1 teaspoon white sugar, or as needed
instructions: To make the greek seasoning, stir together the dry stuffing mix, 1 tablespoon of nonfat milk, 1 tablespoon of demerara sugar and 1 teaspoon of tarragon vinegar in a small bowl. Spoon enough seasoned stuffing into the cavity of each oxtail to fully cover the stuffing. Use a skewer to poke holes over the stuffing to allow steam to escape. Preheat an oven to 500 degrees f. Coat the bottom of a roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray. Heat the olive oil in a small pot over medium low heat.

title: Green Beans with Saffron
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Place the green beans in a large pot of water to cover them by at least 2 inches. When water is boiling, add pimentos and cook until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. Pat dry with paper towels. Place beans in a microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle with saffron. Cover with 1 cup boiling water. Microwave, covered, on high, for 7 or 8 minutes, until beans are tender, but still firm. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: shortening,red chili sauce,pasta sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,cayenne pepper,button mushroom
title: Pasta Shreds Ala Kennykien
ingredients: 1 lb pasta sauce ( your favorite or my randy's ) | 1 cup red chili sauce ( goya brand ) | 1/4 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon shortening | 1 lb button mushroom | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Prepare all the sauce ingredients, except the mushrooms. Combine all the sauce ingredients except the mushrooms. Heat oil in a skillet. Use a paper towel to blot excess oil on paper towels. Scoop sauce mixture into a zip lock bag or other suitable size freezer bag. Dice the mushrooms. Place the mushrooms, cut side up and coated with the sauce mix into sauce. Place in the fridge. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cook for 30 minutes.

title: Corn with Meat (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 can large ears of corn, well washed | 1 can beef broth or ( 12 ounce ) can beef consomme
instructions: Trim or scrub corn well. Place corn in bottom of slow cooker. Add broth and meat. Cover and cook on high setting for 8 to 10 hours or on low setting for 12 to 18 hours.

Random Ingredients: pickling spice,custard powder,egg white,avocado,cucumber,ginger paste,mustard,coriander seed
title: Avocado and Cucumber Pickle #2
ingredients: 1 kg cucumber, peeled washed and finely chopped | 2 egg whites, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 2 tablespoons pickling spice | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 300 g cubed avocados
instructions: Place the cucumber, egg whites, mustard, cumin and coriander seeds in a large bowl, then mix well. Stir in the pickling spice blend and ginger paste. Season with salt and pepper. Mix to a paste with the avocado and mix well. Place in the refrigerator for several hours. Remove from the fridge one half hour before serving.

title: Green Chile & Parmesan  Fresh Saffron Pesto  Mix
ingredients: 3 dried hot green chili peppers, stems removed or ( 1 tsp. chili powder, crushed | 1/3 cup fresh grated parmesan cheese | 12 teaspoons saffron cereal
instructions: In bowl, combine chilies, parmesan cheese and saffron and stir to combine, then pour mixture into a large saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium low heat, stirring often. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Prosciutto Wraps
ingredients: 4 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto or 4 ounces deli ham | 1 jar teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup low sodium chicken broth, divided | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: On a large heavy duty grill pan or preheated barbeque, place the prosciutto and half of the teriyaki sauce. Cook the prosciutto about 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until crisp. Stir in the other half of the teriyaki sauce and the 1/4 cup of chicken broth and continue to cook uncovered until heated through. Remove from heat. Stir in the vanilla and remaining chicken broth.

title: Frijoles Con Molcajete (Fennel and Beans)
ingredients: 1 lb dried beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1 small yellow onion, chopped fine | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Put soaked beans, chopped onion, fennel seeds, salt, pepper and 1 - 4 cups boiling water into a saucepan and heat on medium high till boiling and then reduce to a simmer. Simmer until beans are very tender, about an hour. When most of the liquid has evaporated this should take about 1 2hrs.

title: Green Chilies Simmered in Raspberry Soup
ingredients: 1 pint of diced tomato with green chilies | 1/3 pint chicken stock | 1 pint fresh raspberry | 1 bunch fresh parsley
instructions: Put all ingredients in a soup pot and bring to a simmer. Cook for 30 minutes, until thickened and chunky. Take off the stove and cool. Once cool add a few small books and a serving dish or leave out until you are ready to eat.

title: Chickpeas & Zucchini-Zucchini.
ingredients: 1 zucchini | 3 cups canned chickpeas
instructions: Peel zucchini & cut into chunks, boil briefly. Drain chickpeas thru a sieve or press with hands to remove as much liquid as possible. Place in large bowl & add zucchini, mix well, sprinkle w/parmesan cheese over & serve.

title: Swiss Cheese Tart
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss cheese, grated | 2 -3 pints pie shells, cooked | 1/4 cup finely chopped dried apricot | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Thoroughly mix the swiss cheese, apricots, and parsley. Pour into the pie crust, place in a heated oven at 350°f bake 20 minutes.

title: Horseradish Ale
ingredients: 1/2 cup gold tequila | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish
instructions: In a shaker filled half full of ice, make your slush by blending your tequila and horseradish and pouring to a chilled glass full of ale. Swirl the liqueurs around and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mango pulp,gruyere cheese,mini marshmallow,bean sprout,wheat flour,orange,maraschino cherry,pearl barley
title: Gruyere and Barley Gratin
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup mango pulp ( about 7 medium ) | 1/4 cup diced orange rind | 1/2 cup fresh mozzarella cheese or 1/2 cup vegan mozzarella cheese, grated | 1/3 cup mini marshmallows | 1/2 cup packed plain wheat flour | 2 cups small marshmallows, chopped | 1 cup shaved gruyere cheese or package vegan mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cook barley in salted water according to package instructions for al dente. Drain. While still hot, add mango pulp and grated cheese. Mash by hand. Combine flour and chopped marshmallows in large bowl. Add wet ingredients and stir until well combined. Spread half the barley evenly in the bottom of an 11 in x 7 in baking dish. Spread half of the filling over the barley and stir gently to distribute. Repeat layers and top with shaved gruyere cheese. Cook until cheese is melted and lightly browned on top and bubbly throughout, about 25 minutes.

title: Passion Fruit Rolls
ingredients: 6 tablespoons cake flour | 1 packet onion soup mix | 5 tablespoons passion fruit pulp | 2 ice, crushed
instructions: Crush the passionfruit pulp into a mixing bowl and add the icing sugar, mix well. Stir in the passionfruit pulp and mix well. Using a 14cm round cookie cutter cut out hearts from the ice and roll up leaving about 3cm between each biscuit. Roll each heart in flour and then roll in the icing to coat. Repeat making more hearts until all the pastry mixture is used. Store in a container with a cover.

title: Tami Wrapped in Spiced Soy
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs tamari, tubes ( about 3 to 4 inches long ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: The tamari tubes should resemble thick, flat bread. Heat the sesame oil in a small, heavy skillet over high heat. Toast the tamari tubes one or two at a time until golden brown on all sides, about 1 to 2 minutes. Using tongs, transfer the cooked tubes to a paper towel lined plate and slice 1/4 inch thick. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,black eyed pea,garlic powder,cannellini bean,artichoke heart
title: Cannellini Bean Salad II
ingredients: 6 cans cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can canned artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 bag cauliflower florets | 3 tablespoons dried black-eyed peas, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
instructions: Mix cannellini beans, artichoke hearts, cauliflower florets, black eyed peas, garlic powder, and optional garnish ingredients in a large bowl. Serve chilled.

title: Andreas Viestad's French Onion Soup With Fresh Fonduta
ingredients: 4 lbs of frozen sweet onions, thawed, peeled and sliced very thin | 1/4 cup vodka | 1 french baguette, cut into 1/2 inch slices | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Place the frozen slices of onions into a large plastic bag or bowl and sprinkle with the vodka. Allow to marinate for 20 minutes while you prepare your fonduta. Heat a 10 inch heavy bottom skillet, or deep fryer. Arrange the baguette slices in a circle in the hot skillet. Cook for a few minutes just to to crisp up. Turn over and crisp the other side. Allow to cool slightly, then place the fries on a plate lined with reynolds wrap, or in two dinner size ramekin dishes. Spoon the warmed fonduta over fries, drizzle a few tablespoons of your preferred vodka over them and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: weet bix,button mushroom,korean red pepper flake,escarole,vanilla,orange peel,molasses,corn kernel
title: Bok Choy (Wondemau Campan)
ingredients: 2 weet-bix ( for frying ) | 1 -2 tablespoon molasses | 1 package sliced escarole | 1 can creamed corn with broccoli ( use 2 cans ) or ( 14 ounce ) can peas and corn, with a bit of the corn | 1 cup button mushroom | 1 teaspoon sakikomaoma ( dried seaweed powder of miso ) | 1 tablespoon finely grated orange peel | 1/8 teaspoon red korean red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat molasses on low in sauce pan. Mix in rest of the ingredients. Cook on low heat. Serve hot while cooking or reheat later. This is a great over rice, noodles or a salad. Also a great addition to a side dish with korean red pepper flakes.

title: Spicy White Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb white chocolate | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 cup double cream | 1 cup chopped pine nuts
instructions: Melt the white chocolate and stir in the sugar. When melted add the cream gradually to make a thin paste. Garnish with pine nuts before serving or cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,vanilla ice cream,cardamom pod,margarine,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 1 cup margarine, softened | 1 brick mexican cheese, shredded ( we like brie ) | 1 cup pureed canned bamboo shoot | 1/2 cup vanilla ice cream, softened | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Cream margarine and blend in cheese. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Blueberry and Pinto Bean Crock Pot
ingredients: 16 ounces pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 8 slices italian cheese | 1/3 cup reduced-fat italian cheese blend, shredded | 1/3 cup frozen blueberries or 1/3 cup frozen cherries
instructions: Place pinto beans, four cheese slices, italian cheese blend, and frozen blueberries into crock pot. Cover and cook on high 2 - 3 hours. Stir before serving.

title: The Perfect Caramel Sundae Salad
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 container caramel ice cream topping, chilled
instructions: Chop cherry tomatoes. Slice caramel ice cream into four inch pieces and dip into one bowl of cherry tomatoes. Place half the ice cream pieces in the blender. Pour 1/4 of the caramel syrup over them and stir. When it is mixed add another tablespoon of caramel syrup. Repeat. You may want to double the recipe depending on the size of the cherry tomatoes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,zucchini,crawfish tail,fish fillet,brown sugar,dark brown sugar,sauce,bread crumb
title: Baked Crawfish Cakes (Australia)
ingredients: 3/4 lb raw crawfish tail | 2 tablespoons vegetable protein ( steak suet ) | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 3/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 4 tablespoons crushed mixed vegetables | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 3/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 teaspoons brown sugar | 1 medium zucchini, grated | 1 cup soft brown sugar | 1/2 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Add 1/4 cup of mixed vegetables, cook, stirring over high heat for 1 minute and add fish sauce, hot sauce and 1/2 cup grated zucchini. Pour mixture into shallow baking dish and add soft brown sugar. Place bread crumbs in a wide shallow bowl and mix together with remaining grated zucchini. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over crawfish mixture and press mixture into molds, cover with foil and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until the crawfish cakes are cooked through. Serve topped with remaining mixed vegetables and hard cooked eggs or fried potatoes.

title: Caribbean Rum Blend Recipe
ingredients: chocolate-covered coffee filter or coffee filters | cooking spray
instructions: Remove the filter from a swiss roll bag using a spoon or clean cloth. Smear the surface of the filter with the coffee. The water should cover the filter completely. Place in the refridgerator. The rum can drain a lot and i like to use an emulsifier, but do not fill the filter too full. After a day, wipe the filter with clean, damp cloth to remove any bacteria. Place the filter in a clean jar or container. Store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: cognac,red wine,green pepper,chicken thigh,cavatappi pasta,herb,wheat flour
title: Italian Chicken Bites
ingredients: 1 package cavatappi pasta or ( 8 ounce ) package capellini | 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite size pieces | 1 cup light red wine or 1 cup white wine | 1/2 cup cognac | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed fresh herbs ( parsley, thyme and rosemary ) | 2 tablespoons green peppers, chopped | 12 slices red wine or 12 slices yellow wine
instructions: Cook pasta as directed by package and drain. Meanwhile, combine all ingredients except wine and chicken in 4 quart saucepan. Heat to boiling.

title: Pasta with Lemon & Ham - Bolognese Style
ingredients: 125 g pasta ( short stubby shapes ) | 1/2 teaspoon yeast | 1 1/2 cups warm water | 1 3/4 cups red bolognese style braising cheese with herbs | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1 egg substitute
instructions: Boil water and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain & put into a bowl. Toss with the rest of the ingredients to combine. Taste & adjust seasonings if required. Put into an oiled, then baking tray or loaf pan & bake at c for about 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Baked Eggplant
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut a lengthwise slit down the stem end of each eggplant. Slice a slit diagonally down the length to form a pocket. Place the hollowed eggplants on a baking sheet or in a foil lined rimmed baking sheet. Combine the smoked paprika with some of the smoked paprika mixture. Spoon over the open eggplants. Cover and roast 25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,vanilla bean,italian herb,tomato juice,coconut,flour tortilla,vegetable oil cooking spray,pomegranate molasses
title: Yum Yum-Yum
ingredients: 2/3 cup pomegranate molasses | 1 large vanilla bean | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil-style cooking spray | 2 pints tomatoes with juice, drained ( or 1 1/2 cups diced tomatoes and 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh tomatoes ) | 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian herbs | 5 -6 flour tortillas | 3 tablespoons shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Combine molasses, vanilla bean and oil in heavy 3 quart pan. Split the split vanilla bean lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. Stir in pomegranate molasses, tomatoes, peanut butter and herbs. Cook over medium heat about 15 minutes, stirring frequently, until slightly thick and tomato sauce has thickened. Wrap tortillas tightly in foil, bake for 10 minutes, remove foil and continue to bake 5 minutes more, remove from oven, place on cutting board and sprinkle with coconut, serve warm.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,margarine,cauliflower,brussels sprout,chicken stock,plain nonfat yogurt,raspberry vinegar,veal
title: Brussels Sprouts, Eggplant and Cauliflower Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs lebanese brussels sprouts | 1 medium eggplant, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 lb cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 tablespoons margarine | 1/3 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon raspberry vinegar | 1 can organic sliced mushrooms, drained | 1/3 cup plain nonfat yogurt or 1/3 cup low-fat yogurt
instructions: In a large wok or frypan melt 1 tablespoon of the margarine over medium high heat. Add the brussels sprouts in batches and cook until crisp tender, turning once approximately 5 minutes total cooking time. Transfer to a plate lined with foil, then tent with foil to keep warm. In the same frypan used to cook the brussels sprouts, heat the remaining tablespoon of margarine over medium high heat. When oil shimmers, add the brussels sprouts, eggplant, cauliflower and sauté until vegetables are soft and beginning to brown, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Add the stock and vinegar and cook until thickened, about 2 minutes. Stir in the mushrooms then remove from heat. Transfer to a serving bowl, add 1/4 cup yogurt and stir to combine. Divide among four serving bowls and top with remaining yogurt.

title: Easy Quesadillas - Cheese Waffle Maker or Sandwich Maker
ingredients: 6 large quick waffles ( or 6 large regular waffles ) | 6 slices colby-monterey jack cheese | 8 -10 tablespoons apricot preserves
instructions: Prepare a waffle maker according to the manufacturers instructions. Spread each waffle with 2 - 3 tbs of the cheese. Carefully place each of the 4 waffles on a warm platter that has been sprayed with cooking spray or greased with butter flavored cooking spray. Spread 8 - 8 tbs of the preserves over the melted cheese. Place 3 of the waffles on each of the 4 warm plates. Place another 2 - 3 tbs of cheese on top of each of the 4 plates. Keep the plates in the heated waffle maker for 15 minutes if using regular waffles. When done, the cheese should be melted and slightly browned.

title: Oodles In A Whole Lime!
ingredients: 8 ounces shredded limes ( about 25 limes ) | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon msg ( i normally omit )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put on wax paper and freeze. To serve, place a scoop of the mixture onto a plate and sprinkle with additional tarragon.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,broccoli slaw mix,accent seasoning,irish cream,chili oil,tamari,beef chuck
title: Spicy Irish Beef and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat | 1 lb broccoli slaw mix | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1/2 cup scotch whisky or 1/2 cup irish cream | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cut beef into 1/2 inch cubes. Slice slaw mix into 1 inch pieces. In a large casserole sauté beef in oil over medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes. Remove beef. Stir in seasoning and cook for 3 - 4 minutes until meat loses its redness. Stir in scotch whiskey/ir fry over medium heat for 1 minute. Stir in beef. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly and the broccoli begins to crisp.

title: Red Curry Cheese Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces provolone cheese, coarsely grated | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 teaspoons red curry paste, heaping | 1/2 teaspoon oregano, dried
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric blender and process until creamy. Serve with toasted bread.

title: Red Potato and Vegetable Hotpot
ingredients: 6 red potatoes | 1 small cabbage | 1 package yellow split peas, dried | 2 medium red bananas
instructions: Wash, peel and cut up potatoes in 3/4 inch pieces. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the potatoes, cabbage, split peas and banana. Heat to a boil, then lower to a simmer and cook 20 minutes or until potatoes are just tender.

title: Breads with Hot Anise Seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons ground coriander leaves | 1 tablespoon whole coriander seed | 2 slices bread | 8 -10 roasted peppers ( from aniseed is nice ) | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Put the coriander seeds and pepper flakes in small bowl with the warm ground spices. Wash the bread under running water and squeeze dry. Put half a slice of bread on your forefinger and roll it into a cigar shape, leaving the other half unrolled but holding the hot filling in a small hole. Heat oil in a frying pan. Quickly lay your stuffed bread on the hot oil, one side at a time, and cook for 2 minutes to crisp up the bread. Then take it out and leave on the paper. Do not let it burn you want the bread to be light and airy. Take it out and leave to drain off the excess oil on the board, then slice and serve topped with your favourite topping. This is good cold too.

title: Tequila-Tomato Slush
ingredients: 4 ounces tequila | 4 ounces sour margarita salad dressing | 1/2 teaspoon coriander | 6 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Dip each half cherry tomato into tequila, then into lime coriander, coating each half. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Japanese Dip
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed milk ( not evaporated ) | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast ( not rapid-rise ) | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Soak 10 minutes, then rinse. Combine all ingredients in blender. Use as a dipping sauce for raw vegetables or pita bread rolls.

title: Chocolate Noodle and Sponge
ingredients: 200 g egg noodles | 1 teaspoon paprika | 200 g cocoa
instructions: Boil water in a pot. Drain the noodle noodles and add them to the boiling water and add the paprika. Leave this for approx 10 mins stir occasionally until the noodles are cooked. Drain completely and leave to stand until completely cooled.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,ricotta cheese,herb stuffing mix,white pepper
title: Ricotta Flavored French Fries - Paula Deen
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package herb seasoned stuffing mix, such as herb croutons | 1 cup ricotta cheese, preferably whole milk | 2 teaspoons white pepper
instructions: Place the prepared stuffing mix into a small bowl and spread it all over the outside of the french fries, securing with toothpicks. Spray a broiler pan with vegetable oil spray and arrange the french fries around it. Spray again with vegetable oil spray and place under the broiler. Broil for 2 to 3 minutes or until lightly browned, and crisp. Remove and set aside until cool. Beat the ricotta cheese and pepper in a bowl until smooth. Stir in the ricotta mixture. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,grapefruit juice,white mushroom,tofu,eggplant,orange juice

instructions: Soak sliced mushrooms in 1/2 cup orange juice. Heat a wok over medium heat. When hot, add a teaspoonful of olive oil. Stir through cooked black eyed peas and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: peanut,grain rice,dark raisin,grainy mustard,cooking spray,iceberg lettuce,topping,garlic clove
title: Delicious Rice Salad With Raisins
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark raisin | 1/4 cup low-fat quick-cooking spray | 1 large garlic clove, minced | 2 tablespoons wheat-free prepared grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon dark-roasted peanuts, chopped | 3 cups low-fat cooking rice or 3 cups cooked short-grain rice | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 head iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In bowl, toss raisins with cooking spray. Microwave garlic, mustard, peanuts and raisins, stirring and scraping sides, until golden on high, about 1 minute. Add rice.

instructions: Place corn in a resealable plastic bag.

title: Italian Spiced Poppy Seed Sauce

instructions: Using an iron skillet, toast poppy seeds in the skillet. As soon as they begin to turn color they are ok. Remove to a plate lined with pam. Combine all ingredients, mixing well. Pour over cooked pasta of your choice. Serve with hot crusty bread.

title: Spiced Baklava
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo pastry, thawed | 2 cups coriander seeds, crushed
instructions: In a large saucpan add water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. When cool, add salt, coriander seeds and phyllo pastry and cut each filo filo stack into 4 pieces, each 6 x 7 inches. Arrange on a greased tray. Bake at 400°f for 20 minutes or until crisp and golden.

ingredients: 2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut in 1-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 pint roma tomato, cut into wedges | 1 green pepper, sliced
instructions: Brown beef cubes in hot oil. Add all the remaining ingredients and simmer slowly, covered, for 2 1/2 hours until the beef is tender..

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,chili paste,broiler fryer chicken,peanut butter,white onion,gingerroot
title: Thai Chicken and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 head cauliflower floret | 2 tablespoons peanut butter ( not cream of wheat ) | 2 tablespoons chinese white onions ( or to taste or use other vegetables ) | 1/2 inch piece gingerroot ( small piece ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili paste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Spray broiler fryer with nonstick spray and place on cookie sheet. Place chicken on top of cauliflower. Cut vegetables into long thin strips. title: Pumpkin Soup

instructions: Place the stock in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil. Place the pumpkin in a colander over the stock, return to the heat, and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until the pumpkin is just beginning to soften. Remove the pan from the heat, and set aside. Using a slotted spoon, check the pumpkin flesh, and remove any browned bits. Return the soup to the pan. Simmer for about 15 minutes, or until all the liquid has been absorbed. Ladle into soup bowls, and serve.

title: Easy Lamb Rillettes
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless lamb shoulder | 1 cup canned coconut milk | 3 teaspoons arrowroot | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1 cup beer
instructions: Cube lamb and place in a shallow roasting pan. Drain the excess fat from the pan and combine with the coconut milk and arrowroot in a saucepan. Place the bean sprouts in a pan of boiling water and cook for one minute. Drain and refresh the lamb under cold water to remove any excess starch. Heat a griddle or large saute pan over a moderate heat. Add the lamb and cook to desired doneness, about 10 minutes. Serve with the curry and the toasted bean sprouts for a great meal.

title: Quick Spanish Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 scallions, white part only, finely chopped | hot pepper sauce
instructions: Combine scallions, minced hot pepper and hot sauce in a bowl.

title: Fried Bacon (British Fry)

instructions: Fry bacon. If you are using the non stick fry pan/pan, use it, otherwise you will have to grease the pan well before adding to the fried bacon. Once bacon is heated through, remove bacon from pan while still slightly warm. Leave grease in the pan, then add the non stick fry pan/pan. Spray with cooking spray then fry bacon. Remove bacon and remove, if desired, before serving.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,brown sugar,saffron thread,grain rice,chili powder,ginger
title: Saffron-Glazed Saffrans

Sprinkle with brown sugar and chilli. Taste and adjust seasonings.

instructions: Place all ingredients into a large non stick pan or wok over medium heat. Heat until mixture comes to a boil. Turn heat up and cover. Cook for 20 minutes. Take off cover and fluff mixture with a fork. The soup can be made ahead of time, and stored in fridge for a couple days.

title: Cardom and Vanilla Burger

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Form into 4 - 5 patties, flatten slightly. Grill or fry at 180°c for 5 - 10 minutes on each side or until cooked and juicy.

instructions: Combine cilantro and water chestnuts.

ingredients: 4 large yucca root | 4 ripe red ripe yellow potatoes | 3 sweet banana, peeled, sliced into half moons | 1 can yellow ripe tomatoes | 1 tablespoon whole chipotle pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped, divided | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f and generously butter a large baking sheet. Place the yucca root and potatoes between 2 sheets of plastic wrap on a high rack.
