instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c/400f degrees. Mix together the potatoes & almond milk & pour into a casserole dish. Sprinkle over the icing sugar & bake uncovered for 1 hr, until soft & golden turning the contents a couple of times. Serve with ice cream to soak up the juices.

instructions: Trim and thinly slice the turnips, then grate 2/3 cup coarsely it.

Remove fish from pan and allow to rest for 15 minutes before serving.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place chicken in a large, deep skillet.

title: Lamb in Irish Whiskey (Slow Cooker)

instructions: Place the ground lamb in a large skillet. Over medium high heat, add the mushrooms, bell pepper and mint. Gently stir the mushrooms and bell pepper until the ingredients are hot and the bell pepper has softened. Divide the mixture between two serving dishes and serve at once.

instructions: Toast the coriander seeds until golden brown in a spice grinder for about 15 seconds and grind finely in a mortar with a pestle or a mortar and pestle. Set aside. Serve, with couscous or pita bread.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 teaspoon lemon, rind of, grated | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 lb chicken, cooked, deboned, halved | 20 slices toasted french bread | 1 can refried beans curds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Add soup, lemon peel and almond extract to soup. Heat through. Arrange bread slice in a single layer on baking paper. Spoon soup over bread. Top with chicken. Pour heated bean curd over top. Bake 20 to 30 minutes, until cheese is bubbly.

title: Beef and Goat Cheese Curry on Rice

instructions: In a slow cooker, place the goat cheese, rice, beef, curry paste, worcestershire sauce, chili flakes, garlic salt until the beef and goat cheese have all been thoroughly mixed. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Salmon Gratin

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly grease a 9 inch baking dish. Pour undrained tomatoes into a medium bowl, and stir in salmon cubes, bread, whipping cream, and lemon zest. Spoon tomato mixture into prepared baking dish, and bake 1 hour. Transfer to a serving dish, and chill completely.

title: Easy Beef - Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 2 large red onions, sliced thin | 1 -2 lb corned beef brisket ( or any cheap cut that has no visible fat, if you are using corned beef ) | 1 can cremini mushrooms, sliced | 0.5 package chunky salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | dill weed ( lots of it leaves, or 1-2 tsp chopped fresh ) | spice
instructions: Layer onion on a serving plate. Dice and lay on top. Place the brisket in a large zipper lock bag and use 1/2 tsp of spice to season all surfaces of the brisket well. Sprinkle with onion and mushrooms. Drizzle your favorite tomato sauce over the top of the brisket and serve.

title: Blueberry and Ham Salad With Matzo

instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the apple cider, orange rind, lemon juice and canola oil over medium heat until hot. title: Barefoot Contessa's Italian Sausages
ingredients: 3 pounds hot italian sausage | 2 bunches baby yogurt | 1 3/4 cups drained capers ( optional )
instructions: Cut sausage in half horizontally. Remove casings, and separate into halves. Lay halves out on a cookie sheet with a 1/4 inch high edge nearest you. If making ahead, skip this step. Serve warm, with your favorite salad. Garnish with capers if you like.

title: Raisin-Prawns With Peanut-Soy Nuts (Indian)

instructions: Start by making your rice as per the instructions on the package or your box. Rinse and drain the rice and place in a bowl. When all of the peanut mixture is in the pan, place the prawns on top of them, and cook, shaking the pan, to coat everything in a glaze. Carefully, stir the noodles and serve.

title: Dublin Curried Quinoa & Clam Salad

title: Oven Poppy Seed Lasagna
ingredients: 6 thin slices of crusty french-fried onions | 1/4 cup margarine, melted | 6 lasagna noodles ( or your noodle ) | 1 can french onion soup | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1 dash nutmeg ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup poppy seed | 1/4 cup butter ( optional ) | crushed ice ( for topping ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Put melted margarine and 2 tablespoons of onion soup in a 9x13 baking dish. Layer the dry ingredients in the following order, 2 slices each of french fried onions and noodles. Add remaining soup. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Cover with tin foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Uncover for the last 15 to 30 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle the last few flakes of nutmeg on top and allow to cool slightly. For best results allow to cool and serve at room temperature.

title: Coconut-Jalapeno Jelly
ingredients: 1/2 lb grated coconut | 1 pickled jalapeno pepper | 4 -5 cardamom pods | red food coloring
instructions: Dissolve the food coloring in hot water, add coconut and jalapenos and stir to coat. Cook in a saucepan over medium high heat until the mixture thickens. Remove from heat and add cardamom pods. Transfer mixture into a clean jar and cool before using.

Random Ingredients: glutinous rice,asparagus,salmon,velveeta cheese,flour,shaoxing wine,green chili,yellow bell pepper
title: Asian Grilled Asparagus and Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 lb smoked salmon, cut in thin slices | 1 lb velveeta cheese or 1 lb cheddar cheese, cut into cubes | 8 slices yellow bell peppers | 8 slices green chili, cut in thin strips | 1 lb glutinous rice | 2 packages simply natural flavor gluten free french wraps | 3 tablespoons shaoxing wine
instructions: Steam asparagus for 3 minutes or until tender. Combine asparagus, salmon, cheese, peppers, and chili strips in bowl with cooked rice. Make 4 burritos. Serve on bed of seaweed, then sprinkle with rice. Serve the asparagus mixture hot.

title: Basic Flavoured Buttermilk
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain flour | 1/4 cup yogurt | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Mix flour, yogurt, and soy milk in a bowl, and mix well with a fork until thick. Pour the buttermilk into a large saucepan and place over medium heat. Turn the heat to low when bubbles appear on surface of milk, and stir for about 3 minutes, or until bubbles disappear. Pour into four 1 cup capacity baking dishes, and cook 30 minutes. Turn out onto wire racks to cool.

title: Mexican Style Balsamic Pizza Balls
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon sage | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seed | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 28 ounces rotel tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. In a large bowl mix the flour sage, poppy seed, and balsamic vinegar. Add rotel tomatoes and stir till mostly dry. Add dry ingredients, and stir till mixed in evenly. Roll out evenly to make balls, and place on parchment covered pizza pans. Bake for 7 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: sage,chicken wing,date,basil leaf,red kashmiri chilies,orange blossom water,corn
title: Chinese Glazed Chicken Wings (Shalgam Masala)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings ( or other pieces ) | 1 1/2 quarts chicken stock or 1 1/2 quarts chicken wings broth | 12 dried red kashmiri chilies | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water | 1/2 cup fresh-minced basil leaf | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh-grated sage | 4 small dried red kashmiri chilies | 1/4 cup fresh-minced basil leaves | 4 whole orange blossom water or 4 whole rose water | 2 teaspoons sago or 2 teaspoons dried sago
instructions: Cut the wings up at joints. Place in a large, heavy pot with enough water to cover the wings by about 1 inch and bring to boil. Boil 4 to 5 minutes, or until just partially cooked. Remove wings from pot, place on paper towels to drain. Return the chicken to the pot, add stock or broth, 4 dried whole red chili peppers and cook over low heat, loosely covered, for 1 hour. Using a slotted spoon, remove the chili peppers and set aside. Remove the seeds and veins from the 4 whole orange blossoms. Rinse and dry the chilies lightly. Crush all of the chilies and add to the chicken with the oil in medium size frying pan. Cook over low heat until aromatic and starting to brown, about 5 minutes. Add the remaining dried red chili peppers to pan with the oil. Stir and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the sago, basil and sage. Stir, then simmer, tightly covered for about 20 minutes, or until the chicken and chilies are cooked through and the flavours have begun to blend. Spoon all stew into serving bowls and top with reserved chopped basil. Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,palm sugar,bean sprout,green lentil,sirloin beef
title: Burgundian Dried Noodle Salad
ingredients: 5 cups thin green lentils | 1/2 cup palm sugar or 1/2 cup brown sugar | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 tablespoons palm sugar or 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 lb sirloin beef, sliced thinly | 1/4 lb bean sprouts
instructions: Rinse lentils thoroughly in cold water. In large pan bring 4 quarts of water with palm sugar or brown sugar and 3 tablespoons fish sauce to boil. When water is boiling drop in the drained lentils. As soon as they double or triple in volume, turn off the heat and cover with a lid. Let sit for about 15 minutes, then remove from heat and drain off excess water and rinse again. In a serving platter lay out the bread of your choice and sprinkle both sides with a pinch or two of palm sugar in a pinch. When cool cut into small pieces approximately 1 inch wide and then place on plate and repeat until all the mixture is used. Then add beef on top of the bread, top with bean sprouts and serve.

title: Tortellini With Mushrooms and Peanuts
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh cheese tortellini | 2 teaspoons fresh tarragon, chopped ( or 1/2 t. dried, use your own to really taste ) | 1/2 cup cooked salted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions, drain. Toss pasta with tarragon, peanuts, and 1 tablespoon water. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,rice paper,thai basil,pepper,golden raisin
title: Sweet and Sour Rice Paper Wraps
ingredients: 4 sheets rice paper, about 12 x 3 inches in width | 4 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 cup golden raisin, washed, dried and chopped | 2/3 cup thai basil, chopped | pepper, to taste
instructions: Lay the 2 sheets of rice paper on a clean, dry surface. Using a small spoon, spread a scant 1 tablespoons of sugar on the rice paper sheets. Spread 1 cup of raisins and 1/3 cup of basil over the sugar, dividing evenly, and sprinkling the chopped raisins/basil evenly over the sugar. Using a clean dry wooden spoon, fold the rice paper wrapper, then the second 1/3 cup raisins and 1/3 cup basil over the raisins/basil. Starting at one short end of the wrapper, tightly roll up the rice paper, placing each piece in the center or the ends to make a complete package. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling. Serve with additional black pepper to taste. Preparation time does not include marinating time.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,brown rice flour,leg lamb,curd cottage cheese
title: Cottage Cheese and Coriander (Cottage) Croquettes
ingredients: 500 g small curd cottage cheese | 2 1/2 lbs organic leg of lamb, diced ( or 2 large leg of lamb ) | 500 g brown rice flour | 500 g roasted coriander or 1000 g fresh coriander
instructions: Mix the curd cottage cheese and the brown rice flour together in a bowl. Cut the diced lamb into 2 equal portions. Make golf balls out of the mix and roll into round balls. Arrange them side by side, slightly overlapping, on a baking tray with a little extra water on the top. Cover with foil and cook in a preheated oven for 1 hours. Alternatively place in the croquettes and cook at 100f for 2 hours. Allow to cool and serve with salad.

title: Hot Kidney Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 jar kidney beans, rinsed & drained | 1/2 cup chutney bean juice or 1/2 cup lemon juice ( see note in note 2 ) | 1 lemon, zest & juice of | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves or 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/2 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Note, if making as above, add lemon zest & juice, chili powder, salt, lime juice/olive oil & oregano leaves. Shake or stir well before adding any other spice or seasonings. Note 2, i made 2 variations, add chopped fresh tomatoes for a twist on a spicy dip. Use your discretion on the herb amounts, adding more thyme, chili powder, or salt & pepper. Note, i found that one of my toddlers was not as sweet as my other toddler was because the other kids didn't have them. My DH likes spicy food & used 1/2 of this to make the kids eat some of the time. When he's tired, take some of the bean liquid, & puree. This is where i added a little more water & 1/2 of the lemon juice as well, i did not add the lemon zest & juice to the beans or juice & i couldn't tell them if they were sweetened anyways. This is where i added 1/4 cup of feta and stir well to moisten.

title: Colombian Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup potato starch, or more as needed | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon rind | 1 quart picante sauce | 2 large baking potatoes, scrubbed
instructions: Combine potato starch and lemon rind in a bowl. Dredge potato wedges in potato mixture, then press to coat on all sides. Arrange wedges in a casserole dish.

title: Baked Strawberries and Lemongrass
ingredients: 1 gallon fresh strawberries | 1 leek, chopped | 10 button mushrooms, chopped | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Using a zester, zest and then pound the berries down to about the size of the lemon you are going to use. Slice leek and mushrooms into a bowl of hot water for a few minutes to loosen the sand inside. Stir them in with the leeks and mushrooms. Combine the xanthan gum, oregano and the berries and toss with the leeks and mushrooms and berries into an oiled baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 spanish onion, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 package seasoned croutons
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine tomato sauce, onion, cinnamon, and croutons. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer 2 minutes or until the sauce has thickened and the onions are tender.

title: Cheesy Baked Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck roast | 1 container ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix ricotta and meat in a 9x13 pan. Cover tightly with foil. Cut slits at the top of the roast to allow steam to escape. Place the pan in the oven. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove the roasts from oven, uncover and stir, if desired. Bake an additional 25 minute. Remove beef from the oven, tent with foil, and allow to rest for 5 minute covered with foil. Reserve juices in pan and serve with a salad. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,pork,cherry,french onion soup,green cardamom pod,vanilla bean,onion salt
title: Gramma's French Onion & Vanilla Pork Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs country-style pork, diced | 3 cans condensed french onion soup | 2 cans tomato juice | 2 lbs cherries, stoned ( no pits ) | 1 medium onion salt ( to taste ) | 6 green cardamom pods, split lengthwise | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split lengthwise
instructions: In large stock pot, place pork, onion soup, tomato juice, sugar, cherries, pepper, vanilla bean, and cardamom pods. Simmer soup for about 3 hours, stirring occasionally. If the soup becomes too thick to stir, use 2 tbsp water. Serve in soup bowls with crackers cut in half.

title: Sliced Apples With ouzo - Moroccan Dressing
ingredients: 4 medium oranges | 2 medium tart apples | 2 medium onions | 1/2 cup chopped palm sugar | 10 ounces ouzo
instructions: Peel the oranges and apples, cut into 6 wedges each apple, remove skin and set aside. Cut each wedge into thin ribbons. Cut the apple wedges into thin strips 2 in wide. Cut the onions into strips 2 in wide. Dice the palm sugar into small fine pieces. Crush 10oz ouzo slightly with a teaspoon into each of the 6 serving bowls. Spread olive oil on the bottom of each bowl. Put the citrus slices in the bowl, sprinkle top with the sugar and ouzo. Serve or refrigerate overnight.

title: Curry Paste Fritters (Bread Fritters)
ingredients: 100 g bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste ( i use thai kitchen brand )
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients together so that they are combined and form into a rough paste. Use a large, flat ladle so it won't sink. Lightly grease your hands. Knead dough briefly, about 5 - 10 minutes, depending on consistency of paste. Form a smooth ball and coat with paste. Lightly dust a tray with bread flour. Take the dough out and divide it into 12 equal portions. Form each piece into a long, flat circle. Push a circle down to 8cm in diameter, making sure that the edge is at least 2cm deep. Repeat the same for the other side, then place fritters on lightly greased tray. Press a little more bread flour into each fritter circle. Cook for 35 - 40 minutes, turning once.

title: Beef Hash
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 3 dried figs ( i like feta cheese ) | 2 serrano chili | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 -3 radishes | 1 pinch dried greek mustard seeds
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the roast and remove all of the fat. Use a roasting pan or cookie sheet with a flat bottom to place your beef hash on. Cover it with aluminum foil, place it in the oven, and preheat on 160 degrees it will have a bit of extra in the middle, so if you need that extra, turn your oven down to 250 degrees. Bake for 1 1/2 hours test for doneness by touching the beef with a fork. When done, remove from the oven, remove the wrap, and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Slice or shred the beef and arrange on a platter and top with the figs and the chiles. These can be served on the side.

Random Ingredients: tangerine juice,half cream,flour tortilla,sesame oil,mint leaf,kale,cashew
title: Lebanese Kale Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale or 1 bunch frozen kale, chopped into bite sized pieces | 1/4 cup cashews | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried tangerine juice | 8 low-fat flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint leaves or 1 teaspoon dried mint | 4 tablespoons tangerine juice | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame oil
instructions: Steam the fresh kale, nuts, and tangerines until tender crisp. Remove the leaves from the water and chop the larger pieces into small bite size pieces. Place them into a medium size bowl and mix with the cashews and tangerine juice. Set aside. Using a grill or your oven to broil, warm the tortillas in a small pan for a few seconds on each side just until warm. Place them on a plate. Cut the greens into thin sliced segments with your hands, removing the choke if desired. Add the herbs to the greens and then mix with the greens. To serve, place a few tangerines in the sour cream. Place a scoop of greens on top, garnish with toasted sesame oil, and serve.

title: Cabbage and Tomato (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1 medium-sized white cabbage, preferably the inner core removed, and cut into quarters lengthwise | 2 cups tomato sauce ( i used homemade for the dry version ) | 4 cardamom pods
instructions: Place the cabbage quarters in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Slice the cardamom pods in half and remove the hard outer cores, leaving the green tops slightly flattened. Add the tomato sauce to the pot and bring mixture to a simmer. Reduce heat slightly and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours or until cabbage is very tender.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,graham cracker crumb,half,italian salad dressing mix
title: Italian Creamy Grammy Topping
ingredients: 1 lb graham cracker crumbs or 1 lb graham wafer crumbs | 1 package italian salad dressing mix ( or any dry italian flavor prepared mix ) | 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half, heated ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Stir all ingredients together. Pour into a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Place in middle of oven. Bake about 20 minutes, until bubbly. Remove from oven and serve plain or with any sauce.

title: Curry Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 cup icing sugar | 2 cups round steaks, cut into 1. 2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a glass baking dish or bowl, mix 1 cup icing sugar with the remaining 1 cup of icing sugar and cut up the steaks into pieces 1/2 and 1/8, using the meat slicer. Roll the steaks in the mixture, coating them all over. Place the steaks onto a cookie sheet and bake in a preheated oven for 25 minutes, until tender.

title: Hot Roast Sausages
ingredients: 8 hot polish sausages | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pickled grape | 3 tablespoons lemon peel, grated | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees celsius and grease a medium sized oven dish. In a large bowl, stir together the drained chickpeas, grape, lemon peel, thyme, sugar, garlic powder. Lightly spray the rashers with olive oil cooking spray. Put the sausages in the dish and bake for about 45 minutes, turning occasionally, until well browned all over.

title: Quick Caribbean Pasta
ingredients: 450 g short pasta ( such as orecchiette ) | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar, plus a pinch | 1 pinch saffron | 150 -200 ml prepared roux | 2 pints ripe papayas, sliced lengthways
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions, and drain. Meanwhile, warm sugar in saucepan over a low heat until golden, stirring regularly to prevent crystals forming. Add saffron and fry, stirring for one minute. Add papayas, stirring well, and cook for another minute. Pour in cooked pasta, and toss to coat.

title: Cilantro Chilled Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cilantro | 2 1/2 pints chicken stock | 3/4 cup double cream
instructions: Place the cilantro and the stock mixed together in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and stir in the cream. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,sesame oil,chile powder,oyster sauce,applesauce,ice,wine,poblano pepper
title: Yummy Applesauce Apples
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons chile powder | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chile powder | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/4 cup fresh chile wine | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 cup ice | 1 cup granny smith apple, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3 poblano peppers, halved and seeded
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together sesame oil, chile powder, chipotle chile powder, applesauce, chile wine, oyster sauce and ice. Cover and refrigerate for flavors to blend. Place the apple slices into the ice cream maker, stir, and run until desired consistency is reached. Pour the macadamia sauce in the centre of each plate and place a poblano pepper slice on top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: harissa,artichoke heart,plain yogurt,iceberg lettuce,pear,egg white,mayonnaise,baking soda
title: Artichoke Hearts in Yogurt
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 pear - peeled, cored and chopped | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise, or more to taste | 1 egg white | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon harissa | 3 teaspoons shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Mix artichoke hearts and pear together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,worcestershire sauce,red pepper flake,agave nectar,almond extract,extra sharp cheddar cheese,mozzarella cheese
title: Cheddar and Almond Mozzarella Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup low-fat agave nectar | 2 tablespoons mild worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon bottled garlic and herb seasoning or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon real almond extract
instructions: Combine cheeses and nectar in glass measure. Cover and microwave on high for 2 minutes. Stir in worcestershire sauce, parsley, crushed red pepper and garlic herb seasoning. Microwave for 1 more minute and stir, stopping occasionally. Serve with crackers. Note, i microwave this on high for exactly one minute, 30 seconds and then set aside. To make into a cheese product, slice apples and place 1 slice on each of 2 plates. Sprinkle with desired amount of cheddar cheese and almonds. Spoon 1/2 of cheese mixture over apples. Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,anaheim chilies,italian seasoning,cashew,egg,red currant jelly,ghee
title: Cheese Triangles Pastry Wraps
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry | 2 large eggs | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup cashews, finely chopped | 8 ounces red currant jelly, rinsed and drained | 5 large anaheim chilies, stemmed sliced | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Lightly oil a baking sheet. On a floured surface, roll out the pastry until it is 1/8 thick. Cut into 8 - 8 rounds. In a bowl, beat the eggs with the italian seasoning. On another cutting board, combine the cashews, red currant jelly, chilies, and ghee. Gently fold into the egg mixture. Place 1 tablespoon of the filling into each pastry round. Seal the edges. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Preheat 1/3 oven to 400 degrees. Place the triangles on the prepared baking sheet. Brush with the egg mixture. Bake 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden.

title: Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses or 1/4 cup coconut palm molasses, i use the best quality | 5 ounces red enchilada sauce | 4 -6 fresh edible flowers ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the ground round and molasses. Stir and cook until it begins to turn light brown slightly. Transfer to a bowl. Stir in the red enchilada sauce, and continue cooking until heated through. Taste and adjust seasoning. Garnish with flowers. Serve over hot spanish rice.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,bamboo shoot,corn flake,ramen noodle,lavender flower,thyme sprig,white mushroom
title: Lavender Ramen (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 3 cups cooked ramen noodles ( exclude seasoning packet ) | 1/2 cup corn flakes ( crushed ) | 1 cup crushed bamboo shoot | 1 cup white mushroom ( sliced thin ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme flowers or 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram leaves, crushed | 1/4 cup picante sauce ( vegetarian or your choice ) | fresh lavender flowers ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for the ramen noodles. The noodles should be slightly slushy. Stir in the ramen noodles. Heat thoroughly. Sprinkle with lavender flowers. Serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,orange juice,chicken stock beef,miso paste
title: Miso and Ginger Soup
ingredients: 300 ml chicken stock or 300 ml vegetable stock | 1 orange, juice of | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 2 teaspoons miso paste
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook for 5 - 7 minutes on a low fire until it is reduced to a puree. Serve with fresh bread or toast.

Random Ingredients: carb spaghetti sauce,rice,pork,tamari,ear corn cob,honey mustard
title: BBQ Honey Mustard Pork Sausages
ingredients: 6 fully cooked pork sausages | 4 ears corn on the cob, husked | 1 can sweet and sour prepared mustard | 1 cup honey mustard | 3/4 cup bottled low-carb spaghetti sauce | cooked rice
instructions: Prepare your grill or fire. Place sausages on grill. Place the ears of corn on the grill. Grill over medium heat approximately 5 - 7 minutes turning once. Turn frequently and grill for another 3 - 5 minutes or you can just flip and grill on a foreman type grill. Let stand for 5 minutes before slicing. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine mustard, honey mustard and spaghetti sauce. Add to the cooked sausages and stir lightly. Serve with cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,gourmet wine vinegar,club soda,turbinado sugar,green cardamom,black cardamom pod,tomato puree,leaf lettuce
title: Gourmet Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 5 lbs firm asparagus | 1 cup club soda | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 1 1/2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 4 green cardamoms, crushed slightly | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground black cardamom pods or 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin | 4 cups shredded fresh leaf lettuce | 3/4 cup thinly sliced asparagus | 3 tablespoons chopped truffle-flavoured vegan gourmet wine vinegar
instructions: Trim asparagus tips and cut into 3 inch lengths.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,vanilla bean,tomato green chilies,rosemary,tuna water,feta cheese
title: Greek Tomato White Bean Dip for One
ingredients: 400 g greek-style canned tomatoes and green chilies, drain and finely chop | 2 cups kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 vanilla bean | 2 cups feta cheese, crumbled | 1 1/4 cups canned tuna in water, drained well | 1 tablespoon rosemary, finely crushed
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender with 2 3/4 cups water, process until smooth. Taste, adjust seasoning if necessary. Note that the above measurements can be reduced to your desired consistency. Place in serving bowl and chill for about 1 hour or until cool. Serve with crackers.

title: Granola Cheesecake (Savile)
ingredients: 3 cups graham cracker crumbs | 10 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, margarine, and 1/3 cup of cheese until well blended. Roll into balls, and place onto a greased baking sheet. Press gently with your fingers to make sure the crumb filling doesn't spread out. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: tap water,pickle juice,sake,golden syrup,dark soy sauce,french
title: Soupy Onion Soup
ingredients: 6 small french ( or other 'fennel'onions ) | 1 3/4 cups pickle juice | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon sake ( rice vinegar is best ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 3/4 cup boiling hot tap water
instructions: Cut the onions into very thin slices, about 1/3 to 1/2 inch thick. Heat a heavy bottomed saucepan over medium heat until a bead of water dropped onto the pan sizzles. Scoop the onion slices into the pan and cook 1 or 2 minutes on each side, or until they have softened and turned a deep, golden brown, about 20 minutes. Remove them with a slotted spoon and onto a serving tray lined with paper towels to drain. Sprinkle with soy sauce, then stir in vinegar, golden syrup and hot water until well mixed and warm. Serve immediately.

title: Goats Cheese Popcorn Balls
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables | 1 package goat cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl mash the goat cheese well with a fork. Add the mixed vegetables.

title: Crock Pot Apple and Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can apple juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook on high for 5 hours, low for 6.

title: Bun-Bop (Indonesian Fried Rice)
ingredients: 2/3 cup crisco shortening | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 2 tablespoons plain bread flour | 1 cup sushi rice ( short cut ) | 1/2 bunch fresh anchovy ( chopped fine ) | 1/4 cup ketjap manis or 1/4 cup chili sauce
instructions: Mix cumin and bread flour together in a small bowl. If using wooden hands, stretch and knead to combine. If using wooden hands, begin to mix. In a medium sauce pan or saute pan, heat cumin/bread flour mixture on medium heat until oil shimmers. Add ginger and anchovies.

title: Delicious Black & Tan Frozen Brew
ingredients: 4 ounces frozen limeade concentrate | 2 fluid ounces black coffee | 3 -4 tablespoons vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender with 1 tablespoons vanilla essence.

title: Spiced Hot Peppered Brinjals
ingredients: 1 cup hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 package frozen brinjals
instructions: Slice brinjals in 1 inch intervals with a paring knife or knife. Heat sesame oil in medium skillet over medium high heat. Add brinjals, season with salt and black pepper. Reduce heat to low and cook 5 minutes, until brinjals are heated through. Serve hot.

title: Pommes De Terre Bouillabaisse (French Herbs and Potato Rounds)
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato | 1/8 lb sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon arrowroot | chopped fresh herb, for serving
instructions: Wash and peel potatoes and cut them into rounds of about 1/2 inch. Place them on a baking pan and pour the sliced potatoes over them in plenty of cold water. Let them sit in a cool place for about 30 minutes. Remove the potatoes with a slotted spoon and arrange them on a baking sheet. Heat a little cooking oil in a small frying pan, and add the chile sauce. When it starts to bubble, add the arrowroot to about half a cup of water and stir until smooth. Cook the soup for about 2 minutes longer, stirring occasionally. Pour the soup over the potatoes and garnish with fresh cilantro. This recipe makes about 1 - 2 servings. You can freeze the soup in an airtight container for up to 3 months.

title: French Onion Dip (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ultra-sour cream ( organic ) | 1 cup vegetable oil cooking spray ( or other neutral flavored cooking spray ) | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Line a small baking sheet with parchment paper. Spray top of parchment with vegetable oil spray. In a mixing bowl, whip cream until fluffy and light colored. Beat in tarragon. Transfer to a serving bowl. Serve warm or cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,vanilla bean,flour tortilla,seasoning salt,brown sugar
title: Citrus Pork or Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin ( or other lean meat of your choice ) | 4 flour tortillas | cooking spray or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 3 tablespoons light brown sugar | 1/2 cup flour | 1 can fat-free vanilla beans or ( 16 ounce ) can pineapple tidbits
instructions: Cut the pork into 1/2 inch strips. Spray a 10 inch skillet with cooking spray or set it up an oven proof dish. If you can, use a pie plate. Put it in the freezer until needed. Put the flour and brown sugar in a plastic bag. Add the pork strips and shake to coat. Put in the skillet and fry over medium heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until the pork is cooked and no longer pink inside. Remove the pork from the skillet and place on tortillas. Add the brown sugar and continue to fry over medium heat for about 4 minutes more. Add the vanilla beans and heat through. Serve with guacamole, guacamole or salsa.

title: Crazy Tweaky Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup coarse-ground cornmeal | 1/3 cup finely coarse-ground colby cheese or 1/3 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup mild hot sauce | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium size bowl or baking sheet and mix well. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Pour into ungreased standard size baking sheet. Bake 18 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: turkey stock chicken,chicken breast half,mint,pine nut
title: Pine Nut Turkey
ingredients: 12 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into thin strips | 1 pint chicken stock | 1 cup toasted pine nuts | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line a shallow baking dish with aluminum foil. Arrange chicken strips in a single layer on the foil. Pour chicken stock around the chicken.

title: Cauliflower-Parsley-Cauliflower Fettuccine
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Using scissors or sharp knife, cut each cauliflower head in half lengthwise.

title: Simple Rigatoni with Garlic
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 clove garlic, minced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rigatoni in boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain pasta in a colander. Toss hot cooked pasta with garlic in a large bowl. Pour pasta sauce over.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,white wine vinegar,tarragon,sunflower oil,mushroom,bourbon,white fish fillet
title: Furting up. Easy and Cheap
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 200 g cremini mushrooms | 300 g shiitake mushrooms | 125 ml good bourbon | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 15 g fresh tarragon
instructions: Chop the mushrooms finely and boil in very little water. Slice the fish into thick slices. Heat up the vegetable oil in a frying pan. Cut the mushrooms into small pieces. Dry fry the fish fillets in the frying pan. Then add them to the fry pan and fry them together, until they are nice and cooked. Drain on paper towels and add the bourbon and white wine vinegar. Stir. Add 3 tablespoon of fresh tarragon and mix. Garnish with fresh tarragon.

title: Fettuccine With Plums - Tomatoes With Coriander and Fresh Coriander
ingredients: 400 g fettuccine pasta ( short pasta shapes ) | 400 g plum tomatoes, seeded, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped | 3 slices sourdough bread, toasted, finely chopped
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water for 8 - 10 mins or until almost tender but still firm. Drain well and set aside. Meanwhile, heat the pan over a medium heat and add the tomatoes and coriander and simmer for a final 2 mins until the tomatoes have collapsed. Meanwhile, tip half the fettuccine into a large bowl and add the tomato mixture, toss well, then serve scattered with the remaining chopped coriander.

title: Apple and Honey Glazed Kohlrabi Rolls-Sakura Style
ingredients: 6 kohlrabi, peeled and cut into 1/8-inch-thick rounds | 2 tart apples, cored and cut into thin wedges | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 pinch ground cardamom pod | 1/2 cup honey | 2 tablespoons grated nori, seaweed sheets | 35 ladyfingers
instructions: Place kohlrabi on paper towels or plastic towels.

title: Curtido
ingredients: pastry for a double-crust pie | 1/2 lebanese cucumber ( sliced and chopped ) | 1 yellow bell pepper ( sliced and chopped ) | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Roll out pastry to line a deep 6 inch deep dish pie plate. Line the sides with parchment paper to prevent a soggy crust. Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Line the pie plate on top of the pastry and sprinkle on the green pepper. Place the sliced cucumber over the white pepper. Topping, combine breadcrumbs and breadcrumb/breadcrumb mixture and blend well. Sprinkle breadcrumb mixture over vegetables. Dot with butter. Bake for 1 hour then remove pastry from oven and cool, covered.

title: Fish for Steve's Kitchen and Pantry
ingredients: 1/3 cup corn ( fresh or frozen ) | 10 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 cup radish, chopped | 1 cup cilantro or 1 cup parsley, chopped | 1 cup coconut, shredded
instructions: Mix together corn, tomatoes, radishes, and cilantro in large bowl. Add coconut. Let stand about 10 minutes. Serve with bread, or rice.

title: Easter Noodle Potato Cake
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper | 3 tablespoons tea | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 4 tablespoons almond paste | 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add potato, and cook for 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and set aside. In a small bowl, combine lemon pepper, worcestershire sauce, and almond paste. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,bacon,grand marnier,plain flour,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chicken stock,ha avocado,stout beer
title: Beer and Lentil Soup
ingredients: 750 ml chicken stock, preferably home made | 250 g brown lentils | 300 g thick-cut smoked bacon, thickly sliced | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup finely chopped parsley | 2 ripe hass avocadoes, quartered | 1/3 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup plain flour
instructions: Combine the stock, lentils and bacon in a large saucepan and bring to the boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer until the lentils are just tender, around 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, using a blender or food processor, puree the avocado in large bowl until smooth. Stir in the cheese and parsley. Remove the soup from the heat. Slightly mash the soup with a fork or in the food processor if it is too smooth. Stir in the guacamole and heat over a low heat, stirring frequently until it has melted and is heated through. Adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper. Ladle into warmed bowls and garnish with the avocado slices and a little Grand Marnier. Serve with grated parmesan on the side for added flavour.

Random Ingredients: sherry,chili oil,black pepper,corn tostada shell,taco seasoning mix,chicken meat
title: Easy Mexican Chicken tostadas
ingredients: 16 small corn tostada shells | 1/4 cup chili oil | 3 lbs chicken bits, canned | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add oil and swirl to coat. Remove tortillas from pan. Add chicken bits, sherry & taco seasoning to the hot skillet and bring to a boil, stirring to combine. Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes. Drain chicken bits well. Add corn to the chicken nuggets, stir well and remove from heat. Place mixture in the center of a large platter or shallow baking dish. Spoon chicken mixture evenly over the chicken. Sprinkle with pepper.

title: Sweet Pepper-Sun Dried Tomato Grilled Skewer Cake
ingredients: 2 ripe yellow peppers | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup cointreau liqueur | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Cut 2 sweet peppers lengthwise in half crosswise. Remove and discard stem and seeds. Slice 1/2 the long piece off top of each pepper half. Remove seeds. Cut remaining 2 halves into thirds lengthwise and crosswise. Thread pepper strips onto skewers. Combine 1/2 cup sun dried tomato oil with cointreau and honey in medium bowl.

title: Grilled Italian Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup crumbled goat cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup goat cheese or 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese | 3 tablespoons cracked pepper | 2 tablespoons gold tequila ( optional ) | 3 lbs boneless leg of lamb, fat trimmed, butterflied and tied ( about 2 racks ) | 3/4 cup crumbled sweet pepper ( optional ) | 12 slices prosciutto ( about 1/3 inch thick )
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Using a meat pounder or your fingers, cut fat from lamb to about 1/4 inch thickness. Starting at short end, press fat on one side of each rib. Pat rub on both sides of each rib. Roll up each lengthwise, pinching ends to keep meat from curling when grill is ready, and place lamb, fat side up, on a rack in a shallow glass baking dish. Grill 2 minutes per side or until meat thermometer registers 125°f. Cover loosely with foil. Remove from grill. Transfer meat to cutting board.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,chocolate,panko breadcrumb,pear,cottage cheese,cream cheese,guacamole,thyme leave
title: A Fully Monty (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sour cream ( to taste, i use low fat ) | 7 ounces cottage cheese ( or ricotta cheese ) | 6 ounces fat free cream cheese | 1 1/2 - 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 6 ounces semisweet chocolate ( i use ghirardelli's best ) | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1 -2 tablespoon shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 ripe pear, peeled, cored and cut into thin slices
instructions: In mixing bowl, stir together sour cream and cottage cheese. Blend in cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle panko on untoasted panko. Spread into shallow crock pot that has been coated with pam. Layer with pears. Top with shredded parmigiano reggiano. Set crock pot on low for approximately 4 hours or until the panko is very dark in color and has absorbed all the flavor. Serve with bread and garnish with a spoonful of guacamole and fresh thyme leaves. Makes 4 servings approximately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,sunflower oil,semolina flour,turmeric powder
title: Falafel
ingredients: 10 ounces semolina flour | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Sift the semolina into a medium sized bowl. Add the turmeric powder and mix well. Spray a food grade baking dish with cooking oil for sprinkling. Pour half the sesame oil. Add the semolina to the pan. With a fork, begin flaking the semolina into small bits of flour. The spatula works best here. If you have a pizza cutter, the dough will be easy to press down with a wooden spoon and then flatten as the dough is grated. When it is all the way grated, form the dough into large, flat bread shapes. Spray the dough with the remaining sesame oil. Place on a sheet pan to dry slightly. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Bake for 5 minutes and let them sit for another 10 minutes. Slice them up and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,tart apple,lentil,thai chili sauce,ice,cocoa powder
title: Apple Lentil & Apple Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese ( about 2 oz. ) | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder or 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup sweet thai sweet chili sauce | 1 cup frozen apples or 1 cup fresh apple, diced | 1/2 cup dry lentils ( i like to use the bagged kind ) | crushed ice
instructions: In a medium bowl stir together the cheese and cocoa. Add sweet chili sauce, apples, lentils and ice. Taste and add more seasoning if necessary. Serve. Great with bubble fries and/or fresh bread as desired.

title: Mexican Shrimp Appetizer
ingredients: 24 large shrimp | 12 slices mexican blend cheese | 12 slices apricot jam
instructions: Place 1 shrimp piece on each of 6 slices of cheese. Place on a large, round platter. Top with 1 slice of jam. Roll up and serve.

Random Ingredients: leek,white bean,curry powder,basmati rice,pearl barley,ginger paste
title: Tibetan Beans & Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley, washed | 400 -500 g white beans, cleaned ( white beans or kidney ) | 1/2 cup white basmati rice, washed and soaked in 2 3 cups of hot water | 1 tablespoon mild curry powder | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | fresh leeks or spring onion, sliced into thin rings
instructions: Soak both the grains and rice separately for at least 1/2 hour. Drain & mix with the rest of the ingredients. Microwave for 12 minutes on high power, stirring once or twice, or until all the water evaporates & the ingredients are well mixed. Serve hot, garnished with sliced onions or green chillies.

title: Almond Gravy for Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: In a skillet, combine beef stock and almonds. Cook over medium heat for 30 minutes, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: sauce,penne rigate,mace,thyme sprig,brown sugar,bartlett pear,beef gravy,seasoning salt
title: Penne With Pear Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb penne rigate ( dried ) | 1 jar beef gravy | 5 tablespoons steak sauce | 1 1/2 cups brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 dash hot sauce | 1 ripe bartlett pear, peeled, halved, lengthwise, and core removed
instructions: In large pot of boiling water, cook pasta according to package directions. When pasta is done, drain. While pasta is cooking, combine gravy, beef gravy, brown sugar, mace, thyme, and hot sauce in a small bowl. Set aside. Remove rind from pear halves and slice into thin wheels. Transfer pear to 1/2 quart casserole dish. Add reserved gravy mixture and stir to coat. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Add cooked pasta to sauce and simmer for another 8 - 10 minutes. Garnish with shredded or shaved pecorino romano.

title: Steamed Mussels
ingredients: 400 g fresh mussels, thoroughly washed and scrubbed ( live or shell, not sure, as it opens ) | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 250 ml burgundy wine
instructions: Crush the mussels in the bottom of a saucepan, so that the shells have the volume of an ordinary size baguette. Add bouillon cube, and wine to one in the saucepan. Cover well and cook for about 3 - 4 minutes or until the mussels are just open to the touch, shaking the pan over the sink regularly as they open. Remove lid, turn up heat slightly to high and boil rapidly for about 10 minutes stirring constantly, until mussels have opened and liquid has reduced somewhat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,pork loin,farfalle pasta,sun tomato oil,mace
title: Creamy Pork and Sun-Dried Tomato With Farfalle
ingredients: 1/4 lb loin ( sirloin ) | 3 -4 links pork loin | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 3 -5 -5 cups farfalle pasta | 2 cups dry sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced into wedges | 3 tablespoons oil
instructions: Cut the loin into 1 inch cubes and marinate in 2 tbsp oil for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator. Remove from the refrigerator about 30 minutes before you are ready to cook the farfalle. Place the farfalle just under the broiler. Cook, turning often, until the farfalle is bubbling and lightly toasted. Reserve 1 tbsp oil. Remove from the broiler, add the sun dried tomatoes to the skillet, and cook about 5 minutes to make them slightly browned. If the pan does not have sun dried tomatoes, you can drizzle with a little bit of olive oil to get them sizzling. Stir in 1 tbsp oil, or if you have it too hot, add 1 tbsp of water to cover a little of the sun dried tomatoes. The sun dried tomatoes will release the excess oil and flavor, leaving a pleasant surprise in your kitchen. Stir in the pork and marinade. Cook about 9 minutes. Stir in the marinated farfalle and heat through. Serve and top with parmesan. Variation #1, add a tablespoon of fresh basil or coriander leaves for added flavor.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,pistachio nut,cashew nut,arborio rice,white sugar,half,chocolate chip
title: Pistachio Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1/2 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1 cup cashew nuts | 1/4 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chips | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 cup miniature pistachio nuts, finely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in arborio rice. Cover, and let stand for 20 minutes. Drain. Combine rice, sugar, and caraway in a bowl, and mix thoroughly. Pour into a microwave safe dish, and cook on high in the microwave until the rice has absorbed most of the water, about 1 minute. Fluff rice with a fork, and stir in cashews. Chill rice. Stir half and half and pistachios into rice mixture until well blended. Spoon into a small glass bowl, and sprinkle with chocolate bits. Drizzle with melted chocolate, and stir while coating each ramekin with coconut oil. Chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

title: Masala Fingers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs potatoes | 3/4 cup dried fenugreek | 1 -2 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Boil the potato, potatoes should be ready when pierced with a fork. Drain excess water and mash the potato. Remove and discard the skins. Add the dried fenugreek leaves and stir lightly. Add lime juice. Serve at once or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,thai red curry paste,juice,chick pea,salmon fillet,fontina,cornstarch
title: Thai Salmon Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1/4 cup frozen spinach | 2 tablespoons plum shrimp | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste ( to taste ) | 1 cup fontina | 4 flour tortillas | juice of an artichoke ( to garnish ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: For the salmon fillet,. Trim the salmon of any bones or skin and cut into 2 inch chunks. Place in a container with a lid or resealable plastic wrap, and cover with water. Let marinate for 15 minutes. For the spinach mixture,. Place the spinach in a dry saute pan and cook over medium heat until the spinach is wilted. Remove from the pan with a slotted spoon and rinse well. Place thawed spinach in a blender, add the shrimp and 1 t of thai red curry paste. Process until it forms a paste. Cut the fontina into 1 1/2 inch chunks and transfer to a bowl. Add the remaining 1 t of red curry paste and 1 cup of water to the spinach mixture. Stir until well combined. Roll the salmon chunks in the mixture to coat and set aside. Heat a nonstick skillet until very hot but not smoking. Add 2 t of cornstarch to the pan and cook the salmon in the skillet for 4 minutes on each side. Top with fontina and serve with the spinach and tomato salsa. Enjoy.

title: Jalapeno - Wet Rub
ingredients: 1 cup golden syrup | 2 tablespoons fresh jalapeno peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Grind the dried jalapenos with your spice mill. A mortar or molcajete works well. Gradually stir in the warm golden syrup. Use with your favorite crackers and/or vegetables.

title: Lambs' Lamb Shanks (Cured)
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb chops, in 5 x 3 cm cubes ( see related recipe ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 bunch kale or 1 bunch chard | 1 bunch scallop | 2 tablespoons parsley or 2 tablespoons cilantro
instructions: Wash lamb and lamb chops thoroughly, drain and pat dry. Mix together vinegar, vinegar and herbs in a jug until well blended, chill. Soak lamb in mixture in refrigerator overnight. Preheat griller pan or fry pan until hot. Cook lamb for a few minutes on each side or until browned and cooked through. Remove from heat. Strain lamb mixture to remove any excess fat. Reheat lamb mixture, pour over beef and serve. This can be prepared in advance and stored in an air tight container up to two days. Note, the meat can also be braised in the oven, using stock cubes instead of water and vinegar. The former can be kept in the fridge for 2 weeks. Note, the technique for curing the lamb is to rub the lamb with hot oil and place in a dry frying pan. Cook over medium heat until well coated. When the lamb is cooked, remove from the skillet and set aside in a baking dish. If you wish, you may bake it in the oven at 350 degrees fahrenheit for a few minutes before removing from the oven. This will produce an incredible rare lamb which will last for a long time, turning over once. Pour off excess fat when lamb is cool enough to handle but not tough.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,yellow cornmeal,green chili pepper,dark brown sugar,beef tenderloin,roast
title: Mexican Beef Tenderloin With Brown Sugar Glaze
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup dried apricot preserves | 2 teaspoons green chili peppers, minced | 3 lbs boneless beef tenderloin | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup green chili pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f combine cornmeal, brown sugar, apricot preserves, chiles and beef in shallow pan. Dredge both sides of meat with cornmeal mixture, and transfer to foil lined baking dish. Brush with glaze. Bake at 375°f for about 1 hour or until meat thermometer reads 145°f.

title: Easy Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 package hot smoked sausage meat | 1 1/2 tablespoons bacon fat, plus | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 package imitation crabmeat
instructions: Heat the fat in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Add the sausage meat and saute, stirring often, just until heated through, 3 - 4 minutes. Add the vinegar and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until liquid reduces to half and thickens slightly. Add the crabmeat and cook for 3 minutes, stirring often. Serve hot.

title: Basic Masala Gravy (A Simple, Easy Delicious, Vegan Recipe)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tomato paste | cilantro leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place tomato paste in a small bowl, sprinkle with cilantro, and mash with a fork, adding water as you go, until you have a thick and smooth gravy. If desired, make gravy with additional water.

title: Quick and Easy Preserved Lemons
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs serrano peppers | 1 3/4 cups uncooked couscous | 3 tablespoons grated fresh horseradish | 8 -12 sprigs fresh rosemary | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thai chiles
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place serrano peppers in a small baking pan/tin. Bake until blackened but soft, about 30 minutes. Remove peppers with a brush or paper towels and set aside. When cool enough to handle discard skin, slit the pepper lengthwise. Remove the seeds and ribs and cut peppers into quarters. Place couscous in a medium bowl and add hot water, 1 tablespoon at a time, mixing with a fork. Cover bowl and let stand 10 minutes. Stir in serrano peppers, horseradish and rosemary. If rice is too dry, add more water 2 tablespoons at a time, stirring well after each addition. Spoon hot pepper and horseradish mixture onto a wooden board, then sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon lemon zest. Using your hands or 2 forks, cut squashy squash into wedges about 1/4 by 2 inches. Lay wedges flat on a baking sheet sprinkled with sugar. Sprinkle with remaining lemon zest. Bake until crisp and slightly browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,ice cube,water chestnut,yellow bell pepper,ear corn,pistachio,mexican cheese
title: Tunisian Grill Party
ingredients: 4 small skinless salmon fillets | 4 ears corn, shucked and cut from cob | 1 cup white mexican-style cheese | 1/4 cup unsalted shelled pistachios or 1/4 cup shelled walnuts | 1/2 cup finely chopped yellow bell pepper | 8 cups boiling water chestnuts, sliced or quartered | ice cube
instructions: Cook salmon fillets in boiling water to cover 7 to 9 minutes for each ounce, until just cooked. Transfer salmon to cutting board and let cool. Cut fish across the grain into 1/2 thick slices to remove the bones. Place corn, cheese, nuts and peppers in individual serving bowls. Spoon salmon on top, add ice cubes and serve.

title: Hot Nacho Chicken Nachos
ingredients: 4 cornish hens, cooked | 4 large tortillas | 4 large jalapenos, sliced ( or other hot pepper ) | 4 slices firm textured apples | 3 large courgettes | cooked pasta ( optional ) | cooked turkey breast ( optional )
instructions: Take hens and shell them. Chop them into 2 or 4 pieces depending on sizes. Slice onions into thin slices. Place one tortilla on a plate and place 1/4 slice of tomato on the tortilla. Add 2 pieces of turkey breast then 1 slice of courgette. Top with 1/3 of the onion, 1/4 slice of jalapeno, 2 slices of apple, and more tortilla. Top with 3tb each of seson and meat. Place another tortilla over and repeat process with all meat, vegetable, and pasta. Finish with another tortilla to make nachos. You can top with diced tomatoes and salsa if desired.

title: Glazed Pork and Carrots
ingredients: 750 g pork fillets, thinly sliced | 2 carrots, cut diagonally into thick slices | 4 teaspoons mustard, prepared
instructions: Place the meat in a non aluminium dish. Sprinkle each slice of carrot with mustard. Pour over the remaining mustard. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Preheat the broiler. Remove the dish from the fridge about 30 minutes before cooking, and place the pork slices on a greased baking tray. Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve with remaining carrot wedges over the top.

title: Easy Cucumber and Coriander Appetizer
ingredients: 2 unpeeled cucumbers, peeled and halved lengthwise | 1 cup chopped fresh coriander ( cilantro ) | 2 tablespoons shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine the cucumbers and coriander in a mixing bowl. Top with the mozzarella cheese. Toss to combine. Keep in refrigerator for 1 to 5 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,onion flake,french baguette,dark chocolate,tomato sauce,nutmeg,wine
title: Rye's Chocolate Lentil Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces french baguettes | 1 cup brown lentils | 1 onion ( finely chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce | 1/2 cup dark chocolate | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice the french or baguette and place on a baking sheet. Brown the lentils and onion in the tomato sauce with the chocolate,. Then place half of the lentil mixture in the crock of a 8x8 inch oven safe dish. Add the remaining lentil mixture. Top with remaining bread slices then cover with foil. Bake for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,brown rice,garlic salt,coconut pecan frosting,yogurt,catsup
title: Coconut Nuts Barbecue Beef Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup toasted coconut pecan frosting
instructions: Prepare grill or preheat broiler. Cook rice according to package directions. Slice beef into 1/2 in wide strips. Combine beef, catsup, yogurt, garlic salt and coconut pecan frosting in a 9 x 13 glass baking dish. Top with beef.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,mango powder,baking potato,white wine,beef chuck,beef shank,tandoori paste,kidney bean
title: Crock Pot Tangy Red Beans and Beef Shanks
ingredients: 4 lbs beef chuck | 2 -3 tablespoons tandoori paste | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut in half | 1 lb beef shank, trimmed and cut in 1/2 | 1 1/2 cups white wine | 1/2 cup dry mango powder | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Place beans in crock pot, making sure you have plenty of the liquid. Slice beef. Rub spice mix into beef and season with salt and pepper. Place the potato halves on top of the beef. Place the beef shank on top of the meat. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: hickory smoke barbeque sauce,baby spinach,wide rice noodle,chicken breast,bok choy,broccoli floret,spring onion
title: Sizzlin' Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked wide rice noodles, such as jasmine | 3 cups chicken breasts, cooked and shredded ( or 2 cups chicken thighs, cooked and sliced diagonally ) | 8 cups baby spinach, stems removed | 1/2 cup broccoli floret, sliced to 1/8 inch ( and stems cut off ) | 3/4 cup bok choy, sliced | 2 tablespoons spring onions, cut up | 1/4 cup hickory smoke flavored barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil or 1/4 cup regular basil
instructions: In 12x14 baking dish, combine noodle ingredients.

title: Indian Spicy Quinoa (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( raw, uncooked ) | 11/8 cup red wine vinegar | 5 green cardamom pods
instructions: Rinse and drain the quinoa in a fine mesh sieve and place in the strainer. Place a heavy saucepan on the stove and add water to cover the bottom. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat. When the water is bubbling, add 1 teaspoon of salt. Meanwhile, prepare the quinoa. Combine the vinegar and water in a small bowl and set aside. When the quinoa has turned a golden color and begun to stick to the bottom of the saucepan, add the cardamom pods, a few pods at a time. Let the pods cook for 1 minute, then flip them over with a slotted spoon and let them cook until they begin to open. Drain the quinoa in a fine mesh strainer. Place the quinoa in a serving bowl or rice dish, cover with the red wine vinegar mixture and toss to coat.

title: Spicy Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb beef, sliced into thin 1/4 '' strips | 1/2 cup onion soup mix ( i use low-sodium ) | 1 bottle heinz italian salad dressing ( not prepared ) | 1 medium baking apple ( i used golden delicious ) | 1 1/2 lbs cheddar cheese ( shredded ) or 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup brandy ( optional garnish )
instructions: Brown beef with onion soup mix. Place beef and 1/2 bottle of the italian dressing on a piece of waxed paper then place in a hot skillet with one half cup of water. Simmer 5 minutes then sprinkle 1 1/2 cups of the cheese on beef. Top with remaining cheese & hot sauce. Slice the remaining apple into thin wedges, and arrange on top of the cheddar. Serve with additional italian dressing, if desired.

title: Homemade Coating
ingredients: 1 chicken ( cut up, not cleaned ) | 1 2/3 cups white flour | 3 cups white flour
instructions: Put chicken, water and flour in a medium bowl and mix by hand. Put into the fridge till ready to cook. Cook chicken on rotels on stove on the low setting till golden brown. Cut up chicken to make gravy.

title: Krakas Untimate Feta
ingredients: 500 -600 g boneless pork loin | 1 onion, chopped | 100 g krakas | 1 turnip, chopped | 100 g pitted olives, chopped | 100 g dried sweet peas ( kalamata, kalamata or similar ) | 100 g raisins ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups broth | 1/3 cup olive, coarsely chopped ( kalamata or similar ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta
instructions: Cut your pork into very thin strips, then slice across the grain about 1/4 on a diagonal. Season all sides with salt and pepper and marinate a few hours or overnight. Place your khobz on baking paper and pat it generously to cover your krakas. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat, add the pork and stir for an hour or until meat is white and lightly browned. If you need to use kraas in broth, you can buy them at the grocer. The amount of kraas in broth depends upon the type of meat, the kind of meat used and what type of veggie you have available. Turn your burner to a medium heat if you need more liquid. The krakas will cook on both sides. For kraas in broth, cook your peas and raisins in your broth. Stir until just warmed and the peas are cooked. Pour the broth on top. Cover again and cook in a lower heat for 15 minutes, or longer if your pan gets dry. You will need to stir the whole time. When the krakas are done, remove them from the heat. Spread the khobz on a small, buttered baking sheet. Sprinkle the feta and olive over the top. Bake in a 500 500f degrees oven for 5 minutes or until the feta is slightly golden around the edges. Then just eat while still warm, no pain.

title: Artichokes and Prosciutto
ingredients: 3 artichoke hearts | 4 slices thin prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove any tough choke from the artichokes. Lay out 2 slices of prosciutto on a work surface and spread them out with a knife. Sprinkle the artichokes with some of the prosciutto. Place the remaining prosciutto cheese on top on top of the artichokes, then drizzle the artichokes with a little more of the liquid. The artichokes will be slightly undercooked on the outside and they may be easier to handle once you are through. Place into the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese is browned.

title: Lighter Spinach Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach or 1 bunch spinach | 4 chinese cloves | 1 1/2 ounces rice noodles | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Wash the spinach and tear as much as possible off the stems. Separate it and cut off large stems too. Slice off the stem to expose about 1 1/2 3/4 leaves. Cut 1 kaffir lime leaf into very thin slices. Wash and drain the spinach. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the rice noodles and boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain the noodles in a fine mesh strainer and rinse them in cold water until the water runs clear. If the noodles are hot, stir them gently as they cook. Remove from the heat and drain the noodles. Place the spinach in a large salad bowl. Break the kaffir lime leaves by holding them with 2 or 3 fingers and crushing them with the back of a broad bladed knife. Toss well with the noodles and spinach. Add the chinese leaves, if using. Sprinkle the kaffir leaf mixture over the top. Chill in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,french bread,pesto sauce,marjoram,wheat bread,chicken stock cube,parmesan cheese,cilantro leaf
title: Cheese & Parmesan Bread Pudding in Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried marjoram | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup chicken stock cube | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons whole wheat bread, crumbs, unseasoned | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1 loaf crusty french bread | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, a toasted slice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. In a bowl combine the marjoram, pesto sauce, stock and parmesan to make the sauce. Taste and adjust seasoning. In a 3l baking dish, combine the bread, cilantro, bread, parmesan, 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture and then top with the rest of the bread. Bake, uncovered for 15 minutes or until the top is golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Cheese Tortellini With Tortellini and Sauce

instructions: Prepare cheese tortellini according to package directions and drain. Cook tortellini according to package directions until they are al dente. Drain. Meanwhile cook tortellini according to package directions and drain. Cook in medium saucepan of salted boiling water for 3 minutes and drain. To serve, place tortellini on serving platter then add cheese flavored tortellini. Sprinkle with white pepper and serve.

instructions: Coarsely dice clementines, place them in a saucepan. Add tomato juice, maple syrup, and bouillon.
