instructions: Place cream cheese into a mixing bowl and add the vegetables and herbs and mix. Add 1 table spoon of lemon juice, or more according to taste if it tastes too sour. Season with black pepper and freshly ground black bean, as desired.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,green pepper,plain yogurt,lemon zest
title: Beef on a Stick (Swiss Rouladen)
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1-2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 -2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 - 1 green pepper, cut into 1 inch squares
instructions: Heat olive oil in skillet over med heat. Place beef cubes in skillet. Brown on all sides. Remove beef and set aside. Place onions, green peppers and lemon zest in same skillet. Saute over med low heat until vegetables start to soften. Add yogurt and pepper and simmer 3 to 5 minutes. You may need to add another 1/4 cup of water as the sauce thicken so no liquid escapes. Taste the sauce. If it needs a little sourness, add a little water and simmer for another 2 to 3 minutes. Remove meat and vegetables from skillet. Place meat back in skillet. Simmer another 1 - 2 minutes uncovered.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,sauce,white onion,baby spinach,basil,tofu,sharp cheddar cheese,season italian dressing
title: Tofu Florentine
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained, cubed | 1 1/2 cups chopped white onions ( about 4 medium ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh basil | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1/2 cup hp steak sauce ( or more according to your taste ) | 1 bag baby spinach | season italian dressing, as needed | shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Place the tofu cubes and onions in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the tofu and onions are very tender. Transfer the contents of the skillet to a bowl. Add the basil and walnuts, mix well and set aside. Spray the inside of a 9 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray and preheat oven to 450°f. In the bowl of a food processor, blend the hp sauce with the spinach, dressing and tofu until well mixed. Add the spinach mixture to the tofu with the onions and nuts. Transfer mixture into the pan and bake for 15 minutes. Sprinkle top with cheddar and return to oven for another 5 minutes.

title: Festa (Festa de Frutta) Alla Fremont
ingredients: 3 lbs yucca root or 3 lbs rutabagas | 2 bottles german beer | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 tablespoon italian parsley ( finely chopped )
instructions: Peel and coarsely grate the rutabaga into a large mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly until combined. Divide the gfassagmu into six portions and shape each into ball. Transfer to the panchor with stones or wood skewers, leaving a little bit of the fat on the top. Grill sausages on a hot grill. Turn frequently.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,chicken thigh,monterey jack cheese,green pepper
title: Spanish Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs, skin on | salt and pepper | 2 -4 medium green peppers ( red and or or or red, cut in wedges ) ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. In a deep casserole dish, spray with non stick cooking spray. Place thighs, skin side down on casserole dish. Salt and pepper the chicken. Sprinkle with green peppers and/or salt, if desired. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake for about 30 mins or until cheese is melted and browned. Serve with rice or tortillas.

title: Spanish Rice With Pork
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, cut into 8 thin slices | 1 cup quinoa, long-grain | 3/4 cup tamari or 3/4 cup soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups chili sauce | 1/2 cup tomato chutney | 3 -4 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Soak quinoa in cold water for 15 - 20 minutes or according to package directions. Place pork in large saucepan with 1/2 of tamari or soy sauce, and 1/2 of chili sauce. Cover and set over medium low heat. Cook for 4 hours or until meat is tender. Remove from heat.

title: Jicama Sticks
ingredients: 1 cup jicama | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Bake jicama sticks at 350 degrees fahrenheit for about 8 minutes. Remove, and allow to cool off. Coat jicama sticks with cheddar cheese and return to oven until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,sauce,red pepper flake,chicken stock,ranch salad dressing,beef tenderloin,vegetable
title: Pepper Steaks With Corned Beef-Stuffed Beef
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, flatiron preferred, trimmed | vegetable oil, for brushing | 1 can corned beef brisket, drained | 1 can corned beef mixed vegetables, drained ( drained ) | 1/3 cup hot sauce | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon ranch salad dressing
instructions: Cut beef tenderloin crosswise into 8 slices. Brush with vegetable oil. Place one fourth of beef between 2 sheets wax paper.

title: Beef Fajitas(Or Turkey) With Dates, Ham, and Pumpkin Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 1 small croissant, cut in half | 2 -4 tablespoons catsup | 1 small cooked hamburger ( or turkey liver ) | 1/4 cup canned kidney beans or 1/4 cup chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 small kielbasa, sliced | 1 cup shredded cooked pumpkin ( or other winter squash ) | 1 ripe romaine lettuce | 8 slices dates, with caraway seeds or 2 -4 teaspoons crushed dried dates
instructions: Cut croissant into 6 even wedges. Spread each wedge with catsup. Put a slice of ham/liver on bottom half of croissant. Next top with beans, and then the kielbasa with a few slices of pumpkin. Cover with lettuce, and top with remaining croissant triangles. Fold the top halves of croissant over the top and bottom, and place under the broiler until bubbly. Serve with your favorite greek salad. Serve with garlic bread.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil vegetable,lasagna noodle,red chili pepper,chicken bouillon cube,black peppercorn
title: Quick & Easy Sesame Chicken Lasagna
ingredients: 4 teaspoons sesame oil or 4 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon ground black peppercorn | 1 small red chili pepper, finely chopped | 400 g sliced lasagna noodles or 400 g prepared savoy cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Spray a nonstick frying pan with oil and set over a medium low heat. When hot add your bouillon cubes. Simmer for a few minutes or until they dissolve slightly, then add the peppers. Turn up the heat, add the chicken stock, lower the heat slightly and bring to the boil. While the soup is heating, dry the noodles in a strainer and drain. Put a layer of noodles in a large square or oval oven dish, then pour over the soup. Top with a layer of sauce and a sprinkling of sesame oil. Cover with a clean tea towel to keep the noodles moist. Place in the oven, and cook 15 to 25minutes until the noodles are tender and soup is bubbling. Serve with sour cream and freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Danish Pastry
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self raising flour ( if not gluten free, sift the flour over and fold in ) | 1 large rhodes dinner roll, thawed
instructions: In a mixing bowl add flour and mix until well blended. Turn out onto floured board and knead into a smooth ball. Dough will be crumbly, but it will turn out. On lightly floured board spread dough out into a rectangle on a greased cookie sheet about 1 and 1/2 inches thick. Cut in half if desired so that you create two large rectangles that will fit into a 9x9 inch pan. Roll out between two sheets of wax paper into a rectangle of about 1 and 1/2 inches in diameter. Prick all over with a fork. Place in preheated 450 degree oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Lis' Hungarian Stuffing
ingredients: 2 quarts fresh broccoli florets | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 jar pimientos, sliced | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup chopped dill pickle | 1/3 cup beer
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the chopped vegetables with the bread crumbs, pickle, and beer. Season with salt and pepper. Use to stuff chicken, pork or beef.

title: Korean Rice (Pokkunbap)
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rice | 3/4 cup orange blossom water ( yellow, not lemon ) | 2 1/4 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons orange blossom water or 2 -3 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Put all ingredients in the rice cooker. Close lid and set to white rice cycle. When cycle begins remove lid and fluff grains with fork.

title: Super Easy Seafood Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 serrano pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons fermented oyster sauce
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the mayonnaise, cornstarch, and minced serrano pepper for a dip. Add the oyster sauce and mix well. Serve with bread sticks.

title: Macaroon Beef Risotto
ingredients: 3 macaroons | 12 ounces beef gravy | 1 tablespoon pine nuts or 1 tablespoon chopped sunflower nuts | 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed and coarsely torn | 500 ml iceberg lettuce, washed and torn | wooden skewer
instructions: Rinse macaroon and slice 1in thick into discs. Place the macaroons and beef gravy in a pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 45 seconds. Place the macaroon disks onto the hot broth and bring back to the boil. Remove from heat. Place the iceberg lettuce, 1nch lengths, on a large serving platter. Spoon the beef ragout over the greens.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,kosher salt,italian breadcrumb,crescent dinner,dark soy sauce
title: Japanese Onion Rolls
ingredients: 12 italian rolls | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon grated kosher salt | 1 teaspoon vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Take italian rolls out of its wrapper packaging, and lightly coat with the soy sauce and salt. Take the rolls apart and roll up into a 1 1/2 inch sausage roll. Place rolls in a 9 x 13 baking pan and repeat until all the rolls are rolled. Mix bread crumbs, remaining soy, salt and vinegar in a shallow dish. Bake rolls for 15 minute remove and drain excess grease. Serve with dipping sauce, dipping sauce, etc.

title: Korean Spiced Broth
ingredients: 3 cans broth ( two soup cans ) or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) cans broth ( two soup cans ) | 1 inch piece gingerroot, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Pour the broth into a pot large enough to hold the broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer over moderate heat for 3 minutes. Add the ginger and cook 30 seconds, then add the ginger to the broth. Cook the broth uncovered for 10 minutes. Remove the ginger and discard. Using a slotted spoon, lower the broth into the broths and simmer for 25 minutes, or until the broth is very thick. If the broth reduces too much, skim as needed. Discard the ginger.

title: Texas Style Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 can tomato sauce | 24 ounces cocktail, chilled
instructions: Put tomato sauce in a small freezer safe freezer bag. Place over night air in bag and seal. Keep refrigerated for 6 - 6 hours. Shake bag every so often. Remove air from bag.

title: Hummus (From Middle East Market)
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm tahini or 1/2 cup olive oil | 1/2 cup smooth untoasted tahini, plus, 1 tablespoon, for topping | fresh parsley ( garnish ) ( optional ) | fat, for the sandwich ( optional )
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm tahini in a small bowl and whisk until smooth. If the yeast is looking to dark, cover with plastic wrap and set in warm spot to proof. Warm oil over low heat until hot but not smoking. Whisk in yeast mixture and beat vigorously until it begins to foam. Turn heat up to medium high and bring to a simmer. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let rise, stirring often, until it has doubled in bulk, about 1 1/2 hours. Pour hot tahini in a thin, spreadable tubular or parchment paper or a clean coffee towel lined baking tray and place in the oven at its lowest temperature. Smash down the dough and sprinkle on any or all of the optional ingredients, and top with remaining tahini. Return to oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until browned and bubbly. Remove bowl, but do not remove cheesecloth from bread. Cool on a wire rack.

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the drained bulgur, ice water, kidney beans, watermelon, oregano, garlic salt, orange zest and cloves and season to taste with more garlic salt and salt. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

Bake in a preheated oven at 190° c/375°f for 20 minutes, covered with a cloth, for about 25 minutes. Remove, uncover and let stand for an hour before slicing.

title: Beer Beef Bake

instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Place beef, beef, chard, beer, onion, and penne in a large pot. Spoon vegetables over beef mixture. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven until vegetables and beef are tender, about 2 1/2 hours.

instructions: Place the chorizo into a skillet over medium heat, and add water to cover. Bring to a simmer, then stir in the chorizo, roasts, salsa, chili powder, turmeric, and baking powder. instructions: Spread desired amount of pizza spice mix on prepared crust. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Slash tops to create an indention on edge of dough.

title: Safflower Oil (Saffron ) for Salad

instructions: Combine 1/3 cup safflower oil with 6 lettuce leaves and mix well. Add more oil if needed.

title: Herby Sausages

instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degrees celcius. Mix flour, bran and parsley. Sift over salad greens, potato, salad mix and noodles and mix lightly. Add a little more oil and oil a few at a time. Form sausage and fry until cooked all the way through. Serve with salad.

title: Slow Cooker Gluten-Free, Low Fat, Low Carb, Beef Gravy

instructions: Brown beef in hot shortening or margarine in dutch oven or large skillet. Pour off grease. Add pesto sauce, tomato paste, sundried tomatoes, water and brown sugar. Stir thoroughly. If using other ingredients, add now or just before serving if using from slow cooker. Cook on low 7 to 9 hours.. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,strawberry,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cocktail frank,dark chocolate,bulgar wheat,black olive
title: Chocolate Steamed Easter Eggs
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups bulgar wheat, ground fine | 2 ounces medium grain dark chocolate | 1/2 cup cocktail franks, sliced about 1/2-inch thick | 1/2 cup black olives, pitted, sliced | 1/2 cup strawberry, sliced | 1/2 cup fresh black eye peas | 12 medium eggs | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, fresh grated for grating
instructions: In a large bowl combine the bulgar, bittersweet chocolate and franks. Add the olives and strawberries and mix well. Break the eggs into a bowl of cold water in a slow, thin stream and bring them to a boil. Boil gently until the whites are set. Remove the whites with a slotted spoon and set aside. Melt the cheese over low heat, stir constantly, then let it cool. When the whites are cool, spoon them into a large buttered metal or glass bowl. Grate the cheese over the whites and then fold it in with a rubber spatula. Set aside for 30 minutes at room temperature or until the chocolate has set and is easy to handle. Place a steamer or a large saucepan over medium heat. Fill with hot water, bring to a boil, then immediately add the bulgar mixture and cook until absorbed. Do not allow the bulgar to dry completely. Drain thoroughly. When the bulgar mixture is set, break it into little balls and toss them into the pot of melted cheese. Continue to stir the cheese so that it does not stick, or over heat, while stirring continuously and repeatedly until all the cheese has melted and mixed with the bulgar and eggs. Keep the pot under the broiler for a few moments only so the edges of the eggs will set and the egg won't overcook. Pile the eggs onto a warmed platter and sprinkle the grated cheese over them. Lift the platter up, invert it onto wax paper, and continue making and removing the eggs. When all the eggs are in the pot, reheat the remaining eggs over medium heat. When the whites are set, remove the bowl, then place each egg on its side in the center of a small bowl and put a thin slice of the white in the centre of the egg and then drag this slice back over the white into the bowl. Place the bowl in a serving dish or on a platter or decorative serving plates. The yolks may be eaten hot, as well as slightly warm, or cooled, as an appetizer..

ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 bottle kalamata olive | 1 can condensed chicken soup base | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1 cup applesauce | 3/4 - 1 cup rolled oats | 1/4 - 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a 2 quart casserole dish. Place beef in a large bowl with the olives, soup, cream, ketchup and applesauce. Spread in baking dish and sprinkle with rolled oats. Sprinkle with swiss cheese. Bake in oven for 45 minutes until hot and bubbly.

title: Italian Seasoning Bisk

instructions: Combine onion powder, parsley, salt, and pepper in an airtight container. Close lid securely, and shake until salt is evenly distributed. Store in an airtight container.

title: Spaghetti - Spaghetti Algerique
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti sauce, medium sized | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 -4 ounces spaghetti sauce, sweet ( or use any brand you like ) | 1 tablespoon mango chutney ( i use homemade sweet and spicy, but if you prefer to omit the chutney, you can use another brand of sweet chutney ) | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water according to directions on the spaghetti package. Drain water and rinse thoroughly with cold water. In a medium sauce pan, heat up your favorite sweet and spicy sauce over a medium heat, stirring frequently until warmed. Turn off the heat. Add the spaghetti to the sweet and spicy sauce, and stir well. Add the sesame seeds, stirring well. Serve immediately.

title: The Big Beef Burger
ingredients: 600 g lean ground beef ( lean, lean rump ) | 100 g ciabatta | 80 ml single cream | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 teaspoon dried chives | 1 tablespoon ice water | coriander and chives, to garnish | 3 peaches, sliced, to garnish
instructions: Preheat the grill on high. Combine the beef, breadcrumbs, cream, chili flakes and chives in a large bowl. Divide the mixture into four, shaping each into a patty. instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the quinoa, chicken, rotel tomatoes, tomatillos, parsley and anise seed.

title: Apple-Ziti Salad With Chili Dressing
ingredients: 4 cups sliced ziti pasta, cooked, drained & rinsed | 6 cups thinly sliced apples ( i used granny smith apples ) | 6 cups torn figs ( i used fresh figs for this recipe... but you can use any fresh fig you like ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( more or less to taste, i use mexican ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( more or less to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( more or less to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( more or less, i use mexican ) | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup hellmann's mayonnaise | 1/3 cup light cornmeal
instructions: Note, you can substitute white mayo or cream of wheat as needed with reduced fat mayo.

title: Grilled Ham Roasted In New York Style
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs ham | 1/2 teaspoon morton lite salt
instructions: Place a sheet of heavy duty foil on the rack of your gas burner or on the rack. Place several layers of aluminum foil, starting with a very high layer of flour. Slide the ham through the foil and over the rack. Sprinkle with the morton lite salt. Wrap the entire rack with some heavy duty kitchen twine. Wrap well and tie securely. Place on your gas burner or rack in a large, heavy baking pan. When ready to cook, place your rack of ham with the fat side down on the rack, not touching. On my gas burner or rack this is about 8 degrees f and it stays light and warm. Set the ham into the hot grill. Close the lid and cook for 2 hours 20 minutes. At the end of 2 hours. Remove the foil and increase your heat to 400 degrees. Check with a knife. If the ham is done.

title: Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 pounds kielbasa sausage, sliced into 1/2 inch slicesagainst the grain | 6 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 package frozen chopped frozen chopped onions | 1 package frozen chopped edam cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place the kielbasa slices in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until browned and crumbly, about 7 minutes. Stir the flour into the kielbasa, and cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown and slightly crisp, 2 to 4 minutes. Mix in the onions, and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Transfer the sausage mixture into a bowl, and top with the kielbasa mixture. Cut several slits in the cheese to allow steam to escape. Bake in the preheated oven until evenly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla yogurt,vinegar,bay leaf,chili garlic sauce,wheat pita bread,pesto sauce,lime juice,herb
title: Pesto Garlic Naan
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat pita bread, cut in half | 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped | 3/4 cup fresh lime juice, divided | 1/4 cup vanilla yogurt | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 3/4 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the vinegar in a bowl and stir to combine. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat the skillet over medium high heat until it shimmers. Add the drained bread and stir to coat. Add the pesto and chile garlic sauce. Stir to coat bread. Transfer to a baking sheet and bake at 400°f uncovered for 15 minutes. Drizzle with the vinegar.

title: Farfalle With Crispy Apple and Sultana
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 1 tart apple | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( golden raisins ) | 1 tablespoon cashews | 2 tablespoons hot chili sauce | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Boil rapidly the pasta until al dente. In a large saucepan, mix up 2 tbsp butter with 2 tbsp flour. Saute the apple and raisins till golden, add to the warm farfalle and cashews. Stir in the chilli sauce. Pour over half a cup hot water, mix well and cook over low heat for about 5 - 10 minutes till sauce reduces and pasta is coated with this wonderful sauce.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,thyme leaf,green creme de menthe,pineapple chunk
title: Minty Pineapple Daiquiri
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh green creme de menthe | 8 ounces fresh pineapple chunks, drained | 1 sprig fresh thyme leaves | 1 sprig fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: Preheat oven's broiler. In a medium bowl, stir together the creme de menthe, pineapple, thyme, and rosemary. Place the dish on a baking sheet, and broil until the top is lightly toasted, about 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: currant,orange blossom water,no salt tomato sauce
title: Low-Fat No Salt Tomato Sauce (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 lb no-salt-added tomato sauce ( or homemade ) | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water
instructions: In a 2 to 1 quart nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray cook the tomato sauce over medium high heat 8 - 10 minutes, until thickened and bubbling. Reduce heat to low uncovered, stir in currants and orange blossom water. Cover and cook until sauce mixture is hot, about 5 minutes.

title: Kielbasa and Baked Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 pound kielbasa | 2 pounds chopped beef roast | 2 cans chicken drumsticks | 1/4 cup grated romaine's cinnamool | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 green cardamom pods, or as desired - divided | 4 cups packed fresh arugula | 8 rolls, cut in half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the kielbasa, beef, chicken drumsticks, romano's cinnamool, cinnamon, and green cardamom pods in a 9x13 inch baking dish with enough water to cover. Cover, and bake for 90 minutes in the preheated oven. Uncover, and cook for an additional 60 minutes. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool. Remove from the baking dish, and sprinkle with the arugula. Wrap each half with a roll half, and place in a sandwich box. Serve with crusty french bread.

title: Coconut Corn on the cob
ingredients: 1 can ear sweet corn, drained | 1 can coconut, drained | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 radish, sliced
instructions: Pour the coconut and ear corn into a microwave safe bowl. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and heat in the microwave on high power about 20 seconds or until heated through. Stir in the pudding mix according to package directions. Spoon popcorn into individual bowls and garnish with radish slices.

title: Mexican Meat Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 lb salt pork, diced very small | 1 small red onion, diced small
instructions: Put all ingredients in a slow cooker cover and simmer on high for 2 hrs or low for 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: demerara sugar,colby monterey jack cheese,poblano chile,cooking oil,pepper flake
title: Mexican Party Appetizer Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 3 poblano chiles, stems removed, seeded ( about 1/3 pound ) | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon demerara sugar
instructions: Heat 1tbsp oil in a skillet over moderately high heat. Add poblanos.

title: Soy Glaze for Dipping Sauces and Vegetables
ingredients: 250 ml soy milk, canned | 1 tablespoon rose water or 1 tablespoon dried rose petals | 60 g bamboo shoots, drained and halved widthways | 3 tablespoons pineapples, cut into small chunks and fresh ( optional )
instructions: Combine soy milk, rose water, bamboo, pistyrex peas and pineapple in a large shallow bowl and mix well. Chill for one hour to develop the flavours, and then serve.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,kosher salt,serrano chilies,beef gravy,dill weed
title: Rimfire Savory Chile Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups sour beef gravy | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 can whole canned cormick beef gravy | 3 -4 serrano chilies ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,coriander leaf,baking powder,asparagus,veal cutlet,juniper berry,tomato green chilies,french bread
title: Veal Chops With Tomato-Wine Pan-Simmered Basquaise
ingredients: 4 ounces veal cutlets | 2 medium tomatoes and green chilies, sliced | 4 slices french bread, thick | 4 -6 fresh asparagus | 1/8 teaspoon fresh ground juniper berries | 1/8 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup coriander leaves, chopped ( optional, i use it ) | 3 tablespoons canned sliced jamon berry ( optional )
instructions: Grill veal, then slice into 1/2 slices, set aside. Remove crusts from bread and tear into pieces. Cut up tomatoes and chilies. Cut asparagus into 2 segments, and slice into 3 pieces. Heat pan over high heat. Combine spices and bread, add asparagus and tomatoes, fry 3 - 4 minutes on each side. Serve topped with sauteed peppers and greens if desired.

title: Lentil & Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 medium mango | 200 g brown lentils, rinsed | 450 g small shell pasta
instructions: Peel mango and cut the flesh into bite sized pieces. Chop into a fine dice. Toss into a large bowl with the lentils. Pour over icecream and stir through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,spinach leaf,tilapia fillet,ginger paste,rice noodle,raisin
title: Fried Beef Noodle Wraps
ingredients: 3 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 3 tablespoons raisins | 1/4 cup shredded cooked tilapia fillets | 12 flour tortillas | 1 package rice noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix ginger paste, spinach, raisins, and tilapia in large bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Spoon about 1/3 cup filling into tortillas.

title: Halloumi and Vodka in Spinach
ingredients: 1/4 lb halloumi cheese, in 1/4 in cubes, 1/16 in thick | 4 ounces frozen spinach, thawed, drained, and chopped | 4 ounces vodka | 5 -6 green cardamom pods, split lengthwise
instructions: Fold the cheese into 1/4 thick cubes and shake off any excess moisture. Heat a deep 12 inch sauté pan over medium low heat. Add 1 tbsp olive oil, then the drained spinach and rabe and sauté over low heat until it wilts, about 10 min, flipping once. Add the vodka, cardamom pods, and 1/4 cup water to the saucepan, and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 min or until hot. Stir in the cheese and cook until just melted, 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,green cardamom pod,chicken stock salt
title: Picante Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups picante sauce ( store bought or home made ) | 1 green cardamom pod | 1 1/2 cups water | 3 -4 cups chicken stock ( can add more or less to taste )
instructions: Place cardamon pods in a saucepan with about 1 - 2 cups water. Bring to a boil and boil for one minute. Then stir in picante and bring to a boil again. Strain the oil out of the saucepan and return the saucepan to medium high heat. Add 2 cups of broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil. Stainr over medium heat and simmer until liquid thickens slightly. Strain and cool slightly. Add picante mixture to food processor or blender and blend until slightly smooth. Strain mixture into a bowl and stir in remaining broth.

title: Feta Cheese With Amaretto and Feta
ingredients: 1/4 cup feta cheese ( crumbled ) | 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Whisk the feta cheese, amaretto and sesame oil in a small bowl with a fork. Drizzle feta mixture onto a preheated large baking sheet, spreading so it is a little thicker around the edge and slightly thicker around the edge. Sprinkle generously with the pinch of salt and bake in a preheated 300f oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until the top turns golden brown.

title: Raspberry & Pisco Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh raspberries, halved | 1/2 lb jicama, peeled and diced | 1/2 lb jicama, peeled and diced ( may use baby greens ) | 1/2 red curry paste | 1/2 cup diced tomato | 1/2 green pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons pisco or 2 tablespoons other orange flavored liqueur
instructions: In a small bowl, toss the raspberries with the 1/2 lb. Jicama. Place in a glass bowl & toss with the red curry paste, diced tomatoes, green peppers & pisco or orange flavored liqueur. Cover & chill. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Scottish  Curried Salmon
ingredients: 1 kg coarsely chopped fatty salmon roe | 1 kg finely diced meat | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 whole allspice berries ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried currants or 1 tablespoon dried sultanas, soaked for 15 minutes and drained
instructions: Place salmon roe in a bowl. Add allspice and currants mixed with 1 tbsp water, to taste. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes at least, but no longer than overnight. Drain. Place vegetables in an ovenproof dish. Cover and cook in a preheated oven for 10 minutes at 180 grades c. When cooked through, take out of the oven and let cool. Remove the salmon from the refrigerator, place on warmed serving dish and garnish with the reserved currants.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,snow pea,anise seed,green olive,swiss chard,tart apple
title: Swiss Chard-Green Apple Galettes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mixed anise seeds | 5 stalks green chard | 4 tart apples | 1/4 lb swiss chard | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 lb dried snow peas | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400^f. Wash chard well and cut off top 1 to 1 1/2 inches of the leaves and cut the leaves crosswise into 1 1/2 inch thick slices. Place on an oiled baking sheet and toast in 400°f oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. Trim and discard stems from chard. Cut leaves in half crosswise and then into thirds lengthwise. Cut the chard leaves crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Combine chard leaves, apples, swiss chard, and 1 tablespoon of flour in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with beaters. Blend on low speed just until thoroughly combined. Transfer chard mixture to a medium bowl and stir in 1/4 cup of flour. Combine 1/4 teaspoon anise seed in a small bowl and place on top of chard mixture until well blended. Shape dough in half on floured surface and roll out until it is 1/4 inch thick. Spread half of chard mixture on each dough half, leaving an inch between mixture. Add about 1 1/2 tablespoon of chard filling along the lengthwise tips of the dough. Bring the two long sides together over the filling, making a semicircle. Tie the top 1/3 inch of dough loose at 1 inch intervals with kitchen twine. Cut the dough 1 - ½ inch wide. Arrange on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake in 400°f oven 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,leek,vermouth,hot water,pecorino romano cheese,dark soy sauce,balsamic vinegar
title: Sweet and Sour Strawberries
ingredients: 2 quarts fresh strawberries, hulled | 3 leeks, white part only trimmed, cut into 3/8-inch-thick slices | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon good-quality dry vermouth or 1 teaspoon white wine | 1/4 cup warm skim milk or 1/4 cup skim milk | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 cups freshly grated pecorino romano cheese or 2 cups pecorino romano cheese, more for passing at table
instructions: Place the strawberries, leeks and soy sauce in a large bowl and stir to coat. Let stand at room temperature at least 1 hour, stirring now and then. Bring 1 inch of water to a boil in a large pot. Reduce heat to medium low. Add vermouth. Stir to dissolve the cheese and keep warm. Pour hot water, milk and vinegar into the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade. Blend until smooth. Transfer strawberry mixture to bowl. Cover and refrigerate until slightly chilled, at least 30 minutes and up to 4 hours. Before serving, place the balsamic vinegar in a small dish. Sprinkle the cheese over the top. Toss gently and serve at once. Pass at once.

title: Codfish
ingredients: 2 lbs codfish | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Wash fish and pat dry. Place in a 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking dish or a roasting pan. In a bowl, mix orange juice and half of the orange juice. Pour mixture over fish. Cover and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested, basting once or twice with juices. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Spicy Florina Chips
ingredients: 1 large head lettuce leaf ( such as savoury bag, chicke ) | 2 drops vanilla essence
instructions: Using a kitchen scissors, cut the bottom corner off the chicke like you would cut your knife through a bag of broken grains. Place lettuce in a heat proof dish, pour over the flavouring, and press evenly to submerge. Heat in an area of a microwave on high setting for 7 minutes or until lightly charred, shaking the dish 2 or 3 times to ensure that the chips do not stick to the bottom. Allow to cool, then break into pieces.

title: Quick Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans ( with liquid ) | 1/2 cup madeira wine
instructions: First rinse and drain your beans and liquid. I usually leave them in the water overnight, then strain. Then just pour them out of a container and start using them.

title: Tex and Tasty Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain rice | 6 slices toasted bread | 3 tablespoons minced lime peel | 1/4 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Place the rice and 3 cups cold water in a small saucepan to cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and water has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain any excess water, fluff rice and slice bread. In a salad bowl, combine the lime peel and mayonnaise.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,shallot,cheese,baking powder,cooking spray,butter cracker,white pepper,pico de gallo
title: Cracker and Fish Fillets With Roasted Shallots
ingredients: 1 lb small fish fillet, such as halibut, cod or 1 lb sole, sliced crosswise into four slices | cooking spray | 1/2 cup grated cheese, divided | 1/4 cup pico de gallo, drained | 1/2 teaspoon chopped shallot ( about 2 large ) | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon baking powder | butter-flavored cracker
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange fish in 9x13 baking pan coated with cooking spray. Combine cheese, pico de gallo, shallot, pepper and baking powder in small bowl.

title: Herbs on the Cob
ingredients: 2 heads of cabbage | 1/2 cup milk | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon sage, ground
instructions: Cut off ends. Remove all outer leaves and the outer layer. Slice leaves in half lengthwise. Place half of the leaves on the skewers. Combine milk, herbs and sage. Pour over leaves and skewer them. Grill over low heat until steaming stops and cabbage starts to char.

title: Simple Onion Sambal
ingredients: 1 package onion sambal omani togarashi | 2 dashes turmeric powder
instructions: Heat oil on medium in wok or frying pan. Drop sambal togarashi into oil. Cook until brown. Put on plate and top with onion jam.

title: Cheesy Red Cabbage and Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, cored and quartered | 1 cup ricotta cheese, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread the cabbage quarters onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, 20 to 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,rice wine,cooking spray,green grape,dark rum
title: Beef and Grape Wrapped in Rum
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | cooking spray | 1/8 cup rice wine | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( i use jack daniels ) | 1/4 cup fresh green grapes, halved
instructions: Cut 1/8 of the beef lengthwise into 24 1/2 wide slices about 2 long. Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Place beef on pan and turn once, cooking and flipping beef halfway through. Remove beef from skillet and set aside. Repeat to cut remaining beef into 24 thin slices. Heat remaining fat in skillet over medium heat. Add rice wine and rum. Cook until mixture just begins to boil, stirring frequently. Stick beef slices with grape halves, then set aside. Bring to a simmer and cook until meat is warm, about 2 minutes. Turn and cook approximately 3 to 4 minutes longer. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,yellow pepper,tart apple,beef tenderloin,scallion,pesto sauce,rigatoni pasta
title: Apple-Pesto Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1/4 cup commercial pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed of visible fat and thinly sliced | 4 teaspoons prepared tapenade ( store bought or home-made ) | 1/2 cup yellow pepper, cored and sliced | 2 medium scallions, thinly sliced ( both green and white parts ) | 1 3/4 cups rigatoni pasta
instructions: Place beef between sheets of plastic wrap and pound until very thin. Spread pesto generously over top of beef and roll up tightly. Arrange in a shallow dish. To prepare tapenade, combine a saucepan of water, vinegar and peppers in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, cook for 2 to 5 minutes. Drain vegetables.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,red wine vinegar,chunky salsa,peanut,red curry paste,curd cottage cheese
title: Spicy and Delicious Red Curry Cottage Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 cups large curd cottage cheese | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted peanuts
instructions: Mix all items together and serve immediately. Serve with bread and/or indian flatbreads. Variation, make the dip thinner and add 1/4 c chicken stock. Makes enough to generously coat a crockpot. Variation, add 1/2 cup chicken stock to dry ingredients and pour into crockpot and cook in low for 1 - 2 hours or to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: salad green,german chocolate cake mix,salmon,macaroni,cumin powder,kidney bean
title: Salmon & Bean Muffins (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 1 box german chocolate cake mix | 180 g canned salmon, chopped | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 box macaroni, cooked | chili powder to taste | cumin powder to tast
instructions: Set oven to 325 degrees f. Prepare and cook german chocolate cake mix using directions on box, using 1/2 tin of water & 1/2 tin of beans. Add chopped salmon, kidney beans a bit of chili powder & cumin powder, mix thoroughly. In a large baking sheet place 1/2 tin of macaroni, mix thoroughly & place in oven. Mix cooked & drained can of kidney beans thoroughly, mix into the cheese mix & spread onto the first layer of the meringue, sprinkle more chili powder on top if desired. Make the second layer of macaroni & spoon on the salmon & bean mixture & sprinkle more chili powder if desired. Top with remaining shredded cheese.. Place on the middle rack of the oven & bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,caper,cumin seed,ritz cracker,pistachio,coconut milk,bok choy
title: Stacked Brunch Mushrooms With a Green Coconut Raita
ingredients: 500 g mixed mushrooms, cleaned | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 250 g bok choy, washed, ends trimmed, and cut into bite sized pieces | 2 tablespoons fresh coconut milk | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 3 dashes pistachios, crushed | 1 teaspoon capers
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 °c. Put the flour in a wide, wide skillet and put it on low heat. Wait for the flour to begin to turn colour. Add the mushrooms and sauté until golden. Add the bok choy and sauté for 2 - 3 minutes. Add 1/2 cup of coconut milk and heat over high. Add 1 teaspoon of cumin seeds to the mixture. Remove from heat. Allow to cool. In a small frying pan, put the pistachios. Put the coconut milk in the blender and process it to a smooth paste. Add the paste to the mushroom mix from the skillet and stir it continuously until all the liquid dries up. Add the remaining coconut milk and the capers, mix, and transfer the mixture into ritz crackers. Put into a greased oven dish, bake for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: stock,red chile pepper,kosher salt,currant,pecorino romano cheese,red cabbage,stout beer,ginger
title: Beer Cabbage
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1 teaspoon kosher salt, or more as needed | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 12 fluid ounces stout beer | 4 1/2 cups stock | 2 cloves roasted red chile pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Grind currants in a mortar or coffee grinder using a blade or pestle. Add salt, ginger, and stout and pulse until coarsely ground. Pour mixture into a heavy 2 quart enameled saucepan. Add red chile and cabbage, and stir to blend evenly to combine. Boil over medium heat, stirring frequently, until cabbage is just tender. Sprinkle with cheese and remove from heat. Serve warm.

title: Danish-Style Eggs
ingredients: 6 large hard-cooked eggs | 1/2 lb shredded provolone cheese | 3/4 lb thinly sliced smoked salmon | 1/2 lb thinly sliced mozzarella balls | white pepper
instructions: Peel eggs. Cut eggs lengthwise into halves. Remove the yolks. Put half of the onion slices in the bottom of a bowl with half of the provolone cheese. Place half the sliced smoked salmon on top of the cheese, then place 2 tablespoons of the egg white mixture over all. Top with the remaining provolone and place mozzarella balls on top. Season with white pepper. Heat nonstick skillet over high heat. Place 2 eggs on top of each other and cover with a lid to keep them warm. When eggs are puffed up, place other half of egg around them so that they cover the bottom of each slice of egg completely. Carefully slide a fork into each egg and, using a spatula to push the yolks through, cook until egg whites are done to your preference.

title: Crock Pot Spiced Bread Wedges
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 pinch coriander | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into crock pot.

title: Cacinjunney Fish
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless red snapper, cut into 2-inch x 2-inch strips | 1/2 cup rice or 1/2 cup arborio rice | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1 teaspoon cumin, ground | 1/4 cup cola | 6 maraschino cherries, in juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except cherry and fish in a large oven safe, glass or ceramic bowl. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, uncovered, reduce heat to low and simmer until the fish is just firm to touch, 25 to 60 minutes. Drain fish and keep warm. Boil cola until reduced slightly, about 10 minutes. Pour enough cola through a paper towel to remove the excess cola to make 3 tablespoons.

title: Coconut-French Bread Toast
ingredients: 2 loaves french bread | 1 cup shredded sweetened coconut
instructions: Remove crusts from loaves and cut french bread loaves in half crosswise or slightly smaller. Spray a 9x13 pan with pam. Using a sharp knife, cut a slit and insert a dollop of coconut into each half loaf and place in pan. Sprinkle with a little more shredded coconut. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 325 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes or until warm and bread is a little crispy on top.

title: Easy Kiwi and Okra Appetizer
ingredients: 1 fresh kiwi fruit, sliced ( no seeds ) | 12 okra, slices | 3 -4 large chunks kiwi fruit
instructions: Wash kiwifruit well, leave until they are just beginning to soften. Slice a few off kiwifruit and carefully remove peel and seed from one end. Slice the kiwifruit into thin rounds, and slice the okra into thin pieces. Alternate layers of okra, kiwifruit, and kiwifruit into a nice, snugly shaped mold. Top off with chunks of kiwifruit. Microwave on high for 2 minutes. The kiwifruit should still be a little soft, and the okra probably wasn't. The kiwifruit should be firm and releasing some juice. Turn off microwave. Leave in for 10 minutes, stir, then leave for another five or ten minutes to heat through and soften kiwifruit.. I usually leave this for an hour. The kiwifruit and okra should be soft again, and the juice should've been absorbed if not.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,lamb,rump roast,farfalle pasta,pork loin roast,vegetable shortening
title: Farfalle with Lamb and Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless lamb, cubed | 1 pound boneless pork loin roast | 1 1/2 pounds bone-in lamb | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 1/2 tablespoons all purpose greek seasoning or seasoning | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Rinse farfalle under cold water and place in a large pot. Cover and fill with 3 inches of water. Bring to a boil. While pasta cooks, tie meat with butcher's string. When pasta begins to boil, remove from heat and add shortening and greek seasoning.

title: Vietnamese Caramelized Cheese
ingredients: 2 ounces fresh gruyere cheese, grated ( or parmesan cheese ) | 1 ounce fish sauce
instructions: Place the gruyere or parmesan cheese in a mortar and pestle and pound until finely incorporated. Add more fish sauce if you like a thinner cheese. Mixture can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator after a few days for best flavor.

title: Namakano
ingredients: 3 lbs prawns, headless and shelled | 1/4 cup finely chopped shallot | 5 serrano peppers | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Shell prawns if necessary and discard tail and head. In a wide frying pan, warm 2 tablespoons of oil, add the prawn heads and brown on all sides. Remove from pan after 5 minutes and set aside. Add remaining oil to pan, add the shallots and peppers. Cook gently for 15 minutes stirring from time to time.

title: Real Hummus
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1/2 thai dried hot chile
instructions: Rinse and drain garbanzo beans. Place beans in bowl and mash with a fork, making sure to break up chunks. Stir in remaining ingredients. Use immediately or cover and store in the refrigerator. Makes 20 to 30 servings.

title: Korma
ingredients: 1 cup yoghurt | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Whisk yoghurt and red pepper together in a bowl. Serve plain or with pita.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,asafoetida powder,heavy whipping cream,chicken thigh,radish
title: Creamy Indian Corned Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 6 -8 large radishes, sliced thin, divided | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Dissolve yeast and asafoetida in the cream in a small bowl and set aside. Cut the radishes in half lengthwise and remove the ends. Layer 1/4 of the radishes into the pan of a food processor fitted with the metal blade with a metal blade. Add 1/2 c of the chicken broth and process until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed. Add the cream mixture and process until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed. Layer the remaining radishes, broth, etc in a large crock. Top with the final layer of sliced radishes. Cover and leave in a warm place for 30 minutes.. Remove chicken pieces, placing them on a plate and cover with a kitchen towel to keep warm. In the crock, place the remaining 1/4 c of broth and a little water. Set on high and bring the entire mixture to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and let simmer 5 minutes, then remove lid and cook 10 minutes more until the juices run clear. Remove lid and cook until sauce thickens a little, about 10 minutes more. Serve warm or cool, spooning hot broth over the chicken.

Random Ingredients: thyme,wheat pastry flour,active yeast,self rising flour,ricotta cheese
title: Caramelized Thyme Focaccia Bread
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 4 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 14 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Sprinkle bottom of a 2 cup fluted tube pan with flour. In a mixing bowl, combine the yeast and ricotta. Add thyme. Stir with a wooden spatula until well blended. Sift the flour all the while stirring so that all of the flour gets absorbed by the dry ingredients. Don't overmix. Spoon dough in fluted tube pan and allow to rise until half of the loaf appears dry. Place in middle of oven and bake for 20 minutes. After 15 minutes, lower heat to 350 degrees f and continue baking for an additional 40 to 50 minutes, or until bottom of bread sounds hollow when tapped. Cool on wire rack.

title: Cheese and Cherry Won Tons
ingredients: 32 wonton wrappers | 1 large head of cabbage, finely chopped | 1/2 small onion, finely chopped | 1 cup cherry, pitted and chopped | 1/2 cup pickled onions, finely chopped | 1 package provolone cheese, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a muffin tin with cooking spray. Place a wonton wrapper into the muffin tin. Spread approximately 1 tablespoon of cabbage, diced onions, cherries, chopped cheese and cajun seasoning into each won ton wrapper. Moisten the edges with the water and fold into squares. Bake in a preheated oven for about 25 minutes, or until tops are golden brown.

title: Quick  Guacamole
ingredients: 3 hass avocadoes ( peeled, seeded, and mashed together ) | 2 cups fresh baby spinach
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the avocados. Add a cup of baby spinach and stir to combine.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Compote
ingredients: 2 cups apple juice | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dry red pepper
instructions: Blend together apple juice, vinegar and red pepper in a bowl. If desired, leave in refrigerator 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,grand marnier,greek olive,beef consomme,corn kernel,extra virgin olive oil,nonfat plain yogurt,currant
title: Greek-Style Beef Roulades
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 8 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1 cup frozen corn kernels, thawed | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 1/3 cup currants or 1/3 cup raisins | 1/3 cup greek olives, finely chopped | 1 can nonfat plain yogurt | 1 can beef consomme, undiluted | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a large bowl, combine oil, ground beef, corn, chocolate, currants or raisins and olives. Stir to mix well, and divide among 16 ramekins. Bake for 30 minutes, or until heated through and golden brown. For the soup, stir yogurt with beef consume, and pour over ramekins. Serve immediately.

title: Taco Bell Grilled Squash
ingredients: 6 small yellow squash, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 3 tablespoons kahlua
instructions: Prepare grill. Cut squash in half lengthwise and discard top 1/2 inch of skin. Cut squash diagonally into 1/2 inch slices. Lightly oil grill grate. Spread squash evenly with creole seasoning. Place on the grill rack and cook, flipping halfway through, until tender. Sprinkle kahlua evenly over squash slices and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,lettuce,beef chuck,vanilla bean,mint leaf,wheat germ,soymilk
title: Savory Beef Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 2/3 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 tablespoon wheat germ | lettuce | mint leaf | 1 1 loaf french bibb
instructions: Combine the beef, soymilk, vanilla bean, and wheat germ in a small saucepan. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Let cool in liquid 30 minutes. Place beef in shallow salad bowl. Pour beef over the meat. If serving immediately, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: tea,sauerkraut,grainy mustard,lemon,wide egg noodle,prosciutto,garlic salt,kosher salt
title: St. Brenden's Traditional Irish Cabbage Kugel
ingredients: kosher salt | 1 package wide egg noodles | 1 lb sauerkraut | 3 slices thin prosciutto, each 3 1/2 to 4 inches long, cut into 6 wedges long enough to fit into a 10x15 inch baking dish | 12 cloves garlic salt | 1/2 medium lemon, zested and cut in half | 1 teaspoon grainy mustard | 1/4 cup coarse grainy mustard
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Salt the water and return to a boil. Add the noodles and cook until al dente, about 5 minutes. Drain the noodles, rinse with cool water and drain again. Lay out the noodles on a large serving platter and set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir the garlic salt, lemon zest, grainy mustard and shredded cinnimon into the oil and butter until combined. Layer the noodles in the skillet with the sauerkraut, prosciutto slices and garlic salt mixture. Drizzle with 3 tablespoons of the traditional irish mustard and toss to incorporate the flavors. Serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Ramen - Microwave
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon ground dried marjoram | 3 crushed ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Combine soy milk and soymilk in a microwave safe bowl. Cook on high until boiling, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in spaghetti sauce, then sprinkle with marjoram. Microwave 2 to 3 tablespoons in microwave until the sauce is hot.

title: Cardamom Cherry Bark
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh sour pitted sour cherries ( about 10 ) | 1 tablespoon whole cardamom seed
instructions: Wash and stems dry your cherry jars. Dry them thoroughly. If they are too old, the rims of the jars will crack and you can save on jam or flavor. Place the sour cherries in a large bowl, and add the cardamom seeds, pour enough boiling water into cover them by 1/2 inch or so. Cover the bowl with a moist cloth and leave for a few hours, or overnight, until they lose any of their green color and plump. Drain off excess water. Pack the sour cherry mixture into the prepared jelly jars, and process for 10 seconds on each side in a water bath or in an electric coffee grinder. Allow the jars to cool completely, then store in a cool dark place for up to one week. These will last up to 12 months. Makes about 1 large jar.

title: Polish Sausage (Aka Sausage Polish)
ingredients: 1 package pork sausage | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary ( crushed )
instructions: Brown sausage. Drain fat and return to sauce pot. Add rosemary and cook on low heat for 2 - 2 1/2 hours until sausage is done. Sausage can be frozen as directed above with the addition of the oil and cook all day.

title: Mushroom and Asparagus Turnip Saute
ingredients: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 3 ounces asparagus, trimmed | 1/4 cup turnip, diagonally sliced | 1 lime, cut in 4 wedges | 2 tablespoons fresh mint sprigs
instructions: Saute mushrooms and asparagus in 2 tspn olive oil for 3 minutes in 12 inch nonstick skillet. In 14 inch skillet, heat remaining 1 tspn olive oil over moderately high heat until just smoking. Add turnip, mushrooms and asparagus and saute until almost tender, about 6 minutes. Transfer skillet to a cutting board, sprinkle with salt. Cut in half crosswise.

title: Barley and Beef Brisket
ingredients: 7 -8 lbs beef brisket ( or shoulder ) | 3 ounces pearl barley
instructions: Make a quick brisket by trimming the fat from the brisket, as much fat as possible. Rinse and pat dry the briskitt with paper towels. Place the meat in a large roasting pan, fat side up, with the barley over it. Place in the pan with the fat on top of the brisket. Cover tightly and put in the oven at 325 degrees f. For 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,vinegar,milk chocolate,green olive,ginger powder,kosher salt pepper
title: Chocolate Salami (Or Elegant Sweet Pea Pea Dip)
ingredients: 1 whole green olive, roughly chopped | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup milk chocolate ( melted ) | salt and pepper, as needed | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( optional ) | pulphered ginger ale or sweetened condensed milk chocolate dipping sauce, warmed
instructions: Place first four ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. If the mixture seems too thick, thin it out with condensed milk or yogurt. Season with salt and pepper if necessary. Garnish with dried fresh ginger ale or sweetened condensed milk chocolate dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,tomato green pepper onion,rice vinegar,monterey jack cheese,sriracha sauce,brown sugar,fish stock
title: Spicy Rice Vinegar and Chipotle Sauce with Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile | 2 tablespoons unsalted fish stock, or chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 1/3 cup pickled chipotle chile ( with sauce ) | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup thinly sliced pickled chipotle chiles, plus 1 -2 teaspoons sauce, divided
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. In a small dry skillet, toast the dried chile, breaking into 1/4 inch pieces, over medium heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Let cool. Pour the fish broth and ground chipotle into a blender.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,cardamom,soda water,applesauce,adobo seasoning
title: Adobo Rub for Fish
ingredients: 1 cup kosher salt, divided | 1/3 cup salt | 1/3 cup ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, mix 1 cup of kosher salt with the black pepper and cardamom. In a microwave safe bowl, combine the adobo, applesauce and remaining 1/2 cup kosher salt. Cook on high for 3 minutes. Spoon into your favourite fish fillets, coating each fillet well.

title: Harmony Drumsticks
ingredients: 1 pound bulk italian sausage | 4 skinless, bone-in chicken drumsticks | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons dried mint, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange the chicken drumsticks in a roasting pan. Place sausage in a skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir until browned and crumbly, and no longer pink inside, about 10 minutes. Drain the sausage, reserving 1/2 cup of the drippings. Crumble sausage into a skillet, and stir until browned and crumbly. Mix in the horseradish. Mix in curry powder, mint, and chicken.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard,chili sauce,scotch bonnet pepper,dill,cream tartar,sesame oil
title: Baked Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dijon brown mustard | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon brown mustard | 1 teaspoon dill | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Combine the rest of the ingredients except for pepper in a small saucepan. Simmer for a couple of minutes over a medium heat until the sauce thickens and the mustard melts. Cool to room termperature. Place the peppers in a baking dish large enough to hold all the ingredients in one layer, cover and refrigerate. When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 375°f. Remove the peppers from the pan and sprinkle with pepper. Roast for about 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pepper and pepper have a light, crisp char. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with more pepper. Serve with warm rolls.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,puff pastry,tabasco sauce,pineapple tidbit,orange juice,romaine lettuce leaf,salmon
title: Tropical Salmon Appetizer(Or Fried Tofu) for Two!
ingredients: 1 lb salmon, cleaned, patted dry and cut into 2 x 3 inch squares | 1 lb puff pastry ( plain ) | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 4 egg yolks | 3/4 cup pineapple tidbits, drained ( not canned! ) | 1/3 cup romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut the puff pastry into 12 squares. Set pastry squares on cookie sheets and place in the over for one hour. Remove puff pastry squares from the oven and brush lightly with beaten egg yolks and pepper flakes. Place a dab of orange juice into each square before placing each one in the oven. You may also, place the 2 halves of the salmon onto each pastry square. Carefully spoon ¾ cup of the pineapple tidbits and ¾ cup diced pineapple into the center of each salmon square. Bake in the oven for approximately 15 minutes, or until the puffed pastry is lightly browned.

title: Lebanese Baked Prunes - Prunes With Spinach
ingredients: 10 -12 large pitted prunes, such as tepid | 1 lb fresh spinach leaves | 3 1/2 cups malt vinegar | 3/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 10 -10 dashes marmalade powder or 1 dash curry powder ( for the kick )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f remove pits from prunes and cut off stems and remove pimentos. Place all halves together in a baking dish, cover tightly and bake for about 30 minutes, until tender with a bit of juice. Meanwhile, prepare the salad. Drain the pan juices from prunes, leaving about 2 t in the pan water. Set the prunes aside, discarding the liquid. Remove all prunes and roughly brake them up with your hands. Reserve 3 t. Of the pan juices. Add the reserved prectar, vinegar, garam masala and curry powder. Stir until combined and warm through. Put the spinach leaves on a baking sheet, spray lightly with oil and arrange the leaves close together in an attractive row on serving platter. Sprinkle with the reserved water, cover tightly and bake until just wilted, about 10 - 15 minutes, depending on size and moisture level. Dip the spines under cold water and carefully roll them around in the dressing. Arrange them attractively on the spinach. You can serve the salad immediately, but it is best eaten within 24 hours. It is best to chill the salad for up to an hour. Drain it well and serve the salad with croutons, bread or pita bread.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,asafoetida powder,ra el hanout spice mix,pine nut,baking soda,ginger paste,clear honey
title: Baked Pina Colada
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups fresh ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup pine nuts, chopped | 1/4 cup raisins and raisins ( golden ) | 1 ounce ginger paste | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 3/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons clear honey
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Use right away if your mix is rather wet. It is better if you allow it to sit for at least 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350°f with the rack in the middle position.

title: Slow Cooker Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar chunky salsa ( mild, medium, or hot! ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon sriracha sauce ( or more, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: In a large bowl, add salsa, ginger garlic paste, sriracha, and flour. Stir lightly to combine. Cover and cook on auto 4 for 6 hours or on high 4 for 5 hours. Stir to coat with mixture completely. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes more to thicken.

title: Eyes of the Earth (Ejjet Char Kebab)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped shallots or 1/4 cup scallion | 4 teaspoons black sesame seeds | 2 cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 2 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups chicken broth | 2 teaspoons hot sauce ( sriracha ) or 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 2 -4 large belgian endive, sliced crosswise into rings
instructions: Combine the shallots, toasted and black sesame seeds, and pinto beans in a large bowl. Stir to blend. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Cover and chill for 2 to 4 hours in the refrigerator. Arrange the endive rings on a cookie sheet large enough to accommodate them in a single layer or on a serving platter. Serve with bread or crackers. Variation, use fresh herbs instead of sesame seeds.

title: Sparkling Cranberry Snack
ingredients: 2/3 cup dried cranberries, stems removed | 2 tablespoons pecan nuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 2 cups seasoned dry bread crumbs | 3 tablespoons dried bread crumbs, divided
instructions: Place the dried cranberries, pecans, sesame seed oil, seasoned dry bread crumbs, and 1/3 cup water in a food processor, and process until combined well, about 35 - 45 seconds. Press or roll into a ball, then reshape into one inch balls. To store, place the cracker in a container or ziplock bag with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 3 - 4 hours, or overnight. Preheat oven to 500°f place remaining 1/3 cup bread crumbs on a work surface or baking sheet, and place the crackers on top. Place a rack in the middle of the oven and heat the oven to 425°f when the rack is hot and warm, place the crackers on the rack, and bake for 5 - 12 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,italian parsley,cilantro root,chicken bouillon,coconut cream,active yeast
title: Portuguese Style Coconut and Parsley Cheese (Pudim De Jitomate)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 15 cups lukewarm unsweetened coconut cream | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs fresh cilantro roots ( or roots and roots ) | 2/3 cup fresh italian parsley | 1 3/4 cups unbleached cane vinegar or 2/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup double-leaf italian parsley, stemmed and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a large bowl combine the yeast, warm coconut cream, cilantro roots, parsley roots, vinegar, and half of the italian parsley. Stir in half of the remaining parsley and half of the remaining italian parsley. Cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours or preferably overnight. Remove from refrigerator and let sit for an hour. To serve, line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the dough in it on it. Gently punch down dough, pulling the edges apart to help it stretch out, and knead about 5 minutes. Divide the dough into six pieces and form into balls. Place about 2 tablespoons oil in a round hotel dish and heat uncovered until almost smoking. Place one ball on the palm of your hand and press for 10 seconds or put the dough into the hot oil, browning the other side. When browned, transfer to a wire rack and cover with a tea towel to cool.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,garlic salt,sharp cheddar cheese,english cucumber,ricotta cheese,italian sausage
title: Cheesy Sausage Salad
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs | 1 english cucumber ( peeled and sliced in thin half moons ) | 1 jar deli italian sausage | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 package of grated old sharp cheddar cheese | 1 lb ricotta cheese, with low fat added
instructions: Break eggs into a medium pot, cover with water and bring to boil for two minutes. Place the hard boiled eggs into a colander and shock in the wata water. When they are cool enough to handle, peel off the skins and chop into quarters. Discard the shells and return back to the pot. Drain the casings and slice them into 1/4 slices and set aside. Cut the cucumber into thin half moons. Drain the sausage of any excess fat cut into large cubes and crumble. Place all the ingredients into the salad bowl. Stir gently by hand. Serve at room temperature.

title: Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 kg raw cashews ( shelled ) | 300 g of raw radishes, sliced | 2 -8 drops vanilla essence
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl.

title: Mexican White Bean Casserole
ingredients: 4 cups dry cannellini beans, picked over and rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 8 stalks fresh cilantro, chopped | 3 tablespoons roughly chopped kahlua | 1/2 - 3/4 cup tajolianka liqueur ( or other good hot coffee to your liking ) | 2 cups shredded kahlua ( or other coffee to your liking ) | 3/4 cup packed chopped cheddar cheese | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese | sliced mushrooms, to garnish | 4 heads cauliflower
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Toss everything in order given and place in large greased casserole dish and stir to blend evenly. Cover with foil and bake until heated through stirring gently every 20 minutes for an additional 30 minutes or so as not to burn. Remove foil and bake until golden brown.

title: Egg Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 liter beef stock | 1 serrano pepper, deseeded and slit | 1 egg noodle | 1 tablespoon currants | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Put the beef stock, serrano pepper and egg noodles in a pot and bring to a boil. Meanwhile, combine the currants and turmeric powder in a small bowl. When the soup comes to a boil, reduce the heat to half. Add the currants and turmeric powder to the soup and cook, stirring frequently, until the soup thickens. Add the currants and egg noodles and simmer on a low light for about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,nutella,icing sugar,red chili pepper,chile powder
title: Chile & Nutella Fudge
ingredients: 250 g icing sugar | 25 ml chili powder | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chile peppers | 25 g nutella, sliced into four squares | salt & pepper
instructions: Combine icing sugar, chilli powder & pepper in a small bowl. Cut nutella squares in half crossways & then into chunks add to the sugar to soften slightly & melt in a microwaveable bowl. Spoon the fudge onto a silicone baking tray then place under a grill to brown lightly then spread with icing sugar when cool.

Random Ingredients: garlic,italian herb seasoning,squash,salt pork,corn tortilla,green bean,beef bouillon cube
title: French Dip- Taquitos #5FIX
ingredients: 3 lbs ground beef or 3 lbs ground turkey | 1 lb corn tortilla, cut into quarters | 1 lb salt pork, diced | 1 1/2 cups fresh green beans, cut in 1-inch lengths or 1 1/2 cups frozen green beans | 1 1/2 cups mixed italian herbs seasoning, chopped | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons garlic, minced
instructions: Saute the salt pork and salt pork in a medium skillet until the salt pork is browned. In a small bowl, combine the italian seasoning with the beef bouillon cubes and set aside. Pour the sauteed salt pork, green beans, and mixed italian herb seasoning into a large mixing bowl. Add in the ground beef and mix until they are completely coated with the spice mixture. Lay out a corn tortilla quarter on a cutting board.

title: Vietnamese Omelet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 4 tablespoons aubergines ( peeled, sliced )
instructions: Place tamarind paste and aubergines in bowl. Heat a little bit of oil over medium heat. Sauté until aubergines just start turning translucent. Turn down heat and add tamarind paste on top. Serve immediately with soy sauce of your choice.

title: Crispy Shredded Carrots-Pops
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin, coarsely chopped | 4 cups canola oil, divided | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 lbs carrots, sliced diagonally in 1 1/2-inch rounds
instructions: Mix raisins and 1/2 cup oil together in a large bowl. Add cream of tartar and remaining oil mixture and toss to combine. Add carrots and toss well to coat. Pat carrots dry. Coat a large plate with a paper towel, and place remaining carrot slices on top. Cover, and set aside while you finish making the caramel. Place a large non stick skillet over medium heat. When shimmering, add about 1/2 cup cooking oil. When it shimmers, add carrots in batches, and shallow fry until golden, about 10 minutes. Keep warm on paper towels.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Bruschetta - 3 Points
ingredients: 1 baguette, preferably toasted in a pan | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon dry sherry ( optional )
instructions: Slice baguette into 1/2 slices. Arrange in single layer on serving platter. Drain oil from jar from jars into small bowl.

title: Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef tenderloin ( depending on how thin or thick you want your tenderloining to be. i used 2 steaks from the sirloin steak ) | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Slice tenderloins into medallions, about 1 long & about 1/2 wide. Place in a pan with water to barely cover. Bring to a boil, turn down heat & boil slowly for about 10 minutes, then drain. In a bowl, combine the flour & beef juices, then add to the beef & simmer for another 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer the beef to baking pan & brush on the pastry. Cover loosely with foil & bake for 45 - 50 minutes, or until tenderloin is cooked.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,pimento pepper,dark rum,white wine vinegar,italian sausage,coriander seed,hard egg
title: Mama's Piri Piri Sauce and Eggs
ingredients: 1 bottle light rum, preferably cajun | 1/2 cup dark rum, preferably cajun | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, crushed | 2 hard-boiled eggs, shelled, peeled, finely chopped | 2 pimento pepper, seeded, finely chopped | 4 cups dry white wine vinegar | 1 small hot red chili pepper, seeded, deveined, finely chopped, or to taste
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup light rum and 1/2 cup dark rum in a bottle. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 2 days. When ready to serve, stir together 1/2 cup dark rum and 1/2 cup dark rum in a small saucepan and heat over medium heat until very hot, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and discard husks and stems from red chili pepper.

title: Guacamole for Turkey
ingredients: 1 pound ground meat | 5 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Mix meat, guacamole, and 1 teaspoon salt together in a bowl to form turkey. Form into 2 patties. Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil grate.

title: Amerikan Bagel (sriracha-Spice Noodle Sandwich)
ingredients: 3 ounces bean sprouts, blanched | 4 -8 slices roasted almond | sriracha sauce
instructions: Combine peanuts and sprouts and place on a sheet.

Random Ingredients: olive,guacamole,pineapple juice,lime wedge,red chili pepper flake
title: Tropical Avocado Smoothie
ingredients: 3 ripe mangoes, peeled and coarsely mashed | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple juice | fresh lime wedge ( to garnish ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup chopped olive ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients, except the olive, in the container of a food processor fitted with the metal blade and process until smooth, about 1 minute. Place in a tall glass, drizzle with the remaining olive oil, and garnish with lime wedges.

title: Tropical Trout Salad
ingredients: 2 trout fillets, with body | 1/2 cucumber, sliced | 1/4 cup diced pimiento | 1 -2 teaspoon basil | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Place trout in shallow salad bowl. Place sliced cucumber, diced pimento and basil on fish. Sprinkle with a teaspoon of the vanilla. Pour pineapple juice over the trout. Dot fish with margarine and decorate with lemon wedges or a few sprigs of basil. Enjoy and enjoy.

title: Chipotle Crackers
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/3 cup flour | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking spray | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground dried chipotle powder ( or more )
instructions: Heat oven to 400º. Combine flour, curry powder, and pepper in a medium size mixing bowl. Add chipotle powder and stir. Add 1/4 cup water to dry ingredients, beat with spoon until mix is uniform and dry, then stir in remaining water. Divide dough into 4 portions, pat each into a disk with floured hands. On ungreased cookie sheet, flatten each disk very slightly. Bake 10 - 14 minutes or until lightly browned and crisp. Cool on cookie sheet for 5 minutes before removing.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,kaffir lime leaf,coriander sprig,stewing beef,lemon zest,tahini paste
title: Django Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut in cubes | 4 teaspoons lemon, zest of | 1/4 cup tahini paste | 20 coriander sprigs | 10 g fresh coriander powder | 10 kaffir lime leaves, shredded
instructions: Marinate beef cubes in lemon zest, tahini, coriander and lime leaves for at least 1 hour or overnight. Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a deep fryer or sieve to smoking point and fry beef until well browned on all sides. Place beef cubes in a serving dish. Serve hot with basmati rice.

title: Low-Fat Baked Broccoli & Spinach
ingredients: 3 cups fresh spinach | cooking spray | 2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1/8 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Rinse spinach with water.

Random Ingredients: sage,pumpkin seed,cake yeast,dark brown sugar,mustard seed
title: Pumpkin Seed Bread
ingredients: 450 g pumpkin seeds | 400 ml dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 225 g cake yeast | 1 teaspoon sage
instructions: Crack the pumpkin seeds in a coffee grinder until fine. Measure 500 ml of the brown sugar, the mustard seeds, and the spice into a large bowl, and pour in 1 pkgs of the grated pumpkin seeds and sugar mix well. Allow to stand 25 minutes at room temperature, then stir in a little of the remaining sugar. Turn the dough out onto a well floured board and knead until smooth and elastic. Lightly oil a large bowl and place the dough in it. Oil the bowl, cover, and leave in a warm place for 20 minutes, or until doubled. Preheat the oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas 1, place the yeast in a large bowl, and stir through the remaining sugar. Sprinkle over the risen dough, and leave in a warm place for 30 minutes, or until doubled. Use the dough hook to punch down the dough. Roll the dough into a rectangle, using a rolling pin if it's so long it's almost stretched too far. Spread the mixture onto the dough, leaving a 1cm margin on all sides. Fold the left and right edges inwards then roll the outside out again. Turn the right and left over as you roll. Repeat with the second 2 doughs. Slash a cross hatch pattern through the top of the loaf at the beginning and end of each cut, and place the loaf on a baking sheet. Leave in an open oven to rise, or in a cool place for 3 hours, turning the oven down to 120c/fan 110c/gas 3 after 30 minutes, take out of the oven and leave 10 minutes more. Leave overnight, or in the fridge until doubled, baking is ready for storage. Heat up 2 tbs of oil in a pan, carefully place the bread on it, and fry quickly on all sides until golden and crisp. Cut into wedges and serve with butter, jam, cheese, etc.

title: Crispy Won Tons
ingredients: 50 wonton wrappers, about 1-inch x 2-inch | 1/4 cup barbecue-style catsup | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons honey mustard | 1/3 cup minced lebanese cucumber | prosciutto, smoked, salted, and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place a wonton tip in the center, brush the edges with water, and pinch together with your fingers. Keep on hand and keep covered to prevent drying out. Heat 1 tblsp. Beer or 1 tsp.
