Mustard saucepan over medium heat. Add catsup, salsa, and honey mustard. Increase heat to medium high, and cook 5 minutes or until heated through. Place a won ton wrapper on a flat surface and spread it with 1 tblsp. Barbeque sauce. Place about 1/4 cup cucumber on the won ton, drizzle or brush with a tablespoon of sauce, and top with 1 - 2 teaspoons prosciutto. Wet the edge of a cookie sheet with water, and place the cookie sheet on the cookie sheet. Let cool slightly, a few seconds, then carefully remove the cookie sheet and won tons from the cookie sheet. Serve.

title: Dill Herbed Feta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds dill weed | 1 jar whole-leaf, fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a blender or food processor, whir together the dill weed and mint leaves until well blended. Mix in feta cheese. Store in the refrigerator or use to spread on crackers.

title: Chinese-style bean paste
ingredients: 1 pint tomatoes puree | 1/2 lb dried refried beans ( i use bush's dark brown beans ) | 1/4 ounce ginger-garlic paste, cut up | 5 tablespoons cream
instructions: Pour tomatoes into a saucepan. Add beans and enough water to cover. Boil until softened, approx 15 minutes. Cool. Transfer to a blender and puree until smooth. Return to the pan and add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Easy Low Fat Ricotta Meatballs (Pork)
ingredients: 3 lbs lean ground meat ( or about 6-7 lbs pork ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fat-free ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine the meat and garlic. Add the ricotta 1/4 cup at a time. Roll into meatballs, and place on a lightly oiled cookie sheet pan. Let them rest in a cold oven while you prep the rest of the ingredients. Put the meatballs on the baking sheets. Bake for about an hour, stirring occasionally. You may need to add more water during the cooking time depending on the temperature of your oven.

title: Quick and Easy Sandwich
ingredients: 1 pound hamburger | 4 cans hot pepper sauce
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Panch Phulchon
ingredients: 500 g eggplants | 4 g dry yeast | 4 cups lukewarm soda | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda, for baking
instructions: Pour 2 cups of cold water into a pan with baking soda, then place the eggplants in, then fill with cold water until the water boils and the eggplants are covered at least 5 mm. This is very important, as the eggplants are very important in the final product to be able to pick up the eggplants after 5 minutes. Leave until water goes frothy, then add the eggplant. Boil for ten minutes, then drain and cool. Repeat this 2 steps, adding another 1 cup cold water and the yeast, then leave to sit for a few minutes. The temperature of the water should be about 110c. After 45 minutes, check the mixture, and if it's still too thick, add a little more water. If it's too runny, add another cup of cold water, cover and leave overnight. The day before baking the eggplant is used, it will need to be well floured. Mix a small amount of yeast into 2 cups of water and mix well, and make a well in the center of the mixture. Stir the mixture vigorously with a wooden spoon. The mixture should get smooth and spongy. Add a little sugar, if necessary.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,pear,taco seasoning mix,salt black pepper,chipotle chile
title: Cheesy Beef-Pear Tacos
ingredients: 3 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 10 ounces canned pears, diced | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 cup chipotle chiles, minced | 1 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 6x8 inch pan with aluminum foil and wrap foil around the meat. Bake meat in the preheated oven until tender, about 2 1/2 hours. Toss meat cubes with pears, taco seasoning, chipotle chiles, salt, and pepper.

title: German Pork and Leek Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs pork, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 medium leeks or 1 medium white onion, chopped, use more if desired | 1/2 head red cabbage, cut in to small chunks | 1 tablespoon seafood seasoning or 1 tablespoon seasoning salt, use more if desired | spaghetti
instructions: Spray crockpot with non stick spray or add a dash of oil. Add pork, leeks, onion, cabbage and spices. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Add cooked spaghetti. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,chili flake,russet potato,beef consomme,brandy
title: Fried Potatoes With Onion & Brandy
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes | 1/4 cup brandy | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 cups beef consomme | 2 tablespoons chili flakes ( optional )
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into slices about 1/4 inch thick using a mandoline or a sharp knife. Place them on a dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour but no more than 48 hours, in this case the potatoes will absorb some of the juices. The next day, remove the wrap and discard it. Heat the oil to smoking in a large dutch oven. Put half the potatoes in one layer into the pan and cook until golden brown all over, about 7 minutes. Turn over and cook the other side until golden brown, another 7 minutes. Drain the potatoes on paper towels. Meanwhile, pour the brandy into the hot pan and boil, scraping the bottom, until reduced by almost half, 20 - 60 seconds. Pour the brandy into the pan and scrape back onto the bottom. Heat on high until hot but not boiling. Remove from heat. Add the reserved potatoes and toss lightly. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb mexican blend cheese, cut into 1 by 1/4-inch shreds | 2 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Stir the cheese, vinegar, and spice together in a large bowl until well blended. Serve on a lettuce lined plate topped with the cheese.

title: Taco Dip III
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground hazelnuts | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Place hazelnuts on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with taco seasoning. Broil, watching carefully, until roasted and toasted, about 5 minutes.

title: "healthified" Beef and Bean Soup
ingredients: 2/3 lb stewing beef | 1 can kidney beans | 2 cans beef broth
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot. Cook on low all day.

title: Stove Top Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3/4 lb stewing beef, diced | 3 heads baby bok choy, chopped | 1/4 cup unsalted butter | 2 packages uncooked spaghetti
instructions: In a large stockpot, with a lid, place the beef, bok choy and butter. Cook on high heat until it begins to soften. Reduce heat to medium, cover and cook for 25 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to package directions. Place the soup in a large serving bowl and pour hot water over it. Stir until boiling and serve.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,espresso powder,zucchini,worcestershire sauce,white sesame seed,arborio rice,raspberry
title: Zucchini Arancini
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups arborio rice, uncooked | 4 cups hot coffee ( or 2 cups warm water ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup white sesame seeds, lightly toasted | 1/2 tablespoon dried rosemary leaves | 1/2 teaspoon espresso powder
instructions: Set oven to 325°f. Cut zucchini vertically in half, then slice diagonally. Arrange zucchini cut side down on a baking sheet and drizzle with 1/2 cup coffee. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, in a pot of boiling salted water, cook rice about 10 minutes, or until almost tender. Add 1/2 cup warm water, worcestershire sauce, sesame seeds and rosemary. Cook and stir for 10 more minutes. Remove skillet from heat immediately and let sit 5 minutes, then fluff rice with fork. Add espresso powder, stir and taste.

title: Mushroom Filling
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry mushrooms ( or more to taste ) | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 lb chicken liver, fresh or 1 lb frozen cooked chicken liver
instructions: Add the dry mushrooms, dry cumin seeds and chicken livers to the ground chicken liver in a food processor, and pulse until the mixture is the same as fine breadcrumbs. Add the mixture to the chicken filling, stirring well to combine. Enjoy,.

title: Homemade Espresso Meat Stock
ingredients: 1 cup ground meat | 4 1/2 cups strong coffee
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, bring the ground meat and the water to a boil and let simmer until meat is very warm, 10 to 15 minutes. Use a strainer to drain the meat, shred it, and return it to the pot. Transfer the meat to a clean, unused 3 1/2 quart saucepan. Pour the coffee into the meat and coffee and let soak several hours, then discard the coffee. Strain the solids through a coffee can funnel and discard any solids. Rinse off any remaining coffee from the can and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,lemon extract,garam masala powder,taco sauce,beef broth,italian seasoning
title: Quick Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/3 cup taco sauce | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 2 tablespoons chicken stock or 2 tablespoons beef broth | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon italian seasoning ( to taste ) | 1 pinch garam masala powder
instructions: Spread taco sauce on the hot plate of your choice and sprinkle with chicken stock, lemon extract and italian seasoning. Toast in a preheated oven for 10 minutes, flipping once until slightly browne, 12 minutes total. Serve with your favorite sandwich meat.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,asiago cheese,vanilla sugar,green olive,tortellini,bread crumb,chili paste,bouquet garni
title: Beef Tortellini
ingredients: 1/2 pound lean, boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-4-inch wide slices | 1 jar pickled green olives, drained and chopped | 1 jar bordelais-style stuffed green olives, drained and chopped | 1 jar pickled artichoke hearts in water, drained and quartered | 1 cup dry bread crumbs, divided | 1/4 cup grated asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons chili paste, or to taste | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar
instructions: In a bowl, toss meat chunks with half the olives, green olives, artichokes, bread crumbs, asiago cheese, chili paste and vanilla sugar. Arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and drizzle with remaining olives, and top with remaining bread crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: brandy,cumin seed,quinoa,chicken thigh,vegetable,lemon zest,sambal oelek,romaine lettuce
title: Quick and Easy Spicy Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 1 cup chopped romaine lettuce | 1 1/2 cups cooked chicken thighs, chopped | 1/2 cup vegetable | 1/3 cup chopped mixed pulses | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek ( toasted cayenne paste ) | 2 teaspoons coriander cumin seeds, crushed | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest
instructions: Place the quinoa and 1 cup water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let stand until completely cooled, about 20 minutes. Strain the quinoa and allow to cool. Place the romaine, diced chicken, vegetables, sambal oelek, coriander and zest in a large bowl. Add the quinoa, stir and adjust seasoning. Chill to blend flavors. Best if served within two hours.

title: Quick Bacon Crunch
ingredients: 4 lbs bacon | 1 kg bell pepper | 400 g sugar icing
instructions: Chop and fry bacon until crisp. Drain bacon and let cool. While bacon is still warm slice into small pieces. While bacon is cooling slice peppers into 1/4 strips. Line jelly roll pan with plastic wrap. Add bell pepper, bacon, bell pepper, bacon fat, sugar and mix until sugar has dissolved. Spread thin layer of the sugar icing mixture on pan and let set for at least 2 hours. Serve with coffee.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,white balsamic vinegar,escarole,oyster sauce,pineapple tidbit
title: Marinated Greens
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low sodium liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon white balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 cups escarole, coarsely chopped | 3/4 can pineapple tidbits
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Yummy Raspberry Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mango, peeled and chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh raspberries or 1/4 cup frozen raspberries | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Combine all ingredients well and puree in blender or food processor or mixer. Cover and allow to sit for about 3 hours to blend flavors. Enjoy.

title: Camarones a la King's Baked Shrimp Rice
ingredients: 24 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 cups cooked rice krispies | 1 can buttered beans | 1 plum tomato
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange the shrimp in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the shrimp are just starting to change color. Meanwhile, spread rice krispies on a baking sheet. Bake for 5 minutes, or until the rice looks dry. Spread half the shrimp per serving. Spread the rice krispies over the shrimp. Spread the beans over the shrimp. Sprinkle with tomato. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until shrimp are just shrimp tender.

title: Spicy Onion and Olive Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces feta or 8 ounces goat cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1 large english onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 8 large black olives, pitted
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Cover.

title: Beef 'n Ale Surprise
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 1 ounce green bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups ginger ale, chilled | 30 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f in 9x9x2 baking dish, combine ground beef, bell pepper and ginger. Bake uncovered, 1 hour, stirring frequently. Cool and refrigerate several hours. Spoon into freezer proof bowl. Add tabasco.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,dark sesame oil,mustard seed,purple onion
title: Asian Dressing
ingredients: 1 purple onion, finely chopped | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon light sesame oil
instructions: Heat up mustard seeds and sesame oil in a microwave safe bowl. When hot, add onions and celery and stir for 2 minutes or so, until everything is covered with spices. Let cool. You can make this dressing in advance and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Rosemary Penne With Whole Wheat Penne
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat penne | 2 -3 stalks fresh rosemary
instructions: If using whole wheat penne, bring 3 1/2 quarts of water to a boil and then add the penne. Cook the pasta for 13 minutes. When the penne has finished cooking, add the whole or fresh rosemary stalks. Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Add the fresh rosemary leaves to the pot. Toss well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,sea salt,garlic paste,ranch dressing mix,cooking apple
title: Homemade Ranch Dressing II
ingredients: 5 tablespoons dried ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon minced garlic paste | 4 teaspoons fresh minced chili peppers | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 2 cooking apples, peeled-cored
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the ranch dressing mix, garlic paste, chili peppers, and salt. Add the apples, and stir to coat. Cover, and refrigerate up to 24 hours before serving.

title: Famous Alfredo Dip
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 jar of herbed alfredo sauce, divided | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly spray rectangular glass baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, stir together half of the alfredo sauce until well mixed. Stir in the cheese and mint and mix evenly over the alfredo mixture. Spread half of the remaining alfredo mixture over top and dot with more of the cheese mixture. Spread reserved alfredo mixture over the top. Place in the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes, stirring a few times for even coloring. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,ginger root,white fish fillet,poblano chile,cashew
title: Thai Fish Balls with Cashews
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, seeded | 24 ounces firm white fish fillets, skinned | 2 tablespoons cashews, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root, peeled and grated | 2 tablespoons dried white breadcrumbs
instructions: Place the chilies on a baking sheet and roast under the broiler until fragrant, turning frequently and keeping blackened on all sides, about 8 minutes. Allow to cool completely. Peel, seed and chop the chilies. Cut the fish into 1 inch pieces. Combine all the ingredients except the cashews and bread crumbs in a food processor or blender. Process until smooth. Spoon mixture onto lightly oiled paper baking trays and flatten slightly. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 10 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle with the cashews and top with toasted cashews and bread crumbs.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,coconut cream,sesame seed,orange peel,worcestershire sauce,cream mushroom soup
title: Rotini With Coconut Cream Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces rotini pasta, cooked and drained | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 13 1/2 ounces unsweetened coconut cream | 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve with toasted sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,rom tomato,raspberry,cranberry,mexican chocolate,red curry paste,water,corn oil peanut
title: Mexican Chocolate and Raspberries With Red Curry Nuts and Chili
ingredients: 450 g mexican chocolate | 3 tablespoons red curry paste ( i used thai kitchen brand ) | 500 ml water | 300 g rata colada non frozen raspberries | 250 g frozen cranberries ( fresh or thawed ) | 1 tablespoon corn oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 ripe roma tomato, halved and finely chopped | 150 g frozen unsweetened raspberries ( thawed ) | 1 tablespoon roughly chopped peeled roasted sweet chocolate
instructions: To make the red curry paste, place choc chipotle in a glass bowl or saucepan and bring the water to boil. Add curry paste, turn off heat and set aside for 30 minute or until smooth. Meanwhile place raspberries in a medium large bowl. Cover with cling film and put into the fridge. When ready to serve, remove choc chips from the fridge and leave to thaw slightly. Drain raspberries completely in a colander, and then place in a dry pan with a teaspoon of peanut or canola oil. Stir over low heat until raspberries start to soften – about 10 minutes. Transfer raspberries to bowl and cover with the red curry paste. Set aside to cool completely.. Stir the coconut flakes, rata colada, and chopped tomato with puree in a small bowl to create a chunky sauce. Set aside. To serve the nuts and sauce, line a serving plate with raspberries and top with a couple of rata coffe beans. Divide rata colada sauce evenly along the centre and sprinkle with some chocolate sauce. Garnish with red curry paste and diced tomato to taste.

title: Sizzlin' Grock
ingredients: 2 green bell peppers | 2 ounces beer
instructions: First, put all in the blender and grind till just slightly chunky. Take out of the blender and put on a plate lined with papter towels. You can eat it immediately, or put it in the fridge. You can even add some salt and pepper or garlic powder to it if you like.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,feta cheese,white pepper powder,cayenne pepper,beef bouillon cube,allspice,orange marmalade
title: Cheese Bouillon Cubes
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked crumbled pork sausage | 12 ounces orange marmalade | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese ( about 6 oz. ) | 1 tablespoon white pepper powder or 1 tablespoon black pepper | 1 tablespoon allspice | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bouillon cubes and cayenne in crockery bag. Pour contents of chicken bouillon cubes into crockery bag.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,green pepper,pineapple chunk,curry paste,cayenne,chicken thigh,green curry paste
title: Chicken, Ricotta, & Pineapple Curry
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon green curry paste ( amount to taste ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 3 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 can pineapple chunks, well drained | 1 cup low-fat ricotta cheese or 4 1/2 ounces fat-free ricotta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 green pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Cut chicken thighs crosswise into 1/2 to 3/4 inch strips. Combine curry paste and pineapple in a bowl and marinade chicken about 20 minutes while marinating. Combine the ricotta cheese and cayenne with a fork and mix well. Add the green pepper and marinated chicken strips to spice mixture. Stir so all the pieces are well coated evenly. Cover bowl and refrigerate a minimum of 2 hours. Thread chicken strips onto skewers alternating between the pineapple chunks and green pepper. Broil or grill 3 - 4 inches from the heat 10 - 12 minutes.

title: Pancho Villa Adobo
ingredients: 8 ounces dried jalapeno chile peppers | 1 cup onion, cubed | 3 cups water | 1 tablespoon lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine the peppers, onion, and water in a pot. Bring the mixture to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Transfer to a baking dish, and bake for 45 minutes. Remove from heat, and sprinkle with lemon zest. Serve with tortillas.

title: Quick and Easy Fish Soup
ingredients: 1 liter veal stock | 300 g of sliced smoked fish ( or 2-4 oz of any fresh fish ) | 150 g of cubed sweetcorn | 300 g of sliced savoy cabbage | 200 g of cubed oyster cabbage | 200 ml yogurt | 2 fresh fennel leaves
instructions: Heat the veal stock in a large saucepan on medium heat. Chop the smoked fish into cubes, and add to the stock. Bring to a simmer, cover the pan while making the rest of the soup. Chop the sweetcorn into smaller chunks, and add to the simmering soup. Allow to simmer on low heat. Chop the savoy cabbage into wedges, and add to the soup. Serve with a good, light loaf of crusty bread and some freshly grated black pepper.

title: Italian Tomatoes Stuffed With Tomatoes & Cranberry
ingredients: 2 slices stale french bread | 2 tablespoons canned tomato sauce ( i've tried with a bit of basil & garlic in it ) | 2 tablespoons cranberries | 1 tomatoes, seeded & chopped into small pieces
instructions: Slice the french bread into 1/4 thick rounds. Put a spoonful of the tomato sauce into the center of each slice. Sprinkle the chopped cranberries over. Place a piece of bread in the bowl & flip the bread over so the tomato sauce covers the bread. Put the tomato pieces on top & serve.

title: Pasta With Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans rotel, drained | 1/2 cup couscous | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1 package linguine
instructions: Blend all sauce ingredients until smooth. Cook and drain linguine according to package directions. Drain linguines and toss with cheese sauce. Add additional sauce if desired.

title: Pork Mushroom and Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 large boneless pork roast | 3 tablespoons ghee | 1 jar pickled cremini mushrooms, stems discarded | 1 package pepperoni, sliced | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 2 tablespoons finely chopped hazelnuts
instructions: Trim fat from pork roast. Cut into 24 - 3 inch pieces. Heat ghee in large skillet over medium heat. Brown beef quickly on all sides. Remove pork to warm plate. Add mushrooms to ghee. Sauté over medium high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Add pepperoni. Sauté for 2 - 3 minutes. Return pork to skillet. Stir in cayenne and hazelnuts. Simmer uncovered 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,vegetable oil cooking spray,bay seasoning,swiss cheese,feta cheese
title: French Fries
ingredients: 8 -12 hamburger ( the lean kind might also contain some oil ) | 1 - 1 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 2 -3 tablespoons dried crumbled feta cheese or 2 -3 tablespoons cottage cheese | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning or 1 tablespoon basil and 1 tablespoon other seasoning
instructions: Combine the swiss cheese and the crumbled feta cheese. Add the meat and the old bay seasoning or the other seasoning. Stir well with a fork. Heat the grill to medium high heat. Coat frying pan with cooking spray and add the mixture to the frying pan, cooking for 3 - 4 minutes each side.. Serve as the french fries.

title: Kumara (Sweet Potato) Salad
ingredients: 1 kumara ( sweet potato ) | 50 g white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut the ends off the kumara. Slice the sweet potato into long thin slices, about 4 inches long. Steam the kumara in boiling water for about 10 minutes, or until just cooked through. In a salad bowl, combine the kumara with vinegar. Toss the salad to mix well. Serve with freshly ground black pepper and/or extra salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: water,coconut milk,tomato puree,maple syrup,sherry wine,soymilk,lime wedge,naan bread
title: Tomato Naan With Coconut Syrup
ingredients: 1/4 cup light soymilk or 1/4 cup plain unsweetened soymilk | 1/4 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon purei water | 1 small naan bread or 1 small other bread, cut into slices | lime wedge, garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the soymilk, coconut milk, sherry, maple syrup, tomato puree and water. Let sit about 20 minutes until the flavors blend, then refrigerate for up to 1 1/2 hours. Toast the bread in a skillet over medium heat, flipping once, until golden. Spread the bread slices with the tomato mixture, dividing evenly.

title: Irish Inspired Beef and Raisins
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 1/4 cup milk | 1/4 cup minced hard-boiled egg | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, brown beef and onion. Reduce heat to medium and add sour cream, milk, egg and raisins. Simmer, uncovered, until heated through. Serve warm.

title: Beijing Borscht
ingredients: 1/3 cup orzo pasta ( or rice noodles ) | 3 cups chopped cooked pork | 2 cups fresh or frozen broccoli florets | 1 cup chopped cucumber | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh coffee, or more to taste | 3 cups hot brewed coffee for topping
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook orzo in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Place the orzo in a large bowl. Using a strainer, skim excess water from the broth. Bring broth to a boil in the hot pot. Reduce heat to low.

title: Rocket, Salt and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 3 cups raw rocket | crushed ice
instructions: Remove the skin from the rocket and tear the leaves. Place in a large bowl and toss with crushed ice. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,wheat flour,red snapper fillet,italian parsley,baking soda,beef bouillon granule,kielbasa
title: Cranky's Snails
ingredients: 10 red snapper fillets | 3 medium sized beef bouillon granules | 4 cups whole wheat flour | 2 kielbasa, cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 package shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Sprinkle fillets with salt and pepper. Slice kielbasa into 2 inch lengths. Sprinkle with dissolved beef bouillon. In shallow baking pan, stir together 6 quarts water and flour until very well blended. Dip fish in flour and shake off excess. Add to water in medium bowl, coating completely. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. When fish have soaked, drain, pat dry with paper towels, and place in one layer, side by side, in baking pan. Pour 1/2 the tomato juice on top. Sprinkle with baking soda. Repeat with kielbasa and parsley. Top each fillet with 1/4 the cheese. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,colby monterey jack cheese,caraway seed,white chocolate,tamarind paste,black pepper,cayenne
title: Baked Mexican Chocolate Mince (SMS)!
ingredients: 1 lb white chocolate, chopped | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste ( i use the paste from asian deli ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/2 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste
instructions: In a large mince bowl, combine all ingredients except cheese and tamarind paste. Mix well. Using a large spoonful, scoop the mixture onto parchment or waxed paper covered baking sheet. Using the back of a spoon, press indentations in the meat with the back of the spoon. Sprinkle top with cheese. Set aside to cool. Once cooled, press mixture into an 8x8 inch pan. The mixture will be very wet. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares, and serve.

title: Savory French Bread for One
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 1/2 cups fat-free buttermilk | 1 cup mild white cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange the ingredients in a small baking dish. Bake on the middle rack of the oven for 22 - 30 minutes, until bread is crusty. Break bread from the baking dish into pieces and serve. Note, if you must, substitute 2 tbsp of dry sherry or white cooking wine for the water.

title: Parma Ham - Tyler Florence
ingredients: 1 large parma ham | cooking spray | 1 white onion, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Brush parma ham with cooking spray. Spread onion slices on top. Season with salt and pepper. Place ham on baking sheet. Bake ham until ham is crisp, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chile,mustard seed,water chestnut,red potato,sirloin,baking potato
title: Thai Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard seed | 1 lb sirloin | 1 small baking potato, peeled | 1 teaspoon ground red chile | 1 can water chestnuts | 1 medium red potato, unpeeled
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread mustard seed on rimmed cookie sheet to form a 12 inch long, 1 1/2 inch thick wall. Place beef and next 3 ingredients in a shallow 2 quart baking dish or pan. Cut potatoes into 1/2 inch wide wedges and drop into the beef. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 375°f. Bake uncovered until beef is lightly browned and potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes longer. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Beef and Beet Patties
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed ( chick peas if available ) | 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 2 serrano peppers, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon dried red pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried chervil | 1 lb fresh beet, peeled, grated ( can also use frozen if desired ) | 1/3 cup bisquick, plus | extra bisquick, for moistening each patty
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except the beef, together in large bowl of an electric mixer. Divide bean mixture among 4 burger patties and pat into 6 patties. Place patties on a broiler pan sprayed with cooking spray and arrange on top rack of a broiler pan. Broil until patties are browned and crisp, turning once, for 5 to 10 minutes or until desired doneness. Serve warm.

title: Mushroom Almond Sauce
ingredients: 2 pounds mushrooms, cleaned and stems trimmed | 1 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons almond extract, or to taste | 3/4 teaspoon garlic paste, or to taste
instructions: Place mushrooms into a large saucepan with enough water to cover.

title: Tofu Fonduta With Vanilla Essence
ingredients: 150 g firm tofu | 2 shallots, peeled and finely diced | 1 teaspoon fine salt | french baguette | 2 -3 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Slice the tofu very thin. Sprinkle with the fine salt. Mix the mashed shallots and garlic in a bowl add the toasted french baguette and stir to combine it well. Add the vanilla essence and mix. Heat up the tofu in a dry frying pan and cook until done stirring constantly for few minutes. Towards the end you can take a fork and crush the tofu a few times until it softens. Serve with ice cream for an extravagant french touch.

title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs broccoli | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese ( or other cheese ) | 1/3 cup pickle relish | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup coriander ( optional )
instructions: Break stem off broccoli and break in serving pieces. Boil in 1 inch water until crisp tender. Drain well and let dry in a colander. Cut in half and remove seeds. Combine lettuce, cheese, relish and rice vinegar and add broccoli mixture. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Beet and Red Beet Bites
ingredients: 12 large red beets | 4 tablespoons miracle whip | 2 tablespoons tapioca | 1 tablespoon minced fresh thyme leaves | 1/4 cup miracle whip | 1 jar sweet potatoes, drained, rinsed | lemon wedge
instructions: Place the beets into a large pot, and fill with water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook for about 5 minutes, or until very tender. Drain, and place in a large shallow baking dish. Preheat the oven broiler. Slice the tops off the beets, and carefully peel them. Place them cut side down onto a baking sheet, and broil them for 4 minutes. Turn, and broil the other side for another 2 - 3 minutes, or until the beets' are tender and the tops are lightly charred. Turn off the heat, and stir in the Miracle Whip. Place the thyme onto a plate, and spread the beet slices over the top of the Miracle Whip. Cover, and refrigerate until serving time. Serve with sweet potatoes.

title: Halloumi Hawaiian Style
ingredients: 4 kiwis, peeled and sliced | 4 slices halloumi cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 habanero pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons canola oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place kiwis under running water over a large bowl and gently flatten to separate. Place cheese on parchment paper, overlapping it slightly so that it fits the length of the pan. Sprinkle with vanilla extract. Place a slice of halloumi cheese on top of the cheese. Place habanero pepper slices over the cheese with a small amount of the canola oil or other vegetable oil. Drape a few kiwi slices over the top of the halloumi cheese, and pinch well to seal the mixture. Repeat with remaining kiwi slices. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and has started to turn golden. Allow to set up a few minutes before cutting into wedges.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,panko breadcrumb,mint,wheat tortilla,sumaq,peanut oil,red bean
title: Red Beans and Sizzles With Mint and Sumac
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red beans, boiled and mashed | 1 medium yellow mustard | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon sumaq | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 2 teaspoons roasted peanuts oil | 2 teaspoons mint, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 package wheat tortillas
instructions: Toast panko and sumac, set aside. Roll into 1 inch thick patties, fry. Fry in the panko mixture. Serve with the mint and sumac.

title: Chamomate
ingredients: 4 bananas, ripe and very ripe | 2 tablespoons chamomate fresh gingerroot ( fresh or bottled ) | 1 tablespoon maggi seasoning salt ( i use goya brand )
instructions: Cut bananas in half and remove the seeds. Slice bananas lengthways into half, removing as much skin as possible. Cut each half again into 4 or 5 pieces and set aside. Chop roughly and put into a food processor alongwith the chamomate and the maggi seasoning. Process until completely processed. Pour out seeds and serve as a side dish or accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,breadcrumb,cheese ravioli,peach,iceberg lettuce,blue curacao,heavy cream,mint leaf
title: Grilled Scallop and Pear Ravioli
ingredients: 1/4 cup crushed iceberg lettuce | 1/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1/8 teaspoon blue curacao | 8 ounces uncooked cheese ravioli | 1 lb fresh peaches or 1 lb other firm-ripe green-peach | 4 slices firm ripe peaches | 1 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon minced fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a bowl, combine first 5 ingredients and 1 cup bread crumbs. Set aside. Spray broiler rack with cooking spray. Coat bottom of a grill pan with cooking spray. Arrange ravioli in a single layer on the rack and brush with cooking spray. Grill, turning once, until golden and crisp, about 6 minutes. Transfer with a spatula to a platter and keep warm. Pour remaining 1/4 cup bread crumbs evenly over each piece of dough. Top with sliced peaches and whipped cream. Garnish with mint.

title: Dijon Cherry Tomato, Pineapple and Cheese Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 1 lb cherry tomatoes or 1 lb grape tomatoes | 12 1/2 ounces canned pineapple juice ( drained weight 136g ) | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 3 ounces mature cheddar cheese, shaved ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Cut a cross in the thick end of each tomato and stand upright on a plate. Place tomatoes in a large sieve over a saucepan of just simmering water and cover with a lid and gently boil for 1 minute or until slightly thickened. Transfer to a heatproof plate and set aside to cool slightly. Strain juices from tomato and transfer liquid with the juice to a pan, heat gently then stir in mustard. Season to taste and divide cheese among 4 serving plates. Scatter reserved tomato mixture over cheese and serve.

title: Aunt Dot's Thai Curry Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons panang curry paste | 5 tablespoons fresh dill, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and use as desired.

title: Chipotle Copycat Roast Green Chilies
ingredients: 3 chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large skillet over medium heat. Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 - 4 minute. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. Serve over lettuce, tomato, onion, fresh corn tortillas, croutons, or as suggested on your favorite recipe.

title: Salsa-Crab Cocktail #5FIX
ingredients: 2 packages imitation crabmeat | 1 jar salsa | 2 cups diced scallops | 1/2 ounce red wine | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Place crab meat, salsa and scallops in a large bowl. Mix well. Add wine and pine nuts. Heat a drop of vegetable oil or a tablespoon of olive oil in a small frying pan over medium heat. Place the coated imitation crabmeat into the skillet. Cook on the bottom until the imitation crabmeat is thoroughly cooked. The imitation crab will turn a deep golden brown. Serve with a bowl of red wine on the side.

title: Tofu and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 250 g white fish fillets, cut into 1 centimeter squares | 200 g firm tofu, cut into 1 centimeter squares | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 pint grape tomatoes ( or other vine-ripened tomatoes )
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Lightly grease a shallow baking dish. Place fish and tofu in the dish and bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until tofu is softened.

title: Red Wine and Spice Bread
ingredients: 1 cup red wine | 1 ounce fresh yeast or 1 ounce compressed yeast packet | 1 1/2 cups single cream | 1 1/2 cups double cream or 1 1/2 cups light cream | 6 -7 cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 2 teaspoons salt | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, ground
instructions: Place wine and yeast in a small bowl, cover and set aside for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring until frothy. Stir together the double cream and cream and set aside. Place cardamon, turmeric, salt, peppercorns and 2 tsp of the spice mix in a small, heavy based pan, and gently toast until the turmeric has infused flavour. Stir the remaining spice mix into the cream base, then cover with a cloth and set aside. Combine remaining spices. Pour in the cream and leave to stand slowly for 5 minutes, stirring now and then. The final product should be quite thick and sticky. Pre heat the grill. Butter 2 loaf tins and line them with the bread, overlapping the slices. Pour warm red wine and cream on top and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled in size. Remove from grill and allow to dry for 5 - 10 minutes, then cut into wedges.

title: How to Make Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 8 ounces frozen fettuccine, defrosted according to package directions
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a simmer.

title: Oma's Polenta
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons soda | 1 cinnamon stick
instructions: Put all ingredients into your food processor and blend until you get a smooth, thin batter. Pour into a casserole dish and bake at 400 f for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Glazed Apricot Rice - Risengryn Groen
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white rice, rinsed well and drained | 3 1/2 tablespoons apricot preserves, any flavor | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f spray two baking sheets with cooking spray. Rinse rice, dry and let dry at room temperature for 20 minutes. Place apricot preserves into a small bowl. Sprinkle on rice with grated ginger. Using a slotted spoon, gently but thoroughly rinse rice. Spread rice on the baking sheets, allowing ample room to expand. Place in oven and bake until rice is very lightly colored and has absorbed most of the liquid, 25 to 30 minutes, or according to package directions. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,grainy mustard,mustard powder,red cabbage,microwave popcorn
title: Mustard Crunch Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 small red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 lb cremini mushrooms, sliced or sliced | 12 scoops plain whole grain mustard | 3 tablespoons grainy mustard powder or 3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 3 cups microwavable popcorn, rinsed
instructions: In a large bowl with a snap lid or plastic wrap, combine the cabbage, mushrooms & mustard. Stir in the spice powder. Add 1/4 cup of cornmeal to the cabbage/mustard mixture & toss to coat the mixture evenly. Cover & let stand for 5 minutes. Transfer the popcorn to the prepared cereal bowl & stir to distribute the popcorn evenly. Spoon the popcorn batter evenly onto a large sheet of wax paper & press the mixture gently to spread it evenly. Spray a baking sheet with no stick cooking spray & set aside until crisp. About 2 - 5 minutes before the cakes are removed from the pan, toss the remaining cornmeal with the oil in a large, heavy saucepan over high heat, stir in the remaining mustard, & cook about 3 minutes or until slightly darkened. Quickly drop the popcorn mix into the pan, being careful not to crowd the cake mixture, & stir so the cakes are well coated. Serve immediately. These may then be reheated in a 350 degree f oven for 20 minutes or until crisp. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Spiced Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, unpeeled | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Scrub potatoes, and place potatoes on a medium baking sheet. Brush them with baking soda. Sprinkle potatoes with sesame oil. Grill potatoes for about 15 minutes, or until fork tender.

title: Indonesian Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 2 lbs pork tenderloin ( trimmed of fat ) | lemon peel, shredded ( for dusting ) | 1 -2 tablespoon horseradish ( to taste )
instructions: Combine oil and cumin in a small wok or saute pan and heat on medium high heat, stirring frequently. Add pork, sprinkle with lemon peel, and fry, stirring occasionally, approximately 5 to 10 minutes or until the pork is browned. Add about 2 tablespoons of the horseradish and continue to fry, stirring constantly, until heated. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: red bean,basil leaf,cranberry sauce,gouda cheese,white pepper,meatless sauce,vodka,beef tenderloin
title: Beef Tenderloin With Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cranberry sauce or 3 tablespoons vodka | 4 garlic slices ( about 1/4 cup total, cut in half if using a whole bottle, if using a whole bottle ) | 1 whole beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 4 ounces smoked gouda cheese, shaved | 1/4 cup frozen cooked red beans, thawed | 1/4 cup bertolli meatless sauce | 4 fresh basil leaves, coarsely chopped, basil leaves may be left whole if needed
instructions: Note, the recipe suggests freezing the tenderloin overnight on the grill for the sauce. Drain and refrigerate any leftover sauce. Preheat grill or broiler. Combine cranberry sauce, garlic, and 3 tbsp of the shaved cheese in a small bowl, stirring well and season to taste with white pepper. Cover and chill until ready to use. Put remaining shaved cheese on a plate and lightly oil the grate or broiler pan, or divide among individual serving plates. Grill steak until medium rare and medium doneness on each side, turning once. Transfer to a cutting board and tent with foil. Let stand 10 minutes while you prepare the sauce. Cook onion and garlic in remaining sliced 1/4 cup butter or margarine until translucent, about 1 minute. Add red beans and cook 3 minutes or until heated through. Remove and place in a bowl and stir in the bertolli and cooked cranberry sauce. Taste and adjust seasoning using either black pepper or a pinch of white pepper. Spoon the sauce onto each serving plate and scatter with the basil and the remaining shaved cheese.

title: Pasta Al Relleno or Arrabbiata
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes with juice | 8 ounces penne or 8 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground maraschino cherry, chopped ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried coriander powder ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon dried mint ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt & pepper
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling, salted water to following directions, omitting any oil. Drain well, stir in sauce ingredients and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,double acting baking powder,golden raisin,rosemary,habanero pepper,vegetable bouillon cube,jalapeno pepper
title: Easy Microwave Rosemary Vegetable Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 green jalapeno pepper | 1 yellow bell pepper | 8 ounces golden raisins | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon double-acting baking powder | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon finely minced fresh rosemary | 1 -2 habanero pepper, halved, seeded | 1 tablespoon double-acting baking powder
instructions: Chop jalapeño and bell pepper. Mix all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 5 - 6 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes. You may need to use your microwave oven if you want a more crisper sauce. Transfer to a bowl to cool completely. Once cool add 1 tablespoon baking powder. Add 1 teaspoon double acting baking powder. Stir to combine.

title: Ww 3 Points - Kumquat Spicy Avocado Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1/4 cup long grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 kumquats, seeded, minced or grated medium | 1 tablespoon avocado, diced
instructions: Heat soup, coconut cream, mustard and worcestershire sauce, mixing well. Add kumquats and avacado.

title: Turnip and Strawberry Salad - New Year's Eve
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, peeled and cut into 1 by 1/4 inch pieces | 1/2 lb raspberries in light syrup | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Combine turnips and raspberries in a large bowl.

title: Liptauer Fondue (Liptauer Fondue)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs cooked cubed beef stew meat | 3/4 cup gruyere, grated | hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cut all the fondue in half and place half in a crock pot. Add the cheese and stir. Cook on lo heat for at least 2 hours. Serve with lots of crusty french bread.

title: Chocolate Chimichangas
ingredients: 4 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1/3 cup chocolate | 2 tablespoons serrano chilies, minced | rose water | cayenne
instructions: Combine chocolate, chile and rose water in a bowl.

title: Macaroni Cheese & Apple Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni cheese | 1 lb grated apples
instructions: Preheat over to 350 degrees. Cook macaroni al dente and drain. Place macaroni, cheese, apples and macaroni, as much water as needed, in an oven proof caserole dish. Bake, covered, on stove for about 15 minutes, until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,stewing beef,green cardamom pod,baking potato,tabasco sauce,chive,sourdough bread,mustard seed
title: Beef Stew With Sourdough Crust
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup sherry or 1/4 cup beef stock, made from bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons chives | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 3 -4 green cardamom pods, crushed ( optional ) | 3 -4 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1 unbaked pie shell | 1 floury plain flour or 1 1/2 cups finely crumbled dried sourdough bread
instructions: In a large skillet over high heat, fry beef lightly to flavor. Add in stock, wine, chives, mustard seeds and cardamom pods if using. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered until meat is tender. Serve stew over boiled potatoes and top with crumbled bread.

Random Ingredients: bean,thai fish sauce,quinoa,peanut,liquid smoke flavoring,cooking apple,gruyere cheese,apricot
title: Quinoa-Apple Gratin
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 cup boiling water | cooking apple, diced | 4 ounces cooked sliced pecans, rough chopped ( if not salty enough to go ) or 4 ounces walnuts, chopped ( if not salty enough to go ) | 1 ounce gruyere cheese, grated or 1 ounce emmenthaler cheese, grated | 6 ounces firm bean sprouts, such as napa cabbage, green or red, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bring quinoa and 1 cup of boiling water to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer, covered, 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until cooked, but firm to the bite. When cool enough to handle, fluff quinoa with a fork.

title: Hodie's Easy & Delicious Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans refried beans | 2 cans cannellini beans ( optional ) | 0.5 packet taco seasoning | 1 bag french's french fried onions, chopped | 1 can sliced pitted green olives, drained
instructions: Mix refried beans, cannellini beans, taco seasoning, french fried onions and olives together in medium size bowl until blended. Cover and refrigerate up to one day.

Random Ingredients: paprika,dijon mustard,mint sprig,pimento pepper,scallion,dill,graham cracker crumb,chinese black mushroom
title: Mushroom Ravioli With Pimentos & Russian Dijon Sauce
ingredients: 15 ounces fresh chinese black mushrooms ( sliced 1/8-inch thick ) | 12 ounces pimento pepper ( sliced into 1/8-inch wide strips ) | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 3 tablespoons fresh dill ( chopped ) | 3 tablespoons scallions ( chopped ) | 8 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon paprika
instructions: Place half of mushrooms and half of chinese pimentos in strainer and rinse under hot tap water until water runs clear. Using your hands or a spoon, remove both ends from mushrooms and set aside. Combine mustard, dill, scallions, and chopped mushrooms in a small bowl and set aside. Combine graham cracker crumbs, paprika and remaining chinese pimento strips in another small bowl and set aside. Combine mushroom and dijon mixture and coat the ravioli with this mix. Place on a floured board and roll out to 1/4 inch thickness. Using a pizza cutter, cut through each ravioli until you have a round shape approximately 8 inches square in diameter. Transfer ravioli to baking sheet and brush with a little olive oil. Sprinkle each ravioli with paprika mixture and sprinkle paprika mixture over the ravioli. Bake in a 400 degree oven until crispy and golden about 25 35min.

title: Spinach and Meat Salad
ingredients: 1 kg baby spinach | 200 g lean meat, chopped finely | 100 g salad greens ( red or green ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Boil the greens in a large pan or pot. When just starting to 'drain' add in the meat, stirring to coat everything. Then add in the spinach and mix well. Mix well and remove from heat. Let cool. When cool, add in the coriander powder. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Portobello Mushroom & Onion Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 white onion, diced ( optional ) | 3 portobello mushroom caps
instructions: Saute onion in a small amount of butter or margarine until just softening, about 2 minutes or so. Add mushrooms and continue cooking until softened, about 30 seconds.

title: Baked Rice With Shrimp and Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1 lb shrimp, peeled | 1/2 lb meat | 1/2 lb chicken meat | 4 sun-dried tomatoes, cut into strips with tops | 10 slices tomatoes | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, cut in strips | olive oil
instructions: Prepare rice as per packet directions. Mix shrimp, meat, tomatoes, catsup, and turmeric in a large bowl. Spray a baking pan with cooking spray. Put mixture in pan and place in preheated oven. Place tomatoes on top of rice. Bake about 15 minutes, or until rice is brown and tomatoes are slightly bubbling. Cut tomato slices in strips with a cleaver or kitchen peeler. Serve rice topped with tomato and shrimp mixture. Great with a side of green salad. Variations, cook as directed on the package for pinto bean and green beans, or instead simmer on low for a less dense rice, substitute green beans.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,ranch salad dressing,apple cider,mexican chocolate,salsa verde,white onion,sauce
title: My Version of El Yucatecan's Mexican Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 can sweet beans in natural sauce ( drained ) ( optional ) | 1 medium white onion ( diced ) | 1 can bean sprouts, drained | 4 ounces mexican-style cheese melts ( grated ) | 2 ounces hot sauce | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/4 cup ranch salad dressing ( i prefer to use dijon )
instructions: Place the drained beans and onions in the greased 6x7 microwave safe bowl. Sprinkle with cheese melts if desired. Pour mixture over beans and onions. Microwave at high 1 minute, stirring every minute or so. When the cheese melts, pour over top of bean layer. Spread warm ranch dressing over bean layer.

title: Super Easy One Pan Linguini
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and add the linguine. Cook until tender and drain.. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet. Add the black beans and cook until heated through. Add the linguine to the skillet along with the warmed beans and toss to separate as much as possible. This step of cooking allows even cooking time. Serve and enjoy.

title: Pistachio Pudding
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 3 cups whipping cream | 1 cup of coarsely chopped finely chopped and toasted pound cake
instructions: Pour 1 tablespoons of canola oil into hot water in a small frying pan. When it sizzles, swirl and pour the oil into a bowl. Quickly whip cream in small bowl while slowly drizzle whipping cream on top of canola oil. Add 1 cup of chopped pound cake and mix well. Continue to whisk until smooth and creamy. Fold remaining 1/2 cup of chopped pound cake in with the creamy mixture. Pour into four individual serving dishes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,pumpkin puree,habanero sauce,catsup,jumbo pasta shell
title: Hot and Spicy Pumpkin Pasta Shells
ingredients: 12 jumbo pasta shells, cooked and drained | 2 cans pumpkin puree | 1 1/2 cups catsup | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 3 tablespoons habanero sauce
instructions: Combine pumpkin puree, catsup, caraway seeds, and habanero sauce in a bowl. Add pasta, and toss until coated. Serve immediately.

title: Sliced Sesame Vegetables
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum, deseeded and diced finely | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 175 g sliced prosciutto | 1 bunch mixed vegetables, cut into thin sticks | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons coarse english mustard | 1/2 cup salsa
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan. Add the sesame seeds and stir fry for 30 seconds. Add capsicum, prosciutto and vegetable sticks and stir fry for 2 minutes. Add the dry mustard and stir fry for about 1 minute more or until vegetables are just just tender. Stir in the salsa.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,parmesan cheese,water,rice noodle,swiss cheese,canola oil,ramen noodle
title: Ramen Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package of thin rice noodles | 8 ounces swiss cheese, cut into small pieces | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 8 ounces ramen noodles ( discard seasoning packet ) | water | 1 teaspoon canola oil, divided | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper ( i have used a mix of red and yellow, not scotch bonnet )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cook noodles as per the package directions, omitting seasoning packet. Drain, stir and set aside. To a sprayed 9 x 13 inch baking dish, layer about 2 cups noodles, cheese, noodles and green pepper.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,serrano pepper,french bread,vanilla bean,german mustard
title: Broiled French Bread With Serrano Pepper & Vanilla Beans
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 2 teaspoons german mustard | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, slitted
instructions: Cut the french bread lengthwise in half.

title: Cider Bell Peppers and Leeks
ingredients: 9 large leeks | 1 orange bell pepper | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1/4 cup bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Grease a baking sheet. Cut the top off the leeks, leaving about 4 1/2 inches of green tops and the white bulbs intact. Wash the leeks thoroughly and cut off the root ends. Cut the leeks into 1/2 inch thick slices on the diagonal. Cut the bell pepper into 1 pieces with a sharp knife. Lay the leeks and the orange pepper in a wide, shallow saucer, sprinkle with the vinegar, then cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 40 minutes or until tender and soft. Place the leeks on a serving platter and remove the foil. Stir to mix and serve at room temperature.

title: Laurie's Famous Cream Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons other shortening | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 4 tablespoons brandy ( you decide ) | 1 red chili pepper | 8 fluid ounces cream
instructions: First makeup the base, place the margarine or shortening, oregano, crumbs, red pepper in the top of a double boiler, add the cream. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until the butter has melted and sauce is smooth. Remove from heat and stir. This is not necessary for western dishes or oriental desserts. This is very good on top of other vegetables but also makes a good sandwich filling.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,penne rigate,anaheim chilies,pecan half,tomato green chilies,leek,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheddar and Pecan Penne
ingredients: 1 box penne rigate | 1 can rotel diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 can sliced anaheim chilies | 6 pecan halves | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1/4 cups sharp cheddar cheese | 2 large leeks, thinly sliced
instructions: Cook penne rigate per package instructions for al dente.

title: Truffled Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn on the cob, with husks | 1 head kale, cleaned and coarsely chopped | 500 g raclette cheese
instructions: Preheat your barbecue grill. To make the cornhusks, place the corn with husk side down on a baking tray or grillite. The husks should be 3/4 inch away from the side area. Place the cornhusks onto the tray.

Random Ingredients: beef,coconut powder,extra virgin olive oil,feta cheese,shallot,chicken stock vegetable
title: Creamy Beef and Feta Soup
ingredients: 500 g beef, diced ( any kind of meat you would like ) | 1 shallot ( finely chopped ) | 150 g goat cheese | 3 tablespoons coconut powder ( or a little less ) | 150 ml chicken stock or 150 ml vegetable stock | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a large pot, add extra virgin olive oil over medium heat and add half of the diced meat and the shallots. Cook until meat is lightly browned on all sides. Add coconut powder, stock and cook until the meat is cooked to your liking. Add feta cheese and cook until the cheese has melted. Add other half of the diced meat and heat through. Serve with crusty french bread or potato chips and enjoy.

title: Spinach With Lentils & Smoked Paprika
ingredients: 250 g spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon dried brown lentils | 1 -2 ounce smoked paprika | 2 tablespoons rum | 2 ounces smoked bacon ( optional ) or 2 ounces sliced smoked sausage ( optional )
instructions: Put your spinach in a pan and cover with water. Give it some good press down and bring the water to the boil. Once it comes to the boil, reduce the heat to a medium simmer and cook it for 15 minutes. Add the lentils and cook for an additional 5 - 10 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in smoked paprika and transfer to a serving plate. Slice the bacon into pieces and scatter the slices over the spinach. Pour the spiced rum over the top and sprinkle with smoked paprika.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,black peppercorn,black eyed pea,turmeric
title: Tibetan Style Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas or ( 16 ounce ) can white whole peas, drained | 1 cup beef bouillon cube, crushed | 2 teaspoons turmeric ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Rinse and drain peas. Combine all ingredients in crock pot and cook on high 2 or 3 hours. This can be made in advance and refrigerated or frozen up to 6 weeks.

title: Carnitas
ingredients: 20 fresh tortillas | 2 cans imitation crabmeat, drained and flaked | 2 cans diced tomatoes with chilies | 1 can tomato paste | 1 can diced green chiles, drained | 1/4 cup anise seed
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Split and roll the tortillas with a moist paper towel or paper towels to crisp and dampen the tortillas completely. Spread a layer of the tortillas onto the bottom of the greased baking dish. Lay a few pieces of crabmeat over the tortillas. Sprinkle half of the tomatoes with chilies, and half of the tomato paste. Repeat layers until all ingredients have been used. Cover, and bake in the preheated oven until bubbling, about 1 hour. Uncover, and bake until heated through, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,tomato juice,stilton cheese,onion salt,almond extract,granny smith apple
title: Stilton Apple Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cut lengthwise into wedges | 3 ounces stilton cheese, grated | 1/3 cup finely chopped onion, such as vidalia | 1 tablespoon fresh tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 pinch onion salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees and butter a large baking sheet. In a small serving bowl mash together the stilton cheese, onion, tomato juice, almond extract, and salt. Add potato wedges and toss lightly. Spread mixture onto prepared baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes or until heated through and center is tender. Serve warm. Note, the cheese mixture can be frozen for up to 1 month.

title: Linguinguine With Smoked Fish
ingredients: 1 lb smoked fish | 2 1/2 cups fish stock | 6 cups short-grain rice or 6 cups arborio rice
instructions: Remove skin from smoked fish as much as possible, without damaging bones and skin. Slice both bones lengthwise. Bring fish stock and smoked fish to a boil in a large stockpot.

title: Wild Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 -16 large fresh wild mushrooms | mushroom, fresh ( optional )
instructions: Rinse mushrooms, cut in half if clean and slit fresh mushrooms. Steam or sauté mushrooms and shallots until soft and tender, adding a little bit of water if they get too dry. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,cherry tomato,chili sauce,kielbasa,cocoa,apple juice,oat,red wine vinegar
title: Italian Tomato and Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb other sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 3/4 cup apple juice or 3/4 cup water | 2 teaspoons cocoa | 1 1/2 lbs cherry tomatoes, halved | 6 tablespoons rolled oats | 1/2 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Place sausage in a medium skillet and cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Add chili sauce, vinegar, juice/water and cocoa and bring to boil. Turn heat down to medium and cook for 5 minutes, or until thickened. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Place tomato halves on a plate and top with a generous layer of sausage, then sprinkle with oats and roll with cocoa. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,tomato juice,thyme sprig,coriander seed,pork sparerib,rice,ginger garlic paste
title: Baked Sea Bass and Rice
ingredients: sea bass fillets, with the bones and skin removed | 2 cans tomato juice | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 2 slices fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 lbs raw pork spareribs | 1 1/2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a roasting pan, combine the tomato juice, coriander seeds, ginger garlic paste, thyme, and pork spareribs. Season with additional seasonings, if desired, and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Transfer the pork and spareribs into the roasting pan. Pour enough tomato juice into the pan to come just halfway up the sides of the pan. Sprinkle the rice into the pan. Transfer to the oven, and bake until the rice is tender and the juices have absorbed, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,salad oil,cellophane noodle,lima bean,cooking spray,red pepper,lettuce
title: Sweet N' Savory Cellophane Sprouts

instructions: Cover noodles with room temperature water and cook according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Rinse with cold water and dry in a towel using a paper towel. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add red pepper and noodles.

title: Asian Snow Peas and Prions
ingredients: 1 lb snow peas, strings removed | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Slice the snow peas diagonally into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Set aside. Cut the green pepper into 1 inch pieces. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, partially cover and simmer for 5 minutes. The snow peas should be crisp tender. Remove from the heat. Cover and set aside to steam for five minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cod,kielbasa sausage,soymilk,caraway seed,hot water,rigatoni pasta,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Mediterranean Cod With Kielbasa, Raisins, and Caraway Seed Sauce #Ragu
ingredients: 2 lbs cod, fillet, cubed | vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 1 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup raisins ( not dried ) | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 teaspoon hot water | 1 package kielbasa sausage, sliced | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, uncooked
instructions: Prepare the fish per the package directions. Heat oil in a deep skillet or frying pan on medium high and fry the cod until golden brown and crispy. Remove from oil and set aside. Cook rigatoni pasta according to the package directions. Drain, add to sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,cornmeal,broth,phyllo pastry,chickpea flour,broccoli floret,dark rum
title: Chickpea Croquettes

Repeat with the remaining pastry sheets, filling to the desired shape and placing on a baking tray. Brush the tops with a little melted dark chocolate. Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden. Serve.

title: Italian Beans Wrapped in Bacon

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Peel and slice potatoes into 1/8 thick slices. Place in large mixing bowl and add all remaining ingredients except peanuts. Bake at 350°f for 40 minutes, then top with bacon slices and bake for 10 minutes longer. Serve with garlic bread for a beautiful finish.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,lime juice zest,cardamom seed,cream mushroom soup,sesame oil,okra,red chilies,milk

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Grease a loaf pan. Toss okra with sesame oil and place evenly in pan. Mix soup, chilies, lime peel and lime juice, add to pan and toss to evenly coat okra. Sprinkle with rosemary sprinkle evenly with cardamom seeds. Bake 40 - 45 minutes. Serve over white rice.

Random Ingredients: green onion,onion powder,red curry paste,dark chocolate,blueberry,plain yogurt
title: Chilled Blueberry & Red Curried Yogurt Dip With Blueberry and Onions
ingredients: 12 slices dark chocolate ( i used semi skimmed ) | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted ( i used baking spice brand ) | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt ( i used keto ) | 2/3 cup chopped green onion ( white and light green parts, 1/3 each ) | 3 tablespoons red curry paste or 3 tablespoons green chili hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Line a large cookie sheet with foil and place inside. In a small bowl, mix together the melted dark chocolates and melted dark chocolate. In another small bowl, stir together the yogurt, chopped green onions & chopped red curry paste with a fork. Add this to the yogurt mixture and stir till well combined. Stir in the optional green chili or onion powder. Cover and chill for about 1 hour and serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,asafoetida powder,egg noodle,green olive,cremini mushroom
title: Mushroom and Cremini Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package uncooked egg noodles, uncooked | 5 cups chopped cremini mushrooms | 5 green olives, halved and pitted | 1/2 cup italian-style salad dressing mix | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional )
instructions: Cover a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil. Stir in the egg noodles and return to a boil. Add the olives, italian dressing mix, and asafoetida powder to the mushrooms and olives and mix until well blended. If desired, may be topped with crumbled bacon slices.

title: Crispy Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup basmati rice | 4 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons tomato soup | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: In a large microwave safe bowl add all ingredients. Cover the bowl and microwave on high for 6 minutes. Fluff rice, stir again, and serve hot. Variation, when adding rice to hot wok, add 1 tsp cornstarch. Serve hot, hot or cold. Variation, add 1 tbsp of cornstarch to mixture. Microwave on high for 2 minutes until dissolved, then microwave on high for 1 minute until thick, stirring now and then.

title: Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 600 g lamb, cut into 1 in pieces | 100 g fresh key lime yogurt | 1 egg yolk | 1 cup half-and-half or 1 cup low-fat milk
instructions: Mix together yogurt with egg yolk until creamy, add half and half or milk. Place lamb on tray on grill. When all pieces are coated with yogurt mixture, grill meat until just barely cooked through. Serve with marinade.

title: Korean Steamed Rosemary-Peach Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecan pieces | 3 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 2 tablespoons minced peeled fresh gingerroot | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 8 -10 fresh curry leaves | 24 ounces frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
instructions: Stir together first 4 ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes prior to serving.

title: Apple Cheddar
ingredients: 12 medium red apples | 1 cup grated white asiago cheese | 1/2 cup finely grated asiago cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped celery | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Peel the apples and cut away the hard core, leaving 1 inch of core in all. Core each half if there is a core. Core the second apple and cut into quarters. Place the peeled apples in a large bowl and sprinkle the 2 cheeses over the top. Using your hands, spread 1/4 cup of the asiago cheese over the top of the apples. Sprinkle with the celery and cayenne. Cover the bowl and refrigerate the container for at least an hour.

title: Broccoli With Sherry and Sherry
ingredients: 1 head broccoli floret, ends chopped off, leaves chopped to 1-inch | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Steam or steam the broccoli in a steamer basket over boiling water until barely tender, about 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Toasted Italian Shell and Barley Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked jumbo pasta shells | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 1/2 cups diced firm-ripe franks ( see note for recipe link ) | 1 cup frozen frozen franks ( see note for recipe link ) or 1 cup frozen franks ( see note for recipe link ) | 2/3 cup dried italian seasoning | 1 package frozen mixed frozen vegetables | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package and drain. In large bowl, combine pasta with boiling water and barley.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,tomato paste,chocolate chunk,truffle,vanilla extract
title: Truffled Chocolate Chipped Chili Strips With Green Chillies
ingredients: 6 ounces chocolate chunks | 2 ounces tomato paste, see note | 2 teaspoons dried truffles, see note | 1 green chili pepper, such as jalapeno | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Melt the chocolate chunks in a small saucepan. Stir until smooth. Heat the tomato paste and truffle sauce in the microwave briefly. Stir in the chile and cook 1 minute longer. Pour the chile mixture into a shallow non aluminium container, and sprinkle the mixture with the vanilla. Allow chocolate to harden for about 1 minute, stir, then chill for 30 minutes.

title: Sherry Vinegar Chicken bouillon - Pollo Borracho
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon | 3/4 cup sherry wine
instructions: Place bouillon in a medium saucepan. Add sherry to bouillon. Add enough water to equal 1 cup.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,beef bouillon,irish whiskey,dark soy sauce
title: Sweet and Sour Caramelized Beef Cubes
ingredients: 1/2 cup light dark soy sauce | 1/8 cup light beef bouillon ( or 3-6 pieces of beef rib soaked in water for 10 minutes ) | 8 kaffir lime leaves or 1 small lime leaf, chopped to 1/2 | 3 1/2 - 4 lbs beef cubes ( or lamb )
instructions: In a heavy bottomed non reactive pan, combine all the ingredients and place over medium high heat. Once the liquid is simmering and bubbling, reduce the heat and continue to stir. Cook, stirring frequently, until the meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,ginger,pineapple juice,rice flour,chuck steak,cornstarch,rice noodle,oat
title: Noble House Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/4 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 3/4 lb flank steak | 1/4 cup rice flour | 3 tablespoons rice noodles, soaked in hot water and drained | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, minced | 5 cups bean sprouts | 3/4 cup oats
instructions: Stir cornstarch and 1/4 cup of the pineapple juice in a small bowl. Trim and discard ends of steak. Slice steak into thin strips about 1/2 inches wide and 1/4 inch thick. Stir fry steak on high heat about 3 minutes until meat is no longer pink. Remove from heat and add 2 tablespoons of the cornstarch. Stir until dissolved. Add remaining 1/4 cup pineapple juice, noodles and ginger. Heat through, stirring constantly. Add bean sprouts and bring to a boil. Return beef and pineapple mixture to the skillet. Cook about 3 - 5 minutes until heated through. Serve over noodles.

title: Spicy Indian Beans

instructions: Heat cream, appleauce, and cardom powder in a saucepan over medium high heat until mixture simmers. Reduce heat and cook until sauce thickens. Remove from heat and add both cans of beans and ham strips. Add hot cream to bean mixture and serve.

title: Rice Crust

instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together flour, thyme, oregano and oats. Combine 1 cup water and remaining 1 cup water in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Add rice.

title: Easy Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice, washed and drained well ( or use brown basmati rice or long grain rice ) | 1 tablespoon mango chutney or 1 tablespoon major grey chutney
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let sit for an hour or two to allow flavors to blend. Adjust seasoning if desired.

title: Italian Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round roast or 1 1/2 lbs italian lamb, trimmed of all fat and cut into 4 serving size slices | 1 small baking powder | 2 tablespoons hot sauce, such as tabasco
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°. Line a baking sheet with a silpat or parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the ground beef with baking powder and hot sauce. Using your hands, thoroughly coat the beef with the spice mixture. Use a large spatula to transfer the beef to the prepared pan. Bake for 35 minutes, or until juices are clear and meat is golden brown.

title: Sauerkraut, Spinach and Lemon (Gramma's Recipe)
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh baby spinach | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( i used zest of 1 lemon ) | 1 cup sauerkraut, well drained
instructions: Spray cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350°f. Toss everything in large bowl. Bake 20 minutes until spinach is wilted. This is great with rice or egg noodles.

title: Kluski Noodles - Sriracha Kinos
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen kluski noodles ( see kluski noodles ) | 1/2 cup sriracha sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Cook kluski noodles according to package directions. While still hot, stir the sriracha sauce until melted and smooth. Drain noodles and return to package. Add the sriracha sauce and vanilla. Stir well. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Serve at once.

title: Peasehynes' Scottish Pea Soup

instructions: Toast the peppercorns in a dry pan. Cool, chop finely. Use the peppercorns to make a base for the soup for later use. Place stock in a stock saucepan and bring to the boil. Add parsnips and peas and simmer for 20 minutes. Add peppercorns. Serve with bread to soak up the flavour.

title: Chinese 5 Second Shooter

instructions: Pour ingredients into a shot glass and slowly pour cocktail over. Shake the drink with ice then pour.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. To make the puffs, sift and mix all ingredients and roll 1/2 tbsp into a ball with floured hands, flatten slightly between palms. Cut into 8 wedges. Bake on a non stick cookie sheet for 10 mins, or until just golden brown.

title: Okra, Baked With Apples & Cinnamon

instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place pasta in a large bowl. Add okra, apple and cinnamon. Mix to combine. Place a layer of okra mixture on the far end of each ramekin. Cover with more okra mixture. Roll up, placing a long end under the okra mixture. Place ramekins on a baking tray and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown.

instructions: Preheat oven to mix flour, cornmeal, five spice powder and almond extract in a medium bowl with fingers until well incorporated, about 10 pulses. Spoon remaining batter into a 9x5x3 inch loaf pan. Sprinkle each serving with some crushed corn chips. Bake bread for 25 - 35 minutes or til toothpick inserted comes out slightly clean.

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain well. Combine vinegar, tahini, brandy and 1/4 cup mint in small bowl, stir well. Let stand 10 minutes. Mix pasta with spinach, parmesan, pecorino, and next 5 ingredients, toss. Pour dressing over noodles.

title: Crock Pot Thai Beef Steak Sandwich

instructions: Cut the beef into thin slices. I use a meat chop slicer to slice the meat. I don't really like long slices so it makes a lot. instructions: Place the stock in the container of a sieve and set aside. Combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan and heat stirring until hot but not boiling. Pour over the chicken and marinate until cooked through.

title: Green Chile Rellenos

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease cookie sheet or 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Lay out biscuits on cookie sheet to avoid breaking. title: Easy Pressure Cooker Bay Shrimp
