instructions: Heat bacon grease in a pressure cooker over medium heat until a crust forms with no visible visible signs of browning, about 10 minutes. Add shrimp, and cook until shrimp are cooked through, about 10 minutes. Serve with french fries.

title: Spicy Southwest Chard With Pineapple
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice | 1/4 cup salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon minced thyme | 1/2 teaspoon mace, crushed | 2 cups mixed swiss chard, in one bun | 1/2 cup rice krispies
instructions: Combine orange juice, salsa, paprika, thyme, mace and swiss chard in glass bowl. Cover and chill in refrigerator at least 4 hours, but no longer than 12 hours. To serve, place equal portions of the swiss chard on each of 2 plates. Divide the orange mixture evenly among the 2 plates. Sprinkle with rice cereal before serving.

title: Shredded Beef and Lamb Racks
ingredients: 4 lamb racks | 1/4 cup canola oil | 10 fluid ounces beer | 1 teaspoon splenda granular | 2 1/4 lbs beef bones with marrow | leek ( scallions ) | 2 tablespoons chopped white onions | 3 slices canned bamboo shoots, cut into halves
instructions: Cut racks into quarters. Set aside. Combine 4 tablespoons of canola oil and beer in a large saucepan. Heat. Add splenda and beef bones. Cook over medium heat, and stir in beef and broth mixture to reach mix. Cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour. Meanwhile, place a heavy duty aluminum foil in a roasting pan. Place beef racks on foil and place in foil. Bake, covered, in a 300°f oven for 70 - 80 minutes. Stir and cook for an additional 15 minutes or until meat is well browned. To serve, remove from oven and cover with foil. Cover with heated sauce and sprinkle with chopped onion.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,mint jelly,chicken breast,saffron thread,mozzarella cheese
title: Grilled Chicken Queso
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced on diagonal | 1 cup fresh mint jelly | 10 -12 saffron threads | 3 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 gallon vanilla ice cream | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place the sliced chicken between two pieces of plastic and pound slightly with your fists or the flat side of a large meat mallet. Spread the jumbo saffron over the chicken and marinate at least 10 minutes. Meanwhile, line a heavy large grill pan with aluminum foil and set over medium heat. When the pan is hot, place the chicken in the center and sprinkle with about 3 tablespoons of the adobo jinade. Quickly pour or squeeze the remaining jinade into the pan, stirring to dissolve until the jelly dissolves. Lower the heat to low, then set aside. Grill the chicken approximately 2 minutes per side, until the chicken is just no longer pink on the outside and the juices run clear. Turn the chicken over, then cook until the second side is just pink. Place the grilled chicken, cut side down, on a cutting board and let it rest for about 10 minutes. When the chicken is cooled, slice into 1/2 to 1 inch strips. While the chicken is cooking, place the remaining saffron over low heat. When the pan is hot, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of adobo sauce in the pan. Remove from the heat. Taste and add more chipotle pepper if needed. Place the ice cream in a plastic container for a few minutes to soften slightly. Drain the ice cream and place on plates. Place the chicken breast strips on top of the ice cream. Top with the saffron jelly. Ladle the hot sauce on top of the grilled chicken. Add the mozzarella. Serve immediately.

title: Amarula Mousse
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Clean the mushrooms. Slice them in half and remove the outer dark green leaves. Chop the stems with scissors. Add it to a bowl, mix well. Add the amarula cream and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Churros
ingredients: 1 cup egg yolk | 1 cup diced avocado | 1 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: In a small bowl, combine egg yolk, avocado, green bell pepper, and turmeric. Beat egg mixture into yolk mixture. Chill 1 hour, or until ready to serve.

title: Chiles and Capers for Two
ingredients: 20 dried ancho chiles | 1 can refried beans | 1 ounce capers | bread, pieces toasted, bread torn into pieces, for dipping
instructions: To make a hot tapenade by placing the chiles in a bowl and sprinkling with water to cover, cover and let sit for 1 - 2 hours. Drain. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f place a single layer of toast in a baking dish. Spread half of the dried ancho chiles on toast and sprinkle with capers. Spoon a small amount of refried beans over the top. Place remaining ancho chiles on top and cover with remaining toast. To serve, spread warm liquid over toast. Sprinkle with a little more ancho chile, if desired.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,rotel,gravy,beef stew meat,sesame seed,bouillon cube,water,cumin
title: Simple Slow Cooker Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 jar rotel ( hot ) | 1 bottle apple juice | 1 cup water | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon cumin | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons gravy
instructions: In a crock pot place stew meat, carrots, water, and bouillon cube. Add all other ingredients and stir to blend. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Serve over rice or with pita bread.

title: Herring Salad (Jandraphsi Kwasaki)

instructions: Boil 2 cups of water with 1 tbsp white vinegar until very soft. Keep it aside. Cut the herring into 2cm cubes. Chop the scallions thinly. Arrange the salad on plates and top with the diced herrings. Add the remaining dressing and serve immediately.

title: Strawberries Stuffed With Spiced Liver
ingredients: 600 g fresh strawberries | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 60 g sliced liver
instructions: Wash whole strawberries carefully. Cut the stalks into halves by cutting off the stems. Cut the stalks into 2 pieces. Mix together 1/2 tsp cardamom, 1/2 tsp thyme and 1/2 tsp dried thyme in a bowl. Cut the liver into thin slices. Add 1/2 tsp cardamom, 1/2 tsp thyme and 1/2 tsp thyme to the strawberries. Mix the strawberries and liver together. Put the mixture in a baking dish, cover with clingfilm and put in the fridge until needed. Preheat oven to 200°c. Put 1 tbsp liver in a frying pan over med high heat and fry until it turns brown, turning over once. Drain on paper towel. Keep the strawberries from drying out. Put the rest of the liver in the same frying pan over med high heat and fry up until golden on all sides. Remove from heat and place on a plate. Remove the stems from the strawberries, then put into a bowl with your hands and add your strawberries and the rest of the liver. Mix and add the remaining 1 tbsp of cardamom, 1/2 tsp thyme, and 1/4 tsp dried thyme, mix well. Spoon out the stuffing into a baking dish. Fill the strawberries with the stuffing. Drizzle with a little bit of olive oil and top with the remaining liver. Bake in the oven for 10 - 25 minute. Enjoy.

title: Pork Loin

instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Combine fat, sage and salt and pepper. Rub over pork. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Line shallow roasting pan with aluminum foil. Add pork and marinate at least 30 minutes in mixture. Grill or broil meat to desired doneness, 15 minutes per pound for medium rare. Serve with gravy or vegetables.

title: Pasta With  Flavored Shredded Baked Shells
ingredients: 8 ounces pasta ( small shell, stars or quorni are all i had ) | 2 cans of canned bamboo shoot ( any of the kind is fine ) | white flour, for dredging | bamboo shoot oil ( to saute )
instructions: Boil the pasta according to package directions. Drain and toss well with the sauce. If the pasta needs more water, use more or less. Toss again briefly while the pasta is cooking. Sprinkle generously with any kind of your own flavoring and serve alongside the bamboo shoots.

title: Baked Risotto With Lentils

instructions: Heat oven 200c. Pour olive oil into a baking dish and scatter around the risotto. Bake for about 40 - 45 mins or until golden. Meanwhile, cook lentils. Cook rice. Drain and rinse. Heat remaining oil in a pan, then add the lentils, butter, cream, mixed spice and peas. Cook until the peas are just tender. Stir into the rice. Put the dish into a warm oven, cover and bake for 40 mins on 200c. Stir a bit of the rice onto the risotto and serve.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,rice flour,yellow onion,golden raisin,mint leaf,black eyed pea,chunky salsa,baking soda
title: Killer Black-Eyed Peas Risotto
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked rice flour | 1 medium yellow onion, diced | 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons packed fresh mint leaves | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium, heavy pot with a lid, combine the rice flour and onion. Stir in the black eyed peas, baking soda, onion powder, mint leaves, salsa, and raisins. Stir constantly over medium heat until the mixture begins to thicken. Transfer the mixture to the prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 to 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted into the center of the risotto comes out clean.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,green cardamom pod,tabasco sauce,coriander seed,walnut,flour
title: Swedish Spiced Nuts and Cheese.
ingredients: 1 lb salted walnuts | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 2 tablespoons green cardamom pods | 5 allspice berries | tabasco sauce ( optional ) | flour ( optional )
instructions: Put nuts in a large frying pan or fryer and brown on both sides. Cool. Place nuts and spices in a spice mill or small mortar and add a little water to make a paste and rub into the nuts. Pour into containers and leave overnight. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Guilt-Free Mango Chutney
ingredients: 3 tablespoons seedless raisins | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 jar mange-tout peas, drained | 12 stringy pieces, or more as desired
instructions: Place raisins in a medium bowl, and mash with a fork, or potato masher. Mix in mango chutney, cumin, and mange tout pea pods. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 2 hours. To serve, serve topped with stringy pieces.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,nonstick cooking spray,chili powder,green pepper,spinach noodle,bamboo shoot,cayenne
title: Chile Noodle Salad
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 6 ounces spinach noodles, dried | 1 can bamboo shoot, julienned | 1 green pepper, diced | 1/3 cup mint leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Toast chili powder with cayenne for 1 minute. Whisk together. Add hot noodles to skillet. Cook 2 to 3 minutes until slightly browned. Drain noodles. Add bamboo shoots. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through. Add green pepper and mint. Toss. Sprinkle with chili powder and cayenne.

title: Sunflower Seed Granola
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 1 vanilla bean, split | 1/2 cup unsweetened pineapple syrup, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 8x4 inch glass dish or pan with cooking spray. Combine the seeds, vanilla bean and pineapple syrup in a food processor, process briefly until seeds just jump to the surface. Remove seeds from processor and stir in 1 tablespoons of seeds mixture. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 1 hour or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,cornflour,lettuce leaf,mustard powder,pork shoulder,ginger root,chicken
title: Pork Vindaloo
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 2 tablespoons coarsely ground cornflour | 1 tablespoon skinned and ground mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 1 pound finely chopped pork shoulder | 1 package lettuce leaves
instructions: Cut chicken into six pieces. Place chicken and cornflour in a bowl, then stir in mustard, fenugreek, ginger, pork, and lettuce. Pour enough water over mixture until mixture has a consistency of gravy.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,alfredo sauce,tabasco sauce,plain yogurt,green chili pepper,jasmine rice,corn
title: Spicy Rice and Vegetables, Alfredo Sauce, and Chili
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1/2 cup frozen peas and corn | 1/4 lb green chili pepper, minced | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup mild prepared alfredo sauce | 2 drops tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Place jasmine rice in pan with 2 cups water and bring to boil over high heat. When water comes to a boil, stir and cover. Reduce heat to low and cook. After 30 minutes, remove from heat. When rice is cooked, place peas and corn in colander and run under warm water until water runs clear. Rinse rice under cold water. Drain. Over medium high heat, add green chili pepper and stir fry for 2 minutes. Stir in yogurt and set aside. Stir alfredo sauce and tabasco sauce with rice mixture. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Sprinkle garam masala over top and serve.

title: Tortillas Con Carne (Rostrich Toast)
ingredients: 2 lbs rump roast | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/4 cup vincotto | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 12 -16 french bread | 12 tortillas ( soft or crunchy )
instructions: Cut meat from bones & discard bones. Cook meat for about 30 minutes. Add rest of ingredients except tortillas & tortillas. Cook for about 40 minutes on low heat. Slice bread into strips & arrange in a serving bowl. Pour hot meat & sauce over tortillas & serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,green bell pepper,liquid smoke,puff pastry,cucumber,cooking oil,molasses,fennel seed
title: Vegan French Bread Pizza
ingredients: 1 medium green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon molasses | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dried italian parsley | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 medium cucumber, sliced thin
instructions: Cut bell pepper lengthwise in half. Scoop out seeds. Reserve. Place bell pepper in microwave safe bowl. Top with liquid smoke and molasses. Microwave on high 15 seconds to soften. Microwave 30 seconds longer. Stir to blend. Meanwhile, heat oil in 15 inch skillet. Add parsley, fennel, and salt and pepper to taste. Saute 1 minute, stirring often. Transfer bell pepper and liquid to resealable plastic zipper bag or small bowl and reserve. Microwave on high 30 seconds. Stir. Unfold puff pastry on lightly floured board, then with floured hands, roll onto floured board to a 13x9inch rectangle. Brush with oil. Arrange in single layer in skillet. Roast in 375 degree oven 20 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Turn over, brush both sides with oil. Roast 7 - 10 minutes more or until golden.

title: Apple Bourbon Hoagies
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1/4 cup apple juice ( reserved from can for roasting ) | 1/2 cup bourbon | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 3/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 6 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise | 1/4 ounce unsweetened chocolate, shaved
instructions: Combine tomatoes, apple juice, bourbon, ginger and pepper in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,napa cabbage,jalapeno pepper,extra tofu,pine nut,radish,red radish
title: Crunchy, Fat-Free Kimchee Kebab
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, diced | 1/3 cup pine nuts, toasted | 3/4 cup napa cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup red radish, shredded | 1/4 cup red radish, shredded | 2 teaspoons pickled jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 cup radish, slices sliced diagonally
instructions: Place tofu in microwaveable, covered microwave safe dish with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for about 3 minutes, or until thoroughly heated. Stir until smooth. Cover, and continue with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Ancho-Pepito
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ancho chiles or 1 tablespoon jalapeno, minced | 2 pints cooked pumpkin | 1 package linguine
instructions: Heat the chile to a boil in a small pan, about 1 minute. Remove and set aside. Slice the pumpkin into chunks about 1/4 inch in size, then remove seeds and fibers. Heat 2 cups of water in a deep 12 inch skillet and add the pumpkin. Cook for about 10 minutes, or until the pumpkin is tender and all the liquid has been absorbed. Sauté the pepito in the chile water for about 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Scoop out the pumpkin chunks, and mix them into the sauce. Bring to a boil, and then simmer until the sauce has thickened somewhat. Serve over linguine.

title: Cranberry Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 chili | 1 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Put all ingredients in a crock pot and cook on high for 2½ hours. Remove chili powder from crock pot and remove the stems. Stir in water and serve as directed. Stirring for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,colby monterey jack cheese,turmeric,chicken breast,lamb shoulder,chili powder,orange peel
title: Mexican Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 6 tablespoons colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 12 small eggplants | 12 pieces lean ground lamb shoulder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Mix turmeric, chili powder and orange peel. Slice chicken lengthwise, at a 45 degree angle, about 1/4 inch thick, and place between 2 sheets of waxed paper on a nonstick baking sheet. Wrap each breast tightly with chicken breast and then with eggplant. Roll chicken in cheese and place on baking sheet. Bake about 20 minutes or until done. While chicken breasts are baking, warm 2 tablespoons of oil in deep nonstick skillet, over low heat. Add lamb and saute until done, stirring often, about 7 minutes. Remove from heat and keep warm. Serve sauce over chicken, garnish as desired.

title: Krisi's Low Fat Green Chile and Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons low fat natural fat vanilla yogurt | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 medium eggplant | 1 can large green chilies | 1/2 cup low fat plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in a blender or food processor, process until smooth. Set aside. Cut stem end off of eggplant, then peel skin off and discard. Cut stem end off all around the stem as well. Slice off the top just below stem end, leaving a small opening about 1/2 inch deep. Place all of the chilies into a food processor and place on the flat side of the processor. Pulse 3 or 4 times. Add 1/2 cup yogurt and process 1 or 2 times. Stop to taste test for salt and pepper. If necessary, add more yogurt. Pour into an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving. Serve with tortilla chips, assorted corn chips, veggies, etc.

title: Chili Molasses Bread Dipping Sauce  (for Toast)
ingredients: 1/2 cup light molasses | 3 tablespoons finely chopped red chili peppers ( i have a `` thai red chili '' blend in the freezer ) | 1/2 cup dry cornbread mix | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves ( omit if using fresh basil ) | chili ( optional )
instructions: Put molasses in microwave safe bowl, and cover with water. Microwave on high for 10 - 12 minutes or until molasses is just warm.. Combine chili, cornbread mix, cocoa and basil in medium mixing bowl. Stir in molasses. Add more salt and/or sugar to taste if desired. Serve warm with toast.

Random Ingredients: butter,beef tenderloin,heavy cream,burgundy wine,whipping cream,oregano leaf
title: Beef Fillet au Beurre (Zwt-9)
ingredients: 3 1/2- lbs beef tenderloin, about 6 steaks ( approx 1-6 oz. ) | 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons burgundy wine | 2/3 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup dry oregano leaves | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a medium skillet melt two tablespoons of the butter over medium heat. When the butter stops foaming, add 2 tablespoons of the butter to the pan.

title: Amazing Low Fat Salsa Bacon Salad
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1 cup cheap chunky salsa
instructions: Place bacon in a skillet & cook over medium heat until crispy but not yet a bit crunchy.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,mace,radish,black bean,pepper sauce,balsamic vinegar,dark raisin
title: Balsamic & Raisin Crostini With Black Bean & Radish Dressing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 1/2 cups fat-free ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup shredded dark raisin | 12 ounces cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup sliced black olives | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Whisk vinegar & hot pepper sauce in small bowl. In bowl, combine ricotta, raisins, beans, olives and mace. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add dressing to cheese mixture & toss to coat. Divide filling among 8 breaded crostini/serve.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,black eyed pea,garlic paste,peanut,celery leaf
title: Hoya Peanut
ingredients: 20 dried black-eyed peas | garlic paste | 8 -10 handfuls unsalted peanuts ( to be roasted first in a pan with a little water ) | 1 handful roasted peanuts | freshly chopped mint leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Soak the peas for at least 6 hours. Drain. Put the peas and a few drops of garlic over the top of water until it just covers them and leave in a pot with the rest of the water for 5 hours. Drain. Put the peanuts and 2 tablespoons of roasted peanuts into a mortar and crush them to a paste. Place the mint leaves into another mortar with plenty of water, pound them until they are coarsely chopped. Add this to the pot with the split peas and peanuts and stir fry the mixture until the split peas are dry. Add the remaining 4 tablespoons of roasted peanuts and mix well. Put on a serving platter and sprinkle with roasted peanuts. Garnish with dried mint leaves, if using.

Random Ingredients: green plantain,spaghetti,extra beef,mango chutney,rice paper,maple syrup,barbeque sauce
title: Hot Faux Stuffed Rolls
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 2 green plantains, sliced lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 2 teaspoons maple syrup | 8 sheets rice paper | 2 cups thinly sliced cooked extra beef | 2 cups barbecue sauce, or more as needed | 1/4 cup mango chutney, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain. Arrange the uncooked spaghetti in a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until rice paper are slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Cook 2 plantains using the rice paper as an option, about 3 minutes. Spread 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup on the cut sides of each roll. Cover with another slice of plantain and close the rolls using a toothpick. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook the rolls in the hot skillet until hot, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove from skillet and set aside. To serve, pour barbecue sauce into the hot skillet and boil until reduced by half, about 3 minutes. To serve, top each roll with 1/2 cup hot barbecue sauce, 1 tomato slice, or 2 plantains.

Random Ingredients: pepper,curry leaf,cake flour,sharp cheddar cheese,lemon juice,almond paste,tamari,dill pickle
title: Savouries: Lamb or Beef Rouladen (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 kg rouladen or 1 kg beef rouladen | 1/2 cup cake flour | 8 pieces dill pickles, cut into thick rounds ( thin slices ) | 1/4 cup tamari | 3/4 cup sweet pepper paste ( kecap manis ) | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese or 1/2 cup gruyere cheese | 3/4 cup almond paste or 3/4 cup olive oil | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 3 -4 curry leaves
instructions: Place the beef rouladen pieces in the bottom of your crock pot then sprinkle them with flour. Arrange the pickles, jam and cheese on top. Mix the almond paste and lemon juice in the top of the beef rouladen and pour over the cheese. Pour in lemon juice and curry leaves. Set the crock pot to high and cook for 3 1/2 hours. Serve with boiled or steamed pasta.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,italian plum tomato,chinese wine,kirsch,salsa,salad oil,pepper sauce,grape tomato
title: Roasted Cauliflower With Hot Dressing and Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 pint grape tomatoes or 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1 cup bottled salsa | 1/4 - 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons kirsch ( optional ) | salad oil ( for sauteing )
instructions: Roast the cauliflower at 375 - 375 degrees in 2 1/2 to 3 quarts of lightly salted boiling water for 40 to 50 minutes, occasionally checking for doneness with a knife. Set aside to cool.

Random Ingredients: okra,oregano leaf,spaghetti sauce,grain spelt flour,sage,white chocolate,milk,new potato
title: Pasta With Okra and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb small new potato ( about 3 ) | 1 cup chopped okra ( about 2/3 ) | 3 tablespoons spelt flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crumbled | 1/4 teaspoon sage, dried ( rubbed between fingers to release flavour ) | 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce ( i prefer newman's own house cooking club brand with herbs ) | 1 cup 1 % low-fat milk | 6 ounces white chocolate, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan of lightly salted water, bring 4 quarts of salted water to a boil. Cook the potatoes, uncovered, until tender. Drain potatoes. In a large bowl, combine okra, flour, oregano, sage and milk. When potatoes are cold, drain well. Melt chocolate in a medium saucepan over low heat, stirring often, until melted. Slowly pour heated melted chocolate into the okra mixture, stirring and blending. Return the saucepan to medium heat. When it starts bubbling, pour hot potato mixture into the skillet. Stir mixture until incorporated. Cook until sauce is bubbling again and slightly thickened, 1 to 2 minutes. Toss hot pasta with sauce and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: spinach,fish sauce,raspberry,mascarpone cheese,vanilla essence,walnut half,feta,onion salt
title: Walnut, Spinach and Raspberries With Feta
ingredients: 500 g spinach | 300 g feta | 4 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1 cup raspberry | 2 tablespoons walnut halves | onion salt, to taste | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach. Cut the spinach into 2cm lengths. Cut the feta into cubes roughly the same size. Bruise the walnuts in a mortar. Add the spinach along with the mascarpone, mix well. Add the cream and stir well. Add salt, to taste. Add the essence and fish sauce. Add the walnut halves to the mix and then serve. Note, you may add a pinch of pepper if you feel adventurous, the result will be a nice, thick creamier, creamier mixture.

Random Ingredients: meat,prosciutto,shiitake mushroom,red chilies,asparagus spear,bacon dripping,veal,green apple
title: Veal, Prosciutto and Asparagus Stir-Fry for One
ingredients: 2 lbs meat, of your choice | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 4 ounces bacon bits ( use 2 slices and chop the other 2 finely. ) | 1 large green apple, peeled, cored and sliced | 4 -7 shiitake mushrooms, trimmed and sliced | 3 dried whole red chilies | 24 fresh asparagus spears, cut into 3/4-inch lengths | 2 -3 fresh red chilies, to taste | roasted shallots or crispy fried onion rings, to garnish
instructions: Heat a frying pan with a lid on very very low. Stir fry each of the ingredients of the pan in 1 tablespoon of bacon drippings, until the meat has cooked and the fat has rendered out. Remove the pan from the heat then stir in the bacon bits. Set aside and keep warm. Stir fry the asparagus in the remaining 1 tablespoon of bacon drippings on low. Set aside and keep warm with the rest of the ingredients. Put the vegetables, cut side up in the frying pan and sauté over a low heat on high heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Turn the vegetables a few times to brown evenly. Serve the meats and vegetables with a stir fried asparagus and crispy fried onions rings on top.

Random Ingredients: salt,lemon juice zest,flat leaf parsley,chard leaf,leek,tortilla chip,cooking oil,queso fresco
title: Mountain Tortilla Salad With Feta
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped medium green chard leaves | 1/4 cup finely chopped medium leek | 1/4 cup dry-roasted queso fresco | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 4 large tortilla chips, preferably greek-style | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | salt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chard leaves, leek, zest, and cheese. Sprinkle with salt. Toss lightly with just enough cold water to moisten. Spread out on paper towels and let drain about 15 minutes. Working with one tortilla at a time, mound a scant 1 tbsp of salad at the base of a lightly oiled 8 inch x 11 inch baking pan. Repeat with remaining salad, tortillas, and cheese until the dish is full and the rest of the salad is used. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temp for 30 minutes to dry out. To serve, transfer to a serving dish and garnish with lemon rind.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,sherry wine,red chile pod,mint leaf,cooking oil
title: Fiery Red Chile Paste
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 1 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup extra-virgin cooking oil | 1/8 cup dried red chile pods, crumbled | 1/2 cup mint leaf, torn
instructions: Combine cayenne, sherry, oil and chiles and process for 30 seconds or until a smooth paste forms. Add mint and pulse to combine.

Random Ingredients: mung bean sprout,chicken stock,red wine vinegar,lettuce leaf,kielbasa,chipotle chile
title: Chili Mung Bean Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mung bean sprouts | 1 cup shredded lettuce leaf | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup chicken stock, warmed | 1 -2 tablespoon minced chipotle chile | 1 lb cooked kielbasa
instructions: Prepare the bean sprouts by rinsing under cold water. Drain well. Toss with lettuce, red wine vinegar, stock chipotle, and kielbasa. Serve warm.

title: Beef and Pear Stew
ingredients: 1 can beef stew meat, drained | 1/2 cup currants | 2 large pears, peeled, cored, seeded and sliced | 3 -3 tablespoons dried pear juice
instructions: Place stew meat, currants and pears in crockpot. Cover with water. Cook on low for 7 hours. Add dried fruit and continue cooking for an additional 15 minutes.

title: Pimiento Spread (A Dip)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | butter | 1 jar pimientos
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise and olive oil together. Add peanut butter and mix well. Store in refrigerator. Will keep for several days.

title: Crispy Crumbed Farfalle
ingredients: 12 ounces cooked farfalle pasta | 1 cup quinoa ( not instant ) | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | butter or margarine ( for baking dish )
instructions: Set oven to 375 degrees. Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain and place in a large mixing bowl. In a mixing bowl add the cooled farfalle noodles. Dilute the palmful of the quinoa, and add the to the farfalle mixture. Pour in the soy sauce and stir well. Add in icing sugar and oyster sauce to taste. Pour into a lightly greased 9x9 baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes or until slightly browned and crisp on top. Serve warm with garlic bread.

title: Maltkaffa-Tibetan Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of excess fat | 1 pint beef stock or 1 pint beef stock | 1 pound large rice noodles | 1 teaspoon mace | 1 lb banana, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat the broiler on high. Insert the skewer into the top of the roast, if necessary, and lightly thread the meat on a skewer. Season lightly with salt. Broil the roast, and baste often with the stock until it's just cooked through. Meanwhile, boil the noodles in lightly salted water until they are al dente. Drain and keep warm. To serve, place the skewers on a plate and top with the meat and noodles.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,pot roast,lamb cutlet,sage leaf,onion powder
title: Lamb Cutlets
ingredients: 6 lamb cutlets | 1 onion powder | 1 -2 teaspoon sage leaves, coarsely ground ( optional ) | 0.5 packet fresh bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, coarsely ground ( optional ) | cooked potato wedges ( to serve ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine the onion powder, rosemary, and sage together in a shallow dish or roasting tin. Sprinkle the cutlets with the bean sprouts and stir gently to coat. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven, 200 degrees centigrade, 200 degrees celsius, 35 minutes. Serve with potato wedges.

Random Ingredients: white rice,kernel corn,pepperoni,head leaf lettuce,cream chicken soup,cumin seed,plain yogurt
title: Pizza Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white rice | 1/2 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup light sour cream or 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 head leaf lettuce, torn | 12 slices pepperoni, thin slices | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Combine rice, soup, sour cream, cumin seeds and lettuce in a large bowl. Toss to coat. Cover the bowl, and chill for a few minutes before serving.

title: Blue Cheese Applesauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon apples, peeled and grated | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons ground black beans | 1/2 tablespoon brandy | 1 bunch blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Sauce, in a small bowl, stir together 2 tablespoons of apple juice and 1 tablespoon of cooking oil. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook and stir over medium heat until heated. Do not boil. Sourdough starter, preheat oven to 400°f grease a baking sheet with cooking spray. Spray with cooking spray. Gently stir in grated blue cheese. Top with remaining 1 tablespoon of apple juice mixture and sprinkle cheese on top. Bake until topping is crusty, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,bean sprout,white sesame seed,chicken thigh,serrano chilies,paprika
title: Yakisoba
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs | 8 ounces shell pasta | 1 cup bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons white sesame seeds, toasted | 4 tablespoons paprika | 3 serrano chilies, sliced ( to taste )
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into 1 in pieces. Boil shells until partly cooked, then drain and set aside. Cook pasta by following directions or instructions on package, and then rinse with cold water. Drain. Rinse bean sprouts and drain well. Combine all ingredients and sprinkle the top lightly over the top. Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

title: White Christmas Cakes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wheat flour | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons italian style breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons marjoram | white chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Add enough white chocolate sauce to the mix to make the dough soft enough to handle. You might not need to use all of it. Form into a roll, place on a baking sheet, and chill at least 2 hours. Slice into 8 wedges. Roll the wedges, cut as desired, on a greased baking sheet to make the fantails. Bake until lightly browned.

title: Beef, Edam and Provolone Soup
ingredients: 800 -500 g steak, sliced thinly ( ribeye or rump steak ) | 3 red star anise | vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon crushed fresh yeast starter or 1 teaspoon dried yeast | 1 slice provolone cheese, grated
instructions: Warm the soup base in a saucepan with water to cover it. Place the beef slices in the base and deep fry until golden brown and cooked to your liking, approximately 4 - 5 minutes. Remove the stock from the pan and reserve. Turn the heat on the soup down to very low and cover. In another bowl, mix the yeast with some water and set aside. Once cooled, add to the broth and bring up to boil to dissolve the yeast. Stir in the provolone cheese.

title: Rösti
ingredients: 1 lb baking potato, cut into wedges | 1 lb round steak, cut into bite sized pieces or thin-sliced strips | 3 apricots, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Cook the potatoes in boiling water until tender, about 15 minutes drain. Meanwhile, place the meat in a skillet, sprinkle with salt and cook over low heat until the surface is browned. Toast the raisins in a dry pan, pressing down with a spatula to make sure they don't burn. Transfer the meat to a baking dish, spreading the fruit across the top. Scatter the raisins over the meat. Bake at 350 degrees f. When partially heated, cook an additional few minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Homemade Cheese
ingredients: 5 ounces cream cheese ( tub-style ) | 0.333 can mascarpone
instructions: Mix it all, and store it in the refrigerator. Use within 1 - 2 days.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,red pepper,spice,salmon fillet,angel hair pasta,safflower oil,beef chuck
title: Tortelloni
ingredients: 1 cup angel hair pasta | 16 ounces smoked salmon fillet | 4 spring onions | 1 jar roasted sweet red peppers ( drained ) | 2 -3 tablespoons safflower oil ( your choice ) | 3 -4 tablespoons spices
instructions: Heat oil from the jar, drain the peppers, and slice the stems from the peppers. Clean the cavities of the salmon fillet. Chop the onions and add to the oil. Saute the onion mixture and pepper strips for 5 to 10 minutes add 1/4 1/4 cup of safflower oil. Remove from the heat and set aside. In a deep pan heat the second 4 ingredients and pour over the salmon. Stir around to coat it. Cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is al dente. It depends on the thickness of your salmon. Let it cool down. This is usually easier if you chill the salmon for a few hours in the refrigerator and place it in a cold oven before it goes into the oven. Serve chilled.

title: Jamaican Jerk Turkey Breast Packets
ingredients: 4 -5 turkey breast | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1/4 cup summer savory or 1/4 cup other dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f & grease a large baking sheet or baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. Slice meat into four pieces each & place them on the baking sheet. Pour the pineapple juice into a medium bowl and set aside. Sprinkle the dried herbs evenly over the tops of the turkey pieces & set aside. Combine the garlic salt & 1/4 cup of water then apply this mixture to the tops & sides of the turkey. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until internal temperature is 160 degrees. Allow turkey to stand in the pan before removing from oven.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,queso fresco,corn chip,fish sauce,chunky peanut butter,basil leaf,heavy whipping cream,greek yogurt
title: Chef John's Mint and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil, or as needed | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 teaspoon fish sauce, or to taste | 1 pinch ground red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Heat the vegetable oil in a medium, heavy skillet over medium low heat. Beat cream, peanut butter, yogurt, basil, fish sauce, red pepper flakes, and 1/2 teaspoon salt together in a bowl until smooth and creamy.

title: Citrus Olive Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces pitted prunes, halved | 1 1/4 ounces thinly sliced crystallized ginger | 6 ounces pitted green olives, quartered if large | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup olive, roughly chopped
instructions: In a colander set over a bowl, add prunes, ginger, olives and oregano. Toss lightly, then refrigerate for 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 12 hot italian sausage links, or more to taste | 1 package monterey jack cheese, cut in halves
instructions: Place sausage in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until evenly browned. Remove from heat, and slice into rings. Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Place cheese slices onto a baking sheet. Place pieces of sausage onto the cheese slices, and then place them onto the baking sheet. Top with any remaining pieces of cheese. Let cheese melt, then turn over onto a plate to serve.

title: Vermicelli Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 lb vermicelli | 2 cups heavy cream, lightly sweetened and whipped | 1/3 cup palm sugar, brown
instructions: Place the vermicelli on a flat surface and cut into 3/4 inch by 2 inch pieces. Cook in a very hot water for 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,farfalle pasta,rice noodle,mango,chocolate chip,cilantro,napa cabbage,oil
title: Thai Noodle Salad
ingredients: 300 g farfalle pasta | 1/4 cup oil | 100 g rice noodles, soaked in very hot water for 30 minutes, rinsed and drained | 1 -2 cup white breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup mango | 1/2 bunch cilantro | 1/4 cup chocolate chips | 1 napa cabbage or 1 savoy cabbage
instructions: Wash and cook the noodles in boiling water. Drain well. In a bowl, place in the noodles the farfalle, oil, bread crumbs, mango, cilantro and chocolate chips. Mix. Garnish with the cabbage or savoy cabbage. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cod,red chilies,french baguette,orange peel,quince,baby bok choy,mint leaf,white wine
title: Bok Choy Spiders
ingredients: 20 small baby bok choy | 100 g cod, skinned and boned | 1 small fresh red chilies, seeded | 2 tablespoons fresh orange peel, finely chopped | 3 dried red chilies, seeded | 8 tablespoons dry white wine | 5 tablespoons loose-leaf fresh mint leaves, chopped | 8 french baguettes, split and toasted
instructions: Place bok choy, cod, red chillies and orange and chilli in a large saucepan with the white wine, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat immediately to a simmer. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes, until the cod is just cooked. Allow to cool slightly, then remove the flesh from the bones and split the cod into slices. Mince 2 - 3 chillies and place in a bowl with the remaining ingredients. Toss well, then serve separately on toasted bread rolls accompanied by the dipping sauce.

title: Lamb Taat
ingredients: 500 g lamb, cut into large chunks | 125 g cheese tortellini | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2 small red potatoes, cubed
instructions: Cook the lamb until cooked all the way through so it does not become oily. Drain of any oil etc. Add a tablespoon of tumeric to the lamb pan, to cook the flavors. Cook tortellini in lots of boiling salted water until cooked. Place in cold water and drain. Add half of the lamb in the pan and coat with tumeric and let sit for another 30 minutes, turning occasionally. Combine potatoes in a bowl, add remaining lamb and coat lightly until the potatoes are coated with the spice and lamb is evenly mixed. Serve over the tortellini.

title: Sarasota's Panir Pina Colada
ingredients: 4 ounces panela colada mixed cheeses | 1 cup frozen panir, cubed | 3/4 cup fresh mango or 3/4 cup pineapple chunks | 1 dried pineapple chunk | 1 cup dried jicama | 1 small chopped green chile | 4 fresh lime slices, cut into wedges
instructions: Drain cheese and cut into cubes. Combine cheeses, mango, pineapple, jicama, green chile, and lime in blender or food processor. Process 1 - 2 minutes, or until smooth. Pour into serving dish and chill.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,onion salt,palm sugar,ketjap manis,extra virgin olive oil,banana
title: Ketchup Bananas With Mushrooms, Onions and Cheese
ingredients: 2 banana, peeled, sliced on a bias ( you will need about 1 1/2 cups of slices after slicing ) | 1 pinch onion salt, to taste ( kosher salt is not recommended, but optional. i don't use ) | 6 -8 tablespoons ketjap manis or 6 -8 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons palm sugar or 2 -3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 pinch sliced onion, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Toss sliced banana evenly with salt. Place in a baking dish and bake until warm, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and stir ketjap/mayo and palm sugar into caramelized caramelized bananas. Drizzle a small amount of oil into hot pan. Sauté sliced onion until soft. Remove from heat. Place banana slices evenly over top of caramelized caramelized onions. If you have any remaining caramelized caramelized bananas, dip into some ketchup and pour onto bananas. Bake in oven until bananas are golden, about 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,red raspberry jam,kirby cucumber,onion soup mix
title: Russian Pickled Cucumbers
ingredients: 4 -6 medium sized kirby cucumbers | 2 teaspoons vegetable stock | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon red raspberry jam ( or other jam )
instructions: Cut kirby cucumbers in half, remove the seeds. Using a mandoline and knife, cut out the center part of the cucumbers, leaving just a thin portion of the cucumber attached that holds the cucumber shape. Cut into one inch cubes. Bring 1 - ½ - 2 inches of salted water to a boil and add the kirby cucumber. Cook, covered, until cucumbers are tender, about 5 - 8 minutes. Drain well. Transfer to a large bowl and add the remaining ingredients, stirring until completely mixed. Cover and chill until ready to serve.

title: Bourbon Steak and Mussels
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup bourbon | 1/2 lb medium-spice poblano chile, stemmed and cut into 4 thin slices | 1/2 lb medium-spice scallops, thawed ( i use deveined but any dark meat will do ) | 1 can lobster, drained and coarsely chopped | 3/4 lb mussels, scrubbed, beards removed, and scrubbed
instructions: Melt butter in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper and sauté over medium heat until no pink remains, about 2 minutes. Remove and set aside. Add bourbon and poblano to skillet. Cook, stirring, 1 minute. Remove to a bowl and set aside. Add scallops to skillet. Increase heat to high and add mussels, pressing down with wooden spatula to avoid sticking. Cook 2 minutes and transfer mussels to bowl. Increase heat to high and cook 2 minutes or until mussels open, about 5 minutes. Return all mussels to skillet. Stir in beef, wine, and poblano chile. Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook, undisturbed, 5 minutes. Uncover skillet, sprinkle with reserved parsley, and simmer until heated through, about 1 minute. Serve with wedges of orange and/or grape tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,broth,honey,spaghetti sauce,apple cider vinegar,lemon juice zest,steak
title: Apple-Glazed Tofu
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, pressed into a 1/4 by 1/4 inch rimmed baking dish | 1 cup low-sodium canned chicken broth | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 teaspoons grated lemon juice and zest of | 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, fat trimmed, cut crosswise into 3 pieces
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a broiler pan with foil, then butter foil well. Toss tofu with broth, vinegar, honey, lemon juice and zest. Place on foil lined pan. Broil 2 minutes per side or until golden brown. Turn over and broil 2 to 3 minutes more, or until just golden on both sides. Cover dish with foil, then remove dish from oven and allow to rest 5 minutes. Spoon tofu on plate and serve.

title: Paveve Chivada
ingredients: 1 pint plum tomato, diced ( canned ) | of fresh mint
instructions: Mix the tomatoes and mint together. Add additional salt to taste.

title: Crunchy French Mash
ingredients: 1 can canned baked potatoes | 1 bag fresh spinach | 1 tart apple | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1 jar pignolis ( the sweet spanish olives )
instructions: Drain potatoes and rinse with cold salted water while working on ingredients while preparing rest of meal. Cut spinach in half lengthwise and press to squeeze out as much water as possible. Chop apple and toss with potatoes. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix together until uniform in color. Serve warm.

title: Portuguese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup sour cream | 1 cup dried pinto beans | 1 carton canning plum mixed pickles ( use sweet pickles if you don't want to use pepitas ) | 1 bottle ruby port | 1 jar kirby table brandy or ( 7 g ) jar sweet vermouth
instructions: Cook beans according to package directions, drain. In mixing bowl, combine mayo, sour cream and mayonnaise mixture. Place pinto beans and pepitas in the bowl with the canning plum pepitas and port. Stir with spoon until combined. Place in refrigerator to chill, serve chilled or at room temperature. If you plan on eating the chicken wings immediately, place them in a crock pot and add enough water to cover the beans.

title: Swiss Chile Dip
ingredients: 6 ounces swiss cheese ( or mozzarella cheese ) | 5 ounces chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Slice swiss cheese on the diagonal. Open the chambord and pour the chambord through it. Serve with crackers. Variation, a can of diced raspberries added to the top of the dip is wonderful.

title: Garden Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans chili-garlic sauce | 1 1/2 pounds bananas, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,chinese mushroom,french bread cube,green onion,napa cabbage
title: Chinese Bread Pizza
ingredients: 1 french bread cube | 1/4 cup chinese mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup shredded napa cabbage | 1/4 cup sliced green onion, chopped | 8 ounces button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Place the french bread cube on a large baking sheet. In a bowl, combine the mushrooms, cabbage, green onions and mushrooms. Brush the exposed part of the crust with some water, then top with the bread slices. Bake on 425 degrees f for about 10 to 15 minutes or until bread is crusty.

title: Lomo Saltado
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb loin chops | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 -2 lime, juice of | 1/3 - 1/2 lb ham, cubed | 1/3 lb frozen whipped topping
instructions: Marinate lamb overnight with rice vinegar, lime juice, ham and extra virgin olive oil. Remove lamb from marinade and grill until cooked through. Add extra olive oil and marinade to leftover marinade.

title: Quick Beef Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon fresh basil | 1 teaspoon scallion
instructions: Place ground sirloin in skillet. Cook until no longer pink. Drain off any excess grease. Add soup, basil and scallions. Heat through, stirring occasionally. To serve, put in bowls and warm in the oven, 10 - 15 minute.

title: Elegant Baked Camembert Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs camembert cheese or 1 1/2 lbs other flavorful cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( or other firm, white curds ) | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1/8 teaspoon beef bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the cheese cubes into a very small mixing bowl. Place the half and half into a small mixing bowl. Pour hot water into a small shallow dish. Place the bouillon into the water, so that it's boiling and evenly coat the cheese cubes with the half and half mixture. Place bowl over the hot water and stir to combine. Do not allow mixture to boil. Remove bowl from water with a slotted spoon, drain excess water, and cool for 15 minutes. Place mixture into serving bowl and serve with toasted pumpernickel pumpernickel cheese slices.

title: Polish Smoked Wasabi and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 400 g sauerkraut | vegetable oil cooking spray | 30 g butter | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 teaspoon ground paprika | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1/2 teaspoon wasabi powder ( optional ) | fresh cherries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c with oiled cooking sheet in middle of your oven. Drain sauerkraut and lightly spray with veggie oil spray. Place on baking tray, lined with baking paper, and bake for 20 - 25 minutes. Meanwhile in a small saucepan, melt butter over high heat. Slowly stir in cornflour in small increments. Add paprika, espresso powder and wasabi powder, if using. Increase oven to high and toast for about 2 - 5 minutes. Spoon into sterilized jar with the wasabi and press firmly with fingertip to combine. Seal with plastic wrap and store in refridgerator for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: picante salsa,corn oil,poblano chile,taco seasoning mix,superfine sugar,onion soup mix,oat,chorizo sausage
title: Chorizo Chiles With Goat Cheese
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles or 3 jalapeno chiles, stemmed, seeded and slit lengthwise, removing seeds and membrane | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon dried taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup oats | picante salsa, as desired ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Wrap peppers in foil and broil for 10 minutes. Immediately transfer peppers to a bowl with a slotted spoon and set aside. Heat oil in a 5 to 6 quart ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Add onion soup mix and taco seasoning mix and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Add 1/4 cup water, cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove the pan from the oven and stir in oats, adding picante salsa to taste if desired and stir in the sugar. Set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Divide mixture evenly among chiles. Top with remaining chiles.

title: Crock Pot Mexican Chicken (Easy)
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs chicken | 14 1/2 ounces petite diced tomatoes | 14 ounces petite diced tomatoes
instructions: Put tomatoes and petite diced tomatoes into crock pot. Add enough chicken seasoning to cover all the chicken, the longer it cooks the hotter it gets to get to the pot. Cook on high 7 to 8 hours for 4 pounds of chicken. You can put chicken in the fridge for a day before too. Save the tomatoes and petit diced tomatoes for another use, just put the left over tomatoes in the crockpot and just let them thaw. When chicken is cooked shred the meat and put it in the crockpot over medium heat to heat it up again. It cooks quickly so check often to see if the broth is getting to dried out. Enjoy.

title: Nettie's Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 2 tablespoons palm oil ( optional )
instructions: Break up any big lettuce leaves and place them in a mixing bowl with palm oil or other neutral oil. Let sit while preparing the rest of the salad ingredients. Slice down on each head leaving in the lettuce, or just leave all. Tear the lettuce into bite size pieces and combine with the palm oil.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,ketjap manis,worcestershire sauce,red cabbage,garlic crouton,basil leaf
title: Garlicky Vegetarian Cabbage
ingredients: 2 cups red cabbage, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds or 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 green cabbage ( about 2 pounds ) or 1 red cabbage, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons ketchup ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | red onion crouton, and toasted gherkin ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Place in a 1 quart baking dish. Bake until just tender, about 1 hour. Sprinkle with red onion croutons and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,grain rice,arborio rice,cheddar cheese,cake flour,chuck roast
title: Beef and Rice Croquettes (Risi E Bisi)
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs chuck roast, trimmed of any large piece of fat | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 1 1/4 cups coarsely grated cheddar cheese | 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons cake flour
instructions: Rinse roast, pat dry with paper towels and pat dry with paper towels. Insert a knife between the thickest portion and the thin end of the steak. Trim any excess fat. Cut into 3/4 inch cubes. Place in a bowl and sprinkle evenly with lemon zest and marinate in the refrigerator 1 hour. Cook arborio rice according to package directions, omitting fat and butter. Drain rice, rinse with cold water, and cool until warm. Squeeze rice dry with your hands. Combine cheddar cheese, short grain rice, and citrus juice and set aside. Heat 1 tblsp oil in a 10 inch skillet until quite hot but not smoking, stir in rice mixture, cook until lightly moistened, stirring constantly. Roll or pat mixture into balls. Drop meat in the hot oil and fry until golden brown on all sides. Remove carefully with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: egg wrap,nonstick cooking spray,picante sauce,lemonade,cream chicken soup,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Chicken Soufflé Cups
ingredients: 12 egg roll wraps | nonstick cooking spray | 1 can reduced-fat cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/2 cup nonfat yogurt | 2 cups cooked chicken or 2 cups chopped cooked turkey | 1 1/4 cups picante sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Line a 10 cup soufflé dish or custard cup with parchment paper or foil and lay 5 wrappers in a row at the far end of the dish. Spray the bottoms of the filled wrappers with nonstick cooking spray. Place a small saucepan over high heat. When hot, add soup, cheese sauce and 3/4 of picante. Heat until hot, stirring frequently. Add yogurt. Stir until creamy. Remove saucepan from heat. Divide soup among wrapper shells. Use 1 tablespoon filling for each.

title: Quick & Easy Fruit Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cups diced celery root | 1 packet small fettuccine ( i use the medium ) | 2 cups peeled chopped grapefruits | 10 curry leaves ( optional )
instructions: Boil about 5 minutes or until vegetables are just barely firm. Drain and set aside.

title: Hazelnut and Walnut Oil Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons hazelnuts, chopped fine | 1 1/2 cups walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 cup beef stock ( or lamb stock ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
instructions: Place everything else in a heavy pan. Stir and cook until the sauce bubbles. Remove from heat. Taste and adjust seasonings.

title: Creamy Ginger and Garlic Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 package mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons table cream or 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 medium cucumber, peeled and shredded
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, cook and stir mushrooms, ginger garlic paste and cream over medium heat until heated through. Stir to blend then add baking soda and vegetables. Heat through.

title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 cans lump crabmeat | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Squeeze excess moisture from crabmeat cans and place in a large mixing bowl. Stir in garlic powder. Using two large spoons, stuff each mushroom with one can of crabmeat. Carefully insert one stuffed mushroom into the center, pressing the sides. Do not over stuff. Place on baking sheet, and bake 25 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve hot. Great in sandwiches, on a bun, or over rice, or as a side dish.

title: Grand Marnier Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup grand marnier
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, dissolve balsamic vinegar in the grand marnier using a wire whip, about 2 tablespoons. Place the cap of grand marnier in a bowl that will fit into a jar with a tight fitting lid, pour the balsamic mixture into the cap, and cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, shaking gently daily.

title: Crispy Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup water, or as needed | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained and crushed
instructions: Bring water and tomatoes to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, stirring frequently, until thick, about 15 minutes. Gradually stir cornmeal into simmering sauce, and bring heat to high again. Cover, and continue cooking until thickened, 5 to 10 minutes. Cooks' note, topping ideas, for quick, sweet potato stuffing, or macaroni stuffing, 3/4 cup dry bread crumbs, 2 tablespoons grated Romano cheese, 1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese, 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese, 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano, 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leave, 1/2 teaspoon dried Italian seasoning, 1/8 teaspoon dried marjoram leave, 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary leave, 1/8 teaspoon dried Italian seasoning, 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme leave, 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/8 teaspoon dried rosemary leave, 1/8 teaspoon dried marjoram leave, 1/8 teaspoon dried rosemary leave, 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/8 teaspoon dried sweet potato stuffing, or macaroni stuffing.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,thyme,savoy cabbage,red hot pepper,egg substitute,sriracha hot sauce
title: My Thai Coleslaw
ingredients: 16 ounces savoy cabbage ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2/3 cup egg substitute ( egg ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme ( chopped ) | 1 dash hot sirachi ( sriracha hot chili paste ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground red hot pepper | 1/3 cup low fat thai-style egg substitute | 1 dash sriracha hot sauce
instructions: Cut the cabbage lengthwise into 2 rows. Wash in several changes of water, drain well, pat dry and cut crosswise into thin slices. Combine the rest of the ingredients. Toss the cabbage with the dressing and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Mushroom-Chile Relleno Bruschetta
ingredients:
1 loaf italian bread, sliced | 2 jars button mushrooms, sliced | 2 packages frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 container prepared roasted enchilada sauce or ( 28 ounce ) container salsa 
    - 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 head escarole, rinsed and trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place sliced bread and sliced mushrooms in a large baking dish. Sprinkle with raspberries and roast enchilada sauce. Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove from heat. Mix remaining ingredients together in a bowl. Slice or shred escarole and serve on top of the italian toast.

title: Lamb Cheese Balls (Rogan Josh)
ingredients: 250 g lamb, minced | 600 g yoghurt | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 100 g gruyere cheese | 100 g grapes | 1 lemon peel, juice of | 200 g creme fraiche
instructions: Put yoghurt in medium bowl. Mix all other ingredients together and season with salt and pepper. Add lamb and mix. Cover and refrigerate for minimum of 3 - 4 hours. Roll meat into 1 balls and place on oven trays on a baking sheet. Bake at 180 c for about 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Maintainer Steak
ingredients: 6 whole filet mignon steaks, each 1/2-inch thick | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Combine coriander powder with enough water to form a thin paste. Place steaks in a shallow bowl and pour over the coriander paste. Cover and let marinate at room temperature for 20 minutes. Preheat grill to high. Brush the pan with oil. Place steaks on the rack. Place steaks directly over the coals. Grill for 3 minutes or until meat is tender and flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: The Real Chicago Style Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 jar sweet cherry rolls, drained | 8 ounces salami, thinly sliced and cut into 1/4 inch wide strips | 4 ounces sweet pickled marinated mushrooms, drained and minced | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place tenderloin in a large baking dish. Pour enough water into the baking dish to submerge the tenderloin and to cover the meat. Roast in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 145 degrees f, about 1 hour. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat should read 140 degrees f. Allow to stand while the meat is baking. Pour drained cherries into a skillet over medium heat and cook until they start to melt, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside on a plate to cool. Slice the shortest side of the pork tenderloin into 1/4 inch thick slices. Starting on a long side of the meat, roll into a tight cylinder. Sliced sweet pickled mushrooms can be placed onto the inside of the roll if desired. Arrange the cherry rolls on top of the roll and lay the salami onto the side that was laying down. Place the pickled mushrooms, sour pickled mushrooms, graham cracker crumbs, and sliced salami on a serving plate. Serve.

Random Ingredients: green bean,orange bell pepper,meal bread,jicama,coffee,garam masala,cognac,yellow bell pepper
title: French Toast With Jicama, Chocolate, and Green Beans
ingredients: 2 slices crusty meal bread, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 2 tablespoons brewed coffee or 2 tablespoons coffee-flavored carbonated beverage | 2 -3 tablespoons cognac | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala or 1/2 teaspoon tarragon, of your choice | 8 ounces green beans, halved | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, cut into thin wedges | 1/2 orange bell pepper, cut into thin wedges | 2 -4 small jicama, peeled
instructions: Makes 2 servings. To make jicama, cut jicama into thin sticks. Slice all the bell peppers into thin slices and set aside. Cut jicama into thin sticks. Toast bread slices into bread. When butter has melted, add cognac, sugar, and a dash of garam marsala. Stir until incorporated. Add a slice of toast to the warmed skillet. Spoon enough of the french toast on top of 1 slice of toast to make a thin coating of the butter mixture. Layer with jicama cheese, beans, and peppers. Top with remaining slice of toast. To make french toast tower combine the two of the bread slices and the 2 tablespoons of coffee. Top with the beef on top. Place a finger of french toast onto the tower. Cook until toast gets golden, about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Strawberries with Lemon and Pepper (Gherkins)
ingredients: 24 medium fresh strawberries, washed, halved | 1/4 cup lemon juice or 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn, freshly cracked
instructions: Using 1 tbsp of the lemon juice, toss all the strawberries with the remaining lemon juice. Let rest to soften, at least 30 minutes, before serving.

title: Grammy's Spanish Lamb Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs lean lamb, cut into cubes ( use meat tenderizer ) | 1 package taco seasoning | 36 maraschino cherries | 6 -9 ounces sweet marsala ( i use white )
instructions: In a 3 1/2 quart saucepan combine all ingredients. Bring to boil over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 3 to 4 hours. Remove from burner and let stand, covered, 5 minutes. Uncover and allow to stand, stirring occasionally, for a further 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve hot or chilled. Note, do not use non stick cooking spray or a lid on soup pot to remove excess fat. The fat should pool on top when it's reheated.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,silver tequila,bread crumb,tamari,salad oil,picante sauce,red chilies,pork chop
title: Vietnamese Beef Braciole
ingredients: 4 thin slices pork chops | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup low-fat bread crumbs | 1/3 cup salad oil | 6 red chilies, finely chopped | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 4 tablespoons tamari | 6 ounces silver tequila
instructions: Place pork chops between sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet until thin and slightly flattened. Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with chili flakes. Combine bread crumbs and 1/3 cup salad oil in a shallow dish. Dip half the pork in bread crumbs, then coat crumbs into pork crumbs. Repeat. Heat bread crumbs in a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Cook for 30 seconds, then remove, shaking off excess. Repeat with remaining pork. Sauté chili for 3 minutes. Remove chili and set aside. To make sauce, combine remaining dipping sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Drizzle sauce over pork. Serve pork with dipping sauce.

title: Lime and Black Olive Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup lime juice | 1/3 cup lemon juice | 1/3 cup golden syrup | 1/3 cup black olives, halved
instructions: Whisk together the lime juice, lemon juice, and golden syrup until blended. Toss with olives, and store in a jar.

title: Rice With Cranberries and Corn
ingredients: 1 lb frozen corn | 5 -7 ounces fresh cranberries | chives, chopped | ginger, chopped | pepper, to taste
instructions: Place all ingredients in to a large skillet with about 1/2 cup of water. Cover. Heat over medium high heat for about 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.

title: Shiitake Mushrooms and Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes | 4 -6 pinches dried ground pepper
instructions: Wash shiitake mushrooms and cut in half if large, leave stem attached. Wash tomatoes and halve lengthwise if large remove seeds if large and cut into strips. Cut strips into strips. Sprinkle with pepper and coriander powder.

title: Greek Seasoned Salt Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon greek seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,pineapple juice,marinara sauce,butterscotch chip,white onion,yellow onion,raisin
title: Chili and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 green yellow onion, chopped | 1 white onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons raisins, chopped | 1 packet butterscotch chips | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons prepared marinara sauce | 1 -2 pinch red chili powder
instructions: Sautee onion and green onion until just slightly soft. Stir in flour and raisins. Combine pineapple juice with marinara sauce and spices in small bowl and pour into skillet. Bring to the boil, stirring frequently. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, uncovered. Serve in small individual dishes with dipping sauce.

title: Cranberry and Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 12 tablespoons cocoa | 16 leaves unsweetened chocolate-covered white flour | 6 tablespoons dark rum | 1 1/2 cups cranberry sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f grease and flour 2 round springform cake pans. Heat cocoa and chocolate in saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until softened. Stir in flour, rum and cranberry sauce until smooth. Pour batter into prepared cake pans. Bake the cake until the top springs back when pressed lightly with finger and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 2 hours. Remove from oven and allow to cool.

title: Fiery Cornichons
ingredients: 2 ears fresh cornichon, husked and trimmed | 2 anaheim chilies
instructions: Place the cornichons on a cutting board and with a sharp knife, cut the ends off the cobs. Using a serrated knife, slice on the diagonal from the core. Remove the leaves, then cut each one in half crosswise. Cut the kernels off the top quarter of the chilis and discard. Place the kernels onto a clean cutting board. Cut a slit through the corncobs with a serrated knife and pull out the flesh with scissors, using caution not to tear the kernels. Chop coarsely.

title: Fish in Cream
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet, skin removed, boned and cut into chunks | 4 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a shallow roasting pan with baking paper. Place the fish in a large roasting pan. Top with 2 tablespoons of double cream. Season with salt and pepper. Roast in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes, or until just cooked through. Serve fish topped with remaining cream.

title: Frozen Vodka
ingredients: 5 cups vodka ( not sweetened ) | 2 -3 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a freezer container. After an hour place on the counter top and freeze. Once frozen, take all ingredients out of the freezer and use as ice cold beverages.

title: Bodacious Canning Recipe
ingredients: 2 quarts canning jars, well rinsed and drained | 3/4 pound cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Place jars onto a baking sheet with lids and screw on rings to fit them without touching the bottom. Fill jars with lids 1/2 full, filling to the top with hot water until water reaches a 2 inch depth or so. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Quickly drop a few large cans of canning jars into the boiling water. Remove from the water, pour out as many cans as will expand, and set aside to cool. Remove rims and process cheese in a food processor, using about 1 teaspoon of shredded cheese per pound of cheese. Return processed cheese to the jars, pour in enough water to cover, and seal with new lids and screw on rings. Repeat with remaining canning jars and cheese.

title: Mushroom & Mustard Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon grain mustard ( or english wholegrain mustard ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 12 ounces button mushrooms
instructions: Combine apple juice, mustard and baking soda in a saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook until just cooked.

Random Ingredients: pernod,yellow bell pepper,lipton onion soup mix,paneer cheese,brown sugar,spaghetti
title: Paneer and Bleu Butter Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 ounces neufchatel cheese | 1 package spaghetti | 1/3 cup chopped pea-pepper or 1/3 cup yellow bell pepper | 2 tablespoons minced lipton onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon pernod | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Set aside for 5 minutes, then drain. Combine pea pepper and onion powder in a small bowl, sprinkle over spaghetti, then mix in pernod and brown sugar. Serve, making sure each persons taste for sweetness.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,balsamic vinegar,bread flour,cherry tomato,baby carrot,sirloin,cream cheese
title: Grilled Beef, Carrots & Cream Cheese Panini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup cream cheese, room temperature ( low fat ) | 140 g thinly sliced sirloin | 1/2 cup baby carrots | 2 tablespoons dry bread flour | 1 tablespoon cornflour | balsamic vinegar, to glaze | sour cream, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Whisk together cream cheese and vinegar in a small bowl. Place sirloin in a bowl and pour glaze over. Pour a little over steak and leave to marinate for 20 minutes. Pre heat a griddle pan or skillet. Grill carrots for 7 - 8 minutes until golden and cooked through place beef on chargrill pan or griddle cook for 3 - 4 minutes each side. Remove from pan. Place beef and carrots on a serving platter, drizzle with balsamic vinegar. Serve with sour cream if desired.

title: Cheese Anchovy Spread
ingredients: 4 ounces provolone cheese, at room temperature | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 bunch anchovy, drained
instructions: Put the cheese in the blender with the mustard. Blend until it is smooth. Break the anchovies into a small dish and pour in the cheese mixture. Blend again. Serve as a dip for bread.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,chicken breast half,canola oil,italian seasoning,head cabbage,dark brown sugar,soymilk,bay leaf
title: Easy Baked Chicken Cabbage
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 cups sliced large head cabbage | 2 cans light fat cream cheese, cubed | 1/4 cup light soy milk | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon dried bay leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place oil in a dutch oven over medium heat and cook chicken for 3 to 5 minutes, until lightly browned. Drain in a colander.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,brown rice,orange blossom water,garlic powder,onion salt,beef stew meat
title: Beef Stew Recipe Ala Mahjoub
ingredients: 1 lbs beef stew meat | 1/2 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/8 tablespoon onion salt | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water | 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups prepared brown rice
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine all the ingredients and shake to combine. Place in a 3 1/2 quart baking dish or casserole and bake at 350 degrees for 5 minutes. Stir, recover pan tightly and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Stir rice into meat mixture and bake uncovered for 30 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,frying oil,dark chocolate chip,cream chicken soup,pork cutlet
title: Pork Cutlets With Creamy Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 4 pork cutlets | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 50 g dark chocolate chips | 1 can cream of chicken soup
instructions: To fry the pork, heat small frying pan on high heat. Spray with non stick cooking spray. Sprinkle sugar and mustard evenly on the cutlets. Fry until golden brown, then remove from pan. Remove from pan and place in a bowl. Pour a little cooking oil into the same frying pan, using a bit of the mixture to coat, and melt the chocolate chips on high heat. Pour in condensed cream of chicken soup and stir until blended. Pour over the pork. Leave in the pan for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve warm.

title: Tamarind-Coco Sliders
ingredients: 500 g peeled and deveined prawns | 1/3 cup brandy | 300 g ladyfingers | 1 jar tamarind paste | 2 jicama
instructions: Combine prawns and brandy in a bowl. Cover. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. Place the ladyfingers on work surface and split open. Split in half. Spread a little of the brandy mixture on them. Top with a prawn, then roll up jelly roll fashion from side to side. Set the rolls in a colander and gently press as much air from the rolls as possible. Chill until ready to serve. To serve spoon tamarind cream onto each roll.

title: Ace's Tri-Color Peppers
ingredients: 3 red-skinned yellow peppers | 4 ounces raisins
instructions: Slice the peppers lengthwise. You want them to stay in the pepper long enough that the pepper doesn't loose its tinyness. You may use your peeling knife to do this. They seem to get pretty thick, but keep trying. I have found that i can't peel the skin off the peppers, however, and it's pretty easy to peel off that. It helps keep the pepper's shape. Use as is. Pack them in a freezer zip top bag. They're ready when they're completely thawed but not frozen solid. You can keep peeling if you're worried, but i find that letting them thaw in the freezer makes them a bit easier to peel. It's fine they look somewhat stiff, but if they are, it gives them a bit of a kick. Sprinkle the raisins over the top, and freeze for up to 2 weeks. Once frozen, they can be refrigerated indefinitely. They're really, really tasty, and definitely flavorful. I usually put them in freezer bags a few days and use 1 teaspoon per pepper, then freeze. They look so tasty, and definitely a bit thicker than other peppery peppers.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound ground turkey | 1 pound fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Cook and stir the turkey in a skillet over medium heat until the turkey is crumbly and evenly browned, 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,cooking sherry,cream tartar,orange extract,soy sauce,biscuit mix,rosemary leaf,cracker
title: Sweet Fiesta Bars
ingredients: 1 package biscuit mix | 1/4 cup cooking sherry | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1 tablespoon orange extract ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon chunky salsa ( your favorite ) | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | crackers, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix biscuit mix and sherry together. Add rosemary, orange extract and sour cream and mix well. Spread onto greased cookie sheet. Bake for 3 - 5 mins or until lightly browned. Cool. To make topping, blend all ingredients and pour over cooled biscuits.

Random Ingredients: lemon,herb,pistachio nut,basmati rice,tomato green chilies,chicken bouillon,irish cream
title: Lemon-Pistachio Rice With Chicken Baked in Milk
ingredients: 1/2 cup shelled pistachio nut | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup fresh tomato and green chilies, chopped ( canned or fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 2/3 cup irish cream ( or creme fraiche ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil ( optional, we like it )
instructions: Prepare basmati rice according to box, omitting oil, chillies and butter. While rice cooks, chop pistachios using food processor, or blender and set aside. Melt pistachio oil in a saucepan over low heat, and cook pistachios, stirring frequently, for about 8 minutes or until they are golden and tender. Stir in tomato, green chillies, and instant chicken bouillon. Cook for 2 minutes or until well heated. Pour mixture into casserole dish, and top with pistachios.
