Bake, covered, in a 350 degree f oven for 45 minutes, until rice is tender. Remove cover, and bake for 5 to 10 minutes or until top is light brown. Remove from oven and let sit, covered, for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Grilled Swiss Smoked Swiss
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, cut into 3/4 to 1-inch cubes ( or gruyere, if you can get it ) | 1/8 teaspoon coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons mortadella
instructions: Grind coriander and mortadella seeds into a fine powder. Combine with cheese cubes and mix well. Grill over direct medium heat, using a 1/4 inch lid for the first 5 minutes on each side to melt cheese. Allow to rest, for 15 minutes at room temperature.

title: English Beetroot
ingredients: 1 large beet | 4 sprigs sage | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Peel and slice cooked beet into thin lengthwise slices. Cut sage, leaving leaves for garnish. Bake at 375 for 1 1/2 hours until beginning to become dark brown, stirring several times. Cool and grate coarsely on coarse shredder or in food processor. Place beetroot in a large bowl and coat with soda and turmeric. Toss with beetroot. Serve at once, garnished with sage leaves.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,cellophane noodle,pistachio,cabbage,peach brandy,poblano pepper,worcestershire sauce,hot mustard
title: Poblano-Peach Melted Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 lb cellophane noodle | 1 head cabbage | 2 peaches, halved pitted and sliced | 2 pickled sweet peppers, slices | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 cup unsalted shelled pistachios, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup peach brandy or 1/4 cup bourbon | hot mustard
instructions: To make the cheese, break the cellophane into several pieces and heat it gently with a wood spoon in a heavy skillet set over medium heat. Toss with a little water, then turn off the heat and place the cellophane and vegetables in a small saucepan over low heat. Cook, covered for 5 minutes, then remove from heat and let cool until the filling is warm. Remove the tough outer leaves from the cabbage and cut into quarters or thin wedges. In a small bowl, mix the peaches, sweet peppers, poblano, pistachios and worcestershire sauce. Drain the cooled melted cheese. Combine the filling with the cheese and the noodles or, if desired, stir in some of the warm vegetables.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,mayonnaise,fish sauce,ricotta cheese,green pea,oyster sauce
title: Thai Green Mayo With Rice Wine (Ganmode)
ingredients: 1 cup canned green peas | 6 tablespoons light mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor and pulse until well mixed. Chill in the fridge until serving time. Serve over greens, chicken, beef, or tofu.

title: Apple Soup With Chick Peas and Garbanzo Beans
ingredients: 2/3 cup dried garbanzo beans, washed and picked over | 1 cup apple juice | 2 teaspoons hot pepper flakes
instructions: Place the chickpeas into a large pot, and cover with about 2 inches of water. Bring water to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat slightly, cover, and simmer until tender, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Drain, and discard the chickpeas. Meanwhile, stir together the apple juice and hot pepper flakes in a small saucepan over medium heat. When the lentils are tender, remove from the heat, and let sit for 5 minutes to cool slightly. Puree the chickpeas in a blender or food processor or food mill until smooth. Transfer the soup back to the pot, and reheat over low heat, stirring occasionally, before serving.

title: Baked Chunky Parsnips
ingredients: 6 pared parsnips, scrubbed | 1/8 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1 teaspoon grated cheese | 50 -75 g grated swiss cheese ( swiss or emmenthal )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Cut parsnips in half lengthways, scrubbing under cold water to remove the hard core. Boil on a well salted waterpan of water for 20 minutes or until fork tender. Drain well. Transfer to a large bowl. Combine nutmeg, cheese and parsnips in a small bowl and mash well. Add to parsnips bowl and toss well. Place mixture on a baking sheet with rind side up. Bake for 40 minutes, stirring the parsnips every 20 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle top with grated swiss and cook for a further 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese has melted and top is golden.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,cocoa,cream chicken soup,red pepper flake,marshmallow
title: Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 dash crushed red pepper flakes | 3 cups miniature marshmallows
instructions: Combine soup mix, red enchilada sauce, cocoa, and crushed red pepper. Put in microwave safe glass bowl. Microwave at high 3 minutes or microwave 20 - 30 seconds at a time to thicken. Stir after each minute, or until heated thoroughly. Pour into microwave safe bowl, and microwave on high 2 minutes.

title: Saucy Beef Sandwiches With Balsamic Onions and Onions
ingredients: 600 g dark beer or 600 g beer, warmed | 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 lb hamburger | 2 tablespoons yellow onions, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the beer and vinegar and heat in a small saucepan over low heat until the vinegar is reduced by two thirds. Brush the hamburger with the vinegar mixture and cook for 5 - 7 minutes, stirring to break up lumps. Add the onions and heat through for a further 2 - 3 minutes. Serve with the fried onions.

title: Maraschino Jelly for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 jar jalapeno peppers | 2 jars maraschino cherries
instructions: Melt jalapeno peppers over low heat or in microwave stirring frequently. Add cherries and stir. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,rice noodle,beef tenderloin,sharp cheddar cheese,yellow bell pepper,turnip green
title: Beef Tenderloin With Rice Crisp
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 package frozen turnip greens, thawed | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into thin chunky wedges | 1 large yellow bell peppers or 1 large red bell pepper, cut into thin chunky wedges | 4 ounces uncooked rice noodles, cut into 2 x 1/4-inch strips | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Spray a 9 x 13 baking dish with cooking spray. Place beef in a large, resealable plastic bag. Add turnips, green bell pepper and yellow bell pepper slices to meat. Close bag and shake to coat. Place one half bag on top of another and shake to coat.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,breadcrumb,basil leaf,cajun seasoning,onion soup mix,black eyed pea,green chilies
title: Black-Eyed Pea Balls
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups dried black-eyed peas, cleaned and drained | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 6 -8 fresh basil leaves or 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/3 cup fresh breadcrumb | 2 cans chopped green chilies | 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts and process until well mixed. Add 1/2 cup bread crumbs while blending. Shape into 1 1/2 balls. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown, drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with additional bread crumbs before serving. This recipe is an excellent with hamburgers, hot dogs or pork.

Random Ingredients: strawberry liqueur,jalapeno pepper,caper,rump roast,nutella,chuck steak,new potato,coriander
title: Steak Tartare
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump roast | 1 1/2 lbs chuck steaks | 1 1/2 ounces butter | 1/2 ounce dried coriander | 3/4 ounce caper | 1/2 ounce jelly or 1/2 ounce strawberry liqueur | 10 ounces frozen tiny new potatoes, thawed | 1 ounce nutella
instructions: Place beef, steak, butter, coriander and caper in crockpot. Cook on high on top of the stove for 5 hours or until tender. Remove beef to carving board. Shred steak into manageable portions. Remove the bay leaf from the crockpot. Add the jelly to crockpot. Place potatoes and nutella in a baking dish and heat in oven, uncovered, for 20 - 25 minutes or until hot. Place meat on serving platter and surround with vegetables.

title: Avocado Casserole
ingredients: 2 avocados - peeled, pitted, and diced | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 package slivered orange slices | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 cup diced cashews
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Mix diced avocado, condensed soup, orange slices with poultry seasoning, and cashews together in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spoon avocado mixture over the top. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven. Uncover, and drizzle more of the cream of mushroom soup over the top to lightly coat. Bake uncovered for another 3 to 5 minutes before serving.

title: Pumpkin Pizza
ingredients: 3 tablespoons prepared german mustard | 2 tablespoons brandy ( light or dark ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 2 2 cups grated low-fat mozzarella cheese or 2 cups fresh grated lowfat provolone cheese
instructions: Combine 1st eight ingredients.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,flat leaf parsley,soya sauce
title: Spicy Italian Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 -2 ounce monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the soya sauce in the microwave safe mixing bowl. Add the cheese and parsley and mix well. Spread the mixture evenly on your favorite bread. Cut into 1/2 inches slices. Put on a baking sheet or pizza pan and bake at 400 degrees f for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Meat Piña
ingredients: 4 cups frozen cooked rigatoni pasta | 1 cup low-fat vanilla ice cream ( i used becel ) | 1 cube beef bouillon
instructions: Put the water on to boil for the pasta in a large pot. Put the frozen ice cream in the pot and heat it up just enough to melt the ice cream. Add the beef buillon cube, stir to combine. Once the water starts boiling, add the rigatoni to the pan with the sauce. It only took about 1 minute or so to thaw the meat, but do not let it boil, it will be done after 2 - 3 minutes. Put the pasta on to a plate and pour the meat sauce over the pasta. Enjoy.

title: Nam Sod - Tuna in Jelly
ingredients: 1 can tuna packed in water | pinch of chili paste or a little red chili powder
instructions: Drain the tuna and put in a casserole dish. Heat to boiling point and then pour over the chilli paste. Chill the tuna overnight and enjoy the crisp, crisp flavour.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,orange peel,asafoetida powder,chili paste garlic,golden syrup,walnut
title: Walnut Popsicles
ingredients: 12 ounces plain greek yogurt | 12 ounces golden syrup, heated | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon finely grated orange peel | 1 tablespoon ground walnuts, toasted
instructions: Combine yogurt with syrup, chili garlic paste, orange peel and ground walnuts. Mix well. Keep refrigerated. Keeps for one week.

title: Easy, No Bake, Moroccan Green Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 cup green sweet pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon pomegranate syrup ( i prefer ruby reds )
instructions: Prepare a serving platter or large platter with lettuce, tomato slices, and/or cucumber slices and/or sliced/torn green peppers. Sprinkle with pomegranate syrup, and serve warm.

title: Rose Wine St. Pattyches
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup rose wine | 1/2 cup sliced fresh straw mushrooms
instructions: In plastic bag, combine meat, orange juice, 1/2 cup of the wine, mushrooms and all remaining ingredients.

title: Black Sesame Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 cup black sesame seeds, lightly toasted | 4 teaspoons malt vinegar
instructions: Combine the black sesame seeds and malt vinegar in a mortar and pestle. Grind the seeds and vinegar through a fine mesh sieve. Store in a small, screw top jar and use within 1 month.

title: Spinach & Black Olive Saute
ingredients: 100 g baby spinach | 50 g black olives | 20 g currant jelly | 1 cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 400 ml broth | 1 cardamom pod, split in half
instructions: Wash the spinach, remove stalks and wash under running cold water. Blanch for approx 2 minutes then drain into large bowl and squeeze out as much moisture as possible. In a small pan, heat half the olive oil over a medium heat, add cardamom pods and let heat for a couple of seconds, add the beans and stir, adding the jelly gradually until it boils. Add the spinach and olives, stirring well so it is well mixed. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,cherry,ginger root,lamb shoulder,brown sugar,mushroom,gruyere cheese
title: Saganaki (Lamb and Gruyère Stew)
ingredients: 1 lamb shoulder, trimmed of excess fat, cut into chunks ( can also use pork chops ) | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger root | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 cups sliced fresh fresh mushrooms ( optional ) | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ( can sub parmesan cheese ) | 12 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese ( can sub mozzarella or a combination of cheeses )
instructions: Mix lamb, brown sugar, and ginger root well. Pour equal amounts of cherry tomatoes into the bottom of a crockpot, along with about a cup of mushrooms. Add the remaining mushrooms. Pour the lamb mixture into the crockpot. Sprinkle the top with about a cup of mozzarella cheese. Cover and cook on high until the lamb is cooked through and the mushrooms have given off their liquid, about 8 to 10 hours, using a meat thermometer or a stab test to check the meat to see if it is almost cooked through. Serve on a bed of couscous, garnished with more mozzarella cheese and sprinkling some grated gruyere cheese over the top.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,italian sausage,chipotle chile,apricot brandy,lemon zest
title: Smoked Sausages With Apricot & Chipotle Glaze
ingredients: 12 italian sausages | 4 tablespoons apricot brandy | 1 lemon, zest of | 2 chipotle chiles, seeded or 2 jalapeno chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: Heat a shallow roasting tin on the bbq or grill the sausages. When the sausages have been cooked, remove them to a bowl. Place the oven shelf about 6 inches from the element and heat the grill or grill pan. Coat the sausages with the smoky glaze. Place the sausages in the broiler or grill and cook 3 - 4 minutes on each side, until cooked through. Remove from the grill and allow to cool. Cut into diagonal slices and arrange on serving plates. Sprinkle with the chiles and zest of the lemon. Serve with roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,lemon extract,mozzarella cheese,serrano chilies,onion soup mix,chicken bouillon,peach
title: Peach Melts
ingredients: 10 fresh peaches, sliced | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup fontina cheese | 1/2 cup fresh peach slices and serrano chilies | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place peaches in a baking dish. Add the cheeses, then top with the sliced peaches. In a bowl, toss well with the soup mix and chicken bouillon. Pour over the peaches. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake at 425 degrees f for 15 minutes, then remove, and let stand for 5 minutes. Drizzle the peach mixture and lemon into the cheese mixture. Bake until the cheese is bubbly and the peaches are hot.

title: Tex-Mex Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 1/2 cup texas toast bread, crumbs
instructions: Remove tips from wings. Place wings into a shallow casserole dish. Drizzle bread crumbs over wings. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 40 minutes or until well browned.

title: Venison and Beef Kebabs With Soy Milk and Ancho
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 4 cans whole canned anchovies | 4 tablespoons soy milk | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup cherries tomatoes or 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 1/2 lb stewed venison, diced
instructions: Cut meat into 3/4 inch cubes and set aside. Put the anchovies into a jar with a tight fitting lid. Add all remaining ingredients and seal.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,sea scallop,broad bean,beef sirloin steak,lettuce,spaghetti
title: Beef, Scallops & Spaghetti in One-Dish Salad
ingredients: 1 beef sirloin steak ( thinly sliced steak meat from the deli ) | 2 ounces spaghetti ( or similar ) | 2 ounces broad beans ( or dried beans ) | 1 ounce baby lettuce ( or other lettuce ) | 1 -2 teaspoon light soy sauce | 2 slices french's classic bread or 2 slices other crusty bread ( if you prefer )
instructions: Cook the pasta in boiling water and put it in cold water for about 5 minute drain and let it cool slightly cut the steak in half and then cross slice it into thin strips, set it aside when cooked and cool enough to handle remove and discard any remaining fat from the meat in a bowl, throw it away and set the beef strips aside. Pour the spaghetti in to a large serving bowl and add the broad bean/spaghetti mix and beans. Add the beef strips, tossing to coat them evenly with the beef slices and then season with the soy sauce. Garnish with the lettuce and sprinkle with the bread slices just before serving enjoy.

title: Marinated Cabbage Wraps
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 can evaporated fat-free cream of lime beverage or 1 cup hot coffee | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 semi-sweet chocolate shavings | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Slice coleslaw mix, 1/2 cup cream of lime, in half lengthwise, then in half crosswise. Separate the halves. Mix first 4 ingredients together in a glass bowl, making sure margarine is included in each slice. Slightly grease a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Spoon half of the marinade into the center of each piece of coleslaw. Top with half of the chocolate shavings, leaving about 2 inches between each piece of slaw. Wrap tightly in the plastic wrap. Allow to cure for at least 1 hour at room temperature. Drain, sprinkle lightly with extra melted chocolate.

title: Lamb Tenderloin
ingredients: 8 ounces pork tenderloin | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon wedges | 1 tablespoon finely minced yellow onion | 1 tablespoon lemon wine vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely grated cooking apples | powdered sugar, for dusting ( optional )
instructions: Slice the pork tenderloin. Mix all ingredients together. Dredge pork in a mixture of sugar and vinegar. Grill over medium coals for 20 minutes, or until done to your liking.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,phyllo pastry,demerara sugar,peach,chile pepper
title: Chipotle Peaches
ingredients: 6 large ripe peaches | 4 ounces thinly sliced chile peppers | 8 ounces thinly sliced chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 teaspoon demerara sugar | 1 sheet phyllo pastry
instructions: If using fresh peaches, cut off the stems and remove the peel on the peaches, leaving the peaches intact. Slice the peaches lengthwise into half moons. Place into bowl, sprinkle with salt, stir in the sugar, drizzle with some of the adobo juice, and set aside to macerate for about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Lay the phyllo pastry sheets on a cookie sheet, and brush lightly with some of the remaining adobo and sugar. Place a peach slice in the center, place another peach slice on top, and carefully top with the remaining four slices.

title: Cheesy Pea Bake
ingredients: 1 cup frozen cut stringless snow peas | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon molasses | 2/3 cup shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts, toasted
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f combine peas, broth, molasses, cheese and peanuts in a saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Mini Pretzels
ingredients: 4 cups unbleached cane sugar or 4 cups demerara beans | 2 packages yeast ( 2 packages )
instructions: In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the dough hook, mix the sugar and the yeast, incorporating all the flour and all of the sugar and yeast. Add enough additional flour to work out the lumps. The mixture should still be somewhat lumpy. Stalk each piece of dough on a sheet of waxed paper or lightly oiled parchment paper to prevent drying. Divide the dough into three pieces, cover and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper or lightly oiled. Preheat oven to 450°f. Roll out each piece of dough to an 8 x9 rectangle on a lightly floured surface. Place 1 - 2 tablespoons of the sugar mixture on top of each rectangle, then roll up, jelly roll fashion. Place each pretzel on a parchment lined baking sheet seam side down. Cover and leave to rise until doubled, about 35 minutes. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until bottoms of the pretzels become pale tan. Allow to cool slightly, then cut into 1/4 inch wedges. Serve cooled pretzels either warm on a pizza peel or with butter or jam as a snack.

title: Soyabe House Perfectly Simple Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 16 fresh spinach or 16 fresh spinach leaves, washed and dried | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 ounces soyabe's fresh white-blend prepared horseradish root ( naruto, or shoga mushi ) | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Remove the tough stem ends of the spinach or spinach leaves as it cooks. Place the spinach/spinach slices along the underside or on the end of a clean cloth to drain excess water. The leaves should be about 8 to 10 inches long or about 3 1/2 to 4 inches wide. Spread out evenly with your fingers, leaving about 1/2 inch of space at each end. Place about 1 tablespoon of parmesan or shoga on the spinach leaves or the spinach leaves at one end of each spinach leaf. Roll the spinach or shrimp from each end into a cylindrical roll, starting at the wide end and rolling tightly. Repeat until the spinach is finished rolling into cylinders or balls. Roll each cylinder or goiden roll to make a double decker. Chill completely before serving. It will keep several weeks. To serve, take the rolls from the refridgerator in a single layer and carefully remove the toothpicks. Place on serving platter, drizzle with mirin or soyabe's prepared horseradish sauce, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,puff pastry,fish sauce,half cream,extra virgin olive oil,wine vinegar,noodle
title: Thai Noodles (Prawn Pastry)
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed | 3/4 cup half-and-half cream or 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon seasoned wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 cup coarsely crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 450ºf. Unroll pastry sheets and cut into 3 even rectangles. Working with one at a time, transfer to a large, heavy duty baking sheet and place on top rack of oven. Bake until pastry is puffed up slightly when moved and golden brown, about 20 minutes. Stir cream and vinegar into pastry rectangles on baking sheet. Spread a little of the hot cream mixture over top of pastry and bake until cream is just beginning to thicken, about 1 minute. Stir in fish sauce and olive oil and return to oven and bake until sauce is bubbling and thickened, about 5 minutes.

title: Baked Souse' Bell Peppers
ingredients: 6 -8 bell peppers ( red, or yellow ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Cut peppers lengthwise into 1 inch strips, about 2 inches wide by 2 inches long. Place strips of peppers into greased oven proof baking dishes, leaving about 1/2 inch of space between strips. Sprinkle mace over top. Cover loosely with a piece of aluminum foil, but don't seal tightly. Pour boiling water in kettle to depth of one inch, just below top of foil, and cook over high heat until boiling. Cover tightly and remove from heat. Let stand 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,watercress,meyer lemon,rack lamb,sugar,chicken thigh,onion salt,cream mushroom soup
title: Lemony Lamb and Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons onion salt | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 rack lamb, bone in with bones, 3- 4 pounds | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup watercress, chopped | 1 meyer lemon, sliced
instructions: Sprinkle onion salt on rack of lamb. Place lamb on rack in a roasting pan. Bake in a preheated 450 oven for 45 minutes. Turn and brown other side, 7 to 10 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes, then slice thinly. In a small mixing bowl, combine kidney beans, soup, watercress and lemon.

title: Tomato and Mango Salsa
ingredients: 4 ripe mangoes, coarsely chopped | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1/2 cup mirin | salt and cayenne pepper to taste | 8 cups ice
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together mangoes, diced tomatoes, and mirin. Season with salt and cayenne pepper.

title: Clams in the Microwave (Clams in the Microwave)
ingredients: 8 small clams | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup caster sugar ( superfine )
instructions: Spray inside of your microwave safe bowl with cooking oil. Combine the soup and sugar and pour into your microwave safe bowl and mix well. Put your clams inside of bowl and cover with cling film until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,yellow squash,shallot,pecorino romano cheese,dumpling wrapper look,savoy cabbage,ravioli,black olive
title: Lamb and Savoy Ragu
ingredients: 1/2 medium yellow squash, chopped | 1/2 medium savoy cabbage, chopped | 1 shallots or 1 green onion, chopped | 12 ounces ground lamb or 12 ounces ground lamb | sliced black olives | 24 large dumpling wrappers, i like look for a picture on my website | 3 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 packages refrigerated ravioli or ( 12 ounce ) packages frozen ravioli
instructions: Cook squash, savoy cabbage and onion in a large pot over a medium heat until the cabbage just starts to soften. Drain off excess water. Add lamb, olives, dumpling wrappers and cheese and mix well together. Prepare ragu per package instructions, about 3 minutes for savoy cabbage and 15 to 20 minutes for cabbage. Place a scant 1 tablespoon of filling into the center of each ragu wrapper. Fold the ragu over the filling and tuck sides tightly.

Random Ingredients: bacon,silken tofu,cherry,pork,snow pea,sirloin tip roast,red potato
title: Hot and Sour Pork Stew
ingredients: 3 tablespoons silken tofu | 2 slices bacon, chopped | 2 tablespoons sliced cooked pork | 2 cups cubed sirloin tip roast | 1 1/4 pounds small red potatoes, cut into bite sized pieces | 1/2 pound snow peas, trimmed | 1/2 pound fresh sweet cherries, quartered
instructions: In a saucepan, place the tofu on its side, and place a skillet over medium heat. Cook the bacon in the microwave until crisp, about 5 minutes. Reserving the drippings from the pan, place the sirloin tip in the pan, and cook, breaking it up with a spatula, until nicely browned and no longer pink, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove the meat from the pan. Place the potatoes into the same skillet with the bacon drippings, and cook over medium high heat until browned, about 15 minutes. Mix in the snow peas and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. Stir the meat back into the skillet, and coat with the potato mixture. Heat through, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Spoon into bowls, and garnish with a few cherries.

title: Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 bag tortilla chips | 2 tablespoons nutmeg, grated to taste
instructions: Toast tortilla chips in dry skillet on medium heat until they are crisp and light golden brown. Using slotted spoon, remove chips from skillet. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Drizzle with more nutmeg.

title: Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Place jalapeno pepper, white wine vinegar, and chopped or finely diced jalapeno pepper through a food processor or blender.

title: Crab Nachos
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti, broken into thirds | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can crabmeat, drained and flaked | 3 tablespoons fresh raspberries or 3 tablespoons thawed frozen raspberries | crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 2 quarts of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the broken spaghetti, and cook until 'al dente', about 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in cream of mushroom soup, and heat until warmed through. Stir in crabmeat, and heat through. When all of the spaghetti is hot, drain, and toss with raspberries and tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: caribbean jerk seasoning,shaoxing wine,yellow pepper,red food coloring,penne,pomegranate molasses,pickle relish
title: Caribbean Jerk Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces penne | 2 ounces sweet pickle relish | 1/2 teaspoon caribbean jerk seasoning | 1 teaspoon pomegranate molasses | 4 drops red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 ounces yellow sweet peppers | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 2 1/2 teaspoons yellow hot pepper molasses
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente. Drain pasta and mix with sweet pickle relish, caribbean jerk seasoning and pomegranate molasses until well coated. Divide among serving dishes and garnish with yellow sweet pepper.

title: Roasted Corn Chips
ingredients: 1 cup cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon garlic pepper seasoning ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Mix cornstarch, black pepper, and or salt and pepper together and sprinkle evenly over the cornstarch mixture. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or wax paper. Bake the dough for 10 minutes, or until it flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,thyme sprig,garlic,picante sauce,lemon,dijon mustard,raisin
title: Quick and Easy Picante Sauce
ingredients: 1 can picante sauce | 1/2 cup raisins, or more to taste | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1/2 lemon, juiced, or to taste | 1 clove garlic, pressed, or to taste | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules, or to taste | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Stir picante sauce, raisins, mustard, lemon juice, garlic, bouillon granules, and thyme sprigs together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: pistachio,green curry paste,kosher salt,beef base,kalamata olive,gruyere cheese,beef steak
title: Beef Roll-Up
ingredients: 1 pound beef flank steak, sliced very thin | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 can or bottle dry french-style beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons green curry paste | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1 cup kalamata olives, pitted and finely chopped | 1/2 package pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Rinse meat under cold running water and pat dry. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle meat with salt. Cook in hot oil, stirring for about 1 minute. Pour beer over meat, cover and cook over medium heat, turning once, for about 5 minutes, until beef is evenly browned. Transfer meat to a plate. Cover with foil and keep warm. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil in skillet and stir in curry paste. Add the cheese and olives.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,chili paste,dark brown sugar,oyster sauce,large mushroom
title: Chilli-Hot Mushroom Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup dark brown sugar | 2 roma tomatoes | 150 g oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 lb large mushroom
instructions: Cut up the tomatoes, then fry them in oil. Cut the mushrooms into quarters then fry them in oil a little over medium heat.. Add the rest of the ingredients together in a small pot and boil off the alcohol.. Stir fry for about 2 minutes. Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: egg white,raspberry,iceberg lettuce,green pepper,sun tomato oil,cream chicken soup,fruit
title: Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 4 ounces cream of chicken soup | 8 ounces diced mixed fruit, drained | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup grated fresh lemon rind | 1 large egg white, lightly beaten | 1 lb iceberg lettuce, torn crosswise | 1/3 cup seedless raspberry, halved
instructions: In a small bowl combine the tomato, soup, fruit and green pepper. Add the rind of the egg white. Place the lettuce in a serving bowl. Sprinkle the tomato mixture on top of the lettuce and top with the raspberry halves.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,veal,rump roast,yellow squash,quinoa,coriander,coleslaw dressing
title: Paleo Pot Roast, Italian Style
ingredients: 2 lbs lean boneless chuck roast | 2 cups low fat coleslaw dressing | 1 package dry quinoa, medium-ripe | 3 cups cut up yellow squash | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 package part-skim ricotta cheese, low fat
instructions: In large plastic bag, combine coleslaw dressing, and quinoa. Seal and turn over bag to coat meat. Repeat process until ready to grill, 3 - 4 days. Discard dressing. Remove meat from bag and discard bag. Spray grill with nonstick cooking spray. Grill meat over hot coals 3 minutes for medium rare, or 7 minutes for medium. Transfer to platter, tent tent with foil, and let rest 10 minutes. Meanwhile, slice squash.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,superfine sugar,romano cheese,sea salt,cannellini bean,chocolate square,chicken breast fillet,olive
title: Chicken Fonduta
ingredients: 1 ounce superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon olive | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast fillet, cut into thin strips | 3 ounces canned cannellini beans, drained | 1/4 cup grated romano cheese | 1/3 cup chopped pitted ripe olives | 14 ounces miniature chocolate squares, with melted chocolate sprinkles
instructions: Combine sugar, olive oil, orange peel and chicken strips in a bowl. Toss well. Drain beans and combine with romano cheese and olives in a separate bowl. Divide chicken mix among four serving bowls and top with chocolate sprinkles. Serve at once.

title: Watercress Soup With Red Onions and Celery
ingredients: 1 red onion, quartered lengthwise | 8 -10 whole watercress, stemmed in | 2 -3 celery ribs | fat, to taste
instructions: Wash red onion and cut into half moons. Place in a saucepot or dutch oven and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Add celery, onion/celery stalks, and watercress. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer gently, until onion/celery leaves the side of the pan. Remove lid and skim off any foam that rises to the surface.

title: Salsa Di Cristina (Copycat)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 jar chunky salsa ( use whatever type you like ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 package button mushrooms
instructions: Heat over medium high heat until simmering. Meanwhile, drain beans and mushrooms and reserve liquid. Stir bean mixture until heated through. Remove mushrooms and discard. Serve on platter with sizzling chile sauce, if desired.

title: Tori's Chinese Mushroom Stock
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage or 4 small cabbage | 3 cans sliced mushrooms | freshly ground mace ( optional )
instructions: Chop the cabbage and mushrooms very thinly with a vegetable chopper. Place all ingredients in a huge stock pot and simmer 10 minutes at a medium heat to blend flavors. Take off heat and let cool. You may use all or half of the flavouring. Put into a jar and put out of the fridge. Leave overnight or serve the next day.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,dark beer,vegetable stock,green bean,green creme de menthe,quinoa,date,mexican corn
title: Easy and Quick Chicken and Manchego Paella
ingredients: 2 cans mexican-style corn | 2 cans chicken thighs ( in one can ) | 1 can green beans ( in one can ) | vegetable stock | 1 can dark beer | 2 cups dry quinoa | 1 dash green creme de menthe
instructions: Place the chicken thighs in a large dutch oven and add the mexican style corn, green beans and dark beer. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook the chicken until cooked through, approximately 40 minutes. Add the quinoa, cover and cook about 10 minutes more. Remove the can of chicken and stir the mixture. Remove the bay leaves. Stir the creme de menthe into the chicken chicken through the quinoa mixture. Cook until heated through.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,cellophane noodle,green olive,curry powder,white pepper
title: Cambodian Noodles
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili flakes | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 15 -20 green olives, pitted | white pepper | cellophane noodles
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients. Allow to sit for about 30 minutes for ingredients to combine. Serve cold. Enjoy.

title: Salsa Kidney Beans
ingredients: 7 ounces kidney beans or 8 ounces pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage | 1 tablespoon whole sesame seeds | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 cups beef bouillon or 1 1/2 cups canned low sodium beef broth
instructions: Add all ingredients to food processor.

title: Rice With Juniper and Long Grain White Beans (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups whole grain white rice or 2 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 tablespoon juniper berries, crushed
instructions: In a 6 quart rice cooker bowl or 4 cups measuring cup, combine the rice, juniper and the black pepper. Close the lid securely and process on high for 5 minutes. Set rice cooker to medium and continue processing for 20 - 25 minutes, or until all the rice grains are broken down into small grains.

title: American Tortillas
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon anchovy oil | 1 bay leaf | 2 ounces corn tortilla chips, coarsely crushed | 1/2 small shallot, minced
instructions: Heat anchovy oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Spread the crushed tortilla chips on a small plate. Stir the shallots into the hot oil and cook 5 seconds. Add the bay leaf. Serve the hot tortillas, warm or room temperature.

title: Dried Mexican Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oregano leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons mixed herbs
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and store in an airtight container. If you want to make dried meat instead of a meat, make it with a mortar and pestle.

Random Ingredients: yeast,salad green,bailey irish cream,tahini,red pepper,shallot,rye bread
title: Baileys Irish Cream Focaccia Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried yeast | 1 cup warm water | 4 -5 cups rolled gluten-free bread | 1/4 cup light biansweet pure tahini | 2 -3 tablespoons shallots, minced | 3 tablespoons roasted red peppers, chopped ( from a jar, i use rooster's delights roasted peppers ) | 4 tablespoons mixed salad greens ( i use spring mix )
instructions: Mix yeast and warm water in medium size mixing bowl. Let stand 10 minutes or until creamy.

title: Creamy Dorukka
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 7 ounces vegetable stock | 4 3 tablespoons drambuie | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander
instructions: Put the yoghurt, vegetable stock and drambuie in a blender. Blend until smooth. Then taste and adjust the seasoning. Pass through a fine mesh sieve into serving glasses, stir in the chopped fresh coriander and serve immediately.

title: Low-Fat Low-Moist Apple Pudding
ingredients: 1/3 cup skim milk or 1/3 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons low fat cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 cup desiccated apples with juice | 5 teaspoons fresh parsley leaves ( roughly chopped ) | 1 teaspoon lemon peel
instructions: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Place the milk/sherry in a small pot on the medium heat with a knob of butter over a low heat and stir until heated. Take the pot off the heat, then stir in the grated cheese and then the remaining ingredients. Pour into the prepared baking tray, spreading as evenly as possible. Place in the oven and bake for 45 - 50 minutes, until crisp and golden. Remove from the oven and allow to sit for two minutes. Serve either warm or cold with yoghurt or fat free yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: apricot,dark rum,golden syrup,garlic,corn tortilla,black forest ham,pork shoulder
title: Tajine (Island Breakfast)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds bone-in pork shoulder | 4 cloves garlic, chopped | 1/2 pound dark rum | 1/2 pound thick sliced apricots | 1 can sliced black forest ham, rind removed | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 package corn tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler. Lay the pork skin side up in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle garlic over pork. Bake in the preheated oven until the pork is tender, 35 to 40 minutes. Remove and discard the garlic. Remove pork from the oven and set aside. Discard fat from the bones, shred the meat with 2 forks, and set aside. In a large pot over medium heat, combine rum and rum. Bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits. Mix in apricots and cook until the fruit is tender. Stir in the ham and brown sugar. Continue to stir while cooking until ham is well browned. Transfer to a warmed platter, and spoon glaze over the tortillas.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,couscous,tomato,sesame oil,yogurt,puff pastry,picante sauce
title: Couscous Custard Pizza
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 tablespoons whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons sour yogurt | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon picante sauce | 1/4 cup couscous ( instant or uncooked, see note ) | 1/4 cup diced tomato
instructions: Note, this is the only time i made this recipe the night before, so it doesn't get cold when ready to bake. Preheat oven to 425 °f. Roll out each piece of pastry dough in a rectangle shape for 8x8 inches. Press each into a 12 x12 inch cake pan to form a rectangle of 5 x 9 inches. Set aside. Cut each sheet of frozen pastry in half lengthwise. Place one half sheet of pastry into each prepared pan. Combine ricotta, yogurt, sesame oil, picante sauce and couscous in a small bowl. Place tomato in a small bowl and toss with salt. Spread couscous mixture evenly over pastry. Spoon half of ricotta mixture over couscous, leaving about an inch at the top for a filling to spread. Gently spread remainder of ricotta mixture over tomatoes and couscous. Sprinkle top with half of cheese. Place other half of pastry on top of cheese. Top with remaining ricotta mixture and top with cheese. Spread top layer of pastry with tomatoes and couscous. Place in oven. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown and filling is bubbly and sauce is slightly thickened. Serve.

title: Spanish Spicy Dark Chocolate Sauce, from Good Eats
ingredients: 1/2 cup light molasses | 1/8 cup dark soy sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 cloves garlic, finely minced | 1/2 teaspoon ground star anise | 1 lemon, juiced | 1/2 cup dutch-processed cocoa, for dusting
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small saucepan. Place over medium heat and bring to a boil over medium heat until thickened, about 2 minutes. Turn off heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Pour cooled mixture into a jar and refrigerate for up to 6 months. Note, for creamier sauce use milk or cream of wheat. Stir in 3 t. Orr. Sweetener, depending on how thick you want it to be.

title: Orange Baked Veggies
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoned bread | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 orange, juiced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Brush 2 cookie sheets with melted butter. Place eggplants on cookie sheets. Roast in preheated oven on bottom rack. Remove from oven, and cut into bite size pieces. Bring to a boil. Place on cookie sheets. Stir onions and soup mix into boiling soup mix.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,active yeast,parsley,black bean,prosciutto di parma,cumin powder,balsamic vinegar,port wine
title: Portabella Black Bean Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup port wine or 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 4 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/3 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 3 slices prosciutto di parma, cut into chunks | 4 sprigs fresh parsley | 2 1/2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Add the port, cumin and chili flakes to the yeast. Add the beans, prosciutto, parsley sprigs, balsamic vinegar and 1 1/4 cups water and mix well. Set aside in a warm place and allow to rise for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Put the yeast in a large bowl, pour the rest of the water around the bowl. With a spoon, work into the yeast with the teaspoon of yeast, about 1 teaspoon at a time. Let rise 2 hours. In a preheated 400 degree f oven, knock the wall of the bread down and leave at least 10 inutes. Stir the bread into the top and brown on both sides for 5 minutes toasty smell. Cut through the bread with a kitchen scissors. You may need to cover with plastic to prevent the bread from getting excessively brown on the bottom.

title: Scallops and Chive Wraps
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 8 ounces medium shrimp, peeled, deveined, tail removed | 2 ounces chives, stems removed, leaves thinly sliced | 2 hard-boiled eggs, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 6 tortillas, for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Coat a medium baking sheet with cooking spray. Toss shrimp, chives, eggs, ketchup in a bowl to coat. Bake in the oven until shrimp is barely opaque, about 8 minutes. Serve sprinkled with chives.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,sesame oil,mexican cheese,cream mushroom soup,chicken bouillon cube
title: Sour Cream Chicken With Gruyere on Toast
ingredients: 2 cups sour cream | 2 tablespoons sesame oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( we like cambosh ) | 1/2 cup mexican cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine sour cream, oil and bouillon in a medium bowl. Toss with cooked chicken. Spread mixture onto hot ungreased pan. Sprinkle cheese over mixture. Cook until cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,vegetable stock,half,salt black pepper,onion paste
title: Creamy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 pound dried pinto beans | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup minced onion, or to taste ( optional ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/8 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place pinto beans in a bowl and cover with several inches of water. Soak overnight. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Add onions and cook over medium heat until onions soften and darken, about 5 minutes. Pour in 1/4 of the vegetable stock, and stir in the beans. Add remaining stock and salt and pepper. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 1 hour, adding more stock if necessary.

title: Pineapple-Garlic Sprouts
ingredients: 1 package fresh pineapple slices in juice, cut in half lengthwise | 3 cloves garlic pepper seasoning | 1 container bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange pineapple halves onto a baking sheet. Brush each half with garlic pepper seasoning. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until pineapple are tender.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,mirin,coffee bean,cotija cheese,nutella,beef sirloin
title: Beef and Bean Kabobs With Cotija Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin or 1 lb top round beef, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 lb japanese breakfast hot sausage | 1 lb hot italian sausage, cut in half lengthwise | 1 cup cotija cheese | 1 cup toasted nutella ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons instant coffee beans
instructions: Combine beef cubes with hot sausage in large bowl or resealable plastic baggie. Using hands or hands, mix together beef and sausage, being careful not to over work the cubes as they can become soggy. Thread beef and sausage on skewers. Grill or broil kabobs, about 4 minutes per side, brushing with melted butter if desired, until just cooked through and no longer pink. Meanwhile, prepare coffee bean sandwich spread, in a small bowl, combine cotija cheese and nutsella. Spread on toast, dividing evenly. Serve immediately.

title: Courgettes With Cornstarch
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray, for greasing | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 courgettes, each weighing around 200g | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil, for shallow-frying
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c, 400f, gas mark 4 / 350°f. Prepare courgettes by cutting a thin slice off the base and then chopping the stalk very finely. Add to a bowl with a small amount of water and stir in the cornflour.. Cut 4 - 5 lengths of kitchen paper about 10cm wide / 5cm long. Lightly coat the courgettes well with oil and place onto a large baking tray. Bake for 15 minutes or until tender. Serve immediately with chutney.

Random Ingredients: stuffing,plain flour,pear,mexicorn,thai red chili pepper,bamboo shoot
title: Red Bell Pear Burgers
ingredients: 2 large pears, pared and cored | 4 small thai red chili peppers, seeded | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 150 g canned sliced bamboo shoots | 1/4 cup frozen mixed mushrooms | 1/3 cup dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut pears in half and remove fruit. Remove seeds from peppers & dice. Combine flour & vinegar and sprinkle over pears, place into fridge for 15 min to marinate. Drain fruit & chop. Toss with rest of ingredients and marinate for at least 1 hour. Serve on burger buns.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile,lime juice zest,coffee granule,bean sprout,crabmeat,creme de cassis,sunflower oil
title: Creamy Crab Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh bean sprouts | 4 ounces imitation crabmeat, drained with marinade | 2 tablespoons creme de cassis, creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon finely grated lime zest | 1 tablespoon coffee granules | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 3/4 teaspoon coarsely crushed dried ancho chile
instructions: Combine all salad ingredients into a salad bowl. Add creme de cassis or mayonnaise, lime rind, coffee granules and sunflower oil. Mix well. Serve immediately or store in refrigerator for flavors to develop.

title: Aussie Baked Carrots With Toasted Rum Dip
ingredients: 1 package baby carrots, trimmed | 1 loaf bread, torn into pieces, crusts removed | 1/4 - 1/3 cup paprika or 1/4-1/3 cup chutney | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 cup chopped mango chutney | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento ( green part only ) | 1 cup thawed frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/2 cup crushed corn chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400ºf. Combine the pimentos and chutney in a bowl and set aside. Grease an 8 square baking dish. Place the carrots in a steamer over boiling water. Cover, and steam for 2 to 3 minutes or until tender but not mushy. Remove the carrots once they are cool enough to handle. Place the bread pieces on a clean, dry platter, and toast until lightly toasted, but not browned. Set aside. Stir rum and paprika into the bowl with the carrots. Spoon or pipe the contents of the bowl and contents onto the toast.

title: Cilantro and Chorizo Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro | 3 tablespoons extra creamy yoghurt | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 lb smoked mexican chorizo sausage, casings removed | 2 cups finely chopped cod | 4 cups hot cooked rice | taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to grease two 6 x 4 inch baking dishes or a large baking dish. In a medium non stick pan over medium heat, cook chorizo until browned and crumbly but not cooked through. Drain off excess fat. Add cilantro and mix well. Add yoghurt and 1/4 cup enchilada sauce, stirring. When the yogurt is warmed, stir in chorizo and cod. Pour mixture into dish and level. Season with salt and pepper. Bake for 30 minutes or until sauce has reduced a little and cod is opaque. Serve with remaining enchilada sauce.

title: Chile Relish II
ingredients: 8 flour tortillas | 10 dried chilies, seeded and torn into pieces | plum, slices chopped ( a few small star fruit is okay ) or cored ( a few small star fruit is okay ), for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 500f degrees. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, using two flour tortillas, roll each into a rectangle about 1/2 inch thick. Tightly wrap the tortillas into a cylinder that measures about 1/2 inch thick. Secure the rolls to the prepared baking sheets with kitchen twine. Bake 10 - 15 minutes then remove and transfer the tortillas to a cutting board. To serve, remove from oven and set aside, keeping warm. To serve, spread the chile pieces on a plate. Place 2 or 3 plum on top and garnish with a little cotija. Yum.

title: Amerikaner (Lobster Cocktail)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground anise seed | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 1/2 pounds fresh lobster meat, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 ripe olives, chopped
instructions: Heat an olive oil skillet over medium high heat. Cook aniseed and sage leaf in the heated oil until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir chile powder into anise and add lobster.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,confectioner sugar,dark soy sauce,red chili powder,pepper,egg white
title: Confectioner's Shredded
ingredients: 5 slices fresh bacon | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon red chili powder ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 3 -4 tablespoons sifted confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cut the bacon into about 1/4 inch squares and place them in a large, deep skillet. Briefly sauté the bacon in the pan at medium heat until it starts to render its fat and turns crispy. Remove bacon and set aside. Crumble bacon slightly but not thoroughly. In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg white, red chili powder, light soy sauce and pepper. Place the bacon in the egg white and blend thoroughly. Add the sifted confectioner's sugar, stirring just until the sugar dissolves, but not completely. Pour the mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a round tip. Seal the bag and shake to combine. Once all the ingredients are mixed, roll the bag to roll the rest of the ingredients. Line a medium saucepan with parchment paper, and put the bag of shreddeds in it.. Place over a medium heat, and keep a close eye on it so it does not burn. Once the bag has melted and become very dark, remove it from the heat. The color of the hot sun needs to turn dark enough for this. It should take about 10 - 15 minutes depending on the oven's heat. When the bag is golden brown and the oil starts separating from it, remove it from the heat. It should be about 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons in color.

title: Garlicky Chili
ingredients: 8 poblano chiles | 1 quart beef stock | 1/2 cup grenadine | 1 dash marjoram or 1 dash thyme

instructions: Spread cherry or pineapple filling on top of each serving or wrap with a sheet of plastic wrap. Sprinkle with creole seasoning, sugar, coarse salt and chopped nuts if using. Serve immediately. Garnish with lettuce greens.

instructions: Prepare grill and place rack 4 to 6 inches from the heating element. Lightly coat a 12 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add lentils and sugar. title: Sweet & Spicy Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup catalina dressing | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon mild prepared chinese hot prepared spaghetti sauce ( or spicy v8 style )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. Stir on medium/low until thickened. If making ahead, cover and return to pan. If making ahead, cover and return to pan for 5 minutes. Cool completely and store in refrigerator. If freezing, place in freezer bags when indicated to freeze, or allow to defrost in refrigerator when indicated to freeze.

title: Easy Chive Chive Cake
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 1 can chopped champignons packed in heavy syrup | 2 tablespoons minced fresh chives | salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Prepare the white cake mix according to package directions, and pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle in the chives, and toss to evenly distribute. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,chili sauce,brandy,garam masala,orange juice,chili oil,mushroom
title: Spicy Chilli Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon orange juice ( freshly squeezed ) | 2 -4 teaspoons lemon peel, very finely grated | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 500 g large fresh mushrooms, very thinly sliced | 1/4 cup sweetened chili sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Add in chilli, garam masala, orange and lemon peel. Stir fry for 15 seconds, then add in mushrooms, chili sauce and sweetened red chili sauce. Fry for 2 minutes to heat through.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,strawberry,breadcrumb,cumin powder,pesto sauce,greek yogurt,vegetable stock,kosher salt black pepper
title: Grilled Strawberry Stuffed Chilled Cheese Strawberries
ingredients: 4 medium strawberries, stemmed | 1/3 cup plain greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons toasted breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons store-bought pesto sauce, plus additional | pesto sauce, for dipping | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 pinch ground allspice | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil over high heat. Place the strawberries in a serving dish and cover with several inch pieces of fresh mozzarella cheese. In a bowl whisk the yogurt, bread crumbs, pesto, cumin, allspice, salt and pepper to taste. In a large saute pan, set over high heat, add the remaining marinade ingredients and stir until the pesto has melted and the tomatoes have begun to shrink back from the pan, about 3 - 5 minutes. Transfer the tomatoes and mozzarella to the bowl with the mozzarella and cheese and marinade. Cover and allow to stand for 30 minutes to marinate.. Heat an outdoor grill or a grill pan over high heat. Remove the pan from the heat and line it with a sheet of aluminum foil, shiny side down. Place the strawberry mixture on the foil and place under the preheated grill, close the lid and cook for 4 minutes. Unwrap the cheese and remove the stems and set them aside. Transfer the strawberries to a serving bowl. Spoon the roasted pesto onto the chilled cheese and serve. Cook's note, a tablespoon of plain pesto mixed with about 1 teaspoon of ground cumin powder is enough for a smoky flavor, but if you prefer it mild, try using the entire tablespoon of roasted cumin. If you prefer it more spicy, add a tablespoon of ground paprika.

title: Cheesy Quinoa and Escarole Rice (Gluten free)
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking brown rice ( i recommend stove | 1 cup quinoa ( i prefer white ) | 1/2 head escarole ( i use large can ) | 6 ounces blue cheese, crumbled | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves, chopped fine ( i used dried )
instructions: Prepare the quinoa, as I like to say, it is a long time process, and the texture is already sticky. Rinse the rice in a strainer once with cold water, and then drain. Bring your 2 quarts of water to a boil in a wide pot, and add the quinoa. Swirl the pot until the water comes to a boil, cover, and bring it back to a boil. If possible, leave it for at least 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, if you like your rice to be slightly translucent, just cover it longer. Stir well, cover again, and boil until it has absorbed all the water. While the rice cooks, prepare the escarole and cheese. Once the rice is cooked, fluff it up with fork, and stir the cheese and oregano into the quinoa in a bowl. If you need more liquid, just add more water, or more rice. When it is done, stir it up again, and cover. Let it stand off the heat for 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,strip steak,liqueur,sun tomato pesto,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Pesto-Wrapped Steak Rounds
ingredients: 1 strip steak | 1 large yellow pepper | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato pesto | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 2 tablespoons liqueur
instructions: Heat an outdoor grill for medium high heat. Grill steak slices until desired doneness, 7 to 10 minutes per side for rare. Slice peppers into rounds, then thinly slice rounds with the grain. Spoon 1 teaspoon pesto onto each slice of steak. Add an adobo pepper to each steak. Mix the sun dried tomato pesto and chipotle sauce in a small bowl, and pour into a small bowl. Drizzle 1 teaspoon pesto onto each steak, and serve.

title: American Piña Colada
ingredients: 6 quarts water | 2 lbs white american cheese, cut into cubes | 3 lbs white onions, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup white rum | 3 tablespoons cognac | 6 tablespoons fresh white port wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 small sweet onions, very thinly sliced ( to garnish )
instructions: Wash the cheese in cold water.

title: Quick and Easy Steak Marinade
ingredients: 6 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup club soda | 1 tablespoon steak seasoning | 1 cube vegetable bouillon
instructions: In a large non metallic bowl, combine all ingredients. Add meat.

title: Alaskan Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut into strips | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 dash almond extract | 1 small onion, coarsely chopped | 8 ounces scallops, cut into 12 pieces, with shell | 2 bay leaves | 8 corn tortillas | 3/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 3/4 cup gruyere cheese
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook the pork strips and onion over low heat about 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Add scallops.

title: Tangerine Seasoning

instructions: Place zest in a small microwave safe bowl, add 2 cups boiling water, cover bowl and microwave on high 2 1/2 minutes or until zest is tender. Drain zest, return to bowl, add 3 tablespoons chopped chives, 2 tablespoons of chopped chives, 1 teaspoon of dried tangerine zest, 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne and 1/4 teaspoon of seasoning blend.

title: Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cake flour | 1 1/4 pounds yellow onions, peeled, finely chopped | 6 red chiles, seeded, finely chopped | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl combine flour and half of the onions. Stir in chilies and toss to coat evenly. Lightly spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange chilies in a single layer on the baking sheet. Sprinkle with flour mixture, shaking off excess. Bake in preheated oven until golden, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: apple,harissa,chili garlic sauce,green onion,parsley,asparagus,caraway seed,chili sauce
title: Harissa Sausages
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus | 1/2 lb fresh carrot, trimmed and cut into pieces | 2 -3 green onions ( finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 3 -5 drops hot chili-garlic sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet parsley or 1 tablespoon coriander | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Chop the asparagus and carrots into 3/4 inch lengths. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and add asparagus and carrot. Cook for a few minutes to steam the carrot and asparagus, then set aside. Meanwhile, combine harissa, chili sauce and the hot chili garlic sauce in a small bowl. To grill sausages, heat a little oil in a pan. When hot, rub the asparagus and carrots with the harissa paste and fry on both sides. Remove from pan and set aside on clean plate. When all the sausages are cooked, remove them from the pan and cut into bite sized pieces. Set aside, and keep warm. To grill the asparagus and carrots, heat a little oil in pan, and brown the asparagus and carrots with the harissa, garlic and hot chile sauce. Turn only occasional bubbles if needed so as not to burn the garlic. Serve the sausages with the asparagus and carrots. Garnish with the parsley and coriander.

title: Authentic Mexican Stew
ingredients: 1 jar hominy, drained | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 cup veal stock | 1 1/2 bunches fresh mussels | 1 bell pepper, chopped ( i use red bell pepper for more color )
instructions: Pour the canned vegetables and the broth into the stew pot. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the mussels. Cover and cook for another 10 minutes uncovered stirring occasionally. Discard any mussels that float to the surface. Serve with brown bread and sour cream.

title: Baked Asparagus and Kumara
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon lime, divided | 2 large baking potatoes, about 1 pound | 5 ounces asparagus spears, cut into 2 inch pieces | 5 ounces sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
instructions: Stir together yeast with 1 teaspoon of the lime juice in a medium bowl until yeast begins to foam. Add remaining lime juice.

title: Italian Bride Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried porcini mushrooms, crushed and drained | 1/2 lb shredded mexican cheese | 1/2 lb shredded spanish mild cheese | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts, toasted | 1 tablespoon minced capers | 1 tablespoon minced fresh rosemary
instructions: Place the dried porcini mushrooms into a small bowl and mix in the mexican cheese and then the spanish mild cheese, the toasted walnuts, the capers and the minced rosemary. Beat well, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to 2 days before serving.

title: Cucumber Salad (Shrikhand)
ingredients: 2 bunches cucumbers ( about 1-3 pounds ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 grated lime, juice and zest of | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Peel cucumbers and cut into bite size pieces.

title: Sliced Beef and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 package egg noodles | 1/2 cup light brown onions, chopped | 1/4 cup chili pepper flakes | 1 pint vanilla ice cream | 1/2 cup cooked turkey, diced
instructions: Combine beef, noodles, onions, chili, ice cream and turkey in a greased 8x12 baking dish. Bake at 375 degrees for 50 - 60 minutes or until noodles and meat are tender.

title: Almond-Cayenne Powder (Using Almonds)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine cayenne, almond extract and a teaspoon of cayenne powder on a teaspoon of water and microwave briefly, stirring once. The temperature should droosh around 90 degrees f until the mixture boils. Pour into a container and keep in the refrigerator until needed.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,bamboo shoot,white truffle oil,skewer,swiss cheese,poblano pepper
title: Rice With Poblanos and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 4 medium poblano peppers | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/3 cup white truffle oil | 2 1/2 teaspoons white truffle oil | 1/3 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 8 bamboo shoots, washed, cut, grilled | 6 saffron rice sticks, soak in hot water, drained
instructions: For filling, roast the poblanos under the grill for about 10 minutes or just until blackened. Cool and peel away the black skins. Slice off the tops and seeds. Slice off the bottoms of the poblanos. Remove the black skins. Remove and reserve the head of the poblanos. Place the peppers in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Allow to sit for about 20 minutes, then drain, run under cold water to cool. Remove and discard the seed ends. Cut the pepper in half lengthwise, remove the seeds and membrane, and discard. Cut the pepper halves into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a glass bowl with the vinegar, truffle oil, and 2 1/2 tsp of the truffle oil. Blend well until all the ingredients are well combined. Arrange the pepper slices in a single layer on the skewers. Spoon half the filling over the poblanos. Stir the cheese into the cheese until it melts. Drain all but 2 tsp of the truffle oil. Spread the cheese over the top of the pepper and poblanos. Serve at room temperature.

title: Sharon's Tasty Italian Style Subs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pizza sauce | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon instant minced saffron threads | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1/4 teaspoon saffron-flavored cooking sauce, optional to taste | 8 hoagie rolls or 8 thin submarine rolls
instructions: In a small bowl, combine pizza sauce, margarine and saffron. Heat butter and saffron flavored cooking liquid on low until warm. Pour half of sauce over rolls and serve. Serve with other optional toppings on top.

title: Green Beans With Cream on the Side
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream
instructions: In a steamer basket over boiling water, steam until tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, steam green beans in the cream just until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain green beans and transfer to a serving dish. Makes 2 to 3 servings. Note, prep time does not include steaming.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,green cardamom,cocoa powder,italian seasoning,pickle,ginger,raisin,lemon extract
title: Chickpea Fudge
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups raisins | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons italian spices | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon extract | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated raw garlic | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 1 1/2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. Place the raisins in a bowl and cover with hot tap water. Cover bowl and soak overnight. Drain and place the cooked raisins in a clean kitchen towel. Add the remaining ingredients to the raisins. Wet fingers and rub the palms of your hands with water. Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts. Roll each piece into a ball, then put each one on a parchment lined baking sheet. Press in a palm of your hand to flatten each ball. Bake for 1 hour, or until edges are firm. While still hot, remove from the oven, drizzle the melted chocolate around the fudge, and then drizzle a little more. Toothpick, put a toothpick through the center to secure. Variations, add 1/2 cup shredded carrot, 1 - 2 tablespoons chopped candied ginger and 1/2 tablespoon red candied ginger. Add 3/4 cup grated nutmeg, 1/2 1 tablespoon of ground cinnamon and 1/4 tablespoon ground cardamom. If using grated apple, add 2 tablespoons sugar.

title: Greek Sushi

instructions: Prepare chicken wings, wash and dry. Mix vinegar, saffron, oregano and beer. Add chicken wings. Sprinkle with pepperoni. Let stand 30 minute at room temperature or refrigerate overnight. Drain well.

title: Pineapple Greek Pasta

instructions: In medium bowl, mix salad dressing, pineapple juice or orange juice concentrate and olives. Add pasta and mix gently. Sprinkle top with crumbs. Sprinkle with anise liqueur.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove casings from sausage meat and remove meat from casings. title: Mixed Soybeans

instructions: Place soyabean beans in a large saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil.

instructions: Place everything in a bowl, and using a potato masher or your hands, mash until it's a smooth sauce consistency. Add more water if desired depending on how thick it is. Keep refrigerated and set aside for at least 1 hour. When you need it, stir and enjoy.

title: Queso Blanco Dip

instructions: Combine all ingredients and spread into small bowl with plastic wrap. Cover with plastic wrap, then refrigerate several hours or overnight to blend flavors. Serve with tortilla chips.

instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock pot. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Note, the idea is to combine the flavors and keep at least 4 to 6 hours on low, although a few hours will make your mouth water.

title: Creamy Pasta and Bean Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces rotini pasta or 12 ounces your favorite spaghetti, cooked al dente according to directions | 6 ounces bean slices | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, seeded and sliced into strips | 1/8 cup cake flour | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup chopped celery leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f place the dry pasta on a lightly greased baking sheet and bake in the oven for 20 minutes. While preparing the beans, combine the beans and bell pepper strips in a small saucepan with enough water to cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until the pepper is tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the flour and cream until well blended and well blended. Add the bell pepper mixture to the pasta in the saucepan. Toss until the pasta coats the pasta completely. Transfer half the pasta mixture into a 1 quart casserole. Top with the bean mixture and sprinkle with remaining pasta mixture. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Mexican Brownie Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cocoa powder, dark
instructions: Mix fennel with cocoa powder in small bowl.

title: Kefalonites

instructions: Mix ground round, 3/4 cup confectioners' sugar, salt, and cream of tartar with hands until well combined. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat until just smoking. Arrange the patties in the oil so they are not crowded. Cook patties until nicely browned, about 8 to 10 minutes per side. title: Pasta Florentine

instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. While pasta is cooking, dice mushrooms and saute in a large skillet with the garlic and onions. Slightly mix in shiitaki asiago cheese until melted and mixed well. Pour over pasta and toss to coat.

title: Super Easy Tempeh in Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 package tempeh | 1 can sweet chili sauce
instructions: Cut tempeh into bite size pieces. Put in crockpot. Pour over sweet chili sauce. Cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Serve over rice.

title: Quick & Easy Coleslaw
ingredients: 375 g rotini pasta or 375 g penne pasta | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 4 spring onions, chopped ( white part only ) | 1 packet coleslaw mix | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules ( not granular )
instructions: Cook pasta according to pack instructions. Saute spring onions in a little olive oil spray. Add chicken bullion. When pasta is cooked drain and toss together in a large bowl with coleslaw and onion mixture. Serve warm.

title: Crock Pot Carribean Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef roast | 3 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1/4 cup seasoning | 1 banana
instructions: Mix all ingredients except banana on crock pot. Let cook on low setting 8 - 12 hours. Serve with tortillas and guacomole.

title: Parmesan Pastries
ingredients: 12 puffed egg whites | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Draw 24 - 2 inch circles on the parchment paper, and place on the prepared baking sheet. Fill each circle with about 1 tablespoon of the cream mixture, and seal the edges, or press out air bubbles with your hands before baking. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes to set cooked pastry nicely.

title: Cashew Puffs

instructions: Heat griddle to 400 degrees f. Sift the gound flour into a bowl. Add a splash of water all at once to a lumps, or use your fingers to rub it into the flour. Mix with your fingertips until the mixture forms soft crumbs. Put a teaspoon of the ground cashews in each patty, then roll the puffs into puffs. Heat the griddle. And repeat steps five and six until all are used. Serve immediately. Recipe is also good with jam and ice cream.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,wild rice,mustard seed,bratwurst,snow pea,flat leaf parsley
title: Wild Rice With Brats
ingredients: 1/2 cup wild rice | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons butter | 3 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 lb bratwurst ( turkey or beef ) | 1/2 cup sliced almonds or 1/2 cup snow peas | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions and keep warm. Meanwhile, heat oil or butter in a large nonstick skillet, until boiling. Add mustard and mustard seeds, cover and cook for 1 minute or until seeds pop. Add bratwurst, cover and cook until beginning to turn crisp, about 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in rice and nuts.

title: Spicy Egg and Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 1 jumbo egg | 1 teaspoon whole grain mustard | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/2 cup thick & chunky salsa, salsa or 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1 green cardamom pod
instructions: Hard boil the egg for 1 minute. Cool the egg for 1 minute and peel. Slit the egg lengthwise. Place egg on the flat side of a serving dish or dish, slightly overlapping the edges from the sides. Make a space in the center of the egg with your finger and place a teaspoon or a few drops of mustard into the space. Crack the egg shells into the space. Lightly whisk the egg white and pepper into the egg and sprinkle over the egg. Sprinkle the chili powder and salt and pepper over the salsa. Let sit for 10 minutes. Stir gently and gently. Sprinkle the green cardamom over the egg and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,egg yolk,mango puree,cauliflower floret,green bean
title: Torta De Cebola (Torta with Mango-Green Bean Sauce)
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret | 8 large egg yolks | 1 1/2 cups mango puree ( not the canned chunky kind ) | picante sauce | 1/2 cup green beans, cooked and drained
instructions: Steam or steam the cauliflower floret until tender. Do not overcook the cauliflower. Allow to cool for a few minutes. In a blender puree the cooled cauliflower into a smooth sauce and add the rest of the ingredients. Set aside. Serve chilled.

title: French Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans french style green beans, drained | 1 can tomato juice | 1 cup ginger ale
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the green beans, tomato juice and ginger ale. Chill until serving.

title: Homemade Potatoes & Tomato
ingredients: 28 ounces italian-style stewed tomatoes | 24 ounces potato starch or 24 ounces corn tortilla dough
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. In a large bowl, mix the stewed tomatoes and potato starch. Add enough water to just cover the potatoes and tomatoes. Mix well and set aside for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, put the flour or corn tortilla dough into a deep dish, or one of two cookie sheets. Dip the tortilla dough first into the flour or corn tortilla batter and then roll it into a sausage shape on the cookie sheet, or using a pastry bag fitted with a star tip. Repeat this with the remaining dough until all the dough is used. Place the sausage on top of the dough and spread evenly with the stewed tomato/potato mixture. Bake for about 30 minutes or until the crust has browned.

title: Apricot and Chipotle Jam With Adobo
ingredients: 8 dried apricots ( i use golden delicious ) | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo | 3 -4 cups strained apricot jam or 3 -4 cups strained apricot jam, with pulp
instructions: Scrub dried apricots, cut into small chunks and soak in hot water until tender, about 30 minutes. Drain, drain and place in a small saucepan. Add chipotles and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer over medium heat until most of the liquid has been absorbed. Pour jam over apricot chunks with pulp or jam as desired. Stir and simmer, uncovered, until jam is soft and jam is completely thickened, about 6 - 8 minutes. Discard chipotles. Chill jam before using, as jam tends to settle if left to rest. Enjoy.

title: Sticky Rice Cheesecakes(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons glutinous-rice, uncooked | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup loose aluminum foil, lightly toasted | 1 baked 9 inch pie shells
instructions: Place rice in a bowl and cover with cold water, about 2 inches deep. Soak at room temperature 15 minutes. Drain. Stir ricotta cheese into rice until well combined. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the foil on a large rimmed baking sheet. Spread rice into the center of the foil. Sprinkle with a scant 1 cup of rice and 1/2 cup ricotta mixture. Fold the sides and top of the foil over the cheese, scrunching it as you go. Pinch the sides and bottom edges of the foil together with the rice. Cut steamers into 5 x 1 inch squares. Place the squares on the baking sheet. Bake 17 minutes. Remove the foil squares from the oven.

title: Tacos de Espinaca (Tacos de Espinacas)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef chuck | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 4 tablespoons ground almonds | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 6 flour tortillas ( fresh or purchased, 1-inch diameter, 8-inch-square ) | 4 jalapenos, stemmed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.
