In a small bowl, mix the chuck, turmeric, almonds, sugar and half the tortillas and the jalapenos together and roll into 8 cylinders about 8 inches long and 1/4 inch thick. Arrange over a baking sheet and bake until browned on all sides, 20 to 25 minutes. Cool slightly and slice, arrange and serve.

title: Oven Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice ( about 3 oranges ) | 1 cup taco bell light thick and chunky taco sauce
instructions: Mix all together. Heat in a frying pan over medium heat for about 1 1/2 minutes per side.

title: Polish Pumpkin Pie With Pumpkin Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne, uncooked | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 cup chopped cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 2 cups chopped cherry tomatoes or 2 cups grape tomatoes
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Lazy Tongues
ingredients: 3 packages refrigerated fresh pasta | 1 pound fresh lemon linguine | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Combine uncooked linguine with lemon noodles in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water. Cook, covered, on medium heat until pasta is tender but still slightly firm, about 13 minutes. Drain pasta well. Stir graham cracker crumbs into cooked linguine. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,pistachio,vanilla bean,cottage cheese,soda water,garlic seasoning,dark brown sugar,horseradish
title: Cottage Cheese Salad by Carolyn
ingredients: 15 ounces cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon grated dark brown sugar | fried slivers mandarin soda water | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 1 teaspoon dried mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon garlic seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: Drain cottage cheese and mash well with a fork. Stir in the horseradish, brown sugar and about 4 tablespoons of the soured horseradish dressing. Sprinkle the crushed mandarin soda water over cheese mixture and add more dressing. Garnish with chopped nuts, dried mustard seeds, and garlic seasoning.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,tomato ketchup,lemon peel,vanilla pudding,cucumber,tarragon vinegar,garam masala powder
title: Lemon and Garam Masala Popsicles
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, mashed | 2 tablespoons lemon peel, grated | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup or 2 tablespoons heinz dipping sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1 small cucumber
instructions: Mix garlic, lemon peel & vinegar together & refrigerate for 15 minutes. Whisk ketchup with seasoning. To peel cucumber slice off the ends, then slice lengthwise into 12 slices, then slice crosswise into very thin slices. Place prawns in a bowl of cold water & set aside. Remove peel & discard using a sharp knife. Add the garlic and lemon peel to the ketchup mixture, toss to combine. Place cucumber slices into separate glass bowls & pour mixture over prawns, stir to coat. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: baby potato,irish cream,grape tomato,ricotta cheese,vanilla ice cream
title: Irish Potatoes & Ricotta Cheese Parfaits
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese, well-washed | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla ice cream | 8 baby potatoes, sliced horizontally | 1/3 cup seedless grapes or 1/3 cup cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup irish cream, warmed
instructions: To make the parfaits, put ricotta, vanilla and ice cream into a small bowl and stir until well mixed. Put potatoes into a greased, 13x9 inch baking dish. Spread about 1 1/2 cups of the ricotta mixture over the potatoes. Spoon the ricotta mixture over the ricotta and spread to cover. Cover the top of ricotta with sliced tomatoes. Dot the top with the remaining cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes or until the parfaits are toasted and cheese is bubbly.

title: Egg & Vegetables (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 spring onion, finely sliced | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, slivered | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon mint, chopped | 1 ounce provolone cheese, roughly grated | 2 teaspoons almond extract or 2 teaspoons almond paste, grated
instructions: Combine sesame seeds, spring onion, almonds, egg, mint. Add provolone & almond extract. Beat well until smooth & creamy. Pour over vegetables & toss.

title: Spiced Whole Wheat (Or Black) Wheat
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat ( sushi grade dark wheat ) | 8 fresh lime leaves | 12 -16 saffron | 12 -16 fresh marjoram ( or 3 tsp. dried marjoram leaves ) | 2/3 cup dark sesame oil ( good quality! ) | 1/2 cup catsup
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Rinse the wheat and soak overnight or for at least 4 hours. Drain well and bring to a boil. Cover and return to the oven. Bake at 325°f for 1 hour or until the grains are dry and crisp. Cool completely and transfer to a bowl. Add remaining ingredients, except the catsup. Toss to combine. Stir in the catsup.

Random Ingredients: scallion,fruit blackberry,white bean,garlic,rice flour,extra virgin olive oil
title: Crispy Black Beans & Rice Dumplings
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried black beans or 1 1/2 cups brown beans, picked over and rinsed | 1/2 cup dried white beans | 3 tablespoons rice flour, more for dusting | 1 clove garlic, crushed and chopped | 7 scallions, white and some green parts, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Wash the black beans well to remove any sand, and soak in a large bowl of cold water until at room temperature overnight. Drain the beans and let them dry out a bit before proceeding. In a large bowl, mix together the black beans, white beans, flour, garlic, scallions, and olive oil. Gather up your hands and shape the mixture into small balls. Roll them in a bit of chopped green part too. Chill in the freezer until ready to use. This is not a traditional yield, but it's good with freshly made breadsticks.

Random Ingredients: beef heart,creamy peanut butter,wonton wrapper,cepes,cilantro leaf,vegetable bouillon cube,ice,port wine
title: Peanut and Beef Heart Wraps
ingredients: 4 phyllo wrapper rolls | 2 teaspoons creamy peanut butter | 1 beef heart, finely sliced ( or other cut of cut ) | 1 tablespoon port wine ( a good one ) | 1 small vegetable bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped | wonton wrapper | ice ( for dipping ) ( optional )
instructions: Put phyllo on counter until they're done. Lay a few sheets of wax paper along the work surface. If using stick, roll each sheet in the wax paper so it fits tightly. If using meat, add a few strips of sirloin beef to work with and slice into fine strips, or shred into shreds with your hands. Mix the peanut butter w/pickle and set aside. You may also make a meat broth using one vegetable base with stock and water, but the broth will not dissolve as it simmers. Put half of the peanut butter in a small mixing bowl. Add 1/2 of the sliced beef heart. Stir and let sit until all the beef is coated with peanut butter. Add a small amount of mushroom, vegetable base, and cilantro and mix well or pulse until it's all mixed in and incorporated. Lay the wonton wrappers on a work surface and top with a few tablespoons of peanut butter mixture. Take one wrapper and roll into a 10 circle. Add approximately 2 tablespoons of meat mixture to the middle of the wonton wrapper and wrap it with a tablespoon or two of beef heart. Wrap it all up and bring together. If your wrap is too thick, just try to roll it up by hand and secure it with a toothpick. Repeat for remaining wrappers and filling. If using meatballs, cut them into 1/2 inch pieces. To freeze for future use, cover with a plate and then freeze. Remove wrapper from refrigerator about 10 minutes before serving and carefully unwrap. If using cooked meat, allow them to thaw in fridge. Dip in a good glass of good wine, if they're soft, just place a large spoonful of sauce on a wrapper, top with about 1 tablespoon of meat and place a finger of cilantro on next, then wrap the wrapper around it. Secure with a toothpick, making sure it's secure. Serve with a small glass of wine in the center. Serve with lots of napkins and some nice green chutney on the side.

title: Mincemeat Skewers
ingredients: 500 g minced beef tri tip | 1/2 cup dijon mustard | 1/2 cup mincemeat | 1 teaspoon coarsely ground mustard
instructions: Combine beef, mustard and mincemeat. Pierce each skewer with a skewer and bake at 180 degrees c for 5 minutes drain off grease. Brush the kebags with mustard.

Random Ingredients: caper,apple juice,sugar snap pea,ajwain,no boil lasagna noodle,mango powder
title: Lemon Mango Toss (No-Cook)
ingredients: 14 no-cook lasagna noodles ( i used jumbo ) | 2 teaspoons mango powder | 13 ounces mangoes, peeled and diced | 1 cup sugar snap pea, cut lengthwise in 1-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons cider or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 teaspoon ajwain
instructions: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Mix together mango, snap peas, sugar snap peas, and capers. Spread 3/4 of this mixture on the bottom of an 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Top with 3 lasagna noodles, 1/3 of the mango mixture, 1/2 of the sauce, and another 1/2 of the mango mixture. Repeat layers, ending with the remaining noodles. Spoon remaining mango and sauce mixture over the top. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to overnight.

title: Vanilla Surprise
ingredients: 4 large italian tomatoes | 4 tablespoons tomato sauce ( we use soya sauce ) or 4 tablespoons pure soya sauce ( we use soya sauce ) | 1 dash vanilla essence
instructions: Bake tomatoes on a non stick baking sheet until the skin is blistered. Turn and bake another 15 - 20 minutes. Remove and let cool. Remove the skins from tomatoes.. Puree the tomatoes in a blender. Then add the tomato puree and vanilla in a bowl. Mix well.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,chicken meat,bok choy
title: Mexican Chicken Rollups (Tacu Tacos)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 10 pieces frozen, whole chicken meat | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican cheese | 1 cup chopped bok choy
instructions: Prepare 12x13 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Place frozen chicken inside a large plastic bag and fill with shredded cheese. Shake around in bag to evenly distribute cheese. Lay out plastic over chicken and roll to evenly coat. Heat oil in a large skillet or saute pan to 350 degrees f using tongs. Cook chicken pieces in hot oil for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until golden brown and juices run clear. Serve with bok choy, sour cream and salsa. You can also make these in advance and refrigerate them immediately if you can, although the longer they refrigerate, the more flavour they get.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,jalapeno pepper,chicken liver,oyster sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray,seasoning salt
title: Sauce for Chicken Livers or Steak Frites
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh jalapeno pepper, stemmed | 1/4 cup vegetable oil ( or other cooking spray ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 3/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 8 ounces chicken livers, trimmed
instructions: Cut the stems off the jalapeno peppers and pull out the black seeds. Rinse and dry the jalapenos thoroughly. Cut the peppers into small strips about 1 inch long and 1 1/2 inches wide. Slice the strips across the back of the tip in a spiral with the peel at an extreme angle. Heat the vegetable oil or spray in a large skillet until hot but not smoking. Add the strips of jalapenos and cook in hot oil until deep golden brown. Transfer the strips to paper towels to drain. Return the skillet to the stove over medium heat, add the vinegar, and bring to a high boil. Reduce the heat to low, and add the oyster sauce and seasoning salt. Cook until the sauce is reduced by three quarters, about 7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the chicken livers and cook until they're tender, 2 to 2 1/2 minutes longer. Serve the sauce hot and enjoy.

title: Orange Steak
ingredients: 1 orange ( peeled, halved, and sliced ) | 1 lb flank steak | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar ( or more )
instructions: Mix all ingredients including the orange slices. Place steak on rack of broiler pan and broil to desired doneness.

title: Oregano Spicy Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp, peeled, deveined | 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 2 teaspoons dried mint | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Prepare a medium hot fire with coals about 4 inches from the heat or preheat the broiler. Dry the shrimp thoroughly with paper towels. Place shrimp in a large non metallic bowl. In a small bowl, mix the sour cream, mint, oregano and salt and pepper to taste. Pour sour cream mixture over shrimp, stirring to coat.

title: Pita Chips With Brie
ingredients: cooking spray | 6 tablespoons brie cheese, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 6 whole wheat pita bread
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the pita bread in a baking dish, and spray lightly with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,dark sesame oil,self rising flour
title: Pan Fried Green Onions
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1 lime, zest of
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pinch off 1 rounded teaspoonful of the perforated green onion mixture place in freezer. Repeat the same with the remaining dough, until all mixture is used. Heat oil in heavy skillet or wok over medium heat, drop slabs into hot oil in batches. Fry on both sides. They should not be cooked through and brown, they should develop a nice, slightly golden color. Remove from skillet, drain and serve hot.

title: Red Capsicum Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red capsicums, sliced thinly | 1 teaspoon allspice | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 40 g unsalted dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Cut capsicums into thin slices. Place in a shallow, microwavable dish. Sprinkle allspice over capsicums and add 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar and 80g chopped peanuts. Microwave on high for 2 minutes. Serve immediately, sprinkled with remaining ingredients.

title: Asian Style Beef on the Skillet
ingredients: 4 ounces rib-eye steaks | 5 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 3 cups baby arugula | 1/4 cup fresh baby spinach
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Place the steaks over 1/2 the skillet and brush with hoisin sauce. Sear steaks until almost cooked through, about 1 minute per side. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside for 5 minutes. Add arugula to the skillet, cover, and cook until wilted and lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Slice the steak thinly across the grain and sprinkle on top.

title: Tropical Cantaloupe Salad
ingredients: pasta ( your choice, i prefer fresh ) | 1 small cantaloupe ( chopped into small pcs. size & chopped into small pcs. size & ) | 2 stalks celery, chopped ( about 4/5's worth ) | 1 ounce herb seasoning mix ( i prefer mrs. dash ) | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss well. Let sit 10 - 15 minutes prior to eating to allow flavors to combine. Enjoy.

title: Swiss Blackberry Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 32 ounces large fresh blackberries, unstrained ( about 1 lb ) | 1 bay leaf | 1 whole clove ( optional )
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large crockpot. Place bay leaf and whole clove on top. Add cheese. Turn on low, and let simmer until thick and creamy, about 3 hours.. The longer this sits in the crockpot, the more flavorful it gets. It will be ready to serve.

title: Rosemary Tahini
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Combine it all together in a small bowl or jar and mix well.

title: Jicama And Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ice water | 1 lebanese cucumber, finely diced | 1 jicama, finely diced | 1 blueberries
instructions: Place the diced cucumber in a small bowl. Add the blueberries, but do not let them sit in the ice water or it will make them tough. Sprinkle with powdered sugar immediately.

title: Pasta With Vanilla-And-White Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white rice ( or pearl barley ) | 1 1/2 cups milk | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 lb farfalle pasta ( or bow-tie pasta ), cooked ( i prefer bow-tie pasta )
instructions: Heat rice in a heavy large saucepan with lid on over medium high. Stir frequently until rice has turned a pale golden brown color, about 12 minutes.

title: Gram's Indonesian Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: In a blender jar, combine sugar and coriander. Process until finely ground. Store mixture in an airtight glass jar with a tight fitting lid.

title: Orange, Coconut, and Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups canned unsweetened coconut milk | 2/3 cup frozen green pea ( preferably the larger ones ) or 2/3 cup frozen green pea ( preferably the larger ones ) | 1/2 cup diced shallot | 1/2 cup orange wedge ( about 1 1/2 teaspoons ) | 3 tablespoons margarine ( see note ) | 1/2 lb cooked rice or 1/2 lb salad greens | steamed rice
instructions: In a saucepan, combine coconut milk, peas, shallots, and orange. Bring to boil and cook, stirring frequently, until peas are tender crisp, about 6 minutes. Drain and let cool to room temperature. Combine salad greens and margarine. Serve over rice. Note, this salad may be served cold, too, as the dressing freezes and reheats.

title: Coconut Based Cherry Tomato Appetizers
ingredients: 1 can rotel | 2 cans yellow cherry tomatoes | 1 1/2 cups low fat coconut pecan frosting
instructions: Brown the coconut in 1 cup of coconut water for about 15 to 20 minutes, then stir in chopped yellow cherry tomatoes and 1 1/2 cups of coconut frosting. You can also refrigerate this recipe to help keep it from turning brown.

title: Japanese Barley-key Lime-Nori Sushi
ingredients: 3/4 cup barley | 1/4 cup nori ( seaweed shavings ) | 1 key lime, zest of
instructions: Place the nori on a dry, flat surface, and sprinkle it with a few drops of water. Scatter the barley over the nori until it becomes saturated. Slice the key lime halves into 4 thin sclices. Place a small piece of nori on top of the barley. Spread the nori with the sliced lime. Roll up and slice along the nori so that each slice is a little bigger than the desired amount of nori.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,green chili pepper,root vegetable,seasoning salt,red bliss potato,cumin powder,lettuce leaf
title: Chickpea Burritos or Burritos
ingredients: 1 large red bliss potato, washed, peeled, and boiled ( about 20 minutes. the frozen or fresh potato can also be used if you want to lower the fat-free quot ; just not that spicy ) | 1 pinch cumin powder | 1 -2 green chili pepper, seeded, minced ( depending on your preference ) | 1/4 teaspoon mccormicks liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon mrs. dash seasoning salt ( if you use the mexican variety, mccormicks is quite hot ) | 2 tablespoons greens chili pepper, minced ( about 5 or 6 green jalapeno peppers ( you may use a mix of both! ) ( optional ) | 1 head lettuce leaf ( i use boston lettuce )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Slice potato lengthwise into 1/2 inch coins. Spray cookie sheet / broiler pan with non stick cooking spray. Place the potato coins & sliced potato in a medium bowl. Add all other ingredients and stir thoroughly to combine. Place a lettuce leaf on your work surface. Spoon the mixture into the center of the leaf. Roll up the leaf. Secure roll with tooth picks. Brush roll with some oil or butter, put the tooth picks aside. Place rolled burritos on a hot grill for 3 - 4 minutes, moving the ends of the tooth picks as you go. Serve and enjoy.

title: Spaghetti With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, undrained | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 jars spaghetti sauce | 2 cups queso fresco, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a dutch oven combine chickpeas, bouillon cubes, dry spaghetti sauce and half the queso fresco.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,self raising flour,caper,spanish onion,cottage cheese,cream
title: Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 300 g self raising flour | 1 large spanish onion, chopped into rings | 500 g cottage cheese | 300 ml cream | 500 g chicken thighs, chopped into pieces or 750 g chicken legs, chopped into chunks | paprika and capers, for sprinkling
instructions: In a bowl, using an electric mixer, make a well in the centre. Add all the ingredients of the mix and mix to blend. Do not overbeat the batter, this is very important to avoid breaking the large pieces of chicken. Pour the batter in to a well in the middle of the mixture, it will not occupy the space too much. Mix the ingredients well to combine and cook the mixture on a very slow to medium heat. Once the mixture has been cooking on the slow to slow method, it will begin to thicken and develop a smooth thick skin. Cover the dish with a lid/foil and keep on a low heat for at least an hour, stir every 10 minutes to avoid the mixture burning the bottom and the sides. The pancake should be able to move at the start and then the pancake will be fairly thick and very difficult to stir too much. When you lift the pancake, it is done and very easy to lift out of the pan. Use a slotted spoon, place the cooked pancake in ovenproof serving bowl and ladle the coloured mixture over the top and allow it to set. If you like a bit of tartness, you can sprinkle with a bit of paprika/paprika. Allow to set, at least 20 minutes before serving.

title: Prelude
ingredients: 1 lemon grass, white part only ( leaves only, about 1/8cm of green stems, trimmed ) | 2 whole fresh rose petals, stem removed and discarded | 1 stalk fresh lemongrass, white part only ( optional ) | 5 slices galangal ( about 2-inches each ) | 2 -3 tablespoons vodka ( not sweetened ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract ( optional )
instructions: Remove and discard the gills and stems from the lemon grass and spring off the outer layers. Wash and dry the spring off the lemongrass. Use a sharp knife and slice the lemongrass thinly. Trim the lemon grass stalk from the bottom and discard. Cut the lemon grass into 3 4cm cubes, then cut the lemon grass into 2 3cm long, 5 4mm long strips or 2 - 3 cm long strips. Heat up the vodka on low heat and mix with the almond extract. Put a few teaspoons of the flavored vodka into the bowl of a mini coffee mug, then add the sliced lemongrass and the lemongrass mixture. Stir until it becomes aromatic and the flavor is reduced, about 2 minute. Remove from the heat. Set aside, covered, and allow to set at room temperature for 30 minutes. Serve at room temperature. Tip, you can use a hand held blender to blend the alcohol into a nice paste. You should have the same consistency of a pesto sauce.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,turmeric,pomegranate molasses,taco seasoning,garlic clove,bok choy
title: Pomegranate Bok Choy and Pomegranate Molasses Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 cup fresh pecorino cheese, grated ( about 2 oz ) | 1/2 cup pomegranate molasses | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 4 bunches bok choy
instructions: In medium bowl, combine cheese, 3/4 cup pomegranate molasses, garlic and turmeric. In medium nonstick skillet, heat remaining 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses and taco seasoning, stirring over medium heat. Add bok choy.

title: Coconut Shrimp Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried lentils | 1 1/2 cups watermelon rind, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups brussels sprouts, cut in 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup pimiento, diced | 2 cups frozen brussels sprouts, thawed | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/2 cup reduced-fat cottage cheese | 12 tiger shrimp, peeled ( deveined )
instructions: Combine lentils, watermelon rind and brussels sprouts in a large saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until lentils are firm, about 5 minutes. Drain and rinse under cool water. Remove rind from watermelon. Halve crosswise then remove seeds. Combine pesto, sour cream or cottage cheese and anchovies. Spread pesto mixture on lettuce leaves then arrange lentils over that. Sprinkle with shrimp then dollop pesto mixture.

title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs rice noodles | 1 large onion, chopped | 1 package corn kernels | 1/2 cup caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Cook noodles in hot water. Meanwhile cook onion in a small amount of boiling water until tender. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Drain again. Drain all but about 2 tablespoons of the water. In a large bowl cook noodles in hot water, drain for 2 minutes and drain again. Place the noodles, onions, corn, sugar and mustard seeds in a large attractive serving dish. Pour over the dressing and toss lightly.

title: American Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 12 slices american cheese
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,beef stew meat,gruyere cheese,poblano chile,mandarin orange,green lentil
title: Spanish Inspired Beef and Lentil Bake
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 cup gruyere cheese, shredded plus | 2 tablespoons gruyere cheese, shredded divided | 1/2 cup green lentil, cooked | 1 poblano chile, minced and seeded | 1/2 can mandarin oranges, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a bowl, mix together the cream cheese and 1 cup of the gruyere cheese. Spread the cream cheese mixture into the bottom of an 9 inch casserole dish. Set aside. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the gruyere cheese over the cream cheese. Layer the green lentils over the cheese. Drain and pit the poblano chile, and place them over the lentils. Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup gruyere cheese over the green lentils. Top with mandarin oranges. Cover the casserole with aluminum foil. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil, sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup gruyere cheese over the top, and bake for 15 minutes longer or until the cheese is brown.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,fennel bulb
title: Moroccan Fennel Tea
ingredients: 1 lb fennel bulb | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( mix of seven spices )
instructions: Quarter fennel bulb and slice fronds into small wedges. Put fennel wedges in a pot with water.

title: Strawberry and Kielbasa Spread II for One
ingredients: 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup shredded colby cheese | 8 ounces frozen strawberries, thawed and drained | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Place kielbasa cubes in a large pot over medium heat. Cook until it starts to show darker brown spots, about 10 minutes. Shake the kielbasa under water to remove excess grease. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until kielbasa is firm and flavors have melded, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the cheese and strawberries. Season with a pinch of asafoetida powder. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled, at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: chicken soup base,cottage cheese,green bell pepper
title: Cottage Cheese Stoup
ingredients: 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups cubed, processed green bell pepper | 1 1/2 cups chicken soup base
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine cottage cheese and green bell pepper over low heat. Stirring frequently, cook until tender. Stir in chicken soup base and continue heating. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,barbecue sauce,chicken wing,corn oil,consomme
title: Mexican Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, and drumettes | 1/3 cup corn oil | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1/2 fresh lime, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup consomme, diluted with | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Cut drumettes along joints. Place chicken wings in large pot of lightly salted water and bring to boil.

title: Guiness Biscuits
ingredients: 3 cups bisquick | 3/4 cup honey | 1/2 cup dark rum ( i used a rum ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, mix the bisquick, honey, rum, and rice vinegar. Fold in the cheese until it is evenly distributed. Drop rounded tablespoons of the dough onto the parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, and let cool for 5 minutes before removing to cool on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,chicken breast half,pork chop,vegetable,ancho chile powder,mango chutney,apple,dark rum
title: Crock Pot Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork chop | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/8 teaspoon maraschino cherry, finely chopped | 1 apple, cored, peeled and sliced into chunks | 1 1/2 cups sliced vegetables ( your choice ) | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Pound pork chops to 1/4 inch thickness. Combine mango chutney, rum, ancho chili powder, chopped cherries, and chopped apple in a large bowl. Place pork chops on a foil lined sheet pan. Spread mango chutney mixture over pork. Broil 4 - 5 inches from heat for 5 minutes on each side or until pork is no longer pink. Serve with fruit and vegetables.

title: Southern Lima Bean Burgers
ingredients: 4 lbs ground beef chuck | 3/4 cup wheat breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, finely chopped | 1 can lima beans, drained and rinsed ( or canned lima beans, drained and rinsed or cannelines )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground chuck, bread crumbs, sun dried tomatoes, beans and the 1 1/4 cups water. Mix well with your hands, but be careful not to overmix. Shape the mixture as small balls as possible into patties about 1/2 inch thick, and place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until the patties are cooked through. Serve at once with corn bread for dipping.

title: Quindim
ingredients: 2 large green cardamom pods, split open | 3 cups whole green-colored orange, peeled and sectioned | 1 tablespoon allspice berry
instructions: Rinse orange sections well. Place cardamom pods in a 2 quart flameproof casserole dish and cover with hot water. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Discard water. Pour water over cardamom. Add allspice berries.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,peach,yellow bell pepper,mint,boursin cheese,half cream
title: Peach Melba With Boursin Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 peach | 2 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream | 1/3 cup freshly grated aged boursin cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped of fresh mint | 2 1/2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil | 1 1/4 teaspoons boursin cheese, grated or 1 1/4 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Cut the peach in half lengthwise with a small pointed serrated knife.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,ricotta cheese,chili garlic sauce,coffee,chili powder,poppy seed,panir
title: Panir With Poppy Seeds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 cup panir | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling
instructions: Bring 2 1/2 cups of water to a boil for the pesto, in a small skillet over med high heat. Add the poppy seeds and remove from heat. Grind the poppy seeds and mix them with the ricotta cheese until they are evenly blended. Whisk in the brewed coffee and chili garlic sauce in a bowl. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over med high heat. Add the chopped poppy seeds and cook for 1 - 2 minutes until they turn and begin to give off their aroma. Add the pesto and coat all of the pesto with the pesto. Remove the pan from the heat and cover. Let sit for 20 minutes. Serve with sliced cheese on the side.

title: Thai Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup julienned fresh kale | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 package rice noodles, chilled
instructions: Toss kale, mint and rice noodles with enough water to moisten, about 2 tablespoons, about 8 minutes. Chill salad while preparing dressing before serving.

title: Mille Foglie
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 3 tablespoons green onions, chopped | paprika | 3 tablespoons green onions, chopped, for garnish
instructions: In a medium bowl, beat egg yolks with a wire whisk until thick and lemon colored. Stir in 2 tbsp green onions. Slowly stir in paprika and pour into an ungreased 10 cake pan. Slide into oven and bake at 350. About 20 - 25 minutes. Cut into serving pieces. Garnish with remaining green onions.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,matzo,nonfat milk,pie crust mix,sandwich bread,star anise,chorizo sausage
title: Spicy Chorizo Bread Stuffed Chorizo Empanadas
ingredients: 1 package sandwich bread | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk | 1/4 star anise | 1/2 lb mexican chorizo sausage, casing removed | 1/2 unbaked pie crust mix | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit and prepare a baking sheet with cooking spray. If you're going to bake the stuffed empanadas, line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the bread and milk into 8 pieces. Combine the milk and dry milk in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and remove from heat. Place the star anise in a spice mill or mortar and pestle. Heat milk mixture in microwave on high to reach 120 degrees fahrenheit, about 30 seconds. The star anise will be left for flavor. Remove the star anise from heat. In a small mixing bowl, combine the mexican sausage and chorizo casing. Lightly spray a 9 x 12 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the pie crust mix in the prepared pie crust dish. Stuff the bread pieces into the sausage mixture. Place the stuffed bread pieces on the baking sheet with the remaining sausage. Spray the tops of the empanadas with cooking spray and bake for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Steamed Rosemary Chips
ingredients: 500 g of white flour ( or other white flour ) | seasoning salt | 3 tablespoons fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Measure out flour and salt into a mixing bowl. Tear off a large piece of kitchen string and throw out the bits of dried flour and add to the flour with salt. Mix well. Make a hole in the centre of the dough and add a little water, one heaping tablespoon per chip. This is the top layer of the dough. Cover with a dish towel and leave the dough to rise for about 40min or until nearly doubled in size. Place a sheet of greaseproof paper on the work board and lightly roll up the dough. Press out the chips. Turn over so the bag on the work surface is on the outside. Pile the chips up the sides of the board and press out any air pockets. This helps to prevent a sharp cutting. Spray a tray lightly with oil and add the chips. Cover with a dish towel and leave to rise for 20min or until doubled in size. Meanwhile, heat a steam or grill pan over a high heat and dry off the rosemary leaves. Brush off any excess water. Dip the chips in the melted spiced rosemary and leave for 2 minutes, then brush the tops and some over the melted rosemary with egg wash. Leave for a couple of minutes again so the rosemary can absorb the egg wash and finish absorbing the egg wash and becoming crispy and crisp. Enjoy you may use chip crinkle chips, but they taste just as good as the fresh. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,green bean,beef gravy,pesto sauce,egg substitute
title: Creamy Pesto Burgers
ingredients: 1 package hamburger buns, toasted | 2 tablespoons fat free beef gravy | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 egg substitute | 2 tablespoons green beans, cooked and drained
instructions: In a small bowl, using a fork stir together gravy and pesto. Cut tops from buns. Split into four sections. On bottom half of each bun place a generous 2 tbls. Of gravy in center of bun. Top with a spoonful of egg substitute and a small handful of beans. Top with the other half of the bun. Top with a scoop of thickened pesto.

title: Cocktail Bread
ingredients: 8 parsnips | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup molasses | 2 cups bread flour | 1 tablespoon hot chili pepper, finely minced
instructions: Boil the parsnips for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile combine all of the ingredients in a bowl and mash together with a fork. Transfer the mixture to a large glass or plastic bowl or muffin pan. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place in the freezer for 10 minutes to harden the mixture. Remove the mixture from the refrigerator, transfer it to a plastic bag and freeze for 3 to 4 hours. The mixture can be made up to 2 days in advance.

Random Ingredients: almond,orange section,corn flake crumb,tilapia fillet,spanish onion
title: Spicy Almond Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1 cup almond slivers, chopped ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 4 spanish onions, chopped ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 1 cup corn flakes crumbs | 1/4 cup orange section, well drained
instructions: Remove bones and skin from fillets.

Random Ingredients: walnut,cilantro leaf,caraway,spaghetti,paprika,kaffir lime leaf,chicken bouillon cube
title: Moroccan Spaghetti - Nettos Al Horno Yahnisi
ingredients: 1 tablespoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon ground caraway | 3/4 cup walnuts, toasted ( or pecans ) | 10 -12 kaffir lime leaves ( or lemon wedges, plus more for garnish ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1 lb spaghetti | chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | cilantro leaf, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Note, all measurements were given just for added flavor and texture. You can also add more paprika or caraway if you like. Combine paprika, caraway and peanuts in a small bowl. Put a kaffir lime leaf in a small pot and bring water to boil. Place the kaffir lime leaves in the pot, close lid and boil for 1 minute, then remove for garnish or serve in a bowl on the side. Cook spaghetti to al dente in salted boiling water only. This will depend on the size of your spaghetti. Reserve half of the pasta water, then drain spaghetti and return to pot. Add remaining ingredients, toss well and serve garnished with cilantro leaves at the table.

title: Spicy Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Cut red bell pepper in half lengthwise and place cut side up in roasting pan on high. Pour the tomato sauce over the red pepper. Sprinkle with oregano. Cover roasting pan with aluminum foil and bake at 250 for one hour.

Random Ingredients: margarine,cool whip topping,beef bouillon cube,lemon peel
title: French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 1 cup finely chopped lemons or 1 cup finely chopped tangerine peel | 2 packages cool whip topping, 2 small containers, 1/2 `` | 2 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix margarine and lemon peel together in large mixing bowl. Cut up cooled whip cream into 1 inch cubes. Dissolve bouillon in 1/2 cup cool whip mixture.

title: Crab Fettuccine
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh crabmeat | 1 loaf cuban bread ( without crust ) | 3/4 lb fettuccine | 4 maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Toast crusted bread in a toaster, oven or on broiler pan until browned and toasted. Let cut surfaces dry and cut crab into 1 1/2 inch squares and place in breadcrumbs along with cherry. Pour grand marnier over and toss well. To make ahead, complete preparation, remove top layer of bread and cut bread into squares.

Random Ingredients: white flour,vermicelli,yellow pepper,velveeta cheese,aubergine,olive,beef tenderloin,red pepper flake
title: Aubergine Beef
ingredients: 800 g beef tenderloin, cut into chunks | 1 large aubergine | 1 medium yellow pepper | 1 medium sized red pepper | 4 -6 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons white flour | 2 tablespoons olive | 200 g velveeta cheese ( or similar cheese )
instructions: The night before you need to cook the beef remove the aubergine peel from the skin and cut into approx 1cm cubes, removing the bitter juices. Slice into thick slices, place into a bowl, cover with boiling, salted water and refrigerate until required. Cut the aubergine in half lengthways or into approximately 30 - 1 cm slices, removing the bitter juices. Cut into small sticks, place in a bowl and cover with boiling water and refrigerate until the aubergine becomes soft. Cut the peppers into quarters and remove the seeds and ribs, roughly chop and place into a bowl. Slice the pepper into thick strips and place over the aubergine and peppers. In a shallow tray, mix the flour and olive. Punch the aubergine and pepper flakes into the flour and lightly coat. Fry in the olive until golden brown. Take out of the oven. Using a large fry pan, or your favourite shallow dish, pour in enough olive to cover the bottom of the pan and add the sliced beef on top. Place the aubergine and beef under the pan or bread if you are using a dish that will fit over. Slice the velveta into 1 cm cubes and add to the hot pan or pan. Top each piece of beef with a pinch of white pepper flakes. Add the velveeta cubes on top of the beef and continue to cook on medium heat until the cheese is melted and everything has heated through. Take each diner to a large plate and serve the beef on top. Serve with garlic bread and a green vegetable.

title: Caribbean Coconut Balls
ingredients: 1 coconut, peeled | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 pinch saffron strand, crumbled | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1 dash saffron water
instructions: Cut the coconut into thin rings around the skewer. Thread the coconut onto the skewers with the coconut rings sticking out at the top. Put all the coconut balls, soaked in warm water for 30 - 40 minutes, to dry the coconut. Combine the cayenne pepper and saffron in a small heatproof bowl. Drain the coconut and discard any excess water. Put the sersona into a mortar and pestle or crush with a rolling pin. Stir in the teriyaki sauce and crushed séra. Mix well and allow the mixture to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Cheesy Cranberry Crumble Dip
ingredients: 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 package dried cranberries, chopped | 1 dash white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine cheese, cranberries, and pepper.

title: Diet Cucumber and Cheese
ingredients: 2 cucumbers | cottage cheese ( homemade is best, if you can find )
instructions: Peel cucumbers. Use a small knife to split lenghtwise. Cut cucumbers into thin julienne strips.. Place in microwave safe bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir till all cheese is mixed well.

title: Cheese and Couscous Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup couscous, uncooked | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon sriracha sauce | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs ( i use wheat flakes )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350'f, and lightly oila a casserole dish. Cover the base with a piece of plastic wrap and set aside. Rinse the couscous thoroughly with cool water and cool slightly. In a large bowl, combine the couscous, cheese, sriracha, fish sauce and bread crumbs. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes. Transfer the couscous to the prepared casserole dish. Cover and bake until lightly browned and the liquid is absorbed, 35 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,risotto rice,quinoa,vegetable cooking spray,fennel seed,pecorino cheese,linguine
title: Quinoa and Spinach Risotto
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups basmati rice or 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 2 cups risotto rice | 20 ounces raw quinoa | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated | 2 3/4 cups vegetables ( cooking spray, broccoli, cauliflower, or broccoli ) | 1/2 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon pecorino cheese, freshly grated ( optional ) | vegetable cooking spray ( pam for cooking )
instructions: Soak quinoa in lukewarm water for 20 minutes while it heats to the boil. Meanwhile steam quinoa in covered microwave for about 10 minutes or until it is a little tender. Meanwhile wash quinoa in cold water, remove and discard rind, and rinse quinoa under water. Drain. Place rice in a colander and rinse under warm water, shaking to separate rice grains, until water runs clear. Repeat with oil and quinoa. Set aside. Cut broccoli into 1/2inch cubes, set aside. Heat vegetable cooking spray in a 10 inch nonstick pan over medium heat. Add fennel.

title: Cherry Salsa
ingredients: 1 kg cherry | 1 kg queso fresco, in cubes | 4 cups mixed berries, cut in small pieces | 1 -2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: First mix all the ingredients together and serve.

title: Sweet Peppered Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb yellow bell pepper | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and diced ( 4 drained ) | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons light molasses
instructions: Cut tops off of bell peppers and then remove stem and seeds. Fill pepper generously with water chestnuts and then sprinkle with cream and molasses. Replace tops and wrap with saran wrap. Place in a plastic bag and freeze until ready to serve.

title: Fried Onions
ingredients: 2 white onions | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | seasoning salt
instructions: Slice onions on the diagonal into about 1/2 thick slices. Place slices onto a tray and sprinkle with the panko. If using a deep fryer, heat to 300 degrees f, then preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a deep fryer, preheat 1 gallon of oil to 350 degrees f. Fry onions about 30 seconds until crisp and golden brown and limp. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with seasoning salt to taste, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,salt black pepper,wheat linguine,tuna vegetable oil,green chili pepper,basil,sage leaf
title: Braised Tuna in Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat linguine or 1 lb linguine | 1 1/2 lbs canned tuna in vegetable oil | 1 can sliced green chili peppers | 3 fresh sage leaves | fresh basil, torn into 1/4-inch pieces ( a generous handful ) | cooking wine, such as riesling or merlot, for serving | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package directions, until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, drain canned tuna of liquid through a sieve set over a medium bowl. Discard solids, discarding any solid pieces of tuna. Cut tuna into 1/4 inch thick slices. Set aside. If using canned tuna, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add linguine and cook until al dente, about 1 - 2 minutes. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta cooking water. Add drained linguine to skillet and stir to coat with cooking water. Cover and continue to cook until linguine is hot and slightly translucent, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, spray a broiler pan with cooking oil. Add sliced chilli to pan and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until aromatic. Add minced sage and toss to coat with cooking oil. Stir through chopped chili. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Spoon linguine into a serving serving bowl. Top with tuna slices, chile mixture and basil leaves.

title: Ginger Cookies
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups self rising flour | 1 tablespoon ground gingernap cookie | 3 tablespoons rum | 3 tablespoons crystallized gingernap cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Sift the flour and gingernap cookie crumbs together in a bowl. Mix the rum with a brush and the gingernap cookie crumbs into the dry ingredients. Place the cookies on a baking sheet and drop into the oven. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Pasta With Fennel and Cherry Scented Crispy Crisp
ingredients: 3/4 lb rigatoni pasta or 3/4 lb tagliatelle pasta noodles | 6 cups packed assorted fresh cherries ( about 4 large ones ) | 1/8 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup chopped fennel bulb, leaves from stems
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite, stirring occasionally. Drain pasta and return to pot. Meanwhile, coarsely chop cherries. Heat about 2 tblsps. Oil in saucepan over medium heat. Add cherry mixture, stirring constantly, and cook, stirring, until cherries pop open, about 3 minutes. Dip 1/3 cup of pasta in cherry mixture and place in buttered shallow 2 1/2 qt baking dish. Arrange in a single layer in baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cherries and cornstarch. Bake until sauce is bubbly, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with fennel.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,wild rice,peanut oil,allspice,half cream,beef,cumin seed
title: Baked Wild Rice with Smoky Beef
ingredients: 1 package lean ground beef | 1 can petite diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 1/2 lbs wild rice | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Add diced tomato and chilies. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Prepare Wild rice according to package directions. In an 8x8 inch baking dish or a 9x13 inch roaster, mix cooked beef and wild rice. Stir in peanut oil, allspice and cumin and pour in half and half cream. Spread tomato mixture evenly over rice and bake for 45 to 50 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serve with chopped onion, chopped cilantro and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: silken tofu,cayenne,pork chop,shortening,chipotle chile adobo,swiss cheese,palm sugar
title: Tibetan Pork Chops and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup softened shortening | 12 ounces thick slab-style pork chops | 3/4 cup chopped swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped chipotle chiles in adobo | 4 teaspoons piloncillo sugar | 1 pinch cayenne | 2 tablespoons reduced-fat soft silken tofu | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Trim fat from chops.

title: Curried Noodles With Linguini, Spaghetti, Oil and Lime
ingredients: 1 lb dried farfalle pasta | 1 lime, juice of | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder, divided | 8 ounces spaghetti | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Cook pasta in plenty of boiling water until al dente. Drain, rinse under cold water, and drain again. Meanwhile, slice the limes crosswise into thin slivers, discard the pith, then cut the limes in half, setting the juice aside in a small bowl. Place the lime juices, 4 tbsp of the curry powder, and 1/2 teaspooon of salt in a large bowl and mix to combine. Add the pasta and lime zest and stir to combine. Add the pasta to the bowl and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, tossing once. To serve, divide among warm plates and garnish with lime slices and chopped cilantro.

title: French Hangover Ham Hocks
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs cured fat ham hocks | 4 tablespoons pancetta fat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place two sheets of heavy duty aluminum foil in a roasting pan to make a double thickness of double foil. Place ham hocks in one casserole. Cut bacon fat into bite size pieces. Sprinkle ham with the fat, and drizzle with the pancetta fat. Bake at 350f 1 hour. Note, you will cough and/or gental acheive, and will need a piece of twine to insert a fork in the center of the dish before it dries out.

title: Pomodoro
ingredients: 6 tablespoons grand marnier or 6 tablespoons orange liqueur | 1 ounce orange peel, grated ( to yield 2 tablespoons ) | 3 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Heat a small, dry frying pan over low to medium heat and add the grand marnier. Roughly chop the orange peel and add to pan. Turn heat up and boil for 2 minutes without stirring until the color changes to a pale golden in colour. Remove pan from heat. Beat the cream with a knife or electric beaters and remove pan from heat. When cream is cool, slowly add it to the cream beating well until thick. Pour mix into bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until just before serving.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,hot pepper,half,macaroni,vegetable oil cooking spray,sun tomato oil,ranch bean
title: Pesto-Sauce Minestrone
ingredients: 1 medium sweet hot pepper, chopped ( about 3/4-1/4-1/3 cup ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 1 can ranch beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can navy beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1 3/4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut into strips ( about 1 cup, about 3 to 4 ounces )
instructions: Cook pepper in oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Stir to loosen browned bits. Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Apricot and Almond Puree
ingredients: 3 tablespoons apricots, chopped | 3 tablespoons ground almonds
instructions: Place chopped almonds in a small pan over low heat. Gently cook for about 5 minutes. Place apricots and almond puree in food processor or blender and work until well combined. You can put it through a fine mesh sieve, but be careful the puree may be extremely oily. Store in the refrigerator, in a glass bowl, for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,apple cider vinegar,chicken breast half,green pea,baking potato,turnip
title: Easy Sweet Chicken & Vegetables
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs bone-in skinless chicken breast halves | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon hot chili sauce, to taste | 1 lb baking potato ( about 4 ) | 1 medium turnip, peeled and cut into 4 wedges ( about 2 cups ) | 2/3 cup frozen green pea, thawed
instructions: Place chicken into a 5 x 9 1/2 x 2 inch baking dish. Mix the vinegar and chili sauce together, and pour over the chicken. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 1/2 to 3 hours and up to 3 hours. Meanwhile, fill a large saucepan 2/3 full with water. Add potatoes, turnip, peas, and green onions. Boil over high heat until just tender, about 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Italian Pepper Cookies
ingredients: 4 medium yellow peppers | 1 1/4 cups egg substitute | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 tablespoon hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place peppers in foil lined cookie sheet. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, stirring halfway through. Cool, remove foil and set aside,. In a bowl beat egg substitute, baking powder, italian parsley, hot sauce. Gradually beat in blended peppers. Drop spoonfuls on tops. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until cookies are browned.

title: Fried Cumin - Oil Free
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel
instructions: First fry the seeds in a dry frying pan. This takes 10 - 15 minutes. The original recipe says to use about 5 - 6 cups of oil at a time.

Random Ingredients: sofrito sauce,dark molasses,provolone cheese,beef tenderloin,italian parsley
title: Italian Beef Tenderloin Roast
ingredients: 2 pounds beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 2 tablespoons dark molasses | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/4 cup thinly sliced provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the tenderloin slices into a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, blend the sofrito, molasses, parsley and 1/4 cup of the mojare's cheese. Spread the sofrito mixture evenly over the roast. Sprinkle the remaining mojare's cheese evenly over the top and then place the dish in the preheated oven, and turn heat down to 350 degrees f. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until meat thermometer registers 135 degrees f for medium rare. Remove roast to a cutting board and let meat stand for 5 minutes before slicing. Slice against the grain and serve.

title: Cheats Veggies in Champagne
ingredients: 3 cups rice krispies | vegetables | 6 baby carrots | 5 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 4 cups champagne | cooked rice, to serve
instructions: Place a microwaveable bowl and lid on top of the bowl, so the bottom is covered. Microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes, or until steam rises from bowl. While bowl is standing, heat 2 - 3 cups of rice krispies in a saucepan for 3 - 4 minutes until warm. Place carrots on a microwave safe plate, top with 4/5 cup of each ingredient and stir to coat carrots. Microwave for 7 - 9 minutes, or until lightly carmelized. Add a splash of champagne to each kraft bowl and top with krispies. Serve with cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,beef tenderloin steak,mace,red bell pepper,baking powder,chervil,vodka,pecorino romano cheese
title: Bollywood Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 14 ounces beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground chervil | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 large red bell pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°. Place the steaks, if using whole tenderloin steaks, between sheets of waxed paper and pounded to about 3/8 inch thickness. Place the steaks in a non reactive baking dish, and sprinkle each with 1/2 teaspoon each tikka masala, 1/4 teaspoon each chervil, mace, 1/4 teaspoon each mace, and 1/4 teaspoon each garam masala. Sprinkle each steak with 1/2 teaspoon each of parmesan romano and pecorino cheese. Broil in the top half of the oven for 6 to 8 minutes, or until the steaks are firm but not browned. Meanwhile, remove the steaks from the oven, and place on cutting board. Using a large sharp knife, slice the red bell pepper into large chunks. Arrange the chunks in the baking dish, and broil them in the top half of the oven for 6 to 8 minutes, or until just charred and blistered. Place the steaks on a carving sheet, and loosely cover with foil to keep warm. Remove the toothpicks from each steak once they are done. Meanwhile, preheat the grill for high heat. When you are ready to serve, place the steaks on the grill, and cook until a meat thermometer registers 160°. Serve hot, garnished with the red bell pepper chunks.

title: Easy Microwave Sausages
ingredients: 6 sausages | 2 -3 tablespoons hot sauce | 4 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Pierce sausages all over with an x and microwave on high 2 - 3 minutes. When done, drain and set aside. Cool completely. Remove casing from sausages and place on a cutting board. Slice open with a sharp knife, cutting the end into half. Seal meat in a microwave safe container. Sprinkle with 1 - 2 teaspoons garam masala. Microwave in 100% power for 15 - 30 seconds or until meat looks dry and is no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,salmon,green olive,onion powder,leek,green chilies,coriander seed,walnut
title: Indian Salmon Fish Filet (Pescado a La Fillet Huey)
ingredients: 1 salmon, cleaned | 1 lb salmon, boned and scaled | 5 green chilies ( i sometimes use 4 ) | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 1/2 cups walnuts ( optional ) | fresh basil leaf | 1 large onion, diced
instructions: Dice salmon into 1 inch square pieces. Place on a piece of wax paper or plastic wrap. Sprinkle salmon with onion powder. Add spices and mix together. Place salmon into a baking dish. Sprinkle with the onions, walnuts and basil. Sprinkle the outside with diced fresh onion. Place in 350 degree oven for about 20 minutes, turn over and bake until fish flakes easily when tested. Serve with salsa, rice or with your favorite side dish. Variation, if you want it more spicy, place green olives and/or serrano peppers on side for a spicier fish. Place some canned tomatoes in the sauce. The walnuts will sink to the bottom of the sauce. If a sauce is too thin, place the sauce over medium heat and bring to a boil. Then remove from the heat and add chopped onions and parsley. Serve with rice or serve with hot bread.

title: Tricia's Italian Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, sliced | 1 cup grated italian parsley
instructions: Separate lettuce leaves and trim stems. Coat in vegetable oil. Toss lightly with parsley.

title: Hot Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 30 pods fresh tamarind pods | 1/2 cup ketchup, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine heavy cream and tamarind pods in a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: tamari,golden syrup,xanthan gum,mustard powder,texas toast bread,thyme,celery rib
title: Low Fat French Toast for One
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamari | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup mustard powder | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1/4 cup texas toast thick bread | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 2 celery ribs, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the celery in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until mixture begins to bubble. Reduce heat to low and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Turn heat to low and add celery.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,new potato,tomato green chilies,curry powder,oyster,green onion,turmeric powder
title: Fish and Potato Curry in Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 dozen tiny new potato | 2 small tomatoes | 1/3 cup oyster | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 4 -5 green onions | 4 -6 dried new mexico dried chilies ( use the tiny `` chiles '' ) | 1/4 cup fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water. Meanwhile, rinse the fish, leaving the head and tail shells. Slice each fish head into half inch thick slices. Cut the potatoes into 2 inch squares. Heat oil in a wok or large deep skillet over medium high heat. While waiting for the oil to start to get hot, scoop up the oyster shell with your fingers. When oil is hot, put in as many chiles as the skillet can hold into it, turning the chiles around constantly. They will pop and be ready right away, too. After the chiles have popped, add the sliced pieces of fish, potatoes, tomatoes, curry. Add salt and pepper to taste. Turn heat to medium. After 5 minutes, add the cheese and mix and turn heat to low. Continue to stir gently and cook for 20 minutes or until potatoes are soft, but not mushy. Serve over a bed of rice.

title: Scottish Christmas Cookies (Scottish Biscuit)
ingredients: 6 ounces icing sugar | 8 ounces raisins | 8 ounces icing sugar, sifted, for coating
instructions: Sieve the flour into a large mixing bowl.. Add the icing sugar and raisins in increments of two. Make a well in the centre and add enough sifted icing sugar to bind. Gently knead the dough until it is smooth. Preheat your oven to 300°f roll the dough out to about 1/4 inch thickness. Use a round cutter to cut out the cookies and place the 2 inch cutter onto the baking parchment. Bake the cookies until the sides are light tan coloured, 15 - 20 minutes. Allow them to cool before placing on a lightly greased baking sheet. Place in an airtight container and store in the fridge.

title: Quick and Easy Easy Pilaf
ingredients: 1 bag rice, long grain | 3 -4 tablespoons chicken flavored bouillon
instructions: Put everything in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring regularly. Take off the heat. Allow to sit for 10 - 15 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

title: Creamy Sage Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, sliced into about 12 inch pieces | 1 can cream of cream soup
instructions: Cook the cucumber slices according to the pack instructions. Drain and cool. Cut off the ends of the cucumber and discard. Cut into about 12 inch pieces.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,baby carrot,spaghetti,thai red curry paste,pimiento,heavy whipping cream
title: Creamy Red Curried Beef With Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 3/4 lb frozen stir fry sirloin steak ( cut into 1/2-inch dice ) or 3/4 lb thinly sliced thinly sliced italian beef escalopes ( cut into 1/2-inch dice ) | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained | 1 cup halved baby carrots | 1 pint heavy whipping cream
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain and set aside. Meanwhile, stir curry paste into sliced beef. Let sit about 3 - 4 minutes before beginning to brown. Add beef and cook until heated through. Stir carrots, pimentos, and cream into beef mixture. Cover and simmer about 3 minutes.

title: Wild Mushroom Barley Hot Days
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown barley | 5 dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon grand marnier
instructions: Soak shiitake mushrooms in hot water for 20 minutes. Slice mushrooms then chop mushrooms. Strain shiitake soaking liquid through cheesecloth. Place barley, mushrooms and 1 tablespoon of the golden syrup in a saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in grand marnier. Cover and let stand 20 minutes.

title: Artichoke and Lentil Ragout
ingredients: 15 frozen artichoke hearts, defrosted if using defrosted artichoke hearts, drained ( about 25g ) | 1/4 cup red lentil, rinsed | 150 g mange-touts peas ( about 4 medium ) | 10 large ladyfingers
instructions: Rinse rinsed lentils and snap off any tough ends. Add lentils, artichoke hearts, peas and a little water to a heavy based saucepan, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Turn off the heat and leave the ragout covered for 8 - 10 minutes to firm up some of the lentils, then gently loosen the mange tout and cut open. Spread open the rice and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Lay the ladyfingers on a plate and place a slice of mange tout between if using. Microwave ragout until warmed through, then spread over the top of the raki.

title: Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 head red cabbage, shredded | 1 lb deli sliced roast | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: Toss cabbage with mustard powder to taste, cool.

title: Spareribs or Baked Spareribs
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon clove | 1/4 teaspoon dry mint | seasoning salt or white salt, for sprinkling | 4 lbs boneless sirloin or 4 lbs beef brisket, trimmed
instructions: Stir together the spice ingredients to make a paste, about 5 tsps. In a large heavy skillet, or dutch oven heat the oil to 400 degrees f. Add the meat and brown lightly on all sides, turning frequently, about 15 minutes. Transfer to baking sheet. Sprinkle with 1 tsps. Of the spice paste. Cover the pan with plastic wrap and bake in 400f oven, basting every 20 minutes, until meat is tender and sauce is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,green cardamom,vegetable oil cooking spray,pearl barley,hot italian sausage
title: Kielbasa and Barley (Sausages With Barley)
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/4 cup brown pearl barley | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons green cardamoms, crushed | 2 tablespoons hot italian sausage, cut up
instructions: Cook kielbasa in nonstick skillet over medium high heat 1 minute or until browned and crumbly. Stir in barley and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Add seasoning, stirring 2 minutes more. Coat skillet with cooking spray. Sauté sausage, breaking up browned bits with back of wooden spoon, until no longer pink, 5 - 6 minutes. Drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: bulgar wheat,red michigan apple,lemon zest,chinese cabbage,soy sauce,vinegar,lime wedge
title: Crunchy and Flavorful Bulgur Wheat Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup bibb wheat, grains | 1 red michigan apple | 2 tablespoons red-michigan apples, diced | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 2 teaspoons soy sauce, more to taste | 1 small head chinese cabbage, cored and shredded
instructions: Place the wheat in a glass bowl. Peel the apple off the peel, dice, and add it along with the remaining ingredients in the bowl. Toss to mix. Cover, and store in the fridge for at least 30 minutes or overnight, tossing the ingredients every so often.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,sage leaf,italian seasoning,angel hair pasta,horseradish,lemon juice,sherry wine vinegar,maple syrup
title: Lemon & Sage Baked Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups angel hair pasta or 2 cups spaghetti, cooked and drained | 2 3/4 cups self raising flour | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 1 tablespoon maple syrup or 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1/3 cup fresh sage leaves or 1/3 cup dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f / 200°c. Place the cooked noodles in an ovenproof dish, pour the lemon juice over them, mixing well. In a mixing bowl sift flour, seasoning, lemon juice, horseradish, maple syrup or golden syrup & sage together, then add to the noodles. Place into oven & bake for 30 - 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until cooked through and golden.

title: Spinach French Fried Eggs
ingredients: 6 large eggs | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons grand marnier, sugar syrup | grated fresh thyme ( to garnish )
instructions: In a very large frying pan, heat the ole. Oil and butter. Add the yolks, nutmeg and cheese and stir together over medium heat until it has melted. Add the sugar syrup and stir until all of the cheese has been incorporated before adding the cheese. Lower the heat and cook until most of the water has boiled away. Pour the mixture on the eggs and toss well. Garnish with thyme and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,cumin powder,dill,liquid honey,panir,thyme leaf,black coffee,taco seasoning mix
title: Quick & Easy Kiwi Coffee
ingredients: 4 -5 cups water | 1 kiwi fruit, sliced | 2 tablespoons dried dill | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 3/4 - 1 cup low-fat panir ( may use reduced fat grated cheese or a flavored spread ) | fresh dill, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan or dutch oven, stir together the water, kiwis and 3/4 cup of the dill. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove cover, stir in 1/4 teaspoon cumin and taco seasonings. Transfer the mixture to a blender, add honey and process on high until very smooth. Stir in remaining dill. Return mixture to casserole dish. Pour remaining 1/4 cup dill over top. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cinnamon and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream,lemon juice,apple juice,beef stock cube,red chili powder
title: Creamy Lemon Coriander Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 beef stock cube | 1 small red chili powder | 1 ounce cream
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a high pan and leave to simmer until the flavours have mingled. Serve on your favourite plate with crusty bread, as an appetiser alongside or as an accompaniment to lamb, etc.

Random Ingredients: creme de banane,cumin powder,dark brown sugar,coconut,sage,pecan,fruit,caper
title: Caribbean Pecan Candy
ingredients: 20 leaves sage | 1/2 cup cumin powder | 7 ounces creme de banane ( a french flavor but is easily found in craft stores ) | 5 ounces dark brown sugar | 1 can mixed candied fruit, drained ( i use a 16oz can ) | 1 teaspoon capers ( optional ) | 1/2 cup toasted pecans, coarsely chopped | 1 cup grated coconut, toasted pieces
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Add more coconut powder or sugar if you prefer. I usually just add the 1/2 tsp of capers until the mixture is creamy. Spread out in small paper cups. If it is sticking, cover tightly with a lid, it will be easier to work with this later. Once all pieces are in, roll in the remaining coconut. Refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Yummie Chicken Lasagna
ingredients: 3 ripe plantains, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 1/4 cup tahini, or more as needed | 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, sliced | 1 tablespoon honey | 12 lasagna noodles | 4 leaves lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the plantains in a layer on a baking sheet.

title: Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dry cranberries | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Combine above ingredients in a sauce pan. Simmer 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with poultry or meat.

Random Ingredients: lamb,rice noodle,phyllo pastry,cornmeal,creole seasoning,egg white,accent seasoning,jalapeno
title: Sarasota's Lamb Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 packages phyllo pastry sheets | 4 -6 lbs ground lamb | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | cornmeal | 1 bunch fresh jalapeno, chopped | 2 packages rice noodles
instructions: Add egg white and creole seasoning into ground lamb and mix well with your hands. Add a handful of jalapenos and continue to mix. Cut each package into 6 rectangles. Place a 1/2 tsp of beef mixture into center of each rectangle. Add 1/2 tsp cornmeal mixture on top of beef mixture. Fold sides over, then roll tightly into a loaf shape and place seam side down cookie sheet pan in rows. Repeat until you've used up all of the phyllo and meat mixture. Bake at 400°f for about 45 more minutes or until golden brown and internal temp reaches 165°f. Let cool for 10 minutes and enjoy.

title: Faken Ground Fenugeya
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup dry fenugreek leaves
instructions: Combine soup and fenugreek in a small nonstick frypan over medium heat. Heat to boiling, stirring often.

title: Potato and Wine Filling
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled ( about 4 medium ) | 1 cup red wine ( recommended ( cabernet sauvignon or burgundy )
instructions: Cut the russet potatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a large saucepan and add enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, until tender, about 10 minutes. Larger potatoes need to cook longer. Drain the potatoes, saving all the cooking water. Place the potatoes in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,brown lentil,shrimp,plum tomato,chocolate ice cream,pinto bean
title: Mock Gumbo Sundaes With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown lentils | 1 lb small shrimp, peeled and deveined ( about 2 1/2 lb ) | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese ( about 1/2 pound ) | 3 tablespoons chopped semisweet chocolate ( can use dark chocolate ) | 3 tablespoons small plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 cup small dry pinto bean ( can substitute 1 cup of pinto beans and 1 1/2 cups of cooked jasmine rice ) | 2 pints chocolate ice cream
instructions: Soak lentils in a small quantity of water until beginning to soften, about 20 minutes. Shred the shrimp well, removing tails if they're a bit tough. Place the pinto beans, drained lentils, shrimp, and half the cheese in a blender. Blend until smooth. Place half the pinto bean paste in a bowl and mash with a potato masher or large spoon to keep the mixture smooth. Repeat with remaining bean paste and shrimp. Add chocolate and tomatoes, stirring until smooth. Add the pinto beans and noodles and fold in thoroughly. Divide among 4 large plastic freezer containers about 1/4 cup each. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight or up to 5 days. To cook, in a large pot of boiling salted water, blanch the shrimp, about 1 minute, or until they are tender but not overcooked. Drain shrimp, transfer to a plate and set aside. Repeat with remaining shrimp, shrimp, bean paste, and remaining cheese, adjusting the seasoning. Remove the plastic packages from freezer containers and, using a fork, remove the shrimp and any shells. Divide noodle mixture equally among the containers leaving 1/4 inch space at the top. Top each container with the shrimp, shrimp and bean paste. Roll each container in plastic wrap to enclose and refrigerate at least 1 hour or for up to 1 day. To serve, unmold the pints to serving plates. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Chile Risotto
ingredients: 1 can poblano chile peppers | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 4 tablespoons frozen dinner rolls, thawed
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Strain poblanos, reserving juice. Pulse peppers with reserved juice in a food processor until finely chopped and pulsed, then strain to remove seeds and stems. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering hot, and cook rice until lightly browned, stirring constantly to avoid burning. Add oregano, and stir. Cover, and simmer about 3 minutes. Add reserved poblanos, and stir. Reduce heat to low, and allow rice to steam until liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes. Fluff rice, and stir in reserved chile juice and vanilla. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Spoon into bowls, and serve hot. Serve with a drizzle of reserved peppers.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,herbes de provence,virgin olive oil,yogurt,cilantro,courgette,crescent dinner,coconut milk
title: Savory Herbed Stuffed Vegetables
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1/4 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil ( for frying ) | 2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon yogurt ( optional, if using dairy-free yogurt ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 1/4 lbs zucchini or 1 1/4 lbs carrots | sliced courgette ( to decorate ) | 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
instructions: Place the olive oil in a small sauce pan to warm. Add the herbes de provence and garlic powder to the warm oil. Stir to coat. Combine the herbes de provence and yogurt.

title: Persian Spice Paste
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups plain yogurt | 1 cup fennel seed
instructions: Put yogurt in a large, tall bowl. Toss with fennel seeds. Cover with damp cloth, and set aside to marinate about one hour. When ready to serve, discard the cloth. Transfer the yogurt to a jar with a tight fitting lid. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 2 teaspoons pepper. Shake to mix. Serve at room temperature.

title: Spicy Caesar Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, rinsed and dried | 3/4 cup bottled hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a bowl, toss all ingredients together. Chill for 1 hour before use. Shake well before serving.

title: Maple Syrup and Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 1 dash maple syrup | 2 tablespoons fresh green beans, diced
instructions: Melt margarine in skillet. Add maple syrup. Add beans. Mix well.

title: Steamed Blueberry and Oyster
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light soy sauce | 1 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the soy sauce and blueberries. Pour the sauce over the berries and toss to coat. Cover and keep at room temperature until serving.

title: Homemade Plov
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut into 2inch cubes | 1/2 green chili pepper, deseeded
instructions: Cover the veal with water, bring to a boil and lower heat to simmer the chicken for about 40 minutes, turning occasionally until meat easily passes through. Remove from heat and drain thoroughly. Cover with a dish cloth and allow to dry out overnight in the fridge, or leave overnight in its dish out.

title: Curried Pears
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 4 pears, in a single layer cored and split at the bottom
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Combine curry and curry powder in a small bowl. Brush cut side of pears with curry mixture. Place pears in a glass pyrex dish. Pour over enough boiling water to cover. Cover and bake until pears are tender and easily pierced with a cleaver, about 30 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Tips
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 can condensed tomato soup
instructions: Cut beef into 1 inch cubes. Heat skillet over high heat until hot. Drain beef. Add tomato soup. Increase heat to medium. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until tender. Serve over favorite rice.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,yellow squash,celeriac,chili garlic sauce,bread flour
title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour, or as needed | 1/2 cup unbleached bread flour | 1 container refrigerated prepared ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup green chili-garlic sauce ( such as creole seasoning ) | 1 cup yellow squash, diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Mix whole wheat flour and bread flour together in a bowl and make a well in the center. Pour ricotta cheese into center of well. Stir chili garlic sauce into the well and stir quickly until heated. Pour into the well in the flour and cheese mixture. Stir the dough until well blended. Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead it briefly until smooth and elastic, about 2 minutes. Place dough onto prepared baking sheet and flatten into a 6 inch circle.
