Using a floured razor blade, cut circles out of dough, pressing gently with fingers to flatten each cut. Bake in the preheated oven until browned, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Chorizo Patties
ingredients: 2 links chorizo sausage | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 5 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon pickled gherkin, finely chopped | lettuce, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Combine chorizo paste and teriyaki sauce in a bowl. Mix well with a fork. Spoon equal amounts of mixture onto each patty and roll up and secure with toothpicks if necessary. Place in a baking tin. Bake for 15 minutes until golden. Remove from oven and scatter with gherkins. Serve with lettuce.

title: Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup yellow onion, minced | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup sweet pimiento, drained and minced | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/4 cup stock
instructions: Place the asparagus, onion, beans and pimiento in a large saucepan. Pour the rum and stock over all and bring to boil. Simmer until asparagus is tender.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,chicken bouillon cube,cauliflower,sparkling apple cider,arborio rice
title: Cauliflower With Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 3/4 cups picante sauce | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets and cut into florets | 1 1/2 cups sparkling apple cider, chilled
instructions: In a large pot, combine the rice, picante sauce and bouillon cube and bring water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook 15 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Mix in cauliflower and cook an additional 5 minutes. Serve warm, or refrigerate until cold. Serve warm with salsa verde.

Random Ingredients: chicken,thai chili sauce,salsa,white wine vinegar,nacho cheese flavor doritos,pimiento,fenugreek seed,black bean sauce
title: Kung Powde Dessert Nacho Dip
ingredients: 2 packages nacho cheese flavor doritos | 2 cups cooked chicken, cubed bite sized | 1 jar salsa ( hot or spicy ) | 1 jar black bean sauce ( black and/or green ) | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento | 1 tablespoon thai sweet chili sauce | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: To make greek yoghurt, combine all the ingredients in a bowl and whisk till blended. Fold in the yoghurt to make a light dip. Refrigerate till serving time.

Random Ingredients: molasses,lemon juice zest,oat,beef rump roast,flour tortilla,cooking onion,lemon
title: Dusted Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses or 1/4 cup light molasses | 1 small cooking onion, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lemon rind | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( freshly squeezed, or 1 tablespoon juice from a 1-ounce lemon ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 lbs boneless beef- rump roast, sliced thin | 2/3 cup quick-cooking oats or 2/3 cup quick-cooking polenta | 4 large fat free flour tortillas or 8 fat-free flour tortillas
instructions: In a small bowl stir together the molasses, onion, lemon rind, lemon juice and 1 tablespoon water. Place the beef in a shallow glass or ceramic dish and pour the molasses mixture over the meat. Cover and turn meat to coat. Cover the dish and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Uncover the dish and spread the rolled oats evenly on the bottom of an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking dish. Arrange the meat in an even layer over the oats and bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until the meat is thoroughly cooked and the oats are crisp and brown. Meanwhile, wrap the tortillas individually with foil and bake for 10 minutes to soften. Cut each tortilla into 4 wedges.

title: Italian Parsley
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh italian parsley | 2 ounces italian-style dry sesame oil, or as needed | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese
instructions: Separate leaves from stems of parsley stems and chop separately using the dull side of a chef's knife. Combine parsley and sesame oil in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,creme de banane,italian salad dressing mix,baking soda,semolina flour,peppermint extract,shiitake mushroom cap
title: Vegetable Hero Cake
ingredients: 3/4 cup creme de banane | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup semolina flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1/2 cup chopped peppermint extract | 1 package shiitake mushroom caps | 8 -10 slices strawberries
instructions: Beat creme de banana with salad dressing mix with a wire whisk or electric mixer for about 2 minutes. Stir in semolina flour, baking soda, peppermint extract, mushrooms, and strawberries. Pour into greased and floured 10 cake pan. Score the top with a fork. Bake at 350 for about 35 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool for about 10 minutes. Turn onto a wire rack to cool completely. Cover with plastic wrap and put in freezer until set. Store up to 2 days, if frozen.

title: The Best Corn & Mushroom Nests
ingredients: 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained | 14 white shoepeg corn
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, add mushrooms, sauteing 2 minutes. Add the corn and stir to coat. Bring to a boil, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: colby,chili oil,rice,red chili pepper,lime zest,thai red curry paste,red pepper
title: Lime Curried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups raw rice | 3/4 cup minced red pepper | 3/4 cup minced red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon minced lime zest | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1/3 cup shredded colby, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Combine rice, red pepper, red chilies, lime zest, curry paste, chili oil, and shredded colby cheese. Stir, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes to one hour before serving to allow flavors to combine.

title: Irish Bread and Whiskey Rarebit
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped green tomatoes | 2/3 cup finely chopped cooked dried irish whiskey | 1/2 cup finely chopped small barley | 1 tablespoon finely chopped head garlic | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( or other orange liqueur ) | 8 slices crusty french bread, cut in 1/2
instructions: In a small container, stir together tomato, whiskey, barley, garlic, and grand marnier until well combined.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle relish,mango,pistachio,turmeric powder,tamarind paste,white wine vinegar,sesame oil,bread
title: Tamarind & Sesame Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon yellow sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 400 g jam or 400 g relish | 200 g dry bread, crust removed, torn into small pieces, torn into small pieces | 2 large dill pickle relishes | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill pickle, plus extra for sprinkling
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a screw top jar. Cover and shake until well combined.

title: Buffalo Chicken Sauce I
ingredients: 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 dash hot sauce | 1 dash worcestershire sauce
instructions: Heat cream, broth, onion powder, cayenne pepper and hot sauce in saucepan. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to transfer hot sauce to slow cooker. Add hot sauce mixture to slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,red bell pepper,romano cheese,apple,red onion,rice wine vinegar
title: Kosher Risotto and Red Onions
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon apple wood smoke granules ( optional but recommended ) or 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, to taste | 6 tablespoons unsweetened rioja yogurt or 6 tablespoons plain yogurt | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon red bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon grated romano cheese | 4 medium red onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a bowl and stir. Heat a grill pan or grill pan over high heat. Thread the onions onto metal skewers and grill on each side until charred, about 2 minutes per side.

title: Avocado and Leek Fritters
ingredients: 3 large leeks | 1 tablespoon plain flour | sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berries | 1 large ripe avocado, peeled, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: Trim the leeks and cut off the tops and roots. Finely chop the leeks. Put the chopped leeks, flour, sea salt, allspice and avocado into a medium sized mixing bowl. Using your hands gently mix everything together. Using your hands gently mix in the orange juice until evenly combined. Spoon into fritters and fry over medium heat, using a little extra oil or butter to prevent sticking.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,virgin olive oil,caribbean jerk seasoning,oatmeal
title: Grilled Pina Colada Oats
ingredients: 2 cups oatmeal | 2 tablespoons caribbean jerk seasoning, such as mccormick's | 1 1/4 cups canned crushed pineapple with juice | 1 cup virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat your grill and grill your oat patties. Use non stick baking pans if you have them. You want your bread to be slightly under the grill. In a large bowl, mix the oats with the jerk seasoning. Mix in the pineapple, olive oil and then pour into your prepared pans. Sprinkle the top with more of your jerk seasoning. Place your pan in the preheated grill for 15 minutes or until the oat patties are cooked through. Remove the oat patties from the pan and serve.

title: Steamed Oyster With Oranges (Asian Style)
ingredients: 10 large oysters ( approximately ) | accompany : ( condiments, i used sesame seeds, red chile slices, green onions, and scallions ) | 8 sprigs fresh mint leaves ( i used about 2 t. ) | 1 small small red onion, halved and thinly sliced | 100 ml kahlua ( for authenticity ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: To steam oysters. Line steamer basket in a small, heavy bottomed pot with a double layer of cheesecloth that's been rinsed in cold water. Place the shucked oysters in the cheesecloth, add a little water to come halfway up the side, set the pot over a bowl of hot water and bring to a brisk boil. Carefully pour in enough hot water to cover the oysters. Cover and let steam until the top just begins to turn golden and the oysters are just firm to the touch and the tops are ajar. Remove the oysters to a platter or warmed dish and set aside. To steam the oysters, bring a pot of water to a boil. Remove from the heat. Using tongs or paring a slotted spoon, place the oysters on the hot water. Cover and cook for just about 1 minute. Carefully pull the center of each oyster out of the water, leaving the shell as it will become hard to remove. Repeat with remaining oysters to fill and serve, reheating just before serving. Toast sesame seeds and place in a small saute pan over medium heat. Using a wooden spatula, toss to coat, until golden. Set aside. Add mint and onions to the sesame seeds in a mortar and pound until finely chopped. Add kahlua and bay leaf and combine well. Add this mixture along with or against the back of a spoon to thicken sauce. Drizzle sauce over oysters.

Random Ingredients: coffee,campbell cheddar cheese soup,almond extract,lime juice
title: Campbell's French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 cans cheddar cheese soup | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 3/4 cup coffee | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,noodle,chicken stock vegetable,sauce,hamburger bun sesame seed,bacon,breadcrumb
title: Noodles - British Pub-Smoker Friendly
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb hamburger bun, sliced | 1 lb noodles, cooked | 1/2 lb ground sirloin or 1/2 lb ground top round | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce | 12 slices bacon, cooked and lightly crumbled | 1 1/2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 -2 cup chicken stock or 1 -2 cup vegetable stock | 1 pinch breadcrumbs
instructions: Sauce, brown meat in heated pan with hot sauce and seasoning mixture. Add crumbled bacon. Stir occasionally until bacon is crisp and cooked but not too crisp remove and drain bacon and grease. If the sauce is too thick, thin it down with some of the stock. Serve a few warm hamburger buns and place the cooked noodles on top. Sprinkle with cheese and parsley if desired.

title: Baharat Aka Spicy Bread
ingredients: 2 slices bacon, chopped | 2 pita bread | soya sauce, to taste | 1 cardamom pod
instructions: Using 1 tablespoon of oil per pita add to baking dish. Add onion slices. Sprinkle with a little oil. Spray a little bit of soya sauce as you are adding it. Pre heat the griddle, pan or oven. Turn oven on 200°c. Put the bacon on the pan / oven. Cook for 10 minutes then remove from the oven. Take the pan / oven off the ghee. Put the pita bread in the oven without turning the bread. Remove bread pieces from the oven, leaving a whole pile of bread on the pan. Slice bread into small triangles or squares, or make slathers with bacon and sauce as desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,sea salt black pepper,stewing beef,pickerel fillet,celery
title: Fish Archestratus
ingredients: 1 2 lbs stewing beef | 16 ounces pickerel fillets or 16 ounces other fresh fish | 2 -3 stalks celery, cut diagonally into half inch lengths | 1 teaspoon sea salt or 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut fish into 1 inch cubes and toss with pickerel, celery, salt and pepper. Lightly coat a baking dish with cooking spray and lay chunks of fish in the baking dish, placing about 1/4 to 1/3 cup each piece of fish in the dish. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Place in the preheated 300°f oven for about 20 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,garlic powder,oatmeal,fig,black cardamom pod,phyllo pastry
title: Figs Wrapped in Phyllo
ingredients: 4 large fresh figs, stalks removed, quartered lengthwise | 4 cups oatmeal | 1 tablespoon garlic powder, or to taste | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pod, or to taste | 14 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup oatmeal, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with wax paper. Place figs on the prepared baking sheet. Gently stir 1 cup oatmeal into oatmeal. Sprinkle garlic powder over figs. Wrap each fig in 2 sheets phyllo dough, brushing with remaining oatmeal, and cover stack with 2 more sheets phyllo dough. Cut stack in half crosswise, cutting off the ends. Lay 1 phyllo sheet on top of 4 remaining figs, cut side down, pressing into each fig with fingers, and place on prepared baking sheet. Continue with remaining phyllo sheets, brushing each fig with more oatmeal. Bake in preheated oven until figs are tender and phyllo is golden brown, 40 to 50 minutes. Watch carefully so phyllo doesn't burn.

title: Oysters and Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg whole leg of lamb, cut into 10 equal pieces | 375 -375 g oysters, shucked | margarine or butter, for greasing | 1/3 cup ketchup ( kikkoman )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degree celsius. Arrange the lamb in a deep roasting tin. Brush lightly with melted margarine or butter. Combine the remaining ingredients and pour over lamb. Cover tightly and bake for 1 hour, basting once or twice during the baking. Remove from the oven and turn meat and top with crusty bread.

title: Bleu Cheese Bites II
ingredients: cooking spray | 4 ounces pepperoni, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Prepare a sheet of waxed paper with cooking spray. Arrange 2 pepperoni slices in a horizontal line in the center of the paper. Top with 2 cheese slices and 2 more pepperoni slices. Place the sheets of waxed paper at an angle, about 1 inch from the source of heat. Allow the mixture to sit at room temperature for 15 minutes. Carefully remove the waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,bacon grease,chive,pizza sauce,tomato green chilies,cold water,cream
title: Pizza Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon low fat bacon grease | 500 g ready to serve pizza sauce | 2 tablespoons cold water | 300 -300 g ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup low fat sour cream | 3 tablespoons reduced-fat sharp parmesan-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon snipped fresh chives or 1 teaspoon fresh chives, chopped | 2 tablespoons canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained ( i did not add )
instructions: Heat the bacon grease in a saucepan over a medium heat. Add the tomato sauce, water and seasoning. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Spoon the sauce onto a warm serving dish. Sprinkle the ricotta over the sauce and mix in the cheese and chives. Top with the diced tomatoes and any chunky chilies.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,arugula leaf,clear honey,marshmallow,date,apple juice,dill
title: Apple and Arugula Salad
ingredients: 4 cups packed coarsely chopped dried arugula leaves, or as needed | 6 large marshmallows | 1/4 cup dark-colored honey | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon clear honey | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill | 1/2 serrano chile pepper, finely chopped | 3 large fresh dates, pitted and sliced
instructions: Stir arugula, marshmallows, 1/4 cup honey, apple juice, dark sugar, dill, and chile pepper in a bowl.

title: Vanilla Citrus Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla sugar | 3/4 cup lime juice, from 2 regular lemons | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and process until it reaches desired thickness or syrupy consistency.

title: Soupe Flamande
ingredients: 16 ounces bow tie pasta | 8 ounces mixed currants | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat a pot of water to boiling over high heat. Add the bow tie pasta and cook until al dente, according to package directions. Drain pasta and return it to the pot. Add the currants and pepper and toss lightly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: scallion,black sesame seed,red chile,ha avocadoes,tomato green chilies,wine vinegar,panko breadcrumb
title: Salsa-Stuffed Guacamole
ingredients: 10 hass avocadoes | 4 slices red chilies ( fresh or dried red peppers ) | 4 tablespoons scallions, chopped | 4 teaspoons panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup pico de gallo black sesame seed, toasted | 3 small tomatoes, chopped ( roma tomatoes )
instructions: Peel, pit and remove the avocadoes from their shells. Cut the avocados in half lengthwise. Remove the pit by holding a piece of avocado with the pointed tip of a small, sharp knife, or you can use a melon baller to cut out the center with a knife. Using a small spoon, scoop the pulp out of the pit leaving a 1/8 inch shell that holds its shape. Discard shells. Remove from shells. Rinse the shell well and then cut the avocados in half lengthwise. Arrange the chunks, cut side up, in 6 small shells. Cut the chilis lengthwise into 6 smaller chilis. Place the chiles under hot water and let steam until softened, about 2 minutes. Place the scallions and panko in a small bowl and combine with the vinegar. Add the sherry and mix. Set aside. To make the topping, add the toasted sesame seeds. Place tomatoes in a shallow dish. Sprinkle 1 t. Of the cheese mixture on the top, then top with the chilis. Spoon the salsa over the top. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Raspberry Vinegar - Rieska
ingredients: 125 ml vinegar ( or wine vinegar ) | 250 ml vegetable stock | 1 dash black salt | raspberries, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Place the vinegar in a pan and bring to the boil with the stock and salt. Remove from the heat and cover and leave to stand for 1 to 2 hours or until the liquid is reduced. Strain and pour into hot champagne flûts. Garnish with raspberries to serve.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,salt pork,red onion,hot red pepper flake,blueberry,thyme
title: Blueberry Salsa
ingredients: 1 quart fresh blueberries | 1 red onion, diced | 2 pounds salt pork, diced | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 hot red pepper flakes, chopped | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place the blueberries into a large pot and fill with enough water to cover. Add red onion, salt, bacon, salt, thyme and red pepper flakes. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer for 20 - 30 minutes, or until most of the liquid is reduced and the berries are soft. Stir occasionally. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate seed,canola oil,ice water,garbanzo bean,cilantro leaf,white wine
title: Chickpea Fresca
ingredients: 1 cup canola oil for frying | 2 cans garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, minced | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds, or to taste | 1 teaspoon ice water
instructions: Heat canola oil in a deep fryer to 300 degrees f. Drain chickpeas thoroughly, and transfer to a bowl. Stir the garbanzo beans, wine, cilantro, pomegranate seeds, and ice water into the garbanzo beans, and blend well with a fork until the mixture is thoroughly mixed. If you have any leftover garbanzo, you may cut it into strips with scissors to make small chunks. Allow to cool and set out at room temperature for about 20 minutes before serving.

title: Papaya Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 large papaya, ripe, peeled, seeded, and chopped | 1 small green pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender. Chill until serving.

title: Chicken & Pasta Nests
ingredients: 300 g rigatoni pasta, fresh, cooked | 1 packet green lentils ( or white beans, or green lentils ) | 1 medium red onion, finely chopped | 125 g cooked chicken, shredded | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped pistachios | 2 tablespoons crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Cook the pasta according to pack instructions, drain. Meanwhile, place the lentils in a pan of boiling water and stir in the onion, chicken and pistachios for 5 mins, until the vegetable are tender. Drain the pasta and then toss it through one of the prepared vegetables and toss through. Tip, you can also do this in the microwave or just mix it all together with your pasta once it has been cooked.

Random Ingredients: margarine,cilantro,rice flour,fennel,maraschino cherry,sage leaf,yellow mustard seed,tamari
title: Chesse
ingredients: 4 tablespoons margarine | 1/2 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 4 fresh sage leaves ( or more, to taste ) | 2 teaspoons fennel | 2 teaspoons fennel, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves, crushed | 4 cups rice flour, raw | 6 tablespoons tamari | 8 maraschino cherries, to garnish
instructions: Heat the margarine in the skillet over low heat until it is melted. Add the mustard seeds. When seeds begin to pop, mix in sage, fennel and crushed sage leaves. In a large bowl mix rice flour, tamari and mustard mixture. Mix until smooth. Add the cherries. Garnish with mint leaves or cilantro and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,bok choy,sun tomato oil,orange peel,guacamole,soya sauce
title: Guilt Free, Super Stove Top Salad
ingredients: 250 g guacamole | 25 g hazelnuts | 2 bunches bok choy | 1 orange peel, finely grated | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 8 -10 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, thinly sliced
instructions: Using your hands make a small slit on one end of all the bok choy and use a sharp knife to slice the bunches until roughly two thirds of the length. Roughly chop the bok choy and put aside. Put the guacamole into the bowl with the hazelnuts, add a layer of bok choy, then cut into pieces about 3 inches long. Add the orange zest, 1 tbsp soya sauce and a drizzle of olive oil and mix. Toss in the bok choy and the sun dried tomatoes before tossing in the other ingredients. Let it chill for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Chunky Corn and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon thai prepared pesto sauce | 1/2 medium cauliflower floret, coarsely chopped | 1/4 - 1/3 cup frozen corn, thawed | cocoa powder
instructions: Combine pesto and cauliflower in a microwave safe casserole dish and microwave on high until cauliflower is crisp tender, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Stir over medium heat and microwave until heated through, about 2 minutes. Stir in corn. Sprinkle cocoa over mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,balsamic vinegar,chili paste,orange flower water,coffee granule
title: Quick & Easy Moosé Sauce
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes, undrained | 2 teaspoons instant coffee granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon orange flower water
instructions: Mix all all ingredients together in a small saucepan and heat, stirring constantly, until boiling.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,salmon fillet,chili bean paste,oatmeal,red lentil,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Chilli Bean & Barley Crumble Salmon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 600 g salmon fillets, cut into 2 cm cubes | 1/2 cup red lentil | 250 g pearl barley, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons chopped mild chili bean paste | 300 g crunchy rolled oats | 2 tablespoons coarsely grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c degrees. Heat oil in a large, ovenproof pan over medium heat. Add the salmon and cook, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes or until browned and cooked through. Add lentils, barley & chili bean paste. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until combined. Place rice, oats & cheese in a deep roasting tin. Spoon over salmon mixture and bake in oven, uncovered for 20 minutes, or until top is crispy and golden.

title: Skillet Veggie Meatballs
ingredients: 16 meatballs | 1 bag yellow squash, thawed | 1 container frozen mixed vegetables, stir fry mix
instructions: Brown meatballs in a hot skillet. When cooked enough to break apart, transfer to a large pot of lightly greaseed cooking spray. Slice squash into rounds and toss with meatballs. Pour vegetable mix over and stir well. Cook 7 to 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened and squash is tender crisp. You can serve over noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,beefsteak tomato,white bread
title: Sopa Seca
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beefsteak tomatoes, ripe or can ripe tomatoes | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | crusty white bread
instructions: Slice tomatoes into 1 in wedges and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and toss gently.

title: Ginger Oranges
ingredients: 6 -6 oranges or 6-6 lemons | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups dry red wine or 1 1/2 cups orange juice
instructions: Peel the oranges and lemon or lemons and cut them in half lengthwise. Do not peel away the skin unless you are planning on using fresh lemons and oranges. Grate the zest from 1/4 of the oranges using a juicer and set aside. Coarsely chop the remaining orange or lemon peel and put them in a deep sided casserole dish. Cut the remaining orange or lemon in 1/4 rounds and add them to the casserole dish. Add the ginger garlic paste to the mixture and mix well. Pour the wine or juice over the oranges or lemons and stir to combine. Place the pan into a heated oven and bake for 30 to 40 minutes until the wine has reduced, syrupy and concentrated. Serve warm or cold. Serve warm or cold.

title: Pumpkin Mustard
ingredients: 10 1/2 ounces condensed beef broth | 14 1/2 ounces pumpkin puree | 4 teaspoons honey mustard | 6 1/2 ounces mixed italian herbs
instructions: Place all ingredients into a blender and process at high speed until smooth. Pour into a shallow bowl or pie dish. Cool slightly, then refrigerate until ready to use. Drain well before use.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,tomato juice,spring onion,boston lettuce,pea,yukon gold potato
title: Roasted Summer Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 bunch spring onion, sliced | 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled, cut into 2 inch pieces | 3 lbs butternut squash, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 can tomato juice | 6 leaf torn boston lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place butter in large cast iron skillet. When butter melts add onions and potatoes and saute until golden and vegetables starting to color. Drain and stir in tomato juice. Cover skillet and place in oven. Bake 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove from oven and top with lettuce.

title: Sushi Roll With Skirt Steak
ingredients: 4 teaspoons sushi rice | 16 ounces skirt steaks, preferably fresh, cut thinly | 1 cup cooked and chilled peas | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat 1 1/2 to 2 tsp oil in non stick pan over medium high heat. Sprinkle both sides of steak with salt and pepper. Working in batches, cook steak 3 - 5 minutes per side for medium doneness. Transfer steak to platter and loosely tent with foil while preparing rice. Drain drippings from pan. Add rice to drippings and bring to a boil, stirring often until liquid is absorbed and rice is slightly toasted. Spoon rice onto platter, spreading to cover. Serve with peas and whipped cream.

title: Bread Machine Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup warm water | 3 tablespoons dried oregano flakes
instructions: To make warm water, place in large container and sprinkle over the yeast. Sift in 3 tablespoons of the dry oregano flakes. Mix and turn onto dough setting and add remaining dry ingredients. Set bread machine for regular or pizza dough setting and push start. When finished, remove dough to a floured surface. Divide into 3 equal pieces and shape into 2 long patties. Spray a pizza pan with tony cosh® or similar cooking spray and set 1 piece of dough on the pan. Stretch dough to fit on sheet. Repeat by lightly spreading dough over pizza pan, using the other piece of dough. Lightly stretch dough and coat the edges with the tony crust. Set into pan with crust. Allow to rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour. Remove crust from pan and allow to cool before slicing and topping with your favorite toppings.

title: The Perfect Zwt 1 Seven Seasoning
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2/3 teaspoon golden syrup | 1/3 small cucumber, peeled and cut into very thin slices
instructions: Crush the coriander and salt in a mortar & pestle or with the back of a spoon until fine. Combine all the ingredients in a glass baking dish or zip lock bag. Use this as a seasoning for meats or seafood. Makes about a cup of zwt 1 seven seasoning.

title: Cavatelli - Spiced Mozzarella Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 400 g flour | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 1/4 cups apple cider vinegar ( or cider vinegar ) | 1/2 cup grated cheese, mixed with the flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°c. Place all the ingredients into a blender/mixer and whiz until smooth until you have a thick, but spreadable batter that sticks to the blade. Place the batter on a large baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper and bake in the oven for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool completely before removing the paper or putting into a zip lock bag to speed up the process. Serve with lots of crusty bread for dipping. This is wonderful on sandwich slices, as an accompaniment to a meat and vegetable accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: white bread,salmon,habanero pepper,hungry jack potato flake,apple juice,garlic olive oil
title: Habanero Potato Salmon Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, preferably crustless | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant mashed potato flakes ( see footnote for recipe link ) | 2 tablespoons garlic-flavored olive oil | 1 cup heinz chili sauce with mushrooms or 1 cup heinz hot sauce | 3 ounces habanero peppers, stemmed, deseeded and thinly sliced | 2 ounces salted salmon, skin removed and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread potato flakes all over the bread. Place on baking sheet. Heat olive oil in a medium bowl until just hot enough to sizzle a tahini. Stir in chopped chile peppers. Spread about 1/4 cup chili hot sauce over the potatoes. Add salmon chunks and stir to coat. Pour remaining chili mixture over the bread, spread evenly. Place bread on baking sheet and bake until crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Tzatziki (Lebanese Cheese Spread)
ingredients: 8 ounces cream-style cottage cheese | 8 ounces chopped ham ( optional ) | 1/3 cup tahini | 4 dates, chopped
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend the cottage cheese, ham, tahini and dates until smooth. Transfer to a serving dish and serve at room temperature.

title: Cheesy Baked Spicy Cheese
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups aged cheddar cheese | 1 cup crumbled pecorino-romano cheese | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Place the cheddar cheese, pecorino romano cheese, vermouth, hot sauce, and chili powder in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until the ingredients are mixed well. Pour the cheese mixture into a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,bean,taco seasoning mix,italian sausage,beef broth,coriander seed,soya sauce
title: Taco Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 6 ounces frozen refried beans | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning or 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1/8 cup beef broth or 1/8 cup tomato juice | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place the bean slices in a single layer of aluminum foil. Place in the oven on the middle rack and leave to cook for about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside the cooked pan juices. Place the beans back into the pan and return to the oven. Meanwhile, in a small bowl mix together the cornstarch, soya sauce, seasoning and beef broth. Mix well and set aside. When the beans are nearly cooked turn the oven off, remove the foil & set a timer for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, using the reserved beef broth, in a small fry pan brown the corriander seeds over low heat for a few seconds. When the beans turn slightly darker and a bit darker then the original temperature, add this to the corriander mixture, stirring all the while. Add the cornstarch and stir well until it thickens. Pour the blended mixture over the warm and warm beans. Serve with tortilla chips or fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,sugar,orange,linguine,maple syrup,sherry wine,cheddar cheese
title: Stir Fry Pasta
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 1 bunch fresh orange rind, cut into thin rounds | 4 cups reduced cheddar cheese, grated, about 1 cup, about 3 cups | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry wine | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice
instructions: Preheat your nonstick wok over high heat until very hot add small amount of oil and the orange rind, stir frying until rind darkens and starts to caramelize. Immediately add the cheese and stir fry until cheese melts. Add the sherry, vinegar, sweet sherry, syrup, and orange juice. Stir fry for about 2 minutes. Season with salt to taste. Serve over the pasta of your choice.

title: Green Coriander Chicken Wings
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings, separated at joints, and tips discarded | 8 ounces crystallized gingerroot | 1 pint walnuts | 1 bunch green chili | 1/4 pint icing sugar | 1 pint finely chopped lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon capers
instructions: Cut the wing tips from the joints and discard them. Place the wing pieces in a bowl and cover with cold water, adding the crystallized gingerroot, walnuts and chilli. Allow to soak for 30 to 45 minutes maximum. Meanwhile, combine all of the icing sugar, celery seeds, capers and the remaining icing sugar in a bowl and mix well until all of the icing sugar has dissolved. Remove the chicken from the water and place in an oiled baking tray lined with baking paper. Using your fingers, press the icing mixture in to the cuts made from the wings. Sprinkle the caps over, and drizzle each with a little of the remaining sesame oil. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 40 to 50 minutes, or until the coating becomes a dark colour. Remove from the oven, and set aside. When cool, cut into segments, and serve with a dipping sauce.

title: Chunky Italian Cherry Snack
ingredients: 1 jar stoned sun-dried tomatoes, drained | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1 1/2 cups glace cherries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Combine tomatoes, sugar, bread crumbs and pecans, tossing together until evenly mixed. Drop spoonfuls of tomato mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them well apart, and bake for 15 minutes, or until crumbs are golden brown and crisp. Cool 10 minutes, removing foil and mashing cherry tops. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,lemon peel,jalapeno pepper,beet,brown sugar substitute,cooking spray,half cream,pistachio
title: Spicy Beet Spread (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 5 medium fresh beets, peeled and grated ( about 3 cups ) | 1/3 cup chopped toasted shelled pistachios ( about 3 tbsp ) | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar substitute | 1/4 cup butter, softened ( i use vegan food process butter at this point, use whatever type of butter you enjoy and you can also use vegan margarine ) | 1/2 teaspoon finely shredded lemon peel | 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped | cooking spray | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Place grated beet into a colander and set over a bowl. Spray a large, wide bowl with cooking spray. Run your thumb along the length of the grated beets and pull off the hard, slightly broken ends. Then slice them into 1/3 inch pieces and dump all of them into the bowl. In a blender or food processor, mix pistachios, brown sugar and butter until thoroughly combined. Squeeze the juice from the jalapenos into the bowl, then add to bowl with beets. Add lemon peel, jalapeno, and half and half. Beat until creamy and smooth. It can also be made without it, by processing the mix in a blender or food processor. Spoon mixture onto a large baking sheet coated with cooking spray, then sprinkle with pistachios. Bake at 450° for 20 - 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Sprinkle top with additional chopped pistachios or serve plain or with your favorite fruit salad.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,panko breadcrumb,lamb,romano cheese,wheat pita bread,fenugreek seed,kaffir lime leaf
title: Lamb and Onion Gyros
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked ground lamb | 1 small panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons finely grated romano cheese | 2 teaspoons whole fenugreek seeds | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 spanish onion, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup fine grain country-style pita bread, broken in half
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a large bowl, add ground lamb and panko crumbs, cheese, fenugreek and lime leaves. Blend for 2 minutes. Chop the onion into 1/2 inch pieces. Add onion and 1/2 cup panko to lamb mixture. Mix well. Shape into eight 2 inch long sausages or 6 inch flat pita breads. Place on wire racks, and broil for 6 to 8 minutes on each side, basting with accumulated juices. Cut pitas into 3/4 inch wide slices. Serve on a platter with a dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,white onion,fajita seasoning mix,banana pepper,liquid smoke,risotto rice,flour,spinach
title: Kittencal's "Spinach and Fajita Rice"
ingredients: 2 cups flour ( can use more ) | 1 envelope fajita seasoning mix ( i use paul prudhomme's ) | 2 cups risotto rice ( i've used arborio but that's my personal taste ) | 1/2 white onion ( diced ) | 1/2 cup kalamata olive ( sliced, i don't really like the amount, i think them larger, but cut in half ) | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 bag frozen chopped spinach ( thawed and squeezed dry ) | 4 slices bananas ( or hot pepper slices )
instructions: Combine 2 1/2 cups flour mix and 2 tsp fajita mix in large bowl. Heat large non stick skillet on medium high. Dredge diced onion in flour, add to skillet. Sauté onions, onions until lightly browned in pan. Add the sautéed onions to the pan.

title: Namia Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 5 1/2 ounces dried apricots, chopped | 2 tablespoons sweetened, dried apricot puree or 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 3/4 cups double cream | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons mild curry powder, plus more as desired ( i like hot! ) | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions, drain and set aside. In a small bowl, combine the apricots with the apricots and puree or tahini. In a medium bowl, whisk together the cream, almond extract and curry powder. Add the cream mixture, stir to combine and set aside. When the macaroni is finished chopping, drain and return to the bowl with the fruit and apricots. Pour the cream mixture over the macaroni, toss to combine, then sprinkle the nuts over the top. Chill a couple of hours or overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,red pepper flake,oat,salad oil,linguine,herb,lemon,italian seasoning
title: Lettuce Wrapped Italian Lemon Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine, uncooked | 4 1/2 cups vinaigrette ( i prefer herbed olive oil ) | 2 -4 teaspoons mixed chopped fresh herbs | 1 teaspoon garlic or 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 lemons, juice of | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1 teaspoon mixed chopped fresh herbs | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon cracked red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Cook linguine al dente in salted water. Drain and put in large bowl. While linguine is cooking, mix together vinaigrette, herbs, garlic and red pepper flakes. Set aside. Combine lemon juice, salad oil and mixed herbs in a pan and heat until hot. Pour over the linguine and mix thoroughly. Add pasta to bowl and toss to cover thoroughly. Serve at once or refrigerate for a few hours and then serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,cheese ravioli,red bell pepper,linguine,celery,asiago cheese
title: Linguine With Bell & Asiago
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine or 12 ounces pasta shells ( linguine-shaped ) | 3/4 lb white cheese ravioli, cooked ( or your favourite ) | 3 large stalks celery, thinly sliced crosswise | 1 1 jar roasted red bell peppers, drained and sliced ( jarred ) | 1 1/2 cups grated asiago cheese | 1/3 cup white sugar
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Chinese Curry Potatoes
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1/4 cup minced savory | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 1 teaspoon pureed galangal | 1 teaspoon dried bay leaves
instructions: Preheat over to 450 degrees f. Remove peels from potatoes and cut in half lengthwise. Remove potato halves into small strips. Cut into 3/4 to 1 inch pieces. Set aside. In a dutch oven, heat oil over medium high heat. Cook potato in oil, stirring often, 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to a plate lined with a paper towel lined napkin. Repeat until all potatoes are cooked and in the dutch oven. Stir in savory, garlic and galangal. Return potatoes to pot. Cover and return to heat. Cook until potatoes begin to soften. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,bacon dripping,shallot,dark sesame oil,black vinegar,halibut fillet
title: Bahama Bay Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 lb thick-cut bacon, cut into small pieces | 1/4 cup minced shallot | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil, plus extra for drizzling ( see tip ) | 1/3 cup frozen limeade concentrate, defrosted ( see tip ) | 1/3 cup light-colored sesame oil | 4 halibut fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f and position the rack in center of oven. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine the bacon, shallot, sesame oil, limeade concentrate and sesame oil in a small saucepan, bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer until sauce is reduced to 1 1/2 tablespoons. Heat a 10 inch heavy skillet over medium high heat, add the bacon and shallots and sauté, stirring occasionally, until the shallots have begun to soften. Add the fish and cook for 3 minutes on each side until they turn opaque and the fish is cooked through. Transfer the fish to plates and garnish with additional sesame oil, serve with lime slices and sesame seeds.

title: Chile Prawns with Curried Parsnip
ingredients: 400 g parsnips, halved lengthways | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon hot curry powder | 2 teaspoons chile paste | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 140 g bacon, chopped | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Shell the parsnips and discard the peel. Wash and cut into 2cm dice. Heat the butter in a frying pan, add the parsnips and curry powder and fry until they are just cooked through. Stir in the chile paste and cinnamon then stir in the bacon and sundried tomatoes. Stir in the drained prawns and cook until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,lebanese cucumber,salmon,topping,water,beef roast,gruyere cheese,golden raisin
title: Smorgastuckers
ingredients: 1/3 lb fresh salmon, diced | 1/2 lebanese cucumbers, peeled, cored and sliced into small chunks or 2 ounces cucumbers, fresh, diced | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup boiling water | 10 ounces whipped topping, warmed | 4 slices gruyere cheese or 4 slices other swiss cheese ( 1/4-inch thick )
instructions: In a small bowl combine the diced salmon, cucumber, raisins, and bouillon and pour over boiling water. Allow to soak for 10 - 15 minutes. Stir vigorously to dissolve the bouillon, then add the whipped topping and mix well. Divide the salmon mixture between four serving dishes. Scatter the cheese over the top. Serve over white buttermilk biscuits or french bread.

title: Mika's Limas & Blueberry Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans lima beans | 2 bottles tzatziki ( found in health food aisle of any supermarket ) | 1 dozen frozen blueberries ( depending on size ) | 4 bottles light beer or 4 bottles of dark beer | 12 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Drain the limas and blueberries, place in food processor and pulse a few times to roughly chop. Add tabasco and beer to food processor, pulse until blended. Add lima beans and blueberries and pulse again. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve with crackers or raw veggies like asparagus and corn chips.

title: Easy Mexican Rotel Tomatoes
ingredients: 20 cans rotel original diced tomatoes | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: In 12 - 14 ounce canning jars, pour juice from tomatoes into saucepan. Heat over medium heat until boiling. Boil about 10 minutes or until clear. Press two cans and one can of rotel together in a cup. Fill tomato cans with rotel mixture. Do other can containing tomatoes over the top of the cans.

title: Pate Chinois
ingredients: 1 package smoked sausage | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 lb ground veal
instructions: Brown sausage and chopped bell pepper together until sausage is well browned. Mix all ingredients into a loaf pan or casserole. Bake at 450 degrees for 30 minutes to an hour or longer.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,barbecue sauce,apricot,star anise,cream corn,cracker crumb,lamb chop,rice wine
title: Lamb Chops in Rice Wine
ingredients: 3 red-skinned boneless lamb chops, pounded slightly | 1 cup rice wine | 2 tablespoons cream-style corn | 4 small sweet bell peppers, sliced into rings | 4 slices apricots | 1/2 teaspoon ground star anise | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 8 tablespoons cracker crumbs
instructions: Mix rice wine wine, corn and cream style corn together in a shallow, nonreactive dish. Add lamb and turn to coat evenly. Cover and marinate 30 minutes or refrigerate 8 hours. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place apricots in a small, dry frying pan and pour 1/2 cup hot water over them. Let stand for 10 seconds, and remove apricots and nuts. Place lamb on a rack in a roasting pan and bake, turning once, for 1 hour, or until lamb is just done.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,garlic clove,fennel bulb,marshmallow,white sugar,basil leaf
title: Italian Tomato Fennel Noodles-No Bake, No Bake,
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry small shell pasta | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 fennel bulbs, white ends trimmed, trimmed, cored, with tops sliced crosswise 1/4 inch thick | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, packed | 1 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook pasta until tender but firm. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, stir sugar and fennel until the fennel stalks begin to blacken and caramelize, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and chopped basil and cook for 2 minutes more. Pour tomato mixture over fennel mixture and toss to combine. Drain pasta and toss with tomato mixture and chopped basil.

title: Nestled White Meat Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup farina | 1 cup semolina | 1 lb white pearl onion ( about 1/2 onion ) | 1 lb fried ham ( about 4 slices from deli ) | 1 1/2 lbs gyros meat ( or more )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees. Mix farina, semolina, and onions together in a bowl. Stir to mix. Dip ham slices into flour, then into meat. Dumplings are ready when they float to the surface. If your pan is big enough, line it with wax paper or parchment paper and put dumplings into it. Spread the dumplings out evenly, then transfer to the preheated oven. Bake for 45 minutes. Turn dumplings over. They are ready when the edges are crispy and the dumplings have turned golden brown and some are still slightly flaky inside.

title: Spicy Brazilian Cocktail Oil
ingredients: 1 cup olive oil | 8 ounces ice, crushed | 1 bunch fresh coriander sprig
instructions: Shake the olive oil slowly in a screw top jar with crushed ice until it dissolves. Place ice in a bowl, pour ice mixture over and stir. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. To serve, remove from jar and garnish with coriander.

title: Spicy Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1/8 teaspoon french bread, crumbs | 1/8 teaspoon cornmeal | 1 tablespoon french toast, crumbs | butter ( for frying )
instructions: Mix peanut butter, soya sauce and spoon over bread. Sprinkle with crumbs. Heat butter on skillet and put bread in pan, cook about 5 - 6 mins or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,ginger,dark chocolate,celery leaf,cooking spray,nut
title: Spice-Smoked Brown & Sweet Chocolate Teriyaki Barbecue
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/2 lb smoked dark chocolate, roughly chopped | 5 kaffir lime leaves, washed, drained and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon crystallized ginger, grated | 1/4 cup celery leaf, finely chopped | 1/3 cup nuts, chopped, toasted
instructions: Preheat grill to moderate. Spray a 9 inch square baking dish with cooking oil. Combine chocolate, kaffir lime leaves, ginger and celery. Mix thoroughly. Pour into the baking dish just to fully enclose everything in the centre of the baking dish. Sprinkle nuts over top. Place in the centre of the grill and close lid. Grill for 5 minutes, or until surface of chocolate is dry. Leave in the baking dish covered for 10 minutes. Remove from the grill. Allow to completely cool. Break into pieces and store at room temperature in an airtight container for up to 6 months.

title: Crispy Pancetta Fries With Ginger
ingredients: 8 red potatoes, washed and cut into 1/4-inch-thick fries | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, fresh squeezed | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 ounce pancetta, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. In a large frying pan, heat the oil until it is quite hot, but not smoking. Add the pancetta and cook over high heat until it is browned and crisp. Remove the pancetta to a paper bag to absorb excess grease. Reduce the heat to low. Put potatoes into a large bowl of cold water, add salt, and stir gently until softened and pliable. Pat dry with paper towels. Add ginger garlic paste and lemon juice to hot pancetta oil and stir until fragrant. Add sugar and mix well. Add potatoes to the oil.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,steak,salmon fillet,coffee,rice,spinach,curry paste,new potato
title: Asian Beef-Potato Salad (Asian)
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh spinach | 1 small new potato, sliced into 1/2 inch wedges | 1 -2 cup chow mein noodles ( rice-stick noodles ) | 1 can salmon fillets, drained ( optional ) | 1 -2 cup brewed coffee ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons hot curry paste ( to taste, i like sambal oelek ) | steamed rice
instructions: Trim off the spinach leaves. Place in a bowl. Trim the ends of the potato wedges and slice into 1/2 inch thick wedges. Peel the spinach and slice into 1 inch lengths. In a large bowl, toss together the steak, spinach, potato, potato. Break in the chow mein noodles and toss until just coated with the dressing. Top with the salmon and garnish with the coffee, curry, or steamed rice. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk powder,steak,beef broth,port wine,vodka,spinach leaf
title: Cream of Beef Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen spinach leaves | 1 lb steak | 1 tablespoon beef broth | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 tablespoon coconut milk powder | 1/2 cup port wine or 1/2 cup other dry red wine
instructions: Place spinach in crock pot. Sprinkle with beef broth and cover with water. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or high for 3 - 4 hours. Do not stir or lift lid during cooking. About 20 minutes before serving, place vodka, coconut milk powder and port in a blender and process on high until slushy. Add the spinach and cook until just tender. Serve over rice or noodles. Note, i usually prepare a batch at a time and refrigerate the rest. You can add more water if need be. You can also do this in a dutch oven, and just make sure the steaks are sliced against the grain and not on the bone. You can do this in any pot used to cook the beef.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,tart apple,salt black pepper,chili powder
title: Bombay Apple Korma
ingredients: 6 tart apples, washed, peeled and sliced | salt and black pepper | 2/3 teaspoon chili powder | 2/3 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Toss the shredded apple slices in a mixing bowl. Stir in salt, pepper and chili powder. Mix well. Allow to stand for 20 to 30 minutes. Pour 1/3 cup water into a frying pan. Pour over the apple mixture. Allow to cook on medium flame for 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from flame. Serve hot with rotis or curries.

title: Spicy Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 -3 carrots, shredded | 4 cardamom pods, cracked and lightly crushed | 4 -6 tablespoons salsa, warmed
instructions: Lightly coat a medium baking dish with butter spray. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Spread in pan and bake in a 400f oven for 15 minutes. Garnish with additional salsa.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,oregano,cooking oil,dill,active yeast,black pepper,lebanese cucumber,chat masala
title: The Ultimate Gourmet's Focaccia
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons warm water | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 2 teaspoons snipped fresh dill or 2 teaspoons dried chives | 1 teaspoon low-sodium cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 small lebanese cucumber, sliced into half-moons | 2 medium anaheim chilies, thinly sliced
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in oregano, dill, oil, pepper and salt. Add cucumber, chilies and remaining ingredients. Spread on a greased pizza pan or baking sheet. Let rise about 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Preheat broiler. Cut into wedges and serve with toppings of your choice.

title: Kourimaki (Japanese Stock With Bonito)
ingredients: 200 ml stock | 1 small lime, juice of | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried bonito flakes ( katsuobushi or conchigiri )
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil. Add the lime juice, bonito and katsuobushi. Cook for about ½ minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,green bean,red chili,milk ricotta cheese,heavy cream
title: Creamy Ricotta and Green Green Beans Baked in Creamy Peppercorns and Chili Sauce
ingredients: 200 g green beans, cut into 3cm segments | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons milk ricotta cheese | 1 fresh red chili, finely sliced or 1 jalapeno, finely sliced | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons crushed black peppercorns
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Grease and flour a shallow 23cm ovenproof dish. Arrange the beans in a single layer in dish. Whisk the cream, milk and rind in a jug or bowl to blend. Pour over beans, season and toss to combine. Bake 35 - 40 minutes, until hot and bubbling. Serve warm with chili sauce and freshly grated cheddar over top. Salsa verde,. Place all ingredients in a medium saucepan, bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 - 20 minutes, until sauce has reduced and thickened slightly, stirring occasionally. Pour over hot baked beans.

title: French Sugar Snap Peas With Asparagus and Herbs
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs asparagus, trimmed | 2 teaspoons sugar snap peas or 2 teaspoons sugar pumpkin seeds | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory
instructions: Thoroughly wash the asparagus in cool water. Split each piece lengthwise in half and then in 1 1/2 inch pieces. Set the asparagus in a steamer basket over boiling water. Cover and steam about 8 minutes until tender. Transfer to a serving plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. Discard cooking water. Stir the snap peas into the cooked asparagus. Sprinkle the asparagus with the savory. Let stand about 5 minutes to heat through.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,turmeric powder,basil,flat leaf parsley
title: Tandoori Parsley and Basil Mix
ingredients: 2 bunches flat-leaf italian parsley | 3 bunches basil | 4 bunches flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Toss together italian flat herbs and parsley in a large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature to marinate, 8 hours to overnight. Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Coat 2 3/4 to 6 1/2 quart baking dishes with cooking spray. Remove stems from parsley, reserving 4 bunches for garnish. Transfer remaining sprigs of parsley to a large bowl. Pulse remaining parsley for 5 seconds in a food processor. Add parsley and basil and pulse until very coarsely chopped. Add parsley mixture, 1/2 cup basil, 1/2 cup parsley and all of remaining herbs.

title: Sausage and Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces pork sausage | 1/2 lb egg noodles | 1 tablespoon snipped chives | 7 cups water ( or more )
instructions: In a saucepan, cook sausage til brown. Drain, return to pan. Drain off fat. Stir in noodles and chives. Cover. Simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add water..

title: My Dad's Primavera
ingredients: 1 box penne or 2 cups rigatoni pasta | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions, drain. Set aside. In a medium saucepan over high heat, combine soup and sugar. Cook, stirring constantly until sugar dissolves and soup begins to bubble. Mix pasta with soup mixture and stir until heated through. Transfer to large serving bowl, and top with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,lemon pepper,wonton wrapper,dark soy sauce,white onion,cardamom seed,ramen noodle,mace
title: Wontons
ingredients: 7 ounces wonton wrappers | 24 -30 sheets nori ( dry seaweed sheets ) or 24 -30 sheets baby spinach leaves | 1 -2 small celery rib ( optional ) | 1/4 small white onion ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 2 -3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: On a cutting board lay out a few wonton wrappers. Place about a tablespoon of the vegetable mixture into the center of the wonton wrapper. Bring the two edges together, pinch the sides together and roll up tightly.

title: Cornflake Pie
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie crust | 1 cup corn flakes, coarsely ground
instructions: Heat oven to 400ºf. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Roll out one pie crust on a lightly floured surface. Spread corn flakes into the top crust. Roll out second crust and cut out 3 more circles from it. Put on baking sheet. Bake at 400ºf for about 10 minutes or until crust is lightly browned. Cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,tamarind paste,white wine vinegar,ginger juice,chinese cabbage
title: Gingered Chinese Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lime juice or 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 teaspoons ginger juice | 3 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup savoy cabbage, shredded
instructions: Mix lime juice, tamarind paste, ginger juice, vinegar, and white wine vinegar together to make smooth dressing. Add cabbage and stir fry until heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed | coarse salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Using a sharp knife, prepare 6 inch heavy duty aluminum foil pie plates or other ovenproof skillet that has been lined with parchment paper and has a lid or two inches larger than the pan. Lightly sprinkle beef with coarse salt, and set aside. Place skillet on oven rack and heat until just smoking. Turn beef slices into the hot skillet and brown on all sides over high heat. Transfer to a plate and cover loosely with foil. Continue cooking until all slices are browned, about 20 minutes. Transfer skillet to a rack set over a baking sheet lined with foil and let cool. When the beef are cooled, unwrap and place in a freezer bag. Seal bag and refrigerate until solid, at least 2 hours or up to 3 days.

title: Sweet-And-Sour Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups skim milk | 1/3 cup low-fat sweetened condensed milk | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar, to taste | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in a covered container. Refrigerate. Shake well before serving to prevent lumps.

Random Ingredients: honey,plum tomato,chicken thigh,pesto sauce,bean sprout,baby clam,rosemary sprig,chicken
title: Garlic Chicken With Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 500 g minced chicken | 4 chicken thighs, chopped | 1 cup baby clams | 1/2 cup canned plum tomatoes, drained | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary sprig | 4 basil sprigs, to serve ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked beans sprouts
instructions: Make up the pesto, and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight to infuse. Heat oven to 190°c. Line a shallow ovenproof dish with foil and spray with oil. Put chicken pieces and marinated chicken into dish, and bake for 30 minutes or until cooked. Remove from oven and turn chicken pieces. Return to oven and bake for 5 minutes more. Mix together the pesto and remaining ingredients. Gently stir through pesto mixture, and season. Spoon half of sauce into the chicken, sprinkle with basil leaves, and then serve with beans sprouts.

title: Green Beans With Beer
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Trim most of the stringy ends from the green beans. Cut the green beans into 1 inch lengths with a vegetable peeler. Place all ingredients except for the oil in a large frying pan or stove top dutch oven. Mix well, cover and cook over high heat for 5 minutes. Add the oil and stir fry for a minute or two or until heated through.. Ladle into shallow bowls or onto a platter covered with foil. Serve cold or warm.

title: Lime Slices with Peach
ingredients: 1/4 small cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 1/2 cup reduced-fat cream cheese, melted | 2 tablespoons finely chopped peeled ripe peaches | chopped fresh basil | lime wedge
instructions: Stir shredded cabbage, soy sauce, sugar, and chopped peaches together in large bowl to blend well. Toss with warm lemon juice in small bowl. Serve with basil leaves.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,chicken breast fillet,artichoke heart,thyme,bean sprout,kosher salt
title: Jook Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh ginger paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 lb chicken breast fillet, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 pint bean sprouts | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and halved
instructions: Stir ginger paste, thyme and salt. Add chicken, tossing to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 3 hours. Preheat oven to combine marinated artichokes with sprouts.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,lamb,sirloin tip roast,poultry seasoning,chicken breast tender,cocoa,chicken thigh
title: Easy Slow Cooker Rosemary, Swiss Steak and Sheep's Feet
ingredients: 1 boneless lamb, cut into 3 equal pieces | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken thighs, cut into 4 pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons powdered cocoa, divided | 3/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 2 1/2 teaspoons chopped rosemary leaves | 1/4 cup chopped roasted and peeled pork butt or 1/4 cup boneless beef tenderloin, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Place lamb, chicken, 1 1/2 teaspoons of the cocoa, poultry seasoning, rosemary, and the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons cocoa in large bowl. Toss to combine. Divide the mixture evenly among 4 - 5 crocks.

title: Fried Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons roasted peanuts, ground | 1 tablespoon vinaigrette
instructions: Add the peanuts to a food processor or blender. Pulse until finely minced. Transfer to a medium size bowl. Add the vinaigrette and stir until well blended. Serve. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,eggplant,self rising flour,tofu,crisco shortening,pork chop,brown lentil,bean
title: French Lentils and Baked Vegritters
ingredients: 2 eggplants | 400 g baked beans | 400 g tofu, cubed | 150 g self-rising flour | 350 g brown lentils | 50 g crisco shortening | 2 teaspoons tarragon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c or gas mark put the eggplant on to a baking tray with the baked beans and soak in preheated oven for 30 mins, until soft. Put the tofu and tofu in a large pan and stir in the flour and brown and lentils. Mix everything together well, turn onto to a floured surface and cut into strips. Stir the shortening into the lentils and bean mix then add to the pan in small batches. Bake for 45 mins until golden and cooked through. Serve with fresh crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: new potato,baking soda,green olive,cottage cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,calvados
title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 400 g tiny new potatoes, scrubbed | 4 tablespoons reduced fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons calvados | 1 teaspoon baking soda | vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 tablespoons green olives, sliced
instructions: Boil potatoes 15 - 20 min until tender. Cool, slice. Combine other ingredients and toss together. Add potatoes, stir and sprinkle with olives. Serve.

title: Jalapeño Pork Chops With Prawns and Jicama

instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the pork chops, garam masala, saffron, rice, anchovies, cilantro, vanilla, and jicama. Toss well to coat. Grill chops, brushing with any marinade, until just cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side.

title: Tasty Vegetarian French Vanilla Soup
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 2 cans vegetable broth
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large pot. Simmer on low for at least 8 - 15 more minutes.

title: Camarones
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Put the shrimp and refried beans in a bowl. Serve..

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,brown rice,caraway seed,chicken broth,pepper sauce,coconut extract,marmalade
title: Curried Rice "meatballs"
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low sodium chicken broth, divided | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice, not instant | 1 tablespoon ground caraway seed | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon dried marmalade
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup broth in small saucepan over medium high heat until boiling. Add rice, caraway seeds, hot sauce, bread crumbs, coconut extract, hot sauce and pepper sauce.

title: Roasted Tomato Onions With Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 -4 large firm ripe sun-dried tomatoes, cut into thin slices or 1/2 cup tomato, finely chopped | 2 1/2 1 1/2 cups vinegar or 2 1/2 cups red wine
instructions: Arrange tomatoes on an ungreased baking sheet with sides. Bake in 350f degree oven just past smoking point for about 35 minutes or until charred. Transfer to an open jar. If you prefer the onions more brown, drizzle with oil. Let cool. If you prefer to make the vinaigrette a day ahead, cover tightly and place in the refrigerator. Drain well. Place vinegar or wine in a frying pan. Heat gently, stirring often, until boiling and smooth. Do not brown. Remove from heat and add the chopped sun dried tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,brandy,sherry,caper,egg white,white vinegar,couscous,pumpkin pie spice
title: Lighter Baked Mexican Pumpkin Pie Spice Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups couscous | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 2/3 cup white vinegar | 2/3 cup dry sherry | 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 2 egg whites | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 teaspoon sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. To make couscous, in a covered bowl, combine couscous and taco seasoning. Stir in 2/3 cup vinegar, 1/3 cup sherry, pumpkin pie spice, capers, egg whites, brandy, and sherry. Pour into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, until lightly browned.

title: Pasta Al Cervezza (Pasta With Cauliflower and Carrots)
ingredients: 2 ounces elbow macaroni, uncooked | 1 - 1 1/4 lb cauliflower floret, broken into florets | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 -1 1/2 cup grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese, at room temperature
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, blanch cauliflower in boiling water 3 minutes, then drain. Combine pasta, cauliflower and thyme. Add cheese and toss to coat. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve.

Random Ingredients: olive,basil leaf,beef bouillon granule,asafoetida powder,basmati rice,sherry wine,milk ricotta cheese
title: Beef and Olive Croquettes (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 250 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup olive ( sliced ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 200 g basmati rice, cooked ( or any long grain rice ) | 4 -5 basil leaves | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf
instructions: Mix all the above ingredients together. Shape mixture into croquettes and set aside in fridge until solid. Cook rice using hot water to get rid of excess water. Place in a warm oven to slow down the water, keep an eye on the croquettes during cooking. Serve with fresh tomato sauce, marinara sauce or plain marinara sauce.

title: Moloto (Melt-Like-Cocoa)
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour, sifted | 1 cup dark chocolate-covered cocoa | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 1 serrano pepper or 1 jalapeno, chopped | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oven to 350°f. Combine the flour, cocoa, lime zest, pepper, onion and liquid smoke in a large bowl, and mix well. Transfer to a rimmed cake pan, and bake for 30 minutes, until the edges are golden. Cool for 5 minutes, and cut into thin strips. Place on a plate as soon as the strips are in the pan, and drizzle with chocolate.

title: Homemade Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 12 ounces chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over boiling water and stir until smooth. Stir in the parsley. Melt the chocolate in a clean kitchen towel to remove the excess water. Cool thoroughly and store, covered. This is not necessary, but you can use a coffee spoon or a fork to dip your fingers into melted chocolate.

title: Traditional French Bread (For French Frying)
ingredients: 3/4 cup cointreau liqueur | 4 large eggs | 2 teaspoons flour tortillas, cut into 8 wedges | 4 1/2 inch thick slices baguette
instructions: For fritters to do this in advance, lightly spray a very hot griddle with cooking spray. For french fries, in a bowl, with an electric mixer, beat together cointreau, eggs and flour until frothy and well combined. In a 12 frying pan, add a few tablespoons of oil to coat. Working in batches of 4, dip half of baguette wedges into batter and place onto griddle. Cook until golden and cooked to your liking. Remove from griddle and place on a serving plate with a slotted spoon. Repeat until all french fries are cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Beef Pot Pie With Ground Beef(ATK)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 lb beef chuck | 3 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 cup shredded cheddar, divided | 6 cups cubed cheddar flavored roast beef
instructions: Heat oven to 350ºf. Heat oil in heavy skillet over medium heat. Brown beef on all sides. Stir in broccoli, half the cheese and the roast beef. Transfer to 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Heat to boiling. Cover. Bake, stirring occasionally, about 45 minutes. Uncover. Bake 7 to 9 minutes or until meat is heated through and vegetables are tender.

title: Chinese Seasoned Nuts -- Fungus! -- Snails!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 5 cups cooking oil for frying | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, mix sesame oil and 5 cups of the oil. Stir in sesame oil until evenly coated. Let stand for 15 minutes at room temperature. Heat electric skillet or deep fryer to 375 degrees f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Pour remaining oil into pan, and heat over medium high heat, using a thermometer dipped in oil as a shield to stir often. When oil starts to smoke, remove from heat and place fungus in batches in hot oil. Cook until golden. Remove from excess oil with a slotted spoon and place on paper towel lined plates to drain.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,beef tenderloin,black olive,garlic,chicken stock cube
title: Beef Tenderloin With Black Olive Gravy
ingredients: 600 g beef tenderloin | 1/4 pint chicken stock cube | 1/4 pint light black olives | 1/3 cup garlic | 1 cup cheddar cheese
instructions: Cut the tenderloin into 1 inch thick slices. In a shallow glass dish, combine the stock cube and olives. Spread the olives over the tenderloin and mix together with the garlic. Cover dish with cling film and leave to marinate in the refrigerator overnight. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Bake meat for 2 1/2 hours or until cooked. Remove from the oven, leave for 20 minutes to absorb the juices. Turn the meat over and pour the marinade over. Return to oven and cook for a further 20 - 25 minutes. Add cheese and serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: half,sirloin,lime juice,vegetable summer squash onion green,breadcrumb,arborio rice
title: Lime-Garlic Beef Sirloin & Vegetable Roundup
ingredients: 6 ounces ground sirloin | 1/3 cup light breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup half-and-half, fat free is ok | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables ( summer squash, onion, green, and baby spinach ) | 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup carnarola rice, cooked
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add beef and stir until browned, about 5 to 7 minutes. Drain. Stir in crumbs until well blended. Pour half and half into skillet and bring to a simmer. Stir in 1/3 cup lime juice. Stir in rice. Heat through. Remove from heat. Spoon between paper towels. Sprinkle remaining lime juice on meat mixture. Serve with additional crumbs if desired.

title: Spinach and Nuts With Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon orange blossom water | 12 ounces mixed cremini mushrooms, sliced | 4 ounces fresh spinach, cleaned, stemmed and sliced | 18 ounces semi-sweet chocolate chips, divided | 1/4 cup walnuts, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine blossom water and mushrooms. Arrange spinach, 2 oz chocolate chips, and half the Nuts over a cookie sheet. Broil 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,red chili pepper,parmesan cheese,anchovy paste,each salt pepper,green cardamom pod
title: Spicy Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 green cardamom pod | 8 anchovy paste | 250 ml red chili peppers, destemmed and deseeded ( about 100 grams ) | 120 ml cornflour | 50 g parmesan cheese, grated ( or more ) | 150 ml extra-virgin olive oil | salt and pepper
instructions: Heat oven to 350f. Place cardamom pods on baking sheet, put in oven and roast until pods are very fragrant, about 4 - 5 minutes per side. Remove cardamom pods, reserving some on tray. Add anchovies to pan with chilies, and cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Strip the pods from the chilies, discard seeds, and finely chop. Combine cornflour, parmesan cheese and half the cardamom pods in a bowl. Add olive oil, 1 tablespoon at a time, while whisking well to incorporate. Add salt and pepper. Pour dressing into a bowl and add remainder of green cardamom pods, and toss. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese, and serve on small platter, allowing guests to add more in their own bowl and dressing.

title: Mexican Chocolate With Parsley & Hot Chocolate (Melt)
ingredients: 2 ounces mexican chocolate, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 tablespoon rocket, finely chopped
instructions: Put chocolate in small bowl & stir in a pinch of cayenne. Place rocket around edge of serving dish & stir well. Pour melted chocolate over rocket & sprinkle with a dash of cayenne. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,almond,red pepper flake,pesto sauce,gorgonzola,beef bouillon cube
title: Pesto Glazed Italian Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped pisto sauce | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons chopped celery ribs | 3 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the pesto sauce, pisto, bouillon, red pepper flakes, and celery. Cover, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat.

title: Lime-Powder Wontons
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers ( can use wonton wrappers or just plain wonton wrappers ) | 3 limes, juice of | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | chopped nuts, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine lime juice and lime juice in a small measuring cup. Dip wontons in juice, then moisten with lime juice mixture. Place on a baking sheet and lightly coat with lime juice/lime juice mixture. Sprinkle with desired garnish..

title: Baked Chicken Wings With Peach and Apple Jam Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tamari or 2 teaspoons soy sauce | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar ( i use organic ) or 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce ( i use organic ) | 1/2 lb brie cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 -4 lbs chicken wings ( i use frozen, defrosted, thawed ) | 2 tablespoons mirin ( optional ) | 1/2 lb red cabbage, thinly sliced | 12 medium fresh peaches, peeled, pitted, quartered and sliced in half ( or 12 medium raspberries ) | 1/4 cup roughly chopped fresh sage ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix tamari and vinegar in a wide paper nonreactive bowl with a whisk. Add brie and toss to coat. Place chicken in lightly oiled baking dish and arrange in an even layer. Bake until tender, 45 - 50 minutes, stirring once or twice. Cool completely, then slice into 1 1/2 inch thick pieces. Add cabbage and let it wilt. Meanwhile, place peaches in a medium size bowl. Add sage and mix. When chicken is about 10 minutes away from being done, spoon mustard from wine into a small bowl and mix. Add vinegar mustard to peach mixture. While shaking/shaving or shaking sauce, drizzle the brie and dressing over the chicken on the plated dish. Sprinkle with sage or serve on the side, with the peach salad.

Random Ingredients: white flour,paprika,caribbean jerk seasoning,chicken patty,brown sugar,cream cheese
title: Jerk Chicken Spread in a Jar
