ingredients: 4 chicken patties | 2 packages cream cheese | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 1/4 cup paprika | 2 tablespoons caribbean jerk seasoning | 2 cups white flour
instructions: Dip patties in cold water, place them in a glass dish, stir the lemon juice and sugar together in the glass. Add the spices. Cover, refrigerate overnight. Remove the patties from the fridge 45 - 60 minutes before serving. Toast the bread, spread some butter on one side of the toast. Spread the spread to the edge then top with your favorite dip. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red wine,raisin bread,orzo pasta,spanish onion,saltine cracker,caraway seed,jasmine rice,shell pasta
title: The Classic American Cappuccino
ingredients: 1 spanish onion, 1 inch dice | 10 thin slices raisin bread | 1 lb medium shell pasta ( bowtie rigati ) | 8 cups cold water | saltine crackers ( available either whole-grain, or multigrain, such as sara lee's ) or dried corn flakes ( available either whole-grain, or multigrain, such as sara lee's ) | 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( not ground or roasted ) | 2 cups uncooked jasmine rice ( arborio, avorio, or calamari, with their cooking liquid )
instructions: Combine onion, 1/2 cup water, and bread in large bowl.

title: Tommy's Easy Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 3 cans stewed tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add noodles.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,lebanese cucumber,salt black pepper,sea salt,white pepper,garlic,maraschino cherry
title: Lemon Garlic Pasta With Pressed Cucumbers
ingredients: 1/2 cup farfalle ( bow-tie ) pasta or 1/2 cup other flat-leaf pasta | 1/2 cup lebanese cucumber, cut into 1/4-inch dice | sea salt | fresh ground white pepper | 1 clove garlic, minced | salt and ground black pepper | dried maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: In a large pot of boiling lightly salted water, cook pasta for 12 to 15 minutes until al dente. Remove and set aside. Drain pasta and keep warm. Cook cucumber in a large skillet over high heat for 2 minutes, or until beginning to soften. Meanwhile, coat a baking sheet with cooking spray or mist olive oil. Spread a generous slice of pasta in center of tray and then a layer of cucumber slices. Sprinkle sea salt and white pepper on cucumber layer, garlic, salt, and pepper. Dollop lemon garlic over top of all and roll up pasta tightly, tucking sides in.

title: Homemade Mexican Cheese Sticks  (Using a fork!)
ingredients: 2 lbs of your favourite bread ( about 1 loaf, your favorite bread cut, bread, white wine, or something similar ) | 1 lb confectioners'sugar, sifted | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 lb chopped cooked ham | 1 can tomato paste
instructions: Cut a slit lengthwise in the top of the mozzarella, but not all of the way down to the bottom of the cheese, to stop it curling up. This will stop it from curling in the meat. Mix the meat, confectioners' sugar, and the taco seasoning until well blended. Line cookie sheets with wax paper and spread out the cheese mixture evenly in an even layer. Pile meat mixture onto the cheese, and cover with wax paper. Refrigerate 3 hours. Drain mozzarella, and place on the meat mixture, pressing to dry slightly. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Drain ham, and slice across the grain into ½ to ½ inch slices. Roll meat in tomato paste, and then into cumin. Serve with crackers for dipping.

title: Spinach 'n' Macaroni Dinner
ingredients: 2 packages yeast | 1 1/2 tablespoons margarine | 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained, squeezing liquid out of can, excess water reserved | 2 1/4 cups macaroni, uncooked | 1 cup celery, chopped | 1 cup sweet italian sausage, removed from casings
instructions: Dissolve yeast packages in 1 to 1 1/2 cups warm water. Melt margarine in a 6 quart dutch oven over medium high heat. Add spinach and heat until water evaporates and spinach begins to steam, about 2 minutes. Add macaroni, celery and sausage. Dissolve yeast packages in water mixture, about 2 minutes. Add all at once to dutch oven. Cover and cook 90 minutes, mashing with a potato masher or wooden spoon for about 10 minutes. Remove and heat oven to 350°f. Serve warm.

title: Tunisian-Style Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 4 chicken breast fillets | 1 cup water
instructions: Heat grill to medium high. Place cumin seeds in a small shallow glass dish, and toast in the preheated oven 5 minutes, until fragrant. Remove husk and rub off the blackened skin around the chicken, then rub the chicken with the cumin seeds until coated. Arrange the chicken on the grill pan skin side down. Cook chicken for 15 minutes. Turn the chicken over, and cook until the chicken is browned, about 10 minutes more. Reduce grill heat to medium, and place chicken on a serving platter. To serve, cut chicken into strips, and serve with rice, lettuce, tomato and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: oil,turkey,curry paste,chipotle pepper,spinach leaf,cherry tomato,sesame oil
title: Spinach With Turkey and Chipotle
ingredients: 2 lbs spinach leaves, washed, stemmed, and chopped | 4 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup curry paste | 2 chipotle peppers ( seeded and roughly chopped ) | 1 lb ground turkey | 9 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 3 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat. Sautee curry paste and chipotle peppers until fragrant, about 3 minutes. Add ground turkey and saute until no longer pink, 8 - 10 minutes. Add tomatoes and spinach and simmer until almost all liquid is evaporated. Drain mixture well and season to taste with sesame oil. Transfer to plate and garnish with sliced cherry tomatoes.

title: Onion Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 cup onion, finely chopped | 1 can fat-free refried beans ( with liquid ) | 1/2 cup skim milk
instructions: Heat up the refried beans until warmed up, then add 1/2 cup of the onion, and mash with a fork. Add 1/2 cup of the onion, the milk, and all of the other ingredients.

Random Ingredients: apricot,taco seasoning mix,carrot,brown rice,tart apple,baby spinach
title: Wet Fried Apple Rice
ingredients: 3 bags baby spinach | 8 -10 large tart apples ( depending on size and preferences ) | 4 carrots | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix ( or to taste ) | apricots ( optional ) or fresh fruit ( optional ) | brown rice, of choice ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and pat sautee greens dry, in a fry pan on medium/medium high heat, add taco seasoning and apple. Cook until both apples are starting to fall of their kernels. Remove from heat and sprinkle on desired amount of brown rice. Place greens on top of apples and spoon mixture over greens in pan and serve. For your vegan option omit the paprika and the fruit.

title: El Suero
ingredients: 4 ounces dark rum ( preferably havana club club ) | 1/2 ounce salsa
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a blender with ice and blend until smooth. Pour into a cocktail glass and serve.

title: Smoked Tilapia
ingredients: 1 poblano chile | 4 tilapia fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Cut the poblano pepper in half, remove the core, and remove the seeds. Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. Place the poblano pepper in the skillet and grill for 10 minutes, or until blackened. Remove the poblano pepper from the skillet and chop finely. Heat the olive oil in a separate skillet over low heat. Place the tilapia fillets in the skillet and brown on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,pork roast,apple juice,cumin seed,chuck,bread crumb,basmati rice
title: Basmati Rice With Pork and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck, trimmed | 1/4 cup unseasoned dry bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/3 cup chopped sun-dried tomato | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed dried basil | 8 ounces boneless lean pork roast, trimmed of fat | 1/3 cup apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cut chuck into 1/4 inch cubes. Coat meat with bread crumbs, cumin seeds, sun dried tomatoes and basil. Place meat in a lightly oiled 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Cover and bake at 325 degrees f for 5 hours or until meat is tender. Remove from oven. Drain meat and place on a platter. Cover with foil and keep warm. Skim fat from pan juices. Mix juices with pork and cook and stir over medium heat until pork is browned and juices are thin, about 10 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,irish cream,ra el hanout spice mix,saffron strand,nut,catsup,vegetarian bean
title: Smoky Saffron Beans & Mash
ingredients: 1/2 cup bomba vegetarian baked beans or 1/2 cup vegetarian baked beans | 3 tablespoons baqoon saffron strands | 1 tablespoon morroccam mixed nuts | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 tablespoon irish cream | 1/2 tablespoon saffron strand | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Soak saffron on kitchen towel. Combine, beans & raisins, spread on a foil lined baking tray & bake at 225°c for 20 minutes. Combine the rest of the ingredients and spread on top of the baked beans & raisins. Bake and stir until hot & starting to crisp up.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,thai chili sauce,white sesame seed,hard egg,tortilla chip
title: Thai Pepper & Egg Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( basmati or jasmine, not basmati ) | 1 teaspoon thai sweet chili sauce | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 3 tortilla chips, broken into 2 pieces each | 1 teaspoon white sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Place the rice, chili sauce and egg in a microwave safe bowl and cook on high, uncovered, until rice is tender, about 3 minutes. Stir the noodles, then transfer to a serving dish. Sprinkle each serving with 1 teaspoon of toasted sesame seeds.

title: Real Refried Beans (Tortilla De Frijoles)
ingredients: 3 lbs pinto beans | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs hard-boiled eggs | 5 lbs raw potatoes, peeled
instructions: Place beans in pot, cover with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 hours or until beans are tender, then add potatoes and return to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 - 30 minutes longer, or until potatoes are cooked through and beans are hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,asparagus,chipotle powder,deli roast beef,halibut fillet
title: Grill-Roasted Beef and Asparagus
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice and zest | 3/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon shaved fat-free ham or 1 tablespoon reduced fat deli ham | 3 1/2 ounces shaved fat-free rotisserie steak fillets | 12 spears fresh asparagus, trimmed
instructions: In a shallow dish, stir the lemon zest, chipotle powder and lemon juice. Stir in the ham, pressing into the zest. Trim the asparagus spears.

title: Indian Cheese Salad
ingredients: 3 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 6 ounces shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup finely chopped brown onion | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: In bowl combine cheese, lettuce, onion, mustard seed and salt. Stir. Place in refrigerator till cheese is melted.

title: Peeled Beetroot (Swiss Style)
ingredients: 12 medium beets | 1/2 cup shelled pistachio, lightly toasted
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f and place beets in a 3 1/2 quart baking dish, be careful of burning. Bake until tender, about 45 minutes. Let cool slightly.

title: Homemade Scented Baking Powder
ingredients: 1/2 small dried fruit | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the chilli, nutmeg, and salt. Combine the ingredients and mix well. Allow the mixture to sit out at room temperature for a few hours to absorb the flavours. Store in an airtight container.

title: Besciamella Saffron Halva
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pinch saffron | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1/4 cup pistachios, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a large microwave safe bowl, combine saffron and cream. Microwave on high for about a minute then stir until very hot and dissolved. Add garlic and stir for one minute. Stir in pistachios. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. Spread saffron mixture evenly into dish. Bake for 20 minutes. Cool completely and remove foil. Cut halva into squares. Serve with pita bread or pita chips.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,asafoetida powder,bell pepper,chocolate baking square
title: Asafetida-Roasted Bell Pepper
ingredients: 3 plum tomatoes, halved lengthwise | 1/8 bell pepper, red, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | sweet and sour chocolate baking squares, for rolling
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil. In a large bowl, toss tomatoes with asafetida and pepper. Roast in the oven until vegetables begin to blacken in the centers about 25 minutes. Meanwhile, line baking sheet with waxed paper or parchment paper. Place bell pepper and tomato halves on baking sheet and roasted vegetables in separate foil baking pans. Pour hot water over vegetables. Let stand 5 minutes, then drain vegetables on paper towels. Season with salt and pepper once roasted to taste. Garnish with chocolate sprinkles.

Random Ingredients: apple,prosciutto,asafoetida powder,vegetarian bean,thai fish sauce,cremini mushroom
title: Beans and Lemons Sauteed in Apple Prosciutto
ingredients: 3 cups vegetarian baked beans or 3 cups baked beans | 4 ounces crumbled prosciutto or 4 ounces cooked ham | 1 tablespoon asian fish sauce | 1 dash asafoetida powder | 1 small apple, chopped | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, chopped
instructions: Preheat your broiler to high. Put the baked beans in a large mixing bowl and add the prosciutto, fish sauce, asafoetida, and apples. Stir to combine. Cook the vegetables, stir frequently, until they are crisp and starting to brown, about 3 minutes. Add the mushrooms and continue to stir. Serve at once.

title: Wasabi Marinated Chicken
ingredients: 750 g dark raisins | 1 teaspoon wasabi | 1 tablespoon rosemary leaf | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Take out of fridge about 15 to 30 minutes before serving. Baste with marinade.

Random Ingredients: tomato basil oregano garlic,fingerling potato,ranch dressing,stir fry vegetable,cotija cheese
title: Stir Fry Fingerling Potatoes
ingredients: 1 package frozen fingerling potatoes | 2 tablespoons ranch dressing ( can use homemade or your own homemade brand ) | 3 tablespoons cotija cheese, shredded ( can use mild cheddar, or monterey jack ) | 2 tablespoons fresh tomato basil oregano and garlic, minced | 2 -3 cups fried stir-fry vegetables
instructions: If using fresh garlic, peel and roughly chop the garlic. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the fingerling potatoes and cook uncovered until tender, about 15 - 20 minutes. Drain and transfer potatoes to a serving bowl. Add the ranch dressing and cotija cheese and toss with a kitchen shears or fork til the cheese has melted and the ingredients are combined. Taste and adjust the seasonings, if desired. Serve over your favorite fettuccine pasta, or fresh, grilled veggies.

title: Quick Beef and Turnip Samosas
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes | 2 lbs turnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/2 lb unsalted butter, cubed | vegetable shortening ( or oil ) | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1/2 teaspoon yeast | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup light cream | 12 sheets puff pastry
instructions: Combine beef, turnips, and butter in a medium bowl. Heat shortening in a large saucepan or dutch oven over medium high heat. Add beef mixture to hot shortening.

title: Thai Beef
ingredients: 300 g skirt steak | 3 tablespoons thai chili paste
instructions: Combine thai chili paste and beef in a plastic bag and press firmly into the surface of the meat. Refrigerate for about 24 hours. Barbecue over hot coals or under a preheated grill until well browned, about 3 - 5 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: red wine,double cream,dark soy sauce,pork shoulder
title: Chinese Style Pulled Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup sweet red wine | 150 -300 ml double cream
instructions: Trim any excess external fat from the pork butt. The meat should be cut into about 20 pieces. Place meat in a large plastic bag. In it, mix together the dark soy sauce, sweet red wine, and beef stock. Lay the bag in the freezer to thaw any excess moisture. Slice the pork into about 4 to 8 pieces each, removing as much fat as possible from the meat, then place in the freezer until solid, about 6 hours. If cooking in a crockpot, follow the manufacturer's instructions to cook the meat in the slow cooker. You may not need to drain all of the accumulated juice. Pour the meat mixture into a large glass or ceramic cooking bowl with a lid. If freezing in a crockpot, place in the crockpot and cook on high for about 4 hours. At the time of serving, remove the lid or the lid of the crockpot and increase the temperature to high. Add in a cup of cream and gently stir to combine. Serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,manicotti shell,molasses,mexican cheese,broccoli,teriyaki sauce,tomato green chile pepper,milo
title: Molasses Calzones
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chile peppers | 1 can meyerdoba ( brown sugar twin ), drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 teaspoon teriyaki sauce | 1 package frozen broccoli, chopped | 1 package frozen piza original mexican cheese blend | 1 unbaked prepared calzones or regular crust pizza crust | 1 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese in a bowl until well blended. Mix in half of processed cheese with a fork, mixing until all the cheese is melted and mixed in well. Spread 1/3 of the sauce into the bottom of a pizza pan. Spoon half of the broccoli on top, and spread evenly, leaving about 1/4 uncovered. Spread half of the cheese blend on top. Spoon half of the tomato over the broccoli, then top with remaining broccoli and spread evenly with a fork. Spread rest of the cheese blend on top, and add remaining tomatoes. Arrange calzones on top of pizza. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and let cool for 2 minutes. Use plastic wrap to wrap around edges of dish, and invert onto a serving platter. Serve calzones with toppings if desired. For vegetarian use vegetable juice in place of molasses.

Random Ingredients: thyme,kaffir lime leaf,beef stew meat,tahini,taco seasoning mix,crabmeat,mustard seed
title: Shrimp Taco Feast
ingredients: 2 pounds medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, tail removed | 2 pounds beef stew meat | 1/4 cup prepared mustard seed | 4 fresh kaffir lime leaves, torn into pieces | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 cup tahini | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp. Place all in a large crock pot. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 hours. Toss shrimp, beef and taco seasoning mix with 1 cup tahini and thyme. Serve on hard shell tacos or plain crackers.

title: Pork With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork ( i use a combo of pork and chicken breasts ) | ice cube | 1/4 cup apricot nectar | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped ( with tops ) | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 1/4 cup dried currant, lightly crushed
instructions: Rub the inside of a glass pan with the cubes of pork. Set aside the chicken breasts, chop off all of the dark meat and reserve for later. Dice up the meat. Combine the ingredients, except the reserved pork and cover for one hour.. Strain the glaze, then serve the meat over the marinade with plenty of salad greens, crusty french bread, and fresh seasonal vegetables. Note, the yield is based on two people using one chicken breast, one slice of pork, and one fruit and vegetable. Adjust the amount of fruit and vegetable you use. Note, if not using all of the glaze, you may want to add 1/3 cup of flour.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,horseradish,pecorino romano cheese,cucumber,beet,beef broth,italian seasoning,mirin
title: Beef, Cucumber, and Beet Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs beet ( beets, peeled and cubed ) | 1/2 small cucumber ( unpeeled ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons grated fresh pecorino romano cheese or 2 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/4 cups beef broth, divided | 2 teaspoons mirin
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine the beets, cucumber, soup, horseradish, seasoning, and cheese, and cook, stirring often, 5 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are just tender. In a blender or food processor, puree 1/2 cup of the soup mixture with 2 cups of the beef broth until smooth.. Return soup mixture to skillet and warm through. Add the remaining broth and mirin. Cover and remove from the heat. Let cool slightly, then refrigerate the soup for up to 2 days.

title: Hot Pickled Dried Onions
ingredients: 6 -8 large very sweet fresh onions | juniper berries
instructions: Cut off ends from onions. If they are large enough, cut in half to make about 6 per onion. Rinse them well. Place onions in a large glass jar, and sprinkle with a little bit of juniper or other dried spices. Cover, and let sit at room temperature for about 6 - 8 days before using.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,sesame oil,chicken breast half,chili powder,greek yogurt,cumin powder,lobster tail,pine nut
title: Lobster Tagine
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast half ( about 3 ) | 2 slices thick-cut stale bread | 16 ounces lobster tails | 2 cups fat free greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds ( optional ) or 2 teaspoons pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread in half widthwise and spread evenly. Slice cooked meat into 1/4 wide strips, and arrange meat and chunks over bread. Cut lobster tails into 2 wide chunks and place on top. Mix yogurt, sesame oil, chili powder, cumin, and poppy seeds or pine nuts. Drench the meat into the yogurt mixture and add it to the pan or tagine. Turn to coat well with yogurt mixture. Cover and cook 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, then uncover and cook an additional 30 minutes until cheese has melted.

title: Quick Pasta With Fruit  (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 package small shell pasta ( we prefer ditalini ) | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1/2 cup chopped dried fruit | 1/2 cup chopped fresh fruit or 1/2 cup canned mixed fruit | 0.5 can fat-free liquid smoke | 1 -2 teaspoon accent seasoning
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions till al dente. Rinse with cold water, drain, and set aside. Melt margarine and liquid smoke in frying pan. Add diced, fresh fruit. Stir in cooked pasta, and add accent and liquid smoke. Garnish with parmesan cheese, if desired.

title: Easy Sesame Oil Dressing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: In a blender, add the sesame oil, italian parsley and blend well. Yields 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons for each cup of veg. Use as a salad dressing or with other salad or with meats.

title: Cocktail in a Pond
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cucumbers, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons iceberg lettuce or 2 tablespoons other salad greens
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Enjoy.

title: Peach 'n' Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can peach slices | 1/4 cup bean sauce, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the cream of chicken soup, peach slices, and bean sauce together in a shallow baking dish with a lid. Bake in the preheated oven for at least 20 minutes.

title: Lamb in Coconut
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb, cut into 3/4-inch chunks | 2 ounces bacon | 7 fluid ounces coconut milk
instructions: Remove fat from bacon and cut into 3/4 strips, about the width of a dinner plate. Dice lamb pieces into 3/4 chunks. Wrap in bacon pieces, and fry in a thick bottomed frying pan over moderate heat until well browned all over. Add coconut milk to the pan and simmer briskly for 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,pinto bean,peanut oil,parsnip,ancho chile powder,half,cumin powder,savory
title: Ancho Pintos (Baked Nuts)
ingredients: 3 lbs parsnips, peeled | 3 cups peanut oil | 3 cups yogurt | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 5 tablespoons fresh savory, chopped | 1/4 cup half-and-half, mixed with | 1/8 cup chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts, toasted
instructions: Quarter the parsnips lengthwise and slice lengthwise into very thin slices. Place the parsnips and 3/4 cup of the water in a deep saucepan, cover and bring to a boil. Boil for exactly 8 minutes. Drain and rinse. In a medium bowl, mix the mustard and spices and set aside to make a dressing. In another bowl, add the yogurt, chile powder, cummin and half and half. Mix well so there is no lumps. Dredge the sliced parsnips with the mustard and spices, then dip the coated noodles in the yogurt mixture and let sit for 10 minutes at room temperature. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place the peanuts on a baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes, turning after 5 - 10 minutes. Serve the noodles hot with the mustard dressing.

title: Homemade Phyllo Pasta Sauce for Pasta and Cheese(Lebanese)
ingredients: 20 cloves | parsley
instructions: To prepare, grind your clove with a mortar and pestle or spice grinder until fine. Add 2 t. Water to ground mixture to make a paste. Add salt to desired consistency, although if not salty enough, add 3 cups of water for desired consistency. Boil 3 quarts of water with a pinch of salt.

title: Chilli Pissaladiere
ingredients: 1/2 shortcrust pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup thawed frozen crescent dinner rolls | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios | 1/2 teaspoon red chile pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Press the crescent roll dough out onto a nonstick baking sheet. Sprinkle with pistachios and chopped chili. Bake for 30 minutes, or until golden.

title: Piquant Basting Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
instructions: In a small heavy saucepan, stir all ingredients together. Bring to a rolling boil over moderate heat, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to low, but do not allow to boil. When the mixture is thickened, pour into a jar or bottle and store in a cool, dark place. The oil will keep for a few weeks and improve on standing.

title: Chinese Fried Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 2 eggs, beaten
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shape into 2 inch meatballs. Heat 1/2 inch oil in skillet, fry. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock powder,beef stock,wonton wrapper,cremini mushroom,farfalle pasta,mexican oregano,turnip
title: Quick and Easy Beef and Veggie Raviolis(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 12 corn-flour wonton wrappers | 2 cups chicken stock powder | 1 lb ground round | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 1 cup beef stock | 1 small turnip, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, thinly sliced | 1 box farfalle pasta
instructions: In a saucepan, add chicken stock powder, dried oregano, beef stock, carrot and turnip. Heat, bring to a boil. Add farfalle pasta and cook until al dente. While pasta is cooking, coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Lay out a won ton wrapper and spoon approx 1/4 cup of filling onto the center of each won ton wrapper. Place a second won ton wrapper on top of that and press lightly to seal. Cook in a skillet over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until golden brown and the won tons are cooked through.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,lime wedge,flat leaf parsley
title: Fiery Lime Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons minced fresh flat-leaf parsley | lime wedge
instructions: Place mustard seeds in a small skillet over medium high heat. Allow to crackle and pop. Cook seeds, shaking the skillet occasionally just until seeds are dark brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Spread mustard seeds on a large plate to cool to room temperature. Grind parsley in a mortar with a pestle or a spice mill about 1 minute. Stir in mustard seeds and parsley, and stir in lime wedges. Use immediately to dip warm or cold fish, such as chicken or shrimp.

title: Salsa-Pepper Bananas With Corn Flour
ingredients: 3 large ripe bananas | 1 medium onion ( chopped ) | 2 -3 tablespoons cornflour | 3 -5 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Use a food processor or blender to pulverize bananas and onion. Pour mixture onto a lrg bowl with the cornflour, chili flakes, & baking soda. Mix quickly, it will be too thick & it will bubble up. Place mixture onto a parchment lined baking sheet, cook at 200c for 10 - 15 mins or till the mixture is firm & golden. Slice bananas & serve.

title: Roast Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried white beans, such as navy, navy, or red kidney beans | 2 lbs fresh roast fat, cut into small cubes | 1 tablespoon crushed saffron threads | 2 tablespoons salt | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Sort beans. Rinse beans quickly, then place in dutch oven.

title: Beer and Chilli Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 1/2 cup beer ( i use budweiser ) | 1 bay leaf | cornmeal, for dusting | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 1/2 cup teaposteen beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place salmon on shallow ovenproof dish, and spray salmon with oil. Combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to the boil. Pour over salmon and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked through. Serve with rice and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,pickling salt,olive oil,vanilla pudding,russet potato,grenadine,hungarian paprika,onion powder
title: Spanish Potatoes, Red Bell Peppers, and Sweet Onions
ingredients: 2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled | 1 1/2 tablespoons pickling salt | 8 small red bell peppers, sliced and roasted until blackened on all sides, about 30 minutes and drained | 3 tablespoons light olive oil, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1/4 cup grenadine | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla flavored instant pudding
instructions: Cook potatoes in a large pot of boiling water to cover until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, and cool to room temperature. Cut in 1/2 inch cubes. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Drop in potatoes and bring back to a boil. Cook until tender, 10 to 20 minutes. Drain. Pat cool potatoes with paper towels and set aside. Reserve water in pot. Place roasted red bell peppers in a large mixing bowl. Drizzle 1 tablespoon olive oil over the peppers and toss. Add the rest of the ingredients, and mix thoroughly. Serve chilled.

title: Lobster and Fettuccine
ingredients: 250 g fettuccine pasta | 425 g sliced cooked lobsters | 1 cup cubed dried apricots | 1 cup chopped dates | 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon mild cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 banana, sliced
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet directions while adding rest of ingredients except for bananas.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,bay leaf,yellow onion,baking powder,dijon mustard
title: Homemade Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 tablespoons yellow onions, finely chopped | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: In a heavy, ovenproof casserole, mix onion, bay leaf, baking powder and diced tomatoes with green chilies. Cook over high heat, stirring often, until mixture boils. Continue stirring until mixture is slightly reduced. Stir in mustard and continue cooking until thickened, about 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Blackberry, Roasted Squash and Madeira Jam -Madeira
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/2 cup madeira wine, plus | 1 teaspoon madeira wine | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup dried blackberries | 1 yellow squash, peeled, trimmed, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Melt the ghee in an oven proof pot over medium high heat. Once warm, add the madeira and stir until the wine evaporates and the madeira begins to smell fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir in the baking soda, blackberries and squash. Cover the pot and let sit in the cold oven, stirring occasionally, for about 30 minutes. When the squash is tender and the blackberries are soft, give it about 5 minutes. Remove the pot from the oven and let sit for about 10 - 15 minutes to absorb the flavors. Serve hot or warm.

title: Green Onion Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package of white cheese, shredded | 1 bunch green onion, chopped | 1 shallots, chopped
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and put into casserole dish. Sprinkle with more green onions before baking.

title: Chermoula
ingredients: 2 cups watermelon, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, plus more to taste
instructions: Arrange watermelon slices on a shallow serving dish. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper. Refrigerate for several hours to develop the flavors.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,pineapple chunk,sesame seed,pork loin chop,mango chutney,strawberry
title: Sweet and Savory Pork Chop Loins
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/3 cup dry mango chutney | 1/2 cup unsulfured pineapple chunk | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 1 cup fresh strawberries, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Remove pork chops from package, reserve marinade. Trim excess fat from meat, discard bone. Arrange pork chops in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, mix together bouillon cubes and mango chutney until blended, stir to combine. Pour over pork chops, then dot with sesame seeds. Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, or to a minimum internal temperature of 145 degrees f. Remove pork chops to serving platter, spoon pan drippings over pork, and top pork with strawberry halves.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Pear Puree
ingredients: 2 lbs pears, ripe, whole ( any firm pear will do fine ) | 8 ounces cilantro roots, minced
instructions: Put the pears and cilantro roots in a large bowl of water to cover them by 2 inches. Let sit for 20 minutes, then drain them and pat them dry. Put the pears in another large bowl of water and let them sit for 15 minutes. Then drain them and pat them dry. Put them in a clean bowl and add the minced cilantro roots. Place bowl in the refrigerator and chill for at least an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,hard egg,italian salad dressing mix,kielbasa,cremini mushroom,parsley leaf
title: Polish Sausage  (Kielbasa or Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1 bag baby cremini mushrooms | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice, undrained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 package kielbasa ( or your favorite sausage ) | 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 8 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
instructions: Remove sausage casings from casings and rinse in cold water. Drain. Combine remaining ingredients except eggs in a crock or nonstick skillet. Cover and cook until sausage is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer sausage to a plate. Reduce remaining mixture to one half of the original consistency. Toss sausage with sausage. Cover.

title: Grilled Sandwiches, and Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 1 pound hamburger | 1 pound shredded deli roast beef | 1 can guacamole, or as needed
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate. Place the hamburger and roast beef in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir until evenly browned. Drain excess grease, and add the guacamole. Cook and stir until warmed through. Remove from heat. Allow to cool for about 5 minutes, then slice into 1/4 inch thick sandwiches. Serve.

title: Smoky Black Beans
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces black beans, rinsed and drained | 10 5/8 fluid ounces worcestershire sauce | 1/4 tablespoon savory | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1/4 tablespoon dry minced onion or 1/4 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Add all ingredients and stir well. Cover and cook on low 6 - 7 hours, stirring occasionally.

title: Corn Sweet & Sour Corned Beef
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs corn on the cob ( fresh, frozen, or canned ) | 4 -5 lbs chicken, whole | 2 bay leaves | 2 cups light corn syrup
instructions: Place corn on oven tray. Bake for 1/2 hours at 325°f mix 2 cups of the corn syrup with 3/4 cup boiling water to make a sauce. Set aside. Remove brisket from oven. Place brisket in roasting pan. Add 1/2 cup of sauce. Add 2 bay leaves. Cover with foil. Add remaining 3/4 cup of corn syrup mixture. Bring to a boil. Turn heat to lowest setting. Place brisket in oven and bake for approximately 4 - 5 hours. The cooking time will vary depending on the size of the brisket and the temperature of the corn. Turn the brisket and remove bay leaves. Cut against the grain and serve.

title: Sarale's Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage, chopped | 1 poblano chile, chopped | 1/2 cup green chilies, chopped | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons pignolis pesto ( or other flavor ) | 2 large cucumbers, diced | anchovy ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Taste and add more/ less pith/seasonings to your liking. It should not overpower any of the vegetables.

title: Award-Winning Apple Stuffing
ingredients: 1 large tart apple, quartered | 1 package taco seasoning, or more to taste | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 pinch dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a small baking sheet. Place the apple pieces into the baking sheet, and poke a few holes in the top with a fork. Pour the taco seasoning into a small bowl. Mix the cheese and sage together in a little bowl. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture into the hole in each apple. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese has melted, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,anaheim chili,ancho chile powder,vermouth,red chile powder,mango chutney
title: Churros
ingredients: 8 medium soft tortillas | 5 -6 ounces vermouth ( i use spanish for this, but any brand will do ) | 1 cup mashed ripe mango chutney | 1 cup roasted anaheim chili ( or green chutney, can also use chilies ) | 1 tablespoon crushed red chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder
instructions: Heat your grill or gas grill and lightly oil the grate. Wrap your tortillas tightly with foil, place on the hot grill and let unwrap for 10 minutes. Carefully remove the tortillas from the grill and spread them out flat on a clean, dry towel. Spread the vermouth over the tortillas and gently roll up. Wrap snugly in the towels and then set aside for 20 minutes. For a breakfast sauce add mango chutney, anaheim chili, chile powder, and ancho chile to the vermouth and stir gently. Place the tortillas on the grill, close the lid, and grill 10 minutes, flipping over 2 or 3 times. Serve as an appetizer with your favorite salad or on it's own with your favorite sides.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,natural peanut butter,vanilla,leg lamb,monterey jack cheese,mustard
title: Peanut Butter Roasted Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 3 lbs of bone with skin | mustard or prepared mustard | mustard powder | 1 kg whole leg of lamb, with bone | butter or margarine, for greasing | 1 cup of natural-style peanut butter | 3/4 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. Sprinkle the meat with mustard powder. Put your leg of lamb in a roasting pan that is greased with the olive oil and butter. Sprinkle a layer of mustard on top. Cover loosely with foil and roast for 15 minutes. After 15 minutes, turn the lamb and roast for 2 hours. Turn off the oven and leave the roasting pan on your stove. Take the beef out on kitchen counter about 45 minutes before you want to serve. To get the broth going you will need 1 cup of broth and a 2 cups of water in a saucepan, and bring to boil. Place a sheet of aluminum foil on the stove and put your steamer in it. Preheat your oven to 450 degrees. Once the beef is removed, put it in a roaster. You will also need to brush some melted butter onto the lamb so the crust doesn't stick. Pour the broth in a nice roaster with the meat side of the leg of lamb. Add more mustard, some more salt and mustard powder a little bit by little stirring the broth until your desired taste is achieved and adding more mustard if desired. Once in a while add the peanut butter in small increments until the peanut is not creamy anymore. It is all right if it is very creamy. Slice on a bias and serve with rice. The meat and the rice will be amazing. Remember, these measurements make this a very moist meal. I usually make the rice as is, then add a small amount of the peanut butter mixture into the hot broth, stir that in at the end and serve in the center of the meat. You can also serve these in the traditional gravy boat with potatoes or as a gravy on the side. You can also make gravy by simply adding a bit of the peanut butter sauce into the broth, stir that in, cover with a piece of foil and keep in your crock pot. Cook on low until meat is cooked and tender. This is about 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: squash,feta cheese,french baguette,half,red pepper flake,milk,anise seed,ketjap manis
title: Greek Grilled Veggie Panini
ingredients: 2 large french baguettes, cut lengthwise in half lengthwise | 1 cup feta cheese | 1/2 cup sour milk or 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 4 teaspoons ketchup or 4 teaspoons tamari | 2 teaspoons kakikoman anise seeds | 1 dash red pepper flakes
instructions: Split garlic. Using hands, rub 1/2 cup of cheese and anise seeds to one side of each baguette half. Spread on mustard side of each half. Grill until golden brown. Remove to a plate to cool. In a serving bowl, combine remaining cheese ingredients. Mix with a fork. Slice grilled veggies in half lengthwise. Top with cheese mixture. Spoon dressing onto a serving plate and top with a piece of grilled cheese that has been lightly sprinkled with some additional anise oil. Serve with bread and vegetables.

title: Avocado Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons water | 1 avocado, peeled, seeded and diced
instructions: In a small bowl combine water and avocado together. Serve immediately or refrigerate until serving.

title: Portuguese Lobster
ingredients: 1/2 lb lobster meat | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 teaspoon portuguese-style sausage casing ( spanish brand ) | 4 tablespoons picante sauce | 1 1/2 cups fish stock
instructions: Cut the tail in half and, with kitchen shears or sharp knife, split each tail to expose the meat shell on the inside. Using small forks, cut a thin slice from the base of the shell into the shell. Place meat in the shell and set aside. Mix the capers and sausage together in a small bowl. Coat the meat evenly with spanish picante sauce. Set aside. Carefully pour fish stock into shell. Stuff in the cavities. In the portuguese style sausage or mackerel, tie the underside of the tail securely with a twist or tie with twine. Place on a medium barbecue or grill and grill over direct medium heat for about 10 minutes.

title: Macaroni and Pepper Casserole
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 1 can whole yellow bell peppers | 1 package pita bread rounds, cut into triangles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, place oven rack in center of oven. Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite. Drain. Place macaroni in a large mixing bowl. Set aside in oven. Place a bell pepper into a microwave safe bowl, and cook on high, approximately 2 minutes, or until tender. Spread a generous layer of macaroni on the bottom of the prepared baking dish in an even layer. Top with a layer of bell pepper. Place a sprinkling of pita triangles over the bell pepper layer, making sure they stick to the pasta. Repeat with remaining ingredients in the dish. Bake in the preheated oven until thoroughly heated and cheese is melted, approximately 15 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,cheddar cheese soup,basil pesto,cake flour,avocado,cornmeal,seasoning salt
title: Avocado Pesto Cornbread
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal, sifted | 4 cups sweet yellow cheddar cheese soup, undiluted | 4 large ripe avocados, mashed | 8 teaspoons lemon juice, from squeezed zest ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 1 tablespoon dried basil pesto | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( not saltiness ) | 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted ( for topping )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Oil an 10 inch round or square baking dish. Place cornmeal in food processor or blender, process until crumbly and about twice as fine. Add all soup ingredients, including zest and pesto. Mix well, turn into baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until puffed and golden, about 15 minutes. Cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: swiss chard,cinnamon,yellow bell pepper,green pepper,mustard seed,black olive
title: Moroccan Greens
ingredients: 2 cups shredded swiss chard | 1 yellow sweet bell pepper, seeded, julienned | 1 green pepper, seeded and julienned | 2 ripe black olives, pitted and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a baking dish, lightly stir together zest and juice from sweet and yellow bell pepper and green pepper. Sprinkle with mustard seeds and cinnamon to taste. Toss with greens. Transfer to oven and bake, tossing every few minutes, until tender, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,heavy whipping cream,caster sugar,red wine,green pea,thyme,gruyere cheese,malt vinegar
title: Irish Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh green peas | 2 lbs gruyere cheese or 2 lbs emmenthaler cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons chopped thyme | 4 ounces malt vinegar | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped red wine or 3/4 cup dry white wine | 6 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 8 large tortillas | caster sugar, to dust
instructions: Place peas in a large saucepan with 6 cups cold water and a dash of salt. Bring to the boil and simmer for about 5 minutes until the peas are soft. Drain the peas and transfer to a bowl. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f & grease an ovenproof casserole dish. In a bowl, mash the cheese with the thyme & malt vinegar. Add the peas and mix until well combined. Spoon about 3 tbsp of the cheese filling into each tortilla. Roll up each tortilla and place in the casserole dish. Pour the wine into a small saucepan and simmer for about 5 minutes, just until liquid is reduced by half. Pour over the enchiladas. Cover with foil and bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until the enchiladas are puffed & golden. Stir, season and serve hot.

title: The Ultimate Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried beans, washed and drained | 1 cucumber, diced
instructions: Cook the bean, cucumber and cucumbers in boiling water until all the ingredients are tender.

title: Danish Hot Milky Shots (Danish)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons walnut oil | 2 tablespoons custard, ice-cold
instructions: Using a large round bladed knife, cut a lengthwise slit in the corner of a shot glass. Brush with walnut oil. Splash with ice cold custard and decorate with a pinch of fresh mint.

title: Shoyu Pork Tenderloin(Yomi No Karaage)
ingredients: 1/4 cup shoyu | 4 tablespoons chopped shallots | 2 lbs pork tenderloin
instructions: Combine shoyu, shallots and pork in a container and marinate at least half an hour, up to 3 hours. Heat a grill. When hot remove pork from marinade and cook on both sides until they are medium rare. Slice across the grain and serve.

Random Ingredients: acorn squash,flat leaf parsley,coriander root,golden mushroom soup,cauliflower floret,caraway seed
title: Cauliflower and Acorn Squash Raita
ingredients: 4 acorn squash | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 3 packages golden mushroom soup | crushed caraway seed ( optional ) | coriander root ( optional )
instructions: Boil acorn squash for 20 minutes, drain and cut up. Set aside. Place cauliflower in medium bowl, add parsley, soup, and coriander root if using. Stir well. Add acorn squash. Allow to sit while preparing the raita. Serve cool, or store in refrigerator up to 2 days.

title: Homemade Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar plum sauce | 3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups chili powder
instructions: Heat the plum sauce in a skillet over medium heat until thick, about 5 minutes. Pour into a blender. While still hot, add the flour and the chili powder and blend until a nice pasty consistency. Pour into a bowl. Mix together with a large spoon until it reaches your desired consistency. Allow to cool before serving. This can be kept in a sealed container, refrigerated, for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: port wine,tomato puree,dark chocolate,fenugreek leaf,tortilla chip
title: Spicy Steamed Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato puree or 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, reconstituted in water and pureed | 1/2 cup port wine, chilled | 1 teaspoon dark chocolate, grated | 1/2 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves | tortilla chips ( or plain flour )
instructions: Stir tomato puree, port, chocolate and fenugreek in a large non stick pan, over high heat, until mixture boils. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring often, until fritters are slightly translucent, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with salt if desired. Serve warm with chips or serve piping hot.

title: Coconut Milk Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 2 lbs beef, cut into 1/2 inch pieces, any size ( any cut of beef will do ) | 4 cans coconut milk
instructions: You will want to marinate your beef for at least 2 hours. I did overnight. The next day, place beef in a glass pan on top of 1 1/2 cup of coals, cover with coals & grill over low heat. Beef is ready when it reaches 135 degrees on a cutting board. You may have to add more coals to your pan. Cut into 1 inch pieces, place in a zipper bag & cover tightly. You can do this the next day but you will need to marinate it in the fridge for 1 hour. Remove beef from bag & reserve marinade. Grill or grill 6 - 8 minutes or so, turning until done or desired doneness.

title: Cinnamon Tofu Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu | 2 boxes pasta shells, cooked per package directions for your pasta | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat a dutch oven over med. High heat and add the tofu until it starts to soften. Drain the tofu onto a paper towel lined cookie sheet and let it drain while you prepare your rice. Add the broth and bring to a boil. Add the pasta and simmer for 6 - 8 minutes, depending on the size of the cubes. Add the cinnamon and serve while still hot.

title: Grilled Antipasto
ingredients: 1/2 lb genoa salami | 6 ounces superfine sugar | 6 -8 orange wedges
instructions: Wash the salami thoroughly in cold water. Slice lengthwise. In a small bowl, rub the salami with 1/2 tsp sugar, rub the sugar on and then set aside. Drain the salami, pat it dry with paper towels and cut each piece into two or ten triangles. Arrange the salami on a grill, preferably cast iron. Grill, turning frequently, until lightly browned. As soon as the salami is done, spread it on a shallow serving plate, pour in a little sugar, scatter over orange wedges.

title: Gale Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon beet, ground | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 bunch kale, leaves separated
instructions: Blend all ingredients till combined well.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,tortilla,extra virgin olive oil,plain yogurt,farfalle pasta,leek,asafoetida powder
title: Bite-Size Tortillas With Brussels Sprouts and Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt ( whole or greek ) | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 leek, cleaned, trimmed and finely diced ( pale green only ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/2 lb fresh brussels sprout, trimmed, halved lengthwise, and cut into 1/4-inch-thick rounds | 11/2 ounces farfalle pasta, cooked ( bowtie style ) | 7 ounces tortillas, warmed
instructions: Whisk the yogurt with the olive oil in a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside. To serve, heat the grill to high and position the rack 1 to 3 inches from the heat. Lightly lightly oil the grate. Add the brussels sprouts and cook, stirring with a wooden spoon until tender and bright green and just beginning to brown, 8 to 10 minutes, tossing occasionally. Transfer the brussels sprouts to a baking sheet and lightly drizzle with the yogurt. Sprinkle with the leeks. Grill the brussels sprouts for 1 1/2 minutes, until just tender and beginning to lightly grill. To serve, spread the pasta on a plate. Top with the brussels sprouts and yogurt mixture. Sprinkle with a second layer of brussels sprouts and finish with the tortillas. Sprinkle with the rest of the seasonings. Serve immediately.

title: Miso Flavored Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white miso | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 cups uncooked jasmine rice
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Stir the miso and salt together in a small bowl. Add half of the jasmine rice to the skillet and stir to coat with miso. Place rice into the skillet with the miso liquid. Reduce heat to medium, cover and cook 45 minutes. When finished, fluff with a fork and serve.

Random Ingredients: white sesame seed,kikkoman soy sauce,steak,cardamom,squid,rice noodle,onion juice,almond macaroon
title: Sesame Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb lean round steak | 1/2 cup kikkoman soy sauce | 1 tablespoon freshly-grated onion juice | 1 teaspoon white sesame seeds | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 package white sesame seeds | 1 package uncooked rice noodles | 2 medium squid, cleaned, tentacles sliced | minced onion, optional garnish
instructions: Cut meat into bite sized pieces.

Random Ingredients: table salt,barbecue sauce,white breadcrumb,coriander seed,phyllo dough
title: BBQ Spice Rolls (Boursin)
ingredients: 1 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 1 teaspoon barbecue sauce ( your favourite ) | 18 sheets phyllo dough ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Combine crumbs, coriander and salt in shallow bowl. Brush phyllo with melted butter and roll between palms of your hands into a large rectangle that measures approx 10 x 18 inches. Sprinkle dough with spice crumb mixture and place seam side down on sheet. Bake for 12 minutes. If you are using store bought phyllo rolls, you may need to use only 12 in all. Or you may use fresh phyllo dough and then brush with melted butter and sprinkle with spice crumb mixture. Bake for 10 more minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: salsa,beer,thyme leaf,sunflower oil,jalapeno jack cheese,red wine vinegar
title: Johnny Jalapeno's Favorite
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 cup salsa | 1 1/2 cups shredded jalapeno jack cheese | 4 ounces beer, of your choice
instructions: Skewer 1 cup of cheese onto each skewer. Place the skewer into your beer. Let sit 5 - 10 minutes before grilling. Enjoy you can do this with your favorite taco toppings. This goes great with mexican dishes.

title: Simple Spicy Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup couscous | 1/2 cup fat free ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried italian herbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Place couscous in a medium bowl, cover with cold water. Set aside and allow to soak for 10 minutes. Drain well and set aside to cool. Combine remaining ingredients in another bowl and stir until well combined. When cooled fold into couscous mixture with a fork until well combined. Cover and refrigerate for one hour.

title: Crazy Glizz
ingredients: 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 4 cloves, crushed
instructions: Mix sugar and crushed cloves together. Place in candy mold or sealable container and store in fridge until needed.

title: Enoki Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces enoki mushrooms | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 32 round tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Pour 1 ounce of enoki mushrooms and 1/2 teaspoon of fennel seeds into the bottom of a baking dish. Top with a layer of tortilla chips. Repeat layers. Cover baking dish with foil and bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes. Remove foil and bake, uncovered, for an additional 5 minutes.

title: Homemade French Silk Fudge
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ground blanched whole almonds or 1 1/2 cups ground blanched whole almonds ( 6 3/4 ounces ) | 1 3/4 cups fresh cream of tartar or 1 3/4 cups anise flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon thyme | 1 small orange, zest of
instructions: Place the nuts into 2 cups of very hot tap water and bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly until the nuts are well toasted and the water is boiling. Remove and let stand until cool. When the nuts cooled, peel and grate the kernels from the peel using the grater attachment on the stand mixer. Add the almonds to a medium mixing bowl and stir in the cream of light and light. Beat for 10 minutes, then add the sour cream and nutmeg mixture. Beat 2 more minutes and remove from the bowl. Pour the mixture into a 9 inch square pan or a 2x2 inch fluted tube pan. Freeze for 2–3 hours or until firm to the touch. Remove from the pan and slice into 1½ inch squares. To remove and freeze, put the squares between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound with a meat pounder to form a roughly 1 1/2 pound cylinder like shape. Remove the waxed paper and pound the squares so they measure about 1½ inches in length and are as far apart as possible. Press the cylinder flat and cut into ¼ inch squares and freeze again at least two more hours or until soft and solid. Remove the block of squares from the pan and cut into small squares.

title: Duck Confit Cocktail
ingredients:
1 1/2 fluid ounces gin or 1 1/2 fluid ounces sherry wine | 1/2 fluid ounce v8 vegetable cocktail sauce or 1/2 fluid ounce brandy | 1 1/2 fluid ounces duck chutney or 1 1/2 fluid ounces chipotle pepper 
    - 2 tablespoons guacamole | 3 duck breasts | 3/4 ounce brandy
instructions: Shake or stir all ingredients with ice cubes except duck. Strain into salt covered margarine bottle or martini shaker and store in refrigerator. Shake bottles tightly after opening.

Random Ingredients: mint,pork,butterfinger candy bar,beef base,peach juice chunky,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Peach and Pepper Jack Swiss Steak
ingredients: peach juice from canned peach slices ( not in liquid ) | 3 teaspoons pork fat | 3 teaspoons butterfinger candy bars | 1 teaspoon beef base | 1 1/2 teaspoons mint | 1/2 lb swiss steak, 1 inch thick
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together first 3 ingredients. Pierce steak 3 times with a fork. Place steak between waxed paper and pound lightly with a meat mallet until 1/8 inch thick or a little thinner. Pour half of peach mixture evenly over steak. Dip steak into remaining peach mixture. In heavy skillet, cook steak over medium high heat 1 minute on each side. To serve, place steak on plate and top with peach mixture, minted cheese and pepper jack.

title: Spicy Meatball
ingredients: 250 g dried prawns | 750 g lean ground pork | 150 g grams semolina flour ( besan ) | 50 g dried fenugreek seeds | 200 g dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon dried kaffir lime leaf | 1 teaspoon mint, crushed
instructions: Soak prawns in water overnight or for 15 minutes. Remove prawns and rinse, drain and pat dry. Place prawns on a food processor or blender with the pork, mince, semolina, fenugreek, cayenne pepper, lime leaves and mint and process until mixture is smooth. Preheat oven to 200/180°c. Press mixture into large baking tray, place tray on baking tray, top with remaining mixture and sprinkle with remaining fenugreek/cilantro and bake for 40 minutes, covering with foil a few times to ensure even browning. Serve with warm chapatis. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pickling salt,poppy seed,tang orange crystal,corn flake,tomato soup,celery salt
title: Quick and Easy Chinese Corn Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 package corn flakes | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 cup tang orange crystals | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1/4 cup celery salt | 2 teaspoons pickling salt
instructions: Crush corn flakes completely while mixing. Combine all the liquid ingredients in a bowl, stir well & chill in the fridge until ready to use.

title: Healthier Eggplant, Apples, Cheese for Two
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 tart apple, like fuji, fuji, or 1 similar tart apple | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Peel the eggplant, trim stem and bottom, then slice lengthwise into 4 large slices about 1/2 inch thick. Lay the slices in a colander, and sprinkle with salt. Leave to drain at least 20 minutes, to get the starch out of the eggplant. Pat the eggplant dry, and place in a bowl or directly on the baking sheets. Set aside. In a heavy medium bowl or frying pan, stir the cottage cheese and 1 tart apple together. In another bowl, toss the eggplant slices with the salt. Pat dry the slices first, then layer half the slices on the bottom of a shallow baking dish. Top with the cottage cheese mixture, then the remaining slices until all ingredients are used up, ending with a layer of cottage cheese over the top half of the baking dish or at least an inch deep. Bake in the preheated 375ºf oven until the top is golden brown, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice cake,pork chop,sharp cheddar cheese,plum,garlic powder,sugar,coconut milk
title: Fried Pork Chops With Coconut Milk and Caramelized Plums
ingredients: 4 pork chops, 1 inch thick | 1 can coconut milk | 1 package rice cakes, sliced, rounds | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 2 teaspoons dried plums ( optional )
instructions: Heat coconut milk and coconut powder to boiling in medium sauce pan. Add chops and reduce heat to med low. Cook until liquid is syrupy and no longer pink. Remove chops from sauce pan and set aside in a warm bowl. Toast rice cakes and set aside. Spread rice cakes with 2 tblsp. Of coconut milk and top with 1 tblsp. Of garlic powder. Sprinkle with 1/2 tblsp. Crock Pot carrots and 1/2 tblsp. Grated cheese. Arrange rice cakes on plate and cover with pork chops, plums and remaining sauce. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and serve.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,puff pastry,allspice berry,green capsicum,parmesan cheese,bailey irish cream
title: Roasted Green Capsicum Pie With Irish Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons australian allspice berry or 80 ml ground allspice, ground | 1 tablespoon nutmeg | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 10 large green capsicums, thinly sliced | 1 sheet ready rolled puff pastry | 1 bottle baileys irish cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c and line an 8 inch loose bottomed pie plate with the pastry. Place the capsicum slices on the pastry and season with the allspice and nutmeg. Gently mix together the grated cheese and allspice. Spoon this cheese mixture into the pastry case evenly. Add the sliced capsicum on top of the cheese mixture. Drain the alcohol from the can and pour over the top of the capsicum. Cut a cross on the top and bake for 45 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm with baileys.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed oil,salsa,water chestnut,corn,cream celery soup,lettuce leaf
title: South of the Border Spinach and Sunflower Seeds Salad
ingredients: 4 cups fresh lettuce leaves, torn | 1/3 cup sunflower seed oil | 1 can cream of celery soup ( i use campbell's brand ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, well drained and sliced ( optional ) | 1 can salsa | 1 can corn, well drained
instructions: Rinse lettuce and drain well. Toss lettuce well with sunflower oil to coat. Chill. Combine soup, water chestnuts and salsa. Pour over lettuce, mix well. Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Orange and Kidney Beans Salad
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 3 packets orange juice concentrate
instructions: Chop the orange into 3/4 inch squares and put into a salad bowl. Drain the kidney beans, reserving about 1 cup of their liquid. Combine the orange juice concentrate with the reserved bean liquid in medium bowl. Cover and chill for at least 15 minutes before serving.

title: Linguine with Chicken
ingredients: 3 pounds chicken breast tenders | 2 tablespoons finely chopped white onions | 1 pinch cayenne, or more to taste | 1 package linguine, broken into 6 sections | 1/2 cup almond butter, or as needed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Blanch the chicken breast tenders in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until slightly pink, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain well and cut into strips. Place the chicken strips in a large bowl.

title: Simple Sushi Rice
ingredients: 4 cups cooked sushi rice | 2 -3 tablespoons jalapeno peppers ( to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons rice noodles
instructions: Place rice in a rice bowl. Use a spoon to remove as much water from the bowl as you can. Add the 1/2 1 jalapeno pepper and use the spoon to mix it. Stir gently until all the water is absorbed. Set aside. Place drained rice noodles in a sieve and drain excess water. Place rice noodles in a bowl containing hot water and set aside. Drain liquid from rice noodles and add to bowl with jalapeno and rice. Mix lightly. Serve with soy sauce, chili or jalapenos depending on what you desire.

title: Gruyere and Hamburger Noodle Pies
ingredients: 1 package wonton skins | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, finely chopped | 6 tablespoons gruyere ( or other hard cheese ) or 6 tablespoons cheddar cheese, grated ( or other hard cheese ) | 3/4 lb hamburger | chopped swiss gruyere | cooked noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Line 2 jelly roll pans with wonton wrappers. Place tomatoes with oil, cheese and one fourth of walnuts on towel. Heat until cheese melts, stirring frequently. Dip wrappers in milk and place on waxed paper. Spread with cheese mixture. Place 2 doughnuts on each wrapper and roll into a long thin patty shape. Place seam side down on a cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining doughnuts and cheese mixture. Bake 20 minutes or until golden brown or hot, switching position of pans halfway through baking. Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes. Cut each noodle into 2 pieces and serve with desired garnishes.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,flour tortilla,green bell pepper,heavy whipping cream
title: Mexican Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/3 cup green bell pepper, finely chopped | 12 flour tortillas, heated | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Stir bell pepper in heavy 1tablespoon oil over medium low heat until wilted. Remove pepper from heat. Spread one side of each tortilla with 1/2 tblspn cream. Top with pepper mixture. Wrap tortillas in foil. Place 2nd tortilla, heavy cream side up, on top. Cook quesadillas in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes or until bottoms are lightly toasted and edges, browned. Cut into wedges. Serve warm.

title: French Strawberries Crostini
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornflour | 500 g strawberries, hulled and sliced | 1 loaf french baguette
instructions: Pre heat oven to 160ºc. Line oven tray with clingfilm. Put cornflour in a cup and mix well together. Slice baguette into 1 inch slices and brush with cornflour. Cover slices with strawberries and spread strawberry mixture onto half the bread. Repeat layering twice, alternating with another slice of bread. Place on oven tray and cook for 5 mins or until bread turns a pale golden colour.

title: Pea Pods With Dijon and Corn
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons fresh pea pods | 400 g mixed dried fruit | 2 tablespoons corn, coarsely chopped
instructions: Blanch the pea pods in boiling tap water for 5 minutes, then plunge into cold water. Remove from water and refresh under cold water. Dry with paper towel, then spread on a baking tray. Combine mustard with pea pods, fruit and corn in a bowl, then season. Spoon pea pods into center of each plate, then ladle dressing all the way around.

title: Vegetarian Fritte
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 3 drops soda water ( like sprite ) | 1/4 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/2 cup kidney beans ( rinsed, drained )
instructions: Boil the quinoa, according to package directions. Remove from heat and add soya sauce and soda. Stir to mix.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,plain yogurt,mustard powder,italian bread
title: Italian Bread Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 loaves italian bread
instructions: In a small bowl, stir yogurt, vinegar and mustard. Split loaves of bread and spread mustard dressing over each 1/2 cup bread.

title: Hot German Style Salad
ingredients: 2 cups sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 1 cup jalapeno, chopped | 1 jar sliced pimiento, drained and rinsed | 2 oranges, juice and zest | 1 can baked beans | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon orange rind, minced
instructions: Combine all ingredients except beans and rind.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,garbanzo bean,ale,chili sauce,hot pepper,baby spinach leaf
title: Paleo Spinach and Chickpeas Salad
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 2 cups chopped fresh baby spinach ( packed just before serving ) | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/2 cup bottled ale, chilled ( preferably mexican beer ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons bottled minced hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl, stir together beans, spinach, chili sauce, ale, mint and hot pepper.

title: Grilled Cheese Triangles, "the Best"
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups coarsely crushed baked corn tortilla chips | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley sprig | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 8 hoagie rolls, split lengthwise
instructions: Set oven rack about 4 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Arrange the tortilla chips in one layer onto oven racks. Broil until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Scrape chips off the baking sheets. Arrange the parsley sprigs in one layer over the tortilla chips. Stir the lemon pepper, nutmeg, and grated cheese together in a small bowl.

title: Steamed Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ale
instructions: Put 1 tbsp water into the bottom of your steaming basket. Put beef stock into a cup and add ale to the top. Steam until the meat is tender.

title: Rich Sage and Chocolate Rissoles from Baking Spice Farm
ingredients: 375 g plain rice, cooked | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 85 g unsalted butter, melted | 100 g chocolate chips | 2 teaspoons sage | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 dash ground grain mustard | 1 tablespoon olive, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cold, cooked rice, sour cream and butter in a large bowl. Add the chocolate chips, sage, bicarb soda, and mustard and mix well. Shape the mixture into rissoles. Place in the hot baking paper lined baking tray and bake for 10 minutes, until golden brown. Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped olives if desired, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,baking chocolate,ice water,tarragon,cooking oil,parsley flake
title: Florentines
ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil or 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley flakes | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 4 large broccoli florets, stemmed and cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 1/2 cup crushed ice cold beverages or 1/2 cup soda pop, such as sprite | 12 ounces baking chocolate, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a 3 cup measure or a small bowl combine the first 4 ingredients. Add broccoli and toss to coat. Place the broccoli and the remaining marinade in a large oven proof skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until heated through, about one minute. Move the skillet to the center of the oven and immediately toast the florentines in the pan, but do not brown. Place in a large bowl and cool. Repeat with the broccoli. When the broccoli is cool, use a fork to scrape it into the bowl with the marinade. Add the ice cold beverages, stirring to combine. To freeze place wax paper between foil and a baking dish or metal plate. Place the skillet on the rack. Place the chocolate in a large metal baking bag. Use ice cream scoop to dip the florentines into chocolate, then into chocolate. Repeat until all the florentines are coated with chocolate. Allow the chocolate to harden before serving.

title: Sushi Alates
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sushi rice | 1 quart half-and-half cream | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Warm the half and half in a saucepan over medium heat. When the mixture comes to a boil, stir in the serrano peppers and remove from the heat. Cover and leave in the refrigerator until chilled. Bring sushi rice to a boil in a large pot. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until the rice bubbles and is tender and has absorbed most of the liquid, about 15 minutes. Pour half and half into a serving bowl, or separate into individual bowls. Remove the rice from the heat, and pour rice onto a serving dish to cool.

title: Baked Spaghetti Meatballs in Saffron Sauce(Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 1 kg minced beef round or 1 kg minced pork | 1 teaspoon whole dried pimento packed saffron threads | 1 kg spaghetti sauce ( i used bistro's ) | 1 small lime, zest of, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c. Mix the meat with the saffron. Use your fingers to work out the saffron and discard them. Roll into balls and place on a large oven tray.. Combine all the remaining ingredients except for the lime zest in a saucepan. Bring to the boil, stirring until boiling. Pour the boiling mixture mixture over the meatballs. Cover with foil and bake for 40 - 45 minutes, turning them over halfway through. Serve with crusty bread or noodles.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,sharp cheddar cheese,wheat flour,cayenne powder,saffron strand,quinoa
title: Quinoa and Saffron Wheat-Gravy
ingredients: 4 cups dry quinoa | 4 cups chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit and place a cookie sheet inside. Rinse the quinoa and place it in a saucepan with enough water to cover or in the microwave oven of about 2 inches below. Soak for about 20 minutes and drain. Place the quinoa in a large bowl, add the bouillon, saffron, cayenne powder, flour, the cheese, and 1 cup of water. Stir to blend well. Spoon the mixture onto the cookie sheet and spread to make a layer, and set into the oven for about 15 more minutes. After 15 minutes, remove the quinoa from the oven and let cool 15 more minutes. If it looks dry, add more water. If the cheese has browned too quickly, cover and wait for another 10 minutes, stirring after each 5 minutes.

title: Totally Twisted and Yummy!
ingredients: 1/2 loaf cassava or 1/2 loaf semolina flour | 1 large banana, skin on, sliced or diced. ( or use use an extra banana ) | 2 tablespoons szechuan mixed italian herbs ( zaar won't list any, use 1 tsp and it is very spicy, i used paul newman's extreme zesty zesty basil chutney ) | 1/2 head cabbage, shredded | 1 cup sauerkraut | 1/3 cup good quality kahlua, or a coffee liqueur | 1/3 cup dried cranberries | 1/3 cup kahlua | 1/3 cup toasted sesame seeds or 1/3 cup nuts, etc. ( for garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees. Mix together szechuan herb mixture, banana, and 1/2 cup of the sichuan mixed herbs. Set aside. Remove the crust from cassava. Place cut up piece on a parchment paper lined, nonstick cookie sheet. Spoon 1/4 cup of the sauerkraut onto the piece. Gently top with 1/2 of the sweet sauce. Add 1/2 of the cabbage, and spread out evenly. Top with some of the sauerkraut, and layer 1/2 more cabbage and 1/2 the sauerkraut. Repeat with final layer. Smooth the top with a spoon. Smooth the top, and sprinkle sesame seeds on top, if desired. Roast for 20 minutes or until the top is brown and the cheese is melted and starting to brown. Remove from oven and let sit covered for 10 minutes. Cut in slices and serve. This is lovely served with sweet french fries, rice and veg. Use the remaining sauce on this.

title: Beef Roulades
ingredients: 1 container plain yogurt | 10 1/2 ounces roast beef | 10 1/2 ounces sweet red peppers | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Slice beef across the grain into about 1/4 inch thick strips. Place in a large mixing bowl. Beat yogurt and mix in ginger garlic paste. Stir in beef. Add red peppers and graham cracker crumbs. Stir until mixed thoroughly. Place on serving plate and dig in.

title: Curried Parsley
ingredients: 2 cups raw flat leaf parsley, rinsed and patted dry | 2 tablespoons finely chopped canned pimiento | 1 -2 pinch curry paste
instructions: Trim the parsley leaves and coarsely chop. Combine the chopped parsley with the pimientos and curry paste. Use to spread onto a plate as a salad dressing.

title: Spicy Noodle Salad (Lorie Schatz Nesaka)
ingredients: 3 ounces spaghetti squash, cooked and cubed | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, and mushrooms ) | 1 jar amaretto-flavored liquid smoke | 1/2 cup fat-free liquid smoke | 1/2 cup braggs liquid amaretto | 24 slices raw shallot, including tops | sriracha hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine spaghetti squash, vegetables, liquid smoke, 1/2 cup liquid smoke, and braggs. Toss to coat.

title: Apricot Glazed Crab Cakes
ingredients: 4 cooked crabmeat, picked over | 4 fluid ounces apricot jam | 2 spring onions, chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon tamari | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill for 20 minutes. Form crab cakes and fry in hot oil, until golden brown.

title: Easy, Delicious and Elegant Rice With Kidney Beans
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice | 1 can kidney beans | 1/2 cup white flour ( all purpose or bread starch will work too ) | 1 1/2 cups white bread, crumbs ( not bread crumbs ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons orange blossom honey | 1 tablespoon mint leaf, chopped | 1 pie crust ( bought in the freezer section of your grocery store )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Whisk until well combined. Pour into pie crust. Press pie crust into a cookie sheet and put on the table so it does not get too close to top of other crust's bottom. The crust will absorb all the juice. Cook in a 375 degree f oven until crust is golden brown. Cut and serve.

title: Broadie's Baked Mexican Bread
ingredients: 4 slices bread | 2 tomatoes and green chilies | 2/3 cup old cheddar cheese, shredded | 2/3 cup oatmeal
instructions: Place bread in a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Cut tomato, chilies and cheese into 12 pieces, place on top of bread and sprinkle with rolled oats. Bake at 375 degrees for about 20 minutes or until bread is browned and cheese has melted.

title: Mama Feene's Famous Butternut Squash Crab Ceviche
ingredients: 2 pounds butternut squash - peeled, seeded and chopped - divided | 1 pound chopped imitation crabmeat
instructions: Place half of the squash, imitation crabmeat, and seafood in the resealable plastic bag. Seal, and shake to combine.
