title: Baked Dutch Pork Tenderloin With Apple Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried thyme | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground dried thyme | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground dried thyme | 1 teaspoon ground dried coriander powder | 1 teaspoon crushed dried coriander powder | 2 pork tenderloins | 1 apple, peeled, cored and finely shredded | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 1/2 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled and quartered ( about 2 3-6 cups ) | 2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: To prepare the spice rub, combine all the rub ingredients in a small bowl and rub all over the pork slices. To prepare toasts, preheat the oven to 375f degrees. Place the tenderloins on a roasting rack in a roasting pan and brush with the apple juice. Bake the pork for about 45 minutes.

title: Chinese Spicy Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/3 cup white wine ( chinese wine is suggested )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300f.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,farfalle pasta,beet,italian sausage,ranch dressing mix
title: Big M's Italian Pasta and Beet Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta shells ( small ) | 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 can beets, finely diced | 1 package ranch dressing mix | ice cube
instructions: Cook elbow macaroni in salted cold water until al dente. Drain and run under cold water if dry. Cut hot italian sausage in half to form 1/2 inch pieces. Mix drained macaroni, sausage, beets, and ranch dressing mix together. Pour into a large glass bowl. Top with ice cubes. Serve chilled.

title: Swiss and Avgolemono Frappé
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 4 tablespoons brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 2 slices cooked swiss cheese | 1 pinch kosher salt | 1 1/2 cups dry medium-dry pasta, such as penne or 1 1/2 cups fettuccine pasta | 4 -6 tablespoons prepared pasta sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together 1/2 cup of the orange juice with the coffee. Put the basil and sliced swiss cheese in the bottom of a large deep saucepan. Pour the orange and coffee mixture over the cheese, making sure all the cheese has been covered. Add the remaining 3/4 cup orange juice, cheese and salt, and stir with a wooden spoon until the cheese is melted and the mixture is thoroughly mixed. Bring water to a boil in a large pot. Meanwhile, place the pasta in the boiling water and cook as per package directions, until just tender. Drain. Place the pasta into a serving bowl and pour the sauce over. Top with remaining 1/4 cup of orange and garlic dressing and serve.

title: Slow-Cooker Teriyaki Red Gravy
ingredients: 4 lamb chops | 4 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger root, grated
instructions: Place the chops into a slow cooker.

title: Indian Bread
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1/4 teaspoon yellow food coloring | 1/3 cup celery, minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. In a bowl, stir together the flour, coriander seed, and yellow food coloring until evenly blended. Stir in celery. Spread dough into a greased, shallow baking pan, and bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until deep golden brown.

title: Homemade Rice (Or Baked)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1/2 cup tomato sauce ( tomato ketchup ) | 1 1/2 - 1 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.

title: Quick Red Beans with Mushroom Swiss Steak Sandwiches (Modified)
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup marsala wine ( optional ) | 8 -12 hoagie rolls, split | 1/2 cup basil pesto ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1 lb thinly sliced round steak | 1 1/2 cups alfredo sauce or can condensed cream of mushroom soup ( regular )
instructions: In saucepan over medium heat, heat the red beans and soup to boiling. Cook, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, spread the hoagie rolls with pesto. Spoon 1/2 cup soup onto each sandwich. Divide bean sandwich evenly between the rolls. Top with a thin slice of steak. Add additional soup to top if desired. Spoon remaining soup over each sandwich with pesto, and serve.

title: Homemade Coriander (Coriander, Bengali Fenugreek & Chana)
ingredients: 1/4 cup dried fenugreek seeds ( kasoori methi ) | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Rinse the fenugreek and urad dal. Dry completely. Place the fenugreek into a mortar & combine with enough water to make a paste. Place into a mortar & pestle & pound well.. Add the chicken stock & mix well. When this mixture is well mixed & frothy, remove from heat. Stir in 3/4 tsp salt while still hot. Leave for 5 minutes, then set aside. Stir well before serving cold.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,arborio rice,allspice,ancho chile powder,french bread,beef sirloin,cider vinegar,green chili
title: Crock Pot Beef Risotto (Beef and Beer)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili, canned chili peppers if you have them | 2 1/2 cups beef sirloin or 2 1/2 cups beef broth | 2 loaf french bread | french bread, sliced into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: In bowl, combine chuck, salt, spice, chile powder, vinegar and chile peppers. Add beef and marinate 1 hour. Meanwhile, rinse bread slices and soak in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain the bread and dry thoroughly on paper towels. Slice bread into strips 1/2 inch long. Spread bread on a large platter with sides and place beef pieces on top of bread. Place french bread slices over beef and bread. Serve with your favourite spanish rice.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,orange blossom water,chinese cabbage,green lentil
title: Lentil and Chinese Colcannon
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green lentils | 1/2 cup chinese cabbage | 1/3 cup spinach leaves | 1/8 teaspoon ground orange blossom water
instructions: Blend ingredients. Store in the refrigerator and use within 1 to 2 days.

title: Blue Lagoon Shrimp (Shrimp) Dogs
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh shrimp, peeled ( i don't use frozen ) | 4 ounces blue curacao ( a premium liqueur ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Slice shrimp in half lengthwise.

title: Arepas
ingredients: 1/4 lb yellow peas, shelled | 1/4 lb green peas, shelled | 1/4 lb yellow pea, shelled | 1/4 cup shortening | 1 pie shell, unbaked
instructions: Puncture peas with fork.

title: Mushroom Filled Apples
ingredients: 1 chipotle chile - stemmed, seeded, and minced | 1/4 cup golden raisins | 1 tomato, chopped | 4 english muffins, split and toasted | 1/4 pound fresh tomatillos, husks removed, washed, and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a small bowl combine the chipotle chili, golden raisins, and tomato. Fill a large pot with enough water to reach 3/4 of the way up the side of the bowl. Bring to a boil. Add the tomatillos, lower the heat to medium, and boil 10 minutes. Spoon the contents of the pan onto a paper towel lined plate. Roll each of the toasted muffins halves lengthwise in the chipotle mixture so they are slightly flattened. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: raisin,monterey jack cheddar cheese,poblano pepper,beef tenderloin fillet,baby spinach,romaine lettuce,cardamom
title: Spinach-Wrapped Beef Tenderloin With Poblano Cheese and Raisins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin fillets, trimmed | 8 ounces baby spinach | 2 poblano peppers | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 romaine lettuce, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place tenderloin in a 13x9x2 baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes or until thermometer registers 140 degrees. Cool and slice. Spread spinach on top. Arrange poblano peppers on top of spinach in a single layer. Top with raisins, cardamon and lettuce. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, covered, for 12 minutes. Uncover, and bake 5 - 7 minutes longer. Cut into 1/8 slices.

title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried oregano
instructions: Combine the wine and oregano in a small bowl. Serve with your favorite hot pasta with garlic and onion.

title: Quick Pineapple Kebabs
ingredients: 1 medium red capsicum, diced ( aka yellow capsicum ) | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1/2 teaspoon garlic, crushed | 400 g pineapple chunks, drained, reserving syrup | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place capsicum in a bowl, stir in ketchup, mirin & garlic & add reserved pineapple syrup. Mix lightly. Stir through lettuce just before serving. Serve with extra pineapple slices or sweet potato wedges on the side & sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,passion fruit juice,shrimp,hoisin sauce,corn kernel,red chili pepper,amaretto
title: Shrimp Puffs
ingredients: 600 g shrimp, shelled & deveined | 300 g wheat flour | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup passion fruit juice ( or fruit sambal olek ) | 1 tablespoon corn kernel, canned | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon amaretto ( or to taste )
instructions: Place shrimp and hoisin sauce in a medium pan over medium low heat until shrimp turn pink, stirring often. While shrimp cook, combine flour, sweetner, corn kernel, chilli pepper & amaretto in a large bowl and mix with a fork. Remove shrimp & reserve shrimp, then combine with the flour mixture and shape into 2 balls. Flatten dough with palm of hand, and place on greased oven trays, allowing 2cm between each. Bake in preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden. To serve, place 2 shrimp balls on each plate, and top with scallion.

title: A Pear Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 package noodles | 1 can evaporated milk | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 slices canned pears, chopped
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. In a large saucepan, combine evaporated milk, salt, marjoram, garlic salt, and uncooked noodles. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: green chili sauce,grain rice,pecorino romano cheese
title: Arroz Blanco (Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice, rinsed and drained ( about 1/4 cup ) | 2 tablespoons green chili sauce | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, shaved ( about 2 tablespoons )
instructions: Bring 3 cups water and rice to boil in medium nonstick skillet over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Transfer rice to platter. Sprinkle with chile sauce.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,chicken breast,applesauce,almond flavoring,salmon fillet,green chilies,buttermilk,grain white rice
title: Salmon Rice With Green Chile Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces salmon fillets ( skin removed, about 1.4 lb/1.25 kg ) | 1 1/2 cups converted long grain white rice | 1 can mild green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 3 ounces smoked salmon fillet, chopped | 2 1/2 tsbp chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond flavoring | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened applesauce
instructions: Combine the salmon, rice, green chilies, buttermilk and flaked salmon in a 13x9 baking dish and press into an even layer. Blend applesauce with bouillon in a blender on high speed until creamy. Pour over salmon. Cover, and refrigerate, covered, for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 375°f degrees. Bake, covered, for 35 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Serve with green chile sauce.

title: Linguine With Mustard Seeds and Pasta
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 3 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 pound linguine | 1 cup cold dry pasta
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat and lightly sprinkle with mustard seeds. Cook 1 minute and stir in seasoning salt. Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain linguine, reserving 1 cup. Rinse linguine and add to pancake iron along with reserved cooking water. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes until hot. Remove from heat and place on a warmed platter. Pour mustard and dressing into skillet. To make the bechamel sauce, bring 2 cups or enough water to a boil to loosen the flavor from the mustard seeds and salt. Add pasta to fryer along with 1 to 2 tablespoons of reserved pasta cooking water and the bechamel. Heat a few seconds and pour over the linguine.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,shiitake mushroom,fish stock,grape tomato,olive,red cabbage,bread crumb
title: Shiitake and Grape Tomato Cabbage Soup With Oyster Filling
ingredients: 1 cup shiitake mushrooms, finely sliced | 3 cups light fish stock | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon olive, sliced | 4 cups shredded red cabbage | bread crumbs, to coat with | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a medium sauce pan, stir together mushrooms, broth, chili pepper flakes, bread crumbs and tomato slices. Cook over medium heat until soup comes to boil and mixture begins to thicken, about 3 minutes. Stir in cabbage, then sprinkle with more bread crumbs and pinch of chili flakes.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,beef bouillon cube,ice water,pineapple juice
title: Sweet and Sour Spicy Spinach
ingredients: 1 bunch baby spinach ( or 1lb fresh ) | 2 tablespoons crushed pineapple in juice | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup pineapple juice, from drained canned pineapple concentrate | 1/8 cup ice water
instructions: Wash and dry spinach. Cut in half, then separate each half into two pieces. Blend all ingredients together in a processor until smooth. Add pineapples one at a time to mixture, stirring for a maximum of 1 minute. If mixture seems too stiff to pour on food, you can add a little more water. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour, but ideally overnight. Transfer to a serving bowl. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Ground Beef & Barley Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 8 ounces rotel | 2 jars peanut butter | 14 ounces cooked penne pasta | 1 mango, cubed | 1 teaspoon garlic, crushed
instructions: Brown beef in a skillet drain any excess fat. Mix in rice, barley and rotel. Stir in peanut butter. Bake at 300°f for 1 hour.

title: Spanish Olive Crostato (Lebanese)
ingredients: 1 lb nicoise olive | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 cup sugar free plain flour, sifted ( i have never measured it completely )
instructions: Place all ingredients into food processor and pulse several times or just until finely chopped and combined. Form into a ball and roll in flour just until well rolled. Pour into a 9 x 12 rectangular pan or round cake pan lined with waxed paper. Cover with waxed paper or parchment paper and refrigerate overnight to firm up. Remove sides and slice.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 24 ounces monterey jack cheese | 4 bell peppers ( or any combination with seeds )
instructions: Chop peppers and stir them in fondue pot for 3 minutes while making fondue. Transfer fondue to a container and refrigerate for at least an hour before eating. After removing from refrigerator, add cheese. Stir until melted. Serve with assorted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,pizza crust,plain flour,pecan half,cucumber,greek yogurt,vegetable oil olive,mace
title: Scallops and Cucumber-Pecan Pizza With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 300 g greek yogurt | 300 g cucumbers, sliced | 3 cups mixed seafood cocktail prawns or 3 cups sea scallops | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( i like sunflower seedless olive oil ) | 1/4 cup pecan halves, toasted
instructions: On a floured surface, roll out the pizza crust dough to a 5cm thickness and cut into 12 rounds. Combine flour and mace in a bowl. Spread yogurt into a large pizza base dish, top with dough rounds and scatter cucumber slices, followed by seafood. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with pecan halves. Bake at c for 15 minutes until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,red wine,vegan cheddar cheese,blackberry,tabasco sauce
title: Vegtable Fish Cocktail
ingredients: 1 cup vegan cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup dried blackberries ( more or less to taste ) | 10 small red wine ( i used portobello ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs fish fillets, such as haddock, cod or snapper | tabasco sauce ( to taste )
instructions: In a large bowl place cheddar cheese, blackberries and wine. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour before using. Cut fish fillets diagonally into 4 serving size pieces and sprinkle with tabasco sauce. Thread pieces on skewers and grill on a heated grill or until cooked through, about 5 minutes on each side. Serve hot.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 1/2 pounds ground chicken | 2 teaspoons cajun spices | 1 can sliced smoked salmon | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spray a baking dish with cooking spray. Combine the ground chicken, cajun spice, salmon, and lemon juice in a large bowl. Roll the mixture in the towel to coat all the pieces of meat. Arrange the rolls on top of the aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink, 30 to 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,mexican chili powder,garlic clove,brandy,almond extract
title: Salsa Colorada
ingredients: 4 mexican chili powder | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 2 teaspoons brandy or 2 teaspoons rum | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, lightly ground | 1 -2 teaspoon pure vanilla bean puree
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a bowl. Let stand for about an hour. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Eggplant in Tomato Sauce (Dimetetes De Terre)
ingredients: 6 medium-size eggplants | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 quart hot water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Using a vegetable peeler, remove and discard peel from eggplants. Cut eggplants in half. Remove pulp and discard stems and discard. Cut the pulp into very thin slices and place slices in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Mix oregano and water in a medium bowl and pour over eggplant slices. Bake in the preheated oven until eggplant is soft and lightly browned, about 50 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 425 degrees f. Remove baking dish from oven and top with foil. Continue baking until eggs are firm, about 20 minutes. Place a serving plate on top and remove foil. Makes 4 servings.

title: Portabella, and Kale Hash
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, stems and leaves washed, stems removed, and finely chopped | 8 medium portabella mushrooms, stems and leaves finely chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pimiento | 1 finely chopped yellow onion
instructions: In a 10 inch skillet, steam the kale just until wilted and tender. Using a slotted spoon remove the kale to a bowl and set aside. Add the rest of the ingredients and whisk again.

title: Roquefort & Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2/3 cup dry white wine or 2/3 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 1 tablespoon grated romano-reggiano cheese or 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese to taste | freshly ground pepper | 4 -6 ripe mixed fresh fruit, such as raspberries, blueberries, apricots, cranberries, strawberries, melon lollies ( optional )
instructions: Pour canola oil into a medium bowl. Add wine and grenadine and stir to combine. Add cheese and pepper, to taste. Add fruit, toss, cover and let sit at room temperature for at least 45 minutes to develop the flavors. To serve, place a few mixed fruit in your glass, top with a few croutons and serve as a condiment, or garnish with a sprinkling of grated cheese.

title: Pear and White Chocolate Bark for Bark
ingredients: 1 can baked beans, undrained | 2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard | 2 1/2 ounces white chocolate chips, melted | 1 pear, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place drained beans in a medium bowl. Drizzle each piece with mustard and stir in chocolate chips. Toss to coat. Spoon into a 9 inch square glass baking dish, smoothing top. Garnish with pear.

title: Spicy and Spicy Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, cut into 1 x 1 inch strips | 1 tablespoon mustard oil | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained
instructions: Thread strips of beef onto skewers. Brush with mustard oil and thread onto soaked wooden skewers. Grill over medium heat about 5 minutes per side or until desired doneness.

title: Barbecued Kiwi Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg lamb | 200 ml heinz tomato ketchup | 1 red pepper | 200 g kiwifruit sliced thinly
instructions: Cut the lamb into cubes and put into a large bowl with the ketchup and pepper. Toss well and leave for at least an hour. Meanwhile cut the kiwifruit into long slices and thread onto long bamboo skewers. Cook over hot coals, grill or barbecue plate for 15 - 20 mins turning, till lamb is well browned and the kiwifruit is tender and sticky.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,almond extract,pimiento,pasta,italian sausage,lemon juice zest
title: Stuffed Calzone
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage ( about 2/3 of an italian sausage ) | 1 jar stuffed pimientos, drained ( about 3/4 cup ) | 5 ounces button mushrooms, drained ( about 1/3 of an italian saute ) | 1 grated lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 2 cups dry short pasta, cooked as directed on package
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. In a large skillet, heat the sausage until crumbly. Using a slotted spoon, remove from skillet. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a bowl. Discard any drippings in the skillet and reserve. Add pimentos, mushrooms, lemon zest, almond extract and reserved saute liquid. In a bowl, combine pasta and reserved sausage drippings. Spoon about 2 tablespoons pasta stuffing into a 12 ½”x10” baking dish. Using an ice cream scoop, dollop 1/4 cup filling onto the pasta. Top with remaining stuffing. Bake until stuffing is hot and crispy, about 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,ancho chile powder,poblano chile,green capsicum,reynolds wrap foil
title: Roasted Pork Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, roasted, deseeded, chopped | 1 red capsicum, roasted, deseeded, chopped | 1 package pepperoni | 1 green capsicum, roasted, deseeded, chopped | reynolds wrap foil, to spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In food processor or blender pulse the poblano, capsicum, pepperoni and green pepper until finely chopped. Season and mix well. Skewer the roast beef and place onto a piece of reynolds wrap with equal amounts of the roast beef, capsicum mixture and the roasted chile. Brush all sides of foil lightly with vegetable oil. Place the foil onto your upper oven rack. Place the roasting tin on the middle rack of the oven. Cook in oven for about 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Chef John's Spaghetti Crunch With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 200 g dried spaghetti | 300/5 ml double cream ( optional ) | 300 ml buttermilk ( see method below ) | 1 -2 tablespoon grand marnier ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | bread flour, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas mark 4 or 180c/350°f place a large baking tray into the oven, and line each with parchment paper and some greaseproof paper. Rinse and boil spaghetti until tender drain, and set aside in colander. Meanwhile, place the buttermilk in a pan over gentle heat and warm slightly. When it begins to bubble, remove from heat with a slotted spoon and stir in the grand marnier and vanilla essence. Taste and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper, and set aside for 5 minutes. Whisk the cream and the buttermilk mixture into the hot spaghetti until thick and creamy. Season with the grand marnier, and transfer to prepared trays, turning to coat. Sprinkle in the toasted breadcrumbs and bake in small batches for 15 minutes until the biscuits are crisp and browned. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Japanese Rice Rolls (Toshikari Ume Dango)
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed and at room temperature | 6 tablespoons sushi rice, sushi rice | 1/2 lb sushi rice ( i use king's brand ) | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 teaspoon rose essence
instructions: Lightly grease cookie sheet with some cooking spray and preheat your oven to 375°f roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface to a rectangle about 1/8 in thick. Using a floured rolling pin, press out the pastry and cut into 3 - 8 squares or rectangles, depending on exact size and thickness of your rice sheets. Put a scoop of rice in the middle, then arrange the rice in a straight line along the length of the pastry. Fold both long sides over the rice, and press the edges out. Put another sheet of pastry on top, and repeat with the rest of the dough.

title: Spicy Vegetable Sammies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg | 2 packages frozen asparagus, thawed | 2 medium potatoes, peeled and halved | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 3/4 cup mexican-style processed cheese
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir hot asparagus in the hot skillet until just lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from heat and drain asparagus in a colander.

title: Crispy Cashews
ingredients: 1 lb salted cashews | 1/2 lb tomatillo, husked and washed, stems intact, rinsed and dried | 1/2 cup dry-roasted salted cashews | 3/4 cup white sugar | 2 1/2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f. Butter a baking sheet with baking spray.

title: Radicchio and Yellow Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 large yellow pepper, diced | 3/4 cup fresh mint leaves | 2 1/4 pounds radicchio, trimmed
instructions: Combine the pepper, mint leaves, and radicchio in a large bowl. Toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Cauliflower Adobo
ingredients: 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 1/2 pounds cauliflower florets, chopped
instructions: Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir cauliflower into hot oil.

title: Herbed Herbed Rice
ingredients: 150 g fresh mixed herbs, such as dandelion greens, savoy cabbage, rocket, arugula, parsley | 4 tablespoons extra virgin rice wine
instructions: Wash the herbs and any damaged herbs. Rinse them. Dress with the remaining half the extra virgin rice wine and toss to combine and leave to marinate for 20 minutes. Put the remaining herbs into a pestle and mortar and pound with a pestle until you have a textured paste. Drain the herbs then coarsely chop the ingredients. Add them to the herb/rice paste and toss to combine. Cover with foil and refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Taco-Style Tri-Tip with Chili and Spicy Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb tri-tip steak, lean | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup hot taco sauce
instructions: Rub steak with seasoning mixture and let marinate at least 30 minutes or longer in refrigerator. Heat a skillet with 1/4 inch of high heat and add all ingredients except the steak. Stirring for about 30 seconds or so, cook steak about 3 minutes on each side, or until internal temperature reads 155f degrees with tips of thick steak. Remove from heat. Brush beef with additional soy sauce and serve on a bed of your favourite hot beans. Note i also like to add a few jalapeno peppers, cayenne pepper or a few serrano chile peppers.

title: Vegan Black Bean Sriracha
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian refried beans, any flavor | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 teaspoon chili paste with garlic
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Allow to sit in refrigerator for at least one hour or overnight.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,anchovy oil,extra virgin olive oil,bread crumb,marjoram,cabbage,oregano leaf
title: Enchilada Bake II
ingredients: 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 4 heads cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 bunch fresh marjoram | 6 anchovy oil, drained and chopped - 1 1/4 t. | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 cup bread crumbs | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In large mixing bowl, stir together enchilada sauce and cabbage. Place anchovies in bowl, and cover bowl with plastic wrap. Let anchovies soak in sauce for an hour, and shake the anchovies out of the sauce. Drain cabbage mixture. Mix together marjoram and oregano leaves, and stir into cabbage mixture. Mix in breadcrumbs, and olive oil until just mixed. Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan or a large baking dish with plastic wrap. Pour cabbage mixture into pan. Bake 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until a fork goes into center before the center of the loaf if stuck. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Tamarind Toast
ingredients: 2 slices bread | 1/2 cup tamarind syrup | paprika
instructions: Heat a heavy pan. Add 1 tbsp tamarind syrup and toast the bread till browned. Slice bread into 2 or 3 thin circular slices. Spread one side of the toast with 1 tbsp tamarind syrup. Sprinkle paprika over the toast. Serve immediately.

title: Apple, Cucumber & Apple Salad - Martha Stewart
ingredients: 1 apple, cored and finely chopped | 1/3 cup finely chopped cucumber | 1/3 cup taco seasoning ( to taste ) or 1/3 cup other hot pepper sauce | 1/16 teaspoon msg ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,onion powder,star anise,cardamom seed,cilantro stem,pimiento,velveeta cheese
title: Crispy Baked Fish
ingredients: vegetable oil or lard, for deep frying | 1 piece white fish fillet, skin removed and deveined | 1 can petite diced tomatoes, drained | 1 tablespoon cilantro stem, packed | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 2 teaspoons pimientos, diced peeled | 2 teaspoons white fish fillet, skin removed and deveined, deveined and patted dry
instructions: Heat half the oil in a pan over medium high heat. Place the fish fillet in the skillet and cook until golden and flakey, about 3 minutes, moving pieces of fish around so that they brown on all sides. Drain off any excess oil remaining in the pan. Turn the heat to medium. Add remaining oil to empty pan and heat till hot but not smoking. Add tomatoes, cilantro stem, cardamom seeds, onion powder and the pimentos.

title: Chef John's Famous Spicy Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 box mac & cheese classic mac & cheese classic mac 'n cheese classic mac mix | 1 1/2 cups light coconut milk powder | bacon grease, or as needed | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine mac & cheese® classic mac and cheese® classic mac and cheese® classic macowder mix in a large bowl. Drizzle about 1/4 cup bacon grease per 4 serving of mac & cheese® classic mac treats. Squeeze lime wedge over the top of each mug of mac & cheese® classic mac treats. Sprinkle top of Mac treats with salt & pepper. Place 8 individual foil cups of foil in a 10 by 15 inch baking dish. Carefully transfer foil cups to the center of each pan. Cook until mac treats are just heated through, 3 to 8 minutes. If your mac & cheese treats just begin to burn, cover the foil cups with foil immediately for a crisp finish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,chicken bouillon cube,phyllo pastry
title: Pork Phyllo
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork loin roast, boneless | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 package phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place pork loin roast in roasting pan and cover with some water. Cover and roast about 1 1/2 hours or until the meat reaches 115 degrees. Drain off fat. Cool and shred meat, stir in bullion and cover pot. Set aside and place remaining dough in plastic zip lock bag,. Squeeze out as much air as possible. Cut pieces with scissors or two knives you may need to do this in two batches. Put pieces on a lightly floured board and knead with hands or work surface for a few minutes. Place in freezer for 2 hours. Thaw dough in fridge for 30 minutes. Remove from freezer and punch down with fork and then divide into 8 equal parts. Place two parts on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet, each about 14 inch in length. Using a sharp knife, cut a diamond or square pattern on top. Place other half on top. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 450 for 20 - 30 minutes. Remove from oven, brush with beaten egg and return to 375.

title: Homemade Pizza Dough
ingredients: 300 g yeast | 300 g fresh basil, trimmed and minced | 35 g salt
instructions: If you are using a 5 liter container, sprinkle the yeast over one cup water and let it proof for 20 minutes. Rinse the yeast with cold water and rub it into the water until it looks like a gritty water. In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients, mixing well. Transfer the dough to an oiled bowl and knead until it comes smooth and elastic but not sticky. Cover with a wet cloth and set aside on a kitchen towel. Allow to rise for one hour, or until doubled in size. Knead the dough with your hands and transfer to a floured work surface. Knead or knead the dough with your hands until it forms a round, elastic ball. Lightly dust with flour, remove the dough from the bowl and shape into a ball by stretching the edges and stretching the tips of your hands. Cover with a damp cloth and set aside to rest for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the pizza stone on the middle shelf and bake for 12 minutes, or until the crust is golden. Using a metal slotted spoon, remove the pizza from the oven and immediately slide it onto a cooling rack. Sprinkle with extra basil and serve.

title: Italian Spice Blend(Gravlax)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning ( gravlax ) | 1 tablespoon mixed spice ( gravlax )
instructions: Mix together. Use as required to store away from direct sunlight.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,celery seed,cashew,sesame seed,apple juice,canola oil,basil,baking powder
title: Apple Seed Cookies
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups canola oil | 1 1/2 cups cashews | 3/4 cup dry crushed pineapple | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon basil, dried | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/4 cup dried sesame seeds
instructions: Heat canola oil at a low setting, stirring frequently. Cool until warm to touch, but not hot. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine cashews, crushed pineapple, lemon juice, basil, salt, and baking powder. Stir well. Pour warm oil into a shallow dish or skillet. Dip heaping tablespoons of dough into oil and then press into cashew mixture to coat. Chill on paper towels, until heats.

title: Cheesy Mince
ingredients: 1 pint kidney bean | 1 cup cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, grated ( or ginger powder ) | 12 dates, cut into small pieces ( or your favourite dates ) | 2 tablespoons crisco
instructions: Use a large oven proof frying pan or large griddle to cook the mince, until evenly browned.

title: Homemade Cheese

title: Pumpkin Candy 1999
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pumpkin puree | 1 pinch of grated nutmeg | 2 tablespoons golden syrup ( or other flavor you love ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 3 -4 tablespoons peanut oil ( i use light tasting oil ) | 1 teaspoon savory or 4 -5 drops poultry seasoning ( optional )
instructions: First, make sure you have 3 - 4 tablespoons of peanut oil in the container for the filling. Add all the dry ingredients into the large bowl. Add pumpkin puree, golden syrup, nutmeg, seasoning salt. Mix lightly together. Then pat into paper thin rectangular shape on counter top with wax paper, like square, so there are long strips of wax on top. You can use a flat edged spatula in the palms of your hand. With a knife, slice with a sharp serrated knife as if cutting a cross. Keep the wax paper between slices so they don't burn. Now sprinkle the wax paper with the savory or poultry seasoning. This is not meant to be powdery stuff. You have a clean paper and herb treat with plenty of savory. It gives that special flavor. Now, lay a sheet of wax paper or parchment paper on a flat surface. Slice off about 2 - 3 inch by 2 inch pieces. Using your fingers, press the dough along the sides of the wax paper in a circle about 3/4 inch thick and about 6 to 8 inches in diameter. This is important to prevent your hands from getting tired and to tear the dough from the edges of the wax paper. If your fingers break right up into pieces, break the dough. You can break it up into smaller pieces if it breaks up into smaller pieces, if it breaks over into smaller pieces. Lay a piece of wax paper or parchment paper on the flat surface. Press the dough out into a small rectangular shape. Using your hands, press the dough up and down on the wax paper to form a square about 6 to 8 inches in diameter. Make sure the top of the dough is facing you. Keep the wax paper or parchment covered with wax paper or parchment paper so the dough does not splatter. Turn upside down on the work surface and use the wax paper or parchment to cover it loosely with wax paper or parchment paper. Pressing gently into the dough. You have a beautiful rectangle of wax paper or parchment paper that has a slightly higher rim than the whole bottom. If you press the wax paper on top of the dough and the parchment covered dough, that can be seen through the top of the wax paper. Now, cut some small vent holes in the top of the dough with a sharp knife. Put a spoonful of filling into the hole of dough. Try to leave space about 1/4 inch from the top of the dough. You should find that at this point any filling can fall into the hole. If it does, put the spoonful on the surface of the dough with the spoon full of filling. You should end up with a wonderful round or square filled with filling. Now, lay a strip of waxed paper or parchment paper standing over the top of the filled dough. Try to leave a lot of dough uncovered, as the wax paper will soak up too much water while baking. Carefully lift the parchment paper or paper and the dough will start sticking. If you notice too much filling, try dipping the back of a spoon into the hot dripping drippings.

title: Easy Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 cups canned mixed vegetables | 2 garlic cloves | 5 cups reduced-fat coconut milk | 1 cup chopped baby bok choy ( about 4 green leaves ) | 3 teaspoons soft medjool dates, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Coarsely chop garlic and discard garlic. Combine vegetables, garlic and coconut milk in a 6 quart slow cooker and stir to combine. Cover and cook on high setting for about 3 hours. Stir in the brine, baby bok choy and dates just before serving.

title: Curried Onions on Skewers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( or more, to taste ) | 1 -4 tablespoon spanish curry paste | 1 large spanish onion, halved and thinly sliced
instructions: Thread onion onto several skewers. Grill or fry skewers over medium heat until golden brown and cooked through, approximately 3 - 4 minutes per side for medium.

title: Glazed Mustard
ingredients: 500 ml prepared honey mustard | 300 g of chopped pecans, toasted
instructions: Spread the mustard on a very, thickly flavoured plate, then spread with the pecan pieces and chill in the refridgerator for up to 1 week. Toasting for up to 1 week.

title: Steamed Beef With Pears
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef | 150 g of chopped pears | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Mix and put through a steamer. Steam for 1hr or until tender. Enjoy the aroma.

title: Peanut Oil Chicken wingettes With Mussels, Bacon, Vanilla & Peppercorns
ingredients: 2 lbs mussels, in the shell | 1 bunch of thin scallions or 1 bunch white onion, chopped ( 1 bunch ) | 1 slice bacon or 1 slice rind of bacon, chopped | 2/3 cup chicken or 2/3 cup vegetable stock | 1 1/2 - 2 cups peanut oil or 2 1/2-2 cups other neutral flavored oil | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon flour | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Poke several holes in the shell of each mussel, pour some peanut oil into the wells, place chicken or bacon in the bottom. Push the mussels and onion pieces with their shells in the hole in the top and set aside. Wash the shrimp and remove the beard and make a slit in the shell using a sharp knife. Do not remove the mussel, don't worry, it will sink to the bottom. Open the mussels and add the shrimp, bacon or onion filling under the hole in the top of the shell and push to the side. Pour stock about 1/2 inch deep into a small saucepan and add the 1 tbsp or so of flour and a tablespoon of white pepper. Place over high heat until mixture boils, stirring constantly. Reduce heat & simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Place mussels in a bowl and fill with a little of the liquid from the pan. Cover and leave to steam undisturbed for 3 minutes. Uncover and add remaining liquid to pan. Break up any shells and open mussels, add to the pan with liquid and return to boil for 2 - 3 minutes until mixture is thickened. Serve hot or cold.

title: Ancho Enchilada
ingredients: 2 ancho chilies | 1/2 cup cream of coconut
instructions: Cut ancho chilies in half and remove the seeds. Place the chilies and 1/2 cup of cream in a small pot set over low heat. As soon as they are warm, remove from heat. Stir in the remaining 1/2 cup of cream. Serve with spanish style corn chips.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 1/4 ounce dry yeast | 1 lb penne | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 10 ounces poppy seeds | 2 -3 cups cooked rice | red hot sauce
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Cover and set aside in a warm place. When lukewarm, add penne and salt and stir to coat. Set in a warm place to rise until doubled. Turn out onto floured surface and knead for 1 minute. Return to bowl and place in a warm spot. Cover and set aside in a warm place for 2 hours. Drain, rinse with cool water and dry with paper towel. Spread cooked rice on a large baking sheet and spread out. Place a heaping teaspoon of poppy seed on top and then place a tablecloth on it. Make diagonal cuts across the beans about 1/2 inch apart. Place the cooked noodles on top of the poppy seed and seasonings. Cover and let rise until doubled. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,hummus,baking chocolate,palm sugar,chicken thigh,water,baby spinach
title: Spinach, Chicken & Almond Cake With Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 300 g baking chocolate or 300 g drinking chocolate | 250 g honey-flavoured almond paste ( about 20 pieces ) | 2 teaspoons sweet moroccan stir-fry palm sugar | 3 1/2 - 4 3/4 lbs chicken thighs, cut in half ( chicken breasts or leg ) | 14 ounces baby spinach, washed | 1/2 cup water | 1/4 cup halved roasted salted almond and almond paste, warmed
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f melt chocolate and honeyflavoured almond paste in a small heatproof bowl over hot water, stirring till smooth. Cool slightly. Add sugar, stirring to combine. Place chicken thighs skin side down in shallow roasting tin. Pour marinade over chicken. Set aside 20 minutes. Roast chicken for 20 minutes. Turn chicken over and roast for 25 minutes longer or until cooked through. Remove from oven. Drain off any excess fat. Place spinach in a large lidded salad bowl. Sprinkle with water. Cover and set aside for 3 minutes. Drain excess water. Add spinach to spinach in pan. Add basil, almond paste and warm water. Toss to combine. Serve chicken, spoon sauce around the plate, garnish with almond and almond slices.

title: Ancho Chiles and Apples
ingredients: 1 fresh ancho chile | about 5 tablespoons apple juice or about 2 cups apple juice
instructions: Wash, remove stems and seeds from chiles. Slice chiles lengthwise along the cut side of the chile and remove veins & seeds. Place chile in a saucepan, pour boiling water over and cover with lid. Steam for 15 - 20 minutes or until chiles are completely softened. Remove from heat and allow to steep for 30 minutes. Remove chiles and transfer to blender. Add enough apple juice to cover chiles/puree. Puree or process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,chow mein noodle,cream celery soup,mace blade,green chile pepper,orange zest,cherry tomato
title: Chow Mein Salad
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 10 cherry tomatoes, or more to taste | 1 pinch ground mace blade | 4 mince blades
instructions: Whisk sour cream, cream of celery soup, orange zest, chile peppers, tomatoes, and mace together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Cook mince blades in a skillet over medium heat until evenly browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Drain mince, reserve liquid, and place bacon in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Pour bacon mixture into a bowl. Garnish with mince blades.

title: Dill Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1 tablespoon orange rind | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 -2 teaspoon bottled sweet-sour sauce
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients in a blender until very smooth. Pass mixture through a sieve into a bowl. Stir in sweet sauce. This soup is nice served with fresh bread for dipping.

title: Beef and Pasta for Two
ingredients: 500 g ready to eat italian v8, cut in thin slices | 1 brown onion, sliced into very thin half moons | 3 beef bouillon cubes, if desired ( or 2 smaller ones, if desired ) | 1 packet ditalini, cook and drain ( pasta or penne pasta, depending on your taste )
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions and drain. Place beef and onion on plates, pour v 8 on top or serve separately for dipping.

title: The Best Salad Recipe
ingredients: 3 cups bow tie pasta ( uncooked ) | 1 small celery rib, diced | 1/4 cup applesauce | 1/4 cup corn oil
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta and return to the hot pot. Add celery, applesauce and corn oil. Stir to combine well. Cook and stir another minute or two before removing soup from heat.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,thyme sprig,marsala wine,basil,chipotle powder,italian salad dressing
title: Tilapia Fillets With Herb Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs fillets | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium terany sprigs | 1 teaspoon dried italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup reduced-sodium port wine or 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 3/4 teaspoon chipotle powder
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Combine terany and salad dressing and set aside. Brush fillets with oil.

Random Ingredients: bay seasoning,caster sugar,bay leaf,coconut cream,black pepper
title: Coconut Crackle Cake
ingredients: 8 ounces coconut cream | 3 tablespoons caster sugar, see note | 1/4 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1 bay leaf | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and stir until well combined. Place in an airtight container for up to about 4 days before you wish to serve the crumble crumble cake.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,asparagus,flour tortilla,caster sugar,red cherry,quinoa
title: Quick and Easy Spring Rolls
ingredients: 225 g asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2 cm pieces | 1/2 cup red cherries, halved | 1/2 cup couscous or 1/2 cup pearl onion, soaked in | 3/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 flour tortilla, to serve
instructions: Place the asparagus, cherries and couscous in the bowl of a food processor and process until smooth. Add the dark soy sauce, sugar and nuts and process until mixture is smooth. Divide between the 4 tortillas. Spoon over asparagus paste and roll up. Serve with plain yoghurt or sour cream.

title: Kalalecen (Prune Almonds)
ingredients: 1/2 pound prunes | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Place prunes in a bowl. Sprinkle with almonds. Cover with remaining prunes, then press down lightly to compact.

title: Hot and Spicy Grilled Steak
ingredients: 4 top sirloin steaks | 1 jar roasted red peppers ( about 1 1/2 cups jar ) | 1 package grated edgerman gouda cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Place steaks on a heavy foil lined baking sheet. Place 2 teaspoons coke mixture into center of each steak. Sprinkle peppers and cheese over steaks. Place baking sheet on grill, close lid, and grill steaks about 3 minutes on each side for medium rare, or until desired doneness. Serve.

title: Mango cheek Appetizer
ingredients: 2 corn tortillas, cut into 2 x 1 inch strips | 1 mango cheek, peeled and cut into thin wedges
instructions: Prick each cube of mango cheek with a fork so the pieces curl slightly. Arrange one tortilla onto a microwave safe plate. Pour 1/2 of mango cheeks onto tortilla. Top with another tortilla and cook in the microwave for approximately 2 minutes on full power. Remove from the microwave and cut into four equal pieces. Serve warm.

title: Coconut Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups desiccated coconut flakes | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning, of your choice | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced
instructions: Combine coconut, butter/margarine/flour mixture, olives and seasonings in a medium sized bowl, combining well. Roll into small balls, rolling them gently in the coconut mixture to coat well. Place on greased tray. Chill in fridge for at least 1 hour. Bake in preheated oven for 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown. Serve.

title: Honey Roasted Tia Maria Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 jar chili sauce | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons capers | 17 ounces tia maria | 5 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Tear off a 3 1/2 to 4 pound piece of heavy duty aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,basil,poppy seed,mint sprig,citrus peel,sirloin tip roast,cider vinegar,celery rib
title: Strip Beef for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 cup chopped celery rib | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil | 2 tablespoons dried citrus peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh citric acid ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar ( optional ) | 8 lbs sirloin tip roast, trimmed of fat | chopped fresh basil, for garnish
instructions: Combine sour cream, celery, basil, citrus peel, poppy seeds and citric acid. Cover and chill for at least 8 hours. Remove meat from marinade and coat lightly with the marinade. Let stand at room temperature about 15 minutes. Preheat broiler. Grill meat, brushing with marinade, until done, 15 - 20 minutes. Cut into serving size portions. Serve with a garnish of fresh basil.

title: Minty Vegemite Raita
ingredients: 3/4 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 pint fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced | 1 cup frozen corn cobs, well cooked | 1/2 cup fresh corned beef or 1/2 cup chopped veal, cooked | 1 tablespoon ghee ( clarified butter ) or 1 tablespoon butter | fresh mint leaves ( to garnish ) or fresh parsley sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except mint or parsley in a glass serving dish. Whisk until mixture is blended together well. Serve immediately, garnished with fresh mint or parsley.

title: Tofu Mash with Black Beans
ingredients: 1/2 russet potato, medium diced | 1 -2 tablespoon brandy or 1 -2 tablespoon whiskey | 2 -3 tablespoons flour | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon turmeric powder ( optional to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dried basil leaves | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the diced potato and heat for five minutes, or until you can poke it all the way through with a fork. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix brandy and 1 teaspoon of turmeric, if using. Dip the potato chunks in the brandy and then drop them into the boiling water. Lower the heat slightly and simmer covered for 20 - 30 minutes, or until tender. When the potatoes are just about done, add in the chopped basil and 1/2 cup of water. Heat for another 5 - 10 minutes. When you remove the lid, the beans will be a bit softer and have a lot of wonderful mashed potatoes. Drain the beans and mash with a potato masher or a wooden spoon. Add the balance of the turmeric if using and blend through the mashed potatoes. Add about 2 2/3 tablespoons of water if necessary to give a thick creamy consistency, but not watery at all, like you were making mash in before.

title: Lime Salt and Pepper
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 large lemons, scrubbed and thinly sliced into rounds
instructions: Combine the salt and salt in a shallow bowl. Add the lemons and toss to coat. Arrange the lemons around the sides of a microwave safe nonreactive baking dish. Microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring once, or until lemons soften. Remove lemon pieces from oven using a slotted spoon and transfer the lemons to the prepared dish. Turn the dish to cover lemons tightly with foil and keep in a cool, dry place for 6 to 8 hours, tossing occasionally, to release any juices. Preheat a grill pan to medium high. Sprinkle the lemons with salt. Set the pan over medium high heat. Grill lemons, turning once, until completely dry and slightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Transfer the lemons to a dry towel. Wipe the pan clean and return it to medium heat. Return lemons to the microwave. Cook, pulsing 4 times, until juice begins to form, about 30 seconds. Dip the lemons in the lemon juice and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: turkey,gruyere cheese,tart apple,yellow mustard seed,lettuce leaf,baby bok choy
title: Aardappel Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 5 ripe tart apples | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 bunch baby bok choy | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds | 4 lettuce leaves | 4 lettuce leaves, for lining bowls ( such as spinach, kale, kale or bibb )
instructions: Core apples and remove core. Slice apple into 1/4 thick half moons. Place apples and cheese in toaster oven and toast until cheese is melted, about 2 - 3 minutes. Remove apples and carefully slice the other side. Remove the toast from the oven and spread mustard seeds on toasted slices of bread. Place a few napkins on a board and mound the apple and cheese in the center of a lettuce leaf. Top with a few leaves of bok choy and pile some of the toasted side of the toast. Wear lettuce leaves and serve with salad.

title: Russian Tea Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix confectioners' sugar and vanilla together in a bowl. Drop small amounts of the mixture on cookie sheets. Let cool completely. Store in airtight container until ready to use. To make frosting, beat confectioners' sugar and vanilla together with an electric mixer in a bowl until fluffy.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,rice noodle,peanut oil,pecan half,red bean,tomato paste,greek seasoning
title: Vegan Fried Noodles
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 3 cups peanut oil | 1 cup red beans, chopped | 1 can black beans with roasted pimento and red peppers | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons all purpose greek seasoning | 1 1/2 cups pecan halves ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain, and rinse with cold water until cool. Cut 1 cup of beans into thin strips. Set aside. Heat 1/4 cup peanut oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the red beans, black beans, and tomato paste. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the rice noodles and greek seasoning. Simmer until heated through.

Random Ingredients: linguine pasta,part ricotta cheese,pineapple,star anise,vanilla bean,deli ham,chicken thigh,pork shoulder
title: Linguine With Ham and Pork
ingredients: 1 whole skinless chicken thigh | 1/2 lb lean boneless pork shoulder | 1/2 lb deli ham, cut in cubes | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese or 1 cup cottage cheese, drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 whole star anise | 1 package linguine pasta, cooked and drained | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Cut chicken in half and set aside. Cut ham in very thin slices and set aside. Cut pork into thin slices and set aside. Cut up ham and pork into little cubes if you prefer. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a medium saute pan that is non stick. Add all of the pieces of chicken and pork, then cook and stir until chicken is brown and crispy. Remove. In a large bowl mix ricotta, cinnamon, star anise and pineapple mixture. Add cooked pasta, ham and pork and stir just to combine. Add sausage and mix well. Add cooked pasta to dish and stir. Then serve.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,cooking spray,vanilla bean,garlic powder,pea,cardamom pod,basil,yeast
title: Gluten Free and Yeast Bread
ingredients: 1 sachet dried yeast | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1 tablespoon dried pea | 1/2 teaspoon dried cardamom pods | 500 ml warm-temperature water | cooking spray | 2 teaspoons dried garlic powder | 1/2 vanilla bean
instructions: Combine the yeast, basil and pea in a 2 quart mixing bowl, cover and allow to sit until the yeast softens. Add the cardamom pods and continue to work the mixture with your fingers until the spices release their aromas and begin to smell familiar. This should take a few minutes. Add the water, cover and allow to leave for 5 - 10 minutes. Spray the dough ball of your choice with veggie oil and lightly dust with cooking spray. Place dough on a lightly floured surface and knead the dough for about 5 minutes, using oil or water as required. Dived the dough into 8 pieces. Stretch them for 6 - 8 minutes per side, or alternatively divide between your 2 - 3 baking sheets. Cover and allow to rise until doubled, about 45 minutes. Heat oven to 375°f. Brush a baking sheet with oil or water. Lightly dust the top of each dough ball with garlic powder and place in the oven. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until light brown. Remove from oven and allow to cool, then slice and serve enjoy.

title: Italian Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage link, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup vinegar
instructions: Grill sausages until cooked through, but not soft. While sausages are cooking, simmer the vinegar. Add to the vinegar. Serve over hot buttered noodles.

title: Spinach-Fish Bake
ingredients: 500 g potatoes, cut into 4cm chunks | 400 g fish fillets, cut into slices | 5 -6 cups baby spinach | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary or 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 cups macaroni, cooked
instructions: Cook potato in boiling salted water for 6 - 8 minutes until soft. Mix with fish, spinach, rosemary and nutmeg. Place in an oven proof dish. Bake in a moderate oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with coriander and serve.

title: Tavukari Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy lard or 3 tablespoons lard, melted and heated | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet spanish rice wine )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the melted lard and turmeric. Then stir in the mirin and cool to room temperature. Refrigerate any unused portions.

title: Cardamom Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs basmati rice, washed, soaked in plenty of water, for 2 to 3 hours, rinsed | 1/2 lb green olives | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Put the soaked rice in the bottom of a pan over medium high heat. The water should not be boiling, but the water should be just below the level of the rice. Cover the pan. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes, shaking the pan frequently. Turn off the heat, and leave the rice in the pan. Keep the pan covered. Keep the rice covered, tightly, for 3 to 5 hours. Remove the lid about 20 minutes before you want to serve it. Place 4 - 5 fresh green olives on top. Cover with a thick cloth. Keep it in a warm oven until the olives are cool. Discard the olives after 5 days. The olives have been allowed to swell until they become liquid. If the olives absorb too much water, you can add a tablespoon or two of water. When the olives have swollen, add 1/2 tsp cardamom powder and stir. Keep on stirring. The cooked rice goes nicely fried, and should be tender and translucent. Serve hot. Note, if you have a rice cooker, do not drain the rice.

title: Homemade Onion Scented Yogurt Parfaits
ingredients: 500 g natural greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon green peppercorn | 1/4 teaspoon sherry wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons plain flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Using a teaspoon, scoop into 8 parfait glasses. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: pecan,half,grain white rice,orange zest,peppercorn,flour tortilla,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Rice Balls With Pecans and Oranges
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 2 cups half-and-half | 1 3/4 cups pecans | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1/3 cup flour tortilla, rolled between 2 hands | 3 tablespoons minced pecans, divided
instructions: Rinse rice, and place it in a large, shallow saucepan. Pour in enough water so that it covers the rice by 2 inches. Bring to a boil over high heat, then cook until the water is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Stir in the orange zest, half and half, 1 cup of pecans, and artichoke hearts. Transfer the rice to a bowl, and mix in the 2 tablespoons of pecans. Scoop into the center of a flour tortilla. Roll and place on a plate to keep warm while you cook the rest of the meal. To serve, sprinkle the remaining 1 tablespoon of pecans over the top of the rolled tortillas.

title: Chicken and Eggplant Sandwich
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked instant quinoa | 2 chicken cutlets | 1 large eggplant, cut into cubes | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1 loaf french bread
instructions: Break quinoa into bite size pieces. Spray nonstick skillet with pam. Saute chicken and eggplant in skillet over medium heat until cooked through and eggplant is browned. Mix rice and curry powder in small bowl. Spread one side of bread with quinoa mixture. Place two chicken, eggplant and onion in a bowl with rice mixture. Cut other side of bread in half, then spread sandwich with quinoa mixture. Cook in non stick skillet until warm. Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,oreo cooky,red currant preserve,wide egg noodle,seasoning salt,rice,vanilla
title: Pennsylvania Dutch Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles, cooked, drained | 1 can red currant preserves | 3/4 - 1 cup rice, cooked or 3/4-1 cup brown rice | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 can italian flat leaf parsley ( or 2 tablespoons italian parsley, crushed with a mortar and pestle about 1 tsp in a mortar and pestle ) | 1/2 teaspoon oreo cookies ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix all ingredients, refrigerate until ready to serve. Note, i recommend using the chewy stuff at room temperature rather than heating over medium heat for too long.

title: Budia's Asparagus Patties #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 4 ounces rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon tomato juice | 4 slices dill pickles | cornmeal, as needed
instructions: Prepare japanese style asparagus in boiling water & drain. Toss in oil, vinegar, & tomato in a skillet. Cook until the asparagus is crisp tender, approximately 10 minutes. Meanwhile preheat oven to 400°f. Form the rice dough into patties & place on baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes or until a pattie reads 160f.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,velveeta cheese,new potato,italian salad dressing,pork baby back rib,dark brown sugar
title: Baby Back Ribs
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork baby back ribs | 1/3 cup fat-free italian salad dressing | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon hot tabasco sauce or 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 12 medium new potatoes | 12 slices velveeta cheese, cut about 1/2 and 1/4-inch thick
instructions: Preheat oven to cook potatoes per package directions until just tender. Drain water and cool. Cut ribs into 2 ribs per pound. Slice potatoes into 1/2 wide slices. Place sliced potatoes in a 2 quart baking dish cut side up. Drizzle the ribs with salad dressing and sprinkle the sugar and hot sauce into the potatoes. Smooth ribs out the sides, and arrange in the baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 2 to 3 hours. To serve, arrange ribs on platter and sprinkle with the cheese. Serve with warm tomato and tomato basil or red wine, and green salad.

title: Beef With Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 2 -3 tablespoons parsley leaves, fresh, chopped | 2 cups whipping cream | 4 -6 fresh thai basil
instructions: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs and parsley until combined. Put in a casserole. Beat whipping cream and fresh basil. Pour over beef mixture. Cover and bake 350°f for 45 minutes.

title: Ouzo-Spicy French Toast
ingredients: 2 slices country bread | 1/4 cup doubanjiang ( malaysian dumpling paste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, diced
instructions: On a lightly buttered griddle or pan, mix the dumpling paste and sage together. Dunk the bread and butter slices into the mixture until saturated but not mushy. Brown each side briefly on the griddle for a second or two on each side. Serve with kikkoman sweet soy sauce and kikkoman sweet chili sauce. Recipe variation, make the dumpling sauce in advance and store in air tight jar. Note, if you don't use this sauce the mixture can be reheated and mixed with water in a nonstick fry pan, but be sure to stir before use to avoid burning the top. Variation with savory sweet chili sauce, instead of the dumpling paste you can use regular sweet chili sauce. Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of ginger. This is an excellent variation to use on pork, eggs or chicken. Use sparingly when mixing with fish or vegetables. Substituting a red pepper, can replace the red pepper with a chile if desired. Tip, the bread can sometimes come off easily. I find both to be extremely dry when i slice it, but in the end results it has little stickiness. If you use dumpling paste, rinse the bread with cold water and dip into the heated dumpling sauce. Drain and then crumble into the sauce until coated. Tip, alternatively, when slicing the bread, you can use a frying pan. If you don't have a frying pan, you may use a griddle for a crisper bread. You may want to spread butter on the griddle.

title: Grilled Whole-Wheat Beer Can
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs whole malt beer, such as budweiser beer | 4 large apples - peeled and grated | 1 cup sliced mushrooms | 4 teaspoons red gold tequila | 1 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Place the beer, apples, mushrooms, tequila, and vinegar in the canning jar of a beer canner.

title: Pineapple Fried Wings
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh pineapple, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 quart chicken wings | 2 baking soda | 1 tart apple - peeled, cored and diced
instructions: Combine pineapple slices, wings, and baking soda in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Place apple in a bowl.

title: Spicy Salmon and Temptation - Emeril's Traditional Recipe!
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 4 ounces salmon fillets, chopped ( boneless skinless ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 teaspoons scotch bonnet peppers, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f in a small bowl, combine the salmon, thyme and pepper and mix well. Press the salmon mixture onto the breadcrumb/scallion/scallion/sunflower oil baking tray. Bake 10 mins or until golden brown. Cut into squares, serve.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,matzo cake meal,tagliatelle pasta noodle
title: Tagliatelle Cookies With Matzo Crust
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated matzo cake meal or 3 egg yolks | 1 package tagliatelle pasta noodles or ( 7 ounce ) package linguine, cooked, drained and reserved pasta water
instructions: Heat oven to 350f degrees. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray. Place matzoh in a food processor, add 1 package of noodles and process until fine, scraping down sides with rubber spatula, then add remaining noodles and process until fine, scraping between rubber spatula as needed. Add matzo mixture and 1/2 cup of reserved pasta water and process again. Turn pasta dough out onto floured surface and divide dough into two pieces and flatten each half into a rectangle 6x 12 inches and 1/2 inch thick. Bake 7 to 8 minutes or just until golden, then transfer to a wire rack to cool. When cool, remove from oven, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch slices and arrange on a foil covered baking sheet. Bake until golden, about 10 minutes. Let cool completely. Makes about 12 cookies. Company’s coming and eating.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,penne pasta,kernel corn,butternut squash,lime juice,feta cheese,baby spinach leaf,golden syrup
title: Squash & Spinach Pasta
ingredients: 400 g butternut squash, peeled and chopped into about 1. 6cm cubes | 400 g penne pasta | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 400 g mixed baby spinach leaves | 400 g whole kernel corn, drained | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 300 g crumbled reduced-fat feta cheese
instructions: Heat a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the squash in stages, alternating with the lime juice and beef bouillon granules until all is used up. Lower temperature and simmer, covered, for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the penne according to the packet instructions. Drain, then toss the pasta with the squash and saucepan mixture. Tip into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with the spinach, then drizzle over the golden syrup and feta. Toss gently.

title: Chicken Bologna
ingredients: 2 kg frying chickens | 125 g cottage cheese or 125 g goat cheese | 1 bunch fresh dill or 1 1/2 tablespoons dried dill | 1 egg yolk, beaten | pitted prune | grated locatelli ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken in a large roasting pan. Add the cottage cheese, chopped dill or dried dill and beaten egg yolk. Carefully spoon over some water to cover and leave to marinate for up to 5 hours. Preheat the oven at 190°c or 325°f. Bake, uncovered, in small, shallow roasting pans for 45 minutes, or until cooked. The internal temperature will rise as it bakes. Meanwhile, place the prunes in water, boil, then boil until soft. Drain the marinated chicken, reserve the cooking liquid. Take half the chicken off the bone and remove the rest. Pull the meat apart into bite sized pieces, removing the meat from the bones. Cut the meat into bite sized portions. Add half of the cheese to the pan. Dice the reserved chicken and add to the pan. Heat through. Turn the heat to low, add the prunes and continue stirring until heated through. Spread the remaining cheese on a small serving plate or small dish. Place the chicken on top and serve with warm bread.

Random Ingredients: white flour,greek yogurt,potato,tomato soup,peach,garlic powder,pine nut
title: Nana's Peach and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 can condensed potato soup | 1 can sliced peaches, drained drained | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons chopped unsalted pine nuts | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek yogurt
instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine the potato soup, peach slices, tomato soup, minced garlic, and greek yogurt. Stir in flour until smooth. In separate bowl, combine peach mixture and pine nuts. Pour onto apple mixture, stir until well coated. Allow to sit 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Stoofpeh (Broccoli Cheese Bites) II
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 3 packages active dry yeast | 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 bunches broccoli, cut into small pieces | 4 bananas, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. To make bread crumbs, in a large bowl, blend cake mix, yeast, honey and ketchup until a dough forms. Roll out dough to 1/8 inch. Cut out six 3 inch squares. Put 3 to 8 tablespoons of the cheese mixture, about 1 teaspoon per square, on the center of each square. Bring the sides together and pinch together the top of the two squares. Spoon the buns with a teaspoon or a little water in the bottom of a muffin tin. Place in preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until light brown. Serve warm.

title: Gingerbread Cookies (Gingerbread Cookies) Welsh
ingredients: 6 ounces grated strong white flour | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 2 tablespoons ginger syrup | 1 ounce chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 170°c or 170°c if you are using a fan forced oven. Mix everything in a bowl. Shape the dough into walnut sized balls and roll the balls in chocolate. Place the balls on an oven tray and bake for approx 25 minutes. Let cool. Store in an air tight container.

title: Macaroon Bars
ingredients: 8 ounces shredded coconut | 1 cup fresh orange juice | 6 ounces shredded sweetened coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line an 8 inch square baking pan with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, stir together the coconut and orange juice. Stir in the orange mixture. Press half of the mixture into the pan. Sprinkle half of the sweetened coconut over the top of the macaroon. Repeat layers with the remaining mixture. Bake in preheated oven, about 40 minutes. Set aside to cool completely, then cut into 18 individual bars.

title: Creamy Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 cup cranberry juice | 1 tablespoon heavy cream | 2 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped | 8 pita bread, cut into 8 pieces
instructions: Combine the vegetable stock, cranberry juice, and cream in a blender.

title: Dynamite (Danish)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tomatoes ( very ripe ) | 1 dash corn oil
instructions: Core tomatoes and put into hot pan with corn oil. When they turn to mush, drain tomatoes on paper towels and put into a sauce pan. Cover with tomato paste and salt. Keep pan on medium heat, stirring occasionally for around 15 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Corn and Arugula Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup corn syrup | 1 cup arugula, packed | 1/4 cup butter lettuce, chopped | 1 teaspoon maple syrup
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine corn syrup, arugula and butter. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the arugula just begins to wilt. Transfer to a serving platter. Drizzle warm corn and arugula mixture over lettuce wrap.

title: Roast Shallots
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shallots, very finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dry red wine | sea salt, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a medium size, shallow roasting tin with kitchen paper and sprinkle with garlic salt. Add shallots and dry red wine to the base of the tin and toss to combine. Roast in oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the shallots are dry and golden, crisp and golden. Turn out onto a chopping board and allow to rest for 5 minutes before slicing. To serve, place onto a large plate and serve with fresh seasonal salad.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,new potato,cold water,swede,teriyaki sauce,cilantro leaf
title: Crispy Potato-Swede Salad
ingredients: 10 new potatoes, scrubbed | 2 large swedes ( aka sweet potato ) | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup low sodium teriyaki sauce | 1/4 cup cold water | 2/3 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Cut new potatoes in half lengthwise and then cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Place in a medium saucepan with water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and cook until potatoes are fork tender and easily patted dry with a fork, 10 - 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander and shake to remove excess water. Set potatoes aside and allow to cool. When cool, arrange onto a lightly greased oven proof serving platter and cover completely with slices of swedes. In a small bowl, combine ricotta cheese, teriyaki and 1/4 cup water. Spread over potatoes and sprinkle with cilantro. Bake, uncovered in a 400 degree f oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until cheese is browned and bubbly. Cool 5 minutes, then cut into quarters.

Random Ingredients: salt,lime zest,stew meat,sherry wine vinegar,mango chutney
title: Mangalore Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat, cubed | 2/3 cup dry sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon lime zest, grated | 1 1/2 cups mango chutney | 1 teaspoon salt, to taste
instructions: Stir vinegar with lime peel in large crock pot. Add meat, and stir to coat with liquid. Cover crockpot, and cook on low heat 8 hours, or until meat is tender. Add mango chutney, and stir well. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,pimento pepper,cilantro,date,tomato green chilies,nori,amaretto liqueur,scallop
title: Medley With Seafood & Sushi
ingredients: 1/3 bunch fresh cilantro ( approx, approximately 6 cups ) | 2 ounces chopped sun-dried tomatoes ( about 1 1/2 cans ) | 1/4 cup julienned pimento pepper | 1/4 cup chopped pimento pepper ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 2 ounces chopped seeded chopped fresh tomatoes or 2 ounces roasted, julienned fresh tomatoes with jalapeno juice | 1 scallop | 1 teaspoon amaretto liqueur | 1 cup chicken stock
instructions: Combine first 15 ingredients and season with salt and pepper. Arrange scallop and seafood down centre of square slice of nori and put sauce down center on nori. Drizzle with liqueur.

title: Yummy Ziti
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked ziti pasta | 2/3 cup tahini
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking pan with aluminum foil. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook ziti in boiling water, stirring occasionally until tender yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl. While ziti is cooking, stir together the tahini and tahini sauce together in a small bowl. Drain ziti well and return to pot. Stir in sauce with tahini mixture. Transfer to baking pan. Bake in preheated oven until sauce is bubbling and lightly browned, about 1 hour.

title: Irish Beer Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beer | 1 green onion, sliced ( scallions ) | 1 kaffir lime leaf ( about 1/4 tsp. dried leaf )
instructions: Mix beer and onion, and pour over greens. Garnish with the lime leaves.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,salad oil,granny smith apple,parmesan romano cheese,rice vinegar,parsnip
title: Swiss Parsnips
ingredients: 3 medium parsnips, peeled, cut into 3/4-inch slices | 3 tablespoons raw rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 tablespoon granny smith apple, finely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped plus sprigs for garnish
instructions: Preheat broiler or grill. Arrange parsnips on a baking sheet.

title: Rice With Fennel (Tulsi)
ingredients: 300 g rice, washed & soaked in warm water for around 1 hour, before washing
instructions: Put the soaked rice & 3 cups of water in a pot. Keep on a tight fitting lid. Keep on a close lid for around 20 mins until all water is absorbed or cook on high till rice is cooked. Stir to ensure that the rice does not stick to the bottom of the pot. Do not discard the used water or any of the remaining water. Remove lid. Sprinkle with salt & mix well. Leave standing for 5 minutes. Garnish with fresh fennel seeds. Serve hot with cream. Tip, keep this rice covered in water and not on top of the rice. Note, if you have any of the required amount of rice to cook on the next day, you can also use the same water for soaking the rice & then use the same water to cook the rice. So, keep an eye on the rice at 2 hr before cooking, as the water could burn then you'll see the rice getting burnt. Keep cooking & check if it is done by putting a flat tray or bowl on the table & putting it in a warm oven. If it cooks well before your 2 hrs for around & then is cooked in about 2 hours your rice is ready but if it cooks too much you'll have a long grain rice.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,sesame oil,wheat couscous,white mushroom,cayenne,corn,olive oil,tamarind paste
title: Healthy Seaweed Couscous
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups whole wheat couscous | 1 can white mushrooms | 1 can tamarind paste | 1 can sweet corn | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( optional )
