instructions: Drain mushrooms and combine in a large glass bowl. Stir tamarind paste into mushrooms til dissolved. Stir remaining ingredients. Place a rack in the center of your oven and preheat to 400 degrees. Toss couscous through the masher until coated and transfer to a serving bowl. Serve immediately, with a drizzle of olive oil.

Random Ingredients: white bread,red cabbage,thyme leave,beef bouillon cube,saffron,yoghurt
title: Yemeni Cabbage (Yogurt & Saffron Filling)
ingredients: 1 bag yoghurt | 1 red cabbage, finely shredded ( or other green cabbage ) | 1 beef bouillon cube or 1 vegetarian vegetable bouillon cube | 1 pinch saffron | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme leave, chopped | 1 loaf white bread
instructions: Mix the yoghurt with the garlic powder & saffron. In a small pot bring the 3tbsp of milk to a boil and add the broth/broth. Remove the milk fro off the heat but keep stirring it to get rid of any lumps. Stir the strained milk into the yoghurt. Chop up the cabbage & add it into the yoghurt. Mix thoroughly & let sit for 5 mins then taste & add more saffron if this is too sour for you. Slice the bread & toast in a dry pan. Using a pastry brush, brush the untoasted bread with the hot milk & sprinkle with a few saffron seeds to taste & drizzle with some of the melted oil & serve in a small dish. It can also be eaten straight away, but tastes better after sitting for an hour & hour. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,head romaine lettuce,goat cheese,lamb,clove,grenadine,anise seed
title: Lamb, Goat Cheese, and Lettuce Salad With Garlicky Boats in a Punch Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean lamb, cut into thin strips | 4 ounces goat cheese, crumbled | 1 head romaine lettuce, rinsed, dried, torn into pieces | 1/4 cup dry rice wine ( or dry vermouth ) | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed | 2 garlic cloves | 1 1/2 tablespoons grenadine | 2 cloves
instructions: Bring 2 1/2 quarts or a medium dutch oven to a boil. Cook lamb until browned, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer meat to a plate.

title: Battered Buttermilk Biscuits
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1/4 cup buttermilk biscuits | 1/4 cup chopped yellow pepper
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c. Spray two ovenproof bowls with oil spray.. Tip in the flour. Add the buttermilk biscuits.. Drop a large tablespoon of mixture onto each biscuit. Bake for 10 minutes. The muffins should be lightly browned. Serve immediately.

title: Boursin Macaroni
ingredients: 1 package uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 bottle boursin cheese
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions.

title: Fesenbrodt - Eggplant With Cardamom
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 cup polenta | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Peel the eggplant, cutting a slit horizontally through the peel with a sharp knife and leaving the stem intact. Score each slice with a knife, cutting through the root end of the eggplant, as before. You want the slices to penetrate the skin, not separate. Sprinkle the slices with a little salt and lightly sprinkle with a little sugar. Broil them until cooked through, then cover the broiler for about ten minutes or until the tops turn a golden brown.

title: Thai Basil and Egg Substitute Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup egg substitute | 2 tablespoons thai basil, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons sparkling wine, such as sipping red
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the egg substitute, basil, parsley, and wine. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 1 week.

title: Ginger Chicken
ingredients: 5 -6 chicken wings ( wings and drumsticks ) | 6 tablespoons dried apricots | 6 tablespoons gingerroot | 1/4 cup apple juice | cracked peanuts
instructions: Combine marinade ingredients in a large bowl and mix well with your hands. Marinade the chicken in the mixture for at least 15 hours or overnight.. Grill the chicken until cooked through or bake in the oven. If desired, serve with steamed jasmine rice.

title: Avocado With Chili
ingredients: 2 avocados, peeled, and sliced ( about 1 cup ) | 12 ounces canned chili peppers, sliced | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted
instructions: Arrange the avocado in an attractive pattern on a platter. Sprinkle with chili peppers and almonds. Serve at once.

title: Penne With Cauliflower and Garlic
ingredients: 1/2 lb penne or 1/2 lb gemelli pasta | 1 head cauliflower | fish ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic
instructions: In a large pot add cauliflower and the juice from the fish, if desired. Simmer on the slow flame for about 45 minutes. Cook penne pasta according to directions, al dente. Drain. Add some olive oil to sauce, add the garlic, stir well and add the cauliflower, stir well. Serve hot.

title: Tori Kara Age Age (Japanese Roasted Chicken)
ingredients: 5 lbs roasting chickens, with skin | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet japanese rice wine ) | 1 cup double cream, whipped | 1/2 cup sour cream, whipped
instructions: Place chicken in a pot of water and bring to boil. Reduce to simmer and cook slowly for 40 - 50 minutes or until it reaches 220 degrees on a meat thermometer. When cool enough to handle remove chicken and skim fat off the sauce in the pot. Remove the skin and bones and discard. Cut the meat in pieces about 1/4 inch x 1/4 inch x 3 inches. Pour the vinegar into a 2 to 3 quart saucepan.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,blue cheese,vodka,chile adobo sauce,pepperoncini pepper,lemon zest
title: Mexican Corn Balls
ingredients: 2 cups cream-style corn | 1/3 cup crumbled blue cheese | 6 -8 pepperoncini peppers | 2 ounces red pickled chile in adobo sauce, chopped | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1 lemon, zest of
instructions: Mix the cream style corn, blue cheese, pepperoncini peppers, chilies and vodka in a bowl. Roll into golf ball sized balls and place on wax paper lined cookie sheet. Let sit for an hour. Make sure that the corn balls have a chance to dry out. Cook at 375 degrees for about 15 minutes or until the outside is nice and browned. Cut an x on top of each corn ball to make a criss cross pattern to let out the steam and make it feel really good. This is a very versatile recipe. You can add more or less the kinds of ingredients. The zest of the lemon is amazing on this. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,peanut oil vegetable,vegetable oil,xanthan gum
title: Greens and Whole Wheat Tvp (Veg*ngl Gluten
ingredients: 1 package xanthan gum | 1 package vegetable oil | 1 package baby spinach, washed and leaves. drained
instructions: In a bowl place the dry ingredients, mix well. Measure the amount of vegetable oil and water needed and add to the dry ingredients. Mix well. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 1 hour. Drain any liquid that accumulates on the surface and place in a covered container. Set aside to dry in a cool place overnight. Add all spinach leaves in to the container and use to mix well. Store in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,green chili pepper,white wine,vinegar,madeira wine,apple,green capsicum
title: Frijoles Borracha (Pink Bean and Apple Salad)
ingredients: 500 g green pinto beans | 200 g pink capsicums | 200 g apples, peeled, cored and sliced | 1 green capsicum, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup white wine | 2 liters madeira wine ( chilled ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Soak beans over night, rinse and drain. Cook chard in boiling water for 5 minutes, then chop finely. Cook apple in boiling water for 2 more minutes, remove to cold water and core. Discard outer leaves and core. Rinse and drain pinto beans, place in a large bowl, cover with boiling water, cover and place in fridge for another 5 hours. Chop vegetables and cook in remaining cooking water until soft. Shake or whisk wine into vinegar, add to food processor and pulse until mixture becomes smooth like a dressing, then taste and season with salt and pepper. Add madeira to the vegetables and stir through. Cover and refrigerate. Serve chilled with pumpernickel bread and enjoy.

title: Persian Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetarian refried beans | 1/2 small jicama, diced | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 cup minced fresh basil leaf | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs round rump roast or 1 1/2 lbs rib eye steak
instructions: Heat refried beans in a small skillet over low heat. When warm, stir in jicama, paprika, & turmeric. Toast briefly, stirring often. Divide lettuce among four warmed dinner plates, cutting steak across grain at a diagonal. Divide bean mixture evenly among plates, dividing equally. Spoon sliced roast evenly between four plates, placing bean mixture on top, then surround with a garnish.

title: Spanish Beef Roll Ups (Sbd P2)
ingredients: 5 lbs chuck roast | 1 can green olives, drained | 4 egg yolks, beaten
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast.

title: Easy Nachos
ingredients: 2 cups tortilla chips | 1/2 cup coriander, chopped | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 100 degrees f. Place chips, coriander, and parsley on a sheet of aluminum foil. Cover with the sauce, and seal tightly. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until chips are heated through. Flip each one about half way through. Let them cool and then eat. Or let cool completely, break into serving sized pieces and serve on the side.

title: Sausage Cheddar With Mushrooms or Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg piece sausage | 1 - 1 1/2 kg part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 -2 serrano pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Cut the sausage into slices or rectangles about 1 1/2cm thick. Put the slices or rectangles into an ovenproof dish with a little water and place in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes, or until nicely browned on the outside. Meanwhile, place the chevre cheese into a bowl or cheesecloth and put into the microwave and cook on high power for about 4 minutes or until tender and starting to melt, stirring every 2 minutes. Stir the sausage or provolone cheese into the cheese to mix completely. Put the sauagemeat mixture into a colander over a bowl to drain off any fat. Press the cheese through the colander. Put the sausage/chevre mixture on a serving plate and add the chopped pepper onto the sausage/chevre mixture and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,rice wine,seasoning salt,tomato puree,puff pastry,lamb chop,red wine
title: Crusty Lamb Chops With Tomato & Wine Pie
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice wine | 2 tablespoons chopped tomato puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon dry red wine | 2 lamb chops, lean, trimmed of fat | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 2 tablespoons thickly sliced sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°. Combine wine, tomato puree, salt, red wine, and lamb chops in a large bowl, whisking to evenly coat lamb. Place half the puff pastry on a baking sheet and spread evenly with the lamb mixture. Sprinkle lamb with half the cheddar cheese, pressing to fit. Repeat with the second half of the puff pastry, lamb chops, and cheese. Spread tomato mixture over the top. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,yellow onion,water chestnut,blue curacao,basil leaf,flat leaf parsley
title: Quick & Easy Blue Taranto
ingredients: 15 ml blue curacao | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seed | 1 yellow onion, finely diced | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced | 1 tablespoon basil leaves | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine curacao with mustard seeds in a heavy bottomed mug & stir to mix well. Stir in diced onion. Add water chestnuts, basil & parsley and toss gently. Serve with crusty french bread.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,white onion,ra el hanout spice mix,corn tortilla,dijon mustard
title: Delicious Enchilada Bites
ingredients: 12 ounces can enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 white onion, diced | 12 corn tortillas, cut into rounds, to fit in pan | 1/2 cup raisins and butternut squash seeds ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Blend all ingredients until smooth. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Using one round tortilla at a time, scoop about 3 tablespoons of the sauce into each tortilla, covering the entire surface. Spoon some of the mixture on to each tortilla, cover with remaining tortillas, and spread until they fit into the pan. Top with the second round of tortillas, then drizzle a small amount of olive oil across the top. Bake at 300 degrees f for 35 to 45 minutes. Serve with remaining raisins and butternut squash seeds as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,flat leaf parsley,yellow squash,pasta,red chili pepper flake,spaghetti sauce,butternut squash
title: Timbale Pasta Primavera (Squash Pasta With Sausage)
ingredients: 2 pints thin spaghetti sauce or 2 pints small white pearl pasta cooked in boiling water | 1 lb butternut squash, peeled and diced | 1 yellow squash, peeled and diced | red chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | flat leaf parsley, chopped | freshly ground white pepper | 8 ounces dry pasta, cooked
instructions: Bring 12 cups of salted water to a boil in a large pot and add the squash and yellow squash. Cook until the squash is tender. Drain off any excess liquid. Return to a boil and add the spaghetti sauce. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often. Add white pepper flakes and chopped parsley to taste. Top with crouton sized pieces of fresh, cold meats and serve.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,heavy cream,bean sprout,chambord raspberry liquor,rapid rise yeast,tabasco sauce,bacon,lettuce leaf
title: Aussie Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rapeseed rise yeast | 10 fluid ounces heavy cream | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1 lettuce leaf | 4 slices bacon or 4 slices smoked ham, cooked and chopped | 4 slices chambord raspberry liquor ( optional ) | 200 g bean sprouts
instructions: To make the starter, dissolve 2 tablespoons of the starter in 5 fluid oz. Of hot water in a small bowl. Stir in the cream, tabasco, thyme, remaining starter and remaining ingredients. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand in a warm spot for at least 2 hours. Transfer to a nonstick pan and heat until bubbles appear from the top. Brush the top of the bread with the starter. Spray with an oil spray or grease the inside. Transfer to a serving platter and set aside while you prepare the garnishes. Melt the bacon or ham and set aside. Brush the bread with the remaining rosemary sprigs. Top with the bacon or ham, bean sprouts and a sprinkling of cheese. Place the bread on a platter and serve.

title: Ricotta Cheese Pies
ingredients: 1/4 lb evaporated milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 lb grated white bread | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 1 package refrigerated frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 6 tablespoons milk, warmed
instructions: Beat ricotta with an electric mixer in a bowl until smooth. Stir bread into ricotta in a small metal bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until thoroughly cold. Preheat oven to 400f on a baking sheet, sprinkle gelatin over 1 sheet.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,pasta,kosher salt,baking chocolate,plain flour,pistachio,heavy whipping cream
title: Spicey Ricotta Rice Cake
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice or 1 cup brown rice ( such as arborio or jasmine ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup unsalted sunflower oil or 1/2 cup light olive oil | 1/4 cup pistachios, chopped | 2 ounces baking chocolate, grated ( or use chocolate, chips ) | kosher salt ( optional ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 3/4 cups cooked pasta, such as macaroon
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place rice in a bowl and pour in a cup of boiling water to cover. Cover and refrigerate overnight. It should not be soupy, and need hardly any soaking liquid.. While water is coming to the boil, using half a stick blender or fork, puree rice until it is a chunky paste. It should have a fine texture. You may need to reduce or increase the amount of water used, depending on the rice and amount of liquid that's in the rice and the amount of rice you use. Add salt to taste. In a bowl whisk together cream and flour. Add sunflower oil while whisking, and then pour into rice mixture. Stir in chopped pistachios. Add grated or chopped chocolate, and stir until completely blended. Spoon into a shallow baking tin and bake 35 - 40 minutes until golden brown. This cake can be frozen, and it will last 2 years. Cool cake in the tin for 5 minutes. Turn a knob of butter over the top to loosen and return to the oven for a further 5 - 10 minutes, or until the cake is browned and puffed up a little. Serve immediately, or refrigerate overnight. Note, depending on type of rice used, it can take up to 20 minutes for a rice sponge. Note, i found some photos and this interesting note for how the texture can change out if it's cooked too long. I would cut back on the amount of time that was used by recipe.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,beef roast,wine,blueberry,coconut milk,manchego cheese,curry paste,half
title: Manchego Cheese and Blueberry Stacked Beef (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1/4 cup curry paste | 1 1/2 lbs beef roast, trimmed | 2 cups half-and-half | 15 ounces coconut milk | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 - 1 cup manchego cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup blueberries | 1 -2 cup dry white wine ( optional )
instructions: In a plastic bag, combine the curry paste with just enough cold water to make a paste about the consistency of a matchstick paste. Add beef and allow to marinate at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Place coconut milk and chili powder in a 2 - 3 qt crock pot slow cooker and add the paste mixture. Stir, cover and cook on low setting for 7 - 8 hours or high setting for 3 - 4 hours. Remove the beef to a serving dish. Remove the gravy paste from the slow cooker. Add the manchego cheese, blueberries, and white wine if using. Cover and warm for another 15 - 20 minutes. Serve over rice. Garnish with fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,cardamom pod,curry powder,milk chocolate,scallop,taco seasoning,white onion
title: Creamy Seafood Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons taco blend cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate, chopped | 1 cup cauliflower floret, chopped | 1 small white onion, diced | 6 sprigs curry powder ( or 1-2 tsp curry powder ) | 3 cardamom pods
instructions: In a small bowl, stir the taco seasoning and cheese until well blended. Stir in the chocolate. In a large skillet or saute pan, saute onion and curry powder until the onion is just tender and the curry powder has turned pale green.. Add taco mix, cauliflower, and fish.

title: Pita Breads a la Honeymoon
ingredients: 4 pita bread | 2 teaspoons fresh herb, chopped | 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup white rum ( preferably harvey's )
instructions: Open the pita breads, cut side on one side and open up like a book. Open out a little bit. Sprinkle each triangle with a little fresh herbs. Divide the cheese and 2 teaspoons of the rum over each pita. Fold the two sides over the cheese and press lightly. Wear a tinfoil over your hands, a vegetable brush or your hands as needed and roll up the breads. Arrange on baking sheets and bake in a 375 degree f oven about 12 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Champagne
ingredients: 1/2 lb mexican chocolate, chopped | 1/2 lb hot salsa | 2 cups hot champagne | 2 lbs lasagna noodles
instructions: Melt chocolate and salsa in double boiler. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Break noodles into pieces and place in chocolate mixture. Top with sauce, then cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. The next day, bake at 375ºf for 45 - 55 minutes or until golden and bubbly.

title: Homemade Saffron Crumbs
ingredients: 1 pound ground sirloin | 1 tablespoon saffron strand | 1/4 cup chocolate cookie crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Line baking sheets with aluminum foil. In a bowl, mix the ground sirloin, saffron, cookie crumbs, and allspice. Form the meat into small balls, and place on the prepared baking sheets. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With White Beans and Celery
ingredients: 1 lb white pea beans, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons green chives, chopped | 7 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions and drain. Set aside. Meanwhile, cook peas in a large pot of boiling, lightly salted water until crisp tender, about 12 - 15 minutes. Rinse with cold water.

title: Banana Bell Pepper  (Pepper) and Almond Mac 'n' Cheese Tarts
ingredients: 4 fresh egg whites | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 3 -4 tablespoons minced lemon grass or 3 -4 tablespoons minced white onion | 3 large red ripe bananas, peeled & sliced into thin rounds | 2 medium assorted hot bell peppers, seeded, deribbed, sliced into rings and separated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In bowl, beat egg whites with a wire whisk until stiff peaks form. Beat in almond extract and lemon grass or onion. Transfer to piping bag fitted with 1/2 inch long tube. Add banana slices, close, and tie with kitchen string. Spoon 2 tsp batter onto each bread round. Bake until golden brown, 12 - 15 minutes. Serve warm with additional toppings if desired.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,brown sugar,fettuccine pasta,french bread,dark sesame oil,head cauliflower,cream cheese
title: Honey Brown Sesame Fettuccini With French Bread
ingredients: 1 cup light cream cheese, softened | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons honey brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil ( optional ) | 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 1/2 cups dry fettuccine pasta | 2 -3 slices french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: In a medium bowl, blend together cream cheese, bay leaf, honey brown sugar, and sesame oil. Set aside. In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook pasta until al dente.

title: Quick & Easy Spicy Spiced Bean Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces feta | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 4 ounces roasted red kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup instant espresso powder | 1/2 teaspoon turbinado sugar or 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1 teaspoon rotel
instructions: Place the feta in small microwavable bowl, cut with scissors. Microwave on high 1 minute or until lightly toasted, stirring every minute. Cut the oatmeal in half, toss with the beans in a bowl. Add the espresso powder, sugar, rotel, and stir. Enjoy.

title: Easy Beef Gyros
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cooked steak | 5 sheets very thin rice noodles | 1/2 cup shredded nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon miso ( or 2 tbsp water, if you use miso-infused miso, use about half of this amount instead ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/3 cup roughly chopped hazelnuts ( optional ) | pickled japanese mustard pickled ginger ( optional )
instructions: Note, the amount of miso is up to your tastes. Add the soy, miso and garlic salt and mix well. Add the shredded steak, mix well, then refrigerate for at least one hour. Just before serving, microwave the noodles in 5 second increments, stirring after every minute, until they are tender and flexible. This process can take an hour or two for the rice noodles to get sticky, and a good long cooking time depends on how much meat you have or how thick you like your noodles. When the noodle is cooked, mix in the keens and the pickled ginger, if using. When you eat them, it will not be sticky.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,mayonnaise,flour tortilla,button mushroom,thai fish sauce,peanut oil,chili
title: Vietnamese Pizza
ingredients: 1 flour tortilla | 6 -8 ounces button mushrooms, sliced ( or 1 package fresh mushrooms ) | 4 ounces thai fish sauce ( you can use soy sauce of your choice ) or 4 ounces prepared sweet-and-sour sauce ( you can use soy sauce of your choice ) | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon dried chili, crushed | 6 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon dried shrimp/mushroom spread ( or store-bought )
instructions: Cut the crusts off your tortilla and place on a pizza pan covered with foil. Bake at 400f for 5 - 7 minutes or till crisp. Remove from oven, then arrange the slices in one layer on the foil covered pizza pan. Mix together the fish sauce, mayonnaise, dried chili and the crushed red chili paste from the thai kitchen or other recipes in a small bowl. Then spread one side of your crust with the dipping sauce. Layer 4 slices of tomato basil, then a few pieces of roasted or roasted button mushroom on top of the sauce. Top with another crust that has been slightly crusted and spread with the dipping sauce. Repeat the layers until all the crusts are used, finishing with the tomatoes and roasted mushrooms. Cut in quarters if using mushrooms, basil, etc. Spread the toppings of your choice on top of the pizza. Enjoy.

title: Roasted Garlic and Chicken
ingredients: 1 -1 1/2 lb ground chicken, lean | 1 bulb of garlic, split lengthwise | 1 can blueberries, rinsed and drained ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 medium onion, quartered ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 tablespoon packed light brown sugar | 4 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh spinach ( or 2 tablespoons frozen chopped spinach ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated orange peel
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f. Trim top third of garlic.

title: Jamaican Pepper Beef Steaks
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 12 ounces beef top sirloin steaks
instructions: Score a few slits in top of sirloin steaks. Sprinkle allspice evenly over steak and marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours, and preferably overnight. The meat can be prepared up to 2 days in advance, and can be grilled in a 350 degree f oven for 15 minutes or until thermometer reads 160 degrees f degrees.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,button mushroom,green pea,almond milk,vegetable broth,jigger whiskey,cranberry juice,coriander sprig
title: Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth | 2 jigger whiskey | 2 ounces blanched sliced almonds or 2 ounces sliced almonds | 1 cup split button mushrooms, stemmed, sliced and mixed with | 2/3 cup canned cranberry juice | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3/4 cup green peas | fresh coriander sprig, for garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan bring the vegetable broth to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to a simmer and add the whiskey and almonds. Cover partially, cook until the almonds are just tender, and remove from the heat. Add the mushrooms and cranberry juice, and continue cooking the soup, uncovered, over medium heat until the liquid has evaporated and the mushrooms are tender, about 20 minutes. Stir in the marjoram and cook until the peas are tender, about 2 minutes. Ladle into bowls and garnish with some coriander.

title: Cheesy Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 package crumbled queso fresco | 1 cup diced velveeta cheese | 4 ounces chopped roasted bell peppers or 4 ounces roasted red peppers | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro | 1 romano cheese, grated | 1/4 lb bacon or 1/4 lb other cooked crumbled bacon | 2 bags fresh cut broccoli florets
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix together the beans, cheese, bacon/tomato puree, cilantro, romano and chopped roasted peppers. Layer in the order as shown in the ingredients list, refried beans, bacon/tomato mixture, broccoli florets, etc. Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach in a Sweet Mustard-Sauce Flair
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh spinach | 1 container frozen topping, thawed drained and dried ( thawed ) | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 medium white onion, chopped | 1/2 cup light brown bean sauce | 1/2 teaspoon honey
instructions: Wash, trim, and dry spinach as necessary. Set spinach aside to dry approximately 1 hour, then squeeze excess water out and pat dry with paper towels. Remove thick layer of wilted water from spinach stems, set aside. Using a paring knife, slice spinach into 1/2 inch slices. Combine spinach, thawed topping, canola oil, onion, brown bean sauce, and honey in a food processor or blender. Blend on high until thickened, about 5 minutes. Place spinach mixture in a 2 quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350°f for approximately 10 minutes, then uncover and bake an additional 5 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Beer Sipper
ingredients: 1 can beer ( pacific beverage is good ) | 2 cans chopped green chile peppers, drained
instructions: Pour beer into a large, wide shallow pot. Add green chile peppers and cover with enough water to the pot.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,cooking brown rice,cocoa powder,cream mushroom soup
title: Easy Polish Sausage & Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar sauerkraut | cooking brown rice
instructions: Brown the ground round, drain fat if needed. Stir in all remaining ingredients including cooked rice. Transfer to a casserole dish and bake. Bake at 350 degrees f. For 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup rice flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh soy sauce
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together on a plate. Put soy sauce in a cup or pan. Pour a little soy sauce into the bowl. Pour a little soy sauce into the pan. Put enough oil to make your batter into a small basket with the handle of a spoon. You may have to hold it in a circle with your hand, but you do not need to. Cook pancake on a medium, hot griddle. You should drop a few pieces of batter into the frying oil, they should brown, but underneath should still be slightly crisp. You don't need to stir it, but check it. Cook until they are golden. If not, repeat the same on a second side. Turn over and brown the other side. Serve with a salad for breakfast, coffee, or just eat them warm.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces velveeta italian cheese, cut into 2 `` cubes | 1 jar velveeta mexican cheese, broken into 2 '' pieces | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Place 1 cube of cheese, broken into 2 pieces of velveeta or mexican cheese, in a 4 quart double cheese fondue pan.

Random Ingredients: green olive,picante sauce,vermicelli,ancho chile powder,sharp cheddar cheese,molasses,gouda cheese,tortilla
title: Cheese Vermicelli Salad
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni-type tortilla, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces and crumbled | 1/2 cup grated smoked sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup chopped green olives ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped stuffed green olive ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 16 ounces marinated picante sauce, divided | 16 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese ( about 3 cups ) | 2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Combine all ingredients, toss and chill several hours.

title: Clams With Apples
ingredients: 2 tart apples | 1/2 cup clam juice | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons finely shredded lemon peel
instructions: Remove the core from the apples and cut them into chunks on a medium heat. Cook in a large saucepan of boiling water, stirring, for 3 - 5 minutes or until tender, then drain and plunge into cold water. Drain well. Blend with the clams and add the sugar and lemon rind. Mix well and serve.

title: Nachos (Nachos)
ingredients: 1 package plain doritos | 1 small diced onion
instructions: Bake chips in oven or indoor preheated to 450°f. Bake for 10 minutes at 450°f. Sprinkle with diced onion.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,marinara sauce,swede,coleslaw mix,sun tomato oil,vodka,green onion,rice
title: St. Patrick's Day Gluten Free Stove Top Baked Swiss and Tomato
ingredients: 1 cup shredded swede ( you won't need to peel the carrot ) | 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1 1/4 cups coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon rawspicebar's veggie marinara sauce | 4 green onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, slivered | 1/3 cup rice | 2 1/2 tablespoons vodka ( optional ) or 2 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar ( optional ) | salad dressing ( optional ) or prepared salsa ( optional )
instructions: Place swedes and rice in a bowl of ice water and toss to combine. Drain well but do not rinse the swedes and rice while draining. Drain well again and set aside. Cook the sauteed vegetable in tomato oil until crisp tender and beginning to brown lightly, about 10 to 15 seconds. Add rice, cabbage mixture and tomatoes to the vegetable and toss to combine. If desired, season with salt and pepper to taste. Spoon into a shallow baking dish and sprinkle with the green onions. Sprinkle with the slivered sun dried tomatoes and any optional marinara, mixed with the rice. Bake at 200°c for about 15 to 20 minutes or until hot and bubbling. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving to crisp up some edges.

title: Baked Rye Wedges
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces sliced pancetta ( or ham ) | 2 1/2 ounces sliced corned beef stew meat | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 9 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly butter a baking sheet. Brush each slice of rye bread with 1 tbsp of maple syrup. Spread 1 tbsp of pancetta over each slice of bread pressing into the fat. Spread the remaining 1 tbsp of maple syrup evenly over the rye crisps. Bake for 12 minutes until crisp. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,thai fish sauce,gold tequila,pea,mirin,black bean,sun tomato oil
title: Tequila-Lentil Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted dried brown lentils | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/3 cup frozen peas ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons mirin | 3/4 cup packed light brown and white tequila ( i prefer calolive oil )
instructions: Place the lentils in a medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer until the lentils are tender, stirring once, about 20 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Transfer the lentils to a bowl. Add the sun dried tomatoes and frozen peas to the lentils and toss well. Stir in the fish sauce and mirin and refrigerate until the noodles are ready and are well chilled, about 20 minutes. Before serving, add the tequila and whisk well until thoroughly combined. Adjust the salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,gingerroot,skirt steak,pine nut,lobster tail,vegetable,barbecue sauce,red wine
title: Beef Stew in Pine Nut Stuffing
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 1/3 cup red wine | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot | 3/4 cup chopped mixed vegetables | 1 1/2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1/4 cup canned baby mixed vegetables, drained
instructions: Pound the steak to a thickness of 1/8 inch or less, and cut it into 2 to 3 thick strips. In a small bowl, whisk the wine, bbq, vanilla essence, gingerroot and nuts together. Place the steak in a wide, shallow casserole. Pour half of the wine mixture over the meat, and cover with the rest of the wine mixture. Place in a preheated 350 f oven and bake, stirring occasionally, until cooked as desired. When stew is done, stir in the mixed vegetables. Cool, and store in the refrigerator. Serve with grilled meats and vegetables, and/or crackers.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,crawfish tail,cayenne pepper,cauliflower floret,green chile pepper,stewing beef
title: Shrimp and Beef Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/2 pound crawfish tails, shell removed | 1 head cauliflower florets | 3 cans diced green chile peppers | 1 pound stewing beef, cut into strips | 1/2 cup lemon peel, minced | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Remove and discard heads from cauliflower florets. Rinse and drain the head, and place in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,coconut flake,white cheddar cheese,lemon extract,topping,dark sesame oil,tortilla chip,camembert cheese
title: Smooth Camembert Fondue
ingredients: 500 g white cheddar cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon hoisin sauce ( your favourite-i use low-fat ) | 1 -2 1 -2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 -2 teaspoon lemon extract ( from 1 lemon ) | 100 g low-fat sour cream ( i use light ) or 100 g greek yogurt ( i use light ) | tortilla chips, to serve | camembert cheese, roughly sliced or grated ( or danish if you have some )
instructions: Slice the top and most of the cheese off of the cheddar cheese and reserve in a small dish. Break the cheese into chunks and use as much or little as you like. Heat 1 - 2 tsp of sesame oil in a non stick pan and when hot add the cheese chunks and stir until melted. Add the remaining sesame oil to the pan and slowly add the hoisin to create an emulsion and a lovely bonding to the cheese chunks at the bottom of the pan and on top of the cheese. Pour in any juice from the lemon and mix well. Stir in just enough sour cream or yogurt to bind and then turn the heat down slightly. When you have a creamy sauce, pour over the cheese chunks and top with the grated cheese. Toss to coat and heat through over a very low heat. Serve with your favourite mexican dishes such as tortilla chips, hot crusty bread, bread or fritters. Note, i had a little trouble getting it to work in my fondue pot, so i had to use a little cornstarch dissolved in water when working with it. I ended up making this again and it worked beautifully until it was quite runny. So, in simpler words, perhaps if you had fried it in oil for a while, you could just dip the cheese chunks into the mixture and cook them in that way too.

title: Nopales (Pernod Bread)
ingredients: cornmeal, for dredging into | pernod ( optional ) | cornmeal, for sprinkling, to roll
instructions: Lightly flour a board and turn over flour. Dredge hands under fairly cold water or alternatively pour the cornmeal into a container. Cover with lid or plastic wrap and leave for 10 - 12 hours.. Preheat oven to 200 degrees c. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Cut each nopale into 6 equal squares and place on tray. Sprinkle with cornmeal. Bake in batches for 10 - 15 minutes or until crispy and golden, turning once. Note, do not overcook, as they will loose their delicate texture. Cool before removing from the tray.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,black mustard seed,spring wrapper,pecorino romano cheese,strawberry ice cream,lavash bread,corn oil
title: Fresh Strawberries and Cheese Bites
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 1 1/2 cups whole grain bread, crust removed, diced into small squares | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan romano cheese | 250 g fresh ripe strawberries, diced into small pieces | 300 spring rolls | strawberry ice cream, for serving
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a small bowl.

title: Wildfire Pea Minty Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup shallot ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons marsala | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 package frozen yellow pea ( thawed ) | 1/2 cup butter | 1/2 cup cashews | 1/4 cup green mint ( to taste ) or 1/4 cup white pea ( to taste ) | 1 cup french vanilla flavored coffee creamer
instructions: In blender process shallots, marsala and cayenne in 2 batches until smooth. Set aside. Place thawed peas in a 3 qt saucepan and add water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, drain. Place rice in medium size bowl, stir in peas, 1 1/2 tbsp butter, cashews and mint. Let stand for 5 minutes. In the microwave, melt reserved 1/2 cup butter, about 4 minutes on high. Stir in creamer and microwave on high for 1 minute, stirring about 1/4 time, then remove from heat, stir in creamer and serve.

title: Chinese Bread and Butter Tea
ingredients: 6 1/2 cups water | 3/4 lb rye bread or 3/4 lb sweet bread, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes | 4 tablespoons margarine | 2 -4 teaspoons red chili peppers, crushed | 1 teaspoon corn or 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Place bread cubes in 3 qt saucepan. Add water. Bring to a boil, uncovered, over high heat, stirring occasionally to avoid burning. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat, stir in remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,steak,brown bread,yellow bell pepper
title: Bread and Pepper Rollups
ingredients: 3 slices brown bread, torn into bite-size pieces | 1/4 cup yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup self-raising flour | 1 steak, trimmed and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c line a non stick ovenproof dish with bread. Sprinkle with bell pepper and flour. Spread bread pieces on the baking paper and sprinkle with steak. Cover and bake in the oven for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, scatter with remaining bread and return to the oven for 10 minutes or until the top is golden.

Random Ingredients: milk,broccoli floret,dijon mustard,gingerroot,polish sausage,lemon extract,chili powder,pickling spice
title: Dijon Hot Dog
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons minced gingerroot ( fresh ) | 3 tablespoons pickling spices | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 3/4 lbs spicy polish sausage or 1/2 lb other sausage ( sliced thinly ) | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced fresh broccoli florets ( can use frozen ) | 1/2 cup milk ( can use non-dairy milk ) | 2 -3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 -6 teaspoons lemon extract
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together minced gingerroot, 3 tablespoons pickling spice, chili powder, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Pour spice mixture into a heavy saucepan or dutch oven that will hold hot dogs and can be placed in pan. Add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and immediately lower heat to medium. Simmer uncovered 2 1/2 2 hours or till hot dogs are cooked through. Add broccoli during last 1/2 hour for desired crispiness. Add milk during the last 15 minutes of simmering, if mixture becomes dry and thick. Add mustard and lemon extract at this time, stir and add hot dogs, don't stir until dogs are all hot, just heated through. Note, don't allow hot dogs to overcook. Cooking time varies depending on your oven.

Random Ingredients: pecan nut,broccoli,black eyed pea,beef brisket,extra sharp cheddar cheese,egg yolk,pork shoulder
title: Savory Mccormick Broccoli and Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 4 cans black-eyed peas | 14 ounces lean pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 8 ounces broccoli or 8 ounces kale, cut into small florets | 2 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup pecan nuts | 1/2 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place brisket in the center of a 9x12 inch baking pan that is lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Trim excess fat. Place the beans and pork in the pan. Place the broccoli on top. Whisk the egg yolks and 1/4 cup water in a bowl until smooth. Pour egg mixture over the veggies and meat. Sprinkle the pecan nuts randomly over all. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake at 325 degrees f for 6 hours or until fork tender.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,avocado,celery rib,white rice,golden raisin,red chile pepper,butter,spinach
title: Spanish Rice With Avocados and Salsa
ingredients: 1/3 cup golden raisins | 1/4 cup white rice | 1/3 cup chopped celery rib | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh red chile pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons shredded, unseasoned breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 can medium sized avocados, peeled, pitted, and cubed
instructions: Put the raisins in a small bowl and pour boiling water over. Let stand, covered, for at least 20 minutes, shaking once or twice. Drain. Add the rice, celery, chile to the raisins, spinach, bread crumbs, butter and drained raisin mixture. Toss to combine. Let stand about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, arrange the avocado cubes on to a serving platter in a decorative pattern. Spoon the tomato topping over the top.

title: Easy Beef Steak
ingredients: 4 medium steaks | 1/2 cup brandy or 1/2 cup cognac
instructions: Put steaks in plastic bag or zipper bag to marinade for 4 hours up to 6 hours in refrigerator note, don't add any liquid to the marinade. When ready to cook, remove steaks from bag and place on broiler tray. Broil 3 - 4 inches from heat, turning once or twice. About 5 minutes per side for rare or 6 minutes per side for medium well.

title: Belgian Marinated Veal
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut into 1/2 -by-2-inch cubes | 4 medium portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup red vinegar | 6 tablespoons vegetable oil or 6 tablespoons clarified butter | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1/4 cup fresh chives or 1/4 cup parsley, minced
instructions: Combine all but the meat and marinate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, in refrigerator. Drain and wash meats and pat dry. Thread 2 beef cubes onto each skewer, about 4 per skewer. Brush with a little oil and grill on a preheated grill 5 minutes per side, or until the meat is no longer pink inside, turning once halfway through cooking. Garnish with chives. Serve with rice and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,ricotta cheese,brown sugar,sharp cheddar cheese,chicken wing,crisco
title: Sweet & Savory Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lb small whole chicken wing | 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 teaspoons crisco
instructions: Place chicken wings in a large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour over wings and toss to coat.

title: Pork Chorizo
ingredients: 1/4 lb chorizo sausage | 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cut in half lengthwise | 4 spring onions, white portion only, minced | 1 1/4 cups breadcrumbs | 3 slices bread, crusts removed, bread crumbs removed | 2 -3 tablespoons sriracha sauce | 8 ounces spaghetti, cooked, drained
instructions: Remove sausage casing and crumble or break it into small pieces. Cook the sausage with the spring onions and garlic, stirring and breaking up the meat. When the meat is browned, place it in a large bowl and add the breadcrumbs, 2 tbs. Toppings, sauce, potatoes, sasuage and egg. Toss to combine. Pour mixture into a small casserole dish, top with crumbs and cover with foil. Bake in a medium low oven, stirring the dish occasionally, until filling is hot and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,flat leaf parsley,lemon juice,mint leaf,tamarind pod
title: Yogurt (Somali Dahi) - Indian Spicy Herbs & Lemons
ingredients: 150 g tamarind pods | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup mint leaf, roughly chopped, plus extra leaves for garnishing | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: In a small mortar/grinder crush the tamarind pods with a pinch of salt until completely crushed.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,pepper sauce,pumpkin,thyme,cooking spray,thai red curry paste,ghee,pea carrot
title: Pumpkin and Red Curry Stew With Peas Carrots
ingredients: cooking spray | 400 g pumpkin, cut into 1. 5cm cubes | 2 -3 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 2 1/2 tablespoons vegetable or 2 1/2 tablespoons ghee | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | pepper sauce | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 medium carrot, peeled, trimmed & finely grated
instructions: Heat the oven to 180c/fan 160c/gas 7. Place the pan of pumpkin in the oven, and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender & lightly coloured. Meanwhile, put the curry paste, worcestershire sauce, thyme & pepper sauce into a heatproof bowl or dish & season with pepper & hot sauce. Heat the ghee in a frypan, or shallow frypan, & while hot, stir in the curry paste. Stir fry over a medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes, until well combined. Add the pumpkin & carrots & cook for 5 minutes or until the pumpkin & carrots are just tender. Serve immediately while warm, with crusty bread or rolls.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,thyme,golden mushroom soup,lasagna noodle,vodka,plain flour,okra,avocado
title: Lazy New Mexico Lasagna
ingredients: 250 g lasagna noodles | 300 g frozen okra, thawed | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 1/2 cups vodka | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1 large avocado, cubed
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Cook okra by wrapping with a tea towel. Rinse with cold water. Cut into 1 inch pieces and set aside. Combine soup, vodka, flour, thyme and rice wine in a large saucepan over medium high heat. Stir well to mix. Bring to boil, then reduce heat to medium. Simmer for 10 minutes then add okra, avocado and soup mixture. Simmer for a further 25 minutes or until okra is tender. Serve hot.

title: Crunchy Honey and Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 2/3 teaspoon honey | 1 pinch salt | 3 1/2 cups corn flakes | 1/4 cup cornichon ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons cilantro ( chopped ) | 4 drops hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Place whole egg in cold water. Mix in dry ingredients. Bring to boil on high. Add honey, a pinch of salt, and corn flakes. Stir to mix. Cook stirring constantly on medium heat, about five minutes. Add cornichon, cilantro, and hot sauce. Stir in cinnamon. If mixture is too thick, you can add more corn flakes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: linguine,apple juice,hot green chili pepper,white wine vinegar,lite olive oil
title: Linguine With Apple Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb linguine, uncooked | 1 1/2 cups white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil, divided | 1 -3 tablespoon hot green chili pepper, chopped, crushed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the linguine to boiling water, and cook uncovered to desired doneness, according to package directions. Drain. In a large salad bowl, whisk together the vinegar, apple juice and 1 tablespoon of the olive oil. Stir in the chili. Toss the linguine with the vinaigrette and top with the chopped green chiles.

Random Ingredients: potato,tomato paste,tabasco sauce,currant,sumac,chunky salsa,red wine vinegar
title: Hash Tart Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mashed potatoes | 2 large tomatoes | 1 cup chunky salsa ( or other sweet salsa ) | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup currants | 2 teaspoons sumac | 2 dashes tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix the potatoes, tomato and salsa together. Make sure you mix every ingredient very thoroughly so that each peace gets a good coating of moisture. Taste, it should be slightly sweet. Add tabasco and sumac, if using. Refrigerate, covered, 1 hour or overnight to blend flavors.

title: Peppered Black-Eyed Peas With Apricots in Mascarpone
ingredients: 2 cans black-eyed peas ( drained, rinsed ) | 2 ounces sliced water chestnuts | 12 ounces mascarpone cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper | 1 package dried apricots
instructions: Drain peas and reserve liquid. Warm mascarpone cheese on low heat in microwave. Add pepper and apricots. Garnish with dried apricots.

title: Champagne and Parmesan Meat
ingredients: 6 lbs cubed stewing steak ( i use beef stew meat ) | 2 teaspoons instant minced onion flakes | 1/3 cup dry crushed onion flakes | 4 cups dry champagne | 1/2 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Place meat and instant dried onion flakes in a large baking dish or crock. Pour in the wine and parsley and stir to coat meat. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove cover and cook at the laziest possible temperature about 4 hours or until meat is tender. You want it to be moist, but not soupy. Serve over cooked noodles or rice for a delicious, moist and tasty meal.

title: Spinach With Chutney
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach | 1/2 cup fresh mango chutney | 1 -2 tablespoon pickled juniper berries, finely crushed
instructions: In a large bowl combine spinach with chutney.

title: Cherry Tomato-Cranberry Broth With Whole Wheat Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat spaghetti | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( sometimes i use craisins ) | 2 cups plum tomatoes, roughly chopped ( or 1 cup chopped canned tomatoes ) | 1 cup dried apricot, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons white pepper | 3 cups strong tea, hot from a can | decorate with additional cherries ( optional ) or dried fruit ( optional )
instructions: Fill 4 - 6 quart or larger stockpot with water to come up 1/2 inch above the rim. Bring to boil. Meanwhile, place the dry beans in a small bowl. Cover with water and soak for at least 3 hours or refrigerate overnight. Drain and discard the water. Put the pasta in a large bowl. Add the cranberries and tomatoes. Toss to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit, stirring occasionally, until it's time to serve. Add the pepper and white pepper. Drain the liquid from the tomato mixture thru a colander into a bowl and reserve. Add the reserved liquid and the hot tea to the tomato mixture and mix well. If the pasta is dry, add more hot tea. When the pasta is ready, it should have the consistency of a loose soup. Serve with additional fresh cherries if desired.

title: Lentils With Melon and Sultanas (Cottage Pies)
ingredients: 1/2 lb lentils, picked over | 1/3 lb sultana | 1/2 cup sultana | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon black seasoning salt | 1 medium cantaloupe, chopped into small pieces
instructions: Boil the lentils overnight, then rinse under running water. Drain well and place in large bowl. Add other ingredients and mix thoroughly.

title: Roasted Red Bell Peppers With Tomato Custard
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, halved, seeded and cut lengthwise into slices | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon low-fat custard powder | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 8 ounces fontina or 8 ounces cheddar cheese, cut into thin slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Arrange the bell peppers, half in one layer, on a plate. Combine tomato paste and custard powder in a small bowl. Sprinkle over peppers. Toss to coat evenly. Arrange cheese slices over the top. Bake in oven for about 14 minutes.

title: Blackened Chocolate With Sprouts
ingredients: 1 bag light bean sprouts, see note | 12 cardamom pods | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 4 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | cayenne pepper
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add the sprouts and simmer for 1 - 2 minutes, checking occasionally to make sure they are completely tender. Drain and set aside. Place cardamom pods in a small dry pan with the sherry. Let boil 1 minute. Turn heat down slightly and set aside to cool to room temperature, stirring often. Put the chocolate and the cooled sprouts in a small bowl. With a whisk, beat in cayenne, check for sweetness, if necessary add a little of the hot sauce from the sherry. Pour the warm chocolate onto the sprouts and mix well. Chill the brine.

Random Ingredients: salad dressing,soybean,nicoise olive,macaroni,cherry tomato,mushroom,white wine vinegar
title: Spanish Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni | 1 cup salad dressing | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 6 ounces mushrooms, halved | 6 ounces mixed mushrooms, halved | 10 nicoise olives, halved | 1/2 cup diced sweet potatoes ( red ) | 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes, cut in half
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. In mixing bowl, whisk dressing and vinegar well to mix. Add macaroni and mushrooms to bowl.

title: Crispy Roasted Celery
ingredients: 4 large fennel bulbs, quartered | 3 tablespoons chicken meat | 5 1/4 cups chicken stock or 5 1/4 cups canned broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Using a mortar and pestle or a small, sharp knife, crush fennel until coarsely chopped. Mix in fennel puree, meat and broth.

title: Carob Parfait
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints frozen puff pastry | 1 1/2 teaspoons carob powder | 200 g seedless grapes, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Roll out the frozen puffs pastry dough according to directions on the package. Combine the carob powder and grapes, adding a little melted butter to give them a pretty glaze. Spoon the grapes into the center of each puff pastry sheet, and spread about 1 oz of the mixture and 1 tablespoons of butter onto the top of each one. Cut slits into the top of the pastry with a sharp knife or razor blade to make a vent that will allow for expansion of the pies. Bake for 15 - 15 minutes and the mixture is piping hot.

title: The Perfect Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dried split peas or 1 cup frozen peas | 2 cups beef stock | 1 anaheim chilies, seeded and chopped or 1 pasilla chile, seeded and minced | 1/2 yellow onion, chopped | 1 garlic clove, minced or 1/2 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: Place whole dried peas/peas into large saucepan. Fill well with water and bring to boil. Reduce to simmer. Cover, let sit for half an hour remove pepper and discard. Chop pepper, add all to a large saucepan and simmer until tender about 10 minutes. Add minced garlic or garlic powder and simmer for a couple minutes. Ladle hot soup into bowl, stirring to combine. Add chopped onion, stir to combine. Pour soup through strainer and serve cold.

title: Soupy Shrimp in Lobster Sauce(Camarao Com Jaffrey)
ingredients: 12 ounces medium shrimp, shelled and deveined | 24 -25 fresh figs ( or 2 tsp dried if fresh ) | 1/4 lb gruyere cheese or 1/4 lb swiss cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons sugar | 4 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons mirin | shredded cabbage
instructions: Prepare the shrimp and figs. Wash and dry the shrimp very well and set aside. Cut the figs into quarters or quarters if they look dry. In a bowl, mix cheese, sugar, tomato sauce, lemon and zest, and mirin. Place shrimp in the pan and coat in the pan mixture. Serve with shredded cabbage and red cabbage mixed with a bit of soy sauce and red pepper flakes.

title: Chicken Chapli (Chinese Saffron Chowder)
ingredients: 6 cups chicken soup base ( see note ) | 6 squares unsweetened chocolate | 1 red onion, finely sliced | 1 saffron strand
instructions: Heat a large kettle over medium heat. Add the chicken soup base and bring to a boil. Dissolve the saffron in a few tablespoons of hot water. Cut the chocolate into chunks and add to the kettle with the onion and saffron and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the saffron. Ladle into hot chow mein noodle dishes, dividing evenly, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ice,cooking spray,beef sirloin,thyme sprig,english mustard,scallion,oregano leaf
title: Herbed and Spiced Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 can beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 scallions, trimmed, cut in half lengthwise | 2 tablespoons scallions, finely chopped ( white and light green parts only ) | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 2 teaspoons quick-cooking spiced english mustard | 1 cup ice, crushed
instructions: Place the beef cubes in a shallow dish.

title: Steamed Noodles (Thailand)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 chili peppers, sliced | 3 cups fish stock
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok, put in as many of the chilies as the chilies will fit into the wok. Add the sliced chilli and stock. Cover the wok and steam for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat. Let sit for 5 minutes.

title: Kalamounia (Mussels):
ingredients: 2 lbs mussels, scrubbed, be careful not to crowd them
instructions: Heat a deep fry pan over a high heat until a deep fry thermometer reads 375 degrees f or until oil just begins to float around the pan. Add mussels and cook 3 - 4 minutes, shaking the pan constantly. Remove mussels from pan, shaking off any excess oil and discard any mussels that remain.

title: Three Olive Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet fontina cheese | 1 lb fresh black olives, pitted | 1 can black olives, sliced and drained | 12 -24 ladyfingers | 6 tablespoons cocoa ( for spreading ) | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange zest | 2 tablespoons chopped nuts
instructions: Chop fontina cheese into 1/2 inch cubes. Drain olives, reserving 2 or 3 tablespoons of the liquid. Place remaining ingredients into a large bowl of a blender and blend until completely smooth. Transfer mixture into a medium saucepan and add reserved liquid. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Transfer to a fondue pot and raise heat to high. When mixture boils, reduce heat to low. Beat in cheese and olives in 2 to 3 batches until smooth. Transfer to warmed fondue pot and pour remaining mixture over fondue. Serve with fresh fruit and cinnamon sticks.

title: Persian Grilled Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 1/2 cup orange peel, finely chopped | 1 cup heavy whipping cream ( or 1 cup milk )
instructions: Place the chicken wings in a large bowl with orange peel. Cover with cold water and let stand overnight. Drain and rinse well. Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Coat a grill rack well with nonstick spray and set over moderate heat. Place the chicken wings, breast side down and grill for 7 minutes, turning once, then brushing with the cream and sprinkling with orange peel and sprinkling with orange peel, until the skin is crispy and brown in spots, 8 to 10 minutes total. Serve immediately.

title: Pears Marsala
ingredients: 4 large ripe apples - peeled, cored and cut into 1/4-inch wedges | 2/3 cup peach preserves | 1/4 cup marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Toss apples with preserves in a bowl to coat. Arrange in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until apples are tender and glazed, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cumin Flavoured Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 ounces white button mushrooms, roughly chopped | 7 ounces golden syrup | 10 -12 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon thyme, chopped
instructions: Heat the brown sugar and syrup together in a frying pan. Add the remaining ingredients and cook gently for 5 minutes. Allow to cool slightly, then bottle or seal into a dry, clean jar. Keeps indefinitely.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,green onion,silken tofu,grain rice,worcestershire sauce
title: Tex Mex Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long-grain rice | 1 cup green onion, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 1 cup silken tofu | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Remove from heat and stir in onions and picante sauce. Spoon rice onto a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: english mustard,extra virgin olive oil,star anise,bow tie pasta,anise seed
title: Baked Bow Ties (Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb bow tie pasta | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 star anise, pod | 1 tablespoon prepared english mustard | 2 teaspoons toasted anise seeds | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly oil an 11x7 inch baking dish and set aside. Cook the pasta in boiling salted water until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain. Heat the remaining oil in a 10 inch skillet over medium heat. Add the star anise, mustard, anise. Stirring often, cook until it begins to release its fragrance, about 2 minutes. Pour over the pasta and toss to coat. Transfer to the prepared baking dish. Bake until the edges of the pasta are lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Garnish with sliced orange slices and toasted seeds, if desired. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Calabrian Fish
ingredients: 4 fillets fillets | 1 package brown gravy mix | 2 cans vegetable broth | 1 cup sliced yellow squash | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat grill to high. In a medium bowl, mix together brown gravy mix and vegetable broth. Stir in squash and pecans. Place fish fillets on grill over medium heat, and top each with gravy mixture. Cover grill, and reduce heat to medium low. Simmer until fish is easily flaked with a fork, about 10 minutes.

title: Cousin Pete's Duck
ingredients: 8 ounces chicken thighs, in 3/4 inch cubes with skin | 1 lb english cucumber, peeled, deseeded, chopped roughly ( peeled or english seedless ) | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 teaspoon rice flour, to thicken ( see recipe description ) ( optional )
instructions: Put the chilies, chicken and the chicken parts into a large saucepan/crock pot and add the stock. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Stir in a little sherry, then set to one side. In a shallow bowl or jug stir the rice flour into the chicken mixture. Tip into the saucepan, stir and heat to hot. Serve on bed of rice, topped with the cucumber and sherry.

title: Chive Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 6 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup oyster sauce, made with bagoong | 4 tablespoons ground nutmeg
instructions: Beat the egg yolks on high speed for 2 minutes. Beat in the oyster sauce. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into the sauce. Sprinkle in the nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,chipotle chile adobo,date,trout fillet,orange juice zest,coriander
title: Smoked Trout With Chilli
ingredients: 2 slices orange zest | 2 ounces of dried chipotle chiles in adobo ( or a mixture of both ) or 2 ounces chili pepper flakes ( or a mixture of both ) | 4 ripe dates | 1/2 pint fresh orange juice ( or fresh juice ) | 1/4 pint fresh coriander | chili pepper
instructions: First soak the dried chipotles in the orange juice or juice until softened. The longer the piece is left, the hotter the chilli will be. The more chilli you use. Cut the dates into quarters. Put the figs, chilies, and tomatoes into a large, ovenproof dish. Cut the smoked trout fillets into 4 - 6 pieces per fish. Pour the chilli sauce over the fish. Dust with coriander. Bake gently in the oven at 170c for around 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Easy Curried Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs mild curry powder ( or more if you dare of a tangy one ) | 2 lbs onions ( or more ) | 2 cups enchilada sauce | 2 lbs garlic | 2 -3 lbs vanilla beans
instructions: Chop onions. Add all to crockpot. Cook on low until onions are translucent or 1 cup is all you're cooking. Once cooked put all in and simmer for 30 minutes. Then add the vanilla beans to the mix and cook on high for another 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,beef bouillon cube,red enchilada sauce,rosemary,snow pea,oil,paprika,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Beef Strips and Snow Peas in Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon paprika | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary or 1 -2 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1 bag frozen snow peas, defrosted | 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup light sour cream | 1 teaspoon oil | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In large skillet, heat oil over high heat. Spray bottom and sides of pan with vegetable spray. Sprinkle paprika over the oil, stirring frequently. Stir in bouillon cube, rosemary, and peas. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until peas are tender, about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove skillet from heat, add enchilada sauce, sour cream, and oil. Stir to combine. Spoon mixture into glass baking dish, filling 2/3 of the way full. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Easy Beef Ban Sandwiches (Beef Burger)
ingredients: 2 -4 hamburger buns, toasted and buttered | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish sandwich spread ( horseradish flavored ) or 1 teaspoon your favorite horseradish-flavored spread ( horseradish flavored )
instructions: Spread mayonnaise on the tops of the two buns. Layer the filling in the order given and cover for 2 minutes. Flip over the sandwich and cover for 2 minutes more. Cut into four pieces.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,corn oil,salmon fillet,purpose flour,mustard seed,mirin,egg white,egg wrap
title: Salmon Wrapped in Egg Roll
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, 5 oz/8 ounces | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 3 -4 medium egg whites | 1 package egg roll wrap | vegetable oil or corn oil | 4 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 3 -4 fresh parsley sprigs, plus more for garnish | prepared horseradish sauce, if desired ( optional )
instructions: To make salmon, remove skin from one side of the fillet, keeping filet intact with one filet on each side, and trim any oversize bones and fillets you have left. Rinse salmon and pat dry. Dredge in flour.

title: Duck Confit
ingredients: 1 duck, whole | 2 coriander | 1 cup molasses
instructions: First clean the duck and trim off all extra fat and neck. Set aside. Trim off the remaining skin and any protruding fat from the cavity by trimming off the bone and neck with your thumbs. Rub the duck with an inch layer of salt in a clean cloth bag, adding the whole coriander root and the salt inside the bag. Place the duck onto a cutting board in a flat flat layer. Trim away any excess fat and string. Wrap the duck pieces in the coriander leaves. Place the bag in a pot, cover with water and add a weight about 2/3 of the duck will fit inside the bag. Bring to a boil over high heat and skim away any foam that rises to the top. Once the water boils, reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 4 hours. After 4 hours, transfer the duck to the refrigerator and allow to set for at least 2 hours before carving. Remove the duck from the bag and place in a clean pot with a small amount of water. Bring to a boil over high heat and skim off the foam that rises to the top. Cover and reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours. Remove the cover, increase the heat to low, and simmer for an additional 30 minutes, skimming as necessary. The duck should be fork tender and no liquid remaining. Remove the duck from the heat and allow to rest overnight. Skim off any fat and serve with fresh bread, mustard or horseradish. To reheat, take the hot duck and reheat under a hot grill, or heat a few tablespoons of butter in a heavy frypan and quickly brown on both sides. Note, the duck will keep for up to 3 days covered in the dry spices and then heated up.

title: Jicama Banana Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups jicama, julienne | 2 cups sweet pickled banana peppers | 2 -3 tablespoons flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 cups apple juice | 1/2 lemon, juice of
instructions: Dredge jicama, bacon and sweet pickles in flour. Shake off excess. Saute in heavy skillet over medium high heat till bacon is crispy.

title: Cajun Hot Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup vinegar | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce ( such as sriracha ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon other hot pepper ( such as sriracha )
instructions: Mix ingredients together and serve at room temperature.

title: "healthified" Beef Steak With Mexican Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin ( i use round steak ) | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons catsup ( mexican-style ) | 1 teaspoon greek oregano | 2 tablespoons miniature semisweet chocolate milk
instructions: Slice steak into 1/2 inch thick strips and brown in a medium sized skillet with 1 t. Of sugar and 1 t. Sauce. While meat is cooking cut up 2 t. Of water and combine with cheese mixture, stir well and let simmer for about 3 - 5 minutes and add water a tablespoon at a time until desired thickness. Serve over white or brown rice. Microwave half and half cream and mix with 3 tablespoons of catsup and 2 t. Of water to desired thickness for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, set aside for 2 minuted. Add 1 t. Cheese mixture to bowl with meat and stir once. Microwave chocolate milk for last few seconds on medium heat. Add 1 t. Cheese mixture to meat and stir once.

title: Grilled Beet Stomach Appetizer
ingredients: 2 large ripe beet ( use small green beet ) | 12 small tart shells | 1 cup walnuts or 1 cup pecans, chopped | 1 can sliced ancho chilies
instructions: Wash the beet. Peel beet and chop them as small as you can, about 3/4 inch long. In a large bowl, mix the chopped beet, walnuts, chiles. Prepare a grill pan by spraying with just enough oil to cover the bottom. Grill beet, covered, over direct medium heat 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Cut into 1/2 inch slices and serve immediately.

title: Yummy Poblano Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb fresh poblano chile, seeded and chopped | 1/2 lb fresh porcini mushroom, ciliegine size | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 lb mild provolone cheese | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Remove stem and seeds from chiles and cut chiles in half lengthwise. Scoop out the seeds, then place in a glass bowl and pour 1/2 cup boiling water over. Let stand 10 minutes. Drain well and remove black veins and stems. Cut cheese into 2 inch cubes. Heat heavy large skillet over medium heat. Add chiles and toss 5 seconds. Add remaining water, oregano, and cheese. Turn heat to low and cook about 6 minutes, stirring frequently and sprinkling each with some salt and pepper, until chiles are hot. Stir in baking soda. Toss, serve hot, hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,ginger garlic paste,ra el hanout spice mix,seasoning salt,thyme leaf
title: Raz Bel Laban (Raisin and Chicken Pasta)
ingredients: 12 ounces penne pasta | 1/4 cup sweet seasoning salt ( i use morton's old's low-fat salt ) or 1/4 cup white salt ( i use morton's low-fat salt ) | 1/4 cup ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons all-day seasoning salt | 3 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Boil water for pasta. While you are waiting, combine ras el hanout spice in bowl with 3 tsp of salt, water, and set aside place your dried thyme leaves and garlic paste in a blender or food processor and puree. Combine wet and dry salt in a glass jar with lid and add to jar mixture, combine thoroughly. Add water if the sauce is too thick or if it is too thin, add water, little by little, until desired thickness of sauce is reached. If you are cooking on the stovetop, bring sauce back to a simmer and then turn to medium heat, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes after the last minute of simmering. Slightly thicken sauce with cooking spray to taste. You may want to add more salt, but the pasta absorbs it. Otherwise, it should be slightly spicier. Drain pasta and return to pot. Pour hot sauce over hot pasta and serve immediately with a nice green salad or crisp fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,sharp cheddar cheese,rigatoni pasta,stewing beef,half,turkey
title: Turkey and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 lb stewing beef | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese | 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil ( optional ) | 16 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: In skillet over medium high heat, brown both meats well and drain. Pour half and half into crockpot. Drain meat and return to skillet, stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients, mix well. Put in 4 cups casserole dish sprayed with pam. Cover dish and bake at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 hours or until beef and noodles are tender. Top with cheese when ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,belgian endive,bell pepper,green plantain,mascarpone,garlic powder,white vinegar
title: Belgian Endive and Plantain Antipasto
ingredients: 8 heads belgian endive | 8 heads bell peppers, red endive, cut into 1/4 '' strips | 12 large green plantains, scrubbed | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 7/8 cup mascarpone, for topping | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 8 leaves asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch lengths, if desired
instructions: Cut endive into 6 serving pieces, removing roots and tough leaves. Cut larger endive into 4 diagonal slices, and separate pepper strips. In large bowl, combine vinegar, mascarpone and garlic powder. Add endive and peppers. Toss until coated. Cover, and refrigerate 15 minutes to marinate. Preheat grill, or broiler. Remove vegetables from marinade. Place meat on grill, and place vegetables on metal skewers. Grill uncovered and turning frequently, 15 - 17 minutes, or until meat is well browned. Baste meat with equal amounts of sauce during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Cut vegetables in half. Arrange on plates, sprinkle with additional mascarpone cheese, and serve with warm bread.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,broccoli,confectioner sugar,red chilies,cheese,ham,ginger garlic paste
title: Broccoli Cones (Stir Fried Noodles)
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli, stems trimmed and chopped | 1/2 cup chopped roasted ham, chopped | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons onion flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 -2 small dried red chilies ( optional ) | 4 ounces cheshire cheese, grated
instructions: Cut stems off the broccoli, and cut into 2 inch pieces. In a medium mixing bowl, mix ham, confectioners' sugar, onion and ginger garlic paste. Cut the chiles into small pieces. Add small amounts of chile mixture when serving, and stir until well combined.

title: Coconut Sage Cheese Dip (for Can)
ingredients: 3 ounces cottage cheese | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage | 2 tablespoons whole angel flake coconut ( optional )
instructions: Beat your cottage cheese. Add all remaining ingredients and mix until smooth and creamy.

title: Korean Chicken Big Bowl
ingredients: 12 chicken wings | boiling ice water | 1 green cabbage, cored and roughly chopped
instructions: Slice the wings in half, then crosswise, so you end up with 12 equal portions. Heat your broiler, place each section on the counter in a small circle. If it is a good size, place the chicken wings on a baking sheet about 1/8 inch deep. Pour about 1 1/2 tablespoons of boiling ice water into the circle of wings. Turn the wings over to ensure even cooking. Place the chicken pieces on top of the coating, skin side down, making sure the coating is covering all parts. Try and move them around a bit to ensure even cooking. Broil for 10 - 10 minutes, flip over, place the baking sheet under the broiler, and cook another 5 mins to dry out the coating. Remove and let cool about 10 mins, then carefully flip over again so it browns again. These are so easy to brown too. If you want to keep the korean crunch, bake them until you get the desired thickness. I prefer to use a mandolin so that i can mix up the ingredients. Use 2 large skillets if you have enough, as the skillets are to overpower the other flavors better.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,white bread,coconut milk,lobster meat,bacon bit,cotija cheese
title: Monsters
ingredients: 1 loaf firm white bread | 1 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup fresh lobster meat | 1/2 cup salted bacon bits, cooked and crumbled | 1/2 cup crumbled bocconcillo cheese | 1/2 cup crumbled roasted salted butter-flavored bacon bits | 1/2 cup crumbled goat cheese or 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Cut a large loaf in half horizontally, place onto cookie sheet and set aside. Remove the crusts from of the bread, and soak bread halves in coconut milk for 10 minutes. The loaf can be cut into 1 inch slices if you like. Place sliced slices in a medium bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit for 20 minutes to firm the coconut meat. In a skillet, cook the salted bacon bits over medium heat until golden brown. Remove from heat and combine with bocconcillo, crumbled bacon bits, and goat cheese. Drain the bread from the coconut milk, and place evenly over the cheese mixture. Place baking sheet into the oven and bake for 20 to 30 minutes, until bread is nicely browned.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,red chili powder,cayenne pepper,mango,clam juice,applesauce,baking potato,beef stock
title: Caribbean Mango Chowder
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs medium baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1/2 lb lean ground beef | 1 cup mangoes, diced | 2 cups beef stock, made with the coconut milk can | 1 cup unsweetened applesauce | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | cayenne pepper | red chili powder
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain. Meanwhile, brown the ground beef. Add all remaining ingredients, except the cocoa, to the pot. Cook over medium heat covered for 15 minutes. Stir in cocoa and cayenne and serve over hot cooked pasta, rice, or mashed potatoes, if desired.

title: Mascarpone Cheese
