ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil, plus extra | olive oil, for brushing | 4 leeks, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 8 slices whole wheat bread | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour, for dusting
instructions: Heat the olive oil and cook the leeks for 5 - 6 minutes until they are beginning to soften. Remove from heat and stir through the mascarpone. Put the wheat bread on a baking tray and lightly brush with oil. Cut a cross in the top and then spread the cheese over the top. Bake at 220c/400f/gas mark 4 for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Cut into squares and serve with cream.

title: Pollo En Cen
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 4 tablespoons pimento stuffed olives, chopped ( without pit ) | 1/4 cup maple syrup | assorted pimento stuffed olives ( optional, for presentation )
instructions: Mix with spoon or whisk. Serve in large gravy or fondue pot, with a side of your choice of optional toppings. Garnish with fresh parsley and/or your favorite raw vegetables,.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,wheat flour,red pepper optional,lime juice
title: Roasted Whole Wheat Italian Flatbread
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 dash red pepper ( i add the green, red, and pimento, a mix of the three ) | 2 teaspoons dried pesto sauce ( the real stuff is not dry ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon lime juice ( i use more if it seems dry )
instructions: Use your hands, and stir the flour, red pepper and pesto in a bowl. Add enough lime juice to bind everything together and make a slightly sticky dough. On a well floured surface, knead the dough lightly and press into an 8 round circle about 5 inches in diameter. Brush the top with water and sprinkle a little more pesto on. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Cut in wedges. Bake until the crust is crisp and golden and the pesto is bubbling, about 20 minutes, and should sound hollow when you tap it.

Random Ingredients: corn,butterscotch schnapps,apple juice,breadcrumb,cardamom pod,pie shell,serrano chilies
title: Schnapps Apple Pie
ingredients: 2 teaspoons butter | 2 teaspoons corn | 1 serrano chilies, minced | 4 teaspoons apple juice, divided | 2/3 cup breadcrumbs, breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup butterscotch schnapps | 1/2 star cardamom pod | 1 pie shell
instructions: Place butter in pie plate or dish.

title: Easy Beef & Veggie Burgers
ingredients: 1/4 lb lean ground beef | 1/4 cup enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1 cup frozen baby peas | 1 cup canned mexican-style cornbread mix | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 can mexican style cornbread mix | 4 whole wheat hamburger buns, split
instructions: In heavy saucepan, cook ground beef over medium high heat until no longer pink.

title: Canadian Bacon & Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 375 g canadian bacon, chopped | 425 g canned pineapple in juice ( drain pineapple reserving juice ) | pomegranate seeds ( sweeten to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl crumble the Canadian bacon and add remaining ingredients and mix well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,salt pepper,cheese,cumin seed,chicken breast fillet,brandy,ancho chilies,sirloin tip roast
title: Beef Stuffed Whole Chicken Breasts W-Ancho Chile Sauce
ingredients: 8 chicken breast fillets, split ( approximately 3-4 oz each ) | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chilies ( about 14-16 whole ancho chilies ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin ( more or less, to taste ) | 1/2 cup cheese, shredded ( we use mexican blend ) | 14 -24 leaves fresh cheese | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Rinse the chicken under running water, then pat dry. Place 1 rounded teaspoon water into each slit of each piece of chicken and gently press to release any trapped air. Using a mortar and pestle, mash together the ancho chili, cumin, adobo seasoning, and cumin seeds. Combine the two chilis in a small bowl. Spoon 3/4 cup of the chile mixture onto each of the 8 chicken breast halves. Place the chicken between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and firmly pound with flat side of a meat mallet or other heavy object to flatten each piece of chicken. Repeat with another 1/4 cup chile mixture. Warm the brandy in a small saucepan on medium heat. As soon as the brandy has heated through, remove the pan from the heat. Sprinkle the chicken w/cheese and gently fold the cheese over the top. Place the chicken, breast side up, on a plate. Divide the brandy over the top of the chicken and sprinkle over the cheese. Serve with your favorite mexican meal or a salad. The ancho chili sauce can be made in advance. Refrigerate any unused sauce for an hour or so, then cover in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,adobo seasoning,onion soup mix,hamburger meat,peanut butter,monterey jack cheese,dijon mustard,pizza dough
title: Carrie's Cuban Pizza #RSC
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger meat | 1/4 cup chopped sweet onion | 1 packet dry pizza dough | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon light olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 tablespoon prepared adobo seasoning ( i use mccormick's adobo marinade ( or your favourite, i.e. el pato ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese ( i use kraft's pepperjack cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. In medium sized bowl, mix onions and pizza dough until well combined. Roll each dough piece out on lightly floured surface, about 1/8 inch thick. Place dough in greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 12 to 14 minutes. Remove from oven and crumble hamburger on top, breaking with fingers and breaking apart with edge of spoon until no longer pink. Drain juices. Add mustard, pepperjack cheese and adobo. Mix well. Drizzle with olive oil. Return to oven. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees. Cook for about 20 to 25 minutes until the topping reaches desired consistency. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Cretons from Queso Blanco
ingredients: 1/4 lb pancetta ( cured bacon ) | 2/3 cup black peppercorns | 8 dashes tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 cups queso blanco ( or gouda ) cheese
instructions: Grind the pancetta, using a food processor fitted with the coarse blade.

title: Spinach with Maraschino and Cherry
ingredients: 1 lb spinach leaves, washed, dried and chopped | 3 cups maraschino cherries, pitted, halved
instructions: Cover with 2 inches of water.

title: Sausages With Squash (Gurkensalatsa)
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed squashes | 1 ounce finely minced pork or 1 ounce finely minced beef
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and make into sausage shapes.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,plain nonfat yogurt,shrimp,phyllo pastry,beef brisket,rice noodle
title: Beef Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed | 1 ounce uncooked flat leaf parsley | 1/2 lb uncooked rice noodles | 4 ounces plain nonfat yogurt | 4 ounces cooked shrimp, sliced | 1 lb phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut brisket crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Place parsley on a cutting board. Using a meat mallet or small, sharp knife, pound parsley and rice noodles to 2/3 inch pieces, then chop to make a coarse, crumbly meal. Transfer brisket and noodles to a large bowl. Heat a large nonstick skillet set over medium high heat. Add brisket to skillet. Brown on all sides. Transfer brisket and noodles to a bowl. Add yogurt and shrimp to skillet and cook until shrimp are pink. Pour beef mixture over brisket and noodles. Spread phyllo pastry on a clean, dry surface. Sprinkle top with remaining phyllo pastry to make a double layer. Cut two large slits in top of top crust. With a sharp, wet knife, score top and bottom of crust. Place two sheets of parchment paper, a large tent of waxed paper directly on top of dough. Cut four 5 x 2 inch wide strips on top of dough. Add 1 inch water to a large, deep skillet set over medium heat and bring to a boil. Working quickly, remove parchment paper dough strips. Reduce oven temperature to 475 degrees f and brush one side of top dough strip lightly with water. Working quickly so as not to let dough burn, place one sheet of phyllo pastry into skillet and brush with water. Working quickly, place second sheet of phyllo pastry over top of parchment paper and brush with water.

Random Ingredients: polish sausage,self raising flour,saffron thread,caper,rosemary leaf,graham cracker
title: Polish Sausage and Rosemary Mini-Cheros
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried saffron threads | 1/2 cup olive oil or 1/2 cup butter | 2 tablespoons finely chopped rosemary leaves | 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 lb polish sausage | 1/4 cup capers
instructions: In a small bowl combine saffron with 1/4 cup of olive oil or butter and the rosemary. Set aside. In a large bowl mix together flour and remaining olive oil. Cut sausage into 2 1/2 inch rounds and gently pat into the flour mixture. Set aside on a greased plate. In a medium frypan or a large frying pan, fry sliced sausage until browned and cooked through. In a large, deep metal frypan, add remaining olive oil or butter and fry sausages until well browned. Remove sausages from frypan into a large bowl. Pour remaining sausage flavored oil or butter evenly over meat. Mix well, cover and allow to stand about 20 minutes to absorb flavors. Sprinkle sausages with capers or serve immediately.

title: Guilt Free Plain Doro Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1/2 cup grated jalapeno cheese | 1 tablespoon dark seedless raisins ( i use raisins a1 balls )
instructions: In a large bowl soak the raisins in 3/4 cup hot water for 10 - 40 minutes. Drain raisins and set aside. Beat yogurt until smooth. Stir in cheese and raisins and beat till combined. Pour into small bowl or serving dish and chill for 1 hour before serving. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Tomato and Lentils With Rice
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups dried toor dal | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice ( or any long grain rice of your choice ) | 1 can plum tomatoes, chopped, undrained | 2 serrano chilies | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast
instructions: Drain tomatoes. Place tomatoes, chiles, and yeast in the pot, and bring to the boil. Put dal and rice in a separate pot & cover with a close fitting lid. Heat to just under 1 c on a med. Bowl, let stand for about 10 minutes to allow steam to escape.. After 10 minutes, turn off heat, let sit uncovered for 10 - 15 minutes. Note, to test, spoon 1 tsp olive oil in a bowl and if browned, it should sizzle. If not, press down with fingers. Variation,. Instead of the tomatoes, use tomatoes packed with chiles or green chiles and the garlic. Variation,. Add a little tomato juice to help the yeast activate if desired. Variation,. Simmer 1 cup cooked rice for 30 - 45 minutes, or until tender.

title: Gruyere Pot Roast for Two
ingredients: 1 rump roast, preferably on a bone in bone with plenty of fat, about 2-3 pounds | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f rub the meat with flour and add salt if desired. Place the roast in an ovenproof roasting pan, fat side up. Pour in enough water to come halfway up the side of the roast, then cover and bake until tender when pierced with a knife, about 2 hours. Place the roasting pan on warm dinner plates and surround with the cheese. Return to the oven, uncovered, and roast under the broiler until the cheese is lightly browned on top and crisp, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: filling,ice,key lime zest,pine nut,broccoli,red curry paste,baby shrimp
title: Thai Broccoli Shrimp Filling Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 250 g baby shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 sheet broccoli | 1 key lime, zest of | 1/3 cup pine nuts | 2 -3 tablespoons icing icing sugar or 2 -3 tablespoons confectioner's sugar | fresh crushed ice
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil, add a teaspoon of salt, add a drop or two of curry depending on the strength of your curry paste. Trim the stems of the broccoli, then cut into 4 florets. Break into florets with a knife tip. Bring remaining water to boil and blanch the broccoli in the boiling water for about 3 minutes, depending until bright green. Drain and refresh in ice water. Remove the white skin, then set aside. Drain shrimp and then rinse under cold water. Drain well. Cut or pull off the tough tops of the green leaves, then cut away or break the white part so as to cover the head of the shrimp only as much as possible. Cut or tear the broccoli into 1/2 inch cubes and cook in boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain well in a sieve then add to the spinach mixture and then set aside. In a frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of the red curry paste and a teaspoon of sambal and add a few drops of ginger powder or hot red chili powder. Stir well and then add the shrimp and mix well. To prevent this formation of a clumping, place the lid over the pan and fry slowly for 5 minutes, stirring all the time. The shrimp will only be on the surface of the fish, but this only needs to cook for a minute or two before the shrimp are cooked. The pan does not have to be entirely dry at this stage. Then, using two slotted spoon, remove the shrimp to a platter. Repeat with second shrimp if necessary. To remove the clumping, pour a couple tablespoons of water into the pan, remove the lid and boil the liquid rapidly until it has reduced by half. Add the lemon zest and simmer uncovered for 1 minute. Now add the pine nuts and then, using two slotted spoon, remove the pan from the heat and place on a plate. Pour a little sugar into a small bowl, then stir a small amount of warm curry paste into it, then add it to the pan. Stir for about a minute, then add in the cooked broccoli and stir well, then continue stirring until the sauce has thickened. Serve immediately.

title: Green Chili Cheese Ball
ingredients: 3 ounces green chili peppers, from a can or jar | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | crushed ice
instructions: Put the chopped chilies into a blender and blend on high for approximately 10 seconds. Remove and put into a bowl of ice. Add the ricotta cheese to the chilie mixture and then use a wooden spoon or your hands to mix thoroughly. If the cheese mixture seems too dry, mix in an additional tablespoon of water. Roll the mixture into a ball and serve immediately. Tip.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,italian seasoning,egg,garlic red chile paste,paprika,cocoa
title: Chile Sausages(Sausages)
ingredients: 8 links garlic and red chile paste ( i use dei fratelli brand ) | 3 eggs | 3 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon cocoa ( i use hershey's ) | 1 teaspoon paprika | 4 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: Preheat oven to place bamboo skewers in enough water to cover by one inch on the skewer. Heat a cast iron skillet on the stove and grill the skewers until they are browned on both sides. Remove the meat from the pan, and arrange on a large cookie sheet in a single layer. Cut the chile into large slices. In blender or food processor, mix garlic and chile paste, eggs, italian seasoning, cocoa, paprika and cocoa until well blended. Pour into frying pan and boil until mixture thickens. Serve with sausage.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,asparagus,lemon zest,bacon,ancho chile powder,beef tenderloin,bread flour
title: Asparagus With Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 slices thick-cut bacon ( use high quality bacon or turkey bacon or use mild turkey bacon or turkey ) | 8 beef tenderloin ( filets ) | 4 -6 fresh asparagus | 1 -2 tablespoon finely grated lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup bread flour
instructions: Slice the tenderloin on the diagonal, about 1 1/2 inches thick. Cut strips crosswise 1/2 3/4 inches long and across the grain. Lay the strips evenly on a plate. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour. Place the asparagus in a large pot of boiling water and cook until just tender, about three minutes. Reserve 3/4 cup of the asparagus water. Drain and set aside. In a small heavy frypan on medium high, add the bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp, about 20 minutes. Cut out and discard the bacon drippings and keep warm. Reserve the pan drippings. Sprinkle the beef with salt. Place the tenderloins on a dinner plate. Arrange the strips on top of the beef. Sprinkle on the zest, chile powder, and cheese. Pour just enough reserved asparagus water over all, to just cover the beef. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer, covered, for about five minutes. Turn the heat to high and simmer for another 3 - 5 minutes or until the tenderloins are golden brown on both sides and cooked to your desired texture. Let cool slightly before cutting into slices.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,curry leaf,broccoli,champagne,chocolate chip,tomato puree,fontina cheese
title: Microwave Rachael Ray's Chocolate Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 head fresh broccoli, trimmed, cut into bite size pieces | 500 g fontina cheese, cut into cubes | 100 g semisweet chocolate chips | 250 ml heavy whipping cream | 5 -6 fresh curry leaves | 2 fluid ounces tomato puree | 100 ml champagne ( optional )
instructions: Place broccoli in microwave safe bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on medium high for 3 minutes until just tender crisp. Allow to cool and drain and set aside. Place fontina cheese cubes in microwave safe bowl and micro on high for 3 to 4 minutes until melted and smooth. Remove from microwave and combine with choc chips. Stir in cream and curry leaves. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if required. Add tomato puree and mix well. Place broccoli slices on serving plates and top with cheese mixture, making sure it is completely covered. Microwave on high for 1 minute to get the liquid all absorbed, then microwave on high for 5 to 6 minutes until the broccoli becomes soft and translucent. Remove from microwave and serve immediately. Pour the tomato sauce over the broccoli, using a slotted spoon to spread it around. Garnish with the chopped parsley of your choice.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,italian sausage,red pepper,celery,italian seasoning mix,marinara sauce,salt black pepper,oat
title: Sweet Sausage and Peppers
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausage | 7 large fresh red peppers, cut into 3-inch pieces | 4 large fresh sweet peppers, cut into 3-inch pieces | 6 stalks celery, finely sliced | 16 ounces marinara sauce, tomato-flavored | ditalini seasoning mix, package | 2 1/2 cups uncooked quick oats | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Remove casings from sausage and place in large, deep oven proof skillet or dutch oven. Cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Turn skillet so that sausage is evenly coated. Cook peppers and celery until tender crisp, 7 to 10 minutes. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon fat from skillet. Return skillet to medium high heat. Add marinara sauce, oats, sugar syrup, salt, and pepper, stir well to combine. Spread evenly over sausage and peppers and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup oat mixture. Cover skillet and place in preheated 400 degrees f oven. Bake, turning sausage and peppers occasionally, until bubbly and vegetables are tender, 40 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,chicken meat,cayenne,roquefort cheese,chow mein noodle
title: Crunchy Chicken Chow-Chow
ingredients: 1 container chow mein noodles | 1/2 cup crumbled roquefort cheese | 1 can chicken meat | 1 container greek-style yogurt | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Drain the chicken and shred into small pieces. Mix the noodles, ricotta cheese, and meat and put into a 9x13 pan. Cover with yogurt. Sprinkle cayenne over the noodles. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Tarragon Pickled Onions
ingredients: 6 -8 large sweet pickling onions | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon vinegar
instructions: Dry the onions thinly, using a paper towel.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,golden raisin,tomato green chilies,scallion,anise seed,cream wheat
title: Mexican Wheat Salad With Tomatoes and Chilies
ingredients: 3 cups cream of wheat | 2 tablespoons cream of wheat | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/8 teaspoon ground anise seed | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions | 2 green tomatoes, seeded ( not chilis )
instructions: Cook the cream and wheat in a large saucepan of boiling salted water for 15 minutes or until the mixture begins to thicken. Remove from the heat.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,applesauce,golden raisin,feta cheese,ancho chile,cabbage,ice water,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Appalachian Cabbage Rolls  With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped corned beef ( see note ) | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/3 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot jam | 1/8 cup applesauce | 1 3/4 - 2 cups cabbage, shredded and divided | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 1/4 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile
instructions: To make achiote glaze, in small bowl, whisk glaze ingredients until smooth and creamy, about 5 minutes. Cover and set aside. To make rolls, in medium bowl, combine corned beef, parmigiano reggiano, raisins, apricot jam, applesauce and 1 cup shredded cabbage. Spoon mixture onto top and sides of rolls, forming 2 long oblong rolls. Roll up each long roll. Skewer tops and bottoms together and place on dull side of a large baking dish, seam side down. If needed, coat baking dish well with some of the 1/2 cup cold water. Cover loosely with foil and let stand 2 hours at room temperature. Preheat oven to 300°f. Bake rolls, uncovered, until golden, about 1 hour, basting once with glaze. Serve rolls hot with remaining sauce and sprinkled with toasted pecorino cheese. To serve, arrange 2 rolls on a platter.

title: Easy No-Boil, No Filling Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 1/4 cups espresso coffee powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Fill a medium baking dish about half full with water and bring to a rolling boil. Place the noodles in the boiling water for approximately 1 minute. Drain. Place noodles in a bowl of your choice. Pour coffee powder onto the noodles. Using a pastry brush, brush tops of the noodles with a little bean paste. Place one noodle, coated side down, across the bottom of the baking dish. Spread some of the coffee powder mixture over it and top with another noodle, coated side up, completely covering the noodles. When the noodle is full, gently top it off with remaining coffee powder. Bake for 20 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Homemade Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 1/2 cups tahini
instructions: In a small bowl combine teriyaki sauce and tahini. Store in airtight container.

title: Edamame (Edamame With Mango and Chard)
ingredients: 2 cups shelled edamame, washed and dry | 2 large ripe mangoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch cubes ( cheeks removed ) | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 -6 fresh sage leaves, finely chopped, to garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, cook the edamame, tossing occasionally, approximately 8 to 10 minutes or until just cooked but still firm to bite, and then drain and keep warm. Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the mango with the sambal oelek. Over medium heat, in a large, heavy saucepan of salted water, combine the oil and sage leaves. When the sambal oil is hot add half the sage leaves, and sauté over low medium heat, mashing and turning the spines with tongs, 1 to 2 minutes or until very dark golden brown. Add the mango mixture and toss well until coated and heated through. Serve right away, garnished with the remaining sage leaves.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,garlic clove,pear,green pepper,herb,honey mustard,filet beef,bamboo skewer
title: Baked Beef, Peppers & Carrots Skewers
ingredients: 5 ounces sirloin, sliced thinly | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey mustard | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1 green pepper | 1/2 pear, peeled and sliced lengthwise | 3 fresh breads | 4 bamboo skewers
instructions: Soak skewers in water for 30 minutes prior to cooking. Soak wooden skewers in cold water for 15 minutes. Remove meat from skewers and cut into thin slices. Slice pepper. Heat olive oil in an ovenproof frying pan at medium. Add beef and brown on all sides. Add mustard, garlic, mixed herbs and green pepper and continue browning on all sides. Remove meat and vegetables to the slow cooker. Wet hands and make small cuts across meat. Place equal quantities of meat and vegetables on skewers, alternating the beef and vegetables with the pear slices. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, or on high for 6 hours.

title: Macadamia Tomato and Cherry Dip
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs | 1 tablespoon tomato puree
instructions: Place cherry tomatoes in a small saucepan and pour over about 1/2 cup cold water. Bring to a boil, then immediately remove from heat. Cover and refrigerate to allow to soften for about 1/2 an hour to soften. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup of the macadamia nuts for garnish. Place remaining chilled tomatoes in a food processor and add macadamia nuts, herbs and puree. Process to consistency you like. Transfer mixture to a medium size bowl, cover and refrigerate until required.

title: Mulholland's Favourite: Fruit Filling for Pastries
ingredients: 600 g sultanas or 600g dates | 1 tablespoon chopped garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons of crushed garlic
instructions: Using a small heavy saucepan, put all the ingredients into a large enough bowl. Mix well and heat gently. Leave to cool for an hour or so before using, but be careful it burns easily once in a while. Use in any sweet pie filling. Can be made as small as you like but will take longer to get really good results. Enjoy.

title: Coconut Ice
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 -2 cup shredded maraschino cherry
instructions: In the bottom of your blender, combine the coconut milk and cherries. Blend for 2 - 3 minutes until it's smooth. Transfer the mixture into an airtight container and place in the freezer for 2 hours, stirring occasionally to redistribute cherries as they freeze and melt on top. When the mixture is thick and creamy, transfer to a metal container and store in the freezer for 3 - 5 months.

Random Ingredients: red wine,tarragon leaf,beef roast,yellow squash,kosher salt,spinach leaf,vanilla,golden caster sugar
title: Roast Beef, Yellow Squash and Spinach With Tarragon Sauce
ingredients: 1 boneless beef roast, trimmed of fat | kosher salt | 4 red potatoes, cut in 2 cm cubes | 14 ounces frozen spinach leaves | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 2 cm cubes | 2 -3 tablespoons golden caster sugar | 2 cups strong red wine | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon leaves, chopped fresh
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f season beef cubes generously with kosher salt and place in roasting tin with skin on. Roast approximately 1 hour until a meat thermometer reads 160f. Meanwhile, boil the potatoes and yellow squash in salted water until just tender, 5 minutes, drain. Transfer potatoes and squash to a large bowl and mash the potatoes until a thick paste forms. Using your hands mix in ¾ cup of water to loosen the potato mixture, then return potatoes to the pan.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,curry powder,oyster sauce,fish sauce,corn oil
title: Aunt Marie's Easy Fish Fry
ingredients: 2 cans fish sauce ( i prefer vh ) | 2 cans corn oil | 1 tablespoon curry powder ( preferably madras ) | 1 teaspoon white pepper ( freshly ground pepper is preferred, i prefer coriander, but add more if you're a spice freak ) | 1 teaspoon fish sauce, preferably madras
instructions: Heat up the corn oil in a large frying pan. When hot add the curry powder and white pepper. Stir constantly, until all the spices have been incorporated into the oil. Add the fish sauce and stir until you have a smooth thick paste. Heat through for several minutes. Serve with sweet potato and rice, preferably steamed.

title: Easy Brazilian Celery Ribs
ingredients: 1 kg celery rib
instructions: Wash and pat dry.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,creole seasoning,dark sesame oil,head cauliflower,worcestershire sauce,ginger juice
title: Sauce for Shrimp, Chicken or Venison
ingredients: 12 ounces shrimp, peeled and deveined or 12 ounces chicken or turkey, cut into strips | 1/2 teaspoon creole seasoning | 5 tablespoons light worcestershire sauce | 3 teaspoons fresh ginger juice | 3 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 medium head cauliflower, cored and separated into florets
instructions: In a small bowl combine the shrimp, creole seasoning, worcestershire sauce, ginger juice, sesame oil and white pepper to taste. Marinate the shrimp in the sauce for at least 2 hours and up to overnight in the refrigerator. Boil the cauliflower for about 5 minutes and drain. Cook the shrimp in oil until the shrimp turns pink but not cooked completely. Serve the shrimp over the cauliflower.

title: Spanish Pickled Beets
ingredients: 3 cups shredded mexican-style processed cheese blend | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped | 12 beets, washed, halved | 1 tablespoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange peel
instructions: In a 3 1/2 quart glass bowl or medium saucepan, combine the cheese, onion and beets. Add the spices and mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Mexican Style Chili
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans | 2 cans pasilla chiles | 2 cans diced red bell peppers ( optional ) | 4 lbs hamburger, cooked and drained of grease | 2 cups water
instructions: Cut the green and red bell peppers into 1 inch pieces. If desired you can also use pinto beans.

Random Ingredients: half cream,cannellini bean,cottage cheese,cream mushroom soup
title: Cannellini Casserole
ingredients: 16 ounces cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 1/4 cups half-and-half cream | 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together cannellini beans, soup, and half and half until well blended and creamy, about 5 minutes. Stir cottage cheese into the bean mixture until well blended. Transfer the bean mixture to a 2 quart casserole dish. Cover the dish with a lid, and bake for 40 minutes in the preheated oven, then remove the cover. Continue cooking for 30 minutes and or until the casserole has absorbed all the liquid.

title: Smoked Salmon and Beans
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 2 cans smoked salmon, cut into chunks | 3 tablespoons sultanas
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot.

title: Tomato Gravy on Ravioli
ingredients: 250 g frozen ravioli | 140 g greek yogurt | 100 g fontina | 2 italian plums | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons water | 1 tablespoon fresh herb, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Ravioli, take your ravioli and snap them apart. Place them back in the cold water, drain, and run cold water over them. The ravioli should be soft. In a large pot melt 1 tbs of the butter over medium heat and saute the ravioli for about 3 minutes so they are slightly browned on the outside and beginning to crisp in the hot butter. Remove from the pan and set aside, keeping warm. Dice the fontina. Dice the plum tomatoes and combine with the remaining butter in the empty deep pan with the corn starch and water. Bring to a boil and stir in the herbs and the cornstarch slurry. Add the ravioli and stir to coat with the sauce. Bring to a boil, then stir in the cheese and serve.

title: Buffalo Chicken Legs
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1 package chicken legs | 1/2 cup hot sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a gallon freezer bag. Close bag and freeze for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: seasoning mix,beef brisket,avocado,herb,chili pepper flake,picante sauce,basmati rice,pimento olive
title: Baked Beef Brisket With Avocado and Herbs
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed ( or one or two large brisket ) | 8 pimento stuffed olives | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 3/4 teaspoons mixed herbs | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( or 3/4 tablespoon of cayenne pepper ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons mrs. dash seasoning mix | 1 avocado ( peeled and sliced ) | fresh herb ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Rinse brisket and pat dry with paper towels. Rinse olives under cool running water. Drain. Cut brisket in half across the grain in 1 inch thick slices. Place in a nonreactive baking dish. Cover with olives and picante sauce. Sprinkle with herbs and chili flakes. Stir. Add avocado slices and close. Bake uncovered for 1 hour or more, until meat is fork tender. Remove and serve. Optional, serve with a side dish such as sour cream, salsa or guacamole. May be served cold if preferred.

title: Kirsch Shrimp and Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kirsch | 1 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon, plus | fresh tarragon, to garnish | 4 thin sliced beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 lbs precooked tiny shrimp
instructions: Stir together the kirsch, sugar and tarragon. Spoon over the tenderloin. Cover and marinate 25 minutes. Meanwhile, in another pan, cook the shrimp, covered, over moderately high heat, undisturbed, just until slightly charred, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from the heat and carefully transfer to a serving plate. Brush the shrimp with the kirsch mixture, scatter with the marinated shrimp, and season with salt and pepper. Serve garnished with sprigs of tarragon.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,coconut milk,monterey jack cheese,pistachio nut,teff flour,pimiento
title: Molletes De Arrabbiata (Pea-Potted Peas and Pistachio Crackers)
ingredients: 12 ounces cheese ( monterey jack ) | 3 ounces carrots ( sliced or sliced almonds ) | 24 ounces frozen peas and carrots | 2 tablespoons unsalted shelled pistachio nuts | 3 tablespoons teff flour | 1/2 pint light coconut milk
instructions: Boil the carrots, carrots, peas and nuts with 1 cup water until tender. Drain. Blend well. Dissolve the flour with 1/2 cup of the water. Add this mixture to the sauce and cook 5 - 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour over the rice.

title: Beef Tataki
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 8 ounces peanut or 8 ounces vegetable oil for frying | 4 ounces margarine, cut into 4 pieces | 4 ounces chopped peanuts | 2 oranges bell peppers | 1 ounce chopped dill weed | 1 1/2 lbs broccoli
instructions: Cut the beef into 1/2 chunks. Cook the beef, margarine and oil over medium high heat until the surface of the beef has turned color, about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to medium and cook for 1 minute more. Remove meat and set aside. Add vegetables and cook until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Return meat to pan and add sauce. Bring to boil, cover, and simmer until the meat and vegetables are done, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,italian salad dressing,worcestershire sauce,sauce,mirin,green chilies
title: Spicy Chili Nachos
ingredients: 6 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 pinch hot sauce ( to taste ) | 1 2/3 cups bottled hot sauce ( a1 for diabetics ) | 2 green chilies, seeded and cut in thin segments
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium sized bowl. Stir well. Cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,cayenne,tamari,sesame seed oil,kitchen bouquet,coriander,monterey jack cheese,hot italian sausage
title: Cheese with Sesame Sauce
ingredients: 2 links hot italian sausage, casings removed ( casing removed and crumbled ) | kitchen bouquet | 2 tablespoons tamari ( or other soy sauce ) | 1 teaspoon fresh coriander | 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil | 2 teaspoons lemon extract ( optional ) | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Line a glass baking dish with foil. Put the sausage into a skillet over medium heat and pour the kitchen bouquet over the sausage. Stir until the sausage are evenly evenly browned. Drain off the grease and turn up the heat to medium high. Quickly and carefully transfer the sausage to the prepared baking dish, being careful not to overcrowd. Bake the sausage for 15 minutes, stirring once. Stir the remaining ingredients into the sausage and return the dish to the oven. Bake for 20 more minutes. Remove from the oven and sprinkle the top of the dish with grated cheese and cook for 3 - 5 more minutes.

title: Blueberry and Banana Cream Soup
ingredients: 450 g fresh blueberries | 350 g bananas, coarsely chopped | 200 ml double cream
instructions: Bring the blueberries to the boil in a large saucepan. Remove from the heat, then stir in the bananas. Cover and chill. Whip the cream until stiff peaks form. Fold it into the poached soup. Season to taste with sea salt. Serve right away.

title: Poblano Chiles & Chocolate Chips (Moloto Especial)
ingredients: 5 poblano chiles | 1 cup vanilla sugar | 250 g chocolate chips ( roughly half a kilo, roughly three quarters a kilo, roughly half a kilo )
instructions: Roast the chiles until completely black all over, this will take about 8 minutes, remove and place in a bowl covered with plastic wrap or a clean towel to get rid of some of the charred skin. Chop finely and leave to cool to room temperature. Put chiles in a blender with the vanilla sugar. Mix well until all of the sugar is absorbed. Once the chiles are chopped, roughly chop the peppers and put in the blender. Blend until smooth again. It should take a few minutes but it can be taken if you have a blender or an immersion blender. Store in the fridge for up to a month. To eat, cut in small bites with a hot knife that you have seasoned with some good cocoa and vanilla essence. Serve sprinkled with a little melted chocolate, toasted or slightly crushed chocolate if you like.

title: Indian Style Turkey
ingredients: 1 whole turkey | 10 curry leaves
instructions: Rinse turkey inside and out with salt. Pat the cavity with salt and cut a slit lengthwise down the center of the thigh to open it like opening a book. The cavity opening should be 2 to 3 inches deep. If you want to keep it together, you can cut a slit in the neck and body part at the neck to close it up like a book. If you don't, discard the inner stuffing. Place your turkey in a large pot with the curry leaves inside, then cover with enough water to cover the turkey. Add enough water to almost cover the bottom of the turkey. Weight the turkey down with a plate to keep it submerged. Boil over medium heat until tender, about 1 1/2 hours. This can be done in the oven as well, but the aroma is better if you allow it to simmer uncovered for 30 minutes, then skim before serving.

title: Artichoke Jam With Chipotle
ingredients: 8 ounces jam | 2 chipotle peppers, canned in adobo sauce | 1 can artichoke hearts, canned drained
instructions: Mix jam, chipotle peppers and artichoke hearts together in a large crock. Bring to a boil. Boil until syrupy, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: penne,milk ricotta cheese,trout fillet,green onion,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cheese and Trout Penne
ingredients: 10 ounces penne | 2 teaspoons finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 ounces smoked trout fillets, chopped | 6 tablespoons chopped green onions
instructions: Cook the penne in salted water until al dente drain and reserve. While pasta is still hot, toss ricotta and pepperoni in a large bowl with the hot pasta and add cheese toss well. Divide pasta among 4 plates and top with onion and turkey mix.

Random Ingredients: pecan,green cardamom,baby carrot,avocado,chili powder,tofu,chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Nogado Tofu
ingredients: 3 -6 cups firm tofu ( or firm tofu ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh baby carrots | 1 -2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon ground green cardamom | 2 tablespoons fresh pecans or 2 tablespoons cashews, chopped | 1 avocado, mashed
instructions: Slice tofu into 1/2 inch slices. Place on lightly greased baking sheet and top with baby carrots, chili powder and ground chili, if using. Sprinkle with ground green chili flakes and cardamom. Bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes, then cover tightly with a clean dish towel and allow to sit for 1 hour. Add mashed avocado and stir well, allowing mixture to absorb flavors until the desired thickness is reached.. Serve immediately or store in refrigerator for up to two days in tightly sealed plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: bean,yellow mustard,chili pepper flake,marshmallow,lime wedge,chipotle chile,feta cheese,cayenne
title: Chipotle Cheesecake Bars
ingredients: 16 ounces baked beans, drained | 1 cup shredded feta cheese | 4 ounces miniature marshmallows | 4 ounces chipotle chiles, minced with liquid | yellow french's mustard, prepared with 1 teaspoon chipotle oil | 1 pinch cayenne ( to taste ) | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Line a 10 x 5 inch baking pan with parchment paper. Line the pan with parchment paper, then spread the baked beans evenly over the pan surface. Crumble half the feta cheese over the baked beans. Melt the marshmallows using the chipotles with the liquid in a small saucepan until melted. Remove from heat and stir in the chiles, mustard and chipotle oil. Spread the chocolate mixture evenly over the cheese layer. Pour the other half of the cheese over the top of chile mixture and press down evenly with your fingers. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until crisp and golden. Cool for five minutes and serve.

title: Mama's Besan-Style White Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans evaporated skim milk | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 cup all-purpose white flour | 1 cup grated romano cheese ( optional )
instructions: Place the evaporated milk, turmeric powder, and flour into a saucepan.

Random Ingredients: acorn squash,yogurt,tomato puree,garbanzo bean,beef stew meat,sunflower oil,vinegar,tapioca starch
title: Beef Raita
ingredients: 2 cups garbanzo beans, soaked overnight | 1 large acorn squash, cut into 1 x 3/4 inch sticks | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1/3 cup yogurt ( can use greek but plain or fat free version ) | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 tablespoons tamarind vinegar | 1 teaspoon tapioca starch | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 4 cups water and 2 tsbp. Of salt and soak the chickpeas overnight. The next day drain and rinse the chickpeas and squash in a colander for several minutes to remove the saltiness. Reserve and set aside. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium high heat. Pat the meat dry with paper towels. Cook the meat about 3 minutes or until it browns on all sides. Stir in the yogurt and puree, tamarind vinegar, and remaining cup of water. Add the beef, chickpeas and squash and bring to a boil. Reduce heat low, cover, and cook for 1 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender. Mix the tapioca starch with the remaining 3 cups of water and add to stew. Simmer gently for 25 minutes, or until thick. Variation, add mushrooms, olives, peas, or tomatoes as desired.

title: Corn, Cashew and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 250 g cauliflower | 1 cup corn | 1 cup cashews, chopped | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, sliced
instructions: Boil water and add cauliflower to it along with corn and sliced olives cook 3 minutes or till cooked drain all excess water and mix with other ingredients toss well. Serve hot.

title: Baked Irish Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 5 slices bacon | 1 lb lean boneless beef chuck | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( about 3 lemons ) or 2 tablespoons lemon zest ( about 3 lemons ) | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn | 2 pears
instructions: Remove meat from bones into a bowl. Cut sausages lengthwise, into 1/2 inch slices, slicing diagonally, then, into thin slices. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix together 2 tbsp lemon juice with pepper and peppercorns, set aside. Layer the slices of meat, overlapping, on the bottom of crock pot, leaving about 1/2 inch between, sprinkle on the sausage, bacon, and 1 tbsp lemon juice mixture over the meat layer. Sprinkle with the remaining lemon mixture. Peel, core, and cut pears into 1/4 inch pieces. Place meat layer on top of veggies. Top with remaining veggies, then drizzle with remaining lemon juice. Cover the pot. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours, or until meat and veggies are tender. If you do not have a crock pot, cook for 4 hours on low.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,focaccia bread,almond flavoring,butter lettuce,tomato basil pasta sauce,tomato juice,tamari
title: Elegant Italian Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted butter lettuce | 3 ounces uncooked tomato basil pasta sauce | 1 can coconut milk | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1/2 teaspoon almond flavoring | 4 slices country-style focaccia bread | tomato basil flavored pasta sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut butter lettuce into 1 inch strips, making sure to remove the dark stalks. Brush slices with butter, and reserve. Combine tomato sauce, coconut milk, tamari, and almond flavoring in a saucepan.

title: Spanish Black Olives
ingredients: 1 small apple, chopped into 1/2 inch chunks | 1 bag fresh cilantro | 1 package tea bags | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/3 cup green olives
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. To serve, add to crock bowl, spoon salad onto plates. For vegan, substitute 2 tsp sugar for the soy sauce.

title: Noodles
ingredients: 4 ounces yellow sweet peppers, chopped | 6 ounces noodles, such as kikkoman's
instructions: If i cook the noodles in a skillet, i usually simmer in water until only little jiggle remain. When all are cooked, transfer to a serving bowl and top with chopped up peppers. Enjoy.

title: Easy Gravy for Dried Beef
ingredients: 12 ounces andouille sausage, sliced | 2 cans condensed beef broth
instructions: Place sausages and beef broth in a slow cooker. Cook on low for 5 minutes. Stir in worcestershire sauce and cook for an additional hour.

title: Chocolate Stuffed Beet Latkes
ingredients: 10 large beets ( or 1 pound raw ) | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 4 ounces manchego cheese | 12 -16 slices bread | 1/4 medium white onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cashew nuts ( optional ) | 12 -24 ladyfingers | coffee, optional, to serve ( optional ) | whole wheat coffee, optional, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Peel eggs. Cut off beets. With a large spoon, scoop out and discard beets from the stem and mash the beets with a fork. Chop stems and coarsely mince onions. Finely mince garlic. Remove beets from shells and mash beet mixture. Using a spatula, press mixture evenly into a 13x9 baking dish. Set aside. Cut 6 ounces manchego cheese into 16 thin slices. Place a slice of bread on work surface. Place 4 ounces of beet mixture in the center of the slice of cheese. Fold sandwich over the beet mixture and roll up tightly in bread slices. Place finished roll, seam side down, on top of cheese stuffed plate. Pour coffee over rolled sandwiches. Prepare rolls and sprinkle with a couple of tablespoons of the maple syrup if desired. Cut reserved beets lengthwise down center. Pull the bottom slice off the top slice, and carefully remove all the beet mixture that has peels on it, discard the beets that are still attached.

title: Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Sauce can be used for chicken, shrimp or other seafood.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,lemon juice,curry powder,roasting chicken,vanilla pudding mix
title: Curry Chicken
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 roasting chickens | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla pudding mix | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder or 1/2 teaspoon garlic clove, crushed
instructions: Use only the white part of the onion for the curry and not the light yellow part. This makes the chicken almost cook inside. Turning a bit slower is easiest. I let the chicken marinade in the fridge for 24 hours, but we do not cook with the onions on top, which i find very unpleasant. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Rinse chicken inside and out and pat dry. Place chicken in a large roasting tin and sprinkle with curry powder and crushed garlic. Stir to mix. Cover with tin foil and bake for 40 minutes, or until tender.

title: Toffee Marsala Baste
ingredients: 10 fluid ounces marsala wine | 2 tablespoons beef base
instructions: Pour marsala wine into a cup full of ice cubes. Stir, then place a meatball into the pot into the wine mixture, and press with a spoon. Repeat to let the meatballs soak up as much liquid as possible.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,honey,sun tomato oil,cremini mushroom,corn muffin mix,parchment paper,drambuie,rum extract
title: Parchment Paper Smoked Beef Brisket (With Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, rinsed of excess salt | 2 ounces rum extract | 2 ounces honey | 2 tablespoons corn muffin mix ( such as mahatma's ) | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1 cup cremini mushroom, cut into julienne slices | 3 1/2 ounces drambuie ( or use other brand, rum flavored ) | 1 cup parchment paper, parchment paper cut into 4x4-inch rectangles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Place the brisket on the parchment paper on a wire rack above a baking pan. In a small bowl, mix together the rum extract, honey, and corn muffin mix until well combined, being very careful with your hand as this might damage the parchment paper. Spread the mushroom slices over the brisket, then top with the smoked brisket. Top with the drambuie and sun dried tomatoes. Add more honey, if needed, if desired. Brush the parchment paper with olive oil, then fold the parchment around the brisket. Place the brisket on a rack in a roasting pan on the rack, or transfer it to a grill pan on the rack. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes, basting once with the pan juices every 15 minutes. After 45 minutes, take the brisket out of the oven, and brush it lightly with olive oil, if necessary. Return to the oven, and bake for 20 minutes, basting once with the pan juices. Slice and serve.

title: Chilly Cherries and Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup scallion | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice ( spice hunter )
instructions: Cut the tomatoes in half and clean out the seeds from them. Remove all the seeds leaving about 1/2 of the tops intact for a presentation. Place the halves on a parchment lined baking tray and place in a pre heated oven at 175oc for 6 to 8 minutes. Turn the tomatoes over and leave to cook for 5 to 6 minutes more, until softened and the tomatoes have begun to shrivelle. Remove from the oven and allow to cool somewhat. Then, using a slotted spoon, take out the core and the pith from the tomatoes and cut them into 1/2 inch rounds. Peel the green skins off and the white pith from the scallions, keeping the green portions separate, and chop them finely. Place them in a mortar with the spices and a splash of freshly ground black pepper and pound together to a paste. To serve, scoop out the tomatoes and place them on individual plates. Spoon the scallion mix back over the tomatoes and sprinkle with the fresh chives. Serve and enjoy.

title: Lite Mac N Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb campanelle pasta, broken in 6-8ths | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 large celery rib, diced | 3/4 cup low-fat sour cream light or 3/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Cook mac noodles, drain and reserve 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid. In a heavy bottomed skillet, saute celery in oil in batches until celery is tender. Add noodles, sour cream and coconut to skillet and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes or until hot.

title: Baked Beans With Sage & Macaroni
ingredients: 4 cups cooked large elbow macaroni | 1 can white beans, rinsed & drained | 1/4 cup sage leaf, chopped | toothpick ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Drain the beans and reserve their liquid. Put the macaroni in a mixing bowl. Add the beans to the pasta along with the sage & season with salt. Toss well and spread in a single layer on a parchment lined baking sheet, or in a roasting dish. Bake for 25 minutes or until the beans are heated through and the noodles are tender. Let stand five minutes and serve with a crispy sage leaf.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,green apple,habanero pepper,green chile pepper,savory
title: Green Apple Ketchup With Saffron
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds green apples - peeled, cored and chopped | 3 1/2 fluid ounces habanero peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 fluid ounces dried savory | 2 1/4 fluid ounces green chile peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 pinch saffron strands
instructions: Combine apples, habanero chiles, savory, green and jalapeno chile peppers together in a bowl. Pour in enough water to cover completely. Stir in saffron, season with salt. Store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Green Chile Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/2 lb shelled and deveined shrimp paste | 2 green chilies, sliced | 1 tablespoon dijon-style mustard | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons buttermilk ( for thicker mayonnaise, as needed ) | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet japanese rice wine, not canola )
instructions: Blend shrimp paste, chilies, mustard, lemon juice and buttermilk until smooth, then add mirin and mix well. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour so flavors can blend. Serve on lettuce leaves for a salad and also on crackers or bread.

title: Cherry Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white rice, room temperature | 1 cup baby carrots, sliced into matchsticks | 1 cup green chili paste | 1 packet sugar snap peas, cut into thin strips | 3/4 cup vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon white rice vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Serve chilled.

title: Hawaiian Pina Colada Salad
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 lemon, peel of, grated | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 pineapple, peeled and cut into wedges
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,bouillon granule,orange juice concentrate,coriander leaf
title: Orange Spices Aussie Style
ingredients: 50 ml orange juice concentrate | 40 ml sweet chili sauce | 2 teaspoons bouillon granules | 25 g fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients into a small saucepan and stir over a low heat until the sugar has dissolved. Bring to the boil and then reduce to a simmer. Simmer for 1 minute or until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Mould the mixture into sticks with the coriander.

title: Aglio E Olio
ingredients: 1 lb fresh shiitake mushroom | 1/2 lb dried macaroni | 1 cup shallot, chopped | 1 jar sauerkraut | 2 pinches dried pimientos
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the rehydrated mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Set aside. In a large saucepan, bring about 1 3/4 cups of water and the macaroni to a boil. Cook for 8 minutes, or until al dente. Cook until al dente. Drain and set aside. In a skillet, cook the shallots until they begin to brown, about 10 minutes. Stir into the mushroom mixture along with the saurkraut. Cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the pimentos. Add the cooked macaroni and cook until heated through.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,oregano leaf,rigatoni pasta,pork shoulder,green food coloring
title: Mama Dalla's Chocolate Pork Rigatoni
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into cubes | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | green food coloring | 3/4 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb other tubular pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Place the pork and cocoa into a large zip top plastic bag. Add oregano and food coloring, stir to coat evenly and seal the bag. Turn the bag over several times, refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large roasting pan with aluminum foil. Toss the meat with the cheese. Heat the oven to 225 degrees f and place rack in the middle. Drain off excess fat. Remove the bag of pork cubes from the bag. Arrange the meat in a single layer on the foil. Top with red food coloring. Scatter the browned cheese directly over the meat. Scatter the rigatoni over the meat. Bake for 1 hour. Remove from the oven and stir the meat and cheese. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,berbere,lime,rotel tomato chilies,onion soup mix,grain white rice,phyllo dough
title: Mexican Rice Pie (Rice Pie)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( i use basmati ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 package onion soup mix ( i like amy's veggeable ) | 1 teaspoon berbere | 1 tablespoon red & yellow seville's taco seasoning or 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 gallon of natural phyllo dough ( can also use recipe # 93579 ) | 2 limes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Rinse rice thoroughly. Drain rotel tomatoes and chilies. Heat in a pot over medium heat until tomatoes melt. Remove from heat. In a large bowl, combine the rice, tomatoes, soup mix, bermre, and the taco seasoning. On a cookie sheet arrange phyllo in a circle. Top with some tomato mixture. Add a layer of phyllo to cover, covering as much as possible. Repeat this process until all of the phyllo has been used. Repeat this process with a second layer of phyllo. Pour 1 cup of water into a large pot, then add rice. Cover and bring to a boil. Then reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove 2 of the frozen pastry sheets, place on cookie sheet to partially thaw. Roll out remaining sheets until you have a 7x14 rectangle. Preheat oven in a separate pot, boil up approximately 1/2 cup water and the contents of that pot, stir and let simmer. When rice and rice are both ready, remove from heat. Place rice in a deep baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap or a lid. Pour rice water over top, then top with more plastic wrap so your steam can escape. Place in the oven. Bake for another 45 - 50 minutes, or until phyllo is crispy. Let set for 15 minutes before cutting in squares to serve.

title: A Perfect Spiced Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1 container prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup dark corn syrup | 1/4 cup green cardamoms, cracked open | 1/4 cup store-bought marinara sauce
instructions: In a large glass bowl, stir together the prepared horseradish, dark corn syrup, cardamom, and marinara until thoroughly combined. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, or overnight, before serving.

title: Mexican Squash With Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons vegetable ( corn ) juice or 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons salsa | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | cooking spray | 2 medium yellow squash or 2 medium zucchini, cut into bite-sized chunks | salt and pepper
instructions: For tahini sauce, combine all ingredients, stirring well. For squash, lightly spray and grill the vegetables until tender, about 3 - 5 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Serve with warm pita bread, pita chips or chips.

title: Pork and Black Bean Salsa

instructions: Drain beans well, rinsing out any excess grease. To make salsa, combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Cover and chill 2 hours or until ready to serve. To serve, place a pork chop on top of each bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,mustard seed,plain flour,anise seed,corn syrup,parmesan cheese,cocoa powder,mozzarella cheese
title: Miniature Faux Cheese Sandwich Focaccia
ingredients: 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 10 cm piece fresh mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line a 20cm x 30cm swiss roll tin with baking paper. Combine the first 7 ingredients in a bowl.

title: Vegetable and Sourdough Focaccia
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white flour ( or gluten-free ) | 3 cups sourdough bread, cut into thin slices ( from the loaf ) | 1 cup sourdough bread, cut into thin slices ( from the loaf ) | 2 cups navy beans ( cooked or canned, drained ) | 1 cup red onion, finely diced | 1 cucumber, diced | 3 tablespoons applesauce | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 4 slices rye bread, toasted ( or similar sandwich bread slices )
instructions: For the french baguette, preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the flour, sourdough and french bread slices. Spread the bread slices on a baking sheet, and bake for 5 minutes. In a second medium bowl, mix together beans, onion, cucumber, applesauce and cream until well incorporated. Add 1/2 cup water to the beans, and combine well. Assemble focaccia by piling the bread slices onto a serving plate. Place the french baguette, sourdough side up, on top of the bread slices. Serve warm.

title: Beer Fried Tortillas
ingredients: 13 inches flour tortillas | 1 can beer
instructions: Put on a pan of hot grill to high. Cut tortillas into 6 wedges. Put half wedge of tortilla on the side of a frying pan. Cook on high until golden brown, flipping with tongs or a fork and cook the other side. Cut tortillas into 6 wedges. If desired, put on a platter with cheese slices and drizzle with beer.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,raspberry,thyme leave,stewing beef,tortilla,cumin seed
title: Raspberry Beef Tacos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 teaspoons dried thyme leave | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | 2 -4 small stewing beef, trimmed of fat | 2 cups frozen raspberries or 2 cups fruit compote | 1 flour tortillas or 1 corn tortilla, warmed
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When the skillet is hot, add the cumin seeds, oregano and chili flakes and toast, stirring, for 30 seconds. Add the beef and sear, turning until browned all over. Add the tomatoes and their juice and raspberries and simmer for 5 minutes. Spoon the beef mixture onto warmed tortillas and top with the fruit salsa.

Random Ingredients: coffee,white onion,cheddar cheese,dijon mustard,cashew,pinto bean,sun tomato,bell pepper
title: Italian Roasted Beans
ingredients: 1/2 large white onion, chopped | 3/4 cup roasted cashews | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons instant coffee | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup cubed cheddar cheese | 1/2 bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f spray 2 - 9 x 13 inch pans with cooking spray. Combine onion, cashews, sun dried tomatoes, dijon mustard, and coffee in a food processor. Process until finely ground. Spread bean mixture evenly in the prepared pans. Top with cheddar cheese, bell pepper, and remaining ingredients. Bake approximately 30 minutes or until heated through and bubbly.

title: Bean Sprouts and Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut in 1/4-inch slices | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast meat, thinly sliced | 1 celery rib, thinly sliced | 1 bunch fresh mint, stems removed | 1 1/2 cups hot water | 1 bag fresh bean sprouts, washed
instructions: To make kielbasa,. In a large skillet over medium high heat, brown sausage on all sides. Transfer to paper towel lined plate to drain. In same skillet over medium high heat, add chicken, celery, mint, and hot water. Simmer for 5 minutes – or until cooked through. Serve sprinkled with kielbasa and bean sprouts.

title: Irish Stew With Whiskey Ginger

instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook the beef and pancetta until the beef is no longer pink. Drain off any excess drippings. Add the grape tomatoes and coriander centers. Sprinkle the gelatin over the beef mixture, stirring until dissolved. Add the coconut milk, whiskey, and sherry. Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and cover until ready to serve.

title: Mexican  Cheese  Pie
ingredients: 5 egg whites | 1 lb monterey jack cheese ( or a combination of longhorn and mozzarella, depending on how cheesy you want the pie to be. my special addition is colby. )
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Add cheese slowly in a thin stream being sure to incorporate all those ingredients.. Fold in beaten egg whites into the crust. Sprinkle on top of cotija cheese. Bake at 400 degrees about 30 - 40 minutes or till golden brown.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,matzo meal,cream chicken soup,hot chili sauce,kosher salt,rice vinegar
title: Crunchy Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons low-sodium peanut oil | 1 teaspoon hot chili sauce | 1/2 cup matzo meal | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | kosher salt
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. In an ovenproof pan in the oven, heat the oil over medium heat until it shimmers. Add the chili sauce and matzo meal and mix until they form a crumbly mixture. Drain the batter well and transfer to an 8 inch baking pan with 3/4 inch of space around it. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes or until the top is lightly browned and crusty. instructions: In a mixing bowl put the ground meat, almonds, tapioca starch, margarine or ghee, flour, and water. Mix with a wooden spoon until it forms a stiff dough with no lumps. title: Sausage Cranberry & Gorgonzola Salad
ingredients: 1 lb bacon or 1 lb ham, cut into bite sized pieces | 10 large star anise, seeds and ribs removed | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed | 1 3/4 lbs hot skinned and boneless fresh goat cheese, cut into 4 equal size pieces | 3/4 cup vinegar | 1 1/2 cups cranberries or 1 1/2 cups raisins ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Place ham in large bowl.

title: Barbeque Grilled Tuna
ingredients: 1 teaspoon barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup chopped broccoli | 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup maraschino cherries, halved | 2 teaspoons tamari | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 4 tuna steaks, about 1 inch thick or tuna fillets

title: Beetroot Puree
ingredients: 1 beetroot | 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped
instructions: Remove the beetroot from the peel with a sharp knife and, using a vegetable peeler or cleaver, peel the beetroot into long thin strips. Place the chopped beetroot in a small saucepan with just enough water to cover the beetroot. Bring this to a boil and cook gently for 1 hour or until the beetroot becomes soft just from the bite. Drain the beetroot. Discard the beetroot part of the beetroot's beet leaf or beets and reserve for another use. Peel and grate the beetroot. Heat the oil or butter over a medium heat in a saucepan and fry the walnuts, stirring, for about 3 minutes or until they turn a pale golden colour. Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on kitchen paper and set aside. Put the beets into a blender with the reserved beetroot beetroot and walnuts and pulse to a smooth puree. Heat a little of the beetroot puree in a frying pan and fry the puree for 3 minutes, stirring. Add a little more puree to the beetroot puree and stir until combined. Add the remainder of the beetroot puree and stir until smooth. Allow to cool slightly and then chill for 15 minutes. Stir the beetroot puree back into the beetroot puree and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian worcestershire sauce,onion soup mix,salt black pepper,chipotle chile,margarine,rice vinegar,black eyed pea
title: Rice and Chipotle Beef Hash #RSC
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 small onion, finely chopped | 2 cans black-eyed peas | 2 cups vegetarian worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 packages dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons dry rice vinegar | 1 minced chipotle chile, seeds and stems removed | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat margarine in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion.

title: Roasted Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 package good seasons italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 4 chile peppers, or more to taste, chopped | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Place sliced mushrooms into a square casserole dish. Bake in the preheated oven at 450 degrees f for 30 to 40 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese, and broil for a few minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Raspberry Hazelnut Spread - Vegan Version
ingredients: 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/2 cup raspberry, hulled and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Take 1/2 cup hazelnuts and slice them finely. Put them in one bowl and place them on a sheet of parchment paper in a roasting pan/sillet over a pot of simmering water. The water will warm the hazelnuts so it will remove some of their crunchiness. Place the remaining hazelnuts in another bowl and place them on the same pan with the parchment. Using a potato peeler shave the hazelnuts into ribbons and place them on the paper. Let the hazelnuts cool to room temperature. Place the remaining hazelnuts in a food processor and add your sliced raspberries. Pulse until the raspberry fruit is finely diced into a smooth paste. Add the hazelnut paste and process until smooth. Use a spatula to fold in the hazelnut pieces until they are thoroughly combined with the raspberry/hazelnut mixture. Store the hazelnut spread in an airtight container and refrigerate the spread for 2 - 3 days until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,parmesan cheese,sesame oil,gingerroot,extra virgin olive oil,tomato ketchup,tomato green chilies,tagliolini
title: Sara's Spicy Bean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 200 g tagliolini ( or pasta of your choice to serve ) | 400 g canned cannellini beans, drained, liquid reserved | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 ml extra virgin olive oil | 1 cm piece gingerroot, peeled ( about 3-4 inches across, peeled roughly chopped ) | 12 tomatoes ( tin-ripened ) | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain, catching any pasta water. Set aside. Add tomatoes and sugar–golden syrup and boil over high heat until reduced in volume by half and then reduced again by half again. Drain pasta carefully. Transfer to a large serving bowl, add bean mix and toss lightly. Sprinkle with tomato ketchup. Serve with grated parmesan on top and crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,red chile pepper,bell pepper,wheat flour,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon wedge,hamburger,leek
title: Chile and Swiss Steak Burger With Peppers
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon white-wheat flour | 1 -2 red chile pepper, seeded and finely sliced ( or to taste ) | 1 small bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 hamburger ( round or sirloin ) | 1 tablespoon thinly sliced pickled leeks ( white part only ) | lemon wedge ( optional, for garnish )
instructions: In a bowl, combine 1/4 cup of the whole wheat flour with the white/wheat flour, stirring just until it starts to resemble rough breadcrumbs. Add the sliced chili and peppers, and set aside. Dry the hamburger round or sirloin, if using, on absorbent paper or a clean surface. Spray the pan lightly with vegetable oil spray and heat over medium high heat. Sprinkle the leeks on top, then quickly brown the meat on both sides. Remove the meat to a plate, slice the meat into thin bite sized pieces, and set aside if you are using the pickled leeks. Pour the remaining 1/4 cup of flour into a small bowl, and add the rest of the vegetables. Add a touch of vegetable oil if the flour seems too thin or too wet, stir to combine, and let the flour and water thicken a bit. Once you have the desired consistency, gently fold in the flour mixture and the swiss cheese. Let the burgers dry out, in the meantime, heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat with a splash of oil if using. Gently place the hamburger round or sirloin slices in the pan, and let them cook down for about 5 - 10 minutes, or until the meat has mostly released juices and no pink remains. Move them to the sides of the pan until you find you can get the desired level of doneness. When cooked to your liking, remove the hamburger from the pan and set aside. Stir the leeks and green parts of the hamburger into the pan drippings, add the rest of the burger juices and heat thoroughly. You may add a few tablespoons of vegetable oil now if you like a more runny burger. Sprinkle the hot cheese over the top as an garnish, and serve with lemon wedges as desired.

title: Okra & Rum Balls
ingredients: 14 ounces frozen okra | 1/2 cup golden rum, good quality | 1 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Place okra in pan with rum, sprinkle lightly with baking powder. Microwave on high for one minute. Cool. Place okra in large bowl of processor.

title: Easy Baked Salmon With Cashews and Pistachios

instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place the cashews, pistachios and lime in a food processor. Process until well pureed. Place the salmon skin side down on the baking tray. Dot salmon with butter. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until just cooked. Place on a large plate. Top with cashews and pistachios.

instructions: Roast poblanos directly over fire on an open flame on a gas stove or in the broiler. When they start to smoke, use tongs and turn as necessary so skins do not burn. title: Homemade Onion Rings

instructions: Wash onions, dry and slice into rings about 1/8 thick. You can prepare these rings about 10 minutes before baking in a 350 degree oven until lightly browned.

instructions: Cook shrimp with salt and pepper. Drain shrimp. Mix prawns, vinegar and oil together. Form into patties, dust with flour and fry. Serve with red wine and sweet basil.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. In a medium bowl, mix the tomato soup, corn, and rice wine. Pour over chicken. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until chicken juices run clear and chicken pieces are beginning to brown.

instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c or 170°c if using a fan forced oven. Remove fennel bulb from sun as it will be tough during cooking. Cut stems and fronds from fennel. Slice a very thin slice into about 5mm intervals. Lay fennel flat on a chopping board.

ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh chives ( optional ) | 1/2 cup canned corn | 2 tablespoons snipped green onions or 2 tablespoons shallots ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional )

title: Easy Raspberry and Chili Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 container creamy goat cheese | 1 1/2 cups raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( such as tabasco ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | grated chocolate
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except chocolate, together until thoroughly blended. Spread in an ovenproof serving dish and sprinkle with grated chocolate. title: Kielbasa and Pepper With Fennel and Kalamata

title: Chickpea Fritters

instructions: Place chickpeas into a saucepan and rinse out any excess water and place over a high heat, stirring occasionally. title: Egg Chocolate
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla bean, split and scraped | 6 eggs | 2 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 8 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme ( or 1 1/2 tsp. dried ) | 6 hard-boiled eggs, quartered
instructions: Prepare the vanilla bean paste by placing the 1 teaspoon of vanilla bean paste into a small, heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over moderately low heat, stirring occasionally. title: Quick Mexican Mushrooms

instructions: Slice a few holes using a sharp knife into the stem end of the mushrooms. Then slice through the stems for easy eating. Stuff with picante sauce, salsa, and a little green onion if you wish.

title: Peaches in  Mustard Sauce (Barefoot Contessa)

instructions: Cover ice with water. Place mustard seed in heavy medium skillet over medium heat. When mustard seeds begin to sputter, add dill sprigs. Reduce heat to lowest setting and place peaches in center of platter.

title: Apple and Onion Crostini

instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm tepid water, stir until dissolved. Let stand until foamy, about 10 minutes. Place on baking sheet, cover loosely and let rise until doubled again, about 40 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Crock Pot Beef Stroganoff

instructions: Open soup can and pour into crock pot. Pour soup and consomme over top. Cover and cook on low heat setting 7 - 9 hours. When ready to serve stir in sliced beef. This goes great with noodles, rice or a nice flat breads.

title: Quinoa Mustard Bean Snack Loaf (Gluten Free)

instructions: Mix ingredients and spread on a slice of bread or use a cracker. Spray your oven with pam before baking it or heat your oven to 180°c. This is very low in fat but a little crunchy as it is so there is always little to no fat.

title: Pimenton de Canard-Charred Onions
ingredients: 2 large yellow onions | 6 -7 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | sun-dried tomato oil, for rubbing
instructions: Dry out the excess oil from the tomatoes using a paper towel or clean paper kitchen towel. Heat an oiled heavy pan. Slice the onions as thinly as possible. This will make them brown quicker. Dry them evenly a minute or two in the skillet. If you do not want to do this, do not fry them too long as they will brown too quickly. If using kitchen towels, rub the onion lightly several times to remove any excess oil residue. Fry them quickly over medium heat, stirring constantly, only until they are well browned on all sides. This will take 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the onions or put them in a colander and drain the oil out of them. Place the tomatoes upright in the pan and spread them across the bottom. Place the lid on the pan tightly. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Turn the stove over. Add salt to taste. Check the heat again and if the water boils furiously, move the pan, cover, and turn heat down. The onions should be just cooked through, but not soft. You want them to be tender. Let them cook for 5 - 7 minutes longer and then transfer to a big bowl, covering and set aside. Towards the end, preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Rub the drained onion with about 1 teaspoon of sundried tomato oil. If using a dish towel, rub the onion with the entire mixture.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,poppy seed,chilies,cumin seed,bay seasoning,endive,crouton,puff pastry
title: Chilli Purée
ingredients: 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 cup of finely chopped endive | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 3 chilies, finely chopped | 2 bay seasoning, poremings | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel, pithy pith removed, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh grated orange peel | 1 1/4 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Toast poppy seeds in a dry pan over low heat. They should not burn. Remove from heat and cool. Grind poppy seeds to a fine powder in a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle. Remove stalks from pepper and finely chop finely, set aside. Finely chop endives, add to ground poppy seeds. Dry fry chilis, bay seasoning, dried orange peel and ground orange peel in a pan, on medium high heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir in poppy seed mixture. Allow to cool. Cut each sheet of thawed pastry in half and using a round cookie cutter lightly cut out 12 rounds. Pout the cooled cooled filling into 12 hollows. Place on greased oven trays and bake at 450°f for 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Vanilla Paneer - Apple Pudding
