ingredients: 1 can cream-style fat free panir ( i used a low fat but any would do fine with that ) | 1 can apple pie filling ( i used the premade pie filling. you can use whatever flavor strikes your fancy. use whatever flavor strikes your fancy. ) | 1/2 cup mashed potatoes ( not instant but not the instant ones. )
instructions: Mix everything except for mashed potatoes and beat well. Pour into an buttered casserole dish. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes. Garnish with fruit if you like. Serve warm.

title: Beets Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 cans beets | 5 ounces pecorino romano cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/2 lb fresh spinach | 3 pinches cayenne | 1 nut, for garnish ( optional ) | fresh spinach ( for garnish )
instructions: Drain the beet greens and cut in 2 to 3 inch lengths. Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,soymilk,egg yolk,red lentil,marjoram,chili oil
title: Spicy Lentil & Egg Custard
ingredients: 3/4 cup red lentil, picked through | 1 2/3 cups soymilk | 2 -3 large egg yolks | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil ( to taste ) | pimento-stuffed kaffir lime leaf, about 1/4-inch-long | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram, leaves
instructions: Bring lentils & soy milk to the boil in a saucepan. Cover & reduce heat. Simmer until the lentils are just tender ~ 10 - 15 minutes. Beat egg yolks in a bowl until lightly yellow. Whisk into lentils, then set aside. Drain lentils of any excess water if needed, then stir into yolks. Heat a 5 - 6 inch/2 to 2 - 6 inch nonstick nonstick skillet over med high heat just until hot.. Remove the kaffir lime leaves & add them to the skillet. Cook, turning the heat to very low, until the kaffir lime leaves are crisp & a little darker ~ 8 - 10 minutes. Do not overcook or the kaffir lime will make the custard too firm & dry. Remove skillet from heat, then add oil & lime leaf. Stir lightly. Sprinkle with marjoram leaves & serve at once.

title: Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs beef short ribs, trimmed | 1 can haricot beans, undrained | 1/2 cup chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Prick the short ribs all over. In a large bowl, combine short ribs, haricots, peanuts and paprika. Wrap with plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 8 hours and up to 3 days. Heat remaining contents, except paprika, in a large heavy skillet over moderately high heat, stirring. Remove meat from bowl.

title: Moroccan Coffee With Cucumbers
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt, sweet | 1 teaspoon coffee, sweetened ( or more, to taste, we like it mild but not essential ) | 1/2 cup cucumber, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup pimiento, minced ( optional ) | toasted sesame seeds ( garnish )
instructions: Mix greek and sweetened yoghurt until well blended.

title: Lebanese Noodles (Pasta Rolls)
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon fresh mint, minced | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon dry vermouth | 10 sheets lasagna noodles, cooked, drained and cut in half crosswise
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions or to package directions. Drain and allow to cool to room temperature. Using potholders or your fingers, make indentations in the dough around the outside edge of each noodle to form a seal. Brush edges with water and place on a baking sheet sprayed with pam. Repeat to make 3 more sandwiches. Bake at 400°f for 12 - 15 minutes or until pastry is lightly browned and puffed. Meanwhile, combine mint, ginger, and vermouth. Arrange noodles on a serving platter. Top with mint mixture. Serve with sauce.

title: Creamy Coriander (Indian Spread)
ingredients: 12 ounces cream cheese ( block or lite ) | 1/2 teaspoon dhaniya powder ( try baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix with 1/2 t. diju ghee ) | 1 dash cider vinegar
instructions: In a food processor, chop the cream cheese and mix with your hands until smooth. Stir in the spice powders. Taste and add more spice as necessary.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,canola oil,beef steak,mirin,taco seasoning,chili pepper flake
title: Grilled Beef Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 lb beef top round steak, cut into strips | 1 lb chili pepper pepper pepper, seeded and sliced | 1/3 cup mirin | 1 packet taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle pepper flakes
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon canola oil in a sauté pan over medium heat. Add meat strips and stir fry 5 minutes until tender. Stir in chili peppers and remaining canola oil. Mix in 1/3 cup mirin, taco seasoning, and chipotle pepper flakes. Cook 5 minutes or until heated through.

title: Mexican Veggies
ingredients: 3 cups french style green beans, washed and trimmed and sliced | 4 -6 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 cup canned pumpkin seeds | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Cook beans and sprouts with pumpkin seeds in boiling salted water until sprouts are slightly tender and liquid is absorbed. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Pesto sauce, mix all ingredients together except salsa. Serve at once directly over cooked vegetables.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,soba noodle,cherry tomato,pork rib,taco seasoning,ice,chili paste,green chilies
title: Mexican Skillet Supper
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 -5 lbs pork ribs, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 can diced green chilies, undrained | 1 package frozen whole cherry tomatoes, thawed | 3 cups canned corn or 3 cups canned tomatoes, drained | 1 can chili paste | 1/2 cup fresh minced aneheim green chilies, seeded or 1/2 cup pickled aneheim green chilies, deveined or 1/2 cup other hot chili pepper, finely chopped for a kick | ice or baguette
instructions: Place beef into 12 inch skillet. Sprinkle with 1/2 t taco seasoning and remaining taco seasoning. Arrange pork, ribs and chiles around. Add tomatoes. Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes. Remove cover, increase heat to medium and cook until pork is heated through. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, heat chili paste over low heat until warm. Stir into meat mixture. Serve with sopapillas, or on italian sandwiches or toasted baguettes.

title: Carnation Fish With Pecans
ingredients: 2 heads halibut fillets, bones reserved | 2 cups bean sprouts, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons snipped pickled peppcane peppers ( may sub canned ) | 1 bunch fresh celery salt | 1/2 cup pecans, toasted and chopped | chile, slices, for dipping
instructions: Preheat grill to high heat. Line a large baking sheet with foil. Place fish in baking sheet and sprinkle with garlic powder. Wrap foil around fish, securing with string. Place fish on hot grill. Cook until just tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. Place sprouts and pecans on a plate and arrange fish on top. Season with celery salt and sprinkle with chile slices.

title: Peach Mousse - Sweden
ingredients: 6 button mushrooms, sliced thin | 6 peaches, peeled and sliced | 8 medium button mushrooms, sliced thin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 8 tablespoons peach-flavoured mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon grenadine | 1 tablespoon minced of fresh mint
instructions: In a bowl combine the mayonnaise and grenadine. In another bowl combine the mushrooms, cinnamon, peaches and mint. Place the mushrooms and mushrooms onto a plate and top with the peach mayonnaise mixture.

title: Simple Italian Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: In skillet brown hamburger and drain. Mix in soup and wine until heated. Shape into patties. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 min or place on plate.

title: Italian Dip Sandwiches - Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons hot sauce, or to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped pecans
instructions: Mix artichoke hearts, hot sauce, and pecans in a bowl.

title: Naan (Semolina Bread and Cheese Grissini)
ingredients: 2 cups semolina, coarsely ground | 2 cups grated aged cheddar cheese | 8 ounces grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 4 cups store-roasted semolina, coarsely ground, or as needed | thinly sliced naan bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix semolina, cheddar, and parmigiano reggiano together in a bowl. Cut four 12x8 inch slices of rind off of naan. Spread each slice with 1/4 cup semolina mixture and top with slices to form a dome. Place a piece of dough on the edge of one slice of rind. Fold rind over the rye to form a half moon shape and press to seal. Repeat with remaining rye and cheddar slices. Place onto a cookie sheet and set aside. Place oven rack into the center of the oven and preheat to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Once the door is open, place a baking dish on the rack and carefully pour in enough water to cover the naan dome. Bake 1 hour. If the loaf looks dry, shake the baking dish halfway through. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely before removing from parchment paper or plastic wrap. Place cooled naan into a resealable plastic bag. Add about 1/4 cup semolina mixture to bag with raisins, and shake gently, ensuring semolina mixture is evenly coated. Place bag onto a baking mat and cut naan into pieces approximately 1x4x3 inch. Drizzle baking sheet with melted margarine or butter to keep shape from sticking while baking. Place a small dish or slice of naan onto a serving platter and top with raisins.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,red enchilada sauce,rice,orange zest,baking powder,liver
title: Santa Fe Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato, cut into 6ths | 12 ounces liver, cut into thin 2-inch pieces | 1 orange, zest of, cut into small cubes | 10 ounces red enchilada sauce, canned | 1/2 tablespoon baking powder | 1/2 cup parsley flakes
instructions: Boil and cook sweet potatoes until just tender. Drain and set aside. Cook liver and zest in skillet with red sauce and baking powder. Spoon liver mixture into tortillas and place in a 9x13 pan. Combine parsley flakes with 2 tablespoons of enchilada sauce.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,mint,nonfat cream,cremini mushroom,creme de cassis,olive,walnut
title: Smoky Wild Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cremini mushroom | 1 tablespoon chopped walnuts | 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce | 4 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 tablespoon creme de cassis ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts, toasted
instructions: Place mushrooms and walnuts on a plate. Toast under a grill until the walnuts brown, about 6 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Mix the mushrooms, walnuts, and barbecue sauce in a bowl. Drizzle on the sour cream and mint. Season with cassis and toasted nuts to taste.

Random Ingredients: butter,rigatoni pasta,bean,yogurt,red chili pepper,cognac,wheat flour,canola oil
title: Rigatoni With Beans and Cognac
ingredients: 450 g rigatoni pasta, uncooked ( fresh or dried italian style ) | 8 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 red chili pepper | 200 g refried beans ( i prefer refried beans ) | 150 g cognac ( optional ) | 250 ml yogurt | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Boil the rigatoni in salted water until al dente. Meanwhile heat the butter in a pan and add flour and cook for two minutes stirring continuously. The flour doesn't have a chance to colour but it does. Add the red chilli, stirring. Cook for one minute. Add the refried beans and stir and remove from heat. Drain the rigatoni and mix them together with the sauce. Add the cognac. Serve hot or warm.

title: Grilled Vietnamese Dipping Sauce - Nama Shio
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 cup finely diced dried mixed fruit | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 tablespoon dried summer savory | 1 tablespoon dipping sauce
instructions: Stir together the dark soy sauce, mixed fruit, tahini, summer savory and dipping sauce. Serve warm.

title: Gourmet Mexican Style Cucumbers and Prosciutto
ingredients: 3 packages prosciutto | 1 bottle pesto sauce | 1/4 cup walnut halves | 2 tablespoons oranges, freshly squeezed | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2 english seedless cucumbers, peeled, halved lengthwise and sliced thinly | 8 ounces queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Place prosciutto, pesto sauce and walnuts in a deep pan. Set pan over low heat and let sit about 5 minutes to bring out the flavor. Add the orange zest and turmeric. Stir gently and evenly over medium heat so no liquid begins to bubble. Once the flavor is developed fully, stir in the cucumbers. Turn off the heat. Place pan over medium heat and allow to cool slightly. Toss with crumbled cheese. Remove the crispy prosciutto from the pan and place on a plate to hold. When mixture has cooled slightly, stir in the crumbled cheese until evenly coated.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,mango,muenster cheese,rice wine vinegar,rom tomato
title: Baked Alaska Sun-Dried Tomato-Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets | 2 roma tomatoes, quartered | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup muenster cheese | 1 tablespoon mangoes, diced ( optional )
instructions: Cook salmon on greased baking sheet until cooked through. In small bowl, mix together remaining ingredients. Spread mixture over salmon. Bake in 375 degree oven for 25 - 30 minutes. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: lamb liver,cumin powder,white wine vinegar,sage leaf,garam masala powder
title: Lamb Liver with Vinegar
ingredients: 1 kg lamb liver, cut into pieces | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek dried coriander or 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Put lamb in a heavy based pan, pour enough water over to cover and bring to the boil, skim off any froth until all the water has boiled away. Add vinegar and spices and boil for 3 minutes, take off the heat and leave the lamb in the pan for a few minutes. Pour the gravy over the lamb and leave for a further hour. Serve with boiled rice and vegetables.

title: Tajine Fluffs With Corn Vinegar
ingredients: 1 dozen corn tortilla strip | 2 tablespoons light white vinegar | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Mix the vinegar, oyster and the corn vinegar together, to form a dipping sauce. Use immediately or store in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Serve with fish or pork or shrimp salad. Store in refrigerator to keep soft, crisp crispy crisp and crunchy.

title: Spicy Hash Brown Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 1 pound ham, chopped | 4 russet potatoes, peeled, cubed | 1 can chipotle peppers | 1/2 package roasted cashews | 1 package frozen hash browns
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook rigatoni until almost done but firm, about 12 minutes.

title: Chinese Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 lb shredded chinese cabbage
instructions: Mix the cabbage and tarragon together. Chill the salad.

Random Ingredients: butter bean,rosemary leaf,margarine,chicken bouillon,chuck,macaroni,plum tomato,pine nut
title: Pasta With Pecan Crust
ingredients: 1 cup margarine | 2 cups macaroni ( you can use your favorite pasta ) | 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 3 plum tomatoes ( seeded, chopped, and mashed ) | 1 cup fresh rosemary leaf ( chopped ) | 2 cups canned margarita chicken bouillon | 4 tablespoons pine nuts ( chopped ) | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon ( or 2 tsp other flavor enhancer )
instructions: Cook, pasta according to directions. Boil pasta. Sauté ground chuck over medium heat to render fat and brown a bit. Drain off fat. Add tomato and cook another 5 minutes. Turn heat to low and add macaroni. Add 1 cup water or stock and stir. Add 2 tbsp of the margarita chicken base. Cook over low heat for 25 minutes. Stir to prevent sticking. When sauce is a nice red color, remove from heat and stir in remaining margarita base. Place back on low heat for 20 minutes. Add pine nuts and stir. Remove from heat. To serve, remove rosemary stems. Place pasta on serving plate and top with sauce on top.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,marsala wine,salsa,jumbo shrimp,chipotle chile,dashi stock,tabasco sauce,green pea
title: Shrimp With Chili-Pea Puree
ingredients: 1 cup frozen green pea | 1 1/2 cups jumbo shrimp, shelled | 1 cup salsa, choose mild or medium | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1 cup dashi stock | 2 -4 dashes tabasco sauce | 1 cup diced chipotle chile | jalapeno, diced ( optional )
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Pour the sauce into a measuring cup and add enough hot water to cover the bottom of the pan. Bring to a boil and pour over the shrimp. Bring back to a boil and cook for 3 - 4 minutes. Drain shrimp, remove heads and shells and put on a bed of red cabbage, top with chilies. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Pesto Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 50 g semolina flour ( or coarsely ground flours, about 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Add pesto sauce to flour and stir to combine. Stir in the chilli and knead lightly to smooth. Transfer mixture to an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and chill. Serve chilled or at room temperature as an accompaniment to pasta.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,coriander powder,guinness stout,celery rib,red potato,cream mushroom soup,eel
title: Celery With Guinness and Potato Balls
ingredients: 3 lbs celery ribs, coarsely chopped | 11 ounces cream of mushroom soup or 11 ounces cream of celery & herb soup | 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 24 ounces guinness stout | 2 ounces ground eel | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | breadcrumbs
instructions: Toss potato chunks in the beer with salt then place them in a roasting tin in a single layer. Preheat oven to 400°f. Sprinkle the eel over the top of the potatoes. Bake in the oven for 20 min at 400°f until potatoes are tender and have absorbed most of the juices. With a slotted spoon, remove potatoes and mash with potato as you go. Stir in soup and coriander. Check seasoning. Sprinkle with bread crumbs last. Serve warm.

title: Upside Down Cucumber Cheese Bread
ingredients: 4 ounces shredded cucumber | 1/8 teaspoon cumin seeds | 8 ounces asiago cheese, diced | 5 cups self rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Dice and mix cucumber and cheese in a bowl. Set aside. Stir together flour and cumin seeds. Turn onto a floured surface. Pat the dough out to 1/2 inch thickness. Cut out six 3 inch circles. Press a small hole in the center of the circle, about 1/2 inch deep. Fill with the cucumber cheese mixture. Fold the two sides over to make a crust. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden and crusty.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,coconut cream,cardamom pod,scallop,mint,curry powder
title: Curried Seafood and Coconut Curry
ingredients: 2 -3 pints scallops | 4 tablespoons curry powder | 2 -3 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 4 -5 tablespoons unsweetened coconut cream | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a non reactive bowl. Heat on medium high heat in your wok.. When heat is really hot stir fry scallops for two minutes on each side, or until opaque. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,herb,sun tomato oil,kalamata olive,ginger paste,cauliflower floret,farro
title: Italian Farro Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup kalamata olive ( chopped ) | 1 cup cauliflower floret ( chopped ) | 1 packet italian salad dressing mix | 1 ounce sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 ounce ginger paste, chopped | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs
instructions: In a large bowl add all ingredients and toss well. Chill for 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Easy Chicken with Green Chile
ingredients: 1/2 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 3 tablespoons masala | 4 ounces canned diced green chile peppers | 1 package fresh spinach, rinsed and trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and arrange the chicken on the foil. Pour enough boiling water into the bottom of the pan to reach about halfway up the side of the chicken. Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is no longer pink inside and the juices run clear, 30 to 40 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Let cool until easily handled, about 10 minutes. Slice the chicken. Stir the masala green chiles into the chile water and set aside. Place the spinach in a colander fitted with a cheese cloth or paper towel, and squeeze between your hands to remove excess moisture. Place the drained spinach in a bowl, and toss with the green chile mixture. Arrange the chicken on the prepared baking sheet. Cook in the preheated oven until the chicken is no longer pink on the outside and the juices run clear, 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Allow to rest 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,chipotle chile,chicken meat,rotel tomato chilies
title: Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 1 bag chicken meat, cut into bite size pieces | 2 cans diced chipotle chilies | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies ( not green ) | poblano peppers or red chili pepper, of choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Mix all ingredients in a large oven safe baking dish. Bake 30 minutes. Bake uncovered at 500 degrees for a further 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,german chocolate cake mix,clam juice,taco seasoning mix,pork shoulder
title: Baked Pork and Clams
ingredients: 1 package german chocolate cake mix | 1 package dry taco seasoning mix | 2 lbs pork shoulder ( cut into 1/2 inch slices ) | 1 1/4 ounces guajillo chilies, chopped and seeded to a paste | 1 cup bottled clam juice
instructions: Mix dry ingredients at the bottom of a large bowl. Dip pork slices in the chili paste, then arrange atop the batter using all sides. Bake at 350 fahrenheit for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown, turning once.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,white sauce,almond,lamb rack,linguine,italian sausage,balsamic vinegar
title: Lamb and Sausage Linguine
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 1/2 cup sliced blanched almond | 12 ounces italian sausage | 1 lb lamb rack, sliced 1/8 inch thick | 1/4 cup white sauce | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 4 ounces swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Add pasta, almonds, and sausage to a large skillet and cook until pasta is done and sausage is browned. Heat white sauce, vinegar and balsamic in the microwave until warm. Add to pasta mixture and stir to mix. Garnish with cheese.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,lettuce leaf,dark rum,rice wine,grain white rice
title: Rum and Rice Rolls - Mais-Sang-Thong
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 teaspoon rice wine | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 4 large fresh lettuce leaves | 5 cups whole grain white rice, steamed
instructions: Heat the rice in the 1 tbspn rice wine over moderately low heat, stirring, until hot but not boiling, about 5 mins, stirring occasionally, until slightly syrupy. When it has cooled slightly, add the vanilla and stir for a further minute. Meanwhile, lightly grease and line a baking sheet with two 3cm/1in slices of parchment, allowing 3cm/1in of space around the edge. Add the rice and mix quickly in a circular motion until the rice is completely covered with rice grains. Remove the rice grains from the heat and pour half the rice into the centre of a large piece of reaived parchment, then spread the rice over the rice in a very thin layer. Place a tea towel over the paper and roll the parchment around the rice, tightly. Using your fingers, press down a little to release the steam. Once the sushi is sealed, carefully tap the rolls on a clean paper towel to remove excess rice grains and rice. When the sushi is prepared, place a serving plate on top, invert half of the sushi and top with the rest of the rice, cutting the sushi into 4 equal pieces.

title: Torticas de Patata
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups millet flour | 6 cups chilled potatoes starch | 2 tablespoons chile pepper, sliced into thin strips | 1 cup marsala wine
instructions: Mix millet flour, potato starch, and chile pepper together in a large bowl. Place chilled potatoes flour in a deep mixing bowl and pour in the wine until a dough forms. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and gently knead until dough starts to come together. Dust dough with a little potato flour and cut into small pieces. Place about 1 1/2 cups of dough on a floured baking sheet, and cut into squares. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes in a preheated oven until puffed and crisp.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,canadian bacon,sesame seed,vanilla essence,green chili pepper
title: Green Chile Pepper Stuffed Banana Peppers
ingredients: 4 green chili peppers | 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds | 4 slices canadian bacon | 1 tablespoon canadian bacon | 1/8 teaspoon sesame seed | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Wash and wipe the peppers with a towel. Wrap the stuffed peppers in toasted sesame seeds. In a skillet place 1/4 stick of canadian bacon and 1/4 stick of canadian bacon. Saute on medium high until bacon has caramelized and the bacon is brown on top, about 10 minutes. Remove the green chili peppers from the skillet and place on plate. Remove the canadian bacon from the skillet and set aside to drain on paper towel. Cut the green pepper into 1/2 thick slices and place on top of bacon. Place on a serving plate and sprinkle 1 tablespoon of canadian bacon drippings along top of the peppers. Sprinkle about 1/8 teaspoon ground sesame seeds on top and dash the vanilla essence in with the green chile pepper slices to taste. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beer,lime juice,cognac,baking potato,green chilies,lemon extract,miracle whip
title: Mexican Potato Wedges
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes, cut in wedges | 1/2 cup mayonnaise or 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 can diced mild green chilies, drained | 2 tablespoons freshly grated lemon extract | 1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice | 4 1/2 tablespoons cognac or 4 1/2 tablespoons brandy or 4 1/2 tablespoons rum | 1 can beer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease two 9x13 baking dishes. Arrange potatoes in a large bowl.

title: Baked Fish
ingredients: 2 1/2 kg haddock | 2 tablespoons dry marsala wine | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place fish in a large roasting tray. Sprinkle with marsala and mace. Bake 5 minutes and check.. Remove fish, baste with the wine and pour the juices carefully over the fish. Turn over, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked.

title: Spicy Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained and patted dry | 1 cup sour cream | 1 cup blueberries | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: In food processor or blender, add the pimentos, sour cream, blueberry, garlic salt and pulse to blend. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: bread,penne pasta,scallion,thai chili sauce,almond extract,curry leaf,soya sauce,sirloin steak
title: Creamy Beef Stroganoff with Thai Sweet Sour Cream
ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 2 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaf | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/8 cup scallion, diced ( green parts ) | 1/2 cup bread, crumbs of choice ( bread crumbs ) | 1 lb penne pasta ( uncooked )
instructions: Heat a non stick skillet. Slice the steaks lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick strips. Put oil, soya sauce, chili sauce, curry leaves and almond extract in a large bowl and toss to mix. Add the meat and toss to coat. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator 10 minutes. Drain the meat. Remove excess oil from the skillet. Add the scallions and toss to coat. Heat a wok over medium high heat. Add the meat and marinade and toss to mix. Heat 2 minutes more. Serve the stroganoff topped with soy sour cream, and the bread crumbs of choice.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,spice,roast pork,mini chocolate chip,gruyere cheese
title: Aussie Style Poached Pork and Cheeseburger
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean roast pork, cut into slices from shoulder | 1 box mini chocolate chip | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese | 6 teaspoons pure vanilla extract or 6 teaspoons fresh vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Place pork slices in a 6 quart pan, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add the chocolate chips over the meat, stirring to mix well, and barely cover with more water. Add cheese, then vanilla on top. Sprinkle spice blend over. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving the next day.

title: The Perfect Corned Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs ground coriander powder or 2 lbs cumin seeds | 3 1/2 ounces salt pork
instructions: Toast the coriander powder in a dry pan over low to medium heat for 2 - 5 minutes. The mixture should give off a strong aroma and smell as it cools. Grind the coriander as finely as possible. Grind the salt pork. When cool, put in a large bowl and mix with the curing mixture. Refrigerate. Keep refrigerated for at least 6 weeks and up to 3 days.

title: Smoked Salmon & Bread - Smoked Salmon & Bread
ingredients: 4 thick slices white bread | 2 tablespoons parsley leaves, chopped | 12 slices smoked salmon
instructions: Line an oven tray with non stick baking paper. Place the bread on a baking tray & place under the grill. Allow to brown & crisp. Turn the bread over & top with parsley & smoked salmon. Re wrap your tray in foil & place on wire rack to catch any excess juices. Allow to rest in a cool place for at least 15 minutes to allow the bread to mature & to develop a sour flavour. Cut into fingers or chunks & serve with salad or salad dressing alongside.

title: Italian Asparagus With Peppers and Anchovies
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus, cleaned, ends trimmed and cut into 1 `` lengths | 4 slices pepperoni | 1 can anchovy fillets
instructions: Put the asparagus in a sauce pan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and then simmer until just done. Meanwhile pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Put pepperoni slices in a baking dish and put the asparagus on top. Dot asparagus with pepperoni slices. Bake in oven for about 20 minutes. The more you bake, the crispier they will become.

title: Red Pistachio Dukka
ingredients: 1/2 cup pistachios, shelled | 1 small red chili, split | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace, or | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 6 -8 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1/3 cup feta cheese, crumbled ( about 1 1/4 oz. )
instructions: Place pistachios in a skillet over medium heat. Place pepper and chile in the skillet.

title: BBQ Lamb Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb, cut into cubes | 1 package frozen artichoke hearts | 1 can frozen blueberries | 1 package quick tapioca | 10 1/2 ounces frozen meatballs or 10 1/2 ounces frozen meatballs | 16 1/2 ounces store-bought stellen brand sweetened condensed milk & cream | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: If making the stew by itself, thaw artichoke hearts and artichokes. Arrange meat, artichokes, blueberries and tapioca in a crockpot. If preparing by itself, place in crockpot and cover with remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes. If preparing by itself, remove meat, artichokes, blueberries and tapioca and stir to mix. Cook on low for about an hour. Serve with rice.

title: Broccoli and Potato Soup
ingredients: 4 cups frozen broccoli, thawed, or 2 cups fresh broccoli, cut into bite-size pieces | 3 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes
instructions: Cook broccoli and potatoes in a soup pot of boiling water until the vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes. Drain. Return the soup to the boil. Add the potatoes.

title: Homemade Chunk Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 4 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 cup half-and-half ( whole milk )
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the oregano, salt and milk until thick and creamy. Pour the chunk salmon onto a small plate or shallow tray. Pour the creamy liquid over the salmon, then cover with plastic wrap and allow to sit at room temperature for at least one hour before serving.

title: White Beans
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained | 1/4 teaspoon savory, or to taste | 3 slices prosciutto | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory | 1/4 teaspoon dried savory | 1 dash almond extract
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.

title: Fish With Jalapeno Mayo
ingredients: 1 lb haddock fillet, skin left on | 1 cup prepared jalapeno chile, chopped ( about 8-12 ) | 1/3 cup mayonnaise ( sour cream is best )
instructions: Prepare jalapeno mayonnaise. Place in a serving bowl. Place the washed and drained haddock fillet on top of the jalapenos. Top with remaining jalapeno mayonnaise and sour cream. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Salad with Pistachios and Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces dried brown lentils | 1 roasting chickens, cut in pieces ( about 12 ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 8 small baguette, sliced into 1 inch cubes | 1 cup baby fresh spinach, rinsed and dried | 1/3 cup packed shelled pistachios | 1 can baked beans sprouts | 2 cups milk | 1 cup louisiana-style hot sauce
instructions: Place lentils in a large saucepan. Cover with 3 cups cold water.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,arugula,self rising flour,shiitake mushroom,white sesame seed,savoy cabbage,double cream,yellow pea
title: Chinese New Year's Eve New Year's Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 package frozen yellow pea, thawed and drained | 8 ounces shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 3 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup white sesame seeds | 1 cup fresh green enchilada sauce | 1 head savoy cabbage, sliced | 15 large leaves arugula ( can also use other mixed salad greens ) | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f/180°c line a 12 cup/2 cup souffle dish with parchment to prevent sticking. Place thawed peas in a large mixing bowl. Add mushrooms, mix well and set aside. In another mixing bowl, toss flour, sesame seeds and 1 cup enchilada sauce. Add to the peas and mushrooms and stir. Place half of the shredded cabbage in the bottom of the souffle dish, and scatter with half of the arugula. Sprinkle with half of the green salad leaves. Place half of the bread mixture on top of the greens, and top with the remaining 2 cups of shredded cabbage. Pour cream over mixture, and bake for 35 - 45 minutes until bread is golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: french bread,tagliatelle pasta noodle,chicken breast fillet,vodka,plain flour
title: Chicken and Tagliatelle Crostini
ingredients: 250 g tagliatelle pasta noodles | 250 g chicken breast fillets, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 tablespoon plain flour ( all purpose ) | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/2 loaf french bread, cut into 1cm thick diagonal slices
instructions: Cook the tagliatelle in boiling water until al dente. Drain and refresh under cold water, then drain again. Transfer the chicken to a shallow dish and crumble over the flour to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Cook the pasta in boiling water for about 10 minutes, until al dente. Drain. Add the chicken and vodka to the pasta, then stir in salt and pepper to taste. Heat a large non stick frying pan over high heat. Add the bread, then quickly dip the slices of french bread into the pan to toast. Place the crostini onto a serving plate and top with the chicken.

title: Mushroom Mussels (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, boned and cut into cubes | 125 g button mushrooms, halved | 2 liters chicken stock | 1 kg mussels, scrubbed and de-stalked
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas place lamb cubes in a large baking tin. Add the sliced mushrooms and stock and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Bring to the boil, cover the tin and place in the preheated oven. Cook until the meat has turned dark red in the centre, and the sauce has thickened slightly. Transfer the mussels to a large casserole dish and pull out any mussels that haven't opened, pushing them out firmly. Discard any clams that haven't opened meanwhile. Discard any mussels that haven't opened and cover with water. Bring to the boil, cover and put in the preheated oven. Cook in the oven for about 1 hour, until the meat is tender and has turned golden brown and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,chicken wing,celery seed,fennel seed,broth,marjoram,white wine,black pepper
title: Baked Chicken with Sherry
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cut into 8 pieces | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup canned broth | 3/4 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon marjoram | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1 small fresh serrano pepper, deveined and thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Pat chicken dry and arrange in a large roasting pan. In a small bowl combine the stock, wine, fennel, pepper, marjoram, celery seed and sliced red chile peppers. Pour over chicken and spread to about 1/2 centimetre thick. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until a meat thermometer, inserted near the bone, reaches 165 degrees f. Transfer the chicken to a cutting board, cover and let stand for 15 minutes.

title: Dijon Noodles With Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1 lb kielbasa, cut in 1/2 cm cubes | paprika, a nice quality mustard | 2 -3 tablespoons dijon mustard, to taste | 1 package linguine, cooked
instructions: Drench baguette lengthwise in plastic wrap. Slice baguette into half rounds. Combine all ingredients and put on plate. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove 1 hour before serving. Serve with noodles.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,taco seasoning,pimiento,beef broth,white bread
title: Margarita Meatball Sandwich from the Famous Sandwich Shop
ingredients: 1 loaf white bread, unsliced | 5 pimientos, slices, canned with lime juice | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 kaffir lime leaf
instructions: Cut loaf of bread in half lengthwise. Use the hollow center of a dinner plate to make an oval loaf. Place pimentos on 1 bread loaf slice, layer with slices of the pimentos and top with 1 tablespoon of taco seasoning. Drain beef broth into a medium saucepan. Pour beef broth into the empty plate and pour into the skillet the pimentos were cooked in. Cook over medium heat until it comes to a simmer, reduce heat and add the kaffir lime leaf. Simmer 15 minutes or until mixture is reduced by half. Remove kaffir lime leaf and serve immediately.

title: Chakchuka (Filled Pistachio Nuts)
ingredients: 2 cups pistachios, shelled | 3/4 cup pitted black olives
instructions: Put pistachios and olives in a blender and blend until fine. Spread this mixture evenly on a plate or waxed paper, and let it stand for a few hours. Break the pistachios into pieces and roll them into nuggets. Place nuggets on a rack set over a plate, and allow them to dry for a few hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,chunky salsa,ghee,extra sharp cheddar cheese,romaine lettuce,salt black pepper,orange bell pepper,green chilies
title: The Ultimate Salad!
ingredients: 1 head washed fresh romaine lettuce | 2 oranges ( bell peppers can also be used ) | 1 can diced green chilies, including liquid | 4 tablespoons extra sharp cheddar cheese ( or to taste, i used 2 tablespoons mexican blend ) | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon ghee | salt and black pepper | 1 cup chunky salsa
instructions: Remove the lettuce from the head and trim off any tough stems. Rinse the lettuce and set aside. Separate the heads from each other to account for the lettuce tearing during the cooking process. Drain the lettuce well and place all in a salad bowl. Break the orange in half, remove all of the membrane from the membranes with a sharp knife. Cut zest into thin rounds and set aside. Cut the rind from the orange including the white pith.

title: Lobster With Mangoes on the Half Shell
ingredients: 24 large frozen lobster tails | 1 large mango, halved, seeded if desired | 1 cup fresh parsnip, seeded
instructions: Boil the lobster tails for 3 - 4 minutes, then drain and cool under cold water. Remove the tail with a knife and cut each tail in half lengthwise. To serve, spoon some of the juice from the lobster shells into a bowl. Top with lobster, mango and parsnip.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,canadian bacon,red wine vinegar,barbecue sauce
title: Canadian Apples
ingredients: 4 granny smith apples | 4 slices canadian bacon | 12 small teaspoons canadian bacon fat ( optional ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Prepare grill with medium direct heat. Peel apples and slice in half lenghwise. Remove core carefully as apples can burn too quickly. Turn apple halves over and cook until apples are almost soft. Remove apples to a bowl and mash apples. Place drained bacon in a nonstick skillet and add 1/2 cup of the canadian bacon fat. Place apples over fat and bacon fat. Add vinegar and cook over medium heat until fat is melted, stirring and scraping up brown bits from bottom of pan. Place apples on a large platter with the bacon slices and pour the sauce over just before serving.

title: German Christmas Kielbasa and Peppers
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon powdered red pepper
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 1/4 inch slices. In a medium, heavy skillet, brown sausage over medium heat until no longer pink at all. Add parmesan cheese and red pepper. Drain sausage.

Random Ingredients: kale,vanilla extract,lemon pepper,lard,red pepper flake,cardamom powder,ginger powder,enchilada sauce
title: Bamya Yummy (Sweet) or Kangay Kale (Yummy Drink)
ingredients: 1 liter brewed enchilada sauce ( kikkoman brand preferred ) | 100 g fresh grated ginger powder ( fresh grated fresh grated ginger powder is not ) | 2 lemons, pureed | 100 g lard ( solid, white & no fat, not the fat content of the tin ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 400 g chopped kangay or 400 g english kale, chopped into 1 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract or 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Prepare the kangay by washing and finely chopping it into pieces. You can use any brand you like to make this recipe. Dissolve the vanilla with the lemon juice to a light froth. Dissolve ginger in the ginger juice. Take a large bowl and crush the block of lime and add to it some of the vanilla and lime juice mixture. If you are using a mortar and pestle, combine these ingredients together. In another bowl combine the chopped kale and add a pinch of salt. Once the kale is cooked, combine with the above kangay recipe. This is your marinade. I use a food process which is a bit messy in a blender or magic bullet. If you want to make this into a big party, combine all the marinade ingredients together and pour over the sliced kangay/kangay mixture. Let it stand at room temperature for at least one hour. When ready to serve, add some ice cubes, stir well and refrigerate. This recipe also makes a great snack.

title: Quick and Easy Awesome French Baguettes
ingredients: 25 g yeast, active dry | 200 g soft ladyfingers | 300 g soft ladyfingers | 1 packet active dry yeast ( 2 packets )
instructions: Preparing the dough, grease a non stick 7 - 9 inch pizza pan, preheat oven to 500°f in your work space, put approximately a cup of sour dough in your hand and gently break it into 6 fingers. Lightly flour each finger and place them on the pizza pan. Sprinkle a little flour over the fingers and put in oven. After 40 minutes, remove from oven. Meanwhile, remove the yeast packet from the packet and whisk the dry yeast into 2 tablespoons of the sour dough and set aside. Dry the fingers thoroughly, place in a bowl and cover with a tea towel. Stretch the dough out to about 1 thick on a clean work surface. Slather the dough generously with the yeast/sour mixture. Add more flour if necessary. Cover with a towel and leave to rise again until doubled in bulk. When this time, slice the french bagels into 6 to 8 slices and place on a baking pan. Cover with a towel and leave to rise another 30 minutes. After 40 minutes, remove the french bagels and sprinkle on 3 to 5 more bread slices, depending on the size. Bake for another 2 minutes or until they begin to brown. Turn out into a baguette tin, cut in half and serve.

title: Chili Bean Lasagna
ingredients: 500 g chili beans | 500 g ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Place all the above into a large oven safe dish and cover with cling wrap. Heat oven to 180 degrees celsius. When very hot, carefully remove cling wrap then allow to cool for 3 minutes. Remove all the excess oil from the dish. Place the prepared dish under a preheated broiler for 5 minutes or until golden brown. Turn down the oven to 350 degrees celsius while the lasagna is cooking, make the filling. Soak chillies in a large roasting dish for 5 - 6 hours. Slice up the ricotta into little pieces. Put the ricotta in a bowl and mix in the soya sauce through. Drain the chillies.

title: Italian Square
ingredients: 1 box white cake mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl combine the dry cake mix and dry ingredients. Mix well and cut into two 9 inch squares. Place square one at a time into a greased 9x13 inch pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,bamboo shoot,mexican tomato jalapeno pepper
title: Queso Blanco
ingredients: 2 lbs country-style pork roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes with jalapeno peppers | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained
instructions: Place pork in crock pot. Add remaining ingredients along with any extra ingredients. Place on low setting for 10 to 12 hours.

title: Easy Sausages With Mushrooms and Onions
ingredients: 750 g sausages | 2 tablespoons white flour | 400 g sliced mushrooms ( capsicum, yellow capsicum ) | 1 small red onion, finely sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 180c / 350°f. Lightly grease an ovenproof pan with oil. Cut sausages into 16 thick slices. Transfer to ovenproof dish. Bake sausages for 35 - 40 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Quesito Alla Queso
ingredients: 8 queso fresco | 1/4 lb queso fresco | 4 celery ribs | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle mince cheeses to the consistency of ground cheese. Add oregano. You won't need to fully mix it, just make sure to work a lot and rub inches. Pour into oiled quesadilla or oiled cookie sheet. If it sticks too much to pan, leave some room or oil in the pan. Heat in 400°f oven till light brown. Let cool a little, then take out and dip into powder or sandeshops of desired size while warm. I like them more crumbly and less grainy so i can see where they stick, but they don't stick to each other. Some might say that they stick more because a pan with so few ingredients is too liquid. They'll taste best if you do not make them right. Some folks like a little kick. Hope this helps.

title: Gourmet Sang Fish
ingredients: 4 ounces salmon ( skin removed ) | 1 teaspoon tamari | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder flakes | 1/8 cup dried cherries
instructions: Cut salmon into 2 pieces. Dry salmon with paper towel. Combine in a glass dish or glass bowl. Add tamari, orange juice, chili flakes and cherries. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,white bean,red pepper flake,squid,italian parsley,lamb shoulder,oregano,dark soy sauce
title: Spice-Rubbed Lamb With Italian Beans
ingredients: 1 lb mixed white beans, such as cannellini or great northern beans, soaked overnight in | 1 lb split white beans, such as manchego or great northern beans | 1 1/2 lbs lamb shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs small red peppers or 1 1/2 lbs sweet red peppers, sliced | 3 -4 medium squid, cleaned | 1 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | red pepper flakes | dried oregano, to taste
instructions: Place the meat in a large dutch oven or crockpot, adding the beans and enough boiling water to cover the meat. Cook until the meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours and the beans are heated through. Add the peppers and squid, recover and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours or on high for 3 - 4 hours. Just before serving, sprinkle with additional fresh, chopped parsley and dark soy sauce. Sprinkle with dried oregano to taste.

title: Sour Cream Poached Pigeons
ingredients: 14 ounces pea ( peas or peas of your choice ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried mixed herbs ( thyme, dill, sage ) | 1/2 pint heavy cream | 1 -2 tablespoon milk | 3 -4 sauteed apricots
instructions: Wash the peas and remove the stones from them. Break them into small pieces and place them in water to which a few dried herb powders have been added to wash. Bring to the boil, stirring frequently, and simmer slowly for 5 - 10 minutes. Strain through a fine sieve. Discard the solids. Stir in the cream and milk and season with salt and pepper. Stir in the chopped sauteed apricots and heat through but do not boil. Ladle into serving soup bowls. Serve warm with fresh green salad, crisp crusty bread and green beans.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,queso fresco,red curry paste,egg,mustard seed,vodka,button mushroom
title: Mushroom Cakes With Queso Fresco
ingredients: 1 package queso fresco, crumbled | 2 ounces vodka | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 lbs fresh button mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon brown sugar, packed | 2 large eggs, beaten
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f. Stir together queso fresco and vodka. Set aside. Spread mustard in a shallow baking pan. Bake for 10 minutes. Increase oven temperature to 400f. Spread mushrooms in the pan, and bake for 10 minutes, or until brown and tender. Add curry paste and brown sugar to mushrooms, and continue to bake for 5 minutes, or until liquid has come to a boil. Cool, then stir in the eggs. Remove from heat. Serve with the mushrooms cakes.

title: Dulce de Leche Custard
ingredients: 1 fresh fruit, of your choice ( firm enough to serve ) | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half or 1 1/2 cups milk
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a blender/grinder/grinder or food processor and process until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until time to serve.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,cream chicken soup,salt,no salt tomato,pistachio nut,ketchup,dark sesame oil,canadian bacon
title: Canned No-Salt Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can creamy chicken soup | 2 1/2 ounces diced canadian bacon, diced | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes, drained and broken apart | 3 -4 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 4 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio nuts ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts in a large saucepan. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer, stirring often until slightly thickened, about 20 minutes. Turn of heat and stir in nuts. Serve over toast, chicken or meatballs if desired.

title: Easy Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 container ready to bake honey garlic hoisin sauce, divided | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
instructions: Whisk 1/2 jar of sauce with garlic powder together in a bowl.

title: Lancaster Stew
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 lb ground veal | 1 can diced green chilies | 12 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Brown lamb and veal in skillet over medium heat till cooked through and no longer pink. Pour off fat into large mixing bowl. With rubber spatula mix in chilies. Pour meat into 13x9 pan. Cover with foil and bake for about 45 minutes or till hot. Serve over pasta.

Random Ingredients: butter,red leaf lettuce,pearl barley,radish,dark soy sauce,turmeric,sultana
title: Tasty Vegetable Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 liter red leaf lettuce | 1 cup pearl barley ( can use white rice barley or brown rice ) | 1 cup sultana | 1 bunch radish | 4 tablespoons butter | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 4 teaspoons turmeric
instructions: Wash and pat dry the red leaf lettuce, blanch the sultanas and radishes. Drain, cut the barley in half, wash, dry and cut each half into four, slice the radishes thinly and add to the barley mixture along with the sultanas and sprains. Melt the butter in a frying pan, cook this till it is slightly reduced, remove the pan from the heat, stir in the dark soy sauce and turmeric. Add to the finished salad. Chill the salad.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,lavender,red bell pepper,shallot,manchego cheese,kidney bean,cream mushroom soup
title: Peperonata
ingredients: 400 g chopped shallots | 250 g manchego cheese, grated | 250 g red capsicums ( roasted & chopped ) | 200 ml tinned kidney beans ( drained ) | 250 ml cream of mushroom soup | 3 tablespoons snipped fresh lavender or 3 tablespoons snipped dill | 3 red bell peppers, thinly sliced
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180ºc. Combine all ingredients into a large ovenproof dish & bake uncovered for 1 hour. Stand for 5 - 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Roasted Parsnips on the Cob
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, well scrubbed | 6 ounces brown mustard seeds ( not pate, the yellow kind ) | 4 4 ounces mulato chiles or 4 ounces chiles, with oil, of choice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f cut the parsnips lenghtwise into halves that have been peeled and cut into 1/8in wide pieces. Place in a large dutch oven, fill with water and boil for 20 minutes or until they are tender but not mushy. Remove the pot from the heat, drain the water and place the chopped parsnips in a deep roasting tin or roasting pan that has been lined with the dried mustard seeds. Scatter over the chiles or chiles and cover the pan with a lid. Cook for 1 hour. Remove and spread the contents of the pan on a warm platter. Remove any excess fat from the roasting pan and place the roasting tin or pan in a preheated oven for another 1/2 hour or until a dark brown crust forms. Allow to cool and store in an airtight container.

title: EASY and Tasty Dip
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese, softened | 1 jar picante sauce ( mild or medium ) | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves ( stems removed ) | cinnamon sticks ( optional )
instructions: Mix cream cheese and picante sauce in a blender or medium mixing bowl until mixture forms a smooth paste. Add cilantro and cinnamon to cream cheese mixture and mix well. Chill a few hours or overnight. Keep refrigerated and serve when mixture starts breaking down and becomes smooth. To use, stir in corn chips or as a filling for crackers.

Random Ingredients: milk,parmigiano reggiano cheese,peanut butter,tomatillo,orange juice zest
title: Bianco Yuca Yello
ingredients: 3 cans tomatillos, drained | 2 cups orange juice, plus 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 can sweetened condensed milk | 2 packages dry roasted sweet butter | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Puree tomatillos, orange juice, and sweetened condensed milk in blender until creamy. Add 1 cup of orange zest after processing, and store in refrigerator. When ready to serve the bianco yuca, heat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange 3/4 cup of the puree in the bottom of a medium baking dish. Spread roasted sweet butter on top of the puree. Mix remaining 1 cup orange zest with remaining 3/4 cup of orange juice, and pour over the bianco yuca. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup of orange zest over the bianco yuca. Bake uncovered for 1 hour in the preheated oven, then remove baking dish with pan from oven and carefully pour remaining 1/4 cup of orange zest evenly over top. Return to oven and bake uncovered for 1 minutes, or until golden and zest is puffed and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,self rising flour,pepper,flour tortilla,cranberry,red wine,sun tomato,lettuce leaf
title: Wild Cranberry Tacos
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups fresh cranberries ( or frozen ) | 2 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 1 1/4 cups self rising flour | 1/4 cup red wine or 1/4 cup low-end vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon flour | 5 large lettuce leaves | 1 cup light sour cream or 1 cup low-fat sour cream | pepper
instructions: Place cranberries, tomatoes, flour and broth in a mixing bowl. Stir in the red wine or vegetable broth. Sift into a bowl the flour. Use half to make a very thin batter of batter and pour into a paper lined baking sheet. Make sure the mixture is about 1/2 inch thick. Brush the top of the cornmeal batter lightly with water. Using a spoon, carefully spread it out over the pan. Using an egg beater or whisk, beat the batter for about 7 minutes or until it has formed a thin ovals. Use a teaspoon or spatula to spoon 1/5 of the batter onto each cornmeal tortilla. Use a fork to flute the edges of each taco. Garnish with additional fresh parsley. Heat oil in a large nonstick frying pan over medium high heat till oil shimmers. Working in batches, fry the tortillas till the underside is puffed and golden. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to paper lined plate and let rest for 5 minutes. Serve hot with sour cream, pepper jack cheese and mango salsa. Tip, i've found the best way to cut up tacos this way is to cut the tortillas into long strips with a chefs knife, remove the seeds, and then cut each strip into wedges or triangles.

title: Shrimp-And-Yogurt-Gan-Honeyed Tzatziki
ingredients: vegetarian style beans | 1/2 orange ( i know navel oranges are great, but i find it works out ok ) | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 lb shrimp or 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled | 1 cup fresh plain yogurt, i used reduced fat | 1/2 cup miracle whip or 1/2 cup sour cream | teriyaki sauce ( to add a little extra flavor ( i use soy sauce. can sub with a little hot sauce )
instructions: Skewer the bean and zucchini. I usually make the bean and zucchini with a little skewer or bamboo skewers as i love my grill. It will skewer a while so the grill won't burn. Skewer the shrimps if using. I usually make the grilled shrimp skewers myself. It will take a bit on the grill, so the shrimp and shrimps can broil. You can cook in a grill pan, broiler, or in a pan on the stove top. It helps meld all the flavors. In a small bowl soak the orange in hot water until juice is clear, about 10 minutes, then add to orange food. Squeeze the orange in your juice, if there are any, and add to orange food mixture. Mix well. The yogurt can also be thickened a little or thick. Stir in the yogurt. Mix well and set aside. The yogurt can now be stored in the refrigerator or a covered container in the fridge until it is time to eat. In my house, this would be a bit too much as we like it. Yummy.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,pesto sauce,spanish olive oil,ricotta cheese,thyme leave,avocado,peanut butter
title: Easiest Avocado Salad Ever
ingredients: 4 large ripe avocados, skinned, peeled & coarsely sliced | 1/4 cup low-fat peanut butter | 2 tablespoons light ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon spanish olive oil | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 2 teaspoons low-fat pesto sauce | hot cooked rice or noodles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Keep refrigerated. Great served cold on fresh crisp lettuce leaves with fresh garden salad. This is a great salad with roasted veggies or even cooked macaroni.

title: Savory Pita Crisps
ingredients: 2 pita bread ( about 4 inches in diameter ) | 1 cup raisins | 1/4 cup yellow mustard | 1 can sliced cashews, drained | 1 large sweet salt pork, shaved into strips | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the pita breads on the prepared baking sheet. Gently spread the raisins onto each pita half, and top with the mustard, cashews, and salt pork. Sprinkle evenly with thyme. Place the second pita on top of the filling, and pinch the crust edges to form a seal. Arrange the pita on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown and crispy. Allow to cool slightly before eating.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,chipotle pepper,whipping cream,key lime juice
title: Chipotle Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 2 large chipotle peppers, stems removed | 3 -4 tablespoons lemon lime juice | 1/2 cup whipping cream | tabasco sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 1/2 cup whipping cream with enough hot water to cover the bottom and sides of a 1 quart slow cooker. Slice peppers into narrow strips removing their seed cores. Combine the hot cream with remaining whipping cream and a little paprika and a few drops of tabasco sauce. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed. Spoon 1/3 cup cream onto a piece of wax paper and spread out to cover the surface with a thin layer of cream. Refrigerate until firm, about 5 hours.

title: Grenola Vegetable Puffs With Hints of Hot  Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables | 1 small pickle, chopped | 3 tablespoons granola cereal | 3 -4 ounces vegetable stock powder | 1 small handful mixed pickles, thinly sliced, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: First, make the hot dressing. Put everything into your bowl and whip for a short time while constantly stirring. This should allow the pickles to soften a little. You can even put the mixed pickles into hot water to cook for a few seconds before you add them. Then, place the frozen vegetables and granola into the dressing, and mix. Add vegetable stock powder and mix. Add more granola powder to taste. Serve immediately on crisp fresh pumpernickel bread with slices of pickle. Enjoy makes 6 to 10 servings. You can also add more sweetener to the hot mustard if desired. Enjoy.

title: Baked Scallops
ingredients: 12 -18 large scallops, washed thoroughly | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon glaze ( or to taste, this depends on your taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lay the scallops vertically on a piece of foil. Top with a few drops of oyster sauce. Wrap tightly with the foil. Place on a cookie sheet and bake in middle of the oven for an hour or until cooked. Remove scallops to warm serving platter. Drizzle with glaze. Note, you can also use the salty glazes. I was told it was not salty enough and i did not know what the flavor was that depends on your personal taste.

title: Homemade Crispy Potato Nests for Christmas Trees
ingredients: 3 cups quick potato chips ( or regular chips ) | 1/4 cup frozen whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 celsius. Line 2 baking trays with nonstick baking paper. Using a heaped teaspoon, scoop 1 teaspoon sweet potato chips onto each paper lined tray. Spread each chip thinly on the top & bottom of each n dent. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown & set around the edges.

title: Gorgonzola Wrapped Pork and Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons gorgonzola | 2 teaspoons cottage cheese | 1/2 lb boneless pork loin, cut into strips about 1/4 inch thick and 2 inches wide | 2 bunches fresh bok choy, trimmed
instructions: Brush 1 tspgorgonzola over pork in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: sherry,flat leaf italian parsley,jasmine rice,juniper berry,shiitake mushroom,tomato green chilies,white breadcrumb
title: Mushroom Rice Balls With Sherry
ingredients: 3/4 cup jasmine rice | 1/4 cup green dried white breadcrumbs | 8 cups canned stewed tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 2 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry | 8 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, washed and sliced thin | 1 teaspoon juniper berries, crushed | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley ( for garnish )
instructions: Drain cooked jasmine rice into a small bowl and add enough warm water to make it 3/4 cup.

title: Chinese Chocolate Ribs
ingredients: 8 lbs pork ribs, bone in | 3/4 cup chocolate chip | 1 egg white | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger juice
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut each meat rib about 3/4 in deep through the meat, forming a 2 layer square. Place rib bones in a 3 1/2 quart glass baking dish. Using a fork, beat chocolate chips, egg white, and ginger juice together in a medium bowl until combined.

title: The Best Pizza Crust
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs of homemade yeast | 1 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Combine all the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Put it all in your pizza maker, and select pizza setting & regular oven. When pizza is completed, remove the top of crust when dough is dark brown. Cut the crust into 3/4 pieces, and top with cheese sauce or cheese. Cook in the oven to your liking.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,white creme de cacao,coconut oil,cream chicken soup,new potato
title: Creamy New Potatoes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coconut oil, divided | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup new potato, diced | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 3 tablespoons white creme de cacao ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a medium sauce pan over medium high heat. Add potatoes and adobo. Mix well, and cook for 7 minutes until potatoes soften. Mix in the cream of chicken soup until well mixed. Pour soup mixture into a 9x13 inch baking pan. Bake for 20 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,pomegranate seed,island dressing,white bean,garlic clove,coconut flour
title: Mashed Sweet Beans in Pomegranate Flavoured Island
ingredients: 600 g white beans ( dry ) | 80 g pomegranate seeds | 60 g coconut flour | 80 g canola-flavoured soymilk | 125 ml thousand island dressing | 1/4 garlic clove
instructions: Soak the beans overnight. The next day, put beans in a blender and process until smooth. Pass through a fine sieve and transfer to a bowl. Add the 100ml/1/4c/0p mix in the pomegranate seeds, coconut flour and the yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: orange liqueur,queso fresco,hot chili sauce,panko breadcrumb,bread dough,vegan mayonnaise
title: Cuban Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegan mayonnaise ( i used low sodium ) | 1/2 sweet hot chili sauce ( i used sriracha ) | 1/4 cup crumbled queso fresco | 2 tablespoons grated vegan parmesan cheese or 2 tablespoons grated romano cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons hot chili sauce or 2 -3 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce | 2 -3 1/2-1 cups bread dough, for sandwich buns ( i used 1 lb of bread ) | 1 tablespoon orange liqueur ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise, sriracha and cheese on medium speed. Combine the sriracha and sauce in a small frying pan, and heat over medium heat until it starts to bubble. If desired, mix in a little more sauce. Add the sauce to the cheese mixture, and stir well until coated. Cut the bread in half, and, shaping each section into a small log, cut out 2 1/2 inch pieces. Fill a baking sheet with warm water. Roll each piece of bread into a ball, dustting each one with a touch of kosher salt. Arrange the bread on the baking sheet, and bake until crispy, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool. Top with the cheese, then repeat until all cheese is used up. Cut into 2 or 3 pieces and top with a few pinches of the sriracha cheese sauce. You can also use other condiments for the panko breads. If using sriracha and/or hot sauce, i would recommend adding a small pinch of cayenne pepper or a little more of the sriracha sauce. Enjoy.

title: Green Beans With Pancetta
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, cut on the diagonal into 1 1/2-inch lengths | 1 lemon wedge, for garnish | 1/8 cup pancetta, diced finely | 1/3 cup black olives | 1/4 cup shredded cheesecloth
instructions: In a large saucepan of salted boiling water cook beans 5 minutes or until just crisp tender. Drain and transfer to a bowl. Stir in lemon wedge and pancetta. Let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile in a medium skillet cook olives until dark brown and heated through, stirring frequently. Drain olives and sprinkle on bean. Sprinkle with cheesecloth.

title: Guacamole With Cheese, and Cherry
ingredients: 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/2 cup guacamole ( homemade or from a packet ) | 8 maraschino cherries, cut into small pieces
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a small bowl. If you are serving guacamole on chips or fresh vegetables, put a layer of cheese on top instead of just sprinkling some of the grated cheese over it. This tastes great served with sour cream or salsa for dipping.

title: Grilled Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb kiwi, peeled and quartered lengthwise | 4 teaspoons minced fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Wash and dry kiwifruit, then cut into 1/4 inch slices, cutting away the peel if necessary. Place kiwifruit in a large bowl, add the rest of the marinade ingredients and toss well. Sprinkle parsley over the top. Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Broccoli and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup long-grain white rice | 1 bunch broccoli, tough stalks removed and cut into florets | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Heat the pan over a low heat and pour in the rice. Stir until the rice is lightly toasted and the grains are coated with the oil. Add a few pinches of fenugreek seeds and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Stir in the broccoli florets and cook for a further 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: french bread,milk,mace,scotch bonnet pepper,green pepper,almond extract,sea salt
title: Hot Chile Pepper French Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, unsalted | 5 large scotch bonnet peppers, stemmed and seeded | 1 green pepper, finely chopped | 1 cup milk | 1 cup freshly bread, cut from crustless french bread | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add chiles, green pepper and all. Cook stirring occasionally until pepper is soft. Add milk and cook stirring until mixture slightly thickens. Remove from heat and cool. Cut crusts of french bread into 1 inch cubes. Add to chile pepper mixture and stir to coat. Spoon 1 cup of cheese into small ovenproof ramekins or custard compartments and top with 1 teaspoon almond extract. Bake in preheated oven until cheese is bubbly and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes. Serve with additional cheese.

Random Ingredients: stevia,french mustard,wheat flour,red wine,apricot jam,rom tomato
title: Red Wine and Apricot Chops
ingredients: 2 roma tomatoes, sliced | 3 ounces red wine ( a splash ) | 12 g apricot jam ( or jam of your choice ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons stevia | 1 teaspoon french mustard | 3 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Spread jam on the tomato slices. Top with the tomatoes and chill well. Whisk together all other ingredients. Add flour and mix until the mixture thickens. Roll out onto a lightly floured surface and use to line a baking tray. Brush with melted butter. Bake for 15 - 20 mins. Or until golden brown on the top.

Random Ingredients: aubergine,olive,italian dressing,rice wine,vanilla extract,dill weed,ha avocado
title: Baked Eggs With Avocado-And-Rice Salad
ingredients: 6 large eggs, hard boiled, cooled and cut into half lengthwise | 1 aubergine, sliced | 1 tablespoon dill weed ( i use dried, but fresh is traditional ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 3/4 cup rice wine ( or wine ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/2 cup italian dressing
instructions: Toast french bread and butter. In a small bowl beat eggs on high speed until soft peaks form. Whisk together dill weed, olive oil, and rice wine in a small bowl. To the egg mixture add egg/wine mixture and combine well. Arrange a bed of egg halves on the hot french bread and top with avocado raki. Drizzle with more olive dressing. Serve immediately.

title: Sparkling Brown Sugar Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup sour cream, room temperature
instructions: Place cream cheese in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade. Pulse for about 20 seconds a time, stopping to scrape down the sides with metal spatula when it just begins to come to a small ball. You want it still chunky, not smooth. Add brown sugar and stir. Add sour cream slowly, stopping each addition to scrape down the sides after each addition. Blend until smooth and creamy, stopping and scraping down the sides after each addition. Pulsate a few more times until creamy again.

Random Ingredients: bran cereal,chocolate,phyllo pastry,thyme sprig,fine breadcrumb,mint sprig
title: Melting Biscuits (Breads)
ingredients: 1 package thawed bran cereal | 3 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 4 teaspoons of fresh mint or 1 teaspoon dried mint | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme sprigs | 1 square grated chocolate | 4 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Dissolve the cereal in 2 cups of boiling water then add all of the other ingredients and mix well, set aside. Using a sharp knife, trim off all but a small piece of each sheet of phyllo pastry to make a 12 x 5 inch square and brush with the melted cereal mixture. Lay one sheet of phyllo pastry on work surface and generously coat with melted butter, cover with another 1/4 sheet, brush with butter and repeat with remaining sheet of phyllo. Heat oven to 350°f. Place two 12 x 5 inch squares of phyllo, one for the top and one for the bottom and repeat cutting the stacked squares into strips about 2 1/2 inches wide. Place a damp kitchen towel or foil paper towel in a shallow roasting pan and lightly wrap two of the strips around each other, but do not cover so the phyllo does not steam. Place in oven and bake on the middle shelf of the oven until golden brown, about 40 minutes and keep an eye on them as they bake so they do not burn. Remove and leave on wire rack to cool. These can be eaten with cold milk icing, whipped cream or cream or just eat plain.

title: Italian Style Chicken & Pork Ribs
ingredients: 5 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 can plum tomatoes | 3 lbs country style pork ribs
instructions: Place chicken, tomatoes, and country style ribs in slow cooker and sprinkle 1/2 teaspoons salt over all. Cover.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,pepperoncini pepper,corn syrup,ranch dressing mix,white bean,dill pickle,baking potato,parmesan cheese
title: White Bean and Pepperoncini Muffins
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and sliced | 4 tablespoons ranch dressing mix | 2 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | 4 garlic cloves, minced | fresh dill pickles, chopped ( for garnish ) or fresh green onion, minced ( for garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly spray two 12 cup or larger muffin cups or line with paper liners. Place the potatoes in a colander and squeeze as much water as possible out of the potatoes. Place the potatoes on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, combine the ranch dressing mix with bean and corn syrup in a saucepan. Cover and cook for 3 minutes, stirring. Remove from the heat. Remove the potatoes, cover and set aside for 10 minutes. Heat the remaining ingredients and stir into the mashed potatoes. Serve warm or cold. Garnish with dill or onion.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,green chili pepper,ice water,cream tartar,chicken breast half,sesame seed,limeade concentrate
title: Crock Pot-Slow Cooker Santa Fe Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 can chicken breast halves, undrained, cut into thirds | 2 cans beef broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1 can mild green chili peppers, chopped, drained | 4 tablespoons ice water | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Place chicken in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Combine broth, limeade, sesame seeds, green chilies, ice water, and cream of tartar in a small bowl. Pour over chicken. Cover and cook on low setting 6 to 8 hours or on high setting 4 to 5 hours. Remove chicken to a serving platter and cover loosely with foil. Increase cooker heat to high setting. Cook until liquid is reduced to about 1 cup, about 15 minutes. Transfer chicken and sauce to a serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,tilapia fillet,orange bell pepper,chunky salsa,oregano leaf,coleslaw,gruyere cheese
title: Tilapia in a Snap
ingredients: 1 lb tilapia fillets | 1 medium orange bell pepper, sliced super thin | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, sliced super thin | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 cups coleslaw | 1 cup chunky salsa | 2 cups gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat broiler. Cut tilapia fillets crosswise in half, horizontally through center, leaving tail fin intact. Place fish in a rectangular baking dish, skin side down. Add pepper slices. Sprinkle with oregano. Broil tilapia about 8 minutes or til fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Meanwhile, combine coleslaw and salsa in a large salad bowl. Shave mozzarella cheese and sprinkle on top of salad. Topped with shredded cheese. Serve with crispy slices of french bread and enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Peppered Shallots
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of potato soup | 1 bunch fresh basil leaf, chopped | 1/2 cup minced shallots
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, mix together the cream of potato soup and basil until well blended. Stir in the shallots and toss until thoroughly coated. Spread in the prepared baking dish and bake in the preheated oven 25 minutes, until bubbly and hot. Serve immediately.

title: Rice Pilaf (Microwave)
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( pearl barley if possible ) | 2 cups long-grain rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl. Cover tightly and microwave on high for 5 minutes or until rice is tender.

title: Macaroni and Noodles
ingredients: 1 box elbow macaroni | 2 tablespoons dry bread ( no substitute ) | 2 tablespoons mirin, plus extra for drizzling | 1 egg noodles, fried ( optional ) or 2 -6 fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined ( optional )
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain pasta and cool under running water. Dry macaroni and put into a large serving bowl. Add bread to bowl and sprinkle on extra mirin. Using your hands, mix well, then coat with egg noodles or shrimp. Drizzle more mirin over mixture, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,asafoetida powder,chinese five spice powder,potato,cheddar,apple cider
title: Cheddar Potatoes (Paleo)
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes | 1/4 cup low-fat cheddar, coarsely grated | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1/4 teaspoon safflower oil | 2 tablespoons apple cider | 3 tablespoons low sodium chicken broth ( optional )
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a saucepan and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat.

title: Vanilla Beans in Vinaigrette
ingredients: 500 g vanilla beans, sliced in half lengthways | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | oil, for deep frying
instructions: Blend the vinegar, vanilla bean paste and vanilla bean paste until you have a smooth paste. Place the oil in a medium sized saucepan over medium heat, then heat for a couple of minutes. Add the vanilla bean paste mixture. Using a slotted spoon, remove the blade from the puree, then add to the pan. Allow the flavors to blend for at least a minute, or until the oil is almost white. Drain the puree, then pour into a serving dish or bottle, tipping it so the oil coats the surface evenly.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,red jalapeno chile,yellow hominy
title: Mexican Posole
ingredients: 8 quarts yellow hominy, rinsed | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 red jalapeno chile, chopped
