instructions: Place hominy in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes. Drain and discard hominy from pot. Wash peppers, and chop. Add peppers to hominy. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add reserved liquid and seasonings to taste.

title: Chipoltes (Mint Chutney)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fresh mint leaves | 3 teaspoons ground chipotle powder
instructions: Place mint leaves in a blender with 3 teaspoons ground chipotle powder. Blend or process to a paste. Mix in remaining 1 1/2 cups of freshly made mint chutney. Cover and refrigerate. Store chutney in a tightly sealed plastic container.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,peanut butter,vanilla essence,lime,dark sesame oil,spring onion
title: Thai Style Satay Meatballs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 500 g beef chuck, ground | 1 spring onion, coarsley chopped, whites only | 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon lime rind, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c. Heat the sesame oil in a large frying pan. Cook chuck, stirring continuously until meat is coloured and completely cooked. Remove from heat and add spring onion. Place peanut butter, peanut butter, vanilla, lime rind, peanut oil and soy sauce in a food processor and process until combined. Mix into meat mixture, season with salt and pepper, stir well. Transfer to ovenproof dish and bake for 20 minutes, turning meat several times during cooking.

Random Ingredients: black olive,ginger juice,beef rib roast,splenda sugar substitute,mint sprig,chicken breast half,chicken bouillon granule
title: Moroccan Chicken
ingredients: 6 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon ground ginger juice | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 ounces black olives, sliced ( drained of all liquid ) | 2 fresh mint sprigs
instructions: In a small saucepan, mix the first 4 ingredients and bring to a boil. Remove from the heat and add the chicken. Cool the chicken in the poaching liquid. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and add the black olives and half the mint and broil for 10 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked and browned and the olives look toasted. Remove the chicken from the poaching liquid and transfer to a serving bowl. Toss the chicken with remaining mint. Serve.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,head cabbage,cardamom pod,turmeric,white wine,self raising flour,cream cheese spread
title: Capsicum and Spice Ale Baked in Sour Cream Parchment
ingredients: 100 g self-raising flour, plus extra for dusting | 100 g cream cheese spread | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 medium head of cabbage | 1/2 cup dark beer ( or use ale ) | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 deg f/180 deg c. Grease and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Using a spoon or your hand, roll out half of the dough on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle about 20 x 20 cm thick. Using a rolling pin, cut into the rectangle into 20 squares, keeping edges neat and straight. Repeat this process until all the dough has been used. Line up a small roasting tin with baking paper. Cut the centre of each square apart again, forming a crescent. Using a rolling pin on a floured surface, roll out the remaining pastry to make a circle. Roll out the edges of each pastry circle to the same circle as the original scone, using a rolling pin on a floured surface. Turn each circle onto a lightly floured baking tray. Using a sharp knife, cut the dough out of the crescents as if you were making a cake. Use the same method as the previous scone, using a sharp knife, and trim off any ragged pastry that rises to the top as you roll out the pastry. Transfer the crescents onto the paper lined baking tray. Using a small spoon or your hand, spread the cream cheese spread evenly over the top of each cresent, leaving a 2 cm border over the top of the cream cheese spread. Sprinkle with the cardamom pod. Using both hands, flatten and shape each cresent into a ball, spacing about 25 cm from the edge. Set the tray aside to allow the dough to air dry. Bake 25 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Transfer the crescents onto a wire rack and allow to cool slightly. Meanwhile, place the cabbage in a pan with about 5 cups water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for about 15 minutes until tender. Drain and place in a large bowl. Set aside. While the cabbage is cooking, place the wine in a small pan over medium high heat and bring it to the boil. Stir in the turmeric and warm through. Remove the pan from the stove and allow to cool for about 5 minutes. Transfer the wine to a bowl and set aside to cool slightly. Once cooled, transfer the sour cream mixture to a bowl. Add the cabbage and mix with a wooden spoon. Season to taste and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 1 hour to allow the flavours to develop. Preheat the oven to 160 deg c and spray a sheet of baking paper with oil. Place the crescents on the prepared baking tray. Using a sharp knife, cut the cream cheese into 24 triangles and place into the oven. Bake about 20 minutes, or until golden. Remove from the oven, and place on wire rack to cool slightly.

title: Watercress and Spicy Tempeh
ingredients: 1 bunch watercress, stems removed | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 3 mint sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Place the watercress stems on the prepared grill, and sprinkle with taco seasoning. Cook, uncovered, until tender, about 3 minutes. Remove the watercress stems from the grill, and stir gently. Repeat cooking process with the mint sprigs. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shortening | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon ginger | 1/2 lb poblano pepper, roasted and peeled | 2 tablespoons sliced ripe olives
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and rub over chicken. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before cooking. Brush with bbq sauce. Sprinkle on chicken and drizzle on additional bbq sauce.

Random Ingredients: mango pulp,beef stew meat,black pepper,avocado,carrot,moisture part mozzarella cheese
title: Beef and Carrot Rollatini
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 8 ounces mango pulp | 1 1/2 cups shredded carrots | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons lowfat mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 avocados, peeled and sliced
instructions: Brown meat in sauce pan. Put all ingredients except cheese in crock pot. Cook on high 1 hour. Turn off cooker and remove meat. Let rest 10 minutes. Take meat out of sauce and shred with two forks. Combine meat, cheese, avocado and salsa and serve.

title: Mama's Easy, Simple & Delicious Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1 lb masa harina or 1 lb cornmeal | 1/4 ounce molasses ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon mixed spice ( i love keens spice blend ) | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese, light or regular | 1/4 cup chopped scallion
instructions: In a bowl, mix the ground meat with the masa harina, molasses, mixed spice & yogurt till moistened. Roll into balls. Cook on a lightly oiled grill tray or in a skillet over med high heat till browned on both sides. Sprinkle with scallions and serve with a side of sauce or guacamole on the side.

title: Yellow Indian Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/2 cups whole-milk mango chutney | 4 large carrots, finely grated | 1 cup chopped fresh cranberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, whisk cornmeal and cardamom together. Stir in the mango chutney, carrots and cranberries until well coated. Pour into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 90 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.

title: Puff Shells Wrapped in Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground chuck | adobo sauce | 12 -12 slices prosciutto, torn into pieces | 12 -12 toothpicks or 12 -12 large corn tortillas
instructions: Cook the meat until it is cooked through but not browned. Remove meat and drain. Sprinkle on the meat with adobo sauce, and set aside. To wrap the shells, lay the toothpicks or corn tortillas on a board and pile on a small mound of meat. Add some prosciutto or other cheese and roll to close. Slice in half and serve with salsa.

title: Red Cabbage (Colcannon)
ingredients: 1/2 head red cabbage, cut into thin wedges | 3 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon white rice cereal or 1 teaspoon instant panko bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees in a large bowl combine the panko and rice crumbs. Dredge the cabbage in the panko. Place onto a baking sheet. Bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,green chili,french bread,bottom steak,grain rice,american cheese,oyster sauce
title: Sausage Sandwich (Pan-Grilled)
ingredients: 3 -4 links smoked lean bottom round steak ( or links of your favorite steak ) | 1 large russet potato, peeled, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 slices american cheese | 2 slices russet potatoes | 1 small green chili, seeded and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | plain toasted french bread, to serve ( use your favorite bread )
instructions: Cut meat into 1/4 inch slices and set aside in the refrigerator while preparing the rest of the sandwich. Preheat grill to medium. Place potato slices on the grates of your grates and allow to sit for 10 - 15 minutes so that some of the juices will have drained into the grates. Cut cheese slice into 1/2 inch pieces and set aside. Open the french bread and cut the bread into 1/2 inch slices. Place cheese, potato slices, green chiles, steak slices, and other toppings in your favourite bowl. Toast bread under grill. Garnish with toasted bread slices.

Random Ingredients: apple,olive oil cooking spray,lump crabmeat,egg white,chicken breast,clear honey,celery salt,mustard powder
title: Crunchy Crusted Chicken With Honey Crab
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 4 chicken breasts | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 cup fresh crabmeat, picked through for large pieces | 3 tablespoons clear honey | 2 tablespoons clear honey
instructions: Wrap chicken breasts with egg white, sprinkle with celery salt, mustard powder, and roll in the crab meat. Coat with melted pepper spray and place, seam side down, in a buttered baking pan. Bake at 375°f for 45 minutes. To make honey crab stuffing, melt honey in microwave for 20 - 30 seconds and combine with 1 tbsp clear honey, mix well, and spoon over chicken breasts. Cook uncovered on high for 5 - 10 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Japanese Beans - Shio-Kari
ingredients: 19 ounces black beans, drained | 2 1/2 cups dashi
instructions: Wash and sort beans. Bring water to a boil in a heavy saucepan. Add beans, reduce heat, cover and simmer until beans are tender, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: corn,vanilla extract,cooking sherry,prosciutto,maraschino cherry,rose water,sun tomato oil,baking powder
title: Cherry-Stuffed Corn Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups corn | 1/2 cup pistachio-flavored sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup prosciutto, chopped | 1/4 cup maraschino cherries, chopped | 1 tablespoon cooking sherry | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/4 cup rum-flavored cooking sherry
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of lightly salted water to boil over high heat. Add corn and cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Drain and cool. In a small bowl, toss pistachios, sun dried tomatoes, prosciutto, cherries, sherry, and vanilla. Spoon equal amounts of pistachios mixture into corn. Using the back of a spoon, gently press corn with fingers. Serve hot.

title: Bunuelos II
ingredients: 2 whole lobster tails, cleaned | 2/3 cup jamaican mixed spice
instructions: Prepare fresh lobster tails, either under the tail or in a plastic bag. Refrigerate for at least four hours. Wearing gloves, remove all visible fat from the tails. Cut them in half. Wash the inside of a large bowl thoroughly. Drain shrimp and pat dry. Rinse shrimp well using a clean cloth to remove shell and cartilage. Place shrimp shells on a large plate that has been covered with a towel or several layers of paper towels. Sprinkle a large bowl of rum on top to enhance their aroma. Spread 2/3 of the rum over the bottom of the bowl, then place lobster halves on top. Sprinkle 1/3 of it over the lobster and top with 1/3 of the mix. Repeat until all the seafood is in the bowl. Repeat for remaining ingredients. Cover bowl with remaining rum. Serve right away. Repeat with another layer of rum. Serve with fresh fruit and cinnamon.

title: Nectarine Apples in Palm Syrup
ingredients: 2 nectarines, peeled and chopped into medium chunks ( or try nectarines and pears to make nectarines ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f / 160°c / 350°f. Mix nectarines, brandy and pears in a medium to large baking dish. Cover tightly and cook for about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until fruits have softened a little and the syrup has thickened slightly. Season to taste and serve as soon as possible with crackers or toasted whole grain bread.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum pasta sauce,butter,bacon,champagne,tarragon,vegetable oil cooking spray,sriracha sauce
title: Spicy Champagne & Bacon With Chutney
ingredients: 125 g red capsicum pasta sauce or 125 g penne pasta | 50 g chardonnay champagne | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 25 g butter or 25 g margarine | 20 g fresh tarragon or 30 g fresh chives | 170 g bacon | sriracha hot sauce
instructions: Heat grill pan on high. Cook capsicum pasta in water. Meanwhile, heat oil & butter in a fry pan. Add bacon & simmer 2 minutes. Take bacon out & place on absorbent paper to dry. Add red capsicum pasta sauce & mix well. Add chardonnay champagne.

title: Pesto with Olives
ingredients: 2 jars nicoise olives, drained | 1/2 cup capers | 1/4 teaspoon crumbled dried sage leaves
instructions: In a screw top jar with a tight fitting lid, combine olives, capers and dried sage leaves. Cover tightly and shake well. Cover jar and shake well or refrigerate at least 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: pepper flake,thai fish sauce,process american cheese,tomato puree,kaffir lime leaf
title: Spice-Free Tomato and Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 box process american cheese, cut into chunks | 1 can tomato puree | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1 pinch hot pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a small baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spray with non stick cooking spray and set aside. Place processed cheese chunks in a large bowl and top with tomato puree. Remove kaffir lime leaves and sprinkle evenly over top of cheese mixture. Add hot pepper flakes. Mix well. Spread evenly over prepared baking sheet. Bake 35 - 40 minutes, or until cheese is melted and slightly browned and golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Thai Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon red chili paste | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Mix together red chile paste and brown sugar. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,russet potato,breadcrumb,kernel corn,liquid smoke,tomato ketchup,ladyfinger
title: Texas Potato Patties
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, halved and thinly sliced | 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn, thawed | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 4 tablespoons country style breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons powdered dried ladyfingers, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f. Mix potatoes evenly in large bowl. In 4 quart saucepan, combine corn, flour, ketchup liquid smoke and bread crumbs. Cook and stir over medium heat about 2 minutes until thick, stirring constantly. Spread mixture over potatoes in a 5 x 3 inch rectangle on lightly greased or parchment lined cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 17 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm, sprinkled with powdered ladyfingers.

title: Marinated Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 cup superfine sugar or 1/2 cup sugar | 1 1/4 cups oyster sauce | 1 whole leg of lamb
instructions: Wash lamb very well in cold water before cutting into 8 to 10 pieces, each about 2 inches long and 2 inches wide. Preheat oven to 450°f. Combine marjoram, 3 tablespoons each of the sugar and marjoram, plus the oyster sauce, and 1/2 cup of water. Rub half of this mixture over the lamb pieces. Roll in remaining sugar mixture, using remaining marjoram mixture to thoroughly cover each piece. Place on rack in roasting pan and roast in lower third of preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes or tnead up roast with oven door ajar. When cooked to the desired level of tenderness, remove from oven and allow to rest at least 20 minutes. Turn meat on a carving board, and use skewers to briefly test the degree of doneness for medium rare, or medium. Transfer the meat to a warmed serving platter or deep platter, and surround with remaining marinade.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,walnut,avocado,curry powder,italian parsley,red cabbage,heavy cream
title: Easy Beef Curry Salad
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 3 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 cup red cabbage, shredded | 1 large avocado, peeled, seeded and coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large, nonstick skillet, cook beef over medium high heat, stirring often, until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with curry mix and parsley.

title: Simple Pork Loin Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 pound pork loin, cut into chunks | 1 loaf crusty bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place pork chunks onto a baking sheet with slightly raised edges. Bake the pork in the preheated oven until meat is just firm to the touch and an instant read thermometer inserted in the center of the loaf registers 145 degrees f.

title: Fruit Salad With Currant Sauce
ingredients: 2 pears | 1 red pepper | 1/4 cup currants
instructions: Using a sharp knife, core and very thinly slice the pears into thin wedges. Scoop out the core and very tough inner core from the red pepper. Cut the pears into thin strips. Slice the red pepper into julienne. Arrange the pears and red pepper in the bowl of a salad bowl. Toss with the currants to taste. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,no boil lasagna noodle,feta cheese,green apple,kitchen bouquet,chocolate,green chili
title: Kittencal's Yummy Feta Lasagna
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 boxes no-boil lasagna noodles | 8 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 4 ounces chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon green chili, chopped | 1 teaspoon kitchen bouquet | 4 green apples, peeled, chopped ( approx 12 to 15 )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray 13 x 9 baking dish with cooking spray. Spray a large nonstick frying pan with cooking spray. Layer ingredients accordingly, sauce, then cheese. Layer apples and cheese on top until ready to take the pan off the stove.

title: Faux Tuna and Okra Pudding
ingredients: 2 cans tuna | 1 package frozen chopped okra, thawed | 1 package taco-flavored sweet potato fries or ( 6 ounce ) package corn chips | 2 ounces confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon dried ranch-style seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/3 cup chopped peanuts | 1/4 cup brewed tea
instructions: Drain and coarsely mash the tuna with a fork. Cut into 1 inch cubes. Place the potatoes into a large bowl and add the frozen okra. Add the tuna, sweet potatoes and taco seasoning, mix well. Add the confectioners' sugar, ranch style seasoning, salt and nuts and mix well. Place the mixed potato mixture into a greased 6 quart baking dish or a 4 quart baking dish, sprinkle the top with the peanuts. Pour in the prepared sweet potato mixture and bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,almond extract,cumin,fenugreek leaf,green bean,peel,corn syrup
title: Chilean Style Green Beans(Or Spinach)
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs fresh flat or spinach | 1 can green beans or ( 16 ounce ) can pink beans, drained and split in half | 1/3 cup light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons chopped cumin | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon ground fenugreek leaves | 1/3 teaspoon almond extract, or to taste
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium low heat. Add 1/3 of the green beans and sprinkle with 1/3 of the cumin, parsley and fenugreek. Stir and cook 1 minute. Stir in 1/3 of the green beans and continue cooking 10 minutes or until green beans are tender crisp. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the green beans to a bowl as they are done and set aside. Repeat steps 7 - 8 with remaining beans. Return skillet to medium high heat. Add remaining green beans, corn syrup, remaining cumin, parsley and fenugreek and heat until mixture bubbles and thickens slightly, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in almond extract until incorporated. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: table salt,chickpea flour,confectioner ' sugar,cilantro leaf,sea salt pepper,baby spinach,red chili pepper,cinnamon
title: Spinach with Chickpea Flour Fritters (Palak Paneer)
ingredients: 10 ounces baby spinach | table salt | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 10 teaspoons chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon ( or 1-2 tsp. cinnamon-optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh-ground red chili peppers ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons jalapeno pepper ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh-cilantro leaves, finely chopped ( or 1 ts. dried-chopped cilantro ) | 3/4 teaspoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Heat a grill pan over high heat. Rinse the spinach under running water.

title: Grilled Eggplant and Swiss Cheese Linguine
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced | 8 ounces linguine | 1 cup cubed swiss cheese
instructions: Grill or broil the sliced eggplant.

title: Chile Powder
ingredients: 5 ounces finely grated orange zest ( zest of 2 orange ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chile powder
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the grated orange peel and chile powder together with a fork. Let sit until the mixture turns bright yellow. Pour into a resealable plastic bag and give a twist to shake the coating back slowly. If the coating is not thick enough, sprinkle more chile powder.

Random Ingredients: dill,tomato green chilies,cheddar cheese,cauliflower,chicken,vanilla essence,apricot,hot salsa
title: Spicy Chicken and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 500 g of cubed chicken | 2 large cauliflower, cut into bite sized bits | 400 g chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot | 1/2 cup hot salsa | fresh dill or mixed herbs, to taste | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | cheddar cheese, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Pour boiling water over the cubed chicken to which a few cubes have been crushed. Keep aside to soak for 15 mins. Drain thoroughly. In a bowl mix the rest of the ingredients, stir well and refrigerate for 1 hour. Place the chicken in a large oven proof dish. Mix all the ingredients together and pour the water evenly over the chicken. Place in a preheated oven at 160c/450f for approximately 30 mins, till the chicken is cooked and the sauce has been reduced and thickened. Serve with salad leaves. Enjoy.

title: Sweetened Pineapple Filling for Fish or Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple chunks ( canned ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: Drain all ingrendients and allow to drain off liquid before proceeding further. If using fish or chickens, add saffron to the pineapple juice before adding the fish. If using chicken or chicken, add saffron and saffron mixture to the pineapple juice before adding the other ingredients. If using chicken, add saffron mixture after adding the other ingredients. Also, if using poultry, add saffron to the pineapple juice before adding to the fish.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,sumac,tapioca,fruit,caraway seed,bulk italian sausage
title: Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1 package bulk mild italian sausage | 1/4 cup minced dried fruit | 1/4 cup chopped finely-sized raw peanuts or 1/4 cup cashews | 1/4 cup drained raisins ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon golden raisin seed ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar or 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground black mustard seeds ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add toasted cashews, cook for 1 minute, stirring until evenly browned. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients. Add to sausage, stirring until it is thoroughly mixed and coated with the spices. Increase heat to medium high and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 10 minutes or until it begins to turn dark golden.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,kosher salt black pepper,romaine lettuce,lemon zest,gruyere,ginger
title: Green Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 cups finely diced romaine lettuce | freshly grated gruyere, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine salt, ginger, zest, ground oil, and salad greens. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with gruyere. Toss to coat. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,celery rib,whipping cream,cayenne,pastry crust pie,red onion,green chili
title: Cajun Sweet Onion Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 green chili, chopped | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2/3 cup whipping cream | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 recipe pastry for a 9 in. pie crust
instructions: Place onion, celery, and chilies in a food processor and process. Add onion mixture to slow cooker. In a small bowl, whisk cream with bouillon. Add cream mixture and cayenne to slow cooker. Serve slow cooker mixture over pastry.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,black eyed pea,lime zest,asian chili oil,red onion,chicken stock vegetable,broth
title: Chinese Black-Eyed Pea Soup
ingredients: cooking spray | 3/4 cup black-eyed peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 liter chicken stock or 1 liter vegetable stock | 1/2 tablespoon asian chili oil | 1 red onion, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest | 1 1/4 ounces broth ( water )
instructions: Spray a large saucepan with a little cooking oil that can be left in the pan with the peas and chicken. Put the mixture over medium heat and add the onion. Cook, stirring, until soft but not brown, around 10 minutes. Add the chili oil and lime zest and cook for 2 minutes longer. Add the stock and simmer until peas are soft, around 10 minutes. Add hot water, lower heat to medium low and simmer for 5 minutes. Puree soup using a blender or food processor, until smooth, then return to the pan, reheat and serve.

title: White Chewy Sauce
ingredients: 1 can unsweetened coconut milk | 1 cup white chocolate | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: In a small saucepan, place the coconut milk and chocolate. Whisking constantly, cook over medium heat until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth. Remove pan from heat. Stir in parsley.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,angel hair pasta,cream corn
title: Pasta with Cream-Corn and Rice
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta, broken into 1 inch pieces | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice
instructions: Heat a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the angel hair pasta and cook for about 8 minutes. Drain and transfer to a bowl to keep warm. Drain all but 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid. Return the reserved liquid to the pot. Add the cream corn and corn mixture.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,pumpkin puree,confectioner ' sugar,chili without bean
title: Pumpkin Spiced Cannoli
ingredients: 2 cans pumpkin puree | 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 12 ounces conchigliette pasta or 12 ounces other long, thin tube-shaped cannoli shells | 1/4 cup chopped nuts ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook cannoli for 7 to 8 minutes or until shells float to the top. Remove with a slotted spoon.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,beef tenderloin,head cabbage,pork loin,edamame,kale,hot chili pepper
title: Beef and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless pork loin, cut into 1 1/2 inch wide strips | 2 1/2 lbs flank steaks, 1-inch cubes | 1 head of cabbage, halved crosswise and cut into wedges | 1 jar edamame, drained and rinsed | 1 package frozen cut green shelled edamame | 1 cup sweet hot chili pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 cups dry marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place pork in a large dutch oven over medium high heat. Cook and stir with a wooden spoon, breaking the meat into small pieces to release flavor and keep it tender. Transfer pork to a large baking dish or 2 quart baking dish and arrange beef, cabbage, and edamame on top, then arrange chili peppers around the meat. Season with salt and pepper, pour wine over all and cover dish. Bake for 5 hours. Add meat and any accumulated juices to pot.

Random Ingredients: ham,cream cheese,deli ham,oil,salt,curd cheese,soy sauce,rump steak
title: Beef Cheese With Ham, Cream Cheese and Salami
ingredients: 6 thinly sliced rump steak | 12 slices ham | 12 slices deli ham | 12 tablespoons cream cheese | 1 dash salt | 1 - 1 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1 dash salt | 1 dash soy sauce | 1/2 cup oil
instructions: Mix sauce and cheese sauce together and set to one side. Place ham slices in center of the rump steak slices. Cut the ham slices into strips and sprinkle on top of meat. Heat oil in skillet. Dip the ham slices one at a time into oil and place in skillet. Cook on each side 3 to 4 minutes. Turn over and do the same with remaining ham slices, do not over cook. Remove from skillet and place on a warm platter. Cut in half to serve.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,parmigiano reggiano cheese,basil,baking potato,red curry paste
title: Spicy Red Curry Potatoes
ingredients: 5 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 1/4 cup red curry paste | 1 teaspoon basil | 1 -2 cup prepared mushroom ( sliced ) | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | fresh basil, cut into large strips garnish
instructions: In a large pan, cut potatoes into wedges. Coarsely grate potatoes and transfer into a large bowl. Sprinkle with curry paste and stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, tossing potatoes occasionally. Arrange potatoes and mushrooms in a single layer on a serving platter just large enough to hold them in a single layer. Sprinkle with basil and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Beefy Veal, Asparagus, and Browner Beef Casserole #RSC
ingredients: 8 ounces sirloin beef | 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin beef bones with marrow ( i use coleman's ) | 1/4 cup brown sugar ( optional ) | 14 ounces beef broth | 2 loaves medium grain white rice | 1 lb asparagus, fresh | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13 inch pan with oil. Cut beef into 2 1/2 x 1 inch cubes. Combine brown sugar and bones in 3 quart sauce pan. Cover and let simmer on low heat, or until meat is just tender. Add meat to stew and set aside. Bring broth to a boil. Stir in rice, cover, and reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,phyllo dough,avocado,button mushroom,sherry wine,bay scallop,szechuan peppercorn,queso fresco
title: Scallops and Mushrooms (Mock Hoi)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bay scallops | 1/2 lb button mushroom | 1/2 lb queso fresco or 1/2 lb mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns, cracked | 1/2 cup brown mustard seeds | 1 sheet phyllo dough | 1/4 cup brown mustard seeds | 1/8 cup sherry wine | 2 avocados, ripe
instructions: Combine the mustard seeds, sherry, sherry and mustard seeds and spread on a piece of parchment paper. Place the scallops on top of the mustard seeds, pressing any seeds that have failed to stick to the parchment to ensure even coverage, and lightly grind 1/2 the peppercorns into the mixture. Let stand 1 hour at room temperature, then drain well. Combine mustard and peppercorns in a small bowl and set aside. Combine mustard seed mixture with mushrooms. Lay one sheet of phyllo dough in front of you with thick, parallel strips of waxed paper. Brush with a little mustard oil and cut 2 strips in half crosswise. Working in batches, lay the scallops on top of the phyllo, overlapping the slices, brush with oil and sprinkle with mustard mixture. Fold this diagonally over the scallops so they are overlapping the strips. Brush with mustard and mustard mixture and sprinkle with peppercorns. Continue on and brush phyllo pastry and top with the remaining 2 strips of pastry, making sure it is not layered with the mustard mixture. Cut into 1 squares, and arrange on a nonstick baking sheet. Repeat with remaining scallops and phyllo, then brush with mustard mixture. Bake in 475f oven for 10 - 15 minutes, then cut crosswise into 1 squares. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,white mushroom,cream celery soup,red chilies,salt pepper,superfine sugar,tomato paste,heavy cream
title: My Sassy Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut into thin slices | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 3 cans cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 can whole red chilies, drained and sliced | salt and pepper
instructions: In a large skillet, brown steak slices in hot tomato paste, stirring frequently and breaking up chunks as you go. Remove to the slow cooker. In skillet, heat remaining tomato paste over medium heat until just barely beginning to color. Pour in picante sauce, cream of celery soup and sugar.

title: Roquefort Crumb Topping - Microwave
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roquefort cheese | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Combine cheese and breadcrumbs. Put on the crumbs in a dish and spread over any kind of meat you desire.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,apricot half,anchovy fillet,garam masala powder
title: Anchovy Apricot Salad (Bollywood)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons aniseed seeds | 1 can apricot halves, drained, juice reserved | 1/4 cup garam masala powder | 2 anchovy fillets, finely minced
instructions: Spread the aniseed seeds over a plate, and let soak 15 minutes. Drain the apricots into the pan, and spread out to cover with enough juice to cover. Scrape the cap of the apricots onto the liquid. Stir in the garam masala, and stir until fragrant. Place the anchovy fillets onto the mixture, stir well to blend and coat. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Artichoke Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 2 jars pico de gallo, drained ( refrigerated is best ) | 1/2 - 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained, and cut into strips | 12 whole cloves ( i cut my own using less if they are too small )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Line the bottom of an oven proof pan with pico de gallo. Layer shrimp on top of pico de gallo, then artichokes, and then clove. Pour enough pico de gallo over the top layer to cover the shrimp and artichokes. Cover with foil and bake for approximately 45 - 50 minutes, until shrimp are done.

Random Ingredients: cheesecloth,hot water,blueberry,parmigiano reggiano cheese,garam masala powder,taco sauce,shrimp
title: Easy Shrimp Tatin
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, unpeeled and deveined | 4 cups warm hot water | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 4 teaspoons cheesecloth or 4 teaspoons soft taco seasoning | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup bottled taco sauce | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries or 1/2 cup frozen blueberries
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut the shrimp so that each shrimp sits on the bottom of the shrimp shell. Remove the shrimp from the shrimp shells and set aside. Place the shrimp shells on the work surface and set aside. Add the water, garam masala powder and cheesecloth or taco seasoning to a large pot and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, skimming occasionally, for 1 1/2 hours. Remove the lid and simmer until the sauce thickens slightly and the shrimp are just cooked through, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes longer. Season to taste with additional salt and freshly ground black pepper, if desired. Remove from the heat and set aside, covered, for 30 minutes or longer. Stir in the taco sauce and top with blueberries to serve.

title: Pepperoni and Raisin Cracker
ingredients: 1 cup white raisins, washed of excess water | 12 ounces pepperoni, sliced thin
instructions: Place raisins in a bowl, cover with cold water, and let soak overnight. Next day drain all raisins well and blot dry. Line a shallow dish with wax paper. Place raisins on wax paper, and place pepperoni on top, and press down lightly until all raisins are covered evenly. Drain water out of raisins and place on top of pepperoni, and press lightly again until all raisins are covered. Cut into small pieces, and serve at once.

title: Best Ever French Lasagne
ingredients: 24 sheets lasagna noodles | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 egg, beaten | 1 tablespoon crushed peppercorn
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together egg and buttermilk with crushed peppercorns. Brush noodles with egg mixture, and layer with a layer of noodles, until all noodles are covered. Spread more egg mixture on top, and sprinkle more crushed peppercorns on top. Cover with plastic wrap for one hour to absorb excess moisture.

title: Tunisian Thyme Stock
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs | 1 pint chicken stock
instructions: Crush the thyme sprigs with the back of a spoon. In a pan heat the cream and pour on the thyme. When the broth is boiling, lower the heat and let simmer for 5 minutes. Take off the heat and let cool. Seal in sterilized bottles. Store at room temperature. Note to make your own lemon thyme bouquet, rinse the salt from your lemon thyme stalks. Use a spice grinder or mortar and pestle, to grind to remove the lemongrass and thyme. You can use a coffee grinder or mortar and pestle, or pulse until the bouquet is finely minced or ground, but be careful, as they can become rather gritty if left in air.

title: Japanese Breaded Almonds
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Toast almonds on nonstick cookie sheet for 3 - 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Spread almond paste on toasted cookie sheet and bake for 5 - 6 minutes, or until lightly browned. Turn over and bake for 5 minutes more, or until lightly browned. While this is in the oven make the sauce. Place the remaining ingredients in a microwave safe bowl and warm on high for 2 - 3 minutes. Just before serving place the almonds on the cookie sheet to cool.

Random Ingredients: natural yoghurt,kaffir lime leaf,kaiser hamburger bun,xanthan gum
title: Gluten Free Yoghurt Cheese Ball
ingredients: 3 cups natural greek yogurt | 2 1/2 cups a good quality gluten free cheese blend | 1 teaspoon ground xanthan gum ( gluten-free variety ) | 2 large kaiser rolls or 2 large other hamburger buns
instructions: Place the greek mix in a bowl and stir in the xanthan gum. Mix until combined and then refrigerate for 1 hour or until ready to use. Preheat oven to 180°c. Form the cheese mixture into balls slightly larger than your buns, but bigger in diameter than the buns. Warm the pan over a medium heat, then add the grated cheese. Add the cheese mixture to the pan and cook for one minute and then remove from heat. Scoop the cheese into the buns, cover with a lid and allow to cool for five minutes. Enjoy.

title: Easy Peppercorn and Red Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 red onions ( unpeeled ) | 2 tablespoons peppercorns, cracked | 1 tablespoon chopped sage ( can use fresh sage ) | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Cut 1/2 onion into rings. Peel remaining onion and cut it into thin rings. In deep frying pan, fry 2 onion rings at a time until brown, turn once. Drain on paper towel, place 2 onion rings in each bowl, sprinkle with peppercorns, sage, and drizzle with oil.

title: Rye Bran (Crispy Bran) Soup
ingredients: 2 cups natural bran, picked over to remove any brine | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock or 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons vinegar ( not white vinegar )
instructions: Wash the bran, dry thoroughly, and drain well. Mix the bran, stock and vinegar together, stirring continuously until it becomes somewhat sticky. Cool, store in an airtight container, and use as a base for the next time. It is great with rice crackers.

Random Ingredients: tamari,peppermint extract,jumbo pasta shell,maple syrup,wasabi paste
title: Wasabi Pasta Shells
ingredients: 8 ounces jumbo pasta shells | 1 can tamari | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons wasabi paste | 1 teaspoon pickled peppermint extract
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, mix together tamari, maple syrup, wasabi and peppermint extract. Pour sauce over hot cooked pasta and toss lightly to coat.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,water chestnut,asadero cheese,applesauce,corn,white vinegar,rice noodle,creole seasoning
title: Creamy Asadero Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1 package fresh rice noodles, any variety | 3 3/4 cups water chestnuts or 3 3/4 cups canned low sodium vegetable broth | 1/2 cup canned sliced strawberry | 2 ounces asadero cheese or 2 ounces monterey jack cheese | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained of any liquid and chopped | 1/2 cup toasted sliced strawberry | freshly chopped parsley or cilantro
instructions: In a large bowl and using a hand held blender, combine vinegar and creole seasoning. Add 2 cups water and stir until mixed. Set aside for 10 minutes. Bring remaining water to a boil and add rice noodles. Boil 3 minutes or until al dente and drain. Set aside. In a large bowl, combine the soup and vegetables. Just before serving add the drained noodles and mix just until heated through. Garnish with toasted sliced strawberries and parsley.

title: Sizzler Onion Rings and Eggs
ingredients: 1 large white onion ( yellow or purple onion is best ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Cut the peel from your onion. Cut them into fairly thin rings about 2'' by 4'' by 3''. Spray the cooking oil in a frying pan or griddle to about 2 1/2 inches in diameter at 300f degrees. Gently and slowly, place your onion rings in and cook slowly until the rings are caramelized slightly but not burnt. The onion rings will begin to cook as soon as they are cooked, but will not burn on the outer side. Remove them from the pan. When cooled completely, store them in an airtight container at room temperature while you prepare your main meal, as soon as possible. When you are ready to make your main course meal, heat oil in a large frying pan or griddle on a high heat. Test by frying a small circle of onion rings and if they look almost cooked, they are done. If any rings aren't cooked, they are not ready. When onion rings are done, drain on paper towels, then transfer to a baking pan or baking tray lined with a baking paper liner. Sprinkle evenly with salt, then cool completely. They keep indefinitely if stored in an airtight container.

title: Chocolate Bread - Microwave
ingredients: 3 slices raisin bread, crusts removed | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional ) | 12 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Place the bread slices on the microwave safe plate and microwave on high for 1 minute, turning once. Spread the cocoa, mustard and raisins evenly over the bread. Place another piece of bread on top. Microwave on high for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring twice. Leave to cool and serve.

title: Spicy Roasted Parsley Tea Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1/3 cup fresh parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f place the baking soda in a cup or small bowl. Add the parsley and stir to combine. Use a spoon or a large fork to stir in the tea until the baking soda dissolves. Sprinkle the bread with some of the remaining baking soda until it sticks to the bowl. Sprinkle the remaining baking soda over the top and continue to stir in the parsley. Bake for 10 minutes or until the bread is nicely browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: coconut pecan frosting,dark molasses,green chilies,ziti pasta,orange peel
title: Tex Mex Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, cooked & drained | 1 can coconut pecan frosting | 3/4 cup dark molasses | 1/4 cup orange peel, grated | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained
instructions: Toss together all ingredients except ziti, cover and chill. Add drained ziti, stirring until all coated. Spoon ziti into 3 quart crockpot. Add remaining filling. Cook on low 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,fennel seed,double cream,cumin powder,cremini mushroom,tea,chuck steak,oregano leaf
title: Creamy Beef Pies
ingredients: 6 tablespoons double cream ( light ) | 6 tablespoons cremini mushrooms ( sliced ) | 2 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes or 2 teaspoons vegetarian beef bouillon granules, dissolved in | 2 teaspoons tea, brewed ( or 1 1/4 cups milk, white or 1 1/4 cups fat free chicken broth, whichever you like ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon crushed fennel seed ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin ( optional ) | 1 lb chuck steak ( thinly sliced )
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, whisk together the cream, 1/4 cup cremini mushrooms, 3 tbsp of the coffee bouillon, tea, the cumin, oregano, fennel and cumin powder. Let simmer on low for 20 minutes. Stir in the beef slices. Cover and keep warm over low heat. Spoon into individual ramekins or individual pie dishes. Freeze until hard, at least 2 hours, overnight if you have frozen them. Keep frozen in a tightly covered container at room temperature and will keep forever at least two weeks. To reheat, put in microwave on high for 1 minute, or until warm, stir and heat in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave for 45 seconds, or until hot. You can also do this in a nonstick fry pan, just heat on medium. Just use a fork to poke holes all over the top of the pie. Microwave for 1 minute, then microwave an additional 30 - 45 seconds, until warm, stir, serve hot and enjoy.

title: Couscous With Curry Meat
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh gingerroot | 2 tablespoons sweet curry powder | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 1/2 cups couscous ( i use lundberg's ) | 1/2 cup brewed coffee | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well on a flat surface. Chill for at least 1 hour or up to 12 hours. Serve with couscous.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,pearl barley,tomato juice,herbes de provence,cornflour,blackberry
title: Baby Swiss Cheese and Blackberry Barley Bake (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 200 g pearl barley | 150 g swiss cheese, cut into 1 cm cubes | 7/8 cup tomato juice | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence or 1 tablespoon dried herbes de provence | 500 g frozen cornflour | 120 ml blackberry jam or 120 ml raspberry jam
instructions: Cook barley in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, spray 13x9 pan with a baking spray. Combine all ingredients except jam in a large bowl, stirring well. Put half the hot barley in the bottom of the dish. Spread half the cheese cubes on top of the barley. Spread half the swiss cheese on top of the swiss cheese and again spread all of the swiss cheese. Layer blackberry jam. Top with remaining barley. Cover with remaining swiss cheese. Invert swiss cheese on top. Dot swiss cheese with the back of a spoon. Place in moderate oven.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,cider vinegar,provolone cheese,lime zest,green onion,cocoa,american cheese
title: Grilled Salmon Sandwiches, 2 Ways
ingredients: 2 salmon steaks, about 1 pound each | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 lime, zest of | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 4 tablespoons green onions, white and light-green parts, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons american cheese, coarsely shredded | 4 tablespoons provolone cheese, coarsely shredded
instructions: Preheat grill. Place salmon on rack in broiler pan and set under broiler for 4 - 5 minutes. Turn and broil 3 - 4 minutes longer. Meanwhile, whisk together cocoa, lime zest and cider vinegar. In shallow dish, stir together green onions, cheese and 1 tablespoon of the cocoa mixture. Dip both sides of salmon, then evenly coat both sides with half of the green onions mixture. Serve with a third of the remaining green onions mix, remaining cocoa and lime mixture on the side for dipping.

title: Cheesy Cheddar Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/3 cup grated cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Combine the cheeses in a small bowl and spread over one side of a preheated hot griddle or skillet. Let cheese soften slightly before moving it over to the griddle. After cheese has melted, sprinkle with the garam masala and grated cheese. Use your second side of a hot griddle as you would butter on the dish.

title: Sauza Nisames (Shake Nuts)
ingredients: 6 ounces asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup candy sprinkles
instructions: Heat a non stick fry pan. Add the asofoetida powder and stir fry until the asofoetida is browned. Add 1/2 cup of candy sprinkles. Remove from heat. Remove from heat. Spread the asofoetida on clean kitchen towels.

title: Grilled Pork With Passion Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 4 pounds pork shoulder | 1 jar sweet pupper's passion fruit salsa | 5 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced celery | 1 pork tenderloin, sliced
instructions: Season pork with salt. Place pork, pork shoulder, sweet pupper's in a 9x13 inch pan. Pour salsa over pork, and sprinkle with celery and sliced pork tenderloin. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,chicken breast meat,green bean,coconut cream,olive oil
title: Dutch Oven Fried Chicken over Coconut Milk
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into strips | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 package frozen cut green beans, thawed | 1 package kielbasa | 1/2 can coconut cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange the chicken strips on the prepared baking sheet and pour the olive oil over them. Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is no longer pink in the center and the outsides are golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, place the beans in a pot with enough water to cover.

title: Cauliflower Saute
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret ( about 1 1/2 1 1/2 pounds ) | 6 slices scallions, preferably white green and very thin sliced | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns | 1/2 teaspoon finely ground mace ( or more if desired )
instructions: Steam the cauliflower for about 7 minutes or until tender. Drain the cauliflower into a colander and run under cold water to steam off excess moisture. Do not wash the cauliflower. Let the cauliflower cool before peeling. Cut the cauliflower into very thin matchstick size pieces. Set a large skillet over moderately high heat and dry toast the peppercorns and mace in it for 30 seconds. Stir in the cauliflower pieces and cook for 3 minutes. Reduce the heat to moderately low and cook, stirring frequently, for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salt,lime juice,flour tortilla,lettuce leaf,tahini paste,vanilla bean,beef bouillon
title: Fried Burritos
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini paste | 3 teaspoons lime juice | 1 pinch salt | 2 tablespoons honey or 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/4 teaspoon beef bouillon, dissolved in | 2 tablespoons water | 1 flour tortillas, warmed | lettuce leaf, for serving
instructions: In food processor, combine tahini paste, lime juice, salt, honey, and bouillon, process until smooth, about 20 seconds. Wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Heat grill to high. Brush tortillas with olive oil, and grill until soft, 3 - 5 minutes on each side. Serve on top of warm tortillas with lettuce leaves.

title: Braised Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 4 -6 lbs beef brisket ( or a combination of beef, pork stew beef or stewing beef ) | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 cups hot water
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Put 2 tablespoons oil into a deep skillet over medium high heat. Dry the brisket on all sides, remove and place on a piece of waxed paper. Rub the other 2 tablespoons oil with the dry oil, this will ensure a marbled appearance. Add 1 cup hot water. Cover pan, and place in oven. Bake for 4 hours, making sure meat does not become dry. Remove brisket from oven, and let sit, covered, for 1 hour. Slice into slices and serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: red onion,chinese five spice powder,onion powder
title: Chinese Five-Spice Tea
ingredients: 1 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1 cup chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup onion powder | 3/4 cup chinese five spice powder, blend
instructions: Pour boiling water over the five spice blend and let sit for 10 minutes. Stir the mixture every 5 minutes. After 10 minutes, add the onions and five spice powders and blend. Serve hot.

title: Buffalo Pepper Bread Pita Sandwich
ingredients: 1 whole-wheat pita bread | 1/2 cup canned blueberries | 1/4 red peppers or 1/4 yellow pepper, diced
instructions: Cut up all the veggies evenly. Spread blueberries in the pita bread and top with diced pepper. Microwave about 45 seconds until hot and bubbly.

title: Beer and Cottage Cheese Dip
ingredients: 150 g cottage cheese, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup good old fashioned stout beer ( recommended ( guinness )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl. Mix well until well combined. Cover and chill in the fridge for at least one hour, up to a day.

title: Peanut Butter Nuggets
ingredients: 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Combine peanut butter and honey in a small bowl.

title: Quick & Fresh Vietnamese Herb Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lemongrass | 1/3 cup minced fresh rass | 1 tablespoon freshly grated fresh lemon grass | 2 cups chopped romaine lettuce, or to taste | 1 tablespoon grand marnier, or as needed
instructions: Stir ginger, lemongrass, and rass into ginger paste in a bowl. Stir romaine lettuce, or to taste, into ginger paste.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,apple cider,lemon,worcestershire sauce,cheddar cheese,mushroom,beetroot
title: Spicy Apple and Beetroot Appetizer
ingredients: 600 g beetroots, peeled, grated | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 small lemon, juice of | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon apple cider | 1 pinch dried cherries ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except the cherries in a bowl, and mix. Pour it into a gratin dish and grill until browned, and puffed up over medium heat. Serve with grilled veg.

Random Ingredients: texas toast bread,tomato sauce,ginger,rice vinegar,cocoa powder,risotto rice,honey,green cabbage
title: Quick Cowboy Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 8 -20 slices texas toast thick bread | 2 cups thinly sliced green cabbage | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1/4 cup honey ( or more to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated | cooked rice, for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Brush each slice of toast with melted butter. Place one slice of bread on each of 4 dinner plates. Toast the remaining 4 slices of toast and place on plates. Place a cabbage leaf atop each toast slice, then top with a few teaspoons of cocoa powder, some tomato sauce and 1/4 cup honey or more to taste. Top each plate with a few teaspoons of rice vinegar. Sprinkle the ginger on top of the cabbage leaf and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red onion,parsley,tomato sauce,angel hair pasta,maraschino cherry
title: Angel Hair Pasta With Tomatoes and Parsley
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta, uncooked | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 small red onion, very thinly sliced | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, minced | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and quartered
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: crisco,russet potato,graham cracker crumb,picante sauce,onion powder,spaghetti,soymilk
title: Microwave Spanish Cheesy Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, cut in chunks | 3 tablespoons onions powder | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 1/4 cup crisco | 1 jar spaghetti or 1 can ranch style beans, drained | 1/2 jar picante sauce | 2 teaspoons graham cracker crumbs, crushed
instructions: Combine the potatoes and onion powder in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Smoked Salmon on a Stick
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon | 4 ounces smoked beef, diced | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Clean up and clean the salmon, and remove the skin. If the fish does not have skin, use the brush of a knife or a fork. Chop the flesh finely, place in a bowl with some water. Refrigerate for about 4 hours to let the flavors mingle. Remove the salmon from the bowl. Reserve the water in which it was snipped, and bring it to a boil in a large saucepan. Add the honey, and return the whole, unshucked, to the pan, stirring to coat. Let it cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Take it off the heat and allow it to sit covered until it cools slightly. Remove the salmon from the bowl, strain and save it for another use, if you like. Use the skin as a garnish for a wrap or as a wrap for a fish cake, or in your favorite recipes calling for salmon, etc you choose.

title: Japanese Fruit Salad
ingredients: 12 asparagus spears, trimmed | 1 package dry rice noodles | 1 bottle apple brandy
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add asparagus, and cook for 5 minutes, or until crisp tender. Drain, and cool. Place the asparagus on a plate, and gently flatten the noodles with a rolling pin. Arrange noodles on a serving platter, and fill with cooled asparagus.

Random Ingredients: sake,white vinegar,self rising flour,cream tartar,tea,turmeric,dark chocolate,cooking spray
title: Tea Scones, Like Donburi
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon white vinegar or 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar, heated | 1 tablespoon sake ( optional ) | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon sake or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar, hot | 150 g dark chocolate, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons strong tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, whisk flour with cream of tartar, turmeric, and salt and pepper to taste. Add in the warm sake or wine vinegar. Stir continuously until the mixture forms a soft dough. Turn onto a floured surface. Knead until smooth, place on a bowl covered with a tea towel and chill for 10 to 15 mins, if you feel this need some time. Turn oven up to 220c/fan 160c/gas 1 and lightly spray a baking tray with cooking oil. Place dough onto the tray and spread evenly. Use a small knife to make slits all over the dough. Bake the dough for about 5 mins, or until the top is a medium golden colour. Turn out onto a board and allow to cool on a cloth. To make chocolate glaze, melt the chocolate over a bowl of hot water, or until smooth and creamy. Remove the baking tray from the oven and stir in the tea. Turn the heat up to 375f/120c/gas 3, and immediately pour the chocolate mixture over the scones. Set the baking tray on a flat heat. Allow the scones to steam for 3 - 5 mins to harden slightly and crisp. Serve immediately.

title: Beef and Beet Pizza
ingredients: 2 cups cubed mozzarella cheese | 2 beef, bison, round steak meat, thin | 2 cups cubed beets | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1 orange, juiced | 1 bag cooked chicken wings
instructions: Prepare a non stick griddle pan with nonstick cooking spray. Place beets onto grill. Grill over hot coals, turning frequently. When beets are tender, place on paper towel lined plate. Chill for 10 minutes. Set aside to steam. Slice into thin strips and place into a container with marjoram. Place cheese onto a microwaveable plate. Scatter marinated beef and beets over cheese and marjoram. Add sliced orange zest, juice of one orange and some extra marjoram if desired. Microwave at low for a few minutes to heat through. Serve with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Whole Wheat Cocoa Beef Strips & Buns
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef sirloin | 4 teaspoons cocoa | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon granules
instructions: Cut the beef into thin strips about 1/2 inch wide by 1/2 inch long, removing tough portions of meat. If there are not long strips cut into 1 inch lengths. Combine the cocoa with the flour and bouillon and add the meat strips. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees, then line a baking sheet with parchment paper or grease lightly with butter. Divide the meat mixture into twelve portions, and place each onto the parchment. Bake the meat for 20 - 25 minutes, until the meat is brown and cooked through.

title: Baked Chocolate French Bread
ingredients: 4 french baguettes, preferably the thin ones, sliced lengthwise | 6 tablespoons poppy seeds | 8 ounces baking chocolate | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place baguette slices onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until toasted. Combine poppy seeds and chocolate in a saucepan and melt over low heat. Remove from heat. Add basil and sprinkle on top of toasted bread slices. Enjoy.

title: Couscous With Ham and Red Peppers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons couscous | 1 red bell pepper, minced ( or green or yellow ) | 5 leaves ham, minced | 1 bay leaf | 2/3 cup half-and-half or 2/3 cup whole milk
instructions: In large bowl, add rice, bell pepper flakes, ham, milk, or any optional ingredients you like. Mix well with fork. Cover pan. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,white wine vinegar,salmon fillet,green grape
title: Seared Salmon With Sweet Pickled Grape and Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, skin removed | 1/2 cup orange bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup green seedless grapes | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Spray large skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Place salmon & peppers in skillet, flesh side down, and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until just done. Place on platter & cut into wedges. Arrange grapes over the salmon fillets & spoon remaining vinaigrette over. Serve.

Random Ingredients: butternut squash,fennel,red chili,rose water,spinach leaf,red potato
title: Spinach & Butternut Squash
ingredients: 1 small butternut squash, peeled ( about 1 lb ) | 1/3 cup rose water | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped fresh fennel ( optional ) | 1 -8 canned dried red chili | 1 red potato, medium, diced ( optional ) | 9 fresh spinach leaves, washed, trimmed and chopped
instructions: Combine squash, 2 teaspoons rose water, fennel and chilies in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 2 or 3 minutes or until squash is just tender. Stir together potato and 1/4 cup of the hot squash mixture.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,part ricotta cheese,french haricot vert,broth,garlic head,orange
title: Garlic Cheese Soup
ingredients: 3 garlic heads, blanched and peeled | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 6 cups chicken stock or 6 cups broth | 4 cups french haricots vert ( trimmed ) | 1/2 cup grated orange rind or 1/2 cup fresh orange juice | fat ( for deep frying )
instructions: Separate garlic heads from stems. Blend in processor until coarsely chopped. Strain through a small sieve and set aside. Heat stock, salt, garlic and orange rind in 4 quart pot over high heat until it just ripples but does not boil. Add in haricots verts and cook until well heated. Immediately remove from heat. Pureee soup in blender and return to pot. Heat but do not boil. Serve hot with crusty bread for dipping.

title: Mango Cloverleaf Crescent
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 4 cans pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 medium mango, sliced
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium heat. Stir together the grand marnier, cilantro and 2 tablespoons of the grand marnier and drizzle into the skillet. Simmer, stirring frequently, until the liquid is reduced by 1/ and the grand marnier is syrupy, about 5 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Using a 2 count cookie cutter, shape 1 dough can onto a 10 inch round cake pan. Top the dough with 1/4 of the mango slices. Continue topping with the remaining dough can, fruit sauce, remaining mango and grand marnier mixture.

title: Thai Nam Pla (Fish in Curry)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons curry paste
instructions: Mix tamarind paste and curry paste together. Serve hot with rice.

title: Macadamia Meatball Mix
ingredients: 500 g ground chicken | 3/4 cup sweetened coconut, with peanuts | 3/4 cup poppy seed | 1/2 cup broth ( any kind ) | 1 dash cayenne
instructions: Mix all the above together, except the stock. Add the stock little by little and knead with your hands. Keep in the fridge until required. Cut meat into 1 inch size balls using your hands. Add more stock or water as required. The mixture should be moist, but should not stick to your hands. Cook in a dry pan with a little oil on medium, stirring until it browns. Serve on a warm platter.

title: Easy Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 pound beef top sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup buttermilk
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Mix the liquid smoke into the beef chunks. Allow to marinate in the refrigerator, 30 minutes to 4 hours. Remove the beef chunks from the marinade, drain, and set aside. Place in a bowl, and toss with the buttermilk to coat. Thread cubes onto skewers, about 3 per skewer. Cook over high heat until the meat is cooked through and beginning to turn brown.

Random Ingredients: berry,irish cream,dijon mustard,thyme,habanero pepper,vanilla essence,green cardamom pod
title: Irish Cream Cocktail II
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces irish cream or 2 fluid ounces sour cream | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla essence | 1 green cardamom pod ( optional ) | 1 habanero pepper, split up ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs mixed berries ( strawberries, blackberries, fresh red currant berries, blueberries, raspberries )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the irish cream, mustard, vanilla, cardamom and green cardamom pods. Pour into a cocktail shaker or a jar with a tight fitting lid. Add the pepper, berries and optional ingredients and shake well. Ladle over ice cubes filled with ice cubes. Shake vigorously and strain through a fine mesh sieve into a cocktail glass. Makes about 1 pint.

title: Way Too Easy Sweet Onion Dip
ingredients: 1/2 onion powder | 1 1/2 cups sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and refrigerate in an airtight container for at least one hour before serving. Serve with your choice of dippers.

Random Ingredients: habanero pepper,tomato sauce,salt,orange juice,carnation milk,cake yeast
title: Spicy Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups carnation evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 2 1/4 teaspoons salt | 1 1/4 lbs cake yeast | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice or 1/2 cup evaporated milk | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: For the syrup, combine all ingredients in a small saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat. Combine the syrup and yeast in a large mixing bowl, and let stand for 10 to 15 minutes. Add liquid and salt to the yeast mixture. Stir to incorporate, and beat at medium speed for about 2 minutes. Reduce dough by half, and knead for about 10 minutes. Grease large bowl or bundt cake mold with cooking spray. Oil a large bowl with vegetable oil or lard. Place dough in bowl. Invert the dough in the bowl, and turn the dough in the bowl. Cover, and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 2 hours. For the bread, punch down the dough, and cut into 12 pieces. Place 1 piece of bread into the oiled bowl, and turn the bread to coat on all sides with the oil and salt. Let raise for 30 minutes, or until puffy and golden. Allow the bread to rest for about 5 minutes. Slice the bread into 1/2 inch slices, and serve.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,anise seed,green chilies,almond,cayenne,clam juice,swiss chard,green chili
title: Mexican Spicy Sauteed Chard
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard, stems removed | 4 cans diced green chili | 2 cans chopped green chilies | 4 cups bottled clam juice | 4 ounces sliced almonds | 3 teaspoons anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup shredded medium monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to boiling. Add swiss chard stems.

title: Baked Ziti with Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 4 slices bread ( toasted is preferred )
instructions: Preheat a grill pan with a rack 6 inches from the heat or in the oven. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ziti and cook uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: double cream,tomato onion,sage leaf,palm sugar,rice noodle,pinto bean,pear,parsley
title: Pea and Pear Rolls With Sweet Basil Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley | 60 g palm sugar, chopped | 2 sage leaves | 150 g pinto beans, drained & rinsed | 300 g frozen mixed peas | 150 g rice noodles, cooked | 300 ml double cream | 1 finely grated fresh carrot
instructions: Heat oven to 150c/fan 160c/gas tip the herbs, pinto beans and peas into a large bowl and toss to combine. Add the noodles and cream and toss again to combine. Put 2 big baking trays in the base of the oven and spoon in the mixture. Bake for 12 minutes or until risen and golden. Transfer the rolls, cut side down onto serving plates and garnish with the carrot and serve.

title: Easy Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb chicken wings or 1 -1 1/4 lb large turkey wings | 1/2 cup fruit flavored liquid seasoning | 1/4 cup liquid maggi seasoning or 1/4 cup mixed dried fruit ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon crushed whole cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a baking sheet with nonstick spray or line with parchment paper. Pour enough water into a medium, heavy nonstick fry pan for cleaning all chicken wings. Bring water to boil, immediately lower heat. Cover & cook for about 40 - 45 minutes, stirring chicken every 15 minutes. While chicken is cooking break wings into sections. Remove tips, skin, and bones from wings. Rinse with cold water. Drain any leftover liquid. Mix in seasoning, mixed dried fruit, & ground cloves. Let mixture rest 5 minutes uncovered. Rinse the fry pan then wipe it dry. Place in preheated oven & bake for 30 - 45 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sandwich bread,chicken breast half,asiago cheese,strawberry,tart apple,masa harina,broth,salt pepper
title: Ole! Chicken With Apple Mousse
ingredients: 4 -6 boneless chicken breast halves or 4 -6 boneless chicken thighs | 4 large tart apples or 2 large pears, peeled | 4 -6 fresh mushrooms, sliced | 4 tablespoons fresh french harina ( made with a salad dressing mix ) | 8 -10 cups prepared low-sodium broth ( or chicken stock ) | salt & fresh pepper | 2 cups purchased masa harina | soft-textured sandwich bread
instructions: Put the apples or pears in a large pot with the water coming up to just under the top of them and a dash of salt. Bring the water to a rolling boil and boil for 8 - 10 minutes, or until the apples or pears are just tender. Remove the pan from the heat, but let the apples or pears sit while you make the masa. Place the chicken in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook slowly, turning frequently until golden brown on both sides – about 10 - 12 minutes or so. Remove from the heat when done and place on a plate covered with plastic wrap. In the meantime, prepare the masa. Make sure to get out every last vestige, especially between the chicken and the masa, otherwise the masa will stick in the pan. If it does, simply place it back on the heat. Stir all the while for one to two minutes. Drain the apples or pears and add them to the pan. Cook for about five minutes, stirring regularly, until the apples or pears are tender, but not mushy. Taste and add salt if needed. Stir in the harina, then slowly stir in just enough broth to make it moist but not soupy. Bring to a simmer and partially cover, turn the heat to low. If you find the mixture too loose, add the hot broth a little at a time, stirring continuously to avoid lumps. When the masa is tender and creamy, remove the pan from the heat and stir in the soft bread. Cut the chicken into 1 inch pieces, and place them in with the sauce. Serve with sliced or grated hard boiled eggs on top. This is delicious warm with crusty italian bread. It also goes well with romaine lettuce and other greens or veggies that have been tossed with the harina.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,tea,molasses,walnut,lite olive oil,grain rice,raisin,part ricotta cheese
title: Italian Rice Balls  With Fresh Walnuts (Wheards)
ingredients: 1/2 cup lite olive oil | 32 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 14 ounces white whole grain rice ( stone ground ) | 13 ounces fresh raisins | 2 ounces walnuts, coarsely chopped | 16 ounces teabags ( white sugar, white corn kernels or nuts of your choice crushed slightly ) | ice cube | 14 ounces low-sodium frozen tea, thawed ( or 1/2 cup strong brewed tea )
instructions: Prepare the yeast as follows, mix together and allow to foam for 5 - 10 minutes. Pour the oil, then set aside until needed. Put both amounts of rice in a large bowl and add the raisins and walnuts, and mix well. Add both amounts of teabags and mix well. Then set aside in a warm place until you need to make the meatballs. To make the meatballs, roll and shape the ice cubes into small balls. Put the frozen tea bags in a large bowl, add the meatballs and allow to chill for 10 mins or until they reach your desired softness. Place a handful of ice in the bowl and then place the meatballs on top. Allow to freeze completely before serving.

Random Ingredients: oregano,grapeseed oil,rice vinegar,plain flour,watermelon,italian seasoning,sharp cheddar cheese,margarine
title: Watermelon Slice
ingredients: 2/3 cup chopped watermelon, seeds removed | 1 1/3 cups plain flour | 1/2 cup frozen rice vinegar | 1/3 cup margarine | 1/2 cup rapeseed oil | 1/4 cup zesty fresh italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano | 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 1/4 cup other creamy cheese
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, except cheese, stirring just until blended. Press mixture into a large baking dish, about 1 inch high. Bake at 400°f for 20 - 25 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Sweet Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces pasta ( penne, rigatoni etc ) | 4 1/2 ounces light margarine | 5 1/2 ounces dark brown sugar | 5 ounces sugar syrup
instructions: Boil the pasta till al dente and drain. Boil sugar syrup, add margarine to dissolve and boil till creamy/syrup is a golden syrup color. Fold the pasta into the syrup and sugar syrup. Turn off heat and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,steak,gold tequila,red pepper,wild rice,burrito flour tortilla
title: Tropical Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak | 1 can peeled italian-style diced tomatoes | 2 packages burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 can italian style diced tomatoes | 1 cup sweet red pepper, strips | 1/4 cup golden tequila
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a 13x9 baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray, layer beef, undrained tomatoes, tortillas, diced tomatoes, red pepper strips, and tequila. Cover, and bake 45 minutes. Uncover, and bake an additional 40 minutes, or until hot and cheese is melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,steak,dill,sherry wine,cream chicken soup,mushroom stem
title: Beef Roast in Sherry
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs round steaks, trimmed, cut 1 inch thick | 12 ounces fresh mushrooms stems and pieces, cut in half | 12 ounces canned cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup sherry wine ( dry ) | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh sage leaf | 1 tablespoon freshly snipped dill
instructions: Place meat in a baking pan. Cover with mushroom pieces. Drain soup through a sieve. Mix remaining ingredients in a medium bowl, pour over meat. Cover and marinate at room temperature, up to 24 hours. Preheat oven to 350&deg.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,wheat germ,puff pastry,wheat bread crumb,cilantro
title: Mexican Whole Wheat Pastry Triangles
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 sheet of regular whole wheat puff pastry, thawed ( about 12 ounces ) | 1/3 cup whole wheat bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon cilantro, minced, or to taste | 1/3 cup wheat germ
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 15x10x2 inch baking sheet with veggie oil cooking spray. On a lightly floured surface, roll out half of the pastry to make a rectangle about 10x3 inches in thickness. Cut it into four equal strips. Starting from the long side, roll each strip with a wooden kitchen mallet and pound it with the smooth side of a rolling pin or the edge of a glass until it reaches about half of the wide of the dough. Sprinkle the rectangle with bread crumbs and cilantro and roll up the pastry dough tightly. Transfer the folded pastry to the prepared baking sheet and repeat process to make four rolls about 10x14 inches in width. Sprinkle wheat germ on each roll and bake until golden brown at the edges, about 15 minutes. Let dough cutters rest a few minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,vegetable oil,white miso,tamari,spaghetti,marinara sauce,head cauliflower,shiitake mushroom
title: Miso Mushroom and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 1 cup prepared marinara sauce | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 package dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon white miso | 2 packages dried spaghetti
instructions: Place cauliflower in a large pot with boiling water.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,key lime juice,cracker,sea salt,taco seasoning,pie,bratwurst,cornmeal
title: Bratwurst Tacos With Key Lime and Gruyerre
ingredients: 2/3 cup cornmeal | 1/3 cup grated gruyere cheese ( or other hard cheese like swiss emmenthal ) | 3/4 teaspoon taco seasoning, plus more | taco seasoning, for the crust | 3/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup chopped bratwurst ( such as german ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh key limes or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 1/2 lbs pie shells
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f combine cornmeal, cheese, taco seasoning and salt in a mixing bowl. Sprinkle bratwurst over crust. In 1 t non stick skillet, heat lime juice on medium heat and cook bratwurst until no longer pink, about 4 minutes per side. Spread bratwurst over cheese mixture, then sprinkle with key limes. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until hot and bubbly. Let cool 5 minutes.

title: Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 2 cups shredded steak | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup flour tortillas, warmed | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 2 cups hot cherry tomatoes or 2 cups red cherry tomatoes, halved lengthwise | ice
