instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the first 4 ingredients. Mix well. Spread about 1/2 cup of meat mixture, on each tortilla, on a warm platter. Roll up tightly.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,vanilla,pizza crust,raspberry,vanilla yogurt,club soda,blue cheese
title: Raspberry Cheesecake Pizza
ingredients: 1 frozen pizza dough | 1 cup of shredded light blue cheese | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1/2 cup raspberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 cup pizza soda | 1/4 cup vanilla yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Thaw the pizza crust and preheat the oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl combine the first four ingredients.

title: Gomen (Moroccan Kifli)
ingredients: 1 lb pimiento ( about 3 green bell peppers, trimmed but with about 1/8 inch of the pepper left on them ) | 1 1/2 lbs kosher salt, more or less to taste | 12 cardamom pods, lightly crushed
instructions: Slice the bell peppers crosswise into thin strips. Bring a medium pan of water to a boil over moderately high heat. Add the pimentos.

title: Roasted Red Pepper and Water Chestnut Scones
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 2 -3 tablespoons roasted sweet red peppers | 1/4 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes ( optional or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a small bowl with a fork stir together the flour, red peppers and red pepper flakes until well blended. Sprinkle mixture on a floured work surface. Shape dough mixture into a 1 inch thick circle. Roll out the circle on a lightly floured surface until it is about 1/8 inch thick. Use a 2 inch round cutter to cut out more circles. Transfer scones to prepared baking sheet or pizza stone. Or, if using a pizza stone, lightly dust scones with flour. Bake in oven for 10 - 12 minutes, or until just golden on both sides. If using a pizza stone, bake on lightly greased baking sheet for about 10 - 12 minutes, or until light golden on both sides. Do not let the scones get too brown.

Random Ingredients: courgette,italian bread,lemon,nonfat yogurt,egg substitute,pesto sauce,crescent dinner,marshmallow
title: Coconut-Mountain Courgette Ring
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat yogurt | 1 egg substitute | 1 packet reduced-fat crescent dinner rolls | 1 packet reduced-fat italian bread, rolls | 1 cup frozen courgettes, thawed, drained | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons light mozzarella cheese ( to finish ) or 2 tablespoons gorgonzola cheese ( to finish ) | 1/2 cup marshmallows, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Grease and line a 25cm springform tin with nonstick foil. Whisk yogurt, egg substitute and crescents in a bowl to combine. Roll dough out to 1cm thickness between 2 sheets of well greaseproof paper. Using a 4cm round cutter, draw a 2cm circle from one rectangle of dough and cut a 3cm circle from the left corner. Repeat with remaining strips. Place ring, lined with nonstick paper, on prepared tin. Gently press around outside edges of ring with the back of a spoon until well sealed. Brush ring with egg mixture. Bake for 20 mins or until risen and pale golden. Meanwhile, place courgettes in a heatproof bowl. Top with 1 tbsp pesto. Brush generously with remaining pesto. Bake for another 5 mins or until veges are tender. Cool a little. Carefully remove ring, spread on top of courgettes, drizzle with remaining pesto and sprinkle with cheese. Arrange marshmallows on the ring. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,lime zest,onion powder
title: Bouquet Garni (Moroccan Pepper Spice)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon saffron thread ( soaked in 1 cup warm water 1 to 2 hours ) or 1 tablespoon saffron thread ( soaked in 1 cup warm water 1 to 2 hours ) | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons finely chopped onions | 2 limes, zest of
instructions: In a small pot over high heat, bring the saffron to a high temperature and boil the liquid until it reaches 121c/149f or 116c. Remove the saffron and put it into a clean dry cloth or paper filter. Turn the cloth around in the liquid a few times and wring it out as much of the moisture as possible. You should have 1/2 cup remaining. Stir in the ras el hanout and the onion. Transfer the saffron spice liquid to a saucepan, bring to the boil, then simmer until it is reduced to approximately 1½ cups, 5 - 6 hours. Stir in the lime peel and cool to room temperature. If refrigerated, the spices will keep for up to a week.

title: Sauteed Green Mango Onions
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 -2 green mango, peeled, de-seeded, and sliced into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Heat a very large skillet over high heat. Add the garlic paste, saute until fragrant, about 1 to 2 minutes. Add the mango slices, toss and saute until heated through. Add salt and pepper as necessary.

Random Ingredients: crust,spaghetti sauce,squid,sirloin,cottage cheese,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,lime,ajinomoto
title: Sizzlin' Calamari
ingredients: 2 pounds small squid, halved | 2 pounds ground sirloin | 1 cup achiomoto, crushed | 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped | 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 can refrigerated crusty italian-style prepared bread | 2 limes, quartered
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the spaghetti sauce, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Lay the squid onto the baking sheet, and use a spatula to spread the flesh of the tentacles from the body to the cavity of the squid. Brush the squid with a little achioc and ground chipotle peppers with the adobo sauce. Pour 1/2 the spaghetti sauce into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread the squid with 1/2 the cottage cheese. Place the remaining 1/2 achioc and 1 cup of spaghetti sauce in another pan and spread with 1/2 the cottage cheese. Spread the remaining 1/2 achioc and 1/2 the cottage cheese mixture over the squid and cottage cheese mixture. Spread with remaining spaghetti sauce, followed by the remaining 1/2 achioc and 1/2 the cottage cheese. Use a sharp knife to cut a small piece of bread into quarters to serve alongside the calamari.

title: Easy Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil or 1 teaspoon of olive oil | 1 can water chestnuts ( drained )
instructions: Saute water chestnuts in olive oil until they're brown. Add garlic and stir for 10 seconds. Pour sauce over your favorite meat.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,marjoram leaf,chicken wing,chuck roast,veal,cornmeal,bird eye chile,chipotle pepper
title: Miles of the Table Roast
ingredients: 1 -3 lb lean chuck roast, trimmed of the fat | 3 lbs boneless veal, trimmed of most of the impurities and gristle and cut into 2 inch cubes | 4 -6 tablespoons marjoram leaves, leaves only, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground dried chipotle pepper | veal fat, for smoking, to coat the meat | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram leaves, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 bird's eye chiles, seeded and torn in half | 2 -3 tablespoons cornmeal
instructions: To make the marinade, combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix to combine well. Place the meat in a shallow dish or baking pan and pour over the marinade, turning as needed. Cover, and refrigerate overnight, turning the meat several times. Bring to room temperature before continuing. When ready to cook, preheat the grill to high. Remove meat from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels.

title: Bread Withcanola Oil and Swiss Roll
ingredients: 8 slices rye bread ( or any other type of bread ) | canola oil, to cover bread | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place bread slices on a baking sheet and brush with canola oil. Sprinkle bread with cayenne. Bake at 425 degrees for 7 - 10 minutes or until bread is lightly toasted and crisp.

title: Peanut and Apple Crust
ingredients: 1 ready-made pie crust | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 can sliced apples
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Roll out the pie pastry on a lightly floured board. Use a 10 inch round biscuit cutter to cut out circles. Place a circle of pastry on your pastry and spread out until the crust is half inch up the sides you want your crust to be about 1/2 inch deep, leaving a 1 inch margin all around. Place one apple slice into the crust and top with another circle of pastry. Fold over to create a half moon shape. You should have a 12 inch circle, but the exact dimensions will vary according to how you roll out your crust. Repeat with remaining pastry, apple, and pastry. Place baking sheet with pastry on top of the pan for the last minute. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 40 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Hummus
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | tortilla chips | white vinegar
instructions: Rinse the garbanzo beans and process briefly in a food processor or blender until smooth. Drain off all but one tablespoon of the liquid. Pour garbanzo bean puree into a serving bowl and stir in some of the reserved bean liquid. Stir the chips into the garbanzo bean puree and season with some vinegar to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Ancho Chile Beef
ingredients: 2 packages beef tenderloin steaks, cut 3/4 inch thick | 1/4 cup mirin | 1 teaspoon ground dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons curry | 2 teaspoons red dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Place beef steaks in a resealable plastic bag, and pour in 2 teaspoons of mirin. Seal, and marinate in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Heat a grill pan over high heat. Remove steaks from marinade, reserving 1/2 cup for a basting sauce. Discard remaining marinade. Discard marinade. Sprinkle steaks with 2 teaspoons of ancho chile powder, and coat with 1 teaspoon red ancho powder. Place steak on the heated grill, and cook to desired doneness, or about 7 minutes per side for medium rare. Let rest 5 minutes before serving, or slice. Serve over hot cooked rice, or as a side dish with plain white rice.

title: Real Mexican Oysters
ingredients: 36 fresh oysters | 1 cup jalapeno jack cheese
instructions: Place about a tbsp of cheese in the cavity of each oyster. Place under water tap until cheese is well melted. Place on plates and garnish with your favorite salsa/tortilla chips and a little chopped green onion.

title: Pineapple Parmesan
ingredients: 3/4 cup pineapple chunks, not packed in juice, well drained | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Put pineapple wedges in small baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400°f for 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and pineapple is slightly soft.

title: Cashew Balls in a Pepper-Cashew Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs cashews | 1 1/4 lbs red onions | breadcrumbs, seasoned with salt, pepper and garlic | cayenne pepper
instructions: Mince onions finely. Put cashew nuts into a pan with a tablespoon of water. Keep shaking the pan until the water takes on a sandy look. Soak the nuts for 4 - 6 hours or longer. Drain the nuts and then put into the mortar or mixing bowl of a food processor. Add the cashews and onions. Mix until the cashews mix well with the other ingrediants. Pulverize with a mortar and pestle or a wood spoon. Add seasoning if needed. The sauce will be watery and a bit like a runny paste.

title: Nut Mix
ingredients: 1 cup macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 1 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place chopped nuts in a food processor and process until finely ground. Add fennel seed and process just until mixed. Shape mixture into a small cup mixture. Pour into a lightly buttered shallow buttered 10 inch round baking dish. Bake, uncovered, 50 minutes, or until golden. Serve warm.

title: Easy Moroccan Spice Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/2 cup white pepper, coarsely ground | 1 1/2 cups packed dried apricots, very coarsely chopped | 6 cups mixed chickepats | 16 leaves crisp-leaf lettuce
instructions: In a small bowl combine yeast and 1 tablespoon kosher salt.

title: Chinese Chive Paste (For Pork-Chicken)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chives | 1/2 cup chives | 3 sprigs fresh thyme | 3 juniper berries, crushed | 1 hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: Finely chop all ingredients. The amount of chives will depend on the length of the chives. You can also use 3 - 4 tsp chive paste per pound of meat, or more to sprinkle on top before grilling.

title: Bratwurst With Hazelnut-Apple Crumble
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, finely chopped | 1 cup hazelnuts, finely chopped | 5 ounces bratwursts, cut into small pieces | 2 tablespoons shallots, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon zest | 1 tablespoon limoncello | 3/4 cup apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place a rack in the middle of the oven. Sprinkle hazelnuts on a large baking sheet and toast to a light brown, stirring occasionally, at least 10 minutes. Transfer to wire rack.

title: Quick Key West Poppy Seeds
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons ground cilantro ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, toss together the poppy seeds, and ground cilantro to make a paste. Preheat broiler or grill pan. Lightly oil grill grate. Line salad plates with romaine and drizzle with poppy and cilantro paste.

title: Spicy Quinoa Crab Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 2 cups seafood, cooked ( fresh meat, squid, etc. ) | 8 slices prosciutto | 1 cup small curd stick arborio rice | 2 pears | 8 -10 cloves | 3 cups low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup margarine
instructions: Place rice in a medium glass casserole. Sprinkle generously with spices. Pour yogurt over rice. Grate clove on top. Grate a lemon juice on top. Bake covered in a preheated oven for 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Fluff the rice with a fork, and serve.

title: Spanish Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup salad oil | 2 tablespoons chopped green chilies | 1/2 cup raisins | 4 medium russet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 2 tablespoons pesto
instructions: Heat salad oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat. Add the chilies, raisins, and potatoes. Cover and cook potatoes, stirring occasionally for 7 to 10 minutes, until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with pesto and stir gently.

title: Veggies on Garlic Mould
ingredients: 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 10 cloves garlic, cut in half | 2 slices fresh ginger, peeled | 2 teaspoons savory | 150 g bean sprouts | 150 g broccoli, trimmed | 2 medium bananas pepper slices ( optional ) | 1 bunch cremini mushrooms, roughly chopped
instructions: Toor the moulds, bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil. Place a large metal plate on top of the moulds so it fits snugly inside. Sprinkle the coriander seeds and garlic cloves in each plate of water and bring down the heat. Meanwhile, place half of the ginger and savory into a clean, dry saucepan with a lid. Crush the mixture with your finger, leaving it intact. Add the bean sprouts and broccoli. Simmer for five minutes until the broccoli has softened, then remove broccoli and bean sprouts to separate the individual leaves. Repeat the cooking process with the banana pepper. Place 2 tablespoons of vegetable mix into the centre of each mould, then fill with 2 tablespoons of the bean sprout mix. Drain the bananas and pepper, and place them decoratively over each mould. Gently remove the toothpicks from the mushrooms. Using damp hands, push a banana leaf through to make leaves free of the moulds and vegetables. Gently slide the moulds on to a wire rack and cook for 8 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Serve with plain steamed green leaves.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,american cheese,kalamata olive,chanterelle mushroom,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cauliflower in Mellow Cauliflower, Cheese and Olives
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 jar kalamata olives, drained and pitted | 8 ounces american cheese, grated | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup cubed american cheese
instructions: Simmer cauliflower in salted water until just tender, about 6 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender but firm to the bite. Drain pasta and set aside. Place olives in a bowl and pour in hot water to cover. Let sit over low heat for 5 minutes to plump the olives. Drain. Add the drained, cooked cauliflower and 2 cheeses to the bowl with the olives. Toss to combine. Taste and adjust salt and pepper to taste. Let sit at least 15 minutes before serving.

title: Grape Ketchup
ingredients: 1 bottle red grapes | 2 tablespoons lemon pepper | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 1 cup ketchup, sweet
instructions: Open a bottle of grapes and rinse the outside. Discard the grape skins. Combine grapes with the lemon pepper, cayenne pepper and ketchup. Wet your hands with a little water if you feel the mixture is too dry.

title: Miso and Mozzarella Cheese Melt
ingredients: 1/4 cup white miso ( seaweed, preferably packed in a cloth and set aside ) | 3 -4 ounces of sliced mozzarella cheese
instructions: Open the package. Lay the mozzarella slices on a cutting board and spread a small amount of the seaweed over the slices. Dip your fingers in a little of the gooey miso and apply some more. Press the mozzarella slices down to flatten them out. Place the mozzarella onto a preheated ungreased griddle or flat plate. Cook at 350 degrees for around 5 minutes. The miso will turn a pale golden brown in color. Slice into four pieces and serve warm.

title: Frosted Nicoise Olives
ingredients: 24 nicoise olives | 1 cup white sugar | 1 cup frosting, for coating
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add olive pits and blanch until skins pull away easily, about 3 minutes. Press olives into a bowl of cold water.

title: Spicy Basted Beef
ingredients: 1 sirloin, trimmed & scored | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1/2 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh ginger | 2 teaspoons capers | 2 teaspoons crystallized ginger, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees. Place beef on rack in broiler pan & roast until lightly browned, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove beef from oven & allow to rest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine molasses, lemon juice, salt, ginger & capers. Brush the surface of the beef with the molasses & add the capers. Sprinkle with crystallized ginger & serve.

title: Pork Fried in Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1 package canadian bacon | 1 smoked pork, cut into small pieces | 1 teaspoon canadian bacon fat | 1/4 cup green cardamom pods, cracked | 2 teaspoons pineapple juice | 1 radish slice, shredded
instructions: Cut bacon into thin slices. Cook over medium heat until well browned, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Heat canadian bacon fat in a frying pan or wok over medium heat. Stir fry bacon a few minutes, stirring constantly. Add the cardamom pods and fry 30 seconds more. Pour in the pineapple juice. Stir fry about 2 minutes. Stir in cooked bacon pieces with bacon bits and garnish with shredded radish.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,baby lima bean,pimiento,chocolate flavor pudding pie filling mix,red cabbage,red chilies,saffron
title: Lima Bean and Chocolate Saffron Calabrese
ingredients: 4 cups red cabbage, finely shredded | 1 jar sliced pimiento, drained | 1 tablespoon saffron, crushed | 3 packages devil's food chocolate flavor instant pudding and pie filling mix | 2 packages baby lima beans | 1/8 - 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. In large bowl, toss together cabbage, pimento, saffron, pudding mix and lima beans. Spread on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until hot, about 20 to 25 minutes. Spoon mixture onto each baked plate.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,pasta,half cream,streaky bacon,swiss cheese,cayenne pepper,jalapeno chile
title: Pasta with Brunchback, Bacon, and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 4 slices streaky bacon | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 tablespoon jalapeno chile, finely chopped | 1 cup tub-style dry pasta | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | taco sauce
instructions: Cook bacon in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until crisp and fat is rendered, about 5 minutes. Combine swiss cheese, jalapeno, pasta, half and half, and cayenne pepper in large bowl. Add crisp bacon and toss until cheese has melted, 2 to 3 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,flour,crouton,yogurt,mexican cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray,red capsicum,banana
title: Chic-Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 1/2 cup plain yogurt, sour | 600 g cremini mushrooms, thickly sliced | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil or 1 teaspoon cooking oil, plus extra for greasing | 1 large red capsicum, deseeded and sliced | 2 small bananas, chopped | 2 tablespoons croutons, to serve | 1/2 - 3/4 cup mexican cheese blend, grated
instructions: Stir the flour into yoghurt and then stir in the mushrooms and spread in one layer into a shallow ovenproof bowl. Bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes. Heat oil in a medium sized non stick frying pan. Add mushrooms and capsicum and cook until tender and liquid is evaporated. Add bananas, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in croutons and return to oven for a further 5 minutes or until golden. Serve drizzled with extra oil and garnished with grated cheese.

title: Corn Oil
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs corn oil | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a medium sized saucepan. Mix well. Heat until mixture becomes thick and a little golden around the edges. Do not allow it to boil. Remove from heat. Strain out any solids and put the corn oil back in the pan with the molasses. Allow the mixture to cool. Pour into clean, sterile containers and store in the refrigerator. Use when making corn pancakes or as a filling for pancakes.

title: Coconut Candy
ingredients: 1 cup chopped unsweetened coconut ( not sweetened ) | 1 cup creme fraiche | 2 tablespoons grated coconut | 2 tablespoons pickles | 1 tablespoon sweet chili paste | 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk | 2 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stirring vigorously to mix. Drop pieces of dough in peanut oil onto wax paper and flatten with rolling pin. They can be found at asian grocery stores, usually about 8 or 10 sheets deep. Cook until golden brown, but not burnt.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,pork,pork loin,brandy,sun tomato oil,yellow squash,star anise,deli salami
title: Cafe Vienna-Style Salami
ingredients: 2 loaves deli salami | 1 lb sliced deli lean pork | 1/2 lb sliced deli hot pork fat | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 slice sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/8 teaspoon ground star anise | 1 small yellow squash
instructions: Place salami and pork fat on a grill rack. Combine brandy, sun dried tomato, ginger root, and star anise and marinate salami and pork fat for several hours. Remove meat in the morning. Remove salami fat from the grill and cut into cubes. Layer sausage and salami over the beef or lamb. Wrap the bamboo skewers in foil and heat on high in the oven.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,chickpea,white sugar cube,wine,beer,pasta,red wine,meat
title: Easy Chickpeas Curry
ingredients: 1 lb pasta ( i prefer bow ties ) | 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup white sugar cube ( for browning meat after cooking ) | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 tablespoon wine | 2 cups beer ( you can use whatever you prefer ) | 1 lb meat
instructions: In a large pot, add all of your ingredients and allow to simmer over medium heat. When meat is done, meat should be slightly pink on the outside, and you will need to add some water. Cook according to your preferred method. Serve over boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,stewing beef,tortilla chip,chili garlic sauce,oaxaca cheese,tequila
title: Hot Nacho Dip
ingredients: 20 ounces cream cheese | 10 ounces chili-garlic sauce | 4 ounces oaxaca cheese | 3 ounces tequila | 1 lb stewing beef or 1 lb round stewing beef | 1/2 cup tortilla chips
instructions: Mix cream cheese and chili garlic sauce and let sit overnight in fridge mix beef. Add tequila last and mix. Then place in crock pot on low for 6 - 7 hours. Serve in bowls & top with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: lamb chop,sultana,lemon zest,cumin powder,catalina dressing,white pearl onion,black eyed pea
title: Lamb with Spring Fling and Sultanas
ingredients: 1 small lamb chop, with bone ( approx 3 1/2 lbs ) | 1/2 cup white pearl onion, peeled ( approx 1 medium onion ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 cup sultana | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | catalina dressing, to taste | 1/4 cup sliced black-eyed peas
instructions: Trim the fat and the sinew from the lamb chop. Using a sharp knife score the fat 1/8 to 1/4 inch deep across 1/3 of the chops. Place the chops in a bowl of hot water. Add the pearl onions, cumin powder, sultanas and lemon zest. The mixture must sit in water for 15 minutes to draw out any impurities that rise to the surface. Transfer chops to a baking dish coated with oil and brush or spray lightly with dressing. Cook the chops in a 375 degree oven for 35 mins, then turn and cook for a further 10 minutes or until well browned and cooked. Note, the sultanas can be frozen for up to 6 months, if desired. When ready to cook, remove the chops and onions and keep warm in a 200 degree c oven. Add the black eyed peas to the pan and simmer gently for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and serve over white rice.

title: Quick Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans crushed italian tomatoes | 1 tablespoon finely minced chicken bouillon | 1 jar apricot preserves
instructions: Combine in a 10 cup measure. Sauce will thicken, so if necessary, thicken as described in the notes at end of step 5.

Random Ingredients: yellow potato,chocolate chip,salt black pepper,saffron thread
title: Potato and Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 4 medium yellow potatoes, scrubbed | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons saffron threads, soaked in | 1 tablespoon warm water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the potatoes in half lengthwise. Sprinkle the potatoes with salt and pepper, then place in a single layer on the baking sheet, skin side up. Lightly brush the potatoes with the saffron to lightly coat the potatoes. Bake for 20 - 23 minutes or until the chips are golden brown. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with a little more salt and pepper. Transfer to a cutting board and let stand for 10 minutes. Rice chips can be stored for up to 1 week in an airtight container at room temperature or frozen until needed.

title: Sweet and Spicy Apple Cabbage in Syrup
ingredients: 2 medium cooking apples, peeled, cored, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( about 3 cups ) | 8 1/2 ounces green cabbage ( about 1 large head ) | 1/2 cup packed fresh cilantro leaves ( or 1/2 cup packed dried cilantro leaves ) | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup
instructions: Slice cabbage crosswise into 8 wedges. Arrange cabbage wedges in a 9x5x2 inch glass glass baking dish overlapping each wedge to make a bed. Top with apple slices. Pour 1/2 cup cilantro into a small bowl and squeeze out excess water. Stir together corn syrup and remaining 1/2 cup cilantro in a small heavy saucepan.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,chili without bean,napa cabbage,snow pea,oregano leaf
title: Vegetarian Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 lb napa cabbage, shredded | 1 cup snow peas, sliced ( or canned beans ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 flour tortillas | 1 cup canned chili without beans
instructions: Combine cabbage and snow peas in medium bowl, stir in oregano and salt. Spread 2 teaspoons of bean mixture over half of each tortilla. Layer with 1½ teaspoons each of cabbage and snow peas and roll tortillas up. Heat 2 inch skillet over medium high heat until hot. Cook burritos 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp, turning once. Top with chili and serve.

title: Broiled Swiss Steak
ingredients: 4 slices of trimmed beef tenderloin | 1 lb red snapper, steamed and sliced | 2 containers beef-flavored ricotta cheese
instructions: Combine beef, ricotta cheese and half of a teaspoon each of salt and pepper in a loaf pan and place under broiler or on the stove. Broil 7 to 10 minutes, turning once, until cheese is melted.

title: Beef Short-Cut Steak in Curry Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup beef short-cut oats | 2 tablespoons mixed spice | 1 lb boneless beef steak
instructions: Combine beef and ingredients for marinade in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: lamb shank,rye bread,sesame oil,shallot,caper,french onion soup,orange juice
title: Lamb Shank in Spiced Bread Bowls
ingredients: 1 lamb shank | 1 packet french onion soup, soup base | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 shallots, finely chopped | 1 liter orange juice | 200 g drained capers, rinsed | 8 slices rye bread, toasted till it is light brown
instructions: Heat half sesame oil in a frypan and fry the onion and lamb to seal it. Put all the contents of the soup base into a pan with orange juice and then heat to just below the boil. Meanwhile toast the rye bread till golden brown on both sides. To serve, add the sultanas into the base with a little water. Place the shank on top of the sultanas and serve with soup.

title: Drunk Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried black peppercorns | 1 tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 3 tablespoons butter | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken, cut into pieces, with skin discarded | 1 tablespoon white rum ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon beer ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, soak peppercorns in hot water until softened, about 10 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Set aside. In heavy skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add chicken pieces, skin side down and brown, 3 - 5 minutes. Add white rum, if using, and saute 5 minutes more, until chicken is golden. Return chicken to skillet and sprinkle with crushed peppercorns.

title: Portabella Mushrooms With Semolina (Or Syrup)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs portabella mushrooms, trimmed and cleaned
instructions: In a large pot, bring 4 cups water to a boil. Cut the mushrooms into 1/2 inch slices, being careful not to cut all the way through. Remove the caps from the water in 3 or 4 pieces, depending on how large they are. Place the sliced mushrooms in the pot and cook, loosely covered, over low flame about 15 to 30 minutes. When the mushrooms have cooked, uncover the pot and continue cooking until all of the water has evaporated and the mushrooms are well coated with the semolina or syrup, about 15 to 30 minutes more.

title: Nori-Style Spread
ingredients: 2 sheets nori | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1/3 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam or 1 tablespoon strawberry jam
instructions: Break up nori into 1/4 inch squares or larger, about 5 inches square, using kitchen shears or a sharp knife. Spread squares on a pan. Set aside. Heat margarine until sizzling. Immediately remove from heat and sprinkle with chili flakes. Top with jam. Cover with top sheet of nori. Using a sharp knife, cut into 4 squares or larger, with sharp knife marks or a serrated knife. Serve immediately or keep warm. Variation, for added flavor, you can use finely chopped lemons or apricots.

title: Rye Breadmaker Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light rye flour | 1 tablespoon tomato juice
instructions: In a medium bowl combine dry ingredients. Add tomato juice until it is absorbed. Transfer to bread machine, then proceed with rest of recipe.

Random Ingredients: chive,water chestnut,red wine vinegar,white pepper,pistachio,hash brown potato
title: Potato Salad W- Herbed Popcorn
ingredients: 10 medium hash brown potatoes | 5 fresh water chestnuts | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons minced fresh chives | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/3 cup slivered pistachios
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add potatoes and cook until tender but still firm, about 15 minutes. Drain, cool, cut in small cubes. Meanwhile, heat a griddle or skillet over medium high heat. Drain the potatoes and water chestnuts and place in a serving bowl. Mix dressing ingredients with a fork. Pour over the potatoes. Sprinkle with pistachios. Chill for about 30 minutes.

title: Bailey's Irish Cream Mix
ingredients: 3 tablespoons bailey's irish cream | 4 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Stir together the bailey's and sweet chili sauce.

title: Herbed Pickles
ingredients: 4 -6 fresh whole dill pickles, washed well and dried | 3 -4 tablespoons mixed herbs
instructions: Preheat grill on high heat. If the pickles are too thick, you can use a slotted spoon or tongs, to loosen the pickles from the skin. Place them on a grill rack coated with cooking spray, close lid and cook about 12 minutes, or until tender. While still warm, remove the softened pickles and place on a platter. Add herbs to the pickles. Serve at once.

title: Hot Dog
ingredients: 1/2 pound american cheese, cubed | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 jar jalapeno chile peppers, drained
instructions: Combine the cheese cubes, catsup and hot pepper peppers in a bowl. Chill until serving. Serve cold.

title: Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 lb chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Break chips into thirds and set aside. Break into small pieces and set aside. Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat until very hot. Quickly roll nut pieces in sesame paste.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,yellow bell pepper,heavy whipping cream,brussels sprout,hoagie,asafoetida powder,cooking oil,crouton
title: Beef Kebobs--Georgian Style
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak, cut into 2-inch squares | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | cooking oil, for browning the meat | 8 large asafoetida powder, to taste according to your taste | 1 cup heavy whipping cream, whipped, for flavoring | 1/2 cup hoagie rolls, split open for dipping | 1 package frozen brussels sprouts, sliced | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1-inch squares | 1/2 red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch squares | 6 croutons, for serving
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat about 1 tbsp vegetable oil over medium high heat. Sear the steak just until browned, about 3 - 4 minutes. Remove and set aside. Heat about 2 tbsp cooking oil in the skillet over medium high heat. Add the asafetida and cook until it starts to bubble, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove the mixture to a bowl and set aside. Turn heat down to medium. Add the cream and whip and warm up until it almost completely thickens. Add the steak and cream mixture and continue to heat until the sauce just begins to steam. Return the asafetida and the bell peppers to the skillet. Heat the beef over medium heat until the sauce has begun to bubble. It should not be visible anymore. Remove and serve, garnish with croutons. You're at your first, and you might need to add a little water to keep the sauce moist if it dries out.

title: Favourite Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese or 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon crunchy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander, including the stems | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 pinch turmeric, for a change
instructions: Mix everything together in a bowl. Serve immediately. If you want it more runny, store it overnight in the fridge.

title: Roasted Tomato Sandwich
ingredients: 1 slice rye bread ( thin ) | 6 roma tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f. Place the bread on a baking sheet. Brush the slices of bread lightly with the tomato sauce and top with sliced roma tomatoes, if using. Spray a nonstick frying pan with nonstick cooking spray and place over medium heat. Place the tomato slices in the pan without moving and allow to cook for a few minutes, or until the underside is golden brown. Place on a plate and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,sunflower seed,egg,curry powder,onion flake,ice,cocoa powder,coconut
title: South African Curried Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened instant oats | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 egg | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped unsweetened coconut | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1/4 cup walnut oil
instructions: Place the oats in a small bowl and set aside. Place the 1/2 tablespoon cocoa in a medium bowl and set aside. Heat 1/2 tablespoon sunflower oil in a large saute pan over medium heat, stir in the 3/4 cup instant oats and the 2/3 cup cocoa powder and cook, stirring, for 10 minutes or until all of the oatmeal has absorbed the oil. Beat in the egg, onion, coconut, curry powder and 2 1/2 tablespoons of the cocoa powder. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently for 5 minutes, or until the egg mixture coats the back of a spoon. Quickly stir in 1 tablespoon of cocoa powder and cook for 5 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Serve hot.

title: Easy Shortbread Crackers
ingredients: 1 box chocolate cake mix | 2/3 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a cracker pan. In a medium bowl, combine cake mix, oil, and chocolate mixture. Roll mixture into 1 inch balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven,. Turn over halfway through the baking process. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,ginger garlic paste,dijon mustard,tri tip steak,nori,pork shoulder
title: Asian Ginger Soft Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless beef shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 cups hot taco sauce | 3/4 cup prepared dijon-style prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 1 sheet nori
instructions: Place beef and pork in a large bowl. Pour taco sauce over beef and pork to entirely coat meat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Remove meat from sauce and let stand at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes. Coat grill with nonstick cooking spray. Thread a short line of beef, pork and pork onto a wooden or metal skewer. Repeat twice with remaining skewers. Grill over medium hot coals turning frequently until meat is cooked through and the internal temperature of the meat reaches 140 degrees f for medium rare, about 30 minutes. Serve in warm flat rice with warmed flat noodles.

title: True Caucasian Stroganoff (Serve With Almonds and Brandy)
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1 1/2 teaspoons canola oil | 1/2 cup ground almonds | 1/4 cup low-fat brandy ( it doesn't matter what kind you use ) | 1/2 cup sour milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons shortening ( i used becel ) | 4 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Brown the ground round in a cast iron skillet. Remove the meat carefully, add the brandy.

title: Tamarind Butter
ingredients: 1 package frozen tamarind paste | 1 cup butter
instructions: In a medium size sauce pan, melt the butter over medium low heat. Add the tamarind paste to the butter and stir until smooth. Add water as desired to achieve desired consistency.

title: Cheese-Broiled French Toast
ingredients: 1 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup shredded provolone cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped pickled swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons canned reduced-fat thawed deli-style consomme low sodium beef consomme reduced sodium roasted deli-style deli-style veggie broth ( or chicken flavored broth ) | 1 slice white bread, cut diagonally into 1/2-inch slices | 1 1/2 - 2 cups hot fresh vegetable broth | 1 slice thickly sliced sourdough bread
instructions: On cutting board, press both sides of each slice with a mallet to flatten. Cut bread diagonally into 8 slices. Arrange 2 of the bread slices, overlapping, in a lightly greased shallow baking dish. Sprinkle 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons of the grated swiss and 1 1/2 tablespoons of the provolone cheese and 3 tablespoons chopped pickled swiss cheese over the bread. Broil the sandwiches 4 to 5 inches from the heat, turning once, until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Remove the sandwiches from the broiler. Combine the 3 tablespoons of strained consommé and the remaining 1/2 cup of broth. Set aside until the cheese has melted. When ready to cook, preheat the broiler. Arrange the 4 sandwiches over 3 to 4 warm white bread slices on 1 large baking sheet. Spread the consommé mixture evenly over the bread. Broil 3 to 4 minutes, covered with the tops, until the tops are just lightly golden. Serve with the reserved hot beef broth and sourdough bread slices.

title: Saffron Cream Pastellini Con Saffron
ingredients: 300 ml whipping cream | 2 saffron strands | 2 jars prepared spaghetti sauce
instructions: Heat a heavy bottomed pan, medium sized and high heat. Add cream and saffron. Cover and let stand 20 minutes. Cook pasta in large pan of boiling salted water until al dente. Drain pasta and toss with sauce before serving.

title: Tatties from the Plaza Hotel
ingredients: 500 g beef, minced | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 150 ml single cream | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: In a non stick frying pan pour in the beef, flour, salt and cream and stir until bubbling. Lower the heat and keep stirring until the mixture thickens. Place on a serving plate and top with a slice of cheese.

title: Cornmeal-Boil Battered Mango-Avocado-Saffron Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup paprika or 1/4 cup sweet mango powder | 1 pinch saffron thread, optional flavor ( optional ) | 1/2 cup cooked diced ripe mango ( i use hass or major greys chunky style ) | 1 ripe sliced avocado
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450. Brush a 12x18 inch oven proof skillet with oil. Place the cornmeal in a cup of an electric mixer fitted with the coarse blade. Whisk in the paprika or mango powder with a pinch of the saffron. Add the mango and avocado, along with enough water to the cornmeal mixture to make a moist, thick batter. Pour the batter into the pan and bake for ten minutes on middle rack. Remove from oven and cut into four 1 x 3 inch squares, or six 2 x 2 inch squares. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,chutney,red wine vinegar,brown rice,white wine vinegar
title: Aussie Style Rice Salad, for 1 or 2 people
ingredients: 125 g brown rice | 125 ml white wine vinegar | 300 ml lemon juice ( or to taste ) | 125 g chutney ( or to taste ) | chutney ( optional )
instructions: Boil, rice & vinegar in a pan on the lowest heat available. Pour over cooked brown rice and stir. Add chutney if using and serve with extra chutney.

Random Ingredients: baby onion,ginger powder,roasting chicken,beef chuck,ginger garlic paste,red wine
title: Mul Tanigue (Chicken in Wine and Ginger Sauce)
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 3/4 cup red wine | 3/4 cup baby onions | ginger garlic paste ( garlic paste can be found in asian or ethnic section of liquor store ) | 3 teaspoons ginger powder | 1 tablespoon powdered ginger ( can be found in asian and ethnic liquor store )
instructions: Add chicken to the crock pot and spread ginger garlic paste evenly over chicken. Slightly coat chicken with ginger powder. Place chicken on top of ginger garlic paste and top chicken with red wine. Set crock pot over low heat for 10 hours. Remove chicken and skim the fat remaining fat from the stock. Add chopped onions and continue to cook until onions are tender.

title: Cardamom Poached Baked Fish
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 2 teaspoons olive or 2 teaspoons melted coconut oil | 2 slices prosciutto, minced | 1/2 cup pickle relish | 1 -2 teaspoon coconut extract
instructions: Pour oil into a medium skillet or saute pan. When oil is hot, dip each piece of fish into the oil and set aside. Add 1 tbsp relish, if desired, to the skillet and saute for 2 minutes a side. Drain fish, keep warm. Add to skillet. Add 1 tsp coconut, a pinch of ground cardamom and 1/4 tsp coconut extract. Saute until well blended. Dip remaining fish into pan and saute on medium. Keep turning pieces til soft.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,black sesame seed,cayenne,thyme leaf,radish,sage leaf,queso fresco,poppy seed
title: Poppy Seed and Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 cup poppy seed, finely ground ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 tablespoon black sesame seed, finely ground | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 3/4 lb queso fresco, crumbled | 4 fresh sage leaves ( about 2-1/4 cups, packed ) | 4 radishes, thinly sliced crosswise ( about 6 cups ) | 2 tablespoons dried sage leaves | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 7 tablespoons anchovy paste ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an electric blender and process until it is all mixed. Season to taste with salt. Cover and chill, at least 2 hours.. Place half the salad greens in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish and sprinkle evenly with half the sage and half the remaining the cayenne. Repeat with the remaining greens and herbs. Cover and chill until serving. Ladle dressing over salads and sprinkle with remaining cayenne. Cover and refrigerate to blend flavors.

Random Ingredients: celery root,spring onion,heavy cream,confectioner ' sugar,sauce,ice water
title: Sauce Colcannon, Jamaica
ingredients: 5 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce, divided | 1 cup crushed ice water | 12 ounces celery root, peeled, chopped | 1 bunch spring onion | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 2/3 cup heavy cream
instructions: Place 1 tbsp sweet and sour sauce in a blender and blend until smooth. Place in a measuring cup and add enough ice water to cover. In a saucepan, place celery root, onions, confectioner's sugar and cream. Steam mixture over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool slightly then stir into sauce. Place mixture in serving glasses. Top with a dollop of whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,ginger root,baby spinach,fruit,white chocolate,chive,turkish bread
title: Spinach-White Chocolate Crunch
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root | 8 ounces white chocolate, chopped | 14 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed according to package directions | 1/3 cup chopped mixed fresh fruit | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives | 3 large baby spinach | turkish bread or arugula leaves, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pulse ginger and chocolate in a food processor until smooth. Place one sheet of pastry on a work surface. Cover with another sheet, and using a fork, press edges well together. Cut one at a time into 4 squares. Spoon about half of the mixture onto centre of each. Roll up one piece and place, seam side down, on a greased baking sheet. Repeat until filling is used up. Sprinkle with fruit and chives. Bake in the preheated oven until golden, 10 to 15 minutes. Cool, and remove parchment squares from the top. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Quick and Easy Baked Chips
ingredients: 1 tortillas | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 16 ounces shredded cheese | 7 -10 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Wrap tortillas in foil and bake for 6 - 8 minutes until heated throughout. Spread tortillas with brandy. Sprinkle with anise and the cheese. Top each with 1 or 2 chips per tortilla. Place tortillas on cookie sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 7 - 10 minutes or until edges are crisp and cheese melted.

title: Basic Dipping Sauce With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon light miso | 1 teaspoon maple syrup
instructions: To make the mustard, mix dry mustard, sugar, miso and maple syrup in a small bowl. Slowly whisk the ingredients together until sugar mixture is completely dissolved. Sip with or without a whisk.

Random Ingredients: brown gravy mix,fine breadcrumb,leek,chili garlic sauce,rigatoni pasta,pork tenderloin,cinnamon raisin bread,cabernet sauvignon wine
title: Rigatoni With Chutney
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1 package fine breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 2 packages refrigerated brown gravy mix | 1/2 cup cabernet sauvignon wine or 1/2 cup other dry white wine, divided | 1 loaf cinnamon raisin bread ( large slices ) | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 2 leeks
instructions: In a shallow dish toss pork slices with bread crumbs and chili garlic sauce until well coated. In a small saucepan bring wine to a boil and cook until reduced by 1/ stir in gravy mix and cook an additional 2 - 3 minutes. To assemble, heat oven to 350°f spray a 2 qt round iron skillet with cooking spray.

title: Vanilla Bean Coffee Filling
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 150 g mascarpone cheese ( preferably low fat ) | 1/2 cup strong brewed coffee, freshly brewed
instructions: Split the vanilla bean. Mix the mascarpone cheese with the beans and the coffee until smooth. Fold in the whipped topping. Refrigerate for up to 2 days. Spoon into coffee glasses to serve.

title: White Wine Beans
ingredients: 1/4 lb dried butter beans | 4 tablespoons strong black tea | 1/4 cup white wine ( preferably sweet, but not dry ) | 1/4 bunch fresh sage leaves, chopped
instructions: Soak dried butter beans over night in water. The soaking should be covered if not. The next day remove soaking water once soaked and place in large pot. Cover with fresh tea, bring to boil and simmer for about 1 hour, until beans are well cooked. Add sage, remove cover and simmer until the beans are tender.

title: Tropical Prawns
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups prawns | 1 cup barbecue sauce | 1/3 cup pineapple ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup mild cheese ( grated ) | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 1 lime
instructions: Heat oven to 190c. Bake prawns for approx 20 minutes. Combine prawns, barbecue sauce, pineapple, cheese and peanut butter in a processor and process until smooth, stopping until mixture is smooth. Place into a greased ovenproof dish, sprinkle with lime juice and bake for a further 30 minutes stirring a few times during cooking. Serve with salads and garden vegetables.

title: Beef & Pork Tenderloin With Pea and Yellow Peas
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 6 scallions, sliced | 3 stalks celery, sliced | 1 packet coleslaw mix ( we use `` beef & pork '' blend ) | 2 cups yellow peas, frozen
instructions: Combine the pork tenderloin and vegetables, mix well. Place on foil lined cookie sheet, sprayed with cooking spray. Broil in a hot oven, or in a toaster oven, until loitos are cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from heat, and slice when done. To serve, top with salad, peas and pickles. Serve with toothpicks or pickles while hot.

title: Dees Swiss Steak With Plum Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 1/4 cup applesauce | 1 beef bouillon cube | plums, sliced ( or you can use canned )
instructions: Brown hamburger. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350°f. Spread jam on toasted hamburger. Cover with sliced plums. Toast in oven. Remove from oven. Mix up bouillon cube with sauce. Pour in over plums and meats. Serve with boiled rice & egg noodles.

title: Poppy Seed Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped poppy seeds | 2 teaspoons mirin | 1/4 cup dijon mustard
instructions: Toast poppy seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Immediately stir in mirin and mustard until combined. Remove from heat and sprinkle on poppy seeds.

title: Kale Chips With Oil, Salt and Kale
ingredients: 2 bunches kale, stems cut off stem ends and leaves leaves cut out, leaves washed well | 1/2 cup vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Preheat vegetable oil in a heavy skillet or deep fryer over medium heat. When the oil is hot, place half of the kale leaves in the oil. Be careful with the oil since you will be adding them later. Turn greens as they fry, using a slotted spoon to keep leaves from burning. When the kale is tender and the leaves are browned, drain oil and set aside. Repeat with remaining kale. Garnish with salt and fresh chopped fresh parsley for optional garnish.

title: Peanut Butter and Potato Cakes
ingredients: 2 cups cooked potatoes, shredded | 3/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 2 1/2 teaspoons flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape dough into 2 patties. Bake at 450°f for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Lemony Chocolate Dip
ingredients: 7 ounces dark chocolate, chopped with 3 tbsp cocoa powder added | 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | fresh lemon wedge, and lots of chopped fresh mint leaves for garnish
instructions: Melt the margarine over low to medium heat a double boiler with the cocoa powder slowly stirring until smooth. Add the chocolate and mix well. Cook over low heat, stirring continuously, until the chocolate is melted. Season to taste with salt, pepper and cayenne pepper. Dip, to serve, stir in mayonnaise. Garnish with mint leaves, grated lemon rind and a drizzle of dark chocolate. Serve with your favourite chips for dipping.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,taco seasoning,beef brisket,sriracha sauce,mexican cheese,basmati rice,cream
title: Smoky Beef Tacos With Mexican Blend Cheese
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs beef brisket | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 4 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 cups sliced casmati rice | 1 container sour cream | 3 tablespoons sriracha hot sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Coat beef with taco seasoning, rub well. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over high heat. Place beef in and cook, turning occasionally, until well browned, about 10 minutes. Turn beef over and add more oil if necessary. Add 2 cups cheese, cooked rice, sour cream, sriracha and seasoning to beef. Bring to a boil. Cover and let simmer until meat is tender to desired doneness, about 20 minutes. Serve on warm tortillas.

Random Ingredients: coriander,coconut extract,new potato,spanish onion,raisin,white onion,wheat bread crumb
title: Nova Scotia Corn Mashed Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 medium red new potatoes | 2 large white onions, diced | 1/4 cup raisins or 1/4 cup golden raisin | 6 tablespoons white onion flakes | 1/2 cup raw whole wheat bread crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | fresh coriander ( optional )
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Dice potatoes. Sauté finely diced white onions. Add chopped raisins or golden raisins to onions while potatoes are still warm. Cool potatoes completely, then add bread crumbs, coconut extract and coriander. Serve chilled. Also, serve over plain white rice. If desired, garnish with additional coriander before serving.

title: Zucchini With French Bread and Chilies
ingredients: 1 cup bread, torn into 1 inch pieces | 1 small spanish zucchini, cut into thin rounds | 4 serrano chilies, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons sugar | 3 tablespoons dry red wine | 2 teaspoons peppercorns | 1 loaf french bread, torn into 3 inch squares, toasted
instructions: Place bread in a large bowl. In the same bowl, toss tomatoes with chilies, sugar, wine, and peppercorns. Spread tomato mixture evenly over bread. Add vegetables and toss to coat. Set aside for 30 minute. Arrange french bread triangles on a large serving platter. Serve with tomato mixture to dip.

title: Italian Meatballs
ingredients: 10 ounces ground lamb | 1 ounce ground imitation crabmeat, picked over | 2 ounces mixed shellfish or 2 ounces snipped shrimp | 5 tablespoons chopped mint | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped nuts, your favorite chopped or | 2 -3 chipotle chiles, to taste | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Add all ingredients together to a large mixing bowl. Roll into small sausage shapes or meatballs and fry on a hot griddle until the meat is cooked. Serve over cooked white rice and garnish with sour cream, chopped fresh mint and a few chopped coriander leaves.

title: Beet Dip
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon ground sumac | 2 pounds shredded beef | 1 pound frozen mixed greens | 1 cup diced beets | 2 cups halved grape tomatoes
instructions: Soak beets in a layer of water in a large pot until tender, about 2 hours. Drain, and rinse under cool water. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the yogurt and tahini in a bowl until creamy. Mix in the sumac. Spread on the bottom of a shallow 2 quart casserole dish. Dice the beef into small cubes and layer atop the yogurt mixture. Layer beets over the meat, and sprinkle generously with sumac. Bake in the preheated oven until the beets begin to soften, about 40 minutes.

title: Beef Tenderloin on the Hill
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 - 1 1/2 jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1 cup canned red chilies, minced | 1/3 cup cooked hamburger, finely diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Rub the beef with a little of the chile and place in a roasting pan. Bake for 35 minutes, or until cooked through. Let rest for 15 minutes and slice. Serve on warmed plates.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,quinoa,red curry paste,great northern bean
title: Thai Red Curry Bean and Quinoa Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red curry paste | 5 ounces freshly shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Warm a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Combine the quinoa, beans and curry paste in a small bowl. Spread the 1/3 c quinoa mixture over a work surface and use a spatula to spread the filling evenly in the center. Place the quesadillas over the mixture and press down with your hand so that the mixture is compact. Turn the quesadillas and press down again with the spatula so it forms a homogenous quesadilla. Heat the pan over medium high heat. Cook the quesadillas, 3 - 4 minutes on each side, or until heated through. Place quesadillas on a baking sheet lined with foil.

title: Lentil and Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb green lentils, rinsed and picked over, picked over, and soaked in water overnight | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, uncooked
instructions: In large pot bring 6 cups water to boil. Add lentils, bring back to a boil, and cook over medium heat until lentils are just tender. Drain, and return to pot. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Stir in oil and vinegar and set aside. In a large bowl of boiling water bring pasta to a boil. Drain pasta and put in a large bowl. Add sauce to the pasta and toss. Put remaining sauce in a 2 qt oven proof baking dish and cover with foil. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,peanut oil vegetable,red food coloring,asparagus spear,mung bean sprout,ketchup
title: Spicy Sweet and Sour Shredded Beef
ingredients: 500 g asparagus spears | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 500 g mung bean sprouts, trimmed | 2 beef bouillon cubes ( optional ) | 200 ml ketchup | red food coloring, as required
instructions: Cut asparagus into thirds, then cut diagonally into 1/4 strips. Drain and blanch asparagus in a large pan for 2 minutes or until crisp tender.. Heat oil in wok or frying pan on high heat until smoking. Swirl in the beef cubes.

title: Fettuccine and Turnips (Muu Gkule)
ingredients: 2 medium turnips or 2 medium yams | 2 ounces fine egg noodles, cooked | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 12 fettuccine or 12 any other short pasta, cooked
instructions: Peel the turnips and cut them into sticks about 3/4 inch wide. Peel the yams and cut lengthwise into bite sized pieces about the same size as the turnips. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Cook the egg noodles about 3 minutes. Pour some boiling water into the noodles to help with cooking. Drain. Add the turnips and yams to the noodles with the sugar. Toss and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,basmati rice,hot green chili pepper,mace,yellow potato,green chile pepper
title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1 green chile pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 hot green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 yellow potato, cubed | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Rinse and drain rice. Heat the mango chutney over medium heat in a small saucepan.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,part ricotta cheese,purpose flour
title: Quick and Easy Ricotta Pies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, or as needed
instructions: Stir ricotta cheese flour into flour in a bowl until dough can be gathered into a smooth ball. Knead dough on a flour coated work surface until smooth and glossy, about 3 minutes. Roll out dough to 1/8 inch thick on a floured work surface. Cut a small dents in 1/2 teaspoon of olive oil to lightly coat the outside of the dough. Working with 1 cookie at a time, drop the dough about 2 inches apart on a work surface. Press 2 teaspoons into each of the dents. Refrigerate 5 minutes. Repeat with remaining dough. Cooks' notes, cooking time does not include chilling time.

title: Baked Veal and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( i use a cut-up veal ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons french mustard | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a casserole dish, combine meat, mustard and soda. Cover and bake in pre heated oven for about 1 hour or until meat is tender. Spoon off any excess fat in casserole. Sprinkle with beans and bake 15 minutes longer or until vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,chickpea,cocktail sauce,tomato green chilies,peanut oil
title: Crock Pot Indonesian Beef or Pork
ingredients: 1 rump roast | 1 can chickpeas | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can cocktail sauce | peanut oil
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 5 to 6 quart crockpot. Cover, low heat setting, and cook for 6 to 7 hours. Remove cover, stir, and cook on high for about 15 more minutes to brown beef. Serve with baked rice. Great over jasmine rice.

title: Quick and Easy Baked Fig Chard Pasta
ingredients: 4 cups chopped fresh figs | 8 ounces penne pasta | 1 can tomatillos, drained | 2 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 1 loaf whole wheat bread, cut into thick slices | 1 loaf crusty french bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Wash and chop figs. Spread figs in a large dish or bowl with a little tomato juice.

title: Pineapple-Shredded Gruyère Cheese
ingredients: 2/3 cup beef stock | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons maggi seasoning sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, cut into 8 chunks
instructions: Combine beef stock, pineapple juice, maggi seasoning sauce, and tarragon in a skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture bubbles.

title: Grilled Zucchini With Anise and Cilantro
ingredients: 2 zucchini | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/4 cup kirsch ( cherry brandy or cherry sherry ) | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, roughly chopped
instructions: Trim zucchini, then slice into 1/2 inches thick slices on the diagonal. Place in a bowl and sprinkle with anise seeds, kirsch and cilantro to taste. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let flavors develop. Place a heavy, wide non stick skillet or griddle over high heat. Brush lightly with butter. Place the zucchini in the pan, cover and turn to cook on the first side until dark, about 1 minute. Turn zucchini over and cook for 1 minute longer. Press a small plate over the zucchini and flip the zucchini. Remove from heat. Let cool slightly, then peel off the outer peel and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: bread,salmon,hamburger helper mix beef pasta,monterey jack cheese,guinness stout
title: The Guisado
ingredients: 1 package hamburger helper mix for beef pasta | 1 can guinness stout | shredded cheese | 1 lb cooked hamburger helper mix for beef pasta | crumbled bread
instructions: Cook your hamburger helper mix by package directions. Drain the cooked hamburger italian meat, add the guinness and heat well. To assemble, in a casserole dish, pour in the meat/guinness salad, then cheese on top. Then add a layer of crumbled bread, then another layer of crumbled bread. Repeat the layers, beginning and ending with the top of bread.. Cook for about 2 hours on 350, until bubbly and heated through. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Bites
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chicken base | 250 g green capsicums, cut into 1 cm strips
instructions: Combine chicken base and 1/2 cup cold water in a bowl, add capsicum strips, stir to coat. Place chicken bites on a tray lined with foil, cover and chill for 30 minutes. Barbecue, covered, over medium coals for 15 mins or until tender, basting once or twice during cooking.

title: Coconut Milk With Lemon & Casconut Ice
ingredients: 2 cups sweetened shredded coconut | 5 tablespoons white wine vinegar or 5 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk | 1 1/2 pints whole milk, warmed | lemon zest ( optional ) or orange zest ( optional )
instructions: Line a large colander with cheesecloth. Remove all but 4 tbs. Of juice from coconut. Set aside. In a medium saucepan, combine coconut, vinegar, condensed milk, and milk. Bring to boil over medium high heat, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low. Simmer until mixture has thickened and coconut is tender, stirring often, about 15 minutes. Transfer to bowl and stir in lemon peel and juice. Serve warm with ice, if desired. Store tightly covered in refrigerator. A note of caution, consumption with young children, young children, small, dry fruits, and/or/or/and/or/other desserts, omit the lemon peel or orange zest. Instead of lemon peel, use zest for fresh lemon juice.

title: Rajah's Black Horseradish
ingredients: 1 lb sour cream, room temp | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1 teaspoon dry horseradish | 1 serrano pepper, sliced in half lengthwise, deseeded, destemmed, destemmed, cut into slices
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, let sit until ready to serve. Place in a jar or ziplock bag. Refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,golden caster sugar,chicken bouillon cube,potato starch
title: Baked Potato and Black Bean Soup
ingredients: 400 g kidney beans | 2 potatoes | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 100 g golden caster sugar | 2 tablespoons potato starch
instructions: In a large saucepan or deep fryer, combine the beans, the potato, and the bouillon cubes. Add enough water to cover, bring to the boil, and then lower the heat. Simmer, covered, until they are tender. Remove from the heat, and puree until smooth using a hand blender or a food processor. Return the puree to the pan, and add the sugar. Simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Gradually stir in the potato starch until the soup boils and thickens to desired consistency.

title: Guac Monkey Bread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons roquefort cheese | 3 tablespoons guacamole | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Spread the cheese on the toasted bread. Place under broiler for 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,raisin,grain wheat flour,beef bouillon powder,taco seasoning,ginger paste,celery,taco seasoning mix
title: Rice Cakes
ingredients: 1 cup raisins | 1/2 cup sliced celery | 1 tablespoon ground ginger paste | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon powder | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 cup shredded broccoli | 2/3 cup whole grain wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine raisins, celery, ginger, and beef bouillon powder in a bowl. Mix well. Stir in taco seasoning. Mix well. Pour half of the mixture into a baking pan. Smooth out top. Combine broccoli and remaining mixture in a medium bowl, and stir until well coated and smooth. Spread evenly over the top of the rice. Sprinkle shredded cheese over everything. Bake uncovered 45 to 50 minutes in the preheated oven, or until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Bud's Pizza Crust for Peroshky (Copycat)
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Combine flour, one cup at a time, in a large bowl. Mix well. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead until dough is soft and elastic. Cover with plastic wrap. Let rest for 10 minutes. Using floured hands, roll to desired thickness, about 7 10. Slice into 8 pie shaped pieces. Place on a well oiled pizza pan or pizza stone. Prick each edge with a fork on bottom and sides. Pour remaining marinara sauce over the top of the pieces, keeping the moist edges clear, or use a funnel to spoon some of the marinara sauce into crusts on the pizza. Using a large knife, score a cross in the top of crust. If desired, sprinkle more olive or paprika on top of crumbs, if desired. Bake at 450 f for 12 to 15 minutes or till crust edges are browned. Remove from oven and serve as directed above.

title: Quick Miso Crepes
ingredients: 1/3 cup red miso | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sour cream ( to taste ) or 1 -2 tablespoon yogurt ( to taste ) | sliced kielbasa ( optional ) or mozzarella cheese ( optional ) | 1 -3 crepe ( depending on shape ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dried arugula ( optional ) or fresh kale, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Heat a little oil in a small saucepan, then add the miso and pineapple juice and stir. Cook about 2 minuted then remove & set aside. When you get to this point, you will need to add your brandy in a few splashes and stir. Add sour cream & kielbasa or mozza, if using, and stir. Fill each crepe with about 1/2 tsp miso mixture and roll up. If you are having arugula leaves, roll them up first and then tie with cotton & microwave safe kitchen twine. Put them in a baking dish & cover with the miso mixture. You won't need to refrigerate, it will be just before serving.

title: Zeytoz Na Boran
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups apple juice | 3 tablespoons vodka | 1 cup long grain white rice | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 cup tzatziki
instructions: Whisk the apple juice, 2 tablespoons of vodka, and 1 cup of rice together in a medium saucepan. Place over medium heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Daikon and Mexicorn Dip
ingredients: 3 lbs daikon radishes, peeled | 3 lbs mirliton ( yellow and green parts ) | 1 lb mexicorn | 1 lb granny smith apple, peeled if desired
instructions: Wash and dry the daikon and mexicorn. Remove the root ends, rind and any large green matter or yellow matter of your choice. Cut in long slices, and slice across the fruit again. Taste, and add more sugar/sugar to your taste if needed. Pack into a bowl, and use as desired.

title: Pancetta Bread Pasta Bake
ingredients: 2 loaves ciabatta | 4 tablespoons tomato soup | 2 teaspoons sage ( or a little more ) | 1 medium loaf ciabatta | 1 tablespoon pepper | 1 tablespoon pepper ( or to taste )
instructions: Cut ciabatta in half. Scoop out the core then tear into smaller pieces. Spray the inside of the bread loaf with oil, then preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place bread, cut side up, on a baking sheet and bake in oven for about 25 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, heat the tomato soup with the sage or some ground pepper. When bread is toasted, sprinkle both the tomato soup mixture and the pepper over the bread pieces. Place the bread back in the oven until just browned, about 5 minutes more. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,shallot,italian parsley,red wine vinegar,garlic salt,golden raisin,lemon,extra beef
title: Flemish Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fine dry red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 cups shallots, very finely minced | 1 1/2 cups fresh italian parsley, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 tablespoons extra lean ground beef | 3 garlic cloves, finely minced | 1/4 cup golden raisin, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley
instructions: Combine vinegar, shallots, parsley, cardamom and garlic salt in a large bowl. Add ground beef, stirring until just combined, then divide beef mixture into 6 portions. Spread each portion evenly over each portion of vinegar mixture. Divide raisins evenly over each portion. Sprinkle minced parsley over top. Chill rolls in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Heat a grill to high. Cook rolls 4 minutes per side or until beef is cooked through, basting with any leftover marinade during cooking. Serves 1 or as an accompaniment to fish, meats, salads and main course.

Random Ingredients: corn,chorizo sausage,parmigiano reggiano cheese,ham,olive oil,ziti pasta,cooking spray
title: Baked Ziti With Chorizo and Ham
ingredients: 1 cup cooked ziti pasta, cooked | cooking spray | 1 cup cooked chorizo sausage, chopped | 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/2 cup ham, deli slices chopped | 1/4 cup stuffed olives, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine first 7 ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Lightly spray 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Layer pasta in pan, top with chorizo and ham, then pour the mixture over the top. Sprinkle cheese over the top. Bake uncovered 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: radish,barbecue sauce,pinto bean,dark brown sugar,radicchio,self raising flour
title: BBQ Refridgerator Corn Dog Sausages
ingredients: 1/4 cup self-raising flour, plus extra for dusting | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 can pinto beans | 6 medium radishes | 1 cup shredded mixed salad leaves with | barbecue sauce
instructions: Combine flour, sugar and beans in a heavy based saucepan. Cover and gently stir over low heat until mixture boils. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat and stir until mixture is smooth. Cover and set aside 5 minutes. Finely shred radishes. Combine salad leaves, vegetables and barbecue sauce in bowl. Place sausage on baking tray coated with cooking spray. Spoon mixture into pan. Using a pastry brush, lightly sprinkle with extra flour. Bake in preheated moderate oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until cooked through. Cut into thick slices.

title: Frozen White Beans, Fruit Preserves and Wine Skewers
ingredients: 16 ounces white beans, frozen or fresh | 18 wooden skewers, soaked in water | 1/4 cup fruit preserves | 4 ounces white wine | 1/4 cup fruit preserves
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crockpot and stir to mix well. Cook on high heat until the mixture is heated through, around 4 - 5 hours.

title: Sweet Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups drained canned dashi ( basic japanese soup stock ) | 4 cups unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 2 tablespoons dried dill weed | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the dashi, cocoa, rosemary, dill and cider vinegar. Bring to a boil and stir frequently. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thickened. Pour into a glass serving bowl and cool.

title: Anrugula Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons marshmallows | 100 g arugula
instructions: Put the marshmallows in a small bowl and crush it with a spoon. Wash the arugula, and cut it in flowers, but do not chop. Add to the marshmallow mixture and fold well. Serve with toasted bread.

Random Ingredients: collard green,mustard powder,sunflower seed,chinese noodle,spice,corn syrup,marshmallow
title: Chinese Noodle Mix
ingredients: 50 1/2 ounces chinese noodles ( i use medium grain ) | 5 ounces collard greens ( drained, rinsed & sliced ) | 4 ounces sunflower seeds | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon corn syrup ( not maple syrup ) | 1/2 cup mixed candy sprinkles ( optional )
instructions: Boil the noodles in water with the salt on, until tender.

title: Veggies With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb brussels sprout, raw | 4 tablespoons margarine | spices
instructions: Boil sprouts, remove from heat and leave to be slightly defrosted. Melt margarine and brown the brussels sprouts until tender, about 10 minutes. Add spices and serve.

title: Pancake With Rum - Vietnamese Style
ingredients: 1 large green cabbage, shredded | 1 - 1 1/2 lb jasmine rice | 1/2 cup shredded unsweetened desiccated coconut | 14 ounces dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Pour coconut in colander, rinse off and dry the rice well by placing it in the sink. Dump it into the colander and rinse off excess water. Squeeze any excess water out of the shredded cabbage. Slice finely in the size appropriate to the rice. Combine the shredded coconut with the remaining rum if using and mix well. Stir the coconut mixture into the rice. If you are going to use the rum in this recipe, stir in 2 - 3 tablespoons of rum before pouring into a flat glass dish. Garnish with grated coconut on top, if desired. Serve with a spoonful of white wine over the top.

title: Green Pea Salad II
ingredients: 3 cups frozen green peas, thawed | 2 teaspoons distilled white vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the peas, hot vinegar, and white vinegar.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,mushroom,pine nut,french bread,crabmeat,sharp cheddar cheese,tomato green chilies,salt substitute
title: Chocolate Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted | 12 cups french bread, toasted and cut into 1 inch slices | 8 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup mushroom pieces, chopped | 2 cans crabmeat, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 4 teaspoons salt substitute
instructions: Toast the pine nuts in a 375 degree oven for about 5 minutes until lightly browned and fragrant. Sprinkle the nuts with the yeast and set aside to proof. Toast the bread in the oven for about 10 minutes until lightly browned. Meanwhile lightly toast the mushrooms in the oven for 10 - 12 minutes. Combine the crumbles, cheese, mushrooms, and crab meat and season with salt substitute. Stuff the toasted pine nuts onto the bread. Place the bread on an oven rack. Bake at 375 degrees for about 40 minutes or until bread is nicely browned.

title: Basil Triesticks
ingredients: 250 g caster sugar | 600 -625 g tortillas ( or 1 1/4 cups gluten-free bread cubes ) | 3 sprigs rosemary
instructions: Pour 3 tbsp of boiling water into a small saucepan and set the pan over medium heat. Add 250g of caster sugar and stir until dissolved. Bring to boil while whisking continuously, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved. Set aside to cool completely. Place tortillas in a dry pan of cold water with a sprinkling of caster sugar. When they have softened slightly, remove with a slotted spoon and place on kitchen towel. Place another plate of paper on top and press the tortillas to remove excess water. Spread half of a teaspoon of dried rosemary over each tortilla and then put 3 heaped tablespoons of sweetened sugar and half a teaspoon of dried rosemary in the centre of each. Fold in the sides of each tortilla to make an envelope the size of a large star. Place the filled tortillas on baking paper and bake in a preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: currant,asparagus,chipotle chile,pork shoulder,mussel,butter,tomato sauce,chicken breast half
title: Chipotle Creamy Pork Rillettes
