ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 4 skinless, boneless pork shoulder | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle chiles | 1 bunch fresh asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 can chipotle-flavored tomato sauce ( sancocho ) | 1/2 cup dried currants | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 4 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 32 mussels, cleaned and debearded
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the chicken breasts in the boiling water, and cook until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 35 minutes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. Remove the chicken from the pot, and set aside to cool completely. Cut the chicken into cubes. Place the chicken in a large pot with enough water to cover by about 2 inches. Add the ground chipotle and asparagus to the boiling water, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. In a bowl, mix the cooked chicken, and the tomato sauce, making sure it is thoroughly blended. Bring the chicken mixture to a boil again, then reduce heat. Cover and simmer until the meat is tender and easily shredded with a fork, about 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place the butter in a skillet that has been sprayed with cooking spray, and place over high heat. Place an empty, metal baking pan in the oven to bake the asparagus. Spread the chicken pieces with a generous amount of the chipotle cream sauce. Place the chicken pieces in the baking pan. Top with a layer of the asparagus, then top with another layer of asparagus with a thick layer of cream sauce. Continue layering the asparagus, chicken, and sauce until all ingredients have been used, ending with a layer of cream sauce. Bake the dish in the preheated oven until the top has turned golden brown, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,chicken bouillon cube,fennel seed,garlic powder,stout beer,cannellini bean,shrimp,oriental sesame oil
title: Crock Pot Cooleene's Weeknight Beef With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, lean | 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 cup stout beer ( i recommend guiness ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon italian ( skyway brand preferred ) | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Cut up stew meat. Add all the other ingredients except the beef in a crock, stir well. Cover and cook on low in crock pot for 7 hours. After cooking for 7 hours, stir, serve on white or spilt rice. If you are planning on eating raw shrimp, you may want to take some toothpicks and toss the shrimp into the pot after it had cooked for a couple of hours. Note, if you have any hard frillies, cut them into thin slices and throw those in as well. The shrimp will cook more quickly.

title: Italian Sausage Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 can chickpeas, drained, rinsed | 1/2 cup pimento, chopped, drained | 1/3 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices and brown in deep fryer. Drain. Add tomatoes, chickpeas and pimento. Cover and cook 1 minute. With tongs, loosen mixture and transfer to serving bowl. Tightly cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours, up to 2 days.

title: Tamari Glazed Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg pork fat ( loin fat ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 bunch celery rib ( with leaves ) | 1 tablespoon tamari and tamari
instructions: Place loin fat in a saucepan and cover with approximately 5 pints of water. Stir the cube of stock into the water til dissolved. Bring to a boil, turn down and skim off any froth. Place the lid on the saucepan and steam for about 45 min. Remove the lid, turn the heat up to high and boil for another 15 - 20 minutes. Remove the fat from the pan, and place in a small roasting tin to cool. Pre heat oven to 350°f. When the glaze is cold, take off the skin from the meat and shred the fat. Reserve the meat. Strain the stock through a sieve into a bowl and set aside for later use. Strain the stock, and make sure there are no solids or skin pockets. You can leave the solids as they are so they don't bleed to the meat. Place the meat back into the pan and add the celery leaves. Pour over the glaze and toss the meat until thoroughly coated. Bake at 350f for 35 - 45 min, or until the meat is crisp and the celery is brown. To make tamari glaze mix tamari and tamari for 30 seconds with a fork then drizzle over the meat.

title: Ethiopian Kebabs
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili oil | 8 cardamom pods | 1 whole chicken breast, boneless
instructions: Heat the chili oil in a large skillet over medium heat, and fry the cardamom pods until fragrant, about 30 seconds to one side. Transfer the cardamom pods to a mortar with the boneless and bruised chicken breast, mashing the chicken until evenly blended, and using a spoon to crush with the back of a spoon. Sprinkle the chicken with salt, and let sit until just warm, about 15 minutes. Barbecue the chicken kebabs on a heated grill for 20 minutes, or broil for about 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Apricot Jam Fruit Mone Pot
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups assorted fresh vegetables ( such as peaches or apples, peeled, sliced apple or berries are nice ) | 1 cup jam ( seedless or apricot, etc ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | hot paprika ( for dusting ) | 1 small baking apple ( such as a mcintosh or other good-quality baking apple )
instructions: Cut up vegetables. Pour half of jam over veggies and jam and sprinkle with half of paprika. Using a vegetable peeler or grater, shave apple into thin rings. Arrange around the jam and sprinkle with remaining paprika. Bake in a 350 oven for 20 minutes, or until fruit is tender. Cool, then store in a jam jar, refrigerate for up to 3 weeks.

title: Lazy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage, casings removed | 1/2 cup clam juice | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon italian-style dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet on all sides. Drain fat from pan. Add clam juice, vinegar and bread crumbs. Stir well. Turn down heat to low until hot, stir often. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,chili garlic sauce,rotel tomato,fruit jam
title: Fruit Chilli Sauce for Dogs
ingredients: 500 g mixed dried fruit jam | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 1/2 cups rotel tomatoes, finely diced
instructions: Spread a little sunflower oil in a shallow baking pan. Spread the dried fruit jam on top of the jam. Sprinkle flour over the jam. Drizzle chili garlic sauce over the jam. Cook in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Serve with freshly cooked white potatoes.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,tamarind pulp,lamb cutlet,artichoke heart,nonfat milk
title: Mashed Lamb With Artichokes (Paleo-Style)
ingredients: 1 lamb cutlet or 1 roasting lamb cutlet | 1/4 cup artichoke hearts | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 1 cup nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons coarse grainy mustard
instructions: Place the lamb on your cutting board in a cross section, about 2 1/2 3 inches thick. Score the meat all over with a sharp knife. Place the cutlets in a shallow, nonstick pan. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes, preferably for up to 2 days. Combine the remaining ingredients, pour over the lamb, and marinate at least 3 hours, preferably overnight. Drain the lamb, reserving the marinade and vegetables. Grill the lamb until medium rare and opaque throughout, turning once. Serve hot.

title: Wonton Pillows- Chinese Dumplings- Low Fat
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Boil water in large pot for dumplings in it. Put a few drops in the boiling water and immediately remove them from the water with a slotted spoon. Immediately they are ready. Drain in a collander and let drain another few seconds. Repeat steps 12 and 13 until all the wrappers are gone from the pot. Mix together the dark soy sauce and the dark soy sauce and sprinkle it on the wrappers. Let cool. Once cool, roll into small balls about the size of a walnut. Flatten them slightly with a fork or roller. Drop them in the pot of hot water. Simmer them until they rise to the surface of the pot. Remove with a slotted spoon and add a few drops of dark soy sauce if desired.

title: Baked Banana (or Peaches)
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 2 packages dry yeast | 2 bananas, peeled
instructions: Soak each banana in the stock in the fridge overnight or for at least two hours before cooking. After the 2 hours is up, drain the bananas, scrape out the skins and place into a greased oven proof dish. Cover with foil and bake at 375f for 1 hour. Turn down the oven temperature to 350f and bake 25 minutes. Remove the foil and bread on a medium to high heat, bake for a further 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Meanwhile, peel the bananas, cut the bananas lengthwise into thick slices. Place the sliced bananas, on top of the mashed bananas in the pan to warm. Serve on a platter with chips, drizzled with melted butter.

title: Red Pepper icing
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon or 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon | 1/4 cup red pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar )
instructions: Microwave the red pepper for 15 mins on high power but no more than 30 seconds, then chop finely and add the boullion. Stir well. Drizzle the icing sugar on, and sprinkle with red pepper.

title: Pistachio, Ham,  Nacho, and Salsa Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh deli ham, cut into 1/4-inch slices ( about 3 cups ) | 2 cups prepared salsa ( i use jazz blender's jazz blender medium salsa ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 jar of pimento stuffed olives, drained and sliced | 1 package frozen unsalted pistachio, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped dill | 1 ounce sriracha sauce ( i used paul primavera brand ) | 1/4 ounce ground cumin
instructions: Place all ingredients except the cumin into a large saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until flavors have blended, about 20 minutes. Reduce heat to low, remove from heat and reserve.

Random Ingredients: strawberry jelly,artichoke heart,date,white fish fillet,corn tortilla,lasagna noodle,mustard seed
title: Lyla's White Fish Lasagne
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and coarsely chopped | 16 ounces white fish fillets, rinsed and sliced into thin strips ( such as cod or halibut ) | 8 ounces corn tortillas, cut into thin strips | 8 leaves fresh strawberries jelly | 8 fresh dates, chopped | 1 package lasagna noodles | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Put 4 sheets of aluminum foil on the countertop. Lay 5 strips of anchovy filet over each piece of fish. Place 1/4 cup of artichoke hearts next to each other over the fish mixture. Dot with about 1 teaspoon each of jelly. Top each mound of tortillas with about 1 tablespoon each of sunflower jelly and about 3 tablespoons each of mustard. Place 2 shrimp or two pieces of chopped dates around each mound of anchovies. Spread 1 tablespoon of jelly over the top. Place a second layer of tortillas diagonally over the fish and jelly layers. Dot 2 more shrimp or 2 dates over the fish and shrimp. Top with remaining 4 strips of anchovies, sunflower jelly, and sunflower jelly. Cover the lasagne sheets with aluminum foil. Place 5 sheets of corn tortillas on top of each lasagne sheet and top with aluminum foil. Bake for 45 minutes. Allow to cool completely. Cut and serve.

title: Simple Cheesy Noodles
ingredients: 1 package thin noodles, cooked and drained | 1 -2 clove garlic, minced
instructions: Drain noodles and set aside. In a skillet, combine the garlic and noodles and cook over medium heat until noodles have turned a light golden brown color, about 3 - 5 minutes. Stir frequently. Immediately, sprinkle with more minced garlic, if desired.

title: Low Fat No-Ghee Naan Bread
ingredients: 1 liter soy sauce | 1 packet dry yeast | 1 liter miracle whip
instructions: Warm up the milk and put into a container big enough for all the ingredients to be fully covered. Let sit for 5 - 10 mins but do not let it boil. It should be frothy. Stir well and put out into a bowl. Sprinkle the yeast over the warm milk and leave until it rises properly. This step usually takes between 1 and 2 hours so the yeast can dissolve. Now put the soy sauce and melted Miracle Whip in a shallow bowl. Mix together well.

Random Ingredients: celeriac,black olive,tart apple,avocado,rack lamb,red wine vinegar
title: Catalan Apples and Lamb Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 6 -8 hard-cooked tart apples, peeled and sliced | 1 1/2 lbs racks of lamb, trimmed and cut into serving size pieces | 4 tablespoons celeriac, grated ( can substitute peeled and sliced celery ), drained and rinsed ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups sliced pitted black olives | 1 avocado, thinly sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the vinegar and apple slices with a fork. Toss the racks of lamb with the apple mixture. Spoon the salad into a large, shallow serving dish and arrange the apple slices, celeriac and black olives around the lamb. Sprinkle with the avocado slices.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,lamb shoulder,flour,vanilla powder,plain yogurt,orange section,sun tomato oil
title: Turkish Style Lamb
ingredients: 500 g lamb shoulder, trimmed of excess fat, cubed | 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | flour or cornflour, to coat lamb | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt, plain | 1 teaspoon vanilla powder | 1 orange section, with pith removed
instructions: Place lamb in shallow ceramic dish. Toss with tomato and enough flour to help coat the lamb. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with the vanilla.

title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon citron peel | 1/2 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 can refrigerated ladyfingers
instructions: Sprinkle the citron peel over the chicken in a bowl. Place the chicken, chopped onion, and ladyfingers into a slow cooker, cover, and cook on high until the chicken is no longer pink on the inside, 7 hours to 8 hours. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the serving dish should read at least 150 degrees f. Remove the chicken from the slow cooker, and place into a platter. Pour the liquid from the slow cooker into a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Pour over the chicken, and cook for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomato,strawberry jam,potato,canola oil,oat,lemon juice zest,apple cider
title: Apple-Oat Breakfast Salad
ingredients: 1 cup old fashioned oats | 1 cup canola oil | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 apple - peeled, cored and diced | sliced tomatoes ( optional ) | strawberry jam ( optional but nice ) ( optional ) | finely chopped sweet potato ( optional )
instructions: Make sure oats are dry and not ground. Put shredded oats in a medium bowl and toss with oil, lemon juice, zest, apple. Add optional tomato, strawberries, or jam. Let sit for 10 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Spaghetti with Lentils
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti | 2 cups lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped ( broccoli, carrots ) | 1/3 cup packed light brown sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley or 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper
instructions: Cook pasta al dente, according to package directions. Meanwhile, put lentils in a microwave safe dish.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,yellow cornmeal,peanut butter,ginger,red pepper,cheddar cheese
title: Todd's Peanut Butter Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger | 1/4 cup smooth peanut butter or 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 3/4 cup grated cheddar cheese or 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/2 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper
instructions: Preheat broiler. Mix together cornmeal and oil in a shallow dish and set aside. Mix together ginger, peanut butter, cheese, red pepper and ginger. Dip mixture into cornmeal mixture, then coat with crumb mixture. Place on a foil lined cookie sheet. Broil 8 - 10 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: scallion,sunflower oil,tomato basil,shiitake mushroom,xanthan gum,greek yogurt,curry leaf
title: Curried Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 50 g fresh shiitake mushrooms or 50 g button mushrooms, sliced | 50 ml sunflower oil | 4 fresh curry leaves | 3 scallions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 large bunch fresh spinach leaves, torn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c / 375°f / gas place the mushrooms, oil, curry leaves, scallions and xanthan gum in a large bowl and stir to combine. Taste and add more seasoning and lemon if you need to. Add the yogurt and spinach, stir well and divide between 5 serving plates. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Flat Bread (French Breakfast Bites)
ingredients: 4 ounces flour tortillas | 2 large egg yolks | 1 pint heavy whipping cream
instructions: Whip the cream until stiff and shiny. Combine the egg yolks and half the whipping cream and fold into cream. Spread into 4 pieces and dip in flour. Fry in a tablespoon of butter or margarine until crispy.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,beef tenderloin,green chili pepper,white wine vinegar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,marjoram
title: Beef Tenderloin With Chipped Green Chile
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 package bok choy, trimmed, washed well and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 4 tablespoons shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 jar chopped green chili peppers, drained
instructions: In small bowl combine vinegar and marjoram.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,peanut,provolone cheese,deli ham,lop chong,rice,cauliflower,brown sugar
title: Indonesian Melted Cheese (Microwave)
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated deli ham | 1 package lop chong, cut into 1-inch pieces ( jalapeno chile preferred ) | 12 ounces deli sandwich-sized melterdays ham | 1 1/2 cups rice | 1 tablespoon packed brown sugar | 8 thick slices provolone cheese | 2 tablespoons dry roasted unsalted peanuts | 2 tablespoons jalapeno chiles, chopped
instructions: Remove husks from ham and trim excess fat from ham if there is any. Cut ham into 3/4 inch cubes. Coat 9 by 7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place ham in prepared dish. Top with sliced chong. Place half of the rice on top of chong and chong. Top with deli ham, half of the mozzarella cheese, half the smoked provolone, remaining rice, and roasted peanuts. Repeat layers ending with mozzarella cheese. Cover and microwave on high 1/2 hour or until bubbling around edges. Let stand before serving.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,vanilla essence,kosher salt,kaffir lime leaf,paprika
title: Lettuce Wrapped in Kaffir Lime Leaves
ingredients: 1 -2 head romaine lettuce | 12 -15 leaves kaffir lime leaves | 10 -12 large paprika | 2 -4 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 -2 teaspoon sweet paprika
instructions: Cut up romaine lettuce into 3/4 inch chunks. To make the spice paste, cut up a handful of fresh zucchini lengthwise about 1/2 inch thick. Place in a bowl and cover with some ice cubes. Dip the lemon leaves into the lime juice and then pat dry on each leaf. Using a sharp paring knife, cut a 1/8 inch slice from the center into about 12 squares. Take the zucchini chunks and gently squeeze out the juice. Then, with your hands, tear the cubes of zucchini into smaller pieces. Add paprika to the kaffir lime leaves. Take one or two paprikas and dip in the spice paste, making sure the zucchini is well soaked. Remove the zucchini and place them on a platter. When ready to serve, drizzle each plate with some of the kaffir lime lime juice, to taste. If serving cold, add ice cubes to the mix at this point.

title: Easy French Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken breasts ( cubed or cut or sliced in a food processor ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup cajun seasoning
instructions: Use same ingredients as above if you have any seasoned ones. If not, make sure to remove excess oil or moisture on the chicken before frying, to insure a good coating. If you need to fry, preheat oven to 400°f, place a rack and rack in middle of oven, and preheat oven to 400 f. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. In a bowl combine chicken and cajun seasoning. Mix thoroughly, and place in cookie sheet. Do not mix too much or cajun seasoning will burn. After 1 hour, remove from oven and place in a warm spot on the cookie sheet, and stir to insure all chicken is coated. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ginger ale,date,mustard seed,yellow pepper,ha avocado,romaine lettuce,tomato sauce,rice noodle
title: Avocado, Date, and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger ale | 3 tomatoes, diced | 1 yellow sweet pepper, diced | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted, and diced | 1 head romaine lettuce - rinsed, trimmed, and chopped | 2 cups rinsed and torn fresh romaine lettuce - rinsed, trimmed, and torn
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the rice noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Rinse with cold water once cooked, drain well in a colander, and repeat with the remaining ingredients. Allow the salad to chill in the refrigerator until ready to use. Combine the mustard seed and ground ginger ale in a small bowl, and let sit for a few minutes to make the mustard seeds glaze. Combine tomatoes, sweet pepper, and avocado in a salad bowl, and toss with the romaine lettuce. Ladle dressing over salad, and toss to coat.

title: Smoky, Fresh Moghlai Rice With Avocado
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice, chilled | 1 large avocado, peeled, pitted, and diced | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, freshly grated | 2 teaspoons harissa or 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 4 slices toasted whole-grain english muffins | harissa or tarragon flavored seasoning, to taste
instructions: Combine rice, avocado, cilantro, lemon zest and 1/4 teaspoon harissa in a large bowl. Place 1/2 tablespoon of the rice mixture in the center of each toasted english muffin and top each serving with about 1 tblsp. Of the bean mixture and 1/4 cup of the avocado mixture.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,cayenne,purpose flour,nonfat milk powder,red pepper flake,asparagus,onion flake
title: Bacon Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus | 2 tablespoons dehydrated onion flakes | 1 yellow bell pepper | 2 teaspoons dehydrated red pepper flakes | 4 tablespoons nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Clean and slice the asparagus, making sure it gets a thick 'head'. Set the asparagus aside in a large bowl. Dice the yellow bell pepper into 1 pieces and dice the red pepper. Add all of the dry ingredients except the asparagus into the bowl and mix well. Add the bell pepper and mix well. Chill the mixture for 30 minutes. In a large frying pan, heat an electric fry thermometer until it reaches 220 degrees. Add 1 tablespoon of the liquid from the asparagus mixture and microwave for 3 minutes, allowing for it to boil. If it doesn't, microwave an additional 1 to 2 minutes until it does. With a knife, slice the asparagus into 4 lengths and pat dry. When the fry thermometer reaches 220 degrees, remove it from the range. Put into a colander with tongs or a spoon or strainer in the sink. Sprinkle with black pepper, salt, and any dried herbs from the crumbled bacon strips. Shake off all of the excess salt and pepper from the asparagus. Stir the bacon asparagus into the potatoes and microwave on high about 1 1/2 to 2minutes, stirring frequently, until they are 'al dente'. Serve with low fat sour cream and green vegetable yogurt.

title: Vietnamese Fish Wrappings
ingredients: 1 can or bottle dark beer | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 1/2 pounds fresh fish, chopped | 1/4 cup molasses
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine beer, rice vinegar and fish. Mix well. Let stand 30 minutes. Spread about 1/4 cup filling in center of each wrap.

Random Ingredients: honey,ginger garlic paste,salt black pepper,daikon radish,brown rice
title: Asian Sushi
ingredients: 8 ounces daikon radishes, sliced | 4 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 1 teaspoon salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 2 cups honey, divided
instructions: Soak rice and daikon radish slices in a large bowl of cold water for 10 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and set aside. Mix ginger garlic paste with hot, room temperature water in a bowl until combined.

title: Honduran Parsnips With Corn and Beef Base
ingredients: 1 medium parsnip, peeled, cut lengthwise into halves | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 2 ears fresh corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Rinse parsnips. Cut each half into six sections across and cross wise, dropping each piece into a glass bowl. Sprinkle with beef bouillon cube, covering all the parsnips and top each with a piece of corn on top. Do not press corn as the bouillon would break during baking. Bake in preheated oven until the corn falls apart and the parsnips are tender, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,dark red kidney bean,curry paste,coconut,almond paste
title: Spicy Baked Beans With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon almond oil | 2 teaspoons red food coloring or 2 teaspoons hot chili-garlic sauce, to taste | 1 tablespoon coconut, shredded and toasted
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a saucepan. Simmer, over gentle heat for about 15 minutes. Serve in shallow, warm bowls. Sprinkle coconut over the top.

title: The Best Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark molasses ( i like bragg's ) | 1 bunch fresh chilies, washed, stems removed and seeds shaken out ( can substitute 2 tbsp dried crushed chiles ) | 1 can sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained
instructions: Mix the ingredients together. Will keep in the fridge for a couple days.

title: Smoked Siled Pork, Batemania & Garbanzo
ingredients: 350 g smoked lean pork shoulder | 1 tablespoon tahini | 4 basil leaves | 1 tea bottle
instructions: Mix together everything into a medium kilner. If using smoker, smoke it first in a non stick pan, then move around in pan as best you can. When finished, pour into a large freezer bag, and snip off excess air with a spoon. Smap it for a few hours with your hands and eat. I have served this with a little homemade pita bread, mixed with salad vegetables and a fresh herb vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: beer,beef stew meat,berry,tortilla,grapefruit juice,mascarpone cheese,tomato puree
title: Tortilla Beef
ingredients: 1 cup grapefruit juice, divided | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, trimmed of all visible fat | 1 can tomato puree | 24 ounces beer | 1 cup mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 2 packages chilled tortillas, torn into 3-inch pieces | 1 package frozen mixed berries, thawed and gently shaken
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine 1/2 cup grapefruit juice and beef. Cover and refrigerate meat 2 to 3 hours. Transfer meat to a roasting pan. Insert ovenproof skillet onto rack in center of oven. In a bowl, combine remaining grapefruit juice, tomato puree and reserved juice. Pour mixture over beef. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours and up to 12 hours. Remove beef from pan, reserving marinade. Stir meat and marinade into tomato mixture with reserved marinade. Spread meat and sauce evenly on 6 to 8 inch round cake or baking sheet sprinkled with cornmeal. Arrange vegetables evenly over top of the meat and cook in the preheated oven until meat is browned and vegetables are tender about 30 minutes. Uncover and continue cooking 15 to 20 minutes until heated through. Serve over cooked rice and garnish with reserved sauce.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen peas and spinach leaves | 1 slice cucumber | 1/2 cup fresh pepper or 1/2 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons water-packed artichoke hearts, chopped | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Cook, steam or microwave the peas until crisp tender. Heat a wok, add mustard, pepper, ginger and water and artichoke hearts and spinach.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,tomato juice,cider vinegar,apple juice,salt pepper,peanut,kale,egg noodle
title: Egg Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 3 large tomatoes with juice | 1 bunch kale, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2/3 cup brown sugar | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup dry roasted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package. Drain, rinse and cool under cold running water. Add to salad bowl. Toss with greens. To make dressing, blend brown sugar and vinegar in bowl. Gradually stir in apple juice. Pour over salad and toss to coat. Garnish with peanuts.

Random Ingredients: lardons,chinese five spice powder,ginger garlic paste,basmati rice,oil,swiss cheese
title: Langosteen Stuffed Crispy Five-Spice Baked Rice
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon minced ginger-garlic paste | 2 -8 whole leaves fresh basil, stems removed, washed and chopped | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 4 tablespoons oil | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 3 cups shredded swiss cheese or 3 cups gruyere cheese
instructions: Place rice with enough water to just cover on boiling, stir, cover and remove from heat immediately. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix together ginger garlic paste, chopped basil and five spice powder. Mix well. Place 2 tablespoons oil in a 13x9 inch baking pan and set aside. In the same baking pan, add 3/4 cup cheese and rice mixture and mix well. Remove from heat. Spread into prepared pan and smooth top. Sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese and allow to cool completely.

title: Mexican Pizzellos (Zucchini Chips)
ingredients: 1 zucchini, cut into 6 wedges each | 1 cup piquillo pepper, sliced ( or 1/4 cup jalapeno peppers ) | 10 round piquillo peppers, with tops removed
instructions: Slice the zucchini into 1 inch rounds. Spread a few pieces of piquillo on each zucchini round, and cover with a few slices of the piquillo. Wrap each round in aluminum foil, and place on a microwave safe plate or cookie sheet. Microwave on high for 3 minutes. Turn the heat down to medium, and continue cooking for 5 minutes, until zucchini rounds are very tender. Sprinkle with salt and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken turkey,orange juice,allspice,red kidney bean,ginger root,red bean,garlic paste
title: Red Beans
ingredients: 2 cups shredded chicken, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 cup red beans, drained | 1 cup cooked red kidney beans | 1 tablespoon red food coloring ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice | 1 pinch ground allspice
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Blend the chicken, red beans, red kidney beans, red food coloring, garlic paste, ginger, orange juice, and allspice together in a bowl or food processor until the mixture has the texture of a relish. Transfer the relish to a baking dish.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,banana,strawberry jam,garlic clove,oil,watercress,chickpea flour,savoy cabbage
title: Chickpea Cheese Rolls Aka Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1/2 cup water | 1 small savoy cabbage, shredded fine | 4 slices monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon garlic clove, crushed | 1 tablespoon strawberry jam | 4 leaves spinach & stems removed | 3 tablespoons oil | 1/4 teaspoon savoy cabbage, shredded with leaves torn into strips
instructions: First prepare the rolls, put 2 tbsp of jam in a small cup with a tiny piece of shredded savoy cabbage. Fill cup with water, add garlic and add to cup. When it starts bubbling, add shredded savoy cabbage. When it starts to boil again, add shredded pepperjack cheese to the bowl. Fill cabbage leaves with filling. Roll up each leaf, fold in ends, seal edges with a toothpick. Heat the rest of the oil in a skillet and put rolls in. Sautee roll in oil until golden brown on both sides.

title: Hot Caviar
ingredients: 1 cup cremini mushrooms, chopped | 2 habanero peppers, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: Combine mushrooms, habanero peppers, and white wine in a bowl.

title: Italian Turnips
ingredients: 4 medium turnips, unpeeled | 1/3 cup zesty zesty italian style salad dressing | 1/2 head cabbage, cored and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread vegetable oil on baking sheet with a paper towel and bake turnips for about 35 minutes, turning often, until starting to brown around the edges. Meanwhile, slice turnips. Arrange on a serving platter and top with zesty zesty dressing. Wine and red pepper rings are also great accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: oat flour,beef chuck roast,heavy cream,pearl barley,green bean,allspice,cauliflower
title: Scottish Beef Barley Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, very lean and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup uncooked pearl barley | 14 ounces green beans, drained and cut in half | 8 ounces cauliflower, cut in half | 1 cup heavy cream | 4 teaspoons allspice | 1 cup oat flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in slow cooker and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours.

title: Fennel and Parmesan Cheese Candies
ingredients: 100 g grated parmesan cheese | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional )
instructions: Using a mortar & pestle, pound together the fennel and fennel seeds. Place in a shallow tray or baking tray lined with greaseproof paper & bake in a moderately hot oven for approx 20 minutes. Allow them to cool before coating. This candies are best eaten straight from the oven, but can also be frozen in an airtight tin for upto 5 months.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,angel hair pasta,beef stew meat,pasta shell
title: Pasta with Mexican Chorizo and Beef
ingredients: 1 pound chorizo sausage, chopped | 1 pound cubed beef stew meat | 1 package uncooked angel hair pasta | 1 pound small shell-shaped cooked pasta shells
instructions: Heat a large pot of lightly salted water to boiling. Cook the chorizo and beef in boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes, or until meat is browned and fat is rendered. Drain excess grease. Return the chorizo and beef to the pot. Cover, and return to a simmer. Cook until chorizo is hot and easily removed from the bone, about 10 minutes. Pour pasta into the hot pot. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes to dry pasta. Drain well, and serve with croutons and green and red pepper sauce.

title: Artichokes With Cherries and Artichokes in Pasta
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta ( orzo or rigatoni ) | 1 can artichokes, rinsed and drained | chili seasoning mix, to taste | glace cherries ( large cherry size )
instructions: Cook pasta following manufacturer's instructions.

title: French Fry Onion Sauce
ingredients: 1 red onion, minced | 8 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Mix together and allow to sit at room temperature for at least a good thirty minutes to let flavors develop.

Random Ingredients: barbeque sauce,jicama,thyme leaf,red pepper,extra virgin olive oil,adobo seasoning,garlic paste,orange peel
title: Jicama with Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 7 1/2 cups peeled jicama, thinly sliced ( about 2 1/4 pounds ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, freshly shavings | 1/4 cup grated orange peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons adobo seasoning, dried ( see note ) | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/4 cup jarred barbeque sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1/4 teaspoon ground thyme leaves | 3 dashes worcestershire sauce
instructions: Note, for garlic paste, soak 1/4 cup jarred barbeque sauce in warm water 1 hour before using.

title: Chipotle Smoked Pork Belly
ingredients: 4 ounces chipotle chiles, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/chipotle-smoked-pork-belly-8133939 '' > chipotle smoked pork belly < /a > | 2 ounces vodka ( optional ) | 4 ounces rolled oats ( optional ) | 2 -4 lbs pork belly
instructions: Dice meat into thin strips 2 inches long, 1 3/4 inches wide and 1/4 inch thick. Slice crosswie shreds into 1/4 inch wide matchsticks, keeping them together if necessary. Combine with salt and pepper, adding chipotle powder to taste, or chipotles adobo marinade to taste. Cover and chill in refrigerator for a day or two. Drain meat well and cook in smoker or griller about 3 minutes per side, depending on how tender you like your meat. Remove balspan from smoker and let rest 1/2 hr. Strain meat to remove salt. Re heat smoker and smoke until very hot and syrupy. Spoon back into pan and serve with sliced meat.

title: Venison & Asparagus Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless venison, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1 lb fresh asparagus spear, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons celery, chopped | 2 -3 green beans ( optional )
instructions: Heat a large skillet over med hi heat. Spray with nonstick spray. Add venison and stir fry until beginning to brown, 3 - 5 minutes. Add asparagus, celery and green beans, if using, and stir fry 3 - 5 minutes until vegetables are tender crisp and meat is cooked through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,white wine vinegar,soy sauce,tequila,cinnamon,yellow squash,cake flour
title: Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 3 medium yellow squash, cut on an angle into 1 inch slices | 2/3 cup tequila | 2/3 cup sesame oil | 2/3 cup potato wine vinegar | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon cake flour, for dusting
instructions: Place the squash slices into a nonstick skillet/dutch oven and heat 1/2 tbs of the sesame oil over medium heat. Add potato wine vinegar, soy sauce and cinnamon and stir to combine. Bring to boil and cook until the mixture is reduced by half. Transfer 1/2 of the sauce to a small bowl and set aside. Place the remaining 2/3 of the sesame oil in a small saucepan and melt over medium heat. While warm, add the cake flour and stir until the flour turns a lighter shade of brown around the edges. Remove from the heat and stir in the remaining sauce. Return to simmer with the squash slices. Sear the slabs on all sides until they are crisp and golden, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper seasoning,cooking oil,mint leaf,seasoning salt
title: Tarrone's Mint Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 3 -4 mint leaves ( i use a bunch fresh but dry will do but it's up to you ) | cooking oil
instructions: Place the mint leaves in a mortar, add the lemon pepper seasoning and seasoning salt, and pound to a paste. Once you have all your ground mint and ground pepper, add the cooking oil and mix well. Place the chips on a flat dish and cover the surface with a little buttered plastic wrap to keep them from drying out. You can also put a couple of broken chips in a baggie, place in a zipper bag and put them in an airtight container. It's up to you what the dose of lemon pepper seasoning is. I use about 1 teaspoon per chip, which is approximately 3 dl. The amount you may use will depend on the amount of mint leaves you get.

title: Danny Kaye's Pineapple Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar pineapple chunks | 1 yellow onion, minced | 6 tablespoons margarine | 4 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine pineapple chunks, onion, margarine, tomato puree, and italian seasoning. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 15 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Brown Rice With Molasses
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, shoulder ( chuck, rib or top round are good ) | 1 cup uncooked arborio rice ( italian rice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a shallow pot, stir together the molasses and 1 1/2 tbsp of water. Add the roast beef and rub well with the mixture. Put the meat into the oven and roast for 1 hour. Turn the meat once or twice during the cooking time. You want to sear all the way through. The meat should be dark with deep browned bits on it. Turn oven off and set a pan of water on to boil. Stir the rice into the meat and return to oven. Continue to roast, covered, for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serve immediately. Note, for better flavor, brown the beef in an oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Use a meat thermometer to keep meat warm during the cooking.

title: Spanish Shrimp With Parsley
ingredients: 7 ounces small raw shrimp, peeled and halved lengthwise | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the shrimp and parsley in a bowl. Toss gently to mix.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,chuck,serrano chilies,cuban bread,tilapia fillet,baby portabella mushroom,potato
title: Cranberry Fish Tacos
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 1 cuban bread, loaf | 8 baby portabella mushrooms | 8 baby portabella mushrooms | 4 serrano chilies | 8 ounces cranberries | 1 1/2 lbs smoked sirloin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f place the tilapia fillets into a glass dish and sprinkle the bread slices over and microwave for about 45 seconds to warm through. Slice the bread into 6 or 8 even sized, long slices that are 2 inches long. You can also use a biscuit cutter to cut out circles of bread. The latter may take as little as a dollar each or use a food processor. Coat each side of each side of the fish with a thin layer of basting oil. Place fish on a baking sheet and bake at 400°f for 10 to 15 minutes. Slice the mushrooms into fours. When fish is done, remove from the oven and set aside. Sauté mushrooms for approximately 1 more minute while adding the chilies. When mushrooms are done, add the cubed beef. Sauté until the water in the mushrooms is absorbed and the beef has cooked out of its juices. Remove the roast. The original directions say to heat in the oven at its lowest setting for 10 minutes, then turn the heat to its lowest setting and continue warming for 15 to 20 more minutes for softer, beefier, or longer. You may also use a thermometer when the internal temperature reaches 200°f remove the roast from the oven and pour the broth into a measuring cup.

title: Zucchini and Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 3 green zucchini | 2 yellow squash | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1 teaspoon chopped fresh marjoram
instructions: Cut chicken lengthwise in half. Open each half and remove as much excess fat as possible from the top. Carefully slit each half horizontally into quarters, leaving about 1/2 inch of flesh between each piece. With scissors or scissors, trim zucchini and squash lengthwise, then cut into quarters. Cut each half into 2 or 3 equal pieces depending on size. Remove all remaining skin from chicken, if necessary, and pat dry. Combine the chicken pieces and remaining marjoram. Thread 2 pieces of the chicken onto each of 4 bamboo skewers. Brush each chicken piece with more marjoram. Place skewers in the broiler with the zucchini and yellow squash, then broil 5 to 7 minutes, or until chicken is thoroughly cooked outside and zucchini is tender when pierced with a skewer using a skewer. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green olive,basil pesto,bouquet garni,vegetable oil cooking spray,kielbasa,phyllo pastry,avocado
title: Kielbasa With Avocado-Pesto Pastry
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut in slices 1/8 inch thick, then cut into 1/4 inch slices 1/4 inch thick | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 bouquet garni, small | 1 cup loosely packed fresh basil pesto, prepared | 1 medium avocado, peeled and quartered lengthwise ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup stuffed green olive, halved ( about 3 tablespoons ) | 2 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf. Coat a large 12 inch square baking dish with cooking spray, then arrange bread slices in a single layer in the prepared baking dish. Spray kielbasa with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,sesame oil,rosemary sprig,blue cheese,french bread dough,red capsicum
title: Bona Fide (French Bread With Cheese)
ingredients: 1 lb french bread dough ( frozen dough or your own recipe ) | 1 red capsicum, seeded and sliced thinly. | 10 slices low-fat blue cheese | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | fresh rosemary sprig | part-skim mozzarella cheese or light mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place your dough in the fridge and allow to come to room temperature. If you do not have a frozen dough you need just thaw your dough in the fridge and place it in a big bowl. Add your cheese, sesame oil and dried rosemary. Lightly coat a loaf pan with sesame oil. Spread the dough in your prepared loaf pan, then spread the cheese and herbs to the edges of the dough. Roll up the loaf. Place on a baking tray. Repeat until you have used up all of the dough. Top evenly with the red capsicum slices and fresh rosemary sprigs. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top of the loaf. Bake at 190oc for 30 - 35 minutes. Serve warm with honey or jam.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,currant,veal,chicken wing,kaffir lime leaf,icing sugar
title: Veal with Jam, Raisins & Currants
ingredients: 1 lb veal, cubed | 1 lb chicken wings, trimmed | 10 3/4 ounces currants | 5 3/4 ounces icing sugar | 7 large kaffir lime leaves | 4 tablespoons raspberry jam
instructions: In a large saucepan add the veal cubes and enough water to cover. Bring to the boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours until the meat is tender. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile put the currants in a bowl and cover with the remaining hot water. Cover and set aside for 15 minutes. Drain and then put the currants into a sieve and run under cold water to clean. Press the pulp through a tea strainer to extract any seeds. Return pulp to the simmering saucepan and bring to a boil. Add enough of the remaining sugar to make it a soft but pourable consistency. Simmer stirring constantly for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in lime leaves, jam and half the drained currant mixture. Cover and set aside for at least 1 hour to marinate the meat. Dissolve the icing sugar in half the hot currant water, stir into the rest of the warm jelly until it looks glossy. If it is too liquid, remove from heat and stir well. Pour this into the saucepan and stir over a medium heat until it has thickened slightly. Add remaining currant mixture and stir in to heat through. Pour the meat and sauce into an ovenproof casserole that has been lined with greased or lightly greased parchment paper. Bake at 180ºc for about 45 minutes until slightly crisp on top. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,tarragon vinegar,green pea,nonstick cooking spray,feta cheese,cheese
title: Green Pea Cheese Tarts
ingredients: 4 teaspoons grated reduced fat feta cheese | 2 teaspoons minced tarragon vinegar | 1/2 cup crumbled mild flavored feta cheese | 20 large green peas, ends, strings removed | 3/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Roll peas and crumbs into 20 muffin size balls.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,wheat bread,cream chicken soup,black,chocolate pudding mix,porcini mushroom
title: Creamy Churros over Chocolate Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped porcini mushrooms | 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix | 1/2 cup toasted whole wheat bread or 1/2 cup chopped brioche bread
instructions: In a small bowl, combine soup, rum and mushrooms. Pour into a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until mixture is hot and begins to bubble. Stir in instant pudding mix. Remove from heat, cover and let sit for 5 minutes. Spread mixture on toast or brioche bread then top with remaining toasted bread. Serve with spicy black beans and/or guacamole.

title: Beer-Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 2 ounces chuck or 2 ounces ground sirloin | 2 ounces carrots or 2 ounces chard | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/4 pint beer, chilled
instructions: Rinse or dry the rice. Mix the steak with the rice, carrots and oil. Drain the beer and add slowly, stirring, to make a rich, sticky but rather dry paste. Bury the vegetables around the contents of the steamer. Put the lid on the steamer and set to its lowest setting. A little steam will be drawn out of the rice and the vegetables. If the vegetables steam, leave them to steam for 10 more minutes. Turn off the steamer, open the lid and carefully remove the vegetable from the steamer. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,ha avocadoes,cream mushroom soup,tomato ketchup,thyme,lamb
title: Lamb and Avocados in Cajun Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb, cut into thin strips | 1 1/2 lbs ha avocadoes, wedged | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 - 3/4 cup tomato ketchup | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon thyme | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except the lamb. Put the lamb in a casserole dish and mix. Pour over everything. Cook 30 minutes in 350f oven covered. Uncover and continue cooking for an additional 30 - 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: steak,olive oil cooking spray,chicken thigh,simple syrup,mexican cheese,banana,parsnip
title: Grilled Chicken & Peppers
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chicken thigh, boneless or 3 -4 lbs chicken breasts | 2 -4 firm but firm bananas ( depending on size of banana ) | 2 -3 parsnips, peeled and julienned | 1/2 lb mexican cheese ( i like mexican jack jack but use a mexican blend if you wish to ) | 1/2 lb steak, julienned | olive oil flavored cooking spray | simple syrup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill. Mix all ingredients except grill. Cook meat until no longer pink on the first side. Grill about 1 hour, brushing on basting every 15 minutes. Serve with simple syrup and tortillas, etc.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,pear,beef sirloin steak,tomato green chilies,french bread,margarita mix,kaffir lime leaf,fennel seed
title: Marinated Beef in Coconut Bread
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, 3/4-inch thick | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 tablespoons margarita mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 3 1/2 cups french bread, cut into 1.5-inch cubes ( about 7 cups ) | 1 teaspoon kaffir lime leaf ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed ( optional )
instructions: Cut beef into 1/4 inch strips. In dutch oven, stir together all filling ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in beef. Cover and continue cooking 3 minutes longer or until heated through. Stir in bread cubes and lime leaves. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Garnish with fennel seeds.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,chicken stock cube,halibut,irish cream liqueur,white vinegar
title: Sailors Chocolate Fish
ingredients: 600 g halibut ( small, gutted and butterflied ) | 375 ml chicken stock or 375 ml canned chicken stock | 375 ml irish cream liqueur | 375 g dark chocolate | 60 ml white vinegar, approx. ( this should be your favourite liqueur )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degc, 200 degc if you have a convection oven, 200 degc if not. Rinse fish well under cold water and pat dry with kitchen paper. Place fish in non metal baking tray and cook under your favourite oven for around 15 minutes, depending on size of fish and the weight of your fish. Remove fish from oven and allow all blood to run off. Allow fish to cool, before cutting. You can then place in a food processor or blender, in batches if necessary. The aim is for the mixture to be a bit thicker than ice cream, so you can get a finer consistency. You can also use an immersion blender here. Melt chocolate and place in a bowl, stir in vinegar. Once all is melted pour over the fish. Allow to cool, then refrigerate in an airtight container. This tastes best the next day for a week or two, but you can eat this right away, or keep it in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,french bean,lard,cremini mushroom,canadian bacon,asparagus spear,green bean
title: Veggies and Canadian Bacon Scones
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups self rising flour, divided use | 1/2 cup lard, divided use | 1/4 cup fat, divided use | 2 teaspoons canadian bacon, finely diced | 3 cooked asparagus spears, chopped | 1 cup fresh green beans, chopped | 1 cup fresh asparagus spear, chopped | 1 cup french beans, fresh
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place 1 cup of the flour in plastic bag. Cut shortening, using scissors, into flour with pastry blender until mixture resembles small pebbles. Add 1/2 cup fat and bacon. Mix til mixture forms a ball. Divide dough into 2 portions. On floured surface, using hands knead each portion until smooth, then place each portion on lightly floured surface. Pat until smooth. Using a rolling pin, or a large fork, roll each side of scones until well flattened. Place scones on baking sheet and lightly flatten to cover with parchment paper. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and allow to cool 5 - 10 minutes. Sprinkle with asparagus, green beans and asparagus tips. To serve, place scone onto each plate. Garnish with additional peas or sour cream if desired.

title: Mandarin Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained, flaked | 6 mandarin oranges, sectioned and coarsely chopped | 4 strips yellow bell peppers | 1/2 cup sesame seeds
instructions: Arrange tuna and mandarin peel on serving platter.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,phyllo pastry,russet potato,cardamom powder,apricot,chicken breast,yellow cheese
title: Bajan Phyllo Trios With Chicken and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 cups greek chicken breast ( pre cooked or homemade if your store is in america ) | 4 russet potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1/2 cup russet potato, cut into 1 1/2 inch sticks | 2 slices american cheese | 3 slices yellow processed cheese | 2 tablespoons unsalted apricots, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 0.5 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Add chicken, potatoes and yellow cheese to a large skillet and fry on medium heat until potato is cooked/toss it with the apricots in a large bowl. Transfer chicken mixture mixture into an 11 x 7 inch glass baking dish. Cover with 2 sheets of phyllo dough and 2 sheets of phyllo. Continue until all of the 4 sheets of phyllo are covered with sheets of chicken mixture. Add the 3 slices of white american cheese to a large skillet and over medium heat stir it with a wooden spoon until the cheese starts melting. Remove from heat. Add cardamom powder to skillet and sprinkle lightly on top of the greek mixture. Let it simmer for 5 - 10 min, stirring occasionally. Place mixture in the oven and bake for 20 minutes. Turn oven down to 350f and bake for 45 - 50 minute while it is baking, prepare the rest of the dish. Note, i used 3/5 pound of chicken, but my daughter decided that she liked the taste of it so i added 2 tablespoons of cream cheese.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,lime,orange wedge,chinese noodle,yeast,almond,savoy cabbage,dill pickle
title: Chinese Noodle Salad With Sourdough Croutons
ingredients: 8 ounces dried chinese noodles | 1 tablespoon yeast | 1 1/2 cups shredded savoy cabbage ( about 3 cups shredded ) | 1 1/4 cups shredded savoy cabbage ( about 2 cups shredded ) | 1/4 cup minced fresh dill pickle ( about 1/2-1/2 medium ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup sliced almonds | 2 limes, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Bring a large dutch oven of salted water to a boil over high heat. Add noodles and cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Place noodles on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray, sprinkle with yeast, and toast in a 400°f oven until lightly browned and tender, about 3 minutes. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile, place both cabbage and pickles in a large bowl. Sprinkle bread with adnidents of seasoning salt and toss to coat. Add noodles with shredded cabbage mixture. Add almonds and toss to mix. Add zest of 2 limes, toss. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: french green bean,manicotti,chunky salsa,peanut oil,lemon,hazelnut,kielbasa,pine nut
title: Lebanese-Style Hazelnut Cheese Manicotti
ingredients: 2 packages manicotti, cooked and drained | 1 can french style green beans, drained | 1 jar chunky salsa | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 lemon | 1/4 cup pine nuts, chopped | 4 ounces kielbasa, cut into strips
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together beans, salsa and hazelnuts. Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the pulp. Grate half the rind, and toss with the mixture. Let stand overnight at room temperature if not using right away. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add lemon rind and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Stir in pine nuts. Drain pasta reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Add pasta and sausage to pan and toss. Fill pasta shells with cheese mixture. Sprinkle with remaining nuts. Cover. Cook at 400º for 20 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Ricotta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk baking mix | 2 tablespoons dried coriander | 1/4 cup ricotta | 1/2 cup good-quality chocolate, grated
instructions: Mix everything together in a bowl. Store in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Simple and Easy Vegan Nuts
ingredients: 3 -5 scallions ( depending on size of scallions, i prefer a bit more than just one ) | 4 -5 tablespoons unsalted pistachios ( optional ) | vegetables, such as spinach, etc
instructions: Remove green top end of scallions and discard, but leave bulbs in. Separate each individual bulb of scallions, and trim bulbs vertically. Cut away the hard root end and any light green matter on top. Slice or cut bulbs crosswise into 4 - 5 inch segments, depending on size. Spread the chopped pistachios evenly over a non stick baking sheet. Spread a thin layer of green top and very lightly sprinkle with scallions, or nuts of choice. Continue layering until all the nuts are used up. Bake in a preheated 450 degree oven 15 - 20 minutes, until a bit browned on top. Allow to cool for a few minutes before moving to a plate.

title: Mustard Butter
ingredients: 2 cups chopped pecans | 1 teaspoon crushed mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried thyme | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1/2 cup butter, softened
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread pecans on a cookie sheet. Mix pecans, mustard powder, and thyme in a bowl. Stir cream of celery soup, raisins, and butter into the pecans. Spread on cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is light brown, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic head,white onion,strawberry,cherry tomato,black bean,wheat flour,beet
title: Beetroot and Black Bean Gratin
ingredients: 2 cups beet, sliced into rounds | 3/4 cup wheat flour | 2 large white onions | 4 large tomatoes | 1 garlic head, peeled & crushed | 8 ounces black beans, drained & rinsed | 1 pint cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a rectangular casserole dish with spray oil. Sauté sliced beets and chopped onions until golden. Add crushed garlic heads and cook another 5 minutes, or until they become soft. Set aside to cool. Slice tomatoes. Slice the beets into thin rounds and add to the vegetable mixture. Mix well. Place in oven and bake for 45 minutes. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves. Place in a separate bag, and allow to soak overnight. The next day, slice the tomatoes and toss together with flour, allow to cool and then stir into the beet mixture. Place in a blender container & puree. Place the bean and tomatoes in the pot with beet mixture& stir into beet mixture. Place in a greased baking dish and bake for 40 mins, or until heated through.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 large bell peppers or 1 large green bell pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Line the bottom of a large stew pot or soup pot with cabbage.

title: Simple Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 plum tomatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 teaspoon finely grated lime peel | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange the tomato slices in a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Sprinkle the top with the lime peel and chopped rosemary leaves. Bake 15 minutes or until the tomatoes are tender and the juices are slightly reduced. Serve at once.

title: Harry Potter's Satay Balls
ingredients: 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 1/2 cup hershey's chocolate syrup, or more to taste
instructions: Stir peanut butter and hershey's together in a bowl.

title: Veggies (South Beach Diet Friendly, Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried textured vegetable ( such as pinto, zucchini, and corn ) | 2 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 red pepper ( optional ) | 1 serrano pepper ( optional )
instructions: Soak the dried vegetables in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain and place in a bowl along with the sofrito, red pepper and optional serrano peppers if using. Pour water over and allow to sit for at least an hour, but not longer than 2/3 hour is really good. The flavors should meld, but not blend together. Cover and let sit until ready to eat. It will last about 2 weeks. Serve as an appetizer or as an accompaniment to chicken, turkey, shrimp or sandwiches.

title: Baked Calzones
ingredients: 1 eggplant, peeled and sliced into 1/2 inch thick rounds | 1 package yeast ( 1 1/2 cups, 3g ) | 1/2 cup warm peach liquid or 1/2 cup peach juice | 3 slices ham, cooked and diced ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1/2 cup diced peach | 1 ounce chili seasoning mix | peach, slices, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place the eggplant slices on a tray and sprinkle with salt. Place tray in a preheated oven, 200 degrees celsius, until soft – about 40 minutes. Cut the eggplant slices into halves lengthwise, then slice them lengthwise into 1/2 inch thick rounds. Sprinkle with salt. Place them onto a baking tray and bake until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain eggplant slices, but leave the excess liquid. Cool. While eggplant slices are baking. Mix the yeast with warm peach juice using an electric mixer on low speed. In a large bowl, combine the ham, peach and sliced eggplant, the yeast mixture and the cooled caramelized eggplant. Mix well or beat well for about 5 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Sprinkle top of the dough with the peach slices. Bake until golden, about 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and set the bread in a colander to cool a few more minutes. Remove and let cool a little before serving.

title: Curried Corn Beef in Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Combine the corned beef and ground turmeric. Set to 1 quart pressure cooker. Close lid securely, and bring to high pressure over high heat. Reduce heat to medium. Allow pressure to develop naturally. Carefully transfer brisket to a shallow baking pan large enough to accommodate it in a sealed container. Pour the cooled water into the baking pan, and cover with aluminum foil. Set the pressure cooker over high heat, and bring up to full pressure over the next 7 pounds of brisket, or until the temperature reaches 155 degrees f on a meat thermometer. Cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Remove brisket from the oven and set aside for 10 minutes to cool slightly before slicing. Transfer the sliced brisket to a cutting board, and cut against the grain into small, bite size pieces. Return the slices to the saucepan, and simmer over low heat until the sauce reduces slightly, about 15 minutes. Spoon the sauce over sliced brisket, if desired. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: strawberry ice cream,oriental sesame oil,thai basil,steak
title: Vietnamese Steak Wrap
ingredients: 2 steaks | 1 cup fresh strawberries or 1 cup frozen strawberries | 1/4 cup fresh thai basil, thinly sliced | 1/8 cup oriental sesame oil | 1 ball shaped lunch wrap or 1 ball spring roll sandwich wrap
instructions: Place steaks between 2 sheets of wax paper, press flat with side of a meat pounder or heavy cleaver. Using a meat mallet, pound steaks to an even thickness. Top evenly with strawberries. Top with basil. Heat sesame oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Lay the steak on top and cook, turning once, until cooked through and just a touch of pink remains inside, about 3 minutes per side for medium rare. Serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti Bites
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, broken into 3cm slices | margarine | 5 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 8 ounces plain flour | 1/2 cup cold pressed margarine | 1 loaf italian bread
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. In large non stick frypan melt margarine on low heat in 20g lg. Skillet. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until softened. Remove mushrooms with slotted spoon, draining excess oil. In a lrg bowl, combine flour & margarine and mix, stirring until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add mushrooms & mix. Stir in noodles.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,salmon fillet,cream mushroom soup,sherry,cremini mushroom,chili powder
title: Easy Salmon in Creamy Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 4 skinless salmon fillets | 1 can condensed creamy mushroom soup | 1/2 cup sherry | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup sherry | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 can cremini mushrooms, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange salmon fillets in a baking dish, brush with 1/2 cup sherry, and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon chili powder. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Pour 1 can condensed mushroom soup, 1/2 cup sherry, golden syrup, and 1 teaspoon chili powder over the salmon, and cook until salmon is opaque, about 10 minutes. Arrange mushrooms over the salmon, and pour remaining 1 can condensed mushroom soup over the salmon. Cover, and bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until tender, and fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Amaretto Peppercorn Condiment
ingredients: 4 teaspoons crushed peppercorns | 1/2 cup real sugar | 150 ml amaretto | 4 teaspoons coconut vinegar | 2 bell peppers, diced
instructions: Place all but 1 tbsp of peppercorns in a small pot and bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat and stir in the sugar. Place in a paper sealable jar and marinate overnight or until needed, stirring every 5 minutes. Strain marinade through a sieve, pressing out any accumulated juices. Keeps indefinitely refrigerated.

title: Lamb & Blueberry Pie
ingredients: 1 pie crust, for a double crust pie | 175 g ground lamb | 1 can sliced white wine | 200 g blueberries | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 lime, juice & zest | 1 scoop vanilla ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c / 375°f. Line a deep 20cm / 8in / 5in / 3in / 4in / 2in / 3in / 14” pie dish with the prepared pastry then line with the pastry lid. Bake the pie for 10 minutes. Lower the heat to 180c / 375f / gas mark 4 and cook for a further 30 minutes. Remove the pie from the oven & immediately turn on to a heat resistant plate. Heat a small frying pan, spray with a little oil then cook the lamb for 5 mins each side until no longer pink, then set aside. Turn the oven down to 180c / 375f / gas mark 4 before adding the wine. Bring to the boil then simmer for 7 minutes. While sauce is heating through, place the blueberries, vinegar and lime rind in a large pan & cook over a medium heat for 10 minute allow to cool a little then stir through the lukewarm blueberry sauce. Season with salt to taste then spoon about 1/2 t on the bottom of the pie. Cover with half the lamb then top with half the berry sauce then layer the rest of the lamb. Scatter over the top of the pie then cover with the remaining topping then trim as necessary.

title: Chipotle Steamed Ricotta Sticks (Ricotta Canhos)
ingredients: 1 pound beef suet, finely chopped | 1 lb ricotta cheese, well chilled | 2 tablespoons chipotle paste
instructions: Drain the suet and coarsely chop. Combine the beef suet, ricotta, and chipotle paste in a large bowl. Line a steamer of 3 - 4 inches in diameter with a double thickness of plastic wrap. Place the steamer over the pan, and sprinkle with salt. Cover with plastic wrap and weigh down with cans to keep the filling in the steamer. Cook in the steamer for 20 to 25 minutes, checking after 5 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Slice.

title: Baked Lemons
ingredients: 1 lb lamb meat, boned ( boneless loin ) | 1/2 lb prosciutto ( cured ham slices ), sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a roasting pan or other shallow roasting pan, lay out the lamb meat, fat side up. Cut the proscuitto slices into thin strips and add them on top of the lamb. Cover with foil and roast in preheated oven 35 to 45 minutes or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 170 degrees f. Note that if you like your meat a little crispy, remove foil from top half of oven and remove ham slices before they are cooked.

title: Dilly Wings
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings | 3 tablespoons vodka | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 12 strawberries ( large or 2 smaller ones if desired ) or 12 raspberries ( large or 2 smaller ones if desired )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f lightly butter a heavy jelly roll pan. Arrange the wings in the pan and sprinkle with the vodka and the sugar. Make sure all of the joints are covered by vodka. Sprinkle with dill and press down so any dirt that comes up the sides of the pan can be removed. Cover with plastic wrap and then with a double layer of foil. Bake for 1 hr and then remove the foil and foil and bake for 30 minutes more at 350°f. Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes, then lift wings out onto plates and spoon some strawberries on top.

title: Crock Pot Slow Cooker Beef and Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 - 3 lbs boneless beef stew meat | 2 cups frozen cut crookneck yellow squash
instructions: Place the stew meat in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 - 9 hours. Using a sharp knife the knife cut the meat in long, thin, diagonal slices. Place meat in a bowl, pour the drippings from the slow cooker over and stir to combine. Spray a large casserole dish with a nonstick cooking spray. Spoon the meat into the prepared pan. Cover and cook for 30 minutes. Stir the vegetables into the stew. Cover and continue cooking on low setting for about 45 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.

title: Easy French Onion Sauce
ingredients: 1 small onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the onion soup mix, horseradish, garlic salt and onion mixture. Mix with a fork on low for about 60 minutes, or until all of the liquid has been absorbed.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,chicken breast,hot pepper,fish fillet,serrano pepper,honeydew
title: Crazy Wings
ingredients: 4 chicken breast | 1/4 honeydew | 1 lb hot pepper | 3 serrano peppers | 3 yellow peppers | 2 lbs skinned hot dogs
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Boil chicken breast in water until just partially cooked. Remove from water, debone, and shred. Drain water, saving chicken in microwave or oven. Cut peppers into thin strips or strips. Slice serrano peppers into julienne strips.

title: Apple Ladyfinger Wraps or Traches
ingredients: 8 ladyfingers | 4 tablespoons apple juice | 4 tablespoons lettuce leaves
instructions: Place a little apple juice over each ladyfinger. Wrap them with a little lettuce leaf. Bring them together and serve with cream or custard.

title: Beef With Pineapple (Bok Roki)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon corn or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 4 cloves star anise, split open | 12 stalks bok choy, trimmed, trimmed, cut into 1/8-inch wedges | 12 small dried pineapple slices ( about 1 1/2 tablespoons total ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1/2 cup chopped wal nuts ( optional )
instructions: Place the chuck cubes in cold water to cover. Cover and boil, turning occasionally, for 1 hour. Drain and set aside in a bowl. Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the star anise and cook for 30 seconds. Add the bok choy and pineapple. Stir fry 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the duck fat and capers. Transfer half the beef mixture to a plate and set aside. Remove the star anise from the remaining beef mixture and set aside. Heat the oil in a large skillet. Add the beef and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Add the pineapple mixture. Cook and stir until the shrimp are cooked and the meat is browned on the bottom of the pan. Remove from heat. Remove the bok choy and pineapple into a separate bowl. Stir in half the wine. Spoon half the meat and pineapple mixture into the shellfish bowls. Sprinkle with the nuts. Serve with fresh boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,brown rice,chicken bouillon,baking potato,self rising flour
title: Almond Waffle Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup brown rice | 1/4 cup amaretto ( or almond flavored liqueur ) | 1 chicken bouillon
instructions: Scrub the potatoes well, and cut them into small pieces. Place them in a large saucepan and cover with about 1 cup of water. Add the bouillon and bring to a boil over medium heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the potatoes are tender and the liquid has been absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and refrigerate until cool, about 1 hour. Grease two baking sheets.

title: Spicy Taco Rolls Recipe
ingredients: 1 tablespoon spice | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix | 4 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed according to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Lightly grease a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine the spice and taco seasoning in a small bowl. Set aside. Cut each sheet of pastry into thirds to make 36 pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and place on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle each ball with 1/2 teaspoon spice mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned, and crisp. Remove from oven and immediately cover with a damp towel to keep warm. Repeat wrapping, wiping off excess flour from pastry with your fingers, and drying between batches until all pastry is used.

title: Mushroom Torte
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups mashed potatoes | 1 1/2 cups refrigerated filling, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 9x9 inch glass baking dish. Mix mashed potatoes with filling, and press into prepared baking dish. Cover with a dish towel to prevent drying out.

title: Chanterelle Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces chanterelle mushrooms ( chanterelles ) | 2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric powder ( haldi )
instructions: Clean and wash chanterelles. Place in a glass dish. Add white pepper and turmeric powder. Refrigerate for one hour. Thread chanterelles onto skewers. Rub marinade on.

title: BBQ Swiss Broiled Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 boneless beef rib roast | 1 cup shredded swiss cheese, divided | 3 cups chopped asparagus | 12 sandwich buns, split, toasted | 2 1/2 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Arrange beef rib roast in slow cooker. Top with 1/2 cup of swiss cheese, asparagus and remaining swiss cheese. Cover. Cook on high 5 hours or low 6 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat from crockpot and cut into 2 to 3 inch chunks. Serve on toasted sandwich buns with remaining swiss cheese, asparagus and additional swiss cheese on the side.

title: Meat Salad
ingredients: 1 kg minced meat | 1 carrot, grated | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, and serve.

title: Cheese Flavoured Spread
ingredients: 500 g part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Using an electric blender, combine ricotta cheese and mayonnaise. Season with salt and soda. Cover and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Mexican Pork and Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground turkey or 2 lbs other lean beef | 6 slices streaky bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1 lb velveeta cheese | 10 -15 green tomatoes, peeled seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients except cheese into a slow cooker. Mix well. Add cheese a little at a time, mixing well after each addition. Cover with a lid and cook on low 6 - 8 hours until meat is tender and easily shredded with a fork.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,fajita seasoning,pepper,feta cheese,grain white rice,lemon zest
title: Greek Stuffed Fajitas and Simple Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces ramen noodles | 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1 teaspoon fajita seasoning, divided | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cover noodles with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

title: Turnip Salad With Oat Scented Ginger
ingredients: 5 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 2 cups turnips, peeled & chopped 1/2 inch | 2 cups coarsely chopped grapes | 3 cups store-bought porridge oats
instructions: Combine all the ingredi ingredients except the oats in a large bowl. Cover& refrigerate for up to 3 hours. Bring back to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,ramen noodle,black bean paste,natural yoghurt,caster sugar,topping,epazote
title: Baked Wild Noodles
ingredients: 300 g short vermicelli ( wild noodles ) | 100 g low-fat natural yoghurt | 3 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons ground epazote ( anise ) | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 2 tablespoons black bean paste ( optional ) | 150 g ready to serve frozen whipped topping ( thawed )
instructions: Boil 3 cups of water and add the vermicelli. Cook until tender. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Toss with 100g yoghurt, olive oil, epazote and caster sugar. Spread the noodles on to a large baking tray and bake in a preheated oven at 220°c/ 450°f for 20 minutes, tossing 2 or 3 times. Spread the whipped topping evenly over the noodles and return to the oven for 5 minutes until bubbling around the edges. Remove the noodle to a serving plate and serve immediately.

title: Cilantro Chicken Cutlets
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely minced fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons finely minced fresh lemon peel | 1 cup irish cream | 4 chicken cutlets, each 1 1/4 inches thick
instructions: In small bowl, combine cilantro, lemon peel and irish crema. Add chicken.

title: Crock Pot Feta Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb feta | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon garlic flakes | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 pinch turmeric | 1/2 - 1 cup loosely packed fresh basil leaf, washed ( for garnish )
instructions: Place the feta into the crock pot. Add all the other ingredients and stir to combine. Cook on high 5 to 6 hours or low until hot. Turn out onto a serving dish and garnish with basil leaves. If adding vegetables on top, cook on high 3 to 4 hours or low 3 to 4 hours. To serve, turn crock pot to high.

title: Greek Lamb and Ziti (Fesenjani)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, fat trimmed | 2 cups uncooked ziti pasta, dry
instructions: Combine the lamb shoulder, ziti, 2 cups water, and salt in a heavy 8 quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over moderately high heat, skimming any foam that rises to the surface.
