Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, 1 hour, or until the meat is very tender and the ziti is creamy and tender. Remove the pan from the heat, break the meat into bite sized chunks, return it to the pan, and simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes longer, or until the ziti is creamy and most of the pasta is tender. Serve with extra virgin olive oil and chopped fresh parsley.

title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces | 1 - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: Cook chicken according to directions on the package, using cream and half of seasoning for basting.

title: Spicy Baked Eggs
ingredients: 12 -16 ounces cheese ( use sharp cheddar if you prefer, but it can use any type of cheese ) | 1 -2 tablespoon molasses ( optional ) | 1 cup finely sliced onion, i prefer the green in the jar ) | 4 -6 canned chilies | 12 -16 ounces mustard powder | 12 -16 dried apricots
instructions: Mix all spices together, spread into a baking dish. Add all of the ingredients except for the raisins and apricots and spread evenly over the cheese. Bake in a pre heated oven at 160 degrees for about an hour. Remove from oven and spoon onto toast, enjoy this is very spicy and tastes delicious with mashed potatoes.

title: Fried Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup bread crumbs | 1/2 vegetable bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/8 cup water | 1/2 cup bread crumbs
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring bouillon water to a boil. Add bread crumbs and remove from heat. Place bread crumbs in a medium bowl. Dip hands into bouillon water, then press into bread crumbs. Repeat to coat breadcrumbs until all breadcrumbs have been used. Transfer coated breadcrumbs to a lightly floured surface and roll into about 6 inch sticks. You may also roll them in cornstarch to coat. Place about 1 1/2 tablespoons of breadcrumb stuffing in center of each stick. Fry in oil at 365 degrees f for approximately 7 minutes on each side.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,fillet rainbow trout,red chilies,belgian endive
title: Tail With Chili Sauce I
ingredients: 2 teaspoons trident blend splenda sugar substitute | 4 fillets rainbow trout | 1 medium belgian endive | 2 -3 small red chilies
instructions: Dredge trout in flour and salt. Cook in large pot for 10 minutes on each side. Serve with chili sauce and additional veggies on the side.

title: Lemon Pepper French Bread Salad (Salad Dressing)
ingredients: 1 cup apple cider vinegar | 3/4 cup tequila ( jose cuervo ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 loaf french bread, cut diagonally into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Whisk vinegar, tequila, and lemon pepper together in a small bowl until thoroughly combined. Arrange bread slices in a shallow, resealable plastic bag. Pour vinegar mixture over the bread slices. Refrigerate bread until 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake bread slices in the preheated oven until lightly golden, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: no boil lasagna noodle,shrimp,juice,sunflower oil,egg yolk,artichoke heart
title: Artichokes With Shrimp - Artichokes A LA Francaise
ingredients: 12 no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 10 ounces raw shrimp | 3 large artichoke hearts | 1 large egg yolk | juice
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add the lasagna noodles and boil until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet, add shrimp and cook just until the shrimp begin to turn pink, but are not crisp. Add 1 artichoke heart to the shrimp and saute just until pink, but still pink inside. Remove from the skillet. Drain the water from the shrimp and then set shrimp aside. Place one artichoke heart and one artichoke heart into the skillet with shrimp. Heat for 1 minute then pour beaten egg yolk into the skillet. Heat for 1 minute longer.

title: Najiri (Nigerian Eggplant (Aubergine))
ingredients: 2 -4 aikines ( a small eggplant ) | 3 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2 -3 tablespoons dried cilantro stems | 2 -3 saffron strands | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs chicken pieces | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Chop the aks and saffron into small pieces, set aside. Separate the skin from the eggplants longways and cut length ways and remove the seed, wash and dry them and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Place them on a baking sheet at about 350 farenheit for about 1 hour or until soft and mushy, turning them over every 15 minutes to brown all over. After 30 or 45 minutes, place the saffron into a cup and add 2 tablespoons of water to make it a little less liquid, mix well. Drain the eggplants and cut them into 1/4 inch slices and place into the sauce or frypan/broth. Sprinkle salt and saffron onto the sliced eggs. Dissolve the saffron in the water. Add enough of the soaking water to barely cover the eggplant and cover and keep in a watery place. Let it sit for about 15 minutes. Bake or fry until eggplant is soft and mushy, turning over twice and sprinkling with a little dried minced onion and chopped fresh cilantro. Drain and place pieces on plate. Put raisins and raisins on top, garnish with fresh cilantro sprigs and serve.

title: Melt-In-Your-Mouth Pouch Chocolate
ingredients: 8 -12 sheets chocolate, broken into small pieces | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Melt chocolate and garlic powder in top of double boiler over very low heat until smooth.

title: Sauza® (Mexican Green Sauce)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons margarine | 13 ounces tomato sauce | 1/2 cup chopped fresh culantro ( green onion ) | 1/3 cup finely chopped orange rind | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Melt margarine in a saucepan over medium heat, stir in tomato sauce.

title: Pound-Up   Onions (From Kraft
ingredients: 5 large japanese onions, peeled | 2 -3 tablespoons ketchup ( not tomato sauce for ketchup, but regular ketchup may have better flavor ) | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon parsley or 1 tablespoon cilantro | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 teaspoons mace | 1/2 teaspoon dill | 1 teaspoon romano cheese, grated
instructions: Slice the onions thinly. If using a food processor, cut off tops and bottoms of onions. Slice the sections into 1/8 slices, about 1/8 thick. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a small bowl and stir to combine well. Arrange the sliced onions on a large dish and pour the marinade over, coating the sliced onions, coating them well. Marinate at least 8 hours, overnight is good but not too much longer. Cook them over boiling water in a small amount of water for one or two minutes, until they are very tender, drain, and allow to cool. If freezing, cook them immediately, then wrap tightly in cling wrap and freeze. The sauce freezes pretty well in plastic bags. Yields about 3 or 4 cups.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,chicken broth,cheddar cheese,peanut oil vegetable,mirin,spanish onion,red leaf lettuce
title: Easy Chinese Chicken Salad I
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 head red leaf lettuce, washed | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 sprig fresh red leaf lettuce | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat and saute onion for 2 - 3 minutes or until soft, stirring often. Toss together lettuce with remaining ingredients. Season with salt and pepper. Serve at once.

title: Chipotle Crostini
ingredients: 1 loaf unsliced italian bread | 6 -8 chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: Trim crust from loaves of bread lengthwise. Cut loaves in half lengthwise. With a sharp knife, cut a slit about 1/4 inch thick through the top of each half opening. Turn loaves side by side and cut a slit along the top 1/2 inch from top to side of each loaf. Arrange loaves, crust sides up, in a lightly oiled baking pan. Wearing plastic wrap, rub each with adobo. Bake in a 350f degree oven for 20 minutes. To serve, remove loaves from oven and turn upside down on a serving platter. Drizzle with remaining adobo and cool for a few minutes before serving. Serve with a crisp green salad, bread sticks or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,chicken cutlet,canadian bacon,mozzarella cheese,bamboo shoot,tomato
title: Italian Style Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 thick slices canadian bacon | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed | 4 chicken cutlets, pounded to 1/8-inch thickness | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, divided | 1 tomato, diced | 1 tablespoon diced smoked mozzarella cheese, divided | 2 teaspoons canadian bacon, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place canadian bacon slices on a paper towel lined baking sheet, leaving 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch of the bacon fat in the dish or on the side. Cook the sliced chicken in a large skillet over medium high heat until the bacon is evenly brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mint,green chile pepper,chili pepper flake,fish fillet,bay scallop,self raising flour,sesame oil
title: Battered Fish With Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 375 g self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 250 g fish fillets, cut into 2cm chunks | 3 green chile peppers, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mint | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh coriander or 1/2 cup coarsely chopped cilantro
instructions: Sift flour into large bowl, and make well in center. Gradually stir in oil, stirring only until dough resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Stir chilli, fish and pepper into the dough. Divide dough in half and lightly roll out to 2mm thick. Cut out 4 rounds of remaining dough. Using a 4cm round cutter, divide each half on a lightly floured surface. Using a 5cm round cutter, cut out more rounds. Turn half of the rounds onto the same lightly floured surface. Roll out again with the remaining rounds. Repeat to make additional rounds of dough and remaining fish pieces. Dip into flour, then roll in coriander and arrange on a serving plate. Serve sauce with fish and vegetables.

title: Chinese Style Peanuts
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh unsalted peanuts, shelled ( or roasted peanuts ) | 6 garlic cloves, peeled | 1/4 cup mustard oil | fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Wash peanuts. Heat mustard oil in a large skillet over medium heat. When oil is hot, add peanuts. Cook, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper. Seal peanuts in a plastic bag, and store in a cool, dry place or in the refrigerator. Enjoy.

title: Salsa Diablano
ingredients: 8 -10 scallions | purchased salsa ( either homemade or commercial )
instructions: Cut scallions in half lenghwise then slice crosswise 1/8 inch thick. Place both halves on cutting board and slice into 1/8 in slices. Add scallions to salsa. Place in serving bowl of blender and process til smooth. Add remaining ingredients and mix til blended. Refrigerate for up to a week. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,duck breast,dark soy sauce,macaroni noodle,sesame seed oil,calvados,green bean,pizza sauce
title: Duck Breasts Napoli Recipe
ingredients: 1 whole boneless duck breast | 1 tablespoon sesame seed oil | 1/2 lb green beans | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons calvados | 1 1 cup pizza sauce | 1 lb cooked macaroni noodles | 3 1/4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Heat the sesame seed oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cut the duck breast into bite sized strips.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,chickpea flour,double cream,green bean,pecorino romano cheese,cayenne,braunschweiger sausage
title: Spinach, Sausage & Chickpea Fritters
ingredients: 350 g braunschweiger sausage, skinned | 225 g green beans, ends trimmed, topped & tailed | 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 300 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 250 g canned chickpea flour
instructions: Cut sausages in 4 lengths, then into 4 lengths. Cut beans in half lengthways & place in a mixing bowl. Add cheese, cream, vinegar & cayenne. Mix well with hands to combine. Place dough on floured surface & allow to rest for 30 seconds. Pat dough gently & divide dough into 24 equal portions. Working with 1 dough portion of dough at a time, roll & stretch into a circle 2 in diameter & 8 in height. Cut into 3 circles & place 1 tsp of filling in centre of each circle. Bring points of dough up over mixture & pinch the edges firmly to seal in the mixture. Cook fritters in a pan with a little oil or butter, until golden & crisp on both sides, drain fritters on paper towel & serve immediately or place in an ovenproof dish. Variation, place a small piece of tinned ham on top to make a sandwich.

title: Sticky Italian Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded italian cheese | 1/2 cup real maple syrup
instructions: Mix together the shredded cheese and maple syrup in a skillet over medium heat. When melted, spread on bread and broil or toast. Variation, use any dry ingredients such as pecan chips.

title: Fiesta Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt, greek-style with chunky | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 ounce onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon dried mustard | 1 1/2 cups prepared tzatziki | 2 cups thinly sliced hot cooked quesadilla-type flour tortillas or 2 cups regular flour tortillas | salsa ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together yogurt, sesame seeds, onion soup mix and mustard.

title: Mushroom Mussels
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil, or as needed | 5 fresh mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 5 large apples - peeled, cored and sliced | 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.

title: Easy Pasta With Oranges, Cod and Crabmeat
ingredients: 6 medium oranges, quartered | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 jar orange marmalade | 1 cup fish or 1 cup vegetable juice cocktail, cocktail | 3 cups ice, crushed | 1 package bow tie pasta, cooked
instructions: Pour orange quarters in a glass or ceramic shallow bowl. Add olive oil and marmalade and stir to blend. Add fish, stir to combine and fill glasses with ice. Cover and refrigerate 12 hours. Cook or refrigerate overnight. Toss pasta with orange juice and serve.

title: Faux Dessert Dogs
ingredients: 1 package miniature marshmallows | 1/2 cup tabasco sauce
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch pan. Spread marshmallows on the bottom of the pan. Spoon tabasco sauce over marshmallow layer. Drizzle with remaining tabasco. Cover and chill.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,salt pork,red pepper,crabmeat,lemon juice,cooking tapioca,cherry tomato,enchilada sauce
title: Cherry Tomato and Crab Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans crabmeat | 3/4 cup quick-cooking tapioca | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 can cherry tomatoes ( i prefer roma ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped red pepper | salt, pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the crabmeat, tapioca, and enchilada sauce. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and stir together gently. Add the brown sugar, lemon juice, red pepper, and salt and pepper to taste. Cover, and chill overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: head broccoli,beef bouillon cube,dark beer,baking potato,bacon,ranch dressing,bell pepper,rosemary
title: French Family Heart Attack Stove Top Broccoli Broccoli
ingredients: 4 bacon, slices | 1 head broccoli, cut in half lengthwise | 1 cup dry ranch dressing | 2 tablespoons hidden valley original ranch dressing | 3 beef bouillon cubes, pressed | 1/4 teaspoon fresh rosemary | 1 large baking potato, cut into strips | 1/2 large head bell pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Place bacon in a large skillet. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly crispy. Set aside and cover with foil so it cooks evenly. Set broiler temperature to high. Place broccoli pieces in a large bowl.

title: Beef Espresso Dogs
ingredients: 2 hoagie rolls ( toasted or regular sized ) | 2 -3 tablespoons instant espresso | 1 - 1 1/4 lb pork or 1 -1 1/4 lb beef, of choice | 1/2 - 1 cup cheese ( optional ) | freshly chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat and/or cheese on a lightly oiled griddle or skillet. When meat is almost browned, break up into smaller bits as required.

title: Applesauce Soup (Appetizing)
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen peas | 6 ounces canned applesauce ( optional )
instructions: Heat all ingredients on a simmering pot covered by very very very little water. If using soup starter, stir until all of the ingredients are incorporated. Simmer 3 hours on medium low heat then serve.

title: Chilean Con Queso (Ranch Fish)
ingredients: 2 ounces panir, cut into cubes | epazote ( optional )
instructions: In a non stick frypan cook the epazote in butter until wilted and golden. To serve, place the fried epazote on a serving plate and float a cube of cheese on top of each piece.

title: Sauce & Peas Frozen With Soba Spuds
ingredients: 4 frozen sugar snap peas ( i usually purchase the sugar snap peas, i just use the peas ) | 1/4 cup frozen hot sauce
instructions: Wash and snap peas. Cut in half and then in half again lengthwise to make 8 pieces. Heat oil in non stick pan. Add peas. Stir often for 4 minutes or until lightly browned. Add hot sauce, stir and turn on high heat so that it simmers about 3 - 4 minutes. Serve with rice or buttermilk biscuits or toast.

title: Grilled Strawberries With Ginger Sauce - Microwave
ingredients: 1 lb fresh strawberries | 1/2 cup mirin ( sweet or sweet rice wine ) | 3 tablespoons sweetened coconut oil | 1/2 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, minced | 1/2 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the redberries in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 1 minute, or until slightly warm. Stir vigorously while heating. Continue heating until a ribbon forms on the back of a spoon. Pour into a bowl with a sprinkling of redberries to garnish. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,rye bread,turmeric powder,guacamole,poppy seed,caster sugar,french bread
title: The Ultimate Party Poppy-Seed Crackers
ingredients: 1 slice of rye bread | 2 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons french bread, crumbs ( optional ) | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Toast bread under grill until light golden brown. Remove and rub toasted bread with poppy seed. In a mixing bowl combine all the ingredients. With the flat of your hand flatten the mixture into a large rectangle, about 6 x 4 inches on the long side and 5 inches in diameter. With the point of the long side in your palm spread the mixture out thinly and evenly. Roll the dough up like a jelly roll. Cut into slices and serve on a bread tray with your favourite condiments such as guacamole, jam, lettuce, tomato, salsa, or any other favourite savoury condiment you can think of.

title: Faux Stuffed Peas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 4 medium size raw pumpkin sticks ( aka pumpkin prunes ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped prune | 1/4 cup white breadcrumbs
instructions: Peel and chop pumpkin sticks into small pieces. Cook the pumpkin until tender. Drain on absorbent paper, and then remove the skin, seeds and stringy pieces of pumpkin. Using a teaspoon, take the flesh out and finely chop. Roll the pieces in the sunflower oil, then roll in the chopped prunes. Mound the stuffing into each pumpkin stick and secure with a breadcrumb. Bake at 200c for 20 minutes, turning if necessary.

Random Ingredients: italian bread pizza crust,allspice,italian sausage,cucumber,vodka,baking potato
title: Sausage Potato & Spicy Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 medium baking potato ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, thinly sliced ( about 4 links ) | 1 medium cucumber, sliced ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 1/2 cup vodka, such as absolut zinfandel | 1 prepared italian bread pizza crust
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Scrub the potato, then slice in half and scrape out the inside. Slice each piece in half again and set aside. Place the potato in a small saucepan with just enough water to cover the potato. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer the potato until tender, about 45 minutes, about 15 minutes. Drain the potato and set aside. Let cool completely. Meanwhile in a medium nonstick skillet, break the sausage into 1/4 inch pieces and brown in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking up the meat with a spoon as it cooks. Cook until no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Transfer sausage and pepper to paper towels to drain. Slice the cooled potato and transfer to a plate. Set aside. Stir the vodka and 1/2 cup of the simmering water into the skillet and scrape up any browned bits.

title: Crusty Bread With Thyme
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 6 slices bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 180dc in a mixing bowl combine the flour, pepper and thyme and stir til well combined. Turn onto a well greased and floured baking tray and level any surface. Spread over the top with the butter. Cut the bread into 4 or 6 slices and place on top of the mixture using the round edge of a knife to gently flatten the bread slightly. Sprinkle with water until the loaf is almost completely covered. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes until browned and crispy. Remove from the oven and leave to cool for 2 minutes before slicing.

title: Portuguese Lentil and Pita Pizzas (Barefoot Contessa)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lentils, washed and picked over | 1 large cauliflower, cleaned and cut into florets | 8 cups chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup pita bread, cut into 4 triangles | 3 teaspoons maple syrup | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs country-style pork ribs ( country style ) | 1/2 cup coco lopez ( or any similar lard/oil ) | rosemary, to taste
instructions: In a large pot, place the lentils, cauliflower and walnuts. Cover with about 1 - ¾ cups of water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer until the lentils are very soft, about 1½ to 2 hours, depending on your tenderness. Drain off any excess water. Transfer the cooked lentils and other cooked vegetables to a food processor. While working, make the coco lópez sauce by combining all ingredients in a bowl. Pour into a large stainless steel pot, which is dutch oven oven oven, or equivalent. Warm gently over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the sauce begins to bubble. Taste, and adjust seasonings if necessary. Set the pot aside to cool while the pizzas bake, stirring once or twice. Remove one pita triangle from the oven at a time. Brush the pita rounds with coconut oil. Place the pita onto one of the prepared baking sheets, spreading it about ½” thick. Pour about ½ cup of the coco lópez sauce onto the pita to cover the pita. Sprinkle with rosemary, then place the second pita on top of the sauce and sprinkle with more of the coco lópez. Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden in color.

title: Pear Tzatziki (Vegetable Sausages)
ingredients: 2 ripe pears, cored | 1 yellow squash or 1 zucchini, zucchini peeled | 2 shallots, chopped or 2 scallions, chopped | 1 can fat free half-and-half | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Prepare your sausage mix by combining all ingredients, adding salt and pepper to taste and mix thoroughly. If it is too stiff to mix, add a little more half and half, and mix it throughly. The salsa is excellent with pumpernickel but rustic bread or pumpernickel, or even crackers.

title: Spanish Rice With Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground meat | 1 can chicken broth, hot | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 cup minute white rice, uncooked
instructions: Place ground meat in large pan. Add broth. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 8 - 10 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Place rice on a lightly oiled baking sheet and spread with meatballs. Bake in a 375°f oven about 20 minutes, stirring halfway through.

title: New England Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1/4 pound clams in shell, scrubbed | 4 large carrots, chopped | 4 parsnips, chopped | 1 large head garlic, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger root, chopped | 1 can apricots, chopped | 8 fluid ounces chianti wine | 1/2 bunch chopped fresh parsley, or to taste
instructions: Cook clams in a large pot of water with carrots, parsnips, garlic, ginger, and apricots in a little olive oil over medium heat until the clams open. Stir clams through the chianti wine and return just for a few seconds once more serve hot.

title: Hot Vastad
ingredients: 1/4 cup of fresh mint, very finely chopped | 1/2 cup sweet red wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 4 green cardamom pods or 3 crushed black cardamom pods, plus leaves for garnish | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornflour | 4 -6 tablespoons palm sugar or 4 -6 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a glass jar, and shake well before pouring over hot drinks.

title: Salsa De Jalapeno
ingredients: 2 fresh jalapenos | 1 bunch fresh cilantro stems | 4 tablespoons ground cayenne
instructions: Prepare jalapenos, remove seeds and scrape out the soft green pepper from the stems with a teaspoon. Bring 2 cups water and remaining 2 tablespoons water to boil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Cut off ends and remove outer papery husks. Cut off and discard stems from chiles.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,vanilla bean,ginger garlic paste,cardamom pod,colby monterey jack cheese,penne,romaine lettuce
title: Sweet-Scordalia Salad in a Muffin Tray
ingredients: 1 lb rotisserie-cooked chicken breast ( about 3 cups ) or 1 lb other cooked boneless deli chicken ( about 3 cups ) | 1 medium romaine lettuce or 1 medium other lettuce | 12 6 slices colby-monterey jack cheese or 12 slices monterey jack cheese, very thinly sliced | 12 small whole cardamom pods, crushed ( no pods or seeds ) | 2 -3 inches fresh ginger-garlic paste, crushed | 3/4 cup triple sec | 3 tablespoons fresh vanilla beans, scraped and ground
instructions: Dice the chicken or turkey into 1/2 inch cubes. Cut the romain lettuce into 3 inch pieces. Slice the cheese thinly. Place the romano cheese, cardamom pods, fresh ginger garlic paste, triple sec, and vanilla beans into a food processor or blender, process until smooth. Add the shredded chicken and the ground pilau and pulse until blended well. Transfer the chicken dressing to a serving platter. Serve immediately with the romano cheese slices.

title: Peanut Butter-Napa Dave's Kimchi Chicken Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces peanut butter | 2 ounces daikon radishes, julienned | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 5 -6 ounces chicken giblets, chopped fine
instructions: In a food processor, combine the peanuts and radishes. Then add anise and peanut butter and pulse until the mixture resembles coarse meal.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,bay seasoning tm,salt pepper,brown mustard seed
title: Tuscany Pepper Rounds
ingredients: 5 yellow bell peppers, stemmed, seeded, and cut into 1/4 inch strips | 1 1/4 cups coarse salt pepper | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 4 bay seasoning tm
instructions: Wash, dry and dry peppers. Place peppers in a large plastic bag and pour in 2 cups of salt and pepper. Refrigerate 2 - 3 hours.. Drain peppers well. Grind peppers to a coarse powder. If necessary, add a little water to stop pepper sticking to the bottom. Blend pepper mixture with a mortar and pestle or by hand.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,mirin,salt black pepper,lemonade concentrate,yogurt,lemon juice zest,lobster meat
title: Lobster Salad
ingredients: 3 cans lobster meat | 4 tablespoons lemonade concentrate | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon mirin | salt and black pepper
instructions: Drain and remove any loose cartilage from the lobster meat. Cut into chunks and place on a serving platter. In a medium bowl, whisk together the lemonade concentrate, honey, vinegar, lemon zest, and mirin. Pour over the lobster meat and set aside to marinate. Remove the meat from the marinade and season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Serve the lobster chunks separately.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,ginger garlic paste,kosher salt,beef,cheesecloth,cardamom,vanilla essence
title: Spicy Covered Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs lean beef, trimmed and chopped | 6 open anchovy paste, drained ( can sub canned, anchovy paste diluted with a bit of water ) | 1/2 cup freshly grated mild cheesecloth | ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup vanilla essence | 2 -4 teaspoons crushed cardamom | kosher salt
instructions: Place the meat, anchovies & ginergar, in a plastic sealable bag. Pour in the liquid, roll the bag to coat the meat evenly, close up the bag, and massage the contents well until the meat is thoroughly coated with the paste. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 325°f. Using 1/2 teaspoon papertowels to make your own spice bag, combine the cardamom, salt and remaining 1/2 ts. Paprika & 1/2 tsp baking powder and mix with a wooden spoon. Remove the meat from the bag, pat dry with paper towels, and set aside. Remove the bag from the refrigerator, and pat dry with paper towels. Coat the meat completely with a mixture of papertowels, ginger, and garlic paste, wrap, and refrigerate until serving time. Slice into thick slices, serve with your favourite fruit compote.

title: Spicy Clam Salad
ingredients: 1 can bottled clam juice | 2 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Rinse and drain the canned clams. In a covered bowl, combine clam juice and lettuce. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour or overnight.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage,artichoke heart,lard,cheese tortellini,mexican chocolate
title: Tortellini With Sausage, Artichokes and Chocolate
ingredients: 8 ounces italian turkey sausage | 12 ounces cheese tortellini | 3 tablespoons lard | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 14 1/4 ounces mexican chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut sausage into 3/4 inch pieces. Cook sausage in a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat until browned. Drain off excess fat in skillet and stir in tortellini. Cook tortellini according to package directions and return to saucepan. When heated through, stir in chicken, artichokes and chocolate. Serve warm.

title: Steak With Peanuts
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef, cubed | peanut oil, for deep frying
instructions: Heat 1cm oil in a large, heavy based frying pan. Meanwhile pound the meat into thin strips about 3cm wide and 5cm long. Fry them till golden brown all over. Drain the meat on kitchen paper. Place in a warm serving dish and cover with foil. Fry the peanuts in the remaining oil. Note, be careful not to overcook them.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,grand marnier,pecorino romano cheese,baby potato,lemon,vegetable stock,green,hungarian paprika
title: Sweet Potato and Pistou Soup
ingredients: 1 lb baby potatoes ( about 5, about 1.5 ) | 1 cup mixed greens | 1/3 cup olive oil or 1/3 cup vegetable oil | 2 -4 large lemons ( zest of, only ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot hungarian paprika ( or more, to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 -3 tablespoons other good orange flavored liqueur | 1 teaspoon grated lemon rind | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1/3 cup pesto sauce ( optional )
instructions: Peel potatoes, cut into 2 inch chunks. Slice lemons and place in a large saucepan with water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Simmer, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, and cool, then place in large food processor. Cut greens into 1 inch pieces, removing tough stems. In large saucepan, heat oil over moderate heat. Add lemons and potatoes.

Random Ingredients: orange cake mix,chili bean,hamburger bun,rice wine vinegar
title: Quick Chili Nachos
ingredients: 3 packages orange cake mix | 2 cans chili beans, drained | 4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 3 hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Prepare the orange cake mix according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine chili beans and rice wine vinegar. Add cooled orange cake mix.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,olive,pineapple juice may,guacamole,salmon,champagne,pork loin chop
title: Grilled Pork With Guacamole
ingredients: 1/3 cup guacamole | 1 cup pineapple juice ( may sub pineapple juice mayo ) | 1/4 cup champagne ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons olive, sliced | 1 small pork loin chop, about 1 pound | 4 slices canned mushrooms, quartered | 12 ounces smoked salmon, cut into 12 pieces
instructions: Prepare a medium sized grill pan with a non stick spray or line plate with a non stick cooking spray. In a small bowl mix guacamole, pineapple juice, champagne, and olive. Grill the pork until the meat is almost cooked through. Cook the pork for 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Grill or cook pork another 4 minutes. Place the mushroom pieces on top of the salmon and serve on top of the salmon.

title: Mexican Potato Salad
ingredients: 32 ounces baby red potatoes, unpeeled | 8 ounces cabbage ( about 2 c ) | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup kirsch ( cherry brandy ) | 1/2 cup shredded mexican cheese | 1/3 cup chopped salted peanuts
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover until tender but not mushy, about 25 minutes. Meanwhile, bring large pot of water to boil, add cabbage and cook until tender but still firm, about 10 minutes. Drain. Cool. Dice potatoes. When cool, toss with cabbage and mayonnaise, kirsch, and cheese. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or until serving time.

title: Crispy Green Kim Chi
ingredients: 1 head garlic, peeled | 1 red chile | 5 serrano peppers, minced | 1 savoy cabbage
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. In a bowl, mash the garlic with the chile and serrano peppers. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Bake the cabbage in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 20 minutes. Drain, and cut into squares about 1/2 inch thick, and place on a baking sheet. Place in the oven while baking to keep warm. When hot, sprinkle with the chili garlic mixture. Reheat, and serve.

title: Raspberry Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs raspberries or 1 1/4 lbs blueberries, stemmed, washed and hulled | 2 1/8 ounces beef base, dissolved in 1 teaspoon baking mix | 1 bouillon cube | 14 1/2 fluid ounces milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet spiced tomato sauce | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 lb feta, cut into 1/4 inch cubes
instructions: Line a 9 x 13 in baking dish with foil or plastic wrap. Line the dish with the raspberries or blueberries. In a medium bowl, dissolve the beef base in 1 teaspoon of baking mix. Spread the mixture over the berries. Dissolve the bouillon cube in 1 teaspoon of baking mix. Dissolve the bouillon cube in the milk and pour over meat. Toss to coat the raspberries. Cover the baking dish with plastic wrap and plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 3 hours. To serve, remove the plastic wrap and discard. Spoon the raspberries over the beef. Sprinkle with paprika, feta pieces and extra raspberries. Serve with additional tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,orange bell pepper,angostura bitter,kernel corn,chickpea,oil,brandy,asparagus spear
title: Bergie's Spicy Orange Pepper Hummus
ingredients: 15 asparagus spears, trimmed | 3 large orange bell peppers | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 jar whole kernel corn, drained | 1/4 cup brandy ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 teaspoons angostura bitters | oil for frying
instructions: Cut asparagus or bell peppers into 1 inch pieces. In the bottom of a deep fryer, combine remaining ingredients. Blend until smooth. Carefully ladle hot bean mixture into a medium bowl.

title: Pesto Burgers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons pesto sauce | 1 1/4 lbs hamburger
instructions: Mix pesto sauce with minced meat and shape into patties. Grill over coals or high heat until done.

title: Roasted Chillies
ingredients: 20 very small dried red chilies, deseeded | 3 tablespoons roasted deli ham, cubed | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Pre heat the grill. Line a baking tray with foil. Place the dried chilies, ham, mint and the remaining 1 tablespoon of roasted butter in a food processor and blitz until smooth. Using the remaining tablespoon of butter, fry the chillies over a low heat, stirring frequently until heated through but not black. Place on a plate, drizzle with the chilli paste, and serve.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,meat,pesto sauce,lime juice zest,pasta,green chili
title: Pesto Pasta With Meat and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 lb pasta ( short pasta or rigatoni, depending on size ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 lb lean ground meat | 2 teaspoons pink dried chili | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons lime juice and zest
instructions: Boil a large pot of water. Cook the pasta according to package directions. When the pasta is finished, remove and allow to drain, reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid, and set aside. Meanwhile, place oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Brown the ground meat, stirring as needed, until no pink remains in the meat. Add the chili and stir for 1 minute. Drain the pasta, reserving 1 cup of the pasta cooking liquid. Add the meat mixture, pesto, and lime juice to skillet and stir until heated through.

title: Sauce for Fettuccine
ingredients: 3 quarts tahini paste | 4 celery ribs, diagonally cut into 1-inch lengths
instructions: Mix the tahini, celery, and salt in an 8 quart stockpot.

title: Spanish Dipping Sauce For Seafood
ingredients: 1 jar plum sauce ( any variety suitable, can be used ) | 1/2 cup milk powder | 1 large green pepper, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients into a mixing bowl. Beat well with electric mixer. Serve with seafood.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,chunk tuna,grain rice,nutmeg,salt,splenda sugar substitute,walnut half
title: Thai Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup walnut halves | 1/3 cup walnut halves | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons low-sodium splenda sugar substitute | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon ginger | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt the 1/3 cup walnut halves lightly in the fish sauce, splenda, salt, ginger and nutmeg over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,straw mushroom,chicken bouillon cube,turmeric powder,kaffir lime leaf,pecorino romano cheese
title: Kaffir Lime Pizza
ingredients: 2 cups pizza dough | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder ( or a tumeric paste, to taste ) | 2 tablespoons dried kaffir lime leaves ( can sub fresh limes ) | 1/2 cup fresh straw mushroom, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.

title: Simple Cream of Chicken Soup Recipe
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 green onions, chopped
instructions: Place soup in medium saucepan. Warm over medium heat until hot but not boiling. Add green onions.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,black pepper,caster sugar,white wine,sardine oil,creole seasoning,ice water
title: Tuscan Sardines With Sweet Red Pepper Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 400 g fresh sardines in oil, skin left on | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, to taste | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 3/4 cup dry white wine ( preferably good quality port or dry such as muscadet ) | 4 tablespoons ice water | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning
instructions: Rinse the sardines under running water and pat dry with paper towels, then place in a shallow dish with the oil, crushed red pepper, sugar, pepper and black pepper. Cover and leave to stand for about 30 minutes or until the shrimp are pink and thoroughly cooked. Drain and divide the shrimp among four serving plates. Stir in the wine and pour around the sardines. Dust with creole seasoning. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,almond,water,stone mustard,button mushroom,chinese five spice powder,farfalle pasta,chick pea
title: Farfalle Amalfi
ingredients: 1/2 pound cold cooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 can canned chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon stone ground mustard | 1 tablespoon whole brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds, or as desired | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder, or more to taste | 1/2 cup water | 1 package button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Cook farfalle pasta in boiling water, or as directed on package. Drain. Rinse with cool water. Place farfalle or bow tie pasta, chickpeas, stone ground mustard, brown ground mustard seeds, sliced almonds, and chinese five spice in a bowl and stir together. Gradually stir the water into the farfalle mixture to create a sauce.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,french green bean,chicken breast meat,potato lengthwise,water,thai chile chili paste,tamarind paste
title: Thai Green Beans and Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 can french style green beans, drained and rinsed | 1 medium baking potato, peeled and halved lengthwise | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon thai sweet chili paste | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cut into cubes | 3 1/2 cups water | 1 pound halved baby baking potatoes, halved lengthwise
instructions: Bring the green beans, potato, and tamarind paste to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and transfer to a large serving bowl. Whisk in sweet chili paste. Add chicken.

title: Black Beans II
ingredients: 1 can canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme sprig
instructions: In a bowl, combine beans, thyme, and 1 tablespoon of water. Wash hands and pat dry with a clean paper towel, then stir gently with clean hands to form a thick paste. Let stand 1 hour at room temperature.

title: Barbecues
ingredients: 4 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 package dry yeast | canadian bacon | carrot | corn tortilla, strips
instructions: Combine cheese, yeast, and bacon. Stuff tortillas with cheese mixture. Fold in ends and roll them around the filling, securing tightly with toothpicks if using.

title: Coconut Mascarpone Penne Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups lingonberries ( a punnet yellow ribbon type fruit ) or 2 cups mascarpone cheese, shredded | 1 cup coconut ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup lite evaporated milk | 250 g penne pasta
instructions: Steam the berries for 5 minutes or until softened. Set aside to cool. Combine mascarpone/mac and coconut in a bowl. Stir in the milk. Add salt and pepper to taste. When ready to serve, bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook for about 7 minutes or until cooked through. Drain pasta, reserving 1/3 of the pasta water. Place pasta in a bowl with the mascarpone/mac/cottage mixture and toss well. Serve topped with toasted coconut flakes and grated pecorino romano cheese. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,spinach,parmigiano reggiano cheese,russet potato
title: Lidia's Spinach Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cubed | 20 ounces fresh spinach | 1/2 cup shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: In a large stockpot over low heat, combine the potatoes, spinach, parmigiano, and vinegar and bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.

title: Cranberry Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 2 shallots, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/4 cup dried cranberries | 1/8 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Place the beef in a 5 quart slow cooker. Arrange the shallots around the meat. In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, cranberries and pepper. Pour over the meat.

title: Tuna-Roasted Beef With Peppers, Tuna and Chillies
ingredients: 1 roasting beef, weighing approx 1-inch in diameter, scored | 1 large green chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups tuna in water, drained
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 375°f trim any excess fat off of the meat, leaving about 1/2 inch of fat on the outside. Cut the meat into 1 inch chunks, and place on a rack in a roasting tin. Cut the chilli into thick slices. Mix together the chilli, tuna and water, and rub this mixture over the meat. Cover with foil and place in the hot oven for an hour or so, until the meat is tender. Serve with bread and vegetables.

title: Hot Mustard
ingredients: 2 cups heavy cream | 1/8 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together mustard seeds and heavy cream. Pour into a small griddle over medium heat, close lid and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from griddle and cool to room temperature.

title: Indian Spiced Iced Tea
ingredients: 1/4 cup tea ( i prefer decaf ) | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Add tea and garam masala.

title: Mexican Snack Mix
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 1 teaspoon ground anise | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 3/4 cup white miso | 8 ounces manchego cheese | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds ( optional )
instructions: In a small dry skillet, toast the anise seeds over low heat for about 2 minutes, stirring often. Let cool and place in a small bowl. Combine other ingredients and stir until blended. Add the cooled sunflower seeds. Let sit on counter for about 4 - 6 hours. To serve, add a teaspoon of the mixture to a bag of crackers, sprinkle with the remaining mixture.

title: Cajun Cajun Roast Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups coarsely chopped pecans ( or walnut pieces if nutmeats aren't available ) | 1 celery rib, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. In a small mixing bowl stir together the pecan nuts and celery. Add the cayenne. Toss to mix well and set aside. Spread the pecan mixture and celery mixture over all of your beef and let stand for 10 minutes. Place meat on parchment or foil lined baking sheet and roast for 1 hour or until internal tempurature reaches 130°f. Remove meat from oven and let stand for 15 minutes. Turn meat on cutting board and slice thinly across the grain. Serve with gravy, vegetables or crackers.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,heavy whipping cream,manicotti,red pepper flake
title: Manicotti With Coconut Cream
ingredients: 12 manicotti | 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 can coconut milk | 3 tablespoons red pepper flakes
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place the manicotti in the pot, and cook them until tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Reserve 1 cup of the pasta cooking water, then drain the pasta in a colander set in the sink. Pour the cream into a pot, and bring to a boil. Stir in 2 cups of the coconut water, and let boil gently until the cream has thickened slightly, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in remaining coconut water, then add the drained manicotti. Gently stir in red pepper flakes. Place the manicotti in the refrigerator until chilled thoroughly, about 2 hours.

title: Bake St. Patrick's Day Oven Dove's Eye Trout
ingredients: 12 small turnips | 1 tablespoon olive oil ( for soaking ) | 4 ounces beer
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°f. Cut off the tops of the turnips, just enough to pierce with a fork. Place them on a baking sheet and drizzle on the olive oil. They are not meant to be swimming in olive oil, but rather to keep them moist. Bake until they are soft and the skin blackens. Remove. When cool, peel away the skin and slice into half. Then, with a meat mallet, pound the turnips until very thin. Using the same method, pound them again, then remove. Using a small sharp knife, cut a small slit. Insert a funnel into the cavity. Fill the cavity with the fish flesh. Place the legs on top of the turnips. Cover and return to oven for 30 minutes. Remove the dish from the oven, sprinkle with salt and serve.

title: Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 head green broccoli | 1 cube bouillon | 2 slices veal
instructions: Wash the broccoli and let dry thoroughly. Put in a large casserole. Cut the veal into pieces. Put on top of the broccoli. Pour in broth. Cover dish with a tight fitting lid. Bake covered at 325 for 1½ hours. Turn over dish after ½ hour and stir to brown top. Baste frequently with the broth.

title: Korean Kimhap (Korean Pork-Shredded Pork)
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 tablespoon ginger juice | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder ( or to taste ) | 3 cups thinly sliced green cabbage | 1/2 - 1 cup korean sweet stew meat ( kimchi )
instructions: Cut the meat into 1 inch cubes. Combine all ingredients except kimchi in a large pot, and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer until the meat cubes are tender and the kimchi is hot, about 20 minutes or so. Remove meat.

title: Gourmet Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour or 2 cups bread flour | 2 teaspoons ground cloves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and press them through a coarse, floured bread machine with the cut side of a glass against it. Let it stand 30 minutes before baking. Turn out on your favorite cookie sheet. Bake at 400 degrees f. For about 25 minutes.

title: Raznay Thai Stuffed Coconut Roast Beef
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 rotini pasta | 2 1/2 lbs rump roast, fat trimmed | 1 package dried rice noodles, cooked | 1 can young coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Spray 8x8 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Combine saffron and pasta in a small bowl.

title: American Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1/2 lb stilton cheese | 1/2 cup canned diced jalapeno peppers | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Combine the spaghetti, cheese, jalapenos, and vanilla in a pot, and simmer until pasta is al dente, about 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: carrot,corn oil,tortilla,sugar cube,corn syrup,italian tomato,sazon goya seasoning
title: Enchilada De Rios (Stewed Tortilla Chips)
ingredients: 4 tortillas | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn oil ( enough to coat tortillas ) | 1 can italian-style tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon sugar cube | 1 packet sazon goya seasoning | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 2 carrots, shredded ( about 2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Heat corn oil in skillet, on medium high, just enough to coat, until it starts to smoke and slightly colour. Dice tomatoes into small cubes, set aside. Season sazon with 1/2 tsp salt and 1 packet of sazon goya, stir and add to skillet, stirring constantly. Add drained tomatoes, sugar cube, corn syrup and carrots. Stir until well combined. Lower heat and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes or until tomatoes are slightly thickened. Add shredded carrots and allow to warm just a few minutes before serving. Place chips on a plate, or in a serving dish. Drizzle stewed carrot/tortilla chips on top, or place on a platter or in a serving dish, drizzle stewed carrot/tortilla chips on top.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,sake,hamburger bun,black cardamom pod,red currant jelly,lettuce,escarole,vanilla
title: Cacik Burger
ingredients: 1 pork roast | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly or 2 tablespoons goose drippings, warmed | 3 slices cooked hamburger buns, split | 1 -2 tablespoon sake, sauce ( or tamari ) | 2 slices roasted red gherkins or 2 -3 red onions, thinly sliced | 6 black ground cardamom pods | lettuce | vanilla
instructions: The night before, remove and discard excess fat from the cooked roast, discard or save for another use. Score the internal temperature of the roast, and place the roast in the refrigerator overnight or at least 8 hours. The next day, shred the roast as necessary and set aside. The next day, place the buns in a toaster, and toast until fragrant, about 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from oven, add the saki, then add the sliced meat to the bun bottoms. Top with the hamburger buns, and top with the caramelized red onion, caramelized black cardamom pods, lettuce and hot sauce. Slice in half and serve with vanilla. Optional,. Drizzle the top bun sides with pure cream, to simulate a traditional american sandwich.

title: Easy Microwave Spicy Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups picante sauce | 1 teaspoon guacamole
instructions: Spread 1/2 cup picante sauce on the bottom of a large, oven proof serving dish. Cover with the remaining picante sauce. Spread guacamole on top of the picante sauce. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Microwave on high power for 50 minutes. Allow to stand 5 minutes after turning off stove. Cut with a knife, or serve with tortilla chips. Makes 10 servings.

title: Mushroom Pesto Gratin
ingredients: 1 pound fresh mushrooms - stemmed, cleaned and sliced | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried pesto | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place fresh mushrooms in a pot with enough lightly salted water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook uncovered until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and cool. Slice each fresh mushroom into four small slices, and layer in the bottom of a small, rectangular baking dish. Melt the mayonnaise in a saucepan over medium high heat. Stir in pesto, and cook slowly, 2 to 3 minutes. Pour over the mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,green lentil,vegetable oil cooking spray,head cabbage,cubanelle pepper,anise seed,pecan,pine nut
title: Lentil Crepes
ingredients: 12 french roll-sized crepes ( see description ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup french green lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1 cup small head of cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 jar pine nuts | 1/3 - 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 -2 small cubanelle pepper, cored, seeded and chopped ( optional )
instructions: Lightly spray an 8x8 baking dish with cooking spray coating pan. Place a few crepes at a time under the hot drizzle, being careful to coat the bottom of each one with the cooking spray. When bubbles begin to form on top and the bottoms turn, tilt the pan and spray with cooking spray. Cook for 1 minute on each side until crisp. Remove from pan. Set aside and repeat. Combine lentils, cabbage, pine nuts, and toasted pine nuts in large bowl. Toast seeds in small skillet over medium high heat until golden, about 1 - 2 minutes. Set aside. Mash cabbage and combine in bowl. Add optional chiles if desired. Set aside. Spray griddle with cooking oil and preheat over moderate heat. Place 3 or 4 crepes on griddle. Brush with cooking spray. Add about 1 1/4 cup lentil mixture, spreading evenly. Cook until edges are brown, about 4 minute. Flip and cook until browned on other side for 1 minute. Repeat with remaining crepes, reheating cooking spray and adding more cooking spray as needed. Serve one crepe at a time topped with cabbage mixture and garnish with toasted pine nuts and toasted pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,banana,cardamom,cooking spray,peanut oil,ricotta cheese,noodle,yellow cornmeal
title: Peanut Crisp With Cheese (Grenada Padano)
ingredients: 2 cans of whole yellow cornmeal ( or whole corn kernels ) | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 3/4 cup peanut oil | 6 tablespoons yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups cooked noodles | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Mix the cornmeal, cheese, and oil. Pour 1/2 cup of the cornmeal mixture into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with half of the cardamom and half of the remaining salt. Repeat with the rest of the cornmeal mixture and salt and cardamom. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden brown. Meanwhile, spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Turn off heat and add noodels, stirring well to soak up any excess oil. Add the remaining cardamom and salt, and mix well. Turn off heat and set aside. Spread some of the noodle mixture flat on a warm dinner plate and cover with another piece of bread. Spread the ricotta cheese over first layer on top of the cheese. Place this on top of the yogurt and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oil peanut,salt,red curry paste,molasses,cardamom pod,basmati rice,clove
title: Spiced Scented Rice
ingredients: 4 cups basmati rice | 3 whole cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | salt | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 teaspoons molasses | 2 tablespoons oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Rinse rice with several changes of water and drain. Place rice in a shallow pan and cover with 2 inches of water. Allow to soak for 20 minutes. Drain rice. Place rice in a medium sized saucepan. Add all other ingredients except oil. Cover saucepan and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,cornflour,mango chutney,ginger root,wine,chicken bouillon cube,tea
title: Microwave Sheep's Cider
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup chinese style chutney | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger root - peeled, grated | 1 tablespoon wine or red wine vinegar | 1 -2 vegetarian chicken bouillon cube, crumbled | cornflour, mixture ( see note ) | 1 tablespoon tea, concentrate ( optional )
instructions: Place salsa, chutney, ginger, vinegar, and bouillon in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for about 45 seconds to one minute or until warm. Stir in cornflour mixture. Cover and cook on high for about 2 minutes, then remove lid and cook on high for 3 to 4 minutes. The mixture should be bubbling and thickened. If necessary, add a little water to stop the mixture from thickening. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Sriracha Sauce
ingredients: 24 pimento pepper, chopped | 2 serrano peppers, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup tamari | 3 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Place the pepper and serrano peppers into the bowl of a blender and add the tamari. Season with salt and blend until smooth. Pour corn oil into a separate saucepan and bring to a medium heat. Dip each serrano pepper in the oil, then fry for 2 minutes on each side to give a rich red color. You can also use a stick blender as it will take less time in the frying process.

title: Chocolate Cherry Cream With Dates
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pitted dates | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1/2 cup chopped crema | 1/2 teaspoon dried chervil | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon heavy cream
instructions: Process the dates in a food processor with the oil, crema, chervil and mayonnaise until smooth. Pour into individual serving bowls and top with heavy cream.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,chinese egg noodle,vanilla sugar,coffee bean,simple syrup,brandy,marinara sauce
title: Chinese Noodle Cake
ingredients: 3 ounces chinese egg noodles | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons brandy | 3 tablespoons simple syrup | 1 1/2 ounces coffee beans | 1 ounce brandy
instructions: Start to cook the noodles in boiling water, then drain them and set aside. Combine the sugar, fish sauce, brandy and the vanilla sugar in a small bowl and set aside. Put the noodles into a large saucepan of boiling water and cook for about 1 and 1/2 minutes until they are cooked but still slightly firm. Drain them and rinse them well under cold tap water, then drain them again and set aside. Put a round spring form pan on the table and set a rack in the center. Take a piece of wax paper and paper it to fit, then turn it over so the paper is completely on the outside. Tear off a piece of wax paper and cut a rectangle or long strip about 1/8 inch wide and 1/2 inch long. Dip your fingers into the mixture when they start getting sticky, spread it onto the rectangle, laying it on the wax paper until the whole sheet has been used up. Take a few slices of egg from the block and pull it together a little. Take the slices of egg and drop them in the mixture and spread them out evenly in the pan. When the mixture is firm and breaks apart, spread it all over the noodles and then spread the bean sprouts on top. Dip the edge of the dish that you set aside briefly on the table with the noodles on it to make the edge curl up and make some pretty pictures. The noodle cake can be prepared ahead and frozen immediately or the cake has a solid, bite sized dome with wax paper hanging over the top for later use. You can serve it with dipping sauces as an appetizer, or just as is. If using egg noodles, make sure they get loose of all the grease. This cake can also be eaten immediately, wrapped in paper towels, or wrapped in wax paper, or wrapped in plastic wrap and refrigerated. You can use a sharp knife to cut small blocks of noodle cake with scissors. The cakes are a bit oily, so you need to use more oil to soften them.

title: Mexican  Baked  Green Avocado - Green Avocado Dip
ingredients: 2 hass avocados ( ripe or slightly underripe, i prefer hass ) | 1 cup fresh bean sprout | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | chili | salt | chili sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Halve and pit avocados and cut into small pieces. Place in a colander and toss with beans sprouts, cocoa and chili sauce. Salt to taste. Place in a baking dish. Bake 20 minutes. Serve immediately with chili sauce.

Random Ingredients: green pea,tapioca starch,bamboo shoot,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pecorino and Pea Rabe (Rabe Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups frozen green pea | 1 bunch fresh pecorino romano cheese | 32 bamboo shoots, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup tapioca starch
instructions: Place peas in a food processor.

title: Polish Sausage and Orange Party Appetizer
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs polish sausage, cut into 1 inch slices | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes
instructions: Brown sausages in a non stick skillet or frypan.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 french baguette
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Lightly grease a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan or a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. In a small bowl, sift together the cheese and grated baguette. Working with about 1/3 cup of the cheese mixture per diand in each corner, dip each bread triangle into the cheese. Transfer bread to the prepared pan or loaf pan. Brush with remaining cheese mixture. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Tasty Cauliflower and Beans
ingredients: 1 cup red kidney beans | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets
instructions: Combine beans and cumin, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 8 - 10 minutes until heated through. Add cauliflower and stir for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve hot. Keep warm in an oven preheated to 450 degrees.

title: Cherry Braised Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage, very finely sliced | 1 cup chicken stock | 2/3 cup sour cherry ( optional ) | salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place savoy cabbage in a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Allow to boil until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 15 minutes. Drain well and set aside to steam for a few minutes. Discard all the liquid and coarsely chop the cabbage. Stir chicken stock into cabbage and bring to a light boil.

title: Creamy Spinach
ingredients: 7 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 package cream of tartar
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the spinach in a small amount of water until well coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small mixing bowl, stir together the cream of tartar and the cream of tartar. Spoon off about 1/4 cup of spinach mixture and set aside in a small dish for garnish. Fold the spinach mixture into the cream of tartar mixture until just combined. Spread the cream of tartar mixture into a 9 inch square piece of aluminum aluminum foil. Fold the sides of the foil over the cream of tartar mixture and crimp the edges with a spoon to seal closed. Place the foil wrapped bundles onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cream of tartar topping has turned golden brown.

Random Ingredients: ice,vegetable oil,cottage cheese,green cardamom pod,chorizo sausage
title: Chorizo Delight
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 lb chorizo sausage, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 8 ounces cottage cheese | crushed ice
instructions: On a medium heat saute the chorizo until golden brown. Drain the oil and add the oil and the cardamom. Saute for a couple of minutes and add the cottage cheese. Bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer for about 15 minutes and serve.

title: Cousin Pete's Beef Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups of shredded cooked chuck | 1 1/2 cups crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup coconut cream | 1 - 2 1/2 cup broth ( your preference )
instructions: Boil the coconut cream until thick or with no lumps. Set aside to cool, then mix in the crumbled feta cheese, and set aside. Heat up your broth. In a pan, fry ground chuck at medium high heat until it is brown on all sides, and remove to a plate. When meat is cool drain most of the fat out of your pan. Return pan to stove. Add 1 cup of broth and stir the coconut cream into pan drippings. Add the browned ground chuck back in and stir to completely combine. Add the feta cheese and stir. Add another cup of beef broth. Stir. Serve over hot cooked rice or with crusty bread.

title: Arabic Saffron Jewels
ingredients: 500 g saffron | 1 tablespoon mixed spice ( gulf spices, gulf spices, dukkah, etc )
instructions: In a large bowl mix all the ingredients by mixing with a spoon. If using the whole saffron. Take an oiled spoon and pour the hot mixture onto it by using it in small round balls or flat bread shapes. Dont leave any of the saffron or spices sticking to the spoon, but leave the spoon for about 5 minutes before you use it as directed. Use as required or, you may use the required spices. Note, if using the mixed spice for a spice, you may use the powdered spices or saffron powder instead of the saffron or powder. If your using the powdered spices for a spice, you may use the powders or powder and only use what is needed or, you may add more of anything if the powder is not sticking. Serve immediately. Note, if you are using all saffron then you must put the whole saffron and mixed spice in a heavy bottomed vessel, preferably non stick. Cover the vessel, put on medium heat. When all the moisture is absorbed, reduce the heat slightly and add 50 - 75 ml/2 cups of water. Do not stir the mixture so that the saffron and mixed spice dissolve. Cook for approximately 15 minutes on high heat. Turn off the heat. Serve hot. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: hot pepper sauce,coriander seed,broth,chicken leg quarter,new mexico chile
title: Coriander-Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 2 whole chicken leg quarters | 1 teaspoon ground dried new mexico chile ( such as california ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seeds | 2 leaves fresh coriander leaves, torn | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups broth | 2 hot pepper sauce, such as tabasco
instructions: Cut slits 1/2 deep across chicken. Insert a cheese tender or sharp knife into each slit. Place in boiling, salted water. Boil for 3 minutes, then drain. Heat a heavy, shallow saute pan over medium high heat. Stir in coriander and ground chile. Add chicken, and saute 5 minutes. Turn chicken in brine, and saute 15 minutes more. Remove and set aside. Place remaining salt in a small skillet. Toast, stirring frequently, until blackened. Watch very closely so that the spices don't burn. When cool enough to handle, rub with pepper. Place chicken between two sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap, and roll into 1 inch thick ropes. Tie rolls in a piece of kitchen twine. In a large saucepan, combine chicken stock and hot pepper sauce. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, until chicken is tender, about 30 minutes. Serve in warm soup bowls over hot buttered rice.

title: Rainbow Cookies
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 1/2 cup sesame oil | 4 cups rolled oats | red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Draw a 9x9 inch cake pan with a pencil about 12 inches long. Use a brush or two of the back of a spoon to grease the paper. Set aside. Beat egg whites in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Slowly add sesame oil and beat until well blended. In a separate bowl, stir together the rolled oats and 1/2 cup of water. Using a metal spatula, stir the oat mixture into the egg whites. Add food coloring as you wish and beat until the desired shade goes dark. Spread the dough out onto the greased pan. Spread the red food coloring evenly over the dough. Bake in the preheated oven until a tester comes out clean, about 20 minutes. Remove from the oven, cool on a wire rack and cut into pieces that are 2 inches square.

title: Quick & Easy Basic Taco Sauce Mix
ingredients: 1 packet dry taco seasoning mix | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir to mix well, then refrigerate 1 1/2 to 4 hours as desired. Serve over your favorite mexican dish.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,cumin seed,lime juice zest,tomato puree,taco seasoning,dark soy sauce,chicken breast,juniper berry
title: Sensational Slow Cooker Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon whole dried juniper berries ( ajicito or other hot pepper ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 8 ounces tomato puree | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons lime juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, and tenders
instructions: Toast the cumin seeds in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute remove from heat. Add the juniper berries, vanilla, tomato puree, soy sauce, lime zest, and taco seasoning. Stir well. Add the chicken, cover, and let marinate in the refrigerator overnight. Cook in the slow cooker until chicken is cooked through and tender, about 7 hours. Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Grilled Beef Cubes
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, trimmed | 16 ounces mung bean sprouts | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Prepare grill. Place steaks on grill over medium high heat. Grill steaks just until desired doneness, about 10 minutes for medium rare. When cooked through remove from grill and tent with foil. Transfer steaks to a cutting board and slice thin against grain. Add bean sprouts and cayenne pepper to hot grill and cook until desired texture is reached for the bean sprouts. Cool 10 minutes before serving. Serve.

title: Mexican Flag Log
ingredients: 30 large mexican-style candies ( see note ) | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f and line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper. Place candies on a large metal cake rack. Drizzle melted cheese into both sides of candies. Bake until the candies are just beginning to turn dark, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and cool 5 minutes. Transfer candies to a paper lined plate and peel off paper. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: red potato,tomato juice,tea,watercress,wine,white potato,white wine vinegar,apricot preserve
title: Toffee Potatoes
ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons wine | 1/8 teaspoon instant tea | 4 medium red potatoes, peeled and diced | 4 medium white potatoes, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup apricot preserves, any flavor | 4 green small tomatoes, sliced ( optional ) | 4 sprigs watercress
instructions: Place vinegar, wine, and tea, in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Add potatoes and cook until tender. Stir in preserves.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,spanish onion,lasagna noodle,yellow squash,wonton wrapper
title: Garlic Nests
ingredients: 1 jar uncooked lasagna noodles, broken | 3 cups shredded yellow squash | 3 cups chopped spanish onions | 1 package wonton wrappers | 10 fluid ounces cream of chicken soup
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan. Place noodles in a large bowl, breaking them apart as needed to cover. Pour enough water over the noodles to cover. Cover, and let stand 10 minutes. Drain, and rinse again. Mix together the squash, onion, and wonton wrappers in a large bowl until evenly coated. Spread some of the mixture in the bottom of the prepared pan over the noodles. Cover the wonton wrappers with a layer of cheese, and cover with a layer of squash mixture. Repeat layers, and cover with more cheese. Use a toothpick to poke several holes in the top of the layers. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is light brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Simple Low Fat Turkish Yogurt Dip(Yogurt Can)
ingredients: 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt | paprika ( to garnish )
instructions: Mix yogurt and paprika in the blender or food processor until smooth. Chill in the refrigerator until serving time. Garnish with paprika to serve.

title: Japanese-Style Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 large cabbage ( washed, not shredded ) | 1 -2 tablespoon tamari | 2 shallots, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons sake ( japanese rice wine ) | 1/2 teaspoon chicken stock powder | 1 pinch baking powder
instructions: Remove the outer leaves from the cabbage and finely shred it. Mix it with the tamari, chopped shallot and sake in a small pan. Bring it to a boil and reduce it on high for 5 minutes. Add the baking powder and mix it through. Season to taste with more salt or salt and freshly ground pepper. Remove from heat and allow it to sit for 10 minutes to cool down a bit before serving.

title: Maple Syrup for Meatloaf on the Grill
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons artificial sweetener
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir 2 tablespoons maple syrup, 2 tablespoons maple syrup, and 1 1/2 teaspoon artificial sweetener. Bring to boil over medium heat, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until syrupy, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,graham cracker,yellow onion,italian plum tomato,coffee,kalamata olive,butter
title: Roasted Italian Plums
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1/3 cup diced yellow onion | 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, drained | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/3 cup grated kalamata olives or 1/3 cup black olives | kosher salt and cracked pepper | 16 slices graham crackers
instructions: In a small oven proof skillet, melt italian butter over medium high heat. Add onion and cook 8 minutes, or until translucent. Remove from heat and stir in tomatoes, coffee, olives, salt and cracked pepper. Place on baking sheet, spread mixture evenly, and bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes. Cut into 16 squares. Serve warm on plates.

Random Ingredients: sauce,club soda,heavy cream,red food coloring,paprika,blackberry,chocolate syrup
title: Blackberry Mousse with Hot Chocolate Syrup
ingredients: 4 cups heavy cream | 1 cup powdered sugar ( use 1/2 cup for topping ) | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1/8 teaspoon paprika | 2 drops hot sauce | 2 -1 drop red food coloring, depending on how much sweetness you want ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups fresh blackberries or 2 -3 cups frozen blackberries
instructions: Place all ingredients except fruit into the bowl of an electric mixer. Beat on medium speed 5 minutes. Gently fold in the blackberries. Transfer to individual or individual 4 ounce ramekin dishes or mousse dishes. Cover and refrigerate until ready to be served.

title: Farloshka (Russian Cauliflower Pizza)
ingredients: 4 cups cauliflower, florets | 1 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Cut cauliflower into florets, being careful to cut very thin. Saute cauliflower in olive oil over medium heat until tender, a few minutes per side. Remove cauliflower from pan and place in serving dish. Cover florets with pizza crust dough, and bake until golden brown on top, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grainy mustard,basil leaf,fish sauce,onion soup mix,saffron,pear,syrup
title: Parsley Pear and Onion Salad
ingredients: 4 pears or 4 large pears, cored and sliced into rounds | 4 tablespoons parsley mustard | 2 packages onion soup mix | 2 ounces thick-sour syrup | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon coarse grainy mustard | 1 teaspoon fresh basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Arrange pear slices in a large serving bowl. Place the other ingredients in a blender and blend on medium speed until well mixed. Pour over top of pears. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,monterey jack cheese,napa cabbage,red capsicum,extra virgin olive oil,apricot
title: Crispy Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch cauliflower, finely chopped ( known as napa cabbage and broccoli in australia ) | 2 red capsicums, seeds removed, chopped | 2 firm apricots, chopped | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, grated | 1 small napa cabbage, finely shredded, to serve
instructions: Place the prepared vegetables in a bowl of water, and season with salt and pepper. Set aside to stand for 15 minutes. Drain. Heat a large frying pan, add 2 tablespoons of olive oil. When the pan is very hot, add the peppers, apricots, and remaining olive oil and stir fry for 5 minutes. When the vegetables are just cooked, stir through the parmesan. Toss through the salad, sprinkle with extra parmesan, and serve with toasted sesame seeds as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,red currant jelly,curry powder,turkey,okra
title: Curried Okra, Okra and Cheese
ingredients: 2 packages frozen okra, thawed and thoroughly dried | 1 lb turkey, chopped, cooked ( turkey or other beef flavor ) | 1 can red currant jelly | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded ( i like to use cheddar, but a combo of mozzarella and swiss will do )
instructions: Heat oven to 375f degrees. Grease 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, combine okra, turkey, sugar and red currant jelly.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,mango,spaghetti,buttermilk,pork loin roast,seasoning salt,ajinomoto
title: Filipino Beef and Pork With Mango Soup
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 pinch seasoning salt | 1 pound bone-in sirloin tip roast, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 pound pork loin roast, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon ajinomoto | 1 1/4 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1 pound mangoes, peeled and chopped, or more if needed | 2 packages spaghetti
instructions: Whisk buttermilk and ajinomoto in a bowl to blend. Mix remaining buttermilk with seasoned salt in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: caper,basil leaf,red onion,chai tea teabags,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chai Tea Salad With Capers
ingredients: 7 cups fresh basil leaves, torn | 1 red onion, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 packet hot chai tea teabags ( see note in description ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons capers | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine basil, onion and hot chai tea teabags in large bowl. Stir in cheese, and mix. Add olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Steamed Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin or 1 lb rump steak, sliced into strips | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce or 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 12 ounces uncooked linguine, cooked al dente
instructions: Place all ingredients except linguine in a large bowl and toss gently. Put in steamer and steam 30 minutes or until noodles are tender {nonstick}.

title: Tex Mex Beef Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 6 egg whites, slightly beaten | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 box fat free sour cream | 1 lemon peel, shredded
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f combine egg whites, picante sauce, and sour cream in large bowl. Add beef mixture.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,nori,mint leaf,mexican corn,tapioca flour,chicken bouillon cube,lamb shoulder
title: Tatties or Tofu in Microwave
