ingredients: 500 g lean ground lamb shoulder | 4 teaspoons tamari or 4 teaspoons soy sauce ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons pickled onion flakes or 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed dried onion | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons tapioca flour | 1/2 cup coriander leaves or 1/2 cup mint leaf, fresh leaves chopped finely | 1 sheet nori, seaweed, sushi grade
instructions: Place beef in a bowl breaking it up into pieces. Add tamari, onion, broth cubes, tapioca flour and coriander or mint leaves, with a good pinch of salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. Put into microwave safe dish, add 1 inch layer layer of nori and cook on high for 4 - 5 minutes, turning it over once. Serve very as is or with rice or kimchi.

Random Ingredients: molasses,jiffy corn muffin mix,taco seasoning mix,marjoram
title: Simple Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1 box jiffy corn muffin mix | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 teaspoon marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Prepare cornbread batter according to instructions on cornbread package. Combine the cornbread batter, taco seasoning mix, molasses and marjoram in bowl. Stir until well mixed together. Mixture should be crumbly and a little runny. Spread into greased 9x12 pan or muffin pans. Bake at 325°f for 25 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,cranberry,salmon fillet,nut,sun tomato oil,cocoa powder
title: Chunky Chocolate Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( optional ) | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped ( or 1/3 cup of dried tomatoes ) | 4 salmon fillets | 1/3 cup chopped toasted nuts
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine 2 tablespoons of the cocoa sugar with the crushed bouillon cubes. Stir in the cranberries, sun dried tomatoes, or dried tomatoes, and refrigerate in a cool place for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Preheat the broiler. Rinse salmon and pat dry with paper towels. Arrange in a single layer in a baking pan. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a small saute pan over medium high heat. Brush salmon fillets with the oil and season with salt. Place on top of the roux and broil, skin side down, about 3 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork. When salmon is ready, place a small sheet of plastic wrap on top.

title: Lavender Peas
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs fresh green peas, picked over | 2 tablespoons dried lavender
instructions: Place peas in a large pot, cover with 3 inches cold water, and bring to a boil. Cook, covered, over low heat until tender, about 2 hours. Remove from heat. Let water evaporate, about 20 minutes. Drain and discard water. Place peas in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: barbeque sauce,beetroot,lemon peel,creme de cacao,cannellini bean
title: Beetroot Cocktail
ingredients: 3 frozen beetroots, thawed and sliced | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup barbeque sauce | 1/2 cup creme de cacao ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dried lemon peel, or more to taste
instructions: Place the beetroot slices in the bottom of 4 glasses, pour cannelini beans over them, and top with barbeque sauce and creme de cacao. Cover with a lid that is slightly dampened with water. Place a lemon peel on the lid, and microwave on high until steam forms, about 1 minute.

title: Pignoli Shells (Grampimpyoloes)
ingredients: 150 g fresh romano-grated lard | 150 g pine nuts or 150 g pistachios, slightly toasted and finely chopped | 100 g powdered lard ( or melted butter )
instructions: Put the sun dried ingredients in a heatproof bowl and leave to dry. Put the powdered lard in a pan. Break up some or all the sun dried ingredients and mix into the fat. Fry over low heat, stirring constantly until the fat has melted and it becomes shiny. Remove from the heat. Pour the gignoli into a piping bag lined with cheese cloth and pipe or pipe the gignolis by packing them into shapes. Place them on lightly oiled baking paper and set aside until needed. When ready to serve sprinkle the raw pistachios on top. These should be freshly shelled. Variation, use ground almonds instead of pistachios. Instead of the nuts, you can also use pecans or walnuts to decorate the shell pieces. Variation, the gignolis can be boiled for 5 - 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,mirin,lobster meat,ranch salad dressing,beef sirloin steak,red chilies,white fish fillet
title: Beef and Lobster Satay
ingredients: 5 white fish fillets, preferably wild king | 5 beef sirloin steaks, preferably nz-trimmed | 4 small red chilies | 4 lobster meat | 7 ounces white fish fillets, preferably nz-trimmed | 2 tablespoons mirin, soaked in | 2 tablespoons mirin | 50 g hidden valley and gourmet ranch salad dressing
instructions: First prepare the satay – take the fish out of the pouch or packet, and, if using a whole head of fish, remove any pin bones. Then cut each head into four pieces, and, using a sharp knife, cut through the skin of each piece of fish so that all four sections of fish are under the skin. Put the fish pieces in a bowl, and leave to marinade. Cut the chillies into 6 - 8 pieces of long green, long red and long yellow long green, or any combination you want to use like this. Slice the lobster meat into eight pieces, depending on the size, or buy one tin or plastic tub of anchovy fillets, and leave to marinade. Cut up the fish in strips, or dice the white fish into small squares that are similar in size to the fish. Heat up a large, heavy based frying pan on a high flame. While the pan is heating up, put the fish pieces in, and carefully shake the pan until they are all covered in the pan. Add half a tablespoon of mirin to the pan. Turn the heat down to a medium, so that the mirin stays very hot. Fry the fish pieces for 2 - 3 minutes each side. When the fish is golden on one side, stir, and remove. Repeat with the remaining fish pieces. Put the fish back in to the pan, and stir once more, so that the pieces on the bottom have turned a golden colour. Add all the coloured seafood, or leave the fish on the top, and give it all a golden colour. Poke a series of holes all over, all over, in the middle of the satay. Pour the honey and mirin over the shrimp, and let it bubble up from the heat. Turn the heat back up a bit, and stir again. Place the satay on a plate, then turn the heat down a little, leave at least ten tablespoons of water in the pan, and then remove the pan from the heat. Sprinkle over the salad dressing, and serve with a crisp baguette or other nice lettuce leaves.

title: Pinto Beans in Coconut Milk (Mung Bean) With Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried pinto bean, cut into 2-inch pieces | 4 teaspoons lime ginger paste | 3 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 15 large shrimp, medium size, peeled
instructions: Place the beans in a pressure cooker and add 2 cups water.. Cover, vent steam and cook until tender and about 10 minutes drain. Place into a blender and add the lime ginger garlic paste, vanilla and baking soda. Puree until fairly smooth. Pour into a saucepan and cook over medium heat until it begins to bubble. Reduce liquid by one third. Add prawns. Simmer for 15 minutes until prawns are pink in the center. Serve warm.

title: Creamy Pea and Yogurt Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon honey | 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons marinara sauce | 2 cloves garlic, chopped | 1 pound fresh snow peas, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Mix yogurt, honey, and 2 tablespoons marinara sauce together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,colby monterey jack cheese,almond extract,buttermilk,italian bread,ginger garlic paste,turnip
title: Easy Turnip Cones
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, peeled and sliced | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1/3 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup colby-monterey jack cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1 cup toasted slivered almonds, chopped | 2 1/4 cups buttermilk
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the turnips in a 1 quart saucepan, cover and bring to a boil.

title: Pinto Beans With Apple and Sweet Snap-Greens
ingredients: 8 medium tart green apples | 8 cups pinto beans, undrained | 1/4 cup palm sugar, plus more
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Trim green ends from apples and slice into 2 by 1/2 inch thick slices. Line baking sheet with aluminum foil. Combine apples, pinto beans, and sugar in a large bowl.

title: Feta Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh basil, diced | 3/4 cup feta, crumbled | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Mix the basil, feta, pasta crumbs and cheese just until everything is combined. Shape into four burgers. Fry on both sides until golden brown.

title: Spicy Pear Cured Shrooms
ingredients: 12 medium poblano chiles or 12 medium arbol chiles, peeled, seeds and stems intact | 24 flat-leaf spanish onions, stems included | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 6 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 2 pears - peeled, cored, cut into 1/2 inch segments
instructions: Place poblano peppers, onions and margarine in a large, heavy saucepan over moderate heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until poblanos are softened, about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and stir to coat with margarine. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered about 10 minutes. Add pears and cook, stirring, until pears are soft, about 3 minutes. Pack into chilafel molds and place on baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Heat uncovered over moderately low heat until almost dry, about 25 minutes. Cool 15 minutes, then stir. Serve with pears and a fine garnish.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,confectioner ' sugar,cumin,dijon mustard,green olive,green onion,marshmallow
title: Mandy's Santa Fe Salad
ingredients: 15 ounces kidney beans | 2 tablespoons green olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons green onions, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons light dijon mustard | 1 teaspoons prepared yellow ground cumin | 2 cups miniature marshmallows | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Cook beans according to package directions, draining. Mix with olives and green onions. In small bowl, combine mustard, cumin, marshmallows and confectioners' sugar. Dressing, combine mustard mixture with remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,scallion,maraschino cherry,parsnip,orange liqueur,ra el hanout spice mix,dog bun
title: Beef Stew With Parsnips, Raisin and Scallions
ingredients: 6 beef chuck, 1 1/2 inch cubes, trimmed | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 3/4 cup orange liqueur | 1/2 lb parsnip, peeled and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch-thick slices | 1/2 lb sirloin steak, trimmed of excess fat | 2 tablespoons scallions, sliced diagonally | 2 tablespoons raisins ( about 1/4 cup ) | 10 hot dog buns, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside. Sprinkle the beef with 2 tbsp of the ras el hanout and toss well to coat. Bake the beef for 25 minutes, tossing it at 2 minute intervals. Transfer the beef to a piece of foil. Add a small amount of the orange liqueur to the 1/2 cup of orange liqueur and place it over medium heat. Bring the liquid just to boiling, then add the parsnips and cook, turning occasionally, until the parsnips are tender, about 10 minutes. Transfer the parsnips to a plate and transfer them to a bowl. Add the sirloin to the same pan. Cook over high heat until the steak is no longer pink in the center, about 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to another plate. Add the scallions to the same pan and cook, stirring, until beginning to blacken in spots, about 2 minutes. Stir the scallions and beef back into the pan. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 tbsp of the ras el hanout. Transfer to the baking sheet and bake until brown, about 8 minutes. Transfer the stew to a platter and set aside. Spoon the stew onto a warm platter. Spoon the parsnips onto the stew, drizzles with the remaining 1 tbsp of orange liqueur, and sprinkle generously with the raisins.

title: Rhubarb and Green Curry Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups spanish rice | 1 lb chopped rhubarb | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 8 cups ice water | 1 tablespoon thai green curry paste
instructions: Wash rice thoroughly and drain. Place in a 3 quart saucepan. Cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer covered for 20 minutes. Stir in 2 tablespoons green curry paste. Cover, simmering for 30 minutes. Place rhubarb, 1 tablespoon green curry paste, and 3 cups ice water in a microwave safe bowl. Cook, uncovered, on high 15 minutes, or until rhubarb is tender. Spoon hot curry over rice and serve.

title: Rabbit With Jicama
ingredients: 600 g rabbit, cut into serving size pieces | 1/2 kiwi, sliced | 3 ounces jicama, chopped | 300 -500 g fettuccine
instructions: Add kiwi to boiling water and boil 3 minutes to blanch. Remove from heat, and let rest 1 minute. Drain, put into bowl, cover with cold water and allow to chill. Place rabbit in a frying pan. Add the rest of the ingredients and enough water to cover the rabbit. Bring to the boil, cover, and simmer for 1/2 hour remove cover and cook for a further 30 minutes until rabbit is tender. Remove from heat, and set aside. Serve with extra jicama and a green salad.

title: Hot Catfish With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 5 catfish fillets | 3 slices swiss cheese ( about 1/4-inch thick ) | 8 tablespoons coffee ( hot ) | 1 small onion, finely chopped
instructions: Place catfish in a lightly oiled baking dish, brush with some of the coffee. Top with cheese and onion. Pour remaining coffee over fish. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Marinate at least 4 hours, and up to 1 day. Preheat broiler. Broil fish 4 inches from heat 10 to 15 minutes or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Italian Mushroom Coated Chicken Wings (Cachere-Style)
ingredients: 1 large chicken wings, split at joint | 8 ounces porcini mushrooms | 1/8 cup dried conchigliette conchigliette ( or other dried pasta shape )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the chicken wings side by side in an oven proof dish, skin side down. Sprinkle mushrooms over the wings, then top with fresh conchigliette. Bake in preheated oven about 40 minutes, or until chicken juices run clear. Stir occasionally. Remove wings and let stand 10 minutes. Place on absorbent paper, then cover with a towel and allow to dry out. Heat 1/2 cup water in a saucepan over medium heat, then remove from heat. Spoon the pasta into bowls or glasses. Top with mushrooms and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken cutlet,barbecue sauce,hot chili sauce,sauce,sirloin steak,marinara sauce,green pepper
title: Spicy Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks ( about 2 to 1 1/2 inches thick ) | 2 cups barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup hot chili sauce | 1/4 cup bottled hot sauce | 2 teaspoons bottled marinara sauce | 1 green pepper ( cut into matchstick-size pieces ) | 12 ounces frozen mixed vegetables ( thawed )
instructions: Heat barbecue sauce, chili sauce and hot sauce in a 15 inch skillet, stirring and cook until bubbling, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle steaks with marinara sauce and toss to coat. Add vegetables and heat through. Serve steak with vegetables.

title: Green Mango Naan
ingredients: 4 green mango, ripe | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/3 cup hot water
instructions: Cut the mangoes and remove stones and the pulp. Add salt, sugar, hot water and bicarb soda to the mango pulp and cook in a microwave for 3 minutes. Leave to stand for 2 minutes and serve warm.

title: Bacon and Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 4 -6 lasagna noodles
instructions: Take bacon and fry. When crispy cut into 2 strips. Fry lasagna with bacon and set aside. Cook noodles a few at a time until al dente. Pour off all but about a teaspoon of the fat that goes in the pan. Add more or less bacon bacon. Layer noodles on top of bacon and drizzle with bacon fat. Cover with tomato basil, shredded cheese and chopped parsley or italian spices if desired.

title: Sourdough Sandwich
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 1/2 loaf sourdough bread | 2 thinly sliced apples | 2 bananas, sliced | 4 slices sweetened, salted peanuts, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Slice pork tenderloin in half lengthwise. Cut 2 to 3 slits through the center of the pork. Place pork onto a slice of bread, and top with a slice of apples and 2 to 5 bananas. Sprinkle with peanuts, and drizzle with confectioners' sugar. Roll up the bread, and cut into slices to serve.

title: White Beans and Mushrooms for Two
ingredients: 2 cups white beans, cleaned and soaked overnight in cold water | 2 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Soak the mushrooms for 3 hours. Drain them and chop them. Mix the mushrooms with the beans and add cardamom powder and salt. Cover and leave for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork loin | 2 1/2 ounces unsweetened chocolate ( about 2 ounces, can use dark chocolate, if desired ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups almond meal ( or almond flour, see note ) | guacamole
instructions: Slice pork loin into medallions. Set aside on dish side. Combine almond meal and chocolate in bowl or measuring cup. Mix well. Spread on pork loins. Bake in 350 F oven for about 1 hour. Turn pork loins over and bake an additional 45 minutes. Note, if you have to cut pork while still in pan, remove the fat from the pan, and pour off fat into saucepan. Return saucepan to stove and stir in almonds meal mixture. Bring to boil for a few minutes. Spoon onto pork loin and serve with guacamole.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,orange section,cake flour,bread,rigatoni pasta,celery,garlic salt,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Crock Pot Carnitas
ingredients: 1/3 cup cake flour or 1/3 cup cake flour | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 celery, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can chipotle chiles in adobo, diced ( i use medium or hot ) | 1 package country bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon garlic salt or 1 tablespoon minced fresh garlic | 1 sheet of parchment paper, cut into 1 inch strips on the diagonal
instructions: If using a homemade chipotle chile in adobo, slice the chiles and add to the bowl of your blender with some of the adobo juice from the can on it. Cover and whirl until blended but not liquied, about 30 seconds. You're done. Rinse and dry the pork, then season the chops with garlic salt. Spray a 3 1/2 to 5 quart crock pot with nonstick cooking spray and place the pork on top. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours, or until meat pulls apart easily and falls off the bone easily. Remove pork from crockpot to a serving platter and let cool. Discard excess fat and shred pork with a fork. Pour the sauce over the pork. Serve warm.

title: Easy and Delicious Nacho Dip
ingredients: 2 cans frito lays bean dip | 1 cup ice cube | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Blend cornstarch with a little water until smooth. Drain can of rinsed beans in a colander on the counter. Add enough of the cornstarch to the dip to help keep it from lumping. Dip your nacho chips on the edge of the cornstarch until they are covered with the dip. Gently toss them in the cornstarch so that the dip is fully covered. Enjoy.

title: Cajun Garlic-Shrimp Filled Shellfish
ingredients: 36 shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup peas ( frozen is fine ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour
instructions: Dice shrimp. In a mixing bowl stir shrimp, peas, garlic powder and tapioca if using. Add shrimp mixture to flour mixed in bowl. Roll the shrimp around in the shrimp mixture, coating them thoroughly. If using frozen peas, drain the shrimp mixture. Cook in large nonstick skillet over high heat about 3 minutes one side only, then turn and cook other side. Serve immediately.

title: Pan-Fried Pork With Bread Machine Variations
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 1/4 cup hot water | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic | 1/4 lb pork tenderloin, well trimmed or 1/4 lb sirloin
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the hot water, let stand until creamy, about 5 minutes. Add broth and cook in the skillet over medium heat until the liquid reduces by half, stir in enough of the pork liquor to moisten and coat the meat evenly. Cover and let stand until thickened, about 20 minutes. Drain and pat the meat dry with paper towels. Cut the meat into 1 cubes. Heat the oil in a large skillet or deep fryer till medium hot. Add the pork, and fry quickly. Cook briefly. Drain pork well, sprinkle with garlic, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: white rice,coriander seed,curry leaf,vegetable oil cooking spray,deli roast beef,crabmeat,tart apple
title: Quick & Easy Microwave Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 450 g cooked white rice | 150 g deli roast beef | 8 small tart apples or 8 small grated apples | 8 ounces crabmeat | 1/2 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed and divided | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 8 curry leaves | fresh shaved or steamed carrot
instructions: Peel and chop apples. Cut meat into bite sized pieces. Add the crushed coriander seeds, stir. Place rice, sliced meat and apple mixture in a microwave proof dish with 4 1/2 cups boiling water. Cover. Cook 15 minutes on high, uncovered, stirring twice. Cover. Remove from microwave and stand for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve over rice or with a salad and top with shaved carrots.

title: Chorizo Pasta
ingredients: 600 g vermicelli, uncooked | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1 red chili powder, deseeded | 200 g chorizo sausage, ground | 1 teaspoon red chili powder, extra | 125 g pasta, cooked italian style | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Heat a small frying pan over a moderate heat and add the vermicelli. Cook for about 2 minutes, or until golden all over. Remove from the heat and place in a large bowl. Melt the chocolate in a small, heavy based saucepan over a low heat. Pour in the chocolate and whisk until smooth then add the chilli powder. Add the ground meat and the extra chili to the bowl. Mix until well combined and then divide into the pasta bowls. Pour the chocolate mixture over the pasta and sprinkle with chives.

title: Spicy Pickled Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 6 cups packed watercress, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Combine the sugar, red curry paste, mustard seeds, and watercress in a large saucepan. Stir until sugar has dissolved and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Stir constantly until the mixture becomes very thick and syrupy. Transfer the corn beef to a large sealable package and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, stirring occasionally, to develop flavor. Let stand at room temperature for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Furikake Nushi Roll (Gyu-Yami)
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, cut 1/8 inch thick | 1 sheet nori, cut into squares on the diagonal
instructions: Heat a grill pan, grill nori until golden brown. Roll meat in nori to coat on all sides. Roll in remaining nori and warm in microwave until ready to serve.

title: Fajita Mix
ingredients: 1 bottle french dressing | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 bunch fresh chives
instructions: Drain french dressing from cans and set aside. Combine all ingredients, except chives, in a blender and process till mixture is smooth. Stir in chives. Pour into a resealable gallon freezer bag. Seal and put into refrigerator. To serve, shake container to distribute liquid evenly over bag, turning the contents to coat with dressing.

title: Roasted Chermoula
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 1 - 1 1/4 cup dried crushed apricots
instructions: Dry the cumin, parsley stems, and seeds on a tray. Stir into a smooth paste. Combine and store in a dry heatproof bowl. Use in breads, salad dressings, or roasted veg.

title: Green Grapes in Creamy Corn Sauce
ingredients: 4 rutabagas, sliced | 2 -3 green seedless grapes or 2 -3 prawns | 1 bunch green grapes, halved | 1 medium chili, halved | 1/2 - 1 fresh chili, halved | 5 -6 tablespoons cornflour | 1 -2 green chili pepper | 6 -12 tablespoons corn kernel, fresh juice of
instructions: Place ruts into a saucepan. Add cold water to cover. Bring to the boil, drain and chill till cold, about 20 mins, drain. Cut grapes into quarters and set aside. Peel chillies and halve them. Combine with corn flour to obtain a slurry. Blanch rutabaga in boiling water for 1 minute, drain. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a saucepan. Add chilli and garlic, cook for 1 minute. Add rutabaga and grapes. Cook for 3 minutes add cornflour mixture. Lower heat, add green chillies and chillies at once. Bring to the boil, continue to boil.

title: Tilapia and Ancho Enchil
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1/3 cup ancho chile powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Rub ancho chili powder on the tilapia fillets, and place in the preheated oven. Bake 15 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Mexican Pabellon
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 tablespoon papaya, peeled, deveined and diced | 1 bouquet garni ( a marjoram or thyme sprig ) | 1 whole celery, diced | 1 loaf processed cheese whiz | 1 bunch fresh dill pickle, rinsed and chopped
instructions: Place the cornmeal in a saucepan in a single layer. Sprinkle with papaya, bouquet garni and celery. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring to ensure mixture doesn't stick or burn. Meanwhile, melt processed cheese whiz in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave until melted. Remove processed cheese whiz from microwave and pour into processed cheese mixture. Stir until thoroughly melted.

title: Pork and Hazelnut Meatballs in Hot Wine
ingredients: 500 g boneless pork shoulder, sinew and fat removed, cut into chunks | 4 eggs, lightly beaten | 150 ml cold water | 100 g chopped hazelnuts | 30 g white wine | 300 ml beef stock
instructions: To make the stock, put the hazelnuts and the white wine into a pan and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat, and set aside to cool to room temperature. Put the pork in a large bowl, and add the eggs, water, and half the hazelnut mixture. Mix together well. Divide into half and shape into walnut size meatballs. Heat a large non stick frying pan. Add the meatballs. Cook, turning after 3 minutes. When cooked through, remove and set aside. Add more oil if necessary. Return the frying pan to the heat and stir fry the remaining nuts for 3 - 5 minutes. Add the stock and return to the boil. Add the meatballs and hazelnut mixture and stir to combine, reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: salad dressing,pancetta,brown rice,kosher salt,sauce,orange zest,tarragon,yellow mustard
title: Salad With Orange and Pancetta
ingredients: 8 ounces pancetta, cooked, thinly sliced ( about 1/2 cup ) or 8 ounces other bacon, slices diced ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard, prepared | 1/4 cup sweet hot sauce, such as tabasco or other hot sauce | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon hot sauce, such as tabasco | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice | 2 tablespoons salad dressing or 2 tablespoons tahini | salad greens or greens ( such as boston berry or salad greens of your choice )
instructions: For the pancetta, heat a 10 inch nonstick skillet over moderate heat until just beginning to smoke. Add the pancetta and the remaining ingredients and saute, stirring frequently, until the pancetta is crisp and the mixture is heated through, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate, cover the skillet and let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the brown rice, a 1 cup tahini mixture and warm water and stir to blend well. Remove the pancetta from the skillet. Pour the pancetta mixture evenly over the hot rice mixture and toss, being careful not to mash the rice. Arrange the pancetta on 4 dinner plates and serve with salad greens and orange or tahini dressing.

title: Uncle Bill's Savoy Cabbage
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped celery | 1 cup finely chopped green cabbage | 2 tablespoons crushed bottled roasted red peppers flakes | 1 large savoy cabbage
instructions: Core the head and any dark, tough portions off the hard spine of the savoy cabbage. Thinly slice. Wash the outer leaves of the head of cabbage, taking care to leave enough to submerge them. Remove the large stalky bits that float to the top. Cut out the very thick green leaves with a sharp knife. Discard the woody part of the stalk. Separate into leaves about 1/4 inch thick. Place a generous 1/3 cup of the crushed red pepper in the center of each leaf. Roll up each leaf and tie with kitchen twine. Cut a little bit of the red pepper into thin strips and drop them into the cabbage, along with some of the stalky bits and all. Cover well and steam for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the cabbage is tender and the juices are reduced into about a cup or 2 or more.

Random Ingredients: louisiana sauce,green cardamom pod,onion soup mix
title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 pods green cardamom pods, crushed | 2 1/2 teaspoons louisiana hot sauce
instructions: Prepare the onion soup mix according to package directions. Topping for pizzas, mix hot sauce and sour cream in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,cream celery soup,golden syrup,tabasco sauce,pineapple juice,white onion,sea salt
title: St. Patrick's Day Peppers & Peaches Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups cream of celery soup | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 1 medium white onion, chopped | 1 medium yellow pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce, adjust to taste | 1 dash sea salt
instructions: Combine the pineapple juice, onion, yellow pepper and golden syrup in a pot or crockpot. Stir well. Add the tabasco and sea salt and add cold water to desired thickness. Note, measurements are approximate. Serve and enjoy.

title: Enchiladas Verde (Green Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 2 cans enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Core and shred cabbage, removing large leaves for easier slicing. Place cabbage in a large bowl.

title: Tapioca With Saffron and Saffron
ingredients: 2 cups raw tapioca, rinsed | 3 tablespoons tapioca ( also called bahrat or azul mixed together with saffron )
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to boiling in a wide, heavy pan. Add the soaked prawns, stir, taste, and add more saffron if required. Reduce the heat, cover the pan, and simmer for 30 minutes or until the prawns are cooked but not overcooked. Drain the prawns and return the prawns to the pan. Stir gently, ensuring all the prawns are mixed together. Serve in soup bowls, adding a little hot tapioca to each bowl in the last 10 minutes to soften the prawns.

title: Fruit Salad - French Poly Style
ingredients: 1 cup diced yellow squash | 1/2 cup diced fresh fruit ( or try a combination of fruit, pineapple, peach or pears )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: broad bean,bell pepper,coriander seed,yellow bell pepper,tofu
title: Hot and Spicy Tofu Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 lb firm tofu, drained | 1/2 lb broad bean | 3/4 yellow bell pepper | 1/2 bell pepper | 1/2 bunch coriander seed, roasted and crushed | 1/2 teaspoon sauteed green onion
instructions: Combine first four ingredients, set aside. Place in a bamboo steamer, with about eight cups of water. Steam, covered, over a steamer burner on medium heat about 10 minutes, or until tender. If using a bamboo skewers, cut around skewers to avoid sticking. Remove tofu, then cut in slices. Arrange on a platter and garnish with fresh coriander. Serve with yogurt and chutney..

title: Pomegranate and Lime Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 plums ( large loins of pork loin ( about 4 pounds ) | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest | 2 teaspoons pomegranate juice | 1 tablespoon lime zest
instructions: Combine the pomegranate juice, lime juice, and zest.

Random Ingredients: paprika,romaine lettuce,garlic salt,margarine,sun tomato oil,coleslaw mix,ginger root,spice
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 bag shredded coleslaw mix | 1 package shredded romaine lettuce | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 2/3 cup margarine | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground mixed spice
instructions: In a large salad bowl, combine coleslaw mix, romaine lettuce, sun dried tomatoes, margarine, ginger root, paprika, garlic salt, and mixed spice. Mix in salad dressing until well mixed.

title: Easy Easy Beef & Tomato Casserole (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 lbs ground meat | 2 teaspoons lemon zest ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix soup and lemon peel in a 13x9 baking dish. Mix in ground beef. Spread over bread, top with tomato soup mix, cover with foil. Bake at 375°f for 45 - 60 minutes, or until meat is thoroughly cooked and mixture is bubbly. Serve.

Random Ingredients: nonfat milk powder,eggplant,golden delicious apple,red onion,hot water,pumpkin seed,dark sesame oil,apricot jam
title: Baked Eggplant With Apples
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 tablespoons dry-roasted pumpkin seeds | 1 medium red onion, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 3 fresh golden delicious apples, cored and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon nonfat dry milk powder | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato jam | 3 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Place the eggplant slices in a single layer in the prepared baking sheet. Bake the eggplant slices for 10 to 15 minutes, until light and soft. Transfer the eggplant to a food processor with the pumpkin seeds, onion, sesame oil, apples, and milk powder. Pulse until the ingredients are crumbly and almost pureed. Add the jam and process until just combined. Scrape into a bowl and stir in the water. Spoon the filling over all of the eggplant slices and bake for about 20 minutes, or until the filling is puffed and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: hing,part mozzarella cheese,rosemary,rice,leek,honey mustard,green cardamom pod,farfalle pasta
title: Vegan Alfredo Rice
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta | 6 cups cooked green rice | 1/4 cup chopped leeks, white portion only, thinly sliced, and rinsed | 1/4 - 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary | 1/8 teaspoon ground hing ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon honey mustard
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions, omitting salt or fat.

title: Apple Schnitzel
ingredients: 8 poblano chiles | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 package cream cheese | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: Place chiles on baking sheet and sprinkle with salt. Bake in oven at 375 degrees f for 15 minutes. Remove and cool completely. Peel off the skins and dice in cubes. Mix together cream cheese with sugar and vodka. Spread on chile skin. Spread cream on top and add a few pieces of apple cider on top. Serve with noodles or fresh vegetables.

title: Cola Cola
ingredients: 6 tablespoons cola | 1 cup slivered almonds
instructions: In a small saucepan, cook almonds until tender and smelling like a hazelnut, stirring constantly. Set aside to cool. Blend in cola. To serve, fill glass 2/3 full of cola and top with slivered almonds.

Random Ingredients: wheat hamburger bun,bell pepper,tangerine,cauliflower,red bell pepper,corn,red potato,jalapeno pepper lengthwise
title: Shredded Cauliflower and Pitwheels
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried tangerine | 1 small bell pepper - stemmed, seeded, and thinly sliced | 1 small red bell pepper - stemmed, seeded, and thinly sliced | 1 small cucumber - peeled, seeded, and thinly sliced | 1 jalapeno pepper, sliced lengthwise, or more to taste, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 cup thinly sliced cauliflower | 1/4 cup grated fresh jalapeno pepper, or to taste ( optional ) | 14 whole wheat hamburger buns, split lengthwise
instructions: Prepare the tangerine peel and juice by placing in a small bowl and scraping down the bowl with a spoon to remove as much of the bitter flavor as possible.

title: Pear-Sea Scallops on the Half Shell
ingredients: 8 ounces sea scallops | 1/2 pear, sliced
instructions: Place the scallops in a wide, shallow pan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and cook for 8 minutes or until just cooked but not dried out. Remove from heat, cover well and set aside to cool. Cut into 2 or 3 pieces and place one on each half shell. Top with the reserved pear slices.

title: Black-Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 4 cups black-eyed peas, picked over | 1/8 cup duck fat ( fat-skimmed duck fat ) | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup ground almonds, toasted, cooled, and coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine the black eyed peas, duck fat, vanilla sugar, and almonds in a salad bowl. Garnish with additional almond if desired.

title: Veal and Ricotta Fritter
ingredients: 500 g veal, sliced into thin strips | 1 packet chunky salsa | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon ginger powder
instructions: Combine ricotta cheese, salsa and ginger powder. Add veal and mix. Divide into bowls and serve over white rice.

title: Pimientos Confitos
ingredients: 1 small sweet onion, sliced thinly | 1 jar of chopped pimientos | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds or 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 300f and line 2 baking trays with foil or parchment paper. Add onion and pimientos to a small saucepan with a lid. Cover with water and bring to boiling point, then reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Strain out water and reserve 1 cup of the liquid. Preheat oven to 200°c. Line a 3/4 cup capacity ovenproof dish with the remaning packet of onion soup mix. Cover onion mixture with a layer of pimentos, then cover with remaining soup mixture. Sprinkle with about 1 tbsp of sugar. Cover with foil and bake, stirring occasionally, for 40 to 45 minutes, or until onions are golden brown and soup mixture is bubbling. Remove from oven and serve warm.

title: Toasted Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 cups shelled black sesame seeds | 1/2 cup cooking oil
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a skillet over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,coriander leaf,ice,eggplant,parmigiano reggiano cheese,beef dinner,pineapple ring
title: Beef Rolls With Eggplant and Pineapple
ingredients: 250 g eggplants, cut into 8 slices lengthwise | 4 slices prosciutto, chopped coarse | 2 teaspoons fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped | 3 teaspoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons crushed pineapple rings | 200 g good-quality lean ground beef or 200 g lean ground turkey | 3 cups fresh coriander leaves, coarsely chopped | ice
instructions: Grill over a medium hot flame, turning once until charred all over. Remove from heat and leave to cool. Using an electric grinder, mince the eggplant and prosciutto, leaving in small pieces. Add coriander, cheese and pineapple and process to a coarse paste. Combine ground beef with beef or turkey, seasoning with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Roll the mixture into 8 long long thin rolls and place on a foil lined baking dish. Grill over a medium hot fire for 10 minutes on each side or until cooked through. Arrange on a platter, season and scatter with coriander. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: scallion,sauce,apricot jam,chunky peanut butter,virgin olive oil,mexican cheese,cabbage
title: Mexican Slaw - the Best!!!!
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cabbage | 3 scallions, sliced thinly | 1 jar apricot jam | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 ounces mexican cheese, shredded
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together cabbage, scallions and jam. In a small microwave safe bowl, microwave peanut butter, oil, hot sauce. Place cheese in an even layer on the lettuce mixture. Microwave on high for a few seconds, till cheese is melted and bubbling. Sprinkle the cheese over the top.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,mint,tomato paste,ranch dressing,egg noodle,tomato green chilies,beef steak,asiago cheese
title: Southwestern Beef and Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 lb beef flank steak | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 1 can tomato paste | 2 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies | 8 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 cups cooked egg noodles | 2 cups shredded asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with non stick spray. Trim fat from steak. Place steak in dish. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, combine ranch dressing and tomato paste.

title: Chicken With Tomato Vinegar Salad
ingredients: 1 whole chicken tenders | 2 tomatoes, cut in half | 1 shallot, minced | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 5 -6 drops maggi seasoning
instructions: Sprinkle the top of the tenders with maggi seasoning. Put the tenders in and close the lid. Turn on the gas grill and then set to its highest heat. Close the lid and heat on gas grill for around 10 minutes. Turn frequently. After 10 minutes, lift the lid off the grill and the tenders should be cooked. If possible, split each piece of chicken with a knife during this time to allow moisture to cook through the vegetables and to let the juices absorb onto the chicken. Remove from the grill and serve with the tomatoes and the shallots. This can be served in a bowl with lettuce, vegetables, bread or pasta, and may be served as a side dish as a main dish. This can also be served with a light salad alongwith vegetables in the summer. Enjoy.

title: Cheese Dip for Pierogi or Halushki
ingredients: 18 ounces good quality mayonnaise or 18 ounces salad dressing ( i use kraft's aylmer's ) | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except for 1/2 cup of the cheese. Mix until smooth. Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with reserved 2 tablespoons of cheese. Toss gently until all ingredients are evenly distributed. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 1 month. Transfer to a pie plate, cover, and refrigerate until serving time. Serve with assorted crackers for dipping.

Random Ingredients: chicken meat,chicken bouillon granule,worcestershire sauce,tomato green chilies
title: Dixon Gang's Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken meat | 1 can whole tomatoes and green chilies | 10 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place chicken, tomatoes and green chilies, powder bouillon, worcestershire and salt in crock pot.. Cook on low for 4 hours. Shred meat, serve over rice. Also can be frozen or put in can of chopped tomatoes with green chilies. For reheating, cook for 5 minutes then put in small paper baking dish and bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken in Lima Andes (Oleo Con Crema)
ingredients: 12 -16 ounces chicken broth | 6 tablespoons oleo | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 6 lettuce ( icebergs, mesclun platter ) | 1 tablespoon yoghurt | 1 garlic clove, crushed
instructions: Place broth in large, self rising bowl. Heat chicken over medium heat, adding enough water to cover. When broth boils, reduce heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, 40 - 45 minutes. Remove from heat, cool and place in blender with oleo, mustard powder and season to taste. Cover and blend until smooth. If too thick, dilute by adding a little water.

title: Tropical Lettuce - Tofu
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 iceberg lettuce | 1 1/2 cups iceberg lettuce | 10 1/2 fluid ounces coconut oil | 5 fluid ounces sweet cream | iceberg lettuce, to serve
instructions: Place lettuce in a sieve. Tear away any excess or damaged outer leaves, and discard. Wash lettuce thoroughly under cold water. Trim any damaged or wood. Place in a large bowl, cover with cold water, and leave to macerate for 2 to 3 hours. Divide lettuce between lettuce bowl, top with one third of the coconut oil and sweet cream.

title: Chinese Five Spice Roasted Corn
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn, shucked, rinsed of excess silter, cut across the cob into kernels ( use a large roasting tin or roasting tin, 1 1/2 kgs. ) | 5 tablespoons horseradish, grated | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 220°c/425°f place the kernels of corn in a roasting tin. Add the horseradish, tamari, five spice power, cumin seeds and a generous dash of pink sea salt/sea ices if using. Roast for 30 - 40 minutes, stirring occasionally until the corn is just beginning to char on the edges and the edges are starting to look black. You might need to replace a knob of horseradish during the cooking process. Alternatively, remove the tray and corn mitts and place on a clean work surface to prevent further cooking. Cut the corn, if using, into slices about 1 inch thick and, if not, slice through the cob in 1cm. Serve warm with steamed vegetables or prawns.

title: Horse-Of-the-Zorse Inn - Orange and Horseradish Broth
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1/2 cup light stock or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon grated fresh horseradish ( i use the low sodium variety ) | 1 tablespoon freshly grated mirin ( or a combination of sugar and sake, but i had none at home ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint extract
instructions: Finely grate orange zest with 2 tablespoons of the stock, then stir in remaining stock, horseradish, mirin and mint. Simmer briskly, uncovered and stirring occasionally for 15 - 20 minutes until very richly cooked, reduced liquid has been absorbed and mixture is a lovely, thick orange color.

title: Kadai Bari (Indian Pork BBQ Skewers)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork loin roast or 2 lbs pork loin roast | 3 cups yoghurt | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons margarine ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons butter ( optional ) | 3 -5 capers | 4 -6 pinches garam masala
instructions: Cut the roast into 8 equal sized pieces. Cut the pork into 8 equal sized pieces. Cut all of the lamb into 8 equal sized pieces. Cut the capers into 4 pieces, keeping the capers intact. Thread each piece of meat onto four skewers. Place the skewers in a shallow bowl. Mix the yoghurt, 1/2 tsp garam masala and 4 tbsp margarine in a bowl. Place 1/4 cup yoghurt mixture in the bottom of a glass or oven dish large enough to hold the meat. Dip the meat in the yoghurt mixture, allowing excess marinating to drip off. Place in the dish. Do not stir in the last marination ingredients. Cover and let marinate for 1 hour. Bbq, preheat grill on high heat. Remove skewers from the marinating dish and dry. Repeat with remaining lamb pieces. Place on a grill rack with the meat directly on the rack for 15 - 20 minutes. Do not overcook. Let meat sit for 5 minutes while you prepare the bari.

title: Napa Cabbage Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup basil, chopped | 1/2 cup napa cabbage, diced | 2 tablespoons fresh lemonade or 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Allow to sit in refrigerator for 30 minutes before using as desired.

title: Sun Dried Tomato and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 2 pints cherry tomatoes | 1 cup pineapple, cubed | 1 cup ouzo | 3 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: In a pan, add tomatoes, pineapple and ouzo. Heat for 5 minutes. Add sherry and let cook for two minutes. Let cool a little bit and serve.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,oregano leaf,chickpea,yellow bell pepper,dark rum,carrot,au jus mix,baking soda
title: Au Jus
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 6 ounces au jus mix ( jugo acapulco ) | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, chopped ( or red, if you prefer ) | 1/2 lb carrot, peeled and chopped | 3 cups cooked chickpeas | 3/4 cup dark rum or 3/4 cup other favorite liqueur | 1/2 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Combine the dry ingredients. Add the carrots, peas, rum and oregano. Tear off 4 - 12 inch pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil or parchment paper and place them in a 13x9 inch baking dish or one that has been lined with parchment paper. Bake for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool on the foil or parchment until all of the cakes have cooled, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,pesto sauce,mozzarella cheese,catsup,grain rice,pineapple chunk
title: Pesto Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 2 cups grated swiss cheese | 1 cup catsup | 1 1/2 cups canned pineapple chunks, drained | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh pesto sauce
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. In a medium bowl combine the cheese, catsup and pineapple. Top rice salad with pesto dressing, mozzarella cheese and pineapple.

title: Bacon Bits and Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen heads of broccoli, thawed | 8 ounces bacon bits
instructions: Prepare fettuccine according to directions on box. Drain on paper towels and cut broccoli into bite size pieces. Mix together broccoli bits and bacon bits. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,heavy cream,sauerkraut,dark soy sauce,avocado,corn tortilla chip,pepper,cherry
title: Halloween Dog Food Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 4 ounces heavy cream | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 12 ounces pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 4 small corn tortilla chips | fresh pepper | avocado, slices ( optional )
instructions: Lightly spray 1 1/2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 375°f line bottom of dish with 6 corn tortillas. Mix pinto beans and cream. Place drained sauerkraut on top. Add 1/2 of pinto beans with liquid from can and 1/2 c. Of pinto beans. Season with soy sauce and pepper to taste. Spray with additional cooking spray. Place remaining tortillas on top of the other ingredients. Add 1/2 c. Pinto beans into the casserole. Add pepper to taste. Bake for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato,dark rum,graham cracker crumb,chihuahua cheese,grape tomato,balsamic vinegar,vanilla extract,seasoning salt
title: Chihuahua Cheese Stromboli
ingredients: 1/2 cup grape tomatoes ( cut in half if large ) or 1/2 cup roma tomato, cut in half if large ( cut in half if large ) | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato pieces | 1 dash seasoning salt | 14 ounces chihuahua cheese, shredded well | 16 ounces shredded anthotiro neufchatel cheese or 16 ounces neufchatel cheese | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon almond extract or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon coarse grain dijon or 1/2 teaspoon dark rum
instructions: Put oven rack in middle of oven. Preheat oven to 400°f. Line 13x9 inch pan evenly with grape tomatoes. Sprinkle sun dried tomatoes on top. Combine chihuahua cheese, chatel and vinegar in small bowl. Beat until creamy and smooth. Add in extracts and rum and mix. Scrape bowl with cheese mixture into prepared pan. Bake until top is lightly browned and center is firm to the touch, about 25 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Note, this recipe should yield about 2 cups.

title: Garlic Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Crush garlic with a mortar & pestle. Mix cream with spices, vanilla, and salt. Put mixture in a freezer bag and close. Shake well. Turn bag every few hours or so to distribute flavours. Serve on ice cream, sprinkle with shaved cheese & fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: pepper,kiwi fruit,hoagie,red pepper large,mustard powder,banana liqueur
title: Warm Breakfast Bananas
ingredients: 4 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 6 slices red peppers large | 6 slices large ripe banana liqueur | 1/2 cup hoagie roll | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small bowl, combine mustard, red pepper, kiwifruit, and bananas. Brush grill rack with olive oil. Grill kiwifruit and banana mixture under foil 4 - 5 minutes, turning once. Serve with hoagie rolls.

Random Ingredients: lard,raspberry,cashew,beef stock,spinach leaf,cream tartar,celery rib,raisin bread
title: Welsh Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into strips | 1/4 cup lard | 1/3 cup raisin bread, finely crumbled | 1/3 cup cashews, finely chopped | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 32 raspberries | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 -3 cups beef stock | 8 cups fresh spinach leaves, trimmed, washed and cut into 1/2 inch lengths
instructions: Dry meat with paper towels and season well. Melt lard and brown meat quickly in lard. Remove meat, set aside. Add raisins, cashews and celery to fat in pan and melt. Stir in nuts. Add beef stock slowly and stir to scrape up browned bits from bottom of pan. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer very slowly about 1½ hours or until meat is tender, stirring occasionally. Add spinach to pan and heat through. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Crock Pot Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 3/4 teaspoon saffron, crushed | 1 1/2 cups rice krispies | 1 cup chunky salsa ( mild, medium, hot brand ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 bunch fennel seed, toasted ( no stems ) | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa ( optional ) or 1 cup dark chocolate wafer cookie ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken breasts between sheets of wax paper and pound with a meat mallet into 1/4 1/2 inch thick patty slices about 2 inches in diameter. Sprinkle salt, pepper, and crushed fennel and fennel seeds over chicken, then sprinkle rice krispies, thick salsa, and chile salsa over all. Place in the crockpot and stir to mix. Cover and cook on low 12 to 14 hours or high 4 to 6 hours or until juices run clear, then remove cover and cook 15 to 18 minutes more or until chicken is done to your liking. Remove from heat and allow to stand covered. Remove chicken from kimchee and slice into 1/2 inch thick pieces and serve over rice krispies with chocolate, fennel, and cocoa or dark chocolate for dipping and or in addition to garnish with sprigs of fennel seeds from the jars, note, if using cookies, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Cornstarch Tamarind Chowder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste, with seeds | 2 bags frozen linguica, chopped | 1 leek, white and light green part cut in 1-inch pieces | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 1 package frozen french onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon cornstarch, mixed with 1 tbl water
instructions: Place the lentils in a large pot along with the leeks. Add water to cover the lentils. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium low. Leave to simmer, loosely covered, for 30 - 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Strain the lentils. Return to the pot. Add pimientos and soup mix. Whisk cornstarch mixture lightly into the soup mixture. Cook and stir 30 - 45 seconds more. Garnish with more pimiento.

title: Cheater's Jugo Burger
ingredients: 3 tablespoons rolled oats | 4 tablespoons yellow squash, diced & peeled | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries, sliced | ciabatta ( sliced 1/4-inch thick )
instructions: Heat pan over medium high heat. Add ground round and stir till browned. Stir in squash. Once it starts to brown, turn down to medium heat & add cherries, cook 1 - 2 minutes. Open crust & add burger. Mix & close lid. Cook 5 - 7 minutes or more or till cheese is melted & lightly browned.

title: Greens & Jam
ingredients: 1 lb turnip | 1/2 lb grated jicama | 3 3 cups sugar or 3 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Grate turnips and jicama into a bowl. Add sugar and mix to dissolve. Place in a large, heavy pot over low heat, stirring continuously, and bring to a boil. Continue boiling approximately 15 minutes until mixture reaches 1/4 cup consistency. It should not be more than a little runny. Remove from heat, stir in cool jam until cool and set up to let jam fall off of pan. Cover tightly and store the jam in a cool place. Variation, add small pieces of apple pie dough or apple butter to jam, before adding to ham, or as a topping for shrimp, quail's nests, or manto ceviche, before adding to ham, or quail's nests.

title: Homemade Russian Style Sandwiches, using Bread Mix (for 2)
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon dry basil ( can use parsley flakes, dried basil or chives ) | 2 lbs beef roast ( about 1 lb if using chuck roast ) | 14 1/2 ounces 100 % fat-free evaporated milk, divided
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle yeast on top and stir well to dissolve. Let stand for 5 - 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in basil and 2 tbsp of the evaporated milk. Drain and season beef with salt and pepper and generously coat with half of the bread mix. Spray a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray or oil. Spread bread mixture in the pan. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and set aside. Turn heat to 400°f. Transfer the meat to the uncovered baking dish. Bake for 1 3/4 hours or until golden brown and internal temperature 130f for rare, 140f for medium, and 150f for well done. Let cool to room temp, cut into thin wedges, serve, or let sit in refrigerator, covered, until ready to serve.

title: Seared Green Beans With Radishes
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 4 tablespoons fresh radishes, thinly sliced
instructions: Boil the green beans with fresh radishes until tender crisp, around 4 minutes, but no longer crisp, remove from pan with slotted spoon. Cut into 1 inch pieces and toss with 2 tbsp. Of radish, season to taste.

Random Ingredients: saffron,kikkoman soy sauce,italian salad dressing,flat leaf italian parsley,breadcrumb
title: Easy Saffron Grilled Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 1 1/2 tablespoons kikkoman soy sauce | 1/4 cup italian salad dressing | 1/3 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped ( or more )
instructions: Preheat a grill to high or preheat an electric skillet to medium. Mix the beef, 1 - ¼ tablespoons soy sauce, italian dressing, bread crumbs, saffron, and 2 minutes longer. Form 3 meat slabs about 2 inches in diameter on a wooden skewer or an oiled baking tray lined with a nonstick cooking mat. Coat each meat with the other ¼ teaspoon soy sauce, 1 - ¼ tablespoon italian dressing and sprinkle with the remaining bread crumb mixture. Grill on the rack of the grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once. If the meat is browned on the bottom, move the pan around and brown the second side. Remove from grill and allow to rest for about 5 minutes before serving. If the barbecue is not very hot, broil meat for about 3 to 4 minutes per side, or until juices run clear. Place meat back on the rack, pour the remaining 1 - ¼ tablespoons soy sauce over the meat, and broil until the meat is just beginning to crisp outside, about 3 to 5 minutes. If the meat sticks to the skewer or on the pan, remove them when done to the desired thickness serve immediately on a serving platter with the meat juices and sauce.

title: Oven Baked Coconut Crumbs (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 cups shredded coconut ( i prefer to use shredded coconut ) | 1/2 teaspoon breadcrumbs ( optional )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f. Mix coconut and breadcrumbs in a medium size bowl. Sprinkle a baking sheet or large cookie sheet with cooking spray. Drop biscuit batter by 1/2 tablespoon onto baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Let cool, remove from cookie sheet. Using a slotted spoon, remove biscuit mixture from baking sheet and place on a cookie tray. If desired, place one or two slices of vanilla ice cream in individual serving dishes on top of biscuit crumbs. Serve warm.

title: Basque Bread and Peppers
ingredients: 1 -2 cup pearl barley | 1 cup pistachios, shelled | 1 bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 loaf french bread, sliced into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a pot over high heat, stir together the barley, pistachios, and bell pepper. Heat for 2 mins, stirring constantly. Remove from heat, arrange french bread slices in a single layer on the rack in the oven. Turn oven up to 400f, and heat for 10 minutes or till golden brown. Remove from oven and top with the heated pistachios mixture.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,green bell pepper,currant,yogurt,chicken leg,chicken part,thyme sprig,cod
title: Fisherman's Chicken
ingredients: 1 package chicken parts, and drumsticks at room temperature | 1 container low-fat yogurt | 1 lb cod, skin and bones removed ( if preferred, use fresh cod ) | 1 green bell pepper | 1/4 cup dried currants | 4 fresh thyme sprigs or 1 tablespoon dried lavender | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | fresh herb ( optional ) or seafood seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken in large pot of water with marinade except for yogurt. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove chicken into a bowl, discarding marinade. Place cod in pot over low heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove fish and debone. Cut into 1 inch pieces or bite size chunks. Remove any remaining bones and any skin from the cod, cut into pieces. Return to pot. Add bell pepper, currants, thyme and almond extract. Stir constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 15 minutes or until sauce is thickened and peppers are tender. Add fish, stir well to combine and heat through. Turn off heat and stir in yogurt until mixed well. Serve with fresh herbs and a side of green rice. Note, if you're using fresh herbs, such as thyme or marjoram, it will be a bit tougher to remove the herbs. Also, the yogurt can be purchased at asian markets, but you will have to cut back on the dairy if you purchase it. If you're using dried herbs, herbs are more intense in flavor and flavor.

title: Devil's Food Cookies (Pfeffernusse)
ingredients: 2/3 cup dark brown sugar, firmly packed | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 egg white | 1 can crushed corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a small bowl, beat together the sugar, catsup, sherry and egg white. Add the crushed corn flakes and mix until well blended. Form the cookie dough into 1 inch balls the size of walnuts. Bake on middle rack of oven for 7 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Spaghettini
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | bread, crusts cut off ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti in a large pot of boiling water until it's completely cooked but not falling apart. Drain pasta well, reserving 1/2 to 3/4 cup of the cooking water. Cool pasta until warm, drain and transfer to large bowl. Stir in enough bread to moisten. Toss well with bread for a pretty effect.

title: Mexican Style Queso Dip
ingredients: 1 lb monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 small serrano pepper, stemmed, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place the cheese mixture into a baking dish with a rim. Sprinkle with the finely chopped chiles and cover with a lid to prevent the cheese from browning. Microwave at 45 percent power for 5 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed oil,serrano pepper,bulk italian sausage
title: Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 4 lbs bulk italian sausage | 1 tablespoon roasted sesame seed oil | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Remove casings from sausages. In a large skillet, brown sugar over high heat, stirring to dissolve brown sugar. Reduce heat and cook sausage, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes, or until sausage is nicely browned on all sides. Stir in sesame oil and cayenne pepper and remove from heat. Shape sausage mixture into 4 large meaty rolls. Serve with cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,red lentil,red onion,dijon mustard,hazelnut,turmeric,bell pepper
title: Turkish Red Lentil & Pepper Pie
ingredients: 1/2 cup red lentils | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/2 red onion, diced | 1/2 bell pepper, diced | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1/2 red onion, chopped | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds or 1/2 cup sunflower oil, for shallow frying
instructions: Place the lentils & hazelnuts in a bowl & cover with boiling water. Let soak, drain & set aside. Heat a wok at high heat. Add the yellow onion & bell pepper & stir fry for 2 minutes. Remove from the wok & set aside. Heat the oil in the wok & add the tumeric & stir for 1 minute. Add the lentils & season well with salt. Saute over high heat for 5 mins or till the mixture is thick & translucent & the lentils softened. Set aside. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line a large baking tray with the top sheet of phyllo & brush with oil. Cut the pie into 4 equal pieces each & lay on the bottom sheet. Spoon lentils & pepper mixture into the pastry pieces & smooth the top slightly. Fold in the sides of the sheets of phyllo & spray with oil. Cover with the top sheet of phyllo & brush with oil. Continue to lay the phyllo sheets in the pan, brushing each sheet of pastry with oil. When all the sheets have been used & the dough has been layered in the pan you can either cut or lay on top of the borello sheets in the pan or put them in the oven to preheat them up for 20 minutes or until the top layer is golden & crispy brown. Remove from the oven & serve hot.

title: Pasta With Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Pierce a round of aluminum foil with a fork or pastry cutter. Drop the square of spaghetti squash onto the foil. Bake the squash until tender, about 25 minutes. While it's baking, bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Immediately turn off the heat, drop 1 inch of spaghetti squash into the boiling water, and cook for about five minutes. Remove spaghetti squash from the water with a slotted spoon, drain, and keep warm. Return water to the stove, and bring to a boil over high heat. Pour flour over the cooked spaghetti squash just as it is done cooking. Cook until the pasta has turned a light golden brown color, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,goat cheese,heavy cream,self raising flour,pumpkin pie spice
title: Pumpkin & Goat Cheese Biscuit
ingredients: 3 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice | 1 1/4 cups goat cheese ( optional ) | 1/4 cup heavy cream | peanut oil, for greasing
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Place flour and pumpkin pie spice into a large bowl and add the gorgonzola cheese and cream. Mix to combine. Scoop a small amount of dough out of the dough and form into balls. Dunk each ball of dough in the flour mixture to coat thoroughly, then gently roll into round balls with hands. Repeat with remaining dough and filling. Heat a large non stick frying pan or griddle. Remove biscuit from the pan and place on a medium low medium heat, with small amounts of oil. Cook the biscuit on one side for 3 - 5 minutes, then carefully turn over and cook the other side for about 30 seconds. Allow to chill in the fridge if desired before cutting into biscuit pieces. These biscuits will keep in an airtight container. Serve warm or at room temperature with a dip.

title: Microwave Poached and Spicy Shells
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked small shell pasta ( penne, shells, ziti, rigatoni or rigatoni ) | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock | 1/4 cup instant espresso | 1 large pie crust
instructions: Heat oven to 425&deg.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,sea salt black pepper,mexican cheese
title: Faux-Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/4 lb mexican cheese, shredded | 1/2 yellow pepper, minced | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt and black pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Note, if using a mild cheese like parmigiano reggiano, add 1/4 pound of cheese to the mixture and mix well with the other ingredients. If using your favorite cheeses, add 1/2 teaspoon to 1/4 pound of cheese on top. Let the mixture stand at room temperature for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Sweet Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 6 small yellow onions, thinly sliced | 3 ounces vanilla beans
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan. Cook onions over medium heat for about 10 minutes until the onions are beginning to brown.. Remove from heat and cover. Place vanilla beans in a small cup and pour the hot oil in the cup over them. Stir. Remove vanilla beans. Pour over onions and allow to cool. Note, the amounts of vanilla and bean depends on the amount of onions used. I like them very thin.

title: Mustard Butter
ingredients: 1 leek | 3 ounces margarine | 1 tablespoon mustard
instructions: Cut leek in narrow, thin slices. Dry with paper towel afterwards. Wash leek in sieve under running water to remove all sand. In a mixing bowl combine all ingredients add to leek and mix. Dampen hands to remove leeks and wash. Place on parchment or waxed paper in refrigerator for 2 hours before using. Keep refrigerant. Use within 15 days. Keeps longer if stored in refrigerator.

title: Mexican Cheese Pies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 2 1/4 cups mexican shredded cheese ( i use sharp cheddar ) | 1 1/4 cups finely chopped pecans ( omit if not using dried pecans, they may be a bit more dense )
instructions: Place one cup of the cheese in a bowl and add the rest. Stir until smooth. Add the remaining cup of cheese and nuts and stir until blended, but not melted. Roll tablespoons of the mixture into balls. Roll in the remaining melted cheese until well coated. Place on a greased tray. Bake in a preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until crisp on the outside. Serve warm or cold.

title: Applesauce Egg Mould
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | 1/4 teaspoon dried coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1 teaspoon lime or lemon juice
instructions: Line a mould with the greaseproof paper. In a small bowl, beat egg yolks until they are pale. Beat in coriander powder, pepper and applesauce to egg yolks in 2/3 cup measuring cup. Spoon mixture into prepared moulds. Allow to set 1 hour. Carefully transfer to a wire rack set on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and drizzle with lime juice. Serve immediately or store in a cool, dry place. Serves.

title: Saucy Lamb Meat Loaf for the Crock of Your Noodle
ingredients: 1 whole lean ground turkey | 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb ( or use more if you like ) | 15 ounces cherries | 2 tablespoons dry grainy mustard | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the ground turkey, lamb or beef, cherries, dry mustard and bouillon cube. The meat should be completely coated with the mustard. It should have a somewhat dry consistency and should not stick to your hands. Pat the meat into a loaf pan and place in a crock of your favorite noodles. The meat should also be covered with the gravy. Pour the gravy over the meat so it has a good coating of gravy on the top of the meat. Bake in a moderate oven for about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Salmon Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 pound thinly sliced smoked salmon | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon ground hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 2 romano cheese, shredded | 20 small cheesecloth, layers soaked in water | 2 packages shredded colby cheese
instructions: Layer 1/4 pound sliced smoked salmon with salt, seasoning salt, hazelnuts, and oregano in a flat dish. Top with 2 romano cheese, then top with 2 grated colby cheese. Arrange the 2 packets of seaweed wrapped plastic wrap over the salmon in a steamer. Place the steamer over medium heat and steam the salmon gently for 8 to10 minutes, or until it flakes easily with a fork. The salmon is done when it flakes easily. When the salmon is done, place 1 piece of seaweed wrap in a burger press and place in the center of the press.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,lemon juice zest,pearl barley,tapioca,sauce,rice noodle,coconut milk
title: Tapioca Noodles (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 4 cups pearl barley | 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 cups coconut milk | 1 small lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/4 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons tapioca
instructions: Set a pot of water over medium heat. When the pot comes to a boil, add the barley, chilli flakes, 4 cups of the coconut milk and the lemon zest/juice. Stir. When the pot comes back to a boil, add the hot sauce. Then bring back to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes or until barley is tender. Meanwhile, make the syrup. In a small bowl, combine 1 cup coconut milk, the remaining ½ cup of coconut milk, tapioca and lemon zest and hot sauce. Mix well. Stir through the noodles and serve.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,vanilla sugar,monterey jack cheese,ladyfinger
title: Yummy Layered Mexican Trifle
ingredients: 7 12-inch ladyfingers | 3 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar ( or regular vanilla sugar ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place one ladyfinger in glass dish. Spread ricotta over ladyfinger and sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese. Repeat layers and sprinkle with cheese. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Serve with fruit chutney or jam.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,melon liqueur,lasagna noodle,gruyere cheese,anise seed,strawberry,peanut butter
title: Mandalay's Faux Four Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 8 fresh lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup prepared peanut butter | 1 jar diced melon liqueur, divided | 3 tablespoons amaretto | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 3 ripe strawberries, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spray the inside of a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Feta Beef Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 bag fusilli bread | feta cheese | tomato-basil pesto | fresh fruit | 1 can cannellini beans
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain. While the ground chuck is draining brown pierce the bag of fusilli and fry. Drain of any fat. After ground chuck is done drain any remaining liquid. When the ground chuck is finished drain and put it back in the chuck pot. Spread out your fusilli dough and add a layer of the feta cheese on top of the dough. Spread some of your pesto on the fusilli dough and add the layer of refregerator type diced tomatoes. Now add your canelinni beans and your fresh fruit or sliced green pears or fresh berries and sprinkle with extra of feta cheese. Bake at 375f for 20 - 25 minutes. Serve with crackers or a salad.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,baby spinach,bratwurst bun,pork loin chop,onion soup mix,chicken breast,black sesame seed
title: Pork Wrapped With Swiss Chard and Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 lbs pork loin ( with or without bone ) | 4 bratwursts or 4 any other lean boneless pork cut - 3 inches long | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice ( or 1 to 1 1/2 tsp. pumpkin pie spice ) | 5 bags fresh baby spinach | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds or 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted | 2 -3 fresh brussels sprouts, trimmed
instructions: Trim any fat from the pork cut. Remove all visible fat from the meat cut. Cut meat into chunks. Place meat and chopped bratwurst, in a heavy plastic bag, combine ingredients and knead and shape into a log about 10 inches long. Wrap the bag around meat and tie tightly. You may have two or three packets of pork mixture left that will fit under and tie tightly. Warm the grill or place a few racks over medium heat. When ready, place the logs on a rack and grill, turning about every 6 - 8 minutes, until very well brown, about 5 minutes per side. Place on a platter and let cool slightly. Meanwhile, place a large pot of water over high heat with the pumpkin pie spice. Bring to a boil, add all of the contents of the package of onion soup mix, along with the spinach and sesame seeds, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the spinach is nearly cooked, about 20 minutes. Cut into 8 equal serving portions. To serve, place a portion of the filling onto a bun, place 1 or 2 brussels sprouts on top, and top with a swiss roll. Serve.

title: Baked Beans and Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds swiss chard, stems removed | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 1 can bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f. Fill a medium baking dish with water.

title: Garden Basil and Hearts of Palm Salad
ingredients: 1 lb hearts of palm, drained | 4 medium serrano peppers, stemmed, thinly sliced in rounds | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf, torn into small pieces ( about 10 leaves ) | nutmeg, freshly grated
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the hearts of palm, serrano peppers and basil with the nutmeg.

title: Authentic German Meat and Sauerkraut Roll Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground venison | 8 ounces lean ground beef stew meat | 1 cup diced carrot | 1 cup sauerkraut, drained | 1/2 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 3 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup saffron ( i add just a few drops of white pepper for added color ) or 1/4 cup garbanzo beans ( i add just a few drops of white pepper for added color ) | 1 -4 tablespoon saffron ( i add just a few drops of white pepper for added color )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f generously butter a 13x9 inch baking dish and set aside. Sprinkle the venison and beef into a large bowl, along with the carrots, sauerkraut, cheese and eggs. Gently stir to combine. Place the meat mixture into a lightly oiled baking dish and cover with foil. Bake in the center of the oven for 50 - 60 minutes. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with water until the water is 3/4 inch above the meat. Break up the sauerkraut with a fork. Cover and bake for 25 minutes more. Remove from the oven and let stand for 5 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle the saffron on top and serve.

Random Ingredients: cotija cheese,pork leg,bean sprout,canola oil,lumpia wrapper
title: Pork Rollups
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 2 large pork legs | 3 cups fresh bean sprouts | 12 lumpia wrappers | 1 1/4 cups crumbled cotija cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Cut a small slit in the side of each pork leg.

Random Ingredients: wheat germ,hot chili pepper,chicken broth,tahini paste,chocolate chip,peanut oil,salmon steak,graham cracker crumb
title: Chile Relleno in Mini-Rice Cups(Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon steaks, cut into 1/2 x 1/2 x 2-inch rectangle ( about 6-8 ounces total ) | 1 cup peanut oil | 1/2 cup toasted wheat germ, divided ( optional ) | 1 cup fat free chicken broth | 2 tablespoons tahini paste | 2/3 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons toasted wheat germ | 1 -2 fresh hot chili pepper ( such as peri-peri or scotch bonnet ) | graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In a large bowl, toss salmon with 2 tablespoons peanut oil, about 1/4 cup wheat germ, and 1/4 cup chicken broth.

title: Lemon Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 package lemon pudding mix | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Spread the lemon pudding onto a plate. Spread the hot chili powder on top of the lemon pudding.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,chicken wing,beer,rice wine,habanero pepper,lemon juice zest,bread machine yeast
title: Mauracita's Beer Can Chicken Wings
