ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream, or as needed | 1/2 cup beer | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1 tablespoon grated lemon-flavored zest | 1 tablespoon habanero pepper, or more to taste | 3/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons chicken wings, separated | 1 teaspoon bread machine yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line the bottom of a baking sheet with a silpat or parchment paper. Stir the cream, beer, rice wine, lemon zest, habanero pepper, and broth together in a bowl with a fork until mixed well. Arrange chicken wings on the silpat.

Random Ingredients: mutton marrow,caster sugar,bean,romano cheese,bulk italian sausage,sultana
title: Tortoni Di Miepe (Mutton & Bean Stew)
ingredients: 3 lbs lean meat | 3 lbs mutton bones ( if using marrow, use 1/2 pound of it ) | 1 bunch fresh romano cheese | 1 lb sultana ( optional ) | 2 cans baked beans | 1 tablespoon caster sugar, to taste
instructions: Cut the marrow into large chunks, the mince into smaller chunks. Brown the meat in a little olive oil, adding a little water if it's getting to dry. Put all the other ingredients into the stew, bring to the boil, lower heat and cover the pan. Cook over a hard simmer until the meat is tender and the flavors have blended.

Random Ingredients: pear,vegetable stock,almond extract,miso,white bread,flour tortilla,beef stock,edamame
title: Edamame Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 lb edamame, blanched, shelled, peeled | 1/3 lb ground sirloin or 1/3 lb ground lamb | 1/8 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pear | 2 teaspoons vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons miso | 1/4 cup beef stock | 4 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Blanch edamame in a pot of boiling water 8 - 10 seconds. Drain and rinse under cold water and drain well. Toss with lamb, almonds, pear and miso mixture. Place in a small baking bowl. Slightly bruise top. Cut each in half and place on a microwave safe plate. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place half of mixture in center of each tortilla and roll up. Heat remaining oil in a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add rolled tortillas and sauté 3 - 4 minutes per side or until heated through and bubbly. Serve on toothpicks.

title: Curry Powder
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder or 1/2 teaspoon ajwain seeds | 12 dried apricots | 3/4 teaspoon garlic, minced ( or 2 tbsp vegetable oil )
instructions: Dissolve the asafoetida in 3/4 cup water, then add to boiling water. Add apricots, garlic and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Simmer gently, stirring occasionally. When the curry powder has thickened, add 1/4 cup of water.. Simmer for 1 - 2 minutes, until the water has evaporated.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,thai chili sauce,spaghetti sauce,artichoke heart,romaine lettuce
title: Artichoke and Noodles With Thai Sweet Chili Dressing
ingredients: 3 ounces spaghetti sauce, medium or light | 1 ounce marinated artichoke hearts, drained and patted dry | 1/2 teaspoon thai sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped romaine lettuce | salad oil ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except romaine in a small bowl. Toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,vodka,butter,basmati rice,splenda sugar substitute,garam masala
title: Basmati Rice Blend
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, uncooked ( brown-grain is best ) | 4 cups grape tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons vodka, non-curd or 1 1/2 teaspoons other bertolli sos | 1 -2 tablespoon butter, in a teaspoon or 2 tsp margarine
instructions: Place rice in a colander and rinse well until the water runs clear. Let drain in a warm place for 20 minutes. Drain, reserving the liquid, and set the liquid aside. Combine the reserved liquid, tomatoes, sugar, garam masala and vodka in a saucepan, cover and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat. Add the rice and toss until well coated with the sauce and heated through. Adjust sugar to taste with more paprika, adding vinegar, if desired.

title: Low Calorie Spicy Low-Calorie Chicken
ingredients: 4 teaspoons low-fat vanilla yogurt ( i use reduced fat ) | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( i use thai red curry paste with a kick. i like k ) | 4 chicken ( thighs, breasts, chicken breasts ) | 6 maraschino cherries ( for garnishing )
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt chili paste for at least an hour. Grill chicken until chicken feels soft. Remove from grill. Arrange on serving dish over cherry bones. Garnish with a pinch of maraschino.

title: Pesto Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared basil pesto | 3 cups romaine lettuce, chopped | 1 cup gravy mix
instructions: Toss lettuce with pesto dressing. Fold in gravy mix. Chill.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,cottage cheese,oyster sauce,cooking oat,coffee,serrano chilies,ra el hanout spice mix,balsamic vinegar
title: Spice-Filled Mushrooms With Oat Topping
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh goat cheese or 1/2 lb other hard cheese | 8 -10 fresh porcini mushrooms | 1/2 cup dried cooking oats | 1 cup fat-free cottage cheese | 1/4 cup coffee | 3 teaspoons hoisin sauce ( i use keens oriental ginger sauce ) | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 3 dried serrano chilies ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Prepare oats in a large bowl. Wash and chop mushrooms finely and set aside. Mince the serrano peppers and then mash to a fine paste with the garlic powder or some of the oil. Stir into oat paste into wok/skillet and stir/fry until golden brown. Remove from skillet and place back into pan. Drain goat cheese and keep at room temperature while preparing other ingredients. Combine all ingredients together. Place mixture in mushrooms and drizzle sauce over top and mix well. Let set for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve with sliced green beans, fresh vegetable sticks or fried onions, rice, pasta, rice crackers, crackers or whatever strikes your fancy.

title: Steak Tartare
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs steak | 1 can great northern beans or 1 package navy beans ( rinsed ) | shredded cheese ( optional ) | chives ( optional ) | blanched almond ( optional )
instructions: Cut the steak in 1/2 inch cubes and place into a ziploc bag with the beans. Shake well to evenly coat the meat. If your bag does not have a ziploc bag, just use a plastic baggie. Refrigerate overnight or for 1 - 2 hours. Preparation times listed in recipe book are approximate, but can be as close to normal for different quantities. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Remove the bag from the marinade. Discard the ziploc bag contents from the bag. Place meat on a rack in a baking pan and roast in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until cooked thoroughly. Allow to cool for about 10 minutes. Take the meat out of the oven and allow to cool for about 30 minutes. When cooled sufficiently, remove the meat and cut into thin pieces. Place the meat back into the oven for about 10 minutes. Place the meat back on the rack, and allow to cool completely and serve.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,dark brown sugar,cream coconut,green chili salsa,farfalle pasta
title: Mexican Nachos  (Pasta-Stuffed)
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow-tie or other long, skinny pasta ) | 1 package onion soup mix | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup canned diced green chili salsa | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cook pasta, according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water, then drain again. Combine remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat until well combined. Place about 1 tablespoon of the pasta mixture in the center of the tortilla shell. Fold up sides of tortilla around filling and roll up. Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 10 - 15 minutes or until heated through. If there is any stuffing left, spoon over the pasta. Serve warm or refrigerate until serving.

title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise or 1 tablespoon salad dressing, i use miracle whip light and it works out | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari or 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili peppers, in a paste ( we use canned, diced, you can use hot! ) | 2 -3 tablespoons marsala wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,part mozzarella cheese,cayenne pepper,molasses,white vinegar
title: Low Calorie Pesto Queso Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low-calorie molasses | 2 tablespoons reduced sodium white vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 lbs chicken pieces, cooked, boneless, skinless if desired | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk together all the ingredients, but the chicken. Spoon onto a lightly greased grill pan. Close, and reduce the heat to medium. Cook for about 15 minutes or until the sauce reaches desired consistency. Stir the chicken into the sauce. Cover and cook until heated through. Sprinkle the cheese on top.

title: Raspberry and Oranges
ingredients: 4 large firm raspberries | 1 small onion, peeled and chopped
instructions: Wash and hull all the raspberries. Place on a bowl and add onion. Toss well until coated. Pack the raspberries in a decorative jar or dish.

title: Homemade Coffee and Filling for Peroshka
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups strong coffee | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat coffee in a heavy bottomed heavy skillet to boiling. Gradually add the cheese while stirring. Pour into a small cup and ladle into hot, clean cup or mug. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: navel orange,coconut oil,parsnip,tomato paste,maple syrup,white rum
title: Baked Parsnips With Tomatoes and Rum
ingredients: 4 medium parsnips, peeled, trimmed, and thinly sliced | 1 1/4 cups maple syrup | 1/2 cup white rum ( dark ) | 1/3 cup coconut oil | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1 navel orange, halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Place the parsnips in a casserole dish, and in a small bowl, stir together the maple syrup, rum, coconut oil, and tomato paste. Top the parsnips with the marinade, and bake for 15 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter, and sprinkle with orange slices. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Chocolate Pepper Strips
ingredients: 1/3 cup jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons rolo chocolates, coarsely chopped
instructions: Stir the jalapeno pepper and rolo chocolates into the choclate. Place into a zip top plastic bag and refrigerate until cool, at least 5 hours or overnight. Strain the chocolate mixture through a fine mesh sieve lined with cheesecloth. Pour into a resealable plastic bag. Seal the bag.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,garlic salt,bay leaf
title: Muhammara (Moroccan Spice Mix)
ingredients: 1/4 cup bada el hanout spice mix | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 bay leaves or 3 pinches ground cloves
instructions: Shake or stir in a pinch of salt. Store in an airtight container.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh swiss roll hicoche ( or other soft white wheat hicollini ) | 2/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup finely chopped scallion ( green onion )
instructions: Cut hicollini or soft white wheat hibiscusks in half widthwise so there are 4 equal pieces. Stack pieces on a flat surface, cutting about ½ inch away from each other at an angle, then sawing and cutting gently and carefully to prevent sticking. If you are keeping the dough at least ½ inch away from you, slice them as thin as possible, then repeat with the remaining pieces of hicollini or the raw pieces. Let dry at room temperature for 1 to ½ hours. Heat the oil in a heavy large skillet over medium heat until its ripples are shimmering furiously. Working in batches, fry the hicollini, 1 piece at a time, stirring, for 5 to 7 minutes or until cooked through. Transfer to a plate, sprinkle the scallions over and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: pretzel,vegetable stock,cognac,sea salt pepper,farfalle pasta,spaghetti sauce
title: Bow Ties With Spaghetti Sauce and Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne, broken into 3 sections | 1 jar spaghetti sauce ( commercial ) | 2 tablespoons cognac | 2 cups vegetable stock | sea salt and pepper ( to taste ) | 1 dozen pretzel stick
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and rinse. Place farfalle in a 5 quart dutch oven and add enough boiling water to cover by 1 inch, just until the farfalle begins to soften drain and set aside. Add spaghetti sauce, cognac, stock, salt and pepper. Stir until well combined and simmer until desired thickness of sauce is reached, about 10 minutes season with salt to taste.

title: Mushroom soup icing
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup icing sugar | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl. Roll the dough in the icing sugar. Cut into fingers. Bake in a muffin tin at 150 degrees celcius for 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Mango Chutney-Ice Pop
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mango chutney | 1 cup coconut cream | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 tablespoon whiskey
instructions: Put the mango chutney, coconut cream, sea salt and whiskey in a food processor. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Apple Turnovers
ingredients: 2 cups apple juice ( apple juice can be used ) | 1/4 cup whiskey ( optional ) | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f prepare a baking sheet by spraying with nonstick spray. Combine all ingredients except sheets in a medium bowl. Place 1 layer of phyllo in a baking sheet. Spoon some of the liquid mixture along the length of the phyllo stack. Working with 1 sheet at a time, cut through phyllo into 4 equal strips. Lay the 4 strips out on your prepared baking sheet, brushing each strip with a pastry brush. Sprinkle the tops with 1/8 teaspoon of liquid smoke if desired, allow pastry sheets to soak up any juice mixture in the bottom of your baking pan. Bake for 25 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Hot Chocolate Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons double cream or 2 tablespoons whipped cream | 3 tablespoons chocolate slices
instructions: Put the vinegar, cream, and chocolate into a screw top jar and shake over a very low heat to melt. If desired chill until ready to use. Serve with warm meats and vegetables.

title: Artichoke Kiss
ingredients: 1 ripe banana, cut into chunks | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and cut into chunks | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | ice cream
instructions: Place banana chunks and artichoke hearts in a blender. Process until very smooth.

title: Finnish Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh roast beef | 2 -3 fluid ounces hot sauce ( i've never found this, but it might be enough for your taste ) or 2 -3 fluid ounces steak sauce ( i've never found this, but it might be enough for your taste ) | 1 lb fresh loaf of udon noodles or 1 lb fresh noodles
instructions: Cut beef in strips. Bring to a boil in a large pot. After 10 minutes, add noodles and sauce. Cover and simmer 5 - 10 minutes or until noodles are soft.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,parsley sprig,beef bouillon cube,chinese cabbage
title: Sauce Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken bouillon cube | 2 cups chinese cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 cup orange juice | 2 parsley sprigs
instructions: Place everything in a small pot. Simmer about 15 - 20 minutes over low heat until cabbage is soft. Remove from heat and let settle for about 2 - 3 minutes. Put back on heat and stir until all vegetables are cool.

title: Nigella's Green Hot Toddy
ingredients: 2 cups dry port wine | 1/4 cup agave nectar or 1/4 cup maple syrup | juice from jalapeno
instructions: Pour wine and agave nectar in a pitcher or bowl. Stir to mix liquids together. Serve with jalapenos, lime juice, or pineapple slices.

title: Spicy Polish Kielbasa and Spice
ingredients: 1 lb sausage | spice ( optional ) | season salt | 2 tablespoons spiced sausage ( optional ) | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons mixed spice or 4 tablespoons spicy mix spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Spray 9 x 12 glass dish with vegetable cooking spray. Slice sausage and place in dish, on the bottom. Season liberally with spices. Sprinkle spice over sausage. Bake uncovered 90 minutes. After 30 minutes, spoon into cups and serve with crusty loaf or crackers/toast.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Buns
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon granules | 1/1 package pepperoni, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Stir in bouillon granules. Stir in pepperoni. Pour into a greased 8x8 inch pan. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Spread with remaining pepperoni topping. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,tangerine juice,marsala wine,green chili pepper,yogurt,courgette
title: Courgette With Tangerine Juice
ingredients: 1 large courgette | 3 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 green chili pepper | 1/4 cup tangerine juice | 150 g low-fat yogurt | 1/2 cup marsala wine
instructions: Cut the courgette into 4 thick slices and cut slices into 2 wedges each. Wash the tangerine into boiling water to loosen the skin and rinse quickly under cold water. Peel, core and dice. Heat a little oil in a frying pan and fry the tangerine wedges over medium until golden. Remove from the pan and set aside. Slice the chilli over medium heat and quickly add tothe tangerine juice to stop it turning brown. Bring back to the boil and boil for a few minutes. When it is syrupy and starts to smell fragrant add the courgettes and raisens and cook for a few minutes. Remove from the heat, mix in the tangerine juice and yogurt, then divide among serving plates. Pour the tangerine syrup over the top.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,broccoli,lamb stew meat,vegetable shortening,salt pork,chambord raspberry liquor,walnut
title: Lamb and Broccoli Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in 1 inch pieces | vegetable shortening | 10 ounces frozen broccoli, thawed and drained | 10 ounces frozen raspberries | 2 cups chambord raspberry liquor | 1 lb salt pork, cut in 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat oil in dutch oven and brown meat until brown. Remove and reserve. Add 2 1/2 cups pan drippings to reserved drippings and saute the broccoli and raspberries 5 minutes. Add chambord and heat. Pour into crock pot and add salt pork. Add walnuts and stew meat, cook on low 10 minutes. Serve stew over couscous.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,bell pepper,chili paste,cream tomato soup,jicama,quinoa,parsnip,cranberry
title: Crazy Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 package fresh cranberries | 2 medium parsnips | 1/4 cup diced bell pepper, any colour | 1 can condensed cream of tomato soup | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1 tablespoon dried chili paste ( to taste ) | 1/2 chopped jicama
instructions: Place jicama in plastic bag. Add jicama with other ingredients, shake to mix. Make sure bag is touching jicama, then seal bag and refrigerate overnight.

title: North African Grilled Fish
ingredients: 3 large fish | 1 tablespoon ground white pepper | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted
instructions: Brush fish lightly with olive oil, then rub in white pepper with dried parsley and cayenne pepper. Place on hot grill and grill until fish is just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Serve fish with toasted pine nuts sprinkled on top.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,basmati rice,celery seed,oregano leaf,red potato,coffee ice cream
title: Miaquins' Rice and Chips
ingredients: 1 cup dry basmati rice | 1 1/2 cups cold water | 1/4 cup dehydrated coffee ice cream | 1/4 cup chopped frozen chopped red potatoes | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon celery seeds | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained
instructions: Combine the rice, water and coffee ice cream in a large microwave safe serving dish or porcelain container. Microrowave on high for 7 minutes or until hot. Stir, microwave for 2 more minutes or until the mixture is thick and creamy. Stir water chestnuts through the rice mixture. Cover and keep warm in a microwave oven. Turn microwave down to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Serve with a dollop of yogurt and a sprinkle of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,mandarin orange,egg bread,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Spiced Breakfast with Mandarin Orange
ingredients: 1 canned mandarin oranges | 3 scotch bonnet peppers | 8 slices egg bread, toasted | 3 curry leaves
instructions: Pour boiling water over the mandarin oranges and let stand for 5 minutes. Drain oranges and pat dry. Split down the middle, removing the white pith in the flesh. Cut 2 thinly rounds from each slice of bread. Place a slice of orange between 2 bread slices and place a curry leaf on top. Break a few eggs into a small serving bowl. Pour boiling hot tap water over egg whites and mix until whites form peaks.

title: Jalapeno Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped canned jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup chopped celery leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, mix jalapeno peppers, celery leaves, and garlic powder. Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: olive,honey mustard,iceberg lettuce,red curry paste,apple cider vinegar
title: Chilled Apple Salad
ingredients: lettuce, leaves separated from lettuce | 1 cup thinly sliced iceberg lettuce | 1/2 apple, diced | 1/3 cup finely diced ripe olives | 2 teaspoons red curry paste or 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 cup honey mustard
instructions: Place lettuce on plates. Place apple slices in a bowl with olives and red curry paste. Mix together dressing with a fork. Dress salad and serve immediately.

title: Thai Coconut Chips
ingredients: 1 lb raw peeled coconut | 1 cup canola oil, plus extra for frying
instructions: Place the coconut and canola oil in a dry skillet over medium high heat, tossing once or twice, until the coconut is toasted and melted, about 3 minutes. Set the fried coconut chips on paper towels to drain. Store the fried coconut chip in an airtight container at room temperature to improve the flavor, up to 6 days.

title: Homemade Pizza Dough
ingredients: 6 cups all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup sherry wine
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a small amount of warm water. Stir in ½ cup warm water. Let stand for 5 minutes to proof. Stir flour into yeast mixture until dough pulls away from the sides. When dough becomes to stiffen to finger touch, turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Place dough in a well oiled bowl and cover loosely with waxed paper. Let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 2 hours. Punch dough down and turn onto a floured surface. Knead dough into a ball and divide into 2 equal parts. Roll each part of dough into a 12 inch circle, place on a lightly oiled pizza peel, cover and let rest 10 minutes. Spray a large pizza pan with cooking spray. Spread 2 tbsp olive oil onto pizza peel, place yeast dough on peel, spread remaining olive oil onto crust. Sprinkle yeast dough with sherry, top with remaining dough. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 45 minutes. Reduce heat to low and bake 30 minutes, or until crust is lightly browned. Let cool 20 minutes on baking rack.

Random Ingredients: green bean,cardamom pod,white breadcrumb,kosher salt,mint,cipollini onion,yeast
title: Finnish  White  Bread (Tepsi Baytiniju)
ingredients: 2 cups fresh white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 2 teaspoons dried cipollini onion ( aka sweet onion ) | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 300 g green beans, trimmed and cut crosswise into 3-inch-long pieces
instructions: Put all the ingredients except the beans into a large bowl. Add the beans, mixing well. Put the mixture in a warm, wet bowl, cover and let ferment in a warm. Well heated place for 1 hours. Remove from the bowl and put into the refrigerator until ready to use.. Serve as is, with melted butter on top. The bread is usually served toasted with a good pumpernickel sandwich or with jam and fruit, but can be eaten plain, or eaten with your favoriate dippers. Variant, try making your own white bread instead of the basic white bread, and replacing the mint and cipollini with parmesan cheese. Try substituting dry mustard powder for the dried mint and cipollini.

title: Basic Sweet Bread Dough
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon brown bread crumbs
instructions: Mix egg yolk and bread crumbs until blended. Sprinkle bread mixture onto a floured surface and knead dough for 6 minutes or until smooth. Form dough into a ball, place in a covered bowl and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, until dough has expanded and chilled slightly. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Remove dough from refrigerator and divide it in half. Form each half into a round loaf. Wrap each loaf in plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. Place a loaf pan on a cookie sheet or baking stone. Dust lightly with flour. Brush with egg mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: aluminum foil,okra,orange peel,baking apple,blueberry,chinese five spice powder,mustard green
title: Crispy Okra on Chinese Five-Spice Apples
ingredients: 12 okra ( about 1 lb ) | 1 large baking apple, peeled and chopped | 1 bunch mustard greens, chopped ( such as borage, chinese leaf lettuce or napa cabbage ) | 1 orange peel, cut in to long thin strips, removing the pith and white pith | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | aluminum foil, wrapped in a double layer of heavy duty foil or parchment paper | 3 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Snap off the hard tops of the okra. With the vegetable peeler, shave off the coarse strips of skin around the root. You’ll be looking for thin strips about 3 inches long and 1 inch wide. Reserve. Set one cut okra lengthwise on paper toweling. Using the vegetable peeler, shave the remaining okra lengthwise to about 4 1/2 inches in depth, discarding all the peel. Arrange a layer of okra at one end of a paper towel large enough to wrap a single layer of okra around the okra. Dice the apple until about 1/8 inch. Add the remaining ingredients from the parchment to the okra and stir to combine. Lay another strip of okra on top, cut side down, and roll up toward the end of the strip. Continue to roll out the remainder until you have used all the filling and okra. Preheat the oven to 450°f wrap the foil with a double layer of aluminum foil, place in the oven, and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the okra is lightly browned. Remove from the oven. Let sit for about 10 minutes. Serve hot or warm with maple syrup.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,thai red curry paste,mustard powder,cream
title: Creamy Indian Curry Pastry
ingredients: 0.5 package pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1/2 cup light cream | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 tablespoon sour cream
instructions: To make the pastry, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place a pie dish and lid on the bottom of a 9 inch deep dish pie plate. Roll out pastry to fit the pie pan, allowing the pastry to extend over the sides and ends of the crust. Fill pie shell halfway with the cream. Chop the curry paste and add to the cream. Sprinkle mustard powder and sour cream on top and around the rim of the pie dish. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries | 1 1/2 cups white pearl onions, peeled | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning | 4 tablespoons water | 1 cup prepared syrup | 1 1/4 cups watercress | 2 unbaked pastry shells
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Place the blueberries, onions and baking soda in a large bowl. Season with italian seasoning and 1 tablespoon of water. Mix until evenly coated. Press 1 cup of the blueberry mixture into the bottom of a 9 inch pie plate. Spread the maple syrup over the blueberry mixture. Dot with 1 1/4 cup of the watercress. Layer with remaining 2 cups of blueberries. Make another pie crust with remaining 1 1/4 cups blueberries, onions, remaining italian seasoning, and remaining 1 1/4 cups watercress. Roll the pie pastry to fit a 9 inch pie plate, using a fork. Trim excess pastry from the edges of the pie crust, and cover the pie with pastry cutters. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, then reduce the temperature to 325 degrees f, and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and let sit for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Blackberry and Turbinado Soda (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried crushed chipotle powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar ( to make this gluten free, use brown sugar or honey ) | 2 whole cardamom pods, crushed | 1 1 tablespoon dried parsley ( to be gluten free, use fresh parsley ) | freshly chopped blackberries ( to be gluten free, use blackberries, blueberries and strawberries ) ( optional )
instructions: If making the buttermilk yoghurt, combine the buttermilk, chipotle and sugar in a medium bowl and pour over the cardamom pods. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Transfer to a serving dish. Garnish with blackberries and parsley. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 2 days. Enjoy note, gluten free note, this gluten free yoghurt can be made by using a gluten free yoghurt or other non-gluten cheese. Substituting 1 cup unbleached whole wheat pastry flour for the whole wheat pastry flour. You could also use a low fiber plain yogurt. Enjoy.

title: Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 400 g dry kidney beans | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Put the beans in to a large bowl, cover with water and leave to soak overnight or for 2 hours. Preheat the oven to 200°c if you have bought your double cream it's easier. Put the mixture in a casserole dish and top with the cream. Bake for approximately 1 hour or until the cream is reduced by 1/ serve immediately.

title: Fish Stock
ingredients: 4 cups fish fat ( such as bacon bits ) | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil. Place fish fat in the saucepan, and add the parsley leaves. Cook and stir over low heat until the fat has melted and fish is browned, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,dark sesame oil,yellow pepper,ricotta cheese,spanish paprika,vanilla yogurt,marinara sauce,bay scallop
title: Scallops in Light White Seaweed Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces low-fat organic ricotta cheese | 4 ounces organic marinara sauce ( i like trader joe's in light ) | 1 bay leaf | 1 pinch extra virgin dark sesame oil | 1 pinch extra virgin spanish smoked paprika | 16 fresh bay scallops | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, minced
instructions: Preparing the scallops, prepare a large nonstick frying pan with oil or shortening. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a small bowl, stir together the low fat ricotta, and 3/4 of the jar of marinara sauce. Add the bay leaf and whisk until thoroughly mixed. Add the scallops and whisk to coat evenly on both sides. Arrange the scallops in a single layer in the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Scatter the minced sweet pepper over the scallops. Add the remaining jar of sauce and the remaining 1/4 cup of marinara sauce. Cover and heat just until it begins to thicken. Do not boil, as liquid from the scallop will heat the scallops. Transfer the pan to the oven and cook uncovered for 25 minutes. Remove and discard the bay leaf. Note, if you use homemade marinara sauce, you can use one that has been refrigerated for several hours. The sauce will also be more flavorful if refrigerated overnight. Use half or all of the sauce and season to taste. Scallops can also be served hot, like fish, or with pasta and garnish as desired.

title: Pumpkin Spinach
ingredients: 32 ounces pumpkin puree | 8 cups fresh baby spinach | 1 1/2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat the pumpkin puree in a large saucepan over medium heat until hot, but not simmering. Turn down the heat if necessary and stir in the spinach. Simmer until the spinach wilts and is a little dry for 2 to 3 minutes. Season with cayenne pepper and serve at once.

title: Candied Cherries (Cookies)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh cherries, stoned well and pitted | 1 bottle sugar
instructions: Pit the cherries. Put in a jar with 1 cup of sugar and cover with oil. Cover and put into a dark baking pan. Set in a warm oven for about 7 days. Check every few hours. Add more sugar in 1/2 cup increments until you arrive at your desired texture. After removing from the oven, stir frequently. Pour into midde cups to collect juices. Can also be eaten as a snack. Variations, fruit punch is a sweetening for the cherry juices.

title: Oaxacan Corn-Corn Relish for Vegetarians or Choliers
ingredients: 3 cups dry mexican-style corn, drained | 1 can mexican-style corn, drained
instructions: Combine corn and mexican style corn in a blender.

title: Easy Coq Au Vin
ingredients: 1 lb country pork tenderloins ( country-style ) | 6 ounces cannellini beans
instructions: Cut tenderloins cross wise into 1 inch pieces. Put all ingredients into slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours. Turn slow cooker to low during cooking time and stir. Cover and cook 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,veal,chili oil,brown mustard seed,kosher salt,head cabbage,paprika
title: German Christmas Cabbage
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/4 lb ground veal | 4 small heads of cabbage | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Break the cabbage large enough that the head of cabbage is separated into leaves and place them in a large bowl. Dissolve the salt, paprika, and chili oil in a small bowl. Squeeze excess water from the leaves, and wash off the excess. Dice the cabbage up into small pieces. Lay the cabbage into the bowl, and add the mustard seeds. Mix until well combined. Place the cabbage in the refrigerator to marinate, 8 hours to overnight. Remove the cabbage from the refrigerator, and roll up in the confectioners' sugar until it's thoroughly covered. Serve at room temperature.

title: Kofta With Sweet Chilli, Cardamom and Ketchup
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste ( heaping, can use bottled variety ) | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram ( fresh ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom ( dried ) | 1 -2 green chile, deseeded and cut in half lengthwise ( optional )
instructions: Make the kofta dough by combining dry ingredients and mix well with water gradually. Knead the dough, adding more water if needed, until it becomes very smooth and elastic. Cover and keep aside for 30 minutes or longer. To make the ketchup, heat the ketchup on medium high heat until it boils, but do not boil. Remove from heat. When the kofta is done, divide it into four equal parts. Using one piece of dough, roll out into a thin circle. Make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom of the kofta, as this could cause your koftas to stick to the bottom of the kofta. Take one portion of the dough and roll up around the kofta, pressing closed and pressing together. Repeat until all the dough has been used. To make patties, heat the oil/griddle over medium heat. Add a few small batches of the koftas to the oil/griddle at a time, cooking only enough to make them dry on both sides. If necessary, add a few drops of oil or butter for extra crispiness. Fry the patties quickly until golden brown and crisp on both sides. Serve with sweet chilli, padi, tikka, or plain yoghurt. If you want to make the patties into patties for sandwich, you can roll them up and fry in oil/griddle or other pan.

Random Ingredients: steak,tamarind paste,cake flour,italian herb,spanish onion,fennel seed,red pepper lengthwise,cocoa
title: Churrascos
ingredients: 300 g champignol silver-bulb steak | 1 large spanish onion, peeled and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cocoa | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herbs ( or substitute rosemary, basil and dill or use cilantro or basil chive ) | 1/4 teaspoon blackened dried red pepper, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon tamarind paste
instructions: Cut steak into large strips. Coat in spice mixture and marinate for 1 hour or longer. Heat oil to smoking point then toss in the steak and stir fry until browned. Transfer to a warm serving dish and cover. Simmer for 5 minutes then strain juices and reserve. Reheat juices then serve with churrascos.

title: Artichokes Sauteed Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 can artichoke hearts
instructions: Heat oil in medium skillet. Drain artichoke hearts, reserving juice. Add artichoke hearts to skillet and heat through. Do not burn.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,romaine lettuce,cornmeal,red chilies
title: Breadless Focaccia
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornmeal ( stone ground or stone ground ) | 2 tablespoons coarse black pepper, fresh ground | 2 fresh red chilies, red roasted, skinned and deveined and thinly sliced | 2 romaine lettuce | kosher salt and black pepper
instructions: Pulse the first 4 ingredients in a food processor, until chopped fine. Scoop up the red chilies with a paring knife and slice thinly across the entire length. Spread the chiles evenly onto an 8x6 baking dish or shallow serving bowl. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper and broil for 1 to 2 minutes until lightly charred and slightly blackened. Serve right away or store tightly sealed in the fridge for up to 3 days. Alternatively, bake covered for up to 30 minutes at 200c, then broil for 7 to 10 minutes until browned and puffed, turning once for even browning and crispness. This focaccia does not rise well in the oven. Remove and cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,half,yellow squash,kale leaf,heavy cream,cool whip,green bean,fenugreek seed
title: Kale and Squash With Churney
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds or 1 teaspoon ground fennel | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 teaspoons instant kale leaves, powder ( chaulai ) | 1 medium yellow squash, sliced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped green beans | 1 container cool whip
instructions: Heat a medium saute pan on medium heat with 1/2 teaspoon of fenugreek seeks, or whole fenugreek seeds, if using. A few seconds later, add the sugar or brown sugar and saute briefly until the sugar is dissolved, to syrupy consistency. Add the half & half, chaulai powder, squash, green beans and cook until the squash is well coated and heated through. Top with whipped cream if desired and serve hot.

title: Champinativo de Pina (Champinata Mushroom and Pineapple Soup)
ingredients: 3 ounces cremini mushrooms, cut into small pieces | 1 cup fresh pineapple juice
instructions: Place the cremini mushrooms in a bowl of ice cold water and let stand until soft, about 10 minutes. Drain mushrooms, reserving the water. Chop the mushrooms and combine with the pineapple juice in a saucepan over low heat, whisking often. Simmer for about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour the soup into bowls and serve.

title: Creamy Spicy Beef over Rice
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced | 1 can coffee beans, chilled and chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon ground ginger paste | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup light cream
instructions: Add beef to a large non stick skillet. Saute over medium heat for 4 minutes per side. While beef is cooking, combine coffee, teriyaki sauce, ginger, and salt in a medium saucepan. Heat and stir for 3 minutes, until well mixed and hot. Add cream and simmer just long enough to heat through. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,tomato green chile pepper,ricotta cheese,peanut butter,farfalle pasta,corn tortilla chip
title: Hot and Savory Corn Nachos
ingredients: 16 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1/2 cup smooth peanut butter | 12 corn tortilla chips | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a medium glass bowl, mash the ricotta cheese with a fork and add the corn syrup, tomatoes with green chilies, peanut butter and tortilla chips. Mix well, then divide among 2 large baking sheets. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until the sauce is slightly bubbly. Remove from the oven, and immediately transfer to a serving dish or container. Top with more corn syrup if desired, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,prosciutto,allspice,green food coloring,acorn squash,tomato paste
title: Calabrian Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken thighs, skinned, boned and cubed | 4 slices prosciutto | 3 tomatoes, peeled, seeded and diced | 1 acorn squash, peeled and chopped | 3 drops green food coloring | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Add the chicken thighs in a large bowl. Add the prosciutto and diced tomatoes. Pour enough water over the mixture to cover. Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours. The longer it is refrigerated, the more the flavors meld. Pre heat oven 325 degrees. Remove and add the green food coloring and allspice to the mixture. Place the mixture in a casserole dish and bake for 1 hour until the mixture is fairly dry. Serve topped with grated parmesan cheese on top and a leaf of green.

title: Apricot (Sourdough) and Green Curry Dip (Honduran Style)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander powder or 2 tablespoons dried cilantro | 2 teaspoons dried shrimp ( finely ground ) | 1 1/4 tablespoons green curry paste ( i like hotness, but you can decrease to your preference if you prefer ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat 1 - 2 t of corn oil, in a small jar or bowl place 1/2 t onion powder and 1/2 t curry paste and shake vigorously to combine. Set aside. Using remaining oil in a 3 - 4 qt. Punchbowl place half chopped or whole garlic, 1/4 t paprika powder, 1/4 t c coriander powder, 1/4 t nutmeg and 1/2 pms salt. Mix well with a sturdy rolling pin so spices become evenly distributed, roll into balls about 1 inch in diameter. Carefully remove balls from oil, roll into a thick sausage then place in a bowl covered with a cloth. Cover. Place a baking pan on your stove top, in a 400f. Oven or warming oven on medium low heat on the rack. Remove the grease in the pan from the mustard mixture. Dissolve mustard and sugar in 1 1/4 c water and pour over bread. Let sit off heat for 10 - 15 minutes and then serve as a dip with other dipping sauces. Makes appox 8 servings.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,fruit,golden mushroom soup,turkey breast,mayonnaise,basil leaf,marjoram
title: Garlic-Baked Turkey
ingredients: 4 -6 small turkey breast | 1/4 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon basil leaves | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 2 whole dried fruit
instructions: Put all ingredients except dried fruit into a bowl and mix well. Place turkey in a 9 x 12 pan that's been sprayed with cooking spray, with cover on. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until done, turning after 10 minutes. Add dried fruit around 45 minutes before serving. I serve with crusty bread and sour cream. Yummy.

title: Bread Crusted Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 package frozen ramen noodles | 1 lb zucchini, cubed | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, snipped
instructions: Slice the bag of french bread in half lengthwise. Cut 1 - 2 diagonal slices diagonally across the loaf.

title: Tunisian Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 loaf extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup dried fenugreek seeds | 6 tablespoons extra-sharp cheddar cheese, for rolling balls
instructions: Place the cheddar in a small bowl. Sprinkle the fenugreek over it. Roll the cheddar mixture in 1 tablespoon of cheddar. Gently stir the cheddar back into the bowl, squeezing gently to ensure the cheddar is evenly coated. Cover and chill the balls. Drain, and use the remaining 2 tablespoons to roll the balls. If the balls are still sticky, dust them with additional extra sharp cheddar cheese, if desired.

title: Pasta With Queso Fresco and Nuts (Pasta Bows)
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow shapes ) | 4 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 cup queso fresco, crumbled | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Cook farfalle as package directs.

title: Spicy Cheese Burritos (Meat)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sausage | 1 lb stewing beef, cut up small | 16 ounces cheese, any kind, grated, i like velveeta | 12 ounces sliced black olives, drained ( optional ) | 10 flour tortillas, burrito size | 24 dinner rolls, thawed ( if frozen )
instructions: Brown beef and sausage together until well browned. Pour off any excess fat. Spread ground beef mixture into a large baking pan, top with onion, olives, if using. Drain any excess liquid. Spoon a layer of cheese over the mixture, then top with shredded meat and roll up, covering the entire bottom of the pan. If using frozen rolls, place in a 9x13 baking pan. Bake at 350 for about 45 minutes, or until meat is heated through and rolls are lightly browned on top.

title: Tex-Mex Noodles
ingredients: 14 1/2 ounces petite diced tomatoes with puree | 14 1/2 ounces noodle ( or similar type ) | 1 tablespoon hot tap water | 1/4 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Pour the noodle in to a large saucepan.

title: Chef John's Baked Cashews
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cashews, cashews | 1/2 cup margarine, melted | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 2 ripe avocados, pitted and peeled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the cashews out on a kitchen towel, leaving ample space between each one. Place the paper in oven as soon as the cashews are hot, about 7 minutes. Pour 1/2 cup margarine into a bowl. Drizzle 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar over the margarine. Using a rubber spatula, swirl the margarine all around the sides of the bowl. Using a slotted spoon, remove the cashews and toss them in the sugar. Transfer the brown sugar to a container. Use a potato masher to mash the cashews, adding more margarine to the bowl if needed. Mound about 1/2 cup of the chips in the center of each baking sheet. Arrange the avocados around the chips in the pan. Bake until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Use a fork to remove from the oven.

title: Homemade Sesame Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb self-rising flour | 1 cup toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix the flour, sesame seeds and 3/4 cup of water.

title: Koulourakia (Greek Chickpea Fritters)
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour ( besan ) | 1 can chopped tomatoes with ketchup
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Divide mixture into 25 balls. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Place the balls in the pan and fry for about 10 minutes, flipping occasionally. Serve hot.

title: Queso Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 4 slices white american cheese | 1 1/2 cups chopped tomatoes with puree
instructions: Heat the beans in a skillet over medium heat until warm, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place the cheese in the bottom of a soup bowl. Layer the bean mixture, tomato puree, and cheese in the bowl with the cheese.

title: Black Bean & Steak Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 cup double cream | 1 1/2 cups cold cooked black beans, drained | 2 lbs round steaks, trimmed and cut into 6 serving sized pieces | 2 1/4 - 3 cups ice cubes, or as needed | 1 large yellow onion, sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, sprinkle the yeast on the cold black beans and let the mixture stand until the yeast begins to foam up a little, about 5 minutes. Stir in cream.

title: Ajiaco (Zucchini Fennel Bread Salad)
ingredients: 6 lbs zucca root, peeled, and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 6 slices italian bread, 1/4-inch thick ( about 10 oz. each ) | 2 limes, cut into slices | tortilla
instructions: Combine zucchini, fennel, bread, lime slices and 2 teaspoons salt. Cover and refrigerate overnight, turning over the mixture one or two times. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,barbecue sauce,half,wheat flour,lemon juice,peanut
title: The Greatest Cheese Ball
ingredients: 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half or 1/2 cup light cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 teaspoons half-and-half or 2 teaspoons light cream | 1 tablespoon lemons or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons barbecue sauce | peanuts
instructions: Place half and half and cream in a medium size bowl. Add lemon or lime juice and cream. Stir until thoroughly combined. Add cheese, stir until melted and well mixed. Add remaining ingredients until well mixed. Pour into a buttered 8 inch square, greased or round baking dish. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts.

title: Gluten Free Multi-Grain Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 300 g xanthan gum | 300 g white flour | 300 g dried cranberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c mix all ingredients until combined. Cut chips either by hand or with a pastry cutter. Place on a baking tray and bake for 20 - 15 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Quick and Easy Hot Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 15 whole ancho chile powder | 1 bottle oyster sauce
instructions: Heat an empty nonstick skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: red wine,mocca milk chocolate cocoa chip ca n't bar
title: Coco - Goldie's Chocolate Chip Mousse
ingredients: 1 ounce mocca milk chocolate or 1 ounce dairy milk chocolate | 1 ounce red wine ( optional )
instructions: Add the following to a mug with the wine and stir well. Add sweetened condensed milk if desired – this is optional because of the dairy milk chocolate and red wine, the wine helps with the melting.

title: Homemade Nuts
ingredients: 3 cups cornmeal | 12 tablespoons white chocolate, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl mix 3 cups cornmeal, 12 tablespoons white chocolate, and 3 tablespoons of oil. Mix until well combined. Dump onto lightly floured surface and knead by hand for about five minutes. Pat into a 1/4 or 1/2 thick. Cut with cookie cutter or razor blade into fours. Bake at 400f degrees for 12 - 15 minutes until light brown. Let cool slightly, then cut into 1 1/2 squares.

title: Crock-Pot Swedish Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, cut into 6 -8 pieces | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 3 1/2 ounces pineapple-flavored cocktail frankfurters ( optional ) | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 slice rye bread, coarsely torn ( optional )
instructions: Combine pineapple juice, juice cocktail and bread.

title: Beet Salad - Algerian Beet Salad
ingredients: 10 large beet, medium-size, washed and peeled | 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice
instructions: Rinse and dry the cooked beets then place in a bowl with the pomegranate juice. Mix well. Chill the salad until serving time or leave overnight.

title: Cape Malay
ingredients: 400 g spaghetti | 8 drops cardamom
instructions: Place a large pan of water on a medium to high heat. Bring to the boil then cook for one minute or until al dente. While waiting for the water to boil, put a large saucepan, some of the water may be boiling, and the other ingredients, as well, on the top on a burner. Cook your spaghetti following the instructions on the packet. When cooked, drain and serve hot using the sauce in a bowl.

title: Cashew Patties
ingredients: 225 g cashews, roasted | 2 tablespoons coriander, ground | 25 g lard, lean
instructions: Break cashewnut in to small pieces. Sprinkle coriander over the cashews. Add the lard and knead lightly. Make into patties of 4 cm diameter. Grill or fry as required.

title: The Desertified Easy Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup tahini | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice
instructions: In small bowl, mix the tahini, vermouth, and lime juice together. Serve as a dip with pita chips, tortilla chips, or as a garnish for salads.

title: Spicy  Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 7 tablespoons chili paste | 1/2 tablespoon red pepper, grated | 1 tablespoon lemon, zest of, grated | 1/4 cup sugar, to taste | 8 ounces provolone cheese, sliced thin
instructions: Combine chili paste, red pepper, lemon zest and sugar. Sprinkle the provolone cheese on top. Place in small individual casserole dish, dish towel dried for at least an hour, until cheese is firm and bubbly. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Pork and Cranberry Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean boneless pork, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 cups cranberry juice | 1 tablespoon savory, dried | chopped fresh radish, green onion, celery, spinach
instructions: In a 4 quart saucepan, place the pork, cranberry juice, savory and 3 cups water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Stir in the radishes and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,serrano pepper,orange juice,red burgundy wine,pecorino romano cheese
title: Red Burgundy Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup red burgundy wine ( or sweet white wine ) | 1/3 cup orange juice | 2 cups freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 serrano pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the red wine. Let stand until creamy, about 10 minutes. Stir in the orange juice. Add cheese and serrano pepper. Mixture should be rather warm.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,non dairy creamer,hazelnut,pimento olive,beef stock cube
title: Noodles With Hazelnuts (Healthy Alternative to Beef)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted hazelnuts | 1 medium beef stock cube, crushed | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon pimento stuffed olive ( sliced ) | 1 tablespoon non-dairy creamer ( or other flavour sugar you desire )
instructions: Put nuts in bowl using a spoon or pastry bag. Add olive leaves. Crush stock cube into crumbs. Add the liquid and nut mixture and mix well, so as not to make a paste. Put in fridge for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. When ready to serve, mix well and remove from fridge.

title: Garlic Mayonnaise
ingredients: 2 tablespoons melted butter | 2 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 -4 tablespoons dried parsley flakes ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the melted butter and oil. Add parsley flakes.

title: Sausage Cakes With Red Beans
ingredients: 500 g lean ground sausage | 100 g ground lamb | 4 sausages | 2 cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 large red beans | 1 teaspoon dried saffron or 1 teaspoon ground fresh saffron
instructions: Boil the red beans in water until soft. Remove from the heat and strain. Combine the sausage, lamb, sausages and cauliflower florets in a bowl and season to taste. Divide the sausage mix into four, shape each into a pattie on a hot griddle. Cook each side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove the sausages from the oven, and leave to rest for about five minutes before removing from the oven. Heat the patties on a griddle, turning frequently. When all of the sausages are cooked, arrange on a baking tray and top with red beans and saffron. Serve with boiled new potatoes.

title: Cousin Pete's Cheese With Saffron Tapenade (Qatarain Qibe)
ingredients: 250 g soft fresh goat cheese | 1 bomba saffron
instructions: Use all the ingredients as well. Mix well or store in airtight container for upto 1 week.

title: Russian Beetroot Soup
ingredients: 10 large beetsroot, peeled, washed and diced | 2 cups stock | 1 cup cucumber, deseeded, diced | 1 star cardamom seeds
instructions: Wash and scrub beets. Place in pot and cook over medium heat for approximately 40 minutes until tender. Cool, then transfer to blender or food processor. Add stock, cucumber, and star cardamom seeds and process until well mixed. Blend until fairly smooth and add liquid by tablespoonfuls, depending on how thick you like your soup. Cover and refrigerate leftovers. Serve, in chilled bowls, with crusty bread for dipping.

title: Liptoiardi (Grand Marnier Baked Onions)
ingredients: 3 medium spanish onions, peeled and sliced ( the length of a large spoon ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons oil, divided use | 1 1/2 teaspoons grand marnier or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh orange juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Slice onions lengthwise into thin slivers. Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons oil in a 10 or 12 inch heavy nonstick skillet over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, then cook onions, stirring occasionally, mashing with a wooden spoon, until golden brown, about 8 minutes. Return onions to skillet, sprinkle with remaining 3/4 teaspoon oil, and sprinkle with grand marnier. Cook until liquid is reduced to 1/4 cup, about 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: miso,clam,bulk italian sausage,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cream cheese,white wine vinegar,pear,pork sausage
title: Clams & Sausage With Creamy Pear Spread
ingredients: 12 ounces bulk hot italian sausage ( remove casings and crumble ) | 12 ounces pork sausage ( remove casings and crumble ) | 12 ounces ground bacon ( or sausage of choice ) | 12 ounces firm pears | 8 ounces clam, in shells ( small can ) | 3 ounces cream cheese | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup miso | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place sausage and pork in a large skillet and brown and crumble the meats in the skillet until cooked through, breaking sausage into bite sized pieces. Remove meat from skillet, leaving a small amount of fat in the skillet. In the same skillet, add the bacon and brown lightly, and drain off any fat. Add the pears and minced clams and cook over very low heat for 10 minutes or so, stirring from time to time. In a large bowl, stir together sour cream cheese, white wine vinegar, miso and 1/2 cup of the parmigiano reggiano cheese. Stir the sour cream/marinade mixture into the sausage and pears a few minutes before baking in the oven. Sprinkle remaining cheese and remaining parmigiana reggiano cheese over the top, place in oven and bake for about 5 minutes until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,rice vermicelli,tamarind paste,golden brown sugar
title: Rice Vermicelli Balls
ingredients: 60 g rice vermicelli | 120 g golden brown sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons tamarind paste | 60 g bread flour
instructions: Put the sugar and tamarind paste in a food processor and mix well. Add the rice vermicelli. Process on high until all the ingredients are well mixed. Place a teaspoon of the mixture on a lightly greased tray. Make a small depression in each side of the rice vermicelli and shape a little ball using your palm. Press the rice vermicelli into the palm of your hand and press the palm with the palm of your hand to flatten. Repeat until the mixture is used up. Place palm side down in a hot dry and dry pan and cook over a medium heat until brown. Turn the rice vermicelli balls over and cook for 15 - 20 minutes until golden. Eat warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,crema,chili flake,red enchilada sauce,basil leaf,thyme,cold water
title: Curried Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 8 -10 leaves fresh basil leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 5 -6 leaves fresh basil leaves | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1 -2 teaspoon mild chili flakes | 1/2 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon crema ( optional )
instructions: Place the first 4 ingredients in a blender or food processor. Blend well to blend. Pour in cold water slowly, blending well. Add crema, if using, at the desired point.

Random Ingredients: lamb stock,cardamom pod,lime juice zest,french bread lengthwise
title: Lamb Shank Soup
ingredients: 500 g lamb bones, trimmed | 3 tablespoons lime juice, and zest of | 500 ml lamb stock, made by cooking 1 tablespoon lime juice, drained of excess liquid | crusty french bread, to serve
instructions: In a large saucepan cover the bones with cold water and bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes, skimming the scum from the surface if required, and then drain. Add a splash of lime juice and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes more or until the bones are tender. Allow the stock to cool slightly then discard any bones, bones and skins that have not pinched. Remove the meat from the bones and shred, using your fingers, if they are a bit too soft. Taste for seasoning and correct seasoning if necessary. You may either put the soup in a food processor or blender, processing on high until you have a creamy paste. Return the soup to the saucepan and heat through. Scatter the remaining lime rind on top and serve with a crusty stale bread.

title: Pistachio and Chicken Roasted
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, quartered if large | 2 cups coarsely chopped pistachios | 2/3 cup good brandy | 1/2 cup sour cream ( lowfat or nonfat ) | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 teaspoon red pepper, flakes- to taste | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place chicken on rack in shallow roasting pan or roasting pan. Bake for 30 minutes or until just cooked through. Cover with foil if browning and cool for 15 minutes. Remove chicken from pan. Place pistachios in a food processor, add brandy, food proc, sour cream, lemon extract, red pepper flakes and 1/4 of ground red pepper. Pulse until smooth. Spoon onto cooled chicken. Bake for one hour on lowest oven rack, or until topping is golden. Cut into serving pieces. Spoon on remaining red cherry sauce for dipping.

title: Faux Sage Leaves
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh sage leaves | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/8 teaspoon ginger powder
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sage, cardamom and ginger. Allow to sit at room temperature for 1 1/2 to 2 hours before using as desired.

title: Jamaican Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup of thawed lime juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in crockpot. Cover and cook on low 10 hours or high 5 hours.

title: Rub for Pork Roast #RSC
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 32 ounces good quality pork rinds | 1 bunch fresh raspberry | 3/4 cup sugar | 4 -5 garlic cloves, crushed ( to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons mixed spice rub ( to taste )
instructions: Rub meat with spice rub. Place rind on large baking sheet and place in a 400 degree oven. Roast for 20 minutes per pound or until meat is medium to deep brown in color. While meat is cooking prepare berries while the meat is roasting. Remove fat. Reduce temperature to 300 degrees f. Remove pork from oven and cut into smaller pieces about 2 1/2 inches in diameter. Place in single layer on the baking sheet. Roast for another 5 minutes per pound at 300 degrees f. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 5 - 10 minutes. Place on large platter and garnish with the raspberries, sugar, garlic and mixed spice. Tear off pieces of meat and slice into pieces before serving.

title: Simple Japanese Salmon
ingredients: 3 salmon fillets | 1/2 cup silken tofu, well drained | 2 teaspoons light soya sauce | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | seasoning salt, to taste
instructions: Place salmon in an oven safe pan. Add all other ingredients except the salmon. Bake at 350f degrees, uncovered, for about 20 minutes depending on thickness of salmon. If the salmon seems watery, you may need to add more liquid.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,seasoning salt,biscuit,oregano leaf,mint,red curry paste,vegetable oil,pasta
title: Tandoori Tandoori Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 green pepper, finely diced | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 1/2 cups dry pasta-style small curd biscuits | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 2 packets plain sweet biscuit biscuits ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the oil over high heat. Add the green pepper and cook, stirring, until tender. Stir in the red curry paste, oregano and seasoned salt, and cook for 1 minute. Add the pasta and stir to coat with the curry paste. Transfer the pasta to a colander, rinse with warm water, and dry completely in a separate bowl. Preheat the broiler. Place the biscuits onto a baking sheet, and place under the broiler for 1 to 2 minutes on each side. Place the biscuits on a plastic bag with the mint and/or biscuit coating. Place the noodles on a waxed paper lined cutting board. Cut the biscuits into 1 inch cubes. Roll each cube into a small ball, then place on each noodle. Brush the tops of the noodles with water. Heat the remaining oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the biscuit cubes and fry, turning once, until golden brown and crisp, about 5 minutes per side. If desired, place the noodles on a serving plate and serve with the mint and/or biscuit coating.

title: Lentils and Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon whole grain gluten ( or 2 1/4 tsp. rice gluten )
instructions: Heat a large heavy saucepan over low heat. Add lentils, rice, and gluten, and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer gently until rice is tender and lentils are tender, approximately 30 - 40 minutes.

title: French Confetti Pie
ingredients: 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 3 tablespoons double crust pie crust | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 5 ounces bittersweet chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1 unbaked pie crust
instructions: For topping, sprinkle 1 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar over spinach in a large bowl. Pour chocolate over top.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,tomato sauce,yellow bell pepper,pastry crust pie,mint leaf
title: Beef Samosas
ingredients: 1 pound beef sirloin steak | 1 small yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1 pastry for a 9-inch double crust pie
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Place the sirloin steak in a large pot over high heat. Add the bell pepper, tomato sauce and mint. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and simmer 20 minutes. Spread 1/2 the beef mixture in the bottom of a pastry lined baking dish, and top with remaining beef and bell pepper mixture. Pierce holes in the pastry with a sharp knife.

title: Green Veggie Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup diced raw green asparagus | 1 cup brown rice, washed and drained | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 large flour tortillas, fried or 1 large burrito flour tortilla
instructions: In a skillet or wok, fry the asparagus in small amount of oil for about 7 minutes or until the asparagus is crisp tender and beginning to brown. Take the asparagus out with a slotted spoon. Add in the rice, turmeric, salt and cocoa powder and stir to coat. Heat a few minutes until the rice is warm. Arrange the warm rice on the tortillas, spooning as much of the mixture onto the tortillas as you can. Fold the remaining ingredients into the tortillas, folding in sides as you go. Serve immediately.

title: Red Onion & Cream Dressing
ingredients: 1 large red onion ( use the whole thing, but if in smaller you like, add 1/2 cup water ) | 1 2/3 cups half and half cream
instructions: Add all ingredients and mix well.

title: Cauliflower Cheese and Strawberries Salad
ingredients: 500 g baby cauliflower florets | 60 g yoghurt | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 60 g grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 bunch fresh strawberries | 1 slice ginger ( optional )
instructions: Boil and steam the cauliflower until just tender. Place in bowl mix yoghurt, soda, cheese, grand marnier and ginger. Pour over the cauliflower and toss it. Serve.

title: Brazilian Sunrise
ingredients: 2 ounces creme de cacao | 1 ounce orange juice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve.

title: Kathy's Best Caesar Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour over salad just before serving.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,sherry wine,hash brown potato,green cardamom pod,mustard powder,tofu,cheesecloth
title: Tofu Hashbrown Potato Wraps (Kaffeeen)
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, drained and pressed | 2 tablespoons roasted mustard powder ( dijon preferred ) | 1 tablespoon sherry wine ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 4 green cardamom pods, seeded and chopped finely | 2 lbs hash brown potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4 inch slices on the horizontal | 1 sheet cheesecloth | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder, to sprinkle over the top of the wraps
instructions: Cut the tofu into 1/4 inch cubes. In a medium bowl, mix the mustard, sherry, balsamic, mustard powder, and cardamom. Add the potatoes and mix thoroughly. Lay a piece of tofu on your work surface, coat with a little of the mustard mixture, and spread with about 1 tbsp of the potato mixture on it. Using 1/8 of a teaspoon, make a 1/2 inch hole in the center of each wrap, and use a spoon to make a 1 inch hole on each potato. Starting from the side closest to you, carefully bring the filled wrap about 3/4 inch from the bottom and tuck the ends down under the filling. With 1 hand on the top and a table knife on the left side, roll the wrap. Secure the roll with a toothpick, and bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Slide the filled wraps into the boiling water 1 piece at a time, cooking 1 - 2 at a time, until they float to the surface.

title: Dressed Mushrooms & Marsala
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mixed mushrooms | 2 teaspoons mustard | 2 tablespoons tomato puree or 2 teaspoons marsala wine | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine
instructions: Heat the mustard in a frypan and stir fry the mushrooms all over for 5 minutes. Place in a serving bowl and stir in the marsala, pour over the mushrooms & sprinkle with remaining mustard.

Random Ingredients: mustard,red wine vinegar,cheddar cheese,white flour,cream mushroom soup,asparagus
title: Mustard, Asparagus & Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 bunch thin asparagus, trimmed | 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/3 cup unbleached white flour | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Place asparagus in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring water to a boil and cook asparagus for 2 to 3 minutes, until bright green, crisp tender. Drain and place in a medium bowl. Pre heat oven to 250f degrees. Drain soup cans. In medium bowl, combine all ingredients. Spread in a shallow 9x13 pan that has been sprayed with pam, or lightly sprayed with pam. Bake at 250f degrees about 30 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned. Turn off oven, and immediately pour all contents into a blender. Cover and process on medium to high speed until mixture thickens, about 1 minute or so. Spread mixture over warm asparagus in baking dish and bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned. Serve warm.

title: Applebee's Lamb Broth (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 3)
ingredients: 1 kg lamb chop | 100 ml teriyaki sauce | 100 ml apple cider
instructions: Put lamb fillet in a shallow ceramic or glass bowl and pour teriyaki sauce over. Allow to marinate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. Meanwhile, preheat grill to high. Thread lamb, alternating with the steaks, on 4 to 5 skewers. Bbq on low for 12 minutes or until cooked to your liking.

title: Sautéed Spicy Figs on Rice With Swiss Cheese, Tomato and Basil
ingredients: 24 fresh figs, halved, stemmed | 4 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1 medium swiss cheese, cut into thin slices, about 1/4 inch wide | 4 slices sweet italian tomatoes, such as san marzano | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( heaped ) | 1 tablespoon unbleached rice | 1 tablespoon finely shredded lemon peel
instructions: Place 2 of the figs cut side up on a cutting board and slice each into a 1/2 inch wide, 2 1/2 inch long slabs about 1/4 inch thick. Place on a large plate with paper towels. Put a 1 slice of cheese, a tomato slice, 2 strips of prosciutto, and a 4 second swiss round on top of each. Arrange the remaining figs cut side down on the cheese, tomato slice, prosciutto and swiss side of each fig. In a small small bowl, combine the cornflour and water until there are no sign of lumps and set aside. Dip the assembled figs in the cornflour water and put them on a nonstick griddle set over low heat. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until firm and lightly browned. Cut the remaining 2 figs into quarters and place them and the remaining cheese slices, prosciutto side down, on the top. Serve immediately.

title: Chile Focaccia Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon yeast | 1 red bell pepper, diced | 1 green pepper, diced | poblano chile, diced | 2 parsnips, diced | 1/2 cup fresh green peas or 1/2 cup frozen green pea slices, thawed | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh red chili pepper flakes, to taste
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and stir in peppers, parsnips, green peas. Let stand until ready to use. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 425 degrees. Sprinkle bread with red chili flakes and bake for 10 minutes or until crust just starts to form on top. Remove from oven.

title: Parma Ham and Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/3 cup dijon mustard | 1/3 cup thinly sliced parma ham | 3 dash hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Whisk ingredients in a bowl. Spread on a pizza or other flat bread. Cut diagonally into 1/2 inch slices. Place on a foil lined cookie sheet. Cover. Place on the oven rack and bake at 400 degrees f for 10 to 15 minutes or till bread is toasted.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,corn syrup,fennel seed,asiago cheese,polenta,beef chuck
title: Mountain Beef Twirls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn syrup | 8 -12 ounces polenta ( fine ) | 1 cup asiago cheese, finely grated | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f combine all ingredients in a bowl. Set aside. Cut dough into 24 6x6 inch sections by cutting out dough, leaving the 1/3 inch thick sections. Roll up each section and pinch the ends closed. Place on a rimmed baking sheet. Pour 1/3 1/2 cup boiling water over dough and let stand, loosely covered, for 10 minutes. Roll out into a rectangle and pinch ends well. Place on baking sheet, and bake for 30 minutes, until golden brown and crisp. Remove from oven and let stand 3 - 5 minutes before slicing. Toss beef with sauce and serve.

title: Pinchi (Indian Hot-Cashew Nut Relish)
ingredients: 2 cups unsalted cashew nuts, toasted | 1/2 cup fresh scallions, chopped | 1/4 cup lard | 3/4 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: Combine cashews, scallions and lard in a large bowl. Rub in the toasted cashew mixture just until well combined. Transfer the mixture to a blender. Add the cumin and blend to a coarse paste. Pour into sterilized jars. Seal and process in hot water bath for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: steak,rice wine vinegar,salad oil,garlic salt,white sugar,stewing beef,lemon extract
title: Mom's Awesome Beef Steak Rolls
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb round steak, thin | 1 tablespoon brown rice wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon lemon extract | 2 teaspoons white sugar, i usually just add more | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 2 tablespoons dry roast fat ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons short-cut bacon ( optional )
instructions: Make sure beef is thoroughly coated. Marinate for at least an hour. Preheat grill to high. Line the bottom of foil with baking parchment. Wash and pat dry the beef. Cut each piece of beef diagonally across the grain into 1 inch pieces. Using a meat mallet or rolling pin, pound the pieces between the palms of your hands to 1/4 inch thickness. They should have a slightly flattened texture but not like to stick. Place the beef pieces on the foil and place in the oven, 475 degrees on the middle rack or until the meat thermometer reads 140 degrees for medium. While the meat is cooking, make the bbq sauce. Stir together the rice wine vinegar, lemon extract, sugar and garlic salt. In a small bowl or cup, mix together oils and sugar. Dip the beef pieces in the oil/sugar mixture, allowing some for a brushing on before the others. Cook for about 5 - 7 minutes per side until fully cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 cup cream of tartar | 1 cup vanilla sugar | 2 lbs round steaks | 4 large eggs | 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
instructions: Make filling by placing all ingredients in a small saucepan, mixing well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Prepare a broiler heat setting. Using tongs, transfer steak to a broiler pan. Brush top with melted butter. Broil 30 seconds on each side or until desired doneness is reached, brushing frequently with butter. Serve immediately.

title: Thai Basil Crust Pasta Appetizer
ingredients: 2 lbs small shell-on pasta | 5 teaspoons thai basil ( available at asian markets, or oriental food stores ) | 5 medium dried red chilies, stems and veins crumbled ( optional ) or 4 small green serrano chilies, stems and veins chopped ( available at asian markets or oriental food stores ) | 1 cup pastry for double-crust pie, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/romaine-basil-2038 '' > romaine basil < /a >, < /a >
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, adding 3 tsp of thai basil when the pasta is almost done. Drain pasta, saving 1/2 cup of liquid. Spread pasta shell on a jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper and spread with thai basil. Cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour, or until filling is set. If using serrano or green chilies, scrape chiles out of seeds with a teaspoon, or heat a grill pan over medium high heat. If using regular chilies, cut off tops of chiles immediately. If using green tomatoes, cut off tops of tomatoes within 1/2 of stem end first, then halve lengthwise and cut into pieces 1/4 inch thick. Add oil to a shallow saucepan, heat over medium low heat, and add remaining 2 tsp fresh basil. Cook briefly until basil softens, then remove from heat. Add pasta, and stir to coat with oil. Add reserved pasta liquid to saucepan and bring to a boil, then stir in the remaining ½ cup chopped basil. Spoon filling into pastry lined pastry lined pan. Cut 4 slits into the top of crust to allow steam to escape. Brush top crust with remaining thai basil flavored oil and sprinkle with reserved chopped basil. Bake at 350f for about 45 - 50 minutes or until top is golden and crust is browned. Cut into 2 equal sections, for each crust, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,golden syrup,fennel,garlic chive,pasta,beef broth,crescent dinner
title: Maurie's Beef Crescent Beef Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces crescent dinner rolls, frozen | 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon fennel ( if using ground meat or mushrooms, reduce fennel to 1/2 tsp and increase ) | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, sliced very thinly | 1/3 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup fresh fennel, chopped ( a pinch ) | 3 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Combine all the rolls ingredients in a medium sized mixing bowl, mix well, until the beef and turkey are evenly distributed. Preheat the oven to 350 or mark divide the mixture into 1/2 to 1 3/4 pound meat and mix well, set aside. Roll the dough pieces into the palms of your hands to form 2 inch long rolls, about 10 to 12 inches long, and press lightly in with fingertips to prevent sticking. Place on a cookie sheet that has been lined with parchment paper covered with foil and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden.
