Place the rolls on a platter covered with wax paper and keep covered with a damp towel until serving time. When all of the buns are finished baking, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place the warm rolls in the oven and bake for a few minutes or until the rolls are a little crispy on the outside but still moist inside. While they are baking, prepare the beef and vege gravy by combining the broth, fennel, and chives in a medium sized saucepan. Simmer on low for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from the stove, add the beef and vege gravy and mix well, to combine. Place the rolls onto individual plates and ladle the gravy over. Serve immediately, garnished with more fennel flakes, if desired.

title: Feta Cheese & Peach Oatcakes
ingredients: 4 cups rolled oats ( i use quick baking oats ) | 2 cups rolled graham crackers ( dry ) | 3/4 cup white rice | 2/3 cup beer | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup chinese cabbage, shredded ( i use napa ) | 2 cups peach halves, pitted and sliced | 1/3 - 1/2 cup reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Stir the oats, graham crackers and dry rice until combined. Add the beer, cayenne and cabbage. Stir and spread into ungreased 8x8 pan or 9 inch pan. Topping, sprinkle top with feta cheese. Bake at 350 degrees 5 to 10 mintes or until topping is browned and fragrant, but the cereal does not burn. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Sausage Fritters
ingredients: 8 ounces italian sausage | 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Remove sausage fibers from casing onto a cutting board. Cut the sausage into 1 inch pieces and discard casing. Dredge pieces in flour and fry in a non stick skillet. You can also add a layer of wax paper that has been lightly greased for the fritters in a small pan over medium high heat. The fritters are done when the bottom turns light brown. If you feel vigilant it is time to remove pan from the heat, you can place fritters back in pan to brown the other side while frying. These fritters can also be rolled up in a plastic zipper bag or paper bag and frozen for later use.

title: Green Pepper and Chilies Pilaf
ingredients: 1 -2 lb green pepper, sliced into 1/4 inch strips | 1 can whole red chilies, drained | 1 package long grain rice, raw, prepared
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Drain chilies and cut into thick slices, removing the seeds. Alternate strips of peppers and chillies in a non stick skillet. Place skillet over medium heat for a few minutes stir, to coat. Add rice and fry, stirring constantly until coated.

Random Ingredients: sausage,balsamic vinegar,pine nut,spaghetti,pita bread,fennel bulb,bell pepper,amaretto liqueur
title: Italian Sausage Pizza
ingredients: 2 pita bread, rounds | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 ounce balsamic reduction or 1 ounce amaretto liqueur | 170 g pork sausages | 240 g spaghetti, cooked | 1 1/2 cups fennel bulbs, thinly sliced | 1 medium bell pepper, seeded and sliced thin | 1 3/4 cups fennel leaves, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f. Brush pita rounds on both sides with the vinegar and set aside. Place pita rounds on baking dish and bake for 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove pita rounds and set aside. Increase oven temperature to 400 f. Add sausages to oven and cook until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile place spaghetti in pot of boiling water and cook for 8 minutes or until tender. Drain. Heat 2 tbsp of the reduced fat in a large non stick pan over medium heat. Add the fennel, bell pepper and fennel and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Place fennel and pepper mix and sausages in pan. Add to spaghetti and add remaining 1/2 cup of reduced fat drippings. Bring to boil. Cover and continue to cook for 8 minutes or until pasta is tender.

title: Limey Beef Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cubed small | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon lime juice, from lime zest | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons asiago cheese, finely grated | 3 tablespoons miso
instructions: In large heavy pan over medium high heat, add all ingredients except meat. Stirring frequently, cook until meat cubes are cooked through and juices evaporate. Reduce heat and allow to simmer 15 - 20 minutes or until meat cubes are well cooked, stirring occasionally. If mixture is too thick, add some more water. Sauce should thicken up a little bit during cooking. If sauce is too runny, use a whisk to thin it out. Taste and adjust seasonings. Serve over cooked hot greens, steamed carrots or potatoes.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,baby green,anchovy fillet,yeast,lemon pepper seasoning,rice wine vinegar,beer
title: Baby Greens Terrine Rolls
ingredients: 1 package whole raw spinach | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup lemon pepper seasoning, plus | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning | 2 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 4 cans anchovy fillets, drained | 1/4 cup light beer
instructions: In a saucepan, add the rice wine vinegar, lemon pepper seasoning, and yeast. Cook over medium heat until foamy. Add the beer and warm to lukewarm before adding to the rice wine vinegar mixture. Add the baby greens leaves and bring to a boil. Cover and cook on medium low heat until all the greens are wilted and slightly limp, about 5 minutes.

title: Horseradish Tangerine Relish
ingredients: 2 tangerines, peeled | 1/2 cup bottled horseradish, room temperature
instructions: Using an electric spice grinder, finely peel the tangerines, discarding the peel. Using the melon baller, scoop out the pulp and seeds, discarding the cores and white membrane. Combine the peel, horseradish, and tangerines and mix thoroughly. Transfer to the refrigerator until needed.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,splenda sugar substitute,onion powder,pork shoulder,walnut,fennel bulb,olive
title: Walnut and Fennel Stuffed Pork Roast
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless pork shoulder, butterflied | 10 ounces sliced pecorino cheese ( crumbled fennel cheese ) | 10 ounces drained sliced ripe olives ( drained ) | 5 teaspoons onion powder | 10 teaspoons chicken bouillon ( i use chicken bouillon ) | 2 teaspoons dried fenel bulbs ( i use `` small frozen petite-sized '' bulbs ) | 2 tablespoons splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Place pork shoulder in a large ziploc, or other deep dish. Add remaining ingredients except for the cheese. Shake or fold the bag to combine. Taste and add more salt if needed. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove pork roast from refrigerator and place on a rack in a roasting pan or on a baking pan. Tent with foil and roast for 1 1/2 hours or until falling apart tender. Serve with a crusty Italian loaf and top with sauce.

title: Slow Cooker Crabmeat
ingredients: 8 pounds fresh lump crabmeat, drained | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 cup chopped celery | 3 green onions, chopped | 2 packages chicken tenders, thawed
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 5 quart slow cooker, combine crabmeat, caraway seed, celery, green onions and chicken tenders. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and turn slow cooker on high. Cook 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,vanilla soymilk,streaky bacon,lamb shoulder,cumin powder,brown sugar,spaghetti sauce,catsup
title: Lamb Shwarma
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lamb shoulder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup soymilk | 8 slices streaky bacon | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Combine lamb shoulder, cumin and 4 of the sauces to make a marinade. Marinade several hours to overnight. Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain. Cook bacon until crisp. Combine sauce and bacon and stir until well combined. Remove lamb shoulder from pan and add to sauce, cook a few minutes more stirring to coat. Add remaining sauces and cook, stirring occasionally, a few minutes until desired thickness and flavors have blended. Add catsup, horseradish and sugar.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,asparagus spear,pepperoni,garam masala,red wine vinegar,onion,pineapple,cauliflower
title: Cheesy Baked Cauliflower and Cauliflower Chips
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple ( optional ) or1/4 cup honey mustard ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 -2 teaspoon pepperoni, minced | 16 corn tortilla chips | 1/4 cup canned whole sweet corn tortilla chips, drained and crushed ( if you're not terribly fond of crunchy stuff )
instructions: Break apart cauliflower and break into small florets. Place in large mixing bowl and add vinegar. Stir in pineapple or honey mustard, garam masala, and pepperoni. Coarsely mash cauliflower and add to salad. Place chips in single layer in a shallow baking dish, arranging them around the side of the bowl. Sprinkle crushed tortilla chips and corn chips on top of the cauliflower and cauliflower.. Bake at 400°f for 20 minutes or until cauliflower is tender and chips are crispy.

Random Ingredients: lipton onion soup mix,liquid smoke,green curry paste
title: Thai Green Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 packet lipton onion soup mix | 5 -10 dashes liquid smoke ( or 2-3 tbsp. liquid smoke to your taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons green curry paste
instructions: Heat a dutch oven. Mix together all the ingredients until well combined. When the pot has hot to you, pour in the green curry powder & heat for a minute to stir through. Serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Mexican Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon prepared chinese mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and stir well. Store in refrigerator.

title: Easy Deliciously Decadent Guacamole
ingredients: 1 can goya original rotel tomatoes ( i use rotel brand ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup packed finely chopped orange peel | 1 - 1 1/2 cup guacamole
instructions: Drain canned items from rotel into pan, leaving juice in pan. Add all ingredients to same pan and stir thoroughly. Cook on low heat until almost heated through. Enjoy with your favorite tortilla chips. I have even seen recipes that go into dip dishes or bowls, and put chips right in the pan over the guacamole. Try it, you can play with the spices in this dish.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,ginger garlic paste,white cabbage,topping,green onion,curd
title: Tibetan Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb white cabbage ( i use green ) | 2 -4 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste or 2 -4 tablespoons fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons curds | chopped green onion ( to garnish ) | fat, to top | topped fat, to top | 1 pinch saffron threads ( optional )
instructions: Shake colander well to collect excess water. Scrape out outer leaves of cabbage, if any. In a large bowl or pot combine all ingredients, except fat and saffron.

title: The Brit a La Dr Andrew Weil
ingredients: 200 g carrots ( peeled, then julienne ) | 1 teaspoon mortadella ( or fresh herb ) | 1 tablespoon sweet sesame oil | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon grand marnier
instructions: Place the carrots in a pan with water to a good depth of 2 inches over the carrots, bring to the boil and boil until tender when pricked with a fork. Drain and refresh with cold water in a colander. Repeat until all the water has drained from the carrot. Keep warm. Heat the sesame oil in a small pan, add the carrot and cook gently until slightly jiggly. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with the grand marnier.

title: Sausages and Gruyere in Chocolate
ingredients: 4 italian sausages | 1/4 cup cocoa powder or 1/4 cup dutch-processed cocoa | 5 ounces gruyere cheese, grated ( about 1/4 cup )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut a 3 inch slit lengthwise down the center of each sausage and remove the casings. Arrange the sausages in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle 1/4 tablespoon cocoa over each sausage and then 1/4 cup gruyere. Bake, uncovered, until the cheese is melted and beginning to brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Chickpea and Ravioli Soup
ingredients: 4 cups cooked chickpeas | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds | 1 savoy cabbage or 1 large savoy cabbage | 1/4 cup teabags or 1/4 cup spiratelli pasta | 1 1/2 cups fresh basil leaves or 1 1/2 cups parsley leaves | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces other small-flake pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and cool and cut cabbage into thin julienne slices.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,white wine vinegar,beef chuck,liquid smoke,lettuce leaf,apple
title: German Cauliflower and Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, torn into bite sized pieces | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 head lettuce leaves, torn into pieces | 3 medium apples, cut into slices | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1/4 cup liquid smoke
instructions: In a large skillet, saute meat over medium high heat until browned. Add cauliflower and cover. Cook 2 - 3 minutes or until cauliflower is tender crisp. Add lettuce and apples and continue to cook, covered, until lettuce is tender crisp. In a small bowl, whisk together vinegar and liquid smoke. Spoon about 1/4 cup sauce over salad and toss. Remove one cup of the cabbage/apple mixture and stir into the salad.

title: Cabbage Curry Blend
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage ( about 8-10 cups ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 3/4 cup port wine, approximately ( or red wine vinegar )
instructions: If using cabbages with a thick outer skin place them on a cutting board and slice about 1/8 thick. Slice the cabbage lengthwise into halves or thirds.

Random Ingredients: nut,spring onion,self raising flour,cream celery soup,chicken breast fillet,cumin seed,cardamom seed
title: Chicken and Spring Onion Curry Masala
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole nut, peeled | 600 g skinless chicken breast fillets, cubed | 1 cup self-raising flour | 3 tablespoons whole mixed sprouts, chopped spring onions | 1 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 cup cream of celery soup
instructions: Place nuts and chicken in a food processor and process to chop finely. Place the seson in a medium bowl with flour, vegetables and spices. Make a well in the center with the soup. Add the chicken, mix well and cover. Refridgerate for one hour or until chicken is marinating time. Preheat oven to 180°c. Line a 20cm by 22cm baking dish with foil and spray with olive oil cooking spray. Place the chicken, on the baking tray, place in oven and cook for 45 minutes. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: halloumi cheese,caesar salad dressing,french onion soup
title: Halloumi in Foil
ingredients: 8 slices halloumi cheese | 1 bottle caesar salad dressing | 1 can french onion soup ( or other )
instructions: Lay cheese on frying/frying pan and spread out flat. Place over medium high heat until cheese starts to melt, flip cheese over and cook until browned. Invert onto serving platter. Spread caesar dressing over cheese allowing it to spill out of the cheese. Serve french onion soup over it.

title: OAMC Spanish Noodles With Pistachios, Onions, and Niles
ingredients: 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup pistachios, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 5 qt casserole with nonstick cooking spray. Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Add noodles and stir. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Cottage Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 1 tablespoon capers, chopped | 1 plum, ripe plum, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup cottage cheese, drained and rinsed
instructions: Stir the capers and plum into the cottage cheese. Sprinkle the capers and plum mixture over the top, mixing well. Serve immediately.

title: Duck Rillettes With Spring Onions & Hot Dill
ingredients: 2 ducks, each weighing a little less than 2 oz ( cleaned weight. ) | 4 fluid ounces hot dill pickle, in bottle | 2 spring onions, unpeeled
instructions: The duck, remove all but 2 of the fat from the duck. Cover with 1 pint of water and boil slowly for about 15 minutes per pound of duck fat. Strain the duck broth through sieve to remove impurities. Place a duck on a double layer of dampened muslin and tie with string and tie each with cotton string. Place the duck in a clean pan over hot coals and cover. Cook slowly for 1½ - 2 hours or until the duck is well browned. Remove the duck from the pan and cover with foil to keep warm. Place the hot mustard dills in a small sauté pan and set aside. Reduce the heat slightly and cook over low heat for 3 - 4 minutes until it becomes a rich red color. Remove dill pickles from pan, arrange them on plates, remove the duck pieces, and arrange warm on the hot mustard pickles. Spoon off any fat that has gathered at the bottom of the pan and arrange the duck pieces attractively on the mustard pickles.

title: Pagashka - Arancini Chicken and Rice Stuffed Pizza
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken legs-thighs | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice, rinsed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sour cream ( depending on your taste ) | 4 -6 pre-baked pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large pot over medium heat, add chicken legs, sour cream and chicken breasts and bring to a boil. Once chicken has cooked through, reduce heat to very low for about 30 minutes to an hour, turning chicken over half way through. While chicken is simmering, prepare the rice according to package directions or if you want a thinner sauce, mix in sour cream until smooth and creamy. While chicken is simmering, place pizza crust onto a pizza pan or cookie sheet, top with a couple more prebaked pieces of crust and bake in oven until pizza crust is nicely browned. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,pam cooking spray,sage,ginger powder,chipotle pepper
title: Chipotle Chilies
ingredients: 8 large chipotle peppers | 1 teaspoon ground ginger powder | 1 teaspoon ground sage | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | pam cooking spray
instructions: Set oven to broil. Cut chiles in half from top to bottom. Remove seeds and core. Place chiles in a single layer on a baking sheet with 2 inch sides. Broil, skin side up, on one side of the oven 7 minutes. Turn chiles and broil, skin side down, for 15 more minutes. Turn chiles again after 15 minutes and broil for 15 more minutes. They will be very dark. Remove chiles from oven. Cover with pam and let cool. When cool, cut into 1 inch square pieces.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,parsley flake,broad bean,pork loin,carnation milk,beer,wheat flour tortilla,lime juice zest
title: Pork and Broad Bean Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 12 ounces lean boneless pork loin, cut into 1/4 inch wide strips | 1 can light carnation evaporated milk | 1/3 cup lime juice, fresh, divided | 12 ounces beer, such as guinness, chilled | 12 -16 fresh mint sprigs, washed and dried loosely | 1/3 cup fresh parsley flakes, chopped to taste | 6 -8 soft carnation evaporated milk | 12 slices limes, zest of
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place tortillas on a parchment lined baking sheet. Combine flour, pork, 1/4 cup lime juice and 1/4 cup beer in a medium bowl. Stir to combine. Divide meat between tortillas, about 1/3 cup per tortilla. Roll and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish, seam side down. Set aside remaining 1/4 cup of reserved beer. Bake enchiladas, uncovered, until meat is no longer pink and tortillas are beginning to crisp, 12 to 15 minutes, flipping halfway through baking. Spoon reserved beer over enchiladas, sprinkle with mint and parsley, and serve. Guacamole, in a small bowl, mix together the rest of the lime juice, 1/3 cup sugar and 2 tbsp. Hot water. Spoon over tortillas, sprinkle with zest of the lime, and serve.

title: Beef Rollat (Miniature Beef Steaks #1)
ingredients: 8 ounces beef round steak | 24 ounces alfredo sauce | 8 ounces feta cheese | 8 ounces kirsch liqueur | 1 orange | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange rind
instructions: To the meat.

Random Ingredients: sake,radish,beef tenderloin,oregano leaf,red wine,chicken meat,bay scallop,mandarin orange
title: Cebolian Inn Chicken and Orange Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, rolled | 3 lbs chicken meat | 4 ounces mandarin oranges, undrained | 1/3 cup sake | 2 tablespoons red wine | 5 ounces radishes, peeled | 1 leaf oregano leaves | 3/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Dip beef in red wine for about five minutes or until browned. Drain, remove as necessary. Wipe all but about 3 t. Of the fat from the pan. Insert sliced oranges in the roll, along with the meat. Sprinkle the scallops with oregano and salt. Wrap the roll tightly and fasten with a string or toothpicks. Grill over hot coals 15 - 20 minutes or until meat reaches an internal temperature of 140 degrees f.

title: Chocolate Pepper Steaks
ingredients: 3 tablespoons self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt | 1/16 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate or 4 ounces milk chocolate
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the flour, cocoa, onion salt and pepper. Melt the bittersweet chocolate with the milk in a saucepan over medium heat. Turn off the heat but stir in the chocolate until melted. Pour chocolate into a shallow dish. Dip chicken in the melted chocolate and then press in the flour mixture so that they are well coated on both sides. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate the chicken for at least 6 hours and preferably up to 24 hours before baking. Preheat oven to 400°f bake the chicken on the middle rack of the oven for about 15 minutes, or place on the lower rack for 2 to 3 minutes, basting lightly with the melted chocolate with a fork before removing the chicken. Let stand for a few minutes before serving.

title: Chipotle Chipotle Tzatziki -  Super Simple!
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1 small diced canned peach | 1/2 small red diced canned chipotle chile ( to taste ) | 1 pinch dark brown sugar | sour cream or other dipping bread ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large bowl. Serve with sour cream or other dip items.

title: Giant Biscuit Zucchini Baked With Pancetta
ingredients: 2 zucchini | 200 g ground extra lean beef | 200 g pancetta, finely chopped | 200 g mascarpone cheese | 8 biscuits
instructions: Peel the zucchini if they are large and cut lengthways downwards. Using a spoon scoop out any pith or grated inner flesh. Set aside. Bring 6 liters of water to the boil. Cook the zucchini in a pan of salt for 10 minutes then plunge int the icy water. Turn off the heat. When they are just beginning to soften, drain them in a colander and allow to chill under running cold water. When they are cool enough to handle, scoop out the flesh by leaving the skin in the water and holding it over a bowl. Heat a griddle or frying pan. Place all the ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. The mixture will be thick and sticky and a lot like a thick mayonnaise. Spoon a spoonful of the mixture onto one side of each zucchini. Roll up, tucking in the seam and ends to create a neat compact parcel. Place in a shallow ovenproof dish and bake at 190°c until lightly browned and cooked through. Serve hot with chunky fresh tomato sauce, a green salad and a nice glass of white toasted italian white wine.

Random Ingredients: milk,tomato green chile pepper,sausage,orange peel,black peppercorn
title: Hot or Cold Chorizo Dip
ingredients: 4 pounds smoked sausage | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/2 cup milk | 1 orange peel, minced | 2 teaspoons whole black peppercorns, cracked
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the sausage in a 9x13 inch baking dish, then sprinkle with the remaining ingredients. Bake in a preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from oven and serve hot or cold.

title: Hot Steak Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs trimmed skirt steaks, about 1-inch thick | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | hot sauce, hot and hot
instructions: Combine all ingredients and brush well over steaks. Refrigerate 1 to 3 hours. Preheat bbq to 400°f, place a rack in center of grill. Close lid and grill steaks 10 minutes, turning twice. To serve, put on a heated platter and spoon sauce directly on top.

Random Ingredients: black bean,lemon zest,chicken breast fillet,baking potato,red wine
title: Spanish Tapas Chicken and Potato Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled, cut lengthways into wedges | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, freshly grated | 600 g skinless chicken breast fillets | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 170c. Grease a shallow 1 1/2 cup capacity microwave safe baking dish. Place potatoes, zest and 1/4 cup of the chicken in the dish, and top with remaining chicken. Combine red wine with beans.

title: Irish Broth
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach | 6 ounces pearl barley ( quick cooking pearl barley, barley or red wine do not add these to the recipe unless you don't want your broth to be )
instructions: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain immediately and place in a large saucepan with a lid. Bring the water to a boil then throw in the spinach and barley, bring back to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes until the barley is just tender. Serve at once.

title: Melon Balls (Aloupe, Melon and Cheese)
ingredients: 2 lbs cantaloupe, cleaned ( see description ) | 1 cup grated pecans | 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup grated lemon peel
instructions: Cut melons into 3/4 dice, then place in a bowl. Mash melon with a fork or molcajete until coarsely chopped, but not mushy. Add the remaining ingredients, including the lemon peel, and combine well. Form into small balls and place in a buttered 9x12 baking dish. Cook for 30 minutes at 325 degrees until the melons are tender and the topping of the melons is slightly darker.

title: Tomato-And-Peanut Hoagies
ingredients: 3 italian tomatoes ( approx 1 3/4 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1/4 - 1/2 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 can tomato ketchup | 1/4 - 1/2-1/2 cup finely chopped unsalted unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 3 hoagie rolls ( approx 2 lbs )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Halve tomatoes lengthwise, remove seeds. Slice tomatoes into quarters. Combine tomato, oil and spices in bowl of food processor or blender and process until smooth or paste forms. Scoop out about 1 tablespoon tomato mixture for each hoagie.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,coconut milk,greek yogurt,phyllo pastry
title: Sweet Potato Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled and cut into 8 chunks | 1 quart coconut milk ( about 6 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt | 8 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Steam potato in a 5 quart pot over medium coals until tender, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain, mash, then set aside to cool. Place coconut milk in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, 20 to 30 minutes, until slightly thickened. Set aside to cool. Pour yogurt into a bowl and refrigerate until set, about 15 minutes. While yogurt is cooling, place 1 phyllo sheet on a flat surface. Using a serrated knife, cut 4 long strips diagonally across the length of phyllo. Dab dough with your fingers and top with a heaping teaspoon of yogurt/coconut paste. Fold corners over the paste and roll up phyllo tightly. Tear off strips of parchment paper and roll each samosa into a sausage shape. Place ssamosas on a baking sheet and brush with more yogurt. Bake samosas until golden brown and crisp, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Guacamole Salad
ingredients: 1 medium jicama | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Peel and cut into 1 inch pieces. Cook over medium high heat, not too hot, but just over medium heat. Let simmer for 3 - 5 minutes on each side until tender. Put in a bowl and sprinkle the mustard and guacamole on top. Toss, or just if it's convenient, put in a serving dish and add slices of fresh mango or peaches.

title: Ugali
ingredients: 1 kg mince | 100 g salt pork or 100 g chorizo | 20 nopales, de-seeded | 20 ml nopales, de-seeded
instructions: Remove the hard rind. Rice and mince well. Take 2 - 3 tablespoons of minced meat from the chorizo and cut into 1/2cm cubes. Add to the meat. Put the rest of the minced meat from the chorizo and the nopales in large pot or small flat vessel with a lid. Add a few drops of oil to cover. Stir occasionally on slow fire to ensure no flare up. After 20 minutes, turn flame off. Allow the mixture to stand about 15 minutes before removing from the pot. Stir the mixture every few minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Butternut Squash and Beer Cheddar Baked Beans
ingredients: 6 ounces beer | 24 ounces butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 2 cups cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 6 aluminum foil | 6 ounces bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f place casserole dish in oven. In medium bowl mix beer, butternut squash, sauerkraut, onion and cheese. Spoon over casserole and sprinkle with bean sprouts and bake 45 minutes, or until bubbly. Cut aluminum foil into squares and remove foil.

title: Barbequed  Steak(ATK)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin | 2 celery ribs
instructions: Cut two 1/2 inch slices of thick aluminum foil about 1/2 inch square. Place sirloin slices on foil and wrap each slice tightly to form a 4 square parcel. Place in a deep 12 inch heavy frying pan. Arrange celery ribs around steak. Add water to cover meat. Wrap tightly in foil. Cook in a 350°f oven for 1 - 2 hours. Remove meat from foil, slice, and serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,chickpea,red chili powder,greek yogurt
title: Chana Ki Channa
ingredients: 400 g chickpeas, washed, soaked in water for 30 minutes and drained | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, grated | 1 2/3 cups greek yogurt, whisked | 1 1/2 teaspoons red chili powder
instructions: Soak the chickpeas overnight. Drain and wash and make them into 2 3cm or 1 1/2 cm patties. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Prick the patties all over with a fork. Place the patties in the hot oil. Fry until both sides are light golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste. Stir fry for 1 minute. Add yogurt and stir. Serve hot garnished with chilli powder.

title: Spinach With Lentils
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons sunflower oil or 2 -3 tablespoons salad oil | 250 g brown lentils, rinsed and drained | 250 g baby spinach
instructions: Heat half the oil in a large pan until shimmering. Add lentils and cook over high heat to coat. Lower heat and cook for 15 mins, stirring occasionally. Cover and cook for approx 20 minutes, then stir through spinach. Serve immediately from a warm bowl.

title: Bourbon Monkey
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bourbon | 1 teaspoon anise extract | 3/4 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Whisk bourbon, anise extract, and italian seasoning together in a small glass or ceramic bowl. Pour over sliced bread and let sit for 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,filet beef,cannellini bean,white sesame seed
title: Dishful Beef and Cannellini Refrigerator Feast
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs filet of beef | 7 ounces cannellini beans ( or great northern beans or great northern beans ) | 3 teaspoons white sesame seeds | 1/4 cup ice cube
instructions: In a bowl, combine the beef and remaining ingredients.

title: Simple Italian Meat Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice | 1 package frozen meat, thawed | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Drain and rinse meat and add to saucepan with tomatoes. Heat for about 5 minutes or the first time you cook it will take longer for thawed frozen meat.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,cherry tomato,self rising flour,white wine,spinach,plum tomato,saffron
title: Italian Batter for the Vegetarian
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, sliced or chopped | 1/2 cup tomato, sliced/chopped | 1/4 teaspoon saffron ( or 1/4 tsp. turmeric and 1/4 tsp. paprika ) | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour ( or 3-day old flour ) | 1/4 cup dry white wine ( or water ) | 2 1/2 cups spinach, steamed and roughly chopped
instructions: To make the batter, combine all the ingredients in a bowl except for the greens, and mix well. Add the greens and mix well. Place the batter in a greased or oiled 10 inch flat bottomed pan or on a large, covered dish and bake in a 350f oven 12 to 15 minutes or until the tops are golden and crusty.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,tea,creamy peanut butter,marinara sauce
title: Peanut Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup dry instant tea
instructions: Place all ingredients, except peanut sauce/tea/pepper sauce, in saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and stir frequently. Simmer for 30 minutes. Stir occasionally to prevent burning and drizzle sauce over any pasta that floats inches.

title: Saffron-Peanut Butter-Saffron Potatoes With Saffron
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, scrubbed ( about 7 large ) | 2/3 cup smooth peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large pot of water, add 1/3 cup of water, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover the pot, and cook until tender, about 1 hour, adding 1/4 cup of cold water as needed to prevent sticking. While the potatoes are cooking, stir together the peanut butter, saffron, and remaining 1/3 cup of water in a bowl. When the potatoes are done, drain and place on a serving platter. Top with the peanut butter and saffron mixture, then serve.

title: Easy Peasy Pea and Mango Shepherd (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 14)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter ( smooth or chunky ) | 100 g frozen peas or 100 g fresh peas, thawed | 1 ripe mango chutney | 1 medium handful black olives, halved
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and process until a slushy blob forms. Scatter with the olives..

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,heavy cream,penne pasta,wooden skewer,broth,crouton,egg yolk
title: Broth and Lime Pasta
ingredients: 2 quarts chicken stock or 2 quarts canned broth | 12 wooden skewers | 12 large egg yolks | 24 small tubetti rigati with broccoli | 1 pint heavy cream | 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 12 ounces penne pasta, cooked
instructions: Prepare chicken stock or broth with chicken skewers in a large stockpot.. Bring to a boil and cook the sauteed chicken until no longer pink. Drain, cool and chop. Reserve. Boil pasta until just tender. Drain, set aside. Place egg yolks in a large bowl, beat well. Set aside. In 2 qt. Paneer pot, place stock and simmer slowly for 3 minutes. Add pasta and cream, beat well. Cook until the sauce is thick. Cook the noodles for 5 minutes, according to package directions. Drain, mix with sauce and garnish with diced avocado and lime.

title: Cherie's Corn Bake
ingredients: 3 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 cup stock or 1 cup broth, divided | 1 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a blender or food processor, add corn, molasses, paprika, 1 cup of the stock or broth, and cheese. Blend until well blended, then pour into a lightly greased 8x8 inch pan. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until bubbly and top is nicely browned.

title: Beef and Walnut Stew
ingredients: 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 2 lbs round steaks, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon savory or 1/2 teaspoon sage | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, finely grated | 3 tablespoons chopped walnuts in oil, toasted | 14 ounces kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat the walnut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the meat & spices and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the beans, reduce the heat & cook uncovered for about 10 mins, until heated through. Serve with creamy mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: kittencal taco seasoning mix,vanilla pudding,savoy cabbage,nonfat milk,arborio rice,wine vinegar,dark sesame oil,dijon mustard
title: Crispy Rice and Napa Squares (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 6)
ingredients: 1 medium head savoy cabbage | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 package kittencal's instant vanilla pudding | 1/2 cup white cajun spices or 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon other dijon-style mustard ( optional ) | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1/4 cup no-fat vanilla pudding | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon other dijon-style mustard ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350ºf. Cut the core of the cabbage. Place in a colander and rinse under cold water until almost clear and dry. Place in a large bowl. In a large pot, place the rice, then add 1 1/2 cups water and vinegar over medium heat, stirring constantly to combine. Bring to boil, reduce the heat to low and cover. Remove from the heat, let stand until rice is tender and absorbed. When cool, drain the rice and place in the bowl of a food processor. With the motor running, add the 2 tbsp of puree to the rice and pulse until the rice breaks up into rice strands. Add 1/2 cup of the raspberry or cranberry syrup, stir to mix and set aside. Place a 12 inch nonstick sprayable nonstick skillet over medium high heat. When the pan is very hot, stir in the mustards and 1 tbsp of the raspberry or cranberry syrup. Allow to crackle, about 1 to 2 seconds. Add the rice mixture and stir to combine. Spoon the rice into the prepared dish. Spread the mixture around the rice and top with remaining puree and flake the vanilla pudding over the top of the rice and cover the dish with a sheet of waxed paper. Spray the waxed paper on top of the dish with the nonstick spray. Bake the rice for 40 minutes. Remove the cake from the oven and let it stand until cool.

title: Microwave Spiced Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups button mushrooms, sliced | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, combine mushrooms, water chestnuts and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Stir mixture and microwave on high for 60 seconds or until hot.

title: Clam Stewed Portuguese Style
ingredients: 1 3/4 - 2 lbs portuguese-style onion, chopped | 3 cans chopped clams with juice, undrained | 2 cans orange juice concentrate, undiluted | 2 cups bouillon, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

title: Bunuelos (Meat Balls)
ingredients: 20 ounces chicken parts, cooked and diced | 3/4 teaspoon white raisins | 1 pound fresh or frozen shredded coconut | 1/2 pound processed cheese food ( such as fritos ), finely crumbled
instructions: Stir together the chicken, raisins, coconut, and processed cheese in a large pot over medium heat until heated through and the coconut is melted. Fill molds with the meat mixture and serve over rice or cooked white rice.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,sugar,dill weed,herbes de provence
title: Herbes De Provence Dumplings or 'Legs of Herbs'
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Mix together the dry ingredients. Dough should be sticky enough to knead lightly. Let rest for 1 to 2 hours for the gluten to absorb the gluten while resting, this is for quick rising and the dough will be quite dry. Using a rolling pin, press/mix down onto a floured surface. Roll out as thin as you can. Cut with scissors into fingers and shape like small pretzels. Place on a tray and allow to rise again until doubled. This dough is so very tasty you may want to make your own rising method. Use a fork to dip or mould the dumplings into the batter. Boil a little water and cook till floating on top. Allow to cool and then transfer to a cookie sheet and refrigerate till serving time or else, they may still stick together and this recipe will yield a lot of leftover dough. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,vanilla essence,olive,yellow squash,egg noodle,peanut oil vegetable
title: Nashi Nabe (Chunk Noodles With Squash and Tomatoes)
ingredients: 1 package yellow squash, sliced thinly | 6 ripe olives, sliced | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 2 tablespoons vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or vegetable oil | 4 ounces egg noodles
instructions: In a large frying pan over medium high heat, place the olive oil and cook the squash slices until the squash is just starting to turn golden. Add the tomatoes and green chiles. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes. In a large serving dish, mix the noodles with the contents of the bell pepper mixture. Divide the mixture between plates and sprinkle with peanuts. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,vanilla bean,mexican cheese,cream chicken soup,white pepper powder,swiss cheese,self raising flour
title: Spicy Baked Bean Casserole
ingredients: 5 spring onions | 100 ml cream of chicken soup | 250 g shredded swiss cheese ( swiss is best, but any ) | 250 g self raising flour | 1 pinch white pepper powder | 2/3 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded ( or other cheese of your choice ) | 100 ml evaporated milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 180f degrees celcius. Grease a 20 x 30cm casserole dish. Wash and slice spring onions and place in bottom of pan. Add soup and mix. Add swiss, mix until combined. Sprinkle over half of the white pepper powder. Layer on the rest of the white pepper powder. Mix the cheese and half of the milk. Layer on top of the white pepper powder and cheese mixture and add the remaining milk on top. Bake in oven for 30mins. Serve warm with warm buttered bread and jam. Variation, instead of swiss, use swiss cheese. In a small pot melt the cheese over a little water over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato chilies,cherry,dark sesame oil,chili garlic sauce,broccoli floret
title: Korean Bar-B-Q Sauce
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 2 cans roasted broccolini, drained | 1 can chinese-style diced tomatoes with chilies | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Empty roasting can and empty contents of roasting can into a large bowl. Add rotel, broccoli, diced tomatoes, sesame oil, and chili garlic sauce. Stir to combine. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: garlic,pecorino romano cheese,chili pepper flake,seafood seasoning
title: Fresh "Fried" Shrimp by Provencal
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh assorted shrimp ( peeled and deveined with tails left on if desired ) | 3/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, coarsely grated | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Finely chop shrimp into bite size pieces. Place shrimp in a large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients except for pecorino and place in a jar. Shake vigorously until all shrimp are thoroughly coated and are coated. Pour shrimp mixture into nonstick skillet. Turn when shrimp turn pink and evenly brown on the outside.

title: Pork Tenderloin With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: salt and salariosa green | 1 pork tenderloin, rolled into a log
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the salariosa on a baking sheet and place in the oven for 10 minutes, or until the pork is browned and well cooked through, 10 to 12 minutes a side. Remove from the oven and serve. Remove from the pan when cool enough to touch. Cut into slices and serve the pork slices separately.

title: Amaretto-Radish & Amarello Salami Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon amaretto | 2 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 -2 radish, thinly sliced ( optional ) | 4 slices crisp smoked salami ( optional )
instructions: To make the salami, line the bottom of the sandwich pan with 2 slices salami. Spread the amaretto evenly over both salami slices. Top with one radish slice. Scatter thinly sliced hard boiled egg slices over the top of the salami. Add the remaining salami slices and top with the remaining 2 slices of salami. If desired drizzle the top with a little light so that the salami gets evenly glazed and slightly crisp. Cut into 2 - 2 rows by 6 squares. Serve on a crisp, greased bbq. Enjoy.

title: Kiwi Potato Fries
ingredients: 2 kiwi, peeled and sliced | 1 potato, peeled and diced | ice cubes
instructions: Put potatoes in a bowl. Add ice cubes and toss to blend. Drop potato sticks into potato water to soften. When soft, drain and put in a bowl of cold water to keep cold. Heat an iron skillet or wok over high heat. When hot, drop kiwi fries into the skillet and cook until golden brown on the underside. Carefully flip over and cook on the other side for 1 to 2 minutes, or until potato sticks are heated through.

title: Melt in Your Mouth Mexican Pepper Butter
ingredients: 1 cup margarine or 1 cup other light spreadable shortening | 1 large serrano pepper
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl combine butter with the serrano pepper. Spread butter on cutting board with a pastry brush. Use a rolling pin to flatten. Slice into about 6 slices and roll each slice into butter. Melt butter in microwave, stirring a few times so it doesn't brown. Serve while warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,bay leaf,confectioner ' sugar,heavy whipping cream
title: Chili Cream
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes with green chilies, diced | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon bay leaf
instructions: In bowl, mix together the tomatoes with chiles, cream, sugar and bay leaf. Chill for at least 2 hours. Serve with coffee, icecream or tostadoes. Makes a 1/2 cup.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,greek yogurt,sandwich bread,beef brisket,turmeric powder,gruyere cheese,chipotle powder
title: MEXICAN Corned Beef and Gruyere Sandwiches on a Diet
ingredients: 3 cups raw ground beef brisket ( about 3 lbs. weight ) | 3 tablespoons self-raising flour | 2 -4 teaspoons turmeric powder ( i like the whole pungent spices ) | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped canned chipotle powder ( i like the chipotle in their adobo sauce ) | 8 slices sandwich bread, cut diagonally, toasted
instructions: Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray or light coat with a low fat stick spray.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,grain rice,espresso,red cayenne pepper,chicken bouillon powder,napa cabbage,chicken bouillon
title: Asian Colcannon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs napa cabbage, coarsley shredded | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon powder | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon powder | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons instant espresso ( optional and i use 1 tbs extra virgin olive oil ) | 2/3 cup uncooked short-grain rice
instructions: In a 2 quart, heavy pot, combine cabbage, bouillon, coriander, cayenne and espresso. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer and simmer until cabbage is tender and liquid is evaporated, about 15 minutes. Let cool slightly. Transfer 1/3 of cabbage mixture to a blender. Cover and blend until cabbage is smooth. Return to pot. Repeat process, adding remaining cabbage to pot as needed. Stir well to blend. Pour 1/2 cup rice into a wide mouth shallow bowl. Dip 1/3 of the cabbage mixture in the rice, coating evenly. Repeat process with remaining rice and the remaining cabbage mixture. Gently stir the rice, cabbage mixture and espresso mixture into the rice and cook over low heat until heated through, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,almond meal,pine nut,baby spinach,red chili pepper,irish whiskey,cream chicken soup,marshmallow
title: Roasted Red Chile Cream Cheese Filled Crepes
ingredients: 8 ounces cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 8 ounces miniature marshmallows | 1/4 cup canola oil, plus additional for frying crepes | 2 cups baby spinach | 1 can crushed pineapple in oil, drained and finely chopped | 8 ounces slivered almonds, halved | 1 red chili pepper, very thinly sliced ( scotch bonnet or similar ) | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey, warmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, stir together the soup, marshmallows, oil, spinach, and pineapple. Season with pepper to taste. In a 12 inch nonstick skillet, pour 1 tablespoon of the warm soup mixture. Spread the crepe, in thirds, on a clean work surface. Arrange about 1/2 cups of the filled crepes along the creole with the 1/2 cup of almonds, then sprinkle with chile slices. Fold up edges of the crepe to make a crepe, keeping crepes in place so the uncooked portions don't touch. Fold in the bottom edge, and roll with a fork to form a cylinder shaped crepe. Transfer rolled crepes to a baking sheet. Repeat process with remaining crpes, placing about 3 or 4 crepes on each. Brush tops with the remaining soup mixture and bake until golden brown, about 25 to 35 minutes. Cut into 6 wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,basil leaf,bay leaf,salmon,romano cheese,semolina flour
title: Fish in Herbed Soya Sauce
ingredients: 3 lbs salmon, whole | 1 large bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/4 lb semolina flour | 1/4 lb grated romano cheese | 1/2 lb fresh salmon, in large chunks, about 1/2 pound total
instructions: Cut salmon in half lengthwise. Using a knife, remove and discard bone and skin. Cut flesh into 1 1/2 inch thick cubes. Place bay leaf, basil, and semolina flour in a large bowl, and mix well. Stir in salmon. Pour fish into a deep pot of boiling water, and boil for 5 - 7 minutes or until salmon is just cooked through. Strain the fish, reserving the cooking liquid. Place fish in a baking dish, then pour enough reserved cooking liquid into the baking dish to cover. Sprinkle the fish with grated cheese. Bake the fish, covered, in a hot oven for about 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: black olive,pita bread,chicken bouillon,red chili pepper,sun tomato
title: The Best Party Pita Bread
ingredients: 4 sun-dried tomatoes, sliced | 1/2 cup sliced pimiento stuffed olive ( about one small pkg ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 1 package pita bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. Mix tomatoes with olives. In a small bowl, combine the bouillon and dried chile. Place bread on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Sprinkle bread with 1/3 cup olive mixture, spreading evenly. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,harissa,italian parsley,kielbasa sausage,meatball,cayenne pepper,seasoning salt,green olive
title: Tunisian Noodle Meatballs
ingredients: 3 cups frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup pitted green olives | 1/2 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon minced italian parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Toss frozen meatballs with corn, olives, parley, harissa, seasoning salt, cayenne pepper and italian parsley. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Korean Chili Paste
ingredients: 6 habanero peppers | 6 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Heat the oven broiler for 5 minutes. Toast the habanero peppers under the broiler. Peel and smash the peppers. Heat the rice wine in a small heavy bottomed pot until it shimmers.

title: Sausage & Strawberry Parathas
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely grated parmesan cheese, good quality | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 cup finely shredded dried italian sausage | 2 cups whole strawberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Stir together parmesan, garam masala and sausage in a small bowl. Add strawberries and toss to coat. Spoon mixture onto cookie sheet and bake 30 minutes, turning once, until topping is golden.

title: Strawberries With Raisins and Capers
ingredients: 4 cups strawberries, divided ( about 2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 1 teaspoon shallot, minced | 1/4 teaspoon rosemary, minced | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Place 2 tablespoons of strawberries in a bowl.

title: Bun and Tacos
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger paste, minced | 2 corn tortillas, torn into small chunks | 1 can beef rib, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Mix together the ginger and garlic paste. Spread each piece of beef with about 1 tablespoon of the ginger garlic paste mixture. Wrap and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange the torn corn tortillas in a circle over the meat in a circle. Place the pan with the beef over the tortilla layer. Cover tightly with foil. Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining ginger garlic paste.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,marshmallow,white wine vinegar,english cucumber,plum sauce,chicken breast half,cranberry juice concentrate,purpose flour
title: A Summer Salad
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, pounded 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup italian style white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons cranberry juice concentrate, thawed | 3 tablespoons plum sauce | 3 tablespoons miniature marshmallows | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 english cucumber, cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Combine flour, vinegar and juice concentrate in shallow dish. Place chicken breasts in and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Drain chicken, reserving marinade. Grill chicken over medium high heat 8 minutes per side or until cooked through and juices run clear. Combine marshmallows and orange zest, and sprinkle over chicken. Add sliced cucumber. Serve immediately.

title: Chari Pulao (Indian Rice With Scallions)
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1 tablespoon curry leaf, finely chopped fresh ( optional ) | 2 scallions, sliced on the diagonal ( including the white tops )
instructions: Pour 1 cup water in medium saucepan, add rice and curry leaves. Bring to boil, then lower the heat and cover. Simmer, tightly covered, until rice is cooked but still slightly al dente, about 18 minutes. Fluff rice with fork. Let stand 5 minutes, then fluff to separate grains and serve.

title: Red Bean Burritos (Red Beans & Beet)
ingredients: 1/2 medium beet, washed, peeled & chopped into bite-sized chunks | 1/2 small turnip, peeled & chopped into bite-sized chunks | 3 small red beans, washed & chopped into bite sized pieces | 3 slices bacon, sliced | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon coconut | 2 tortillas, warmed ( we like the kind at the fat free deli counter ) | 1 cup manchego cheese, grated
instructions: Place all ingredients into a wok. Stir fry over medium heat until the onion and beet are tender. When done, stir fry each tortilla for a minute or two or until the tortillas begin to crisp up. Top with a sprinkling of manchego cheese over the top. Serve with your favorite side dishes and enjoy.

title: Chocolate Squash Avocado & Squash
ingredients: 1/2 avocado | 1/2 teaspoon chocolate | 250 g squash, cut in 2 cm cubes
instructions: Peel and slice avocado & squash. Place squash in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high for 4 minutes 1 minute. Add chocolate & mash until completely melted.

Random Ingredients: black vinegar,green olive,kernel corn,ouzo,romaine lettuce,beef stock,flour tortilla,red pepper sauce
title: Beef Scented Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 cups beef stock | 1 1/4 cups green olives, drained | 1 tablespoon red hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon black vinegar | 12 flour tortillas | 1 cup lettuce, shredded | 1 cup whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup ouzo
instructions: Pour beef stock into saucepan, add olives, red pepper sauce and vinegar. Heat to boiling. Cook until olives are tender. Remove from heat. Place one tortilla directly on heated griddle plate or skillet. Top with a second tortilla. Spread 1/4 cup lettuce on 1 side of tortilla. Place 2 tablespoons corn on top of corn. Drizzle with 1/4 cup beef mixture. Repeat with last tortilla. Cook until bottom of quesadillas are lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove on plate. Place remaing tortillas on plate. Top with remaining 1/4 cup lettuce, remaining beef mixture and sliced olives.

title: Pear-Pastry Hearts
ingredients: 1 quart canned cannellini beans | 1/2 pastry flour, for dusting | 1 quart cold, unbleached cannellini | 2 large pears, cored and quartered | 1 1/2 cups halved iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place the beans in a large pot and cover with enough water to cover them by about 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook for 25 to 35 minutes, or until tender. Drain well and set aside. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish. On a well floured surface, roll out 1 quart of cold butter to 1/4 inch thickness. Use flour to coat a pastry brush and line the bottom and sides of the dish. Roll out the remaining 1/2 cup cold butter to coat the dish and set aside. Place the pear quarters in the prepared pastry pan. Sprinkle each with 1/3 of the toasted breadcrumbs, then top with the lettuce, followed by the remaining breadcrumbs. Sprinkle the crumbs on top. Bake for 20 minutes, then invert the pan to remove the tart from the oven, slice and serve.

title: Homemade Woodruff
ingredients: 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: In a small saucepan, stir together the vinegar, worcestershire sauce and allspice with a wooden spoon or a whisk until the liquid has been absorbed. Cook over medium heat until the water has evaporated and the mixture is hot but not boiling. Set aside to cool to room temperature. When cool, cover and refrigerate for several days or overnight.

Random Ingredients: tangerine,seasoning salt,dark rum,breadstick,white wine vinegar,button mushroom,black plum
title: Tangerines Stuffed With Mushrooms
ingredients: 14 -24 firm black plums | 2 -4 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon dried tangerine rind, finely grated | 1 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt ( or more ) | 1/4 cup button mushroom, chopped | 1 slice breadstick | 3/4 teaspoon sweet dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Note, a good variation is to halve a fresh ripe plums or use canned baby bellas. Cut a thin slice from the bottom of the plums if using the fresh ones. Slice the top of the plums so they will lie on their curved part on the plums. Remove pit from the plums but do not cut through. Using the scooped out fruit flesh, scoop out the hollow center and discard. Using a spoon, remove the inside pits from the plums. Place hollow pit in a bowl with ice cold water to cover. Set aside or refrigerator until ready to use. Combine vinegar, tangerine and seasoning salt in a small saucepan. Place over medium heat and bring to a simmer. Warm up rum and gently stir. Using a spoon, remove zest from the tangerine shells and remove the shells and the seeds from the pith using a teaspoon. In a 12 x 8 x 2 inch metal baking dish, place a spoonful of the vinegar mixture. Place a platter in the dish and carefully remove the platter, scooping the fruit into the dish, using a spoon, into the shells. Spoon the rum over the platter. Carefully open up the platter and remove the platter. Replace the spoon and pour the rum over the platter. Top platter with the breadstick. To serve, place the platter on a cutting board and holding it slightly in your hands, carefully turn the platter over and let it sit in the breadstick for a few minutes before cutting it into quarters or wedges. This works best if you use a very sharp knife for slicing. Note, a good variation is to halve a fresh black plum. If using canned, soak in water to cover for about 20 minutes before using to plop out the bitterness and sand. They do not taste as good. Note, a good variation is to halve or halve an extra large plum. If using fresh, place in a small bowl and add the chopped tangerine fruit flesh. If using fresh, remove stems and seeds, and set aside. It does not hold well after 24 hours of soaking. Mushrooms may be sliced into thin rings or even into thin sticks using a vegetable peeler. It should be just right. Remove the pits, pith and soft white inner core. Slice the small plum into 1/8 inch rounds with a sharp knife. Arrange on a platter and serve alongside the sliced platter. Note, make sure all ingredients are in season or may not be in refrigerator before serving. Note, when slicing or cutting plums to serve, place a small plate on top of platter and carefully flip in the rum and plum slices to ensure the rum covers the plum slice in good contact with the platter. This should take about 3 - 5 minutes on each side to cook the plum, but you don't want plum slices to turn dark as they should. Plate in a wide shallow dish, then arrange the small plum slices on top of the platter. The platter should be completely packed with the rum and plum slices. Note, the rum can be purchased as an additional garnish in most grocery stores, especially near the seafood section of a specialty food restaurant. If using fresh plum slices, drain and rinse under cold water to remove brine.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,dark brown sugar,grape leaf,cannellini bean,slab bacon,cheese
title: Paleo Beans
ingredients: 1 lb plum cannellini beans, canned, drained | 4 ounces thick slab bacon, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 12 small grape leaves, washed | 1 package good quality cheese, grated
instructions: In a medium pan over medium heat, combine the beans and bacon. Cover, cook, stirring occasionally, until bacon has all but rendered 1 tbs of fat. Remove from heat.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork
ingredients: 1 lb pork roast | 1 -2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup ketchup ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon sambal oelek ( to taste )
instructions: Rub the pork roast with the sauce. Grill over high heat for 15 to 20 minutes turning often, until the pork is browned and tender. Spoon sauce over the pork.

title: Aji
ingredients: 2 cucumbers | 1/2 cup coconut flakes
instructions: Wash and peel cucumbers. Cut in half lengthwise and then in half again. Slice into thin slices. Place slices in a bowl and pour boiling water over. Refrigerate until cucumbers are soft and pliable. Drain cucumbers and stir in 1/2 cup coconut flakes.

title: Pasta Toss
ingredients: 500 -800 g linguine | 250 -300 ml pasticcated dry pasta ( or spaghetti ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves ( or dry ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 shallots, finely diced ( red onions for a milder dish )
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil.

title: Shrimp With Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup oil | 1 can tomato sauce, not water packed
instructions: Combine shrimp and 1/4 cup oil in a saucepan.

title: Scotch Steak With Sliced Scallops
ingredients: 1 sirloin, boneless about 1-1/4 pounds ( top sirloin or top rib roast for tenderizing ) | 2 scallops | 1 package of sliced chocolate shavings ( preferably bittersweet ) | fresh dill sprig
instructions: Thoroughly clean the scallops. With a meat mallet, pound them flat, about ¼ inch thick, 1 - ½ inches in diameter, so as not to tear them. With a sharp knife, cut a lengthwise slit about ½ inch deep at the center of each scallop and pull out the white membrane, making a cup or small opening. Cut the scallops lengthwise into ¾ inch wide slices, then crosswise into ¾ inch wide strips, trimming off the ends of the slices. Place 1 scallop per portion of the scallops and place them slightly apart in a bowl. Sprinkle 1 ounce of chocolate shavings evenly over the scallops and top each scallop with another scallop and 1 ounce of chocolate. Sprinkle the scallops with a dusting of salt. Serve right away, or refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Tahini Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 500 g sirloin steaks | 550 g tahini ( sesame paste ) | 500 g chicken thigh ( boneless chicken thighs ) | 1/2 cup sultana
instructions: Place the sirloin steaks onto a large plate, and soak in the tahini for 30 minutes. Place the chicken thighs onto a plate, and thread onto skewers. Place the sultanas onto another plate, and soak in the sesame paste for 30 minutes. Bbq or grill the skewers for 5 minutes, turning frequently. Serve with satay sauce, dipping sauce, salad leaves and toasted pitta bread.

title: Mexican Espresso Snack Mix (Spritz)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant espresso ( or instant espresso powder dissolved in 1/2 cup of hot water, about 125-115 degrees f. ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning
instructions: Place instant espresso in small bowl. Pour hot water over espresso and stir. Cover and refrigerate coffee flavored espresso mixture until cool, about 2 hours or up to overnight. Lightly coat a small baking sheet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper. Divide espresso mix evenly among 24 paper lined 24 shot glasses. Sprinkle taco seasoning on top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: serrano chili,american cheese,orange,chocolate biscuit,green pepper,cayenne,veal,chinese cabbage
title: Chocolate and Pepper Sandwich
ingredients: 1 green pepper | 1 red peppers or 1 orange | 1 lb ground veal or 1 lb ground chicken | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon powdered american cheese ( optional ) | 1 serrano chili, chopped | 16 ounces chocolate biscuits | 4 cups chinese cabbage, sliced
instructions: Cut vegetables into strips.

title: Thai-Spiced Mango Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mango powder ( i used medley mango, but you can use fresh mango or make your own ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 cup prepared hummus
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. If you like crunch, you can serve the salad at room temperature. Yum serve it in your favourite bowl. Or if you don't serve it at once, refrigerate for 1 hour or in the freezer for up to 3 hours.

title: Apple Yogurt With Red Delicious Apples
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 red delicious apple | 3 -4 tablespoons lowfat yogurt
instructions: Core and chop apples into small pieces and put in a glass bowl. Mix in yogurt. Cover and refrigerate overnight. If you use your food processor, start with 2 tablespoons and you can start using up to 3 tablespoons depending how you like your food.

title: Sparkled Tomatillos for Two
ingredients: 1/4 lb tomatillo | 1 ounce saltine crackers or 1 ounce other hard crackers | 1 package bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat grill to high and set a large metal cast iron skillet over medium. Carefully char tomatillos all over by dropping a few tomatillos into the skillet, moving them quickly with a spatula. When edges develop slightly, turn over and char other side. Remove to a heated platter and top with crackers. Sprinkle with sauteed bean sprouts.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,port wine,pineapple orange juice,phyllo pastry,pepper sauce,apple,vanilla custard powder
title: Apple Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 jar peach-orange juice | 2 packages vanilla custard powder | 1 can pineapple-orange juice | 1 cup port wine | 2 cups miniature marshmallow pecan halves | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 cup shredded sifted unbleached cane sugar or 1 cup regular granulated sugar | 1 lb fresh ground phyllo pastry sheet
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. In large bowl, combine first 3 ingredients. Stir in port and marshmallows. Remove 1 cup of mixture, and stir until well blended. With pastry brush, brush generously with melted butter. Unroll phyllo pastry, keeping remaining mixture covered with a towel. With 1 or 2 tablespoons filling, roll up bottom of 13x9 inch baking dish. Repeat with remaining phyllo pastry and filling. Pour 2/3 of orange mixture over phyllo. Arrange rolls, seam sides down but slightly overlapping, in the baking dish in the order directed by your package’s instruction manual.. Pour remaining orange or peach mixture over pastry rolls. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake 45 minutes, until phyllo is golden and crisp. While pastry & juices are baking, cut a slit in the top of each roll halfway through and release the soft interior.

title: Turkey and Romaine Soup
ingredients: 300 g lean ground turkey or 300 g ground chicken | 150 g romaine lettuce ( finely chopped ) or 150 g boston lettuce ( finely chopped ) | 1 liter vegetable stock or 1 liter chicken stock
instructions: Place the turkey or chicken in a pan with the romaine, and just enough stock to moisten completely and keep from sticking to the surface or to the bottom of the pan. Add the stock into a jug, then turn the heat to high and bring to the boil. Once boiling, lower the heat to a simmer, and cook, uncovered, for 45 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to stand 5 - 10 minutes. Serve straight away on a bed of romaine on each plate.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile pepper,flour,nut,fine sea salt,coriander,vegetable stock,cremini mushroom,cayenne pepper
title: Wild Mushrooms With Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 32 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1 1/4 teaspoons fine sea salt | 3 tablespoons flour | 4 tablespoons fine sea salt | 3 jalapeno chile peppers, sliced 3/4-inch pieces | 2 cups vegetable stock, warm | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander, sprinkled lightly | 1 teaspoon chopped nuts, toasted
instructions: Clean and thinly slice cremini mushrooms. Place in a glass dish and sprinkle with 2 1/4 tsp fine sea salt. Cover and sit a few minutes. In a large saucepan add the flour and 1 cup stock. Slowly whisk to blend and bring to a boil. Add sliced chilie peppers stir well. Keep whisking and cook over high heat for about 2 minutes. Sprinkle with sea salt, mix well and taste the chili mixture. Add the mushrooms and continue to cook 1 additional minute. Remove from heat. Add 2 cups warm water and stir to mix. Transfer the mushroom mixture to a serving plate and sprinkle with cayenne pepper and coriander. Sprinkle with toasted nuts.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,apple juice,beer,zucchini,rum,chili paste,pea carrot,plum tomato
title: Mexican Pizza - Fast and Easy.
ingredients: 1/4 cup beer | 2 teaspoons ground chili paste | 2 teaspoons apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon fast rising yeast | 1/2 cup plum tomato, diced | 2 tablespoons raisins or 2 tablespoons frozen peas and carrots | 2 cups zucchini, shredded | 1/2 cup zinfandel style light rum
instructions: Dissolve yeast in beer. Add all the other ingredients and mix until well combined. Allow 2 hours rising time. Pour into greased 12 pizza pan. Cover and allow to rise for 35 - 45 minutes until the surface is very, very light brown. Remove and pizza can be served on a stone, pizza stone, etc. To serve on a stone, sprinkle pizza with cinnamon and sugar.

title: Trinidad Smoked Swiss Chard
ingredients: 2 teaspoons honey | 2 saffron strands | 2 tablespoons tortilla, cut into triangles | 2 tablespoons smoked swiss chard, chard leaves
instructions: Place tortilla triangles in a shallow bowl. Sprinkle saffron strands over the bread, and pour honey over. Fold into triangles of chard, and then press triangles together. Smooth top lightly. Cover, and let sit on stovetop for 20 minutes to finish steaming, then turn out onto serving platter. Serve with salsa and sour cream from the bowl.

title: Walnut Oil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons walnuts, shelled | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 32 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Place walnuts and allspice in blender, add cherry tomatoes. Blend until smooth. Use as a spread for vegetables and or use as a dressing when vegetables are served.

title: Irish Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs | 1 fluid ounce dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Wash and peel the eggs, and cut them into quarters lengthwise. With a sharp knife, cut a slit along the sides of each egg, to within 1/2 inch of the bottom. Remove the yolks, and cut a slit in the bottom, cutting away the yolks. Turn over the eggs, and drop into a glass and plastic dish. Cover tightly with plastic wrap, and place in the preheated oven. Bake in preheated oven until the eggs are tender, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: liquid egg substitute,cilantro leaf,coconut milk,sugar,white wine,coconut oil,parsley
title: Creamy Cilantro Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup creamy coconut milk | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 cup bottled liquid egg substitute | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon dried cilantro leaves or 2 teaspoons fresh cilantro leaves | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 tablespoons water or 2 tablespoons canned unsweetened coconut milk
instructions: In a blender or food processor add coconut milk, wine and egg substitute. Process until mixture is smooth. Do not overprocess.

title: Puff Shells
ingredients: 1 package fennel | 2 eggs | 1 red rind | orange rind
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Dice fennel and then mix well. Break the egg into a bowl. Add red rind. Stirring continuously until it begins to change color, and it is well mixed. Add fennel mixture in small batches to egg batter in baking pan. Cover pan with foil, place in oven until mixture is completely puffed up and golden brown. Remove from oven.

title: Apple Blossom Mint Sauce
ingredients: 2 egg whites | 1 1/4 cups apple juice | 1 teaspoon apple sugar | 1 teaspoon chives ( minced, scallions )
instructions: In a small bowl. Beat egg whites on high for 2 minutes or until stiff peaks form. Fold in all remaining ingredients and blend well. Let sit in refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,chicken stock,peanut butter,egg substitute,dark chocolate,espresso powder
title: Espresso Chocolate Orzo Salad
ingredients: 1/4 ounce dark chocolate ( use good quality chocolate for this ) | 1/4 cup chicken stock ( i prefer mushroom stock ) | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/8 cup orzo pasta ( or any other pasta you like, this may or not use wheat ) | 1 egg substitute or 1 egg | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder ( see note )
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt chocolate and stock over low heat. Whisk while heating until chocolate is melted. Stir in peanut butter and orzo and set aside in fridge until desired consistancy is reached. Whisk egg and espresso powder into orzo mixture. Refrigerate 1/2 hour or until set. Note, this may be served cold or warm, just not chilled.

Random Ingredients: herb,turmeric powder,ice water,shrimp,chicken breast half,basmati rice,wine
title: Chilled Rice Balls-India
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped mixed mixed herbs | 2 tablespoons wine | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 2 cups hot cooked basmati rice or 2 cups jasmine rice | 3 1/2 cups ice water
instructions: Place salad ingredients in a heavy small to medium saucepan and add water, 1 teaspoon turmeric powder and mix well. Bring to a boil over medium heat and then reduce heat and simmer gently for 10 minutes.. Meanwhile, cut chicken into thin slice and stir fry in 1 teaspoon turmeric and the remaining teaspoon turmeric until cooked, about 2 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chicken and any liquid to a bowl. Add chicken mixture to soup and simmer, stirring occasionally until heated through, about 3 minutes. Remove soup from heat and then stir through rice and the 2 - ½ tablespoons olive oil. Divide rice mixture into bowls and top with soup mixture.

title: Easy Radishes and Garlic
ingredients: 1 head of your favorite radish | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 -3 dashes of your favorite spices ( optional )
instructions: Wash and peel the radishes. Cut them lengthwise, then crosswise. Combine all ingredients over medium heat and stir constantly for five minutes to allow the garlic to lightly brown. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,olive oil cooking spray,italian bread,cornflour,peanut oil,chicken broth,bread crumb
title: Nif's Favourite 'Chicken' Fingers
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken pieces | 2 cups greek yogurt ( or 1/2 cup lowfat plain yogurt and 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour ( corn starch ) | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1/2 cup plain dry bread crumbs | olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/4 cup bread crumbs for topping ( optional )
instructions: Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry with paper towels. Place in a large plastic bag with yogurt, corn flour and chicken pieces. Marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Take chicken out of bag and place in a slow cooker. Spray the bottom of the crockpot with oil. Place the remaining marinade ingredients in a bowl and stir until well combined. Pour over chicken to cover. Cook on high for 4 1/2 to 5 hours, or low for 4 1/2 to 5 hours. Remove chicken from marinade and shake off excess marinade. Turn on broiler. Spray cookie sheet with oil. Place chicken on cookie sheet and place under preheated broiler. Turn only once, broil until cooked through and lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove chicken from pan. If desired, remove pan from oven and drizzle with a little extra marinade. Sprinkle crumbs on the chicken before serving.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,pine nut,saltine cracker,raspberry jam,ancho chile powder,lavender,apple juice
title: Mexican Raspberry Ripple Dip
ingredients: 3/4 cup pineapple juice, strained from canned pineapple ( about 4-5 limes ) | 3 tablespoons chile powder, to taste | 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped, reserve 2 tablespoons of the juice | 3/4 teaspoon saltine crackers, crushed | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh lavender | 1 tablespoon unsalted sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil such as sun-dried tomato, drained and slivered | 1 tablespoon pine nuts or 1 tablespoon chopped almonds, toasted
instructions: To prepare dip, combine all the ingredients except the pine nuts and the toasted pine nuts and nuts in a small bowl and stir well. Sprinkle the pine nuts all over the surface of the dip. Serve at room temperature. Store the remaining pineapple juice in the refrigerator, covered, until ready to use. Note, to toast pine nuts, toast them by placing them in a pan and heating them over a medium flame, shaking the pan constantly, until golden brown. Watch for splatters in the pan at the end of cooking. Transfer to a small bowl, cover and let cool. As with all candied pineapple, you may prepare the pineapple juice and the syrup separately. For the raspberry raspberry preserves, combine all the ingredients in a small bowl and mix well. Spoon 1/4 of the raspberry cheese mixture into a chilled bowl that has been lined with waxed paper. Spoon the remaining cheese evenly over the cheese and place the bowl of raspberry preserves on the waxed paper, smooth side down. Cover and chill at least 2 hours or overnight until ready to serve. Can also be served cold. It's nice served with crackers or pita bread.

title: Pesto Swiss Snack Balls
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed miniature party party style swiss cheese | pesto sauce for dipping
instructions: Microwave frozen party style swiss swiss cheese cubes for 30 seconds. Press into miniature party sized party size serving plate. Add prepared pesto to miniature coated party size serving spoon. Dip party style swiss cheese cubes into pesto. Use a toothpick or toothpick to dip.

title: Vegetable Salad on a Toast
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded green cabbage | 1 cup finely chopped chives | 1 can sliced mushrooms, drained | 1 can sliced canned peaches, drained ( optional ) | 2/3 cup canned sliced bamboo shoots, drained ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1 teaspoon ground chives
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chives in a large bowl.

title: Monkey Ham Fondue
ingredients: 5 lbs french bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 cup coarsely chopped seeded serrano ham | 2 large shallots, peeled
