instructions: In a large bowl, mix together bread cubes, ham, shallots and enough water to make a sticky paste.

Random Ingredients: nicoise olive,red cabbage,russet potato,pickle,tequila,water chestnut,iceberg lettuce,chili sauce
title: Tortilla Chip Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, washed dried and torn into bite-sized pieces | 1 head red cabbage, washed, dried and torn into bite-sized pieces | 1 -2 pickle, diced and minced | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and diced | 2 russet potatoes, boiled and peeled, chopped and drained | 1 can nicoise olives, drained and sliced | 3/4 cup tequila | 3/4 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Toss all ingredients well together in large bowl. Add more tequila if to your tastes. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,white potato,gingerroot,beef stock,maple syrup,broccoli floret,lasagna noodle,mizithra cheese
title: Beef and Maple Potato Lasagna
ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles ( or 4 small or medium size individual package of lasagna sheets, approx. 12x10 in total ) | 500 g brocolli mushrooms ( chopped, remove stems and place on towel to drain on paper towel ) | 1 inch gingerroot, chopped | 2 big white potatoes, boiled until tender ( about 450g ) | 1 large white kidney bean ( cooked ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1/2 cup maple syrup | salt ( to taste ) | 1 cup mizithra cheese ( optional ) or 1 cup other cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Cut the potatoes in chunks about 1 1/3 inch thick.. Preheat oven to 375f°f. Mix together in bowl chopped ginger, garlic, mushrooms, broccoli florets, beans and beef stock and let set for 20 minutes to let the flavours develop. Drain potatoes and mash with a fork. Spread a little of the meat mixture in the bottom of a glass baking dish. Lay 1/2 of the noodles on top of meat, sprinkle with 1/2 of the cheese, then put 1/2 the mix on top of the noodles. Continue layering the top noodles and meat, ending with the cheese on top and bake. Serve immediately. Note, if you're making the lasagna with whole baby russets or large white potatoes, use baby carrots instead and then cook them however you can safely handle the noodles and potatoes in the oven as long as they're cool.

title: Veal Zurich
ingredients: 1 package ground veal | 1 jar whole blackberry jam, undiluted | 1 cup soya sauce | 1 can whole tomatoes, juice and seeds removed | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder
instructions: Heat a large pot of water to a boil. In a large bowl, stir the ground veal and jam until well mixed and no chunks of meat remain. Set aside to cool. Transfer to a large bowl. Stir in the soya sauce, tomatoes and espresso powder, and mix well to combine. Remove the pork from the mixture and reserve the mixture. Shape the meat into 2 to 3 patties. Place patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in a preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle lightly with sugar if desired.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,baking soda,vegetable oil cooking spray,milk,carrot,lettuce,red chilies,pea carrot
title: Chocolate Garlic-Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 6 large red chilies, seeds removed, sliced | 2 cans sweet peas and carrots, drained and rinsed ( you need 2 large cups ) | 1/4 cup frozen peas & carrots, thawed if frozen | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 1/4 cups shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup finely shredded carrot | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped maraschino cherries or 2 tablespoons cherrystones
instructions: In a blender or food processor, whirl the peppers with 1 cup of water until coarsely chopped and transfer to a medium bowl. Add the peas and carrots, toss to coat. In the same blender or food processor, whirl the oil, baking soda and 2 cups of lettuce until combined. Add the carrot mixture and the peppers, stir until combined. Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight in the refrigerator. Garnish with the remaining cup of lettuce and the cherries.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,tomato green chilies,red wine vinegar,grand marnier,stewing beef,red pepper flake,canola vegetable oil,black greek olive
title: Beef & Garlic Stew
ingredients: 1 -2 lb stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1 large head of garlic, crushed ( about 14 cloves ) | 2 tablespoons canola vegetable oil ( or olive oil ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 can great northern black greek olives, drained | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Heat oil in a dutch oven or deep skillet over medium high heat. Saute beef until a rich brown crust has formed. Stir in cloves and garlic and cook another minute or so, until tender. Add tomatoes, vinegar, and olives, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer until flavors combine and stew becomes thick, about 30 minutes. Season to taste with red pepper flakes and grand marnier.

Random Ingredients: focaccia bread,lager beer,corn chip,oat,canola oil,lasagna noodle,beef broth,peanut oil
title: Beef and Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 lbs top sirloin steaks or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin tip steaks, cut into 1 1/2 in. cubes | 1 jar lager beer, well-chilled | 1 can beef broth | 12 ounces lasagna noodles, broken into thirds | 7 ounces oat bread, toasted and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 cups crispy corn chips, coarsely broken | 12 slices focaccia bread, cut 1 inch thick ( thin slices ) | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts or 2 tablespoons unsalted dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°. Heat the oil in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add meat and cook until lightly browned, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to medium and stir in beer and broths. Add noodles and cook, stirring until noodles are tender and liquid is absorbed. Spread 1/3 cup noodles in a lightly oiled 11 x 7 x 1 glass baking dish. Top with half the meat, then top with 1/3 cup noodles. Repeat with 1/3 cup noodles, 2/3 cup meat, 1/3 cup noodles and 2/3 cup cheese. Top with remaining meat, then 1/3 cup noodles and 1/3 cup cheese. Top with remaining meat. Cover with foil and bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake, stirring once, until cheese is melted and meat and noodles are tender. Top with the peanuts and peanuts and serve.

Random Ingredients: green onion,fenugreek seed,apple juice,bok choy,cola,sage,taco seasoning mix
title: Oktoberfest Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 bunch collard greens or 1 bunch bok choy | 1 bunch green onion, white parts only, cut into pieces | chopped bok choy | 1/2 teaspoon nigella seeds or 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon chopped sage or 1/2 teaspoon cilantro | 1 ounce abengo hot taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup apple juice or 1/4 cup water
instructions: Chop greens into bite size pieces and toss with onions, greens, choy, and cilantro. Sprinkle the entire top with chiptole seasoning with taco seasoning and apple juice if using. Place on cookie sheet, or lightly oil your hands. Broil until sausages are nicely browned.

title: Simple Nachos Chipotle Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 tabt canned chipotle hot sauce ( i.e. taco bell home originals ) | 1 -2 teaspoon soya sauce ( i prefer reduced sodium, so i use the low sodium variety ) | tortilla chips, for dipping ( or chips of your choice )
instructions: Combine chipotle hot sauce and soya sauce in a small, microwave safe container or a measuring cup. Secure the lid. Microwave on high power on high until hot, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,red chili pepper,broiler fryer chicken,red pepper flake,brown sugar,filling,lasagna noodle,pork loin roast
title: Roasted Pork Calzone
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless loin roast, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 12 ounces filling | 3 poblano peppers, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon crushed red chili pepper | 2 -4 cups broiler-fryer chickens, cut up | 12 lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place pork and brown sugar in a roasting pan. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes and toss well. Spread filling all over pork and add enough water to just cover. Bake uncovered for 3 to 4 hours. While roast simmers, cook lasagna in a large pot of boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,dark chocolate,masa harina flour,pistachio,thai green chili,sesame seed
title: Green Chili Parfait Cookies
ingredients: 500 g masa harina flour | 120 g desiccated dark chocolate | 1/4 cup desiccated sesame seeds | 1 thai green chili, sliced | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 125 g roasted pistachios
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor. Process well until dough forms. Turn out onto a floured surface. Roll into 1 inch balls. Bake on a baking tray until lightly golden in colour. When cool, spread with icing sugar.

title: Tori No Kakoto (Pork Chop & Chinese Cabbage Sausage Cabbage)
ingredients: 4 pork chops ( cut 1-inch long ) | 1 lb cabbage
instructions: Wash cabbage and remove leaves. Wash the pork chops if using and cut into 1 inch. Slice into 1 1/2 inch slices. Bring a large pot of well salted water to a boil over high heat, add cabbage and cook 2 - 3 minutes. Drain well. Put pork slices in a large bowl and pour enough boiling water over to cover. Add the cabbage to the bowl and toss. Set aside until ready to serve. Note, if using a pork chop already cut, cook them on a pan with a little vegetable oil and when brown about 1 minute per side.

Random Ingredients: pimento pepper,cooking spray,chili paste garlic,half,cayenne pepper,black coffee,crisco
title: Mexican Pimento Hot Cocoa Blend
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 1/4 cups pimento pepper strips | 2 tablespoons chili paste with garlic | 1/4 cup strong black coffee | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweetened condensed cream or 1 1/2 tablespoons half-and-half | 3/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup braggs liquid aminos ( optional ) or 1/4 cup milk ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f spray 9x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. In large bowl, toss pimento strips with chili paste and pepper. In blender or food processor, combine coffee, cream, cayenne, and if using, braggs. Stir into hot pepper mixture. Pour into prepared dish. Bake 20 minutes, or until bubbly. Cool 1 minute. Serve warm.

title: Smoked Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 1 lb smoked lean ground pork | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 teaspoon canned chipotle chiles in adobo, minced, seeded ( from a 1-ounce jar, seeded if desired ) | 1 bunch fresh asparagus spear, trimmed ( about 4 cups )
instructions: Remove the hard tough stems from the asparagus. Rinse the asparagus, remove the eyes and white ribs and cut off the tips. Cut each in half lengthwise. Cut an opening at the bottom of each asparagus stalk with a skewer. Cook the meat, garlic, chiles and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a medium skillet over medium high heat, stirring, until the meat is no longer pink and the garlic is fragrant. Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes. Add about 2 cups water and boil the mixture, uncovered for 3 minutes until syrupy and reduced, stirring often. Add the asparagus, cook until just steaming, 2 - 3 minutes longer. Pour into a large warm bowl.

title: Ahi Paneer
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon honey or 1 teaspoon agave, plus extra, for drizzling | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | pitted romaine lettuce
instructions: Combine the yogurt, ketchup, sugar or agave and cardamom seeds in the bowl of an electric mixer. Mix until well combined about 30 seconds or until the yogurt has become smooth and thick but still thick.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,balsamic vinegar,red bell pepper,zucchini,butter,self rising flour
title: Zucchini Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup roasted red bell pepper, drained and chopped | 1 cup shredded zucchini | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 cup butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place the pork in a casserole dish. Sprinkle the red bell pepper and zucchini over the pork and top with the bacon bits. Dissolve the vinegar in about 3/4 cup of the hot water, add to the casserole and cook for 30 minutes. Stir the flour into the melted butter.

title: Tuscan Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 2 pints canned chili beans | 1 jar sweet papayas
instructions: Place bulgur in a bowl and mix with 1 teaspoon of herbes de provence. Mix chili beans into the bulgur. Place papaya slices on top and wrap in cheesecloth.

title: Pepperon's Famous Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef brisket, cut into 12-inch-length, flat pieces | 1/4 cup orange extract or 1/4 cup lemon extract
instructions: Trim excess fat, if necessary. Sprinkle brisket generously with pepperon's original extract. Place on rack in baking pan at highest possible temperature. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Bake uncovered about 1 hour. Baste frequently with orange juice. This makes 1 1/2 to 2 lbs. Pack into freezer bags or ziptop ziploc bags with 1 1/2 to 3/4 lb of brisket for later use. Allow to thaw thoroughly, then trim off excess fat.

Random Ingredients: mustard,picante sauce,mexican oregano,dark brown sugar,italian parsley,mint leaf
title: Mexican Take-Out Dipping Sauce With Rum
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon dry mexican oregano | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar or 1 teaspoon brown sugar substitute | 1 1/2 tablespoons picante sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried mint leaves | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate until ready to use. Use to top salads, sandwiches, seafood, etc. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: table salt,green leaf lettuce,caster sugar,plain flour,coconut mango jasmine rice,fine sea salt,double crust pie,chicken wing
title: Mango-Pareve Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 sheet double crust pie pastry | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings | 2 green leaves lettuce ( optional ) | 1 large ripe mango | 2 tablespoons shredded coconut mijoons natural sweetened coconut-mango jasmine rice
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f lightly spray a baking sheet with vegetable oil spray. Press first measure of sugar into the pastry. Use pastry tip to mark a line on the bottom of the lined baking sheet. Prick the remaining pastry with a fork to mark the same spot. Place the chicken wings beside the sugar line and press in with your fingers. Sprinkle with sea salt and table salt. Place the second pastry sheet on top and cut into 8 wedges using a biscuit cutter. Place wedges on top of the first measure of sugar and bake for 20 - 25 mins, brushing twice with remaining oil. Turn and bake a further 10 - 15 mins or until golden brown. Cut into segments when cooked remove and place on paper towelling to soak up any excess juices. Top with green lettuce leaves if desired and drizzle with sweetened flaked mango and mijoons. Serve alongside mango rice.

Random Ingredients: white bread flour,shiitake mushroom,dark soy sauce,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese Bread Rollatis
ingredients: 200 g dry white bread flour | 150 ml dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh chinese five spice powder | 7 ounces shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Mix the crust ingredients together on a floured board into a ball. Knead the dough out on a lightly floured board until it can be covered with dough. Roll the dough with a rolling pin into a log about 6 inches long and 2 inches wide or even more. Wrap in clingfilm and leave in the cool place for 2 hours or you can freeze it and then bake it for 3 hours at 350°f. If you wish to freeze, simply wrap the log in saran wrap and store it in the freezer. Slice the roll into 3 inch slices. Serve with dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,oregano,rice wine vinegar,tomato vegetable juice cocktail,adobo seasoning,hominy
title: Hominy Salad
ingredients: 1 can tomato-vegetable juice cocktail | 1 can hominy, drained and rinsed | 1 plum tomato, chopped | 4 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine tomato and hominy juice cocktail, rinsed hominy, plum tomato, rice vinegar, adobo seasoning, and oregano in a bowl.

title: Grilled Jamaican Pork Steak Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango juice | 1 cup grapefruit juice | 2 yellow onions, cut into wedges | 1 boneless pork loin, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1 package ready-to-serve skirt steak, thawed | 7 ouncesreame noodles
instructions: For salad, combine mango and grapefruit juice in a small saucepan over medium low heat till warm. Add onions, and simmer 10 minutes, or till onions are tender but not brown. Transfer the onions to a small bowl, and set aside. Pour the pork loin steak into the cooled onions, and season with nutmeg. Let stand at room temperature, covered, 30 min., stirring occasionally, turning it occasionally. For meat, preheat grill to medium high heat. Remove pork from the marinade, and sprinkle with salt. Grill the meat 15 to 20 minutes, turning frequently, until cooked through and crusty and instant read thermometer registers 165 degrees f. Transfer the pork to a cutting board, and let stand about 5 minutes to cool slightly. Slice into thick slices. Cut the pork crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. To serve, plate the meat slices at the table. Spoon some of the onion mixture over each slice, and top with meat slices.

title: Pommes' Onions
ingredients: 6 small onions | 3 mushrooms, sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons onions salt | fresh thyme sprigs ( to garnish )
instructions: Peel the onions and cut into quarters. Place in a mixing bowl, cover with boiling water and leave in the beginning to soften for 15 minutes. Drain and set onion quarters aside to dry. Wash and dry mushrooms. Cut into quarters. Place on serving platter or plates and cover with onions, mushrooms and thyme. Serve with prawns or any other seafood of your choice.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,barley,andouille sausage,pecorino romano cheese,cream cheese,sultana,thai fish sauce
title: Andouille and Marinated Barley Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked barley ( not brown ) pasta | 12 ounces mascarpone cheese | 3 ounces cream cheese | 1/4 cup cream cheese | 3 ounces andouille sausages | 6 tablespoons barley | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Heat a large pan on medium high. Meanwhile, cook pasta as directed on the package. While the pasta is cooking, combine all the ingredients except sultanas and fish sauce in a food processor.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,salt pork,mozzarella cheese,black eyed pea,beer,marinara sauce,oyster sauce,cornstarch
title: Quick-Fix Oyster Canapes
ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread, crust removed | 1 lb salt pork, well drained, cut into 1/4 inch cubes or 1 lb bacon | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 4 ounces beer ( a beer is fine ) | 1 cup marinara sauce, any size, divided | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Arrange a single layer of foil on a shallow pan, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange the bread on a foil covered plate. Pierce each bread slice several times with a fork. Place the 2 ounces of salt pork in an 8 to 10 inch nonstick skillet and cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until the meat is browned. Remove from the skillet and set aside. Arrange the bacon on one side of the bread slices and place the other side of the bread slices on the bacon. Coat the sides of the bottom of the skillet with cornstarch and set aside. In the skillet, bring the beer and 1/2 cup of marinara liquid to boil. Blanch the oyster sauce for 10 seconds and add to boiling the marinara sauce. Stir well and cook until the liquid is almost evaporated and the sauce is thickened.

title: Chipotle Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package uncooked dry lasagna noodles | 1 package frozen meat, thawed, drained | 1 spanish onion, chopped | 1 can chipotle peppers, chopped | 1 container penne, broken into thirds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1 medium cucumber, unpeeled, diced | 1/2 cup peeled, diced parsnips | 2 teaspoons harissa
instructions: Combine ingredients, and stir well for 5 minutes. Serve with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: thyme leave,poultry seasoning,habanero pepper,italian dressing,beef tenderloin,vegetable,bacon
title: Italian Beef and Bacon Stirloin
ingredients: 6 beef tenderloin | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leave | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon vegetable cooking spray with cooking spray | 8 slices thick-cut bacon, cooked and broken up | 8 slices italian-style mixed vegetables, such as baby carrots, broccoli, onions, green beans
instructions: Place the tenderloins in a shallow dish. In a small bowl, mix together the thyme, poultry seasoning and vegetable cooking spray. Sprinkle over the beef. Turn and let rest at room temperature for 10 minutes. Prepare grill for high heat. Remove the beef from the marinade, and pat dry with paper towels. Spray the grill rack with cooking oil. Grill the beef 4 minutes per side for medium rare or longer for well done. Let stand 5 minutes. Transfer to cutting board, and slice thin. Top slices with vegetables and crumbled bacon.

Random Ingredients: date,ricotta cheese,penne pasta,black bean,dish pie shell,kiwi
title: Black Bean Cheesecake Pasta
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup shredded ricotta cheese | 1 kiwi, peeled and grated | 1 package chopped dates | 1 deep dish pie shells, baked and cooled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Mix black beans, ricotta cheese, kiwi, and dates together. Place pasta in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Drizzle with black bean mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is bubbly, about 30 minutes. Cool 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Five Spice Filling for Salmon or Tuna
ingredients: 4 1/2 3 1/2 ounces mayonnaise | 1 pinch five-spice powder
instructions: Stir together all the ingredients and place in a small bowl. Leave in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes prior to making the salmon.

title: Baby Carrots (Sharon benoit)
ingredients: 15 baby carrots ( or equivalent weight from carrots, or your baby's weight ) | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Drain the carrots and place in a saucepan or heavy non metallic bowl. Add a drop or two of a water and stir well to mix. Add the vinegar. Cover the pan and place over a gentle heat. Turn the heat down and simmer for 40 minutes until the carrots are tender and just starting to turn golden.

title: Melt Your Pumpkin Sausage and Aubergine Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen pumpkin or 2 lbs winter squash | 2 -3 lbs sausages meat | 1 can condensed beef stock | 1/4 cup whole almond, toasted | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 - 3/4 cup ground raw almonds, lightly toasted | 1/2 large anaheim chili, roasted, seeded and diced ( optional ) | your favorite roll
instructions: Peel pumpkin or squash, remove seeds to make a small roasting pan, add 1 t. Of water to pan. Scrape any remaining fat from meat, if needed it should be in one small cube. Remove meat from pan and set aside. Brown sausages in pan and set aside. Save pan drippings if necessary. In reserved pan heat reserved drippings a little. Stir stock into pan juices. Pour this over sausages in pan. Add all toasted almonds to pan juices and bring to boil. Reduce heat to simmer then cover and cook for 20 - 30 mins or until tender. Taste and adjust seasoning, remove sausages and roast in oven. Remove from pan and slice into thin sticks. Serve with your favorite roll.

title: Carne Asada(Venezuelan Fried Steak)
ingredients: 1/4 cup yellow onion ( minced, can use white onion ) | 2 lbs round steaks, lean cut | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoni, small, finely diced ( small pepperoni in a jar ) | 1/8 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Heat wok to medium/high. Heat a frying pan on the stove.

title: Kiwi Chocolate Mousse
ingredients: 1/2 lb mexican chocolate, chopped | 2 medium kiwi, peeled, chopped | 3 medium carrots, peeled and chopped
instructions: Melt chocolate in a microwave in the microwave. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill for 30 minutes or until the flavors meld.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,peach,coffee liqueur,sage,red bell pepper,mozzarella cheese
title: Mexican Hot Chocolate Sandwich
ingredients: 1/3 cup coffee liqueur ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons thick & chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons chopped red bell peppers | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh sage | 2 tablespoons sliced peaches ( optional ) | 4 slices fresh mozzarella cheese | 3 inches round slices low-fat buttered bread cut in half
instructions: Spoon 2 tbsp hot coffee in the bottom of each melted half of round bread. Top with 1/2 tbsp of the salsa, 1/4 of the chopped bell pepper, sauteed sage, 1/4 of the sliced peaches, and top with 1/8 of the mozzarella cheese. Put the top of the double pepper slice over the cheese. Wrap in a piece of buttered aluminum foil to weigh it down. Wearing plastic wrap cover, microwave on high heat, uncovered for 2 minutes. Take the foil off and microwave for 2 minutes more. Serve.

title: Green Tea and Kahlua Kulfi
ingredients: 12 tablespoons brewed green tea powder | 1/4 lb kahlua ( or other complimentary flavor ) | 2/3 cup confectioners'sugar | cayenne ( to taste ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon olive oil ( depending on how strong you want it )
instructions: If your teabags are a little over 1/2 inch in diameter, wrap the tip of a knife around the tip to make an opening out of the center, but leave the tip exposed to allow steam to escape. Otherwise, wrap the entire piece in foil and set aside. Measure teabags into medium mixing bowl and add the rest of the ingredients. Whisk or beat at high speed until ingredients are incorporated. Pour hot liquid into a piping bag with a corner snipped off of the corner.. Place each kulfi piece into the teabagas and let sit for 20 - 30 minutes. Once kulfi is sitting, use a small bowl that's big enough to hold the kulfi in a single layer. Pour liquid over entire kulfi and shake to coat evenly. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Santa Fe Pulled Pork and Beans - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 loaf of tex-mex beef tex-mex pork tenderloin, with bone in | 4 ounces french lentils, rinsed and picked over | 2 ounces oat, crumbled | 1 teaspoon serrano chili, seeded ( i used less ) or 1 teaspoon fresh red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped ( i used less ) | 1/2 cup pecans, toasted, chopped ( i just sprinkled the pecans on top of the pork and added about one tablespoon of chopped garlic and parsley ) | 3 scallions, minced | 1/2 cup beer ( i used stout )
instructions: Puncture the pork tenderloin with a fork with a fork. Combine all ingredients except the pork through the oat in a 2 - 3 quart crock pot. Stir in the crumbled pork and brown on high for 5 - 6 hours or on low for 8 hours. I served this with mashed potatoes and green salad. The liquid from the cooking liquid was enough to make about 3/4 cup total liquid and was perfect for dipping into, adding a bit of the liquid to the slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: oregano,yogurt,turkey sausage,thyme sprig,graham cracker crumb,scallion,vanilla bean,pimiento
title: Johnd's Famous Greek Yogurt Sandwich
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 1/2 lbs pork or 1 1/2 lbs turkey sausage | 1 scallion, chopped | 2 tablespoons pimiento, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 package graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place the yogurt in a large bowl. Set aside. Cut the sausage into 1/2 inch rounds. Place on a baking sheet. Cover and freeze for 20 minutes. Let them firm up completely. Remove the sausage from the freezer, remove the skins and bones. Slice the sausage and place in a medium size pot on the stove. Add the pork or turkey sausage, scallion, pimentos, oregano, thyme and vanilla scraped from the pods. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour. Remove the vanilla bean and place in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high, uncovered, for 45 seconds, until hot. Remove from the microwave and whisk until smooth, about 40 seconds. Set aside. Preheat the grill to medium high. Sprinkle the graham cracker crumbs on the plate. Divide the mixture evenly and evenly among the crusts. Spray the tops lightly with oil. Grill for about 5 to 7 minutes, or until lightly toasted, turning and pressing occasionally with toothpicks. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: white onion,cardamom,beef liver,cream celery soup,hard egg,apricot jam,white pepper powder
title: Low Fat Beef Liver and Dumplings
ingredients: 2 -9 ounces beef liver or 1 lb pork liver | 1 container low-fat sour cream or ( 8 ounce ) container non fat cottage cheese | white onion, very fine minced ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper powder, to taste | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons non fat cottage cheese | 3 teaspoons apricot jam or 3 teaspoons strawberry preserves | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional ) or 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon powder ( optional ) | fresh ground white pepper powder
instructions: Dice the meat and cut it in small to medium sized pieces. Pour sauce pan over medium heat. Add onion. Cook until onion is translucent. When onions are translucent, add meat. Brown quickly on all sides, drain fat. Add white pepper, sour cream to meat mixture. Add all ingredients except the jam/confectioner's liquid, and cook slowly for 20 - 30 minutes, stirring often. Add jam/confectioner's liquid to meat mixture. Mix well and add the optional cardamom or cinnamon powder. Turn off the heat and let sit until thick. Strain the liquid into another saucepan and set over low heat. Cover and simmer slowly for a few minutes. The liquid may separate and form a gravy. You may serve this at room temperature at room temperature. Note, i used 3 teaspoons of the jelly/confectioners liquid. The taste should not be too strong.

title: Cabbage and Beans With Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 can drained pinto beans | 1 can drained canned pinto beans | 1 tablespoon chili oil | fine breadcrumbs | 1/4 lb cabbage
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Pour into 2 quart baking dish, sprayed with cooking spray. Bake uncovered in 400 deg. F oven 40 - 45 minutes or until heated through and starting to brown.

title: Baked Hamburger Fingers
ingredients: 1 loaf unsliced white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 4 1/2 lbs hamburger
instructions: Mix all the ingredients, except the hamburger, thoroughly in a deep dish pie plate. Cover the breadcrumb mixture with a piece of waxed paper, and press down slightly. With a fork press the mixture together, forming a large, uniform mass. Flour a clean surface and roll out the hamburger into a cylinder a little wider than the pie plate's rim. Wrap again in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight. Cook in a 350 degree f oven, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 1 hour. Cool and slice to serve.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,basmati rice,salt,sesame oil,tamari,lemon pepper,salad oil
title: Lemon Sesame Rice
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups cooked basmati rice | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 -2 tablespoon salad oil | 2 teaspoons tamari
instructions: Place the rice in a bowl then add 1/4 cup of the maple syrup, lemon pepper, salt, sesame oil and 1 - 2 tablespoon of the salad oil. Mix with your hands. The rice will be slightly wet, and there should be more or less rice. Spread rice out evenly. Place in refrigerator, covered with a tea towel or paper towel for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, measure rest of the maple syrup and tamari. Wipe the rice out with a damp cloth or cheese cloth. Heat remaining salad oil on high in an iron skillet. Place rice onto the skillet. Sprinkle a little of the tamari over the rice. Cook the rice until the syrup is absorbed by the rice. It will bubble a little. Flip the rice.

Random Ingredients: mango chutney,saffron,button mushroom,venison,dark brown sugar,beef bouillon cube,coconut
title: Quick Mulligatawny
ingredients: 1 lb boneless venison, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1 beef bouillon cube ( see notes ) | 10 ounces button mushrooms, quartered | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Note, i use my fondue pot to mince the venison beef and i use 3 cups of water and 2 bouillon cubes. Preheat the pot on medium high. Brown the venison in the hot skillet. Drain off excess fat and add brown sugar and chutney. Cook 1 - 2 more minutes, stirring constantly. Add bouillon and mushrooms and cook 1 minute longer. Stir in saffron, paprika and water and bring to a full boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until meat is no longer pink. Serve over noodles or fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,pork sausage link,green olive,meat tenderizer,malt vinegar
title: Hot and Spicy Sausage Lasagna
ingredients: 16 lasagna noodles | 1 lb pork sausage link, casing removed | 2 tablespoons browning sauce or 2 tablespoons marmite vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons meat tenderizer ( optional ) | 2 cups fresh green olives or 2 cups black olives, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook 4 - 5 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, cook sausage over medium heat 3 minutes. Stir in remaining sauce ingredients, except olives. Heat to boiling and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, pour sausage mixture over uncooked pasta and toss. Place in an oven proof baking dish. Cover and bake about 30 minutes or until pasta is golden and hot. Place one olive slice on top. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Keligun Smoked Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 lb of assorted cut-up lean ground beef
instructions: Place the lean beef, fatty portion to one side of a small heavy iron skillet. Use high heat and brown the hamburg. Do this several times just to seal it shut, to keep it good and juicy. When all done cooking the beef to your liking, remove the beef to a plate and set it aside. Use a clean skillet and wipe it clean of the residue. Place the pan of meat back over high heat. You will be able to hear the bottom of the skillet crackle, as the meat becomes crisp and brown. Using the back of a spoon, pour the remaining fat/liquid into the pan. Lower the heat slightly and begin stirring the liquid. Do not drain the solids if you want a smokey coating of grease.

title: Ancho Chile Mix
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts, or more as needed | 1 tablespoon ground ancho chile powder | 1 tablespoon leeks, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir walnuts and ancho chile powder in the hot skillet until they are golden brown and fragrant, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,candy sprinkle,cider vinegar,red chili pepper,black pepper,nut
title: Hot and Sour Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili pepper | 1 tablespoon black pepper | 2 tablespoons candy sprinkles | 1 tablespoon freshly ground nuts, or more to taste | 1/2 cup chicken broth, or more as needed
instructions: Whisk vinegar, chili pepper, pepper candy sprinkles, and ground nutmeg together in a bowl.

title: Pear and Lime Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat | 2 cans frozen limeade concentrate, warmed | 1/4 cup dried tarragon, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 3/4 cup basmati rice, cooked
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice in slow cooker, mix well. Heat on low, cover.

title: BBQ Stuffed Pork Wraps
ingredients: 500 g pork shoulder | 3 green cardamoms | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons gouda cheese or 2 tablespoons emmenthaler cheese, grated | 100 g meat, fried | powdered syrup
instructions: Cut the pork shoulder into medium sized chunks and roll each piece in the cardamoms, golden syrup and cheese. Heat a frying pan over a medium heat. Cook each piece for 3 - 4 minutes or until the outside of each piece is lightly browned. Serve on a warm hoisin bread roll with a touch of powdered sugared honey.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,red kidney bean,hot paprika
title: Tajinee Chili Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried red kidney beans | 2 tablespoons hot paprika | 1 tablespoon ground ancho chile powder
instructions: Combine the kidney beans, paprika and ancho chile powder in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Simmer, covered, for 10 to 15 minutes, or until a meat thermometer registers 160 degrees f and the beans are very soft.

title: Avocado Pasta
ingredients: 500 g linguine | 1 tablespoon wheat pastry flour | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 3 tablespoons mixed pulses of charentes herbs or 3 tablespoons mixed pulses of charentes | 1 avocado, halal, cut into small cubes | 100 g raspberries | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente. Meanwhile heat butter to a good slashing point in a pan. Add flour to butter mix and whisk in slowly. Turn down heat and add herbs, mash well. Drain pasta and add to mixture. Add avocado and raspberries and mix. Plate dish and leave to cool. This part can be made ahead of time, put in fridge overnight. Enjoy updated with the review notes, for the best results, cover in clingfilm when required.

title: Fruit and Bean Pies (Australian Breakfast Mix)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed dried fruit | 1 cup beans ( any type suitable for boiling and stouring ) | 1 -2 teaspoon dried sage leaves ( or more if desired )
instructions: Using a small sieve, remove the rinds slightly and use to press them through a sieve or colander as gently as possible to extract as much liquid as possible.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,ricotta cheese,cheddar monterey cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Quick and Easy Cheese Dip (No Egg)
ingredients: 1 package shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 package shredded cheddar and monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 container ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: In a bowl combine cheese, pepper, and tabasco. Layer ingredients in the following order, cheeses, pepper, mixture, cheeses, sauce. Let sit overnight in the refridgerator serve with corn chips, crusty italian bread.

Random Ingredients: cream cottage cheese,wheat flour tortilla,pepper,rice paper,bulk italian sausage,dark rum,soy cheese,couscous
title: Sweet Sour Cream Stuffed Wraps
ingredients: 3/4 cup light cream-style cottage cheese | pepper ( fresh mrs. dash ) | 2 tablespoons light cream-style cottage cheese | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 8 ounces cooked sweet bulk italian sausage | 1/4 cup instant couscous | 1/4 cup soy cheese | 4 whole wheat flour tortillas | 3 sheets cooked rice paper ( i use wheat germ free! )
instructions: Mildly spritz a baking sheet or jelly roll pan with oil spray. Combine the cottage cheese and pepper in a bowl. Mix in the cream style cottage cheese in last 5 minutes of cooking. Set aside. Brown and drain the sausage. Add the couscous to the pan, increase the heat to medium, and cook, stirring often, until the couscous is dry, about 1 minute. Set aside. Brush both sides of the tortillas with a little of the olive oil, and set aside. Add 2 tablespoons of cream and 1 tablespoon of soy cheese inside each tortilla and roll up. Put into baking sheet lined along with rice paper, seam side down. You may need to add more olive oil to baking sheet until everything has been used. Repeat until you have used up all the tortillas. Cook in 450 degree oven for 5 minutes, or until golden and crunchy. Serve with your choice of side.

title: Hummus Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups prepared hummus
instructions: Heat oven to 325f.

title: Crispy Salt and Pepper Strips
ingredients: 1/3 cup sugar substitute | 1/3 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup coarse salt, coarsely ground
instructions: Place the sugar substitute, salt, and pepper in a plastic bag.

title: Ham Orange Soup
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, cut thin | 1 ounce uncooked noodles | 1/2 ounce ham, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 2 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Slice and saute onion and noodles. Mix nonfat dry milk powder or powdered milk, add to ham and noodles and saute for 2 minutes. Add orange juice and mix well. Bring to a boil. Serve immediately.

title: Vegan Taco Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup fat-free soymilk | 1/4 cup soy margarine or 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 shredded carrot | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and process about 1 minute or until combined well.

title: German Pizza
ingredients: 8 ounces yeast | 2 lbs ground chicken breasts or 2 lbs ground turkey | 1 red radish ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 cups boiling water in large bowl. Place chicken or turkey in a large pot and cover with 1 cup of warm water. Add remaining ingredients at once. Beat thoroughly with rotary beater for 5 minutes. Change water setting on mixer. Pour in dough that can be stretched thin and cut out as necessary. Turn out dough onto floured board and stretch out to desired thickness. Pat or stretch to desired thickness. Sprinkle with cornmeal if desired.

title: Adzuki Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups adzuki beans | 3/4 cup finely shredded cabbage | 2/3 cup finely shredded carrot | 1/3 cup finely diced parsnip | 1 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 dash ground mace
instructions: Boil adzuki beans until tender, then drain. Allow to cool. Add cabbage, carrot, parsnip, and spices. Mash the mixture in a bowl with a fork. Add mustard and blend well.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,taco shell,mint leaf,vanilla bean
title: Taco Stacks
ingredients: 15 large taco shells, warmed | 12 leaves fresh mint leaves, finely chopped | 4 1/4 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 vanilla bean, split and scraped
instructions: Spread one taco shell with about 1 tablespoon mint cream. Top with 1 - 2 teaspoons ancho chili powder and 3 mint leaves.

title: Tomato Sauce - Basic Recipe
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup lemon rind, grated
instructions: Mix together in a medium saucepan and heat over medium heat. I serve this with bread or rolls.

Random Ingredients: grape,bell pepper,self raising flour,salmon fillet,pasta,andouille sausage,serrano chilies,red chili
title: Sausage and Pepper Pasties
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 lb salmon fillet | 4 ounces uncooked mini pasta | 2 small peppers, cubed | 1 red chili, chopped | 4 ounces andouille sausage, sliced | 1 tablespoon self raising flour | 1 teaspoon crushed red chili
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook according to packet instructions or according to packet instructions until al dente. Heat oil in a frypan over high heat and brown the salmon. Remove from the pan and set aside. Heat the pan and combine the vegetables. Add the salmon and sausages back to the pan. Add the flour and crushed red chilli. Mix well and cook for 1 minute. Preheat oven to 200°c. Grease a large ovenproof dish. Pour the vegetables into the dish and add the salmon. Top with the pasta and sprinkle with crumpled bacon and green olives if desired. Set in the middle of the oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until golden and bubbly.

title: African Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 1/2 cup ginger-garlic paste | 10 cardamom pods | 7 cardamom seeds | 2 medium bunch fresh epazote | 4 toasted, peeled whole cardamom pods | 4 scallions, sliced | 1 piece fresh ginger garlic paste
instructions: Mix the chicken pieces with 1/2 cup water. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight. Heat a small cast iron skillet over medium heat. Remove the chicken pieces from the marinade. Place the ginger garlic paste in a small bowl, and squeeze the excess moisture off. In a small bowl, combine the cardamom pods, 8 whole cardamom pods, 3 whole epazote pods, and 2 whole cardamom pods. Dry roast the cardamom mixture for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Allow the spices to cool. Remove the whole cardamom pods. Place the cooled ginger garlic paste in a mortar. Grind with a pestle until smooth. Spread the ginger garlic paste on one side of the chicken, and sprinkle on the remaining cardamom and epazote pieces. Rub the mixture all over the chicken. Wrap the marinade around the bird. Allow to stand at room temperature for 2 hours, or refrigerate overnight at least. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the chicken on a foil lined baking sheet, and cover with aluminum foil. Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, then reduce heat to 300 degrees f and continue cooking for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Allow to rest for 10 minutes before carving and serving. Garnish with chopped scallions and toasted cardamom pods.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,plain flour,dressing,basmati rice,portabella mushroom,peanut butter,mint leaf
title: Nasi Goreng
ingredients: 4 cups basmati rice, washed | 2 1/2 cups roasted unsalted peanuts or 2 1/2 cups roasted unsalted peanuts | 1 cup roasted portabella mushroom | 1/4 cup roasted australian mixed salad dressing | 3/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh rosemary | 25 g chopped fresh basil ( optional )
instructions: Combine rice and 2 1/2 cups of water in a saucepan and season. Boil, uncovered and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until tender. Drain excess water and set aside. Place peanuts in a food processor and process until finely ground. Stir in mushroom, rice, salad dressing, mint and rosemary and process until combined. Toss with basil mixture just before serving.

title: Salsa & Roasted Apple Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 2 large apple rounds ( cut in half lengthwise, then coarsely chopped into 1/2-inch wedges ) | 4 tablespoons cream | 1 tablespoon hot salsa | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup chopped italian flat leaf parsley | 1/4 cup toasted hazelnuts | 4 tablespoons thinly sliced smoked salmon
instructions: Cut apple quarters lengthwise in half.

title: Mango Caponata
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled, pitted, diced | 1 teaspoon small caper, drained
instructions: In serving bowl, combine mango, caper and extra virgin olive oil. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,worcestershire sauce,basil,white wine,white vinegar,artichoke heart,swiss cheese,apricot
title: Dressed Antipasto
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained | 1/3 cup apricot, chopped | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Combine all ingredients except sesame seeds in a large bowl. Cover and place in refrigerator to chill. When ready to serve, heat dressing slightly in a toaster oven at 450 degrees f. Spread 1 teaspoon sesame seeds on a cookie sheet. Spread 1 tablespoon of the dressing on the toasted sesame seeds. Let stand 10 minutes to allow to set.

title: Baked Tomatoes - Rutherford Grill or Oven
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 ounce dark beer ( i prefer malzbier ) | 1 ounce tomato sauce ( i prefer contadina ) | fresh crushed peppercorn | 4 ounces pine nuts ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 ounce rapeseed oil
instructions: Preheate the oven on high. Lightly oil an 8 inch square baking dish. Combine all ingredients and blend to a smooth, spreadable consistency. Pour into the dish, top with the pine nuts, and bake for 45 - 60 minutes, until crust turns golden.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,pearl barley,peanut oil,serrano chilies,vanilla ice cream,yukon gold potato,parmesan cheese,semolina
title: Shrimps, Kumara Style Hashbrowns.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 3 red serrano chilies, diced | 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined, leaving tails on | 8 cups vanilla ice cream, frozen | 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated, divided | 3/4 cup semolina | 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced | 1/2 cup pearl barley
instructions: In a 12 inch non stick skillet over medium high heat, warm the oil. Add chiles and cook, stirring or shaking the pan occasionally, until they soften slightly and darken, 3 to 5 minutes. Add shrimp.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,orange zest,vanilla essence,fenugreek,harissa,self rising flour,spanish onion,iceberg lettuce
title: Spicy Kielbasa and Onions for Bread and Butter Pies
ingredients: 300 g kielbasa, thinly sliced | 12 large free range organic raw onions, peeled | 2 tablespoons harissa ( or to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons arabic seven spice or 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice | 1 cup spanish onion, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon harissa ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 head iceberg lettuce, large leaves, washed, dried, torn
instructions: Heat oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas cut slashes across onion slices. Place on a baking paper lined oven tray and roast for 30 mins, or until golden and soft. Cool for about 10 mins then slice thinly. Meanwhile, heat harissa if using and stir over a low heat for 2 minutes. Remove and cool. Grind in a food processor or mortar. Stir in onions, spices and fenugreek and blitz using on/off pulses. Transfer to a large bowl. Add flour and mix well. Knead in the shredded lettuce. Divide the dough between 4 x 2 buttered 6 cup capacity ovenproof dishes or 6 ramekins, or line the top of each with a large circle of greaseproof paper. Divide the dough between the dishes. Bake for 45 mins or until browned. Remove from oven and stand 5 mins while still warm, before serving.

title: Smoked Poblano Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 -4 poblano chiles ( roasted peeled, seeded and chopped ) | 1 tablespoon smoked prosciutto | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh pimento ( chopped finely ) | 2 -3 tablespoons part-skim mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | spices
instructions: Chop up roasted sweet peppers, removing seeds if desired. Add prosciutto, pimento, and mozzarella. Sprinkle with spices.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,lemon juice zest,triple sec,mustard seed
title: Homemade Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 1 lb fresh flat mustard seeds, not pickling | 3 tablespoons finely minced lemon juice and zest | 1 tablespoon hot chili paste | 2 cups triple sec
instructions: Blanch mustard seeds in boiling water for 5 minutes then plunge in cold buttermilk or sour milk. Cool and squeeze dry. Blend in remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cover and place in refrigerator.

title: Beef Biryani
ingredients: 1/2 kg stewing beef, cut into thin bite size pieces | 50 ml low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup water, depending on desired consistency | 1/2 cup green cardamom pod, split open | 5 cloves | 6 green chives, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 12 ounces small dried chives | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Toss all of the beef with the yogurt in a small, non metallic bowl until mixed evenly. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to marinate. Serve with crusty bread as an appetiser or for an afternoon meal.

title: Apple Onion Roast Beef
ingredients: 2 kg top sirloin or 2 kg rump roast | 125 ml apple juice concentrate, undiluted | 50 g plain flour | 50 g walnut oil
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Place meat into a roasting dish and add enough water to come half way up the meat. Cover dish and cook in the oven for an hour. Shake roasting dish occasionally to give a watery environment. When meat is ready, remove beef and vegetables to a warmed serving platter to keep warm. Skim fat from fat and pour off any excess fat. Add apple concentrate, and stir well. Sprinkle flour over meat and serve with sausages.

Random Ingredients: brown onion,lemon juice,pork shoulder,tamari soy sauce,cream tartar,salmon fillet,corn oil
title: Pan Seared Salmon with Creamy Lemon and Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 200 g salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce | 1 tablespoon brown onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon corn oil, if desired | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
instructions: Place salmon fillets in the bottom of a shallow glass baking dish. Combine sauce ingredients.

title: Marinated Dates With Dijon Tips
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg ripe dates | 175 ml dry white wine ( if you don't use this reduce the alcohol content by 1/2, about 1 1/2 tblsp. ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Prepare a marinating dish with the dijon foisier ingredients except dates. Take half of the date slices. Sprinkle half of the nutmeg and half of the nutmeg in the middle. Dribble half of the wine over each date. Let stand for an hour in a dark, cool place. Dribble the other half of the wine. Place on the same shelf and let stand for 1 to 2 hours until the wine has reduced considerably. Sprinkle the remaining nutmeg on top and serve.

title: Yogurt Can Chicken Chips
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground chicken | 1 package tortilla chips ( or as many as you like to chips ) | 1 bottle catsup | cooking oil | 1 cup white sugar ( or splenda sugar substitute ) | 2/3 cup vanilla yogurt | 6 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 onion | 1/2 cup radish
instructions: Prepare the bar grill, setting the burners to medium. Brown the chicken. While this is browning, prep the other ingredients. When the chicken is no longer pink, drain well. Combine the ground chicken, catsup, and sugar in a large bowl. Pour in the yogurt and mix. Place the corn chips on a baking sheet, place in the oven for a few minutes, or until slightly crisp. Remove from the oven, dip the chips in the remaining oil, and then in the sugar canister. Place in a paper bag or container and let get all stressed out of the house.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,french fry,pepperoni,hard,lemon juice,romano cheese,cream tartar
title: Straw Hatsnic Dinner for One
ingredients: 1/4 cup whipping cream | 4 tablespoons sour cream | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 6 slices romano cheese ( about 1/2 cup, see note ) | 2 packages frozen french fries, thawed | pepperoni, sliced | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar, for garnish
instructions: Place whipping cream, sour cream and lemon juice in a medium mixing bowl.

title: Easy and Delicious Cherry Croissants (French Bread)
ingredients: 4 cups bread flour | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and patted dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Combine flour and cherries in medium bowl toss and knead with hands. Using 2 tablespoons, roll balls out to 1/4 inch thickness. Using a pastry wheel or sharp knife, cut slits along crust. Spoon 1 teaspoonful of cherry mixture down center of croissants. Top with remaining 1 teaspoonful of cherry mixture. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: kashmiri chili powder,hamburger,pumpkin,colby monterey jack cheese,cream corn,white rice,roux,monterey jack cheese
title: Roux Bake
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1 can pumpkin | 1 lb hamburger | 1 cup grated colby-monterey jack cheese | 1/4 lb grated monterey jack cheese | 1 teaspoon kashmiri chili powder | 2 cups cooked white rice | 1 teaspoon roux
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees. Combine in an oven proof dish, the cornstarch, pumpkin, hamburger, and 1 cup of colby jack cheese. Sprinkle with the 1/4 grated cheese. Combine the chili powder and roux, and spread onto the mixture. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sherry,lime juice zest,green onion,date,croissant,clam juice,accent seasoning
title: Quick and Easy Seafood Croissant
ingredients: 2/3 cup bottled clam juice, canned | 2 tablespoons lime juice, freshly squeezed | 5 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning | 10 slices croissants | 1/4 cup green onion | 1/2 cup dates, diced
instructions: Combine clam juice, lime juice, sherry & cajun seasoning in a bowl & stir well to combine. Arrange croissant slices on a platter & top with 1/2 of the scallions, sliced dates & remaining scallions. Spoon scallions on top of seafood mixture. Garnish with green onions & chopped nuts.

title: Quick and Easy Fish Curry Chips
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chickpea flour or 1 cup garbanzo bean flour | 1 teaspoon curry paste, or more to taste | 2 teaspoons fish sauce, or to taste | 2 teaspoons hot pickled radishes, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco sauce, or to taste
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Cover bowl and allow to sit at room temperature. Form chips into thin, round balls with the desired amount. Store in an air tight container.

title: Panko Crusted Breaded Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 12 ounces panko breadcrumbs | 1 large red onion, cut int 8 thin wedges | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon or 4 teaspoons beef base, dissolved in | 4 teaspoons water or 4 teaspoons milk
instructions: Preheat your oven broiler. In a shallow bowl, combine all the creole seasoning ingredients. Cut the onion wedges into 1/2 inch thick rings and then place in an ovenproof dish, top with the crumbs. Pour the water or beef bouillon over breaded mix and place on lower rack of oven. Broil for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown, shaking and stirring occasionally to prevent burning.

title: Maple Syrup Chicken
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 can vegetable broth
instructions: Pour maple syrup into frypan with the chicken to lightly coat the chicken evenly then put into medium pot. Pour broth into frying pan and distribute evenly over chicken. Bring pan to medium heat and place a cover on the pan. I use microwave to cook the chicken at 50% power. Cook 45 minutes, until all the juices run clear. Remove cover from pan and let stand 5 minutes, then transfer to serving plate and serve. This makes 1 package.

title: Beans and Chips
ingredients: 8 baby carrots | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon jeera powder | 1 dozen taco shell | 12 -20 chilies
instructions: Steam the carrots. When it is done drain, peel, cut into long fingers, put in medium bowl. Sprinkle jeera over it and put some in a microwave. Let sizzle for a few seconds, add a teaspoon cumin seeds, stir.

Random Ingredients: egg white,italian breadcrumb,breadcrumb,mexican tomato,cumin seed,yellow squash,green cardamom pod
title: Tunisian Yellow Squash Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 medium ripe yellow squash | 3 large egg whites | 1 cup plain breadcrumbs | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs ( see recipe # 47900 for bread crumbs ) | 2 tablespoons ground cumin seed | 6 green cardamom pods, cracked open | 1 teaspoon ground mexican oregano or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh oregano, plus extra to squeeze onto tomatoes
instructions: Peel the yucca and cut in half crosswise. Then slice in half lengthwise and scoop out the pulp until you have about 1 tablespoon for each yuca.

title: Canned Vegetables & Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 14 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, drained | 2 1/2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon prepared pepper sauce | 2 teaspoons seedless european cucumbers, halved lengthwise
instructions: Place the vegetables, hot pepper sauce, chili powder, and pepper sauce in a large plastic bag. Close and shake to thoroughly combine the ingredients. Place plastic bag or a few at a time in a refrigerator to chill the vegetables for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,self rising flour,pork tenderloin,butter
title: Morton-Style Pork Tenderloin (Beirut Frito)
ingredients: 8 ounces pork tenderloins, trimmed | 1/2 tablespoon butter | 2 tablespoons yellow bell peppers, finely chopped | 3/4 cup self rising flour
instructions: In a medium frypan over medium high heat, saute the pork until it has cooked through. Drain any excess fat. Stir in the butter, bell pepper and flour, and stir until combined. Raise heat to medium high, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, and allow to simmer, uncovered for 7 - 10 minutes or until thickened. Let stand for 5 minutes, and pour the gravy into a gravy boat. Serve with toasted baguette or stale bread.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,flat leaf parsley,dark brown sugar
title: Champignons Aux Champignons
ingredients: 150 g button mushrooms | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 bunch flat leaf parsley, stemmed
instructions: In a large frying pan, bring 2 1/2 cups water to a boil and add the mushrooms. Cover and boil gently for 5 minutes without lifting the lid. Remove the mushrooms with tongs and drain on paper towels. Dribble 1/4 cup sugar over the mushrooms and remove the pan from the heat. Place in a sieve or sieve fitted with a double thickness of cheesecloth and add the parsley. Place on a board and sprinkle with the rest of sugar. Tie the cheesecloth with kitchen twine and roll the mushrooms into balls a fewcm in diameter. Place on a cookie sheet and steam for 15 minutes until they are tender and have turned a brown colour. Variation, replace 1/4 cup sugar with brown rice syrup. Note, this is a portuguese style saffron which is sold as a pickled cube or slice of saffron bread or crumbly rice pudding. Note, the saffron flavour is also called cinammon and is available in health stores and some food stores. A cube is a thin, metallic piece that can be crushed with a fork after it has been softened, then twisted or pulverised with a skewer after rubbing the surface with a little water and dropped into a simmering pan of simmering water to dissolve a bit of the brown sugar. This will improve the flavour of the saffron flavours. This will keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or in the freezer for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,dark chocolate,cream chicken soup,bay seasoning
title: Spinach-Mock Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 4 ounces dark chocolate | 8 ounces cream of chicken soup | 4 ounces fresh spinach leaves ( or you can leave some frozen chopped spinach in to thaw, but fresh is better ) | 1/8 teaspoon lawry's seasoned salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Melt chocolate over boiling water. Add soup and chopped spinach. Heat through then remove from heat, stirring often to prevent sticking. Remove from heat and stir in Seasoning. Transfer to shallow bowl and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,serrano chilies,poblano pepper,pimiento,green bell pepper,tarragon
title: Poblano Pepper Salsa
ingredients: 2 poblano peppers, halved | 1 can chopped pimientos, drained | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 bunch fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 serrano chilies, finely chopped | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place poblano peppers in a single layer on a baking sheet. Roast peppers in the oven until blackened on all sides, about 20 minutes remove and rub off the burned skin, and set aside. Place poblano peppers in a large bowl, cover with cheese cloth or waxed paper, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Place poblano peppers in a food processor and pulse until very finely chopped. Stir in pimentos, bread crumbs, tarragon, serrano chiles and green bell pepper. Store in refrigerator or in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,balsamic vinegar,picante sauce,green pepper,gruyere cheese,onion soup mix,ouzo
title: Vegetable Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of onion soup, undiluted | 2 tablespoons picante sauce or 2 tablespoons mild salsa | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled red chilies | 8 slices gruyere cheese | 8 large green peppers, grilled until tender
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f in a mixing bowl stir together the soups, picante sauce and vinegar until blended well. Stir in the red chilies and onion soup mix. Spread about 1/2 cup of vegetable mixture on each slice of cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbling.

title: Baked Onion Rice (Veg*n) (Dough)
ingredients: 2 cups rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: In a plastic bag, place the onion into the rice flour. Shake to combine. Place bag in a large bowl of ice and cold water. Use your hands to gently knead dough. The dough should feel smooth and pliable. You should take about 8 - 10 pices of dough, roll each into a 10 inch patty shape on a floured surface, then transfer to a parchment lined baking sheet. Cover with parchment paper, then refrigerate until baking time. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f. Using a pastry brush, or a very sharp knife, lightly coat a 9 inch cast iron skillet with cooking spray. Dredge the dough in the flour, tapping off the excess. Fry the patty until golden brown, about 3 minutes, then move to a rack to drain oil. Serve.

title: Guinness Poached Pork With Raisins and Herbs (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork ( i like to use leg, thigh, etc. ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( optional ) | 8 large fresh mint leaves, chopped | 8 ounces guinness stout, well chilled ( or other dark beer )
instructions: Trim fat from pork. Rinse and pat dry. Trim excess fat, as follows, mix the raisins, mint leaves, and hoisin stout together in a wide, narrow, glass dish. Tie meat legs together with kitchen tongs, allowing stuffing to be hidden inside. Rub half of each ingredient inside and out of the pork. Spoon the remaining hoisin stout over all. Cover and allow to sit 5 - 6 hours, then refrigerate overnight. Cook from morning 6 - 8 hours on high or 8 - 10 hours on low, until pork is fork tender, and falls off the bone tender, depending on thickness. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Lemongrass and Italian Sausage Soup
ingredients: 200 g of diced italian sausage or 200 g ground pork | 3 stalks lemongrass, sliced | 4 liters chicken stock | 400 g of strained raspberries liqueur | 100 ladyfingers | 1/2 teaspoon fennel, seeds | 5 small indian tomatoes or 5 small other fruits
instructions: Take out the lemongrass, finely cut it, and finely slice it. Put in a sauce pan to saute the sliced lemongrass. Add in some raspberries and cook for couple minutes. Take out lemongrass and make sure all the slices are not falling apart. If any part are, remove the pieces, and put into the pot. In the meantime, combine stock, raspberries and liqueur in a large saucepan, or medium pan, making sure to add more. Turn heat off and simmer for about 30 minutes. Prepare idlis, cut ladyfingers into small dices. Take soup out and cut the tomatoes in half, then cut into eighths. Take a bowl, combine sausage/pork, ladyfingers, soup, and fennel seeds in it and mix thoroughly. Take soup out and cut into small pieces. Add tomato halves into soup to mix. Serve with grated cheese, as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,grain rice,chicken stock vegetable,stir fry vegetable,currant,meat
title: My Own Quick and Easy Microwave Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb frozen stir fry vegetables | 2 cups leftover meat, diced | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 6 cups chicken stock or 6 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup medium grain rice | 1/2 cup dried currant
instructions: Prepare rice as directed on package. Mix all ingredients together in a microwave safe bowl. Cover. Microwave on high power for 25 seconds. Microwave, uncovered, on high power for 30 seconds. Stir. Prepare your leftover meat and vegetables. When rice is done, mix in all your vegetables. Cover. Microwave on high for 8 minutes. Stir. Cook for 2 more minutes. Gentley fold in rice and currants. Note, if adding beef, meat or vegetables while cooking, it really needs to be cooked or microwave until vegetables are cooked. If you are adding vegetables to rice, i recommend not combining meat or vegetables when done. Serve immediately if any of them are not cooked through. If rice is to your liking, this recipe works great with chicken or shrimp as well, for chicken. Microwave for 2 minutes, stir and serve. Variation, for a vegetarian/veggie version omit the chicken and seafood and add the vegetables.

title: Frugal Raita(Or Crusty Cheese With Yogurt)
ingredients: 1 lb baby spinach ( or a combo of other dried spinach and white cabbage ) | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce low-fat vanilla yogurt ( low fat can be substituted ) | kosher salt, to taste
instructions: Rinse out the spinach really well under cold running water. Put it in a bowl and add enough cold water to cover. If using regular yogurt, mix well and set aside. Cut up the spinach into bite size pieces and put in a blender or food processor. Add salt to taste and process until it has the texture of a paste. Add more of the yogurt if necessary.

title: Baked Chicken & Potatoes
ingredients: 1 chicken tender, skin on | 7 new potatoes | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 can cream
instructions: Thaw chicken. Preheat oven to 425f. Cut thigh joints from chicken thigh. Using a small piece of cheesecloth or your fingers, remove skin from chicken, leaving approximately 1/4 1/2in of the thigh and the thigh bones. Combine the sour cream or yogurt with the grain mustard and peanuts. Spread chicken mixture on a greased baking sheet and spread evenly in an even layer. Roast for 20 - 25 mins or until chicken is cooked and thoroughly browned. Serve with the potato wedges or jacket potatoes.

title: Barbecued Cornbeef and Swiss Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup coriander powder | 1/4 cup coked back bacon or 1/4 cup lean bacon | 4 beef brisket, well trimmed
instructions: In a small bowl combine coriander and coked bacon. Brush both sides of brisket with coriander paste. Wrap in aluminum foil and place on a rack in a shallow baking pan or baking pan.

title: Nut Rollups With Soy Dipping Sauce by Sy
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soya sauce, plain | 1/2 teaspoon corn, corn-flour | 1 teaspoon finely chopped pistachios | 1/2 teaspoon very finely chopped romaine lettuce | 2 slices banana, very finely cut, very finely, very well chopped ( firm ripe bananas ) | 2 small round oats, cooked in boiling hot water for 2 minutes | 1 medium romano lettuce, torn, washed
instructions: Make the dipping sauce by combining all the above ingredients and set aside. Cut the green leaves off the lettuces, and line the bottom of a large bowl, then spoon the soy dipping sauce on top. Arrange a large scoop of lettuce on the lettuce and pile some banana around it. Continue to scatter the chopped romaine lettuce and pile some nuts and chopped komodo all around the blob of lettuce and nuts. Garnish with some crisp crisp, washed crispy cold oats or crisp papertowels if desired.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,gherkin,white fish fillet,penne,gingerroot,puff pastry,dark brown sugar
title: Crispy Gingered Fish Pasties
ingredients: 60 g fresh gingerroot, peeled and chopped | 250 g red skinless white fish fillets, such as snapper, cod or 100 g red snapper fillets, cut into small dice | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 60 g ready-made puff pastry | 1/4 cup sweet gherkin, finely sliced | 1/4 cup sweet gherkin | 1 sheet puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Line a baking sheet with baking paper. Place ginger, fish, taco sauce, sugar and ginger in a food processor and process until smooth. Scoop mixture into a bowl. Roll pastry into 12 x 16 inches rectangle, brushing with a little water if necessary. Place a spoonful of mixture on the centre of pastry. Brush edges with water. Bring half of the dough to the centre of the pastry, fold in half, pinch corners together and press together with fingers. Cut pastry into 4 equal squares. Spread mixture over filling and sprinkle with gherkins. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until light golden.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,red wine,flour tortilla,hickory smoke salt
title: Lucky Fire
ingredients: 3/4 cup red wine | 3 tablespoons purchased hickory smoke salt | 1/4 cup purchased pesto sauce | 8 flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart non stick skillet, combine first 3 ingredients. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in pesto. Place tortillas on a serving platter. Spoon heated sauce over tortillas. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,cornflour,mint leaf,asiago cheese,onion powder,cayenne pepper,cottage cheese
title: Cottage Cheese and Red Curry Flavoured Noodle Kebabs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 pinch asiago cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon mint leaf, finely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in small bowl. Form into 6 patties. Grill for about 15 minutes.

title: Easy Crescents
ingredients: 1 can pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 large kaffir lime leaf, cut in 10 thin strips
instructions: Remove the crusts from the can of the crescents rolls. Separate the crusts into 10 equal pieces and press each piece into a 9x13 inch pan. Bake until lightly brown. Spread each crescent piece with 1 lime strip and a few kaffir lime leaves. Bake 10 minutes or until hot.

title: Lebanese Sushi
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons crushed flat leaf parsley | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Wiz a wooden sushi rolling bag together with the pinch of tabasco to make sushi sticks. To eat, gently press down onto a wooden sushi stick and cut into 12 pieces about 2 long. Repeat until all the sushi sticks are used up, placing them on a bamboo sushi mat covered with lightly oiled plastic wrap. Spray the grates with cooking spray and place on a plate lined with paper towels. Allow to drain while you preheat your oven to 300 degrees f. Use a knife or spatula to spread the kabocha onto one side of the kabocha and then press it onto the other side. Repeat until all 12 kabocha sticks are used up. After making sushi sticks on a wooden sushi stick, press them flat into a circle about 3/4 inch thick. Place on a baking tray and allow to dry for 20 minutes, or until completely dry. Use a toothpick to cut the kabocha into 2 inch long by 2 inch wide strips. Bake on a rack lined with foil on the middle shelf of your oven until slightly crisp, about 10 to 20 minutes. Remove toothpicks and allow kabochas to cool for 5 to 10 minutes before removing from the foil. Serve hot, with your favorite kabochas, dipping sauce and raw greens.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,white onion,black bean,maraschino cherry,white mushroom,ginger,dark corn syrup
title: Black Bean and Mushroom Hummus
ingredients: 1 can black beans ( rinsed and drained ) | 1/2 cup wild white mushroom, finely chopped | 1 slice ginger, finely chopped | 1/2 white onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon white onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dark corn syrup | 1/4 cup fresh thyme leaves, chopped or 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor, processor or blender til well combined. Spoon into small bowl or jar large enough to hold mixture in small bowl. Cover tightly and refrigerate up to 2 days. Serve with toasted buns or pita chips.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,mushroom,black olive,onion salt,vanilla extract,garlic clove,peanut oil,vanilla essence
title: Gf,Pecorino,Stick to Your Tongu Santo
ingredients: 2 cans mushrooms, drained | 1 3/4 cups pecorino romano cheese or 1 3/4 cups asiago cheese ( 4 slices ) | fresh garlic clove, minced | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon powdered pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 - 2/3 teaspoon powdered pecorino romano cheese ( or substitute ricotta cheese ) | 2 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts or 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts, roughly chopped ( to taste ) | peanut oil, for frying
instructions: Place drained mushrooms in a fine mesh strainer, and let drain for 15 minutes. Slice mushrooms and place in large bowl. In another bowl, mix together grated cheese, onion salt, garlic, onion salt, pecorino/ricotta cheese, nuts or just crushed peanuts. Add to drained mushrooms, stirring until well mixed. Heat a deep fat fryer to 350°f. In a deep pan, make a well in the cheese mixture. Pour in a few tablespoons of peanut oil and begin mixing the mixture vigorously to avoid building clumps, until mixture is creamy and thickened, about 3 - 5 minutes. Turn mixture into oiled pan and fry until browned, about one minute if using peanuts or peanuts. Drain on paper towels, if desired. Enjoy immediately.

title: American Spicy Fruit Sausages With Pork and Mango
ingredients: 1 lb white asparagus, trimmed | 1 lb firm ripe mango, peeled and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 12 ounces pork, finely chopped | 32 fluid ounces tuna, drained and flaked | lime wedge
instructions: Preheat over to 450°f. Cut asparagus diagonally into 1/2 inch slices, and place in a colander and sprinkle with salt. Let sit for 5 minutes, then pat dry. Place mango, chili powder, pork, shrimp and fish in a bowl. Mix well. Place the mixture into a baking dish large enough to accommodate mixture. Bake for 15 minutes. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Kielbasa with Tater Tot
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak | 2 packages tater tots | 2 packages dried porcini mushrooms, sliced | 1 egg substitute | 1/2 cup oat bran ( to thicken ) or 1/2 cup wheat germ, for thickening
instructions: Heat wok over medium high heat. Add sirloin steak and sear. Remove steak and sear other side. Return sirloin steak to wok and add mushrooms to wok and stir fry 2 - 5 minutes or until mushrooms are tender. Remove from wok and drain off all but 1 tb. Oil. Set aside. Wipe out wok. Return to element and add oat bran, cooking 1 - 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add meat and stir fry for 5 minutes or until meat has browned. Add beef mixture to wok. Toss until well combined, adding salt if needed. Serve with rice and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,green cardamom pod,asparagus,rice noodle,chili paste garlic
title: Broccoli Noodle Pilau (Rice Paper)
ingredients: 12 -16 ounces fresh rice noodles | 1 bag fresh broccoli florets, blanched and peeled | 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed | 2 -6 green cardamom pods, split | chili paste with garlic
instructions: Cook rice noodles in boiling water according to package instructions. When done, drain and place noodles and broccoli in a large bowl. Remove 1/3 of noodles from water and set aside. Stir together green cardamom pods and chili paste with garlic and set aside. Add water to noodles and broccoli to cover. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Drain vegetables and add to noodles and broccoli. Serve with sweet chili sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: okra,campari,black vinegar,green bean,kaffir lime leaf,vanilla ice cream,heavy cream
title: Savoury Vegetarian Ice Cream Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 cups vanilla ice cream | 1/3 cup black vinegar ( good quality ) | 1 package frozen okra, thawed | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed, rinsed | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons campari | 1/3 cup heavy cream, whipped
instructions: Combine the ice cream, vinegar, okra and beans. Freeze until firm, at least 2 hours. Slice the kaffir lime leaves into thin wedges.
