Combine the whipped cream and kaffir lime leaves in a small bowl, and add the campari. Slice each tomato 1/4 inch thick and place in an ice cream maker. When the first piece of snow dropped from a plate, scoop out with a slotted spoon. Place on plate, and allow to thaw for about 5 minutes. Remove kaffir lime leaves immediately, and use to garnish the ice cream sandwich.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,wheat bread,pepperoni,chicken bouillon,cashew nut,chicken thigh,red apple,chili flake
title: Cashew Nut Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted cashew nuts, roasted | 3/4 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, boneless | 2 teaspoons low-sodium instant chicken bouillon or 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried hot chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 8 canned red apples, quartered | 12 slices thin cut pepperoni | 3/4 cup canned sliced dry whole wheat bread, torn into pieces
instructions: Toast cashew nuts in skillet over medium low heat for about 5 minutes. Or if cashews are not well toasted, it is easier to toast them by pressing them with a metal spatula. Transfer cashews to bowl or casserole dish and coarsely grind with a mortar and pestle. Alternatively, you can process the nuts in a food processor until smooth. Combine cashew paste ingredients in a small bowl and stir to combine. Dice chicken into 1 inch cubes and place them in another small bowl. Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add cashew paste mixture to hot oil and stir to combine. Cook chicken in batches until they are golden brown, about 6 to 7 minutes, stirring frequently. Set aside chicken on paper towels, drain oil. Pour off the oil and transfer hot oil to pot over med hi heat. Add apple pieces, chicken and any accumulated accumulated juices from tomato paste mixture and cook, stirring once and scraping up any browned bits, about 5 minutes. Add cashew nuts to pot. Stir in bread cubes and cook 1 to 2 minutes until bread pieces are moistened and the cashew nut stew is hot again. Serve stew warm with fresh green beans.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,olive oil,apple juice,guajillo chilies,pasta shell,pepperoni,lasagna noodle,parmesan cheese
title: Pasta Pronto
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 3/4 lb chopped pepperoni | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 chipotle chilies, minced | 3 tablespoons sliced olive oil | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon apple juice | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped pecorino grano cheese
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. While pasta is cooking, fry pepperoni with 1 tbsp. Oil and chilies in remaining 1 tbsp. Olive oil. Add chili powder. When noodles are done, add pasta to skillet. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cook until hot and bubbly.

title: Pasta Nomodata
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 yellow squash | 1 shallot, minced | 1 can cannellini beans
instructions: Prepare quinoa. Rinse quinoa and drain. Cut squash lengthwise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Rinse beans and add to quinoa. Saute in olive oil until they brown. Add reserved beans until beans are warmed and begin to color. Add the minced onion and saute. Cook until onion is translucent. Add the quinoa. Cover. Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Spiced Yogurt With Orzo
ingredients: 8 ounces orzo pasta | 4 ounces jicama or 4 ounces banana sprouts, sliced into 1/8-inch strips on a mandoline | 1/4 cup salsa verde ( medium strength or hot salsa ) | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons honey | 2 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions. Cool quickly under running water.

title: Quick Tandoori Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 12 leaves lettuce, chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pecans
instructions: Shape sirloin into 10 - 6 oblong patties, about 1/4 inch thick and 4 inches long. Sprinkle with garam masala, and coat with pecans. Grill over medium coals, turning occasionally, until no pink remains, about 5 minutes total. Serve burgers with lettuce on the side.

title: Vanilla Cucumber Martini
ingredients: 1 lebanese cucumber, peeled | 1 1/2 ounces vanilla vodka | 3 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Using a sharp knife, carefully pith and remove the peel and peel from the cucumber without tearing it all the way to the ends. Slice into half or thirds lengthwise. Place in the freezer for around 24 hours before martinis.

title: Chickpea Flour Cookies
ingredients: 300 ml chickpea flour | 1 green onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: In a bowl, combine chickpea flour and green onion.

Random Ingredients: turnip,pork shoulder,oil,mirin,black pepper,onion powder,sun tomato oil
title: Quick Sun Dried Tomato and Pork Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cubed | 1/2 lb turnip, cubed | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/3 cup mirin ( or a japanese sweet wine, if you can find it ) | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Heat the oil in a large wok or frying pan. Add the meat and stir fry for a few minutes. Add the sun dried tomatoes and cook for a few minutes more. Add the mirin and cook for a few seconds longer. Add the onion and pepper and cook for a minute or two. Reduce the heat slightly and cook covered for 20 minutes, or until meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,grain white rice,yellow bell pepper
title: Confetti Rice
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white rice | 3 large yellow bell peppers or 3 large green bell peppers | tabasco sauce or other hot spicy flavor enhancer
instructions: Place the bell peppers and the rice in a bowl. Sprinkle with pepper or flavour enhancer, or use hot sauce. Toss well, and serve immediately.

title: Zucchini with Apricots
ingredients: 2 medium zucchinis | 1 cup dried apricot | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Slice zucchini lengthwise and cut into wedges, reserving ends and stems. Discard ends and skins. Soak apricots in water for 30 minutes. Drain well and reserve 2 tablespoons apricots for garnish. Sprinkle zucchini with bread crumbs then sprinkle with cheese. Broil or grill zucchini until tender and lightly browned.

title: Roasted Tomato and Ziti With Gluten-Free Option
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 3 tablespoons arrowroot | 3 tablespoons walnuts, coarsely ground | 1 small plum tomato, seeded, chopped | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1 small orange, zest of, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Cook ziti in boiling water according to package directions, just until al dente but not mushy. Drain. Set aside to cool slightly. Combine arrowroot and walnuts in a large ziplock baggie. Shake the bag till mixture is well mixed and set aside. Combine the plum tomato, ricotta cheese and orange zest in a small bowl and set aside. Add the cooled ziti and mix well. Spread the tomato mixture in an oven proof casserole dish that is just large enough to accommodate all the tomatoes and ziti. Cover with the cheese mixture and bake 10 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the tomatoes begin to turn a little mushy. Remove from the oven, and let stand 5 minutes. Serve with a green salad for a great side dish. To freeze, transfer to an airtight container and place in a freezer bag. After 20 minutes, remove from the freezer and defrost completely. To reheat, transfer to an oven safe casserole dish and bake at 375° for 25 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: honey,bacon dripping,wasabi powder,splenda granular,marshmallow,mexicorn kernel corn,bay leaf,cardamom
title: Nuclear Nests in Wasabi
ingredients: 1 bag miniature marshmallows | 5 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 1/2 tablespoons wasabi powder | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground mexicorn kernel corn | 1 bay leaf | spagetti ( optional ) or pancake syrup ( optional )
instructions: Mix the marshmallows and 2 tablespoons water together in a large bowl. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Drop tablespoons of mixture onto the nests of nests about 3 at a time. Indent with fork if necessary. Cover and chill until hard, at least 3 hours or overnight. To serve, preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Serve nests warm with wasabi or whipped cream. Store in airtight cookie bag in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla,quinoa,carrot juice,habanero pepper,cashew,sunflower seed oil,lima bean,garlic salt
title: Zippy Zesty Corn Fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups quinoa | 1 package corn tortillas, cut into 1-inch strips | 1 can small lima beans, drained | 1/2 cup cashews, or as needed | 1/2 cup sunflower seed oil | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and minced | 3 carrots, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped cashews, or as needed | 2 teaspoons sunflower seeds oil, or as needed
instructions: Place quinoa and tortilla strips in a microwave safe bowl. Cover, and cook on high for 3 minutes. Pour lima beans and lima beans into a small saucepan. Microwave for 1 more minute to warm, stirring constantly, and set aside. In a small bowl, mix together 1/2 cup cashews, sunflower seed oil, and garlic salt. Set aside. In a large skillet or wok over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon sunflower seed oil. Stir in minced vegetable, carrots, and cashews until heated through, about 2 minutes. Stir fried vegetables into quinoa.

title: Spinach and Spinach Pizzas
ingredients: 1/2 cup bottled pizza sauce | 1 cup fresh baby spinach leaves, packed tightly
instructions: Preheat the broiler. To make the pizzas, spread pizza sauce on the pizza base, then layer spinach leaves over the sauce and sprinkle with a small amount of brown sugar, if desired. Repeat layers, beginning with sauce, finishing with a sprinkling of brown sugar.

title: Mexican Turnips
ingredients: 12 medium turnips ( about 2 lbs. total ) | 1 1/2 cups taco sauce ( mild, medium or hot, to taste ) | 2 -3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Scrub turnips and cut off stem end. Turnips into cold water to cover.

title: Nigella's Special - a Fool Proof recipe for Dessert
ingredients: 2 cups rice | 2 cups fruit, thinly sliced and chopped | 1/2 liter good quality alcohol free vodka | 2 -3 cherries, juice of | 2 teaspoons nigella seeds
instructions: Cook rice in 2 - 3 liters of boiling water over medium heat for 5 - 10 minutes until cooked. Keep stirring, don't let it burn. Stir the rice while it cooks so it doesn't stick together to the bottom of the pot. Stir in the fruit, vodka and nigella seeds to the rice. Turn off heat. Put mixture in serving bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,raspberry,buckwheat flour,basil leaf,coconut milk,golden raisin,beef brisket
title: Coconut Beef
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1/2 cup beef gravy ( gluten-free ) | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves | 3/4 cup fresh raspberries ( or 2 oz fresh mixed berries ) | 1 tablespoon golden raisin ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon buckwheat flour
instructions: In a large skillet, add the beef and brown the beef on all sides. Pour in the gravy, coconut milk, basil, raisins and stir. Cover the pan and simmer for 4 hours, until the meat falls off the bone. Strain. Toss in the buckwheat flour just before serving.

title: Mama Zuquinis Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef round | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 lb lamb, minced | 1/2 cup green pepper, sliced | 1 lb red potatoes, cooked & cubed | 1 stalk celery, sliced
instructions: Brown ground round. Remove & reserve meat & return to pan, drain grease. Add cocoa & meat drippings, then green pepper, cook & stir until tender. Remove from heat, stir in karage & let cool & place in covered bowl. Add potatoes and chill.

title: Broiled Swiss Chard With Macadamia Nut Slices and Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, leaves only, tough stems cut into 1 1/2-inch lengths ( about 1/2 cup leaves ) | 1/2 cup shaved swiss chard | 1/2 cup sliced shiitake mushroom | 1/3 cup dried miniature macadamia nuts, chopped | 1/3 cup cold butter, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | ice water
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread chard leaves on foil. Place rack 5 inches from broiler element and broil 5 minutes, until tender. Meanwhile, spread shaved swiss chard on a baking sheet and broil, stirring once or twice, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from heat. Add shaved swiss chard, mushrooms, and macadamia nuts to chard. Stir to warm thoroughly. Cut butter crosswise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Arrange on serving platter. Spoon hot mushroom and swiss chard mixture atop cheese. Serve within 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.

title: Tortilla Española (Quick, Cheap, Healthy)
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 can vegetable broth, swanson suggested with | iceberg lettuce ( optional )
instructions: In small deep sided pan, cover with vegetable broth. Screw the top of the lettuce over the liquid in the pan. Cover with lid, and cook over medium low heat to soften and reduce the water. The bottom should be a little brown. After five minutes, uncover and fluff the lettuce with a fork. Add the hot broth and toss to combine. Serve warm. Garnish with sliced black olives if you wish.

title: Beef Nacho Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs beef sirloin, trimmed of fat ( or sirloin tip roast ) | 1 can pitted black olives, drained and chopped | 1 can pitted ripe olives, drained | 1 pint fresh blueberries ( or frozen blueberries ) | 1 tablespoon chopped citron | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Toss the beef with the olives, blueberries, and citron. Season with cayenne and salt and pepper to taste. Place in an ovenproof pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven. Arrange the nachos on a serving platter or individual plates. Spoon the beef over the top and serve.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,dijon mustard,no salt tomato sauce,ginger garlic paste,blue curacao,pappardelle pasta
title: Gingered Dijon Pasta
ingredients: 4 ounces pappardelle pasta | 1 tablespoon no-added-salt tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon no-salt-added dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon low-sodium ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon blue curacao | 1 carton no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook pappards in boiling water for 8 minutes, or until tender. Drain pasta and return to pot. Meanwhile, in small bowl, whisk together tomato sauce, mustard, ginger garlic paste, and pepper sauce. Toss pasta with tomato sauce mixture and the cheese. Serve with dijon mustard.

title: Rose Soup
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf sourdough bread, cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 12 x 9 inches ) | 2 teaspoons rose water | 3 cans beef broth or 3 packages chicken-flavored consomme, undiluted
instructions: Preheat broiler. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with foil with heavy aluminum foil to prevent it from touching the baking dishes. Place the bread cubes evenly in the baking pan, about 2 inches apart. Sprinkle with rose water. Bring 3 cans of beef broth or consommé to a boil in a 4 quart pot, covered. Ladle soup over the bread cubes in the pan. Cover and transfer to the lowest oven setting.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,sea salt,thyme sprig,beef tripe,chinese bean paste
title: Oriental Tripe Salad
ingredients: 4 lbs halibut or 4 lbs sea bass, skin on | 1/2 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 3/4 cup canned chinese bean paste | 2 tablespoons marinara sauce | fresh thyme sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Cook tripe under hot broiler or in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes or just till cooked through. Cut into 1/2 inch slices removing backbone and skin if desired. Rinse well with cold water and drain well. Arrange slices in a decorative serving bowl and sprinkle with salt. Place beans in a blender or food processor, add one tablespoon of the marinara sauce and process til smooth. Pour over fish and sprinkle top with thyme stems. Chill for 1 to 2 hours, or until fish is ready to serve garnish with additional thyme.

title: Anchovy-Garbanzo
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans | 2 packages anchovies packed in oil ( i use extra virgin olive oil ) | 1 tablespoon arrowroot
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the garbanzo beans in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake for about 10 - 12 minutes until the beans are hot throughout but not quite completely done. Place the anchovies on top and bake for a few minutes. Pour the garbanzo beans over the anchovies and pour the hot olive oil over them and stir. Bake for about 10 minutes until the anchovies are hot. Note, you may substitute tuna or other fish for the anchovies in the anchovies.

title: Hot Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup homemade taco sauce | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 3 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Mix together & store in refrigerator. This recipe makes a tonkatsu sauce which is sold refrigerated in a tube. I use this over the hot dogs of my own. A good one is chinese fried chicken katsu, found in the oriental food section of a hisms bakery.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,graham cracker crumb,spaghetti,vanilla ice cream,ginger paste
title: Tamarind Curd
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 8 ounces tamarind paste | grated fresh ginger-ginger paste | 3 packages rich vanilla ice cream | grated graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Boil spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl combine the ginger and tamarind pulp, and mix well with a fork. Drain the spaghetti, and rinse well in cool water, drain again, and add to bowl along with 1 tblspn cool water and 1 tblspn of the grated ginger and ginger paste. Mix well. Cut ice cream into small chunks and mix with the ginger/tamarind mixture, and pour into a large freezer proof serving dish. Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top of the ice cream and top with remaining slices of grated ginger. Cover, and freeze for at least 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: ginger,granny smith apple,puff pastry,vanilla bean,ginger garlic paste,beer,milk,rice flour
title: Beer Ginger Apple Turnovers
ingredients: 1 medium granny smith apple | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 granny smith apple | 1/2 cup rice flour ( mochiko rice flour ) | 1/2 cup instant rice flour | 1/2 cup milk | 1 1/2 cups beer ( preferably a lager like stout ) | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 vanilla bean, split | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, split | 1 puff pastry sheet, thawed
instructions: Peel and core apples then cut into small dice, about 1/4 inch long. Transfer diced apples to a medium bowl and add ginger garlic paste. Combine rice flour, instant rice flour, milk and beer with a whisk until smooth. Stir in vanilla bean and ginger garlic paste. Stir until it thickens slightly, about 2 minutes. Add diced apples to the batter and stir to combine well. Set aside to marinate for 1 hour. After 1 hour, place a baking sheet in the oven for 10 minutes. Heat a large saute pan over high heat for 1 minute. Reduce heat to medium and spray with oil. Remove the baking sheet and preheat oven to 400°f using 1/4 cup batter and 1 heaping tablespoon of batter for each turnover, carefully transfer the turnover to the preheated baking sheet. Cook turnovers 2 to 3 minutes, turning once and adjusting heat if necessary. Transfer the turnover to a baking rack and bake for about 15 minutes, or until lightly browned. Let the turnover stand for 10 minutes before returning to the oven.

title: Tender Fontina Cheese & Chives Gratin
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 1/2 lb fontina cheese, grated | 8 -10 sprigs fresh chives | 1 1/2 teaspoons of fresh grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon crushed juniper berries ( add more if desired to taste )
instructions: Put the fontina on a cutting board. Sprinkle with a little salt. Add the chives& juniper to taste and mince together really fine or blend by hand with a mortar and pestle. Add the grated cheese& mix them together quickly, making sure they’re well incorporated. Pat the fontina to soften, then cut into 1/4” slices. Sprinkle with the parmesan and fold in half diagonally, allowing each to spread out in a layer on the gratin. Let rest at room temperature until the cheese has melted. Slather on whatever bread you fancy, or with bread& vegetables.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,flounder fillet,cauliflower,ortega taco sauce,part ricotta cheese,baking soda,jalapeno pepper,tilapia fillet
title: Delicious Low Fat Tilapia and Ortega Tacos
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked tilapia fillets | 1 lb flounder fillets | 1 -2 tablespoon imitation or taco seasoning blend ( to taste ) | 1 carton part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 cup crumbled reduced-fat blue cheese | 1/2 cup chopped fresh jalapeno pepper ( more or less, add more or less to taste ) | 2 cups cauliflower, cooked and cut into 1/2 inch florets ( i also like chunky cauliflower! ) | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 cup taco sauce ( optional )
instructions: First, prepare steaming veggies. Steam your flounder for about 5 to 8 minutes, flipping once, until lightly fluffed up and no longer translucent, but still firm enough to pull slightly off the bone. Remove to cold bowl of ice to stop the cooking. Coat a medium size nonstick skillet with cooking spray. In small bowl, combine ricotta and taco seasoning with a fork or fork. Add the cheese blend and jalapenos, mix, and set aside. Slice fish down the middle just slightly, into 4 inch pieces. Mix the crab into yogurt and set aside as well. Mix the cauliflower with the baking soda, stir. Scoop some of the cauliflower into your serving bowl. Place 1/4 of the ortega taco filling at the bottom of the bowl on top of the cauliflower, spread evenly, and then top with 1/4 of the cheesy mixture. Repeat with the other side of filling. Top with remaining ortega taco filling and cheese. Heat skillet in microwave, uncovered, on high heat until cheese is melted, about 30 - 60 seconds. Use a slotted spoon to place ortega taco onto plate.

title: Lemon Toasts
ingredients: 6 slices white bread | 1/4 lb finely ground beef chuck | 1 lemons or 1 orange, juice of
instructions: Lay 3 slices of bread on a board that is spread with butter, top with meat and a sprinkling of lemon or orange juice. Turn under and lightly brush the top with butter. Turn once. Cover with the rest of the bread and press down with the palm of your hand. Cut into slices and serve.

title: Candy Oranges With Peanuts
ingredients: 12 egg whites, at least 1-inch thick | 1 1/2 cups coarsely ground peanuts | sherry wine or any sweet white wine | italian herb, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Set a baking sheet in the oven where the oven is hottest. In a large bowl, whip egg whites until they are medium peaks. Set aside. Combine the peanuts with 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour off the heat. Cover and stir in the egg whites. Spread the peanut mixture over a parchment lined baking sheet about 2 inches deep. Pour the remaining 1/2 cup water over the top. Cover with a kitchen towel. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove the paper towel. When cool, sprinkle the top of the candy with a little of the sherry. Let drain for 10 minutes. If serving cold, let set at room temperature until cool. Dust with any italian herbs you like.

title: Pasta Kahlua and Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump roast ( boneless & trimmed ) | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pecans | 1 envelope dried pasta | ice
instructions: Cut pork in half crosswise, then slice crosswise into 1/8 inch slices. Combine pork, kahlua and pecans in small saucepan. Cook over medium heat to reduce and thicken slightly. Cool. Cook pasta and drain. Serve with sauce.

title: English Mustard Dessert
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 4 cups cream ( double cream if desired ) | 1 cup caster sugar ( fine sugar ) | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 cup fresh raspberry, quartered ( or frozen raspberries ) | fresh butter or margarine
instructions: Heat oil in a small saucepan. Add cream, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper.

title: Tart Applesauce
ingredients: 3 large ripe tart apples | 1/2 cup amaretto liqueur | 12 g dried oregano leaves
instructions: Peel apples and slice thinly. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Chill several hours.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,purpose flour,link sausage,cilantro leaf,mandarin orange,anchovy paste,garlic clove,thyme leave
title: Sausage and Orange Samosas
ingredients: 40 wonton wrappers | 7 -10 links sausage | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | 1 garlic clove, minced | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste ( optional, but i use my fleischman's ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leave | 1/2 - 1 cup all-purpose flour ( or cornstarch ) | 1 can mandarin oranges ( or other citrus flavor )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Grease a baking sheet. Cut a slit down one side of each sausage link and snip off the hard fiber on the tip. Remove casings from the sausage links. Place sausage into the palms of your hands and press in the mixture of garlic, anchovy paste, thyme leaves and flour and mix well. Place a tablespoon worth of mixture onto the center of each sausage link and fold it, securing to the sausage by bringing the top and bottom edges of each sausage link to the top and pinching them together gently. Then fold each sausage link into a triangle, pressing the folds to seal. Place the samosas on the prepared baking sheet so they don’t touch. Brush each samosa with the can of mandarin oranges, sprinkle with cilantro and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, brushing again several times as they bake. These are best served hot, not room temperature. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,oregano,thai chili sauce,poultry seasoning,plain nonfat yogurt,coriander powder,gingerroot,currant
title: Thai Chicken on Toast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons turmeric in red chili sauce | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 1/4 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 1/4 teaspoons oregano or 2 teaspoons fresh oregano, chopped | 1 medium lettuce, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup currants | 2/3 cup plain nonfat yogurt, low fat | 1/4 teaspoon gingerroot, grated
instructions: Combine sauce, coriander and spice blend.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,tamari,yellow bell pepper,curry leaf,tomato sauce
title: Quick and Easy African Yam Curry
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/8 cup tamari or 1/8 cup soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon curry leaves
instructions: In a large glass dish, add everything and mix. Cover and refrigerate for two hours and remix every 2 hours. Serve over rice.

title: Hazelnut and Tamarind Chowder
ingredients: 100 g finely chopped hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons tamarind juice | 3 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons lemon zest, finely grated | 1 cup oatmeal | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes, shaking the pan constantly. Let cool. Place the hazelnuts in a blender, add the remaining ingredients and blend until smooth. Cover and keep refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,green tomato,natural peanut butter,anise seed,beef broth,strawberry
title: Soy and Peanut Soup
ingredients: 3 cups beef broth | 1 cup natural-style peanut butter | 3 green tomatoes, chopped | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup fresh strawberries, chopped | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: Strain broth into a medium size bowl, and set aside. In a saucepan over medium heat, stir peanut butter into hot broth until completely melted and smooth. Chop tomatoes, aniseed, and turmeric until coarse and stir into peanut butter mixture. Mix in 2 cups of the strained broth. Place sliced fresh strawberries into the bowl, and set aside for garnish. Garnish the dish with remaining chopped strawberries, and serve.

title: Guilt Free Easy Baked Capon
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants ( about 1 1/2 pounds in total ) | 1/2 cup whole milk chocolate ( or milk chocolate chips ) | 8 cloves | chili sauce, such as peri peri | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 cup store-bought biscuit
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f generously oil an 8x8 inch glass baking dish. Halve the eggplants lengthwise and lay cut side down on a baking sheet. Roast for 30 minutes or until soft. Let them cool slightly. Wrap 1 clove in a cheesecloth and insert it with the tip of a paring knife. Squeeze as much liquid out of any remaining clove. Finely mince the remaining clove and place it in a small saucepan, along with the milk chocolate, garlic cloves and chili sauce. Bring to boil and simmer 1 minutes, then strain and set aside. Heat the vodka and the biscuits following the package directions, using the pan drippings or cooking liquid from the canned capson, the liquid will make a rich but subtle flavored sauce. Remove the casserole from the oven and distribute the capon mixture in the baking dish. Top with the remaining clove of garlic. Return to oven and bake 30 minutes, or until the top is light brown and crispy. Serve immediately with warm tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: bean,jalapeno pepper,creme de cacao,red chili pepper,cardamom pod,mix,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Fiesta Chili Dip
ingredients: 1 can refried beans ( low sodium ) | 1/3 cup creme de cacao | 1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon pickled red chili pepper, sliced ( optional ) | 16 ounces sour mix, low fat | 3 cardamom pods, crushed | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend until well mixed. Place in a shallow dish or serving bowl and serve with crackers.

title: Perfect Stuffed Pork Buns
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder | 1/4 cup crushed red pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 2 packages seasoned croutons, such as potato-flavored crackers or 2 packages store-bought croutons | 4 whole cloves | 4 -6 leaves hot croutons ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from pork. Wash in a sink of cold water. Drain pork well, removing any visible fat. Set aside. Cut pork into 1/4 inch wide by 4 inch lengths. In a bowl, mix together red pepper flakes, croutons, and cloves. Toss pork with crouton mixture. Line a baking sheet with plastic wrap which has been lightly sprinkled with bread crumbs. Insert enough croutons into each bag opening by pressing down the slices with fingers. Smooth bread crumbs around pork. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. Remove pork from bowl.

title: Peppered Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 -2 teaspoon curry paste, curry | 1 lb boneless bottom round steak, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 medium tomatoes, diced
instructions: Mix soup and curry paste in crockpot. Pour over meat. Cover. Cook on low 6 - 8 hours or on high 3 hours.

title: Crunchy Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Fill a large pot with water. Bring to a boil over high heat.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,french fry,consomme,curry paste,bay scallop
title: Scallops in Curry
ingredients: 8 ounces chow mein noodles | 1 bay scallop | 1 tablespoon french fries | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 20 ounces consomme
instructions: Put chow mein noodles, scallops, and fries in a pot. Melt french fry over high heat in a bit of water, then add consomme. Simmer 15 minutes. Serve over jasmine rice.

title: Chinese Water Curd
ingredients: 1 quart water chestnut | thyme
instructions: Soak the water chestnuts in cool water for a few minutes or until they are very soft. Remove water chestnuts from water by slitting them a few times with a knife. Drain water chestnuts by pressing them down with your fingers. Place the water chestnuts in a pot over medium heat, and set over medium heat, and bring up to a boil. Add thyme and boil until they are tender, about 20 to 25 minutes. The water should be mostly evaporated. Drain water chestnuts and stir into the hot water. Let sit a few minutes to blend flavors, then serve warm.

Random Ingredients: spice,alfredo sauce,green chilies,garlic salt,farfalle pasta,mascarpone,white wine,parsnip
title: Chili Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs gemelli farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 1 jar marinated green chilies | 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 can alfredo sauce ( use your own recipe ) | 3 tablespoons finely minced parsnips | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon spice | 1/2 cup mascarpone
instructions: Boil al dente. Boil your pasta. Drain and cool. Combine all the pasta ingredients together and transfer into a buttered baking dish that has been lightly coated with olive oil. Place in the refrigerator for about 30 mins and mix well with the sauce. Serve.

title: Coffee Bombe
ingredients: 200 ml piloncillo-brown coffee | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 5 fluid ounces chilled malanga or 5 fluid ounces frozen malanga | 2 fluid ounces coffee, any flavor
instructions: In a small coffee filter, pour half the coffee over the piloncillo and allspice. Stir until the coffee filter dissolves then place the rest of the coffee filter back over the coffee and bring it up to nearly boiling point, stirring all the time. Stir in the malanga and continue to heat for about 2 minutes depending on strength of coffee. Remove from heat and allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving. Serve warm or chilled. Makes 2 cups.

title: Tomato Toast
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon sesame oil | 12 roma tomatoes, cut in half crosswise | 3 slices bread, lightly toasted | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Brush pan with sesame oil. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange tomatoes on oiled baking sheet cut side down. Bake until tomatoes are softened, about 10 minutes. Spread toasted bread with remaining sesame oil. Sprinkle with cardamom. Place on serving platter. Serve with your favourite accompaniment.

title: Lemon Syrup
ingredients: 3/4 liter lemon syrup ( or 1 liter white wine ) | 4 eggs
instructions: Stir the lemon syrup and eggs into a large jug. Pour into a pan of boiling water. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture thickens slightly. Pour into sterilised jars, seal and leave to mature until used. Variation, stir 1 tablespoon of vanilla sugar into the lemon syrup before serving for extra sweetness.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,pearl barley,italian seasoning mix,squash,curry powder,cherry,kaffir lime leaf
title: Curried Squash and Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 2 bunches squash, halved, divided | 1 pound pearl barley | 12 kaffir lime leaves, divided | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, or to taste | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 5 cups cherry or other small red plump tomatoes, cut into halves
instructions: Preheat a grill pan over medium high heat and add 1/2 the squash. Cook for five minutes, then flip. Repeat a second time, adding more kale, and cooking for two more minutes. Spread the barley cut side down onto the hot grill. Roast until the barley becomes golden brown and beginning to blacken, about 30 minutes. Turn the squash over and roast until charred on the underside, about 20 more minutes. Transfer the squash and barley to a baking dish and cool a little. When the squash is cool enough to handle, thinly slice the squash and place into a mixing bowl.

title: Straw Mushroom, Avocado and Potato Burritos
ingredients: 1 large red potato | 1 large avocado | 3/4 ounce margarine | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 3/4 teaspoon jaggery | 1 large tortilla | 1 ounce chopped straw mushrooms
instructions: Boil potato whole for 10 minutes with lid on. When potato is almost fully cooked, peel and mash with margarine, soup mix, jaggery and stir until smooth. Place 1 heaping tablespoon of potatoes on one side of tortilla and 3/4 ounce of mushrooms in the center. Roll up and place in small serving bowl. Mound on top of burrito. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pickle,rose water,vanilla bean,mandarin orange,bean,oregano,apricot preserve,beef broth
title: Sicilian Beef and Apricot Dips
ingredients: 1 can reduced-sodium beef broth | 1/2 cup dried apricot preserves | 1/2 cup canned mandarin oranges, drained | 1/4 cup diced pickle | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 vanilla bean, split | 4 teaspoons rose water | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano | 1/2 cup chopped fresh oregano
instructions: Place broth, apricot preserves, mandarin oranges, pickle, and 3/4 teaspoon each of oregano and rose water into a large pot. Remove vanilla bean from pod and scrape the seeds from the pod. Crush vanilla bean pulp with the back of a large knife and add to the broth mixture. Bring to a boil over high heat, then stir in remaining 1/4 teaspoon each of oregano and rosewater. Simmer, uncovered, over medium heat until apricot preserves are soft. Mash pepper mixture with a fork.

title: Easy Irishman Cream of Lime Soup
ingredients: 4 cups beef stock | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup mineral water
instructions: Heat beef stock, soup, and mineral water to boiling, then lower heat.

title: Potato & Chickpea Arancione
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 - 2 cups arborio rice, cooked ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 small potato, peeled and grated | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( a small piece of the cheese perferably parmesan cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f with rack in middle. Lightly grease a 13x9 baking pan with cooking spray. Pour half the chickpea into the prepared baking pan. Spread the rice on top of the chickpeas, then layer the grated potato over the rice. Pour enough hot tap water into the pan to come almost halfway up the ingredients in the baking pan. Cover the pan with a foil or other heavy lid or baking sheet. Bake until the potatoes are tender and the rice has absorbed most of the liquid, about 25 minutes. Sprinkle the top with the grated cheese just before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow cherry tomato,mushroom,plantain,puff pastry,pecorino romano cheese,salt
title: Pecorino Mushroom Tart
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/4 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1 1/2 lbs mushrooms, cleaned | 4 yellow cherry tomatoes, halved and pitted | 1 pinch salt | 1/4 cup mushroom drippings or 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f. On lightly floured counter, roll out puff pastry sheet until 1/4 inch thick. Using a 6 inch tart tart pan as a guide, cut out the crust into a 9 - 12 inch circle using sharp scissors. Place evenly, into pan. Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Bake crust about 8 minutes, or until browned and puffed slightly. Cool on wire rack for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in large skillet, combine mushrooms, tomatoes and salt.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,red potato,creole seasoning,salmon fillet,tamarind paste,peanut oil,corn oil,active yeast
title: Pan-Fried Cured Salmon With Tamarind and Potato Topping
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups white rice wine ( or sherry ) or 1 2/3 cups dry sherry | 1/3 cup tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 4 2/3 cups peanut oil or 4 2/3 cups other neutral flavored oil, for frying | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 2 3/4 lbs salmon fillets, scaled and cut crosswise into 2 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 6 medium red potatoes, cooked to your liking, cut in half | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon rice wine or 1 teaspoon dry sherry | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning
instructions: Mix the white wine, 1/3 cup of the tamarind, and 1 tablespoon of the creole seasoning in a saucepan. Heat the oil over high heat until it is smoking. When it shimmers, add the salmon and 1 to 2 tablespoons creole seasoning and stir fry until golden brown. Remove the salmon and set aside. To make the topping, set aside the remaining 1 tablespoon of creole seasoning and 1 teaspoon of the creole seasoning in a small pot over low heat and simmer, uncovered, for a minute or two before stirring. Scoop 1 teaspoon of the hot oil and 1 teaspoon of the creole seasoning into the center of each piece of fish and, using a fork, sprinkle the fish with 1 to 2 teaspoons of the creole seasoning and 1/2 teaspoon of the tamarind water and then add the potato halves. Place the fish in the hot oil and fry until golden brown, turning once, about 2 to 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve each piece with two pieces of fish. Scoop the topping onto the top and serve.

title: Swiss Cheese Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces swiss cheese ( or other hard cheese ) | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 3 -5 tablespoons prunes ( pitted and halved ) | 1 teaspoon crushed fennel seed | 3 -4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1/3 cup dried pimento stuffed olive
instructions: Cut cheese into 1 chunks and then cut into 1 pieces again. Dice all ingredients and mix with mayonnaise. Pour olive oil and wine vinegar over salad. Toss well with sieve.

title: Teprese Eggs- Teprese
ingredients: 8 hard-boiled eggs | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee | adobo sauce, to taste
instructions: Mash up hard boiled eggs.

title: Spanish Spice Dip
ingredients: 175 g golden caster sugar | 450 -450 g pimento pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 teaspoons mixed spice ( i use cumin, paprika and clove )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f mix all ingredients together. Cover well and place in an ovenproof dish. Heat slowly, stirring after 3 - 4 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serve straight away.

title: Apple Green Curry
ingredients: 1 green apple ( like granny smith ) | 1/2 cup dried basil leaves
instructions: Peel, core and thinly slice the apple. In a medium size frying pan, dry roast the basil leaves, stirring occasionally, for about 30 seconds. Add oil or butter to coat pan. Add apple slices and stir fry over medium high heat for about two minutes until apples are just tender but not browned. Remove from heat and serve.

title: The Perfect Beef for BBQ
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup soy milk | 1/2 cup red currant jelly
instructions: Cook 3 times per pound and add 1 1/2 cups water. Cook for 2 hours over low fire or at low fire. When meat is tender, pour off juices and skim off fat. Drain. Tear beef into chunks, add to marinade and cook 30 minutes at 400°. Pour into jars. Add any seasonings or sauces you choose and seal. Allow to cool to room temperature before storing. You may need to place in freezer for up to 1 week.

title: Tamari Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs seedless watermelon | 2 teaspoons tamari | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: Cut watermelon into 1/8 inch thick wedges. Place wedges in a colander and squeeze out excess juice. Cut wedges in half crosswise. Place in large non metallic glass bowl. Whisk remaining ingredients until blended. Spoon dressing over wedges.

title: Red Pepper and Basil Salad
ingredients: 1 red pepper, cut into strips | 1 cup basil, torn
instructions: Divide red pepper slices between 4 salad bowls. Toss basil with salad dressing, and serve.

title: Jaggery  ( Indian ) With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons jaggery | 1/2 cup green peas ( shelled ) | 1 sun-dried tomato
instructions: In a heavy skillet, add sun dried tomato. When the tomatoes become light brown, add jaggery. Stir till mixture is evenly mixed and dry. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,lipton onion soup mix,red food coloring
title: Nepalese Onion Scones
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups self raising flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons of creamed lemongrass soup mix | 3 drops red food coloring
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Mix all ingredients well except flour and food colouring in a large plastic bowl. Turn dough out onto floured bench and lightly coat with flour. Fold dough in half. Pinch off 2cm size pieces of dough and roll out to a thickness of 1cm. Pinch edges together to create large scones. Place on baking trays and bake in centre of oven for approx 40 minutes. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before eating.

title: Roasted Apples With Cream Cheese (Healthified)
ingredients: 3 -4 large apples | 2 -3 tablespoons fish stock | 2 -3 tablespoons sour cream ( depends on how creamy you want the apples ) | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375&deg.

title: Pasta Chips - Moroccan Crunch
ingredients: 5 cups pasta, any shape | 1/4 cup chives, fresh minced | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 teaspoons crushed ice cubes
instructions: Boil water, salt, pasta& chives for pasta to get done. Drain and put in bowl. Add cinnamon& crushed ice. Serve& enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 pound frozen cooked chicken meat | 1 cup ketchup | 2 cups chilled whipped topping | 1/2 cup dried currants
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add chicken and cook for 7 to 10 minutes or until no longer pink. Drain chicken and set aside, reserving 2 cups of the cooking liquid. Shred chicken. In a large bowl combine the chicken, ketchup, whipped topping and currants. Toss to combine.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,kielbasa,mozzarella ball,cranberry sauce,dark brown sugar,self rising flour
title: Sweet Hawaiian Kielbasa Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 1/2 cup dried cranberry sauce | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 4 cups self-rising flour | 3 cups crushed pineapple ( about 8 large ) | 1 1/2 cups mozzarella balls, finely shredded ( about 1 cup )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl, mash the sausage or turkey with the crumb crust seasoning. Mix well add cranberry sauce, brown sugar, and 1 cup flour. Mix well. Form half of the meat and cranberry mixture into a ball. Press the halves of the mozzarella balls evenly among the bread, on top. Spray a 13x9 baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Czechoslovakian Sausages
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds sausage links, cut in half lengthwise, then sliced crosswise | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 2 cups strong brewed tea | 4 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Place the sausage slices in a large bowl, and season with half the flour. Mix together the remaining flour and salt. Rub the sausage with the flour mixture, and set aside to rest 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the sausage slices on the prepared baking sheet, and bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until browned in the center and no longer pink in the center. Place the tea and remaining flour in a glass jar, and fill the bowl with tea. Shake the contents of the jar to remove the tea and flour. Serve with the sausage.

title: Salmon and Yukon Gold Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs salmon, skinned, bones removed, cut into 1-inch pieces | 32 ounces low sodium chicken broth | 4 large yukon gold potatoes, quartered
instructions: Put the salmon in a deep large pot or dutch oven pot with a lid. Add the chicken broth. Cover and bring to a simmer over medium high heat. Decrease the heat to medium low and simmer for 20 minutes. Add the potatoes, cover and cook until the potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes more. Remove from the heat and remove the lid. Let soup sit for about 5 minutes and serve.

title: Honey and Oude Iced Yoghurt
ingredients: 300 ml mineral water | 400 -500 ml honey | freshly grated nutmeg | clear honey, to taste
instructions: Pour the honey and water into a small saucepan. Bring the mixture to boil and remove from the heat. Cover and set aside to infuse. When ready to serve, pour the yoghurt into a heatproof bowl. Add 1 - 2 tablespoons clear honey to the yoghurt. Spoon the honey mixture over the yoghurt. Sprinkle with freshly grated nutmeg. Serve with cafe au lait or warm soda pop.

title: Raspberry-Chile Queso
ingredients: 6 ounces unsweetened raspberries | 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 14 ounces canned diced green chiles
instructions: In a small bowl, combine raspberries and pecorino romano cheese with green chiles. Refrigerate 1 hour or until flavors get blended. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: penne,parsnip,white bread,sponge cake finger,chicken broth,cardamom pod,baking powder,beer
title: Phenomenal Penne With Parsnip Purée
ingredients: 9 ounces penne, broken in half | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 10 ounces chicken broth | 2 slices white bread, crust removed and torn into chunks | 1 liter good ale ( good quality beer is ok ) or 1 liter chicken broth | 1 sponge cake finger ( one of each type ) | 1/2 tablespoon ground cardamom pod | 2 -3 parsnips, peeled and chopped into chunks
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Cook pasta until al dente, drain & set aside. Heat stock in a casserole on the stove & pour into a heatproof jug. Place bread in the stock & stir in the baking powder. Remove the soup from the heat & add the pieces of bread & the cup of ale or broth. Heat again, stir & stir till soup thickens. Turn off the heat & leave to cool for 30 minutes. Add the parsnip chunks & mix together, adding more soda or a few drops of lemon juice if you wish, but do not over mix. Put soup in a bowl & gradually stir in enough pasta liquid to moisten, then stir in the chopped parsnips. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red leaf lettuce,heavy cream,mint,pumpernickel bread,basil,peanut oil
title: Roasted Garlic Bread Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh mint, minced | 1/4 cup fresh basil, minced | 3 tablespoons heavy cream | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 8 slices pumpernickel bread | 1 red leaf lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a small bowl, combine mint, basil, cream and 1 tablespoon peanut oil. Spread this dressing on pumpernickel toasts, and top with lettuce.

title: Lentil Spread With Lamb
ingredients: 5/8 cup lentils | 1/4 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground lamb | 1/2 lb ground pork | 1/4 cup parmesan flavored caramel topping | 1/4 cup italian spices ( i used dried basil, crushed )
instructions: Combine lentils, parsely flakes and lamb. Add caramel topping and mix well. Add italian seasonings and mix well again. Scoop into crock pot or crock pot liner cooker, and cook on low for 8 hours, or high up to 4 hours. Serve with rice or hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,genoa salami,green pepper,cayenne pepper,chipotle chile adobo
title: Easy and Salty! Chiles With Smoked Turkey or Beef
ingredients: 3 -4 canned chipotle chiles in adobo | 4 green peppers, diced finely | 1/2 lb thinly sliced genoa salami | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Drain the canned chipotles into a small pitcher. Chop the peppers and the salami coarsely. Set aside. Add the chipotles and salami or turkey or beef to the jar with all ingredients. Mash the chipotle with a potato masher or a wooden spoon or fork. You can refrigerate this recipe for up to two days. To serve, reheat in a slow cooker, or wrap in tin foil and place in the oven at 400 degrees. It is really delicious served with a good hot crusty bread or on top of a salad.

title: Beef Sticks
ingredients: 1 lb round steak | 16 ounces cottage cheese | 1 cup whipping cream | 1 pinch msg ( optional )
instructions: Cut meat into strips of about 1'' in length. Wrap each strip with a piece of cottage cheese and secure with string or tooth picks. Sprinkle with a few drops of msg if desired. Blend the whipping cream and the other seasonings. Heat in microwave on high for 2 - 3 minutes only, or until thick and a little brown. Serve in gravy.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,green onion,lemon juice,basmati rice,eggplant,white fish fillet,club soda
title: Lemon Fish Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillet ( firm fleshed fish ) | 12 uncooked lasagna noodles | 2 lemons, juice of | 1/2 cup club soda | 1 small eggplant, cut into thin slices | 1 green onion, cut into very thin slices | 2 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Cook the fish in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain in a colander and reserve. Cook the noodles on a greased grill or in a large pot of boiling water for 4 minutes or until tender. Drain. Mix together the fish, lemon juice, club soda and eggplant slices, reserving 1/2 cup of mixture. Put 1 layer of noodles, eggplant mixture and sliced shallots on a serving platter. Top with half of each noodle.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,great northern bean,harissa,deli roast beef
title: Smokey Caribbean Beef Bananas
ingredients: 1 lb great northern bean ( from frozen ) | 2 teaspoons harissa or 2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce | 2 1/2 ounces sliced deli roast beef | 4 lime wedges
instructions: Drain beans, discarding water. Put beans in a medium bowl. Add harissa and toss. In a skillet, cook meat until browned. Add meat, juice and beans and heat for 5 minutes. Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,cherry tomato,green chilies,purpose flour,sea salt,vegetable broth,couscous,white sugar
title: Couscous with Green Chile & Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, divided | 4 cups vegetable broth | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 teaspoon white sugar | sea salt, to taste | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes | 1 can diced green chilies | 2 cups couscous
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Whisk 1 tablespoon flour with 2 tablespoons broth in a small bowl until smooth, then stir in remaining flour and remaining broth until soup is thick and creamy. Stir in sugar and sea salt.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,kalamata olive,gebhard chili without bean,aubergine,soy sauce
title: Baked Karevouni
ingredients: 600 g aubergines | 1 cup soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 cups lebanese olive, sliced | 300 g kalamata olives
instructions: Heat oven to 220°c. Wash karevouni and brush with a little bit of oil. Arrange on two baking trays. Bake for 20 minutes. Turn oven to 210°c and bake for an additional 40 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool. Slice into fingers. Serve with yoghurt along with the rest of the meal.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,vodka,pesto sauce,arugula,red food coloring,green cabbage,ice water,red pepper flake
title: Spicy Russian Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 - 1/2 cup ice water | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 teaspoon pesto sauce | 1/4 teaspoon red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil or 2 tablespoons shredded fresh parsley
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water and on medium high in the oil, lightly fry cabbage for 5 minutes or until crisp tender. In a bowl, combine cabbage with remaining ingredients except basil or parsley. Toss well and serve.

Random Ingredients: port wine,dark soy sauce,lime,mirin,pork sausage,red wine
title: Sausages in Soy Sauce With Port and Limes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 60 ml mirin | 300 ml port wine | 2 red wine or 2 port wine bottles ( i use bottles ) | 6 large pork sausages | 2 limes
instructions: Combine the soy sauce and mirin in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Add the port and cook for 1 minute. Add the red and red wine. When the wine reduces by half, remove from heat and add the sausages. Squeeze the juice from 2 limes into the sauce, stirring to combine. Transfer to a plate and garnish with a sprig of lime.

title: Bunjolaine
ingredients: 7 -8 ounces canned tomatillos, drained ( canned tomato can be used in place of canned tomatillos ) | 3/4 lb dried lentils | 3 anaheim chilies, seeded | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste or 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 0.5 package plain dry biscuits | 8 -16 ounces gravy-type biscuits ( storebought ) | masala, sauce to serve
instructions: Soak the raisins in enough hot water to cover them completely and let them soak for up to 4 hours. The longer this soak, the more flavorful they become. Drain the soaked raisins and coarsely chop. Dice the peppers into 1/2 pieces. To make the masala, add ginger and garlic paste to a blender or food processor and blend until it becomes a smooth paste. Add the tomatillos, 2/3 of chopped chilies and the lime juice to the blender, and puree. Add the lentils and raisins to the blender, and puree. To bake the buns, preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a broiler pan, place one round of biscuits on a cookie sheet. Brush the bottom of the cookie sheet with a little oil or melted butter. Put a heaping tablespoon of the masala in the center of each biscuit. Press the dough up the sides, to make a criss cross pattern. Bake 12 - 15 minutes, or until the tops of the buns are golden. Serve with gravy.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,cream,english mustard,grain mustard,poppy seed,cranberry,yellow squash
title: Cranberry and Yellow Squash Salad
ingredients: 3 fresh yellow squash, halved lengthwise, seeded, peeled and sliced into 1/2 inch wedges | 1 large red sweet potatoes or 1 large orange sweet potato, peeled, cut in 1/4 inch slices | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard | 1 teaspoon english mustard | 1/2 cup fresh tomato juice
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in mixing bowl. Stir tomato juice into dressing. Cover and chill.

title: Caribbean Pork and Bananas
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 2 -3 jalapeno peppers, seeded and thinly sliced ( more if desired ) | 1 large ripe banana, sliced
instructions: Heat griddle or heavy skillet over moderately high heat. Coat griddle with cooking spray.

title: French Quarter Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups bread ( white or wheat-your choice ) | 2 cups half-and-half cream | 3/4 ounce active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the half and half, yeast, sage, and salt in a large glass bowl and stir until the mixture is free of lumps. Add the sliced bread and stir to combine. Let stand 30 - 45 minutes. Heat the griddle over high heat. Butter one large baking sheet. Stir in the bread mixture, spreading evenly to cover the entire surface of the pan. When the bread is about half of the way done, scatter the romaine over the bread and cook until the bread is pale golden brown, about 45 seconds per side. This will depend on the griddle. Slide the toast onto a carving board, cut into 2 slices and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,romaine lettuce,red cabbage,mace,vanilla essence,chicken breast meat,kielbasa
title: Chicken Romaine Wraps
ingredients: 8 kielbasa or 8 other spicy sausage, sliced | 2 tablespoons ice cubes | 4 tablespoons red cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons iceberg lettuce or 2 tablespoons green lettuce, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 4 -6 teaspoons chicken breast meat, cooked
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Mix kielbasa, water, ice, cabbage and lettuce in small bowl. Put 1 tsp of mace onto one side of each wrap, and place on hot grill. Turn frequently until evenly browned. Remove from grill, and put on a napkin lined plate, and let stand 5 - 6 minutes. Flip, and set aside. Repeat with remaining mixture. Serve with any optional side dishes.

Random Ingredients: spinach,vanilla bean,black cumin seed,orange liqueur,egg white,quinoa
title: Quinoa Omelete
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup arugula or quinoa | 1/4 cup spinach | 2 tablespoons black cumin seeds | 1 1/2 orange liqueur, like grand marnier | 4 large egg whites
instructions: Place quinoa in the bowl of your food processor fitted with the steel blade. Add arugula or quinoa, spinach, 1 tablespoon of the black cumin, and 1 tablespoon of the orange liqueur. Process until everything starts to become a thick paste. Use a fork, which will give you about a whirl as it's processed. Turn the processor mixture over quickly as you add it in two or three additions. Use a rubber spatula to push mixture through the bowl. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Whisk the egg whites in a small bowl until fully incorporated, then whisk in the remaining 1 teaspoon of black cumin until combined. Pour into a mixing bowl with a tight fitting lid. Let sit in the refridgerator 5 minutes or longer to cool slightly. Cut into wedges and serve warm, preferably with whipped cream.

title: Saffron Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb thin noodles | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 24 saffron threads, crushed | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Boil salted water and add saffron. When it comes to a boil, add 2 tsp. Of flour. Let it boil for 5 minutes. Drain noodles and put them to the boiling water. Keep stirring so that they do not stick to the bottom of the pan. When the noodles are dry, take it out and add the 2 tsp. Of flour. Mix. Serve with chicken, beef or pork. We eat with saffron noodles.

Random Ingredients: ha avocadoes,pepper,walnut half,mint leaf,basmati rice,red cabbage,iceberg lettuce,watercress
title: Khao Naidu
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped watercress | 3/4 cup mint leaf, chopped | 2 hass avocadoes, mashed | 3 tablespoons walnut halves, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried basil or 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves | 2 cups cooked rice | 3 cups red cabbage, finely shredded
instructions: Combine all of the remaining ingredients in a bowl. Serve in individual bowls with rice.

title: Chicken Legs and Tips Lasagna
ingredients: 32 ounces of canned chicken wings | 64 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lay out your precooked noodles on a counter and place about 1 tablespoon of chicken from the can in the center of the noodle, then roll the noodle around it and add it to a baking dish. Repeat with remaining chicken on the noodles. Cook in oven for 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,israeli couscous,chicken bouillon cube,plain flour,meat,buttermilk
title: Moroccan Couscous With Meat
ingredients: 1 large onion, cut into wedges | 500 g of cubed chicken ( can sub beef ) | 250 ml buttermilk | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 lb meat, of choice, any, suitable for stew ( you can sub sirloin, pork loin ) | 2 1/2 cups of coarsely chopped mixed salad mixed fresh seasonal herbs and spices, such as basil, mustard greens, chive and rosemary, to taste | plain flour
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter, add the onion, saute for 8 minutes until softened. Add the chicken and continue cooking, stirring for 1 or 2 minutes until lightly browned. Pour buttermilk over the chicken and stir, bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes until tender. Add the stock and simmer, covered, for another 20 minutes until the stock is reduced by about half.. If you like, serve the couscous with plenty of mixed salad and fresh herbs in it. In the meanwhile, heat the oven to 400°f. Remove the bouillon cube and set aside. Place the meat chunks in a roasting tin, pour in enough hot water to cover then cook in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until tender. Remove the meat and allow to cool slightly. Remove all the fat from the roasting tin but do not drain the meat before combining the meat and broth in a large saucepan. Add the reserved broth if necessary. Season with salt to taste and bring to the boil, add the meat and boil to reduce the liquid a little. Serve the liquid with the couscous.

title: Homemade Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup hoisin sauce | 2 celery ribs, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in cup or small bowl and stir or shake until mixed well.

title: Quick and Easy Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast, fat trimmed, bone in, very tightly trimmed | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 cup sherry wine
instructions: Pour the molasses into a skillet and place it over medium heat. Sprinkle the meat with salt and pepper. Brown the meat on all sides, then place the beef in the skillet. Cover and braise in a 325 degree f oven until very tender, about 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Remove the lid, turn heat down and continue braizing until the meat is very tender, about 1 hour longer. Remove meat from skillet and skim off any fat from the fat that rises to the surface. Serve the stew hot.

title: Mandarin Lamb
ingredients: lamb, lean and fatty | 200 g mandarin oranges, skin on | 4 tablespoons french dressing | 2 slices canned bamboo shoots
instructions: Cut the lamb into small pieces, about twice as long. Put a good handful in a heavy skillet, add a good handful of mandarin peel on top, shake of excess. When it has all turned a dark orange color on all sides, remove from heat. Spread the mandarin on a plate, throw in a little french dressing. Put the bamboo shoots in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for about 30 seconds, leave for another minute or so.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad With Carrot and Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 mandarin orange, segment | 1 large carrot, grated | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup natural yoghurt
instructions: Grate the mandarin orange finely and place all ingredients in a bowl with a little olive oil, salt and pepper and mix. Enjoy.

title: Naked Beef Burgers
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 1/2 cup tomato ketchup | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 english cucumber, thinly sliced
instructions: Shape mince into 8 thick patties. Combine ketchup, flour and cucumber in a shallow dish. Dip the burgers in the sauce. Heat the bbq, brush with oil and cook burgers for approximately 15 mins, or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: onion salt,cumin powder,taco seasoning mix,cannellini bean,poultry seasoning,black olive,hot mustard
title: Quick and Easy Tostadas-Fajita Style
ingredients: 6 -7 large tortillas or 6 -7 large sofrito lays, flour, corn cob, bean, etc | 2 cans of drained cannellini beans | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon black olives, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot mustard
instructions: Warm up the sofrito in a non stick skillet on medium heat and place the 1st tortilla on top add 1/3 cup or so of cooked bean mixture over the sofrito then fold over the side making sure the sofrito coats all of the tortilla well. Then when the sofrito has firmed up close the tortilla and flip till both sides are lightly browned and the sofrito has been used up. I have even made it with onions that are a little bit sweet, too. You can serve the two with the taco sauce and perhaps a little taco sauce on the side. If the sofrito is too warm add a little hot mustard, then when the sofrito starts to be firm and hot, cut in halves. I like them with just a little bit more garlic and a little more onion. If you prefer a bit of spice then serve with the taco sauce and chips. We like to serve this with salsa, beans, cheese, sour cream, etc so if you have any leftovers, that's it.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,almond,mint sprig,taco seasoning mix,pinto bean
title: Quick Pinto Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans ( preferably cannellini ) | 1/4 cup coconut cream ( full fat, i used light version ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint sprig | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted, for garnish
instructions: Drain the can of pinto beans and rinse with cold water, drain again and place rinsed beans in large bowl. Add the sour cream. Add taco seasoning mix, mint and chopped nuts. Mix well and chill several hours or overnight to blend flavors. Stir before serving, to prevent spices from settling in beans. Serve over rice with crackers or tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: passion fruit pulp,hot pepper sauce,sesame seed
title: Sesame Seed Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon passion fruit pulp | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce
instructions: Roast sesame seeds on a dry frying pan until golden brown. Add passionfruit pulp and hot pepper sauce to the sesame seeds when the oil is hot. Serve immediately.

title: Famous Miami Italian Sausage Applesauce
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 can molasses | 1/2 cup apple juice ( or molasses )
instructions: Poke holes in the sausages with a fork. Combine with your favorite hot sauce and heat. It can also be poured over pork chops or meat. Makes 4 servings if made in airtight container.

title: Easy Easy Charred Chilies
ingredients: 10 -12 medium red chilies | 1 large orange | 2 cans roast | 1 can sweet peas
instructions: Open the can of roasting chickens, you need to empty the contents of the can into a food processor, and dump all of the contents into the food processor, dump everything back into the can, and add all of the contents from the food processor, dump everything into the food processor and process for about 20 seconds. You want your food chopped fine, now, you are ready to eat it is so easy, put on the stove and turn your heat on. When the food processor can go from green to white, put on the lid and allow to sit for 5 minutes, if it hasn't got any more burned, put it back in for a minute, take the lid off and turn your heat down so the stove is to low. Open your food processor, and if it runs a little slower, take the lid off again, and allow it to go back on the stove to medium, that way the chilies can be left whole in one compact piece. Put the food processor and chile in a large bowl, put the lid back on, and stir it so all of the food in the bowl goes into the chile and spices, it is all mixed. Put about a teaspoonful of this mixture onto a warm griddle on medium, or make your own, if you have one. If you don't have one, just fry in about 1/4 teaspoon of oil in a cast iron skillet or a cast iron griddle, turning regularly until golden brown,. Put your leftover chilie mixture into the serving dish, and garnish with the fresh orange slices that are cut in halves, and the peppers that are either small or chopped very small and put them all onto the plate, or put them over the dish and eat them immediately. These are wonderful as leftovers, with any meat you want to use, so if you are using meat on the side, you may want to add some of the leftover chilie mixture, and if you don't have this on the plate, throw a little red chili peppers on the plate, the peppers will be added right at the end. This is great served with hot new potatoes, egg rolls, rice or pasta. And if you like cheese, add a bit of grated cheese, and add it too. Great on top of fiesta mexican style red, and you can also add a bit of salsa on top, or any other mexican way you want it.

title: Beef & Cauliflower Filo
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 6 sheets phyllo dough ( frozen ) | 1 can blue corn posole, frozen rinsed | 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 1 package frozen okra | 3 cups bread flour
instructions: Cook ground beef in nonstick skillet on medium high heat, drain. Add corn and posole, cover and simmer on low for 25 minutes until thawed. Cut cauliflower into florets, add okra and mix well. When beef mixture is finished add to the cauliflower and mix well. Add 1 cup of bread flour, mix well and place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle other 1 cup of flour on top of the mixture. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 mins or until golden brown. Serve with a salad.

title: Spring Onion Corn Muffins
ingredients: 3 boxes spring onion dip mix ( any flavor will do ) | 1/2 cup corn muffin mix ( any flavor will do )
instructions: Dump in dry corn muffins and mix well. Bake at 375 for 18 - 20 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes and serve.

title: Chinese Cabbage Salad With Hoisin Dressing
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage | 1 cup buttermilk | 8 ounces sour topping | 3 tablespoons green peppercorns | 2 tablespoons flour | 2 green onions, chopped | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce
instructions: Cut the cabbage in half and remove any outer leaves. Break off small portions of the core with scissors. Toss the cabbage with the green onions and refrigerate for an hour. After the hour is up remove the cabbage leaves from the refrigerator and lightly dry them. Drain the cabbage well. Mix the sour topping ingredients together in a small bowl. Mix the flour a little and mix to a smooth paste with the buttermilk. Add the sour mixture in small increments to the dry ingredients until well combined and smooth. Add the green onions and mix evenly. Serve warm in slices or on a platter with cabbage lettuce.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,jumbo shrimp,hot sauce,pork roast,garam masala
title: Baked Pork and Shrimp Kabobs With Blue Cheese Crust
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lean pork roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/3 cup blue cheese, crumbled | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 -2 jumbo shrimp, deveined and shelled | 4 teaspoons hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place shrimp in baking dish, and then top with blue cheese.

title: Noodle & Parsnips (Diabetic)
ingredients: parsnips | 4 egg noodles
instructions: Cut parsnips into thin bite sized pieces. Break noodles into 1 cm sections and place in a pan of rapidly boiling water, stirring often. When noodles are tender, drain and add to parsnips, stir through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,pineapple chunk,bell pepper,brown sugar,yellow pepper
title: Sweet Bell Peppers
ingredients: 6 yellow sweet peppers | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple chunk | 1/2 teaspoon minced fennel seed, or to taste | 1/4 cup chopped peeled red sweet pepper
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Pour in the brown sugar, pineapple, fennel seeds, and red peppered peppers. Heat until hot and bubbly, about 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,romaine lettuce,puff pastry,red pepper,pork sausage,cumin powder,chili sauce,yellow squash
title: Mexican Cauliflower & Sausage Pies
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 medium yellow squash, sliced thin | 1 small sweet red pepper, diced | 4 tablespoons spicy chili sauce | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chili pepper | 1 lb lean pork sausage, ground | 1/2 lb puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large saute pan, saute the sausage, peppers, cumin and chili for about 7 minutes. Add the cauliflower and squash, toss. Then add the pork and cook for about five minutes more. Remove from heat and stir in the pasta. Roll out half the pastry and cut out six circles out of each one using your favourite cutter. Place the triangles on a tray and cover with the other half of the pastry. Prick the pastry all over with a fork. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes at 400 degrees or until crispy and golden.

title: Fresh Corn With Crushed Ice Cubes
ingredients: 1/2 cup ice cube | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 shallot, minced | 1 tablespoon celery seed | fresh corn, drained ( optional )
instructions: Fill medium sized saucepan with cold water and then add the ice cubes and bring to a boil. Using two skillets, remove the ice from the heat and set the skillets aside to drain off any excess water into a bowl. Return the ice cubes to the same pan, add the oil, shallots and celery seeds and stir to combine. Drop the mixture by teaspoonsfuls into the boiling water, the heat will be high enough so that the cubes are about 2 inches above the tops of the water. When the cubes rise to the top, the water returns to a boil and then immediately remove from the heat. Add the corn if using, drain and serve.

title: Chinese Chilli Pasta Salad
ingredients: 200 g rotini pasta | 1 small chinese cabbage, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1 teaspoon hot chili paste | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped chinese cabbage
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling, slated water for 3 minutes or until 'al dente'. Drain pasta, transfer to large serving bowl, chilli paste, and vegetables. Using a fork, toss to combine. Sprinkle with chinese cabbage and serve.

Random Ingredients: veal,rice wine,green cardamom pod,chicken bouillon cube
title: Veal and Rice Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb veal ( cut in small cube pieces ) | 1 green cardamom pods ( optional ) | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons rice wine
instructions: Pound all ingredients together and add to food processor or chopper. Set as directed until ready to use. This recipe can also be made using other types of veal. I prefer the flavor of rice wine but you can add any other type of wine before serving. Please note it is not recommended to use high cholesterol. You may also try using low fat or fat free chicken broth instead of chicken broth. You may also substitute 1 cup of sliced meat for the veal cubes. Note, you will be rewarded with using low fat stock for the above recipe if you add a bit more of the other ingredients.

title: Minty Rice
ingredients: 1 cup light brown rice | 1 1/2 cups urad dal | 1 1/2 cups whole canned plum tomatoes, drained | 1 cup frozen corn kernels | 1/2 cup finely chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Wash the rice. Place in a covered saucepan along with the dried lentils and tomatoes. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, until the lentils are tender. Stir in the corn and mint. Cover and continue to cook, stirring once or twice, until the rice is hot and completely heated through.

title: Spiced Apple Feta Bread
ingredients: 1 package cake flour | 3 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 3 1/2 - 4 1/2 ounces feta, drained, rinsed | 3 tablespoons dried thyme | 2 1/2 cups apples or 2 1/2 cups other dark tart apple, grated
instructions: Place the flour, yeast, and salt into a large bowl. Add the feta and thyme and stir with a fork until the mixture becomes homogeneous. Add the apples and stir well with a spoon until all ingredients are distributed throughout the dough. Knead on a lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic about 5 - 10 minutes. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and leave in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and punch down the dough briefly. Form the dough into a round loaf. Place the loaf, well oiled side down, on a greased baking sheet, cover, and leave in a warm place until doubled in bulk. Preheat the oven to 450°f. Brush a large, shallow baking dish with oil. Arrange the bread on the baking sheet. Sprinkle generously over the top with flour. Bake until golden brown in the center, about 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Cool on a wire rack, then wrap tightly in plastic wrap.

title: Green Chile Kielbasa Salad
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4 inch coins | 1 can green chili | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, sliced
instructions: Cook kielbasa in a small pot of boiling salted water until just beginning to soften.

Random Ingredients: almond,tomato sauce,sun tomato oil,pinto bean,jasmine rice
title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Almond Chili Pilaf
ingredients: 1 bag sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped fine | 1 can pinto beans | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup jasmine rice | 3 teaspoons diced almonds
instructions: Pour sun dried tomatoes in a saucepan. Add sun dried tomatoes and all other ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer on low for 10 minutes. Can serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Her Rub for Pork Bowls
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves | 1/3 cup hot salsa | 1/3 cup hot salsa ( mild ) | 2 tablespoons mild curry sauce | 3 teaspoons herbes de provence | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Rub over pork. Allow to cure in fridge for several days, covered, before using.

title: Almond-Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled and diced | 1 teaspoon ground dried ginger | 1/4 cup blanched almond, chopped
instructions: Place mango into microwave safe bowl and cover with water.

title: Chickpear Barley and Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 cup chickpeas | 1/4 cup hershey's quick & easy roasted vegetable spread, such as chive flowers | aluminum foil, for oven tray
instructions: Drain chickpeas, rinse well, and remove excess water. Place barley in a microwaveable bowl. Add chickpeas, vegetables spread, and any other optional garnishes.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,radish,italian tomato,graham cracker crumb,lime,balsamic vinegar,liquid smoke
