title: Tomato-Grain-Free Dressing - for Sushi Party
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw hazelnuts | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/8 - 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon balsamic vinegar ( i use red ) | 4 large italian tomatoes, halved | 8 ounces radishes, sliced | 2 teaspoons lime ( juice and zest )
instructions: In a large bowl mix the raw hazelnuts, graham cracker crumbs, liquid smoke, balsamic vinegar, and tomatoes. Add the radishes to the bowl and toss well. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Macaroni
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 12 ounces salsa, mild | 10 ounces chicken broth
instructions: Cook macaroni in as directed on package. Rinse with cold water. Toss with salsa, chicken broth and simmer in microwave for 5minutes. Stir once.

title: Flaming Mango and Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced peach | 1/2 cup italian parsley, minced | 1/4 cup minced of fresh mint | 3 tablespoons minced fresh italian parsley | 1 can or bottle dark beer | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 1/2 cup watercress | 1 lb hot italian sausage or 1 lb hot italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: In a bowl, combine the peaches, parsley, mint, 1 tablespoon of the parsley and the italian parsley. Stir in the beer, capers and watercress. Toss just until evenly coated. This may be served cold or room temperature. Place sausage in a nonstick skillet. Cook over medium heat until brown. Remove sausage and drain fat. Add remaining parsley. Toss well until heated through, about 3 minutes. To serve, divide sausage and juices among 4 bowls. Drizzle with a little of the pan juices.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,yellow bell pepper,sun tomato oil,olive oil,cream tartar
title: Italian Seasoned Onion Dip - Paula Deen
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow bell peppers, thinly sliced | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup with roasted, peeled tomatoes & cream of tartar | 1 lb sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Stir fry the bell peppers in the olive oil, remove and drain off any excess oil. Add the soup into a medium baking dish and arrange the sliced tomatoes over it. In a small bowl mix together the cream of tartar, the cream of el menthe & the cream of celery. Pour over the onions & bell peppers in the baking dish and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Auntie Theresa's English Ham & Bacon Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb thickly sliced ham | 2 tablespoons salted roasted peanuts, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons dry mustard seeds
instructions: Remove ham from freezer and break into small pieces. In food processor, blend roasted peanuts and mustard seeds until combined well. Spread onto ham slices and refrigerate for about 2 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef base,parmesan cheese,grain rice,coconut cream,lemon peel,za'atar spice mix,ricotta cheese,cornstarch
title: Fairy Fritters (Gramma's Recipe)
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 teaspoon za'atar spice mix, or ( 1/2 tsps. ) | 1/4 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1/4 cup coconut cream | 2 -3 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1 tablespoon beef base
instructions: Combine ricotta cheese, cornstarch, parmasan cheese, za'atar, and lemon peel in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix until smooth. Using your hands, break the ricotta cheese into small chunks. Mix the coconut cream into the cheese mixture until blended. Using a spoon, lightly stir in the cooked rice until thoroughly coated. Scoop and drop the rice into the coconut cream mixture. Gently stir mixture until it forms a ball and transfer to a platter. Cover and refrigerate while preparing the remainder of the dish. Serve with a dollop of homemade, whole cashew or vanilla yogurt on the side.

title: Spanish Green Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds green olives | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and diced
instructions: Place the green olives into a covered salad bowl. Add the diced bell pepper. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 3 hours.

title: The Best Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 pound tri-colored spiral pasta | 1 pound dried tri-colored spirals sweet peppers | 32 fluid ounces bottled liquid smoke | 4 cloves garlic, chopped | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 2 tablespoons dried chopped thyme | 2 tablespoons dried curry leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for 13 to 17 minutes or until al dente.

title: Easy & Delicious Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken legs, skinned & amp, deboned ( approx 2 lbs total ) | 6 ounces cream of chicken soup ( about 2/4 cup thick, or sour cream if you prefer ) | sliced pimiento | 4 chicken thighs ( approx 2 lbs each ) | 1 jar sliced pimientos ( drain the liquid then place in a bowl and mash together till liquid has dissolved ) or ( 5 ounce ) jar red pimientos ( drain the liquid then place in a bowl & mash together till liquid has dissolved )
instructions: Place chicken legs, skin side down, on a cutting board and using meat tenderizing hammer, pound them a few times to remove as many bones as possible. Cut chicken into manageable chunks, cutting in quarters if needed. Mix soup with desired amount of liquid and pour the mixture inside the baking dish with the chicken. Bake in a 350 degrees f oven covered with a lid until a knife test, approximately 45 minutes. Remove chicken to platter and tent in foil. Add pimentos on top and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Cheesy Ginger and Pap Cookies
ingredients: 1 package gingersnap cookie, frozen | 2 cups ricotta cheese, well chilled
instructions: Put the frozen ginger in the refrigerator for 1 hour, or till defrosted. Take the paper cookies out and let it cool. Once the ginger has cooled, cut it smaller, if it's already smaller, so that it will break up into smaller pieces. Put one teaspoon of ricotta in the palm of your hand. Take about a teaspoon of the ginger and use it to scoop or roll it in the cracker crumbs. Put in a freezer bag. Repeat with the other teaspoon of ginger. Enjoy.

title: Cabbage Knead
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1/2 cup grated nutmeg | 1/2 cup grated napa cabbage ( shredded ) | 1/2 cup shredded cheese | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean ( scraped ) | 1 grated orange, zest of | 1 grated orange, zest of
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl. In a separate bowl, combine orange zest, milk cheese, vanilla bean and zest. Add to dry ingredients and mix until the dough forms a ball shape. Divide into about 16 pieces and roll each piece into an oval, approximately 1/2 inch thick. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour if refrigerated. Heat knead for 5 minutes over medium heat. Place one piece of dough on lightly greased baking sheet. Cover with towel and let it cool for 10 minutes. Remove dough from sheet. Roll out dough with rolling pin. Cover with towel again and let it cool for 1 minute more. With an oiled icing, frost dough with orange zest/orange zest/onion mixture and cut into squares and place in serving plates.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,prune,sea salt,soymilk,asparagus,green salsa,yellow mustard,chicken bouillon cube
title: Indian Lamb Stew With Asparagus #2
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless lamb shoulder | 8 ounces green salsa, medium | 4 medium asparagus | 32 ounces low-fat low-fat soymilk, low sugar | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 15 ounces green salsa, low sugar | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon yellow mustard ( or dijon )
instructions: Chop asparagus into 1 1/2” pieces and steam. Combine soy milk, crumbled bouillon cubes and 1 - ½ teaspoons sea salt and make sure there are no chunks of bouillon/salt. Dice lamb and place in crockpot. Add the soy milk, 2 cups of the green salsa, asparagus, and mustard and mix well with your hands. Pour this marinade over the lamb. Place in refrigerator and marinate in the fridge for a couple of hours. Drain off excess liquid and serve over rice. Note, i prefer green vs white salsa, so please adjust your salt. Note, for extra liquid you can either serve with a spoonful of salsa, or you can mix in fresh diced vegetables. A nice touch is to serve the stew with veggies.

title: Mock Chilie Chips
ingredients: 16 ounces corn tortilla chips | 1/3 cup dry sherry ( white )
instructions: Dip tortilla chips into sherry. Place in a single layer on serving platter and cover with sherry. Serve with cafe queso fresco or monterey jack cheese as accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,yellow onion,anaheim chilies,american cheese,lime,coconut rum
title: Coconut Rum Bananas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons distilled white or yellow onion | 2 tablespoons grated white american cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon coconut rum | 2 fresh anaheim chilies | 2 fresh limes
instructions: Combine the vinegar, onion, grated cheese, vanilla extract, coconut rum, anaheim chilies, and lime juice in a bowl of hot water. Remove and discard both seeds and stems from the peppers and cut in half lengthwise. Insert 2 slivers of cheese into each half and dip each half into the vinegar mixture. Marinate in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours or over night before serving.

title: Nabey's Easy Asian Style Steak
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Rub ginger and garlic paste on the outside of the steak. Place on a tray covered with cling wrap and leave in the refirgerator overnight. Remove steak from bag & slice into thin diagonal slices. Steam the lettuce for 5 - 10 minutes, depending on size. Serve with a crunchy relish or dip.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,cream mushroom soup,beef sausage,vanilla essence,apricot jam,sirloin,tamari
title: Beef Sausage & Onions with Apricot Surprise!
ingredients: 1/2 sirloin or 1/2 top sirloin, cut into thin slices | 150 g beef sausages, halved lenghtwise and cut in half | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/3 packet vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon tamari | 2 roma tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Drain the meat into a colander, removing as much excess fat as possible, and then toss the meat with the jam, soup, vanilla essence and tamari in a sauce pan, cover and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the meat is cooked and the flavours have blended. Stir through the tomatoes and serve on toast points.

title: Tarragon Arugula Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/3 cup chopped fresh tarragon leaves | 1/4 cup chopped arugula
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, salt, cardamom, and tarragon.

title: Pastry Alentejana(Venezuela Cheese Roll-Dusted Empanadas)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs unseasoned pastry ( use your favorite pastry recipe ) | 1/2 cup rice wine | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno | 4 -5 pinches red wine vinegar or 4 -5 pinches white wine vinegar | 3/4 lb finely shredded mexican queso queso or 3/4 lb other mild-sauce-like quesadilla cheese
instructions: Make cheese filling, in a bowl, combine the jalapeno, vinegar, and 1 tablespoon of the hot sauce.

title: Sausage and Asparagus Quinoa Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked quinoa | 1 lb sweet italian sausage, sliced | 1 can beef broth | 1 cup thinly sliced watermelon | 1 cup thinly sliced asparagus
instructions: Place quinoa in microwave safe bowl.

title: Xell's Tom Yum Sauce
ingredients: 750 ml chilled tomato juice | 2 cups frozen raspberries | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 12 tablespoons piri-piri, spice ( spice specifically )
instructions: Put everything in a large glass container. Cover with cling wrap and put in the fridge for 6 hours. Note, this can be done in advance but it is much easier to do when it's cool enough. Take out a few leaves and use for flavouring.

title: Lamb Kabobs or Tofu
ingredients: 2 pounds lamb stew meat, cubed | 1 tablespoon ground allspice | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Mix lamb meat through the allspice with rice vinegar. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. Thread onto skewers. Arrange on a foil lined broiler pan and grill over high coals about 15 minutes, turning often.

title: Italian Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach, in the washed | 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Wash your spinach leaves and place in a colander over a sink. Fill with cold water. Tie the leaves and 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme inside the leaves. Let sit 10 minutes. Wash well and squeeze out excess liquid. Drain thoroughly and place in a mixing bowl. Cover and let rest 15 minutes while you do the rest. To use, wash and drain your spinach. Cook according to the directions on your package. Assembling and serving, place several handfuls of spinach in a bowl, drizzle 2 teaspoon of the water from the bowl over it, and give it a stir. Pour about 1/2 teaspoon of thyme over the spinach and then top with remaining leaves, sprinkling each garnish with a little more of the mint.

title: Beef and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb beef, cubed | 2 tablespoons cracked black coffee | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 8 ounces green beans
instructions: Cook the beef and drain as much fat as possible. Mix beef with coffee and sprinkle with celery. Cook the green beans to preference add more sugar and mix. Serve with a hot, crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,mayonnaise,large shrimp,tomato green chilies,onion powder,spaghetti,ice
title: Spicy Shrimp Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 cups uncooked wide egg noodles | 1 jar tomatoes and green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 2/3 lb large shrimp, peeled & deveined | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water. In a large bowl, combine noodles, tomatoes, shrimp, mayonnaise, mixed spice and onion powder. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Matarangai Tamarind Chai
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon tamarind juice ( nam pla ) | 1 teaspoon tomato yum paste | 2 ounces conch, finely chopped | 2 ounces blueberries | fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Grind tamarind with a mortar & pestle to fine powder. Mix tomato yum paste with a spoon into small bowl & set aside. Combine conch with tamarind powder until just combined then stir into chai. Add blueberries & coriander leaves to chai, then serve with chapati or rice.

title: Korean Potato Chips
ingredients: 3 cups thinly sliced baking potatoes | 1 tablespoon minced yellow mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon white sugar ( optional )
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet sprayed with vegetable cooking spray, cook potato slices, stirring constantly, until potatoes have darkened in color, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove potatoes from skillet. Dry potato slices, dry with paper towels, and sprinkle with mustard seed. Sprinkle mixture with sugar if using.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper lengthwise,lemonade,pork butt shoulder,chunky salsa,fruit,white tequila,penne rigate
title: Tequila Pork Penne
ingredients: 2 pounds pork butt shoulder, cut into 2 inch strips | 2 jars chunky salsa | 1 can diced green chile peppers with liquid | 1 can fruit cocktail, drained and diced | 1 jar chunky salsa picante sauce | 2 tablespoons lemonade | 1 package dry penne rigate, cooked and drained
instructions: Put pork into a large pot and pour in the salsa, green chile peppers, and the cocktail dressing. Stir until well combined. Add the cooked pasta, and stir to mix. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours to overnight, stirring occasionally.

title: Aunty Frankel
ingredients: 1 cup wesson oil | 1.25 anise seeds
instructions: Heat oil over high heat until smoking hot, then add anise seeds. When they crackle, turn over, and fry for just a few seconds. Take the oil from the heat and pour over the aniseed. Serve hot.

title: Quinoa Tabbouleh (Veggie Quinoa)
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa, rinsed ( cracked wheat, 1 cup ) | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme ( chopped ( dried )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes, until vegetables are tender and water is absorbed.

title: Creamy Noodles Oriental
ingredients: 1 lb thin spaghetti | 12 ounces egg noodles | 12 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons coconut rum or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 12 tablespoons anise seeds ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente, in heavily salted water, drain, and set aside. In large bowl dump all ingredients except noodles. Mix noodles well. Refrigerate at least an hour. Serve over hot brown rice. Note, i like to make this with chicken breast.

title: Curried Beef & Lamb Shops
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed, cut into 2-inch-thick cubes ( or other lean stewing cuts ) | 10 ounces lean sauteed sirloin, cut into 2-inch-thick slices | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium curry paste | table cream, for serving
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add lamb and saute until well browned, about 8 minutes.

title: Sweet Soy Spareribs
ingredients: 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons korean chile powder ( gochujang ) | 1 package dried linguine
instructions: Heat a cast iron skillet or wok over high heat. Add sugar and chile powder. When the sugar mixture begins to bubble, add the ribs and toss to coat. Cook until the outside is glazed, about 5 minutes, then turn off the heat. Serve immediately.

title: Quick Creamy Rice for One
ingredients: 500 g arborio rice | 1/2 pint cream | 2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Warm the cream using a little water, and add to another bowl. Pour over rice with oil. Season to taste.

title: Souvlaki (Vegan)
ingredients: 1/4 cup wheat bread flour | 1/4 cup minced leek | 1 tablespoon tomato juice | salt and pepper
instructions: Place the wheat bread flour, leek and tomato juice into a bowl. Mix with a fork until the mixture resembles a smooth paste. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add about 2 tablespoons of water if it seems too dry. Heat a griddle and brush with some cooking oil. Place the bread flour mixture in the griddle. Leave it to cook for 1 - 2 minutes or until golden brown on top. Serve with steamed vegetables or pita chips as an accompaniment, or drizzle with a little olive oil flavored oil.

title: Ditalini Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons olive, drained | 1 1/4 cups whole milk | 1/4 cup ditalini, cooked | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 cup walnut halves, sliced
instructions: Toss herbs with milk, salt, and pepper in large bowl. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Add cooked pasta and walnuts to milk mixture. Toss gently. Transfer to serving platter.

title: Roast Corned Beef
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, trimmed of excess fat | 1/2 - 3/4 lb ground lean pork | 1/2 - 1 cup blackberry ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f. Line 2 large roasting pans with parchment paper and place roasting pan over medium heat. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Sprinkle pork over beef. Brown meat well on all sides and add blackberries. Cover roasting pan and bake in oven for about 1 hour. Remove from oven and allow it to rest for 20 - 30 minutes. Cut down on temperature to maintain a moist roasting. Slice up and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,vegetable broth,pear,american cheese,savoy cabbage,leg lamb,ricotta cheese
title: Lamb, Cheese and Pear Pie for a Shepherds Pie
ingredients: 4 slices leg of lamb, roughly 2 ounces each, with bone and skin left on | 2 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 ounces fat-back peas ( or 2 ounces frozen peas and 1 tablespoon of chopped prawns, thawed if using fresh or thawed peas ) | 4 ounces american cheese, grated | 1/2 small green capsicum, finely chopped ( capsicum ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons grated savoy cabbage
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 400°f. Line the base and side of a baking dish or tin with baking paper and season it with salt. Place lamb in dish. Combine ricotta and peas in a bowl. Using a mandolin, cut a slice from the edge of the slab of lamb to form a lid for the cheese filling. Using a small sharp knife, spread 1½� tablespoons of filling over half the lamb. Cover with half the cheese mixture and then with the remaining lamb and cheese. Dot with remaining cheese and decorate with the paprika. Pour on the broth. Put on the lid. Bake in oven for 35 - 45 mins or until the lamb is cooked and the ricotta and peas are bubbling. Serve with roasted green herb salad.

title: Pineapple Ham and Chili
ingredients: 4 -5 anaheim chili, stemmed | 1 quart reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1 bottle unsweetened pineapple juice ( i use the amber ) | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 6 precooked ham slices ( thick slices, or sliced in half )
instructions: Char the chilis over gas flame, rotating them frequently until blackened but not burnt, about 10 to 12 minutes. Place the chilis on a kitchen towel and rub the skins off, keeping them intact. Place the chilis in a large saucepan with the chicken broth and pineapple juice. Scrape in the sugar and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes, until the meat is falling off of the bone. Remove the saucepan from heat. Slice the ham slices into 1/4 inch wide slices. Remove the seeds and the tough outer skin from each chili and place them in a serving bowl using a slotted spoon. Pour the remaining sauce over the ham slices and serve at once.

title: Jamaican Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 package sirloin tip roast | 2 cans bean sprouts, drained | 2 teaspoons ground cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place roast into a slow cooker and add the bean sprouts and their juice. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper, allspice, and mace. Cover, and cook on high for 2 to 4 hours.

title: Easy No Fat Soy Cream (Fat-Free)
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups low-fat soymilk or 1 1/3 cups plain soymilk ( 787 ml ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening or 3 tablespoons butter
instructions: Using a handheld electric mixer with a metal ring, beat the soy milk or plain soy milk with 2 tablespoon measuring spoon in 3 - 4 to 6 - 3 minutes until frothy. Using a pastry brush or large spatula, lightly brush the shortening or butter over the edge of the bowl of a chilled bowl, then spoon in enough of the soy milk soaking liquid with a back of a spoon to produce 2 cups total soaking fluid. Refrigerate 30 minutes while preparing the cream.

Random Ingredients: lamb,lime wedge,sirloin steak,turbinado sugar,basmati rice,white onion
title: Cambodian Beef, Lettuce, & Red Onions on Rice(Bibingkene Satay)
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs sirloin steaks, trimmed | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar | 6 small white onions, cut into wedges, rings | 12 small limes, juice of | 3 cups cooked basmati rice ( jasmine is best ) | 8 -12 toothpicks, to hold wraps together
instructions: Make the marinade, in a small bowl, combine the sugar, onions, and lime juice. Pip the beef into the marinade, turning to coat and shaking off excess. Place the beef in a shallow dish, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside at least 20 minutes, turning once. Preheat broiler and position the rack to the lowest possible position. Thread the beef onto the skewers and place on an ovenproof platter or baking sheet, making sure all the skewers are covered. Broil the beef for 3 - 4 minutes per side, until nicely charred and cooked to your liking. Transfer the skewers to a clean platter and serve immediately with the red onion sauce. To serve, place a toothpick in each bowl. Spoon some of the red onion sauce over the top and serve.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,bean,fish sauce,grain white rice,vegetable,papaya,lime,carnaroli rice
title: Rice Soup With Fish - Vegetarian
ingredients: 1 cup carnaroli rice or 1 cup arborio rice | 1 liter vegetable stock | 1/2 cup carnaroli fish sauce | 200 g mixed vegetables | 500 g bean slices | 200 g mixed beans | 2/3 cup long-grain white rice | 1/2 grated lime | 1 -2 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/2 cup fried papayas or 1 -2 cup fried chives
instructions: Place fish sauce in a microwave safe bowl with 3 cups of water and heat on high for 30 seconds. Add rice and stir well. Add vegetable stock and stir well. Cover the bowl and cook on high for 20 minutes. Add mixed vegetables and stir to combine until the vegetable mixture starts to soften, 3 minutes. Stir in the rice and cooked fish sauce, cover and cook on high for 3 minutes. Remove from the microwave and let sit, covered, 5 minutes before serving. Stir, taste and add fish sauce if required and serve while hot. Sprinkle coconut and paprika over the top if using.

Random Ingredients: chicken,brandy,cooking spray,monterey jack cheddar cheese,clove,red pepper flake,rigatoni pasta
title: Raggle Di Pollo With Chicken and Cheddar
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rigatoni pasta or cans rotini pasta | 2 cups grated monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 3 small roasted chicken | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | cooking spray
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Reserve 1/4 cup of pasta water. Drain pasta. Add remaining ingredients to pasta in the order listed and toss to coat. Spray 8 x 8 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Pour pasta mixture into the prepared baking dish. Cover tightly and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,mozzarella cheese,chili oil,coriander,orange juice concentrate,saffron thread
title: Saffron Lentils in Yogurt (Moroccan)
ingredients: 10 ounces brown lentils ( arabic ) | 2 teaspoons saffron threads | 2 tablespoons orange juice concentrate | 6 ounces soft low-fat mozzarella cheese, cubed | 2 tablespoons chopped coriander | 2 pinches saffron threads
instructions: Place lentils in a large saucepan and cover with 2 inches of water. Add saffron and orange juice concentrate and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover pan, reduce heat to low and cook until tender, about 1 hour. Season to taste with salt and pepper, and set aside. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine mozzarella, coriander and 1 pinches of saffron. Roll lentils one at a time into cheese mixture. Place balls on a tray. Bake at 400°f for 15 - 20 minutes until hot.

title: Zucchini with Beef (Hoy Marnie)
ingredients: 4 slices zucchini | 1/2 cup green olives, pitted | 1/4 cup chopped fresh edible herbs ( marjoram, oregano, basil, savory or fi ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place zucchini and olives in baking dish. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,coconut milk,baguette,oatmeal,beef chuck,rotel tomato,nacho cheese soup
title: Cinderella's Mexican Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck or 3 lbs round roast | 3 cans rotel tomatoes | 1 can condensed nacho cheese soup | 2 -3 teaspoons chili powder | 24 ounces coconut milk | 1 loaf crusty baguette, sliced in 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 - 1 cup oat meal
instructions: Pour can of diced tomatoes over crockpot and stir to mix with rest of ingredients. Add beef chuck and stir. Cook until meat is tender. Put beef chuck in baguette and pour some of the sauce over meat. Put baguette into crockpot and cover with rest of sauce. Cook on high for about a half hour. Serve over hot cooked rice or at room temperature and garnish with oatmeal.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,cream chicken soup,vegetable shortening,romaine lettuce,iceberg lettuce,hamburger,purpose flour
title: American Hamburger-Cocktail #1, #1FIX
ingredients: 1 bag shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 lb hamburger | 1 package original hburger rolls or 1 package hamburger bun | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 cup teriyaki sauce | 4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 6 cups shredded romaine lettuce, divided | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening
instructions: In large skillet over medium heat, brown hamburger, hamburger bun and hburger mixture. Drain. Make hamburger mix as directed on pkg., combine soup, teriyaki sauce and flour.

title: Feta Flavoured Noodle Soup
ingredients: 600 g mf reduced fat chicken bouillon | 200 g tomato paste | 200 g macaroni noodles | 100 g feta cheese | 1 pinch ground allspice | 100 g smoked salmon, diced
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large pot. Bring to the boil and simmer for an hour. Remove the salmon and flake. Return to the heat for a further 5 - 10 minutes. Ladle into hot sterilized ramekin dishes and enjoy.

title: Brown Rice Low Fat Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 1 large cucumber
instructions: Chop the white of the cucumber very fine. Cut the cucumber into pieces 1/4 inch thick. Place the rice in a salad bowl and sprinkle with the brown rice. Add the cucumber pieces. Serve immediately.

title: Rosemary Ricotta Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 lb ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Mix the ricotta, flour, and rosemary together in a bowl. Place about 2 tablespoons of mixture onto each floured floured potato peel. Roll and stretch the floured potato to 1/4 inch thick. Carefully place fritters onto a plate lined with a plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Heat a griddle or griddle pan over medium heat. Cook fritters, turning frequently, until crisped and lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a serving plate and serve with your favorite chutney.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,sauce,crescent dinner,chicken bouillon powder,beef chuck,italian bread
title: Beef Hot Chocolate Empanadas
ingredients: 1 cup mild sauce | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 1 1/2 cups cooked beef chuck, minced | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 package pre-sliced crescent dinner rolls, thawed | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. In heavy large skillet, blend hot sauce, beef, cocoa, and 2 t. Chicken bouillon powder until smooth. Unroll dough and separate into triangles. Place, triangles on ungreased baking sheet. Brush with 1 t. Hot sauce mixture. Bake 5 - 8 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chinese noodle,kosher salt,serrano chile pepper,pesto sauce,black bean
title: Asian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chinese noodles, preferably the short-grain ( chinese vermicelli ) | 1 can black beans, drained | 2 serrano chile peppers, chopped and seeded | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Place the noodles into a large bowl, pour in enough water to cover them completely. Let them soak overnight or until they are tender but not mushy, but not quite falling apart. Drain well. Combine the noodles and beans in the bowl with the pesto. Add the serrano chile. If your pesto is tart, add more to your taste. Stir to mix, taste, and adjust seasoning.

title: Taco Seasoning Corn Cookies - Copycat Recipe #RSC
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 can cornstarch roux | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl or container. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Mexican Beef Tip
ingredients: 1 bag frozen mexicorn ( i used frozen ) | 1/2 cup sugar-free syrup | 1/2 cup steak sauce | 1 dash cardamom seed, crushed | 1 dash steak sauce ( optional )
instructions: Empty bag of frozen mexicorn into a small frying pan. Add sugar free and steak sauce, cardamom, and steak sauce. Heat on medium high until it begins to boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium. Let cook for about 8 - 10 minutes, until slightly thickened.

title: Plum Tomato Dressing  (French Canadian)
ingredients: 4 large plum tomatoes | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped dried bread ( preferably french ) | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/3 cup apple cider
instructions: Core tomatoes, and cut crosswise into ½ inch slices. Place tomatoes, pecans, parsley, and bread in a food processor, and pulse several times until mixture resembles breadcrumbs, about 30 seconds. Drizzle wine, apple cider, and 1/3 cup water around tomato and bread, and process until mixture forms a paste, about 1 minute. Store remaining dressing in refrigerator up to 8 days.

title: Italian Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 4 ounces fontina cheese, shredded ( about 2 cups ) | 1 tablespoon italian dressing
instructions: In bowl, combine yogurt, cheese and dressing. Stir well. Cover & chill until ready to serve.

title: Island Pesto With Pork
ingredients: 2 cups fresh basil pesto ( or 1 cup prepared basil and 1/2 cup prepared basil ) | 5 tablespoons island dressing | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rubbed sage | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried minced onions ( or 2 large fresh onions, cut into quarters ) | 2 lbs boneless pork roast, trimmed
instructions: In food processor or blender, combine all ingredients except pork. Process until finely chopped. Cover and let stand 30 minutes. Spread the pork on a rack in foil lined roasting pan. Bake, uncovered in a 350°f oven 45 minutes, until well browned on top and meat thermometer registers 160°f. Remove and let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Butternut and Bean Burgers
ingredients: 200 g pinto beans | 200 g butternut squash | 1/2 cup yellow split peas | 500 g hamburgers
instructions: Soak the squash in warm water for 10 minutes. Drain well. Slice the squash into chunks and mash. Fry the hamburgers by heating the bottom of a heavy pan on the stove. When they are crispy brown and cooked through sprinkle with paprika.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,romaine lettuce,garam masala,cream cheese,chicken breast
title: Smooth Ranch Dip
ingredients: 4 beef ribs | 3 tablespoons cream cheese | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 cups romaine lettuce | 2 chicken breasts ( cooked and shredded )
instructions: Cut rind from 2 chicken breasts, then shred. Combine cream cheese, garam masala, and shredded chicken. Add meat to cream cheese mixture. Simmer on low for approximately 4 minutes. Serve over tortilla chips.

title: Thai Broccoli Sprout Salad
ingredients: 4 cups fresh broccoli, washed and cleaned | 2 teaspoons sugar | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Cut the heads off the broccoli stalks and steam them for 2 minutes. Cool them thoroughly. Put the broccoli in a bowl and season with salt and sugar. Add sugar, fish sauce and a dash of vanille. Mix and add the sour cream. Taste and adjust the sugar by if you like it sweeter add more of the 1/2 to 1 tablespoon of sugar, but not too much that it actually tastes like sugar. Let it sit for several hours to set fully. Eat it fresh or let it cool. Enjoy.

title: Ouzo With Channell Dosas  (Pelmen)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ouzo | 3 cups channa dal, cleaned | 2/3 cup cornmeal
instructions: Wash and soak the channell dal for 30 minutes. Drain the liquid from the channell dal. Heat oil in a wok. Mix in ouzo. Boil until thick. Stir to coat the grains, add cornmeal. Boil gently until thick. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Serve with sambhar powder.

Random Ingredients: ice water,white bread,turmeric,sunflower oil,angel hair pasta
title: Angel Hair Pasta With Turmeric and Coconut
ingredients: 350 g good quality white bread | 500 g angel hair pasta ( or your favorite pasta ) | 100 g sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 3 tablespoons ice water
instructions: Toast the bread in a dry frying pan until it starts to change colour and turns a golden crust. Take it out and squeeze out excess moisture. Cut the bread in small cubes and dry fry them in a little hot oil on all sides, turning constantly with tongs or kitchen paper. Cook the pasta in boiling, salted water for ten minutes, following instructions. Meanwhile pour the turmeric into a little hot oil in a pan and heat over medium heat. When it starts to darken, pour in the ice water and stir for 15 seconds or until you can feel the turmeric dissolving. Add the bread to the pan and toss to coat through the turmeric. Add the pasta and toss until it absorbs all the flavours. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,roast beef,sherry wine,veal beef pork,red onion,masa harina flour
title: Porcupine Tacos
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina flour | 1/4 pound veal, ground, meat removed | 1/4 pound roast beef, ground meat removed, meat removed | 1/4 pound sweet onions or 1/4 pound red onions, cut into 1-inch slices | 1/3 cup dry sherry wine | sea scallops or crab meat of your choice
instructions: Sift the masa harina into a large bowl. Make a well in the center of the dry masa harina with the meat and the onions. Add the sherry, a small handful of sea scallops or crab or fish of your choice, and mix well. Gradually add the dry sherry until all the dry ingredients are incorporated into the dough. Shape the dough into 8 balls. Roll out the balls in your hands into taco size oblongs. Heat one inch of vegetable oil in a large cast iron skillet over medium heat. Add the taco meat or beef, and cook until browned, about 6 minutes. Lift out of the pan with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and serve with your favorite taco fixings.

Random Ingredients: lardons,vodka,miracle whip,shortening,chicken broth,caraway seed,bacon dripping,vegetable oil
title: Finnish Vodka Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces bacon drippings, divided | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons lardons, finely chopped | 6 ounces chicken broth | 3 ounces vodka | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 6 ounces miracle whip | 2 cups flour
instructions: Heat the bacon drippings and 1 tablespoon oil in a saucepan. Sprinkle in the lardons and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes, until crisp. Strain out all but 2 T butter and fat from the saucepan. Raise the heat to high, add the remaining oil and lardons and cook for 5 more minutes. Lower the heat to medium and stir in the vodka and cook 2 more minutes, until thickened. Stir in the chicken broth and cook for a further 5 minutes, until heated through. Spoon the hot noodles into a large casserole dish. Stir miracle whip into the sauce, stir to combine, then fold in the flour until thoroughly combined. Spread sauce over the noodles, then bake in a preheated oven at 375°f for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Greek Halvasia
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups semolina flour | 4 1/2 teaspoons seasoning
instructions: Place 5 1/2 cups of semolina flour into a large bowl. Make a well in the middle. In a large bowl, stir together the remaining 7 1/2 cups of semolina flour and seasonings. Gradually stir in 5 1/2 cups water until dough is the right consistency to roll out. Knead on floured surface until dough is smooth and elastic. Lightly dust work surface with flour leaving dough free of any fallen dough. Cover with a large, clean cloth. Let rest 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 450 degrees and lightly oil baking sheets. Form dough into walnut size balls and carefully remove the center. Using floured hands, push and roll balls to about 1/4 inch thick. Place on prepared baking sheets and brush with about 1/2 teaspoon vegetable oil. Bake 12 - 14 minutes or until lightly browned and puffed.

title: Tho Ruung Kapusta (Potatoes and Cream Cheese)
ingredients: 250 g pumpkin, diced | 150 g cauliflower floret | 150 g red capsicums, diced | 2 tablespoons kkhoya milk | 20 g cream cheese | 1/2 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Microwave on high for 5 mins then microwave for 3 mins or 10 mins on high, stirring every now and then to prevent burning.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,button mushroom,quinoa,green tea powder,cream celery soup,italian parsley,saltine cracker,ice water
title: Italian Potato & Vege Soup
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes, scrubbed and quartered ( about 3 lbs ) | 8 ounces fresh button mushrooms, quartered | 1 can cream of celery soup | 8 -10 cups ice water | 3/4 cup quinoa, soaked according to package directions | 2 -3 tablespoons green tea powder ( to taste ) | saltine crackers, for serving | chopped fresh italian parsley, for serving, if desired | additional italian parsley, if desired
instructions: To a 4 quart slow cooker insert the potatoes and mushrooms. Add soup, water and squash seeds and the green tea powder. Season lightly with salt. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours. If soup is too thin, stir in water. Remove cover and cook for 20 minutes longer. Turn off cooker. If soup is too thick, stir in a little water. Serve sprinkled with seasonings and crackers.

title: Grilled Hawaiians
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces pineapple slices | 1/2 fluid ounce whiskey | 2 tablespoons cotija cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: On grates of your choice, cut a cone shaped hole in the top of the pineapple about 5 inches long. Reserve any hollowed out cone. Soak the cone in warm water for about 30 minutes. Heat the grill. Place the pineapple on a foil lined grill grate directly over the heat. Grill the cone about 10 minutes or until warm. Brush each with whiskey, sprinkle with cotija cheese, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,chinkiang vinegar,coriander,spanish onion,shiitake mushroom,hot red chili pepper,bitter
title: Mushroom Vindaloo (Spicy Hot Vindaloo)
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh shiitake mushroom, finely chopped ( red or white ) | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons bitter | 3 cups chinkiang vinegar ( or vietnamese vinegar ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 6 -12 hot red chili peppers, chopped ( or to taste )
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, coarsely chop the mushroom and combine with the onion and bitter. Place all the other ingredients in a blender, and blend to a paste. Pour into a bowl and stir in the vinegar. Cover and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: green bean,salt,chicken stock vegetable,spice,pasta,red currant jelly,self raising flour,spinach
title: Spinach and Green Bean Scrolls
ingredients: 225 g dried pasta ( small tube-shaped rice-shaped pasta ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 300 g green beans, trimmed and cut into 3cm lengths | 150 g fresh spinach, cleaned, washed and dried | 2 1/2 teaspoons red currant jelly | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Cook the pasta in boiling water for 10 seconds to al dente. Meanwhile, place beans in a saucepan with 2 1/2 cups boiling water. Bring the water to the boil, cover the pan and cook for 3 - 5 minutes or until just tender. While beans are cooking, place spinach, jelly and stock in a saucepan over low heat. Stir to combine. Add salt and mixed spice and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes or until liquid is reduced by half. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Add the cooked pasta and mix well. Divide pasta between 2 - 2 3cm deep baking trays, pressing down lightly to level. Make a well in the centre of the base and pour in the bean mixture, then spread evenly.

title: Green Chile Dip (Sour Cream Dipping Sauce with Chile Peppers)
ingredients: 4 cups sour cream ( can use low fat sour cream, low fat cottage cheese or a mixture ) | 5 tablespoons green chili peppers | 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped | 1 tablespoon dill, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon peanut oil ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon grenadine
instructions: In a bowl, mix sour cream and 1/4 cup green chile peppers. Stir in cilantro, dill, chili powder, oil and grenadine. Cover and chill for 2 hours.

title: Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 5 sheets dried rice noodles | 1 kg pork spareribs | 1 3/4 liters of homemade sour cream | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 -3 cm fresh thyme sprigs | club soda, to serve
instructions: Soak rice noodles in water to cover until soft. Heat oven to 120c/fan 180c/gas slice lean pork into 2 - 3 cm pieces. Soak in cool water for 1 - 2 hours. Drain and pat dry with towel. Heat 1 litre of water to boiling in a large ovenproof bowl. Add the rice noodles and turn into large roasting tin. Stir to combine, then add the pork, sour cream and tamari. Season well and cover. Transfer to oven, turning once for 40 minutes or until pork is cooked. Remove meat from the oven and leave to stand for 5 minutes before serving. To serve, top with thyme and serve with soda, if using.

Random Ingredients: pickling cucumber,brown lentil,olive oil cooking spray,white wine,mirin,blueberry,anchovy fillet
title: Lentil and Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 400 g pickling cucumbers | 400 g blueberries ( mixed salad leaves ) | 1 teaspoon anchovy fillet, rinsed, minced | 45 ml white wine | 45 ml mirin | 85 ml olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1/2 cup brown lentils
instructions: Cook green & white lentils in 5 cups boiling water for 15 minutes. Rinse under running water, drain. Meanwhile, spray olive oil spray from skillet with cooking spray over medium heat. When hot, add anchovy, and sauté for 1 minute. Add garlic, sauté for 1 more minute, and then add white wine, turn down to simmer while preparing salad. Combine lentils and red wine in a bowl. Add dressing to salad and stir. Add lentils, toss and serve.

title: German Fruit Bread (For a Crowd)
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | 10 ounces seedless sour apples, peeled and diced | 1/4 cup dried cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Combine the apples and dried cranberries with a little water and a touch of salt and allow to soak for about 20 minutes. Slice the bread up into chunks and place them in a big serving bowl. Add the sour apple mixture and toss with a fork to combine well. Serve immediately. May be served warm or at room temperature.

title: Rice and Broccoli Pilp
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rigatoni pasta or 1 cup other short-grain rice | 1 package frozen diced broccoli, thawed and drained ( 3 cups ) | 2 teaspoons prepared english mustard | 1 cup freshly made arborio rice
instructions: In skillet, cover rice with 1 inch of hot salted water.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,canadian bacon,lamb shoulder,baby corn,fish sauce,honeydew melon
title: Chinese New Year Breakfast
ingredients: 1 package honeydew melon, peeled and thinly sliced | 5 slices canadian bacon, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni | 4 small honeydew melon | 2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Cut 1 slice of melon in half and remove stone and all white inner flesh from the fruit. Place melon on a cutting board. Remove the membrane and white membrane from the melon with the melon. Cut away as much of the white flesh as possible and slice into 1 inch chunks. Set aside. Place honeydew melon slices on wax paper to prevent drying by getting all of the water out. Let stand about 20 minutes. Slice melon on the bias into 1/4 inch slices. Place each slice of melon on a slice of bacon. Place a tablespoon of pepperoni in the middle of the melon. Close with a slice of melon and a tablespoon of bacon on top of the pepperoni and bacon. Close with a slice of lamb or beef. Place on a platter and serve.

title: Nuclear Nite Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce ( i use homemade and it works great too! ) | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder ( optional..will not be as spicy )
instructions: Open can of enchilada sauce and put on paper towel to dry out while you are cooking the remainder. Mix peanut butter and lemon juice in blender with the coriander. Add the jar of sauce to blender and mix until the peanut butter has completely mixed into the other ingredients. Add to a bowl, or use a funnel for stirring in the sauce. Keep at room temp until serving time.

Random Ingredients: mango powder,black tea,potato starch,peanut butter,vanilla custard powder,cream,ghee
title: Sweet Potato Cupcakes
ingredients: 125 g cream | 500 g sweet potatoes starch | 600 ml warm milk or 600 ml hot tea | 200 ml vanilla custard powder | 100 g ghee | 200 ml mango powder | 125 g peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c or 190c. Beat the sour cream with a mixer until soft peaks form. Add the vanilla custard powder and ghee and beat until smooth. Mix the sweet potato starch with the warm milk or the hot tea until smooth. Pour this mixture into the bowl with the sour cream mixture and mix well. Pour the mixture into 12 prepared 12 cupcake moulds or pat into a 10 cupcake tin. Bake in the middle of the oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the cakes start to turn a little golden around the edges. Allow to cool before filling with mango cream.

Random Ingredients: wheat couscous,cumin powder,lemon juice zest,raspberry,ginger garlic paste,oatmeal,banana,milk ricotta cheese
title: Lemon Rice Loach
ingredients: 1/2 cup wholemeal couscous | 1/2 cup wheat couscous | 1 cup whole milk ricotta cheese, cut up | 1/3 cup raspberries ( to taste ) or 1/3 cup currants ( to taste ) | 1 small lemon, juice and zest of | 1 small fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons oatmeal
instructions: Rinse your rice and couscous until water goes clear. Let sit aside for a minute or two to absorb any excess water. In a bowl mix ricotta, raspberries, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste and oats in a little water until combined. In a separate bowl mix your rice, couscous and lemon zest. Add milk mixture and toss to combine. Set aside to sit at room temperature for 1 hour to absorb the juices and flavor. Serve with whipped salad and fresh fruit if preferred.

Random Ingredients: black tea,salt black pepper,kernel corn,curry powder,lemon juice zest
title: Curried Corn and Tea
ingredients: 6 ears fresh sweet corn, rinsed and cleaned | 1/2 cup hot black tea | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon curry powder | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to boil over high heat in a large bowl, add the corn and remove from the heat. Cover and let stand until it has softened, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a separate large bowl, combine the tea, lemon juice and zest, curry and salt and pepper. Cut the corncobs from the cob using a sharp knife, discarding the stems, and cut the kernels from the cob into bite sized chunks. When the corn is cool enough to handle, cut it crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Add them to the tea along with any juices. Mix well. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,plain nonfat yogurt,lamb shank
title: Spiced Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 5 green cardamom pods, split | 4 lbs lamb shanks | plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Toast the cardamom seeds in a dry, heavy frying pan over high heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Sprinkle the lamb shanks with a little salt and place into a heavy 3 1/2 quart saucepan. Fill the pan with enough water to cover the shanks and add the cardamom seeds. Cover and bring to a rapid simmer over moderately high heat. Reduce the heat to moderately low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender. Skim any fat from the surface. Turn off the heat and let the shanks stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Drain and skim off any fat that rises to the surface. Transfer the lamb to a warm serving plate and keep warm in a low oven. Skim fat from the surface.

title: Peppered Chicken and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 4 chicken thighs and 1 chicken breast | 1 medium rutabaga, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 4 -6 baby carrots, cut into 3/4 inch slices | 3 whole cloves | 1 teaspoon whole peppercorn | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Brown chicken for a few minutes on each side. Add the vegetables and cook, stirring constantly, until the chicken is beginning to brown. Add the cayenne and the whole peppercorns to the skillet and reduce heat to medium. Simmer for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the chicken is tender. Serve over rice.

title: Spaghetti Powder
ingredients: 3 tablespoons anise seed | 1/2 cup spaghetti noodles, broken into thirds
instructions: In a small skillet over medium heat, heat the anise seeds until fragrant, about 15 seconds. Remove the pan from heat, and sprinkle the anise seeds into the hot sauce. Cook the spaghetti in the hot sauce until tender, but still firm, about 4 minutes. Stir spaghetti strands with their cooking water into the noodle mixture.

title: Muesli With Beer
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat, cracked into 3 x 1 inch diagonal slices ( burghul wheat can be substituted ) | 2 cups dark beer, like belgian wit beer | 1 orange peel, cut into small cubes | muesli
instructions: Cook rice as per directions for instructions on pack. Drain and rinse wheat with cold water. Coat with beer. Top with orange peel. If desired garnish with muesli.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,chicken bouillon granule,arborio rice,onion powder,feta cheese basil tomato,tomato sauce
title: Tomato Rice and Feta - Microwave
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups uncooked arborio rice or 2 1/4 cups other short-grain rice, rinsed well and drained | 1/2 cup low-fat feta cheese with garlic and herbs, crumbled ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 2 -3 fresh kaffir lime leaves, finely cut crosswise | 1/2 cup tomato sauce or 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1 pinches onion powder
instructions: Combine rice and cheese, then sprinkle with bouillon and lime leaves. Microwave on high, stirring constantly for 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Hot and Spicy Mango Salsa
ingredients: 2 mango salsa | 4 tablespoons hot sauce | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup yellow onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup sweetened condensed milk salsa | 2 paper thin slices of unopened paper
instructions: In saucepan, combine all ingredients. Heat until warm. Arrange paper slices in 4 individual serving bowls. Spoon hot mango salsa among slices. Serve with additional salsa.

title: Crock Pot Guacamole (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 hass avocado, mashed | 1 cup fresh broccoli florets | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | roasted broccoli floret
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 1/2 quart crock pot and cook on high for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,apple,rosemary,turmeric,sun tomato oil,lime juice,rice wine vinegar
title: Turkish Apple Salad
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups apples, chopped | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 3 tablespoons orange juice concentrate ( frozen or canned ) | 1/2 tablespoon fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Combine apples, sun dried tomatoes, orange juice concentrate, rosemary, lime juice, sun dried tomato oil, turmeric. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,tomato green chilies,white sugar,chicken stock cube,lipton onion soup mix,artichoke heart
title: Bourekakia (Artichoke-Veggie-Dip)
ingredients: 250 g lasagna pastry ( plain to make it work ) | 125 g artichoke hearts, sliced ( can use tinned ) | 2 packets lipton onion soup mix | 2 cans white sugar ( the packets i usually use organic ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 150 g green olives and tomato and chilies, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oven to 200 celsius. Take the baking sheet you were going to use and place it right onto the bottom and place the phyllo sheets into a large bowl using a rolling pin. Dip each sheet in the water before assembling each one. Layer 4 sheets directly on top of each other making sure not to stack them and not tearing them. Once all 8 sheets have been layered place your whole pot of ingredients into the preheated oven & preheat for 1 hour. While the base is baking, put the olive garlic sauce into a bowl with 1 - 2 tbsp water. Whisk the olive cream sauce well to combine then pour over the base layer of pastry. When the base and bottom have been baking for 1 hour, remove the tin of artichokes & carefully slice through the base layer. Add 1 tbsp more water & mix together. Add 2 more tbsp water and mix together. Remove the phyllo sheets from the oven & brush generously with the olive cream sauce. Sprinkle the black olives for a nice finish if you like. Cut in half horizontally & serve immediately or keep in the fridge for later.

title: Grilled Ginger and Prunes
ingredients: 2 pounds prunes | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 2 1/2 inches piece fresh ginger root, peeled and grated
instructions: Trim and de pit the prunes, then cut in half lengthwise. Place them into a medium bowl and cover with cold water. This will help loosen the skins. Cover with plastic wrap, and place in the refrigerator. Soak prunes 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate. Soak prunes in water for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove prunes from water and place on the prepared grill. Baste with fish sauce and oyster sauce every few minutes. Cook prunes 5 minutes after they begin to soften. Continue cooking prunes until tender, about 10 minutes. Cooking time will vary depending on the thickness of the prunes. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f. An instant read thermometer inserted in the center should read at least 165 degrees f.

title: Quick and Easy English Pea-Mustard Breakfast Kebabs - Low Fat
ingredients: 1 cup plain low fat soymilk or 1 cup lactose-free soymilk | 1/4 cup apple juice or 1/4 cup apple cider | 1 1/2 teaspoons apple-flavoured instant yellow mustard | 1 teaspoon vital wheat gluten | 1 1/4 cups yellow split peas
instructions: Put the soymilk and cider in a bowl and stir in the mustard powder and gluten. Slowly fold in the peas. Scrap into a bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm but still slightly runny. Heat a non stick frypan. Scoop out some of the pea mixture with a tablespoon and carefully slide onto the hot pan. Cook over medium heat until almost crisp on the edges, about 1 - 2 minutes, then turn and cook for a few seconds more. Serve with bread and butter or honey mustard.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,salt black pepper,pepper
title: Marinated Dijon Salt
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | salt & freshly ground black pepper | pepper, freshly ground
instructions: Combine the olive oil, salt, and pepper. If needed, add 1/2 tablespoon at a time until the desired consistency is achieved.. Serve, or store in an air tight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: blueberry,club soda,green bell pepper,plain flour,beef marrow,grand marnier,lettuce leaf,salmon fillet
title: Blueberry and Salmon Rolls
ingredients: 1 kg beef boneless marrow, rind and sinew removed | 500 g green bell peppers, deseeded and finely chopped | 500 g plain flour, sieved | 300 ml club soda ( approximately ) | 300 ml freshly squeezed double cream or 300 ml heavy cream | 300 ml shredded lettuce leaves | 300 g salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Cut the marrow into 4 thick slices and cut each slice into three equal portions. Combine grated cheese, flour and club soda in a bowl and stir until well combined. Add the cream gradually until mixture forms a dough that pulls away from the sides of the bowl, just enough so that the ball does not overbake and becomes easier to roll out. Roll out on a lightly floured work surface to about 1cm thick. Cut a 5cm round out of the pastry and roll out the round again to about 2cm thick. Repeat these steps, placing a few ramekins under the pastry. Spoon 1 heaped tablespoon of the cheese mixture into the centre of the round and brush the top and sides with the grand marnier. Roll out the remaining dough lengthways to about 1cm thick. Bring the edge of the pastry over onto a work surface, and pinch the top of the pastry to seal, then cut around the edges to seal again. Repeat this process using the rest of the rounds and place 2 rounds on top. Brush the tops with the remaining grand marnier. Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas mark 4 and cook for 45 - 50 minutes or until the pastry is golden and springy when gently pressed with your finger tips. Serve with a seasonal salad and the blueberry or other vegetables of your choice..

title: Quick and Easy Parsnip Chips
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, sliced | 1/4 cup pitted kalamata olive
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Bake the parsnip in their own oven until just tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the olive oil. Add the parsnips and toss until coated. Spread the parsnips on a serving platter and sprinkle with the olives.

title: Cassic Chicken & Mango Pasta
ingredients: 400 g chicken | 100 ml tea | 250 g rigatoni pasta | 3 tablespoons dark molasses | mango chutney, for garnishing
instructions: Cut chicken in 2 3cm lengths and place in a large casserole dish. In a jug, stir the tea with a fork to dissolve the sugar. Pour over the chicken and turn into a single layer. Add the pasta, mango chutney and enough hot water to cover the chicken. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook over a low heat for 15 - 20 minutes or until the pasta is tender. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside, stirring to ensure it does not dry out. Serve with your favourite salad or bread.

Random Ingredients: hot water,beef tenderloin steak,mayonnaise,panko breadcrumb,cashew half
title: Korean Beef Kebabs II
ingredients: 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup cashew halves, chopped | 2 pounds beef tenderloin steaks, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup hot water
instructions: Combine panko bread crumbs and mayonnaise in a large bowl. Stir in cashews. Set aside. Place the beef in a large resealable plastic bag. Pour hot water in bag.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,kalamata olive,mirin,oregano leaf,cream mushroom soup,yellow pepper,spring onion,kahlua
title: Tasty Kahlua Onion and Pepper Hash Browns
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 5 medium yellow peppers, halved and deseeded | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup mirin | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, cut in half, seeded and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f and lightly spray an ovenproof dish with oil. Heat a frying pan over a medium heat and brown the peppers for 2 minutes, then remove and place in a paper bag to cool and remove the skins. Remove and discard the seeds from the peppers if desired. Cook the peppers in a non stick frying pan over a medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring the peppers to ensure they do not burn. Remove and place in a bowl. Add the oregano leaves, kahlua, soup, mirin and olives to the vegetables and mix well. Place the onion and pepper mixture in the prepared ovenproof dish, season to taste and mix well. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes, or until the topping is golden and bubbling and the hashbrowns are cooked through, but still very moist. Serve immediately.

title: Green Chile Mince & Cucumber Fritters
ingredients: 300 g minced veal | 1 green chilies, finely chopped | 1 medium cucumber, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons baking soda
instructions: Place in a colander & rinse under cold water until all liquid is drained. Press mixture to remove as much water as possible. Leave to drain well. Place into bowl. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Dont over mix. Leave to stand for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: nut,rump steak,yukon gold potato,wheat flour,oyster,italian breadcrumb,apricot
title: Dried Beef, Potato Stuffing and Apricots
ingredients: 1/2 lb rump steak, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons yukon gold potatoes, finely chopped | 125 g apricots, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons dried italian breadcrumbs, dry | 1/2 cup light wheat flour | 2 tablespoons mixed nuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon wheat flour
instructions: In a large bowl, combine meat, potatoes, apricots, breadcrumbs and 2 1/2 tablespoons water. Season with salt and pepper and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Preheat oven to 350f gas mark dust flour, nuts and wheat flour on your bench. Roll mixture into balls. Place on a baking sheet. Press into crumpets with hands. Bake in oven for 40 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Hot Sushi
ingredients: 2 sheets nori | 1 jalapeno chili, seeded, diced fine | 1/2 cup cognac ( very dark )
instructions: Spread jalapeno chilli on the nori slices, leaving about a half inch of flesh on each slice. Sprinkle cinamon on top of chilli. Roll up the nori using a damp towel, placing the sushi in a sushi rolling mat or glass. Flip the roll over several times until the cinamon is covered in the nori. Drizzle approximately 2 tablespoons of cognac over the sushi. Roll the sushi over so the chilli is all around the edge of the nori. Roll the sushi up in your hands or roll your fingers around the sushi.

title: Raspberry Frambois
ingredients: 6 ounces raspberry preserves | 1 teaspoon soda water ( or liquid )
instructions: Fill tall glass with ice. Pour raspberry preserves into glass. Pour soda water over preserves into glass. Stir. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white wine,cumin powder,cauliflower,thai fish sauce,stock cube,walnut oil,golden syrup,tomato paste
title: Baked Cauliflower with Thai Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1 cauliflower | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon tomato paste ( can ) | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 -2 stock cube ( if needed ) | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: Grease a small ovenproof dish with butter, olive oil and coconut. Core and boil the cauliflower in salted water for about 20 minutes or until it is florets sized,. Drain thoroughly and leave to cool. Place the walnut oil and cumin in a mortar and pestle and smash to a powder then gradually add the tomato paste, fish sauce and white wine to the crushed ingredients and whisk together. Add the remaining ingredients. Place the cauliflower in a baking dish and pour the sauce over it bake in oven, for about 30 - 45 minutes until the cauliflower is golden.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,cream cottage cheese,tarragon,poppy seed,currant,butter,grain white rice
title: Wild Rice & Dried Fruit Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups cream-style cottage cheese | 1 cup long grain white rice | 6 tablespoons butter, softened | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1/4 cup chopped dried currants | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped chocolate
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine cottage cheese, rice, butter, tarragon and poppy seeds. Stir in currants and chocolate.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,coriander leaf,sazon goya,pomegranate seed,serrano pepper,spaghetti,oatmeal
title: Moroccan Spiced Noodle Salad With Pomegranate Seeds
ingredients: 250 g rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 4 -5 tablespoons oatmeal | 4 3 -5 tablespoons pomegranate seeds or 4 3 -5 tablespoons sunflower seeds, lightly roasted | 1 teaspoon ground coriander leaves | 1/4 - 1/2 serrano pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon sazon goya | 12 ounces spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Cook the pasta according to pack instructions until al dente, it should be still relatively firm to the bite. When cooked, drain, and rinse well in cold water. Mix the oatmeal, pomegranate seeds, coriander, serrano pepper, and sazon. To serve, place a mound of cooked pasta on large serving plate, then ladle a generous amount of the pistou sauce along the top. Top it with the spiced noodles and drizzle more pomegranate and pomegranate sauce on top, for a nice presentation. Variations, substitute romano.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,dashi stock,phyllo pastry,mozzarella cheese,thyme,cooking onion,chili oil,tamari
title: Steak Samosas
ingredients: 600 g sirloin steaks | cooking onion | 1/4 cup tamari | 3 tablespoons dashi stock | 500 g mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 6 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Slice steak diagonally into 8 thin slices. Peel onion, slice into rings, set aside. Combine tamari, stock in pan with onion, bring to boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Pour over steak and simmer for a further 5 minutes, or until cooked through. Meanwhile, prepare cheese slice. To do this, use the back of a fork to spread all over the slices. Drain steak and allow to cool. Preheat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Lay half the cheese slices on a work surface, layer with half of the steak, cover with half of the onion rings and then top with the rest of the cheese. Douse with tamari sauce. Roll up phyllo pastry to enclose filling, and place on lightly floured baking tray. Repeat with remaining pastry, onions and cheese to make 18 rolls. Bake in oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove and cool slightly before cutting into small squares.

title: Green Beans With Nutmeg
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/2 cup basil pesto
instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Add the green beans, cover, and reduce the heat. Simmer the beans until cooked, about 10 minutes. Drain the green beans and reserve some cooking water. When cool enough to handle, cut them into bite sized pieces. In a small bowl, mix the baking powder, and freshly grated nutmeg together. Set aside. Toss the beans with enough of the reserved cooking water to lightly coat. Add in the pesto. Spoon enough into a baking dish to coat all of them. Bake in a 350° oven until browned, 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 2 cans cream-style corn | 1 can or bottle light beer
instructions: Drain the corn and light beer in a large pitcher or punch bowl. Stir in the corn blend with a wooden spoon. Serve immediately, with crackers for dipping.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,goat cheese,sage leaf,catsup,prawn,plain yogurt,cream tartar
title: Goat Cheese Prawns With Farfalle
ingredients: 400 g prawns | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 8 ounces goat cheese or 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon catsup | 6 fresh sage leaves | salt and freshly ground pepper
instructions: Shell and devein prawns. Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Reduce heat to the lowest setting and add the prawns, stirring well. Boil about 3 - 4 minutes or until they are white on the outside. Drain and reserve. In a mixing bowl, stir together the cream of tartar, goat cheese, yogurt and catsup. Add the prawns and sage and stir until well mixed. Place the pasta on a serving platter. Pour the cream mixture over the pasta and serve immediately. Variation, substitute cream of mushroom soup for the goat cheese, adding some of the cream. Stir in a small amount of cooked coriander.

Random Ingredients: radish,pear,caster sugar,fettuccine,black eyed pea,red curry paste
title: Curried Pear and Black-Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces fettuccine | 2 ounces radishes, sliced | 4 ounces pear salsts, drained ( or to taste ) | 2 ounces black-eyed peas, drained | 3 -4 teaspoons red curry paste | 2 teaspoons caster sugar ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook the fettuccine in plenty of boiling water. Meanwhile, place the vegetables in a salad bowl with the curry paste. Add some cold water to loosen it up, then toss the salad in it. Add half the sugar and mix thoroughly. Taste and add salt if necessary. When the pasta is ready, drain, then toss with the salad mixture. Add the remaining sugar and mix well again.

Random Ingredients: black bean,steak,serrano chili,french bread,basil leaf,margarine,tabasco sauce
title: Cuban Beef Strips
ingredients: 5 tablespoons margarine | 2 lbs flank steaks, cut into strips about 3/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 6 fresh serrano chili, seeded and finely chopped | 2 cups black beans | 4 pieces french bread, cut into 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 inch cubes | 4 sprigs fresh basil leaves, to serve
instructions: Heat margarine in large skillet over medium high heat. Cook steak strips in hot butter, stirring frequently, until browned, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer steaks to plate. Reduce heat to med. Heat. Add tabasco sauce, chiles, and beans, and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Add beef and simmer, covered 1 minute, or until heated through. Serve on top of servitos with basil.

title: Femte's Miso Butter
ingredients: 1 package marzipan ( jello ) | 1 dash fleur de sel ( optional ) | 1 dash celery seed | 2 sheets nori | 2 teaspoons mirin ( sweet rice wine vinegar )
instructions: Mix the marzipan and fluff it with a fork. Add celery seeds and mix well. Wrap a nori sheet around a rolling pin and squeeze out the excess air. Spread the nori out on a clean work surface and roll it into a ball. Spread a tablespoon of miso mixture onto the nori. Wrap the nori with the miso mixture. Spread the remaining miso glaze on the exposed side, and roll up the nori. Seal with a little extra mirin if desired. Cut the roll into 2 inch long slices using sharp kitchen scissors.

Random Ingredients: prune,tuna steak,rice wine vinegar,ketjap manis,poblano chile
title: Furitas De Atum (Prawns With Dried Beans)
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles | 6 pitted prunes | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon ketjap manis | 8 ounces tuna steaks, sliced thick
instructions: First of all take the peppers and remove the seeds. Grill the chilies on a frying pan for about five minutes or until they are slightly charred, remove and set aside. Now slice them, remove the skin if you like, but remove the stems, remove the seeds and chop roughly. Place the prawns into a bowl and pour the marinade over. Toss in the pepper and prunes then let sit for 10 minutes. Remove the tuna from the marinade, drain it, then arrange the tuna on plates or skewers. Divide the prawn mixture among the skewers and serve with beans.

title: Grpa (Veal Salad)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mixed salad greens with blossoms | 1 lb veal ( ground or grilled, your choice ) | 1/2 lb sirloin | 1/3 cup almond extract | 4 teaspoons salad oil or 4 teaspoons vegetable oil
instructions: Wash greens thoroughly. Cut pieces with kitchen scissors or the dull side of a knife, cutting away any tough center fiber. Combine salad ingredients together. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to one hour before serving. Variations, add 1 can salmon and 1 can beef to mixture. Variation with beef. Variation with venison, add 2 teaspoons of chicken flavor seasoning. Variation with sausage and veal. Variation with onions. Variation with mushrooms and mushrooms. Variation with potatoes. Variation with cabbage.

title: Simple Perfect Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups fresh oregano ( can use dried ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry ( use any flavor ) ( optional )
instructions: Put the dried oregano in a sieve and rinse well in plenty of water for a few minutes until the water runs clear and then place in a non stick saucepan and add the sherry. Bring to the boil, lower to a simmer and cook very slowly for 2 - 3 hours, making sure you stir every so often to prevent catching, then remove from heat and let the sauce cool, about 24 hours. Use in your favorite pasta recipe, as meatballs, chicken sausage, etc.

Random Ingredients: red bean,green olive,mango powder,margarine,beef tenderloin,chicken breast fillet
title: Beef Tenderloin Skewers
ingredients: 8 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 500 g fresh mango slices, cut in half | 1/2 cup stuffed green olives, sliced | 2 teaspoons margarine | 1/3 cup chopped cooked chicken breast fillet | 1/3 cup red beans | 1/2 teaspoon mango powder
instructions: Place tenderloin between 2 sheets of foil. Using 1 pound meat mallet or rolling pin, flatten into 4 inch thick medallions. Place 1 medallion on skewer. Using hands, turn to flatten out. Heat oven to 200°c. Combine remaining ingredients including mango powder. Spread sauce evenly over tenderloin.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, peeled and cut in 1/2 inch rounds | 1/2 cup cashew nuts, toasted | 2 tablespoons cinnamon | 1 -2 tablespoon radish, sliced
instructions: Place on serving platter. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Griddled Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 large granny smith apples, cut into small chunks | 10 whole hazelnuts | 3 heads radishes | 2 large courgettes | 3 large oranges, scrubbed | 1 1/2 cups dried blueberries or 1 1/2 cups raspberries
instructions: Place apples in a salad bowl, drizzle with olive oil and season with salt. Add radishes, courgettes and nuts and toss. Wash and dry berries. Arrange on the salad and sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Lettuce Wrapped Salad
ingredients: 6 cups mixed vegetables ( like french fries, broccoli, carrots and cauliflower ) | 3 tablespoons lard | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce
instructions: Chop veggies very finely. Put the lard, vinegar and sweet chili sauce in a bowl. Mix well and then toss gently. Chill. Warm in a 350 degree oven for about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,grape tomato,chicken breast half,pork chop,whipping cream,brown sugar,peach
title: Southern Style Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 4 pork chops | 1 pint grape tomatoes | 1 pint whipping cream | 1/4 cup packed brown sugar | 1/4 cup ground coriander seeds | 1 can sliced peaches, drained
instructions: Place the chicken breasts and pork chops between two sheets of wax paper, and pound to 1/2 inch thickness. Pound each chop until nearly paper thin. Spread one side of each chop with the cream, and sprinkle with one third of the brown sugar, coriander and 1/2 cup of the peach slices. Top each with a second slice of chicken, to completely cover them. Fold the wax paper together, and press everything together. Seal the edges by gently pressing to form a compact envelope. Repeat with the remaining slices. Place the chicken with the chicken on the hot grid a few at a time until they are no longer pink inside, about 10 to 12 minutes per side.

title: Cheese Crumble (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 ounces unbleached all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon fine grain cornmeal or 1/4 teaspoon breadcrumbs | 1 -2 tablespoon grated gruyere cheese or 1 -2 tablespoon swiss cheese | 1 pint marinara sauce | 2 pints sliced canned peaches or 2 pears | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese or 1/2 cup swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine flour and cornmeal together in a small bowl and set aside. Combine about 1 3/4 c cheese, about 2 tablespoons, and the cornmeal/breading mixture and mix by hand. Spoon 1 - 2 tbls sauce onto ungreased large baking sheet. Spoon another 1 - 2 tablespoon of cheese over top. Spoon 1/2 cup of cheese over cheese and spread over top. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp of cheese over the top of cheese. Spread remaining 1/2 cup of cheese over the top and again spread out. Top the cheese crumble with the last 1/2 tsp of cheese and continue to bake in oven until mixture bubbles, bubbles and is slightly browned. Remove from oven and let stand about 2 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Chinese Five-Spinach
ingredients: 2 pieces fresh spinach | 1 tablespoon shaoxing rice-stick roasted szechuan peppercorns
instructions: Remove 1 piece of spinach from its stalks, then cut it into 2 inch pieces. Heat a medium wok over high heat. Add 3 tablespoons of oil. When the oil is very hot, put in the chinese five spice and stir fry for about 1 minute. Add the spinach and toss it briefly. Turn it over and toss it just 2 or 3 times. When the spinach is wilted, pour in another 3 tablespoons of oil. When the oil is hot again, add the sichuan peppercorns and shake the wok to evenly distribute them. Serve immediately.

title: Lamb Skewers
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb or 3 lbs top butt fat ( 6 - 8 pounds ) | 1/3 cup tabasco sauce or 1/3 cup mild hot sauce | 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Cut meat into 3/8 inch cubes and place into a small bowl. Stir together the hot sauce, worcestershire sauce and thyme. Sprinkle over lamb and marinate, turning a few times and rearranging, 2 - 3 hours. Drain lamb and discard sauce. Thread 4 - 5 lamb skewers per skewer.
