Place skewers on baking sheet, pour most of remaining sauce over and let stand 1 hour. Preheat broiler to high, broil 20 minutes turning once. Or bake in a 350 f oven for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours, turning halfway through. Note, lamb will release some juices during cooking and be moist, moist and cooked through. Some may prefer to leave out the hot sauce. Remove skewers from oven and let stand for 5 minutes before moving. Use a wooden carving board to remove lamb from skewers. This can be done easily, but it varies widely. Adjust oven temperature and correct seasonings. I've also found that this dish tastes great just as is.

title: Asparagus Salad With Green Olives
ingredients: 1 green pepper | 100 g green olives | 1 tablespoon caramel topping | 1 bunch asparagus | plain flour
instructions: Place the black olives on a non stick pan and cook until most of the moisture has absorbed. Allow to cool. Trim the green pepper, if using it chop finely. Place the green pepper and olives in a large bowl with the caramel topping. Slice the asparagus into long, thin, thin pieces and add to the salad. Toss lightly, serve or chill.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,pesto sauce,lobster tail,vegetable,eggplant,dark chocolate,salmon,halibut fillet
title: Lobster
ingredients: 1 fresh halibut fillet, cubed | 1/2 lb lobster tail | 2 slices fresh firm white fish | 1 eggplant, peeled and cubed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/2-3/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 cup prepared pesto sauce, with basil, garlic, and anchovy | garlic powder | dark chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Coat inside of the mold or other shallow pan with oil or coat with cooking spray. Place the halibut on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake, uncovered, stirring once or twice, for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the pesto sauce by mixing pesto sauce and basil or anchovies in a small bowl or a small, microwave safe bowl. Stir well. Set aside. To test if the halibut has baked or is soft, poke with a knife or toothpick in the center of the meat before measuring. It should feel slightly toasty inside. If not, press the meat firmly with the palm of your hand. If using the toothpick, the halibut should be soft enough that you can poke with a fork and the meat should pull away from the toothpack. To test if the meat has cooked completely, insert a cube of bread in the center of a toothpick. If it cracks it does not need to be puffed up. If the bread does not crack, it should crack open. Remove from the oven and poke with a fork several times. Place the bread in a flat serving dish. Place the lobster in a single layer in the middle of the bread. Spread half of the pesto sauce over the lobster and top with half of the eggplant.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,pork loin chop,extra virgin olive oil
title: French Breadcrumb Crusted Pork Loin Chops
ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin chops | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 4 tablespoons fresh italian-seasoned breadcrumbs, fine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a 13x9 inch casserole with nonstick cooking spray. Place pork loins in a single layer in a roasting pan. Drizzle with olive oil. Top with the bread crumbs to coat evenly. Bake, uncovered, for 35 - 45 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 160 degrees f.

title: Cilantro Jelly (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 3 bunches fresh cilantro stems, stems trimmed | 1 roasted red pepper ( about 3/4 pound ) | 2 cups cold water
instructions: Wash cilantro stalks and stems thoroughly in a colander, then place them in a medium pot. Add about 6 cups cold water. Pour boiling water from a cup into the bowl of a food processor or blender and add red pepper, cover with plastic wrap, and process until finely chopped. Transfer red pepper mixture to a small saucepan set over low heat to warm, then bring mixture to boil.

title: Simmered Short Ribs With Sultanas & radishes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs seasoning | 12 ounces spareribs | 2 ounces sultanas | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 -2 ounce rice, uncooked | radish
instructions: Heat the oven to 400° f/200°c line two jelly roll pans with non stick baking paper. Put the mixed herbs into a dry frying pan, add the spareribs & sultanas & fry quickly. Turn them once. Put the cooked spareribs in the prepared tray & add the sugar to the juices in the pan & cook until the sugar is dissolved & golden around the ribs. Put the rice in a sieve to drain. Remove the roasting pans from the oven & remove the baking paper. Stir the sultanas into the ribs & return to the oven. Bake for 10 - 15 mins or until the rice is cooked. While the short ribs are cooking, remove from the oven & leave them to cool on a wire rack. When the rice is done, turn the heat off & leave to stand for about 15 minutes, then tip out onto a serving platter.

title: Bran Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup natural bran | 1/2 vanilla bean | 1 cup dry wine | 3 tablespoons dried oregano
instructions: Combine bran, vanilla bean and wine in pot over medium heat. Heat for 5 minutes. Add oregano to syrup and remove from heat. Let stand for a few minutes to absorb flavors. Transfer to bottles and refrigerate.

title: Artichoke Bites
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts
instructions: Prepare a medium hot fire of cooking spray. Line a baking sheet with non stick foil or parchment paper. Place the artichokes on the foil. Spray the artichokes with the cooking spray. Grill the artichokes until hot and charred inside, about 2 minutes per side. Turn the artichokes over and sprinkle with more salt before letting the charings cook in the residual heat of the grill. Remove from the oven, cover loosely with foil, and allow to cool for 10 to 15 minutes. Cut the artichokes into bite size wedges, arrange on the foil, and serve.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,italian turkey sausage link,cream,vanilla extract,cold water,bamboo shoot,tomato green chilies
title: Mexican Sausage With Peaches
ingredients: 1 cup diced ripe peaches ( about 3 medium ) | 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian turkey sausage links | 2 cups cubed peeled fresh tomatoes with green chilies | 2 cups cold water | 2 tablespoons finely chopped canned ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract | sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Combine peach, sausage and tomatoes in a large nonreactive slow cooker. Add water, chile powder, and vanilla and stir to loosen browned particles. Cover and cook on high until liquid is reduced to a sauce consistency, 2 to 3 hours. Remove sausage from slow cooker and cut into bite size pieces. Add sausage to slow cooker. Cover and cook on high until sausage is no longer pink in center and no longer pink in center, about 20 minutes. Serve topped with sour cream if desired.

title: Broccoli with Bean Mash
ingredients: 1 broccoli, crown, florets left on | 1/2 cup bean, mash ( canned or homemade ) | 1 cup cornmeal | 2 cups roughly chopped canned coriander ( small sprigs )
instructions: Break off broccoli stalk, leave whole until needed.

title: Pork Chops With Prosciutto, Bacon, and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 -6 pork loin chops | 2 tablespoons dry prosciutto, cut into strips
instructions: Wrap each chicken breast with a strip of prosciutto or other thin strip of thin, thin film of bacon fat, securing each piece with toothpicks. Place chicken in a baking dish, then sprinkle with salt, if using. Pour enough hot water into the dish to come about halfway up the sides of the chicken breasts. Cover tightly and refrigerate, turning the chickens occasionally, 2 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bake chicken, uncovered, for 30 minutes, or until no longer pink in center, basting with pan juices occasionally.

title: Wild Pea and Bread Rolls (Sara D’ottbullar)
ingredients: 250 g dried mixed peas, washed | 225 g yellow peas, washed | 1 bunch fresh thyme | 250 g bread flour | 85 g dried bread flour | 150 ml coconut milk
instructions: Place all prepared ingredients into a food processor and pulse until the mixture becomes a little bit coarse. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and knead well until you have a round, even round cake with the mixture about 5cm diameter. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape the portions into balls. Dust with flour and let the cakes rest for 20 minutes. Heat a pan with some coconut oil on medium heat and fry the cakes on both sides until browned on all sides, turning them over half way through. Drain the cakes on kitchen paper and serve with your favourite topping. Cooks notes, to make the bread rolls more manageable, shape the dough into round or square balls and then cut them into slices, then cut all the slices in half, creating smaller round loaves.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,ranch dressing,mirin,pork tenderloin,onion soup mix,cream chicken soup
title: Crock Pot Porridge
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 envelope dry ranch dressing | 1 tablespoon oatmeal | powdered onion soup mix
instructions: Place pork tenderloins in crock pot. Combine all the other ingredients in a separate bowl stir well. Pour mixture over pork. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. I serve mine over a bed of rice, topped with onions and drizzled with a bit more mayo on top.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,fish sauce,beet,red bell pepper,tomato sauce
title: Nigerian Beet Salad
ingredients: 4 medium beets, washed and finely chopped | 1 red bell pepper, roughly diced | 2 teaspoons bottled fish sauce | 2 teaspoons bottled soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Place the beets into a saucepan of boiling water and cook for about 6 minutes or until just tender. Drain and set aside to cool. Then peel and finely dice, placing them into a bowl. Place the chili pepper, fish sauce, soy sauce, sea salt and half the beetroot into the bowl and mix gently. Taste and adjust seasonings or leave out for an extra touch. Serve immediately while still in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,pepperjack cheese,anchovy paste,grain brown rice,prawn
title: Pan Fried Rice Using Anchovies
ingredients: 1 cup long grain brown rice, uncooked | 3 anchovies packed in oil, drained and sliced | 6 ounces pepperjack cheese | 3/4 cup basil leaves | 2 tablespoons anchovy paste
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat anchovies in oil in skillet over medium heat. Add pepperjack cheese. Cook for 2 minutes or until it melts, stirring constantly. Cook 2 - 3 minutes more. Stir in basil leaves and anchovy paste. Add cooked rice. Heat through, stirring constantly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pea carrot,broccoli rabe,parmesan cheese,broccoli,white flour,lemon peel
title: Italian Broccoli and Pea Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1 package florets broccoli rabe | 2 pounds broccoli rabe | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 8 leaves fresh peas and carrots | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup white flour for coating
instructions: Slice broccoli rabe into 1/2 inch squares and add to a saucepan with water to cover. Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Drain. Blanch broccoli rabe in boiling water until tender but not mushy, about 5 minutes. Cool and remove stems. Slice into 1/2 inch lengths and add to a salad bowl. Dressing, combine the lemon peel and cheese and stir in flour. Gradually stir in the peas and carrots. Pour dressing over broccoli rabe and gently toss to coat. Serve chilled.

title: Pressed Pepper Croutons With Fresh Oregano
ingredients: 4 -6 large cleaned fresh pepper | oregano leaves
instructions: Remove the black bits from the peppers. Place the peppers into a plastic zip bag. Squeeze the peppers to extract as much flavor as possible and seal. Place the peppers into the center of a double thickness of heavy duty foil, then wrap and seal the ends. Carefully place the bag containing the peppers onto your work surface, preferably an old one. Place all the pepper croutons onto the top of the open foil. Gently twist the two ends together to form a double thickness. Remove the top layer of foil and discard. Wrap the entire pepper and contents of the bag back into the center of the foil. Press down to remove air pockets. Bring the two bottom halves of the pepper ups together with the last 2 ends of the foil. Bake the pepper croutons at 300 degrees for 40 - 50 minutes, or until the pepper skins turn dark white and the bread crackles. Remove the pepper croutons from the foil and place them onto a rack to cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pasta,pork shoulder,baking soda,noodle,plain nonfat yogurt,kidney bean
title: Breaded Pork and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb cooked pasta ( any shape ) | 1 lb cooked pork shoulder, shredded | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 can kidney beans | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup noodles ( any shape, cooked )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350, spray a 9x11 cake pan with non stick spray. Add cooked pasta in layers. In a separate bowl, mix the yogurt and the beans together to make creamy yogurt. Spread mixture over the bread mixture layer. Place the pork on top and cover with the noodles. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove from oven when oven is about 180 degrees the breading is done.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,rigatoni pasta,wheat english muffin,lime,active yeast,vinegar,potato flake,maple syrup
title: Portuguese Egg and Potato Flatbread
ingredients: 8 cups egg and potato flakes, at room temperature | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 4 teaspoons lime, freshly grated | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 6 cups unpeeled potatoes, preferably red | 12 hard-boiled eggs | 1/4 cup dry potato flakes | 8 whole english muffins, split | 2 tablespoons whole wheat english muffins, toasted
instructions: In a small bowl, combine 1/4 cup plus 1 teaspoon of the maple syrup and the grated lime. In a large mixing bowl, combine 2 cups of the potato flakes with the 1/2 cup maple syrup and the yeast. Gradually add the egg mixture, beating on low speed until just mixed. Beat in the remaining 1/2 cup maple syrup, vinegar, and yeast mixture. Transfer the dough to a 2 quart baking dish, turning it to coat the bottom. Cover the baking dish with plastic and let rise in a draft free place until doubled, about 2 hours. Remove plastic and discard, punch down dough on a floured surface, and cut into four pieces. In a large bowl, combine the potato and 1/2 cup potato flakes, and stir in the eggs, 1 cup at a time. Dough should be sticky and pliable. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise until puffy and doubled, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 400°f. Grease a large baking sheet with some of the remaining cooking spray. To break the dough, place the dough in a wide, flat metal tub, and spread the whole wheat english muffins on the baking sheet. Using a spatula, spread the potato mixture in a thin layer. Add the bread, and sprinkle with the remaining 1 teaspoon of maple syrup. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the filling is bubbly. Cool on a metal rack.

title: Ramen Stuffed Shrimp
ingredients: 4 -5 shrimp paste ( use as many as desired ) | 24 slices parmigiano-reggiano cheese | parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Wash and remove the tails from the shrimp past the head and devein. Cut a slit in each shrimp's tail shell, lengthwise. Mix the shrimp paste with the cheese and the shrimp paste to coat shrimp lightly. Fill shrimp tails with the mixture. Pour enough water to cover the shrimp in the shells. Wrap a towel around the shrimp, securing the towel with a toothpick. Heat olive oil in a saucepan or deep fryer until a deep fry thermometer reads 375 degrees f, about 3 - 5 minutes. Transfer shrimp to paper towels to drain. Sprinkle with parmigiano reggiano and serve at once.

title: Achaari(Indian Style Asafetida)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons safflower oil | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Heat the safflower oil and asafetida in a pot on medium low heat. Add the safflower oil and asafoetida. Simmer the asafetida over medium low heat for about 10 minute then remove from heat and serve.

title: Italian Spinach Beans and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried red beans | 4 cups fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Place all ingredients in large pot, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 1 hour or until beans are tender.

title: Spicy Vegetable Mix
ingredients: 2 cups low-fat peanut butter | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves | 1 zucchini, sliced, unpeeled | 2 tea bags
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor.

title: Spicy Sicilian Sausages
ingredients: 2 jars marinated artichoke hearts | 8 ounces hot sausage, cut into 1/2 - 3/4 pieces | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 orange, peeled and diced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil
instructions: Drain the artichokes, reserving liquid. Set aside. Place artichokes in a 3 - 4 quart slow cooker. Add the hot sausage and drizzle with the reserved marinade. Mix the ginger paste and marsala wine together and spoon over the sausage. Stir to coat everything. Cover and cook on high for 4 - 5 hours. Add the orange. Cover and cook for an additional 30 - 45 minutes or until the sausage is cooked to your taste. Turn the cooker off. Remove the pan from the slow cooker and place on a serving plate. Sprinkle the basil over and serve.

Random Ingredients: amarula cream liqueur,colby monterey jack cheese,flour tortilla,oatmeal,marsala wine,ice water,bell pepper
title: Famous Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 large flour tortillas | 2 cans amarula cream liqueur | 1 cup ice cold water | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 2 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded plus 1/2 cup | 1/2 cup sweet bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup rice-and-herb seasoning or 1/2 cup marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line 11x13 glass baking dish with parchment paper. Place tortillas in large bowl.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,irish whiskey,mint leaf,pear,celery salt,hot paprika,ladyfinger,serrano chilies
title: Irish Shorba With Pear and Fresh Mint
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 cup irish whiskey | 1 lb sour cherry tomatoes, cut into quarters | 1/2 lb arugula leaf | 1/2 lb serrano chilies or 1/2 lb jalapeno pepper, chopped very finely | 1/2 lb celery salt | 2 fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cook pasta, according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine the celery salt, hot paprika and whiskey in a small bowl. Set aside. Add cherry tomatoes, arugula leaves and serrano chiles to pasta and toss till just starting to soften, about 3 minutes. Add celery salt and chopped mint leaves to pasta. Toss well. Transfer to serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,chocolate shaving,puff pastry,cashew,clear honey,italian breadcrumb
title: Creamy Italian-Style Chocolate Pastry Twists
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry, defrosted | 2 1/4 cups low-fat milk ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 tablespoon italian breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon chopped cashews | chocolate shavings ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Roll out pastry on a lightly floured surface to approximately 1/8 inch thickness. Using a 2½ inch biscuit cutter cut out 5 inch rounds from thawed pastry.. Stir ricotta, honey and bread crumbs together in a bowl. Combine cashews and chocolate with an offset metal spatula or toothpick. Stir in ricotta mixture, spreading mixture evenly to cover dough. Place 3 teaspoons pastries on pastry lined baking sheets, leaving a 1½ inch edge on each side. Sprinkle with additional sesame seeds, pressing to adhere. Bake pastries until golden brown and puffed, 10 to 12 minutes and cool. Transfer to a wire rack and cool. Run a knife around the edge of each pasty to loosen and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,broccoli floret,almond,creole seasoning,canadian bacon,nonfat milk,pork chop,chicken stuffing mix
title: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 12 thick slices canadian bacon, cut in half | 1 package reduced fat breakfast sausage deli rolls ( about 15 rolls ) or ( 8 ounce ) package egg roll wrap, defrosted frozen rolls | 1/4 cup nonfat milk | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning ( or to taste ) | 1/3 cup slivered almonds | 1 package broccoli florets, defrosted, coarsely chopped | 3 lbs tilapia fillets ( about 20 large ) | assorted cooked vegetables or favorite fresh salsa
instructions: Arrange chicken breasts on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake at 375 degrees f. For 13 minutes. Turn over, and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes for thinner breasts. To pan, brown sausage and cooked bacon, set aside. To pan, spread open package of rolls on a large plate. Place one half of the deli roll on roll, lengthwise. Lay 3 to 4 slices of ham on top of roll, cutting in half and cutting diagonally. Add broccoli to rolls. Arrange tilapia fillets on top of broccoli and sausage. Top with 1/4 of the crumbled cheese. Dot with sliced almonds. Serve with salsa.

title: Pinchi Triangles or Spicy Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 2 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed if frozen
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place four sheets of thawed phyllo into a cookie sheet, allowing room for spreading. Brush each sheet with butter and dust lightly with salt. Spoon 1/3 cup of spicy peanut sauce into the center of the phyllo sheets, then brush with another 1/3 cup of sauce. Working from the center out, roll up the phyllo around the stuffing so that the pastry can be folded over. Repeat with the remaining sheets, placing each rolled pastry log seam side down on a cookie sheet. Brush the outside of each rolled pastry log with butter and bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Flammeaux
ingredients: 10 saffron threads | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 3 tablespoons light cream or 3 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup rum ( or your favourite flavor ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Place the saffron, basil, and cream in a mortar and pestle and grind well. Add the peanut butter and rum and blend to make fine crumbs. Add the salt and pepper and stir until well mixed. Serve immediately.

title: Corn and Poblano Pepper Salsa
ingredients: 2 cups frozen corn kernels plus 3/4 cup corn | 1 orange peel, about 3 x 1/4-inch strips ( about 2 1/2 inches long ) | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and thinly scored
instructions: Place corn and orange peel in processor.

title: Red Cabbage Toast
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 1 red cabbage, shredded | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | 1 fresh fruit or 1 frozen fruit
instructions: Slice bread in thin strips. Spread each piece with the seeds from a fresh fruit. Sprinkle with a pinch of caraway. In a nonstick pan toast both sides until light brown, about 2 minutes on the first side, then turn with spatula to brown other side. Stack both on a plate, slice and cover with a cloth. Cut fruit into thin wedges.

title: Sauce Vierge for Beef and Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups aged balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 cups maple syrup | 2 - 2 1/2 lbs lean ground beef ( or top round meat roast ) | 3/4 teaspoon hot horseradish
instructions: In small bowl, whisk balsamic vinegar, maple syrup, beef bouillon and horseradish.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,cayenne powder,coriander,black cardamom pod,turmeric,white rice
title: Rice with Spices
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked white rice | 2 large black cardamom pods, crushed | 2 tablespoons ground coriander | 4 tablespoons ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place white rice in a bowl, and cover with water. Rinse the rice in a strainer until water runs clear.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,swiss cheese,couscous,cream,red pepper flake,marsala,celery seed
title: Low-Fat Sticky Couscous With Swiss Cheese, Marsala & Marsala
ingredients: 5 tablespoons low-fat sour cream or 5 tablespoons non-fat sour cream | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce ( regular and low sodium ) | 1 teaspoon dry marsala or 1 teaspoon creoletto | 1/2 cup reduced-fat crescent roll dough, partially thawed | 3/4 cup light swiss cheese, grated | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Make all the ingredients, except the dough and filling, at your discretion. Preheat oven to 200 degrees. If the dough has difficulty pulling together on a lightly floured surface, use a rolling pin to roll it out to the size the roll might need. Lay out the dough on a lightly floured surface and place on a nonstick or parchment lined cookie sheet to avoid making the dough more difficult to handle. Cut the dough into 4 equal pieces and transfer the pieces to a pastry bag fitted with a star tip. Pipe or spoon out the filling into the middle of each piece of dough. Gently pinch the dough around the filling, pulling it up into a loose loose, oval shaped roll shape and placing the seam side down in a baking dish. Drizzle with a little water to prevent the dough from sticking as it bakes to the bottom. You should have a fairly loose square shape that you can spread the filling over. Bake the unpeeled dough for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the edge is golden brown and the filling is beginning to bubble. Let the bread rest for 1 minute and sprinkle with the crumbs. Carefully remove the tray from the oven and place the cheese directly on top. Return to the oven and heat until the cheese is bubbling again and the topping is golden.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pepper,kaffir lime leaf,cilantro leaf,lebanese cucumber,extra beef,bean sprout
title: Asian Style Meatball and Cabbage Wraps
ingredients: 15 ounces extra lean ground beef | 32 ounces bean sprouts, rinsed and dried | 1 red peppers or 1 yellow pepper | 1 slice lebanese cucumber ( about 1/4 inch thick ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, packed | 1 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1/4 cup fresh kaffir lime leaf, minced ( or 2 tsp. lime juice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Lightly grease your palms with cooking spray or use olive oil cooking spray. In a large mixing bowl crumble the ground beef with a pinch of salt and pepper. Form into 1 inch meatballs, about 2 inch diameter. Slice peppers into long thin strips. Place bell peppers, cucumber slices, coriander and lime juice in separate bowls. Top with meatballs on wax paper until ready to roll. Arrange 2 meatballs on a piece of parchment paper, overlapping edges to form a wrap. Wrap tightly with plastic wrap or aluminum foil. Refrigerate 2 hours. Place a small piece of wax paper on a board. Place a large bowl over the bowl and set aside. Place the rolls, seam side down, on the parchment paper.. Pour 1/4 inch hot water into a nonstick skillet or a medium sized deep fryer. Heat 1 inch of oil to 375f degrees. Place 3 or 4 balls into the skillet on each side, turning once, then place on top of the paper with more hot oil. Close lid and cook until meatballs are cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from skillet and place on plate covered with foil until meatballs are reheated. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,cucumber,romano cheese,baking soda,king prawn,chili bean,kaffir lime leaf
title: King Prawns and Feta
ingredients: 1/2 lb king prawns or 1/2 lb prawns | 1 cup basil pesto | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves | 2 tablespoons freshly grated romano cheese | 1 small cucumber, cut into pieces | 6 fresh romavalta fresh tomatoes or 6 plum tomatoes | chili beans
instructions: Shell prawns and wash under cold running water. Chop the prawn. Place in a saucepan of hot water and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes until just cooked. Drain and cool slightly. Remove heads and set aside. Heat the ramekins or serving bowl and refrigerate the prawn heads. Slice in half, remove beaks and set the heads aside. Finely grate the cucumber and tomatoes. Add pesto, grated cheese and chopped, fresh rind of lime. Set in refrigerator until ready to serve. Place prawn heads back into the ramekin or serving bowl, pour over the pesto, arrange the tomato halves on top then top ramekin with cucumber strips and serve with chili beans.

Random Ingredients: clamato juice,mango chutney,black sesame seed,salmon,chunky salsa,flat leaf italian parsley,spaghetti,nutmeg
title: Spaghetti With Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 small spanish-style smoked salmon, skin removed ( 2 to 3 oz each ) or 1 small salmon fillet, 4 to 6 oz | 1/2 cup chunky salsa, your choice | 1/4 cup bottled clamato juice | 1/2 cup mango chutney or 1/2 cup chutney, of your choice | chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | grated nutmeg | crushed black sesame seed | cooked spaghetti or vermicelli
instructions: Remove bone and skin from salmon. Cut salmon in half lengthwise and place skin side down on cutting board. Using a mallet, pound salmon until it just measures about 1/4 inch thick. Transfer salmon to cutting board and set aside. Cut a slit lengthwise through one side of salmon. Cut salmon lengthwise through center of flesh to form snappertail. Place salmon in a nonmetal bowl. Pour salsa over salmon, dividing evenly between bones. Stir in clamato juice. Place mussels on top of salmon. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours. Drain seafood, discarding any shellfish. Sprinkle fish with seasonings. In a small bowl, cover mussel mixture with plastic wrap and refrigerate 1 hour. Serve with cooked spaghetti or noodles. Garnish with sesame seeds and grated nutmeg.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,purple onion,beet,orzo pasta,cannellini bean,tart apple,blue cheese,salt black pepper
title: Beets With Orzo and Blue Cheese
ingredients: 2 medium beets, sliced 1/4 in. thick | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons orzo pasta, uncooked | 1/4 cup quick-cooking wine or 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 cup cannellini beans, drained & rinsed, well-rinsed | 1 small tart apple, peeled, cored & diced 1/4 in. | 2 teaspoons goat cheese or 2 teaspoons sour cream | 2 teaspoons minced purple onions or 2 teaspoons shallots
instructions: Place a steamer over medium heat. When it starts to run, add a couple pinches of salt & pepper orzo.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,strawberry,ice water,lamb,orange juice zest,greek yogurt
title: Persian Lamb-Strawberry Patties
ingredients: 500 g minced lamb | 250 g strawberries, cleaned rinsed and quartered | 100 -200 g greek yogurt | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 150 ml water ( or less ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder or 1 teaspoon sage powder
instructions: Fry the minced lamb in a nonstick frying pan until it changes colour. Add the fruit and cook over a high heat until the juice has been mostly absorbed add the yogurt, orange rind juice and water mix thoroughly. Cook on medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes. Let cool. Using a teaspoon, make patties from the mixture. Dip the patties in the mixture and fry in a nonstick skillet on high heat for 1 to 5 minutes each side over a medium high heat until they are golden on the underside.

Random Ingredients: raisin,water,water chestnut,cream chicken soup,pecorino cheese,red chile pepper
title: Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/4 cups raisins | 1/4 cup chopped water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh red chile peppers | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh pecorino cheese
instructions: Drain soup cans and reserve liquid. Combine reserved soup liquid, raisins, water chestnuts, red chile peppers and pecorino cheese in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Homemade Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 jar taco sauce | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain off fat. Add taco sauce and whipping cream. Stir in the shredded cheese, mix well and dip into tortilla chips or serve on a tostada.

title: Spicy Strawberry and Chili Potatoes #SP5
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1 can small whole green chilies, diced | 1 cup strawberry, sliced
instructions: Set aside 1 cup of the diced potato. Using 1 cup cold water add to the dry potatoes and mix well. Heat oven for 375 degrees. Mix potatoes and diced green chiles well and transfer to a greased deep 8 inch square baking dish. Add sliced strawberries to the top of potato mixture and gently toss. Sprinkle remaining potatoes on top of potato mixture and bake uncovered until potatoes are browned and the strawberries are softened.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,green chile pepper,cayenne,asafoetida powder
title: Spiced Indian Chiles
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder ( hing ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice ( juice from about 3 to 4 lemons ) | 1 can diced green chile peppers | cayenne, or to taste
instructions: Place the asafetida in a small, heavy skillet, and cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, until the foam dissipates and the asafetida darkens, about 10 minutes. Stir in the lemon juice, green chiles, and cayenne. Remove from heat, cover, and allow to stand until cool, about 15 minutes.

title: Easy No Bake Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | 3 3/4 cups plain flour, to dust
instructions: Mix alfredo sauce, lemon lime beverage and flour in a bowl until well mixed. Turn into a greased ramekin or pie plate. Place in refridgerator and allow to chill for about 1 hour. When ready to serve, remove ramekin from refrigerator and allow to chill for about 20 minutes. Remove ramekin from refridgerator, and remove lid. Using a fork, scrape the sauce mixture from the bowl into the ramekin. Tear off a big piece of foil the size of a ramekin and place over the top of the sauce. Tightly tent a steamer or saucepan lid securely over the top of the sauce. Place a steaming rack on the bottom of the pot and bring back to over 325 degrees. Allow to heat for about 45 - 60 minutes or until bubbly. Once heated, remove from stove and allow to cool for about 30 minutes to allow flavors to fully combine and to thicken slightly.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,greek yogurt,puff pastry,chicken,celery salt,canadian bacon,coconut milk
title: Chicken, Canadian Bacon & Coconut Jaffles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon black peppercorns | 500 g chicken | 2 cups creamy greek yogurt ( not skim ) | 300 ml coconut milk | 2 tablespoons celery salt | 150 g smoked canadian bacon | 350 400 g puff pastry
instructions: Slice cooked chicken into four quarters. Slice bacon into four pieces and fry in a frying pan until crispy. Place the diced chicken in the pastry, cut into four slices each, and toss together. Tear and chop lettuce into bite sized pieces. Place on top of the chicken & bacon mixture and cover with the yoghurt, coconut milk, celery salt, & hot pepper. Mix well until everything has mixed well & has the consistency of soft jam. Spread the jam on the chicken mixture. Fold half the pastry over the top & crimp closed with a fork. Press the edges to seal. Slice into 12 slices & place on a sheet of foil. Repeat with other half of pastry & filling. Bake in moderate / over for 12 minutes, allow to cool & refrigerate for 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,pistachio,red bell pepper,black cardamom pod,fennel,white pepper,co lettuce
title: Pistachio and Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1 head fennel, finely chopped | 8 cups co lettuce, finely chopped | 1 small red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 4 tablespoons roasted pistachios, chopped | 0.5 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 pinch white pepper | 1 pinch powdered black cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Mix fennel, lettuce, red bell pepper, pistachios, soup and spices in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,pimiento,rigatoni pasta,cumin powder,chicken bouillon cube,cream chicken soup,adobo seasoning
title: Chipotle Creamy Chipotle Ragu
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta or ( 900 g ) package bow tie pasta | 7 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1 cup sour cream ( we just used fat free ) | 4 ounces canned chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped ( we like spicy! ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 cubes chicken bouillon cubes, crushed | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained
instructions: Cook pasta, drain and set aside. Combine soup, sour cream, chipotles, cumin, adobo, and 2 bouillon cubes in a medium bowl and stir well. Add the pasta to the soup mixture and stir well to coat. Toss with pimentos. Serve immediately. Makes about 2 cups.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,superfine sugar,double cream,plain yogurt,bread,tomato sauce,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Easy Tomato-Cheese-And-Yogurt Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices bread | 1/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 2 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon double cream | 8 lettuce leaves ( optional ) | 1 tomatoes, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Spread yogurt on bread slices with a fork to coat entirely. Whip cream cheese & superfine sugar in a bowl using an electric mixer until smooth & creamy. Spread cream cheese mixture on top of the yogurt. Scatter lettuce across the cream cheese, cutting it in half crossways, then scatter tomato slices over. Put the sandwiches together & enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,tequila,almond extract,italian spice,kielbasa,chicken thigh fillet,corn oil
title: Chile-Tequila Pulled Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken thigh fillets | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 3 1/2 ounces tequila | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 teaspoons dried italian spices | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 -2 tablespoon kielbasa, sliced
instructions: Remove chicken thigh and pork shoulder from the bone in large cubes. Trim of excess moisture. Rinse and pat dry and dust chicken and pork with italian seasonings. Rub one side of each piece with corn oil and rub with italian seasonings. Wrap chicken and pork in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 45 minutes to overnight. If refrigerated, preheat oven to 350°f. Place chicken, pork, tequila, orange marmalade, and kielbasa in a 9 x 13 pan. Drizzle with a little more marmalade and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until the meat is firm. Serve with roasted vegetables.

title: Spicy Egg Noodle Cocktail
ingredients: 450 g egg noodles | 6 tablespoons double cream, to taste | 1 teaspoon allspice berry | 300 g fresh marjoram | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Put noodles, salt, pepper and mustard, vinegar, allspice, mustard and marjoram in a pan of boiling water and boil for about 8 minutes. Drain. Serve the chilled cocktail with the double cream.

title: Frosting With Chiles and Sour Cream
ingredients: 250 g canned anaheim chili, pureed | 1 can tomato paste | 125 ml red wine, preferably decent quality | 120 g sour cream | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 packet of campbell's healthy request herb and garlic free frosting
instructions: Boil wine until reduced by 1/ place the peppers in a bowl of boiling water until the skin starts cracking. Remove from water, cool, then peel and remove the seeds and membrane and dice into one inch pieces. Combine peppers, tomato paste, tomato puree, herbs and sour cream in a food processor and process until combined. Pour mix into individual moulds leaving 3/4 of room at the top of each mould. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving. You can prepare your meal up to 2 days in advance, refrigerate and reheat before serving, otherwise, reheat for 2 - 3 minutes and serve alongside veggies.

title: Simple Parsley Appetizer (Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 lb pizza sauce | 1/2 lb italian parsley, finely chopped | 1/2 lb fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 small apple, finely diced
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the order listed. Start out with a few drops of water and check to make sure that the apples are really, really well diced. Note, i always add the garlic towards the end of the final grinding to prevent it from oxidizing. When everything is finely chopped and mixed together it is ready to serve. Serve as a dipping accompaniment to pasta, or with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,mint,red potato,sourdough bread,plain flour,caster sugar
title: Irish Beef Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs cubed stewing beef | 4 ounces sourdough bread | 14 ounces plain flour | 1 tablespoon caster sugar or 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 3 -4 cups sliced red potatoes ( enough to cover the top of the stew. e.g. guinness or other baking potatoes ) | 1/4 cup of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Put the beef and bread in a large casserole dish. Thoroughly blend the flour and sugar into a fine paste with 1/2 cup water and whisk inches pour this mix over the meat in the casserole. Add sliced potatoes to the casserole.

Random Ingredients: broth,mandarin orange,onion soup mix,colby cheese,hoagie,chili powder,chicken
title: Quick Chicken Oranoff Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 cups chopped cooked chicken ( or use prepared deli chicken ) | 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained | 1/2 cup sweet onion soup mix ( such as vh ) | 1/2 cup broth ( fat free ) | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 24 hoagie rolls ( optional ) | 2 cups shredded colby cheese
instructions: Add all ingredients together except bread, cheese, and 2 cups cheese in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on lo heat or low heat setting 3 - 4 hours, until reduced and mixture thickens. Toast rolls on baking sheet. Place on cookie sheet and top with a portion of the mixture evenly over the tops of the rolls. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Broil until the mixture is heated through and bubbly.

title: Tofu Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 3 cups chopped fresh mushrooms | 1/4 lb ground lean ground veal | 1 teaspoon sriracha hot sauce | 2 tablespoons dry tahini | 1 bunch chopped watercress leaf | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Using a peeler or an apple corer cut off the stem and discard.

Random Ingredients: potato,vanilla bean,seasoning salt,flax seed,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Vanilla Fritters (Tropical Mashed Potatoes)
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans ( optional ) or 3 1/2 teaspoons sugar or 3 1/2 teaspoons orange extract | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 cup mashed potatoes ( leftover mashed potatoes, cold mashed potatoes or instant potato flakes ) | 1 teaspoon flax seed, toasted, toasted ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt ( optional ) or 1/8 teaspoon table salt ( optional )
instructions: Stir the vanilla bean in with the sugar in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat for about 5 minutes, or until the sugar is disolved. Do not burn. Remove the vanilla bean and discard it. Do not mash the bean. Spray a nonstick frying pan with the vegetable spray, then add the mashed potato. Stir the potatoes until they are heated through. Stir in the flax seed, if using and seasoning salt. Drop the mixture by heaping tablespoons into the hot pan. Stir vigorously just until the fritters turn slightly opaque and the fritters are well coated. Transfer the fritters to a paper towel lined plate to drain. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,rice krispies,hot italian sausage,anaheim chilies,cumin seed,chunky salsa,horseradish
title: Mexican Sausage and Rice Krispies W-Caramelized Chile-Salsa Dipping Sauce and Horseradish.
ingredients: 2 large hot italian sausage | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 cups chunky salsa ( i use medium ) | 1/2 cup prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup hot chunky salsa ( i use pace ) | 1 cup rice krispies ( rice krispies ) | italian seasoning, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f spray a 13 x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Place the sausage meat in a large dutch oven. Insert a meat thermometer. Add cumin seeds and stir to coat evenly. Cover and bake until browned, stirring once halfway through. Remove cover to oven. Place 2 cups salsa in a microwave safe bowl set over moderate heat. Stir and heat, uncovered, until hot, about 1 minute. Remove from the heat and stir in horseradish. Stir in remaining salsa and 2 cups rice krispies until coated. Spread sausage mixture across the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Cover and bake until the sausage is cooked and hot, about 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a cutting board. Sprinkle with julienned hot italian sausage. Remove sausage to a cutting board and stir to separate. To serve, invert sausage onto an individual serving plate. Spread hot salsa on top, drizzle warm salsa over and top with remaining rice krispies.

title: Strawberries Marinated with Marsala Wine and Marsala
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh fava beans, trimmed and cut into chunks | 3 cups pearl water or cider vinegar | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 2 bunches romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup drained drained rinsed and dried calendula leaves | 3/4 pound fresh strawberries, hulled and halved
instructions: Place the fava beans, pearl water and marsala wine in a large glass bowl. Cover and marinate the fruit and vegetable in the refrigerator for 4 hours. Bring the wine mixture to a boil in a large deep skillet. Cook over high heat until the water has reduced by half. Add romaine lettuce to the skillet and cook, basting occasionally, for 3 to 5 minutes. Add the fruit and stir to combine. Serve in soup dishes on the side.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,arborio rice,self rising flour
title: Cousin Pete's Black-Eyed Peas & Rice
ingredients: 1 package frozen black-eyed peas, thawed and liquid reserved | 2 cups arborio rice | 3 cups self-rising flour
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the beans, rice, and enough water to just cover. Bring to a boil before removing from the heat. Cover, and let stand for 5 minutes. Remove 1 1/2 cups of the bean liquid, and set aside. Place the remaining bean liquid, flour, and about 3/4 cup of reserved bean liquid into the pan, and whisk together with a fork until the mixture has become well combined. Cook and stir over high heat until thickened, about 5 minutes. Spread the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and place in a cold oven. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake bean mixture in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Scallopes With Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 16 sea scallops | 1 1/2 tablespoons white flour | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 teaspoon tahini, dry rub | 3 -5 tablespoons red wine
instructions: Wash dry scallops well and remove muscle and blemishes from shells. In shallow dish combine flour and chili oil. Dip scallops in flour mixture and lightly shake off excess. Melt butter in skillet and sear scallops on both sides until lightly browned. Put scallops on platter and pour tahini sauce over.

title: Benihana Baste (Beer Marinade for Beef and Pork)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup bourbon
instructions: Combine ingredients in a small saucepan over medium heat.

title: Clams With Goat Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces goat cheese ( goat cheese works well ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons vodka | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar ( can be made ahead by whipping your own cane or vanilla extract ) | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 6 -8 canned lobsters ( in their shells, don't leave shells open, the lobster will help to open their shells ) or 6 -8 large canned clams
instructions: Place the goat cheese, icing sugar, vodka and herbs in a bowl and beat well until all ingredients are blended. Spread the mixture evenly onto the cooked lobsters/clams with your favourite method. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,beef chuck,green chili pepper
title: Beef Steak for Two
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, cored, seeded and cut into long strips | 1 hot green chili pepper, seeded, deveined and thinly sliced ( or use red chiles ) | 2 -3 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed
instructions: Put the peppers in a plastic bag and add the chile, the beef and the meat packing the marinade tightly open. Seal the bag and place it in the freezer. To cook, let the beef thaw or marinade for up to 1 day. Remove the beef from the fridge 4 hours, or over night. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Arrange on a baking sheet, fat side up. Bake uncovered bakers 30 minutes, or untill the beef is cooked. Let the meat stand for 15 minutes then slice thin.

title: Vodka Vegetables
ingredients: 5 fluid ounces vodka | 2 fluid ounces soya sauce | 2 drops dried marjoram | 2 stalks lemongrass ( tough outer stalks ) | 1 tablespoon fennel | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | vegetables
instructions: Make sure the vodka has been allowed to cool for a few hours. Cut the outer stalks into large slices. Mix the vodka, soya sauce, marjoram and fennel in a bowl. Slice the lemongrass into very thin strips and mix with the fennel. Add this mixture to the vodka mixture, stir and chill for about 2 hours or overnight. Strain and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,peach brandy,orange juice zest,penne,chili paste,currant,corn
title: Spicy Penne Salad
ingredients: 1 cup penne, uncooked | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 cup frozen diced peaches or 1 cup peach slices, thawed | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon currants or 1 tablespoon raisins, soaked in hot water for 15 minutes
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente, drain and cool a little, if needed. Put hot, drained pasta into a bowl, add drained tomato soup and mix. In a smaller bowl, mix together, peach, chilli paste, orange zest, and currants or raisins to taste. Add this to the drained pasta and mix well. Toss with salad dressing and serve.

title: Terrific Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 maraschino cherry, cut into halves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Serve hot over your favorite steak.

title: Crock Pot Rice Enchilada
ingredients: 200 g long grain rice | 5 spring onions | 50 ml pineapple juice | 20 ml amarillo enchilada sauce ( or amarillo sauce )
instructions: Place rice into crock pot. Cut spring onion in rounds and add into crock pot. Mix the remainder of the ingredients in a bowl to make sauce. Pour sauce over rice to cover the top. Stir and cook on low for 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,harissa,macaroni,potato traditional,meat,rye flour,kielbasa,mozzarella cheese
title: Ahi (Potato Cheese Pie) With Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 4 -6 cups leftover meat, chopped as finely as possible ( polish, ham, kielbasa, smoked sausage, sausage ) | 3 lbs frozen miniature mashed potatoes, 2 medium size ones | 1 cup macaroni, cooked and drained as directed on directions on packet ( or make your own ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon harissa, to taste ( to taste, we prefer it spicy ) | 1/4 cup kielbasa, finely minced or minced | 1/4 cup kielbasa, finely diced ( polish, turkey, pick your favorite type ) | 1/4 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped | 3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese or 3/4 cup cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f coat casserole dish with cooking spray. Spray bottom and sides of pan with cooking spray. Place the meat, potatoes, macaroni, kielbasas, parsley, mozzarella, and harissa in the bottom of pan. Cover the top layer of meat with mashed potatoes, breaking it up as it melts into the mixture. Place in oven and bake for 35 minutes, or until cheese is bubbling.

title: Grilled Scallops
ingredients: 1 cup salad greens | 1 1/2 teaspoons lawry's seasonings salt | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 12 scallops ( approximately 3 lbs. )
instructions: Preheat grill. Wash and pick up the scallops and place on a hot platter. To one side of each chop down into a thin circle. Sprinkle salt over tops of scallops. Heat 1/2 tsp pepper sauce in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place scallops in pan and grill, turning once, until done, about 1 - 2 minutes. To plate, place scallops on plate, drizzle with remaining teaspoon pepper sauce, and serve.

title: Rhubarb and Strawberry Salad With Jalapeno-Spicy Croutons
ingredients: 1 large bunch rhubarb, chopped | 1/2 large cucumber, chopped | 1/2 large romano cheese, drained | 1/4 - 1/2 cup strawberry, sliced | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh tarragon | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chopped pickled jalapeno chili | sea salt, to taste
instructions: Combine rhubarb, cucumber, romano cheese, strawberries, tarragon and jalapeno in large bowl. Salt to taste.

title: Egg and Pepper Fondue for Perogies
ingredients: 2 slices bacon | 3 egg whites | 1/2 cup yellow sweet pepper, diced
instructions: Add bacon, stirring to cover bacon. In a small bowl, beat egg whites. Slowly add egg white mixture, stirring briskly until egg whites are glossy and set. Add sweet pepper, stirring, and stir until thoroughly combined. Refrigerate for about 30 minutes before serving.

title: Green Beans With Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb green beans | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth
instructions: Cook beans about 5 minutes in boiling water, until they just start to soften. Drain and place in a buttered oven proof baking dish. Add broth. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Oven Corned Beef Brisket and Vegetables - 6-Qt Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 1 can stewed fruit | 1 1/2 lbs small yellow squash or 1 1/2 lbs butternut squash, halved | 1 small red onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pressure cooker. Secure lid securely. Pressure regulator pressure adjust to high pressure. Bring pressure to high pressure, develop steam to high pressure and process for 17 minutes. Remove from heat and wait until pressure dissipates. Uncover and let stand 5 minutes. Release pressure through mesh strainer. Note, if canned beef brisket is in season, remove from can, drain and return beef brisket to contents of saucepan and reheat using same method.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,pistachio,egg substitute,mini chocolate chip,dijon mustard,silken tofu,chicken
title: Double-Simmered Stuffed Chops
ingredients: 8 mini chocolate chip melts ( one 8 ounce package of melts recommended, 2 1/2 ounces total squares ) | 8 tablespoons egg substitute ( one 8-ounce package of eggs recommended ) | 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour ( up to 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/3 cup reduced-fat silken tofu, drained and pressed ( 2 1/2 ounces total squares ) | 1/4 cup mini chocolate chip ( up to 1/4 cup semisweet chocolate chips ) | 1/4 cup chopped shelled pistachios ( about 1 small bunch ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a medium bowl. Microwave chips in microwave safe bowl on high power 1 min, stirring after 1 minute, until chips are slightly softened, but not browned. Transfer chips to a plate. Add next 3 ingredients to bowl. Stir to combine. Add the egg substitute and oats to bowl.

title: Caramelized Steak
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs round steaks, cut 3/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup hot milk or 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a rimmed baking sheet with greased aluminum foil. Lay the steaks on the foil. Place the pan in the oven. Cook the steaks for 20 minutes. Turn the steaks, seasonings and pour off the fat. Place on a warmed platter. Serve the gravy over the steaks. Garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Apple and Herb Flatbread
ingredients: 4 slices bread flour | 1 teaspoon fresh lemonade | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 teaspoons apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place flour and lemonade in a plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,red chilies,brown rice,tea,caper,beef gravy
title: Roasted Red Chilies and Beef Tips
ingredients: 3 large red chilies | 8 ounces beef gravy, low sodium | 1/4 cup brewed tea | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 cup uncooked brown rice, cooked per package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Roast chilies over indirect heat on a foil lined baking sheet, turning occasionally, for about 40 minutes or until tender and dark in color. Remove to a bowl and set aside. Place broth mixture, brewed tea, capers and beef in an electric slow cooker. Cook on low 5 to 7 hours, or until beef is tender, and gravy is bubbling. Stir rice into beef gravy. Cover and cook 5 to 10 minutes or until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Funghi (Rice, Spinach and Fruit Salad)
ingredients: 5 cups chilled cooked arborio rice, or as needed | 8 ounces fresh baby spinach, washed | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh fruit | 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 jar small cubes ice, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rocket
instructions: Toss chilled rice with diced fresh spinach, fruit, confectioners' sugar, ice and rocket. Cover bowl and chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: pork meat,gruyere cheese,coconut milk,chestnut mushroom,mayonnaise,caster sugar
title: Mushroom Cakes With Gruyère Cheese and Chestnuts
ingredients: 250 g chestnut mushrooms | 300 g gruyere cheese, grated | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 600 g pork meat, chopped into small patties
instructions: Melt half the chocolate in the microwave or a small saucepan and stir in the chestnuts and cheese until melted. Add remaining ingredients except for the oil and stir until well combined. Heat the oil over high heat and fry the patties until browned and cooked through, about 4 minutes each side.

title: Easy and Delicious Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 boneless pork loin chops | 2 cans chicken broth
instructions: In a large pot, pour in the broth. Slice the chops, and dump them in the broth. Cover and bring to a boil. Lower heat, and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve on top of your choice of fried or fried veggies or rice.

Random Ingredients: ginger,tomato paste,chick pea,yellow pepper,celery salt,curry powder
title: Baked Curried Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 cans chick-peas, drained | 1 small yellow pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup minced fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss the chickpeas with the yellow pepper, ginger, curry powder, celery salt, and tomato paste. Transfer to an 8x8 inch baking dish, and bake 25 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,sun tomato oil,garlic,pork tenderloin,vegetable oil peanut,anise seed
title: Chilean Pork Sirloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 -3 tablespoons minced garlic | 2 -3 tablespoons anise seeds, crushed ( optional ) | 3 -4 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 1 1/2-inch thick slices | 2 -kosher salt | cayenne or white pepper
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 400 degrees. In a heavy skillet, heat the oil over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Add garlic, ginger and anise seeds and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly browned about 1 minute. Add pork and stir fry to heat through. Remove pork from skillet. Add the remaining oil to the skillet and heat. Sprinkle 1/2 tablespoon salt and another 1/2 teaspoon salt, cayenne or white pepper to taste. Add the cayenne or black pepper and add pork. Reduce heat to medium and cook about 15 - 20 minutes, or until the pork is browned enough that no blood seeps out of the slices easily. Remove from the heat. Transfer pork to a warm serving platter and keep warm. Pour the warm skillet juices over the pork and serve.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,red chili pepper,beef tenderloin,ginger root,scotch bonnet pepper
title: Mildly Grilled Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 teaspoons minced ginger root | 2 teaspoons freshly grated scotch bonnet peppers | 2 tablespoons garam masala powder | 2 teaspoons minced red chili pepper | 1 pound beef tenderloin, trimmed
instructions: Mix ginger, scotch bonnet peppers, garam masala powder, and red pepper together in a plastic bag.

title: Gramma's Biscuits (Microwave on high for 20 seconds or 2 minutes)
ingredients: 1/2 cup bacon grease | 12 teaspoons tapioca flour, or more if needed ( optional )
instructions: Combine the bacon grease and tapioca flour in a small dish or bowl, stirring well with a fork. Sprinkle tapioca flour on a cutting board or waxed paper and, if using the dough, toss the dough with just enough of the oil to make dough that is still a little sticky. Press the dough into a ball and wrap tightly in waxed paper. Refrigerate the dough for 20 minutes to firm up. Heat a cast iron skillet or deep pot over medium heat. Place the wrapped dough in the skillet and cook about 30 seconds per side, flipping frequently. Remove to a plate. Repeat with remaining dough.

title: Dandelion Grape Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup grape ( fresh or fresh ) | 2 -3 large red onions | 1 packet onion soup mix
instructions: Peal the grapes and cut into small cubes. Chop the onions. Bring all ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes. Serve in a soup bowl, garnished with more sugar. I don't recommend serving this in soup bowls with any other garnish on top.

title: Buffalo Blueberry Salsa
ingredients: 1 poblano chile | 2 cups fresh blueberries, washed
instructions: Prepare your peppers first with a wet brush that has been lightly brushed on the chile seeds. When they begin to pop and turn a little pink, remove them all to a bowl of ice water until they are cooled. Once the chile is completely cooled peel off outer greenish skin of the chiles with a vegetable peeler. Cut the chile into strips about 1/2 inch wide with the skin. You can also peel the papery outer layers off if desired. Put the chile strips on a plate and keep covered with tin foil or cellophane. After you have removed the skin slice into 1/4 slices and put to one side. When ready to serve, either cut into wedges or just put in a bowl with the blueberries. The goal is to have as much of the blueberries as possible. I like my salsa to have chunks of blueberries as a garnish if i am not serving right away.

title: Seafood on Cream Cheese and Bay Scallops
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 3 ounces sirloin steaks | 1/2 lb bay scallop
instructions: Spread cream cheese on scallops, layer with steak and top with scallops.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,yoghurt,gnocchi,salmon fillet,hard egg,cream celery soup,asparagus spear
title: Creamy Salmon Pasta
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon fillet | 250 g asparagus spears, chopped into 3mm lengths | 200 g yoghurt, greek brand style | 200 g cream of celery soup, low fat | 200 g sour cream, breakstone type | 7 -8 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 10 fresh gnocchi
instructions: Boil water in a large skillet. Season salmon with salt and pepper and sear on both sides. Drain and set aside. Bring to a simmer and add asparagus and cook until tender. Whisk together yoghurt, cream of celery soup and sour cream until smooth and creamy. Remove asparagus mixture from heat and stir into salmon mixture. Serve sliced egg gnocchi and salmon topped with soup.

title: Peanut Butter Cilantro Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Whisk together creamy peanut butter, sour cream and cilantro. Serve warm or chilled over your choice of grilled meat.

title: Strawberry Chix White Bean and Strawberry Starter
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can small chunks strawberries, rinsed and diced | 1 snack weet-bix ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in your food processor. Process until smooth. Serve over ice.

title: Spicy Herb Mix
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups fresh flat-leaf parsley, leaves picked from stems | 1 1/2 cups fresh dill seeds
instructions: Stir parsley, dill, and dill seeds with a mortar and pestle or food processor until desired texture is achieved. If using a mortar and pestle, pulse herb with a pestle to break down any large chunks of herb. Store in an air tight container at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,chili oil,white mushroom,mandarin orange,brussels sprout,superfine sugar,cumin powder,flour
title: Chinese Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour | 1 pinch chili oil | 1 pinch cumin powder | 1 pinch superfine sugar | 1 pinch garlic salt | 15 -20 brussels sprouts | 1 mandarin orange | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon flour, extra | 1 pinch cumin powder | 1 pinch superfine sugar | 1 pinch garlic salt | 1 pinch cumin powder | 1 pinch superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 pinch chili oil | 1 pinch cumin powder
instructions: For the brussels sprouts, trim the tops just to be rounded and bottomed off the sprouts. Cut off any hard strings that float. Using a teaspoon, carefully scrape out the peels of the brussels sprouts with your thumbs. If you don`t have very fresh brussels sprouts, rinse them, snap off their tough stalk, and cut them into 2 inch lengths. Cut the stem ends away from the sprouts and discard. Slice into 2 inch lengths. Place in a bowl. Mix together the remaining flour, the pinch of chili oil, the cumin powder, and sugar. Dust the brussels sprouts with the flour mixture and cover with a lid. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or until they are completely plump and soft. Heat up the oil and fry the brussels sprouts until they are dark brown and crisp, approximately 3 minutes. Remove, drain on paper towels, and set aside. For the sauce, combine the mandarin orange, sugar, and a splash of flour to make a stiff paste. Keep warm over low heat, stirring constantly until it starts to thicken, approx 3 - 5 minutes. Sprinkle over the brussels sprouts, and stir to coat. Serve warm. Optional garnish with ancho chili oil, minced hot paprika, or a squeeze of lime juice. Note, for extra spice, i put the extra 1 tbsp of flour and 1 tsp of cumin in a little baggie, finely chopped red onion, and chopped raw almonds into it, and used this mix. Serve with the brussels sprouts.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,olive oil,kielbasa,chili flake,poblano pepper,sherry,peach,onion salt
title: Peach-Kielbasa Hot Dogs(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 4 slices | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 ripe peach, peeled, pitted and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, finely grated | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1/2 cup sliced poblano pepper
instructions: Cook kielbasa in skillet over medium heat, in 1 t oil for a couple of minutes on each side until well browned. Set aside. Combine peaches, sherry, lemon peel, chili flakes and onion salt. Layer kielbasa, peach mixture, poblanos on top.

Random Ingredients: beef consomme,dill pickle,egg white,oriental sesame oil,mexican cheese,beef,chicken bouillon cube,italian sausage
title: Crock Pot Sausage and Beef Empanadas
ingredients: 1 package johnsonville & # 174 mild italian sausages | 2 lbs lean ground beef | 1 3/4 lbs ground italian sausage, casings removed | 1 beef consomme | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon dried dill pickle | 3 tablespoons yellow mexican cheese | 1 tablespoon ground oriental sesame oil | 2 teaspoons fresh italian sesame oil
instructions: In a large skillet, begin browning the sausages. Set aside browned sausages in a separate bowl. Add the sausage directly to the grease in the skillet and brown until the sausage loses its pink color.. Remove sausage to the slow cooker, pour off fat from skillet. Add the sausage back into the skillet, brown on all sides. Transfer sausages to slow cooker. Add the beef to skillet. Add the chicken bouillon cube, pickle, sesame oil, 1 teaspoon of sesame oil and 1/2 teaspoon of ground sesame oil. Add the consommé, 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and 1/2 teaspoon of ground sesame oil. If the consommé is not dissolved completely, add more consommé and/or consommé to achieve a saucy consistency that will coat the casing evenly. Pour the contents of the skillet into the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours, or on high for 3 - 4 hours.

title: Easy Crunchy Fig and Herb Figs With Cool Whip
ingredients: 1 package chopped figs ( i used johnsonville but fresh figs would work too ) | 3/4 cup chopped chives | 2 teaspoons dried dill weed | 1 package nori ( crunchy seaweed ) ( optional ) | 1 container cool whip lite, thawed
instructions: Wash and dry figs, remove white membrane and cut each fig into 4 inch pieces. Cook figs in boiling water for 2 minutes, remove and drain. Meanwhile, mix chives, dill weed and remaining ingredients together in a bowl, add cooled whip and gently fold to combine. Pour evenly over figs. Place on individual plates and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,sun tomato,plain flour,phyllo pastry,salt pork
title: Foil Wrapped Pastries With Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb plain flour ( all purpose ) | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, very thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, finely grated | 1/2 lb sun-dried tomato, oil packed, not drained | salt pork, shredded and finely chopped | 1 phyllo pastry sheet, thawed if frozen
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Line 4 baking sheets with parchment paper. Sift the flour and sun dried tomatoes into a bowl. Season with orange peel. Stir in the sun dried tomato and shredded cheese. Add the salt pork and stir to combine.

title: Classic British Style Lentil Pudding
ingredients: 150 g dry white lentils | 1 cup double cream | 1 1/2 cups grand marnier or 1 1/2 cups other white liqueur | 1 -2 teaspoon tabasco sauce, to taste ( optional ) or 1 -2 teaspoon chili ( optional )
instructions: Soak lentils in cold water and let soak for around four hours, they should still have a lot of moisture. Place them on to a baking tray, spread or steam them for around twenty minutes or until your desired texture. Take out of the oven and mix all the ingredients together except for one or two tablespoons of grand marnier. Pour into an oven safe dish or shallow bowl and sprinkle over the grand marnier. This can also be accomplished in a pan and the resulting soup is just as good served hot, in a small saucepan. The mixture is very thin, i find it easiest to serve it with a nice green salad.

Random Ingredients: tomato,tomato puree,shiitake mushroom cap,penne pasta,orange juice
title: Penne With Orange Shiitake Sauce
ingredients: 5 shiitake mushroom caps, cracked into small pieces | 6 medium ripe fresh tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 lb penne pasta, cooked, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pasta in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, until most of the water from the mushrooms is absorbed and sauce thickens. Transfer sauce to a small bowl and reserve. Saute pasta in remaining sauce and serve.

title: Chipotle Lentil and Chipotle
ingredients: 1/4 cup red lentils | 2 roasted chipotle chiles
instructions: Place lentils into microwaveable dish and heat on high for 5 minutes, then reduce heat and continue heating for 7 minutes. Place chipotle peppers in bowl of a mortar and pestle, pour in oil and chipotle oil and stir to combine. Add in chipotle paste and gently mix. Serve warm with chips from other specialty lentil and vegetables that have been well developed.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,green onion,red bell pepper,beer,gingerroot,baby green
title: Fried Green and Red Bell Peppers
ingredients: 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons gingerroot, julienned | 1 1/4 lbs baby green, with greens and stalks, blanched | 4 red bell peppers, sliced | 1/2 cup green onion, sliced | 3/4 cup beer, heated
instructions: In a wok or large frying pan, heat oil. Add ginger and stir fry over high heat for about 30 seconds, stirring. Add green and red bell peppers and stir fry over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Add green onion and beer and cook for 1 minute or until vegetables are crisp tender. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Beef and Rice Stew With Crispy Crust Crusts
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain quinoa, toasted and drained | 2 cups shredded cooked beef | 14 1/2 ounces stewed tomatoes with ketchup ( such as muir glen ) | 4 slices medium thin rounds steak | 1/4 cup thickly sliced spinach | 1/3 cup chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the quinoa onto a rimmed baking pan or rimmed baking sheet, and bake for approximately 20 minutes, or until crisp. Meanwhile, mix together the beef, tomatoes, and spinach with 1/4 cup of water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes until the beef is cooked and most of the liquid has cooked away. Remove from the heat. Divide the beef stew between four small, shallow ovenproof bowls. Spoon the beef stew over the quinoa and top with 1/4 cup of spinach and parsley. Set the bowls on a baking sheet. Bake for approximately 15 minutes, or until golden and bubbly.

title: Tex-Mex Fiesta Tuna and Spinach
ingredients: 1 bunch green onion, chopped | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can tuna, drained | 1 jar salsa | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Combine all ingredients in a medium casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Slow-Cooker Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lean boneless lamb shoulder - cubed | 1 cup salsa | 1 1/2 cups corn syrup | 1/4 cup crystallized ginger, minced | 1/2 cup crushed cocktail stick ground on stove top
instructions: Place beef, salsa, corn syrup, ginger, and cocktail stick in crock of a slow cooker crock. Cover, and cook on low setting for 4 hours. Turn control to high, and stir every 15 minutes. Serve over rice if desired.

title: Easy Coconut Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut ( shredded ) | 1/4 cup carnation evaporated milk | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon prepared hot chili powder | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1/8 teaspoon pepper ( optional )
instructions: Combine coconut, mustard, condensed milk, chili powder and broth in blender. Mix until smooth. Pour into glass jar with tight fitting lid. Seal and refrigerate for at least 1 hr to develop flavours.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,tart apple,basmati rice,grape,puff pastry,cardamom seed,white kidney bean
title: Apple & Rice Pilaf With Danish Dill Beans & Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon fillets, fillet skinless, cut into 3cm chunks | 1 packet frozen puff pastry | 300 g white kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 4 tart apples, peeled, cored and coarsely chopped | 200 g basmati rice, rinsed & drained | 2 cardamom seeds, cracked | 1/2 cup english grape, halved | 1/4 cup fresh basil, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c / 425°f. Place the salmon and 1/4 packet of beans in a single layer on a baking tray, cut side down. Cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and scatter the remaining beans and apple over the salmon. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and scatter remaining bean, apple, rice, cardamom seeds, and the 2/3 packet of beans on top. Bake for the remaining 10 minutes. Remove from the oven, sprinkle with basil and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,tomato soup,wine vinegar,romano cheese,coconut cream
title: Coconut-Pork Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup wine vinegar | 2 romano cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons grated romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the cream of mushroom soup, tomato soup, vinegar and romano cheese. Stir in romano cheese. Layer ramekins or serving dishes in a pie dish, pouring soup mixture inside. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until bubbly.

title: Kale and Pork Chops
ingredients: 3 -4 bone- in pork chops | 2 bunches kale
instructions: Take two large pans or dinner plates. You can use a 9x13 inch dish if you don't want to use a pansize pan. Take the pork chops out of the freezer and cut into pieces about 3 to 4 inches wide. Dice the pork into large pieces about 1. Add 1/2 of pork chops to each pan. Add kale. Cover pork chops tightly with aluminum foil and bake at 325 degrees f for about 45 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Mama's Strawberry Jalapeno Poppers
ingredients: 1 jar green peppercorns | 1 cup strawberry jam | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 cube shredded fresh ginger root, or to taste
instructions: Place the peppercorns, strawberry jam, taco seasoning, and ginger in a bowl, blend with water, and pour into a resealable plastic storage bag. Seal the bag, and refrigerate for at least 8 hours, preferably overnight. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Remove peppercorns, strawberry jam, and grape seasoning, reserving juices and juice, and place on a cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Remove pepper from bag to a bowl to cool, and set aside, allowing it to cool to room temperature. Warm reserved juices in a bowl in the microwave, and pour over pepper mixture right before eating.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,rump steak,lettuce,five spice powder,coconut extract,red wine,beef brisket
title: Luscious Beef and Pork Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light coconut extract ( if you're not using coconut extract mix it up with a little milk or brandy ) | 2 tablespoons red wine | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 500 g lean beef brisket, in 1 inch cubes | 1 large red capsicum, diced and cut into chunks ( bell pepper ) | 2 large lettuce, heads separated, washed and torn into small pieces | 80 g crisp cooked coriander greens
instructions: Mix all dressing ingredients together in a non metallic bowl. Arrange brisket, capsicum and lettuce on serving plates, and drizzle all with dressing. Garnish with coriander and serve.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,black cardamom pod,peanut,red enchilada sauce,apple cider,strawberry
title: Apple Yogurt with Zucchini
ingredients: 1 large zucchini ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup apple cider | ground fresh black cardamom pod | 12 fresh strawberries, rinsed, patted dry, and halved | 1/4 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup chopped roasted peanuts
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1/4 inch slabs. Using kitchen shears, remove and discard peel and fibers. Cut into 1/4 inch slabs. Scrape seeds and coarsely coarsely chop. In a nonreactive baking dish with at least 3 inches of head space, arrange zucchini, alternating with their rows of zucchini in an even layer, sprinkling each layer with 1/4 cup cider, cardamom pods, and a few whole strawberries. Cover tightly with foil or plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature until filling is completely absorbed. Position oven rack in upper third of oven and preheat to 500 degrees f. Spoon half the filling mixture into a blender.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,liquid smoke,monterey jack cheese,red food coloring
title: Monterey Jack and Red Velvet Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 drops red food coloring | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a jelly roll pan. In a medium bowl, mix together the flour and liquid smoke. Stir in the black and red food coloring. On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes with a cookie cutter. Make a slit in the center of each roll using a teaspoon, taking care not to cut all the way through. Place on the prepared pan, and brush the top with melted butter. Bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until slightly browned.

title: Famous Indonesian Eggplant Kebabs (Eggplant)
ingredients: 2 large eggplants ( about 1 pound each ) | 1/3 cup tomato, minced | 1 teaspoon chili paste, minced | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 3 tablespoons chili paste, minced | 3 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons ginger paste
