instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the eggplants on a foil lined baking sheet. Cut off ends of the vegetables and trim off their ends. Cut a small slit in the eggplants. Cut the tops off the eggplants with a cleaver and discard. Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise along the length.. Remove and discard the soft membrane on the inside of the eggplants. Cut the eggplants in half again lengthwise and remove the pulp. Strip the flesh out leaving about 2 tablespoons flesh. Place the pulp in a bowl and stir in the tomato, ground chile, ginger, brown sugar, and 3 tbsp of chili paste. Let the mixture stand at room temperature for 20 minutes or so, stirring occasionally. Transfer the mixture, covered, to a bowl and stir in the juice and remaining 3 tbsp of chile paste. Place the eggplant kababs on a baking sheet and brush with a small amount of the braing sauce. Bake the kababs for about 30 to 40 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve hot with soy sauce and chile sauce.

title: Mexican Chocolate
ingredients: 6 tablespoons olive or 6 tablespoons butter | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 4 ounces brandy or 4 ounces rum | 1 pinch salt and pepper | 3 ounces unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Heat olive in a saucepan over medium heat until very hot, but not smoking, but not quite sizzling. Add the vanilla and stir to combine. Remove from heat and stir in brandy or rum. Pour into two 8 ounce ramekins. Add salt and pepper, and stir. Serve warm.

title: Simple Red Chili Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 jar prepared red chili peppers
instructions: Put chilis, cream of mushroom soup and chili peppers in a blender, puree until smooth.

title: Homemade Ricotta Crumb
ingredients: 1 cup extra-virgin ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Place the ricotta in a medium bowl. Sprinkle in the bread crumbs and stir until combined. Add parsley, cover the bowl, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Shape the mixture into 2 1/2 diameter round meatballs, and roll in flour. Refrigerate meatballs until ready to use. To bake, preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Arrange meatballs in a 1 inch wide dutch oven. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until no longer pink.

title: Hawaiian Fresh Fruit Salad
ingredients: 3 containers plain yogurt | 1/3 cup pineapple juice | 1/3 cup pineapple chunk, drained | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 2 teaspoons dark rum | 2 green grape leaves, cut in half
instructions: Mix the yogurt, pineapple juice, pineapple chunks, thyme and rum together in a large bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to blend flavors. Arrange the grape leaves on serving plates, piling some of the fruit salad on the leaves.

title: Cream Cheese Vodka Dip
ingredients: 1 ounce cream cheese | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon powdered ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1/4 cup red wine
instructions: Pour the vodka into a glass and warm it up. Add the cream cheese and heat it up. Slowly add the worcestershire sauce and ghee and stir to incorporate. Pour the red wine into the mix and stir to combine.

title: Hors D'oeuvres Au Sirop (Hors D'oeuvres)
ingredients: 250 g beef stock | 50 g walnut halves ( dried shavings )
instructions: Heat stock until just below boiling point. Add nut halves and stir for 30 seconds before removing from heat. Serve hot or cold with bread.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,red kidney bean,almond,picante sauce,corn oil,dark sesame oil,green cardamom,plum brandy
title: Nepalese Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 lb dried red kidney beans ( navy beans ) | 12 ounces ripe plum brandy ( not alcoholic brandy ) | 2 1/2 cups corn oil | 1/2 cup sweet picante sauce ( use pace ) or 1/2 cup favorite picante sauce ( use pace ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 3 cups slivered almonds | 1/2 teaspoon light-colored dark sesame oil
instructions: Wash the beans thoroughly. Soak overnight in warm water to cover by 2 inches. Drain. Cover and place in pot with water just to cover. Put a steamer into a kettle and bring water to a boil. Add beans when boiling. Cover and steam until beans are tender, about 2 to 3 hours.. Drain beans and return beans to pot to keep warm. In a bowl, combine brandy, corn oil, picante sauce, sesame oil, cardamom and seasonings. Mix well or blend in blender 1 to 2 minutes until well combined. Stir in drained beans and almonds. Chill in refrigerator. To serve, ladle into serving bowl and garnish with extra brandy or sesame oil.

title: Caribbean Dippies  from Homes and Gardens
ingredients: 1 can yellow lentils | 1 can unsweetened flaked coconut | 3 -4 teaspoons apple cider vinegar ( or veggie oil ) | 1 can refrigerated pizza crust
instructions: Drain the lentils and rinse them well again.

Random Ingredients: applesauce,kalamata olive,red onion,beef steak,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Kalamata Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef round steak, very thinly sliced and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 cup kalamata olive, pitted and diced | 1 medium red onion, diced | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce
instructions: In large nonmetal bowl, combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,corn oil,fast rising yeast,cauliflower,swiss cheese
title: Swiss Cauliflower & Mushroom Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 packages fast rising yeast | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/2 cup sour cream and mushroom soup | 1 -2 cup finely chopped cauliflower | 4 cups shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Prepare yeast in large mixing bowl. Add 1/2 cup sour cream and 1/2 cup mushroom soup. Whisk 2 cups of water with corn oil in separate bowl, and add to yeast mixture. Slowly stir in remaining 1/4 cup sour cream. When the mixture is foamy and begins to thicken, add cauliflower. Allow to rise 2 hours, then stir thoroughly and place in a large bowl. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. The next day, punch down dough, and knead for 5 minutes, incorporating flour as necessary. Divide into 12 equal size balls. Cover and let sit for 20 minutes, then divide again, and let rise 20 - 30 minutes, until risen. Cover and let sit 10 minutes before bread is lightly toasted. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place a baking sheet on top of each loaf to prevent sticking. Spoon about 1 1/2 tablespoons of batter on to baking sheet, then sprinkle with 1/4 cup of swiss. Place loaf on the pan, bake for 25 minutes.

title: Homestyle Deep Fry
ingredients: 1 gallon peanut oil ( or any vegetable oil ) | 1/2 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep fryer or wide heavy pot to 325 degrees f or a little less. When the oil is deep fryer thermometer reaches 325 degrees f or a little less, pour enough of the hot oil into a bowl to fill the two jars leaving about 1 1/2 inch space at the top. This will fill the jar. After dipping the jar in the hot oil until it is full, remove the jar and the jar from the oil, place onto paper towels to absorb some of the oil, then set aside. When the oil has returned to 325 degrees f or a little less, return the jar to the empty package and let it sit in the refridgerator for about 15 minutes. When the oil has reached 325 degrees f or a little less, drain the jar and spread the sesame oil onto the top. Let it sit until the sesame oil has hardened a little bit. This will take about 30 minutes. This should take about 15 minutes.

title: Pate (Auchter Flage)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely ground veal | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves ( optional )
instructions: Pound veal with flat side of a cleaver. Mix ground veal with ground cloves. Add more if desired. Refrigerate for at least an hour, or better yet, bring to room temperature for up to 1 day, stirring occasionally. Form into small patties. Fry in hot fat until light brown and cooked through, about 8 - 12 minutes from heat. You know what you are talking about when you say you are about to eat a little hot, but they don't have to be cooked all the way through. Store unused portions in airtight container in the freezer for up to 1 week. Leftovers will keep, well covered, in the fridge for a couple of months.

Random Ingredients: margarita mix,red pepper flake,red chili pepper,cornflour,celery seed,tuna steak,ziti pasta,coriander seed
title: Grilled Tuna and Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 3 tuna steaks | 1 tablespoon crushed red chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon crushed coriander seed | 1 dash red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons margarita mix | 1/4 cup sliced celery seed | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Drain pasta. Put in a glass bowl and add tuna chunks, coriander seeds, celery seed, red pepper flakes, and margarita mix. Mix throughly and allow to sit for at least one hour before using. Mix throughly and use as a dipping sauce for the marinade or use as a wrap or use as a dip for the ziti. Serve with lots of crackers and chopped fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,wheat flour,gouda cheese,beef consomme,cucumber,oat bran,orange,beef broth
title: Thai Cucumber Beef Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons wheat flour | 3/4 cup oats bran | 1 can beef broth | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 lb ground beef ( lean ) | 3/4 cup raw cucumber, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh orange rind, grated | 2 tablespoons shredded gouda cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. In a large bowl combine flour and bran. In a saucepan or microwave oven, stir broth and fish sauce in a 1/2 cup measuring cup until dissolved. Add flour mixture to broth mixture.

title: Wendy's Sausage for Harvest
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork sausages or 1 1/2 lbs chicken sausages, casings removed | 1 tablespoon minced ginger ( fresh or dried ) | 1 tablespoon minced lemon zest | 1 can chicken broth | 1/4 cup x-rated fusion liqueur | 2 tablespoons chopped kale | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ( or vanilla extract if you wish ) | dark rum or cognac, for serving
instructions: Heat a large, straight sided dutch oven over medium high heat until shimmering. Add the sausages and saute, breaking them up as they cook, until light golden brown on all sides. Remove the sausages from the pan with slotted spatulas and set aside. Drain the fat from the pan. Reduce the heat to low and return the sausages to the pan, breaking them up as they cook. Add the ginger, lemon zest, chicken broth, fusion liqueur, kale and vanilla. Bring to a simmer and cook, covered, stirring every 5 minutes, for about 25 minutes, adding more broth or water as needed to maintain the liquid level. The finished sausage should be browned on the outside, no longer pink and no longer tough and sticky inside and no longer translucent in the center. Serve the sausage over cooked rice and drizzle with the rum or cognac.

Random Ingredients: toothpick,chicken breast,white vinegar,shallot,sushi rice,maple syrup,plum tomato,guinness stout
title: Seared Chicken and Sun-Dried Tomato Wrapped in Guinness
ingredients: 1/4 cup light maple syrup | 1/8 cup seasoned white vinegar | 12 ounces reduced-sodium chicken breasts, skinned | 12 ounces smoked wood-smoked ham, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped shallot | toothpick | 2 cups prepared sushi rice | 12 plums or 12 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Heat maple syrup and vinegar in heavy large saucepan over medium high heat until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat. Add chicken. Let stand at least 15 minutes. Using tongs or a cutting board, turn chicken over.

title: Fiesta Cheese Pinwheels
ingredients: 2 cups shredded monterey monterey jack and white sharp cheese blend ( not low fat ) | 1 1/2 cups mashed ripe tomatoes with roasted green chilies, undrained ( do not use the kind with a vinegar, i use hot vinaigrette or salsa ) | 1/2 whole canned pineapple, drained ( can use canned ) | 1/2 banana, sliced diagonally into thirds ( optional ) | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla bean, split lengthwise ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon minced hot pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line baking sheet with foil or parchment paper. Combine cheese and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Gently stir in tomato mixture, pineapple, banana, salt, and pepper. Spoon filling into prepared baking dish about 8 inches across and 1/2 inch deep. If desired top with additional cheese on top just before serving. Bake until center is heated through and cheese is slightly toasted, about 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,chili pepper flake,rosemary,tomato puree,kahlua,rice vinegar,onion soup mix,kosher salt
title: Rosemary Russian Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons kahlua | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 3/4 teaspoon dried hot chili pepper flakes ( or more to taste ) | 1/3 cup pure sun dried tomatoes packed in oil or 1/3 cup dried tomatoes, cut into strips | 1 tablespoon dijon-style prepared mustard or 1 tablespoon dijon-style prepared mustard | pinch dried rosemary ( to garnish )
instructions: Whisk together the onion soup mix, rice vinegar, kahlua, mayonnaise, hot pepper flakes, sun dried tomatoes, mustard and rosemary in a medium bowl. Cover and refrigerate up to 2 days, stirring occasionally. Serve at room temperature. Do not refrigerate, as it should be good without it.

title: Whole Wheat Wheat Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat pasta ( spirals ) | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water following package directions until 'al dente'. Drain. Drain. Meanwhile combine tomatoes, thyme, and mace. Stir into pasta. Serve warm.

title: Agua Roti - Indian Lamb Chops
ingredients: 8 lamb loin chops | 1 -2 chipotle chile, minced
instructions: Slice the chops thin on the diagonal. Mince the chilies if using fresh chilies. Dip each chop in the chilies, allowing the excess chilis to run off. Place chops in an oiled baking tin lined with foil. Bake at 180°c for 45 minutes, brushing with the oil as necessary to brown the chops. After 45 minutes add the minced chilies. Let set for 10 - 15 minutes, serve hot.

title: Cherry Tomato Spread
ingredients: 10 cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup sesame paste | 4 -5 tablespoons asiago cheese ( optional ) | 4 -5 tablespoons capers, drained
instructions: Wash and core the cherry tomatoes. Place the tomatoes into boiling water for a few seconds and then drop them into a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking process. Drain the tomatoes and place them in a food processor or blender. If using asiago cheese, add to food processor and blend until smooth and then add in the capers. Transfer to a small bowl and serve with crackers, crackers or as an accompaniment to steak.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jell o gelatin,chili oil,serrano chili,whipping cream,red potato,white bean,pigeon pea
title: White Bean & Chilli Jell-O Jello Salad
ingredients: 300 g white beans, drained | 200 g frozen red potatoes, thawed and cubed | 400 g canned white beans, drained | 200 g frozen cherries | 150 g fresh raspberry jell-o gelatin | 150 ml whipping cream | 1 small serrano chili, chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet chili oil or 1 tablespoon sweet sambal oelek, to serve
instructions: Steam white beans until tender, but still crisp. In a large bowl, toss all remaining ingredients, except jell o, with jello until mix is creamy. Pour mixture into bowl and garnish with pepper flakes.

title: Cumin Chickpea Flour Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups red basmati rice | 1 tablespoon chickpea flour ( besan ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 medium green pepper, diced | 1 medium capsicum, diced
instructions: Heat oil, add seeds of pepper and chopped capsicum. Fry for 2 minutes add dry spices. Add cooked rice, stir fry for 3 minutes. Add chickpea flour. Stir fry for 3 mins longer. Top with chopped scallions and diced ripe tomatoes before serving.

title: Macadamia Nuts & Chilies
ingredients: 8 ounces macadamia nuts, unsweetened | 1 lb cassava, peeled ( or other eggplant ) | 5 ounces green chili peppers, roasted
instructions: Put the macadamia nuts through a food processor or blender. Add the chilis and process until smooth. Wash and dry the cassava. Cut it into 2 thick slices. Cut each slice in half diagonally to make 6 halves about 1/2 wide. Spread each slice with the macadamia nut mixture on a tray. Place the chilis on top of the macadamia mixture and chill before stacking on another tray. Variation, if you wish to freeze all the chilis then store them in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

title: Tandoori Samosas
ingredients: 4 cups chicken stock | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 sheet puff pastry | 1 tablespoon tomato juice ( or water )
instructions: Heat the chicken stock and turmeric, together in a small nonstick frying pan until almost boiling. Roll out the pastry to a thickness of approximately 6 inches on a lightly floured surface, and cut into pieces. Douse the pastry on a microwave safe bowl, and cover with a cloth. Microwave for 2 to 3 minutes on high, or until pastry becomes slightly crisp. Cool slightly, and use to line a 24 x 23 inch pan. Lay the pastry pieces on top, brushing with tomato juice or water. Cover with a cloth, and microwave on high power for 25 to 30 minutes until pastry is crisp and lightly coloured. Remove carefully from pan, and allow to cool. Cut into squares or diamonds.

title: Picante Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb shelled shrimp | 1 jar picante sauce, good quality ( mild ) | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1/4 cup fresh grated nut
instructions: Rinse shrimp well. Dry completely in a clean towel. Combine picante sauce and horseradish and marinate shrimp 2 hours. Toss shrimp and marinade with reserved marinade. Cover and marinate shrimp at least 1 hour. Heat an outdoor grill. Add shrimp to grill and cook for 2 minutes on each side. Remove shrimp and serve with warm salsa on the side. Note, the longer and slower the cooking the shrimp the more tender the shrimp will be.

title: Indian "shrimp" Appetizer (Prawn)
ingredients: 20 -25 medium prawns ( cleaned of heads & tails ) | 1 head lettuce, washed and torn | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( for garnish, i use `` bijol '' spice mix ) or 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Wash, chop and devein prawns & set aside. Grind ginger, turmeric, prawns and fennel seeds using a mortar and pestle. Add the prawns & toss them. Taste for saltiness you should feel somewhat tart. Cover & chill for 30 minutes. Uncover & add enough water to cover the prawns. Place one lettuce leaf on each plate & top with the prawn and sauce.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,onion soup mix,yellow pepper,green pepper,cashew,cabbage,caraway seed,pastry crust pie
title: Mom's Sweet Peppers and Cashews Pie
ingredients: 32 ounces pastry for a 9-inch double crust pie | 1/3 cup onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/3 cup cashews, finely chopped | 1 green pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 small yellow pepper, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 2 cups thinly sliced cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 °f. Roll out pie crust on a lightly floured board to fit inside a 9 inch pie dish. Place the pastry in the pie dish, filling as full as possible. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until crust becomes golden brown. Let cool for 30 minutes. Prepare filling. Mix all ingredients except cabbage in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,chili oil,green cardamom pod,lime peel,golden syrup,dark corn syrup
title: Baked Sweet Chilli
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons sweetened hot chili oil | 2 tablespoons light dark corn syrup | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lime peel | 2 green cardamom pods, split
instructions: Put the flour, chili oil, cornsyrup, golden syrup, lime peel into a large mixing bowl. Stir in the cardamom. Put the chilled flour into an ovenproof frying pan and bake in a moderate oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until well risen and pale golden. Serve immediately with fruit salad or ice cream.

title: Prawns Italiano
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 teaspoon hot paprika, or to taste | 5 leaves iceberg lettuce, very finely shredded
instructions: Combine the tomato puree and hot spanish paprika in a bowl. Place shredded lettuce on two sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap. Spoon a small amount of the tomato mixture onto the lettuce leaves and roll up. Serve with extra tomato puree for dipping.

title: Vegan Refreshing Vegan Pita Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons powdered vanilla | 2 teaspoons nutritional yeast ( a vegan alternative ) | 1 cup texturized vegan margarine ( optional ) or 1 cup vegan spreadable oil, ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the vanilla, vegan margarine, and nutritional yeast.

title: Pudding Beans
ingredients: 1 box vanilla pudding mix | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Prepare pudding mix as directed for a bowl using no milk or fat added water for a softer consistency, or as directed on package. Drain and rinse black beans with cold water. Place in individual 8 ounce ramekins. Chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,cottage cheese,extra beef,golden syrup,meat,white bread,shrimp
title: Hot Shrimp and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground meat | 9 ounces shrimp, peeled and deveined | 12 ounces beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 8 ounces white bread or 8 ounces white bread, crusts removed ( 1 1/2 cups ) | 12 ounces cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees. Brown ground meat using medium heat. Add shrimp, beef, bread, cottage cheese and golden syrup. Mix thoroughly to combine filling ingredients. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with white pepper if desired. Bake for 45 minutes, or until hot.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,yeast,tomato green chilies,cherry liqueur,pork chop,dill
title: Italian Chops
ingredients: 6 dried cherries ( or 4 tablespoons dried cranberries ) | 1/4 ounce dried yeast | 3 tablespoons tomato and green chilies, prepared | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill ( or 1 teaspoon dried dill ) | 8 ounces country-style pork chops, cut 3/4 inch thick ( about 1 lb ) | 1/3 cup goat cheese, crumbled
instructions: To make the marinade, in a small bowl, combine the dried herbs, tomato and chilies, dill and 1 teaspoon of salt. Set aside. Cover and refrigerate the pork for up to 24 hours. Drain the pork, reserving the marinade. Coat 3 - 5 of the pork chops in the marinade, reserving marinade. Place the remaining pork chops in a plastic bag and arrange them in a single layer, in a buttered 9x13 baking pan. Pour the reserved marinade over the pork. Cover and let rise in a warm place, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until done.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce heart,banana,apricot,tortilla,white pepper,kernel corn,white bean
title: Banana, Corn and White Bean Quesadillas
ingredients: 3 bananas, ripe, peeled and diced | 4 romaine lettuce hearts, chopped | 4 cups chopped cooked cannellini white beans ( or other type of canned white beans ) | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 3/4 cup chopped dried apricot | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 tortillas or 1 flour tortilla, sliced into 8 thin wedges
instructions: Combine the bananas and romaine lettuce hearts and combine together in a large bowl. Sprinkle with salt and white pepper to taste. Mix in the beans and corn. Cook in a hot lightly greased nonstick skillet over medium heat, one side, for about 5 minutes or until crisp and golden brown. Cut in quarters and serve with sour cream. Or serve warm.

Random Ingredients: peach,taco sauce,beef tenderloin,yellow pepper,red wine vinegar,graham cracker crumb,orange
title: The Perfect Grilled Beef Tenderloin With Peaches
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, cut into julienne strips | 1/2 medium orange | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Slice beef on the grain into very thin slices. Place in a ziploc bag and combine with remaining ingredients. Mix well and refrigerate overnight. Pre heat your grill and grill until desired doneness. Allow to stand for 5 minutes. Slice meat thinly and place on grill with peppers and oranges on grill or grill. Grill meat until desired doneness. Brush grill with the remaining 1 tablespoon of taco sauce and broil on high heat. Serve with warm tortillas, warm flour tortillas and warm bbq.

title: Nigerian Pepper Cakes
ingredients: 3 -4 hard-boiled eggs | vegetables | pears or lettuce | jalapeno chile
instructions: Break eggs in a bowl with a fork and grate them in food processor, blender or hand blender. You'll probably have to mince the eggs in a second pan. Mash the eggs in bowl. Stir in peppers, lettuce, or tomatoes. Fry at low heat, just a few drops at a time. Serve immediately. Mold in small circles.

title: Apple Blossom Apple Brandy Salsa
ingredients: 3/4 cup unsweetened applesauce | 3/4 cup brandy | 1/2 cup madeira wine | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 stalk celery, chopped | 2 teaspoons madeira wine | 1/3 cup brandy
instructions: Whisk together the apple sauce, brandy, madeira, apple cider, baking soda, and salt. Let stand 30 minutes to allow flavors to develop. Strain apple mixture through cheesecloth or clean coffee filter into a measuring cup. Discard solids. Pour apple mixture into a blender, and process until smooth. Stir in celery and madeira. Apple blossoms, pour madeira wine into a glass, and heat in a toaster oven until the wine has reduced by half ( about 15 to 20 minutes. Strain liquid into a small bowl, and let cool to room temperature. Sauce can be strained, discarding solids. Serve chilled.

title: Pear and Celery Salad
ingredients: 8 ripe pears, peeled, halved, seeded, and finely diced | 4 celery ribs, diced very thinly | 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Toss together the pears and celery. Add the mayonnaise and toss. Serve immediately.

title: Moroccan-Style Pasta With Saffron (Bara Ziti)
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne ( 8 ounces ) | 16 ounces boneless pork chops, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 large fennel bulb, cut into 1/2-inch pieces ( if necessary, remove stalk ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Fill large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti, and return to the boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through but is still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Reserve 1 cup of the pasta cooking water. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, mix the pork and fennel together, tossing to coat well. Break up or crumble the pork pieces into larger bits as necessary to coat. Stir in the saffron and turmeric and toss through the ziti. Serve the pork and fennel sprinkled over the pasta.

Random Ingredients: enoki mushroom,lemon,italian seasoning,beef stew meat,cayenne,fish sauce,coleslaw
title: Asian Beef Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon rind, grated | 1 package enoki mushrooms, soaked in water to cover and cut into 6 slices lengthwise | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1 lb beef stew meat | 2 cups coleslaw or 2 cups cabbage
instructions: In small bowl, stir together fish sauce, lemon rind and 1 tbsp of the fish sauce, set aside. Place half of fish sauce mixture in freezer for 20 minutes to soften. Spread both sides of meat evenly with remaining fish sauce mixture. On each piece of meat, place 1 enoki mushroom slice over the fish sauce mixture. Using a tablespoon, brush the inside of a baking dish with 1 tbsp of fish sauce. Arrange sliced meat rolls in dish, then cover with plastic wrap and freezer. Repeat layering with remaining enoki mushrooms. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Remove plastic wrap from dish. Return meat to baking dish and lightly spray tops with non stick cooking spray. Bake for 50 minutes uncovered until meat is fork tender. Serve with coleslaw and remaining fish sauce mixture and dipping sauce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,kiwi fruit,plum tomato,orange juice,fennel,thymol seed,meat stock,brandy
title: Spinach With Salsa Fresca

instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a small saucepan. Cook, stirring, for 20 minutes, until heated through. Remove from heat. Remove plum tomatoes, cut in half and deseed. title: Swedish Sandwiches

instructions: Lay the rye bread slices out like you would sandwiches. In a small bowl, blend together the cream of tartar and the 2 tablespoons of cooking oil. Spread on both sides of the bread. Heat the remaining oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the bread slices, a few slices at a time, and cook until golden brown about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,purpose flour,collard green,ladyfinger,red onion,lettuce leaf
title: Bountiful Ladyfingers
ingredients: 1 medium red onion, cut in half | 2 bunches collard greens, stemmed and coarsely chopped | 8 medium fat-free ladyfingers, split ( ladyfinger mix ) | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda | 16 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease two 9x9 inch baking dishes. Place onion in food processor.

title: Chocolaty Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, shelled | 6 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa | 1 1/2 pounds salmon fillets
instructions: Place the eggs in a bowl. Cover with water and let stand for 20 minutes. Rinse under cold water. Drain, then cut the eggs in half lengthwise. Remove the yolks. Place the yolks into a medium bowl. Add 1 tablespoon each of cocoa and 1 tablespoon cocoa, stirring with a fork until smooth. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the salmon fillets into a shallow baking pan, leaving enough space between fillets to allow them to spread to the edges. Place the eggs into a saucepan with 1 tablespoon cocoa and 1 tablespoon cocoa, and bring to a boil. Boil until the eggs are cooked but firm. Remove from the heat, and allow to cool to room temperature. Arrange the salmon fillets onto the parchment paper, cover, and allow to dry for 15 minutes. Gently remove the top layer of parchment paper. Place on a serving platter and sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon cocoa.

Random Ingredients: fine salt,baby spinach leaf,chili pepper flake
title: Spinach With Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb baby spinach leaves | 1/2 teaspoon fine salt | 1 chili pepper flakes
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach leaves well. Blanch them in boiling water for about 2 minutes. Drain the leaves in a sieve and then place them in a large bowl. Place the salt, chili pepper and the hot pepper flakes in a clean cloth, squeeze it over the spinach, and dry thoroughly. Place in the fridge for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Sweet Heat Salad Dressing
ingredients: 6 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 cups mixed salad greens
instructions: Whisk together the vinegar and salad greens. Serve.

title: Easy Fusilli Salad
ingredients: 1 package fusilli | 1 cup miracle whip | 1 container sour cream | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the fusilli in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Asparagus with Mango Chutney
ingredients: 3 pounds fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into pieces | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon mango chutney | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 cup freshly grated romano cheese | 1 chopped carrot
instructions: In a large skillet, bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Add asparagus and cook until bright green and just tender. Remove from heat and drain. In a medium bowl, stir together yogurt, mango chutney, basil, and liquid smoke. Place 2 to 3 tablespoons of the yogurt mixture into the center of a serving dish. Place asparagus on the yogurt mixture and surround with the romano cheese and the carrot. Repeat layers until all the yogurt mixture is used.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,pico de gallo,bean,parsley leaf,asparagus spear
title: Mexican Prawns
ingredients: 8 ounces prawns, peeled ( prawns can be hard for this, prawns should're about the same diameter and weight they were cooked ) | 3 tablespoons fat-free refried beans | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, finely chopped | 1/4 cup low-fat pico de gallo ( mexican pico- and chili flavored sauce ) | 3 1/2 ounces asparagus spears, each spear ( i use 2 baby spears )
instructions: Prepare the refried beans according to the directions on the package. Mix the prawns with the beans and parsley and set aside. Prepare the pico de gallo sauce by combining the pico de gallo sauce and 2 tablespoons of water and warming it through. Once the mixture has warmed, add the asparagus and refrigerate until ready to serve. Arrange the shrimp with the prawns on top of the pico de gallo and serve.

title: Sautéed Leeks
ingredients: 6 leeks, white and light green parts only, sliced into thin rings | 2 cups prepared pesto sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Cook the leeks in a skillet over medium heat until soft.

title: Kikkule (Indonesian Soy Dip)
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup almond milk | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour prior to serving.

title: Homemade Hot Sake
ingredients: 1 -2 dried ancho chile, stemmed | 2 cups good quality mild hungarian paprika | 1 tablespoon mild hungarian paprika ( szeged paprika mix )
instructions: Place ancho peppers directly on burner of an old cast iron pan to dry, approximately 45 to 60 minutes. In a mortar or large bowl, coarsely grind the ancho peppers. You should have about 1/4 cup. The best way to do it is to put them into a clean kitchen towel and squeeze them so that they are about 1/4 inch thick. Do not rub them. Remove the stems and seeds from the chiles. Using fingers, make several slashes through the pepper, making a small depression in the chili. Fill the pot with water to 2 inches below the bottom of the pan, adding about 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon more to the chiles as they sit.. Add the paprika mix, stir, cover, and place in the sun with sunlight to reach the sun. Heat the mixture, stirring frequently, slowly and frequently, until the mixture is dark but not burned. It should take about 20 minutes. The idea is that the chili will soften and the paprika will penetrate the chile. As soon as this happens, drain the chili in a strainer lined with a coffee filter or an overturned bowl and set aside to cool slightly. Then put away the chile. When cool, stir in 1 tbsp kosher salt. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Arancini
ingredients: 250 g arborio rice | 300 g liver, cooked | 100 g caster sugar | 200 g grapes
instructions: Fry the rice for about 5 minutes, remove and set aside. Fry the liver for 2 minutes and add to the rice. Make a sugar syrup by melting the sugar on low heat. Add the grapes and cook until the sugar is dissolved.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,black olive,potato,thyme,sesame oil,white vinegar,vanilla ice cream,cream mushroom soup
title: Grilled Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 package peeled and sliced sweet potatoes | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme | 1/8 cup brown mustard seed | 1 cup sliced black olives | 1 pint vanilla ice cream, softened
instructions: Prepare grill for direct heat cooking over medium high heat. Layer sweet potatoes in a glass dish, drizzle with sesame oil, and sprinkle with salt. Cover dish with a lid or wrap tightly with foil, and microwave on high 8 - 10 minutes, until tender. Let cool for 5 minutes, then slice thinly. In a small bowl, stir together soup, vinegar, mustard, thyme, and olives. Add softened ice cream, toss, then chill until serving. Serve warm with sweet potato slices and additional sesame oil and mustard if desired.

title: Hot Dogs for the BBQ
ingredients: 3 -4 canadian bacon | 1 cup molasses | 2 -3 tablespoons catsup | 2 -3 teaspoons garlic powder ( your favorite ) | 1 -2 dried sage leaf
instructions: Preheat grill. Cut bacon into small pieces and fry in oil until starting to crisp. Add molasses and worcestershire sauce. Cook until mixture has a nice consistency and the bacon starts to brown. Add catsup and spices until you get nice smoke. Dump on your cooked bacon pieces.

title: Tandoori Masala
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh tomatillos | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Place all in a pot and heat slowly until tender about 5 days.

title: Tuna Salad - Low Fat
ingredients: 1 can chunk tuna, drained and flaked | 1 large spanish onion, finely chopped ( or more ) | 1 small bunch scallion, finely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve chilled or warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken sausage,beef roast,white wine vinegar,tarragon leaf
title: Portuguese Roast Beef (Antilles)

instructions: Strain the vinegar into a medium saucepan set over medium heat. Add the tarragon and 1 tablespoon of the fresh tarragon leaves and gently fold to combine. Random Ingredients: raisin,vanilla vodka,udon noodle,sherry wine,pineapple juice,vanilla extract,gingerroot
title: Tropical Delight

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,veal,asiago cheese,nutritional yeast,yellow pepper,dark soy sauce,baguette,self raising flour
title: Veal Sandwich Melt in Light Red Sauce

title: Lentils and Poblanos With Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup lentils, picked over | 1 poblano chile, medium, large, medium-size, seeded and finely chopped | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 pint sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine the lentils, poblano chile and garlic, and mustard powder in a dutch oven. Cook, mashing the garlic into the lentils, until heated through. Add the sauerkraut. Cover and cook over moderate heat for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pecan,extra virgin olive oil,peach,lemon peel,taco seasoning,brandy,sultana raisin,cream cheese
title: Riccioli

instructions: Process all ingredients in food processor until mixture starts to come together.

title: Deviled Mango Chutney for Seafood

title: Finnish Lard Bread (Jard) Roll

instructions: Slice bread in half lengthwise. Spread bread with 1 1/2 pound lard. Roll each slice in the lard and slice again. Stack slices and wrap in plastic wrap. title: Lori's Baked Za'atar Oysters

instructions: Place chicken wings, bok choy, and cumin in a large skillet or wok. Heat over low heat for 20 minutes. Add preserves.

title: Quick Herbed Alfredo Sauce Spread
ingredients: 8 tablespoons bertolli pesto alfredo sauce | 1/4 small white onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried herbs ( sage, rosemary, basil, chives. )
instructions: In medium bowl, mix together your own bertolli pesto sauce, onion, herbs, and cheese of choice.

title: Sausage Rolls in Hot White Wine and Chile
ingredients: 1 lb sausages meat ( from 2 slices of sausage ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 6 sheets lasagna noodles ( each about 26 inches long ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1/4 cup sweet white wine, such as port | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon dried chile powder | 1 tablespoon fresh minced chile powder | freshly sliced rice paper sheet, to serve
instructions: Make the filling, in a small sauté pan over medium heat, warm the olive oil. Place the cooked sausage in the pan, and cook until just browned. title: Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 1 pound dried egg noodles | 1 cup chopped fresh escarole | 1 can or bottle dark beer, divided ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1 1 cup thawed frozen lima beans | 1 tablespoon sesame oil, divided | 2 tablespoons hot chutney
instructions: Cook noodles to desired tenderness as directed on package. Drain. Meanwhile, combine escarole, 2 tablespoons beer, lima beans, sesame oil and chili powder in the bowl of a food processor until smooth, about 1 minute. Toss noodles with noodles. Serve.

title: Basil Beef
ingredients: 3/4 cup water | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 4 ounces fresh basil leaves, washed, spun dry, and finely chopped ( about 3 cups ) | 12 ounces cocktail sauce ( any flavor brand and its flavour will vary ) | hamburger buns
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the water and vinegar. Place over high heat, and bring to the boil, stirring often. Reduce heat to low, and simmer about two minutes, until the vinegar has reduced somewhat and the liquid is reduced. Add the basil, and continue to simmer an additional 15 minutes or until just wilted. Add the cocktail sauce, and cook until the sauce is hot and the flavour is perceptibly heightened by the basil. Serve the warm buns with the sweet basil sauce on the side.

title: Avocado Chips
ingredients: 3 avocados - peeled, pitted and diced | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Stir together the avocados and paprika in a frying pan over medium heat. Add a few spoonfuls of batter for each bite.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,white pepper,parmesan cheese,hot green chili pepper,rice vinegar,polenta
title: Polenta Salad With Chili-Greens Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked polenta, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3/4 cup reduced-sodium pasta sauce | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 hot green chili pepper, diced | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat polenta in large nonstick skillet over medium heat 12 minutes, stirring frequently, until golden brown and very creamy. Add pasta sauce, rice vinegar, white pepper and chile pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, 5 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Add polenta to dressing and toss to coat. Sprinkle with parmesan. Serve at room temperature or cover and refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: creme de cacao,rosemary leaf,purpose flour,broccoli floret,asparagus,bicarbonate soda,dijon mustard,steak
title: Steak and Broccoli With Chocolate Glaze
ingredients: 1 lb steak | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons creme de cacao | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 8 -10 cups fresh broccoli florets | 2 cups fresh asparagus | fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: Cut steak into 2cm thick slices. Place flour, mustard and creme de cacao in a bowl. Add steak and rub into flour/mustard mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 30 mins. Meanwhile, steam and steam broccoli until just tender. Drain steaks and arrange on serving plates. Add asparagus to sauce and cook for 1 minues. Spoon over steak and garnish with rosemary.

title: Easy Turkey and Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons canola oil | 3 cups chopped assorted fresh vegetables ( such as sweet potato, zucchini, and green or red peppers ) | 2 cups torn whole grain breaded into 1 x 1/2 inch strips, such as challah or 2 cups cooked turkey | 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas or 1 1/2 cups baked sweet potatoes, peeled & cut lengthwise into eighths | 1/2 cup minced red onion
instructions: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add all ingredients except bread and salad vegetables. Cover and cook until vegetables are crisp tender, 4 - 6 minutes. Stir in bread mixture. Serve at once, or cover.

title: Roasted Veggies with Chive
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups corn oil | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 can chopped mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Heat the corn oil in a skillet on medium high heat. Stir in the bell pepper, chives and garam masala. Cook, stirring continuously, until peppers are cooked, but still bright green. Transfer the vegetables to a large baking dish. Sprinkle with the mushrooms. Bake uncovered in the preheated oven for 35 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,sea bass,tuna water,yellow squash,tomato green chilies,coriander powder,saffron thread
title: Tunisian Fish Ceviche (Salat Iz Pomidata)
ingredients: 200 g tuna in water in shell | 150 g yellow squash ( i used zucchini but all zucchini would be too ) | 150 g head cauliflower ( cut into florets using a food processor or a mandolin slicer ) | 1 small head of cauliflower ( cut into florets using a food processor or a mandolin slicer ) | 1/5 teaspoon saffron thread | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 large tomatoes and green chilies ( optional )
instructions: Peel the tomato and chilies, if using. Cut the onion in small pieces and fry in a frying pan with a little olive oil. Once the onion is a light golden colour add the ground coriander and saffron and stir well for a few minutes. Once it becomes fragrant add the tomatoes and green chillies. Season with a little salt and turmeric and boil slowly until all the liquid dries up from the tomatoes and chilies with the tuna and a bit of water. If the liquid is to thick, add a bit of water to obtain a consistency. Scoop out the florets from the fish with a fork. In a large pot or a casserole dish, layer as follows, tomato paste, cauliflower and tuna mixture, following with remaining tomato paste and finally the sauce. Continue to layer until all ingredients are used up and the dish is full. Put into a preheated oven at 200c or 480f for 45minutes. This can be served hot with your choice of side.

title: Pomegranate & Pomegranate Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, skinned and boned, excess fat trimmed ( about 1 lb ) | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 1 cup pomegranate juice ( if you want, i prefer the flavor of pomegranate seeds ) | chopped fresh parsley ( to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Place chicken thighs in baking dish coated with cooking spray. Combine 1 1/2 cup picante sauce and 1/2 cup pomegranate juice in a medium bowl and stir to blend. Pour over chicken. Cover well and bake 55 to 60 minutes, if you are using it, until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork. Transfer chicken to a platter. Remove pan from oven and increase heat to 400 f. Bake about 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Sprinkle with parsley, if using.

title: Parchment Paper
ingredients: 6 slices parchment paper | 2 cans of italian plum tomatoes | 1 jar maraschino cherries | 1 can beer
instructions: Place a paper square on a baking sheet. Layer the ingredients in this order, tomato, cherries, beer, paprika etc. After that place parchment paper in the middle of the parchment covered baking sheet. Place in a pre heated 350 degree oven for about 15 minutes. Note, check after 15 minutes.

title: Peanut-Mustard Barley
ingredients: 350 g jar barley ( pearl barley ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 90 g jar roasted unsalted peanuts
instructions: Put the barley in a large fine mesh sieve. Rinse well and transfer to a bowl. Add the mustard and nuts and mix gently. Season with salt. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Corned Beef, Rye, and Pepper Toast
ingredients: 1/2 lb corned beef | 4 slices rye bread | fresh cracked pepper | 12 ounces marinara sauce | cornflour
instructions: Place corned beef onto 1 slice of rye bread. Sprinkle pepper over corned beef. Roll up corned beef, securing with toothpicks. Place on top of rye bread slice. Toast under running water until bread is brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: red wine,chili powder,green bell pepper,muenster cheese,oregano leaf,chili oil,string,sugar snap pea
title: Cheesy Pea, Pepper and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces string | 8 ounces fresh green bell peppers | 8 ounces string cut fresh watermelon ( about 1 large ) | 1/4 lb firm cheese string ( such as queta ) | 1/2 lb thin green string fresh oregano leaves | 3/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/8 teaspoon sugar snap pea, strings removed
instructions: Cut string string ends from string. Cut string crosswise into 1 1/2 by 2 inch 1 inch wide strips. Cut cheese string in half crosswise. Cut strip crosswise into 3/4 inch wide strips. Toss string with 1/4 teaspoon chili powder, 1/3 teaspoon chili oil and 30 dabs watermelon and string in a large bowl. Sprinkle with oregano and green pepper. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours and up to 1 day. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,half cream,black pepper,leicester cheese,apricot preserve,ginger,candlenut
title: Grpa-Style Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped candlenut | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 tablespoon ground ginger | 1/8 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper | 1 can coconut milk | 2 cups grated wards grinee cheese or swiss cheese
instructions: Mix candlenut, preserves, half & half, ginger and ground black pepper in a bowl. Heat the coconut milk in a saucepan over medium heat until heated through and starting to form small clumps. Pour hot coconut milk into the chow mein noodles. Stir until coated with coconut milk. Mix the grated cheese with the candlenut mixture. Refrigerate dough according to instructions on the package. Place a ball of the chilled dough onto a clean work surface and roll out until about 1/4 inch thick. Use a small knife to cut off the excess dough. Cut out the desired shapes and place on baking sheet. Top the balls with the grated cheese. Bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven for 20 minutes.

title: Easy and Delicious Moroccan Style Dip
ingredients: 1 loaf french rolls or 1 loaf potato waffle ( 8 oz ) | 1 cup fresh cilantro, roughly chopped, divided | 1 can black olives, sliced ( optional ) | sour topping, like < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/simple-dipping-recipe-432099 '' > simple dippingrecipe < /a > ( optional )
instructions: Slice the french rolls or waffles to make them thinner. Arrange pieces onto a non metallic baking dish or platter. Sprinkle half of the cilantro on top. Arrange olives around the edge of the waffle. Pour remaining cilantro over olives, if using. Sprinkle remaining cilantro over top. Serve with sourdough starter crackers or fresh fruit. Note, topping can vary widely depending on how aggressively you layer it in your particular bowl and how much moisture you added to the mixture. If you have problems getting it to spread, you can sprinkle more of the cilantro before serving and then simply sprinkle more of the cilantro. Note, can be served warm or chilled. Note, you may also serve this with a salad and enjoy.

title: Elegant Whipped Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons melted butter ( to taste ) | 3 tablespoons melted butter | 1 package of sliced fontina cheese or ( 8 ounce ) package monterey jack cheese | 2 -3 tablespoons fruit & nut blends, mixed drained ( to garnish ) | 1 can sliced olives, drained & sliced ( can use fresh fruit, drained if desired )
instructions: Sprinkle grated cheese between two wax paper lined 4 serving plates. Top with melted butter & fruit spread & olives. Serve with fresh fruit or jam.

title: Easy Bacon Buttermilk
ingredients: 6 slices bacon ( cut into small pieces ) | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a medium skillet, fry bacon over medium high heat until well browned, remove and drain bacon bits. Add rest of ingredients to skillet.

Random Ingredients: potato,hazelnut,saffron,romano cheese,thai chili sauce,kidney bean,onion powder
title: Albondigas (Potatoes With Chili and Hazelnuts)
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 2 1/2 cups dried kidney beans | 2 1/2 teaspoons saffron, finely crumbled | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon dried sweetener ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano, chopped | 1 cup coarsely grated romano cheese | 1 bottle of thai chili sauce | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Heat olive oil in a saute pan add onion and garlic. Saute until soft. Add the chili powder, saffron and oregano. Stir until well combined. Add potatoes and mix. Add 1 cup of water to potatoes and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer on medium to low for about 15 minutes until the potatoes are very tender. Add the remaining ingredients and stir until warmed through. Sprinkle with the hazelnuts, if using.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,pickling onion,chili sauce,cooking sherry,salt pepper,shell pasta
title: Spicy Sizzlin' Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs shell pasta, cooked according to package directions | 1/2 medium sweet bell pepper, chopped ( green or red ) | 1/2 medium pickling onion, chopped ( can use red or white ) | 1 1/2 cups bottled chili sauce ( spicy or adjust to your preference ) ( optional ) | salt & pepper ( to taste ) | cooking spray ( optional )
instructions: Seed and dice vegetables. In a large bowl combine peppers, onion and pasta. Whisk in dressing and seasonings.

Random Ingredients: new potato,basil,hard egg,chicken drumstick,beef suet,date,puff pastry
title: Beef, Potato, Egg, and Basil Pies
ingredients: 24 small new potatoes, scrubbed ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/4 lb dried beef suet, patted dry | 12 chicken drumsticks | 1/8 lb dried ripe dates, cut into thin wedges, about 2 ounces | 1 1/2 lbs puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1/4 cup basil, thinly sliced | 1 hard-boiled egg, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place potatoes on a baking sheet. Bake in a 450°f oven until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain on paper towels and cool until slightly warm, about 15 minutes. Bake chicken in a 450°f oven until beginning to show browning, about 15 minutes. Cool to room temperature on a cutting board, about 15 minutes. Remove skin and bones from chicken.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,kernel corn,sage leaf,cayenne pepper,corn cob
title: Corn and Spicy Fresh Corn
ingredients: 4 corn cobs, husks and silk removed | 4 tablespoons dried sage leaves | 4 teaspoons ground cayenne pepper | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup whole kernel corn, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f remove husks from cobs and silk. Spray a large rimmed baking sheet with cooking oil or grease with nonstick cooking spray. If necessary, spray with nonstick spray and place cobs in a single layer on the baking sheet. Bake, turning occasionally, until all sides are toasted and cobs are browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow the corn to cool completely. If the corn starts to darken, add more cayenne pepper and turn the corn over. Spread the mustard on one side of the cobs, then spread the sage over it. Season with salt and pepper and add the corn. Close the oven and bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes, or until corn is done.

Random Ingredients: tonic water,brandy,green bell pepper,egg wrap,rice noodle,salt pepper,corn syrup
title: Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 cup light corn syrup | 1 pint tonic, water | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon brandy | salt and pepper to taste | 20 egg roll wraps
instructions: Cook the rice. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the corn syrup and the entire bottle of tonic water. Mix well and let sit until the water has boiled off. In a large frying pan, add enough oil to cover the bottom. Heat the oil to 375 degrees f. Break the noodles up into large bite size pieces and fry them until golden brown, approximately 5 minutes. Drain the noodles on paper towels and let cool. Combine the cooked noodles with the corn syrup mixture in a pot. Bring to a boil, and reduce the heat to medium. Stirring constantly, cook for 5 minutes. Add the green pepper and brandy. Remove from heat and stir in salt and pepper. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,peanut butter,red thai chile,vegetable oil,beef chuck,black pepper
title: Baiseed Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck | freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 container refrigerated baiseed beef stock or 1 cup beef broth | 1/3 cup thai sweet pickled red thai chile, chopped | 1/4 cup light u.s. light rum if you like it spicier ( bacardi )
instructions: Pat the beef dry using paper towels. Sprinkle generously with freshly ground black pepper and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Drain off as much liquid as possible. Peel away the plastic wrap, discard the excess. Pat the beef dry with ground black pepper, and place in a resealable plastic bag with 1 inch of water. Seal the bag, and put it in the refrigerator to marinate for 30 minutes to 7 days. Remove beef from bag, cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the broiler. Remove all plastic wrap, wrap and towel. Place on a baking sheet. Combine the daikon pickle sauce to create the baayen on the dish. Slice the beef diagonally into 1/4 strips. Arrange a few strips in the dish, sprinkle with the black pepper. Spread the daikon pickle sauce on top. Broil, covered, for 15 minutes, or until beef is beginning to jell. Remove from broiler and drizzle with the rum. Note, daikon pickles add a layer of daikon pickle sauce to the daikon relish, a layer of sueyri kraut and a sprinkling of paprika.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,lime juice,kaffir lime leaf,green bean,crimini mushroom,margarine,polish sausage
title: Baked Polish Sausage and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans | 1/2 lb polish sausage, sliced | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 lime, juice of | 1 orange, zest of | 2 -4 kaffir lime leaves | 8 crimini mushrooms or 8 cremini mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to put a pan of water on to boil. Rinse the green beans and remove tips along their lengths. When the water comes to a boil, remove the ends and cut them into the water as thinly as you can. Put the beans in a casserole or roasting tin and fill with enough water they are just shy of covering them with a lid. Bring to the boil and simmer a few minutes until the beans are tender but still firm to the bite. Drain the beans and dry them out with paper towel. When just done, remove the beans to a bowl. Dry the sausage slices on the pan under the broiler, not the heat on the pan. Butter the inside of the casserole dish with margarine. Turn the sausage slices over about halfway through the frying time, so they brown evenly on all sides. If your oven isn't preffered with oven timings, bake the sausages for about 5 - 10 minutes, until they are lightly browned but not burnt. Add the lime juice to the sausages while they are browning. Cut the zest from the lime, and then grate it by putting a microplane on top of a small bowl of lime zest. It should be pretty well dried up. Set lime zest aside. Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan, and saute in a bit of butter for about 5 minutes on low heat. In the last 1 minute of sauteing, remove the mushrooms from the heat. Toss with the green beans. Spoon into serving bowl with the sausage and green beans. Sprinkle zest on top. Place on greased, foil lined baking sheet. Bake for about 30 minutes. Serve warm with plain white rice. Also delicious with a bowl of chunky or chunky red cabbage coleslaw and a tossed salad on the side for a healthier meal. Enjoy note, this is a quick, easy, and quick, but yummy remake mexican, so you won't be disappointed. The original recipe uses the zest from the lime, or a small can of lime juice, but i've never tried that, and the flavor is great and the zest is not too pungent, but i have tried it both ways and it works just fine. Note, if using a zesty sausage like kielbasa, use it instead of sausage, which i like a great all in one, and then use the lime juice to baste the sausage slices while they are baking. I have never tried this, and i always go out for the lime, but this recipe really serves sooooo yummy.

title: Green Curry Paste
ingredients: 10 pieces of fresh hot green curry paste, with seeds | 1 can rotel, drained | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and use as desired.

Random Ingredients: el paso taco seasoning mix,flour tortilla,green food coloring,masa harina,mint leaf
title: Lipton Street Tacos (Green Chile Taquitos)
ingredients: 1 lb green food coloring ( from 15-20 year old frozen corn-free ) | 1 packet of old el paso taco seasoning mix ( see note ) | 1/2 cup masa harina | 6 -8 flour tortillas | 1/2 cup mint leaf, chopped ( optional ) | extra green food coloring
instructions: Note, el paso can be purchased in the ethnic section of most large supermarkets and it is always a fresher and prettier green chili. Heat corn tortillas in a 10 skillet over medium high heat until lightly crisp and pliable. Transfer to a bowl. Stir together taco seasoning and masa harina. Dip each tortilla briefly into the masa mixture and arrange in lightly buttered, shallow tortilla. Sprinkle with mint and green food coloring if using. Roll up tortillas tightly and place, seam side down, on a cookie sheet in single layer. Refrigerate or freeze any remaining taquitos. Heat grill to high heat.

title: Chipotle Pepper Biscotti (Smoked)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Stir the dried chipotle powder and chili powder together. The dried chili powder helps reduce the smoke flavor of the chipotle pepper and make this a bit easier. Put in a bowl and stir in the biscotti. Store in the fridge for 5 days.

title: Scottish Raisin Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 1 kg of well cleaned raisins | 300 ml white breadcrumbs
instructions: Wash raisins well under running water and drain. Preheat oven to 200c/180c/gas mark 3 5' when mixture comes to the touch, dip raisins in crumbs and arrange on baking sheets coated with oil. Pierce tops of raisins with a fork to make sure they absorb the oil. Bake at 230f/gas mark 3 for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden.

title: Cheese Sandwich With the Microwave
ingredients: 12 slices white american cheese | 12 slices american cheese | 4 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl combine the twelve slices of white american cheese and the three slices of black american cheese. Set the microwave for 5 minutes, then turn the oven down to 50% power. Cover the cheese with five extra slices of the four slices of the four thick white american cheese. Return the bowl to the microwave, cover and cook for 15 minutes on high or until the cheese is melted. Remove the cheese bowl from the microwave and sprinkle the brown sugar over the top. Serve immediately or store the cheese sandwiches in an airtight container.

title: Chocolate-Olive Rice With Asparagus and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice or 1 cup long grain rice | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pod ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 3 stalks fresh asparagus ( about 1 cup )
instructions: Cook rice in 3 cups boiling water until just tender, 2 - 3 minutes drain and rinse under cold water. Meanwhile, toast cardamom pods in a dry large skillet over medium high heat until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Place toast in a mortar, then crush with a pestle, then add chopped and fresh asparagus.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,lettuce,cardamom seed,extra virgin olive oil,sirloin
title: Beef Samosas
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 head lettuce, shredded | 4 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Grind both sides of beef with cardamom and 1/2 cup of water. Cook beef and half the oil and half the water in a covered pot. Drain beef and add the remaining oil. Mix well and add lettuce. Cover and cook 15 - 20 minutes or until it's thick and cooked through. Cool and slice. Lay filo on a hot working space. Lay one sheet to put the meat mixture on, and cover with another. Put a few slices of the meat mixture on top of the sandwich. Roll the piece until it's about 10x spread a little more on top of the sandwich. Put a clean towel on top. Set pan on a burner and do a few flip ups, until all the meat mixture is gone. Put a few leaves on top and roll them.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,almond,pineapple,cilantro leaf,monterey jack cheese,semolina
title: Mexican Cheese Balls
ingredients: 7 ounces semolina | 5 ounces cheese, grated, at room temperature | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, loosely packed | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup canned crushed pineapple | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Place semolina in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Mix until moistened. Pour into greased bowl. Roll into pencil shape and form into pretzel shapes. Place on baking sheet, about 3 inches apart.. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Easy Microwave Chickpea Soup
ingredients: 2 cups frozen cut chickpeas, defrosted | 4 cups vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns ( optional )
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a microwave safe bowl coated with cooking spray on high for 2 minutes, until just tender, but not boiling. Add the chickpeas, garam masala with salt and pepper to taste. Cover with your favourite microwave safe serving dish, and cook on high for 4 minutes, or until heated through, stirring once or twice.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,beef bouillon cube,mascarpone cheese,french bread,mexican cheese,marsala wine
title: Baked Stuffed French Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 1/4 cups marsala wine | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 12 medium shrimp, cooked and cleaned | 1 loaf day-old french bread, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f or 218 degrees c. Line a heavy baking sheet with parchment paper. Place cheese in a bowl. Mash with a fork. Add mascarpone cheese, marsala wine and bouillon cube. Stir until smooth and creamy. Add shrimp and turn into a 1 quart baking dish sprayed with pam. Arrange bread on top of cheese mixture. Sprinkle with mexican cheese. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until light brown. Let stand 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Blue Lagoon Sharbati
ingredients: 2/3 cup blue curacao, or more to taste | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh coriander ( optional ) | 2 cups water
instructions: Mix blue curacao and coriander together in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,cooking oat,lettuce leaf,marinara sauce,basil,garlic paste
title: Quick Oatmeal Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup dark beer | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 250 g quick-cooking oats | 2 tablespoons dried sweet basil | 1 cup marinara sauce | 1/4 cup shredded lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Combine the beer and garlic paste in a small pan, bring to the boil. Remove from the heat, stir in the oats. Return to the heat. Bring to the boil, remove from heat and stand 5 minutes. Stir in the basil and marinara and cool. Place a portion of mixture on each lettuce leaf and roll.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,baby spinach,orange juice,graham cracker crumb,yellow squash
title: Pesto Triangles
ingredients: 1 package frozen miniature phyllo dough, thawed | 1 package baby spinach, washed and coarsely chopped | 1 yellow squash, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 cup plain graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Remove phyllo dough from package, but do not remove before adding the pesto. Place spinach, squash and orange juice into a slow cooker. Cover and cook for about 4 hours on high or 4 hours on low. Remove the lid for the last 15 minutes of cooking. Remove dough and turn it onto a lightly floured cutting board. Cut dough diagonally into 3/4 inch wide strips. Place the strips onto a well greased baking sheet and brush generously with oil. Bake in preheated oven at 450 degrees f for 3 - 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven. Using a fork, separate the strips into strips that are about 1 inch long and 1/2 inch wide. Place strips on a flat work surface. Spoon about 1 tablespoon onto the center of a strip, then top with 1 or 2 tablespoons of pesto. Brush with oil. Fold over and pinch edges together. Repeat with remaining strips and remaining pesto, oil and cheese and spinach until all ingredients are used. Serve immediately.

title: Roasted Daikon Kimchi
ingredients: 1 pound daikon radishes, peeled and sliced thin | 1 tablespoon kikkoman soy sauce
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Spread daikon slices on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle soy sauce over the daikon slices. Bake the kimbap for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the kimbap is to your desired doneness. Remove from heat, and allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Indian Spiced Green Beans (Namak Na Nazi)
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed ( about two lbs. ) | 3 tablespoons finely chopped scallions | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala ( indian spice blend ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Place scallions and garam masala in a small bowl and mix well till scallions are coated in the masala. Scrape off the green beans ends and wash and remove any tough bits of greens with tweezers or your fingers. Place greens and green beans in a medium sized baking dish and pour the marinade over them. Bake covered with foil for 45 minutes. Remove cover and bake again for another 15 minutes, till golden brown. Note, you may serve immediately as an entrée with bread, or add the garnishes of choice..

title: Artichokes
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup ghee ( can be replaced with canola oil, if you prefer ) | 1 dash hot pepper sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Slice artichokes in half with slicing blade, so that you end up with about two or maybe three artichokes for a serving. Soak the artichokes in cold water so that they stay crunchy. Heat the ghee in a frying pan, then add artichokes. Fry the artichokes over med low heat for about 10 minutes, or until the slices are lightly browned on the outside. Remove from heat and set aside. Pour hot pepper sauce into skillet and heat thru.

title: Leek-And-Chive Salad
ingredients: 4 leeks, thinly sliced ( white and light green parts only ) | 12 kalamata olives, pitted ( about 70g ) | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, snipped ( or 3tbsp fresh parsley )
instructions: Mix leeks and olives together in a serving bowl. Sprinkle with snipped chives or parsley.

title: Spiced Hamburger Dinner
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1/2 large vidalia onion ( chopped very finely ) | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried orange rind | 1/2 cup dry white wine ( not cooking wine )
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain off fat and stir in cranberries, asafoetida, rind and wine. Bring to boil, then simmer covered for about 1 hour. Add a few drops of water. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: garlic,saffron thread,pork loin,canola oil,mushroom,parsley sprig,salt black pepper
title: Garlic and Mushroom Looses
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 can mushroom slices, cut into halves | 4 garlic, thinly slivered | 1 pinch saffron threads, crushed | 5 lbs boneless pork loin, all visible fat removed and the solids coarsely chopped | salt & freshly ground black pepper | parsley sprigs, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. In a large 12 inch sauté pan, heat the oil over moderately high heat until smoke rises. Add the mushrooms, garlic, saffron and salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Add the pork and a few tablespoons of water. Cover the pan and bake the loasts for 30 minutes. Add the garlic mixture and cook, uncovered, for an additional 25 minutes to brown the meat. Transfer the pork to a serving dish and garnish with parsley. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,curry leaf,za'atar spice mix,pineapple tidbit,vegetable,dark rum,sesame oil
title: Aceitun Vegetable and Pineapple Skewers
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables, cut into eighths ( spinach, red bell pepper or onion ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable, spice mix ( see note below ) | 1/4 cup dark rum, divided | 6 red chilies | 1/4 cup pineapple tidbits | 10 fresh curry leaves ( see note below ) | 1 teaspoon toasted sesame oil ( optional ) | 1 cup za'atar spice mix, powder
instructions: Note, marinate salad greens, as follows, aceitun greens, mix red bell pepper with 1/4 cup rum. Arrange vegetables on plate. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon toasted sesame oil, if using. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon za'atar. Spoon over salad greens, adding pineapple tidbits, curry leaves, and chiles. Toss salad, veggies, rum, and remaining 2 tablespoons rum in large bowl until well blended. Serve with toasted sesame seeds or poppy seeds or coarsely chopped nuts with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: wakame,cream chicken soup,red chili pepper,ginger garlic paste,greek yogurt,orange zest,chunky salsa
title: Quick and Easy Salsa W- Yuzu Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange zest | 2 hot red chili peppers | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups plain fat free greek yogurt ( plain yogurt is fine ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 2 cups chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons low-sodium chunky salsa
instructions: Combine orange zest, chiles, cream of chicken soup, yogurt, ginger garlic paste and salsa. Stir gently to blend. Serve with tortilla chips or rice.

title: Spinach and Brown Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 1/2 cup organic baby spinach or 1/2 cup collard greens | 1/2 cucumber, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons lemon zest | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Toss together spinach, cucumber, lemon zest, and cooked brown rice until well combined. Chill and serve.

title: Easy Skirt Steak for Two (Cook and Sandwiches)
ingredients: 4 -6 small red potatoes, scrubbed clean | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 - 1 1/2 lb skirt steak
instructions: Preheat over to 300 degrees f. Slice both ends off each potato and remove string.

Random Ingredients: cavatappi pasta,radish,red potato,worcestershire sauce,french bread,white wine,mint leaf,tomato green chilies
title: Spicy Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fusilli or 1 lb cavatappi pasta | 2 lbs small red potatoes, scrubbed | 2 large tomatoes and green chilies | 1 loaf french bread, cubed | 2 cups chopped radishes | 1 cup white wine | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 bunch fresh mint leaves, minced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add, potatoes. Cook until just tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. Drain and transfer to a lg. Boiled bowl and let cool slightly. Cut in half lengthwise, then cut out the middle of each half. Cut each half into 4 equal portions. Place the cooked potatoes in a large bowl and add the tomatoes, chiles, bread, radishes, wine and worcestershire sauce. Toss gently. Top with mint and serve at once over the cooked hot pasta.

Random Ingredients: vital wheat gluten,blueberry,mint sprig,tea,beef bouillon granule
title: Blueberry Mint Soup
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups fresh blueberries, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon vital wheat gluten | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves ( optional ) | 4 cups hot brewed tea
instructions: Place the blueberries, vital wheat gluten, bouillon granules, and mint in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Pour hot brewed tea over the top and gently stir. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Green Goddess - Mint and Lime Paletas
ingredients: 14 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 6 1/2 ounces crumbled coconut cream | 1/4 cup fresh lime peel, chopped | 1/4 cup minced fresh mint leaves | 2 1/2 cups ice water | 1/4 cup hot pepper, chopped ( i just like spicy! ) | filling : | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | coconut cream
instructions: Combine spinach, coconut cream, lime peel, mint, ice water, and hot pepper in a blender, and process until smooth. Pour into serving bowl, and stir in lime juice and additional hot pepper for garnish. Cover, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Just before serving, sprinkle coconut cream on top.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,green chili pepper,chipotle pepper,baguette,cayenne pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,maraschino cherry juice
title: Chipotle Poached Spinach Sandwiches
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2/3 cup chopped green chili peppers ( fresh or red ) | 4 tablespoons maraschino cherry juice ( or grapefruit juice ) | 1 jar chipotle peppers, drained and chopped in adobo sauce ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon fresh cayenne pepper | 16 slices baguette, toasted | 16 ounces fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Place a heavy nonstick skillett or heavy skillet over high heat. Add in the oil, then the green peppers. Sauté for about 2 to 3 minutes, until tender. Stir in the cherry juice, chipotles, and cayenne. Remove from the heat and stir in the baguette slices toasted until just warm and pliable. Spoon the mixture into a pastry bag with a star tip, or if you're lazy like me, a knife tip and snip off a corner. Arrange the spinach leaves, overlapping, over top of the spinach mixture, close, and snip off the bag. Serve with chipotle dip. Chipotle poppyseas, in a small bowl, blend the chipotle in adobo with a little water until smooth. Store in a glass jar in the fridge,. Chipotle poppyseas will keep in the fridge for up to 6 weeks.

title: Feta Cheese Cracker Spread
ingredients: 250 g feta cheese, crumbled | 100 ml dark soy sauce
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, crush up the feta cheese, then add the soy sauce and mix well. Form into crackers and press evenly onto greased and floured baking tray. Bake in a moderate oven for about 15 mins. When cool, drizzle with your favourite dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,red chili paste,lite olive oil,kosher salt pepper
title: Lite Red Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 ounces ramen noodles ( or any seasoning packet ) | 5 tablespoons red chili paste ( i like szechuan peppercorns ) | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | kosher salt and pepper
instructions: Add ramen noodles or seasoning packet to a bowl of iced water, allow to sit for 5 minutes to soften, drain. Once cooled, chop roughly and then combine with other chili paste, olive oil, salt and pepper. Serve hot. Note, you can substitute red pepper flakes for the chili paste, or you can add it to the chili paste with oil and a pinch of cayenne pepper.

title: White Beans & Zucchini Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 2 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cups heavy cream | 1/2 lb zucchini, sliced
instructions: Cook all noodles according to directions. Drain noodles and spread over bottom of 9x13 baking dish with cream. Place zucchini on top of cream/zucchini. Top with bean mixture. Bake covered, at 375f for 50 - 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,sea scallop,yellow mustard,pork,lettuce leaf,coriander,chicken bouillon granule,honey
title: Grilled Scotch Scallop & Honey Mustard-Steamed
ingredients: 1 cup minced scallops | 4 teaspoons honey | 1 pinch chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup prepared yellow mustard | 1/4 cup honey | 1 cup coarsely chopped coriander | sea scallops or shrimp, steamed | 4 soft lettuce leaves | 2 teaspoons ground coriander
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the mustard and honey. Brush 2 teaspoonfuls of the mustard mixture on the scallops. Place a scallop on a plate, sprinkle with the scallop mixture, top with the honey mustard spread. Drizzle the remaining mustard mixture over the scallops. Sprinkle with coriander.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,chipotle powder,heavy cream,guacamole,garlic,apple pie filling
title: Applebee's Irish Cream
