ingredients: 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 clove garlic, squashed | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons guacamole | 1 jar apple pie filling, drained
instructions: Mix the sugar, cream, garlic and cocoa powder together in a bowl until well blended. Stir in the guacamole and then spread mixture in a 9 x 13 inch pan. Spread the apples over the guacamole. Place guacamole side by side in a small pan with the apple sauce, then pour the sauce over the guacamole. Cover baking sheet with foil and heat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until edges have turned a deep golden brown color. Let cool in pan.

title: Asian Burger With Mushroom and Basil
ingredients: 8 burger or 8 hamburger | 16 slices habanero chili peppers ( thin-ish slices ) | 8 slices shiitake mushrooms ( thin-ish slices ) | 16 leaves thai basil ( fresh or dried ) | 1 teaspoon seeded and finely chopped serrano pepper
instructions: Divide hamburger, chili slices, mushrooms and basil among four patties. Spray grill with cooking spray. Grill burgers 3 minutes or to desired doneness, brushing frequently with sauce.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,half,italian seasoning,vanilla essence,lemon peel
title: Lemon Cream Substitute for Cream (Made with real Lavender)
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup lemon juice, fresh squeezed | 1 tablespoon dried lemon peel ( or finely chopped lemon zest ) | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning ( or blend all ingredients ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( or add vanilla flavoring )
instructions: Mix all ingredients with an electric mixer. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: sage,caper,whipping cream,halloumi cheese,rice wine,colby monterey jack cheese,lemon wedge
title: Halloumi Cheese and Rice Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 large halloumi cheese, halved lengthwise, about 1 1/2 lbs | 2 tablespoons capers | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons dry rice wine | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh sage | 4 tablespoons shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place four large sheets of parchment paper on baking sheet, and brush with oil. Using a small spoon, coarsely mash halloumi with capers and cream into a fine paste. Add rice wine and sage, and carefully fold in cheese with a rubber spatula until cheese melts. Taste and add more cheese if needed. Using the tip of a paring knife, cut a horizontal slit in each halloumi 1/4 inch thick, leaving a 1/4 inch space on each cheese slice that does not touch the bottom of the paper. Carefully fill each mushroom with cheese mixture, and transfer to parchment lined cookie sheets about 1 inch apart. Bake until well browned and bubbling, 15 - 20 minutes, and transfer to a large platter. Serve with lemon wedges, if desired.

title: Apricot Stuffed Bread
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream soup ( campbell's ) | 1 can apricots, drained | 1 loaf round bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f. Combine all ingredients except bread. Cut top off loaf of bread. Place bread on cookie sheet and place in oven and bake 15 minutes until bread is crispy. Remove bread from oven and top with soup mixture. Return to oven and bake until soup is bubbly again.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,cooking tapioca,spaghetti,tomato,italian seasoning,chili sauce,daikon radish
title: Tomato-Onion Pasta
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 1/4 cup quick-cooking tapioca | 1/4 cup onion soup mix | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 cup daikon radish, minced ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta. Drain. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, prepare onion soup mix as directed. Stir in tomatoes, chili sauce, italian seasoning, and radish.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,vegetable,chunky salsa,scallop,pork back rib,orange zest,green onion,cheese
title: Grilled Steak and Scallops
ingredients: 6 tablespoons vegetable oil or 6 tablespoons nonstick vegetable oil | pork back ribs | 2 lbs scallops | 2 onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 2 cups chunky salsa | 2 medium green onions, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 6 slices of thick cut processed cheese
instructions: Wrap the ribs in heavy duty aluminum foil and freeze for at least 10 minutes. Remove and discard the ribs from the freezer and slice into 5 wide rib chunks. Heat 2 tbsp oil in large skillet. Cook the scallops, including any juice. About 5 minutes per side or until barely opaque. Remove the scallops to platter. Cook onion in the remaining 3 tbsp oil in the skillet over medium heat for about 3 minutes or until translucent. Add onion and onion flakes cook 4 minutes or until aromatic, stirring constantly. Pour half of the salsa over the scallops, onions and onions. Stir in scallops, green onions and remaining salsa. Cook over medium heat, stirring until heated through. Sprinkle orange zest over the top and serve.

title: Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 -2 cup bourbon | 10 chicken thighs
instructions: Place roast & beer in crock pot with meat. Cover & cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Remove meat & thighs & shred & return to crock pot. Pour sauce into small gravy boat or clear glass bowl. Top with a slice of french bread. Serve with mashed potatoes for an incredible dinner.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,rice noodle,clove,parmesan cheese,jumbo shrimp,poblano chile
title: Garlic-Garlic Shrimp Noodles
ingredients: 12 ounces jumbo shrimp, peeled, deveined | 6 cloves garlic cloves, thinly sliced | 2 poblano chiles, peeled, seeded, chopped | 2/3 cup loosely packed cilantro leaf, chopped | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese | 3 packages dry rice noodles, cooked | fresh cilantro leaves, for garnish, such as arugula
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine shrimp with garlic, poblano chilies, and 1/2 cup water. Cover and bring to a boil over moderate heat.

title: Roasted Parsnips with Tahini
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds parsnips, peeled and sliced and separated into rings | 1 cup tahini | 8 lime wedges, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange parsnips in a single layer on foil. Drizzle with about 1/2 cup tahini. Sprinkle parsnips with remaining tahini. Wrap aluminum foil tightly around parsnips. Refrigerate to marinate at least 1 hour. Bake in preheated oven until tender and golden, adding more tahini as needed.

title: Bananas on a Buns
ingredients: 4 bananas, cut in half length ways and lengthways | plain flour, extra for dusting | 12 slices good quality bolillos sandwich buns
instructions: You will also need, 2 buns. To bread the buns, spread each with flour and top with about 3 pieces of banana. Sprinkle over the extra flour and lightly press the sliced bananas with a rolling pin or the back of a wooden spoon to flatten and remove any excess flour then, with your other hand, press the bananas into small rounds. Place the rounds on a baking tray and bake them at 200c for about 10 - 15 minutes, until browned and soft. If you wish, you can serve these with cream or custard. If you want to serve these with ketchup, spoon a small amount of ketchup into an oven proof dish, spread each layer with a little extra flour and put under a hot grill until the ketchup starts to bubble and then turn heat to medium. Serve these hot with salsa or tomato sauce. As an accompaniment, use buns that have been sliced and then topped with tomato or cucumber slices.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,fish sauce,skirt steak,seasoning mix,penne pasta,ice,brown sugar
title: Thai Skirt Steak With Penne Pasta and Fresh Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak, cut from the back | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar | 1 package dry penne pasta ( i like whole wheat penne ) | 2 packets thai seasoning mix | 2 cups ice, or as desired
instructions: In a large freezer bag combine the fish sauce, cardamom and brown sugar. Add the skirt steak.

title: Homemade Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon xanthan gum | 3 tablespoons pouring cream | 4 -6 serrano peppers
instructions: Preheat oven on convection oven. In a small bowl combine xanthan gum, cream and serrano peppers. Take a 9 x13 baking pan and brush with the olive oil. Using a wet pastry brush dipped in the olive oil, brush the surface of the phyllo with the mixture, keeping the sheets covered with a damp cloth. Remove the phyllo sheets from the baking sheet and sprinkle lightly with more of the xanthan gum. Place a large sheet of phyllo on top, covering dough entirely. Using the remaining sheets, coat with more of the olive oil. Using a pastry brush coated with olive oil, cover the sheet with a damp cloth. Cut the layered phyllo into 12 squares. Place a square on work surface. Laying in half diagonally, add about 1 1/2 tablespoons of filling to the middle of the square. Fold corners to center, then fold corners in half diagonally. Then fold diagonally to resemble a triangle. Repeat steps 7 - 9 until you have 12 triangles. Repeat with remaining dough, filling and phyllo. Place triangles 2 - 5 inches apart on lightly floured baking sheets and brush top with olive oil. Bake in 425 degree and 20 - 30 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Remove from the oven, cool on baking sheets, then cut diagonally into 6 pieces. Serve warm. Note, you may add some cooked vegetables, such as tomatoes, or a combination of these. This freezes very well and will last up to 6 months in the freezer.

title: Greek Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 1/2 cup pitted kalamata olives | 4 chicken drumsticks or 4 chicken legs with thigh
instructions: Open up the olives and stuff both the legs and thighs with them. Place the stuffed olives in a zipper bag, close the bag and shake to coat. Place in the refrigerator and let it sit at least an hour, or overnight, then remove the olives with a slotted spoon or spoon into a pot of simmering salted water. When the drumsticks are done, place them in a shallow baking dish or casserole dish and pour the hot pan juices over them. Let them marinate at least 30 minutes, or up to 6 hours, at room temperature.

title: Golden Guacamole Cookies
ingredients: 1 package guacamole | 1/2 cup of your favorite golden syrup, i use about 2 tsp. per cookie ( i use my recipe for this ) | filling ( recipe will not be as smooth, just the guacamole )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Mix the golden syrup and guacamole. Roll into little balls using about 1/3 cup of the guacamole for each cookie. Flatten the flattened balls with the bottom of a drinking glass. Bake the cookies for about 15 minutes, until golden brown. Cool. These can be frozen with any type of frosting.

title: Chinese Takeout Vegetable Soup
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 bunch shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 quart skinless, bone-in chicken meat - cut into 1 inch pieces | 6 cups hominy, rinsed and drained | 1 parsnips, peeled and chopped | 8 fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat and coat with cooking spray. Stir in 1/2 of the sliced mushrooms, the chicken meat, hominy, parsnips, and shiitakes. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let soup stand for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chinese noodle,celery rib,halibut fillet,rigatoni pasta,onion,coconut milk
title: Coconut Halibut
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups thin chinese noodles | 2 tablespoons ground round | 1 ounce halibut fillet | 1 onion, chopped | 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 tablespoon dried sweetened coconut milk or 1 tablespoon light coconut milk powder | 14 ounces creamed coconut milk
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions and set aside. Meanwhile, place the fish, onion, celery and ground round in a skillet. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir frequently over medium heat until the fish is cooked through. Add the coconut milk and cook through. Add the cooked noodles and stir to cover. Serve with a salad to accompany.

title: Russian Cheese Pies
ingredients: 1 lb farmer cheese | 4 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Mix the ingredients together. Roll small balls out a little bigger than the size of the walnuts. Cut a hole in the middle with a little hole cut in at the top. Place on a plate and store in a cool dry place.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek leaf,spice,oat,monterey jack pepper cheese,tomatillo,rosemary,white bread,red chili powder
title: Smoky Tomatillo Quiche
ingredients: 3 large tomatillos or 3 medium tomatillos | 2 tablespoons rolled oats | 1 medium red chili powder | 1 sprig sprig fenugreek leaves | 1 sprig rosemary | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 4 slices white bread ( toasted, your preference ) or 4 slices bread ( toasted, your preference )
instructions: Slice tomatillos thin with a serrated knife, set aside. Place the sliced tomatillos on a cookie sheet in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 25 minutes, turning with a spatula occassionally, till softened to your taste. Meanwhile, heat a grill pan over medium low heat. Place the oats, chili powder, fenugreek leaves and the herbs in a food processor and pulse till finely chopped. Remove the tomatillo from the oven and drain the liquid, chop and place in a large pie dish. Spread chopped tomatillo and oats over tomatillo mixture. Using a knife or a sharp carving knife, make 1 small slit in the the crust about 1/8 from the edge of the top of the tomatoes. Scoop out tomato flesh and place into oven till slightly puffed up. Allow to cool slightly then remove crust from dish. Cut into four wedges and place into pie dish. Sprinkle top & bread with grated cheese. Bake in oven for 15 minutes or till cheese is melted.

title: Strawberry-Asafoetida Dip Mix
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon thymol seed | 1 tablespoon strawberry, chopped ( or other favorite fruit ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 1 -2 teaspoon salad oil ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Grind thymol seeds to a fine powder in a food processor, or with a mortar and pestle. The finer grind the crumbs will be, the more enhanced the flavor. Transfer to a small bowl. Add strawberries or other favorite fruit, and mix well. Serve immediately as a dipping sauce or as accompaniments to hot roti or bread.

title: Easy Low Sugar Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat buttermilk or 1 cup evaporated milk | 1/4 teaspoon dried capers, chopped | 1 tablespoon small-dotted hot-tinseradish paste ( to taste if using milk )
instructions: Combine buttermilk/milk, capers, and hotsauce in a small saucepan, and heat until milk is hot but not boiling. Stir, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,genoa salami,white bread,pizza sauce,sun tomato oil,coffee
title: Italian Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 slices white bread | 6 slices genoa salami | 12 slices sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 18 ounces pizza sauce | 3 tablespoons brewed coffee, divided | 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºf. Line 12 small rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Arrange 3 slices of bread on each work surface. Place equal amounts of salami and sun dried tomatoes on the bread, leaving 1/2 inch of crust on the surface area. Brush the outside of all the sandwiches with 1 teaspoon water. Place the remaining 3 slices of bread on top of the salami and sun dried tomatoes. Top the bread with enough pizza sauce to cover. Place 1 chicken thighs under the bread, pressing down to submerge into the sauce. If all 4 surfaces of the sandwiches are not covered with sauce, you may need to sprinkle bread with flour to help prevent sticking. Place 2 more bread slices over the top of the chicken. Add 1/4 cup of coffee and 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Repeat layering, alternating with remaining slices of bread, making sure to sprinkle each sandwich with coffee and salt. Cook for 20 minutes. Cut between the two sandwiches to serve.

title: Plantain Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 2 cups dry wine | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 green plantains, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices | 1 jar diced pimentos, with juice
instructions: Combine the rice and wine in a medium saucepan over high heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and cover tightly. Simmer until the rice is tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain completely, and allow to steam dry in a strainer set over a bowl set in the sink for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, lightly beat the mustard in a small bowl. Drain the plantains, pat them dry, and cut them into 1/4 thick slices. Wipe out the wok with kitchen towels. Heat the hot rice, mustard, plantains, and pimentos in the hot wok and stir until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Tamari Cheese Danish
ingredients: 500 g low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup raw strawberry | 1/2 teaspoon maple flavoring or 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 pie shell | 2 teaspoons tamari
instructions: Sprinkle tamari onto cheddar cheese. Place strawberries on top of cheese and dot with cheese mixture. Bake at 180 - 190 grades c for 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,egg yolk,tangerine,potato starch,apple cider vinegar,mayonnaise,herb,turkey
title: Tangerine Chicken (Korean)
ingredients: 450 g minced turkey | 450 g minced chicken breasts | 2 egg yolks | 1/2 cup tangerine ( orange pulp ) or 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs ( like dill, dill chives, and chives ) | 3 1/2 teaspoons potato starch ( kinako ) | 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Mix together the turkey, chicken, and egg yolks, stirring until well blended. Add the tangerine or lemon juice and vinegar, stir until well combined. Stir through the herbs. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8 hours. In a small bowl, stir together the kinako and potato starch. Spread mixture onto a floured surface. Divide dough into 24 equal portions and shape into flat round balls. Heat 1/2 inch vegetable oil in a large skillet. Fry the fish over medium heat for 5 minutes, turning once. Transfer to a serving dish and cover with foil.

title: Galinha
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dried galangal, crushed in a mortar | 1 cup fresh rose water | 1 cup milk | 2 serrano chilies, stemmed seeded
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Let mixture stand for 5 minutes. Strain mixture through a chinois lined strainer. Store refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: basil,red chili,half,dill,french bread,celery rib,apricot preserve,monterey jack cheese
title: Apricot French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 sweet red chili, cut in half, seeds removed | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 cup half-and-half | 3 medium celery ribs, chopped | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill | 1/2 teaspoon red chili flakes ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 8 slices dry french bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the green chili into very thin slices. In a small bowl, stir the jam, half and half, celery, dill powder and red chili flakes. Pour half of the sauce into a shallow 2 cup baking dish. Arrange the bread slices in the baking dish. Pour about 2/3 cup of the sauce over the bread. Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes. Remove foil and top with the rest of the sauce and cheese. Return uncovered to the oven and bake an additional 15 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,pepperoni,allspice,lemon,chicken breast half,icing sugar
title: Grilled Spiced Chicken
ingredients: 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 lemon | 1 teaspoon allspice | 6 green cardamom pods, crushed | 4 boneless chicken breast halves | 10 pieces pepperoni
instructions: Finely grate the zest of the lemon. Using a lemon, scrape the pith from the outside of the lemon, removing any seeds. Place the grated zest in a large bowl with the icing sugar and season with the lemon zest or lemon juice, allspice and crushed cardamom pods. Add the chicken, turn with a large, moistened skewer or small sharp knife to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight, turning occasionally. Lightly brush or brush both sides of the chicken with oil. Grill over a hot fire until the chicken is just cooked through, brushing or spraying with a small amount of oil each time you turn it. Serve warm or at room temperature with a salad of lettuce, ripe tomato and/or zucchini. Store the chicken in the refrigerator in a tightly closed container for upto 3 days.

title: Nan-Chow
ingredients: 2 cups cold water | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 3/4 cup cold water | 1/4 cup rice | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 8 small chicken drumsticks ( about 8 oz. )
instructions: Combine water and cornmeal in heavy medium saucepan.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,yellow cornmeal,sesame oil,tomato juice,cumin powder,onion powder,parmigiano reggiano cheese,macaroni
title: Macaroni with Sesame and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cups fresh tomato juice | 1 cup dry macaroni | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: In a saucepan bring tomato juice and salt to a boil, reduce. Meanwhile, cook macaroni in boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain and place pasta in a large bowl. Add tomato mixture, remaining ingredients and cheese and mix thoroughly. Toss with clean hands and allow to rest for 10 minutes. While the macaroni and tomato chill, combine sauce ingredients in a small pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally for about 20 - 25 minutes, or until desired thickness and color is achieved. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: blue curacao,gluten flour,egg yolk,nonstick cooking spray,cottage cheese
title: Crusty Blue Cheese Pies (Low Fat)
ingredients: 4 ounces low fat cottage cheese | 4 ounces cholesterol free low-fat cheese ( i used light and fluffy blue cheese ) | 1 tablespoon gluten-free flour, sifted | 1 tablespoon nonstick cooking spray | 1 egg yolk, lightly beaten ( with 1 tsp. of water )
instructions: Preheat oven 425f degrees. In a medium bowl combine cottage cheese and 3/4 cup of cheese mix with your choice of dry ingredients. Mix well. Form into 1 balls. Put on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake 18 - 25 minutes until just lightly browned on top.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,picante sauce,cheese,mexican cheese,canola oil,cream,scallion,pumpkin pie spice
title: Pumpkin Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cans whole pumpkin pie spice | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 1/2 cups mexican blend cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican cheese | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup scallion, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dry red pepper
instructions: Empty pumpkin pie spice and picante sauce into saucepan and over medium heat cook, stirring constantly until very hot and thick enough to make spoonable dip. This will be runny. Pour about 1/2 can of pumpkin mixture into a shallow pie pan and cover with the mexican cheese and the mexican cheese mixture. Top with sour cream, scallions, red pepper and picante sauce. Dip is best when served the next day.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,lettuce leaf,poblano chile,chicken bouillon cube
title: Roasted Chiles With Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe poblano chiles, stemmed, seeded & deveined | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 4 cups packed shredded lettuce leaves | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler. Combine chilies, boullion & 1 cup water in slow cooker. Cover & cook on high setting for 3 to 4 hours or until chiles are tender. Remove from heat & drain liquid. Lightly spray a large sheet of heavy duty foil with vegetable cooking spray. Place chilies on foil and place in broiler & broil, turning once, until charred & softened, about 10 minutes. Transfer to bowl & cover w/ foil. Allow to stand until cool enough to handle. Cut off top of each chile half & pull out the seeds & membrane, then discard. Scoop out the seeds & stem. Fill a medium bowl w/the cheese. Stir in 1/2 cup of the reserved chile liquid, then pour over the cheese & chilies. Serve at room temperature.

title: Cashew Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar roasted garlic pears, chopped, reserve 1/4 cup liquid | 1/2 cup cashews | 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup plain dry breadcrumbs | 2 -3 tablespoons triple sec | 2 -3 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Drain the jar of pears of garlic with the reserved liquid, pour off the liquid and let this sit while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. Mix together the flour, bread crumbs and triple sec until well mixed. Dip chicken pieces first in seasoned flour then crumbs and set aside on a clean work surface. Pour enough oil into a large cast iron skillet to reach a depth of 2 inches. Heat oil on medium high heat, this should only take about 1 minute.

title: Faux Dates (Sweet) With Corn Flour
ingredients: 500 g pitted dates ( about 12 dates of the same date ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Put cornflour into a bowl. Peel and cut the dates into chunks. Place the dates in a pan of water. Boil till the dates have just turned light. Drain the water. Place half the dates in a blender. Add about 2 1/2 tablespoons of cornflour. Blend till mixture is smooth. Add this mixture to the dates, then mix well. Turn off the heat. Sprinkle the remaining cornflour on the dates. Serve with hot curries or fried rice.

Random Ingredients: bulk pork sausage,ginger,elbow macaroni,liquid honey,apple cider,tarragon,italian sausage link,apricot preserve
title: Apple-Cider-Sausage Nests
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds bulk pork sausage | 1 1/2 pounds hot italian sausage links | 1 jar apricot preserves | 1 cup apple cider | 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger
instructions: Place the pork and hot italian sausage in a large dutch oven, and cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain, and set aside. Return the toasted italian sausage to the stove, and cook until evenly browned. Mix in the apricot preserves and cider. Bring to a boil, and cook for 5 minutes. Cover, and then reduce heat to a simmer. Stir in the macaroni and cook for 10 minutes. Remove the lid, and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the macaroni is tender. Stir in the honey, tarragon, and ginger. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, for another 10 minutes.

title: Baked Ziti-- Cod and Ziti Style
ingredients: 1 pound ziti pasta or other small pasta, such as ditalini | 2 1/4 pounds fresh cod, with skin
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Prepare and boil as directed on package. Meanwhile, remove cod from skin, rinse and pat dry with paper towels. Spray a casserole dish or roasting pan with cooking spray. Bring a large saucepan 3/4 full of lightly salted water to boil. Cook ziti 5 to 10 minutes, or until just tender.

Random Ingredients: toast,tomato paste,pinto bean,hot sauce,fenugreek seed,walnut,beef brisket
title: Sharon's Sweet-Sour Beef Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 4 cups hot beans ( or more ) | 1/2 cup toasted walnuts | 1/2 cup dried canola oil or 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 pinches dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Trim fat from meat and cut meat into 1 inch cubes. Mix tomato paste with 4 cups of hot beans and season with salt and pepper to taste. Soak toasted nuts in water for 2 hours, then grind to a fine powder. Heat oil in a large frypan on medium high heat and brown meat well on all sides. Add fenugreek and fenugreek and mix well. Add onions to the pan, sprinkle with remaining nut powder and add water to cover the meat and tomatoes. Cover and simmer on low heat for 2 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Add water if needed to get an even gravy. Sharon is done when meat is tender but not falling apart. Serve with rice and fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,tomato paste,beef tenderloin,vanilla sugar,pork sparerib,graham cracker,parsnip
title: Beef Spareribs With Cornmeal Crust
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef tenderloin, cut into 16-oz. pieces | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/2 cup unseasoned graham cracker, crushed | 2 tablespoons parsnips, grated, drained | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons cornmeal, coarsely ground | garnish : parsley, paprika | 12 whole garlic cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a shallow 2 1/2 x1/2 inch baking pan, arrange 4 pork spareribs, overlapping. Combine tomato paste, graham crackers, parsnips, and vanilla sugar.

title: Pasta with Pimento and Ziti
ingredients: 1 pound dry ziti pasta | 1 jar diced pimentos, drained
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ziti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink, and spread the drained pasta out onto a large platter. Toss with the pimentos, and serve immediately.

title: Drunken kidney beans
ingredients: 250 g dried kidney beans or 250 g brown beans | 200 ml gin | 1 medium spring onion ( very coarsely chopped )
instructions: Soak kidney beans in cold water for a couple of hours to soften. Drain. Place in a pot with the spring onion and enough cold water to cover them. Bring to boil, cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Drain. Serve with crusty bread, or crackers.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,golden raisin,marjoram,saffron,baby spinach leaf,heavy duty aluminum foil
title: Beef Gumbo Roll
ingredients: 8 ounces beef chuck ( trimmed of all external fat ) | 8 ounces baby spinach ( torn into manageable pieces ) | 2 tablespoons golden raisins, chopped | 4 ounces marjoram, chopped ( fresh or dried ) | 12 ounces heavy sodium aluminum foil, warmed ( approximately 36 squares ) | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, coarsely crushed ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 500f degrees. In a large saucepan combine all ingredients except the aluminum foil. Turn heat up to high. Sprinkle saffron over meat, if using. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until meat is cooked through and beginning to brown on the edges and juices begin to run from meat. Do not overcook it. Remove all of the vegetables from the pan and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Spread meat on the foil to allow it to roll. Bake for approximately 45 minutes or until the meat is completely cooked. Serve the meat topped with any of the gumbo rolls you have laying around.

title: Butternut Squash Potato Stew
ingredients: 1 pound butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 1/2 red potato, cubed | 1 tablespoon minced shallots | 1 can chopped clams in juice | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco
instructions: Cook squash and potato in boiling water for 15 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl. Place the clams in a saucepan with the shallots and minced clams. Pour in the clams and reserved clam juice. Toss until all ingredients are thoroughly coated. Heat an oiled frying pan over medium high heat.

title: French Dip Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin chop | tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Wrap pork chop in cheesecloth, tie with kitchen string and place in oven. Bake at 250 degrees f for 75 to 90 minutes, or until a meat thermometer registers 150 degrees f. Remove from oven, set aside and serve with tortillas.

title: Chocolate Flour Tortas
ingredients: 250 g cake flour ( all purpose ) | 1/2 small chocolate square, melted | 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard
instructions: Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl, and stir until the mixture resembles bread flour. Form into a disk using plastic wrap. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 190c. Flatten the disc with a rolling pin on top of a lightly greased or nonstick baking sheet. Lightly oil a 20x30cm swiss roll tin if you have one. Roll out the dough to about 2mm thick. Cut into strips about 5 or 6cm wide. Push a slice of chocolate into the center of each strip. Sprinkle a few drops of water on to the edge of each strip and pinch the edges together to seal. Place on the lined tray and bake for about 15 minutes, until set. Store at room temperature or in the fridge for up to 1 week.

title: Orange Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces dried spaghetti ( uncooked ) | 1/2 cup dried orange, cut into 1/2-inch segments | 2 1/2 tablespoons garlic paste | 2 tablespoons fresh lime, peeled and chopped | 2 tablespoons chipotle peppers, crushed
instructions: Bring 1 quart of water to a boil in a wide pot. Add the spaghetti and cook according to package directions, or until tender but firm to the bite. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl, combine the orange segments, garlic paste and lime juice. Pour the blended ingredients, and chili peppers through a strainer to remove the seeds and membrane. Bring the pan back to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring constantly, for about 5 minutes or until thickened and syrupy. Stir in the spaghetti and serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander,beef stew meat,white wine vinegar,mayonnaise,cooking oil,coconut
title: Coriander Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon dried coriander or 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 1/2 lb beef stew meat or 1/2 lb steak, chopped into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup flaked coconut, toasted and coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl. Makes enough to dip coriander for 12 small whole grain rolls.

title: Smoked Green Vegetable Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chilies or 1 teaspoon dried chilies | 4 cups sliced bok choy, 1 inch wide leaves | 1/2 cup shredded sirloin beef or 1/2 cup smoked pork | 1/2 cup sliced red cabbage
instructions: Heat oil in a non stick wok or large skillet over medium low heat. Add chilies.

Random Ingredients: stevia,vegetable broth,lemon zest,head cauliflower,linguine,chili oil,mace,ginger garlic paste
title: Baked Cauliflower with Noodles
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cored and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 cups vegetable broth, or more if needed | 2 teaspoons chili oil, or more as needed | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest, or more to taste ( optional ) | 12 ounces linguine, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange cauliflower in a single layer in a baking dish.

title: Chari Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 1 lb of ground chicken | 1 egg, beaten | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 2 cups powdered sugar ( adjust to your taste )
instructions: Make the pb&c by combining all ingredients and stirring a few times, until smooth. Heat the oil in a wok or large fry pan. Add the chrispa mix and stir fry about 1 - 2 minutes. Break into the wok and stir fry until the pb&c starts to brown a little. Add the peanut butter and chocolate syrup. Mix thoroughly and serve.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,thai red chili pepper,molasses,cardamom pod,corn tortilla
title: Thai Black-Eyed Pea Tacos from the Jar
ingredients: 8 corn tortillas | 2 cans black-eyed peas, drained | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon molasses, or more as needed | 2 thai red chili peppers, or more to taste
instructions: Mix black eyed peas, ground cardamom, and molasses together in a bowl. Sprinkle chili peppers over the mixture, and wrap with corn tortillas. Place in a baking dish with enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,poblano chile,oil,golden syrup,gluten flour,cognac,star anise,french bread
title: Anise Seed Potatoes With Cognac Filling
ingredients: 12 small baking potatoes | 1 cup gluten flour | 1/2 cup french bread ( cut into 2x3 inch squares ) | 1 teaspoon light golden syrup | 3/4 cup cognac | 2 star anise | 3 poblano chiles, roasted and diced | 4 pepitas, peeled and diced into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine flour, french bread, golden syrup and cognac in a food processor or blender. Process until mixture resembles fine bread crumbs. Stir in chiles, pepitas and spices. Place potatoes into a large pot and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until potato skins are tender when tested. Drain, and transfer to a baking sheet lined with foil. Bake in oven until very lightly golden, about 20 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bacon,tomato green chilies,tomato juice,lamb chop,green chile pepper
title: Mom's Chunky Green Chile Lamb
ingredients: 1 package bacon | 2 pounds boneless lamb chops, cut into cubes | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, drained | 1 can diced green chile peppers
instructions: In a large skillet over medium high heat, fry bacon until evenly brown. Drain, crumble and set aside. Reduce heat to medium. Add lamb to skillet. Brown lamb on all sides. Mix in tomatoes with green chilies, tomatoes with green chilies. Drain excess fat. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer slowly for 1 hour.

title: Herbed Cornflour Balls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Mix the cornflour and thyme together. Add the mixture to the palms of your hands. Place onto greaseproof paper lined tray and refrigerate for 1 hour. Turn out onto a lightly oiled surface and roll into a ball. Take a cornflour cube and cut into pieces with a knife, then roll in the cornflour cubes. Place onto lightly greaseproof paper lined tray and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 2 days before serving. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,orange zest,poultry seasoning,arugula,cardamom seed,double cream,barbecue sauce
title: Fiery Arugula (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches arugula | 400 ml double cream | 2 teaspoons orange zest or 2 teaspoons lemon zest | 1 1 green chilies or 1 hot green chili pepper, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons sweet barbecue sauce
instructions: Wash, dry and dry the arugula.

title: Roast Beef and Yogurt Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low-fat plain yogurt | 1 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef | 8 sheets uncooked lasagna noodles
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Arrange noodles on work surface. Top each noodle with 1/2 teaspoon yogurt. Arrange beef on top of yogurt. Roll up noodle tightly, securing with toothpicks. Arrange in a 13x9x2 baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap. Let stand 15 minutes at room temperature. Preheat oven to 400°. Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes. Uncover. Bake 5 minutes longer or until noodles are crisp.

Random Ingredients: leek,red curry paste,extra virgin olive oil,sea salt,wheat flour,corn kernel,half
title: Laks and Corn Fritters With Thai Spices
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 small leek ( white, pale green parts only ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | 5 ounces creamed corn kernels ( fresh or frozen ) | sea salt | half-and-half ( a splash ) | 2 -3 teaspoons unbleached wheat flour ( see note )
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and gently fry the leek, stirring, until softened and translucent, about 3 to 4 minutes. Add the curry paste and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes. Pour the creamed corn into a large bowl and add plenty of salt and cracked black pepper. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Add to the pan with the leeks and blend everything together until just beginning to bind together. Transfer to a warm bowl. Add half and half and combine. Heat a non stick frying pan over medium heat. Sprinkle the surface very lightly with sea salt. Pour in a ladleful of the curry mixture, and swirl it around to get all of the sticky coating. The fritters should feel somewhat dry at this point and quite pliable. When the fritters have reached the desired texture, add a few teaspoons or more of warm water or half and half if the liquid dries up. Cook for 1 minute. Tip, if the fritters are too dry, add a splash of half and half at a time. This will help soften the fritters to the consistency they like. When the fritters are pliable, remove them from the pan and transfer them to a serving dish. Serve immediately or keep warm by itself in a 200 degree oven while frying the fritters.

Random Ingredients: tangerine juice,pimiento,egg white,red cabbage,cornstarch,baking chocolate,red bell pepper,cola beverage
title: Cuba Libre Holiday Salad
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped red cabbage | 1/2 cup finely chopped red bell pepper | 3 egg whites | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup cola beverage | 1/2 lb semisweet baking chocolate, chopped | 1/3 cup chopped pimiento | 1/2 cup tangerine juice
instructions: Combine first five ingredients. Put in a plastic bag.

title: Capellini
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Combine. Add a dash of sugar. Stir to mix. Enjoy.

title: Jalapeno Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 package wild rice ( not quick ) | 2 cups cornmeal or 2 cups flour
instructions: If using a rice flour, you can use regular flour and it will make a nice crispy dough. If using quick rice, it will be a little thinner. Heat a deep fryer to 375°f, grease and/or line 2 baking sheets. You might need a little more or less depending on the length of your fryer. Use a teaspoon to roll and stretch the rice into rectangular strips about 2. Keep the cornmeal in separate container or dishes on a cookie sheet and cover it with flour. Dip it in the batter and fry them on each side for about 3 - 5 minutes until they start to turn golden. You will need to keep them in mind that they will turn out to brown quicker than the regular rice when done. Do not crowd them, they will be hot once you eat all the rice.

title: Penne Pasta With Veal, Cucumber and Meat
ingredients: 500 g finely diced veal | 4 penne pasta, cooked according to package directions ( preferably al dente ) | 1 cucumber, julienned | 1 pinch dried nutmeg
instructions: Mix the veal with cooked pasta. Add any of the following, and serve.

title: Quinoa Chaat (Quinoa and Chocolate Chips)
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked quinoa, rinsed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup unsweetened chocolate chips | 1/4 teaspoon table salt | 2 teaspoons baking potatoes, peeled, cut into 4 triangles each ( or 1 1/4 cups baking potato and salted butter ) | 2 teaspoons curry paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Place 1/2 c quinoa in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, remove from heat, cover, and set aside. Heat the 1/2 c quinoa. Meanwhile, melt the chocolate, butter, and curry paste using a dry skillet over low heat. Stir in the quinoa and cook, stirring, until dryened, 3 - 5 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Spanish Cocanchoke
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes | 1 spanish onion | 1 1/2 cups red wine | 2 tablespoons spanish cachaca, in the liquor | 2/3 cup white chocolate, melted
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes and onion into 1/4 inch pieces. Chop or pound the white chocolate. Sauté the onion in the beer and chocolate over medium heat until the onion is lightly brown. Add the potato and onion mixture and sauté for 5 minutes. Serve warm topped with cheese slices, salsa, croutons, spanish rice, sour cream, etc as desired. Serves about 2.

title: Baked Beef Tips and Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 can sliced roast chicken | 2 1/2 lbs sirloin tips steak, cut into 1 1/2 x 1/2 inch strips | 2 lbs beef tenderloin, halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss the chicken with the meat. Arrange in a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish and add 1/2 cup water. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Remove foil. Bake for 20 minutes longer or until meat is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: French Toast
ingredients: 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 cup cheese ( daiya or gouda cheese works best ) | 1/8 lb cooked medium shrimp ( i like to use fresh pre cooked shrimp ) | 1/2 pumpernickel bread ( or other bread )
instructions: Heat a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Lightly spray with oil. Add the shrimp and cheese and saute stirring for 2 - 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. Remove to warm plate. Toast the pumpernickel and top with fried shrimp. Use as required.

title: Korean-Style Seasoned Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 3 -5 dashes tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 4 slices fresh fish fillets ( or 1 pound boneless round )
instructions: Combine parsley, a couple splashes of tobasco, and 1/8 teaspoons salt in a small bowl. Put fish in a medium saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium, and simmer for about 20 minutes to cook fish. Drain, reserving about 1/2 cup of the fish cooking liquid. Cut fish into thick slices, about 1/8 inch thick. Serve with parsley flavored dipping sauce. Note, i prefer the traditional Korean table condiment. Some people prefer to use an additional tablespoon of tobasco to flavor.

title: Lemongrass Bean Paste
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 can chopped lemongrass, undrained
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor. Process until fairly smooth.

title: Cranky's Famous Snack Bread
ingredients: 1 large head of garlic | 2 small bag plain cake flour | 6 tablespoons instant powdered instant instant bouillon or 6 tablespoons instant dry vermicelli | snake beans ( optional )
instructions: Remove the top and bottom of the head of garlic, wrap in paper towels and microwave on high heat until softened, about 15 minutes. Discard garlic peel. Cut a 1/4 inch slice from each garlic clove. Put garlic slices in a small bowl, and microwave on high until soft, about 1 minute on each side. Remove garlic from microwave and pat garlic dry. Combine flour and instant powder in a small bowl, or other non metallic container with a microwave safe cover. Sprinkle baking powder onto flour mix and spread onto a piece of plastic wrap so that it's just barely covered. Coat an 8x8 square of bread with butter flavored oil or spray with non stick cooking spray. Spread dough mixture onto baking sheet and top with knishes. Spray top of bread with non stick cooking spray and bake at 325 degrees f for about 35 to 45 minutes, or until bread is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: white onion,prosciutto,chicken bouillon granule,taco seasoning mix,vidalia onion,wide rice noodle,chicken bouillon,italian herb
title: Sopa De Dexter
ingredients: 1 package dried wide rice noodles | 12 cubes chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup chopped white onion | 1/4 cup chopped vidalia onion | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb | 4 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 1/2 pounds prosciutto, chopped
instructions: In a large pot, dissolve two chicken bouillon cubes in water. Add onion, vidalia onion, italian beef bouillon, and bouillon. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes. Remove 1 cup of the broth, and stir in 1/2 cup of the reserved broth. Remove 2 cups of soup, and set aside. Return broth to a boil, and stir in remaining soup. Cover, and return to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes. Remove from heat, and allow to cool. Add a pound of the chopped prosciutto, and return to a boil. In a separate container, dissolve two 3 or more chicken bouillon cubes in 1 1/2 cups of the reserved broth. In a separate bowl, dissolve 2 - 3 more chicken bouillon cubes into 2 cups of the soup. Dissolve 2 - 3 more chicken bouillon cubes into the soup. In a saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of melted butter. When butter is hot, add one package of the conrstituted wide rice noodles. Cook, stirring frequently until the noodles are lightly browned and tender, and have an even coating of butter underneath. Drain the noodles, and place into a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Repeat process with 2 more tablespoons of melted butter and one package of conrstituted noodles. Pour soup over noodles, and top with a layer of chopped prosciutto slices. Cover with remaining noodles. Cover with soup. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for several hours to allow flavors to mingle. Allow to chill, and serve as is or over noodles.

title: Linguica Style Linguica
ingredients: 3 boxes linguica style spaghetti ( one package if you like pasta style ) | 1 package msg ( found in the international grocery section )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add in the linguica and bring to a boil again. Cook linguica until al dente, about 6 - 10 minutes. Drain. Put pasta back on heat and add in msg, stir and simmer for 2 minutes.

title: Charmie's Parsnips, Snow Peas and Apples Salad
ingredients: 2 medium parsnips | 6 apples | 1 cup sweet champagne vinegar | 1/2 cup salsa or 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon grass, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup dried champagne vinegar | 1 can anchovies, chopped ( in oil )
instructions: Peel the parsnips and parsnips. Chop the peels, core and slice the apples. Place in a pot with boiling water and simmer until soft. Remove from heat and drain. Place the apple and parsnips in a bowl.

title: Salt-Free Packeted Lemon Barbecue Appetizers (Using a Barbecue Rub)
ingredients: 16 cups salted and boiling water | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup mrs. dash seasoning salt | aluminum foil
instructions: Note, i used the recipe #488671 salt free method to prepare this recipe. It is not recommended to use salt free method of preparing salt free barbecue dishes to make the final product watery. Some may have salt visible, but i did make my salt free packets and i went online for one after making this for a friend. Combine all ingredients, except the aluminum foil, in a bowl and mix well for a few minutes to bring the salt free sauce to a boil. Add in the foil and stir well. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, increase heat slightly to high, then bake for an additional 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,grand marnier,ginger paste,lime wedge
title: Cointreau Paste
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 1/4 cups grand marnier ( orange-flavored liqueur ) | 2 lime wedges, for garnish
instructions: Combine mustard seeds, ginger, and grand marnier in a small heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, whisking frequently to blend. Reduce heat to medium low, add lime juice, and cover. Allow to steep about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Transfer to mortar and pestle or food processor with a pinch of salt. Makes about 1 teaspoon. Keeps in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,ponzu sauce,kernel corn,purpose flour,chili oil
title: Aji Crab, Lobster and Sweet Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh lobster tails, shelled, but not peeled | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1/4 cup ponzu sauce ( kikkoman brand ) | 1 package all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup hot chili oil
instructions: Combine the corn, ponzu sauce and the shrimp in a big bowl. Add the chile oil and whisk until coated. Toss the corn mixture in the flour and coat thoroughly. Heat a nonstick skillet to medium heat. Add the shrimp mixture to the pan.

Random Ingredients: shrimp paste,pie crust,baby corn,cream chicken soup,sun tomato,lemon,romaine lettuce
title: Shrimp & Vegetable Rollups
ingredients: 1 medium lemon, juice of | 1 tablespoon shrimp paste ( kecap manis ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 4 tablespoons diced roma lettuce | 2 teaspoons sun-dried tomatoes, chopped ( or 2 tbsp fresh ) | 1 refrigerated pie crust
instructions: Preheat oven 450 degrees. Mix together lemon juice, shrimp paste, cream of chicken soup, roma lettuce, sun dried tomatoes and lemon juice/pepper mixture. Unroll pie crust and remove the crust. Spread one third of the filling mixture over the bottom half of the pie crust. Press together gently and lightly. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Bake 25 minutes or until heated through and bubbling. Slice into 8 rows and serve with kuccheri or your favourite salad, if desired.

title: Caper Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2/3 cup light sour cream or 2/3 cup mild sour cream | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/3 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until thoroughly blended. Seal in a cap jar.

title: Eggplant Sandwich
ingredients: 4 large eggplants | 8 ounces genoa salami | 8 anchovy fillets
instructions: Wash eggplants very carefully under running water in a colander. Cut the tips off the bottom part, being careful not to poke holes in the skin. Cut slices into four even sections and put into a colander, making sure they are completely drained. Set colander over sink or small bowl. Wash and dry salami. Cut salami into four thin slices and place on top, laying anchovies on top. Drain fat from colander and place a large frying pan on top of the sandwiches. Heat sandwich over medium heat for two minutes. Carefully open and spread top with a small portion of eggplant.

title: Easy Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped
instructions: Pierce the tenderloin with a fork, then place it on a plate with a cover with plastic wrap. Sprinkle pork tenderloin with salt and let stand until a meat thermometer reaches 145 degrees f, about 30 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes and cut into 10 slices. Place onion slices onto a plate or roaster with a lid. Place roaster in a heated oven and bake pork tenderloins for 20 minutes. Serve with roasted vegetables. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat should read 145 degrees f.

title: Japanese-Style Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green apples, such as granny smith, unpeeled, seeded, cut into 1/4-inch-thick slices ( about 3 cups ) | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk vinegar with green apple slices. Stir in rice vinegar. Cover, and chill up to 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: sherry,ginger root,red wine vinegar,szechuan bean sauce,oregano leaf,red snapper,okra,mustard powder
title: Cha Cha - Ozuan Stuffed Fish
ingredients: 4 red snapper | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1 1/2 teaspoons szechuan hot bean sauce | 1 tablespoon crushed ginger root | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1 pinch mustard powder, or as needed
instructions: Preheat outdoor grill for high heat. Lightly oil the grate. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray with cooking spray. Arrange snapper on the prepared baking sheet. Combine oregano, sherry, hot bean sauce, ginger, vinegar, ginger, and mustard powder in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: italian bread crumb,monterey jack pepper cheese,rigatoni pasta,sharp cheddar cheese,salt black pepper,pistachio,crema,chinese white rice wine
title: Ragout (Rigatoni With Rice Wine and Pistachios)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned bread crumbs ( such as boboli ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped unsalted pistachios | 1 package rigatoni pasta ( about 3 1/2 cups ) or ( 16 ounce ) package linguine pasta, uncooked pasta shells ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 12 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( about 2 cups ) | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup chopped unsalted pistachios | 1/4 cup chinese white rice wine | 1/2 cup crema or 1/2 cup sour cream | salt and black pepper
instructions: To make the crumbs, in a medium bowl, combine the bread crumbs, pistachios, cheese and pistachios. Drain rigatoni, then coarsely grate 1 cup cheese in food processor.. In a large bowl, toss the rigatoni with the half cup grated cheese, 1 cup cheese, pistachios and rice wine. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Sprinkle a large baking sheet with the remaining 1/2 cup grated cheese. Stir the crema or sour cream and remaining teaspoon of cheese into the rigatoni mixture with a fork. Spread the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet. Smooth the top. Bake the ragout, stirring every 5 minutes, until the bread crumb topping is golden and bubbling, about 30 minutes, or until the crumbs are brown and bubbly and the pasta is tender. Cool the ragout to room temperature, about 20 minutes. To serve, place each ragout on a large platter. Cut into wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: coriander,french ladyfinger cooky,pumpkin puree,heavy cream,shiitake mushroom,tart apple,peanut butter
title: Savoury Apple Mushroom and Spicy Peanut Butter Tiramis
ingredients: 1 medium tande ginger-marinated and sweet potato ( with peel ) | 200 g fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 large tart apple | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 500 g french-style ladyfinger cookies | 1/4 cup coriander, finely chopped
instructions: Cut the stem ends off the sweet potato and grate on the small grater right into a bowl of cold water to help remove any bitter taste. Set the potato aside and, using the back end, slice the capsicum thinly and scrape out the seeds and finely dice it. Place the sweet potato in a bowl with cold water to stop it from cooking further until tender. Drain the sweet potato, pat it dry, slice and set aside. Meanwhile to make the filling, finely dice the apple and place in a mortar with the chopped ginger and sweet potato and smash together until chopped very fine using a pestle. Blend the peanut butter with 2 tablespoons water in a small bowl until smooth and creamy. Add the cream or heavy cream and stir in until well incorporated. Line a 20cm x 35cm / 5 inch tin/cake tin with plastic wrap or lightly grease the tin/cake tin with vegetable oil spray or line with baking paper and set aside. Remove the zest from the orange and trim the white on a diagonal with a vegetable peeler. Place zest segments into a food processor or grater and process into a fine, powdery consistency. Reserve. Peel the fuits in portions and slice them crossways into 1 cm / 5 inch lengths. Set the segments aside and chop the apple slices in the same way. Set aside. Using a rolling pin, press and roll the mushrooms roughly until evenly coated. Then cut out the woody core and cut out the tough fibrous center membrane with the membrane attached to the underside of the mushroom. Spread half the peanut butter mixture evenly onto the base of the tin/cake tin. Spread the diced apple slices around the bottom of the tin, then top with half the mushroom capsicum mixture. Sprinkle half the coriander over the top and top with half the remaining chopped sweet potato mixture. Spoon on half the remaining peanut butter mixture and press down gently. Sprinkle with half the remaining coriander. Spread remaining filling over the mushroom and sprinkle with the remaining coriander. Place in the centre of the preheated oven for 25 minutes to brown and bubble and soften, then remove from the oven and leave to cool. Remove from the tin and cut into 8 squares / diamonds. Whip the remaining whipped cream until soft peaks form and sprinkle on top. Serve, cut into squares, with a few plain or chocolate curls on the side.

title: Corn Tortillas With Sherry and Sherry
ingredients: 1/2 cup masa harina ( mexican flour ) | 2 tablespoons sweet sherry or 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the masa harina and sherry or vinegar. The dough will be rather dry at this stage. Roll the dough between your palms, 1/8 inch thick, to make long tortillas about 3 inches wide. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat for 1 minute. Firmly press the tortillas into the hot skillet to make a 6 inch long tortilla, approximately 1/4 inch thick. Turn the tortillas over, and press on each side with the flat of a table knife. Cook the tortillas until golden on both sides, about 3 to 5 minutes per side, being careful not to burn them. Place the tortillas on paper towels, cover with foil, and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Cut each tortilla into 4 wedges.

title: Parmesan-Hing Croutons
ingredients: 1 package of goya thman's kitchen kitchen creamed chiffonade, not `` powdered '' | 1 package dried parmesan-romano cheese mix
instructions: Mix all of the above ingredients together. Dip hands in a little water and then into the parmesan croutons. Note, the amount of water is not really measured, but the amount will depend on how dry, croutons and noodles are. Cook at 350 degrees for 20 - 30 minutes or until well browned.

title: Spicy Prosciutto Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1/2 inch fresh gingerroot, thinly sliced | 3 cardamom pods, smashed
instructions: In small bowl, stir together all ingredients. Store in refrigerator.

title: Coconut Christmas Stars Pasta
ingredients: 350 g penne pasta | 350 -450 g icing sugar | 1 -2 star anise | 200 ml coconut milk
instructions: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling hot water until just cooked. Place the icing sugar in a bowl and then slowly mix in a cup of coconut milk for a thinner icing until you have a thin paste. Add the star anise to the bowl for flavour & heat. Drain the pasta & add to the bowl of icing sugar mixture & stir to combine. Add the remaining coconut milk & stir. Place the pasta in an attractive serving platter & pour over the icing sugar mixture. Serve with more coconut marmalade & more star anise as your favourite seasonings to serve.

title: Prawns In Rice Vinegary
ingredients: 300 g prawns | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 3 -5 drops green food coloring | 400 ml hot beef stock or 400 ml hot broth
instructions: Shell prawns and remove tail then add to boiling point and cook for 1 minute. Reserve prawn liquid and set prawns aside. Heat rice vinegar, curry powder, wine & food colouring to boiling point and add prawns and cook for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Return prawns to the pan and pour over reserved sauce. Keep hot before serving.

title: Niter Kebab - Algerian Sticky Herb Blend
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh thyme sprig, about 1 inch | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed
instructions: Place the thyme, cardamom and a pinch of salt in a small frying pan, stirring frequently to prevent sticking. Cover with a lid and leave for 30 minutes, but do not let it darken. Remove the lid, increase the heat slightly, and bring to the boil. Place the herb blanching liquid in a sieve and pour into the pan. Cover and boil for 15 minutes, or until mixture thickens. Season generously with salt and leave for a further 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and allow the gee to set, perhaps in a dry frying pan until it has hardened a little.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,fennel,red pepper flake,cumin seed,virgin olive oil
title: Easy Red Pepper Spread
ingredients: 5 tablespoons unsweetened orange juice | 2 tablespoons chopped red sweet peppers or 2 tablespoons roasted red peppers | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds or 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl and mix well.

title: Broccoli and Dill Relish II
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1/2 cup chopped carrot | 1 cup minced fresh broccoli florets | 1/2 cup diagonally sliced fresh dill, or to taste
instructions: Mix red onion, carrot, broccoli florets, and dill together in a bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until chilled, about 20 minutes.

title: Sweet and Spiced Savoury Curried Turnips (Golbe)
ingredients: 300 g turnips | 2 tablespoons strong coffee | 1 large onion, finely sliced | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Cook the turnips in a pan of boiling water until soft. Drain. Heat the coffee in a pan, add the onion, sugar, sesame oil and horseradish and warm in the microwave. Blend the turnip mixture in batches with the sauce to give a good texture. Serve warm.

title: Vegetarian Kebab
ingredients: 1 cup dried kidney beans, soaked in water overnight | 200 g rice noodles | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 120 g figs, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan, mix soaked beans, curry paste, soya sauce and 2 cups of water. Bring to boil and simmer 10 minutes. Add rice noodles, cook on low heat for 5 minutes. Add figs, cook 5 minutes, remove from heat, serve.

title: Artichoke Caviar
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Mix artichoke hearts, fennel seed, and fesh fesh fesh fesh corn chips together in a nonreactive serving dish. Cover with plastic wrap and stir every 5 minutes. Allow to cool to room temperature before adding more or less oil.

title: Black Asparagus and Smoked Mozzarella Frappe
ingredients: 20 stalks fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1/4 cup black coffee | 6 ounces mozzarella cheese with rind
instructions: Prepare ice cubes in a large saucer. Trim ends and discard. Break off tips of asparagus and discard. Cut tips into 6 inch lengths and place in ice cubes. Cover with coffee and cover. Freeze until solid. Mold 1/2 cup of cheese into each one. Serve chilled.

title: Sweet Spicy Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed drained well ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup sweet smoked back bacon | 1/2 cup triple sec ( or other orange liqueur ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1 medium serrano pepper, thinly sliced ( or a combination of chili peppers and garlic ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Toast the quinoa in a dry skillet over moderate heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl with a slotted spoon and let cool. While the quinoa is toasting, crumble the bacon into bite size pieces and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until golden brown and crisp, about 5 minutes. Break into the bowl with the quinoa and cool. Combine the bacon, triple sec or other orange liqueur, vinegar, yogurt, serrano, and turmeric in a medium bowl. Toss the dressing with the quinoa mixture.

title: Baked Fries,  Banana Fries--it seems a bit unusual
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 4 1/2 - 5 1/2 lbs baking potatoes, scrubbed | 3 -4 firm bananas, peeled and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices | 1 -2 cup guacamole ( preferably hellmann's )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup of a lukewarm water. Wash and well pierce potatoes. Place in a large bowl, add enough water to cover by 2 inches and let rise in a warm place for 40 to 50 minutes. Drain and pat dry. Place banana slices on a baking pan and bake in a 425 degree f oven for 12 to 15 minutes until crisp and lightly browned. Turn, remove from pan, cut in half and toast on second baking sheet. Serve with guacamole.

title: Espresso Brownies
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons instant espresso | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325º f. Line an 11x7x2 inch baking pan with foil so the foil hangs over the perimeter of the pan and to prevent a mess from forming on the oven while you preheat the oven. In a large bowl, stir the flour, cocoa, espresso, and allspice until thoroughly blended.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,salt black pepper,wheat lasagna noodle,pimiento,red grape,grand marnier,green lentil,bay leaf
title: Lentil Lasagna
ingredients: 14 -16 ounces green lentils | 8 ounces yellow squash, coarsely chopped | 2 bay leaves | 1 jar prunes or ( 5 ounce ) jar pitted pimientos, rinsed and diced | 10 ounces red seedless grapes, drained, halved | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup marsala | 12 whole wheat lasagna noodles | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a saucepan, combine the lentils, squash, bay leaves, and pimentos with about 1/2 cup water and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to medium. Cook the lentils, uncovered, for about 40 minutes, or until the liquid has cooked away and lentils are tender and beginning to break down. Add the grand marnier. In a large bowl, toss the greens with about 1/4 cup of the lentil mixture. Arrange half of the greens in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place 6 lascilantro leaves over the greens, then sprinkle 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture over the greens. Spread the remaining greens over the cheese and arrange the rest of the cheese on top. Cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Guava Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 1 cup raw peanuts | 2 1/2 tablespoons dried guava nectar | 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/4 cup thinly sliced prosciutto, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange potatoes, cut side up, on a greased baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until tender, about 40 minutes. Cool. Place peanuts in a dry skillet over medium heat and toast, stirring frequently, until golden. Remove from heat. Stir guava nectar into peanuts until blended. Spread evenly on baking sheet. Bake until hot, 5 to 10 minutes. Place prosciutto in a bowl of cold water to soften. Drain oil and cool to room temperature. Spread nectar mixture on potatoes. Arrange prosciutto on top. Increase oven temperature to 200 degrees f. Bake until heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Fruit and Potato Rounds
ingredients: 5 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 cup peeled diced fresh fruit
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread potatoes on a large baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly toasted, about 15 minutes.

title: Daikon Radish With Herbed Marinade and Daikon Radishes(Vietnamese)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons prepared mustard | 2 1/2 cups daikon radish, grated ( fresh, about 2 small ) | 1/4 cup basil leaves, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( purchased from asian or pacific food markets )
instructions: Combine grated daikon radishes, basil, and pesto in bowl of food processor. Process until finely grated and transfer to medium bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 - 12 hours. Drain any accumulated juices from daikon radish and radish and place in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,mustard powder,cinnamon,coriander seed,red enchilada sauce,feta cheese,flour tortilla,turmeric
title: Feta Cheese Wraps
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs feta cheese, crumbled | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine the feta with the vinegar, mustard powder, cinnamon, turmeric, corianderseed and 1 1/2 cups water and process until smooth. Spread 1 tbsp of the enchilada sauce on each tortilla and roll up. Place the roll in a baking dish and pour the remaining enchilada sauce over all. Cover and bake at 425f for 30 minutes, uncover and bake for 15 minutes more.

title: Cumin and Tarragon Tin Herb Mix
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 2 tablespoons tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seed, crushed
instructions: Toast cumin and tarragon over medium heat in a small skillet, tossing to remove particles of cumin, until fragrant, 3 to 4 minutes. Watch carefully, the tarragon scorches, and is quite high. Do not allow it to smoke. When cool, grind or grind cumin and tarragon in spice mill or mortar and pestle or on an airtight container to make a smooth paste, such as an airtight biscuit mix. Store spice mixture in glass or stainless steel bowl. To make herb dressing, combine tarragon and oil in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until needed. Use as directed for seasoning herb salads and as a spread for crackers, toasted pita wedges, pita chips, etc.

title: Tomato Mustard Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans tomatoes | 2 cups tomato juice | 1/4 cup prepared mustard | 1 1/2 cups syrup or 1 1/2 cups honey | 1 lb carrot, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in pot and cover. Simmer. Sauce will thicken as it cooks.

title: Homemade Smoked Moose Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked moose | 3 leeks | 2 -3 jalapenos ( or a bit of serrano pepper ) | 1/8 cup mild grainy mustard
instructions: Skin the moose, remove any excess fat using a sharp knife. Cut the meat from the center toward the joint and remove any attached muscle. Cut away the fat and cut away the membrane. Rinse with cold water and discard the pulp under running water. Chop finely. Clean the leeks and cut them into 1/2 inch lengths. Place them in a large pan and cover with water. Bring to a simmer and cook for about 45 minutes, or until tender. Remove from heat. Cut the leeks in half and cut them into rounds, cutting off the very ends. Cut them into half again and cut them into bite size pieces. Add all the vegetables to the pan and heat gently. Take the meat from the casing and put it in a mixing bowl or place in a storage container of your choice. Place into the refrigerator for about 1 hour, until the meat is tender. Strain the meat and keep the liquid. You can refrigerate the mixture for up to 4 days, or store it in the fridge if you want to keep it longer.

title: Beef Orzo
ingredients: 8 ounces orzo pasta | 1 jar taco sauce
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions. Drain. Rinse with cold water and drain again. In a saucepan of boiling water, cook orzo 3 to 5 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,ham,coriander leaf,golden raisin,crescent dinner,italian seasoning,steak,teriyaki sauce
title: Spicy Chipoltes (Oma's Recipe)
ingredients: 200 g phyllo dough ( can use the dough on a box ) | 100 g lean lean ground beef ( lean ground chicken or turkey can also be used ) | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 1 tablespoon dried coriander leaves | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon pico de gallo ( ketchup ) | 80 g cooked ham ( roughly chopped )
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of vegetable oil in a medium sized, high sided frying pan. In the meantime take the phyllo dough out of the package and leave to soften. Cut the pastry into 8 equal squares. Keep cutting the squares so that you have 8 squares of dough. Put the meat, raisins, coriander leaves, teriyaki sauce, and pico de gallo in a non stick frying pan. Add a tsp of vegetable oil. You want to make sure everything is hot and saute gently. Pour over the beef mix and leave on a dry surface for 10 minutes. Divide the meat mixture into 8 equal parts. Put a small bit of mix in the middle. Put the dough around the mix and spread it out into a rectangular shape until it looks nice and like a large pancake. Put a small bit of italian seasoning on the top of the dough for the seasoning to stick the meat into later. Put the ham on top of the meat mix and again spread evenly. Preheat oven to 200°c. Bake in a small oven for 20 minutes. Flip over halfway through baking time, the meat mix should be brown on the top and crispy. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: goat meat,provolone cheese,flour tortilla,great northern bean
title: Easy Goat Ranch Quesadillas with Great Northern Beans
ingredients: 7 flour tortillas | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 4 ounces crumbled goat meat | 4 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Mix 2 flour tortillas with 1 can of great northern beans. Set aside. Heat cast iron skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes. Add goat meat and cook until lightly browned on both sides. Cut tortilla into 1 pieces. Place goat meat and 1 sliced provolone cheese between 1 tortilla. Top with 1 more tortilla. Spread remaining 1 can of great northern beans over tortilla and top with remaining cheese. Cook until cheese is melted, 3 - 5 minutes. Slice into wedges.

title: Eggless Fishcakes
ingredients: 1/2 kg whole fish ( white firm fleshed kingfish or scrod ) | 500 g smoked salmon ( or cod ) | 200 g beans ( frozen or canned is fine ) | 100 g cannellini beans | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary | 6 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 dried habanero pepper
instructions: If using whole fish, do not use white fish. It can only be cooked in the bones. If using salted fish, soak for about 20 minutes or until it flakes easily with a fork the fish can be substituted with fish bones from sea bream etc. Clean bones well and break off any fat that floats to surface. If using scrod, cut a length of thin, 2 inch round slice from top to bottom. Do not cut from tail to back side as the fish will shrink as it cooks. Slice the fish into 1 inch squares. You can cut into 2 inch slices, or pieces of any size you want. Take soaked fish and cut into pieces, remove any bones left in the bones. Soak beans in water until ready to use. After soaking the leaves, add to them a quart of cold water and soak each piece for 20 minutes or until softened. You can also soak a piece of fresh or frozen salmon in cold water for 5 mins before cutting the fish out of the skin.. Once softened, remove skin from the fish and cut into small slices. Take chopped dried beans out of refrigerator and let sit for 10 minutes. Drain water from beans and put them into a food processor or blender. Put 5 tbsp olive oil in a small pot at medium heat. Place garlic cloves and finely chopped onion in oil and sweat gently for 5 mins on medium heat until translucent. Do not burn add 1/4 cup water after 5 minutes and stir in beans and mix well then add rest of ingredients and boil 5 mins until liquid thickens.

title: Lemon-Cinnamon-Cinnamon Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 5 baby carrots, sliced in lengthwise rounds | 1/4 white sugar, can also use brown sugar | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon and sugar | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Arrange lady fingers in bottom of a serving dish. Sprinkle sliced carrots over top. Whisk together sugar, cinnamon and pepper to sprinkle on top of lady fingers. Dot with a small amount of lemon juice. Beat together with a fork, and pour evenly over carrot layer. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 6 hours. Serve with a scoop of chilled or toasted bak choppadame, if desired.

Random Ingredients: red bean,enchilada mix,couscous,spicy brown mustard,kosher salt,yellow pepper
title: Mexican Hot Brown Beans and Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1 yellow sweet pepper | 2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard or 2 tablespoons other spicy brown mustard | 3 ounces dry enchilada mix ( use only 1 envelope ) | 6 ounces red beans, rinsed and drained | kosher salt | 1 box instant couscous
instructions: Quarter and seed the pepper. Cut the pepper in half crosswise and discard the stems. Seed and quarter the pepper lengthwise. Put the pepper halves, cut side down, on a baking sheet or in a large ovenproof bowl and lightly brush them with mustard. Bake in a 350 degrees oven for about five minutes until the peppers start to turn black. Remove from the oven and let cool. Cut remaining pepper into strips. Combine the red beans with about 2 tablespoons of the mustard in a saucepan and stir into the contents of the saucepan. Add the pepper strips and a little water, if necessary, to make the sauce simmering. Bring to a boil and simmer, uncovered, for about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the remaining 1 envelope of enchilada sauce. Serve the hot brown beans over instant couscous.

title: Simple Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1 jar chunky salsa | 1/2 cup dry sherry
