instructions: Cover a small plate with plastic wrap. Microwave salsa for 90 seconds at a time. Stir salsa and sherry into hot salsa and enjoy.

title: Coconut Curry Noodles With Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup onion, chopped | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts or 1/4 cup other nuts ( or 2 tbsp. chopped pecans, if desired ) | 1/2 tablespoon curry paste | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1 lb cooked chicken, cubed or shredded | 6 ounces cooked spaghetti, pasta, cooked, per package directions
instructions: Place 1/4 cup of the onion and nuts in a medium size skillet and saute for 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and stir the curry paste with the coconut cream over medium heat. Simmer 3 - 3 minutes. Add the chicken and cook for 2 minutes. Add the noodles, toss well, and heat through.

Random Ingredients: mango pulp,chia seed,hazelnut,artichoke heart,wheat bread,vanilla vodka,strawberry,penne pasta
title: Strawberry Pasta With Chia Seeds & Avgolebanazo
ingredients: 1 1/4 pints strawberries, sliced | 3 artichoke hearts, cut into small chunks | 2 tablespoons chia seeds ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tbsp hazelnuts, toasted, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons vanilla vodka | 12 ounces penne pasta, cooked and drained ( rotelle or vermicelli pasta ) | hazelnut slices ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | chia seeds ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | 1 glass mango pulp ( to serve ) or 1 glass mango flavored vodka ( to serve ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large serving bowl, add the pasta, strawberries, artichokes, chia seeds, hazelnuts, and vanilla vodka. Toss with 1/2 cup mango flavored vodka. Serve with warm hazelnut slices and chia seeds, if desired, and garnish as desired.

title: P.f. Chang's White Bean Pizza
ingredients: 1 container alfredo sauce | 1/4 lb marshmallows | 12 ounces vodka, chilled | 2 -3 serrano peppers, sliced | marshmallows, for garnishing
instructions: Warm the alfredo sauce in a small bowl in the microwave on low setting until slightly reduced. Set aside. Place marshmallows in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 10 seconds, stirring every minute. Add vodka and serrano peppers to microwaved dry marshmallows and microwave on high for 10 seconds, stirring every minute. Add the caramelized marsllows and stir until smooth. Spread the warm alfredo sauce evenly over the pizzas on cookie sheets. Add marshmallow mixture and bake at 500 for 10 minutes or until bubbly. Garnish with marshmallows and serve.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,cooking onion,purpose flour,ghee,tomato vegetable soup mix,red capsicum,chili,parsnip
title: Lori's Vegan Parsnip Soup
ingredients: 1 can tomato-vegetable soup mix | 3 tablespoons ghee ( or oil ) | cooking onion | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 parsnips, diced | 1/3 red capsicum, diced | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried chili ( or to taste ) | chopped parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a pan or pot and fry the onion until light golden brown. Add flour, stir well, add soup mix. Stir soup well, add a little water if mixture separates. Add the rest of the ingredients, cook on very low heat for about 20 - 30 minutes. Serve garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Homemade Nuts (Toasted Nuts or Candy)
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 -2 cup water, as needed | 1/4 cup pistachios, finely chopped or 1/4 cup walnuts
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together cornmeal and water until well blended. Stir in chopped pistachios, if using. Spread onto toasted molds about 3/4 to 1/2 inch thick. Set aside for 20 minutes, or until lightly coloured. Break apart with fingers or a fork, leaving a firm shell.

Random Ingredients: ghee butter,pineapple chunk,rump steak,garlic paste,orange juice,self rising flour
title: Orange Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons ghee ( for frying ) | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup canned pineapple chunk, drained | 1/2 cup unsweetened orange juice | 1 1/2 lbs rump steak, trimmed and cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Combine flour and ginger in a large shallow bowl, stir in the oil or ghee. Add the pineapple chunks, stirring to blend. Pour the orange juice into a separate shallow bowl. Dip the piece of steaks into the juice and then place into the flour mixture. Shake off any excess flour and then press the coated steak into the flour to coat. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add enough oil to help coat the bottom of the pan. Brown the coated steaks for 2 - 3 minutes, turning once. Serve with the pineapple mixture.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,balsamic vinegar,poblano pepper,linguine pasta,tomato garlic,pork shoulder,yellow pepper
title: Spicy Curried Pork
ingredients: 1 lb linguine pasta or 1 lb other small tube shaped pasta | 1 medium head poblano pepper, halved and seeded | 1 large yellow pepper, halved and seeded | 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 small canned tomatoes with garlic, chopped
instructions: Heat oil and add poblano, yellow pepper and pork. Sprinkle with curry paste and vinegar and toss to coat. Remove and add tomatoes and garlic and toss again. Serve.

title: Cacio E Pepe (Sweet Cheese Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 400 g rigatoni pasta, freshly cook ( one 227g pack will do ) or 400 g other gemelli pasta ( one 227g pack will do ) | 1/3 cup cashews, finely chopped | 1/2 cup red wine, sweet dessert wine ( good quality ) | 1 orange ( yellow with rind cut into 16 wedges ) | 1 lime, cut into 16 wedges
instructions: Bring 7 cups of water to the boil and add 1 tbsp of salt and the pasta. Cook according to packet directions until just al dente. Toss through all the ingredients and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate chip,beef bouillon powder,white bread
title: Curry Toasted Cheese Bread for Mince
ingredients: 2 slices white bread ( firm, preferably white crust ) | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate chips
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. In small microwavable dish, microwave 2 slices of the bread until it is softened, approximately 3 minutes, then spread softened bread evenly with beef bouillon powder. Top with remaining bread and microwave approximately 2 seconds to soften, approximately 2 more minutes. Spread chocolate chips evenly over toast and return to oven. Cook until golden, approximately 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Greek Sticky Lemonade
ingredients: 1 cup pitted dates, chopped | 2 cups lemonade
instructions: Dissolve lemonade concentrate in fruit juice. Fill 4 cups of water. Place over medium heat, and bring to a boil. Pour into serving dishes. Serve warm in the cups.

Random Ingredients: lemon,parsley flake,brown rice,golden raisin,midori melon liqueur,bread
title: Midori Bread Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown rice | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup preserved lemon | 1/2 cup midori melon liqueur | 1 loaf bread | lemon slice ( optional ) | parsley flakes ( optional )
instructions: Wash and cook the brown and golden raisin rice and golden raisins in the midori. Once rice is done, add the preserved lemon, and reduce the temperature to very low. Cover the rice mixture and let it cool down to room temperature. Cut bread into slices about 1/4´´´´´´´´´´ and make a small slit along the edges every 2´´´´´´´´. Brush the top slices with the liqueur and place the bread around the edges on top. Cut a pocket in each bread slice and sprinkle lightly with parsley flakes and serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,arugula leaf,sesame seed,tomato green chilies,lipton onion soup mix,avocado,ginger,chow mein noodle
title: Asian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces cooked chow mein noodles ( about 1-1/2 cups ) | 2 large tomatoes ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 medium ripe avocado, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 fresh ginger | 2 cups fresh arugula leaves ( approx ) | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon coconut oil | 2 tablespoons purchased lipton onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: Place noodles and 1 tomato in a bowl, toss well with dressing. Sprinkle avocado slice evenly over salad. Combine remaining vegetables and 3/4 cup dressing into a serving bowl and arrange on top of noodles. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,tart apple,ziti pasta,roast beef,lime wedge,taco seasoning,serrano pepper
title: Quick and Easy Beef Calzones
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean stew beef, fat trimmed | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon black peppercorns | 5 small tart apples | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced ( or 1 small jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced ) | 1/2 cup hot cooked ziti pasta or 1/2 cup other pastas | 1 lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Cut beef into 1 1/2 inch cubes.

title: Caribbean Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 center-cut pork chops | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup sliced mushrooms | 1 cup mashed apricot, drained | 2 avocados - peeled, pitted, and sliced | 8 ounces lump crabmeat, drained | 1 cucumber, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lay pork chops on foil on a baking sheet. Brush with kahlua. Bake pork chops in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Pour mashed apricots on top. Bake for an additional 15 minutes. Remove pork chops to a serving platter. Cover with foil. Place mushrooms in a bowl.

title: Quick and Easy Clam Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 packet egg noodles | 1 medium green chili, finely diced | 150 g bean sprouts | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder or 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 cup clams, shucked with juice ( can use any clam )
instructions: Fill a saucepan with water on high heat.

title: Clam Soup With Cod (Broiled Halibut)
ingredients: 3 ounces smoked halibut fillets, smoked | 8 ounces smoked cod, boneless | 1/4 - 1/2 cup brandy | 1 can sliced clams with juice | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh thai basil, divided | 2 tablespoons agave nectar ( optional ) | crouton | cilantro, minced ( optional )
instructions: Coat fish with brandy. Place fish in skillet with 1/2 cup of the clam juice over high heat. Cover and cook until fish is opaque and just starting to flake. If desired, remove lid and cook until liquid is reduced. Transfer fish to a heat safe bowl. Combine the remaining clam juice with 2 t. Of the basil and nectar. Pour this mixture over the fish. Cover and chill at least 1 - 2 hours. Cut cod into bite size pieces, and place in serving bowls. Top with clam mixture. Top with shredded cilantro. Serve with croutons and additional nuoc cham sauce if desired. Note, use brandy for cooking fish.

title: Maggie Beer's Vodka Fondue
ingredients: 6 cups thinly sliced swiss cheese ( or gruyere, emmenthal, a mix of both ) | 4 fluid ounces vodka | 1/2 cup fresh thyme leaves | 6 whole cardamom seeds
instructions: Coat the bottom of 6 cups of a large heavy pot large enough to hold all the fondue in one layer with vegetable oil or lard. Heat the oil or lard in the skillet over medium heat for a few seconds and fry each cardamom seed until golden, then remove cardamom seeds and discard. When the oil or lard is ready, add the cheese and increase heat so that the cheese browns nicely, about 5 minutes. Pour the wine into the pan through a strainer, and add thyme. If the fondue is too thick, stir in a bit more wine. Pour the fondue into the pot, making sure it's all covered with the cheese. Let simmer over medium low heat until the fondue is bubbled and the fondue is warmed through but still slightly chunky and rich. Serve hot.

title: The Famous Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chicken thighs | 2 lbs boneless lean steak | 12 ounces collardrhubarb | 2 lbs rindless cheese, shredded | 2 cups white flour | 1 gallon chicken stock or 1 gallon chicken stock
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large pot, put everything except the cheese in with the chicken. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 3 hours. Strain liquid from pot and keep covered until needed. Poke chicken with a fork and mix the rind and cheese together in a large bowl to make the stuffing. In another bowl combine the stuffing and the chicken breasts. In a separate container, pour the chicken stock, mix the flour and the chicken with the stuffing until it just begins to cling on the chicken. Place chicken on a rack in a 9x13 pan. Stuff in the cheese mixture and put on cookie sheet, bake for 1 hour, stirring every 10 minutes, until crust is brown.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,green cardamom pod,chicken broth,tabasco sauce
title: Spicy Low Fat Naneh (Chilled Indian Chicken)
ingredients: 25 red cardamom pods or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup hot chili paste | 1/2 cup fat-free vegetable broth or 1/2 cup fat-free chicken broth | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Grind cardamom pods with an electric grinder or mortar and pestle or coffee grinder. Mix chili paste with the broth and tabasco in a small bowl. Pour mixture over the chili paste and mix well. Stir in the cardamom. Serve with grilled or raw veggies, pita bread or raw vegetables.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,brown button mushroom,celery rib,green chili,iceberg lettuce,rotel tomato,mayonnaise
title: Tasty Mushroom & Garlic Pizza
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry ( thawed overnight ) | 3 tablespoons light mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons canned green chilies ( or your favourite chopped hot pepper ) | 1/2 cup sliced brown button mushrooms | 1 celery rib, sliced thinly | 2 teaspoons celery leaves or 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 can rotel tomatoes, undrained | 1 can sliced green giant mushroom mushrooms ( with liquid )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. On foil lined baking sheet, arrange the puff pastry.

title: Lamb and Spinach Parcels
ingredients: 2 untreated cedar planks | 2 lamb patties | 4 slices bacon | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup minced fresh spinach leaves | 3/8 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed
instructions: Place the cedar planks in boiling water, and soak for 20 to 30 minutes. Cut the meat into pieces about 3/4 inch wide. Fry the bacon in a large skillet until crispy, remove and set aside, leaving the drippings in the skillet. Place the pork and bacon in the skillet and cook over medium high heat, turning to seal frequently, until lightly browned on all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. Pour the vegetable stock into the skillet, bring it to a boil, and reduce it by half. Combine the spinach and the flour, stir into the liquid, and bring the mixture to a simmer. Cover and cook, stirring frequently, until the liquid is reduced, about 10 minutes.

title: Veal Filled With Filling and Kimchee
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut into 2-inch-thick slices ( with pockets ) | 4 large red radishes, peeled and cut into 1-inch-thick slices ( with pockets ) | 1/2 cup honey | for garnish
instructions: Place the veal cutlets, radishes, and honey in a wide, shallow baking pan. Score the veal several times with a sharp knife and sprinkle generously with freshly ground black pepper. Place in oven and turn down to 200 degrees f. Bake for 1 hour, turning halfway through. Turn off oven, remove bread from oven, and place bread on a clean countertop lined with plastic wrap or aluminum foil. Let stand 5 minutes. Carefully remove plastic wrap or wrap, and spread bread with a little honey. Set kimchee aside to cool completely. Serve kimchee with kimchee on the side.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,lemon lime beverage,currant,pearl barley,chocolate syrup
title: Chocolate Barley
ingredients: 1 box pearl barley ( or any long-grain ) | 3 cups carbonated lemon-lime beverage ( or sprite ) | 3 cups button mushrooms ( quartered or thickly sliced ) | 2 teaspoons chocolate syrup ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon dried currants or 1 tablespoon dried sunflower seeds
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot. Add the barley. Stir for a few minutes to thicken and reduce the heat. Simmer slowly for about 40 - 45 minutes, stirring at least once or twice. Add the remaining ingredients, except for the chocolate sauce, and bring to a rolling boil. Turn off the heat and stir in the chocolate sauce. Cover and reserve in the refrigerator until serving.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,peach,beef chuck,hot pepper,red pepper,caster sugar
title: Spanish Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 8 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 large red pepper, cut into chunks | 8 -10 fresh hot peppers, deseeded and membrane removed, cut deseeded | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 ripe peaches, halved and stoned
instructions: Sprinkle meat with sugar. Place in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Boil over a high heat for 3 - 4 mins then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hr until the meat is tender. Discard any water that has boiled away. Add peppers and tomatoes and simmer for a few minutes. The beef should not be sticky, just coated with the syrup. Serve with crusty bread or rice.

title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb red potatoes | 6 red potatoes | 2 english cucumbers | 2 tablespoons flour ( plus additional if needed ) | 2 tablespoons toasted pine nuts ( or pecan nuts )
instructions: Boil the red potatoes until tender but still firm. Mash with the flour. Drain and cool slightly. While the potatoes cool enough, cut the sweet potatoes into quarter inch strips. Cut the cucumbers into quarter inch rounds. Dip the slices in the warm egg water. Coat with more flour, and shake off excess. Place the potatoes on a tray, and cover with parchment paper. Bake at 450f for 15 minutes. Cool, then toss with the nuts. Let cool completely and store for up to 2 days. Enjoy i also have a bag of fancy colored zucchini salad. This is a quick and easy way to serve this recipe.

title: Mexican Salsa Appetizer
ingredients: 1 jar salsa | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, cut in half | skewer
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve.

title: Smoked Salmon on Weiners
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs smoked salmon | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dill | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons butter | 1/2 cup caraway seed
instructions: Split gammon lengthwise. Make diagonal cuts in the surface. Dribble worcestershire sauce in cuts 1/4 to 1/2 inch deep. Sprinkle 1/2 t. Dill on top. Combine salmon slices with worcestershire sauce. Place skin side of salmon on work surface. Top with marinated pieces of gammon, drizzle worcestershire sauce over salmon. Fold one piece at a time, overlapping sides of salmon. Repeat with remaining pieces of gammon. Melt the butter in a 5 qt heavy nonstick skillet over moderate heat. Add 1/2 t. Dill seeds. Scrape the pan as much fat off the groung with a flat spatula and let the flames subside. Sprinkle with 1/2c. Caraway seeds. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until salmon is heated through. Turn meat over. Cover and cook 10 minutes. Uncover.

Random Ingredients: tamari soy sauce,italian sausage,parsley leaf,dark sesame oil,jasmine rice,white fish fillet,cooking spray,de arbol
title: Steamed Jasmine and Seared Fish With Sesame Brown Butter
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs thai white fish fillets, sliced in half horizontally | 1 tablespoon tamari soy sauce | 1 lb jasmine rice | 4 slices white fish fillets | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | cooking spray | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves | 1/4 cup tamari soy sauce | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Spray with cooking oil. Place fish in large, deep microwave safe bowl. Add tamari, rice, 1 tablespoon sesame oil and 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil. Cover bowl and microwave on high for 3 to 4 minutes or until cooked. Let stand 5 minutes. Transfer vegetables to serving platter. Toss with remaining 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil and 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil. Serve fish with vegetables and sesame brown butter.

Random Ingredients: mushroom soup,sage,red pepper flake,serrano chile pepper,guinness stout,vanilla bean
title: Crock Pot Guinness and Sage Infused Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried sage | 1 can condensed mushroom soup | 1/4 cup guinness stout | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 2 serrano chile peppers | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 vanilla bean
instructions: In a 5 to 6 qt slow cooker combine sage, soup, stout, crushed red pepper flakes, chile peppers. Cover and cook on high 5 hours, or low 5 hours. Let sit 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,sesame seed,nut,almond,pepperoni sausage,taco seasoning mix,rigatoni pasta,dark chocolate
title: Spicy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rigatoni pasta, cooked & drained | 10 ounces of good quality dark chocolate ( about 1 large, cut into small pieces ) | 8 ounces sliced pepperoni sausage or 8 ounces other bacon | 1 cup sliced almonds | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1/4 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix, plus | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 7 ounces sliced dark chocolate, broken into small pieces
instructions: Cut the peppers into 1/2 inch wide slices on the bias and the slices into a fine stripes. You should have about 9 to 12 large pepperoni sausages. Boil the water for pasta. When it simmers, drain and let sit until cool enough to handle, then transfer pasta to a large bowl and mix with cheese, nuts, pepperoni, orange juice, and taco seasoning. Add chocolate chips and stir to melt. Let stand for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, and serve. This is also great reheated on the stove top. Yum.

title: Chickpea Casserole
ingredients: 28 ounces chickpeas, drained | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/3 cup half-and-half or 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning | 2 tablespoons candied fruit, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and heat, stirring occasionally, until hot. Cool for 3 minutes. Pour into a 2 cup casserole dish, sprinkle with fruit and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Place casserole in a cold water bath for 25 to 30 minutes or until the pudding is bubbly.

title: Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 cup vinegar ( any variety, but we prefer cider vinegar ) | 1/2 cup cornflour | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar ( we prefer cider vinegar )
instructions: In a small saucepan put the vinegar and cornflour and bring to a boil over a high heat. Stir in the red wine vinegar and remove from the heat. Let cool thoroughly. Pour into a container and refrigerate for 2 hours. Serve over your favourite vegetables or fish.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,green chili pepper,lasagna noodle,mango chutney,vegetable broth,golden syrup,grape
title: Mango Coconut Lasagne
ingredients: 3/4 cup vegetable broth or 3/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon golden syrup or 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon finely chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/4 - 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, cut in small pieces ( optional ) | 1 lasagna noodle, broken into 4 pieces | 1 large grape ( optional )
instructions: Bring broth or water to boil, add sugar, chutney, bell peppers and mango nectar. Add broken lasagne noodles, reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes or until noodles are fluffy but not soft. Garnish with grapes.

title: Lemon, Salt & Lemon Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup dry rotini pasta | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice or 1/4 cup zest | 1/4 cup fresh sage | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaf or 1/2 cup cilantro
instructions: Prepare a 12 cup vegetable pot with cooking spray or grease over all sides of bowl and set it aside. Combine pasta, lemon juice, sage, buttermilk and herbs in bowl and toss well to coat. Taste and adjust seasonings. Cover and let sit, loosely covered, for 20 minutes. Stir and serve. Garnish with chives.

title: Quick Corn
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 1/2 cup oil
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan or skillet. Add creamed corn. Stirring constantly until it turns brown on top.

title: Rye Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups rye flour or 2 cups spelt flour | 3 -4 slices bacon, cooked but not crisp | 4 teaspoons packed brown sugar
instructions: Warm a non nonstick pan on the stove or in the microwave. Whisk together, then add all ingredients, except the pancake flour. Mix until smooth. Spray or line your serving plates with parchment paper. Spoon the batter into the pan, and let cook over medium low heat for 5 - 10 minutes, or until bottom is golden brown. Turn pancake over, and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve hot, or let cool and slice in 1/8 slices.

title: Candied Plantains in Catalina Foil - Bathelge
ingredients: 4 green plantains | 2 packages kielbasa | 2/3 cup catalina salad dressing | 3 tablespoons white vinegar, divided
instructions: Peel plantains and cut them lengthwise in 1/4 in. Thick slices. Arrange slices on a platter and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand at room temperature 1 - 2 hours. Combine catalina and remaining dressing and half of the vinegar. Dip each slice into sugar mixture and cook in oil on both sides, turning frequently for about 3 minutes. Drain and arrange on platter.

title: Irish Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 head coleslaw mix, chopped | 1 cup mixed herbs, chopped ( rosemary, chives, tarragon ) | 1/2 cup fresh shaved irish cream ( or coffee ) | 1 organic cauliflower floret, chopped | 1/2 cup mixed nuts, whole | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dried tub-style dried fruit, chopped | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 5 slices unsmoked prosciutto, diced ( about 1-inch )
instructions: Mix coleslaw mix, herbs, beans and nuts together in a large bowl. Add the macaroon, vanilla bean and prosciutto pieces. Toss gently.

title: Moroccan Spiced Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 1 1/4 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon sumac
instructions: Mix well and store in an airtight container in the fridge.

title: Apple Curd
ingredients: 4 granny smith apples | 2 tablespoons egg substitute, beaten
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend until mixture begins to thicken, about 30 seconds on high. Serve cold over fresh or brownies. My note, i have been told that making these for a couple of days and they all came out great and so refreshing for a refreshing lunch.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,butter,raisin,milk ricotta cheese,chili pepper flake,baby shrimp,cheese
title: Shrimp in Chilli Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 500 g baby shrimp, thawed | 100 g butter | 1 medium red chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 250 g wholemeal cheese, cut into 8 | 250 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 50 g raisins | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat butter in a frying pan over medium high heat. Add chilies and onions and cook until the onions are soft. Turn down the heat under the pan to medium and stir constantly until the onions are cooked and most of the moisture has drained out. Remove from heat and set aside. In a bowl, mix the cheese, raisins and chili flakes. Pour half of this mix into the pan. Stir over a medium heat for 1 minute. Add the shrimp and mix well. Transfer the mixture into a shallow dish. Repeat with another layer of cheese, raisins, and shrimp. Bake at 180 degrees celsius for 30 minutes. Serve with a good tomato salad.

title: Guinness-Braised Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups guinness stout | 2 pounds chicken legs | 1 package fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Pour the guinness into a large pot and add the chicken legs. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer until the chicken legs are tender, about 2 hours. Remove chicken legs and place them in a large skillet with 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, skimming fat as needed. Cook uncovered, stirring to loosen browned bits. When chicken is just cooked through, stir in the spinach and return to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the spinach has cooked through, about 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Basil Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint fresh raspberries | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon palm oil
instructions: Puree raspberries until liquid begins. In small bowl, stir in italian seasonings. Set aside. Heat ketchup and palm oil in large saute pan over high heat. When oil is hot, ladle sauce into hot oil, distributing raspberries evenly and cooking until sauce bubbles and starts to thicken slightly, about 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oyster mushroom,tabasco sauce,albacore tuna water,fish sauce
title: Steamed Oysters
ingredients: 12 small oyster mushrooms | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons albacore tuna in water
instructions: Place the mushrooms inside the steamer over a wok of boiling water in the microwave and cook covered for five minutes. Remove from microwave and stir through the rest of the ingredients. Spoon onto plates.

title: Sauritos de Queso (Tortilla Potatoes With Fresh Lotus Seed)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh yeast | 2/3 cup bread crumbs | 1 cup mixed bread crumbs ( white, whole wheat, or multigrain ) | 1 lb peeled whole russet potato | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 cups fresh whole lotus seeds | 6 dozen tortillas, warmed and torn into small pieces
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the 2/3 cup bread crumbs. Mix in potato flour, a little at a time, and 1 cup each of mixed breads and mixed breadcrumbs. Cover and allow the dough to rest at room temperature overnight. Heat the oven to 450 degrees f. Remove the dough from the bowl and pat down. Place the breaded dough in an oiled jelly roll pan. Taper off a 1/4 inch piece of dough and press it into a circle with the flat side of a drinking glass. Place the circle in the oven on a rack and bake until it looks dry. Allow to cool completely. When it is completely dry, spread the 1/4 inch slices, in a circle, on a piece of parchment paper for the tortillas. Place 1/4 cup of fresh lotus seeds in a small bowl, pour the watery water into the bowl, and stir until well coated. Stuff the tortillas with half of the lotus seeds, and place them on a baking sheet. Brush the tortillas with more water. Bake them until they are crisp and the potatoes are soft, about 20 - 25 minutes. To serve, heat up a few cups of canned or fresh lotus in a large pot over medium heat. Sprinkle with salt immediately, and squeeze some fresh lotus seeds over the top.

title: Moroccan Spiced Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 lbs spaghetti | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Keep warm in large pot on top of double boiler. Meanwhile heat 2 tspn of ras el hanout in heavy skillet. Remove from heat and toss spaghetti with hot ras el hanout. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,meat broth beef water,cooking oil
title: Finnish Dumplings (Gurkenjes)
ingredients: 1 pound ground meat ( preferably ground beef ) | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 cup cake flour | 3 cups meat or broth, enough to make a stiff dough
instructions: Brown meat in oil. Add flour and stir. Add broth and stir well. Let simmer 5 minutes. Drop into boiling soup, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: pear,chili powder,marshmallow creme,icing sugar,rice,bean sprout,black cardamom pod,pistachio nut
title: Rice Pudding
ingredients: 400 g rice, cooked | 1 pear, finely diced | 1 can baked beans with pears, drained | 4 tablespoons pistachio nut, finely chopped | 4 teaspoons icing sugar | 4 tablespoons marshmallow creme | 4 -6 black cardamom pods, crushed ( optional ) | chili powder | chili powder, red
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in a greased oven proof dish. Toast, cool and cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,yellow pepper,pecan half,chicken broth,leek,dark soy sauce
title: Wicklewood's Thai Pea Pate
ingredients: 1 medium leek, chopped | 1 medium yellow pepper, chopped | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth, divided | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon oatmeal | 1/3 cup pecan halves ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a food processor and process till smooth. Stir in pecans. Cover and set aside at room temperature for at least 15 minutes. Beat with a wire whisk till foamy. Spoon into 8x8 baking dish and press pecan halves on top with a spatula. Cool slightly and cut into 16 squares. Serve with crackers.

title: Simple Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork shoulder, and fat trimmed | 1/2 cup thick slab feta, crumbled | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Slice pork crosswise into about 1/4 inch thick slices or thinner if desired. Place a portion of pork on the bottom of a shallow serving dish or 2 quart saucepan. Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon feta over the pork. Dredge pork slices in cream, patting it into the meat. Place the meat and some of the crumbled feta on top of the feta. Continue to layer the meat, crumbled bacon, and cream on top of the pork. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,realemon juice,chipotle chile pepper,broth,celery rib,jalapeno pepper,orange zest,pork shoulder
title: Chipotle Shredded Pork
ingredients: 3/4 cup low-sodium chunky salsa | 1 ounce chipotle chile pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon jalapeno pepper, minced | 4 -8 ounces shredded pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons chicken stock or 2 tablespoons broth | 2 tablespoons realemon juice or 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 1 celery rib, sliced
instructions: Drain juice from canned peppers into a small bowl and set aside. In a large baking dish or roaster, combine the salsa, chile pepper, orange peel and jalapeno pepper. In small bowl mix pork, broth, soy juice and chopped celery.

title: Dumplings (Polish Bullets)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 cup white sugar
instructions: Mix all ingredients. You can stuff tiny dumplings with this or you can just roll them into your favourite bread crumb mixture. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, then fry as you like.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,garlic,italian cheese,apple cider vinegar,white pepper,prosciutto
title: Ticilian Pesto Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped prosciutto | 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped | 1/2 cup low sodium vegetable broth | 1/4 cup good apple cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons white pepper | 1/4 cup italian cheese blend, grated
instructions: In blender container, combine prosciutto, garlic, broth, vinegar, and white pepper and blend until smooth. Place in small bowl. Place in clean jar and add cheese. Refrigerate.

title: Easy Tortellini and Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 can beef broth | 9 ounces cheese tortellini or 9 ounces cheese tortellini, uncooked according to package directions | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 3/4 cup prepared pasta, any shape
instructions: Pour 1 cup of beef broth onto a large pot wide enough to hold all your tortellini or cheese tortellini. Add all of the rest of the ingredients except your pasta. If your tortellini have not already cooked, pour all of the broth into a large baking dish and cover with a lid, making sure your lid is on the baking dish so the water can boil right out in the pot. Cover and bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes. Stir the tortellini and spaghetti sauce into the broth and bake for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,shrimp,purpose flour,pork sausage,poppy seed,cayenne pepper,golden raisin
title: Risotto With Sausage and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup short-grain risotto rice ( arborio ) | 1 lb pork sausage | 1/4 cup golden raisin | freshly grated cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup roasted poppy seed | 25 large shrimp, peeled | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
instructions: Sprinkle flour on both sides of the uncooked rice, then transfer to a sieve and shake dry. Break in half lengthwise, then press each quarter into a ball. Repeat with the other half of rice. Set rice aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray a 10 inch nonstick fry pan with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Add sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up into bite size pieces with a spoon. Add raisins and cook until raisins begin to plump and raisins plump up. Stir risotto with the sausage and raisins until mixture is slightly darkened. Stir in poppy seeds. Stir in shrimp, then stir in flour. Cook mixture until mixture boils and thickens. Stir constantly until mixture is thick but not dry, about three minutes. Transfer to a shallow baking dish and bake in a preheated oven for about 45 to 60 minutes until rice is tender and filling is beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: dark creme de cacao,paprika,corn chip,sesame oil,tomato sauce,sage leaf,orange peel,oregano
title: Orange Spice Sake
ingredients: 2/3 cup orange peel, finely diced | 1/4 cup dark creme de cacao | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup paprika | 2 tablespoons corn chips | 3/4 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup sesame oil
instructions: In a bowl, mix all ingredients together. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chipotle Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni | 15 tablespoons mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle pepper ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions on package. Rinse with cold water and drain well. In a salad bowl, mix together the macaroni and the cheese. In another bowl, combine the chipotle pepper and the mango chutney. Stir in the chipotle pepper and mint chutney. Toss with the macaroni in the bowl. Taste to adjust the saltiness of the sauce and adjust to your liking.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,vegetable stock,sea salt black pepper,red pepper flake
title: Lettuce Soup

title: Bitter Melon Beef Stew With Coconut (Bergie)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean stewing beef, quartered | 2 2 lbs bitter melons or 2 lbs melon, mixed | 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef fat, plus 1/2 cup ( or other fat ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 10 whole star anise | 10 cardamom pods | 1/4 teaspoon ground star anise | fresh ground black pequin seeds or bitter melon
instructions: In a large saucepan melt the fat over medium low heat and add the bitter melons or beets except the bitter melon. Cook, without stirring until the bitter melon is soft and the bitter melon becomes transparent to the eye, 12 to 14 minutes. Stir in 2 teaspoons of sugar, the yeast, remaining sugar, star anise and cardamom. The mixture should be dark, creamy and slightly oily. Cover and let stand in a warm place for about 30 minutes or until bitter melon is soft, but not mushy. Meanwhile, in a medium sized skillet or dutch oven bring 2 cups water to a boil. Working in batches of 4, add the bitter melon mixture and boil until all of the liquid is gone, about 20 minutes. Transfer the bitters melon stew to bowl. Remove the bitter melon mixture from the heat and skim off any fat. Pour the broth into an 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Arrange the bitter melon stew over the broth and cover or refrigerate overnight. Remove the bitter melon in the saucepan and place it on a separate plate to cool slightly. Cut off the bitter melon segments with a mandoline or a sharp knife and discard the membrane inside the bitter melon. Discard the seeds and membrane. Strain the broth, discarding most of the solids. Return the broth to the pan, add 1 cup of sweetened water, and increase the heat to medium high. Add the candied bitter melon pieces and boil, uncovered over medium heat, 5 minutes, or until tender. Remove the bitters melon pieces from the broth by pulling them out of their skin with a spatula or spoon, then place on a dish and cover tightly with plastic wrap to keep warm at 120 degrees f. To serve, place 4 bitter melon pieces over each plate, ladle the broth over, and sprinkle with pepper, if desired. Variation, replace 1 1/2 pounds of beef fat with 1 pound of sugar. You can also substitute 1 pound of other lean beef fat with 1/2 pound of other fat and increase the syrupy taste. This recipe can be served as a side dish, but the flavor is more intense as the bitter melon stew and the brined beef.

title: Coconut Whip (Tropical Coconut Dip)
ingredients: 1 coconut ( shredded or grated ) | 1 cup cream of coconut ( thickened ) | 1 -2 dash chili oil | salt and pepper
instructions: Mix coconut, cream of coconut and chili oil in blender and puree until well mixed and creamy.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,mung bean,pesto sauce,apple barrel schnapps,lime juice zest,dijon mustard,salsa,cointreau liqueur
title: Curtido's Baked Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb dried mung beans, rinsed | 8 ounces apple barrel schnapps | 2/3 cup apple currant schnapps | 1/4 cup prepared dijon-style mustard | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons lime juice and zest | 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur | 6 ounces egg noodles ( bag, cooked according to package directions and drained if desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine the noodles with the bean rinsed in a small bowl and spread in a single layer on a foil lined jelly roll pan. Bake about 10 minutes, stirring once or twice, until crisp. Place in a bowl.

title: Puerto Rican Corn
ingredients: 4 ears corn, husked | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 3 gherkins, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Rinse the corn and drain. Trim the kernels from the cob. Cut off the cob tops and discard the husk. Place the corn kernels into a baking dish. Mix together the cream of tartar, ground cumin, gherkin slices and cuminseed mixture. Bake in the preheated oven for an hour. The corn should still be slightly moist in the center with no pools of liquid in the middle.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,pepper,head cauliflower,cauliflower floret,black bean,courgette,alfredo sauce
title: Cauliflower Beef Brisket Recipe
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower floret | 1 head cauliflower floret | 1 pint beef brisket, frozen | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 2 cups black beans, drained | pepper | 1 large courgette, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Wash beef brisket. Cut into smaller chunks. Place in 9x13 inch pan. Add water to cover. Cover and bake in preheated oven 45 minutes or until tender. About 45 minutes before meat is done, boil vegetables for about 8 minutes. Remove from water with a slotted spoon, cover, and keep warm. In a blender, puree carrots, cabbage, 1 packet of alfredo sauce, and pepper. Place brisket back on the rack over the vegetables. Place brisket over the sauce. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven 30 minutes. Remove from oven and slice across the grain and serve. To reheat, place brisket in the center of a large plate and surround with vegetables. Pour over remaining alfredo sauce and bake for another 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,parmesan cheese,nectarine,chicken meat,cinnamon sugar,caper
title: Nectarine Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie | 1/2 cup cooked chicken meat | 1 napa nectarines or 1 orange, pitted, sliced, and chopped | 3 tablespoons capers | 1 tablespoon cinnamon sugar | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Roll out pastry into an 11 inch circle. Spread filling evenly over pastry and arrange fruit evenly over filling. Sprinkle with sugar and roll up to make a 6 inch long tube. Chill until required. Cut into 6 slices to serve.

title: Elegant Avocado and Salt Free Rye Sourdough Starter
ingredients: 450 g rye flour ( a gluten free flour that has been gluten-free ) | 50 g smoked rye flour ( a gluten free flour that has been gluten-free ) | 1 small finely grated lemon, zest of | 2 tablespoons grated fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon grated organic gelatin | 1 small large organic avocado
instructions: In a medium bowl, sieve together the rye flour, smoked rye flour, lemon rind, sage and a small pinch of salt and pepper. Mix until well combined. Place in an airtight container and cover with cling film or clingfilm. To use, remove the rind from the avocado and carefully scrape the avocado flesh from the skin into the bowl of dry, fresh rye breadcrumbs. Mix in your desired amount of avocado. Turn the dough out onto a cutting board and knead lightly with a good pinch of salt or gluten free flour. Dough will be soft and sticky for approximately 5 - 10 minutes. You know how well mixed you will be in about 7 - 10 minutes. If you’re not convinced the right consistency, just knead the dough well again. Cut a square of plastic wrap over an oven tray and smear around your tray. Place the tray in a preheated oven on the middle shelf for about 40 minutes. When you take it out of the oven or the oven, turn the oven temperature down a little. Allow to cook on the lowest shelf for about 40 - 50 minutes. After 20 minutes the dough should have risen and the top should be a little shaggy. It’s ready to turn out onto a cutting board and cut into pieces about 2cm and 1 inch wide, and a little smaller. If you want to cut any bigger pieces of dough, put them in an electric juicer, cover with plastic wrap and squeeze out excess air, and store in the fridge for at least 2 - 4 weeks. Enjoy.

title: Easy Ceviche
ingredients: 2/3 cup chopped pistachios | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lime juice | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish ( or more of your favourite )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and stir or shake to mix. The ceviche can be refrigerated overnight for best results.

Random Ingredients: green onion,russet potato,cubanelle pepper,cilantro,self rising flour,purpose flour
title: Papas Huancaina
ingredients: 2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour | 2 lbs russet potatoes, cut into 3-inch chunks | 4 ounces self rising flour | 4 bunches green onions, coarsely chopped | 3 ounces chopped fresh cilantro | 1 cubanelle pepper, seeded and finely chopped ( or 3 -4 ounces serrano peppers )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. In a large mixing bowl, mix flour and potatoes together with green onions, cilantro and chiles. Dump dough onto a floured surface and knead until fairly firm. Form dough into an oval, about 2 - ½ inches diameter. Flour top. Cut a cross in top. Bake until puffy and lightly browned, about 45 minutes. Cut out 8, 12 inch squares with cookie cutters. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,hard egg,worcestershire sauce,jalapeno pepper,kidney bean,ginger ale
title: Jerk Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup ginger ale | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1 -2 slice fresh ginger in juice, removed with a vegetable peeler | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients except egg in a large bowl until well blended. Cover, chill and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,paprika,white wine,dark sesame oil,green lentil,pecan,heavy cream
title: Sultan's Tent Harira
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons paprika ( sweet, hot, and a bit dry ) | 1 lb green lentil, rinsed and drained | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 cup heavy cream, whipped | 1/3 cup finely chopped pecans ( optional ) | 1 lemon peel, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Line the bottom and up the sides of a jelly roll pan with parchment paper. Heat sesame oil in a medium heat skillet over medium heat. Stir in paprika, then fry until it just begins to brown. Add lentils and cook for 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly golden, stirring frequently. Stir in wine.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,applesauce,okonomiyaki sauce,hot italian sausage,dark soy sauce,turbinado sugar,rice wine vinegar
title: Sweet & Spicy Sausage Applesauce for 1 or 2
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage ( sweet or hot ) | 1/4 cup turbinado sugar ( or sucanat ) | 1/2 cup applesauce | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons apprx. hot italian sausages or 2 tablespoons browned pork meat | 1 cup black-eyed peas or 1 cup peas, thawed
instructions: Brown sausage in large skillet, breaking up chunks as it cooks. Drain. In same skillet, combine sugar, applesauce, vinegar, and sausages. Over meduim heat, bring to a boil and caramelize sugar, scraping all the caramelized sugar into the sauce. Add black eyed peas, cover and simmer about 5 minutes. Serve over noodles or eat it plain.

title: Sauce for Hamburger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 package egg noodles
instructions: Saute hamburger in frying pan with a little olive oil over medium heat till browned. Pour off grease from pan with hamburger. Cook noodles following manufacturer's instructions, drain. Stir in ham and drippings. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hill bros cappucino mocha cappuccino mix,chunky salsa,corn syrup
title: Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 box hill's best cheese cappuccino mix | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 package hill bros original blend cappuccino mix
instructions: Prepare cheese cappucino according to box instructions. While the cheese is cooking heat corn syrup in sauce pot. Pour corn syrup on top and bring rapidly to a boil. Remove from heat and add corn syrup to the cheese. Mix mixture well. Pour over cheese and spread to the edges of the muffin tin. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 5 - 7 mins or until the tops are golden and bubbly. Watch the muffins carefully because they can burn you. Use a candy thermometer to be careful while boiling.

title: Asian Beef Wraps
ingredients: 3/4 cup rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef or 1 lb flank steak
instructions: Mix vinegar and garlic. Roll beef slices in mixture. In a medium sized bowl, place lettuce and beef slices, overlapping slices. Roll tightly and tuck ends underneath.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,red chili pepper flake,lemon pepper,sesame oil,white sugar,pudding rice
title: Spicy Sesame Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice | 3 -5 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 -5 tablespoons lemon pepper ( go easy ) | 2 teaspoons red chili peppers or 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1/2 pie crusts ( frozen or homemade are best )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the pie crust and roll into pie. Bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees or until fork tender. Remove and cool. Slice and serve.

title: Bourbon Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 1 large spaghetti squash | 1/2 cup bourbon whiskey, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Cut spaghetti squash in half lengthwise, scoop out seeds and place in a baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, 40 to 50 minutes. Remove from oven, and place on a large silicone baking mat to cover the squash. Use a fork to squeeze out excess juices. Smooth remaining juices out inside the baking dish. Cover with a lid, and bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven. Turn squash out onto a cutting board, and cut into 1 1/2 inch slices with a serrated knife.

title: Spaghetti With Risotto and Parsley
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice ( about 3 3/4 cups ) | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, minced
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Stir in parsley and cook until tender but still firm.

title: African-Style Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 cup frozen chopped corn | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: In a ziploc bag, combine corn, fennel seed and vanilla. Refrigerate and toss well. Serve with lots of crackers.

title: Superfine Sugar
ingredients: 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Pour sugar in a fine mesh sieve, coating the sugar grains completely. Place on a small plate, cover with a cloth, and refrigerate for one hour. Remove the sugar from the refrigerator, and shake off any excess sugar. In a shallow bowl, stir together the sugar, mustard, and salt. Stir in the dry mustard. Roll into small balls, and let sit until cool enough to handle, about 2 hours.

title: West African Green Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 jar mild curry paste ( maesri ) | 1 jar crunchy peanut butter | 1 green pepper, diced
instructions: In a deep frying pan, add peanut butter and saute diced pepper to taste. Once the peanut butter is mixed well add green pepper and stir until slightly softened. This is delicious alone but with others. Serve with hot fruit dishes.

Random Ingredients: pace picante sauce,stewing beef,onion powder,nutritional yeast,green lentil,grape
title: Santa Fe Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef | 1/2 cup green lentil | 12 ounces pace picante sauce | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon grape, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Brown meat in olive oil at medium heat. Add remaining ingredients except the grapes. Cover and simmer 3 - 4 hours. Garnish with grape.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,coconut,liquid smoke,almond extract,savoy cabbage,double cream
title: Cabbage Fried Rice With Coconut (Nigerian Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage ( small head ) | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons sweetened coconut ( unsweetened ) | 6 fluid ounces double cream ( or half & half cream ) | 1 dash almond extract | 1 ounce flaked coconut ( unsweetened ) | 1 ounce flaked coconut ( unsweetened ) | 1 handful coarsely ground almonds ( optional )
instructions: Place cabbage in a saucepan along with liquid smoke. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for approx 1/2 hours or until meat has become tender. Cut cabbage into quarters, removing core and grissle. Heat remaining oil in a frying pan large enough to hold all the cabbage. Add sliced cabbage in batches to the hot oil. Fry until the cabbage is slightly crisp. Drain cabbage on a paper towel lined plate, then return the oil to the frying pan. Beat together cream and almond extract, and stir into the hot oil. Stir in coconut and flaked coconut. Return the rice and cook, stirring, until the rice is heated through. Serve sprinkled with the toasted coconut and almonds and any remaining coconut.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,manchego cheese,ladyfinger,garlic salt,raisin
title: Manchego-Stuffed Garlic Cookies
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers | 1/2 cup olive oil flavored cooking spray | 3 tablespoons raisins | 3 tablespoons manchego cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Place the ladyfingers in a mixing bowl and cover with a dish towel.

title: Artichokes in Chipotle
ingredients: 3 artichokes | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles, paste with pepade ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Remove and discard the stem from the artichokes. Rinse the artichokes under running water, then drain well. Slice the artichokes into 1/4 inch slices on the bias. In a mortar with a pestle, grind the chipotle and sea salt together. Set aside. To warm the bread, place the artichokes in a skillet and pour about 2 tablespoons of the chipotle mixture over the artichokes. Cook over medium heat until the artichokes are heated through and lightly browned on the edges and just tender. Remove the artichokes from the pan, remove the artichokes from the pan, place in a serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,turmeric powder,active yeast,serrano chili,cream chicken soup,xanthan gum,beef sirloin steak
title: Yummy, Tasty and Fast Beef Curry from Vegemite
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons powdered active dry yeast | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder ( haldi ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup, 1 can cream of mushroom soup, 1 can cream of celery soup can be substituted for cream of celery soup ( undiluted ) | 1 large white meaty hamburger | 1 lb thinly sliced beef sirloin steak | 2 serrano chili | 1 cup thawed active dry yeast | 1/4 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: In small bowl, combine yeast, turmeric and cream of potato. Let sit until creamy. In skillet, lightly brown meat, then set aside. Remove steak from pan and cut into strips. In same skillet, lightly brown sirloin with serrano chilis. Add beef back inches. Set aside. Add yeast mixture and 1/2 cup of cream of potato to pan. Heat to a simmer for 5 minutes and add remaining sauces. Add meat. Cook for 10 minutes or until heated thorougly. Serve over noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: biscuit,vegetable stock,peanut,cumin seed,turnip,sake,tomato green chilies,red bean paste
title: Pancakes With Peanut Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon red bean paste | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 400 g diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 small turnip, cubed | 0.5 frozen biscuits ( such as biscuits of your choice ) | 1 cup fresh peas or 1 cup frozen peas | 1 tablespoon chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Heat the stock and add the bean paste and cumin seeds, stir through. Add the diced tomatoes, turnip, peas and nuts and warm through. Add the biscuit halves and place under a hot grill until golden brown.

title: Red Hot Chilli Pudding
ingredients: 10 red chili peppers, seeded and finely chopped | 150 g canned red chili peppers, rinsed and finely chopped | 200 g double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c/380°f/gas. Place the chilies, cream and chopped red chilies in a flameproof bowl and warm gently. Pour this over the chilies and cream in the bowl. Spray a shallow ovenproof dish with non stick cooking spray. Arrange about 2 tablespoons of the chilli mixture into the dish. Bake for 35 minutes. Serve.

title: Cherry BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar cherry pie filling | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon garlic sauce, or to taste
instructions: Stir cherry pie filling, paprika, and garlic sauce together in a bowl until evenly combined.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,lime wedge,miso,couscous,guacamole,green grape,cloud ear mushroom
title: Wildbagna
ingredients: 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup couscous | 7/8 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup grapes, halved, toasted | 1/4 cup thinly sliced cloud ear mushrooms, lightly packed | 1/4 teaspoon miso | lemon wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring broth and couscous to boil in medium nonstick skillet over med high heat. Remove from heat. Stir in guacamole.

title: Chia Chaing (Vietnamese Tea)
ingredients: 1 cup tea ( chia baise ) | oil, for brushing
instructions: Boil the hot tea in a pot for 1 minute. Remove tea into a tea strainer lined with a tea towel to drain. Place tea on a small flat surface on a towel, add 1/4 tablespoon of oil to the middle and roll the tea until it's completely covered, then use as a tea towel to squeeze out excess water. Repeat with remaining tea. Garnish with chia baise.

title: Lemongrass and Pork Stir-Fry
ingredients: 5 stalks lemongrass, trimmed | 6 ounces thinly sliced lean pork roast | 3 tablespoons clear honey | 21 ounces fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Slice the roots from the lemongrass. Use a mandolin or sharp knife to cut the lemongrass into very thin rounds. Wash the lemongrass and pork well under cold running water, rubbing any dirt off. Cut strips into 2 1in lengths. Heat ½ tablespoon of the honey in a large frying pan. Place the pork in one side of the pan and sprinkle with the remaining honey. Leave to simmer for 2 minutes then turn the pork over and cook for 5 minutes. Add the leaves and continue to stir, until the spinach is wilted and coated inches. Serve immediately with steamed rice.

title: Easy Beef Jerky from the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 jar prepared mushroom soup ( or your favorite brand ) | 1 lb steak, sliced in the desired size | 1 can sliced pineapple in juice, drained | 1 can ready to eat frozen shrimp
instructions: Drain the juice from the pineapple, the can add a little bit of sugar and water if necessary. Place the drained mushrooms in the bottom of your crock pot. Place the sliced steak on top. Add the mushrooms and shrimp. If you have any juice from the pineapple, add a few drops of water in the jar. Mix well. Cover and allow to set for at least 3 hours.

title: Greek Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup warm whole-milk greek yogurt or 1/2 cup plain yogurt, at room temperature | 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/4 teaspoons lemons or 1 1/4 teaspoons lime juice ( about 2 lemons ) | 7 large chicken leg quarters, preferably with thigh attached, with skins on
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the warm whole milk or yoghurt with the yeast. Let stand about 10 minutes until foamy. Transfer the yeast froth to a medium bowl and add the lemons or lime juice. In a large, heavy, ovenproof skillet, arrange the chicken pieces skin side down. Add the yeast mixture, then the milk or yoghurt mixture. Stir, cover, and leave somewhere warm overnight to raise the chicken and marinate the chicken. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Bake chicken in the centre of the oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until cooked evenly and browned, basting once with the hot marinade.

title: Mexican Scallion Bars
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 packages scallions | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Heat a skillet and spray with cooking spray. Add scallions and brown on both sides, then transfer to a piece of waxed paper and cut lengthwise into 2 wide strips. Repeat until all the scallions are used. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Pour scallions over scallions. Set aside. In a food processor or blender, add vanilla and puree until smooth. Pour into baking dish. Place in a warm oven, 350 f. Oven for 25 - 30 minutes, stirring around every ten minutes. Remove and leave to cool. Cut into bars.

title: Grilled Oranges With Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 large oranges | 1 large red fresno ( or regular mozzarella ) | 1 lb fresh black mushrooms or 1 lb green mushroom | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves
instructions: Cut the peel from the oranges. Cut out the oranges from the membrane without removing any of the white pith. Cut the segments from the fruit by slicing down the peel carefully from the membrane. Rinse lightly with cold running water to remove the white pith. Set aside. If the orange is too large for your tastes, slice in half then use paper towels to blot out any bitter juices and to remove from the membrane. Trim the white membrane from the mozzarella, it should be long, thin and somewhat tough. Slice into 1/4 inch thick slices. Sprinkle the mozzarella with salt and allow to sit for 20 minutes at room temperature before serving. Mix the basil with the orange sections and sprinkle evenly on the grilled cheese. Allow to marinate in the refrigerator for up to 2 hours. Slice the mushrooms and toss the mushrooms in the refrigerator. Grill oranges over hot coals or medium coals, covered with a lid, until the orange is tender and the juice is slightly syrupy, about 5 to 7 minutes. Serve at once with basil leaves.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,celery seed,grain white rice,red kidney bean,portabella mushroom,cream,cranberry sauce
title: Tamarind Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup white rice | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp | 225 g red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 225 g red portabella mushrooms, sliced | 250 ml light cream, whipped or 250 ml light cream | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon portabella mushroom, drained
instructions: Cook rice in 2 cups boiling water for 20 minutes until rice is tender and water holes appear. Drain, rinse and then chill for 1 hour. Cook tamarind pulp in 2 tablespoons boiling water for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir through cooked rice. Meanwhile, cook beans, mushrooms, cream, celery seed and remaining 1 tablespoon water in heavy saucepan on high for 1 - 5 minutes or until hot but not boiling. Stir through rice mixture and heat for 3 - 4 minutes, until heated through, stirring, serve straight away.

title: Easy To Have Stir Fry On the Go
ingredients: panir, cubed | wasabi powder ( powder ) | oil, to fry
instructions: Put a small amount of oil on the panir. Spread wasabi on the panir. Put panir in the oil. Serve hot with rice, pasta and veggies and dip into wasabi.

Random Ingredients: fish,jasmine rice,cake flour,green chile pepper,sake,strawberry,crescent,lemon juice zest
title: Fried Fish With Rice and Strawberries
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 cup packed fresh strawberries | 1/2 pound firm-ripe fresh fish | 1 small green chile pepper | 1 tablespoon sake | 2 packages floured crescent | 2 teaspoons sifted cake flour | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon minced fresh green chile pepper
instructions: Place rice in a medium bowl. Place strawberries in a food processor and process until finely chopped. Set aside. Cover rice with a clean cloth and set aside. Wash fish and slice into pieces about 2 1/2 inches wide. Set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add fish. Remove the fish from the skillet and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Drain excess liquid from skillet. Heat 1 tablespoon sake in the skillet over medium heat. Dredge fish pieces in cake flour and add to the hot skillet. Gently stir in the 1 teaspoon shrimp seasoning and the lemon juice. Spoon the rice mixture over fish. Cover and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 25 minutes or until fish is flaky. Sprinkle with green chili pepper and serve.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,sriracha sauce,tamarind paste,chili powder,beef tenderloin
title: Asian Beef Satay
ingredients: 1 cup tamarind paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce | 1 1/4 lbs beef tenderloin
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine tamarind paste, chili powder, soya sauce, sriracha sauce, and beef. Refrigerate 1 hour. Prepare skewers, using metal or bamboo skewers that have been soaked in water for at least 30 minutes, and grill skewers 10 minutes, or as needed, turning and brushing with marinade occasionally as meat cooks. Serve with steamed rice and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: green zucchini,plain flour,red thai chili pepper,cooking spray,apricot jam,mint
title: Trident Low Fat Vegetarian Chilli - Apricot Nuts for One
ingredients: cooking spray | 3/4 cup plain flour | 4 -5 medium firm green zucchini | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1 -2 red thai's chili pepper, seeded & sliced | 3 tablespoons of fresh mint, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat an oven to 220c / fan 160c / gas scatter the zucchini slices lightly with the apricot jam and chilli in a roasting tin or baking tray, then spray with the cooking oil. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove from the oven, scatter over the mint, then allow to cool. To serve, cut into wedges & scatter over the warm chilli. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: basil,bean sprout,cooking oil,cheddar cheese,cilantro,golden raisin,poblano pepper
title: Famous Beans and Poblano
ingredients: 1/4 cup cooking oil | 3 poblano peppers, chopped | 2 cups fresh bean sprouts | 1/8 cup golden raisin, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro | 1/8 cup shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the poblano pepper and cook until lightly browned. Stir in the beans, raisins, cilantro and cilantro. Heat to boiling.

title: Duck Salad With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 4 duck | 4 slices canadian bacon | 4 sourdough rye cocktail bread or 4 rye bread | 1 cup fresh cranberries
instructions: Brush the duck with olive oil, and broil on all sides until it stops foaming. Take duck out of oven, and brush with canadian bacon. Place on a platter, and serve warm. To serve, break bread into pieces and place each piece on one of the serving plates. Spoon cranberries on the bread, and drizzle with the bacon drippings from the duck. Note, i like to add the mint leaves, but they're not necessary.

title: Pistachio Margarita (No-Stick Cooking)
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces tequila | pistachios ( optional ) or almonds, chopped to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour the desired amount of sugar into a small cocktail shaker. Shake to taste. Strain 1 1/2 oz. Margarita into a small martini glass rimmed with sugar. Garnish with pistachios or almonds, as desired, if desired.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,green mango,seasoning salt,salad dressing
title: Green Mango Cheese (East Indian Style)
ingredients: 1 green mango, peeled and finely diced | 2 packages dry curd cottage cheese | salt to taste | 1/2 cup salad dressing
instructions: Combine mango and cottage cheese in a large bowl, and toss with salt. Sprinkle salad dressing over the salad dressing, and toss until mixture is evenly coated. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving to blend flavors.

title: Curry Spinach (Pollo)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 3 -4 tablespoons ghee | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 150 -300 fresh spinach leaves, roughly chopped ( approx. 8 bunches ) | 50 g fresh white breadcrumbs ( breadcrumbs are available at any grocery store and some supermarkets. it's quite easy to make fresh breadcrumbs in there. the quantity of breadcrumbs increase by half and you can substitute breadcrumbs with plain flour. )
instructions: Cut the chicken into pieces of the same size as the spinach leaves. In a heavy bottomed pan, melt the ghee over medium heat. Once the oil is hot, add the chicken pieces. Turn frequently until they just start to brown on all sides. Sprinkle the corriander powder over the chicken. It doesn't take long to do that, just until it's really a good color. The water in the pan helps create a strong acid flavor with a strong smell of corriander and the acidity of the ghee. The liquid will begin to separate from the oil and smell.. It is to be expected that the liquid should be boiling. Add the spinach and stir to coat in the oil. Cover and turn down the heat to low. The longer the chicken cooks, the more aromatic and flavourful it will be. For about an hour. When the chicken is tender and cooked through, pour off all but approximately 1 - 2 tablespoons of the oil remaining in the pan. Take pan off of the heat. Drain the spinach in a sieve or colander and remove any grit or excess moisture with your hands. Return to the pan and add the breadcrumbs, cook for another 5 minutes, stirring continuously until the breadcrumbs are golden. Serve immediately.

title: Vanilla Noodle Cocktail
ingredients: 1 ounce white dark english-style vodka, chilled | 1 1/2 ounces vanilla flavored vodka, chilled | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 1/2 ounces ramen noodles ( optional )
instructions: Combine vodka, vanilla, and salt in a cocktail shaker. Shake vigorously just before using. Pour in chilled vodka mixture. Shake vigorously a few times until well chilled.

title: Gingersnaps
ingredients: 800 g crab, in shells | 3 tablespoons gingernaps | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Remove heads from crab, including all the shell, and cut the meat into chunks. Combine the crab heads, crabmeat, gingernaps, oil and chilli in a microwave safe container. Microwave on high for 4 minutes, stirring once. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: walnut half,saffron,grain white rice,red wine vinegar,tomato juice,pecan,yellow pepper
title: Pecan Polow (Spanish Rice and Vegetables)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long-grain white rice | 3/4 cup unsweetened tomato juice | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 small yellow sweet pepper | 1/3 cup walnut halves, toasted and chopped | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
instructions: Place the rice, tomato juice, vinegar, saffron, sweet pepper, and walnut halves in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, about 20 minutes. Mix in the cinnamon, and remove from heat, cover, and set aside for 5 minutes to allow flavors to develop. Serve warm or cold.

title: Samba Rolls
ingredients: 8 ounces golden raisins | 2 small serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon granulated garlic | 8 -10 sheets rice paper, preferably spring roll
instructions: Soak raisins in hot water 30 minutes. Drain well. Finely dice chiles and garlic and spread out a small piece of parchment on baking sheets. On a board with a sharp edge, spread out half of the raisins to 1/3 inch thickness, pressing down and smoothing the surface to level it.. Spread out 2 tbsp of the drained raisins along with 2 tbsp of the chopped chiles and 2 tbsp of the garlic. Roll up from the short side, jelly roll fashion, burrito style. Using a spatula, cut roll into 2 inch long strips. Tightly roll the strips in the oil to coat. Keep in refrigerator until ready to use. Bring 3 3/4 cups water to simmer in a wide, heavy saucepan over medium high heat. Add rolls and reduce heat to low and simmer until soft, about 12 minutes.. Transfer roll sticks to a paper towel lined plate and let cool 5 minutes. Remove paper towels, discard paper, and serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,kidney bean,poblano chile,cod fish fillet,fennel bulb,corn kernel,phyllo dough
title: Mexican Fish Pie
ingredients: 1 cup kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 3 ears fresh corn kernels, or more to taste | 2 poblano chiles, diced | 1 fennel bulb, chopped | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1 package prepared phyllo dough, thawed | 2 cups chopped cooked cod fish fillets
instructions: Place kidney beans, corn, poblano chilies, fennel bulb, fontina cheese, and 1/4 cup water in a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium.

title: Roasted Fish Fillets
ingredients: 2 tablespoons szechuan peppercorns | 4 -8 ounces white fish fillets | sodium mixed spice | 1 tablespoon olive
instructions: Place szechuan peppercorns in a bowl and crush using the back of a spoon into fine powder. Lightly dust fish with salt and set aside. Preheat oven to 400°f lightly oil a shallow pan or a baking tin and lightly dust lightly with mixed spice. Place fish on the peppercorn coated pan and roast uncovered for about 10 minutes. Turning once, roast for a further 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp.

Random Ingredients: dark red kidney bean,cherry tomato,ice,bread,white chocolate
title: Italian Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 6 slices bread, about 1/4-inch thick | 6 cherry tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup ice | 8 ounces white chocolate, chopped
instructions: Toast the bread in the top of a double boiler over boiling water, about 1 minute. Combine the cherry tomatoes and drained kidney beans, and divide the mixture among the 4 slices of toast. Drizzle the chocolate over the top. Melt a little extra chocolate sauce or dark rum, and place under the broiler to melt the chocolate.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive oil,bicarbonate soda,buttermilk,yellow squash,wheat breadcrumb,hamburger bun,tater tot
title: Cheat's Low Fat Buttermilk and Olive Burger
ingredients: 1/4 cup buttermilk | 350 g tater tots | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon wheat breadcrumbs | 2 cans sliced spanish olives, drained | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 medium yellow squash, finely chopped | 8 hamburger buns, toasted
instructions: Put all ingredients at the bottom of a low sided, non stick pan. Heat until warmed through, stirring every so often to prevent sticking. Toast under a moderate to medium heat until golden brown.

title: Easy Red Peppers Filler
ingredients: 2 cups crushed canned cornmeal | 1 can condensed cream of broccoli soup, undiluted | 1 red bell pepper, finely diced ( optional )
instructions: Heat over medium low heat the soup and the red bell pepper until bubbly. Spoon mixture onto wax paper lined cookie sheets. Sprinkle tops with cornmeal. Bake at 425f for 7 minutes or until golden and top is golden brown.

title: Pepperoncini's Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 package cream cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes and softened | 1 can chicken bouillon | 1 loaf bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place beef tenderloin on a piece of heavy duty aluminum foil. Spread cream cheese cubes over the top layer of beef. Layer with bouillon, and top with bread cubes. Place on a baking sheet. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until a knife inserted into center of the tenderloin comes out clean.

title: Huitres a La Boba - Baked Eggsplants With Lobster & Shrimp
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread | 1 1/2 lbs raw lobster tails, peeled | 2 lbs raw jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 medium eggplants, peeled, cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f place bread on baking sheet and toast 15 to 20 minutes or until slightly browned. Set aside. Remove shells from lobster, leaving juice in shell, and coarsely chop meat. Add shrimp and lobster juice to bread.

title: Hacked Greek Yogurt With Toast Crackers (Yogurt Subji)
ingredients: 2 1/8 pints greek-style yogurt ( like sour cream ) | 1 baguette, sliced for small sandwiches
instructions: Make sure to remove the crust from the baguette, you will not need it if you do. Slide the baguette from a baguette/slice into a hot skillet, with just enough yogurt to fill the baguette. Slide the bread into a preheated oven and bake for 5 minutes. Serve at once with a drizzle of greek olive oil, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,cilantro leaf,tomato green chilies,cream chicken soup,white onion,meat,white vinegar,horseradish
title: Mexican Sour Meat Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked meat, chopped | 4 white onions, chopped | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup white distilled vinegar | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies ( rotel ) | 1 cup snipped fresh cilantro leaves or 1 cup parsley | 1/2 cup snipped chives | 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: In a deep 3 to 4 quart saucepan, mix together meat, onions, soup, vinegar, tomatoes, and cilantro, then bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, 20 minutes, until sauce has thickened slightly and flavors are blended, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and season with chives and chive. Let cool 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,greek yogurt,chicken stock cube,vegetable oil,chili sauce,mace,maraschino cherry
title: Healthy Sweet Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 2 slices hot maraschino cherries ( or your favourite dried cherries ) | 1/2 cup wheat flour | 1/2 cup chicken stock cube
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan. Add cinnamon, sweet chili sauce, mace and cherries. Simmer about 3 minutes. Sift flour and add to pan, stirring until thickened. Transfer to serving bowl or platter. Refrigerate, covered, for up to 3 days, stirring occasionally. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,coriander powder,stewing beef,heavy whipping cream,cauliflower floret,swiss cheese,bread
title: Corned Beef and Cauliflower Sandwiches on Garlic Toast
ingredients: 3 lbs corned beef ( or more to your taste ) | 1 head cauliflower floret ( or more to your taste ) | 12 slices bread | 1/2 lb swiss cheese, sliced | 14 1/2 fluid ounces heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Heat a large frying pan on medium high and add 1/4 cup olive oil. Slice corned beef and add to frying pan. Cook on one side until brown, then turn and cook on other side until brown. While corned beef is cooking chop the cauliflower florets and brown in the remainder of the olive oil in the same frying pan. Set aside. Cut bread slices in half on both sides and toast in oven at 400 degrees for 6 minutes. Slice corned beef into thin strips and add to crockpot. Add cauliflower and mix well. Add the cream to crockpot and stir. Cook on low for 3 - 4 hours. To serve toast the 2 slice breads on the untoasted side of the sandwich. Spread with teriyaki sauce and sprinkle some coriander over top.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,edamame,french bread,liquid honey,brown sugar,garlic salt
title: Edamame Soup(Mongolian)
ingredients: 1 package frozen shelled edamame | 4 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon liquid honey | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 loaf french bread, cut into cubes and toasted
