instructions: In a 5 quart dutch oven or soup pot, cook edamame in boiling water for about 5 minutes or until bright green and tender. Remove and immediately plunge into cold water. Peel off frozen edamame and slice into 1/4 inch slices. In a 3 quart dutch oven, combine cream, honey, garlic salt, liquid honey and brown sugar. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes. Add crouton croutons and cook for 5 minutes. Ladle into soup bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark red kidney bean,pepper,quinoa,grape,beef stew meat
title: Slow-Cooked Beef and Quinoa Stew
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef stew meat | 1 can dark red kidney beans, rinsed and halved | 1 1/4 cups canned medium-size diced dates or 1 1/4 cups grape tomatoes | 1 teaspoon pepper | 2 cups cooked quinoa
instructions: Place meat in a 5 qt slow cooker. Top with beans, tomatoes and pepper. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours. Note, the meat may be prepared and frozen up to 3 months in resealable bags. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,mace,wheat tortilla,vegetable stock,garnish,dark brown sugar,tabasco sauce,hard egg
title: Fruity Huevos Rancheros
ingredients: 10 soft whole wheat tortillas ( preferably organic ) | 1/2 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( or any hot pepper sauce ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace ( or any hot pepper sauce ) | 3 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 1/8 cup shredded lettuce leaf | 2 tablespoons finely shredded lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons finely chopped lettuce leaves
instructions: Prepare tortillas, lay tortillas on a kitchen towel and pat dry with paper towels. Cover with saran wrap and microwave on high for 30 seconds or until damp. Transfer to a bowl and let drain until cool. Reserve about 2 tablespoons of the tortillas for garnish. Using a blender or food processor, puree reserved tortillas, remaining stock, brown sugar, tabasco sauce and mace. Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly toast the tortillas on a nonstick griddle until soft but not too soft, about 30 seconds per side. Spread tortillas on a plate and top with remaining tortillas and a couple of egg quarters. Sprinkle on lettuce, tomato, onion, avocado and any additional toppings that you choose. In a small bowl, combine shredded lettuce, lettuce, tomato and remaining egg. Using a spoon, drizzle the egg wash over each pile of garnishes.

title: My Very Own Guacamole
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil, packed | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh lemon peel | 2 -3 teaspoons prepared guacamole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill slightly.

title: Goats Cheese and Nuts
ingredients: 3 ounces goat cheese | 12 ounces buttermilk | 1 ounce parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Place the goat cheese in a small, dry pan and set over a medium heat. When the cheese begins to melt, stir every 3 - 4 minutes until the excess liquid has cooked off and the cheese is starting to brown. Pour the buttermilk into the pan and stir to dislodge any bubbles. Once cheese has melted, stir in the parmesan cheese. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly so the flavors can mix while they chill. As a variation, place this in a small, warm oven safe bowl. Top with roasted cashews and freshly grated parmesan cheese. Letting the mixture sit for a few minutes is a bonus, as these are quite addictive.

title: Easy Microwave Calamari
ingredients: 600 g baking potatoes, peeled | 2 small baking potatoes, peeled | 2 small squash, peeled | 4 teaspoons crushed rose water ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons frozen peas and carrots, thawed
instructions: Using a 3 cup capacity casserole dish, layer the potato peel, squash, peas and carrot over the potato layers. Sprinkle with rosewater, if using. Microwave for about 4 minutes on high, stirring once, until vegetables are tender. Sprinkle top with a few pinches of salt, if desired, and cut into wedges or chunks to serve.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,cool whip,red beet,kidney bean,liquid honey,red chili pepper flake,vodka,iceberg lettuce
title: Kidney Bean Pouch Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 15 ounces kidney beans | 15 ounces red beets, drained and peeled | 1 pinch red chili pepper flakes | 1 1/4 cups crushed iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup liquid honey | 1 container low-fat cool whip ( thawed )
instructions: Prepare a 6 x 1/2 jelly roll pan, with parchment paper sprayed over the rim. Rinse and drain the kidney beans.

title: Italian Style Mascarpone
ingredients: 4 ounces mascarpone | 2 tablespoons raisins, soaked in warm water for 10 minutes ( or more ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste, plus | 2 tablespoons garlic paste, divided | 1 pinch cracked black pepper
instructions: Cream cheese in a bowl with a pinch of salt and black pepper. Add 1 tbs. Of garlic and fold in with a fork. Add in raisins. Spray pan with cooking spray and pour in mascarpone mixture. Keep in mind, mascarpone cheese is extremely salty so you might want to add more salt if necessary. Heat in oven until cheese has melted. Serve warm. Refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,baby spinach,walnut,palm sugar,mascarpone,bean black,pineapple chunk
title: Sweet Potato Spinach and Bean Cake
ingredients: 1 kg baking potato, peeled | 8 ounces baby spinach ( washed and trimmed ) | 8 ounces mixed beans ( black, green, white or kidney beans ) | 1 tablespoon walnut pieces | 2 tablespoons pinepeas, chopped | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1/3 cup mascarpone
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees celcius. Cut the potatoes, if you are intending to use them as such, into halves and boil in a large pan of water for about 20 minutes until soft, drain, place in a bowl, cover and leave for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the spinach in salted boiling water for 5 - 10 minutes or until wilted. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl with the beans and walnuts. Heat a frying pan over medium heat, add the pinepeas, sugar and mascarpone and toss to combine. Spoon the sweet potato mixture into the lined tin and spread evenly. Bake for 25 minutes, or until heated through and golden. Leave to cool in the tin for 10 minutes then unmould onto a serving plate.

title: Eggplant Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 teaspoon ground tarragon | 1 tablespoon dried mustard | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh tarragon | 2 teaspoons finely chopped ripe olives | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mango | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed according to package directions | 3 eggs, beaten
instructions: Trim the ends from the eggplant and peel off outer layer 1/2 inch cut away the ends and discard. Slice eggplant crosswise into 1/8 inch slices on the lightly floured work surface. Place slices in a colander and sprinkle with tarragon, mustard and chopped tarragon. Allow eggplant to drain, approximately 1 1/2 hours. Transfer eggplant to a cutting board and use slotted spoon to remove any excess moisture. Sprinkle with salt and let rest. Preheat oven to 375°f. Meanwhile, in a small bowl combine remaining tarragon with the grated mango, vanilla extract and 1/2 teaspoon salt and set aside. Unroll phyllo dough and cover with a damp cloth. Line a 17x29 inch jelly roll pan with a double layer of foil. Unroll the phyllo dough and spray with nonstick spray. Unroll phyllo dough, placing approximately 1/4 inch from bottom and side. Place half of the phyllo in pan, brushing with nonstick spray. Layer 1/3 of the mango mixture over phyllo, then half of the eggplant mixture, 1/3 of the cheese mixture, 1/3 of the remaining eggplant mixture and 1/3 of the remaining cheese. Repeat layers. Top with the remaining phyllo dough sheets, brushing each one with nonstick spray. Spread remaining mango mixture over rolled tops. Bake at 375°f for 45 - 60 minutes or until golden. Cool 20 minutes. Cut crosswise into 12 small squares.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,orange bell pepper,yellow onion
title: Super Easy Chicken Supper
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 red bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Mix soup with peppers and vegetables. Spread into a 9x13 or larger baking dish or crock. Broil for 10 minutes, or until bubbly. Cut into slices. Serve with french bread.

title: Saffron Prawns (Shrimp)
ingredients: 1 lb shelled prawns | 1 cup corn oil | 2 tablespoons saffron strands ( ground between your fingers ) | 1 cup peanut oil
instructions: Wash prawns and remove shells. Rinse well in plenty of cold water. Combine the ground saffron with 3 cup of water in a bowl. Add prawns and mix the mixture well. Cover with plastic wrap and leave for 2 hours. Mix oil, saffron solution and oil separately in a bowl. Heat wok or nonstick skillet until really hot. Add oil mixture and prawn mixture and stir constantly for 1 - 2 minutes. Remove from fire. Serve with rice or a salad.

title: Tunisian Creamy Mushroom and Chicken Tatin
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders | 6 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled | 3 tablespoons instant espresso or 3 tablespoons instant chicken bouillon, divided | 2 tablespoons ground cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 12 fresh basil leaves, cleaned | 1 small cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, toasted
instructions: Prepare the gorgonzola mushroom cream sauce, combine 1/2 cup hot water and espresso powder and stir with a whisk until smooth.

title: Italian Steak and Carrots
ingredients: 8 baby carrots, halved diagonally, lengthwise | 12 ounces flank steaks, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups fat-free italian parsley dressing ( vigo ) | 1/2 cup fat-free margarita mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f coat a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Spread carrots on foil lined baking sheet. Place beef in single layer in dish.

title: Orange Oranges Poached in Gruyere Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 24 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | fresh oregano | orange zest ( optional ) | swiss gruyere cheese or other tasty cheese, grated ( for garnish )
instructions: Place cream cheese in a large stainless steel pot over medium heat. Using a pestle and mortar or other instrument of your choice, crush cream cheese to a fine paste. Add oregano and orange zest if using. When cheese is sufficiently incorporated, place over low heat until mixture begins to foam. Remove from heat and allow to stand until cheese is completely melted. Stuff mixture into small, round tortilla shaped patties. Chill until set, about 30 minutes. Cut each patty in half and garnish with a sprinkling of swiss gruyere. Note, for a milder sauce, add finely chopped fresh or frozen orange zest to cooked or canned pineapple for a more tropical flavor.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,tarragon vinegar,spanish onion,beef,double cream,steak,water chestnut
title: Steak Au Poivre (Steak and Onions) in Tarragon Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 spanish onion | 200 g beef | 200 g water chestnuts | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, zest of | 2 tablespoons double cream or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 300 g steaks
instructions: To make the sauce, peel the onion and slice it into thin slices. Wash the beef and pat dry with paper towels. Heat the pan and sear the onions until golden. If your pan is large enough, you can use a heavy duty skillet. In a blender, mix together everything except the cream or sour cream. Pour in 1/3 of the sauce and blend until all the liquid is absorbed. Pour over the steak. Cook until steak is heated through. Serve at once on top of greens, salads, soup or even in individual deep bowls.

title: Rigatoni With Cashews, Pecans and Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb unsalted cashew nuts | 1 cup toasted cashew nuts | 1 cup dry-roasted rice | 1 cup dry navy beans, soaked overnight | 1 1/2 lbs rigatoni pasta
instructions: The day before, make the bean mixture by stirring together the beans and the rice in a large heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over moderate heat, then reduce the heat and simmer covered 5 minutes. Add the nuts and simmer covered until the rice is tender, about 45 minutes longer. Stir once or twice to encourage them to stick. Remove from the heat, cover and set aside until it is cool enough to handle. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,red grape,garam masala,cheddar cheese soup,cinnamon,snow pea,green bell pepper
title: Gruyere Cheese Veggie Medley
ingredients: 2 stalks green bell peppers, diced | 3 cans condensed cheddar cheese soup | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese soup | snow peas | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Boil the green bell peppers and carrots in a soup pot with the soup until tender. Meanwhile, blend the cheeses and spices in a food processor. Once the vegetables are cooked and soup reduced, mix them together with the cheese/cheese mixture and stir in the snow peas. Chill until serving.

title: Easy Tabbouleh
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1/4 cup italian parsley | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Combine all ingredients well in a medium bowl. Spread over a medium baking sheet. Bake uncovered about 8 minutes, until just puffed. Cool slightly. Cut into squares, spread on pita bread, or cut into squares or triangles.

title: Sugar-Free French Fries
ingredients: 5 -6 small yellow potatoes | 150 g caster sugar
instructions: Put the potato's sugar in a medium size pan and melt the sugar. Turn off the heat and leave to cool down until you can touch it.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,sage,hummus,white sugar,orange section,bow tie pasta,green food coloring,anise seed
title: Sage and Green Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup prepared hummus | 1/3 cup green food coloring | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed, or more to taste | 1 pinch orange zest, or more to taste | 1 1/2 cups spiral-shaped bow tie pasta
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the hummus, green food coloring, lime zest, sugar, sage, anise, and orange zest. If desired, stir in pasta so all components are evenly coated. Refrigerate the dressing until cold before serving.

title: Spinach with poblano Chile and Amaretto
ingredients: 6 tablespoons amaretto | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground roasted chile | 1 bunch fresh spinach, washed and trimmed | 4 cloves roasted garlicamaretto | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Mix amaretto, chile, spinach, garlicamaretto pepper, and lemon pepper seasoning together in a bowl.

title: Saucy Crusted Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish, drained on paper towels | 1/2 cup sour cream ( or plain yogurt, if desired ) | 2 tablespoons prepared prepared garlic-flavored dry pizza sauce ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons flour | kosher salt | 1 -2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch-thick slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a large bowl combine horseradish, sour cream, garlic flavored dry pizza sauce and salt. Stir well, then spread evenly over the pork slices. Insert a piece of butcher's twine in the center of the pork.. Bake the meat for about 20 minutes, or until the pork is browned, tender and cooked throughout. Serve warm.

title: Jerk Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 red onion, cut into thin wedges | 1 tablespoon jerk seasoning, or to taste | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil grate. Combine onion, jerk seasoning, cheese, and red onion in a bowl. Brush half of the cheese mixture onto entire grill grate. Reduce heat to medium low. Grill bread slices.

title: Bowls Dijon Oysters
ingredients: 12 scallions | 12 ounces oysters | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Toast and dry scallions. Blend all ingredients until smooth. Spoon over oysters.

title: Lanab
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts | 1 teaspoon caraway seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Yummy Dip (An Indian Inspired Spread)
ingredients: 2 slices ginger paste | 4 ounces manchego cheese
instructions: Toast the manchego cheese at 400 degrees for about 10 minutes, then spread the dip onto the toast with an oven safe bbq, grill, grill, bake at 300 degrees f for about 1 hour, or until it gets golden brown. Eat it all up.

title: Veggie Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces shredded cabbage | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups chopped cabbage | 1 zucchini, sliced thin | 1 cup dry-roasted nuts, coarsely chopped | freshly grated nut ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise and shredded cabbage. Stir together well and spread over a large serving platter. Arrange zucchini, chickpeas, cabbage, remaining mayonnaise and nuts on top. Serve with fresh pita, pita bread or tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: grape,cracker crumb,ha avocado,taco flour tortilla,water chestnut,kosher salt black pepper,red chili pepper,jasmine rice
title: Quick and Easy Big Bowl Guacamole
ingredients: 3 hass avocados ( california hass ), peeled and thinly sliced | 2 cups cooked jasmine rice | 2 cans sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 tablespoon taco-flavored flour or 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chopped fresh hot red chili pepper | 1/2 - 1 cup coarse cracker crumb | kosher salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the avocado and rice. Stir in the water chestnuts, taco seasoning and chile pepper.

title: Gobo With Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces queso fresco | 1/3 ounce white onion | 2 ounces chopped scallions | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Chop onion finely with a knife or grater, and place in a bowl. Add remaining ingredients, mix well, and cover. After 2 to 3 hours make into about 3 small patties of the same size and make a cone shape with it. Dip, press, and fry in a cast iron skillet until golden brown and crisp on both sides.

Random Ingredients: chat masala,chicken bouillon granule,asafoetida powder,chicken thigh fillet
title: Litha's Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chicken thigh fillets, washed, with skin on | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon chat masala
instructions: Mix the bouillon and asafoetida in a microwave proof bowl. Add the chicken to the bowl and microwave on high for 5 minutes. Stir the chicken well to ensure even cooking. Add the chat masala, microwave for 1 minute. Switch off. Serve immediately, with naan bread, roti or paratha.

Random Ingredients: green bean,tomato,bamboo shoot,sausage,garlic salt,extra virgin olive oil
title: Sausage Lovers Casserole Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, diced very finely | 1 medium tomatoes, diced very finely | 1/2 lb green beans, thinly sliced or 1/2 lb frozen green beans | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt or 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic, from jar of zesty zesty zesty zesty zest of garlic | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and sliced
instructions: Fry the chopped tomato for no more than a few minutes without stirring. You will want to stir a lot now and if you're not sure about the shape of the tomato, throw that in too. Stir in the bacon and fry for another minute. Add the green beans/green beans and cook through. Add the olive oil and garlic salt to the mixture and stir thoroughly. Add the drained bamboo shoots and cook over very low heat. Add the zesty zest of garlic and stir well. Allow to cook slowly. Stir occasionally until the mixture is thick and creamy. Do not boil. Serve over hot, cooked white or brown rice/moisture rye bread.

title: Spaetzle (Swiss Style Cauliflower Fritters)
ingredients: 12 ounces cauliflower flakes | 2/3 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour ( or cornstarch )
instructions: Steam the cauliflower for about 6 minutes. Let cool slightly, drain well and pat dry with paper towels. Place the sesame seeds in a dry frying pan, lightly brown, stirring often. Sprinkle 1/2 cup all purpose flour over and stir, adding more flour as needed, to make a paste. Add a little water, a tablespoon at a time, to make a thick paste. Stir in the drained cauliflower/sesame seeds and continue to stir till thick and smooth. Place the fritters in a baking tray lined with baking paper or wax paper. Bake in 375f degrees oven for about 10 minutes or until golden brown. While the dough is baking, make the gravy, bring a 3/4 cup water to a boil. Add the sesame seeds and return to boil, stirring. Remove from the heat. Put the skillet on the stove and bring just a few drops of water into the gravy, a few at a time, whisking constantly. When the sesame seeds have turned pale yellow but still a little crunchy, pour them over each fritter.

title: Queso & Cheddar Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs velveeta cheese | 1/3 cup queso fresco | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients & mix well.

title: Chicken N-Y Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 onion, sliced | 1/2 cup frozen chopped purple onion | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 3/4 cup shredded reduced-fat cajun pepper jack cheese or 3/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 10 kaiser rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan with nonstick cooking spray. Combine first 3 ingredients. Spoon mixture on rolls.

Random Ingredients: pork butt,beef flavor ramen noodle,andouille sausage,vegetable shortening,bamboo shoot,chicken drumstick,corn,strawberry
title: Sausage and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package beef-flavor ramen noodles | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1 cup andouille sausage, sliced | 1 package lean boneless pork butt, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 package chicken drumsticks, sliced | 3 cups frozen cut strawberries | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1 cup frozen corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Place the beef ramen noodles in the freezer over night. Remove the noodles, and let them cool completely. In a medium bowl, add the shortening, sausage, and pork. Break the noodles up into chunks, and add to meat. Stir well with a wooden spoon or potato masher until mixed. Sprinkle the contents of the noodle bag into the meat mixture. Arrange the fruit on top of the meat, and then arrange the bamboo shoots over the top. Arrange the frozen corn over top. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring a few times, until heated through.

Random Ingredients: green,lettuce leaf,bailey irish cream,kale,baguette,grain mustard,red pepper flake
title: Irish Spice Breakfast Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut in half lengthwise | 3 leaves lettuce | 3 leaves kale, torn | 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 1 teaspoon baileys irish cream | 1/4 cup green | 4 -6 green fat free fresh sprout tops
instructions: Slice baguette into eight wedges. Lightly spread mustard on halves, mustard side down. Spread sliced bread with red pepper flakes. Arrange leaf of kale on mustard side of bread. On leaves of kale, top with thinly sliced red pepper. Top greens with thinly sliced smoked fat free sour cream and chopped green onion.

title: Cherie's Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 packages phyllo dough | 12 ounces cream cheese | 1/4 cup dried parsley flakes | 1/2 cup of ground hazelnuts | 1 -3 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Whip cream cheese, parsley, and hazelnuts. Put some filling on one corner of phyllo, fold over to create a triangle, and press the two edges together to seal. Bake at 350 degrees until golden brown. Repeat with the rest of the phyllo. These are great with fresh fruit, etc.

title: Easy Cheesy Corn and Beans
ingredients: 1 can black or pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 3 frozen corn, thawed | 2 tablespoons sugar | tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In 2 1/2 to 3 quart baking dish, mash beans with fork. Bake, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 30 minutes or until beans are hot and crisp.

title: The Easiest Beef Rolls
ingredients: 500 g sirloin steaks | 50 g yeast | 1 tablespoon cardamom | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup melted golden syrup | 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Put warm milk, yeast, cardamom and garlic salt into a large bowl and mix well. Put the sirloin steaks into the bowl and cover. Leave for 1 hour. After 1 hour add the golden syrup and mix thoroughly in the bowl. Leave for 40 minutes in a warm place to rise for 1 hour, or until doubled. Preheat oven to 190c. Remove sirloin roll from the bowl and place on a flat baking tray. Leave for an hour or until the roll rises. Heat a large non stick pan. Heat for a few minutes to dry beans, and then remove from the heat. Use a pastry brush to brush the milk on and down the sirloin rolls, then cook for 5 min. Flip the rolls with a fork and pour over a little sauce. Heat for a further couple of mins and place on a baking tray. Leave for five mins, then pop them out with a fork and serve with your favourite side dishes.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,red kidney bean,avocado,za'atar spice mix
title: Italian Baked Beans with Avocados
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 can red kidney beans | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 1 avocado, peeled
instructions: Mash the tomatoes and add one can of the beans, and 1/2 teaspoons of the za’atar. Stir well and put in a casserole dish sprayed with pam. Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and pit carefully. Spoon on the tomato mixture, sprinkle with the remaining za’atar and bake under hot broiler 2 to 3 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup mix,chicken thigh,cream mushroom soup
title: Easy Stove Top Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs ( or whatever size it has or no drumsticks is really all i had ) | 1 packet frozen french onion soup mix | 1 can cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Heat oven to 350 deg f/180 deg celsius. Throw chicken and onion soup mix in a roasting tin and coat with soup mix. Stove top. Bake about 40 minutes or until done.

Random Ingredients: edamame,paprika,dark soy sauce,lamb,heavy whipping cream,malt vinegar,pork leg,pinto bean
title: Glambe
ingredients: 12 dried pinto beans | 1 lb lamb, cut into 2-inch cubes | 4 ounces lean ground pork legs | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | fresh edible shelled edamame ( optional )
instructions: Soak beans for 24 hours in water. Drain and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to simmer and cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Do not drain. Cook meat and lamb separately over medium heat for about 10 minutes each side. Drain, reserving cooking liquid. Strain liquid. Stir in remaining ingredients and cook uncovered at medium low for another half hour. Discard any unopened beans. Serve immediately over cooked rice and garnish with fresh edible shelled edamame ( optional. Note, this recipe can be frozen up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,molasses,green bean,hokkien noodle,green bell pepper,sunflower oil,superfine sugar,hard egg
title: Stuff It You'll Clean Your Plate
ingredients: 3 heads green beans, ends trimmed and strings removed ( optional ) | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 loaf fresh italian breadcrumb | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 cup dried italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Break the green beans in half and boil them until they are tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Mash the eggs and bell pepper together in a bowl. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the eggs and pepper mixture and stir until they are set, about 3 - 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and mix in the bread crumbs and molasses. Let cool. Divide the mixture in half. Use the reserved half as a stuffing for the stuffed green beans. Stuff the filled green beans with this.

title: Pecan Bean (Frijoles Charros)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pinto bean, soaked overnight in water and drained | 1/3 cup greek style yoghurt ( more or less to taste ) | 1/3 cup pecans ( finely chopped ( pecan nuts ) or 1/3 cup walnuts ( finely chopped ) | 4 peppercorns ( crushed )
instructions: Place the soaked beans into a large pan and cover with water. Bring to the boil over a high heat. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for about 45 minutes. Drain excess water and reserve the water. Cover the beans with water and bring to the boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until a knife goes through the beans every 10 to 15 seconds. With a slotted spoon, remove the beans and set aside to cool. Strain the soaking liquid through a fine sieve. Combine the drained boiled beans with the yoghurt, pecans, 1 tablespoon of the crushed peppercorns and half of the reserved water. Mix thoroughly. Spread mixture evenly on a large platter. Add the remaining crushed peppercorns and garnish with remaining crushed peppercorns. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,beef bouillon cube,ra el hanout spice mix,cumin seed,sage,red grape,green onion
title: Beef Kabobs With Ra-Jadout and Green Onions
ingredients: 14 -16 lbs beef kabobs, cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 2 green onions, cut into 1-inch lengths on diagonal and kept separate | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon rubbed dried dried sage | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 beef bouillon cube | 6 cups buttermilk
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place kabobs into a shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with sage, green onions, cumin, ras el hanout, and mustard powder. Drizzle with olive oil. Broil kabobs 3 - 4 from heat 1 - 2 minutes per side until they turn pink color. Serve with ra jadout and green onions.

title: Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups sushi rice ( prepared according to package directions ) | 1 lb ground meat | 2 tablespoons sushi rice miso | 14 1/2 ounces canned italian-style stewed tomatoes, drained | 14 1/2 ounces peeled small shrimp | 14 1/2 ounces tart apples, peeled with peel left on | 1 tablespoon salt | 2 teaspoons tatiko ( flying fish meat seasoning ) or 2 teaspoons kombu seaweed oil
instructions: Cook sushi rice according to package directions, but omit miso powder. Meanwhile, brown meat in a large skillet. Remove meat from skillet and set aside, reserving any accumulated juices. Stir pan juices into skillet along with miso, stewed tomatoes in can. Heat for about two to three minutes, then add the shrimp, apples, and salt. Stir well then set the pan aside. Assemble and roll the sushi, lay out 2 sheets of nori, then overlap the slices of nori with the tips of your hands, so that the sushi overlaps the sides of the nori. Place 1/1/2 cup of the meat mixture on the nori. Pick up a slice of shrimp or two and press down. Place a few tablespoons of the shrimp mixture onto the top of the meat and rice mixture. Fold the nori over the contents of the filling to form a 1/2 inch thick roll. Repeat to make remaining rolls. Cut the rolls in half onto thirds diagonally. Serve with the sake sauce.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,egg white,allspice,chinese cabbage,pasta sauce,bulk sausage
title: Jamaican Cabbage Patties
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dry hot paprika | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 package shredded chinese cabbage | 1 pound bulk sausage | 4 large egg whites, beaten to blend | 1 package dry pasta sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Blend ground hot paprika, allspice, and shredded cabbage in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Slice sausage, and place in a large skillet over medium high heat.

title: Pixie Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 2 tablespoons paprika | 4 teaspoons pomegranate molasses | 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1/3 cup chopped pecans | 3 tablespoons dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Heat about 1/4 cup of olive oil or 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a frying pan. In a plastic bag, add flour, curry paste, safflower, paprika, pomegranate molasses and tamari. Mix until smooth. Add pecans and nuts and mix. Dip small tablespoons of batter into hot oil. When golden on the bottom, flip and cook on other sides. When completely cooked, serve immediately with a raita.

title: Vanilla Milk (Caramelized Root Vegetable Juice)
ingredients: 3 celery root, peeled and cut into 3/8 inch pieces ( about 3 quarts ) | 2 cans vanilla ( or other vanilla-flavored juice )
instructions: Peel the celery root, and finely slice it into 1/8 inch lengths. In a large pot set over medium low heat, combine the celery root slices, vanilla and vegetable juice. Stir, and boil until the liquid begins to thicken slightly, about 20 minutes. Continue to stir the mixture while the solids break up on the bottom of the pan. Remove from the heat and keep warm until ready to serve. Be careful the solids can ignite easily. Be careful not to burn the solids.

title: Spicy Oven-Fried Rock Lobster Tail
ingredients: 1 rock lobster tail | 1/4 cup catsup | 4 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Trim the tail of lobster meat, and remove it's shell meat. Cut the tail in half so the tail lays flat, and roll up. In a shallow dish, mix together the catsup and amaretto. Place the tail, seam side down, into the pan, and arrange any tail bits into the mixture. Place onto the middle rack of the oven, so the top will be facing up. Bake for about 45 minutes, or until the tail is browned and juices run clear. Note, if you do not plan on eating right away, cover the tail shell with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for up to one day before serving.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,dark brown sugar,red currant jelly
title: Smoked Salmon and Redcurrant Preserve
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 8 tablespoons red currant jelly | 8 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Arrange the salt salmon in the bottom of a greased 9x13 inch ovenproof dish, pouring half the jelly over each piece. Sprinkle over half of the sugar. Dot with the remaining jelly. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 25 minutes. Carry on cooking the rest of the ingredients and check the thickness of the sauce. Bake for a further 15 - 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rice,macaroni,ginger garlic paste,vegetable oil cooking spray,ra el hanout spice mix,pearl barley
title: Rice with Vegetables
ingredients: 1 medium sized pearl barley ( about 6 oz. ) | 1 package macaroni | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix ( i use massell brand ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/4 cups rice, uncooked
instructions: Cook the pearl barley as indicated on the packaging. Rinse barley with cool water until no longer cloudy. Drain and set aside. Cook macaroni in 2 - 2 1/2 cups boiling water approximately 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain. Cool macaroni completely. Preheat oven to 325°f. Spray a 9x9 glass casserole dish with oil spray. Cook macaroni in the 1 1/4 cups boiling water over medium high heat until tender. Meanwhile, toast spices in a small, dry skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, 2 - 3 minutes, or until fragrant. Remove from heat. Drain off any excess water. Stir the rice, roasted vegetables, and spices into the couscous. Pour contents of cooked pot into the casserole and stir. Cover and bake at 325°f for 30 - 35 minutes, or until heated thoroughly. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,coleslaw mix,mint,almond extract,digestive biscuit,yellow cornmeal
title: Coleslaw
ingredients: 4 cups coleslaw mix | 3/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 packets digestive biscuits, separated
instructions: Place coleslaw mix, cornmeal, graham cracker crumbs, mint and almond extract in a large bowl.

title: Black Bean-Stuffed Asiago Cheese-Stuffed Fritters
ingredients: 1 can canned black beans, drained ( reserve one cup liquid ) | 15 ounces roasted vegetables | 100 g crumbled queso blanco | 50 g grated asiago cheese or 50 g grana padano | 6 -8 drops pineapple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Strain the liquid from one can of beans into a medium sized mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,celery salt,wheat angel hair pasta,vegetable oil,champagne,red pepper flake
title: Cauliflower-Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely julienne peeled cauliflower ( flowerets ) | 1 1/2 cups coarsely julienne peeled cauliflower ( flowerets ) | 1 1/2 cups chilled champagne | 1/3 cup frozen whole-wheat angel hair pasta ( capellini ) | 1/8 teaspoon celery salt | 1/8 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Place cauliflower in a colander.

title: Umeboshi Plum Paste
ingredients: 1 kg plum paste | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Heat the plum paste over a gas flame or in a large non stick frying pan, stirring constantly until well melted. Transfer the plum paste to a large shallow bowl and stir in a few drops of brandy. Allow to cool completely. Transfer the plum paste to an airtight container to store for up to two months.

title: Mmmm Hot Tomato (canned)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 tablespoons finely shredded lime juice | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Stir together oil and lime juice until well blended. Drain pureed mixture into a mixing bowl or measuring cup. Stir in pureed tomato. Cover and chill for at least 6 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,green banana,catsup,lamb,wheat flour,salt pepper,white wine,garam masala
title: Fried Baked Lamb
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lamb | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon salt & pepper | 2 tablespoons tomato curry | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 bay leaves | 2 medium green bananas, cut into 1 inch pieces ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups dry white wine
instructions: Heat oil in a stew pot. Place all of the marinade ingredients in a sealable container and refrigerate until needed. Remove lamb from marinade and discard marinade. Place lamb in baking dish and coat with the marinade. Cover with aluminum foil or a lid secured with kitchen string. Arrange lamb in baking dish. Add any of the remaining marinade ingredients to the empty dish of stock and add to dish except bananas. Cover well and bake @ 325 degrees for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until the lamb is tender. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 15 minutes. Serve with mashed potatoes, rice or bread. Note, this can be frozen with the stock becoming thicker as the meat absorbs it. Reheat before serving if needed.

title: Italian Holiday Dessert Fizz
ingredients: 1 pint vodka | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: In a double boiler, combine vodka and sugar. Mix well. Heat over low heat, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat. Stir in vodka mixture and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. When ready to use, rub one side of the cake with confectioners' sugar. Place on prepared cake board. Turn over the cake side, and spread with remaining confectioners' sugar to a flat bottomed cake or cardboard. Top with desired amount of your favorite holiday fruit, cheeses, or chocolate chips, and/or a drizzle of olive oil. Make certain to make a small slit around the outside of the cake.

title: Green Beans, Asparagus and Lemon
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed ( or frozen for garnish ) | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/2 cup green beans, finely chopped | 1/3 cup fresh asparagus, chopped, stems removed, coarsely chopped ( or frozen asparagus spears if used ) | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, minced
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. On the stovetop, add the green beans and bring water back to a boil. Cover and cook for 5 minute. Drain. Place all vegetables except for the green beans in a serving bowl. Heat a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add hot green beans and asparagus. Cover and cook, stirring often, 5 minutes. Add lemon rind. Remove from heat and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,lemon juice zest,cauliflower floret,cocoa powder,heavy cream,chili sauce
title: Chili Cream Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup chili sauce, sriracha sauce or 1/4 cup chili paste | 4 tablespoons heavy cream ( whipping ) | 1/4 - 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon coconut vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice, as needed | cauliflower floret, to taste | cocoa powder, for dusting
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Meanwhile, combine chile sauce, cream, bell pepper, and vinegar in a small saucepan. Heat over low heat until simmering. When pasta is done, stir with sauce, cover, and allow to sit for five minutes to heat through. Dust with cocoa, if desired, before serving. Serve warm.

title: Quick Basil Fajitas
ingredients: 1 flour tortilla | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil ( or more ) | 1/4 cup chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Put the basil and mint in a bowl and mix. Heat the tortilla in a non stick frying pan. Cut into bite size, 1 inch strips. Put them in the hot pan. They will cook quickly. When cooked, turn and cook the other side, then turn and cook until done on the second side.

title: Cranberry Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, shelled and deveined ( cleaned if necessary ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 tablespoon minced dried shrimp | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke ( mesquite flavored, such as kha )
instructions: Heat canola oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium high heat. If the oil starts smoking right away, stir the oil quickly. If the oil starts smoking before it smokes again, add the shrimp, and stir fry for two minutes. Push the shrimp with a spatula to one side of the wok and set aside. Add the tamari and rice vinegar to the wok. Raise heat to medium high until the liquid smoke has mostly sizzled off. Add the shrimp and toss quickly until they begin to turn pink. Be careful since the shrimp is a bit salty, you want to use less than the recommended suggested saltiness of the tamari. Serve immediately if desired.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,marsala wine,asafoetida powder,table salt,enchilada sauce,lite olive oil
title: Quick Microwave Wet Marsala Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salad oil, plus | 1 1/2 teaspoons salad oil | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 2 -3 tablespoons enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon table salt
instructions: Using a nonstick skillet, spread salad oil in a 9x13 casserole dish and place into microwave for 1 minute to mix. Add asafoetida and microwave for 1 more minute, or until oil has mostly melted and asafoetida is beginning to brown. Add wine and cook, stirring occasionally, until almost evaporated. Remove from micro and add enchilada sauce. Sprinkle each serving with 1 1/2 tablespoons of table salt. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: brown rice flour,dill pickle,green chili,tomato green chilies
title: Dried Dill Pickles (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice flour | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, drained ( rotel ) | 1 can diced green chili peppers, drained | 2 small dill pickles, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium size bowl and mix well. Let the pickle mixture sit in the refrigerator for up to 3 days to allow the flavors to marry before serving. It is best the next day to leave pickle mixture to sit on the counter overnight to thaw as much as possible.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,pesto sauce,french onion soup mix,coconut milk,cream,walnut half
title: Creamy Pesto French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 envelope french onion soup mix | 1/4 cup sour cream ( can use no fat type ) | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh coconut milk | toasted walnut halves ( or pistachios ) ( optional )
instructions: If using the pesto, mix it well. Set aside. Pour soup mix and sour cream into the pot, making sure to stir it over medium heat until well blended and soup becomes smooth. Stir in the asafoetida. Mix the coconut milk and walnuts. Add the toasted walnut/pistachio mixture to soup. Heat through. If desired, serve topped with fresh parmesean/vietnamese/chicken breast meat mixture or roasted veggies of your choice. Enjoy.

title: Coconut Mallow Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 1/4 cups shredded coconut with milk ( such as coco especial ) | 4 tablespoons mirin | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13 pan with nonstick spray. Combine the cornmeal, coconut, mirin, and salt in large bowl and stir lightly with a fork until the mixture is well blended but still crumbly, about 3 minutes. Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a large, non stick skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Drop 1/2 cup of batter into the hot skillet and flatten into a disc with a rolling pin. Carefully peel it off the paper towels and use fingers to spread the mallow between the fritters. Fry the fritters until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Broccole Con Escabeche (Broccole in Avocado and Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed mushrooms, cleaned, washed and stems removed | 1 small avocado | 2 tablespoons broccoli, washed, cleaned and chopped | 1/4 cup plastic wrap
instructions: Dice the avocado in small pieces. Pour small amount into a small bowl and sprinkle with the broccoli, then the rest of the ingredient. Dip your hands in the avocado mix right before eating. Eat.

title: Coconut Fish Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 1 packet frozen tiny peas, thawed | 200 g white asparagus, cut crosswise into 2cm slices | 50 g radishes, thinly sliced | 1 small fresh apple, cored, thinly sliced | 10 -12 medium marshmallows
instructions: Place the vinegar and coconut milk into a small pan over very low heat until the coconut is reduced to a glaze and the milk is hot, but not boiling. Remove from heat and keep warm. Cook and stir the peas, asparagus and radishes in a small pan of boiling water for 2 - 3 minutes or until just tender, drain and rinse under cold water and discard any excess water. Transfer the vegetables to a bowl and add the dressing. Gently stir through the fruit and marshmallows to combine. Serve immediately.

title: Chinese Style Macadamias
ingredients: 1 iceberg lettuce, torn | 100 g canned corn, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts, chopped
instructions: Arrange lettuce on serving dish. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl, pour over lettuce, and toss to combine. Serve.

title: Quick  Art Culinaire  (Art Culinaire's Art Culinaire)
ingredients: 4 cups tapioca starch, or more to taste | 1 cup white vinegar, or more as needed
instructions: Place tapioca starch in a large plastic jar with a lid. Cover jar tightly with foil or plastic wrap and shake until well mixed. Heat vinegar in a large saucepan over medium high heat until almost boiling. Pour vinegar into a 2 quart casserole dish in a slow stream. Sprinkle tapioca starch over tapioca starch in the dish. Let vinegar boil until it begins to thicken, about 5 minutes. Turn off heat. Let tapioca starch sit at room temperature for a few hours. Rinse towel with cold water and shake off excess. Transfer tapioca starch mix to a 9x13 inch baking dish and pour vinegar over it. Let stand at room temperature for 3 to 4 hours. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cover baking dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Mexican Hot Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons shredded light-tastefully-thin monterey jack cheese or 2 tablespoons muenster cheese
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour 1 teaspoon sesame oil into the pan and swirl it around. Swirl in the fat and spread evenly as it slits into a thin golden rectangle. When the oil is smoking, lay a few cheese cubes at a time over the waxy sesame oil. When the cheese is well melted, carefully flip the quesadillas, then cook another minute or two, until browned. Add the remaining tablespoon sesame oil to the pan and heat it, scraping up any browned bits stuck to the pan. Spread 1 to 2 tablespoons of the cheese in a criss cross pattern over the cheese and cook, stirring, until it just begins to brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Slide the quesadillas onto a plate. When the cheese tortilla is cooked, remove it from the pan, place it on another plate, and cut it up into 4 wedges.

Random Ingredients: neufchatel cheese,kalamata olive,bread crumb,beet,ice water,cheese,pork tenderloin,chili oil
title: Pork Tenderloin with Beets
ingredients: 1 pound pork tenderloins, trimmed | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped kalamata olives | 1/4 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 1 can beets, drained and finely diced | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon water | 1/2 cup cheese, shredded | 1 package neufchatel cheese
instructions: Place pork tenderloins on a work surface, and sprinkle with kalamata olives and bread crumbs. Roll, and tie with kitchen string. Heat a skillet over medium high heat with chili oil. Place stuffed tenderloins in the skillet, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cooked through. Spread beets over meat, and sprinkle with cheese. Pour hot meat juices over all. Cover, and let sit 5 minutes. Uncover, and let stand 5 more minutes, or until cheese has melted.

title: Guilt Free Low-Fat Avocado Dip
ingredients: 2 avocados ( about 31g, or equivalent amount of canned ) | 3 tablespoons soymilk ( dairy free ) | 1 teaspoon celery salt ( optional ) | 4 ounces lowfat mozzarella cheese, grated ( vegan, vegan, gluten free )
instructions: Peel and pit avocados. Put avocado in a bowl. Add the soymilk, celery salt, and a pinch of salt. You can sprinkle with some more paprika if you wish. Grate cheese over avocado. Grate more or less if you wish. You want to use the consistency of the avocado.. Add cheese and continue to mix. Put in fridge for at least 1 - 2 hours. The longer you let it sit the better. The flavours will meld. If you want to give this a longer, go ahead and try. You can serve this in a crockpot, in it you can serve it in an individual bowl.

title: Steamed Beef and Strawberry Parfait
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 2 lbs stewing beef ( with skin and fat attached ) | 12 ounces mixed strawberries, sliced | 1/2 cup green chili pepper, chopped | 1 pint fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: Cut meat into thin slices. Pour 1tablespoon of vanilla sugar over meat. Toss meat until coated. Thread each slice into a skewer. Cover and place on a rack or in a shallow pan. Add 1/2 the remaining wine, the remaining berries, and 1/2 the vanilla sugar. Place under the grill or oven. Cover and braise beef on both sides until cooked through, brushing with remaining 1/2 tablespoon of vanilla sugar every 10 minutes or so until tender. Place 2 slices beef on each plate, surround with the fruit, and top with remaining fruit. Serve with green chutney if you like.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,methi seed,coffee powder,chipotle pepper,beef broth,pineapple
title: Hawaiian Street Chipotle Pepper Steak
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin, 1/4 to 1 1/2 inch thick slices ( 1 oz each ) | 6 -8 canned pineapple slices | 1 tablespoon dried ground chipotle pepper | 1 tablespoon methi seeds | 1 tablespoon coffee powder | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f place beef slices between plastic wrap and pound until slightly flattened. Combine remaining ingredients. Spread this mixture over each slice of beef and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 18 to 30 minutes, or until meat is just cooked through. Let stand 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white hominy,dark soy sauce,mustard,escarole,pasta sauce,olive,bulb garlic,lettuce leaf
title: Capsicum, Garlic and Herb Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 heads head lettuce leaves | 3 bulbs of garlic, halved, skin on | 400 g white hominy, rinsed, drained | 400 g pasta sauce, any flavour | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 4 tablespoons prepared mustard | 50 g olives, chopped | 200 g small capsicums ( or zucchini, halved lengthways and deseeded and cut into wedges )
instructions: Chop the top and base of the lettuce and set aside in a large bowl. Place the heads of garlic, rinsed, drained and soaked hominy in a large saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently for about 10 minutes then remove from heat. Allow to cool slightly then peel off garlic head. Slice the cooled garlic into very thin slices and place in the bowl with the lettuce. Add the pasta sauce, soy sauce and mustard, stir well and taste to see if the seasoning needs more seasoning. Pour over vegetables and mix well. Chill for at least two hours to allow flavours to develop and adjust seasoning before serving with a scattering of fresh herbs.

title: Hot Cheese Ball
ingredients: 3 -5 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese or 3 -5 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup barley ( optional )
instructions: Grate and use a food processor or large box grater to grate finely the cheese, then transfer to a bowl. Gradually add the barley, if using. Dough will be quite soft. If using a bowl with a handle, roll tablespoonfuls of the cheese mixture into balls, then transfer to a covered container. Cover with a damp cloth while shaping until balls are chilled and/or heated. To cook hot cheese balls on a griddle or on a hot griddle, coat with a small amount of pam or oil, then cook on one side only until puffed and golden.

title: BBQ Steak Satay
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef sirloin | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup tamarind paste ( paste to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups tamarind beverages
instructions: Remove fat from sirloin. Cut meat into 1/4 inch pieces. Place in zip lock bag, close and refrigerate. Drain fat from bag. Add barbecue sauce, tamarind beverages, meat, and 1/2 cup water to the bag. Freeze overnight. In saucepan, melt 1/4 cup water. Pour into bag with marinated meat and marinate at least 1 hour for best flavor, but up to 2 hours for more flavor. Drain meat and marinade. Grill over hot coals for 15 - 20 minutes in sauce.

title: Chocolate Crumb and Pepper Powder
ingredients: 300 g good quality white breadcrumbs | 250 g szechuan peppercorns, finely ground | 300 g coarsely chopped shallots or 300 g other vegetables | 125 ml good quality chocolate syrup | 3 -4 teaspoons ground hing ( optional )
instructions: Place breadcrumbs, peppercorns, shallots or vegetables in a food processor and pulse until the mixture forms fine crumbs. Add the chocolate syrup and process until combined thoroughly. Add a little more warm water if mixture is too dry. Add more sugar if the mixture is too dry. Pack mixture into a pastry bag and pipe a cross on the surface as a decorative bag with a handle. Allow the crumb mixture to develop a semi solid shape at the top of the bag. Refrigerate for at least 24 hours to allow flavours to develop. When using this powder place in an airtight container, refrigerate and use as required.

title: Cranberry Snack Mix
ingredients: 8 ounces sour cream and mushroom soup | 1 can chopped dried apricots | 1 jar dried cranberries
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.

title: Deutschland Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut or 1 lb rusk, washed | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, cleaned, seeded, and halved | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken bouillon ( or similar, for flavour ) | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons horseradish ( or to taste ) | 1 dash sauerkraut ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Place sauerkraut in a large pot and add water to cover about 3 inches over the sauerkraut and the cherries. Boil rapidly, skimming off any foam that rises to the surface. Dissolve bouillon in warm water if using. Stir in sauerkraut/cherries. Cover and cook over very low heat, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, until the vegetables are tender, about 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Stir in other ingredients and cook until sauce thickens. This dish is best eaten over hot buttered bread that is toasted and lightly caramelized the next day. You don't want to taste this as you would any other type of bread so add a little bit of milk and some vinegar just for the flavor.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,dark sesame oil,yellow onion,superfine sugar,basil leaf,pecan,fine egg noodle
title: Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 3 ounces fine egg noodles | 2 ounces white pecan pieces, shelled | 4 ounces savoy cabbage, shredded | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 large yellow onion, finely sliced | 8 fresh basil leaves, torn | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Place noodles in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water and cook for 5 - 6 mins, until tender and well drained. Strain and set aside. Using a small frypan, heat 1 tsp of the sesame oil over a low heat and cook the onion for 1 - 2 mins, until just softened. Add the cabbage and cook, stirring through for 3 mins or until softened. Meanwhile, place the rest of the sesame oil in a bowl and mix with 1 1/2 cups water. Stir until the sugar dissolves and set aside. Drain the noodles and return to the pan, then add the bean sauce and half the noodles and toss to combine. Serve and repeat with the other half of the sesame oil mixture. Serve with the remaining noodles.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,pine nut,icing sugar,gelatin powder,green pepper,red wine vinegar,pepper,oyster sauce
title: Thai Sea Bass Salad With Gingery Peppers
ingredients: 3/4 cup water | 4 teaspoons unflavored gelatin powder | sea bass fillet ( one 3-1/2-pound piece ) | 2 green peppers ( small, about 10 oz. each ) | 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1/4 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Note, to soften gelatine, bring just enough water in a small saucepan to dissolve it. Combine 5 tsp gelatin, 1/2 cup water, and sugar in saucepan and bring to boil, stirring until gelatin is dissolved. Set aside to cool. Remove skin from pepper and cut into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Arrange pepper rounds on individual plates. Drizzle with 1/4 cup of the reduced gelatin. Spoon 1/4 c water from pan over top of veggies. Spoon oyster sauce over and around fish. Sprinkle with ginger and pepper. Drizzle with vinegar and sprinkle with more sugar if desired.

title: Maraschino Pan-Fried Tuna
ingredients: 1 lb tuna steak | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Cut the tuna steaks into serving size portions. Add the maraschino cherries to the tuna steaks. Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet or griddle over medium heat, being careful not to burn. Saute tuna 5 to 7 minutes per side, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve over cooked couscous.

Random Ingredients: kale,rotel tomato,red chili pepper,bicarbonate soda,white fish fillet,soya sauce,celery
title: Kale and Fish Packets
ingredients: 4 cod fillets or 4 white fish fillets | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 small dried red chili pepper | 1 stalk celery | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 cup light soya sauce | 1/4 cup spinach/vegetable stock, for flavouring
instructions: Cut fish into chunks. Cook vegetables in vegetable stock until soft. Add salt, pepper, and garlic and bicarb soda. Add other vegetables. Cook for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,corn kernel,garlic paste,cayenne pepper,spinach,rice flour,grapeseed oil
title: Grapeseed Oil Pasta Fresca
ingredients: 1/4 lb spinach | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 2 ounces corn kernels, canned
instructions: Squeeze out excess water from spinach but reserve spinach leaves for sauce. Heat the grapeseed oil in a saucepan. Add the garlic and spinach leaves, fry, stirring constantly, until the mixture just begins to wilt. Stir in the rice flour, cayenne pepper and stock.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,iceberg lettuce,plain flour,maraschino cherry,pita,pear,liquid smoke
title: Low Fat Pear and Swiss Cheese Pitas
ingredients: 1 pita, split in half | 6 slices swiss cheese | 6 slices pear ( pippies ) | 6 teaspoons fat-free liquid smoke | 1/4 cup plain flour | 3 cups non-fat powdered milk powder ( non fat dry ) | 1/4 cup shredded low-fat swiss cheese | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees celsius. Split the pitta halves evenly, and place face down on a tray. Cut the cheeses into small cubes then cut the pear into four slices. Bake for 5 - 10 minutes or until they are soft and golden. Remove from the oven and drain the pita into a glass bowl and leave to cool completely. In another bowl, mix together the margarine and fat free powder until light and fluffy. Remove the pitta halves from the oven and spread a tablespoon of the margarine/fat free mixture over each pita half evenly. Place a slice of cheese and a burger in the center of each pita half, and roll up and place side by side in a shallow baking dish. Pour over the remaining margarine/fat free mixture. Sprinkle over the maraschino cherries, if using, and bake in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until crisp. Serve with natural yoghurt, lemonade, or some yoghurt sauce. Yum.

title: Italian Meatball Sauce
ingredients: 1 egg white | 1 pound ground chicken meat | 1/2 bottle dry marsala wine, divided | 1 can diced tomatoes, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a small bowl, mix together the egg white and ground chicken. Dip the meat into the egg white mixture. Roll meat in corn flour. Place the meatballs in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Gently stir together 1/2 the marsala wine and 1/2 can of diced tomatoes. Pour tomato mixture over meatballs. Bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes.

title: Applesauce Crunch
ingredients: 4 green cardamom pods | 1 1/3 cups dry breadcrumbs | 1 can unsweetened applesauce | 1 cup chopped dried cranberries | 1 1/3 cups all-purpose oatmeal, or as needed
instructions: Bake the cardamom pods in a large, heavy skillet over medium low heat and stir occasionally, until fragrant, about a minute. Pour in half the bread crumbs. Set aside for now. Crush the remaining bread crumbs. In a heavy, large saucepan, pour in the applesauce, cranberries and half the oatmeal. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat, stirring frequently. When the mixture forms clumps, stir in the remaining oatmeal. Cook, stirring, until the oats are dry but moist, about 3 minutes. Pour the oatmeal into the crumb mixture and stir until well combined. If the mixture seems dry, add a bit of water to moisten. If more liquid is needed, blend in the reserved bread crumbs.

title: Caribbean Curry Pies
ingredients: 1 package crescent rolls | 1 cup golden raisin | 3/4 cup water chestnuts, chopped | 3/4 cup chopped drained canned curry paste | 1/2 cup vodka | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add raisins and sauté until golden, drain onto paper towels. Spread curry paste in 8x8 in baking dish. Top with raisins, raisins, etc. Pour vodka over all. Sprinkle with coconut and olive oil. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Dolmades (Greek Lentils and Meat)
ingredients: 1 cup yellow lentils ( long-grain or split yellow lentils ) | 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb ( i use extra lean ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt ( to taste )
instructions: Boil water in a pot until the lentils are soft and mushy. Drain and rinse the lentils under cold water until cool enough to handle. Place lentils in large bowl. Add lamb mince. Add salt and mix thoroughly. Cover with fresh water and let soak overnight. The first day, drain, discarding liquid that has returned to the bottom of the pot. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.. The next day, drain the lentils and serve with fresh bread.

title: Quick and Easy Chinese Lettuce Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup diced dates | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1 head iceberg lettuce, outer leaves removed
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor, pulse the dates and sesame seeds until the sesame seeds form a fine powder. Place the lettuce leaves on a serving plate. Place the date mixture down the center of a lettuce leaf. Roll tightly. Serve with a bowl of chinese rice wine vinegar dressing for dipping.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw mix,red capsicum,pineapple,orange juice zest,italian parsley,swede,dough
title: Couscous Fruit Jumble
ingredients: 2 cups stale bread | 2 tablespoons orange juice or 2 tablespoons lemon juice, from 1 orange | 1 zest, grated or orange peel | 1 small swede, peeled and chopped | 1 red capsicum, deseeded and chopped | 1 cup coleslaw mix | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley
instructions: Process all the ingredients in a food processor and pour into a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for about 6 hours or overnight for best results. Serve with warm bread.

title: Chili Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sherry vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and whisk well. Can be stored in refrigerator up to 2 days.

title: Dinner Party Cocktail
ingredients: 30 ml worcestershire sauce | 45 ml vanilla sugar | 10 saffron strands, crushed | 45 ml celery, minced ( optional ) | ice, for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients over crushed ice. Stir for 2 minutes.

title: Red Onions
ingredients: 6 small red onions, peeled | 220 ml corn oil
instructions: Wash the onions well and pat them dry with paper towels. Heat a heavy based frypan over a medium heat. Add the corn oil and fry the onions until golden. Remove from the heat, leave them covered and leave for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Grilled Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package fresh portabella mushrooms | 2 maraschino cherries, halved | 4 tablespoons pineapple slices | 4 slices thinly sliced prosciutto
instructions: Place mushrooms in a heavy duty resealable plastic bag. Cover mushroom completely with maraschino cherries. Cover bag and let marinate in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Remove portobello from bag, reserving marinade. Skewer marinated mushrooms and pineapple slices onto four skewers. Grill, covered, on a preheated grill on high heat for 5 to 7 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Turns when needed, and sprinkle with prosciutto to serve.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,farfalle pasta,thai chile,red chilies,apple cider,pecorino romano cheese,corn tortilla
title: Farfalle with Apple Cider Chili, Poblanos, and Corn Chips
ingredients: 10 ears fresh corn tortillas or 10 fresh baby bella corn tortillas, each cut into 10 wedges | 2 large poblano peppers, stemmed, halved lengthwise and deseeded | 2 medium red chilies, seeded and deveined | 8 ounces firm pomegranate flavored apples with california chiles | 8 ounces farfalle pasta or 8 ounces elbow macaroni, cooked | 1/2 - 1 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese or 1/2-1 cup parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons sweet pickled red chilies, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Adjust oven rack to lowest position and heat oven to 450 degrees. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment. Arrange corn tortillas on prepared baking sheet and brush with oil. Bake 10 minutes, flipping halfway through. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Meanwhile, coat a large roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray and set over high heat. Cut off tips of bell peppers and discard. Cut in half, remove ribs and seeds and veins. Cut each half into thin strips about the length of the corn tortilla. Cut peppers diagonally into thirds. Sauté poblanos, chiles, and carrots in cooking spray for 5 to 10 minutes until crisp tender. Transfer 2 roasted corn tortillas or baby bella or 3 tortillas to a cutting board and using a slotted spoon, cut up in 1/2 inch strips. Remove all but 1/4 cup of vegetables and poblanos. Cut remaining tortillas into wedges.

title: Sweet Crisco Onions
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crisco cooking oil | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan until it is just smoking. Test temperature of the oil by dropping a heaping tablespoon of the sweet crispness indicator into the oil through a sieve, it should be golden brown on both sides. Do not overcook or they will burn. Carefully turn oil over with a slotted spoon. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the hot oil to the clean dish. Leave to settle until a few minutes before removing the hot oil from the sieve. Stir in the mirin.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,chili pepper,marsala wine,vanilla ice cream,honey
title: Blancman's Chili Ice-Cream
ingredients: 3 tablespoons honey | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 jar chili peppers, chopped ( jalapenos in the usa ) | 8 scoops vanilla ice cream | 1 jar chianti wine or ( 10 ounce ) jar marsala wine
instructions: Whip together until smooth the vanilla and honey are almost mixed in. Add the peppers to the honey and then stir in the cream. Put in freezer for about 2 hours then put into popsicle trays and freeze until slightly hardened, or put in rigid freezer for as long as you really like..

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,dark soy sauce,chicken bouillon,beef tenderloin,water chestnut,cream cheese,coffee,parsnip
title: Chinese Beef Medallions(ATI)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef tenderloin, cut into strips | 1 cup chopped parsnips | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced in half | 1/4 cup low-sodium instant coffee | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 3/4 cup low-fat cream cheese | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: In shallow nonstick skillet, stir fry beef strips and parsely vegetables in instant coffee for 5 - 10 minutes or until done. Drain and discard any accumulated juices. Stir in oregano, cream cheese, soup base and soy sauce. Stir until smooth. Pour mixture over beef mixture.

title: Salsa Roja
ingredients: 4 large ripe italian plum tomatoes | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 cups water | 2 fresh tomatillos, husked and rinsed
instructions: Place tomatoes on a plate, and drizzle with olive oil. Let tomatoes sit about 10 minutes, then slice them crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place tomatillos into a medium saucepan over medium heat, and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes. Drain, and serve with salsa roja.

title: Rigatoni With Beef and Brown Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks, sliced very thin ( about 2-1/2-3 pounds ) | 2 cans spaghetti sauce ( or your favorite ) | 1 1/2 lbs rigatoni pasta ( or your favorite pasta )
instructions: Cook rigatoni in a large pot of boiling water until just a couple of minutes shorter than needed and drain.

Random Ingredients: triple sec liqueur,red chili pepper,oyster sauce,red onion,corn oil,cayenne pepper,graham cracker crumb,vermouth
title: Rita's Tri-Colored Red Onions
ingredients: 1 teaspoon corn oil | 8 slices red onions ( thin half moons ) | cayenne pepper, to taste | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup dry vermouth or 1/3 cup dry white wine | 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons triple sec liqueur | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f brush onion slices with corn oil and sprinkle tops with cayenne pepper. Bake on parchment for 15 - 20 minutes, turning to brown on all sides. This should yield about 16 puffs. Remove to a dish to cool. Heat vermouth or wine, oyster sauce, triple sec and crushed red chili in a pot over low heat. Simmer for 5 minutes to melt the alcohol. Remove onions from the bowl. Place 3 puffs in the center of each. Garnish with crumbs and serve.

title: Irish Crawfish Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 2 cans crawfish, rinsed and cut into bite-size pieces ( i used the del monte ones ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika | 1/2 cup shredded yellow squash | 2 small red potatoes, cut into chunks
instructions: In saucepan, combine the whiskey, crawfish, hot paprika and squash. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Add potatoes and cook 5 minutes more.

title: Irish Beer
ingredients: 14 fluid ounces nonfat plain yogurt | 4 fluid ounces light beer lukewarm water | 1/4 cup dried herbs or 1/4 cup fresh herbs, finely chopped | 1/4 cup instant hot water | 2 -3 tablespoons bourbon ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Put the yogurt and lukewarm water in bowl of a stand stand mixer. Beat at high speed for 1 - 2 minutes. Add herbs. Mix at low speed for 6 - 8 minutes. Stir in the hot water mix. Pour into a jug or plastic ziplock bag and freeze for 2 hours. Stir through any optional ingredients and serve.

Random Ingredients: emmenthaler cheese,cake,taco sauce,chili pepper,golden raisin,haddock fillet
title: Foil-Filled Haddock
ingredients: 500 g smoked haddock fillets | 1/2 cup finely chopped pitted golden raisin | 1/4 teaspoon minced chili pepper | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1/2 cup shredded emmenthaler cheese or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup shredded sesame seeds or 1/4 cup finely chopped calendula
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c remove any skin and all bones from the haddock fillets. Place the haddock fillets on a large ovenproof dish and scatter over the raisins, chilies and taco sauce, mix well. Cover with the cheddar cheese. Bake in oven for 20 - 30 minutes until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: panko bread crumb,mustard powder,caster sugar,vinegar,yellow pea,broccoli
title: English Pea and Broccoli Salad - Low Fat!
ingredients: 50 g prepared yellow split peas, rinsed and drained | 250 g broccoli, finely sliced | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon caster sugar ( aka superfine granulated sugar ) | 2 tablespoons vinegar, white | 2 tablespoons panko bread crumbs
instructions: Place split peas, broccoli and mustard in a serving bowl and toss well. Combine sugar, vinegar, panko and vinegar and drizzle over salad and toss well again. Serve, with freshly made hot bread.

title: Taco Apples
ingredients: 6 large tart apples, pared and diced | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix taco seasoning, oregano and apples together in a bowl. Arrange apples in an aluminum foil lined baking dish. Spoon taco mixture over them. Smooth top. Bake in preheated oven until cooked through, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Barley Pearl
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces pearl barley | 1 teaspoon curry paste
instructions: Rinse the pearl barley under cold water. Place in a bowl along with 5 fl ozs of water. Cover and place over a very low heat for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and add curry paste. Leave for 5 mins before serving.

Random Ingredients: extra finely sugar,hamburger bun,granny smith apple,bourbon,beef,mango,pineapple chunk,pork butt
title: Maui-Maui Brunch
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef | 1/2 lb lean pork butt | 1/2 lb hamburger bun, sliced | 1 granny smith apple, unpeeled, chopped | 1 mango, peeled, seeded, coarsely chopped | 1 cup pineapple chunk, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup bourbon | 2 tablespoons extra finely granulated sugar | 1 tablespoon bourbon ( optional )
instructions: Note, be careful not to burn the pineapple and mango.

title: Blueberry and Blueberry Lassi
ingredients: 15 ounces low-fat sour cream | 1 cup blueberries | 2 cups ice
instructions: Pour all ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth. Pour in tall glass and serve.

title: Vermont Pickles
ingredients: 1 large red cabbage, shredded | 5 tablespoons white peppercorns, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons msg ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the crushed peppercorns and msg. Use as you would for regular relish.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,half,rice noodle,cointreau liqueur,red food coloring,sugar
title: Rigatoni and Noodle Toss
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package penne pasta ( 1 box ) | 2 cups half-and-half or 2 cups light cream | 1/2 cup cointreau liqueur ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon red food coloring | 9 ounces frozen curly-edged cheddar-wall type ragu linguine or 9 ounces whole grain linguine
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water. Meanwhile in large bowl, combine cream, cointreau, sugar and food coloring. Stir over medium low heat until mixture is hot but not boiling. Drain cooked pasta well.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,kosher salt black pepper,beef stew meat,green pea,maraschino cherry,green olive,pimiento
title: French Crock Pot Pot Philly Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 1 jar green olives, sliced | 1 jar pimientos, sliced | 1 jar green olives, sliced | 1 jar maraschino cherries, with glaze ( or use grape tomatoes ) | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, freshly grated ( optional ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place the beef, green olives, pimientos, and green olives into the crock pot. Season with the maraschino juice and sprinkle with the gruyere. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours until hot and bubbly. Discard the pink bits from the top.

Random Ingredients: wheat hamburger bun,butter,butternut squash,white wine vinegar,sauerkraut,tonic water
title: Butternut, Sauerkraut, and Buttered Browned Veggie Sandwich
ingredients: 10 buttery wheat hamburger buns | 1/2 cup butternut squash, cut in 1/2-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 10 ounces sauerkraut, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons ttonic carbonate water ( or water ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Place butter in a baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine butternut squash with vinegar and toss well. Spread squash over buns. Top with sauerkraut. Dot with bacon fat. Top with buttered buns, if using.

Random Ingredients: orange,yellow food coloring,chipotle chile,icing sugar,italian salad dressing
title: Mexican Green Salad or Salad Dressing
ingredients: 3/4 cup italian salad dressing | 1/2 green chopped yellow food coloring | 1 chipotle chile | 1 orange rind, grated | 1/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: Pour entire dressing on a cutting board. Stir. Add all other ingredients and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Chill. If you wish to make this right away, mix ingredients together in a bowl to coat. Serve with toasted bagels, sliced baguette slices or crisp tortilla. Chill the salad.

title: Cheddar and Parsnip Pies
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese ( low moisture best ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped parsnips or 1 1/2 tablespoons other raw vegetables | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped dill | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon oil | chopped dill ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine grated cheese, parsnips, pepper, oil, dill.

title: Faux Potato Dessert
ingredients: 2 medium red potatoes ( about 1-1/2 pounds total size ) | 2/3 cup water chestnut, finely chopped ( not canned ) | 2/3 cup chopped pitted dates, dates should be used instead ( light or dark ) | 1 teaspoon orange flower water | 2 tablespoons boiling water, approximately
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Place potatoes in small saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring water to boil, reduce to medium low, and cook, partially covered, until potatoes are tender and easily pierced with a knife, 10 - 12 minutes. Drain. When cool enough to handle, place potato slices into a small bowl and mash with a potato masher or with a fork until well combined. Add chestnuts and dates and mash with a potato masher or a potato masher. Dissolve 1 teaspoon orange flower in 1 tablespoon boiling water. Add enough hot water to mixture to moisten.
