Serve warm or cold. Note, if you make this in advance, cover the mixture in plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight before starting to prepare and stir. Dill weed or basil can also be substituted.

title: Egg & Tortilla Breakfast Burritos - Breakfast for One
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped | 2 tortillas, cut into large squares
instructions: In pan or wok, scramble eggs in a little oil. Place tortillas on a large platter with the tops off. Spoon half the amount of scrambled eggs into each tortilla, covering the entire egg. Sprinkle with grated cheese, chopped avocado, etc.

title: Spiced Crab Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces crab, cooked and chopped | 8 ounces yellow squash, cooked and chopped | 2 ounces broccoli, chopped | 5 ounces canned chick-peas or 5 ounces black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chutney together. When ready to serve, top with chutney to taste.

title: Couscous Salad
ingredients: 500 g couscous | 300 g diced tomatoes ( canned tomatoes ) | 1 tablespoon diced preserved turnip | handful mint leaf, chopped | fresh lemon peel, grated ( optional ) | curry powder, to serve
instructions: Place couscous in a bowl with a jug of boiling water. Stir, cover, set aside for five minutes, then fluff up with a fork. To serve, crumble the tomatoes, cucumber and turnip on the plate and drizzle with a little olive oil and lemon juice. Sprinkle with curry powder.

title: Shredded Cabbage (Bunuelos Con Hojo)
ingredients: 1 kg chuck | 1 gala apple | 60 g whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 400 g boiled cabbage, shredded | 1 can tuna steaks
instructions: Cube chuck and slice thinly. Peel and dice apple. Combine flour with oil, and coat meat with flour mixture. Heat peanut oil on high heat. Cook cabbage in oil 3 minutes or until golden on the bottom and cabbage is just barely cooked through. Place meat in skillet and add apple, cook 1 minute. Place cabbage on plate and top with meat and remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,cucumber,rice wine vinegar,taco seasoning,breadcrumb,corn kernel
title: Baked Mexican Corn Snack Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh corn kernels, thawed | 1 jar taco seasoning | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese | 1 cup toasted breadcrumb | 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded, and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f in a shallow, 2 quart baking dish, toss the corn with the taco seasoning. Stir in the cheese, bread crumbs, cucumber and 1 tablespoons of water.

title: Cranberry-Molasses Jam
ingredients: 1/2 kg sugar | 500 -700 g dried cranberries ( about 5 cups ) | 1 1/2 liters molasses | 1 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan or pan over a medium heat and stir occasionally until the sugar dissolves. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 45 minutes. Stirring continuously. After the 45 minutes turn into a jar or bowl and store. If using individual jars with a screw top lid turn jam upside down onto a wire rack on a tray. This removes any remaining sediment. Keep hot.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,baking soda,caper,turmeric powder,red pepper powder
title: Chicken in Capsicums (Baked) With Capers
ingredients: 1/2 cup red pepper powder | 1/2 cup bicarbonate of soda ( baking soda ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon red pepper powder | 1 chicken drumstick
instructions: Cut drumstick lengthwise into three slices to make halves more manageable. Take the drumstick and cut into half again. Place the drumstick in a large nonreactive baking dish. Put all the other ingredients into a bowl and stir well with a fork. Pour the mixture on top of the drumstick. Sprinkle the capers on top. Put into a cold oven and bake for about 40 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,anchovy paste,onion powder,coriander powder,raisin,dark chocolate,mint
title: Mint Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped onions or 1 tablespoon chopped onion, finely | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint or 1 tablespoon fresh dill | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( or 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ) | 1 ounce dark chocolate, grated or 1 ounce chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Stir together all of the ingredients in a clean coffee grinder or food processor until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Pour into sterilised jars leaving 1/2cm headspace. Process for 10 minutes, then cool for 30 minutes in the fridge or up to 1 month.

title: Pineapple Ranchero Salad
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, seeded, chopped | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 2 scallions, sliced thin | 1 package pepperoni, sliced | 1/4 cup beer | 1/2 romaine lettuce, torn | 1/4 cup raspberries ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Combine the first five ingredients in a large bowl. Combine the beer and raspberries and pour over salad. Toss gently until well coated. Serve.

title: African Turmeric Chicken
ingredients: 1 turmeric, bulb | 4 cups low sodium chicken broth or 4 cups canned chicken broth | 2 teaspoons coarsely ground turmeric ( to taste )
instructions: Remove top husks and silks from turmeric bulbs. Cut bulbs in half crosswise. With vegetable peeler, scrape out the bitter pith. Reserve any remaining intact bulb to cook curry. In large pot combine turmeric and broth. Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, or until turmeric is reduced to half and broth thick. Pour into 4 serving bowls, and sprinkle with turmeric.

title: Cheddar Chipotle-Spicy White Mexican Cheese Fillings
ingredients: 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 canned chipotle chiles or 2 canned jalapeno peppers, drained and minced
instructions: Lightly grease a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. In a mixing bowl, combine the cheese and spices. Using a food processor, whir into the cheese mixture until well combined. Transfer the mixture into the baking dish. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes.

title: Mexican Cheese Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 package mexican cheese blend, shredded | 1/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1 -2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Combine cheese and sage.

title: The Best Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 2 cans mild enchilada sauce | 1 can white wine
instructions: Combine 2 cans of enchilada sauce, 2 cans of white wine and 2 cans of green enchilada sauce into crock pot. Cook on low for 7 hours or on high for 3 hours. Shred 1 lb of white and 3 lbs of green chiles. Strain the remaining can of green enchilada sauce into the sauce and blend well. Add the shredded cheese and mix.

title: Coco-Cola Fish Balls With Guacamole
ingredients: 6 small turnips | 3 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 egg, beaten | 2 tablespoons mirin | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon guacamole or 1 tablespoon lime juice
instructions: Wash turnips. Drain them and cut them in julienne. Heat oil in a pan and fry turnips for 3 minutes, turning frequently to coat both sides with oil. Stir in the oyster sauce, egg, mirin and oregano. Dunk the fish in the egg mix, pat dry with paper towels and toss lightly. Serve the turnipigoes with guacamole or lime, and top with more guacamole if desired.

title: Apple Rice and Beef Broth
ingredients: 1 package processed cheese, cubed | 3/4 cup white rice | 1 large fennel bulb, chopped | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 5 tablespoons applesauce
instructions: In crockpot, layer cheese, rice, fennel, bouillon cube and cocoa. Cook on high for 4 1/2 hours or until rice is done. Discard bouillon cube. To serve, pour broth over top and serve with desired toppings.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,half cream,chile powder,sunflower seed,green food coloring,tequila,spaghetti,kielbasa
title: Texas Kielbasa and Sunflower Seed Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 pound kielbasa | 1/2 cup sunflower seeds | 2 tablespoons dried chile powder | 2 tablespoons scotch bonnet chile powder | 1 quart chicken broth | 2 cups half-and-half cream | 1 cup scotchandar cream or sour cream | 1 -2 drop green food coloring
instructions: Toast the sunflower seeds in a large skillet until golden brown. Let cool. Grind the ground seeds in a clean coffee grinder or mortar and pestle until fine. Add the dried chile powder and 2 tablespoons of the scotch bonnet chile powder to the grinder and grind until fine.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,cardamom,flat leaf parsley,ginger powder,yellow pepper
title: Ginger and Yellow Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1 teaspoon powdered ginger powder | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 pinch ground cardamom | 1 large yellow pepper or 1 large red pepper, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a small bowl combine ginger, brown sugar& cardamom and place in a medium size bowl. Cut peppers diagonally and place in the bowl. Coat peppers with ginger mixture and sprinkle the parsley over the peppers. Serve warm, or refrigerate for up to 2 days. Yield, about 8 servings.

title: Linguica
ingredients: 1 1 lb butter | 10 beef bouillon cubes | 1 dried red chili pepper, seeded, destemeed and destemeed | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: In a saucepan, melt butter over medium low heat. Add beef cubes and chili. Pour the vodka over the meat. Turn beef occasionally as it browns. When meat is nearly all brown, pour in beef broth as necessary to cover meat.

Random Ingredients: green peppercorn,ginger garlic paste,plain flour,baby spinach leaf,red chili pepper,rosemary,heart palm
title: Heart palm and green peppercorn Burgers
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 tablespoon green peppercorn, powder ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary, finely chopped | 300 g heart palm, cut into 1/3 inch rounds | 200 g baby spinach leaves | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/170c fan/gas lightly grease or line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Mix flour, peppercorn powder and ginger garlic paste together on a flat plate, make indentations in the palm with your fingertips. Spoon about 2 tsp of the palm onto the flat surface of the palm, fold the palm over to enclose the palm with filling. Place palm onto trays, press down and flatten to about 3cm thick. Repeat with remaining palm and filling. Sprinkle the chopped chili over them, taking care to ensure they don't touch. Bake for 10 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,cupcake liner,swiss chard leaf,rose water,beef broth,greek yogurt,dark brown sugar
title: Beef and Swiss Chard Tarts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 5 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 12 ounces swiss chard leaves, coarsely chopped | 2 cans reduced-sodium fat-free beef broth | 1/4 cup reduced-fat greek yogurt | 2 teaspoons dried rose water | 6 cups cupcake liners
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine dried onion flakes, brown sugar, and chard leaves. Set aside. In a soup or dutch oven, stir beef broth, greek yogurt, and rose waters into beef mixture. Bring mixture to a boil, then cook, uncovered, over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature. Stir mixture into chard mixture in bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake in preheated 400°f oven for 20 minutes, or until tops are just beginning to brown. Remove from oven and cut into 8 bars.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,white wine vinegar,hot dog,beef bouillon cube,coriander leaf
title: Hot Dogs With Condiments and Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg beef bouillon cube | 250 g fresh coriander leaves | 200 g pine nuts | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon vinegar | 4 hot dogs
instructions: Dissolve the beef bouillon cubes in 100 ml of boiling water. Leave to cool and make a paste of the crushed coriander leaves, pine nuts or breadcrumbs. Heat the butter in a non stick, heavy based heavy based saucepan and stir in the seasoned soup base mixture. Mix until boiling, add the hot dogs and reduce the heat to a simmer. Stirring occasionally, heat for about 30 minutes serve hot with rice.

title: Ravioli With Cheese, Tea and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup dried cheese ravioli | 1 cup finely cubed cheese ravioli
instructions: Prepare the cheese ravioli according to package directions, drain. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ravioli and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until tender but firm.

title: Vegan Chile Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1/3 cup soymilk | 4 dried ancho chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh herb, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix cream cheese with soy milk in a nonstick skillet over low heat. Stir ancho chiles, and herbs into cream cheese mixture. Heat until cream cheese is well blended and chiles are fragrant, 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Raspberry Raita
ingredients: 2 cups canned raspberries, drained | 2 cups plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: In a blender, combine the raspberries and yogurt. Add lemon juice and garlic powder. Cover and blend until smooth. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Guacamole Chips
ingredients: 1 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard oil
instructions: Using a pastry blender or food processor, process the guacamole until completely dissolved. Add the mustard oil and pulse until well mixed.

title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups ricotta | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh chilies ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup marsala wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° and line a deep 4 quart casserole dish with foil and spray with pam. Layer ricoot in dish and add chiles. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl and pour over the swiss cheese. Cover tightly, bake in preheated oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Cheese Filled Halushky
ingredients: 4 potatoes starch mixed with 2 cups cold water | 1 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Grease the bottoms only of the pans with the 3 cups of potato starch. Boil together the cranberries and 1 cup water until they have become brittle and are transparent. Remove from heat and add the cheese. Drain the cranberries, saving 1/2 cup liquid. Mix in the cheese. Place in the prepared pans but not over crowdering them too far. When done, drain the excess moisture. Scoop out desired amount of potato pastry and place on top of the cheese. Place in a cold oven. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove from oven and cool on rack.

title: Cafe Rio Chicken
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: Heat tomato sauce according to directions on the packet, adding shredded lettuce. Serve with tortilla chips and salsa.

title: Eggplant and Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, sliced | 7 ounces farmer cheese | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons whiskey, to taste | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh herbs | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley | 8 ounces quinoa | 4 ounces kalamata olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. Arrange sliced eggplant in a lightly greased, 3 1/2 to 4 quart shallow ovenproof baking dish. Sprinkle with salt if desired. Bake until eggplant is tender and beginning to brown, about 1 hour. Remove from oven and let cool completely. Peel eggplant, discard ends and then dice into 1/4 inch cubes. In a large skillet, melt cheese over medium heat until bubbly and beginning to turn golden. Watch carefully, because cheese can easily burn. Pour about half of cheese into a large shallow bowl. Add remaining cheese and stir until melted. Add herbs to cheese mixture just before removing from heat. Spread quinoa over half of one baking dish, then top with eggplant and cheese mixture. Sprinkle evenly with olives. Continue layering ingredients and ending with cheese mixture. Bake in preheated oven, about 45 minutes, or until quinoa is lightly browned and cheese is bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,cream mushroom soup,cumin seed,baking powder,grape jam jelly,button mushroom,apricot
title: Aunt Clara's Glazed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb mixed mushrooms | 2 ounces dry apricots | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 2 ounces gorgonzola ( i like brie cheese ) | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 -3 tablespoons grape jam or 2 -3 tablespoons jelly
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Drain mushrooms and chop or cut into small pieces. Combine all ingredients. Pour mixture into baking dish. Bake approx 20 - 25 minutes and serve.

title: Broiled Halibut
ingredients: 4 pounds center-cut halibut fillets | 1 cup white onion, chopped | 1 package rye bread, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place halibut fillets in a shallow roasting dish. Cover fish with onion in a saucepan. Brush the fish with water. Place on a baking tray, and place in the oven. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until fish is easily flaked with a fork. Baste fish with water halfway through cooking, and sprinkle the rye bread cubes over the top. Return to the oven, and continue cooking for 5 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and fish are golden.

title: Guilt Free Sourdough French Toast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1/4 loaf sourdough bread
instructions: Spray medium skillet with non stick cooking spray. Over medium heat. Add coconut oil, cocoa, herbs and vinegar to pan, stir constantly over medium heat until sauce bubbles. Dip bread in mixture until it is well coated and lightly browned on each side. Add extra oil to skillet or pan as needed to get desired thickness. Serve with soy sauce.

title: Homemade Hamburger in Brown Sugar
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 1/4 ounces black-roasted jalapeno peppers or 2 1/4 ounces serrano peppers, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Brown hamburger. Drain. Mix well. Pour into ungreased 1/2 quart baking dish. Top with peppers and sugar. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes until done.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,ro tel tomato,cabbage,dark sesame oil
title: My Favorite Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 lb shredded coleslaw mix | 1 cup rotel diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1 cup shredded cabbage
instructions: Combine all ingredients, refrigerate until ready to serve so flavors can meld. Serve in shallow soup dishes or salad bowls.

Random Ingredients: fettuccine pasta,cherry,splenda sugar substitute,chicken breast fillet,garlic powder,milk
title: Low Fat Chicken and Fettuccine With Cherries
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast fillet ( about 1.75 pounds ) | 1 1/2 cups skim milk | 1 cup diced canned cherries | 1/1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/3 cup splenda sugar substitute | 12 ounces dry fettuccine pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Cut chicken into ½ inch slices & place in a shallow non metallic dish. Combine milk, cherries, garlic& sugar substitute in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on medium power, uncovered, for one minute, stirring half way through. Pour milk mixture over chicken, stir to coat. Cover & microwave on high power for 12 minutes. Add pasta and turn to coat. Cover & microwave 2 minutes more, stirring half way through. Note, this is a low fat recipe, add more skim milk if desired.

title: Butternut Squash Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ancho chile powder | 1/2 lb ground pork or 1 italian sausage | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 cup spaghetti, broken up | 1 lb butternut squash, peeled, sliced | 1/3 cup raisins | 1/3 cup almond paste | 1/2 cup sliced blanched almond, toasted
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Toast ancho chile powder in small skillet over medium high heat, stirring frequently until fragrant. Remove from heat and grind chili according to spice mix's instructions. Remove from pan and set aside. Brown ground pork in skillet, stirring to crumble as it cooks. Remove to bowl. Add cornflour to drippings in skillet and cook while stirring rapidly for 2 minutes. Add spaghetti, squash, raisins and almond paste or almonds and return sauce to a boil. Pour onto spaghetti mixture and mix well. Place on greased cookie sheet, cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,blueberry pie filling,kaffir lime leaf,kernel corn,peanut,chipotle pepper,spring onion,pecorino romano cheese
title: Baked Corn and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 cup whole kernel corn | 2 cups chopped fresh or frozen corn | 1/2 lb blueberries or 1/2 lb grape tomatoes, halved | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 3 spring onions, chopped ( scallions ) | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted peanuts | 1 chipotle pepper | 2 tablespoons grated grana padano or 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese
instructions: In a medium size bowl, toss the corn, blueberries, tomatoes, onions and peanuts together. Spread the mixture onto a sheet of parchment paper and bake at 350 degrees for about 25 minutes. While the corn mixture is baking set the remaining salad ingredients. Serve at room temperature or chilled. You can also garnish with grated parmesan cheese or other toppings if desired.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,chicken breast meat,anchovy,salt pork,pecan,white sesame seed,asafoetida powder
title: Dry Roasted Pecan Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast meat | 1 cup white sesame seeds | 1 cup white sesame seeds | 5 tablespoons marjoram | 6 anchovies, drained and minced | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 lb pecans, coarsely ground ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken breasts between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound to 1/4 inch thickness. Using the same method as for the pounded chicken, pat the chicken dry with paper towels so that it is even thickness. Blend the sesame seeds, marjoram, anchovies, and asafoetida in a food processor until finely ground. Dump the ground sesame seed mixture into a large skillet, add the ground pecans, and spread over the chicken. Let it simmer until a toothpick passes through the thickest part of the chicken thigh, about 20 minutes. Strip the chicken from the skin and place it on a baking sheet lined with waxed paper or parchment paper.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,white pepper,saffron strand,red chili powder
title: Kashmiri Saffron Kebab
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 6 saffron strands | 4 red chili peppers | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Place saffron in a small heatproof bowl. Stir in chilli powder and keep aside. Cut the peppers into small pieces. Toss pepper pieces into the bowl containing saffron. Drain the oil from the bowl and wipe out the bowl. Toss the peppers into the kashmiri spice mixture. Allow the spices to settle to the bottom of the bowl. Then, push the mixture through a sieve pressing down hard on it. Repeat procedure with remaining peppers. When the peppers are all gone, transfer them to a serving plate and serve as a snack with pakora.

title: Beef, Tomato Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb of any kind deli roast beef | 2 tablespoons soymilk | 1 large plum tomato, sliced thinly | chopped coriander or cilantro, to garnish
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve over the beef or other vegetables as desired. Note, i prefer using a red wine vinegar and tomato juice instead.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,ricotta cheese,beef bouillon powder,linguine pasta,red pepper flake,nonstick cooking spray,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Quick & Easy Chipotle Linguine
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 lb linguine pasta, dry | 1 jar rag� pastina chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, coarsely chopped, liquid reserved | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1/8 teaspoon freshly ground crushed red pepper flakes | 1 cup shredded low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped jarred roasted red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Coat 6 cups water with nonstick cooking spray about 10 to 12 minutes to make it water proof. Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil.

title: Fiesta Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 lb ground beef | 2 links italian sausage, mild | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 bottle catsup | 1 teaspoon dried red chile, chopped, without seeds | 1 hot red chile, minced
instructions: Mix first five ingredients together well. Shape meat into 1 inch thick patties. Fry until no longer pink inside. Drain fat and wipe fat from the pan. Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside. Add the turkey, pork and beans to the fat in the skillet and cook until browned. Add the taco seasoning, catsup, chile and minced chile. Stir well, simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes until heated through serve with tortillas.

title: Lebanese Crispy Parsley (Makaron Yahniesha)
ingredients: 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, packed | 1 tablespoon corn oil, or as needed
instructions: Toss the parsley with 1 teaspoon salt and let stand at room temperature until it's soft and begins to break down a bit, about 1 hour. Use the tip of a paring knife to break down any remaining pieces. Pour 1 teaspoon of hot oil into a 1 cup measuring cup. Pour enough oil to cover 1/4 inch of the top of the parsley, then sprinkle the oil onto the parsley to coat. When the oil is absorbed, gather all of the pieces into a coarse, grainy paste, sprinkling with more oil as needed. Wrap the oil around the parsley so the paste doesn't break but sticks together. Taste, and add more salt, if necessary, and set aside while you proceed to fry the bread in another pan. Gently shake off any excess oil. Transfer the bread to a work surface, and pat into a rectangular shape with a kitchen towel placed over the towel. Gather the edges of the towel together, and lift the bread onto the towel with the cloth. Cut into 2 or 3 wedges, then cut them crosswise into wedges. Wrap in clean, dry plastic wrap and place somewhere cool, dry, for 1 to 2 hours. Drain, and reheat the crisped bread over low heat until crisp and dry, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chutney,beef stew meat,chicken stock,grape leaf,pickle relish,garlic clove
title: Easy Beef Rolls
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 2 -3 cups mixed pickle relish ( you can use sweet pickle style ) | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish | 1 garlic clove, minced | 2 cans chicken stock ( don't need to use low ) | 1 jar grape leaves ( they should come packed in brine, not dried out )
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees.

title: Artichokes (French Style)
ingredients: 30 artichoke hearts | 4 -5 spring onions, cut into 3 inch pieces
instructions: Wash the artichokes well and remove the tough center vein from each. Slice off the tops of the artichokes by slicing the bottom one through to the bottom and the stem end and remove the choke. Cut each artichoke heart lengthwise into 3 pieces. Using a sharp knife cut the artichoke hearts into 2 inch lengths. Sprinkle the artichoke hearts with 1 inch of green onion and a small pinch of salt and pepper to taste. Place the artichokes on a dish and bake uncovered for about 40 minutes at 450f or until the onions are very lightly colored. When done, take them out of the oven and arrange them in layers in a serving platter.

title: Seared Vermicelli With White Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch vermicelli, broken in half | 2 tablespoons white sauce or 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Fill a large bowl with cold salted water and add the vermicelli. Swirl to cover the noodles with the warm water and let drain for 5 minutes. Using a wooden spoon, press the pasta into the remaining water and dry it out with a paper towel. Transfer the vermicelli to a serving dish and stir through the white sauce or ketchup.

title: Tunisian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed ( or pork stew if you prefer ) | 6 ounces tomatillos ( or one can diced tomatoes ) | 1/4 cup coriander, chopped
instructions: Place the stew meat into a crockpot and stir in the tomatillos, coriander and chilli over medium heat until the stew is hot and the flavors are combined. Serve warm or room temperature.

title: Algerian  Layered Dip (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup green cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons black olives or 2 teaspoons other light black olives ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sofrito sauce | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning or 1 teaspoon sumac | powdered powdered sugar or finely toasted almond ( for spreading on the cookies )
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle grind the cardamom pods then add the black olives, sofrito, if using, and italian seasoning to the ground cardamom. Mix thoroughly and spread in a small bowl. Refrigerate for 4 - 8 hours or for best results refrigerate for 3 days.

Random Ingredients: adobo sauce,chinese pea pod,broth,lemon peel,shell macaroni,mascarpone cheese,lard
title: Spicy Macaroni and Peas
ingredients: 8 ounces shell macaroni | 1 1/2 teaspoons lard | 2 teaspoons chinese pea pods, split lengthwise, seeds removed | 1/8 - 1/4 cup chicken broth | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese or 2 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 1/4 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 1 -2 dashes adobo sauce
instructions: Boil 7 quarts of water in a large pot until the water is at a boil, then add in the macaroni. Boil the pasta to al dente or al dente. Drain the pasta, then toss with the lard and cut into bite size pieces. Transfer to a large bowl and add the pea pods, chicken broth, mascarpone or cream cheese and lemon peel. Season to taste with adobo sauce. Serve warm or refrigerate.

title: Spicy Chocolate (Pampered Chef)
ingredients: 1 pound dark chocolate, chopped | 1 can whole peeled anaheim chile peppers, drained
instructions: Melt chocolate in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in sliced anaheim peppers.

title: Radish Halwa
ingredients: 2 cups evaporated skim milk | 1/2 cup small radish, peeled | 1/2 tablespoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Place the evaporated milk in a heavy, medium saucepan. Add the radish, cardamom pods, and pinch of salt. Simmer over low heat until tender, 20 to 30 minutes. Cool to room temperature, about 5 minutes. Strain the milk to remove the cardamom pods.

Random Ingredients: olive,fish sauce,sesame oil,tomato juice,egg,bacon bit,shallot,orange bell pepper
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pate
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 cloves shallots, minced | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 2 tomatoes, finely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh orange sweet bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons bacon bits | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Make the eggs, beat eggs and put aside. In a large frying pan, heat a few tablespoons of olive oil on medium heat and lightly sauté the shallots and sesame oil until they become translucent, about 2 minutes. Add the tomatoes, bell pepper and bacon bits and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring. Add the beaten egg and continue to stir. Add the fish sauce and continue to stir so that the eggs are evenly mixed. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes more. Remove from the heat and allow to cool for about 10 minutes. The pate will harden quickly so keep a close eye on it to ensure that it does not dry out.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage link,maraschino cherry,chili oil,picante sauce,onion soup mix,tomato puree
title: Italian Turkey Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb dry italian turkey sausage link | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 can tomato puree | 1 jar picante sauce | 2 maraschino cherries
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Mix together in 9x13 pan. Top with picante sauce. Pour tomato puree over the top. Sprinkle with cherries. Cover and bake 1 hour at 325 degrees.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,ginger paste,beef burger,cider vinegar,queso fresco,beef broth,mint leaf,peanut
title: Beef Burgers With Yogurt, Peanuts and Peanuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 500 g beef burgers | 1 1/2 cups sliced queso fresco | 1 cup beef broth | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | fresh mint leaves | dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a frypan over medium heat, add ginger and cook for 1 minute or until aromatic. Remove from heat, add ground beef, crumble and saute until browned. Remove from heat, stir in cheese, beef broth, vinegar, mint leaves and peanuts. Serve with a green salad.

title: Braised Beef On The Top (For Crock Pot)
ingredients: 10 ounces stewing beef, cut to 1/2 inch slabs | 5 tablespoons olive ( preferably spanish )
instructions: Spray the meat with non stick cooking spray and brown it thoroughly in 3 tablespoons oil. Transfer the beef to your crock with the onions. Cover the crock and cook on low for 7 - 10 hours until the beef is tender and is cooked to your desired level of doneness.. Serve immediately, or refrigerate and serve warm for a delicious crock pot meal.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,chicken broth,mayonnaise,walnut,enchilada sauce,ginger,bulgur wheat,red chile
title: Mexican Fiesta Burgers (Serve with Corn Chips and Green Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup prepared enchilada sauce ( i use the canned one from my own recipe ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth ( or 2 tablespoons of a 14 ounce can enchilada sauce ) | 1 teaspoon minced ginger | 1/2 teaspoon chopped red chile | 1/3 cup bulgur wheat | 1 cup torn walnut pieces | 2 tablespoons ranch dressing
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the enchilada sauce, mayonnaise, chicken broth, ginger, chilies and bulgur. Serve the cooled meat on a serving plate sprinkled with walnuts or corn chips. Top with salad dressing. If desired, top with additional walnuts or corn chips, if desired.

title: Rice Noodles With Marsala
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/3 cup marsala wine | 1/4 cup romano cheese
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling, salted water for 3 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,black olive,quinoa,celery rib,button mushroom,cornmeal,white pearl onion
title: Vegan-Friendly Cornmeal Crackle
ingredients: 1 cup dry quinoa | 1/4 cup peas ( or green beans ) or 1/4 cup white pearl onion | 8 small button mushrooms | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 8 ounces white pearl onions | 1/4 cup black olives
instructions: Place 1 cup quinoa, peas, mushrooms, cornmeal, celery and onions in a rice cooker. Set on and fluff. Sprinkle remaining cup quinoa and black olives on top. Close lid and steam in microwave oven for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,lettuce,bread flour,tuna vegetable oil,mirepoix,buttermilk,angel hair pasta
title: Tuna, Mirepoix and Pasta Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup mirepoix, shredded | 1/2 cup lettuce, shredded | 4 slices bread flour | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 packet nori no-soppa no-sugar-added tuna in vegetable oil ( drained in a colander ) | 1 package oignon's angel hair pasta | 2 tablespoons buttermilk ( optional )
instructions: Bring 9 quarts of water to boil, then lower heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the noodles and cook until al dente, not mushy. Drain in a colander and run under cold water until cool, about 30 minutes. Drain in a sieve and leave to drain well again. Heat the tuna in the vegetable oil in a pan for 3 minutes. Add the oignon's sauce and cook for 2 minutes. Add the lettuce and toss to combine, then add the drained pasta. Top with the nori.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,cilantro stem,sage,red chili pepper,avocado,nonfat milk,roquefort cheese
title: Roquefort Avocados
ingredients: 2 ripe avocados | 1 ounce low-fat ripto cheese | 2 tablespoons nonfat milk or 2 tablespoons soymilk | 1 pinch fresh sage or 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 4 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems ( optional ) | 1 dried red chili pepper ( optional ) | 1 can roquefort cheese ( i used daiya ) or ( 5 1/2 ounce ) can regular cheese ( i used daiya )
instructions: Remove the seed from each avocado. Cut avocados in half lengthwise, then scoop out the center with a spoon or melonballer, leaving the flesh on the shells. Reserve the shells. Halve and seed the avocado and scoop out the flesh with a spoon or the blade of a knife. Place the ripto cheese in a small bowl. Cut the ripto cheese in small pieces then cut pieces into bite size chunks. Toss with the avocado in the bowl. In a small bowl, combine the milk with the sage, cilantro, chili, and cheese with a fork. Drain the avocado meat, reserving the liquid, then coarsely mash with a fork until the mixture is creamy. Taste sauce, or make your own, but i strongly recommend to do so at the table. If you prefer a thinner sauce, you can add a little water, or low fat milk, if necessary. To serve, place two avocados in a small serving bowl, drizzle cheese onto top.

title: Easy French Fry Steak
ingredients: 16 ounces beef bouillon powder | ketchup, or your favorite spicy garlic sauce
instructions: Dissolve bouillon and chili powder in ketchup. Brown steak on both sides. Serve as appetizer or hors d'oeuvre with assorted crackers.

title: Vanilla Shortbread
ingredients: 2 cups cornmeal | 1 3/4 cups coarsely shredded unsweetened butter ( plus more if necessary ) | 1 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature with a touch of added butter, at room temperature ( plus more if necessary )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Spray bottom and sides of a 12 inch by 8 inch jellyroll pan with cooking oil. Sprinkle cornmeal evenly on the bottom of the pan and shake it around. In a large bowl, with your fingertips, lightly beat together the 2 cups of cornmeal, butter and 1/2 cup of cold butter until it is thoroughly blended, a few lumps are visible. Scrape the remaining 1/2 cup of cornmeal into the bowl and sprinkle evenly over the cornmeal. With a spatula or wooden spoon, scrape the butter, cornmeal, and butter to a smooth, crumbly consistency. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured work surface and knead with your hands about 2 or 3 times. Divide the dough into 12 pieces and shape each piece into a 1 inch thick circle on an ungreased cookie sheet with a 1 inch rim. The shapes may be found in most decorating and can be shaped into loaves, crescents, squares, squares, etc.

title: Simple Spicy Indian Ginger Beer
ingredients: 1 cup ginger-garlic paste, about 2 to 1/2 inches long ( about 1-1/2 of a 10 oz can, if it's really strong it's worth making ) | 1 quart water ( not ice, but enough water to cover the ginger )
instructions: Rinse the ginger in a strainer lined with a double layer of cheesecloth. Dump it in to a bowl, and put the ginger in a heavy 3 quart kettle or other heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add the water. Bring almost to a boil, and boil for about 10 minutes, until the ginger is very aromatic and bubbly. Stir the ginger ale with a wire whisk, and boil over high heat, stirring constantly, for about half an hour to a minute, until no longer cloudy and the bottom of the kettle have become a dark layer of dark roast goodness in color. Transfer the ginger ale to a bowl, and refrigerate uncovered until cold, at least 1 hour. Once cold, transfer to a glass measuring cup and add the ice cube to it. Fill the pitcher with 2 tablespoons of cool, still boiling stout beer, then strain the remaining stout into the cup. Pour into your sterilized pint mason jars and process in a waterbath for 15 minutes. Alternatively, you could pour the beer through a strainer and let the liquid cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,beef tenderloin,hot chicken broth,cilantro,dark sesame oil,colby monterey jack cheese,strawberry,fruit
title: Steak With Strawberries and Kiwi
ingredients: 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 4 teaspoons hot chicken broth or 4 teaspoons vegetable broth | 1 lb beef tenderloin, fat trimmed, tied with kitchen string | 2 cups frozen mixed fresh fruit, sectioned | 1 cup strawberry, sliced | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro ( optional ) | 1/2 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Whisk fish sauce, sesame oil and broth in small bowl until blended. Place beef in large resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,cocoa,farfalle pasta,cucumber,stewing beef,rice wine,red food coloring,peanut
title: Hot Chocolate Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 cup sweet peas ( frozen is fine ) or 1 cup sugar snap peas ( frozen is fine ) | 1 cup coconut ( or coconut flakes ) | 1 cup red food coloring | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 cups farfalle pasta ( bow tie ) | 1/4 cup butter or 1/4 cup margarine | 1 1/2 teaspoons cocoa ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla ( optional ) | crushed peanuts, coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cut stew or meat into bite size pieces.

title: Fresh Herb Stock -- Canning
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs watercress, picked from stems and leaves | 1 teaspoon orange peel, rind of, cut finely | 1 teaspoon pepper, freshly ground
instructions: In a 5 - 6 cup enameled or glass jar or jar with a tight fitting lid, combine the watercress roots, orange peel, pepper and salt.

Random Ingredients: pear,molasses,liquid smoke,parmigiano reggiano cheese,korean red pepper paste,white cornmeal,honey,dijon mustard
title: Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 2-inch cubes ( sirloin tip ) | 1 piece korean red pepper paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons molasses | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1/2 cup dry white cornmeal | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated to serve
instructions: Put the meat in a large bowl. Mix in the pepper paste, molasses, honey, mustard, and molasses. Sourkop the meat onto the skewers, and marinate at least 1 hour. Meanwhile, heat the charcoal to high and lightly oil the grate. Grill the skewers, turning once, until cooked to your liking, 7 to 10 minutes per side for medium rare. Serve topped with grated parmigiano reggiano.

title: Pasta and Peas
ingredients: 1 small turnip, peeled and chopped | 1 teaspoon dried mixed herbs | 1 medium ripe tomatoes, chopped | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 1/3 cup reduced-fat coconut milk | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 lb pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Place oil in large non stick pan. Add turnip and seasonings. Saute 3 - 4 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and cook 1 - 2 minutes. Add pesto and coconut milk and vinegar. Boil gently 2 - 3 minutes. Add pasta, salt and pepper to taste. Let boil until pasta is tender.

title: White Bean Salmon (Salad Shiraz)
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon, cleaned, scaled and cut into chunks | 1/4 cup white beans, washed and drained or 1/4 cup dried white beans
instructions: Cook the salmon in boiling salted water about 8 minutes each side, until cooked through but not falling off the bone. Drain and set aside. Drain the beans and dry them out. Remove any fat from the surface of the salmon. Add the beans and salmon chunks in a skillet with the fat. Saute for a minute or 2 on a medium heat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,mineral water,ice water,white flour,fish sauce,buttermilk baking mix,cardamom seed
title: Fishcake
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach, stemmed and washed | 2 cups dry fish sauce, divided | 2 cups buttermilk baking mix | 1/2 cup mineral water | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds | ice water, as needed | 5 1/2 cups white flour ( may need a little more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. To prepare, place the washed spinach in a colander and sprinkle with 2 cups of the fish sauce and salt. Let sit for 10 minutes or longer. Transfer to a large bowl and add the baking mix. Add the water, 1 tablespoon at a time, stirring or rubbing the mix until smooth after each addition. Add the cardamon seeds. Add a little more water if the mixture is too dry to work with. Sift together 1 cup of the flour and the remaining fish sauce and add to the dry ingredients, mixing very well. Add 1/2 cup water and mix until smooth. Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead until smooth. Divide the dough into 8 equal sized pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and cut into 8 wedges in the centre. Place the dough on an ungreased cookie sheet and press the wedges into the cakes with fingers to form wedges. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes or until the edges are crisp and the center is barely cooked. Remove and let cool a little. To serve, arrange the wedges on a platter and top with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: mint,sesame oil,romaine lettuce,red potato,cayenne,cocoa,hard egg,pico de gallo
title: Minty Chocolate Salty Eggs With Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 1/3 cup pico de gallo | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, halved lengthwise | 1 tablespoon grated fresh mint | 2 tablespoons shredded sweet greek unsweetened cocoa | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 dash cayenne, to taste | 8 cups romaine lettuce, finely chopped | 4 pico de gallo, for serving
instructions: Using a sharp knife, make a 1 inch slit in each egg, almost in the top, making a cut in the bottom. Drain the eggs completely and pat the yolks so the yolks are solid but not hard. Spread half the pico de gallo on a clean plate or tray, and set aside. To the pico de gallo, add the remaining pico de gallo, mint, cocoa, sesame oil, and cayenne. Remove any egg yolks with a slotted spoon. Place into a shallow bowl, and toss together with the lettuce and pico de gallo. Serve with pico de gallo on the side for dipping.

title: Green Chile Salsa
ingredients: 4 tablespoons chopped mild green chilies ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons maple syrup ( see note in description ) | whole grain mustard, for brushing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl, stirring well.

title: Roast Prime Rib of Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs prime rib of beef | 1 cup ground coffee ( or to taste ) | 1 butternut squash, peeled and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. Place all of the roast in a single layer on a very large baking tin. Pour the coffee over the roast and spread evenly. Roast, stirring every 10 minutes, until the roast is fork tender and beginning to fall apart, at least 1 hour or up to 45 minutes. A meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the roast should read 140 degrees. Transfer the roast to a warm platter.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,greek yogurt,ginger garlic paste,yogurt,chicken bouillon cube,baby onion,celery,balsamic vinegar
title: Quick & Easy Yogurt Chicken
ingredients: 4 small chicken tenders | 1 container greek yogurt ( preferably natural ) | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup low moisture chicken bouillon cube | 1/4 cup light balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped yellow and purple celery
instructions: Heat oven to 400°. Poke holes in chicken tenders with fork. Place tenders in a 9x13 baking dish or 2 large baking dishes. Mix yogurt, yogurt, ginger garlic paste and bouillon in large bowl. Pour yogurt mixture over chicken. Cover with foil. Bake 40 - 45 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Remove foil. Mix vinegar and celery in a small bowl. Spoon yogurt mixture over chicken and vegetables. Bake until bubbly and warm, about 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,cranberry,pork fillet,cinnamon,sea salt,garlic powder,fenugreek seed,fish stock
title: Spiced Pork Wraps with Pineapple
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 4 slices lean pork fillets ( thin cut ) | 1/4 cup fish stock | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 4 large flour tortillas
instructions: Combine cranberries, fenugreek and salt in a small bowl. Sprinkle pork evenly over both sides of fenugreek mixture. Arrange pork on an ungreased grill rack and grill 5 to 7 minutes or until cooked through. Meanwhile, combine fish stock, garlic powder and cinnamon and bring to a simmer in a small saucepan over medium high heat. Place tortillas on a large plate and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high 2 minutes or until warm. Remove wrap and discard. Spread 1 to 2 teaspoons of fish stock mixture evenly on each wrap and top with remaining filling. Serve.

title: Famous Easy Veal Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs veal, cut in cubes | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Put the veal cubes in the slow cooker. Pour the mushroom soup over the veal. Cover and cook on low heat setting 4 - 6 hours or on high heat setting 3 - 5 hours.

title: Pancho's Chili Con Tomate
ingredients: 4 tomatoes with green chilies, diced | 1 cup canned kidney beans, drained | 4 slices ripe camembert cheese | 2 tablespoons flour
instructions: Cook and stir tomatoes and bean with chilies in medium saucepan over medium heat until chilies soften, about 5 minutes. Stir cheese into tomato and bean mixture. Sprinkle flour over mixture.

title: Aubergine (Sweet Beef) Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 ounces ouzo | 1 teaspoon gluten | 2 packages gluten free penne or ( 900 g ) packages spirals ready-made pasta | 1 package stoned cling peas ( frozen is fine ) | 1 pint heavy cream | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes with oil, drained and snipped into thin strips | 1/2 cup rum extract or 1/2 cup a mixture of 1/2 a cup rum extract and 1/4 cup a mixture of 2 shots ouzo | 1 teaspoon of grated gluten
instructions: Trim excess fat from stewing beef and cut into 1/2 chunks. In an oven safe pan or dutch oven, fry the meat in olive oil until just brown. Add rest of ingredients except cream and ouzo. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1 hour. Add cream, ouzo, and gluten and simmer another 1 1/2 hours, or until thickened. Serve over your favourite pasta, topped with shredded parmesan.

title: Dogs Pastry or Noodle for Dogs
ingredients: 250 g minced meat | 2 teaspoons grainy mustard ( for dogs ) | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the egg yolk together until smooth. Roll mixture into a sausage shape, like a french stick. Make a hole in the middle and drop the egg yolk into the hole. Place in a large frying pan, with a little water to cover, and cook until the meat is thoroughly cooked.

Random Ingredients: season salt,baby corn,coffee crystal,bay leaf,basil leaf,water
title: Coffee Seasoning Blend for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/4 teaspoon season-all salt | 1/8 teaspoon old bay leaf | 1 bay leaf | 3 cups water, divided | 5 tablespoons instant coffee crystals
instructions: Place spices in a gallon size bag.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,onion soup mix,cocoa,mace,coconut cream,vanilla essence
title: Coconut Smoked Pork Loin Loin
ingredients: 4 pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 can coconut cream
instructions: Place pork in an ovenproof dish and add rest of ingredients and stir gently. Cover tightly with a wrap and bake at 180 degrees for 2 hours.

title: Spam® - Texas Spicy Pine Nut Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon southwest spicy seasoning | 1 tablespoon allspice
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl with an electric mixer on high for 5 minutes. Remove from bowl and drop onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Let cool, cut into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Kiwifruit Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 can creamed corn | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter, softened | 2 tablespoons mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1 dash pimiento, spice | 2 tablespoons kiwi, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix in cheese. Cover and chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,hot italian sausage,half cream,guinness stout,black rice,romaine lettuce
title: Italian Sausage Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs hot italian sausage, casings removed ( or links ) | 1 cup guinness stout | 2 cups half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chili peppers ( or to taste, use green ) | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 1 cup fresh coarsely julienned rice
instructions: In a large pan, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink. Drain. In a bowl, combine the guinness and half and half and cook over high heat until hot. Add chili peppers and cook 1 - 2 minutes or until hot and mixture starts to thicken. Cool off the heat. In a large bowl, toss the sausage with the rice, lettuce and hot guinness mixture. Chill at least 2 hrs prior to serving.

title: Potato Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 pound red potatoes, sliced thin | 1 large tomato with juice | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Blanch the potato slices in the boiling water, stirring to separate the slices. Place the potatoes into a colander and squeeze excess water off. Place the potato slices in a skillet over medium heat and sprinkle with tomato and cheese. Continue cooking until potatoes are tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand until the cheese has melted.

title: Spicy Scented Beef - Siew Choy
ingredients: 300 ml homemade beef stock ( or 2 cups leftover beef stock cubes in juice ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 red chiles ( optional )
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil. Slice a small slit into each chili if desired. Add the chili to the water, and allow to simmer for 15 - 20 minutes. Strain off the water from the stock, and return the stock to the pan. Stir in the oil. Serve.

title: Creamy Ricotta Lime Dressing
ingredients: 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon lime juice ( or lemon )
instructions: In blender or food processor, blend ricotta, lime juice and salt. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: rose water,yellow cornmeal,onion flake,parmesan cheese,chipotle chile adobo
title: Roseycornmeal Crackers
ingredients: 1/4 cup white cornmeal | 1 tablespoon yellow cornmeal | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 2/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon rose water
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Whisk all ingredients in a large bowl. Spread onto parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes or until golden. Cool.

title: Alfredo Iceberg Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 2 ounces almond milk ( or cream milk ) | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla ( or almond extract )
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add lettuce and scald about three minutes. Remove from pan and set aside. In a small bowl, blend almond milk with a fork or spoon. Pour milk mixture into skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly. Stir in the vanilla. Serve in a lettuce leaf lined bowl.

title: Bell Pepper Appetizers
ingredients: 2 cups crushed marshmallows | 1 large bell pepper | 1 tablespoon garlic salt
instructions: Take the crushed marshmallows in a large bowl. Slice peppers into 1/4's, set aside. Slice the bell pepper into 1/4' rings, set aside. In the bottom of a fry pan, coat with a mix of garlic salt and a dash or two of paprika. Quickly toss in the pepper rings. Quickly toss them into the mix with garlic salt again. Cook on low heat stirring often just until the mixture gets hot, the bell peppers will release their juices, stir in. Immediately take pan off of heat serve in bowls.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,pork roast,pasta shell,beef brisket,carrot,portabella mushroom,corn syrup,savory
title: Savory Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed | 2 teaspoons dried savory | 1 teaspoon corn syrup | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1 can peeled and diced carrots, drained | 2 cups shredded cooked pork roast | 20 fresh portabella mushrooms | 1 package uncooked small pasta shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place beef brisket in a roasting pan. Toss with savory, corn syrup, and flour. Place carrots and cooked pork roast in a roasting pan. Top with mushrooms, and place in preheated oven. Roast for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Remove from oven, and cover to keep warm. Add pasta to oven, and cook, covered, until cooked. Remove from oven, and serve.

title: Ww  Mein  With Snow Peas and Radishes
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea | 1/2 lb radish, sliced | 1 tablespoon olive oil
instructions: Drain the peas and remove the strings. Mix the olive oil, sliced radishes and snow peas. Wrap the snow peas with paper towel and toss them all in there.

title: Penne With Habanero Peppers. Penne With Habanero
ingredients: 4 -4 tablespoons habanero peppers | 1 lb penne pasta | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Wash the habanero peppers and discard any papery juices or seeds in the habanero peppers. Rinse the chili peppers under running water, or the juice released from the habanero peppers is released. Slit one edge of each chili pepper and remove the ribs. Cut the chili peppers lengthwise into strips about 1 long and 1 wide, and make a slit along the chili lengthwise. Turn the chili strips and slit down their sides. Repeat with the penne. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Add salt to taste. Add the penne and cook uncovered over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain and rinse the pan. When the pasta is finished cooking, transfer it to the sink, and drain any excess liquid from the pasta and set aside. Incorporate additional 2 to 3 tablespoons of habanero pepper juice into the pasta and toss well. Add about half the pasta liquid to the pasta and toss. Transfer the pasta to a platter.

title: Tofu Tacos
ingredients: 1 box extra firm tofu, drained | 3 celery ribs, trimmed | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1 teaspoon cotija cheese, grated or 1 teaspoon shredded mexican cheese, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cut all ingredients in half lengthwise and place into food processor with reserved tofu. Blend until well combined. Adjust seasonings if necessary. To make the mixture thinner, add some water. Form the mixture into two balls. Place them on a flat surface or cutting board and flatten slightly with meat mallet or rolling pin until small, 1 inch diameter pieces form. Bake in 400 degree oven for 15 minutes then turn off the heat. Use a spatula to transfer the tofu to a plate. Wipe out pan and return to oven. Turn heat up to 400 degrees. When it starts darkening, place a couple of tofu pieces on an upside down plate. Place another tofu piece on top of the tofu, then turn the oven temperature up to 500 degrees. Cook until the tofu reaches desired doneness, another 5 minutes or so, depending on desired level of doneness. Remove to a carving board, cut in half and serve hot.

title: Thai Caramelized Leek-Cashew Strudel
ingredients: 1 lb leek | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 can chicken broth | 2 cans vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon cashews | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 quart vegetable broth
instructions: Trim leek but do not remove the black matter. Slice into 1/4 inch pieces. Cut away and discard the root ends from leek. Place leeks in a large pot of boiling salted water to cover by 1 inch. Cook until tender. Drain and cool. Peel off outer layers. Cut into thin slices. Place leeks, salt and fennel seeds in a food processor. Pulse to grind spices. Add 2 cans broth and process again. Spread 1 can vegetable broth in the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Place 1 layer of the phyllo pastry over the vegetable broth. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 15 minutes. Lightly brush the top layer of phyllo with some of the vegetable broth. Cut a few slits in the top layer. Repeat the same process for the second phyllo sheet. Place the phyllo sheets on top and brush with more of the vegetable broth. Lay the first layer of phyllo pastry over the top and brush the bottom layer with more vegetable broth. Spread 1 more can of vegetable broth over the bottom layer of pastry. Lay the second layer of phyllo pastry over the top, brush with more vegetable broth. Spread half of the sauteed leeks evenly over the phyllo pastry and spread about 5 tablespoons of the roasted cashew nut mixture. Repeat these layers for the 4 rest of the phyllo sheets. Spread the last layer of sauteed leeks over the cashew nut mixture and use the remainder of the roasted cashew nut mixture for garnish. Place the final 3 sheets of pastry over the top layer and brush top layer with more vegetable broth. Cut several slits in the top layer of phyllo pastry and brush with more vegetable broth. Set the pastry sheets aside and cover with plastic wrap. Chill for at least 30 minutes. Uncover the pastry sheets and brush with more vegetable broth. Place 6 sheets in each of 8, cut out a circle of phyllo around the edge of the pastry sheet. Place 2 sheets into each of 8, set aside. To serve, place 1 pastry circle on a serving plate, top with 1/6 cup suace. Repeat the above process for the second 9 sheets of pieces. Serve with a small bowl of pickled carrot sauce.

title: Avocados
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 4 ounces ground veal | 2 teaspoons grenadine | 2 teaspoons ground habaneros ( jalapeno pepper ), or other hot pepper sauce | 2 small ripe pears - peeled, cored and finely chopped | 1 cup single cream | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Roast poblano chiles skin side up under broiler, watching carefully, until blackened in areas but still soft, about 15 minutes. Place in a plastic bag or paper towel, and wrap tightly. Allow chiles to steam 1/2 an hour, turning once, until very soft. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slit side of each chile from top to bottom. Place chiles on the baking sheet, and bake them in the preheated oven 20 to 25 minutes, until firm and fragrant. Remove chiles from oven, and cut into rings with a serrated knife. Cook and stir pears in the duck fat that has accumulated over the top, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes. Mix pears into cream, and simmer about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in baking soda, until smooth. Pour cream into a bowl, and stir in confectioners' sugar until well blended. Continue cooking about 5 minutes longer, until thickened. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,almond essence,pineapple ring,couscous,demerara sugar,plain yogurt,cayenne pepper
title: Tandoori Pineapple Couscous With Cheese and Almonds
ingredients: 300 g couscous | 150 g unsalted plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons ground almonds, plus a pinch of extra | almond essence | 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 -3 canned pineapple rings, drained and halved lengthways
instructions: Place couscous in a large heatproof bowl and pour hot water over. Gently cover and set aside at room temperature for 20=30 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed. Meanwhile, whisk the yogurt, ground almonds, coriander, cayenne and half of the spice powder, until smooth. Set aside. Heat a large frying pan over a medium heat and add the pineapple in the yoghurt mixture, then cook for a few minutes, stirring, until the pineapples are warm. Tip half of the pineapples into a large bowl. Stir the rest of the spice, pineapples and any excess yoghurt mixture into the couscous. Serve and crumble the remaining pineapples onto the top.

title: Harry's No Crust Strawberry Ice Cream
ingredients: 6 pints fresh strawberries, hulled and rinsed | 2 packets vanilla beans | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place rinsed strawberries in a small bowl and set aside 30 minutes to plump up. Remove vanilla pods from vanilla pods and discard pods. Place raspberries in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with sugar to taste. Roll graham cracker crumbs into a log about the size of the strawberries, then place on top. Roll cranberries around the log until smooth and evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate in a cool area for 2 hours.

title: Moroccan Wine
ingredients: 2 pints merlot ( or other fruity white wine ) | coarse ground cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine 4 cups merlot and sugar in a pot with 1 to 1 1/2 cups water. Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves. Increase heat to medium high and bring mixture to a boil. Turn heat off, but skim the froth from the top. Cover tightly and let sit for 1 hr, stirring once. Remove cover, taste for sweetness.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,cheddar cheese,vermicelli,salt black pepper,tomato basil pasta sauce
title: Golabki (Mock Swiss Steak Noodle)
ingredients: 1/2 pound medium fresh vermicelli, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/4 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper | 1 jar tomato and basil pasta sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,hot paprika,anchovy,cherry tomato,lettuce leaf,yellow pepper
title: Rigatoni With Peppers and Anchovies
ingredients: 300 g linguigi pasta, freshly cooked | 2 tablespoons hot paprika | 100 -180 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 yellow pepper, deseeded and sliced | 1/2 cup red lettuce leaf, torn | 1 anchovy, sliced
instructions: Preheat the grill. Place the pasta on a baking tray. Lightly brush with the oil. Sprinkle the paprika on to the pasta and bake in a hot oven until heated through. Scatter the cherry tomatoes and red pepper on top of the pasta. Scatter the anchovy pieces over the pasta and serve. Note, to toast anchovies, heat a non stick frying pan over a low heat until warm. Using a metal slotted spoon, quickly shallow fry the anchovies in oil for about 3 mins each side or until they turn pink.

title: Homemade Creamy Frosting
ingredients: 1/2 cup pure vanilla ( see note above ) | 1 1/2 cups water | vanilla stick ( optional )
instructions: Place ingredients in a heavy duty airtight container, and mix well as making your frosting. When all desired frosting is used, make sure the mixture is smooth by using a hand held mixer with high blade. If necessary, frost cooled frosting either by stirring with a spoon or with a standing mixer in a bowl. Frosting will be light and fluffy and glossy.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,red onion,onion salt,cream tartar,portobello mushroom,garlic salt
title: Coconut Mushroom and Onions
ingredients: 3 cups coconut milk | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar | 15 -25 large portobello mushrooms, cleaned and sliced | 1 teaspoon dried onion salt | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 large sweet onion
instructions: Warm coconut milk in a large skillet over medium high heat for a few seconds. When this starts to scald, stir in cream of tartar and then add the diced onion. Continue to fry the onion and mushroom until onions are translucent. Add salt or garlic salt to taste. Add in the portobello mushrooms. Lower heat to medium. When mixture is thick, remove from heat. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Serve. If desired, you can also add a little bit of sifted powdered sugar and red pepper flakes.

Random Ingredients: marsala,chili oil,red onion,serrano chilies,cream tartar,olive,cilantro leaf
title: Sherry Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red onions, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons serrano chilies, canned, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dry marsala | 2 tablespoons black olives, finely chopped or 3/4 cup chopped kalamata olive ( to garnish ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, snipped ( to garnish ) or 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat. Cook, stirring and watching mixture, until it thickens. Serve hot. Note, alternatively, you can buy a bottle of jellied olives in your local mexican grocery store. To serve, top with toasted sliced pita, grilled steak, egg, pico de gallo, etc.

title: Black-Olive Spread
ingredients: 1 cup pitted black olives, or more to taste | 3 cups half-and-half
instructions: Mash olives with a fork and mix in half and half.

title: Tangerine and Sweet Potato Stacks
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers | 1/2 cup chopped tangerine ( optional ) | 1/4 cup honey | 1/2 cup orange flavored water ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 2 large sweet potatoes, halved and diced | 24 taco shells
instructions: Wash ladyfingers and dry with paper towels. Place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine tangerine, honey, oil, oyster sauce and cherry tomatoes and stir. Split up each ladyfinger lengthwise and put 2 or 3 on each, depending on the size of the ladyfingers. Dredge the ladyfingers in the mixture and refrigerate. Heat a nonstick skillet on medium high heat. Lightly spray with cooking oil. Add the uncooked portions of the sweet potato and stir fry. Sprinkle with chopped sun dried tomatoes. Top with the reserved taco shells. Remove from heat and cool a few minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Ginger Cookies (Yukgae Gee)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 2 lbs green ginger, peeled, finely minced | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Mix the flour, vanilla, and ginger until just blended using a knife. If too dry add more water. If too dry add more flour. Let mixture stand for 30 minutes. Roll dough thin on a floured surface, place the dough on the cutting board and cut into desired shapes. Place on greased cookie sheets and brush with melted butter. Bake at 350f for 16 minutes.

title: Grandma's Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 2 pounds italian tomatoes, peeled, seeded and diced | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups fresh fruit, diced ( to taste )
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of the tomatoes and grand marnier in a large bowl, or jar, and mash the tomato slices until they're coarsely chopped. Add remaining 1/4 cup of diced tomatoes and grand marnier, and mix in salt, msg, and optional sweetener. Cover pan, and refrigerate for 4 to 7 hours, stirring a couple of times. Slightly bruise fresh fruit with a fork, and add to sauce. Cover and cook over high heat until boiling.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,cream cheese,mustard,red wine vinegar,table salt,swiss chard
title: Swiss Chard Roll
ingredients: 4 swiss chard | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons low-sodium mustard | 3 tablespoons fat free cream cheese, softened | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/8 teaspoon table salt
instructions: Snap off the stem and top of the chard stems without tearing the leaf very much. Set aside. Cut away the stems from the leaves, if necessary. Slice chard crosswise. Combine chard leaves, vinegar, mustard, cream cheese, sugar and salt in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and shake well for about 10 seconds. Drain the chard well, but reserve the vinegar. Rinse with cold water to remove excess sand. Place the chard in a large serving bowl. With the back of a spoon, press out excess moisture. Sprinkle the chard slices with the red wine vinegar mixture, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate in a warm place for about 30 minutes. With toothpicks, carefully remove the outer plastic wrap and discard. Wrap the chard slices around the cheese and roll them gently with a metal spoon or rubber spatula. Serve.

title: Yellow Posole Stew
ingredients: 2 cans yellow hominy | 6 cans pineapple juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 package uncooked spaghetti
instructions: Combine the yellow hominy, pineapple juice, and allspice in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer at least 15 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add spaghetti, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,sea salt,bean sprout,flax seed meal
title: Healthy Rice Crust
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice or 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice ( 2 1/2 cups ) | 1 teaspoon flax seed meal | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 65 g bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees celsius. Place rice and flax meal in a medium sized ovenproof saucepan. Sprinkle over sea salt. Then cover and leave in the oven for 10 minutes until the grains are just soft. Take the saucepan out and stir in the sprouts. Allow to cool. Dump rice mixture in and put back in oven for 45 - 50 minutes, until warm and golden.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,french onion soup,yellow squash,vegetable broth
title: French Onion Shrimp & Squash
ingredients: 750 g raw large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 yellow squash, sliced | 1 box french onion soup, au jus | 1 cup vegetable broth
instructions: In a medium saucepan, cook shrimp with yellow squash over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until pink, stirring all the time. Add french onion soup and stir to mix well. Stir in broth and heat through. Serve sprinkled with fresh cracked pepper.

Random Ingredients: white flour,cream mushroom soup,rice,asiago cheese,fig,fennel seed,gingerroot
title: Figs in Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 4 -6 fresh figs | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup asiago cheese | 1 teaspoon white flour | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 cups hot cooked rice
instructions: Filling, boil figs in salted water until soft. Drain and chop. Strain juice. Add gingerroot, cheese, flour and fennel seeds. In blender add cream of mushroom soup and simmer 10 minutes. Then add cooked rice.

title: Yemeni Spiced Salt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon green cardamom pods | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac ( optional )
instructions: Crush the cardamom pods using a mortar and pestle or a coffee grinder. Crush the cardamom pods and transfer to a small bowl. Stir in the sumac and stir well. Cool. Sprinkle over the meat of your choice before serving.

title: Tortilla
ingredients: 1/2 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 3 pounds boneless lamb shoulder, cubed | 1 can crushed mussels, drained | kosher salt to taste
instructions: Mix taco seasoning mix, mace, and cayenne together in a bowl. Add meat.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,feta cheese,sea salt,sauce,bouillon,strawberry,romaine lettuce,mozzarella cheese
title: Bouillon Fried Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | sea salt | 1 teaspoon ground flaked sea salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground flaked flaked sea salt | 10 -12 boursin cheese or 10 -12 stromaine lettuce | 8 -10 strawberries, sliced | 8 -10 slices mozzarella cheese | 1 bottle hot sauce or ( 10 ounce ) bottle your favorite bouillon | 1 head romaine lettuce, separated ( to serve )
instructions: Place chicken breasts between 2 pieces of waxed paper and pound lightly to flatten slightly. Sprinkle sea salt, flaked sea salt and flaked flaked sea salt onto chicken. In a small bowl combine boursin cheese or stromaine lettuce and toss well.

title: Spice Bread - Spicy Bread
ingredients: 3 italian bread | 2 teaspoons hot spice | 1 teaspoon red capsicum, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 2 teaspoons italian spices or 2 teaspoons curry | 1 tablespoon chili oil or 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Cut bread into quarters lengthways, cutting away crusts. Split the bread lengthways into 4 slices. Divide capsicum and spices between them, stir fry bread over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, turning once, or until bread is crisp and capsicum is crisp cooked. Drizzle with oil or soy sauce. Serve warm.

title: Spicy Cheese on Toast
ingredients: 1 package mexican cheese | 6 slices fresh bread | 2 teaspoons lime peel | 4 slices serrano chilies | lettuce leaf, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine cheese, bread and lime peel in a small bowl. Spread cheese mixture onto 6 slices of bread. Place chiles in the center of each cheese slice. Dip sandwiches in cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,celery rib,mango,lasagna noodle,king prawn,chicken breast strip,heavy cream
title: Chicken and Mango Lasagna
ingredients: 10 large lasagna noodles | 1 mango, peeled ( medium size cut in half ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 chicken breast strip | 1 small celery rib, chopped | 1 pint heavy cream | 500 g cooked king prawns ( chopped very small )
instructions: Chop mango and celery if using chop into bite sized pieces. Heat vegetable oil in a large frypan. Chop the chicken strips into small 3cm pieces if you want, or alternatively add it to the pan in another way. Add the mango, celery, chicken strips and cream to the pan and bring to the boil. Simmer about 10 minutes or until sauce has reduced. Remove from heat. Using tongs, dip a large spoonful of the sauce in the munged sauce into the mrawns. Transfer into a 13x9 x2 casserole dish. Repeat with the remaining sauce and mousses. Cover with foil and bake at c for approx 75 minutes or until the pasta is tender.

title: Tea With Celery & Tahini
ingredients: 3 stalks celery, with leaves, ends trimmed | 3 -4 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 3 dashes chili paste | 3/4 cup brewed teabags or 3 tea cups
instructions: Cut off the ends of the celery at the root end.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,lime,cardamom pod,amchur,soda cracker,red chile,rice wine,gemelli pasta
title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 12 small yellow bell peppers, halved and seeded | 2 teaspoons crushed amchur | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 6 cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons dry soda crackers | 1 red chile, chopped | 2 tablespoons dry rice wine | 2 cups fine grated gemelli pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees fahrenheit. Combine the amchur, lime juice, crushed cardamom pods, soda crackers, red chili and rice wine in a bowl. Set aside. Set peppers halves, and remove the seeds and membrane inside. Insert pepper halves cut side down onto a metal baking sheet. Pour half the lime marinade over the top. Roast for 35 - 45 minutes, until tender. Top each pepper with the remaining marinade and top with remaining crackers before serving. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,caster sugar,chicken vegetable are,french,saffron,red wine
title: French Rice and Saffron Rice
ingredients: 200 g long grain rice, washed | 250 g chicken and vegetable ( drained and rinsed of excess water ) | 500 ml red wine ( optional ) | 450 g french rolls, cut on the diagonal into 4 - 6 slices each ( french bread rolls may be substituted if preferred ) | 1/2 of a saffron ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar ( to sprinkle between each slice of bread ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice in a large pan, along with the chicken, vegetables and saffron, and pour water to just below the level of the rice at a height of no more than 2 inches over the rice. Bring to the boil, cover and reduce heat. Simmer until all the water has been absorbed, about 45 minutes. Remove the lid and sprinkle with caster sugar, if desired. Allow to stand, covered for 5 minutes before serving. Variation,. Instead of saffron, you may substitute with 1 tbs cinnamon instead of pulverized. Rice may also be used as an accompaniment to pasta, meat, salads and soups.

title: Simple Cazuela Con Pasta
ingredients: 1 package uncooked spaghetti | 1/2 cup freshly chopped white onion | chopped fresh chervil ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped toasted nuts ( toasted peanuts, toasted almonds, pistachios, black almonds, or hazelnuts )
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package.

title: Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cups buttermilk | 1 package rice noodles
instructions: In a large pot cover noodles with lightly salted water and let sit for about an hour. Drain. Using a colander put the noodles in the colander and let them drain the residual water. When the noodles are cool, mix together the buttermilk and rice noodles and set aside. Return the noodles to the pot and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until all the noodle mixture has the ingredients mimply coated in the buttermilk mixture. Turn down to a simmer and cover. When the soup begins to bubble, remove lid, add salt if needed and serve.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,sun tomato,kiwi fruit,gruyere cheese,turnip,tabasco sauce,ketchup,mint sprig
title: Grilled Kiwi and Turnip Grilled Cheese Wedges
