ingredients: 1 kiwi fruit, peeled, quartered, and sliced | 1 small turnip, peeled, quartered, and sliced | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 sun-dried tomato | 1 ounce gruyere cheese, shaved, such as cheddar | 4 ounces taco sauce | 4 tablespoons ketchup, for brushing | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint sprigs
instructions: To prepare the fruit, arrange the kiwifruit and turnip on a grill rack over medium high heat, brush with a little olive oil and grill, turning, until golden brown, 5 - 7 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board, chop fine, and transfer to a bowl. Cut the sun dried tomatoes into thin slices. To assemble the grilled cheese, divide the cheese evenly between 2 serving plates. Top with the salad of kiwifruit and tomato, then drizzle with taco sauce and ketchup. Sprinkle with mint, and serve.

title: Pelon de Asafeta (Poblano Cheese)
ingredients: 1 lb ham, minced | 1 poblano pepper, minced | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. You can use a food processor to speed things up. I use a food processor because i like the taste of the peppers. Use as much or little water as necessary to make sure the mixture is not watery.

title: Yorkshire Mashed Potato Wedges
ingredients: 4 ounces of good bacon fat, trimmed | 1/4 cup bacon drippings or 1/4 cup low stick butter | 16 ounces of good size kumara | 2 chipotle chiles | 1/2 teaspoon dried currants
instructions: Put the bacon grease or butter in a non stick frying pan/skillet and put slowly over low heat. When it starts to get to sizzling, add the kumara and stir in a little the bacon juice, as it may not be enough. Turn off the heat and add the chipotle chiles and the dried currants. Cover the frying pan/skillet with a lid or foil and set aside to marinate for at least 1 hour or up to overnight. When ready to cook, put the hash in a warm oven to keep warm. When the hash has become slightly crispy, remove it from the oven and place it on a kitchen towel if there isn't quite enough moisture. When finished, place the hot hash in a paper sack, twisting it closed on itself and put it back onto the hob. The potato should still be slightly soft in the middle when you remove it from the pan. This will help melt the bacon grease. Once it is brown, remove it to a bowl, drain the fat from the pan. Return the pan to a medium heat, add the margarine or dripping and the bacon and bubble it briskly on a fairly low heat until it has become a smooth sauce consistency. Keep doing this until the potatoes have nice thickness. Turn off the heat. The grease from grilling the potato will be very hot and you will have to press a piece of potato with a wooden spoon into the sauce to loosen it. It should stick together. Serve alongside the potato wedges.

title: E-Z  - Shrimp With  White Bean, Shrimp Etc...
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 can white beans | 1 cup ice cube
instructions: Shell & rinse the shrimp. Remove tails from shrimp & discard. Devein. Rinse beans. Drain shrimp & rinse in cold water. Put water in a med. Bowl or bowl on your table with shrimp & beans covered in it. Let the shrimp & beans boil while you are steaming your rice. Once a couple of minutes' time, put the shrimp & beans in under your rice & stir. Add the ice cube & stir. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Spanish Spanish  Beet Salsa  -  Ovarada
ingredients: 4 english muffins, sliced | 4 ripe beets | 2 teaspoons gelatin | 3 ounces tomato sauce | 3 teaspoons pimiento, chopped | 6 tablespoons shredded coconut | 2 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Place the english muffin on a plate and lightly toast with grill lid removed, or until toasted. Cut the beets in half and remove all of the root and the top but leave just a stem in the beet. Slice them into 1/4 inch pieces. Place the slices in a saucepan and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to the boil over high heat and then reduce the heat to low and cook until very tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain. When finished, the beets should be very tender. Drain in a clean dish towel. Let cool slightly, then slip off the skins. Cut the beet skin away from the beet, leaving the beets in the beetroot pieces. Cut the beetroot into 1 inch chunks and remove the seeds, including the stem. Rinse and then grate them into a large bowl. Place the drained beetroot, chopped beets, gelatin, tomato sauce, pimentos and coconut in a small saucepan bring to the boil over medium heat and stir until the gelatin has dissolved. Pour over the beet root mixture, and stir together until combined. Serve warm, or refrigerate for up to 2 days. Serve warm or cold with tortilla chips or fresh french breads.

title: Baked Beef Strips--Tokyo Style
ingredients: 2 tablespoons saké gogi ( japanese seasoned salt ) | 1 1/4 lbs sirloin, cut in strips about 1/4-inch x 2 1/4 inches, about 1 cup, very thinly sliced
instructions: Mix the salt together. Place strips in a large, sealable plastic bag with approximately 2 inches of space each. Pour 2 cups of water into the bag, make sure the salt is submerged, and seal. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f. Remove the salt from the chilled bag and arrange the strips in a single layer on a rack in a baking pan. Bake, uncovered for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the strips are deeply and evenly browned. Note, if you wish, broil the strips 4 - 5 inches from the heat for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, or until the beef is cooked to your desired degree of doneness.

title: Confetti Calrose
ingredients: 1 cup calrose rice, uncooked | 12 large cabbage leaves, shredded | 8/10 cup picante sauce
instructions: Cook rice, in a medium skillet, heat picante sauce, approximately 3 or 4 cups of water, stirring until mixture reaches a boil. Cook, covered, over low heat for 15 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Serve as is or topped with any mexi or any other toppings desired.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,thai fish sauce,pomegranate juice,green chili sauce,ice cube
title: Teddy's Favourite Thai Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, cut into 2-inch pieces | 7 tablespoons pomegranate juice | 2 tablespoons thai green chili sauce ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons thai fish sauce ( optional ) | 4 cups ice cubes, more as needed
instructions: Pour the potatoes into a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until tender, about 20 to 25 minutes. Drain and cool. When cool enough, slice potatoes into 1/4 inch slices. Transfer 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice into a small bowl and set aside. Stir remaining pomegranate juice, chili sauce, fish sauce and 1 tablespoon of water into potato slices and set aside. To serve, divide potato salad among 4 serving bowls. Top with potato slices, drizzle with reserved sauce, remaining pomegranate juice, and sprinkle with more chili sauce.

title: Cheddar Spread With Parsley & Shallots
ingredients: 10 ounces old cheddar cheese, grated ( about 3 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons sweet onions, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced ( italian or french parsley ) | 1 -2 tablespoon parsley, minced ( italian parsley ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 2 -3 tablespoons applesauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Cover & chill until ready to serve at least 1 hours. Serve with crackers. Serve w/ crackers.

title: White Posset of Easy Orange and Tomato Poffards
ingredients: 3 oranges, peeled, segments removed, sliced and then quartered crossways | 1 1/4 cups double cream | 1/2 - 3/4 cup tomato puree or 1/2-3/4 cup jam, eg al dente
instructions: Pour the cream into a bowl. Place the orange and cream in an emulsioniser or mini food processor. When the cream has been thoroughly mixed with the orange and cream, strain the mixture through a fine sieve, removing as much as possible of the orange and cream as possible. Reserve the orange and cream portions and set the orange and cream aside. Heat up a heavy based saucepan. Add the orange and cream mixture to small batches of orange blossom test. Use tongs to push oranges and cream through to prevent sticking. Continue cooking until the mixture will turn glossy and set. When all the ingredients are warm, stir in a little tomato purée. Pour the mixture, including the reserved orange and cream, onto to two dessert plates. Garnish with orange zest. If serving immediately, cover and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,margarine,radish,lamb shoulder,almond,hard egg,fennel seed,ladyfinger
title: Lamb Stuffed With Fennel Egg
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs lamb shoulder | 1 can whole blanched almonds ( reserve a couple of tablespoons of slivered almonds ) | 3 hard-boiled eggs ( sliced thin, reserve a few of peeled ) | 6 ounces margarine, melted ( save a couple of tbsp of oil ) | 2 tablespoons ground fennel seed | 1 package ladyfingers | 1 lb monterey jack cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Cut off tail of lamb and discard top of each half leaving one inch in each half. With tip of knife make cuts across fat lengthwise on each half. Do this with the hard boiled eggs then discard tips. Fill lamb cavities with the slivered almonds, hard boiled eggs, melted margarine and, if using the fronds from one of the sliced olives, with the fennel seed. Dribble cheese over the top. Place stuffed lamb onto a rack in casserole, sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake covered 1 hour or until meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,nicoise olive,italian plum tomato,apple cider,soy yogurt
title: Vegan Greek Pizza
ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy yogurt ( plain yogurt works too ) | 1 tablespoon apple cider | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 bag nicoise olives ( i like to use kalamata brand )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all ingredients until well combined. Pour the mixture into a casserole dish. Cut nicoise olives into strips and arrange around the pizza and topping with olives. Bake at 350 f for 10 - 12 minutes or until it's bubbly.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,yellow bell pepper,tender spinach leaf,flour,italian seasoning,tea,enchilada sauce,yeast
title: Italian Seasoned Bean Snack
ingredients: 5 cups fresh loose-leaf tender spinach leaves | 1 1/4 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 small yellow bell pepper, seeded, and grated ( about 1/3 cup ) | 1 tablespoon anise seed, crushed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/2 cup strong brewed tea | 1 jar prepared enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Place the dried yeast in one large, nonreactive bowl. In a second bowl, rinse the spinach and squeeze out excess moisture.

title: Napa Dave's Chicken Salad
ingredients: 8 medium chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup honey | 3 chipotle chiles in adobo, chopped | 1 1/3 cups shredded peeled jicama | 1/4 cup chopped beets
instructions: Rinse chicken, and pat dry with paper towels. Place chicken on a baking dish, and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 to 35 minutes, or until juices run clear. Allow cool slightly. Dice chicken, and toss with chipotle and jicama. Drizzle with honey, and sprinkle with chipotle.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,thai fish sauce,chicken bouillon granule
title: Simple Microwave Thai Chicken Mix
ingredients: 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce, or to taste
instructions: Mix Italian style salad dressing mix, chicken bouillon granules, and fish sauce together in a microwave safe bowl. Cook in the microwave on high until the mixture boils, about 1 minute. Cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.

title: Mashed Potatoes in Coconut Milk
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mustard | 6 new potatoes, washed and sliced into rounds | 4 tablespoons coconut milk | 2 gherkins, slit lengthways for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c or gas lightly grease a baking tray with a little oil. Place the mustard into a bowl and add all the potatoes. Mix well. Place in the oven and bake for 45 minutes or until cooked.

title: Roasted Chiles and Poblanos
ingredients: 3 -4 fresh poblano chile or 3 -4 serrano chilies | chopped fresh cilantro, coriander or flat leaf parsley, to taste
instructions: Roast chiles directly over broiler or on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray, in 500f degrees oven. Turning chiles occasionally, until blackened all over, 15 - 40 minutes or until skins blister. Transfer chiles to a bowl of ice water to cool. Peel chiles and discard charred ends and stem. Transfer peeled chiles and 1/4 cup salt to a blender or processor along with 1 1/2 cups water and puree.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,celery,sumac,meatball,chili pepper flake,bamboo skewer,sirloin steak,cream cheese
title: Beef and Bacon Stuffed Sirloin Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean sirloin steaks, very thinly sliced | 1/2 lb very thick-cut cream cheese | 1 package fresh precooked meatballs, cut in half ( you 'll need one ) | 1 1/2 lbs shredded mexican blend cheese ( or to taste ) or 1 1/2 lbs muenster cheese ( or to taste ) | 16 bamboo skewers, soaked in water | 1/2 cup pickled jalapenos with hot peppers or 1/2 cup chili pepper flakes, drained | 1/4 cup fresh sour cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 garlic or 1 garlic powder, withhed
instructions: Combine meat, one package cheese, softened cream cheese, meatballs, jalapenos, sour cream, and garlic powder. Mix well. Fill each roll with 2 slices of meat mixture. Top with remaining cheese. Grill, covered, over medium heat 4 to 6 minutes, basting occasionally with reserved marinade, until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees c, basting frequently with remaining marinade.

title: Pasta With Cherry, Cheese Croutons and Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked rotini pasta | 2 cups frozen cherries, thawed and juice squeezed out | 6 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 3 cups shredded, unpeeled whole wheat bread | ice cube
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rotini in boiling water for 3 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Quick French Toast
ingredients: 2 slices french bread | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons french syrup ( optional )
instructions: If making the french toast with corn syrup, dissolve the corn syrup in 1/2 cup warm water. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Dip the bread slices in the syrup until well coated both sides. Cook bread until golden brown on both sides, 4 - 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,pear,egg substitute,beef oxtail,clear honey,lime,mirin,golden syrup
title: Bun-Gung-Kun (Chicken Fried Sticks)
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings, tips removed | 1 lb beef oxtail or 1 lb beef round steak | 1 cup egg substitute | 1 cup pear slices ( fresh or canned ) | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Combine ingredients, except chicken wings, in medium sized pot over med high, bring to just above boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer slowly for at least one hour. Remove from pot, cool slightly, and cut chicken into 3/4 inch strips. Using 2 forks, hold chicken and beef strips in your hand, pull out any remaining fat and discard. Place in lightly oiled bowl, and stir fry. Remove and drain on paper towels. Serve with sambal oelek. Sambal oelek, in small saucepan over med high, combine all ingredients and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened and reduced to about ½ cup.

title: Spiced Whole Wheat Chapati
ingredients: 200 g whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1 scottish sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Put the flour, sugar, thyme and chili sauce in a bowl and with a fork mix by hand until you have a soft dough. Spray a non stick frying pan with cooking spray and put in 3/4 cup capacity of water. Turn heat to medium and roll the dough out to about 1 inch thickness. Turn the dough over as you make small indentations and allow to rest on the surface of the pancake. Cook the pancake on one side, then repeat with the other half of the dough. Remove from pan and roll out into a round. Brush a small, non stick frying pan with oil and put in another handful of dough. Cook on the first side for 3 minutes, turn, reduce heat to low and cook for another 3 minutes. You want the dough to be quite dry, so you need to stir it occasionally while cooking so you get the right texture for the dough. Serve the chapati with cream or yoghurt.

title: Shrimp Coconut (Pumpkin) Dip
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked medium shrimp | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 cup light cream of coconut
instructions: Peel shrimp and devein. Add shrimp and pumpkin to small bowl, mixing well. Add cream of coconut to pineapple puree, stirring until smooth. Chill.

title: Pesto Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 2 medium carrots, peeled | 2 medium green capsicums | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( the store bought kind is very good ) or 1 tb basil and 1 tb basil pestil
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c. Use a baking tumbler, or a sharp carving knife to slice the carrots into large sticks about one centimetre across. If using a food processor, mince them if you wish, or blitz them through the food machine until finely grated. Put the carrots, capsicum and pesto/basil or basil into an ovenproof dish, then scatter over your vegetables. Drizzle over half olive oil or water and mix to coat. Cook in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and have turned golden in texture.

title: Larb Gook
ingredients: 2 pieces lemongrass ( cut into 3 inch lengths ), finely chopped | 1 lamb shoulder | 2 teaspoons minced pork fat ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and cook over very low heat for 1 hour or until tender. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,white pepper,brie cheese,apple
title: Queso Blanco
ingredients: 12 -13 firm fresh apples, peeled and quartered | 1 whole hot green chili pepper, seeded and minced | 4 ounces firm brie cheese, cut crosswise into 12 wedges | fresh ground white pepper
instructions: Place the apples in a large bowl. Mash them slightly using your fingers and add the minced chili. Mash well, but not too much, and add just a touch of white pepper. Put the brie into 4 small serving dishes. Place the apples into bowls and pour the hot dressing on top. Sprinkle with fresh ground white pepper. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: date,honey,ranch salad dressing,red pepper,green peppercorn,spinach leaf,seasoning salt
title: Spinach Salad With Dates
ingredients: 4 ounces spinach leaves, chopped | 12 green peppercorns, washed and torn in half | 3 teaspoons green ranch salad dressing | 1 teaspoon dried dates | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the chopped up ingredients in a bowl. Stir in chopped up spinach leaves. Serve.

title: Country-Style Beef Ribs
ingredients: 4 thick beef rib bone | 12 medium beef chuck or 18 small other tender meat | pie crusts ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350°f in a roasting pan, or other large heavy bottomed pot that can be used on the stove top, heat all the ingredients over medium heat until meat is tender. Transfer meat to roasting pan/pot. Cover and bake for 2 hours, or until most of the liquid has evaporated. Bake uncovered for a least 15 additional hours, or until meat pulls apart easily with a fork.

title: Grpa's Ultimate Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 1 lb beef short ribs | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour ( for dredging ) | 1/4 cup fresh rosemary, chopped | 12 dates, pitted and chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 3/4 lb vermicelli rice noodles, broken in half | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Dredge short ribs in flour.

title: Pineapple Raisins and Pineapple Wine
ingredients: 15 ounces crushed pineapple, drained | 1 1/2 cups red wine ( i use cabernet sauvignon ) | 2 tablespoons gold raisins, soaked in hot water for a few minutes, then drained | ground nutmeg
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, crush the pineapple, raisins, and nutmeg up until a slurry.

title: St. Louis Fried Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1 lb fresh gorgonzola, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 8 fresh sage leaves | 3 tablespoons fresh cajun seasoning ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Gently toss the gorgonzola using a fork to mix. If you are making this in advance, cover and refrigerate the cheese for up to 2 days. Place bread crumbs in a small bowl. Add sage leaves, cajun seasoning, turmeric, paprika and 1/2 tsp salt. Toss to coat. Add 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper.

title: Homemade Portuguese Omelette for the Grill
ingredients: 4 egg whites, with whites | 1/4 cup red onions, minced, including tops | 8 teaspoons commercial portuguese-style omelette with onions and roasted red peppers ( available at portuguese food section of store )
instructions: If your cheese has come into contact with regular cheese it will be easier to break than with regular omelette. Start heating a griddle or large frying pan on medium low heat.. Place egg whites in bowl of processor. Add onions and 1 teaspoons each of salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,ice cream,russet potato,fig,adobo seasoning,beef eye,ginger garlic paste,mozzarella cheese
title: Cotton Sack Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef eye round | 4 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 tablespoons ketchup | 6 russet potatoes, peeled | 1 loaf mozzarella cheese, cut into small squares | 1 pint ice cream | 12 -14 fresh figs, washed, quartered
instructions: Marinate the beef with 3 tablespoons of adobo and 3 tablespoons of ginger garlic paste for 1 hour. Put in the refrigerator, and let it sit out overnight. The following day, cut the potatoes into 3/4 dice, and boil until very tender. Remove from heat. In a medium mixing bowl, with a mixer, mix together the ketchup, potatoes, mozzarella cheese and ice cream. Stir into the potato mixture. Add the figs and the remaining 3 tablespoons of marinating adobo and ginger garlic pastes. Toss until well mixed. Pour mixture into the corning ware, and close the lid. Let it sit out overnight in a cool place.

title: Italian Orzo Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 1/2 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions and drain. Place peas in a large bowl. Add orzo, dressing, and guacamole.

title: Easy Egyptian Delight
ingredients: 1 can fava beans ( or 4oz can peas if preferred ) | 1 tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 head of cabbage, chopped finely | 1 boneless chicken | 2 cups yogurt ( plain or sweet ) | 4 cups ice cream
instructions: In crock pot, dump fava beans, add tomato and cabbage, add chicken, cover and cook on high for 6 hours, then switch to low and cook for 2 hours. If you like a chunkier dish, add yogurt and stir until smooth. Note, this dish can be eaten cold or warmed up right when finished.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,bourbon,pizza sauce,vegetable broth,cocoa,cilantro stem,oregano leaf,seasoning
title: Mexi-Rice Pizza
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1/2 cup brown rice or 1/2 cup brown rice bran | 1 1/2 cups commercial ready-to-serve pizza sauce ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons bourbon ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic paste or 1 tablespoon chopped canned chili pepper paste | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems ( coriander leaves, 2-3 tablespoons chopped ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | seasoning, to taste | shredded cheddar cheese or monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a medium saucepan, stir broth, rice, if using, sauce and bourbon or rum.

Random Ingredients: golden mushroom soup,hazelnut,vodka,raspberry jell o gelatin,mint leaf
title: E-Zi-Ya(Russian Nuts) from Sharon's Reciepe #RSC
ingredients: 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 package raspberries jell-o gelatin | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | mint leaf ( optional )
instructions: Mix soups with chocolate sauce in a pan over medium heat. Let the chocolate melt, making sure it mixes well. While this is cooling down, mix jell o with hazelnuts and set aside. Mix contents of pan with the chocolate mixture until well mixed. This is easier if it is a little warm so you can stir it until all the ingredients are well incorporated together. Spoon into 3 cup sized casseroles and top with a little bit of mint. I usually add a couple of hazelnuts and some chocolate shavings to the top of the jell o. Chill in the refrigerator at least an hour before serving. Enjoy.

title: Chickpea and Kaffir Lime Salad (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 20 ounces kale | 6 ounces mexican lime slices
instructions: Drain chickpeas and rinse. Heat oil, kaffir lime leaves in medium size non reactive skillet over medium heat. Stir until hot but not brown. Add chickpeas, kaffir lime leaves and kale. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer until thickened, but still slightly chewy, 10 to 12 minutes. Toss salad with sour cream and serve warm.

title: Baked Watermelon Kimchee
ingredients: 2 cups sliced watermelon | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 3 cups shredded cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare a large, deep baking dish with cooking spray. Spread watermelon onto the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Cover with chopped onions and shredded cabbage. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in a preheated oven for 35 minutes. Remove foil, and bake for 30 minutes more, or until hot and crusty.

title: Calypso Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch scallion, leaves only, very finely chopped | 2 cans diced green chilies | 3/4 cup red snipped green chilies
instructions: Combine scallions, chilies and snipped green chile in a food processor.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,cherry tomato,garlic granule,salmon fillet,corn oil
title: Beef and Salmon Fillet Saute
ingredients: 800 g salmon fillets, cut into thick fillets | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules or 1/2 teaspoon granulated garlic | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 150 m cherry tomatoes or 150 g grape tomatoes | 400 g sliced beef steak
instructions: Place fish, garlic granules, oil and tomatoes in a shallow dish, toss to coat. Turn chicken and marinate in marinade for 20 minutes, turn fillets twice or three times. Grill or oven cook until fish is cooked and flakes easily when gently with a fork.

title: Cardamom Mascarpone Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups mascarpone cheese | 1 medium red onion, medium diced ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 cup ripe pitted ripe olives, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a food processor or blender, process cheese until smooth. Add onion, olives, and cardamom.

title: Pasta Mushroom-Shish Kugel
ingredients: 12 ounces tri-colored rotini pasta | 2 1/2 cups asiago cheese, coarsely shredded | 3 tablespoons gin | 2 tablespoons whiskey | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 8 shiitake mushrooms, sliced
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the rotini pasta until al dente. Drain and keep warm. Drain the cooked pasta again. In a bowl, stir together the shredded asiago cheese, gin, whiskey, and confectioners' sugar. Toss with hot pasta until well coated.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,tomato sauce,teriyaki sauce,sesame seed,hot chili pepper
title: Spicy Sesame Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/3 cup red currant jelly | 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, finely chopped
instructions: Combine teriyaki, redcurrant jelly, tomato sauce, and chili peppers in small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and place sesame seeds in a shallow bowl.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,vanilla bean,baby pea,chinese cabbage,corn flour,italian parsley
title: Baby Pea Puffs - Giada De Laurentiis
ingredients: 400 g baby peas | 200 g chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon corn flour | 200 g monterey jack cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla beans | 1 tablespoon chopped chinese parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325f/180c. Boil the peas until they are clear and cooked. Stir in the cabbage, heat through and mix with a spoon into small cubes. Add the vanilla bean. Mix to coat. Add the cheese and salt and pepper. Mix the corn flour with 1 1/2 cups cold water. Add to the soup and stir. Divide between small ramekins. Sprinkle chinese parsley on top. Bake till crisp.

Random Ingredients: coriander,lemon juice,taco sauce,white flour,pork shoulder,elbow macaroni,tortellini pasta
title: Macaroni With Pork and Tortellini
ingredients: 3 cups elbow macaroni | 1 medium pork shoulder | 8 -10 tablespoons white flour | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 0.5 bottle taco sauce | 2 cups taco sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. While that cooks, trim fat from meat or shred. Bring large pot of water to boil with salt. Add macaroni. Cook until cooked through stirring occasionally. Drain. Set aside. Cut pork into bit size pieces. Cook over medium heat in a 2 - 4 quart sauce pan. In a bowl, combine pork, taco sauce, lemon juice, corriander and cook over medium heat. Stirring often until hot. Add pasta to pork mixture. Combine and serve on warm plates.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,chocolate chip,bamboo shoot,red cabbage,pizza dough,cointreau liqueur
title: Passional Slice
ingredients: 1 pizza dough, ready made | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 cup chocolate chip | 400 g canned bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 small red cabbage, finely shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 190° celsius roll out dough onto a flat surface. Spread the cointreau over the base of the dough, leaving 3mm or less around the edge. Combine the chili powder, chocolate chips and bamboo and spread generously over the crust. Lay the red cabbage over the chocolate mix and top with the remaining dough. Score with a knife. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes.

title: Tofu
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu or packages tofu | 1 chicken ( optional ) | 1 package chopped spinach leaves, i use frozen | 1 package fresh spinach leaves, i use frozen, chopped spinach is usually cut up with scissors, if i do not have fresh cut up use 3 4 leaves each, i just use 2 sheets, they cook the spinach | lemon juice | pistachios ( to garnish ) or almonds ( to garnish )
instructions: Drain the tofu for about a minute before placing on the rack in the oven. It will release a lot of liquid and solidify as it cools. Slice the tofu into 1/4 inch thick pieces. Place back on the rack in a cookie sheet or large, preheated pan or a roasting pan and bake in a preheated oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Take into a bowl and break into chunks, removing all excess juices. Add the chicken, if using, to the tofu and stir to coat. Add the spinach, the spinach, spinach, spinach, pistachios, or almonds, mixing gently. Cook over low heat for about 15 minutes, stirring until spinach is wilted and chicken is heated through. You don't want to overcook it right now if you want to serve it hot, or warm it over low heat while it is warming.

title: Hot Pepperoni and Cream Sipper
ingredients: 250 g sliced pepperoni | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 120 double cream | 2 tablespoons caster sugar, for topping
instructions: Slice pepperoni on the diagonal into 1 1/4 inch slices then gently pat the pepperoni dry with kitchen paper. Combine chilli powder with cream and sugar in a small bowl. Spoon cream mixture into four 125ml ramekin dishes. Top each ramekin with a slice of pepperoni. Serve piping hot.

title: Lazy Baked Dove's Feet
ingredients: 25 -30 feet fresh gorund lovage | 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 - 2 1/2 cups prepared gravy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 °f. Wash the lovage thoroughly so that no dirt shows if it leaks out. Rinse the lovage under running water. Put into a pan with the gravy. If needed, add 1/4 cup water and simmer for 15 minutes. Cover and put in oven for 1 1/2 hours or more checking it should not go owder. When it gets thicker, turn on oven broiler and put the casserole in the broiler. Turn the birds every 10 minutes. Baking will take about 50 minutes to 1 hour. Check doneness after 2 hours. The longer it cooks in the gravy, the driier and more flavorful the gravy will be. When done, the driier the gravy will be. Don't open the oven until you are ready to eat it. The fumes from the gravy can irritate the bird, cause some to get burned. If it's burned, the bird will not be as flavorful.

title: Rice Won Tons
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1 1/3 cups white rice | dijon mustard
instructions: Combine the won ton wrappers and the rice in a large bowl. If you do this the rice in a larger bowl, just make sure it's a bit bigger then the wonton wrappers. Heat up a small nonstick skillet and add 1/4 tsp of dijon mustard to the pan on medium high heat. Place a small amount of the won ton wrapper in the skillet, allowing space for spreading the rice mixture onto the won tons, when they float to the top, it's done. Once the won tons have been covered, remove the won tons from the pan and place on a plate and top with additional mustard. Eat & enjoy.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,green bell pepper,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Mexican Shrimp and Grilled Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package jumbo shrimp, uncooked, peeled | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat grill to high. Toss shrimp, bell pepper and cheese with hot mixture. Serve warm with tortilla chips or tostados.

title: Easy Microwave Snapper
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 red snapper, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Wrap each piece of fish in plastic wrap, then microwave on high power for 5 to 7 minutes. Open plastic wrap.

title: Harry Potter's Buttermilk and Almond Jello
ingredients: 1 box refrigerated buttermilk biscuits ( such as keebler gold medal biscuits ) | 1 lemon, cut into thin wedges ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spray a cookie sheet with pan spray and set aside. Place biscuits in a large biscuit bowl. If using lemon wedge add it now. Spoon in the almond jell o coating each biscuit generously. If using lemon wedges, add now. If using apple or pearls, add now. If using any other flavor you like, use the lemon wedge to garnish. If using pears, add now. If using pearls, add now. If using other nuts, add now. When ready to fill, place one biscuit on a cookie sheet and spoon on 1/2 cup of the buttermilk mixture. Top with the second biscuit and drizzle the remaining buttermilk mixture over the top. Bake 15 minutes, or until golden and bubbly, depending on how you prefer your biscuits.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,feta cheese,garbanzo bean,orange zest,single cream,rye bread,chili pepper flake,gherkin
title: Gherkin and Feta Soup
ingredients: 6 tablespoons gherkin, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 4 fresh small chili peppers ( i've also used serrano chili ) | 2 cans garbanzo beans | 1/2 cup reduced-fat feta cheese | 1/2 cup single cream | 1 tablespoon tamarind juice
instructions: Heat the gherkin, chile and orange peel in a large saucepan over medium heat until aromatic. Add the chilli and sauté for 1 minute. Add the garbanzos, reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove the gelatine and blend into the broth. Add the cream and tamarind juice. Simmer for 2 minutes. Season and serve.

title: Tasty Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained & rinsed | 1 packet dry onion soup mix
instructions: Put everything in your food processor, and blend until smooth. Serve with crackers.

title: Lemongrass Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces medium egg noodles | 4 stalks lemongrass ( white part only )
instructions: Trim ends from lemongrass. Cut peel into 2 inch lengths and slice into thin slices. Place in pan with enough water to cover. Bring to boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop further cooking. Drain well. Meanwhile, cover saucepan with water. Bring to boil and then reduce heat and simmer noodles until barely tender and slightly firm, about 10 minutes. Drain noodles well and place back in pan. Toss well with remaining ingredients. Serve.

title: Strawberry and Cream Parfait
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs strawberries, hulled and halved ( may also use canned sliced strawberries ) | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Wash, dry and chop strawberries. Whip the cream until soft peaks form. Fold in strawberries and gently fold through. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen mixed vegetables | 1 1/4 lbs frozen green beans, thawed, and diced | 1 green pepper, diced | 1 can italian-style tomatoes, diced
instructions: Combine everything in a large salad bowl. Toss until evenly distributed. Cover and store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Serve cold. Enjoy.

title: Potato and Sourdough Crumble
ingredients: 1 slice sourdough bread | 1/4 cup potato starch | 1 packet consomme | 2 cups grated raw potatoes or 2 cups mashed potatoes | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley or 2 tablespoons dried parsley
instructions: Place sourdough bread slice in an oven proof dish. Combine potato starch, consomme and 1/2 cup of the potato water in a saucepan. Bring to the boil over medium heat. Mix potato or mashed potatoes into the hot starch mixture, adding more potato water if necessary to make a soft dough. Spread the batter over the bread slices, top with remaining potato or mashed potato. Cover with foil or wax paper and bake in preheated oven at 180c for about 1 hour or until crusty and golden. Sprinkle with parsley or dried parsley.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,chocolate chip,confectioner ' sugar,angostura bitter,wheat pastry flour,vanilla bean
title: Vanilla Bean-Vanilla Peppermint Truffle Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 1 1/3 cups confectioners'sugar | 3 tablespoons chocolate chips | 2 1/2 tablespoons pure vanilla bean | 5 fresh thyme sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon angostura bitters
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Sprinkle 1 1/3 cups of the confectioners sugar over 1 baking sheet. Set aside in a bowl. Place the remaining confectioners' sugar over the confectioners' sugar and stir until combined. Place the vanilla bean in another small bowl. Slice 1/4 inch off the root end of the vanilla bean, leaving it intact. Scrape the vanilla bean paste into the bowl with the confectioners' sugar. Break the vanilla bean into pieces and add to the bowl. Split 5 thyme sprigs and pour 1 tablespoon of the bitters into each of 4 small saucers, rotating the pan until the sprigs are well coated with dark pimentation. Roll the saucers into the bitters, then place them seam side down on the parchment paper. Scantly brush each sheet with some of the bitters. Place the baking sheet into the oven and roast for 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and brush the top of the truffle with the bitters. Return to the oven and bake for 12 minutes until truffles are bubbly and pale golden. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Escarole Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 -2 cup of cooked escargot
instructions: Pour all ingredients into the pot on the stove and put on medium heat until it starts to boil. Reduce heat, cover. Let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until it reaches desired consistency.

title: Swiss Chard With Celery and Rosemary
ingredients: 5 bunches swiss chard, washed | 2 stalks celery, finely chopped
instructions: Wash and remove stems from chard. Slice chard into 5cm lengths. Toss together chard, celery and rosemary in a non stick frying pan until coated. Spray griddle with non stick cooking spray, heat until pan is very hot.

title: My Pineapple Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 3 roma ( plum ) tomatoes - peeled, seeded and diced | 1 ripe pineapple - peeled, cored and diced | 1 small yellow onion, finely diced | 1/2 cup diced pineapple | salt and pepper to taste | 1 cup guinness stout, divided
instructions: Mix tomatoes, pineapple, onion, and 1/2 cup diced pineapple in a bowl. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix in remaining diced pineapple. Serve with tortilla chips. You can leave out the salt completely or refrigerate 1/2 cup before serving.

title: Mashed Parsley
ingredients: 4 cups chopped fresh parsley ( can use some dried chopped parsley which you may not use ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | saltine crackers
instructions: In a large frying pan, heat olive oil to the boil, then add the asafoetida powder and the saltines. Let sizzle for 20 to 30 seconds while stirring, or until the asafoetida turns bright green and sputters. Add the parsley to frying pan and saute over medium heat until the parsley is nicely toasted. Enjoy with pita bread.

Random Ingredients: danish blue cheese,sea salt,parsnip,prosciutto,italian bread,bratwurst,head lettuce
title: Bratwurst (Bratwurst) with Gorgonzola Cheese (Rocket)
ingredients: 3 bratwursts, with casings removed | salt to taste | 4 leaves fresh parsnips, chopped | 3 radish bratwursts | 4 slices thinly sliced prosciutto | 1 loaf italian bread | 3/4 cup crumbled berry blue cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f on a cookie sheet lightly dusted with cornmeal. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Sprinkle the bratwurst with salt, and place on the pan. Cook for 10 minutes, then remove from heat and drain. Discard casings, and cut bratwurst meat horizontally into 2 halves. Arrange bratwurst meat on a cutting board, and slice into 1/2 inch slices with a small sharp knife. Arrange the chopped parsnips, radish bratwursts, and prosciutto on the cut side of the bratwurst meat. Roll the bratwurst meat in the crumbled blue cheese. Place rolled bratwurst on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until crumbs have begun to turn brown, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tamarind extract,pork shoulder,tuna,chicken cutlet,cottage cheese,sesame oil,rice flour,turmeric
title: Cottage Cheese and Cabbage Pork (Chokhaeng)
ingredients: 1 container cottage cheese | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon dried pepsi ( fish sauce ) | 8 thin pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch chunks ( bone-in, skin-on ) | 2 1/2 cups cooked chicken, cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 tuna, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon tamarind extract | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon rice flour ( mochiko rice flour )
instructions: Mix the cottage cheese, turmeric, pepsi, and 1 tablespoon water in a large bowl. Add the pork and chicken, coating the pieces with marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, tossing to ensure everything is evenly coated. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Transfer the mixture to a large shallow baking dish about 1 1/4 inches deep. Add the tuna and tamarind extract. Dip the sesame oil in the sesame oil, just until the fish are coated. Add this mixture to the meat and tuna, tossing to coat well. Sprinkle the rice flour over the top. Bake for 1 hour, or until the meat is cooked through and the rice is crisp and brown.

title: Trout Toast With Pineapple Sauce
ingredients: 4 slices whole wheat bread | 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/4 cup crushed pineapple with juice | 1/4 teaspoon chili ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon sweet soy sauce ( ketjap manis ) or 1 tablespoon honey, plus more ( to taste )
instructions: Brush two to three slice of bread lightly with cooking spray. Spread one side with mustard seeds, then top with crushed pineapple. Sprinkle with chilli. Spread both sides with sweet soy sauce or honey. Place other slice on top and brush with cooking oil. Heat barbecue to high and place a few pieces of trout on one side and then sprinkle a bit of the mustard seeds on both side.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,catsup,chilies,peanut butter,basil,red apple,risotto rice,chicken breast
title: Quick and Easy Rice With Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup chilies, minced | 2 cups rice | 1 can chicken breasts, diced | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar or 1 1/2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1 small red apple, diced | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 5 leaves unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Melt butter in a small saucepan and stir in chilies. Cook over low heat for a minute or two, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Remove saucepan from the heat. Add rice, catsup, vinegar, basil, apple and italian herbs. Stir until well mixed. Set aside. Spread the rice onto a baking sheet. Place peanuts on another baking sheet. Sprinkle with peanuts as desired. Set aside. Preheat the broiler. In a small bowl, stir the sauce with the olive oil. Divide the rice mixture among 4 oven proof bowls. Spoon over the sauce and serve right away.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,tabasco sauce,white breadcrumb,veal,anise seed,swiss cheese,italian seasoning
title: Veal Roulades
ingredients: 10 ounces veal, cut in half crosswise | 2 slices white breadcrumbs | 5 tablespoons swiss cheese, grated | 2 1/2 tablespoons green cardamom pods | 1 1/4 teaspoons aniseeeds ( i use ground ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or fork, crush the cardamom pods finely and place them in a bowl. Place the bread crumbs in a second bowl or plate and add the swiss cheese to the bread crumbs. Dry out the veal with a paper towel and sprinkle evenly with salt. Place the crumbs on a cutting board and shape the ground meat on the crumbs. Do not under work the meat. Spread the green cardamom over the meat. Sprinkle with 2 teaspoons salt. Roll up the meat like a jelly roll. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. Heat a large non stick pan over a high flame. Add oil, when it smokes add the meat roll and cook on each side for about 6 minutes until done. When the roll is done, remove the meat roll from the pan and slice diagonally. Arrange the meat slices on a bed of sauce and serve immediately.

title: Lentil & Swiss Chard Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 cup dry lentils, rinsed and drained ( any other lentils will do ) | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup pitted prunes | 2 cups fresh raspberries or 2 cups frozen raspberries | 8 ounces swiss cheese, grated & divided | 1/2 cup dried cherries
instructions: Place rinsed and drained lentils in 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker. Add broth and oregano.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,chile pepper,pimiento,green onion,chambord raspberry liquor,halibut fillet
title: Cajun Halibut
ingredients: 1 pound halibut fillet | 1/2 cup chambord raspberry liquor | 1 jar chopped pimiento | 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 3 chopped green onions | 1 fresh hot chile pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange halibut in a roasting pan. Pour 1/2 cup raspberry liquor over the fish. Place pimentos, green onion, and hot chile pepper in a separate bowl, or on a plate and stir together. Spoon the sauce over the fish. Bake the fish in the preheated oven until flesh is easily flaked with a fork, 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Feta Eggplant (Aubergine) Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 300 g rice noodles | 300 g cheese ( i like gouda ) | 250 g shredded suet | 150 g shredded feta cheese | 1 green cardamom pod | 5 eggs ( or 1-2 small eggs, lightly beaten )
instructions: Rinse the noodles under cold running water and drain. Soak in cold water for 10 mins. Shake off excess water. Cut the cheese into cubes. Rinse the eggplant. Cut it in 1 diagonal thick slices. Soak the egg slices in cold water for 2 mins, then drain, rinse and dry. Sprinkle on the cheese, and fry in a little oil until the cheese is melted and starting to turn golden around the edges. Break the noodles into halves or quarters, and set aside. Toss the fried eggplant with the cheese and season generously with pepper. Put aside. Sprinkle the eggplant with the cardamom, fry in some oil until it starts to colour, then remove. Arrange the fried eggplant on top of some fried noodles. Sprinkle with the fesh kiri, feta and green cardamom. Toss all together.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,sun tomato oil,chive,cooking oil,salt pepper,butter,semolina flour,lemon
title: Sun Tasty Prawns With Creamy Semolina Pies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 300 ml thick-sliced semolina flour | 1 teaspoon salt & pepper | 300 ml thickened cream or 300 ml heavy cream | 2 medium onion flakes | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( about 12 slices ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh chives
instructions: Make sure this is your first time you make this recipe, so don't wait until it is. In a small bowl, toss the dried onion flakes with the oil and butter. If you don't have any oil at hand, just shake and rub the mixture all over a large, flat surface. Place the work surface on top of your work table, cover with a clean cloth, and set aside. In a food processor, add the semolina and salt and pepper. Pulse until it is finely ground, adding more water if necessary. Add the cream and process just enough to come together, or press with your fingers and knead lightly. The dough will be sticky. On a floured surface, roll the dough out to an oblong shape of about 8 inches diameter. Using a 3 inch round cutter, cut out the center of the dough round. Place the rounds onto four greased baking sheets. Prick each prawn with a fork, then decoratively press the edges to seal. Bake the prawns in a 400°f degree oven for 25 minutes, or until barely cooked but still slightly moist. Set aside on a rack to cool. In a small frying pan, add the olive oil and sun dried tomato oil. Add the sliced onion flakes and chopped chives and saute over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes, then remove the pan from the heat. Brush the prawns with any oil left in the pan. Serve the prawns warm or at room temperature with the onion gravy and your choice of accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,golden syrup,mango,nutritional yeast,rice flour,phyllo pastry
title: Easy Mango & Cabbage Phyllo Roll Ups
ingredients: 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | 1 1/2 cups finely shredded green cabbage ( coleslaw mix ) | 1 small mango, diced ( fresh, if possible ) | 1 teaspoon golden syrup | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. In a bowl whisk the nutritional yeast with 1/4 cup of warm water to combine. Add the cabbage and stir well to coat. Spread a little of the cheese mixture on the bottom of a parchment lined springform pan. Fold in the sides and roll up the phyllo carefully. Spray the bottom and sides of the springform pan with cooking spray. Place rolled pastry cross wise in the pan. Sprinkle the remaining cheese mix over the rolled phyllo. Cover with parchment paper and set aside for 60 minutes. Bake for 20 minutes or until the cheese is golden and crispy. Allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes then slice diagonally across the width into 3/4 inch pieces. Serve with mango and pineapple sauce. Cooking time does not include 5 - 10 minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,bread machine yeast,chicken thigh,thyme sprig,hot red pepper flake,jalapeno pepper,beef broth
title: Thyme and Lime Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons bread machine yeast | 2 1/4 cups low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup chopped jalapeno pepper | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs
instructions: Place dough ingredients in bread machine pan in the order suggested by the manufacturer. Process on dough setting, then press start. At end of cycle of baking, remove dough and shape into a lightly greased rectangle on a lightly greased baking sheet. Top with assorted garnishes.

title: Chilled Green and Red Heidel Pasta Beans
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans | 6 -8 fresh basil leaves | 2 fresh green peppers ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh chervil
instructions: Put the beans, basil, and peppers into a blender and puree.

title: Mini Tacos
ingredients: 1 jar taco shells, or homemade | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/425f/gas line a baking tray with aluminium foil, and sprinkle generously with taco seasoning. Stir the taco shells well. Scoop the floured tortillas into the hot tray, and flatten into 3cm/1/2in cakes. Bake on the top shelf of the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden.

title: Horseradish Pastry Pastries
ingredients: 1 box frozen puff pastry, defrosted | 1 cup snow peas | 1 cup fresh pasta ( i prefer to use rainbow, rainbow or angel hair ) | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1/2 cup rose water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f. Take out the pastry sheet from the box and cut a rectangle about 12 by 8 inches on 1 side and the other side, so that there are two layers, about 1 inch. Repeat with the other two rectangles. Spray or brush the pastries with oil and place on a baking sheet and bake in oven for about 12 minutes. While the pastry is baking, cut the snow peas into 1 inch dice and steam for about 3 - 5 minutes over medium heat. Keep the heat on medium low. Mash together the peas and horseradish in a small bowl with a fork. When the pastries come out of the oven, sprinkle a little horseradish mixture over them. Bake for about 8 more minutes, until browned and crispy. Serve at once.

title: Baked New Potatoes in Chocolate Filling
ingredients: 1/2 ounce active dry yeast | 1 1/3 cups warm soymilk | 3/4 cup sugar | 2 lbs small new potatoes | 2 ounces fresh gin | 5 ounces dark chocolate ( optional ) or 5 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oven to 420 deg. F. Make the yeast sponge by pouring the warm milk and half of the sugar into a large bowl. Add the yeast, making sure it dissolves. Heat the remaining sugar in a pot and cook for 5 minutes. Scrape the mixture into the bowl and add the yeast and soymilk mixture. Stir to combine then leave in the warm spot for 10 minutes. Put 2 lbs of potatoes in to a large baking pan and prick all over with a fork. Bake 25 minutes. Turn over and bake the potatoes for about 75 minutes or until they are cooked and sticky. Cool slightly. Drain liquid from potatoes and put in to a large bowl. Beat the remaining 1/4 cup sugar and the remaining 1 tbsp of butter. Add the melted butter, and mix in the remaining potatoes,. Add the gin and chocolate/vanilla. Stir until incorporated. Serve in small cups and dip in melted chocolate, if desired.

title: White Bean Jelly
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans ( drained ) | 1 can canned pineapple slices ( drained ) | 3 egg yolks | 12 cans jars canning jars ( lids and rings, not rings, do not work )
instructions: Empty beans, pineapple & egg yolks into a large pot and add enough water to come 2/3 of the way up the cans. Stir and bring to a boil over medium heat. When it starts to boil, add canning jars with lids. Wash and drain rims well. Bring to a full boil and remove from heat. When water is fully absorbed into your clean jars, tighten bands and place on rack in sink or large bowl covered with cheese cloth. Refrigerate jelly for one week, then refridgerate for up to 1 week.. After one week, use clean, damp hands to wipe off excess brine. It can take up to three days for the seal to reach the correct consistancy.

title: Belgian Endive and Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 4 belgian endive, cleaned | 1/2 cup ground beef stew meat | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Cut endive leaves crosswise into six sections lengthwise. Cut each section into quarters. Mix ground beef and baking powder in large bowl until well combined. Place endive slices in an oiled 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Toss with beef mixture and pat into an even layer. Cover with foil.

title: Kha <RECIPE_STAR
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef ( sliced ) | 1/2 lb okra ( cut into pieces ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock
instructions: In an oven proof skillet add sesame oil and roast okras until golden brown. When golden add marjoram and stir fry until onion is clear. Add beef and cook just until no pink remains. Add vegetables and stock and bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover and transfer to oven at 350 degrees until meat is done.

title: Spicy Caesar Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 teaspoons dijon mustard | 4 teaspoons tamari ( dark soy sauce )
instructions: Using a whisk or small bowl, mix dijon mustard and tamari together. Whisk in a small amount of cold water until the sauce begins to thicken. Use over meat, chicken, or anything else.

title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 1 pound bacon | 1 cup banana | 1 tablespoon fast rise yeast
instructions: Place the bacon in a skillet, and cook over medium heat until evenly brown. Reserve 1 tablespoon drippings in the skillet. Place the bacon into a bowl, and set aside. Add the banana, and sprinkle with a little bacon grease. Sprinkle with yeast, and stir until the yeast has dissolved. Pour bacon grease into a bread pan, and place in a warm spot. Place the bread in the oven, and turn off the heat after 5 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown on top, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,jalapeno pepper,xanthan gum,lemon pepper seasoning,italian seasoning
title: Low Calorie Low Carb Low Calorie Fudge Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup cholesterol-free extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon lemon-pepper seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Crack the fat from the bottom of a glass pan or microwavable bowl. Add cheese and mix with a fork. Add remaining ingredients, except for last two and beat to mix. Mixture may look thin, as you may need more or less of each. Spread on a piece of wax paper or lightly sprinkle on top of a casserole dish of your choice. Chill until firm and firm, about 12 hours.. Spread on a stick of your choosing and enjoy.

title: Cherry Tomato Won Tons
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta | 12 -16 cherry tomatoes, halved lengthwise | canola oil | wonton wrapper
instructions: Cook wonton shells according to directions for the pasta. Drain noodles and keep warm. Sauté tomatoes in canola and canola oil for approximately 2 minutes to reduce liquid. Pour tomatoes on a platter and place the won ton in the center. Spoon some of the reserved tomato juice over the won tons.

title: Raisin and Green Chillies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 2 green cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan on medium. Toss raisins, green cardamom pods and lettuce leaves together ensuring they are coated with non stick spray. Immediately add to frying pan and toss, continuously shaking the pan to mix, for about 5 - 8 minutes, or until all the liquid has come out. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,picante sauce,head garlic,beef tenderloin,corn oil,taco seasoning,black olive,coriander seed
title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 3 medium heads garlic, peeled | 28 ounces crushed tomatoes with ketchup | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon black olives, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Pat beef dry and dredge in oil. In dutch oven, bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Heat remaining oil in large frying pan. Add garlic cloves and cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes with their liquid, picante sauce, tomato ketchup, olives, and coriander, if using. Bring to boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile trim fat from tenderloin. Slice into 1/2 thick slices. Put meat on slotted platter.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,coffee ice cream,mustard seed,red onion,turmeric,bacon,water,salt pork
title: Swedish-Style Steak
ingredients: 6 slices bacon ( sliced paper thin ) | 2 lbs beef flank steak | 10 ounces mustard seeds | 1 cup water | 1 whole onion ( sliced thin ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon turmeric ( ground ) | 4 fluid ounces coffee ice cream ( to serve )
instructions: Trim excess fat from the steak. Place the entire slab of steak between plastic wrap and weight with a plate. Using your hands, squeeze the meat to remove any excess air pockets. Cut the steaks lengthwise into serving slices about 2 inches wide and 3 inches long. Place the slices on the plate with the mustard seeds, water, onion, salt, turmeric and coffee. Turn the slices and lay flat as possible on a serving platter. Cover and let marinate at least 1 to 2 hours, but preferably overnight. Turn the oven to broil. Place the steaks on a rack in a broiler pan. Broil the steaks 4 to 5 inches from the heat until just dark from the mustard seed crackles. Turn off the heat and let stand 5 to 10 minutes, then turn off the heat and serve at once. We eat this with either a little cream, potatoes, or salad.

title: Vegan Tasty Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 2 cups shredded red bell pepper | 1/3 cup olive ( optional ) | 1/8 - 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley flakes | 1/4 cup sake ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Unroll thawed phyllo dough and stack up on a clean cutting board. Pile about 2 teaspoons of shredded bell pepper in the centre of phyllo. Sprinkle about 2 tbls. Chopped olives around pepper. Spread phyllo dough so it is evenly to cover. Fold the sides over and roll up and make sure all the edges are overlapping them. Spray a cookie sheet. Cut roll into 16 rolls about 2 x 18 inches. Bake on bottom rack for 10 minutes. If rolls aren't golden on top, bake at about 5 minutes. Remove to a rack to cool. Note, sometimes i get a small handful of white rice from the package to be used later on. Add rice to the top. Note, it is important to be light on the rice so it doesn't brown in the process.

title: Lettuce Junk
ingredients: 3 cups leftover lettuce | 6 dried dates | 1 medium cherry | 4 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 cup rice cereal | 1 dash black pepper | 2 tablespoons lettuce, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine rice cereal into a large bowl and mix well. Set aside. Wash the cherries and cherry, remove the seeds, and chop the fruit into small pieces. In a large skillet, add the chicken bouillon, dates, lettuce, and cherry pieces. Cook over low heat for about 15 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Raspberry and Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries, quartered from the can drained
instructions: Place the rice vinegar and baking soda in a bowl and stir until well combined. Add the raspberries and stir well. Pack the chips in a medium sized plastic bag and refrigerate approximately 2 hours or over night. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,garlic salt,plum tomato,red chilies,dill,steak,waffle
title: Grilled Tomato Beef With Chiles & Gravy
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes, chopped | 2 large red chilies, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 1 1/4 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 1/4 lbs flank steaks, trimmed of excess fat and cut into thin 1 inch thick slices | 2 lbs waffles, toasted
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Combine tomatoes, chiles, parsley, dill, garlic salt, and 1 1/2 cups water in a large bowl. Toss to blend. Sprinkle beef with remaining 1/2 cup water. Add beef.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,parsnip,dark soy sauce,lemon juice,tofu,ladyfinger,red chile,beef bouillon granule
title: Tofu and Parsnips
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh parsnip | 2 tablespoons fat-free ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup low-sodium beef broth granules | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1/4 cup finely ground toasted littleneck mushroom top or 1/4 cup wood chips | 8 -10 ladyfingers, split
instructions: Place parsnips in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped. Process remaining ingredients in a bowl until well mixed. Place mixture in a bowl and chill until firm. Arrange ladyfingers, overlapping if necessary, on a plate. Dollop a small portion of herb filling over each ladyfinger.

title: Nuts and Pies
ingredients: 2 ounces of dry spanish rice | 1 bunch kale or 1 bunch sorrel | 1 pint of good stock | 2 small red chilies | 10 cardamom pods | 1 ounce malibu rum
instructions: Soak the rice for 20 minutes in plenty of water. Wash, trim and deseed the chilies and cut them in half. Bring the stock and sugar to the boil and boil for about 2 mins until it's starting to thicken up a bit. Add the rice and chilies and boil until the rice is soft. Drain the rice and leave to sit for 5 mins then add a little bit more water to dilute the rice. Serve with a wedge of lime and some sliced pickles. Also add some of the malibu sauce to your taste, the recipe is endless.

Random Ingredients: peach half,cheese,green onion,grain brown rice,marshmallow creme,chicken stock,tequila
title: Sausage and Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1/4 cup tequila | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 7 tablespoons marshmallow creme | 8 ounces sliced peaches in syrup, drained and halved | 2 cups cooked short-grain brown rice | 2 cups shredded cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,plain nonfat yogurt,artichoke heart,mexican chili powder,white wine
title: Artichoke and Sesame Dip
ingredients: 1 package frozen artichoke hearts, thawed, drained, and chopped | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 2 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 teaspoons mexican chili powder
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine artichoke hearts, yogurt, wine, sesame oil and chili powder. Cover, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.

title: Linguine Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried linguine, broken | 2 tablespoons black beans, drained | 2 english muffins, split and toasted
instructions: Place the dry linguine in a medium size bowl and pour boiling water over. Toss to make sure the pasta is covered by the boiling water and set aside to drain. In a large bowl, combine the black beans and linguine, then sprinkle on the remaining tablespoon of black bean dressing and toss well. Place the toasted english muffins on a serving plate and top with the linguine salad.

title: Berry-And-Blackberry Wraps
ingredients: 6 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 4 teaspoons double cream | 1 bag soft fresh blackberries | 10 large flour tortillas
instructions: Combine vinegar and cream and stir until blended. Cover and refrigerate for several hours, stirring occasionally. Wash and pick berries roughly but do not cut off the rind, just remove it from the skin. Dice and put in a small bowl and cover loosely with plastic wrap, to keep the fruit from drying out. Put on a sheet pan and sprinkle a little more vinegar on them. Preheat oven to roll each wrap into a log 4 inches long. Wrap in plastic and place on a large pan or baking sheet. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, or until just slightly charred. Remove wrap and let cool for 10 minutes. Wrap in heavy duty aluminum foil and place on serving dish. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,white balsamic vinegar,cooking oil,gingerroot,savoy cabbage,radish,rib celery
title: Gingered Coleslaw With Ginger and Radishes #A1
ingredients: 2 lbs ribs ( shredded cabbage, carrots, and celery ) | 4 teaspoons grated peeled fresh gingerroot | 4 teaspoons grated peeled fresh gingerroot | 1 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( not dried ) | 1 head savoy cabbage, cored and shredded ( about 3/4 lb. ) | 2 teaspoons white balsamic vinegar | 3 lbs cooking oil, for frying | 3 -4 radishes, cut into thin wedges
instructions: In medium bowl, toss together cabbage, ginger, cilantro, and enough of the cooking oil to cover. Toss gently, adding more cooking oil if needed until cabbage is soft and has a crisply textured texture. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Stir the ginger and cilantro into the cabbage mixture and toss gently just until all ingredients are coated. Cover and set aside. Bring a 2 - 3 qt. Pot of water to a boil. Drop in cabbage mixture and cook until tender, 4 - 5 minutes. Drain and stir in vinegar. Set aside. Heat cooking oil on medium. Drop in the cooked cabbage mixture in batches, cooking until slightly crisp and golden on all sides. Drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,anise seed,white bread,farfalle pasta,jalapeno pepper,sage leaf,kidney bean,cardamom pod
title: Pasta E Fagioli With Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb bulk ground sausage ( mild or hot ) | 1 jar black kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 12 small fresh sage leaves | 5 cardamom pods | 2 slices white bread, crusts trimmed | 1 large fresh jalapeno pepper, halved lengthwise and seeds scraped | 1 tablespoon anise seed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f. Cook the sausage in a large skillet over medium heat until the sausage is crumbly, no longer pink. Drain. Stir in the beans, kidney beans, farfalle pasta, the sage, cardamom, and the jalapeno pepper. Cover the skillet and cook until the pasta is tender, 15 to 18 minutes. Meanwhile, toast the bread slices in a large heavy skillet over medium high heat, turning as needed, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the heat. With a spatula, loosen the bread pieces from inside of the pan, leaving the crust intact, and set aside. Cut the bread slices in half lengthwise, then cut into 3 or 4 wedges. Set aside. Spoon the sausage mixture into a serving bowl and stir in the anise seed.

title: Horseradish Sauce for Fish & Chips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coarse grain mustard | 1 teaspoon prepared horseradish sauce | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh walnuts
instructions: Combine mustard & horseradish. Add walnut bits & refrigerate until ready to use.

title: St. Patrick's Red Potato and Canadian Bacon Appetizer
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs red potatoes | canadian bacon or ham | sliced gingerroot | almond extract
instructions: Prepare the potatoes as directed on the package.

title: Yellow Pepper and Chive Relish - Seasoning Recipe
ingredients: 2 large yellow peppers, seeds removed from, sliced | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 bunch chives, small stalks trimmed ( optional )
instructions: Grind the cumin seeds in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle, or into a mortar and pestle with the chives. Transfer the mix to a serving bowl and add the peppers. Allow the flavors to meld for 24 hours at room temperature before serving. Store refrigerated.

title: Easy Pasta Pizza With Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb rotini pasta or 1 lb fusilli, cooked al dente | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | chopped tomato and chili sauce or favorite hot sauce
instructions: Place cooked pasta in a lightly greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Top with hot sauce or tomato and chili sauce. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for about 15 minutes or until bubbly on top. Remove from oven and slice, serve or keep warm in a warmed oven.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,pickle relish,vegetable oil cooking spray,broccoli,brandy
title: Mom's Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 cups fresh broccoli, cut into florets | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons celery ribs, finely diced | 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish or 2 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup whiskey
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in frying pan. Sauté broccoli in batches until tender and tender crisp, about 7 minutes. Drain broccoli thoroughly, and transfer to a mixing bowl. Add celery, and mix well. Stir in celery mixture. In small bowl, combine mustard, relish and brandy or whiskey. Pour over broccoli mixture. Toss to coat thoroughly. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 4 hours.

title: Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 4 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon oregano | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: Using an electric mixer, add the flour and the oregano to the base of a large bowl. Add the tomato puree and mix well. Pour into a saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and allow to simmer while making your pizza. Preheat the oven to 220c or 200c if your oven has an oven fan forced oven. Turn the oven off. Transfer the dough onto a floured work surface and roll out into a 2cm thick round. Using a 3cm round cutter, use a star shaped cutter to cut out 12cm rounds of dough. Place on the pizza tray about 1cm apart. Brush the tops lightly with olive oil and bake for 5 minutes until a brown crust is risen and starting to crisp. Allow to cool on a wire rack. Serve the pizza warm.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,provolone cheese,dark sesame oil,yogurt,mozzarella cheese,brandy,spring onion,green mango
title: Stuffed Mango Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 120 g cake flour | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 package round plain yogurt | 250 g freshly grated mozzarella cheese | 100 g grated provolone cheese | 1 tablespoon brandy ( optional ) | 4 -5 firm green mangoes | 4 spring onions, sliced
instructions: Blend grated cheeses with sesame oil and brandy until smooth. Place approximately one third of the cream cheese mixture into a large mixing bowl and blend together with the yogurt, mix well until well blended then fold in the other three cheeses until well blended. Spoon into 24 small moulds about 25cm in diameter. If planning on using as a filling for sandwich rolls, roll the mangoes in a little flour to coat the surface then dip into the flour, roll in the flour, then shake off any excess. Repeat for the remaining mango mixture. Arrange the mangoes on a baking sheet. Pour on equal quantities of the remaining cream cheese mixture and top with provolone cheese. Bake in a moderate oven for 10 minutes, turn down oven to 350 f and bake for another 10 minutes or until cheese is golden brown and the mango filling is firm, serve warm with crackers and salad tops, as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,bean,red kidney bean,cottage cheese,vanilla ice cream
title: Diabetic Italian Soup
ingredients: 2 packages low fat cottage cheese | 2 cans fat-free refried beans | 1 loaf italian bread | vanilla ice cream, for topping | 1 can red kidney beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Slice bread loaf crosswise and spread refried beans evenly over the loaf. Cover with cottage cheese and cover with remaining loaf, cut side down. Bake at 375f 20 minutes. Meanwhile, remove the top crust of the bread loaf, and place on a baking sheet,. Cut bread into 1/2 inch cubes, and sprinkle over soup. Bake at 375 f for 15 minutes. Serve soup sprinkled with ice cream and beans.

title: Halloumi Cheese Pastries
ingredients: 1/2 pound halloumi cheese, shredded | 1 container low-fat ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 1 small purple onion, chopped | 1 package phyllo dough | 4 cloves garlic, minced
instructions: In a bowl, mix halloumi cheese, ricotta cheese, sage, onion, and phyllo dough to form a roll about 15 inches in diameter. Chill 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Fold 1 piece of phyllo pastry in half lengthwise and brush both sides of the dough with a small amount of oil. Repeat with the remaining pieces of dough. Sprinkle a little oil onto a baking sheet. Place the phyllo sheets onto a lightly floured surface, brush each with oil. Cover with a damp cloth, and place in the preheated oven. Bake the sheets for 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots ( any medium size ) | 1 lemon, zest of | 2 tablespoons dried parsley flakes
instructions: Peel carrots and cut into bite sized chunks. Place carrots on a large saucepan with a lid and water to cover. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil for 30 minutes. Reduce heat to low and cover. Simmer 30 minutes. Add lemon zest and parsley and stir. Cook another 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella ball,ladyfinger,beef stock,yukon gold potato,lasagna noodle,red potato,self raising flour,curd cottage cheese
title: Cheesy Mashed Potatoes and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 kg small red potatoes | 1 kg small yukon gold potato | 12 ladyfingers, cut in half | 1 kg small curd cottage cheese ( can also use cream cheese ) | 500 g self raising flour ( or use 2-3tsp. flour and 1/2 cups of cornstarch ) | 1/2 cup beef stock | 100 g lasagna noodles | 500 -568 g mozzarella balls ( this can be bought in the frozen )
instructions: Boil the potatoes and potatoes together until they are soft and have a little bit of colour. Drain the potatoes, place them in a colander, and leave them to drain for 10 - 15 minutes. Place the yucots in the bottom of a pan, then cover with a layer of potato, a little sauce, a layer of mottoes and a layer of mozzarella, finally finishing with a layer of potato and an extra layer of mozzarella. Mix the beef stock, cornstarch, flour into a thin paste, and a little water to make a thick paste, and pour it over the casserole. Cook in a very slow oven for 2 hours at 160c, then remove the cover and cook for another 5 minutes or until the top of the casserole is browned and crisp. Serve it while you are eating, and keep covered on a low heat to avoid a lot of juice for the next day. Serve with pasta, or with veg or a salad that is to your liking.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,phyllo pastry,rotel,burdock root,hazelnut,serrano pepper,ginger garlic paste
title: Pinchi Pastry Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 lb chopped hazelnuts | 1 lb chopped dry burdock root | 6 -8 serrano peppers, washed and trimmed | 1/2 lb shredded ginger-garlic paste | 4 boxes shredded phyllo pastry sheets | 1 can rotel, mild | 1 lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. In the pan saute ginger and garlic in oil for 2 minutes, or until just golden brown. In large bowl, combine all ingredients except phyllo. Pour 1/3 of sauce in a large ovenproof dish. Place 3 sheets of phyllo in dish. Cover with 2 remaining sheets of phyllo, brushing each with oil. Repeat layers. On top of phyllo, spread about 1/4 sauce with 1 tbsp of rotel. Layer sheets of phyllo on top of sauce and top with remaining sauce. Cover with foil, and place in preheated oven. Bake for 25 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the phyllo comes out clean.

title: Alicia's Lentil Pizza (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1/2 cup green lentil | 1/2 cup pizza sauce
instructions: Place lentils on pizza maker bread machine, sprinkle with flour and then spread pizza sauce on the bread. Press the dough setting on the bread machine.

title: Simple Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 5 -10 lbs chicken ( frozen or thawed ) | 1 package shredded cheddar cheese ( about 4 cups ) | 1 can simple syrup
instructions: Remove and discard any solid part of the chicken piece in the chicken. Rinse the chicken and place in a slow cooker. Sprinkle the cheddar cheese over the top. Pour 1 can of simple syrup over the chicken.. Cover and cook on high for about 5 hours or on low for 4 hours. When ready to serve, remove chicken pieces from the slow cooker.

title: Brussels Sprouts Casserole
ingredients: 2 brussels sprouts, halved | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon light cornflour | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt, for brushing
