instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c/300°f. Toss sprouts with tomato sauce. Combine cornflour and cream of tartar in a bowl, add yoghurt and stir until blended. Arrange sprouts on a lightly greased, 1 inch high, ovenproof dish and brush with the yoghurt bake 30 minutes or until cooked and golden.

title: Easy  Texas Beef Dip!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, chuck, boneless, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1 jar salsa ( mild ) | 1 canned apricot, drained and coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. In large baking pan combine beef, salsa and undrained apricots and toss to coat evenly. Bake uncovered until meat is fork tender, about 3 hours.

title: Cabbage Rum Roll
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored | 1 cup dry white wine | 2 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Unwrap the cabbage and place it in a bowl. Cover with hot water, remove excess water and place in the refrigerator for 1 hour or more. Remove the cabbage from refrigerator, remove the leaves, and cut with a cleaver. Rinse in cold water, drain. Put the cabbage in a saucepan along with the wine. Cook over low heat, stirring, for 10 - 15 minutes, until the liquid is reduced by 1/ and the wine is syrupy. Remove the cabbage from the heat and discard any remaining water. Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and place in refridgerator for 1 1/2 hours, or until the rolls are well chilled and set. To serve, place a roll slice in a roll and spoon in the rum and the cabbage filling. Serve immediately.

title: Faux Orzo
ingredients: 1 lb dried linguine | 1/2 lb stewing beef, cut into bite-size pieces | 3/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, finely shredded | 1/2 cup bean threads
instructions: Remove hard edges from dry rice and rinse well. In a large skillet, bring 2 quarts of water to boil and add the rice then turn down heat so the water is barely simmering. Cover and simmer until all liquid is absorbed. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat an extra 3/4 c oil and brown the meat well and drain. Add to the rice and cook until it is slightly brown. Add the apricots, orange peel and bean threads to the rice and stir well. Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,pork hock,bird eye chile,shallot,beef,orange zest,flour tortilla
title: Chile Con Carne With Beef and Pork Hocks
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef ( i use round cut ) | 1 lb pork hocks | 15 shallots ( i remove half for garnish and half for garnish ) | 1 bird's eye chile | 1 orange, zest of | 1/2 cup flour ( or use whole wheat pastry flour ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh fruit ( raisins, sultanas ) or 1/2 cup currants ( raisins, sultanas ) | 6 -8 large flour tortillas
instructions: Place the beef and pork hocks in a large pan and add enough water to just cover the hocks. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer until meat flakes easily with fork about 2 hours. Remove meat from pan and reserving stock. Pull meat from bones and discard fat or save stock to use as meatballs later in the recipe. Cool meat and return bones to pan. Using food processor, process shallots or chiles until fine, but not powdery. Reserve. Slice meat lengthwise and then into thin strips 2 inches long and 1/4 inch wide. Add salt to taste. Add reserved stock and pepper to taste. Meanwhile, heat skillet over medium heat and oil or butter. Add shallot mixture and sauté about 3 - 5 minutes until fragrant. Add reserved stock or liquid and stir to mix. Slice shallots thickly and add to skillet. Sauté about 5 minutes or until shallots are translucent. Remove from heat. Place one tortilla on work surface or counter top. Top with some filling, then a few strips of pork hock in a row. Top with some more filling. Roll up tortilla to enclose filling. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red onion,ginger garlic paste,blueberry,icing sugar,ginger root,sage leaf,lime
title: Chilled Blueberry (Gran) Blueberry Relish
ingredients: 1 package frozen blueberries | 2 tablespoons red onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger root, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 3 teaspoons icing sugar | 2 limes, juiced | 2 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Place the blueberries in a medium saucepan over low heat, and cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the red onion with the 3 teaspoons of ginger and the 2 teaspoons of garlic in a skillet over medium heat until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Drain blueberries, and stir into the onion with the 3 teaspoons of ginger and garlic. Stir in the remaining 2 teaspoons of ginger, and mix until combined. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or until set. Place the reserved blueberries in a blender or food processor, and process until smooth. Stir the gelatin into the blueberry mixture, and process until completely mixed into a semi thick relish, about 1 minute. Spoon the relish into serving glasses, garnish with fresh sage leaves, and serve.

title: Corn Cracker Mix
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and heat to 400 degrees f. Coat a 10 inch saute pan with cooking spray. Toss chickpeas, coriander seed and cornstarch in resealable plastic bag. Press 1/4 of chickpea mixture in pan and repeat with remaining chickpeas and coriander. Transfer to baking sheet and sprinkle with remaining cornstarch.

title: Pistachio and Tofu Skewers
ingredients: 12 ounces extra firm tofu | 1 vidalia onion, finely chopped | 1/2 cup good quality pistachios, toasted
instructions: Slice the tofu in half horizontally. Soak tofu for 30 minutes at room temperature or you can freeze it. Cut the tofu into cubes about 1 inch across. Cut the onion in half and finely chop it. Coat the tofu with water. Soak the cubes in a bowl of water for 20 minutes. Drain and blot dry the tofu with paper towels. Set aside. Thread the tofu onto the skewers. Alternate the tofu cubes and onions onto a skewer. Grill the skewers until the tofu is warm and the onion is crispy.

title: BBQ Chicken Breast
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts | 2 cups light beer ( budweiser is good ) | 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 orange | 4 tablespoons orange juice
instructions: First cut up the chicken breasts, then slice them in half and then into thin slices. Then mix the dark brown sugar together. Add the beer to a small bowl and let it sit. Then add 1/2 a tsp. Of the sugar mixture to the beer. Mix the chicken until it is coated. Then put the chicken in your bbq on medium, pour the remaining marinade over, cover and turn the heat up to medium. Let the chicken cook for 1 hour flip the chicken over, cover and cook for another 10 minute or less. Turn off the bbq/bbq and let the chicken rest for an hour and then serve on a plate with plenty of your favourite sides.

title: Sweet Island Relish
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh pineapple preserves | 1/2 cup thinly sliced onion | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a sealable container. Refrigerate until needed.

title: Easy Poached Chicken and Hominy
ingredients: 2 chicken breast meat, boiled and sliced | 1 cup chicken tenderloins, cut into strips or 1 cup white hominy | 2 slices bacon | 1 cup dry white breadcrumbs | 1 can white hominy, drained and rinsed
instructions: Soak chicken for a few hours. Drain and set aside. Put ham slices on a baking sheet and place in a 350 degree oven for a few minutes or until lightly browned on both sides. Remove ham from oven and set aside to cool. To make the chicken. Dice up chicken, bacon into small pieces and place in a large bowl. Add bread crumbs, hominy and drained chicken breast meat and mix well. Place all ingredients into a sauce pan, bring to a simmer and poach in the slow cooker for 3 hours on high, 2 hours on low. Check for doneness with a fork and drain off most of the liquid. Place mixture in soup bowls, top with shredded cheese if desired and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,fish fillet,curry leaf,black eyed pea,black sesame seed,bell pepper,caraway seed
title: Pork Spareribs (Asian Style)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork spareribs | 1/2 lb black sesame seed | 4 tablespoons black sesame seeds, toasted | 1 teaspoon curry leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 cup black-eyed peas, soaked in cold water at least an hour
instructions: Slice the spare ribs in half. Place the ribs in a small saucepan. Add enough water to cover.

title: Potato, Chickpea and Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen drained chopped potatoes, thawed ( about 90 grams, or about 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup canned chickpea flour ( chickpea flour ) | 8 flour tortillas
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine potatoes and chickpea flour and stir to combine. Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium high heat.. Coat pan with cooking spray. Working with two tortillas at a time, dip dough between two small dampened towels into hot pan. Using tongs, press each tortilla into hot oil to form tortillas. Lift out with a slotted spoon. Dry excess oil from second tortilla and repeat process until all six tortillas are fried. Arrange cooked tortillas on plates and top with potatoes and chickpea mixture.

title: Zucchini Applesauce for Veggies
ingredients: 2 zucchini, sliced into rounds | 1 can applesauce | chili
instructions: Put all ingredients in a sauce pan and mix. Add to vegetables and bring to a simmer. Serve.

title: Easy Low Cal Lasagna
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagna noodles | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: Bring a quart of water to a boil in a large pot. Add salt to taste and cook the pasta until they are al dente. Drain well. While the noodles are cooking, stir in the mustard and sprinkle evenly with the mustard powder. You may have to do this in two batches. When all of the noodles are ready, put them on a large serving platter and spread with the mustard mixture. Cover with foil and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,cod,nigella seed,snow pea,green curry paste,vegetable stock,wine
title: Spicy Green Curry Fish
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh green curry paste ( i like thai kitchen brand ) | 1/2 cup low sodium vegetable stock | 11 ounces frozen snow peas | 11 ounces cod, diced | 1/4 cup nigella seeds | 1/2 cup wine ( if you're using any sweet white wine, you may want to use less )
instructions: Boil the curry paste in the vegetable stock for 20 minutes. Add the snow peas and simmer for 1 minute or less to heat through. Add cod and nigella seeds and cook for a further 5 minute remove from the heat, stir in the wine and set aside to serve. Please note that curry paste can be used on any seafood, especially chicken.

title: Crisp Pecorino
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups semolina or 1 1/4 cups grated unbleached unbleached cheese | 1 cup pecorino cheese | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon wasabi | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Mix together the semolina or grated cheese with one cup of the pecorino. Heat oil, worcestershire sauce and wasabi in a small skillet to boiling. Immediately add in the semolina mixture and stir constantly until all the liquid is absorbed. Transfer to an oiled rimmed baking sheet. Spray with nonstick cooking spray and top with remaining cheese. Drizzle with the remaining 1/4 cup of pecorino. Bake until the cheese is bubbly and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salsa,grain white rice,lamb,heavy whipping cream,scallion,baking powder,beet,vanilla yogurt
title: Mafta (Beet Cake)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground lamb | 1/2 lb raw ground lean ground beef | 1/2 cup salsa, medium | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 scallions, white parts minced | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla yogurt | 1 cup salsa | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream or 1/2 cup evaporated low-fat milk | 1/2 cup long-grain white rice, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f butter 2 jelly roll pans or jelly roll pans. Place lamb and beef in large bowl.

title: Almond and ancho Chile Sandies
ingredients: 150 g toasted almonds | 1 banana, very finely chopped | 3 tablespoons ground ancho chiles
instructions: Grind the toasted almonds to a powder in a grinder. Place the ground almonds in a bowl and add the banana and ancho chili powder, stirring well. Using a teaspoon, make small balls from the almond mixture in small, flat shapes with your thumb and index finger, taking care not to tear the mixture. Place them on a floured board and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Preheat the oven to 190 degrees celsius. Bake the cookies, until golden, approximately 10 - 15 minutes, depending on the shapes you cut and how well you like your cookies. Allow to cool on the cookie sheets at least 10 minutes before breaking each one up with a metal spoon to make a sandwich.

title: Bastur Yaki: Grilled Mushroom, Asafoetida and Red Pepper Rolls
ingredients: 1 package fresh yeast | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 2 drops dried red pepper | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 medium red pepper | 5 heads crimini mushrooms, cleaned and quartered lengthwise | 1/3 - 1/2 fluid ounce melted fat-free yogurt
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in mirin and set aside in a medium bowl for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and mix quickly to combine, adding more milk if necessary. Mix well and set aside for an hour or so. Preheat grill. Roll pepper quarters between your palms as well as the palms of your hands so the sides are well coated. Sprinkle with melted fat free yogurt and place peppers on the grill. Close lid and cook for 15 - 20 minutes until golden. Slice each pepper lengthwise in half and place pepper halves and a pepper half into each cut. Drizzle with melted fat free yogurt and serve.

title: French Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup tarragon vinegar | 3/4 cup hot water
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Store in glass container. Shake vigorously.

title: Laksa
ingredients: 500 g tri-colored rice paper | lard | pink chili oil, to taste | sweet chives | triple sec
instructions: Line a bamboo sheet with two layers of damp clean muslin, leaving about 1cm between each layer. Place a layer of plastic wrap directly on top, using 2 sheets of damp cloth over the edge. Cover with another layer of damp cloth, making sure the ends are sealed. Repeat until the second layer has been used up. Heat a large skillet to medium high and add the lard. When the fat has started to bubble up add the rice paper sheets and fry until both sides have turned a pale green colour. Turn over after 3 - 4 minutes of cooking and drain on absorbent paper. Repeat until all the rice sheets are cooked. When the laksa is completely cool toss in a little sweet chilli oil and garnish with more chilli, chives and a few drops of pink food colouring or lemon juice. Serve with sweet chilli or sweet chilli sauce, to serve.

Random Ingredients: italian bread,caster sugar,olive oil,black olive,no salt tomato sauce,iceberg lettuce,pork butt
title: Pork and Olive Crostini
ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 600 g pork butt | 500 g iceberg lettuce, ends removed | 15 ounces no-salt tomato sauce | 375 g no-salt-added whole tomatoes, chopped | italian bread, to serve
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan and add the sugar. Turn down the heat and fry the pork on the oiled side for 10 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside. To the same pan add the lettuce and stir fry for 2 minutes. Add the tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes. Return the pork to the pan and add the olives and stir fry for a further 5 minutes. Serve with toasted sandwich rolls, toasted french and bread.

title: Kimbap
ingredients: 350 g soba noodles | 1 1/2 liters boiling water | 1 teaspoon beef base | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 potato, sliced thin ( optional ) | 300 g bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Boil soba for 10 mins, drain and rinse well with cold water. Place noodles in a large bowl. Cut potato in half and squeeze the juice out. Fold the potato into the noodles. Cover and leave to stand for 10 minutes. When done pour off the liquid. Mix soba, potato and noodles together and pour over the noodles. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,bell pepper,irish whiskey,spinach,scotch bonnet pepper,oyster sauce,chive,orange bell pepper
title: Roast Spicy Goat Cheese With Peppers
ingredients: 5 ounces shucked goat cheese | 1 ounce oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon orange bell pepper, julienned | 1 tablespoon scotch bonnet pepper, seeds removed, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons shucked sweet bell peppers | 1 teaspoon grilled sweet potatoes, julienned ( can use 1/4 cup roasted roasted peppers ) | 2 heads steamed spinach
instructions: Blend together goat cheese with oyster sauce, chives, orange and black peppers. Brush spinach with olive oil and place on parchment paper. Bake at 400 f in oven for around 2 minutes. Cool in the oven for a few minutes. Take off parchment paper and top with roasted peppers and cheese. Let cool completely before you dig in. Serves a large party or just a quick meal with some chilled hard boiled potatoes on the side.

title: Fettuccine with Beans and Fettuccini (Fettuccini Con Mesti)
ingredients: 1 cup dried cannellini beans ( preferably cannellini or arborio ) | 6 ounces fontina cheese ( or more ) | 15 large basil leaves | 6 ounces semolina ( i used wholemeal bread crumbs ) | 1 lb fettuccine, cooked and drained
instructions: The following step may not be necessary depending on the type of dried beans you use, you can also use plain cannellini, which has the same capacity and fibre content as cannellini. Soak beans overnight. The next day drain the beans and put them in a heatproof dish. Pour hot water over to cover, then put the dish in the kitchen. Cover and set aside in a warm place until the beans are nearly cooked. Turn the heat down to low and leave to simmer gently for about 20 to 30 minutes, stirring from time to time it should become very thickened. Meanwhile, fry the semolina with a little oil until it has a light golden colour. Cut the fontina in small cubes around 1 inch or so and fry in a little oil to cover with a little oil. Put the basil leaves in a mini chopper to make the basil, stir them into the beans. Add the cooked pasta and mix well. Taste, adjust the seasoning and add a little more oil, if necessary. Serve with fresh bread crumbs on the side.

title: Easy Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 1 cup onion powder | 1 onion steak, cut into strips
instructions: In a shallow dish or bowl, combine the onion powder, and onion beef strips. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.

title: Vegan Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, seeded | 12 plum tomatoes, seeded | 3 cups plain soymilk or 3 cups skim milk
instructions: Turn up heat on your grill to medium high and grill the chiles until charred. Immediately remove the chiles and set aside. Place the tomatoes on the grill or broiler and char them until blackened on all sides. Let cool. Remove the blackened chiles with tongs and slice into halves. Place the tomatoes into a blender. Put in the blender, the soymilk and the chiles, turning in the blender a couple of times. Blend for 30 seconds to a minute or so.

title: Mangarin Oranges With Oranges
ingredients: 1 cup mandarin oranges or 1 cup mandarin orange juice | 12 small mandarin oranges | 2 -3 tablespoons orange juice, if necessary
instructions: Wash and remove the hard rind from the mandarins. Slice them thinly. Pour the mandarins into a colander or sieve over a bowl. Place the mandarin orange slices in the bowl with the mandarin orange juice and let them drain for 30 minutes. Then rinse and dry the slices. Slice each mandarin orange in half lengthwise and remove the pith. Sprinkle generously with fresh grated orange rind. Arrange the oranges onto a serving platter, and spoon or squeeze over the mandarin flavoured orange juice, garnish with a tablespoon of orange juice, and serve at once.

title: Peanut Butter Sun Dried Tomato Cream Dip
ingredients: 2 cups chopped sun-dried tomatoes | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes - packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. In a bowl, toss together sun dried tomatoes, sun dried tomatoes and garlic. Stir in cream of celery soup.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,lamb shoulder,white bread,sausage,rice,clear honey
title: The Sausage Stuffed Sausages (Sausages W- Honey)
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin steaks or 1 kg lamb shoulder | 2 slices white bread | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 1/2 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 smoked sausages ( johnsonville brand ) | cooked rice
instructions: Trim meat of fat and sinew. Trim fat from the lamb and cut out the soft strings with the tip of a sharp knife or a knife. Strip the bread to make a loaf shape around the meat, then remove the meat from the slice. Break into small pieces and season with salt, pepper & honey to taste. Stuff the sausages lightly with the meat stuffing, ensuring they do not leak out. Cut 4 - 8 small slits in the meat and stuff the sausages with the left over bread. Secure the openings with skewers, if necessary. Barbecue the sausages over a moderate heat for about 30 minutes or until cooked thoroughly. While they are cooking heat the grill and brush the sausages with oil if desired. Serve with cooked rice.

title: Grilled Pepperoni Lamb With Grilled Sesame Seeds and Garlic
ingredients: 1/4 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 teaspoon garlic granules ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped pepperoni | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 pound boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: Whisk 1/4 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons sesame oil, and garlic granules together in a small bowl until smooth. Add pepperoni.

title: Pressed Turkey
ingredients: 1 kg turkey, sliced ( skin on, bone in ) | 150 ml plain flour, unbleached, unprocessed | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon greek yogurt | 150 ml yoghurt | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon horseradish, prepared | 3 plum tomatoes, sliced | 1 tablespoon vodka
instructions: Sauce, mix oil and yogurt and blend in flour slowly. Cook over low heat until mixture thickens. Set aside. In a hot tandoor or sauté pan, add corn oil, turkey slices and sauté to a pale golden in color. Spread a teaspoon of sauce over each turkey slice and pour over remaining sauce. Roast in a hot oven for 10 minutes or until juices run clear. Garnish, add tomato, horseradish and vodka. Serve immediately over cooked spaghetti, as desired.

Random Ingredients: white bread,jalapeno pepper,red bell pepper,leek,stew meat
title: Mexican Meat  (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cubed | 1 cup leeks, sliced thin | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into chunks | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced | 1 loaf white bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot. Cover and cook on high 4 - 6 hours, or on low 8 - 9 hours. To serve, cut bread into pieces and arrange meat on it. Serve with tortillas and salsa.

title: Red Sauce: Thai Spicy Rub for Roast Chicken Salad!
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried red pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried stam or 1/2 teaspoon ground dried shrimp | 1 tablespoon fish sauce ( nam pla )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Brush onto chicken. Cook as desired.

title: Peach   and Feta Dip
ingredients: 1 can sliced peaches, drained drained | 1 can pitted ripe olives, drained | 4 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Prepare the peach filling according to package directions. Fold in the whipped topping. Spread over warm baked potatoes.

title: Vanilla Noodle Surprise
ingredients: 4 ounces wide egg noodles | 4 ounces shrimp ( small ) | 16 ounces vanilla sugar ( or other sugar ) | 1/2 inch cinnamon bark, bark
instructions: Boil water for noodles. While waiting for it to boil, brown the shrimp. Remove shrimp. Remove cinnamon bark from the stem. Pour about 1/2 of the vanilla sugar on noodles. Stir noodles and shrimp together and serve immediately.

title: Chef John's Lazy Gluten Free Bread
ingredients: 1 cup flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 cup xanthan gum
instructions: Gently toss the parsley and xanthan gum together in a large bowl.

title: Chicken and Cheese Melt Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices rye bread | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked chicken breasts, shredded | 3/4 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 3/4 cup hot pepper sauce ( your choice )
instructions: Preheat large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Place bread slices in skillet. Cover with 1/4 of the chicken and 3/4 of the cheese. Top with remaining 1 1/4 of the chicken and 3/4 cup of the cheese. Heat until cheese has melted and begins to melt. Spread pepper sauce over bread. Immediately, remove from heat. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,garlic,salad leaf,extra virgin olive oil,yellow squash,lettuce leaf,mint leaf
title: Marinated Yellow Squash (Squash) Salad
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash, washed, peeled and cut into thick slices | 2 cups lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 1 cup salad leaves | 1/2 cup mint leaf | 1 tablespoon garlic, chopped | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | salt and pepper
instructions: Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and combine thoroughly. Toss salad leaves with dressing and serve.

title: Indian Spiced Honey
ingredients: 50 ml clear honey | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds
instructions: Combine honey, cumin seeds and cumin seeds in a small saucepan.

title: Caribbean Orange Roughy
ingredients: 1 orange roughy fillet | 2 teaspoons dark rum
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f. Remove skin and all visible membrane from orange roughy by slashing the skin, avoiding all the white part and including the base, and removing as much of the black flesh from the membrane as possible, and cut off the very very light green membrane. Place in a small casserole dish and sprinkle each side with rum. Bake in the preheated oven just long enough to brown and caramelize the rum, and then set aside until serving.

Random Ingredients: wine,vanilla essence,parmesan cheese,mini marshmallow,coconut cream,dark sesame oil,almond
title: Quick Italiano Macarecce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 4 ounces parmesan cheese, grated | 2 -3 tablespoons coconut cream | 1 1/3 cups dark sesame oil, divided | 6 mini marshmallows or 6 mini gingersnaps | 4 tablespoons dry sweet wine | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Dip marshmallows into wine and set aside. Combine cocoa with 1/4 cup of sesame oil. Roll marshmallows in cocoa and roll in sesame oil. Place in a 9 pan. Pour the remaining sauce over marshmallows. Add remaining sesame oil and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Lamb Biryani
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb shoulder | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 russet potatoes, peeled | 1 lb flat noodle
instructions: Fry the asafoetida in a heavy frying pan over medium heat for 30 seconds. Add the lamb and fry until evenly browned.. Scrape into a bowl and set aside. Dry fry the potatoes over medium heat about 40 seconds or until golden. Toss with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Set aside. Fry the noodles until al dente. Drain and return to the pot. Re fry 2/3 of the lamb and drain. Place the potatoes over the lamb and toss well. Add the noodles and mix well. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Seafood and Cherry Soup
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp | 1 cup frozen cherries, thawed | 6 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1/4 cup hot water ( add more if necessary ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Wash shrimp and devein. Set aside. Cook cherries until tender, about 20 minutes. Reserve juice. Drain cherries. Put cherries, cream, shrimp, and bouillon in food processor.

title: Beer & Pistachios Croutons
ingredients: 1/2 cup pistachios, shelled | 1/3 cup chopped sweet red cabbage | 1/2 cup shredded french baguette | 4 teaspoons onion powder | 4 teaspoons sweetened beer
instructions: Preheat outdoor grill. Process pistachios in food processor or blender until smooth.

title: Saffron Iced Tea
ingredients: 4 tablespoons saffron strands | 4 ounces lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
instructions: Add one teaspoon of saffron and 4 ounces of lemon liqueur to teacups. Fill teacups with cold beverages and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: garlic granule,spanish onion,extra virgin olive oil,lemonade,orange juice,sugar
title: Spicy French Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 cup raw spanish onion, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sweet orange juice | 1/4 cup fresh lemonade, can | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon garlic granules | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,meat,vegetarian bean,curry paste,jumbo shrimp,lard,white flour,shallot
title: Curried Shrimp Balls
ingredients: 20 jumbo shrimp, chopped | 1 1/3 cups lard | 1 cup minced shallots or 1/2 cup onion | 1 tablespoon curry paste ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1 -2 cup vegetarian baked beans ( optional ) | 2 lbs lean ground meat ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups white flour ( optional )
instructions: Place first 3 ingredients into a large, deep pot. Set over high heat. When hot, add meat, if using. Brown, breaking it up small, as much as possible with a wooden spoon. Add more oil if necessary. Add curry paste and peanut butter. Stir with a wooden spoon 1 - 2 minutes or until all mixture is well mixed. Drain any excess grease and flour from the food. Stir the meat mixture into the meat with a spoon. If it seems wet add flour a little at a time, mixing into a firm dough. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. In a large, heavy pot, bring water to a boil. Place shrimp shell side up in the boiling water. Cover. Boil shrimp on top 2 - 3 minutes. Drain shrimp and set aside. Using a slotted spoon, remove shells from shrimp. Use a slotted, wet, clean, wide pot, again. When hot, add the shrimp back to the shrimp pot. Stir in the cooked ground meat. Cook, stirring, until meat is dry. Using a slotted spoon, remove shrimp. Add enough oil to cover shells, if necessary. When oil is hot, add shrimp shells, cooking 4 - 5 at a time. Stir shrimp frequently to prevent meat sticking to shrimp. When they are cooked, remove and drain on paper towel. Set all pieces of shrimp on a platter and spoon meat sauce over. When serving, place reserved shrimp into a bowl with hot sauce. Serve.

title: Spicy Eggplant With Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup green chilies | 1 cup eggplant | 1/2 cup dark chocolate ( i used hershey's ) | 1/2 cup hot sauce | 1/4 cup honey | 8 ounces egg noodles | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Chop the green chilies and eggplant into small pieces. Cook the eggplant until soft. Place in a sprayed 8 x 8 pan. Sprinkle with the dark chocolate and hot sauce, and let sit about 10 minutes. Pour chocolate mixture over the eggplant and mix well. Chill. Cook noodles in salted water until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. Add the frozen raspberries and honey to noodles and mix well.

Random Ingredients: sherry,bacon dripping,edamame,green onion,grain white rice,tamari,spanish onion
title: Edamame Rice Salad (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1/2 - 2/3 spanish onion, diced | 2 cups frozen edamame, thawed in microwave according to package directions | 1/4 cup green onion, diced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tamari ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon bacon drippings ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dry sherry ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in rice cooker, stir to combine. Close tight lid. Set to cook. Let sit 10 - 15 minutes until all ingredients are cooled. Stir, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: honey,garam masala,garbanzo bean liquid,button mushroom,cottage cheese
title: Garbanzos & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package dried garbanzo beans in liquid ( chickpeas ) | 1 package button mushrooms, chopped | 1 1/2 cups cottage cheese | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon honey
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight. Drain, rinse and dry chickpeas. In a medium saucepan over low heat, cook mushrooms until tender, and the liquid has been absorbed. In a small bowl, combine cottage cheese, honey and garam masala. Combine this with the chickpea mixture. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer, stirring frequently, for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oriental sesame oil,orange,garlic powder,red enchilada sauce,red curry paste,jalapeno chile pepper
title: Red Curry Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon minced fresh jalapeno chile pepper | 1/2 cup canned red enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon minced fresh orange rind | 1/2 tablespoon garlic powder | 1/2 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/4 teaspoon dried oriental sesame oil
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add jalapeno and saute until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Add enchilada sauce. Return skillet to low heat.

title: Kielbasa and White Wine Vinegar Steaks
ingredients: 1/4 lb kielbasa, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 10 lbs trimmed beef skirt steaks
instructions: In large resealable plastic bag, combine kielbasa with vinegar and add meat.

title: Easy Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans of your favourite spaghetti sauce | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 green chili pepper
instructions: Open two cans of sauce. Pour into large pot. Cut up the green chili and add to sauce. Heat and serve with hot fettuccine.

title: Easy Cheesy Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/4 cup catsup, or to taste | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons cottage cheese, grated
instructions: In a small bowl combine preserves, catsup, parsley, and cottage cheese.

title: Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 5 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Combine whipping cream and sugar. Heat in saucepan to boiling point and stir continuously until the mixture has thinened. Place caramel sauce in a 1 quart glass dish lined with wax paper. Quickly set 1/3 aside to use for brushing. Use your spoon to spread the caramel sauce on the cream. Cover with remaining cream. Let stand for 2 hours to cool. Gently lift cream from the cream leaving enough sauce from the bottom to coat the bottom of the dish. Using a small, sharp knife, remove caramel sauce from the saucepan, tipping cream over the caramel. Chill, uncovered, in refrigerator for 3 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,kernel corn,purpose flour,coffee granule,rye bread,celery,sherry
title: Cuban Grilled Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican cheese blend or 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup chopped celery | 1/2 cup dried whole kernel corn ( not canned ) | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules ( optional ) | 1/4 cup sherry ( optional ) or 1/4 cup vermouth ( optional ) | 1 package thinly sliced rye bread
instructions: Preheating oven to 375 degrees. In a 2 quart baking dish sprayed with cooking spray, combine first 7 ingredients and spoon half of mixture into bread. Sprinkle with sherry and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 20 minutes.

title: Easy Raisin Hawaiian Corn
ingredients: 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Drain juice of pineapple pieces and add to a large bowl. Stir in the beef boullion cubes. Pour juice from pineapple into a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high about 5 seconds or until heated, stirring after every minute. Stir pineapple juice mix with pineapple and raisins.

title: Toby's Dolly
ingredients: 1 cup self raising flour | 1 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Make sure you don't burn the vinegar. Sift the flour in a mixing bowl with a large pinch of salt. Mix in the vinegar. Make sure the mixture pulls together into a ball.. Turn the mixture out onto a floured surface and knead it slightly. Cut out small circular circles with pastry cutter. Roll each circle between two pieces of clean cloth, and stamp out as many as you can. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Plunge the teabags into the boiling water. Make sure to watch them carefully so the scum rises to the surface. Once they begin to float, remove from the water with a slotted spoon and place on paper towel to drain. Once they're all drained, place in a warm oven. Do not let the water boil off, if there is a temptation to eat them straight, you'll have a hard time. Let the teabags cool slightly before filling and hanging from the teacups. I usually use a silicone liner or grease paperecloth to prevent the foil wrappers from getting too hard if the water bubbles and gets too cold. You can also do a little dolly sprinkles at the bottom. These are delicious baked on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet, and can be used in other recipes. Store them in an airtight container when cold.

title: Chinese Style Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb raw broccoli | 2 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Wash the broccoli. Cut into quarters. Place all in a large pot and add the catsup. Melt the catsup in the hot water and cook until it coats the vegetables. Drain the vegetables and serve.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,lemon twist,caraway seed,onion,curry powder,pimiento,turmeric powder,chipotle chile
title: Cucumber Tomato Salsa (Salat Yumurt)
ingredients: 3 quarts cucumbers ( very coarsely chopped and seeded, about 1 lb of the peeled cucumber ) | 2 -6 quarts very fresh tomatoes, chopped and seeded ( from 1 lb ) | 4 tablespoons fresh lemon twists | 2 teaspoons fresh ground turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons dried chipotle chiles | 1 teaspoon garam masala or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds, if desired ( optional, but recommended )
instructions: Combine the finely chopped cucumbers, tomatoes, lemon peel and turmeric in a large bowl. Stir once in a while, making sure the tomato and cucumber are well blended. Add the remaining ingredients and stir to mix. Taste and adjust the seasonings. The salsa may seem thin at first, but keep mixing as it thickens. If the salsa is too thick, you can thin it with a little water. Serve in a bowl with pita chips or as a topping with bread.

title: Lunchy Spanish Rice and Chilies
ingredients: 1 cup long grain rice | 1 small leek, diced ( remove white stalk ) | 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 1 medium bell pepper | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup chunky salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, minced
instructions: Cook rice using 3 cups water over medium heat until just tender. Drain rice and keep warm. Set aside. Meanwhile, in a skillet, saute leek over high heat until softened. Add bell peppers and cook stirring occasionally until soft. Remove from heat. Stir in rice, chile mixture, chocolate, salsa and parsley. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,lemon pepper,pepper,pomegranate molasses,button mushroom,sun tomato oil,bread,mustard
title: Yummy Beef Skewers With Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs steak fillets | 1/3 cup pomegranate molasses ( available ready-made if not in the can ) | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 teaspoon pepper | 12 -16 whole button mushrooms, cut in half | 12 -8 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 8 ounces firm stale bread, cut into slices | 1 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Cut steaks into cubes. Thread onto skewers. In a medium bowl, mix the pomegranate molasses, dry mustard, lemon pepper, pepper and mushrooms. Place sun dried tomatoes on a foil lined baking sheet. Top tomatoes with bread pieces and drizzle with mustard. Broil or grill skewers for 10 to 15 minutes or until the tomatoes are soft and the bread is browned. Serve over hot rice or couscous.

Random Ingredients: parma ham,marsala wine,sazon goya,sherry,black bean,curry paste,dill pickle spear,turnip
title: Caribbean Yellow Rice
ingredients: 2 boxes sazon goya | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 teaspoon ground fresh dill pickle spear | 1 tablespoon hot curry paste ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups dry marsala wine | 15 ounces canned black beans, drained and rinsed | 3 1/4 cups peeled and chopped turnips | 1/2 cup thinly sliced parma ham, or more to taste
instructions: Cook the sazon goya and sherry in a skillet over medium heat until zap.

Random Ingredients: chocolate shaving,black eyed pea,dark soy sauce,lemongrass,yellow onion,pecan,lamb loin chop
title: Lamb and Sheep's Bones
ingredients: 1 lb lamb loin chop, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup lemongrass, cut into 1-inch pieces | 4 tablespoons chinese black-eyed peas or 4 tablespoons frozen black eyed peas | 2 tablespoons chopped pecans | 1 tablespoon finely diced yellow onion | chocolate shavings ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place lamb in large bowl. In small bowl, stir together dark soy sauce and lemongrass. Stir into lamb. Pour soy sauce mixture over meat.

Random Ingredients: hot paprika,apricot,self rising flour,chili pepper flake,pecan,italian herb seasoning
title: Apricot and Pecan Scones
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 1 cup finely chopped dried apricot | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon hot paprika | 2 teaspoons finely chopped pecans, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour, apricots, chili flakes, italian seasoning, paprika and pecans, and mix well. Divide dough into 6 equal portions and place each in a lightly greased cookie sheet, spacing evenly apart. Sprinkle top with additional paprika, and sprinkle with pecans as desired. Bake for 10 minutes. Cool on wire racks.

title: Aussie Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 brown onion | 300 g filet of beef or 300 g sirloin | 200 gr red fresh strawberries or 200 ml fresh strawberries, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill or frypan until very hot. Slice the onion thinly. Place sliced onions and beef on it, season and cook over very low heat until beef is browned.

title: Scotch Bonnet Smoker - Smoked Aboard for Years
ingredients: 2 cans of ground bonnet peppers, i like the smoke flavor | italian herbs, dried, chopped and mixed with the ground spices
instructions: Smoke with your favourite fuel on a hot dry wafer or smoker for 4 - 5 hours, drying the heat off with the bbq grill after 1hr and drying if you want your smoking hot or on your smoker drying schedule. Use a hot smoker as your favourite filler for smoking.

title: Crispy Maple Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3 cups ice cubes
instructions: Cut cabbage into bite size pieces. Cover with water and boil for 8 minutes. Remove from heat and drain. Place in a large bowl and mash with a fork. Add maple syrup, marjoram, and ice and toss until coated. Pour into two plates or bowls top with cheese to serve.

title: Tapenade Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup hot tapenade | 1/4 cup minced shallots | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 pinch fresh thyme sprig | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon creole-style seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the jar of a blender or food processor.

title: Pixie Dust
ingredients: 4 cashews | 2 slices ginger marmalade | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeds and stem | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 2 pounds bratwurst | 1/2 cup rice wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Chop cashews coarsely. Remove cores from jalapeno pepper.

title: Chipotle Cherry Relish
ingredients: 1 cup dried sour cherry ( or candied cherries - the good stuff ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion flakes ( or 1 small onion, minced ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried chipotle chile powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Chill at least 2 hours for flavors to meld. Can serve chilled or room temperature. I can also chill the mixture for a more pronounced sour flavor, but it gets thickened quickly and so does the sour cherry flavors.

title: Creme De Pimento-Roasted Red Pepper Mint Salad
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 1/3 cups light cream | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Char red peppers over flame of gas burner, broil or grill until skins blister, turning frequently, until completely charred and blistered. Transfer peppers to a metal sheet pan and let cool. Peel and core. Cut red peppers into 1 inch cubes. In a medium bowl combine cilantro and cream. In a food processor or blender combine bell peppers, half and half, and olives. Process until mixture just reaches a shaggy texture. Pour into large serving bowl. Toss with remaining mixture. Garnish with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: grain wild rice,cheddar cheese,rosemary,sherry wine,anaheim chili
title: Arroz Verde Mexican Style
ingredients: 2 cups long grain and wild rice blend, dry | 1 fresh anaheim chili, seeded | 1 bunch fresh rosemary, trimmed | 3 teaspoons sherry wine or 3 teaspoons cognac | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, heat a large non stick skillet, dry over medium heat. Remove and discard chili and rosemary. Rinse rice with cold water. Drain and return cooked rice with chiles, rosemary and sherry to warm skillet. Add cheddar to rice and cook until cheddar is melted. Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight.

title: Spicy Mexican Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 6 -8 chiles | 1/6 - 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Remove the chilies from the stems, rinse and remove the seeds if necessary. Place all ingredients in a saucepan or blender and heat, but do not boil. Turn the mixture into a large, dry, clean jar. Allow to cool to room temperature, then refrigerate. Use the chilli sauce at your restaurant, as condiment.

title: Quick and Easy Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 2/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon ketchup ( or other hot sauce, such as ketchup ) | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry ( or cherry juice )
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,cream cheese,russet potato,pizza crust,lime wedge,mocha coffee
title: Mexican Potatoes Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust | 1/4 cup light cream cheese, cubed | 3/4 cup yukon gold potato, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons mocha flavored instant coffee | 1 russet potato, cut into thin wedges | lime wedge, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread cream cheese on crust and top with potatoes. In a small bowl, mix coffee and soy until well blended. Spoon over potato mixture and sprinkle with lime wedges. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned.

title: Pomodorona (Pomodoro an Liqueur)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Pour wine or water into a glass bottle. Sprinkle the salt over the top, then pour over enough water to make up around the rim of the bottle. Let the bottle rest in the kitchen for a few days, shaking the bottle occasionally to remove excess fluid. The longer this sets the rims, the more flavorful the Pomodorona will be.

title: Quick and Easy Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup of cooked quinoa | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup thawed sour cream or 1/2 cup light sour cream | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 4 ounces diced canadian bacon ( optional )
instructions: Sauté bacon. Drain and crumble. Add soup, sour cream and pomegranate juice. Mix cornflour and pomegranate juice together. Put quinoa in with mixture and mix, stir until well coated. Pour into 2 1/2 or 3 quart casserole. Bake at 180°c approximately 20 to 30 minutes or until quinoa is tender when pressed, stir once or twice or twice after 10 minutes to make sure it doesn't burn.

Random Ingredients: oil,beer,picante sauce,coriander powder,mexican corn,plum sauce,pie shell
title: Mexican Fish Pie
ingredients: 1 pie shell, unbaked | 2 lbs mexican-style fish fillets, cut into serving pieces | 2/3 cup bottled tomato sauce | 1 jar picante sauce ( not salsa ) | 1/2 cup frozen corn, thawed | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Preheat oven 375°f. In a non stick skillet, lightly brown fish. Add tomato sauce, picante sauce, corn, oil and coriander. Place fish and salsa mixture in pie crust. Bake for 25 minutes. Bake 5 minutes longer until pie is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: annatto seed,cumin,black currant,lasagna noodle,tomato paste,pepper sauce,apricot jam,green
title: Tomato and Black Currant-Apricot Lasagna
ingredients: 3 cups chopped tomatoes with jam | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon annatto seeds ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 pound fresh lasagna noodles | 1 cup chopped green parts of scallions
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to boil. Add lasagna and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Mulled Vegetables (Chard & Spinach)
ingredients: 2 lbs rutabagas, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 lb baby spinach | 1 lb fresh fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( or other dark liquor ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( or other dark liquor )
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the rutabagas until just tender but still firm, about 4 minutes drain and set aside. When the rutabagas are cool, toss them into the pot with the spinach. Let stand for 1 hour. Drain the rutabagas and spinach and let cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, toast the fenugreek seeks in a dry pan over medium high heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 5 to 7 minutes set aside to cool. In a small bowl, combine the grand marnier and grand marnier and let stand until needed. Place the rutabagas and spinach mixture on a cutting board and chop coarsely. Place the chopped spinach in the same bowl with the spices. Pour the reserved grand marnier over the vegetable mixture and stir to combine.

title: Veal With Herbs and Celery
ingredients: 1/2 cup celery seed, cracked
instructions: Combine the celery seed with 1 teaspoon of salt in a cup or small bowl and grind to obtain a fine powder.

Random Ingredients: green olive,bread,cranberry sauce,chile pepper,tomato puree,red curry paste,red pepper flake
title: Spicy Chilli and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 8 slices bread | 1/3 cup red curry paste | 2 cloves fresh chile peppers | 1 cup dried cranberry sauce | 1 cup diced fresh tomato puree | 2 roasted red peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup green olives, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Brush a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place all of the ingredients except the olives, in a blender and puree. Stir in the basil. Slice the bread in half across, then into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place the slices in the baking dish. Spoon the broth over the bread, then add the olives. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil and bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes, stirring twice. Remove foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until the bread is soft. Serve hot.

title: Advieh - Persian Saffron Roast Spice Blend
ingredients: 5 tablespoons saffron, soaked in | 1/2 teaspoon crushed rosemary or 1/2 teaspoon rosemary | 2 dried red chili,, with | 1 pinch saffron, soaking in
instructions: Grind or pound saffron into a powder with 1/2 tsp salt. Combine spices with some water and set aside. Bring remaining 1/2 tsp salt to boil in a pot over low heat with a tight fitting lid. Add the saffron infusion. Stir constantly until saffron has dissolved. Raise the heat and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat. Boil the mixture for about 10 minutes. Strain thru a fine sieve into a clean bowl or a wide, clean jar with a tight seal. Allow spices to cool to room temperature or warm. Note about rosemary, if using dried chiles, soak 1/2 tsp salt in 1/2 tsp rosemary and set aside. If using dried chiles, place in a mortar and work with a wooden pestle or spice grinder until smooth. If using dried chiles, soak 1/2 tsp rosemary in 1/2 tsp rosemary and set aside. If using regular saffron, soak 2 tsp rosemary in 1/2 tsp crushed rosemary and set aside. Rub a little of the flavoring off the tops of the chiles. Place chiles on a rack in the baking dish and sprinkle with the rest of the flavoring. Bake in 450f oven for 10 - 15 minutes and cool completely. Remove them from the dish and store them in an airtight container.

title: Irish Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 large potatoes | 3 lbs smoked baby back rib or 3 lbs venison roast | 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Cover whole pot with water and bring to boil to cover. While water boils, cut potatoes into 4 pieces. Place in large deep pot. Boil for 15 minutes or until almost tender. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup liquid in pot. Using fingers, poke potatoes with a fork. Remove skin, but not all of the visible fat. Slice kielbasa into rounds about 2 inches long, and place on top of potatoes. Place in same pot with kielbasa. Add reserved potato liquid, enough to cover meat. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 1 hour and 15 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes. Serve with grated parmesan.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,seasoning salt,plain nonfat yogurt,coriander leaf,garam masala,orange peel,heavy whipping cream,rotini pasta
title: Curried Rotini Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rotini pasta, dry and broken into large bite sized pieces | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 cup fresh coriander leaves | 1 tablespoon orange peel, grated or 1 tablespoon fresh lime zest, grated | 1/2 cup fresh parsley sprigs
instructions: In large bowl, toss drained pasta with yogurt, cream, salt, garam masala and coriander. Cover and chill. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Put uncooked pasta in a large pot of boiling water and cook until al dente, about 7 minutes. Drain and place back into water. Mix in orange peel and parsley. Toss with warm pasta and serve.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,spaghetti,tomato paste,brussels sprout,potato chip,rye bread,chicken breast half
title: Quick and Easy Chicken N' N' Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked smoked chicken breast halves, cubed | 1 can tomato paste | 6 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 package instant potato chips | 1 cup brussels sprouts, coarsely chopped, divided | 12 slices rye bread, halved | 2 packages curly-leaf, dry pasta
instructions: Combine the chicken, tomato paste, and confectioners' sugar in a large bowl.

title: Honeyed Pork Rolls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 3/4 lb lean pork, shaved or 3/4 lb lean ground pork | brioche bread | sesame oil
instructions: Pour the honey into a shallow skillet. Heat over medium heat until the honey smells toasty and begins to bubble. Add the pork and pork, and cook, turning them gently, until well coated with honey. Divide the pork mixture evenly between the buns. Re heat the honey and pork mixture in the skillet until bubbling. Continue to cook the pork rolls over moderate heat until warmed through, then transfer to oven to finish cooking at 350 degrees fahrenheit. Remove the rolls from the pan, and brush with sesame oil. Serve warm.

title: Sesame Soda
ingredients: 1 cup sesame seeds | 3 cups ginger ale or 3 cups lemon and orange flavored carbonated beverage, chilled
instructions: Place the sesame seeds in a blender. Crush slightly. Add the gingerale or lemon and orange soda.

title: Strawberry Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 packages frozen peas | 2 packages fresh strawberries, chopped | 1 tablespoon minced fresh tarragon | 1 lb cottage cheese | 1/4 lb sliced frozen strawberries | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 12 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed ( approx. 8 sheets )
instructions: Thaw peas, if desired.

title: Minty Vienna Bread
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 10 -12 cups warm ( room temp ) | 1 1/2 cups mint
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 3 cups of warm water. Combine yeast mixture and mint in a large mixing bowl. Add the rest of the warm water and stir till combined. Let sit until dough starts to rise, about 5 hours. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead 10 minutes on a lightly floured surface. Place into a lightly greased bowl, turning so dough is evenly coated over top of bowl. Cover with a light cloth and let rise in a warm area to an hour, or until doubled in size. Turn dough out onto 2 lightly floured surface. Using a rolling pin, roll dough as you would a swiss roll or marble slab. With floured hands, stretch dough until it is almost as flat as you like it. Cover with a light cloth and let rise until double, about 45 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Remove dough from bowl. With a rolling pin, lightly press dough into a 10 x 6 x2 rectangle. Press the mint down over the dough.

title: Easy Vegetable Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetables, carrot, and daikon ( fresh, frozen, or fresh ) | 1/2 cup kikkoman soy sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl or pan, and mix and allow to marinade at least 30 minutes. Cook over medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes, depending on the moisture level in the vegetables.

title: The Perfect Blender - Simple Easy Twist on Dressing!
ingredients: 8 ounces rotel tomatoes | lemon twist | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut rotel tomatoes in half and discard the seeds. Cut up finely and set aside. Pour 1/4 cup olive oil or vegetable oil into blender and stir until all ingredients blend together. Add salt and pepper and mix again.

Random Ingredients: sultana raisin,irish whiskey,green bean,dark chocolate,white cabbage,shrimp
title: Pub Lindprints
ingredients: 1 lb raw shrimp | 1 medium head head white cabbage, cut into slices | 2 cups sultana raisins | 1 cup dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon irish whiskey | 12 ounces dark chocolate
instructions: Separate the shrimp using a sharp knife or the back of a cleaver. Break or pull apart the small shrimp as desired. Combine all the ingredients and mix well with a knife until all shrimp are covered. Put in a large piece of foil, seal, and let stand at room temperature for a few hours. Heat up your coals or a gas grill. Remove the shrimp from foil. Stir fry the shrimp on all sides until cooked through. Serve on toasted bun.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,cayenne pepper,corn tortilla chip,yellow mustard,romaine lettuce,ginger garlic paste,thyme
title: Indian Restaurant Nachos
ingredients: 4 cups coarsely crushed corn tortilla chips | 2/3 cup chopped romaine lettuce ( about 2 ) | 1/3 cup creme fraiche or 1/3 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon dry yellow mustard | 1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine the nachos ingredients in a large, shallow bowl and mix lightly. Position a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 400°f using 2 sheets of aluminum foil, toss the nachos with the nachos. Place the nachos in a large ovenproof dish and bake until lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Remove the foil and foil. Cool the nachos, 5 minutes then transfer to a cutting board. With a serrated knife, cut into wedges. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Vegan Japanese Turnip Appetizer
ingredients: 3 large turnips, peeled and sliced very thin ( you may use zucchini if you don't plan on using them in sauces ) | 1/8 - 1/4 cup tamari soy sauce ( or tamari glaze ) | 1/8 - 1/4 cup orange marmalade ( or white almond marmalade or other apricot brandy spreadable flavour enhancer ) | harissa, to taste ( or other flavour enhancer ) | radish, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450f, and line a baking sheet with foil, letting it heat. Toss the sliced turnips in the tamari or glaze to coat. Place the turnips on the lined baking sheet, and bake in preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes, or until just beginning to get brown. The turnips should be tender and slightly crispy on the outside, and soft and tender inside. Transfer the turnips to a cutting board, and allow them to cool slightly. Slice them thin. To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together, and season with salt and pepper. When ready to eat, arrange 2 slices of turnips on each plate, spoon over the sauce, and top with sprinkles of radish.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,fillet halibut,rock salt,spicy brown mustard,orange zest,gruyere cheese
title: Grilled Halibut With Maple Mustard Glaze
ingredients: 1 cup maple syrup or 1 cup maple syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons spicy brown mustard | 3 tablespoons olive oil or 3 tablespoons canola oil, plus additional for brushing or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons orange zest, finely grated, grated | 1/2 teaspoon rock salt | 12 fillets halibut | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: In small saucepan, combine maple syrup, mustard, oil, zest and salt. Stir over medium heat until the mixture starts to bubble. Cook 1 minute. Set aside 1/3 cup glaze. Preheat a large, heavy gas grill on medium high heat. Brush the fillets with 1/3 of the glaze. Grill 6 - 8 minutes, until just slightly charred and cooked through. Divide the fish among 6 plates. Pour remaining glaze over the fish. Top the fish with gruyere. Drizzle the remaining glaze over the top of the fish and serve with the reserved glaze. Variation, substitute honey mustard for the mustard. Brush fish with extra oil before grilling. The heat of the grill makes them crispy and more flavorful, which makes them more tender and delicious. Note, this glaze is wonderful served with lemon wedges and sliced green veggies with butter and bread to sop up all the wonderful glaze.

title: Smoked Fish Biscuit
ingredients: 1 smoked salmon | 1 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon cake flour
instructions: Cut fish into 4 equal pieces. In a skillet, add the chili pepper flakes and cake flour. Roll the fish pieces in this mixture, making sure all sides are coated. Let it simmer gently in a mixture for about 10 minutes. Place the two pieces on a baking tray. Bake at 190c for about 10 minutes, then turn them over and bake on the other side. Cut when both sides are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock water,coriander powder,anaheim chilies,garam masala,velveeta cheese,spring onion,jalapeno pepper cheese
title: Spicy Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces velveeta cheese | 1/2 bunch spring onions | 1/2 green anaheim chilies or 1/2 red anaheim chili | 3 hot jalapeno peppers ( or other green chili of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon coriander powder ( a hot green chili from the indian market is good- i prefer it ) | 4 ounces garam masala | 1 quart chicken stock ( a mix of the two ) or 1 quart water
instructions: Cut the cheese into small cubes and chop the onions, peppers and hot chili. Set aside. Mix the coriander, garam masala and salt together. Add a liter of water and the cheese to the water. Mix well until the cheese is completely mixed through the sauce. Put it into a large, heavy pan. Add the onions and cheese. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix once again. Put on medium, slow simmer. When the cheese and onions are almost ready, turn off the oven. Give the dish a good stir and leave it in there for at least an hour. Serve hot with a thick, crusty bread..

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,blackberry,baking soda,turnip,white wine vinegar,cilantro,asafoetida powder,anchovy paste
title: Blackberry Salsa and Straw Eggs(Ensalada Verde)
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh blackberries or 3 lbs frozen blackberries, washed drained | 6 teaspoons anchovy paste | 6 teaspoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 jars chunky salsa ( or salsa verde ) | 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons chopped parsley ( optional )
instructions: Place thawed blackberries or frozen blackberries in a large mixing bowl, cover, and let sit overnight. Next day, rinse and drain, making sure to shake each one off excess foam. Place thawed blackberries, anchovies, baking soda, and asafoetida into a bowl, and mix well. Add vinegar and salsa, stir well to combine, and mix well. Sprinkle with chopped cilantro, if desired, and chill in refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight, stirring every so often if desired. Variation, instead of asafoetida you can use 1/2 white wine vinegar and reduce the vinegar by a quarter.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,italian sausage link,pizza crust,mexican cheese,onion,thyme sprig,green chilies
title: Pineapple-Italian Sausage Pizza
ingredients: 1 package sweet italian sausage links ( casings removed ) | 1 small onion ( thinly sliced ) | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 cup crushed pineapple in juice | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Brown sausage and onion in olive oil. Drain fat from sausage and set aside. Layer sausage mixture, jalapeno pepper, pineapple, onion, green chillies, and cheese in pizza crust. Top with remaining ingredients and bake on top rack of 350°f for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Beef and Parsnips
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs boneless beef chuck or 2 1/4 lbs round steaks | 2 lbs raw parsnips | 1 1/2 pounds raw potatoes | 24 whole blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray with nonstick cooking spray or a paper sack. Cut the chuck and parsnips into 1 1/2 inch slices and trim the ends. Cut the potatoes into large chunks. Peel and wash the leeks, wash them under cold running water and drain thoroughly. Arrange the potatoes and beef in a single layer over the top of the beef. Sprinkle with dried parsley or chives and sprinkle cheese over the top. If desired, cover the top of the beef and potatoes with a cloth or double wrapping. Place pan in oven and bake for about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender and potatoes are easily pierced with a fork. Garnish with whole berries.

title: Rice Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice, cooked | 1 cup yellow mustard, prepared | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 6 ounces confectioners'sugar | 2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Mix the rice, mustard, coriander and nutmeg until well blended. Add the sugar and mix well. Add a little water if it seems too thick, the mixture will thicken up a little when it does. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Ketski
ingredients: 500 g self-raising flour | 1/2 - 3/4 cup ketjap manis ( sweet soy dipping sauce ) | 1 -2 teaspoon dried marjoram ( dried or fresh )
instructions: Sift the flour into a large bowl and make a slight well in the centre. Put the kecap manis and marjoram into the well. Mix well into a smooth paste. Add 1tblsp of the ketchap and knead dough for about 8 - 10 minutes. Turn out onto floured board and knead briefly. Divide into 8 - 12 equal sized pieces. Kneed each piece into a round ball, cover and set aside to rest for 30 minutes. Cut 2 circles from each ball and place on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 220c for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden. Serve warm or cold and enjoy.

title: Currant Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1 cup plain yogurt or 1 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup currants | 10 -12 ladyfingers | 1/4 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns ( or equivalent salt ) | 3/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Put cottage cheese, sour cream in a bowl and mix well. Add currents and sprinkle with cracked peppercorns. Whip the flour into a smooth paste with yogurt. Line a 9 x 12 cup glass bowl or other clear jelly roll pan with waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,pork loin roast,virgin olive oil,beef rump roast,pork,anchovy paste
title: Pork and Roast in Creamy Poached Anchovy Sauce
ingredients: 1 beef rump roast | 2 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 4 ounces anchovy paste | 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste
instructions: Pound the roast on all sides with a meat mallet. Rub with salt and pepper to taste. In a large pot, melt the olive oil on a high heat and brown the roast on all sides, about 7 to 10 minutes. Transfer the roast to a plate and set aside to rest. Discard all but 2 tablespoons of the pan drippings. Add the anchovy paste to the anchovy paste in the same pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat.

title: Easiest Salsa Ever
ingredients: 1 can italian processed cheese sauce ( i just use kraft mexican style ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Drain the tomatoes and chiles into a saucepan over medium heat. Heat until the cheese is melted, about 3 minutes. Stir in the tomato sauce and the green chiles. Cook 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Easy Easy Plain Rice & Bread Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup white basmati rice ( or a jasimine, or a basmati dinner, if available ) | 2 cups vegetable oil ( i use olive oil ) | 4 slices whole wheat bread ( or sourdough or gluten free bread )
instructions: Rinse the rice in a sieve then drain well. Place the rice and 2 cups water in a rice cooker, and add the remaining water, cover with plastic wrap and cook on the normal way. It may be necessary to add a little extra water. This rice will need cooking time depending on the rice you use, but i usually cook about 10 minutes in this way. While it cooks, spread a few tsp of vegetable oil over a frying pan and add half of the bread slices to the pan and fry for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy. You may have to do this in batches depending on the size of the frying pan/skillet. Drain on paper towels and keep warm in a low oven while you finish cooking the rice. You may also cut the bread into 1 inch cubes and fry in the oil until golden brown and crispy. Keep warm in a low oven while stirring through the rice for a few seconds after removing from the heat. Serve rice with a sprinkling of cinnamon and a few drops of lemon juice. For a variety of flavors, you can use plain or flavoured rice instead of the rice.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,whipping cream,chinese mushroom,monterey jack pepper cheese,couscous,dark rum,tamari soy sauce,liquid smoke
title: Couscous With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 12 ounces fresh chinese mushrooms, cleaned and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 7 tablespoons whiskey or 7 tablespoons dark rum | 1 1/2 cups couscous | 6 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1/3 cup light cream | 1 teaspoon tamari soy sauce
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add the onion and mushrooms and then simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Add the liquid smoke. Meanwhile, put couscous in a large heatproof bowl, cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Pour half of the butter into a saucepan and set over moderate heat. As soon as the butter foams, stir in the rice and mushrooms and cook, stirring, for 1 - 2 minutes, until the rice is fragrant. Stir in the liquid smoke and rum, then add it to the couscous and stir to combine. Pour the mixture into the couscous and set gently on top of the stove, about 5 mounds of couscous should, stirring a little at a time as it sets, about 5 mounds of couscous should, stirring a little at a time by now, and then, in increments of 5 mounds of couscous and another 1/2 cup of boiling water until all the water is absorbed. Cover the pan and let sit for 5 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Fluff up the rice with a fork and transfer it to individual plates. Top with the remaining 1/3 cup of butter, the pepper cheese and the cream. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta Primavera With Lentils and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package penne | 1 pint canned lentils | 2 cups creole seasoning ( can use more ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 lb shiitake mushroom, sliced | 1 container ricotta cheese
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions on the package. Cook lentils by placing them in a pan of fresh water and boil until tender. Drain and place lentils and mushrooms in a crock pot. Add creole seasoning, vanilla and salt and pepper. Cook on low for 6 hours. Remove and discard mushroom stems. Shred and combine with ricotta. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Add cooked lentils and mushrooms to crockpot. Heat oven to 425 degrees. Cook on high for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Let cool for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Artichokes, Preserved Green Grapes & Apples
ingredients: 5 jars artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 1/2 cups crushed green grapes | 1 can sliced pimiento-stuffed artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 cup chopped candied pineapple chunks, drained | 1/4 cup cognac or 1/4 cup other brandy
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients and put in a large pot. Bring to a boil at medium heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in cognac and cook until thickened.

Random Ingredients: rice powder,bread,swiss cheese,pimiento,egg noodle,yellow bell pepper
title: Noodle Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles, broken | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese, divided | 3 slices bread, halved horizontally, cubed | 1/4 cup chopped pimiento | 3 eggs, beaten | 1/2 - 3/4 cup white rice powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add noodles and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until just tender. Drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking process. Drain, cool slightly and set aside. In a shallow dish spread 1/2 cup swiss cheese and 1 tablespoon bread cubes. Top with other 1/2 cup swiss cheese, bread crumbs, pimientos, crackers or other desired filling. Add egg and rice powder to noodles and toss to combine. Spread noodle mixture in a sprayed 2 quart casserole dish. Top with remaining swiss cheese and remaining bread crumbs. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Serve with sliced green onions.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,radish,italian parsley,linguine,lime juice,stew meat,english mustard
title: Grilled Beef Linguini with Radishes, Fontina Cheese, and Lime
ingredients: 1 pound stew meat | 1 lime, juice of | 1/4 cup minced fresh italian parsley | 1 teaspoon dry english mustard | 1/4 cup shredded fontina cheese | 12 medium radishes, quartered | 3 cups cooked linguine
instructions: Place beef in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Pour with lime juice and half of parsley. Saute until meat is well browned, about 8 minutes. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Add remaining parsley and mustard and cook 1 minute. Add fontina cheese to beef mixture and turn heat to high. Add radishes and remaining parsley. Cook until sauce boils and is thickened, about 8 minutes. Drain pasta and toss with sauce.

Random Ingredients: orange,purpose flour,steak,dark sesame oil,chili paste,cream mushroom soup
title: Quick and Easy Beef and Sweet Sour Cream Stew
ingredients: 1 flank steak | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup light cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 cup orange slices from 1 orange
instructions: Cut flank steak into 3/4 inch slices. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Spread one side of steak slices with sesame oil. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes. Remove one steak slice at a time and discard wrap, unwrap again. Place on ungreased grill over medium high heat and cook 7 minutes on one side, turn and cook 7 minutes. Turn and cook 1 minute longer. Turn again. Remove from grill and cover with plastic wrap. Keep warm. In medium saucepan over medium low heat, whisk soup, sour cream and chili paste. Cook 10 minutes, or until heated through. Arrange meat on serving plate and pour soup over them. Garnish with orange slices. Note, recipe can be reduced or substituted for the beef broth.

title: Cheese Tortellini - Vegan!
ingredients: 500 g cheese tortellini ( or spaghetti or macaroni ) | 1 1/4 cups self raising flour
instructions: Start the day before to boil the tortellini for two hours or until they float. Put the pasta in a large pan of boiling water for about 10 mins then drain well. Add a cup of warm water and mix it through. Heat the oven to 180 degc. Coat a large baking tray with cooking spray, then pile in the tortellini. Sprinkle a couple of tablespoons of sesame seeds and seasoning and bake for about 20 minutes.

title: Liangban Yang Yu (Chicken Nuggets)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken ( cut and sliced about 1 1/2 inches thick ) | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 1 lb oil ( peanut or soybean )
instructions: In a wok add 1 cup of oil and swirl wok fry for about 1 minute. Add chicken and brown until it is cooked. Add brown sugar and cook until it thickens. Cook for 1 - 2 more minutes. Serve warm over steaming rice.

title: Mustard Bites
ingredients: 4 tablespoons coarse grain mustard, coarsely grated | 4 teaspoons chives, finely chopped | 4 slices white bread, crusts trimmed | 4 tablespoons white rum
instructions: Combine the mustard, chives and bread in a bowl, and stir to combine well. Add the rum and mix well. Drop dollops of the mustard mixture onto a lined baking sheet. Using a pastry brush, lightly coat each bead with the mustard mixture. Return to the baking sheet and refrigerate until ready to serve. Keep refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: cayenne powder,turmeric powder,spice,beef tenderloin steak,salt black pepper,cinnamon,sparkling water
title: Curried Cutlets With Spiced Beef - 3 Points
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried mixed spice ( i use spice the essential mix 1 tbs. ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3/4 lb beef tenderloin steak, cut 1 inch thick | spicy sparkling water, for serving
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add the dry spice and turmeric powder. Stir to blend. Add the cinnamon, cayenne powder and salt and pepper. Add the meat and then the spiced spiced water. Raise the temperature to high and stir so the spiced beef coats the meat evenly. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 2 hours or until the meat is fork tender and the sauce is slightly bubbly. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,vegetable oil,rice vermicelli,maple syrup,coffee,alfredo sauce
title: Maple-Cafe Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package rice vermicelli | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 2 cups alfredo sauce | 1/3 cup maple syrup
instructions: Prepare noodles and set aside. Heat oil and cream in a separate skillet. Add noodles and stir. Add instant coffee, stirring to dissolve. Mix the sauce and pour over noodles.

title: Chipotle Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 cup sliced kalamata olives | 1 3/4 cups chopped chipotle peppers, or more to taste
instructions: Cook rice noodles in a pot of boiling water for about 11 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Cheese Puffed With Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into 8 slices about 4 x 1/2-inch | 1/3 cup currants | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot water | lemon wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f arrange mozzarella on a large baking sheet, breaking apart any large pieces. Top with currants. Sprinkle evenly with hot water. Cover and bake 30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve with lemon wedges.
