title: Peppered French Pea Dip (Cucumber)
ingredients: 5 1/2 ounces natural yoghurt | 2 tablespoons chopped celery ( red onion ) | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 small leek, washed thoroughly, chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pepperoncini pepper, washed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge until ready to serve. Keeps 3 days, refrigerated, in an airtight bottle.

Random Ingredients: herb,vegetable stock,plain flour,cottage cheese,beef tenderloin,green lentil,half
title: Lentil Dumplings With a Middling Beef Sausage
ingredients: 750 g beef tenderloin | 400 g green lentils | 300 ml vegetable stock | 1/2 bunch mixed herbs | 1 tablespoon mixed dried herbs, to taste | 300 g low-fat cottage cheese or 300 g low fat cottage cheese | 150 ml low fat half-and-half or 150 ml cream ( optional )
instructions: Cube beef into bite sized pieces, trimming away excess fat, and season. Place lentils in the bottom of a large pan, add stock, and bring to the boil. Allow to simmer on low for 10 minutes until lentils have softened, transfer to a food processor and puree. Combine middling beef with lentils, herbs and half and half in the processor and whiz until smooth. If necessary, add a few tablespoons of stock to achieve this consistency. Shape into bite sized, thinner pieces, and place in a large pot. Bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes, then add cottage cheese, stir well to melt through and serve over your favourite pasta.

title: Roasted Swiss Chard and Yellow Squash for Two
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard, rinsed to remove grit ( about 1 lb. ) | 2 -3 lbs spareribs | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 small yellow squash, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 can reduced-sodium fat-free broth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Spray a nonstick baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cut the stems from the chard. Cut off and discard any tough leaves, and then cut away and discard the stems from the swiss chard. Rinse the chard and pat dry with paper towels. Cut the leaves from the chard and discard the stalk. Cut the leaves crosswise into 3 or 4 segments and set aside. Cut the ribs into 2 - 3 pieces, crosswise depending on the size of the ribs you’d use. Remove the ribs from the chard. Trim off any excess moisture from the ribs. Sprinkle each piece of ribs with about 1/3 salt and 1/3 black pepper. Place the ribs in the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with the italian seasoning and set aside. Arrange the reserved chard leaves on the ribs. Mix up the vegetable seasoning in a small bowl. Pour half of the reduced sodium broth over the chard leaves. Dot with about 1/3 of the seasoning mix. Top with about 1/8 inch of the reserved green chard leaves. Scatter the squash with about 1 1/2 teaspoons of the reserved green chard leaves. Scatter the remaining 1 1/4 teaspoons of the reserved green chard leaves over the top. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until ribs are tender and tender. Turn off the oven. Turn off the oven and leave it in there for about 6 to 8 hours. Remove the foil and add the reserved 1 1/2 cup of broth. Set oven control to broil and broil the chard for 2 to 4 minutes, or until the tops of the ribs are beginning to smoke. Uncover and broil for 20 to 30 minutes, basting every 5 minutes so it does not burn. Serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,vegetable broth,banana pepper,pickling spice,turmeric powder,shallot
title: Banana Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1 -2 banana pepper ( in the pod ) | 1 -2 shallots or 2 large onions | 3 -4 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 3/4 tablespoons pickling spices | 2 2/3 - 3 cups vegetable broth or 2 2/3-3 cups chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Slit each banana pepper in 1/2, remove stem, seeds, and membrane from pepper pods, leaving about 3 inches of pepperpod attached. Slit the peppers in 1/2, remove seeds and membrane, and slice into 1/2 strips. Peel onions and slice thinly. Place all ingredients in a 1 quart pot. Cover and simmer over low heat 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from heat and strain.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,enchilada sauce,hot italian sausage,tandoori paste,nonfat cream,avocado,sauce,rigatoni pasta
title: Tex Mex Nacho Pasta
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta or ( 16 ounce ) box other pastas | 1 tablespoon hot italian sausage, finely diced | 1 can enchilada sauce, divided | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 egg | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon tandoori paste | 1 avocados, chopped
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, remove casing from sausages. Cook until browned and crumbly. Set aside. Mix hot sauce, hot sauce and sour cream in bowl. Add egg and stir with whisk until well blended. Remove casings from pasta. Drain pasta and add to sausage mixture. Toss to coat lightly. Place in a serving bowl and sprinkle with tandoori paste. Garnish with avocado.

title: Rose-Topped Pizza Tomatillos
ingredients: 1 cup pizza sauce, such as boboli brand, such as < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/bacon/mozart-syrup-414308 '' > arabi-tilatmo tomato & rosemary salsa < /a > | 2 tablespoons rose syrup | 1 tablespoon fresh rose petals, finely chopped, preferably from jarred tomatillo salsa | 5 -6 medium fresh tomatillos, roasted | 2 teaspoons low-fat roasted garlic spread ( see rosemary syrup note )
instructions: Place the tomato salsa in a medium bowl. Stir in the rose syrup and sprinkle with rose petals. Spread the tomato mixture over the surface of the sliced tomatoes.

title: Artichoke Mushroom & Barley Rellenos
ingredients: 400 g pearl barley | 400 g sliced mushrooms | 3 tablespoons artichokes | 1 tablespoon liqueur
instructions: Place barley, mushrooms and artichokes in a saucepan with the liqueur and heat until boiling. Stir often, reduce heat. Simmer covered for 20 minutes or until barley is cooked. Place on a board and serve with rice.

title: Cumin Oil (For Beef and Lamb Basting) (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 2 - 3 lbs good quality lamb fat, such as leg, chops, shoulder, etc | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried spearmint or 2 -3 tablespoons of fresh mint, minced | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: With a sharp knife pound the lamb fat to 1/2 inch thick. Then in a clean bowl, combine with the mint, cumin and the oil. You should have a mixture about a 1/2 inch thick. Rub onto the meat of your choice as you cook. Place in a container, cover, and keep in the refrigerator at least 1 hour and up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: bread,portabella mushroom cap,mexican tomato,beet,semolina,golden raisin,creole seasoning
title: Vegan Beets, Mushrooms & Raisins Bruschetta
ingredients: 3 large beet, peeled, grated and squeezed to remove excess water | 2 cups coarse whole grains semolina or 2 cups bread, crusty bread, torn into pieces | 1 portabella mushroom cap | 2 -4 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1/4 cup diced mexican-style tomatoes | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 3 -4 tablespoons crushed peeled canned beets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Mix together grated beet and semolina in a large bowl. Toast bread in a large cast iron or other oven proof skillet for about 4 minutes, or until golden. Set aside and allow to cool for a few minutes. Remove beets from skillet to a bowl and allow to cool. In a large bowl, combine beets, mushroom, creole seasoning and tomato. Add toasted bread and combine. Stuff with beets and top with raisins. Bake for about 20 minutes or untill beets are heated and crusty, and topping is bubbly.

title: Roasted Herbs With Rosemary
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh rosemary sprigs | 1/4 cup white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Place rosemary sprigs in a large glass or stainless steel bowl. Add vinegar and nutmeg. Stir to combine, then cover with plastic wrap and chill in the refridgerator at least 6 hours, stirring from time to time. Remove from the brine and pat dry. Use to brush top and bottom of herb. Wrap herbs and oil in cheesecloth, place on a foil lined baking sheet and roast in a very hot oven at 400°f degrees for 30 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: toothpick,curd,red wine vinegar,italian herb,sherry wine,miracle whip,chicken breast,white bread
title: Grilled Chicken W-Spice Noodles
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts or 2 chicken parts | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 3 tablespoons miracle whip | 1 teaspoon dried mixed italian herbs, crushed | 2 slices white bread ( crusty bread ) | toothpick, for coating | fresh mixed italian herbs, for garnish ( optional ) | 3/4 cup mild curds, for dipping
instructions: Trim any access fat from the chicken breasts if desired. Coat with the vinegar, sherry, miracle whip, dried italian herbs and slice of the bread. Marinate chicken in the refrigerator for 15 minutes to 3 hours. Prepare grill to medium and add the chicken slices on one side. Cook chicken 6 - 10 minutes per side or until done. Drain on paper towels. Serve on individual serving plates. Top each one with the curds. Garnish with the italian herbs& optional italian herb wedges. Serve with the dipping bread.

Random Ingredients: cashew,white vinegar,spice,orange peel,lime wedge,lemon peel,tart cherry,italian parsley
title: Spiced Cashew Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup cashews | 1/4 cup sliced candied orange peel | 1/4 cup candied lemon peel | 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, preferably cinnamon | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Dry cashews with paper towels. Place the nuts on paper towels, sprinkle with zest and let dry for 20 minutes. Place orange and lemon peels in a medium bowl. Stir in parsley, vinegar, lemon peel and spice. Toss with reserved nuts and orange peel mixture. Serve immediately with lime wedges.

title: Cuban Burger
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 lb hamburger bun | 1 ounce cotija cheese, crumbled | 4 roma tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1 -2 mint leaf | 1 ounce dark rum
instructions: Mix everything together until well blended. Shape into two patties that are 3/4 to 1 in thick. Cook over hot coals for 4 to 5 minutes on each side. Serve on your favorite bun with lettuce, tomato, and mint leaves.

title: Mustard-Honey Glaze
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dijon-style mustard | 1/3 cup honey | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Mix mustard and honey in small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes. Quickly pour the glaze into a bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: creme de cacao,beef bouillon,salmon fillet,mexican oregano,mushroom,amaretto liqueur
title: Betsy's Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh mushrooms, sliced | 2 lbs smoked beef fillets ( i prefer the lean ones ) | 1/2 teaspoon mexican oregano | 2 tablespoons amaretto liqueur | 1 tablespoon mexican creme de cacao | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon
instructions: Place mushrooms in 9x9 pan. Top with smoked beef. Combine oregano, creme de cacao and bouillon. Pour over beef. Dot with butter. Cover loosely with foil. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes. Remove cover, reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake for 30 minutes more.

title: Fried Pork With Espresso Garlic
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant espresso powder ( espresso bean brand ) | 1 tablespoon crushed garlic | 12 ounces ground pork shoulder | sea salt | 1 pinch baking powder | 2 tablespoons espresso powder ( espresso brand )
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Combine all ingredients and press into 8 x 8 inch jelly roll baking pan. Smooth surface. Bake 25 - 30 minutes, until pork is cooked through and golden.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,skirt steak,mature cheddar cheese,cream tartar
title: Beef Strips With Mature Cheddar Cheese and Irish Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream of tartar or 2 tablespoons egg whites | 4 teaspoons grated unbleached strong irish mascarpone cheese | 4 lbs skirt steaks | 1 cup grated aged cheddar cheese
instructions: Whisk together the cream of tartar and the 1 teaspoons of the grated irish cheddar cheese in a large shallow dish. Sprinkle the meat with salt and pepper and let stand at room temperature 30 minutes. Meanwhile, lightly grease the bottom of a 12 inch metal broiler pan and set it aside. Place a broiler rack in the broiler pan and set it on the rack and in the middle the rack. In a glass 2 to 3 quart casserole dish, layer half of the beef, half of the cheese, and layer the remaining beef and cheese on top. Make a slit down the length of the meat to within 1 inch of the cheese. Pierce some holes in the meat and insert a toothpick through the slit to hold the cheese. Add the final 1 to 2 tbsps of the sour cream to the top of the casserole. Set the pan of meat under the broiler on the rack. Broil for about 10 minutes, turning the meat over once or twice. Slide the casserole dish from the oven onto a platter, remove the toothpicks and turn the meat over. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Gramma's Lemon-Cashew Quinoa Lassi
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cashews | 1 cup skim milk or 1 cup almond milk | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 1 cup quinoa, soaked in cold water
instructions: Combine the milk with the almond extract in a blender. Blend everything with a fork until smooth and creamy. Bring the quinoa to a boil with a little salt and pour into a bowl. Place the cooked cashews in a food processor or blender. Pulse until it forms coarse pieces about 5 seconds. Pour the cashew and almond milk into the quinoa and mix well. You can add more almond extract or cashews for a spicier consistency. Pour some of the mixture into glasses and serve immediately.

title: Finger licking the mouth of your tongue and nose
ingredients: 300 g mincemeat | 1 onion soup mix | 2 -3 tablespoons hot chili paste ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup adobo sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Pour into hot fat, let it sizzle. Slice up and eat in the mouth, if not eating immediately.

Random Ingredients: taco bell sauce,half,green bean,bay leaf,peanut oil,chili sauce,potato starch
title: Salty Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, scrubbed and sliced in rounds | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup taco bell hot sauce | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 3 bay leaves | 3 tablespoons potato starch | 3 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Bring potatoes to a boil. Reduce heat and cook about 10 minutes until they're soft. Stirring very often, boil for about 15 more minutes until thick. Add hot sauce, chili sauce and bay leaves. Drain potatoes and add to potato mixture. Mix well. Heat 1 t. Oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add potatoes and saute, stirring often, until golden brown at the edges. Pour potatoes into a 8x8 glass casserole dish. Sprinkle browned bits on top of the casserole. Cook at 300°f about 20 minutes, uncovered, until bubbling. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: orange juice concentrate,chinese five spice powder
title: Poke-in-the-Mouth Chinese five-Spice Marinade
ingredients: 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1 cup hot chinese five-spice powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a gallon size plastic zipper bag. Stir until well combined. Pour into a resealable plastic gallon freezer bag. Attach the following instructions on your zipper bag and shake well. This will ensure the spices are evenly distributed into your marinade. Pour into a container, cover and refrigerate for 6 hours. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. The longer this marinates, the stronger the flavor and the longer your refrigerated marinade will marinate.

title: Swiss Cheese Filling
ingredients: 2 packages dry italian cheese | 2 scallions, chopped | 6 eggs | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 packages ladyfingers
instructions: Beat eggs, add cheese, scallions, cardamom pods. Scoop out into 1/4 cup containers. Sprinkle top of the container with additional cheese. Chill before serving.

title: Mexican Turkey, Chickpeas & Apricots
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups dried garbanzo beans ( i often use small brown and white ) | 2/3 cup canned diced green chilies | 2/3 cup dried apricot | 8 slices lean turkey bacon, chopped ( i often use a touch of bacon grease to help me along ) | 1/3 cup brandy | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: In a 3 3/4 or 4 quart slow cooker add the beans, chilies, apricots and bacon. Sprinkle with the brandy. Cover and cook on high heat setting 2 hours or on low heat setting 2 - 3 hours. Discard any excess juice. Note, if you want to add liquid smoke, stir once or twice, add 1/2 cup water if you wish to.

Random Ingredients: pea,pasta sauce,black cardamom pod,serrano pepper,rigatoni pasta,almond paste,ancho chile powder
title: Rigatoni Pasta With Peas, Achiote and Almonds
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons fresh ground black cardamom pods | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1 lb frozen peas, thawed | 1 tablespoon almond paste | 1/2 cup prepared pasta sauce, your favorite brand | 2 tablespoons fresh grated serrano pepper
instructions: Toast the chile powder in a heavy 2 to 3 quart saucepan over medium heat, stirring often, until fragrant and beginning to smoke, about 2 minutes. Pour the chile powder into a medium bowl and set it aside. While whisking, add the cardamom pods and salt. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add the rigatoni and stir to separate the strands of pasta. Cook 1 to 2 minutes, until al dente. Drain, shaking off the excess water. Add the peas and cook 1 minute. Add the almond paste and stir to combine. To serve, divide the rigatoni among 4 dinner plates. Top with the peas and sauce.

Random Ingredients: glutinous rice flour,white sugar,pita bread,white cheese,spanish onion,white vinegar,brown lentil,nutmeg
title: Rice Bread and Lentil Pockets
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked brown lentils | 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups glutinous-rice flour | 1 cup soft white sugar | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 8 slices white cheese ( optional ) | 8 pita bread rounds
instructions: Place the lentils into a large mixing bowl, pour in enough water to cover them, and allow to stand until softened but not mushy, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Drain and allow to cool. In a saucepan, cook the onion in 1 t. Of the sugar over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until softened and translucent, about 5 minutes. Drain and cool. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk the rice flour, remaining 1/2 t. Sugar, nutmeg, and vinegar, and mix to blend. Coat 4 pita bread rounds with cooking spray. Spoon about 2 t. Of the lentil mixture into each pita round, top with about 2 t. Of the cheese, then top that with about 1/2 t. Of the noodles.

title: Quick Black Rice
ingredients: 2 cups white or black rice | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to grease a 9x13 baking dish or casserole dish. Slightly dampen and wash your hands well. You don't want them dry out.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,lamb shank,rose petal,spring onion,five spice powder,taco seasoning mix,msg
title: Lamb Shanks With Fresh Rose Petals
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb shanks, trimmed ( about 3 ) | 10 spring onions, chopped | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package dried tri-colored quail's nestle petals | 1 package crumbled five-spice powder | 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1 package farfalle pasta | 1/2 cup msg ( optional )
instructions: In a large stockpot over high heat, cook the lamb shanks until brown. Remove the shanks, and place in bowl of ice water. Set aside. Drain the fat from the stockpot, and place in a large slow cooker. Add the spring onions. Stir until onions are translucent. Mix together the taco seasoning mix, five spice powder, and 2 tablespoons 5 spice powder. Place shanks, meat, and accumulated juices in slow cooker. Reduce heat to low, and cover. Cook for 6 to 8 hours remove all the shanks. Discard bones and onions, and chop meat. Return meat and onion to stock pot. Add quail cracker nestle petals, and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove quail crackers and serve over rice and sauce. Optional, if desired, add some minced green onions. Serve with crumbled quail's nestle petals per serving. Note, quail's nestle petals are available at asian markets. If soup is cold and the ingredients are too hot for dinner, just reheat in a pot or frying pan to soften before serving.

Random Ingredients: chinese wine,mint leaf,olive,self rising flour,sirloin steak,dill pickle
title: Peking Steak
ingredients: 2 3/4 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, about 1-inch thick | 2 cups self rising flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons mixed dried mint leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill pickles | 2 tablespoons dry chinese wine | 2 tablespoons olive, drained
instructions: Place the sirloin steaks between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound with the flat side of a meat pounder to 1/4 inch thickness. Add the remaining ingredients to a large resealable plastic bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 4 to 10 hours. Remove the steaks, reserving the marinade. Brush the steaks with the marinade. Grill over hot coals, covered, for about 12 minutes, turning once, until lightly charred and cooked to your desired cut. Serve immediately.

title: Sauteed Zucchini Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 3 zucchinis, sliced 1/8-inch thick and cut into 1/8-inch rounds
instructions: Heat oil in a large saute pan over medium heat. Add zucchini.

title: Apricot Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 pound pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh apricots | 1/4 cup sweetened tea, or as needed | 4 leaves fresh basil | 2 cups plain yogurt
instructions: Place cardamom in a mortar and pound it into a paste with a pestle. Add pork, apricots, and sweetened tea or as needed until pork is very tender. Thread kababs onto skewers and brush with tea or milk. Grill kebabs over medium heat until lightly browned and cooked through, about 15 minutes.

title: Couscous Salad With  Lemon and Galliano
ingredients: 8 ounces medium couscous | 1 cup fresh lemonade | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 4 lemons | 1 cup grated galliano
instructions: In medium bowl, bring couscous to a boil with a couple tablespoons salted water. Boil 2 - 3 minutes, until tender and water is all absorbed. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Remove top 2 layers of cheesecloth and set aside in a large bowl. Grate lemons with citrus zest and juice, if using, and set aside. In remaining bowl add cooled couscous with lemonade, shredded lettuce and citrus zest. Toss. Drizzle with freshly squeezed olive oil, adding the extra mozzarella if using. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,garlic powder,almond,lemon juice zest,egg yolk,flat leaf parsley,extra virgin olive oil,iceberg lettuce
title: Tunisian Yogurt Egg Salad (Chiacotess)
ingredients: 6 egg yolks ( i used the 6 egg whites from a package from another good recipe ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/3 cup chopped blanched almond | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground gingerroot | 2 teaspoons granulated garlic or 2 teaspoons fresh minced garlic | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 -3 cups iceberg lettuce, preferably whole or torn, washed and dried
instructions: Place the egg yolks in a large bowl and whisk together the whisk until blended, then mix in the lemon zest, almonds, parsley, ginger, garlic, olive oil and stir until well combined. Add salt and pepper. Chill the mixture for 10 minutes or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator. Toss the chilled mixture with the iceberg lettuce and serve. Variation, after using this salad, use fresh parsley. This will make about 12 servings.

Random Ingredients: single cream,baking potato,apple cider,thai chili sauce
title: Spicy Potato Rounds
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes | 3 tablespoons thai sweet chili sauce | 2 teaspoons apple cider or 2 teaspoons coconut cream | 300 ml single cream
instructions: Scrub the potatoes, cut them in half lengthways and place on baking sheet cut side down. Bake at 200oc for 45 - 55 minutes or until soft. Cool slightly then peel & slice into rounds approx 1 & 1/2' thick. Pour the sweet chili sauce over the potatoes, coating all the slices. Beat the cream and pour over the whole potatoes. Bake, uncovered, for 20 - 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Scallops With Cream Malsian-Style Sausage (Sausages for Scallops in Lefse)
ingredients: 1/3 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet japanese sweet wine ) | 1 lb mild italian sausage, casings removed | 5 teaspoons bechamel sauce | 1 1/4 lbs sea scallops or 1 1/4 lbs baby clams, scrubbed
instructions: Dilute cream and mirin in a double boiler over very gently simmering water. When a small amount of hot cream begins to simmer, add sausage, stirring constantly until cooked through and light brown, about 5 minutes. Drain sausage with a slotted spoon and return it to the bechamel sauce. Add scallops with shells to sauce. Cover and simmer until scallops open slightly, about 5 minutes. Remove and discard shells and scallops from sauce and add to the sauce. Remove scallops from sauce and serve with sauce.

title: Chameed Cherries (Chinese BBQ) With Cherries
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dark sweet cherries ( or any cherry of your preferred ) | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate-covered roasted almonds ( or any almond paste ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon anise seed | glaze, for basting
instructions: If using cherry/lemonade mix up the ingredients and add cherries. Slightly coat the cherries in the glaze. Grill until they are just bubbly on top and turn over. Serve immediately with rice.

title: Egg Islands in Lobster Sauce
ingredients: 6 slices friedmeat | 4 eggs, hard boiled | 1/2 lb fresh mushroom | 16 lime wedges
instructions: Sauté the mushrooms lightly in a tablespoon or two of olive oil. Set aside as they are done. Hard boil the eggs and place in a serving dish. To serve put a slice of scrambled egg on each slice of friedmeat so that it is just about touching the egg white on the top. Place a mushroom on top. Garnish with lime. Serve with a lime wedge.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,anaheim chilies,lemon thyme,red onion,baking soda,rotel
title: Spicy Mexican Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb raw ramen noodles ( or other pasta will do in a pinch ) | 1 can rotel ( use regular diced, can use reduced sodium ) | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 1 anaheim chilies ( jalapeno or other chili would do in a pinch ) or 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped ( jalapeno or other chili would do in a pinch ) | salt and baking soda | 1 teaspoon lemon thyme
instructions: Boil the noodles according to package directions. While noodles are boiling, saute chopped onion and peppers in non stick skillet with salt and baking soda. Rinse noodles with cold water until cool enough to handle. When noodles are cooled and drained, break into large bite sized chunks. Rinse chilies with hands and drain liquid off. Drain in hot water to keep from skinning. When noodles are done in the microwave, drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Toss noodles with the veggies and the dressing, adding sour cream, if desired.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cumin,pimento green olive,olive oil,romaine lettuce leaf,cardamom,orecchiette pasta
title: Greek Cavatelli Salad With Pimenton & Oregeno
ingredients: 1 lb orecchiette pasta | 4 tablespoons olive oil, extra virgin | 1 lb pecorino romano cheese, shaved | 6 -8 green olives, sliced | 1 teaspoon cardamom | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 romaine lettuce leaf ( preferably baby leaf )
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package, rinse quickly in cold water and drain again. Meanwhile, use a large bowl, add oil to coat, add cheese, olives and remaining ingredients. Toss lightly to coat.

title: Hot Chili Oil
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 hot chile pepper - stemmed, seeded and minced | 2 cups chicken broth | 2 teaspoons ground hot paprika
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Saute peppers and chile pepper until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in chicken broth.

title: Caramelised Oranges & Fresh Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sugar or 6 tablespoons honey | 6 large egg yolks | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 100 g coarsely choppen fresh broccoli or 100 g frozen broccoli | 24 large lettuce leaves, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c / fan 160c / gas line a tray with 2 baking paper. Place the sugar in a bowl. Beat the egg yolks with the vanilla and a splash of water until thick and pale. Beat in 3 tbsp sugar/water/whipped cream. Halve the broccoli stalks and slice into thin 2cm lengths. Place in a roasting tray and top with the orange mixture. Cook the broccoli in the oven for 10 - 15 mins, stirring twice and adding a splash of water as it blanchens. Drain and return to the pan. Stir well and spoon over the caramelised/ginger. To serve, scatter broccoli on serving plates and place a portion of orange mixture over the top of each cup. Serve warm or cold.

title: Homemade Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 3 cups low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soy beans | 1 tablespoon chopped dried aniseed or 1 tablespoon dried anise extract | 1 dash allspice
instructions: Cook, cook, cook, and stir beef until no longer pink. Add beef broth, soy sauce, beans, dried anise or anise extract, and spices. Bring to boil then simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Feta in Banana Leaves
ingredients: 1/3 cup feta, crumbled | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 3 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 tablespoon sumac
instructions: In a food processor, combine cheese, pineapple, chicken soup, and sumac.

title: Pizza Margaritas-Cashews & Olives
ingredients: 1 cup cashews | 1/2 cup chopped frozen sweet olives | 1 tablespoon dried minced olive ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons wheat flour ( gluten-free if preferred ) | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons vodka
instructions: Toast cashews by following the instructions on the package, in a small skillet, over medium heat, stirring constantly until cashews are lightly browned and fragrant. Remove from heat and set aside to cool completely. Process cashews in a blender or food processor until finely ground. Toast olives in the skillet for about 3 minutes or until browned. Stir in cashew nut mixture and taco seasoning until combined and evenly distributed. To use, dip your fingers in vodka and coat the olives. Makes about 4 servings.

title: Quick and Easy Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo pastry | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Prepare an 11x7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Place the frozen phyllo pastry in a 9x9 inch baking dish. Cover evenly with plastic wrap, and lightly with the salt. Arrange the phyllo in a single layer on top of the salt until thoroughly covered. Bake in preheated oven, reducing the temperature to 375 degrees f. After 45 minutes, place the phyllo sheets on top, and bake for 2 more hours, adding the phyllo every 15 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Turn off the oven, and allow to sit for 15 minutes before removing all the phyllo sheets from the baking dish. If you have made this right away, allow to cool then cover with a damp cloth and refrigerate. When ready to serve, break off pieces of phyllo dough with a fork or cleaver. Roll with palms into 1 inch balls. Heat a skillet over medium heat and sprinkle with about 1 tablespoon of salt. Quickly place about 1 to 2 balls in the skillet, and flatten slightly, using a spatula. Cook until brown spots appear on the underside of the balls, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and season with remaining tablespoon of salt. Continue until all the balls are done. Serve warm.

title: Italian Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 4 slices salami | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Place barley in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for about 1 hour or until tender. Drain and allow to steam dry for a few minutes. Toast and cut into 1 inch cubes. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over barley and toss just before serving.

Random Ingredients: cherry brandy,white onion,parmesan cheese,cider,caraway seed,yellow bell pepper,pastry
title: Delicious Polish Cherry Pepper Pastries
ingredients: pastry for double-crust deep-dish double-crust pie | 1/2 cup white onion, chopped | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 cup cherry brandy, chopped | 2 tablespoons dry cider | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Roll your pastry out to fit the bottom of your tart ring. Fit into your tart shell bottom and set aside. Place your onions, peppers and caraway seeds in a small sauté pan, pour in the brandy and ignite quickly. Add the cherry brandy and cider. Allow to flame cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, add the parmesan cheese and set aside. Roll out your pastry on a lightly floured surface until it is a 3/4 1 inch thick rectangle. Using a 3 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, stamp out a circle, fit into your tart shell bottom and up the sides to form the lid. Pour your filling into your pastry pie, filling the circle. Bake at 425°f for 30 to 40 minutes. Allow to cool for 5 minutes, top with your favorite fruit and serve.

title: Edamame Tikkas
ingredients: 1 large bag frozen shelled edamame, thawed | 1/2 cup skim-milk natural yogurt | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1/4 cup hot water | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine edamame, yoghurt, vanilla sugar and hot water. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400°f butter 2 1/2 inch diameter glass baking dishes. Divide mixture evenly among dishes, and spread to coat evenly. Bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until heated through. Remove from oven, sprinkle with mace, and serve immediately. For a special tikkas, top with a dollop of yogurt.

title: Indian Ginger Beer
ingredients: 8 -10 lbs ginger ale ( i use miller lite ) | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 1/4 cup ginger ale, chilled
instructions: Mix all the beer ingredients together, pour into a 2 1/2 quart container and refrigerate for 4 days.

title: Mexican Tostadas
ingredients: 1/2 lb breadcrumbs ( about 3 per tortilla ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crushed red chile ( i love the heat but leave out if you really like heat ) ( optional ) | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and slivered ( 1/3 cup drained is just right ) | 16 -20 corn tortillas
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the bread crumbs, dried red chile, sundried tomatoes and the sun dried tomatoes. Roll into 1 balls and arrange on a platter. Chill for 1 hour. Place the tortillas between 2 sheets wax paper and cook at high for about 30 seconds on each side. Note, i like to roll the tortillas and keep in 2 plastic bags. When all tortillas are baked, dip each one in a bowl of tomato slest and set aside until all are warmed up i use a spatula to scoop up the tortillas and lay them in a baking dish covered with foil, making sure they are all snugly. Once the tortillas are warmed up, stack them up and place them under the broiler to get a nice dark golden brown crispy crust. If you are having a party, they can be served on warm buttered toast and sliced into wedges or tostados. If you are making a crowd, you can use less then 20 depending on number of guests. Note, i used my hands to make the bread crumbs and then had 2 batches which worked out.

title: Muesli Posole With Bacon
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup sultana | 8 large soft taco shells | 1 cup muesli ( greek thyme leaves ) | 3 cups cooked white hominy, drained | 9 teaspoons cake flour | 1 lime ( to squeeze onto posole prior to cooking )
instructions: Fry bacon until well browned, remove bacon and drain. Add the chopped friut and sultanas to the bacon drippings and saute until sizzling, adding only enough water to the pot to absorb all of the bacon drippings. Add the muesli with their liquid and mix well. Remove from heat. Dissolve tagli in this mixture and set aside. Combine the flour and the lime juice and then add to the bacon drippings and soup with the hominy. Continue stirring over low heat until soup comes to a boil, about 5 minutes. Serve with pita chips before slicing.

title: Caramelized Pineapple Salad - Microwave
ingredients: 2 -3 heads fresh pineapple | 1 bulb of garlic | 1 teaspoon marjoram, dried | 1/4 cup pineapple juice, reserved from pineapple
instructions: Peel and core the pineapple, leaving the core on the head whole and cutting away the peel. Cut into chunks and place them in a microwave safe bowl. Cut unpeeled garlic bulb into quarters and insert them into the chunks. Sprinkle over the marjoram and 1/4 cup reserved pineapple juice. Cover and microwave on high for 4 minutes. Remove lid and stir. Microwave on high for another 10 - 12 more minutes, till juices start to run clear. Allow to cool. Transfer to a serving bowl. Toss with the remaining 2 tablespoons reserved pineapple juice. Top with the reserved pineapple.

title: Coconut Halibut
ingredients: 1 lb halibut fillet | 1 cup light cream | 3 tablespoons coconut flakes
instructions: Bake or bbq halibut fillet until skin is crispy, about 5 minutes. While fillets bake, mix cream with coconut flakes. Place fillets on a serving platter and pour cream mixture over. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,chicken breast,cake flour,apple,beef bouillon cube
title: Apple Chicken Curry With Beef
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts or 6 chicken thighs | 1/4 kg cake flour | 3 tablespoons beef bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons black cardamom pods, crushed | 1 apple, chopped
instructions: Coat the chicken breasts in the spice mix, dust with flour, brown in a hot pan on both sides. Remove. Pour off all but about a tablespoon of fat from the pan and fry the apple chunks for a couple of minutes. Return chicken breasts to pan, pour over any excess oil and stir the apple bits around the chicken breasts as much as possible. Turn down the heat, cover, and fry for a further 30 mins, until tender. If your chicken is really fatty, put it back in and fry until the fat runs out. This will take about 20 mins as well. Serve with rice, potatoes if you like. This recipe can easily be doubled or tripled for larger quantities. A large packet of mixed sprouts goes a great gift when served with this curry.

title: Tex Mex Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 1 baguette | 1/2 medium boneless top round steak | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 cup quinoa | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1/8 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Season steaks with cumin. Place steaks on grill, cover, and grill for 8 minutes, or until well cooked. Transfer steak to a cutting board, and let sit for 5 minutes. Slice into thin slices about 1/4 inch thick. Meanwhile, combine quinoa, vinegar, and mirin in a microwave safe measuring cup or small saucepan.

title: Lemon Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs shrimp, peeled, deveined | 2 tablespoons limoncello or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Place shrimp in a large stainless steel or enamel saucepan and pour water over them to cover. Place over medium heat and simmer, covered, turning shrimp until they are bright pink on the outside and almost cooked through, 45 - 55 minutes. While shrimps are cooking, bring limoncello to a boil in a medium frying pan. Boil, uncovered, until reduced by 1/ stir in garam masala and cook, stirring, about 1 minute. With slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to warmed platter and pour sauce over. Serve warm.

title: Quick and Easy Raita
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ginger root, grated | 1 cup rice, uncooked | 1 1/4 cups low-fat buttermilk | 4 ounces low fat cream of chicken soup | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 cups cooked small pasta | 2 tablespoons low-fat mayonnaise
instructions: In a medium sized saucepan, heat the buttermilk to just below boiling point. Add in the cream of chicken soup, turmeric, and rice.

title: Pasta Custard Sauce
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled and quartered | 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 1 box pasta
instructions: Cook pasta per box instructions with a little salt. In a blender combine all ingredients including the cooked pasta. Process/blend until smooth. Pour into a bowl and serve immediately so pasta doesn't turn brown.

title: Tuscan Seafood Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb squid, cleaned, deveined and sliced | 1 large green shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 can kidney beans | spaghetti sauce | any other favorite seafood ( your favorites )
instructions: Start water boiling to cook spaghettini according to package directions. Meanwhile on a greased skillet fry mushrooms and scallop for 2 minutes. Drain any remaining liquid from the shrimp. Drain shrimp and put back in skillet with mushrooms and scallops. Heat through and stir in spaghetti sauce. Salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,beef shank,salad oil,spring onion,chili pepper,chachere seasoning,pineapple,graham cracker crumb
title: Jaeger Schnitzel
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless beef shank, at room temperature | 3/4 teaspoon chili pepper ( see note above ) | 2 tablespoons rice-wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 7 ounces crushed pineapple ( drained and slightly crushed ) | 1 teaspoon chachere's original creole seasoning or 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon graham cracker crumbs | 1 spring onion, finely chopped
instructions: For marinade, in a ziplock freezer bag, combine 2/3 of the chili pepper sauce and all the chopped onions and combine thoroughly. Add the pork shoulder and massage it into the meat, then marinade for 1 hour in the refrigerator. For the crumb topping, combine all the crumbs ingredients. Slice the pork and sprinkle over the crumb topping, then serve the pork with the remaining chili sauce.

Random Ingredients: tomato,rye bread,mexican tomato,celery seed,beef bouillon powder
title: Easy Cheesy Texas Style Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup sliced tomatoes | 1/4 cup chopped canned mexican-style tomatoes | 3 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon powder | 1/3 teaspoon celery seed | 8 slices sour rye bread
instructions: Place tomato halves in a small bowl. Add onion, beef bouillon powder, celery seed and remaining 1 1/2 cup salsa. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.

title: Garlic Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 pound garlic, peeled and cut into thin slices | 4 cans cannellini beans, drained | 4 cups oyster sauce
instructions: Place garlic and beans in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until garlic is translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in oyster sauce and simmer 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white hominy,guacamole,beef stew meat,creole seasoning,large curd cottage cheese,saffron thread,penne
title: Slow Cooker Santa Fe Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound dry rigatoni pasta | 1 can white hominy | 1 pound cubed beef stew meat | 1/4 cup creole seasoning | 1 package large curd cottage cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup chopped saffron threads | toasted guacamole : | 2 tablespoons crushed saffron threads, or to taste | 2 tablespoons crushed dried fenito cheese, or to taste | 2 tablespoons crushed dried fenito cheese, or to taste
instructions: Place rigatoni pasta, hominy, stew meat, and creole seasoning in a slow cooker. Cook on medium until hominy and meat are hot, 2 to 4 hours, depending on your cooker. Remove meat mixture from slow cooker. Mix together cottage cheese, 1/2 cup saffron threads, 1/2 cup cooked pasta, 1/2 cup pasta liquid, toasted saffron mixture, and 1/2 cup cooked pasta liquid until well blended. Spread meat mixture onto a serving dish, and top with guacamole, 1 tablespoon dried fenito cheese to taste, and 1 tablespoon crushed dried fenito cheese.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,baker semi chocolate,artichoke heart,cucumber,tahini,cayenne pepper
title: Beef and Vegetable Skewers
ingredients: 4 whole cloves garlic | 4 beef brisket, trimmed of most fat | 2 pounds cucumbers - peeled, seeded, and sliced in half lengthwise | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and sliced | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
instructions: Place the garlic cloves in a blender and puree until smooth. Slice the brisket across the grain into 1/8 inch thick slices. Toss the slices in 1/2 the garlic puree, cucumber slices, and artichoke hearts with the remaining garlic puree and tahini. Place the meat and marinated vegetables into a large resealable plastic bag with the marinade, seal, and toss to coat all the meat. Refrigerate overnight, turning the bag over halfway through marinating. Preheat grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate. Remove the meat from the bag and arrange slices on the grate on the lightly oiled grate 1/2 inch apart. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, or to desired degree of doneness.

title: Truffled Mint Pasta Sandwich
ingredients: 8 thin slices white bread | 1 jar tiny mint leaves | 1 jar miniature marshmallows | 9 thin slices white bread, cut into 3 triangles | 7 thin slices yellow peppers, cut into thin strips | 5 slices thin yellow pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 -4 cup crushed roasted and salted walnuts
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Place 4 thick slices of bread onto a baking sheet. Cover with a second piece of bread and butter top with the remaining bread in a thin round stack. Place a mint leaf atop each piece of bread, cover with another piece of bread, and spread each one liberally with melted butter. Place a hot yellow pepper strip onto each of the sandwiches. Place 3 hot yellow pepper strips atop the yellow peppers, a few strips of yellow pepper strips, 1/2 jar of marshmallows, 3 pieces of bread, 2 slices of bread, and 1 or 2 tablespoons of crushed peanuts into an oven proof skillet that has been lightly oiled and heated up. Place the skillet over low heat until the bread is golden on each side, about 15 minutes, and remove and place into the oven toaster. Repeat with the remaining bread and butter stack. Allow the toast sandwiches to rest for a few minutes, then place under the broiler and broil until the tops are browned and crisp, 3 to 4 minutes on each side.

title: French Croissant With Nutmeg (Or Spread With Milk)
ingredients: 10 plain croissants, split | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Pre heat sandwich maker. Split croissants lengthways, diagonally in half. Spread about 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg on both halves of each croissant. Place onto bread maker, close lid, and cook for 5 minutes after the 5 minutes, and then turn the bread out onto a plate, allow to cool. Eat with fresh cream, ice cream, syrup, fresh fruit, jam or milk.

title: Chiles and Almonds
ingredients: 4 large red chilies | 4 ounces almonds, toasted | 3 drops sesame seeds, toasted ( optional ) | 3 drops almond extract ( optional ) or 3 drops almond oil ( optional )
instructions: Place the dry red chilies in hot water for about 20 seconds. Remove from hot but not boiling water and set aside for 10 minutes. Rinse chilies under cold tap water and pat dry. Place in a nonstick skillet or wok and cover with approximately 1 1/2 cup of hot water. Heat over low heat. When just barely boiling, remove from heat and place 2 or 3 chilies in the hot water and continue cooking for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain the chilies and let completely dry out in a kitchen towel. Put 2 or 3 almonds in the food processor and process to a fine powder. Sprinkle in the sesame and almond extracts. Blend in the reserved chilies. When finished, store in refrigerator.

title: Cranberry Potato Bread
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups potatoes starch | 1 teaspoon canadian bacon fat | 1/2 lb canadian bacon, thinly sliced | 8 ounces fontina cheese, grated | 1 cup fresh cranberries, picked and cleaned | 1 teaspoon cake yeast | 1 cup oil, for frying
instructions: In a large bowl, place the potatoes flour and bacon fat. Drain the canadian bacon, reserving the grease in the skillet. Saute the bacon in the fat until light brown. Add the cheese, cranberries, and yeast. Stir until well blended. Let cool to room temperature. Preheat the oven to 350°f. Grease an 8x8 inch loaf pan. Stir the cooked bread into the cheese mixture. Add enough of the wine or milk to cover the bottom of the pan. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. The next day, preheat the oven to 350°f. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until well puffed and golden brown. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes.

title: Chorizo & Couscous Quiche
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry ( approx 1/2 lb ) | 1 1/2 lbs ground chorizo sausage | 2 1/2 cups couscous | 1/2 cup kahlua ( coffee-flavored liqueur ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 can refrigerated pie shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees farenheit and generously butter a 13x9 baking dish. Prepare the phyllo pastry by laying out four sheets of filo pastry on a work surface. Start layering the filo into a 2+inch wide, 10x15 inch rectangle. Begin layering the rest of the filo sheets on another cutting board. Take each sheet of filo and cut in half on each side, trying to maintain pieces of filo that are at least 1x3 inches, from a previous piece of filo that are already thicker. You may have to cut more than this. Cut each piece in half again to make 4 large rectangles. Lay the filo pieces in the baking dish and brush with the kahlua / coffee liqueur. Then sprinkle the gruyere over the top. You must be careful that the pastry do not soak up the kahlua. Lay the phyllo dough in the baking dish and brush with the remaining kahlua. You’ll still have a phyllo layer with a layer of phyllo that is thicker than the phyllo. Make sure you have layered the phyllo as evenly as you can. Cut the pastry in half so that you have 4 squares. This means your final product won’t be fan coated in kahlua on top and you have two layers of phyllo. You may have to eyeball it for a while to get it the exact thickness of the phyllo you would like. You’ll probably have to eyeball this and give it a final cut for me. Bake for about 50 minutes, checking until the top is golden brown and the phyllo pastry has puffed up. This should take about 7 to 8 minutes. Allow the quiche to cool for at least 10 minutes, then carefully transfer it to a cutting board and allow it to cool slightly before cutting. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Grilled Halwa (Zucchini & Ham With Pistachios)
ingredients: 4 slices grilled ham, cut to 2 by 1/4 by 1/4 | 2 zucchini, halved lengthwise | 12 dried red chilies, soaked in hot water for 20 minutes then drained and sliced crosswise | tabasco sauce or other hot red pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons shelled pistachios, chopped | 1 tablespoon granulated sugar | 1 cup maldive fish, chopped into 3/4-inch pieces
instructions: Brush the ham and zucchini with sauce and grill over moderately hot coals, turning, for 15 minutes or until zucchini is golden. Remove the ham and zucchini from skillet and arrange on a serving platter. Sprinkle with chiles, arrange on top and sprinkle with sugar and pistachios. Grilled diagonally, ham and zucchini may be grilled over moderate coals for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Drizzle with remaining sauce and serve.

title: Authentic Restaurant Dry Roasted Chile Rind
ingredients: 3 chiles, rinsed | 4 loaves italian bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f. Place the rinsed chili pods on a cookie sheet, or large baking sheet and lightly roast in oven for 30 minutes, turning every 5 minutes. Remove chili pods, cool, and place the pods upright in a roasting pan. Roast in the preheated oven for 1 1/4 hours, or until the pods have roasted to a rich golden color and begin to pop open. Stuff the chiles with the roasting chile and let cool to room temperature or room temperature before serving.

title: Limima-Lamur (Soup)
ingredients: 2 cups lima beans | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a food processor. Serve cold.

title: Chili Noodles
ingredients: 16 ounces wide egg noodles | 2 pints thin chili paste ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup tequila ( to taste ) | fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Boil large pot of water. While waiting for water to boil, slice chili paste thinly, and mix with hot water until no red remains.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,english cucumber,pie shell,escarole,red wine,pancetta,mayonnaise,taco seasoning mix
title: Easy Baked Spanish Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 lb english cucumbers, unpeeled | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 lb pancetta | 3 cups escarole, cut bite sized pieces | pancetta, cut into thin strips, to taste | best quality homemade mayonnaise ( for dipping, i used light and hellman's brand )
instructions: Slice cucumbers in half length wise and scoop out excess water. Arrange slices in a large bowl or serving platter. Sprinkle taco seasoning over cucumbers. Pour red wine and mayonnaise over cucumbers. Top with pancetta strips. Cover with plastic wrap or paper towels and keep in refrigerator until ready to serve. Serve with mayonnaise or guacamole at room temperature.

title: Rosemary Beer Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup sweet barbecue sauce | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed
instructions: Place all ingredients in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,tomato puree,urad dal,plain yogurt,basmati rice,champagne,french baguette,meat
title: Moussaka
ingredients: 500 g cooked meat, in little cubes | 400 g cooked basmati rice | 400 g ready to eat french baguettes, cut into thick diagonal slices | 200 ml thick plain yogurt | 140 ml tomato puree | 100 ml champagne | 1 french baguette, cut into thick diagonal slices | 200 g feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of yogurt in a small bowl and add the tomato puree. Mix and set aside. Toast the bread slices in a dry pan over a low heat and set aside. To serve, place 5 slices of bread into a large glass bowl. Cover with a layer of meat, then top with a layer of rice, then a layer of the cooked meat and finally with a layer of balfalfa and feta cheese. Repeat layering with the top and last slice of bread. Serve with warm lemon and olive oil pikitas and a small glass of wine per person.

title: Lebanese Spiced Lemonade
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups lemonade, frozen | 6 -10 cardamom pods
instructions: Add lemonade to a tall glass or tall mug and add the cardomon pods. Stir to mix thoroughly. Pour over ice into a glass. Chill for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Chinese Cabbage and Navy Beans
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage, quartered | 1 cup canned navy beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cups chicken broth | 1/4 cup unsalted hazelnuts, toasted | grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Put the cabbage in a large pot with just enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Cover, and simmer for 40 minutes or until tender. While the cabbage cooks, heat the broth in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the beans and hazelnuts. Cook and stir until the mixture is heated through. Spoon the bean and hazelnuts mixture into the cabbage, and sprinkle on top. Serve hot.

title: Chinese Red Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 12 medium red potatoes | 1/8 cup sweet chili paste ( sambal oelek )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Spray a medium baking sheet with cooking spray. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Add the potatoes. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until fork tender and potatoes coated with a thin film of oil about 3 to 4 minutes. Place on prepared sheet and brush with chili paste. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 30 to 35 minutes or until tender and lightly browned. Variation, add about 1/2 cup crushed red pepper flakes to the potatoes. Use as a topping for fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,red chili pepper,yogurt,extra virgin olive oil,pecan,vegetable stock,parsley flake
title: Hot Yogurt in Oil
ingredients: 300 ml thick natural-style yogurt, drained | 1/2 - 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 -3 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 tablespoon dried red chili pepper ( or green chilis ) | 1/2 cup chopped pecans ( optional ) | 2 -4 tablespoons vegetable stock
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Taste and adjust seasoning. Spoon into serving dishes or shallow bowls. Cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Nigella's Noodle and Mamoula
ingredients: 8 ounces ladyfingers or 8 ounces egg noodles | 4 ounces miso | 2 ounces dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons light heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: In a small pot boil water for the noodles. Mix miso, cream, spices, sugar and miso mixture. Cook noodles in it for 1 minute over medium heat. Place noodles in a serving dish and pour sauce over top.

title: Fried Tomatoes in Saffron Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs tomatoes ( firm or ripe ) | 3 tablespoons good quality soy sauce ( or tamari ) | 1 pinch saffron
instructions: Heat a cast iron skillet over high heat. When its surface turns a deep golden brown, place the pan into the hot oil.. Cut tomato in half on the cut side. Take a half teaspoon of the saffron seeds into a small jar with a lid and rub it lightly into the tomato halves, pushing any seeds into the stem if they crackle, put it in the hot oil. Fry until golden, but still a bit chewy, about 3 minutes. Remove and set side. Continue frying remaining tomatoes till the tomatoes are a rich golden colour all over, about 15 minutes, adding the soy or tamari little by little while frying the tomato halves. It is possible to test the consistency of the sauce. Serve hot or cold as an accompaniment to meat dishes.

title: Easy Microwave Hoagie
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato, unpeeled | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 3 scallions, sliced diagonally | 8 hoagie rolls
instructions: Cut unpeeled potato in half and cut lengthwise in half. Using the tines of a fork, poke holes in the potato flesh with cuts about a quarter inch deep. Microwave, uncovered, on high for 1 hour or until fork can easily pierce potato with a sharp knife. When potato is tender, poke with a fork again, remove from microwave and let stand 10 minutes, or until cool enough to handle. Cut potato into 1/4 inch cubes. Using a spoon, mash potato to desired consistency. Add scallions, chicken bouillon and 1 teaspoon water and continue cooking on high until heated through, stirring to coat. Serve cut into small pieces.

title: Peruvian Tablecloth Pork Balls
ingredients: 1/2 liter white wine | 1/2 liter white flour | 1/2 liter pork fat | 3 serrano peppers | 200 -300 g dates | 8 -10 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: To make marinade, put all ingredients in a bowl and blend until smooth and smooth. Set aside. Cut the stem end off the serrano chillies. Remove any veins if desired. Use a sharp knife to slice the inside of the chillies. Set aside. Slice the body into about 1 inch long pieces. Slice the meat into about 1 inch lengths. Make sure all pieces are roughly the same thickness. Roll the pork into thin fat balls. Dip meat into the marinade for a few minutes on each side. Remove pork balls with tongs, and place in a dish. Put some water into the bottom of a large pot. When the water is at a boil, add in the pork balls and let them boil until they start floating. Cook at a slow simmer until they turn a nice brown color, approximately 2 hours. If you prefer a thicker sauce, add in a bit of cornstarch to thicken the sauce. When done, check to make sure there is enough cornstarch and some water to thicken the sauce, remove from heat, remove from heat once the sauce reaches the desired consistency.

title: Buttermilk and Herb Bread
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 cup pomegranate seeds in natural juice or 1 cup pomegranate juice | 1/2 teaspoon sage or 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon ground gingerroot ( or 1/4 tsp. grated fresh ginger ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mustard ( or 1/2 tsp. ground mustard ) | 1 lb loaf sourdough bread | 1 loaf sliced baguette or 1 loaf other fresh loaf
instructions: In a bowl, combine the buttermilk and seeds and let set overnight. The next day, combine the sage, ginger, mustard and the buttermilk mixture. Slice the bread into 10 slices on the diagonal. Spread slices with the mustard mixture and place on baking paper. Spread mustard mixture on tops. Place the bread on the mustard topped bread, then close with the bread loaf, buttered sides up. Lightly toast under a preheated broiler. Slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,cheddar cheese,hot red chili pepper,chocolate ice cream
title: Sweet Chilli and Cheddar Coleslaw
ingredients: 125 g cabbage, shredded | 125 g cheddar cheese, diced | 1 fresh hot red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 375 g chocolate ice cream
instructions: Place shredded cabbage and cheese in a large salad bowl. Add dried chilli and hot red chilli. Add cold icecream and stir into mixture. Chill and serve.

title: Chinese Noodle Soup
ingredients: 13 1/2 ounces asparagus | 1/2 lb whole wheat spaghetti | 1 dried chili pepper
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Chop asparagus into 1/2 inch slices. Place hot spaghetti in microwave safe bowl. Cover with boiling water for 3 minutes or until pasta is tender. Drain. Sprinkle with chili pepper and serve.

title: Fish Pie from Granny's Oven
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fish, cut into serving pieces | 1 cup corned beef chuck, chopped and skinned | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 2 tomatoes | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons apricot jam
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Place half cooked, skin on tomatoes into a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with half grated swiss gruyere cheese. Top with the fish pieces, then eggplants. Sprinkle with half the remainder of the cheese. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Place remaining tomatoes on top and bake, uncovered, for another 15 - 20 minutes. Serve.

title: Basil Garlic Chicken Sub Sandwich
ingredients: 4 frozen hoagie rolls, thawed | 4 carrots, shredded | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Mince 1/4 cup of carrots into a paste using a microplane. Place all ingredients into the crockpot and stir well to combine. Put contents of the crockpot in crockpot, cover and cook on high for 4 - 6 hours until carrots are cooked, stirring every hour if desired. Remove meat from the crockpot and discard/discard vegetables.

title: Caribbean Style Carne
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck ( blade blade ) or 4 lbs stew meat, with bone ends cut 1 inch thick | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 tablespoons nonfat sour cream | 2 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f place meat in shallow roasting pan. Brush with oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake meat in oven for 30 minutes. Shake pan, add sour cream and butter, and bake for another 30 - 45 minutes or until desired doneness. Spoon off the fat.

title: Hummus (Chicken & Mashed Potatoes)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon cauliflower, chopped | 4 large cooked chicken, cubed | 5 -6 kalamata olives ( for each serving )
instructions: Place the baking powder in a small bowl and mix into a paste with a dash of salt. Combine the olive paste and garlic crumbles and add to the bread cubes. Cook the chicken in olive oil on medium heat until it is cooked. Add the cauliflower and cook until it is slightly crisp and cooked through. Add the remaining ingredients and mix. Serve.

title: Cucumber and Salsa Salad
ingredients: 2 small lebanese cucumbers, scrubbed | 1 jar salsa ( any kind of medium salsa, i prefer herdez )
instructions: Boil the water and drain cucumbers into a colander lined with a cheese cloth. Once cool squeeze out the excess water and place in a large bowl. Toss with salsa and serve.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,vegetable shortening,lemon juice zest,avocado
title: Avocado Sticks
ingredients: 1 ripe avocado | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening
instructions: Cut avocado in half lengthwise and remove pit. Remove skin, but do not remove. Using a fork, mash avocado with lemon peel. Combine cheese, juice and zest. Cut shortening into avocado slivers. Spoon filling into avocado halves. Sprinkle with more cheese.

title: Smoked Smoked Salmon and Plantain Pudding(Saffron)
ingredients: 2 large ripe plantains, sliced lengthwise into 1/4-inch rings and placed in a steamer basket ( about 6-7 cups ) | 1/2 cup light cream ( may use whipping cream ) | 1/2 tablespoon paprika | 3 1/2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter, can use margarine ) ( optional ) | 1 -2 cup smoked salmon, shredded | fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place the plantains on a non stick baking sheet and sprinkle with salt.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,lemon pepper,topping,cherry tomato,pecorino romano cheese
title: Baked Tomatoes With Topping Crust
ingredients: 14 fresh cherry tomatoes | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 120 g pecorino romano cheese or 120 g asiago cheese | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping ( optional ) | lemon pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius. Place cherry tomatoes on a baking tray, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with the bicarb soda. Bake until tomatoes are soft and lightly caramelized. Put cheese on top and sprinkle with the lemon pepper. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,white potato,natural bran,leek,garlic clove,co lettuce,cocoa powder,cream tartar
title: Potato Health Scones
ingredients: 500 g white potatoes | 600 g onions ( peeled, thinly sliced and thinly sliced lengthways ) | 2 garlic cloves, finely chopped | 1 leek, finely sliced lengthways ( white and light green parts only ) | 100 g natural bran | 1 lemon, juice and rind | salt pork, to taste ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar ( optional and to taste )
instructions: Cut the potatoes into thick wedges. Place in a large saucepan of boiling water. Boil for 15 - 20 minutes, then drain and cool slightly, then put through a potato ricer. Return the potato to the pan with all of the sliced onions. Melt the cocoa powder in a frying pan. Add the bran, lemon rind, garlic and a few drops of lime juice. Stir until well combined and cook, stirring, until the bran is very dark brown. Take care not to let the liquid smoke when stirred. Remove from the heat and stir in the cream of tartar. Add the sauted potato mixture to the toppings and mix well. Put the mixture on a baking sheet and bake at 230°c / 425°f / gas 4 for 25 - 30 minutes, mixing frequently. Cut the scone shapes into 5cm / 1 inch / 1 in / 1 in / 3 in / 3 in / 2 in / 5 in / 5 in / 2 in / 2 in / 5 in / 6 in / 9 in / 2 in / 5 in / 8 in / 4 or 6 in / 25 in / 75 inches / 75 inches / 75 inches / 10 in / 60 inches / 75 inches / 75 inches / 10 in / 6 inches / 4 in / 12 in / 2 in / 3 ft / 5 in / 6 inches in / 5 in / 4 ft / 3 in / 5 in / 5 in / 4 in / 6 ft / 5 in / 28 inches / 5 inches / 5 inches / 4 in / 4 in / 6 inches / 5 ft / 5 in / 6 inches / 5 in / 6 inch / 5 in / 6 in / 5 inches / 5 in / 6 and push together firmly. Using a skewer or a wooden spoon, make small indentations in the top of the scone and pop them into the hot liquid or brush them with a little water / butter or oil to make them stick. Cover and cook gently for five minutes, tossing twice. Remove and leave to cool slightly before handling, as this will create them chewy skins, and will make them tough if eaten slightly before eating.

title: Seitan-Peach Beef With Peaches and Barley
ingredients: 6 beef ribs, cut into 1- to 2-inch pieces | 8 -12 ounces dried shiitake ( or other dried fish ) | 1 bag frozen sliced pecorino romano cheese | 1 can peach-peach rusks or ( 16 ounce ) bag sliced peaches | 1 cup dry barley | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place beef in crockpot, pour in any remaining fat and add any seasonings from the shrimp, shiitake and olives. Cook on low or 4 hours until the beef is tender and the flavors blend. Add peas during the last 45 minutes of cooking the beef. After 45 - 50 minutes, add the wheat barley and cook for 15 more minutes or until barley is tender and the sauce is smooth. Serve over brown rice, if desired. Or just eat it as is or use some leftover pot roast. If you prefer to use canned peas and peaches, serve them on top of your wheat barley as well for a change of pace.

title: Bucatini (Shrimp and Red Cabbage Lasagna)
ingredients: 12 sheets lasagna noodle | 1 1/2 pounds red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 bunch spring onions, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange a single layer of noodles in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread about a cup of cabbage on top of the noodles and add about half the sliced spring onions. Repeat layers until all of the ingredients are used. Top with a second layer of noodles and top with more cabbage slices. Sprinkle with remaining spring onions. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Reduce heat, place covered dish on a baking sheet, and bake for another hour.

title: Pesto Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/4 pound semolina, coarsely ground | 1 teaspoon mixed pulses ( pesto ) | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 4 ounces dried tubular pasta shells, cooked and drained
instructions: Combine semolina.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,milk ricotta cheese,rice vinegar,snow pea,lemon,baking soda,white balsamic vinegar,strawberry
title: Summer Squash Sushi
ingredients: 2 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 cup shredded snow peas ( about 1 cup ) | 1/2 cup diced dried strawberries | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3 tablespoons brown rice or 3 tablespoons sushi rice | 1 lemon, cut into wedges
instructions: Mix together ricotta, 1 cup each of snow peas, strawberries and balsamic vinegars in a medium bowl. Season to taste with salt. Stir in brown rice, then spread on a cutting board lined with waxed paper or plastic wrap. Pat into a 1 1/2 inch thickness. Cut with a 4 inch round cutter from a 1 1/2 inch square box cutter. Arrange on the waxed paper using a spatula. Cover with waxed paper or plastic wrap and keep in a cool place or refrigerator until ready to use, up to a week. Heat a bamboo sushi rolling mat or steamer over medium high heat. When it is heated, gather the pieces of rice and snow peas and roll them into long long ropes that are about 2 inches long and 1/4 inch wide. Arrange the rolls on the bamboo mat so they make a pouch on the top and bottoms. Place the rice over the top and press gently to compact everything. Seal tightly, enclosing the ends and ends of the bamboo mat and rolling it over to make a circle. Use a fork to poke several small holes in the top layer of rice and nuts, if necessary. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and keep in the cool place until ready to use. Slice to serve. Wrap and refrigerate leftovers in plastic wrap or a damp paper towel for up to a week. Remove from the bamboo mat to serve. Serve with lemon wedges, if desired.

title: Rice Vinegar Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2 & quot, thick slices | 3/4 cup seasoned rice vinegar | 1 can diced tomatoes
instructions: Combine beef and rice vinegar in a shallow dish and mix thoroughly. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for several hours. Drain beef slices, reserving marinade. Barbecue beef over hot coals or on grill, basting occasionally, until cooked to desired doneness, about 10 minutes.

title: Roasted Honey (Agua Al Bara)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Put honey, honey & liquid smoke in tightly covered jar. Wash & dry jars & let stand 30 minutes. Heat oven to 350f.

title: Yummy Beef and Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cube | 1 mango, peeled, seeded and sliced
instructions: Cook the ziti according to package directions. When the ziti is just tender drain the water. Add the beef, bouillon cube and mango slices into the ziti and toss. Serve with fresh bread.

title: Breaded Penne
ingredients: 1 package dry penne | 2 cups chopped pepperoncini peppers | 1 tablespoon dried greek oregano
instructions: Cook the penne according to package directions. Meanwhile, stir together the pepperoncini, oregano, and 1/2 cup of water in a large skillet. Cook 5 to 10 minutes, just until the sauce is thickened, but not too liquid. Drain pasta.

title: White Poached Pears With Hominy and Rice (Sopa Seca Y Papillote)
ingredients: 2 lbs pears, ripe | 1 cup white hominy, drained | 2 cups white breadcrumbs | 3 cups uncooked white rice
instructions: Wash and de stem pears. Trim off stem end pips. Wash and rinse well under cool running water, drain and allow to dry a little while. Remove as much husks and white pith as possible off of 1 strip of thick skin on each pear. Cut away the stem, being careful not to tear the pears so much that they collapse and turn a little sad. Trim off the white parts of the peel with a sharp knife. Remove the stem from the outside of each pear so that none of the white pith remains. Trim the outside of the pears with a sharp knife so that none of the pink is left. Place the pears in a small pot and cover with about a cup or a little more of the water. Place a plate, preferably one with high sides, on top of the pears to keep them submerged. Bring the water just to boiling and then turn down the heat. Cook until the pears are tender, about 50 - 60 min.., depending of ripeness. Test the liquid level and taste for salt. When they are done, you should have at least 1 1/2 cups of clear liquid in the pot. You can test if the liquid level sinks to about the level of the top of the pears, which should not be too watery. Remove the pears to another plate and put in the drained hominy. Wipe the rice with a damp cloth or kitchen towel to remove most of the excess moisture. Return to the same pot with the pears. Add about 2 cups of the reserved water, about 4 c. At a time, stirring until the rice is tender but not mushy. Add more water to cover the rice as needed. Wash the rice with a damp cloth. Place the rice, pears and pears in the poached, drained hominy and mix gently. If the mixture seems dry, add additional water. If the mixture seems wet, add additional water. Continue to add about 1/2 cup water to cover the rice, and about 3 cups of the hominy. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove the plate, add more water if needed and continue the cooking, covered, for another 5 - 10 minutes or until all the liquid has absorbed. Serve hot.

title: Sweet and Savory Kale Salad
ingredients: 4 cups kale ( about 1 bun ) | 2/3 cup chopped cheese ( preferably queso blanco ) | 3 tablespoons kale-leaf salad salad dressing ( such as miracle whip or your favourite ) | 3 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup
instructions: Chop kale with kale stems and stems. Place kale, cheese, salad dressing and rice wine vinegar in a large bowl. Toss to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salad dressing or other seasoning as necessary.

title: Clams Casino
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lobster meat, cooked ( lobster if available ) | 1 red bell pepper, roasted, peeled and cut into strips | 2 lbs cooked clams | 1/2 cup sherry wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except for lobster meat, in a 3 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours. Remove cover and stir clams into sauce. Cook for 1/2 an hour more. Serve as a main course or side dish with fried plantains. Note, i use boneless thighs instead of shrimp and crab meat for this recipe i used boneless chicken. Great with potatoes and salad.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,ladyfinger,salmon,hazelnut,jumbo shrimp,green bell pepper,almond extract,red cabbage
title: Sukuma
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sliced almonds | 1 pound boneless sirloin tip roast, sliced 1/2 inch thick | 10 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 green bell pepper, finely chopped | 14 ounces smoked salmon, cut into chunks | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 bag warm ladyfingers | 2 small red cabbage, cut into wedges
instructions: Soak almonds in a small amount of water for 20 to 30 minutes. Drain and set aside. Cut sirloin tip roast into thin bite size pieces and place in a large skillet. Cook over medium high heat until browned. Add shrimp, green bell pepper, and orange bell pepper. Stir, and cook for about 1 minute. Stir in almonds, and sprinkle with almond extract. Add bread fingers and continue stirring over medium heat for 2 or 3 minutes until warm. Arrange bread fingers and the vegetables on a serving platter. Surround with warm berries. Serve and enjoy.

title: Tropical Cherry Tomato Salad
ingredients: 12 cups cherry tomatoes ( about 11 ounces ) | 1 can red cherries, drained and liquid reserved | 1/3 cup curry powder
instructions: Place cherry tomatoes in a large salad bowl, and toss with juice from cherry tomatoes, reserved liquid, and curry powder. Add cherries to cherry tomatoes. Chill until serving.

title: Couscous With Venison and Chilies
ingredients: 32 ounces frozen venison or 32 ounces ground turkey | 2 teaspoons dried pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce or 2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1/3 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon poppy seed ( i used sunflower seed ) | 1/3 cup green chilies | cooked couscous
instructions: Spray pam in a 10 skillet or pot with non stick cooking spray or grease. Slightly brown venison and set aside. To prepare pesto sauce.

title: Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 medium jalapeno pepper, chopped | 1 medium red onion, chopped | 1 cup frozen corn, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Grease a 10 inch loaf pan and line the bottom with parchment paper. In a mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, pepper, red onion, corn, mace, salt and pepper. Mix well and place mixture into prepared loaf pan. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 400°f for 30 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chile Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 3 tablespoons diced red chile pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the cream cheese, chile peppers, and red chile pepper. Serve with fresh vegetables of your choice.

title: Kosher Jewish Chopped Vegetables
ingredients: 1 head turnip, pared, halved if large | 3/4 cup pitted kalamata olive, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper. Arrange half of the turnip halves on baking sheet.

title: Pea and Camembert Parfait
ingredients: 4 ounces camembert cheese, cubed | about 1 1/2 cups peas | 4 -5 cups ice water
instructions: Soak the peas in water for as long as possible because they will absorb allot a lot of water during cooking. The water is used to poach the peas. This method of soaking tends to work well, but if the peas are still too runny, you may take a few minutes longer. Remove the peas from water and bring them together with their cooking water to a boil. Drain, and set aside. Toss the camembert with the peas in a large saucepan. Add the ice water. Random Ingredients: black bean garlic sauce,seasoning,tomato clam juice cocktail,mustard powder
