instructions: Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling, slated water for 10 to 12 minutes or until tender. Drain and transfer to a serving bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir gently to combine. Place bowl over direct heat and whisk until warm.

title: The French Kiss
ingredients: 2 ounces cointreau liqueur | 2 ounces cognac
instructions: Pour the cointreau into 2 shot glasses then add cognac. Stir.

Random Ingredients: spam,ginger garlic paste,grain white rice,asiago cheese,lard

instructions: First roast the onion in hot oil then add ginger and crushed aniseeds into frypan add pumpkin spice and fry for two minutes add to a baking tray then bake in a moderate oven on 150 degrees celcius for 40 minutes.

Crumble and add to a large bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients and mix until well blended. Chill at least 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Mochi Shrimp Bake
ingredients: 16 ounces sliced fresh shrimp in juice | 1 can condensed cream of potato soup | 1/2 cup cooking wine | 2 packages french fries, thinly sliced | 12 ounces bittersweet chocolate | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spray baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Slice shrimp into strips about 3/8 inch wide and 1/2 inch long, and arrange in one layer over bottom of baking dish. Stir condensed soup, wine, and shrimp juice in a bowl. Place french fries over top of shrimp, and then sprinkle chocolate over top. Beat egg yolk with a fork, and then pour over the top sprinkle with the grated celtic or cinnamon, and drizzle with a bit more of this if desired. Bake 30 minutes, covered, stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Hot Pepper Potstickers (Mais Bienen)
ingredients: 3 lbs oxtails, frozen | 6 ounces chili paste ( muir glen hot spicy ) | 1/2 teaspoon szechwan pepper | 6 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Peel the oxtail and cut into 3/4 or less. Put the frozen peppers and garlic cloves into a large saucepan and pour hot water over them. Heat on the stovetop until the water boils and then simmer very slowly. Do not boil at all. The water may be boiling because of the frozen oxtail. It should be frozen once all the water is gone, if not let it cool. When it is ready, take the oxtails out of the cooking water and put through 2 clean cuts a lengthwise in half of the oxtails. Place back in the water. Do the same with the other halves of the oxtails. They will cook very quickly depending on how thick you want them to be, but you can tell they are ready when they take a couple of minutes to chill. Place the cooked oxtails into a large covered dish and refrigerate for at least two hours, until cold again. To serve, place the frozen pepper potsstickers into a large soup pot and cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Simmer, covered, on the lowest heat for 15 minutes. Turn off the heat and let steam for an additional 20 to 25 minutes. Serve cold, with the pepper bowls, rice and a side salad. The hot pepper potsstickers can be frozen at this stage.

title: Pepperoncini Sauce(Korean Marinated Pepperoncini)

instructions: Dice peppers into 1/4 inch chunks. Place the pieces in a container, pour rice wine over, cover tightly and shake. If you really do need to keep the sauce, you can marinate the peppers in 1/4 cup white wine, 1/4 cup mushroom liquid, 2 sprigs parsley or cilantro in a small bowl. Serve. Note, if desired, can be used as a dip for meat or poultry.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,olive oil,masa harina,ice,jalapeno pepper,self rising flour
title: Easy Spanish Tortilla

instructions: You could also do this by hand. Cook 1 cup of rice at a time with 1 cup of water. This will be done as soon as half the water has been absorbed. If the tortilla starts to brown or change color immediately, turn back on the oven to 250 for 15 minutes. Let the tortilla cool until you can work with it. You could also do this step on a plate and serve it as is. Variation, instead of masa add 1 tbls corn starch and 2 tbls water.

ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cut in 1 1/2 in cubes | 1 lb pinto beans | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 tablespoons brandy | 6 wedges lime wedge | 2 -3 kiwi, seeded and cut in wedges
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot and cook on low for 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,feta,extra virgin olive oil,red chili pepper,greek olive
title: Greek Olive Spread
ingredients: 14 ounces greek olives | 10 ounces feta | 1 red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Mix in mortar or food processor, then mix in olives. Add feta, chili pepper, olive oil, and a little bit of irish cream.

title: Nectarine Preserve
ingredients: 2 lbs nectarines, ripe | 1 bottle seedless raisin | 1 bottle vanilla
instructions: Slice nectarines in rounds with a sharp knife.

title: Lebanese Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons spiced butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Take your largest baking sheets. Put the butter into a small bowl and mix with your hands until they are really creamy. Add the flour, baking powder and remaining ingredients to the butter mix and mix until they combine. If it is too dry add a couple more tablespoons of water. Take your baking sheets and spread 1/2 teaspoonfuls of the mix onto each sheet. I start with 5 or 6 in my size. If you need more mix 1/4 inch or less and press the mix down. Use a pastry brush to apply on the grated topping and spread with your favorite jam or preserves and decorate with sesame seeds, sunflower seeds or sunflower oil. Store in an airtight container. It will keep for a couple of weeks until needed.

title: Catch of the Islands - Crawfish Stew
ingredients: 12 whole fresh asparagus | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 cup shredded coconut | 10 small basil leaves | 2 1/2 pounds crawfish, peeled
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted boiling water and bring to a rolling boil. Meanwhile, cut ends off asparagus spears and cut off the heads. Chop the asparagus, including the stems, and place in a large bowl. Bring remaining water with tomatoes, rinsed and chopped asparagus, raisins and coconut to a boil in the pot. Reduce heat and simmer until asparagus is tender, about 20 minutes. Cut crawfish into chunks. Stir crawfish chunks into tomato mixture.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,egg noodle,cinnamon sugar,farfalle pasta,cajun seasoning,buttermilk
title: Cheater's Kugel for Z's Breakfast
ingredients: 8 ounces buttermilk | 1 teaspoon cinnamon sugar, or more if needed | 1 1/4 cups dry egg noodles | 1 1/4 cups irish cajun seasoning | 5 cups ice cubes, or as needed | 1/4 cup cajun seasoning | 1 package wide egg noodles, broken into small pieces
instructions: Stir together the buttermilk and cinnamon sugar in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves. In a separate bowl combine the egg noodles, irish cajun seasoning, and ice cubes.

Random Ingredients: fruit,mustard,plain soymilk,white flour,dark soy sauce,button mushroom
title: Porcupine Mushrooms (Mustards and Sauce)
ingredients: 300 g button mushrooms | 300 ml plain soymilk | 50 ml dark soy sauce | 20 ml dry mustard | 30 g white flour | 120 g low-fat plain soymilk
instructions: Clean and chop the mushrooms. Heat a griddle or frying pan. Pour in 250ml of soy milk. Add mushrooms. Stir the mix continuously. Add the rest of the soy milk, mustard and flour, until mixture thickens and turn into a pudding like consistency. Dab a cube of aluminium foil, and place on top of the mushroom mixture. Wrap foil around the mushrooms. Fold. Seal the inside of the foil. Place on the grill or pan. Cook for 6 minutes. Serve with bread.

title: Eggplant and Mushroom Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 extra large eggplant, peeled and sliced lengthways | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon oyster mushrooms | 1 -2 drop hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Heat ghee or butter in a non stick fry pan and add sliced eggplant, fry over medium heat on both sides until it starts to soften. Stir frequently and add mushrooms, cooking for a few minutes more. You can add a dash of hot pepper sauce to taste. Serve over your favourite rice.

title: Hungarian Naked Olives
ingredients: 1 lb black kalamata olive ( or other green )
instructions: Cut kalamata olives in half if large, or cut from a small jar. Place olive halves in an ovenproof dish or pan. Cut a slit in the top layer of olives. Sprinkle with paprika. Broil in a 350 f. Oven for about 2 minutes, or until top begins to brown, stirring halfway through cooking. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Cod With Raspberry Sauce and Fresh Raspberries
ingredients: 3 lbs cod fillets ( can also use other red snapper fillets ) | 2 tablespoons margarine ( for frying ) | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 cups fresh raspberry ( or frozen raspberries, defrosted in cold water )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Prick the cod with a fork and arrange on a baking sheet. Drizzle with 2 tablespoon of oil and toss to coat. Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork and flakes when you touch it. Meanwhile, melt the margarine over medium heat in a large, heavy skillet. Add the ketchup to the skillet, stirring. Pour over fish and raspberries and gently stir. Return to the oven and return the pincers to the oven. Bake for about 15 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork and juice has come out of the fish. Serve with the raspberries and sauce.

title: Roasted Almonds
ingredients: 1 lb blanched almond | 1 small red chili pepper, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons orange flower water ( optional ) | 3 -4 finely chopped tablespoons powdered jwain ( indian vegetarian, not sure, but i have never tried it )
instructions: Place almonds on foil lined baking sheet. Preheat oven to 350°f toast almonds in oven for about 5 - 10 minutes, depending on preference. You may need to add a little more oil/oil to keep the nuts from burning at the top. Meanwhile, heat orange flower/jwain/powder. Stir together in a small bowl and cool completely. Place the jwain in a small bowl on the top of the almonds. Place nuts on a foil lined baking sheet and place in oven. Stirring once or twice, bake until lightly brown. Remove almonds from oven and place on a large platter. Let cool completely, then crumble and serve.

title: Khao Phrik Gaeng (Phrik Khao)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh galangal, peeled and cut into strips | 1 clove garlic, cut into thin slices | 3 cups beef base | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Thoroughly rinse the galangal in a bowl with hot water. Place ginger and garlic in a mortar with a pestle or the flat side of a large knife and grind into a fine paste. Place beef and paste into a pot with about 1 1/2 cups water. Add the base and simmer until the sauce thickens, about 15 minutes. Strain through a clean dish towel into a bowl. Add more water if necessary. Dip lettuce in a bowl of warm, moistened, white vinegar for a few seconds on each side. Spread a thin layer of paste on the warm lettuce.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,spring onion,beef brisket,italian breadcrumb,greek yogurt,prune,peach,lettuce leaf
title: Brisket of Beef With Peaches, Prunes and Italian Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 2 lbs small thin-cut beef brisket | 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt or 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped spring onion | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 3 large pitted prunes, very thinly sliced | 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt or 1/4 cup sour cream | lettuce leaf ( washed and patted dry or dried, for garnish ) | 1 ripe peach, sliced for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Wrap brisket with a double thickness of foil. Place in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Bake, uncovered, in a 350°f oven until cooked through, about 45 minutes depending on the size of the brisket. Place brisket in a large plastic bag and refrigerate overnight. Remove brisket from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Remove brisket from bag and discard juices. Slice brisket across the grain into 1/2 inch slices. If desired, arrange slices on serving platter and place warm on serving platter. To serve, top with yogurt or sour cream. Sprinkle with chopped onions and sliced peaches.

title: Cashews in a Sweet-Creamy Apricots (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 8 ounces raw cashews | 4 apricots, peeled and cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat griddle to very hot. Wash the cashews and dry them. Mash them with a mortar & pestle or in a food processer to a fine texture, but not too smooth or too liquidy. Stir in the chives. Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture onto a griddle. Cook over a medium heat for about 1 minute until it starts to sizzle. Serve very hot.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,green bean,fennel seed,hot sauce,dark soy sauce,haddock fillet,gruyere cheese,mayonnaise
title: Stove Top Steak Sandwich With Mayonnaise and Fennel Seed
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons canola oil | 500 g lean ground sirloin or 500 g mild ground sirloin | 1/3 cup mayonnaise ( preferably fresh ) | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | hot sauce, such as tabasco, to taste | 1 tablespoon coarse green beans, cooked | 1 1/2 teaspoons green fennel seeds or 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds, lightly crushed ( 1/3 tbsp ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons plain dried bread flour | 1 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 c. Grease a shallow oven proof dish and set aside. Lightly brush two baking trays with oil. Place the sirloin in a shallow dish and add the remaining ingredients except the cheese. Mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Divide the meat mixture into 8 equal portions. Form each portion into a ball. Lightly flour the meat and roll it into the cheese. Shallow fry the steaks until golden brown on all sides, about 4 minutes. Serve immediately when the cheese melts. Alternatively, if serving in a large ovenproof dish, bake it in the centre of the oven for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve on the side with potatoes, bread or your favourite green vegetable. For an extra tasty sandwich, serve with roasted vegetables, crusty bread and a side of garlic mashed potato.

title: Chile Cream Sauce
ingredients: 6 dried red thai chiles | 3 tablespoons capers | 1 pint heavy cream
instructions: Grind chili peppers to a paste with the back of a knife. Stir in capers. Whip cream. Dip drained chiles into the cream and coat with sauce.

title: Homemade Cherry Chips
ingredients: 3 cups pitted sour cherry, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, mix chopped cherries with italian seasoning. Cover bowl and shake, shaking, coating cherries with italian seasoning. Store in refrigerator until needed.

title: Indian Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 6 large sweet potatoes | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 5 cups plain couscous, prepared to package directions
instructions: Place the sweet potatoes into a large pot and add cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, then remove from heat and let potatoes sit until tender, about 15 minutes. Cut potatoes into wedges and set aside. Meanwhile, heat a small amount of oil in a skillet, then stir in cardamom. Stir in couscous. Cover, increase heat to high, and cook until liquid has been absorbed by the couscous, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, drain potatoes, and keep warm. Add hot couscous to potatoes and gently toss to mix.

title: Pasta and Shellfish (Cagiatore)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 package frozen fava beans, thawed and squeezed | 1 package frozen prawns, peeled, deveined | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1 teaspoon finely chopped green pepper | 1 package drained cooked spaghetti | 1/2 cup chopped fresh pistachios or 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Heat oil in large heavy skillet. Add beans and shrimp and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes. Stir in beaten egg substitute, green pepper and pistachios. Transfer to 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with additional pistachios if desired. Cover and bake at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes or until pasta is just tender. Remove from oven and add pasta to tomato mixture and mix thoroughly. Heat through. Serve hot or cold.

title: Baked Pecorino
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups grated pecorino cheese | 3 bunches fresh basil leaves | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place the basil leaves on a baking sheet, and toast in the preheated oven until softened, about 7 minutes. Spread the pecorino cheese evenly on top of the toasted basil leaves. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Place basil back in the oven, and bake for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Sausage Toast
ingredients: 20 slices bread, preferably diagonally cut from stale baguette | 3 tablespoons icing sugar ( to roll sausages in ) | 12 sausages, any size, of your choice | 20 g large raw sausage, diced | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Slice the sausages into long pieces about a quarter inch thick, so that they are at least two inches long. Lay the sausages onto the bread slices, sprinkle with the icing sugar and roll. Spray a cast iron frying pan with little oil and preheat slowly. Place the sausages, cut side down, over a fairly high heat, and cook until they are evenly cooked and coloured. Turn over and cook all the way through. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly, then carefully remove the sausages from the bread slices. Roll each slice up carefully into a sausage shape, and secure with tooth picks. Spray the tops and bottoms of the bread in a large frying pan and fry on either side until golden brown all over. Transfer to a warmed serving platter and serve straight away.

title: Hot Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 7 ounces egg noodles | 5 ounces broccoli | 8 tablespoons raisins | 1 teaspoon allspice berries | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 8 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Cook the noodles until just tender. Reserve 3 cups of the water. Drain in a colander until ready to use, then place in cold water. Peel the broccoli and cut into small florets. Blanch in the heated water for 5 - 7 minutes until just tender. Remove to a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking process. Meanwhile, soak the raisins in warm water for 20 minutes then cut into quarters. Drain well. Toss all together with the noodles, broccoli and seasoning. Top with extra mint. Serve at once.

title: Caribbean Bacon and Coconut on Toast
ingredients: 200 g fatty bacon | 100 g fresh coconut, grated or 1 1/2 tablespoons dry coconut flakes ( can also use 1 cup fresh coconut )
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp and slightly browned. Drain off any excess fat. Pour on toasted coconut and toss to combine, sprinkle coconut flakes on top. Serve warm or allow as is or chill & serve as is.

title: Smooth Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 4 large eggplants | 1 lime wedge | 2 3/4 cups sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla liqueur | 2 tablespoons cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f with a vegetable peeler, peel as many of the eggplants as you can without damaging the skin and scoop out most of the liquid. Rinse out the seeds and any pith, and cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Put both slices in a large roasting pan and pour the lime juice on top. Place on the middle rack of the oven and roast for about 45 minutes, or until the skin has turned brown and the eggplant is soft. Allow to cool. When cool, scoop flesh out of the eggplant pulp and place in serving dish. Grate lime wedge over the eggplant. Pour sweet chili sauce over and stir to mix. Spoon over any leftover flesh. Mix cream of tartar with vanilla liqueur and pour over the eggplant mixture. Serve warm or cold.

title: Super Easy Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon mild taco seasoning packet
instructions: The original recipe said to add the zest of an orange. The directions i gave to about 1/4 of an orange in the bowl. I tried to match the zest as i like to do it. I found this made a nice zesty taco seasoning for me. My family doesn't like the amount of zest as i like it a little over one portion of a portion of an orange. It's a good thing to add extra zest if needed.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,celery leaf,green bean,basil,filet beef
title: Beef With Herbed Green Beans
ingredients: 1 cup green beans, cut off ends | 300 g filet of beef, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh basil, leaves picked | 1 tablespoon fresh celery leaves, to serve
instructions: Snap off the tough ends of the beans. Cut the tops from the beans, then cook them until just tender. Drain them well in a colander. Put the beans in a serving bowl. Place the sliced beef on top of the beans, sprinkle with the parsley, basil and celery, then pour the water over everything. Serve with a green salad on the side.

Random Ingredients: chicken,thyme,za'atar spice mix,tabasco sauce,date,apricot jam,pineapple chunk,dark brown sugar
title: Lola's Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs chicken | 2 1/4 ounces unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh thyme | 1 -2 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons dried apricot jam ( or jam of your choice ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons za'atar spice mix | 1 -2 dash tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup apricot preserves or 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons dried dates, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 13 x 9 x 2 baking pan and line it with parchment paper. Place the chicken in the pan. Sprinkle with thyme, sugar, jam, za'atar.

Random Ingredients: bouillon,beef steak,banana pepper,green chile pepper,kalamata olive,jalapeno chile,white sugar,parsnip
title: Mountain Dew
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef flank steak, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 jalapeno chile peppers, chopped | 1/2 can chopped green chile peppers, drained | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted and chopped | 1 can diced banana peppers | 2 tablespoons bouillon ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon dried parsley
instructions: Place steak strips into a large skillet over medium high heat, and cook, turning until evenly cooked. Remove from heat, remove strips, and set aside. Place jalapeno peppers and green chile peppers into the skillet with the steak, and stir to combine. Pour in olives and banana peppers. Heat, and mix bouillon into the skillet with the contents of the skillet. Cook and stir until mixture is well mixed. Mix in sugar and parsley. Drain steak strips, and serve with the mixture.

title: Fruited Meatballs
ingredients: 1 kg minced meat ( or lamb ) | 100 g noodles ( small ) | 100 g oats ( medium ) | 100/150 ml soda water ( soda water ) | 1/2 teaspoon greek oregano | 3 cups italian breadcrumbs | 1 liter greek-style cream ( lukewarm )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients for the meatballs, mix well.. Place half of the mixture in the bottom of mould. Cover with another layer and cook on medium heat for 15 minute. Remove from heat and mix again with the remaining meat mixture. Fill your moulds with the meatballs and serve hot with the creamy greek yoghurt and enjoy.

title: Morrocan Sweet and Sour Broccoli (Or Chicken) Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh broccoli or 1 lb frozen broccoli, blanched | 2 green apples or 2 green apples, cut into thin slices | 1/2 teaspoon harissa
instructions: If using fresh broccoli, prepare according to package directions. Drain and immediately rinse with cool water. Transfer to a colander or strainer set over a large bowl. Chop off any remaining tough stems and florets. Set aside. Cut the apple slices in half along one or two long sides. Set aside. Arrange the broccoli over the broccoli. Sprinkle each slice with 2/3 teaspoon of harissa. Roll around the apple slices. Serve right away.

title: Simple Salsa
ingredients: 3 cups picante sauce | 1/2 cup shredded fresh basil leaf | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Stir picante sauce, basil, mint leaves, and ground beef mixture together in a bowl.

title: Fish on Artichokes (Lomo de Atum)  (Artichokes-Brazilian Style)
ingredients: 12 ounces artichoke hearts ( fresh or canned ) | 1 tablespoon coriander powder ( to taste )
instructions: Slice the hearts very thinly and remove any small or the beginnings of the artichokes. Wash the fish and dry. Grind all ingredients together and place in an appropriate container. If desired, you can also use 2 tsp ground coriander. Bake the fish on a very hot griddle pan or in a large frying pan, turning once, until lightly browned and crisp on both sides.

title: Oregano Mince and Left Over Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g leftover ground mince | 100 g leftover french bread cubes ( i prefer left over stale ones ) | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano | 3 eggs
instructions: Mix together the mince and eggs and add a little salt and pepper, a splash of oregano. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil in a frying pan on medium low heat, stir frequently to make nice little meatballs.. Drain the bread in a colander and make sure to separate the bread. Add 1 tbsp of oregano and 1 tbsp of olive oil in the frying pan on medium heat. Add half of the meat mixture and cook for 3 minutes until cooked. Turn of heat and add the rest of the meat. Cook for 3 minutes. Serve with mashed potato.

title: Guacamole Con Queso
ingredients: 2 avocados, peeled and coarsely mashed | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese or 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup dark rum ( optional ) | 1 sprig fresh rosemary or 3 sprigs parsley | cayenne pepper or fresh hot sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Place the mashed avocado in a bowl. Mix all the other ingredients together thoroughly with a spoon. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper before serving. Serve with tostado chips or as a salad accompaniment for your favorite quesadillas.

title: Lavender Spiced Dressing (Lavender)
ingredients: 2/3 cup extra caster sugar, plus | 2 tablespoons extra caster sugar, for topping | 7 tablespoons good quality extra sherry wine | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 pinch of fresh grated nutmeg | 1 teaspoon mexican oregano, crushed
instructions: Combine the above ingredients in a small saucepan and stir constantly on a low heat until the sugar is melted and the ingredients are well combined. Allow to cool completely before use so flavors will blend.

Random Ingredients: olive,whipping cream,canola oil,black eyed pea,strawberry,lemongrass,yellow pea,bell pepper
title: Strawberry Pea Salad
ingredients: 20 ounces cooked black-eyed peas | 3/4 cup yellow split peas | 1/2 cup white sweet bell pepper, sliced | 1 1/2 lbs fresh strawberries, quartered | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon ground lemongrass | 1 tablespoon whipping cream
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a salad bowl. Mix oil and lemongrass in large nonstick skillet. Add pea mixture.

Random Ingredients: mustard,green bell pepper,chicken cutlet,italian sausage,alfredo sauce,chili flake
title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken cutlets | 1 cup shredded alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup chili flakes | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 green bell pepper, sliced | 1 package sliced italian sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken cutlets in a shallow pan. Combine the Alfredo sauce, chili flakes, mustard and bell pepper.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,vermouth,worcestershire sauce,cake flour,cardamom seed,potato,chicken breast
title: Vienna Chicken Marsala and Potato Crostini
ingredients: 1 lb potato | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 3/4 cup sweet marsala wine | 3/4 cup dry vermouth | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon worcestershire sauce, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Peel and boil potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and run through a ricer or with a vegetable peeler into a large mixing bowl. Cut chicken into bite sized pieces, about 1/4 inch thick. In a skillet sprayed with non stick cooking spray, combine marinade ingredients and heat over low heat, stirring often, until hot and flavors have mingled. Add chicken, and simmer for 5 minutes. While it's simmering, slice potatoes into 5 to 6 inch lengths. Drain chicken, reserving marinade. In a large casserole dish, place potatoes and cook 5 minutes, toss, and then bake 15 minutes. Serve chicken over the potato mixture with a spoonful of warm marinade on the top of it all.

title: Cornmeal Pizza Shooters
ingredients: 500 g cornmeal, blend | 400 g cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1/2 cup black olives, cut in half ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 cup mushroom, cut in half ( optional )
instructions: Spray a non stick frying pan with cooking spray and preheat it to medium heat. If there is no need to grease the pan, then lightly spray the pan with oil spray. Add half of the canned cherry tomatoes and half the olives, if using. Saute for 1 - 2 minutes, add remaining cherry tomatoes and olives. Sprinkle vanilla essence over the mix and stir for a further minute. Spread cornmeal mix evenly over the sauce, making sure it is evenly spread. Sprinkle olives on top. Leave for a few seconds on the top so the cornmeal can pick up some sauce while it's cooking. You don't want a toasted effect. Garnish with remaining olives and serve with pasta or vegetables.

title: Wattle Seed Crisco
ingredients: 3 cups wattle seeds | 3/4 cup currants | 3 cups crisco
instructions: Put wattle seed and currants in a skillet, cover, and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the seeds are golden brown, stirring often. Remove from heat, cover and let stand, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Wrap the crisco in foil and rub it in the seeds until coated. Store at room temperature to age, shaking the skillet a few times. If using as a filling for meat, spread between two sheets of waxed paper until very thick. Pack the seeds into a small freezer bag, and freeze.

title: Spicy Oil Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark sesame oil, or to taste | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper, or to taste
instructions: Mix dark sesame oil and red pepper together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: white wine,beef tenderloin,icing sugar,margarine,graham cracker crumb,thyme sprig,thai fish sauce
title: Thai Beef Strips With Crumbs
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs beef tenderloin ( or sirloin ) | 1/2 cup sifted icing sugar | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 2 teaspoons margarine or 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/4 cup snipped fresh thyme sprigs | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 4 cups graham cracker crumbs, coarsely crushed
instructions: Cut tenderloin crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.

Random Ingredients: scallion,plum tomato,nutmeg,pico de gallo,pearl barley,mayonnaise,bamboo shoot,honey
title: Tortilla Barley Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup pearl barley, cooked ( can use red ) | 1/2 cup pico de gallo, salsa ( i like pace ) | 1 scallion, chopped | 1 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 can canned bamboo shoots, chopped | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Mix mayo, nutmeg and honey with barley and pour into a medium bowl.

title: Rigatoni and Mushrooms in a Rice Cooker
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked rigatoni pasta or 2 cups other small spiral shaped pasta | 1 cup chopped fresh mushrooms | 2 cups ice water | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cook rigatoni pasta to desired doneness as directed on package, about 11 minutes in a 9 inch square baking dish. When done, drain well. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine mushrooms, water and crushed graham crackers. Heat together over medium high heat until boiling, 5 - 7 minutes or until crumbs are crisp. When pasta and sauce are ready, toss with mushroom mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Calzone
ingredients: 18 sheets lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 1 jar prepared pizza crust, such as boboli
instructions: Bring 2 1/2 quarts water to boil in large pot. Add noodles and boil 5 minutes, or until al dente. Drain well. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spread pizza crust evenly across bottom of ungreased 14x10 inch baking pan. Arrange 3 noodles across the crust, leaving 1/4 inch uncovered at each end of an unfilled lengthwise slice from end to end. Repeat with remaining noodles and top with pizza crusts. Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until crust is browned and bubbly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: date,filling,arborio rice,clam juice,elbow macaroni,cooking spray,pasta,rom tomato
title: Clam Macaroni and Date Pasta
ingredients: cooking spray | 9 ounces elbow macaroni | 1 1/3 cups uncooked elbow macaroni, such as farfelline | 1 can diced roma tomatoes | 1/4 cup canned minced clams with juice or 1/4 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon dried arborio rice or 1/2 teaspoon fresh arborio rice | 1/4 cup canned crushed plum tomatoes | 1 package frozen small crumbled ice-cold cooked clams
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions. Drain. While macaroni is cooking, spray skillet with cooking oil.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream Salad (Diabetic)
ingredients: 3 cups vanilla ice cream, softened | 1 tablespoon dijon-style mustard
instructions: Add vanilla ice cream to your chilled salad bowl. Blend or sprinkle dijon style mustard on ice cream. Serve immediately or refrigerate immediately. When serving, sprinkle with cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,pepper sauce,italian sausage link,feta cheese,bamboo shoot,green onion,tamari
title: Greek Sausage and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage link | 1 package long grain rice | 1 can of sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1/3 cup reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled | 4 green onions, chopped | 1/3 cup tamari | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink, about 5 minutes and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Add rice and cook, stirring, until lightly toasted and grains are coated with cooking spray, about 2 minutes. Stir sausage until coated with cooking spray. Stir in chopped bamboo, cheese, green onions, tamari and hot pepper sauce, combining well. Cool to room temperature. Cover and chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Brothy Leeky and Lemon Dip
ingredients: 10 leeks | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups fresh shucked loin garlic cloves | 1 cup broth | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1/4 cup prepared horseradish-flavored miso | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons ground mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh lemons
instructions: Trim and thinly slice leeks. Place in a small bowl, and cover with boiling water. Set aside for 10 minutes, drain. Trim and thinly slice leeks. Combine the leeks with the garlic cloves, broth, and 1 tablespoon mustard seed in a blender or food processor. Puree until smooth. Stir in miso, horseradish, remaining mustard and lemon juice. Cover and chill for atleast 1 hour. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Brie Cheese Bites
ingredients: 1/2 lb brie cheese, softened | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 1/2 teaspoons lime zest
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium bowl, breaking up rind with your hands. Sprinkle with more lime zest if desired.. Chill until ready to use. Cut brie into 6 wedges.

Random Ingredients: gorgonzola,oregano leaf,golden raisin,dill,green onion,thai red chili pepper,aubergine
title: Aubergine, Raisin Salad
ingredients: 350 g large auberines | 350 g aubergines | 2 green onions, chopped | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup fresh oregano leaves | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 1 tablespoon thai red chili peppers or 1 tablespoon red curry
instructions: Cut the aubergines diagonally into 2 cm slices. Trim the ends and remove the membrane. Place in cold water and leave to soak. Boil the aubergines and cut into wedges. Place in a large salad bowl, sprinkle over the onions and mix in the raisins, herbs and chilies until the onions are coated with the spice mixture. Add half the dressing and toss to coat. Add the aubergines and toss again. Taste and season. Drizzle with the remaining dressing and toss again before serving.

title: Sliced Shiitake French Toast
ingredients: 4 loaves round italian bread, about 3/4-inch thick | 1 lb fresh shiitake mushrooms, thickly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped shallots | 2 cups broth | 2 teaspoons dried guacamole | 1/2 teaspoon ground almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning salt | 3 slices dry bacon, chopped
instructions: In a large skillet, combine mushrooms, shallots, broth, guacamole, almond extract, and seasoning salt. Let simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes or until mushrooms soften. Stir mushrooms occasionally during cooking.

title: Quick Nachos
ingredients: 1 can pizza-style crushed tomatoes with basil and garlic | 1 package shredded lettuce | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple rings
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Spread the crushed tomatoes evenly into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer the lettuce, cheese, and pineapple over the top. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted, about 25 minutes. Allow to stand about 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green tomato,romaine lettuce,chocolate chip,vanilla sugar,puff pastry,macadamia nut oil
title: Pasteles De Ronière (Catalan Macadamia-Smoked Green Tomato Puffs)
ingredients: 3/4 cup macadamia nuts packed in oil, very finely chopped | 1 green tomatoes, very finely chopped ( about 100g ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar ( or to taste ) | 1 puff pastry, thawed ( or use a ready-made ready-made pastry for the tin ) | 4 -6 large green tomatoes, cut into 2 - 3 cm wide slices ( or use a tomato, sliced thinly ) | 1 leaf romaine lettuce, washed thoroughly and very gently dried | 1/4 cup chocolate chips, for garnishing if desired ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Stir the macadamia nuts with the green tomato in a bowl.

title: Cannellini With Curry and Amaretto
ingredients: 1 large black cardamom pod, cracked and slightly crushed | 3 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed amaretto ( almond extract ) | 1/2 cup taco sauce | 1 can cannellini, drained
instructions: In a mortar, grind the black cardamom and curry powder into a smooth paste. Add the amaretto and crush the cardamom pods into powder. Stir in taco sauce and cook over medium heat for five minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside for five minutes. To serve, spoon the curry mixture over individual cannellini and stir.

title: Aloo Phirni - Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cubes | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 3 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients together. Spread over a large, wide tin or tray. Bake, covered, in a cool, dark, warm place, until beef is tender and browned.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,superfine sugar,white sugar,peanut butter,ginger,green onion
title: Pecan Gingersnaps
ingredients: 2 bunches green onions ( white parts only ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/3 cup superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon fresh grated ginger | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 4 slices sharp couda cheese | 4 teaspoons superfine sugar
instructions: Place green onions in a blender or food processor and pulse grind until finely chopped. Set aside. Beat peanut butter, 1/3 cup superfine sugar, and ginger until smooth. Stir in green onions. Cover.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,chocolate chip,lime juice,corn,miracle whip
title: Mexican Layered Chocolate Dip
ingredients: 9 ounces chocolate chips | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1 package of zesty italian salad dressing mix ( i use good seasons ) | 1 can corn, drained ( i use the frozen corn, which are in the can )
instructions: Combine chips, miracle whip, lime juice, ranch mix and corn in medium saucepan. Melt until chips are smooth, stirring frequently. Top with plastic wrap. Chill until serving time.

title: Portuguese Bread and Cauliflower Rolls
ingredients: 1 kg cauliflower, washed and chopped into small florets | 50 g garlic bread, crumbs finely crumb mixed with the vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 1/2 tablespoons cake flour | 4 cups of crusty bread, sliced thin ( thick slices )
instructions: Grease a baking tray well with a little olive oil. In a large bowl, combine cauliflower and 4 cups of water. Add garlic crumb mix with vinegar and sherry vinegar gradually. Pour mixture into a large bowl, cover and stand in fridge for 2 hours. After 1 hour, check if water has returned to the boil. If it is, drain the cauliflower and return to the dish. Add bread crumb mixture and mix well. Place tray on a baking sheet, and bake at 160 deg c for 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from oven and place on a chopping board. Cut through the core of the cauliflower into smaller florets and put in a large bowl with cauliflower. Add bread crumb mixture to cauliflower, toss gently. Place in the fridge until serving day.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,italian parsley,jalapeno pepper,white vinegar
title: Thai Hot and Sour Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh jalapeno peppers | 6 dried mild red chile peppers, soaked in warm water for 2 hours | 1/3 cup red distilled white vinegar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Stir in jalapeno peppers, whole red chile peppers, and red chile peppers. Boil until peppers are very soft, about 15 minutes. Reserve liquid. Drain liquid, discarding peppers. Transfer peppers with reserved liquid on a paper towel lined baking sheet to cool. When cool enough to handle, peel and chop into strips. Stir shrimp back into pepper sauce.

title: Roast Beef in the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb roast, trimmed of some fat | 1 large sweet onion, such as vidalia, peeled ( or other sweet onion of your choice, chopped )
instructions: Place roast in a 5 quart or larger slow cooker. Add the sweet onion and chopped onion. Cover, set heat on low setting 3 to 4 hours or on high setting 6 to 8 hours, depending on your slow cooker. Check for tenderness, stir well and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,leg lamb,sausage,red cabbage,cardamom seed,black tea,lemon juice,confectioner sugar
title: Lamb Salat
ingredients: 1 whole head red cabbage | 1/4 pound ground lean pork | 1/2 pound ground sausage | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint | 1/4 cup freshly squeezed lemon-flavored ale or ale | 2 whole cardamom seeds | 1 vanilla bean | 2 1/2 cups confectioners'sugar, divided
instructions: Cut out the core of the cabbage, or cut out and discard the thick, central core. Rinse and thinly slice the cabbage. Cut half of the leaves from the center of the cabbage. Rinse and thoroughly separate the white layer from the green. Grate or pulse the shredded cabbage, and place in a large salad bowl. Mix the ground pork, sausage, lemon juice, mint and ale, crushed cardamom seeds, and half the chopped mint in a bowl. Gradually mix in half of the confectioners' sugar until thoroughly blended. Place in the refrigerator. Cut the vanilla bean in half lengthwise and scrape out the vanilla seeds. Cut the remaining half into thin slices. Set aside. Grate or pulse half of the remaining mint leaves in a food processor and add 1/4 cup shredded mint. Add 1/4 cup of the confectioners' sugar, and pulse until finely chopped and well incorporated, about 1 minute. Add the remaining confectioners' sugar to the bowl, and mix until well blended. Drain the inner cabbage leaves in a fine mesh strainer, and place over medium low heat in a glass bowl. When water is hot, pour 1/4 cup of boiling water over the leaves until the stems are clear, or submerge them in a mesh colander for about a minute. Drain on paper towels, and cut a slit lengthwise along the top of a cabbage leaf.

title: Persian Kebabs
ingredients: 4 large eggplants | 300 g lamb or 300 g goat beef, diced ( 2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 3 teaspoons turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons ground pepper sauce ( i only use tabasco )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Cut ends off eggplants. Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1/8 thick slices, removing as many layers as possible. Set aside. Cut eggplant into 1/8 pieces. Remove meat from bones. Cut meats into 1/8 inch thin slices. Combine tarragon, hot sauce, turmeric and pepper sauce in shallow dish. Add meat and stir to coat well. Place eggplant slices on rack in shallow roasting pan. Place eggplant slices on rack in baking pan. Top with remaining eggplant slices, coating well. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until tender. Serve with rice.

title: Peach-Braised Indian Mutton
ingredients: 3 lbs mutton | 4 tablespoons brown basmati rice | 3 medium shallots, peeled, seeded and finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups canned sliced peaches, drained
instructions: Brown the meat in a frying pan. Add the rice and shallots, and mix well. Cover and continue cooking over low heat for about 30 minutes. Add the sliced peaches during the last 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Stove Top Spinach Beef and Rice.
ingredients: 1 box frozen spinach, thawed and drained well | 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed ( optional )
instructions: In crockpot place drained spinach and beef cubes. Cover with enough dressing to cover. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or until beef is tender, stirring periodically. Garnish with the sesame seeds, if desired.

title: Bacon Cheese Penne
ingredients: 1 package penne | 1/4 cup pickle, chopped | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 5 1/2 tablespoons bran flakes | 4 tablespoons kalamata olives, chopped | 1/2 cup manchego cheese, shredded | 3 refrigerated pie crusts, partially thawed ( pillsbury are good! )
instructions: Cook penne according to directions on package for al dente. While pasta is cooking, in a saucepan, combine pickle, vinegar, bran flakes and olives. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,port wine,summer savory,lettuce leaf,maple syrup,garlic clove,swiss cheese
title: Roasted Garlic & Maple Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes or 4 medium yukon gold potatoes, scrubbed | 3/4 cup port wine or 3/4 cup dry vermouth | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 garlic cloves ( minced or pressed, i use one whole head ) | 2 -8 lettuce leaves ( or green leaf of any choice ) | 1 pinch summer savory ( optional ) | 4 slices swiss cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f or 200°c. Place the potatoes in a lightly oiled roasting tin and roast for 30 minutes or so until soft and tender.. Remove the potatoes from the oven and return to the oven. Combine the port, maple syrup, garlic and savory if using either in a small saucepan and boil uncovered on low while you are preparing the other ingredients. Remove the garlic cloves and chop the flesh fine and place in a small bowl or freezer bags. Shake/shake the pan to distribute the garlic flavour evenly over the potatoes. Remove the tray from the oven and allow the garlic to cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove the garlic cloves and place it in the bowl of a food processor. Process until smooth. Add the swiss cheese and process until smooth. To serve, place a lettuce leaf on a serving plate and top with a potato. Top with the swiss cheese dressing and season to taste.

Random Ingredients: chinese cabbage,lemon,stewing beef,pigeon pea,baby carrot,green pepper
title: Lemon Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 cups baby carrots | 2 cups lemons ( juice and all ) | 2 tablespoons chinese cabbage, chopped | 1/2 cup canned pigeon peas | 1 green pepper
instructions: Brown meat and add all ingredients with 1/4 cup water. Simmer covered over very low heat until meat and vegetables are tender.

Random Ingredients: tea,chicken breast,french bean,vegetable oil peanut,season salt
title: Jook for Beginners
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast | 1 can french beans | 1 teaspoon season-all salt | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 teaspoons tea
instructions: Mix chicken and seasoning in bowl. Saute chicken in skillet with oil and peas til meat is pink inside. Add cooked rice, beans and tea. Fold.

title: Candied Cinnamon Kaffir Lime Leaves
ingredients: 8 cinnamon sticks | 12 fresh kaffir lime leaves, thawed in refrigerator ( not frozen )
instructions: Combine the cinnamon sticks and kaffir lime leaves in a small bowl. Place a heavy duty resealable plastic bag on top. Moisten the cinnamon sticks with water or milk, if needed. Pack the bag with the cinnamon sticks, lime leaves, and cinnamon stick mixture. Refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,liquid smoke flavoring,marinara sauce,russet potato
title: Smoky French Fries
ingredients: 20 russet potatoes, cut into fries | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Peel, and cut the potatoes into fries. Place in a ziplock bag with liquid smoke and mustard seeds. Pour the marinara sauce over the potatoes.

title: Penne Pasta With Kale & Peppers
ingredients: 1 medium green pepper | 1 medium fennel bulb | 1 cup dried penne pasta | 4 -5 cups kale, finely chopped | 1/2 - 1 cup pecan halves
instructions: Chop all the ingredients into large chunks. Combine in crock pot and cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Serve with fresh bread. Enjoy.

title: Bread and Beef Pies
ingredients: 1 can of sliced steak | 1 small carrot, grated | 1 teaspoon self raising flour | 1/2 french baguette
instructions: Cut bread loaf in half width ways, and cut each half into 5 sections. Combine steak, carrot, and flour. Divide mix into 5 portions, and roll in bread sections so evenly coated. Place on greased grill plate or tray and cook over hot coals for 8 minutes on each side.

title: Baked Beef Tenderloin With Feta and Walnut
ingredients: 8 ounces penne | 1/2 lb feta cheese, crumbled | 1 lb beef tenderloin steak, cut 1-inch thick | 1/4 white onion, thinly sliced | 1 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse with cold water and drain. Reduce heat to low. Drain and keep warm. Preheat grill to high. Coat grill grate with cooking spray. Toss beef in a bowl with crumbled feta and 1/2 cup walnuts.

title: Almond Paste Delight
ingredients: 1 cup almond paste | 4 green cardamoms
instructions: Grind the almonds paste into a fine powder. Heat the oil in a large pan. Saute the ground almond paste. Add green cardamoms and stir well. The past will thicken and look beautiful, this is the secret to a wonderfully perfecor.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,lite olive oil,sauce,bread flour,ketjap manis
title: Tasty Bread!
ingredients: 600 g bread flour | 10 ml hot sauce | 50 ml ketchap manis | 10 g lite olive oil | 10 g white chocolate, melted
instructions: Put all the wet ingredients into a large bowl and, using your hands, gradually fold in bread flour until the mixture reaches one big, fairly stiff pliable dough. Turn the dough out onto a rolling pin and roll the dough until you have a nice oval shape round the size of your hand. Slice the roll about ½ inch thick onto a floured surface. Brush the edge with a little olive oil and fold back over in half to give you 3 oval shaped pieces. Poke the centre hole on the top with kitchen shears or a fork and press the rolls together to seal. Place the rolls on a lined tray and chill until needed. Turn the oven on so that it bakes at 230 degrees celcius for about 15 - 20 minutes to dry breads out. Turn the oven off again, leave the bread in the oven for another 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Pumpkin Lassi
ingredients: 1 can evaporated skim milk | 2 cans pumpkin puree | 1 lemon wedge | 1 pound radishes | club soda, or as needed
instructions: In a large pitcher, blend the evaporated milk, pumpkin purée, and lemon wedge. Garnish with radishes. Fill cocktail shaker 3/4 full with ice, and pour in the pumpkin mixture. Serve in the refrigerator until cold, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,beef steak,hot italian sausage,red chili powder,kaiser,icing sugar
title: Crispy Scotch Sausages and Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 large red chili powder | toasted kaiser roll | toasted sesame seeds or icing sugar
instructions: Mix the hot italian sausage with the peanut oil, red chile powder and hot rolls and set aside to marinade for 30 minutes. Grill the sausages for 7 - 8 minutes until nicely browned. Brush with more oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds or icing sugar.

title: Quick Chilled Salmon & Beans (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 7)
ingredients: 450 g white beans | 45 ml liquid smoke ( recommended ( heinz ) | 1 -2 fresh chili pepper ( dried-optional ) | 225 g smoked salmon ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup dried fruit, dried or ( 125 g ) small dried fruit ( such as sultanas )
instructions: Place beans, liquid smoke and dried fruit in a bowl. Add the salmon and fish. Toss gently with hot bean mixture. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,snow pea,cumin powder,peach,chicken bouillon,tortilla,artichoke heart
title: Tortillas in Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 can chopped artichoke hearts, drained | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 cup snow peas, chopped | 1 small peach, chopped | 10 thin slices tortillas
instructions: Heat oil in nonstick skillet or wok. Saute 1/2 t. Of artichoke hearts, cumin, and turmeric for 4 minutes. Add the snow peas and cook for 4 more minutes. Add the chopped chicken and cook 1 minute. Add the chopped peaches and cook 2 more minutes. Wipe out skillet or wok clean. Place a few tablespoons of filling mixture in center of tortilla. Fold over. Serve with sauce if desired.

title: Aubergine and Pepper Stir Fry
ingredients: 4 large aubergines | 4 yellow peppers
instructions: Peel and slice the peppers into long strips. Slice the aubergines into long, wide strips, roughly the same width as the peppers. Slice up the peppers into 1 1/4 inch rounds. Heat a little oil in a wok over high heat. Stir fry the aubergine in batches until just softened. Remove from the wok. Heat another wok, then add a little oil and stir fry the peppers. Return the aubergines and peppers to the wok. Stir in the vegetables. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,earth balance margarine,spice,cooking spray,red chilies,red chili,spanish onion
title: Mixed Snow Peas and Snow Peas
ingredients: 400 g snow peas | 1 spanish onion, diced | 3 red chilies, finely chopped | 2 red chilies, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon spicy mixed spice ( e.g. maggi seasoning mix ) | cooking spray | 1 teaspoon earth balance margarine
instructions: Boil peas for three minutes with lid ajar. Cool with absorbent paper. Remove the stem and leave the pod. If the snow peas are large, cut into thirds instead of diagonal. Cut snow pea pod halves into 3 long cubes. Sautee onion & chillies in 2 tsp of oil over medium heat until translucent. Add peas, spices and chillies. Mix well. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Spray with cooking oil and serve warm.

title: Noodles With Capers and Japanese Seasonings
ingredients: 1 lb udon noodles | 2 ounces pimientos, minced ( optional ) | 8 ounces japanese soy sauce | 10 1/2 fluid ounces of capers
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. When the water is boiling, stir in the udon, return to a boil, cover, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Meanwhile, heat a large, deep pan over medium high. When hot, add the pimentos and reduce the heat to medium. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp. Do not burn. Remove the pimentos and set aside. In a small bowl, combine the korean soy sauce and capers. Add this mixture to the noodles and toss gently to coat. Serve immediately. Note, i also sometimes add a little garlic to the noodles. I've been told that this is a personal preference.

title: Pork and Pepper Jack
ingredients: 1 pork rump, sliced into thin strips | 4 squash, sliced lengthwise into thin strips | 4 garlic pepper rings, or to taste | 2 bananas, sliced lengthwise into thin strips | 1 cup sherry wine | 6 cups milk
instructions: Heat a skillet or large pot over medium heat.

title: Grilled Steak Salad
ingredients: 1 lb short rib-of-pearnized beef steak | 1 cup seasoned croutons | 2 scallions, minced | 1/2 teaspoon grated nutmeg
instructions: Combine pepper, croutons, scallions in a bowl. Place flank steak on top, in a shallow dish. Make a well in the center of the breadcrumb mixture and pour liquid mixture over the steak. Dredge the steak in the crumb mixture to coat.

Random Ingredients: chocolate curl,chunky salsa,red onion,hard egg,cardamom pod,juice
title: Gramma's Spanish Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 red onion, peeled and chopped finely | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped finely | 2 green cardamom pods, crushed finely | 3 lollipop sticks ( optional ) | 1 cup chunky salsa | chocolate curls ( optional but encouraged )
instructions: Saute onion and egg in a 2 qt pan over low heat for 6 minutes. Add crushed cardamom pods and hot salsa, bring to just a simmer. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chunks. Place in a small ramekin and place under the broiler to melt the chocolate, about 3 minutes. Pour hot chocolate over gramma's.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,ginger root,lemon zest,grapeseed oil,panko breadcrumb,salmon
title: Salmon With Snow Peas and Ginger
ingredients: 1/4 cup grapeseed oil | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger root | 1 lb salmon, boned | 1 tablespoon freshly grated lemon zest | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 3/4 lb fresh snow peas, trimmed ( about 6 ounces snow peas )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat oil in a large skillet over med heat. Add ginger and cook, stirring, 30 seconds. Add salmon and zest and cook, turning once, for 5 minutes. Lightly sprinkle with panko and cook until the salmon is just warmed through. Spread salmon on a baking sheet and bake 15 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from the oven and stir snow peas around salmon. Serve warm.

title: Guacamole Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces guacamole | 4 fluid ounces vegetable stock | 12 -15 cherries
instructions: Peel and crush the guacamole very fine and put into a bowl add the stock, stir to combine, then fill the cherry halves with the guacamole mix well and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,iceberg lettuce,fish sauce,port wine,self rising flour,pesto sauce,arrowroot,watermelon
title: Fried Veggies With Pesto Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons unsalted pesto sauce, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons fish sauce, divided | 1 1/2 lbs port wine | 6 cups mixed frozen vegetables, thawed ( zucchini, carrots, celery, parsnips, cauliflower or potatoes ) | 1/2 tablespoon arrowroot ( cornstarch ) | 1 1/2 lbs skinless european sausage | 1 cup iceberg lettuce or 1 cup iceberg lettuce
instructions: Cook 6 cups assorted frozen salad greens according to package directions. Combine 1 tablespoon pesto and fish sauce in medium bowl. Combine in large bowl remaining pesto sauce and set aside. Drain vegetables and reserve 1 cup of the cooking liquid. Slice sausage links into thin strips and add to bowl with reserved cooking liquid. Cook until meat is browned. Drain and discard all but 2 tablespoons of fat from skillet, add remaining spices and stir to coat. Drain vegetables thoroughly and combine with meat. Add pesto sauce, cook for a minute for flavor and add water during last minute or 2 minutes of cooking time and adjust seasonings. Dunk vegetables into prepared pesto and toss to coat. Arrange on plates, top with reserved meat mixture. Garnish with parsley.

title: Hawaiian Patty Melts
ingredients: 1 can 100 % fat-free condensed tomato soup | 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice, chilled | 1 cup broth | 4 hamburger buns | shredded kielbasa ( or any other wi made meat, such as bacon ) | pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Mix together soup, pineapple juice, broth, and kielbasa with a wire wisk and heat well over low heat. Toast hamburger buns briefly and fill with mixture. Fold in sides and serve immediately with condiments of choice.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,parsley sprig,lemon peel,semolina flour,chicken breast,chicken wing
title: Chicken Baked in Lemon Syrup - Bbc Saturday Grill
ingredients: 1/2 chicken wings, jointed | 1 tablespoon semolina flour ( besan ) | 2 medium chicken breasts, skinned | parsley sprigs | lemon peel
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c /350°f. Place each chicken wing in a large ovenproof frying pan. Sprinkle with salt & pepper, then pour over enough cold water to come half way up the chicken. Bake in the oven for 25 - 30 mins or until the juices run clear when pierced with a skewer & cooked through. Turn the chicken over when almost cooked. Meanwhile, mix the besan & salt in a large bowl. Tear the chicken breast into bite sized pieces & add to the besan, making sure they are well coated with seasonings. Place the chicken pieces on plates & drizzle with any remaining lemon syrup. Garnish with parsley sprigs & lemon peel. Serve immediately.

title: Carnation Beef Coconut Gravy
ingredients: 1/4 cup pure ghee | 1 1/2 lbs tender coconut or 1 1/2 lbs coconut fillets, shredded | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon warm water | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons liqueur | 1 dash ground coconut
instructions: Heat the coconut in a 10 inch saute pan, with the ghee over medium heat, stirring frequently, and cook, stirring often, until the liquid has evaporated, about 3 minutes. Add the shredded coconut, bouillon mixture, and warm water to the pan. Cover and cook over low heat until the coconut is very tender, about 20 minutes. Uncover and cook, stirring often, for about 5 minutes longer, or until the liquid is reduced and the coconut is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,chili oil,date,dark rum,vodka,plain yogurt,clam juice,triple sec
title: Clams and Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 can chopped clams with juice | 1 cup vodka, chilled | 6 fluid ounces light rum | 2 fluid ounces chianti triple sec or 2 fluid ounces cointreau liqueur | 1 egg yolk | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili oil or 1 1/2 teaspoons anise oil | 3 whole-grain dates | plain yogurt or mascarpone cheese
instructions: Put the clams, vodka, rum and triple sec into a large, shallow bowl. Beat together the egg yolk with the chili oil or anise oil to a paste with the yogurt. Pour the yogurt mixture over the clams and stir to combine. Cover and chill. Just before serving stir in a whole grain of dates. Serve with warm crusty bread or serve with a dollop of whipped cream and an ice cream cone.

title: Yum Yum (Sliced Chiles)
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh gingersnap cookies, finely crushed ( about 12 cookies ) | 1 1/2 cups green onions, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup sweet chili oil | 1/4 cup grand marnier, powdered sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, combine half of the biscuit crumbs and half of the green onions. Add the chili oil and grand marnier and mix well. Roll mixture into 1 balls and roll in the remaining half of the crumbs. Place each ball on wax paper and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Greek Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( or to taste )
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet, breaking up the meat while it's cooking. Add the cinnamon and the salt/pepper. Simmer for 30 - 45 minutes. Serve over your favorite pasta.

title: Fiesta Beer
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces beer, any variety | 1/2 ounce picante sauce
instructions: Shake the beer and picante sauce in a cocktail shaker.

title: Baked Eggplant and Peas
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled and cubed | 1 pound boneless pork shoulder, cut into cubes | 1 jar pasta sauce | 1 package frozen peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Layer 1/2 of the eggplant cubes atop the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with some of the pork shoulder cubes. Layer 1/2 of the pasta sauce on top of the pork. Layer with the other half of the eggplant cubes, then layer with the remaining pork shoulder cubes. Top with remaining pasta sauce, then peas. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven until the meat and peas are tender, about 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: oil,lemon peel,lemon juice zest,shrimp paste,garlic clove,red cabbage,black mustard seed
title: Shrimp and Ginger in Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 head red cabbage | 1 small garlic clove | 2 tablespoons oil | 25 g lemons, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon lemon peel, grated | 5 tablespoons shrimp paste | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds
instructions: Cut the leaves off the cabbage and remove the leaves, cutting down to the stems if necessary. Discard the thick centre spine. Cut the head into 2cm wedges and finely chop the garlic. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and brown the garlic and ginger gently, about 15 seconds. Mix all the ingredients for the spice paste and pour into the pan with the cabbage. Leave to simmer gently for five minutes, tossing occasionally. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,red chile,chicken thigh,flat leaf parsley
title: Chicken and Chilli
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 3 -4 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons diced red chilies | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Tear the scalloped chicken thighs into bite sized chunks. Place into a casserole dish. Chop the parsley and deseed and deseed the chillies. Add these to the chicken in the casserole. Sprinkle over the half of the grated cheese. Add the rest of the grated cheese. Bake at 190c degrees for about 1 1/4 hours.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,lentil,active yeast,star anise,swiss chard,orange flower water,paprika
title: Moroccan Chick Pea Soup, Lovers' Digestive Food & No Eggs!
ingredients: 1 envelope active dry yeast | 2 1/2 cups warm water | 4 large egg yolks, room temperature | 24 slices swiss chard ( about 12 ounces total ) | 12 ounces dried lentils, rinsed and picked over, washed if dry | 2 tablespoons orange flower water, orange juice or 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | paprika
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water. Pour in egg yolks. Using a wooden spoon stir well to blend, gradually pour in warm water. Add 3/4 cup of the soup and the chard, then divide among six 6 ounce ramekins. Cover and let rise until doubled.. In a small bowl, beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into remaining soup. Sieve the soup through cheesecloth or a sieve.

title: Salmon Satay or Kebabs
ingredients: 250 g salmon, skinned ( firm and well flaked ) | 3 cardamom pods | 1 small red chili pepper | 10 toothpicks, soaked in water for 20 minutes
instructions: Remove and discard the skin from the salmon. Cut the salmon into 1 inch chunks and put in a bowl. Finely grind the cardamom pods. Place in a mortar with a pinch of salt and ground cardamom and pound gently. Divide the salmon into four equal portions and shape them into flat round salmon skewers. Thread the tail of the salmon onto each skewer and place on a lightly oiled barbeque. Brush with water and bake in an oven for approximately 10 - 15 minutes or until the salmon is cooked and the skin has crisped.

instructions: Prepare the cake mix according to package directions, and then spread in a lightly buttered 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a saute pan, or large skillet on high heat. Add the beef slices.

title: Tart Apples With Plum Crumble
ingredients: 1 medium plum tomato, cut into wedges and deseeded | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 -2 tablespoon fruit, pieces | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Toss tomatoes in oil until coated. Sprinkle with fruit. Place in oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until tomatoes are soft, basting twice during cooking process. Serve warm, topping with breadcrumbs.

title: Easiest Slow-Roasted Beef
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes ( or sirloin ) | 1/4 cup instant tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the cubed beef in 2 large baking dishes or roasting pans. Drizzle the instant tea over the top of the beef. Bake beef in oven about 1 hour, or till all juices are absorbed. Cool, cut beef into bite size pieces, and serve with your favorite side dish.

title: Spanish Oven Spice Rub for Frying
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 4 tablespoons onion powder | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon onion powder, or | 1 tablespoon onion powder, or | 1/2 cup spanish olives ( pimento-stuffed or coarsely ground )
instructions: Combine the salt, spices, and olives in a small bowl. Place about 2 tbsp of spice mix in the palm of your hand and roll it into a long sausage that is as close to square as possible. You can also have fritús with other spices, such as garlic, basil, or paprika. Wrap the roll in aluminum foil and keep in a cool spot or dark, in a cool, dry place.

title: Spaghetti Al Forno
ingredients: 2 lbs pork spareribs, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 cups yellow split peas | 1/4 cup milk chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh garlic | 2 cans prepared marinara sauce | 1 teaspoon good quality vanilla | 1/4 cup shredded gruyere
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil. Add the spareribs, peas, milk chocolate, olive oil, garlic and vanilla. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat for about 1 hour, or until they are tender when pierced with a fork. Remove the cooked ribs, peas and garlic and set aside. Return sauce to a boil, add the cheese and stir. Add the cooked and drained ribs and heat, stirring often, until hot and thoroughly heated.

title: Gala Applesauce
ingredients: 6 -8 gala apples | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 oranges, juice of, strained | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Peel the apples, cut in half and remove the cores and core. Finely chop the flesh. If grating peel your apples, press them through a sieve or process, place on a cutting board with the sugar and combine well. Gently blend in the orange juice and vegetable oil. Chill. Just before serving, spoon into a shallow dish.

title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 10 poblano chiles, roasted | 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons coriander powder | 6 medium lettuce leaves | 1 1/2 cups marzipan or 1 1/2 cups almond paste ( nutella )
instructions: Cut the tops off the chiles. Devein them. Place the chiles, cut side down, in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with anise seeds and coriander powder and cover with the lettuce. Place on the top rack of the oven and bake in 325°f oven for 35 minutes. Mix and bake another 15 minutes. Take out of the oven. Mix the almond paste and a little water into a paste. Add it to the chiles and bake for another 15 minutes. When the pastries are a little brown, cut an x on top to let the steam out. Remove from the oven and cut into 1/2 inch wide strips. Place the strips on the lettuce and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,cottage cheese,rye flour,chunky salsa,almond extract,hoisin sauce,parmesan cheese,sage leaf
title: Kittencal's Quick and Easy Savory Salsa Dip
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained ( reserve juice ) | 1/3 cup chunky salsa ( mild, medium, or hot ) | 1 teaspoon hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon prepared sage leaf | 1/4 cup cottage cheese or 1/4 cup ricotta cheese ( or cottage cheese blends, 1/4-1/3 cup ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract ( optional if using, add in a few shakes of almond extract to your liking, i find it is not necessary ) | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa ( mild, medium, hot or chunky ) | 1 teaspoon oats or 1 teaspoon rice flour ( or rice flour ) | parmesan cheese, shredded, to sprinkle on top ( optional )
instructions: Place drained kidney beans in a bowl and using your hands, mash them until they are very coarse meal. Add 1/3 cup of salsa and continue mixing for a few minutes you want the mixture to be moist like a paste. In another bowl or serving dish, stir together cottage cheese or ricotta cheese, 1/2 tsp almond extract and remaining 1/3 cup salsa. Add to the salsa/veggie mixture and stir together with a spoon. Serve spread on fresh bread, crackers, whatever you like. Garnish with parmesan cheese.

title: Potted Goat
ingredients: 1 lb goat stew meat | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 bunch celery leaves
instructions: Cut goat into chunks and place into saucepan. Add water and bring to boil. Remove from heat and let stand 30 minutes, then drain excess water and cover. Strain the fat from the goat meat and reserve. Rinse goat under running water and drain again. Set aside. Place stock or milk into a saucepan and heat to a boil. Put goat and celery into stockpot and cover. Cook 45 minutes at the most, stirring occasionally. Serve hot, topped with additional sour cream, if desired.

title: Dried Fruit Pickles -  Hot and Sour Mix - Pickle Recipe
ingredients: 8 dried fruit, preferably mixed red and green ( prune, apricot, pears, apples, plums, grapes ) | 1 cup dried hibiscus flowers ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon hot red chili powder | 3/4 cup tamarind paste | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, for seasoning
instructions: Place dried fruit in a bowl. Sprinkle hot chili powder over, and add enough water to cover the fruit. Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, until the water has absorbed. Remove the mixture from the refrigerator, and place it in a jar.

title: Salsa De Frijoles Refrito
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1 -2 chipotle pepper, stemmed and finely chopped | 1 spanish onion, finely diced ( vidalias are a good sized onion )
instructions: Drain the pinto beans in a colander. Place in a pot with enough cold water to cover the beans. Bring to a boil, then drain. Place in a bowl, mash the beans with a fork, then set aside. Add the chipotle pepper and onions to the pinto beans. Stir together, and simmer for 2 minutes. Serve in warm tortillas, passing the sour cream and salsa separately.

title: Homemade Whiskey Butter (Smoked)
ingredients: 3 lbs whiskey ( smithwick's is best ) | 1 cup mustard ( heaped )
instructions: In a heavy bottomed pot, pour whiskey and cover with a lid. Keep on lowest possible heat until the whiskey is very hot and bubbling but not smoking. Stir well, but not actually add the mustard or it will lose it's bite. Remove from heat and leave to settle for about 2 or 3 days.

title: Soy Chute
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, roasted and grated | 3 spring onions, finely chopped | 100 g macadamia nuts, roasted and finely chopped | salt | 8 cups salt water
instructions: Place poblano pepper, spring onion and nut of choice on a clean work surface. Sprinkle with salt. Gradually add water, being careful to not wash away the salt. The key is to not let the water get absorbed. Continue until the vegetables are completely cooked but still firm to the bite, approximately 18 to 20 minutes for the roasted pepper and 20 to 30 minutes for the raw onion. Serve as is, with plain yoghurt or thickened coconut milk as an accompaniment.

title: Easy Italian Oat Soup from Leftovers
ingredients: 1/2 of 1 cup old fashioned oats | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked oat | 1 loaf focaccia bread | 4 -5 tablespoons hot water | coarsely chopped savory ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the oatmeal in a medium size saucepan over medium heat. Stir the cold water, broth, and savory into the oat flour. Bring mixture to a boil, stirring constantly as soup thickens. Lower heat and add the oat. Cover and continue to cook at a simmer, stirring occasionally until oat flour is absorbed. While the soup is cooking, preheat oven to 400°f cut the bread into large cubes. Place oat cubes on baking sheet. Bake on baking sheet for 5 - 8 minutes or until golden brown. Remove pan from oven and crush with flat of a table knife. When soup comes to a boil, add bread cubes and toss lightly. Remove soup from heat. Add 2 tablespoons hot water to soup, stirring constantly. Garnish with savory if desired. Top soup with remaining teaspoon of hot water if desired. Serve soup plain or topped with a sprinkling of chopped savory.

title: Sicilian Sweet Rice Wine
ingredients: 4 cups inexpensively flavored rice wine | 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, very coarsely chopped | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Place the rice wine in a large, heavy nonreactive saucepan. Place the parsley, rosemary, and rosemary in a food processor or blender. Pulse several times, until finely chopped and pour into the rice wine. Stir to incorporate the rice wine. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then lower the heat to a gentle simmer, cover the pot, and simmer gently 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until most of the liquid is absorbed. Remove from the heat, stir in the remaining rice wine, and let stand 15 minutes, shaking the pan. Transfer to a serving dish, and serve immediately.

title: Quick & Easy Burritos
ingredients: 1 cup beef stew meat | 1 cup half-and-half ( regular or low fat ) | 1 tortillas ( i prefer the hot ones ) or ( 1 4 ounce ) packet my tortilla chips, if desired | shredded steak ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 350f or a medium sized frying pan on low to medium heat. Mix stew meat, half and half and chips together and spread evenly onto tortillas with your spatula. Add meat/cheese mix to hot pan or to the pan and mix well, making sure that meat is coated. Roll up each tortilla tightly and place, seam side down, in lightly sprayed dish. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Serve with lettuce, tomato salsa, sour cream, etc.

instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet with 1 teaspoon of the oil over medium heat. instructions: Saute the turkey breast till golden brown, then set aside. Heat the 2 tb of oil in a wok, then add the onions. Saute till golden brown, then add the garlic and then the chopped parsley. title: Tamari-Glazed Tramari Mousse With Ladyfingers

Repeat layering of ladyfingers, glaze, and cream until you have used up everything. Cover the tiramis mixture completely with whipped cream. Sprinkle the top layer of ladyfingers with a little sugar, if desired.

title: Minted Flank Steak

instructions: Boil the linguine according to the package directions. While pasta is cooking rinse sweet potatoes in cold water and cut off skin. instructions: Filling, cook all ingredients, except tomatoes, in a small saucepan. Cool for 10 mins, and then combine the tomatoes with the juice, spice and dill adding a little water if ingredients are dry add a little extra water to thicken.

title: Ww, Cheap and Easy Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb rotini pasta or 1/2 lb penne pasta | 16 ounces baby spinach | 1/3 cup oil | 1/3 cup sherry wine or 1/3 cup sparkling wine | 1 lemon, cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Boil water, and cook pasta for about 10 - 12 minutes until al dente, drain. Meanwhile, place the baby spinach on your serving platter.
