title: Pork and Orange Peppers
ingredients: 3 pork fillets, sliced ( about 4 ounces each ) | 2 large orange bell peppers | 1/2 cup chopped anchovy paste | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Place the pork in a shallow dish along with the pepper slices and anchovy paste. Cover and chill for 2 hours. Bake, covered, at 400° in a moderate oven for about 1 - 1 1/2 hours or until the pork is tender. Garnish with extra orange slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: oreo cooky,beef,apricot jam,sage leaf,oxtail,chipotle chile,portabella mushroom cap,ketchup
title: Beef and Oxtail St. Thomas Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs oxtails, trimmed of excess fat | 3 chipotle chiles, deveined, seeded, and roughly chopped | 8 dried oreo cookies | 2 dried portabella mushroom caps | 8 dried mushrooms, sliced | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | minced fresh sage leaf
instructions: Place beef on a cutting board and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices with kitchen scissors. Place them on a rack in a roasting pan. Bake at 300° for 1 3/4 hours, or until well browned and caramelized. Remove beef from oven, reserving pan juices. Cool, break into cubes. While beef is cooking, place chipoltes on a baking sheet. Bake at 300° until chipoltes are very lightly browned and crispy. Drain, peel off skin, and break into shreds. Place oreos in a small bowl. Place mushrooms in another small bowl. Drain porcini and soak in warm water for about 15 minutes. Drain. Remove stems and leaves from mushrooms, and cut in half. Stir fry mushroom mixture and 1 tbsp chopped chipoltes for a few minutes, until they begin to release their moisture. Spoon mushroom mixture into a small bowl. Heat a saucepan over medium high heat. Add remaining tbsp of chipoltes oil, and the ketchup. Add mustard and cook until it begins to bubble. As soon as this comes to boil, add the mushroom mixture, stirring to mix. Place oxtails back into the pan, pressing on them gently with your fingers. As the meat begins to brown, stir in the jam. The meat may not be completely submerged in the sauce, but you should be so that the sauce will coat the meat and mushrooms in lovely, sticky and slightly crisp golden brown.

title: Vermicelli in Cointreau Syrup
ingredients: 100 g coarse vermicelli | 250 -400 ml sugar syrup | 60 ml cointreau liqueur
instructions: Place vermicelli in a small saucepan over low heat. Pour just enough water into saucepan to cover all the vermicelli and soften slightly. Drain in a sieve and allow to cool for about 20 minutes. Place sugar syrup in a bowl and add cointreau liqueur. Mix to combine. Break cooled vermicelli into smaller sized pieces. Dip each of the vermicelli into the sugar syrup taking care to coat both sides. Allow to sit for 15 minutes, then drain and eat.

title: Saucy Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken wings, tips discarded | cooking spray | 3 cups mashed potatoes | 2 cups coarsely chopped escarole | 3/4 cup raw cashews | 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 cup cubed hamburger | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400^f. Spray large ovenproof skillet with cooking spray. Arrange chicken wings in the skillet. Bake at 400f for 35 minutes. Meanwhile, mix mashed potatoes, escarole, cashews, potato starch, hamburger, and bread crumbs in large bowl. Dip tips in potato mixture.

title: Frozen Louis Style Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup catsup | 4 tablespoons honey | 1 teaspoon real orange extract | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Prepare the sauce in a large nonstick pan. Keep on a medium flame until bubbles begin to form and evaporate. Remove from heat add remaining ingredients and stir till heated through. Pour over the hot turkey, turkey or pork.

title: Roasted Apricots With Blue Cheese
ingredients: 12 thin apricots | 1/3 cup blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the apricots and blue cheese on an aluminium foil lined baking sheet.. Broil for 5 minutes or until melted and starting to bubble around the edges. Remove from the oven. Serve at once or store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Pickled Herbs

instructions: Cut stems away from watercress and set aside. Place all 4 cups watercress in a blender jar with the reserved herbs. Cover and blend till well mixed. Refrigerate until serving time. Pour into hot sterilized jars. Note for vegetarians use 3 cups of water.

title: Apples in the Dutch Oven

instructions: Wash the chicken.

title: Brandy Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons brandy or 3 tablespoons madeira wine | 2 cups small curd cottage cheese ( cottage cheese ) | 1/2 cup brown rice | 1 1/2 cups red wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 6 cup ovenproof dish with a little olive oil and dust with flour. Put the brandy in a small saucepan, melt, and pour into the center of the prepared baking dish. Lay the cottage cheese over the brandy. Pour the wine around the cottage cheese, then scatter the rice over it. Pour the wine and brandy over everything, and bake until the rice is tender, about 60 minutes, stirring once or twice. Allow to cool slightly, then spread the entire contents of the baking dish into a bowl or serve topped with cream, chardonnay or sour cream.

title: Scottish Beef Round Steak
ingredients: 4 boneless chuck steaks | 1 can or bottle beer | 4 large onions, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a roasting pan, combine the beer and onions and heat until the liquid has just begun to boil, about 3 minutes. Spoon the mixture over the steaks, being careful not to spill. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour. Remove from oven, sprinkle with onion flakes, cover the pan and continue to bake for 30 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Fisherman's Baked Fish (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 1 white fish fillet | 1 bunch celery, finely chopped ( or more ) | 1 jar coleslaw beans or ( 1 1/2 lb ) jar fresh bean sprouts | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cardamom powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. In an ovenproof dish or skillet, pour 3 inches of water over the fish. In this order, sprinkle the fish with the celery and the beans. Sprinkle the fish with cardamom and add the ground cardamom. Cover and bake, turning the fish once or twice, for 30 minutes. Remove the cover and bake for 15 minutes longer. Note, the fish may be served this way, or browned on the top and cooked through in the oven, so watch for splatters. Note,. You may also use fish from all types of fish but be careful how bay seasoning you sprinkle it on top. This is an excellent meal made on the outdoor grill, in the latter case such as oak or ham bones and/or wood fired briquets. I also suggest salmon, cod as well as any type of fresh vegetable and use a combination of carrots and/or onion. This recipe can also be used as a topping on other dishes or in other dishes such as the traditional fish salad in addition to or with sauteed potato sticks.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,cooking oil,chicken breast half,mexican cheese,vermouth
title: Cheesy Chicken Kiev
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet with cooking spray and arrange chicken onto baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken juices run clear, 10 to 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, stir together the vermouth, celery salt and chicken. Divide the chicken mixture into 4 portions.

title: Southwestern Peppered Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 6 sheets puff pastry | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, chopped | 1/2 cup kraft mexican cheese, shredded and divided | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Unfold crust on a large baking sheet. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup olives. Combine all ingredients. Press into the prepared crust. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes. Spread with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Bake for 5 - 10 minutes more or until golden crust is bubbly.

instructions: In saucepan combine broth, beef, garlic and beef. Bring to a boil, simmer 10 minutes. Add rice noodles and banana and heat through. Serve with orange liqueur on the side.

title: Soupa(Sweet Chickpea)

instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium high heat, place cream and orange juice. As soon as the cream begins to simmer, add sugar and bring to a boil. Add tarragon and chickpeas. Cook until liquid is reduced to half. Garnish with dried tarragon leaves and serve at once.

instructions: Roast the sesame seeds in a skillet over medium heat, shaking the pan frequently, until colored and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Transfer the sesame seeds to a baking sheet and let cool. Transfer the seeds to a food processor. Add the habanero peppers, chile, paprika, and cooled sesame seeds. Blend until smooth.

instructions: Preheat oven 450f degrees. Combine beef, soup, peppers, and shallots in large bowl. Stir in shrimp. Spoon filling evenly into six ungreased 9 inch pie pans or mini muffin tins. Bake 15 minutes. Serve hot. Make ahead, the soup can be frozen, reheated, and reheated in microwave.

instructions: Place apples, 1 cup sugar, coconut milk, pear slices, beef bouillon, and 1/4 cup white sugar in a pot. Bring to a boil.

title: Cappuccino
ingredients: 1 lb penne | 3/4 cup dry instant coffee | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/8 cup ground pecans | 1/8 cup ground coriander powder
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Pour pasta into large bowl and add cold water to cover. Stir in instant coffee and grand marnier. Let stand until mixture is reduced and pasta is tender. Drain pasta and toss with pecans and coriander.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,self raising flour,coffee,guava jelly,orange peel,beef broth,cool whip,tortilla
title: Hot Chocolate Tortilla Cake
ingredients: 225 g ground beef ( lean sirloin or round steak ) | 4 teaspoons coffee | 4 teaspoons self-raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 3 tablespoons guava jelly | 300 ml strong hot brewed coffee | 140 g cool whip, to serve | 2 oranges, peeled & segmented | 4 tortillas, to serve
instructions: Pre heat oven to 160°c. Combine meat, coffee, flour, bicarbonate of soda and jelly. Spread half of meat mixture onto 12x18cm piece of baking paper, cover with remaining meat mixture and roll up. Place seam side down on 2 baking trays, and freeze for 25 minutes. Bake for 15 mins or until golden, and then cool on rack. When cool, place half of cooled cake onto serving plate. Top with half of guava jelly and half of whipped cream. Repeat with remaining cakes, arranging them on top of jelly, and drizzle with remaining jelly and cream. Sprinkle with orange segments to serve.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,fine bread crumb,fig,oleo,cayenne powder,cumin powder,green curry paste
title: Green Fish Ball - Thai - Fish Ball
ingredients: 6 large fish balls | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon oleo | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/4 cup fine dry bread crumb | 6 figs, cut in half lengthwise | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seeds
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the fish balls. You will need 18 - 18 balls at once. Mix all of the ingredients together except the fig halves and poppy seeds, and place the figs cut side down in a small bowl. Dip the fish balls into the mixture all at once, coating evenly. Place the coated fish balls on a paper towel lined cookie sheet, cover, and refrigerate approximately 2 hours or overnight. When ready to serve, bring to room temperature. Preheat the oven to 400 deg degrees f. Remove any remaining pieces of fish and place them on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until crisp and lightly browned on the edges. Drain any excess oil/water and place them in an airtight tin while the fish balls bake. You will need 18 - 18 balls at once.

title: Pear & Salmon Sausage Rollups
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 8 slices pickled pear, thinly sliced on the diagnol until they are almost completely cooked | 4 slices smoked salmon | 8 -10 slices thin flat bread
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Mix the cream and the pear slices together in a small bowl. Cut each slice of bread in two and spread thin on a cutting board. Place each slice of bread on top of the cream and pear mixture. Roll up each slice and secure with toothpicks. Place the finished roll up on a large serving platter and serve.

title: Chicken Teriyaki
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | 3 teaspoons gelatin | 3 scallions, chopped | 2 tablespoons peanuts oil
instructions: Rinse and drain the chicken, then put the chicken in a bowl. Mix the chinese shoyu with a teaspoon of the gelatin powder, then mix in the scallions. Sprinkle the jelly over the chicken, cover and set aside for 30 - 45 minutes. Heat up the oil in a skillet, and fry the chicken until it is browned. Pour in the choyu mixture. Heat up for 3 - 5 minutes before removing from the heat.

title: Stove Top Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 cups coarsely shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | fresh romaine lettuce or torn kale
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In large bowl combine cheese, baking soda and shredded lettuce. Using a tortilla press, press mixture on surface. Cook for about 15 seconds then flip and repeat. Place on large baking sheet and bake until lightly browns.

title: Rice With Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, cut into 8 pieces | 4 baby carrots, peeled | 1 leek, white part only, halved lengthwise and cut 1/4 inch thick | 1 1/2 cups rice, uncooked | 2 2/3 cups chicken broth or 2 2/3 cups beef broth | chicken broth or water ( as needed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Remove brisket to large roasting pan. Using fingers, poke holes in brisket all over. Insert bone and string tie into brisket. Drain carrots and leeks through cheese cloth and add to roasting pan. Pierce brisket 3 times with a sharp knife. Rub brisket with salt and pepper. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, bring broth to boil in a large pot. Add uncooked rice and brisket. Cover tightly and transfer to oven. Bake for 2 hours, or until meat is fork tender. Remove from oven. Place brisket on warm platter and tent with foil. Allow to rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mini Brik
ingredients: 1 egg | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 20 wonton wrappers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Beat egg and nutmeg together in a large, shallow bowl. Place a wrapper on a lightly floured surface. Make a horizontal slit lengthwise down the center of the wrapper, to make a horizontal line about 1/2 inch deep. Dip 1 wrapper at a time into egg mixture, letting excess drip off, then roll dipped wrapper around edge.

title: Chinese Shiitake Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 4 ounces dried shiitake mushrooms, stems discarded | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley leaves
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the mushrooms and the bread flour. Add the leaves and toss until evenly distributed. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Working in batches, add the mushrooms to the water and cook uncovered until soft and tender, about 3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Pate Reinagel
ingredients: 2 cooked rabbit | 1 pinch coarse salt ( to taste ) | 100 g ouzo ( or treacle ) | english muffins | 1 peach
instructions: Rabbit, split the rabbit pieces along its stomach, and clean out as much of the blood as possible. You don't want any organs inside. The blood is supposed to be the part that makes the meat fall off the bone. But if it isn't, that's too. Place the rabbit in a saucepan of boiling water, or enough to cover, and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes so the bones can float. This is not a necessary step, just to lightly cook the skin. Pate, place your favourite fillings in a bowl and stir. Squeeze as much juice as possible out of the peaches. Spoon onto meat. Place slices of the pear on top. If serving warm, leave a few for sprinkling.

title: Lime Basil Infused Oranges
ingredients: 1 cup packed basil leaves | 6 limes | orange wedge, for garnish
instructions: Finely grate the zest of 4 limes into a small bowl. Slice each limes crosswise into about 1/2 inch thick slices, and set aside. Squeeze the zest from 1 lime into a small bowl, and set aside. Halve 2 limes lengthwise, and slice into about 2 wedges, cutting the other half into half moons. Place the basil leaves in another small bowl. Juice the limes, and stir the juice into the basil. Let stand about 1 hour, stir, and refrigerate. Serve in small bowls or glasses, with orange wedges.

title: Artichoke Couscous
ingredients: 1/4 cup semolina | 1 tablespoon oil | 2 cups milk | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup peas ( frozen or fresh cut ) | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil | 2 bags frozen mixed-pepper and rice couscous, thawed | 1 2/3 cups cold water
instructions: Combine couscous and oil in a large bowl. Add milk with artichokes and peas and sesame oil, and bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Add water, cover and cook until all liquid is absorbed and couscous is tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Danish Smoky Sausage
ingredients: 4 links smoked and spicy ham | 20 cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 8 ounces kielbasa, cut in half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Place ham on a large, ovenproof frying pan and sprinkle evenly with tomato halves, cut side down. Cut kielbasa crosswise into 3 inch sausages with a sharp knife. Insert skewers through the end hole of each sausage. Place on top of tomato halves. Place into the hot oven and bake for 1 hour, basting twice with tomato juices. Remove from oven and cut in half, serving with remaining tomato halves. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,pear,sirloin,vodka,cottage cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese,red chili pepper,peanut
title: Tarantula Beef Burgers
ingredients: 600 g ground sirloin | 1 jar chargrilled red chili peppers, drained | 1 container low fat cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 2 tablespoons peanuts, crushed | 2 teaspoons low-fat vodka
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and shape into patties about 1cm thick. Bake at 190/375°f for 20 mins or grill, brushing occasionally, until well browned, turning to cook all sides.

Random Ingredients: vodka,pistachio,pasta sauce,greek oregano,tomato green chile pepper
title: Pista Piri Pasta
ingredients: 1 jar pasta sauce | 1 jar sun-dried tomato and green chile peppers | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 teaspoon greek oregano | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the pasta and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Transfer to a large serving dish, and cover with a layer of tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,nonfat milk,mint,jicama,peanut oil vegetable,heavy cream,hamburger,red chili powder
title: Jicama Hamburger Pesto Beef With Basil Pesto
ingredients: 250 g hamburger | 2 teaspoons red chili powder | 250 ml nonfat milk | 100 ml peanut oil or 100 ml vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 jicama, peeled and grated | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 3 tablespoons heavy cream
instructions: Pound or process hamburger until fine. Heat the pepper in a non stick wok and pour in the pesto. Stir fry the beef until its white on the outside, then remove to a plate. Add the jicama to the wok and stir fry until it just wilts. Add the red chili powder and stir fry just a moment, to combine. Put the milk in a bowl and add a 1 tsp of the red chili powder. Pour this into the wok with the hamburger mixture and stir fry quickly over high heat until the milk starts to thicken. Turn off heat and let sit to cool. Drain away any excess water with your hands and put the cooked meat back into the wok. Add the mint and stir quickly. Add the cream and stir through. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,confectioner ' sugar,veal,green chili salsa,lettuce,bacon dripping,chili oil
title: Easy and Quick Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 8 slices bacon drippings | 8 ounces chopped green chili salsa | 8 teaspoons confectioners'sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil | 8 ounces hamburger | 10 -12 leaves lettuce
instructions: Dice bacon and fry until crisp, then put aside in a bowl and save for later use. Add the veal to the bacon drippings and fry until brown. Then add the rest of the ingredients except for the lettuce. Mix everything well and set it aside and let it cool down. Add the bacon and mix in with the meat. Roll into small balls and cook them in the bacon fat until no longer pink inside. Add the lettuce and stir it around a little while you are cooking to ensure it gets a few bits of lettuce in the finished dish. Serve.

title: Calde Verde
ingredients: 1 small aubergines, diced | 1 can white beans or ( 19 ounce ) can peas | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 300 g snap peas
instructions: Rinse the aubergines and snap peas. Boil a small pot of water, add aubergines and snap peas. When they soften, remove the vegetables and put to one side to cool. When the skins are all removed, peel off the skins, cut into smaller pieces and put in the food processor with aubergines and peas. Stir well. Season with salt to taste. Add horseradish and mix well.

title: Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb chopped red cabbage | 1 tablespoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon instant onion seeds | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

title: Ricotta Toast
ingredients: 1 package light graviera or 2 slices bread | 2 tablespoons chicken-flavored broth | 2 tablespoons dark rum ( optional ) | 12 slices white bread | 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Cut slices of the heavy crust type bread about 1´´´´´´´ thick. Soak the slices of bread on each side with broth, rum and lemon pepper for about 5 minutes. Remove the slices from the bread using a slotted spoon and soak in the broth. Drain and keep them in a warm place until ready to serve. Cut the slices of bread about ¾´´ thick. Heat griddle about 2´´´´´s high at the highest oven. Butter the bread slices lightly with butter and place a tablespoon of ricotta on the bottom of each slice of bread. Place the slices of bread on the ricotta. Cover the sandwiches with the remaining slices of bread. In the upper half of the oven, cook the sandwiches until all the slices of bread have been fried. Serve hot.

title: Japanese Style Sweet BBQ Chicken (Teriyaki-Style)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons fresh ginger root, peeled and grated | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the grated ginger root and ketchup. Season to taste with poultry seasoning.

title: Beef Tastichoke on Banana
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef ( or other ground meat of choice ) | 2 artichoke hearts, sliced | 1 small banana, sliced | 1/2 cup fresh thyme sprig, chopped
instructions: Cook ground meat in a large, nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until browned and crumbly, 4 - 6 minutes. Remove from heat and pour off any excess fat. Add remaining ingredients, except for thyme and mix well. Add beef mixture to skillet and mix well. Cover and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, 20 - 25 minutes or until meat is tender. Remove from heat and sprinkle with thyme.

Random Ingredients: white onion,anchovy paste,chive,greek yogurt,lemon juice zest
title: Greek White Onions With Anchovy
ingredients: 2 lbs white onions, peeled | 4 ounces anchovy paste ( or homemade anchovy filet-tender, strained ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped | 3 ounces thick greek yogurt, plain ( to serve )
instructions: Cut each slice from the root end off and carefully remove the hard end from the onion without damaging the outer white layer. Slice the onion across in 2 or 3 slices, lengthways, to make thin slices. Place the slices on a tray and allow to drain for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place the anchovy paste or anchovy fillets in a saucepan with 7 cups cold water and bring to the boil. Simmer for 5 minutes, then strain through an sieve and set aside. Punch the anchovy paste, then put it into a small pan with the lemon juice and enough water to make a thin paste. Whisk the mixture over a medium heat until the water has boiled off, then simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 to 15 minutes, or until slightly reduced. Cool the anchovy paste completely. When ready to serve, put the onions, then the cooled anchovy paste into a serving bowl and gently mix in the yoghurt so that the onions are well incorporated into the yogurt. Serve at room temperature.

title: Peruvian Salmon & Rice Noodle Tacos
ingredients: 16 ounces boneless and skinless salmon, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 2 medium rutabagas, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 medium anaheim chilies ( about 2 cups ) or 1 medium poblano chile, seeded and chopped ( about 2 cups ) | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 package rice vermicelli, broken in half ( thin )
instructions: Arrange the cooked rice noodles in a single layer in a 13 in baking dish. Top with the salmon, chiles, tomato sauce, and rice noodles and sprinkle with salt. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and marinate the seafood for up to 2 days in the refrigerator, turning 2 or 3 times. Bring to room temperature. Bake, uncovered, in a 350°f oven for 30 minutes. Serve the seafood hot.

Random Ingredients: sea bass,salt pork,peppermint extract,chili flake,monterey jack cheese,sultana
title: Caramelized Sea Bass With Sultanas and Chilies
ingredients: 1 sea bass | 8 ounces sultanas | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon peppermint extract | salt ( can use kosher salt for an extra kick ) | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese ( optional ) or 1/2 cup colby cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a medium sized baking tray at 400 degrees. Slice the sea bass in half. Place pieces on the tray and set aside. Place the sultanas in small bowl with a little bit of water and stir to combine. Once the sultanas are combined set aside. Incorporate the peppermint extract into the mixture. Rinse fish fillets with cold water and pat dry with paper towel. Place in a non stick pan, place on the hot griddle and cook two pieces at a time. Cook the fish for approximately 8 - 10 minutes each side. When cooked place one piece of sea bass on a plate and place the two pieces of sea bass on top. Top with chilies to serve. Serve with sour cream and salsa and fresh salad leaves. Delicious.

title: Tastes With Mustard and Dried Red Chile
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 lb fresh red grapes, washed, stems removed | 1 red chile pepper, seeded and sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 325° f and arrange the grapes on a parchment lined baking sheet. Sprinkle the mustard over the grapes and roast in the preheated oven for about 30 minutes or until tender. Cool slightly and serve warm.

title: Spanish Yellow Turnips and Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, peeled, diced and cut into 6 chunks each | 3 ounces sliced black beans or 3 ounces pimentos, drained | 3 bulbs of garlic, cloves peeled, cut lengthwise in half
instructions: Cook turnips in boiling salted water for 5 minutes, or until tender.

title: Mcuddy's Lola Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 fluid ounces kahlua | 1 1/2 fluid ounces kahlua | 3 cups iceberg lettuce, leaves | 3 bottles lager-style beer, divided
instructions: Blend kahlua and 2 cups ice in blender on high, until smooth.

Random Ingredients: celery flake,pumpkin seed,heavy cream,feta cheese,phyllo pastry,farfalle pasta,onion
title: Feta-Stuffed Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta, cooked and drained | 1 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds, shelled | 1/2 cup sweet onion, minced | 1/4 teaspoon celery flakes | 8 sheets frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1/4 cup heavy cream or 1/4 cup milk
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cooked pasta, feta cheese, pumpkin seeds, onion, and celery flakes. Brush 2 sheets of the phyllo dough on two baking sheets, brushing each with milk. Divide the filling among the sheets, and sprinkle with the remaining pastry. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 400 degrees, or until the filling is hot. If the filling is not hot enough, add warm water to make it creamy. Garnish with paprika and lemon zest.

title: French American Style Pizza Dough
ingredients: 225 g beef, very lean and very lean | 4 teaspoons margarine | 4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast ( fleischmann's )
instructions: Put everything into a very large mixing bowl and dig in well. Mix on a strong floured surface til a nice ball forms. Turn out onto floured board and knead on a lightly floured surface til smooth and elastic. Add in 1/2 cup warm water if needed. Cover and let rest 25 minutes. Line two cookie sheets with parchment paper. Using a rolling pin and a floured rolling pin press up dough into pan. Stretch and roll out dough till it is about 1/8 1/4 thick. Spread with the yeast and bake at 190 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Danish Red Wine Jelly
ingredients: 1 jar apricot preserves | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Mix the preserves and red wine vinegar together in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil until preserves begin to melt, 2 to 5 minutes. Stir in the jelly. When jelly is thick, remove from heat. Transfer to sterile jars.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,mustard powder,green onion,chili powder,turmeric,chunky salsa,pistachio nut,peanut oil
title: Halibut With Mexican Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups thick & chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon powdered turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup pistachio nut, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup green onion, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 4 halibut fillets, 1-1/2 inches thick
instructions: Combine salsa, mustard, turmeric, chili powder, pistachios, green onions. Place oil in 13 x 9 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add halibut.

title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup--With a Twist
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 medium onion, minced | 2 cups cauliflower, washed and cut into florets | 1/2 cup dry vermouth or 3/4 cup white wine | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Brown meat& onion over low heat, stirring until meat is brown.. Add cauliflower& vermouth, bring to a boil. Reduce heat& simmer for 20 - 30 minutes. Stir occasionally. Place the 1 can of broth in a blender. Cover& blend till smooth. Serve with chopped fresh parsley.

title: Bacon Wrapped Green Pepper Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices smoked bacon | 1 large green pepper, sliced | 2 ciabatta rolls | baby rocket
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp, drain and slice into thin strips. Put in a ciabatta sandwich tin or on your serving plate. Take the peppers and put on the bacon. Put a leaf of rocket on top of the peppers to give them a sandwich. Enjoy these are great with a fresh green salad.

title: Kielbasa and Kielbasa (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs kielbasa | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 3 teaspoons ground sage | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | soup, to serve
instructions: Place kielbasa in a 4 to 5 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle with garlic, sage, parsley and seasoning. Pour soup over. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours. Shred meat using two forks, and serve with salad, vegetable, etc.

title: Rosemary Poached Watercress
ingredients: 25 -30 small rosemary stems, stems finely chopped | 15 -20 slices bacon, cooked and drained | 20 -30 leaves fresh watercress
instructions: Bring 10 - 12 ounces salted water to boil. Add rosemary sprigs. Cook until limp, but not wilted. Drain watercress and spread onto a large serving plate. Arrange bacon over the top.

title: Grilled Rye Bread
ingredients: 6 1/2 ounces rye bread | 4 large eggs | 4 tablespoons mustard, for mustard patties | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce, for patties ( or sambal oelek ) | 2 teaspoons oil, for patties ( optional ) | salt
instructions: Preheat grill. Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Cut the bread slices in half diagonally, place into a baking sheet. Whisk the eggs and mustard together until well mixed. Whisk in 3 tbsp of the barbecue sauce, 1 tbsp of the oil and the remaining 2 tbsp of oil. Pour over the bread, leaving the bread edges to form a ridge or rim. Brush generously with oil. Lightly toss the surfaces of the bread with egg mixture, season and oil the grates. Cook under griller on each side until golden.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,liquid smoke,white sesame seed,coriander seed,white flour
title: Moroccan Mushroom Powder
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 2 cups mushroom pieces, dried | 1/2 cup coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon white sesame seeds, crushed | 1/2 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Put dry ingredients in bowl and add liquid smoke. Mix to form a thick paste. Add chopped mushrooms and mix well. If mixture is too wet, add liquid as necessary to achieve the right consistency. Knead well and refrigerate overnight. Keep covered. The next morning, make dumplings, using 1 1/2 tbsp flour for each dumpling. Flatten with a rolling pin. Bake on a nonstick cookie sheet for 15 - 20 minutes at 425 degrees f. Dust with more sesame if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,tomato,cream chicken soup,carob powder,white flour,chili
title: Mom's Chicken in Gravy
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can crushed tomatoes | chicken bouillon cube | white flour, for dredging | carro powder | chili
instructions: Mix together soup and crushed tomatoes, and pour into casserole pan with lid on. Add the boullion cube, and enough water to just cover the bottom of the pan. Add the whole can of tomatoes with juice, and cover. Cook for 3 hours at 325 degrees. Add the flour and chilis to the top and serve.

title: Yogurt and Tzatziki Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tzatziki ( homemade, if possible ) | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese
instructions: Mix together the tzatziki and ricotta and mix well.

title: Pineapple Butter Bean Snack
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soft butter beans | 3 tablespoons pineapple juice | 3 tablespoons rice, rinsed | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 25 fluid ounces light cream sandwich spread ( can be made from creamers ) | 1 tablespoon suet, sifted
instructions: Put the butter beans and pine juice in a pan. Stir in the rice, making sure the mixture is evenly mixed into the buttery beans. Spread the cream sandwich spread on top of the rice mixture. Press the mixture down firmly with your fingers. The butter bean mixture should be absorbed by the cream spread. Sprinkle the suet over the top. If you're serving lunch today, bake this sandwich in the oven for 6 - 8 minutes at 300f until browned.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,coffee,tamarind paste,lime juice,ramen noodle,roasting chicken,nicoise olive,gruyere cheese
title: A Different and Yummier Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 2 ounces sliced gruyere cheese | 1 pinch nicoise olives, to taste | 2 tablespoons tequila ( i prefer patron brand ) | 2 2 ounces roasted unsalted jerky-seasoned rice wine vinegar or 2 ounces brewed coffee | 2 ounces ground espresso or 2 ounces coffee-infused coffee | 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed orange juice | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste
instructions: Using the flat of your hand, roll the chicken breast up on the inside of the bird, and place on a rack, fat side up. Brush the outside of the chicken with a little olive oil. Lay the ham rolls down around the chicken. Place the cheese, olives, and tequila in a wide, shallow dish with a lid and cover with plastic wrap. Let sweat in the fridge, for at least 4 hours and up to six depending on the type of chick you're using. Preheat the oven to 425°f. Place the rice wine vinegar, espresso, orange juice, and tamarind into a bowl, mix well with a fork. Spread the tamarind mixture evenly over the inside of the chicken. Poke chicken with a fork, or skewer, and place on an elevated rack. Roast, covered, for 30 - 35 minutes or until no longer pink and juices run clear. To serve, remove cover and flip over on a carving board or platter.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,jalapeno pepper,shrimp,jalapeno chile,lamb,fontina cheese,red potato
title: Portuguese Shrimp and Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 lbs medium red potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 10 ounces fontina cheese, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 fresh jalapeno chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 2 pickled jalapeno chiles, seeded and finely chopped, with | 1/2 cup guinness stout | 2 fresh jalapeno chiles, stems, and seeds removed, with | 3 whole jalapeno chiles, stems, seeds, and seeds removed, with
instructions: In a large bowl, toss shrimp with potato pieces, 2/3 of fontina cheese, 1 chile, and 3 jalapeno chiles. Pour guinness into medium saucepan. Heat, but do not bring to boil. Pour guinness mixture over shrimp, and gently toss well. Arrange shrimp mixture in 9x13 baking dish. Sprinkle remaining 1 3/4 of fontina cheese over top. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes, or until cheese is browned.

title: Easy Meejeh Sabzi (Indian Carrot Side Dish)
ingredients: 1 lb carrot, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup rice noodles ( long cooking rice noodles can also be used ) | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Boil carrots in water for approximately 5 minutes and remove. When done, drain and put carrots into hot salad spinner to cool to room temperature. Combine garam masala and rice noodles in large bowl and sprinkle with rice powder. Mix thoroughly and add to remaining vegetables. Add parsley and toss. Serve warm or cold.

title: Velveeta Potatoes
ingredients: 4 lbs velveeta cheese | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 can vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Cube the velveta, or use the block of fatback you sliced it into, cutting out large chunks, and place in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water. Add the tarragon and vegetable broth. Melt the velveta over low heat, until warm, but do not boil. You don’t want the buttery, foamy pieces of cheese floating. Drain the water off the cheese and pour into a roasting pan. Cover the pan with a lid or aluminum foil. Bake 20 minutes, remove the baking dish from the oven and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tomato Bitter
ingredients: 1 tomatoes, sliced thinly ( optional ) | 1 dash angostura bitters | 2 tablespoons grated fresh carrot | 1/4 cup tomato juice
instructions: Stir tomato slices with a splash of bitters until coated with bitters. Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with grated carrot, and serve.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,prickly pear,quinoa,marjoram,oat,green chilies,cinnamon sugar,french bean
title: Quinoa-Chile Muesli (Vegetarian.)
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups quinoa | 1 cup french beans, chopped and thawed if frozen | 1 green chili pepper | 1 green chili pepper | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1 can chopped green chilies | 3 -4 tablespoons rolled oats | 5 -6 -7 tablespoons cajun spices ( optional ) or 5 -7 tablespoons curry powder ( optional )
instructions: Soak quinoa for 1 hour. Drain and rinse. If frozen cook in rice cooker. After cooking quinoa. While quinoa is cooking add 1 tblsps olive oil or canola oil if possible. Meanwhile heat up 1 1/2 celsius olive oil or canola oil in a pan. Add 1 chopped pepper and 1 chopped green chile. Fry until tender. Add 1 tblsps olive oil or canola oil. After 2 minutes add 1 - 2 tblsps olive oil or canola oil. Fry a bit more. Add 1 tblsps olive oil or canola oil. Add quinoa and 1/2 1 1/2 cup of water or more to moisten, rice is good for this step also. Add 1 - 2 tblsps dried marjoram, 1 tsp cinnamon, 4 - 5 tblsp green chili peppers if using. Simmer for 15 minutes. Turn off heat and add in can of chopped green chilies which have been undrained. When quinoa and peppers are done remove from heat. Add the 2 tblsps chopped and unthawed olives. Pour the rice mix over the peppers and mix well. If it seems runny add more water. Put in a bowl of a baking pan or a cookie tray and bake at 400ºf for 20 - 25 minutes or until rice should have a crispy edge. Remove from oven and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,plain yogurt,sherry wine,bamboo shoot,golden raisin,scallion,almond milk,chicken meat
title: Chicken Asparagus & Raisin Salad With Almonds
ingredients: 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 bag fresh asparagus, cleaned, trimmed, and cut into 2-inch pieces | 7 ounces cooked shredded chicken meat | 2 scallions, including green parts, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1/4 cup almond milk | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Combine the asparagus, bamboo shoots, chicken, and scallions in a large mixing bowl. Stir golden raisins into yogurt with almond milk. Pour dressing over salad and toss. Adjust seasonings with reserved scallions and serve.

title: Avocado Tequila Sorbet
ingredients: 24 sprigs fresh parsley leaves | 1 1/2 cups tequila | 2 ripe avocados - peeled, pitted, and diced | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line an 8x8 inch baking dish or roasting pan with parchment paper. Place sprigs of parsley in the bottom of the prepared pan. Scoop about 1 cup of the tequila atop the sprigs in the pan. Place the pan over the tequila. Gently toss the avocado in the pan, then stir in the crushed red pepper flakes. Scoop the avocado mixture into the baking dish, being careful not to dislodge the parsley from the sprigs. Bake in the preheated oven until the salsa is hot and very bubbling, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red salmon,extra virgin olive oil,chinese cabbage,cold water,parsley leaf
title: Chinese Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage ( napa ) | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 cup cold water | 2 cups small red salmon
instructions: Cut cabbage leaves in half if necessary and divide each half into three or six small lengths. Using a vegetable peeler, slice cabbage into thin strips about ½ inch wide. Cut salmon into thick strips about ½ inch wide, about 5 inches long. In a skillet, warm 1 tablespoon of the olive oil over moderate heat and, stirring, add the cabbage strips and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes, or until cabbage is crisp tender and lightly browned. Add the salt and stir. Add water and bring to a boil in a 3 to 4 quart heavy pot or deep skillet over moderate heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer, loosely covered, stirring occasionally with a fork or offset spatula until cabbage is tender but firm, about 20 minutes. Uncover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is crisp tender, about 20 minutes more. Stir in salmon and taste for salt and adjust any seasoning. Serve warm.

title: Tomato Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sour cream or 1 1/2 cups tartaragon | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a bowl, combine sour cream and cream of tartar. Stir in the cream of tartar.. Turn mix into a greased pie plate. Cover and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until center is set. Cut into squares while warm.

title: Cheat's Cheese Mousse With Olives and Applesauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon applesauze | 1 tablespoon kalamata olives | 1/2 lb gouda cheese | 1 tablespoon citron | 3/4 cup eagle brand condensed milk
instructions: Chop the pith from the cheese and set aside. Finely chop the olives. In a small bowl, combine applesauze, olives, and cheese. Mix well. Grate the citron into cheese mixture. With a blender, add the entire contents to the cheese mix and blend until it's nice and smooth. Taste and add more spices if needed. Place cheese mixture in a serving dish and chill until ready to serve. To serve, pour cheese mousse into dishes and garnish with sprigs of lemon. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,brown lentil,cilantro,lemon juice zest,almond paste,gruyere cheese
title: Lebanese Lentil Tart (Quatrati)
ingredients: 1 large lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 2 -3 fresh thyme sprigs | 1 cup brown lentils or 1 cup other fine lentils, picked over and rinsed | 1 -2 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons almond paste | fresh cilantro ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water, 1 1/2 tsp salt and a few dashes of black pepper to a boil over high heat.

title: Peas & Rice Casserole With Curried Squash
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seed ( or to taste ) | 6 ounces peas | 3 cups arborio rice | 1 squash ( about 2 pounds or 2 medium ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated ( about 2 oz ) | 8 pita bread rounds
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Heat cumin seeds over medium high heat in a large skillet, stirring until fragrant and slightly toasted. Stir in the peas, rice and squash. Bake covered 15 minutes or until liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally or until water absorbed and rice grains are tender.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,pinto bean,orange juice concentrate,chocolate square,hominy,tilapia fillet,potato
title: Lilah's Baked Fish and Potatoes
ingredients: 3 - 4 lbs tilapia fillets | 1 lb potato, cut into 1-inch chunks | 5 ounces cream cheese | 3 cans hominy, drained and rinsed | 4 cups frozen orange juice concentrate | 3/4 cup semisweet chocolate squares | 1 cup whole pinto beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Coat a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Place tilapia in single layer in dish. In a medium bowl, combine egg, cream cheese, hominy, orange juice concentrate and chocolate. Stir well. Pour over tilapia. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.

title: Southern Snow Peas With Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups thinly sliced winter squash ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 8 ounces shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add the 1 1/2 cups of diced squash and 3/4 cup of shredded cheese to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook and stir the mixture until the vegetables are wilted, about 2 minutes. Stir in ¾ cup of water and cook until the cheese melts and the mixture is piping hot, 8 to 10 minutes more. Serve immediately.

title: Spinach Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 3/4 cups spinach | 8 ounces tomato paste | 2/3 cup half-and-half or 2/3 cup cream | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Boil water in a casserole or pan. Add rice and spinach and let sit 15 minutes or more, stirring a couple of times. Stir in tomato paste and season with salt and pepper. Pour in cream and stir fry for 1 or 2 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chickpea 'n' Sourdough Casserole
ingredients: 5 cups assorted fresh mushrooms | 1 can yellow peas | 2 can chickpeas, drained | 2 packages loaf sourdough bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil, or as needed | 1 cup sour cream, optional garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Toss fresh mushrooms, yellow peas, chickpeas, and sourdough bread with vegetable oil in a large baking dish.

Random Ingredients: white flour,corn oil,romaine lettuce,yogurt,salt black pepper,pecorino romano cheese
title: Italian Cheese Slices
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and dried | 3 cups unbleached white flour | 2 cups corn oil | 2 cups grated pecorino romano cheese | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 cup yogurt
instructions: In a salad bowl, add lettuce, dry cheese, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly. Serve immediately. Dry cheese freezes fine.

title: Penne Pasta With Egg Noodles (Lite )
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta ( or other tubular pasta such as rotini, ziti, rotini, spaghetti ) | 1 egg noodles ( i use dreamfields brand for this ) | 1 tablespoon dry red wine or 1 tablespoon white wine | 3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a pot of boiling, salted water, add pasta and cook until al dente.

Random Ingredients: loaf ciabatta,crabmeat,deli ham,white vinegar,hot pepper,vanilla sugar,rice
title: Cuban Cracker Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 -2 loaf ciabatta roll | 16 ounces imitation crabmeat | 1 -2 tablespoon rice or 1 -2 tablespoon pasta flakes, etc. | 1 3/4 - 1 3/4 tablespoons white vinegar or 1 3/4-1 3/4 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons of melted vanilla sugar or 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar | hot pepper
instructions: Slice roll in to half, lengthwise. Spread with oil, let rest for 20minutes. Spread roll flat in broiler. Top with imitation crabmeat, sprinkle with rice or pasta flakes, etc. Top with remaining roll. Mix together remaining ingredients and add to top of roll. Place under preheated broiler for 5 - 7 minutes or until the edges are nicely browned and the filling is hot. Cut into 8 slices.

Random Ingredients: italian salami,cardamom,beef stew meat,mini chocolate chip
title: Italian Salami Appetizer
ingredients: 1 beef stew meat | 1/2 cup mini chocolate chip | 5 slices italian salami | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom, or more to taste
instructions: Cut the beef stew beef into cubes about 1 inch thick and place into a baking dish or crock of your choice. Sprinkle meat evenly with 1/2 cup of the mini chips. Top with the salami slices. Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon of freshly ground cardamom on top of the salami. Bake at 350 degrees f for 1 hour or until the meat is thoroughly cooked.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,basil leaf,pork shoulder,heavy whipping cream,roast beef,cocoa
title: Roast Beef and Pork With Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 6 1- to 2-by-1-inch slices | 12 ounces whole blanched porcini mushrooms | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 cup packed fresh basil leaf
instructions: Combine mushrooms, cocoa, cream, and half the basil in a bowl. Place pork in a large baking pan. Add sauce and sprinkle with remaining basil. Pour remaining basil over. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Remove pork slices from dish.

title: Roasted Pork Belly
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 5 pounds pork belly, cut into 1-inch cube | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring vegetable oil and sea salt to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Add pork belly, reduce heat, and cook until pork is cooked through and juices run clear, about 15 minutes. Transfer pork pieces to a medium roasting pan and cover with romaine lettuce. Bake in preheated oven until romaine is tender, about 1 hour.

title: On the Go Italian Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 24 inches pizza crusts | 1/2 of an orange peels ( or lemon with zest ) or 1/2 an orange, juice of ( or lemon with zest ) | 1 1/2 cups onion, finely chopped ( sweet onion such as vidalia or sweet onion ) | 1/2 cup double cream | fresh ground white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread the base of the pizza dough with a thin layer of white pepper. Layer the onions and cheese on top of the white pepper. Add the juice of the orange/lemon. Roll the dough into a long sausage shape. Cut the thin sausage into thin slices about 2 inches long. Arrange slices, overlapping, along pizza dough. Paint the top with flour and bake for 8 minutes or until cheese is bubbly. Remove from oven. Let cool for 5 minutes. Loosen with a fork. Cut into four or six pieces and serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: ice,pistachio,banana,macadamia nut,fenugreek seed,salt black pepper,adobo sauce,onion soup mix
title: Pistachio Banana and Chipotle Bliss(Guilt Free)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups finely chopped sweetened pistachios | 1/3 cup finely chopped salted roasted pistachios | 1 packet onion soup mix | 3 banana, ripe | 4 tablespoons chipotle adobo sauce, plus, a little, for dipping ( available in latino markets ) | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1 cup coarsely crushed ice | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Mix the pistachios and roasted pistachios in a large mixing bowl. Toss the pistachios and pistachios with the onions and 1 teaspoon of adobo in a mortar before pounding in the pistachios and pistachios. Place in a shallow baking dish, cover with aluminum foil, and refrigerate overnight, stirring 3 to 5 times. Stir together the remaining 1/2 teaspoon adobo with garlic powder and the remaining 1 tablespoon of adobo in a small skillet over medium heat. Saute until fragrant, about 2 to 3 minutes. Set aside. Split the banana lengthwise and scrape the seeds out with a spoon. Blend the chipotle adobo mixture with chipotle oil in a blender or food processor fitted with a chopping blade. Place in a saucepan over medium heat and fry, stirring until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add the fenugreek and toast until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in 1/4 cup ice and 1 tablespoon of baking powder. Blend until smooth, adding water if necessary to get a smooth batter. Season the batter to taste with salt and pepper. Dip 1 to 2 balls of ice into the chipotle batter, then let excess drip off. Arrange 3 to 4 chipotle Bliss in the baking dish, overlapping slices if necessary. Place 1 or 2 additional slices of fruit on top of each Bliss and gently press. Set the dish on a rimmed baking sheet and bake until the topping is golden brown and crisp, about 35 minutes.

title: Red Currant and Smoked Salmon With Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 4 tablespoons fresh red currant jelly | 8 ounces smoked salmon | 1 large pinch salt | 8 pieces dried malaysian smoked sausage with smoky red currant jelly
instructions: Rub the smoked sausages with red currant jelly and a pinch of salt. Wrap the smoked salmon in foil or plastic wrap, and place on foil on a barbecue rack over a grill. Grill quickly for 8 to 10 minutes or until the smoked smoked sausages have a crispy and evenly coloured coating. Serve hot. To freeze, place the dried sausage on a dish lined with clingfilm, then put the saucepan contents in a freezer bag and remove the sausage. Shake off any excess water and put in the freezer to finish chilling. Remove the sausage from the freezer, place the sausage into the saucepan that was used to cook the smoked sausage, and bring to boil. Turn down the heat to a slow simmer, cover, and set the sausage aside to cool.

title: Sweet Thai Chicken Bread Wedges
ingredients: 3 eggplants | 3 stalks fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup salad oil | 100 g red chilies | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1 cup thai sweet apricot jam | 3 slices challah, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c, and lightly grease baking trays. Slice the eggplants and ginger in half across the width. Lay the halves, skin side up, on the baking trays. Make slight holes in each onion with a skewer and brush lightly with oil. Place in the oven for 20 minutes. Turn the eggplants, ginger, chilli, limeade concentrate and apricot jam into a bowl. Place both of the bread and the bread in each of two shallow, ovenproof bowls. Spoon fruit into each bowl. Serve warm.

title: Yummy Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed | 2 1/2 cups sushi rice | 2 tablespoons green onions, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, dried | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half ( or whole milk )
instructions: Heat oven to 375'f. Roll out half of the pastry on a floured surface. Cut into two 10 squares. Arrange on a greased baking sheet. Brush and sift dry rice, green onion, honey, rosemary and cayenne on top. In 2 or 3 batches, roll each pastry into a 10 inch circle. Brush each half with half and half. Place a pastry stick onto each pastry stick. Spread some of the cooled sushi rice on each pastry stick. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes or until filling is hot and rice is crisp.

Random Ingredients: red potato,red chili pepper flake,kalamata olive,linguine,broth,cream celery soup,orange zest
title: Greek Red Potato Pasta With a Kick
ingredients: 2 large red potatoes | 1 red chili pepper flakes, deseeded and minced ( or less if you want a milder sauce ) | 8 ounces linguine | 1 cup broth or 1 cup seafood stock | 1 cup light cream of celery soup | 1/2 fresh orange, zest of, grated and zested | 1 cup kalamata olive, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Cook or boil red potato until just tender, around 5 - 8 minutes depending on size, drain and cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Add chili flakes and zest, stir until zest is absorbed. Meanwhile cook linguini until just tender and drain. Mix all ingredients together in bowl and serve over cooked pasta.

title: Smoked Sea Scallof With Radishes Appetizer
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin steaks ( about 2-1/2 pounds total for well-stirred steaks ) | sea scallops, 6 inches long, trimmed | 8 slices white bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 lb radish, cut into thin rounds
instructions: Lay the tenderloin steaks on a cutting board or a rimmed baking sheet. Using a knife, split the steaks lengthwise along the grain. With a paring knife, make small, 1 1/2 diagonal cuts in each grain of meat. Set the steaks under running water, let stand 30 minutes, then drain. Pat meat dry with paper towels. Grill the steaks to desired doneness, 4 to 5 minutes for medium rare to medium well done. Set crusty side up and top with scallops. Place bread cubes on a heated platter. Spoon equal amounts of radishes on bread and radish in a large, shallow bowl. Spoon equal amounts of the smoked scalloponhos on the radish and scalloponcinis. Serve with crackers.

title: Potato, Spinach and Chive Stir Fry
ingredients: 500 g waxy potatoes, peeled and cut into 2cm cubes | 150 g fresh spinach leaves | 6 fresh chives, stalks removed | 2 tablespoons rice wine | fresh fruit, slices or mango, peeled and sliced ( optional, but very nice when served )
instructions: Place the potatoes in a saucepan and cover with water.

title: Saffron and Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 small tart apples ( such as jazzbread ) | 1/8 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 pinch saffron | any vinaigrette, to taste
instructions: Take the core out of the apples and slice them as thinly as possible, without removing the bitter peel. Cut the apples in half and gently pare them. Place in a bowl, sprinkle the cumin, salt and saffron over the apple and toss gently. When apples have absorbed all the salt and oil, add vinaigrette, to taste, and toss once or twice.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,grain rice,stove stuffing mix,sugar snap pea,string bean,cointreau liqueur
title: Stove Top Rice With Sugar Snap Peas & Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 box long grain rice or ( 13 1/2 ounce ) box brown rice blend, seasoned to your taste | 1 package stove top stuffing mix | 1 can tomato sauce | 3 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1 -2 bag frozen string bean, thawed if using fresh | 1 jar sugar snap peas, thawed if using fresh
instructions: In a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker, combine rice, stuffing mix and tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: lump crabmeat,yellow onion,bechamel sauce,chicken bouillon cube
title: Huey's Crab Soup
ingredients: 1 can lump crabmeat | 1 large yellow onion | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube | 1 jar bechamel sauce
instructions: Saute onion in butter until golden brown add bouillon cube.. Bring to boil. Add undrained crab and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in bechamel sauce. Serve.

title: Hot Chili Cashew Spread
ingredients: 12 ounces soft cashews, finely powdered | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Heat a skillet or wok over medium heat. Add cashews and fry, stirring constantly, until golden brown and well mixed. Pour about 2 - 3 tablespoons of chili oil into the pan and reduce heat so cashews brown evenly. Stir in remaining chili oil, and continue to stir until the mixture smells fragrant. Cool, store in refrigerator.

title: Edamame Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb edamame, in pods | 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Wash the edamame and dry them on paper towels. Heat a skillet over medium heat and add the edamame. Cook about 2 minutes on each side, or until they are softened and beginning to brown. Spread them on a paper towel. Place the cheese on top and sprinkle lightly with a little parsley and salt.

Random Ingredients: vermicelli,vegetable broth,corn kernel,rice wine vinegar,baby spinach,soy sauce,sirloin tip,peanut oil
title: Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 4 cups torn fresh baby spinach | 6 ounces vermicelli | 1 package frozen corn kernels
instructions: Slice steak into thin bite sized strips. Place meat in a mixing bowl with remaining ingredients except spinach. Toss with steak and let marinate for at least 30 minutes. Cook pasta according to package directions, rinse under cold water and drain. Combine with meat mixture. Garnish with sprigs of parsley.

title: Orange Rice  Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 4 -6 tablespoons unsalted butter | 25 g cornflour | 1 cup white cornmeal | 2 -3 tablespoons orange juice | 3 dill sprigs ( for garnishing )
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 4 - 5 cups of water to the boil. Gradually stir in the rice, a little at a time, until the water is absorbed. Reduce the heat to simmer, cover and cook until the rice is cooked. Remove the pot from the heat and let stand, covered, for 5 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, sift the cornflour into a large bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and mix to a smooth consistency, adding a little extra water if necessary. Transfer the rice and cornflour mixture to a large casserole dish or a wide shallow pan. Garnish with a little dill and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,pickling cucumber,yellow bell pepper,sherry,cooking spray,blueberry,baking soda,chili pepper flake
title: Pickled Baked Cucumbers (Low Fat and Low Sugar)
ingredients: 2 cups blueberries | 1 1/4 cups chopped celery ribs | 1 1/4 cups finely chopped yellow bell peppers | 1 tablespoon pickling cucumbers or 1 tablespoon cucumber-based relish | 1/4 cup dry sherry, such as anisette ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes, depending on taste ( i use more ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons light-brown-tasting rice bran powder-gluten baking soda | cooking spray
instructions: Pour enough water into a medium saucepan to reach 1/4 inch up the side of the food processor bowl. Add the blueberries, green celery, bell pepper, and pickling cucumber relish. Warm over medium low heat, cover, and let stand until the berries soften to your liking, about 10 minutes but check after 2 hours. If moisture seems runny, remove lid and cook until liquid is syrupy, about 5 minutes. Remove lid and cook about 2 minutes more. Stir in the chili flakes. While the pickling cucumbers are cooking, make the brine by putting the rice bran in a small bowl. Stir in a pinch of salt and enough water to cover. When the water boils, add it. When the water boils again, add it. When the water boils again, add it. When the water boils again, add it. When the water boils again, add it. Mix well. Dissolve the baking soda and chili flakes in the brine, and pour about 1/4 1/3 cup into each serving bowl. Scoop out 1/2 teaspoon of mixture, and set aside. Once cool, use a teaspoon to scoop a 1/2 teaspoon full of mixture into each sterilized glass and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of the reserved brine. Serve chilled.

title: Mushroom and Barley Pate With Oranges
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs barley ( not wheat grains ) | 1/2 lb dried portabella mushroom | 1/2 teaspoon ground orange peel
instructions: Soak portabello mushrooms in cold water for 1 hour. Drain and chop coarsely. Cook barley in 2 cups hot water until soft. Drain. Rinse mushrooms and add them to barley mixture. Add orange peel when ready to use. This makes 3 or 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,tomato juice,fruit,orange zest,coriander seed
title: Fruit Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup chopped dried fruit | 1/2 teaspoon shredded orange zest | 1/4 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/2 cup tomato juice
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except the tomato juice in a bowl and place on the lowest possible oven rack in the oven. Cook in the oven 20 minutes to 1 hour until sauce is thickened, stirring from time to time.

title: Corned Beef With Pistachios and Jicama
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons distilled white corn syrup ( or corn syrup diluted with 1/4 cup water ) | 1 corned beef brisket, about 1-1/4 pounds | 8 ounces jicama, slices cut to about 2 tablespoons length | 2 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Bring broth and corn syrup to a boil in a large heavy saucepan over medium high heat. Slice brisket into about 1 slices. Add brisket to broth.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,malt vinegar,ice cube,anise seed,ladyfinger,cheddar cheese,lemongrass,steak
title: Lemongrass Grilled Flank Steak - 5 Points
ingredients: 4 -5 stalks lemongrass, leaves only ( bottom third only ) | 2 teaspoons whole anise seeds | 2 teaspoons orange blossom water | 2 lbs flank steaks | 2 cups malt vinegar | 5 tablespoons grated cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons grated reduced-fat cheddar cheese | 4 tablespoons freshly chopped lemongrass | 15 ladyfingers ( about 9 inches in length if fresh ) | ice cube
instructions: For the syrup, preheat the broiler. Remove the base of the lemon grass stalks from the stalk. Split the stalks lengthwise into halves and chop finely. Combine the lemongrass, anise and orange blossom water in a small bowl. Trim the meat of any visible fat and slice the meat crosswise into thin slivers. Brush with the syrup and let marinate at room temperature for at least 30 minutes. Slice the steak diagonally 1/2 inch thick, about 3 1/2 inches long. Heat up grill or grill pan. Brush the steaks with oil and grill for 7 - 10 minutes or until rare. If desired, let cool for 5 minutes. For the topping, place the vinegar, cheddar, cheese, lemon grass, and a few sprigs of zest in a small non reactive baking dish. Cover and shake vigorously. Remove the dish from the heat and let sit for 5 minutes. Place the ladyfingers on a clean cloth or kitchen towel and set over a small platter. Add more herbs to taste. To serve, run the tip of a knife around the side of the dish. Place one or two sprigs of lemon grass inside so it will pick up the juices. Spoon some of those juices onto the dish and put the steak on top of the herb and herb.

title: Chile and Mango Chutney Sauce
ingredients: 10 poblano chiles | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 2 cups diced mango chutney, divided | 6 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Bring a kettle of water to a boil. Brush poblano chilies with oil, and place them in the boiling water. Boil for about 5 minutes, then place the chilies in a blender, and blend until smooth, about 5 minutes. Bring a saucepan of water to boil. Add 1 tablespoon honey, chili oil, chili pepper puree, 1/2 cup of mango chutney, and dark chocolate to the blender, and blend until very smooth, about 10 seconds. Stir in cayenne to taste, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: spanish chorizo,vodka,rosemary leaf,green bell pepper,fennel,coriander powder
title: Marinated Green Pepper Vodka
ingredients: 1 lb spanish chorizo or 1 lb other sausage | 1 1/2 lbs green bell peppers, seeded and cut into thin strips | 2 fresh fennel, cut into 2-inch chunks | 3 1/2 cups vodka | 3 sprigs fresh rosemary leaves | 3 tablespoons coriander powder
instructions: Cook the chorizo until brown breaking up clumps as it cooks. Remove chorizo from pan and cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Add the red bell pepper strips, fennel slices and vodka and simmer about 10 minutes until peppers are crisp tender. Add rosemary and coriander. Serve chilled, or at room temperature.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Meat
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tongues | 1 cup chow mein noodles | 1 cup sesame seeds
instructions: Heat a large heavy pot on low heat. In large plastic container with a tight fitting lid, place tongues, and add enough hot water to cover. Turning once, tightly tie the ends of the tongue. Let sit, covered, overnight in the refrigerator. Next day drain liquor, discard the fat.. Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Remove meat from the refrigerator. Using tongs, dip meat through the sauce into a bowl of chow mein noodles. Place in skillet. Cover and cook 3 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to remove meat from skillet. Garnish with sesame seeds.

title: Brazilian Orange Refrigerator Mix
ingredients: 2 cups milk powder | 2 2 cups orange peel or 2 cups candied orange peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. Will keep for up to one year.

title: Shish Kabob
ingredients: 6 large mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil, divided | 2 tablespoons baking powder | 1/2 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Thread mushrooms on skewers.

title: Smoked Salmon, Cranberry, and Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 lbs salmon, skin on | 3/4 cup sesame seeds | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/4 cup shredded fresh basil leaf | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Place fish in food processor. Add marinade ingredients and process until smooth, about 40 seconds. Place fish in an airtight dish, and cover. Refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Remove fish from marinade, reserving marinade. Grill or broil fish over medium high heat, turning once, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Brush salmon with reserved marinade during the last few minutes of cooking, if desired. Serve hot.

title: Pork Chops Italiano
ingredients: 1 can evaporated milk | 1 lb sliced cooked bacon | 3 -4 boneless pork chops, cut in 1-inch cubes | 3/4 cup grated pepper jack cheese or 3/4 cup locatelli cheese | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Heat the milk to just under the boiling point. Add pork, bacon, spices and cheese to milk. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Pour into 13x9 inch baking dish and bake in a preheated 350°f oven for 1 hour, stirring once or twice. Serve over your favorite pasta of your choosing.

title: Gourmet White Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head green broccoli ( or asparagus ) | 2 teaspoons fine sea salt | 1/2 - 1 cup vegetable broth or 1/2-1 cup mushroom broth
instructions: Snap the tips of the broccoli stalks, then cut the buds in half on the diagonal leaving 1 inch or so chunks. Set the stalks aside or you can leave them whole. Heat a steamer and cover. Steam the broccoli until just tender, crisp tender, and bright green, 4 - 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Rinse under cold water and drain. Set aside. Add the salt and broth to the broccoli and stir to blend. Place the broccoli on a serving platter and serve.

title: Herbes De Provence
ingredients: 12 garlic cloves, peeled | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1/3 cup flour | 1/3 cup vinegar
instructions: Place garlic and thyme in a saucepan. Add the water and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer over med low heat, covered, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes or until garlic is tender, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature. Stir flour into garlic mixture, stirring until flour is well blended. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: brown lentil,breadcrumb,half,apricot preserve,icing sugar,thai red curry paste,beef
title: Tasty Beef and Lentil Patties
ingredients: 1 loaf crusty bread, cut lengthways, into 8 pieces | 1 lb lean ground beef | 2 tablespoons dried apricot preserves | 2 -3 tablespoons thai red curry paste ( i prefer sharwood's ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half | 1/2 cup toasted breadcrumbs
instructions: Meat mixture, stir fry beef in a large frypan until browned, transfer to a bowl and cover. Add red curry paste and stir fry 1 - 2 minutes until fragrant. Return to pan and mix in apricot preserves. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until heated through. Set aside. Patties, mix half and half and breadcrumbs in medium bowl. Add flour and mix well. Spray a fry pan with nonstick spray and heat over high heat. When pan is hot, add 1/4 cup of the cream and swirl to coat pan. Add about 1/4 cup of the meat mixture to the pan and press down firmly and evenly. Cook for 4 - 5 minutes and then flip over and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until cooked to your liking. Add remaining cream to a small bowl and stir in icing sugar and mix well until it becomes a slightly grainy coating by now. Serve with the remaining beef and vegetables, or on top of the patties with your crunchy bread crumbs.

title: Cheese Sticks With Riz Puffs
ingredients: 1/2 graham flour tortilla | 2 cups puffed cheese | 1/2 cup finely shredded taro root ( or other white cake ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1 tablespoon rice cereal | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Prepare the rice puffs, heat a non stick frying pan with a little oil over a medium heat. When the oil is quite hot add the tortilla and then lower the tortilla into the oil. After a few seconds turn the tortilla over and allow the tortilla to fry for a couple of seconds and then you can check the underside to see if it is golden brown. When that side has toasted, sprinkle the cheese on top and fry another couple of minutes. Add saffron and rice cereal to the middle and then cover with tortilla. Turn the tortilla upside down onto a tray and press down slightly.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,radish,strawberry ice cream,parsley,salsa,white sugar
title: Grilled Pot Roast
ingredients: 4 pounds beef chuck roast | 1/4 cup white sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 3 radishes, sliced | 1 container strawberry ice cream | 2 cups salsa
instructions: In a shallow dish, sprinkle the roast with the sugar and parsley. Drain the fat from the beef and set aside. Place a gas grill for direct heat, cover and set on high. Grill the roast uncovered on the grill for 5 to 7 minutes per side, until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Slice the roast across grain into 1/3 inch slices. Arrange the slices in the crock of a double layered baking dish and top with a layer of sliced radishes, cover loosely and allow to rest for 20 minutes. In a bowl, mix together the strawberry ice cream and 1/2 cup salsa and pour over the roast. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,red chili powder,poblano chile,butternut squash,caster sugar,meat,dill weed
title: Welsh Sausages (Cooked Meat and Pumpkin Sausages)
ingredients: 2 -3 poblano chiles | 1/2 butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 1 -2 tablespoon red chili powder ( to taste ) | 1 cup chopped cooked meat | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill weed | 1/3 cup pineapples ( i prefer kiwi fruit packed in syrup ) or 1/3 cup apricot ( i prefer kiwi fruit packed in syrup ) | 1 teaspoon caster sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat the broiler or set the oven to 180c. Cut a slit in each chile, without cutting straight through the top, so they stand upright on a baking tray. Broil, split side down, for about 10 minutes or until charred. Turn and broil for another 10 - 12 minutes, or until charred all over. Move to a plate and cover with foil. Allow to cool. Peel, core and dice the pumpkin and mix all the ingredients except the sugar in a food processor and purée until smooth. Season with salt if necessary. To serve, sandwich the sausage with the pumpkin mix and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Homemade Whole Wheat Pastry Dough
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups whole wheat flour | 1 3/4 cups stone ground whole wheat flour ( available at most indian grocers )
instructions: Place all the dry ingredients in the container of a food processor fitted with the steel blade or in a large mixing bowl and process to combine. Or you can do in a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment and add the wet ingredients to the flour. Process until the dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. If dough seems dry, add a little more flour or water. Knead dough lightly on a clean surface. Refrigerate dough for 30 minutes. Transfer dough to a floured surface and shape into a round ball. Lightly flour rim of a large baking sheet. Cover dough with a towel or a board. Refrigerate dough for at least 30 minutes or up to 1 day. Lightly grease and flour baking sheet. Pre heat oven to 425 degrees f place dough on the prepared cooking sheet, lightly sprinkled with paprika. Cut out a circle about 16 in from the side of the dough. Bake at 425 f for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool on a rack. Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,chili powder,green plantain,red potato,bosc pear
title: Chicken With Chips and Green Plantains
ingredients: 1 lb of green plantain, cut into 1/2 inch sticks | 1 lb of each green plantains or 1 lb red potato, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch sticks | 1 small bosc pear, peeled, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 whole chicken wings | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed garlic
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,hamburger,trout,onion,sherry,spring onion,chili pepper flake,coffee granule
title: Smoked Trout and Beans
ingredients: 4 slices smoked hamburger | 2 cans kidney beans | 4 slices onions | 1 chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 3 teaspoons sherry | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 2 spring onions | 1 tablespoon coarsley chopped onion
instructions: Briefly simmer the beans with the onion and chili flakes in a saucepan until cooked but still with a little bite in the middle of the beans. Drain well. Stir in the remaining ingredients.

title: Finnish Vanilla Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain flour | 1/4 cup vanilla extract
instructions: Place the flour in a small bowl, gradually whisking in the vanilla essence. Rub the flour into the vanilla by hand. Turn onto a greaseproof covered surface and spread out to about 1 cm thickness on the surface. Wrap in wax paper and leave to dry at room temperature overnight. The next day, preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas 6. Using your hand gently flatten onto parchment paper, then cut into six equal squares. Place on an oven tray. Spray with water and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden brown. Turn over and bake for about a minute longer. Serve warm, or cool and freeze.

title: Lentil Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces of chopped dried lentils | 2 ounces raisins | 2 tablespoons dried apricots ( stoned ) | 2 ounces rasinsed cooked lentils | 2 ounces self raising flour | 1 lettuce leaf | 2 ounces jarlsberg cheese
instructions: Place the lentils, raisins and apricots into a pan with a small amount of water and cook on a low heat for 10 to 15 minutes, until the lentils have softened. Drain well and mash well together with the lentils. Mix in the flour and mix thoroughly. Spread in a greased swiss roll tin and top with the lettuce leaves. Sprinkle the cheese on top and bake under a hot grill for 2 to 3 minutes, or until lightly golden.

title: Pesto Dip - Pesto Spreads
ingredients: 1 package onions flakes or 2 ounces onions, 1/2-inch dice | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1/2 cup chopped toasted pine nuts, about 5 to 10 toasted
