instructions: Place all the ingredients in a food processor. Pulse about 10 seconds or until the desired consistency is achieved. Transfer mixture to an airtight container or jar with tight fitting lid. Refrigerate for 1 week or until cold. Keep refrigerated for up to 1 day.

Random Ingredients: baby back pork rib,beef chuck,sea salt,anise seed
title: Chinese Five-Beef Ribs.
ingredients: 10 baby back pork ribs, about 3 lbs each ( or use 3 lbs pork ribs ) | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark salt ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. Place ribs on a rack in a roasting pan. Insert anise seed into each side of ribs. Cover roasting pan with foil and roast, turning ribs over once in the morning and again at 325°f for 12 hours, until meat is very tender. Using an instant read thermometer, remove ribs from oven and place ribs on a baking tray and cover loosely with foil. Allow to rest for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, toss salt with enough salt to make it spreadable. Sprinkle salt mixture over ribs. Using scissors, trim excess fat from ribs and discard. Spread the ribs out in a single layer, then slice lengthwise into about 1/4 inch thick slices. Place the slices into the slow cooker and spread out to dry. Turning as needed so as not to lose moisture. Serve as sandwiches with mustard or horseradish mayo. Serve with a hot sauce such as sriracha or hot sauce sriracha sauce. The best way to make sriracha is to make it warm, and then bring to a simmer for 20 minutes. Add the salt, stir well and set aside until ready to serve.

title: Rice Wine Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup green pepper, diced | 1/2 cup sweet red pepper, diced | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 cup bertolli kitchen schnapps or 1 cup bertolli extra dry yeast | 1 cup hot cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Sprinkle red & green peppers in bowl & set aside. In mixing bowl combine icing sugar with yeast, stir well. Place over medium low heat stirring constantly until foamy. Add rice, stirring well.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,fine salt,pear,spring onion,cayenne pepper
title: Pear Onion Beef Roast
ingredients: 2 large pears | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved | 2 teaspoons fine salt | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 4 spring onions, finely chopped
instructions: Peel pears, core and cut off the stem, leaving 1/2 of the core intact. Make a small slit on one side of each pared pear, cutting a small opening in the pears.. Add to a large bowl and combine with salt and pepper. Use a vegetable peeler to slice the peel into thin strips, making sure you catch all the juice. Put aside. Heat a heavy roasting or griddle over high heat, then add beef bouillon. Place pears on the hot griddle and cook, turning once, for 3 to 4 minutes until tender and lightly charred.. Remove from griddle and drain fat. Serve either hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,quinoa,habanero pepper,hot sauce,purpose flour,apple butter
title: Spicy Fried Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups hot water ( or other veggie oil ) | 2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | clarified apple butter ( optional ) | diced habanero peppers ( optional ) | finely chopped iceberg lettuce or lettuce ( optional )
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the 2 cups of water or vegetable oil. Add the flour and stir until blended. Poured in the hot water gradually. Cook on low for about 1 hour, stirring constantly, adding a bit of the hot water at a time. Stir in the quinoa.

title: Tasty Onion Chilies
ingredients: 4 small sunflower oil brown onions or 4 small onions | 4 cans stewed tomatoes with mild green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup dried onion flakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f & grease a medium baking dish with a little of the oil and set aside. Separate layers of brown and onion and scatter over the bottom of the greased baking dish. Mix the stewed tomatoes with green chilies until well combined, then pour over the onion & onion flakes. Dot the top with little bits of onion & season if you wish. Bake 35 minutes, or until heated through & slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,cornstarch,heavy cream,yogurt,watercress,ranch dressing mix,cajun seasoning,tomato
title: Pasta Salad With Ranch-Tandoori Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 can diced tomatoes, drained | 1/2 1/2 cup frozen chopped cornstarch or 1/2 cup corn flakes | 1 teaspoon dried cajun seasoning or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle pepper sauce ( i use 2 tsp. of mccormick's chipotle marinade ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta, cooked according to package instructions | 1 bunch fresh watercress, stemmed
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine yogurt, ranch dressing mix and cream and bring to a simmer, whisking to blend. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and stir in tomatoes, cornstarch, cajun seasoning and heat over medium heat just until hot. Set aside. Cook rigatoni according to package directions and divide among 4 plates. Top with sauce and watercress and serve immediately.

title: Persian Pig - My Way
ingredients: 2 pig feet | 2 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Separate the pig feet and place them in a large pot. Peel the hard boiled eggs. Break the hard boiled eggs into pieces and place them in the pot. Boil rapidly until they turn pale green. Fill a bowl half full of cold water. Then pour the cold water carefully over the pig feet. After 4 days they are ready to eat.. This means that at least you can peel the pig feet. Bag them with cold water for at least 4 hours. They are now ready for use.

title: Queso Blanco Dip (Poblano Chile Dip)
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup freshly cooked smoked barbeque sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Roast chilies directly over flame of gas burner on medium high heat or under broiler, turning occasionally, until charred all over, about 30 minutes. Transfer peppers to paper towel lined plate and run under cool water to remove skins. Peel and seed chilies, scrape off charred blackened skins. Grind chilies throughly in processor. Transfer chilies to medium bowl. Add barbecue sauce, barbeque sauce and garlic salt. Beat until blended. Pour into 4 serving dishes. Serve warm with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,baby portabella mushroom,taco seasoning mix,chicken,tomato green chilies,sea salt,red onion
title: Crock Pot Easy Chicken and Vegetable Dinner
ingredients: 1 -2 lb chicken ( sliced into strips or chunks ) | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 2 cans cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1 bag baby portabella mushrooms ( sliced ) | 1 red onion, sliced | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Put everything in the crock pot except the red onion. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Add red onion for last 20 - 30 minutes of cooking time.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,plum sauce,black eyed pea,pimiento,feta,soymilk,bulk italian sausage
title: Italian Sausage Bake (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 packages bulk italian sausage ( i use bulk ) | 1 package frozen black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento | 1/2 cup plum sauce ( i use hunts brand ) | 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup skim milk | 2 tablespoons feta, crumbled
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Spray a 9 square baking pan with cooking spray. Brown sausage in large skillet.. Drain. Place black eyed peas and pimientos onto the bottom of the pan. Top with sausage drippings. Mix other ingredients, pour over black eyed peas and pimentos. Bake uncovered 40 - 45 minutes, or until golden all over.

title: Sizzling Green Chilli
ingredients: 2 tablespoons mild green chilies | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 lb small lamb, cut into 2-inch cubes | 200 g dried broad beans
instructions: Heat the grill to medium. Place the chillies and lime juice in a mortar. Season with salt and pound together until you have a fine powder. Stir in the lamb, and cook over a medium heat for 6 - 8 minutes. Stir in the broad beans and cook 2 - 3 minutes, or until just tender.

title: Shrimp and Truffles With Smoked Chocolate
ingredients: 2 lbs peeled baby shrimp | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 lb silken tofu | 1 cup catsup | 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 2 ounces semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl, use a spoon to add 1/3 cup of the tahini and the shrimp. Toss gently, breaking up clumps and coating shrimp slightly, set aside. Repeat with remaining ingredients, tossing until shrimps are coated thoroughly. Arrange 1/3 cup of the tofu on the bottom of a baking dish and sprinkle generously with 1/3 cup of the tofu. In a small bowl, combine remaining tahini with the catsup, vermouth and remaining tahini mixture, add to shrimp mixture and stir to combine. Spread shrimp mixture over the tofu, top with the remaining 1/3 of the tofu and bake in a 425 degree oven until shrimp are pink and cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and let sit for about 5 minutes and serve in chocolates, drizzled with remaining melted chocolate.

title: Veal Fritters (Zwt Three)
ingredients: 1 lb veal | 1 cup buttermilk | 3 teaspoons low fat buttermilk | 14 ounces stewed tomatoes | 3 teaspoons nutritional yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili oil ( vegan ) | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( vegan )
instructions: Peal the veal and cut into small cubes. Put the buttermilk, tomatoes, yeast and chili oil into a bowl and mix well. Put the veal in the bowl and cover with the sauce. Let marinate for minimum of 24 hours. Thread the veal pieces onto skewers about 15 - 20 per skewer. Cook on a medium heat on your bbq plate or barbeque. Serve with yogurt dip, veggie sticks and/or cheese on top.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,white wine vinegar,beef stew meat,polenta,chicken stock,white cheddar cheese
title: Crock Pot Corned Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 2 cups dry white cheddar cheese ( i like sharp, cheddar is also good ) or 2 cups colby cheese ( i like sharp, cheddar is also good ) | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 cup prepared polenta or 1 cup coarse country bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Spray crock pot with vegetable spray. Put chicken stock and grand marnier in crock pot, and put the beef cubes in the bottom of the crock pot. Sprinkle cheese in the bottom in a small to medium size bowl. Pour some of the beef juices from the crock into a medium sauce pan. Stir in the vinegar and warm over medium high heat to bubbling. Pour the cornstarch mixture into the saucepan and whisk vigorously to thicken. When bubbling, stir in the sauce. Stir in the wine/cheese mixture, scraping the bottom of the pot to loosen the mixture. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes or until the sauce is smooth and bubbly serve immediately over polenta or coarse country bread.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,beef bouillon cube,lard
title: Cheese Croutons
ingredients: 1 cup canned sliced corned beef bouillon cube | 5 tablespoons fat-free lard | 1 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place bouillon cube in pie plate. Heat lard in a large skillet over medium heat. Dip each slice of cheese in the lard and place on lard, allowing excess lard to drip off.

title: Burgundy-Style French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf baguette | 1/4 cup honey garlic barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup orange rind, grated zest | 1/4 cup vodka | 1/4 cup fresh chives, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Using 1/3 cup of bbq sauce, coat all sides of bread with 1/3 cup bbq sauce, roll into 4 loafs. Place loaves in 9x13 inch or larger casserole. Bake bread in preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes to dry bread slightly. Meanwhile combine grated rind, vodka and chives in a small bowl. Remove bread from oven and sprinkle with rind mixture. Serve bread with remaining bbq sauce and serve with toast. Yum.

title: Tasty Coffee
ingredients: 1 cup strong black coffee | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/2 cup tasty cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Mix strong black coffee with sour cream in a bowl. Add grated cheese and fresh flat leaf parsley, mix together. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,pepper,beef tenderloin,beef steak,lemon peel,fig,apricot jam,kraft mayonnaise
title: Budget Beef Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons kraft mayo | 1 tablespoon apricot jam | 2 tablespoons kraft sour cream | pepper | 12 leaves fresh figs or 12 green figs | 6 spring onions, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs trimmed tenderloin
instructions: Cut beef into 3 inch long pieces, 1 inch in diameter. Place in 12 wooden skewers. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl. Pour over beef skewers. Turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate 12 to 24 hours. Turn often. Place on rack in broiler pan. Broil 4 - 5 inches from heat for 15 to 18 minutes or until desired doneness. Serve on bed of cooked egg noodles.

title: Orange French Toast
ingredients: 4 slices white bread | 1 cup fresh orange juice ( or frozen squeezed oranges, thawed ) | 1 can eagle brand sweetened condensed milk ( or other condensed milk substitute )
instructions: Preparation, cut 1 inch slice bread in half diagonally, lengthwise. Spray 13 x 9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Spread bottom half of bread with orange juice. Top with half the sweetened condensed milk. Repeat twice with second half of bread, orange juice and sweetened condensed milk. Repeat layers, finishing with remaining cheese. Cover lightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight, turning often to distribute the seasoning. Preparing the bread, preheat oven to 160º f. Remove plastic wrap from cheese and discard. Wet your wooden paddles or hands with cold water and slice cheese into 1 inch pieces. Arrange cheese pieces on top of the orange mixture in dish and roll up tightly starting with the long side of the cheese. Bake for 45 minutes, uncovered. Serve with sour cream and fresh fruit, maple syrup, mint chutney or your favorite jam.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,orange peel,flour tortilla,romano cheese,spring onion,tomato green chilies,egg white,thyme sprig
title: Easy-Easy Mexican Chicken Tortilla Wraps
ingredients: 20 soft flour tortillas | 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup orange peel, pith and all visible fat. coarsely chopped and packed | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme sprig ( optional ) | 1 can of diced tomatoes and green chilies | 4 pieces romano cheese or 4 slices parmesan cheese, about 1 1/4 inches wide | 6 large eggs | 2 teaspoons grated fresh thyme or 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: In a large skillet, brown chicken thighs, orange peel, and any cooking juices on medium low or medium low heat. Remove chicken, let cool slightly, then slice into thin strips. If you like, you can stir fry chicken pieces in hot skillet for about 5 minutes. Set aside to cool slightly, then set aside. In another bowl, combine tomato, chilies, and chicken cubes. Lightly beat eggs in a separate bowl. Fold in thyme. Divide egg mixture equally among 4 wraps. Fold, top off, and seal in the center of each wrap. In a preheated griddle or large skillet heat approximatly oil, or on medium high heat, fry wraps until golden brown on both sides, flipping once, 4 - 6 minutes per side. Sprinkle tops with grated cheese, continue frying until cheese has melted. Serve warm. To serve, let everyone place a toothpick in the middle of a wrap, then pile up the chicken strips and a little more cheese. Serve the wrap with sour cream, guacamole, salsa, etc.

title: Chicken and Tomato Wafers
ingredients: 2 cans crushed tomatoes | 1 can evaporated milk | 1 -2 dash hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dry english mustard | 12 sauerkraut-type wafers | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Place crushed tomatoes in blender or food processor and puree. Combine pureed tomatoes with evaporated milk, hot sauce, and mustard in small container. Add sauerkraut and blend just until smooth.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,pecan half,anaheim chili,stewing beef,teriyaki sauce,mango,rump roast
title: Oriental Beef-Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef or 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 1/2 spanish onion, cut into chunks | 1/2 anaheim chili, seeded | 1 -2 lb rump roast, cut into 1 � cubes | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup of chopped pecan halves | 6 tablespoons butteryaki sauce and teriyaki glaze
instructions: Poke holes in beef or skirt steak with a skewer a couple of times. Arrange beef cubes on skewers. Mix together teriyaki sauce, onion and chilies in a shallow dish. Place beef and onions in sauce and marinate for 2 hours or over night. Thread beef cubes onto soaked wooden or soaked skewers. Bake or grill 12 - 15 minutes or till tender. Serve on top of warmed teriyaki glaze.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,salmon fillet,maraschino cherry,bamboo shoot,hard egg,cream cheese,mint
title: Aloha Salmon Salad
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1/2 cup small bamboo shoot, drained and chopped | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped | 2 ounces soft cream cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced of fresh mint | 4 ounces salmon fillets, cooked and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beans, cherries, bamboo, egg, cream cheese, mint, and salmon. Toss to coat. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: galliano,parsley flake,red curry paste,tabasco sauce,beef sirloin steak,salt
title: Lola's Beef Kabobs (Grilled Beef)
ingredients: 1 1 lb beef sirloin steaks ( or your favorite steak ) or 1 lb boneless beef tenderloin ( or your favorite steak ) | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/2 cup galliano or 1/2 cup light cream | 1/4 cup parsley flakes | 2 teaspoons salt | 1/8 - 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce ( for added kick )
instructions: If serving at room temperature, cover steak loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour and overnight. If using a grill, remove the wrap and discard.. Trim fat from steaks. Cut into thin slices across the grain. Place cut meat in large bowl. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp salt and turn meat and onion to coat evenly. Marinate, covered and chilled for at least 30 minutes. Stir curry paste into meat mixture and set aside. Thread slices onto skewers. If using grill, oil grill grate and heat on high. Turn often until meat is thoroughly cooked and no longer pink in the center.

title: Rice Pilaf With Ham, Mushrooms and Yoghurt
ingredients: 400 g arborio rice | 1 1/2 liters low chicken stock or 1 1/2 liters low sodium broth | 100 g ham, chopped | 200 g button mushrooms, halved chopped | 400 g oat, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 3 tablespoons almond meal | 150 ml natural yoghurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c/gas mark bring the chicken stock to the boil in a large saucepan and add the rice. Return to boil, then simmer until rice is cooked. Stir in ham, mushrooms and oat. Spoon mixture into a large ceramic bowl, stir in allspice. Cover with foil and rest in the refrigator for 15 minutes before serving. Serve rice in large plass based ovenproof soup bowls, top with yoghurt.

title: Roasted Corn, Pistachio  and Roasted Red Capsicum
ingredients: 1 red capsicum | 1 cup baby corn ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup roasted peanuts ( if you're using frozen, place on the shelf in pre heated oven ) | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 -2 tablespoon ground instant coffee | 1 tablespoon pistachios ( golden kernels toasted ) | 3 -4 tablespoons smooth peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 200c. Dice the red capsicum and baby corn and place in a microwave proof bowl or tin with a little olive oil, then the peanut oil. Microwave for a couple of minutes until the corn is warmed up, but not hot, then the ground coffee. When it's ready, mix everything together with the peanuts. Taste and adjust the seasoning and drizzle over the roasted corn to serve.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,tabasco sauce,baking powder,spaghetti sauce,celery,greek olive,brand rice
title: Greek Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked uncle ben's converted uncle ben's converted rice | 1 can whole canned clam juice | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons bottled clam juice | 3 cups shredded whole celery | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | tabasco sauce, to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a very large skillet, combine the rice, clam juice, spaghetti sauce, celery and baking powder. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to lowest setting. Simmer for 25 minutes. Remove from heat and stir. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Ww 7 Points - Spanish Mushroom & Potato Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 2 cups simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 lb button mushroom, chopped | 1 cup salsa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f cook the simply potatoes with onion in the microwave, stirring once. When potatoes are almost done, add the mushrooms. Mix well and pour mixture on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Bake in the oven for 25 minutes until potatoes are tender, stirring the potatoes after 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: buckwheat flour,chicken thigh,purpose flour,jasmine rice,parsley,jumbo shrimp,blue cheese
title: Chicken, Blue Cheese and Shrimp Pancakes With Jasmine Rice (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 2 )
ingredients: 400 g jumbo shrimp, tails on ( peeled ) | 100 g blue cheese, crumbled | 100 g chicken thighs ( trimmed of fat and cut into 3cm x 2cm sticks ) | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh parsley | 1/2 cup buckwheat flour | 100 g all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, steamed until just tender
instructions: Combine shrimp, cheese, chicken, parsley and flour in a large bowl, stir well to combine.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 can rotel | 1/4 cup marmalade, of your choice | 1/4 cup chunky salsa ( you decide ) | 1 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped | 1/2 cup roast, cubed
instructions: Add rice, marmalade, salsa and mint. Cook on med to high heat till everything is hot and hot. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes. To serve, place cubed roast in rice, or serve with tortilla chips on the side.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 12 -16 ounces shelled sunflower seeds | 24 -32 mint leaves ( not dried )
instructions: Put the sunflower seeds in a food processor with 3/4 cups cold water. Process until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Add a few mint leaves and process again to a smooth puree. Pour into an oiled colander, sprinkle with more mint if desired, and press through the fine sieve extracting the mint leaves. Let cool down. Store in an airtight container. Variation use less nuts or a mix of these two.

title: Mango With Chocolate in Bread Cups
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 6 slices sourdough bread, cut 1/2 inch thick | 24 large mangoes | 24 slices italian bread, crusts removed | 24 fresh basil leaves, 1 inch wide | 3 bars dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f coat 12 cup muffin tin with cooking spray. Combine sherry and 1 cup warm water in a small saucepan over medium high heat. Slowly add bread and cook until just heated through, about 2 minutes on each side. Transfer bread to prepared pan. Cut bread tops and tops off of mangoes and arrange evenly on toast. Place remaining 1/2 cup warm water, cheese, and 2 slices of bread in each loaf cup. Cover and refrigerate until set, about 60 minutes. Remove from pan and serve.

title: Rose Nectar
ingredients: 2 lbs brown sugar | 1 cup fine sea salt | 1 1/2 cups rose water | 2 cups boiling water
instructions: Place brown sugar and salt in very large bowl, stir well. Add rose water and stir to mix. Pour boiling water over sugar salt mixture. Using rubber spatula, stir well until the sugar has absorbed liquid completely. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours. When ready to use, remove from refrigerator 20 - 60 minutes before using. Pour hot syrup over ice. Note, the ratio in to the 1 1/2 pounds of sugar and salt will make a difference to your taste buds. As soon as the syrup has cooled completely, it will spread out to the edge of the bowl and be easy to remove from the bowl. Remove from bowl before using. Refrigerate until cold for up to 1 week. The longer the time, the more flavorful the sugar will be.

title: Mongolian Baklava
ingredients: 1/2 cup soymilk | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, minced | 3 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup peanuts | cornstarch | 7 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup dried shredded phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. In a small saucepan, combine soy milk with lemon rind and sunflower seeds. Bring to a boil then set aside. In a small saucepan combine chopped peanuts, cornstarch and 3 tbsp of water. Pour into the soy milk mixture while whisking. Place 3 sheets of phyllo dough in a lightly greased 9x13 pan. Spread the peanut butter sauce in the bottom of the pan. Arrange 6 sheets of phyllo on top making sure you don't stack it and also covering the phyllo. Carefully top with remaining phyllo sheets. You may stack the sheets as you roll them up towards the end, but you may have to use your hands to do the wrapping job. Place in the freezer for 20 minutes. Take the pastry out of the refrigerator and brush generously with the melted chocolate sauce. Sprinkle the remaining chopped peanuts on top. Place back in the freezer until ready to serve.

title: Wendy's Miso Sausage Spread
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, bulk ( or links if possible ) | 2 tablespoons light miso paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped pecans
instructions: Heat oven to place sausage in a small, oven safe skillet. Cook over medium high heat, turning occasionally with a large spatula, until cooked through, about 15 minutes. Drain off any fat. Stir in miso paste and worcestershire sauce, breaking apart with a fork. Transfer to a large bowl and stir in pecans. Transfer to a small baking sheet, cut into 8 wedges, and sprinkle with remaining walnut paste before serving as part of an antipasto spread ( vegetarian or vegan if you prefer ).

title: Horseradish Hummus
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons minced honey-roasted mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup mango chutney | crushed ice, or as needed
instructions: Place the cannellini beans, honey roasted mustard seed, mayonnaise, horseradish, mango chutney, and crushed ice into a blender. Blend until smooth.

title: Italian Beans With Smoked Salmon or Pesto for One
ingredients: 1 can navy beans or ( 16 ounce ) can pink beans, rinsed & drained | 1 can green beans, rinsed & drained | 1/3 - 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce ( commercial ) | semolina flour or cornmeal, as needed, for dredging
instructions: In a 6 quart saucepan combine the beans & 3/4 cup pesto as per package directions & bring just to a boil. Reduce heat, skim off any scum that appears on the surface of the beans & return to a boil. Reduce heat slightly & simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally for 7 minutes. Cover & cook over low heat 15 minutes stirring frequently or until the beans are well heated through. Remove from heat, stir in the remaining pesto. Serve topped with desired amount of smoked salmon or pesto.

title: Mexican Bean Dip (Low Fat)
ingredients: 6 ounces fat-free sour cream ( low fat ) | 1/2 cup low-fat cream | 1 can reduced-fat mexican beans | 2 tablespoons lard ( smart balance ) | 2 tablespoons spanish-style cocoa | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Cover and refrigerate while preparing other ingredients.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,orange marmalade,taco seasoning mix,cherry tomato,half,white wine
title: Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crushed pineapple in juice | 1 tablespoon white wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 0.5 container light sour cream with pineapple | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade or 1 tablespoon apricot preserves
instructions: Spread the crushed pineapple on a pizza crust or pizza pan. Mix the white wine and taco seasoning and brush on the pineapple. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for five minutes. Spread the cream over the cheese, and top with the sour cream and pineapple marmalade.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,sun tomato oil,cabbage,oyster sauce,liquid smoke,phyllo dough
title: Spicy Oyster Beef and Cabbage Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 1/2 lb raw oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons reduced sodium oyster sauce, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 8 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Combine cabbage, sun dried tomato, and cooking oil in a bowl and combine, stirring to coat. Place in refrigerator. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, and liquid smoke and cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Cover and cool slightly. Lay out one sheet of phyllo dough, brush with beaten egg, top with cabbage mixture and roll up. Cut in half diagonally on a clean dry surface. Repeat with the remaining sheets, placing them about 1 inch apart on a lightly floured baking sheet. Brush with beaten egg. Bake in a preheated 375°f oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from baking sheet and cool completely. Serve with dipping sauces or steamed white cabbage.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,baby bok choy,mint leaf,honey,cornmeal,raspberry,white fish fillet,spaghetti sauce
title: Cousin Juneau's Thai Fish and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 350 g baby bok choy | 150 g raspberries | 300 g spaghetti sauce | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 tablespoon honey | 300 g baby bok choy | 100 g cornmeal | 200 g white fish fillets | mint leaf, to garnish ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Boil the baby bok choy, raspberries and spaghetti sauce for 5 minutes. Set aside. Cut the fish fillets into cubes. Heat up the marinade ingredients. Dry the pieces. Put the fish into the pan with the sauce and vegetables. Toss. Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Garnish with mint leaves and serve.

title: Sage and Mustard Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb cheddar cheese | 1 cup shallot, minced | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Cheddar cheese may be made 1 day ahead and chilled in the refrigerator. Cheddar cheese may be made a day ahead and chilled in the refrigerator. In a food processor, blend cheese, shallots, marjoram, sage, and salt until smooth. Add as much of the remaining of the reduced fat cheddar cheese to make an spreading consistency. Store leftover cheese mixture in the refrigerator.

title: Black Olive Salad
ingredients: 2 cans pitted black olives, drained and patted dry | 1 package mixed salad greens, chilled
instructions: Punch holes in the salad leaves with a wooden chopstick or scissors. Arrange the olives in the rows of green. If you want to keep the shape, refrigerate.

title: Split Tea Eggs With Potatoes
ingredients: 12 baby red potatoes, quartered | 2 1/2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 tablespoons tea | 3 slices white bread
instructions: Place potatoes in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Cook over low heat until potatoes are tender, but not mushy. Drain and cool. Meanwhile, in a bowl mix together the vanilla and tea. Lightly toast the slices of bread. Crack the eggs into the potato/oatmeal mixture and mix thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for about 10 minutes. To serve, place the potato halves on a plate and top with the egg/oatmeal mixture and serve either warm or cold.

title: Easy Peasy Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetarian baked beans | 2 tablespoons peas | 2 tablespoons frozen vegetables | 1 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Mix all the above together. Refrigerate for at least an hour.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,pepperoncini pepper,green chili pepper,ginger garlic paste,plain flour,tuna water
title: Spinach and Tuna Pakora
ingredients: 400 g frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1 inch ginger garlic paste | 1 green chili pepper | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 2 tablespoons tuna in water ( i use solnedin good tuna in water, this might not add much ) | pepperoncini pepper, to taste | green chili pepper, to taste
instructions: In a non stick pan fry ginger garlic paste till it turns white. Add chilli pepper and stir fry for 30 seconds. Add flour and mix well to make a smooth paste. Add tuna and water. Mix well and stir fry for 3 to 4 minutes till everything is well cooked. Drain any excess water from spinach and mix well. Place onto skewers. Place pepperoncini and green chili pepper slices on top of spinach mixture, if desired. Serve with rice. If you want to have this authentic pakora recipe, place 5 or 6 balls with the pakora at the bottom part of the skewer and add some boiled potatoes on top. If you desire an other flavor dimension, serve with a dollop of sour cream. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,mix,linguine,white miso,ziti pasta,couscous,basmati rice,emmenthaler cheese
title: Miso Cheese Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 cups ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 english cucumber, chopped | 3 cups cooked couscous, hot ( see comments in introduction ) | 8 ounces of shredded emmenthaler cheese | 1 cup white miso | 1/2 cup quick cooking couscous | 1 prepared mix | 1 1/2 cups prepared white miso ( see directions ) | 1 1/2 cups of prepared prepared prepared quick cooking couscous | 1 1/2 cups of prepared white miso ( see directions )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ziti, cucumber, cooked couscous and cooked cheese and combine well. Mix in the white miso and mix well. Make the moroccan cheese dressing by combining the 2 1/2 cups of prepared white miso in a jar with a lid. Warm the couscous according to package instructions. When ready to serve, pour couscous on a plate with a tight fitting lid and place on a burner on high heat until hot. Remove from burner but leave lid. Drain any excess liquid from the couscous in the bowl. In a 3 to 4 quart casserole, combine the miso cheese dressing, 1 1/2 cups or more of prepared miso and stir to combine. When the miso cheese dressing is ready to serve, spoon salad onto serving plates and top with warmed miso cheese dressing.

title: Green Chile and Pear Dip
ingredients: 2 green chilies, finely minced | 1/2 fresh pear, peeled and finely grated | 1/2 cup low fat refried beans | 1 green chilies, finely diced | 4 ounces button mushrooms, finely diced | 2 tablespoons snipped chives | 2 teaspoons whipping cream | hot sauce
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl and mix throughly. Serve on top of a hot plain cooked egg.

title: Spaetzle
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups self raising flour | 5 lbs penne pasta, cooked till tender | 3 3/4 cups plain flour, sifted
instructions: Put the sifted flour in a large bowl. Cut the pasta in 4 - 5 sections and then cut them into three chunks, then put it into the bowl and add the pasta. Add the flour all at once and rub into the pasta with your fingers do not overbeake. This is vital as it removes the starch from the pasta when cooking. Preheat the oven to 220c/fan 200c/gas put a large baking tray on the shelf, but get it into the middle of the oven. Place the pasta in a large bowl, then pour on the hot tray. Cook on the shelf for 10 minutes. Serve right away.

title: Crispy Tofu Wedges #RSC
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 6 cups finely diced peeled parsnips | 2 tablespoons reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Taste for seasonings and adjust to taste. Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 - 20 minutes until cooked through.

title: Italian Turkey Dogs
ingredients: 1 pound fresh turkey wings | garlic salt to taste | 1/4 pound deli ham, chopped
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Place the turkey wings in a bowl, and season with garlic salt. Gently toss to coat, and place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until browned and crispy, 20 to 30 minutes. Spray a large skillet or grilling pan with cooking spray, and place over medium high heat. Cook and stir turkey wings until browned, 5 to 8 minutes, breaking each piece into 2 pieces. Divide ham down the center of each turkey wing, and sprinkle with garlic salt. Serve with warm crusty italian bread for dipping options, you can serve them without the ham and serve on a bed of tomato or lettuce.

title: Mexican Mucbil
ingredients: 2 cups semolina | 1 cup mild chunky salsa
instructions: Pour semolina into a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes to absorb all of the water there should no visible fat. Mix in the salsa. Scoop mucbil into tortillas using tongs and dip into the warm salsa.

title: Jamaican Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken breast | 1/2 lb raw quail, shelled and cleaned | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 can chipotles whole red chilies, undrained | 1 rump roast
instructions: Cut a slit in the breast of the breast. Insert a quarter of the chilies into the slit. Place the flour into a flat container. Dredge the chicken in the flour, coating well. Heat a skillet over medium heat for 7 - 10 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet, and brown the meat well on all sides. You may need to do this in batches. Set aside. Add the oil to the pan. Brown the quail in the oil, 3 - 4 minutes, removing and saving any fat. Drain. Return the meat to the pan, add the remaining chilies, cover and simmer for 1 hour, or until liquid has reduced or evaporated. Add the broth and cook, covered, for 30 minutes more – or until chicken is tender. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rack lamb,orange peel,balsamic vinegar,fig,thai basil,chicken broth,horseradish,black cardamom pod
title: Spiced Lamb With Fig and Orange Peel

instructions: Trim the fat from the lamb. If you wish to save any of the fat, trim off excess fat, trim off extra and discard rib sections if you wish. Make the spice paste by combining all the ingredients. Trim fat from racks. Place the lamb in a shallow dish, pour over the spice paste and add enough cold water to cover. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, turning meat occasionally. Preheat the bbq to medium high. Remove lamb from the marinade and thread onto each of 4 skewers. Pour the chicken broth into a small pan. Place the lamb on the rack, brush well with the broth and sprinkle with the herb mixture. Oil the grill. Oil grill lid. Grill the lamb, brushing once with oil, until done, about 8 minutes for medium rare. Slice lamb and serve with cooked figs. Note. It is easier to broil in advance and have time to serve the lamb as you normally would to reduce its cooking time.

title: Cashew Nut Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw cashews | 1 1/4 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup molasses | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh marjoram or 1/4 cup scallion | 1/4 cup chopped salted cashews | 2 tablespoons cold water | herbs or salsa, to taste
instructions: Blend cashews, bread crumbs and molasses in a food processor or blender until combined. Scoop into a bowl. Add salsa, marjoram, cashews and water. Form 1 1/4 cupfuls of cashew mixture onto a lightly oiled griddle or pan. Cook over medium heat, turning often, until evenly browned, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a warm plate.

title: Fiesta Beef Stew

instructions: Brown meat and chives then stir in reserved meat and rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours until meat is tender. Spoon into bowls and serve with warm tortillas.

instructions: Combine lima beans, lentils, coconut flakes, and allspice in bowl.

title: Green Curry Paste

instructions: Heat half the curry paste with the garlic and parsley in a dry frying pan over a medium to low heat. Stir regularly. Once the curry paste is heated through, stir in the remaining curry paste and cook for 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mushroom stem,beef chuck roast,arrowroot,egg noodle,garlic,simple syrup,oxtail

instructions: In a large stockpot, add Oxtails, 1/4 cup simple syrup, and minced garlic. Cook over medium low heat, stirring often, for 5 minutes. Add the beef and mushrooms. Once the water is boiling, stir in the bowroot and return to a boil. Pour the egg noodles into the boiling water, and return to a boil. Cook the oxtail until crisp tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and serve with noodles.

title: Pork Loin Steak

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place beef in a shallow pan. Sprinkle bread crumbs onto the beef. Bake in the preheated oven until meat is no longer pink inside, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,mussel,dark beer,scallop,tomato ketchup,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Mussels in Stout & Beer
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 2 teaspoons dark beer | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix ( bulk barn ) | 2 lbs mussels, cleaned ( i use live from the grocery store at a dry grocery store ) | 1 tablespoon scallops
instructions: Heat a griddle pan or saute pan over medium high heat. Add the oil and heat for 1 minute. Add the ketchup, beer and ras el hanout and toast for a minute or two until well incorporated. Note, you can remove the scallops and mussels from the mussels if you prefer.

title: Hawaiian Berry Pork (Or Chicken) Loaf
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef ( or other lean meat ) | 2/3 kg stewing chicken wings ( or other chicken, cut in 4 pieces ) | 250 g whole macadamia nuts | 250 g small mixed berries ( or more ) | 3/4 tablespoon molasses | 3/4 tablespoon vinegar, mixed with | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 150c or 150c if using a fan forced oven. Place meat and bones in a roasting tin. Sprinkle with nuts and cover with water. Cook for 1 hour. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and cook for 15 minutes covered, then increase heat to 190c or 160c and cook for 3 hours. Allow for a minute. Drain off fat if necessary. Cover with foil and rest for 15 minutes before slicing into 3 slices. Serve with your choice of accompaniments.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,jalapeno chile,taco sauce,salmon,chicken stock,almond paste
title: Salmon Tacos

title: Chili Oil

instructions: Mix peanut butter, sesame oil, and chill over low heat.

title: Nama Mama's Pumpkin Seeds and Beef Stew

instructions: Place meat, peanuts, mixed peel, and water into a 3 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on low until tender, 12 to 14 hours.

title: Baked Oranges with Clams

instructions: Place the clams, pears or orange and pasta in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water by 2 inches and bring to the boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until the shells open. Reserve the cooking water. Drain and place the clams and or orange wedges on a serving platter. Add the parsley and/or pine nuts.

title: Macaroni and Tofu in Mustard and Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 lb macaroni | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced | 3 tablespoons mustard seeds, dark | 2 tablespoons wheat mustard greens with chives, minced | 1 package silken tofu, drained | 4 cups shredded red cabbage | fresh ground black mustard
instructions: Cook macaroni in 4 qts. Boiling water over high heat for 10 - 12 minutes. Drain pasta well and set aside. Meanwhile, heat oven to in a 10 nonstick skillet, cook ground beef in oil over medium heat until browned.

title: Homemade Polish Seasoning

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a gallon bag, seal and shake to combine. Store in cool, dry place.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Shiitake Mushroom Chicken
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley | 1 package frozen sliced shiitake mushrooms | 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces angel hair pasta | 12 ounces cooked tilapia fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Heat chicken bouillon in microwave on high power for 1 minute, stirring once. Bake 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Spinach on the BBQ (Kuka Neera)

instructions: Mix all ingredients in a pan. Cook on medium and high heat till the mixture is cooked and well mixed. Serve with pita rounds or naan bread. Note, for added flavour, chilli powder can be substituted for chili powder.

title: Avocado, Cabbage, and Peppers Salsa
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 can crushed tomatoes with liquid | 1/4 cup apple cider | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley
instructions: Heat margarine in a large skillet over medium heat until melted. Stir the cabbage into the melted margarine and coat with the margarine. Stir tomatoes, cider, garlic, and parsley into the cabbage mixture until it boils. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until the vegetables are tender and heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Quick Beef N' Spinach

instructions: Mix stew meat, spinach leaves and enough water to cover in a crock pot. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours. Stir a few times. The longer it simmers, the more the flavors blend.

title: Lazy Chicken & Kale Spinach Rolls

instructions: Remove and discard asparagus tips, or cut in 1 1/2 to 1 - 2 inch pieces. Place in boiling water. Cook about five minutes or until tender. Drain. Combine breadcrumbs and kale. Pour vinegar mixture over chicken. Bake 20 to 30 minutes or until sauce is bubbly and no longer raw. Serve over hot cooked lasagna noodles.

instructions: Pour 3 quarts water into a large pot. Add rotelle and bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat until pasta is tender but firm, 12 to 15 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Add zucchini slices and cook until browned and tender, about 3 minutes. Remove zucchini with a slotted spoon. Add 1/4 of the zucchini to the oil in the skillet and cook until lightly browned, turning frequently, about 3 minutes. Divide among the toasts. Spread a thin layer of cottage cheese over the toasts. Place 4 zucchini on each of the toasts and top with 1/4 of the drained pasta and meat. Serve with the potatoes on the side.

instructions: Place cream and bread crumbs in a saucepan, and bring just to a boil.

instructions: In a 10 skillet or a casserole or pan, heat 1 tbsp oil over medium high heat 3 - 4 minutes.

ingredients: 1 package white mushrooms, rinsed and sliced | 1 jar hot pepper beef gravy, can use mushroom | 1 package sliced fresh mushrooms (, can use other ingredients ) ( optional ) | 1 can pineapple chunks | 2 cans chunk-style crushed tomatoes | 8 ounces ricotta cheese | feta cheese, crumbles
instructions: Place all ingredients into a deep, 1 1/2 quart, casserole dish or large crockpot. Stir to mix well, breaking up chunks of tomato as they cook. The mixture will have a lot of juice. Bake uncovered in a 325 degree oven for 5 to 10 hours. Serve immediately or refrigerate until serving time. Stir in feta crumbles when served.

title: Amaretto Sunrise
ingredients: 1/2 ounce amaretto liqueur | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Pour amaretto in a shot glass. Add a teaspoon of turmeric over the amaretto. This is the night before and leave at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,cottage cheese,spanish chorizo,red chile pepper,filet beef,orange liqueur
title: Mexican Rolled Beef - Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 filet of beef, 1/2-inch thick | 1 cup chopped spanish chorizo, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped red chile peppers | 2 slices orange liqueur | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 3 tablespoons grated low-fat cottage cheese
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the beef with paper towels. Cut each of the beef slices lengthwise and place in a 2 1/2 quart crock pot. Scatter the sauteed chorizo in a criss cross pattern over the meat. Scatter the red chile peppers over the chorizo. Pour in the orange liqueur, sprinkle with the cinnamon, and place the beef on top. Cook on low 8 hours, or on high 3 hours. Turn the beef over about half way through, and spread a generous amount of cottage cheese across the top. Let stand at least 10 minutes before serving.

title: Raspberry Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 package frozen raspberries, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 packages small tortilla chips
instructions: Mix together raspberries, onion powder, and capers in a bowl. Mix in the crushed chips. Chill before serving.

title: Yogurt Dip (Yepdi Dip)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yogurt ( plain or greek style ) | 1 minced green chili pepper or 1 minced jalapeno pepper | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Mix all in a covered container. Eat with pita bread.

title: Chipotle Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb turkey breast, cut into 2 inch pieces ( or chicken breast ) | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 12 ounces chipotle chiles | 1 lb small cauliflower, in the florets | 1/2 cup stout beer | 12 slices pepperoni, sliced
instructions: Brown turkey in a large skillet. Pour off fat. Add stewed tomatoes, chipotle chiles, cauliflower and beer. Simmer uncovered over medium heat for about 30 minutes. If you prefer it a little thicker you can cook it longer, if you like it with lots of sauce. Serve with pepperoni slices.

title: Raspberry Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas | 1/2 cup raspberry jam | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Defrost peas overnight in microwave. They should be defrosted the next day. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add frozen peas. Cook until tender, about 7 minutes, do not overcook. Remove with a slotted spoon and rinse under cold water to cool. Slit each back into the loose shelled peas. Place peas back into the pot, and mix in raspberry jam, soy sauce and vanilla. Taste and add more soy sauce if necessary.

title: Broccoli Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup broccoli ( finely chopped ) | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar
instructions: Blanch the broccoli in boiling salted water for 25 seconds. Drain, cover with cold water, and set aside. Place the vinegar in a screw top jar. Shake gently to combine. Add broccoli and stir until coated.

title: Ponzu Lime Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons garlic paste | 1/2 cup ponzu sauce | 2 -4 limes, quartered
instructions: Combine garlic paste and ponzu sauce in a small sauce pan and bring to a simmering boil. When sauce comes to a simmer add the chopped lime cutlets. Simmer for about 10 minutes to desired crispiness.

title: Tortilla and Eggplant - Low Fat
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas | 1 eggplant | 3 spiced spicy mexican spices | 2 teaspoons chopped orange peel | 1 1/2 cups white wine | 3 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Slice eggplant and place eggplant in saucepan and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: white flour,vanilla essence,mandarin segment,celery seed,rye bread
title: Puff Pastry Rye Bread (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 10)
ingredients: 1 loaf raisin bread or 1 loaf light rye bread, cut into cubes ( approx 1.9 kg ) | 1 can mandarin segments, drained | 3 tablespoons white flour | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed, toasted
instructions: Place bread cubes in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine, ensuring cereal is evenly dispersed over the bread and fruit.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,ginger,gingerroot,dream whip,spanish onion,cherry tomato,italian breadcrumb,crust
title: Christmas Dessert
ingredients: 1 jar cherry tomatoes, cut in half | 1 tablespoon italian gingerroot, grated | 3/4 cup frozen spanish onion, thawed and sliced | 4 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon grated gingerroot | 1 1/2 cups italian style soft breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup italian style dry breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup sour cream or 1/3 cup whipping cream
instructions: Mix together tomatoes, ginger root, rum, and onion slices in a 1 1/2 quart rectangular baking dish. Stir together bread crumbs, sherry, and sour cream until well combined. Pour bread crumb mixture over tomato mixture.

title: Rice Crisp
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh yeast | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1 1/2 cups warm-hot mashed potatoes or 1 1/2 cups cold mashed potatoes | 1 cup leftover cooked white rice | 1 1/2 - 2 3 lbs chicken drumsticks or 1 1/2-2 3 lbs chicken thighs, boned and skinned | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup flour | cooked corn oil or light olive oil
instructions: Dissolve yeast in caraway seed and let stand 10 minutes or so. Add potatoes and 2 cups water. Dip chicken in flour and place in a large mixing bowl. Gradually add 1 1/2 pounds at room temperature or until coated. Beat in horseradish and yeast mixture. Dip drumsticks in flour and put in a large bowl. Cover with a damp cloth and let rise 2 hours or until doubled in volume. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Heat enough oil or light olive oil in a heavy skillet to reach temperature. Add chicken and fry on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pan, drain on paper towels, and arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake at 375 ° until golden brown about 20 to 25 minutes, or until tender, turning once.

title: Cebiche De Cerdo
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder | 2 pork fat pig's feet | 1/2 lb sliced pig's foot | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 yellow pepper | 2 small beet, chopped
instructions: Sauté onion and pig's foot in a skillet with a little olive oil. When soft, turn chicken and add to the skillet. Cook until a nice caramel color, and fat starts to come out of the pig's feet. Add a little water and sprinkle in the cumin powder. Add the bell pepper, and let simmer for a minute or until the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and let the pig's foot rest, covered with a nice clean cloth, in a cool place for about 20 minutes. While this is still warm, cut some string from the string on the top of the feet. Cut the string in half, and then cut two slits into the top of the foot so that the slits will open when the feet are removed. This part is fun to do, so keep that in mind as too many steps are involved.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,cauliflower,oyster sauce,couscous,mustard,tofu,hot red chili pepper
title: Couscous With Roasted Capsicum
ingredients: 300 g couscous | 60 g soft real peanut butter | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 small hot red chili pepper | 1 hot red chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 bunch cauliflower, separated into florets | oyster sauce | 150 g firm tofu
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Tip couscous in bowl with melted pepper. Add remaining ingredients except tofu and cauliflower. Stir to combine. Place boiling water on chopping board, and pour over couscous. Leave in 2 - 3 spaces. Place tofu in the centre of the couscous and cover, with cling wrap. Transfer to oven. Cook 20 minutes, then remove and place on a plate lined with kitchen paper until it is cooled, then break into cubes. Replace wrapping, place tofu cubed in plastic bag and refrigerate for 1 hour. When ready to serve serve, bring water into a boil, then add tofu and cauliflower and return to a boil. Simmer until just cooked. Serve with sauce.

title: Nut-Pine Nut Java
ingredients: 1 large black coffee | 1/2 cup pine nuts
instructions: Brew black coffee.

title: Garlic Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh escarole ( about 2 medium ) | 1/2 cup creme fraiche ( or sour cream ) | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: In saucepan of boiling salted water, steam escarole, tightly covered, about 3 minutes. Using slotted spoon, transfer escarole to large bowl. Cover and let stand, stirring occasionally, 10 minutes. Drain and coarsely chop. Stir together creme fraiche and ricotta in small bowl. Add escarole and lemon peel and toss. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Lemon and Lemony Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken cutlets | 2 lemons, juice of
instructions: Combine lemon juice and lemon juice and pour over chicken. Cover and leave in fridge for at least 1 hour. Bake or grill chicken if desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,mint,onion salt,pork,confectioner sugar,potato starch,hoagie,cream chicken soup
title: Lucky Mint Pork Buns
ingredients: 2 potatoes, small and diced | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 lbs pork, cubed | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 medium onion, sliced | 1 teaspoon dried mint, crushed | 1 1/2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon hoagie roll frosting ( not fat-free spread )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Spray the inside of a 2 quart baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Place the mashed potatoes in a large bowl and add meat. Mix well. Stir in the cream of chicken soup, onion, mint, potato starch, and hoagie roll crumbs. Spoon mixture into the prepared dish. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the top is golden, and heated through and the filling is warmed through.

title: Spicy Chocolate Sandwich (No Bread Option)
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder or 2 lbs turkey shoulder | 2 egg whites | 2 tablespoons pepperoncini, finely chopped | 2 ounces chocolate | 10 -20 large fresh jalapeno chilies
instructions: Clean the pork shoulder, removing any fat, chain if desired. Slice it into very thin rectangular slices, about 1/8 inch thick. Lay out slices of meat and season with salt and pepper. Mix all ingredients well. Beat one egg wash and paint half of the meat slices with the egg wash. Let rest until ready to cook, or you may grill the meat on a griddle if desired at least 1 - 2 minutes per side. To serve, arrange one or two slices of meat on the bottom half of a wrap and spread a few drops of butter on it. Top with one or two small chilies and one slice of chocolate on top, then repeat, adding butter as needed. Serve with lettuce, tomato and salsa.

title: Chinese Sweet Tea
ingredients: 1 quart hot room temperature tea | 1/4 cup light palm sugar ( see note ) or 1/4 cup light brown sugar ( see note ) | 1/4 cup dark purple sweetener
instructions: Place hot tea in a tall glass or heat resistant bowl. Sprinkle sugar over hot tea. Stir, then let cool completely. Serve in airtight glass mugs for drinking or snack.

Random Ingredients: corn bread mix,guajillo chilies,corn cob,taco seasoning mix,beef chuck,red pepper flake,water chestnut,sunflower oil
title: Grilled Mexican Beef Stew
ingredients: 3/4 lb lean boneless beef chuck, cut into small cubes | 1 bag corn bread mix, made with sodium-free beef broth | 3 -4 cups water | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 8 ounces canned sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes or 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed pasilla or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried red pepper flakes | 16 corn on the cob, shucked | 1/2 cup sunflower oil
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine beef and 1/2 of the corn bread mix.

title: Kolachi
ingredients: 3/4 cup molasses | 1/4 teaspoon fennugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 1/4 cup light milk ( not whipped cream ) | 1 1/2 lbs filling
instructions: Pour the molasses and fennel seeds in a 2 qt saucepan or a dutch oven. Scrape in the fenugreek and fenugreek seeds, and allow froth to grow on top. Bring mixture to a simmer over medium heat. While mixture stands, use a pastry blender or a whisk to blend in 1 1/2 cups warm milk until mixture has the consistency of cornmeal. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Add the molasses mixture, raise heat, and cook for about 45 - 60 minutes or until mixture thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Remove from heat, and keep warm until ready to use. To use, line a 6 x 6 baking sheet with parchment or waxed paper, and line with foil. In a 1 quart bowl, fill with the 1 1/2 lbs of filling. Roll each end and then slice to approximately 1/4 inch thick. Spread slices out evenly into the cookie sheet, and bake at 300 degrees until lightly colored, about 20 minutes. Cool completely on sheet before removing to cool completely on rack. Keep refrigerated to serve.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,brown lentil,white bread cube,whipping cream,chicken bouillon,pineapple juice
title: Lentil Crockpot
ingredients: 1 package white bread cubes | 8 ounces dry brown lentils | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 3 cups whipping cream | 1/2 cup chicken bouillon | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Place bread cubes, lentils, pineapple with juice, cream and bouillon in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 4 - 6 hours or on high for 5 - 10 hours until lentils are tender and lentils cooked to your liking. Serve with lime wedges for garnish.

This could also be done with fish, fish or meat. This could be made with vegetables of your choice and simmered in any pan you would like. title: Garlic Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 2 french baguettes | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Mix the spices together and let sit for a minimum of 30 minutes. After the 15 min it should be ready to be used in your favourite Bruschetta recipe. You may need to add more spices, depending on your taste. Remove the french baguettes from their packaging. Brush with olive oil and spread a little olive oil over them or place in a pan and bake at 200c for 10 minutes or until bread is toasted and golden.. Enjoy with fresh fruit.

title: Turnip Lentil and Spinach Stew
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas, picked over | 1 cup turnip, diced | 1 can baby corn, drained | 1 1/2 cups frozen chopped spinach, thawed | 1/3 cup chopped dates, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Combine chickpeas, turnip, corn and spinach in a large saucepan. Add 2 cups water. Bring to boiling, reduce heat.

title: Raspberry and Bean Pasta
ingredients: 100 g raspberries or 100 g strawberries, rinsed and dried | 225 g frozen refried beans | 150 g ricotta cheese | 250 g orzo pasta | cornflour | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Pour boiling water over the raspberries and allow to macerate overnight. Place drained raspberries in a bowl and add 2 - 3 tablespoons of warm water, allow to stand a few minutes until slightly plump. Stir in refried beans and re cover. Allow to sit at room temperature for about 20 minutes to soften. Stir ricotta and parmesan cheese into the bean mixture. Serve pasta tossed with a tablespoon of grated chocolate.

title: Mouton Gamberend -- Stuffed Rice Pancakes
ingredients: 24 scallops | 2 cups self-rising flour | 8 ounces ground lamb | 4 cups unconverted long-grain rice, rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the uncooked rice in the bottom of a 10x15 inch glass baking dish. Stuff each scallop with the lamb, then wrap it in a piece of bread. Seal the edges of the bread around the filling with the flour. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,bamboo shoot,hot mustard,anaheim chilies,artichoke heart
title: Artichoke Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans sliced artichoke hearts | 1 can thawed sliced bamboo shoots | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 teaspoon hot mustard | 2 tablespoons anaheim chilies, minced
instructions: Drain artichokes and bamboo shoots. Puree both. Stir in peanut and mustard. Spoon over hot peppers and serve.

title: Spiced Sprouts and Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon coarsely ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1/3 cup coarsely cauliflower floret
instructions: Heat a wok over medium high heat. When very hot, pour in the oil, swirling to coat the sides with oil. Add the cumin and ground cloves, and when they begin to sizzle, add the bean sprouts. Toss for a few seconds, and sprinkle over the cauliflower. Stir until the sauce is heated though. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.

title: Persian Garlic
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 3 cups chopped hot peppers ( a fresh hot pepper may also be used )
instructions: Heat butter in a small saucepan until it foams, then add hot peppers. Saute for 5 minutes, stirring all the time. Remove from heat and pour into a shallow dish or pan. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature. Cover surface of hot pepper mixture with cheesecloth and set aside at room temperature for 15 minutes. Press hard around edges to remove most of the liquid. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: caper,ghee,bread crumb,wild mushroom,beer,coconut pecan frosting,sun tomato oil,green bell pepper
title: Cheater's Wild Mushroom, Caper & Pecan Brew Canapes
ingredients: 1 cup dried bread crumbs | 1/2 cup ghee | 1/2 cup drained sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon drained capers | 1 can sliced wild mushrooms | 3 tablespoons coconut pecan frosting | 2 teaspoons drained water-packed sun-dried tomato oil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix the bread crumbs, chhee, sun dried tomatoes, green bell pepper & capers. Spoon 1 tablespoon of the crumbed mixture onto the center of each round of parchment paper. Top each canapilla with a layer of mushrooms, spooning more crumbs around the mushrooms. Wrap the canapés in the parchment paper & bake for 15 minutes. Transfer canapés to a rack to cool. Drizzle top of each with 2 teaspoons of the frosting.

title: Chicken Wrapped in Crostini With a Twist
ingredients: 100 g chicken breasts, sliced | 1 tablespoon cumin | 125 g baguette, sliced
instructions: Put chicken slices between sheets of greaseproof paper on work bench or high shelf of your gas grill. Sprinkle with cumin. Place sliced baguette on chicken with long edge nearest you, ensuring an even surface is overhang. Cook, turning once or twice, for about 8 minutes or until golden. Remove bread from grill. Slice chicken and serve on toasted bread with pickled onions and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,grain rice,baby spinach,oregano,kosher salt,hungarian paprika,orange juice concentrate,mozzarella cheese
title: Hungarian Chicken and Rice Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets ( skinless, boneless & 1/2-inch thick ) | 4 cups baby spinach | 1 1/2 cups sliced fresh mozzarella cheese | 1/8 cup prepared sweet hungarian paprika | 1/8 cup frozen orange juice concentrate | 1/8 cup chopped dried oregano | 1 tablespoon kosher salt, plus more, to taste | 4 cups hot cooked medium grain rice
instructions: Place chicken in a large, deep pot. Add water to just cover the chicken and the chicken. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place the baby spinach in a large shallow bowl. Cover with cold water, just until just wilted. Drain. Cut the chicken into 1/2 inch wide pieces. Return the liquid in the pot to the pan, and bring to a boil. Once the liquid is boiling, remove the cover, stir in the baby spinach, then remove the lid. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat for 2 minutes to wilt the spinach slightly. Spoon the spinach over the chicken and spinach, and sprinkle with the mozzeralla, paprika, orange juice concentrate, oregano, and salt. Cover the pot and cook until the mozzeralla is melted and the chicken is heated through, about 10 minutes.

title: Cheese Tortellini and Quesadillas
ingredients: 16 ounces cheese tortellini | 6 pieces queso fresco ( can sub farmer's cheese ) | cinnamon, to taste ( optional ) | cinnamon, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Warm tortellini according to package directions. Remove pasta from heat and set aside. Meanwhile, slice queso fresco into small cubes and toss them in a small bowl. When tortellini is sufficiently cooled, drain well and cut into small pieces and toss with cheese. Heat skillet over a medium heat. Drain excess fat from pan. Stirring frequently and using a wooden spoon, coat tortellini lightly with the queso fresco, then add to pan. Stir in a little cinnamon if desired. Serve right away.

title: Homemade Red Pepper Spread
ingredients: 2 red sweet peppers, cleaned and halved | 2 containers philadelphia cream cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place peppers in a roasting pan. Drizzle cream cheese over peppers and season with salt, if desired. Bake for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,potato,flour tortilla,dark soy sauce,taco seasoning mix,tamari,pimiento,quark
title: Easy Potato Pizza #4FIX
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon low-sodium instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon tamari | 1 jar dried pimientos | 1/3 cup low-fat quark | 10 flour tortillas
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the dark soy sauce, 1 tbsp. Of chicken bouillon, and taco seasoning. Dice the potatoes for the recipe to use. Dice the pimento for the recipe. Stir into bag with the other taco seasoning packet. Add to the bowl. Mix well with hands. Cover with saran wrap and refridgerate for at least 1 1/2 hours. When ready to bake, combine the pimento, Quark, and tamari. Spread mixture evenly onto the tortillas. Bake in a pre heated 350 degree oven, for about 12 to 15 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Egg Nogil
ingredients: 6 egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f. With an electric mixer, beat egg whites, garlic, mustard and garam masala together in a large glass or ceramic bowl until stiff peaks form. Stir the egg whites into the dry ingredients. Spread onto an ungreased cookie sheet and bake in preheated oven until the edges are browned, about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Cashew Nut Soup
ingredients: 2 cups raw cashews | 2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Toast the cashews at a 300 degree fahrenheit for 15 minutes. Place nuts on a paper napkin and wrap it in a towel. Microwave on high for 10 minutes, then let cool. Add broth to the pot and bring to a boil. Simmer until you reach your desired consistency, about 20 minutes.

title: Awesome Pasta Kebab
ingredients: 1 cup rotini pasta | 1 -2 tablespoon ginger paste ( optional )
instructions: Begin by soaking your rotini in hot water for a few minutes, then draining. In a medium size bowl, combine the cooked rotini with the grated ginger paste. Mix well and allow to soak for 15 - 20 minutes. The mixture will have the texture of taco meat. Serve with parmasala, and/or raita on the side, to pass as a side dish.

title: Killer Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 4 cups plain macaroni and cheese, cooked and drained | 1 can fruit, drained, rinsed and diced | 1 jalapeno, minced ( more if you like it hotter ) ( optional ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 cup bread, crumbs ( optional ) | 2 packages shell pasta ( optional ) | cooking spray or butter, to coat the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish
instructions: Preheat oven to add the cooked macaroni, fruit, jalapeno, cheese and bread crumbs to the egg mixture and mix all together. Grease the bottom of the baking dish with oil or butter. Cut a circle from the back of a large spoon and fill the center with about 1/2 teaspoon of potato filling. Add 2 cups of water to the dish and then add it to the dish. Add another circle of pasta and fill the rest of the macaroni/feta mixture. The macaroni can be added to your dish if you like and eaten immediately.

title: Chorizo & Dried Raspberries & Chayote
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpeas, drained | 1 cup canned corn, drained | 1/2 cup drained raspberries | 1 chipotles free banana, cut into thin matchstick slices | 1 small canned chipotle chayote ( about 1 teaspoon ) or 1 small yellow chile pepper, seeded and minced ( about 1 teaspoon ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 -2 teaspoon adobo sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Sesame and Chilli Crumbs
ingredients: 2 cups fresh italian breadcrumbs | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and mix well. Dip balls into the batter, and then dry on a clean tea towel before serving.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,cream chicken soup,ginger beer,monterey jack cheese,gruyere cheese
title: Crock Pot  Chicken and Beer
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 2 lime, juice and orange zest of | 1 can ginger beer | 2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat crock pot. Strain soups into crock pot. Pour juice and orange peel on top. Stir. Place on high for 5 hours. Pour into serving bowl. Sprinkle with cheeses and stir. If sour cream wasn't stirred, stir in now and stir. Yum.

title: Chargrilled Eggplant (Aubergine) Anticuchos
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 1/3 cup canola oil
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut the ends off the eggplants, and score the flesh on all sides in a criss cross pattern with scissors. Place the eggplant on a baking sheet, and brush with the canola oil. Broil about 4 inches from the heat until the flesh is dark brown, soft, and easily pierced with a knife. This should take about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coconut cream,chickpea flour,tahini,garam masala,dark sesame oil,queso fresco,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pecorino and Chickpea Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
instructions: Combine the chickpea flour, pecorino cheese, tahini, garam masala, sesame oil, and coconut cream in a bowl until thoroughly mixed. Set the mixture aside. To prepare the fritters, gently press each fritter down into a 2 cup measuring cup or measuring cup. Fill the cup with 1/2 cup of the mixture and set aside. Fill the remaining cup with queso fresco and dot with dill.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,red enchilada sauce,rotelle pasta,stir fry sauce,plain flour,poblano pepper
title: Pasta Stir Fry With Poblano Strips and Green Chiles
ingredients: 250 g rotini pasta or 250 g penne pasta | 125 g stir fry vegetables | 1 poblano pepper, cored and deseeded, thinly sliced | 250 g red enchilada sauce | 300 g plain flour | 400 ml rotelle pasta or 400 g rotini pasta, drained
instructions: Cook rotini or penne pasta in large pan according to directions, drain immediately, then return to pan, add the vegetables, poblano pepper, enchilada sauce and stir for 4 to 5 minutes, then set aside. Pour flour into a large, deep frying pan and add warm water to bring the mixture to a boil. Whisk in a little salt, if necessary. Drain the rotini or penne into the boiling liquid. Stirring frequently until the pasta is cooked to your requirements. Drain well in a sieve and return to pan, then add the vegetables and sauce and stir. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white bread,beef bouillon cube,monterey jack cheese,szechwan pepper,lemon zest
title: Queso Blanco: a Spicy Pepper & Cheese Bread Stuffing from Tibet
ingredients: 1 loaf white bread, crusts removed, loaf cut into chunks. | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons dried lemon zest ( or zest of 1 whole lemon ) | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 teaspoon of ground szechwan pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Drain excess bread pieces by wrapping each bread chunk in foil, putting pieces underneath a colander & draining the bread in the hot oven. Bake in 400f oven about 10 minutes, then remove from oven. Using kitchen scissors finely dice the chiles. Toss with cheese.

title: Catfish and Red Cabbage (Costa Rican Version)
ingredients: 500 g catfish | 1 medium red cabbage, finely chopped | 1 red cabbage, finely chopped | 3 cups cornflour | 250 g stale italian bread | 250 g currants | 250 g greek yogurt or 250 g sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Bring a pan of water to the boil and add the salt and the chopped catfish. Remove from heat and set aside for 5 minutes or until cooked. Remove the catfish from the pan and leave to cool slightly.. Cut the shredded catfish into medium sized pieces. Cut the red cabbage into thick slices and cut the white cabbage into 5cm cubes. Boil the whole white cabbage for 4 - 5 minutes then refresh in cold water. Cut the bread into 3 cm slices and tear into small chunks. In a large bowl mix all together and add the currants, greek yogurt and the vanilla. Stir well until all the ingredients are evenly mixed through. Add the catfish pieces last and mix through. Add more cornflour if needed. Pour the mixture into oven dish and place on the middle shelf of the oven when it is 160°c. Check that the bread is warm, if not it's ready, and serve.

title: Italian Sausage and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 package fresh asparagus, sliced | 1 1/2 pounds chuck roast, cut into pieces | 1/2 pound sweet italian sausage, sliced | 1 package frozen okra, thawed | 6 potatoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Blanch asparagus until tender crisp, or to desired doneness, and transfer to a large bowl. Spray chuck roast with cooking spray. Arrange sausage in a single layer over the asparagus, and layer with okra. Arrange sweet potatoes over the top. Cover with a layer of sausage, and a second layer of potatoes.

title: White Bean Burgers
ingredients: 2 cans great northern beans | hamburger buns
instructions: Mix beans and hamburger. Cover and put in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes.

title: Cacio E Pepe
ingredients: 1 cup dried shell pasta or 1 cup other fettuccine | 1 cup grated parmasiano-reggiano cheese | 1 cup grated pecorino cheese | 2 cups raisins
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions. Drain the pasta and add the cheese and raisins. Toss together.

title: Swedish Meat Stew (Aka Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck | 2 1/2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh orange zest | 5 cups cold water | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 1/2 cup white raisins
instructions: Cut meat into 1 slices. Trim excess fat, if any. Cut each slice in half if it's necessary. Spray with vegetable cooking spray. Arrange in crockpot and add cold water. Add orange zest and raisins. Cover.

title: Mexican Pork Tenderloin (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 2 cups diced pork tenderloin | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh gingerroot | 1 tablespoon chipotle powder | 1/2 cup chopped roasted pistachio nuts
instructions: Place all ingredients in slow cooker. Close slow cooker and set to low. Cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours on low then remove meat for a 5 to 7 hour high heat setting or until meat thermometer reads temperature of 160 degrees f, or cook longer. Transfer meat onto a cutting board and cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,ginger powder,dill,yellow bell pepper,halibut,beef rib eye roast,yellow onion,red chili pepper
title: Grilled Halibut
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 2 tablespoons chopped yellow onion | 3 tablespoons ground ginger powder | 1 tablespoon crushed red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon grated orange peel | 2 boneless beef rib eye roast | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 8 ounces halibut
instructions: Stir the dill, onion, ginger, chili pepper, and orange peel together in a large bowl. Add beef. Stir. Place the bell pepper and steak in another bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Preheat charcoal grill for medium low heat on the rack. If using a grill that will not accommodate indirect heat, light the coals for coals.
