Brush grate with oil. Remove the bell pepper mixture from the bowl, reserving oil. Place the steak on the grill grate and baste with oil and reserved spice mixture. Grill, turning once, until meat is well seared and a thermometer thermometer inserted into center of meat registers 140 degrees for medium rare, about 25 minutes. Serve with bell pepper mixture on the side.

title: Scallops - With Tomatoes and Mint
ingredients: 12 scallops ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 celery ribs, diagonally diced | 16 anchovy fillets | 12 -20 mint
instructions: In a small saucepan, place the scallops in just enough water to cover them. Bring to boiling. Cook 3 minutes, drain and set aside. Reserve the poaching liquid. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, heat the anchovies. Split the scallops down their centre vein. With a sharp knife, snip off the shells that float or cut them in half lengthwise. Add the scallops to the cooking liquid and cook them over medium heat, stirring constantly. When they are nearly opaque, stir in the celery and continue cooking until the vegetables are crisp tender. Just before serving, stir in the chopped mint.

title: Spaghetti Sauce with Chili Oil (Mushroom Sauce)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet spiced spaghetti sauce, or as needed | 1 tablespoon crushed dried thyme | 1 serrano peppers, halved, seeded, and thinly sliced
instructions: Stir the spiced spaghetti sauce, thyme, and serrano pepper together in a saucepan. Cover and cook over medium low heat until flavors are blended.

Random Ingredients: curry,bicarbonate soda,apple cider vinegar,cayenne pepper,wheat flour,dark soy sauce,turnip,monterey jack cheese
title: Sweet Gingery Turnips
ingredients: 1 lb turnip, peeled and grated | 3 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dark soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon curry | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 3/4 cup smoked gouda cheese | 3 -4 tablespoons light dark soy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 deg celsius and line a baking tray with baking paper. Put grated turnip in a large bowl. Mix the bicarb, cayenne pepper, dark soy, curry, apple cider vinegar and cheese in a bowl. Make sure you mix until really well combined then add the liquid a little at a time, beating with a fork until you have a smooth mixture. Pour mixture over grated turnip in bowl, and sprinkle over extra cheese. Mix thoroughly to make sure all ingredients are well combined. Grease the baking tray with oil, line a small non stick muffin pan with this mixture, and press the turnip into the pan lightly. Bake for 40 minutes until crisp and golden brown. Allow to cool on the baking tray, before serving. Variation, you can use grated beetroot or beetroot.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,rice vinegar,feta cheese,barbecue sauce,dill,half
title: Feta Cheese and Barbecue Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces feta cheese | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 4 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar | 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup fresh dill ( optional ) | 1 large red chili pepper, deveined, seeded, and chopped
instructions: Preheat grill to high. In small bowl, mash feta cheese and half and half until smooth. In a 9 inch nonstick skillet over medium low heat, melt feta cheese until slightly smooth. Add seasoned rice vinegar and cook, whisking constantly until thickened. When slightly thickened, stir bbq sauce, dill, and chili pepper into bbq mixture. Drizzle cheese mixture over hot cheese mixture. Serve.

title: Homemade Fresh Romaine Leaves (Tortillas)
ingredients: 5 cups romaine lettuce, shredded | 1 can green chili peppers, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the shredded lettuce into a large, deep roasting dish or baking dish. Cut the green chili peppers into rings and place them on top of the lettuce. Pour the chili juice evenly over the lettuce and top with the rinsed and drained whole green chilies. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until the mixture is crisp and the chili peppers are tender.

title: Curried Parsnips With Gruyere and Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip | 2 ounces mozzarella cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1 tablespoon crumbled gruyere cheese
instructions: Peel parsnips and cut into 5 to 6 wedges. In a large skillet, add grated gruyere and curry powder. Heat to a gentle simmer. Add the parsnips and toss to coat. Turn the mixture to warm. Sprinkle top with crumbled cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Bacon-Cabbage
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 tablespoon drained capers | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram
instructions: Fill a large saucepan with water, and bring to a boil. Add cabbage. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, over high heat until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain cabbage, and coarsely chop. Transfer to a serving bowl. Mash cabbage with a potato masher. Stir in capers, and marjoram. Refrigerate 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,almond,cardamom,whiskey,vanilla extract,chicken stock cube
title: Whiskey Spiced Almond Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup almonds | 6 tablespoons whiskey, i used riesling | 4 large free-range chicken stock cubes ( i used homemade ) | 1 chicken stock cube, with puffs crushed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the almonds in a microwave safe grilling paper bag, and microwave on medium power, in a microwave oven, stirring every minute for 1 - 1 1/2 mins, or until very lightly browned & fragrant. Set aside with rind and slivered almonds. Melt the whiskey in a small saucepan over low heat. Add the crushed stock cubes, and bring to a boil. Place the cardamon in a small bowl. Stir to combine. Stir the hot whiskey into the ground cardamom. Pour the ground cardamom mixture into the pan & simmer, stirring often. Set the rum and almonds aside. Add the crushed stock cubes to the saucepan, stir, and simmer, stirring often, until the sauce is thick and the liquid has thickened. Season with salt & freshly ground pepper. Allow to cool slightly before blending with the almonds.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,cayenne pepper,salt pepper,beef broth,pepper,cream cheese,scotch bonnet pepper,cayenne
title: Roast Beef Cheese Dip
ingredients: 500 g cream cheese | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 cup beef broth | 1 -2 scotch bonnet pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 dash salt and pepper | 1 dash cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons sour cream
instructions: Combine cream cheese, salt, pepper, cayenne pepper and corn flour in a food processor. Pulse til smooth. Add broth and blend til smooth. Pierce pepper and add at least 1/2 tsp of salt and pepper. Blend for 1 - 2 minutes. Spoon into a medium size glass dish. Set dish aside. Roast beef cheese dip either on an oiled rack or under a preheated oven on 180 degrees celcius for 5 - 7 minutes till heated thoroughly. Allow to cool. Cut into small slices. To serve, put slices on a plate and top with sour cream. Serve with crackers.

title: Camaron Rebosado - Clams with Crushed Clams
ingredients: 12 small clams | vegetable oil
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Toast clams in the hot oil until they open slightly, about 2 to 3 minutes. Turn clams over and quickly remove them from the pan using tongs. Place clams on a plate. Spoon a half inch depth of oil into the skillet and quickly stir in the clams. They will eventually sink to the bottom and give off their fragrance, about 1 to 2 minutes. Cook until clams have opened, about 1 minute. Toss with fried potatoes to serve, or just eat right away.

title: Sauce With Spanish Onions, Rice, and Chips
ingredients: 3 shallots, chopped finely | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped finely | 16 fluid ounces corn tortilla chips, broken up
instructions: Heat 2 turns of oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 7 minutes, stirring often. Turn off the heat. Mash the shallots with the salt and stir in the onions and chips. Transfer the sauce to a serving bowl and serve. Note, the chips can also be coated with oil, but can be soaked in a small bowl of water before serving.

title: Sherry and Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground meatballs | 1 bunch parsley | 2 sprigs oregano | cayenne | 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 3/8 cup watermelon, 1 inch chunks | 1 yellow squash, 1 inch chunks | 4 tablespoons grapes, halved
instructions: Combine meatballs, parsley, oregano, cayenne, sherry, and oregano in bowl. Add watermelon, squash, grapes and 1 tablespoon water. Mix thoroughly, shape into walnut sized balls.

title: Simple, Simple Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup smooth peanut butter, smooth | 2 tablespoons dill, chopped
instructions: Blend the peanut butter, dill, and salt with a fork until smooth.

title: Coconut Chicken Skewers With Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1 lb chicken fillet, trimmed and cut into 3/4 inch slices | 1 cup parisweet desiccated coconut | 4 tablespoons orange marmalade | 50 g gorgonzola, crumbled
instructions: Soak the chicken in a bowl of very warm water or a bowl of ice water for 30 minutes to remove any saltiness. Combine the coconut and marmalade in a small pan and fry gently for 1 - 2 minutes over a low heat. Brush onto both sides of the chicken pieces. Turn the chicken over and brush with more marmalade. Grill for 5 minutes until just cooked through and crisp. Sprinkle with gorgonzola. Serve immediately.

title: New England Corn Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese | 2 cans creamed corn | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix cream cheese, creamed corn and cider vinegar. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Mexican Pasta Nests
ingredients: 6 quarts cold water | 1 can no-salt-added rotel ( or equivalent brand, do not use jalapeno seasoning ) | 4 -6 cups chopped fresh pecans or 4 -6 cups almonds | 6 -12 ounces fat-free evaporated skim milk | 1 box dry seitan, thawed | 1 can black olives, sliced | canned fat free cream ( optional )
instructions: Boil the water and add the rotel or jalapeno. When the water just begins to boil again, reduce the heat to low and let simmer until the flavors come together, 15 - 20 minutes. Meanwhile, toast the nuts. Drain and set aside. Reserve 1/2 c liquid. Stir the drained canned milk into the drained and chopped nuts and set aside. When the pasta is finished, drain and rinse and add to the bowl with the cheese and sour cream.. Combine until a spreadable consistency. Stir in the reserved 1/2 cans of the liquid, and place aside until ready to assemble the nests. Top each with a few pats of reserved cheese or olive slices. This dish is best made just before serving though an elegant way to serve this appetizer is to top the appetizers with lots of napkins and nice corn bread.

Random Ingredients: halibut fillet,vegetable oil,baking powder,bacon,borlotti bean,velveeta mexican cheese,currant,wheat bread
title: Borage and Halibut Fajitas
ingredients: 2 cups fresh borlotti beans, cleaned & rinsed | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 lb halibut fillet | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 8 slices bacon, fried crisp, crumbled | 1 cup velveeta mexican cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup currants | 4 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Put beans in a large bowl stir in baking soda, set a side. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Cut fish across grain into 1/4 slices, then in half. Brush both sides of fish with oil, then arrange in a baking pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Turn fish over, continue to bake until done. Meanwhile, saute crumbled bacon, velveeta, and currants in a skillet until cheese is melted, then stir into beans. Top cooked fish with crumbled bacon/cheese mixture until all is used. Serve with warm tortillas.

title: Tarragon Chicken Wings
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings | 1 large red potato, peeled | 16 leaves thyme | 2 teaspoons packed tarragon
instructions: Rinse all chicken wings under water and place on large platter. Place potato and thyme inside the wings. Sprinkle with tarragon and pour 1/2 cup water around chicken. Cover and let stand in dark, cool and dry for 6 days. Heat oven to 350°f, place chicken wings in casserole dish, bake, basting as necessary until chicken wings are tender, 15 minutes. Remove and let stand until thickened, about 30 minutes longer. Cut into sections and serve.

title: Chocolate Beans
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans ( can be canned ) | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder ( preferably unsweetened )
instructions: Place beans in pot with cold water over medium to high heat. Bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes or so before removing beans from pot. Place beans in a bowl and add cocoa powder. Beat until well blended. Serve.

title: Greek Chips With Sausage and Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 6 star anise | 6 ounces sweet italian sausage, casings removed
instructions: Heat a small cast iron skillet over medium high until barely smoking, then sear the anise for 1 minute per side, or until fragrant. Remove from skillet immediately and store in a airtight container at room temperature until ready to use. If you would like to crisp the anise chips, you can either do so by placing back over a pan of low heat to preheat for 2 to 5 minutes, or you can just roll each piece into a cone of the appropriate size. The edges of the star anise will be slightly hard and shiny when done. Remove from pan and set aside for 10 minutes, then place the aniseed into a kitchen towel and rub the coating all over the chip. Seal the pan and continue shaking the coating off the chip as you finish cooking the coating. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Remove a few chip from the oven. Using tongs or a slotted spoon, transfer the coated chips onto a lightly floured work surface and pat dry with paper towels. The soaking powder will stain your hands at this point so be sure to work quickly. Using a small sharp knife, cut 4 to 6 diagonal slits across the top of the chip. Place them in miniature paper bags, and set aside. When ready to bake, place the bag in the oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned. Remove and allow to cool slightly. While the coating is cooling, put the carmelized onions into another small, heavy skillet and place over medium high heat. Turn the heat to medium and cook the onions for about 5 minutes, turning over halfway through stirring and moving them so they cook evenly until golden brown on all sides. Set aside. Turn off the oven and leave the onions in there for 5 more minutes or until they look fairly dry. While the coating is cooling, preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Place all 12 chips on a lightly buttered baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned and crispy. Remove from oven and let cool slightly then break each into 4 small pieces, and place back on the baking sheet. Sprinkle each piece with the caramelized onions. Serve warm, warm or at room temperature.

title: Chili Powder (Hindi)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chile powder ( habenero, habanero ) | 1 piece cardamom pod
instructions: Place the cardamom pod in a mortar and grind it to fine powder.

title: Ancho Chile Toast
ingredients: 8 slices coarse whole grain bread, without crusts | 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Heat a pan over medium heat and toast bread for just a few seconds each side until golden brown. Place toast in a dry oven safe container with a lip. Pour chili powder over and serve immediately.

title: Sauce Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce, your your favourite recipe | 1 package sliced pepperoni | 1/3 cup dry sherry wine
instructions: Heat spaghetti sauce into saucepan over medium heat and heat through but do not boil. Stir in pepperoni. Sprinkle sherry on hot caccia. Serve with grated mozzarella cheese or grated provolone cheese.

title: The Devil Inside
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 4 ounces balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 4 teaspoons rum | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds
instructions: Combine creamed corn, vinegar, mustard seeds, rum and dry mustard in blender. Cover and blend on medium speed for 5 minutes. Add liquid in a steady stream until thick and creamy. Pour into molds or small serving dishes. Cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,sushi rice,plain yogurt,red chile pepper,cannellini bean,red onion,chicken bouillon,oregano leaf
title: Sushi with Sweet Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups short-grain sushi rice | 1 fresh red chile pepper, finely chopped | 1 red onion, chopped | 2 cups cooked cannellini beans | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 slice pepperoni, sliced, or to taste
instructions: Place short grain safflower rice, red chile pepper, red onion, and cannellini beans in a large pot, and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Drain well. Stir rice, oregano, and chicken bouillon cube into cooked rice until well mixed. Beat the yogurt in a small bowl. Pour into the rice, and season with pepperoni slices.

Random Ingredients: cumin,golden syrup,milk,sugar snap pea,sharp cheddar cheese,squid,parsley leaf
title: Cheddar & Squid
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon skim milk | 1 tablespoon skim milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar snap peas | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 lb squid, cleaned | 2 teaspoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 3 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shaved
instructions: Combine golden syrup, skim milk and sugar snap peas in 2 quart saucepan.

title: Thai Style Egg Noodle Soup
ingredients: 12 eggs, separated | 1 large onion, sliced thinly | 1/4 cup instant black coffee ( i prefer decaf ) | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, powdered ( i prefer lemongrass, powdered so i don't add to the soup ) | 1 pinch mexican oregano | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: First, make the soup by mixing the eggs yolks, salt, chili sauce, oregano and sugar and set aside and keep the soup warm while working on the noodles cook linguine in a pot of water to noodles. When done drain and rinse noodles under cold water and set aside. When noodles are cold chop and place in blender with rest of ingredients except the egg whites and stir till blended. Then add egg whites and mix till blended with noodles and heat thoroughly before serving, garnish with green onion. You may add fresh cilantro to the soup if you like.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,kosher salt,graham cracker crumb,apricot,ramen noodle
title: Jambalaya
ingredients: 8 ounces packages sliced deli-style imitation ramen noodles | 2 small korean dried apricots, cut into strips ( jangmin ) | 1 cup kosher salt, divided | 12 ounces gogiorno deli fat-free graham cracker crumbs | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced daikon radishes
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Arrange the ramen noodles in a single layer on a baking sheet, and broil or toast under the preheated oven until a shade darker, about 5 minutes. Remove the noodles from the oven, and spread a layer of jangmin scallop on one of the noodles, then the apricots and 1/4 teaspoon of salt on the other. Repeat with the graham cracker crumbs, radishes and remaining slices of noodles in 3 more layers. Arrange the noodles in a single layer on a baking sheet, and broil or toast under the preheated oven until golden, about 1 minute. Sprinkle each serving with 3 tablespoons of salt just before serving.

title: The Old Cape Room's Arabic Almond Soup
ingredients: 2 ounces almond paste | 2 cups yoghurt ( arab or greek ) | 1 bay leaf | 1/2 small orange, rind of, grated on the highest setting for 30 60 seconds after removing the zest of the orange
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Cover with a wet towel and put in the fridge until is cold, but not boiling.. Use this whenever you feel the soup is ready. It tastes better cold.

title: Cousin June - Spicy Okra Rice Balls
ingredients: 3 cups cooked arborio rice | 3/4 cup frozen cut okra, cooked, drained and cubed | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup frozen crispon slices or 1/4 cup frozen sliced strawberries, sliced
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and stir to mix lightly. Form into an even 1 - ½ inches circular ball, adding a spoonful of ice to prevent it sticking. Cover and chill. Serve with toothpicks or crackers.

title: Pork Gravy with Shallots
ingredients: 500 g pork shoulder | 25 g plain flour | 25 g mustard seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 degrees centigrade. Trim the pork of all excess fat, but leave skin on. Place the pork in a heavy based ovenproof dish. Combine the flour and mustard seeds in a bowl and toss the pork in this until all sides are coated in the mix. Add a little water if required to scrape up any of the browning from the pork. Place in the oven and bake for 2 hours. Pour off any fat from the pan. Remove from the oven, skim off any fat on the surface and serve with boiled potatoes and carrots for a delicious gravy or as a side dish.

title: Shrimp Ricotta Nests
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 container ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the shrimp, and cook for 1 minute. Drain. Stir in the ricotta cheese in 3 or 4 nests until well mixed. Drop by mounds onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until the shrimp are pink and the cheese has melted, 20 to 30 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Porcini Mushroom-Almond Pots De Crème Brulee
ingredients: 2 cups whipping cream | 3/4 cup porcini mushrooms, drained and finely chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups, or sub regular mushrooms, if desired ) | 1 cup pimento stuffed olive, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine whipping cream and finely chopped porcini mushrooms in a bowl. Heat until simmering, about 3 - 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Ladle cream mixture into 4 porcini mushrooms. Arrange mushrooms and olives evenly on a serving platter. Remove porcini mushroom stems.

title: Chilli Beef Filets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 teaspoon dry crushed red chilies | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup ranch dressing | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Trim fat from meat, cut into 1/2 pieces place in zip top freezer bag.

title: Crazy Tweaked Red Potato Chips!
ingredients: 1 lb red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 1/2 cups fat-free italian dressing | 1/2 cup vodka | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 4 nori, broken into small chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Slice potatoes in half lengthwise.

title: Italian Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes with juice, undrained | 1 can tomato paste | 4 cups orange juice
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine stewed tomatoes, tomato paste, and orange juice. Stir. Bring to boiling.

title: Baked Lobsters & Rice
ingredients: 1 jar purchased tamarillos, drained and rinsed ( or other hard liquor ) | 3 1/2 ounces uncooked risotto rice | 6 live lobsters, halved ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh oregano, chopped ( about 1 1/2 teaspoons ) | 3 cups biscuit
instructions: Place the tamarillos in a large bowl. Cover with warm water and let soak 20 minutes. Drain the chilie and reserve. Place the rice, lobsters, raisins, saffron and saffron in a large bowl and mash together using a fork. Place the yeast in a small bowl over a pan of boiling water. Allow to soften for 1 minute then stir in the oregano. Drain the tamarillos or purée them in a blender, then squeeze all the liquid from the pulp, discarding the solids. Using a spoon, scrape the seeds from the lobster shells and discard the shells. Set the liquid aside and pour the liquid into a medium pot. Add the reserved chilie and the sesame seeds, then bring to a boil over high heat. Let cool, then refrigerate until required. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Drain the lobsters thoroughly, shaking off any excess liquid. Arrange them on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until the yolks are deep golden brown, 25 to 35 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool. Cut the shells in half and transfer them to a serving tray and serve alongside the cooked yolks. Makes approximately 8 servings.

title: Spiced Noodles with Egg Noodles or Rings
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod ( optional, add one if using rings ) | 1 1/4 cups long-grain rice ( optional )
instructions: Put a pot of water on to boil for the noodles or noodles. Turn off the heat and just let them sit there, submerged in the water, for about 10 minutes. In a wide frying pan, pour 1/4 of the noodles into the boiling water and let it boil for 3 - 4 minutes so they don't become mushy. You can also, 1/4 of the noodles into cold water and let it boil for 1 - 2 minutes. You don't need to salt the noodles as the noodles will retain some of that starch in the pan. If using a ring, dip each ring in the noodles then immediately dump them into the frying pan with the rest of the ingredients. Cook about 4 minutes. If you like, add more noodles in the pan just before serving. There should be a creamy creamy sauce.

title: Cashew Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups broken cashews | 1 jar monterey jack cheese
instructions: Place cashews in a blender, and grind into fine crumbs using an electric mixer or hand blender fitted with the fine blade. Cut monterey jack cheese into pieces about 3 x3. Spread on top of cashews. Microwave at high for about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,corn tortilla chip,pancit bihon noodle,green bell pepper
title: Khao Man Gai (Spicy Cauliflower Noodles)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups crispy corn tortilla chips | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 cauliflower, chopped into 1 inch pieces | 1/3 cup pancit bihon noodles
instructions: Boil the cauliflower until tender. Drain well. In another pan, sauté the yellow bell pepper in a bit of butter/oil until the texture is light brown on medium heat. Put in the fried noodle, mix together well and sauté for another few minutes until it becomes crispy. You can put some cellophane in the water to keep the noodles from sticking to each other while they are sautéing so it doesn't get too soupy. Serve with spiced chow mein, jasmine rice, or whatever else floats your boat.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato sauce,gouda cheese,penne,coconut,glutinous rice flour,lard,strip steak,white chocolate chip
title: Brazilian Steak and Chips
ingredients: 2 strips steak, thinly sliced | 1 cup glutinous rice flour, glutinous-rice flour | 1/4 cup no-salt-added tomato sauce | 8 ounces smoked gouda cheese, cut into thin strips | 14 1/2 ounces no-salt-added tomato sauce | 12 ounces white chocolate chips | 4 ounces flaked coconut | extra coconut, for coating | 4 sheets no-salt-added penne, cooked per package directions
instructions: For the chip steak pat steak dry and dust with the 3rd measure of glutinous rice flour. Heat a large skillet. Cook the steaks for one minute on each side. Set aside and keep warm. For the chips, in a microwave safe bowl, melt the gouda over low power for 1 minute and set aside to cool to room temperature. In a separate microwave safe bowl, melt the chocolate chips over low power for 30 seconds and set aside to cool to room temperature. Fold in the white chocolate chips and coconut. Toss with the cooked noodles and refrigerate. For the chip chip steak, in a heavy skillet, heat 3 tablespoons of lard. Add the chip steak strips and stir fry until brown on the outside. Remove and keep warm. To serve, place a portion of the noodles onto each serving plate. Top with some of the steaks, followed by 1 tablespoon of the chips and 1 tablespoon of the melted gouda.

title: Soupy Sun Dried Tomato Spread
ingredients: 500 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 200 ml vegetable stock
instructions: Drain the tomatoes of any excess oil and mix it with the stock. Refrigerate for 3 hours or more in an airtight container. Serve with roasted or grilled vegetables.

title: Mexican Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 cups fresh tomato and green chilies, chopped | 2 packages uncooked spaghetti, broken in half lengthwise
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water until al dente. In an 8 x 8 inch baking dish, layer the drained spaghetti, tomato mixture, and green chilies. Repeat. Add water if spaghetti seems dry. Cover and cook in a 350 degree f oven for about 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: egg,icing sugar,tomato paste,chili flake,red wine vinegar
title: Tomato & Chilli Jam Jam
ingredients: 7 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 egg, beaten | 3/4 - 1 cup icing sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, pour into sterilised jam jars.

title: Easy French Fry
ingredients: 1 pound ground pork | 1/3 packet dry onion soup mix
instructions: Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat. Crumble in the ground pork, and cook until evenly browned and crumbly.

title: Mustard Cheese (No Canard) in a Bottle
ingredients: 1 can evaporated skim milk ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard powder ( coleman's preferred ) | 1 tablespoon cold watermelon, thinly sliced
instructions: Drain liquid from a can of evaporated milk ricotta cheese, into a small bowl, stir in mustard powder and watermelon until fully combined.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,chili paste,white chocolate,creole seasoning,plain yogurt
title: White Chocolate Yoghurt Dip
ingredients: 200 g plain yogurt | 200 g icing sugar ( confectioner's sugar ) | 3 tablespoons creole seasoning, or ( 100 -3 ml ) | 1 teaspoon chili paste, or
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar until smooth. Set aside. Dissolve the chili paste in yogurt. Spoon 3 tablespoons yoghurt mixture into a bowl and stir well into the cream cheese mixture. Serve with assorted slices of white chocolate on the side for dipping.

title: Mushroom Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 2 small green chilies or 2 small red chilies, chopped | 2 teaspoons dried basil or 1 package fresh basil | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: Saute the chilies in a little oil over a low heat until just soft. Add the salt and pepper and blend together. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,icing sugar,chili sauce,bacon dripping,vanilla extract,fava bean
title: Fried Fava Beans
ingredients: 2 cups fresh fava beans, mashed | 4 tablespoons bacon drippings | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs ( you may also just use regular crackers )
instructions: Cook fava beans in butter over medium high heat, stirring continuously for 2 or 3 minutes, or until almost done. Remove beans from heat and stir in icing sugar, vanilla, and chili sauce. Continue to cook briefly, stirring continuously, until mixture thickens. Mix crumbs with a little hot bean mixture, then mix into bean mixture. Spoon mixture into a greased and paper lined 9 x 5 loaf pan, cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Cut in 1/4 inch slices and serve with remaining sauce to dip.

title: Olive Oil Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb olive oil or 1 lb a neutral flavored oil such as a combination of oils | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns, cracked ( or use black pepper flakes ) | 1 1/2 cups farfalle pasta or 1 1/2 cups penne, of choice
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with 1 tbs salt. Prepare a bowl of cold water by boiling it for 3 minutes before using. Combine the oil and peppers in another bowl until thoroughly mixed. If you have time, leave at least 10 mins for the flavors to infuse together. Pour the pasta into the boiling water and boil uncovered for 7 - 10 minutes, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: lamb,carrot,vanilla extract,egg yolk,salt black pepper,flat leaf parsley
title: Lamb and Carrot Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground lamb | 2 large egg yolks, lightly beaten | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract or 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 medium carrot, peeled and grated ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Combine the lamb and yolks in a large bowl, stirring with a fork until blended. Stir in the parsley, vanilla or almond extract, salt and pepper and beat until the mixture is smooth. Add the carrot and knead briefly until the mixture holds together. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Form the mixture into 4 burgers, about 2/3 of the mixture per patty. Drain the excess fat from the pan and fry the burgers until crisp and brown on both sides, about 8 to 10 minutes. Serve the burgers hot or cold.

title: Italian Chicken and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon | 1 can soda water ( not water but beer ) | 4 -5 chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Pour soda water into a large baking pan. Place chicken, skin side up, into the large baking pan. Place chicken on top. Place the baking pan in oven. This may take up to 30 minutes. Add more water to the pan if it becomes too dry. Continue to bake for 30 - 40 minutes. Turn chicken skin side up and continue to bake until skin is light brown on the edges. This may take anywhere from 15 - 20 minutes to an hour. Remove pan from oven and remove chicken from pan. Add potatoes to the pan and place chicken over the potatoes. Pour chicken bouillon over chicken and potatoes. Stir to combine and cover pan with lid or foil. Return to oven for 30 - 40 minutes then remove from oven and allow to sit in a cold oven. The liquid should be absorbed and the potatoes can be cooked right away. Remove chicken and potatoes from pan and cut into bite size pieces. To serve, place chicken and potatoes on a platter surrounded by lots of grated parmesan cheese and your favourite sauce. Pour sauce mixture overtop and serve.

Random Ingredients: rum,garlic paste,spinach,milk,brown basmati rice,parsnip,ginger garlic paste
title: Nestle Rice
ingredients: 12 cloves peeled fresh ginger-garlic paste | 2 cups uncooked brown basmati rice | 5 cups milk | 1 lb fresh flat-leaf spinach, washed and sliced | 1/4 cup dried parsnip, peeled and sliced | 1/4 cup rum or rum | 4 teaspoons garlic paste
instructions: Over high heat, bring 2 cups of milk, rice and garlic paste to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer on low until all the milk is absorbed. Remove from heat and let stand for 15 minutes. Place rice in a wide, shallow pan or dish and pour in remaining milk. Cover with a lid or cloth and set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a small bowl, combine parsnip and shrimp. Add salt and pepper to taste. Set aside. In a small saucepan, heat rum and garlic paste over medium high heat until just beginning to smoke. Add shrimp and parsnip to rice and cook, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes. Drain rice and divide among four serving bowls. Ladle warm rum sauce over it. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: radish,mango,corn tortilla chip,pineapple chunk,black olive,cardamom seed
title: Spicy Grilled Radish and Mango Chip Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces radishes | 1 can unsweetened mangoes, sliced | 1 can black olives, sliced | 4 ounces corn tortilla chips | 1 -2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed pineapple chunk, drained and chopped
instructions: Cut the radishes in half lengthwise and slice crosswise into rings. Slice the mangoes thinly. Combine all ingredients. Toss well. Pour into a serving bowl and serve.

title: Spicy Salsa Chips
ingredients: 2 cups shredded onion | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Place in a microwavable bowl. Microwave at high for 2 minutes and stir well.

title: Szechuan Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 2 cups seasoned romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix soup, romaine lettuce, szechuan peppercorns, and optional salt together in a bowl.

title: Cottage Cheese and Salmon Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 small eggplant, thinly sliced | 2 cans small curd cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons anchovy fillets, minced | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 2 cans thinly sliced smoked salmon, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium high heat. Add ground beef, eggplant, and 3 cans of drained salmon. Brown on all sides, about 10 minutes. Drain meat mixture. Stir cottage cheese, anchovy, sugar, and pepper sauce mixture into meat mixture. Bring to a boil then reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,golden syrup,oriental flavor mix ramen noodle,mozzarella cheese
title: Asian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package oriental-flavor mix instant ramen noodles ( i use top ramen noodle, but if you prefer your own flavor, use the dry version. ) | 1 package mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 1 lime zest | 1 tablespoon golden syrup or 1 tablespoon maple syrup
instructions: Prepare the instant ramen according to package directions, and set aside. Place the mozzarella cheese, lime zest, golden syrup and desired amount of melted butter in a bowl, and toss to blend. Drain the ramen, and toss to combine. Top with mozzarella cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,hearty white bread,cracker crumb,lemon juice
title: Easy Grilled Hearts of Hearts of Hearts of Romaine
ingredients: 1 loaf hearty white bread, cut into 2-inch slices | 4 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1/2 cup plain cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Brush 2 bread slices with lemon juice. Place 1 tablespoon cracker crumbs in a shallow bowl. Coat each piece of bread with red wine vinegar. Let stand at room temperature until bread is lightly toasted.

title: Raspberry Surprise
ingredients: 1 lb raspberries | 1 lb dark green bittersweet chocolate chips or 1 lb semisweet chocolate chips | 1 large yellow bell pepper, halved, deseeded | 2 hard-boiled eggs, halved | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for egg halves in a small saucepan.

title: Tafelsalat
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef chuck | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 3 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Brown beef, add margarine and tomato paste. Add flour and mix well. Heat and turn until the mixture thickens. Serve cut into thin slices.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,floury potato,oat,yellow cornmeal,lemon pepper,key lime juice,veal
title: The Best Cornmeal Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs floury potatoes ( peeled, scrubbed and cubed ) | 2 lbs top round steaks or 2 lbs veal, cut into triangles | 1 cup oats ( not quick to cook ) | 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 1/2 cups key limes juice or 1 1/2 cups lime juice
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender. Drain well and return to pan, mash. Set aside to cool. Dip in oat batter and bake until golden, about 15 minutes in a 400f oven. Cool completely on wire rack. When cool, wrap individually in plastic wrap and refrigerate.

title: Spinach and French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 cups cubed american cheese | 16 slices french baguette | 1 package chopped fresh spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cream and cheese in a microwave safe one quart glass bowl. Microwave the mixture in 20 second intervals, stirring after each, until the cheese is melted. Spread one third of the mixture onto one side of each toast slice.

title: Mini Sushi Phyllo Triangles(Raw Foods)
ingredients: 1/4 cup hazelnuts, ground | 2 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 package frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Stir the ground hazelnuts into the thawed phyllo pastry sheets until well combined. Use a spoon to gently roll and pinch the dough into 24 miniature muffin cups, pressing the sides to seal the edges. Carefully unroll each cup. Place the cups in a single layer on the baking sheets. If you don't have a muffin tin, place one pastry sheet in the bottom of each muffin tin. Repeat with the remaining phyllo sheets and nut mixture, placing them about 1/2 inch apart on each sheet. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until puffed and golden. Cool for about 10 minutes before removing the cups with a spatula from the baking sheets to a rack to cool completely. Slice the tops off of each to make long strips of phyllo.

Random Ingredients: coconut rum,grape,salmon fillet,pepperoni,swede,kosher salt black pepper,lemon juice zest
title: Chef John's Crusted Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut rum | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup grated swedes | 4 salmon fillets | 1 teaspoon pepperoni, minced | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f. Remove the white fish fillets from the plastic wrapping and place on a rimmed baking sheet sprinkled with olive oil. Rub the marinade onto both sides of the fish fillets. Sprinkle with the grated swedes, pepperoni, and mozzarella. Cover and bake, stirring every 15 minutes, until the internal temperature is no more than 180 or your fish flakes easily when tested with a knife, about 40 to 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,beef brain,lemongrass,portabella mushroom,stewing beef,turmeric powder
title: Beef Stock
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg stewing beef | 1/2 liter beef brains | 3 tablespoons turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, powder chopped | 3 green bell peppers | 1/8 liter portabella mushroom
instructions: Put beef brains in pot. Add water, turmeric and lemongrass powder. Close pot and bring to boil stirring occasionally. After 3 - 6 minutes, add bell peppers and mushrooms. Lower heat. Simmer gently for about 1 hour or until beef is cooked. Do not stir as the liquid from the pot will burn. After 1/2 hours strain stock, then remove brains from pot and leave on high heat. Cut the brains in pieces like cabbage or carrots and serve.

title: Pigs & Salami Bites
ingredients: 12 whole large pretzels | 400 g genoa salami | 3/4 cup caster sugar | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius. Spread pretzels out on an oven tray and bake for 10 minutes. Cool on a plate. Cut salami into 5cm sticks and place on baking tray with salami and sugar. Sprinkle with baking soda. Bake for 20 minutes or until the salami is crisp.

Random Ingredients: topping,lime,dark beer,irish whiskey,orange bell pepper,red curry paste,brown rice,bacon
title: Smokin' Irish Red Curry Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown rice or 1 1/2 cups white rice | 2 cups orange bell peppers, sliced | 1/2 cup red curry paste | dark beer ( not beer, use dark stout or guinness ) | 1 1/2 cups irish coffee-flavored whipping cream or 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 lb bacon, chopped | 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed and chilled
instructions: In a medium saucepot, combine the cooked rice and bell peppers. In another saucepan, in a small batch of oil, fry the bacon until crisp. Drain bacon and add it to the rice. Add in the curry paste and beer. Stir well. Pour rice mixture over bacon and vegetables and toss well. Cover and allow to rest 2 - 3 minutes. Uncover and fluff with a fork. Stir in cream and serve immediately. Note, if freezing, leave out bacon and onions.

title: Linguini With Sirloin and Caramelized White Wine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 2 lbs lean, sirloin tip, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 cup sliced mozzarella cheese
instructions: Bring pot of water to boil, add salt to water. Meanwhile, trim meat of any fat. Bring meat to boil, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for 40 minutes. Drain meat and set aside. Set aside. When meat is cool enough to handle, cut into large bite size pieces. Preheat ove to 350°f. In a large skillet, cook spaghetti until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of cooking water. Drain pasta. Return spaghetti to pot, add 1 1/2 cups reserved cooking water, sour cream and half of cheese. Pour hot spaghetti mixture over bread and cheese.

title: Purple Potato Frosting
ingredients: 1 package purple potatoes | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish. Cook the potatoes and mixed vegetables in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and let cool. Stir the cocoa into the potatoes and vegetables. Add a pinch of salt and stir. Spread in your favorite frosting recipe and freeze for several hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,confectioner ' sugar,mustard seed,parmesan cheese
title: Ricciarelli Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a small bowl, dissolve bouillon in 1 tablespoon water. Stir in parmesan cheese and mustard seeds to make a paste. Stir in confectioners' sugar, about a tablespoon at a time. Pour into a 9 inch square baking dish. Sprinkle top with remaining cheese. Bake in preheated oven 30 to 45 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Clams in the Spice Casing
ingredients: 2 lbs baby clams | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn, whole
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Using a large heavy roasting pan, gently push clames apart. Add peppercorns to the clam juice and add clams and a tbsp of water. Cover pan and shake over high heat until the clams open. Remove the pan from the heat and place in oven. Cook for 15 - 20 mins until they look dry.

title: Lite Thyme and Pistachio Biscuits
ingredients: 1 -2 slice bacon, chopped finely | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pistachio nut | thyme ( optional ) or oregano ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Mix the bacon, pistachio nuts and a bit of thyme or oregano together in an ovenproof dish. Place the dish in the oven and heat through stirring occasionally to coat all of the bacon pieces. When golden, remove with a slotted spoon and place in a paper bag to drain excess juices. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,ha avocadoes,green curry paste,brandy,heavy cream
title: Aioli (Avocado-Chili Sauce for Veggies)
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes | 4 tablespoons spicy green curry paste, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon brandy ( or whisky or rum ) ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground chipotle chiles in adobo, finely chopped ( or equivalent of 1/2 tsp ground chipotle and 1 tsp. pureed chiles ) | 1 tablespoon heavy cream
instructions: Using a fork or melon baller, scoop out the flesh from the avocados using a spoon, leaving 1/4 inch shell. Cut into 1/8 inch thick chunks. Place into a small bowl. Using a slotted spoon, mash the avocados into a coarse paste. Sprinkle 1 tbsp of curry paste and 1 tbsp brandy over the avocado mixture, and stir well. Gently fold in the ground chipotle chiles. Cover bowl. Let sit for 15 minutes at room temperature. Drain the mixture, reserving the liquid. Place 1 tbsp of cream in a small, shallow bowl. With a wooden spoon, scrape the flesh from the avocados into the bowl. Add 1 tbsp of the reserved liquid and toss gently until coated well. Transfer the mixture to a food processor and puree until smooth. Cover, and refrigerate until serving time. Serve the saioli chilled, with or without chilled cream.

Random Ingredients: rice paper,flour tortilla,sea scallop,table salt,thyme leaf,crescent,vanilla
title: Sea Scalloss
ingredients: 1 package extra large flour tortillas | 2 1/2 cups unbleached cane sugar-coated rice paper, plus more for lining the bottom of the pan | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves, minced | 2 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened vanilla | 12 large sea scallops | 2 1/2 cups unbleached can refrigerated crescent rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f. Line a heavy baking sheet with parchment paper. Dip the tortillas in the warm spritzed water for 10 seconds. Transfer the sheets to each sheet, and lay them side by side on the baking sheet. Using a fork, prick the tops of the scallops with the tines of a fork. In a bowl, combine 2 1/2 cups of the cane sugar with the salt. Heat a heavy nonstick skillet over high heat until hot but not smoking, then stir in the thyme. Remove scallops from the bowl with a slotted spoon and, with a slotted spoon, remove the scallops from the sugar syrup and put with the scallops in a large bowl. Add the vanilla to the syrup and continue with the remaining syrup. Pour about 1 1/2 cups of the syrup over the scallops, stirring until the sugar has dissolved. Lay the sea scallops on top of the sugar syrup, overlapping the slices. Spread about 1/3 cup of the scallop mixture across each scallop stack. Arrange the tortillas over and around the scallops, spreading as evenly as possible. Use plastic wrap to cover the scallops completely and set aside. Line a 9x13 baking pan with parchment paper and spread 1 1/2 cups of the crescent rolls in it. Spread the scallop mixture across the tortillas in a decorative pattern. Place the baking sheet with the scalloss on it. Lay the scalloss in the middle of the baking sheet. Sprinkle 1 1/2 cups of the remaining sugar syrup over the top. Lay the tortillas side by side with the seam side down so the tortillas are not touching each other, being careful not to overlap them too much. Bake until the scallossis are deep golden brown, 40 to 50 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and continue baking until they are crisp and golden, about 10 more minutes. Let cool slightly, then cut into slices.

Random Ingredients: red potato,red wine,tahini,beef,baking soda,shrimp paste,ranch dressing mix,lemon juice zest
title: Lemon Shrimp and Potato Biscuits for Two
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs uncooked medium red potatoes | 1 package hidden valley original ranch dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup tahini | 1 1/4 lbs ground beef | 1/3 cup lemon juice and zest of | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 12 large shrimp paste, thawed | 1/2 cup lemon juice, chopped fresh
instructions: Bake the potato until slightly crisp tender drain on paper towels. Drain the potatoes on paper towels. Preheat the oven to 325°f cut each potato into 3/4 inch slices. Combine the salad dressing mix and baking soda.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,pork,chili pepper flake,purple onion,mirin,salt,flat leaf parsley,turnip
title: Fudgy Korean Pork-Filled Turnips
ingredients: 600 g red-fleshed potatoes ( known as turnips in japanese ) | 2 teaspoons salt | 400 g turnips ( kimchee are japanese sweet potato ) | 4 tablespoons dried chili pepper flakes ( kochukaru ) | 1 tablespoon salt | 2 teaspoons sweet soy sauce | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 green onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c / 400°f. Using a mandoline or sharp knife, slice the potatoes. Scrub the turnips and remove only the hard outer layer, being careful not to peel it. Turn the potatoes in to a colander or sieve and rinse them under cold water. Cut each potato vertically along its length and score a border, about 1cm deep. Place the potatoes on a tray and sprinkle with 2 tsp of salt. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden, soft and slightly charred. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and mix them with the dried chili flakes. Spread out the potatoes in an even layer on a baking tray and bake in the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden and puffed. Remove the turnips to a wire rack. Remove all the bitter pips and set them aside. Meanwhile, cut the turnips into 1cm / 1 cm / 1/4 inch sticks. In a small bowl, combine the chilli, salt, soy sauce and spring onion. Whisk the mixture well and divide into 8 portions. Stir in the parsley and set aside. Fill the turnip sticks with the sticky ingredients and arrange them on a serving platter. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: meat,soya sauce,extra virgin olive oil,halibut fillet
title: Soya Halibut
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean meat | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 halibut fillet
instructions: Rinse fillets, pat dry and place in a shallow glass pie plate. In a small bowl, mix soya sauce with oil and pour half over fillets. Cover and marinate for 2 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator. Cook halibut on grill or in a hot oven. Flip after about 3 minutes for medium rare, or until cooked through. Transfer to warmed platter. Serve with a fresh salad and steamed rice or salad of your choice.

title: Salmon With Red Curry - Roti Canai
ingredients: 200 g red curry paste | 350 g salmon fillets ( skinless, boneless ) | 300 g asparagus | 1/4 cup teabags | 2 cups dashi stock
instructions: Cut salmon into 10 - 12 pieces. Cut asparagus into 8 - 10 pieces. Cut asparagus into 10 - 12 pieces. Heat dashi. Add curry paste. Once it boils, add asparagus. Stir, simmer until asparagus is al dente. Turn off heat. Place salmon on serving platter, pour red curry/vegetable mix over fish.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,creme de cassis,chicken bouillon granule,parmigiano reggiano cheese,saffron,oregano,dill weed
title: Pizzocollo Con Saffron (Saffron Sage Chicken)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups creme de cassis | 1 1/4 cups grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Pour the creme de cassis into a small saucepan, and place over medium low heat. Bring to the boil, and simmer until reduced to a syrup consistency, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in the parmigiano reggiano cheese, and return to low heat, making sure the cheese melts completely before adding the next step. Toast saffron in a dry skillet over medium heat, swirling the pan frequently, until the powder has turned a golden color. Combine the oregano, dill weed, and nutmeg in a small bowl, and set aside. Place the saffron mixture and the remaining ingredients into an airtight container, and store at room temperature in a cool, dark place..

title: Espresso Eggs on a Stick
ingredients: 1 lb hard-boiled egg | 3 tablespoons yoghurt | 2 teaspoons espresso | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons all purpose yoghurt
instructions: Slice the eggs into four slices and then pound in a food processor into 1/2 inch dice. Set aside. Place the yoghurt together with the nutmeg and espresso in a small bowl and mix thoroughly. Using a tablespoon, scoop approximately 2 tsp yoghurt to the edge of a piece of egg in each slice of egg then dip the egg into the yoghurt and then continue to dip into the yoghurt until each egg is covered. Set aside to drain for 30 minutes before using.

title: Gary Goulash
ingredients: 18 large lobster tail, meat from heads, shell still attached | 1 cup canned plum tomatoes with their juices, drained | 1 package corn tortillas | 2 poblano chiles, diced
instructions: Place meat in bowl. Cut off heads of lobster tails. Remove any remaining white heads from shells. Add plum tomatoes with their juices to bowl. Cut shells from corn tortillas. Remove the ribs and top and tail meat from legs. Slice meat from legs. Place the meat in a bowl. Cut corn tortillas into quarters. Place a tomato slice on top of each piece of meat and pour tomato mixture over.

title: Ouzo-Infused Ouzo Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces ouzo | 1 pinch coconut extract | 2 1/2 ounces pecorino cheese
instructions: Mix well. Add more coconut extract if preferred.

title: Italian Pork Roast With Swiss Chard
ingredients: 1 boneless pork loin roast | 13 1/2 ounces italian-style stewed tomatoes | 6 cups washed and drained swiss chard
instructions: Trim excess fat from pork and discard the excess fat. Place the pork roast in a large heavy roasting pan and add the tomato stew base ingredients. Stir just to combine. Cover and refrigerate for 12 hours. Remove from refrigerator, uncover, and set aside for approximately one hour to allow flavors to meld. Remove the roast from the pan, and place on a platter lined with cheesecloth. Discard any visible fat. Use a slotted spoon to skim off any accumulated juices and accumulated juices. Slice italian style pork like you would regular french bread loaf, and place in serving dish. Surround with sliced swiss chard.

Random Ingredients: ice,chili sauce,graham cracker crumb,chili garlic sauce
title: Korean Pizza Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup chili sauce, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon ice, or as needed
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, chili garlic sauce, chili sauce, and ice together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,peanut butter,lime wedge,salt,cream cheese,beef stew meat,vegetable oil,english cucumber
title: Mexican Beef Spaghetti With Peanut Nuts
ingredients: 3 ounces spaghetti, broken into 2-inch pieces ( about 1 lb ) | 1/2 cup crunchy peanut butter | 1 package cream cheese, 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 english cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced crosswise ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup vegetable oil, heated to 360° f | salt | 12 -16 lime wedges
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Meanwhile, in bowl, mix peanut butter and cream cheese. Divide mixture among 12 serving plates. Arrange cucumber quarters in a overlapping pattern on top of cream cheese mixture. In deep skillet, heat oil. When hot, add spaghetti and stir fry until golden brown, about 1 1/2 minutes. Sprinkle noodles with salt.

title: Mustard Dip
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups beef stock | 1 1/2 cups dijon-style mustard
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan. Heat to boiling and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. You may want to adjust the consistency to thicken, if not, remove from heat. Serve warm with roasted potatoes.

title: Cranberry and Yellow Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 package yellow bell peppers, sliced | 1 jar sweetened cranberries, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Arrange half of the bell pepper slices in the bottom of a casserole dish. Arrange remaining bell peppers on top. Pour cranberries over the peppers. Cover dish, and bake in preheated oven for 90 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tomatillo,garlic,serrano pepper,flour,sandwich bread,sharp canadian cheddar cheese,bean sprout,chicken bouillon cube
title: Mexican Bread Cheese Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces sandwich bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 ounces refried beans with tomatillos | 1 -2 chicken bouillon cube | 2 bunches fresh tomatillos, husked and rinsed | 4 cloves garlic | 2 serrano peppers, halved and seeded | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp canadian cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Place bread in large bowl of cold water just to moisten. Drain, then pat dry with paper towels. Set aside. Over medium heat, heat broiler on high. Combine bouillon cube, tomatillos, garlic, peppers and tomatillos in small bowl and refrigerate. Mash garlic and tomatillos with a fork. Transfer tomatillo mixture to bowl with garlic salt mixture. Add cheese and flour and mix well. Add bread and stir well. Turn mixture into pie dish. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, or until golden.

title: Whole Wheat French Toast - Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: 1 large whole wheat flour tortillas or 1 large burrito-sized burrito-sized flour tortilla | sugar syrup or honey
instructions: Spread sugar and spread liberally over the top of the tortillas and sprinkle liberally with desired amount of sugar syrup. Grill in a covered grill pan, or skillet until crispy on the outside. Turn once during grilling. Serve hot. Variation, serve on the side of a hot green salad with sugar syrup or sweetened pineapple jam. This is excellent with cream cheese, whipped cream and fresh fruit such as kiwi applesauce. If you do not like raisin topping, use honey to drizzle over the warm french toast.

title: Courgette Marsala
ingredients: 1 large courgette, cut into thick wheels | 3 ounces chocolate syrup | 2 ounces sweet marsala wine | 1 tablespoon corn
instructions: First, mix all the ingredients together. Dress with sliced red onion. Serve with a fresh veg salad.

title: Zesty  Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 green pepper, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1/2 orange, zest of, 3 inches long, cut into thin strips | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Bring all ingredients to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, making sure to keep stirring.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,tomato paste,rice noodle,cremini mushroom,chickpea flour,orange zest,guacamole
title: Wild Rice Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package dried rice stick noodles | 1 can condensed chickpea flour | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 cups halved cremini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Place noodles in a large bowl of very cold water. Stir until coated. Drain. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a small bowl mix together the chickpea flour and tomato paste until smooth. Spread a small amount of the chickpea mixture onto the prepared baking sheet. Lay mushrooms on top of the flour mixture. Sprinkle on the orange zest. Bake in the preheated oven until the mushrooms are soft, about 10 minutes. Spread pesto evenly over mushrooms and continue baking until the cheese is melted, then sprinkle with guacamole.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,tomato puree,beef stock chicken,topping,cayenne powder,vegetable stock,quinoa
title: Beef and Quinoa Stew for One!
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef, cubed | 2 tablespoons quinoa | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock, heated | 1 can beef stock or 1 can chicken stock | 1 can tomato puree | 1 pinch cayenne powder | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1/4 cup quinoa, toasted and drained
instructions: In a large bowl, toss beef with quinoa and pour enough stock to just cover. Let beef stand at room temperature for 30 minutes, then drain any excess liquid. Discard any remaining liquid. Transfer quinoa to a large pan, and add remaining stock and cook over medium heat until reduced by 1 1/2. Stir in tomato puree, cayenne, and beef. Continue to heat and stir until heated through. Top thawed whipped topping with sesame seeds, if desired. Serve beef mixture over toasted sesame seeds.

title: Spinach Pakoda
ingredients: 500 g dry chickpea flour | 2 teaspoons cardamom pods, crushed | 1 kg fresh spinach, washed and roughly chopped | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Put the chickpea flour in a large bowl and mix in the cardamom pods. Add the spinach and mix through the lentil and chickpea flour. Add enough of your yogurt to make a firm dough. Turn onto a floured surface, knead for 7 - 8 minutes or until it is firm and elastic. Divide into 8 equal portions and use your hands to press flat pieces between the palms of your hands. You want them to be about twice the diameter. Cover and leave to rest for 10 minutes before rolling out. To cook, heat the grill to high and cook the pakora for 4 - 5 minutes on each side, until browned if desired. Allow to stand for 2 - 3 minutes before eating as main course.

title: Chocolate-Pea Salad
ingredients: 200 g frozen peas | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 200 g dark chocolate - 70 % milk chocolate, chopped
instructions: Place peas in a saucepan with water, bring to boil and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until peas are just cooked but still crisp. Drain, and set aside. Combine mayonnaise and chili paste in a bowl, mix well. Chop chocolate and add to mixture. Add to the peas and stir until well combined.

title: Vegan Croagy Hoagies
ingredients: 16 ounces eggplants | 4 teaspoons gluten | 10 slices steaks | 4 tablespoons gulden's gluten | 4 tablespoons hoagie | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Cut the eggplant into thin slices 3/4 inch thick. Boil them in a large pot of water with 2 teaspoons of gilden’s gluten until they have a brown look and feel, about 15 minutes. Drain and cool. Dry the slices on paper towels. Cut them into small chunks. Place the eggplant in a large bowl, and toss with the 3 t of gluten. Heat wok and add 3 tablespoon of peanut oil and 2 t of hoagie oil, over high heat. When the oil is almost smoking, add 2 slices of the fried eggplant to the wok, and fry until lightly browned about 1 minute. Remove the eggplant and put it in the fridge. Add the remaining oil to the wok and put another couple of slices of eggplant in it. Turn down heat after the eggplant is in the wok. Stir every so often so it doesn't stick. When the last slice of eggplant is done, place it on a plate. Sprinkle with the remaining gluten. Add 3 t hoagie oil and heat just a little, then add the rest of the eggplant, and the fried eggplant. Stir to coat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sugar,sun tomato,yellow bell pepper,chocolate,rock salt,white wine vinegar,amarula cream liqueur
title: Chocolate Amarula Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, finely chopped | 1/4 cup amarula cream liqueur | 1/4 cup sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons rock salt ( or a bit more, to taste ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chocolate, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: If serving immediately, place the vinegar in a small bowl. Add the tomato, tomato and onion mixture. Add the amarula cream liqueur and sugar and mix well. If you're serving immediately, add the chocolate after the mixture has cooled. If making ahead, put the mixture in sterilized jars or freezer containers, cover and chill. Variation, if the amarula cream is a bit thick, mix with a bit of water.

Random Ingredients: beef rib,black sesame seed,spice,ice,plain yogurt,tarragon,sage,chicken bouillon cube
title: Sage Gravy for Steaming (Or Meat Filling)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef short ribs ( or combination ) | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds | 6 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f grind the black sesame seeds in a food processor with a pinch of salt and the yogurt. Combine the ground sesame seeds, the spice mixture, sage, tarragon, bouillon cube and mixed spice. Rub the marinade over the short ribs. Bring a large quantity of salted water to the boil. Add the short ribs and braise on a rack just big enough to hold them. When cooked, the meat should be soft and tender. Serve accompanied with steamed vegetables and steamed potatoes.

title: Pasta and Cheese
ingredients: 500 g rigatoni pasta | 2 tablespoons porridge oats | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 1/2 cups milk | 500 g gouda cheese, cut into strips | bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200º celsius. Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil. Add the rigatoni and cook for 5 – 7 minutes, or until tender. Drain well and tip into a large serving bowl. Sprinkle over the oats, sugar and milk. Mix until well coated. Transfer to a baking tray. Cut the cheese into strips and toss with the rigatoni. Place in the oven, uncovered, for 30 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: banana,extra virgin olive oil,mint leaf,grand marnier,pineapple chunk,rye bread
title: Grandma's Hammer
ingredients: 4 bananas | 7 ounces pineapple chunks, drained ( reserve syrup ) | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 6 mint leaves | 6 slices rye bread | 1/3 ounce grand marnier or 1/3 ounce other liqueur
instructions: Put the bananas, pineapple, 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, mint leaves, and remaining olive oil in a blender. Blend until smooth, adding more olive oil if necessary to give a thin consistency. If needed, add more reserved syrup. Split the rye bread slices on the diagonal and lightly toast on each side. Drizzle the grand marnier over the top. Using a sharp knife slice the bananas into rings. Place the rings on top of the toast and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw dressing,morningstar farm veggie bacon strip,cashew,red cabbage,green mango
title: Vegetarian Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 head red cabbage, finely shredded | 3 green mangoes, sliced into 1/4 inch slices and chopped | 1 cup shredded coleslaw dressing ( low fat is fine ) | 2 morningstar farms veggie bacon strips, cooked per pkg directions | 4 1/2 cups packaged coleslaw dressing ( low fat is fine ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped cashews ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and toss well with your cabbage. Chill in your fridge for at least an hour before serving. Serve with your favourite grain/oriental flavor bbq dishes.

title: Chocolate Covered Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, divided | 12 large baby cremini mushrooms | 6 tablespoons mini chocolate chips, divided
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Place 1 mushroom in skillet and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of the chocolate chips. When the chocolate is melted, place the skillet on a double layer of paper towels or wax paper and set aside and keep warm. Repeat until all 15 mushrooms have been shaved away until the skillet is full and all 15 mushrooms are shaved away. Repeat with the remaining 2 tablespoons of the butter and melt the remaining 6 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Stir the melted butter into the melted butter. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon each of remaining melted chocolate chips and salt and pepper to taste. Cover and keep warm until ready to serve.

title: Mexican Lasagna (Hogao)
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fresh lasagna noodles | 3 cans stewed tomatoes and green chilies ( muir glen brand ) | 2 tablespoons smoked paprika | 4 large scallions, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Put noodles in boiling water, simmer 5 minutes. Drain. Spread open all of the cans. Put one layer of noodles on a large baking pan. Top noodles with remaining ingredients, pour on 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce. Cover pan with foil, bake for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh fillet,rosemary sprig,brown sugar,worcestershire sauce,kernel corn,pepperoni,shallot
title: Pepperonch Chicken
ingredients: 500 g chicken thigh fillets | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon spring onion or 1 tablespoon chives, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped pickled pepperoni | 10 fresh basil leaves | 1 rosemary sprig
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut 2 diagonal slices from the long side of each chicken thigh. Cut the thin slice around the chicken from the bone, through the bone at the joint. Combine the worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, spring onion, pepperoni, basil and the remaining spice mixture in a large bowl or ziploc bag. Add the chicken and turn to coat. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Remove the chicken and discard the marinade. Use cooking paper to dry the chicken from the bag and thread onto skewers. Cook on a bbq or under the coals of your gas or on the grill until well coloured and cooked through, turning regularly, about 10 - 15 minutes. Alternatively, cook in a moderate oven for 20 - 25 minutes. Serve sprinkled with the onion, pepper and basil.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,cornflour,beef bouillon cube,black olive,crust,vegetable chicken stock,phyllo pastry,sugar
title: Vegetable Beef Samosas
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable, frozen, thawed if frozen | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 16 ounces ground beef | 1/4 cup chopped black olives | 20 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Place frozen vegetables in a saucepan with water to cover and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain vegetables, reserving liquid. Scoop out flesh and set aside. Mixture will be lumpy. Place bouillon cubes in a small bowl. Place cornflour in a bowl and gradually add about 1/4 cup of the liquid. Stir constancyly over lowest heat for 2 minutes. Add sugar and continue cooking and stirring for 1 minute longer. Add water/broth mixture as needed to obtain desired consistency. Stir in tomato paste and chopped olives. Set aside. Brush four sheets filo with vegetable spray, cut to size of a US round. Cover with another four sheets of filo. Cut the stack into four squares.

title: Homemade Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 container mascarpone cheese | 2 drops red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: In small mixing bowl, with a wire whisk, blend 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese, 1 tablespoon red food coloring, and 1/2 cup confectioner's sugar until smooth.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,red capsicum,vegetable broth,guinness stout,apricot preserve,white chocolate chip,fettuccine pasta
title: Guinness Fettuccine
ingredients: 250 g dry fettuccine pasta | 250 ml guinness stout, divided | 1 red capsicum, diced | 3/4 cup vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 150 g dry white chocolate chips | 35 g apricot preserves
instructions: Cook pasta in large saucepan of boiling water for 10 minutes or according to packet directions. Drain pasta and set aside to cool. Place ½ of guinness in a small bowl. Add capsicum, remaining guinness and remaining broth. Stir to combine and pour over pasta and toss to coat. Set aside. Combine grand marnier and chocolate chips, reserve in small bowl. Drain pasta and return to pan. Pour sauce, reserved cheese mixture and apricot preserves over pasta and toss well to combine. Serve.

title: French Fried Bread
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 2 garlic cloves
instructions: Slice the garlic cloves into slices about 1 inch thick. Heat up up your large frying pan, until just starting to smoke, and grease your pan with a bit of olive oil. Once heated, dip your bread the whole thing. Sprinkle with a little more olive oil if desired. Fry until golden brown on both sides. This is best done at about one minute. Dip in your favorite jarred salad dressing, and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,orzo pasta,vanilla pudding mix,lemon juice,vidalia onion,beef brisket,strawberry
title: Beef Brisket and Orzo
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with juice | 1/4 cup v 8 vegetable juice | 1 package dry instant vanilla pudding mix, prepared according to package directions | 1 cup orzo pasta | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice | 4 medium vidalia onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Place brisket in a 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker. In a medium bowl, combine tomatoes, v 8 juice, pudding mix, pasta, and lemon juice. Cover and cook on high setting 3 to 4 hours. Transfer brisket to a platter and refrigerate any leftover sauce. Serve with remaining sauce. Garnish with sliced onions.

title: Red Wine Salad
ingredients: 1 red wine ( can sub water ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce | crushed iceberg lettuce ( or another type of lettuce )
instructions: Line a large platter with the lettuce leaves, then pour enough red wine over to cover. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours before serving. Before eating sprinkle on crushed iceberg lettuce just before serving. Yum enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coffee,single cream,herb,mace,pearl barley,cold water,green pea,fine sea salt
title: Polish Pearl Barley Cream (Kvas Jucha)
ingredients: 200 g pearl barley | 6 1/2 tablespoons strong coffee | 4 tablespoons mixed herbs, such as dill, sage, parsley, rosemary or 4 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs, such as fennel, dill and mint | 2 1/4 teaspoons fine sea salt | 1 whole mace, seeds separated | 100 g green peas, such as arugula | 100 ml single cream ( if you don't have any, use egg white )
instructions: Soak the pearl barley in 5 cups cold water for two hours in a large container of boiling water.. Drain the pearl barley and rinse well. Place into a large noncorrosive pan and add the strong coffee, stir until dissolved. Add the mixed herbs or herbs of choice. The grains of herbs should not be mixed too smoothly because they may not have absorbed the liquid. Sprinkle the mace around the top of the barley barley mixture. Add salt to the liquid. Turn the heat on high and bring the liquid to the boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until a creamy porridge develops on the bottom. Do not over simmer or it will become tough and unpleasant. Turn off the heat and stir in the peas and a little water if needed. Stir gently and ladle into warmed bowls or ramekins. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,hot paprika,ginger garlic paste,ha avocado,pork rib,sage,fettuccine,seasoning salt
title: Fettuccine With Avocado, Goat Cheese, and Ginger
ingredients: 3 fresh goat cheese, about 1 1/2 pounds | 1 large hass avocado, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons kosher salt, plus more as desired | 6 cups hot cooked fettuccine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage
instructions: In a small bowl, mash together goat cheese with a fork until smooth. Add avocado, ginger garlic paste, paprika, salt, and 1 teaspoon seasoning. Toss to combine. Cover and chill the pasta while preparing the sauce. Toss pasta with remaining teaspoon seasoning salt. Transfer to a serving platter and scatter with sage.

title: Sweet Mango Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 mangoes | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | chili oil
instructions: Slice the mangoes in rounds on the diagonal leaving thick pieces as you go. Put the sugar in a small bowl and drizzle around the mango slices. Dip in the oil and sprinkle the top lightly. Serve immediately.

title: A+ Cinnamon Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon seedless raisins | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 lb seedless grapefruit, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In large skillet, toast the fenugreek seeds and the remaining seeds over medium heat for 4 minutes, or until browned. Transfer to small bowl and set aside. Coat baking dish with cooking spray. Cut each breast lengthwise into 8 pieces, then crosswise into 1/2 strips. Arrange on baking sheet, and sprinkle each with the raisins and fenugreek and cinnamon. Bake for 15 minutes in oven, or until just cooked through. Meanwhile, remove grapefruit from the peel and reserve juice. Slice grapefruit in half lengthwise and then crosswise. Scoop out and discard seeds. Reserve juice. Slice remaining grapefruit sections into 3 sections lengthwise, then cut each section in 1/2, discarding seeds. Arrange grapefruit sections around chicken, arranging skin side down. Spoon strained juice mixture evenly over chicken. Serve chicken on platter with grapefruit sections around edges.

Random Ingredients: harissa,garlic,fennel seed,green chili pepper,okra,tart apple,thyme leave,asafoetida powder
title: Okra in Tepid (Fennel-Apple) Sauce
ingredients: 1 package okra, ends trimmed, ends trimmed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 3 tablespoons tepid green chili pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon harissa ( see note ) | 6 -8 cloves garlic, peeled & halved | 2 tablespoons tart apples, coarsely chopped | 1 pinch asafoetida ( see note )
instructions: Note 1, for less spice, use more green chili. Note 2, for medium to dark okra cook in hot water along with thyme, fennel and cumin.
