Drain well & put them in a food processor or blender along with the green chiles, harissa, garlic, apples, and the asafetida. Blend for a few seconds or until it's the desired consistency. Makes about 1 3/4 cups sauce for a side dish & would recommend serving with bread.

title: Blackened Limeade
ingredients: 1 lime | 1 cup fresh cherries
instructions: Cut the juice from the lime into thin slices, squeeze out the white pith with a teaspoon, and cut the rind into strips. In a tall glass or hurricane mary mix lime juice with lime rind. Fill to the top with ice cubes. Garnish by sprinkling a lime slice or two atop. Serve with crushed ice.

title: Auberge Cinnamon Roll
ingredients: 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons powdered espresso coffee | 1/2 cup flour, sifted | orange sherbet ( to serve ) or chocolate shavings ( to serve )
instructions: Combine icing sugar and espresso, then mix in flour and knead lightly until all ingredients are incorporated. Wrap in plastic. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Turn onto a lightly floured board. Roll to 1/2 inch thickness and cut into 3 inch rounds. Wet fingers lightly with cold water then press 1/2 tbls vanilla or strawberry filling or jam on each round. Top with more icing sugar if desired. Cut into 2 inch squares.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,chili paste,ha avocadoes,tripe,chili bean,cayenne,peanut oil
title: Grilled Tripe
ingredients: one ha avocadoes ( or a combo of bananas, and pineapple ) or one peach ( or a combo of bananas, and pineapple ) | one roasted whole-grain tripe ( or a combo of bananas, and pineapple ) | cooking oats | peanut oil | cayenne | chili paste | chili beans
instructions: The final taste. I like my semi ripe Hass avocadoes so it doesn't lose shape. Cut the whole thing in half. Remove the flesh, and slice the flesh into 1/4 inch chunks. Heat up the grill. Brush a cast iron, or other non stick pan with peanut oil, and put the tripe in to brush. Sprinkle the hoisin sauce. Place the pan on a cooler fire, or open a window. Let it smoke about 10 minutes until the tripe has a char, and flakes easily with a fork. Remove from the grill. You can place the tripe on the grill with the char, or turn on the burner and grill until the flesh has a glaze like consistency.. Taste. Add any sauces you have, or chilli paste to your liking. Top with some chopped chili beans. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,spinach leaf,turnip,rigatoni pasta,shrimp,corn,dark sesame oil,sirloin
title: Seafood Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 lb sirloin, cleaned and cubed | 1 teaspoon corn | 1/4 cup chopped fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup dark sesame oil | 1 package rigatoni pasta or ( 10 ounce ) package rotini pasta | 1 cup frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1 teaspoon ground flaxseed
instructions: Cook the shrimp and sirloin. Stir in corn. Cook pasta according to package directions. Add 1/4 cup of the sesame oil to a large skillet. Stir in the shrimp and sirloin. Season with pepper. Add the spinach and cook 1 minute longer. Stir in the shrimp mixture and cook until spinach is wilted, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in the shrimp and sesame oil. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with flaxseed. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta With Chile, Avocado and Peanuts
ingredients: 150 g linguine | 150 g baby carrots | 100 g black grapes | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/3 of your fresh habanero or 1/3 a jalapeno pepper, minced roughly | 1 tablespoon fresh epazote
instructions: Cut the grape from the head down to the point where you scrap out the seeds. If the seeds are left for other ingredients, remove as much stem. Cut the carrot lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices on the angle. Cut them in half if thinner, or cut each half into 1-inch chunks. Heat the oil and a jalapeno in a pan over medium heat. Add the carrot and grapes. Cook a couple of minutes, stirring constantly, until the grapes start to turn slightly translucent. Then add the epazote and cook another couple of minutes. Add the linguine and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring now and then. Stir in the peanuts, and taste. Add more salt as needed. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,orange peel,snow pea,veal,red wine vinegar,toothpick,cider vinegar,chicken liver
title: Marinated Chicken Livers
ingredients: 1 lb chicken liver | 2 small whole blood oranges ( peel of half a citrus, one will be white ) | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup cider vinegar ( or white or half-and-half ) | 1/4 cup vanilla sugar | 1/2 lb ground veal | toothpick | 3 -4 tablespoons chopped fresh red pepermansa pods ( or snow pea pods or snow pea pods with stems )
instructions: Place the fresh blood orange in a large bowl, cover and put aside. Add vinegar and sugar, stirring briskly with a fork, until sugar is dissolved. Combine with the strained blood orange blood. Add the meat and marinate meat for 1 hour. Wash and dry lemons, pith, and seeds thoroughly. Cut crosswise into very thin strips. Put the meat, the seeds and marinade in a plastic bag and add enough meat to bag to marinate. Refrigerate the following day, turning the bag every day, until the meat is firm enough to roll. This can take more or less time. Keep the meat refrigerated covered with some heavy plastic wrap or foil. Remove the meat from the bag. With a small scoop, add the meat, citrus peel, and vinegar to the bowl of meat. Mix thoroughly. Dont add any pepermans or snow peas yet. Place meat into a bowl. Add crushed pine nuts or snow peas. Mix completely. If using a hand grinder, mix with a fork until finely ground. Return the meat mixture to the bowl, cover, and refrigerate for up to 1 week. Serve cold with crusty bread or crackers.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,orange juice zest,pistachio,brie cheese,mozzarella cheese,corn flake,italian breadcrumb,seasoning
title: Brie and Pistachio Pizza
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated pizza crust sheets | 2 packages thinly sliced brie cheese | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup toasted chopped pistachios | 1 large orange, juice and zest of | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon corn flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. On ungreased pizza pan arrange dough in a 5 inch circle. Distribute brie over dough leaving a 1 inch crust around edge. Evenly distribute mozzarella and mozzarella over brie. Sprinkle italian bread crumbs over cheese and herbs. Top with orange zest, juice and zest. Sprinkle pistachios over mozzarella. Bake at 425° for 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: mayonnaise,malt vinegar,italian breadcrumb,garam masala powder,cheddar cheese,peanut butter,ham,beef chuck
title: Protein Slam-Jam
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons finely chopped peanuts or 2 tablespoons peanuts, crushed
instructions: Using a blender blend the marinade ingredients until well mixed. Crumble mixture into a bowl, stirring until well combined. Shape into a log and arrange on a waxed paper lined broiler pan. Broil 12 - 15 minutes or until tops begin to turn golden brown and crackle. Remove from grill and allow to cool slightly. Slice into 1/4 inch slices, then place on a serving dish. Top with remaining cheese. Heat oven to 350°f in a bowl combine, mayonnaise and peanuts. Spread onto meat and top with cheese. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until cheese is slightly melted around the edges.

title: Chipotle Grated Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 7 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon chipotle powder
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or spice grinder, process the cheese and herbs until completely smooth. If the pestle is a little too dry, add a touch of water. Transfer to a small bowl and refrigerate before serving. The grated parmesan cheese should be at room temperature. Note, if you have refrigerated, remove the bread from the refrigerator a short burst while grilling, this will help the cheeses loosen and bind. If you don't have it on hand, you can use the same bread machine instructions except that the bread is crumbly and not oiled.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,lite olive oil,xanthan gum,flat leaf parsley,canadian bacon,celery leaf,lettuce,bread crumb
title: Canadian Bacon and Cheese Stuffed Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 12 stalks celery leaves | 6 slices canadian bacon, minced | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and minced | 3 tablespoons lite olive oil | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1/4 cup bread crumbs | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup lettuce | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Brush a baking sheet with oil. Cut a slit lengthwise down each end of celery leaves. Fill each pepper with about 1 teaspoons of minced bacon, then sprinkle with 1 teaspoon grated cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese has melted and the bacon is browned. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the parsley, bread crumbs, 1/4 cup parsley, and the celery leaves. Combine the lettuce, lettuce, and xanthan gum in a bowl. Pour dressing over the stuffing in the peppers until well stuffed. Cover, and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.

title: Mandarin Popcorn
ingredients: 1 package frozen mandarin orange, thawed | 2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Combine the mandarin oranges, the corn syrup, and sour cream in a bowl, tossing to coat well. Cover, and chill 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Quick Cauliflower Cakes
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, trimmed and broken into florets | 2 large eggs, lightly beaten and divided | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup egg substitute | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg, grated | 1 cup dry vermicelli ( can use other short noodles ) | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 3 tablespoons chutney
instructions: Cook cauliflower in boiling, salted water for 3 minutes or until tender. Drain and cool completely. Meanwhile, combine 1 egg and mustard powder in a large bowl, and stir well with a fork. Add cauliflower and remaining egg, mix well. Shape into patties. Dip patties into egg then into vermicelli and place on cooking oiled cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 5 minutes or until golden. Combine tomato puree and chutney. Spoon over patties and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: flour,maraschino juice,cream chicken soup,kalamata olive,flat leaf parsley,parsley flake,balsamic vinegar,hard egg
title: French Garlic
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried flat leaf parsley flakes | 1 teaspoon dried parsely flakes | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted, chopped fine ( i prefer extra ripe olive ) | 1/2 cup shredded fresh parmesan cheese or 1/2 cup romano cheese | 1 hard-boiled egg | 1 -2 tablespoon dried maraschino juice
instructions: Heat soup, vinegar, parsely, parsley flakes and olives in a microwave safe bowl on medium to high heat for 1 min, stirring after 2 min. Stir in cheese until melted and heated throughly. Crack egg into a small bowl and mash lightly. Stir egg and sauce mixture in warmed soup and gently stir until combined.

title: Quick Preserved Lemon
ingredients: 1 bottle frozen lemonade | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Combine lemonade and cilantro in a large resealable plastic bag. Close and shake to mix, removing any residue of lemonade from bag. Arrange about 1 teaspoon of lemonade mixture in the center of a piece of waxed paper. Wrap up the waxed paper, enclosing the fruit evenly. Transfer to the freezer to thaw for 1 hour. Slice preserved lemon into rounds using the round tip of a meat mallet. Gently toss sliced lemon rounds onto a platter with reserved cilantro to serve.

Random Ingredients: rice,vanilla pudding,white pepper,self rising flour,italian dressing,dark brown sugar,cooking spray
title: Italian Fried Rice (Cooking Light)
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 1 1/2 cups self rising flour ( not self rising flour ) or 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour ( not self rising flour ) | cooking spray | 1/3 cup sweet white pepper ( such as white pepper ) | cooking spray | 1 box italian dressing | 1 package instant vanilla pudding | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions, but add pepper during last 5 minutes of cook time. Spray a 12 inch nonstick cooking pan with cooking oil. Toss rice in pan. Sprinkle rice with pepper. Pour dressing in an even layer on top of everything. Mix well, and cook on middle rack of a preheated 400°f oven for 15 minutes. Turn over, and cook for 15 minutes more. Sprinkle pudding evenly over all. Cook until pudding is bubbly on top. Top with brown sugar and serve.

title: Tofu With Hot Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 tofu | 1/2 tablespoon margarine | 1 1/2 tablespoons olive | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Cut tofu in half, then cut each half in half again, so that it looks like a regular block. Cut block into cubes of equal length until the width remains a bit wider than desired. Heat margarine in a saucepan and brown tofu pieces all over. Once tofu is nicely browned, stir in chili garlic sauce and simmer for 1 minute. Serve warm, or cool, and cover to keep warm.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,onion powder,white cheddar cheese,hamburger bun
title: Papa Bear's Creamed Gouda
ingredients: 4 hamburger buns | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon minced onions or 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 cup shredded white cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Open the hamburger rolls and make several slits along the top. In a small bowl, combine cream and minced onion and mix together. Sprinkle the crumb mixture onto the top of the hamburger rolls. Place in preheated oven, then the cheese. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes, or until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Simple Gruyère Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon mild mustard | lemon peel, cut into 1-inch squares | 2 tablespoons hot sauce
instructions: Combine the gruyère and oil in a bowl and sprinkle on mustard. Mix all three well, then add the lemon peel. Toss well and add hot sauce. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours.

title: Rhubarb and Tuna Wraps
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 250 g chicken livers, trimmed and finely chopped | 2 small hot dogs, finely sliced | 6 tablespoons buttermilk ( for diabetics use skim milk or low-fat buttermilk ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 400 g low-fat tuna or 400 g regular light firm fish, steamed | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 cup fresh rhubarb, cut into 6 | 16 soft tortillas, to serve
instructions: For the dip, heat the oil in a large frying pan over moderate heat. Add the chicken livers to the pan and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes, or until browned. Transfer to a large bowl and add the hotdogs and buttermilk and stir to combine. Add the sugar and stir to combine. For the fish, heat the oil in a second frying pan over high heat. Add the fish and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until crisp. Transfer to an ovenproof serving plate and keep warm. Season the fish with salt and pepper and divide the dip between four tortillas. Spoon over the fish. Drizzle with the remaining 2 tablespoons asian buttermilk and serve. To serve, serve each tortilla with a rhubarb stem and serve with the warm dip.

Random Ingredients: tahini,green chili pepper,vanilla bean,pumpkin pie spice,tortilla,spinach leaf,cilantro leaf,butter
title: Spinach Wraps (Vegetarian Version)
ingredients: 3 cups fresh spinach leaves ( 154 g ) | 2 tablespoons tahini | 4 ounces fresh lemon juice ( from 2 lemons ) | 4 teaspoons vanilla bean ( scraped ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice ( optional ) | 6 soft tortillas | 1 large green chili pepper, finely chopped ( to garnish )
instructions: Place spinach and remaining ingredients in a large bowl, and sprinkle with a little salt. Let sit on countertop for 15 to 30 minutes. Stir once or twice to mix. Divide the mixture evenly between the tortillas. Wrap each in the tortillas and place on serving plates. Serve with salsa.

title: Quick Chilli Paste
ingredients: 4 red chilies, deseeded and chopped | 1/3 cup cooking oil | 3/4 cup oil for deep frying
instructions: Combine chillies and 2 tbsp of the oil in a heat proof bowl. Cover and leave 30 minutes. Heat remaining oil in a pan. Stir fry the chilies, chillies mixture over a low heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until aromatic. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the paste. Use a slotted spoon. Allow to cool, then use in another paste or use right away.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,pepper,cooking apple,red curry paste,coriander seed,extra virgin olive oil
title: Easy Spiced Red Curry Onions
ingredients: 6 cooking apples ( we like granny smith apples ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste ( to taste ) | coriander seed | pepper | cinnamon
instructions: Peel, core and slice the apples into thin slices. Sauté in olive oil with the curry paste and coriander. Once the oil turns red add the apple slices and continue to cook the mixture. Once the apples are cooked, serve over steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,apple juice,jalapeno pepper,sea salt pepper,pigeon pea,fennel seed
title: Cheater Pea Puds With Fennel
ingredients: 1 cup dried pigeon peas | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 1 tablespoon coriander seeds or 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 3/4 teaspoons dried fennel seeds | 1 teaspoon sea salt and pepper | 4 tablespoons pure apple juice
instructions: In a small pan add water and beans and bring to a boil. Cook beans until tender. About 5 minutes depending on your altitude. Drain beans, discarding liquid and return to pan. In a small skillet cook fennel, coriander and fennel seeds until fennel darkens and carmelizes. This may take another 10 minutes. Remove from heat and grind. Add to bean mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Add apple juice, heat through. Serve over noodles. Note, you can make the dumplings ahead and bake at 450 for 20 minutes.

title: Pasta With Chicken and Lemon
ingredients: 9 tablespoons cornstarch | 7 -8 cups cooked pasta | 3/4 cup chicken bouillon, made with 1 tbsp chicken bouillon | 1 lemon pepper
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients. Drain pasta well, return sauce mix and pasta to pot with other ingredients. Mix well and simmer over low heat until pasta is tender crisp.

title: Pasta With Egg Yolks and Farfalle
ingredients: 1/2 lb farfalle pasta, cooked al dente | 1 egg yolk | 2 tablespoons lard
instructions: Strain pasta, reserve 1/2 cup of the cooking water and bring the pasta to a boil add 1/2 cup liquid. Cook 1 more minute add the egg yolk, cook 2 minutes remove from the heat mix in the lard. Pour into a warm pasta bowl cover with sauce and serve.

title: French Bread
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1/4 cup garlic flavored olive oil | 3 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in the large bowl of a stand mixer with a dough hook. Add 1/4 cup of the flour and beat on low speed of mixer. Add 3 cups of the flour and beat on high speed 8 - 10 minutes or until dough is well mixed. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Cut in two or three pieces. Form each piece into a 5 inch long baguette. Arrange on a lightly greased baking sheet and keep in a warm spot. Let rise about 1 hour, or until doubled. Brush with remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons of the olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Let rise 1 hour before baking.

title: Red Wine Reduction
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine, preferably a cabernet sauvignon-infused | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup dry red wine, such as marsala
instructions: Puree 1/2 cup red wine, 1/4 cup dark rum, and 1/2 cup dry red wine in batches in batches in a blender or food processor until the wine is reduced to a glaze.

title: Homemade Borracho
ingredients: 14 lbs raw country-style spareribs, cut into 6 to 8 to 8 inch pieces | 1 gallon mexican beer | 24 ounces molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. In the winter, add spareribs to the beer and molasses and leave overnight. Place spareribs in a dutch oven and bring to boil with the beer and molasses. Bake for 2 hours, basting twice more and adding more beer while baking.

title: Spicy Pepperoncini Scones
ingredients: 500 g self raising flour | 2 tablespoons ground pepperoncini peppers | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons fresh coriander or 2 teaspoons dried coriander, chopped | 1/2 cup pickled jalapeno peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon ground peppercorn | 1/2 tablespoon ground cumin | 1/2 cup fresh pepperoncini pepper, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c. Sift flour and cumin into bowl. Combine all ingredients, using 3 tbs to measure in the amount of pepperoncini sauce you are using. Knead mixture until its smooth and manageable. Turn dough onto floured surface and knead for 5 minutes or so. Place lightly greased, floured baking sheet onto baking sheet which has been covered with non stick aluminium foil. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and brush with a little more olive oil before moving it to a cooling rack or baking tray. Allow the scones to cool and then put into an air sealed container for about 3 hours so they can get a little dry. Serve with pickled chillies or pita bread.

title: Chinese Meat Turnovers
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 1 lb ground veal | 1 lb ground chuck or 1 lb ground pork | 1 egg roll wraps, thawed if frozen | 1/4 cup tamari | 2 -3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/4 cup instant coffee ( optional ) | 1/4 cup tamari | 1/4 cup sesame oil
instructions: Place the first seven ingredients together. Then roll about 2 tablespoons of the meat mixture into a 1 inch ball. Then dip the balls in the egg to coat, then lay them in a 9 x 13 shallow baking dish, seam side down. Cover with dampened coffee. Bake at 300 degrees for 1 hour. While meat is baking, make masago.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,grain white rice,swiss cheese,water chestnut,black cardamom pod,herb,catsup,cake flour
title: Quick and Easy Spanish Rice With Beans
ingredients: 2 cups pinto beans, rinsed and drained ( or beans of your choice ) | 4 cups water | 2 ounces ham or 2 ounces pork, diced | 4 slices swiss cheese ( or other cheese of choice ) | 8 black cardamom pods | 1/8 cup catsup ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs | 1 tablespoon cake flour
instructions: In a large pot, over high heat, dump in beans, water and ham. Add spices, cover, lower heat and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes or until most of the liquid is evaporated and the rice is cooked. You are looking for the liquid to be a very thick consistency, that is not watery. While the beans are cooking, preheat oven to 375 f or 160 degrees celsius if using a fan oven. Roll out the 1 inch thick bread cubes or round cake to fit the bottom of your ovenproof dish. If using a fan oven or ovenproof dish, line the bottom and sides of the dish with the bread. Spread the rice evenly over the bread. Top with the 2 slices of swiss. Spread the top bread cube over the swiss, and dot with 1 tbsp water. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,chocolate syrup,feta cheese,passion fruit juice,olive,greek oregano
title: Feta Bites
ingredients: 1 small onion, finely diced | 2 ounces goat cheese or 2 ounces feta cheese | 1 tablespoon pure olive or 1 tablespoon butter, softened | 1 cup passion fruit juice | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | 1 teaspoon greek oregano
instructions: Scoop out small, disc shaped ice cube trays and press all ingredients to form mini croops. Spray baking paper with cooking spray and place in oven for 8 minutes at 250f degrees. Bake for a further 8 minutes or until mixture starts to crackle. Remove from oven and place in an ice cream freezer bag or a large freezer bag. Slice & serve.

title: Lamb & Onion Pie
ingredients: 500 g pastry dough ( i use my own ) | 1 kg lean ground lamb ( or beef, for example ) | 4 spring onions ( the green parts of the spring onions ) | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 teaspoon nam pla | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | margarine ( optional )
instructions: Melt margarine with nam pla on low heat. Fry onions untill limp and translucent, but not browned. Put the ground meat into the pan, then slowly add half the onions. Add the rest of the onions. Fry them on low heat until meat is brown. You may need to add more oil to the pan to give this a thick, sticky pulp. Add the mixed spices. Let it simmer for 20 minutes. Place the puff pastry on a greased baking sheet. Put 2 tsp of filling into the center of the pastry. Brush the edges with water. Bake in oven at 220 c for 30 minutes or untill golden brown.

Random Ingredients: honey,rose petal,coconut cream,clove,ladyfinger,duck breast,xanthan gum,baby shrimp
title: Low Fat Freck
ingredients: 3 lbs large frozen baby shrimp | 2 lbs frozen whole roasted duck breasts | 6 large fresh rose petals | 8 ounces coconut cream | 8 ounces xanthan gum | 8 ounces honey or 8 ounces agave syrup | 2 bags plain fat free ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons ground cloves
instructions: Combine dehacked creamed honey, xanthan gum and ground cloves in a small bowl. Set aside. Prepare dehacked creamed honey mixture in the container, using a coffee grinder or a spice mill. Slice duck breasts into ½ inch cubes and set aside. Preheat oven to 400°. Bring a large pot of water with 3/4 cup of creamed honey to a boil, stirring constantly. Add shrimp and cook 3 to 5 minutes and set aside. Pour 1/2 of coconut cream into a 13 x9 baking pan and submerge the shrimp with the other ½ cup of creamed honey mixture. Add 2 of the roasting chicken pieces on top of the creamed honey. Repeat layering with remaining chicken, creamed honey, duck breast, rose petals and finally shrimp on top of the ladyfingers. Combine 3/4 cup of creamed honey and 3/4 cup water and add in the 1/3 of coconut cream mixture and stir to mix. Spread over chicken and sprinkle with ground cloves. Bake 15 to 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Easy Italian Dressing I
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon or 1/4 teaspoon vegetarian chicken base | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake to combine. Add more chicken broth or water if desired.

title: Spanish Rice with Pimentos
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1/2 cup finely chopped pimiento into small pieces ( or a small can of chopped pimiento ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped spanish hungarian paprika | 3/4 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 2 -3 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 can stewed tomatoes, preferably fire-roasted, chopped and undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bring 2 1/2 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Add rice, reduce heat to medium low and stir. Simmer, covered, about 35 minutes. Stir in pimiento, paprika and elbows and bring to boil. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand, covered, about 10 minutes. Stir. Meanwhile, heat oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add tomatoes and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened slightly, about 5 minutes. Stir rice soup into tomato mixture and bring to a boil. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,spanish onion,bacon,lemongrass,chili oil,corn oil,phyllo dough
title: Thai Spring Rolls (Bacon and Peruvian Style)
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, cut into 3 pieces | 1/4 cup lemongrass, chopped | 1/2 spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 1/2 cups taco sauce ( or to taste ) | 18 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed, thawed ( about 10-1/2 x 3-inch, but use thawed phyllo sheets ) | corn oil ( as needed, for deep frying )
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet till just crisp.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,sugar,chili pepper flake,tortilla,wooden skewer,beef sirloin,catsup,red chilies
title: Baked Sweet Sour Beef Satay
ingredients: 1 beef sirloin, cut in 4 even pieces | 3 pieces red chilies, washed and dried | 1 cup apple juice | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/3 cup sugar | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 20 wooden skewers, soaked in water | tortilla, warmed
instructions: Slice the beef into 4 even pieces. Cut each piece into 4 pieces. Place in a resealable plastic bag. Mix together the remaining ingredients, except the skewers, in a large bowl and refrigerate for at least one hour. Meanwhile, prepare the marinade by combining the beef, marinade and the skewer in a bowl. Refrigerate until ready to use. Preheat the broiler on high. Place the marinated beef on a foil lined baking pan and broil or grill for 5 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking. Serve hot.

title: Tikka Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup | 3 tablespoons yogurt, plain | 2 tablespoons ketchup, red table burgundy
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in a bowl. Use to marinate chicken or meat. I used a baster.

Random Ingredients: vodka,red wine vinegar,hazelnut,kaffir lime leaf,cocoa,graham cracker crumb,romaine leaf
title: Smokin' Hot Chocolate - Gorgeous Chocolate & Hazelnut Romaine
ingredients: 600 g chocolate ripple vodka | 400 g hazelnuts | 200 g graham cracker crumbs | 800 g romaine leaves | 50 g cocoa | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1 good quality red wine vinegar
instructions: Take half of your vodka and place in a bowl of water to soften while whisking. Chop hazelnuts finely and coarsely. Combine the walnuts & hazelnuts in a food processor and pulse into a fine powder. Combine in a large bowl. Mix together the graham crackers, hazelnut powder & cocoa in a separate bowl, and add to the hazelnut mixture, making sure the nut is just incorporated. Cut the romaine leaves in half crossways and place on a plate. Fill the bottom of a 6cm lamington pan with vodka, making sure all of the hazelnut mixture is covered. Gently pour any remaining vodka in the bowl over the bread. Chill. Remove the kaffir lime leaves, cut each half lengthways in half and wipe them clean from the inside with a damp cloth for a minute. Remove the rind and bitter pith from the rind with a paring knife and cut the rind into thin wedges removing both the rind and the bitter pulp. Stir the rind wedges and vodka into the chopped hazelnut mixture. Pour into the prepared pan and set aside to chill in the refrigerator. Garnish with cocoa leaves and lime leaves. To serve, drizzle the raspberry vodka over the melted cream and roll the raspberries into a log then wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or longer, stirring every so often so it doesn't get dry. Serve toasted..

title: Swiss Roll Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese ( softened ) | 1/4 cup mixed nuts, finely chopped
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and nuts to form a small patty. Place in a greased 9 x 10 inch pan. Bake in 375 degree oven 15 to 20 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,thyme sprig,red enchilada sauce,spanish onion,cottage cheese,green chilies
title: Chili Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 3 tablespoons soya sauce or 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1/2 cup spanish onion, diced | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 can diced green chilies, drained
instructions: In food processor or blender blend all ingredients until smooth. You can refrigerate 2 - 3 hours to let the flavors marry.

title: Aussie Quinoa Balls
ingredients: 180 g quinoa, rinsed | 60 g glace cherries, chopped | 120 g catsup
instructions: Place quinoa and cherries on a microwaveable baking tray. Sprinkle with catsup and bake in toaster oven for 40 minutes until dry and crunchy. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Pepper Rings
ingredients: 32 large bell peppers | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Cut tops from peppers. Slice pepper lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices. Cut strips into 1 lengths, then cut strips crosswise into 1 lengths. Sprinkle flour over peppers and toss to coat. Place in large freezer bag. Freeze 30 minutes. Drain well. Return to freezer, add 1 tblsp cold water, cover and freeze. Defrost overnight. Remove from bags, then return to freezer one more time, until chilled through. Remove peppers from bag and place on parchment paper lined baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt. Allow to sit 10 minutes. Heat oven to 375°f. Bake 15 minutes, or until very dark brown. Turn off oven, and leave peppers in oven for 1 hour more. Remove from oven, and allow to cool completely. Remove seeds and membranes. Reserve juices.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,chili pepper flake,strawberry jam,parsley leaf,garam masala powder,egg noodle
title: Noodle Pancakes
ingredients: 1/4 lb egg noodles | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon strawberry jam | 2 dashes garam masala powder | 1 teaspoon dried parsley leaves, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water for about 5 minutes or until tender but still firm. Drain well. Beat egg noodles, icing sugar, jam, garam masala powder, parsley, chili pepper flakes, and chilies in mixing bowl until well blended. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in non stick pan. Spoon small amount of noodle mixture in.

title: Italian Sausage and Onions
ingredients: 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 1 beef stock cubes | 1 bunch green onion, sliced | herbs ( optional ) | dried oregano ( optional )
instructions: Sausage can be cooked and but left in casing. Brown on each side, then sprinkle with mixed herbs and pepper. Use as sauce for pasta or with crusty bread.

title: Whipped Lecher
ingredients: 3 cups chilled whipping cream ( you can use heavy whipping cream, but i usually use liqueur ) | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk
instructions: Cover the bottom of a mixing bowl with buttermilk. Line the bottom of bowl with plastic wrap and put it on the table of the table in a clear and warm area. Place 1 cup of chilled whipping cream into the bowl with the buttermilk and beat until the cream begins to thicken slightly. Place the bowl over the bowl of buttermilk in your fridge and stir vigorously until the cream is a creamy consistency. Continue to stir in another cup of the whipping cream and the buttermilk until you have a creamy cream with no lumps. Transfer the cream to the bowl that you are going to use to mix the whipped cream into a serving bowl. Chill covered. It will come out perfect the next day.

title: Mustard and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 10 fresh asparagus spears | 1/3 cup water | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Snap off woody ends from asparagus spears. Place asparagus spears in boiling water in a saucepan and cook until just tender but not mushy, about 3 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again. Combine mustard and water in a small bowl. Dip asparagus into the mustard mixture and then into the mustard seeds.

title: Curried Onions
ingredients: 2 lbs medium red onions, quartered and thinly sliced | 1 large pinch ground turmeric
instructions: Arrange onions and turmeric on platter and serve.

title: Pumpkin, Blueberry and Coconut Salad With Crispy Dried Fruit
ingredients: 2 cups chopped unsalted pumpkin | 1 cup dried cranberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries, thawed | 1/2 cup chopped unsweetened dried shredded coconut | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 medium firm ripe firm ripe firm ripe tomatoes, halved lengthwise and core scored cut crosswise into 1/2-inch-thick slices
instructions: In large bowl, combine pumpkin, cranberries and coconut. In small bowl combine corn oil, sherry and nutmeg. Stir into pumpkin mixture just until blended.

title: Ginger Asiago Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 cup asiago cheese, cubed | 1/4 cup grated fresh ginger
instructions: Mix the asiago, grated ginger and grated asiago together in a bowl. Store in a cool place.

Random Ingredients: baby corn,beef broth,green bean,white bean,marjoram,phyllo dough,seasoning salt
title: Pasticho-Beef & Bean Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 16 sheets frozen phyllo dough | 2/3 cup diced green beans | 1 lb baby corn, sliced 1/4-inch thawed | 1 can small white beans, drained | 1 - 1 1/2 lb top sirloin steaks ( cut up if desired ) or 1 -1 1/2 lb flank steak ( cut up if desired ) | seasoning salt | dried marjoram or oregano | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Preparation,. Preheat oven to place phyllo dough on counter and lightly spray with nonstick spray. Spray with nonstick spray. Place beef tenderloin or steak between plastic wrap. Wrap and pound until it is about 1/8 thick. Sprinkle a little bit of water over the beef if preferred. Place beef on lightly sprayed cookie sheet or pizza pan. Sprinkle with a little bit of seasoning salt/dried marjoram mixed with dried oreganos/or. Place baby corn and white beans on top and place on top of meat. Add a little more seasoning salt/marjoram and oregano if desired. Bake for approximately 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with sour cream. Note, when preparing the meat i usually bake it for about 30 minutes and then slice it and serve it as is, or freeze it, then remove the meat from freezer and cut into smaller pices or cubes.

Random Ingredients: saltine cracker,chicken bouillon granule,ginger juice,hamburger,mustard seed
title: Ginger Dijon
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 2 ounces saltine crackers, crushed | 1/4 cup ginger juice | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup mustard seeds, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large skillet. Stir to mix well. Heat to boiling.

title: Garlic and Garlic Noodles
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti noodles | 2 garlic cloves | 1 teaspoon dried potato flakes | 6 1/2 cups fish stock
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain. Meanwhile, slice garlic, and saute in a heavy bottomed skillet over low heat on the stove until golden. Remove to a paper towel lined plate, discard garlic. Remove garlic from skillet, but reserve. Increase heat, and stir in garlic and potato flakes. Cook until garlic is lightly browned. Stir in fish stock, and remove from heat. Dice and toss in with noodles.

title: Low Fat Turkey and Ricotta Pizza
ingredients: 1 turkey breast, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 1/2 cups lowfat ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f. Combine turkey and mustard and pepper. Place cheese mixture on lightly oiled pizza pan or pizza stone. Spread evenly over surface of pizza. Bake until cheese starts to brown, about 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Vegan-Friendly Low Calories Molasses Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast flakes
instructions: Mix all together and eat with your favourite dippers.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,pineapple chunk,corn,chicken breast half,parmesan cheese,caster sugar
title: Quick Caribbean Chicken
ingredients: 8 boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup canned corn, drained | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese | 1/3 cup light karo light soy beans | parmesan cheese, shavings to garnish
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients, except for the parmesan, in a bowl. Place between plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 30 mins or longer. Heat a little oil in a frying pan. Cook chicken on both sides. Serve sprinkled with parmesan.

title: Rice Salad With Fresh Strawberries and Yellow Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice | 4 cups cabbage, shredded | 1 yellow pepper, diced | 2 cups strawberries, sliced | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan combine cooked jasmine rice, cabbage, yellow pepper, strawberries, and cheese. Toss and serve.

title: Wild Rice With Wild Boats
ingredients: 1 package wild rice | 2 cups triple sec, or more to taste | 1 cup sliced nuts, or more to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add wild rice, cover, and simmer until tender, 25 to 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease a 2 quart casserole dish. Stir wild rice, triple sec, and nuts into rice. Bake in the preheated oven until top is golden brown, 15 minutes. Allow to sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Yellow Split Pea and Mango Jaffle - Jaffle
ingredients: 8 ounces yellow split peas, soaked | 6 ounces mango slices | 4 tablespoons double cream
instructions: Put split peas and mango slices into the jaffle iron. Heat until warm and plump and a little bit sticky. Top with double cream and serve immediately.

title: Shuku Shuku Shuku
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut ( or grated ) | 2 -3 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/3 cup ketjap manis ( to sweeten )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together tofu, coconut, syrup, and cinnamon. Sprinkle mixture into each wrapper and place 2 - 3 tbspn manis over the top. Wet your fingers and brush the edges of the wrapper with water, then fold the wrapper around each other, sealing the edges with a little water. Repeat until all wrappers are filled. Heat a little oil in a skillet and fry the shitkus, drain them on paper towels, and serve with a garnish of soy sauce.

title: Broccoli and Coriander Omelette
ingredients: 2 slices coriander root | 80 g broccoli or 80 g cauliflower | 1 egg white, lightly whisked | 3 -5 tablespoons marinara sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander root, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place the coriander root on a large piece of foil and scatter over a little water. Bring the ends of the coriander root up over the foil and, using scissors, cut off roots, then remove the stem. Cut the roots into 5 cm lengths and slice the root 2cm slices. Bring a large non stick frying pan half full of water to the boil, add the broccoli, coriander roots and egg white and whisk until the mixture is foamy. Add the broccoli and coriander roots to the pan. Cook the mixture for 20 - 30 seconds on a medium heat, stirring occasionally on the way down so as to not allow the broccoli to stick. Remove from the heat and stir half a cup of the marinara sauce into the mixture, stir well then stir in the rest of the marinara pour over the omelette and sprinkle over some coriander root. Serve immediately.

title: Apple and Hokkien Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces of whole horseradish-swiss lo mein noodles | 1/4 lb bacon | 2 tablespoons margarine | 4 cups diced tart apples ( i use red eating apples ) | 1 - 1 1/4 cup miniature marshmallow
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f. Bacon grease a 9x13 inch casserole dish. Cook the noodles according to package directions. Rinse with cool water to cool. Dice the bacon. In a large skillet, fry bacon over medium high heat until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon on a paper towel lined plate and crumble. Turn heat off and leave the bacon and drippings in the skillet. In a large bowl, mix the noodles, bacon with cheese and apples. Spoon contents of skillet over the noodle mixture. Sprinkle with marshmallows. Top with a few criss cross strips of bacon and drippings from the skillet. Bake for 30 minutes, or until top is golden.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,taco seasoning mix,icing sugar,rom tomato,cauliflower,mayonnaise,red kidney bean
title: Spooky Eyeball's Mexican Salad
ingredients: 4 cups grated cauliflower, about 2 small heads | 8 ounces sour cream or 8 ounces mayonnaise | 1/4 cup fat free mayonnaise | 1 jar red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped | icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Mix together the mayonnaise, taco seasoning mix and tomatoes until well blended. Then, in a large serving bowl, combine the cauliflower, the sour cream, and some of the mayonnaise mixture. Mix gently, being careful not to break cauliflower. Sprinkle with icing sugar if desired.

title: Griy's Mango and Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret ( small to medium sized ) | 1 medium cauliflower floret ( small to medium sized ) | 1 medium raw cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup scallion, chopped finely | 1 1/2 tablespoons anise seeds ( i use anise paste from asian or indian spice stores ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons mango chutney | 3 -4 lbs leftover cooked deli meat, sliced thinly ( i like to add a little extra in the dressing )
instructions: Break up any large clumps in the cauliflower and cauliflower florets and steam until they are tender but not mushy, about 2 - 3 minutes. Mix all the salad ingredients into salad until well mixed, adding any leftover meat and chutney if it is desired, season to taste with salt and pepper and refrigerate. This can be made in advance and refrigerated overnite to allow flavors to develop, although i like this as a little labor intensive.

title: Cocoa Barbecue Mango Dip
ingredients: barbecue sauce : | 2 cups canned baby corn, with liquid | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup mango, chopped | 1/4 cup sliced canned creamed tortilla peppers with liquid smoke | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons cocoa, or as needed | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke, divided
instructions: Place baby corn, pearl barley, mango, tortilla peppers, hot sauce, hot sauce, cocoa, and 2 tablespoons liquid smoke in the bowl of a food processor, and pulse until just mixed. Pour remaining liquid into a large resealable plastic bag, seal, and refrigerate until the flavors combine, at least 1 hour. Stir mixture again in the bag, and refrigerate until flavors combine, at least 30 minutes.

title: Mushroom and Mandarin Oranges in cashew oil
ingredients: 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 cup mandarin oranges | 1 tablespoon cashews | 4 -6 mint leaves
instructions: Grate the oranges and mandarin into small pieces with a vegetable peeler, removing the membrane if desired. Heat up the cashewnut oil in a frying pan. Add the chopped nuts in batches to the oil and fry. Cook until they are brown, removing them while they are still on the oil. Remove them while they are still warm to the pan. Remove from the oil and drain if needed. Pour the oil out of the mushrooms, using a spoon, and add the mandarin. Grate these into the pan with the oranges, mushrooms, nuts and mint. Toss the ingredients a few times until the ingredients are well blended and serve hot.

title: Roasted Beef for Lovers on the Run
ingredients: 6 -8 medium chile peppers | 1 package dry roast ( your favorite )
instructions: Place chile peppers in a roaster pan large enough to accommodate a single layer of meat. Sprinkle chile peppers with salt. Place roast on top of peppers and cover with foil. Bake at 350 degrees f. For an hour or so. After removing from oven, stir briskly until all dry ingredients are gone. Slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,red wine vinegar,ginger,couscous,pearl tapioca
title: Sweet and Spicy Tapioca
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl tapioca ( can also use chickpeas ) | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 2 boxes frozen baby spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup quick-cooking couscous, uncooked
instructions: In a small bowl, mix tapioca pearls with ginger, vinegar and spinach. Let stand 10 minutes. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the tapioca pearls mixture and cook until thickened, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Add couscous.

title: Thai Spring Onion and Chilli Crackers
ingredients: 100 g dried red chili peppers or 100 g dried red chili peppers | 1 bunch spring onion ( scallions ) | 1/2 small lime, juice only | 6 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c. Soak chillies in boiling water to soften. Drain. Place chillies, spring onions, lime juice and flour in a food processor or blender. Process until mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Spray breadcrumbs on a baking tray and press into the base of a large baking tray about 1cm deep. Bake in the middle of the oven for 30 minutes or until crisp.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,romaine lettuce,cold water,dill,vanilla essence,allspice berry,curd cottage cheese
title: Low Fat cottage cheese salad
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat small curd cottage cheese | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berry, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried dill or 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, finely chopped | 1 head romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Combine filling ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Just before serving, dilute with a little flour or milk.

title: Liver, White & Frankburger Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 lb chicken liver, cut into bite-sized pieces | 2 cans cannellini beans, drained | 1 jar crumbled hot frankfurters, heated | 1 package queso fresco, crumbled | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 12 ounces spaghetti, cooked and drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl except spaghetti & serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Seared Pork with Turnips
ingredients: 500 g thick blade pork fillets | 2 cups turnips, finely chopped | crushed red pepper flakes to taste
instructions: Heat the grill to high. Brush all the strips of pork fillet with oil and place, flat side down, on the grill. Cook for 6 - 8 minutes, turning the pork fillets over halfway through, until the outside of the fillet is browned to your taste. Sprinkle the turnips and crushed red pepper flakes over the surface of the meat and cook for a further 12 minutes, turning the turnip so both sides of the turnip are browned.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,white pepper powder,dark sesame oil,ginger paste,vegetable bouillon cube,bamboo shoot,parsnip,poblano pepper
title: Sweet and Sour Parsnips
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs parsnips | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot | 1 1/2 cups dry marsala wine | 5 medium poblano peppers | 2 cups vegetable bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon white pepper powder
instructions: First blanch the parsnips in boiling water. Chop fine and place in a bowl. Cut the parsnips into smaller pieces and place on top of the parsnips. Slice the peppers into strips and place on top of the parsnips. In a large skillet add the wine and vegetable bouillon cubes. Place over medium high heat until it barely begins to boil. Add in the ginger and sesame oil. After one minute add in the green pepper strips. Turn heat to low and cover the skillet until vegetables are cooked, about 5 minutes. Stir occasionally, as liquid in the pan reduces. Add pepper strips and continue cooking until peppers and parsnips are crisp tender. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Cream
ingredients: 5 pounds fish cakes | 1 cup vodka | 3 cups buttermilk | 1 bottle white wine vinegar | 1 can or bottle chicken broth ( optional )
instructions: Slice the fish cakes into 1/4 pieces. Place a layer in the bottom of a large bowl. Spread the vodka over the fish cakes, taking care not to cover the meat. Top with buttermilk. Add a few dashes of white wine vinegar over the fishcake mixture. Spread remaining vodkas over the fishcake mixture, as needed. Refrigerate at least 8 hours. The mixture will have absorbed all of the fat. Refrigerate overnight or over night, so flavors will meld.

title: Mouleh
ingredients: 1 kg mussels | 1 kg mar bar ( cut into small square pieces ) | 1 kg daikon radish ( peel peeled and cut into wedges ) | 1 liter coconut cream
instructions: Clean mussels and cut in half. Remove beards from mussels and put them in a pot. Add mar bar pieces. Mix coconut cream with the mussels. Put in the fridge till the end of cooking time.

title: Homemade Sesame Pork Bikkies
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 500 g pork loin, thinly sliced, threaded onto skewers | 1/4 cup semolina | 1/4 cup green capsicum, finely chopped
instructions: Grease the base and sides of 19cm x 29cm lamington pan.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,ice cube,tart apple,cocoa,black eyed pea,lime juice
title: Black-Eyed Pea and Apple Smoothie (SMS)!
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 small tart apple, peeled, cored and cut into chunks | 1/3 cup dried cranberries | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro ( or 1 tbsp dried ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 3 -4 ice cubes or 3 -4 cups ice cubes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor, and blend well. Add ice cubes or ice cubes if using, and blend until smooth and icy. Serve in tall glasses.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,ginger ale,chicken bouillon granule,great northern bean,wheat flour
title: White and Black Bean Pancake - Quick & Easy
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans ( not in season ) | 3/4 cup wheat flour ( white or whole wheat flour ) | 1 cup chicken bouillon granule | 2 tablespoons heavy cream or 2 tablespoons milk | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger ale
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix all ingredients together. In a 9 x 13 pan or crepe pan heat 1 - 1 1/2 tbsp oil. Spoon in 1/2 tbsp batter for each pancake. Use a pancake press if you have one to fit, or roll out. Cook for about 3 - 5 minutes depending on how thick you want the pancakes. Turn over and cook another 4 - 5 minutes or until all the pancakes are done. You may have to roll/rotate the pan so that the pancake is rolled in the middle while cooking in order to keep the pancake from sticking.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,vegetable shortening,chili,berry,fennel,lime wedge,chili pepper,rice wine
title: Spicy Fresh Fruit Crumb Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh white bread, crumbs or 1 1/2 cups dried breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 lbs mixed sprigs ( such as grapefruit, prunes, applesauce, pears and mango ) | 1/2 lb mixed chili | 1 -2 teaspoon minced chili pepper | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 lb vegetable shortening ( such as crisco ) or 1/2 lb lard ( such as crisco ) | 10 fresh fennel or 9 large sage sprigs, tied together with kitchen string in a decorative lace | lime wedge ( optional, for garnish )
instructions: Using an electric mixer, place crumbs in a shallow pan. Add cold water to moisten bread crumbs.

title: Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup frozen orange juice concentrate | 4 -5 dill pickle slices ( use green pepper slices for a vegetarian version ) | 2 -3 dashes tabasco sauce ( optional but highly recommended )
instructions: Thaw concentrate thoroughly and place thawed concentrate in a blender. Add dill pickle slices.

Random Ingredients: red potato,steak,self rising flour,vegetable,bean sprout,daikon radish,sugar syrup,chickpea
title: Daikon Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 1 lb daikon radish, sliced and seperated into rings | 1 cup sliced mixed vegetables | 1 cup bean sprouts | 8 ounces frozen vegetables | 4 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons sugar syrup | vegetables | 1/2 cup fat-free refried beans or 1/2 cup chili sauce, for drizzling
instructions: Place all the vegetables, beans sprouts, and daikon in a bowl with just enough water to just cover. Set aside. Cut the flank steak into 3/4 inch cubes, or thinner if you prefer them thinner. Place the cut beef and vegetables in the bowl with the vegetables. Add the sugar and mix well using your hands. Then add enough water to the flour to make the mixture hold together. Knead the dough for about five minutes, or until the mixture gets smooth and elastic. The dough should be firm enough to roll out easily. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for about an hour or two. Once you are ready to bake, preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place a piece of plastic wrap on a tray, and put the dough on it. Spread the dough out evenly across the tray. Bake until dry and golden, or about 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and drizzle sugar syrup evenly over the fried dough. Eat warm or cool, or leave as is or freeze for later use.

title: Fried Oysters With Sun-Dried Tomatoes and Chives
ingredients: 1/2 cup strong white bread flour | 400 g oysters | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1 tablespoon finely diced sun-dried tomato
instructions: Mix the flour and shrimp ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly. Dip the oysters in the batter and leave to soak for 20min 1hour minimum. Drain the oysters and place them on a clean tea towel. Place the sun dried tomatoes on top of the rolled oysters and cover with a tight fitting lid. Let them stand for 20min to steam the tomatoes through. If not serving immediately, remove the oysters from the cloth and fry them in a little oil until crisp.

Random Ingredients: mint,rice vinegar,pepper,black bean paste,white bean,wild rice
title: Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 225 g wild rice | 1 can white beans ( drained ) | 300 g rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons black bean paste ( black bean paste or other asian style paste ) | 3 teaspoons dried mint | pepper
instructions: Cook wild rice according to pack instructions. Rinse white beans and drain. Combine white beans, vinegar, pepper and mint. Add rice vinegar mixture and mix well. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,chicken stock,queso fresco,date,ginger garlic paste,tiger prawn
title: Ting Tsai (Thai Hot and Sour Soup)
ingredients: 3 lbs leg of lamb, cubed | 3 quarts chicken stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 6 ounces dried dates, soaked in sherry for 20 minutes then chopped into tiny strips ( optional ) | 1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco | fresh medium raw tiger prawns
instructions: Bring all ingredients to boiling. Lower temperature to simmer and cook for 1 hour. Lift out the lamb from the stock and place onto a large bowl. Cover tightly and set aside till needed. Remove and discard solids that have sunk to the bottom of the soup. Grate or chop lamb and toss with 1 tbsp crumbled queso fresco. Reheat stock and gently stir in crumbled queso fresco and a dash of freshly ground black pepper for garnish.

title: Beef on the Run
ingredients: 2 lbs lean cut beef, trimmed of fat | 4 tablespoons brandy | 3/4 cup dry vermouth | 1 3/4 lbs crumbled feta or 1 3/4 lbs goat cheese | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved
instructions: Place beef in a crock pot with the vermouth.

title: Chili Dogs
ingredients: 1/3 cup chili-garlic sauce | 7 ounces fully cooked black beans in hot water, undrained | 6 -8 teaspoons browning sauce
instructions: Drain beans. Combine chili pepper sauce and browning sauce according to your taste. Spread on buns. Sprinkle with beans over sauce.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,chocolate shaving,rose water,egg yolk,rye flour,bacon dripping,ginger ale
title: Flammeaux Rustic Bread
ingredients: 4 slices bacon drippings | 3 egg yolks | 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger ale ( optional ) | 3 1/2 cups rye flour | 1 tablespoon fresh rose water | 1/2 teaspoon chocolate shavings, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a large bowl, beat egg yolks. Beat in ricotta cheese, ginger ale and rose water. Combine rye flour and chocolate shavings and fold into batter. Dip bread into batter and arrange in 12 muffin pans, about 1/3 cup per loaf. Bake in preheated oven 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Grammy's Butternut Squash With Brown Sugar and Pickling Spice
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash, peeled, cut into 2 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons pickling spice | 2 large green bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch chunks
instructions: Place squash cubes into a large pot and cover with water and a sprinkle of pickling spice. Cover with lid and bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes, then remove from heat and let sit 5 minutes. Drain well and transfer to jar.

title: Orange and Spice Spiced Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 8 slices peeled orange rind ( about 1/2 inch thick ) | 4 peaches, sliced | 1/2 small dried apricot, cut into eighths
instructions: Place couscous in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,basil leaf,sea salt,black pepper,flat leaf parsley,bread,gherkin,hard egg
title: Grilled Eggs With Herbs and Gherkin
ingredients: 8 hard-boiled eggs | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | sea salt | fresh ground black pepper | 5 tablespoons butter or 5 tablespoons ghee | 4 small gherkin, finely chopped | 1 cup of loosely packed fresh basil leaves
instructions: Peel and chop the eggs. Place the eggs in a medium size dish to cover with the buttermilk, then mash lightly. Add chopped parsley, salt and pepper. Mix until well combined. Using a non stick griddle, melt 2 tablespoons of the butter or ghee over medium heat. Add the chopped gherkins to the heated griddle and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove the gherkins from the skillet. Whisk together the remaining butter or ghee with the remaining chopped herbs and add to the eggs. Bring to a boil while stirring. Simmer, stirring, until the eggs are just set. Serve in the eggs with the basil or mixed greens on top.

title: Spanish Spiced Pork With Apples and Walnuts
ingredients: 4 pork fillets | 2 teaspoons paprika | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 2 tablespoons walnuts | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 2 tablespoons sherry | 2 tablespoons pimento, pickled jalapeno strips
instructions: Combine all ingredients for the charmoula and marinate the pork for 2 hours or overnight in the fridge. Heat up the pan and add the marinated pork and stir fry all over. Serve in a dish with the apples and walnuts.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,stock,soy sauce,cottage cheese,cake flour,bean sprout,red capsicum
title: Vegetarian Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/2 cup button mushroom, sliced | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1/2 cup low fat cottage cheese | 0.5 packet frozen bean sprouts | 1/2 large red capsicum, sliced
instructions: Put vegetable stock, mushroom, flour and soy sauce into a saucepan and mix thoroughly. Once mixed mix in the cottage cheese and set aside. Cut capsicum into 2 x 1cm strips. Place the sprouts in a pan of boiling water. Once cooked they will curl, take out of the water and chill. Heat oil in a large wok or frying pan. When oil is hot add capsicum strips and stir fry until they are golden brown, then remove and drain on absorbent paper. Place prawns in the fry bowl or flatbreads, and top with bean sprouts and capsicum. Serve hot.

title: Grilled Homemade Vegetable Chips
ingredients: 1 3/4 - 2 lbs assorted fresh vegetables, such as broccoli, cauliflower, bell peppers, zucchini, and baby carrots | 2 cups fresh fruit, such as cranberries or 2 cups chopped fresh pineapple, peeled | 24 inches flour tortillas | 2 cups whiskey | 1 bunch fresh basil leaf
instructions: Cut vegetables into 2'' squares. Place on a large sheet of foil, brush with 1 1/2 cups whiskey and a little salt. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Brush 2 grill holes with remaining canola oil. Grill the vegetables, turning once, until blackened, 15 to 20 minutes. Brush the tortillas with the remaining whiskey. Grill the tortillas for 2 minutes. Remove from grill and cut into 2 strips. Divide the vegetables among the tortillas. Drizzle with more whiskey and serve.

title: Swiss Severn Scallops
ingredients: 2 ounces swiss scallops | cooking onion, sliced
instructions: Cook scallops in medium saucepan of boiling salted water for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,apple,japanese eggplant,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Pinchos De Padangza -- Eggplant (Aubergine)
ingredients: 4 japanese eggplants | 3 firm organic plantains ( about 1 pound ) | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix ( mtr baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix ) | 2 tablespoons apple, diced or 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
instructions: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1/4 thick slices. Toss lightly with pinches of salt and set aside for 20 minutes. Drain, and rinse briefly. Preheat a heavy griddle on low. Brush eggplant with about half of the oil and set under the broiler for about 8 minutes, or until lightly charred and tender. Turn over onto a platter, then set aside. Turn a couple of times. Repeat until eggplant is cooked. If using asian vegetables, place on a platter, and coat with ras el hanout or asian spices. Set aside, and keep warm in low oven. In the same skillet, heat the remaining oil. Brush eggplant and tomato slices with the hot oil. Turn pieces over and repeat, brushing tomatoes with oil. When the tomatoes are soft, sprinkle with the chopped apples and the remaining salt. Serve with remaining asian spice mix or butter and some green beans.

title: Mango-Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cognac ( or rum like to taste ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 500 g cabbage | 1 mango | salsa ( to taste ) | shredded cabbage, to taste | watercress, to taste
instructions: Peel the mango. Cut into slices.

title: Easy Easy Country Ribs
ingredients: 8 -10 country-style pork ribs, rinsed and trimmed of any extra fat ( about 1 pound ) | 3 -4 lbs boneless chicken breasts or 3 -4 lbs other cut of your choice, skin on
instructions: Place the pork ribs in a large dutch oven and cover with several inches of water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 45 minutes, or until the water is reduced to almost half. Remove the ribs from the liquid and cool under running water and drain. Put the cooked ribs and all the remaining ingredients in a food processor, and process until smooth. Put the sauce in a plastic bag or container, add the chicken in sections, and marinate, refridgerating, for about 4 hours, or overnight. Heat a grill or electric skillet over medium high heat. Ladle a small amount of oil to about 1/2 inch depth in a large skillet using 2 tablespoons, or use a very flat 9x13 inch pan. Drain the ribs and arrange on the hot oil. Grill, covered, to desired doneness as the ribs will continue to char.

title: Easy Grape Almond Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup grapes | 4 1/2 teaspoons onion salt | 4 1/2 teaspoons celery salt | 1/2 cup blanched slivered almonds
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine all ingredients. Cover and chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,cooking oat,fish sauce,italian parsley,dark chocolate
title: Terriyaki
ingredients: 14 ounces sweet dark chocolate | 14 ounces fish sauce | 12 ounces quick cooking oats | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl, melt chocolate and fish sauce together on medium high, stirring just until smooth. Stir in oats, lemon zest and chopped parsley. Transfer mixture to a pastry bag with a 1/2 pound tip. Press mixture into bottom and sides of a 13 x 9 inch pan. Freeze for 5 minutes or until firm. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,asafoetida powder,red pepper,rutabaga,coriander,grand marnier,raisin bran cereal,romaine lettuce
title: Root Beer (Greens Salad)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 1 green rutabaga, grated ( small ) | 1/4 cup raisins in bran cereal | 8 fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon coriander ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Place the spinach in a large salad bowl. Add all of the other ingredients. Mix well. Refrigerate at least an hour and serve.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,green plantain,allspice,chili powder,self rising flour,pie crust,marjoram,clove
title: Baked Chilean Plantain Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons finely chopped white chocolate | 1 teaspoon ground marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/8 teaspoon chili powder | 10 medium green plantains, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 unbaked pie crust, for 10 inch pie crust | 12 large squares white chocolate, for chocolate and vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Set the rack in center of the oven. Grease a 9 inch pie plate. Mix the flour, white chocolate, marjoram, allspice, cloves, and chili powder. Dip the plantain slices into the mixture, allowing them to drip off as much flour as possible. Arrange the bananas on top of the dough, and sprinkle the top with chocolate. Roll out the remaining dough to fit the pie plate. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 3 hours. Place a pie plate on a rack of a cookie sheet. Uncover the pie plate, and trim off any flour drapes. Place the filled pie plate on the cookie sheet. Remove plastic wrap, and bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the crust is lightly browned. Remove to a cutting board, and cut into four pieces. Use a spatula to remove the plastic wrap, then slice into four equal pieces.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Coriander Seed Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 1 ounce coriander seed, roughly chopped
instructions: Roast the coriander seeds until they become fragrant but not colored, shaking the pan constantly. When cool, grind it and stir it through the roasted and sun dried tomatoes. Chop the coriander roughly and stir it through the salad.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,pepper,brussels sprout,back bacon,romaine lettuce,tomato puree,pork
title: Tuscan-style Brussels Sprouts with Bacon and Sausage
ingredients: 8 slices unsmoked back bacon | 1 pound bulk italian sausage | 1 pound brussels sprouts, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 pound rindless country-style cut bacon, cut into bite-size pieces | 3 cups tomato puree | 6 cups finely shredded romaine lettuce | freshly ground pepper to taste
instructions: Place the crumbled italian sausage into a large pot and cook over high heat, breaking it into crumbles as it cooks, until browned, about 10 minutes. Drain off excess grease. Add the brussels sprouts and stir to combine. Return to a simmer over medium high heat, and cook for about 10 minutes. Add the country style bacon to the sprouts, along with the tomato puree and romaine lettuce. Continue to simmer until the vegetables are tender and the flavors meld, about 20 minutes.

title: Salmon Tart
ingredients: 200 g graham crackers, crushed | 150 g jicama, peeled and grated | 200 g jicama, peeled, grated | 300 g red salmon, skinned and sliced thin | 2 tablespoons mirin | 150 ml double cream | bread, triangles
instructions: Make sandwich crust, combine graham crackers, jicaya, jicama, salmon, mirin and cream in a medium sized mixing bowl. Spoon into pie dish. Sprinkle top with bread triangles, bake in 180 deg c oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown and jicama is tender.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,golden brown sugar,pinto bean,apple juice,lime,green bell pepper,bread,corn
title: Sweet and Savory Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package uncooked spaghetti | 1 can pinto beans | 1/2 cup apple juice | 3 tablespoons golden brown sugar | 1 small lemon, juiced and zested | 2 slices bread | 1 tablespoon corn, drained | green bell pepper, diced
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta cooking water. Drain and set aside. Heat apple juice, brown sugar, and lemon zest in a saucepan over medium heat. Place bread on a plate and place 1 tablespoon corn on bread. Dip bread in apple juice mixture. Place in a baking dish and bake at 350 degrees f for 5 to 10 minutes, or until lightly golden brown. Top with red pepper and additional tomato juice if desired.

title: Prawn, Date and Radish Salad
ingredients: 350 g medium prawns, peeled | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dates | 1/2 cup chopped chives | 1/2 cup radish, finely sliced | 1/2 cup gouda cheese, grated | 2 teaspoons key lime juice | 500 g vermicelli, broken into 5 cm lengths
instructions: Shell and devein prawns, leaving tails intact. Halve prawns lengthways if large, leaving 5cm tails in shells. Combine prawns, dates, chives and radishes in a serving bowl. Sprinkle with cheese and lime juice. Place noodles in a heatproof bowl, cover and set aside for 3 minutes, or until beginning to soften. Using a slotted spoon, gently toss noodles into pear mixture. Serve salad topped with prawn shells.

Random Ingredients: hamburger meat,cider vinegar,lobster meat,cucumber,green pepper,beef rib
title: Lobster Beef Steak
ingredients: 4 lbs hamburger meat | 4 beef rib bones with marrow | 1 small green pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 medium cucumber, peeled and sliced lengthwise | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/3 cup finely chopped fried onions
instructions: Prepare all ingredients well by placing into glass pan on low heat stirring often. Once mixture resembles a cake batter coat skillet lightly with cooking oil spread out hamburger on skillet and place on a piece of waxed paper. Brown quickly without moving and drain. Place in refrigerator. Prepare a few charcoal briquettes or coals in the oven and preheat to low heat. Place hamburger, mixed cheeses, tomato slice, pepper slice, cucumbers and onions on the piece of waxed paper. Carefully flip meat to brown other side and put onto coals and cover. Lower heat to minimum and simmer for 2 hours or until beef is fork tender. Remove from heat and cool for 15 minutes. Serve on a bun.

title: Chinese Style Hamburgers
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded and roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon crushed dried red chilies | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon mixed italian parsley, dried | 1 lb lean ground lamb or 1 lb beef
instructions: Heat shortening in medium skillet over medium heat. Add the cucumber and chilies. Stir occasionally so that cucumbers stay light brown. When slightly softened, add catsup, parsley, and ground lamb, mix until the mixture begins to turn into patties. Slightly cook burgers over medium heat about 3 minutes per side or desired degree of doneness. They might need a touch of space if they are cooked through.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,white bread,spring onion,olive oil,hot red pepper sauce,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower and Bread Soup With Hot Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret | 1 -2 teaspoon olive oil | 2 spring onions, sliced | salt & fresh ground pepper | 2 slices white bread, crust trimmed and toasted | hot red pepper sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Boil the cauliflower in boiling salted water for three minutes only, drain well and pat dry with paper towel. Heat a small pan on a medium heat and add the olive oil. Slice the spring onions and add them to the pan with the sliced cauliflower, a little salt and pepper, and mix. Add the hot pepper sauce to taste and remove from the heat. To serve, place two slices of toasted bread on the base of a large soup bowl and ladle the soup into the bowls, then add a dollop of sauce over the top.

title: Chilli Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen chopped turnips | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 2 tablespoons strong tea | 1 cup raspberries or 1 cup strawberry | 1 cup consomme or 1 cup broth
instructions: Peel turnip. Place in microwave safe bowl. Cover with boiling water. Microwave on high power in 1 1/3 4 minutes or until very soft, 1 - 2 minutes longer. Drain turnip. Place asafoetida, chilli and tea in heat proof bowl. Microwave on high power 1 minute or until mixture begins to boil. Microwave on high power 30 seconds or until mixture is hot, 1 - 2 seconds longer. Remove from microwave. Stir into turnip. Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Microwave on high power 8 minutes or until vegetables are hot and hot, 1 - 2 minutes longer. Stir in raspberries or strawberries. Cover bowl. Microwave on high power 4 - 6 minutes or until berries are warmed. Let stand 1 minute. Stir.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,sage leaf,self rising flour,sun tomato oil,korean soy bean paste,white wine,pine nut
title: Dakdoritang (Sticky Rice Balls)
ingredients: 2 cups sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, coarsely chopped | 1 -2 cup tomato paste | 6 tablespoons korean soy bean paste ( kimchi available at asian-food stores ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon white wine | 1 cup self rising flour, sifted | 1/2 cup pine nuts or 1/2 cup chopped walnuts, toasted
instructions: In a blender, combine tomatoes, tomato paste, soy bean paste, and wine. Blend until smooth. Sift flour into medium bowl, add the mixture and stir until batter is smooth. Stir in nuts. Cover, chill thoroughly, up to 12 hours. Make dough with a well chilled doughnut scoop about 1/2 cup batter and shape it into a ball, using about 1 tablespoon dough for each ball. Repeat until batter is used up. Place cookies on buttered baking sheet, let dry at room temperature 45 - 50 minutes, until light tan and slightly firm. Brush or spray with oil. Let dry on racks, then store for up to 2 weeks, covered.

title: Baked Pork Shoulder
ingredients: 1 bone-in pork shoulder | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Arrange the pork shoulder in a large baking dish. Top with mozzarella cheese. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,chicken broth,tomato green chilies,cucumber,breadcrumb,pineapple chunk
title: Sweet 'n' Chunky Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 1 cup canned tomato and green chilies, drained | 1 can pork fat free chicken broth | 1 cup unseasoned breadcrumbs | 1 -2 bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( i use a mix of green and red peppers ) | 3 medium cucumbers, shredded ( about 4 cups, i remove the seeds to prevent the soup from discoloring ) | pineapple chunk ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Combine salsa and tomato with chilies. Set aside. Heat broth and bread crumbs in 1 1/2 quart nonstick pan until bread crumbs are golden. If using the red bell peppers, slice up crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips. Set aside. Stir shredded cucumber with salt and pepper in bowl.

title: Faux Lettuce and Bulgur Wheat Salad
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 16 large lettuce leaves ( mixed ) | 1/2 cup bulgur wheat
instructions: In large pot, bring water to boil. Add wheat. Cover, decrease heat to medium and boil for 15 minutes, until it is tender. Drain and allow to cool. Sift bulgur into bowl with cooked pasta, toss to coat evenly. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,lemon juice zest,saffron strand,navel orange,bulb garlic,lime juice
title: Simple Sauteed Orange and Garlic
ingredients: 1 bulb of garlic ( with the bulb whole peeled out ) | 2 small navel oranges | 2 tablespoons zesty italian dressing | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( lemon rind, grated, if you have really fresh, 1 tbsp orange juice can be used ) | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand | 1/4 teaspoon lime juice
instructions: Slice bulb of garlic lengthwise down the length. Remove white papery skins. Slice off both upper and lower layers and discard. Wash garlic and discard. Cut a lengthwise slit lengthwise down the center of the peel. Take one end and the other out of the peel. Cut peel crosswise into halves about 1 inch thick. Lay garlic pieces out flat on paper towels to dry, about 4 hours at room temp. Remove rind from oranges using a paring knife, if the slices stay on the paper towels you know you will be using them to add them later, if not, just peel back the skin and trim off the bitter white pith under the peel and discard.. Remove papery skin from garlic pieces on the paper towels. Cut garlic in half through the base of each orange with a vegetable peeler. Using a mandolin or sharp knife, cut peel slices into 2 inch length slices. Set orange and garlic in a medium glass bowl and drizzle with dressing. Set aside while you prepare saute. For best results, set the bowl and oranges in a warm, cold oven to allow the oil to drip evenly over the orange and garlic and serve the orange and garlic with remaining ingredients.
