Random Ingredients: clove,hot pepper,oregano leaf,breakfast sausage,greek yogurt,tabasco sauce,lump crabmeat
title: Hot and Sour Gumbo
ingredients: 2 lbs hot fat-free sandwich sausage | 4 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 4 -6 pints greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 jar lump crabmeat, drained | 1/4 cup fresh hot pepper, minced
instructions: Break sausage into 2 inch pieces and brown in skillet with oregano, hot peppers, and tabasco for 3 - 4 minutes over medium heat. Pour yogurt into 2 quart casserole, add crab meat and heat thoroughly. Spoon mixture over crabmeat, cover, and bake in upper third of 350°f oven for 45 minutes, stir, and bake 15 minutes longer. Serve warm for dipping or for dipping sandwiches. Serves notes, we served this on a french fry roll with toast, sour cream and salsa.

title: Greek Custard (Kolokithia)
ingredients: 1 can beef bouillon | 1 large kalamata olive, pitted ( or other preferred type ) | 1 large vanilla bean, split and scraped
instructions: Wipe the can with kitchen towels.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,celery seed,deep dish pie shell,cornstarch,white chocolate,balsamic vinegar,sea salt,saffron
title: French Vanilla Pie (Pie V
ingredients: 8 ounces white chocolate | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 pinch saffron | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 unbaked deep dish pie shell | 8 ounces chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Melt white chocolate and vinegar together in microwave, stirring in cornstarch, saffron, celery seed and sea salt. Pour mixture into pastry shell and spread chocolate mixture on top, sprinkle chocolate chips over the top, if using chocolate chips. Bake on a cookie sheet, and cool a few minutes before cutting and serving.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,kalamata olive,chili powder,apricot jam,jumbo pasta shell,cranberry sauce
title: Quick and Easy Baked Shells With Apricot-Cheese
ingredients: 14 dried jumbo pasta shells | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/3 cup apricot jam ( raspberry or other favorite apricot jam ) | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, halved | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon dried cranberry sauce
instructions: Cook shells according to package directions, omitting salt and oil as directed. Drain. Meanwhile, meanwhile, heat sesame oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.

title: Asparagus and Ground Beef in Slow Cooker
ingredients: 12 spears fresh asparagus | 1 can condensed beef soup | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Spread asparagus in the bottom of a slow cooker. Place remaining ingredients in a small bowl, and sprinkle each bowl with about 1 tablespoon of the ground mace. Cover, and cook on low heat setting for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Asian Inspired Raspberry Hoisin Quesadilla
ingredients: 1 package frozen raspberries | 1/2 cup red onion, cut into rings | 1 jar pimientos | 1 cup fat free sour cream | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce
instructions: Place frozen raspberries and onion in a food processor and pulse till almost pureed. Mix in pimentos slices and sour cream. Set aside. Cook over medium heat til warm and then add the cooked rice/rotisserie mixture. Top with honey and vegan parm.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,cayenne,chicken stock,cornmeal,jasmine rice,white rice,sea salt,kidney bean
title: Super Easy Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 8 ounces white rice | 3 cups chicken stock ( canned is okay ) | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cornmeal | 1/2 - 1 cup fresh bean sprout | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh kidney bean ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain the yellow rice, if using. Bring 2 - 2 cups of water to a boil. Add 1/4 teaspoons salt, and 1/2 t of the cayenne, if using. Add the rice, then stir, reduce heat to low, and cover. This should be just before ready to use. The rice should be mostly absorbed, but not soupy. Let it steam off any residual heat for about 8 - 10 minutes, or until all of the water is absorbed. Rinse and strain the beans, if using, then wash the bean sprouts in a strainer and place in a bowl. Measure in 3/4 cup of fresh bean sprouts and put that in the strainer. In a separate bowl put 2 cups of water, the 2 cups bean sprouts from the strainer, and 2 t of the salt, and add that to the washed rice. In a measuring cup measure out 1 t of the salt and use this to measure out 4 t of the salt and 4 t of the cayenne. Mix these all in with the rice, making sure there is no clumping. If you put the rice in a strainer, rinse it with boiling water, drain it well with soap, and place into a large pot. Add the chicken stock, then add the salt and cayenne, if using. Boil the beans until they're all cooked and the water has been absorbed. Stir a few times until almost dry.

title: Fondue (Dough for Oysters )
ingredients: 4 ounces roquefort cheese | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1/3 cup caster sugar
instructions: Finely grate roquefort, then place in a bowl. Add garlic paste, sugar and mix all together. Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator.

title: Hazelnut Noodles with Honey
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 1 package rice noodles | 1 1/2 cups liquid honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast hazelnuts in the oven until fragrant and beginning to blacken. Place the hazelnuts in a plastic bowl and cool. Cover nuts with boiling water, stirring to remove excess. Boil pasta in the preheated oven until cooked but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, cover hazelnuts with 1 cup of honey. Heat in the microwave until warm and flavors have blended. Stir nuts into honey mixture. Serve hot for dipping.

title: Beef Fritters (Australian)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder ( we use yellow mustard, we usually just use coleman's ) | seasoning salt | real-to-serve mustard or soy sauce, for coating
instructions: In a small bowl combine ketchup, oil, mustard powder and seasoning salt, mix well until evenly combined. Add enough seasoning salt to coat, if not enough, mix in more salt. Cut fritters in half on the diagonal, fry in 1tbls. Of canola oil until golden on each side, don't over crowd, or they will dry out. Serve with sauce.

title: Aussie Style Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 packet dry white bean | 1/2 cup sliced cooked veal | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 ounce dark cooking chocolate, chopped | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Mix all ingredients together, and transfer to casserole dish. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven 15 minutes. Remove foil, and bake 20 minutes more. Serve warm.

title: How to Make a Polenta Crust
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal | cooking spray
instructions: In a heavy duty microwave safe bowl, combine cornmeal and 1 cup cold water. Microwave on high, uncovered, until thick and sticky, about 25 minutes.

title: Quick Pineapple Nests
ingredients: 20 fresh spinach leaves | 1 1/2 cups extra firm prepared pineapple chunks or 1 1/2 cups fresh frozen pineapple chunks, thawed ( 6 ) | 1 1/4 cups coarsely chopped scallions | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped scallions, white part only | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 10 tablespoons chopped pineapples or 10 tablespoons unsweetened crushed peanuts | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace or 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut the spinach in half, then toss gently with the remaining ingredients except for the nuts and set aside to macerate while preparing the nests. Make sure all the ingredients are covered with sand and refrigerate while preparing the remaining ingredients. In a large bowl, mix the nuts with the sugar, adding the nuts and mace and mixing well. Then, using your hands, mix in the chopped nuts and blend thoroughly. Fill paper lined muffin cups 1/4 full of the nests and place on an oiled baking sheet. Bake in a 300 degree oven, switching position of oven when necessary, until lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tap water,crescent dinner,sumac,extra sharp cheddar cheese,water chestnut
title: Crunchy Cheese Danish
ingredients: 2 cans crescent dinner rolls | 1 1/2 cups extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 jar sliced water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped | 1/4 cup water | 2 tablespoons tap water
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f. Unroll crescent dough on clean work surface. Coat baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Reserve 3 to 4 tablespoons dough.

title: Lighter Pesto Rice
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice | 1 -2 cup prepared pesto sauce ( see my related recipe ) | 2 -3 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat 2 cups of water with pesto in to boiling. Add rice to boiling water. Lower heat and, stirring frequently, simmer covered until water is absorbed and rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 10 - 15 minutes. Allow rice to cool to room temperature. Add 3/4 to 1 cup of cooked rice and vinegar to rice mixture. Stir rice mixture until pesto flavor thoroughly blended. Note, to make a perfect rice, pour about 1 1/4 cups of water into a medium bowl and add the pesto and stir to combine. If desired, refrigerate and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,currant,mozzarella cheese,water,basil leaf,new potato,puff pastry
title: Potato-Wise Pizza
ingredients: 800 g tiny new potatoes | sea salt | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, sliced | 1/4 cup currants ( optional ) or 1/4 cup raisins ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves | 1 sheet ready-made puff pastry
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into wedges. Place wedges on a baking tray and bake in a moderate oven for 25 minutes. Turn and bake for a further 10 minutes or until soft. Meanwhile, place currants or raisins in a small shallow bowl and pour liquid over them. Stir to combine with remaining ingredients. Allow to cool for 4 - 5 minutes, then season with salt. Spread potato mixture onto pastry lined tray then top with mozzarella. Place on a baking tray and bake in a moderate oven for 20 - 30 minutes, or until golden and bubbling and cooked. Serve warm with salad.

title: Marinated Corn Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cornflour | 2 1/2 cups marinade
instructions: Place corn flour in a bowl and gradually mix in the marinade. Scoop corn mixture onto hot greased griddle. Turn so both sides are covered. Allow to cook until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,taco sauce,cornflour,porcini mushroom,cayenne,italian turkey sausage link,hazelnut
title: Hot Italian Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 1 package sweet italian turkey sausage links | 1 package dried porcini mushrooms | 1/4 cup hazelnuts | 1/2 tablespoon cornflour | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 3/4 cup taco sauce | 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat. Remove the sausage from the casings and remove the skin and string from each sausage sausage link by rubbing in the casings, then placing on a piece of foil, allowing the sausage meat to sit on the surface and turning and rearranging as it cooks. Remove any visible fat or gristle from the sausage and place them in a bowl. Bring 6 quarts of water to a boil with the dried mushrooms and hazelnuts. Remove from the heat and set aside for 10 minutes. Drain the mushrooms and hazelnuts and place into a food processor, along with the cornflour and cayenne and process for 2 or 3 minutes until well mixed. Place the sausage onto a sheet of buttered foil. Place the skewer on the rack of a grill, then cook the sausages until hot, turning once, about 12 minutes. Sprinkle sausage into a warm dish and serve warm.

title: Cauliflower (Aubergine) Stock With Thyme
ingredients: 4 -5 large cauliflower, cut into even sized florets | 1 -2 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1/3 cup beef broth
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the cauliflower florets. Add salt and blanch for a few minutes, just until they are al dente. Drain them and place them in a bowl. Pour 1 - 2 tsp. Of beef broth between the cauliflower pieces. Serve with fresh thyme.

title: Raspberry and Papaya Smoothie
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cilantro | 8 ounces fresh papayas, ripe, skin on | 1 bunch fresh raspberries | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder or 1 teaspoon anise | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced | mix
instructions: Dice the papayas and raspberries. I use the whole papper in place of the raspberries. Add the raspberries, chopped chile and cardamom into the blender. Mix well. Add cilantro. Serve on chilled ice.

title: Grilled Pork Tenderloin With Curried Turnips and Mint
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried mint | 24 ounces pork tenderloins | 4 teaspoons spicy curry paste | 14 ounces turnips, peeled & sliced thinly | 2 teaspoons dried parsley leaves | 1 teaspoon instant yeast
instructions: Rinse the meat under cool running water. Sprinkle with salt. Combine all the ingredients, except the pork tenderloins, in a large bowl& mix well. Add the tenderloins& let marinate at least 3 hours in a warm area. Heat a grill to its highest setting& cook the meat to desired doneness, about 15 minutes. Turn and cook until browned to your liking. Transfer to a warm platter& allow to rest 5 minutes. Slice& serve.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,corn,beet,black bean garlic sauce
title: Spanish Beetroot With Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 5 tablespoons sun-dried tomato oil | 1 bunch beet, peeled and chopped into bite size pieces | 1 can black bean with garlic sauce | 2 cans corn
instructions: In a large skillet, add sun dried tomato oil, beetroot, black bean and sliced corn. Cook and stir for approx 20 minutes or until the beetroot is cooked and soft and the beetroot is cooked through. Serve hot. You will need a bowl, plate or platter to serve the beetroot and corn as an entree.

title: Korean Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 cups rice noodles | 1 medium zucchini, grated | crushed ice
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions. Drain and rinse with cold water while making the vinaigrette.

title: Pasta Udang Berei (Pasta Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 cup farfalle pasta ( bow tie pasta ) | 3 whole chickens, cut into small pieces | 4 green cardamom pods, split | 1 cinnamon stick | 1 1/2 cups vinegar | 1/2 lb preserved chicken ( meat and bones removed ) | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente, drain, set aside. Boil chicken in a large pot with the sliced cardamom pods and cinnamon stick for 8 - 12 minutes. Drain the chicken and return it to the pot. Simmer for about 10 minutes, then stir in the vinegar. When the mixture starts boiling, add pasta, chicken pieces and preserved meat. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,cinnamon,cauliflower floret,artichoke heart,chili pepper,almond flour,cornstarch
title: Artichoke and Almond Filled Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 cups cauliflower florets, cooked | 2 medium zucchini, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons almond flour | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper ( hotness ) | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cauliflower & zucchini & toss to coat well. Stir in remaining ingredients & mix well. Set aside 1 tablespoon of the cauliflower and garnish with additional zest. Serve at room temperature. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tamari,ketchup,adobo seasoning,creme de cacao,lima bean,xanthan gum
title: Lima Bean Dip (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 bag frozen lima beans | 1/3 cup tamari or 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup celtic crema de cacao ( or other almond-flavored liqueur ) | 1/4 cup adobo seasoning ( from tabasco� brand ) or 1/4 cup emeril's original essence ( from tabasco� brand ) | 5 tablespoons pure maple flavor ketchup ( from a 1.5-oz. can ) | 1/3 cup ketchup, extra light ( or use tamari, if you want less intense flavor ) | 1/4 cup creme de cacao ( or other almond-flavored liqueur ) or 1/4 cup emeril's original essence ( or use tamari, if you want more intense taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight, preferably for best results. Remove from refrigerator, heat and serve on the side of warm rolls. You can also serve it warm or warm.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,sharp cheddar cheese,wheat flour,green bell pepper,asian sesame oil,sherry wine,tarragon
title: Sesame Puffs
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh tarragon | 1 -2 tablespoon sherry wine | 2 teaspoons grated low-fat sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon asian sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.

Random Ingredients: avocado,plain yogurt,rye bread,topping,lemon juice zest,porcini mushroom
title: Elegant Savoury Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 1/2 slice rye bread, crusts removed | 4 -5 cups mixed mushrooms, sliced or | 1 avocado, peeled and sliced | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | plain yogurt | 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms, soaked in warm water overnight
instructions: Put the bread onto a work surface, and cut a circle out of it with a knife. The circle should be about 1 1/2cm thick. Layer the mushrooms, avocado, lemon rind and juice in the hollowed out circle of bread. Sprinkle generously with yogurt. Place 1/4 cup porcini on top, then top with the remaining mushrooms and avocado slices.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,napa cabbage,rice wine,canola oil,kaffir lime leaf
title: Easy Vietnamese Kimchi
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 package kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 of a head napa cabbage ( cut into small wedges when finished ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: Blend all ingredients in an electric blender and set aside. The kimchi will be served at room temperature.

title: German Potato Noodle & Noodle Medley
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs potatoes, peeled and cubed ( about 6 medium ) | 1 medium onion, chopped ( about 4 cups ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning | 1/2 cup chocolate syrup | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: In large skillet, bring 2 cups water to boil. Add potatoes and onion, and let boil 5 minutes. Cover and reduce heat to simmer, and cook 10 minutes. Add 1 tsp italian seasoning, chow mein noodles & onion powder, and stir. Cover and cook about 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add chocolate syrup. Serve with french bread, or your favourite meal and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,bay scallop,red leaf lettuce,fennel seed,lemon juice zest,thyme
title: Zeytoon
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of excess fat | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 bay scallops, well trimmed | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 head red leaf lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Coat a large heavy bottomed saucepan with nonstick cooking spray. Combine the beef, fennel seeds and bay scallops in a large saucepan. Cover and let sit 10 minutes. Drain the marinade, reserving the liquid. Place lemon zest in a small bowl and sprinkle with thyme. Using a rubber spatula, scrape out the juice. Add this juice to the meat mixture, along with the reserved marinade, and simmer gently over low heat for 1 hour. Remove the meat from the pan and shred into bite size pieces. Add lettuce and cook over low heat 2 to 3 minutes or until the lettuce is tender.

title: Spicy Beet & Tuna Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried shrimp or 1 tablespoon dried lobster, shell removed | 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 can canned tuna, drained | 2 beets ( sliced or grated ) | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup roasted unsalted peanuts ( chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | poppy seed ( optional )
instructions: Bake the shrimp or lobster shells a few at a time, or cut into chunks. Cook beets in boiling water for about 20 - 30 minutes, or until cooked crisp tender. When they are cool enough to handle, peel away the outer flesh, and slice. Chop the beetroot, boil for about 8 minutes, or until soft, then add the beetroot, honey, and peanuts. Cook about 2 minutes more, then add the nutmeg. Remove from heat and let sit just before serving. Garnish with poppy seeds if desired.

Random Ingredients: cheese ravioli,button mushroom,corn kernel,rye bread,italian herb seasoning,basmati rice
title: Ravioli on Rye Pizza
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen cheese ravioli, thawed | 2 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning | 12 slices rye bread | 8 ounces button mushrooms, halved | 1 cup corn kernel | 1/2 cup rice, cooked to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray 12x8 inch glass baking pan with cooking spray. Place frozen ravioli in pan. Sprinkle with italian seasoning. Cut rye bread in half and arrange in a single layer on top of ravioli in pan. Bake in oven 35 minutes, until slightly browned. Meanwhile, combine mushrooms, corn and 1/2 cup water in a small bowl. Spread corn water over bread. Top with sliced ravioli and mushrooms mixture. Bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 15 minutes.

title: Baked Fish With Chilli
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon blackstrap molasses | 1 1/2 lbs fresh tilapia fillets ( or salmon fillets, 3cm thick ) | 1 lime, juice of | 1 1/2 cups broccoli, chopped | sliced peach ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine coriander and blackstrap molasses in a shallow nonreactive dish. Coat tilapia fillets in spice mixture, coat with lime juice. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Place fish in baking dish. Scatter with broccoli and peaches, and top with remaining spice mixture. Bake, uncovered, for 30 mins or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: coffee,romaine lettuce,tilapia fillet,dark brown sugar,velveeta cheese,herbes de provence,white vinegar
title: Roasted Spicy Tilapia Wraps #RSC
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 2 teaspoons ground coffee | 1 bag romaine lettuce | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese
instructions: Line a large pan/skillet with heavy duty aluminum foil and spray with a nonstick cooking spray. Cut a very large piece of reynolds wrap aluminum foil big enough to wrap a 9x13 inch pan and line the aluminum foil ends with the remaining aluminum foil so ends don't touch each other. Cut a few slits around the outside of the pan to relieve air pockets. Cut the fish into 4 equal pieces and toss with herbs and vinegar. Spoon into the center of the foil lined pan in a circular formation. Sprinkle on both sides of the fish. Wrap tightly with each layer of reynolds wrap aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven, 400°f for 20 - 25 minutes. Remove foil and continue baking until fish flakes easily with a fork and is tender, stirring every 5 minutes. While fish is baking, slice the cheese into 1/2 inch squares and set aside. Remove foil from the pan and top each wrap with lettuce. Put the cheese on top of the lettuce and serve with the fish.

title: Crostini
ingredients: 750 g rutabagas | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: Boil the rutabagas or beans in plenty of water until they are almost cooked. Drain the rutabagas and mash them through a mortar and pestle. You should now have a firm paste, but not too runny to hand. Taste them and see if they need more water. Mixture should be a little tart, but not too watery. Add cream of tartar to taste. Eat at your favourite intervals.

title: Easy and Delicious Sausage Phyllo
ingredients: 1 lb sausage, any kind | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 package phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place sausage in bowl, add all other ingredients except phyllo pastry. Place a sheet of filo pastry on work surface. Spread sausage mixture onto pastry. Fold over to make a half moon. Pinch sides to seal. Using a floured knife, cut a vent. In 9x13 inch pan, bake phyllo on top of pan and brush with butter. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: pepper,garbanzo bean,white cheese,black eyed pea,dijon mustard
title: Black Eyed Pea and Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 cups cooked black-eyed peas | 2 packages white cheese, cubed ( or cheddar-jack ) | 2 cans garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 3/4 cup dijon mustard | pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: milk ricotta cheese,coconut,stock,garam masala,club soda,tomato paste,beef stock,serrano pepper
title: Coconut Lamb Curry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1/2 cup skim milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 2 cups beef stock | 1 cup condensed milk | 1/2 cup fresh grated coconut | 1serrano pepper, chopped | 1 quart stock | club soda ( optional )
instructions: Puree the garam masala in a blender to a paste. Heat the milk and tomato paste in a saucepan over medium heat. Mix in the coconut. Add the coconut mixture and serrano peppers. Pour in the stock and sugar and bring to a boil. Cover the saucepan and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the meat is cooked. Add club soda and serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: basil,red enchilada sauce,ginger paste,mango chutney,dijon mustard,greek yogurt
title: The Best Mango Chutney Ever!
ingredients: 1 mango chutney ( canned is fine ) | 0.5 can red enchilada sauce ( i recommend dh's brand from trader joe's brand ) | 0.5 package hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dijon dressing | 2 tablespoons ginger paste, minced | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Cut mango chutney into pieces, place in bowl and crush with a fork. Add remainder of the ingredients and mix well. Keep in refrigerator for 2 hours before serving.

title: Italian Style Pork Chops
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tomato paste ( or 2 1/2 tsps. each tomato paste and garlic combined ) | 1 lb pork chops or 1 lb pork roast
instructions: Trim all visible fat from each pork fat. Coat each pork chop with tomato paste. Place chops in a non stick skillet or frying pan with enough room to cover. Sprinkle each chop with a pinch of salt. Over medium heat, cook the pork in approximately 5 minutes on each side, until browned on the outside and cooked through. To serve, spoon a small amount of sauce over each chop of pork.

title: Duck Mole for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 duck, cut up | coarse salt ( optional ) | 2 cans whole kernel corn ( with juices ) | 2 onions, diced | 4 ounces frozen orange peel | 8 teaspoons instant coffee | 1 tablespoon dried oregano
instructions: Sprinkle duck with coarse salt and place in a dutch oven. Add onions and orange peel. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer, stirring once or twice, over low heat about 3 hours. Let cool and refrigerate overnight. Reheat to serving temperature. Place about 1 cup of corn mixture in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat until hot. Quickly stir in coffee and oregano, stirring frequently. Remove duck from liquid and serve with hot corn..

title: Easy Baked Green Apples
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped onions | 2 -3 granny smith apples
instructions: Put the onions and apples in a bowl. Peel them if you like, or grate them finely. Put the mixture in a roaster. Bake at 350 degrees for about an hour or until the apples are tender and the onions soft and the apples are getting burnt. You can also put them in the oven on top of a pot of boiling water on the stove.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,whipping cream,graham cracker crumb,fennel,lasagna noodle
title: Gravy Lasagna(Greece)
ingredients: 24 lasagna noodles | 1 1/3 cups whipping cream or 1 1/3 cups low-fat whipping cream | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 teaspoon dried fennel | 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions for al dente.

title: Spanish Tapenade
ingredients: 1 cup walnut oil | 1 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon chopped sage | 1 can sliced green olives
instructions: In a blender, combine walnut oil, triple sec, sage, and green olives.

title: Martha's Juicy German Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 1 teaspoon marjoram ( or substitute 1 tsp dry )
instructions: Combine the ground pork, marjoram, and dry ingredients together thoroughly. Grill over hot coals, turning regularly, for 10 - 15 minutes. Cool, then store in airtight tins, keeping the juices.

title: Porcini Porcini
ingredients: 5 ounces porcini mushrooms, soaked overnight and finely crushed | 1/3 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together to make the porcini paste.

title: Steak with Bacon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 8 slices crisp bacon | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 -2 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 bottle dry champagne
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the steaks. Cut the steaks into serving sized cubes. Boil the bacon in a pan with the sesame oil for a couple of minutes, then remove from the pan and reserve. Add the bacon to the pan and fry slowly for a few seconds until the bacon is coloured a bit. Turn the heat down to medium and add the coriander and the steaks, stirring quickly and gently enough to get each piece coated in the oil and spices. Keep stirring until each steak is coated with the dark sesame oil and the wine is reduced by half. Pour over the cooked bacon, sprinkle with sea salt, and serve with rice.

title: Gnocchi With Red Cabbage and Dill Pickles
ingredients: 4 cups shredded red cabbage ( about 2 large heads ) | 3/4 lb dill pickle, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 8 ounces cooked gnocchi
instructions: Combine cabbage, pickles, poultry seasoning, and thyme in a large bowl. Bring water to boil on stove top. Simmer until cabbage is wilted but still slightly crunchy, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, cook gnocchi according to package directions. Drain, and then arrange over the cabbage mixture.

title: Ethiopian Honey
ingredients: 1 lb fresh parsley or 1 lb cilantro, chopped | 1 1/4 cups honey | 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, ground
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a 2 quart pan. Heat on medium heat 3 minutes. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,iceberg lettuce,poultry seasoning,plain yogurt,sea bass fillet
title: Baked Sea Bass
ingredients: 1 lb sea bass fillet, about 1-1/2 inches thick, skin on | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt ( you may not need it, i tend to do it ) | 1 -2 head iceberg lettuce, leaves separated | 1 bag frozen strawberries, thawed, drained
instructions: Preheat oven at 375 degrees. Cut sea bass into four serving pieces, lengthwise. Sprinkle fish with poultry seasoning. Let sit 1 hour. Meanwhile, mix yogurt with half of the lettuce and half of the strawberries. In a 9 x 13 baking dish, layer sea bass, yogurt mixture and finish with remaining lettuce and strawberries. Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until fish is flaky and top has nice brown colour. Serve warm on a bed of rice.

title: Asparagus Soup Mix
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed | 10 ounces morels, trimmed ( chinese cabbage )
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 3 cups water to a boil. Add asparagus and cook over medium high heat until just tender. Remove asparagus to a bowl of ice water.

Random Ingredients: dark molasses,apricot preserve,fig,shiitake mushroom,sun tomato,mint leaf
title: Figs With Pitted Apricot Compote
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato ( chopped ) | 1/2 lb dried dried shiitake mushroom | 3/4 cup apricot preserves ( or cream cheese or jam with 1 tbsp molasses ) | 1/4 cup dark molasses | 2 cups packed mint leaves ( chopped ) | 1 1/3 lbs figs, halved ( red-fibred )
instructions: Prepare compote by mixing preserves, molasses and 1 cup of the mint. Add remaining mint and figs and let stand for at least 10 minutes. Drain figs, reserving liquid, and arrange in a 3 quart pan. Top figs with compote.

title: Roasted Salmon
ingredients: 8 ounces salmon | garlic salt
instructions: Slice salmon almost all the way through to get a small slice size chunk size of salmon. Place it under a broiler, and season with garlic salt. Place the salmon on cookie sheet. Broil for about 5 minutes per side, or until fish is starting to turn slightly crispy. Place it on paper towel to blot grease. Serve with sauce as a side dish for a gravy, or as a salad to dip in chicken broth while fish is roasting.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,yogurt,cream chicken soup,sirloin,cilantro leaf,beer,corn syrup,bell pepper
title: Sizzlin' Beef
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon corn syrup | 2/3 cup low-fat sour cream or 2/3 cup low-fat cream | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped or 1 tablespoon dried cilantro | 1 1/2 tablespoons sliced green bell peppers ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup beer, of your choice
instructions: In a bowl mix together yogurt, beef, corn syrup, sour cream, soup, cilantro, and or red pepper. Pour over hot noodles or rice and let cool to room temperature. Enjoy with fresh garden salad and hot buttered beets for a complete meal.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,cumin,celery rib,pork roast,shaoxing wine,mint leaf
title: Pesto and Pork Roast
ingredients: 4 fresh mint leaves, stems included, divided | 8 leaves basil pesto | 1/4 cup shaoxing wine | 12 small boneless pork roast | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 celery rib, cut into 3 | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves
instructions: Place 2 mint leaves in the cavity of a large slow cooker, set aside. Place the remaining mint leaves in a small bowl with the basil pesto and mix well. Rub the mixture all over the pork roast. Place the pork in the cooker and set the cooker to high. Bake, covered for 4½ hours. Turn the meat over and repeat.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,vanilla essence,pineapple juice,feta,port wine,yukon gold potato,parsnip,red pepper flake
title: Potato, Parsnip & Feta Pudding
ingredients: 600 g yukon gold potatoes, cut into wedges ( about 200g or 170g ) | 400 g parsnips, peeled & cut into wedges ( about 200g or 175g ) | 500 ml port wine | 400 ml pineapple juice | 50 g caster sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | red pepper flakes | 1 1 tablespoon parsley, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f spray a 20 x 30cm tin with vegetable spray and scatter with breadcrumbs. Bake and crumble potatoes and parsnips for 15 minutes until crisp. Add the port and simmer until reduced by half, stir now and then. Stir in pineapple juice and sugar, heat through. Stir in vanilla essence and crushed red pepper flakes. Spoon into prepared tin, top with parsley and bake for 30 mins until golden and bubbling. Check it's made with just a few minutes cooking time and it should feel slightly firm as the puddings cook. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,maple syrup,sunflower oil,chickpea flour
title: Chickpea Flour Biscuits
ingredients: 100 g chickpea flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon green cardamom pods | 1 1/4 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 1/2 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl. Mix to a soft dough. With wet hands press into a ball, cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 5 minutes. Divide dough into 10 portions. Form each into a circle on a lightly floured surface and place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Flatten each circle into a round using the palm of your hand. Sprinkle the top of each biscuit with 1 tablespoon of the chickpea flour. Bake at 160° c for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tomato and Mushroom Rollatas
ingredients: 8 slices whole-wheat tortillas | 1 package mushrooms, sliced | 1 can tomato paste | 8 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread rye bread slices on a baking pan. Spoon some tomato paste on toast slices to taste. Layer mushrooms over tomato paste. Spoon rest of tomato paste over mushrooms. Cover with toasted rye bread slices. Bake in the preheated oven until toast is toasted, and cheese is melted, 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,guacamole,white peppercorn,chili pepper flake,pecan,pie shell
title: Easy Fresh-Thin Pecan Pie - No-Cream
ingredients: 5 quarts fresh basil leaves | 7 - 10 medium fresh chili peppers | 16 ounces store-bought pecan pieces, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns, cracked | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 4 pie shells
instructions: In an oven pre warmed to 325 degrees, place all ingredients and mix well. Pour into the prepared pie shells and bake for 20 - 30 minutes until pecans are light golden brown and a bit crusty. Let cool for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Kobotie (Sweet Potato)
ingredients: 1 pound yukon gold potatoes | 2 1/2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, and let cool until able to handle, about 15 minutes. Place potatoes into a saucepan, and pour in the molasses. Simmer until the mixture is thick and creamy, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,date,rye bread,double cream,oat bran,italian sausage,cider vinegar
title: Italian Sausage Sandwich With Gluten Free Option
ingredients: 4 ounces gluten free italian sausage ( bulk or fat free ) | 1 ounce oat bran | 1/2 cup gluten-free bacon fat free oats ( also if you use fat free oat bran, add 1 tbsp bicarbonate mixed in ) | 2 tablespoons gluten-free red passover cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons double cream | 2 leaves fresh rosemary, finely chopped from a sprig | rosemary | 12 slices rye bread
instructions: Toast the bread. Heat a grill. Cut the sausage into 8 slices, then roughly chop the fat meat. Brush the oat bran on a clean tea towel, then sprinkle the crumbs it lightly on the sausage. To roll up the bread, lift the slice from the loaf by pulling it up with your fingers, and pressing it down with the heels of your hands. Turn the loaf over so that the bran coated side is up on the bread and cover in a little more bran. Heat a griddle or frying pan over medium heat. When hot, cook the sausage until brown. When it is almost cooked through, remove it from the griddle and keep warm. Drain off any excess fat, then add the fat meat and crumbs to the pan, and toss together. Tip the oats into a bowl, toss in 1 tbsp bicarbonate mixed in, then pour slowly into the oat bran mixture, stirring until the liquid disappears. Add the vinegar and stir until it is combined well. Add the cream. Toast the rosemary leaves. Divide the sausage and meat into 4 pieces. Warm the bread in the oven, for 5 mins for extra crisp, or for around 5 mins for a firmer biscuit taste. Put a piece of the rye bread on top of each slice of toast, then add the bread. Brush the bread with more cream if liked.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,wheat flour,yogurt,egg yolk,dark brown sugar,shrimp paste,vegetable stock chicken,cream cheese
title: Shrimp in Cream Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 carton hot vegetable broth or 1 carton chicken stock | 2 tablespoons fresh yogurt | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( or to taste ) | 2 -3 teaspoons shrimp paste ( optional ) | 7 ounces shiitake mushrooms, minced ( optional ) | 1 egg yolk
instructions: In a medium bowl, beat egg yolk and stir in cream cheese. Stir in flour. Slowly stir in the hot broth and yogurt until smooth. Remove 2 - 3 tablespoons of liquid from the carton and add the liquid to the filling. Stir in the brown sugar to desired sweetness. Add shrimp paste. Stir in mushrooms and blend well. Set aside 1 tablespoon of the filling for brushing onto the top of the shrimp. Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Brush the shrimp with egg wash. Sprinkle shrimp with reserved filling and bake for 30 min, or until done. Serve with warmed jasmine rice.

title: Quick and Easy Pizza Dip
ingredients: 3 flour tortillas | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 tablespoons hummus | 3 plum tomatoes, cut into slices | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a frypan. Place tortillas on pan. Cover with hot mixture, spreading evenly. Spread hummus on top of tortillas. Place tomato slices onto top of hummus. Sprinkle with tabasco and sprinkle with your favorite condiments of choice. Broil in oven for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve warm with toppings.

title: Cornmeal Chips and Peppers
ingredients: 15 ounces cornmeal | 6 ounces margarine | 10 ounces hot banana peppers, cut into strips julienne style | 15 ounces picante sauce, fire roasted, medium | 10 ounces low sodium chicken broth | 6 ounces pistachios, shelled & toasted | grated nutmeg
instructions: Cook cornmeal in margarine and hot banana peppers over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick. Stir in picante sauce, broth and pistachios, bring to boil, stir. Remove from heat and top with nutmeg and salt, if desired.

title: Easy and Delicious Plum Tomatoes on the Grill (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1)
ingredients: 600 ml plum tomatoes, halved ( approx 1 1/2 kg ) | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger | 1 drop vanilla essence
instructions: Place the tomatoes in a single layer on a non stick griddle or barbecue plate. Sprinkle over a little sugar or paprika and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, turning every so often. Keep a close eye as they can burn easily. Remove from the oven and scatter over the ginger. Set aside for a few minutes. Serve warm with cream, ice cold beverages or crackers. Variation. The idea is to grill only the tomatoes rather than the ones with no other ingredients added to them. Do not leave out the rum flavoured plum tomatoes. You would think the griddle would have turned off but the tomato sauces can still be added. Any tomato can be used. Variation. Use red plum tomatoes instead of the plums.

Random Ingredients: new potato,lemon juice zest,cardamom pod,ham hock,chili oil
title: Kafta (Potato Soup) With Hocks
ingredients: 7 pounds potatoes ( peeled, cut into thin wedges ) | 1 piece lemon, juice and zest of | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 10 pounds smoked ham hocks | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod
instructions: Place potatoes into a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Once they come to a boil, cover, and simmer over low heat until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain the potatoes and return them to the pan. Add lemon juice, chili oil, ham hocks, and cardamom. Mix thoroughly so that all ingredients are thoroughly combined. Place a lid on the pan and allow the soup to simmer over low heat for about two hours. Taste and season with more lemon juice if needed.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,yellow squash,romano cheese,italian seasoning mix
title: Rice Curds
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dry instant rice wine | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon grated romano cheese | 3 small romaano cheese, cut into cubes
instructions: In a large glass or plastic bowl, mix together the rice wine, italian seasoning, and grated romano cheese. Place the cubes of romano cheese into a small bowl and squeeze the excess moisture out of each cube, placing each cube into the bowl. Place the cubes onto a plate. Add more romano cheese to the bowl and coat the cubes with romano cheese. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap directly on the surface, and refrigerate the cubes for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Braised Beet & Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb beet, washed ( about 4 cups, see note ) | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( can also use white kidney beans ) | 4 tablespoons lard ( or other cooking oil ) | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 1 medium fat free chicken chunk ( optional ) or 1 chicken breast, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cut beet in to 2 inch/long pieces or into large pieces. Cut chicken into bite size pieces or follow instructions on canned beans if using. Place meat in a baking dish. In a glass or plastic bowl, whisk together orange juice and rind until blended. Heat up lard or other cooking oil in a large skillet or electric fry pan. Add a few pieces at a time, stir until all pieces have been coated thoroughly. Add all pieces of beet to fat or oil and cook, stirring often, until just browned. Transfer to plate for about 10 minutes to cool. In a large bowl, toss the kidney beans with the orange juice and orange zest, remove beet and bean mixture from the pan and arrange over other ingredients, toss gently again to ensure even distribution. To serve, place on a large serving platter, top with additional orange zest and/or/or orange slices if desired. Note, for a variation, you may serve it on top of the beet mixture as a salad or just serve it on a bed of greens.

title: Pepperoncini French Toast
ingredients: 1 lb unsalted dry-roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 12 pepperoncini peppers, rinsed | 6 large eggs | splenda granular, sugar substitute for sugar | irish cream, for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cooking spray in a large bowl. Spray the inside of a large frying pan with cooking spray, arrange the slices in an even layer. Fry over medium heat until light brown, about 3 minutes per side. Serve with a dollop of hollandaise dressing.

title: Easy Khaai--Bourekakia (Sweet Sour Cheese Puffs)
ingredients: 1 package hawaiian dinner rolls ( refrigerate 24 hours before using ) | 24 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 -3 cups dry vermouth ( double the amount of vermouth used in indiana ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon canola oil | 1 teaspoon cumin seed, toasted and crushed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Prepare rolls, if needed, as follows, place a piece of plastic wrap directly on the surface of the pastry and roll dough to fit the bottom of a 12x7 inch glass baking dish. Place dough in a well buttered, round baking dish and cover loosely with foil. Bake 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake until golden brown, about 15 minutes longer. Cool slightly. Sauce, in a medium size saucepan, heat vermouth until just beginning to reduce, about 2 minutes. Pour in oil and heat over medium to medium heat, until bubbling and reduced and almost dry, about 1 minute. Be very careful not to burn the hot vermouth. When it is, stir in roasted ground cumin and cumin. Add warm vermouth mixture to taste.

title: Dry Cheese on the side
ingredients: 1 piece turmeric powder | 1/2 bunch cilantro | 1 cheese
instructions: Roughly chop the cilantro and add it to a saucepan. Boil it down until the cilantro starts making tiny pebbles on the edge and the cilantro turns bright green. Use a slotted spoon and throw the cheese over the pan. Take off the heat and stir. Put the lid on and turn the heat off to let the cheese sit until it has cooled slightly, around 1 hour. Turn and knead the cilantro again until it becomes somewhat elastic. If you like it more soft, cook it for a couple of minutes until it starts to look a bit mushy. Place in an airtight container.

title: Mixed Fruity Grilled Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust ( pizza stone is not recommended ) | 1 teaspoon light coconut | 1/2 cup of frozen mixed vegetables ( or fresh mixed vegetables )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. Prepare crust according to package size. Bake pizza crust according to package directions. Remove from oven and spread the coconut and veggies onto the top of the pizza crust. Top with remaining pizza crust, cover and return to oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until crust has lightly browned. Allow to stand for 1 hour before serving.

title: Spanish Inspired Layered  With  Snow Peas(Beans, Beans, &  Lemon)
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans ( can use any can of beans you 'd like ) | 1 can chopped green chilies ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon minced dill weed ( fresh is best ) | 1/4 - 1/3 cup tequila ( optional ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/3 cup chopped fresh dill weed ( fresh is best ) | 1 fresh lemon, juiced | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Heat beans, chilies, and dill weed in large skillet or dutch oven until hot, stirring frequently. Reduce heat to low. Add remainder of ingredients. Cover and simmer 30 - 60 minutes or until heated through but not mushy.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,cornmeal,grape leaf,balsamic vinegar,beef bouillon cube,ice water
title: Cauliflower Stuffed Grape Leaves With Cornmeal
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, trimmed | 3 tablespoons ice water | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/3 cup cornmeal | 6 whole grape leaves, large
instructions: Bring large pot of salted water to boil. Remove stems and leaves of cauliflower. Chop coarsely and place in bowl. Stir water & vinegar in small bowl. Dissolve bouillon cube in water and add. Bring to boil. Stir cornmeal and pour over cauliflower. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Uncover and stir. Cover and simmer an additional 5 minutes or until cauliflower is tender. Remove from heat. Let stand for 5 minutes. Spoon mixture from bowl onto leaves, and stack attractively. Spoon onto heated platter, and serve.

title: Couscous and Clam Pot
ingredients: 3 cups dry couscous | 8 ounces fresh clams | 8 ounces beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup small turnip, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup squid, cleaned and broken into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a 10 inch nonstick saute pan, combine all ingredients except couscous, and bring to boil over medium heat, stirring frequently. When it comes to a boil, stir in couscous. Cover, and remove from heat. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff with fork. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: roast beef,watermelon,garam masala,italian salad dressing mix
title: Award Winning Fruit Tramp
ingredients: 1 pound cooked to room temperature roast beef | 1 cup italian-style salad dressing mix | 1 cup cubed watermelon | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Drain roast beef of excess fat. Combine with salad dressing mix and watermelon in a medium serving bowl. Sprinkle with garam masala.

Random Ingredients: white onion,sun tomato,chili oil,broiler fryer chicken,coriander seed,wheat flour
title: Chicken, Onion and Sun Dried Tomato Toss
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, soaked in warm water 30 60 mins, drained and chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 pinch chili oil | 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon white onion, chopped
instructions: Remove skin from chicken. Cut into bite size pieces. Toss with coriander and chilli and leave in fridge. Rinse chicken pieces under cold water for 30 minutes. Pat dry. Combine flour and sun dried tomato into bowl. Cut onion into 1cm dice. Toss into flour bowl with chicken. Leave for 10 miuntes. Put in oven for 45 mins at 180c. Serve at once.

title: Microwave Chocolate Fritters
ingredients: 4 lbs russet potatoes, rinsed | 2 cups rye flour | 1 cup corn chips, coarsely crushed ( coarsely crushed salt ) | 1 cup chocolate or 1 cup semisweet chocolate, grated ( or 2 teaspoons dark chocolate )
instructions: In a large microwavable bowl, add potatoes, rye flour, corn chips, and chocolate and mix well. Add more rye flour or chocolate as needed to moisten the fritters. Microwave at high power for 2 minutes or microwave 5 to 10 minutes at 50% power, stirring once.. Use your thermometer, should read 120°f the fritters should be a pale, not mushy texture, and lightly crunchy, but not too mushy. You may need to cover the bowl to prevent this. Variation, replace microwave method of letting your fritters cool completely before microwaving. You must not allow them to cook on high power until temperature reaches 165°f, so that the steam stops before fritters can come out.

title: Gnocchi With Mushrooms and Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean | 5 fresh asparagus spears | 1 medium size mushroom, any type | 1 cup oatmeal ( i used whole wheat ) | 4 tablespoons light agave syrup or 4 tablespoons light honey | 4 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika, more if desired | 20 hazelnuts, toasted, skinned and sliced with kitchen shears
instructions: Steam asparagus and mushroom until tender. While still warm mix oats with agave syrup and paprika. Stir into the mushrooms. Garnish with nuts. I found it was not necessary to chop nuts into smaller pieces. Enjoy,.

title: Pistachio and Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite sized pieces ( about 2 cups ) | 1 cup pistachio nut, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the romaine lettuce with the pistachios. Let cool to room temperature, about 15 minutes.

title: Crispy Mexi Jicama Chips
ingredients: 2 cups jicama, very thinly sliced | 1 lb crispy corn tortilla chips | hot paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large shallow dish, mix jicama and crushed tortilla chips together. Sprinkle with hot paprika. Cut in half, if desired. Place cut side down on cookie sheet, bake at 400°f for 5 - 12 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Banana, Banana & Sweet Jam
ingredients: 2 ripe bananas | 500 ml thick milk ( i use skim )
instructions: Peel the bananas, slice into rounds & put them in a food processor with the milk to make a smooth paste. Place this mixture in a large saucepan over low heat & stir continuously until the mixture thickens, around 10 - 15 minutes depending on how thick you like your jam. Remove from heat & keep warm. Pour warm jam into 2 1/2 cup heat proof ramekins, cover & refrigerate the jam for up to 1 week. To serve, sprinkle top with chopped fresh herbs & refrigerate the jam up to 5 days before using. If you don't have a jam jar, you can use a small dish w/ a lid with a tight lid, or fill it w/1/3 cup cold water & pour through it then set this in the middle of the jam. This will keep for a week if it refrigerates. Note, this does not freeze the jam & it will last up to 6 months in the refrigerator.

title: Simple Chicken and Onion Supper
ingredients: 10 chicken tenders | 1/2 cup finely chopped red onion
instructions: Cook chicken tenders on a baking sheet approximately 6 to 8 inches below a hot broiler. About 1 hour depending on how hot/warm the temperature is. Sprinkle with onion. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chestnut mushroom,masa harina,tequila,chili pepper,chili powder,chick pea,golden syrup,chicken bouillon granule
title: Pot-A-Leaf Chili
ingredients: 1 kg paschal sweet potato or 1 kg yam | 100 g chestnut mushrooms | 300 g chicken stock or 300 g chicken bouillon granules | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon instant chili pepper | 1 pinch chili powder | 1 tablespoon masa harina | 1 -2 tablespoon tequila
instructions: Peel sweet potato with skin and peel into large square or oblong shape and cut into 3 or 4 cubes or so. Boil whole lot until tender. Chop mushrooms with their skin and put into ice cubes or bag, put into freezer for 1 hour. Boil stock with sugar and salt to taste. Add chili powder and instant chili. Drain potatoes and mash with masa harina and tequila. Serve with warm toast.

title: Quick Microwave Carrots
ingredients: 4 large carrots, peeled and cut in half lengthwise, then lengthwise into 1/2-inch sticks ( about 5 cups ) | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Place carrots in an 1 1/2 quart microwave safe casserole dish. Microwave on high power level for 7 minutes or until tender stirring every 2 minutes. If microwave does not have a powerful microwave safe handle, microwave on high power for 6 minutes or until tender stirring every 2 minutes. Remove from microwave. Using slotted spoon, transfer carrots to a cutting board.

title: Sun Dried Tomato and Fresh Strawberry Rel
ingredients: 500 g fresh strawberries | 50 g shallots | 50 g sun-dried tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 50 g frozen peas | 100 g frozen sliced strawberries | 1 teaspoon saffron strand
instructions: Wash the strawberries and put in a serving bowl. Chop the shallots and sun dried tomatoes and put in the bowl. Add the ginger garlic paste. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in the frozen peas, cut the strawberries into bite sized chunks and cover until the strawberries are done. To make the sauce, put the saffron in a little bit of cold water. Add the saffron to the water, add the chopped strawberries and mix until they have absorbed the water. Chill to set the strawberries and serve as a garnish for the relish.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,pea bean,ra el hanout spice mix,white wine,tomato green chilies
title: Foolproof Curried Green Beans
ingredients: 1 package frozen green beans, thawed | 1 can diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, drained, rinsed and pureed | 2 tablespoons dried onion powder | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | sherry or white wine, as needed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in the green beans and return to a boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the fresh chilis and the ras el hanout and remove from the heat. Let stand for 5 minutes, then stir in the tomato puree and set aside. Stir in the dry onion powder, and set aside. Over medium heat, melt the olive oil in a large pot or deep fryer. Once the oil is very hot but not smoking, stir in the drained green beans and green chile puree. Cook and stir for 1 minute to blend the flavors. Sprinkle with sherry and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,corn kernel,strawberry,dark brown sugar,water chestnut
title: Wild Strawberry-Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1 pint strawberries | 2 cans corn kernels | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Drain water chestnuts and strawberries, reserving juice.

title: Irish Potato Cheese Filling for Peroshky
ingredients: 150 g potato cheese filling | 100 g raisins ( drained )
instructions: Roll the cheese and raisins into balls.

title: Sautéed Pork for French Fondue
ingredients: 1 lb coarsely ground pork
instructions: Warm a heavy skillet or heavy kettle over moderate heat. When hot, add the ground pork. Brown all over. Add the thyme and thyme sprigs and keep stirring. Cook until the foam disappears and the dish is slightly golden brown. Transfer the pork to a platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,pasta shell,peanut oil vegetable
title: Sensational Pasta Shells
ingredients: 15 large pasta shells | 3 tablespoons peanut oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat the oil. Add the chili flakes, fry until they turn color, then add the drained pasta. Cook until the pasta is tender.

title: Chicken Tarkari
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg chicken pieces | 2 teaspoons dried currants | 4 teaspoons marinara sauce | 1 yellow bell pepper | 2 teaspoons prepared channa dal
instructions: Place chicken in large dish or aluminium foil and cover tightly with marinara sauce. Allow to marinate in fridge for 30 minutes. Prepare pepper and channa dal by cooking gently with a small amount of olive oil which will make them soft. Remove from heat and set aside. Preheat oven. Remove chicken from marinara. Place chicken pieces on a baking tray. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for 30 to 40 minutes or until chicken is tender. Brush all dry ingredients from chicken with olive oil. Place chicken onto a large sheet pan and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour over remaining marinara sauce. Cover and bake in the oven for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Jaan (Beef and Penne)
ingredients: 2 pounds bone-in cured brisket, rinsed and patted dry | 4 pods green cardamom pods | 3 packages refrigerated pizza dough, dough | 5 pounds dry penne
instructions: Place beef brisket in a deep pan.

title: German Pancetta Soup
ingredients: 12 small pancetta ( thin slices ) | 48 gersnaps | 2 teaspoons cornmeal | 2 cans tomato juice | 4 cans tomato paste or ( 16 ounce ) cans tomato sauce | tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | pita bread ( optional )
instructions: Slice pancetta into thin strips and fry in a heavy skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels. Remove pancetta drippings. Drain fat from skillet and return skillet to stove. Combine all ingredients and simmer until well heated. Ladle mixture into warm pita bread, garnish with parsley and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,veal,parmigiano reggiano cheese,hot sauce,lamb,plain flour
title: Quick and Easy Low Fat Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs ground mixed up meats | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley | veal or lamb
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees celcius. Mix all of the dry ingredients together. Form into little balls and cook for 30 - 40 minutes on a cookie tray or on a griddle. Serve with your favourite sauce. Tip, make sure your oven is hot, otherwise your meatballs won't eat any extra sauce after cooking, however, if you do, they can just be kept in the fridge and cooked later.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,mussel,cherry tomato,balsamic vinegar,sesame seed,self rising white cornmeal
title: Saladi Kebabs
ingredients: 4 mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 5 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped | 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon self-rising white cornmeal
instructions: In a large bowl, mash together the mussels, cilantro, cherry tomatoes, sesame seeds and vinegar. Add the cornmeal and toss to distribute the ingredients. Place your hands on top of the mixture for a few seconds to help the cornmeal adhere to the meat. Shape into 8 meatballs a little over 1/2 inch diameter. Arrange on shallow baking sheets. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Bake for 20 minutes or until firm. Serve with salad, crusty bread or crackers.

title: Parsnips With Jam
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled and sliced | 9 ounces ham, cut into 1 inch pieces | 8 cans water chestnuts, drained | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon table salt or 1/2 teaspoon table salt
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and add the parsnip slices and ham. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes. Add the water chestnuts and cider vinegar and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes. Drain the parsnips and ham. Mince the parsnips and ham, adding them as necessary, just before serving the soup. Add salt as desired. Variation, sometimes i add finely chopped cheddar cheese to the soup while cooking.

Random Ingredients: white flour,green enchilada sauce,rice vinegar,allspice,italian seasoning,cake flour,savoy cabbage
title: Green Enchilada Cookies
ingredients: 1 package cake flour, sifted | 1/2 cup potato starch or 1/2 cup rice flour | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon white flour | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 -2 quart prepared green enchilada sauce or ( 8 ounce ) can green enchilada sauce | 2 cups shredded savoy cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine flours, italian seasoning and stir thoroughly. Add about half a cup enchilada sauce to the mixture and stir well. Add another 1/2 cup enchilada sauce and sour cream. Mix well. Roll dough out until it is 1/4 1/2 inch thick. Cut cookies by pinching off rounded 2 inch pieces of dough and then rolling the round into circles with rounded side facing you. Place on ungreased cookie tray and repeat until all cookies have been used. Place the remaining enchilada sauce at the bottom of a 9x13 baking pan/dutch oven on top of cookies and cover with enchilada sauce. Add cabbage on top and bake for 40 - 45 minutes until edges are golden.

title: Homemade Crispy Baking Powder
ingredients: 4 cups white sugar | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the baking powder with the sugar. Gradually stir in flour to make a stiff dough. Turn out onto cutting board, and cut into squares about 2 inches square. Use a cookie cutter, cut squares into diamond shapes. Sprinkle the tops with more baking powder. Let rest for about 15 minutes, then press down lightly, and remove if desired. Skins may be baked in a 400 degrees f oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or in a 9x13 inch pan for 8 to 10 minutes, or just dust with confectioners' sugar while warm.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork
ingredients: 500 g pork tenderloin | 150 g fresh sweet squash | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Cut roast into 6 pieces, lengthways and then crossways, into thick slices. Place the cubed pork into a glass bowl and pour over the vinegar. Add sweet squash and mix thoroughly. Cover the bowl and leave to marinade in the fridge for 4 - 7 hours, depending on how it is cooking. Drain the vegetables and grill until tender – about 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Cheaters Chocolate Polenta Pudding
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons brandy ( or rum ) | 1 jar rainbow nonpareils ( or more if you like ) | 1 1 cup polenta ( not quick-cooking ) | 2 teaspoons creme fraiche or 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon horseradish | 1/4 teaspoon cocoa powder
instructions: Heat a saucepan, or non stick skillet, on medium high heat. When very hot, add broth and brandy and reduce until almost all the liquid is evaporated, about 2 minutes. Add polenta, stirring frequently until it is well blended and smooth. Then add creme fraiche or mustard, horseradish & cocoa powder and whisk thoroughly. Reduce heat and simmer until thickened and creamy about 5 minutes. Serve warm with additional cocoa.

title: Savoury Almonds Rissoles
ingredients: 1 cup blanched almond ( a generous handful ) | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon barbeque sauce or 1 tablespoon ketchup
instructions: Grind almonds as fine as possible. Mix with other ingredients and refrigerate for 5 minutes. Heat oven to 180°c. Roll walnut sized balls, cut a small slit in the centre and place on a baking tray. Pour hot marinade into centre of each. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden brown. These are perfect served hot.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,italian tomato,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cannellini bean,tea,golden syrup,fennel seed
title: Pesto With Soba
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( chick peas, drained and rinsed ) | 1 can italian-style tomatoes ( preferably italian-style ) | 1 1/2 ounces fennel seeds ( about 6 whole ) | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 - 3/4 cup brewed tea | 1 package sugar snap peas, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Put beans, tomatoes, fennel, syrup, cheese, and tea into a food processor.

title: Mangal Vinaigrette (Vinaigrette With Golden-Coated Balsamic-Gurk
ingredients: 1 tablespoon galangal, chopped ( a fresh curry powder ) | 1 tablespoon garlic, chopped | 1 teaspoon white balsamic vinegar
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and let them sit for two hours. The vinegar will become stronger as your vinaigrette so take care to reserve a teaspoon or two for the balsamic vinegar dip. Keep refrigerated. If you are using a vinaigrette bottle, simply place the lid on the bottle and shake, shake, shake, shake, shake, shake, shake, shake, shake, shake.

Random Ingredients: granola cereal,beef bouillon cube,swiss cheese,topping,oatmeal,sharp cheddar cheese,thyme leave,tortilla
title: Granola Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 1 cup quick oats ( not instant ) | 3/4 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 3/4 cup granola cereal | 1/4 cup fresh thyme leave | 12 small tortillas | whole grain pickled swiss cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine bouillon cubes, thyme and oats in a large bowl. Add cheeses and blend very well with a fork. Gently fold in thyme and mix well. Spread about 2 tbsp of the cheese mixture evenly over the tortillas. Sprinkle with some of the granola. Fold quesadilla in half and place on a large, lightly oiled nonstick skillet. Cook in batches, about 3 minutes for each side or until lightly browned. While grilling, add remaining granola to a small skillet. Saute until golden brown and bubbly. Drain on paper towels and serve hot, hot or cold with pickled swiss cheese and a sprig of thyme.

title: Spaghetti with Beetroot Shredded Beef and Chorizo
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef ( optional ) or 1 lb turkey ( optional ) | 1/2 white onion, chopped finely | 1/2 cup blueberries or 1/2 cup raspberries | 1 package spaghetti ( broken up to fit ) or ( 10 ounce ) package linguine ( broken up to fit ) | 1/4 cup pecans, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram ( or oregano, if using rosemary and basil instead ) | 8 slices of barilla spanish chorizo sausages, sliced
instructions: In a large saucepan or dutch oven over medium heat, stir fry the beef, onion, pecans, marjoram and chorizo, breaking up the sausage as it simmers and browning them, adding just enough water or chicken broth to cover the meat. If using meat, add now and simmer for 10 minutes to blend the flavors. Cook the spaghetti or noodles in a large separate pot of boiling water, according to package directions. While the spaghetti is cooking, drain the bacon from its package, reserving some of the grease, and crumble it. Cook bacon, bacon fat or butter separately until bacon is crisp. Drain on paper towels. Turn on broiler. Transfer the beef mixture to a separate mixing bowl, add the cheese of choice, and toss lightly. Spread about a couple tablespoons of the chorizo mixture on each plate, scatter with bread crumbs, and place the plate in the broiler. Broil until nicely browned on top.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,couscous,snow pea,fine sugar,tomato soup,brown onion,pork loin chop
title: Fireside Looney Pork Casserole
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops, cut 3/4 inch thick | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/2 cup diced brown onion | 1 1/2 cups couscous | 4 ounces snow peas or 4 ounces green beans | 4 teaspoons fine sugar
instructions: Lightly butter a 13x9 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle pork with cocoa and arrange on top. In a large skillet, cook the onion and sugar over medium heat until golden brown. Add soup, and stir 1 minute over medium high heat. Add couscous, snow peas, and pork. Heat through. Pour mixture into prepared dish, and spread evenly. Cover and bake at 350f degrees for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake for 20 minutes longer or until internal temperature registers 160 degrees. In the meantime, uncover, and spoon hot sauce over top. Sprinkle with sugar, or to taste.

title: French Kiss Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted | 1/4 cup red wine | 2 hamburger buns
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients in a blender until smooth.

title: Jalapeno Pepper-Glazed Lettuce
ingredients: 1 cup chinese chinese style shredded lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup finely chopped jalapeno pepper | 3 teaspoons superfine sugar
instructions: In a large heavy duty frying pan, mix together the chinese style shredded lettuce and jalapeno pepper. Sprinkle the sugar over the top. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and set aside on a plate to dry. When ready to bake, heat the broiler. Remove wrap and broil until the sugar begins to caramelize. Drizzle the glaze over lettuce just before serving.

title: Kidney Bean & Eggplant
ingredients: 1/4 lb fresh mini marshmallows, chopped ( or to taste ) | 1 can kidney beans, rinsed & drained | 1/4 cup celery leaves, chopped | 1 globe eggplant
instructions: Slice the stem ends off the eggplants and discard. Wrap eggplant into foil.

title: Capellini With Fresh Lime and Coconut
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, plus 1 tsp. lemon rind | 10 -12 leaves capellini | 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 ounces light coconut, shaved
instructions: Heat the grill or oven to 400 degrees. Brush the inside of a large baking dish with 1/3 cup lime juice on a clean surface. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over low heat. Cook the capellini in the boiling water for 5 minutes, or until just tender but firm to the bite. Drain. Put a scoop of the cooked pasta onto a warm platter. Spread the remaining lime juice evenly over the hot pasta and top with the mozzarella and coconut. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,sesame oil,orange zest,cream cheese chive
title: Creamy Marinated Almond Cheese
ingredients: 15 ounces almond paste, such as bob's red mill, puree | 1/2 cup cream cheese with chives, softened | 2 tablespoons orange zest | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Combine almond paste, cream cheese, orange zest in a food processor. Process until well blended and creamy. Season generously with salt and pepper. Store a small amount of the cheese mixture for dipping. Chill unused remainder.

title: Quick Beef Empanadas
ingredients: 2 cans crescent dinner rolls, divided in half | 2 eggs | 1/2 cup diced raw beef | 1/2 cup vegetables or 1/2 cup turkey fat, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Coat 13x9 inch glass baking dish with non stick cooking spray. Unroll 1 can of crescent roll dough.

title: Minted Bean and Celery Soup
ingredients: 1 cup dried cannellini beans or 1 cup gigante beans | 1 cup of fresh bread and butter pickles | 1 cup chopped celery | 1 cup fresh leaf mint | 16 ounces bean sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Clean and rinse the cannellini beans. Place them in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and then reduce heat and simmer until the beans are cooked, about an hour. While the beans are cooking, toast the pickles. Remove them from their wrapper. Rinse with water. Drain, saving the water, and slice the pickles thinly and set aside. Add the bread and the celery to the beans, and heat through.

title: Tomatillo Sweet Tomatillo Sauce
ingredients: 4 firm tomatillos | 1 stalk celery | 3 teaspoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, combine sugar and oyster sauce. Peel, wash and coarsely chop the tomatillos. Cut celery stalk into about 2 inch lengths. Set them aside. Cut celery into 1/4 inch wide strips. Place the celery in a food processor with the tomatillo slices and process until smooth. Add salt and black pepper to taste. Store in the refrigerator. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,pico de gallo,feta,american cheese,cake flour,vegetable oil cooking spray,buttermilk
title: Cheese Sticks
ingredients: frosting : | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 cup crumbled american cheese | 1 cup crumbled feta ( optional ) | pico de gallo : | 1/4 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup cake flour | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: In bowl, combine buttermilk, cheese and feta. Stir in cheese and pecorino romano cheese. Sift cake flour onto plate.

title: Crazy Versatile Bread Machine (No Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 can dark raisins ( not syrup ) | 1 package active dry yeast
instructions: If you do not have a bread machine, use the dough hook of your breadmachine. Use water at the end of the last knead. If you do not have a bread machine, preheat the oven to 450°f. Place the raisins in a small bowl with a good amount of cold water and soak for 20 minutes. Drain the rinsed raisins well and add them to the bread machine. Add the dry yeast into a large mixing bowl. Allow the yeast to rise until doubled in volume about 40 - 45 minutes. Add about half of the hot raisins. When the dough has risen, transfer to the bread machine and select the dough cycle at the recommended speed. When the dough has doubled in volume, remove it from the bread machine to a lightly floured work surface and divide it into 8 pieces. Roll each piece into a 5x8 rectangle shape. Place the dough rectangle on a lightly floured baking sheet, cover with a clean, dry towel or plastic wrap, and leave to rise in a warm place for about 20 minutes, or until doubled in volume. Meanwhile, preheat your oven to 375°f. Lightly grease a large baking sheet. Place the 10 dough pieces on the baking sheet, spacing them about 3 inches apart. Sprinkle a couple of tablespoons of flour all over the dough. Bake the bread for about 30 to 40 minutes, or until pale golden on all sides. Allow the bread to cool slightly on the baking sheet, then remove to a wire rack. Sprinkle a couple of tablespoons of flour over the top of the bread to give the bread a rustic finish.

title: Guacamole With Avocados and Cheese - No Mayo Added
ingredients: 2 avocados, halved and seeded | 1 1/4 cups cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1/4 cup bottled guacamole
instructions: Preheat grill to high. Slice avocados half lengthways and scoop pulp into a medium bowl. Mash with a fork until smooth. Stir through cottage cheese, lemon pepper and flour until well combined. Divide mixture between two serving plates and top with guacamole.

title: Mixed Cakes - Hibiscus Biscuits
ingredients: 3/4 cup fine cornmeal | 1 cup dried hibiscus flowers or 1 cup mixed dried edible flower | 2 cups oil ( for frying )
instructions: Mix the cornmeal with the dried flowers in a food processor and then gradually work the cornmeal into the mixture. If too liquid, add water 1 tbsp at a time until mixture holds together. The mixture should be very fine. If too dry, add another tbsp of water. Roll 2 tablespoons of dough into balls the size of walnuts. Wash hands well. Flatten them gently with the smooth side of a glass. If the mixture holds its shape before the glass touches the surface, use a flat knife to gently lift the dough from the bowl. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan. Dip the cakes one by one into the oil and fry on both sides. Keep in a bowl covered with a towel to keep moist. Serve immediately with lavash or sweetened jam or jam and sugar or jam jelly. Variation, you can make your own cornmeal biscuit dough. For baking biscuits, knead 2/3 of cornmeal into the mixture with your hands. Divide mixture into 12 equal pieces. Roll each out on a floured surface into a circle, about 1/13 thick, adding 1 inch to the depth of the dough. Using an orange bladed knife, slice each circle into 7 - 8 smaller squares. For cooking biscuits, knead 2/3 of cornmeal in with the mixture and place on a floured surface. Using a fork or a pastry wheel, gently push or pull the dough square into the shape and size of the circle. Cook each biscuit circle on a hot, dry griddle or frying pan over low heat for 7 minutes, turning once, until golden brown. Remove from heat and keep warm in a 200f oven until all are cooked.

title: Simple Phyllo Cheese (No Boil)
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen phyllo pastry ( thawed and buttered for ease of cleanup ) | 1 can coconut milk ( drained ) | 1 package crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Grease a 12x18 baking pan and cover with plastic wrap. On a clean work surface lay out a sheet of phyllo, brushing with some of the melted copious from the coconut milk can. Cover with another sheet of phyllo, brushing each one with some butter and a little more. Repeat with more phyllo, buttering each one. Spread coconut milk over phyllo, leaving a 2 or 3 inch border of phyllo at the top. Cover with the feta and top with a layer of phyllo. Carefully fold over all the edges to completely enclose the feta. Pinch the edges to seal and then sprinkle with the remaining butter. Slap onto the prepared pan and bake in 400f oven 20 - 25 minutes, or until crisp and golden. Allow to cool and enjoy with a good pike, chutney or preserves.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,bay leaf,tomato green chilies,grain white rice,gruyere cheese,moose,head garlic,artichoke heart
title: Maggie Beer's Wild Rice and Cheese Soup
