ingredients: 1 whole head of garlic ( about 2 1/2 pounds ) | 2 cans stewed tomatoes with green chilies | 1 jar prepared meat-flavored beef gravy | 1 bay leaf | 1 tablespoon whole grain white rice | 1 1/2 pounds moose, neck bones, with rind and silverskin, sliced into 1-inch lengths | 1 pound ground beef round | 3 cups sliced fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Remove the top layer of garlic from the head and discard. Place the heads, cloves, and bay leaf in a large plastic bag or paper coffee filter that is close to the surface. Heat the tomatoes with juice, beef gravy, and bay leaf in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: pear,chipotle chile,quinoa,bell pepper,ice,golden raisin,garlic salt,serrano pepper
title: Chipotle Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 8 ounces quinoa, raw | 1 cup diced pears | 1 serrano pepper, diced ( about 1 tbsp ) | 3 chipotle chiles, diced | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 bell pepper, chopped | ice, to cover casserole
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions, add pears, serrano pepper, chipotles, and raisins and cover with about 2 cups water. Bring liquid to a boil over high heat, stir once, cover, reduce heat, and simmer 45 minutes. Fluff quinoa with fork and serve topped with your favorite garnishes.

title: A Unique and Yummy Thai Spinach Rice Bowl
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 1/4 cup watermelon, chopped | 1/2 cup torn fresh spinach leaves | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1/2 - 2/3 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Add ingredients to rice cooker or rice cooker. Select sweet rice setting, close lid and fluff rice to make sure it mixes to rice and water evenly. Close lid and stir. Do not lift lid during cooking if you have the time. Let sit while rice is soaking and rest and rice can be served.

Random Ingredients: swiss miss diet cocoa mix,feta cheese,celery salt,beetroot,cayenne pepper,spaghetti,veal
title: Dee's Hot Feta Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups feta cheese, in 1-inch cubes | 1 lb ground veal | 1 lb swiss miss diet cocoa mix | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 package spaghetti, cooked and drained ( reserve 1/2 of the pasta water ) | 1 can beets, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Using a 9x9 inch glass baking dish spread the cheese and ground mince evenly. Mix together the cocoa powder, celery salt and cayenne and sprinkle over the meat mixture. Layer spaghetti over cheese mix and scatter beets on top. Cook the pizza crust in the oven about 15 minutes. Cut at least one inch square from the top and serve warm.

title: Traditional Thai Fried Onion Rings
ingredients: 6 large onions | 1 tablespoon nam pla | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Trim the onions of the root end and the thick part of each slice. If they are large place them into a steamer basket and cover with the cup. Cover and leave for around 20 minutes. Traditionally place the onions in a lightly oiled deep frying pan or wok. Pour the nam pla over the onions and add a cup of boiling water. Cover and leave to stand for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, sprinkle the flour, bicarbonate of soda and some seasoning into the onions and gently toss with a fork to mix. Tip the pan mixture into a hot frying pan and fry the onions, in batches, for around 5 - 7 minutes or until golden.

title: Mouthwatering Lemon Ginger Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup simple syrup | 1 cup finely chopped peeled fresh ginger | 1 cup grated lemon peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan, and bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until ginger is very soft and syrupy, 30 to 60 minutes. Let cool. Serve with fish or chicken.

title: Artichokes and Potatoes
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can quartered artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice
instructions: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Add the potato and artichoke hearts, and return to the boil. Cook until the potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, and return the cooked potatoes and artichoke hearts to the pot. Stir in the pomegranate juice and remove from the heat. Serve warm.

title: Paleo Mung Beans (Kanabiedes)
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 jars mung bean sprouts, drained | 1/2 lb mung beans | 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted and peeled | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice ( cinnamon and nutmeg ) | 1/4 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Place beans in a large saucepan or pot and cover with enough water to cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, partially cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Combine the beans and sprouts in a food processor or a blender and process until fairly smooth and creamy. Add in the mung bean sprouts. Stir in in the walnuts and spices. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lentil,chile pepper,yukon gold potato,baby bok choy
title: Lentil-Baby Bok Choy and Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 package baby bok choy | 12 stalks baby yukon gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup lentils | 2 fresh chile peppers, seeded and minced | 1/2 teaspoon minced chile pepper
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Mix in the bok choy and cook 30 seconds over medium heat. Pour into a colander and rinse with cold water. Lay the bok choy on a cutting board. Trim the root ends, then slice each one in half lengthwise. Lay the potato pieces on the cut side of a cutting board, overlapping the cut surface to form a square. Starting at the square, cut a 1 inch square from the root end to end, then slice the slices crosswise until they look like shrimps. Using a toothpick or sharp paring knife, remove the toothbone. Place the potatoes into the boiling water and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain water and place the lentils in a saucepan with 1 cup water and 1 teaspoon chile pepper. Cover and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer gently until the lentils are tender, about 15 minutes. Stir once just before removing the pan from the heat. Stir in the minced green chile pepper and stir until sauce is well blended. Serve hot. For dipping, mix the red onion in a bowl with 1/4 inch water and 1 teaspoon chile pepper and sprinkle on top of each serving.

Random Ingredients: chive,red wine vinegar,pumpkin puree,jasmine rice,coconut cream
title: Sweet and Spicy Coconut Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked long-grain jasmine rice, chilled and chilled | 1 can pumpkin puree, chilled | 1 1/2 - 2 cups coconut cream, chilled | 2 1/2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives, or more to taste
instructions: Toss the rice with the pumpkin in a bowl. Stir in the coconut cream, vinegar and chives. Chill the salad, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: onion,potato,broccoli,cider vinegar,onion powder,anise seed,red currant jelly,caster sugar
title: Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 sweet potatoes | 4 cups broccoli, cut into florets | 1 onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 4 tablespoons red currant jelly | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 1 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Boil the sweet potatoes until soft, drain and cool. Cook the broccoli in boiling water for 2 mins rinse under cold water and drain. Place all the ingredients except the redcurrant jelly and vinegar mix into a pan on high heat. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 5 mins stirring occasionally, stirring all the time. Pour the hot mixture into a large serving bowl and cool. Add the redcurrant jelly to the broccoli mixture and then stir in the vinegar. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss well.

title: Homemade Beer
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, separated into florets | 1 can beer ( recommended -- yuengling ) | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Poke holes all over cauliflower with a fork, then place cauliflower in a colander and rinse under cold water.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,taco seasoning mix,white pepper,graham cracker crumb,pepperoni
title: Quick and Easy Taco Balls
ingredients: 10 slices pepperoni | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix ( i use goya brand ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed | 1 pinch white pepper | 1 package graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Spread a tablespoon of taco seasoning on half of the pepperoni slices. Sprinkle with dill weed and white pepper. Place graham crackers in an even layer on top of the pepperoni. Repeat with a second half of the pepperoni and the third layer. These can be served immediately, hot or cold with dipping sauces such as guacamole, ranch dressing or just if using ice cream to make taco meatballs.

title: Easy Low Fat Cajun Style White Tuna

instructions: Combine all ingredients or blend. For a thicker consistency add up to 1/2 tsp each of the sugar and soy sauce before you start to blend. Random Ingredients: baby carrot,graham cracker crumb,white corn,chipotle pepper,red pepper,topping,rosemary
title: Taco Spread
ingredients: 1 package frozen baby carrots, thawed and drained | 1 can white corn, drained | 1 can crushed chipotle peppers | 1/4 cup chopped cooked sweet red pepper | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread carrots in a 9x13 inch baking dish on a cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until softened and brown, 5 to 10 minutes. Spread frozen corn, crushed chipotle chiles, sweet red peppers, and fresh rosemary between pieces of reynolds wrap aluminum foil. Bake until hot, 12 to 15 minutes. Spread caramelized carrots over the caramelized carrots, cover, and return to oven, and bake 5 minutes more. Remove foil from the baking dish and sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over the carroized carrots, recover, and continue to bake 20 minutes more. Cool, and store leftovers in refrigerator up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: escarole,parmigiano reggiano cheese,rice wine,green bell pepper,white sugar,button mushroom,molasses
title: Mushroom and Broccoli Sprouts Casserole
ingredients: 1 head escarole, shredded | 1/2 cup chopped green bell pepper | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 can button mushrooms, drained and chopped | 1 cup uncooked instant rice wine | 1 cup molasses | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place shredded escarole in a medium bowl, and pour the green pepper over them. Stir to combine, then spread the green pepper mixture onto the bottom of an 8x8 inch baking dish. Mix together the white sugar, mushrooms, rice wine, molasses, and grated cheese in a bowl. Spread over the green pepper mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, about 30 minutes. Allow to cool for 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,sea salt,thai fish sauce,chipotle powder,italian breadcrumb,seasoning salt,lentil,spinach pasta
title: Spinach and Lentils (Tzatziki_Tzatziki)
ingredients: 1 lb spinach pasta or 1 lb egg roll, cooked according to package directions ( 9 cups cooked ) | 1 1/2 cups cooked lentils | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon mrs. dash seasoning salt ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1 -2 tablespoon thai fish sauce ( kupap manis ) | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Drain the cooked and cooled spinach or pasta of any kind and place in a large mixing bowl. Add lentils, bread crumbs, and spices. Mix well, stir in the fish sauce. Add yogurt and mix again well.. Refrigerate covered until ready to serve.

title: Spicy Vegetable Sauce (Nahmac)
ingredients: 1/16 cup barberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup diced yellow squash ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 teaspoon dried thai chiles ( or other chili ) | 1 cup mixed vegetables
instructions: Place barberries in medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,taco seasoning,cooking oat,pecorino romano cheese,steak,israeli couscous
title: Mini Greek Steak and Oat Burritos (Greek-Style)
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, very thinly sliced crosswise | 1 package taco seasoning | cooked quick-cooking rolled oats | 1/2 - 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | israeli couscous
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f brush oil over each side of the steak slices on both sides and place in a 10 inch or 11 inch cast iron skillet with about 1 inch between the rack and the pan. Cook steak in batches over medium high heat until browned on all sides, about 3 to 4 minutes per side for rare or 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare. Transfer cooked steak to a platter and cover tightly with foil. Return skillet to medium heat and add taco seasoning and 2 tablespoons water. Simmer until water is absorbed, about 6 minutes. Spoon off excess liquid and add remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons water. Return steak to skillet and add rice or couscous. Stir until hot. Spoon some oat mixture down the center of each steak slice, then spoon with 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons cheese over mixture. Serve. Repeat with remaining steak.

title: Blueberry Pita Breads
ingredients: 1 pita bread ( or flat bread ) | blueberries
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Take two pita breads, and carefully cut them in half. Hollow out two halves of the pita or flat bread, place it in an ovenproof bowl, then put a spoonful of blueberries in the middle, and a sprinkling of blueberries. Broil them under the broiler 1 - 2 minutes or until the bread is toasted as desired, and the berries are bubbling. Watch them carefully, they burn fast.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,monterey jack pepper cheese,sesame oil,potato flour,chat masala,red chilies,paprika
title: Spicy Sweet Potato Chapati
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs potatoes ( white, red parts, yams, any sweet potato, your choice ) | 1/4 cup paprika | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( i use mccormick's montreal & perrins smoked ) | 2 -3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon chat masala ( curry powder ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground red chilies or 2 -3 drops tabasco diablos pepper sauce | 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Peel potato and cut into 1 in cubes. Place the potatoes in a colander and squeeze out excess moisture.

title: Saffron Dressing
ingredients: 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup cucumber, diced | 1 can tomato juice | 1/4 cup chopped celery
instructions: Combine with remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,panir,coriander seed,red chili pepper flake,sirloin tip roast,lettuce,onion
title: Spiceful Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, sliced thinly against grain | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 1/4 cup sweet onion, sliced thinly | 1/4 cup finely chopped coriander seed | 1 tablespoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | shredded lettuce ( to garnish ) | shredded panir ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium. If you are grilling, turn on and lightly mist the grate before you begin any preparations. Lay the slices of beef out and slice thinly. Put sliced meat on the grill and cook for 10 - 12 minutes. When done, set up sandwich meat on a plate. Spread each sandwich with sun dried tomato oil, onion, coriander seeds and red pepper flakes. Put a couple of lettuce leaves on each sandwich, then spoon the beef roll up and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,purpose flour,breadcrumb,puff pastry,phyllo pastry,garlic clove,sunflower oil peanut,brown button mushroom
title: Vegetable Kugel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 garlic clove, finely chopped | 12 ounces brown button mushrooms, halved | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f degrees. Lightly grease a 7 - ½ x 11 - ¼ inch baking pan. Mix the oil, maple syrup and garlic together in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until the garlic is fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring, until golden, 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Place half of the puff pastry in the pan, leaving an inch or two around the edge of the pan. Sprinkle with half of the mushroom mixture and sprinkle with half of the flour. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Top with remaining pastry sheets and brush with oil. Bake 45 - 55 minutes or until golden and puffed. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,pork sparerib,italian turkey sausage,egg white,garlic powder
title: Asian Sausage Sticks
ingredients: 2 pounds pork spareribs | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1 egg white, beaten | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 6 links sweet italian turkey sausage
instructions: Place the country style pork spareribs between two sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap. Using a meat pounder, or sharp knife, flatten the meat until it is 1/4 inch thick. Set aside. Heat the sesame oil in a skillet set over medium heat. Whisk in the egg white and garlic powder until blended. Bring to a simmer.

Random Ingredients: black bean,cottage cheese,chicken breast strip,serrano chilies,cucumber,vanilla essence,half,besan
title: Honey Chipits Enchipona
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese | 10 serrano chilies | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 400 g chicken breast strips, chopped | 300 g feta | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 200 g half-and-half, warmed ( if desired, we've always used low fat ) | 1 cucumber
instructions: Chop the chilies very finely. Put all ingredients into blender and blend smooth. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving so that the chilies permeate the cheese before serving. Best prepared several hours in advance so the chilies keep in a separate, separate, clear place.

Random Ingredients: rhubarb,canadian bacon,sourdough bread,chicken leg,sugar snap pea,maple syrup,onion soup mix,romaine lettuce
title: Maple Syrup Chicken
ingredients: 1 package onion soup mix | 12 chicken legs | 4 slices smoked canadian bacon, cut across on the diagonal | 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 head romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped | 3 cups sliced rhubarb, chopped | 1 loaf sourdough bread
instructions: Whisk first 3 ingredients in large saucepan. Add chicken and marinate in refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight, stirring occasionally. Remove chicken from marinade and grill 6 minutes per side or until done.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,chicken breast,taco seasoning,self rising flour,dark chocolate,tomato puree
title: Easy Smoked Tacos
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 2 tablespoons smokey liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1 whole skinless chicken breast, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. In a shallow baking dish, whisk together the flour, taco seasoning, chocolate, tomato puree, and smokey smoke. Place the chicken in the mixture. Place the baking dish on the middle rack of the oven. Cook for 10 minutes, then remove the baking sheet from the oven. Place the chicken on the baking sheet, and continue cooking for 10 minutes, or until the chicken is no longer pink in the center. Flip the chicken, and cook for another 10 minutes, or until the temperature of the chicken increases. Top the chicken with more smokey smokey, and return to the oven until the cheese is bubbly and beginning to brown.

title: Spanish Smoked Ham
ingredients: 1 ham | kitchen bouquet ( enough to moisten ham ) | chili powder
instructions: Remove fat from ham. Rub ham with kitchen bouquet. Cook ham in smoker or oven, until desired temperature is reached. While ham is cooking, saute desired amount of spicy hot peppers or jalapeno and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,ginger garlic paste,chili oil,shrimp paste
title: Shrimp Paste (Qaht Ma Lahmi)
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp paste, 1 inch size | 1 cup tomato juice or 2 tablespoons tomato juice | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste ( i've found that if you grind it like me the garlic will give that a sweeter dish for shrimp ) | chili oil ( for frying, i prefer lite & olive oil )
instructions: In a large mortar, grind shrimp paste together with a pinch of chili oil. I usually grind it by hand to a paste consistency & mix in a small amount of water before adding it to food. Transfer to a pot & stir in the tomato & ginger garlic paste. Note, if using tomato juice, place a small saucepan over high heat & add a generous amount of peanut oil. Add paste to the tomatoes & stir until the paste begins to brown & blister. Adjust your heat to very low. Allow to simmer until the sauce is thickened & there are no lumps & the shrimp paste is done. Variation, add 2/3 cup chicken stock to bring the flavor out of the tomatoes before you pour it into a pan & cook the paste with the stock.

Random Ingredients: creole seasoning,plain nonfat yogurt,cilantro leaf,thyme,beef tenderloin
title: Cilantro Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 teaspoons creole-style seasoning ( mccormicks montreal brand ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf
instructions: Combine creole style seasoning and thyme in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,water,salami,artichoke heart,vegetable oil cooking spray,pecan,mango chutney,white wine
title: Julia Child's Stuffed Squash(Cook's Illust
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 medium yellow squash, halved lengthwise and cut about 1/4 inch thick crosswise | 1/2 cup ground pecans | 5 ounces salami, shredded and sliced small | 6 ounces cooked artichoke hearts, chopped ( may be canned, drained ) | 1/2 cup white wine ( or a good red if you have it ) | 1 cup water ( may need more to cover the bottom or level of the pan ) | mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a baking sheet with vegetable oil cooking spray. Prepare a squash by removing the stalk and bottom from the halved squash half way through. Cut in half lengthwise and remove seeds. Using a large spoon make holes over the tops of the squash halves, spaced about 1/4 inch apart, using toothpicks. Spray or brush squash with vegetable oil cooking spray. Roast in center of oven about 30 minutes, turning at approxurrant times until tender. Remove from oven and let cool completely. Using a slotted spoon remove the seeds and tops from the squash. In a large mixing bowl combine all the other ingredients and add the cooked squash and stuffing mixture. Toss gently to combine. Spoon stuffing into prepared baking sheet and top with mango chutney. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until hot and bubbling and stuffing is warmed through.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,lobster tail,bulk italian sausage,ginger garlic paste,vanilla extract,cumin powder,cayenne pepper
title: Low Fat and Easy Spicy Lobster Tail
ingredients: 15 -20 medium lobster tails, cooked and peeled | 1/2 tablespoon vanilla extract | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | cayenne pepper, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour over or in large flat glass container and place in refrigerator until needed. The tails can be served with any seafood that you prefer. Note, the tails can also be served as a sandwich using cooked lobster tails.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,lamb stew meat,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Lamb and Whitefish With Cheddar
ingredients: 1 lamb stew meat | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese | 16 ounces sea bass fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lay the lamb stew meat out on a cutting board. Cut a hole in the fatty center of the meat. Dunk the meat into the oil and season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,peppercorn,vegetable oil,raspberry,wheat flour,green lentil,green bean
title: Thai-Style Lentils and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry green lentils | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1/3 cup green split peas, washed | 5 -10 peppercorns | 3 -4 tablespoons fish sauce, to taste | 1/3 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup raspberries, washed and drained
instructions: Place lentils in a large bowl and cover with 4 - 4 cups water or enough to double the amount of lentils. Leave to soak in the refrigerator overnight. Drain. Toast peppercorns in a dry wok until they darken and aromatic. Allow to cool.

title: Caribbean Fried Onions
ingredients: 4 medium size green apples ( about 3 lb ) | 6 tablespoons shredded coconut oil ( or 1-2 cups, more may be needed ) | 1 medium white onion, thinly sliced ( i use frozen slices i use an asian slicer ) | 2 tablespoons chopped pickle juice ( i use about 1 teaspoon )
instructions: Peel, core and cut the apples into 1/2 inch slices. Slice the onion thinly. Heat the coconut oil in a large nonstick skillet or wok. When oil is hot, add the onions and cook over high heat, stirring frequently, until golden brown.

title: Roasted Saffron Sage Powder
ingredients: 500 g fresh sage | 600 g orange zest | 500 g saffron strands
instructions: Place all of the ingredients, except saffron, into a food processor and pulse until well combined, stopping occasionally to scrape down the sides. Divide into 4 portions and freeze for one or two months.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,extra virgin olive oil,chili oil,spanish chorizo
title: Spicy Mexican Chorizo
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 3 -4 garlic cloves, pressed | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 lb spanish chorizo, sliced into 2-3-inch pieces
instructions: In a wok, heat the olive oil. Add the garlic and chili oil, stir fry until aromatic. Add the chorizo, stirring it constantly. Reduce heat and cook for about 2 minutes or until some of the chorizo is slightly crisp.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,sherry wine,green chili pepper,heavy cream,hot sausage
title: Sloaked Brains
ingredients: 10 -12 whole hard-boiled eggs | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 tablespoon chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1 lb hot sausage, sliced thinly and fried
instructions: Remove yolks from hard boiled eggs and mash them with a fork, you will need a fork for rather firm texture, you don’t need to mash too hard with your hand. Add sherry, green chili, and heavy cream and mix thoroughly. In a greased 9 x 13 baking dish “salt”, spray the top lightly with oil. Spread sausage on the mashed yolk mixture, then cover with the sausage. Bake at 400 degrees about 45 minutes. Serve warm with guacamole on top.

Random Ingredients: feta,brown sugar,sesame oil,lemon juice zest,corn kernel,pork sausage,cumin seed
title: Corn and Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage | 3/4 cup corn kernel | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 lemon, juice and zest of ( zest from an entire lemon ) | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 teaspoon cumin seeds ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil
instructions: Wash and shred the sausage into bite sized pieces. In a large bowl, combine all the other ingredients together, and mix until the sugar is completely dissolved. Let sit for a few minutes to let the seeds release their flavor. Add the chopped sausage, mix together until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least about 10 to 15 minutes for the flavors to develop and blend. Lightly flour the counter or work surface to remove the excess flour. Using a wet knife, score the marinated meat on skewers several times until the skewer is 1/8 inch thick. Preheat a grill or broiler. Use your hands to mix it in so the corn and sausage cook evenly. Grill or broil until done to taste.

title: Thai Cornflour Seasoning for Fish.
ingredients: 6 cups cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Mix the cornflour with a little water or white wine to make a smooth paste. Add a little white wine to dry ingredients. Taste and add more if desired. Brush on fish and grill or broil until crisp.

title: Faux Churros (Faux Spicy Quesadillas)
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder ( optional )
instructions: Pour oil into skillet on medium high heat. Add turmeric. Dip the quesadilla into the oil. Let cook about 50 seconds or until the underside is a light golden brown. Turn over, and cook 50 seconds more. Turn other side, and cook about another 50 seconds, or until golden brown. Pour the sherry onto the quesadilla.

title: Fish in Red Gravy
ingredients: 600 g skinless salmon fillets | 2 teaspoons plain flour | 2 cups canned chopped tomatoes with puree | 1 tablespoon tomato puree
instructions: Toss the chopped salmon pieces with flour and sea salt and pepper in a bowl. Pour half the tomato puree into a heavy saucepan and add the rest of the tomato puree. Stir well then bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Set aside in a bowl and skim off any cooking oil and then return the fish and all the juices to the pan and stir. Return to the same pan and bring to the boil. Sprinkle with the remaining puree. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce is reduced by about half. Serve with boiled potatoes or boiled or steamed veggies if liked.

title: Taste of Thai Style Almond Nuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup toasted sliced almonds or 1/2 cup toasted sliced almonds, toasted, flake | 1 tablespoon horseradish mustard | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram or 1/4 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 cup coconut cream
instructions: Toast the almonds or sunflwer them lightly. Place them in your blender add the remaining ingredients. Blend well until well mixed. Transfer in sterilized jar and store in fridge.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,icing sugar,pecan,conch,thyme sprig,plain yogurt,canola oil
title: Crispy Fingers
ingredients: 200 g icing sugar | 1 1/2 cups confghans ( plain greek powdered sugar ) or 1 1/2 cups walnuts | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 sprig thyme sprig | 2 sheets large dried flaky cookies | 25 g crystall pieces, finely chopped | 1/2 cup pecans or 1/2 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Process icing sugar & confghans/greek powdered sugar together in a food processor until it forms a coarse dough. Divide dough in 20 portions and roll each portion into a log. Cut log into eight slices. Place 1/2 teaspoon pecans or 1/4 cup walnuts in a bowl and mix with the cardamon and ground cardamom. Cut the biscuit diagonally into 8 biscuits. Brush each biscuit with the mixture, avoiding the edges. Place 2 teaspoons of the crystallised sugar in the centre of 6 of the biscuit slices. Place 2 biscuits on top of each other using a spatula. Place remaining biscuits on top of each other and press lightly. Cut each biscuit diagonally into fingers. Place cookies in a shallow dish and cover with the crystallised sugar icing. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Remove the cookies from the pan and store in an airtight container. Serve with fresh yogurt.

title: Spanish Tapas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry port wine
instructions: Put wine in a saucepan and mix to blend. Heat over medium heat for 30 seconds, add port. Cook until mixture is almost evaporated. Serve in martini glasses.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,shrimp,marsala wine,tangerine,anise seed,basmati rice,strawberry
title: Rice With Tangerines, Strawberries and Marsala Wine
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice ( arborio, carnaroli or rice ) | 3 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained ( may find this if your kitchen is climate controlled ) | 1/3 cup dried tangerine, cut into 3 in squares | 2 large fresh tangerines ( use fresh, or frozen ) | 6 fresh small shrimp, cooked, shelled, deveined and halved | 1 cup chilled light-colored marsala wine ( or sherry ) | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, toasted | 2 cups fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions. Place tangerine halves and shrimp in a large serving bowl.

title: Best Ever Basil Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup fresh basil leaf | 2 cans tomato sauce | 2 teaspoons tamari ( or light soy sauce )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and process until smooth.

title: Sauerkraut and Corn
ingredients: 2 packages shell pasta, broken into 2 inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups sauerkraut - drained and rinsed | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 1/2 cups creme fraiche
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,pepperoni,phyllo pastry,vegetable broth,shallot,sun tomato oil
title: Bacon, Potato, and Pepperoni Samosas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 shallot, minced | 1 sheet frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 6 strips uncooked bacon strips | 1/2 pound frozen pepperoni, thawed | 2 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped
instructions: Heat broth in a small, heavy saucepan over medium low heat until hot. Reduce heat to low. Stir shallot into broth.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,kalamata olive,almond extract,cream tartar,stir fry sauce,cranberry
title: Quick and Easy Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons quick and easy stir fry sauce | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 3/4 cup chopped dried cranberries | 1/3 cup pitted kalamata olive, sliced
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients. Microwave at medium for 20 seconds or until hot, stirring after 5 seconds to coat almonds. Mix well. Stir into sauce. Serve warm or cool, cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Will keep in the refrigerator 1 week.

Random Ingredients: hijiki,white bread,coffee,rag pasta sauce,serrano pepper,tortilla chip,olive oil,coconut cream
title: Vito's Favourite Quesadilla Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb jamaica roll | 4 tablespoons grated fresh coconut cream | 4 teaspoons olive oil | 1 serrano pepper, finely chopped | 1 lb dry white bread, crust removed | 1 package refrigerated gourmet tortilla chips ( such as jiffy ) | 2 cups store bought taco-type refried beans | 1/2 cup prepared hot coffee
instructions: Remove the roll from its package, cut the roll into 8 slices, and place them at least 2 inches apart on large paper towels. Wipe the paper towel and place the roll in one layer on a cutting board or plastic cutting board and lightly sprinkle a little salt on the roll. Place the roll on top of the paper towels and sprinkle with a little more salt. Place another cutting board or plastic board, and then another cutting board, again lightly sprinkle with salt. Working quickly, remove the roll from the cutting board with tongs and cut it with a serrano chile or other hot pepper until it is thinly sliced along the horizontal line of the sliced pepper. Do not discard the stem ends of the pepper as this will leave the pepper easy to remove later. You may need to scrape off the seeds before the peppers are cooked. If you use leftover pepper slices, remove the stem from the peppers after they are done and do not clean out the pepper thoroughly. Prepare the gourmet tortilla chips according to the directions on the package. Lay them on a large, flat plate and sprinkle with a small amount of the shredded coconut cream. Set a piece of white bread at the bottom of a large bowl. Place a portion of the fried pickle noodles on the bread, and top with a portion of the hot refried beans. Repeat for each bowl of noodles used. Serve immediately in the bowl with the chips.

title: Gingerbread Dessert - Chokladbollar - German Chocolate!
ingredients: 14 ounces milk chocolate ( use 1/2 a tin of milk chocolate if liked ) or 14 ounces milk chocolate, i prefer milk chocolate
instructions: Put a metal rack on a baking tray. Break up the block of milk chocolate into small even pieces. Beat with a mixer until very smooth. Pour into the tray. Wait for it to set then pour the chocolate on top. Let stand in the fridge for at least an hour. If it sets very stiff then break up with a clean dishtowel. Top with whipped cream if you like. You may also wish to use a spoon or a fork for creamier desserts.

title: Vodka
ingredients: 1/2 ounce red serrano chilies, finely chopped | 1 ounce vodka
instructions: Place the chilies into a pestle and mortar, and pound roughly until the chilies are finely chopped, and smooth. Add the vodka, and pound through a fine nylon or nylon sieve. Alternatively, make a long thin rub by soaking the rinds in a clean, dark pan for 15 to 30 minutes and wiping any excess vodka off the chilies before adding to the vodka. Store in sterile sterilized bottles in a cool dark place.

title: Moroccan Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb rump steak, very finely sliced | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand | 1 tablespoon sriracha hot water | 1 package phyllo pastry
instructions: Lay out the sheets of the phyllo pastry on 2 baking sheets. Place the beef in a bowl with 1/2 tsp water, 1/2 tbsp saffron, and 1 tbsp sriracha. Toss to coat, then season to taste. Place 2 sheets of pastry, overlapping, over the meat. Roll up the pastry, beginning at the short end, rolling firmly. Repeat this procedure, finishing to roll the meat over the pastry. Preheat oven to 400°f. Place the rolls seam side down in a large baking dish. Bake for 40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Easy Microwave Peas and Carrots in Seasoning
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | seasoning salt
instructions: Microwave vegetables on high for 2½ to 3 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with lemon extract.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,virgin olive oil,vegetable broth,shiitake mushroom,cauliflower,chicken bouillon granule,coconut water,chicken stock
title: Cauliflower, Shiitake and Coconut Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 4 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 3 cups cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped | 8 ounces unsweetened dried unsweetened coconut water | 2 tablespoons coconut milk or 2 tablespoons coconut cream
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine broth, chicken base, and olive oil with 1/4 cup water and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare cauliflower florets, then cook them in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain. Cut cauliflower into 1 1/2 inch wedges, then put all the wedges in a bowl with the cauliflower. Reserve the broth. Place soup in batches in a large saucepan, and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes or until soup is thickened. Discard any remaining soup base. Ladle soup into bowls and garnish with coconut water or coconut cream, if desired. Note, coconut water is needed to remove the water needed to cook the cauliflower and coconut into the cooking broth. For more health benefits, stir fried potatoes can be mixed with equal amounts of cooked cauliflower and coconut.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,limeade concentrate,sesame seed,chicken stock,red yellow bell pepper,blueberry
title: Blueberry and Onion Soup
ingredients: 6 cups low sodium chicken stock | 6 tablespoons frozen limeade concentrate | 1 medium spanish onion, chopped fine | 1 red yellow bell pepper, chopped fine | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: In a large saucepot, combine broth, limeade concentrate, onion, red pepper and sesame oil. Bring to boiling.

title: Pork Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lovage | 1 tablespoon ginger paste, grated
instructions: Mix well and store in an air tight container.

Random Ingredients: bean,catsup,peanut butter,yogurt,vegetable broth,green bean,manchego cheese,spanish olive
title: Spanish Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1/2 cup low sodium vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons low sodium greek yogurt or 2 tablespoons plain yogurt, to taste | 1/3 cup manchego cheese, grated ( i use a blend of parmesan and goat cheese ) | 2 tablespoons green beans, sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup spanish olives, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Pour the first six ingredients into a mixing bowl and stir until well combined. Mix in the cheese. Pour the other ingredients into a small baking dish. Sprinkle with the olives and then top with the cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes, until the cheese is nicely melted and bubbly. Serve at room temperature. Note, you can make this in advance and put it in the freezer for later use. Note, it is possible to freeze a portion and place it in a plastic freezer bag for a day.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,green chili pepper,salmon,baking powder,spring green
title: Grilled Salmon or Fish With Chile, Green and Chile
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon green chili pepper, minced | 2 spring greens | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili peppers | 2 tablespoons cooked salmon
instructions: Cut the poblano into thin strips. Heat the grill. In a bowl with a sprinkling of salt, combine the poblano, chili, spring greens, green chili peppers and baking powder. Drizzle with oil and grill for 4 - 5 minutes on each side.

title: Lazy Italian Bread
ingredients: 3 loaves italian bread crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives | 1 package frozen sliced peppers or ( -10 ounce ) package roasted peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray or oil cooking spray. In a medium size bowl, mix the first five ingredients together. On a cutting board, slice the frozen peppers through the center of each pepper so that it will sit out on the cut surface. With your fingers, push between the pepper slices. You should end up with 8 or 10 pepper slices. Place pepper slices in a single layer in a 9x13 inch baking dish. I use disposable foil and bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until the tops are lightly golden.

title: Green Beans and Lamb Nachos
ingredients: 1 bag of tortilla chips, broken into pieces | 2 lbs ground lamb or 2 lbs pork meat, of your choice | 1 can green beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl combine ground meat and the beans to coat. Place one bag of tortilla chips on a sheet pan lined with a parchment paper and top with 1/3 of the meat mixture. Repeat this layer, making sure to coat the entire bag of tortilla chips. Place tortilla chips in oven for approx 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and immediately add remaining meat mixture.

title: Greek Yogurt Dressing for Fish, Chips & Shrimp or Potatoes
ingredients: 200 g greek yogurt | 200 ml natural yoghurt | 1 2/3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 20 g natural yoghurt | 2 tablespoons sparkling water | 1/4 tablespoon caster sugar or 1/4 tablespoon superfine sugar
instructions: Combine yoghurt with balsamic and caster sugar and mix well to combine. Stir in sparkling water and pour into a glass jar or cruet. Allow to sit for at least 1 hour so flavors can blend. Shake well.

title: Maple Syrup Dessert Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup reduced fat half-and-half | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained & chopped
instructions: In a 4 cup widemouthed jar, combine the half & half, dijon mustard, maple syrup, and cherries. Shake well to combine. Let stand at room temp for 10 to 15 minutes to blend flavors.

title: My Favorite Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb shell pasta, about 1 in by 3/4-inch | 1/3 cup dry sherry, plus more for serving | 2 ounces cooked small fresh mushrooms ( optional ) or 2 ounces canned mushrooms, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a full rolling boil over high heat. Add the pasta and cook, stirring until al dente and well drained, about 1 minute. Drain and return to the hot cooking pot. Add the sherry and stir to combine. Serve warm.

title: Shredded Mexican Squash
ingredients: 6 cups cubed red squash | 1 can corned beef broth or ( 10 ounce ) can chicken broth | 1/3 cup a.1. original sauce or 1/3 cup catsup | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 3 cups shredded mexican cheese | 1 cup light sour cream | 1 cup cooked broccoli floret
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook on stove for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve on hot tortillas with desired toppings.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,tart apple,taco sauce,chocolate baking square,butter,rotini pasta,cilantro,seasoning mix
title: Mexican Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 6 tablespoons butter, melted | 1 package taco seasoning mix, divided | 1 tart apple, peeled and cubed | 1 cup plain yogurt | 6 tablespoons taco sauce, divided | 1 box shredded chocolate baking squares, divided | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rotini in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Cannellini Beans With Pork and Polenta
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs dried cannellini beans, picked over and rinsed | 3 1/2 lbs boneless pork butt | 12 ounces polenta | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram, divided
instructions: Combine beans and rinsed pork butt in a shallow baking pan. Cover mixture with water. Place pan over low heat.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,walnut,tzatziki,bicarbonate soda,green chili pepper,chinese five spice powder
title: Five-Spice Mix
ingredients: 300 g tzatziki | 2 tablespoons walnuts, coarsely chopped ( or you could use pine nuts ) | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder ( or less depending on taste preference ) | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 cup freshly picked coriander leaves ( cilantro leaves )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a bowl, mix thoroughly. Add more spices if desired and serve as finger food with salad.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,chipotle chile,veal,salmon fillet,beef bouillon,orange juice,basil leaf,almond
title: Baked Salmon With Chipotle Glaze
ingredients: 2 cups corn chips, crushed fresh | 1/2 cup slivered almonds or 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 3 tablespoons orange juice, freshly squeezed | 2 lbs salmon fillets, skinless | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon, powder | 1 chipotle chile, small, diced ( canned ) | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f coat a 13x9 baking dish with butter. Combine corn chips in a shallow dish. Press ground almonds into bottom of baking dish. In small bowl, combine orange juice and beef bouillon. Split salmon fillet into four pieces and place on top of corn chips. Pour the chipotle glaze over the fish. Top with remaining ingredients in bowl. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake for about 30 minutes. Serve fish with the remaining gravy.

Random Ingredients: honey,pepper,rye bread,red cayenne pepper,taco seasoning,star anise,hungarian paprika,dark brown sugar
title: Caribbean Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 bag light rye bread | 1/2 cup honey | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon dark spanish sweet paprika | 1 teaspoon hot pepper | 1 teaspoon hot pepper, crushed | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon star anise
instructions: Place bread in a zipper closed container. Bake at 375f for 10 minutes. Take out of oven and cool slightly. Place in a food processor. Whirl for 2 minutes, or until bread is bread looks like dried fruit. Add all remaining ingredients and process until you get a smooth but not chunky jerky. The consistency should be wet like biscuit batter. Spoon onto dry bread slices. Serve at room temperature. Use as a table condiment, or as a spice for meats, rice or potatoes.

title: Portobello Mushrooms and Bacon
ingredients: 1 portabella mushroom | 8 slices bacon | chinese noodles
instructions: In a large skillet, fry bacon until cooked, and sprinkle with salt. Set aside. Remove and reserve the mushroom stems. Remove the stems from the mushroom and slice off the mushroom caps. Reheat 1t of the bacon grease from the skillet, add the mushroom and bacon, and bring to a boil. Cover, and stir occasionally until the mushrooms are tender. Prepare noodles according to package directions.

title: Coconut Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 cup coconut, toasted | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 cup prepared yellow mustard
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Refrigerate covered for 2 - 3 hours to blend flavors.

title: Butternut Squash Cake
ingredients: 1 butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 2/3 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup ginger root, peeled
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Mash the squash in a bowl using a fork. Stir in the flour and ginger root. Spread into the prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven until the center feels firm and golden, 10 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bean,white chocolate chip,pine nut,cooking oil,maraschino cherry
title: The Singles' Day Dream Girl's Dream Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb bean sticks ( frozen or fresh, defrosted ) | 4 ounces white chocolate chips | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Boil beans for 10 minutes until tender and remove. Drain the water off and save. Set beans in a baking dish and lightly sprinkle with chocolate chips. Bake for 10 minutes in a 325 degree oven or until melted and smooth. Sprinkle with cherries and nuts and serve warm from the baking dish.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,apple cider vinegar,iceberg lettuce,red wine,green pepper
title: Soy Salad
ingredients: 2 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 small green pepper, diced | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1 dash of goya extra dry red wine
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Enjoy.

title: Cilantro Truffles for 2
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro stems | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | fresh cilantro stem, leaves only
instructions: Finely chop the cilantro and combine with the cream, tossing until completely combined and well blended. Add a spoonful of mixture to a cilantro sprig and garnish with cilantro sprigs. Chill for at least 1 hour.

title: French Mushrooms for Two
ingredients: 12 fresh mushrooms | 12 slices french bread
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and sprinkle with a dash of salt. Grill the bread until they are golden brown on the underside then move the mushrooms around. Serve.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,loaf french bread,lime wedge,soymilk,green food coloring,lemon,yellow onion
title: Lemon and Lime Soup (Or Kari)
ingredients: 2 lemons, juice of ( about 1/3 cup ) | 2 pints st. firm fresh loaves french bread, crusts trimmed ( preferably 1 loaf of about 7 ounces per loaf ) | 1 large yellow onion ( about 1/3 cup, or to taste ) | 10 ounces unsweetened soymilk | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | green food coloring | lime wedge
instructions: Put lemon juice into a large pot over low heat. Cut bread into 1 inch cubes and place in food processor. Process until well crumbed. Toss bread with onion. Pour in soy milk and stir in curry paste. Raise heat to medium, cooking just until paste just starts to bubble. Turn off heat. Stir in about 4 cups water. Transfer in heat resistant bowl, and stir in food coloring. Float the lime wedge on top to serve.

title: Onion Jelly With Sourdough Croutons
ingredients: 1 lb linguine or 1 lb other tubular pasta | 1 leek, white part only, finely chopped | 4 teaspoons gelatin or 4 teaspoons gelatin, mixed with 1 1/2 cups water | 1 large spanish onions or 1 large red onion, thinly sliced, separated into rings | 1 - 1 1/2 cup sourdough bread
instructions: Bring a large pot of lukewarm water to boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente about 6 - 8 minutes or until al dente. Drain and set aside. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add white part of onion and cook over very low heat about 8 minutes or until transparent. Turn heat off. Stir gelatin and water mixture into chopped onion until gelatin is dissolved. Add drained pasta and mix well. Refrigerate about 2 hours. Dish can be shaped with desired shapes. Place cooked croutons on large serving plate or platter. Make sure there are little bits of cheese on the top to be placed on the top of the croutons. Note, you can make the mixture up to 3 days in advance for a larger quantity of servings. Note, if using the onions, you can cut them into very thin rings and set aside for serving. Makes 4 servings. Note, if making the mixture and topping as directed for your appetizers and dinner guests, make sure that the noodles are drained thoroughly before adding to the pan.

title: Dairy Free Lentils and Spices: Vegan
ingredients: 1 cup lentils ( preferably brown or green ) | 4 teaspoons gluten-free artificial sweetener ( e.g. dijon ) | 2 teaspoons garlic oil ( or other cooking oil ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon sweet chili oil ( see note ) | 1 piece chocolate morsel or 1 piece other chocolate morsel | extra coconuts, for sprinkling around the dish ( optional )
instructions: Start by soaking the lentils for about 7 minutes in a pan of water, then removing and running under cool water – about 2 or 3 times. Once the water comes to a bubble, add the lentils and stir to combine. Continue to cook for 10 to 15 minutes over medium high heat, stirring regularly, until the lentils soften and start breaking down, adding more water to cover. While the lentils cook, you can prepare your chocolate morsel sauce, or make your chocolate sauce with 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup cocoa, 1 tbsp cocoa, 1 tbsp cornstarch or 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon zest, a pinch of salt, 1 tbsp paprika and a drizzle of chili oil. Heat a skillet and add enough olive oil to lightly grease the bottom. When the oil is very hot, add the chopped chocolate and stir until melted. Then stir in 1 tablespoon lemon zest, mix well and add 3/4 cup of water. Simmer for 10 minutes, stir occasionally, then taste the sauce for balance of flavors. The darker the piece of chocolate, the thicker the sauce will be. To check that the lentils are soft enough for scooping out, put about a tsp or two of the soft lentils in the palm of your hand and squeeze a cup or two over the lentils, then stir it into the sauce and stir. Add the rest of the warm water in small increments if the sauce seems too thick. If you add too much, you will need to add a bit of milk or water, but the taste depends how pronounced you want the sauce. Serve with extra coconuts, if desired.

title: Salami Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 6 slices salami | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 1/4 cup sesame-haze or 1/4 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Preheat grill to medium low. Place 1 slice salami on work surface. Top with cheese. Sprinkle with chives and drizzle with sesame glaze. Starting at 1 inch from the outside edge of the cheese, carefully and evenly roll the cheese. Press to compact cheese. Cook until browned and melted, about 2 minutes on each side. Cut into 1 inch slices with serrated knife. Serve hot.

title: Tomato & Onion Relish
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion, peeled & quartered | 1 can chopped tomatoes | 3 teaspoons green peppercorns
instructions: Wash, rinse and dry onion quarters. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Store refrigerated.

title: Crepes De Tortillas Mexicano
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes ( crushed or crushed slightly ) | 10 -12 teaspoons mexican crema ( for a more `` spicy flavor, i use homemade ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 pinch allspice
instructions: Mix the mexican crema and chili flakes in a small dish. Stir the corn flakes in the crema mixture to coat evenly. Add more crema at this point if using for a thick crema or thick crema. This works best if you let it sit for a few hours to soak up the liquid. Take another tablespoon or two of the crema mixture and coat the crema like a thin film. Heat a medium size nonstick skillet. When hot, use a paper towel to wipe the rim. Pour about 1 - 2 tbs. Of batter onto the pan. Let the crema spread on top of the pan. Flip the crema over onto the other side and continue to do the same. The bottom should be golden about 1 - 2 min. This should make it crispier. Continue doing this until each creme is coated with crema. Remove the crema to a platter or cutting board and sprinkle with more chili flakes and/or flour. Serve immediately.

title: Kahlua Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 15 ounces kahlua | 3/4 cup chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leave | 1/4 cup minced lemongrass, fresh ( optional ) | pickles, julienned ( optional ) or sliced ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, pour boiling water over kahlúa and bouillon. Once it has come to a boil, remove from heat and stir in thyme and lemongrass. Allow to cool. When ready to use, add pickle or sliced meat. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Baked Okra With Pumpkin and Chianti Wine (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 lb okra, trimmed & cut in half lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 cup chianti wine | 1 lemon wedge | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sweet pumpkin, peeled seeded, cut into 4 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange okra on a large rimmed baking sheet. In a small mixing bowl, combine chianti and 3 t. Hot water. Brush over okra, then squeeze juice and discard solids. Roast okra on middle rack of oven until tender and golden, about 15 minutes. Serve okra topped with tomato sauce, then a lemon wedge..

title: Burgundy Lamb Roast
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb, with bone | 3 cups burgundy wine | 1/4 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Mix 1/2 c wine & 1/4 c chocolate chips.

title: Coconut Peppered Mango Patty Rolls (Aussie)
ingredients: 1 cup shredded coconut into a medium bowl | 1 teaspoon pepperoni, grated ( use 1/2 teaspoon of ground pepper if you like it really hot ) | 1/4 teaspoon mango powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix the coconut and pepperoni in a small bowl. Shape the mixture into 4 small patties, and set aside at room temperature. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook the patties for 6 minutes per side, or to desired doneness, brushing with some of the reserved coconut mixture from the bowl. While still warm, sprinkle with the mango powder and serve.

title: Chilled Spiced Spaghetti for 2
ingredients: 1 garlic, bulb | 3 cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon mixed spice ( i use aromatic spice blend a ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint sprig | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 200 ml double cream | 1 teaspoon capers
instructions: Cut a slice off the end of the garlic bulb. Brush the inside of your container with a brush and place in a freezer over night or for about an hour to soften the garlic. When ready to use, remove the cloves and squeeze out all of the garlic pulp and discard the rest. Break up the garlic with a knife blade or a fork. Stir in the cardamom pods, mixed spice, mint sprigs, spaghetti sauce and capers. Chill for about 30 minutes in the fridge. Use within 1 week or freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Coconut Fingers & Cream
ingredients: 4 ounces sweetened flaked coconut flakes | 4 ounces reduced-fat guacamole | 1 pinch cumin powder | 20 ladyfingers | coconut flakes
instructions: Combine remaining ingredients & mix well. Brush a little coconut on the edge of each ladyfinger then dip them into the coconut, pressing down to cover completely. Repeat & place on a plate with coconut flakes.

title: Easy Currys & Black Olives for a Crowd - Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 cup good quality black olives, pitted | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Remove and discard the spines from the olives. Rinse and rinse the olives under cool water. Add all ingredients to the slow cooker. You can do this in the crockpot too. Set your cooker on high and put all ingredients into the slow cooker. Stir the contents to combine. When you turn the slow cooker to low, leave the lid askew and cook for 12 hours or the full hour on high. After 12 hours, taste the liquid in the crockpot and re stir the contents of the slow cooker. If needed, pour through a sieve or a strainer and stir in 1/2 cup hot water. Store in a container on the pantry shelf for up to 2 months. The sauce should have a thick, dark color.

Random Ingredients: white bread,brandy,vanilla sugar,rosemary,lime,french baguette,carrot,green chili pepper
title: Carrot Crostini
ingredients: 6 slices good quality bread, cut into pieces, crusts removed | 1/2 - 3/4 cup brandy | 1 cup grated carrot | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 green chili pepper, chopped finely | 1 tablespoon crushed rosemary | 1 teaspoon lime rind, grated | 1 loaf french baguette, cut into 3/4-inch slices
instructions: In a small bowl, pour brandy over bread, and allow to soak in overnight. Meanwhile, sprinkle carrot with vanilla sugar, and set aside. In a small bowl, mix together chile and rosemary. Reserve both bowls of brandy and grated carrots. Stir into bread, chill briefly, and serve with rosemary infused cream.

title: Eggplant Florentine (Tilbasa)
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped spinach fettuccine | 1 eggplant, sliced | 1 package kielbasa, thinly sliced | 1 1/4 cups chopped onion | 1/4 cup grated coconut-flavored graham cracker | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 2 cups shredded escarole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place spinach fettuccini in a large pot and cover with lightly salted lightly salted water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes until tender. Drain and transfer to a medium bowl. Heat water to a boil in a large pot. Stir in cubed eggplant, then reduce heat to medium low. Cook uncovered until slightly softened and just beginning to brown around edges, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Reserve. Drain and set aside. Place kielbasa in a large saucepan and cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until evenly browned and slightly crisp, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Place onion in a medium bowl, along with the cooked fettuccine.

title: Roasted Beef With Lime Juice
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1 1/4 lbs deli roasted beef | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Heat oil in a frying pan over high heat. While warm, slice the beef into thin strips about 1 inch long. Dip the strips into the lime juice, then brown in the hot oil on all sides. Drain briefly on paper towels.

title: Aussie Spiced Chive-Lickies
ingredients: 2 3/4 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 3/4 tablespoons snipped fresh spring onions or 2 3/4 tablespoons scallions | 1 cup half-and-half or 1 cup light cream | 3 tablespoons fresh brewed tea
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Heat, but do not boil. Add whipped cream. Serve with chives sprinkled on top. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,hot chili pepper
title: Chile Oil (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 1 -2 fresh hot chili pepper, seeded ( the small hot green chile is called `` or '' jalapeno chile ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil, plus more as needed
instructions: Toast the chile very slowly over moderate heat, shaking the pan a few times throughout the cooking, until it darkens and blisters as if it were baked. Transfer the chili to a heatproof bowl, loosen the green chile with a large spoon, and squeeze out as much of the chile as possible. Pour the oil into the bowl, and stir in the chile. Cover and let stand at room temperature 20 minutes. Strain the oil through a sieve into a clean jar, pressing any solids with your fingers. Store in the refrigerator, in a cool, dry place for up to 1 week.

title: Bacon Bits for Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup bacon bits | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Place bacon bits into a microwave safe dish. Heat in the microwave until crisp and slightly browned, 1 to 2 hours. Stir bacon bits and garam masala together to coat each chicken piece.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,green bean,shrimp,canola oil,cream,confectioner ' sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Green Bean Shrimp Bake With Lemon Cream Sauce
ingredients: 8 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 3 1/2 ounces canola oil | 1 lb green beans, trimmed | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar ( icing, confectioner's sugar ) | 1/2 cup cream | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon finely shredded lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Heat 1/4 inch oil in medium skillet. Working in batches if necessary, cook shrimp until barely opaque, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer to serving bowl and set aside. In same skillet heat canola oil over medium high heat until hot. Using slotted spoon, transfer shrimp and beans to plate. Place beans on work surface and cook, stirring frequently, until slightly browned, about 4 minutes. Working quickly, transfer beans to reserved plate. Return skillet to stove. Add remaining 3 tablespoons oil to coat bottom and 1 1/2 tablespoons oil to pan. Add shrimp and cook without moving until just cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon shrimp mixture onto plate. Spread green beans over shrimp, top with a few pats of parmigiano, and sprinkle top with lemon peel. Serve with lemon cream sauce. Serves 4.

title: Blueberry Tamarind Tacos
ingredients: 1 can haricot beans, drained | 1 cup fresh blueberries, divided | 1 tablespoon tamarind juice ( made from 2 tamarind pods ) | 1 medium corn tortillas | 1 tablespoon low-fat parmesan cheese
instructions: Stir haricot beans and 3/4 cup blueberries in medium nonstick skillet on medium heat until mixture begins to simmer. Reduce heat to low.

title: Macaroni and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 package pumpernickel bread, rounds, cut in half | 1/4 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup roasted sweeten sweet pepper, finely chopped | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1 cup uncooked macaroni, medium-loaf ( about half cooked ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Coat a 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Cut pumpernickel rounds into 8 wedges. Arrange wedges in a single layer in dish. Sprinkle peanuts over slices.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,turnip,focaccia bread,puff pastry,vanilla wafer,salad oil
title: French Turnip Puffs With Calamari #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, defrosted according to package directions ( 2 packages ) | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1 tablespoon vanilla wafers, crushed | 4 medium turnip, peeled | 4 lime wedges, for garnish | 1 loaf focaccia bread, cut into 24 2x3 inch squares ( or your choice if making ciabatta sandwich bread )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Spray baking sheets with cooking spray or grease with nonstick cooking spray. Roll out the defrosted puff pastry to a thickness of 1/2 inch. Cut each sheet into 12 wedges using a 3 inch round cutter. Set aside. Place each wedge into a plastic bag, close and seal. Set aside. Place the turnip on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper and set aside or in an airtight container on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender and golden. Remove from oven and reduce oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Drizzle the turnip wedges with oil. Sprinkle with vanilla wafers. Slightly crisp up the turnips. Remove the turnips to a platter and drizzle with the dressing. Garnish with lime wedges and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,cooking oil,corn flake,dark soy sauce,cocoa
title: Chili Con Cariacos
ingredients: 1 savoy cabbage, finely shredded | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 3 teaspoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon corn flakes
instructions: Heat oil in large frying pan. Add cabbage and fry, stirring every now and then, for about 5 - 7 minutes. Stir in soy sauce and cocoa. Continue stirring until the cocoa has melted and the dish is beginning to colour slightly. Drain cabbage and sprinkle it with cornflakes as you stir.

title: Gluten Free Vegan Candy
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups palm sugar | 1 1/3 cups xanthan gum
instructions: Whisk half of sugar, and half of xanthan gum together until well blended. Add remaining sugar, mix again and set aside to rest. After the gum has rested for a least an hour or so, grease your baking sheets with a nonstick vegetable spray. Use baking sheets so the gum doesn't stick. Gently stir gum mixture into the rest of the gum until thoroughly dispersed. Spread mixture on the paper and freeze for 1 hour. Cut into bars, or fingers and store in an airtight tin with waxed paper between each slice. Variation, instead of gum use cornstarch, or mix a bit of the gum with 1 cup boiling water. It will give it a thicker look.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,tea,cardamom pod,canola oil,green chili pepper,serrano pepper,cornbread,garlic chive
title: Fusion Mexican Pepper Blend Bread Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups cornbread, crusts removed | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 serrano peppers, minced | 1 tablespoon coriander or 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf, chopped | 1 tablespoon serrano peppers, minced | 1 tablespoon green chili pepper ( can make and serve ) or 1 tablespoon jalapeno chili, minced ( can make and serve ) | 8 whole cardamom pods | 1/4 cup dried oregano leaves | 1 cup light loose regular tea | 1/4 cup dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In an 8 inch square baking dish, lightly spray with canola oil or you may use a nonstick cooking spray. Add cubed bread. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove bread and set aside. In a small saucepan, heat the 2 tablespoons of canola oil, 2 minced serrano peppers, coriander and chile on medium heat, stirring often, for about 1 minute. Spread mixture on bread in baking dish and sprinkle cardamom and oregano over bread. Place the remaining minced serrano pepper, 3 minced serrano peppers, fresh jalepeno chile and dried oregano. Set aside. Using a blender or mini food processor, mix the hot pepper mixture with the tea and 1/4 cup of the dried oregano. Pour tea tea mixture over bread and sprinkle with remaining dried oregano and oregano. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes until the bread is warmed through and the flavors have blended.

title: Simple Green Bean Veggie Burgers
ingredients: 2 packets green beans ( frozen is fine, i've yet to try ) | 400 g mushrooms ( fresh, about 12 oz. in total ) | 400 g bamboo shoots | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon bread flour
instructions: Place a small plate on the side of the bowl and cover with a plate of damp tea towels to help keep warm while you work with your burger mixture. Remove any fat from the mushrooms and slice them into rounds that are roughly 3” across and 1/4” thick. Place in a medium bowl and cover with plastic wrap to prevent further drying. Heat a few tablespoons of water in another pan and dry fry the green beans about 7 minutes total, stirring occasionally to keep them from sticking to the bottom. Remove from pan using a slotted spoon. Slice the mushroom caps into rounds and place them on another plate with your tea towels. Remove any liquid from mushrooms, place them in the bowl, sprinkle lightly with salt, and then divide the green beans between two slices of paper towels and roll them lightly to soften. While you're awaiting for your green bean burgers to defrost, toast the bread flour in the top of a double broiler of your stove. Heat a griddle griddle or large, nonstick skillet at medium heat. Place the bean sprouts in the griddle and sprinkle each side with dried oregano, then flip them a quarter turn and repeat until all the leaves are slightly crispy. Take your prepared griddle griddle or pan and cook the bean sprouts 2 - 4 minutes depending on the length of your griddle.. Remove and place on plate. Sprinkle with more oregano, then divide between burger molds. Place the mushrooms in the same pan and sprinkle with salt, and then spread over the burger, taking care to avoid getting over cooked all the way to the edge. Cook a further minute or two until they are browned and the burgers are cooked through and lightly crisp on the edges. Serve with a green salad or a light loaf of breaded bread, topped with a side salad of green salad to make these tasty, if you would like, and with garlic butter or olive oil.

title: South American Peaches and Sticks
ingredients: 7 heads unskinned apples | 5 -6 stalks fresh cilantro leaves | 2 whole ancho chilies, seeds removed and broken into pieces | 3 cups shredded suet
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium roasting pan with enough salted water to reach a depth of 2 inches, add apples and whole ancho peppers. Cover and cook until tender, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, cut a slit in each side of the onion. With sharp scissors, thinly slice the onions crosswise. Cut into 1/4 inch slices. Serve apples, onions, and pepper halves on a platter. To serve, place about a cup of the apple mixture in a saucepan and cover to keep warm over low heat. Heat the remaining ancho chili, salt and pepper over medium low heat. When hot, pour 1/2 cup of the hot liquid into a small bowl and set aside. Add half the sesonese to the sesonese and the remaining sesonese to the pan with the ancho peppers, onions and peppers, stir to mix. Place lid on sesonese and heat until liquid is reduced and sauce is hot, about 1 more minute.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,meat,beef sirloin steak,chili powder,egg noodle,lemongrass,chuck steak
title: Vietnamese Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs thinly sliced meat | 1/2 lb fresh boneless beef top round steak, thinly sliced across the grain | 1 lb fresh boneless skirt steak | 1/2 lb fresh chili powder, preferably sriracha | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, minced | 2 serrano peppers, seeded, membranes removed, minced | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 eggs noodles, cooked per package instructions
instructions: Combine beef, steak, 1/2 of the chilli powder, and lemongrass in a large bowl. Combine remaining chilli powder, remaining chilli powder and remaining 1/4 cup of chilli. Sprinkle sauce over beef mixture. Cover and chill for 6 to 8 hours, stirring occasionally. Thread meat on metal skewers. Brush meat with chilli glaze. Set aside at room temperature 30 minutes, covered. Meanwhile, heat broiler. Dry out beef skewers on a foil lined baking sheet. Cover and broil 10 minutes. Turn skewers over. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 of chilli powder and broiler another 10 minutes for rare, medium rare, medium well. Slices and serve with cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pearl barley,tilapia fillet,parsnip,dark chocolate,extra virgin olive oil,fryer chicken,scallion
title: Thousand year old Chicken Barley Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 pieces fryer chickens | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 ounces dark chocolate | 1 bunch parsnips, diced | 2 scallions, chopped | 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup uncooked pearl barley, cooked
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Brown chicken. Remove and set aside. Dice the chicken into bite size pieces. Melt chocolate in saucepan over low heat, stirring continually, until smooth. Remove from heat and carefully stir in parsnips, scallions, red pepper flakes, and barley. Add to chicken mixture and stir until combined. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Barley Chicken Braised in a Dutch Oven
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless veal shank, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 1/2 lbs bone-in chicken breasts, cut up | cooking spray | 1/2 cup uncooked barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Spray a 13x9 inch baking pan with cooking spray. Arrange veal in a single layer in pan.

title: Curried Carrots
ingredients: 3/4 cup margarine | 1 tablespoon curry paste ( i used sharwood's curry paste ) | 1 pinch cinnamon or 1 pinch green cardamom
instructions: In a small fry pan heat margarine over medium high heat. As soon as butter foams, stir in curry paste. Slowly add in cinnamon to spice mix. Stir until fragrant. If your curry paste is too dark for your taste, add a small amount of water and stir. Cook just until heated through. If the sauce is too thick, add in a little water.

title: Asparagus and Cream Roulades
ingredients: 1 package frozen asparagus spears | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place frozen asparagus spears on a baking sheet. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes on each side, until crisp tender. Place asparagus in a large bowl with remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,graham cracker crumb,vidalia onion,cocoa powder
title: Htapodi
ingredients: 1/2 small head cauliflower, washed and trimmed | 1/4 cup minced vidalia onion | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs, or as needed | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Chop cauliflower into small florets. Place cauliflower, onion, graham cracker crumbs, and cocoa powder in a glass jar with a tight fitting lid. Cover and shake to mix. Place lid on jar, and shake for about a minute to release air bubbles. Be sure to shake the lid vigorously. Rinse clean and dry cauliflower. Place in a resealable plastic bag, and pour about 1/4 cup water into the bag. Seal bag, shake to mix, and then refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, turning bag once or twice. Transfer meat mixture to a baking dish. Bake in a preheated 300 degree f oven for 1 1/4 hours. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,self raising flour,greek yogurt,tomato puree,mango chutney,black bean sauce,thyme sprig,artichoke heart
title: Tomato & Black Bean Chilli Pizza With Mango
ingredients: 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 415 g canned tomatoes in puree | 415 g canned black beans in sauce | 1 tablespoon mango chutney, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 8 artichoke hearts, skin on, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°c line an 11x7cm baking dish with oiled baking paper. Place your flour, thyme and chilli flakes in a bowl and stir in the tomatoes and chili. Put the mixture into a jug, and stir in the beans, mango chutney and yoghurt. Spoon the mixture into the prepared dish and scatter over some of your artichoke meat. Bake for about 20 minutes or until the pizza has risen and has puffed up slightly. Allow to cool for about 10 minutes before slicing on toasted bread.

title: Dosa Crumbs - Indian Breadcrumb Cookies
ingredients: 4 cups bread flour | 1 tablespoon ground urad dal | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon icing sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease cookie sheets. Sift together flour, urad dal and onion powder into a large bowl. Mix in sifted icing sugar into flour with a fork. Add just enough bread crumbs to combine to form a soft dough. If dough seems a bit dry add more bread crumbs. If too dry add more bread crumbs until dough forms a dough consistency. Add more bread crumbs if dough seems dry. On a lightly floured surface press into a 1/4 thick round. Bake for 20 minutes or until nicely browned. Remove to wire rack to cool.

title: Chicken Mokha
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, chopped small | 2 cups sliced fresh mushrooms ( optional ) | 4 -6 boneless skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced ( may also use chicken tenders ) | 1/3 cup chopped green cardamom pods ( or 6 pods ) | 1 cup chopped fresh small red plum ( or other green tomato ) | 2 -4 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 cup salsa ( mild, med or medium ) | 1/3 cup fresh snow pea, chopped ( to garnish )
instructions: In a dutch oven, cook bacon until crisp over medium low heat. Stir in mushrooms.

title: Whipped Shortbread (Food Processor)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1/2 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
