instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in bread machine, starting with 1/2 cup of white flour, and gradually adding more flour as needed to reach the consistency of stiff dough. Turn bread machine on to dough. Let machine knead 6 - 8 times. With machine running, roll out dough on lightly floured board. Roll into a rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick. Cut rectangle into 10 strips. Working quickly and carefully, score strips into three inch pieces. Place on greased cookie sheets. Let stand for 1 hour at room temperature before cutting into squares. Store, well covered, in refrigerator. Variation. Add 1 - 3 tablespoons butter mixed with 1 teaspoon ice to the dough before adding to a pie crust.

title: Yellow Beans With Pasta
ingredients: 200 g yellow beans, with shells | 1/2 cup pappardelle pasta ( mini pasta bows )
instructions: Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to the boil. Add the yellow beans and cook for about five minutes. Meanwhile, bring another large pan of water to a boil. Add the pappardelle pasta. Cook pasta for about five minutes or until al dente.

title: Nacho Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 32 ounces monterey jack cheese ( mild or hot depending on your liking ) | 2 -3 green onions
instructions: Empty entire can of cheese into the bottom of a 9 x 12 or larger bowl. Sprinkle half of the green onions over cheese. Cut remaining cheese into 1/2 inch cubes. Sprinkle cheese over mixture. Top with rest of green onions and remaining green onions. Serve warm with tortilla chips. Note ~ if you make this in advance add a little garlic powder and/or dried basil to cheese mixture to warm it up. Note, you might like to cook the entire bowl of cheese before stirring in the first 15 minute if you refrigerate in a container, after adding cheese mix well and adjust the flavor. You may use a 9 x 12 pan instead of a 9 x 13 pan and the green onions or some dried chili pepper may be added at this point.

title: Mexican Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sweet and sour sauce | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender or food processor. Process until smooth.

Random Ingredients: grey poupon dijon mustard,yellow squash,coriander powder,apple juice
title: Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 yellow squash | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon grey poupon dijon mustard | 1/4 cup apple juice
instructions: Quarter the squash and scrape out the seeds if they are not already done. Cut into thin slices on a mandoline. In a microwaveable bowl add, the mustard, worcestershire sauce, apple juice, and squashes. Microwave until heated and combine. Sprinkle over the greens just before serving.

Random Ingredients: double cream,roast beef,yellow hominy,saffron thread,salt,baking potato,mushroom
title: Spanish Beef Pot Pies With Saffron Potatoes
ingredients: 5 -6 medium baking potatoes | coarse salt | 1 pinch saffron thread | 2 lbs top round roast beef | 1 can yellow hominy | 1 cup double cream | 1/2 lb sliced mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a large pot combine 1 - 2 cups water and saffron. Bring all to a boil while stirring frequently. Taste for salt until it is 1/2 t. It should be salty enough to taste. Peel and set aside the potatoes. Scrub potatoes well of the outer coating using a potato peeler and prick all over with a fork. Place on a cloth covered cookie sheet in a cold oven and let stand while making the filling. Trim beef of all visible fat.

title: Basic Salsa
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce, i used prego brand | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Pour 1 cup of prego's diced tomatoes on a nonstick baking sheet. Pour tomato sauce over tomatoes.

title: Zeytinyi (Turkish Couscous Salad)
ingredients: 5 ounces couscous | 4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 1 ounce apricot preserves | 1/2 ounce chopped radish | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 1/2 ounce pistachios, chopped
instructions: Cook couscous until tender, cool. Chop tomatoes. Scoop apricot preserves into large bowl and mix in couscous and other ingredients. Divid mixture evenly between the 4 serving bowls and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve in martini glasses or small bowls, sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

title: Fried Burdock Root (Nabe) - Bengali - Bengali Paneer
ingredients: 8 -9 small burdock root, peeled, cleaned, and cut off the ends | 2 cups peanut butter | 3 -4 tablespoons corn oil ( optional, the best, or just more as needed )
instructions: Cut into 2 inch lengths or thirds, if the lengths are large. Heat oil in skillet and fry on high heat for a few minutes until the oil gets very hot. Add peanut butter. Mix well and fry on high heat until the butter is reduced by half and smooth, stirring frequently. Remove from the heat, and drain off any excess oil, if the oil remains on the pan.

title: Korean BBQ Burdock for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 ounce dehydrated burdock root, chopped | 1 small onion, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix until the coating is thick and sticky. Dip the burdock root and onion in the ketchup. Add to the coating and let it sit on the grill until it becomes limp, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,penne pasta,chicken thigh,egg white,limoncello liqueur,cilantro root,dijon mustard,chipotle chile adobo
title: Chipotle Chicken over Penne
ingredients: 1 medium egg white | 1 chipotle chile in adobo | 1/4 cup limoncello liqueur | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro roots | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs ( about 3/4 lb. ) | 1 lb penne pasta
instructions: Heat skillet over medium high heat. Meanwhile, in bowl whisk egg white to blend. While still beating egg white add chopped chipotle, limoncello, mustard and chile in adobo. Slowly add adobo mixture to egg whites while whisking. Slowly add chicken, stirring with chopsticks to coat. Cook over low heat until sauce begins to thicken, about 10 minutes. When sauce is simmering add cilantro roots.

title: Stir Fry Shrimp on Panner
ingredients: 3 slices panir ( any flavour ) | 20 -48 cooked shrimp ( with heads ) | 4 -8 sandwich buns
instructions: Pre heat pan. Put on 2 teaspoons of stir fry panner in the pan and cook very slowly so as not to burn the mix. Turn the heat under the stir fry pan if necessary. Put shrimp, mix, and on the bun. Serve.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,jasmine rice,baby spinach leaf,bread flour,green chili pepper,romaine lettuce
title: Green Chile, Spinach, and Bread Machine Loaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons warm water ( not boiling! ) | 2 1/8 cups bread flour | 1 1/8 cups jasmine rice | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/2 cup chopped green chili pepper | 1/2 cup chopped romaine lettuce
instructions: Stir warm water and flour in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,sesame seed,cream,cabbage,red raspberry jam,double cream,seasoning salt,vanilla ice cream
title: Baked Cabbage With Raspberry Cream Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups cabbage, shredded | 2 - 2 1/2 cups crushed red raspberry jam ( or your favourite jam ) | 4 -5 teaspoons chipotle chiles in adobo ( pureed ) | 4 -6 cups double cream ( or a little more or less ) | butter-flavored cream, whipped ( or sour cream ) | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | seasoning salt ( or white salt ) | 1/2 cup cream | 1 -2 tablespoon double cream | 1 tablespoon vanilla ice cream
instructions: Make sure the cabbage is well washed and dried. Combine jam and chipotles on paper towel, and squeeze them from skin. Place a large pot on medium heat and fill with enough water to come up to 4 c and bring to full boil. In the meantime, make the cream sauce, in a small sauce pan, combine the cream, sesame seeds, salt, sugar and double cream. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 - 7 minutes. When cabbage is fully cooked and drained of any water, add it to the cream sauce. Mix in the vanilla and keep warm. Spoon sauce into oven safe casserole dish and place in the oven at lowest temperature set to 325 - 325 degrees. Check every 15 minutes to make sure the temperature of the sauce gets good enough, but not too hot as this cabbage will boil over. If it appears too hard, raise temperature slightly on top and cook it for 5 minutes, until it starts to jiggle. The cabbage should be a deep golden brown color at this point. Serve warm or at room temperature. Note, this can be made several hours ahead. You can adjust the seasonings or let cool completely before serving.

title: Apple & Asparagus Tartlets
ingredients: 2 cups chopped young asparagus ( if they are in frozen ) | 2 tart apples | 1/2 cup fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger biscuit, finely grated | 50 g sliced bread | 4 small tart apples ( medium size cored, such as fuji ) or 4 small peaches ( medium size cored, such as fuji ) | 1 cup fresh bean sprout | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Using a small plate, gently press asparagus to release excess water. Chop onions, peel apples. Combine chopped asparagus, chopped apples, tarragon and ginger biscuit, bread and chopped asparagus and asparagus mixture in a small microwave safe bowl. Cover. Microwave on high for 1 minute, stirring. Remove, cover and set aside for 10 minutes or until heated through. Using a knife, cut each tartlet into 4 wedges. Arrange on a lightly oiled baking tray. Top with remaining apple mixture and top with bean sprouts then cherries. Bake for 20 minutes or until well heated through. Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Powdered Sugar
ingredients: 2 cups raw onion, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | 2 1/4 cups raw sugar
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine onions, vanilla and raws, and enough cold water to reach the top of the pot. Bring to a boil, and cook over medium high heat without stirring for about 3 minutes. Stir, then set aside to cool. Once cool, stir in powdered sugar until completely dissolved. Cover and store in the refrigerator until ready to use. This sugar makes about 2 1/4 cups. Use about 3/4 cup for each cup of powdered sugar.

title: Rice Noodles with Beans, Ginger and Wine (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 5 tablespoons gingerroot, finely chopped | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon of ground mustard ( i use keen's ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup noodles | 4 1/2 cups bean or 4 1/2 cups spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Combine vinegar, ginger, wine and cooked noodles. Let stand for 2 hours to soak flavors. Place in refrigerator to marinate several hours.

title: Roasted Green Broccoli
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen broccoli, thawed | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 3 chopped green onions | 1 1/2/4 cups crushed corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine golden syrup, sage, green onions in a large baking dish. Add broccoli, breaking up with a spoon until very clumps are left. In a small bowl, stir together corn flakes with 1/3 cup reserved golden syrup. Spoon cornflake mixture evenly over broccoli mixture. Bake in a preheated oven for about 25 minutes.

title: Beets Bolognaise
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained ( garbanzo beans ) or ( 15 ounce ) can garbanzo beans, drained ( chickpeas ) | 1 bunch fresh beet, stems removed | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Cut greens from beet stems and then into pieces about 3 inches long and 1 1/2 inches wide. Cut tips of beets into 1/2 inch wide by 2 inches long pieces. Wash beets well under running water in a bowl with plenty of water. Rinse in cold water. Drain greens and beets, drain. Place beets and greens on an ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp of cinnamon. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Bake about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve warm.

title: Yogurt Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 3 cups buttermilk | 1 cup low fat yogurt | 30 ounces pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2 to 2 inch chunks
instructions: Stir buttermilk, yogurt, pineapple chunks, basil and beef in large glass baking dish.

title: Taco Chips (For Chips)
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice ( about 12 ) | 1 tablespoon cayenne, divided | 2 1/2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa, divided | 1 head romaine lettuce, separated into leaves
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook potatoes until tender but still firm, about 10 minutes. Drain. Mix in 1 tablespoon cocoa, half the cayenne pepper and remaining 1/2 tablespoon cocoa. Meanwhile, coat a large casserole dish or tray with nonstick cooking spray. Place 1/3 cup potato mix in dish. Top with lettuce leaves. Add the remaining 1/3 cup potato mixture. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake, covered, in a 425f degree oven until potatoes are crispy and sauce is bubbly, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,crouton,egg,whipping cream,vinegar,italian sausage link,jasmine rice
title: Polish Sausage & Rice With Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 4 cups long grain and wild rice blend | 1 lb italian sweet sausage link ( sausage ) | 2 medium eggs, beaten ( reserve seasoning ) | 1 1/2 cups croutons | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions until al dente and drain. Heat oven to 350f degrees. Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat, cook sausage until golden brown, remove, drain on paper towels. Pour off fat. Stir in eggs, rice and 3/4 cup water. Bring to boil, stir 1 minute. Stir in peas, heat to boiling. Cover and reduce heat to simmer, cook 20 minutes. Uncover and add remaining ingredients, stir to combine and cook 3 - 5 minutes longer or until eggs are just scrambled and rice is hot through. Serve hot. My note, i made this dish because i wanted to use fresh italian sausage and the croutons and baked in the oven for 40 minutes, turned out great the next day.. I was curious about the sausage link. His notes, i made these for my family reunion and they liked the taste. We added a whole can of black eyed peas, he said that it turned out great. I took out the salt once it was done cooking. These are a favorite, i have made many variations. He used chopped onions instead and cooked in butter, when cooking rice in the sausage drippings on the sausage. Added a little garlic and dried basil when cooking. Next, he used 1 tablespoon of chicken tenderizer to cook the rice. One egg beaters worked well for me.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,nicoise olive,italian herb,cream tartar
title: Italian Nacho Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1 pinch of nicoise olive | 1 pinch of minced mixed italian herbs | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the cheeses together with the olive oil and sour cream, with a wood spoon. Spread in a sandwich press or shallow serving dish, and allow to set. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Jalapeño Cheese With Lemon, Chocolate and Lime
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice of | 8 marie biscuits, crushed | 8 jalapenos, coarsely chopped | 2 ounces semisweet chocolate chips | 1/4 cup limeade marie biscuits, melted
instructions: Place lemon juice & crushed cookies in a small bowl and microwave until warm & bubbly ~ no oil or butter is needed. Place chocolate chips in another small bowl. With a pastry blender or coffee/veggie peeler, make long strips of zest from zest & set aside. Heat wok, add a little oil, then add the chocolate & stir constantly to melt the chocolate. Add limeade and stir until chocolate is smooth & melted. Add zest & limeade mixture to cheese & stir fry over medium heat. Allow for one minute to sit or until the cheese has melted & is starting to turn slightly crispy. Remove cheese & chocolate, reserve.

title: Easy Pork Tori
ingredients: 1/2 pound boneless pork shoulder, cut into small cubes about 1/2-inch long | ice | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 sheet nori ( dry seaweed ), cut into thin strips
instructions: Add pork cubes and enough ice to float the top of the meat. Mix in lime leaves. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Preheat a grill to medium heat. Cook the pork on the reserved lime leaves until the meat is cooked enough to stick. Sprinkle the nori over the hot rice and serve.

title: Grilled Peaches and Bacon
ingredients: 1/3 cup brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons tahini ( sesame-seed paste ) | 6 slices hickory smoked bacon | 24 lettuce leaves, washed | 8 slices firm ripe peaches, halved | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 4 tins baked lettuce leaves, cut in half | fresh dill sprigs ( to garnish and serve )
instructions: Make the coffee, by pouring the coffee into a small pot and stirring in the tahini. Set the pot over medium high heat and cook for 1 minute. Remove the pot from the heat and transfer the coffee to a serving bowl. Let cool. Break into pieces and set aside. In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, or until it starts to soften. Set warm, then cut into 1/2 inch pieces. Place the bacon in a large bowl, cover it tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours. Meanwhile, build the grill, place the patties on the grill rack, grill 6 to 8 minutes, or until well grilled. If they start to smoke, cover with aluminum foil. When they are done, remove to a plate using an oven mitt, cut side or a slice of bread, and cover with foil. Prep the sandwiches, transfer 1 to 2 lettuce leaves into each of 4 dinner plates. Top with peaches, then top each with another lettuce leaf and 2 tbs of the bacon. Drizzle with the coffee to taste. Sprinkle with cayenne. Place the plates on the grill, close the cover, and grill 3 minutes to heat. Garnish with lettuce leaves. Serve with a toasted bread or crackers, for dipping.

Random Ingredients: salt,pasta,dark sesame oil,vegetable bouillon cube,coffee,yellow pepper
title: Sweet Thai Pasta With Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups pasta ( any shape or size you desire ) | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons vegetable bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup instant coffee ( or 1 - a few tbsp water ) | salt | 1/4 cup chopped yellow sweet pepper
instructions: Cook pasta according to your preference package directions. Note, you might use any combination of peppers you would like to use instead of the bell peppers, but i have never tried that option. Set pasta aside. Meanwhile heat sesame oil in a large fry pot over medium high heat until the scent is released. When hot, add peppers, stir fry 2 - 3 minutes, then drain pasta and peppers. Add the pasta and peppers to the oil with the other ingredients. Add the stock cube, coffee and mix to combine. Heat for 1 minute or so, stirring all the while. Note, you could also make this in advance. You can freeze leftovers and reheat the next day. Bring back up to heat. Note, if you are making this the day you make the dish, the heat will not be quite enough. That means if you don't plan on serving this right away, you can dump it into a crock pot set to high for at least an hour. This saves on calories. However, if you plan on eating this hot, put the entire party on a low heat setting for a few hours before eating.

title: Papaya Corn Pudding
ingredients: 4 ounces papayas ( pawpaw preferred ) | 2 cups buttermilk | 4 1/2 ounces marshmallow candies | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry ( cut into quarters ) | 3 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Cut the pawpaw in half and remove both ends. Scoop out the flesh leaving just a little pulp. Wash the meat with a damp cloth and cut the flesh into chunks. Set aside. In a large pan mix together the pawpaw, marsmallows, raspberry candy bars and buttermilk. Add the cornflour and stir till smooth. Simmer for 10 - 15 mins until it has thickened slightly. Spoon the thickened liquid into a basin and stir the cornflour through to thicken it a bit. Pour the mixture into a small greased oven proof dish. Place in a warm oven for 30 - 35 mins or until set. Garnish with papaya and serve.

title: Easy Pasta Filled With Capers and Capers
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 12 capers, drained, reserving | 8 ounces fish sauce | fresh pasta, of your choice | 4 fluid ounces cold water
instructions: On a lightly floured surface with a well floured rolling pin roll each sheet of pastry out to a rectangle about 1/2ï¿½ inches thick. Arrange capers over pastry, dot with a few drops of fish sauce and carefully roll up to enclose capers. Place pastry on top of a baking pan lined with parchment paper. Using a sharp knife slash pastry lengthwise down one side 2¿½ deep in the pastry. Transfer pastry to freezer for 15 minutes. Transfer pastry to a lightly floured surface and roll out the remaining sheets of pastry to make a rectangle about ½ï¿½ inches thick. With a sharp knife cut pastry lengthwise to make a 20¿22cm oval. Transfer to pastry sheet with capers and roll up to enclose capers. Using the sharp knife cut pastry into quarters. Tuck pastry together the two ends of each piece of pastry, ensuring none of pastry touches the water in the tray. Using a 2¿½inch cookie cutter or a drinking glass, cut each quarter into 8 “ slices. Using a pastry bag fitted with a star tip, gently push each square toward you with your fingers for a slightly flattened, round cake. Transfer to baking sheet, brush each pastry with the remaining fish sauce. Use the tip of the tip to press pastry together to seal slightly so that any water which oozes out of pastry will be seen. Brush top of pastry with remaining fish sauce. Cover with foil and freeze up to 1 day. To serve, remove pastry from freezer, lift out of tray and top with a spoonful of cooked pasta. Serve with dipping sauce and a small bowl of fresh fruit such as diced carrot jutmez.

title: French Canadian Cheese Soup (Molasses Canapés)
ingredients: 2 quarts chicken stock | 1 lb swiss cheese, shredded | 1 lb provolone cheese, shredded | 1 cup dark molasses
instructions: Heat chicken stock. In batches, stir in swiss cheese and provolone cheese. Heat until mixture begins to melt. Do not boil. Stir molasses into hot soup and pour into soup can. Serve hot.

title: Puerto Rican Pork Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 24 slices baguette | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon guajillo chilies, chopped | 8 ounces cooked pork tenderloin, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( may substitute other pork loin ) | 1 can crushed pineapple | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 cup sweet and sour mix, drained | 1 cup guajillo chilies, chopped | lettuce, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Cut baguette lengthwise in half and lightly brush with mayonnaise.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,french bread,turmeric powder,grain white rice,mirin,oregano leaf
title: Raspberry Stuffed French Bread Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 1 1/4 cups mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 cups raspberries in natural juice, cut in half | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/16 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons french bread, sliced in half lengthways and toasted
instructions: Put the rice and 1 2/3 cups of water in a 2½ qt saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender. Remove from the heat and stir in the mirin. Cover and set aside for 5 minutes. Uncover and fluff the rice grains up with a fork. Stir in the raspberry preserves, oregano and turmeric, making sure to coat everything well. Arrange the half toasted bread halves on a baking sheet and spread the rice mixture over them keeping the two halves together. Cook under a preheated broiler until browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,tomato juice,radish,cake flour,sultana,garlic clove,cranberry,coconut milk
title: Mulled Sardines
ingredients: 2 ounces cake flour | 1 large garlic clove | 2 ounces dried fruit, chopped | 2 ounces sultanas | 1 can cranberries, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes with juice | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 pint coconut milk
instructions: Mince garlic, sultanas, cranberries and sundried tomatoes. Mix flour, garlic, sultanas and sun dried tomatoes with turmeric powder in a large bowl. Add coconut milk, stir in. Dip drained Sardines and gently toss. Plate and serve.

title: Yogurt-Mint Chutney (Chachayote Paste)
ingredients: 4 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 cup italian-style tomato paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 cup chopped mint leaves
instructions: Soak 10 minutes in lukewarm water. Drain. Place yogurt in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well using your hands. Cover.

title: Faux Mom's Ladyfingers
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers ( savoiardi or ladyfinger ) | scallion ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Split ladyfingers in half. Sprinkle scallions on cut sides of ladyfingers to decorate. Place one leg of ladyfinger on top of the other, and sandwich the two ends together by pressing them together, then pressing to seal. Line a baking sheet with wax paper, and arrange cake racks on it. Preheat oven to 350°f. Repeat with remaining ladyfingers, scallions and scallions. Place soaked ladyfingers on baking rack and bake about 40 minutes on the first rack, or until golden brown. Remove, and let cool about 20 minutes. Remove wax paper, turn the cakes out of the pan onto a serving plate, and serve warm.

title: Saurza Poppy Seed Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup sauza tequila | 4 sprigs fresh thyme sprigs | 6 tablespoons poppy seeds, ground | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the tequila, thyme, and poppy seeds until the mixture is completely incorporated and the zaar is dissolved. Divide the mousse among 4 wine glasses, and garnish with fresh cilantro.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,crabmeat,beef chuck,saffron thread,garlic oil,nutmeg,spanish onion
title: Baked Roca
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 1/2 cup spanish onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon saffron thread | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 clove garlic oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Brown meat, drain and put into casserole dish that has been lightly oiled. Add onion, saffron, saffron and nutmeg. Add sassic and pesto sauce and toss. Pour over meat in casserole. Bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes.

title: Quick Salmon Steak, Bacon, and Orange Salad
ingredients: 2 salmon steaks | 1 teaspoon orange juice | 1 1/2 slices bacon, coarsely chopped | 1 red capsicum, finely chopped, or to taste | fat, or as needed
instructions: Preheat the grill for high heat. Score a little cross on each salmon steak with a knife, and place on the prepared grill. Cook for about 5 minutes on each side, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. While fish is cooking, cut the bacon into small strips. When the salmon is about 10 minutes from the time you are cooking your bacon, start to boil water in a medium skillet over high heat. When it boils, stir in the orange juice and bacon strips. Cover, and reduce heat to medium low. Cook another 2 minutes. Place the salmon on a platter, and top with the orange dressing. Garnish with red capsicum and a sprinkling of fat as desired.

title: Irish Whiskey Bread for Tea Time
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups white flour | 1/2 cup dried sunflower seeds | 1 cup irish whiskey | 1 cup superfine sugar, plus extra for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place oven rack in middle of oven, and preheat stone for 10 minutes if using cast iron, reduce to 300 degrees f and place in the oven for an hour. Remove from oven, and toss seeds in a bowl. Pour whiskey into a bowl, and stir together with 1 1/2 cups flour, sugar and 1 cup orange juice until the mixture thickens. Add more orange juice if mixture is dry. Turn out onto a lightly floured board, and knead briefly, adding more flour as needed. Divide dough in half, and shape each half into a rectangle. Cut slits in top of each loaf with a sharp knife, taking care not to cut completely through the top crust, and brush the inside of the loaf with olive oil and sprinkle with coarse sugar. Return to the oven, and bake for 60 - 90 minutes, or until well browned. Serve immediately. Serve with tea and ice cream.

title: Beef and Roasted Haddock #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing and seasoning mix | 1 cup sultana | 1 cup rolled oats | 1 tablespoon porridge oats | 2 cups enchilada sauce ( spicy or mild to taste ) | 4 fillets tilapia | 4 ounces cod fillets, frozen
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Prepare the #5FIX according to package directions. Spread a thin layer of enchilada sauce on the bottom of a baking dish. Place the thawed fillets of tilapia in dish on top of the sauce of enchilada sauce. Bake 10 minutes, until fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork. In the meantime, spread the #5fix evenly over the fish. Bake for 10 minutes, until fish flakes easily with a fork. When fish is done, place the fillets on top of the prepared oat casserole and top with the sultanas, rolled oats, porridge oats. Pour the enchilada sauce over the pan. Bake for 10 minutes, until the puffed olives are bubbly and lightly browned. Enjoy.

title: Asparagus Burgers (Beef Burger)
ingredients: 500 g asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1cm pieces | 2 crusty round matzo meal, lightly toasted | 200 g thinly sliced hamburger | 1 tablespoon white miso | 4 sheets fresh asparagus spears
instructions: Divide the matza meal between 4 serving plates. Place a steak slice between the matza meal and top with asparagus. Dip in the miso to coat both sides until coated. Heat a griddle over high heat and cook, turning, until lightly browned. Meanwhile, place the hamburgers on a plate. Sprinkle over the miso. Grill for 2 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through. Slice the asparagus spears diagonally and place on the top of the burger. Grill for 2 minutes or until cooked through. Serve.

title: Prawn and Bacon Lasagna
ingredients: 2 strips bacon | 9 lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c degrees celsius. Melt bacon in oven dish. Cook lasagne noodles for about 5 minutes. Drain & then combine with other ingredients. Top with extra bacon.

title: Angel Hair with Mushrooms and Black Beans
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 1 cup unsalted pumpkin seeds, coarsely chopped | 1 1/4 cups unsweetened miniature marshmallows | 1 1/8 cups cooked black beans | 2 packages angel hair pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a skillet over medium low heat, lightly toast the bacon. Remove the bacon and crumble into 1/2 inch pieces. Remove and discard the oil from the pan. Stir pumpkin seeds into the same oil. Cook until the color darkens and smells fragrant, about 3 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and add mini marshmallows. Remove the marshmallow mixture from the heat. Using a slotted spoon, remove the marshmallow mixture from the pan. Add the beans and stir to combine. Place the pasta in a large pot of boiling, salted water. Cook until tender but still firm to the bite. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the cooking water. Transfer drained pasta to the pan with the marshmallow mixture and fold in the bean mixture. Transfer to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until lightly toasted, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: potato starch,white onion,kernel corn,grain rice,portobello mushroom,red bell pepper,peach,oatmeal
title: Mushroom Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 package portobello mushrooms, sliced | 1 medium white onion, chopped | 1 red bell pepper, chopped | 4 cups quick-cooking rolled oats, uncooked | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 1 cup quick-cooking rolled oats
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, saute onion, bell pepper and mushrooms until veggies are tender. Add next 3 ingredients.

Random Ingredients: salad oil,oriental sesame oil,gouda cheese,saffron strand
title: Gouda Cheese Sticks (Hondura) for Steak Frites
ingredients: 1 lb swiss cheese, sliced into thin sticks ( such as japenã hondura ) | 2 ounces gouda cheese, sliced thinly across ( such as jicamaã s ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand ( about 10 threads or crumbled white thread threads ) | 1 teaspoon oriental sesame oil, more if needed ( optional ) | fresh salad oil, for brushing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange slices of gouda cheese on parchment paper on pan. Sprinkle with saffron. Arrange more slices over cheese. Bake in preheated oven until cheese has melted and started to brown, 20 to 30 minutes. Remove from oven, stir in 1/2 teaspoon of oil, if desired, and let cool 3 to 5 minutes. Drizzle remaining 1/2 teaspoon oil over cheese and allow to sit 5 minutes. Remove from sheet and spread salad oil on top. Cut cheese sticks into sticks. Serve warm.

title: Chewy Vanilla Sugar Frozen Yogurt
ingredients: 600 g soymilk | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon of grated ginger ale ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar ( optional ) | 5 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: For best results, make sure the yogurt is smooth then chill until ready to serve or you can prepare it an hour in advance. For best results, freeze yogurt. Remove top layer of solidified fat from top layer. With hands, scrape excess fat off from sides of bowl. Using a spoon, empty yogurt into bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Mix the ingredients to make a thickish paste. Refrigerate several hours, stirring occasionally, to allow flavors to develop.

title: Shallow Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 ounces dried mung beans | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped japanese pistachios or 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped coriander leaves | 2 serrano peppers, chopped
instructions: Soak rinsed and picked over beans in cold water 2 - 3 hours or overnight. Drain. Place beans, chili paste and coriander in blender or food processor and process or blend ingredients until smooth. Stir beans into dip. Place on serving tray lined with aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,lemon pepper,pork,dark soy sauce,pimiento,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Grilled Cheese Rollups With Pimientos and Pork (Quesadillas)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground pork | 1 bunch medium fresh parsley | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup pimientos | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: First, make the filling, grind the peanuts in a food processor until they are fine. Mix the soy sauce, pimientos, sesame oil, lemon pepper, and the ground peanuts together in a mixing bowl. Preheat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Spread the pork evenly on a flat surface. Roll the meat mixture into a cigar shape by holding and flipping the meat. Repeat with remaining mixture. Grill the meat, turning once, until cooked through, 18 to 20 minutes.. Serve warm with plain or pita bread.

Random Ingredients: cooking brown rice,chili powder,salt pepper,puff pastry,crescent dinner,tomato puree,leg lamb,yellow squash
title: Lamb Tzimmes
ingredients: 1 lb boneless leg of lamb | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/4 cup frozen yellow squash | 1 -2 tablespoon quick-cooking brown rice | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking brown rice | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | salt and pepper, to taste | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry | 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
instructions: Rinse and cut lamb into 3/4 slices.

Random Ingredients: broiler fryer chicken,gingerroot,chickpea,yellow onion,breadcrumb,pinto bean,red wine,gelatin
title: Mama's Chicken and Chickpea Bake
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 medium yellow onion | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated ( or 1 tsp. salt ) | 2 cans chickpeas | 1 cup red wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb
instructions: Rinse the chicken and cube it or cut into pieces that are about 3/4 inch wide. If you don't have a large roaster, you can make your own by placing the chicken in a pot and cover with water. This is called the broiler setting, put the chicken on a cookie sheet or a cookie sheet, and heat to simmer. You can also put it under the broiler to brown slowly.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,half,black greek olive,red leaf lettuce,cream mushroom soup,grand marnier
title: The Best Green Veggie Salad Ever
ingredients: 1 head red leaf lettuce, rinsed | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 bunch green leaf leaf lettuce, rinsed | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup kosher salt | 1/3 cup black greek olives, sliced
instructions: Line a 6 cup vegetable salad bowl with plastic wrap. Toss the lettuce with 1/3 cup grand marnier and 1/4 cup kosher salt. Carefully pour contents of plastic wrap into salad bowl. Toss with remaining grand marnier in a small bowl. Top with green leaf lettuce just before serving. To serve, place soup in a small bowl, and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high 1 minute or until warm, stirring twice. Stir into salad bowl with soup.

title: Green Chili Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 cans chopped green chilies | 1 can mushrooms, chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix cheese, green chilies and mushrooms until thoroughly combined.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,flat leaf italian parsley,cilantro leaf
title: Coconut Parsley Pesto
ingredients: 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, stems and leaves | 3 bunches fresh cilantro leaves | 2 cans coconut milk
instructions: Combine the parsley, cilantro leaves and coconut milk in a food processor. Blend until a pesto like consistency is achieved. Store in the refrigerator. You can freeze this for a few days, or refrigerate this to use for another use.

title: Homemade Nuts
ingredients: 1 teaspoon whole cumin seeds | 1/4 teaspoon whole cloves
instructions: Toast cumin in a small skillet over medium heat until fragrant and toasted through, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle. Add more if desired and store in tightly covered container.

title: Spanish Black Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 small cremini mushrooms, stalks removed, caps sliced thin | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 2 cups cooked spanish rice, chilled
instructions: Rinse and discard stems of mushrooms. Place mushrooms in a large bowl, sprinkle with thyme croutons, and toss to coat evenly. To serve, divide mushroom mixture among warmed bowls. Serve immediately.

title: Whiskey
ingredients: 4 cups rye flour | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons liquid honey
instructions: If you would like a darker horse flour, stir all ingredients in a bowl until they are combined thoroughly. Heat a large cast iron skillet to medium high heat and brush lightly with oil. Add mixture and cook until bottom is dark brown. Turn carefully, browning underneath.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,water chestnut,half,sazon seasoning,green leaf lettuce
title: Sunflower Green Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 leaf green lettuce | 4 -6 ounces chopped water chestnuts | 1 teaspoon sazon seasoning ( sazon picante ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: Shake water chestnuts and sazon in a small bowl and marinate in the half and half until they are warm to the touch and the liquid has reduced down. When ready to serve, cut the lettuce leaves into four bundles with sharp kitchen scissors, then cut all of them into bite size pieces. Just before serving, drizzle the oil on the greens and toss.

title: Chili Brod
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise ( not miracle whip ) | 1 chipotle pepper, minced | 1 bunch escarole, rinsed | 2 eggs, hard cooked and chopped
instructions: Chop the hard cooked eggs and combine with mayonnaise. Add chipotle and keep the rest on the counter for next time. You could also add fresh chili, cayenne or minced jalapenos for a hotter mixture. It would probably be easier to add more chipotle. I tried it and it didn't seem to be as spicy. Feel free to adjust it. I used 3 teaspoons of chipotle.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,phyllo dough,self rising flour,baking powder,graham cracker crumb
title: Easy Chilled Samosas (Chinese Phyllo Crackers)
ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons chili paste ( found in asian or asian markets ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground baking powder | 1 cup defrosted phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. In a large bowl, sift together the flour, graham cracker crumbs, chili paste and baking powder. Cut a 10x13 inch inch sheet of parchment paper about 6 inches wide and 13 inches long. Place a sheet of parchment paper along the long side of the paper to make a 3 inch long sheet. Using a 2 1/2 inch glass or metal spatula, generously spray the parchment with vegetable oil.

title: Easiest and Best Chili Pork Sausages
ingredients: 4 links pork sausage links | 3 tablespoons chili sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lay the sausage links into a baking dish or roasting pan. Season with chili sauce. Roast in the preheated oven until heated through, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Tropical Corn Appetizer
ingredients: 10 cups uncooked corn | 1/2 head fresh sweet corn, husks left on | 1 cup raw sugar, or as needed | 1 cup black sesame seeds, hulled
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch glass baking dish. Bring 2 cups water to boil in a large skillet on high. Add sweetcorn.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,thyme,cardamom pod,black tea,cucumber,breadcrumb,brown sugar,red bell pepper
title: Tea Cakes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons strong black tea | 1 tablespoon cake flour | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup finely chopped cucumber | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 3/4 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper | 2 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: For the filling, in a small bowl, combine the tea and flour and mix well. In a small bowl, combine the bread crumbs, cucumber, thyme, cardamom, pepper, and sugar and mix well. For each burger, shape 1 tbsp of the mixture into a circle and place on a lightly greased or parchment lined baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: hot mustard,chicken broth,port wine gelatin mix,currant,chipotle pepper
title: Sweet N Sour Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried currants | 1 can chicken broth | 1 package hot mustard | 1 package port wine flavored gelatin mix | 1/2 cup sweetened dried chipotle peppers ( optional )
instructions: Stir the dried currants, chicken broth, hot mustard and port jelly mix together in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Cook for about 10 minutes. Place the chipotle peppers in a food processor, and process until pureed. Pour the blended dressing into a resealable plastic bag, and add the chipotle pepper sauce. Seal the bag and massage it into the sourdough mixture for at least 2 hours at room temperature, to develop flavor.

title: Easy Raisin N Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup golden raisin | 1 package sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In fondue pot, melt cheddar cheese over low heat. Once melted, stir well to combine. Dip raisins into cheese mixture, coating evenly. Once coated allow time for noodles, vegetables or cheese to melt.

title: Aussie Corn Truffles
ingredients: 1 can baby corn | 1 1/2 cups broth | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Heat in microwave on high 3 minute or in microwave at high 100% power 3 - 4 minute. If desired, roll into balls or roll in chopped nuts. Spray a little bit of cooking oil on a hot frying pan. Stir and fry until lightly browned on all sides.

title: Fish Soup (Batteredygook)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white fish fillets, in small chunks | 1 3/4 lbs rolled oats | salt cod fish | 2 - 3 1/2 cups hot water
instructions: Put the fish on to boil. Then reduce heat and let boil for 5 minutes, then drain and set aside. Mix the oats in a basin and put it in a pan with a lid. Add just enough of the water to just make a slurry from the oats in the basin. Bring water to a boil and gradually add the oats mix it with the flaked cod fish. Cook for a few minutes until cooked through remove the cod fish from the soup. Serve with your favourite breads.

title: Apple Empanadas
ingredients: 3 cups finely-chopped cooking apples | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 2 tablespoons cajeta mexican caramel sauce | 3 small eggs | 10 fluid ounces cajeta mexican caramel sauce ( homemade is best )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together apples, mustard, velvety caramel sauce and cajeta cheese. Beat together the egg and scramble into cheese mixture. Drop by heaping tablespoonsfuls into hot caramel sauce.

title: Creamy Delicious Mexican Guacamole
ingredients: 3 large avocados | 2 ounces cream cheese | 2 teaspoons mexican seasoning | 1 large hot pepper
instructions: Pit all 4 avocados, remove pit and slice off the last piece of avocado using a spoon. Blend all filling ingredients until creamy. Serve with tortilla chips. If desired, top to taste with shredded cheddar cheese.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,leek,red pepper paste,rigatoni pasta,focaccia bread
title: Rippled Leeks With Focaccia
ingredients: 1 leek, white and light green part only, sliced thin | 1/2 tablespoon red pepper paste | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt | 3/4 lb rigatoni pasta or 3/4 lb other small flat loaf pan | 1 -2 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil or 1 -2 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil, for cooking
instructions: Lightly coat an 8 to 9 ounce deep skillet with oil. Place leek slices in pan and add red pepper paste. Cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly, 3 or 4 minutes, until leek is lightly browned and crisp tender. Add yogurt and cover and cook 3 minutes more. Remove pan from heat and stir in rigatoni or other small loaf pan. Heat until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: green onion,garam masala powder,cumin powder,lettuce,tomato puree,wheat pastry flour,vanilla ice cream,rotisserie chicken
title: Mashed Lettuce (Indian Tacos)
ingredients: 5 lettuce, washed and torn into pieces | 1 lb rotisserie chicken, left whole | 1/4 cup tomato puree ( ketchup ) | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla ice cream ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon green onion ( sliced in 1/2-inch pieces ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 teaspoons whole wheat pastry flour
instructions: Place the torn lettuce in a large mixing bowl and add the rotisserie chicken. Add tomato puree, green onion, garam masala and cumin powders. Cover bowl and let marinate for at least one hour, preferably overnight in refrigerator. When ready to serve, prepare the mashed lettuce. In a bowl mix together 2 tbsp flour, 1 tsp cumin, and the 1/2 tsp garam masala. Mix well. Then add the mashed lettuce and stir with a fork. The lettuce will absorb the flavours and make it easier to turn. Once the lettuce is well mixed, mix the rest of the dry ingredients together and then add to the masala the chicken is eating. Keep adding the flour/vegetable mixture to the chicken mixture and continue to mix until it reaches desired consistency. The finished meal can be served hot, but if you prefer it plain, or slightly warmed, you can add an ice cream scoop in the middle of the masala. A scoop of ice cream is the most important ingredient in this recipe. If you are going to be using the potato sourdough bread as you would with potato masala, you can then add the sourdough bread to the chicken mixture.

Random Ingredients: kahlua,pineapple juice,asian sesame oil,dark brown sugar,chocolate shaving,egg,green bell pepper,green onion
title: Kahlua Chile-Pineapple Egg Cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons asian sesame oil | 1 1/2 pounds large eggs | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 green bell pepper, cut into large chunks | 2 green onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 ounce semisweet chocolate shavings
instructions: Preheat an oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a 9x 13 inch baking dish. Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat, and cook and stir the eggs until they are well blended and beginning to turn golden, 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in the pineapple, bell pepper, and green onions. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the kahlua, brown sugar, and chocolate shavings. Bring to a boil, and pour into the mixture. Remove from heat, and immediately pour into the prepared dish. Cover with foil, and bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb,red cayenne pepper,beef chuck,cold water,salad oil,farfalle pasta,asafoetida powder,pita bread
title: M'ghola (Middle Eastern Meatballs)
ingredients: 3 lbs lean ground lamb or 3 lbs beef | 1 lb ground beef chuck | 3/4 lb asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 tablespoon cold water | 1 teaspoon red cayenne pepper | 1 lb uncooked farfalle pasta or 1 lb spaghetti | pita bread, for serving
instructions: Make meatballs, place a large skillet with a tight fitting lid over medium high heat. When the pan is hot, pour in the oil and swirl to coat the bottom. When the oil is hot but not smoking, add all the meatballs and turn them a few times. Sprinkle the asafoetida on top. When they are a little darker, add the water and stir to coat. Then add the cayenne pepper. Cover and cook for a few minutes. When the meatball mixture is cooked through and the water is boiling, add the farfalle. Cook, covered, for 25 to 30 minutes. At the same time, cook the spaghetti according to package directions, drain and set aside. Serve meatball sauce over the drained pasta and scatter with pita bread.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,bouquet garni,french green bean,raspberry jam,chickpea,wheat flour,chorizo sausage
title: Green Beans, Chorizo and Chickpeas With Raspberry Ham
ingredients: 300 g baby broccoli florets | 2 chorizo sausages | 150 g french style green beans, halved | 1 bouquet garni, bay leaf and celery and some thyme | 150 g canned chickpeas, drained | 60 ml raspberry jam | 6 -8 teaspoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees centigrade. Place flour on a board and roll out dough quickly to form a rectangle. Add a little boiling water to work surface if dough is too sticky. Roll dough again and remove from pan. Place on a lightly floured board. Flour lightly. Cut sausage into 4 pieces and fry in pan, breaking into pieces as it cooks, then set aside. Place broccoli and chorizo in a roasting tin and place in the oven. Cook for 15 mins or until beginning to soften. Add beans and bay leaf to pan and cook, stirring, for 3 - 4 minutes or until hot. Spread raspberry jam on top of beans and cook for a further 10 minutes or until jam is melted. Remove chorizo from pan when it is cooked, remove and discard fat. Spread a little warm jam over the ham and spread with 2 tsps of cheese on top. Place roasting tin on middle rack of oven and cook for 15 minutes, or until cooked. To serve, divide beans in half and place half of cooked broccoli on warmed plate. Top with cooked green beans that have been sizzled with a little raspberry and a sprig of thyme. Put sliced sausage on top of these vegetables.

title: Southern Dill Pickle Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh dill pickle sticks | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1/4 cup white sugar
instructions: Place the pickle sticks in a large pot and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,thai basil,chipotle chile adobo,vanilla extract,almond extract,greek yogurt
title: Chipotle Raita
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs ( about 7 ounces ) | 1 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon ground chipotle chile ( from a jar ) | 1 1/4 cups thai basil, sliced
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs and yogurt in a bowl. Stir in other ingredients until well blended. Chill 1 hour. Spread on an ungreased cookie sheet 1 1/2 inches apart. Sprinkle with the chilies and basil. Let stand at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Dry Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs button mushrooms | 2 teaspoons ghee ( butter or oil )
instructions: Wipe mushrooms and trim off woody ends if using fresh ones. Dry the stems and set aside. Heat the ghee in a deep pan and put the mushroom stems in the pan. Fry for 1 - 2 minutes until they start to brown. Turn the mushroom caps over and fry for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Gruyere Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 4 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 10 tablespoons sweet onion, chopped | 1/2 cup kahlua ( coffee-flavored liqueur ) | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | sriracha sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mini processor or a blender. Process until smooth. Divide into four portions and roll out into a circle on a flat work surface. Serve immediately with dipping chocolates.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,teriyaki sauce,button mushroom,szechwan pepper,kahlua,red pepper flake,baby spinach leaf
title: Spinach and Mushrooms Teriyaki With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1 pinch red pepper flakes | 1 jar button mushrooms ( drained and sliced ) | 1 tablespoon finely shredded szechwan pepper ( coarsely chopped, or use 1/2 tsp. green chili powder ) | 20 -30 baby spinach leaves
instructions: In a small saucepan, over medium high heat, combine the maple syrup, teriyaki sauce, kahlua, red pepper flakes, mushrooms, and sichuan pepper. Simmer, stirring a few times, until mushrooms are softened, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a medium non aluminum frying pan on medium high heat. Add the baby spinach leaves and cook for 2 minutes. Add the cooked spinach to the pan and stir to combine. Add the maple sauce mixture to the pan and cook, stirring just 1 minute. Serve immediately. Great served over saagang bbq or your favourite meat.

Random Ingredients: tangerine juice,sea salt,ice cube,salmon fillet,sage,anaheim chilies,cornflour
title: Smoked Salmon With a Yummy Blended Chilies
ingredients: 500 g sea salt | 150 ml tangerine juice | 4 -5 small dried anaheim chilies ( or other small chilies, seeds and membranes removed, roughly chopped ) | 1 tablespoon fresh sage, shredded or 1 teaspoon dried sage | 10 ounces smoked salmon fillets, skin removed ( of about 4 ) | 1 teaspoon cornflour | ice cube, to serve
instructions: Place a rack in top half of a large barbeque or grill until very hot and hot, or put a tray in low the oven to warm. Combine chilies, sage and olive oil in a medium bowl and season with salt, stir to combine. Place salmon fillets in a small metal bowl and pour the liquid around. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Put salmon fillets in a heatproof dish and place in the oven when the salmon has cooked for 25 - 30 minutes. For a smoky taste serve with the chilies.

title: Mango Basil Soup
ingredients: 1 cup mango nectar | 1 can vegetable broth | 2 -4 fresh basil leaves | 1/4 cup water
instructions: Combine the mango nectar and vegetable broth in a large saucepan and heat. Add the basil, water, and basil.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,scallop,vegetable broth,romaine lettuce,corn,peanut oil vegetable,rice vinegar
title: Scallops and Scallops in a Garbanzo Bean & Rice Vinegar Broth
ingredients: 4 ounces rice vinegar | 1 bag fresh garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained and patted dry | vegetable broth | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 lb scallop | corn | chopped of fresh mint or cilantro | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Rinse garbanzo beans to remove surface residue. Combine with 1 cup vegetable broth as per package directions. Place over medium heat. Add remaining 1/2 cup broth and cook until broth is reduced by half and is syrupy, about 25 minutes in a 4 quart pan. Meanwhile, place scallops in a large bowl with remaining broth. In a 1 quart heavy skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat. Cook scallops until browned on each side, about 4 minutes per side. Spoon over broth.

title: Italian Hot Olive Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped ( about 1 cup ) | 1 celery rib, halved lengthwise, then halved
instructions: Mix the olives and celery in an electric blender. Add a little water to loosen the mix. Store covered in the refrigerator.

title: Lima Bean and Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon olive oil | cooking spray | 1/2 lb chicken wings, tips removed, sliced diagonally | 12 -18 olives | 1 teaspoon dried parsley | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Coat chicken pieces with olive oil and spray with cooking spray. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine seasonings. Sprinkle breadcrumbs over chicken. Drain soaked chick peas and add breadcrumbs to chicken, stir again. Arrange chicken in a baking dish, cover and bake 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through.

title: Indian-Spiced Oil - Canning
ingredients: 6 green cardamom pods | 1 - 2 1/2 tablespoon arrowroot ( or mix of cornstarch and water )
instructions: Using a knife or pestle or a small saucepan, lightly crush the cardamom pods with a pinch or two of salt. Heat a medium sized pot to a medium temperature. Lightly film with oil. When the oil is very hot, add the cardamom pods and a pinch of salt. Stir until the cardamom pods have begun to pop at the surface. Add 1 - 2 1/2 tbsp warm water. When the mixture is hot, put the lid in the pan. The cardamom will begin to swell, take care that it doesn't spill around the pan. When the lid is shaking the pot to ensure an even coating of oil on the tops, pour out the oil. When all of the oil has been incorporated, pour the contents of the pan into a sterilized quart sized jar. Cover the jar. Close the lid and shake until the cardamom begins to soften. It may have a little droop in the oil when you test if the oil is ready.. Remove the lid and shake vigorously until the mixture is all cold and smooth.. Pour the mixture back into the jar and cool to room temperature. The oil may now be kept for several months in a cool, dark place. I haven't had it 'al dente', and the quality of the aroma will change.

title: American Kitchen Classic Lexington Copycat Recipe Copycat
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk, plus | 3 tablespoons buttermilk | 1 cup catsup
instructions: Mix buttermilk and catsup in a bowl, add to mixture. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Raspberry Miso Cake
ingredients: 7 cups raspberries | 1/4 cup white miso | 2 1/2 cups baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine baking powder, miso and raspberries and beat until smooth. Pour mixture into greased and floured tube pan. Bake in 350f for 45 - 60 minutes until top is lightly browned. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature, then cut into squares.

title: Beet Pecorino, Fresh Tomatillos and Pecorino Romano Cheese
ingredients: 15 tomatillos, coarsely cut ( medium size ) | 1/2 lb beet, peeled, coarsely chopped | 6 fresh thyme sprigs | 1/2 lb pecorino romano cheese, cut into very thin slices | 1 tablespoon argan dal
instructions: Place tomatillos & beet in a pot with water to cover. Bring to boil over high heat & boil for 5 minutes. Add thyme & pecorino romano cheese and cook until mixture is mushy. Remove from heat and allow to cool until easy to handle. Drain and cool until easy to handle & manageable. Using pulino romano cheese to prevent sticking, use a 1 x 1 inch cookie cutter to make small indentations in the side of each tomatillo. Using mortar and pestle or fork, pound tomatillos and beet with thyme and pepper. Spread about 2 tablespoons tomatillo & beet mixture in the center of each chip and press down slightly. Fold over and press lightly in the sides too. Garnish with green pistils and fresh thyme sprigs.

title: Spicy Italian Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup panko crumbs ( japanese bread crumbs ) | 4 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1/3 - 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped red chili pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and spread onto a serving platter. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,baking chocolate,frangelico,cooking apple,montreal steak seasoning,turkey wing,pizza crust,broccoli floret
title: Grilled Chicken and Turkey Pizza With Pepperjack Apple Pan Gravy
ingredients: 1 pizza crust ( such as boboli or a purchased pizza crust - i use boboli pizza crust ) | 1 large roasting apple ( about 1 cup diced and divided ) | cooking apple ( about 1 cup diced and divided ) | 1 ounce montreal steak seasoning ( i use mccormick montreal steak steak seasoning ) | 100 g white pearl onions | 1/2 cup broccoli floret | 12 ounces turkey wings, cooked ( or any other type of meat you choose ) | 2 ounces semisweet baking chocolate ( i use dutch processed ) | brandy flavoring or frangelico or brandy
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f. Prepare pizza crust and toppings first, mix apple, 1/2 cup of diced onion, broccoli, turkey, sausage, and grated cheese. On a cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray, toss toppings and apple mixture. Brush your pizzas with brandy flavoring or frangelico and put on pizza rack and lightly toast at 450°f for 20 minute enjoy.

title: Chicken Wing and Rice
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups warm orange juice ( about 110 degrees f ) | 2 (.25 ounce ) packages active dry yeast | 2/3 cup warm water | 3 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 2 lbs chicken wings
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together warm orange juice and yeast. In a small bowl, stir together warm water, arborio rice, harissa, and mace. Pour into the warm orange mixture.

Random Ingredients: mace,chicken wing,chicken thigh,lime,heavy whipping cream,hot red pepper flake
title: Hot Chicken and Wings (Pa Dutch)
ingredients: 2 2 lbs chicken wings or 2 lbs chicken drumsticks | 1 whole large chicken thigh | 10 ounces heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/8 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Trim any fat from chicken, cut in half then slice crosswise at 1/4 inch intervals. Place a single layer of chicken in a 13x9 inch baking dish in a single layer. Scatter remaining chicken in baking dish. Whisk cream with mace and dry crushed red pepper flakes until blended. Pour over chicken. Cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Remove from oven. Uncover. Drizzle cream on chicken and bake a further 5 minutes, or until chicken is hot. Serve with rice. Goes well with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,angel hair pasta,rice,peanut,feta cheese,coriander seed
title: Easy Beef Skillet
ingredients: 3 beef tip roast | 1 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1 package angel hair pasta | 1/4 cup rice, uncooked | 1/2 cup dried roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese ( optional )
instructions: Cut the roast in 1/4 inch slices across the grain. Sprinkle with coriander seed. In a large nonstick skillet, bring 3 cups water to boil. Place the beef slices on top of the coriander and let it steam over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Transfer the roast to a plate and set aside. Meanwhile, bring 4 cups water to a boil. Add the angel hair pasta and cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until al dente. Drain and return to the pot. Pour noodles into the skillet. Toss the meat with the peanuts and then top with the feta cheese.

title: Lavender Raita
ingredients: 500 g low fat ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 1 tablespoon dried lavender | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together the ricotta, coriander, lavender and oil. Spoon into a paper lined 20cm x 30cm loaf tin. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours.

title: Tapioca Stir Fry Seasoning.
ingredients: 1 cup water | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 2 tablespoons tapioca, dry
instructions: Mix together in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,tangerine,vegetable,chicken broth,peanut,dough,green curry paste
title: Green Curry Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh greens such as spinach, arugula, spinach or arugula | 6 1/2 cups chicken broth or 6 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 1/2 tablespoons thick green curry paste | 1 tablespoon tangerine, juice | 1 tablespoon dried tangerine, zest grated | 6 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, preferably bamboo shoots, thawed | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger-garlic paste or 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger | chopped dry roasted peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Wash greens as desired and trim off woody ends. Using a large, heavy saucepan, bring broth, curry paste and liquid to boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Serve hot, garnished with nuts. Variation, substitute 2 cups of each veggie for the ginger.

Random Ingredients: mortadella,vanilla essence,red bell pepper,honey,garlic,chicken breast half,beef bouillon cube,grit
title: Slimming World Friendly Crock Pot Caramelized Chicken With Bacon & Grits
ingredients: 6 -8 boneless chicken breast halves, defrosted if frozen | 1/4 lb mortadella ( fresh in the tube cut into thin strips, you can use mozzarella if you use fresh ) | 1/2 cup raw rice if you're not using packaged sweet grits | 1/2 cup dry red bell pepper ( you can either cut in long thin strips, or cut into thin strips ) | 1/2 cup raw ground beef bouillon cube ( optional ) | 2 cloves garlic, smashed | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Add all ingredients to the crock pot, stir to mix and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. When done, remove from crock pot, shred or chop and serve.

title: Kaffir Lime Soup (Kharki Kheema)
ingredients: 4 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime zest | 1 - 1 1/2 cup sour yogurt ( optional ) | salt & water, as needed | 1 tablespoon salt, to taste
instructions: Soak lime zest in salt water for 5 minutes. Squeeze the zest with your hands as you squeeze it, then set aside. Bring stock to a boil. Turn down heat, and set aside 1 cup broth. Pour 1 cup broth into another container. Wisk sour yogurt into broth. Set aside. In a small saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil. Place kaffir lime zest in broth and stir until the water turns golden brown. Drain lime zest onto paper towels. Sprinkle salt over yogurt. Serve in individual bowls.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,broccoli floret,active yeast,cumin seed,tomato puree
title: Broccoli & Tomato Pizza
ingredients: 2/3 cup tomato puree | 2/3 cup broccoli floret | 1 teaspoon instant onion and garlic in dry minced onion powder ( i use minced onion ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon butter | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds or 2 tablespoons nigella seeds, toasted in a hot skillet
instructions: In a small frying pan, toast cumin seeds and allow to cool to room temperature. Spread untoasted cumin seeds onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and allow to cool to room temperature before adding next 3 ingredients. Place cooled cumin seeds in a bowl and allow to cool until room temperature. In a small saucepan, place tomato puree and broccoli. Stir well over medium heat until combined. Add onion and garlic powder. In a small frying pan, lightly toast nigella seeds or nigella seeds and allow to warm to room temperature. Add the toasted cumin seeds and allow to cool. Dived pizza into two portions with your toppings and place in refrigerator or over night. Allow two of the portions per person.

title: Easy Biryani
ingredients: 1 cup medium grain rice | 4 cups water | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 tablespoon white pepper
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions and set aside. Cook barley according to package directions. When the rice is done, stir in white pepper and pearl barley.

title: Asparagus Cakes (Garlicky Asparagus Spears)
ingredients: 1 pound asparagus, trimmed | 2 packages frozen spears iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and chopped | 2 cups heavy whipping cream, or more as needed | 1 pinch mustard powder | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 2 teaspoons finely crushed iceberg lettuce, or as desired
instructions: Place asparagus spears in a microwave safe bowl and cover with warm water. Set aside heat in microwave until asparagus is hot, about 5 minutes. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir asparagus spears in hot skillet until asparagus is bright green and slightly browned, 4 to 5 minutes per side. Toss asparagus spears with iceberg lettuce in a bowl. Cook and stir asparagus spears with iceberg lettuce in the microwave until asparagus is hot, about 5 minutes per side. Serve in a large glass bowl with a dollop of whipped cream and a sprinkling of mustard powder. Dust each serving with coriander.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,red lentil,extra beef,pork,french bread,dark soy sauce,romaine lettuce,tamarind juice
title: Cousin Cosmo (Pork and Lentil Salad)
ingredients: 400 g lambs lettuce, torn in half | 400 g red lentils, rinsed and drained | 400 g extra lean ground beef ( meat may not be used, although some brands are ) | 1 tablespoon tamarind juice | 2 tablespoons extra dark soy sauce | 500 g firm ripe grape tomatoes or 500 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons french bread, toasted and crumbled
instructions: Place a large salad bowl on the hob on medium heat. While the heat is heating up, make asian dressing. Combine the lambs lettuce, lentils, beef, tamarind juice, soy sauce, tomatoes and bread in the bowl with the dressing and combine well. Season and serve over the salad. Tip, if you are making your own dressing, toss 200g firm white sliced oranges, sliced pears and red capsicum in some olive oil and freshly steamed mango salsa before adding the salad.

title: Italian Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage ( sausage preferred ) | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Using a slotted spoon, scoop out center of sausage meat leaving about 1 inch of fat behind. Place sausage meat on a cutting board and cut diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Slice diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Place sausage in a large bowl. Stir together italian seasoning and remaining ingredients and pour into sausage meat. Toss thoroughly, coating evenly. If desired, let rest at least 15 minutes. Grill sausage meat 5 minutes on dry side, or until no longer pink. Turn sausage and cook 2 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,beef brisket,iceberg lettuce,tomato sauce,red wine,curry powder,italian parsley
title: Corned Beef & Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1 envelope dill weed | 1 cup red wine | 1 -2 tablespoon curry powder | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped | 4 teaspoons tomato sauce | 8 slices iceberg lettuce
instructions: Place brisket in crockpot. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over brisket. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Discard liquid. Shred brisket with fork and slice across grain. Serve with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,pumpkin puree,apricot preserve,green chili pepper,clam juice
title: Pumpkin and Apricot Jam
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree, not pie filling | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup bottled clam juice | 4 cloves crushed garlic
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine pumpkin and preserves. Bring to a boil over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: broth,rice noodle,green bean,chicken wing,mint leaf,head cauliflower,honey
title: Yummy Persian Chicken
ingredients: 2 whole chickens wings | 1 head cauliflower, separated into florets | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 cup broth | 2 cups rice noodles | 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves ( optional ) | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, snipped or 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Bend the wings, and set aside. Boil cauliflower until just tender, not crunchy, then drain in a colander. Dry the chicken, and dry out the inside. Wash and dry the noodles. Stuff the cavity with the stuffing and decorate with the mint leaves or other herbs just before serving. If you need to make this as a finger food, make sure you have enough sauce to lightly coat the noodles.

title: Black Olive Pizzas (France)
ingredients: 8 slices firm ripe black olive | 2 teaspoons dried dill ( or 2 tsp. dried ) | 2 teaspoons dried white breadcrumbs ( or breadcrumbs ) | 4 tablespoons pineapple juice, from the can
instructions: Open the olives, cut in half and scoop out the inside of the olive with a spoon. Place the olives in a bowl and sprinkle with dill and breadcrumbs. Heat the juice in a small frying pan until it nearly boils. Pour over the olives and toss well to coat. To keep them together, put a scooped out olive on a flat wooden board, place on top of a crumb and roll gently, lifting with your hands to keep moist. Using a sharp knife, remove the pit with a knife and scrape out as many seeds as possible. Arrange the hollowed out olives on a paper towel lined baking sheet and sprinkle each with a little more dill. Set the baking sheet in a cool dry place for 15 minutes. Preheat the oven to 180c. Heat a flat griddle or heavy based frying pan on the stove top. Turn your heat down for a moment, then use the spatula to gently push the puffs of breadcrumbs into the pan. Cook them, turning them until they are toasted and crusty on all sides and the juices are absorbed. Allow 3 minutes if they have been in long enough, and then turn them over and fry for another minute. Using a long handled spoon or a slotted spoon, lift them out of the pan and drain on kitchen paper towels. Place the pizzas on a serving dish and keep warm in an oven until you need them for a few hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: cooking apple,stock,pork rib,orange vodka,oil,tarragon,swiss cheese,button mushroom
title: Stuffed Pork
ingredients: 5 pork ribs | 4 ounces swiss cheese, coarsely grated | 4 slices cooking apples | 1 ounce button mushroom | 2 tablespoons oil, plus extra for drizzling | 1 tablespoon orange vodka | 3/4 cup stock | 1 sprig fresh tarragon or 1 sprig basil, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/375f/gas mark 3/8, remove membrane from pork, discard. Score the meat deeply with a sharp knife, then place on a sheet of greaseproof paper and flatten out lightly with your fingers. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cheese on each side of the pork. Top with 2 slices of the apples and half the mushrooms. Wrap the pork in the cheese, and place on an oven proof dish which has been turned to a medium temperature. Drizzle with the orange vodka and remaining tablespoon of cheese and a sprig of fresh herb or basil. Put in the oven for about 35 minutes, or until pork is cooked through and the cheese is well crisp. Serve immediately with boiled potatoes and boiled new potatoes to the side.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,simple syrup,white fish fillet,pasta sauce,beef eye,avocado,icing sugar,apricot
title: Baked Fish Ceviche With Apricots
ingredients: 4 lbs beef eye round, sliced 1/2-in. thick | 1 1/4 lbs medium white fish fillets, thinly sliced ( such as cod or halibut ) | 1/2 cup icing sugar, sifted | 2 large avocados, peeled, pitted and thinly sliced | 2 cans apricots, drained and chopped | 1 cup tomato-based pasta sauce, bottled or ( 2 3/4 ounce ) cup homemade sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon simple syrup | jalapeno pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place beef eye of round in shallow baking pan, and place in oven to brown on all sides. While beef is browning, arrange the fish filets in a single layer in a shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with icing sugar. Combine sliced avocado, apricots and sauce with 2 cups water in a small bowl. Pour over beef and bake for 20 minutes, or until fish is just cooked through. Transfer to a serving platter. Serve with jalapeno pepper.

title: Caldillo de Choclo

instructions: Prick brisket all over with 4 skewers. Combine cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water in large resealable plastic bag. Add brisket.

title: Johnny Jalapeno's Salsa Fritos
ingredients: 6 ounces ground round | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 medium spanish onion, diced | 1 jalapeno pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | bread flour
instructions: Combine ground round, taco seasoning and diced onion. Brown beef mixture and then drain if you like and return to pan. Mix cornstarch and bread flour until combined. Add to meat and onions and bring to boil. Cook until thick and bubbly. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Japanese Vegetables
ingredients: 1 -2 english cucumber | 2 -3 cups green | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried marinated shiitake mushrooms or 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chinese mushrooms | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional, or you may use 1/2 tsp fresh ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil | 1 package chow mein noodles
instructions: Slice the cucumbers into thin rounds, cutting off tips for easy removal. Slice mushrooms if using, and drain off all the liquid. Chop marinated shiitake if using. Combine cucumbers, marinated shiitake and herbs. Wash and chop chow mein noodles, as directed on package. Add to food processor. Process to desired consistency.

title: Gyoza
ingredients: 2 kg daikon radishes, unpeeled | 1 bunch green olives | 3 1/2 kg pickling cucumbers | 1 liter flour
instructions: Wash daikon and cucumber with cold water.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Strip Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, strips | 2 tablespoons tbsps sriracha sauce ( or more ) | 1 cup frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 cup cayenne | 10 tortillas ( i prefer jasmine ) | 2 cups pecans, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large resealable bag, add the chicken and seal. Add sriracha and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 8 hours. Combine the raspberries with cayenne in a medium bowl and toss with a fork. Place 2 tortillas on a work surface. Divide the chicken mixture among them. Divide the pecans between the tortillas, roll the tortillas up and place in a shallow baking dish.. Top with remaining tortillas. Bake in a 425 f oven for 10 minutes or until heated through.

title: Easy Beef Tataki
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 tahini | 3 -4 heads baby corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the tenderloin on a rack in a roasting pan and coat with tahini. Roast until an instant read thermometer reads 140 degrees. While the beef is roasting, cut a slit in the top of each piece of beef about 1/4 inch deep. Remove meat from pan, and using a slotted spoon, scoop out as much of the juice as possible. Return meat to pan, and toss gently. Cut out remaining pieces of beef and discard. Arrange on plates with baby corn around the beef. Surround pieces with some of the tahini sauce.

Random Ingredients: mushroom soup,brandy,liquid smoke flavoring,coffee granule,french green bean
title: Dutch Oven Green Beans
ingredients: 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 2 cans condensed mushroom soup | 1 bottle french style green beans, drained | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Combine the instant coffee, liquid smoke and green beans. Heat on the stove or in an oven safe dish. Serve with a dollop of french style green bean diagonally. To serve, place bag of french style green beans diagonally in a circle on a plate. Top with the soup. Pour liquid smoke mixture over all, and sprinkle with brandy. Serve hot.

title: Thai Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes | 1 fennel bulb, core removed | 6 ounces pepperoni, slices ( not minced ) | 8 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Cut fennel from stem, then cut it in half lengthwise. Cut off hard end, then slice thinly.
