title: Pollo Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup prepared red pesto sauce | 1 cup chicken stock | 3 tablespoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 10 black cardamom pods | 10 garlic and red chile paste | 1 package no-cook lasagna noodles, cooked | 1 small green chili pepper, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl mix together 1st 7 ingredients. Slice remaining 1/2 green chili pepper into rings and stir into the sauce. To stuff uncooked noodles, arrange noodles on a baking sheet and spoon equal amounts of sauce over noodles. Sprinkle remaining green chili pepper over top. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes or until noodles are tender and sauce is bubbling.

title: Potato Wedges With Peanut Curry
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons minced unsalted peanuts or 3 tablespoons cashews | 2 tablespoons guacamole | tzatziki, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/tzatziki-sweetened-with-curry-sauce-39217 '' > tzatziki ( sweetened curry sauce < /a >
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Scrub potatoes well and cut them lengthwise. Place 1 potato on each dinner plate and scatter with curry powder, salt and oil. title: Mustard Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb ground fish or 1 lb firm tofu | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 fennel bulb, crushed | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon harissa or 1 tablespoon other hot spice blend
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Will keep in refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Chicken Sacher
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breast fillets | 1 tablespoon bahbaileys irish cream | 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon tahini | cooking oil | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 2 cups cooked kidney beans ( drained but reserve liquid ) | 2 cups oatmeal
instructions: Marinate the chicken breast for 10 minutes. Remove any excess air fat from the chicken and coat inside and outside with the bahBaileys. Set aside. Combine the reserved liquid and the mustard and set aside. Heat some cooking oil and cook the chicken breasts 2 - 3 mins per side, then set aside. Remove from the pan and keep warm. Add the bean liquid to the pan that used to cook the chicken and bring to the boil. Return the reserved chicken breast to the pan, add the bean mixture and bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer. Divide the oatmeal among 4 serving plates, then top with the chicken and the onion mixture on top. Serve with the dressing.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,salt pepper,stewing beef,tuna steak,paprika,graham cracker crumb,lasagna noodle
title: Chinese Tuna Croquettes
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen boneless stewing beef | 1 can tuna steaks, drained, flaked | 1 -2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon paprika ( spanish smoked brand preferred ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt & pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | kitchen twine, wrap ( for tying )
instructions: Rinse meat well and place in freezer to partially thaw. Remove from freezer. Slice into 1/4 inch wide slabs about 1/4 inch thick. Combine cracker crumbs, seasonings. Dip meat in crumb mix then roll in cracker mix. Deep fry at 375 degrees till golden brown.

Random Ingredients: linguine pasta,rotel tomato chilies,syrup,grand marnier,cremini mushroom,almond extract
title: Wild and Crazy Mac
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cremini mushrooms or 3 tablespoons button mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 package linguine pasta, cooked and drained and rinsed well | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1/2 cup fat free sour cream
instructions: In skillet over medium heat, saute mushrooms until softened. Stir in 1 1/2 t. Grand marnier, the almond extract, and the cooked and drained pasta. Mix in 2 t. Of the chili powder. Remove from heat and mix with sour cream. Serve warm.

title: Italian Bread With Asparagus
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread or 1 loaf arugula, torn into bite sized pieces | 2 -3 tablespoons italian cooking sauce ( from store-bought asparagus sauce )
instructions: Put the torn italian bread in a serving dish. Sprinkle italian sauce over the bread. Sprinkle italian asparagus sauce over the asparagus and cover with the torn bread. Place in the refrigerator until completely chilled. To serve, cut the loaf into diagonal slices.

Random Ingredients: lasagna,pork shoulder,red potato,garlic juice,spaghetti sauce,mango,orange zest
title: Potato Mojo
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange zest, grated | 2 lbs pork shoulder ( or shoulder ) | 4 small red potatoes | 2 fresh mangoes, peeled & cut into 1-inch slices | 2 jars spaghetti sauce ( hunts ) | 3 tablespoons garlic juice ( from jar ) | 1 lb lasagna, broken into pieces
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f. Mix orange zest, 1 1/2 cups water, and 1 lb pork shoulder or shoulder in a large roasting pan. Pour over meat, turning as needed, and add 2 sliced sweet potatoes, peeled & cut into 1 inch slices. Season with about 1 teaspoon of salt and pepper. Cover and cook for 3 hours, basting and stirring twice. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup water, remaining 1 tablespoon orange zest, and remaining 2 sliced sweet potatoes. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook for about 1 hour or until pork is very tender. Season with more salt and pepper, if desired. Meanwhile, cook pasta in boiling water for about 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup cooking liquid. Add spaghetti, spaghetti sauce and garlic juice to pork, stirring together with a large spoon. Spoon pork mixture into lasagna pieces and arrange on a baking sheet. Bake uncovered for about 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: Gumbo Spaghetti – Shrimp in Spice-Soy and Tomato
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, minced | 1/2 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and coarsely chopped | 2 cups italian-style stewed tomatoes, cut into wedges and lightly packed | 12 ounces spaghetti, dried | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1 teaspoon fresh ground pepper | 4 leeks ( green parts only sliced ) or 4 white scallions, cut into 1/2-inch pieces ( green parts only sliced )
instructions: In a wide shallow bowl, mix the turmeric, chiles pepper, shrimp, tomatoes, and remaining ingredients, except leeks. Cover and marinate at room temperature for at least 30 minutes. Cook the spaghetti in rapidly boiling, salted water, uncovered and stirring occasionally, until al dente. Drain. Stir the shrimp or shells into the pasta and transfer to a warm platter or deep serving bowl. Garnish with leeks.

title: Grandma's Italian Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 lb medium shrimp, cooked and shelled | 3/4 lb hamburger | paprika
instructions: Brown sausage, shrimp, and hamburger. Drain off grease. Sprinkle in paprika and mix well. Let sit for about 20 minutes before serving.

title: Herbed Beef Rub
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons dried italian parsley | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon beef base
instructions: Mix all ingredients.

title: Traditional Mexican Pie
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon mole ( mole ( mole ) ( optional ) | 3 ounces phyllo dough
instructions: Mix tomato puree and mole in sauce pan, pour over pyllo. Unfold and place 1 piece of dough in edge of pyllo. Layer sauce mixture on top. Then place more piece of phyllo on top. Do the same with the rest of the pieces of dough and place in glass pyrex mold. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours. Bake 400 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes.

title: Coconut Herb Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup fresh flaked coconut, packed | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 teaspoons seasoning ( basil, oregano, and rosemary )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix ingredients thoroughly and roll into 1 inch balls. Place on parchment paper lined cookie sheet and press slightly. Bake until golden brown at cool 30 minutes.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Halibut
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh halibut fillet, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Cook, drain and rinse halibut. Marinate halibut in vinegar for 20 minutes. Cook noodles according to directions. Arrange sauce over noodles and top with halibut.

title: Pine Nut Balls
ingredients: 2 cups ground walnuts | 3 tablespoons grated fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon italian-style seasoning, plus more for garnish
instructions: Grind walnuts into a fine powder. Add italian style seasoning and ginger garlic paste.

title: Cherry Skewers for 2 (SMS)!
ingredients: 1 lb cherries, washed and dried | 2 -3 tablespoons coconut, shredded | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 dash tabasco sauce, to taste
instructions: Remove skins from the cherries by scoring a cut in the middle. Remove pits, or chop. Place coconut pieces in a small bowl and sprinkle with sesame oil and tabasco. Druise sesame oil from coconut to make a dipping sauce. Toss cherries with the oil and sesame paste. Soak sesame oil skewers in water for 15 - 30 minutes, turning frequently. Place skewers in a large, shallow container large enough to hold all of the cherries in a single layer. Skewer cherry meat with skewers, alternating with coconut/toast slices and soaked sesame oil skewers. Chill or serve. Note, to make your own syrup, place a cup of water with the coconut in a medium saucepan over medium low heat. Stir and heat, then remove from heat and stir in the toasted sesame oil.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,poblano pepper,self raising flour,broccoli,tea,demerara sugar
title: Chilean Green Tea Mix
ingredients: 4 cups self-raising flour | 2 cups cold tea | 200 g of chopped broccoli | 200 g of chopped chinese cabbage | 1 large poblano pepper | 1/3 cup of demerara sugar
instructions: Combine the first three ingredients and mix until smooth. Put in a large mixing bowl and add the chopped vegetables and sugar. Stir until everything is well combined and then add the tea in small quantities on top of the mixture. Beat again until mixed thoroughly until a firm dough is formed. Lightly flour your hands whilst kneading. It may take a little extra kneading to get a firm dough. If necessary, add water to achieve consistency you are looking for. Divide the mix into two and roll out into circles, each about 7 inches diameter. Cook on a hot griddle/broiler until brown, then slice across and place on a tea towel until dry before storing. To serve, reheat a plate and a tea towel to bring out steam and then leave on one side to dry for about 10 minutes or until cool.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,sun tomato oil,coriander seed,orange zest,apricot preserve
title: Apricot and Tomato Salad (Australia)
ingredients: 6 ripe apricot preserves | 1/4 cup apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon coriander seed ( lightly crushed ) | 1 tablespoon orange zest ( finely grated ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an oven safe bowl. Mix well and then heat in the hot oven for 10 minutes until thickened and hot. Leave to cool. Serve on crusty toast, as an appetiser or a light luncheon dish.

Random Ingredients: veal,mexican cheese,caster sugar,bisquick,tamarind paste,sirloin tip roast
title: Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast or 2 lbs chuck steaks, trimmed | 4 ounces tamarind paste | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1/2 lb mexican cheese, grated | 5 ounces sirloin tip roast | 1 1/2 cups bisquick or 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix tamarind with sugar, grate meat and place a slice of meat on the bottom of a well greased 9x5x3 loaf pan. Spread meat with 1 cup of the cheese. Cover this with a layer of onions, then pour 1 - ½ cups of water over this. Sprinkle tamarind paste over this layer. Cover with a layer of meat followed by a layer of the remaining cheese. Repeat with all meat & cheese. End with a layer of tamarind cheese & cheese, and top with bread crumbs, pressing them to fit. Bake for 1 & 1¾ hours. Allow to stand 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Aloe Vera - Algerian Green Chile Spice Blend for Fish
ingredients: 1/8 cup harissa or 1/8 cup red chili sauce | 28 ounces tomato puree | 1 teaspoon green chili pepper, finely chopped ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons sugar syrup
instructions: Simply combine all ingredients and mix well – this recipe will make about 1 cup of paste. Serve chilled with fish or salads.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,pork loin,salad green,lamb,green pea
title: Spanish Pork and Peas
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 lb lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups mixed salad greens | 1/2 cup red bell peppers or 1/2 cup orange bell pepper, sliced thin | 1/2 cup green pea, canned, frozen
instructions: In a large stew pot, add pork, lamb and vegetables except peas. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until pork is no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Add peas and cook, about 5 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,semolina,hamburger,grape leaf,creole seasoning,coconut,bake pie crust
title: Shameh Donut-Smooth Pie
ingredients: 1 baking potato | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1/2 cup semolina | 6 hamburger | 1 cup shredded coconut | 24 grape leaves, cut in half | 8 ounces semolina | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 10 hamburger rolls, split lengthwise ( i use the king arthur brand, or you may use a whole 12-ounce can of beef biscuits or your own favorite roll-up dough )
instructions: Peel potato and slice into half inch slices. Put potato in a microwave safe dish and cover with a lid. Spray potato with cooking spray, and cook on high 5 minutes, until soft. Drain, cool and cut into small dice. In a 10 or 12 inch ovenproof skillet, heat 1 tablespoon creole seasoning over medium high heat. Add 2 ounces semolina and stir until it sizzles. Remove from heat, and mix in diced nutmeg. Set aside. In a second 9 inch pie plate, spread 1 cup semolina to cover the bottom. Line the bottom and sides of the pie pan with the grape leaves. Place the sliced hamburger rolls, cut side up, on top of the semolina. Spread half of the nutmeg mixture inside the rolled out shell, then lay the slices of potato on top. Spread the remaining nutmeg mixture. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until set, about 90 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Unwrap the wrap from the plastic wrap. Unwrap the plastic wrap. Slice the chilled pan of donut smoke into 8 wedges, then cut each circle into 8 slices lengthwise and set aside. Bake about 15 minutes, until golden. Slice and serve donut smoky beef sandwiches, or serve with a side dish.

title: Simple Beef Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb fine dry noodles | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 3 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare the noodles according to package directions. Drain well. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, blend the soup and mustard. Pour into the baking dish. Mix well. Scatter noodles over top and bake, uncovered, about 35 minutes until noodles are tender.

title: Pavlova As a Fresh Fiesta Salad!
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 -3 teaspoons amaretto ( or other citrus-flavoured liqueur ) | chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Put the iceberg lettuce in a salad bowl, and mix all of the ingredients carefully. Chill for a few hours before serving, and serve.

Random Ingredients: tamari,rhubarb,chicken bouillon cube,dark soya sauce,chickpea flour,sherry wine,chicken breast half
title: Chicken Teriyaki (Chicken Teriyaki) CP
ingredients: 32 ounces chicken breasts | 1 can chickpea flour | 1/2 cup dark soya sauce | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup tamari | 4 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/2 cups sliced rhubarb
instructions: Place the chicken breasts and chickpea flour in a flat dish and coat them with the soya sauce, sherry & tamari. Let them marinade for 30 minutes. Dry your chicken breasts and set aside. Cut the rhubarb into small pieces and slice them into thin rounds, making them thinner. Heat some oil in a wok or frying pan on medium heat. Place the thawed chicken breasts on it. Add some more oil if necessary and saute your rice if using chicken breast. Once the chicken breasts are fully cooked, take them out and set aside. Place the pan back on the stove and add a tablespoon of oil, then quickly add the sliced rhubarb rounds and saute. Add some more oil if necessary. Add the chicken back to the pan and add the thumped rice. Saute everything together for a couple minutes, then serve.

title: Sausage and Beet Cabbage
ingredients: 2 pounds kielbasa sausage | 1 head cabbage, cored and coarsely chopped | 20 pounds shredded beet | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: Place sausage into a large pot, pour in enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Boil for 20 minutes, then remove sausage, place into a large bowl, and allow to cool for 10 minutes more. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a deep 9x13 inch baking dish. Place cabbage, beet, sesame oil, and half and half into a large pot, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in cooled sausage, and cook until heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Curried Garlic Eggplant
ingredients: 3 large japanese eggplants | 2 tablespoons mild curry powder ( not hot or spicy ) | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat broiler and arrange eggplant on non stick baking sheet. Broil eggplant 4 - 5 inches from heat, turning often, until eggplant is just slightly charred on the outside, about 2 - 3 minutes total total. Immediately transfer to metal bowl or serving plate and let drain 30 - 50 minutes. Cut into halves crosswise and then cut each half lengthwise into 4 - 8 pieces. Place on platter. Combine remaining sauce ingredients and pour over the eggplant. Sprinkle with parsley or cilantro. Note, this can be prepared to this point 1 day ahead and kept covered in the refrigerator.

title: Lamb and Sauerkraut Soup
ingredients: 500 g sauerkraut | 500 g good quality lamb, diced or 500 g beef roast, finely diced | 200 ml hot water | 450 g roma tomatoes, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons chopped pecorino romano cheese or 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese | 2 tea bags, per person
instructions: Slice/grill saurkraut into bite sized bits. Place all the ingredients in a large saucepan and simmer gently, turning the mixture occcoveatntly and stirring often until the lamb is very tender when pierced with a knife. Serve garnished with the pecorino. Serve with plenty of crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,pillsbury pie crust,lemon juice,dark soy sauce,chicken stock
title: Glazed Rum Pie
ingredients: 1 large uncooked pillsbury ready made pie crusts | 8 ounces dark soy sauce | 8 ounces dark rum | 4 cups chicken stock | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Spray deep 9 pie plate with non stick cooking spray. Roll dough in pie pan and freeze crust for at least two hours. Heat oven to bake pie crust for 10 minute. Meanwhile, in mixing bowl add dark soy sauce, rum and chicken stock and mix until well blended. Add lemon juice and mix again. Add chilled crust to pie pan and bake for ten more minutes. Let pie cool and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,cilantro leaf,sriracha sauce,chili sauce,molasses
title: Spicy Sriracha Chili Molasses
ingredients: 1 lb brown sugar | 2 lbs chili sauce ( or other hot spicy chili pepper ) | 3 lbs unsweetened molasses | 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce ( or other favorite hot chili paste ) | 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves, loosely packed
instructions: Heat the oven to 300°f. Mix together the brown sugar and chili sauce. Dissolve the molasses in 2 cups boiling water, then pour into a saucepan and heat over medium high until hot, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add sriracha and cilantro. Stir until dissolved. Pour into a glass baking dish and set aside to cool for about 1 hour. It should be slightly thicker than beer or beer. If it doesn't make it, place a piece of foil loosely over it and return to the oven for 15 minutes to finish cooling. Let it set up for a few hours so it can blend.

title: Fig Jam
ingredients: 25 fresh figs, peeled & finely chopped | 5 -6 slices prosciutto | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, lightly toasted | 1 ounce white sugar | 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: Wash the figs under running water then dry with kitchen paper. Dry on paper towels. Chop the prosciutto in fine pieces and fry in a small amount of olive oil until crispy and just beginning to brown. Remove from pan and set aside. Drain off any excess oil. Mix together the figs, prosciutto, nuts, sugar, and vinegar and season to taste. Wet the tip of a pastry bag with warm water. Shake bag to extract liquid. Add to the fig mixture and stir well. Cook over low heat for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring frequently.

Random Ingredients: shallot,french vanilla coffee creamer,onion soup mix,blue curacao,savory,jasmine rice
title: Blue Ivy and Green Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 packets french vanilla flavored coffee creamer ( regular or flavored ) | 1/4 cup dried shallots, toasted ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory ( optional ) | 1/4 cup blue curacao ( optional )
instructions: Rinse rice under cold running water. Heat rice cooker or pot on stove. Add to rice cooker, soup mix, creamer, shallots, savory and blue curacao. Close lid, and set to warm. Cook for 30 minutes then turn off and start your rice cooker.

Random Ingredients: sesame paste,russet potato,sushi rice,yellow pea,extra virgin olive oil,black sesame seed,anchovy fillet
title: Japanese Sesame Rice
ingredients: 1 lb russet potatoes, unpeeled, cut into 1 inch cubes and frozen | 2 tablespoons sesame paste ( i used light ) | 1 cup sushi rice | 1 3/4 lbs fresh small red-skinned whole russet potatoes | 1 can anchovy fillets ( packed in olive oil, drained and sliced thin ) | 1/2 lb yellow split peas, trimmed | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 -4 anchovy fillets, drained | 3 black sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a large 4 quart saucepan or dutch oven, over medium high heat. Add potatoes and boil until tender. Drain and set aside. In a large bowl, toss the sesame paste, cooked rice, raw potatoes, anchovies and peas. Drizzle the olive oil over the top and mix well. Season to taste with salt, if desired. Place in refrigerator to marinate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend and flavors to meld.

title: Japanese Jumbo Shrimp
ingredients: 1 package jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 pinch hot pepper flakes | 1 package shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Heat a large skillet or wok over high heat. Stir in the shrimp and hot pepper flakes. Cook the shrimp about 10 minutes, or until pink and curled. Remove from heat. Sprinkle shiitake mushrooms with pepper flakes. Wipe skillet with moist paper towel.

title: Fried Bananas
ingredients: 5 medium bananas, ripe, sliced lengthwise 1/2 inch | 2 long fresh chiles, sliced lengthwise 1/4 inch thick
instructions: Heat oil in 10 inch skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Fry banana slices in hot oil about 3 minutes, each side, or until brown on all sides. Transfer bananas to paper towel lined plate.

title: Green Chile Green Chili Frosting
ingredients: 3 green chile peppers - halved lengthwise, seeded, and stem end cut off | 1 cup finely chopped green chile pepper, such as jalapeno peppers, such as anaheim | 1 cup premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium premium cheddar cheese cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir to blend. Pour into a covered container and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Real Simple Queso Fresca
ingredients: 1/2 lb queso fresco ( or similar cheese of choice ) | 1 lemon wedge ( for rubbing ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: If using a cheese that comes in a bag with a plain round opening rub the salt and cayenne pepper evenly all over queso fresco until completely covered with salt. Shake well with your hands several times. Rub on any remaining salt. When the salt has been sufficiently salted, cut it in 1/8´ thick slices. Rub a bit of the cheese on the outside of the slice of queso fresca and squeeze the lemon wedge over it. You will need 1 teaspoon of salt for each queso fresca slice. Serve with crackers or just as an appetizer with crackers.

title: Cajun Style Pancetta Dippers
ingredients: 3 ounces pancetta, finely diced | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 cup mango chutney, with seeds and pulp | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Place pancetta and the vanilla pod in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Be careful not to burn the vanilla. Remove the vanilla pod, and discard the pulp. Place the baking powder and marjoram in a small bowl. Stir the paprika mixture into the skillet until well incorporated. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, and cook while stirring until the chutney becomes thick and syrupy, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the chutney into 4 small, paper cone shaped cookies. To make a small version, pour in about 1 tablespoon of maple syrup. Place 2 cookies inside each mold, pressing the edges together with the back of your fingers. Spoon 1 tablespoon of the chutney into each mold, and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon of worcestershire sauce. Arrange the remaining cookies, overlapping the maple syrup, on top of the chutney. Let chutney bars cool to room temperature before serving.

title: French Canadian Meatloaf
ingredients: 1/3 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon dried dill or 1 tablespoon fresh dill, chopped | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated | 1 lb ground beef | 1 loaf bread, cubed
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until well blended. Spread meat mixture evenly into a greased 9x5 inch loaf pan. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350 degrees for about 1 1/2 hours, testing with a toothpick. Serve as is or sprinkle with additional fresh dill and/or cheese. Serve with fresh french fries or toasted french rolls.

title: Homemade Indian Fry Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces fried onions, ( see basic indian fry bread ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f in small bowl mix turmeric with onion and pour into an oven safe serving bowl. Spread fried onions into ungreased baking dish. Bake for 10 minutes then pour the other spices over the fried onions. Leave to cool a few minutes while you make all your bread breads note, make sure the breads are baked in the oven at 250f. If you have a convection oven, you may toast them on the oven rack for 10 minutes. Or if you have a convection oven, leave the bread out at room temp with the temperature between 300 and 350f. After the 10 minutes are up, remove and cool a few minutes more before consuming.

title: Easy Turkey for a Run
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat ( or a combo ) or 2 lbs turkey ( or a combo ) | 1 brown onion | 2 cans beef rosettes
instructions: Brown whole onion. Cut stew meat into cubes. Add to meat and onions. Sprinkle brown sugar on top if desired. Cover and cook 1 1/2 hours. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Chile and Mozzarella Focaccia
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant yeast | 2 cans fat-free refried beans, warmed | 1 can green chilies, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Add refried beans and chilies. Mix well and cover. Leave the dough to rise for 15 minutes. Line a large baking sheet with wax paper or parchment paper and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Remove dough from bowl and place on prepared baking sheet. With a rolling pin, flatten dough into an even 8 x12 rectangle using the palms of your hands. Cover with a clean kitchen towel and allow to rise 20 minutes. Bake at 425 degrees f until lightly browned on the edges. Cool on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,white wine vinegar,snow pea,pepperoncini pepper
title: Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 lb snow peas, rinsed, dried and trimmed | 2 pints pepperoncini peppers, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced ( canned ) | 1 ounce rosemary leaf, torn into small chiffonade ( or herb leaves ) | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Soak the snow peas for 20 minutes in boiling water. Rinse and drain thoroughly. Pat dry. Using your hands, toss the peas with the peppers in a large bowl. Add the rosemary and vinegar. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: orange,dark sesame oil,ice,longhorn cheese,napa cabbage,asiago cheese
title: Gloria's Napa Slaw
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage | 4 ounces longhorn cheese, aged, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup grated longhorn cheese | 2 tablespoons grated asiago cheese | 1 medium orange, zested | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 3 cups crushed ice
instructions: Set oven to 425 degrees f and line a jelly roll pan with kitchen towels. Cut a circle in the lower third of the napa cabbage.

Random Ingredients: noodle,caper,picante sauce,apple juice,anchovy,white balsamic vinegar,caraway seed
title: German Noodles
ingredients: 1 bag of plain noodles ( i used thin ) | 2/3 jarred noodle ( we use macoun's, but anything sweet or sour will do ) | 1 large apple, peeled and sliced ( i used a sweet tart apple that had been sliced thin ( i used a combination of different colors for color ) | 6 -12 capers ( optional ) | 6 -12 anchovies ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white balsamic vinegar ( or the cider vinegar kind ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cider vinegar ( optional ) | 1 ounce niblets ( optional ) or 1 ounce anchovy, drained ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to directions. Drain. Mix macoun's, sliced apple, capers, noodles, capers and anchovies, in 3 minutes mix vinegar and cider together. Add to pasta. Mix in the noodles. Cover and chill thoroughly. Best if eaten right away. Also wonderful as an appetizer dish after dipping.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,white onion,vegetable bouillon cube,apricot preserve,spring onion
title: Apricot Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed, crushed | 1 tablespoon spring onion, finely chopped | 2 medium white onions, chopped | 4 -5 cups vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Saute cumin seeds in a frying pan, over medium heat. When lightly toasted, turn and saute other side. Add onions and saute until limp, but not brown. When onions are about 10 minutes, add vegetable and cook for 5 more minutes. Add apricot preserves and cook for 5 minutes. Serve hot, if desired.

title: Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup tahini | 4 eggs, separated | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Stir the yogurt and tahini together in a small bowl until smooth. Beat together egg whites, egg yolks, and allspice in a separate bowl. Stir yogurt mixture into egg yolks and pour into a small bowl. Beat egg whites with a fork until soft peaks form. Fold egg whites into yogurt mixture. Spread bean sprouts into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle top with tzatziki.

title: Crunchy Saffron Burgers
ingredients: 6 ounces coleslaw mix | 1 box couscous | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh chilies | 1/2 cup italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Toast the couscous according to package directions. Place the coleslaw mix in to a large bowl and add remaining ingredients except the breadcrumbs. Stir to combine. Spread mixture evenly evenly on a lightly oiled baking sheet. Broil until brown, turning once, about 3 minutes. If desired, sprinkle the top with breadcrumbs. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,pea,chili pepper,corn tortilla,xanthan gum,pineapple juice,pineapple chunk
title: Tortilla Surprise With Pineapple Dipping Sauce - Vegan
ingredients: 1/4 cup almond paste | 1/4 teaspoon zest from 1 large fresh chili pepper, chopped | 1/3 cup pineapple chunk | 1/2 cup sweet peas ( frozen or canned, both work well ) | 1/2 cup canned pineapple chunks | 2 -3 drops pineapple juice ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 1/2 teaspoons corn tortillas
instructions: To make zested chili pepper dipping sauce, puree chili pepper, pineapples in a food processor until fine. This sauce will hold a lot if made with small tomatoes. In a small saucepan, combine sauce ingredients and heat on low, stirring frequently for one or two minutes, adding water if it becomes too thick. Pour sauce into a small dish that is flat and cover with plastic wrap. Chill a few hours or overnight, stirring the dish occasionally. When tortilla wraps are soft, remove wrap and wipe off a little warm water. Take 1 tbsp of the sauce mixture and coat half of the tortilla wraps. Place the warmed wraps on a plate and spread half with almond paste and cover with pineapple. Sprinkle tortilla wraps with more of the almond paste and top with pineapple. Spread reserved sauce on top and serve with tortilla chips, vegetables, etc.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,cremini mushroom,extra sharp cheddar cheese,green cabbage,angel hair pasta,peach,italian sausage,penne
title: Causage, Peaches and Pasta Stir Fry
ingredients: 3/4 package penne or 3/4 package rotini pasta | 1/2 lb italian sausage | 8 ounces fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 1/2 cups green cabbage, sliced | 1 cup peach slices | 1 can beef gravy | 1 carton prepared beef gravy | 10 ounces angel hair pasta
instructions: Cook pasta as directed over package, just until al dente. Drain pasta. Meanwhile, cook sausage until brown outside and crumbly, breaking it up into smaller pieces. In a large skillet, over medium high heat, add mushrooms and cook until just beginning to soften, stirring constantly. Add cabbage and cook until tender crisp, adding sliced fruit for the last 4 - 5 minutes. Stir all together and add beef and beef gravy. Mix well. Add cooked pasta and mix well. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: apricot,cumin,cool whip,anise seed,white sugar,gold tequila,banana,chicken stock
title: Nana-Apricot Lime Soup
ingredients: 4 ripe bananas, peeled and halved lengthwise | 1 cup dried apricots, chopped | 1 cup chicken stock | 1 1/2 cups white sugar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seed | 2 quarts cool whip | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup golden tequila
instructions: Mix bananas, apricots, 1 cup of chicken stock, 1 1/2 cups of sugar, cumin, and anise seed in a large pot over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in cool whip until blended. Serve topped with 1/4 cup of sugar, 1 tablespoon of tequila, and 1/2 cup of tequila.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,caster sugar,cardamom seed,red chili pepper flake,head iceberg lettuce,pecan,pine nut,lemon juice
title: Creamy Pignoli Salad with Pecans
ingredients: 3 medium heads iceberg lettuce, washed dried well and dried on paper towel | 4 -6 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 1/2 cup pecans, toasted | 1/8 cup lemon juice | 1 small red chili pepper, chopped | 125 g caster sugar | 3 cardamom seeds | 2 -3 tablespoons cilantro, loosely packed, chopped
instructions: Slice the lettuce into rounds. Arrange the lettuce on serving plates and set aside. Heat the sunflower oil in a skillet and add the cardamom seeds and chilli. Stir constantly until the chilli turns golden. Turn off the heat and crush the seeds with a pestle. Place the pignoli nuts, pecans, lemon juice and sugar in a blender or food processor and process to a purée. Add the ground spices and process to a smooth dressing. Scrape into a bowl and stir through the cilantro.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,italian flat leaf parsley,turmeric
title: Aromatic Greens and Garlic from the Zaire
ingredients: 1 kg mixed baby spinach leaves | 2 teaspoons grated fresh turmeric | 2 tablespoons italian flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Tear off 2 large pieces of fresh french bread that are roughly the same diameter as your zaire. Heat a large non stick frying pan. Place the pan, flat side down, over a high heat and add some oil. The oil should just come to the surface. Carefully transfer the bread into the hot pan on the top of the gas for 1 1/2 minutes until golden. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a board to drain. Turn the heat up to medium and add the turmeric and stir a few times. Add the spinach, sprinkle with parsley and fry, stirring, for one minute. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,dill,garbanzo bean,pumpkin pie spice,red chili pepper
title: The Perfect Garbanzo and Pumpkin Dip
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can pumpkin pie spice | 1 teaspoon dried dill | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, minced | 1 ounce monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. In medium bowl lightly mix all ingredient. Gently stir. Spread on ungreased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until cheese is melted and dip is bubbly.

title: Baked Limes
ingredients: 9 limes, juice of | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons red wine, sherry or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 teaspoon whole anise seed
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pan large enough to accommodate the limes. Cook over a low heat for a minimum of 30 minutes. Limes should be soft and have a pronounced nutty flavor.

title: Chinese Restaurant Quinoa With Saffron
ingredients: 1/2/2 cup quinoa, rinsed well | 10 tablespoons chinese wine, divided | tabasco sauce | 1 head of garlic, halved and peeled | 1 teaspoon crumbled saffron | 2 cups cracked crackers
instructions: Rinse quinoa well. Place in a medium pot with 1/2 cup of the wine, the tabasco, and about 1/4 of the garlic. Cover, and bring to a boil on high. Turn down heat, and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat, and cool to room temperature. Place remaining 1/4 cup wine in a bowl with the remaining garlic. Cut the top and half of the head off of the garlic. Place on a baking sheet. Place in a 425 preheated oven, and cook for 40 minutes. Remove garlic from oven, and break into small pieces. Place quinoa in a bowl, and stir in the remaining wine and saffron. Sprinkle with crackers.

title: Chickpea-Rice Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 1/2 cups uncooked arborio rice | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt substitute | 6 cups 2 % fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup sugar | 1 tablespoon light yogurt
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the buttermilk, rice, vinegar and the salt substitute. Mix thoroughly and set aside for 15 minutes. Combine well drained rice and cottage cheese in a medium size bowl. Add sugar.

title: Jicama and Pear Soup
ingredients: 1 medium ripe pear, peeled, seeded, and diced | 1 -2 jicama, peeled, seeded and diced | 1/2 1/2 serrano pepper or 1/2 habanero pepper, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry tapioca starch, plus more for coating | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tahini | 1/2 - 3/4 cup almond milk | 2 tablespoons finely grated unpared jicama ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sweetened tapioca starch, plus more for coating
instructions: Grate the rind of the fresh pear and jicama and put them into a medium bowl. Add the minced pepper and tahini, then set aside. Heat the almond and tapioca starch, stirring constantly, until the tapioca starch dissolves. Add the tapioca starch to the vegetable mixture along with 1/4 cup water. Bring to a boil and stir. When the mixture thickens, turn off the heat. Stir in the pears and jicama. If desired, drizzle additional tapioca starch over the top. Let stand for 1 minute without shaking the pan. Chill, covered, for 10 minutes. Serve with freshly grated zest of 1/2 an orange.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,cream celery soup,salt pork,cod
title: Baked Cod with Cream Gravy
ingredients: 4 thick slices salt pork, or as needed | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 pound cod, cut into chunks | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer 1/2 of the salt pork slices into the bottom of the prepared baking dish, sprinkling the entire bottom with some of the cream of celery soup. Top with the second layer of salt pork slices. Repeat layers ending with the cream of celery soup. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, 45 to 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken,tart apple,baby shrimp,apricot nectar,pepper flake hot,cayenne,salad leaf,purpose flour
title: Shrimp on a Bed of Mustard Apricot Lettuce
ingredients: 4 -6 cups mixed salad leaves, if they are large i use large handfulls | 6 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 cup apricot nectar or 1 cup vegetable juice | 1 cup fresh baby shrimp, shelled and deveined | 3 large firm tart apples, such as a mcintosh, peeled, cored and cut into 3 and 1/4-inch wedges | 1 1/2 lbs unpeeled med-sized cooked peeled shrimp
instructions: For a salad with a crisp crust, arrange about 4 cups of the fresh salad leaves, if using large handfulls from a salad garden. Stir the flour with the hot pepper flakes and cayenne, and add the apricot nectar or vegetable juice. Toss as you toss to coat well. Arrange another cup or more on top. Cover the pan and marinate at least 1 hour, or refrigerate overnight. For the shrimp, prepare the fruit and shrimp, toss the shrimp in a large bowl. Add the apples and toss to coat. Arrange the shrimp salad on top of the salads and serve.

Random Ingredients: currant,salad green,granny smith apple,cayenne pepper,dark brown sugar
title: Irish Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 large granny smith apple, such as fuji, unpeeled and diced | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons currants | salad greens
instructions: Put the granny smith apple, sugar, cayenne pepper, and currants into the bowl of a blender. Blend until smooth, about 30 seconds pulses, scraping down the bowl occasionally. Add enough water to the slurry to just cover the apples. This should take about 5 minutes. Taste and add more sugar if necessary.

title: Sweet Italian Sausages - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. In a medium size baking sheet, combine the sausage, ginger and rub onto the sausage. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until sausage is browned and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: catsup,head broccoli,serrano pepper,cremini mushroom,yellow pea,miso,pie crust,kielbasa
title: Kielbasa Pot Pie (Sausage Supper)
ingredients: 1 package fully cooked kielbasa ( turkey kielbasa ) | 1 package frozen yellow pea, thawed and sliced into 1 inch chunks | 1/2 head broccoli, cut into chunks | 2 cans sliced cremini mushrooms ( optional ) | 2 serrano peppers, diced ( optional ) | 2 packages frozen white shoepeg mushrooms ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 cup prepared sloppy joe style pie crust or 1 cup quick-cooking pie crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place sausage in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Cook peas. Cook broccoli. Place in a large, deep bowl. Slice kielbasa and place in bowl with peas and broccoli. Stir in turkey kielbasa, sliced vegetables and mushrooms. Pour catsup over sausage mixture. Spread pie crusts over sausage mixture. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Serve immediately while hot. If making sausage and vegetables ahead of time, cover with foil if sausage and vegetables become too brown.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,red chile pepper,pork chop
title: Spicy Pork Chops
ingredients: 10 pork chops | 3 cups hot cooked red chile peppers, with juice | 4 1/2 teaspoons dried red chile pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons fast rising yeast
instructions: Cut 12 x 1 inch long slits in pork loaves, 1 inch deep. Insert toothpicks through center of each chop. Let pork loaves stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Combine 2 cups hot peppers and remaining 1/4 c chili pepper in small bowl. Sprinkle evenly over pork loaves. Cover with plastic wrap. Let stand at cool room temperature for 3 hours. Sprinkle with remaining 1 - ½ c chili pepper and cover with foil. Let stand 20 minutes at room temperature, stirring occasionally. Dissolve yeast in 1 1/2 cups hot water. Stir in water. Let stand until creamy, about 30 minutes. Place pork loaves, fat side up, on greased cookie sheet, making sure they are not touching.

title: Codfish With Zucchini and Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 cod fish fillets ( can leave whole, about 1.5 lb ) | 2 large zucchini, cut lengthways into 4 pieces | 1 bunch baby bok choy, leaves picked | 4 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c or 190c fan forced and spray a large rectangular ovenproof dish or roasting tin with cooking spray. Rinse the fish under running water and pat dry with kitchen paper. Cut the zucchini in half lengthways and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Place the zucchini, bok choy and 3/4 cup of the dijon style mustard in a saucepan with a little water, cook, uncovered for 3 minutes or until the water has been absorbed. Place the fish in the centre of the prepared dish and scatter over the other 2 tbsp mustard. Pour the vegetables around the fish and bring the sauce to the boil, scraping the edges with a wooden spoon to loosen any sediment. Cover with a lid and bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until the cod is cooked through. When the fish is cooked through remove it to a serving platter. Remove the fish from the oven but leave the juices in the roasting tin. Place the fillets on top of the vegetables. Spoon over the reserved cooking juices and serve with the remaining cooking juices. Serve.

title: Grilled Beef Kabobs (Sirloin and Yellow Squash)
ingredients: 1 sirloin | 1 yellow squash | 2 medium eggplants
instructions: Thinly slice steak diagonally across grain. Cut squash diagonally and slice the two eggplants into 1/4 inch thick rounds. Slice thinly crosswise. Thread a skewer through the meat on each skewer. Grill or broil until meat is cooked to desired doneness, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,chunky salsa,lemon juice zest
title: Sassy Salsa
ingredients: 3 cups chunky salsa, i used trader joe's chunky salsa ( and it is great! ) | 2 tablespoons dark sweet soy sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 small lemons or 1 medium lime, juice of, depending on how lemony you like your lemon
instructions: Combine all ingredients in your food processor. Process until well mixed but still chunky. Use as you would regular salsa, and refrigerate in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,cremini mushroom,almond,pork tenderloin,nuoc nam,hamburger bun,mexican oregano,almond essence
title: Dijon Pork Burgers With Mushrooms, Almonds & Spicy Pork!
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into thin strips | 2 tablespoons prepared dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon mexican oregano | 1 lb cremini mushroom, halved ( or any assorted, i use baby bellas ) | 6 large garlic, peeled and crushed in garlic press | 2 tablespoons ground almonds, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons nuoc nam ( vietnamese fish sauce ) | 8 kaiser rolls, thinly sliced | 4 -5 teaspoons almond essence, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the pork with dijon. Sprinkle the oregano over and set aside. Using a grill pan, heat grill. Add the pork and grill for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until desired doneness and brown color. Transfer to a plate and tent with foil to keep warm. To pan, add the mushrooms, garlic, ground almonds, nuoc nam and heat through. Place the patties on toasted buns, add the mushroom/garlic mixture, and top with meat mixture and drizzle over with almond essence just before eating.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,dark brown sugar,tea,chinese wine,olive oil,creole seasoning,brown rice,duck
title: Beef Rolls With Spicy Sweet Sauce #RSC
ingredients: 1 pork loin, 1-inch thick | 1/4 cup chinese wine | 1 package of regular brown rice, in jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup oil | 2 -3 drops of rooster house smoke flavored teriyaki sauce, i use 1/4 tsp | 1 cup sliced duck, cooked
instructions: Make sure the pork is well marinated. Drain any remaining marinade. Make sure you have enough water to cover the meat and refrigerate. Prepare the brown rice according to package. Prepare the roast by cutting into very thin strips about 3/8 inch long and 1/4 inch wide. Set aside. Prepare the spicy sweet sauce by combining 1/4 cup olive oil, 3 drops of rooster house smoke flavored teriyaki sauce and 1/4 cup brown sugar. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice the roast crosswise into 1 1/2 to 2 inch thick medallions. In a large roasting pan, combine pork, rice, and wine. Add 1 tsp of creole seasoning. Add sliced beef to the pan. Add 2 - 3 t of the spicy sweet sauce marinade. Add the leftover marinade and spread thinly. Spread the meat across the top of the meat. Dot with remaining 3/4 of the spicy sweet sauce. Pour remaining spicy sauce evenly over the top of the meat. Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 mins or until the internal temp reaches 160 degrees. When the meat reaches 160 or its internal temperature has been reached, remove from oven and let stand for 20 min prior to slicing. Slice. Serve on a large platter for a nice and simple entree.

Random Ingredients: shallot,grain white rice,sharp white cheddar cheese,garlic paste,pie shell,italian breadcrumb,chicken wing
title: Italian Stuffed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long grain and wild rice blend | 1 frozen pie shells, thawed | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 cup sharp white cheddar cheese, shredded | 2/3 cup shallot, minced | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a microwave safe bowl combine rice and 1 cup water, and microwave on high 1 1/2 minutes to soften rice. Meanwhile, prepare chicken wings, in a large freezer or food storage bag, combine rice and water mixture, 2 cup of cheese, minced shallots, bread crumbs and garlic paste, and shake to combine. Dip chicken wings in rice mixture, then coat evenly, and place the coated chicken wings in a 9x13 inch baking pan. Bake in preheated oven 35 to 40 minutes. During last 10 or 15 minutes of cooking time, sprinkle with remaining cheese. Note, if you plan on serving this in appetizers, you can put shredded spinach on top when serving.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,pork bean,sharp cheddar cheese,pizza crust
title: Cheesy Chicken and Bean Pizza
ingredients: 1 can pork and beans | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 2 cups refrigerated pizza crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to in a large bowl, combine the pork and beans with cream of both soup and spread into the two pizza crusts. Distribute half of the cheese over the dough. Place the second pizza crust on top of the cheese and spread with cream of chicken all the way to the edge. Top each pizza with the remaining half of the cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, until crust is golden brown and bubbly. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from oven.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,chili pepper,red cinnamon candy,tomato soup,worcestershire sauce,spinach leaf,chicken liver,garlic
title: Spicy Spinach Chicken Liver Rollups
ingredients: 2 cups fresh spinach leaves, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 8 leaves romaine lettuce | 1 1/2 cups roasted chicken livers, sliced | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 chili pepper, seeded and minced ( red or green ) | 3 teaspoons red cinnamon candies, chopped
instructions: For the chicken liver spread first 3 ingredients in a small mixing bowl with a whisk. Spread 1/2 to 3/4 cup chicken liver spread on each lettuce leaf. Divide the chicken liver spread among the lettuce leaves. Spoon 1/4 to 1/2 cup sour cream atop each lettuce leaf. Sprinkle with worcestershire sauce and the minced garlic. Shape the roll ups carefully around the mixture and arrange attractively on a warm serving dish. Garnish with the pepper and red cinnamon candies.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,feta cheese,coriander seed,eggplant,rye bread
title: Moroccan Eggplant (Aubergine) and Tomato Dip - 2 Net Carbs
ingredients: 5 lbs eggplants, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup chicken stock or 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/3 cup crumbed feta cheese | 1 stale rye bread, crumbly
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place the eggplant slices on a baking sheet and drizzle with 1/3 cup of the stock.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,apple cider vinegar,red wine vinegar,fruit,baking potato
title: Dinner Party Bites
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup dry quinoa | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar | 1/2 cup dried fruit
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees f. Bake the potato slices until lightly browned, but not browned, approximately 25 to 30 minutes. Remove and let cool enough to handle.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried apricot pieces | 1/4 cup water | 2 cans tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 banana, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place apricots in a shallow bowl and pour enough water over them to cover. Let stand 30 minutes. Drain. Place apricots, tomato sauce, horseradish and banana slices into a 2 quart baking dish. Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes.

title: Spicy Indian Fry Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/4 cup red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons ground ginger | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( or more for a spicier dish, or to taste )
instructions: If sauce is too thick, add water to thin it out.

title: Garden Salad (Duros Teszia)
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 package firm tofu | 1 pint fresh spinach leaves | 1 box mayonnaise | 1 can pasta sauce | 1/4 cup prepared mustard seeds | 3/4 cup chopped toasted pistachios
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Italian Shrimp Spread
ingredients: 2 cups cooked large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 cup dry bread crumbs | 1 jar capers
instructions: Place shrimp and mayonnaise in a food processor. Stir in turmeric, basil, bread crumbs and capers. Cover and blend until smooth.

title: Torshi Lift
ingredients: 16 ounces rotini pasta | 3 large idaho potatoes, scrubbed | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Pea Fritters With Peapel or Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1 cup split peas | 1 tablespoon finely chopped yellow pepper | 1 tablespoon finely chopped yellow pepper | 1 pinch salt | 2 1/2 cups white flour | canola oil ( for frying )
instructions: If using peas, place them in a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes. Drain. In a large bowl add all remaining ingredients. Mix well. In a large frypan, heat 1/2 cup of oil to 325°f. Drop a little of the mixture into the oil, in batches. Fry till golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Repeat frying all the fritters till all are cooked. Drain on paper towel oil and serve hot. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Dynamite Bombs
ingredients: 12 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 cup fajita-flavor fajita seasoning mix
instructions: Mix fajita seasoning mix with the cherry tomatoes. Use the palms of your hands to shape the tomatoes into small little balls then put them in a plastic bag with a tight lid. Once all the tomatoes are formed, add the vanilla essence over the tomatoes. Then take a teaspoon full of this mixture and fill the tomatoes with it. Allow to marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours before making balls.

title: Cheesy Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh butter beans, shelled | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese | 3 large egg whites | 1/3 cup shredded fat free mozzarella cheese
instructions: Rinse beans well under cold water under cold water, place in microwave safe bowl. Cook on high in microwave about 3 minutes, stirring every 1 1/2 minutes until heated through, stirring between each minute. Place in small bowl. Mash some of the mozzarella cheese into the beans, stirring until the mixture is spreadable. Spread in a 9x13 inch baking dish that has been greased and has been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 400°f for 25 minutes, until top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: green pea,egg yolk,bamboo skewer,italian tomato,stewing beef,barbecue sauce,paprika,fruit
title: Beef Stew With Veggies
ingredients: 16 bamboo skewers | 2 lbs stewing beef, in 3/4 inch cubes | 1 can italian-style tomatoes, in juice, undrained | 1/2 cup kraft light barbecue sauce | 1 cup green peas, thawed, drained | 2 egg yolks | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/2 cup dried mixed fruit ( optional )
instructions: In a 4 quart slow cooker, alternate layers of meat and tomato base, beginning and ending with meat. Set slow cooker to high and stir in green peas. Add remaining ingredients, cover and cook on high for 1 1/2 hours. Remove lid, increase heat to high and cook for 45 minutes.

title: Fish Pakora
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless fish ( e.g. salmon or firm fleshed fish ) | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon sambhar powder ( i prefer chilli-ginger powder ) | 1 cup rye flour ( also known as `` besan '', you can use gram flour ) | 1 cup fruit preserves
instructions: Cut fish into 1 inch squares and place on tray. Sprinkle coriander powder on fish squares and sprinkle sambhar powder over fish and coat in bread crumbs. Refrigerate at least 18 - 30 minutes. Combine sambhar powder and rye flour in a bowl and add enough water to make a paste. Place fish on lightly greased buns. Serve with fruit preserves.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,italian cheese,chicken stock,macadamia nut,cardamom pod,dark rum
title: Macadamia Nut Pastry
ingredients: 1 cup dried macadamia nuts | 1 cup dark rum, warmed | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 cup italian cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f and position rack in the center of oven. Line a 9 inch tart or pie plate with parchment paper. Place dried nuts in a medium bowl with warm, rum, chicken stock and baking soda. Stir in ground cardamom. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 10 minutes. Remove from food and refrigerate 5 more minutes. Line baking sheet with waxed paper. Unwrap nuts from plastic wrap and set aside. Unroll pastry from a sheet of waxed paper and press nuts onto parchment. Cut pastry into 24 squares and arrange about 2 inches apart on baking sheet. Use fingers to flatten each pastry square in the shape of triangles. Brush pastries with remaining rum or chicken stock and sprinkle with additional nutmeg. Bake in the preheated oven until pastries are light brown, about 20 minutes. Cool pastries on the baking sheet 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely. Serve at room temperature.

title: Herbes De Provence Corn on Toast
ingredients: 24 fresh crisp green giant frozen corn ( thawed ) | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: Preheat sauté pan with lid on. Unroll thawed corn on a flat surface. Sprinkle with herbes de provence. Place one slice of corn on center of paper towel. Arrange lettuce on top. Fold over and cut several slits into the top of the wrap around corn to create steam. Place on heated skillet. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes to brown, depending on desired crispiness. Serve with cheese.

title: Crispy French Squash
ingredients: 1/4 cup table salt | 1 cup french dressing | 1 -2 lb yellow squash, cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a large baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine salt and french dressing in a bowl with squash.

title: Sausages With Yellow Squash
ingredients: 4 large sausages ( or you could use more or less to serve ) | 1 large yellow squash, roughly chopped | cooking spray | 1/2 cup rice or 1/2 cup other long-grain rice | 1 tablespoon italian parsley | 1 dried red chilies | 1 -2 tablespoon pickled red chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f and sprinkle a little water into baking dish to absorb water. Cut each sausagem into 4 - 8 pieces. Place on baking sheet and bake them for about 40 - 45 minutes, until the sausage links are cooked through. While the sausages are baking, prepare the yellow squash by boiling in lightly salted water until tender, about 15 minutes. Remove and set aside. Remove skin from squash. You may rinse or steam dry, depending on your taste. Heat a nonstick pan over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add the sausages and cook about 5 minutes, turning, until brown on all sides. Turn off heat. Remove sausages from pan. Coat the squash with cooking spray, then place on baking sheet and cook in the oven for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick pan over medium high heat. Coat the pan with cooking spray. Add the yellow squash and cook for about 4 more minutes, turning, until browned a little. Add rice and cook for about 1 minute, stirring to coat the vegetables with oil. Add some more cooking spray, and chiles, if desired. Stir to coat, and add the rice. Stir, then add the contents of 1 jar of black bean/sausage sausages including liquid from the jar of black beans/sausage sausages including liquid from the jar of black beans/sausages including liquid from the jar of black beans/sausage sausages including liquid from the jar of black beans/sausage sausages including liquid from the jar of black beans/sausage sausages including liquid from the jar of black beans/sausage sausagemeat. Stir thoroughly to combine. Remove from heat, and spoon over the sausagemeat mixture. Serve with sliced green peppers, chopped tomatoes, and/or hot Italian bread.

title: Mixed up Yellow & Red Pepper Halva (Lebanon-Yemenite Version)
ingredients: 10 garlic cloves, peeled and quartered | 1 cup fat-free half-and-half or 1 cup skim milk | 1/3 cup yellow sweet pepper, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom ( ground ) | 1 teaspoon parsley ( ground ) | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg ( ground ) | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg ( ground ) | 1 teaspoon sugar cube ( optional ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped pistachios
instructions: In a medium saucepan add the garlic cloves & saute over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add the milk, pepper, celery seed, cardamom, parsley & nutmeg. Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes until peppers are roasted & tender. Remove from heat & add the sugar. Cool for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in the pistachios just before serving. Serve on bread with a salad & crackers.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,white rice,grand marnier,sherry wine vinegar,green bell pepper,anise seed
title: Gazpacho (Mexican Style Cucumber Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup dry white rice | 2 cups seeded and chopped cucumbers | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 ounce grand marnier | 1/8 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water, uncovered, about 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Place rice and remaining ingredients in a large, chilled bowl. Toss to mix, add the hot cooked rice and stir to mix.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup sultana | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: Pour sultanas and peanut butter into pan and heat gently. It should be like a loose paste.

title: Black-Eyed Peas Mocha
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds black-eyed peas | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 3 cups double cream | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place the black eyed peas into a large pot and cover with 2 cups water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer for 1 hour, skimming every so often with a slotted spoon, until tender. Remove beans from the cooking water and place in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,chipotle chile adobo,blueberry,currant,rigatoni pasta,rice noodle,cilantro stem,chipotle chile
title: Spicy Chipotle Crudites
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried rigatoni pasta | 1/2 lb dried blueberries | 1/2 lb dried currants | 3 small canned chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/3 cup chili sauce ( from can ) | 1 tablespoon minced canned chipotle chile | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced cilantro stems | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice noodles, cooked
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f. Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain and cool. Place the blueberries in a blender, add pepper sauce, chiles, cilantro and chipotle chilies. Blend until blended. Spread sauce in a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with the noodles. Bake, covered, for 15 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,yellow curry paste,green curry paste,egg,lime,banana,rutabaga
title: Lumpia Eggs With Curried Banana and Yellow Curry Flavoured Noodles
ingredients: 150 g sweet rutabagas, sliced very thinly | 150 g red bananas | 2 eggs, beaten | 1 large egg | 1 tablespoon green curry paste, see note | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon yellow curry paste, see note | 1 teaspoon fresh lime rind, finely grated
instructions: Soak green curry paste in enough hot water to cover bananas for 30 minutes. Drain well and pat dry. Cook rutabagas in boiling water until tender and aldente. Drain well. Set aside. Place eggs in bowl of an electric mixer. Add curry paste and mix thoroughly. Add banana slices. Add eggs and scramble until light and fluffy. Add egg mixture to rutabagas. Turn down to low and add lime rind. Add yellow curry paste. Mix thoroughly and serve. Note, yellow curry paste can be found at asian or indian grocery stores with curry. If you like, you can buy curry paste from indian grocery stores.

title: Irish Brisket
ingredients: 12 ounces corned beef brisket, cooked and sliced | 16 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped | rice, to serve
instructions: Place corned beef on serving platter and top with slice of mozzarella. Drizzle with golden syrup. Bake at 350 until cheese melts. Remove from oven and top with desired amount of romaine. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,pork sparerib,plain flour,bread,tomato puree,white pepper,fruit
title: Swiss Ribs in Tomato Cream With Creme Fraiche
ingredients: 4 lbs pork spareribs | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 3/4 cup creme fraiche | 1 cup fresh tomato puree | fresh ground white pepper | 1 loaf crusty bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Dust the spareribs with flour. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan. Fry the pork over a moderate heat for 5 mins, turning regularly, then remove from pan. Heat the remaining oil and cook the spareribs for 2 mins, on both sides. Transfer to a large roasting tin. To the fat in the pan, add the crème fraîche and stir over a low heat for 10 mins, until thickened. Add the tomato puree. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon the creme fraiche into the centre of the pork and pour over the pork. Roast in the oven for 2 hours, or until the meat is cooked. When cooked, remove from the oven and slice thin. Serve with the seasonal vegetables and crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: plum sauce,maraschino cherry,thyme sprig,ice water,green chilies,coriander,celery salt,hominy
title: Hominy Relish
ingredients: 1 can hominy, rinsed ( reserve the juice ) | 1 can green chilies, chopped ( including seeds ) | 1 bottle plum sauce | 1/4 cup fresh coriander ( cilantro leaves ), chopped | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon chopped thyme sprig | 1/2 cup crushed ice water | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine the drained hominy, green chili, plum sauce, coriander, celery salt, thyme and crushed ice water and heat until boiling. Pour into serving bowl and top with chopped cherries and garnish with cherries.

title: Nasi Lemak
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, cut to about 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Grill the bread. You can also use a sandwich maker if you are using bread, it will take less time. Take 1/2 teaspoon of chilli powder and put in the centre of the bread. Spread evenly. Sprinkle the remaining chilli powder. Quickly roll up each side of the toast. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,black olive,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,rotini pasta,cake flour,cremini mushroom
title: Chipotle Pasta with Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cake flour | 3/4 cup pecorino romano cheese | 2 cans chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 cup cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 4 cups hot cooked rotini pasta
instructions: Mix cake flour, cheese, and chipotle peppers in a small bowl and set aside. Over medium heat, saute mushrooms, olives, and mushrooms in adobo sauce for 5 minutes, until heated through. Pour over cooked pasta, mix well and serve.

title: Raspberry Vinegar Soup (Renskavska)
ingredients: 4 slices bread, crusts removed | 2 ounces red cabbage, finely shredded | 1 1/4 pints beef stock | 2 ounces rice wine ( to taste ) | 1 ounce raspberry vinegar, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 400f/ 220c/gas lightly grease a shallow ovenproof bowl. Cut the bread into small pieces. Place bread into the bowl and add any remaining stock. Leave to soak for 15 minutes. Strain the bread from the mixture and combine with the cabbage. Stir through the rice wine and vinegar until well coated and pour into ovenproof casserole. Cover with foil and bake for 30 - 40 mins until bubbling. Serve immediately.

title: Poor Man's Polish Sausages and Chick Peas!
ingredients: 1 package brown polish sausage ( optional ) | 1 can chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 2 cans black gram dal, drained | 1 package kielbasa, sliced | adobo seasoning
instructions: Slice sausage links in 1 x1/4 pieces. Brown them lightly in pan with adobo seasoning. Remove sausages from pan and drain and set aside. Add chickpeas, dal and kielbasa. Bake in 300 degree oven for 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,dark chocolate,vanilla yogurt,egg wrap,beef sirloin steak,epazote
title: Rramen Beef Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup onion, finely chopped | 150 g dark chocolate, good quality | 200 g beef sirloin steaks, sliced thinly | 1 package egg roll wraps | 2 packets top ramen noodles, flavourful | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves or 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 140c or 130c fan forced. Place the chopped onion in a microwave safe bowl. Cover with boiling water and set aside for 5 minutes. Stir, then cool. Heat chocolate and beef in a bbq or skillet for 3 - 4 minutes, or until melted. To assemble, place one wrapper on a flat board, top with 2 slices of beef and 1 teaspooon of chocolate mixture. Place a second wrapper on top of the first, trimming the edges to form a circle. Cut with serrated knife and place in a stacker for the final step. Spread top and bottoms with reserved onions and top with crumpled foil and top with one packet of ramen noodles. Place on a baking tray and bake for 20 - 25 minutes until crispy. Remove from oven and top with jam and a drizzle of jam. Icing, put all ingredients into a small bowl and mix a few teaspoons of jam and 1 tablespoon of jam in with the sirloin, ensuring that there are no lumps and the top is completely covered with jam.

title: Italian Sausage Skewers
ingredients: 3/4 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup low-fat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon splenda granular, sugar substitute | 2 -3 small ice water ( as needed ) | 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 2 -3 lime wedges, to serve
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a metal bowl. Divide into 2 or even 4 servings. Serve immediately, but do not cook.

title: Mountain Dew Party Punch
ingredients: 2 liters ice | 4 liters raisins | 4 stalks celery
instructions: Place the raisins in an irish punch bowl and top with the celery. Pour the entire ice into a large punchbowl. Add the raisins. For a milder flavour leave them in, or you can add 3 cans of canned.

title: Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups ketchup | 1 tablespoon pepper
instructions: Whisk ketchup and pepper together in bowl.

title: The Best Fried Rice!
ingredients: 2 cups cooked orecchiette pasta or 2 cups other waxy pasta, such as long grain such as penne | 3 tablespoons pickled ginger | 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons fat ( for cooking ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon lard | 1/4 cup diced chipotle chile in adobo | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1 1/2 tablespoons powdered cardamom ( i use `` mexican spice blend '', powdered in mexican, if possible, found in the ethnic aisle, maybe some of the entire spice blend ) | 1/2 cup fried valentine ( or a small jar of your favorite valencia or plum chipotle peppers )
instructions: Slice ginger into thin rings with mortar and pestle, until very fine, or pulse in grinder until fine finely. Cook pasta until al dente. Drain. In large mixing bowl, combine ginger, oil, chiles and buttermilk. In small bowl, combine cinnamon and cardamom. Sprinkle this mixture over cooked pasta and mix well. Makes about 3/4 cup. Dip fingers into buttermilk/cinnamon/cardamom mixture. Then, dip into egg batter and fry in hot dry pan in 1 tbsp of the peanut/buttermilk/ginger mixture. Turn until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately with remaining peanut/buttermilk/chile/sugar coated, guajillo salsa, etc.

title: Spaghetti Squash and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, halved and seeded | 4 small red potatoes | 1 large yellow onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Pierce squash with a fork several times. Bake squash in preheated oven until flesh is tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Thai Style Lasagna
ingredients: 4 cups crushed tomatoes | 1/4 cup tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons green cardamom ( or less, we like more! ) | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs lasagna noodles ( or your favorite ) | crushed cracker crumb, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together tomatoes, tamari, fish sauce and green cardamom. Set aside. To prepare noodles, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add noodles and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until al dente.

title: Homemade White Beer
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs white, coarsely crushed | 7 1/2 lbs sweet white, coarsely crushed
instructions: Sift coarsely crushed white beer into a colander set in a large bowl. Cover the bowl with waxed paper and then with plastic wrap. Let it sit for 3 days.. Rinse the colander with cold water and set it aside. Mix coarsely crushed white beer with 5 1/2 lbs of the white, using a funnel. Pour into sterilized 3 - 4 1/2 gallon jars and seal. Place the jars on a hot dry burner and bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Shut the cover down, turn the heat back up to medium, and boil for 15 minutes. Remove and discard the paper, strain the beer through a cloth lined sieve, and reserve the strained beer.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,broiler fryer chicken,nutmeg,ditalini pasta,liquid honey
title: Baked Pasta With Chicken
ingredients: olive oil cooking spray or other cooking spray | 1 broiler-fryer chicken, meat removed | 3/4 cup liquid honey | 3/4 cup finely crushed ditalini or 3/4 cup other small shaped pasta | freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Remove chicken from plastic wrap and wipe excess moisture from meat. Coat a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray. Remove chicken from plastic and place chicken in baking dish. Bake in oven for 20 minutes. Remove chicken from oven and turn heat off. Stir honey and remaining ingredients together and pour over chicken. Return to oven. Bake, covered, about 45 minutes, or until thoroughly heated and tender. Note, for a crisper sauce, increase the cooking time for the sauce. For a softer sauce, drain wine from chicken when cool.

title: Manchego's Snow Pea and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh snow peas, trimmed | 2 teaspoons capers, drained | 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 5 spring onions, chopped | 1 ounce unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Blanch peas in very hot water for 3 minutes. Remove peas and plunge into cold water. Peel and dice the peas into bite sized chunks and toss with the green bell pepper. Taste the seasoning with salt and pepper. Just before serving, stir in the capers. Garnish with the cocoa.

Random Ingredients: cabbage leaf,granny smith apple,herb,green enchilada sauce,romaine lettuce,barberry,elbow macaroni
title: South Seas Mac and Cheese for Two
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cabbage leaves, divided | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and cut into strips | 3 cups hot cooked elbow macaroni, drained ( about 227g ) | 7/8 cup grated romano cheese ( about 1/2 cup ) or 7/8 cup parmesan cheese ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 1/2 cups green enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons dried mixed herbs ( such as cilantro ) or 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill ( such as cilantro ) | 1 small head green lettuce, separated into leaves
instructions: Set oven to 400°f. In a large casserole, toss the cabbage with 3/4 of the apple strips and half the macaroni. Arrange in a single layer in a single layer on top of the cabbage. Pour the remaining ingredients over the cheese. Bake, covered, until hot and bubbling, about 40 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 6 links chicken sausage | 2 large zucchini, cut into quarters | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Remove casings from sausage. Cut sausage into 1 inch pieces. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the farfalle, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta 2 minutes, or until al dente, and drain. While the pasta is cooking, heat a large pot of lightly salted water to boiling. Stir in the sausage, and cook until evenly brown. Stir in zucchini, reduce heat to low, and continue cooking 3 minutes, or until zucchini is tender. Drain pasta, and toss with cooked sausage and zucchini mixture.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,lime juice,rice noodle,tomato green chilies,pearl barley,heavy cream,chicken breast
title: Simple Mexican Chicken Barley Stroganoff (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 cups chicken breasts, boneless, frozen and cut into strips | 3 tablespoons pearl barley ( i use barley ) | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies ( i use rotel ) | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup heavy cream, well-chilled ( whipping cream ) | hot cooked rice noodles
instructions: Place chicken in slow cooker. Sprinkle chicken over barley. In a small bowl, combine the tomatoes, lime juice, and nutmeg. Pour over chicken. Cover, and cook on low heat for 6 hours. Stir in cream, and heat through, or just serve over hot rice noodles.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,chunky salsa,phyllo pastry,chicken bouillon,asafoetida powder,filling,ginger garlic paste,turmeric powder
title: Spicy Indian Phyllo Chicken Bundles
ingredients: 2 lbs phyllo pastry ( store bought or home made ones ) | 1/4 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon filling ( i use a homemade filling blend in martha white ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper ( cayenne pepper may be used instead ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 1/2 cups chicken bouillon, plus 1 tablespoon water
