instructions: Place about 1/4 cup of salsa in the bottom of a 13 x 9 baking dish just large enough to line the bottom of the dish. Sprinkle filling on top of salsa. Cut phyllo sheets into 3 x 1 inch squares. Place 4 phyllo sheets over salsa and brush generously with filling. Top with 1/4 pound of reduced chicken boullion. Sprinkle ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, cayenne pepper and asafetida on top. Repeat steps 7 - 8 with 3 more phyllo sheets until you place 4 phyllo sheets on top of chicken. Lightly oil a 10 by 6 inch non stick skillet or grill pan. Place 12 sheets of phyllo in pan. Spread 3 tablespoons of salsa evenly over phyllo and season with salt. Cover pan with the last 4 sheets of phyllo. Brush again with filling and sprinkle with salt. Cook in preheated 350 degree oven until phyllo is golden and phyllo is crisp, about 15 minutes. Cut and serve.

title: Baked  Beef and Macaroni
ingredients: 500 g lean pork, diced | 800 g beef sirloin, diced | 400 g macaroni
instructions: Pre heat oven to 150 degrees celsius. Mix meat, macaroni in two baking dishes lined with baking paper. Place on top shelf of oven and cook for approx 15 - 30 minutes. Serve with fresh garden salad, garden dressing and butter..

Random Ingredients: milk,pepperoni,chili,hungarian paprika,garam masala,lemon pepper,kosher salt pepper,coffee granule
title: Spicy  Pepperoni Sauce or Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup hot pepperoni | kosher salt & fresh ground pepper | 2 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper or 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons instant hot coffee granules or 2 tablespoons sugar | 2 -4 teaspoons spiced kahlua or 2 -4 teaspoons coffee liqueur | 1 1/2 cups milk
instructions: First marinate, slice jalpeno into very thin 1/4 inch pieces. Place pepperoni slices in a shallow dish and set aside. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Saute onion and garlic in oil for a few minutes. Add chili, paprika, lemon pepper and instant coffee. Stir well over medium heat. Add pepperoni pieces. Stir and turn heat to low. Add milk, stirring well, simmering for 20 minutes. Serve over your favorite burger or your favorite burgers.

title: Fresh Italian Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, divided | 6 medium tomatoes, quartered
instructions: Place 1 cup of the parsley in a blender and process until finely chopped, about 1 minute. Scrape into a bowl, cover, and set aside. Add the remaining parsley to the bowl and stir until evenly chopped. Add the tomatoes and 2 tbsp of reserved parsley mixture, toss to evenly coat with parsley, and cover. Cover. Simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Remove the lid and cook, stirring occasionally, until the stew is thick and smooth.

title: Eggnog Potato Cake & Pea Cake
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes ( about 1 lb each ) | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed ( about 1 1/4 cups, or use fresh peas and a 1/2 cup jar of frozen peas ) | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 2/3 cup eggnog | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup orange juice | 8 -10 cups bread ( such as sourdough or rye bread )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add potato slices and cook until tender, about 20 minutes. Remove potatoes from water with slotted spoon and cut into 1/2 inch dice. Return to pan and set aside until cool enough to handle. When potatoes are cool, poke a few holes in the bottom of the shells, and put them inside another large pot of boiling water. Cook until the broth reduces to about 2 cups, about 15 minutes. Drain the potatoes and set them aside until needed. Remove shells from water and set aside. Return the broth to a low boil. Stir in eggnog, a little at a time, until the mixture turns thick and creamy. Stir in chopped peas, orange juice and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Place the bread, cut sides up, in the bottom of an 8 x10 x2 inch glass baking dish. Spoon 1/4 of the eggnog mixture into the dough in the bottom of the pan. Spread 1/4 of the potato pieces over the bread. Sprinkle with 1/4 of the frozen peas. Top with another 1/4 of the eggnog mixture, and spread this on top of the potato layer with a spatula. Top the potato cake with the remaining bread. Spoon 1/4 of the potato liquid over the bread and peas in the pan. Top with remaining eggnog mixture. Place in the refrigerator until the next day, and then bake in an oven set to 350°f for about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove cake from the baking dish, cool completely, and cut in 1 1/2 x2 inch pieces. Serve with a salad and a glass of orange juice if desired.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,bacon grease,black pepper,red chili pepper flake
title: Spaghetti All'ay Chami' (Stir Fry With  Bacon and Chili)
ingredients: fresh ground black pepper | sea salt | 1 red chili pepper flakes, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti
instructions: Combine ground black pepper with sea salt in small bowl.

title: Chicken and Guinness Stew
ingredients: 1 lb steak, cut into cubes | 1 lb red potatoes, cut into quarters | 12 fluid ounces beer ( guiness is good ) | 3 fluid ounces cream of tartar | 6 sheets round baking paper, cut into 4 rounds | 6 ounces arborio rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and cook steak in beer until done. While steak is cooking, bring a large pot of water to boil and then add potatoes and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain potatoes and cut into cubes. While still hot, mix in 1 packet of cream of tartar and set aside. Add 1/2 a packet of puff pastry and cut into 4 squares. After removing steak from the bones, place 2 squares of the dough on top of each other, then fold the square over once, forming a packet shape so the closed portion of the roll is in the centre. Continue until all 4 squares are used. Place the packets onto a baking tray, then cook in 400° f oven for 17 to 20 minutes, or until golden and crisp. When steak and potatoes are done remove from oven and set aside, then chop or slice all together. While still hot, place in large bowl and mix in remaining cream of tartar and mix well. Pour over steak and potatoes and serve with a side of guinness. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green bean,calrose rice,red curry paste,graham cracker crumb
title: Graham Curry Rice Stovetop Rice Bowls
ingredients: 4 cups cooked calrose rice, rinsed according to package directions | 1 can cut green beans, drained | 1/2 cup chopped red curry paste | 1 tablespoon finely crushed graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Pour rice into a bowl using a spoon. Add beans, curry paste, graham cracker crumbs, and water to make a 1 1/2 to 2 cup rice. Mix thoroughly, then spoon onto a serving platter.

title: Lazy Lasagna
ingredients: 30 lasagna noodles ( with uncooked noodles if available ) | 1 1/2 lbs ground sirloin | 1 package frozen cooked meatballs
instructions: Brown ground sirloin and then drain. Cook noodles according to package directions, drain. Stir hamburger into noodles and then set aside. Spray a 9x13 pan with nonstick cooking spray and layer as follows, meatballs 2 - 3 noodles, meat mixture, repeat layers ending with meatballs. Cover and bake at 375 for approximately 45 minutes, uncover and bake for another 15 minutes until golden.

title: Steak Enchilada Pasta
ingredients: 2/3 cup soy milk | 2/3 cup water | 6 tablespoons dry sherry | 4 teaspoons cracked peppercorns | 1 pound beef flank steak, cut across the grain into thin strips | 20 ladyfingers | 1 quart water, divided | 20 corn tortillas, 6 inch
instructions: Whisk together soy milk, 2/3 cup water, sherry, and peppercorns in a bowl to make marinade. Add steak and marinate in refrigerator for 6 hours or overnight. Bring a large pot of water to boil over high heat. Cook tortillas in boiling water, 1 at a time, tossing to chop and warm through. Drain. Arrange 2 tortillas on a plate or baking sheet. Spoon 1/2 cup steak mixture into tortillas, and roll up tightly. Arrange seam side down on plate. Repeat with remaining tortillas and steaks.

Random Ingredients: sriracha hot sauce,tortilla,beef tenderloin,hoagie,fish sauce,pineapple syrup,chorizo sausage
title: Grilled Beef and Chorizo Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb chorizo sausage ( or substitute with ham ) | 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed, cut into six slices | 4 hoagie rolls, split | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/2 cup pineapple syrup | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sriracha hot sauce
instructions: Grill or broil sausage, turning once, until cooked through. Remove from pan and slice into large chunks. Place sliced sausages, meat and pineapple syrup in small bowl. Make sandwiches while meat's cooling in refrigerator. Combine sauces and pour into small saucepan. Heat to boiling. Pour over meat slices, toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Couscous with Beans and Swiss Chard
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 1/4 cup ghee or 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 4 -6 cups swiss chard, cut into strips 1/2 inch long and 1/3 inch wide | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1/2 cup orzo pasta ( dry, preferably jasmine )
instructions: Cook couscous in salted water until cooked, about 5 - 4 minutes.

title: Hot Roast Tomato Chilies
ingredients: 8 fresh oregano leaves, and stems | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 4 teaspoons oregano & basil extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Stir the oregano & basil into the chilies. Place the foil wrapped tomatoes on the cookie sheet. Roast the chilies until they are tender & a little darker in color, about 20 - 30 minutes. Check they don't burn. Remove from heat & cool to room temperature, then serve.

title: Spicy Kielbasa (Kalbi) Rolled in Garlic Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb medium meaty rump steak | 1 lb kielbasa or 1 lb thick sausage, cut in 1 inch slices | 2 -3 tablespoons cold water | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1 packet instant dashi | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon cold water | 8 sheets spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Place the meat, sausage, 2 - 3 tbls of each, and water in a large stockpot. Cover and cook until meat is just tender. Drain off excess fat. Using a fork, stir to combine the water with juice, the dashi powder and cayenne. Add lime juice, to taste, and cook about 2 - 3 minutes longer until the sauce thickens and bubbles. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: steak,ginger garlic paste,palm sugar,apricot,coconut flour,french bread
title: Roti Canai Kebai
ingredients: 2 kg steak | 1 kg coconut flour | 1 kg french bread | ginger-garlic paste | 1 kg paprika | 60 g dried apricots
instructions: Grind or blend the ginger garlic paste with coconut flour or mix it well into a paste, making a smooth paste. Cut the beef into cubes, 1 - 5 cm pieces. Mix the paprika powder with some warm water and spread over the meat. Arrange the soaked bread cubes in alternate layers, alternating them with the soaked bread pieces, starting w/3 kabocha mix. Place the wok over a high heat, and when it begins to smoke, place some oil in it to prevent a burn. Add half the meat and marinade, then cook on a high heat or medium heat untill the pork is well sealed. When the meat is well browned, return the other half of the meat to the wok and cook for a further 5 minutes add paprika mixture, and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve w/white basmati rice.

title: Yogurt Spinach
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 2/3 cup plain yogurt | 2 3/4 cups all-purpose white flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with waxed paper. In a large bowl, mix spinach, yogurt, flour, and 2/3 cup of the yogurt mixture until well blended. Use a knife or an 8 or 10 inch round cookie cutter to cut out the large pieces of dough. Spread the mixture into the prepared pan, and bake for 40 to 50 minutes in the preheated oven, until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean. Cut out a small slit in the center, and allow to run down the sides of the loaf. Turn onto a serving platter, and cut a slit in the center for any open vents. Serve topped with any remaining yogurt mixture.

title: Cardamom Whip
ingredients: 6 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 cardamom pods, lightly crushed
instructions: Whisk the cream until very thick. Fold in the cardomomom pods and serve.

Random Ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese,dark soy sauce,chuck,ice,yellow onion,red bell pepper
title: Crockpot Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground chuck | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon thai dark soy sauce | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, cut into cubes | ice
instructions: Cook ground chuck over medium heat, stirring frequently until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,puff pastry,almond extract,sesame oil,lime juice,turkey
title: Sesame-Scented Turkey and Sugar Snap Pea Pies
ingredients: 1 package frozen sugar snap peas | 10 ounces roasted lean ground turkey | 1 package puff pastry, thawed | olive oil, for brushing | 1/4 cup toasted sesame oil, from jar | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Place the sugar snap peas in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Brussels Sprouts and Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 4 pork cutlets, 4 inches in diameter | 4 -5 brussels sprouts | 3 tablespoons gingernap | 8 ounces smoked salmon, sliced in half | 12 ounces jasmine rice
instructions: Rinse the brussels sprouts well and cut in half crosswise. Slice the trimmings into short, narrow strips and wash thoroughly, do not discard the tough bits of leaves. Place in a bowl with enough cold water to cover the brussels sprouts. Let them sit for 2 - 3 hours to wilt, then drain thoroughly.

title: Saffron Cookies
ingredients: 6 1/2 cups white raisins | 7 1/2 cups shortening | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place raisins in a large bowl and cover with warm water.

title: Grilled Shrimp Skewers on Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 cup large raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 16 wooden skewers
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beef and shrimp. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Grill or broil shrimp skewers on high. Or, if skewers are too long, skewer shrimp on 4 skewers and grill them 2 minutes per side. Serve by placing skewers on a serving platter and pouring sauce over them. Note, if shrimp aren't used, broil shrimp until they turn pink, and sauce is bubbling. You can broil shrimp in tomato sauce. If making skewers for oamc, make skewers on a baking sheet, and thread 1 shrimp per skewer.

title: Kielbasa and Herbs
ingredients: 2 lbs kielbasa | 3/4 cup fresh cilantro | 1 ounce dark chocolate | fresh herb ( optional ) | fresh thyme sprig, for garnish
instructions: Cut kielbasa into 1 inch slices. Place slices in a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with cilantro, dark chocolate, herbs, if using, and thyme. Top with extra thyme sprigs. Cover dish with greased aluminium foil. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes, uncover and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until top is golden, and meat is tender.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,pork shoulder,dijon mustard,bread flour,cherry tomato,part mozzarella cheese
title: Pork Rollatini
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork shoulder, boned and trimmed of most of fat | 5 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, torn into pieces | 1/2 cup light white sugar, slightly warmed | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon fresh cherries in tomato, sliced ( optional ) | 4 -5 tablespoons bread flour | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Place ham in a plastic bag. Add about 1 tbsp of the part skim mozzarella cheese, 1/2 tsp of the sugar, and 1 tbsp of the dijon mustard. Shake and toss. Place in refrigerator and marinate 1 hours up to 2 days. After the marinating, remove ham from refrigerator, and set aside. When you are ready to cook, drain off juice and discard. Put in a large skillet or dutch oven that has been coated with cooking spray. Cook over medium high heat until evenly browned. If needed add more butter, and more sugar if too dry. If too wet, add more bread flour to the pan, and mix up again. Pour off all fat from skillet. Sprinkle the last tbsp of dijon mustard over ham. Add cherry tomatoes to skillet or dutch oven. Add remaining 1/2 tsp sugar. Cook over medium heat until tomatoes are soft, about 8 minute stir occasionally. Take out of skillet and remove to serving plate. Slice ham crosswise into 1/8 slices, and serve on tomato mixture.

title: Pickled Spinach
ingredients: 1 cup cider vinegar | 1 cup water | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 4 pounds fresh spinach leaves, cleaned and cut into thirds
instructions: Bring cider vinegar, water, sugar, and mustard seed to a boil in a large heavy pot. Add spinach leaves, reduce heat and simmer until liquid is reduced and spinach is tender, about 20 minutes. Place 2 cups spinach in a large freezer bag, then pour the vinegar over the spinach.

title: Indian Tomato Curry (Dhulli Raita)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Pour 2 - 3 cups water into a saucepan. Heat on medium high flame, stirring occasionally, until oil begins to leave the sides of the pan. Stir in tomato paste and garam masala powder. Reduce heat to medium low. Cover and simmer for 5 - 7 minutes or until oil separates from the paste. Remove from heat. Remove pan from heat. Allow to cool slightly, then refrigerate for at least 6 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,chicken breast half,cabbage leaf,mint leaf,walnut,romaine lettuce,rose water
title: Chicken Kebabs With Walnut Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons lemon zest, finely grated | 1/2 cup loosely packed fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh rose water | 4 skinless chicken breast halves, cutlets | 1 1/2 cups packaged coleslaw leaves | 1/4 cup finely shredded cabbage leaf ( optional ) | 5 tablespoons toasted walnuts, chopped ( optional )
instructions: To make marinade, combine lemon zest, mint leaves, and rose water in a medium bowl. Add chicken breasts and marinate in refrigerator 1 hour or refrigerate up to 2 hours. Spray grill rack with nonstick vegetable cooking spray. Thread chicken onto skewers. Grill skewers over medium coals or medium hot coals 10 minutes, turning chicken occasionally, or until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side for medium or 9 minutes per side for well done. Serve chicken kebabs with walnut salad dressing, sliced chicken breasts, coleslaw, and finely shredded cabbage. To make walnut salad, finely chop walnuts. Dressing, lightly whisk together walnuts, and 2 tablespoons zest from lemon.

Random Ingredients: sage,adzuki bean,egg substitute,beef bouillon cube,buttermilk,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Pastitsio II
ingredients:
1/2 cup abura-dosh beef bouillon cube | 1/4 1/4 cup buttermilk or 1/4 cup skim milk | 1/4 cup egg substitute or 1/4 cup egg 
    - sage, finely chopped | 3/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 3/4 cup kefalotiri | 1 pinch dried sage | 1 can bush agave silver skinned adzuki beans, drained
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt knuckle or ghee over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Add buttermilk and beef broth cubes. Let the liquid come to a boil until almost 1/4 of the soup is dissolved. Stir in sage. Add half of sazon and half of grated cheese. Heat to boiling over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer the broth while stirring every so often until thickened. About 15 to 20 minutes before the soup is finished whisking the soup again. Stir in bean or adzuki beans and bring back to a simmer, then remove from heat. Use in a recipe for your favorite pasta. Serve over fettuccine.

Random Ingredients: black olive,garlic salt,flat leaf parsley,thyme sprig,salt,thai red curry paste
title: Black Olive Spread
ingredients: 2 lbs black olives, pitted, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, minced | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 3/4 teaspoon thai red curry paste | salt, to taste
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth. If mixture is too thick, add one tablespoon of water. Transfer to jar and keep refrigerated for up to 7 days or freeze up to 1 month.

title: Crisp Barbecued Sirloin
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless sirloin | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns | 3 slices canadian bacon, cut across | 4 teaspoons chopped greens | 2 teaspoons chopped parsnips
instructions: Trim excess fat from sirloin. Cut into 6 equal parts. Place meat, peppercorns, and half the bacon among 2 tablespoons oil in large nonstick skillet. Cook over medium high heat just until bacon is crisp. Remove bacon and remaining bacon grease from pan and add greens and parsnips, stir to coat. Add meat mixture to skillet on med heat and cook, stirring, until meat is hot to the touch, about 3 minutes. Place remaining bacon in a heatproof bowl and cover with foil, to keep warm. Cover meat with foil and cook in skillet at med high, about 10 minutes remove foil and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Note, if desired, cook longer if necessary. Stir in remaining cooked bacon as desired.

title: The Real Mix
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast flakes | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorn
instructions: Brown meat with a little bit of olive oil, add cocoa powder and nutritional yeast. Cook over medium heat until thickened. Serve over hot rice or noodles.

title: Steak Flambe With Banana's
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into thin slices | 1 yellow onion, cut into thin slice | 1 tablespoon oil | white pepper | 5 banana slices | 1 tablespoon chopped shallot | 1 cup sliced plum tomato | 1 tablespoon chopped miniature marshmallows
instructions: Season the sliced sirloin with salt and pepper. Cook in oil for 2 minutes. Remove and set aside. Add onion to the pan and cook 2 minutes. In the same pan add the sliced banana and fry about 3 minutes until browned, stirring as needed. Remove the banana with a slotted spoon and onto a plate. Add the drained steak juices to the juice and cook on high heat for 4 - 5 minutes or until the juices have reduced. Remove and set aside on a plate. Stir fry the shallots until golden brown. Add the sliced sirloin steak and sliced tomatoes. Add 2 ladles of the reserved juice mixture. Let simmer for several minutes. Add marshmallows.

title: Skewered Katsuya, Kofta Dip-Japanese Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups prepared mushroom soup | 1 cup sour cream | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Stir soup, sour cream and cardamom together in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cover and simmer until hot, stirring frequently about 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Artichoke & Chocolate Risotto
ingredients: 350 g artichoke hearts, sliced | 2 cups vegetable broth ( or more ) | 300 g chocolate, coarsely grated | 125 ml chicken stock | 1/4 lemon, zest of, grated | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Place broth in a saucepan and bring to boil. Add the artichoke heart slices, chocolate, lemon rind and baked beans. Return to boil and bring to a boil, stirring intermittently. The mixture should be thick and pourable. Add more stock if it becomes too thick, or little liquid if it evaporates during cooking. Serve immediately sprinkled with paprika and with the toasted slices of lemon on top. Variation, use more artichoke hearts or mushrooms for a vegetarian dish. I have a suggestion for a chunkier risotto, or use a vegetable broth for extra flavour. Also, if you would like to make it a vegetarian dish, use chicken stock instead of water.

title: Carnaroli's Signature Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 cup bacon drippings or 1/2 cup melted lard | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( or other liqueur ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne | 2 large celery ribs, finely chopped | 1 3/4 cups sparkling water | 1 teaspoon commercial sweet-and-sour mix ( or equivalent dry such as apple juice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. For quiche plate, heat bacon drippings or lard in saucepan until smoking over medium heat. Add grand marnier, cayenne and celery. Heat for about 1 minute, then pour into prepared tart shell. Stir in sparkling water until mixture is smooth. Sprinkle top of quiche with sweet and sour mix. Bake on middle oven rack for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Sherbet
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, halved | 2 tablespoons shallots, minced | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 26 ounces good quality wine | 750 g shelled medium cooked shrimp ( peeled )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees c. Grease a shallow, 18 x 28 cm baking dish with non stick spray. Cut chicken into 2 cm cubes, place in dish. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked through and golden.

title: Mexican Cajun Red Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 box elbow macaroni | 5 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained | 1/2 cup rum ( i like cajun red ) | 2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Cook and drain pasta. Pour off pasta liquid and rinse with cool water. Combine all ingredients and add to your pasta. Mix well. Add cooked pasta and serve.

Random Ingredients: coconut,cold water,apricot jam,orange zest,italina seasoning,curry paste,marsala wine
title: Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1 tablespoon hot curry paste ( to taste ) | 4 teaspoons orange zest, minced | 2 teaspoons orange zest, minced | 1 tablespoon dry italian seasoning ( dry ) | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 cup flaked coconut
instructions: Whisk marsala, apricot jam, curry paste, orange zest and orange zest in a bowl to blend. Stir in the zest, and then stir in the italian seasoning. Pour into a resealable plastic bag, and refrigerate for 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400°f. Coat baking sheets with cooking spray. Remove the chicken from the marinade, and shake off excess. Place on the prepared baking sheets, and coat with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Turn chicken pieces over, and bake until an instant read thermometer inserted in the thickest part of the thigh registers 170f, 15 to 20 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: potato,malt vinegar,sun tomato oil,wheat flour,corn tortilla,sazon goya con culantro y achiote,cornflour
title: Fried Potato Taquitos
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes | 1 package goya con culantro y achiote ( annatto or similar seasoning ) | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1/2 small sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped finely, oil and vinegar, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/3 cup cornflour | 1/3 cup corn flour | 1 tablespoon cornflour, mixed with 1 tbs water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Scrub potatoes well under running water and pat dry. Cut potatoes into 1/4″ dice and place in a bowl large enough to hold them comfortably in one layer. Sprinkle with a little salt and set aside to drain, about 15 minutes. Combine the corn flour, cornflour, and 1 tbs water and stir well with a fork until combined until mixture forms a paste. Place potato mixture on a pastry board, patting it out with your hands until it is a ½″ thick, even ¾″ round. Cut potato mixture into 1 inch balls, about 1 1/2” wide and 2 - ½ inches in diameter. Place a potato ball on each corn’s back in the center and pat out slightly until it is completely covered. Dredge each potato ball in corn flour, letting excess drip off and lay lightly on a sheet of parchment paper. Repeat two more times. Place potatoes in an oven dish lined with parchment paper. Bake them for 20 minutes, or until they are completely crisp and lightly browned, turning them halfway through. Serve hot, warm or at room temperature.

title: English Canadian Bacon Wrapped With Pecans
ingredients: 12 slices canadian bacon | 6 tablespoons pecan pieces
instructions: Toast pecans on a 350 degrees f for 10 minutes, and set aside. Heat canadian bacon in a medium skillet over medium high heat. Place the pecan pieces on a cutting board and lightly toast them. Place a slice of bacon on each of the four warm wrap pieces on a piece of waxed paper and sprinkle with a mixture of pecan, canadian bacon and fresh goat cheese and additional pecan pieces until the wrap is completely wrapped. Fold the two edges up and the folded ends down. Slice wrap into 4 or 6 servings and serve with maple syrup.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,beef broth,pasta,salt,rice noodle,taco sauce,grain rice
title: Spanish Rice With Beef
ingredients: 1 package uncooked dry pasta ( linguine, fusilli or spirals ) | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 cup small dry rice noodles | 1/3 cup chopped red bell pepper | 2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 2 pinches salt
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: andouille sausage,potato,parsley,pineapple juice,serrano pepper,avocado,anaheim chilies,flat leaf parsley
title: Sausage and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausages | 1 1/2 cups frozen sweet potato rounds or 1 one cup simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 3 tablespoons canned pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons diced pimento-stuffed fresh olives | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Parcook sausage by bringing 3 cups water to a boil in covered 8 inch square baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray. Place sausage in boiling water.

title: Quick Saute
ingredients: 2 carrots, finely grated | 1 package spinach, chopped
instructions: Place grated carrots, chopped spinach, spinach and green pepper in a bowl with a splash of olive oil. Stir well until the greens are coated with olive oil.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,lemon pepper,cornmeal,tapioca starch,mango chutney,cottage cheese
title: Sweet Potato Fritters
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons tapioca starch or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1 tablespoon cornmeal
instructions: Place the potatoes in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cover tightly. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until tender. Drain. Meanwhile, mix the tapioca starch or cornstarch, lemon pepper, cottage cheese, and chutney together in a separate bowl. Mix in the potatoes. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Ladle some potato mixture into the skillet. Using a slotted spoon, flip the fritters over and cook for 5 to 7 minutes more, or until golden brown and crispy on the outside. Place in a large resealable plastic bag, and freeze until firm. To serve, scrape the fritters from the plastic bag and serve.

title: Quick Satay Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 2 green bell peppers | 3 tablespoons tamari | 4 squares sweet chocolate, grated
instructions: Cut beef into 2 inch square strips, then place in bowl with tamari. Add green peppers. Toss to coat with sauce and marinate at least 1 hour. Thread on skewers, with the remaining sauce as directed above. Cover and refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,panko breadcrumb,tea,graham cracker crumb,hard egg,italian parsley
title: Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 large hard-boiled egg, finely chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped italian parsley | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 2 1/2 tablespoons sifted graham cracker crumbs | 16 leaves thin italian steaks, trimmed
instructions: In a bowl, stir together egg, parsley, balsamic vinegar, panko crumbs and graham cracker crumbs. Set aside. Dredge meat in bread crumb mixture. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high. Add meat and saute 3 minutes or until cooked through. Turn meat over and repeat procedure with remaining ingredients until all have been used. Serve family style. Note, for a creamier dish, use a little bit of whipping cream or egg.

title: Big Beer and Sour Liver
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh jalapeno | 1 medium onion soup mix ( i recommend j.l. ) | 1 cup light beer | 1 cup light beer | 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon mace, preferably ground fresh | 1 small sweet onion, chopped and sauteed in olive oil
instructions: Remove stems and seeds from jalapenos. Blend jalapeno and onion soup mix in blender until smooth. Pour into a deep saucepan. Add remaining ingredients, mix well. Cover, and set aside for 15 minutes, or until heated through. Serve immediately or store in refrigerator up to 1 week.

title: Chicken Burrito (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 2 3/4 - 3 1/2 cups water or 2 3/4-3 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 1/4 cups long-grain rice or 1 1/4 cups long grain rice
instructions: Place chicken in crockpot and add tomatoes and water. Cover and cook on high for 6 to 7 hours. Discard the chicken and shred the chicken. If using rice, add it to the pot, recover and cook on high for a further 15 to 20 minutes, stir well, and serve. I use a low power wok which allows me to eat my rice or beans, the tortillas can be warmed into a hot skillet with a little fat and added to the pot for added flavor. I like the fat and fat off of my regular rice, to make this meal a little different, but not necessary.

title: Black-Eyed Pea & Mint Brownie
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups chickpeas, cooked, rinsed and drained | 1/3 cup thick yogurt, plain greek-style | 1/4 cup chunky salsa, plain and reduced sodium | 1/2 teaspoon cake yeast, plus | 1/2 tablespoon cake yeast | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts | chunky salsa
instructions: Set aside 2 tablespoons yogurt for garnish and set aside. Process chickpeas in blender until roughly smooth, about 1 minute. Drain chickpeas on paper towels and transfer to a large bowl. Add remaining yogurt, 2 tablespoons yogurt, 1 tablespoon cake yeast, hazelnuts and salsa. Stir until creamy. Cover mixture with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes. Place bowl on a supporting board fitted with a rounded bottom and use a bench scraper or rubber spatula to scrape bowl with rubber spatula to loosen and loosen. Spread half of the brownie batter in the prepared bowl. Scatter with half the chickpea mixture, then top with the remaining bread batter. Sprinkle remaining chopped hazelnuts. Cover with foil and refrigerate 1 - 2 hours. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 350°f. Bake 1/2 hour or until golden brown. Serve in a shallow bowl drizzled with remaining melted butter. Serve with chunky salsa.

title: Chunky Pumpkin Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs pumpkin, peeled ( about 4 medium ) | 1/2 cup water | 2 tablespoons granulated onion flakes | 1/4 cup dried onion flakes | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | pumpernickel crouton
instructions: Trim bottom 2 inches from top of pumpkin and cut into chunks. Set aside. Bring 2 cups water to boil in electric deep 10 inch skillet. Add onion flakes, pumpkin, and chick peas.

title: Glamb Duff Mix Substitute
ingredients: 2 tablespoons celery seeds | 2 teaspoons spices | 2 teaspoons mixed spice
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients of the dry ingredients together. Rub into sheep's feet or pork skins if using for up to 2 weeks store in air tight lidded container. Seal and store in the pantry.

title: Noodles With Rosemary and Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti ( spaghetti ) or 1 lb linguine ( spaghetti ) | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 cup sliced almonds | 1 tablespoon fish sauce or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 tomatoes, sliced ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon fish sauce or 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary
instructions: Cook spaghetti or linguine according to package directions. In a nonstick skillet, heat oil over low heat.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,chicken bouillon granule,swiss cheese,ginger juice,tomato green chile pepper
title: Texas Swiss Chicken (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon liquid smoke, divided | 14 1/2 ounces diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons freshly grated ginger juice | 5 ounces shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Put 3 tablespoons of the liquid smoke in to a bowl. Add the tomatoes, chicken bouillon, ginger juice. Mix well. Pour mixture into a crock pot. Add swiss cheese. Turn to low. Cook for 7 hours on low.

title: Italian Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small bowl and whisk to blend. Store in an airtight container.

title: Low Fat Parsley Peppers for One, Two, and Four.
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 medium yellow sweet peppers ( such as red bell peppers or sweet red pepper ) | 1/4 cup fresh parsley springs, chopped
instructions: Place peppers on a sheet of aluminum foil and spray both sides. Sprinkle peppers with 1 tablespoons parsley. Wrap pepper and foil around peppers, pressing foil down so pepper mixture holds its shape. Bake on a preheated grill for 12 - 15 minutes, or until blackened.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,orange liqueur,apple cider,walnut,maple syrup,tomato puree
title: A Very Victorian Steamed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs ripe tomatoes | 1/3 cup pure maple syrup ( or brown syrup ) | 2 tablespoons apple cider or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 2 tablespoons golden syrup ( or syrup of your choice ) | 2 teaspoons orange liqueur | 2 teaspoons pure maple syrup ( or maple syrup of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon pure maple syrup ( or maple syrup of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon dried walnuts or 1 teaspoon coarsely chopped dried pecans
instructions: Put tomato in a large saucepan large enough to hold the tomato. Sprinkle lightly with maple syrup, golden syrup, orange liqueur, and orange syrup. Place heavy cover on top and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Remove the cover and continue to cook. Once the tomatoes are steaming, remove them from the heat. Spoon off as much of the liquid as possible. Place tomatoes back into the pan, add the syrup, and stir to coat evenly. Do not worry if the syrup turns a golden color. The tomatoes will be firm when you are put on them. Allow them to rest about 5 - 10 minutes covered in a cool place. Pour off as much of the excess liquid as possible. Remove the lid and stir again to coat evenly. Remove the tomatoes from the pan and place into individual steamer dishes. The tomatoes will be steaming themselves during this process. Steam for 5 - 10 minutes until firm and the skins are wrinkled and blistered. Be sure to set tomato carefully not to overcook or the skins will steam and burst. Allow to cool to room temperature. Once they are cooled, remove from steamer dishes and refrigerate overnight. They should not be placed on a greased cookie sheet unless you are using them in a sauté pan or on the top rack of a broiler pan. To toast the nuts, place on a baking tray at 300 degrees farenheit until golden brown and toasted, about 10 minutes. Allow to cool, sprinkle with the nuts and allow to cool completely. Store in an air tight tin at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: vodka,crescent dinner,cherry pie filling,feta cheese,dark soy sauce,italian salad dressing mix,blue cheese,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Blue Cheese & Cherry Danish
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls, partially thawed | 2/3 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1 cup kraft crumbled blue cheese | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/3 cup dark soy sauce | 1/3 cup vodka | 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese or 1/2 lb swiss cheese, shredded | 1 cup cherry pie filling, frozen and canned
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Grease a 13x9 inch baking dish. Arrange half the crescent dough in the prepared baking dish. In a mixing bowl, stir together the italian salad dressing mix, blue cheese, feta, soy sauce and vodka. Place the crescent dough in a plastic bag and squeeze the air out of the bag. Add the cheddar cheese & toss to mix well. Spread a layer of cheese mixture over the crescent dough. Repeat layers with the cherry pie filling and the remaining crescent dough. Bake for 30 minutes or until the crescent dough has browned and the cheese is bubbly.

title: Baked tostada
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell | 1 package linguine | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 carton frozen whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix together the tart shell and linguine. Spread the linguine mixture into the prepared pie shell, and bake for 20 minutes, or until bubbly. Remove, and top with the whipped topping if desired. Allow to cool completely before popping onto the tostada shells.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,white rice,vegetable,coffee,mint sprig,jalapeno pepper,mozzarella cheese,anise seed
title: Jaffrey's Famous Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white rice | 1 cup of fresh favaro mixed vegetables, cut into bite-sized pieces | 1/2 cup of fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded | 1/2 cup of fresh mint sprig | 1/2 cup of fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into bite-sized cubes | 1/4 cup instant coffee | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Cook rice according to package and drain when cooked. Cook frozen vegetables, jalapenos, mint, and cheese in olive oil in a large soup pot or wok for 5 minutes or until shrimp is pink. Stir rice and vegetables together in large bowl. Sprinkle on anise seed. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mustard,topping,italian herb,beef broth,lime juice zest,chicken bouillon cube,sea scallop
title: Sea Scallops With Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup low-sodium low-fat beef broth | 1/4 cup lime juice, freshly squeezed | 3 tablespoons low sodium chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb, crushed | 1 lb sea scallops | fat-free whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a large glass dish or bowl.

title: Gkai Kale and Ginger Gravy
ingredients: 12 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 bunch kale, stemmed and washed | 1/2 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Bring the stock to a boil in the pot. Stir in ginger garlic paste with a pinch of salt, then simmer until slightly reduced. Stir in kale. When kale is just done, stir in pesto. Serve.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,white onion,molasses,creole seasoning,cauliflower,chicken breast,cake yeast
title: Cucumber and Cauliflower Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 lb sweet white onion, with tender white rings | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 2 packages cake yeast | 2 cups cubed skinless chicken breasts | 1 bunch cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 english cucumbers, in slices
instructions: In a large pot brown onion with creole spice and molasses. Add chicken, cover and simmer in water for 10 minutes. Cover, remove from pot and cool. After removing lid and set aside add cauliflower and cucumber to soup mix with cooked onions and chicken. Mix until thoroughly combined and set aside. In a 9x5 loaf pan, place bread cubes, cover with cauliflower mixture and top with 1/2 of the soup mix. Cover with top of loaf and bake at 350 degrees f. For 50 minutes let cool and cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,curry,tomato puree,angel hair pasta,margarine,pork tenderloin,beef bouillon granule
title: Spicy Pork and Beef Pasta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon margarine or 1 teaspoon olive oil | 3 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 1-inch squares | 1 can chopped tomato puree | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 teaspoons curry | 1 package uncooked angel hair pasta
instructions: In a dutch oven or heavy skillet, cook pork in hot margarine over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Spoon off excess fat, then stir in tomatoes, bouillon, nutmeg, curry and noodles. Cover and simmer slowly for 30 minutes. Remove cover, increase heat to medium high and cook 4 minutes longer or until meat is tender and noodles are tender.

title: Cheesy Baked Yukon Gold Potatoes
ingredients: 6 yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks | 1 package shredded muenster cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Cover potatoes with salted water. Bring to a boil in a pot large enough to fit potatoes into a single layer. Reduce heat to medium low, and cover the pot. Cook potatoes 30 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and top with muenster cheese to serve.

Random Ingredients: flour,vegetable broth,raspberry,red cabbage,cannellini bean,salt black pepper,lemon
title: Raspberry and Cannellini Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 head fresh red cabbage ( about 2 pounds ) or 1 head red cabbage, about 2 pounds ( about 2 pounds ) | coarse salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 4 cups vegetables or 4 cups chicken broth | fresh raspberries, for garnish ( optional ) or orange juice, for serving ( optional ) | lemon slice, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Core cabbage and discard woody tops. Trim outer leaves and tough outer leaves from core. Working in batches, shred or shred cabbage and transfer to bowl of a food processor or blender. Season with salt and pepper. Process until finely shredded, about 15 seconds. Transfer to a large soup pot. Return all remaining ingredients to soup pot. Heat to boiling, stirring. Pour into soupboat with a steaming rack over a large bowl. Cover with a lid and steam until hot and berries are tender, about 5 minutes. Season soup generously with salt and pepper..

title: Warm Breakfast With Swiss
ingredients: 1 corn tortilla | 1 tablespoon double cream | 1 slice swiss cheese
instructions: Lay the tortilla on a plate. Spread the cream evenly in a thin circle on the tortilla and roll up, securing with tooth picks. Repeat with the rest of the tortillas and party rye. Place in a skillet and lightly coat with melted butter. After about 10 minutes, sprinkle on the swiss cheese and heat through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,bay leaf,graham cracker crumb,cardamom pod,oregano,pinto bean,sauce
title: Pasta With Pinto Beans or Beans
ingredients: 1 cup pinto bean | 4 ounces sauerkraut or 4 ounces refried beans | 2 bay leaves | 4 -5 cardamom pods ( or use 2 whole pods ) | 3/4 cup miniature graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano ( or use 1/8 teaspoon rosemary )
instructions: Soak the beans overnight. Rinse the beans and drain the water. Place 1 c of the beans and 1 c water into a 5 litre pan. Add the rest of these ingredients. Cover the pan and cook for 45 - 45 minutes or until the beans are tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in the crumbs and continue cooking until the crumbs are crisp and the beans are heated through.

title: Steamed Mexican Samosas
ingredients: 16 wonton wrappers | 2 guajillo chilies, halved lengthwise | 3/4 cup finely grated raw zest of 1 lemon | 4 sprigs fresh rosemary sprigs | rice, for steaming
instructions: Make sure the wontons are flat, and place about 1 tsp of cheese on each. Spread each wonton wrapper with a small amount of zest and a rosemary sprig. Seal the edges by pinching. Put the samosas in the steamer, and allow to steam for 15 minute steaming is done. Arrange on a parchment paper covered baking sheet so the wrapper doesn't touch both ends.

title: Chile Con Coco
ingredients: 5 cups oyster sauce | 1 1/2 cups cream of tartar ( or cream of coconut )
instructions: Combine the oyster sauce and cream of tartar in a large bowl. Mix well and set aside. When ready to be served, prepare a grill. Place one cup of the oyster sauce mixture on the center of a wooden or glass bowl. Place the bowl on the grill and close the lid. Cook on high heat for 3 minutes. Flip, close the lid and continue cooking for 3 minutes, or until the mixture looks dry and the oyster sauce has reduced by one quarter or more. Continue to cool for 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer the con Coco to a container and refrigerate it. You can store in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks. Tip, if making ahead, store the con Coco in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: french bread,ice water,jicama,anise seed,italian parsley,wonton wrapper,garbanzo bean,sun tomato oil
title: Jicama and Garbanzo Bean Ravioli
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated wonton wrappers | 1 cup minced peeled jicama | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons minced italian parsley | 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1 cup ice water | 3/4 cup crushed ice with a pinch of salt
instructions: In a medium, heavy nonstick skillet, stir together all ingredients except wrappers, jicama, and garlic. Heat over high heat until just sizzling. Brush a sheet of plastic wrap lightly with oil.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,beef,cream,chocolate coffee bean,wasabi powder,monterey jack cheese
title: The Big Burger
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | shredded monterey jack cheese or cheddar cheese | grated nutmeg | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup milk chocolate-covered coffee beans | 12 hazelnuts ( optional )
instructions: Mix the ground beef and wasabi, then press and work into patties. Sprinkle grated cheese on. Grate nutmeg over top. Grill over hot coals or under broiler until burger is done. Serve with sauce mixed with sour cream, milk chocolate & hazelnuts. I serve with fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,pecorino romano cheese,gluten flour rice,tarragon,oregano leaf
title: Italian Pineapple Rice Pudding
ingredients: 3 cups glut-free flour rice | 6 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 1 1/4 cups pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup grated fresh pecorino romano cheese or 1/4 cup finely shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: In a 2 to 3 quart saucepan, bring water to boil. While water is coming to a boil, combine flour rice, gluten free flour and 1 cup pineapple juice. Bring to boil again and remove from heat. Stir in tarragon, oregano, 1 cup pineapple slices, cheese and remaining water. Cover and return mixture to skillet. Cook on medium heat until thickened, stirring often and allowing moisture to be absorbed. Serve pudding warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,ricotta,pineapple juice,vanilla extract,red chili pepper
title: Ricotta-Papaya Chilies on the Barbie
ingredients: 16 ounces ricotta | 1/2 cup pure pineapple juice | 2 -4 red chili peppers, dried ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 4 pieces banana peppers ( to taste )
instructions: Combine ricotta, chilies, and puree. Put into refrigerator to allow flavors to develop. To peel and chop chili peppers, run under hot water, drain and discard seeds and membrane. Place chilies in a large ziplock food safe plastic bag, close, and use a pair of scissors to cut off stem ends with scissors. Remove membrane and veins with a large knife or razor blade, then cut off seeds with a sharp paring knife. Place on the side of a grill over high heat. Grill 2 - 4 minutes, turning once. Serve immediately.

title: The Easiest Chicken Broth
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken stock or 12 ounces vegetable stock | black pepper
instructions: Open the stock. Pour the stock into a large saucepan or pot. Bring to the boil. Add the pepper, and keep stirring until the stock starts to separate from the solids. Keep boiling for a further 5 minutes until the liquid is reduced by about half. Add the stock to the simmering stock and serve.

title: Tarragon Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Wash and cook the noodles according to the directions on the package. Mix soda, cumin, tarragon and oregano in a small bowl, stirring well. Drain the noodles. Immerse the noodles into the dry spices and toss until evenly coated, then add the ginger. Transfer to a serving dish, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Oops! Peaches With Peaches, Orange and Peach
ingredients: 4 peaches, halved, pitted and de-seeded | 2 oranges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f / 180°c. Cut 2 oranges in half, remove peel, white pith and membrane.. Place halved peaches and white pith in shallow roasting tin. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper. Bake for 20 minutes or until warm, stirring after 15 minutes. Turn peaches and bake a further 2 minutes. Remove from oven. Spread peaches with orange juice and serve with orange slices on the side. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,hazelnut,white wine vinegar,lager beer,onion soup mix
title: Wild Artichoke Appetizer (No Eggs)
ingredients: 2 cans baby spinach ( drained ) | 4 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1 ounce dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts ( optional ) | 1/2 cup belgian-style lager beer ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for hazelnuts in blender. Mix on high speed until mixture is foamy. If using hazelnuts skip this step. If using hazelnuts, remove stems and seeds. Store in refrigerator. To serve, stir into hot guacamole.

title: Tortilla and Water Chestnut Patties
ingredients: 2 large corn tortillas, cut into 1/2-inch rounds | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f or a convection oven. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange tortillas on baking sheet. Scatter water chestnuts over tortillas and sprinkle panko on top. Bake, uncovered on baking sheet for 15 minutes. Combine bread crumbs and cayenne using a fork. Sprinkle panko over bread crumbs mixture.

title: Herbed Onion Rings (Dry Onion Rings)
ingredients: 1/3 - 1/2 cup dried minced assorted ( dry onion flakes, chopped fine ) | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon fresh lemon thyme, chopped fine
instructions: Line 2 large rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Preheat oven to 300°f degrees. Heat the oven to 375°f in a small mixing bowl, add onion flakes, thyme and 1 teaspoon of salt.

title: Lentils and Lentils With Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 4 slices provolone cheese | salad greens
instructions: Rinse lentils thoroughly in cold water. Place lentils in a pot with enough water to cover them about 3 inches above the level of the lentils. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes, or until lentils are tender and liquid has been absorbed. Tilt the lentils toward the top of the pot with a fork and arrange 4 slices of provolone cheese on top. Cover, and simmer 5 to 10 minutes, or until cheese has melted.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,egg yolk,beef tenderloin,green cardamom pod,cumin seed,saffron,celery
title: Beef Tenderloin Kebabs With Italian Plum Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin | 3 green cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 stalks celery, cut in 1 inch pieces | 12 italian plums with their liquid | 2/3 cup diced peeled italian plum tomato | 4 large egg yolks | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Place beef tenderloin between 2 sheets plastic wrap and mallet to pound to 1/4 thick. Place cardom pods on a cutting board. Place celery in center of a skewer and hold each slice with the point of meat mallet. Cut off top 1 inch from celery and discard. Place tomatoes around beef and top with celery. Dip into eggs and then into yolks. Set aside on a plate. Wrap skewer around meat and marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight. Prepare rack in center of oven and lower temperature to 200ºf. Brush skewers with egg wash and place in oven. Cook 90 min to 120 minute for rare or until thermometer registers 130ºf for medium rare. Let sit 5 min before serving.

title: Low-Fat Crock Pot Chicken Taco Bowl
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs shredded cooked chicken | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup crushed pineapple nuts | 1 bunch chopped fresh broccoli ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot and turn on low for 8 - 10 hours. Serve with flour tortillas and fat free toppings or lettuce.

title: Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt ( plain yogurt ) | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chopped meat ( ground beef ) | 1 package frozen wild rice
instructions: Simmer wild rice according to package directions. Cook meat and drain. Put the meat and wild rice in a 9x13 pan. Pour in the yogurt mixture and mix well. Bring to a simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally.

title: German Potato Nests
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 tablespoons flour | 3 red potatoes | 2 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Combine eggs and cook in skillet. Add other ingredients and fry until all ingredients are cooked.

Random Ingredients: enoki mushroom,pesto,beer,chipotle chile adobo,bread flour,mustard powder,black bean dip,rice wine vinegar
title: Mexican Meatball Subs
ingredients: 1/2 lb enoki mushroom, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/3 cup beer or 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared pesto, divided | 3/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chile in adobo, minced ( if unavailable, use 1/4 tsp. minced fresh chiles or omit ) | 2 tablespoons prepared arugula top or 2 tablespoons spinach salad greens ( optional ) | 1 can black bean dip, homemade is best ( for thicker flavor, use 1/4 cup homemade dip )
instructions: Cut enoki mushrooms in half lengthwise and then into 1/8 inch slices. Place in bowl of cold water to stop the cooking. Drain and place in ice bath to cool. When the water is cold, drain and pat dry with paper towel. Combine vinegar, 1 tbsp. Pesto, mustard powder, chiles, and minced meatball ingredients in a large bowl. Form into 1 inch meatballs with your hands and place on wax paper or plate.. Combine greens and 3 tsp. Cilantro dressing in another bowl. Heat remaining broth in a medium nonstick skillet, over medium high heat until it begins to boil. Add the rest of the salad ingredients, reduce heat, and simmer for a few minutes to blend flavors. Add salad to meatballs and simmer until heated through, about 2 minutes, or use a slotted spoon to get meatballs out of the broth. Serve at once.

title: Lemon & Currants
ingredients: 6 tablespoons currants | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Wash and dry the currants, remove excess moisture. Heat the marinade in a saucepan over medium high heat. Add the currants and toss to coat. Cover and cook until the currants have absorbed most of the liquid, 5 - 10 minutes. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook until the liquid has been absorbed and the currants are crisp& glazed, 8 - 10 minutes.

title: Soup Tortellini
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated small tortellini | 2 cups fresh broccoli florets
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat. Add the tortellini and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until just tender. Place the broccoli in a colander set in the sink, and run cold water over it to separate the strands. Tear the tortellini into bite size pieces. Place the tortellini into the boiling water, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until they float to the surface. Drain, and place into a soup bowl. Mash the vegetables with a potato masher, or in a blender. Pour the soup over the tortellini just before serving.

Random Ingredients: ranch salad dressing,semolina,sesame seed,pineapple chunk,cashew,peanut oil vegetable,cocoa powder,garam masala
title: Rajma's Super Yummy Semolina-Filled Rolls
ingredients: 1 package semolina | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 cup peanut oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped roughly | 1/2 tablespoon garam masala | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Whisk together semolina, baking soda and mango. Set aside. Pour peanut oil into a microwave safe bowl or other pan. Microwave on high for 15 - 20 seconds just to warm the oil. Add chocolate and stir to mix before adding. Stirring every minute or two to ensure even melting. Transfer to bowl of a mixer and add nuts, garam masala and sesame seeds. Mix very well. Place the 2 doughs side by side in a large rectangle log on the cookie sheet. Pour oil/oil mixture over and on top of dough. Using the back of a large spoon, press dough into a thick rectangle approximately 1/3 in diameter. If necessary, use a wet pastry brush to make the doughs more or less flat. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Mama Bennions Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 1 cup salsa, of your choice | 2 tablespoons crushed, unsalted peanuts | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 16 ounces swiss cheese, grated ( or shredded ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 1/8 teaspoon table salt | 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate, melted and cooled | fresh shaved cashews ( to garnish ) or shaved chocolate ( to garnish )
instructions: In a fondue pot, combine salsa and peanuts and set aside. Working in batches, melt cheese and add rice and wine. Stir until well blended and the cheese melts. Transfer cheese/cheese mixture to a bowl, cool, then add the salsa mixture and stir until evenly melted. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled. Using an old fashioned bread knife or cleaver, cut fondue pot into pieces and dip each piece into the fondue mixture. To serve, garnish with shaved cashews or shaved chocolate.

Random Ingredients: extra tofu,macaroni,fennel seed,green curry paste,yellow onion,cider vinegar,pinto bean,vanilla essence
title: Green Curry With Tofu and Macaroni
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon plain canola oil | 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 package extra firm tofu, cubed | 1 1/2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed with the back of a spoon | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | pancake and macaroni, to serve
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Add the onion and then the tofu. Cook, stirring often, until the onion softens. Stir in the curry paste and cook for one minute or until fragrant. Stir in the beans, fennel seeds and vinegar. Cover and cook gently for 20 minutes, or until the mixture seems very thick and smooth. Serve over cooked basmati rice as a side. The tofu should now be heated through and the onions just beginning to brown.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,green chili pepper,coriander powder,cashew nut,grain rice,italian salad dressing,red pepper,tea
title: Green Pepper and Cashew Nut Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked long grain rice | 1 - 1 1/2 cup mild green chili pepper, seeded and chopped ( mild or hot brands, to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon freshly ground coriander powder ( not ground ) | 1 teaspoon red pepper, finely diced ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon finely chopped green chili pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped cashew nuts ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 cup prepared italian salad dressing | 1/2 - 1 cup freshly made brewed tea ( preferably english breakfast )
instructions: Place rice, bell peppers, coriander, red pepper and green chile in a medium size mixing bowl and toss with enough salad dressing to moisten, stirring until well distributed. Place rice in a decorative serving bowl and top with desired garnish. Serve chilled.

title: Mustard-Zucchini with Zucchini in Clay
ingredients: 3 4 -6 medium zucchini ( the zucchini flesh, and the ends, if you are using some whole zucchini, cut them as you will be using this instead of cut them in 2 or 3 slices before you cook them ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons mustard | 1 1/4 teaspoons methi seeds
instructions: Rinse the zucchini with your hands, drain, pat dry with paper towels, and cut the zucchini lengthwise into 4 pieces lengthwise. Put the mustard and the methi in a mortar and pound or mash them with a pestle or a teaspoon until they form an paste. Then add the mustard paste to the zucchini and mix well. Cover and leave in a warm, dark place for 15 minutes. Strain and add 1 tablespoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of seasoning. Place the zucchini slices on a baking tray or in a baking tin lined with parchment paper and cook at 300° until crisp and golden. This can be served warm or hot. If serving hot, leave them to cook for a few moments. If serving cold, leave them to cool to room temperature.

title: Hibachi  Pancakes (Ensalada De Huevos Rancheros)
ingredients: 3 1/4 cups white flour or 3 1/4 cups whole wheat flour, more if needed | 6 tablespoons saffron, soaked in 1/4 cup hot water for 12-15 minutes | 1/2 cup basil pesto ( prepared ) | 1 pinch saffron | 1 pinch saffron | 8 tablespoons basil pesto ( prepared ) | 4 thin slices ham | 8 large purple onions, trimmed of most of the tops | 2 tablespoons white flour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | handful cilantro leaves or fresh coriander leaves, to taste
instructions: Whisk together the white flour and saffron. Mix in 1/2 cup cold water, using half a cup or so to make a stiff batter. Cover and let rest about 30 minutes. The batter should be of stiff, but not liquid. The batter should not spread and the batter should be about a 1/4 thick. Sprinkle the batter with a little salt, but try and keep the batter just under 1/2 of the height of the pancake batter. With a wooden spatula spread out the batter until it is 6 or 7 inches across. You will need a pancake griddle pan to hold all four pancakes together when you cook them. Heat up a griddle and spray it with a little oil, or use a hot non stick cooking spray. Dip each pancake into the batter, tipping to coat evenly. Cook on one side for 3 minutes or until light brown on each side. Turn and cook on the other side, 3 minutes or until light brown. Transfer to a plate and let cool. Repeat warming and baking pancakes as needed, keeping them covered at all times, until all the pancakes are made. In a small saute pan over low heat, dry toast 1/2 cup of white pesto, or to taste, for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Pour 2 tablespoons of prepared basil pesto over 2 large slices of ham. Put a little of the pesto on top of each pancake and sprinkle with a few slices of ham. Garnish with a little diced onion, cilantro leaves, or chopped raw green onion tops. Enjoy.

title: Cottage Cheese With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 200 g cottage cheese | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Place cottage cheese out to dry out for 5 - 10 minutes. Dip your choice of cheese in dipping sauce and then roll in the dipping sauce. Serve your favourite dipping sauce and enjoy.

title: Pepperoni and Pepperoni Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon pepperoni, crumbled | 1/4 cup corn tortilla chips
instructions: Place 1 tortilla chip on a cutting board and lightly flatten to an 8 x 8 inch rectangle. Spread pepperoni over entire tortilla chip. Sprinkle the pepperoni onto the hot pepperoni if desired.

title: Shredded Italian Carrots
ingredients: 3 large carrots, peeled and sliced | 1/4 cup italian italian salad dressing
instructions: Place carrots in a large pot. Fill with water and put on high heat to boil. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until carrots are tender. Drain. When cool enough to handle, peel carrots and then slice. Place in a bowl and add salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,italian sausage,bouillon cube,steak,wheat germ,flat leaf parsley,wheat flour,cream tartar
title: Swiss Steak & Sausages over Muffuletta
ingredients: 500 g flank steaks | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 cup wheat germ | 1 1/2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken stock cubes or 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable stock cubes | 1 bouillon cube | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock, heated | 150 g italian sausage, sliced
instructions: Toss steak with flour, wheat germ, cream of tartar and stock cubes and season well. Heat oil in a frying pan over a high heat, cook steak for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until just cooked through.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,rice noodle,cocoa powder,greek yogurt,extra tofu,mint,white bread,cornstarch
title: Crunchy Enchilidas
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu or ( 8 ounce ) package extra firm tofu | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 8 ounces uncooked rice noodles, 3-4 ounces | 2 cups unsweetened greek yogurt | 1 3/4 cups cornstarch | 1/2 cup rice noodles, 2 cups | 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese or 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 1/4 teaspoon cocoa powder or 1/4 teaspoon instant coffee
instructions: Drain liquid from tofu. Blend yogurt with cornstarch. Place 1/4 cup of yogurt mixture in a bowl and stir in cheese. In the microwave, melt the coconut oil on high for 30 seconds. Mix together cornstarch with reserved yogurt mixture. Add the cornstarch mixture to the yogurt mixture, stir and remove to cool. Dip the cornstarch soaked rice noodles into the yogurt mixture and let rest for a few minutes. Scoop noodles and noodles into a bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, then place the bowl in the refrigerator for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve topped with remaining yogurt mixture and garnished with chopped of fresh mint or cocoa powder or coffee.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,pineapple chunk,green food coloring,new potato,eggplant,baking powder
title: Sweet Potato-Linda's Baba Ghanoush
ingredients: 1 pound small new potatoes | 1 cup chopped eggplant | 1 cup crushed pineapple chunks | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 4 drops green food coloring | 1/4 cup chopped kalamata olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease 2 - 3 inch glass baking dishes with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes, and cook until almost tender, about 15 minutes. Drain, and transfer to a bowl of ice water. Drain, and cool. Meanwhile, combine eggplant, pineapple, baking powder, and food coloring with the olive. Spray with cooking spray. Spread into baking dishes. Pour in the potato mixture. Sprinkle with chopped kalamata olives, and bake in preheated oven 10 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon bark,daikon radish,red bell pepper,leek,baby spinach,lettuce leaf,extra sharp cheddar cheese
title: Spinach and Carrot Gratin (Vegetable Gratin)
ingredients: 4 -6 cups fresh baby spinach, trimmed and torn away from the stalks | 1 cup daikon radishes, peeled, sliced crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1 leek, white part only, sliced crosswise into 1/4 inch rounds | 1 medium red bell pepper, seeded, sliced, rinsed well, and patted dry | 1 1/2 cups shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese, divided in half ( about 1 1/3 cups ) | 4 lettuce leaves | 1 cinnamon bark
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Lightly butter an 8 inch square baking dish.

title: Quick N' Easy Spiced Mac 'N' Simple Ice Cream.
ingredients: 800 g macaroni ( any type of small pasta works well ) | 1 packet nutmeats spice blend | 2 liters vanilla ice cream | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | herbs ( optional ) or seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Prepare macaroni, drain if there is any excess liquid and set out. Mix together and leave to cool. Boil the sundried tomatoes and spice blend for about 3 minutes in a pan, and remove from heat, allow to cool. When it is cool, mix in ice cream. Place macaroni onto your favourite serving plate, pour over the ice cream. If using herbs then sprinkle over the spice blend.

Random Ingredients: pasta,pasta sauce,stewing beef,sea salt,plain yogurt,black salt
title: Quick and Easy Pasta and Beef
ingredients: 300 g stewing beef | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 300 -400 ml pasta sauce | 150 -300 ml plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon black salt ( optional ) | 1 packet quick pasta, prepared and moulded to the thickness of your liking
instructions: Chop your beef and brown over a high heat, breaking apart any lumps. Add salt and pasta sauce. Add the yogurt, mix together and simmer for 10 minutes. When the beef and sauce have simmered together for 15 - 20 mins, add the quick pasta. Add the sea salt. Serve over plenty of freshly steamed pasta.

title: Nam Taise (Nam Taise Queso Breaded Fries)
ingredients: 1/2 cup nam pla | 1 1/4 lbs finely shredded mexican cheese blend, divided | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 12 kaiser rolls ( vietnamese bread or french loaf or other soft bread )
instructions: Combine 1/2 tspn of the american cheese mix and 1/4 cup of cheese in a small bowl and stir until well blended. Brush the 1/4 cup of cheese mixture on the cut sides of a bread roll and arrange in an overlapping circle on a cookie sheet lined with waxed paper. Heat vegetable oil over med high heat in a nonstick skillet. When it is almost smoking, dip the bread in the mixture and place it in the hot skillet. With a meat tenderizing brush, flip the bread until the outside is lightly browned too. Remove from heat and transfer to a rack. Sprinkle with remaining cheese mixture, reheat if necessary. Serve immediately on a platter.

Random Ingredients: green olive,tamari,taco seasoning mix,rye flour,russet potato
title: Taco Fritters
ingredients: 2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 2/3 cup tamari | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 4 teaspoons olive, divided | 3 1/2 cups rye flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place potatoes into a large pan of water, and bring to a boil. Boil for 15 minutes, or until tender. Drain and mash with a potato masher. Stir in tamari, taco seasoning, 1 teaspoon olive, and 2 tablespoons of the remaining olive oil. Mix well. Gradually mix in rye flour, and mix to form stiff dough. Turn out onto a floured work surface, and gently knead until smooth. Roll out again to about 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into 1/2 inch strips. Repeat with remaining mixture and oil. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,pecorino romano cheese,pork chop,baking soda
title: Crispy Pecorino Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 teaspoons baking soda, or as needed | 3 pounds pork chops, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness | 1 container mascarpone cheese | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Sprinkle baking soda over pork chops and toss until evenly coated. Arrange pork chops in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Pour enough water into a large pot to cover pork. Bring to a boil and immerse the pork chops into the water.

title: Plum Dumplings
ingredients: 1 large soft veal or 1 large soft fat vegetable | 1 packet frozen mixed vegetables | 2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Dissolve the cream of tartar in 1 cup of boiling water. Pour this mixture into the centre of a large tea towel. Break the dough into pieces, roll into a ball, and then press out each one lightly with the hands until they are about 1/2 inch think and fairly flat. Cut each piece into thirds. Drop them into the treacle. Cover with a cloth and allow to rest for about an hour. Boil the mixed vegetables until cooked as you would like them to be, or until they are quite tender, then drain off the treacle and set aside. Roll out the balls on a floured surface until they are about 1/4 inch in diameter. Bring a large quantity of water to the boil and drop these balls into the boiling water. Cook for about 10 to 12 minutes. You’ll need to cook them for that long, but they cook themselves, so don’t be tempted to turn off the heat. If you prefer, you can boil these for about 5 minutes longer after the last one. They may be eaten warm or cold, respectively.

title: Ginger and Spice Paste for Fish
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ground ginger paste | 5 teaspoons ground allspice ( whole mixed together )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the ginger and allspice. Use as you would any other raw spice paste.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,ginger root,cream mushroom soup,tamari,cumin,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Coconut Spaghetti
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 tablespoon tamari, or to taste | 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger root | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti, or as needed
instructions: Spray a large skillet with vegetable cooking spray, set over medium high heat.

title: Steamed Japanese Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth ( e.g., clam juice or beef bouillon ) | 2 tablespoons sake
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat. Blend salmon with a fork or in batches, then add to broth. Cover, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender. Discard bones. Serve salmon on a bun or leafy lettuce leaf.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,oat,caster sugar,pecorino romano cheese,pumpkin,sauce,pineapple juice,tamarind paste
title: Pumpkin and Cheese Mousse (Gluten-Free)
ingredients: 100 g pumpkin, peeled and chopped into chunks | 10 g rolled oats | 100 g sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 125 ml pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon aromatic hot sauce ( or paste, to taste )
instructions: Place pumpkin in a frying pan and fry over medium heat until softened. Place in serving bowl and add rolled oats, cheddar and pineapple. Add tamarind paste and sugar and stir until combined. Whisk sauce ingredients together. Pour over mince mixture and mix lightly to combine. Allow to set, then garnish with coriander leaves or parsley for presentation if desired.

title: Ginger-Rubbed Butter
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger powder | 2 teaspoons butter, softened
instructions: In a small bowl, combine oil, ginger and butter. Place on a wax paper lined cookie sheet and flatten with a rolling pin to 1/4 inch thickness. Let sit for 5 minutes. With a sharp knife, cut into 16 pieces. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet and brush all over with oil.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,swiss cheese,irish cream,biscuit,potato gnocchi,cheesecloth,nori,bean
title: Gnocchi & Potato Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 teaspoon graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 can baked beans | 1 1/2 cups drained instant potato gnocchi | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream | 2 cups shredded mixed vegetables ( such as broccoli, carrots, mushrooms, onions ) | 1 packet prepared biscuit | 2 sheets nori, seaweed sheets
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs and 1/2 cup of swiss cheese. Sprinkle the cheese over the cooked beans then stir in the mashed potato gnocchi. Stir the can of baked potato gnocchi into the gnocchi mixture. In a large bowl, combine the rest of the swiss cheese, bean, and potato mixture. Stir in the irish cream and mixed vegetables. Place 1/2 cup of gnocchi mixture into the bottom of a 3 - 4 qt wok or large skillet & press the top layer of parchment paper on top. Place a sheet of seaweed on top of the parchment paper. Remove parchment from sides of pan & press the top layer of parchment paper onto the gnocchi mixture. Cut gnocchi into squares so that there are 3 - 4 squares. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add a teaspoon of oil to the pan. Cook 1 1/2 cups cooked gnocchi for 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, remove gnocchi pieces into the pan then place on top of the seaweed slices, pressing them down gently. Continue to cook until all gnocchi is used, about 1 minute longer. Remove gnocchi from pan & set aside. Repeat with the remaining 3 cups of gnocchi. To serve, line the nori seaweed sheets with seaweed and spread 1 or 2 cups of gnocchi on each sheet.

title: Dredge Ranch Shortbread
ingredients: 225 g plain flour | 1 packet ranch dressing mix | 1 packet seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Use a stand mixer to mix the flour, seasoning salt and salad dressing mix well and roll into a log. Wrap in tin foil. Bake for 20 minutes.
