Increase oven temperature to 180c & cook for a further 5 - 10 minutes until top turns pale gold. Remove from the oven and cool completely, slice & serve with butter. I have left out the seasoning packet which i keep in the fridge for use after.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,salmon fillet,nutritional yeast,brown mustard seed,yeast,cumin
title: Smoked Salmon Wontons and Tips
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet | 1 package dry yeast | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 24 wonton wrappers
instructions: Thaw the salmon completely, if frozen. Rinse fillet and pat dry. Cut into chunks. Mix the yeast, mustard seed, cumin, and worcestershire sauce together in a mixing bowl. Place salmon chunks in a large zip top bag. Stir in yeast and fish sauce mixture until well blended. Spoon out and place in refrigerator for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°f. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper. Place 2 won ton wrappers on a lightly floured board and brush with water. Place 1 tablespoon of the prepared fish mixture in the center of each wrapper. Roll the unused wrappers around the filling, gathering as you go, until there are no more nodes in the wrapper. Cut the wontons into 3/4 pieces. Place the wontons on the parchment paper about one inch apart and place in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, until they are golden brown.

title: Chicken in Spice - Indian
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chicken breasts or 1 1/2 kg chicken legs | 6 green cardamom pods
instructions: Cut chicken into bite size pieces. If using chicken legs, cut in half. Place into a plastic bag, with the cardamon pods. Add 1 1/4 Cups water and let soak for half an hour. After 20 minute, drain. Wipe bag with a clean cloth. Place the chicken, breast pieces and 1/2 cup of water into the pressure cooker. Close the lid and give it a good shake. Close the lid and let cook over medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes. When cooked, remove bag, remove cardamon pods, and take out the cardamon pods, taking the bag from the chicken. Add 1 1/2 cup of water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt to the bag. Close the lid and set on high heat for a few seconds. Lower heat to medium low, pour bag contents into a large bowl. Cut chicken, add back into bag, and add 1/4 cup water. Mix this with the bag and bring to the boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot. This bag is excellent served with white rice.

title: Mushroom-mussel Bisque
ingredients: 6 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 can mussels, well-simmered with the juice reserved | 2 cups soymilk
instructions: Place mushrooms, sherry, mustard powder, garlic powder and reserved juice from can into the bottom of a double boiler over medium heat. Simmer, uncovered, over medium heat until thickened, about 15 minutes. Pour in mussels, stirring to break up clumps. Reduce sauce to a simmer. Remove mushrooms in their juices. Simmer the soup over medium low heat until thick, 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in soymilk.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,pecorino romano cheese,ice water,kaffir lime leaf,allspice berry,wheat bread,anise seed
title: Lebanese Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups plain whey or 1 3/4 cups unbleached cane sugar, such as organic, sugar free or organic low-fat | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice berry | kaffir lime leaf, lightly crushed | 1 slice whole-wheat bread, preferably whole wheat | 1 tablespoon finely grated pecorino romano cheese or 1 tablespoon freshly grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped flat-leaf italian parsley or 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped mixed italian parsley
instructions: Pour 1 1/4 cups of water into a 5 gallon electric slow cooker. Add the sugar, anise seed, and allspice. Cook on high 4 hours. Turn slow cooker off, transfer contents to a large bowl, and allow to cool, about 3 hours. Place the bread slices in a serving bowl, and pour 1/4 cup of the liquid from the slow cooker over the bread slices, turning to coat and letting the bread soak up the juices. Sprinkle each slice with a little grated cheese, chopped parsley and a squeeze of lime juice to serve.

title: Easy English Scones
ingredients: 4 cups white flour | 1 cup golden raisin
instructions: Sift flour. Add raisins. Make a hole in the middle of the flour and drop large spoonfulls into the hole. Do not add too much air until well mixed. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f, using a 3rd measure. Put some kneaded plastic wrap over the top of half of the scone or dough and using the tines of a fork gently poke holes in the dough. Sprinkle the top of dough with more flour. Bake 10 minutes or until top becomes golden and crusty..

Random Ingredients: rosemary,pumpkin spice,greek olive,allspice,sesame oil,oregano leaf,red food coloring
title: Easy Marinated Pumpkin Spice Oil Dip
ingredients: 2 teaspoons pumpkin spice | 1/2 cup toasted sesame oil | 1 tablespoon greek olive or 1 tablespoon kalamata olives, plus more for garnish | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: For a less spicey dip, use one of the following, 1 tablespoon of pumpkin spice & mix it with 1/2 cup of sesame oil. Mix it with the toasted sesame oil, greek olive or kalamata olives, oregano leaves, rosemary, allspice & a dash of red food coloring. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with pumpernickel chips.

title: Real English Pork Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs country-style pork ribs | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 cup shredded emmenthaler cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cover a large roasting pan with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Place ribs in roaster, fat side up and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in oven uncovered until almost tender, about 3 hours. Shred with 2 forks. Pour off fat. Sauce, in saucepan, heat 1/2 cup sugar until sizzling. Mix in vinegar. Dip ribs in sauce and sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,yellow bell pepper,shrimp paste,prosciutto,pork tenderloin,peanut oil,kiwi fruit,active yeast
title: Pinchos
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups lukewarm water | 1 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 ounces smoked pork tenderloin, cut into 1 & quot, squares | 2 teaspoons shrimp paste | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cut into thin 1 & quot, squares | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled, seeded, and sliced crosswise | 1 piece prosciutto, cut into 1/2 & quot, thick slices
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the water, yeast, pork, shrimp paste and oil. Cover and let stand until foamy, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook the bell pepper, kiwifruit and prosciutto over low heat, stirring, until the kiwifruit is crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Spoon the vegetable mixture into the pork mixture and stir to combine. Let cool to warm and shape into 1 1/4 inch balls. Bake in a preheated 400f oven until browned on the bottoms for 10 minutes. Turn the pizzas, and bake until golden, 5 - 10 minutes more, or until the internal temperature reaches 165f.

title: Indian Shredded Coconut
ingredients: 1 can coconut, shredded | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pepperoncini peppers | 1 tablespoon finely chopped thyme ( or 1/2 tsp. fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 cup ice water ( may need up to 1/2 cup more )
instructions: Place coconut, pepperoncini, thyme, cumin, and ice water together in large bowl and mix well. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Serve as a snack or as a salad on crisp, dark bread.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,green curry paste,rotel tomato chilies
title: Green Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( zest of 1 lemon ) | 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( the hotter )
instructions: Put the rotel, lemon juice and curry paste into a non reactive saucepan. Heat on medium. Stir regularly. Lower heat and cook for at least 20 minutes. Serve over your favourite veg, rice, mashed potatoes. For vegetarian use a vegetable broth.

title: Green Curry Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup thinly-sliced cucumber | 1 cup thinly-sliced parsnips | 2 tablespoons minced green curry paste ( or more to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Tuna, Tuna and Black Eyeball
ingredients: 3/4 lb tilapia fillet | 1 can tuna, drained ( or more if needed )
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut the fish into thick chunks and place in a single layer on a broiler proof platter. Top each fillet with 2 1/4 tablespoons tuna and the rest of the tuna. Cover and broil until the fish is cooked, about 10 minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: pork,fennel seed,cocoa,lemon juice zest,vanilla,italian sausage,tomato,cooking spray
title: Pork Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 1/2 lb italian sausage, casings removed | 16 ounces diced tomatoes | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa, dutch roasted preferred | cooking spray
instructions: Brown the sausage in a skillet. Combine all other ingredients except cooking spray in a small skillet. Drain. Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Pour in the meat mixture and top with a layer of the chocolate sauce. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,saltine cracker,white cabbage,pink grapefruit,self raising flour,french bread
title: Homemade Party Crumble
ingredients: 1 large white cabbage, in thin wedges | 1 pink grapefruit | 3 -4 tablespoons self raising flour | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon saltine crackers, coarsely crushed | 1/2 cup rye bread, broken into triangles | 1/4 cup crisp bread, pieces
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large roasting dish, cover tightly and cook in a moderately hot oven about 1½ hours or until the crumble topping is crusty and golden.

title: Raspberry Snacks
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen sourdough cookies | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 10 ounces canned crabmeat, drained | 1 pint fresh raspberries | 6 ounces chopped ripe olives, drained | 16 ounces frozen unsalted cherries ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon poppy seed
instructions: Bake crust in preheated 350f oven for 8 - 10 minutes. Combine sourdough cookies, vanilla, crab, raspberries& olives in large bowl. Spoon into hot buttered 9x12 inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle with poppy seeds. Bake in 325f oven for 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Mushroom, Parsnip and Sun-Dried Tomato Salad
ingredients: 4 medium parsnips or 2 large carrots | 200 g button mushrooms or 200 g cremini mushrooms, thickly sliced | 1 -2 piece sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 100 g pitted green olives, cut into slivers
instructions: Scrub the parsnips, peel them, slice or chop them into bite sized pieces. Slice the mushrooms, heat a griddle or a large frying pan until very hot. Brush the griddle lightly with oil. Cook the parsnips for about 10 minutes, stirring them every 2 minutes to keep them from sticking. They will be crunchy. When all the time has been trimmed off add the mushrooms and sun dried tomatoes, cook for about 2 - 3 minutes and remove from heat. Place the salad in an attractive serving bowl. Sprinkle with the olives and serve.

Random Ingredients: celery leaf,turmeric,strawberry,acorn squash,black peppercorn,turmeric powder,vanilla bean,pinto bean
title: Arafura (Spiny Bean Curry)
ingredients: 2 cups thickly sliced red strawberries ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 cup fresh pineapple or 1 cup acorn squash ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder ( or a dash of ground cardamom ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 fresh vanilla bean ( split lengthwise, scraped, split in half, seeds scraped out ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons black peppercorns | 1 sprig celery leaves ( optional ) | 3/4 - 1 cup prepared unsalted dry-roasted pinto bean | 2 -3 sprigs fresh celery leaves ( optional )
instructions: Cut all the above ingredients in half, and set aside,. Toast the pinto bean in a dry skillet until they're fragrant, about 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,grain rice,cremini mushroom,kalamata olive,adobo sauce,vodka,bean
title: Rice Salad from Laredo's Cafe
ingredients: 1/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted | 2 cups cooked short-grain rice | 1 1/4 cups cremini mushrooms | 2 ounces adobo sauce, from the can | 1 tablespoon vodka | 1 1/4 cups white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
instructions: In large bowl, add the olives. Add the rice, mushrooms, sauce, vodka, vinegar, and red wine. Toss to combine. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Cheese Quesadilla With Tarragon and Gouda
ingredients: 1 flour tortillas ( or 10-inch ) | 2 tablespoons chopped tarragon | 3 tablespoons shredded aged gouda cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºf. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Spread the tortilla with 1 tablespoon tarragon and 1 tablespoon edgi cheese on one half of the tortilla. Top with the other half of the tortilla. Using a fork, prick the surface with a fork and bake until golden brown, approximately 8 minutes. Cut in half, diagonally.

Random Ingredients: salami,icing sugar,semolina,pumpkin,american cheese,purpose flour,bean sprout,red enchilada sauce
title: Pumpkin Cheese Stuffed Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 3 cups shredded cooked rotisserie-cooked pumpkin ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped salami | 1/3 cup diced american cheese with almonds | 1/3 cup canned crushed beans with hot red enchilada sauce | 8 large round or square scalloped flatbreads ( about 1.8-inch-thick ) | 1 jar red enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup shredded icing sugar
instructions: Combine flour and rotisserie in a large bowl. Stir in pumpkin, icing sugar, salami, and american cheese. Spoon 3 tablespoons pumpkin mixture down center of each tortilla.

title: Homemade Applesauce Nests
ingredients: cooking spray | 6 tablespoons applesauce | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, sifted | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream or 1/2 cup kahlua
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine applesauce and flour and stir well. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface with a rolling pin and divide dough into 16 equal portions. Roll each portion to a 7 inch circle. Carefully place one circle, 1/3 cup at a time, onto a nonstick cookie sheet about 2 inches from the sprayer. Using a spatula spread applesauce mixture evenly onto the circle. Top each nugget with kahlua. Use a fork to press mixture into the nugget.

title: Nigella's Coconut Flavoured Milk
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 2 cardamom seeds
instructions: Mix well. If its too thick, add milk and leave to ferment in the fridge for a few hours or until you like desired texture. Use coconut as you would a paste.

title: Mexican Cabbage
ingredients: 4 medium savoy cabbage | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon
instructions: Core the cabbage, trim any outer leaves and trim off the thick stalk. Slice the cabbage crosswise into 1/4 inch slices and drain well. Mix the cabbage, tomatoes, triple sec and tarragon in a large slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours until very tender.

title: Greek Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 4 cups sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 cup pitted chopped kalamata olives | 1 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Combine mushrooms, olives, and vinegar.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,lemon juice zest,chicken broth,date,watermelon,butter,green onion,white flour
title: Spicy Thai Watermelon Wedges
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( zest of one lemon ) | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon chopped green onion, including tops | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 cup fresh dates, pitted and diced and set aside | 1/2 cup chopped seedless watermelon | 1 tablespoon white flour | 4 teaspoons butter
instructions: Mix lemon juice and sifted curry paste and set aside. Whisk broth and dates in a medium bowl and season with lemon juice mixture. Stir into bowl with lemon juice mixture. Chill until desired serve with wedges. Melt butter in a 12 skillet. Add watermelon and saute until tender crisp, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with flour and toss to coat. Place wedges on plates and sprinkle with reserved sauce.

title: Asparagi Aribani
ingredients: 1 kg asparagus | 4 large ripe tomatoes | 100 g bamboo shoots | 1/2 liter mango juice | 4 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 4 tablespoons kalamata olives, pitted | 1 1/2 liters tomato soup
instructions: For the asparagrette, cut the asparagus in half crossways and cut into 3cm lengths. Slice the tomatoes and bamboo shoots. For the tomato soup, remove the thick stalks from the tomatoes and bamboo, and cut into chunks. Mix together the mango, rice flour and 3 tbsp water in a large bowl. Gradually add the cornflour mix into the tomato mixture. Add the kalamata olives and mix well. The asparagus will shrink if cooked too long, so keep an eye on it to make sure you don't overcook it and stir. Pour the asparagus and tomato soup into a large serving dish. Top with the mango dressing. Garnish with an asparagrette leaf.

title: Apricot and Corn Toss
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1/2 cup dried apricots, coarsely chopped | 1 cup frozen corn kernels | 2 lbs red potatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°f. In a large, ovenproof bowl toss the garlic with the apricots and corn. Remove the bowl from the oven. Add the potatoes and toss to coat them with the prepared dressing. Sprinkle with salt. Cover the bowl with foil. Bake, stirring once or twice, for 1 hour or until the potatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,beef stew meat,chicken bouillon cube
title: Easy Slow Cooker Sweet and Sour Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2 inch | 1 lb frozen sour cream or 1 lb sour cream
instructions: Spray large cooking dish with cooking spray and scatter brown sugar evenly over the bottom. Dissolve the chicken bouillon in the sour cream or place in a bowl and mix in the meat. Cover and cook on low 8 - 10 hours. Serve over egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,red bell pepper,pork shoulder roast,kraft mexican cheese,mirin
title: Cheese Roast Pork (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork shoulder roast | 1/2 cup kraft mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup kavita mirin | 1/2 cup red bell peppers, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons anchovy paste, paste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Pierce the roast several times with a sharp knife. In a small bowl mash together the cheese, mirin, and pepper until well combined. Coat the roast with cheese mixture.

title: Smoked Salmon(Dried Salmon)
ingredients: 1 -2 lb fresh smoked salmon | 2 ounces ground turmeric powder
instructions: Wash the fresh salmon and pat dry thoroughly. Use 1/8 inch of water per pound of fish. Sprinkle turmeric powder on both sides of the fish. Close the pan tightly and let the fish steam in the juices for 3 - 4 hours. Dry the fish and serve the fish on a flat bed of rice. Use this to marinate your favourite salad.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,rosemary,beef rib,quinoa,kosher salt,shrimp paste,sauce,rice vinegar
title: Lomo Saltado (Persian Shrimp Rice Vinegar Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp paste | kosher salt | 2 cups quinoa | 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 3/4 lbs beef short ribs, chopped into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon shaoxing wine or 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | thyme, to garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, mix shrimp paste with 2 teaspoons water and 1 teaspoon salt and set aside. Spread remaining 2 teaspoons oil over quinoa. Soak for 5 minutes until it begins to wilt. Meanwhile, drain quinoa and rinse under running water. Rinse under running water until water runs clear and repeat 2 - 3 times when necessary. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over high heat until smoking. Add ribs and shrimp paste mixture and stir fry until shrimp paste turns opaque and shrimp paste mixture changes color. Combine quinoa with reserved shrimp mixture in the wok and add wine or hot sauce and mix well until most of the liquid remains. Cook just until the sauce thickens slightly. Place quinoa on a plate and stir through the shrimp paste mixture and divide among four serving plates. Garnish with thyme.

title: Thai Basil Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons basil leaves | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 leaves lettuce
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan on a medium to high flame. Add chili and stir for a minute. Add the leaf and stir till it turns into a flower. Add basil leaves and stir again. Add the prepared chili sauce to it. Mix well and serve garnished with coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate frosting,cardamom pod,black bean,beef tenderloin,salad green,white vinegar
title: Guatemalan Black Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans, picked over to remove rocks | 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed | salad greens | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate frosting | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pod ( ground )
instructions: Place beans in large pot with water, bring to boil and simmer 3 minutes. Drain, cover with cold water and allow to sit at room temperature 1 hour, or overnight. Cut beef on med. Thick diagonal slices about 1/2 inch thick. Combine rest of ingredients, set aside. Toss beef with 1 t. Yogurt and 1 t. Dress dressing. Arrange on plate and top with bean mixture. Garnish with additional fruit if desired.

title: Mashed Potatoes With Mustard Seeds #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package five cheese herb potato sticks | 6 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds
instructions: Put potatoes in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat and immediately reduce heat to medium low. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes or until done. While the potatoes are cooking, mix mustard seeds in a small skillet. Sprinkle on mustard seeds according to package directions. When they are near done, drain the potatoes and mash with a potato masher or a fork. You can add a bit of water to thin if necessary. Serve.

title: Pasta, Cocoa, and Eggs (Covered in Vegan Confiture)
ingredients: 600 g macaroni, cooked according to package instructions | 4 eggs | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder ( or more according to your taste )
instructions: Combine all 4 ingredients. Pour into a greased 8 square pan. Cook at 170c for 25 - 30 minutes. Remove and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: head green cabbage,green enchilada sauce,pumpkin,coconut milk,red kidney bean,veal,hemp seed
title: Green and Red Cabbage Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 1/1 pounds ground veal | 2 teaspoons dehydrated hemp seeds | 1 package frozen mixed pumpkin, thawed and drained | 1 head green cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 can small white or red enchilada sauce | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place ground veal and hemp seeds in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook, stirring to crumble, until evenly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Set aside to cool completely. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the green cabbage, kidney beans, and enchilada sauce. Cover, remove from heat, and allow to steam 5 minutes or until cabbage is limp but not mushy. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Heat coconut milk in a skillet over medium heat until just barely heated. Place a pastry towel over a bowl to keep moist. Roll handfuls of the cooked ground veal mixture into ball shape enchiladas, then roll into flour tortillas. Lay in a single layer over the tortillas. Spoon some of the hot coconut milk mixture into the center of a tortilla. Roll the tortilla tightly from the center out, and place tortillas on a baking sheet. Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling. Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Bake enchiladas in the preheated oven 5 minutes, or until heated through. Remove from oven and allow to cool 10 minutes. Remove toothpicks and slice into serving sized pieces.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,wheat pastry flour,salsa,white balsamic vinegar,pork loin,marshmallow,peppercorn,wheat flour tortilla
title: Pork Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup salsa | 1/2 cup white balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons cooking wine | 1 teaspoon peppercorn, crushed | 1 lb boneless pork loin | 2 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 1 tablespoon whole wheat pastry flour | 6 medium marshmallows | 12 small wheat pastry flour tortillas
instructions: Combine salsa, vinegar, cooking wine and crushed peppercorns in a non metallic bowl and set aside. Cut pork into thin slices and place in a ziplock bag and marinate overnight to absorb flavors. Meanwhile, combine 1 tbs of the flour with the remaining flour in a bowl along with the liquid from the marinated pork. Reserve the liquid and mix well to make a sticky paste. Add 1 tbs of the reserved salsa liquid and the pork mixture to the flour and flour and gently toss to combine, ensuring a moist mixture covers the pork. Heat grill or a lightly oiled griddle pan/skillet and pan fry the tortillas on both sides for about 1 minute on each side or until golden brown. Place a large spoonful of the pork mixture onto one half of the tortilla and top with one half of the marshmallows and roll up the tortilla. Repeat process for the remaining tortillas and pork mixture. Place the quesadillas on a flat serving plate and serve immediately with salsa.

title: Red Curry Chilies and Chillies(Maja)
ingredients: 1 red curry paste | 120 g whole dried red chilies, deseeded and roughly chopped
instructions: Heat 2 - 3 tablespoons of oil in a thick bottomed pan until quite hot, just barely smoking. Toss in the chillies and cook for about 1 minute shaking the pan continuously to avoid burning. Remove chillies and drain on kitchen paper. If planning ahead, re heat the oil in the pan and add the chillies. Add the curry paste and bring to a boil. Cook gently for 5 minutes. The curry should simmer and thicken very slightly as the chillies cook. Serve over white rice.

Random Ingredients: white sugar,red chili powder,green bell pepper,chili paste garlic,graham cracker,spring green,tabasco sauce
title: Green Bell Pepper Sushi
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, seeds removed, cut in bite-size pieces | 1 spring green, cut in bite-size pieces, washed thoroughly | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 2 teaspoons chili paste with garlic | 3 drops tabasco sauce or 3 drops your favourite hot sauce | 2 pinches salt ( to taste ) | 1 graham cracker, crushed ( for dipping )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crackers, filling, and salt in a deep skillet. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool slightly. Shape mixture into 2 - 3 balls or 3 smaller balls. Place onto a parchment lined sheet or piece of waxed paper. Slightly flatten the balls with a rolling pin. Use the edge of a glass to press down on the balls. Repeat with remaining balls/pices until mixture is used. Let cool completely.. Serve with dipping sauces or with chunky sashimi toasts.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,almond,cilantro,corn tortilla chip,marjoram,chicken bouillon cube,beef stew meat
title: Beef  (Or Turkey)  With Mushrooms in Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup low-fat sour cream ( or may use low fat sour cream ) | 1 canned beef stew meat | 1 1/2 cups frozen cremini mushrooms, partially thawed | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram ( or 1 tbsp fresh marjoram ) or 1 tablespoon oregano leaves | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup blanched almond, chopped | 1 corn tortilla chips
instructions: Soak the bag of tortilla chips in water for about 15 minutes, then squeeze out water. Dry roast the sliced mushrooms in the oven while preheating to 375f or until soft. In a bowl, whisk sour cream with the beef, mushrooms, marjoram, bouillon cubes, cilantro and almonds. When the beef is almost cooked, place about 1/4 cup chips on the bottom of a deep platter. Spoon beef mixture into the tortilla chips and top with remaining chips, pressing the chips into beef. Note, you may add more chips and/or some marjoram if desired.

title: Quick and Easy Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 medium tomatoes | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon catsup ( use a good one ) | 1 dash nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f. Wash and core tomatoes. Cut a slit in half and carefully remove the pith from them. Place in a large bowl. Sprinkle the rest of the chinese five spice over them then mix well. Dot with a little pats of butter. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until tomatoes are soft and a little charred.

Random Ingredients: tahini,chorizo sausage,picante sauce,spanish onion,graham cracker crumb,steak,green pepper
title: Easy Chorizo Steak
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs round steaks or 2 -3 lbs skirt steaks | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs spanish onions, strips | 1/2 - 3 large green pepper, strips | 1 package chorizo sausage, sliced thin | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 5 cups graham cracker crumbs ( you can also use crushed crackers and omit this recipe, use a larger amount of cracker crumbs ) | 1 1/2 cups tahini
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 325 degrees. Line a cookie sheet with foil or spray with non stick cooking oil. In a shallow casserole dish, place beef, chorizo sausages and onion strips, adding peppers and picante sauce on top. In a medium bowl, mix together and sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs. Sprinkle crumb topping topping on the top of the meat on the casserole dish. Bake for about an hour, or until meat reaches desired doneness. Serve alone or with tortillas, or as an entrée on a platter. Serve topped with sliced green onions and/or salsa if desired. Enjoy.

title: Venison Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese | 1 package sliced chicken tenders | 1 pound thinly sliced venison | paprika to taste | 6 toasted bread slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, soften cream cheese at room temperature. Stir in the chicken tenders. Sprinkle with paprika to taste. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly into an 8x8 inch baking dish. Top with venison slices. Pour remaining cream cheese mixture over venison slices, and cover dish with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until center is set, about 30 minutes. Cut into thick pieces with a serrated knife, and transfer to a serving dish. Serve with toasted bread slices.

Random Ingredients: savoy cabbage,ha avocadoes,french bean,corn oil,shell pasta,ice,chicken meat
title: Avocado and Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 lb chicken meat | 3 tablespoons ice, divided | 1/2 head savoy cabbage, chopped | 2 hass avocadoes, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon corn oil | 12 ounces shell pasta ( bowtie or farfalline ) | freshly cooked french beans ( to garnish )
instructions: Place chicken in a pot with just enough water to cover it. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup broth. Set chicken aside. In a food processor, pulse cabbage, avocados, corn oil and 1/4 cup broth until very finely choppe. Set aside remaining broth. Remove and discard core and seeds from cabbage. Cut cabbage into 1 inch wide strips. Stir fry meat and vegetables in remaining broth for 5 minutes. Stir in reserved cabbage.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,farfalle pasta,salad oil,chuck roast,sage leaf,purple onion,cointreau liqueur,beef loin steak
title: Beef Steak Stir Fry (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 2 )
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chuck roast or 2 lbs top sirloin steaks | 2 tablespoons salad oil ( or extra virgin olive oil ) | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 8 large sage leaves ( or other herb of your choice ) | 500 g farfalle pasta | 1 red capsicum ( bell pepper or other fresh chile ) | 1 large purple onion ( or other fresh vegetable of your choice ) | 150 g smoked paprika pickled mushrooms ( or other smoked mushrooms of choice )
instructions: Trim fat from meat.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,taco seasoning,breadcrumb,balsamic vinegar,iceberg lettuce,oat,vegetable oil cooking spray,garlic
title: Taco Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic | 1 bottle taco seasoning | 1 package white vinegar | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 cups rolled oats | oil or vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons crushed garlic | 1 loaf crusty breadcrumbs
instructions: Trim the top and bottom of the lettuce. Cut off large leaves and core, then cut into large pieces. Coat lettuce with taco seasoning and place in a large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Lay the lettuce wraps onto an oiled cutting board. Cover with plastic wrap, then a towel. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Take a portion of the mixture and roll into a 4 cylinder shape. Wrap in plastic wrap, making sure the wrap is tightly closed. Secure the wraps with toothpicks. Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray oiled, heavy bottomed oven proof serving dish with cooking spray. Place filled wraps in the dish seam side down. Brush top surface of wraps with balsamic vinegar. Cover the tops and bottoms of wraps with bread crumbs. Bake for 25 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: corn,chinese cabbage,lard,orange liqueur,white cornmeal,cream mushroom soup,tomatillo,self rising flour
title: Corn and Chile Grilled Tomatillo Rolls
ingredients: 3 cups chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can white cornmeal | 2 cups self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons orange liqueur ( optional ) | 1 lb lard, room temperature | 1 can tomatillos, drained and chopped | 1 can cut corn, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°. Mix the cabbage, soup, cornmeal, flour, and orange liqueur in a large bowl. Cut in the lard with a pastry blender until the mixture resembles cornmeal. Mix in the tomatillos and chopped corn. Transfer to a 9x13 baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and brush the top of the rolls with the lard or margarine. Place the bread back into the oven and bake the other side. Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes, then cut the roll into about 1/2 inch strips. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Dees Red Cabbage & Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 100 ml safflower oil | 25 g bulgur, washed | 75 g camembert cheese, thinly sliced | 20 g red cabbage, shredded | 20 meat, chicken legs, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Heat the safflower oil in an ovenproof dish, adding the bulgur in small batches. Pour into a single layer. Sprinkle the cheese over the bulgur, then top with the cabbages. Bake, uncovered, in the oven for 45 - 50 mins until cheese and bulgur are tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,peanut oil,zucchini,portabella mushroom cap,white bean,yellow food coloring,harissa
title: Puerto Rican Vegetarian Feijoada
ingredients: 3/4 lb zucchini, thinly sliced | 3/4 lb yellow food coloring ( yellow orange food coloring would work too ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons harissa | 2 portabella mushroom caps, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 can white beans
instructions: Heat a wok over medium heat. Add the peanut oil. When the oil is hot, add the harissa paste. Add the mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,asparagus spear,peanut,emeril,baking soda,purpose flour,mexican cheese,red curry paste
title: Spicy Mexican Herb Snack
ingredients: 4 cups all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted peanuts | 1 package shredded mexican-style cheese blend | 1 teaspoon emeril's original essence | 1/2 cup red curry paste | 1 lb fresh asparagus spear, trimmed | 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved if large
instructions: Prepare cereal according to package directions. Heat oven to 400°f. In bowl of an electric mixer, mix flour, baking soda, cilantro, cheese, essence and curry paste until just combined. Stir in asparagus and tomatoes. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead quickly until smooth. Shape into a ball and place on cookie sheets. Bake 7 - 9 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Barley-Garlicky Barley Dip
ingredients: 1 bag frozen pearl barley | 6 ounces extra-virgin olive ( drained weight- about 6 med-large olives ) | 3/4 cup nonfat sour cream ( regular, plain or vanilla ) | 1 dash hot sauce | 1 dash salt | 1 dash all purpose greek seasoning | 2 tablespoons kosher salt
instructions: Place barley in a microwave safe bowl, then add enough water to yield 2 cups, then microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes. Drain the barley in a colander and set aside. In a food processor, pulse 4 ounces olives in 2 batches until finely chopped. Add olives, sour cream, hot sauce, salt, greek seasoning or all purpose Greek seasoning, and 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt to barley mixture. Process until smooth, about 2 minutes. Transfer the barley and 1/2 cup water to bowl with the barley and sour cream mixture and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for several hours before serving. Scoop the dip into small serving bowls, garnish with additional finely chopped olives if desired and serve with corn tortillas.

title: John's Sausage and Lemon Sausages
ingredients: 8 pounds italian sausage | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 12 ounces roasted chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup chopped spanish onion | 6 ounces grated fennel | 1/2 cup dried bread crumbs | 1/2 cup lemon juice
instructions: In a medium size skillet, brown the sausage until brown on all sides. Remove sausage from skillet and drain drippings from skillet. Place sausage, green chilies, walnuts, onion, fennel, bread crumbs, and lemon juice in a large resealable plastic bag. Shake mixture to mix thoroughly, removing any food residue. Chill in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Stir Fry Beef With Onions and Spanish Onion
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef ( i've used other cuts of beef with good results ) | 4 cups vegetables ( fresh, frozen, peeled, chopped, etc ) | 1 large spanish onion, peeled and thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons rice wine or 4 tablespoons sake | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Trim as many fat off of the meat as possible. Slice meat into thin strips about 3/4 or so long. Slice onion into thin strips about 1/4 or so long. Combine rice wine, salt and remaining ingredients and toss well to mix everything together. Add onions. Place meat into crock pot and cook on high for 4 - 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: shallot,chili seasoning,green cardamom pod,almond,green onion,kaffir lime leaf
title: Sri Lankan Style Almonds (Muhalaya) - Raw Food
ingredients: 1/2 cup almonds, unsalted, ground | 4 green onions, cleaned, trimmed with white parts only, chopped very fine | 1 shallot, chopped large | 1 teaspoon chili seasoning, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, or more to taste | kaffir lime leaf, cut into thin slivers
instructions: Place almonds on a baking sheet and toast in the oven over medium low heat until fragrant and golden brown, about 9 minutes. Watch carefully to avoid burning. Watch closely after 10 seconds, and repeat until toasted. Let cool and store in an airtight container. To make the filling, place almonds, green onions, shallot, chili seasoning, cardamom, and lime leaf in a food processor. Pulse until finely chopped. Place almond mixture in a bowl and mix with a fork or whisk. Store in refrigerator.

title: Shahi Tukray
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, peeled | 1/2 cup ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns
instructions: In a mortar, pound the garlic with peppercorns until finely chopped. Heat the ghee in a saucepan over medium low heat. Stir in the garlic.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,white onion,superfine sugar,citrus peel,ice water,saffron,wheat flour
title: Persian Love Knots (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 2 gallons unsalted ice water | 1 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 cup white onion, minced | 2 1/4 lbs thickly sliced strawberries | 6 slices plump citrus peel, pith and root ends chopped into 1-inch pieces or | 1 pinch saffron | 1 teaspoon coarsely crushed kosher salt
instructions: Place all ingredients into your bread machine in order and select knead or basic or white bread dough cycle, 12 to 15 minutes. After cycle is complete let bread rest on a cutting board for 20 minutes. Cut dough with lightly floured and floured knife into 16 - 16 pieces. Form each piece into a circle approximately 1/2 in diameter.

title: Mango, Crab or Melon Lasagna
ingredients: 12 -16 lasagna noodles, cooked, drained | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mango, chopped | chopped pimiento, and | jalapeno pepper flakes, to taste | 1 teaspoon mustard, your taste | chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup bulgar wheat, soaked for about an hour ( black rice )
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Sprinkle with jalapeño, basil and or cilantro to taste. Cook on a medium to warm oven for about 20 minutes and serve hot. Note, when you add bulgur, you may also substitute any type of rice that you would like to add to this, like long grain or penne or rotelle.

title: Chipotle Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 dried guajillo chilies, stemmed | 4 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives
instructions: Place chiles in a medium bowl, and cover with water. Let stand 20 minutes. Drain, and chop. Add chile mixture to the bowl with oregano, and stir to combine. Add chives and stir to mix.

title: Cannellini Bean and Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 cups cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 lb white potato, peeled and diced | 1 large fennel bulb, trimmed and cleaned | 1 cup red wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Refrigerate several hours.

title: Blueberry Mustard Sandwich (Sushi)
ingredients: 1 sponge cake, cut lengthwise into 6 slices, about 1-inch high | 3 tablespoons mirin | 1 ounce fresh blueberries | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Soak the sliced cake in cold water for 5 minutes then drain off the water. Slice the cake into 1/8 inch thick slices about the width of the french bread slices, making sure to cover the whole surface, if necessary. Place the slices on a large plate or tray, and lightly sprinkle one side with salt. Dividing the mustard between 2 plates, top and bottom with 1 tablespoon of mirin. Place the blueberries on top of the mustard, and top the mustard side with remaining mustard. Finally, drizzle with oil and vinegar. Serve cool, or room temperature, on the side.

title: Pickled Black-Eyed Peas (Bharoora
ingredients: 2 cups canned black-eyed peas, drained | 2 cups ice water, or as needed
instructions: Stir black eyed peas and ice water together in a large bowl. Cover the bowl with a plate or lid, and set aside overnight to soak. The next day, add more ice water if consistency is too thick.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,marsala wine,mexican cheese,oat bran,curry,tuna
title: Tuna & Cheese Muffins
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained | 3/4 cup old-fashioned oats ( not quick cooking ) | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly, divided | 1 tablespoon marsala wine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly or 1 tablespoon pink currant jelly, divided | 1/2 cup shredded low-fat mexican cheese blend ( reduced fat for a lighter dish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Combine the tuna, 3/4 cup of the old fashioned oats, 1 tablespoon of the redcurrant jelly and the marsala in a bowl. Spoon into 12 lightly greased 12 mini muffin cups. Scatter evenly with the remaining cheese. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: banana,dijon mustard,cheddar cheese,chili oil,meatball,flat leaf parsley
title: Nana Meatballs (Low Fat)
ingredients: 800 g prepared meatballs ( i like bon appetit, bangers in a tin would work ) | 1/2 cup reduced-fat cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 4 bananas ( ripe small firm bananas ) | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley | 2 -3 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/4 cup sweet chili oil
instructions: Dip the meatballs in the sweet chilli oil and coat well with the Dijon. Brown the coated meatballs on a heavy baking tray. Peel and slice the bananas and place in a medium sized dish. Pour over plenty of cold water to just cover the bananas and gently toss to combine. Top with the meatballs and cover and put in the fridge for at least three hours or overnight to marinate.

title: Mushroom Cavolfi
ingredients: 2 lbs portabella mushrooms | 20 plum tomatoes, blanched | 25 g grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Clean the mushrooms, slice the caps very thinly and place in a bowl. Add salt, to taste.. Add the plum tomatoes, sprinkle with black pepper and freshly grated cheese. Mix well. Cover in a plastic container with a tight fitting lid. Chill in the refrigerator for at least two hours the longer it sits, the more flavorful it will be.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,ladyfinger,cauliflower,sun tomato oil,chili garlic sauce,bay leaf,oyster sauce
title: Sweet & Spicy Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 can pimientos, chopped | 1 jar garlic sauce ( kikkoman garlic and chili garlic sauces ) | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento | 1/3 cup chili-garlic sauce | 1 bay leaf | 2 -3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Wash cauliflower well & steam for 5 minutes in boiling water. Drain & set aside. Add all other ingredients & mix well, except for oyster sauce, to cauliflower. Add oyster sauce & mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 8 cups mixed fresh vegetables | 1 cup rice or 1 cup wild rice | 2 1/2 cups broccoli florets
instructions: In the bowl of your food processor, add the rice, broccoli, and rotel potatoes. Blend until they are chopped but not very smooth. If desired, add other vegetables. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,ladyfinger,tomato juice,tomato puree,lemon juice zest,red chile powder
title: Red Sauce in Your Face
ingredients: 12 ounces tomato puree | 3 ounces fresh tomato juice | 1 -4 red chile powder | 14 ounces dark soy sauce | 2 lemons, juice and zest of, grated
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill in the fridge for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: greek feta cheese,vanilla essence,chili oil,extra large egg
title: Kurdish Cheesecake
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra-large egg | 1/4 cup greek feta cheese | 1/4 cup chili oil ( peri-peri or vh oil ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Put the beaten egg in an oven dish with the feta cheese, oil, vanilla essence and chilli oil. Scatter on the crumbled feta cheese and bake in a 180 c c oven until golden brown.

title: Grilled Pecan Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup pecans | 1/3 cup bourbon | 3/4 cup white distilled vinegar | 3 tablespoons dried italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat grill to high. In a small bowl, mix together chopped pecans, bourbon, and 2 tablespoons white vinegar. Spread each piece of bread onto an ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle with italian flavored seasoning. Grill toasted bread until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: corn,bay leaf,double cream,chicken bouillon granule,penne pasta,ginger paste
title: Penne With Chicken, Corn and Garlic
ingredients: 500 g penne pasta | 400 g corn, shucked | 2 bay leaves | 3 g ginger paste | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 150 ml double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Cook the pasta in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water until al dente. Drain well and leave to side. Meanwhile, peel the ginger, then cut the ginger into long thin slices. Put the corn in a frying pan and fry it until it is lightly coloured and crispy. Remove from the heat. Drain the pasta. Put the corn, bay leaves and ginger into a large frying pan. Put the chicken bouillon and cream in a small pan. Bring to the boil, then add the contents of the frying pan. Put everything into a large roasting tin. Put the oven on and bake the sauce for 15 minutes, or until golden. Add the cooked pasta to the tin and stir well before allowing it to bubble up. Cook for a further 4 - 5 minutes, or until the pasta is cooked. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: seafood seasoning,cream tartar,scallion,potato,yellow mustard,flat leaf parsley,coffee powder
title: Steamed Taters With Mustard Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and quartered ( about 10 ounces ) | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant coffee powder | 1/8 teaspoon coarse salt-free yellow mustard | 1/4 teaspoon seafood seasoning | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 2 scallions, finely chopped
instructions: Mash potatoes with cream of tartar, instant coffee powder, salt free mustard, seafood seasoning, and parsley until well combined. Spoon into a lightly oiled 12 cup pot. Cover, bring to a boil, recover, and steam over very low heat until potatoes are tender and tender, 18 to 20 minutes. Serve with scallions.

Random Ingredients: mexican seasoning mix ii,clove,salmon fillet,yukon gold potato,kaffir lime leaf
title: BBQ Fish with Potato and Kaffir Lime
ingredients: 1 2/3 lbs salmon fillets ( skin removed with 1/4 inch thick centre cut on one side and 1/4 inch thick in the other ) or 1 2/3 lbs bass fillets ( skin removed with 1/4 inch thick centre cut on one side and 1/4 inch thick on one side ) | 1 tablespoon mexican seasoning mix or 2 teaspoons dried mexican seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 large yukon gold potato, scrubbed ( about 2/3 pound ) | 4 small kaffir lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place fillets in a 5 to 6 quart dutch oven or other heavy pot. Combine the mexican seasoning mix with the cashews, cloves, zest and 1/2 teaspoon water. Place the potato in the center. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Spread evenly over the fish fillets. Place the fish with the fish in the pot, skin sides up. Cover the pot and shake the pot to blend the flavors. Cover the pot and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork or fork. Arrange the fish and potato on a platter, cut into thick, crosshatch slices. Spoon any remaining liquid from the pot over the fish and potatoes. Garnish with lemon slices, if desired. Serve with boiled rice.

title: Pomodori Salata
ingredients: 3 cups sweet onions, chopped | 1 cup capers | 1 cup grand marnier
instructions: Over medium high heat slowly cook onions and capers in the grand marnier just until the onions are starting to caramelize. Remove from heat and stir in the marnier. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,sunflower oil,onion powder,green bell pepper,cream,mexican cheese,fast rising yeast
title: Baked Swiss Strawberries
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 lb mexican cheese or 1/4 lb monterey jack cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/4 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1 package fast rising yeast | 3 cups fresh strawberries, sliced or 3 cups frozen strawberries, thawed, divided
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, sprinkle oil over the onion powder and half of the cheese. Stir in sour cream and remaining cheese. Stir in remaining ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and stir until blended. Dough will be sticky and difficult to work with. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease baking sheet, cover and let rise to 1 1/4 hours or until puffy. Turn out onto a heavily floured surface. Knead until dough is smooth, about 5 minutes.. Shape dough into a 10 inch circle or rectangle. Cut into wedges. Place wedges, cut side down, on prepared baking sheet. Cover and let rise until 1/2 inch from the top, about 40 minutes. Brush with 1 tablespoon melted butter. Bake for 13 - 15 minutes, or until browned.

title: Nif's Farfalle
ingredients: 12 ounces farfalle pasta ( bow tie pasta ) | 1 can refried beans | 1/4 cup pesto sauce, can use homemade | 2 tablespoons golden rum | 1 teaspoon chili, garlic and onion blend | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 8 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat refried beans in a microwave oven on high for 1 1/4 minutes until warm. Combine pesto sauce with rum, chili, fennel seed, and garlic in a saucepan, stir and remove from heat. Drain pasta and stir into the sauce. Toss until well coated with the pesto mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Beets in Brazil
ingredients: 4 tablespoons beets root juice, from beetroot | 50 g brazil nuts, or to taste
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat.

title: Mexican Coffee
ingredients: 2 cups strong coffee ( room temperature, like irish coffee ) | 1 serrano pepper ( seeded and finely chopped ) | 4 cups chopped romaine lettuce | cooked rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Serve with crisp lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: potato,whipping cream,poblano chile,orange juice zest,plum tomato,olive oil
title: Poblano Chiles in Orange Cream
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 1/2 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 12 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice, zest of
instructions: Roast poblano chilies, skin on, on a grill, or under the broiler until blackened, turning occasionally. Place in a plastic bag, seal and allow to sweat for 15 minutes. Peel and chop, set aside. Cook tomatoes in oil until softened. Chop chilies in a food processor or blender until about 2/3 of the chilies are finely chopped. Add tomato mixture and 1/4 cup cream, pulse until blended in. Add in orange juice and zest. Process again to get a smooth puree. Season with salt and pepper for texture and color. Spoon chilies into poblano chillies. Let set at least 30 minutes, or up to 8 hours.

title: Gkai Ki Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 bunches green tomatoes | 5 tablespoons green cardamoms, crushed with a mortar and pestle ( available in indian grocery stores ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 5 tablespoons fresh clams, boiled and cleaned
instructions: Bring water to boil in pan. While water is heating, cut tomatoes into 3/4 inch thick slices. Pour warm water over green tomatoes. Add crushed cardamoms and salt.

title: Potatos With a Crust
ingredients: 3 ounces carrots and 2 ounces potatoes starch | 3 ounces almonds, blanched | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 1/3 cups arborio rice | 1 cup potato starch
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together and form a roll about 6 inches long at the top of the pan. Arrange on top, ensuring they hang freely. Bring the water to the boil in a pan, add the potato starch and cook for 1 minute, stirring. Place the pan on a large baking sheet and pour the contents of the pan over them. Bake at 375°f until golden and crunchy.

title: California Fritters
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes, ripe and slightly soft | 4 slices american cheese | 2 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste, chopped
instructions: Peel and pit avocados, discard pits and finely mash in a bowl. Mix in cheese, bacon and anchovy paste. Roll mixture into small balls.

Random Ingredients: white bread,cream tartar,sun tomato oil,yoghurt,celery rib,jelly bean,cherry tomato,pasilla chile
title: Faux Toast
ingredients: 4 ounces white bread, cubed fine | 1 tablespoon dried sweet pasilla chile | 1 tablespoon jelly beans, jelly crystals | 5 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 4 tablespoons creamy yoghurt | 1 celery rib, diced | 4 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies, chopped | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a mixing bowl, coarsely mash the dried pasilla peppers with the dried chili powder. Add the sun dried tomatoes, chopped celery, yoghurt, cream of tartar, and finely diced tomato. Mix all ingredients with the bread cubes and transfer to a baking dish. Bake in the center of the oven for 25 - 30 minutes, until the bread has absorbed the moisture.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,wheat flour,fine salt,egg noodle,mexican cheese
title: Homestyle Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 1 cup fine salt | 1/3 cup wheat flour | 1 cup mexican cheese | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Boil a large pot of water and add in noodles. Cook until noodles are just tender and drain. Add all other ingredients and let them cool slightly. Refrigerate.

title: Couscous Salad from Casa Marcela
ingredients: 1/4 cup pine nuts ( dry, unsalted, dry roasted ) | 1/4 cup chicken broth ( preferably home-made )
instructions: Place the pine nuts in a large, heatproof bowl. Pour the boiling chicken broth over the pine nuts and nuts, mixing to coat. Let sit at room temperature until the pine nuts have softened, 20 - 30 minutes. Drain any extra broth. Toss with the salad, taste and add more broth. Add more cinnamon and sugar if needed, and serve.

title: Korean Linguine With Noodles
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1/3 cup sesame seeds | 2 -4 tablespoons sweet pickled hot chili peppers ( optional ) | 2 -4 jalapenos, seeded and sliced ( optional ) or 2 -4 serrano peppers, seeded and sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook linguine until just tender yet firm. Place pasta in a large serving bowl, add sweet pickled chilies, sliced jalapenos and sesame seeds and toss. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for another use.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow cream,linguine,sage leaf,bamboo shoot,shortening,pepper sauce,graham cracker crumb
title: Jello
ingredients: 1 package of reese's mini blend rice crumbs | 2 packages sliced bamboo shoots | 3 packages graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup shortening ( or margarine ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 jar marshmallow cream | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( optional )
instructions: Spray a nonstick fry pan with non stick cooking spray. Mix rice crumbs with half the sliced bamboo and all the other ingredients. Form into balls by gently pressing it into the rice ball. Cook until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees. Roll in marshmallow cream, sprinkling tops with remaining slices of bamboo as desired. Repeat for remaining servings. May also be served over spaghetti or rice.

title: Coconut Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds ( or substitute ground coriander, increase amount to 2 tsp ) | 4 ounces coconut, dry roasted and grated | 4 ounces fontina cheese, grated ( can use mozzarella or provolone cheese ) | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon minced fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Using a pestle and mortar, crush or chop coriander seeds, coconut and fontina until it resembles small peppercorns. Stir in cream and salt, then stir in cilantro.

title: Sweet Green Grape Jam
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh green grapes | 6 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 can chopped green chiles
instructions: Cut grapes into halves or quarters. Stab chiles with a vegetable peeler. Fill a large saucepan with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer grapes in the water 30 minutes. Drain and reserve about 1 cup syrup and set aside. Warm maple syrup in a large skillet over medium high heat. Mix in chiles. When syrup begins to boil, pour in reserved syrup. Bring to a boil once again, then reduce heat to low. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until syrup has thickened, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir grape halves into jam in the saucepan, and continue cooking 20 minutes.

title: Chile Yogurt With Radishes
ingredients: 1/4 ounce dry yeast | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/2 cups radishes, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 small red chile, seeded and sliced
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in plenty of hot, but not boiling, water. In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, radishes, red chile and the dissolved yeast. When the mixture is bubbly, transfer to a greased bowl, cover with a clean cloth and leave to rise for 30 minutes, or until the mixture has doubled in bulk. Meanwhile, put the oven on and 400 degrees f. Stretch the dough out onto a floured work surface and form it into a round loaf, approximately 10 x 3 inches. Place the loaf on an oiled baking sheet, cover and leave for 40 minutes. The loaf can also be baked on the top shelf of the oven for 10 minutes, or until the bread is light golden. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Paleo Apple Crunch - Microwave
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 1 1/4 cups apples juice | 1 cup frozen corn | 1 teaspoon hot sauce
instructions: Place the flour, apples juice, corn, salt and hot sauce in a bowl, mix well. Add the mix to a bread machine in this order, when it is ready, press the dough until it is evenly cooked and no longer sticky. Cut into squares or rectangles and serve.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,taco seasoning mix,green chile pepper,walnut,stewing beef,gingerroot,green pepper,heart palm
title: Thai Beef Burgers
ingredients: 3/4 lb stewing beef, cut into 4 equal-inch thick, 3/4-inch squares | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped gingerroot | 1/2 small green or red pepper, diced, 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 small green pepper, sliced, 1/2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup purchased taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 1/2 cups hearts of palm, cut into thirds | 3/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: In medium bowl, toss beef with ginger, green pepper and taco seasoning. Shape into 4 patties. Arrange on oiled grill rack. Grill for 10 minutes, turning once, or until well browned.

title: Lamb Shank Salad
ingredients: 1 lamb shank | 4 cups tomato-flavored soya sauce, diluted with cold water | 1/2 cup lemonade | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 8 tortillas, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Slice off the top side of the lamb shank so that it will stand up and form two large flat pieces. Cut off the bone in the center of the shank to leave about 2 inches of meat on the bone. Lay the lamb onto a dish and drizzle with half the sauce. Turn pieces over and repeat with the remaining lamb, so it has 4 lamb shanks on each side and 6 lamb pieces on each side to make four salad servings. In a medium bowl, combine enough flour to be able to coat the lamb, then coat each piece of meat with flour and shake off excess flour. Repeat with remaining lamb and marinade. Arrange the salad on a baking sheet and place in the freezer to chill. In a small bowl, combine the lemonade, soy sauce and remaining sauce and pour over salad. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Put lamb, sauce, and marinade into a large bowl and mix well. Arrange tortilla halves on top of the salad in an overlapping concentric circle. Place lamb on the tortillas and cut in small pieces. Serve on a bed of shredded lettuce.

Random Ingredients: baking chocolate,egg,meat,orange juice,granny smith apple,flat leaf parsley,italian breadcrumb
title: Christmas Meatloaf
ingredients: 200 g minced meat | 40 g granny smith apples ( or other sweet apple ) | 125 g italian breadcrumbs | 3 eggs | 80 g baking chocolate | freshly chopped flat leaf parsley | orange juice ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Crumble the breadcrumbs into a bowl, mix with minced meat, then slowly add egg. Break the chocolate into small pieces. Stir until smooth and add into meat mixture. Pour the orange juice into a baking dish and add chopped parsley and finely chopped orange peel if using. Spread the mixture in the prepared oven and return to oven for about 1 hour. Remove from oven and let cool. Slice into approximately 24 pieces and serve with fresh flat leaf parsley.

Random Ingredients: gouda cheese,egg yolk,half cream,balsamic vinegar,chunky salsa,chow mein noodle,lemon juice zest
title: Soy Creamy Cheeze
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | 1 large lemon, juice & zest of | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 2/3 cup gouda cheese ( grated ) | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa ( i use kraft singles )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a mixing bowl beat egg yolks and lemon zest until thick. Gradually add half and half and whisk until creamy. In a 9x13 inch baking dish mix together the swiss cheese and 3/4 cup of salsa in a small bowl. Stir into the egg yolks in 2 batches. Bake in oven for 25 minutes. Turn off oven. Spoon the mixture into the baking dish and return to the oven, uncovered for 10 minutes. Top with the 3/4 cup of salsa and sprinkle with the gouda. Return to the oven until the cheeses melt and a spoonful is sizzling.

title: Basic French Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Pierce saffron with knife in a small piece or 2 to 3 places. Let it steep at least an hour. When the saffron has fully rehydrated and started to fluff, mix with your favourite salad dressing or store bought salad dressing. You can even do this with any fresh fruit, especially a nice mix of berries or pears. You can serve this over salads in a bottle, if you like, or, for extra zing just drizzle over your french bread or crackers.

title: Gordita
ingredients: 1 pound ground meat | 6 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1 1/3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 1/3 cups dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix together the ground meat, 6 tablespoons of dark rum, and sesame oil in a bowl. Shape the mixture into balls the size of walnuts. Roll the balls in the flour. Bake the gordita in the preheated oven until the exterior is golden, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool. Combine soy milk, superfine sugar, and 1 1/3 cups of rum in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside until cool. Remove meatballs from the loaf pan and cut meat into small bite size pieces. Return to the pan and pour sauce over the top.

title: Mexican String Beans with Pimento and Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 lb string bean | 1 ounce dried pimento stuffed olive | 1 - 1 1/2 cup tuna water
instructions: Snap the ends off the string beans and rinse in cold water. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil and blanch the beans until they are crisp and bright green colored, a few minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and plunge into cold water to stop the cooking. Drain and pat dry. Slice the string beans lengthwise and put into a serving bowl. Break up the pimentos and add and toss well. Add 1/4 cup cold water to the spaghetti saucepan and bring to a simmer. When it begins to simmer, add the olives and mix well. Drain the beans and toss.

title: Wasabi Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 teaspoons wasabi paste | 1 fresh chipotle chile, chopped ( can use 1 tsp of adobo ) | 1 large fresh sage leaf
instructions: Stir wasabi, chile and sage together. Use to dress chicken, lamb, veg or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,salt pepper,penne pasta,blue cheese,brown sugar
title: Chile-Blue Cheese Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese | 1/2 cup diced red chile peppers ( i used 2 ) or 1/2 cup diced green chili pepper ( i used 2 ) | 3 tablespoons light brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook penne pasta until al dente. Drain. Combine blue cheese, red chili peppers, brown sugar, salt and pepper.

title: Molho de Ajo
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 1 1/3 lbs lean sirloin or 1 1/3 lbs lamb fillets | 3 large yellow peppers, cut into wide strips | 3 large poblano peppers, deveined and cut into wide strips | 4 ounces fresh parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons achiote paste
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup warm water. In a small saucepan add all other ingredients except salt, pepper, and cheese. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Simmer for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Dissolve any bacteria in the mixture. Let stand for 10 minutes. Put mixture in a food container and refrigerate at least 7 hours or overnight. Put the mixture into a bowl of a food processor, add the cheese and beat well until smooth. Spread on a warm surface and let it sit for 10 minutes. Form into marble sized balls or make small cakes. Place on an oiled baking sheet and bake at 375 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes. These may need to be turned so they brown properly. Note, be sure to bake the cakes under the broiler for about 1 - 2 minutes, until cooked through.

title: Persian Pork and Bocconcini
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 1 tablespoon crushed dried new mexico dried galangal | 8 ounces pork tenderloin, trimmed of excess fat and cut crosswise into 3/4-inch thick slices ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon ice water | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh ginger | 1 large ripe avocado, cut lengthwise into 8 wedges, pit removed, and cut crosswise into 1/8-inch-thick slices | 3/4 cup drained sliced raisins | 2 teaspoons crushed barberries or 1/2 cup chopped dried cranberries
instructions: Combine wasabi paste with salt and cold water in a small bowl. Add ginger. Stir until dissolved. Pour into a small bowl, add pork and toss to coat. Marinate for 20 minutes. Prepare ice water bath in a small deep saucepan over high heat. Add avocado, raisins, and barberries to the ice water and stir until just warmed and almost dry.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,salsa,canadian bacon,head garlic,green cardamom pod,barbecue sauce,fish sauce
title: Grilled Garlic Beef
ingredients: 1 whole head of garlic | 4 green cardamom pods | 1 inch gingerroot ( or 1 tsp grated ginger ) | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce, of your choice | 1 cup salsa ( i like medium, but spicy! ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce ( your choice! ) | 1/2 cup canadian bacon ( crumbled! )
instructions: Wash all the garlic cloves. Place in the oven on a parchment covered cookie sheet, or a baking sheet, just big enough to hold a whole head easily. Bake at 450 f for about 25 - 30 minutes. Remove garlic and chop into small pieces.

title: Easy Chicken Wings or Broke
ingredients: 1 bag chicken wings or 1 bag chicken wings | jalapeno pepper, sliced or sliced | 1 can water chestnut, sliced or chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.

title: Bailey's Irish Cherry Roll
ingredients: fresh sour cherry | ailey's irish cream
instructions: Wash and dry the cherries. Wipe the rim with a damp cloth or paper towel then using a spoon, take 2 tbsp of the sour cherry juice as a dipping mixture and roll it up into a ball. Dip rolled cherry into a bit of a bit of the remaining sour cherry juice then roll in a small ball again. Repeat so you have a dozen cocktail sticks. Serve on a plate with a small, decorative sprinkles or top with more sour cherry juice.

title: Fish Chowder
ingredients: 1 large peeled and sliced beetroot | 15 small baking potatoes | 1/4 cup diced red chili powder | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon fish or 1 tablespoon vegetable stock concentrate | 1/2 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Cut roots off beetroot and cut into 2 inch pieces. Cut into 2 inch lengths. Place in a steamer or pot fitted with a steaming basket and steam until just tender enough to pierce with a fork.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,italian seasoning,canola oil,raspberry,gruyere cheese,chicken breast half,spice
title: Cheesy-Spiced Garlic Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/4 - 1/3 cup mayonnaise ( miracle whip works great ) | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/8 teaspoon spices | 1/3 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/3 cup raspberries
instructions: Lightly grease the grill. Place chicken breasts between two pieces of waxeless paper and flatten, using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Season each breast with salt, pepper and italian seasoning. Lightly toss the chicken with your choice of cheese. Grill for 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until lightly golden on both sides.

title: Beef with Red Wine (Chokado azuki)
ingredients: 600 g steaks, 2. 5cm thick | 1/4 cup dark chinese red wine ( shao hsing ) | 1 tablespoon low-fat coffee | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/4 cup chicken stock
instructions: Cut meat into thin slices. Combine wine, sesame oil, and coffee. Pour over meat and marinade for 15 minutes at room temperature, turning meat occasionally. Place meat on an oven dish. Bake in moderately hot oven. Turn meat once and baste with the marinade. Baste every 20 to 30 minutes until meat is medium rare.

title: Crabmeat Mexicana
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat, drained | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 packet ranch dressing | 2 tablespoons prepared sweet-and-sour stuffing | 3 tablespoons chopped pistachios | 3 ounces anchovies, drained if desired | adobo dip or taco sauce, for dipping
instructions: Combine crabmeat and taco seasoning in bowl. Add seasoning packet. Mix. Spread on cookie sheet and refrigerate until ready to use. Cook stuffing in microwave or oven until browned. Dip or dip seafood and pesto ingredient into the stuffing mix. Enjoy and use as a filling for pita chips.

Random Ingredients: xanthan gum,cream mushroom soup,red curry paste,self rising flour,heavy whipping cream,chive,napa cabbage,tart apple
title: Quick and Easy Thai Sour Cream Dill Slaw
ingredients: 1 package self-rising flour | 1 cup heavy whipping cream, scalded | 1 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 cups red curry paste, divided | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 cup shredded napa cabbage | 1 cup diced tart apple | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chives
instructions: Combine flour and cream in a bowl, stirring until smooth. Add 1/3 cup of curry paste.

title: Omani-Style Won ton
ingredients: 1 can drained black-eyed peas | 1 cup finely chopped coriander | 2 egg yolks | 5 wonton skins
instructions: Place a few shavings of wonton skins on a kitchen towel, and wring out excess water.

title: Crock Pot Thai Flavored Corn on the Cob (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 ears corn, shucked | 1/2 cup onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, minced | 2 limes, cut in wedges
instructions: Arrange corn on 4 - 5 dinner plates. Combine the first seven ingredients in a small bowl. Stir together well.

Random Ingredients: yellow pepper,linguine pasta,white wine,reynolds wrap foil,garlic clove,icing sugar,cayenne,apricot
title: Chilean Risotto #RSC
ingredients: 16 ounces linguine pasta | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 3 1/2 ounces diced apricots ( drained and chopped ) | 3 tablespoons white wine | reynolds wrap foil ( approx 2 sheets ) | 2 tablespoons minced yellow peppers
instructions: Combine the icing sugar, cayenne, minced garlic, apricots, and white wine. Place the sauce into a small saucepan over medium heat, and cook for 3 minutes. Add cooked linguine and mix with sauce until coated. Place the foil on a piece of reynolds wrap and place under the broiler for 3 - 5 minutes until lightly golden. Add minced peppers and toss to coat. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rump roast,ancho chile powder,blue curacao,tomato sauce,ginger root,buttermilk
title: Chinese-style Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 pound rump roast | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger root, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons crushed ancho chile powder | 3 tomato sauce | 2 fluid ounces blue curacao
instructions: Stir the buttermilk, rump roast, ginger, 1 teaspoon ancho chile powder, and tomato sauce together in a roasting pans. Roast in the preheated oven until the roast is browned and the juices run clear, about 3 hours. Be sure to baste or shake the pan so the meat does not become crowded, even if you see some burning, as the temperature rises.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,hot red chili pepper,red baking apple,chicken bouillon powder,half cream
title: Apple Cream Dressing
ingredients: 1 package hot red hot chili peppers, such as peruvian poblano peppers | 8 ounces cream-style half-and-half cream or 8 ounces light sour cream, room temperature | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 2 tablespoons chili oil ( can be substituted ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream or 1/2 cup light cream
instructions: Cut red chilies in half lengthwise.

title: Pesto Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sun-dried tomatoes, softened | 2 packages active dry yeast ( not in original recipe ) | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 1/4 - 1/2 cup pure vanilla powder or 1/4-1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: If using dry yeast, stir the ingredients together and set aside until the yeast is foamy. Drain the tomatoes and put into a bowl. Mix in the dry yeast, peanut butter, vanilla, and salt. Stir in the peanut butter mixture until you have a loose sticky paste.

title: Currant Beef Curry
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat, such as eye round, trimmed of fat | 3 cups apricot, dried chopped | 1 cup dried cranberry juice, mixed | 1/3 cup currant | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder
instructions: Place meat in large pan. Add apricots, cranberry juice, currants and other spices. Cover and cook for 2 hours or until meat is tender. If mixture becomes too dry, add water. Serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,fillet,anchovy paste,bicarbonate soda,broccoli coleslaw mix,dark soy sauce
title: Pan Pan Fried Steak With Bicarbonate of Beef
ingredients: 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of beef soda | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 cup prepared broccoli coleslaw mix | 1 1/2 lbs steak fillets
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the bicarb of beef soda, yogurt, soy sauce and anchovy paste until well combined. Set the bicarb of beef aside. Combine the broccoli and coleslaw mix in a bowl with the marinated beef. Pour the marinade over the steaks and leave to sit for at least 20 minutes or up to 3 hours. Heat the oil in a wok or large heavy based frying pan. When the pan is hot, deep fry the steaks for 3 mins each side. Remove and drain on kitchen paper. Serve with the hot sauce.

Random Ingredients: fava bean,limeade concentrate,cayenne powder,dark soy sauce,lime juice,green pepper,green cardamom pod
title: Fool Nabeyh (Fava Bean Soup)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons cayenne powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup lime juice | 2 -3 cups fresh fava beans, picked and washed | 1/2 green pepper, seeded ( optional )
instructions: Combine limeade concentrate, soy sauce, cayenne and green cardamom in pot over medium heat. Whisk until well blended. Add fava beans to pot and cook until barely tender.
