title: Creamy Mexican Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb zesty semolina ( italian ) or 1 lb ground confectioner'cheese ( or queso de tomate ) | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 12 ounces canned red peppers in chili, pureed or 12 ounces canned canned anchovy fillets, drained | 1 1/2 cups sour cream or 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs assorted fresh hot peppers or 1 1/2-2 lbs serrano chili, stemmed, seeded if desired and cut into strips ( to make milder chili use fresno chiles ) | 1 can anchovy fillets
instructions: Place the zesty, confectioner's cheese, cream of tartar and the drained chiles in food processor. Pulse the mixture a few times until everything is in small chunks. In large bowl, stir in about half the sour cream until well incorporated. Add hot peppers. Stir in remaining sour cream. Spread in a 9 x 13 glass rectangular baking dish. Refrigerate in refrigerator for several hours. Bring to room temperature before serving. To serve, stir the anchovies into the remaining sour cream. Dot the top with the anchovy paste. Serve chilled.

title: Lebanese Olive Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2/3 cup bread flour or 4 cups store-bought whole-milk bread flour | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped kalamata olives or 2 tablespoons other oil | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped pistachios, for garnish
instructions: Stir yeast with 1/3 cup lukewarm water in a small bowl. Place flour in a large bowl and stir in sugar, vinegar and olives. Mix by hand or with dough hook of a mixer on low to medium speed or with an electric hand mixer set to medium speed. Beat for 2 minutes. Stir in dough with a spoon. Cover with several moistened plastic wrap and let rest at room temperature for 30 minutes or until doubled in bulk. Divide dough into 18 equal pieces. Roll out each piece of dough from one of them to a 12 inch long oval shape. Place the oval shaped pieces onto a sprayed or parchment lined baking sheet and let rise in a warm place for about 10 minutes, or until they are about 1/2 inch thick. Brush the tops of the bread with remaining water to glaze. Sprinkle with pistachios. Bake at 425º f until golden brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Radish and Vanilla Pudding
ingredients: 1 ounce vanilla instant pudding mix ( no pudding added ) | 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 cup fresh radish
instructions: Stir the pudding mix into the cream. Grate the radishes and add to the cream. Refrigerate until cold and serve over ice cream or fresh berries.

title: Potted Chicken
ingredients: 75 g unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon plain flour | 500 ml chicken stock
instructions: Pour the stock into a pan large enough to take the chicken out as it is. Season with salt and pepper and melt over medium/high heat. Drain the chicken pieces, reserving the stock. Return the pan to the heat and add the flour/butter mixture to the pan stirring well. Cook stirring constantly for 2 more minutes. Add the stock and stir until it comes to the boil. Boil down for 10 minutes. Return chicken to the pan, cover and put a lid on. Simmer for 20 minutes. Take the lid off and leave to stand for 10 minutes.

title: Easy Mexican Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 serrano pepper, chopped, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh garlic ( optional )
instructions: Combine taco sauce and serrano pepper in a small bowl. Stir garlic into sauce.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f place chiles skin side down in a baking dish. Combine vegetable broth and maple syrup in a small sauce pan.

title: Lefalonosalat Le Lahem (Lefalonosalata)
ingredients: 1 leek, white and light green parts only, chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1 -2 tablespoon grated fresh lemon, rind of
instructions: Prepare leek by peeling it off the root end, then cutting the root ends away about 1 1/2 inches from the top. Cut the leek root in half lengthwise and, working with 1/3 at a time, rub the outer dark green leaves off of the leek. Finely mince the leek roots, discarding and discarding those tough green parts. Mix the leek root, juice, and lemon rind with the flour and chopped green onion and stir well with a fork to combine. Cover and cook over low heat about 20 minutes, stirring frequently, until very dark brown. Spread the leefalonata on a large piece of parchment paper and place in the oven for about 15 minutes, making sure the pan does not burn. When it is very hot, remove from the oven and allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes. Remove 1/4 cup water and spread the leefalonata on a large platter. Sprinkle with more lemon rind and enjoy.

title: The Easiest Meatball in the World!
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck | 15 baby bok choy, sliced in half lengthways and blanched | 15 fluid ounces red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 3 fluid ounces light rum
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together except the bollis and place in an ovenproof dish/dish. Bake in a moderate oven for 45 minutes. Remove from the oven and pour the bollis on to plates/bowls and serve immediately or store in a warm place for up to 2 days.

title: Smoked Quinoa Crab, Rice and Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 100 g smoked quinoa | 250 g smoked crabmeat | 1 large spanish onion, diced | 1 cup dried quinoa, washed and soaked about 30 minutes | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/4 teaspoon saltine crackers or 1/4 teaspoon finely crushed dried crackers | 1/4 cup macadamia nuts, chopped
instructions: Boil water to a boil with quinoa and salt. Put quinoa in a glass bowl and microwave it on high for 2 minutes. Put quinoa into ice water and microwave for about 20 - 30 seconds or until water is clear. Drain all the water from the quinoa and place in a glass bowl. Put the smoked crab on top of the quinoa then put the onions on top and cover with the crispy quinoa. In a small bowl combine the shaoxing tahini, vanilla bean, salt and cracker crumbs. Mix well. Dressing, place pineapples, peels and macadamia nuts in a large salad bowl. Diced the smoked crab and add to salad. Sprinkle with cheese and dressing and mix well.

Random Ingredients: pork sausage,artichoke heart,pimiento,thyme leave,chicken breast,almond extract,confectioner ' sugar,hot pepper sauce
title: Spanish Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup sliced almonds, toasted | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained well | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped pimiento | 1/2 teaspoon pure dried thyme leave | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon chicken flavored hot pepper sauce
instructions: Place the chicken breasts, 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar, almonds and artichokes in a glass dish or shallow, greased baking dish that holds them snugly. Mix the remaining confectioners' sugar with the pimento, thyme leaves, hot pepper sauce and pepper sauce. Coat the chicken well and arrange in a single layer on top of the almonds. Chill for 20 minutes. Unwrap the chicken and place on a rack in a baking dish or broiler pan. Roast for 40 - 45 minutes at 400 degrees. Turn them once, roast 5 - 6 minutes longer or until nicely browned on top.

title: Beer-Poached Olives
ingredients: 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 8 ounces kalamata olives | kosher salt | 1/4 cup canola oil
instructions: Place each olive in a coffee filter and sprinkle generously with a small pinch of kosher salt. Bring up the sides and close the filter. Repeat the soaking process until all the olives have been soaked, 20 to 30 minutes. In a medium skillet over low heat, warm the canola oil on low heat. Cook the coriander seeds until the spices turn white and dark, about 5 minutes. Remove the spices from the skillet and put them in a mortar. Add the olives, a little bit at a time, to the skillet and lightly fry on medium heat, stirring constantly, for 4 minutes. The liquid should just about fill in in the pan. Remove to a serving bowl.

title: Easy Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 large head of cabbage, cored and sliced into wedges | 2 lbs beef round steak, cut in 1 inch cubes | 16 large plum tomatoes, cut in half
instructions: Heat a large wok over medium high heat. Dry beef and place on top of cabbage. Toss together the beef with the tomato halves and place on top of the cabbage. Bring stew to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and cook for 2 hours. Serve over white rice.

Random Ingredients: anise,rice wine,green pepper,sushi rice,cumin seed,black olive,macadamia nut
title: Casbah Rice
ingredients: 4 cups sushi rice ( short grain or brown works best ) | 1 1/2 cups macadamia nuts ( raw ) | 2 slices green peppers ( or a combo of colors ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon anise seed ( or 1/2-1 tsp. if you like your rice very pretty ) | 1 teaspoon cumin seed ( or 1/4 tsp. if you like your rice very pretty ) | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1/4 cup green olives ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice, macadamia nuts, green pepper, anise seed, and cumin into a rice cooker. Add the wine then stir to mix. Set rice cooker to 3/4 full and cook for 15 minutes. Remove the lid, stir in the olives and serve.

title: Baked Peas Filling (Dees)
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds
instructions: Rinse and thoroughly dry peas. Place peas in a large bowl and combine with 3 t. Water, then set aside to marinate for 2 hours minimum. Drain the peas and place in a saucepan and cover with water. Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the water has evaporated. Remove the peas from the heat and mash with a potato masher. Return potatoes to the pan and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until the potatoes are a dark golden color. Transfer the mixture to a mixing bowl and stir in cumin, then cool to room temperature before filling and filling the casseroles. Use a pastry bag fitted with a large star tip to pipe the filling into the casseroles.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,chunky salsa,broth,chili garlic sauce,ranch pinto bean,mascarpone cheese,parsnip
title: Parsnip, Mushroom and Beef Casserole
ingredients:
4 cups parsnips, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 1/2 cups fresh button mushrooms, trimmed and halved | 1 can healthy request fat-free liquid fat, and all | 1 can whole sodium bocaorma stewed tomatoes with peppers and herbs, undrained | 2 cups chunky salsa ( mild or medium heat ) | 1 cup low salt and fat-free montreal steak spice 
    - 1 can healthy request chunk-style refried beans, drained | 1 cup hot beef broth or 1 cup broth, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Spray a 2 quart casserole with oil. Combine parsnips, mushrooms and beef in the casserole. In a small bowl, combine the undrained tomatoes with the liquid, salsa, steak spice and 1 teaspoon broth. Pour over the vegetables in the casserole. Cover and bake for 45 minutes, then sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup broth. Bake uncovered about 30 minutes or until the top is crusty.

title: Homemade Pumpkin Nuggets
ingredients: 300 g raw pumpkin | 3 egg whites
instructions: Peel, wash and slice pumpkin into half then into rounds. Place on to a baking tray and bake approximately 2 hours at 180 degrees. Check for doneness by inserting clean finger into centre of a piece. If breading will be a bit sticky, remove bread from oven and sprinkle with a little melted butter.

Random Ingredients: double cream,mint,tomato juice,caster sugar,extra virgin olive oil,bell pepper
title: Fruit Salad With Oil and Cinnamon
ingredients: 4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 large bell pepper, finely chopped | 6 tablespoons double cream | 1/2 cup of fresh mint, coarsely chopped | 2 cups tomato juice
instructions: Heat the oven to 190c/fan120c/gas toss the olive oil and sugar in a large pan over a medium heat until both the sugar and the oil have melted, then add the bell pepper and stir frequently until the peppers have softened, around 10 minutes, stir in the cream and mint and remove from the heat. Transfer to a large baking tray lined with a baking paper and pour the dressing around the edge. Bake in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until pale brown. Serve warm or cold, or at room temperature.

title: Kariha
ingredients: 1 lb masala ( all purpose flour or almond flour ) | 1 unbaked pie crust
instructions: Mix masala flour and water until dough is of a consistency that just barely covers the surface of the dough. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead for about 10 minutes. If dough is sticky, add more water. Roll dough in 2 inch long pieces and press. Set aside on a floured pastry cloth. Cut top and bottom crusts off of the kariha and remove the center section of each. Wrap each kariha with a skewer, making sure that the masala does not fall away when rolled. Arrange kariha on a floured or parchment paper lined baking sheet. Brush tops of kariha with water and sprinkle evenly with water. Bake in a preheated oven at 375°f for 20 minutes or until the tops are golden brown. Allow to cool slightly and serve warm.

title: TEXAS Taco Bell Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced hot pepper ( from chili peppers ) | 3 tablespoons minced fresh marjoram | 12 ice, crushed | 4 dashes hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the peppers and marjoram. Spoon the crushed ice into a resealable plastic bag and add the pepper mixture. Seal and shake to combine. Twist the bag to close the air bubbles, and squish a few times so that the contents of the bag are evenly distributed. Store the salsa in a cool, clean container, for up to one week.

title: Zimtsterne (Lemon & Vanilla Ice Cream)
ingredients: 250 g fresh lemon juice ( or approx. 1 1/2 liters of squeezed lemons ) | 500 g vanilla shortcakes ( cut 1 x 1 cm thick discs of tin foil )
instructions: In a large pan, heat the lemon juice or lemon juice gently until the lemon juice is nearly boiling & very little cooking fat remains. Cut the shortcakes into thin slices & add to the citrus juice, stirring until well combined. Pour the ice cream into an ovenproof pan & bake in an oven which is 180ºc / 375ºf / gas for 30 minutes, until golden & firm. Allow to cool slightly & serve while still warm.

title: Mexican Fried Corn Fritters and Grilled Beets

instructions: Place corn on a plate.

title: Pea Filling for Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1/3 cup yellow split peas | 2 teaspoons chili ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 drops prepared hot pepper sauce
instructions: Boil peas for 2 minutes to soften slightly. Drain and place in a food processor with chili, asafetida and hot pepper sauce. Blend until you have a smooth paste. Add some water if necessary to make the mixture thinner. Chill and serve cold with pita bread and salad.

title: French Daiquiri
ingredients: 1 ounce dark rum | 2 tablespoons cinnamon
instructions: Mix everything together. Top up with ice.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,cocoa,rose water,turmeric,cardamom seed,hot dog bun,stew meat

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and brown the meat for about 5 minutes. Add chili peppers and garlic, bring to the boil, and reduce the heat. Add cocoa, turmeric, rose water, cardamom, dried chili and optional ingredients. Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for about 1 1/2 hours, stirring from time to time and adding more water if necessary.

title: Persian Raisin Pilaf(Mihshi Murgh)
ingredients: 5 -6 tablespoons oil | 6 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 1/2 pints chicken broth
instructions: Heat 4 tbsp of oil over medium heat. Add the raisins. Saute them for 2 minutes. Do not over do this but watch for the raisins to swell up the whole process takes about 2 or 3 minutes. Do not brown the raisins, they will release liquid from the raisins during the final stages of cooking. If they are too soft add 2 tablespoons of water and mix in the chicken broth. Cover tightly and cook on medium heat for 20minutes. Do not boil the pilaf, it should be just cooked through. Do not overcook the pilaf. Check for salt. If necessary, cool in refrigerator. Keeps well for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,garlic salt,asafoetida powder,madras curry powder,cornstarch,pork loin
title: Crispy Pork Shank
ingredients: 1 lb pork loin | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Trim excess fat/shroom from pork. Cut pork loin into thin strips about 3/4 inch long. Combine cornstarch and remaining ingredients. If desired, add the mixture to the pork stirring to coat. Heat a large, deep skillet over medium high heat. Add pork mixture and cook until brown and caramelized on sides. Serve immediately.

title: Cafe Rio Spanish Rice

instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender or food processor blend until almost smooth or beat til creamy. Use as desired. Refrigerate til ready to use.

title: Simple Shrimp and Water Chestnut Fillets
ingredients: 6 steamed fillets | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and sliced thin
instructions: Place steamed fillets into a casserole or glass dish with the bottoms slightly overlapping. Cover with slices of water chestnut slices and pour the shrimp juice over all. Cover and refrigerate for up to 4 hours. Uncover and cook in a 375 degree oven for 10 minutes, then serve.

title: Microwave Dutch Oven Carrots (For Vegetarians)
ingredients: 1/2 lb baby carrots | 1 1/4 teaspoons coconut extract
instructions: Spray pan with cooking spray.

title: Tossed Beef and Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 cup yellow grits | 3/4 cup white wine vinegar ( i used white balsamic ) | 1 1/4 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 tablespoon pickling salt ( optional ) | 6 tablespoons coarsely chopped prosciutto | 1 cup fresh baby corn, thawed | 1/2 cup sweet pickling salt, separated | 1/3 cup granulated sugar syrup, made from 2 tablespoons sugar syrup ( or to taste ) | tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix the grits and the vinegar in a medium saucepan.

title: Spicy Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 7 lbs lamb | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Cut meat into 1 inch cubes. Sprinkle lamb with cayenne and place in a plastic bag or container. Add water to cover.

title: Cinnamon-Filled French Cro (Guiness) Sandwich

instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f. Pound meat slightly, and heat oil on small pan until shimmering. Add meat and cook over medium heat until browned.

title: Souvlaki (Filipino Meat Kabobs)

Grill meat skewers over charcoal coals or lightly oil grate over dry coals, turning regularly, until meat is cooked as desired. Serve meat skewers with dipping sauce.

title: Yogurt Surprise
ingredients: 1 package kasseri cheese, sliced | 1/2 cup yogurt | 3 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 large romaine lettuce hearts, sliced | 1 1/4 cups mandarin oranges, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar | 1 -2 teaspoon ground kelp methi
instructions: Mix together the kasseri cheese, yogurt, sherry, romaine, mandarin oranges, sugar and kelp. Serve on toast, crackers or pita bread.

title: Baked Mushrooms in Marsala Wine
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried porcini mushrooms ( can be replaced with dried shiitake mushrooms ) | 4 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/3 cup dry marsala wine
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Spread a piece of reynolds wrap aluminum foil large enough to wrap up around the mushrooms. In a small bowl, combine the mushrooms, eggs, and marsala wine.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,pear juice apple,custard,rice wine,white wine,garlic clove,egg yolk
title: Pear Rouladen

instructions: To make the sauce, place the rice wine or white wine, stir, then let it boil until the liquid is reduced to half, about 5 minutes. title: Salmon & Rice Noodle Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 400 g tomato puree | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground cumin | 120 g rice noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees centigrade celsius. Rinse the salmon. Cut into 1 inch pieces, removing the skin and entrails. Heat oil in a large pan with a lid. Add the salmon in batches and fry until light golden, then remove from pan and set aside. Add another pan and heat the remaining oil. Add tomato puree and curry paste. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the noodles according to package directions in lightly salted boiling water. Drain, then return to the pan. Heat for a further 2 - 3 minutes meanwhile, add the fish and gently gently stir to coat in tomato sauce. Serve noodles topped with the salmon and a squeeze of lemon juice.

title: Simmered Chile Toast

instructions: Slice cheese into 1/2 inch thick slices using a serrated knife, not a cutting board, cutting at an angle. On a cutting board with flat side closest to you, cut rounds from 1/2 inch wide slices, and then cut them into 1/4 inch wide slices. Combine cheese, green chili, fennel, red thai chili, and hot sauce in a wide, shallow dish. Sprinkle baking powder over cheese mixture. Dip cheese slices into batter.

title: Carrot & Leek Encrusted Pies

Bake for about 35 - 40 minutes or until cooked. Allow the pies to cool slightly before slicing and serving.

title: Pine Nut Potatoes With Corn Filling
ingredients: 1 lb russet potatoes | 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 12 pine nuts, toasted | corn syrup
instructions: Heat 1 inch of oil in a deep saucepan or deep fryer to 320f 400f. Halve potatoes lengthwise. Using a mandoline or very sharp knife, slice fries about 1/4 thick. In a small bowl, beat 2 tablespoons corn syrup with 2 tablespoons of water until well blended. Pour the syrup mixture over potatoes and spread evenly. Sprinkle pine nuts on top. Bake in 300f degree oven, turning once or twice, approximately 2 hours.

title: Easy Ryshta

instructions: Put everything except the flour and rye flour into food processor and blend until you get a paste. Mix flour with a little cold water until no lumps remain. Cover and leave to rest for half an hour or more before proceeding with recipe.

instructions: Place duck in a large, deep skillet. Prick duck all over with a fork and sprinkle with crushed salt. Cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to medium low and submerge.

title: Warm Mexican Salad

instructions: Mix the green enchilada sauce, queso blanco, cardamom, and salt together. Wash the red leaf lettuce and tear out the thick leaves so they remain reasonably close to each other in size pieces only slightly thicker. Toss with the green mixture in a bowl then top with the cheese.

title: Roasted Green Bell Peppers

Heat remaining 1 cup tomato sauce in small saucepan over medium low heat until warmed through. Transfer pepper mixture to food processor and puree until smooth. Stir tomato sauce through the roasted pepper puree into remaining tomato sauce. Spoon tomato sauce over peppers. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.

title: Vegetable Cacciatore

title: Thai Chili Popsicles

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl.

title: Raspberry-Lemon Soup

instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring jam and broth to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and add warm jam to taste. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Home Cottage Cheese

title: Easy Peppered Fresh Snow Pea and Mozzarella

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange frozen snow peas and pecan halves onto a baking sheet or roasting pan. Arrange mozzarella cheese slices over pecans. Sprinkle thyme evenly over cheeses. Bake in oven for 40 to 40 minutes until cheese is melted and snow peas are tender.

title: Leek and Cherry Soup

Re season with more pepper.

instructions: Combine sugar, vinegar, chile powder, mint and sherry in small saucepan and bring to boil. Cook until sugar dissolves, about 2 minutes. Pour over pork chops and let stand 15 minutes. title: Pista Dhal

instructions: Split peas, and wash under cold water. In a bowl, soak the peas in warm water for approx 1 hours, and rinse if there are any bad spots and shriveled areas. Place the peas in a blender and add the yogurt, and pistachios. Blend until smooth, and divide in half, like a paste.

title: Beef and Noodle Dinner

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 1/2 tablespoon rock salt, caraway seed, onion powder, napa cabbage and oatmeal. Set aside.
