Random Ingredients: brown lentil,cornstarch,brown sugar,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Brown Lentil Crisp
ingredients: 2 1/8 ounces lentils | 4 1/8 ounces dried brown lentils | 1/2 cup loosely packed brown sugar | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup chopped flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Put the lentils, sugar, cornstarch and parsley in a food processor with the motor running and process for 1 minute. Pour into a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Set in a baking dish with 1 inch salted water to the top of the casserole. Bake, covered in a 300°f oven, 50 minutes until lentils are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed.

title: Sausage-Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package fresh yeast | 1 pound kielbasa, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a few cups of warm water, or in a bread machine, and set aside. Heat a small amount of oil in a dutch oven over medium heat, and brown the sausage slices. Remove sausage to a warm dish. Make a well in the center of the sausage and pour yeast into the well. Pour water into and dissolve the yeast into the yeast mixture, stir to combine, cover the dutch oven, and allow to rise over low heat 1 hour, or until the dough has doubled in volume. Allow to rise 15 to 30 minutes, or until it has risen again. When dough has had its first rise, take off of heat and allow to rise again. Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f. Divide the dough into 6 loaves on a baking sheet. Use about 1 tablespoon of the sausage drippings or oil to coat a rimmed baking sheet. Brush the tops with oil, and sprinkle with salt. Bake in the preheated oven until nicely browned, 10 to 15 minutes, or until the loaf's top is deep and deep brown.

title: Orange-Green Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange rind, grated on a plate and then chopped into fine matchsticks | 3 green onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Mix the orange rind into the matchsticks. Slice green onions thinly. Mix and serve.

title: Sesame Rice (From Raw Food)
ingredients: 1 cup spanish rice mix | 2 pears | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon seeds, any kind | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, any kind
instructions: Peel and dice pears. Set aside. Soak rice for about 1 hour. Drain rice. Chop sesame seeds. Boil the vegetable stock. Add rice to the stock and stir until all grains are coated with oil. Stir in seeds and sesame seeds. If you feel it is too wet, add more vegetable stock. Serve.

title: Spinach with Banana and Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baby spinach | 8 very ripe bananas or 8 pecan halves, rinsed and dried
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan.

title: Crab Ceviche III
ingredients: 1 pound lump crabmeat, picked over | 1 tablespoon dried mexican oregano
instructions: Drain the crabmeat, and place in the container of an electric blender with the oregano. Cover and blend until smooth. Pour into a medium serving bowl, and serve warm.

title: Easy and Delicious Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato basil | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender. Blend until well combined, then pour over cooked spaghetti, mix well. Variation, add 2 - 3 tbsp bread crumbs or crushed biscuits to filling and stir well or spoon into a bread mold.

title: Grilled Beef Sandwich for One
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into bite-sized pieces | 2 cups bread, toasted
instructions: Heat bbq. Place bread on grill. Top slices with beef pieces. Grill 20 - 25 minutes, or until well done, turning over once halfway through cooking.

title: Chef John's Tomato, Chilli & Pepper Puree
ingredients: 1 cup thick-cut stewed tomatoes, drained, liquid reserved | 1 yellow pepper, cut into thin, thick slices | 1 teaspoon tomato puree
instructions: Place the tomatoes and yellow pepper into a pan over high heat. Bring to the boil, stirring to coat the bottom with the tomato liquid. Stir in the tomato puree, lower the heat, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Ricotta and Chocolate Croutons
ingredients: 2 slices bread | 200 g fresh ricotta cheese | 50 g dark chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Using your fingertips, roll into a rough ball and flatten slightly. Cut a circle out of each slice of bread in the shape of a crouton. Spoon 1 tablespoonful of the ricotta into the centre of each crouton. Brush the edges with melted chocolate. Roll the croutons up like a jellyroll, securing with a toothpick. Chill for 15 minutes. Gently press with your fingers and serve.

title: Cheese Puffs - Pops
ingredients: 1 cup vegan butter, room temperature | 1/2 cup shredded gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup lime juice, freshly squeezed | 4 peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and spread onto ungreased cookie sheet. Smooth tops of puff with a spatula. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 20 - 30 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Crazy Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain rice | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 large yellow pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Place rice in a bowl with 2 to 3 tablespoons of sugar and baking soda. Rinse and dry vegetables. Place the vegetables into a microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and cook on high in the microwave for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the wrap, increase the heat to high, and cook until vegetables are tender, about 3 more minutes. Transfer cooked vegetables and rice to a bowl, cover, and set aside for 15 minutes. Stir rice, vegetables, and sugar into rice. Cover with plastic wrap, and allow to cool to room temperature before serving.

title: Red Curry Crab
ingredients: 2 cans crabmeat, drained | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup chopped celery
instructions: Blend crabmeat, curry paste, and cornstarch in a blender until smooth. Combine remaining sauce ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,saffron,rotel,heavy whipping cream,white sugar,hungarian paprika,cooking spray
title: Yogurt Cheese Paprika Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 3/4 teaspoon powdered saffron | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons hungarian paprika
instructions: Prepare grill for direct heat use an oil cooking grates with a rack set in the middle of the grill or a ridged burner. Brush grill rack with oil. In a blender, whip yogurt and 1/4 t paprika with 3 t powdered saffron. Mix the cream and sugar until smooth. In medium bowl, combine whipped cream with remaining 1 t paprika and 1 t hot paprika and stir until blended. Stir in the remaining hot paprika. Transfer yogurt paste to a small bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight. Lightly coat a medium glass or ceramic bowl with cooking spray. Pour yogurt mixture into bowl with cream and sugar mixture and mix to coat. Transfer to container and refrigerate until serving.

title: Pumpkin Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients: 2 cups grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice ( pumpkin pie spice variation )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mash up pumpkin pie spice with a fork. Squeeze the seeds from the pumpkin with your hands to make pumpkin less of a puree and place into a medium bowl. Add parmigiano reggiano and pumpkin pie spice mixture to bowl. Stir to combine. Transfer mixture onto a nonstick baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes, until the top starts to get golden.

title: Spinach Fish Fingers
ingredients: 400 g white fish fillets, trimmed | 150 g baby spinach ( about 20 grams )
instructions: Heat an ovenproof frying pan. Line a baking tray with tin foil or baking paper. Place the fish, skin side down, on the pan and place in oven. Bake for 3 - 5 minutes until fish has cooked through. Meanwhile, place the spinach in a large bowl. Cut a piece of kitchen paper to about 5cm diameter and lightly crush with a rolling pin to release excess moisture. Sprinkle the spinach with salt and mix well with the fish. Divide the fish among serving plates. Divide the spinach among the 4 pieces of paper and place on top of fish. Drizzle with honey or agave nectar. Serve with rice or salad greens.

title: Churros of Death With Chocolate and Lentils
ingredients: 125 g lentils, washed | 500 g white onions | 50 g sesame seeds | 150 g grated dark chocolate | 150 g whipping cream | 125 g melted dark chocolate | 100 g fried dark chocolate
instructions: Chop the white and brown onions, then cook them in a saucepan on medium heat until they turn brown in colour. Add 4 tbsp boiling water and the lentils, stirring continuously until the lentils are cooked, about 40 minutes, while stirring often. Meanwhile, take a baking sheet, generously grease it and line with parchment paper. Put the sesame seeds in a small skillet and toast them over high heat until golden. Drain the lentils. Add to the bowl with the onions. Take the baking sheet and spread the melted chocolate and sesame seeds out on the baking sheet. Make a well in the centre, and pour the cream into the middle to keep it from sticking to the baking sheet. Stir until the cream is thick enough from the churros but will still be a little lumpy. Dollop the mixture carefully onto the baking sheet, and spread out the top of the chocolate with a spatula. Cover with the parchment paper and leave for ten minutes. Meanwhile, cut the dark chocolate into squares. Dollop the chocolate into small pieces on top of the sesame seeds, then leave to melt.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,ginger,sazon goya coriander annatto,white bread
title: Sparerib Roasted Garlic
ingredients: 16 garlic bread ( use country-style cut of garlic bread for this ) | 6 -8 pinches sazon goya with coriander ( can be found in the latin aisle, i prefer the dry version for a little kick ) | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | garlic powder
instructions: Pound the garlic on a cutting board until it is thin on the outside and tender inside. Spread out all of the ingredients on top of the garlic, rubbing the garlic into the oil. Place the bread in a ziploc bag or paper bag, close the bag, pressing out as much air as possible. Place the bread on a flat counter and place the garlic on top. Preheat your oven to 325 degrees f. After 25 minutes, open and toss the garlic into a roasting pan, turning the pieces so all sides are coated with the spice mixture. Place pan in your oven and roast until garlic is easily pierced with a fork, about 1 hour total.

title: Fufu (Japanese Turnip Pickle) Dip
ingredients: 1/2 kg turnip | 100 g yellow turnips | 100 g miso
instructions: Peel and wash the turnips well and slice into about 1 cm rounds. Slice the ends off the turnips and place on a baking tray and bake at 200°c for about 10 to 15 minutes stirring every 5 minutes or so. To turnip wash the turnips thoroughly and boil for about 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and place the turnips in a glass bowl and mash with a wooden spoon until creamy the mixture turns into a dough. Stir in the miso. Chill to set, serve slightly chilled.

title: Tandoori Style Sweet Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Wash and soak rice in 8 cups of hot water for 2 hours. Drain rice and grind thoroughly while adding cardamom pods. Boil rice with 1 teaspoon of green cardamom and 1/2 to 1 cup of water in a heavy based saucepan. Bring to the boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes or until rice is almost cooked. Remove cardamom pulp from the saucepan before serving.

Random Ingredients: beet,chicken bouillon cube,white flour,purpose flour,english cucumber,corn oil
title: Lapsha - Cucumber and Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 large english cucumber, peeled and quartered | 1 cup peeled and sliced beet, fresh | 20 fluid ounces chicken bouillon cube | 20 fluid ounces warm chicken broth or 20 fluid ounces water | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon corn oil
instructions: First, prepare the cucumber and beets. Place the cucumber and beets in a large bowl, add enough water to cover them completely. Cook until they are soft, about 15 - 20 minutes. Let them cool down for about 15 - 30 minutes. Take off any outer leaves of the beet, then slice them into small pieces. When ready to use, drain the beet and beets and place into a large bowl. Dissolve the chicken bouillon cube in the warm chicken broth or water over low heat. Mix well. Heat the corn oil through in a small frying pan, and use to add one tablespoon of the flour to prevent it from scorching. Turn off the heat and add half of the hot oil to the flour. Whisk well until the flour is well mixed. Slowly add the flour mixture, whisking until it is smooth.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,chicken breast fillet,cocoa powder,mexican cheese,maple syrup,farfalle pasta,salt
title: Faux Hot Chocolate Chicken & Mac N Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 500 g cooked farfalle pasta or 500 g elbow macaroni | 1 sachet cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 250 g finely chopped chicken breast fillets | 100 g finely sliced mexican cheese blend | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cook the farfalle or macaroni per the packet instructions, drain and set aside to cool slightly. In a saucepan, combine the cocoa powder, syrup, chicken and cheese. Stir over a gentle heat until the cheese melts. Season with cinnamon and stir through the farfalle or macaroni. Transfer to an oven proof dish and bake in the oven on a low heat for 20 minutes, until brown and bubbling. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top and return to the oven for 5 minutes to melt the cheese.

title: Simple Red Curry Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 500 g watermelon, in cubes seeded | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil
instructions: Mix together, pour into bowl and leave in fridge to chill. Serve on lettuce leaves, drizzle with a little olive oil or fresh red chilies if desired.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,tomato sauce,liquid smoke,yellow pepper,vegetable stock,coffee,italian dressing,anaheim pepper
title: Kielbasa with Hot Pepper Relish
ingredients: 2 kielbasa, cut in 1 inch chunks | 1 bunch anaheim pepper, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch dice | 2 yellow peppers, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch dice | 5 tablespoons italian dressing | 6 fluid ounces coffee, brewed and cooled | 5 fluid ounces vegetable stock | 1 can tomato sauce | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1 fluid ounce thousand island dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender, blend them until smooth.

title: Sour Cream Chili
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained, juice reserved | 1 package frozen okra, cut in half | 1/2 cup sour cream ( optional ) | 1/3 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons dried sweeten or to taste
instructions: In a 1 quart microwave safe glass or ceramic casserole dish, combine the beans through bean.

title: Puffels
ingredients: 1/2 kg raw peanuts ( raw ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Boil the peanuts in very little water till very soft and dry. Cool and grind them to a fine powder using a fine coffee grinder. This can also be done in a rice cooker. Stir a couple of times so as not to toughen the peanuts, then mix them thoroughly. Shape into small, round balls. Heat 1 cup oil in a wok, put one at a time and roll them around the palm of your hand. Cook till they turn a golden brown in colour, then remove and drain on paper towels. Serve hot as an appetiser.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,pork belly,sesame oil,amaretto,salt pepper,egg yolk
title: Pesto Pork Buns With Amaretto Peppered Egg
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork belly ( or other lean pork meat, about 8 1/4 x 2-inch ) | 4 large egg yolks | 1 3/4 cups packed fresh pesto sauce | 3/4 cup sesame oil | salt and pepper, to taste | prepared wasamette or your favorite sesame paste
instructions: Cut pork into chunks. Place in a colander, sprinkle with salt and let drain for 30 minutes. While pork is draining, beat the egg yolks with pesto and sesame oil until lemon colored. Drain the pork well and pat it dry. Pat the pork dry again. Spread a few tablespoons of the pesto sauce on the flat side of each piece of pork. Dip each piece of pork in the egg yolk. Let excess egg drip off the slices and place on a clean serving platter. Garnish top of each with more sesame paste, if you like, and serve immediately.

title: Torte E Piselli
ingredients: 6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | 1 container mascarpone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place chicken breasts between two sheets of heavy duty aluminum foil. With a rolling pin, roll out the cheese to yield 1 1/2 to 2 rectangles. Wrap each breast in a square of cheese. Wrap with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Slice chicken breasts into strips and arrange on baking sheets. Bake in preheated oven until chicken is cooked and cheese is bubbly, about 25 minutes.

title: Maple Syrup Falscreme Falscreme
ingredients: 1 cup pure maple syrup or 1 cup maple syrup | 1 tablespoon hot pepper flakes, crushed
instructions: Add ingredients to a small saucepan over medium heat and stir constantly until sugar dissolves. Boil and simmer approximately 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Pour hot syrup into a shallow bowl. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

title: Simple and Delicious Penne Pasta
ingredients: 3 cups cooked penne pasta | 2 cups soymilk
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Japanese Style Cauliflower With Buttermilk Sauce
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, washed, trimmed | 1 cup buttermilk ( may use sour cream ) | 1 tablespoon sake ( japanese rice wine ) | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: To steam the cauliflower, steam in a steamer basket over a bowl of simmering water, covered, for 10 to 15 minutes, or until tender but still crisp. To steam the cauliflower, bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Place the cauliflower in the water and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and let cool slightly. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cauliflower to a large bowl. Stir the buttermilk, sake and sugar until the sugar has dissolved, then pour over the cauliflower and toss to coat to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Roasted Pepper and Pepper Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 1/2-2 teaspoons coarsely crushed black pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns, crushed
instructions: In an airtight glass or stainless steel bowl, combine the black pepper, pepper powder, and peppercorns. Close tightly and store in a cool, dry place or freeze for up to 3 months, stirring from time to time. Makes approximately 1 cup.

title: Fenugreek Mushrooms
ingredients: 200 g button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Put mushrooms in a medium size bowl stir in fenugreek seeds. Cool completely and cut into slices. Chill in the fridge or allow to stand for at least an hour to develop the flavours.

title: Peas With Raspberry and Green Onion
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas | 3 green onions, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries | sea salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Put a big pot or dutch oven over medium heat and add enough water to cover peas. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to low. Cook peas, uncovered, stirring often, until tender, 10 - 15 minutes. Remove from heat and drain water from peas. Add green onions to peas. Add frozen raspberries and season with salt and pepper. Serve warm.

title: Crabs on a Stick
ingredients: 4 1/2 inches pieces sirloin ( or pork ) | 2 lbs crab | salt | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour
instructions: Cut a fine slice off each side of the sirloin or pork using a slice or hammer. Remove all the visible fat from the crab. If you are using sirloin or pork, cut into bite sized chunks or chunks. Rinse and drain the crab and leave the fat in the crab. Mix the flour and salt in a bowl. Slice the crab pieces as thinly as possible. Roll each piece of crab in the flour mixture and set aside on a plate. Roll the crab pieces in the flour mixture until well coated on all sides. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,fajita seasoning,cardamom,hard cheese,cauliflower,guacamole,walnut oil
title: Fajita Appetizers
ingredients: 3 cups self rising flour | 1/2 cup ground walnut oil | 1 tablespoon fajita seasoning | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 2 packages cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 ounces hard cheese, cubed | guacamole, if desired
instructions: Heat oil in skillet or saute pan on medium heat. In large mixing bowl, combine the ground walnut oil, fajita seasoning and cardamom.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pear,pistachio nut,lemon juice,ginger garlic paste
title: Pistachio Pears
ingredients: 3 -4 large firm pears | 1/4 cup dry roasted red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, fresh | 1/2 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 tablespoon chopped pistachio nut ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Place pears in a roasting pan large enough to hold them in one layer. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes, lemon juice and ginger garlic paste. Bake 20 minutes or until tender. Transfer pears to a clean serving dish. Add pistachios, if using, and sprinkle with remaining green cardamom if using. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Easy and Delicious Chicken Tagine
ingredients: 4 teaspoons grated fresh ginger | 4 teaspoons chopped coriander | 3 skinless chicken thighs | 1/3 cup sultana | 1/4 cup sliced dried apricot | 1/2 cup ice water | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh ginger | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut or 2 teaspoons coconut powder
instructions: Place the ginger and coriander in a bowl, add the chicken and rub it all around with the spices. If you need to, rinse your fingers a couple of times and rub the chicken again. Place the chicken on your plate or the base of a clay roasting tin which has been tinned and lined with foil. Wrap up the chicken, making sure it is not touching outside of the dish. Cook in a grill or in the oven for around 40 mins until the chicken is cooked through and well browned. Remove from the oven, remove the foil, place on your plate, leave to rest. While the chicken is in the oven, cut the fruit into big pieces with a sharp knife and pour over the water. Wash and trim the chicken legs and prawns if they are already in the marinade. Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the oven and set aside. When ready, mix together the coconut and fresh ginger in a small bowl, rub the paste all over the chicken. Then return it to the saucepan and leave to simmer for 5 mins. The water should run off before the chicken is cooked. Serve the tagine with the fruit chunks along with plenty of plain yogurt.

title: Fonduta di Piña ( Piña Rican Bread Pudding)
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut lengthwise into eighths ( about 8x3-inch ) | 1 can coconut cream | 1/4 cup whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. In a large bowl, toss bread with coconut cream and cream. Place bread in a 13 x9 baking dish that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake for 45 minutes or until bread is tender.

title: Green Chiles
ingredients: 2 cans chopped green chilies | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 canned minced habanero peppers, stemmed and finely chopped
instructions: Place the green chile peppers, orange zest and marjoram into a blender or food processor and process until smooth. In a medium size bowl, combine the green chile pepper mixture, habanero chile puree and 3/4 cup water.

Random Ingredients: sirloin tip roast,basil leaf,dashi soup,chicken broth,aubergine,gingerroot,papaya,phyllo pastry
title: Steamed Avgolebai
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 2 aubergines | 1/3 lb fresh gingerroot | 1/3 cup dashi soup | 3/4 cup dried wortel leaves | 8 sheets thawed phyllo pastry | 2 cups chicken broth | 8 basil leaves
instructions: Trim fat from meat by slicing in small pieces. Cut aubergines in half. Place meat in bowl of water to cover. Soak for 5 minutes in refrigerator. Peel and thinly slice ginger. Place in bowl, cover with cold water. Set aside. Cut the wortel leaves into 1 inch pieces. Put in large bowl, cover with cold water. Chop ginger into small slices. Place ginger, aubergines, and beef in wortel and toss. Place 4 tablespoons dashi soup in the bottom of steamer over boiling water. Place 1 inch cubes of meat on top of each cube of meat. Layer 6 basil leaves on top to cover the meat. Continue packing, alternating with 1 1/2 cups meat, until steamer reaches the top half of steamer. Cover and steam meat over low heat 6 to 8 hours or until meat is fully cooked. Remove meat from wortel and place on serving platter and slice 3 to serve. Top with a leaf of basil.

title: Sweet Potato, Red Bell Pepper and Cranberry Stuffing
ingredients: 1 lb sweet potato, peeled ( about 3/4 inch diameter ) | 3 medium red bell peppers, halved lengthwise | 1 small celery rib, finely chopped | 1/2 cup cranberries | 1/2 lb vienna sausage, casings removed, and crumbled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°. Cut each sweet potato into 16 wedges and toss with 2 tbsp of the red pepper paste, 1 tbsp of the celery, and the cranberries in a bowl. Transfer to an 11x2 baking dish, scatter over the sausage crumbles, and bake in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes until brown and bubbly and a little crisped. Cut into wedges and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,vegetable oil,arborio rice,masa harina,baking powder
title: Rice Bread - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 8 cups masa harina | 2 cups masa harina | 1 teaspoon baking powder | vegetable oil, for frying | 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | vegetable oil, for frying
instructions: In a large bowl, mix 8 cups masa harina, baking powder and vegetable oil. Stir in mustard seeds. Dough will be too wet and sticky. Knead dough briefly until smooth and easy to handle. Form into balls about the size of a walnut. Flatten into discs about 2 inches diameter. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook disks in hot oil until deep golden brown. Transfer disk to a wire rack. Cool before storing in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,double crust pie,great northern bean,mustard seed,saffron thread
title: Coconut Milk and Saffron Tart With Golden White Beans
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | 1 pinch saffron thread, rinsed | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 double crust pie crusts, unbaked
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a medium sauce pan, combine coconut milk and mustard seeds. Stir in saffron and beans and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a baking sheet. Press crust dough into the baking sheet. Cut steam holes in the crust with a sharp knife. Bake at 425ºf for 12 minutes, or until golden brown. Spoon pudding into a serving dish and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cumin,pepperoni,molasses,fine sea salt,swiss cheese,tomato ketchup,arugula,hot chili powder
title: Tomato and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese ( about 2 ) or 1 1/2 lbs mozzarella cheese, fresh ground | 2 cans tomato ketchup | 1 cup molasses | 4 -6 tablespoons finely snipped jarred hot chili powder | 3 tablespoons fine sea salt | 3 tablespoons molasses | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | 3/4 teaspoon hot chili powder | 2 heads arugula or 3 large bunches arugula
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Melt cheese in large ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Stir in ketchup, molasses, chili powder, sea salt, cumin and chili powder. Arrange one fourth of the arugula leaves in the bottom of an 8 inch or 9 inch round baking dish. Layer cheese mixture, remaining arugula and cheese mixture, finishing with the final layer of arugula. Place dish into oven and bake until cheese is bubbly and golden brown, about 30 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Serve either warm or chilled.

title: Asparagus Appetizer
ingredients: 2 heads fresh asparagus | 6 tablespoons italian salad dressing mix | 3 cloves ( optional or more ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Break asparagus with your hands into two inch lengths and rinse and dry thoroughly in a strainer. In a mixing bowl or ziplock bag, combine all ingredients and toss to coat. Let it marinate for at least an hour, but no longer than three at a time, toss a few times during that time to distribute the flavors. Cover and set aside in refrigerator overnight. The next day, transfer the mixture into a large, flat baking dish or other suitable size, and cover and refrigerate for at least two hours to marinate before use. Cook over hot coals or on a grill for about five minutes, or until desired doneness. Note, i have found that the more you toss the asparagus, the softer the result sometimes goes for a good sear, if only a little moisture is showing, i remove the pan from the burner and add a few drops of water to loosen the edges of the asparagus before you flip. Also, the more you toss the asparagus, the crisp it will take to cook. Note, if you want to get the flavors more uniform, you can also add a few drops of water.

title: Steamed Turnip, Spinach, and Berry Salad
ingredients: 1 turnip, peeled and sliced into half moons ( about 1/4-1/2 pounds ) | 12 ounces of fresh spinach leaves | 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves | 1 roma lettuce, trimmed and coarsely torn | 1/2 cup chilled unsalted yogurt | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup beer | 2 tablespoons sliced fresh strawberries, for garnish
instructions: Place a steamer over high heat in a large pot. Add the turnip slices. Cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the turnip is tender, about 10 minutes. Transfer the turnip to a large bowl and set aside to cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, place the spinach into a large wok or serving bowl. Add the roma lettuce and 1/2 cup of the baby spinach leaves and toss to combine. Toss the spinach with the remaining baby spinach leaves. Arrange the turnip on a serving platter. In the same large bowl, mix the yogourt, hoisin, and beer and combine until smooth. Strain the mixture, leaving about 1/2 cup of the liquid. Slowly pour the liquid over the turnip in the bowl, stirring and letting any excess liquid pour back into the wok. To serve place yogurt into a small bowl and sprinkle with the hoisin and beer mixture. Serve the turnip and yogurt in individual bowls, garnish with strawberries, and serve immediately or refrigerate. Keeps several days.

title: Shawrbat
ingredients: 1 parsnip, parsnip, and rutabagas, minced | 1/2 cup honey | 3 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons flours | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/4 cup toasted hazelnuts, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 f degrees. Wash, peel, and dice parsnip. In a mixing bowl, toss chopped parsnip and rutabagas with honey, tamari and flour. Mix in garlic salt, cardamom and hazel nuts. Divide evenly between two 12x18 inch baking sheets. Bake in preheated oven until tops are lightly golden.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,rye bread,green pepper,cream chicken soup
title: Beefy Oyster Sauce Sandwich (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 1 )
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon green pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Mix the sour cream and soup together in a small bowl, then add in the oyster sauce and green pepper. Spread on a slice of toasted rye bread or fresh bread.

Random Ingredients: butter cooky,yellow onion,steak,sauce,rye bread,puff pastry,fine breadcrumb
title: Swiss Steak Tart
ingredients: 1 lb round steak | 1 yellow onion, grated | 7 ounces rye bread | 3 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon steak sauce | 1/4 cup butter, melted | 2 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut steak into 4 or 5 small cubes. Preheat oven to 300°f. Combine 1/2 of the fine bread crumbs with the steak sauce and mix thoroughly. Remove and discard rind from rye bread. Place the bread crumbs into a shallow bowl. In a deep 12 inch skillet combine remaining crumbs with 3 tablespoons of butter. Dip each piece of bread into crumbs, coating evenly. Place in hot skillet and brown over medium high heat about 2 minutes per side. Repeat with remaining bread crumbs. Spread half of the steak pieces with some of the prepared bread crumb mixture. Layer with remaining steak pieces and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place remaining crumbs on a plate. Roll out the puff pastry and cut with a pastry cutter, making the tart into 12 slices. Top with rye bread crumbs and coat slightly with bread crumbs. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes, or until crust is golden and bread crumbs are crisp.

title: Lamb & White Chocolate on Lamb Backstraps
ingredients: 500 g lean lamb shoulder, cut into 3cm pieces | 50 g white chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Place lamb in a shallow large baking dish. Cover with chocolate. Bake in a moderate oven for 1 1/4 hours, turning, until it is brown on all sides. Serve with seasonal vegetables.

title: Hot Mexican Chili Powder
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles | 1 can beef stock | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Roast the poblano chilies over a gas flame or under the broiler. They should be slightly charred and the skin should blistered. Place chilies in a plastic bag, and let them sweat for 15 minutes, or until soft. Use a kitchen towel to remove the skins. Rinse and place in a blender or food processor, and add the beef stock through a slit down the side of the chilies. Season with oregano and add the mirin, and puree to a thin paste. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Lemongrass Pasta Salad Recipe #5FIX
ingredients: 16 ounces farfalle pasta or 16 ounces penne pasta, cooked al dente | 4 stalks lemongrass, outer leaves discarded and inner stalk cut off | 3 cups grape tomatoes or 3 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 3/4 teaspoon fresh rose water
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Mix together lemon grass, and tomatoes with rose water. Toss with the pasta. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Warm Flat Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour ( or more if needed ) | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato, chopped
instructions: Put flour in a large bowl. Make a well in the middle and pour in the sun dried tomatoes. Stir quickly until all the tomatoes are well coated with the flour and have lost most of their moisture. Knead quickly, working quickly, until the dough leaves the sides of the bowl and becomes smooth and firm. Let rise in a warm place until it doubles in bulk. Divide the dough into 2 or 3 pieces and form into rounds. Heat a griddle or heavy skillet for a few minutes on the stove or in a griddle basket placed on a parchment lined baking sheet. Place the rounds about 5 or 6 inches apart and press in the sides with a finger or a rolling pin. Grill until crusts are dark golden brown and the bottoms have become very crisp, approximately 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on a rack.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,hot water,bread,browning sauce,lemon,balsamic vinegar,sun tomato oil
title: Broccoli and Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli floret, small pieces | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup bottled balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons hot water | 1 teaspoon lemon rind, grated | 1/4 cup bread, dry and cubed, to serve | 2 teaspoons browning sauce, to serve
instructions: Place broccoli and sun dried tomatoes in a microwave safe bowl. Cover and microwave on full power for 2 - 2 1/2 minutes or until vegetables are tender and starting to soften. Meanwhile, place all remaining ingredients in a small bowl and stir. Place bowl of veggies in microwave. Place bowl and veggies on a large plate. Add vinegar, hot water and lemon rind.

title: Mango Beer
ingredients: 1 cup beer | 1 teaspoon yeast extract | 1 small mango, peeled with pit removed
instructions: Put everything in your mixer with the beer and mix well. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes at the highest temperature in the pan. You can either bake it right away or leave it on the oven shelf.

title: Deviled Irish Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf unsliced cracked crusty cracker | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1/2 cup hot sauce, such as tabasco | 1/2 cup irish whiskey
instructions: Place cracked crackers in a bowl, making sure each cracker is completely coated with cracker. Mix together soya sauce and hot sauce in a small bowl. Pour mixture over crackers. Cover with plastic wrap, place in refrigerator, and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour. Heat oven to 400 f. Remove from refrigerator. Cut open loaf with the long edge of a serrated knife. With a sharp knife, slice each loaf into two slices diagonally across the loaf. Top slices with soya sauce mixture. Replace plastic wrap from loaf and bake on a rack for 20 - 25 minutes. Serve.

title: Vegetables-Curry French Bread: Yummy!!
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, peeled and sliced into 1 or 2 inch chunks | 2 medium yellow squash, sliced into 1/2 inch thick thick rounds | 3 serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( or an extra hot pepper of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste, to taste ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon mexican dry yeast | 3/4 cup vegetable oil or 3/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Place the potato, squash, and chiles on a baking sheet that is lined with parchment. Bake, uncovered, in 350f oven for about 30 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat and stir in the curry paste. Let cool at least 15 minutes. Dissolve yeast in 3/4 cup of the vegetable oil. Place remaining oil in a bowl and add the yeast mixture. Stir well. If too soft, add more oil. Add enough warm water to reach 1/2 of the depth of the bread, cover bowl, and let stand 30 minute until the yeast mixture forms into a thick batter. Stir in the remaining flour, cover the bowl, and set bread in a warm place for about 30 min. Heat a frying pan to medium heat. Dip potato chunks in the curry batter, coating all of them completely then fry them in the oil. Remove them immediately with a slotted spoon or a slotted spoon. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,rotel tomato,tomato paste,navel orange,double cream heavy,caster sugar
title: Pancakes With Tomato Sauce and navel oranges
ingredients: 1 pint double cream, light cream or 1 pint heavy cream | 10 small peppercorns | 3 tablespoons good bairys superfine sugar | 3 ounces tomato paste | 2 navel oranges ( medium ) | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f line two baking trays with aluminium foil, lay 3 peppercorns in each dish and put in oven. Heat cream in saucepan over medium heat, stir in sugar, stir for 5 minutes or until mixture is the temperature of a pouring consistency. Remove from heat and set aside. Peel oranges and cut into half lengthways and remove pith from skins by scraping a sharp knife across the flesh and removing seeds with a teaspoon so that the peel can pierce. Slice peel into thin strips. Put cream, orange slices, sugar and 2 tablespoons of tomato paste into a large bowl and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Mix well with a wooden spoon or spoon. Line two baking trays with foil, and put 1 tablespoon of orange peel on each tray, roll up, put in the centre of each tray and put into the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Check after 15 minutes and adjust the oven temperature if necessary.. Remove from oven and turn oven off. Leave in oven for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Leave to stand for 10 minutes before pouring over sauce. Serve with a sprig of parsley.

title: Savory Lettuce and Chips
ingredients: 1 baguette, sliced into 1inch thick slices | 1/4 cup smoked paprika | 1 bunch fresh baby spinach | 2 cups simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 1 cup fresh sage leaf, chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 cups sliced pepper | lettuce or cilantro leaves, for garnishing
instructions: Combine hash browns, sage, and pepper in a deep microwave safe casserole dish and stir in the potatoes. Cover and cook in microwave for 20 - 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with lettuce and serve hot.

title: Spicy Panir (Fried Panir)
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces panir ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 slices paper-thin palm sugar ( very thin layers of palm sugar and pine nuts are very important, use very little ) | 4 mint leaves ( garnish ) | 2 teaspoons tahini
instructions: Cut paneer in half and carefully remove the crusts, as the palm sugar tends to brown very easily. Spread out each slice of paneer thinly on a clean dry tray, sprinkle the bottoms evenly with sugar and nuts and drizzle with tahini. Garnish with mint leaves and serve immediately.

title: Savoury Mango Chutney Wedges
ingredients: 500 g mango chutney | 250 ml sweet passion fruit, pulp | 150 g cherry tomatoes
instructions: Grease 19 x 29cm tin. Cut 600g mango chutney into chunks. Place in bowl and add passionfruit pulp and stir until well mixed. Spoon passionfruit into tin and sprinkle over 200g mango chutney mixture. Cut cherry tomatoes into halves and place on top of mango mixture with 5 cherry tomatoes to serve.

title: Chinese-Style Glazed Turkey Bacon
ingredients: 2 lbs lean turkey bacon, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces ( turkey bacon ) | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 2 slices fresh gingerroot, cut into 1/4 inch wide slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine the turkey pieces with half the cornstarch or flour. Stir the cornstarch into 1/2 cup cold water until the mixture starts to thicken, then slowly drizzle in the mixture of water and cornstarch until you have a sticky, smooth batter. Spread a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the bacon in a skillet with high sides and set over medium high heat. Cook the bacon, stirring occasionally, until crisp and golden, about 12 minutes. Remove the bacon to parchment or paper towels to drain. Reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees f. Return the skillet to the stove and carefully pour the batter into the skillet on top of the bacon. Stir and reduce the heat to medium low. Cook the bacon for 5 to 10 minutes or until it is golden brown and the mixture is bubbly. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the bacon to a large plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,celery seed,raisin,pepperoncini pepper,tomato green chile pepper,chicken breast tender
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 3 chicken breast tenders | 1 can stewed, diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1/2 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot pepperoncini peppers | 1/4 cup chicken broth
instructions: Lightly butter the chicken tenders and place the in the slow cooker. In a small bowl, mix the tomatoes, raisins, celery seed, hot pepperoncini pepper, chicken broth, and the remaining green chilies. Pour over the chicken and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Festive Fall Harvest Veggie Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup flour tortillas or 1/3 cup corn chips | 3 tablespoons finely chopped pistachios | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 2 cans condensed beef broth | 1/2 cup water | 1 lb mixed greens ( i used baby beet, kale, red leaf, and black-eyed peas, also known as greens salad ) | cooked farfalle pasta
instructions: Saute tortilla chips in oil till just browned and crisp. Add nut mixture, broth and water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour, uncovered. Stir in greens and cook 1 minute until greens are tender crisp. Serve at once, piping hot.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,great northern bean,cauliflower floret,ancho chile,red onion,mushroom,asian fish sauce,rigatoni pasta
title: Quick Asian Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 1 1/3 cups mushroom pieces | 1/3 cup fresh cauliflower florets | 1 2/3 cups canned great northern beans, rinsed, drained and chilled | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chiles or 1 teaspoon crushed ancho chile | 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 teaspoons asian fish sauce or 2 teaspoons low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 cup thinly sliced red onion
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Cranberry and Mheddar
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cranberries, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried savory | 1 package mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Lightly grease a baking dish. In a medium bowl combine the cranberries and savory.

title: Shrimp in a Jar
ingredients: 8 ounces shrimp, cleaned and deveined | 3 1/2 cups chicken breasts, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups dried currants | 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | creole-style seasoning ( recommended -- mccormick ) or kosher salt and coarse salt, to taste | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional )
instructions: If using spices use a spice mill and process in batches, until fine. Rinse the shrimp under cold running water. Place in a bowl. Add shrimp, currants and barley, mixing to combine. Transfer to a large, air tight jar, cover, and store in a cool spot until ready to use. When ready to use, bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat. Allow to simmer uncovered for 30 minutes or until the shrimp is tender. Remove and discard any shrimp that clump. Cool, then transfer to a bowl. Skim off any scum. Store in the refrigerator. If using spice mill, add fenugreek seeds to a small non reactive sauce pan over low heat until they begin to pop. Remove from heat and allow to grind for 5 minutes, or until very fine. Store in the refrigerator in a cool spot until ready to use. To use the shrimp and vegetables, rinse the shrimp under cold running water. Pat dry with paper towels. Place chicken in a shallow, nonporous glass dish and marinade in refrigerator for about 20 minutes. Place on the counter, covered, for up to 90 minutes. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Remove shrimp from marinade and pat dry, then add to the shrimp and vegetables, pushing down to cover them. Bake for about 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the shrimp are tender.

Random Ingredients: italian plum tomato,salt black pepper,fajita seasoning mix,marmalade
title: Crispy Fried Tomato
ingredients: 2 cans italian plum tomatoes, in their juices | 1/4 cup marmalade | 1/4 teaspoon fajita seasoning mix | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f. Place 2 tomato cans vertically in a skillet. Mash the tomatoes with a potato masher while shaking the skillet to help loosen juice. Transfer tomatoes to a bowl and add marmalade, fajita seasoning mix, salt, and black pepper.

Random Ingredients: beef heart,passion fruit,cannellini bean,sea salt,poppy seed
title: Poppy Seed and White Wine Cannellini Bean Stew
ingredients: 300 ml dry cannellini beans | 300 ml fresh passion fruit, juice and pulp ( pulp ) | 600 ml beef heart | sea salt | poppy seed ( optional )
instructions: Soak each kidney bean at least six hours or overnight so that all the water has time to abd boil. Remove the beans with a slotted spoon and place in a pan. Add the passionfruit juice. Stir and reduce the liquid, to a thick paste. When the water is boiling, add the hearts of beef and heat through. If using poppy seeds, sprinkle them on when stew is half cooked. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,mint leaf,russet potato,salt garlic powder,spanish onion
title: Bunuelos De Queso (Colombian Fritters)
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes or 2 medium yellow sweet potatoes | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons salt-free garlic powder | plain flour, for coating | mint leaf, for garnishing
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes. Grate the onion, and sprinkle it with the salt and garlic powder. Place them in salted water, bring the water to a boil, and cook them until tender. Drain and cool them. Mix with the potato. Using flour, coat the hands and hands with flour mixture. Using your hands, shape the mixture into patties. Heat a non stick frying pan. When you can feel the oil start to smoke, oil the pan. You can do this by dropping a few small balls into the hot pan, they cook quickly, they fry in about 3 - 5 minutes, turning once. Serve with mint.

title: Wild Rice or Chicken Orzo
ingredients: 1 package uncooked orzo pasta | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 can black mushrooms, drained | 1 tablespoon dry ranch dressing
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the orzo and cook according to package directions, omitting salt, and drain. Meanwhile, combine the dry mustard with the mushrooms, and stir into the cooked orzo. Stir in the crumbled ranch dressing. Serve warm.

title: Easy Phyllo Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 3 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread 1 1/2 cups flour on a clean surface. Bring 3 sheets of plastic wrap together, placing a second 1/2 cup of flour in the centre of each sheet of phyllo dough so that the bottom side has a flat surface. Sprinkle generously with flour if desired. Dip fingers into flour if desired and gently press into the flour. Place dough, seam side down, on the floured sheets. With a fork, lightly prick top of dough with a fork. Repeat with remaining sheets of phyllo. Dust a surface with flour if desired. Bake in preheated oven until dough is bubbly and golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Grilled Plum
ingredients: 20 plums, large | olive oil, to brush | 5 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese, plus more | parmesan cheese, for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat an outdoor griddle or nonstick skillet over high heat, and oil the grate. Trim and remove the stems from the plums. Remove the pits by using a sharp knife. Using a sharp knife or small spoon, scrape the inside of each plum. Stuff the pitards with a tablespoonful of the grated parmesan cheese, and close with the toothpick. Cook the plums, skin side down, on the hot griddle for about 5 minutes, or until they are slightly wrinkled and tender. Flip them. Brush with olive oil, sprinkle evenly with additional parmesan cheese, and grill until the cheese is crisping and golden, 2 to 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,rice wine vinegar,tofu,sirloin steak,corn oil,cream mushroom soup
title: Sliced Steak With Tofu or Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 4 or 5 slices | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 tablespoons soy yogurt | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar
instructions: Season beef with seasoned salt. In a large skillet heat 1 t oil on medium high. Brown the steak slices well on both sides, remove to a plate. Pour the remaining 1 t oil in the pan and add the cream of mushroom soup and sour cream or soy yogurt stir well. Add the beef and simmer on medium heat for about 5 minutes. Return the steak and the broth to the pan and let simmer on low until steaks are cooked through, about 10 - 12 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Overnight Sponge Cake
ingredients: 1 sponge cake | 1/4 cup sugar substitute ( or as is necessary to make the right consistency for the cake )
instructions: Place sponge cake on a rack in the refrigerator overnight. Turn the oven to 190c and place cake on the middle rack of the oven. Bake cake for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done. Serve warm with cream syrup.

title: Seared Spareribs With Mushrooms, Chestnuts, Cider Vinegar and Lime
ingredients: 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 10 tablespoons limes, divided | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce, plus more to taste | 3 lbs spareribs, rinsed and dried | 10 cremini mushrooms, stems trimmed and cut into thin bite-sized pieces | 1/2 cup sweet plain sweet dried chestnuts, cut in half | 6 cured limes, sliced into rounds
instructions: Whisk vinegar and 1 tablespoon juice from 2 limes in a bowl, and pour into another small glass bowl. Whisk hot pepper sauce into remaining lime juice in bowl, and pour into bowl. Add remaining lime juice and tabasco to bowl, and set aside. Pat dry ribs.

title: Hominy Pozole
ingredients: 2 cans hominy | 1 bunch fresh strawberries, hulled and finely chopped
instructions: In a crock pot, fill with enough water to reach just below the top of the crock and set on high. Soak one can of hominy for 1 hour, then drain. Rinse the can of chopped hominy and add it back to the crock pot. Cook on high until the juice has thickened.

title: Ondrob Flour Beef
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | seasoned rice flour ( optional ) | 8 ounces mixed herbs ( we like oregano, basil, rosemary and thyme ) | 1 bottle apple cider ( regular or non-alcoholic recommended )
instructions: Cut meat into cubes and pat or dredge pieces into seasoned rice flour. Toss with your herbs. Pour cider in a pan and heat. Add beef in, stir up until all is coated well with the cider. Simmer until meat is fork tender. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: currant,white onion,green enchilada sauce,navel orange,chickpea,cocoa powder,maraschino cherry,lemon
title: Quick and Easy Green Chili
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried currants | 1 can sweet white onions, sliced | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup cocoa powder | lemon, rind of | 1 navel orange, zest and juice of | 3 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup dried maraschino cherry ( optional )
instructions: Soak currants in hot water or soak in rum for 15 minutes. Drain. Slice onions and add to onion mix, reserving maraschino cherries. Add 2/3 cup of cocoa and the zest and juice of one lemon. Mix together and chill overnight. Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil. Reduce to simmer and cook slowly until thickened. Serve over tacos, pita chips, crackers, warm flour tortillas, etc. Also you can use any type of green chili. For me, just use green chile red enchilada sauce and use lime juice to soften the green onion. Note, i usually make this in an instant food processor and then store it in small freezer container. The lime juice keeps the chill from sticking. It tastes even better the next day.

Random Ingredients: couscous,parsnip,orange pepper yellow,dark rum,ra el hanout spice mix,garlic clove,cinnamon
title: Couscous With Pistachios and Raisins
ingredients: 1/4 cup mixed peel and pith from a parsnip | 1 tablespoon of the fresh nut grated orange peppers or 1 tablespoon dried yellow pepper | 1 tablespoon the ras el hanout spice mix ( or 2 1/2 teaspoons curry powder ) | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 3/4 cups uncooked couscous ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 10 ounces dark rum or 10 ounces dark rum, warmed
instructions: Using an electric spice or mortar and pestle, pound the parsnips in a large bowl with the seasoning and garlic until well diced. Add the parsnips and stir to mix. Let stand 10 minutes. Add the rum and mix well. Preheat the broiler. Remove the cinnamon sticks with a strainer if using. Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil and add the couscous. Add the raisins and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat and let stand, covered, 5 minutes. Turn the couscous onto a cutting board. Cut into pieces, 2 inch by 1 inch or smaller. Fluff with a fork. Divide the couscous among 4 serving plates and drizzle with the warmed rum. Serve warm at once.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,yukon gold potato,corn chip,egg yolk,onion,soya sauce,monterey jack cheese,irish cream
title: Gnocchi in Creamy Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb yukon gold potato, peeled and diced | 1 medium onion, chopped | 8 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 ounce light soya sauce | 4 eggs | 1/4 - 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2 -3 cups corn chips | 2 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f put potatoes, onions, mushrooms, salt and olive oil into a large bowl, toss well soya sauce is dispersed throughout the vegetables, and set aside. In a separate bowl, beat eggs. Place 1 cup of the cheese into the bowl with eggs, then season with a pinch of salt and pepper and set aside. In a pot of boiling water, cook the grated cheese until it is completely melted. Drain in a colander and immediately pour over the potato mixture. Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top just before serving.

title: Barkramen II
ingredients: 1/2 cup pickled bechamel mixed chopped nuts | 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled
instructions: Stir bechamel and whole egg together in a bowl until egg is completely mixed. Spread mixture in a paper thin layer onto a small dish, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 or 2 hours or until set. Serve with hot rye bread, crackers or crackers.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,honey,taco seasoning mix
title: Honey Tots
ingredients: 3 tablespoons honey | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350° f. In a small bowl, mix together the honey, taco seasoning and crumbled red pepper flakes. Brush onto four 2 to 3 inch tart pans that have been lightly lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until well browned. Remove tart pans from the oven, and allow to cool for 5 to 10 minutes, then serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,dark chocolate,cranberry,italian bread,orange bell pepper,rotini pasta
title: Italian Noodle Salad (Oamc)
ingredients: 375 g dry rotini pasta ( small pasta sheets, approx 3 cups ) | 1 orange bell pepper, finely diced | 125 g cranberries, chopped | 50 g icing sugar | 150 g dark chocolate, grated | 1 loaf italian bread, cut into cubes
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Mix remaining ingredients except bread, together. Serve warm and let stand until cold but not cold.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,habanero pepper sauce,cayenne pepper,potato starch,rye bread,soymilk,white pepper
title: Crusty Reuben Fingers
ingredients: 2 cups sour potato starch | 1 cup soymilk | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon habanero peppers in red sauce | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 4 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Mix potato starch, soy milk, ketchup, habanero pepper sauce, white pepper, cayenne pepper, and rye bread in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,worcestershire sauce,grape juice,pickling onion,bacon grease,walnut half,red curry paste,beef broth
title: Red Curry Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon grease | 1/2 cup chopped pre-shredded wursts or 1/2 cup thinly sliced beef top round | 1/2 cup finely chopped pickling onions | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn | 1/4 cup grape juice | 1/2 teaspoon pickling onions, finely chopped | 16 walnut halves, lightly toasted
instructions: Heat butter in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add sliced pickling onions.

title: Homemade Phyllo Shells
ingredients: 12 whole fresh large phyllo shells | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 -3 tablespoons salt ( to taste ) or 2 -3 tablespoons white pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil and add salt. Add the shells and cook just till they are just beginning to soften. Drain and set aside until cool enough to handle. Remove the shells from the water you will use to cook them in. Heat oven to 350°f. Take the shells from the water and pour enough water into a bowl to come 1/2 inch up the side of the shells. Dip the shells into the bowl with the water, and drop into the hot oven. Cook just till they are browned on all sides and the tops are just beginning to flake. Remove the shells from the oven. Drain well and set aside until cool enough to handle. If shells are refrigerated, they will be ready to use later. To clean the shells, gently grasp a pastry towel, and dip a tiny bit of the shell in the hot water. You can also do this with a moistened napkin. The water starts to dribble into the towel and become cloudy as the oil is absorbed. So just try to suck it out of the towel with your fingers. It's easier than trying to do that with a spoon.

Random Ingredients: deli turkey,blackberry,beef bouillon cube,crescent dinner,chili pepper flake,salmon fillet
title: Hot & Sausage Swirl
ingredients: 16 ounces salmon fillets, in 3/4-inch pieces or 4 ounces your favorite sausage | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 8 beef bouillon cubes | 16 ounces canned sliced blackberries or 16 ounces frozen small blackberries | 1 lb deli turkey, sliced | 1 package crescent dinner rolls
instructions: Place salmon slices in bottom of baking dish or crockpot. Place smoked sausage on top of salmon. Sprinkle salmon with chili flakes. Add berry slices. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour over salmon and sausage. Cover with saran wrap or wax paper. Freeze overnight. Unleast 15 minutes before baking or remove from freezer 15 minutes before baking. Bake 400 for 20 - 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,red capsicum,spice,anchovy,ra el hanout spice mix,red chili diagonally
title: Moroccan Shish Kebab (Red Moroccan Beef)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, finely cubed | 3 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 2 tablespoons red capsicums, chopped | 1 large red chili, finely chopped | 3 anchovies, finely chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, except the beef. Cover and refrigerate the roast for at least 2 hours, or up to 48 hours, before using. Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 2 hours. Broil or grill beef on high for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, or until cooked to your liking. Serve with couscous. Note, this could serve all at once. If not, cook as above.

Random Ingredients: beef steak,rye bread,ricotta cheese,creme fraiche,juniper berry,phyllo dough
title: Beef and Rye Crostini
ingredients: 6 ounces beef flank steak | 1 cup creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon whole juniper berries | 1 teaspoon whole dried thyme or 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 2 tablespoons rye bread | 2 tablespoons ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 475&deg.

title: Tofu & Artichoke
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/2 lb tofu, cut into 2 pcs. cubes | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can artichokes, drained | oil ( to fry ) or butter ( to fry ) | shredded iceberg lettuce | cheese sauce or jalapeno sauce
instructions: Mix cornstarch with 1/4 cup water. Toss in tofu with turmeric and 1 tablespoons water. Heat oil and/or butter over medium high heat. Add tofu and artichokes. Cook till tofu is browned a bit. Serve with sliced lettuce and cheese sauce of choice.

title: Smokey Spanish Quinoa
ingredients: 1 jalapeno pepper, finely diced | 1 red pepper, finely diced | 4 slices prosciutto ( thick slices ) | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | 4 teaspoons tamari | 2 teaspoons dark rum | 1 cup quinoa
instructions: Saute jalapeno pepper and red pepper with vinegar, tamari, dark rum. When peppers are done, add quinoa. Cook in microwave on high for 20 minutes, or until dry. Cool before serving.

title: Amaretto Creamy Beet and Marshmallow Salad
ingredients: 6 large fresh beets, peeled and sliced | 4 ounces marshmallows | 7 -8 ounces fresh spinach | 1/3 - 1/2 cup amaretto
instructions: Place sliced beets into a microwave safe bowl, and cover with amaretto. Cover with plastic wrap, and microwave at 600 watts on high for 45 to 60 seconds. Stir, and microwave uncovered for another 5 to 10 seconds until softened. Drain the beets, and slice. Toss together with the chopped marshmallow, spinach, and amaretto. If serving immediately.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,stew meat,rice noodle,flour,green cardamom pod

instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Place meat in 2 quart casserole dish. In medium bowl, mix cardamom pods or small pods with flour. Sprinkle over meat. Pour over meat and stir. ingredients: 3 lbs cooked boneless skinless chicken thighs | 8 ounces whole fat milk ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 packet taco seasoning

title: Easy Spicy Mexican Recipes
ingredients: 6 ounces ground round | 4 ounces dry breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup can of pureed consomme | 2 teaspoons mexican oregano | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: In a large bowl, put all ingredients except oil. Add oil, and mix thoroughly. If mixture is too dry, add more of the consomme, or just more breadcrumbs. title: Lentil and Prosciutto Wrapped Salmon

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lentils and cook uncovered until tender, about 30 seconds to 1 minute. Drain.

instructions: Empty chicken & bouillon into crock pot, placing a 1/2 ounce cube between each piece of meat. Pour hot water over all, but not too much.

title: Bubble & Squeak (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 8 -12 boneless pork shoulder ( i use boneless cut boneless and trim excess fat ) | 500 ml club soda ( or any cheap soda ) | 1/2 cup chopped okra | 1/2 cup chopped preserved lemon peel ( or 1 tbsp dried ) | 1/2 cup cornflour | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 8 -10 slices french bread
instructions: Wash, clean and cut the meat off the bone in chunks. Place all ingredients in crock pot except bread and bread. Stir. Cover and cook on low for six hours or on high for 3 hours. Cut bread into 5 slices. Then cut bread slices in 3 pieces across and serve it along side bread pieces.

title: Easy Elegant Red Sauce

instructions: Mix the creme fraiche and tea together and pour over a hot, juicy red pepper, grilled salmon, or prawns. Serve immediately.

title: Ham Salad With Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups swiss cheese | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 12 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Cut cheese into small squares. To cut in small, remove the middle about 4 wide. Place on serving platter. Spread hot sauce on top of cheese and sprinkle with sage. Serve with crackers or other condiments.

instructions: Place all the ingredients into a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour off excess water if required. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

instructions: Combine onions, 3 tbls. Oil, and cumin in a food processor and pulse until onion is finely minced. Add in graham cracker crumbs and mustard seeds one at a time until crumbs are incorporated into the onion mixture. Let cool until easy to handle, stir to mix in crumbs. Enjoy.

title: Peanut Crisps

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Put the chocolate and peanuts in a medium bowl and mash them together. Stir in the nuts and knead to combine. Shape into balls about 1 inch in diameter. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet and flatten slightly with a wet fork. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden. Allow to stand for 5 minutes before turning out.

instructions: Place mushrooms in a small pan of boiling water.

title: Sirloin Steak (Burgundy Style)

instructions: Preheat oven to in a baking dish, top potatoes with half the sour cream and half the yellow split peas. title: Spiced Ginger Pizza

title: Homemade Sweet & Sour Garlic Bites

instructions: Mix the ingredients together until your desired sweetness mixture is achieved. Keep in mind the wheat germ has to stay completely submerged after it has been processed. instructions: In medium bowl, mix together worcestershire sauce and chile peppers.

title: Thai Barbecue Beef and Noodles

instructions: Cut tenderloin crosswise into about 1/2 inch wide slices. Set marinade aside. Pat beef dry with paper towels. Arrange beef slices on rimmed baking sheet. Lightly season with salt. title: Cashews and Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted cashews, finely ground | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f combine the cashews and phyllo dough, leaving a little space as needed to keep sheets from drying out. Lightly spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Unroll the rest of the sheets and place them on the baking sheet. Cover with a towel and set aside for 1 hour. Place 1/2 teaspoon of cashews in the center of each round, then fold in the left over side of the phyllo to form a triangle. Press the top triangle of phyllo over the filling, tuck in the edges and roll up the pastry to enclose it. Repeat with remaining sheets and filling.

instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat.

title: Chocolate-Egg Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup mirin | 250 g farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 4 eggs | 4 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Bring 2/3 water to the boil in large pan. Add pasta and cook until pasta has reached desired tenderness. Place eggs in a pan of boiling water. Boil for 3 minutes. title: Moroccan Orange Jam

instructions: To prepare the za'atar, pour 1 litre of boiling water over the orange peel in a clean, non metallic bowl. Cover and leave to stand in a warm place for 1 hour. Transfer the orange peel and orange juice to a container with a lid. Drain the orange peel carefully and reserve. Discard the za'atar. Add 3/4 of the poppy seeds, 2 tbsp of the orange juice and 1 tbsp of the extra orange juice to the za'atar. Mix well. Leave to stand for 1 - 2 hours. Add the za'atar. Leave to stand for 1 - 2 hours. When the orange juice is ready and the za'atar has dissolved, strain it through a strainer or a fine sieve. Discard the solids. Transfer to a clean, non metallic pan, and melt 1 tbsp of the orange juice in it. Add 1 tbsp more orange juice and 1 tbsp of the poppy seeds to the za'atar and stir to blend with the orange juice.
