ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 8 ounces fresh mushrooms stems, thinly sliced | 4 egg whites | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, zest of | 8 8 ounces french bread, thinly sliced on the diagonal | lettuce
instructions: Spray a 12 cup vegetable muffin tin with cooking spray and set aside. Unroll the crescent dough and separate as needed making 4 per loaf.

title: Puff Pastry
ingredients: 1 kg chicken drumsticks ( or equivalent amount of leg meat, depending on the size of your drumsticks ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dutch-processed cocoa, heaped ( i use dutch-process ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sesame oil | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | puff pastry ( a small rectangular tray, or a rectangular pastry, cut into strips about the size of your ovens )
instructions: Rinse chicken drumsticks under cold water, then pat dry with paper towel. Place in a single layer on tray and brush with 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil. Sprinkle with about half a teaspoon of cocoa. Place another tray lightly dusted with more cocoa. Roll and stretch pastry strips to form strips about the size of your ovens. Sprinkle the sesame oil on top then bake at 190c for about 30 minutes, until pastry is a golden colour and is tender. To serve, cut each piece into strips and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,pinto bean,red cabbage,italian sausage,vinegar,cardamom,cauliflower floret,salt pork
title: German Sausage Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces coarse salt pork | 2 1/2 cups red cabbage | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets | 1 1/2 cups red cabbage | 4 ounces dried sweet italian sausage | 3 cups pinto beans, cooked if possible | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 5 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 cup dried cranberries, chopped
instructions: Cut salt pork into 1 inch cubes. Blanch and rinse cabbage and cauliflower until crisp tender, then drain and rinse in cold water. Cut the cooled salt pork into 1 inch pieces. In a large bowl, toss together cabbage, cauliflower and sausage and season well with salt, pepper and cardamom. Place 1/4 cup of the pinto beans in the center. Arrange 1/4 of the drained salt pork on top and repeat layers. Place remaining beans around the ingredients and top with remaining pinto beans. Sprinkle with vinegar and cranberries and serve.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,mozzarella cheese,parsnip,chicken broth,ice cube,honey,herb,saffron strand
title: Moroccan Parsnips and Parsley Soup
ingredients: 450 g parsnips | 200 ml chicken broth | 1 tablespoon honey | 3 sheets saffron strands | 1 green capsicum | 1/4 cup fresh herb, chopped fresh | 5 tablespoons mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: Peel and halve the parsnips into 2 3cm pieces. Using the tip of a sharp knife, hollow out any protruding flesh and into the base of the parsnips. Place in a large saucepan with the broth and honey. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer for 12 minutes. Strain through a fine sieve and discard the solids and vegetables. Chop into 1cm cubes. Cut the capsicum in half and remove the stalk. Cut into thin strips. Sprinkle over the parsley, herbs and mozzarella and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer on the lowest heat for 25 - 30 minutes until all the vegetables are soft and the cheese is melted. The flavour is enhanced if chilled for 3 - 4 hours. Variation, for a twist, add sliced lemon or lime or orange. Place 3 - 4 tablespoons of cooked pasta into a food processor with the parsley, herbs and cheese. Blend until just starting to form a smooth mixture. Pour the soup into a chilled jug and serve.

title: Coffee Filled Sweet Rolls or Sandwich Pies
ingredients: 1 teaspoon turmeric | 250 ml strong coffee | 25 ladyfingers | 350 g hamburger | 150 g sultanas or 150 g raisins | 75 g sandwich bread
instructions: Crush the turmeric with a tablespoon or two of water. Brush a little of the coffee syrup into each ladyfinger, to moisten them. Arrange them in a circle in a single layer in the base of a microwave safe dish. Add a good pinch of turmeric and a pinch of black pepper as you go, then top the ladyfingers with this syrup. Cook in your microwave oven for 3 - 4 minutes using 600 watts. Remove the dish with them from microwave and add the hamburger breaking it up with a large fork. Heat through for a further 3 - 5 minutes. Remove and cool slightly. Cut the sandwich rolls or patty rolls into 5 slices. Put them on plates or other serving plates and dust with paprika. Spread 1 teaspoon of ground turmeric onto the top of each slice of bread and place 1 - 2 tablespoons of sultanas or raisins as a topping if desired.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,corn kernel,beef bouillon cube,chicken leg,pouring cream,cottage cheese
title: Easy Carnitas
ingredients: 8 beef bouillon cubes | 8 chicken legs | 8 pork shoulder ( optional ) | 8 corn kernels, fresh | 1 container cottage cheese | 1 pint whipping cream
instructions: Place chicken legs, pork shoulder, and corn in large baking dish. Pour whipping cream over chicken and vegetables.

title: Tofu in Marsala
ingredients: 1/2 cup mirin | 1/4 cup marsala | 1 package firm tofu | 4 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a 2 quart glass casserole dish, combine the mirin, marsala, and tofu. Bake, uncovered, in a 375 degree f oven for 20 minutes, turning halfway through. Top with remaining ingredients just before serving. Note, if sauce is too thick, stir in a little cornstarch or water.

Random Ingredients: wheat berry,corn,sun tomato oil,self rising flour,chili powder,taco sauce,raspberry vinegar,cooking oil
title: Taco Berry Muffins (Gourmet)
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat berries ( blueberries, blackberries, strawberries, etc. ) | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup self-rising flour, for dusting | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon ground corn | sun-dried tomato packed in oil, minced ( i like it with lots of liquid ) | 1/4 cup taco sauce | cooking oil | 1 teaspoon sweet chili powder | 1 teaspoon taco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a medium sized bowl, mix the first five ingredients. Sift the first five ingredients together. Add the sun dried tomato to the flour in the bowl, then the taco sauce and mix all together. Put a heaping 1/3 cup of mixture onto the buttered muffin tin. Bake at 400°f for 18 - 20 minutes or until done.

title: Spicy Tomato Soup
ingredients: 8 tablespoons dried italian cut tomato | 1 3/4 cups red capsicums, roasted peeled diced | 1 3/4 cups white flour, unsifted | 2 cups fat free chicken broth
instructions: Place tomatoes in a heavy based saucepan and add capsicum. Simmer for 10 - 15 minutes meanwhile, combine flour and broth and mix well. Gradually add to vegetables, bring to boil, stirring and reduce heat so soup simmers slightly. Remove from heat and cover for about 30 minutes. Puree soup in blender. Return to pan and stir to make smooth and creamy soup. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal.

title: Homemade Japanese Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup bell peppers or 1/2 cup red bell pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Add bread crumbs to saucepan. Heat over medium heat until mixture begins to form a solid but not browned crust. Turn off heat. Add bell pepper strips, stirring very well. Cool to room temperature. Remove crust from pan. Form mixture into small balls or flattened flat bread shapes, using desired size. Flatten balls slightly with palm of hand. If possible, cut into 1 - 2 inch pieces to serve as a snack or as a meal.

title: Green Salad (Tako and Kaya)
ingredients: 1/2 head torn greens | 2 -3 tablespoons green sesame paste or 2 -3 tablespoons chili paste ( to taste )
instructions: Wash greens thoroughly and place in a large, shallow bowl. Sprinkle green sesame paste on top. Toss lightly with hands or by spoon and serve.

Random Ingredients: channa dal,sushi rice,broccoli,broccoli floret,cooking spray,nigella seed,beef bouillon powder
title: Beef Soup for Two
ingredients: 1 package sliced frozen broccoli florets | cooking spray | 1 3/4 cups channa dal | 8 ounces thinly sliced cooked beef, or more to taste ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons instant beef bouillon powder | 1 1/2 cups prepared sushi-style prepared rice | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Cook and stir channa dal in a saucepan over medium low heat for 1 minute. Mix channa dal, channa dal, and beef in a bowl.

title: Chilies and Hazelnuts
ingredients: 20 dried hot chili peppers | 3/4 cup ground hazelnuts | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 3 tablespoons cumin | 2 cups dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Pierce the top and bottom of the chilies with a tip of kitchen shears. Cover with hot water and let soak until softened, about 20 minutes. Remove the chilies and discard. Bring the water to a boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Drain the chilies and discard the water. Rinse out the water completely. Place the chilies in a bowl and cover with ice cubes. Cover and refrigerate until the chocolate is set, about 5 hours. Place the nuts in a large bowl, cover with boiling water, and let stand for 10 minutes. Drain the water, and put the hazelnuts, nutritional yeast, cumin, and bread crumbs in a food processor. Mix everything together thoroughly. Put this mixture in a small, shallow pan or a bowl and cover. Refrigerate until set.

title: Parsley Oil
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 clove garlic, minced | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper together in a bowl.

title: Sea Bass Wrappings With Baked Beans, Bacon, Rapids, and Greens
ingredients: 1 sea bass, skinned and boned | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh rosemary or 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1/2 lb broccoli floret | 1/2 lb bean sprouts | 1 ounce chopped fresh bacon, chopped | 2 tortillas | diced capicola, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f trim fins, or use fish scales, which have been twisted together. Cut fish into 1 inch thick slices or strips. Sprinkle with rosemary. Set a side. Spread bean sprouts on the center of each tortilla, alternating with some bean sprouts. On the long edge, lay out the bacon as you would with a pancake. Lay the floured sea bass strips over the bean sprouts. Roll up and secure with a tooth pick. Arrange on a baking sheet and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve from the baking sheet with plenty of salsa on the side. Make ahead, to serve, cover and refrigerate for up to 6 days and reheat before eating.

title: Peppers Pepperoni  Cheesecloth  (Cheesecloth Pepperoni Puffs)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cheesecloth, trimmed of all extraneous fat | 1 tablespoon coarse ground pepper | cornflour | 3 slices pepperoni, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Pound cheesecloth until very thin, then using a large, sharp knife, slice cheesecloth into 5 1/2in lengths. Cut slices in half and set aside. Tie each piece with a string, making a pouch about 8inx4in. Stuff each packet with pepperoni slices. Place the four cheesecloth puffs on a wire rack set over a small baking dish. Pour boiling water into a pan to just below the bottom of the puffs. Bake for about 25 minutes, or until cheese is firm to the touch. When cool, remove cheesecloth and cool on a rack, about 40 minutes.

title: Spicy Tomato and Potato Kebabs
ingredients: 12 baby potatoes, washed, peeled and cut into quarters | 1 can chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Arrange potatoes in a large resealable plastic bag. Combine tomatoes with green chilies, basil and allspice. Pour over top of potatoes. Seal bag. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: wheat spaghetti,orange marmalade,hot italian sausage,salt black pepper,soymilk,provolone cheese
title: Sausage Parmesan
ingredients: 1 package whole wheat spaghetti | 1/4 cup light soy milk | 1 tablespoon orange marmalade | 1 teaspoon hot italian sausage ( such as bob evans ) | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/4 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the spaghetti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Stir soy milk, orange marmalade, and hot italian sausage into the spaghetti, and bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Continue simmering, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly, about 30 minutes more. Pour sauce into a bowl, discard any casings from the sausage, and toss with provolone cheese. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rum flavoring,sharp cheddar cheese,curd cottage cheese,semolina,french vanilla pudding mix,italian sausage
title: Italian Baked Cheese & Sausage
ingredients: 8 cups cubed sharp cheddar cheese or 8 cups grated swiss cheese | 2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 1 box french vanilla instant pudding mix, 2-inch size | 1 cup dry curd cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon rum flavoring | 1 tablespoon italian sausage or 1 tablespoon spicy sausage sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease 9x9 baking dish. Cut sausage into bite sized pieces, and brown in a 5 quart dutch oven. Drain fat. Add 1 package of cheese blend to remaining sausage and brown well. Remove sausage onto paper towel lined plate. Sprinkle other package with 1/2 cup grated cheese. Mix cottage cheese with 1tbsp rum flavoring and mix well. Stir cottage cheese mixture into sausage. Transfer meat mixture into baking dish in 1 layer, forming a smooth layer. Spoon 1 cup cheese blend mixture over cheese, followed by 1 cup cheese. Top with remaining cheese and bake until brown, about 40 - 45 minutes.

title: Glazed Beef Tips
ingredients: 8 lbs chuck or 8 lbs round steaks | 1/2 cup garlic and herb seasoning | 1 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 cup rosemary sprig | 1 carton frozen whipped topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Spray baking sheet lightly with non stick cooking spray. Combine garlic, herb seasoning, preserves and rosemary in a medium bowl. Stir in beef and place in a lightly greased 9x13 baking dish. Make a well in mixture of mascarpone, jam and whipped topping. Pour cheese mixture over beef. Cover tightly. Bake 90 minutes or until beef is tender to taste. Remove from oven. Baste with juices. Serve with your favorite side dishes.

title: Mexican Restaurant Seasoned Dry Rub
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh cilantro ( or more ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons rotel cheese blend ( can use cheddar cheese )
instructions: Place the cilantro or more to cover in a small bowl. Add cheese and coat well. Store in an airtight container for up to a week.

title: Fish Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs firm white fish fillets, such as cod, mahimahi or 2 1/2 lbs red snapper | 6 shallots, peeled, washed and thinly sliced | 1 cup beef stock or 1 cup canned reduced-sodium beef broth
instructions: If using fish fillets instead of fish, cut into slices about 3/8 inch thick. Thread slices onto metal skewers. Place skewers on a greased rack in a broiler pan or on a rimmed baking sheet, slightly open side down. Broil, turning once, 7 - 9 minutes, turning once to brown evenly. Remove from oven. Let stand 3 minutes, then serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: demerara sugar,dumpling wrapper,alfredo sauce,cooking spray,taco seasoning,italian parsley
title: Easy Mexican Samosas
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package round dumpling wrappers | 4 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon finely chopped italian parsley | 2 teaspoons demerara sugar
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Spray a medium size nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Combine filling ingredients, and spoon 1/3 cup of mixture onto wrapper, over filling. Add more filling if necessary, to moisten all edges. Gently roll up. Place on lightly greased grill or baking sheet. Brush tops with water, and cook until nicely browned, about 5 minutes per side. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: milk powder,black eyed pea,taco seasoning mix,cornmeal,oregano leaf
title: Cajun Black-Eyed Pea Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups instant black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 5 tablespoons milk powder | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Process in a blender until smooth. Transfer to a crockpot if desired.

Random Ingredients: mirin,caper,coconut cream,red chili pepper,granny smith apple,red chilies,wheat pita bread,asiago cheese
title: Apple and Chile Pita Pockets
ingredients: 2 cups granny smith apples, finely chopped | 1 red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 red chilies or 1 green chili, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 tablespoons red chilies, chopped | 2 tablespoons mirin | 2 tablespoons coconut cream | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, shredded | 4 whole wheat pita bread
instructions: Combine apples, chili, capers, chilies, mirin, coconut cream and cheese in a large bowl. Chill, covered, for 3 hours, stirring often. Shape mixture into patties with wet hands. Grill patties, turning once, over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side. Serve with pita crisps.

title: Muufarra
ingredients: 1/2 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon unsalted shelled unsalted butter | 1 tablespoon unsalted spreadable smooth peanut butter | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/8 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon minced fresh chile | 1/8 cup chopped fresh toasted pistachios
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cheese, softened butter, peanut butter, bread crumbs, msg, chile and pistachios. Stir to combine. Stir in the cheese mixture just until blended. The more bread crumbs the harder and the creamier any muufarra will be. Mixture should be moist, but not runny. If a thicker paste is desired, add 1 tbsp cornstarch dissolved in 1 tbsp water to a small bowl and stir until the cornstarch is dissolved. Divide mixture into 16 equal portions. Roll each one into a ball. Flatten each ball slightly with the hand. Place on a baking sheet.. Bake in a 350 degree oven for eight to nine minutes or until firm on the outside but moist and puffy in the center when touched. Cool on the pan. Store in an airtight container at room temperature until serving.

title: Cheesy Italian Submarine Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage | 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut in 3/4-inch pieces | 1 jar low fat cottage cheese
instructions: Brown sausage in a skillet on a medium heat, stirring frequently. Set aside,. Cut asparagus into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Cook in boiling water with 1 tsp sea salt. Drain and set aside. In another skillet, heat cottage cheese to desired creaminess. Remove from heat. Stir asparagus into sausage mixture. Preheat sandwich maker. Slather asparagus mixture on one side of the bread. Place other side of bread with the cottage cheese on top of the meat mixture, meat side down. Heat until bottom of bread is light brown, then turn on sandwich maker. Press sandwiches to remove excess moisture and crisp topping. Slather tops with remaining half can of low fat cottage cheese. Serve with side greens.

title: The Old Tavern's Easy Parsley & Eggs
ingredients: 2 large eggs | 1 cup dried sweet red wine or 1 cup dry white vermouth | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: In a large bowl, beat the eggs until thick and lemon colored. Stir in the dry vermouth. Pour the egg mixture into a hot, buttered 8 inch cast iron skillet. Cover and cook over medium heat until the middle jiggles, about 10 minutes.. Carefully invert a serving plate onto the skillet with the eggs. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Chip Guacamole
ingredients: 4 ounces chopped dark chocolate | 1 orange | 2 bay leaves | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Finely grate the zest of a orange. Put the grated dark chocolate in a bowl, add the orange zest and half the orange zest and enough guacamole to coat the chocolate. Break it up with a spatula so it melts evenly, without burning and mix well. Stores well in a jar in the fridge.

title: Mock Frozen Cashews
ingredients: 1 cup cashews or 1 cup almonds | 2 packages frozen limeade concentrate | 1 lb muenster cheese
instructions: Drain canned cashews, and set aside. Combine all ingredients, in a blender, and blend until well mixed. If mixture seems to dry, add a little more limeade. Place mixture in a gallon size ziplock. Freeze according to directions on bag. When frozen, take out of freezer, and break the bag into smaller chunks. Return to freezer, and repeat freezing and zapping, until cashews are fully frozen.

title: Fenugreek English Muffin Melt
ingredients: 2 english muffins, split ( about 7/8-inch thick ) | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Arrange half of the muffins on a foil lined baking sheet. Place the other half of the muffins on top of the muffins. Toast the fenugreek in the broiler over medium high heat. Toast until fragrant, about 1 minute. Set the muffins aside and cool slightly. In a small bowl, sprinkle the fenugreek on the muffins just until you get a nice spreadable taste. Drizzle the fenugreek onto the muffins. Sprinkle with the lemon zest. Use an electric mixer to beat the muffins for just a few minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,deep dish pie crust,cardamom pod,mango nectar,japanese soy sauce,mushroom,cardamom
title: Marmalade Tartar
ingredients: 1 box refrigerated deep dish pie crusts | 1/2 cup japanese soy sauce | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 cups fresh mushrooms | 3 large cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom | 1/2 cup dry mango nectar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Open lid of pie crust and press pie crust a few times. In a large bowl combine soy sauce, sesame oil, mushrooms, cardamom pods, ramen and mango nectar, blend until the mixture is smooth, about 2 minutes. Drain pie crusts onto a wire rack and bake crusts for 7 - 10 minutes until crusts are golden and shiny.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,sardine tomato sauce,baking powder,venison loin,artichoke heart,prosciutto,dill sprig,icing sugar
title: Italian Sardine and Meat Ragu
ingredients: 3 ounces prosciutto, cut into slices about 1 1/2 inches long ( italian sweet sausage ) | 1/2 lb boneless venison loin, cut into thin strips | 2 jars artichoke hearts, drained and sliced thinly | 1/4 - 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 can sardines in tomato sauce, drained and cut into bite-sized chunks | 12 frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and minced | fresh dill sprigs ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place prosciutto in a large skillet, and cook over medium high heat, stirring until it starts to crisp and brown, about 5 minutes. Then, add the meat and a large pinch of salt to the pan.

title: Kidney Bean Veggie Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces pasta, any kind | 1 cup peeled eggplant, cubed | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed well | juice lemon | lime wedge
instructions: Boil the pasta, drain and turn into a large bowl. Pour the kidney beans and juice into a bowl, and add the diced eggplant. Toss gently with the pasta until evenly mixed. Sprinkle with lime wedges and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Breasts (Moorish Kebabs)
ingredients: peanut oil ( for frying ) | 1 lb turkey, boneless, skinless chicken piece, cubed
instructions: Cut the chicken and vegetables into 1 inch cubes. Arrange the cubes on paper towels, and let drain overnight if possible. When ready to fry, add a teaspoon or so of peanut oil to a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Spread the meat out in a single layer. Cook the meat until brown on the outside, and the meat is seared on the inside, 4 - 5 minutes each side. Remove the meat and discard paper towel from skillet. Drain all but 1/2 cup of the fat from the skillet. Pour in the rest of the peanut oil, and place the skillet over medium heat. Place the turkey pieces into the oil.

title: Spanish Beef With Creamy Corn
ingredients: 1/2 cup onion, minced | 1/4 cup spanish onion, minced | 1 lb boneless beef tenderloin, cut into thin strips | 1 can corn kernels, undrained | 1 cup tomato juice ( or 1-10 oz. can ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to spray 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray. Heat 1/4 cup onion in a skillet on medium high heat for 3 minutes or until tender. Add beef and cook, stirring frequently, 2 minutes or until browned. Stir, breaking up beef with a wooden spoon, the cook until well coated with onion. Stir in corn, tomato juice and cardamom. Cover and cook for 8 minutes or until beef is just cooked through. Uncover and cook 5 - 10 minutes longer or until liquid is evaporated. Let stand 5 minutes. Transfer to plate and serve with rice.

title: Green Beans Baked in Gin (Glazed)
ingredients: 6 lbs fresh green beans or 6 lbs frozen green beans, blanched | 1/2 cup mustard, country style | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup gin
instructions: Rinse and drain beans and place in a 4 quart casserole. Combine remaining ingredients, pour over beans. Cover and bake at 300 degrees for 45 minutes. Remove dish from oven and discard the lid. Increase oven temperature to 450 degrees and bake for another 45 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300 degrees and bake for 1 hour more to brown edges.

title: Onion Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons butter | 2 yellow onions, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons molasses ( i use honey but it can also be made with brown sugar or a combo of brown sugar and molasses. ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( add if making glaze )
instructions: Cook onion in oil or butter until golden brown. Add molasses mix very well. Add seasoned salt. Simmer, uncovered for 20 minutes. Remove from heat and stir, reheating.

Random Ingredients: halloumi cheese,sunflower seed,plain flour,elbow macaroni,sun tomato,corn,soymilk
title: Macaroni and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 5 cups elbow macaroni | 1 cup corn, tinned | 12 sun tomatoes, chopped ( chopped ) | 2 teaspoons sunflower seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup plain flour | 5 2/3 ounces halloumi cheese | 1/4 cup soymilk
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted boiling water until just tender, drain. In large bowl combine macaroni, corn, tomatoes, seeds, flour and cheese, stir well to mix. Add enough soymilk to mixture to taste. Serve on warm plates and sprinkle with sunflower kernels and serve with freshly baked breads.

title: Christmas Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 lb mexican cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup fresh cranberry sauce | 1 teaspoon ginger, grated | 1/4 cup parmigiano, grated
instructions: Line large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place 1/2 the cheese in a medium saucepan on the stovetop on the stove top and heat 2 - 3 minutes, until the cheese is melted but not brown. Spread half the cranberry sauce in the bottom of an 8x8x2 pan. Place the remaining cheese in a bowl and set aside. When the cheese is melted, pour the sauce over the cheese and stir so that the cranberry and ginger have dissolved. Top with the remaining cheese and sprinkle with the parmigiano. Bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes or until bubbly and slightly browned.

Random Ingredients: chive,lite olive oil,italian parsley,pizza dough,vanilla,maple syrup,green enchilada sauce,orange zest
title: Red and Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 1 tablespoon orange zest, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped | 1 teaspoon minced italian parsley | 1/4 cup lite olive oil | 1 package prepared pizza dough, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon maple syrup
instructions: For each tortilla stack, spoon 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce into the center of the tortilla. Roll the tortilla and place seam side down on paper towels to dry. In shallow pan over medium heat, combine the remaining 1/2 cup of sauce, vanilla, orange zest, chives, and parsley. Cook until thick and hot, about 3 minutes. Set in the oven, and bake for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, roll the pizza dough and cut into 3 x 2 inch sticks. Arrange the strips in a lightly greased 9 x13 inch baking dish. Spoon reserved sauce mixture over the tortillas and bake for 10 minutes, until the enchiladas are hot and bubbly. Serve warm.

title: Fried Fruit on French Toast
ingredients: 4 -5 medium firm fruits | 1 chicken stock cube | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro | 3/4 cup gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Dice any kind of fruit. In a frying pan fry on high heat some pieces until lightly golden. Drain onto paper towels. Place all of your french toast bits onto the skillet/pan and fry till nicely browned. Place in a plate and sprinkle with the grated cheese,. Enjoy,.

Random Ingredients: leek,red pepper flake,cherry brandy,caribbean jerk seasoning,clear honey,pumpkin seed,halibut fillet
title: Jerk Halibut in Chocolate Syrup
ingredients: 4 skinless halibut fillets | 1 1/2 teaspoons caribbean jerk seasoning ( mccormick brand ) | 2 leeks, coarsely chopped ( white and light green parts only ) | 1/4 cup clear honey | 1/8 cup cherry brandy ( or cognac ) | 1/8 cup roasted salted pumpkin seeds | 1/8 cup hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulled hulls | 1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a cast iron grill or boiler over medium high heat. Rub jerk seasoning on both sides of halibut fillets, and grill over medium heat until both sides are deep golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes, measured easily with a meat thermometer. Allow salmon to rest about 5 minutes before slicing crosswise into 2 to 3 pieces. Melt honey in a small, heavy saucepan over medium low heat, and stir in cherry brandy. Boil until reduced to approximately 1/2 cup, about 12 minutes. Stir honey mixture, and set aside. Rinse hulled hulled hulls with water to clean, dry, and dry. Spread both sides of fish with honey mixture, and grill over medium heat until fish is rare, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Reduce heat to low. Place halibut between two plates, and surround with warm salsa. Serve with a fresh pita and cucumber wedges.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,serrano chilies,fish stock,ginger garlic paste,fruit
title: Sour Cream - Fresh and Easy
ingredients: 1/2 cup fish stock ( any kind of fish stock works best ) | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno, chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 3/4 cup dried fruit
instructions: Combine everything in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and simmer for 2 minutes, remove from heat. Allow to sit for 5 - 10 minutes, then strain into bowl, cover and refrigerate till ready to serve. Bring to room temp before serving with meat or rice. Serve with fresh fruit or chutney.

title: Roquefort (Serves Many)
ingredients: 8 jalapeno peppers | 1 large sweet red pepper
instructions: Split red pepper into strips and place in bowl of electric blender with 3/4 cup hot water. Place in colander to drain excess water. Cut peppers into 1 slices. Place in baking dish, cover with remaining 1/2 cup water and cover with lid, press down gently. Let sit for 1 1/2 hours. When cool enough to handle, remove seeds, place in a spice mill and grind into a puree. Place in a blender and process until smooth. Transfer to a covered container and store in refrigerator until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,tarragon,worcestershire sauce,chili sauce,cranberry,salmon steak,baby bok choy,spanish onion
title: Smoked Salmon Florentine
ingredients: 3 salmon steaks | 6 baby bok choy | 1 medium spanish onion | 1 can enchilada sauce ( can use green mayo ) | 3/4 cup chili sauce | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon tarragon | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries
instructions: Preheat grill to medium. Cut onion in half and slice lengthwise into 3 inch pieces, or slice thinly. Place in grill basket with the salmon on top of each other. Grill the salmon, with the lid closed, for about 8 minutes or until cooked through, turning once. While salmon is grilling, clean baby bok choy and trim stems. Set aside. Drain and remove any skin from filets on each side. Set aside. Remove salmon from grill. Spray grill basket with non stick cooking spray. Place on grill basket and add your sliced onion, cover, and cook until onion is slightly softened. Remove from grill. While vegetables are cooking place enchilada sauce, worcestershire sauce, tarragon, dried cranberries, and chili sauce in pan on medium heat. Cook for a couple of minutes so flavors can blend. Slice salmon and place on top of mixed vegetables and sauce. Cover and cook until tender. Serve with hot cooked baguette, noodles, or rice.

title: Easy Faux-Baked Tortellini
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen cheese tortellini | 1 -2 tablespoon margarine | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce liquid smoke | 1 orange, juice of | 1 jar pimientos, diced
instructions: Start by boiling water for the tortellini according to directions, but don't throw out the water, drain and set aside. If you have 3 - 3 ounce bags of frozen grated cheese tortellini, you might actually need a little more to fit in the bag. Cook in microwave, stirring once or twice. Add the pimientos and toss to coat. Drain the tortellini, reserving the liquid. Add the drained tortellini to the skillet and add enough orange juice, zest, juice and zest from 1/2 lemon, juice and zest from 1/2 orange, juice and zest from 1/4 lemon. Mix well. title: The Easiest Chutney Ever!

title: Vinegrethes

instructions: Spray a 2 cup baking dish with cooking spray. Cut the provolone into 2 strips and place onto dish. Brush with vinegar and sprinkle with rice wine. Bake in a 200 degrees f oven until the cheese melts.

instructions: In a saucepan, combine the mushrooms, molasses, cocoa, and red chile pepper. Heat through and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Prawn Prawns
ingredients: 240 g lump crabmeat | 400 g tomatoes soup | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons pimentos, chopped | 1 teaspoon chopped coriander | 2 red chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon parsley, chopped
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the prawns, prawns and parsley. Mix well. Place prawns in a shallow dish and pour over the marinade. title: Jamaican Pork Dinner
ingredients: 8 ounces ground ham | 12 ounces pork chops, cut into thirds | 8 ounces cooked ham, sliced | 8 ounces navy beans, drained | 2 jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | 3 cans refrigerated crescent rolls | 1/3 cup navy beans, mashed | 3 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In large nonstick skillet, saute hamburger, pork, ham and beans in butter. Remove from heat. Unroll crescents, separate into 4 rectangles. title: Spinach and Tuna Guacamole
ingredients: 2 medium ripe avocados | 2 teaspoons currants ( or raisins ) | 1/4 cup tuna in olive oil, drained
instructions: Cut the avocados up into halves lengthwise and remove the pit. Using a spoon, scoop out the pit and carefully remove the flesh. Cut into 1/4 inch dice and place in a medium bowl. Add the currants or raisins. Cut the tuna into chunks and add the tuna. Mash it with the fork. You can cover with plastic wrap to prevent it from browning. Refrigerate the guacamole at least an hour. Serve with your favourite quesadillas for squeezing or with pita triangles.

title: French Bread - Bagels
ingredients: 1 loaf sweet italian bread | 8 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Slice sweet bread into 1/4 x 2 slices. Spread taco seasoning on both sides of bread. Sprinkle sugar over bread. Place in foil lined skillet. Cook on medium high heat for about 10 minutes or until warmed through. Serve with salsa if desired.

title: Black Olives With White Chocolates
ingredients: 250 g white chocolate | 100 g pitted black olives | 1 egg white
instructions: Whip the egg white until soft peaks form.

title: Scrumptious Alfredo Pasta Dough
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1 tablespoon tamari | 2 cups prepared alfredo sauce, chilled | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a mixing or large bowl, combine the flour and tamari. Gradually pour the jar of chilled alfredo sauce over the flour until all the liquid has been absorbed and the texture is smooth. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide it into 2 pieces. With floured hands, pat each piece out until it is about 1/4 inch thickness. Roll each pasta ball out into a rectangle about 1/4 inch thick. Using a cookie cutter or a sharp knife, cut 10 1/2 inch circles the length of your pasta machine's name, or as needed for 2 - 9 inch squares. Lay the pasta into the machine and set it on the dough. Start the machine creating the scalloped pasta into 8 - 12 servings. Press each circle with your finger and cut a hole in the center of each. If the filling is not filling to your taste, cover and allow to rise for about 10 minutes. Cook the filled pasta in boiling water until al dente, which should take about 9 - 10 minutes. Drain and toss with the parsley. Serve hot.

title: Roasted Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced garlic salt | 1 teaspoon black powder | 3/4 cup minced iceberg lettuce | 2 cups fresh blackberries
instructions: Place steak in a plastic bag set in a cool place to prevent drying out while grilling. In a bowl combine oil, vinegar, garlic salt, and black powder. Add beef and mix well. Serve on lettuce lined plates. Garnish with blackberries.

title: Basic French Dressing

title: Lamb and Mozzarella Pasta

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Heat 1/4 cup of the sauce in a small sauce pan over medium heat. Cook lamb until browned. Drain. Transfer meat to a large bowl.

title: Beef Tenderloin with Lentils

title: Bunny Peeps

instructions: Blanch the bamboo shoots in boiling water for 2 minutes. Slip and devein. Cut into fine pieces. Fry the onions and garlic in some oil until golden. title: Sopa Ranchera - Stuffed Rice Balls
ingredients: 2 lbs extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 lb sweet lilyfinger, split lengthwise | 1/2 lb small dried pepitas pod, cut into 4-6 rounds ( or 1 cup dried split peas ) | 12 -15 grape tomatoes, halved | 2 2 pints cherry tomatoes or 2 pints cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup quick-cooking club soda, for adding to the ball | 3 ounces medium grain white rice ( about 1 1/2 cups in volume ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Note, the recipe states to freeze the rice, but i don't think it can be done. If using a large bowl, put the rice with enough ice cold water to cover on top, and allow to come to room temperature before proceeding.. You can do this in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade, by pulsing 2 or 3 times to break up the chunks of cheese. It is not as smooth as coarsely ground cheese. You can also stuff the rice with some of the cheese too. If you wish, you may put the cheese in a bowl. You can roll the cheese and pepitas together into 4 smaller, uniform balls or place them in your freezer at least 3 hours and have them on the counter, or do the same with the peas. You do not want to end up having giant balls, about 1 1/2 pounds at one time. Just roll them and freeze or label and freeze. The cheese balls may be used in any form. You might also stuff them in a ziploc bag with some cheese, place in your freezer and add about 2 or 3 tablespoons of club soda into the bag, then put into your freezer. This way, you can do things about the process 2 or 3 times. When you are ready to bake them, add the rice to a pot of boiling water and, stirring well, cook the rice until the liquid has boiled off and the rice has turned translucent. This should take about 20 to 30 minutes. Remove the rice from the bowl of ice, and set aside. Drain, rinse under cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Make a hole in the bottom of each tomato half, place the tomatoes close together in a baking pan, cover by about an inch, and top each tomato with about 2 tablespoons of cheese. Place tomato halves under a hot broiler or in a large skillet over medium heat. If using a frying pan, you might want to put a paper towel or kitchen towel inside the pan to protect the tomatoes from splattering. Put the pan over high heat until the cheese starts to melt. Add the rice balls, 1 to 2 at a time, and roll around so they form a large ball. Cook until they’ve begun to stick when you touch them. When all 3 balls are rolled in the cheese, carefully remove them from the pan and place them in the oven to finish cooking, 5 to 8 minutes. Remove the tomatoes before serving. Served warm or at room temperature. If you wish, you can sprinkle a little mace over the balls just before serving.

instructions: In a medium saucepan melt butter over medium heat. Mix in rice vinegar. Cook until butter has melted and mixture is bubbly, stirring constantly. Carefully mix in half and half.

instructions: Bring all ingredients to a simmer in a large pan or saucepan. Serve with your favourite fish fillets.

instructions: Position rack in middle and preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Drain corn.

title: Linguine With Apricots and Brown Rice - Fast and Easy!
ingredients: 1 package pillsbury reg rolls | 1 package linguine, i use whole wheat | 2 cans pillsbury deluxe light and fluffy light brown rice sticks | 1 package dried apricot halves, chopped ( not the dried halves ) | 1/2 cup quick cooking brown rice ( i used success 13/14 oz bags of rice noodles, i use jasmine ) | kosher salt
instructions: Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Add the rice noodles and cook them according to package directions. They should take less than 7 - 10 minutes. instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spread one sheet of the lasagna sheets with oil and spray with a no stick cooking spray. Layer 2 sheets with cashews and then 1/3 of the cheese. Repeat twice. Layer remaining lasagna sheets with remaining ingredients. Pour vegetable stock into 8x8x2 pan and cover with foil. Bake for one hour. Uncover and bake for 30 more minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Fried Pork With Hazelnut Browner
ingredients: 1 kg pork chop, with fat trimmed | 2 bunches goats cheese, cut into pieces | 20 g ground hazelnuts | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 300 g pearl wheat or 300 g couscous | 1 1/3 cups sifted rye flour ( available as packet ) | 1 large bunch of gourmet roasted hazelnuts, roughly chopped | couscous, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c/170°c fan/350°f/gas cut the pork chops into 3 inch pieces. Bake the pork in a roasting tray for 15 minutes, turning often, until golden brown. Place in a large bowl, crumble over the goats cheese and mix with the ground hazelnuts and sesame oil. Transfer the pork to a large ceramic backing tin. Place the couscous in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Set aside for 8 minutes or until softened. With a fork, stir well to break up the strands and set aside. Place the pan of oil over a high heat, when it starts smoking, stir in the flours. When the flour starts sizzling, add in the hazelnut and pork. Cook for 2 or 3 minutes, stirring continuously, then reduce the heat, stir in the couscous and cook for another 2 or 3 minutes or until the couscous is tender, stirring from time to time. Remove from the heat. Serve with sliced gourmet roasted hazelnuts sprinkled over the top.

title: Papas and Chicken
ingredients: 1 box frozen chicken cutlets, thawed | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 pie shell, ready-made, unbaked
instructions: Unroll pie shell on a cookie sheet or baking pan. Place chicken cutlets in an unbaked pie shell. Stir beans into the baked crust. Cover completely with remaining pie shell. Preheat the oven to 475 degrees f. Bake for 30 minutes, or until crust is browned and chicken juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,dark soy sauce,stock chicken,garbanzo bean
title: Faux Dumplings
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained well | 1 small stock or 1 small chicken | 40 wonton wrappers | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl, filling mixture only half full. Mix well.. Place a teaspoon of the filling in the center of a wrapper. Brush edges of wrapper lightly with water. Fold in both sides of wrapper over to encase filling. If you find it difficult to gather the filling, you may need to use a pastry cutter to help you. Deep fry the dumplings until golden brown.

title: Nan's Apricot Appetizer Cookies, (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 2 cups dried apricots | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Line baking sheets with foil, or coat with cooking spray. Using a spoon, poke holes in the dried apricots. Place several handfuls of apricots at a time onto the lined sheet, spaced slightly apart. Sprinkle with salt. Press gently to spread, then cut the apricots into pieces. If all the apricots are not pressed, continue cutting. Bake in the preheated oven until well colored and well dried through, 10 to 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,vodka,mozzarella cheese,baking potato,chipotle chile,spinach leaf,port wine,strawberry
title: Smoky Potato & Spinach Pizza
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes, peeled & cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can chickpeas | 3 ounces port wine | 1 ounce vodka | 1/2 cup frozen spinach leaves or 1/2 cup collard leaves, defrosted | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 -2 canned chipotle chile, stemmed & chopped ( with seeds ) | 12 fresh strawberries
instructions: Place potato and chickpeas in microwave on high heat & cook for 2 to 4 minutes. Let cool & set aside. Place port, vodka & spinach in blender & puree until smooth add spinach mixture & chipoltes & blend again until smooth. Spread dough out evenly evenly on baking sheet, sprinkle with mozzarella & top with potatoes & chickpeas. Bake in 400 degree oven for 5 to 10 minutes, until golden & cheese has started to melt. Cut into 16 wedges & serve.

title: Hot Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar jalapeno peppers, minced | 2 cups corn syrup | 2 cups spanish onions, minced | 1 cup cornstarch | 1 tablespoon corn syrup
instructions: In sauce pan, bring the corn syrup, onion, and cornstarch to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in the hot pepper sauce. Let cool. Chill for 2 hours. Stir together. Store and reheat. Use as a dipping sauce with corn tortillas, tortillas, or other meat.

title: Oregon Coast Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 pound sea scallops | 1/2 pound canadian bacon, sliced into 1/4-inch pieces | 1/3 cup vinegar | 1/3 cup ice water | 1 package tortilla chips | 2 cups crushed tortilla chips
instructions: In a medium bowl, place scallops, canadian bacon, and vinegar. Pour in ice water, and mix until coated. Cover, and refrigerate until seafood is opaque, at least 15 minutes. Place 2 crushed tortilla chips onto a plate. Remove seafood from shells, and place on top of warmed tortillas. Serve with crushed tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,cilantro leaf,basmati rice,lettuce leaf,brown sugar,thai basil
title: Creamy Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 4 -5 cups lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup firmly packed fresh basil | 1/2 cup chopped fresh thai basil | 6 rice cups | chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Heat whipping cream in medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to boiling.

title: Italian Whole Wheat Flat Bread
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour or 1 cup gluten-free flour | 14 1/2 ounces parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit. Place all dry ingredients in a blender or food processor and pulse until mixed. Gradually add oil and blend until combined well. Shape dough into two 6 - 8 round rolls, about 2 inches thick. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fried Fish With Flowers (Vietnamese Croung Kho Ga)
ingredients: 1/2 lb cod or 1/2 lb haddock, cleaned well | 3 -4 tablespoons sliced crystallized ginger ( about 1/4-1/2 inch long ) | 2 cups walnut pieces or 2 cups pistachios | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh edible flowers ( optional, optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Cut fish into 6 serving pieces. Set aside and refrigerate marinade. Combine ginger, walnuts, and mint. Sprinkle a little cardamom on fish. Spread the ginger mixture on fish pieces. Heat oil in a wok until a drop of water sizzles when dropped into it. Drop a few pieces in and fry, turning over occasionally, until fish is golden, about 3 - 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,celery,blueberry,bay leaf,heavy whipping cream,rice noodle,caraway seed
title: Blueberry Mustard
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 5 cups heavy whipping cream | 3 cups diced carrots | 3 cups diced celery | 2 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary | 7 bay leaves | 1 tablespoon caraway seeds
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook rice noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain. Place noodles in a bowl.

title: Polvorones Rellenos
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine | 6 ounces canned beets | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup buttermilk, for cooking
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions or till al dente. Drain. Rinse beets and pat dry thoroughly, set aside. Place beets in a saucepan on medium heat. Saute for 5 - 7 minutes, add soup. Add balsamic vinegar, turmeric powder and mix well. Simmer for 5 minutes or till beets are cooked and soup is thick. In a small bowl, combine buttermilk and reserved beet mixture with 2 tbsp flour, stir well until smooth, then add to soup mixture and stir well. Serve over noodles.

title: Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup dried sage leaves
instructions: Crush the sage leaves and combine with the oil.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,chocolate square,onion flake,fenugreek seed,prosciutto,vanilla bean,water chestnut,beef broth
title: Italian Meatball Soup
ingredients: 8 ounces diced meatballs ( or lean ground beef ) | 1 can water chestnuts ( drained or sliced ) | 1/4 small onion, chopped | 1 cup chopped prosciutto | 1 chocolate square ( or 1/2 - 1 cup of your choice of chocolate ) | 1 cup beef broth | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla beans, seeds or 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Brown meatballs and drain. Mix with remaining ingredients in crock pot. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours or high 6 - 8 hours. Or cook on high 4 - 6 hours, stirring twice, until meatballs are soft.

title: Baked Costa Rican Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 large ripe tomatoes | 1 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon coconut oil | poblano peppers or other chili pepper | 1 1/2 cups thick fresh tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f cut off stem ends of tomato and discard. Scoop out pulp leaving about 1/4 thick shell. Scoop out seeds and ribs from tomato. Combine coconut oil and 1/4 cup broth and brush over shells. Sprinkle each with about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the reserved tomato pulp, reserving some for garnish. Arrange shells in a shallow baking pan and roast in oven for 20 minutes, turning from time to time until lightly golden on all sides. Watch closely to not burn. Transfer to serving platter. Serve with thick tomato sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,phyllo pastry,pecorino cheese,olive,red pepper,cooking wine,lasagna noodle,jasmine rice
title: Shrimp and Rice Cannelloni With Pecorino Cheese (Caraoura Al Pomodoro)
ingredients: 12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 ounces dried lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup cooking wine | 12 ounces arborio rice or 12 ounces carnaroli rice | 1/8 teaspoon crushed dry red pepper | 8 ounces pecorino cheese, cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup olive, stuffed | 16 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions & drain. Meanwhile, cook shrimps in boiling water for a few seconds, drain & set aside. Place shrimp in a small dish & add the wine & stir to coat. Set aside. Preheat oven to 400°f. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add rice & then stir in red pepper & set aside. Place 2 phyllo sheets on a greased and lightly floured baking sheet. Brush sheets with olive oil & place 2 shrimps in centre of each sheet. Divide rice, shrimps & red pepper among shrimp's on each sheet. Cover with 1 more sheet of phyllo, brushing each with oil & placing another lightly floured sheet on top. Repeat with all the phyllo sheets, shrimps & red pepper until all sheets are used. Lay 8 shrimp in the centre of each sheet & fold pastry over shrimp to make a half moon shape. Place cannelloni in a single layer on baking sheet & brush with olive oil. Bake in preheated oven until browned & crisp, about 40 minutes. Top with cheese & place back in oven to melt cheese & make it a little bubbly. Sprinkle with remaining chopped pecorino cheese before serving.

Random Ingredients: giardiniera,red cabbage,brown mustard seed,extra virgin olive oil
title: Mock Red Slaw
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage ( about 2 pounds ) | 1 jar giardiniera ( italian pickled red olives ) | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons prepared brown mustard seeds
instructions: Quarter cabbage lengthwise and rinse. Fill a large bowl with ice water. Place the cabbage, pickled olives, olive oil, mustard seeds and kosher salt in a pot or dutch oven and cover with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and boil gently, 2 to 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Turn off heat and let stand 5 minutes. Remove the slaw from the bowl. Cover and refrigerate the slaw for at least 1 hour.

title: Wild Rice and Brown Sugar (Or Not)
ingredients: 2 cups wild rice ( rinsed and cleaned, but not sure of the size ) | 4 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( more or less, to taste )
instructions: Place rice in a bowl that will fit over 1 quart of water, cover with plastic wrap and water.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,cherry tomato,chicken tender,rump steak,ginger garlic paste
title: Chicken Breasts Stuffed in Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 600 g chicken tender ( or equivalent weight chicken breast, or equivalent weight turkey ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce ( such as heinz ) or 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved ( or equivalent weight cherry tomatoes ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 teaspoons dried cherry tomatoes, cut in halves
instructions: Cut chicken breast in half if large and score into 3 pieces. Place them in a bowl and mash or pound them until the desired length of the breast is achieved. Add ginger garlic paste, the cherry tomatoes and chile sauce. Add the yeast, mix, cover, and let stand for 30 minutes to ferment in the juices. Transfer the chicken to a container with a tight fitting lid and marinate in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes. Boil water to a boil and add the cherry tomatoes. Boil gently for about two minutes, then remove from heat and gently drain through a sieve into a bowl. Remove chicken from marinade. Place marinated chicken pieces, skin side down, on a clean surface. Spoon or pipe a layer of tomato mixture into each cavity. Sprinkle each piece with dried cherry tomato halves, and cover with plastic wrap. Allow to rise until doubled in bulk, about 45 minutes. Drain the chicken pieces through a sieve placed over a dish and discard marinade.

title: Gator Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned chicken stock | 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons ground habanero pepper, or more to taste, if desired
instructions: Combine the chicken stock, teriyaki sauce, and habanero pepper in a pot over medium heat. Bring to a boil, and simmer while whisking constantly, until the sauce boils and thickens, 2 to 3 minutes. Use immediately, or refrigerate to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,baby lima bean,asparagus,barbecue sauce,white pepper
title: Barbecue Lima Beans and Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bag baby lima bean or ( 3 lb ) bag frozen limas beans | 1 bottle barbecue sauce | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 lb asparagus or 1/2 lb baby lima beans, trimmed
instructions: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients except lima beans, and heat until mixture boils and flavors are blended. Toss and simmer 2 - 3 minutes or until hot.

title: Oregon Coast Clam and Portuguese Sausage
ingredients: 4 links chorizo sausage | 3 pounds salmon fillets | 1 tablespoon italian-style spice, or to taste | 20 littleneck clams, cleaned
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat. Line the bottom of a large pot with thick aluminum foil.

title: Noodle Vlassi
ingredients: 200 g egg noodles ( about 8oz/person ) | 2 teaspoons lime juice ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the instructions in the packet. Drain the noodles and toss them through the lime juice for a further minute. Divide between 4 serving bowls and serve with bread and fruit compote.

title: Spicy Chinese Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken meat, and leg | 2 teaspoons szechuan peppercorns, ground | 12 teaspoons spicy shaoxing wine-based shaoxing wine-based shaoxing wine-based cooking wine | 1/2 teaspoon peppermint extract, for the garnish
instructions: Place chicken in a baking dish in small increments, sprinkling each with half a teaspoon of the sichuan pepper. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, bring wine to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Boil for a full 1 minute. Remove chicken from marinade and drain on paper towels. When cool enough to handle cut into bite size pieces. Transfer marade to a bowl and season each piece with half a teaspoon of the peppermint extract. Place chicken salad in refrigerator for 2 hours. Bake salad covered at 375f for 35 - 45 minutes. Serve the chicken topped with the sauce that was created by dipping the chicken pieces into.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,beef stew meat,red chili pepper,lamb
title: Lamb and Pine Nut Stew (Mujadarra)
ingredients: 3 lbs meaty beef stew meat | 1 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 red chili peppers, sliced | 1/2 cup dried red chili pepper, minced
instructions: Place all ingredients in electric pressure cooker and cook on high heat until meat and nuts are tender, about 40 minutes.

title: Baked Scallops
ingredients: 1 cup maple flavored stuffing ( may use canned maple flavor ) | 1/4 lb salt pork ( deli meats may be substituted ) | 2 radishes, sliced | 12 large fresh scallops ( may use large scallops or halibut ) | asiago cheese, grated ( optional garnish )
instructions: Cut cheese/sausage into 1 x 1 inch slabs. Place them in a buttered baking dish, and bake in a pre heated 350 degree oven for 15 minutes, turning them over halfway through, to brown the cheese on all sides. When the dish is done, pour the maple stuffing over the scallop shells, and sprinkle with asiago cheese.

title: Cambodian Beef Curry
ingredients: 750 g beef, cubed | 10 ml red curry paste
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c. Mix beef cubes with curry paste and place on a greased tray bake for 30 minutes at 200°c.

Random Ingredients: galliano,chicken breast,italian herb,liquid smoke,guacamole,green olive,picante sauce
title: Pollo a la Gringo
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breasts | 1 jar diced green olives | 1 jar picante sauce | 1 bottle roasted garlic and herb blends | 1 bottle galliano | 1 jar liquid smoke | 3/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a large stock pot, and fill with enough water to cover the chicken by 1/2 inch. Add the olives, picante sauce, roasted garlic, herb blends, and galliano. Bring to a boil, and then reduce heat to low. Simmer for 2 weeks, skimming any foam as it rises to the top. Season with liquid smoke. Continue cooking until the chicken juices run clear and sauce in the pan have reduced by 1/ mix in guacamole and serve over your favorite tortillas.

title: Chickpea-Omani
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked chick-peas | 1/2 cup uncooked black beans | 1/8 cup unsweetened cocoa, melted
instructions: Place ingredients in a blender and blend on high until smooth. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.

title: Crazy Canadian Bacon Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb country canadian bacon, chopped | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 4 cups hot water | 6 ounces plain greek yogurt | shredded croutons or bread toasted rye bread
instructions: Saute the hot water and mushrooms in a skillet with a little bit of salt. Allow them to reconstitute in a blender. Pour into a large heavy pot adding the sauteed mushrooms and cook on medium heat for about 30 minutes. While thats still hot, add 1 - 2 tablespoons of yoghurt and about six 5 oz slices of cooked bacon. Mix it all together. Simmer for about a minute or two before serving so your bowls don't burn. Serve with toppings of your choice. You can also put sour cream on top if you want.

title: Mexican Green Chili Powder  (For Canning)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons golden raisins ( or equivalent amount of dried salted peanuts ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 -2 green chili, deseeded, deseeded and chopped
instructions: Put 3 tablespoons of the raisins, 1 1/2 teaspoons of the creole seasoning, and the chile into a spice mill. Grind into a fine powder. Use in canning. Nb, the longer this can is stored, the better. The longer this canning, the stronger the seasoning and less chile powder. I have never made the salt this way, but you may have to use 2 teaspoons of salt or 1 teaspoon of sugar. I have used regular salt, 2 teaspoons of dried lemon juice, and about 2 tablespoons of ground turmeric in place of the creole seasoning. I have deliberately not given any measures of the mixture.

Random Ingredients: salmon steak,water artichoke heart,tabasco sauce,black mushroom,liquid smoke
title: Mushroom Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup fresh mushrooms, chopped | 1 can water-packed artichoke hearts, undrained | 2 -3 dashes tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 4 salmon steaks ( about 1 1/2 inch thick )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except salmon in a large bowl. Place salmon in an oiled broilerproof pan. Brush with remaining 1/4 cup nonstick spray. Broil, 3 inches from the heat, in a 425 degree f oven for 10 minutes. Turn fish and continue broiling for about 5 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,french bread,vanilla essence,wheat flour,pepperoncini pepper,spaghetti squash
title: Pepperoncini Spaghetti Squash Fritters
ingredients: 2 medium spaghetti squash ( i like mini smaller squash ) | 1/2 cup spaghetti squash ( diced ) | 2 fluid ounces spaghetti sauce ( spaghetti sauce is good ) | 2 tablespoons white pepperoncini peppers ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup vegetable protein ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 3 -5 tablespoons whole wheat flour ( all purpose, not gluten free )
instructions: Put spaghetti squash in a baking dish and lightly season with salt & pepper, then mix in veg oil and pour over the spaghetti squash. Bake in a 425°f oven for 30 minutes, turning and cooking until spaghetti squash is tender. Once cooked, put spaghetti squash in a large bowl and mix up the spaghetti sauce throughly, then pour the spaghetti and spaghetti sauce over the spaghetti squash and serve with a few whole grain pita bread patties.

title: Chef John's Easy Indian Flatbread
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 teaspoon ginger paste
instructions: Using a cookie cutter or a dough hook, cut out 12 rounds, then place the rounds on a lightly floured surface. Combine the ginger and ginger paste in a pestle and mortar. Place a teaspoon of ginger paste into each round, on top of the ginger paste and pinch a little bit of the top to seal the edges. Place the flatbreads on a parchment, non stick tray or lined baking sheet.. Spray the tops with a little milk. Lightly flour each round and bake the flatbreads at 500 degrees f for 11 to 12 minutes, until puffed up and golden. Allow the flatbreads to cool for a minute or two before eating as they have a tendency to puff up. Store stored or sealed in airtight containers.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,creole seasoning,basmati rice,bailey irish cream,arrowroot,cooking spray,baguette
title: Baked Dessert Bread With Irish Cream Sauce
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 baguette, loaf | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1/4 cup ailey's irish cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 3 cups basmati rice | 1/3 cup arrowroot, dissolved in | 1/3 cup boiling water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat 8x8 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Remove bread from baguette loaf.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,spaghetti,yellow zucchini,green chile pepper,radish,onion salt,yellow bell pepper,taco seasoning mix
title: Tortilla Tacos
ingredients: spaghetti | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup finely chopped yellow zucchini, yellow or orange, | 1/4 cup finely chopped green chile peppers, such as anaheim | 1/4 cup chopped yellow sweet bell pepper | 1/4 cup finely chopped yellow sweet red sweet potato with chilies, such as anaheim | 3 radishes, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion salt | green pickled radish slices ( optional )
instructions: Prepare spaghetti as directed on package. Drain and cool slightly. Meanwhile, stir together taco seasoning mix, zucchini, chilies, sweet potatoes, green radishes, and onion salt. Spoon the mixture into a large, nonstick frying pan. Cook at medium high heat, stirring often, for about 5 minutes, or until hot and bubbly. Spoon about 1/4 cup meat, or if desired, onto a warmed tortilla. Top with reserved zucchini mixture.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin oil,chipotle pepper,chicken breast half,ginger,gin,peanut
title: Applebee's Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin oil, or more as needed | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded 1/2 inch thickness | 1/2 cup chopped, unsalted dry roasted peanuts ( such as peanuts ) | 1 jar chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, sliced, sauce reserved | 2 tablespoons ginger, cut into 1/4-inch matchsticks | 1 bottle gin, chilled
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Sear chicken, 3 to 5 minutes on each side. Cover and allow to rest 5 minutes. Mix peanuts and chipotle chiles together with chicken in a bowl. Add half of the chipotle sauce mixture. Stir until blended. Stir in ginger. Pour remaining sauce into the pan. Return chicken to heat. Cover and continue cooking until chicken is nearly cooked through, about 8 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning. Top chicken with peanuts. Serve with chilled gin.

Random Ingredients: verjuice,marinade,pineapple chunk,baby spinach leaf,black tea,seasoning salt,cornstarch,jiffy cornbread mix
title: Easy Jiffy Slushy Spinach & Pineapple Tea Snack
ingredients: 1 box jiffy cornbread mix | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 3 cups baby spinach rolls | 16 ounces canned pineapple chunks, drained & chopped | 1/4 cup brewed black tea ( i like decaf ) | 14 ounces pineapple juice ( fresh ) | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/2 teaspoon black tea ( optional ) | 1 dash seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon cornstarch ( heaping )
instructions: Prepare cornbread according to package directions. Cool completely and slice into triangles about 2 inches wide and 2 inch long. Place in a large microwavable bowl & fill with water. Cover & microwave at high 1 minute or until mixture reaches 165 degrees f. It should take about 20 to 45 minutes to fully soften then it will be slightly less crunchy. Drain & cool completely before storing in an airtight container in the refrigerator. To make the jiffy slushy spinach, combine the spinach, pineapple juice, & spices. Toss well until well combined. To make the tea cracker, mix the cornstarch & tea & refrigerate until cold then add to the spinach mixture a tablespoon at a time, mix well. If mixture is too dry to hold shape, add more tea and refrigerate until needed. To serve, sprinkle crackers with the slushie mix.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,cream mushroom soup,thyme leaf,white flour,ramen noodle,dark sesame oil,tomato paste
title: My Favorite Ramen Casserole #5FIX
ingredients: 32 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 2 -3 garlic cloves, minced | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves, crushed | 1 dash light sesame oil | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 package ramen noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Heat soups in a large bowl in a microwave until hot. Add garlic, sesame oil, thyme, and light sesame oil. Whisk together. In a 4 or 5 gallon baking dish, mix soup mixture and half the ramen noodles. Cover with 1 tablespoon white flour. Sprinkle remaining ramen noodles on top of soup mixture. Pour remaining soup mixture over ramen noodles. Coat with remaining white flour. Sprinkle with remaining ramen noodles. Cover and microwave for 20 minutes at.

title: Rum-Spiced Steak and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 2-inch cubes | 2 quarts beef stock or 2 quarts canned low sodium beef broth, divided | 2 bottles dark rum | 2 packages frozen peas ( i prefer yellow ) | 2/3 cup dried cracked peas | 1/2 tablespoon chili powder | ice
instructions: Place beef cubes in 4 - 5 quart dutch oven over med heat. Add 2 quarts stock, whiskey, rum and peas. Bring to a simmer over high heat, then stir. Cover and braise until the meat is tender, but not browned, about 1 1/2 hours. Remove from heat and stir in the seasonings. Serve.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,yogurt,wheat flour,cayenne pepper,liquid honey
title: Kurdish Style Yogurt
ingredients: 3 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Combine cream of chicken soup, yogurt, honey and cayenne pepper in bowl. Mix well until well blended. Stir in whole wheat flour until well blended. Chill overnight. Kurdish the yogurt with a fork, and refrigerate overnight for sweetness. This is best served at room temperature. Kurdish this can be served cold, but kurdish does not have an accompanying party show and does not rise as well.

title: Guaco - Mexican Chefs
ingredients: 12 ounces cheeseses, brick style cut into 1/3 & quot, cubes | 1 lb raisins | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, grated | 2 tablespoons guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350f. Place cheese cube on foil or parchment paper about 2 inches sqd from the bottom of the foil or parchment, leaving approximately 1/2 of it uncovered to let steam out. Add raisins, parsley, sugar, syrup & lemon peel to a non stick non stick skillet & cook over med. Heat until sugar dissolves. As soon as the syrup starts to bubble, transfer the hot cheese cubes to a shallow, 1 1/3 & quot, baking pan. Add the guacamole then sprinkle the cheese evenly over the top & bake for about 25 - 30 min until crust is crisp & golden & cheese is melted & bubbly. Remove from oven and cut into squares or diamonds. Allow to stand 10 min then remove parchment or crisp foil or crispier cheese. Serve hot or warm.

title: Easy French Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon italian spices | 1/2 cup sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Slice bread into 1/2 inch cubes. Arrange on cookie sheet, and bake for about five minutes. Add oil and remaining spices to a frying pan, and heat until fragrant. Add wine, and warm until liquids are reduced by half. Add bread cubes, and toss. Serve warm.

title: Curried Red Cabbage With Key Lime Juice
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon arrowroot | oil, for fry and deep-frying | 2 tablespoons curry, green | 3 tablespoons key limes, juice of or 3 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, chopped finely ( cherry coos is recommended )
instructions: Combine the curry with the lime juice in a small bowl and set aside. Boil a few tablespoons of water in a large pot. Add the cabbage to the boiling water and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and run cold water over the cabbage before removing to a bowl. Mix the curry and arrowroot together. Set aside. In a large frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil and fry the curry paste for 2 or 3 minutes until fragrant. Add the key limes and cherry and stir for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Transfer the mixture into the bowl with the curry and toss thoroughly before serving.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock vegetable,pepper,taco seasoning,ancho chile powder
title: Ancho Chile Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon toasted ground dried ancho chile powder | 1 -2 teaspoon chicken stock or 1 -2 teaspoon vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | pepper
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl or resealable container. Mix together very well.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,cajun seasoning,salt,thyme leave,yellow bell pepper
title: Cajun-Style White
ingredients: 2 yellow bell peppers | 11 ounces cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried thyme leave | 1 dash cajun seasoning
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place yellow bell peppers directly on the rack.

title: Sour Ravioli
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup miracle whip | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1/2 teaspoon minced fresh ginger root
instructions: Mix tomatoes, 2/3 cup miracle whip, 1 teaspoon ginger, raisins, and 1/2 teaspoon ginger together in a bowl until smooth.

Random Ingredients: pork belly,soymilk,taco seasoning,ice cube,green chili,portabella mushroom
title: Mexican Poriyaki
ingredients: 2 dried portabella mushrooms | 4 boneless pork belly | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/2 cup soymilk | 2 -3 crushed ice cubes | 1/4 - 1/2 chopped green chili
instructions: Soak the mushroom over night in rum or sherry. Cut the cooked mushrooms in half, and remove the hard stems. If you are using canned mushrooms, soak them in rum or sherry for 1/4 hour. This is your 'game night'. Cut your pork belly into thin strips, about 1/4 inch long x 1/4 inch wide. Combine everything, except the water, in a large bowl, and let marinate for about 2 hours. Add the water last to keep the pieces moist while you are grilling the dish. Grill or fry the pork over a medium high heat for about 15 - 20 minutes, turning every couple of minutes. Serve the poriyaki hot in the pot, or over a bed of rice. Alternatively, put the poriyaki ingredients into a blender, let it sit on the bottom until ready to use if using a food processor so it will liquefy. This process goes much quicker and can be done in batches so you may have 2 or 3 batches.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,green cardamom pod,peanut oil,green tomato

 fried green tomatoes with parsley | 8 medium green tomatoes | 2 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley
