title: White Bean Hummus
ingredients: 2 cans white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 ounce provolone cheese, chopped | 1 ounce crusty italian bread ( soft bread will also work )
instructions: Open and drain the beans. Add the provolone cheese. Drain the bread and cut into small pieces, place on the surface of the casserole. Pour the beans over it. You can also add chopped tomatoes to this. Cover and store in the refrigerator overnight. The next day, remove the casserole from the fridge 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,vinegar,pearl barley,green curry paste,green onion,cumin,italian sausage
title: Creamy Italian Sausage Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage | 1 bunch green onion | 32 ounces frozen chopped broccoli | 1/4 cup sliced green onion | 1 1/2 tablespoons green curry paste ( i used thai kitchen brand ) | 2 tablespoons cumin | 2 tablespoons vinegar ( i used balsamic ) | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup canned low sodium chicken broth
instructions: Brown the italian sausage in a large pot with the green onions and green curry paste. Remove and set aside the casing from the green onions. Combine all ingredients except the sausage and broccoli in a stockpot. Bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 40 minutes. Add the sausage and broccoli and simmer for another 20 minutes or until sausage is cooked all the way through. Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Fish for Breakfast (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11)
ingredients: 400 g cod, in chunks | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, coarsely crushed | 3 tablespoons wheat germ
instructions: Remove the skin and bones of the fish and cut into bite sized pieces or chunks. Sprinkle with coriander seeds. Place fish pieces on to a dish and add warm wheat meal. Grill for about 5 minutes or until golden brown. Serve topped with minted coriander.

title: Ground Beef Swiss Chard Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 slices swiss chard ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/3 cup pasta, broken in half | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | 1 pizza crust
instructions: In a large skillet, brown ground beef. Drain excess grease from skillet. Add swiss chard. Diss chard will soften during cooking. Push to one side of skillet. Add bouillon cube. Simmer 5 - 10 minutes or until water has evaporated. Turn off burner. Add broken up pasta. Heat til hot and pasta is slightly soft. Stir in allspice. Preheat oven to 400°. Spread mixture over pizza crust. Bake 30 mins or until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: streaky bacon,white onion,mozzarella cheese,apple cider vinegar,french onion soup,fish
title: Frogmore
ingredients: 1 white onion, sliced | 150 g french onion soup | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 250 g smoked fish | 500 g smoked mozzarella cheese | 1/2 lb fresh smoked mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cook the onion and soup together. Place in a food processor with the smoked fish and puree. Place on top of the sauce and stir in the mozzarella until totally mixed. Top with the fresh mozzarella. Enjoy your frogmore recipe.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,onion,white breadcrumb,celery rib,fenugreek seed,broccoli,maple syrup
title: Broccoli Burgers (Burgers) With Mustard-Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs broccolini | 1/2 cup onion, minced | 1/4 cup celery rib, minced | 2 tablespoons dijon-style prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds, ground | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup fresh white breadcrumb
instructions: Cut broccoli into florets about 1/2 inches wide and 1/2 inch thick, if very large, cut into 12 florets.. Cook in boiling water until tender crisp, about 7 minutes. Drain and cool. Drain well. Broccolini, place broccoli in a large bowl, cover with several inches of water.

title: Easy Cheese With Raisins
ingredients: 1 cup queso fresco, crumbled | 1 can plain soymilk | 2 teaspoons raisins
instructions: In a saucepan, melt the queso fresco with the soymilk over medium low heat. Cover, and let cool for 10 minutes. Stir in raisins. Serve at room temperature.

title: Easy Awesome Pear Appetizer
ingredients: 1 ripe pear, peeled, halved, cored, and finely chopped | 1 jar cocktail onions ( or use a mix of both ) or ( 12 ounce ) jar pickled cocktail onions ( or use a mix of both )
instructions: Place a few spoonfuls of the fresh pear in the palm of your hand and rub the center of the pear gently with the onion without breaking off the stem. Repeat for about a handful more of the pear, or a handful more of desired garnish. If any leftover filling is stored longer than a couple of tablespoons, store those in a plastic container with a lid. When you are ready to use, simply sprinkle a couple teaspoons of cocktail onions around the pear and use as directed above.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,beef,fettuccine pasta,yellow squash,single cream,chunky salsa,dark soy sauce
title: Chunky Salsa Beef With Rice Pasta
ingredients: 350 g dried fettuccine pasta | 1 small yellow squash, finely diced | 200 g lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa | 1/2 cup fresh single cream | light soy sauce | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 100 g thick & chunky salsa
instructions: Cook the pasta as directed on the packet. Meanwhile, remove any excess water from the beef and place in a non stick pan. Cook over medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes until cooked but not browned. Stir in the squash. Add the beef and cook for 3 - 4 minutes until the beef loses its pink colour and starts to soften. Stir in the salsa and cream. Continue to cook the beef for a couple of minutes until the sauce is thickened. Stir in the cooked pasta and serve.

title: Taste for Tamari Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 bread cube, soaked and cut into 3 - 4 squares | 1 tablespoon tamari
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Use on bread slices.

Random Ingredients: chutney,corn syrup,gingerroot,pumpkin puree,italian salad dressing,scotch bonnet pepper,peanut,triple sec
title: Homemade Screamin' Groggy Party Dip - Halloween Spec
ingredients: 1 packet italian salad dressing | 4 tablespoons light corn syrup or 4 tablespoons light corn syrup | 2 tablespoons double sec | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, freshly grated | 1/2 teaspoon scotch bonnet peppers or 1/2 teaspoon habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon peanuts, toasted | 1 tablespoon sweet corn syrup or 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1 teaspoon double sec | 4 ounces gingerroot, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon triple sec or 1 teaspoon honey
instructions: For the sauce, combine 3 tablespoons of light and light corn syrup, 2 tablespoons of triple sec, 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, 1/2 teaspoon scotch bonnet pepper or habanero. Mix thoroughly. In a separate bowl, combine the 3 tablespoons of dark, light corn syrup, 1 teaspoon of double sec. Add this mixture to the sauce. If the mixture is too thick, add up to 1/4 tablespoon of water or a little more.. Store in the fridge until ready to use. Serve with assorted crackers or bread. For the dip, combine the 3 tablespoons of light light corn syrup, 2 tablespoons of double sec. Add the 3 tablespoons of sweet corn syrup, 1 teaspoon of triple sec or honey and the 2 tablespoons of triple sec. Add the peanuts and mix thoroughly. To prepare, run a knife from a sharp knife to the very bottom of the bowl of the dip. Pour the dip in the bowl using a circular motion so that the dip is evenly spread. Sprinkle some crushed ice cubes into the bowl. The ice will allow the dip to set up as it sets up. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: saffron,white potato,lime,bamboo shoot,cod,red food coloring,apple,grain mustard
title: Fish Stuffed With Bamboo Shoots and Saffron Bites
ingredients: 1 lb thick skinned cod, fillets | 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard | 6 bamboo shoots, sliced into rounds | 1/4 cup sliced white potatoes, small dice | 1 lime, shredded zest only | 1/4 cup finely chopped apple, small dice | 3 drops red food coloring | 1/8 teaspoon saffron, soaked for 15 minutes
instructions: First make the brine by soaking the saffron in warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze the juice from the lime, if necessary, and set aside with the salt. Combine all the ingredients in a jar, and shake vigorously. Pour into a pot with 3 cups water and salt, and bring to a boil. Add the brine, adjust the heat, and simmer for 20 minutes, until the liquid is reduced and clear, and the fish is cooked. Transfer the fish to a platter and pour the liquid over it.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,arugula,garam masala,vinegar,lime zest,chicken thigh,mint
title: Shhhhh
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes, or to taste | 2 tablespoons fresh lime zest, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint | 1/4 cup chopped fresh arugula
instructions: Place chicken thighs in a bowl and toss with garam masala, red pepper flakes, lime zest, vinegar, and mint. Allow chicken to marinate in refrigerator, 8 hours to overnight, stirring occasionally. Remove chicken from marinade, reserving marinade. Saute chicken in reserved marinade for 10 minutes, or until cooked through. Serve over rice, garnished with reserved mint and arugula.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,cremini mushroom,chocolate chip,apricot preserve,pine nut,sage,adobo sauce
title: Chocolate-Dipped Mushrooms and Smoky Almond Mayo
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup light goat cheese or 1/4 cup almond spread ( available at specialty grocery stores ) | 2 teaspoons adobo sauce ( from a 6 ounce can ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried rubbed sage | 3 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1 1/4 cups chicken broth | 2 ounces semisweet chocolate chips ( at room temperature )
instructions: Place mushrooms in a medium bowl. Combine goat cheese and adobo paste in a small bowl. Sprinkle cheese mixture over mushrooms and toss to coat. Sprinkle sage over mushrooms and toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Remove mushrooms from refrigerator if time permits. Combine preserves and broth in a small saucepan, bring to a simmer. Simmer for about 1 minute. Divide mushroom mixture among individual mushroom portions, spoon over top, and sprinkle each serving with 1 tablespoon chocolate and remaining aperotle paste. Serve immediately.

title: Herbed Oil
ingredients: 1 cup light corn syrup | 1 cup dried italian herb, chopped | 1 cup light corn syrup, for brushing
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the corn syrup, italian herb, and light corn syrup. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat. Cover, and set aside to mellow about 30 minutes. Once cool, heat the oil in a saucepan until smoking hot. Pour the oil through a sieve lined with coffee filters or a fine mesh mesh sieve into a bowl or clean jar, and let cool to room temperature. Pour the flavored syrup into the cooled, sterilized bottle, and gently shake to coat the rim.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,onion powder,feta cheese,barbecue sauce,golden raisin,yellow onion
title: Sweet Onion Barbecue - Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 cup light golden raisin | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon dried minced onion | 1 teaspoon instant minced onion powder | 4 ounces sliced feta cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the raisins and bbq sauce together until evenly coated in the mixture. Spoon over the hot cooked beef and/or turkey and sprinkle with minced onion and feta cheese. Cover and cook on low until heated through. This can be served over cooked hot dogs, pork chops, chicken breasts, or steaks.

title: Coriander Fish Rolls
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon coriander ( ground ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion ( ground ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves ( chopped ) | 1 package rice wrappers, cut into rounds
instructions: Mix coriander, onion, flour, lemon juice and half the cilantro over the fish. Place a teaspoonful of mixture on one side of a rice wrapper. Fold over and crimp the edges with a fork to seal. Bake at 180c for 15 minutes. Remove fish and sprinkle with remaining cilantro. Serve with curry sauce.

title: Spicy Black Fish Pizza
ingredients: 25 g fresh yeast | 400 g broccoli | 8 small red capsicums | 250 g fresh mussels | 250 g lebanese mozzarella cheese | 2 slices rye bread ( loaves bread ) | 1 habanero pepper | 1 dash cumin
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 100ml warm water. Wash the broccoli, snap off the tips, remove the stalk and finely slice the leaves. Cut the capsicum into thick strips, and place it in a microwave safe dish. Pour boiling water on to the capsicum and microwave on high for 4 minutes, stir. Remove from microwave and transfer capsicum, leave them on, for 10 minutes. Rinse the mussels and set them aside. Place the lebanese in a pan, sprinkle with a little sea salt, and cover with cold water. Set them aside. Cut the bread into 2 cm cubes. Stretch the mozzarella to fit the size of the bread cubes in the flat of your pizza pan. Spread the mussels over the bread, then put a slice of cheese on the top. Arrange the fish in a single layer on the cheese, and top with a slice of habanero pepper. Lightly sprinkle with a little water to make sure it covers everything, then sprinkle a few cumin over the top. Cover with a flat lid, and press down to seal. When it has been over 10 minutes, open the pizza and spread the pizza with a thin layer of oil. If you wish your crust to be more crisper, leave it in the oven for a few hours. To serve, cut the mozzarella into cubes.

title: Cauliflower Penne
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, chopped | 2 tablespoons instant coffee powder | 1 can mushroom soup | 1/4 cup nigella seeds | 4 radishes, cut into thin wedges | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 8 ounces penne
instructions: Boil water in the pot of pasta to cook the cauliflower to desired doneness. In a large skillet, heat coffee powder and mushrooms with nigella seeds for about 10 minutes or until they begin to bubble. While this is cooking, cook onions and cauliflower until cauliflower is tender. You can also cook turkey or any kind of meat. Once penne is cooked, mix with the cauliflower. This is good over cooked chicken or beef.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,baking soda,ginger root,vegetable broth,honey,green onion
title: Honey Ginger Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root | 4 green onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lettuce leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the honey, vegetable broth, baking soda and ginger. Stir in green onions and lettuce to make the dressing.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,red onion,romaine lettuce,rapeseed oil,cooking oil,chocolate,eggplant
title: Ratatouille With Eggplant (Aubergine) and Squash
ingredients: 1 eggplant, cut lengthwise in 4 pieces | 8 ounces baby yellow squash, cut into thin strips | 1 red onion, sliced into thin strips | 2 tablespoons rapeseed oil | 1 tablespoon rapeseed oil | 1 box roasted bittersweet chocolate, sliced | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 red onion, sliced into chunks | 2 teaspoons rapeseed oil | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, shredded | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking cocoa powder ( to be posted at asian restaurant and asian market )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Place eggplant on cutting board with knife sides up. Sprinkle with salt. Let sit until tender, about 10 minutes. Rinse well. Drain well and pat dry. Cut into 1/2 squares and set aside. Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons of rapeseed oil in frying pan. Add red onion and stir fry approximately 10 minutes. Add chocolate and toast until melted. Set aside. Place broiler rack in middle of oven and broil vegetables. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in pan. Add eggplant and cook about 10 minutes, turning occasionally. Remove vegetables and cover while preparing sauce. To assemble dish, lay out a large bed of romaine, then top with sweet potato strips and a small sprinkling of cocoa powder. Cover with eggplant mixture and a drizzle of oil. Garnish with more shredded red onions and red bell pepper strips.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,sharp white cheddar cheese,chicken bouillon granule,catsup,baby spinach,sirloin tip roast,mango chutney,pizza crust
title: Quick Fix Shredded Beef Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 1 lb sirloin tip roast, shredded and drained | 4 tablespoons shredded sharp white cheddar cheese | 14 inches pre-baked pizza crusts, such as boboli | 3 cups fresh baby spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. In a small bowl, combine the catsup, mango chutney, chili oil, and chicken bouillon. In a separate bowl, toss together the shredded beef, cheddar cheese, and spinach. Spread the meat mixture on the pizza crusts, leaving about 2 inches of crust around the edge of the pizza crust. Sprinkle with half of the cheese mixture.

title: Cabbage and Swiss Cheese Bake
ingredients: 1 lb shredded cabbage | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 3/4 cup chopped swiss cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped pimentos, drained | 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Combine the cabbage and spaghetti sauce in a deep 9 pie dish. Arrange the cheese, pimentos and vinegar in decorative layers over the cabbage mixture. Bake at 350 for about 30 minutes or until cheese in golden brown.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,pecan,white flour,romaine lettuce leaf,beet,rye bread,lime juice,stock
title: Beet and Poppy Seed Pecan Croutes
ingredients: 1 small beet, peeled and cut into thin strips ( about 8 ounces ) | 6 tablespoons white flour ( all purpose ) | 1 1/2 cups strong stock ( or vegetable stock ) | 1/2 cup dry roasted white chocolate, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon lime juice | 2 cups light rye bread, crusts removed and cut into cubes ( or 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pecans ) | 1/3 cup thinly sliced fresh basil leaf | 1/2 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Combine beet and 1 1/2 tablespoons flour in a food processor and pulse to make coarse crumbs. Add stock, chocolate, lime juice and remaining 3 tablespoons flour.

title: Apple Pan Fried Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs roast | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 loaves fresh italian bread
instructions: Trim off any visible fat from the meat, and cut it into about 5 slices. Make slits in the meat with a sharp knife, and insert one slice in the hole of a heavy cutting board. Pour about half the brown sugar into a large flat skillet or griddle. Fry meat in the juices over gentle heat until darkly brown on both sides and crusty, about 10 minutes total. Transfer meat to a serving dish, and sprinkle the remaining brown sugar over top. Serve hot.

title: Turnip and Green Onion Kugel
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/2 cup finely snipped green onion
instructions: Cover the turnips with cold water and place them in a saucepan. Add cold water to cover. Bring water to a boil. Boil until fork tender, 15 - 18 minutes.

title: Wontons With Whiskey Chips
ingredients: 1/3 cup oil | 6 wonton skins | 2 teaspoons whiskey | 1/4 cup walnuts ( toasted )
instructions: Heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the won ton skins and cook over high heat, stirring constantly, until the skins puff and become aromatic. Do not burn. Immediately remove from heat. Use a slotted spoon to remove the wrapper and place on a tray. Dip in whiskey and sprinkle with walnuts. Allow to cool and harden before serving.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,chili pepper flake,beef roast,spanish onion
title: Pepper Beef for Two
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef roast | 4 tablespoons fresh curry powder | 1 -2 chili pepper flakes | 1 spanish onion, chopped or 1/2 small spanish onion, chopped
instructions: Place beef in oven proof skillet with a lid, that has two sides on the bottom. Combine curry powder and pepper flakes, then pour evenly over the roast. Sprinkle onion over the beef. Cook in a 325 degree oven for a 3 - 4 hours or until tender.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,beef sirloin steak,bean sprout,yogurt,red cabbage,serrano pepper,tamarind paste,tabasco sauce
title: Beef Noodle Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef sirloin steak | 1/2 cup yogurt | 4 cans of drained bean sprouts | 2 fresh serrano peppers or 2 poblano peppers | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sliced red cabbage | 1/2 cup red cabbage | 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Brown ground sirloin steak in frying pan. Drain off the fat. Mix ground sirloin with yogurt. Place cooked ground beef, bean sprouts, peppers, cabbage, cabbage and tamarind paste into a large casserole or baking dish. Mix the sauce ingredients together. Pour sauce over meat mixture. Bake covered for 1 hour or until mixture is tender. Uncover and bake for 15 more minutes or until heated through.

title: Pasta With Snow Peas and Chickpeas
ingredients: 3 1/3 cups fresh snow peas | 1/2 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed | 1 package farfalle pasta, uncooked
instructions: Cover a large baking sheet with foil. Microwave snow peas and chick peas, covered, in microwave until peas are tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir peas and chickpeas into pasta.

title: Cornflour Baked Potatoes or Dutch Fries
ingredients: 2 cups mashed baking potatoes | 3 cups cornflour ( cornstarch will work too )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees c or 400 degrees f. Pour the potatoes into a bowl, and mash them as with a fork or potato masher until they are a smooth paste. Stir the corn flour into the mashed potatoes in a separate bowl, then stir in the cornflour a little at a time until you have a thick, batter like consistency like butter. Coat the bottom of a baking dish with the potato mixture. Sprinkle over the top of the potato mixture a little sprinkle over a little more cornflour and bake uncovered for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cannoli shell,chinese wine,red wine vinegar,radish,spring green,golden syrup,sauce
title: Chinese Cannoli Salad
ingredients: 1 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup chinese wine | 1/4 cup sweet sau hot sauce | 8 medium cannoli shells, cooked | 2 tablespoons shredded radishes ( optional ) | 10 -12 chopped spring greens ( optional )
instructions: Whisk together syrups and wine and chill. Drain cannoli shells. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the casserole, garnish with spring greens and serve.

title: Welsh Apple Salad (Somerset)
ingredients: 8 ounces rye flour | 8 ounces caster sugar | 7 ounces butter | 2 tart apples | 6 tablespoons mayonnaise | 8 ounces chopped fresh tarragon, leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons tamari
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. To make the pastry rub the flour and sugar into the butter. Peel the apples and slice into thin wedges. Combine the apple strips, mayonnaise, tarragon and tamari with the cooled pastry and sprinkle over some black pepper. Bake in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,flat leaf parsley,rotel tomato chilies
title: Easy Rotel Topping
ingredients: 4 cans rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1/2 cup packed brown sugar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix tomatoes and chilies together in a large bowl. Sprinkle brown sugar and parsley over the tomato mixture.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,ginger,lemon,lobster meat,hot chili sauce,wheat pasta,pepper sauce,cooking spray
title: Lobster Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked whole wheat pasta ( penne or rigatoni ) | 2 cans lobster meat, drained | 1/2 cup sliced fresh hot chili sauce, or to taste | 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper | 1/2 cup sliced fresh ginger ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon lemon, juiced | 1 1/2 teaspoons hot and fiery chili sauce, or more to taste | 1/4 teaspoon pepper sauce | cooking spray
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Quick Shrimp & Garlic Risotto With Arrabiio Sauce
ingredients: 6 ounces large shrimp, shelled and deveined | 6 ounces arborio rice | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes
instructions: Boil the salted water on high heat and add the arborio rice. Once the pan is very hot, add the shrimp and cook gently for 1 - 2 minutes, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through. Toss in half the mozzarella cubes and gently toss so that everything is evenly coated in the arrabi and mozzarella. Serve immediately.

title: Fresh Chile Paste
ingredients: 16 dried red chilies | 1 tablespoon red chilies, chopped | 3/4 cup cornstarch
instructions: Place the chilies in a small, shallow pan, and cover with boiling water. Let stand for 30 minutes. Drain, then remove the stems and seeds. Remove the cores of the chilies, and then place them into a blender with the water from the chilies. Blend the ingredients well, adding the cornstarch last. Mixture should be thick and smooth.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,thyme sprig,seasoning,horseradish,raspberry vinegar,white wine vinegar
title: Artichoke Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and coarsley chopped | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1/4 teaspoon horseradish | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning, like salt
instructions: Place all ingredients in the bowl of a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth, stopping occasionally to scrape down sides. Store in a refrigerator until needed.

title: Pasta with Grilled Cheese and Diced Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta ( small tub ) | 3 tablespoons cornflour | 2 cups grated cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons parmesean-reggiano cheese
instructions: Boil 3 quarts of water. Meanwhile, toss pasta with cornflour in a large bowl. Drain.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,kosher salt,cardamom pod,dark soy sauce,brandy,triple sec
title: Brandy Covered Deviled Beef
ingredients: 6 cardamom pods, outer green skin removed | 1 tablespoon kosher salt, plus more for grilling | 1 cup light italian dressing | 3/4 cup triple sec | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Using a small rimmed plate, press a piece of plastic wrap directly onto surface of the meat. Set aside. Using a mortar and pestle, grind cardamom pods on a small fine blade or grater into a fine powder. Transfer to a small bowl. Dissolve kosher salt in the italian dressing in a small bowl, then add the triple sec, brandy, and soy sauce. Stir. Add the freshly ground cardamom mixture to the bag. Squeeze as much air out of bag as possible, then seal the bag. Repeat with remaining coated beef. Let marinate for at least 2 hours. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Grill beef for 2 to 3 minutes per side, or to desired doneness. Adjust heat to low during last minute of grilling for medium rare. Remove from heat, cut through the scored lines, and serve. Do not leave a open face on the grill.

title: Scallops & pumpkin Spice Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 32 small whole pumpkin spice shrimp ( see note ) | 13 ounces bay scallops, rinsed | 1/4 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur or 1/4 cup other almond flavored liqueur
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package directions. Drain and cool. Spray 2 quaille dishes with cooking spray and set aside. Heat grill or large skillet over medium heat. Spray with cooking spray shrimp and place skin side down in the pan. Cook for 5 - 6 minutes, turning once. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Repeat process until all 4 shrimp are cooked. When ready to use, transfer all to the pasta and toss. Spoon shrimp among each ramekin. Dollop with amaretto and serve.

title: Roasted and Spiced Overnight Italian Cream Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon dry oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 7 ounces cranberries ( about 1/2 cup ocean spray craisins craisins and 1 pkg raisins ) | 2 tablespoons pecans, ground | 3/4 cup water | 1/4 cup double cream
instructions: Combine raisins and pecans in small bowl, stirring in water, cream and seasonings. Cover.

title: Savory Curried Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs assorted wild mushrooms | 10 tomatillos, husked and washed | 1/3 cup brandy | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Cut off the stems of mushrooms and discard any tough part and finely mushroom stems. Place them in a large, heavy skillet and add water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then turn down the heat but keep at a gentle simmer. In the meantime, rinse mushrooms under cold running water. When the water had come to a boil, drain them and pat dry. Slice the stems and saute over medium high heat until the mushrooms are brown and tender. Meanwhile, prepare the curry sauce by placing tomatillos in a large nonreactive bowl or pan. Drain the mushrooms, reserving the soaking liquid. Finely chop the mushrooms. Add the reserved soaking liquid and brandy, then stir in the curry powder. Cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, until thickened and fragrant. Stir in the nutmeg, season to taste and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve at once.

title: Sopa Seca
