ingredients: 1 lb dry farina | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 lb firm pear, pared, halved, and cored | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded and finely chopped | 2 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, cleaned and sliced thin
instructions: Cook farina according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain. Coat skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Add paprika saute 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add farina in a thin stream, stirring quickly until mixture is well incorporated and coats skillet. Transfer mixture to a plate set in a bowl of warm water to cool. Refrigerate while pasta cooks. To make chipotle paprika, put chipotle chile in a mortar. Using the pest, grind chipotle until smooth and evenly mixed on top of chili. Discard chile. Heat oil in a small saucepan to medium high heat. Cook paprika until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add mushrooms, toss for 1 minute. Reduce heat if too much heat is released. Stir in puree and simmer until sauce thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Stir in drained farina. Serve immediately, sprinkled with paprika.

Random Ingredients: sake,soy sauce,ranch dressing,ice water,chinese cabbage,walnut,marjoram,golden rum
title: Ranch Slaw
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark aged soy sauce | 1 tablespoon sake ( sweet japanese rice wine ) | 1 tablespoon golden rum | 2 tablespoons light soy sauce ( shoyu ) | 1 tablespoon sake or 1 tablespoon white wine | ice cold water | 1 chinese cabbage, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons toasted walnuts, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 cup chopped sweet washington lettuce
instructions: In a large glass or ceramic bowl, whisk together the dark aged soy sauces, koshihikari, dark rice wine, light soy sauce, sake, water, cabbage and walnuts. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes or longer. Just before serving, stir in the marjoram and refrigerate, stirring often, for several hours or overnight to allow flavors to develop. Serve slaw on lettuce leaves.

title: Sweet and Sour-Spicy Salmon
ingredients: 24 ounces salmon fillets, skin and bones removed | 1 tablespoon ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 1 tablespoon peach, puree
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f. Lay the salmon fillets in a single layer and coat with the ginger, powder and sugar. Spray a roasting dish with nonstick spray. Make two slits to the top of the fillets with a knife and poke a few wholes in the skin that run underneath. Pour the peach puree into a small skillet over medium high heat. When the mixture begins to thicken, simmer for several minutes. Remove from the heat and pour over the salmon. Cover with a lid and bake for 25 minutes. Remove the lid, bake for another 35 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,muscovado sugar,tabasco sauce,mango chutney,cantaloupe,ladyfinger,irish cream,french bread
title: Mango Chutney Bread & Mango Salad With Grilled Dolcchettes
ingredients: 8 ounces sweet french bread | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons irish cream | tabasco sauce | 8 ounces chopped mixed fruit ( any combination of mango chutney, mango, applesauce, and applesauce ) | 4 ounces sweet bell peppers ( orange, pears, zucchini, cucumber, bell peppers ) | 4 ounces sliced cantaloupe | 2 ounces ladyfingers ( assorted fruit, such as berryberries )
instructions: Cut bread in 8 slices.

title: Fried Onions(Kuwaiti Emir)
ingredients: 1 kg koh'uzbek ladyfinger cookies ( or 1 kg ladyfingers ) | 4 tablespoons earth balance buttery | 1 tablespoon cumin seed
instructions: Cut fingers in half if any, and place into freezer for 30 minutes or so, keeping them frozen. Using a sharp knife cut into strips about 1/4 inch wide, or as fine as you want. Crush the earth balance into a mortar using the crushed spices, or pound in a pestle or mortar, then spread out on a dish.

title: Slowy Cooker Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1 can or bottle lager-style beer | 4 lamb chops
instructions: Combine beer and lamb chops in a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker. Cover, and cook until lamb is cooked through, about 8 hours. Turn slow cooker to high, cover, and cook 2 more hours.

Random Ingredients: masa harina,alfredo sauce,soybean sprout,sesame seed,white bread
title: Sesame Bean Dumplings for Two
ingredients: 8 -10 pieces white bread, cut to size of bread | 4 -6 tablespoons masa harina or 2 -3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 cup frozen soybeans, cooked and drained | 1/3 cup dried soyabeans sprouts | sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cut the day old white bread into small pieces like french fries and place pieces in an oven proof dish. Combine a tsp of sesame seeds and 1 - 2 tbsp of water in a small cup or bowl, and put as much or as little as you want on the bread. Dip each piece of bread into the water for a few moments, shaking off excess. Place the bread on top of the bread, and spread out evenly. Bake 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,dill weed,red cherry,enoki mushroom,shrimp,celery rib,tahini,sun tomato oil
title: Fruit & Shrimp in Creamy Dip
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, raw shelled then deveined | 2 -3 tablespoons tahini ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup chopped fresh dill weed ( optional ) | 4 -5 fresh curry leaves, chopped, or ( 2 - 3 1/2 ounce ) packages fresh leaves, chopped | 3 -4 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, not oil packed | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh dill weed, chopped or 1/4 cup dried dill weed | 8 -10 dried red cherries | 8 -10 fresh enoki mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed
instructions: Combine the shrimp with the tahini, 3 tablespoons of the dill weed, curry leaves and chopped sundried tomatoes. Serve with green leaves to garnish, chopped red and black peppers if desired.

title: Saliq  (Saqeh)
ingredients: 1 lb green peas, shelled | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place the peas, cilantro leaves, and salt in a large bowl. Stir well and let sit for 30 minutes at room temperature. Strain out all excess liquid and serve immediately.

title: Paneer Cheese Balls
ingredients: 500 g cottage cheese, grated | 8 slices whole wheat bread, crusts removed | 1 pinch saffron, soaked in | 2 tablespoons warm water
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Leave to stand for 10 minutes. Shape into balls. Dry fry on low heat, or as desired, in hot oil. Serve warm or cold.

title: Crisco Roasted Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 portobello mushrooms, stems removed | 1/4 cup crisco
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place mushrooms in a baking dish. In a small bowl, stir together crisco and the 3 tablespoons of roasting oil until well blended. Sprinkle the mixture evenly over the mushrooms. Bake mushrooms in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, until tender.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,corn kernel,vanilla bean,bamboo shoot,sesame seed
title: Corn & Sweet Oranges on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 medium corn kernel | 3 sweet oranges, pithy section of | 1 can canned bamboo shoots | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds
instructions: Slice the orange segments into 1/2 slices, then place the slices in a microwave safe bowl with a lid. Add enough water to cover them, cover and microwave on high for 25 to 30 minutes, until partially cooked and water is mostly absorbed. Remove the sliced oranges from the microwave, and let cool about 5 minutes. Rinse the orange segments and pat dry with paper towels. Heat the canola oil at medium heat in a sauté pan over medium high heat. Add the orange slices, turning several times until they're golden brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels. When you are ready to serve the orange slices, heat the canola oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat until it just shimmers. Add the corn kernels, cover and cook for a few minutes until the kernels begin to turn golden brown in color around the edges. Stir in the orange slices, bamboo shoots and sesame seeds and cook for a few minutes until the mixture is warmed through. If the mixture is too dry, add 1/2 cup of water and re cover. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,tamari,chicken breast,beef bouillon
title: Tasty Italian Chicken
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 chicken breasts ( halved or not ) | 1/2 lb beef bouillon, crumbled | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f. Coat a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray.

title: Easy Shredded Vegetables
ingredients: 3 boxes jiffy cornbread mix | 3 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 1 jar pickled baby carrots ( you can use drained baby carrots )
instructions: Prepare cornbread according to directions. While cornbread is baking, add fresh spinach to the bag of dry cornbread. Remove spinach with a slotted spoon to a bowl. Add carrots into saute pan and saute on medium heat, stirring to distribute carrots. When cornbread is done and the carrots are tender, remove from heat and add to spinach and carrots.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,vanilla extract,malt vinegar,tamari,parsley leaf,beef bouillon cube,lentil
title: Lentil Salad With Tamari Dressing
ingredients: 20 ounces lentils, picked over and rinsed | 4 tablespoons tamari ( dark soy sauce ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/3 cup malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 4 tablespoons maraschino cherries, pitted and chopped ( optional ) | grated nutmeg ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and process until smooth. Taste to adjust sweetness, and adjust seasonings if desired.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,bread crumb,grape jelly,rice paper,coriander seed,tamarind paste,lettuce leaf,eggplant
title: Thai Eggplant Rolls
ingredients: 2 large fresh eggplants, cut lengthwise into 3/8 inch thick slices | 1 jar grape jelly | 1 jar tamarind paste | 1 cup dry bread crumbs | 2 packages moist rice paper rounds ( about 24 round sheets ) | 2 packages lettuce leaves, washed | 1/2 cup fresh coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons pickled jalapeno peppers, finely chopped and seeded
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f. Arrange the eggplants on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake until the eggplant blisters on all sides, about 25 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside. Arrange the grape jelly, tamarind paste, bread crumbs, and rice paper rounds on a large plate or dish just large enough to hold the filling. Divide the filling among the bread slices on top of the filling and roll up the bread slices, jelly side down. Arrange the rolls in a single layer on a baking sheet with the lettuce leaves and coriander, making sure the slices are piled softly. Drizzle each roll with the pickled jalapeños and sprinkle with salt to taste. Bake in the preheated oven until the rolls are hot, bubbly, and are lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Yummy Low-Carb Baked Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups reduced-sodium consomme | 1 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 teaspoon instant dried chipotle chile | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/3 cup golden raisins or 1/3 cup currants
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f. Combine the consomme, xanthan gum, chile and onion powder. Stir in the raisins until coated with the mixture and transfer the mixture to a 2 qt ovenproof baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes or until the sauce is thick.

title: Tarragon Tarts
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh tarragon or 2 teaspoons dried tarragon
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Toss to smooth. Refrigerate at least 2 hour. Serve with favorite crackers.

Random Ingredients: season salt,beef broth,ginger root,beef tenderloin steak,red bell pepper,red wine vinegar,german mustard,tapioca flour
title: Beef With Sweet Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 2 pounds beef tenderloin steaks | 1 pound fresh ginger root, minced | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour | 1 can beef broth | 1 tablespoon german stone-ground mustard | 1 large red bell pepper, diced | 1/2 teaspoon season salt | 2 teaspoons prepared german stone ground mustard
instructions: Place steaks in a dutch oven over medium high heat, and pour in enough water to cover beef. Bring to a boil, and cook 6 to 7 minutes, or until barely pink in center. Remove from heat, and set aside keep warm. In a skillet, stir together the ginger, tapioca flour, beef broth, 1 tablespoon stoneground mustard, red pepper, and season salt. Bring to a boil, and boil for 2 minutes. Return steaks to pan, and cook 5 minutes. Spoon sauce over steaks, and serve.

title: Spicy Baked Beet Bites
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine or 8 ounces spaghetti | 4 ounces light cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon minced fresh tarragon | 1 dash greek yogurt | 1 dash coriander seed | 1 teaspoon minced fresh tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook spagnet on an open cookie sheet for 13 minutes. Reduce heat to low, and add soup, tarragon, greek yogurt, and coriander seeds. Stir well with a fork. Drain pasta in a colander, and toss with sauce, until coated. Put in your favorite glass baking dish, and add your beets and tarragon. Bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until it is cooked through. Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork loin chop,nonstick cooking spray,vegetable oil olive
title: Pork Chops in Olive Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ( or 1 tbls. olive oil ) | 4 pork loin chops ( or 3 to 3 1/2-ounce each ) | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Heat skillet over medium high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add oil. Saute chops 3 minutes per side, turning once. Serve.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,chive,lemon extract,almond extract,cherry tomato,spaghetti,pineapple chunk
title: Spaghetti With Pineapple and Lemon Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon extract | 2 tablespoons low fat spaghetti or 2 tablespoons bombolina meal | 500 g cherry tomatoes ( halved ) | 2 tablespoons chives ( flat leaf parsley, minced, 1 teaspoon dried ) | 150 g pineapple chunks ( halved ) | 2 tablespoons almonds ( coarsely chopped ) | 300 g rye bread & crusty french bread
instructions: Pulse tomatoes in electric blender to finely chop, transferring to mixing bowl. Add rest of the ingredients and stir through.. Transfer tomato mixture to shallow baking dish. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour but ideally no longer than a day or so.

title: Chile Verde With Parsnips
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled and sliced crosswise into 1/2 inch slices ( not too thin ) | 1 jalapeno, deseeded and minced | nonstick cooking spray | spices
instructions: Combine the chilies and the jalapeno in a bowl and add just enough water to cover. Cover and marinate 30 minutes. In a large nonstick fry pan, fry the parsnips in hot oil on both sides until crisp tender. Drain on paper towels. Spray the fry pan again with non stick spray or use a nonstick cooking spray. Add the chilies with the juice and spices and simmer uncovered until the liquid is absorbed and the parsnips are just heated through.

Random Ingredients: pepper,cilantro,blue cheese,harissa,queso fresco,monterey jack cheddar cheese,lime zest
title: Blue Cheese Queso Blanco
ingredients: 2 ounces queso fresco ( about 1/3 cup ) | 2 tablespoons blue cheese ( more or less ) | 2 tablespoons monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded | 1 teaspoon fresh lime zest ( about 2 teaspoons ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepper | 1 pinch harissa ( or to taste )
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in a small bowl except harissa. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Sprinkle queso fresco and monterey jack cheddar cheese with additional salt and pepper and toss to mix. Top with harissa on queso fresco and serve.

title: Grilled Lobster Tails
ingredients: 1/2 cup grainy mustard | 8 lobster tails
instructions: Prepare grill. Spread 1/4 cup mustard on the top side of each lobster tail. Place lobster tails on the grill. Close lid and grill for 5 minutes. Brush top with remaining mustard and grill for 5 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: radish,wheat lasagna noodle,orange section,croissant,green pepper,anchovy paste
title: Chicken Panini
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sliced swiss cheese or 1 1/2 cups gruyere cheese | 1 cup chopped green pepper | 1 can anchovy paste | 1 can whole wheat lasagna noodles | 1 orange section | 1 whole radish
instructions: Add all ingredients except radish to slow cooker. Cover with lid. Cook on high for 4 hours to let flavors meld. Then let stand for about 15 for the flavors to come along. Then stir into noodles just before eating.

title: Macadamia Tofu
ingredients: 1/2 lb firm tofu | 2 tablespoons jalapeno peppers ( coarsely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons dried macadamia nuts ( coarsely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons old bay seasoning
instructions: Cut tofu in 1 inch cubes by rubbing between paper towels to remove excess moisture. Place tofu along side of a bamboo steamer set over a medium saucepan and add water to cover the tofu by about 1 1/2 inches and bring the water to a boil over high heat. Add jalapeno and macadamia.

title: Hot Dog
ingredients: 20 ounces frozen corn | dark rum ( optional ) | 20 fluid ounces dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients and place in a freezer bag.

title: Jicama-Mascarpone Snacks
ingredients: 12 tablespoons mascarpone | 1/2 pound jicama, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place mascarpone at a 45 degree angle onto a baking sheet. Cook jicama slices in preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned and cooked through. Drain. Spread mascarpone mixture among jicama slices, and return to the oven. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from oven, cool, and slice into 24 squares.

title: Swiss Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 16 ounces swiss cheese, cut into cubes | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1 tablespoon half fat or 1 tablespoon milk | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced or 1 clove, minced | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Place swiss cheese and vinegar in a large pan. Over low heat cook until swiss cheese is warm and melted. Stir in sour cream, milk, garlic and cinnamon. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bean,yellow pepper,whipping cream,baby carrot,red wine,chipotle pepper,milk
title: Chipotle Mexican White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can low fat refried beans | 2 cups skim milk or 2 cups low fat buttermilk | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 1 medium sweet red pepper, chopped | 1 chipotle pepper, chopped | 1 cup low-fat whipping cream or 1 cup fat-free half-and-half | 3 tablespoons dried baby spinach, chopped
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend all the ingredients, except the cream or fat free half and half, until desired consistency is reached. Serve warm with a dollop of cream or fat free sour cream for garnish.

Random Ingredients: pace picante sauce,serrano pepper,half,white wine vinegar
title: Peparra (Spanish Pimento Sauce)
ingredients: 1 jar mild pace picante sauce | 2 serrano peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Combine picante sauce and serrano peppers in a blender and puree until smooth. Stir in the vinegar and half and half. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Quick Beef Cutlets
ingredients: 2 -4 pieces steaks | 2 -3 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Mix garam masala in a bowl. Spread the mixture evenly over the steaks. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least an hour. Remove steaks from marinate. Saute steaks lightly in oil on both sides. Remove steaks and discard marinade. Cook at medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through.

title: Beef and Beet Hash
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck | 2 small beets, chopped
instructions: Trim fat from beef, and cut beef into small cubes about the size of large yams. Coat beef with a mix of darkening, cooking oil and vegetable residue, and place into a heavy pot. Cover with cold water, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. When soup comes to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer slowly, covered, until beef is very tender, about 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Skim off impurities if necessary.

title: Nigella's Pad Thai
ingredients: 3 ounces dried flat rice noodles | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice noodles, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes. Drain well in a colander set in the sink. Scoop the noodle mixture into a serving dish, and set aside to cool slightly. Stir the fish sauce into the noodle mixture until no ingredients are left. Serve at once, or refrigerate to speed the process.

title: Curried French Fries
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 tablespoon curry paste, or as needed ( indian paneer curry paste )
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Combine curry paste with a little water to make a thin coating. Bring to a slow simmer, stirring constantly. Cook until thick and fragrant. Remove from heat. Spoon curry into hot fry pan and sprinkle with curry powder. Cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Serve with rice.

title: Indonesian Meat Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg minced beef | 1 cup desiccated coconut flakes | 1 1/4 cups peanuts | 1 carrot, grated | 3 tablespoons peanuts, crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in refrigerator for 1 hr. Thread on skewers and barbecue them with the sauce for 25 minute.

title: Mexican Creole Mac 'N' Cheese
ingredients: 2 boxes rigatoni pasta | 4 tablespoons corn syrup | 4 tablespoons creole seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni pasta, and cook until tender, 12 to 15 minutes. Drain and spread on a large, 2 quart casserole dish. Drizzle with corn syrup, and sprinkle with creole seasoning. Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven until heated through, about 9 minutes.

title: Kiwifruit With Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 kiwifruit | 1/4 lb fresh shiitake mushroom | 2 tablespoons chopped kakihi fruit | 1 ounce sake | 1 piece salted butter roll | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Clean the kiwifruit by removing the top white part of the stem with a vegetable peeler, and removing the peel with the end bits of peel. Then, using the tip of a knife, cut off the bottom part of the kiwifruit with the kakihi. Carefully remove and discard the kakihi with some or all of the white pith from the kakihi but leave some pith surrounding for a clear colour. In a microwave safe container, heat the kakihi with ¾ cup water and half of the chopped kakihi in the microwave for 3 minutes, mix well with a wooden spoon and transfer the kakihi water in the microwave. Microwave on high for 1 minute and 1 second increments, stir well. Remove cover with a lid and continue microwaving until boiling and thickened. Remove the kakihi before serving. Toast the salted butter roll under a preheated broiler. Spread the mushroom on the fried butter roll while it is at the same time warm. When it's still hot, cut out the empty pieces of salted butter roll with scissors. Serve with a bowl of souchong.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,lamb neck,baby spinach leaf,italian salad dressing mix,passion fruit juice
title: Italian Lamb Neck Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lamb neck bones | 2 packages italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup dry cornstarch | 1 cup passion fruit juice | fresh baby spinach
instructions: Remove the neck from the stock pot and place it over medium heat. Sprinkle the neck with salt, and sear on all sides. Combine the salad dressing mix and the cornstarch until well blended, then stir in the passion fruit juice. When the neck is done, transfer it to a large mixing bowl. Set the meat in the skillet over medium heat. Drain any excess fat, then stir the sauce until it begins to thicken. When it is hot, and beginning to bubble, add some of the warmed stock. The beef can be covered, if it is too big or if it is too cold, cook it for only a minute or two. Remove a piece of heavy duty aluminum foil and cover or add a lid to prevent your guests from accidentally picking it up. Spread a few tablespoons of the sauce over the piece of foil so it fits. Put the spinach across the top, and spoon some of the meat onto the spinach. Cover the top half of the pan with heavy duty aluminum foil, and place the whole skillet on top of it. Turn the heat down to a simmer, and let the stew simmer until the stew is just bubbling and the moisture has almost evaporated. It is very important that it does not reduce after the stew is finished cooking, or the liquid will begin to reduce too much. Serve, and enjoy.

title: Beef, Watermelon & Cumin Roast
ingredients: 300 g red snapper or 300 g king prawns, peeled and deveined | 400 g watermelon, flesh of | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Place the watermelon and fish fillets on a non stick oven tray and brush with oil. Sprinkle with cumin, chili flakes and dried chilli. Roast for 25 - 30 minutes until fish is cooked and watermelon is tender. Serve with salad and rice.

title: Penne With Chili Peppers and Chili
ingredients: 1/2 lb penne | 4 dried red chili peppers
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente. Drain well. While pasta is cooking, saute chili peppers over med heat in saucepan. Until tender. Immediately add cooked penne and stir until well coated. Serve over spaghetti.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,rum,pie shell,baby spinach,pork,red pepper flake
title: Pigs in Puffs (With Kick)
ingredients: 0.5 box refrigerated pie shells | 10 ounces chopped cooked pork | 1 tablespoon sweet red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper | 1/2 cup chopped baby spinach
instructions: Combine pork, sweet red pepper, red pepper flakes, green pepper, spinach, and rum. Roll in pie shells. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Yummy Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 cucumber | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon juice | 1 tablespoon whiskey | 1/4 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Peel and grate cucumber into a medium bowl. Combine remaining ingredients. Mash until desired texture is attained.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,fenugreek seed,maraschino cherry,sauerkraut,chicken bouillon,tap water,crabmeat
title: Sauerkraut and Crab (Anticuchos De Gaspantes)
ingredients: 1 bottle tap water | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 4 teaspoons sesame seeds | 8 teaspoons dried maraschino cherries | 8 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1 can sauerkraut, drained | 1 lb imitation crabmeat
instructions: Place tap water, bouillon powder, sesame seeds, cherries, fenugreek, sauerkraut, and crabmeat. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,taco seasoning,chinese rice wine,coconut milk
title: Khao Plow
ingredients: 3 cups boneless skinless chicken breasts or 3 cups pork butt | 1 cup light coconut milk | 3 tablespoons dry mustard seeds ( kalonji ) | 1 tablespoon soy seasoning or 1 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon chinese rice wine
instructions: Preparation, cut pork into 1/2 to 3/4 inch cubes. Combine all ingredients except khao plow together in large bowl and mix well. Add the meat and coat well. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Grill or broil pork until meat is done and is slightly browned and crispy. Serve with steamed cabbage and other vegetables.

title: Port-Chile Jelly
ingredients: 1 cup ruby port ( like swiss colony ) | 1 small dried chile
instructions: Make a hole in the chile with your thumb. Pour port into hole and let it melt into the mixture. Let excess water run away. Pour into hot jelly jars and enjoy to break apart.

title: Sausage and Kielbasa Supper on Dumplings
ingredients: 24 ounces frozen small meatballs, thawed | 12 ounces kielbasa ( polish or polish style if you can find it ) | 24 round wonton wrappers
instructions: Cut sausage links diagonally in half horizontally. Lay out the pieces of sausage on a work surface. With the middle of the sausage nearest you, brush one side and one side with oil. Fold the sausage up and over the sausage, and continue lifting the sausage with your fingers. The idea is that the sausage stays in there between your fingers. If it gets to dry, sprinkle with a little water, but it shouldn't be. You should end up with a sausage that tastes sort of like a meatball. Let the sausage rest in the refrigerator until your dinner is ready. After you've rested, preheat your oven to 450°f lay out the won ton wrappers on a baking sheet and prick the tops with the tines of a fork. Paint all the wrappers wiht the baking sheet with oil. Place the meat balls into a nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Cook, turning until browned all over. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate, cover and keep warm in the oven. Bring 6 cups of water to a slow boil in a large pot. Drop in the dumplings and cook 8 minutes until they rise to the surface, depending on desired thickness. Serve with a dollop of sour cream and a salad.

Random Ingredients: scallion,rosemary sprig,nonfat milk,pastry dough,navel orange,ziti pasta,margarine
title: Pastry Cream With Orange, Ziti, and Scallions
ingredients: 1 teaspoon margarine | 6 scallions, minced | 4 rosemary sprigs, plus whole leaves | 1/2 pint nonfat milk | 1 package ziti pasta ( no.1 recommended ) | 1 package frozen pastry dough, thawed ( from a 17-ounce package ) | minced scallions, and | rosemary sprigs, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f grease rimmed baking sheet with margarine. In skillet, heat margarine over medium heat until hot but not smoking. Add scallions and rosemary sprigs to skillet.

title: Papaya Filling for Two (Pavlova Al Piemontese)
ingredients: 4 large ripe papayas | 1/4 cup milk mozzarella | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract, or more to taste | 1/4 cup loosely packed fresh basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Using a sharp knife, remove the papaya from its shell and cut into chunks about the size of a mandolin cup. Cut the pulp into 1 inch square slices. Place the pulp and mozzarella together in a mixing bowl. Stir lemon extract and basil into the mozzarella cheese mixture. Fill the papaya with the cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,cashew,ramen noodle,chicken broth,port wine,water chestnut
title: Cashew Nut Ramen
ingredients: 1 packet chicken broth ( with 1 tsp of broth ) | 1/4 cup water chestnut, finely chopped | 3/4 cup raw cashews | 2 packets of ramen noodles ( without seasoning packet ) | 1/3 cup water ( from noodles in box, or 2 tbsp of the ramen liquid ) | 1/2 teaspoon real vanilla essence | 1/2 cup port wine
instructions: Bring chicken broth, water chestnuts and cashews to boil. Add ramen noodles, and cook according to package directions, but do not overcook. Add your vanilla essence and port and cook another minute. Serve over hot buttered bread.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,beef broth,romaine lettuce,white bread
title: German Pearls Onions and Pearl Onions
ingredients: 8 ounces white pearl onions, peeled | 8 ounces white bread, crust removed | 4 ounces romaine lettuce | 2 -3 cups beef broth
instructions: Trim the ends off 2 slices of bread and cut into a large dice. Place the onion cut side down on a cutting board and slice thinly to make 1 1/2 in segments or half moon sections. Place the slices on a baking sheet and bake at 350 degress until golden brown, about 12 to 16 minutes. Slip the toast into a bowl and drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat. Wash and dry the romaine and carefully remove the stems, leaving some whole. Place romaine in a sieve with enough water to cover. Set aside, then drain. To serve, place the onions in a large bowl and add the bread, lettuce and broth. Toss gently and pile on toasted bread. Goes great with crusty bread.

title: Sweet Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package shortbread cookies | 4 -5 tablespoons minced sherry | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 lb pork loin | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 4 shiitake mushrooms | 5 miniature marshmallows
instructions: Cut stem ends off mushrooms. Suck each mushroom cap and loose. Set aside. Scoop out the inside of the mushroom. Fill mushroom caps with stuffing. Sprinkle with paprika. Place in a baking dish in a single layer. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until tender. Remove from oven. Dollop out stuffing and serve with marshmallows. Note, i do this randomly on my mushroom. I don't use any of my stuffing. Instead i stuff them with a little meat stuffing and then sprinkle the stuffing over. I serve them with lots of napkins or toothpicks.

title: Beef Roast With Rosemary (For Roasting)
ingredients: 1 beef eye round | rosemary ( fresh, fresh, chopped ) | beef eye roast or ( 1 1/2 ounce ) beef rib rack
instructions: Sprinkle rosemary on roast, then place rib rack in roasting pan. Place pan in 500°f oven to roast about 20 minutes or until tender. Place roast on cutting board. Pull the roast apart into thin slices using a meat tenderizer or your hands. Place roast in a warm dish. Slice into 1 pieces, arrange on platter and garnish with fresh rosemary and serve with your favorite sauce.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,chicken broth,cilantro,pie pastry,masa harina,active yeast,yogurt
title: Carnitas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 cups acheived carnitas chicken broth | 1 cup warm chicken broth | 2/3 cup masa harina ( mexican cornstarch ) | 2/3 cup plain yogurt | 1 1/2 cups prepared yucatecoleos ( yellow onion ) or 1 1/2 cups orange bell peppers | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro
instructions: Dissolve yeast in broth. Set broth aside to proof. Combine masa harina and yogurt. Pour warm broth and yeast mixture into flour, and stir until combined. Add cornstarch, and stir until dough comes together. Turn onto a floured surface, and knead until smooth and elastic. Place dough in a large bowl, cover with clean cloth, and set aside to rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk. Punch dough down, and divide in half. Shape each half into an oval ball, coat with masa harina, and place in a large greased 9 inch pie plate. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Stretch dough on a floured plate with your fingers until it fits the depth of the pie plate, stretching as necessary. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until puffed and golden. Cut into six squares, and let cool, then break into squares to serve.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,bread,curd cottage cheese,natural yoghurt,saffron thread,salad oil,pasta sauce
title: Saffron & Yoghurt Pies
ingredients: 500 g small dry multi-colour pasta such as penne or 500 g rigatoni pasta | 2 teaspoons salad oil | 2 tablespoons fresh simple syrup | 5 ounces curd cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh bread or 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs, finely diced | 4 saffron threads or 1/2 teaspoon saffron powder | 1/2 cup low-fat natural yoghurt
instructions: Boil 6 cups of water. Meanwhile, heat oil in a frying pan over low heat. Add saffron and stir for 1 minute. Do not allow to colour. Drain pasta and toss with saffron syrup, cottage cheese, bread, saffron and yoghurt. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cold water,pasta,garam masala,chili sauce,custard powder,table salt,malt vinegar,watercress
title: Chilled Pasta Salad With Custard
ingredients: 1 cup low-fat custard powder | 2/3 cup ice cold water | 1/8 teaspoon table salt | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 cup cold water | pasta | 1 tablespoon chopped watercress | 2 tablespoons low-fat sweet chili sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the custard powder, ice cold water, chili sauce, garam masala and the cold water. Cook the pasta according to the directions on the package. Drain and rinse with cold water. Toss pasta with 2 tbsp of sweet chili sauce. Spoon into bowls and top with remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,grapeseed oil,horseradish,pear,bay leaf,liquid honey,heavy whipping cream
title: Aunt Jenny's Honey Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons honey | 1 bay leaf | 4 slices canned pears | 1 teaspoon chopped pickled green chili pepper | 1 teaspoon dry horseradish | 1 tablespoon rapeseed oil | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Heat the honey in a small saucepan over medium heat until almost boiling. Whisk in the bay leaf and pears. Remove the pan from the heat and let the pears steep for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place the chile and horseradish in a medium bowl and mash with a fork or pestle. Add enough cream to the mixture to blend. Pour the cream over the pears and toss to coat.

title: Mexican Steak
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef round steak | 1 package mexican blend cheese, shredded ( about 8 cups ) | 1 -2 cup stuffed green olive, sliced
instructions: Put beef round steak in crockpot with 1/2 cup of cheese. Pour remaining cheese over meat. Cover, cook on low for 10 - 12 hours. Remove meat from crockpot and slice thin if desired you may also cut to thin for gravy, etc. Return meat to crockpot and stir in sliced olives.

title: Simmered Pumpkin & Chickpeas
ingredients: 225 g pumpkin puree | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 400 g canned tomatoes with ketchup | 1 green chile, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped stuffed olives | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | peas, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c/fan 180c/gas put the pumpkin, beans and tomatoes into a large bowl, pour over the olive oil, add the chilli, cinnamon and chickpeas. Mix well. Sticky food.

title: Taco-And-Corn Slaw
ingredients: 5 cups shredded red cabbage | 1 cup ground beef | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 cup frozen mexican-style corn, thawed and drained | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange a single layer of aluminum foil in a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a bowl, mix cabbage, ground beef, and taco seasoning mix. Spread mixture into foil lined baking dish. Bake in preheated oven 15 minutes, then mix corn, and salt together in a separate bowl. Spray a knife or spatula with nonstick spray, and carefully pour corn mixture over beef mixture. Return to oven, cover, and bake 15 minutes more, or until beef is no longer pink in center.

title: Veal Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb ground round | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning, any | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 12 ounces uncooked tube-shaped pasta, broken into 1-2 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 3 cups shredded rotel vegetarian cheese or 3 cups your favorite cheese
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add ground round and taco seasoning and saute until brown and crumbly, stirring often, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add oranges and pasta and stir until well coated. Add fish sauce and saute 2 more minutes. Divide and roll into taco size servings.

title: Mexican Broccoli
ingredients: 1 pound broccoli florets, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 can corn, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add broccoli and cook for 5 minutes or until tender but firm. Drain, then transfer to a large bowl. While the broccoli is cooking, steam the corn in a small skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes. Stir corn into the broccoli and toss. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,baby bok choy,american cheese,wheat tortilla
title: Baby Bok Choy Chips With Melted Cheese, Lemon &
ingredients: 2 pieces whole wheat tortillas | 1 tablespoon thinly sliced lemons, zest of or 1 tablespoon lime zest | 2 tablespoons chopped baby bok choy ( may be mixed in a jar, just the green, green only ) | 1 -2 tablespoon thinly sliced fresh american cheese
instructions: Preheat grill. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Spread 1 teaspoon of the zest on each tortilla and top with 1/2 teaspoon of the bok choy and 1 tablespoon of the cheese. Place them on the pan. Lightly spread the remaining cheese on the tops of the chips. Slide them onto the foil and grill until the cheese is melted and slightly browned. Serve with your favorite dippers. Keep cool and serve chilled.

title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs chicken legs ( or 3 breasts ) | 1/2 cup craisins | 3 anaheim chilies, seeded and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lay chilies out on cookie sheet and cover with wax paper. Cover chilies with foil and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until just soft. Remove from oven and discard skins. Place chicken legs back into skillet then add craisins, cover with foil, and bake in 350f oven for another 45 minutes. Serve with tortillas.

title: Mock Russian
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar | 1 cup powdered coffee | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 1/2 cup caramel syrup | 1/4 cup chopped cashews, toasted or 1/4 cup almonds | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate morsel ( or chocolate chips )
instructions: Add first 9 ingredients into a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Stir in semisweet or chocolate morsels. Chill at least 1 hour and serve with remaining chocolate sauce, if you wish.

title: Cathy's Easy Hamburger Mixture
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger ( hamburger should be about 3/4 inch in diameter, not more than 1/4-inch thick ) | 12 ounces buttermilk ( do not use milk powder ) | 1 teaspoon hamburger seasoning | 1 dash sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Form into about 24 meatballs. Place on a cookie sheet and brush the top with melted butter or oil. Place in the oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,granny smith apple,baking cocoa,italian breadcrumb
title: Oka's Chocolate Apple Balls
ingredients: 4 ounces dark chocolate | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 granny smith apples ( peeled, cored and minced ) | 1/4 cup baking cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place baking cocoa in a small bowl. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of bread crumbs in a second small bowl. Place minced apple in a third small bowl. Make a dent in the center of each apple by pressing the two sides together with your fingers. Fill the hole with about 2 tablespoons of the apple mixture. Roll the balls in the bread crumbs to coat. Set aside on parchment paper lined baking sheets. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes and cool to room temperature. Enjoy.

title: Lamb with Shiitake and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 2/3 cup watermelon, seeded and cut away the ends, and cut in large chunks | 2/3 cup finely chopped shiitake mushrooms | 1 teaspoon pepper | 2 shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons shiitake mango chutney
instructions: Melt margarine in a skillet. Add mushrooms and cook 3 minutes. Mix in pepper and chutney, and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat, stir in mango chutney.

title: Okra Patties (Tamari Style-Ready Lemons)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh okra ( ends removed, cut vertically into 1/2-inch pieces ) | 4 cups cornflour ( cornstarch can also be used ) | 1/2 cup tamari ( you can also use braggs amino acids, i have made it all the uses ) | 1 egg white | kosher salt ( to taste )
instructions: Cook okra until just tender and not quite mushy. Drain and place in bowl. Blend corn flour with a little water to yield a smooth paste. Add cornflour paste to okra and mix well. Add tamari and mix. If you have any leftovers place mixture in fridge for about 20 minutes, stirring regularly. It should have a little bit of liquid in it. Form into patties. I had to work with them and if they were too big or too dry, we probably would add 1 1/2 2 cups cornflour mix, and work until they reach the right consistency. Add cornflour mix to the okra mixture and mix well. Pour 1 cup cornflour mix onto a plate and roll each patty around the corn flour to cover evenly.. Place patties on a tray and refrigerate for about 20 minutes. Heat a non stick pan and add 1 1/4 cups of vegetable oil. When oil is hot, place 5 okra on the pan. Keep turning the patties until golden brown all over, about 5 minutes. Turn them again, remove okra to a paper towel. Sprinkle cooked okra with salt and serve.

title: The Dagwood's Cowboy (Drink) Risoles
ingredients: 1 cup white rice | 2 cans lager beer | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup dried coriander
instructions: Combine white rice, lager, kahlua, and coriander in a large mug. Stir, then refrigerate 1 to 2 hours prior to creating your favorite drinks.

title: Honey Peanuts
ingredients: 1/3 lb dry-roasted peanuts, preferably unsalted | 1/2 cup honey, preferably agave nectar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f place the peanuts in a large baking dish.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,egg yolk,wonton wrapper,cornflour,baby spinach leaf,white mushroom,ginger
title: Wonton Pasta - Vegetarian and Healthy!
ingredients: 2 egg yolks, beaten | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 5 tablespoons white mushrooms, chopped ( i like shitake or kansa brand ) | 3 tablespoons baby spinach leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, finely minced | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 20 wonton wrappers
instructions: Start boiling water. In your processor process egg yolks and cornflour. Add ginger and mushrooms. Process for a few more seconds until mixed. Place a tablespoon or two of filling onto the center of a won ton wrapper. Moisten the edge of the wrapper with water and fold in half, sealing the dough around the filling. Repeat until the filling is used and the wonton wrappers are used up. Place the wontons on a tray, cover with another tray and make them sweat, then steam for about 20 min, until golden brown. Enjoy.

title: Lemon Potato and Tilapia Fingers
ingredients: 3 pounds tilapia fillets | 2 large sweet potatoes, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 2 tablespoons onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the tilapia fillets into a large roasting pan and sprinkle with onion powder. Bake fish for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until easily flaked with a fork.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,rice milk,lime juice,mexican cheese,vermicelli,avocado,pistachio,greek yogurt
title: Mexican Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1/2 package uncooked vermicelli | 3 cups hot cooked rice ( or short grain or brown rice ) | 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt, plain | 1 small lime, juice of | 2 cups mexican blend cheese, shredded, divided | 1 large ripe avocado, sliced, divided | 3/4 cup fresh lime juice | 2/3 cup rice milk ( or cream ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped toasted pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Cook vermicelli in boiling water until al dente. Drain well and cool on towels. Stir in rice, yogurt, 1/3 cup of the cheese and a generous portion of avocado. Add enough juice to moisten and chill until ready to serve. Add remaining cheese, chopped avocado and remaining 1/3 cup lime juice and toss and serve immediately. Garnish with parsley toasts.

title: Fish for Two!
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet | 1/2 cup caster sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180oc. Place the tilapia fillet on a large baking tray & rub with caster sugar, then place the tray on the center shelf of the oven. Cook for 20 minutes, then carefully transfer the tilapia fillet, still on the tray, onto a plate. Place the ovenproof plate back on the grill & cook for 6 - 8 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fillet, until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve hot. Cook's note, if you don't have any caster sugar on hand, you can also use 1/2 cup caster sugar. If you don't really have any caster sugar, please use white sugar, stir to combine, then leave to cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: leek,littleneck clam,basmati rice,shell pasta,ancho chile powder,rice,orange juice,beef bouillon powder
title: Camarones Alentejana
ingredients: 8 cups water or 8 cups beef broth | 1 cup basmati rice or 2 cups arborio rice, washed in cold water and drained | 2 tablespoons achi chile powder ( mexican creole achiote ) | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 2 teaspoons beef bouillon powder ( or soy sauce ) | 1 small leek, washed, rinsed lightly and sliced diagonally, for garnish ( optional ) | 2 lbs littleneck clams, cut into half | 4 ounces small shell pasta, such as macaroni or 4 ounces linguica, such as ciabattas
instructions: Combine 4 cups water with the rice in a medium saucepan over a moderate heat. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to low. Simmer until the liquid has absorbed and the rice is tender, 18 minutes. Mix in the achiote and orange juice and reduce heat to low. Add the bouillon powder and lemon grass to the rice and stir to combine. Cover and continue cooking until the fish are barely opaque throughout and the rice is cooked, stirring occasionally, about 35 minutes longer. Do not stir with a fork during this time. Set the caldo de pollo on a dish and drain any excess liquid. Place the clams in a large saucepan and cover with boiling water. When they open, they will open up and close up releasing their aroma. When the clams are no longer open, remove the clam meat and set aside. Discard any clams or shells remaining.

title: Tortillas of Grilled Salmon
ingredients: 1 3/4 - 2 lbs fresh salmon or 1 3/4-2 lbs frozen salmon | 1/2 cup queso fresco, to taste ( can sub monterey jack, cheddar, your choice )
instructions: Prepare a grill with a light coating of oil. Place salmon fillets on the grill and cook 10 - 15 minutes on each side or until opaque in thick, flaky fillets. Remove from grill and let sit 10 minutes. Remove fillets from the grill and cut in slices, then slice each slice in half. Spoon onto platter and sprinkle with cheese. Serve with tortillas of your choice and enjoy.

title: Easy Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. In a small casserole dish, mix the tomato and green chilies with the green enchilada sauce. Spread evenly into the slow cooker. Cook on low power for 8 hours, or on high for 10 hours. When done, remove the casserole from the slow cooker. Let sit 15 minutes to cool slightly before serving.

Random Ingredients: thyme leave,kahlua,dark chocolate,onion powder,seasoning salt,tomato green chilies,ramen noodle,shiitake mushroom
title: Kahlua Mexicano
ingredients: 6 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1 medium onion | 6 ounces dark chocolate ( milk chocolate ) | 4 ounces chopped tomatoes and green chilies | 1/4 cup kahlua or 1/4 cup spicy cream | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1/2 ounce dark chocolate
instructions: Prepare shiitake mushroom by soaking in 4 cups water for 20 minutes. Squeeze mushrooms to remove water.

title: Beets With Penne
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 2 -4 cups cooked penne pasta | 1 cup cooked hamburger buns or 2 cups kaiser rolls | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 2 pinches ground mace | 1 cup mixed lettuce, in wedges
instructions: Brown meat, drain, and set aside. Cook pasta according to directions. Cool. While pasta is cooking, toast rolls. Cook buns. Place meat and pasta in pan with dressing, mace, bread crumbs, and torn lettuce.

title: Gourmet Beef Stew & Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1 lb bulk sausage
instructions: Brown sausage in large skillet.

title: Bolognese Meatballs and Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 package asparagus, trimmed | 1 lb meatball, cooked | 2 cups frozen miniature mixed vegetables | 2/3 cup vodka | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 bag miniature marshmallows | 1/3 cup shredded zucchini, shredded
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together asparagus and meatballs. In a small saucepan, combine vodka, pinto beans with juice. Cover and heat on low until liquid is reduced and flavors meld, about 7 minutes. Add asparagus mixture to meatballs. Add marshmallows and zucchini. Toss to coat.

title: Cuban Spinach Salad
ingredients: 4 stalks celery | 4 cans black beans or ( 16 ounce ) cans pinto beans | 1 bunch spinach | 5 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Cook spinach and beans separately, just until spinach is wilted. Drain and cool. Combine bean mixture, spinach, sesame oil, rum and chili powder. Serve.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,green olive,parma ham,basil,self rising flour
title: Basil, Parmesan, and Asiago Biscuits
ingredients: 6 ounces asiago cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 8 ounces parma ham, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 3 ounces green olives or 3 ounces kalamata olives, well drained | 4 eggs | 1/2 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare baking sheet by lining with parchment paper, or lightly oil a cookie sheet with a cooking spray. Place all the ingredients except flour in a large bowl, and beat with an electric mixer until well combined. Make sure to stir in the flour just to incorporate. Scoop out rounded tablespoons of the mixture onto the baking sheet, and press into circles with your thumb. Place biscottis onto the prepared cookie sheet, and bake 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown. Let cool on the baking sheet for 2 minutes, and transfer to a baking rack to cool completely.

title: Peshwari (Shrimp Braid)
ingredients: 1 package frozen cut okra | 1 cup self-rising flour, or as needed | 1/4 cup ground almonds ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom or 2 teaspoons anise flavor enhancer | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 pinch xanthan gum
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and drop in the sliced okra. Boil until just tender, about 5 minutes. Drain. Place flour into a large bowl. Add okra and cardamom or anise flavor enhancer, cayenne, and gum to flour mixture. With your hands, mix together well. With a pastry brush, spread mixture evenly onto the baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until golden, about 25 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups instant couscous, uncooked | 3/4 cup nonfat milk | 1 can reduced fat cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to prepare couscous as directed on package. Remove from heat. Stir remaining ingredients including chocolate chips into pot of couscous. Mix together. Pour mixture into a sprayed glass 9x13 baking dish coated with cooking spray. Cover and bake 45 - 50 minutes.

Random Ingredients: passion fruit,ha avocado,green chilies,bean sprout,apricot,romaine lettuce,pearl barley,tomato basil oregano garlic
title: Mexican-Style Three-Bean Bean Sprout Salad
ingredients: 1 hass avocado, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 can fat-free refried beans with chilies, drained | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tomato and basil oregano and garlic | 1 can diced green chilies, drained | 1/3 cup chopped dried apricot | 1/3 cup miniature pearl barley | 1 romaine lettuce, torn and lightly toasted | 1 1/2 cups grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: In a small bowl, mash the avocado with a fork or potato masher. Heat the refried beans in a saucepan over medium heat for about 4 minutes. Stir in the avocado, tomatoes, basil and oregano until combined. Spread the bean mixture evenly into a salad bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Just before serving, sprinkle 1/3 cup each tomato and dried apricots on top of the bean mixture. Garnish with lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Apple Salad Dressing for Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tahini | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 2 tablespoons celery, minced
instructions: Add all ingredients and mix well.

title: Feta Spread for Pasta With Green & Pesto
ingredients: 1 container feta cheese, cubed | 1 green pepper, cubed | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Put garlic in a food processor fitted with a metal blade. Add pesto and pepper.

title: Oxtail and Kidney Bean Jam
ingredients: 2 lbs oxtails | 4 lbs whole white peppercorns | 8 scallions, chopped | 12 ounces kidney beans, drained | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Place the oxtails in boiling, salted water. Let them sit for 30 seconds and take them out with a slotted spoon. Drain the oxtails, reserving the cooking liquid. Place the oxtails in a large pot, pour in the reserved cooking liquid, and season to taste with salt. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat, oxtails and vegetables are tender. Skim off any foam that forms on top of the liquid. Stir in the scallions and drained kidney beans. Cover and heat for 30 minutes. Just before serving, stir in the white wine vinegar.

title: Pasta With Chiles
ingredients: 1 small poblano chile, stemmed and seeded | 1 tablespoon hot black vinegar | 1 lb pasta, of your choice
instructions: Remove seeds from chile. Split chile open, removing some seeds if desired. Place chile into 1/2 inch of hot water, and remove the veins. Place chiles in a bowl with a good pinch of salt. Let drain 15 minutes. Drain again, and remove seeds if desired. Meanwhile, boil 3 quarts of salted water. Cook pasta in boiling water until tender but firm. Drain and add cooked chiles to it. Serve hot.

title: Czech Pasties
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 2 ounces zucchini, finely chopped | 2 ounces raisins | 2 ounces sliced black-eyed peas | 6 tablespoons raisins | 2 egg yolks | 3 1/4 cups zucchini, finely chopped | 1 red cabbage, finely chopped | 1/4 cup cold water | 1 carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f degrees. Lightly grease baking sheet. In a large bowl, mix the pork, zucchini, raisins, and black eyed peas. Stir in the egg yolks and the zucchini mixture. Separate and cut the filling into 8 equal portions. Place each portion on a piece of waxed paper. Roll, 1 to 2 inches in diameter, to make 8 logs. Cut the waxed paper into 10 even sections. Wrap each section in the plastic wrap and allow to rest for 10 minutes. Repeat with the other 10 logs. Place each pastry log on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and sprinkle with the raisins and 1/4 cup each of the cold water. Bake at 375f degrees for 30 minutes or until the tops are tinged with brown. Remove from the oven and immediately place on a wire rack to cool. Using a slotted spoon, lower the loaves onto plates, leaving a slight crust on the top. Cover and set aside for at least 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,white onion,vegetable broth,orange juice,millet,asparagus,red chili pepper
title: Asparagus in a Spicy Sauce (Ribollita de Asparagi a La Gallega)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, trimmed to 1 inch pieces | 1/3 cup millet ( arborio rice ) | 1/2 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 fresh red chili pepper, minced ( serrano ) | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/4 cup whole milk
instructions: Rinse asparagus under cold water.

Random Ingredients: mace,italian herb seasoning,corn syrup,lettuce leaf,pesto sauce,taco seasoning
title: Creamy Italian Lettuce
ingredients: 12 lettuce leaves ( washed under cold water ) | 1 tablespoon basil-based pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons italian herb seasoning | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon mild taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon molasses or 1 tablespoon maple syrup, if desired
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce and mix well. Refrigerate for 4 hours, stirring twice. Just before serving, remove lettuce and spoon on desired amount. Serve hot over lettuce.

title: Soupy
ingredients: 200 g cocktail franks ( halved or quartered ) | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 2 teaspoons oil or 2 teaspoons bacon fat ( i use olive oil ) | 200 g lamb ( cut into cubes )
instructions: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients except for the lamb. Add the lamb cubes and lightly coat everything with the marinade. Marinate meat for 30 minutes or longer in the refrigerator. Grill the lamb until medium rare and serve.

Random Ingredients: bok choy,icing sugar,lettuce leaf,dijon mustard,egg yolk,self raising flour
title: Tropical Slice
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 150 g icing sugar | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 2/3 cup dijon mustard | 1 head bok choy, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c. Lightly line a 25cm x 25cm slice pan with baking paper, allowing the paper to extend over the sides of the pan. Beat egg yolks. Add icing sugar and beat until thick and creamy. Add flour and mustard and mix until combined. Spread mixture evenly in the prepared pan. Bake 15 minutes. Remove from fridge and cool. Chop bok choy finely and place in a microwave safe gratin dish. Add 1/2 cup of icing sugar. Microwave until mixture is hot and starting to set, stirring every minute. Remove and pour over base. Cool to room temperature. Spread with remaining icing mixture. Sprinkle with more icing sugar.

title: Christmas Grilled Corn on the Cob With Choc Cream
ingredients: 4 corn on the cob, trimmed | 2 tablespoons olive, chopped | 4 teaspoons fennel seeds, toasted or 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, fromage frais | 1 cup miracle whip | 5 ounces bittersweet chocolate milk | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat. Place corn on the grill plate and lightly brush with some of the olive oil. Turn corn when bubbles appear on the edge of the corn and the tops appear dry, about 3 minutes. Slice corn crosswise into 4 wedges. Sprinkle grates with salt. Transfer to a plate and keep warm. In a small frypan, combine remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil, stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and stand for 10 minutes. Brush grill with a little of the warmed dressing. Grill corn wedges on the rack 4 - 5 minutes or until heated through. Serve corn with choc cream sauce.

title: Tandoori Salad
ingredients: 1 lb lettuce | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons fresh dill weed | 1/2 cup brandy | 2 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Wash, pat dry, and slice the lettuce into 2 inch lengths. Place lettuce and coriander seeds in a bowl, add half the dried and fresh dill weed. Whisk brandy and kaffir lime leaves together. Pour the mixture over the leaves and toss to coat. Serve.

Random Ingredients: fontina cheese,kalamata olive,heavy whipping cream,orange bell pepper
title: Orange, Olive & Fontina Pepper Dessert
ingredients: 1 large orange bell pepper | 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 6 tablespoons fontina cheese | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, roughly chopped

Repeat until cream is all used and cheese is well blended. Spread mixture evenly on top of the cheese. Press remaining pepper halves into cream and sprinkle on the remaining cheese. Set upright under a large piece of tin foil so that the cream does not surround the bottom of the dish. Chill for 1 hour. Unwrap pan of cream and cut into 6 large chunks. To serve, cut each chunk into 6 slices and serve with remaining cream.

title: Cotija and Longanero Salt Body Polish
ingredients: 4 pieces aluminum foil packed in salt | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese
instructions: Place the piece of aluminum foil on your work surface or on the counter. Carefully pack the piece of aluminum foil into about 6 to 12 ounces of liquid, about a 1/8 inch square. You want all of your sheets and your hands to be able to fit into your vacuum flask so tightly packed it will slip out easily. Be sure to take out the air bubbles and circulate the liquid around you. The foil should enclose the air. You could leave it on the counter at room temperature for up to one week before simply giving it as a gift. Place the jar of liquid into a deep, cool place such as the bottom of a small tea kettle to keep hot. To prepare the body, place the piece of aluminum foil that you are using into the liquid and allow it to come to room temperature. Carefully transfer the piece of aluminum foil into the liquid and set it onto the counter with the flat of your finger to remove any liquid that leaks out. Carefully remove the piece of aluminum foil in a single layer with the flat of your hand. Carefully transfer the piece of tin foil with the liquid onto the piece of aluminum foil. You should have 12 pieces of aluminium foil layered on top of each other. Using a tooth pick, poke at each piece of aluminum foil that has been dipped into water, just enough to make a hole in each piece of foil. Carefully remove the pieces with a pair of toothpicks with the tooth picks. Continue to do this until all the pieces are used. To use the liquid in the liquid, you can take one piece of aluminum foil and coat it lightly with pam, place on your working surface, and allow to reach room temperature before you start working it. It just means you are working the residue from another piece of aluminum foil into the liquid by pouring it all over the piece of aluminum that has been coated with pam. After working the residue carefully take your piece of aluminum onto the counter, and apply the residue evenly into a hole in each piece of aluminum foil. Carefully push the piece of aluminum foil with the residue onto the piece of aluminum that has been covered with pam, pressing down on the residue with your fingers to extract more of the liquid. Carefully push the piece of aluminum with the residue back onto the piece of aluminum foil. The residue will begin to air circulate around the piece of aluminum foil. Do not add any more air or you will end up with large air pockets. This is normal. Use your hands to flatten each piece of aluminum foil into a thin slab using your hands. Make sure the air bubbles are between every piece of aluminum foil. Wrap the piece of foil tightly around the fatty pieces of aluminum foil with the palm of your hand to make a seal on the foil. This is a heavy piece of aluminum that has been slightly flattened but doesn't stick to your hands. Place the piece of foil over the weight in the microwave and microwave on high power power for 1 1/2 minutes, rotating your microwave so the aluminum is evenly and evenly covered with its liquid. Check the piece of aluminum at 1 1/2 minutes, and if it begins to bubble up and crackles all over it is done. The tighter you move, the more crispy the piece will be. Remove the paper from the microwave and serve immediately. Store sealed in the refrigerator, and it will keep for up to 2 months.
