ingredients: 1/2 beef brisket | 3 tablespoons instant minced onion salt | 2 ounces vodka | 4 ounces mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 1 teaspoon minced pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons raspberry preserves | 8 ounces italian sausage, sliced 3/4-inch thick from a deli roll
instructions: Spread the beef brisket on a foil lined baking sheet and season with onion salt. Roast in a hot oven just until internal temperature reads 145 degrees f or 195 degrees f for medium rare. Remove from oven and let cool.

title: Simple Muffins
ingredients: 1 free range chicken, cooked | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | miracle whip
instructions: Place the chicken or any seafood into bowl and mix altogether with tomato paste. Spoon mixture into 24 muffin cups. Drizzle with miracle whip and grill them.

title: Cheesy Vegetable and Macaroni Bake
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni | 1/4 cup white cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup celery | 1 teaspoon sherry | 1 small cumberland cauliflower | 1 small courgette | 1 apple
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Drain, cool and crumble. Mix macaroni with cheese, celery and sherry and place into a 9x13 dish. Tear cumberland and courgette into bite size pieces and place on top. Mix apple with the macaroni mix, then sprinkle over the cheese mix. Bake for 30 minutes at 180oc, uncover and sprinkle with grated chedder cheese.

Random Ingredients: mint leaf,honey,chipotle chile,rigatoni pasta,chicken bouillon,soy sauce,stuffing
title: Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 450 g rigatoni pasta | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground chipotle chile | 500 g prepared stuffing | 1/2 cup finely chopped mint leaf | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Cook rigatoni in boiling water for approximately 8 minutes, or until al dente. When cooked, drain well. Allow pasta to cool for a couple of minutes. Meanwhile, combine the soy sauce, chilli, stuffing, mint and chicken bouillon or a tbsp of water. Whisk until well combined and set aside. Once cooled, transfer the pasta to a large salad bowl. Stir through the sauce, mix until combined and set aside. Pour the mixture into a separate dish, put aside.

title: Portuguese Gravy
ingredients: 3/4 cup cognac | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 3 teaspoons chili powder | 4 -6 tablespoons flour | 7 white mushrooms, thinly sliced
instructions: Mix together 1 1/4 cup cognac, cornstarch and 2 teaspoons chili powder. Slice 2 - 3 mushrooms and put into the mixture. Dredge mushrooms with 2 tablespoons of the flour. Let stand 10 minutes. Brown mushrooms in a heavy skillet for five minutes. Pour off any remaining fat and add cognac mixture to the skillet. Let sauce simmer 5 more minutes.

title: Honey & Tuna Skewers
ingredients: 240 g tinned chickpeas | 1 can of cut tuna | 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight in water. Drain and rinse. Soak the tuna in water until it turns white. Place the drained chickpeas on a plate or tray and cover. Leave overnight in the fridge. Drain the tuna of any excess water. Thread the tuna onto 2 skewers. Spray with oil and place on a grill. Grill for 10 minutes or until the tuna is cooked and the tuna is golden. Serve with fresh salad.

title: Oriental Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 cup picante sauce, any mild picante sauce | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar or 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried herbs | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil ( or regular oil )
instructions: Whisk together the picante sauce, vinegar, herbs, oil till well blended and pour over ice.

title: Cranberry Almond Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: In a small bowl combine cranberries and almonds. Place cereal mixture in an ungreased small baking dish. Bake in a small preheated 325 degree f oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and stir.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,chocolate baking square,salad oil,hoisin sauce,dill sprig,dark brown sugar,lettuce
title: Chinese Steak Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb steak, thin sliced | hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 1 inch piece gingerroot, julienned | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chopped dill sprigs | 2 chocolate baking squares, melted
instructions: Combine hoisin sauce, salad oil, ginger root, brown sugar and dillweed in bowl and toss with steak. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Remove steak of steak from refrigerator 5 minutes before cooking to allow juices and marinade time to redistribute. Drain and discard excess marinade. Serve with sauce.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin puree,triple sec,french bread,plain nonfat yogurt,taco seasoning mix,broth,tamarind pulp,tomato juice
title: Slow Cooker Tex Mex Style Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 4 cups canned pumpkin puree | 1 can tomato juice ( or fresh if you wish ) | 1/2 cup dry teabags | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt, stirred | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons tamarind pulp ( optional ) | 1 loaf french bread, cut in 1-inch cubes
instructions: Put 1 cup of pumpkin puree and the tomato juice into the slow cooker. Sprinkle the teabags all over the surface. Cover with 1 cup of water. Set the cooker on high and cook for 4 hours, or until very mushy. After the 4 hours, uncover stir in the teabags, yogurt and triple sec. If serving over french bread, heat through, but watch out for spills. If you are using italian style bread cubes, toast them about 30 - 60 minutes in the oven, until golden brown and crispy. To make the tamarind broth, put the tamarind pulp in to a food processor. Crush until very fine, then stir it into the broth. Let cool a few minutes. For the soup, stir the soup occasionally while it simmers until the flavors meld. Serve in a bowl with a scoop of french bread cubes sprinkled with the warm tamarind broth.

Random Ingredients: horseradish,ranch salad dressing,brown mustard seed,italian bread crumb,yellow bell pepper,cream tartar,chicken meat
title: Chicken Persnickety Patties
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1 dash cream of tartar | 1 cup chopped, cooked chicken meat | 1/2 cup chopped yellow bell peppers | 1/2 cup ranch-style salad dressing
instructions: Heat the mustard seed in a skillet over medium high heat. When the seeds begin to dry out, stir in the horseradish and italian bread crumbs. Spread to make a slightly sloppy paprika coating. Mix in the chicken, yellow bell pepper and ranch style dressing. Form into 12 patties. Slices of any remaining mustard and horseradish can be served on the side. Note, this can also be made using the mustard seed bun as a snack topping, too.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,lipton onion soup mix,bamboo shoot,adobo seasoning,nori
title: Sushi Roll Sushi
ingredients: 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 2 -3 dashes adobo seasoning | nori
instructions: In a bowl mix together the onion soup mix, bamboo shoots, lime zest, adobo seasoning and lime juice so that the soup mix gets distributed evenly. You can keep it chunky or even more or a little bit thicker for a lighter effect. Lay out nori, or seaweed on your work surface. Using one end of the nori slice off just short enough to make a 3 long strip of nori. Spread a very thin layer on the nori leaving about 1/2 inch of nori free on each slice. Spread on 1/2 teaspoon of soup mix. Roll up and place in your bento box. Repeat with remaining nori to make 24 rolls. I roll them up and put them in the container where i kept the soup mix, but they can easily be eaten if desired. I have found that the leftovers are really good when they are refrigerated for 1 day. I add as many rolls as i can.

title: Blueberry Beef Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef or 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1/2 inch chunks | 1 1/2 cups frozen blueberries | 2 cups cold cooked long-grain white rice, uncooked | 2 cloves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 1/2 cups diced cooked boneless beef or 1 1/2 cups turkey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375. Place beef, berries, rice, cloves, and beef in a baking dish. Pour remaining ingredients over beef. Cover, and bake for 30 minutes. Remove cover, and bake an additional 20 minutes. Let stand before serving.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,pecorino romano cheese,olive,cabbage,kaffir lime leaf,guacamole,garlic powder,white poppy seed
title: Kaffir and Lime Calzones
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon minced garlic powder | 1 lime leaf, cut into wedges | 1 tablespoon white poppy seeds | 1 package cabbage, shredded | 3/4 cup crushed ripe olives | 1/3 cup olive | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place cake mix, pecorino romano cheese, garlic powder, and lime leaf in a large bowl. Stir in poppy seeds and spread mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish or muffin tin. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour, or until toothpick inserted into the center of a cut roll comes out clean. Allow to cool completely. To make filling, toss cabbage, olives, and olive oil together in a bowl. Remove toothpicks with a fork.

title: Tomato Soup with Worcestershire
ingredients: 4 cups canned stewed tomatoes | 6 -10 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: If you are using tomatoes and not canned tomatoes, place them in a blender or food processor for a smooth puree. Combine all ingredients. You can add more or less broth or tomatoes for a thicker consitency. If necessary, add more worcestershire sauce, for a thicker consitency. Simmer gently, covered, for about 20 minutes.

title: Teddy's Sausages (Sausages) #RSC
ingredients: 8 ounces lean pork spareribs | 2 tablespoons wattleseed | 3 -4 drops red chile ( perferably a pungent one ) | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Make sure all country sausage pieces are fully defrosted. Pat dry with paper towels. Cut links into one inch size pieces. Combine spareribs with reynolds wrap® foil pieces, one by one, in a large skillet on medium high heat. Sprinkle worcesterseed and chiles onto meat. Turn only once, and let them sizzle for 1 minute, turning meat occasionally with tongs. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 1 day. Cut meat into three even pieces.

title: Green Chile Arroz Con Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken breast half, sliced 1/4 inch thick and cut crosswise into 1/3 inch pieces | 1 can whole canned green chilies, drained ( or 6-8 ounces chiles of your choice ) | 1 can of chopped chilies, drained ( or 2 cups of your choice ) | 1 can arborio rice | 3 cups fresh green chilies, sliced
instructions: Place the chicken in a 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole dish. Drain chiles well. Mix chiles, chiles, and rice in a large bowl.

title: Fresh Thai Basil (Nuoc Mam Man)
ingredients: 20 leaves thai basil | 1 white onion, sliced into rounds
instructions: Combine thai basil leaves, white onion, and sliced white onion in a mortar. Use the pestle to crush the basil until you have a smooth paste. Use as needed to store in refrigerator.

title: Baked Mexican Corn Chips
ingredients: 2 coriander seeds | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 3 cardamoms | 1 head lettuce | 4 slices prosciutto | 1/2 cup corn chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees and arrange a baking tray in the oven. Place coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, cardamom pods and lettuce on a baking tray. Bake on tray for 15 or 20 minutes, until lightly browned and fragrant. Remove from the oven and allow to cool to room temperature. Cut top off each cabbage head, remove outer leaves and cut each head crosswise into 12 wedges. Arrange the wedges onto a serving platter. Top with prosciutto and then with the chips. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg quarter,pearl barley,coconut extract,red wine,white chocolate
title: Coconut Beer Wings
ingredients: 4 chicken leg quarters | 1/2 cup pearl barley, dried | 1 1/2 cups sweet red wine, such as sauvignon blanc | 1 tablespoon coconut extract | 1 white chocolate piece, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place chicken pieces and pearl barley in a roasting pan.

title: Stove Top Pecan, Bacon, and Bleu Soup
ingredients: 2 slices pancetta | 1 can sliced green peas ( drained ) | 1 can bamboo shoots ( drained ) | 1/4 cup dried cauliflower ( rinsed and drained ) | 1/4 cup canned small green peas ( drained ) | sliced fennel | 2 tablespoons broth, of choice | 1/4 cup fish stock
instructions: Melt pancetta in large dutch oven. Add sliced green peas, bamboo shoots, green peas, chopped cauliflower, fennel, and 2 tablespoons broth. Stir to blend. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add remaining broth. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Serve with crusty bread and cheese.

title: Kobotlet (Indonesian Stir-Fried Potatoes)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs red potatoes | 1 teaspoon brown sugar or 1/2 teaspoon honey | 32 skewers | steamed rice, for accompaniment
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1/2 in pieces and boil until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain the potatoes, reserving the liquid. Put into a mixing bowl and add the sugar. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle peel the skin off and mash into the mash. Add salt and pepper to taste. Soak the skewers in cold water for 20 minutes. Remove potatoes from the marinade and thread them onto skewers. Grill or broil until browned and cooked through, 3 - 6 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,rosemary,extra beef,butter,cardamom pod,mushroom,green curry paste
title: Indian Beef on Curry
ingredients: 3 lbs extra lean stewing beef, cut into bite sized chunks | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon ground turmeric | 6 whole cardamom pods | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large dutch oven or heavy pot, preferably wide and deep enough to hold the ingredients. Add the beef, and brown on all sides. Add the green curry, rosemary, cardamom and turmeric. Cook and stir another 2 minutes before the mixture comes to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook slowly 5 minutes, stirring from time to time. Remove the cover, and simmer 45 minutes or until the beef is tender and falling apart. Skim excess sauce off the top as it cooks. Transfer the beef to a platter and keep warm. Stir the pan juices, about 1/4 cup at a time, into the beef and simmer, uncovered, stirring frequently, until the sauce thickens and begins to coat the back of wooden spoon. Stir in 1/2 tablespoon of the butter to thicken the gravy. Serve hot.

title: Asparagus With Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 lb baby corn, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 roma tomato, peeled chopped | 2 tablespoons minced parsley | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: Steam asparagus for 3 minutes. Rinse under cold water and drain. In hot skillet add asparagus, tomato and parsley. In frying pan, add garlic powder and a few drops of oil. Bring to a boil. Add asparagus mixture. Cover and cook over low heat for 8 minutes for young vegetables crisp. Stir once or twice. Serve over rice.

title: Almond Glazed Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 2 salmon fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread almonds out on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly golden brown, about 20 minutes. Turn onto a piece of aluminum foil and drizzle with a little sunflower oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,dark sesame oil,oyster sauce,hot red pepper flake
title: Hot Rice
ingredients: 1 cup instant hot red pepper flakes | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 5 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the hot red pepper flakes, tomato soup, sesame oil, and oyster sauce. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Huey's Italian Sausage and Meatball Stew
ingredients: 1/4 lb ground turkey | 1/4 lb ground canadian bacon or 1/4 lb other bacon, cut into 1/4-inch dice | 1 package meatballs | 1 can diced italian turkey sausage ( hot or mild ) | 1 can pinto beans
instructions: Brown turkey and bacon or crumble sausage, drain liquid. Add meatballs, undrained beans and diced turkey/bacon. Cook until meatballs turn golden brown, stirring often. Enjoy.

title: Lime Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 1 cup lime juice, or as needed | 1 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Stir lime juice and bread crumbs together in a bowl. Place in refrigerator until serving.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,thai red curry paste,chicken bouillon granule,gingerroot,white pepper,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Raspberry Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 cup raspberries ( fresh or frozen & thawed ) | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot ( grated & peeled ) | 1 dash thai red curry paste ( or other hot spice mix, of your choice ( i prefer ras el hanout moroccan spice mix ) | 3/4 cup chicken bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon thai red curry paste ( or other hot spice mix ( i prefer ras el hanout moroccan spice mix )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a food processor & pulse until well blended. Store in an airtight jar in light, warm heat for up to 6 weeks.

title: Easy Cream of Orange Marmalade Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange marmalade | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Combine orange marmalade and sour cream in small bowl. Spread over bottom of small casserole dish. Cover as follows, 1/2 cup sour cream and 1 cup marmalade mixture. Repeat 2 times. Top with remaining 1/2 cup sourcream and marmalade mixture. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Top with whipped cream if desired. Serve with fruit or vegetables.

title: Jicama Salad With Feta-Maple Dressing
ingredients: 2 lbs jicama | 1 cup crumbled feta | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup mustard oil
instructions: Peel, seed, and cut jicama into thin slices. Rinse, and dry jicama by running under cold water to get rid of as much water. In a large bowl, toss together with maple syrup and mustard oil. Mix in cooked jicama, and toss, until coated, and well coated.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,onion,water,provolone cheese,dark sesame oil,mexican cheese
title: Mexi Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups water | 1 medium onion, chopped, divided | 4 cups shredded mexican blend cheese, divided | 3/4 cup shredded provolone cheese | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Stir water, 1/2 cup of the shredded cheese, onion, and remaining cheese together in a saucepan over medium low heat until all the cheese has melted and is hot. Stir in sesame oil and chili oil.

title: Lime-Sour Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless sirloin ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 2 teaspoons chili sauce | 1/2 cup limeade concentrate | 1 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium size bowl. Add the beef and let stand for 5 minutes. Thread the beef onto skewers. Barbecue over medium heat for 10 minutes.

title: Sweet and Tart Pasta With Chicken or Beef
ingredients: 2 frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 500 g ground chicken or 500 g ground beef | 200 g chopped chocolate | 1 cup dates | 3/4 cup catsup | chocolate, melted
instructions: Heat oven to 200c. Line a 10 x 15 ovenproof dish with pastry. Cut pastry into 3 rectangles. Place 1 tablespoon of the chicken or beef in het meat in the centre of each rectangle. Spread half the chocolate over the beef and add another tablespoon chicken or beef to the chocolate. Top with 1/2 of the dates and a third of the semisweet chocolate. Spoon 1 tablespoon of the catsup evenly on top. Fold in half and press firmly.

title: Fruity Moos
ingredients: 1 jar mushrooms, drained ( any kind of port would do ) | 2 tablespoons coffee ( optional )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients. I usually add the coffee to make it strong.

Random Ingredients: za'atar spice mix,ice,italian parsley,nigella seed,ice water
title: Chilled Za'atar With Nigella Chips
ingredients: 1 cup ice, unsweetened | 1/3 cup za'atar spice mix | 5 teaspoons nigella seeds, ground | 1 tablespoon italian parsley, finely chopped | ice, cold
instructions: Place 1 cup ice, za'atar, nutella, and parsley in a food processor. Process until the mixture is smooth and creamy, then transfer to a pitcher and let chill several hours or overnight. Pour the chilled mixture into a martini glass or martini glass and serve with the nigella chips.

title: Tommy's Simple Tomato Jam
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg ripe tomatoes | 2 tablespoons butter | 750 ml fruit cocktail, well drained of juice concentrate ( cocktail with juice, juice and pulp ) | 80 g raisins ( optional )
instructions: Heat 1 litre or larger preserving pan, over a medium heat. Cut tomatoes in half and scoop out seeds with a spoon. Discard the skin. Cut each slice into six wedges then into roughly equal pieces with a spoon. Put into pan and melt the butter over medium heat. Add fruit cocktail mix and raisins and gently mix all together. Increase heat and bring to the boil. Turn heat down and simmer for 40 minutes, stirring frequently until mixture thickens slightly. Do not be afraid of it sticking to the end of the cooking time or your jam will burn. Remove jam from heat and pour into sterilized jars. Use a hot water bath to seal, leaving enough space for the jam to spread freely. You can store the jam in an air tight tin, sealed in a cool dry place for upto a week. If the jam starts to cool, it must be brought back to room temperature before sealing.

title: Baked French Snack Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups reduced-fat crescent dinner rolls | 5 tablespoons orange liqueur | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: In a bowl, combine rolls, essense & vanilla & mix until smooth. Pour mixture into a greased 9' x 5'' loaf pan, allowing an even amount of space for spreading. Bake at 325f for 15 - 20 minute or until heated through. Remove from oven & let cool slightly before removing from pan. Serve warm or room temp with cream fraische.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,jasmine rice,self rising flour,baby spinach leaf,feta cheese,asafoetida powder,grenadine
title: Cottage Cheese & Spinach Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice or 1 cup yellow rice | 3 -4 cups besan ( chick peas ) | 2 tablespoons raw onion & garlic salad dressing ( can use vegan ) | 2 tablespoons grenadine | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 - 1 3/4 cup baby spinach, washed, dried and chopped | crushed feta cheese, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Cook the rice in plenty of water according to packet directions, about 20 minutes depending on how tender you like your risotto. Meanwhile, fry the onion and garlic in a frying pan until golden brown and fragrant. Add the cooked rice, soups, crème fraîche and asafoetida. Stir to coat. Drain and rinse the rice. Add back to the pan to heat through and add the baby spinach. Serve hot with freshly grated or fresh coriander. To make ahead, store the cooked rice and soups separately in a microwave safe container for 6 hours. Reheat before serving.

title: Pina Colada Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white breadcrumbs | 1 cup jasmine rice ( not instant ) | 2 cans chopped chili beans, drained | 1/2 cup dried pineapple chunks | 1 tablespoon mixed spice ( baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix ) | 1 teaspoon thyme | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Rinse rice and set aside. Place bread crumbs into large bowl and set aside. In large bowl, mash beans into bread crumbs using clean hands, adding remaining ingredients. Mix well and let sit 5 minutes. Place rice on baking sheet and bake at 350ºf about 20 minutes or until tender. Turn off oven and open door to make sure rice is open. Cut nori sheets in half. Carefully spread out rice, leaving a 2 inch overhang on each slice of nori. Spoon rice onto nori. Garnish with a sprinkling of dried fruits and chopped nuts if desired. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,fusilli,baby corn,ladyfinger,tomato green chilies,butter,lime zest
title: Lavender Buttery Fusilli
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 cups grape tomatoes, halved, washed | 14 ounces baby corn, cut in half | 7 ounces canned diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest, finely grated | 8 ladyfingers, thin
instructions: Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add tomatoes, corn, chilies and lime zest.

title: Aussie Peaches and Flapjack
ingredients: 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 5 large ripe peaches, halved, peeled, pitted and cut into 6 chunks | 150 -300 ml heavy whipping cream, divided | 12 ounces flapjack steak or 12 ounces lean sirloin steak, thinly-sliced ( 4 steaks total ) | 2 -4 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa | 4 tablespoons large lettuce
instructions: Stir soda into warm cream and set aside. In another bowl, mix peaches with half the cream. Set aside. Combine steak and the remaining cream and refrigerate. Grill steak for 4 - 5 minutes per side at highest heat. Grill steak 3 - 4 minutes per side for medium rare. Transfer steak to serving plate and let it rest while making cocktail sauce, in a pan, stir cocoa into remaining cream. Bring mixture to a boil, stir in remaining cream, remove from heat and stir in peaches. Serve steak with cocktail schnapps alongside.

title: Soy Cheddar Spread
ingredients: 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese, aged, shredded | 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Mix the cheddar cheese with the sesame seeds. You can spread the spread on toasted wheat crackers while still warm, or make it a little more soft to serve, if you like.

Random Ingredients: peach preserve,yellow squash,pie crust,leek,chicken broth,caper,apricot preserve,icing sugar
title: Summer Squash and Peach Soup
ingredients: 1 frozen pie crust or ( 9 inch ) unbaked pie crust | 1 lb yellow squash, sliced | 1 leek, chopped | 3 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup peach preserves | 2 tablespoons capers | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1/2 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Bake the pie crust by following the following instructions on the package. If using a pie crust, preheat oven to 425 degrees f. In a medium bowl, combine squash, leek, chicken broth and preserves and let cook until just tender. Add the butter cheese and icing sugar and mix well. Spread mixture into the crust and place in oven. Bake for 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,rye flour,white pepper,lemon juice,corn oil,vanilla essence,vegetable shortening
title: Rye Popcorn
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 cup rye flour | 1 cup sugar | 2 1/2 cups vegetable shortening | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 3 drops vanilla essence | corn oil ( for frying )
instructions: Place the lemon juice and the rye flour in the bowl of a mixer. Mix at low speed. Add the sugar, continue beating until the mixture is creamy. Add the shortening, salt, pepper, lemon juice, vanilla essence, and vanilla. Mix at medium speed for 1 minute. Pour 1 to 2 tablespoons of corn oil into a deep fry pan. To test if they are hot enough, drop a ball in the oil and it will crackle. If it crackles, it is ready. Turn on the oven to 250°f. Heat the corn oil in a deep fryer or deep saucepan to 350 degrees. You will need two cookie sheets, a tray and half a cup measuring cup.

title: Beef, Bananas and Mahi Daikon Style Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked long grain brown rice, preferably jasmine | 1/2 lb lean beef tenderloin, trimmed of all extra fat, cut into thin strips | 4 slices daikon radishes, cut on the diagonal into 1-inch wide slices | 4 slices ripe bananas, sliced crosswise on the diagonal | 4 small hamburger rolls, split
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, bring 1 cup of water to a boil. Add rice and stir to coat. Boil gently until rice is almost tender, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes longer. Meanwhile, cook beef in remaining 1/2 cup water until just rare, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss sliced beef with daikon, bananas and 3 tablespoons water. Set aside. Preheat oven to 350°. Heat 2 tablespoons of remaining 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add the beef mixture and sprinkle with rice. As soon as the rice begins to brown, place 2 sandwiches on each of 4 dinner plates, breaking each sandwich in half. Top with remaining sandwiches and top with remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Cover pan with aluminum foil, transfer to the oven and bake until the sandwiches are heated through and the rice is hot and crisp, 1 to2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,chili powder,ladyfinger,garlic paste,habanero pepper,grain brown rice
title: Johnny Jalapeno's Killer Saffron Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain brown rice | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups liqueur ( perrier or grand marnier ) | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 -3 habanero peppers | 2 -3 ladyfingers
instructions: Cook rice. Make garlic paste by placing in saucepan and heating until fragrant. Add the liquors and the chili powder. Bring to a boil and add chiles. Allow to boil for an additional 2 - 3 minutes. Serve over hot brown rice.

title: Fennel-Roasted French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread ( about 10 x 12 inches or so- you can use other bread ) | 1/3 cup vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons fennel seeds | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Set oven rack 1 inches away from the heat and preheat the oven to 200 degrees f. Cut the crusts off the bread. Cut a 1 1/2 inch deep slash with a sharp knife into 1 1/2 inch slices. Brush with oil. Scatter seeds evenly into the cuts. Sprinkle with coriander and salt. Bake bread slices in the hot oven for 15 minutes, until bread is hot, but not dark brown. Serve warm.

title: Tortilla Diablos
ingredients: 1 boneless beef roast | 1 tablespoon seasoning | 1/2 cup corn | 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Sprinkle the roast with seasoning. Brown on both sides in oil. Cover. Simmer at low for a hour. Remove lid, add corn and almonds and cook until the almonds are browned. Serve with hot tortillas.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,lemon zest,celery rib,beef bouillon cube,apple cider,walnut,broccoli,plain flour
title: Fish and Chips With Parsley Blossom Sauce
ingredients: 500 g tilapia fillets | 100 g chopped broccoli | 100 g chopped fresh parsley | 100 g chopped smoked greek olive or 100 g walnuts | 3 apple cider | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 lemon, zest of | 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Boil water and drop in fish, boil for 2 mins then remove, cool and separate. Reserve the broccoli and parsley. Chop olives and walnuts and set aside. Whisk flour in 1/2 cup of hot water and gradually add to broth, stirring continuously. Add rest of the ingredients except fish and chips, cook until thickened. Dredge fish in flour. Heat remaining olive oil on frying pan. Fry fish until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Toss chips into fish and sprinkle with parsley, nuts, and serve with mint sauce. Enjoy.

title: Italian Parsnip Chips With Caviar Recipe # Cio-Ciabatta
ingredients: ciabatta, loaf ( i use italian parsnips ) | parsnip ( fresh, about 1-1/2 lbs )

title: Olive Ice-Cream

instructions: Combine the olive juice, yogurt, bay leaf and mint in a small bowl and stir until just combined. Place the cherry halves and cherry halves onto a plate or piece of foil. Spoon the olive mixture into the cherry halves and serve.

title: Calauliflower and Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower | 1 squash | 1/2 cup cashews ( to taste ) or 1/2 cup peanuts ( to taste )
instructions: Cut cauliflower in small florets and remove the head and the seeds.

instructions: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients.

title: Sweet and Creamy Romaine Salad Salad
ingredients: 2 cups romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup double cream | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Place russet lettuce in a large salad bowl. In a small bowl whisk the cream and sesame oils until blended. Pour dressing over romaine lettuce. Toss lightly, cover, and refrigerate the salad for 2 hours.

title: Sausage and Spinach Wrapped in Sage
ingredients: 12 ladyfingers, split | 2 lbs fresh spinach | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 3 -4 tablespoons brandy or 3 -4 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Wash spinach well, pulling away any woody leaves, wash spinach and spin dry. Slice sausage into 1/4 thick slices. Place all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer gently until sausage is cooked through and liquid almost evaporates, about ten minutes. Place in a bowl to cool, but not allow to cool to room temperature. Wrap each half ladyfinger individually in a small piece of spinach and set aside. Arrange sausage in a lightly greased, shallow half sheet pan. Arrange spinach, sausage, and any juices that have run out, in a row, overlapping. Cover with plastic wrap and weight with a 2 lb. Weight. Chill and marinate overnight. Drain sausage and discard marinade. Wrap wrapped sausage in leaves in parchment paper and bake at 400° 45 minutes.

title: Curried Butternut Squash, Cabbage and Beer
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable | 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 2 tablespoons curry powder or 1 tablespoon indian curry paste | 1/2 cup chopped cabbage | 1 1/4 cups well-shaken beer ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a non stick skillet sprayed with spray, saute 1 tablespoon vegetable until tender but not brown, around 8 minutes. Set aside. Using the other tablespoon of vegetable spray and remaining oil, saute remaining 1 tablespoon curry powder, or curry paste. Stir fry coated squash with about 2 tablespoons water until tender crisp around 10 minutes. Set aside. Spray a large baking dish with spray. Pour beer into dish, and mix well. Add the vegetables and stir to mix. Bake at 400 until the dish is bubbly and the vegetables and beer have absorbed most of the liquid, around 25 minutes.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup diced mexican cheese blend | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | 1 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: In a 2 quart enameled cast iron skillet cook the mexican rice following the package directions, except add the half and half. Remove from heat and stir in the cheese until melted and then the rice. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Low Fat Hot Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces canned fat-free refried beans | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1 celery rib ( finely diced )
instructions: Mix well and put in a shallow dish. Bake at 375 degrees 20 minutes. Serve with chips or as a condiment to stir fried vegetables.

title: Cabbage & Asparagus (With Tomatoes & Asparagus)
ingredients: 1 medium head red cabbage, about 1 1/2-inch cut | 1 lb asparagus, snap-tender, 3-4 inches cut lengthwise | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup cherry, cut in half, cut in half with spears ( optional )
instructions: Wash cabbage, remove core, shred.

title: Macadamia Chicken

title: Pasta With Asiago Cheese

instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Cook as per package directions, drain and spread onto a large warm plate and sprinkle with asiago cheese. Serve hot.

instructions: Place tuna in a small heatproof bowl, cover with plastic wrap and scatter with remaining tarragon, 1/2 tsp oregano and the chilli flakes. title: Anise Parmigiana

ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced into 1/2 inch slices | 2 cans french bread, cut in half lengthwise | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 bag baby carrots | 1 small red chili powder | 1 container mango vinaigrette or ( 1 3/4 ounce ) container green chutney | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian bread | 1 lime leaf, cut into wedges
instructions: Layer french bread, green enchilada sauce, carrots, chili powder, and mango vinaigrette in to a 3 quart crock or serving dish. Top with the sliced mozzarella and a lime wedge. Repeat with remaining bread. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours hours to mix flavors before serving.

instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook the penne rigate according to the package directions. When pasta is al dente, drain and keep warm. title: Coconut Cream

instructions: Process coconut in a food processor until fine. Add icing sugar and blend to form a stiff dough. Press into a greased 11x13 pan, and refrigerate until cold. Cut into bars and serve immediately.

title: Roasted Beef Triangles for Two
ingredients: 1 package round baked tofu | 1 cup coarsely chopped roasted roast beef | 1 can thinly sliced pearl onions | 1/4 cup walnuts | 1/4 cup lime wedge | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f lightly spray 9x13 pan with nonstick spray. Combine first 8 ingredients until well combined and set aside. Place tofu between 2 small sheets of plastic wrap and pound using the tines of a fork to flatten slightly. Cut 3 - 4 diagonal slits across the top of tofu and place on the prepared pan. title: Vietnamese Bean and Cheese Salad

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the hot beans with the cereal, cheese, red pepper, lemon juice and chile pepper.

title: Coconut Shuboyaki
ingredients: 10 kikoman green peppers ( or red and or green, depending on size ) | 10 kochiko ( glutinous rice flour or glutinous rice flour ) | 1/4 cup coconut oil
instructions: Clean and cut green or red peppers. Put in a small pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil then turn off heat. Do not boil remove seeds and membranes from peppers. You may need to leave peppers under water for the shrimp to cook fully. Remove peppers from water after cooling down slightly, and place on a plate covered with a paper towel. To do this, take a large spoon and scoop out the shell of the pepper and place it in the rice cooker. When you take the shrimp out of the water and take the skin off, put the shrimp, pepper, and shells into the rice cooker and mix in the macroof or glutinous rice flour. Do not worry if the flour does not mix the mixture well, it should all eventually form into a thick, wet but consistent dough you can work with but be careful not to over work the dough or it could be tough. Put some saran wrap over the dough to keep it from drying out when its done cooking. Take a handful of the dough and roll it out onto a pastry board. With a rolling pin, roll out the dough into a large rectangular shape about 1/4 inch thick. It usually takes about 10 - 12 minutes, since the strips will expand during fermentation. It should take about 15 minutes, however, to get the hang of it. It should be finished before it has reached the desired hang. Heat some coconut oil in a skillet or wok. Do not use a pan, or any way you use it, if its too hot you may damage your dough, making it difficult to roll. Cook on the skillet or wok until it is nice and brown, and it starts spreading around the edges. When it is cool, cut the shrimp in half and make them into little, bite size pieces. Add them to the shrimp when they are all in the skillet. It takes a while.

title: Corned Beef and Peppers

instructions: Cut the brisket across the grain into 1/4 in rounds. Cut each hotdog into 4 - 5 rounds with a sharp knife.

instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain, and combine with pineapple. Stir orange zest into sauce, and serve.

title: Pumpkin-Orange Glazed Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 -10 ounce beef brisket | 1 ounce freshly grated parmesan cheese | 3 tablespoons orange juice or 3 tablespoons lime juice | 2 ounces canned pumpkin puree | orange zest, a pinch
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325 degrees f. Dry the brisket on paper towels with kitchen paper. Heat a heavy bottomed roasting pan on high heat then dry fry the brisket for about 8 minutes per pound. Remove the brisket from the pan and leave to rest until completely cooled. Remove all external fat and discard. Remove the brisket from the pan on a carving board and shred the meat in the roasting pan. Return the shredded beef to the pan. In a small bowl stir the cheese, orange or lime juice and pumpkin or puree, orange zest and a pinch of salt and pepper. Divide the meat between four warmed gravy bowls, cover the pan with foil wrap and pour hot liquid around it. Return the brisket to the pan and cover the pan with foil.

title: Spicy Egg-White Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 cup sultana | 1/2 cup yellow pepper | 1 tablespoon lemon curd | 1 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 4 egg whites | 1 tablespoon fresh epazote, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºf. Grease a small baking sheet lightly with oil. Blend together the sultanas, pepper, lemon curd, asafoetida and egg whites in a food processor until fine. Stir in the chopped epazote until just incorporated. Divide the mixture evenly among the four bread slices. Lightly brush the tops of the sandwiches with some of the egg white wash. Place them on the baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Chili Lime Mixture With Tex Mex Corn Crackers

instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Dip bottom of baking dish in batter and fry till golden brown on each side. Top with lettuce, green chilis and salsa.

title: Bunny Chow
ingredients: 750 ml chuck or 750 ml pork steak | 1/2 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon ghee ( known as `` butter '' ) | ice cube
instructions: Trim as much fat as possible from meat and discard excess fat. Place meat in ice cube trays fitted with a small round nozzle and leave to chill, undisturbed for an hour or two. title: Blueberry Glazed Chicken With Mangoes and Swiss Chard (Raspberry)
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( knorr beef flavored flavor works best ) | 1 cup fresh mango, peeled, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 cup fresh blueberries | 1/2 cup unsweetened raspberry | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 cups broccoli florets, steamed until just tender, about 2 minutes | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Place in a shallow baking pan and sprinkle with paprika. Bake in a 425 oven until no longer pink. instructions: Prepare apple filling according to package directions.

title: Quick Chile-Asparagus-Chile Spears

instructions: Slice off tips of asparagus, but leave 1 inch of thick ribs attached to the head. If they are large, cut smaller accordingly. Dice asparagus ribs and set aside. Add maple syrup, saute for 2 - 3 minutes. Add tomatoes and chiles, if using. Cook until heated through, about 2 - 3 minutes.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Rinse mushrooms and pat dry. Place in greased casserole dish. Blend coffee and vinegar. Pour over mushrooms and toss to coat. title: Caribbean Curried Lamb Chops and Cherry Tomatoes

instructions: Fry bell pepper and coconut in large skillet until light brown, stirring often. Add lamb, tomatoes, salt and bring to a boil. Cover and fry for 12 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Place pan in oven.

title: Mango Nut Scrolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wholemeal self-raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon ginger, finely chopped | 500 g silken tofu, diced into 1cm chunks | 1 packet ready-made puff pastry, thawed according to packaging | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 2/3 cup dried cranberry beans, soaked in water for 10 minutes | mango chutney, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c / fan 180°c line a baking tray with baking paper and scatter over the veg. Bake in the oven for 15 - 19 minutes until the tofu and ginger have softened and become a little crispy. Meanwhile, roll out your pastry to a thickness of about 1cm then cut into 2 strips. Lay the noodles on the lined tray and set aside. Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat then add the ginger and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Tip in the tofu, nuts, beans and cranberry beans. title: Nori Sushi
ingredients: 4 sheets nori sushi | 2 cups frozen peas | 3/4 cup tomato puree | 1 clove, crushed
instructions: Rinse the frozen peas and thaw completely. To cook, place frozen peas in a saucepan with water to cover. Place over high heat. The water should just come to a boil, but it needs not to. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the peas are tender and very little liquid remains in the pan, 2 to 4 minutes. Drain the peas and allow to cool to room temperature. Meanwhile, cut off any tough, straight edges of the nori sheet. Cut the sheets into 3 inch squares and place on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 325 degree f oven until light golden brown, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven and spray the nori with nonstick cooking spray. Spread 1/4 cup of the tomato puree on one side of each nori sheet. Top with 1/4 cup of the cold peas and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon of clove powder. Spread the tomato puree on the other side of each nori sheet, leaving a 1 inch border of ice in the edges. Close the nori around the edges and fold the edges over to form a small seal. When the nori has been unrolled, cut into pieces with a 3 inch star shaped biscuit cutter. Serve while still warm. Variation, serve with a few grilled tuna or scallops.

instructions: Place onions, beans, pineapple juice and potatoes into a large bowl. Cut a slit in each slice of ham or buns and place into bowl with vegetables. Top with salmon, reserving 2 tbsp of the pineapple juice. Serve topped with reserved pineapple juice.

title: Gorgonzola

instructions: Place bread on a cookie sheet. Mix vinegar, yogurt, sherry and prosciutto in a small bowl. Spoon equal amounts of yogurt mixture on to bread slices, and top with a piece of prosciutto. If desired, grill for 2 or 3 minutes per side on cookie sheet. Serve warm.

title: Rosti Ala Ramen

instructions: Soak mushrooms in lukewarm water for 30 minutes. Drain. Place fresh lime wedges or strips in a microwave safe dish or strainer. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Drain water out of mushrooms. Place cabbage and ginger in the microwave safe casserole. Sprinkle mushrooms into the casserole. Microwave on high for about 1 minute.

title: Mexican Brussels Sprouts

instructions: Preheat ove to 350 degrees f. Place brussels sprouts in a pan. Add enough water so that they're covered, and add salt. Bring to a boil. Cover pan and cook for about 20 minutes. title: Rice With Sesame Seeds & Green Chilies

instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions. Meanwhile, mix sauce and heat for 2 minutes. Add green chilies and thyme.

title: Drunken Blueberry Sauce for Hot Dogs and Swiss Steak

instructions: Chop the blueberries into 1 cm squares. Transfer to a bowl with some ice and mash in a bowl with a rubber spatula. You can let it sit for at least 30 - 60 minutes for flavours to blend. Enjoy.

title: Gordita's Santa Fe Beef Sernitas (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 pounds ground beef | 3/4 cup freshly brewed coffee | 1 1/4 cups sweet and sour maris amaretto | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons freshly grated orange zest | 1/2 cup fresh orange juice, or as needed ( optional ) | 2 green jalapeno pickling liquid, chilled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Place the ground beef and ground coffee in a large skillet. Cook and stir over medium heat until lightly browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer the beef and coffee mixture to a 2 quart casserole dish. Stir the amaretto, grand marnier, orange zest, orange juice, and jalapeno pickling liquid into the beef mixture. Cover the casserole dish tightly with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until the liquid is reduced and meat is no longer pink in the center, about 2 hours.

title: Indonesian Lamb Soup

instructions: Place the ground lamb in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir until evenly browned.

title: Tilapia With Snow Peas

instructions: Drain any excess fat from the tilapia and set aside. Cook the pancetta until the fat is rendered, add the rolled oats and stir until well mixed. Add the irish cream, snow peas and tilapia and mix thoroughly. Serve over brown rice.

instructions: Place duck legs and their liquid, cream of potato soup, tomatoes with chilies, tofu and jalapenos in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or until duck falls from the bones. Stir occasionally. Serve in soup cups, with a sprinkling of drained croutons, if desired.

title: Spicy Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chile peppers, undrained | 2 tablespoons quick cooking oil | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 pounds lean stewing chicken, cut into 6 pieces | 2 tablespoons crushed cooking oil
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together teriyaki sauce, stewed tomatoes with green chile peppers, 2 tablespoons oil, and curry powder. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour teriyaki sauce mixture over chicken.

title: BBQ Pork Barley
ingredients: 2 ounces pearl barley | 1 small red cabbage, cored | 3 ounces shredded pork with bone | 1/2 cup chopped radish | 1 red cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh gingerroot | 2 garlic cloves, chopped
instructions: Soak the pearl barley in water for 12 hours or overnight. Drain, cover and cook on low heat for 1 hour. Drain thoroughly and combine all ingredients with the barley and mix well, adding a piece of extra pork before serving.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,jasmine rice,button mushroom,beef tenderloin,tabasco sauce,saffron strand,toothpick,kernel corn
title: Saffron Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin, with bone cut 1-inch thick | 8 saffron strands, left whole | 5 -6 toothpicks | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 cup jasmine rice | 5 -6 button mushrooms, sliced | 3/4 cup unsalted whole kernel corn | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup
instructions: Soak saffron strands in warm water for 20 minutes, drain. Cut beef into 1/2 cubes. Dry on paper towels. Arrange in single layer on baking sheet. Place in oven at 450 degrees f. Cook 20 minutes, turn and cook 15 minutes. Remove beef from oven and keep warm. Turn oven off, remove bones and shred beef into large bowl. Return liquid to microwaveable bowl and add beef, saffron threads, tabasco, rice, mushrooms and corn kernels. Heat until just about boiling, stirring to coat beef and mushrooms. Divide between 6 small ramekins or shallow baking dishes and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,cayenne pepper,egg yolk water,fennel seed,chickpea,pineapple juice,lamb meat,beef
title: Gurkensalat with Pineapple
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 can chunk canned chickpeas, drained | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground fennel seed | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.

title: An Aussie Truacle
ingredients: 1 cup treacle | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 2 teaspoons dried sage leaves | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped ( optional ) | dill or thyme sprigs ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Stir all ingredients together until smooth. Store for up to 2 weeks in an airtight container. Taste, and adjust seasoning if necessary. Transfer to a small bowl, or mold and refrigerate until serving time. Garnish, if desired. Note, for a creamier texture, omit the herbs. Note, this can be served as a light base, or stirred into a dark rum like brandy. Store at room temperature covered. Covered.

Random Ingredients: white wine,super fine sugar,hot green chili pepper,masa harina,bacon
title: Granny's Hot Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 12 fresh hot green chili peppers, stemmed | 1 lb frozen bacon, diced | 1 lb raw best quality masa harina | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: In a food processor, begin to process the peppers. They don't have to be fully frozen. Rinse the pulp under cold water, then place the pulp in a large bowl. Add the bacon and chopped masa harina, sugar and white wine. Season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and transfer to a medium microwave safe baking dish, cover tightly with plastic wrap and place in the microwave. Cook uncovered on medium for 6 minutes, stirring once or twice. Serve hot. Cook times will vary depending on microwave. Note, cook time will vary based on microwave setting and oven.

title: Simple Chicken Wings
ingredients: 36 chicken wings | 1/2 - 3/4 onion
instructions: Rinse chicken wings and pat dry. Place in baking dish. Cover chicken wings with water and pour water inches. Bake at 325f until chicken wings and onions are done, approximately 1 hour or approximately 40 minutes. Drain and serve. If desired, serve with gravy or stew. For stew, combine chicken wings with gravy until thoroughly coated. If desired, cover with water and allow mixture to simmer on stovetop for approximately 20 minutes or until sauce is thick again.

title: Easy Red Cabbage and Radishes
ingredients: 1 small red cabbage or 1 small gold cabbage, shredded | 1 jar of your favorite radishes ( optional )
instructions: Get a large bowl, add the cabbage and radishes. You can add any other vegetables that you like for a pretty color. I used a combination of sliced carrots and a few small jalapeno peppers and just added a nice color. You can also add your favorite flavorings. Enjoy.

title: Shrimp, Pork and Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chopped peeled asparagus | 3/4 lb cooked large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds, toasted | 1/4 lb shaved steak | 2 packages frozen baby spinach, thawed and drained | 1/2 lb trimmed trimmed flank steak | 5 sheets arugula, cut into 3-inch pieces
instructions: Prepare dressing, in blender container, puree shrimp and almonds. Stir in steak.

title: Jicama Diced With Bay Seasoning
ingredients: 1 medium jicama, peeled and finely chopped | 3 tablespoons old bay seasoning ( or your favourite seasoning mix - see note! )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f and generously oil a baking sheet. Combine all ingredients, except the paprika. Mix thoroughly. Add paprika. Spread evenly over the baking sheet. Roast in centre of oven for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,bailey irish cream,anise seed,lemongrass,romano cheese,lettuce,coconut extract
title: Karaage (Coconut Lettuce Wraps)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise seed, roasted | 3 stalks lemongrass ( remove outer layers ) | 1/4 cup shredded coconut | 2 cups shredded romano cheese or 2 cups mozzarella cheese | 2/3 cup capellini or 2/3 cup marinara sauce | 2 teaspoons chopped ginger or 2 teaspoons minced gingerroot | 4 -6 lettuce
instructions: Using a blender or food processor, process the roasted aniseed with the lemon grass, coconut and 3 cups of the mozzarella or cheese. Add as much basil or other cheese you like. Chill until ready to serve. Fill lettuce wraps with this cheese mixture. Cut off a good inch or so of the lettuce stalk, just below the stem of the lettuce stem. Starting at the bottom, top the left and right sides and roll. Eat this as appetizer. Or wrap the wrap in plastic wrap and eat cold on the way home for breakfast, then wrap in a large glad wrap.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,green pepper flake,ginger,tapioca starch,ginger root,iceberg lettuce,peach,tomato sauce
title: Beef & Peach Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon hot curry paste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger | 1 large green pepper, sliced | 1 tablespoon crushed thai chile pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon unsweetened rice-shaped tapioca starch | 1 cup finely shredded iceberg lettuce | 3/4 cup thinly sliced fresh peaches, drained ( optional )
instructions: Combine the tomato sauce and curry paste in a small bowl and set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium high heat.

Random Ingredients: lemon,cherry liqueur,golden syrup,strawberry ice cream,white bean,tamarind pulp,gingerroot,cheese
title: Spiced White Beans With Cream
ingredients: 150 g frozen white beans, thawed and drained | 200 g punnet strawberries or 200 g punnet strawberries, quartered | 1 piece fresh gingerroot, quarter-sized, peeled, thinly sliced | 100 g cherry flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons grenadine mixed with 100ml lemon juice | 1 3/4 tablespoons golden syrup | 50 g tasty cheese, chopped | 2 teaspoons tamarind pulp, crushed
instructions: Place the beans in a pan with enough cold water to cover and place over high heat. Once the temperature comes to 180 degrees c, cover with a tight fitting lid and bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 5 - 7 minutes or until beans are soft. Do not overcook.. Meanwhile, place the ginger in a bowl with the liqueur and lemon juice. Whisk until smooth. Remove the beans from the heat when cooked, stir in the sugar syrup and serve with the ginger and garnish with cherry flavored liqueur. Spice with tamarind concentrate to taste, adding grated cheese and lemon rind on the side as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,pumpkin seed,dark soya sauce,parmesan cheese,curry powder
title: Sweet Spiced Pumpkin Seeds & Cheese Balls
ingredients: 350 g pumpkin seeds | 2 tablespoons dark soya sauce | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Put the pumpkin seeds in a bowl. Mix the soya sauce, curry powder, cardamom and grated parmesan cheese in with the seeds. Sprinkle them over the pumpkin. Let them sit for 30 minutes at room temperature. After 45 minutes, roll the mixture into balls and press gently with your hands. Let them dry for an hour, toss them occasionally to ensure that they don't stick or brown. Store them in an airtight container if they don't turn out right away.

Random Ingredients: pesto,star anise,sage leaf,cheerio oat cereal,ginger root,cumin
title: St. Louis-Style Pesto Bars
ingredients: 5 star anise | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger root | 12 cloves crushed ginger | 8 ounces cheerios toasted oat cereal, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pesto
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil, allowing the foil to extend at least 4 inches over the sides of the dish. Wrap the star anise rings with aluminum foil. Bake until fragrant and beginning to brown on the tops, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,wheat flour,egg tortellini,corn,mango,mayonnaise,flat leaf parsley
title: Corn and Mango Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh corn, kernels removed and halved | 1 large mango, cut into 4 slices and parboil in milk till just tender and then drained in a sieve | 2 large eggs, hard boiled | 2 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 1/2 cups mayonnaise | 10 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Remove the corn kernels from the cob and put into a pan of boiling water to cook. Chop the mango into four slices and set aside. Break the eggs into a pan of cold water and boil till just tender. Drain well and chop the hard boiled eggs coarsely. Fold into the corn mixture. Cut the sheets of phyllo pastry into large squares and arrange them in front of you on a lightly buttered baking sheet. Brush two triangles with melted butter or oil and place half the mango in the centre of each triangle. Top with a sheet of phyllo phyllo pastry. Repeat with two more sheets then top with two more sheets. Brush the four triangle with melted butter or oil and layer on top with another sheet of phyllo. Cut each piece into two triangles and place on the pizza tray. Using a large spoon, dollop onto a spoonful of mayonnaise. Drizzle the chopped parsley on top. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until pastry is crisp.

title: Easy Chinese Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 package top ramen noodles | 1 cube chicken bouillon or 1 cube vegetable bouillon | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Put all ingredients into a pot and simmer for 5 mins. Add more broth if soup looks too thick.

title: Mango-Chile Lassi
ingredients: 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and chopped | 1 can sweetened condensed milk | 3 dried red chile
instructions: Puree mango in a blender. Whisk together sweetened condensed milk, dried red chiles, and mango mixture in a pitcher. Serve with glasses.

Random Ingredients: collard green,grain white rice,swiss chard,pineapple juice,russet potato,garlic,carrot,nutmeg
title: Simmered Greens With Rice
ingredients: 12 ounces collard greens, rinsed and patted dry | 1/2 small russet potato, peeled, diced and cooked in hot water until tender but still slightly crisp | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 3/4 cup long-grain white rice | 2 ounces swiss chard, coarsely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 10 1/2 ounces swiss chard packed in brine, leaves cut crosswise into thin strips 2 to 3/4 inch lengths
instructions: Cut collard greens in half lengthwise. Remove tough ribs, cut the greens into even pieces, and place in a large, deep microwave safe bowl. Mix in potato, garlic, pineapple juice, rice, chard, and nutmeg. Cover and microwave on high 4 to 5 minutes, stirring once. Stir in greens just before serving.

title: Homemade Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 can mushroom pieces, chopped | 1/2 yellow onion, diced | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: In a frying pan saute onion in vegetable oil until translucent. Add mushroom pieces and mix into sauce. Add tomato paste and mix into a smooth sauce.

title: Vegetable & Almond Lasagne
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 leek | 1/2 cup ricotta | 3 -4 cremini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 4 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted & finely chopped
instructions: Wash and thinly slice leek. Place in large bowl of cold water and set aside for 1 hour, or until tender. Drain leek. Finely mince leek and set aside. In large bowl, combine leek pieces, ricotta, almonds, and vanilla sugar. Toss with vegetables until very well coated and spread into 9 x 13 inch sheet pan. Top with remaining vegetables and sprinkle with additional 1 tablespoon of the vanilla sugar. Bake in hot oven for 25 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Easy Phyllo Dough "casseroles d'abricots" (Vegan)
ingredients: 4 ounces celery root, peeled, sliced thin | 4 ounces frozen phyllo dough | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock or 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f. Squeeze out as much excess water as possible from the celery root. Use the same phyllo dough sheets it came in a package of alouette style phyllo dough. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of prepared celery root/vegetable mixture into the middle of each phyllo dough sheet. Begin tearing down between sheets so you now have 12 pieces. Make the pastry sheets into 6 equal sized squares. Pierce the squares 3 or 4 times with a knife all over. Spray a shallow non stick pan with cooking spray and place the phyllo pieces on the pan. Use your finger to make a hole in the center of each square and fill with water, making sure that the water covers the bottom and sides of the dough. Add a small amount of the chicken or vegetable stock to your pan of stock. Put the baking sheet in the upper third on the oven and bake for 10 minutes. Then, remove the phyllo squares and allow them to cool slightly before adding to your baking dish. Allow the phyllo dough to completely dry before serving. This makes it easier to roll. If you don't have a pan with a tight fitting lid for rolling sheets, you could also do with a sheet of waxed paper. Once the phyllo has dried somewhat, you can roll it out, using the waxed paper as a guide for rolling, and cut it and eat it.

title: Sizzling Sweet Beef and Yukon Gold Potato Wedges
ingredients: 2 small yukon gold potatoes | 3 tablespoons gingerroot, grated | 1/2 cup lean roast beef, well marinated, cold, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220c. Cut the potatoes into wedges. Place them in a roasting tin. Drizzle with olive oil. Season & brush with a little more oil. Place in the top half of the oven and roast for 20 - 25 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked and crisp. Meanwhile, toss the ginger and chopped beef together with the warm baked potatoes. Serve straight away.

title: Pickled Jalapenos for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 lb jalapeno pepper | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 1 -2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( i use morton brand ) | jalapeno, pickled ( optional )
instructions: Prep the jalapenos carefully by placing in a pan with cold water and turning over several times. Drain, remove the outer skin and seeds of the jalapenos. The jalapenos should be peeled and chopped into about 3/4 inch/1 thick/thin pieces and should remain completely covered with water. This can be done by simply rinsing lightly with cold water when placing into a jar, and then pressing with your finger to break off some tiny fibers with your fingers. This will also help them keep from breaking up while in the fridge. Place all ingredients into a medium/large zipper bag and allow to sit out in the refrigerator/packed for about an hour or so, while you prep your remaining pickled jalapenos. Drain the pickling liquid through a colander into a bowl and rinse out to make sure jalapenos are clean and dry. It will drain the jalapenos from the water, but will still be clinging to the jalapenos. Dry all the jalapenos lightly with a paper towel and set aside. To clean the jar, put a small plate on the work surface to check if it is clean. It should be the right consistency, but not too tight and if it is, too dry. If it is dry, it seems too dry. If it seems dry, add hot water until the jar is full. The jalapenos are best eaten on the day that they are made, and eaten with anything you like, but the idea is to let them sit in the juice for a few hours before eating. The juice keeps in the refrigerator for about 3 days.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,vegetable shortening,vanilla extract,beef stock broth,chili oil,cheddar
title: Sesame Dipping Sauce for Cheddar Crisps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 teaspoons ground vanilla extract | 3 1/2 cups beef stock or 3 1/2 cups broth | 1/2 cup grated cheddar ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium low heat, heat the oil, shortening, and vanilla. Stir in the broth and cook and stir the mixture just until the sauce coats a spoon, about 5 minutes. Serve the sauce hot with cheddar cheese crisps.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,salt,caraway seed,watermelon,saffron strand,brown sugar,garlic salt,lime zest
title: Caraway-Dressed Watermelon and Mozzarella
ingredients: 2 tablespoons saffron strand, crushed | 1 1/2 cups water | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon caraway seeds | 2 lbs seedless watermelon, cut into cubes | 2 cups pizza sauce
instructions: Prepare marinade, using saffron strands, combine the saffron, and the 1 1/2 cups of water and stir until the mixture is absorbed. Keep covered and refrigerate for 1 hour. Drain and set aside. Drain the watermelon through a coffee filter lined strainer and cut into bite size chunks. In a large bowl, add the 1 1/2 cups of water, the lime zest, garlic salt, and the caraway seeds. Add the watermelon to the mixture and stir until the watermelon is coated. Reserve 1/2 cup of the marinade and add the rest to the watermelon mixture and stir. Taste and add more garlic salt if necessary. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the 2 cups of mozzarella and stir. Reduce heat to lowest setting and leave until cheese is melted, about 10 to 12 minutes. Drain the cheese in a colander. Layer the mozzarella in a 9x13 pan. Spoon the warm marinade over the cheese and then top with the remaining mozzarella. Let stand to allow cheese to dry up before serving.

title: Semolina Halwa
ingredients: 1 cup semolina | 1 cup golden raisin
instructions: Grate semolina finely over a clean, flat bowl. Fold raisins into the grated semolina to form a firm dough. Cover with saran wrap and leave to stand at room temperature overnight. After an hour, lightly press the dough with your knuckle or the back of a rolling pin, ensuring that you have a solid mass. Roll out with rolling pin onto a cloth covered or tea towel to a thickness of 1/2 inch. Cut into rectangles with a sharp knife.

title: Lemon Verbena and Mint Cream for Desserts and Sauces
ingredients: 500 ml single cream | 1 tablespoon celery leaves, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, finely chopped
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a kitchen electric blender to a thick puree. Pour into a glass, allowing room for the flavours to develop.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,grain brown rice,strawberry preserve,coriander leaf,italian plum tomato,guacamole,chili bean,cardamom
title: Indian Spiced Brown Rice
ingredients: 100 g long grain brown rice | 400 ml chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons chipotle chili beans in adobo seasoning ( see note ) | 15 frozen guacamole | 1 tablespoon guacamole | 400 400 g italian plum tomatoes ( seeded, chopped and drained ) or 400 g canned plum tomatoes ( seeded, chopped and drained ) | 1 tablespoon coriander leaves, fresh ( cilantro leaves, roughly chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Note that the original recipe specified chipotle chili beans in adobo seasoning, but i'm esp intrigued with other suggestions. I'll give the recipe a final taste note prior to start preparing the rice as it will depend on whether it's cooked or not. Soak rice with 2 cups of water in large pot according to package directions, or until water is absorbed. Drain. Place rice & beans in food processor, and process till smooth. Transfer to medium bowl. Add tomato, chili bean seasoning, 1 tbs of chipotle and 1 tbsp of guacamole, stirring well. Taste and add more spices if needed. Mix rice & bean mixture gently. Spoon rice mixture into a baking dish, spreading rice evenly around. Spread chopped coriander over top if using. Bake in preheated oven at 180 degrees c. For 45 - 50 minutes, or till rice is crisp and golden. Serve topped with guacamole and other toppings of your choice.

title: Ginger Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 cups instant brown rice, uncooked | pepper | 2 slices fresh ginger, 1/4 inch thick | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.

title: Fettuccine With Pork and Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops, thick | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh vegetables | 1/2 portabella mushroom, sliced | 1 package fettuccine pasta
instructions: Cook pork chops in oil in a large skillet over medium high heat 5 to 7 minutes. Add mixed vegetables and mushrooms. Cover and cook over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.

title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 pound dry macaroni | 1 can kalamata olives, sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add macaroni, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: French Muffins With Vanilla Pudding
ingredients: 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 10 medium baking potatoes | 1/2 cup sliced gruyere cheese | 1 cup miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Bake english muffins for 3 minutes then place on paper towels to absorb excess moisture. Combine pudding powder with 3 tbsp ice cold water and set aside. Slice potatoes lengthwise, but do not cut through. Cut each half into 8 pieces, leaving the middle slightly ajar. Spray muffin cups with cooking spray and place a row of potatoes on each. Divide the pudding mix among the muffin cups. Sprinkle equal amounts of cheese over soup in the muffin tins, followed by a few marshmallows. Repeat with another layer of potatoes and pudding mixture. Bake for 5 minutes, then remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes.

title: Easy, No Bake, Fresh Fig Ravioli
ingredients: 6 fresh figs, ripe, chopped | 1 package cheese ravioli, frozen, thawed ( about 2 cups )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f combine figs and ravioli in large bowl. Spray 8x4 inch glass baking pan with cooking spray and arrange half of the ravioli in pan. Cover with half of the figs and figs and half of the cheese ravioli. Pour fig and fig mixture over the cheese ravioli. Spread remaining ravioli on top. Bake 30 minutes or until filling is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,lasagna noodle,cod fish fillet,baking soda,pumpkin puree
title: Fish and Pumpkin Pie (Greece)
ingredients: 2 small spanish onions, chopped | 2 large cod fish fillets, chopped | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 36 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. In a small bowl combine the onion, cod and pumpkin. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Drain the onion mixture, then remove any excess water. In a medium saucepan, place the baking soda and 1 cup water. Bring to a rolling boil, then stir in the biscuit mixture and transfer to a baking sheet. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 300°f. While the fish mixture is baking, cook and drain the lasagna noodles as directed on the package. Drain the noodles and place in a large bowl. Stir in the onion mixture, then mix in the hot biscuit mixture. Return the mixture to the oven, and bake 15 - 30 minutes, or until bubbly and the top is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: curd cottage cheese,spaghetti,tomato soup,arborio rice,red cabbage
title: Spaghetti and Rice With Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup small curd cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups red cabbage ( shredded ) | 4 cups cooked spaghetti ( uncooked ) | 2 cans tomato soup | 3 cups arborio rice
instructions: Mix cottage cheese in bowl. Chop cabbage and add to cottage cheese. Drain spaghetti and add to the bowl. Stir in rice, pasta, and soup. Stir til mixed. Serve.

Random Ingredients: paprika,plum,beef tenderloin,white vinegar,oriental sesame oil,rice noodle,fish sauce
title: Grilled Beef Kebabs With Plums and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 2 teaspoons smoked paprika | 2 plum tomatoes, cut into eighths | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 package nori's rice noodles
instructions: Cut tenderloin in half lengthwise and into 1/4 inch wide strips. Cut 3 lengthwise slits along meat side of strip. Combine pork, paprika, tomatoes, vinegar, sesame oil and fish sauce.

title: Soup D'charres (Lemon Sauce)
ingredients: 14 ounces can chinese chives | 1 green pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 6 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Mix all together. Serve as is or with steamed vegetable soup plates.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 small pears, peeled | 2 cucumbers | 1 green onion, chopped | 4 tablespoons low-fat vanilla flavour yogurt | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Take a small prawn or other large shrimp and shell. Dice the prawns into tiny tiny pieces. Peel the cucumbers and add them to a bowl. Slice the green onions and the prawns into little sticks, add to the diced prawns. Place the vanilla yogurt ontop of the mixed salad ingredients. Place the prawns on top of the vanilla yoghurt and mix together very well. Place in refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Beef Brisket With Almonds
ingredients: 12 slices bread, crusts removed | 12 slices lean filet of beef, very lean ( very lean ) | 12 ounces fresh almonds, toasted | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar
instructions: Spread bread slices with sugar, leaving a 1/4 inch thick shell. Lay slices in a 9 by 5 inch shallow dish. Set aside, covered, overnight in a cool place. In a heavy skillet, melt 1/4 cup brown sugar over moderately high heat. When sugar begins to bubble, add almonds and toast, stirring frequently, for 1 minute. Remove from heat, stir into toast, and set aside until syrup is nearly dry. Remove almonds, and set aside. Preheat oven to 325ºf. Spread bread, on sides, with beancurd, evenly, and lightly spread with a layer of nuts, being careful not to make them too moist. Wrap beef, with nuts, in aluminum foil loosely, and place in a shallow roasting tin, fat side up. Roast for 2 1/2 hours. When done, remove beef from oven, and transfer to heated platter. Place in oven, cover loosely and allow to rest for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

title: Easiest and Easiest Fried Rice...
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta or 1 lb penne pasta, uncooked | 2 -3 cups cooked long grain rice or 2 -3 cups cooked short-grain rice | 1 cup leek, sliced julienned ( including some of the green if desired ) | chili powder, to taste
instructions: In a wide, deep pan, add 3 cups of salted sofalle or penne, 3 - 4 cups of cooked rice and 2 - 3 cups of leek, or both, and mix up thoroughly. You want to mix everything together well. Heat until it's bubbly. Cover tightly and set aside. Cook your pasta in the pan of hot water as per package directions, until done. Serve, along with your favechos, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ginger paste,black eyed pea,ice water,wonton skin,avocado,graham cracker crumb
title: Avocado and Black-Eyed Pea Ravioli
ingredients: 12 wonton skins | ice water | 2 pounds ground round | 2 avocados, peeled and chopped | 1/4 cup chopped fresh ginger paste | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place wonton skins on a board, and place 2 to 3 tablespoons of ice water in the center of the wonton skin, making sure that the skins completely cover the water. Press edges of the skin closed with your fingers. Continue press the skin and edges together to seal in the water. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the ground round, and return to a boil. Cook until the meat has cooked through, breaking the meat apart as it cooks, about 10 minutes. Drain off excess grease. Allow to cool for a few minutes, then stir in the avocados, ginger paste and graham cracker crumbs. Cook for 2 more minutes, or until well blended. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: baby clam,cake flour,flour,corn kernel,coconut rum,cardamom seed
title: Glassiest Corn Cracker Fritters in the World!
ingredients: 1/2 kg baby clams | 8 tablespoons corn kernel | 2 tablespoons corn rum ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons coconut rum | 1 tablespoon sweet powder flour | 1 cup cake flour | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon sambal olek chili paste ( optional )
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a saucepan. Cover and bring to a bubble. Reduce the heat and simmer until the clams leave their shells open. Place the clams into a separate dish. Pour the clams over the hot clams and serve.

title: Paleo (Wheat Free)
ingredients: 12 1/4 ounces white vinegar | 1 lb xanthan gum | 2 bunches spearmint, leaves chopped ( or 5 sprigs of basil )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, adding more whey or flour to get the right texture. Let stand for at least 10 - 15 minutes before serving. Use for rice, pizza, etc.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,baby spinach leaf,pork chop,vegetable stock,broccoli,green bell pepper
title: Pork Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 pound boneless pork chops, sliced into strips | cooking spray | 1 bunch broccoli, chopped into short shreds | 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 bag baby spinach leaves
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add pork strips and cook over medium high heat until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add chopped broccoli and bell pepper slices together in the pan. Cook and stir until tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Remove and set aside. Return pan to heat and add vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Add spinach and cook until just wilted, about 2 minutes. Pour pork mixture over vegetables and serve.

title: Chipotle Pickle Spread
