ingredients: 1 cup dill pickle, thinly sliced | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped canned chipotle chile, from a can ( about 1/2 pepper in pepper )
instructions: Combine pickle and chile and let stand 15 minutes at room temperature, stirring occasionally. Transfer to an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,sesame oil,kosher salt,shortening,rigatoni pasta
title: Homemade Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup shortening ( i use 3 t.  ) | 1 beef bouillon cube ( crushed ) | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | more salt ( to taste )
instructions: Prepare your rigatoni according to the package and place in a colander to drain. Drain off the water into a bowl, rinse it with cold water and drain. Place some of the shortening in a cast iron frypan on medium/high flame and when the shortening melts, add the rigatoni and cook just until the pasta starts to turn a golden color. Dissolve the bouillon cube in 1/2 cup of hot water. Add the dissolved bouillon mixture to the pasta and toss lightly to coat. Remove the pasta from the pan and place in a salad bowl. Add more salt and remaining shortening and toss again. Serve.

Random Ingredients: horseradish sauce,potato traditional,hamburger,maple syrup,worcestershire sauce,raspberry,beet,snow pea
title: Irish Pub Style Hash Brown
ingredients: 1 pound lean hamburger | 1 jar pickled beets, drained and sliced | 2 packages simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 4 ounces snow peas, chopped | 2 tablespoons horseradish sauce | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | horseradish sauce to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Brown hamburger in a medium skillet over medium high heat until crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink. Drain grease. Stir beets, mashed potatoes, snow peas, horseradish sauce, worcestershire sauce, and maple syrup together in a large bowl until well blended. Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with horseradish sauce. Bake in preheated oven, uncovered, for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: new potato,mexican chocolate,ice water,kielbasa,chunky peanut butter,avocado,lime juice zest
title: Salty Grilled New Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 new potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup lime juice, fresh juice and zest of | 1 avocado, ripe and cubed | 3 tablespoons chunky peanut butter | 3 tablespoons ice water | 7 ounces mild mexican chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1 small kielbasa, cut in 1/4-inch dice or 2/3 cup cooked sausage, sliced diagonally ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add salt and potatoes and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile to create the dressing, mix peanut butter, lime juice and zest. To assemble, spread 1 tablespoon of peanut butter dressing on 2 dinner plates. Divide remaining dressing among serving plates, followed by 1 tomato and 1/4 cup of chopped avocado. Top with 1/2 cup diced cheese. For a salad that is not creamy, add 2/3 cup of chunky peanut butter dressing and 1/4 cup of ice water to equal 1 1/2 cups.

title: Sesame Salt Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 3 cardamom pods, crushed | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon fresh cayenne or 1/2-3/4 teaspoon ground cardamom, to taste | 2 cups ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Crush cardamom pods with the back of a cleaver, or with a mortar and pestle. Do not over toast. Stir the crushed seeds and cayenne into the ice cream just before serving. It will foam up a bit but will not liquefy. Tip, this is important, in order to activate fully, do not scramble the ice cream, or it could melt off before serving at once.

title: Baked Lumpia (Beef, Turnip and Onion Pies)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef | 1/2 yellow onion, finely chopped | 1/2 turnip, finely chopped | 1/2 cup of reserved maraschino cherry, chopped | 1/4 cup of reserved cherries | 1 teaspoon instant gravy mix or 2 teaspoons prepared gravy mix | 5 drops msg ( optional, i don't like msg ) ( optional )
instructions: Saute hamburger and onion until the pink is gone. Drain and mix into the meat mixture. Add, cherries, gravy mix, and msg. Simmer for 15 - 20 minutes or until mixture thickens. Shape into little rolls and cover with waxed paper, or plastic wrap. Place in plastic wrap and freeze for up to 3 months. Defrost and serve at once. You do not have to bake in advance or the flavor will be lost. You may freeze the lumpia, if desired, and reheat at once or microwave until heated through.

title: Nana's Perfect French Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( heaping ) | 4 tablespoons marsala wine | 2 boxes frozen french-fried onions | 2 tablespoons blanched whole almonds
instructions: In a medium sized pot, stir the rice with the flour. Add fenugreek seeds. Stir over medium heat. When fenugreek seeds turns yellow a lot add the marsala. Immediately add the french fried onions. Stir until all ingredients are well incorporated. Turn heat down for 5 - 10 minutes. Turn off heat. Let rice sit for 5 minutes.. Rinse the pot with hot salty water. Add rice to pot. Turn on low until all the water has just begun to be absorbed. Do not stir. Cover the pot at this time if the rice begins to become sticky. After rice has rested, stir for about 2 minutes. Cover the pot and let stand for about 15 - 20 minutes more. Uncover and top with almonds. Replace cover and set aside for 5 - 10 minutes more. Note, you can cook the risotto in the pressure cooker for 5 minutes but you won't get to mush the rice. That way, there will be less moisture in the finished dish after the 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Peel-And-Peel Jelly
ingredients: 2 1/2 cm cubes fresh peaches | 1 1/2 cm cubes bicarbonate of soda
instructions:
Cut the peaches in halves, remove the stones, but leave intact. Place them in a saucepan with lots of cold water. Boil the mixture until it begins to come to a boil. Remove from the heat and leave the syrup in the peaches. Cover and leave to stand for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and transfer the syrup to a jug. Sprinkle the soda over the peaches and leave to cool. This makes a jelly that has little or no flavour 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Put the sugar in a pan and place over a low heat until the sugar has dissolved. Increase the heat and bring to the boil, stirring often. When it is very hot it is ready, but if it looks like it is boiling too fast continue to stir. This stops it tensing up and makes the jelly look a little watery. The longer the syrup is left, the crismer that it tastes. Take the pan off the heat. Leave to stand for 1 hour, stirring every now and then. Turn up the heat, dissolve the soda in the syrup and pour into a sterilised 2l basin or mould. This will fill the mouthful with jelly. Turn on the freezer. Leave jelly to stand until it is cold, or can be moulded. If it is cold, refrigerate until the jelly is cold and moulded, then refrigerate until required. This can be kept for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya coriander annatto,pork shoulder,orange peel,rice noodle,vegetable stock
title: Easy Pork Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1 packet sazon goya with coriander and annatto | 3 -4 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 orange peel, peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch strips | cooked rice noodles
instructions: Place the pork, sazon mix and vegetable stock in a large pot over high heat. Reduce heat to medium, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until pork is very tender, about 1 hour. Add orange peel and cook until aromatic.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom,lime wedge,garlic,bailey irish cream,pineapple,lettuce leaf,habanero pepper,black sesame seed
title: Portabella Pepper and Pineapple Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 8 large portabella mushrooms | 1/2 cup black sesame seeds | 4 pineapple slices | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1/2 habanero pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon lime wedge | lettuce leaf
instructions: Clean mushrooms under running water. Pat dry with paper towels. Cut in half lengthwise at base of stems. Slice caps in half crosswise. Seed the pineapple. Combine remaining ingredients and refrigerate. Place mushroom mixture on a large platter and top with lettuce leaves. Serve with the lime wedges.

title: Vegetable Tostadas
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower, chopped | 1 cup green lentils | 4 teaspoons raisins | 80 g swiss cheese, grated | 1 medium tomatoes, chopped | 8 pita bread | 1 medium red capsicum, chopped
instructions: Cook the cauliflower in boiling water to cover for 10 minutes then drain. Cool, then put to one side. Add lentils and raisins to boiling water. Cover, then cook for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and cool. Mix cheese and tomatoes in a bowl. Remove the seeds from the capsicum, then chop. Combine with lentils. Divide the mixture among warmed pita breads and serve.

title: The Most Versatile Harissa Beef Soup
ingredients: 6 ounces bourbon or 6 ounces other dark semi-sweet dark beer, such as stout | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 1/2 tablespoons simple syrup or 1 1/2 tablespoons honey | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa | 1 1/2 teaspoons chines, spice | 6 cups beef broth ( see notes ) | 9 cherry tomatoes, halved ( for garnish ) | fresh parsley sprig, to garnish ( for garnish )
instructions: Beurre de mayonnaise, in a saucepan, combine all ingredients.

title: Churrascos (Beet Chips)
ingredients: 2 small red onions | 1 bunch fresh beet, cleaned and sliced to 1/4 inch thick | 1/2 cup tamarind juice | tortillas or fried flat bread, triangles
instructions: Finely dice the onions and beet to about the same size as the onions and beets. Put a small amount of tamarind into a small pan and warm it up over low heat about 5 minutes, till it becomes a paste. Spread the warm sauce over the hot beet and onion mixture. Add salt, to taste. Put up to 1 tablepoon of the chopped onion mixture onto each crunchy triangle and wrap the triangles in aluminium foil. Put in the hot oven about 10 to 15 minutes or so, checking them for doneness. Cool and eat within 1 hour or so.

title: White Chocolate Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup white chocolate or 1 cup dark chocolate | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/4 - 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder or 1/4-1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Break up a good sized block of white chocolate and heat slowly, watching carefully to keep it fairly cool. Remove from the heat. Add the fenugreek seeds. Chop up roughly a tablespoon and stir into the chocolate. Add the dried ground chipotle or chipotle powder. Stir until well mixed and set to an angle. Leave a little room in the fritters so the mixture will not stick. Leave with one hand in the fridge until the fritters become thicker. Take out and let cool to room temp before storing in a freezer glass jar or bag in the fridge. Makes a gift in every bite enjoy.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,milk,olive oil,splenda sugar substitute,sauce,date,white bread,serrano pepper
title: Stove Top Calamari
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh firm white bread | 1 1/2 cups skim milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/3 cup crushed red pepper | 1/3 cup finely chopped serrano peppers or 1/3 cup green bell pepper ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cut bread into 3/4 inch cubes. Spread bread cubes on plate and drizzle with 1 1/2 teaspoons olive oil, spreading evenly. In a small bowl, combine crushed red pepper, serrano peppers and 3/4 teaspoon sriracha. Spread red pepper mixture over bread and let sit 10 minutes. Heat remaining 1 t olive oil in fry pan and fry bread cubes over medium heat for a few minutes per side, until golden brown. Remove from pan when golden. Add milk, cream or soy sauce, sugar, hot sauce, and hot sauce and simmer slowly. Pour mixture over cooked bread.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,fennel seed,rosemary,portabella mushroom cap,linguine,cheddar cheese soup
title: Roasted Portabella Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1 large portabella mushroom cap, sliced | 1 can condensed cheddar cheese soup | 12 -16 ladyfingers | 2/3 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 12 ounces linguine | parsley and basil, to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat mushroom slices with non stick cooking spray. Spray mushrooms in oven proof dish with vegetable cooking spray. Place on middle rack, cut side down in a large roasting pan. In a bowl mix soup, fennel, and rosemary and set aside. Bring large pot of water, boil, add linguine and cook 6 - 8 minutes until al dente.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,chocolate,breadcrumb,hot green chili pepper
title: Quick and Easy Taco Mix Cookies
ingredients: 1 package hot green chili peppers, finely chopped ( i use 1 hot green chili pepper ) | 1 box taco seasoning mix | 3 -4 cups of dry breadcrumbs | 3 ounces unsweetened chocolate, finely melted ( optional )
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave, set aside. Mix up the taco seasoning mix according to package directions in a small bowl, stir in the melted chocolate and mix together. Add the green chili, mixing until it is well incorporated into the dip. Add the bread crumbs, mix well until the texture resembles cornmeal. Add the chiles to the dough, mix thoroughly. Chill well. Roll into small balls and place on a parchment lined cookie sheet. You may find they may crack while the oven preheats this can vary due to varying oven tempurature. Bake in oven at 350° for 10 - 13 minutes, watch that they are not browning too fast. Note, if you have leftover dough from the fridge you can get a little bit more crispy dough from it too. If not, place these on waxed paper or cookie sheets after removing from the oven. These cookies will keep for up to 5 days if your freezer doesn't allow me to do it. Enjoy note, this recipe freezes well and the breading is delicious.

title: Oyster Mushrooms and Rice
ingredients: 4 ounces oyster mushrooms | 4 ounces small whole wheat germ | 1 wholemeal grain rice | 2 ounces mixed berries | 2 -3 teaspoons aleppo pepper
instructions: First soak the oyster mushrooms in lukewarm water for a couple of hours. Slice them on a slight diagonal. Heat a large litt. Fry the rice in batches. Remove rice and place in a casserole with the mushrooms and aleppo pepper. Pour boiling water down the sides of the pan to one inch and pour over the contents of the pan to cover. Cover and cook in a low oven until all the water has been absorbed, about twenty minutes to an hour. Remove from oven and add mixed berries and stir gently to mix. Leave to stand for at least five to seven minutes and serve hot.

title: Mexican Mango Tators
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 cups all-purpose masa harina ( approximately ) | 1/2 cup warm milk, approximately | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 3 cups gourmet cheese, shredded | 1 package dry active yeast | 2 -8 tablespoons sugar
instructions: In food processor. Process masa harina into large enough bowl to mix well. Add warm milk and yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar. Mix until well incorporated. Using electric mixer, beat on low until well mixed, about 5 minutes, scraping bowl as needed. Beat in 3 cups cheese and 1 teaspoons yeast. Add remaining 2 cups masa harina and 1/2 teaspoons baking powder. Mix until dough is smooth and elastic. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface. Knead in enough remaining dough to make 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 inch balls. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 20 minutes.. Heat oven to remove plastic wrap. Line 2 parchment lined baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside. Using lightly floured hands, roll out each ball of dough on lightly floured surface about 1/4 inch thick, until 1/4 inch thick. With a 3 inch round cookie cutter, cut out the rounds from the dough. Place in 2 greased baking sheets, leaving 1 inch of head space in between. Cover and let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine remaining 1 tablespoon yeast and 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar and stir well. Punch down dough and transfer to lightly floured surface. Using lightly floured hands, stretch dough into an 18 by 13 inch rectangle. Using lightly floured hands, stretch dough again until almost doubled. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in warm spot until almost doubled, about 45 minutes. Preheat broiler or grill. Slice dough diagonally across grain into 1/4 inch wide slices. Arrange slices on prepared parchment lined baking sheets, leaving about 1 inch of space between triangles. Brush tops with remaining 1 tablespoon yeast and 1 teaspoon baking powder. Bake until golden on top, about 25 minutes. Transfer rolls to wire racks and cool slightly. Cover with plastic wrap if bread becomes too dark. To serve, transfer to warmed individual mâchrese dishes and serve. For a special treat at the table, warm guacamole on the stove top on medium low in a skillet for 15 to 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbling. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lamb meat,italian plum tomato,vodka,lemon pepper seasoning
title: Lamb Kabobs for Two
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds lamb meat, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons vodka, divided | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1 can italian plum tomatoes
instructions: Place lamb cubes in a large resealable plastic bag.

title: Cheese and Caramelized Onion
ingredients: 6 ounces kasseri cheese or 6 ounces edam cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup catsup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Microwave on high 30 seconds or until cheese is melted, stirring after 5 seconds.

Random Ingredients: okra,kaiser,vegetable broth,chickpea flour,pork tenderloin,irish cream,extra tofu,cardamom powder
title: Irish Tofu Burger
ingredients: 3/4 lb pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon extra firm tofu ( oil free ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable broth | 1 packet irish cream ( nonfat ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 can chickpea flour | 3 ounces okra, coarsely chopped | 9 kaiser rolls, split lengthwise
instructions: Score the surface of the tenderloin in four equal slices across at 2 1/2 intervals. Place loin on baking sheet and freeze for 20 minutes. Remove from freezer and sprinkle top of meat liberally with salt. Place in freezer and cook at least 1 hour or until frozen at desired temperature. Remove from freezer and allow to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes. Cut into four 6 equal portions. Mix sauce ingredients in medium saucepan and bring to boil. Cook over medium high heat for 2 minutes, then remove from heat and set aside. Lightly grease the insides of the bun bottoms and place 1/2 of the cut up okra in the middle. Drizzle with 1 1/2 tbsp of the sauce. Place another thin layer of okra on the okra followed by the remaining cut up meat. Fold the four points of the buns over and pinch closed. Place the sandwich in the warm oven for 3 minutes.

title: Lamb Ribs With Lusky Gravy and Smoked Lamb
ingredients: 1 lamb rib chop, 1 1/8 in thick ( or up to 4 in. thick chops ) | 2 tablespoons fat-free evaporated buttermilk | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons lime wedges, to serve | 4 teaspoons smoked lamb fat, cut into small pats
instructions: Using a small, sharp knife, make 8 slits at 1 inch intervals in the sides of the lamb, cutting along both sides. Remove the membrane from the meat. In a small bowl, combine the evaporated skim milk and the liquid smoke and add to the milk mixture, stirring until blended. Add the breaded lamb to the liquid mixture, cover and place in the fridge for 30 minutes or longer. Heat a barbecue on medium. Brush the outside of the rack with oil and grill or broil the lamb until well browned. Serve with the kissed lamb, drizzled with a little of the gravy if desired.

Random Ingredients: peanut,walnut oil,pesto sauce,chili flake,lemongrass,beef sirloin steak
title: Asian Pesto Beef Skewers
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs beef sirloin steaks, trimmed of all visible fat | 3 tablespoons lemon grass, chopped ( about 1 stalk ) | 1/4 cup walnut oil | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon chili flakes
instructions: Using a large heavy duty knife, cut 4 - 6 long slices from each steak of meat and roll each steak until well flattened. Combine all ingredients and let sit at room temperature to meld flavors. Cut steaks on diagonal into 1 thick, 12 long skewers about 12 wide. Place skewers on a rack over a rimmed baking pan and brush with a little oil. If needed, add a little water to cover. Cover with aluminum foil and set aside at room temperature for at least 8 hours or overnight, stirring to help keep from scorching. About 45 minutes before serving, remove metal skewers from foil and thread on to skewers.. Serve with sauce and noodles.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,turmeric powder,basmati rice,irish whiskey,kiwi fruit
title: Kiwi Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 cups basmati rice or 3 cups long grain rice | 5 -8 pieces kiwi fruits | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons irish whiskey
instructions: Boil the rice as per direction on package. Meanwhile boil the kiwifruit in water and mix with bouillon. Heat oil and fry kiwifruit. Add rice, spices and whiskey to kiwifruit and mix well. Serve as desired.

title: Easy Beef (Or Turkey) Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground chuck | 1/2 cup bottled teriyaki sauce, your favourite variety | 1/4 cup halved green onion or 1/4 cup fresh green onion, sliced | 1 can chickpeas ( drained and rinsed )
instructions: Place beef and teriyaki sauce in large bowl and mix thoroughly. Form into four patties.

title: Pork Shoulder
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 lbs pork shoulder | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Trim fat and silverskin from the shoulder. If you like, you can trim off excess fat. Rub salt over the surface of the pork. Place in a large heavy bottomed non reactive pot. Add sherry and stir to combine. Bring to a high simmer over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and braise for 35 to 45 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the mustard seeds and 1 1/2 tsp hot water, and add to the simmering stock. Simmer uncovered until the liquid is reduced by about ¾ half, about 20 minute season with salt.

Random Ingredients: bulgur,extra virgin olive oil,beef chuck,kaffir lime leaf,milk
title: Somali - Beef Kabobs With Bulgur
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck or 2 lbs sirloin tip roast | 1 cup bulgur ( whole wheat ) | 6 -8 kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 - 1 cup 2 % low-fat milk
instructions: Cut beef into thin and wide slices, about 3/8 inch thick. Place each slice between sheets of wax paper, weighted down with heavy duty plastic wrap and pound lightly with bottom of heavy skillet to flatten slightly. Repeat with remaining slices. Heat 1/2 1/2 to 3/4 cup of the olive oil over moderate heat in a heavy large, ovenproof sauté pan. Add half the beef and brown well on each side. Remove beef slices to a board and repeat with remaining beef until all the beef is browned. While beef is browning, make the bulgur. Place 2 cups of hot water, 1/2 cup of bulgur, 1/2 the kaffir lime leaves, and remaining olive oil in a nonreactive bowl.

Random Ingredients: thyme,beef brisket,molasses,corn oil,garam masala,beefsteak tomato,rigatoni pasta,beer
title: Ragout De La Madra (Beef and Tomatoes)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 lbs beefsteak tomatoes, peeled, cored and chopped | 1 tablespoon molasses | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 cup beer | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Heat the corn oil in an oven safe skillet over medium heat. Add the tomatoes, molasses, thyme and about half of the remaining ingredients and cook about 20 minutes. Remove the dish from the heat. Cool. In a separate, dry skillet heat the beer over medium high heat until boiling. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 3 minutes. Pour half of the sauce over the rigatoni. Place the dish in a large serving bowl and pour the remaining sauce over the it.

title: Delicious Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 8 medium yellow onions, about | 4 -6 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into small chunks ( preferably the type with a mild, melty personality ) | 2 -3 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped dried currants, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Place onions in a bowl. Cut a small slit from top to bottom of the onions so that the top of each onion lies flat in a slice of cheese. Insert the cheese into the slit with the tyrup and secure the top with a tooth pick. Brush with the hot sauce until it pours into the cut onions, then spread a little hot sauce over the top. Sprinkle the dried currants over the top and bake on a baking sheet for about 20 minutes or until they look browned toasty and heated through. Remove tooth picks before serving.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,clam juice,tomato paste,active yeast,french bread,shake n bake pork
title: Linda's New York Style Clam Baked French Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 packages active dry yeast | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 cup light cornstarch | 1 can diced tomatoes with onion, with meat | 1 can of shake-n-bake french bread | 2 packages shake-n-bake french bread
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over 1/2 cup water in 2 quart saucepan. Let stand until foamy. Add salt, 1 cup cornstarch. Stir in tomatoes and cook until thickened. Stir in 1 cup of the juice from can of diced tomatoes and simmer until liquid is slightly reduced. Turn off heat. Turn heat up to medium high, place bread in pan. Pour broth over top. Dunk French bread slices into liquid in a few seconds to make sure that all bread is moistened. Cook bread on middle rack in 400 degree oven, until tops are puffed, golden brown. Place bread on a rack to cool.

title: Spanish Onions With Vinegar
ingredients: 2 lbs spanish sweet onions | 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Peel the onions and slice them into 1/4 inch slices. In a nonreactive frying pan with a cover, cook the onions rapidly over low heat, stirring frequently, until they are colored, clear, and tender. When all of the onions are lightly colored and cooked, sprinkle with the vinegar and serve at once.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Dusted Chickpea & Rhubarb Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces chickpeas ( cooked ) | 1 ounce rhubarb ( chopped ) | 4 ounces feta ( crumbled ) | 2 ounces walnuts ( chopped ) | 1 ounce tamarind paste | 4 tablespoons ranch dressing mix | 1 tablespoon lard
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the crumbled feta, walnuts and salad dressing mix together in a bowl. Sprinkle crumbled feta on top of the salad. Dip the peanuts into the dressing mixture and then place on top of the salad and serve.

title: Spicy Beef and Couscous
ingredients: 24 ounces boneless sirloin or 24 ounces top round beef steaks | 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons margarine, melted | 7 ounces couscous or 7 ounces long grain and wild rice blend, prepared | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 1/4 cup scallion, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 green portion scallion, thinly sliced
instructions: Pierce steak with a small sharp knife in a diamond pattern. Brush top of steak with melted butter. Place steak in a glass dish. Combine remaining ingredients, except green portion of scallions, in a small bowl. Pour over steak. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 1 to 2 hours or overnight. Sprinkle with scallion, cover and refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes. Remove steak from marinade and grill over medium heat, turning occasionally for 3 - 4 minutes each side or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,kiwi fruit,green cardamom pod,black bean,orange bell pepper,bacon grease,veal chop
title: Pate Chaud
ingredients: 2 lbs veal chops | 1/3 cup bacon grease | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 large onion soup mix, prepared ( such as french onion soup mix ii ) | 2 teaspoons green cardamom pods | 1 orange bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 small kiwi fruit, chopped with juice
instructions: Cut chops into 1 by 2 inch strips. In a saucepan brown the meat in oil, drain. In a medium size stock. To the stock add remaining ingredients. Stir until moist. Turn into shallow serving dish. Cool and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Aka Middle Eastern Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb ripe tomatoes, cored | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek | 1 1/2 cups crumbs ( or to taste ) | 6 -10 slices round rye bread, cut in half ( or to taste, or use a toasted, crust-cut slice of rye bread, can also use sliced bread, if desired )
instructions: Place the tomato on its side in layers with a little water so they don't break, and place into a food processor with the fenugreek and pulse for about 5 seconds. Add enough crumbs to give a crumbly consistancy, but not too wet, to a thin coating. Place the rye bread on a plate and sprinkle it with the crumb mixture. Heat a griddle to a medium temperature or griddle, and spoon about 3 or 4 tablespoonfuls of the fritter batter onto the griddle, or roll into a large, round patty. Cook until golden brown, and then flip over. Cook about 2 minutes per side. Keep finished fritters warm in a 325 degree oven in a bowl of warm water until you are ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,creamy peanut butter,flat leaf parsley,plum tomato,asafoetida powder,green bell pepper,cremini mushroom
title: Peanut Sauce and Cod
ingredients: 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded, cored and sliced | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, sliced | 1 plum tomato, seeded, chopped | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs cod fish fillets, cut into 8 serving pieces
instructions: Combine the peanuts and asafoetida in a small bowl and set aside. Heat a large skillet. Add the bell pepper and mushrooms to the skillet and saute until the vegetables are tender and the mushrooms golden. Mash the tomatoes with a fork or potato masher. Add the peanut mixture. Stir in the parsley and let the sauce simmer for about 5 - 10 minutes, until the mixture thickens slightly. Meanwhile, season the cod with salt and pepper. Add the cod to the pan and cook until it is opaque and cod is just cooked through. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,green cardamom,hot chili pepper,banana lengthwise
title: Hot Banana Chutney
ingredients: 4 large ripe bananas, peeled lengthwise | 2 tablespoons green cardamoms | 1 teaspoon very hot chili pepper | 1 medium hot chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Place bananas in a small, nonstick skillet over low med heat, and add enough water almost to cover. Bring water to a boil, and let simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, until bananas are tender, and liquid has evaporated. Drain well, and set aside. Strain bananas.

title: BBQ Chicken Barley
ingredients: 1/2 kg chuck, chuck ( ground ) | 1 kg chicken wings ( whole ) | 1/2 kg pearl barley ( dried )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well, shape into 4 patties. Cook in large pot, fat side up in a medium flameproof casserole. Cook at 180c for 30 minutes. Serve with mash.

title: South Texas Style Sausage
ingredients: 12 ounces of thick, thin sliced rindless bacon | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper
instructions: Place the bacon in a nonstick fry pay, medium sized frying pan, and place over medium high heat. Cook until the browned bits are released from the bacon, and starting to caramelize, and are lightly browned around the edge. When this happens, drain most of the bacon fat off of the bacon slices, and transfer them to a plate lined with paper towels to absorb any residual bacon grease. Let drain. Wipe any excess grease out of the bacon. Return the fat to the pan, and add the cilantro and red pepper. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, over medium heat, stirring frequently to prevent sticking, until the sausage is browned. It will be very thick and dry. When the sausage is finished cooking, remove it from the heat, and break it into small chunks. Transfer it to a disposable slow cooker, and cover with foil. Cook on high for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to blend. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Cheese Using Italian Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups italian seasoning | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 teaspoon dried italian parsley | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Mix the italian seasoning and worcestershire sauce together in a small bowl. Stir in the nutmeg, parsley and oil. You can store this in a tightly closed container for up to two months.

title: Creamy Indian Rice
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked val/vermicelli rice | 1 spanish chorizo, chopped | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons dried sweetened fruit, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped | 1 teaspoon minced ginger root
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stir chorizo and mushroom soup until heated through. Add sweetened fruit, cumin, cilantro and ginger. Remove from heat. Add rice, and mix well. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: bacon,milk,chipotle chile,chicken thigh,spice,self raising flour,parmesan cheese,honey
title: Lazy Chicken
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 6 skinless chicken thighs | 1/3 cup self-raising flour | 3/4 cup milk | 2 chipotle chiles, roughly chopped | 1 3/4 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons mild spice | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Fry bacon until crispy. Remove bacon to paper towel lined dish. Dissolve the chipotles in the milk. Fry the chicken in remaining bacon fat until golden brown. Remove cooked chicken and place in a casserole, leaving fat in the pan. Combine flour, salt and black pepper. Add the chipotles and stir in milk and milk. Stir to combine. Add a little more milk if needed. Add chicken to the mixture. Pour the mixture over the chicken. Sprinkle the grated parmesan over. Bake in a moderate oven for 40 minutes or until browned and cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Mexican Bread and Butter Crunch
ingredients: 1 cup chopped mexican style chocolate, melted | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 cups cubed processed cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir until well combined. Spread on toasted baguette slices.

Random Ingredients: oil vegetable,carne seca beef,coconut milk,chili powder,peach,ginger root
title: Spicy Beef With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, or as needed | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root, or more to taste, minced | 1 cup canned unsweetened coconut milk, divided | 1 pinch chili powder, or to taste, divided | 1 tablespoon carne seca ( sweet beef gravy ), or to taste | 1 sliced peach
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the ginger and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Pour half of the coconut milk into the skillet, then pour in half of the chili powder and half of the carne seca. Stir and let simmer 5 minutes while stirring so as to form thickened sauce. Stir the sliced bollero pepper pepper, sliced peach wedges, and any accumulated juice back into the pot. Continue to simmer until beef and coconut milk are hot.

Random Ingredients: sherry,pork shoulder,adobo seasoning,pork loin chop,goat cheese,hard egg
title: Grilled Cuban Pork and Goat Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pork loin chop | 4 small goat cheese | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 3 pinches adobo seasoning | 1 cup sherry, divided | pork shoulder
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Rub grate with adobo seasoning. Place pork, 1/2 cup sherry, and 1 egg on grill. Close lid and grill 5 minutes on each side, turning once. Top each with a cheese slice.

title: Creamy Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 cups oatmeal | 2 cups coconut cream | 1 teaspoon yeast | 1/4 cup sugar
instructions: Add all ingredients into a bowl, mix until combined, set aside to rise for around 3 hours. Cook in a medium oven until light and fluffy. Serve plain, or with melted butter and/or milk.

title: Roasted Coconut Chips With Serrano Chiles, Serrano Chile or Desiccated Serrano Pepper
ingredients: 2 -3 serrano chili peppers
instructions: Preheat oven rack to 300°f. Split chiles lengthwise and remove seeds and ribs. Place chiles in the oven and roast 4 - 5 hours. When they are completely cool, place chiles in an electric food processor and gradually grind until smooth. Scrape out seeds and ribs. Remove chiles and discard. Remove stems and chop coarsely. Place chile mixture in a large bowl and toss with chopped chiles. Let sit 30 minutes to an hour. Transfer mixture to bowl and mix in coarsely.

title: Apple-Red Chilli Dip
ingredients: 300 -400 g frozen whipped topping, thawed | 6 -8 hot dried red chili peppers, seeded ( or to taste- i prefer the ones on the jarred variety ) | 3 tablespoons apple juice concentrate ( do not use reduced fat, use 100ml if preferred ) | 1 tsp paprika or 1 teaspoon ground fennel
instructions: Combine thawed whipped topping with drained chillies, lemon zest and juice. If desired, sprinkle with paprika. Serve with crostini or breadsticks.

Random Ingredients: orange,cassava,cherry pie filling,green cardamom pod,cardamom seed,bean sprout,kahlua,rotini pasta
title: Vegan Tiramisu
ingredients: 8 ounces cassava ( peeled, cubed ) | 14 ounces bean sprouts | 9 ounces colavita sweet potato ( drained ) | 2 ounces orange rind ( diced ) | 1 green cardamom pod ( seeded chopped ) | 14 ounces rotini pasta ( drained ) | 6 tablespoons kahlua | cassava ( optional garnish ) or mint sprig ( optional garnish )
instructions: Blanch the cassava in boiling water for 5 - 7 minutes. Drain, slice cassava and set aside. Saute sweet potato in olive oil and kahlua until soft.

Random Ingredients: brown onion,orange peel,celery seed,porcini mushroom,butter margarine,white wine,black olive
title: Amerikaner (White Wine Sauce)
ingredients: 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms, soaked in boiling water and drained | 2 oranges, peel of | 3/4 cup white wine | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, melted | 2 tablespoons soft brown onion, minced | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon black olives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Finely dice the orange peel and place in a bowl. Add wine and let marinate for 2 hours. In another large skillet, melt butter, add the onions and celery seeds, and saute' gently for 3 or 4 minutes. Stir in the drained porcini mushrooms, cover and simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the pepper and olives, and taste for seasoning. Bring to boil, then remove from heat and allow to stand for 5 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,bread dough,lasagna noodle,cod,lemon juice,mint leaf,serrano chilies
title: Portuguese Fish Pie (Kao Tome Gugurdi)
ingredients: 1 package frozen bread dough | 1 kg cod, skinned and chopped into 3/4-sized pieces ( i use the frozen kingfish ) | 3 teaspoons fresh lemon juice | 3 serrano chilies, seeded | 200 g baby carrots | 3/4 cup fresh mint leaves | 12 sheets lasagna noodles ( or flat noodles )
instructions: Thaw the frozen dough package. Heat the oven to 200°c. Place the dough onto a board and roll out until 3/4 inch thick. Cut out a 12 inch circle using a cookie cutter or biscuit cutter. Line the base, top and sides of a large gratin dish with the dough. Bake the fish for about 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes to make sure it is cooked through but still firm. Meanwhile, place the chilies, carrots and mint into a mortar and pound or crush with a pestle until the chilies are very finely chopped. Remove the fish from the oven and drain off the water. When the fish is cool, put it into a mixing bowl. Add the chilies, carrots and mint, and mix well with a large spoon. Take a sheet of the noodles and separate the strands. Put into a pasta tray with the noodle strands and fish on the base. Sprinkle with the mint and chilies. Spread the fish mixture over the noodles. Pour the noodle/fish mixture over the fish. Use a knife to draw lines on the dough on the top. Bake in the oven for about 40 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: butter bean,wheat breadcrumb,carrot,egg noodle,ancho chile,mace,dark corn syrup
title: Melt Down Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1/2 cup carrot, sliced thin | 1/2 cup raw egg noodles | 1/2 cup black whole wheat breadcrumbs ( for dredging ) | 1 teaspoon dark corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Grease cookie sheet. Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat. Cook carrot for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Then add egg noodles and cook until all noodles are coated. Combine bread crumbs, syrup, chiles, and mace and put a teaspoonful of on the noodles. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Transfer to a plate. Remove the hardened buttery layer from the pan and melt. Pour back over noodles and serve immediately.

title: Spinach Orzo and Beef
ingredients: 1 package orzo pasta | 2 packages taco seasoning mix | 1 pound baby spinach
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add orzo, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Cauliflower and Cauliflower Wraps
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/2 cup shredded lettuce | 3/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Place cauliflower in a large pot of boiling water and cook until tender but still firm. Drain, cool under running water, then place in a bowl. Toss with lettuce, mint and enough of the mint to coat.

title: Quinoa-Chilled Clove Soup (Zwt Three)
ingredients: 4 large whole cloves | 1 ounce quinoa | 4 cups buttermilk ( low-fat or nonfat, to taste, see notes ) | 2 tablespoons tamari, sauce | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 3 small anchovy fillets, pierced with a skewer ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 degrees f. Scrape the shucked cloves into a pan with a teaspoon & simmer with the quinoa for 3 - 4 minutes until cooked. Remove from the heat & set aside to cool. When cooled break open the quinoa using a large paring knife or the blade of a knife. Stir or process the quinoa with a mortar & pestle until fine. Transfer to a bowl & set aside. In a large pan heat the tamari sauce, stir in the quinoa & white pepper. Stir in the remaining ingredients by hand until mixture resembles an ice cream consistency. Heat through & serve topped with freshly ground anchovies for a bit of extra flavor.

title: Simple Microwave Lamb Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup lamb, cubed | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( or 1 chicken cube per 1 kg of lamb )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a microwave safe dish. Cook on high power setting for 1 minute. Stir, cook one minute until thickened. If making for a party, serve with plain boiled rice and veg.

Random Ingredients: rump steak,mushroom,mint sprig,mascarpone cheese,lemon,italian breadcrumb,red bell pepper
title: Grilled Spiced Beef Strips
ingredients: 1 medium rump steak | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/4 cup sliced button mushroom | red bell pepper, cut into strips | fresh mint sprigs ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: To prepare the meat, cut in half crosswise. Open and place, as side, on your work surface. Spread cheese in a shallow dish. Sprinkle both sides of steak with bread crumbs. Roll in bread crumbs to coat on all sides. Place on foil covered grill. Grill for approximately 7 minutes, turn, and cook for an additional 7 minutes or until done. To prepare the sauce, combine mascarpone, garlic, and lemon juice in a small bowl. Spread sauce on cut side of steak.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,puff pastry,rump steak,tomato juice,arrowroot,vanilla extract,poblano chile
title: Spicy Sopaipillas With Beef and Garlic
ingredients: 1 tablespoon arrowroot ( cornstarch ) | 1 1/2 lbs rump steak, cubed | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract | 1 poblano chile, seeded | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed ( approx. 17x14 inch rectangle ) | 12 tortillas
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together arrowroot and 1/2 cup cold water. Place meat in a 2 l casserole dish and pour over the arrowroot mixture. Stir to coat meat well and refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Unwrap the rerolled puff pastry and cut into 8 strips. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each strip to form a 1 rectangle. Sprinkle each rectangle with 1 1/2 tsp. Of garlic powder, 1/2 tsp. Of salt and 1/2 tsp. Of black pepper. Repeat with meat, tortillas, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Place a few teaspoons of tomatillo salsa in the center of each tortilla and roll up. Place in a lightly greased, round 10 x 12 inch baking dish. Pour tomato juice over top and bake in a preheated 450 degree oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until crisp and brown on top. Serve with a green salad, if desired.

Random Ingredients: almond flour,red bell pepper,soymilk,active yeast,whipping cream,pecorino romano cheese,apricot
title: Syraczta (Greek Almond Bread)
ingredients: 2 2/3 - 3 cups almond flour or 2 2/3-3 cups bread flour | 1/2 cup soymilk or 1/2 cup lukewarm milk | 1 package active dry yeast | 3/4 cup unsweetened soymilk | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter, melted or 1/2 cup butter, melted | 2 -3 tablespoons finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 red bell peppers, chopped | 1/2 medium sweet red bell pepper, chopped
instructions: First make greece sour dough, mix all ingredients together and let stand at room temperature an hour or until you can handle it, stirring every 20 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 °f. Grease a large loaf pan. Combine all dough ingredients, except margarine, together in a large bowl and form well in the center. Fill the well with the dough. Insert a toothpick through the top of dough if it protruding from the sides. Place the loaf pan in a roasting pan and pour water into the pan to reach halfway up the pan. Bake for one hour then remove from oven and immediately cover. Leave in the oven for one more hour. Serve warm or at room temperature, with butter and pepper sauce. Note, be sure to add the pecorino romano cheese for a topping note, the cheese itself would be quite salty. Note, be sure not to add cheese directly on top of the dough so you will have a sour dough.

title: Raisin and Honey Grape Tomato Salad
ingredients: 300 g grape tomatoes | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 tablespoon dried currant | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
instructions: Cut the grape tomatoes in half and scoop out the seed. Cut the tomatoes in half again and scoop out the pulp. Mix together the pulp with the cornflour, the thyme, honey, currants and ginger and set aside to marinate for half an hour. When ready to serve, arrange the sliced tomatoes in an attractive pattern on a chilled salad plate and pour over the marinade. Garnish with thyme sprigs.

title: Pigs With Turkey Breast and Prunes
ingredients: 4 large prunes | 4 large yellow peppers | 4 tablespoons turkish bacon fat or 4 tablespoons any neutral flavored oil | cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Wash, trim, and seed pepper. Cut into 4 pieces and boil until they are tender, about half an hour. Remove from heat. Drain. Place on plate and arrange with the skin on top, skinned side up. Slice on either side of the breast into 4 pieces. Sprinkle the breast with cayenne. Let cool slightly and serve. This might be served with crusty bread and can also be served with pita bread.

title: Macaroni N Cheese With Ginger - Diabetic Cookbook Style
ingredients: 200 g macaroni ( dry weight pasta ) | 200 g sharp cheddar cheese ( grated ) | 100 g walnuts ( or pecans ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill leaves
instructions: Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water. Drain and then cool. In a bowl add in the cheese, walnuts, ginger and dill and mix well. The mixture should look like that. Put the macaroni into a colander to drain a little or you can use a cheese cloth. The macaroni should be very warm and the cheese soft. Place in large bowl and sprinkle salt and pepper on it if desired. Mix well. Turn the dish over and let it sit in this way for an hour or two if you get any moisture around the edges of the bowl. Serve with pickled radish slices and salad and pickled cucumber.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,red chili pepper,lobster,kale,bell pepper,tarragon,irish cream,large shrimp
title: Lobster and Shrimp With Irish Cream (Camarao Asada)
ingredients: 1/2 lb lobster | 1 lb large shrimp, shelled | 3 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 small red chili pepper, chopped | 1 medium bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup irish cream | 4 ounces kale, shredded
instructions: In a skillet, heat 1 teaspoon oil and 1/2 teaspoon of the thyme over high heat until hot but not smoking. Add the lobster and shrimp, cook until shrimp has turned pink about 2 minutes. Transfer to bowl and toss with 1 tablespoon of the fresh thyme.

title: Sazon Spanish Onions & Black-Eyed Peas (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 cup dry black-eyed peas or 1 cup other medium-size black beans, washed | 1/2 spanish onion, coarsely chopped
instructions: If using quick pulses, prepare them according to the instructions on the packet. Otherwise, prepare them according to the directions on the packet. Otherwise, soak the dried bean overnight in a little water in a very large pan which has been heated to boiling. Drain the soaked beans and place them in a large casserole. Add the onion and cook over low direct heat, stirring occasionally, for about 10 or 15 minutes, until soft and aromatic. Spread the contents of the pan over the peas and cook over a medium heat for another 5 to 10 minutes, stir all the time and cook for about another 10 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently, until the onions are aromatic, crisp and tender. Remove the casserole from the heat and stir thoroughly. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,plum jam,active yeast,nori,sausage,cinnamon,sherry wine,xanthan gum
title: Portuguese-Style Sweet Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 10 cups napa cabbage ( about 3-6 cups ) | 4 cups prepared marinara sauce ( any flavor ) | 1 cup neufchatel cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons plum jam | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum
instructions: Stir the yeast and 1 teaspoon of the cinnamon in 2 cups of warm water for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir the yeast mixture into the flour. Cover the bowl with a cloth and let stand for 5 minutes to ferment. Add the rest of the cinnamon, wine, cabbage, 1 cup of the prepared marinara, and salt, to taste. Mix to combine. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 minutes. Place in an oiled bowl. Cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Grease a large baking sheet or line with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, work the dough with your hands until it reaches a firm and even ball shape. Roll into a cylinder about 10 inches long and about 1/4 inch thick. Transfer to the prepared baking sheet, cover, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, 30 - 40 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir together the neufchatel cheese and plum jam. Brush over the rolls. Sprinkle top with the remaining 1 teaspoon of cinnamon and xanthan gum. Bake in a preheated 375 f. Oven for 30 - 40 minutes until the filling is bubbling and the rolls are puffed up.

title: Artichoke Rice from the Pastor Food Co
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 5 artichoke hearts
instructions: Soak rice overnight in plenty of water. Drain the rice and artichoke hearts and let drain. Scoop out artichoke heart hearts. In a blender, combine the rice with the artichokes and puree on high until combined. Stir in the artichoke heart mixture and serve hot.

title: Chicken Wings With Chiles and Cheese -- Mexico
ingredients: 6 chicken wings, split | 3 cups finely grated monterey fresh cheese | 3 cups finely grated monterey-shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In large bowl, mix together all ingredients. Place chicken wings in a large non stick baking pan. Bake, basting frequently with pan juices, until almost tender, about 40 minutes. Stir several times during baking to brown. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,poblano chile,asparagus,fish sauce,green cardamom pod,red wine
title: Spicy Asian-Style Asparagus
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus, cut diagonally across the bottom of a 5 -6 inch piece ( about 4 cups diagonally cut ) | 1 medium poblano chile, seeded and membrane removed, coarsely chopped | 2 cups red wine | 3 tablespoons fish sauce ( nam pla asian ) | 4 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 ounce dark chocolate, chopped ( for dipping )
instructions: Place asparagus, poblano chile, wine, and fish sauce in a large skillet. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until asparagus is just tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Transfer asparagus to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and chill in refrigerator until ready to use. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add asparagus and cook, stirring, until barely tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Add cardamom pods and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir chocolate into asparagus mixture. Serve hot.

title: Southwest Beef Cubes
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/2 lb italian sausage, casing removed | 1/4 cup green salsa | 3 tablespoons chili oil ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 medium corn, shucked ( from 2 ears )
instructions: Place beef cubes into a ziploc freezer bag. Remove as much air as possible from beef cubes. Trim as much as possible of excess air from beef cubes, if possible, and place beef into freezer bag, and freeze overnight. Remove beef cubes from freezer and pat dry with paper towels. Remove as many as possible from freezer bag, if possible, and set aside. Cut beef cubes into 1 inch cubes. Remove as much air as possible from beef cubes, if possible, and set aside. Drain all but 1 tablespoon of fat from pan. Fry beef cubes over medium high heat, turning constantly until browned on all sides. Drain all but 1 tablespoon of fat from pan. Add salsa, chili oil, and remaining spices. Stir vigorously to melt meat sauce. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until beef is tender, about 12 to 15 minutes. To serve, spoon stew into shallow soup bowls, garnish with corn shucked ears, and serve with warm tortillas, if desired.

title: Possum and Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 plum ( i like red or green mixed ) | 2 teaspoons gherkins | 12 egg roll wraps | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | sweet plum jam ( or cream of tartar sugar ) ( optional )
instructions: Peel plum, remove seeds and cut in half. Slice plum into thin slices. Arrange plum, gherkin and egg roll wrappers on a cookie sheet. Brush cream mix on each wrapper and sprinkle with tinnch. Let stand 5 min, brush with a little egg wash and sprinkle on sweet jam if using. Let cool about 15 min or until soft. Using the end of a sharp knife cut across center of filling. Wrap each filling tube in the roll and place on a cookie sheet. Using a knife cut a slit across the top of each roll to form 4 rolls.

title: Quick Italian Chicken
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs chicken legs | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 3 cups sliced pepperonis ( from 6-oz. package ) | 2 orange peel, 1-inch strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place chicken legs in a large roasting pan. Mix onion soup mix and pepperonis in a 3 1/2 to 6 quart crockpot. Add enough water to make mixture easy to remove from the stove. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or on high for 3 - 4 hours. Remove chicken from crockpot. Remove orange peel. Place on individual chicken slices. Spoon hot soup mixture over chicken and top with pepperoni slices.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,pineapple juice,chicken bouillon granule
title: Simple Gluten Free Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon pineapple juice | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine the ingredients into a resealable plastic bag.. Shake off any excess air bubbles. Seal and turn over the chicken. Marinate at least 30 minutes, no less than 1 hour. Drain the chicken and reserve marinade.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,molasses,linguine,vegetable,broad bean,tomato paste,liquid honey,curry paste
title: Sweet and Sour Spicy Tomato Linguine
ingredients: 375 g linguine | 2 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons vegetable | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 500 g frozen mixed vegetables | 1 can chopped broad beans, drained | 2 tablespoons liquid honey
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook according to the packet instructions. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large saucepan. Stir in the molasses and then stir in the curry paste and paste mixture. Add the tomato paste, bicarbonate of soda and mixed vegetables. Bring to the boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, before adding the peas and honey. Drain the pasta and vegetables, reserving the water. Toss with the sauce.

title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/4 cup hot chili oil ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese | 1 teaspoon syrup | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Combine mayonnaise, hot chili oil, cheddar cheese, syrup, and cayenne. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Macarrones and Catfish
ingredients: 8 catfish fillets | 8 ounces egg noodles | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 8 large hazelnuts | 1 teaspoon dried chili | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 4 bananas | 3 ladyfingers
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, cooking the macaronno for 3 minutes exactly. Drain. Slice the catfish into long strips and set aside. In a small frying pan, toast the hazelnuts, set aside aside. In the same frying pan, toast the chili, set aside. In a bowl. Add the egg noodles, rum and pine nuts and let soak for 3 minutes. Drain well, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking water. In a large pan, add 4 tbspn of the reserved cooking water, heat till the water reaches a boil and add the pasta. Add the shrimp to the pan and stir continuously for a few minutes. When the pasta is done, drain well and toss the catfish in the sauce, stir in the macaronno and hazelnuts mixture and serve immediately. Note, if the sauce is to stiff, add more water.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,rice noodle,vanilla essence,maple syrup,brown sugar
title: Rice Noodles - Noodle Mixtures
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles, any width | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 100 g brown sugar | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil, stir in the rice noodles and cook for 1 minute. Stir in the maple syrup, brown sugar, lemon juice and vanilla essence. Serve straight away.

title: Vermicelli - Vermicelli Salad
ingredients: 1/2 kg vermicelli | 200 g frozen mixed vegetables | 200 g frozen green peas | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 lime | 1 teaspoon fennel | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil
instructions: Cook vermicelli according to directions. Add peas, peas, vegies and vanilla essence. Cook for 10 minutes stir occasionally. Serve over cooked vermicelli rice. Garnish with lime wedges. Vermicelli may be sliced and microwaved for 10 - 20 seconds.

title: Japanese Turnip Appetizer
ingredients: 6 large turnip | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Peel the turnip and remove the white membrane along its length. Cut peel in half. Put in a pot with enough water to bring it to a boil. Boil quickly for 30 minutes, then remove from heat. Leave for about 15 minutes. Strain out the dill. Place peeled turnip in a saucepan. Drain the excess water out of the juice through a cheesecloth or sieve, and add dill and mirin. Taste for seasoning, add sugar if necessary. Cook uncovered over low heat, stirring regularly, until the turnip is tender. Cut in small pieces. Serve warm.

title: Sausages and Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 kg mustard | 200 g caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 20 kielbasa ( thin sausage casings removed ) | 375 g asiago cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 20 sheets prepared mace ( extra )
instructions: Mix sherry, sugar and mustard. Place sausage in large well greased shallow pan and cover with sherry mixture. Bake at 160 degrees celcius for 30 minutes. Place sausage on absorbent paper to cool. Drain and remove fat, slice lengthwise and cover each sausage slice with sausage, mace and extra mace. Serve in slices or rolls.

title: Tamarind Banana Salad - Malay Style
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, small, halved | 4 bananas ( fresh or grilled ) | 1/4 cup chives, finely chopped | 1 -2 tablespoon mint leaf, fresh, chopped, garnish
instructions: Place the cherry tomatoes in a bowl along with the bananas. Pour oil over tomatoes to cover. Slightly bruise the bananas. Mix everything together and serve. Garnish with chives and mint leaves to serve.

title: Sorrel and Cinnamon Pasta in a Cast Iron Skillet
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 cup warm pappardelle pasta | 1/4 cup cinnamon sugar
instructions: Start heating up your cast iron skillet, on a medium heat. When the pan is hot, add all of the ingredients and stir continuously. Once the bottom of the skillet becomes thicker and puffy, turn the heat off. Place the pappardelle pasta in the skillet, in a flat dish with a lip slightly thicker than your skillet. Toss the pasta until well coated with the syrup. Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar over the top.

Random Ingredients: chicken drumstick,extra virgin olive oil,strawberry preserve
title: Chicken Drumsticks With Strawberry Preserves
ingredients: 4 chicken drumsticks, 4 pieces | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons strawberry preserves, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f degrees. Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides. Heat oil in large skillet or frypan over medium high heat until oil shimmers, about 1 minute. Stir in chicken and cook 2 to 5 minutes. Transfer chicken in to oven. Bake, turning occaly, about 30 minutes, until tender and golden, basting often with sauce. To serve, place chicken onto a platter and surround with preserves. Mound warm preserves over chicken.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,mozzarella cheese,cilantro leaf,onion soup mix,romaine lettuce leaf,mint
title: Cilantro Cheese
ingredients: 3 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup fresh mint, finely chopped | 1 bunch cilantro leaves, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon peel | romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. In a large bowl, mix shredded cheese with dry soup mix, mint, fresh cilantro, lemon peel and pepper. Fill one cup of cheese sauce with cilantro mixture.

title: Pumpkin Battered With Tepid Garlic and Tepid Pecans
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking tapioca | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Line baking sheet with several layers of paper towels. In a small bowl, mix the pumpkin puree and tapioca. Stir in garlic powder. Spread on prepared baking sheet. Bake in a preheated 350°f oven for about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,basil leaf,penne pasta,topping,blue curacao,peanut,sesame seed oil
title: Sesame Noodles in Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dried penne pasta | 1/3 cup sesame seed oil | 1/3 cup brown rice | 1 cup finely crushed peanuts | 1/2 cup dried basil leaves | 1 package frozen topping, thawed with ice and water | 1/4 cup crumbled blue curacao
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook penne at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water to cool slightly, about 2 minutes. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, pour sesame oil into a skillet and place over medium heat. Add rice and cook and stir until golden, about 2 minutes. Add peanuts and basil and cook and stir until just tender, about 3 minutes more. Stir in cooked pasta, peanut sauce, blue curacao and reserved sesame oil. Toss to coat.

title: Braised Herb Cabbage
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs kale ( i use lacinato kale or kale ) | 1/2 cup capers | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 dash fresh nutmeg
instructions: Slice cabbage crosswise down center, trim leaves to about 2/3 inch thickness. Wrap tightly and place on a rack, bake at 200 for 1 hour. Shake and stir cabbage every now and then. Remove leaves from racks. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat until hot but not smoking. Add cabbage, reduce heat to medium, cover and cook, stirring occasionally until cabbage starts to soften, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove cabbage from skillet and cool to room temperature. Remove stems from leaves. In a large bowl, toss cabbage with capers, nutmeg and 1 tbsp oil. Add leaves to cabbage, cover and chill in refrigerator 2 hours. Drain cabbage well, serve at room temperature.

title: Peanut Butter and Coconut Mac 'n Dippers
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk | 1 can tuna fish | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/8 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Combine coconut milk, tuna, peanut butter, ketchup and vodka in a saucepan and heat over medium high, stirring until smooth, about 5 minutes. Pour mixture into a serving bowl and serve with mac 'n cookies.

title: Real Italian Baked Cheese
ingredients: 4 italian sausages | 2 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla | cheddar cheese
instructions: Boil sausages until cooked, about 20 minutes, or to your liking. When sausage is done, remove from pan, and keep warm. Add cornflour and cook until the mixture becomes thicker and is a nice yellow color. Mix together and cut in 4 smaller slices or larger pieces. Arrange on a lined baking dish and cover the slices with cheddar cheese. Bake at 190 degrees c, about 20 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: provolone cheese,red chili pepper,onion salt,hash brown,wheat pasta,acorn squash,cilantro,chicken thigh
title: Mexican Mac and Cheese - Crock Pot
ingredients: 3/4 lb thin whole wheat pasta, uncooked | 1 acorn squash, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 small red chili pepper, deveined and finely chopped | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 3/4 cup chopped cilantro, lightly packed | 1 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1/2 inch slices
instructions: In a 1 1/2 to 2 - 3 quart slow cooker, combine the acorn squash, red chili pepper, onion, cilantro and ground chile and cook, uncovered, on low for 4 - 5 hours, or until the squash is very tender and the sauce is reduced.. When the squash is done, remove it and transfer it to a 4 cup bowl and set aside. While the squash is cooking, put the chicken in a shallow glass dish and pour about 1/2 cup of the sauce over it and toss well to coat the chicken. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. When you are ready to cook, drain the cooked acorn squash, reserving 1/2 cup liquid and discard the liquid. Return the squash to the slow cooker. Add the chicken and any accumulated juices and the reserved cooking liquid and stir well to mix. Cook on high for 4 - 5 hours or on low for 8 - 10 hours. Add more reserved cooking liquid if necessary when you are ready to serve, but be careful not to let the cheese stick to the bottom of the cooker. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,water chestnut,graham cracker crumb,hazelnut,cream celery soup,olive
title: Hazelnut Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs ( not self-rising ) | 2/3 cup finely chopped hazelnuts | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup chopped stuffed olives | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Combine graham cracker crumbs, hazelnuts, and 1 romano cheese in medium bowl. Sprinkle hazelnut mixture over crumb mixture and press evenly onto bottom and 1/2 inch up sides of a 9 inch springform pan, pressing together. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl.. Pour onto crumb base and scatter pecorino on top, pressing down with your fingers. Bake for 50 - 50 minutes or until center is firm and filling is set. If not serving immediately, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 8 hours.

title: Sausage and Watercress With Anchovies and Sherry
ingredients: 16 anchovy fillets | 24 ounces watercress | 1 large italian sausage | cooking sherry
instructions: Place watercress in a skillet and bring to a boil. Add sausage, watercress and cook until crisp tender.

title: Mexican Lentils and Bean Patties
ingredients: 1 -2 - 2 -3 cups lentils or 1 -2 cup pinto beans ( i buy the pre-diced ones ) | lentils | sliced chipotle chiles | 1 dash dried chili flakes | flour, for moistening
instructions: Soak the beans and lentils in water overnight for best results. Drain & rinse the beans & lentils if desired, then mix them in a large bowl. Mix in the chile and lentils to make the lentil mixture. Place the mixture in a frying pan or iron grill and brown on all sides. Add more flour if desired, and allow to brown slightly before serving or storing. I make them a few at a time and freeze them in small baggies, they make great freezer food and it also has a very nice flavor. To thaw, cook in microwave or other type of cooking spray until softened, about 30 seconds or so. If using meat or poultry, brown in skillet until done.

title: Kofta (Shallow-Style Breaded Kabobs)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: In a bowl, combine the bread crumbs and garam masala. Using 1 teaspoon for each, form the mixture into a ball. Wet fingers and moisten with water, if desired. On ungreased baking pans, flatten each piece into a circle about 1/4 inch thick and 1/2 inch thick, and 3 inches wide. Let flatten slightly, about 2 to 3 minutes. With a small ice cream scoop, press out the excess crumbs. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels. Place on the baking sheets and let stand for 30 minutes. Heat a large cast iron griddle or heavy skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle a few pinches of garam masala or other nutmeg on the griddle. Cook koftas about 2 1/2 minutes on each side, until breadcrumbs are lightly golden.

Random Ingredients: white onion,white bread,jalapeno chili,pomegranate molasses,watercress,sherry wine,lamb,green chilies
title: Baharat Aka Green Stuffing
ingredients: 500 g lamb, chopped | 1/4 cup white onion, chopped | 1/4 cup pomegranate molasses | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1 -2 jalapeno chili, chopped ( optional ) | sherry wine, as required | 1/4 cup watercress, chopped | 1/4 cup green chilies | 5 slices white bread
instructions: Put the lamb, chopped white onion, pomegranate molasses, sherry, jalapeno, sherry or watercress and chilies together in a pot, add enough water to cover everything and bring all to a boil. Turn the heat down. Simmer for about 40 minutes or until the meat is cooked. If not using right away, it can take up to 2 hours. It's hard like that. When it's cooked all the way through, skim fat, leave to cool a little more then refrigerate until cold. When cold, place in a freezer bag, removing air and fat. Shaken well to release air. Keep refrigerated until time to use. Note, if you prefer a lower fat version of the dish, you can use an extra virgin olive oil or corn oil you have. If you prefer a creamier sauce, leave out the jalapeno or add 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons of crushed red chillies. To serve, cut crusts off bread, toast in a dry pan.

title: White Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 1/3 cup mayonnaise ( i use low fat ) | 9 ounces rye flour | 2 cups shredded radicchio | 3 -4 tablespoons melted butter
instructions: Open all cans, drain the beans, rinse and drain. Mix the beans, soup, mayonnaise and radicchio together. Mix the melted butter and the butter together in a bowl and then stir into other ingredients.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,cumin seed,mustard,rigatoni pasta,korean red pepper powder,beer,dijon mustard,greek oregano
title: Rigatoni With Spicy Asian Baked Mustard
ingredients: 2 2 tablespoons korean red pepper powder or 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 2 tablespoons yellow mustard | 2 tablespoons dry mustard | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 1 tablespoon korean red curry paste ( to taste ) or 1 tablespoon hot red pepper sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup kosher beer | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta ( can be purchased in the asian food section of your supermarket ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh greek oregano
instructions: Mix all the dry mustard together in a small bowl. Set aside 1 tablespoon of the dry mustard for garnish and set aside to use as a garnish while the rest of the dry mustard is toasting. Put the rest of the mustard and cumin seeds in a small skillet and toast until lightly browned and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Set aside to cool. Drain any excess grease from the pan, then set aside. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cook rigatoni until al dente, about 8 - 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain. Spread the remaining mustard and cumin mixture on the bottom of a 3 qt baking dish. Arrange the cooked rigatoni, mustard mixture and any remaining mustard mixture on top. Sprinkle the cheese blend evenly over the top. Bake the dish until the cheese is bubbly and golden, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate and garnish with the oregano.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,bacon grease,green onion,plain flour,dark chocolate,baby spinach
title: Spinach with Irish Cream and Bacon
ingredients: 400 g baby spinach | 75 g dark chocolate, chopped | 2 green onions, sliced | 1 teaspoon bacon grease | 1 cup plain flour | 2 tablespoons irish cream, warmed
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil. Cook the spinach under a boiling water, cover and cook for 2 minutes. Place the spinach in a large bowl and allow to cool. Drain the spinach and place it in a microwave safe bowl. Add melted chocolate, green onions and bacon grease. Cook on full power for 2 minutes, stirring. Remove from microwave. Add flour and cream and mix together. Stir in the fresh spinach to taste. Serve immediately or keep warm for serving.

title: Potted Chorizo
ingredients: 450 g of cubed stewing beef | 300 g chorizo sausage | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 tablespoon ghee
instructions: Put the meat in a big bowl, season to taste, add enough cold water to cover. You can leave the scallions whole or chop them finely. Cut the chorizo sausage into 5cm cubes, and heat the ghee in a frying pan. When hot, add the chorizo and the scallions. Cover, turn down the heat, and cook for about 45 minutes, or until the meat has absorbed most of the moisture. Serve at once.

title: Enchilada Rellenos (Enchilada Fresca)
ingredients: 2 fennel bulbs, trimmed to the stem end | 2 cans enchilada sauce ( i like puy brand. ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine ( i like pinot grigio, not cooking wine )
instructions: Trim the fennel bulbs lengthwise and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Put the fennel in a very large pot of boiling water and cook for five minutes. Immediately add the enchilada sauce and red wine. Cook, covered, for 20 minutes. Serve over enchiladas.

title: Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine taco seasoning mix and ground nutmeg in a small serving bowl. Mix well.

title: Chicken and Ham on Toast or Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bread flour | 1 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 teaspoon minced fresh garlic or 1 teaspoon dried garlic
instructions: Combine the flour and chicken broth in a measuring cup or a measuring cup. Add garlic. Stir until combined well and pour into a bowl.

Random Ingredients: oyster,yellow cornmeal,linguine,cake flour,shallot,yellow squash,beef consomme,pizza sauce
title: Tortoni With Squash, Beef and Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb linguine, uncooked | 1/2 lb sliced raw shrimp | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1 tablespoon fresh minced shallot | 1 can beef consomme | 1 cup yellow squash, cut into thin slices | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal | 1 tablespoon cake flour
instructions: Cook pasta to al dente. When done, drain and return to pot, toss with shrimp, pizza sauce and shallots. Return to pot and heat through.

title: Pillsbury Easy Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 package cream-style cottage cheese | 1/2 teaspoon granulated beef bouillon granules
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Unroll bag of cottage cheese to make a 9x13 inch baking pan. With a pastry brush spread cottage cheese with beef bullion. Sprinkle on the granulated beef bouillon, or a small amount of water to dissolve the bouillon. Roll up the cheese and place on an foil lined cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, turn oven off and let sit for 10 minutes. With kitchen scissors, open the ends and remove the cheese slices to serve, or slice and eat with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,chicken stock,chili,vanilla extract,beef bouillon cube,kalamata olive,egg white,nutmeg
title: Torta Rustica
ingredients: 4 medium egg whites | 500 g ground lean beef ( or ground turkey or chicken ) or 500 g ground lamb ( or ground turkey or chicken ) | 1 pinch nutmeg | 1 pinch chili | 1 dash celery rib ( optional ) | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 pinch salt | 2 small chicken stock | 100 kalamata olives, pitted ( optional ) | 1/8 liter chicken stock
instructions: Mix together the meatball ingredients. Using a cookie cutter, cut 3/4 inch strips or 2 inch sticks about 2 to 4 inches long and all you have to do is run the meat at a slight angle. Place half the meatball in a small deep mixing bowl, cover with the rest of the meatball mixture and roll to coat. Transfer on parchment or a piece of aluminum foil or tray. Repeat until all the meatballs are used up. Place the meatballs into a baking dish or baking dish in a single layer. Add the chicken stock or water to just cover them. Add the rest of the meatball mixture to the baking dish. Cover and bake for about 1 hour at 190°c. Uncover and bake until meatballs are golden brown in colour. Let meatballs to cool down and slice them into pieces. If planning on serving this for dinner, heat 1/2 liter of chicken stock in a pan for about one minute and then stir it into the meatballs. This will loosen them and create a gravy. Serve or pour over the torta.

Random Ingredients: key lime,hot italian sausage,turnip,pecan,chicken thigh,hard egg,whipping cream,malt vinegar
title: Chicken Salad with Irish Pigs
ingredients: 2 cups pecans, finely chopped | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs or 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts | 4 hard-boiled eggs, coarsely chopped | 1 small turnip, peeled and diced | 2 cups whipping cream | 1 tablespoon good quality malt vinegar | 1/2 lb irish bulk hot italian sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Spray 12 inch ovenproof skillet that the size of the skillet with cooking spray with cooking spray. Combine all ingredients except sausage and blend well together in a large bowl. Add sausage and mix well. Spread mixture in skillet. Dot with mixture and sprinkle with pecans. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until the mixture is no longer pink and a meat thermometer inserted through the stuffing registers 160f. Serve with hot italian sausage.

title: Stirfry Syrup
