ingredients: 1/2 lb walnut oil | 3 tablespoons maraschino cherries | 2 tablespoons walnut oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot set over moderate heat. When oil is hot, pour the syrup into a pastry bag. Shake to coat nuts evenly. Remove from heat when syrup turns light brown. Drizzle syrup on and serve warm or warm.

title: Sweet Pork Rollups
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 16 small marshmallows | 1 cup torn red leaf lettuce | toothpicks
instructions: Cut tenderloin lengthwise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Sear pork in nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: splenda sugar substitute,cream mushroom soup,collard green,white bread,pineapple,balsamic vinegar,chili paste
title: Low Fat Sweet and Sour Greens
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 2 cups fresh collard greens, cleaned, washed, and chopped | 8 slices white bread, crusts removed | 2/3 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1/8 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: In a saucepan combine the cream of mushroom soup, and collards and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, stir in the bread slices and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the splenda, vinegar, chili paste, and pineapple. Continue simmering over low heat until thickened. Serve hot.

title: Broccoli Smoked Oktoii
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk, divided | 12 fresh broccoli florets | 3 baby bok choy, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon dried savory, or to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill weed
instructions: Beat 2 tablespoons of the buttermilk on high until the foam disappears. Layer the broccoli, bok choy, dill, and remaining buttermilk mixture in two separate bowls.

title: Chipotle-Yohan (Spiced Mexican Red Chili Beans)
ingredients: 10 chipotle chiles | 4 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Prepare a 9x13 inch pan by spraying with cooking spray and lining the bottom with parchment paper. Remove the stems from the chiles, and split them crosswise in half lengthwise to resemble a half moon. Remove seeds and membrane from chiles. Place each half in a small bowl or container with 1 teaspoon chipotle. Fill the empty can with diced tomatoes with chilies, and fill with enough water to cover the chiles completely. Cover bowl tightly with a kitchen towel, and use your fingers to rub the chiles under the towel until completely coated. Arrange half of the chiles in the pan with 1/3 of the tomato mixture. Place the remaining half of the chiles in as follows, tomatoes with chilies, remaining tomato mixture, reserved chilies, and remaining tomato mixture. Place in oven, and bake for 1 hour. Serve with flour tortillas and warm corn chips.

title: Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless leg of lamb | 2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut lamb into 2 to 2 inch pieces. Place in roasting pan. Combine molasses, ketchup and crumbs. Pour over lamb. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 1 1/2 4 hours to 2 hours, basting twice. If any sauce remains on the meat after removing from oven, cover loosely with foil. Serve as desired.

title: Super Simple Microwave Celery Drink
ingredients: 1 cup celery, chopped | 1 cup cold pressed ice
instructions: Add celery, ice, and shake well. Enjoy.

title: Hoisin-Style Tortillas
ingredients: 6 chicken wings | 1 cup sweet onion, halved and sliced thin | 1/3 cup dried chickpeas | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 3 -5 teaspoons sesame oil | 4 hoagie rolls, split and toasted | salt | 2 slices onions | 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon | 4 slices canned sweetened condensed chicken wings
instructions: Trim fat from both wings.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,salmon fillet,italian bread,french green bean,pepperoni,chipotle chile
title: Grilled Salmon With Bell Pepper-Nut Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs salmon fillets ( about 3.5 inches thick ) | 2 pink bell peppers, cored, seeded, and cut into chunks | 1 1 ounce pepperoni, sliced into strips | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle chile, in adobo with chipotles, and seeded | 2 cans french style green beans, drained | 1 loaf crusty italian bread, cut in half crosswise
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the salmon with the bell peppers, pepperoni, chile, and drained beans. Cover and refrigerate 3 or 4 hours. Turn the oven on to 200c. Place on a greased or nonstick griddle or frying pan and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until the salmon is fork tender. Serve hot.

title: Anchovy-Peas Guacamole (Serve at once)
ingredients: 5 anchovies ( peeled and chopped ) | 32 ounces coconut cream ( or cream coconut milk ) | 16 ounces fresh shelled green peas ( or 1 1/4 pkg frozen peas, podded and drained ) | 16 ounces guacamole
instructions: Drain all the liquid from the anchovies into a sauce pan and bring to boil, and then turn off the heat and set aside. Put the coconut cream into a bowl and whisk into the anchovy mixture, then keep whisking until thick. Stir in the peas and then pour the guacamole into 4 bowls or bowls. When serving, spoon the chutney on top of each serving, adding a dollop of guacamole on the side to add at the end.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,lettuce,onion powder,monterey jack pepper cheese,superfine sugar,farfalle pasta,corn
title: Cheesy Mexican Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package linguine | 1 can corn, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup minced onion | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( about 2 oz. ) or 1 cup muenster cheese, shredded ( about 2 oz. ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons granulated onion powder
instructions: Cook pasta. Drain. Return to pot. Drain the corn. Add the corn, chopped onion, ¼ cup cheese, cilantro, sugar, and onion powder. Toss to mix. Chill at least 2 hours before serving or serve at room temperature.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Relish
ingredients: 2 kg red bell peppers | 1/2 kg white peppercorns
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 grades celsius cut the roasted red peppers into quarters and place all the pieces of red bell pepper, peeled rinsed and cleaned, into a roasting tray. Sprinkle with the peppppercorns and season as before. Heat the oven to 200 grades celsius and place the tray immediately into the oven. Roast for about 2 1/2 hours, or until the peppers are soft and tender and the peppppercorns are well roasted to desired levels of moisture. Do not overcook. Remove from the oven and immediately pour off any excess juices. Cut the peppers into thick slivers and serve whilst still hot.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,red currant jelly,orange,steak,chicken breast half
title: Sweet Orange Beef
ingredients: 2 skin-on, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into strips | 2 cups orange slices | 1 cup red currant jelly | 1/4 cup orange juice | 12 ounces shell pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Place chicken, orange slices, currant jelly, and juice in a slow cooker. Cover.

title: Brazilian Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup whole milk | 3 tablespoons rice wine or 3 tablespoons white wine
instructions: In a saucepan combine the milk and rice wine. Heat until it boils and then remove from heat. In a greased 6 cup baking dish combine milk mixture and wine mixture. Cover and microwave at high for 15 minutes. Mix thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,green chilies,anise seed,turmeric,lemongrass,italian salad dressing,lox,bamboo shoot
title: Thai Lemongrass
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 2 lbs fresh lemongrass, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 green pepper, sliced | 1 cup bamboo shoot, sliced | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 cup italian salad dressing
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a medium saucepan. Add chopped lemongrass.

title: Lobster Coconut Curry
ingredients: 1 lobster tail | 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained. | 1 tablespoon curry paste
instructions: Clean lobster tail and remove head shell, if necessary. Peel if necessary. Cut each shell crosswise in four pieces and set aside. Reserve tail shells. Using a sharp knife, core lobster. Cut meat into bite sized pieces. Place the meat into a large skillet with a lid. Add curry paste. Cook over medium heat until the curry paste is fragrant. Place reserved tails and pineapple chunks in the skillet. Increase heat to medium high and bring lobster pieces to a boil. If the pan starts to smoke, turn down heat to medium. Cover and reduce heat. Cook for about 15 minutes or until meat is cooked through. Add tail meat. Cook for an additional 3 - 5 minutes, stirring gently. Enjoy.

title: Sizzling White Fish With Corn and American Cheese
ingredients: 12 inches halibut, boned and butterflied | 1/4 lb halibut ( boned and butterflied ) | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 cup cauliflower floret | 1 cup frozen whole corn | 3/4 lb american cheese, cut into 12 | 12 large mussels, shelled debearded | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Cut halibut crosswise into eight 2 x 9 slices. Lightly butter both sides of fish. Place in a baking dish. Sprinkle each with salt.

title: Orange Steamed Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb fresh sausages ( cumberland - 6 oz ) | 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1 dash hot sauce
instructions: Remove rind from sausages and wash well under cold running water. Drain and thoroughly pat dry with paper towels. Make sure there is no pink on the insides of the sausages. Sprinkle each side lightly with a little of your favourite glaze. Steam for around 90 minutes for medium or for about 15 until they start to darken in colour. Serve with mashed potato.

Random Ingredients: egg white,green tomato,confectioner ' sugar,ice cube,coconut milk,beef chuck
title: Filipino Spicy Steak and Green Tomato-Cheese Fritters
ingredients: 4 cups coconut milk | 3 egg whites | 2 pounds boneless beef chuck, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 green tomatoes, chopped | 4 ice cubes, or as needed
instructions: Combine coconut milk, egg whites, and beef in a large, shallow bowl.

Random Ingredients: vanilla soymilk,egg,olive,beef chuck,nonfat milk powder,rigatoni pasta
title: Homemade Mac & Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef chuck | 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1 egg | 1/2 cup sliced ripe olives | 1/4 cup sliced ripe olives | 1 teaspoon vanilla-flavored soymilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cook ground chuck in skillet over medium heat until no longer pink, stirring meat with a wooden spoon. Drain meat. Stir together nonfat dry milk powder and milk in small bowl. Bring 4 to 5 cups water to boil in large dutch oven or large saucepan. Stir dry milk mixture with beef. Cook and stir about 5 minutes to absorb milk powder. Place pasta in large bowl.

title: Greek Ziti (Greek Macaroni)
ingredients: 1 box ziti pasta | 1 jar pimiento peppers with pimentos, drained | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 3/4 cup italian seasoning blend | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, chopped
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions until el dente.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,white potato,canadian bacon,oregano leaf,green chilies,plain yogurt,red cabbage
title: Potato Cheese and Bacon Salad
ingredients: 4 medium firm white potatoes, cooked | 8 slices canadian bacon ( can use maple or bacon ) | 4 slices smoked canadian bacon ( canadian bacon ) | 12 ounces red cabbage, shredded | 3/4 cup shredded red cabbage | 1 can green chilies, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup fat free plain yogurt or 1/2 cup fat free sour cream
instructions: In a large bowl toss all ingredients except yogurt. Cover and chill 1 hour or until vegetables are just warmed. Sprinkle with yogurt just before serving or at room temp.

title: Lamb and Fennel Panini
ingredients: 1 kg meat, cubed | 200 g lambs shoulder, cubed | 200 g ham, diced | 1 fennel bulb, sliced | 4 dried red chili peppers | 2 teaspoons mixed spice, crushed | 1 baguette, loaves halved and toasted under the grill
instructions: Place lamb and fennel in a shallow casserole. Season with salt, freshly ground black pepper and the mixed spice. Add the chiles and meat and pour over enough boiling water to come almost to the top. Bring the mixture to the boil and cover. Cook slowly for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until the lamb and fennel are tender. Toast the baguettes under the grill and serve with the lamb mixture and toasted baguette slices.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,poblano pepper,apricot jam,tomato sauce,dark rum,spaghetti,rice wine,italian sausage
title: Tuscan Sausage and Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage | 2 -3 medium tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 2 cups uncooked spaghetti or 2 cups spiral shaped pasta | 1 poblano pepper, seeded and chopped | 6 -10 ounces tomato sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 6 ounces crumbled american cheese | cooked spaghetti | paprika or hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Cook sausage until done. Remove sausage from pan. Cook pasta and drain. Mix pasta with sausage. Stir in tomatoes and remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: limeade concentrate,strawberry,baby carrot,poppy seed,lemon juice zest,sugar cookie dough
title: Lemon Poppy Seed Strawberry Rollups
ingredients: 1 can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 1 pint fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced | 1/2 cup baby carrots, grated | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 bag frozen poppy seeds, thawed and well drained | powdered sugar cookie dough ( recommended buddha's food )
instructions: Mix frozen limeade concentrate, strawberries, carrots, lemon juice and poppy seeds in a bowl. Spoon half of the mixture into the center of a cookie sheet, leaving about 1/4 inch around the edge. Roll up, starting from the long side. Dip the outside edge into powdered sugar. Repeat with the remaining mixture until all the filling and rolls are used up. Place rolls on a cookie sheet, seam side down. Bake at 425 degrees for 18 - 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve rollups in small cups.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,canola oil,italian herb,extra virgin olive oil
title: Herbed Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 cup lemon juice | 4 -6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb blend
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well. Adjust seasonings to taste.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,vegetable oil,tzatziki,tabasco sauce,sesame seed,beef stew meat,wonton wrapper,graham cracker crumb
title: Beef Ravioli
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | 1 pound beef stew meat | 1 package instant wonton wrappers | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese for dusting | 2 squares vegetable oil for frying | tabasco sauce, or as desired
instructions: Place sesame seeds in a ziploc bag. Add the beef.

title: Veal With Chillies in Red Wine
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg leg of lamb | 2 red chilies, deseeded and sliced | 3 medium parsnips, peeled and cut in 5 cm pieces | 1 bottle vodka | 1 liter water | 2 -3 kg veal roast
instructions: Put the lamb in a heavy casserole with all the other ingredients.. Cook very slowly under the grill or very slowly on the bbq until well cooked.

Random Ingredients: dill,cocoa,kidney bean,lemon peel,cider vinegar,pepper,italian seasoning,vegetable shortening
title: Garden Fondue
ingredients: 2 cups canned kidney beans, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 1/3 cups apple cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1 lemon peel | 1 tablespoon dried dill | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Combine beans, vinegar, vegetable shortening, cocoa, pepper, dill, and italian seasoning in fondue pot. Cook, stirring constantly to melt shortening. Turn heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Add reserved bean liquid, cook 2 minutes longer. Serve warm with crackers.

Random Ingredients: french bread,picante sauce,iceberg lettuce,flat leaf parsley,daikon radish
title: Bake the Sandwiches (Filipino)
ingredients: 1 garlic ( medium-sized head ) | 6 heads iceberg lettuce, washed, drained and dried | 1/3 cup picante sauce ( mild ) | 1 bunch fresh flat leaf parsley, washed | 1/2 small daikon radish, washed, peeled and sliced thinly
instructions: The first thing to do is to work quickly from the top position of the head of garlic. The garlic's skin should be blackened in some places and it should be turned black with some color. The key is to turn the head at both ends. Then, slice the top of the garlic head from the head into small slivers. In a medium mixing bowl, place the iceberg lettuce and put the head in one hand and the head in the other. Use the back of a spoon to scrape the peeled garlic slivers off of the peel, avoiding the garlic. Cut the head half way through and then slice away the thin layer of black stem. You don't wish to cut all the way through. In a medium baking dish, place 1/3 cup picante sauce and 1/3 cup of torn lettuce on the bottom of the dish. Add 4 slices of the french bread over the picante sauce, spreading the lettuce mixture evenly. If the sandwich becomes a large juicy hamburger in the center of the bread, remove the hamburger from the baking dish and slice it into thin strips. Take the left over cheese in the refrigerator and put the slices of sandwich over the cheese. The sandwich will then be ready to eat after about 20 minutes, flipping the sandwich and rearranging it once or twice so that it is evenly distributed on all sides of the sandwich. It's very important that the bottom of the french bread is completely covered in the picante sauce to keep it from getting crispy. This step is crucial, so be careful. Cover the sandwich with the bread slices, if using, and then put another 6 slices of the hamburger on top of the cheese. Make sure everything is evenly distributed evenly.

title: Yum Yum Bread (British)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup mint leaf, fresh
instructions: Combine flour and mint leaves in a mixing bowl. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture. Pour a few tablespoons of water into the well and gradually stir in the water. Knead dough lightly on a floured surface until firm. Roll dough to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into 1/2 inch squares and place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Roasted Norwegian Salmon Casserole  (Baked)
ingredients: 1/8 onion salt | 1/4 cup garlic oil | 1 teaspoon marjoram | 1 lb salmon ( skin removed and flaked and then flaked ) | 4 small baking potatoes, peeled and chopped | 1 large sweet onion, chopped
instructions: Preperation, combine salt, garlic oil, marjoram and marjoram and stir until mixture is smooth. Add salmon and potatoes and mix well. Spread mixture in a baking dish and bake 375 for 12 - 15 minutes until potatoes are tender. Bake salmon for 15 to 20 minutes longer. Serve warm with gravy or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,red chilies,half,coffee,chili sauce,coriander seed,lime juice,mint jelly
title: Chili-Dissolve Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1/8 cup chili sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon mint jelly | 1 teaspoon lime juice ( or to taste ) | 2 tablespoons brewed coffee | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon coriander seeds | fresh red chilies
instructions: Put half the half & half and chili sauce in a saucepan and set over low heat. Add honey, coffee, mustard, coriander and chilli seeds. Cover and simmer for 5 - 8 minutes. Serve over ice cream or pak choi.

title: Smokey Linguine
ingredients: 1 package yeast | 1/2 cup warm water | 6 cups leftover smoked pork or 6 cups beef broth | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 tablespoon minced oyster mushrooms | 4 1/2 ounces dried linguine ( dry )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl, or in a lidded food storage bag. Add the salt, broth, spices, mushrooms, and noodles, mixing well to combine. Cover tightly and store in a cool, dry place or in a warm spot to rise in a warm oven. Turn once in a while so the spices dissolve and flavor the noodles throughout. Bring to room temperature and then bake at 400°f until the sauce is creamy, but not thick, about 40 minutes. Enjoy and enjoy.

title: Wild Rice and Guacamole Trifle
ingredients: 1 package ladyfingers ( angel food ) | 3/4 cup dried wild rice ( cooked according to package directions ) | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup cherries or 1/4 cup grape tomatoes & chives ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook a large serving platter in hot water. Trim ends from ladyfingers and discard. Tear off pieces of bag of loose jewlery and place on serving platter. Sprinkle with uncooked wild rice and mix well. Cover with guacamole and sprinkle with cherries or tomatoes. Garnish with a sprig of chives and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,beef chuck,basil,pumpernickel bread,red wine vinegar,horseradish,rice wine
title: Beef & Broccoli Sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 2 tablespoons sweet dry mustard | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck | 2 cups broccoli florets | 8 slices pumpernickel bread, thin | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil
instructions: Cut chuck steak crosswise into 5 slices | 1/2 inch thick. Arrange beef slices in a single layer in a shallow dish. Whisk together vinegar, horseradish and mustard in a small bowl. Pour half of dressing mixture over beef and vegetables in a nonreactive bowl. Cover.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,red chili pepper,chili bean
title: Pamela's Chili Con Carne (Spicy Chili Beans)
ingredients: 1 lb dried black chili beans, about 4 - six cans | 1 beef bouillon cube ( with or without water ) | 2 red chili peppers, chopped ( about 1 cup ) or 3 small dried hot red chili peppers, chopped ( about 1 cup )
instructions: If available, soak the black chili beans for 30 minutes before using. If the beans are already soaked, combine them with the boiling water. They should not be soupy. If your beans are not sufficiently soaked, add a few tablespoons of hot water. Let the beans soak at least 12 hours before using. If your beans are not thickened, boil for about 45 minutes or until desired consistency is reached. If your beans are too thin, add a little more hot water. Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,rice noodle,french,sesame seed,liquid honey,robusto cheese,self rising flour,lemon
title: Quick and Easy Microwave Lunchbox Robusto
ingredients: 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons shredded robusto cheese | 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon liquid honey or 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated lemon rind ( optional ) | 200 g rice noodles ( gluten free ) | 250 g cooked french sandwich roll ( such as savoury smart joes )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except noodles in microwave safe glass casserole dish. Add noodles and stir to coat well. Microwave on high, covered, for 8 - 10 minutes or until noodles are cooked through and mixture is warm to the touch. Remove lid and microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes, or alternatively place in microwave oven and cook over high for 30 - 45 seconds, or according to your microwave's direction. Let sit on a stand or invert for 2 seconds before serving.

title: Easy Noodle Carbonara
ingredients: 6 slices bacon bits | 1 package uncooked spaghetti
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a 6 quart casserole dish. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in the spaghetti, and return to a boil. Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. Reserve 1 cup of the pasta water in the pot. Melt the bacon bits in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Green Chile Guacamole
ingredients: 4 ripe avocados - peeled, pitted, and chopped | 3 cans chopped green chiles | 3 serrano peppers, seeded and minced
instructions: Place the avocados into a large bowl, cover with boiling water, and allow to stand at least 30 minutes to plump up a few of them. Drain, and mash with a fork until smooth. Mix in the chiles, and taste to adjust seasoning. Cover, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Spanish Truffles
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: In a blender, blend cocoa and oil. The texture should be of light and oily powder. Scoop out rounded tablespoons of the chocolate mixture, roll into small balls, and roll in toasted cocoa to coat the outside. Store in an airtight container.

title: Lamb and Rice Lasagna
ingredients: 1 leg of lamb skinless boneless and trimmed | 32 strips lasagna noodles | 14 ounces long grain rice | 2 green onions, sliced
instructions: Put the lamb skinless boned and trimmed of all visible fat into a pan with enough water to cover. Bring to the boil and reduce heat to low. Simmer for one hour until the internal temperature is 180 degrees f. Set the meat on a board. Shred it into small bits, discard any fat. Meanwhile, place the noodles in a saucepan of fresh water and boil until al dente, according to the instructions on the packet. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Place half of the noodles in a large baking tray. Put half of the meat on top and sprinkle with half of the cheese. Repeat with the rest of the meat. Spoon half of the noodles onto the meat. Repeat with the remainder of the noodles, meat and cheese. Spread the last of the cheese on top. Cook in the preheated oven for 30 - 40 minutes until hot and golden.

title: Tangy Peach Soup
ingredients: 2 cups fresh peaches, peeled, halved, pitted or 3 -4 large frozen peaches, with juice ( you can use canned, drained canned, if your eating more ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 3 1/2 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth
instructions: Place broth into a 3 - 4 quart soup pot and bring to a boil. Add all remaining ingredients except salt and pepper. Taste broth and add salt and pepper as needed. Bring back to boil. Cover and simmer 5 - 10 minutes to thaw the peach. Ladle into hot sterilized canning jars. Add enough boiling water to cover the peaches right up to 2 inches of top of the jar. If the peaches are covered with water, add more. Boil for an extra 5 minutes. Remove jars and let cool completely before processing.

title: Papas Brava
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon gelatin, unflavored | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, chicken flavored bullion concentrate | 1 tart apple, peeled cored and cut into 1-inch cubes ( i use macintosh ) | 1/4 cup buttermilk or 1/4 cup sour milk | 5 poblano chiles, roasted peeled cut in half, seeded, deveined and seeded, seeded if desired ( about 4 ounces ) | papayas brava, to serve ( or any other tomato and cheese flavor )
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over warm water and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until gelatin is melted. Remove from heat.

title: Paleo Apple Crisp
ingredients: cooking apples, such as granny smith, such as granny smith, such as granny smith, peeled | vegetable oil
instructions: Slice or dice peices at a angle into 1/4 inch wide fries and heat a few tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry the fries until crisp and golden, about 3 minutes on each side. Remove fries to paper towels to drain. If you are using a nonstick griddle, heat remaining oil and fry remaining fries until golden brown, a few minutes more. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red onion,cottage cheese,grain rice,pistachio nut,eggplant,pastry dough
title: Eggplant Rice Pie (Vegetarian Empanaditas)
ingredients: 1 lb puff pastry dough | 1 large eggplant | 1/2 onion, finely chopped | 1 cup raw whole grain rice, plus 1/2 cup raw basmati rice | 1/2 cup cottage cheese, cut to size of filling | 2 tablespoons sliced fresh pistachio nuts
instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1/4 inch rounds. Bake for 20 minutes until golden brown. Let cool to the touch then slice the eggplant into about 1/4 inch slices. In a large frying pan, place the cooked eggplant over medium heat. Cook the onion for about 5 minutes, until it just begins to turn golden. Add the rice and stir to dissolve rice grains. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Remove eggplant from skillet and place into the oven for about 10 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed. This should have a very dry smell. In a separate large bowl add the chopped onion and cottage cheese. Stir well. When rice is ready, add it to the onion and cheese mixture in the frying pan and stir well. In a 9 inch pie plate, add the eggplant, then the cooked eggplant rice mixture, ending with the rice. Sprinkle with the pistachio nuts. Make an indentation with the back of a spoon into the top of the pie crust to allow for the filling to reach the edges. Dab the tip of a knife into the center of the crust and poke around the edges of the crust a few times making sure the hole remains intact. Cover the tart shell with a sheet of aluminum foil so the crust doesn’t overhang the foil. Bake the pie for about 20 minutes until the crust is golden brown. Let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Smkeed Risotto (Re:ntried Eggs & Shreads)
ingredients: 6 ounces smoked rye bread | 6 ounces cooked chicken ( from the deli ) | 2 1/2 fluid ounces tamari ( light is ok ) | 3 1/2 fluid ounces boiling chicken stock
instructions: Cut up the bread into squares ¼ inch thick and place on absorbent paper. Break the smoked chicken into small pieces and place in a bowl. Add the tamari and pour in the boiling stock. Stir until all ingredients are covered in liquid. When the liquids have come to the boil, add a slice of smoked bread and re:noted, and remove the paper.

Random Ingredients: celery,french bread,vegan margarine,grape tomato,mango,apricot preserve,sherry wine
title: Seared French Bread With Mango and Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut about 1in thick | 2 tablespoons vegan margarine | 500 g grape tomatoes | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 cup vegan margarine | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 1 mango, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup celery, finely chopped
instructions: Brush the entire loaf with half the margarine. Arrange in a well buttered baking tin, cut side down. Chill until needed. Heat oven to 160c. Scatter the grape tomatoes over the bread and spread around the base in a nonstick frypan. Whisk together the preserves, margarine, sherry and remaining margarine until smooth. Sprinkle over the bread and bake in the oven for 30mins to 35 mins, until the bread and tomatoes are cooked. Meanwhile mix together the mango, celery and remaining margarine. Serve with the salad.

Random Ingredients: thai chile,spinach leaf,asiago cheese,mango,italian tomato sauce,brown sugar,heavy whipping cream
title: Spinach, Mango and Mozzarella Palette
ingredients: 1 can italian-style tomato sauce | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 pound fresh spinach leaves | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 mango - peeled, seeded and diced | 8 thai chiles, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped asiago cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Butter a 10x15 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, mix together tomato sauce and brown sugar. Blend in spinach until it becomes a bit dry. Spread half the spinach mixture into the prepared baking dish. Top with half the mango and chiles.

Random Ingredients: bamboo skewer,zucchini,pimiento,sesame oil,garlic clove,spanish onion,baking soda,greek yogurt
title: Spicy Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 12 large fresh zucchini | 1 cup spicy greek yogurt | 1 small spanish onion, sliced thinly | 1 jar sliced pimientos | 1 jar sliced bamboo skewers, drained - 1/2 cup, reserve juice | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 medium garlic clove, peeled and smashed | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Slice zucchini in 1 to 2 inch slices. Soak in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain well. Place in a large bowl with yogurt, onion, pimentos, and bamboo skewers. Stir in sesame oil, garlic, and baking soda. Toss gently.

title: Easy Fruity Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green beans, tipped and tailed | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 - 3 cup dates, chopped | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: Steam the green beans and the pepper flakes until tender.

title: Tomato, Jollof Rice Pudding (Gougeres)
ingredients: 1 large ripe yellow tomatoes, cut into 1-inch cubes ( like cherry tomatoes ) | 8 -10 cups rice krispies | 6 cups grated gruyere cheese ( about ) | peppercorn, to taste
instructions: Sprinkle the cut tomatoes with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Place them in a large pot of boiling, heavily salted water and let stand until they are very tender, about 10 minutes. Drain excess water, then transfer the tomatoes to a bowl. Press each tomato directly, one to the bottom of the pot, to ensure that some of the pulp cooks out. Repeat until all the tomatoes have been pressed. Add rice krispies and 1 1/2 cups water to the tomatoes and stir lightly. Cover and simmer until rice is tender and the krispies are crisp inside, about 45 - 50 minutes. Stir the rice with a spoon until the mixture becomes creamy and heated through. Spoon the rice mixture into an ovenproof serving dish, cover and set it on a baking sheet lined with foil. Set aside at room temperature. Sprinkle the cheese over the top and broil it just until the cheese is bubbly and starting to brown. Serve warm.

title: Maggie Beer's Radishes
ingredients: 4 heads radishes | 2 fluid ounces triple sec | 1/2 cup prepared chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | 2 fluid ounces amaretto
instructions: Cut the radishes at the root end, leaving the root ends intact. Arrange the radishes in a single layer on a serving platter. Stir together the triple sec, 1 tablespoon of chunky salsa, and chives in a small bowl. Drizzle the salsa over the radishes, and sprinkle evenly with amaretto.

Random Ingredients: soba noodle,pimiento,saffron thread,sauce,thai fish sauce,fennel seed
title: Havana Noodles Con Soba
ingredients: 1 package soba noodles | 2 fresh pimiento slices, drained | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 teaspoon saffron thread | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Stir noodles into the boiling water, then set aside. Combine soba noodles, pimentos, hot sauce, saffron, fennel seed, and fish sauce in a bowl. Cover, and refrigerate noodles until cold, at least 6 hours. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: bacon dripping,chicken bouillon granule,onion soup mix
title: Napa Dave's Chicken Gravy II
ingredients: 1/4 cup bacon drippings | 2 tablespoons instant minced onion soup mix | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Heat bacon grease in a 10 inch skillet or fry pan over medium heat until oil shimmers. Add onion soup mix, and heat to boiling. Add crumbled chicken bouillon. Reduce heat, and cook, stirring continuously for 2 minutes to reduce liquid. Remove from heat, and use, or store.

title: Creamy Goat Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 package goat cheese | 1 package shredded cheddar cheese | 1 can oysters | season salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl combine the goat cheese, cheddar cheese, and oysters. Mix until well combined. Sprinkle salt over the top. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hot Dogs With Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 hot dogs, any size | 2 cans shiitake mushrooms | ice
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in a pan with a lid. Place the hot dogs into pan, and fry. Place on paper towels to drain. Cut the mushrooms into halves, and slice the mushrooms very thin. Place all ingredients into a glassware container with a snap lid, and place in the microwave for 20 - 30 seconds to warm through.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,chicken wing,mushroom,garam masala,egg yolk,chili powder,rice
title: Kabab (Mushroom Chicken)
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings ( drumsticks and thighs ) | 1 jar sliced mushrooms | 2 teaspoons saffron threads | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 egg yolk | cooked rice
instructions: In a large oven proof skillet, brown chicken wings at low heat for about 15 - 20 minutes, turning once or twice. Remove wings and set aside, reserving pan juices. To skillet, remove fat, add saffron, chili powder and garam masala and cook, stirring often, for 5 - 7 minutes or until fragrant. Add wing juices and mushrooms and continue cooking on low for an additional 15 minutes. Cool. Strain sauce and transfer to a bowl. Whisk egg yolk with 2 tsp. Water and stir into sauce mixture. Place a tight lid on skillet and cook on low heat for about 15 minutes. Serve over rice with additional gravy.

title: Mascarpone Cheese - the Real Mascarpone Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1 cup pimento stuffed olive, diced | 2 tablespoons sherry wine, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Combine the soy milk and chopped olives in a bowl. Stir until incorporated and then let stand for about 10 to 15 minutes. Strain through a sieve lined with 2 layers of saran wrap. Add the marscapone cheese and mix until well blended. Cover and chill until ready to eat. Stir the olive mixture into the cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,pinto bean,romaine lettuce heart,ricotta cheese,hamburger bun,spanish onion
title: Spicy Pinto Bean Burgers
ingredients: 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 6 hamburger buns, toasted | 1 jar pinto beans, rinsed | 1 medium spanish onion, thinly sliced | 2 romaine lettuce hearts, cut into thin strips | 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high.

Random Ingredients: rosemary sprig,broad bean,white wine vinegar,anaheim chili,radish,serrano pepper,white peppercorn,anise seed
title: Aniseed Broad Beans With Chiles And Radishes
ingredients: 1 lb broad bean, about 3 large | 1 small anaheim chili | 5 large radishes | 3 fresh rosemary sprigs | 1 small serrano pepper | 12 small dried red chilies or 12 large anise seed, lightly crushed | 1 teaspoon white peppercorns | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Cut off top third of chile, removing seeds. Wash broad bean and remove stems. Slice broad bean on one side. Seed and finely chop chile. Cut radish in half and thinly slice. Remove seeds from aniseed if you do not like spice. Wash and coarsely chop chile. Wash and coarsely chop rosemary. Cut green or red chilies into 1 inch pieces. Toast peppercorns in a dry heavy small heavy skillet over moderate heat about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until blackened. Immediately transfer to ice cube tray and crush. Combine chile, white pepper, and vinegar in a small bowl and mix well. In a large saucepan with a tight fitting lid, place broad bean and broad bean liquid, chiles, radishes, green or red chile, and rosemary. Add liquid and cook over low heat, partially covered, until the vegetables are very soft, about 2 1/2 hours. Stir beans several times during cooking.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,ketchup,fish sauce,garlic paste,flavor fruit jam,superfine sugar
title: Faux Phirik (Spicy Fruit Sauce for Stir-Fry)
ingredients: 1 package broccoli florets | 3 tablespoons superfine sugar | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce | 3/4 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons light light-flavored flavor fruit jam
instructions: Heat a large wok or skillet over medium heat until very hot. Stir fry the broccoli and sugar, stirring constantly, until tender and lightly browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl and transfer to a bowl. Mix in ketchup, fish sauce, garlic paste, and light flavoring until well combined. Stir in the fruit jam. Allow the sauce to reach room temperature before pouring into hot cooked vegetable bowls.

title: Auntie Lori's Savory Beef on Toast
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled | 2 ounces pancetta, cut into small pieces | 4 ounces cream cheese
instructions: Cut the russet potatoes into small squares. Toss together the potatoes and pancetta using a potato masher. Heat the oven to 400°f spread the cream cheese on a large sheet of foil. Place the potato and pancetta mixture into the center of the cream cheese. Fold up sides of the foil until they're completely wrapped around the beef. Seal the ends and ends with the stringy ends. Place the beef onto the foil covered sheet and place into the oven. Bake on the middle rack for 30 minutes, then turn the oven to broil. When the beef is cooked, the beef should be tender and beginning to brown a little.

title: Chickpeas with Radicchio
ingredients: 1 pound fresh sweet peas | 1 bunch radicchio, leaves cut into 2 x 3 inch pieces
instructions: Rinse the chickpeas under cold water, and pat dry. Place the peas, radicchio, and chickpeas in a pot with enough water to cover.

title: Fish on the Sea Grill
ingredients: 1 head small cauliflower | 1/3 cup salad oil | 4 red snapper | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | fresh ground pepper, to taste | 1/2 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Steam the cauliflower just until it is just starting to soften but does not break. Set aside to cool completely. Cut the head of cauliflower diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces and put into a large skillet with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until just tender, about 8 minutes. While the cauliflower is cooking, place a large saute pan with the salad oil in it over medium high heat. Add the snapper and sear for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the snapper and saute the fish in the hot oil until it is just opaque. Reserve the fish cooking oil. Drain the fillets. Remove the cauliflower from the heat and set aside. Place the cauliflower in a bowl. While the cauliflower is cooking, place 3 spoons of the pesto sauce into a small saute pan at high heat. Simmer until the pepper is very fragrant, but not burned. Remove from the heat and combine well with the pepper. Add the coriander, wine and remaining pesto. Mix well and pour over the fish. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tahini,french vanilla ice cream,fine breadcrumb,monterey jack cheese
title: The Great Afternoon Delight
ingredients: 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | french vanilla ice cream, cut in 6 slices
instructions: In a bowl soak bread crumbs in tahini, stirring lightly. Add cheese and mix well. Place slices of french vanilla ice cream on a platter and sprinkle with the crumb cheese mixture. Serve cold.

title: Vanilla Cream Oyster and Refresher
ingredients: 1 ounce active dry yeast | 7 fluid ounces warm vegetable stock | 7 ounces single cream | 7 ounces vanilla, split | 1 ounce chopped epazote ( cilantro ) ( optional )
instructions: Pour the warm vegetable stock into a large jug and add your yeast on top, then set aside and leave until creamy. Pour the sour cream into a bowl, then pour in the dissolved yeast and cream, then beat with a hand mixer for about 2 minutes or until smooth. Mix in the vanilla and chopped epazote. Drain the oysters and rinse well in cold water to stop them turning brown. Slice the eschalots thin, then use a spoon to divide them amongst the oysters, placing them in four individual dishes for presentation. Cover with cream and sprinkle with additional epazote.

title: Spicy Pear Bread
ingredients: 1 package dry yeast | 1 can small peaches, cut in half, juice reserved | 3 teaspoons cornmeal | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon cornmeal, or as needed
instructions: Measure the yeast into a large mixing with 1 cup of the juice, the peaches, buttermilk, 1 teaspoon of the cornmeal and the asafoetida. Stir gently and thoroughly to mix. Cover and let rise until the dough doubles in size, about 40 minutes. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Dump into a large bowl and add 1 teaspoon of cornmeal, working your way into the dough. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Dump into a bowl, cover and let rise until doubled in size, about 40 minutes. Lightly grease a jelly roll pan with pam. Punch down the dough and divide into 2 equal pieces. Shape into balls and place on the pan. Press and stretch the pieces into a 1 1/2 inch wide round. Cover with a dish towel and let rise until doubled, about 15 minutes. Preheat a grill to high. Bake on the preheated grill until the bread is deep golden brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Chinese Nuts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin, thinly sliced on the diagonal and threaded onto metal skewers ( see note, below for instructions ) | 1 cup walnut oil | sweet chili oil, for dipping
instructions: Prepare grill. Heat 1 cup walnut oil over medium high heat, and quickly add the sliced sirloin. Cook, turning, until dark brown, about 5 - 6 minutes. Transfer meat to warm serving plate and sprinkle with 1 cup of the hot nuts. Serve hot.

title: Dried Beef
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup light sour cream, chilled
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.

title: Dutch Style Skewered Skirt Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks | 1 lb shrimp | 1 cup sauerkraut | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Cut the skirt steak into 3 - 4 pieces. Soak wooden skewers in water for 10 minutes. Rinse the shrimp with cold water, and pat dry with paper towels. Set skewers in a large bowl, and sprinkle with turmeric. Sprinkle sauerkraut with chili flakes, and pat dry. Rub the turmeric into the entire surface, rubbing in with your fingers and palms. Thread about 5 shrimp onto skewers. Grill on hot rack of your grill for 5 - 7 minutes, basting with the kebabs as needed, until the juices run clear.

title: Shrimp Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 lb shrimp, peeled | 1 cup spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 2 tablespoons dry parsley flakes
instructions: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain. Set aside. Rinse shrimp and remove tails. Saute shrimp in a skillet in lemon juice and vanilla for about 2 minutes. Set aside. Stir spaghetti sauce into shrimp mixture and cook for 2 more minutes. Toss with shrimp mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,cooking apple,vegetable shortening,sirloin steak,baby spinach leaf
title: Beef and Apple Pot Pie
ingredients: 6 small sirloin steaks | 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening, melted | 21 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 6 cooking apples, cored and thinly sliced | 1/4 cup light corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Cut steaks diagonally across grain into 1 inch/1 inch diagonal slices. Place in buttered shallow baking pan. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons shortening. Bake in same pan 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Turn on oven to broil. Arrange spinach in single layer on top. Arrange apples on top. Sprinkle with corn flakes. Return to oven. Broil 3 or 4 minutes or until apples are softened. Serve. Beef will be rare in this dish. A minute or two should get away with your standard method of cooking..

title: Rhubarb & Apricot Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/3 cup sliced macadamia nuts | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 3 pieces naan bread or 3 slices bread, toasted
instructions: Cut the rhubarb into 1 pieces and place in medium bowl. Toss with remaining ingredients and serve at room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate chip,baking chocolate,raspberry jam,ritz cracker,tapioca flour,fennel bulb,beef bouillon,white pepper
title: Baked Raspberry Beef Striped Burgers
ingredients: 1 package frozen sliced ritz crackers, not the thin ones | 6 ounces milk chocolate chips | 1/2 cup white pepper | 1/2 cup ground fennel bulb | 1/3 cup ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon beef base | 1/4 cup tapioca flour ( optional ) | 1/4 cup milk chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with no stick spray for ease of cleanup. If freezing, you could prebake them in a bag in advance and put them in freezer. In a medium sized bowl, mix ricotta and fennel together until well blended and blended. You could also use a mixer with a meat mallet to crush the fennel, if you are using it. Add beef stock base and mix well. Add the pepper and mix well. Add the chocolate chips, mix well and set aside. In a large bowl, mix the cheese. Add about a third of the cheese mixture to the meat. Add the final third, mix well and then top with remaining two thirds. You can make these ahead with a couple frozen puddings and freeze when ready to bake. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes at 425 degrees, then turn your oven on broil. If you don't have a sandwich maker just use your bread maker to do this. Let cool a couple minutes before taking out of the oven, so they can warm in the oven. If this would not fit, just cut back on the baking sheet. Serve with your choice of sides.

title: Quick & Easy Radishes
ingredients: 1 medium radish | 1/4 cup water chestnut, chopped
instructions: Peel the radish and cut the stem into 1/2” pieces. In a medium bowl mix the water chestnut and the radish. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Uncover and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,rosemary leaf,tortilla,walnut oil,horseradish root,thyme leaf,iceberg lettuce
title: Walnut Lettuce Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 cup walnut oil, neutral | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1/2 teaspoon horseradish root, minced well | 1 bagged shredded iceberg lettuce or 1 bagged mixed greens, well drained | iceberg lettuce, leaf ( optional ) | tortilla, warmed ( optional )
instructions: In small bowl, combine walnut oil, bread crumbs, thyme, rosemary, and horseradish. Add lettuce and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve or serve as desired.

title: Creamy & Feta Lamb With Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces rotini pasta, dry ( i use tri-colored pasta ) | 6 ounces lamb with kidney ( sliced lamb shoulder may also be used ) | 4 ounces blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 3/4 cup fat-free half-and-half ( i usually use skim ) | garlic powder, to taste
instructions: Brown lamb on all sides in a generous amount of olive oil.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,dark sesame oil,velveeta cheese,red cabbage,broccoli floret,onion soup mix,white fish fillet,white flour
title: Fish 'n' Veggies (Baskets) With Low Fat Cabbage and Chickpeas
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets ( skinless, cut into 4 pieces each with bone in ) | 2 cans chickpeas ( drain liquid carefully ) | 1/2 cup low-fat velveeta cheese | 1 red cabbage ( about 24 small outer leaves ) | 1 cup broccoli floret | 1/3 cup white flour ( optional ) | 1 ounce dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Place fish in a large pot of boiling water and cook for 5 minutes or until just done. Add chickpeas and velveeta and heat on low. Add vegetables and cook for 10 minutes. Blend the soup with the sesame oil in a blender until completely mixed. Add into the soup on low heat and serve with chips or bread.

title: Pineapple-Cilantro Prawns
ingredients: 3/4 cup orange peel, chopped | 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped | 1 jar pineapple tidbits, drained | 8 lime wedges, for garnish
instructions: In a blender or food processor, mix the orange peel, cilantro, and pineapple tidbits until smooth. Transfer to a bowl, and stir in the lime juice. Cover, and refrigerate the mixture for at least 1 hour. Strain the mixture into a resealable bag, and set aside. Refrigerate your prawns while the prawns sit in the marinade. Cook the prawns in a skillet over medium heat until just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. To serve, garnish with lime wedges.

title: Seafood and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cans crabmeat, undrained | 1 egg noodles | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 2 apples, peeled and sliced | 2 cups shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Set the crockpot on to low. Pour the crab meat into the crockpot. Add the noodles, barley, and butter. Set this on high and cook 45 minutes. Stir the vegetables and the egg noodles into the soup then pour over the rest of the soup. Stir in msg. Cook 2 - 3 minutes. Note, this soup tends to turn a deep pinky color if left to stand longer. Serve hot.

title: Easy Chicken Breasts with Raisins and Sherry (Pollo E Sesamano)
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, with about 1/2 cm thick between the bone and skin | 3 -4 tablespoons butter ( or cooking oil ) | 1 1 lb baby shallots or 1 lb yellow onion, peeled and sliced very thinly | 2 cups consomme or 2 cups chicken stock | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1 bunch fresh rosemary sprig, about | 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the butter or oil in a heavy 8 - 10 skillet on medium heat. When it is bubbling furiously, quickly brown the chicken breasts for about 15 minutes on each side, or just until they are brown all over. Set them aside. Add shallots to skillet and lower heat to simmer. Saute until they begin to look translucent and soft. Stir in sauteed shallots and cook 2 minutes, or until shallots are crisp tender. Stir in the consommé and cook over medium heat to reduce somewhat. Stir in oil. Then return the chicken breasts to the pan. Mix in the sesame oil, paprika, a handful of rosemary and raisins. Simmer over medium low heat for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked. Discard the other half of the rosemary. Add more rosemary and raisins if you find your guests have more appetite. Serve over crusty bread.

title: Quick Chocolate Banana Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces chocolate pudding mix | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons cognac | 1/8 cup frozen sliced pimiento | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 2 bananas | 2 cups shredded lettuce
instructions: Prepare the pudding mix according to package directions. Place pimento, cilantro, and banana in a small bowl. Toss with the warm pudding mix. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: bacon grease,quatre epices,salt pepper,pork chop,chili sauce,irish whiskey,sherry wine
title: Irish Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 thick cut pork chops, 1/2 inch thick | salt and pepper, | 3 tablespoons bacon grease | 1/3 cup dry sherry wine | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup bailey irish whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon crushed quatre-epices
instructions: Preheat broiler. Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper. Place in a greased shallow baking pan. Heat bacon grease in a small skillet. Brown chops on both sides, approximately 5 minutes per side.

title: Italian Citrus Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/2 cup olive, sliced
instructions: With a fork, dissolve an orange juice in the orange juice. Add sliced olives and toss. Cover, and refrigerate.

title: Scallop Calfatte
ingredients: 3 kg seedy flourish scallops, in the thinnest section and well-trimmed of heads | 40 g butter or margarine | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 7 cm piece cucumbers, peeled | 6 starfruit zimini ( optional ) or 6 cardamom pods, seeds ( optional ) | 400 g chopped beef or 400 g diced lamb | 2 whole fresh red chili pods, stemmed, seeded finely chopped, or 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place butter in a pan with the chilli powder and bring to the boil. Remove from heat and stir to blend thoroughly. Add the beef or lamb, cucumber and cardamom seeds. Heat until boiling. Stir to mix, stir in a couple of handfuls of the flour, to thicken the sauce. Return to heat and boil rapidly for a further 4 - 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cool. Stir in the chopped red chili. Pour sauce into an attractive serving dish and leave for several hours to dry overnight or up to 3 days. Just before serving, reheat if necessary. To serve remove chilli and season with pepper flakes.

title: Golden Raisin Gnocchi
ingredients: 5 pounds russet potatoes | 1 cup golden raisins ( optional )
instructions: Clean potatoes, and cut each into 4 or 5 slices. Place the sliced potatoes into a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain, and pat dry with a paper towel. Mash potatoes using a fork, then stir in dried fruit. Cook to desired consistency, adding water if necessary. Bring to a boil once more, and then remove from heat. Let dough rest for about an hour to allow flavors to blend. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place gnocchi into the boiling water, and cook until gnocchi floats to the surface, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove gnocchi, and immediately remove from the pot. Drop into cold water for a few seconds, and drain. Serve warm.

title: Easy Cheese Toasted Diced Halushkins
ingredients: 3/4 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 cup veggie sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f and line a 6 x 2 or 9 x 1 1/2 baking sheet. In a food processor or blender, process cheese until finely crumbled. Whip sour cream in a bowl until it holds stiff peaks and stir into cheese. Drop the rounded teaspoonfuls of cheese mixture onto the baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake until tops are golden, stirring once, 15 - 20 minutes. Cool 2 - 3 minutes and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,cake flour,lime zest,red potato,filling,red wine
title: Potato Red Wine Cupcakes
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes, peeled | 3 tablespoons cake flour, sifted | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 12 ounces guinness stout beer | 1 tablespoon dry red wine | filling : | 1/4 cup sourdough beer, luke warm
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line 24 muffin cups with paper liners. Cut potatoes into 12 wedges. Place wedges onto prepared pan. Bake wedges until golden, about 20 minutes. While potatoes bake, combine flour, lime zest, and 1 cup guinness. Mix until a sticky crumb like texture is achieved, about 1 minute. Remove baked potatoes from oven. Brush wedges lightly with beer mixture. Bake wedges until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from pan and spoon with gravy. Top each cupcake with sourdough beer mixture. Serve warm, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,asafoetida powder,dark rum,spring onion white,fennel seed,cauliflower,wonton wrapper,mango chutney
title: Aceh - Spicy Tomato and Fennel Dumplings
ingredients: 1 cup tomato paste | 1 cup fresh tomato chutney | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon fenel candies ( or 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice ) | 1 large cauliflower | 1/2 package wonton wrappers | mango chutney ( see my recipes )
instructions: In a bowl combine tomato paste, chutney, rum, asafoetida and fennel. Core the cauliflower and remove the stem and set aside. Place the cauliflower into a pot of lightly salted boiling water. Cook for 3 minutes and drain. While the cauliflower is cooking, trim around the edge of the cauliflower. This will help cut the more tender the dish. Rinse out the pot and bring the water back to a boil. Add a teaspoon of oil to a skillet and heat on medium. Add in the asafoetida, fennel seeds and pumpkin/vegetables. Stir for about five minutes. Turn off the heat and add the cauliflower, stirring well to coat each piece of fish with the paste mix. If you have trouble filling the fish, you can put in a small casserole and just make sure there is enough water to cover it and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Make sure the cauliflower is well cooked or else it will not absorb the sauce. Take the wonton wrappers and cut off the top and make room for the mixture. Dip each piece in a little eggwash and place in the steaming basket placed over the pan of boiling water, letting them steam for about two minutes, or until they float to the surface. Once cooked drain and serve with mango chutney.

title: Golden Mushroom Cones
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen strawberries, thawed. | 30 ounces condensed golden mushroom soup | 1/2 - 1 habanero pepper, diced or jalapeno peppers, minced ( optional ) | adobo seasoning ( to taste )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350f and grease a bundt pan with cooking spray. In a large bowl wisk together thawed frozen strawberries, mushroom soup, habanero pepper, or if desired, and adobo. Spoon half of the cones into the bottom of the pan and spread evenly. Top with remaining cones and bake for 45 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,black,cucumber,garlic clove,large shrimp,caster sugar,head red cabbage
title: Shrimp Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 medium head red cabbage, shredded | 1 small head red cabbage, shredded | 6 large cooked large shrimp, halved lengthways | 14 ounces tomato sauce | 1/2 cup caster sugar | 5 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/2 cup black, cracked up pulp ( or 1/2 cup chopped fresh black peppercorns )
instructions: Place all the salad ingredients in a large bowl. Combine the sauce ingredients in a small saucepan over medium high heat. Bring to boil and then simmer for 3 minutes. Pour the sauce mixture over the salad and mix well. Leave to cool while you prep the rest of the salad. Drain the shrimp if desired and then run under running water. Rinse and pat dry. Remove the hard core. Using a sharp knife, score a large cross in the top of each cabbage leaf about 1cm deep. Fill the core opening of each leaf with the shrimp and then place the leaves, cut side down, on a lined tray. Bake at 180°c/350°f/gas 4 for 30 - 40 minutes or until the leaves are crispy and transparent. Serve with a fresh salad.

title: Coconut Curry Masala
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons tomato puree | 3 canned chopped chilies, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chilies in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, stirring from time to time, for 5 to 10 minutes, until thickened.

title: Mexican Restaurant Cheese (Caprese)
ingredients: 8 12 ounces goat cheese or 8 ounces mozzarella cheese | fresh mint sprigs | chipotle chile
instructions: Cut cheese into four 6 slices. Wrap a cheese slice around a chipotle pepper.

title: Quick and Easy Black Bean
ingredients: 2 cans black beans in black bean sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon finely grated orange peel | 1/2 - 1 cup shredded fresh snow pea ( if using frozen do not thaw before using ) | 1 -2 tablespoon margarine
instructions: In a skillet, combine beans, cumin and orange peel. Stir over medium heat and cook until hot. Top individual servings with snow peas. Sprinkle with extra cumin or other desired spices if desired.

title: Fish With Tamarind, Tomato and Meat Salad
ingredients: 600 g tamarind pulp or 600 g coriander, rinsed, drained, finely chopped | 400 g diced meat, cooked, thawed if frozen | 600 g finely chopped meat, cooked, thawed if frozen | 4 -8 ripe beefsteak tomatoes | mayonnaise | fruit, slices ( garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the tamarind and coriander and drain well. Drain well. In a bowl mix the meat, mayonnaise and the pulp of the tamarind and coriander in. To serve, line a hot serving dish with foil and spoon meat and pulp onto the foil and drizzle with a little olive oil.

title: Tropical Mushroom, Mango Chutney or Mushroom Hotpot
ingredients: 8 small mangoes, halved and stones removed | 1 sprig fresh chili pepper, deseeded | 1 bay leaf | 12 white mushrooms, halved
instructions: Place all ingredients except mushrooms in a large frypan. Cover and cook over a medium flame for 15 - 20 minutes until thickened and the mushrooms are beginning to burst. Add the mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes or until tender.

title: Ginger Pork or Beef and Roast Pork (Aka Crisp)
ingredients: 1 lb pork or 1 lb beef roast | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot, freshly grated | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Sprinkle freshly grated ginger root over roast or meat. Stir in garlic salt. Place on rack or rack in shallow pan. Turn oven temperature up to 400°f place meat on rack or on rack of an uncovered pan. Roast for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes depending on temperature.

title: Spinach and Caraway
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables | 1/4 cup ghee
instructions: First place your bag of spinach in cold water. After about 1 - 2 hours remove the bag from the water and place bag in a bag of veggies. Add ghee on the veggies and allow them to saute in the microwave for about 10 - 15 minutes. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: vodka,pimento pepper,tuna,asparagus,grain rice,chinese five spice powder
title: Asparagus and Rice Tuna Roulade
ingredients: 12 ounces canned tuna | 3/4 bunch asparagus, trimmed and halved diagonally | 1 pimento pepper, seeded and minced | 2 tablespoons vodka | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 cup long grain rice
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the tuna, asparagus, pimento pepper, vodka and chinese five spice powder. Cook the rice in a pot of boiling water, stirring until no longer cloudy, about 20 minutes. When the rice is done, remove with a strainer, drain, and transfer to individual bowls. Ladle the tuna mixture over hot rice and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,vermicelli,bell pepper,vegetable oil cooking spray,ha avocadoes,kosher salt,mushroom,head cabbage
title: Irish Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cabbage | 2 medium fresh bell peppers, seeded, halved, and cut into thin strips | 1 1/4 cups sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2-inch lengths | 1 medium head of cabbage, cored and separated into leaves | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup chopped peeled avocado | kosher salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the avocado in large bowl. Spray both sides of vinaigrette with oil. Cover. Cover with plastic wrap and refridgerate for 1 hour. Just before serving, season with salt. Garnish with avocado slices.

title: Cranberry Crisps
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1/2 cup minced dried fresh parsley | 1 bag frozen cooked meat, thawed | 1 tablespoon fresh cherries in juice, chopped
instructions: Combine cranberries, margarine, parsley and cherries. Roll 1/4 cup of mixture into a tight ball and press firmly onto the top of a heated ungreased, shallow 1 1/2 inch ovals or cookie sheet. Place in preheated 325 degree oven and bake 25 - 30 minutes or until crisp and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bacon,italian salad dressing,coconut,thyme sprig,self rising flour,peanut,marjoram
title: Crunchy Thyme Fritters
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, chopped | 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup chopped mixed nuts ( unsalted, pecans, hazelnuts ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 1/2 cup shredded dried sweetened coconut | 1/2 cup good italian salad dressing | fresh marjoram ( optional )
instructions: Heat bacon until crisp, but not brown. Add flour, nuts and thyme in a medium bowl, mix well. Add coconut, salad dressing and mix. Roll the mixture into small balls and drop into coconut oil. Cook until golden brown on all sides. They can serve with minted basil or a green salad.

title: Madras Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 ounces button mushrooms, small and cut in half or thirds, depending on size
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet and brown mushrooms well. Remove from skillet and serve.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,tea,spaghetti,cream tartar,asafoetida powder,digestive biscuit,shiitake mushroom
title: Spatjang (Beef Stew With Spices)
ingredients: 1 1/3 kg chuck roast | 2 tablespoons salt | 2 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 2 medium shiitake mushrooms | 1 can light cream of tartar | 1 cup fresh brewed white tea | 2 cups hollow edithic biscuits ( approx )
instructions: Heat oven to 160°c. Tear the shiitake mushrooms into small pieces and put into a pot and sprinkle with 2 tb salt. Let sit for half an hour. Rinse off shiitake mushroom pieces and place them in the soup pot. Dice the chuck roast into small pieces and add to the soup. If soup is too thick, you can add more salt or water. Add 2 tb cream of tartar to soup and let simmer. While the soup is heating, place asafoetida in a bowl and mix with a fork until the asafoetida takes on a nice paste like consistency. Add the shiitake mushroom mixture to the soup and season with salt. Cover, heat and serve at once or put in the fridge and go easy. When you remove the soup from the fridge, garnish with fresh tea and enjoy.

title: Beef Consomme Hotfry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon plain flour | 225 g beef, cut in thin strips | 2 tablespoons beef consomme | 1 tablespoon strawberry jam | pepper
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of the beef and consomme in a pan and simmer for 20 - 30 minutes. Stir in the jam. Taste and season with pepper. Serve in plain glasses.

title: Mummy's Rice cereal
ingredients: 3/4 cup wheat cereal | 2 1/2 tablespoons rice cereal | 1/4 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup chestnuts, chopped | 1/2 cup celery rib, chopped | 1/2 cup salted nuts
instructions: Pulse cereals in food processor til fine. Stir in remaining ingredients except nuts. Spread evenly in buttered 8x8 pan.. Sprinkle on nuts. Bake, uncovered at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 25 minutes or until cereal is firm and topping is golden.

title: Simple Salmon Fillets
ingredients: 2 skinless halibut fillets | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 7 ounces salmon fillets
instructions: Place a piece of aluminium foil in a roasting tin and add a cube of chicken bouillon. Wrap up your parcel and place on top of a microwaveable dish. Put on a high heat and cook for about 6 minutes using 600w. You can use whatever method of fish you want. You can also make your own flavoured broth by placing the whole piece of fish in a pan of boiling water for around 8 minutes. Take off the heat and allow to sit for five minutes. Remove the fish and drain the liquid off of the fish. Cut your fillets into small, bite sized pieces and place into the roasting tin, skin side down. Pour stock into the tin and then cook the salmon for about 10 minutes. Take the foil off the fish and drain off the liquid. Use a hand held blender to puree the salmon into the stock mixture until completely smooth, removing the pieces of fish that haven't been gutted or cut into cubes. Season the salmon with pepper and salt if you are using it.

Random Ingredients: sugar,star anise,russet potato,tabasco sauce,bacon,kaiser,green chilies,kernel corn
title: Spicy Mexican Potato-Corn Burgers With Grilled Green Chilies
ingredients: 2 russet potatoes, peeled ( about 7oz. ) | 2 slices bacon, crisply cooked & crumbled | 3 cans whole kernel corn, drained ( 4-6 ounces ) | 3 tablespoons green chilies, finely diced | 3 drops tabasco sauce ( to taste ) | 2 -3 star anise, whole ( each 2-inch-thick ) | 3 tablespoons granulated sugar | 1 3/4 lbs prepared sandwich buns, such as texas brandy | 1 bag sliced smoked bacon, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Cut unpeeled potatoes crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Place in colander. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes. Drain well. Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a large nonstick, heavy skillet with a lid over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp. Drain bacon on slotted spoon. With slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel lined plate. Increase heat to high and add corn and chiles. Stir fry until heated through but not blackened, about 2 minutes. Drain well, pressing on to drain liquid back into skillet. Cool corn mixture slightly before measuring 1/4 cup reserved corn liquid. Stir the corn mixture into corn in skillet. Sprinkle chiles over corn mixture. Add all other ingredients except the bread slices. Mix well. Shape the mixture into 8 - 5 patties. Lightly oil rack large heavy duty aluminum foil cookie sheet and arrange the bread slices on it. Lightly spray both sides with cooking spray. Sprinkle with salt and remaining 1/4 cup reserved corn liquid. Arrange patties on foil cookies, buttered side down. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or until cold. Place one sheet of baking paper on work surface. Place burgers on baking sheet. Heat grill to medium. Grill burger 2 - 3 minutes per side or until cooked through and no longer pink inside. Transfer to platter and cover with foil. Serve with condiments.

title: Taste for Breakfast
ingredients: 1/3 cup blanched almond, ground in processor | 1/3 cup ground roasted peanuts | 1 lb ground lamb | 1 lb ground turkey pepperoni | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon ground cloves
instructions: Mix everything together. Shape into 1/2 balls and roll in almonds. Bake on cookie sheet in preheated 325 degree oven until tops are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,bean sauce,ham,jalapeno chile,allspice berry,italian sausage link,savory
title: Sausage and Bean Bake (Mujadarra Jollof)
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage links | 1 teaspoon savory, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 package kielbasa, cut lengthwise into 1-inch slices | 1 can baked beans with chiles, undrained | 1 can jalapeno chiles, undrained | 1 can spicy hot bean sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Grease a 9x12 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Cut sausage into 1/2 inch slices. Place sausage in a skillet.

title: Red Pepper Focaccia Gift Mix.
ingredients: 2 cups chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together very well. Form the mixture into small balls slightly smaller than walnut size. Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray and drop the balls onto it. Bake at 450 for 15 minutes or until dry golden brown not brown. Remove and serve.

title: Artichoke Chilie
ingredients: 2 cups ice water | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/3 cup finely chopped carrot | 1/4 cup green chili pepper, diced
instructions: Combine water and artichokes. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,farfalle pasta,chipotle chile,beef bouillon cube,ricotta cheese,premade puff pastry
title: Mimi's Beef and Ricotta Pasta
ingredients: 400 g ground beef bouillon cube | 10 g beef bouillon cube | 8 teaspoons chipotle chiles, powder | 300 g cooked farfalle pasta or 300 g ziti pasta | 1 package premade puff pastry | 500 g ricotta cheese
instructions: Add the beef bouillon and beef broth to ground beef and chipotle. Heat to the boil, then simmer for 25 minutes. Cook farfalle according to instructions on package. Rinse and drain pasta. Cool and crumble when cool. Combine ricotta and chile powder. Add to beef mixture and mix well. Preheat oven to 350of. Lightly brush a little water into the puff pastry. Cut out a circle of pastry about 5 cm diameter and a little bigger than the diameter of your farfalle pasta. Put half the pasta into the pastry circle with the filling. Put another pastry square on top. Cook for 5 - 7 minutes. Turn down oven heat to low. Take the pastry circle and make sure that it is well sealed. Place in a roasting tray. Place 1 tbsp of ricotta in the centre of the farfalle, about 1/4 cup. Put another 2 tbsp ricotta on top of the farfalle until the farfalle is covered in cheese. Repeat above and top with the last 2 tbsp of ricotta. Place the tray under the oven until the cheese is melted. Enjoy.

title: Nori-Sum (Sweet and Sour Chicken Wings)
ingredients: 8 pieces chicken wings, thawed | 1/2 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Arrange the chicken pieces on a baking sheet, and broil, 3 to 5 minutes per side, until chicken is golden throughout.

title: English Muffin Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 4 slices american cheese, cut in 1/8-inch thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a 6 to 8 cup muffin tin with graham crackers, and press crumbs into the holes of the crackers with a fork. Spread half of the cheese over the crackers, and sprinkle the remaining cheese over the cheese. Return to the oven, and bake for 10 minutes, or until top is browned and golden brown. Remove from oven, and let cool slightly. Serve with a slice of toasted rye bread.

Random Ingredients: almond paste,black mustard seed,cream celery soup,deli ham,msg,italian bread
title: French Toast (The Instant Food)
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 tablespoon prepared black mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon msg | 8 slices deli ham | 1/2 ounce almond paste | 8 slices italian bread, toasted
instructions: Mix soup, mustard and msg together. Pour soup mixture over ham slices and top with a few almond paste. Cover with toasted bread slices and dig in.

title: Spaghetti and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 8 ounces canned cut green beans, drained | ground red pepper, to taste | 2 tablespoons soy sauce
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil, and cook pasta to al dente. While water is coming to a boil, toss in green beans, and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. While the pasta is cooking, stir in the soy sauce, and season with a dash of ground red pepper. Drain pasta, and toss with soy sauce and green beans.

Random Ingredients: french fry,coconut cream,lemon peel,pork loin,guacamole,garlic salt,red chili powder,cabbage
title: Fried Pork and Sweet Potato Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 lb loin, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup sweet potato, diced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shredded cabbage | 1/2 cup coconut cream | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, grated | 1/2 teaspoon fresh red chili powder | 1 tablespoon french fries, coarsely grated ( optional )
instructions: Mix filling and marinate 2 hours or overnight. When ready to assemble tacos, heat pan, on medium. Put 1 heaping t. Of filling in center of each. Fold. Serve with your favorite sides.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese (No Mayo)
ingredients: 1 cup skim milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage
instructions: Mix well and set aside. This is optional, but makes a wonderful dish to serve with vegetables. In a medium sized bowl, mix all the above ingredients together. instructions: Mix the coconut, mustard, spring onion and meat together. Put aside. Place the water in a pan, add salt and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup uncooked yellow squash, halved and julienned | 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon rubbed sage | 2 cups beef broth | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 3 tablespoons half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add squash halves in a lg. Bowl and stir to coat. Sauté until just tender. title: Easy Dip from Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 1 can diced red chili peppers, drained | 1 can picante sauce | 1/3 package crumbled feta, or to taste

instructions: Remove the shells and heads from the shrimp, rinse well with cold water, and set the shrimp heads aside. title: Jicama Salad

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. Place onions on sheet of foil. Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and drain. Place jicama over onions.

instructions: Boil the lentils, and cook them a minute or two to allow them to soften a bit. While they are boiling, chop the meat into small bite size pieces. instructions: To prepare the acorn squash, preheat oven to 350&#730.

instructions: Toss the ginger, sugar, chili oil, epazote, and thyme together in a large bowl with 2 tbsp. Of the flour and mix until thoroughly combined. Spread 2 tbsp. instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.

title: Lentil & Vodka Balls (Crock Pot)
