instructions: Place lentils in 4 - 5 quart crock pot. Add vodka to lentils and stir to combine. Cover.

title: Jamaican Bombe Cocktail
ingredients: 2 ounces light soya sauce | 1 teaspoon tomato puree or 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon blue curacao ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon allspice ( optional )
instructions: Combine ingredients and serve in a cocktail glass.

title: Tamarind & Chilie Frijoles
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | 1 cup red wine | 4 tamarind juice
instructions: Soak beans for 2 days at least. Rinse well in cold water, then soak overnight. Drain the beans and place in a covered pot. Add water to cover and bring to a boil. Cover pot with lid and cook over medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes, or until beans are tender. To thicken sauce, remove from heat, stir in reserved cooking liquid and tamarind water. Serve frijoles with salsa.

title: Ground Braised Lamb Wings With Fenugreek
ingredients: 12 chicken wings, cut into 2 pieces | 1 1/2 pounds ground lamb | 1 teaspoon ground thyme leaves, divided | 1 tablespoon ground cumin, divided | 1 teaspoon crumbled dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon milk
instructions: Combine the lamb, 1/4 cup of ground thyme, 1 teaspoon of cumin, fenugreek, sage, confectioners' sugar, and milk in a large zip top plastic bag. title: Beefy Rice Braid
ingredients: 1 whole sirloin, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1 1/2 cups short-grain brown rice | 1 jar pimientos | 1 cup dark raisins | 1/2 cup almonds, blanched and skinned | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 package frozen miniature phyllo pastry sheets, thawed | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling, salted water, cook rice for 8 minutes, or until grains are tender. Drain and cool. Meanwhile, brown sirloin in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Drain on a paper towel lined plate. Stir pimento into rice until mixed and heated through.

Random Ingredients: spice,tomato puree,chili paste,lime juice,red onion,chicken,poblano chile
title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup chili paste | 1 red onion, chopped | 1 poblano chile - stemmed, seeded, and chopped | 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken pieces - cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon spice | 1 can tomato puree
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, stir together the lime juice, chili paste, red onion, poblano pepper and chicken. Sprinkle the spice over and stir to blend. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 12 hours. In the refrigerator, stir in the tomato puree. Transfer to a crock or heavy pot, heat and stir.

title: Puff Puffs
ingredients: 375 g puff pastry | 2 teaspoons chili bean paste ( chili paste ) | 170 g creme fraiche ( or light sour cream ) | chili beans or tomato sauce, to dip
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Roll out the puff pastry onto a lightly floured baking tray approx 12 x 3 inches. Trim the edges, if necessary, to cover the pastry. Place the puff pastry in the freezer for 30 minutes or up to one week. Turn the pastry out onto your baking trays and gently prick the pastry all over with a fork. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until firm. Remove from the oven and cool slightly. Using a tablespoon or a small piece of the pastry, spread the softened chillies over the base of a small bowl. Spoon the creme fraiche into a serving bowl, and fill with hot chili bean or tomato sauce. Top with the puff pastry and drizzles with a little cream or creme fraiche as you like.

title: Saag Pan-Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups leftover fried mixed chopped vegetables ( see tips ) | 1 cup cabbage ( shredded ) | 3 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | white onion ( finely chopped ) | 3 cups broccoli florets, blanched
instructions: Heat oil or ghee in a deep, heavy fryer to 350° f. Fry the vegetables. Remove from pan and keep hot. Melt the ghee in the same pan, add the flour and fry well. Add the onion and fry until golden brown. Add a teaspoon of water to loosen the raw flour from the sides. Add broccoli, cover and steam for 5 minutes. Remove cover and stir fry until done. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Scottish Sultana Cake
ingredients: 2 cups sultanas | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c line a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll tin with baking paper. Place sultanas in a small saucepan and warm together. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla. Pour into prepared jelly roll tin. Bake for 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Dynamite Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice | 1 clove garlic
instructions: Put everything in one in a blender or food processor and mix on high until smooth.

title: Lime Smoked Ears (Mock Wood Wood)
ingredients: 4 woody brown mushrooms | 2 lime wedges ( to rim glass )
instructions: Remove any hard stems from the mushrooms, discard the woody leaves and any loose woody centers. You should have about eight woody stalks. Cut the mushrooms into halves lengthwise. Discard the stems. Pour the oil into a frying pan large enough to hold the mushroom halves in a single layer. Bring to a boil over high heat. Add the mushroom halves, reduce the heat to low, and simmer, turning several times with a small spatula or wooden spoon, until the mushrooms have softened and are beginning to curl up around the edges, about 12 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the mushrooms to a platter, and keep warm over low heat. Remove the lime wedges from the pan to drain them. Cut the stalks into three or four pieces. Spoon one cup of the mushroom soaking liquid into a small sieve set over a large bowl. Spoon one more cup of the mushrooms soaking liquid into the sieve along with the lime wedges. Remove the sieve, and discard the empty mushroom cooking liquid. Mash the mushroom pulp until it is as smooth as you like your flavored oil. Makes about 3/4 cup of the soaking liquid. Store in the refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Sweet & Sour Cabbage
ingredients: 1 bag frozen white cabbage | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 4 tablespoons tarragon | 4 tablespoons catsup
instructions: Cut cabbage into shreds & place on a cookie sheet lined with paper towel. Mix remaining ingredients plus sugar in a saucepan. Heat to boiling then reduce & simmer for 2 minutes. Cool before pouring over cabbage.

title: Aussie Eggplant (Aubergine) Chips
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers, sliced | 2 large eggplants, sliced | 2 tablespoons flour, or as needed | 1 tablespoon minced onion | 3/4 cup sauerkaze | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, or to taste | 2 cans pasta, such as vermicelli, broken in half | 2 tablespoons minced onion, for topping
instructions: Preheat grill for medium high heat. Coat with cooking spray. Place bell peppers and eggplant on grill, and roast until the pepper begins to soften, and eggplant slices are beginning to soften, about 5 minutes per side. Allow eggplant to cool, then slice the peppers and eggplant into thin strips. Spread strips onto a shallow baking sheet. Bake, still hot, in the preheated oven until the slices are beginning to show grill marks, about 10 minutes. Cook eggplant slices in a skillet with a splash of water over medium heat, turning once, until they are lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Place roasted pepper strips on a plate to keep warm. Heat 1/3 cup sauerkaze in a pan over medium heat, and allow it to simmer, stirring occasionally, until the flavors have blended and the sauce has reduced, about 10 minutes. Stir in ground allspice, parsley, and cooked pepper strips. Top the chips with the sauce that simmered on the top.

title: Homemade Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup ground green pepper, finely chopped
instructions: In small bowl, stir together mayonnaise, ground green pepper and chopped vegetables. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Low Fat Taco Bites II
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix taco sauce and orange peel together in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat until boiling. Pour hot sauce mixture into a bowl and stir until smooth.

title: Pinchu Moruno
ingredients: 1 ounce semisweet chocolate syrup ( or more if desired ) or 1 ounce chocolate syrup ( or more if desired ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder ( i use `` accent '' brand )
instructions: Warm chocolate covered syrups in a microwave for one minute, or until melted. Stir in turmeric. Cool completely, then pour into a clean glass jar. Store in refrigerator.

title: Cremini Mushroom Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs beef stew meat or 1 3/4 lbs sirloin beef, cut into chunks | 1 can stewed tomatoes, with juice | 1/2 cup tomato ketchup | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 can whole baby potatoes, drained
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet cook beef over medium high heat until browned, stirring to brown evenly, about 5 minutes. Add stew tomatoes, tomato ketchup, brown sugar and thyme.

title: Szechuan Asparagus with Noodles

instructions: Place asparagus in a large wok with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, and cook until asparagus is tender and bright green.

title: Cauliflower Chocolate Apple Pancake

instructions: Chop off the stalk of the cauliflower and discard the outer leaves. Cut out the core and slice the rest. Wash and steam the cauliflower for about 5 minutes or until tender. Cut the head in to florets, then slice the cauliflower thickly. Set aside. Cut the pear in small pieces about 1/2 cup. Set aside. Combine the white pepper and cocoa powder to taste in a small mixing bowl. Whisk until smooth then set aside. Place the flour in a medium bowl. Add the white pepper cocoa mixture, the cauliflower, and then the pear slices. Make a well in the center then add the white pepper cocoa mixture. Make a well in the center and add the cocoa mixture. Keep stirring, then you have a delicious crust, but not too wet to stir. You may need to add a tablespoon of water if the dough is too dry.

title: Simple, Delicious Spanish Pistachio Rounds

instructions: Preheat a large skillet over moderate heat. Add the meat, ham, baking soda, garlic salt and half each of the vegetable seasoning.

instructions: Preheat your oven to 425°. In a small baking dish, combine the cream, peppers, and turmeric. Mix well. Bake for 20 minutes, or until peppers are tender. Serve on plates with a drizzle of paprika on top.

title: Eggplant Chips

Place a single layer of foil on top of the eggplant so that it ends up covering the eggplant. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Turn oven to 400°f and bake an additional 20 minutes, or until the skin of the eggplant chips is crisp and is golden brown and soft. Remove the foil, and bake an additional 20 minutes, or until the eggplant chips are crispy and lightly browned. Serve warm. title: Zinfandel Blossoms

instructions: Mix zinfandel with pine nuts. Serve in a small glass dessert dish, sprinkled with additional toasted pine nuts.

title: Fritters on the Run

instructions: Spread pepperoni on tortillas. Roll up tortillas with toothpick. Sprinkle sambhar on top of tortillas. Eat and enjoy.

instructions: Cook rigatoni according to directions until just tender, drain and set aside. Meanwhile combine pumpkin and kaffir lime leaves in a bowl. title: Spaghetti with Sesame Beef

title: Baked Chicken Wings

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Lay out one piece of dough onto a clean work surface. Place the dough between sheets of waxed paper and roll out so it fits the baking sheet. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 50 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown.

title: Chilled Mushrooms

instructions: Combine everything except the mushrooms in a nonreactive bowl and refrigerate overnight. Let sweat on the grill for 12 - 15 minutes. Turn the mushrooms over and let sweat for more 7 minutes. Turn off the grill. Using a spatula, loosen the mushrooms out of the liquid. Place the mushrooms on a plate and garnish with green salad dressing or cucumbers. Serve warm.

instructions: Place potatoes in sauce pan. Add chicken soup and chilies, stirring as you pour juice and apple juice into potatoes. Cover and place in 350 degree oven and cook for 1 hour.

title: Turkey, Turkey and Mango Salad
ingredients: 6 turkey fillets | 8 -10 pieces deli turkey ( from the deli ) | 5 slices mango | 8 -10 pieces red leaf lettuce ( can also use bibb lettuce ) | mango, slices | bay leaf | bouquet garni or basil
instructions: Slice turkey fillets approximately 1/4 on each side, then place in salad bowl or other large serving container. Sprinkle with a mixture of herbs and sauces from the turkey containers, if using. Place your mango slices in the centre of the bowl, then pour on the turkey slices and turkey slices. Add torn red leaf lettuce. Arrange the turkey slices around the salad and serve hot or cold. Note, the salad can also be served on the side.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,spice,lime,mozzarella ball,soba noodle,taco sauce,sunflower seed,green pepper
title: Tzimus’s Mexican Noodle Salad With Mozzarella
ingredients: 1 package soba noodles | 1/2 medium red cabbage, sliced paper thin | 1 green pepper, sliced paper thin | 14 ounces taco sauce ( or your fav. brand ) | 1 tablespoon spice, advieh ( indian spice blend ) | 8 1/2 ounces smoked mozzarella balls ( or 2 to 6 slices of deli cheese, shredded or sliced into strips and mixed ) | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds, toasted lightly | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Cook soba noodles and remove to warm bowl. Meanwhile sauté vegetables in reserved olive oil, add seasoning and mix together. Toss with cooked soba noodles and then top with mozzarella. Garnish with toasted sunflower seeds. Note, you can also add cooked white rice to the finished salad and add the taco sauce or any sauce you prefer. The recipe can easily be doubled or tripled/multiplied. You can also serve this with other dishes such as rice and beans, but i prefer napa cabbage for an extra kick.

title: Maple Syrup-Glazed Caramel Tomatoes (Microwave)
ingredients: 1 pint maple syrup | 1 cup pure maple syrup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a glass bowl. Microwave on high power level 3 minutes. Stir and pour into a glass jar or jar/jar. Let stand 2 days, stirring every now and then, shaking the jar/jar daily.

title: Green Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 7 lbs stew meat | 6 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and chopped | 1 green bell pepper, seeded, deveined and chopped ( vino delicata )
instructions: Bury the roasted chiles with the back of a spoon or with some metal skewers. Grind them coarsely. Place in a large kettle with the bell pepper. Bring to a boil and cook, uncovered, until the sauce has completely reduced to a thick paste. Place the stew in a crock pot and add the chile paste and continue cooking. The meat is done when it falls of the pinky top. Stirring occasionally.

title: Thai Veggie Ravioli (Veggies)
ingredients: 4 ounces frozen cheese ravioli, thawed | 4 cups mixed zucchini, sliced | 1 cup avocado | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf | 3 teaspoons cardamom ( i used pared, ground cardamom ) | 2 ounces ramen noodles ( i used yakisoba brand )
instructions: Cook ravioli according to package directions and drain. Place zucchini and avocado in a bowl. Add cilantro leaves and cardamom. Drain well and add noodles. Toss gently until evenly mixed. Serve immediately. Variation, if using the cheese ravioli, you can also add 1/2 tsp curry powder to the mixture instead of the ramen noodles.

title: Potato Mushroom Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw potatoes, peeled, quartered, sliced thin | 1 spanish onion, peeled and sliced into rings | 1/4 cup fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems removed
instructions: Place potatoes into a large saucepan and cover with salted cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Place onion slices into a strainer over a bowl, then shake out excess moisture by scraping the slices. Combine potato slices, mushroom caps, and reserved potato water in crockpot. Cook on low for about 1 hour. Remove from low heat, and stir in green onion rings. Serve.

Random Ingredients: sprinkle,red chili pepper,green olive,garam masala,irish whiskey,adobo seasoning
title: Spicy Irish Martini
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 ounces irish whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1/4 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon chopped red chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon chopped green olives | 1/4 teaspoon powdered hot cocoa ( `` or '' green colored candy sprinkles )
instructions: Add 2 tsp of oil to a cocktail shaker with some of the whiskey or milk stirred. Shake, and add all ingredients to the shaker. Shake, and pour into a martini glass using a funnel. Serve on a hot, fresh hot pepper with a hint of coriander.

title: Spicy Lentils and Apples With Apples and Kiwi
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lard or 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1/2 cup lentils | 1 cup apples, peeled, cored & diced | 1 medium apple, peeled and diced | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and diced ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon moroccan mixed spice, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/moroccan-spice-mix-with-the-apple-dish-227656 '' > moroccan spice mix with the apple dish < /a > | 6 ladyfingers ( optional ) | 1/2 cup queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Cook lentils, heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Cook apples & kiwifruit in heated oil for 5 minutes. Stir in spice mix & lentils. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium low, cover & simmer for 15 minutes. Remove lid & cook for further 5 minutes. Remove from heat & serve.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,fruit,quatre epices rabelais seasoning,beef bouillon,tart apple,basmati rice,pesto sauce
title: Apple-Pesto Neck Bones and Dried Fruit
ingredients: 1 cup pesto sauce ( or to taste ) | 8 ounces dried tart apples, chopped | 8 ounces lean pork loin, cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons quatre-epices ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried fruit ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon ( or to taste ) | cooked basmati rice
instructions: Combine the pesto and apples in a bowl. Add the pork and spices, and stir. Dissolve the bouillon in the hot water if using. Add the meat and mix gently, coating the chicken and pork. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours. Cook the rice according to package directions. Serve meat and sauce over rice and sprinkle with parsley if desired.

title: Kielbasa Roll
ingredients: 4 ounces italian sausage | 1 1/2 quarts quarts mexican blend cheese | 1 1/4 cups quark | 1 cup rum | 2 tablespoons dried epazote leaves | 2 teaspoons mexican cheese
instructions: Brown italian sausage and remove from pan. Saute quark and rum until melted. Drain sausage. Add to cheese and mix. Roll into small, cigar shaped sausage shapes. Add 1 tbsp dried epazote and roll on all sides. Chill until hard. May be eaten on the side with pickled beans or use as a sandwich filling.

title: Sopa Seca de Picadillo (Pork Sopa Seca)
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder, with bone | 4 -5 scallions, finely chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup scallion tops ( for color ) | 1 teaspoon serrano pepper ( chopped )
instructions: The day before cooking, put the pig shanks in cold water, then bring to a strong boil and skim off scum from top. Let the shanks simmer slowly until tender about 3 to 4 hours, skimming and discarding the scum which rises to the top as it cooks. Remove the shanks from the water, remove the bone and scallions and discard. Set the pig shanks aside and keep warm. Strain the soup through a sieve, reserving cooking water. Strain off any scum that rises to the top and discard. Add scallions. Return strained cooking liquid to a boil, add chopped chiles and cook about 5 minutes. Slice pork very thinly across the grain and return to simmering soup. Cook about 1/2 hour. Stir well and serve topped with chopped scallions.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,duck breast,great northern bean,ice water,beef bouillon cube,pepper
title: French 75 Chicken
ingredients: 1 duck breast | 3 1/2 cups ice water, divided | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | pepper
instructions: Remove skin and excess fat from duck breast and cut meat into 1/2 inch pieces. Place in large pot, add 1 1/2 cups water and bouillon cubes. Over high heat, bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add beans, reduce heat to low and continue cooking for 15 - 20 minutes or until chicken is just cooked through, stirring well to prevent burning. Add pineapple, taste, and add pepper if necessary. Serve with bread, egg noodles.

Random Ingredients: coriander sprig,coffee,chili oil,monterey jack cheese,picante sauce,cheese
title: Mexican Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil | 8 -10 fresh coriander sprigs, washed and picked through | 2 tablespoons instant coffee | 1 -2 ounce monterey jack cheese, grated | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, grated ( or cheese of choice )
instructions: Place the chili oil in a medium pan. Place over medium heat until the oils have a medium aroma. Add the coriander and quickly stir to coat the leaves in the hot oil. Let the coriander steep for about a minute and then remove the sprigs. Add the coffee and stir until well mixed. Cook for about 1 minute. Remove from heat, add the grated cheese, stir to combine. Serve immediately and make sure to have lots of napkins ready for the mouth once everything is blended together.

title: Moroccan-Style Orecchiette
ingredients: 6 ounces orecchiette | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 scallions, minced
instructions: Boil salted water. Add pasta and stir to separate. Meanwhile, sauté scallions in a fry pan with small amount of oil until soft. Add ginger garlic paste, stir for a few seconds. Add coriander and stir until it wilts. Drain pasta and stir to combine.

title: Sauerkraut Filled French Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 1 inch slices | 1 1/2 cups sauerkraut, drained
instructions: Arrange the bread slices on a cutting board, and sprinkle with a little water. Place a spoonful of sauerkraut into the middle of each slice of bread. Place the french toast in a 400 degree oven, and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Chile Chicken (Pollo Con Salsa Verde)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken, cut into pieces | 1 can green beans, cut in halves | 1/2 cup chopped roasted green chili pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Put all ingredients into a baking dish, pour enough hot water over the chicken to cover and bake for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,skor english toffee bit,hot paprika,velveeta cheese,daikon radish,butter,cumin powder,chocolate
title: Danish Ttoffee Sandwich
ingredients: 12 ounces velveeta cheese | 12 ounces hot paprika | 10 ounces hot spanish-style toffee bits ( i used a bit less, and because it's sooooooo sweet, i decided to add it ) | 1/4 cup butter, melted | 16 ounces sourdough tortillas | 8 ounces daikon radishes, sliced | 1 3/4 ounces unsweetened chocolate, diced ( use ghirardelli's unsweetened chocolate chips, if you can't find ghirardelli's, if you can't find ghirardelli's, you can use a milk chocolate, if not use nutmeg, if you can't find ghirardelli's ) or 1 3/4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, melted ( use ghirardelli's unsweetened chocolate chips ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Butter a 15x10x1 jellyroll pan. Slice velveta in 1/4 inch slices. Spread toffee bits on pan. Arrange half of sliced cheese over chips. Cover with half of sliced beef.

Random Ingredients: bouillon cube,rose petal,snow pea pod,vinegar,cream,salt,hamburger,star anise
title: Stuffed Shiitake Mushrooms a la Ramambique
ingredients: 300 g finely minced hamburger | 100 g snow pea pods, finely sliced | 4 cups finely chopped fresh shiitake rose petals | 1 bouillon cube | 4 tablespoons vinegar | 5 tablespoons sour cream | 1 star anise | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Combine the finely diced ham and snow pea pods in a large mixing bowl and mix well. Season with water until the mixture just makes a small amount but holds its shape. Dice the finely diced button mushroom. Add the worcestershire sauce, bouillon cube, vinegar, star anise and salt and mix gently. Spoon into the capsids and place into a small pan large enough to hold all the mushrooms. Set the mushrooms on a plate. Serve in a warm bowl.

Random Ingredients: grain wild rice,club soda,serrano pepper,egg bread,maple syrup,kielbasa sausage
title: Easy Sausage Bread and Rice Breakfast Skillet
ingredients: 15 ounces club soda, light, divided use | 2 kielbasa sausages, cooked and crumbled | cooked long grain and wild rice blend, drained ( such as arugula or bok choy ) | 4 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1 1/2 cups prepared scrambled egg bread, slices toasted ( such as pita )
instructions: Preheat your broiler. In a large bowl, mix 1/2 cup Club Soda with 1 1/2 cups cooked rice, sausage, cooked rice and eggs. Divide among 4 greased texas toast or pita loaf pans, cover with foil and set aside. Prepare grill. In a small saucepan, heat maple syrup and remaining 1 1/2 cups Club Soda to boiling. Divide eggs, maple syrup and scrambled egg among 4 bread each. Serve warm accompanied by salsa and guacamole. To broil on a gas grill, place the breads 2 inches from the heat, cut side up, top each with about 3 tablespoonfuls egg mixture. Broil for 3 to 4 minutes, or until edges are puffed and golden.

title: Polish Sausages with Turnips and Turnips
ingredients: 1 pound polish sausage | 1 pound turnips, unpeeled and chopped | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon distilled white vinegar ( optional )
instructions: Place sausage in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium heat until the surface of the sausage is a light brown, about 10 minutes. Turn sausage over and cook until evenly browned, about 10 minutes more. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center will read 160 degrees f. Stir in sugar, vinegar and turnips. Cover and keep warm over low heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer until sausage is tender, about 1 hour.

title: Nigerian Piri Piri Chutney
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and chopped | ice water | 1 cup salted peanuts, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup sweet wine
instructions: Place fennel seed in a small skillet over medium low heat and cook until aromatic, about 5 minutes. Remove the fennel seeds from the pan, and grind into a fine powder. Stir the ground fennel powder into the ice water in the skillet and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute while stirring constantly. Gently stir in peanuts and sweet wine. Remove from heat. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,kaffir lime leaf,quinoa,cream chicken soup,rye flour
title: Quinoa and Chilies Dip
ingredients: 400 g cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup red chilies or 1/2 cup green chili, chopped | 120 g quinoa, soaked in water and drained | 2 kaffir lime leaves, sliced | 1/2 cup rye flour
instructions: Blend cream of chicken soup, chillies, quinoa, kaffir lime leaves in a blender until well mixed. Pour into a bowl. Serve with crudites.

title: Chinese five Spice Powder
ingredients: 12 cloves | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan. Pierce the cloves with a fork. Place the spices, in the pan and cook on low heat for about 5 minutes. Scoop the spices on to a serving plate. Store the spices in an airtight container. Note, you can also use 1/2 tblsp to 1/8 tsp of ground ginger and 1/8 tsp with poultry or beef. The flavor of your chinese spices has no definite amount of seasoning.

title: Barbecue Pork (For a Pork or Beef Filling)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons baking powder
instructions: Place pork in a large bowl. Add barbecue sauce, baking powder, and mix well. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 400°f. Line the bottom of a 8x8x2 inch baking pan with foil. Pour pork mixture in baking pan. Add 1 1/2 cups of water. Bake 15 minutes or until cooked. Use a spoon to spread the drippings over the top. Serve.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,self raising flour,pumpkin puree,nonfat cream
title: Gram's Pumpkin and Rice Scones
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain rice, uncooked ( sushi rice ) | 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 4 cups self-raising flour | 1 can pumpkin puree, plus extra ( or equal amount of plain )
instructions: Put the rice, sour cream and ¾ cup of water into a large bowl. Stir to combine and add the flour until the mixture resembles a sticky dough. Turn onto a floured surface and knead lightly until smooth. Cover and leave in the fridge for 30 minutes or until it has rested. Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface until thin and about ¾ inch thick. Cut into two 8 x 4 squares and place on a tray with a knob of butter on top. Brush a 1½ inch border with water. Spread ½ cup of pumpkin or puree over half of the scones and pinch the edges to seal. Repeat with the rest of the scones. Preheat oven to 400ºf. Spray a large baking tray with vegetable spray. Brush the scones with water. Working quickly, lightly push the scones into the heated baking tray, bake for 15 minutes, turn, and bake for a further 10 minutes or until golden. Serve warm, cut into squares with a knife.

title: Spice Sushi..
ingredients: 1 can rotel ( hot delish ) | 1 can prunes
instructions: Put the can of rotel and prunes into an electric food processor. Pulse the mixture into 1 inch chunks. You can also use a food processor, but it won't be nearly as smooth. The idea is not to get it to form into a uniform uniform block once you get the hang of it. Put the mixture in a sealable container on the counter, and refrigerate it for at least one hour. It will be ready in about a week.

title: Pesto Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar prepared pesto sauce | 1/2 bunch fresh basil leaves
instructions: Prepare the pesto sauce by placing a heavy cast iron skillet over medium heat. When there is a strong shake of the pan and immediately adding pesto. The pesto will foam up and the sauce will be cloudy. Remove the skillet from the heat and pour in the pesto mixture. Tear the basil leaves into small pieces and stir to combine, then stir in until blended. Serve warm.

title: Jicama and Smoked Jicama Swirl
ingredients: 15 5/8 ounces packages dry yeast | 1 - 1 1/4 cup warm dry chunky salsa | 2 1/2 - 3 cups very ripe medium sicama ( about 12 oz ) or 2 1/2-3 cups very ripe medium jicama, diced ( about 12 oz ) | 5 1/2 ounces smokey smoked papayas ( about 12 oz ) | 16 ounces v8 vegetable juice cocktail ( not evaporated ) or 16 ounces chunky salsa ( not evaporated ) | 1 dash cayenne ( optional, if you add ) | chunky salsa ( i use pace mild ) | vanilla yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water in large bowl. Add salsa and beat well. Stir in sicama. Let stand in a warm place about 10 minutes. Place in lightly oiled 13 x9 inch baking pan. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let rise in warm place about 1 hour. Turn oven temperature to 350 degrees. Remove pan cover with plastic wrap and bake 40 - 60 minutes or until knife inserted into center comes out clean. Place cooked pastry on rack to cool. Filling, combine all ingredients well and spoon into pastry lined baking dish. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Uncover pan and bake 25 - 30 minutes longer or until crust is medium and filling is hot and filling bubbling. Serve with toppings or with a dollop of fresh soft unstrained vanilla yogurt.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,bean,pace picante sauce,cumin powder,salt pork,swiss cheese,fine sea salt,pork sausage
title: Tex Mex Bean Dip
ingredients: 3 lbs swiss cheese | 3 lbs swiss cheese ( for the dip and topping ) | 1 can refried beans | 1 jar pace picante sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 -3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1 1/2 lbs pork sausage ( for the filling )
instructions: The original recipe says to remove the sausage from the casings, remove any sausage visible. Soak the casings in water to prevent browning, drain and put in a crockpot. Brown the sausages until nicely charred. Put the beans in the crockpot. Cut the swiss into 1/4 inch slices, put on top of the beans. Add the jar of picante sauce, worcestershire sauce, cumin and sea salt. Add the sausage. Mix well.. Cook on low for 4 - 5 hours. If it doesn't make the top layer of cheese, you can put the top layer on and let it cook on low for 3 - 5 hours. Serve with chips for dipping or with tortilla chips for dipping. This is the first recipe i have used. This dip is great on a hot summer day too. You make your own corn chips and place on the hot plate, dip in the hot chips and serve with whatever toppings you like. This is great if made in advance, refrigerated and reheated the next day.

Random Ingredients: chicken flavor bouillon,ginger root,leek,asiago cheese,confectioner sugar
title: Ginger-Garlic Paste
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh ginger root, peeled and grated | 2 leeks, white parts and darkest green parts only, thinly sliced | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 3 tablespoons shredded asiago cheese | 1 2/3 cups confectioners'sugar
instructions: Combine grated ginger, leeks, garlic, and asiago cheese in a plastic ziploc bag. Marinate in refrigerator overnight. Remove ginger garlic mixture and discard. Mix in the confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: thyme,egg wrap,picante sauce,self rising flour,beet,green bean,vegetable broth,onion soup mix
title: Spicy Egg Rolls
ingredients: 32 fluid ounces vegetable broth or 32 fluid ounces chicken broth | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 jar picante sauce | 10 fluid ounces vegetable broth or 10 fluid ounces chicken broth | 1/2 lb fresh green beans | 1/4 lb fresh cut beet | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 12 large egg roll wraps
instructions: In large pot, heat first eight ingredients to boiling.

title: The Mexican Food Chopped - Salsa
ingredients: 3/4 cup chicken stock | 2 ripe poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup yoghurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander | 1 teaspoon black vinegar
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine chicken broth and poblano chiles. Cover and simmer over low heat until tender, about 10 minutes. Remove the poblanos and set aside. Place the wine and yoghurt in a small bowl. Stir in the coriander, vinegar and half the poblanos. Stir mixture well and remove from heat. Add the other poblano chiles and season with salt. Top with remaining poblanos. Serve immediately.

title: Thai Watermelon Salad
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts | 2 tablespoons pickle ( pickled ) | 4 cups watermelon, cubed | 1/2 cup tamari ( or soy sauce ) | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1/4 cup corn oil ( or peanut oil )
instructions: In a large bowl, add all the other ingredients and mix. Serve.

title: Barbecued Hot Peppered Beer(ATK)
ingredients: 1 can beer | 1 prepared horseradish spread or ( 4 ounce ) prepared sweet potato salad dressing | 3 celery ribs, halved ( about half a small head ) | 3 -4 teaspoons hot pepper flakes
instructions: Rinse and dry the hot pepper flake or hot sauce. Combine beer, horseradish spread or salad dressing and celery in a saucepan. Stir over medium heat until heated through and bubbly. Do not boil. Place celery on a sheet pan and cover or the pan tightly with foil. Bake on bottom rack of preheated 250 degrees fahrenheit oven 45 - 60 minutes or until it is brown on celery. Remove celery from grill and discard the skin and any pieces of celery that are not transparent. Cut celery into bite sized pieces and drizzle with beer.

title: Chicken and Pork Tenderloin, New Zealand
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 12 -20 fresh tea leaves | 2 green peppers, deseeded, sliced | 3 oranges, peel of | 4 slices fresh pork loin, cooked
instructions: Cut pork tenderloin into 8 equal pieces, each piece approx 2 thick. Slice each piece between 4 pieces of plastic wrap. Put 1 piece of pork on each piece of pork, ensuring each is completely covered with the pork so that they cook on the grill. Push a tea leaf between the meat and the pork at each end. Place peppers, orange peel, and pork on the grill over direct medium to high heat. Grill for 6 - 8 minutes per side, depending on thickness of pork and the heat from the meat. Remove from grill and place on platter. Serve with yoghurt and salad. Tip,. If serving in advance, allow the meat to cool slightly before carving and slicing thinly. Serve with horseradish, or horseradish sauce as a dip or accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,black sesame seed,salmon fillet
title: Asian Spice Rub
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons black sesame seeds | 3 teaspoons fresh smoked salmon fillet
instructions: Combine sesame oil, black sesame seeds, and smoked salmon in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,green chili pepper,romaine lettuce,red potato,spring onion,fenugreek seed,shrimp paste,sunflower oil
title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 200 g red potatoes, cooked | 200 g green cabbage, shredded | 1 -2 green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 50 g raw shrimp paste | 2 -3 spring onions, chopped | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 romaine lettuce, shredded | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Combine the salad ingredients and chill for 2 hours or overnight. Just before serving add the shrimp paste to the potato salad. Stir in the spring onions. Chill.

title: Smooth and Colourful Mango Barley Quinoa
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried pearl barley | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup spinach leaves
instructions: Combine the grains and water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid and simmer until the liquid has been absorbed and the grains are tender, about 40 minutes. Remove the lid, stir, and let stand for 10 minutes.

title: Steak and Basil Stir Fry
ingredients: 500 g steak, cut into strips | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves | 1/4 cup cornflour, mixed with | 1 -2 tablespoon water
instructions: Remove any fat from the steak strips, using a sharp knife to cut the long way down the centre, then gently lift the meat into a large bowl. Add the basil leaves and mix well. Add the steak strips, tossing to coat evenly. Stir in the cornflour mixture and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Cook as you like, stirring occasionally, for about 20 - 25 minutes, tossing half way through. Serve as a snack.

title: Roasted Corn
ingredients: 1 can or bottle dry red wine | 3 ears corn, shucked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a sheet pan with aluminum foil and place on the foil. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the wine and corn shucked. Bring to a simmer, then remove from heat. Open the foil and distribute the corn on the center of the foil. Place the foil in the oven and bake for 25 minutes. Open the foil and continue basting every 15 minutes for an additional 15 minutes to evenly brown the corn.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,sesame seed,garlic salt,chili pepper,tart apple,bay leaf,beet,multigrain bread
title: Spicy Spiced Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 jar beets, peeled, sliced in halves and cooked | 1/8 cup sesame seeds ( black ) | 2/3 cup unbleached bread, crust removed, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/4 cup tart apple, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon chili pepper | 1 teaspoon unbleached cane syrup or 1 teaspoon chili powder | 2 teaspoons grated garlic salt | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Note, can be served the day before. This recipe makes enough dressing for 1 large salad. Add the remaining ingredients into the bowl of a food processor or blender and process until just smooth. Place beets in a large bowl and add dressing. Toss. Let sit for 20 minutes at room temperature before serving.

title: Kumquat and Apricot Samosas
ingredients: 2 -4 lbs yukon gold potatoes, sliced thick ( about 10-12 large ones ) | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce | 4 kumquats, sliced ( about 1 cup )
instructions: Place potatoes in large bowl. Pour 1/2 cup of preserves over, and set aside. Sprinkle kumquats over and toss until kumquats are coated in preserves. Cover and refrigerate 2 - 4 hours. Preheat oven to 450 degrees, with rack in center. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil generously buttered. Place samosas on sheet, and top with remaining preserves and kumquats. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, or until potatoes turn golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,beef chuck,herb,mint sprig,corn muffin mix,apple juice,chili powder,serrano chile pepper
title: Sweet-Spicy Beef Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 pounds boneless beef chuck, trimmed | 4 -5 tablespoons mixed fresh herbs, chopped ( such as dill, basil, thyme ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/3 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon chopped seeded fresh serrano chile pepper | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint sprigs, crushed | 1 teaspoon juniper berries | 1 bag corn muffin mix, such as jiffy
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Using a sharp knife, cut beef into 3/4 inch thick slices about 1 1/2 inches x 2 inches. In a medium bowl, toss the meat with the herbs and chile pepper. Pour in apple juice and stir to blend. Spread the fruit evenly over the beef and place fat side up in a baking dish or roasting pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice, mint leaves, and juniper berries. Cover dish with foil and bake in preheated oven until meat is tender, about 1 hour 15 minutes. Remove from oven, stir once, place on a serving plate, and remove fat and sprinkle with a little of the mint leaves from the dish. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ginger wine,oriental sesame oil,simple syrup,soymilk,table salt,spinach leaf,chat masala,almond extract
title: Aromatic Spinach with Almonds and Spicy Yogurt
ingredients: table salt | 4 cups very finely chopped spinach leaves ( about 1/2 pound ) | 2 cups soymilk ( or soymilk substitute ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground ginger wine or 1 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 2 1/2 tablespoons extra light tasting oriental sesame oil | 1 teaspoon low sodium instant mashed-food instant granules or 1 teaspoon instant mashed thai sweet potato instant mashed potato | 1/2 tablespoon simple syrup | 1 teaspoon chat masala or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon artificial dried red hot sauce or 1/2-1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Line a baking sheet with wax paper. Put the spinach in a medium pot over medium high heat. Toast just until it starts to wilt a bit. This should take 3 - 4 minutes. Let cool for a couple of minutes. Put the spinach in a large bowl and add the soy milk or soymilk substitute. Stir in the next 6 seasonings and stir to combine. Cover and chill at least 30 minutes and up to 3 hours.

title: Pfefferneuse (Spice Mix)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon mustard | 1 tablespoon ground mace
instructions: Stir together the dry ingredients with a fork and store in an airtight container.

title: Coconut Fritters for Two
ingredients: 1 boxes jiffy cornbread mix | 1/4 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat wok or large frying pan on medium high heat until hot. Mix the dry cornbread mix and shredded coconut. Fry the fritters in batches until golden brown on both sides. Add a few drops of milk or coconut flavored nectar to keep moist. Serve as the topping for fried snacks or as a snack with a sweet and sour sauce.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,pineapple juice,orange juice concentrate,oat,lemon juice zest,sole fillet
title: Faux Sole With Orange-Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 can pineapple juice | 1 1/2 ounces frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 6 ounces oat, crumbs | 2 lemons, juice and zest of, grated | 6 sole fillets, about 2kg | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Place the pineapple juice in a bowl and add the frozen orange juice concentrate, oat crumbs, lemon juice, lemon rind, and chili powder. Mix thoroughly with the sole and pour it over the sole. Place the fillets in a bowl and chill until ready to use. Wash the fish under cold running water, pat dry, and remove the skin. Cut into bite size pieces and serve at room temperature alongside the citrus dressing.

title: Mini-Chocolate Chip Mousse
ingredients: 2 large egg yolks | 1 cup miniature chocolate chip | 1/4 cup ground marshmallow | 1 bay leaf
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the egg yolks. Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over hot water. Slowly stir in marshmallows. Gently stir egg mixture into melted chocolate, then add bay leaf. Refrigerate while preparing the block of mousse for several hours before serving. Top mousse with a shamrock frost and garnish with chocolate shavings.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,cashew,jasmine rice,water chestnut,hot dog,guajillo chilies,lemon juice,bread
title: Arroz-Style Indian-Style Rice Balls With Cashews, Garlic & Hot Dogs
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups water or 2 3/4 cups low-sodium chicken broth | 1 cup uncooked jasmine rice | 1/2 lb hot dog, cut into 1/4 inch-thick slices and then crosswise into thin slices ( a spicy-hotdog brand such as smoky jack daniels works well ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained well and coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon fresh orange juice | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped coarsely ( not dried ) | 1 dried guajillo chilies, stemmed and seeded, stemmed and torn in half
instructions: Combine rice, broth & 1/2 tsp salt in medium saucepan and bring to boil. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook hot dog slices in large nonstick skillet until browned over medium high heat 2 minutes per side, turning once. Transfer to plate. Drain hot dog slices and cut diagonally in half lengthwise, then crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices. Transfer to plate with cashews. Stir fish sauce, water chestnuts, lemon juice and orange juice into rice mixture in large bowl and spoon mixture into rice centers. Top with cashews & guajillo chiles. Serve with additional fish sauce if desired.

title: Almond Crisps
ingredients: 1 cup blanched almond, toasted | oil, for deep fat frying
instructions: Dip the almonds in plenty of hot oil and allow to cool slightly. Using a teaspoon, scrape the peel in and break into pieces.

title: Crock Pot Carnitas
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco | 1 cup fresh cranberries ( optional ) or 1 cup dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves
instructions: Combine beef with other ingredients in a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours. Serve with corn chips.

title: Guacamole-Style Tilapia
ingredients: 8 ounces tilapia fillets, room temperature | 4 ounces guacamole | 4 tablespoons chopped green bell peppers | 2 tablespoons chopped carrots | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place tilapia fillets in lightly oiled 8x8 baking dish. Whisk guacamole, bell peppers, carrots, and oregano in bowl.

title: Tropical-Style Grilled Corned Beef Brisket With Sombrero Bits
ingredients: 4 cups mixed baby beets, scrubbed | 1/2 cup prepared sombrero bits ( yellow mexican yellow corn chips ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence ( i use real vanilla extract )
instructions: Prepare the barbecue. Place beets and sombrero bits in a large roasting pan and mix well, discarding any chunks of cornbeet. Drizzle with the vanilla essence. Cook for 20 minutes at 325 degrees. Brush or oil the beef brisket and cook until the internal temperature of the brisket reaches 160 degrees, about 30 minutes for rare. Allow to rest for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,basmati rice,turnip,vanilla pudding mix,hot italian sausage,lime juice,yellow pepper,yoghurt
title: Aussie Rice
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, sliced, bulk | 1 box vanilla instant pudding mix, 1/2-inch ( half fat and half light ) | 1 bunch fresh basil ( cleaned and chopped - 3 heads ) | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh lemon peel | 1 cup turnip, diced | 1 yellow pepper, diced ( medium or hot ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 cup yoghurt, whipped
instructions: Sautee the sausage in a skillet with a tablespoon of oil until cooked through, over medium low heat for 3 - 5 minutes until it is mostly cooked through. While cooking chop the basil, put in a bowl and add the rest of the ingredients and mix. You want the salad ingredients blended together. Serve by itself or with the yogurt on the side for dipping. Goes great with hot italian style rolls.

title: Chickpea Flour Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chickpea flour, or as needed, or more as needed | 1 cup queso fresco, cubed | 1/2 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread chickpea flour onto a plate, and sprinkle queso fresco and preserves onto top. Cook in the preheated oven until golden and bubbly, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white cheese,cocoa powder,basil sprig,yellow sugar,ladyfinger,pepper sauce,yellow onion,banana
title: Mexican Bananas
ingredients: 4 firm bananas, peeled and sliced � inch thick | 1 yellow onion, chopped fine | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1/2 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 12 ladyfingers ( see note ) | 20 basil sprigs ( optional ) | 4 ounces white cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Place the sliced bananas in a casserole dish or roasting pan. Sprinkle the onions over and pour the sugar on. Bring to a rapid simmer and cook, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved, but do not burn it. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the hot pepper sauce. Arrange the ladyfingers on top of the caramel. Pour the caramelized mixture over, placing ladyfingers beside and covering the ladyfingers with the caramelized mixture. Sprinkle white cheese lightly on the layer of cheese. Cover and return to the oven at 350 degrees f for about 30 minutes or until the ladyfingers soften and begin to crisp. If desired, garnish with basil and serve hot. Note, to make this on the grill, place the bananas on a preheated grill rack over direct high heat, without any oil splatter. Grill them on all sides until the bananas are nicely browned on the exterior and have a nice grill marks, about 8 or 10 minutes depending on the length of your grill so they are lightly browned and cooked uniformly.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,grapeseed oil,cooking oil,serrano pepper
title: Yosopy's Chile and Garlic Fritters
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 serrano pepper, minced | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
instructions: Heat the grapeseed oil in a skillet over medium to medium high heat. Stir in the serrano pepper and cook for a few minutes, stirring frequently, until fragrant. Pour in the drained tomatoes with green chile peppers.

title: Pasta Alentejana
ingredients: 3 cups parboiled basmati rice | 2 ounces nicoise olives, roughly chopped | 1 jar pimientos, drained and finely chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup light rum | 2 cans rotini pasta
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the cooked basmati rice, nicoise olives, pimientos and rum. Cover, and sauté over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is tender and the flavors have blended, about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Apple and Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 400 g canned chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup canned tart apple, drained | 3/4 cup macaroni | 1 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan forced and line a 2 litre capacity ovenproof tin with baking paper. Place the chickpeas in a pan with the apple and mix well. Add the macaroni and spice and then pour in water, just so the macaroni boils through the contents. Cover with the tin foil and bake in the preheated oven for 25mins.

Random Ingredients: sausage link,green onion,cellophane noodle,triple sec,cocoa powder,yellow pepper
title: Mock Jook
ingredients: 2 packages cellophane noodles | 1/2 yellow pepper, sliced in thin strips | 1 link sausage, sliced | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder ( or confectioners ) | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 1 green onion, finely chopped
instructions: Boil the noodles in boiling water for 7 minutes. Drain well and set aside. Drain water from the noodles. In a large frying pan, place the sliced onion and sausages on the skillet. Cook until the sausage is fully cooked. Add the noodles to the onion/sausage mixture.. Add cocoa and triple sec. Stir well. Turn off heat cover and let sit 1 minute. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile adobo,hoisin sauce,banana pepper,sesame seed,cheese,broccoli
title: Broccoli Chipotle -Sesame Banana Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 head broccoli | 2 bananas, peeled, then sliced | 1 sweet banana pepper, sliced ( or two small bananas if you like or dislike banana pepper ) | 3 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 1/2 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Boil water with broccoli. Add sweet banana pepper slices, peppers, and chipotles. Cook according to packaging. Cool completely, then slice into bite sized pieces. Mix rest of the ingredients with some broccoli for garnish. Chill.

title: Mexican Style Rigatoni
ingredients: 8 ounces rigatoni pasta, cooked and drained | 1 can whole new mexico anaheim chilies, roughly chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl and stir well. Serve warm/ room temperature.

title: Spiced Fresh Fruit With Hot Peppers(A Memory for My Dad)
ingredients: 4 -6 cups fresh small fruit, peeled ( strawberries, papas, apricot, grapes, peaches, red grapes ) | 1 tablespoon brown sugar, packed | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper, crushed
instructions: Wash the fruit thoroughly and soak in hot water for 1 hour. Drain. Mix the sugar and pepper in a small bowl. Spoon the fruit into a large saucepan, add the hot pepper mixture and gently toss. Bring to a slow boil, stirring periodically,. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer gently for about 45 minutes or until all the water is absorded. Dish is very thick and very rich. Makes 8 to 10 servings. Variation, substitute fresh berries for the hot peppers or a few dried apricots, or even a combination to replace the sweetness of the hot pepper mixture.

title: John Fipe's Four Seasons Filling for Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 can green chili peppers | 1/2 cup dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon an anaheim chili, seeded and minced | 1 loaf frozen pastry dough ( or your own recipe ) | 1 green chili pepper, diced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees. Drain green chilies well and remove stems and seeds. Put aside in a small bowl.

title: The Easy Slow Cooker Suzerka
ingredients: 5 pounds bone-in beef roast | all-seasoned onion powder to taste | seasoned turmeric to taste
instructions: Place beef roast into the crock of a slow cooker. Sprinkle with onion powder and any seasoning packet desired, and place on top of the meat. Pour enough water over to cover the roast. Cook on high until the water comes to a boil.

title: Slow Cooker Boardwalk Quality Sirloin Tip
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin tip roast | 5 teaspoons salt
instructions: Season the roast with the liquid salt. Put into the slow cooker with the lid on or place in the crock of an electric slow cooker. Cook on high for 10 to 12 hours. Transfer the roast to a cutting board and slice it thin. Serve with the pan juices.

Random Ingredients: nonfat plain yogurt,cucumber,corn cob,oil,cream mushroom soup,green chilies,cream cheese,coriander
title: Creamy Mexican Corn and Cucumber Dip for One
ingredients: 8 corn on the cob, husked | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 4 ounces light cream cheese | 1 green chilies ( minced ) or 1/4 green chili, minced ( minced ) | 1/2 cucumber ( fine chopped ) | 1/3 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons minced coriander ( or cilantro ) | 2 teaspoons oil
instructions: Place corn on the cob cut side up, in a baking dish. Mix with soups, cream cheese, chili, chilies and cucumber. Mix yoghurt with coriander and oil and pour this over the corn. Bake corn at 350 for 20 - 25 minutes or until heated through. Serve with any dip for dipping.

title: Guacamole-Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Combine everything in a small bowl.. Let sit on the counter for about 10 minutes to mellow the flavors.

title: Sour Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 500 g red cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar, good quality
instructions: Mix the chopped cabbage into a bowl. Sieve the malt vinegar into bowl, stir in enough vinegar to make a tangy consistency. Allow to cool and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: Savory Creamy Mint
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 2 slices fresh mint, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt, divided
instructions: Mix cream of chicken soup, mint, and seasoned salt together in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on medium for 5 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Rose Water - Oil and Rose Filling for Fish, Cakes, and Chips
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil or 3 tablespoons other virgin oil | 2 teaspoons minced fresh rose water
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Allow the oil to sit in refrigerator at least 1 hour before using to help dissolve the rose water. Make your own rose water by placing some cold water in a small heavy saucepan. Bring the water to a boil then remove from the heat. Allow it to cool, then strain into a clean jar and store for up to 1 week. Use to brush fish or chips, allow to dry, then sprinkle with vegetable or lemon topping, or to serve as a condiment for fried or fried vegetable croutons or as a side dish for shrimp.

title: Smoked Salmon and Cheese Crostini
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked salmon fillets ( preferably a dark aged smoked ) | 18 saffron strands | 18 saffron strands | 1 tablespoon dried sage ( optional ) | 1 cup vegetable broth | parchment paper | cheesecloth ( optional ) | toasted baguette
instructions: Soak saffron strands in water.

title: Parsnips in Cream
ingredients: 6 parsnips, peeled | 2 liters heavy cream
instructions: Scrub the parsnips with a sharp knife, removing any outer peel if they are too pale or too dark. Cut an x into each parsnip and bake them on a baking sheet at 220°c for about 45 minutes, or until tender. Meanwhile, bring 2 litres of water to the boil. Squeeze the pared parsnips through the cloth or cheesecloth in between handfuls and shake off excess. Pour the cream gently into the parsnips and bake them in the boiling water for around 5 minutes, or until very thick. When the parsnips have baked for a few minutes, put them under a hot grill and cook for a few more minutes before turning them with a sharp knife. Allow to cool slightly before stirring through some parsley leaves before serving. They are then kept for an extra little taste, but as they cool they soften and become richer. Reheat them if necessary. Enjoy note that the cream is very thick and has a considerable taste, a little dryness and acidity at it. If you need to thin it further, the cream may be stirred unto it to get the desired consistency.

title: Ramen Egg Replacer
ingredients: 3/4 cup ramen noodles, broken into small pieces | 3 tablespoons egg substitute | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/8 teaspoon black cardamom
instructions: In a nonstick saucepan, cook ramen noodles according to package directions. Meanwhile, combine egg substitute and cardamom.

title: Quinoa, Red Cabbage and Lemon
ingredients: 1 medium purple head red cabbage, cored and shredded coarsely | 2 1/4 cups dry quinoa, rinsed and drained | 1 1/4 teaspoons grated lemon zest
instructions: Cover the quinoa with water and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer uncovered, until the quinoa is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, about 20 minutes to 1 hour. Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Fry the zest for 15 minutes, stirring often, until it is beginning to turn golden. Sprinkle in the zest and toss to coat. Remove the quinoa from heat. Transfer the quinoa to a serving bowl and stir in the cabbage and lemons.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,yogurt,molasses,cocoa powder,purpose flour,pepper,red chili pepper flake
title: Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup sour yogurt | 1 red chili pepper, crushed ( if large ) | 2 teaspoons molasses | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 pinch red chili pepper flakes ( if you don't like spicy! ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, divided
instructions: Place the sour cream and chili seed in a bowl and set aside until cool. Mix the molasses, cocoa, chili flakes and ground pepper in the skillet. When hot, lightly brown the flour, about 1 minute. Stir in 1/2 cup of the yogurt mixture. Spread this sauce over the sour cream and chili to create an excellent spreadable crust using this process. Cook for 5 minutes or until the crust is a nice light brown.

title: Homemade Faux Bites  (French Fry or Chicken)
ingredients: salt pork, sliced ( about 1-inch thick ) | 2 cans of x-rated fusion liqueur ( or other liqueur of your choice and use 3/4 bottle ) | garlic paste ( optional ) | salt | catsup
instructions: Place salt pork over large plate. Pour fusion over salt pork. Pour catsup over, add garlic and a few dashes each. Roll into bite sized chunks. Arrange on a plate and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Grill or cook as you prefer.

title: Roasted Pork for a Crowd
ingredients: 5 pounds bone-in pork roast | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil | 1 large yellow bell pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Rub pork generously with olive oil and season generously with salt. Place the pork onto a broiling pan with the skin side down. Broil the pork to its most exposed surface, 5 to 7 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly charred and slightly crisp. Turn the pork halfway through roasting. Arrange the yellow pepper strips onto the cooked side of the roast. Cover the roast with aluminum foil, and place the roasting pan on the preheated oven rack. Broil, turning occasionally, to get a crusty brown crust, about 5 minutes per side. An instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh, near the bone should read 140 degrees f. Remove the roast from the oven and set it aside. Allow the roast to rest about 10 minutes before slicing into chunks. Stir the pork, bell pepper strips, and oil together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,prosciutto,chicken bouillon cube,purple onion,coriander seed,water
title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 cups purple onions, thinly sliced ( from 3 large purple onions ) | 12 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 cup sour cream | 2 cups chicken bouillon cubes ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed
instructions: Boil onions with a stock cube for 20 minutes add cream cheese and continue to boil for a further 20 minutes. Add coriander seeds and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow the soup to cool. Add more milk if necessary. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate molasses,fenugreek seed,anaheim chili,apple cider vinegar,red cabbage,lamb,heavy cream
title: Lamb and Pomegranate Molasses Skewers and Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs lean lamb, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup olive oil or 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1/3 cup pomegranate molasses | 3 tablespoons ginger-flavored apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds, crushed | 1 lb red cabbage, shredded | 1 anaheim chili, seeded and chopped | heavy cream
instructions: Place lamb cubes in a large resealable plastic bag. Mix together oil and molasses in a small saucepan. Set pan over medium heat and bring to a boil. Remove pan from heat and stir in vinegar. Pour mixture over lamb, seal bag and marinate at least 3 hours and up to 1 day. Thread on metal skewers. Preheat grill to medium high. Thread lamb cubes onto 12 - 12 bamboo skewers. Grill or broil about 8 minutes, turning frequently, until lamb is browned and cooked to desired doneness. Garnish with cabbage and chili.

title: Quick "salad" Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/4 liters shell pasta | 3/4 cup yellow pink lemonade | 1 tablespoon mustard powder
instructions: Boil water, pasta, and lemonade together. Drain the pasta well and add the mustard and lemonade to the boiling water. Leave to boil. Toss the pasta very lightly, it should still look wet. Enjoy.

title: Homemade Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups vegetables, of your choice ( sweet potato, eggplant, carrot, zucchini, cauliflower ) | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon celery rib, chopped
instructions: Rinse and dry vegetables very well. Heat olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium high heat. When hot, add vegetables in batches, stirring to coat evenly with oil.

title: Baked Shrimp and Stuffed Zucchini
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh zucchini, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 cup low-fat pizza sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1 1/2 cups shredded zucchini ( about 36 to 45, from 1 medium ) | 3 cups cooked jumbo shrimp, peeled | 1 cup watermelon, slices peeled and cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch-thick slices | 1/4 cup quick-cooking tapioca
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Coat 2 baking sheets with cooking spray. Place zucchini slices on baking sheets.

title: Smooth and Crunchy Vegetable - Muhalabian Style
ingredients: 2 large pumpkin, eg. hubbard squash or 2 large butternut squash | 50 g asparagus, trimmed, cut in 2cm lengths | 2 teaspoons cornflour or 2 teaspoons cornmeal | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Mix the cornflour with about 6 tbs cold water to make a thick paste. Squeeze out excess water and mix with the yoghurt. Heat a shallow ovenproof dish in the oven. Pour in the yoghurt. Then add the vegetables, then toss for a couple of minutes. Place the dish on the top shelf of the oven, making sure that the potatoes on the inside get a little crusty on top. Bake at 200c for about 20 - 25 minutes until the top gets a little crispy. Serve with bread or toast if you like.

Random Ingredients: radicchio,pistachio,white vinegar,hard egg,stew beef chunk,chicken part,cinnamon,dark sesame oil
title: Chinese Beef Stew With Parsley Crunch
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 2 lbs lean stew beef chunks, trimmed ( not sirloin ) | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 1/2 lbs small radicchio, coarsely chopped | 12 hard-boiled eggs, quartered | 8 leaves small radicchio, coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup chopped roasted sweetened pistachios, toasted | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar
instructions: Heat oils in a dutch oven over medium high heat. Sprinkle beef with cinnamon.

title: Easy Creamy Celery Soup (Lite Version)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons celery, chopped | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the celery, half and half and salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,lemon peel,canola oil,beer,pig tail,puff pastry,self rising flour
title: Pig Tarts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 1/2 cup beer | 2 teaspoons lemon peel, grated | 12 large prawns, shelled, deveined and shells removed | 1 lebanese cucumber, halved lengthways and sliced | 1 packet puff pastry, defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c/425f/gas 4. To make the batter, heat oil in a small saucepan, stir in flour, then add beer and lemon peel. Bring to boil, then simmer for 5 minutes, stirring. Set aside. Using 4 - 6 prawns, remove the tail meat, leaving the heads and shells in tact. Add to batter and cook for 6 minutes and then add cucumber and mix through. Use 1/3 of the pastry to fill each prawn. Place on lightly greased baking trays and brush the tops with milk. Repeat with rest of the pastry. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until prawns are cooked through and prawns are golden brown. Serve with a green salad and some lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,rice,maple syrup,white fish,white rice
title: Maple Fried Whitefish
ingredients: 1/2 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons white rice, or to taste | 1 pound white fish, sliced across the grain into thin strips | 1 cup uncooked white rice, or as needed | 1/2 cup rice, room temperature, divided
instructions: Whisk maple syrup, sesame oil, 1 1/2 tablespoons white rice, and fish together in a glass bowl until sauce has dissolved. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming while marinating.

Random Ingredients: mustard,green cardamom,almond extract,nutritional yeast flake,wild rice,mace
title: Wild Rice with Almonds and Mustard(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 box wild rice | 7 teaspoons mustard | 3/4 teaspoon ground nutritional yeast flakes | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 3/4 teaspoon ground mace | 8 green cardamoms, split and stalks removed
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions, adding 2 teaspoons mustard to water when finished. Set aside to cool. Meanwhile, in small bowl combine remaining 2 teaspoons mustard with remaining teaspoon mustard, other 2 teaspoons sugar, and almond extract. Set aside. Place the cardamom seeds into a small bowl and set aside. While the rice is cooking, grind 3/4 teaspoon of the nutmeg with 2 teaspoons water in a spice grinder until smooth. Add to the cooled wild rice along with the ground nutmeg mixture. Season with additional nutmeg and/or additional mustard added if necessary. Stir in the remaining 1 teaspoon mustard before serving. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,romano cheese,italian parsley,lemon peel,corn husk
title: Lemon Noodles
ingredients: 12 medium corn husks | 6 ounces lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 cups freshly grated romano cheese | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 3/4 cup chopped italian parsley
instructions: Soak cornhusks in water 10 minutes. Cook in boiling water 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,spaghetti sauce,white bread,white peppercorn,white chocolate chip
title: Spaghetti With a White Chocolate, Caramelized Carrots and Cracked White Peppercorns
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti sauce | 1 cup baby carrots, cut into matchstick-size pieces | 4 white peppercorns | 2 slices country-style white bread | 2 ounces white chocolate chips
instructions: Put the spaghetti sauce in a large pot.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,vegetable oil cooking spray,splenda sugar substitute,white rum,orange,cottage cheese,ladyfinger,flat leaf parsley
title: Ranch Style Ladyfingers(No-Cream Filling)
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers | 1 1/4 teaspoons vegetable oil or 1 1/4 teaspoons cooking spray | 1/4 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup splenda sugar substitute or 1/4 cup sugar | 1/4 cup white rum | 1 tablespoon grated orange rind | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lay ladyfingers on baking sheets lined with parchment paper, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.. In medium bowl, combine cottage cheese, splenda, rum, orange rind and rosemary. Spoon 2 tablespoons of topping into each ladyfinger. Sprinkle with remaining topping and bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Note, serve additional topping on the side if desired.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,cinnamon,dark sesame oil,beverage,kalamata olive,spaghetti,chili pepper
title: Nacho Nachos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spaghetti | 1 can colavita dark sesame oil | 1 can goya brand fire roasted chili peppers | 12 whole calamata olives, sliced | 12 cinnamon sticks | 8 cups broken corn chips, divided, crushed ( i use fritos ) | 16 ounces can goya brand golden sesame oil
instructions: Cook spaghetti. When al dente, drain then return to pan. Pour canola sesame oil into pan and heat on low heat. While waiting for oil to heat, prepare chili peppers, place black olives in a dish and cover with plastic wrap. When oil has reached temperature, remove the olives with a slotted spoon, place olives in a bowl and pour off excess oil. Dry chili peppers by placing them in a bag and using tongs, hold with some paper towel to remove extra heat. Drain chili peppers, and remove seeds and membranes leaving stems of the peppers whole.. Heat canola sesame oil in pan on medium heat. Dip each pepper into chips, holding back the olives with the towel so they don't break and burn. Fill pepper with some drained chili pepper and olive oil. Sprinkle with crushed cinnamon sticks. Place in microwave covered for 4 minutes on high. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: White Chocolate Ganache
ingredients: 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 1 cup white chocolate liqueur
instructions: Whip cream until stiff peaks form.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,onion salt,ginger,bread,rom tomato,egg tomato,button mushroom,bailey irish cream
title: Tortilla Chip Burger
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant minced onion ( or 2 teaspoons instant minced onion powder ) | 1 tablespoon bread, crumbs | 1 egg, slightly beaten | 1/2 cup light sauteed button mushroom, drained, reserving liquid | 1/2 cup roma tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup frozen small whole-kernel corn or 1/2 cup canned baby portabella mushrooms | 1 cup taostram's irish cream | tortilla chips
instructions: In a small bowl combine the onion and 1/2 teaspoon of the instant minced onion powder. Add bread crumbs, egg, and mushroom liquid to form a paste and stir until blended. Set aside. In a small bowl combine tomato, corn, and remaining 1/2 teaspoons of minced onion powder and drizzle over the top of the prepared burger. Place on the grill pan and let cook for 5 minutes or until slightly soft and golden brown. Top burger with tortilla chips and garnish with fresh tomato slices, fresh mint leaves, or sprigs of fresh mint. Makes 8 servings. These burgers can be made ahead.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,crab,turnip,molasses,green chilies,anchovy,golden raisin,beef tenderloin
title: Creamy Crab Stuffed Turnips
ingredients: 4 large turnips, peeled and cut about one third up on a wedge | 1 1/2 lbs crabsticks or 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut up into one inch pieces | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can diced green chilies, drained ( drained on paper towels ) | 1/2 cup molasses | 1/4 cup golden raisin ( optional ) | 2 cans anchovies, drained ( optional )
instructions: Boil the unopened can of chicken soup and can of diced green chilies. Boil mixture for 4 to 6 minutes, and drain. Mix all ingredients together, and set aside. Remove the meat from shells and stuff a little bit of the crab into each shell, leaving the tail meat on. Re stuff the shells of the turnips, then stuff the rest of the crab around the shells. Set in the refrigerator, and leave a couple hours to marinate. This recipe makes about four batches depending on how stuffed you can get them all. This step can be difficult, but worth it in my mother in law or friend in law.

title: Artichoke Hearts in Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 can chili sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1/3 cup canola oil
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the artichoke hearts with the chili sauce and cayenne. Let stand for 30 minutes. Heat the canola oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add the artichokes, and cook about 8 minutes, turning once, until heated through and deep golden brown. Stir in the chili sauce.

Random Ingredients: almond,green chili,active yeast,egg noodle,red chilies,miso,red wine
title: Chinese Noodle Salad With Red Wine and Miso
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 cup warm red wine | 2 teaspoons dried red chilies | 1/2 teaspoon dried yellow split red chilies | 1 cup warm alphonso egg noodles | 1/2 cup sliced blanched almond | 1/4 cup sliced green chili | 1 dash miso ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm red wine, add chopped chilies, egg noodles, almonds, chopped green chili, and miso. Let sit 3 - 4 minutes. Eat.

title: French Pasta
ingredients: 300 g small shell pasta | 200 g extra firm tofu | 2 leaves fresh basil
instructions: Boil the pasta with salt. Cut the tofu into 1inch/1 cm pieces. Mix tofu into the pasta. Place in a preheated oven, 220°c for 25 - 30 minutes. Remove basil leaves. Serve. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,red potato,onion,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes | 1/2 cup onion, chopped | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 3 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil. Toss potatoes with 1/4 cup onion, sun dried tomatoes, parmigiano reggiano cheese, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a large bowl until coated. Spread potatoes onto the prepared baking sheet, and roast in the preheated oven until golden brown and crisp, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: brussels sprout,polish sausage,cucumber,sage leaf,mango chutney,chickpea flour
title: Polish Sausage With Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb polish sausage | 1 bunch brussels sprout | 1 cucumber | 1 can chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves | 1 jar mango chutney
instructions: Peel the sprouts and cut off the root end. Slice off the sprouts into 1/2 inch pieces lengthwise. Cut the stalk into 1 inch pieces. Whip the chutney and brush into the brussels sprouts. Mix the flour in a bowl with a few drops of water until there are no lumps. Toss the brussels sprouts and sprouts in the batter.

Random Ingredients: double acting baking powder,strawberry,cream cheese,cotija cheese,adobo seasoning
title: Strawberry Chocolate Chip Scones #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh strawberries | 2 teaspoons cotija cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon double-acting baking powder | 1 teaspoon adobo seasoning or 1 teaspoon emeril's original essence
instructions: In a bowl, mix cream cheese, strawberries, cotija, baking powder and accent. Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours serve on a piece of parchment paper lined baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,monterey jack pepper cheese,pork roast
title: Pork With Queso Blanco
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs pork roast | pitted jalapeno chile | monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to in a roasting pan about 9x28 inches arrange the roast on top of the chiles and sprinkle with the cheese. Bake for about 1½ hours. Let sit out for at least twenty minutes before slicing and eating.

title: Simple and Delicious Chocolate Lara
ingredients: 125 g baking chocolate ( chopped ) | 125 g frozen phyllo ladyfingers | 60 g frozen bleu cheese | 600 ml sweet spaghetti sauce ( thick and rich ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Place dough in a bowl and spray with a cooking spray or cooking oil. Bake on a cookie tray at 180c for 10 - 15 mins, or until golden. Cut diagonally to make a wide strip, then brush with cooking oil. Break the biscuits into 1cm pieces and place on top of biscuits. Cook on the bbq or the grill, and cook a few mins each side, until lightly golden. Add the chocolate and butter, and mix well. Add the spaghetti sauce and mix well. Cook over a low heat until slightly thick. Take off the flame. Pour into bowls over the biscuits and serve with lots of crusty bread chunks.

title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 5 fresh green chile peppers ( optional ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 2 small leaves lettuce
instructions: Toast hazelnuts in a dry pan over medium high heat, watching them just as they begin to turn a nutty color, about 2 minutes. Watch carefully after a minute or two, as to not burn.
