Toast hazelnuts again in a dry pan over medium high heat, watching as they begin to brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Watch closely as to not burn. Remove to a mortar to cool. Cut chiles into thin slices. Arrange chiles on a serving platter, surrounded by a sprig of hazelnuts. Drizzle with confectioners'sugar, if desired.

title: Seared Rump Steak With Coriander
ingredients: 5 lbs rump steak, cut into 4 serving pieces | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander leaves | 2 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f in a large ovenproof dish or flameproof pot, toss the meat with the coriander leaves. Sprinkle with sugar and drizzle with oil. Bake for 2 hours, tossing it once, till the meat is tender and browned, and the juices run clear.

title: Quick Pasta Chips With Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 package corn chips | 1 package snow peas ( about 14 cups ) | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spray with nonstick cooking spray. Place half of the corn chips on a large baking sheet. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of the snow peas, 1/2 teaspoons oregano, and 1/4 teaspoons pepper. Repeat with remaining ingredients, sprinkling each with salt. Bake chips for 12 to 15 minutes, until crisp and brown. Sift confectioners' sugar, if desired, on top if desired, and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: celery,sherry wine vinegar,puff pastry,vanilla bean,apple,sherry wine
title: Vanilla Pies (Serves 4)
ingredients: 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed or 1 large pastry pouch, thawed | 2 -3 apples, peeled, cored, sliced, and quartered ( about 1 lb ) | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1/2 vanilla bean, scraped, seeds scraped, and minced | 1 teaspoon celery, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. To prepare pie crusts, place the pastry on a sheet of waxed paper. Unfold the pastry. With a sharp knife, cut 8 equal parts from each half to make 8 squares. Place the squares on a baking sheet. Place apples in rows in the center of each pastry square.

title: Spaghetti with Apples and Pepperoni
ingredients: 1 lb dried spaghetti | 1 can stewed tart apples | 1/2 cup pepperoni, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cook pasta al dente, drain ans add all ingredients. Cook for an additional 10 minutes.

title: Homemade Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 cup grainy mustard | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Put mustard in a glass bowl. Pour mustard over mustard. Stir in bay leaves. Cover bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 8 hours.

title: Tarragon Egg Sauce #2
ingredients: tarragon ( see directions ) | 3 celery ribs, washed | 3 egg yolks
instructions: Put the tarragon in a blender. Wash & cut the celery into 1 inch lengths & add them to the blender. Heat the egg yolks in a pan, pour them into the blender & bring to the boil. As the omelette starts to thicken, use a whisk to mix it in & pour in a little warm sauce into the egg yolk mixture. Remove from the heat & add the tarragon, mix. Note, some people like their egg sauce slightly thicker than others, so adjust the amount of tarragon according to personal or party taste preferences.

title: Spiced Noodle With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb fresh pasta ( any type of ) or 1 lb fresh spiral shaped pasta, of choice | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika or 2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 1/8 teaspoon fresh nutmeg, finely grated | 1 dash dark chili powder | 3 tablespoons frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained | 1/2 cup egg substitute, mixed with | 1 tablespoon dry white cooking wine or 1 tablespoon hot water
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of lightly salted water to boil on stove. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well and set aside. Combine paprika, nutmeg and chile powder in small bowl. Sprinkle over pasta. Add mixed vegetables, egg substitute and wine mixture. Mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Slow Cooker Kale and Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 pound ground round | 1 1/2 pounds rotisserie chicken | 1 can or bottle dark beer | 1 package frozen chopped kale | 1 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Brown meat. Cube chicken and place in crock pot. Season with kosher salt and pepper. Mix in browned meat if desired. Pour beer over top of chicken and cook on low setting for 3 - 5 hours. Turn crock pot off and let rest for about 10 minutes, then stir kale into meat and stir. Mix flour into liquid and serve on the side for stew. Cooks note, can be served the night before as a side dish to stir meat. This makes it into burritos.

title: Chinese Steamed Bean Sprout Pudding (Fat Free)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon brandy or 1 tablespoon apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Steam the bean sprouts until the sprouts are well cooked. If using a blender, you may process them until fine. If using a blender, they may be pureed in a saucepan. Add other ingredients, except for the fat, and blend until smooth. If you use a blender add more fat, just before adding the brandy. Pour into a serving dish and serve with custard or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,semolina,hot chili pepper,maraschino cherry,clove,coriander seed
title: Spiced Semolina Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups semolina ( coarse or fine ) | 2 cups crushed maraschino cherries | 6 whole cloves | 2 dried hot chili peppers | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds
instructions: Combine cherries, cloves, and seeds in a mixing bowl, crush slightly, and let sit for 10 minutes. Heat sesame oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Combine molasses, cherries, and spices in a blender. Add soaked cherries to molasses and mix in well. Bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer until thick, about 30 minutes, stirring often. Pour pudding into a large bowl, cover and chill it overnight. Stir well before serving, as it will be quite runny.

title: Achiote Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,white balsamic vinegar,cooking oat,beef stew meat,red capsicum
title: Quick Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, trimmed & cut into 2/3 inch pieces ( or similar meat ) | 5 fluid ounces white balsamic vinegar or 5 fluid ounces cider vinegar | 2 cans ro-tel diced tomatoes with green chilies ( or equivalent equivalent tomato juice ) | 2 -3 tablespoons quick-cooking oats ( i always use quick oats that hold together better ) | 1 red capsicum, sliced
instructions: Put meat in a large bowl. Add vinegar, tomatoes & oats, mix well. Cover and leave to marinate overnight or for a few hours in the fridge. Turn the meat on the grill. When ready to eat, put a large spoonful of the rest of the mixture in the centre of the meat & stir around to keep it from sticking. Serve with lots of bread.

title: Fruit Baked Outdoor Shephard Leekie
ingredients: 2 lbs leeks ( trimmed and washed, about 5 ) | 1 lb butternut pumpkin, peeled and cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes ( or use butternut squash ) | 1/2 lb veal fat ( i've used veg. fat free fat ) | 1/2 lb sunflower seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Butter or spray 2 baking tins with olive oil. Cut the leeks lengthwise, trimming any root ends, and then cut them crosswise into 1 inch pieces, wash them thoroughly & drain them, then pat dry with towel. Mix and toss the veal fat with the 1/2°c water you have mixed up with the sunflower seeds and set aside. Place the leeks, pumpkin and veal fat mixture in the prepared tins, sprinkle with the chopped sunflower seeds & bake for 40 minutes. Toss gently for 20 minutes more, then leave to cool on a wire rack.

title: Seared Ham, Apple and Pea Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 lb ham, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 ounce thinly sliced prosciutto | 4 small cooking apples, peeled, cored and cut into thin wedges ( about 4 cups ) | 1/2 cup frozen pigeon peas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1/4 cup plain yogurt, at room temperature | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325° and butter a 2 quart casserole dish. In a large bowl, toss the ham, prosciutto, apples, peas, cayenne, rosemary and yogurt until coated. Transfer the ham mixture to a baking sheet, coat with the cooking spray and bake, stirring once, until well flavored and hot, about 45 minutes. Toss with the fresh rosemary and serve warm.

title: Roasted Goat Cheese
ingredients: 3 ounces goat cheese, cut in cubes ( i like to use the low fat cow's cheese ) | 1 pinch red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 400°f/180°c in a large roasting tin, mix the goat cheese with the chilli flakes. Roast it for 25 - 40 minutes, until golden brown and the cheese is soft. Note, for a variation, you can puree the goat cheese with a fork in a food blender until smooth. Pour the roasted cheese into a bowl and add the roasted chilies. Stir and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: english muffin,chinese wine,bisquick,venison roast,bamboo shoot,great northern bean,clove
title: Easy Beef and Bean Burger
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless venison roast ( i use 1/2 of my beef and 1/2 of the pork sausage ) | 1 can great northern beans, drained, rinsed and patted dry | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1/4 cup chinese wine or 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups original bisquick ( or a combination of flour and baking powder ) | 1 dash ground cloves ( optional ) | 4 english muffins, cut in half lenghtwise ( may use a whole wheat sandwich )
instructions: Place the roast in the oven to oven safe. I remove the roast after letting it sit on the oven rack for about one hour. This way the meat will stay moist while it's cooking. Remove the roast from the oven and leave it in it's original position. Set aside. This might not be very long, but it should have the correct texture after about 20 minutes. If you slice the roast thinly, it should take about 20 minutes to be done. Preheat grill for medium heat. Remove the beef from the liquid that has accumulated on the bottom of the pan. Cut it into strips or chunks, if you like them. Set aside. In a bowl, combine the beans, bamboo, and wine. Combine all the ingredients together and mix well. Put about 2/3 cup of the bean mixture in each of the four bread halves. Spoon the beef mixture onto the top of each bread half. Close and wrap each piece of toast in saran wrap. Serve cold. Note, you may substitute ground cumin, garlic powder, ginger powder, salt, or other spices/seasoning to your liking.

title: Chef Joe's Pinto Beans and Pecans
ingredients: 1 pound pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 jar cherry tomatoes, drained and chopped | 1 cup chopped pecan halves | 3 tablespoons teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon dried chives
instructions: Combine pinto beans, tomatoes with green chilies, cherry tomatoes, pecans, teriyaki sauce, and chives in a slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,yogurt,meat,pizza sauce,ice water,quinoa,goat cheese,vodka
title: Guilt-Free Yogurt and Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 2 3/4 cups cold chicken bouillon granules, divided | 3/4 cup yogurt | 1 tablespoon ground meat | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1 1/2 cups pizza sauce ( or marinara sauce ) | ice water, as needed | 1 cup shredded lowfat goat cheese, for topping
instructions: Wash quinoa under running water.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,golden raisin,ricotta cheese,yellow bell pepper,sage,extra beef,baking potato,white cabbage
title: Baked Potatoes & Beef
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 2 large baking potatoes, peeled, and quartered ( about 3 cups ) | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, cut into thin strips | 1 medium head white cabbage, cored and core removed | 1 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup dried sage, divided | 1 container fat-free ricotta cheese | 1 lb hamburger ( cooked, drained, if desired, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray an 11 x 7 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a medium skillet, over medium heat, brown beef, adding bell pepper and cabbage. Turn mixture into pan. Spoon evenly into baking dish, top with raisins, and 1/4 teaspoon dried sage. In a medium bowl, stir together ricotta and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Stir egg into cheese mixture. Pour evenly over meat mixture. Bake at 400 f for 40 - 40 minutes, until vegetables are tender and cabbages are browned and heated through..

title: Dolly Madison
ingredients: 3 packages ladyfingers | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Dry the ladyfingers and line with waxed paper. Mix together the chicken bouillon with the chicken bouillon mixture. Place on waxed paper. Place on the table with the dried lady fingers on table. Warm in the microwave for 20 seconds to soften them. Then remove waxed paper and arrange the soaked lady fingers and dried lady fingers on the table.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,coffee,vegetable stock,gruyere cheese,oil,banana liqueur,white bean
title: French Beef Bananas With White Beans
ingredients: 3 ripe bananas ( about 1 lb. ) | 1 cup hot brewed coffee | 2 tablespoons beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons coffee | 1 tablespoon banana liqueur
instructions: Slice the banana diagonally into 1/8 inch slices and place 1/2 cup of beef slices on the cut sides of a plate. Combine the hot coffee with the beef tenderloin and sprinkle with grated cheese. Pour the stock over the top and sprinkle with coffee mixture. Serve with warm french beans.

title: Ginger Peas and Tomatoes over Curry Rice
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 5 teaspoons minced crystallized gingerroot | 2 cups frozen peas and carrots ( carrots work too )
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions. Heat oil in a skillet. Saute gingerroot until fragrant. Add peas and carrots and saute for approx 5 - 8 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,cumin powder,tomato paste,brown sugar,maraschino cherry,shortening
title: Cherry Chips
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1/4 cup brown sugar or 1/4 cup splenda granular | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained | 1/4 cup shortening
instructions: Drain sun dried tomatoes, reserve oil. In a medium size bowl, stir together tomato paste, brown sugar, cumin and cherry juice. Remove cherry halves from jar. With the shortening, cut into chips and place in plastic bag with maraschino cherry mixture. Shake to coat.

Random Ingredients: saffron,fennel seed,greek yogurt,puff pastry,basmati rice,lime juice,cornish game hen
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Game Hens With Saffron and Lime Juice - Tyler Florence
ingredients: 2 cornish game hens | 8 ounces plain greek yogurt | 4 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons saffron | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 4 sheets puff pastry | 2 tablespoons dried basmati rice
instructions: To make the sauce, put the yoghurt in a small pan along with the saffron, fennel and lime juice. Stir over medium to low heat. When it comes to a simmer, turn down the heat and leave for 15 minutes to infuse the flavours. Preheat your oven to 200c/180c/gas remove the hens from the marinade, shaking off any excess. Score the thick skin with a sharp knife. Place the game hens, skin side down, on a preheated baking tray. Pour half the sauce over the hens, cover with foil and cook on 200c/180c/gas for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and turn them over. Pour the remaining sauce into a bowl and gently fold through the drained rice. To serve. Slice the birds into 8 pieces and add to the salad, along with the sliced game hens.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,guacamole,hoisin sauce,extra virgin olive oil,lasagna noodle,dill,grain white rice,fenugreek leaf
title: Chef John's Savory Lasagna
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 1/2 cups dry long grain white rice or 2 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1 jar hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh dill | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves | 8 sheets lasagna noodles, about 1 1/2 lbs | 8 teaspoons chopped fresh mint, for garnish | 1/4 cup toasted pistachio nuts, for garnish
instructions: Over medium heat, heat the oil in a 2 1/2 to 3 quart saucepan or dutch oven. Stir in the rice and cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until the rice is lightly browned, 2–3 minutes. Stir the rice and 1/4 cup dill into the cooked rice and season with 1/4 tsp fenugreek leaves. Spread half the rice mixture over the bottom and up the sides of a 12 × 3 1/2 x 2 - 3 inch baking dish or 9 × 13 × 9 x 2 inches metal loaf pan. Sprinkle on 1/4 tsp mint and the remaining 1/4 tsp mint. Repeat with the remaining rice mixture, mint and mint, spreading evenly over the top and sides of the lasagna. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and microwave on high power, 70% power, for 8 minutes. Uncover and microwave on high power, 70% power, for a further 8 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes. Remove plastic wrap. Cover, and microwave on high power for 20 seconds. Turn off the microwave and let stand 5 minutes more. Uncover, and let rest for 15 minutes. Invert, cut through the plastic wrap and unmold onto a serving plate, leaving a 1/2–inch rim to prevent excess moisture. Top with roasted nuts, and serve.

title: Grilled Lamb Shoulder, Slow Cooker Mexican Style
ingredients: 4 lbs lamb shoulder | 2 teaspoons chili | 4 ounces chunky salsa
instructions: Cut lamb into 12 portions and sprinkle with two teaspoons of chilli. Place meat and salsa in a plastic bag for about half an hour to marinating. Cook in the slow cooker on high setting for 30 minutes. Turn, leave for 10 minutes, then turn again, leave for another 10 minutes or so, until the lamb is cooked to your liking. Serve on your favorite bed of rice or noodles.

title: Spanish Stir-Fry Recipe (Microwave)
ingredients: 1 medium green bell peppers or 1 medium red bell pepper, julienne-cut | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Place bell pepper in microwavable bowl.

Random Ingredients: strawberry,confectioner ' sugar,lettuce head,burrito flour tortilla,italian sausage,ranch dressing,orange peel
title: Grilled Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 4 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1/2 cup italian sausage, casing removed ( hot, sweet or mild to your liking ) | 1 lettuce head, torn | 1 cup strawberry | 4 teaspoons orange peel | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons prepared ranch dressing ( homemade or ready-made )
instructions: Place 1 tortilla on a work surface. Using the smooth side of a mallet, pound the tortilla until 1/4 inches or so thick. Remove from pan and set aside. Grill sausages over medium heat for 4 - 6 minutes on each side, or until done. Slice sausage into 1/2 thick pieces and set aside as well. Tear the lettuce into shreds, place in a bowl, add the strawberries and stir to mix. Toss the lime peel and orange peel into the lettuce. Add the warm sausage slices and toss to coat with the peel. Heat a grill pan or electric griddle to medium high. Lightly brush both sides of the tortilla with olive oil and grill for one side until done. Roll toasted sides up and place on a platter. Pour the salad on top and garnish as desired.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,extra tofu,serrano pepper,walnut,greek seasoning,tomato green chilies,cocoa,tortilla chip
title: Tofu and Cheese Santa Fe
ingredients: 1 cup extra firm tofu, drained | 1 teaspoon extra-light tasting cocoa | 2 tablespoons walnuts | 1 tablespoon green bell pepper ( optional ) | 1 - 1 1/2 serrano pepper, seeded and minced ( or 1/2 red ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1 small tomatoes and green chilies ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons green bell peppers, diced ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon whole grain sweet tortilla chips, crushed ( or crushed wheat tortillas )
instructions: If using the tofu, crush to remove excess moisture if desired. Combine the walnuts, green pepper, and salt. Lightly spray a 12 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Spread the tofu evenly over the pan bottom. Sprinkle on the greek seasoning. Pour the tomatoes on top and sprinkle with the bell pepper and nuts. Pour the water from the tomatoes on top of the tofu. Sprinkle the cheese on top. If using the chili peppers, place in hot water and cook for approximately 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until desired level of heat is reached. To serve, place chips on plate and top with crumbled cheese.

title: Hominy Tacos
ingredients: 2 lbs ground turkey or 2 lbs beef | 3 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 8 ounces drained canned hominy | 8 ounces ranch dip | 2 tablespoons capers
instructions: In large skillet add turkey or beef and 1 tsp beef bouillon. Add cumin and hominy. Bring to boil and then turn down to simmer for 15 minutes. Serve on warm corn tortillas. Garnish with capers if desired.

title: Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 8 medium sweet potatoes | 3 stalks celery, thinly sliced | 2 mangoes, peeled and diced | 1/2 small sweet onion, finely chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, remove pits and cool under running water. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Coarsely chop celery and mango. Mix all ingredients except vinegar together. Pour vinegar over top and toss gently. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: beef consomme,icing sugar,jalapeno chile,pickling salt,tomatillo,white pepper,crouton,water
title: Tomatillo Sauce (Tomato Sauce)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds tomatillos, husks removed and diced | 1 jalapeno chile, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup water | 2 tablespoons pickling salt | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 cup water | 1 can condensed beef consomme | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 3/4 cups dry bread croutons
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, mix the tomatillos with 1 jalapeno and 1/2 cup water. Season with 1 teaspoon salt, white pepper and 1 cup water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes, or until soft. Remove from heat, cool, then chop. Meanwhile, in a saucepan over medium heat, stir together the condensed beef consomme, 1/4 cup water and remaining jalapeno. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and enough bread crumbs to coat. Cover and refrigerate until cold. To serve, spoon some of the warm sauce into each individual baking dish, and top with a sprinkle of croutons and some of the tomato sauce to finish.

title: French Roast Lamb!
ingredients: 6 lbs whole leg of lamb | 1 bulb of garlic, bulbs separated and peeled | 1 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup cold water
instructions: Preheat oven to 250f degrees, 450 degrees. Place lamb in a baking dish. Insert garlic bulb inside. Cover lamb with ketchup and pour water on top. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 c of garlic salt,. Place into a preheated oven and cook in the oven for 2 to 3 hours or until lamb is tender, falling off bone as it rests. Let sit for 5 - 10 minutes before carving and serving.

title: Yogurt Cheese With Diced Lemons
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 small lemon, juiced | 1 cup grated cotija cheese
instructions: In a glass bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, and grated cotija cheese. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until chilled.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,red curry paste,basil pesto,tomato sauce,plain flour,leek,vegemite,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Minty Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 8 ounces plain flour | 7 ounces rajad dal, minced | 6 ounces leeks, chopped | 1 packet old bay cream cheese, room temp | 1 tablespoon vegemite, melted | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, room temperature ( neufchatel ) | 1 tablespoon basil pesto
instructions: Sauce, preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix all the ingredients together except the cream cheese and the pesto in a bowl. Put the mixture into a non metallic bowl and cover in clingfilm. Place in the fridge for 1 hour. Spread the cream cheese on a baking tray, then cover with a layer of the chopped vegemite. Cover with a top piece of plastic wrap, then spray the pesto on the top layer. Bake for 25 - 30 mins, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: polenta,green bell pepper,golden raisin,wine,red curry paste
title: Thai Polenta Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry wine | 1 teaspoon red curry paste or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 cup polenta | 1/2 cup fresh green bell pepper | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Place wine and curry paste in pan, bring to a boil and then simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, place polenta in strainer and press out excess liquid and set aside. Combine the bell pepper and raisins with the sweet wine and transfer to an oven safe bowl. Spread a good dollop of the sweet wine on your hands and spread polenta on top. Roll and seal. Place into 350º oven for 25 minutes or until slightly tender.

Random Ingredients: black tea,cayenne pepper,baking potato,orange juice,hot red chili pepper,yellow squash
title: Cha Cha's African Grilled Vegetables (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes ( like yukon gold ) | 1 large yellow squash ( if you are not vegan, just substitute your favourite squash ) | 1 -2 hot dried red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 4 oranges, juice of ( add lemon juice as needed, too ) | 4 cups cold unsalted black tea or 4 cups hot strong tea | cayenne pepper ( optional )
instructions: Scrub the potatoes and the yellow squash under running water.

title: Yummy & Spicy Grilled Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 6 ounces chopped mild red chiles | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 12 ounces fresh cheese sticks, about
instructions: Puree chilies and sugar in a food processor. Stir in lime juice and place skewerers on a board. Toss cheese with mixture, pressing down with your hands to get a well coated. Grill skewers for 2 minutes. Turn skewers and grill for a further 3 to 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,vanilla essence,egg noodle,poppy seed,pomegranate syrup,garam masala,orange juice,bay seasoning tm
title: My Noodle Recipe
ingredients: 150 g egg noodles, cooked | 2 tablespoons pomegranate syrup ( pomegranate essence ) | 1 yellow onion, diced | 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped | 1 pinch garam masala | 1 packet poppy seed | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning tm
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water following instructions on pkg. Instructions. Mix pomegranate essence and pomegranate essence mixture in a pan and fry onions and garlic until fragrent. Add prawns and fry. Add prawns and fry. Add spices packet and orange juice mixture and cook till prawns are almost firm, stirring occasionally. Serve with plain steamed jasmin rice.

title: Sweet Thai Cabbage for Stir-Fry or Sandwich Maker?
ingredients: 1 red cabbage, medium | 3/4 cup sunflower seeds, dry roasted | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients except cabbage in bread maker. Add 1/2 tablespoons of fish sauce into the bread maker. Turn on and fry until desired consistency. If cooking ahead, remove when it is slightly browned and crisp.

title: Tahini Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1 -2 lb brown lamb shank, trimmed, cut into 8 serving-size pieces | 1/3 cup toasted slivered almonds or 1/3 cup chopped roasted unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 tablespoon light mussels, cleaned, debearded | 3/4 teaspoon lightly crushed saffron or 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 4 cups loosely packed torn fresh mussels, scrubbed
instructions: In a 2 1/2 to 3 quart heavy pot over high heat, arrange lamb pieces, skin sides up, in a single layer and sprinkle the almonds evenly over them. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the lamb is just tender, about 45 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in roasted peanuts, sun dried tomatoes, tahini, mussels, saffron and cardamon and transfer to a 3 quart platter. Serve hot.

title: Lemon grass Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large red potatoes | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon minced lemongrass, tough outer leaves removed, outer leaves removed
instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise into slices of 1/4 inch thickness. Coat potatoes with butter and lemon grass.

title: Crispy Mint Rice Wraps
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 -2 tablespoon cilantro ( to taste-chopped fine, or use thai basil ) | 1/2 cup freshly chopped mint leaf ( or use thai basil ) | 2 scallions, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 lime, cut into wedges ( or to a small bowl of lime juice )
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on package, and add the cilantro, mint leaves, scallions, and mustard seeds. Remove from heat and let set 10 minutes. Divide rice mixture among the lime wedges.

title: Sun Dried Tomatoes in Coconut Cream
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 1 1/2 cups coconut cream
instructions: Rinse the sun dried tomatoes from the oil and roll them in warm water until they are saturated. In a steamer put the coconut cream in the pot, bring to boil and then turn off the heat when you can pierce the skin of the tomatoes with a fork. Stir the tomatoes and let them sit for 5 - 10 minutes. Do not let them sit until you want to serve so they remain white in the cream as the tomatoes break down. Take them out and enjoy note, the coconut cream is not only to absorb the sun dried tomatoes and the remaining soaking water that will float on top. I use this when i roast the tomatoes by rubbing with my hands.

title: Spicy Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 yellow onion, sliced thin | chili powder
instructions: Fill a large pot with enough water to fill the pot about halfway. Place green beans and onions in the water. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium. Simmer until tender, and about 20 minutes. The longer the beans soak, the softer it becomes.

title: Authentic Barbuda Pork Sausages
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin roast, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can jalapeno chiles, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon jalapeno chile, deseeded finely | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Line a 10 x 8 inch heavy baking dish with plastic wrap. Add pork, turning so that all sides are coated. Cover and chill at least 8 hours or overnight. Remove pork from marinade and roll in remaining coating. Grill sausages on a hot griddle or nonstick pan until done, or, heat griddle pan to medium heat. Serve warm.

title: Cafe Rio Peanut Soup (With Peanuts)
ingredients: 2 cups unsalted peanuts, salted with skin | 3 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1/4 cup ground culantro ( to taste )
instructions: Blend peanuts and their liquid with vegetable broth in blender until well mixed then place in soup pot and stir in culantro and return to simmer. Cook 30 - 60 minutes.

title: Grilled Asparagus With Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1/2 lb asparagus, trimmed | 1 cup freshly shredded coconut milk | 1 large frisee, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Place asparagus and 1 cup coconut milk in a large, heavy skillet over moderate heat. Cook, turning occasionally, until asparagus is tender when pierced with a fork, about 5 minutes. Drizzle each piece with a little of the remaining coconut milk, and season to taste with salt. Top with frisee, drizzle with remaining coconut milk and cook until frisee is tender crisp, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,clam juice,mussel,maraschino cherry,herbes de provence,chili oil,broiler fryer chicken
title: Gino's Broiled Sole
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 2 lbs fresh fish, such as shrimp, cod or 2 lbs rockfish roe | 8 fluid ounces clam juice | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 dash herbes de provence | 1 dash fines herbes de provence | 10 maraschino cherries
instructions: Place rack in broiler pan in middle of oven and preheat broiler. Preheat oven to 425°f line cookie sheet with foil. Cut fish into six pieces each and arrange over rack. Bake 8 - 10 minutes and drain fat. In a bowl, mix clam juice, herbes de provence and fines herbes de provence. When fish is finished baking, remove from oven and place on rack and dry off under broiler. While fish is drying, place cherries in bowl of cold water, cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight if possible. To serve, place fish on platter and put cherry on top and squeeze juice from cherries into juice.

title: Baked Apricot Cheese
ingredients: 1 pint cherry tomatoes ( halved ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 12 kalamata olives ( roughly chopped, approximately 2/3 cup ) | 2 cups imitation crabmeat, picked over
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200°c. Mix all the ingredients together really well. Place the cheese on a baking tray and spread evenly. Sprinkle over the olives. Sprinkle with extra chopped olives. Put the tray in the oven and bake for about 3 - 5 mins until the cheese is lightly browned and the edges are starting to crisp up.

title: Quick and Easy Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | garlic powder or other seasoning ( or other garlic flavor )
instructions: Heat your grill. Take one tortilla at a time and place on it. Spread a thin layer of garlic powder on half of the tortilla. Add a little garlic. Roll the tortilla and place on the grill. Repeat the process until all the tortillas are done. Place each tortilla on a baking sheet. When all of the tortillas are done, take out the foil and place the tortillas in a baking pan. Bake until tortillas are soft. It should take about 20 - 30 minutes to cook. Sprinkle on any or all of the seasonings. Yum.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,white flour,bean,italian seasoning,red chili powder,walnut
title: Italian Appetizer Bread
ingredients: 1 cup refried beans | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried red chili powder | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f. Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan, and set aside. Combine refried beans, flour, pineapple juice, basil, chili powder and ground nuts in a bowl. Spread the bean mixture evenly into the pan, and bake 40 minutes and 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Liangban Yang Yu (Potato Rice With Fenitos)
ingredients: 1 lb potato, peeled | 1/2 cup glutinous rice ( mochi ) | 1 -2 hot red chili pepper, stemmed | 1/4 cup sage leaf, loosely packed, chopped
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large bowl. Use a fork to mash the potatoes against the sides of the bowl until the potato slices are completely submerged. Bring water to a boil in a large pot. Add the rice and cook over high heat, stirring occasionally so that the water continues to boil vigorously. Boil rapidly for about 5 minutes. Drain the potatoes, and place in a large bowl. Add the chiles and sage and mix well. Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: pasta,kidney bean,thyme,veal stock beef,green enchilada sauce,vinegar
title: Green Chili Verde
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground veal or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 1 can diced green enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups veal stock, heated ( or 1 1/2 cups beef stock or water ) | 1/2 cup fresh chopped tomato and green enchilada sauce | 8 -10 cups leftover kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( you can use other beans ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 3 tablespoons vinegar ( can sub white wine also )
instructions: Brown ground veal with can of drained tomatoes and green enchilada sauce. Drain well and set aside. Put all of the sauce and meat in a large pot and heat on medium heat for about 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Add the beans and seasonings and cook 3 minutes more. Remove from heat and stir. Add vinegar. Serve warm topped with parmesan cheese if desired. Note, you can also use ground chicken instead of turkey.

title: Simple Spiced Slabs (Aussie Style)
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 12 ounces of meatballs of your choice or 12 ounces hamburgers, cut into 1 inch chunks ( i use extra lean hamburger if that is all i can find ) | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium non stick frying pan over medium high heat. Add in the garam masala, baking powder and fry for a minute stirring continuously until golden. Lower the heat and add in the meatballs and water chestnuts.. Cover and cook for 10 minutes or until all the water has been absorbed by the meat and has turned a rich golden color, stirring once or twice. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,double cream,salt,nonfat plain yogurt,italian dressing,white flour
title: Balsamic Balsamic Yogurt Scones
ingredients: 3 cups sifted all purpose white flour | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup light balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons fat-free italian dressing | 1 3/4 cups nonfat plain yogurt | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 3/4 tablespoons light balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. To make the dough, combine flour and salt in mixing bowl. Make a well in center, then add vinegar, italian dressing and yogurt. Beat with a fork. Add enough dressing to form a wet, but slack dough. Place on a lightly floured surface, then knead for 5 minutes, adding more dressing if necessary. Dough shouldn't be sticky. Divide dough in half. Form each half into a circle to fit baking sheets. Sprinkle top with vinegar. Bake for 15 minutes, then remove scones from baking sheets and let rest for 5 minutes before cutting across. Serve immediately.

title: Ground Beef Stuffed Almonds
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground almonds | 2 lbs ground beef
instructions: Dump the ground beef into a bowl, crumble it, and set aside. Add the almonds to the ground beef and stir until moistened. Preheat oven to 350&deg.

title: Vegan Mexican Avocado Dip
ingredients: 1 avocado, peeled and seeded | 0.5 can sultanas ( i love raisins ) | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1/8 teaspoon green cardamoms, lightly crushed ( or 1/8 tsp ground ) | 2 tablespoons stevia | corn tortilla chips ( or crushed )
instructions: Stir together all ingredients with a wire whip or regular blender. Keeps up to 6 days in refrigerator. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Italian Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bucatini pasta ( or pasta of your choice ) | 1 can chicken gravy | 2 cans black beans, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Brown vegetables with 2 tablespoons of butter. Mix both cans of beans and gravy together. Drain noodles and add to the pot. Mix well, cover and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Oven Fish
ingredients: 1 package pepperoni | 2 ounces tomato-basil chunky salsa | 1/3 cup soymilk | 1 large cabbage, cut into 3/4-inch wedges | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 lb cod fish fillet
instructions: In a 12 skillet, layer pepperoni slice, salsa, meat, cabbage wedges and tomatoes. Place over medium heat. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until cabbage is tender.

title: Kalamata Olive Salad
ingredients: 1 package pitted kalamata olives | 1 head iceberg lettuce, outer leaves removed | 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese, shredded
instructions: In a salad bowl, cut the romaine into bite size pieces. Slice the top off of the lettuce. Place the romaine in a large skillet, and drizzle with olive oil. Cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally for 2 minutes. Toss in the olives. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese, and remove from heat. Serve warm, or allow to cool a few minutes before serving.

title: Korean Style Sweet and Sour Dipping Sauce (Jangjorim)
ingredients: 1 lime ( halved and rinsed ) | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar
instructions: Wipe the lime rind with a paper towel. Cut off the white pith. Cut the peel crosswise into strips that are 5” long. Place in a small bowl of cold water to remove excess water. Add the lime peel and chili paste. Stir thoroughly to combine, then cover and let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes. Drain the lime peel and set aside. Pour the remaining 1 t of vinegar into a skillet or griddle set over medium low heat, until just barely bubbling. Using a slotted spoon, drain off the lime peel on paper towels. Place the lime strips into the hot skillet or griddle.

title: Spicy Spicy Steamed Beetroot
ingredients: 400 g canned pink beets | 150 g dried plain flour | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 150 g canned chunk tuna, drained
instructions: Slice the beetroot in half then put it in a microwave safe bowl, add 200g of becnch water and microwave it on high for 2 minutes. Squeeze out excess water and combine the beets with the flour. Pour this mixture in a microwave safe bowl and microwave it on high for another 2 minutes. Stir and serve with other sauce choices.

Random Ingredients: msg,kale,ziti pasta,green curry paste,halloumi cheese,pimiento,cod fillet,tomato soup
title: Fisherman's Kale - Fish and Ziti
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ziti pasta or 1 1/2 cups penne | 1 can tomato soup | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 1 tablespoon chopped pimiento or 1 tablespoon mild italian seasoning | 4 ounces chopped cod or 4 ounces other white fish fillets | 1/4 cup chopped kale | 1/2 cup chopped ham or 1/2 cup salami | 4 teaspoons msg ( msg or any nuts )
instructions: Cook ziti al dente according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Combine tomato soup, curry paste, pimiento and seasoning in a pot over medium heat. Bring to a simmer. Add ziti, cod, greens and ham/salami and allow to cook covered for five minutes. Add msg. Toss well to coat ziti and serve.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,tahini,chili paste,applesauce,leg lamb,vanilla yogurt,chicken sausage
title: Roasted Korean-Style Yogurt Stuffed Whole Leg of Lamb
ingredients: 1 leg of lamb | 2 cups plain vanilla yogurt | 1 cup unsweetened applesauce | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon chili paste ( to taste ) | salt | chili paste, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Spread the whole leg of lamb on a small foil covered baking sheet. Place on the middle rack of the oven and roast at 450 degrees f for 15 minutes. Turn over. Continue to roast for another 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a bowl, whisk together yogurt, applesauce, tahini, chili paste, and salt until smooth. Place the lamb in a large glass baking dish, and turn the lamb to coat. Drizzle chili sauce over the lamb. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with chili paste and serve.

title: Broccoli With Asian Pears
ingredients: 1 head fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 3 asian pears, slices cut into thin wedges
instructions: Place broccoli into a large pot of a barely simmering salted water. Cover and cook until tender, about 6 minutes. Remove broccoli and place on a large serving plate. Add asian pears to the broccoli.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,rigatoni pasta,artichoke heart,molasses,corn syrup,pickling salt,caper,salt
title: Artichoke and Capers Rigatoni
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 cup corn syrup | 3 tablespoons capers, drained | 1 3/4 tablespoons pickling salt | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon pickling salt | 15 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded medium-hot cheddar cheese or 1 1/2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese | salt
instructions: Heat the corn syrup in a medium saucepan to boiling and stir in capers and pickling salt. Simmer for 2 minutes meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Quick & Easy Cornmeal Sliders & Veggies
ingredients: 1 package shredded coleslaw mix | 1 package frozen stew meat | 1 jar pasta sauce | 2 tablespoons yellow cornmeal, or as desired
instructions: Mix coleslaw mix, beef sausage, pasta sauce, and cornmeal together in a bowl. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Fill a 9x13 inch baking dish with enough water to cover the bottom of the dish. Bring the water to a boil in a deep pot. Stir cornmeal into the boiling water until it forms a thick batter. Gently stir in coleslaw mix until well coated.

title: Flammeaux
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas | 1 french baguette, sliced ( about 1/2 inch thick ) | 1 cinnamon stick
instructions: Cut the baguette into 1 1/2 inch wide strips. Slice the french stick thick. Brush each slice liberally with cinnamon stick. Dip each piece in the hot fritter, taking care not to get burned, for about 90 seconds on each side. Serve immediately. If desired, put slices under broiler to char the surface.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,pork sausage,sesame oil,spice,romano cheese,corn oil,white sugar
title: Sausage With Chillies (Karen Baildi)
ingredients: 100 g pork sausage | 3 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon grounded mixed spice | 2 -3 green chilies, washed, ends trimmed, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon grated romano cheese
instructions: In a medium sized dish, pour 1 cup of water and pour it around the sausage to completely submerge it. Let it soak for 15 - 20 minutes so as to prevent it from drying out. After 15 minutes, remove the sausage from the water and pat off the excess water. Slice the sausage into long slices and place it in a mixing bowl. Add the sesame oil and corn oil to the sausage. Mix to thoroughly blend the wet ingredients and set aside for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a clean pan, heat 3 tablespoons of water or oil, and add the mixed spice and grounded mixed spice. Stir constantly for 5 minutes and remove from heat. Add the green chillies and sugar and mix well. Set aside to cool. After 15 minutes, transfer the sausage into the clean pan with the chillies and mix evenly. Sprinkle the grated cheese over and mix well again. Keep aside to cool completely. Serve chilled.

title: Aromatic Italian Mortadella
ingredients: 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, pitted ( about 2 oz. ) | 10 scallion greens ( green parts only, thinly sliced ) | 1/4 cup mortadella, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f coat 2 - 6 inch pieces of heavy foil with nonstick cooking spray, then cut each piece crosswise into 12 - 3 strips. Place cherry in a small shallow bowl.

title: Spaghetti and Mojito Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/2 cup dried mint | 1/2 cup chopped jalapeno peppers
instructions: Stir spaghetti sauce, mint, jalapeno peppers, and remaining ingredients together in a saucepan.

title: Tostitos Crackers
ingredients: 4 ounces self-raising flour | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 4 ounces tostitos
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c or gas mark 6 or gas mark combine flour and cayenne pepper. Use a knife to rub flour into tostitos until it resembles course crumble breadcrumbs. Add the tostitos crumbs and mix thoroughly to make a firm roll. Place onto a greased tray. Bake for about 5 - 10 minutes. Variation, tostitos add 1 tablespoon of chopped egg to the crumbs when baking, but they can be eaten straight away. If you add a little more flour when baking, the crumbs will absorb more of the moisture and become crisp.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,nutmeg,mint leaf,creole seasoning,rice,mustard powder,baking powder,lemonade concentrate
title: Cranberry Bread
ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice ( can be a little fluffier ) | 1 can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons nutmeg | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried mint leaves or 2 -3 tablespoons fresh mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a 9 x 5 x 2 x 1 loaf pan or a loaf pan. In a large bowl, stir together all ingredients. Pour mixture into the pan. Bake for 40 - 50 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before slicing. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Coconut Ginger Nests
ingredients: 1 cup chopped peeled fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar | 8 poblano chiles ( roasted, peeled, seeded, chopped ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil | 1 lb shell pasta
instructions: Mix ginger, turmeric, and sugar. Heat a skillet over medium high. Add poblanos and cook for 5 minutes on each side, until lightly browned. Remove from skillet and discard peppers, chili, and spice mixture. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Hot and Spicy Wings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 tablespoon dried hot peppers | 4 lbs chicken wings, separated
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Spread cumin seeds in a shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with dried chiles. In a large deep pot or bowl, add wings. Add enough water to cover. Allow to soak 2 - 4 hours. Drain well. Wings can be eaten.

Random Ingredients: broth,tarragon vinegar,icing sugar,olive oil cooking spray
title: Painted Olive Oil Refiment
ingredients: olive oil cooking spray | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar | 1 cup mixed olive oil & stock ( for frying, water bath and other recipes )
instructions: Heat oil & vinegar to 190f. Add icing sugar & mix thoroughly. Pour into a bowl & refridgerate until desired consistency is achieved. When ready to use, dip a dipping tray into the olive oil & swirl around to coat the oil and coat evenly.

title: Lamb With Pistachios and Herbs
ingredients: 500 g thin halibut lamb | 2 tablespoons fresh-ground black pepper | 200 g spanish white wine | fresh oregano leaves | soda water, to taste | 100 g thin blanched shelled pistachios | 1 piece uncooked shortcrust lemon rind
instructions: Trim excess fat off the lamb. Season the lamb with salt and freshly ground pepper and rub all over with pepper on both sides. Place the lamb in a shallow glass or ceramic dish and pour 300ml overage of white wine. Remove the livers from the wine and place in the marinade and set aside for 1 hour to allow the flavours to infuse. Remove the livers from the marinade and pat dry. Heat a frying pan over high heat. Add the remaining wine and then the meat and gently brown it evenly on all sides. Add the herbs and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes until the wine starts to reduce. Remove the meat to a plate. Cook the pistachio nuts in a pan of simmering water for 1 - 2 minutes until golden. Drain the nuts and return them to the pan, dry them out a little and toss with the pistachios. Drain any excess juices from the pan and add the lemon rind. Serve at once with rice or pasta.

title: Chipotle-Honey Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut cream, thickened | 1/2 cup honey | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon dried pecans, or more if needed
instructions: Whisk coconut cream, honey, chipotle powder, and pecans together in a bowl.

title: Blueberry Smoothie
ingredients: 2 cups fresh blueberries or 2 cups frozen blueberries | 1 cup apple juice, chilled ( or apple cider vinegar mixed with 2 tbsp apple juice is nice ) | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender. Blend till you have slushy smoothie consistency and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,sherry,asafoetida powder,lettuce leaf,red chili pepper,ziti pasta,brown basmati rice
title: Zesty Yellow Pepper & Ziti
ingredients: 200 g ziti pasta, dry | 2 large yellow bell peppers, seeded, minced | 4 teaspoons dry sherry | 2 red chili peppers, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 4 large lettuce leaves, shredded | 240 g brown basmati rice, soaked for 20 minutes and then drained
instructions: Heat oven to 200c, spray oven proof dish with cooking spray and bring to boil in simmering water. Add ziti to the boiling water and cook for 5 minutes or until firm. Drain, and set aside to cool before draining again. Cook ziti in boiling water for 2 mins, until just tender. Drain, and set aside with pepper. Toast red chilies in a dry frypan over medium heat, stirring occasionally until fragrant. Remove from heat. Place in a bowl and add sherry, chili slices and asafoetida. Stir well with a large spoon. Place ziti, cooked peppers and pasta on a large platter, and top with shredded lettuce and rice.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,red chili powder,coriander seed,thai fish sauce,brandy,kidney bean,biscuit
title: Kidney Bean Biscuits
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 6 ounces coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 12 pieces biscuit | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons rum | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle with a little sesame seeds. Roll in biscuit crumbs, then place on a greased oven tray and bake at c for 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Tuna and Kale Mole
ingredients: 4 tuna steaks, approximately 1 inch thick | 400 g kale, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan and spray with oil spray. Pour in your choice of chokes, stalks, or kale. Season and leave to cook gently.

title: Eggs with Shallots
ingredients: 2 eggs | 1/4 cup diced shallots
instructions: In medium skillet over medium heat, warm egg until the edges begin to pull away from the sides of the skillet, about 2 minutes. Carefully remove and set on a paper towel lined plate and dab hard with a fork. While the egg is still hot, in the skillet, add shallots. Scramble egg and stir in shallots. Serve.

title: Tandoori Broth (Fish Stock)
ingredients: 2 whole black cardamom pods | 3 cups fish stock
instructions: In a medium bowl, put cardamom pods, and pour fish stock in. Heat until you can hear the popping noise from the pan. Let simmer 5 minutes, then open can. Ladle broth into bowls with a slotted spoon. Serve in broth along with sliced cucumber, fresh or dried red chilis.

title: Spinach With Maple Syrup and Fresh Green Chiles
ingredients: 32 ounces baby spinach | 1 -2 tablespoon maple syrup ( to taste ) | 1 -2 small fresh green chili, chopped
instructions: Wash spinach thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: cognac,tequila,oregano leaf,greek olive,tuna olive oil,parsnip,green pea
title: Tuna, Parsnip, and Olives With Cognac
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 -3 drop cognac | 3 -4 fresh parsnips | 2 -4 tablespoons frozen green pea | 3 -5 tablespoons medium smoked tuna in olive oil, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons tequila, to taste | 1/3 cup pitted greek olive, chopped
instructions: For marinade, in small bowl add oregano, cognac, parsnips, peas, tuna, and tequila. Mix to combine. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Serve over greens if desired. Or, you can make the salad a day in advance, cover and refrigerate for flavors to develop.

title: Sweet Bean, Spinach, and Barley Pilaf (A Memory from a friend of mine)
ingredients: 2 cups quick pearl barley | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cooked spinach | 1/2 cup raisins | 3/4 cup chopped onion | 3 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice cooking sherry ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped candied cherry | 1 dash cayenne pepper | 8 -12 ice cubes ( a little more if you need them )
instructions: Bring several cups of water to a boil in a large pot to a boil. Add barley and cook covered until the barley is tender. Drain all but 2/3 of the water. Add the pearl barley and cook until just tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and let sit uncovered for a few minutes to allow steam to escape. Remove the cooked barley from the pan and save. Save the rice cooking liquid for later. Place the rice and reserved cooking liquid in a bowl and add the cooked spinach, raisins, onion, and mirin mixture. Add a little cooking liquid if the mixture is too dry. Mix well, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to 12 hours before serving, and serve at room temperature with ice cubes. Note, if serving a few people, make sure the rice and spinach are mixed well before eating, but not to go into the refrigerator.

title: Lobcracker Bread (Lobscouse)
ingredients: 12 -14 slices bread, crusts removed | 3 1/2 ounces cream cheese ( or cottage cheese )
instructions: Spread cream cheese on each slice of bread, but not too heavily. Place 1 slice of bread into a microwavable pie bowl. Microwave the remaining slice of bread on high for about 30 seconds per slice if using whipped cheese, which should make enough to spread to the desired moistness.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,salad oil,almond extract,red wine vinegar,corn cob,romaine lettuce,egg
title: Salad With Corn on the Cob & Eggs
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 1 romaine lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 1 corn on the cob, shucked and kernels removed | 3 roma lettuce, torn into bite size pieces | 4 eggs | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon almond extract | 1/4 cup salad oil
instructions: Arrange the lettuce, corn and tomato on individual plates. Beat the eggs & red wine vinegar together. Stir in the almond extract until the mixture begins to set. Drizzle the salad with the oil and olive oil. Serve immediately.

title: Simple Ouzo Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces mixed mushrooms | 1 tablespoon ouzo | 1 basil
instructions: Prepare mushrooms. I wash them off so they smell slightly warmer while i cook. Put the mushrooms in a small pan. Add ouzo and basil. Let it sit for about 15 - 20 minutes and then enjoy.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,kielbasa sausage,black mustard seed,turmeric powder,golden raisin
title: Kielbasa Spice Mix
ingredients: 12 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 6 tablespoons golden raisins | 6 tablespoons kielbasa sausage | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 2 teaspoons finely grated orange peel
instructions: Grind the mustard seeds using two knives or a grinder. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Store in a airtight container. To use, mix 1 tablespoon in a small glass bowl with 2 teaspoons of oil.

title: Mama Cora's Balsamic Colby Cheese Spread
ingredients: 3 ounces colby cheese, sliced | 7 ounces mixed olives | 1 -2 garlic clove | 6 tablespoons pistachios, roughly chopped | 1/4 cup red-wine balsamic vinegar ( for basting sauce ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic | 1/4 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Put all the ingredients through the blender together, and pulse briefly until combined. Add more red wine vinegar if it is too thick. Serve immediately.

title: Baked Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1/3 cup basil | 1/2 cup coriander powder ( or 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper ) | 2 cans crispy corn tortilla chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to in food processor or blender, combine basil, coriander and crushed red pepper. Pulse until well mixed but not liquefied. Spread a third of chip on an ungreased baking sheet and spread evenly. Sprinkle with half the dry herb mixture. Sprinkle with half the remaining chips. Bake at 400 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes or until chips are crispy and chips are golden.

title: Hot Duck Bites

instructions: Stir soup, peppercorns, basil and rosemary together.

Random Ingredients: baking cocoa,sirloin,green cardamom,black peppercorn,dark sesame oil,cottage cheese,hazelnut
title: Frikadeller
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin, trimmed & cut into thin slices | 1 cup cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons baking cocoa | 1 tablespoon roasted hazelnuts, chopped | 3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 4 green cardamoms | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a ziplock bag and squish around to mix well. Put in refridgerator for at least 2 hours before cooking. Shake bag every 30 minutes, and cook the slurry on the grill for about 12 minutes. Taste and correct for seasoning.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,ginger paste,italian bread,yellow pepper,arrowroot,hard egg,oyster sauce,cardamom
title: Fried Eggs II
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 pinch cardamom | 2 ounces vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 pinch ground cardamom | 1/3 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 1/2 teaspoons orange zest or 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest | 4 -8 tablespoons vegetable oil or 4 -8 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup peeled and finely chopped yellow pepper ( i use red )
instructions: Peel eggs, remove egg yolks. Cut the egg whites in half and place on a plate. Cut a sliver from the pointed top back of each boiled egg, without cutting back in its shell. Cut halves into halves again with slivers of egg removed at the side of the egg whites. Cut into slivers at an angle. Mix the ginger paste with 1/2 tsp water, and then stir it into the beaten egg yolks. Heat oil in a wok, until smoking. Put one egg piece into the wok, and cook for 2 minutes, turning once and shaking the wok. When the whites are browned, take it out of the wok and place into a warm bowl with a towel, keeping it warm. Heat some oil in the wok. Stir fry vegetables about 2 min until golden, being careful not to burn them too quickly. Add remaining sauce and ginger paste, cook, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Put the egg yolk mixture back onto the wok and beat well with a fork. Stir fry about 10 minutes, until egg yolk mixture is thickened. Serve warm over cooked egg whites.

title: Grilled Veggies With Apple
ingredients: 1 large portabella mushroom, stems removed, quartered | 3 firm tomatoes, such as fuji, plum tomatoes or 3 medium tomatoes | 3 bananas, large chunks | 1 granny smith apple, ripe, peeled, cored and cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 tablespoon tamari, for sprinkling | 4 tablespoons low-sodium tomato sauce | 1/2 cup stuffed olive
instructions: Heat a small skillet over moderate heat. Place mushrooms in skillet. Slice tomatoes. Arrange tomatoes and bananas on top of mushrooms. Cook over low heat until vegetables are just crisp tender. Transfer mixture to a bowl. Preheat large nonstick griddle over medium heat, add 1 t. Tamari and grill mushrooms 5 - 6 minutes, stirring constantly, until browned. Transfer to a plate. Grill apples 5 - 6 minutes on each side. Meanwhile, add remaining t. Tamari to skillet and cook 1 minute. Place remaining tomatoes over the mushrooms, drizzle with some sauce, and cover. Grill 4 - 5 minutes or until tomatoes become juicy. Transfer to plates and top with olives.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,taco seasoning mix,apple juice,asparagus spear,sharp cheddar cheese,yellow squash
title: Asparagus and Yellow Squash Tacos
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus spears | 1 large apple, cored, peeled, cut into 6 wedges | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 6 wedges | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 - 1 1/2 lb sharp cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Cook asparagus, zucchini, and apple with taco seasoning. Mix together apple juice and juice and serve as is or divide over 4 taco shells. Top with grated cheese.

Random Ingredients: thai chili sauce,asparagus,egg wrap,corn kernel,large shrimp
title: Chinese Spring Rolls ( Spring Rolls With Shrimp and Egg Roll Variations)
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, cut into 1/4-inch diagonally length, stems trimmed | 1/2 lb large shrimp, shelled, deveined, tails removed | 6 large thai sweet chili sauce ( mae ploy brand works best ) | 1 package thai egg roll wraps | 1/2 cup corn kernel ( optional )
instructions: Prepare filling by combining shrimp, sweet chili sauce and corn kernel. Set aside. Preheat oven to 375°f. Place a sheet of parchment paper on a cookie sheet. Random Ingredients: lima bean,spanish onion,corn oil,madeira wine,spaghetti noodle
title: Spanish Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup madeira wine | 1/4 cup corn oil | 2 cups chopped spanish onions | 1 cup frozen lima beans | 1 package thin dry spaghetti noodles | 2 tablespoons madeira wine
instructions: Heat about 6 inches of oil in a large frying pan. Add onions and cook over low heat until transparent. Turn heat up to medium high and cook about 5 minutes. Drain the onions and dump them into a bowl. Set aside. Heat the other tablespoon of oil in the pan, add drained noodles and stir fry, separating them with a spatula. Drain the noodles in a colander. Fry the noodles 5 minutes, or until lightly toasted. Remove from heat. Add 1/4 cup madeira to the oil. When it starts to bubble, add the remaining 1/4 cup madeira. Add about 1/4 cup lima beans. Cook over medium heat for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring until the beans are warm. Add the rest of the makeira. Stir occasionally. Serve.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,tart apple,margarine,tap water,white onion,coffee,pearl barley
title: Apple and Barley Scones
ingredients: 225 g pearl barley | 1/4 cup margarine, melted | 1 medium white onion, finely chopped | 1 cup self raising flour | 1/2 cup self-raising flour | 125 g chopped tart apples | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1 tablespoon hot tap water
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c. Place the barley in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,cider vinegar,ra el hanout spice mix,sauce,carrot,self rising flour,pork tenderloin
title: Tasty Easy Moroccan Pork (Dry )
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 4 tablespoons dry sauerkra-falaf mix | 14 ounces rotel tomatoes | 1/2 cup onion, coarsely chopped ( or 1 green onion, sliced ) | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons a.1. original sauce ( or other flavor enhancer ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix ( moroccan mixed spice blend )
instructions: Cut the pork into 1 cubes. Sprinkle the pork with salt and let rest at room temperature for 30 minutes. Place the meat on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Place the roasting pan in the oven for 15 or 20 minutes, or until the internal blood temperature registers 165°f. Place the pork, if using, in a medium bowl and stir in the saurkra latin sauce or other seasoning mix.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,okra,red pepper flake,lamb chop,celery rib,spanish chorizo
title: Lamb Chops With Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 lamb chops | 1 spanish chorizo | 1 red pepper flakes | 4 -6 cups okra, sliced in 1-inch lengths | 5 celery ribs, sliced thinly | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence
instructions: Rinse chorizo and brown in a frying pan with a little oil. Add pepper flakes and celery and sauté until celery is soft. Place chops, chilli mixture and okra into a glass bowl. Pour over the spicy chilli jam and serve straight away, chilled.

title: Creole Remoulade Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup whiskey | 1 1/2 cups fresh whole kernel corn, drained ( about 2 ears ) | 1 lemon peel | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 1 teaspoon paprika ( optional )
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring whiskey to a high simmer. Add corn. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: no boil lasagna noodle,nectarine,flour,pork shoulder,caraway seed
title: Abernathy Nipping Noodle and Piggy Dumplings
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup flour | 1/2 cup caraway seeds | 12 no-boil lasagna noodles | 2 nectarines - peeled, cored and chopped
instructions: Cook and stir pork in a large bowl in boiling water for 5 minutes. Add flour, cajun seasoning to pork. Turn heat to low and cook until mixture is slightly thickened. In a small saucepan cover the nectarines with about 1/2 cup water and simmer over low heat for about 5 minutes. Drain off any excess water and reserve for garnish. Fill a large pot half full with cold water. Bring water to a boil. Add noodles and noodles and stir to separate. Cook noodles for 5 minutes or until tender but not mushy. Stir in reserved nectarines' juice. Place noodles in a serving dish and top with pork mixture. Garnish with reserved nectarines' juice and caraway seeds.

title: Manchego Fondue
ingredients: 1 jar manchego cheese | 2 cubes chicken bouillon, or more to taste
instructions: Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,kosher salt pepper,irish whiskey,chocolate,soy sauce,currant,swiss cheese
title: Irish Chocolate Mint Truffle Balls
ingredients: 1/2 lb shaved swiss cheese ( about 2 cups ) | 1/2 cup currants | 6 tablespoons chocolate-coated candied ginger, finely minced ( about 3/4 inch squares ) | 3 tablespoons kosher salt-free pepper | 2 tablespoons lemonade ( concentrate ) | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce ( low sodium preferred ) | 2 teaspoons irish whiskey
instructions: Combine shaved swiss cheese, currants, 1 tablespoon of the chocolates, ginger, 1 tablespoon of the salt free pepper, and lemonade concentrate in a bowl and stir to combine. title: Grilled Halibut With Pineapple and Cheese Ravioli
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen small cheese ravioli, thawed | 4 halibut fillets | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Heat grill to high. Spray grate with nonstick cooking spray. Place ravioli on grate, skin side down. Grill ravioli until browned and tender, about 5 minutes. Turn ravioli and cook until browned, about an additional 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Drain ravioli in a colander. Add pineapple juice and cream of tartar to salmon fillets in skillet. Cover and cook until salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork, about 4 minutes. Drain ravioli. Serve salmon over grilled ravioli.

title: Quick Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup pepitas | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 2 tablespoons natural yoghurt | 2 teaspoons basil chiffonade
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Place in a small serving dish, sprinkle with basil and serve with corn chips.

title: Poblano Chile Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cans poblano chiles, drained with seeds removed | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 tablespoons cognac | powdered apple, garnish
instructions: Finely chop poblano chilies, mix with ground cinnamon and cognac. Top with a dollop of whipped topping if desired, and serve immediately. Garnish with a pomegranate pith if desired.

Random Ingredients: green bean,chipotle chile adobo,napa cabbage,cannellini bean
title: White Bean and Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 cup napa cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 can napped green beans | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 chipotle chile in adobo ( from can of chipotles )
instructions: Drain all ingredients except cabbage and bean liquid. Chill overnight in refrigerator. Mix all ingredients in large bowl or container. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,icing sugar,shiitake mushroom,italian bread,celery leaf,cream,arugula
title: Mushroom and Arugula Tartlets
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup light cream ( whipping ) | 1/2 cup unbleached icing sugar, sifted ( confectioner's sugar ) | 4 leaves fresh arugula, packed | 2 -3 fresh celery leaves | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Combine mushrooms and sour cream in a small bowl. Cover and chill. Combine icing sugar and arugula in a small bowl. Cover and chill. Remove mushrooms. Using a slotted spoon or tongs, remove any woody bits of the arugula and set aside. Stir raisins into sour cream and set aside. Place 1 tablespoon mushroom mixture in the center of each miniature tartlet. Divide arugula cream between each tartlet. Top with top and bottom. Press a leaf of celery into each tartlet to surround them with the sour cream mixture. Using a spatula, carefully transfer the tartlets to the preheated 375 degree oven or until the crusts are golden brown.

title: Pasta Al Forno
ingredients: 1/3 cup sweet cream | 3 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: Mix cream, tomato paste, and 2 tbsp. Cornstarch in a small bowl. Stir remaining 2 tbsp. Cornstarch into cream mixture just until mixture begins to boil. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture thickens and begins to boil. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Penne With Crab and Soy Milk
ingredients: 1/2 lb dungeness crabmeat | 5 ounces spicy mustard ( we used low-sodium ) | 1 1/2 cups soy milk ( we used low-fat ) | 3 ounces shiitake mushrooms, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon sweet paprika | 1 lb dry penne, cooked according to your package directions
instructions: If using canned crab meat in it's own juices, drain of excess water. Heat the mustard and soy milk in a skillet until hot. Add the crab and mushrooms, mix well, and place in refrigerator to marinate for 20 minutes. Serve over cooked penne.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,white bread,ziploc,water chestnut,broccoli,snow pea pod,chicken broth
title: Wild Forest Chicken (Aka Wild Forest Stew)
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken ( or beef ) | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 slice fresh white bread | 1/2 cup chicken broth ( low sodium is okay ) | 1 bag frozen tart apple | 2 cups raw broccoli, chopped | 1 ziploc bag baby corn peas and sprouts ( or fresh, or frozen )
instructions: In a medium frying pan fry the ground chicken until it just changes color and becomes a nice brown color. Drain chicken. Remove the chicken pieces from pan and set aside. If your pan becomes dry, toast bread in oven. Set aside. If your pan becomes dry, toast the bag of corn pea pods in your oven. Set aside. In your warming pan add olive oil and place all the bread pieces in one layer on your pan. Once the corn turns dark, add the drained chicken, the water chestnuts, fresh bread, and finally add some broth. Continue cooking in medium low heat on the stove until chicken is fully cooked. If for some reason your pan isn't hot enough, the sauce can evaporate in a few minutes. Once the chicken is fully cooked, add the sliced apple slices. Stir to mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: pepper flake,liquid smoke,thyme sprig,purpose flour,baby spinach leaf,beef broth,coriander powder
title: Spinach-Spinach Gravy (Or Spinach-Smoked Beef Spread)

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Pound steak so that it is flattened. Heat olive oil on medium high. Place the steak in hot oil and brown well on both sides. In a small bowl mix stock with enough water to thin it slightly to desired consistency. Pour over steak and spinach, and bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Serve over your favourite grain.

title: Gratinee

instructions: Wash thoroughly the lemons, trim off the peel and stud with a thin rind. Place in a clean saucepan with 5 1/2 tablespoons of the brown syrup and 4 teaspoons of the cinnamon and simmer gently for 10 minutes without raising the temperature and stirring. Remove from the heat, add the remaining syrup and stir thoroughly. Cool slightly, divide mixture into 6 bowls and freeze in airtight containers, covered, for up to 6 months.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,port wine,garlic paste,mustard,garam masala,wheat flour,ginger garlic paste,granny smith apple

instructions: Mix the gram flour and spices. title: Kittencal's Savory Lamb Stuffed With Semolina & Bacon

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place cleaned rack of lamb on large sheet pan. Pound to 1/4 thick. Using a 3 to 5 pounder, carefully hollow 2 1/2 inch deep opening about 1/2 inch thick. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp remaining thyme. Sprinkle top of lamb with remaining 1/2 cup flour and 1/8 teaspoons white salt & 1/4 tsp black pepper. Arrange on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake for about 2 hours or until a meat thermometer reads internal temperature of 130 degrees. Let stand 20 minutes before carving.

instructions: Divide the apples, mushrooms and tennesse into four medallions.

instructions: Rinse lentils and drain. Place in a food processor or blender along with lemon juice and zest and mango chutney. Puree until smooth. Transfer mixture to a bowl, season to taste with seasoned salt.

title: Tortilla Soup

instructions: Mix all ingredients together except tortillas and mix well with hands so as to make sure all ingredients are mixed up well. Spray 9x13 dish with non stick spray. title: Pan-Fried Beef, Canadian Bacon & Tuna Salad

instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. Slice the steak into thin strips. Place the beef strips in a non metallic dish. Top with the smoked Canadian bacon and cover with aluminum foil. title: Tahini Zucchini

instructions: Pierce or slice zucchini in half widthwise, and then thinly slice crosswise into 1 slices. Spread one tablespoon of tahini over each zucchini slice. Cook in an ungreased skillet over medium to medium high heat, stirring frequently, for 2 to 3 minutes.

instructions: Place the gravy, tomato puree, red chile peppers, sugar, and cardamom in a saucepan over low heat and simmer, stirring, for about 5 minutes, until the mixture is reduced to thick, syrupy paste. The mixture can be stored, covered tightly, in the refrigerator for up to 8 days.

title: Spicy Mango Salsa

instructions: Sauté the sausages in a small non stick pan over a medium low heat, turning regularly until browned all over and cooked through. instructions: Toast sesame seeds in a dry 12 inch heavy skillet over medium heat until lightly browned, stirring frequently.

title: Almond, Pepper and Almond Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups water | 1 teaspoon ground almonds | 1/2 cup chopped green pepper
instructions: Put water in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir in the ground almonds and green pepper. Remove the pan from the heat and let cool to room temperature, about 5 minutes. Remove the almond and green pepper and stir to combine.

title: Apple Kaffir Lime Chutney
ingredients: 1 bunch cilantro, leaves only | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves, torn into tiny pieces | 1 cup apple juice
instructions: If using whole fresh cilantro leaves, remove the stalk and leaves before chopping. You can do this by hand, or in a blender. Garnish with additional lime pieces and a cilantro sprig if desired.

title: Pizza Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 3/4 cups corn kernels or 1 3/4 cups fresh corn kernels, cut from cob
instructions: Place flour in a bowl. Add corn or whatever veggies your using is on your corn stocks. Stir till smooth. Add just enough water to make a dropping consistency. The amount and type of water depends on the amount of flour in your corn stocks. Knead on a lightly floured surface till smooth. Roll into a ball, dust with cornstarch if needed and place on a lightly floured pizza pan. Let cook till bubbles appear and then flip and bake till done to your liking. Spread on your favorite toppings.

title: Tropical Green Prawns with Almond
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 4 prawns, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup slivered almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Spray an 8x8 inch pan with cooking spray. Stir graham cracker crumbs, prawns, cilantro, almonds into graham cracker crumbs mixture until well coated.

title: Gourmet Pork Tenderloin With Zinfandel
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 4 plum tomatoes, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons brandy ( to taste ) or 2 tablespoons rum ( to taste ) | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 6 ounces zinfandel | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Place the pork tenderloin on a rack in a baking pan set over 2 - 3 inches of boiling water. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and weigh it down with a heavy dish or a large heavy 2 - 9 oz canning jar. Let stand for 20 minutes. Turn the pork over in the sauce. Add a pinch each of marjoram and 1/2 tsp each of amjoram and parmesan to the pork. Remove the plastic wrap, patting off any excess, lift the tenderloin into the sauce, pressing it firmly against the surface of the pork. Tightly cover with foil, and refrigerate the pork until very cold, at least 2 hours. When ready to serve, drain off any liquid accumulated on the pan juices. Combine the zinfandel and the remaining marjoram in a small bowl, add a spoonful of zinfandel and set aside. Preheat the oven to 325° f. In a small baking pan, cover the pork with foil. Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven until very rare. Remove from heat and let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes. Slice and serve with zinfandel. Note, this is also wonderful as a side dish when using leftover meat from the braising process.

title: Broccoli Crab Cakes
