ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained | 2 cans crabmeat, drained | 1 bunch fresh rosemary, stems removed | 8 ounces water, or as desired - divided
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in broccoli and crabmeat.

Random Ingredients: coffee,mint sprig,grain rice,caraway,radish,chili powder,black olive,self rising flour
title: Irish Soda Bread, Rice and Black Olive Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/4 cups whole grain rice, plus 1.5 cups | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground black olives | 1 cup brewed coffee or 1 cup espresso, mixed with 1/2 tsp. coffee-flavored liqueur ( optional ) | 1 small chili powder or 2 -3 drops sriracha hot sauce ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground caraway | 1 small radish, thinly sliced into rounds | 1/3 cup finely chopped mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Stir the flour and dry ingredients together in a medium bowl with a fork until smooth. Add the rest of the ingredients, stirring just enough to combine. Shape mixture into balls, then flatten with a rolling pin into round patties about 1/2 inch thick. Brush with coffee flavored liqueur, and sprinkle with mint sprigs. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the fritters, and cook, turning with tongs, until golden brown on all sides, about 3 - 4 minutes. Transfer to a rack to cool.

title: South American Sweet Chili Balls
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 package pitted dates
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, mix tacos seasoning mix and dates. Form golf ball sized balls with the mixture. Place on a medium baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,rose water,chinese wine,iceberg lettuce,parsley leaf
title: Chinese Wine Lettuce
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 bottle chinese wine or 1 bottle dry sherry | 2 -4 leaves fresh parsley leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon rose water ( optional ) | chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Tear off some large leaves the larger ones smaller ones if possible. Boil water and put on to boil the lettuce and turn down the heat. When the water boils, remove from heat. Let the lettuce sit for a few minutes to absorb some of the water. Cut it up and lay flat on a serving plate. Dip the lettuce in the juice, and then top with chopped dried parsley, drizzle with chili oil and chillies. Serve with a little more wine or lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,black pepper,white bread,fenugreek,shiitake mushroom,mussel,icing sugar
title: Seafood Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 large shiitake mushrooms, cleaned | 4 tablespoons fresh shanghai gourmet spice ( or 6 -8 drops of granulated sugar ) | sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 4 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup fresh coarse ground fenugreek | 1/4 cup icing sugar or 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 -2 tablespoon mussels, well scrubbed & debearded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 430°f /430°f / gas mark trim the mushroom stems, leaving them intact. Using a spoon, scrape out the soft, gritty insides of a mushroom with a small spoon. Place the stem caps, cut side up, in a small baking dish. Bake in the oven until tender, approx 30 minutes. Remove from the oven and rub off some of the softened mushroom stems. If you did so, put the mushroom caps back in to the oven for a few minutes until they are crisp and the caps become soft. Allow them to cool then chop coarsely. Discard any tough mushroom stems. Using a spoon, gently scoop out the inside of the mushroom caps and discard any damaged mushroom caps. Set aside 1/4 cup of the mushroom stems to make a stuffing for the seafood. To make the stuffing, combine the breadcrumbs, fenugreek and seasoning in a bowl and mix. Set aside in a bowl. Carefully work the reserved mushroom caps and stuffing mixture into the softened breadcrumbs, being careful not to overwork the stuffing. If you want you can stuff the shrimp, mussels or crab into the stuffing and then place the stuffing inside the mushroom caps. If using mussels, sprinkle lightly with more seasoning and arrange on a baking tray. Bake in the oven for approx 20 minutes, until just cooked through, but still very soft when pressed. Serve hot or warm, with thick ice cream, cream or whipped cream if you like.

title: The Huzzy
ingredients: 1 lb fresh linguine or 1 lb spaghetti, cooked al dente | 1/2 lb fresh brie cheese, diced | 4 fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded & minced | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon | 2 tablespoons pickled ginger | 4 slices baguette, cut in half
instructions: Mince the fresh brie cheese and put it into a mixing bowl. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add the chopped jalapenos, fresh ginger, and fry until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the beef and brown slightly, about 2 minutes. Add the rum, beef mixture, and bring to simmer. Cover and cook over low heat 7 minutes. Add the baguette slices and cook 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,chicken bouillon,heavy whipping cream,olive oil,corn tortilla,beef meat,premade puff pastry
title: Enchiladas Con Picadillo - Puff Pastry Lasagna
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces chicken stock or 6 fluid ounces vegetable stock | 1 chicken bouillon | 350 g ground beef or 350 g ground chicken | 1 package premade puff pastry | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 2 ounces heavy whipping cream ( optional ) | 12 corn tortillas, halved crossways
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Heat the stock and bouillon in a small saucepan over a medium heat, stirring until the liquid is reduced by about half. Stir in the ground meat and cook on a slow speed until the meat has changed colour and is starting to leave the bones. Meanwhile, heat a non stick frying pan, add 3 drops of oil and the cream just until it starts to boil and then set aside. To assemble the lasagne, put 1/4 of the puff pastry on the work bench or a baking tray. Put a tablespoon of the meat mixture near the edge of the pastry and fold the pastry over to enclose the meat mixture. Fold over the pastry to enclose the meat and finish rolling out. Repeat with the remaining pastry. Slice off a 2cm piece of pastry around each tortilla halfway through to create a long strip. Repeat with the remaining tortillas, filling and meat. Heat the remaining oil in a deep frying pan. Brown a third of the lasagne in a couple batches. Turn down the heat and spray each frying with oil. Continue to cook the lasagne for 2 - 3 minutes, until golden brown and just firm. Remove, drain on absorbent paper and serve with sauce.

title: Eggplant(Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 8 ounces bacon, chopped | 3 teaspoons dark sesame oil, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom, ground | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf, minced | 2 medium roasted beets, skinned
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Slice crosswise into half inch slices and spread out on paper towels, to dry. Place the eggplant slices skin side down on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes, or until tender. Cut the eggplant slices crosswise and arrange on a platter, along with bacon, sesame oil and cardamom. Sprinkle with cilantro on top.

title: Easy Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 pound ladyfingers | 1 can red enchilada sauce to top ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Lightly grease a deep 8x8 inch baking dish. Toss pork tenderloins with 1 can enchilada sauce to coat, and place in a saucepan. Cover, and cook over medium high heat until the pork is no longer pink, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat, and set aside. Dip ladyfingers into 1 can enchilada sauce just until soaked, and carefully place in the baking dish. Pour remaining can of enchilada sauce over the dipped ladyfingers. Spread half of the remaining 3/4 can of enchilada sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange half of the cooked pork over the sauce, and arrange half of the ladyfinger halves over it. Spread half of the red enchilada sauce over the ladyfinger halves. Layer half of the remaining 3/4 can of enchilada sauce over the ladyfingers, and spread half of the remaining 3/4 can of enchilada sauce over the ladyfinger halves. Top with half of the remainder of the ladyfinger halves, and place the remaining half of red enchilada sauce over the top. Cover dish with aluminum foil, and bake in preheated oven until the juices run clear, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken cutlet,coffee,nutmeg,fine salt,chunky salsa,chili paste garlic
title: Easy Spanish Style Steamed Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fine salt | 1 lb chicken cutlet, 3-4 long sliced into 6 pieces | 1 jar of heaping-chunky salsa | 1/3 cup coffee ( non instant is ok ) or 1/3 cup water ( non instant is ok ) | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/8 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Sprinkle the fine salt over the chicken cutlets and rub them with the salt. Let sit on the counter for about 20 minutes to absorb the salt. In a large pot heat up your beans, water and salsa on medium high heat. Once the salsa is warmed up add the chicken and cook for about 3 minutes. Serve immediately. For the spicy chicken add about 1/8 teaspoon of the nutmeg in the salsa. It does not need to completely melt.

Random Ingredients: sake,shrimp,coconut milk,egg wrap,red pepper flake,italian spice
title: Soy Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup light coconut milk | 1 teaspoon sake ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian spices | 3/4 teaspoon shrimp, peeled | 12 -16 egg roll wraps | 1 teaspoon dried shrimp ( optional )
instructions: In saucepan, combine coconut milk and sake and boil to smooth paste. Add crushed red pepper, italian spices and shrimp and simmer 3 - 4 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool down. In a small bowl, combine 1 t shrimp and egg roll wrappers. Place some coconut mixture down the center of the wrapper and use about 2 t shrimp and about a teaspoon of shrimp mixture along the bottom of the roll. Roll up the wrap, tucking in the ends as needed to make it stick. Seal the edges well and cook on medium heat 15 - 20 minutes or until the rolls are crisp and golden brown on bottom. Serve immediately.

title: Lamb and Walnut Stew
ingredients: 300 g fresh lamb, cut into 3/4 inch pieces | 200 g walnut halves, lightly crushed ( use the coarse blade of your knife ) | 200 g red cabbage, shredded | 2 -3 green chilies | 250 g flour | 1 cup walnut halves ( optional )
instructions: Put the lamb, walnuts, and chilies into the pot and cook until lamb is cooked through and most of the water is absorbed. Add flour and mix well. Add a bit of water as necessary to thicken the gravy and make it more of a stew like consistency. Pulsate the walnut halves if using before serving..

Random Ingredients: half,tahini paste,tomato juice,chinese five spice powder,snow pea,aubergine,cumin
title: Five Spice Breakfast
ingredients: 2 dried chinese five spice blend | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 aubergine, thinly sliced | 2 small tomatoes, chopped | 100 ml half-and-half | 1 tablespoon tahini paste | 100 -150 g snow peas, steamed and sliced
instructions: Cook aubergine in medium saucepan with a splash of water just until tender. Cool and dice into small pieces. In a bowl mix together aubergine, tahini, chillies and most of the fat. Add tahini mix and remainder of fat. Fry chinese five spice powder on medium high heat for 2 - 3 minutes until aromatic. Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until fragrant. Add sauteed aubergine and snow peas and stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes until snow peas are tender crisp.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,catsup,black olive,clove,green pepper ring,bell pepper
title: Italian Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup green pepper ring, chopped | 1/4 cup pitted and sliced black olives | 1/4 cup green pepper ring, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 large cup maraschino cherry
instructions: Place the catsup in a medium saucepan and simmer over low heat, stirring frequently, for 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat, and stir in the remaining ingredients. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

title: Chilled Black Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed tomato soup, undiluted | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 tablespoon horseradish | 3 tablespoons minced fresh parsley | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup hot champagne ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon prepared horseradish ( optional )
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the tomato soup, black beans, molasses, horseradish, parsley, garlic salt and confectioners' sugar. Stir to blend. Slowly stir in hot champagne if using. Cover and chill.

title: Easy Halibut With Zucchini, Ham and Fresh Green cardamom
ingredients: 4 fresh halibut, 6 to 8 ounces each | 1 red fresh green cardamom pod | 2 small zucchini, coarsely grated | 6 ounces smoked ham, shaved | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 4 teaspoons vanilla beans or 4 teaspoons anise-flavored extract
instructions: Pre heat grill or large skillet and brush grate with oil. Rub halibut with cardamom pods to coat with oil. Place zucchini slices on grill/skillet, lightly oiled side down, and grill until lightly browned and tender, about 2 minutes total. Place grilled halibut in 4 deep dishes or bowls. Top each with some chocloate ham and some shaved zucchini. Sprinkle with green cardamom pods, freshly ground black pepper and a pinch of sugar. To make the vinaigrette, stir together vinegar and vanilla until the sugar dissolves. Place the cooked halibut on a warmed serving platter and drizzle vinaigrette over.

title: Artichoke Heart in Vodka
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts ( drained and chopped ) | 4 tablespoons vodka | 1 lime, zest of, grated ( optional ) | 2 1/2 cups fish stock, or | 2 1/2 cups chicken stock
instructions: To make a paste, combine all ingredients except for the artichoke hearts and chicken in a food processor.

title: Real German Pork or Pork With Black Olives
ingredients: 6 thick-cut boneless pork chops ( or any other tender parts you can find ) | 1 small red onion, finely sliced | 1 cup sliced pitted kalamata olives | 2 cups belgian-style beer
instructions: Prick the pork or ask the butcher to do the job, slice the pork thin and place in a bowl with the sliced onion. Add the olives and toss together. Add the beer and toss again. The olives will stay in a glass jar in the fridge until you take them out of the refrigerator, and when you are ready, serve it.

Random Ingredients: season salt,hard egg,anise seed,cake flour,heavy whipping cream,quinoa
title: Danish Aniseed Quinoa Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream ( about 175/375 degrees ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon season-all salt | 2 cups quinoa ( mixtu )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Butter a 1 1/2 quart baking dish or loaf pan with a lid. In a bowl, mash the hard boiled eggs until coarsely chopped. Transfer the egg mixture to a bowl and stir in the cream, aniseed seeds and seasoned salt to taste. Mix thoroughly, then stir in about 1/2 cup of the quinoa and any leftover soaking liquid, about a quarter cup at a time. Transfer the quinoa mixture to the prepared baking dish or loaf pan and spread it into the bottom and up the sides. Cover the dish loosely with a lid or foil and bake for about 50 minutes, until the top is nicely golden and the crust is golden brown.

title: Orange Peel and Mocha Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 package chocolate pudding mix ( vanilla ) | 1 orange peel, candied
instructions: Place all ingredients into a ziplock plastic bag and marinate for one hour. Remove from bag and serve.

title: Lentils and Beer
ingredients: 1 cup lentils | 1 fresh rose water or 1/2 teaspoon dried rose water | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 cup beer | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Rinse the lentils in a pot of boiling water, adding a splash of salt then drain well. Combine the lentils, rose water, chili paste, beer and dried mint in a large saucepan. Place over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are coated with the mixture. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes or until it has thickened to your preference and has absorbed some of the sauce liquid. Remove from the heat and stir in the chopped mint. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: oatmeal,rice vermicelli,cheddar cheese,pork butt,double crust pie,italian seasoning,turkey
title: Easy Pizza Bites
ingredients: 1 frozen single-crust pie crusts | 1/2 pound boneless pork butt, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons rice vermicelli | 3 cups shredded cheddar cheese | 3 1/4 cups shredded cooked turkey | 1/4 cup oatmeal, or as desired
instructions: Place the pie crust onto a baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap. Flatten the crust dough to fit the baking sheet. Place the pork in a freezer bag with the italian seasoning.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,white pepper,chili powder,worcestershire sauce,wine
title: French Dressing II
ingredients: 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 1/2 cups wine
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients.

title: Creamy Dill
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 1/4 cup dijon mustard, grey poupon, onion powder
instructions: In a small bowl, mix sour cream and mustard together until well blended. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve chilled with french bread, crackers, or your favorite breads.

title: Macaroni and Eggplant (Aubergine)  Filling (Bread Machine)
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant ( approx. 9 oz ) | 5 tablespoons shredded coconut ( or to taste ) | 4 eggs | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 cup shredded reduced-fat ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons molasses or 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 3/4 cups uncooked elbow macaroni ( i used barilla ) or 1 3/4 cups fettuccine ( i used barilla )
instructions: Slice eggplant crosswise into 1/8 inch thick strips. Place on a rimmed baking sheet. Broil until lightly browned and softened, about 5 minutes, flip and broil 3 to 4 more minutes.

title: Mushroom Soup With Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb spinach leaves | 4 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 slice bacon, chopped | 1 leek, cleaned and white part cut in half and sliced | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon finely grated raw vanilla | 1 1/2 tablespoons currants | 2 tablespoons sour yogurt
instructions: Wash, blanch and refresh the spinach, drain well and finely chop the leaves. In a large saucepan, add stock, spinach, bacon, leek and bell pepper. Bring to boil and then reduce heat and simmer until spinach is just tender, about 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in the vanilla and currants and serve, with sour cream optional if desired.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,red enchilada sauce,plain flour,onion powder,chicken broth
title: Easy Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 15 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan and simmer over low heat, stirring often, until thickened slightly, around 8 minutes.

title: Gramma's Vegetable Guinness
ingredients: 1 lb frozen peas | 1 lb frozen green beans | 1 lb frozen peas | 1/2 lb frozen harissa, or more to taste ( see description ) | 1 jar guinness stout | 5 pounds canadian bacon, diced | canadian bacon slices ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cook the peas in a pan of boiling unsalted water until just tender. Add the green beans and peas and continue to cook until tender. Drain. Heat the harissa on the stove over medium heat in a medium casserole dish or roasting pan large enough to hold everything. Add the guinness and heat until warmed through. Stir in the canadian bacon pieces, if using, and heat until the bacon is heated through. Spread the peas around on a large serving platter. Ladle the hot guinness sauce around the peas and vegetables. If desired, serve in small dishes, on top of each dish, with a small scoop of ice cream or whipped cream if desired.

title: Mock Chutney and Black Olives
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut or canola oil | 2 tablespoons black olives, pitted and sliced | 2 tablespoons red peppers, drained and diced | 2 tablespoons chocolate chips | 1 teaspoon crystallized ginger, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean, scrapings
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium high heat, warm the oil, and sauté the black olives and red peppers with the ginger and chocolate pieces for 3 minutes then stir in the vanilla and remove from heat and season with salt and pepper. Spread evenly into an oven proof dish, and cool in the oven for 1 hour. Store refrigerated.

Random Ingredients: pork,coffee,french bread,broccoli floret,white bread flour,large shrimp,heavy whipping cream
title: Creamed Shrimp With Bread (Guy Fieri)
ingredients: 3 cups heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons french bread flour | 1 lb large shrimp, shelled and deveined, tails left on attached | 1 lb ground pork | 1 lb broccoli floret, cleaned, well rinsed, drained, and cut into bite sized pieces | 1 loaf crusty white bread, slices cut into 1-inch cubes ( such as texas toast )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Arrange shrimp attractively in one layer over narrow rimmed baking sheet. Bake until they turn bright pink, 30 to 60 minutes.. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, heat cream.

title: Poblano and Crowder Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 2 cups vegetable stock | 250 g crowder pea ( cooked frozen )
instructions: Cut poblano in half and remove seeds. Wash and cut both together into strips 1/2 inch wide. Place poblano strips and 1 cup of the vegetable stock into an electric frying pan. Bring to a boil, lower heat and cook gently for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add the peas. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes then serve.

title: Fusion Food & Beverage (With a Twist)
ingredients: 3 small red potatoes | 3 cans black beans | 1 pomegranate seeds, ground
instructions: Wash and dry your black beans until ready to use. In a large pot, boil your whole pomegranate seeds until black, about 15 minutes. Drain seeds and throw away. Place each potato on a plate, and place a handful of seeds in the center. Then wrap the potato around the seeds and fill with your fiesta guacamole. Enjoy.

title: Chile and Apple Filling
ingredients: 1 cup cooked yellow beans | 1 green chilies, chopped | 2 garlic cloves, finely minced | 1 -2 shallot, finely chopped | 1 apple, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Heat oil in skillet and soften beans until soft. In bowl, mash and combine with other ingredients. Stir in enough guacamole to moisten. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil, turning as necessary. They should brown on all sides.

title: Strawberry Beer on the Rocks
ingredients: fresh strawberries, hulled | 3 ounces beer | strawberry, halved
instructions: Pour beer in a tall glass. Top with fresh strawberries, then halved strawberries.

title: Faux Porridge With Ham and Oats
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick cooking oil | 3/4 cup porridge oats | 2 -3 tablespoons ham stock | 100 g small shell pasta
instructions: Cook pasta per instructions.

Random Ingredients: coco lopez,cottage cheese,red chilies,pimento pepper,venison,sole fillet
title: Peruvian Steak Fajitas (Pastel De Coco)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon diced red chilies | 1/4 cup chopped canned pimento peppers | 1/2 cup fat free cottage cheese | 1/4 cup low-fat canned coco lopez | 5 sole fillets ( about 1 1/2 oz each, i use tilapia ) | 1 teaspoon crushed canned red chilies
instructions: Put the chilies in a small fry pan over medium low heat. Cook until they soften a bit and start releasing their aroma remove from heat and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix together the cheese and picante sauce. Slice both sides of the fish, 1/8 inch thick. Sprinkle the inside of a tortilla with 1/3 chilies, and place the fish in the center of the tortilla. Place your 2 largest spoons on top, and press down the edges to seal. Preheat broiler. Heat your oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat. Cook each fish for 2 minutes on each side or until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,kidney bean,egg yolk water,yoghurt,green onion,ladyfinger
title: Beef and Yoghurt Pie
ingredients: 3 tablespoons yoghurt, plain | 4 ounces ground beef chuck ( about 90g ) | 1 tablespoon skim milk yoghurt | 1 teaspoon green onion, finely chopped | 1 egg yolk, lightly beaten | 2 ounces ladyfingers, biscuits ( about 18 biscuits )
instructions: Cut each biscuit out of a disc. Heat oven to 375f/190c/gas put biscuit cases into a loose 2/3 cup capacity ovenproof dish. Pour over any remaining yoghurt. Sprinkle beef between layers of paper towel and press onto the biscuit cases, pressing firmly into spaces between each layer. Scatter on yoghurt, green onion and egg. Bake on centre rack of oven for 25 minutes or until biscuit mixture is golden. Remove baking dish from oven and leave hot. Sit biscuit cases onto plates. Serve pie with yoghurt salad.

title: Baked Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice or 1/2 cup long grain rice | 2 cups refried beans | 6 -8 pieces anise seeds | 2 -3 ice cubes
instructions: Place rice in a pan with water as high as you can, and bring to a boil. Turn down the heat and cover, simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, until all the water has been absorbed. Place the undrained cooked beans in a microwave safe container with a lid. Cover and heat on full power for 90 seconds on high. Open up the lid, and fluff the beans with a fork, adding anise seeds and ice cubes if necessary. The dish should be fairly thick, and very dry. Leave to set for a few minutes before serving, if desired.

title: Swiss Cheese and Walnuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded ( about 3 slices ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules, divided | 8 ounces walnuts, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a medium bowl, combine cheese, 2 teaspoons bouillon, and nuts, tossing to mix. Spread mixture on a rimmed baking sheet, or a rimmed baking sheet. Roast in the oven 10 minutes or until hot and lightly browned. Remove nuts and sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon bouillon. Serve. Store any leftover cheese mixture in a tightly covered container in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.

title: Mustard Beef
ingredients: 3/4 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak | 3 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Put steak on wax paper and lightly season with salt. Cut steak diagonally across grain in to very thin slices. Spread mustard over steaks. Grill to desired degree of doneness.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,taco seasoning,tarragon vinegar,mustard powder
title: Texas Taco Beans
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard powder | 1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the beans with taco seasoning, mustard powder and vinegar. Mix well. Cover and chill overnight. Serve chilled.

title: Cornbread Puffs
ingredients: 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted, skinned and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup shallot, minced | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard powder | ice water | 1/4 cup radish, thinly sliced | 2 submarine buns, split
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees f. Mix 1/4 cup of cornmeal, nuts, shallot, 2 tablespoons mustard, and dry mustard powder in a bowl. Cut a hole in the center of each bun. Place the halves into the muffin tin, filling the hole with mustard mixture between the halved bun halves. Fill the hole with water so that the bread does not bake in the oven. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until puffed and golden brown. Remove from oven and allow to cool for a few minutes. Fill the bun halves with the prepared cereal. Top with the radishes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,grain white rice,romano cheese,scallion,italian spice,banana leaf,sherry wine,lemon peel
title: Gerry's Cafe Banana "rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup long grain white rice | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla bean, split in half | 6 scallions, cut into 1 inch rounds | 1/2 lemon peel, sliced thin | 1 banana leaf ( i use banana leaves ) | 1/2 cup rum wine ( r.l.o.o.o. or cava sherry ) | 1/4 cup romano cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon italian spices
instructions: Begin by heating the medium saucepan on the stove. When hot, scoop out the vanilla bean that is very slightly split, but save the scraped seeds. Add the scraped vanilla bean into the small saucepan, add the scallions to the pan, reduce the heat to a slow simmer, and simmer for 2 minutes. Toss the white rice into the pot, cook just until the grains are fragrant and starting to soften, and a minute or two later, add the vanilla bean back into the rice. Add the scallions to the rinsed rice and cook for two more minutes, and then stir in the cinnamon. Turn off the heat and mix in the zest of the lemon peel. Set the rice on a large serving platter, and spread the rum and romano sauce around it. Garnish with the extra romano cheese and dried italian spices. Serve warm or cold.

title: Bratwurst and Grapefruit Kebobs
ingredients: 25 ounces smoked bratwursts | 2 tablespoons grapefruit juice | 3 tablespoons dried cherries
instructions: Mix the grapefruit juice, the bratwurst and the grapefruit kebobs. Place on a tray and let them rest for 5 minutes. Slice with a meat mallet until desired size. Serve with fresh fruit sauce.

title: Wild Mushroom Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2/3 cup currants | 2 fresh shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb kielbasa, cut into thin slices
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together and press down into a lightly greased 2 quart baking dish. Bake at 325°f/160°c for about 30 minutes.

title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu | 3 tablespoons grated white onions | 3 tablespoons margarine | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 2 teaspoons salad dressing or 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | sliced toasted almonds ( optional )
instructions: Wash the tofu well and cut 2 in slices across the width. Slice the tofu into 1/8 x 1/4 slices. Melt the margarine in a small saucepan and saute the onions until they are dark and just beginning to soften, about 2 minutes. Sprinkle with salt. Stir in the horseradish. Spread half of the horseradish mixture over the bottom half of a wrap or a cookie sheet and top with the tofu pieces. Pour remaining horseradish over and top with the rest of the lettuce. Sprinkle with toasted almonds if desired.

title: Classic Mexican Baguette
ingredients: 4 -5 cups prepared bread ( homemade or purchased ) | 1 tablespoon dried anise seed or 1 tablespoon crushed anise seed | 2 tablespoons table salt | 2 tablespoons minced minced shallots ( or green onions ) | 1 -3 leaf lettuce leaf
instructions: If you wish, lightly grease and flour three cookie sheets or other suitable baking pans. Combine the 1 tablespoon of anise seeds, 2 tablespoons salt and the minced shallots in a small bowl.

title: Pizza Potatoes (Vegetable)
ingredients: 6 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 6 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Mix all ingredients together well and arrange the mushrooms in the bottom of a baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes or until cheese is browned and bubbly.

title: Chicken Tuna Casserole
ingredients: 1 teaspoon margarine | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 package frozen fennel, sliced | 16 cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 pound cubed cooked chicken meat | 3 cans tuna, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a casserole dish, melt margarine over medium low heat. Stir in flour until well blended. Gradually stir in fennel, mushrooms, chicken and tuna. Mix well.

Random Ingredients: savory,shrimp,red enchilada sauce,chunky salsa,cayenne powder,double cream,sumac,cream
title: Creamy Cajun Shrimp Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp ( i prefer the tiny wee bit pink ones, so i use the large ones ) | 1/3 cup red enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup medium thick cream | 1 cup double cream | 1 teaspoon ground sumac | 1 teaspoon ground savory | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne powder | 1 cup thin chunky salsa ( or your favorite ) | sour cream, garnish
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp if using. Put shrimp in a medium size bowl. Make a double slit in each shrimp's back to remove the flesh and shells. Reserve shells if they are large enough. Reserve shells. Combine the red enchilada sauce, thick cream, sour cream, sumac, savory and cayenne powder in a mixing bowl. In another large bowl, gently combine the reserved shrimp shells, 2 tbs of green chile salsa and reserved 2 tbs of green salsa. Spoon 1/2 cup of the cream mixture into each shrimp 'n' shell. Then stuff each shell 'cajun shrimp' with the cream mixture. Place shrimp 'on to one side of a 13 in. X 9 in. X 2 in. Baking pan. Pour remaining cream mixture evenly over the shrimp 'cajun' shrimp. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 - 25 minutes or until shrimp are tender and cooked through. Top with 1/4 cup of chunky salsa and garnish with dollop of sour cream.

title: Quick and Easy Low Fat Sauce
ingredients: 4 fluid ounces clear honey ( i use organic honey ) | 4 fluid ounces worcestershire sauce ( i use organic worcestershire sauce )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small saucepan, bring to the boil, then simmer until the honey has reduced to about half its original size and the sauce is syrupy.

title: Quick Chickpea Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup chickpeas, cooked & rinsed | 3 slices white bread, without crusts | 2 tablespoons lard | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Place the cooked chickpeas in a clean cheese cloth and wring out as much liquid as possible. In a mixing bowl, mash chickpeas with a fork. Stir in the lard, white peppercorns and italian seasoning. Scoop up small portions of the mixture and place on a floured surface. Roll the mixture into an flattened log shape and slice into rounds about 1/2 inch thick. Slices of white bread may be placed on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil after baking for the first loaf. When finished, the bread may be stored in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,onion mushroom soup mix,guacamole,vegetarian bean,chipotle pepper adobo sauce
title: Chipotle and Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 package dry onion and mushroom soup mix | 3 cans vegetarian baked beans | 2 tablespoons minced chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 1 pound sweet italian sausage | 1 cup guacamole, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish or line with aluminum foil. Mix dry soup mix, baked beans, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, and sausage until well blended. Spread sausage mixture into the prepared baking dish, and cover with guacamole. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until heated through.

title: Edamame and Beet Relish
ingredients: 1 package frozen beets, thawed | 1 bunch fresh basil sprig, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup pickling spices, or more to taste | 3 fresh beet, peeled and chopped, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons white sugar, or more to taste | 1/2 can sliced pickling vegetables, drained
instructions: Place the thawed beets into a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender but not mushy, about 35 minutes. Drain, allow to cool 10 minutes, then coarsely chop. Chop basil, and stir into beets with pickling spice, sweet red pepper, and sliced beets. Place chopped stems from basil, chopped leaves and sugar into a large bowl, and stir in hot beet mixture to mix. Cover, and chill 2 hours before serving.

title: Easy Fried Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb bean sprouts, washed and drained | 1 1/2 cups cornflour
instructions: Heat 3 tbsp oil in non stick pan. Deep fry bean sprouts until golden. Drain on paper towel. Serve hot with chinese fried chilli bean paste.

Random Ingredients: barbecue sauce,cooking spray,grain white rice,sole fillet,streaky bacon,chicken stock,kitchen bouquet,red lentil
title: Lentil and Bacon Pies With Rice
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package smoked streaky bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 medium size brea fillets, about 12 ounces each, cut in half | kitchen bouquet granary | 1 cup red lentil ( green ) | 3/4 cup dry medium-grain white rice ( or brown ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 cup barbecue sauce ( your favorite )
instructions: Spray a 9 inch square baking pan with vegetable oil. Spread the bacon pieces evenly over the base of the pan in a single layer and fry over medium high heat until beginning to brown, stirring often, 3 - 4 minutes. Remove bacon from pan and set aside. Remove streaky bacon slices from grease and add to cooking pan along with remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and reduce slightly, simmering for 20 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.

title: Peppered Sugar Snap Pea Salad With Basil Pesto
ingredients: 8 ounces sugar snap peas, trimmed | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 1/4 cup golden syrup ( or maple syrup ) | 1 teaspoon mixed peppercorns
instructions: Place sugar snap peas and 2 t water in microwave safe dish.

title: Steamed Beef With Cranberry Gravy
ingredients: 4 ounces beef tenderloin | 1 pinch dried thyme | 1 dash hot sauce, peri (peri-peri ) | 1 1 cup fresh cranberries | microced fresh thyme | 2 teaspoons instant coffee
instructions: Rub the entire beef with juniper berries and a good sprinkling of hasty peri peri. Place in a steamer, cover, and let steam for 4 - 5 hours. Remove from steamer and cool. When completely cool, slice into slices and serve in gravy bowl along with other accompaniments.

title: Szechwan "Fried" Romaine Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 cup shortening | 4 ounces shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup szechwan pepper, ground | 2 tablespoons rum | 2 heads romaine lettuce, rinsed ( leaves separated )
instructions: Cut shortening into 2 x 1/2 inch strips. Mix parmigiano reggiano, szechwan pepper, and rum together. Mix with lettuce leaves. Heat shortening in large skillet over low heat until it shimmers, but do not allow to brown. Lay lettuce leaf on sheet of waxed paper. Brush top of each leaf with remaining shortening. Sprinkle with szechwan mixture and roll up carefully starting at the wide end of leaf. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate until serving.

title: Pesto-Rolive and Romaine Collard Greens
ingredients: 12 cups collard greens | 3 cups butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cut into 1-inch chunks | 7 1/2 teaspoons yeast, divided | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1 1/2 cups polenta, coarse ground | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Place collards and squash in a medium bowl. Sprinkle yeast over vegetables. Let stand 5 minutes, until yeast softens and begins to form a creamy foam. Pour butter over the top, stirring to combine. Let stand until softened, about 15 minutes. Stir in polenta, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring well after each addition. Spread polenta over the collards and squash. Add oregano and remaining 1 tablespoon yeast and spread in a thin layer. Cover bowl with a towel and let rise in a warm place until dough begins to rise again, about 1 hour. Punch down and turn out onto a lightly floured surface and stretch into a 12x6 inch rectangle. Cover and let rise 20 minutes, until doubled. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Using a slotted spoon, transfer spinach and squash to a baking dish. Sprinkle greens with salt, then drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon yeast. Bake in preheated oven until greens are bubbling about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with oregano and remaining teaspoon yeast.

title: Liver Lasagna
ingredients: 1/4 cup salad oil | 16 ounces chicken livers, thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 8 ounces lasagna noodles ( small package )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat, cook chicken livers in oil 1 minute. Remove to drain. Combine chicken livers, hot pepper sauce and broth. Heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: beef base,tequila,purpose flour,white sugar,oregano,green cardamom pod,vanilla essence
title: Gorditas
ingredients: 500 g all-purpose flour | 150 g white sugar | 20 g of ground green cardamom pods ( optional ) | 100 ml tequila | 2 ml vanilla essence or 2 ml lemon flavoring | 3 pinches oregano ( optional or to taste ) or 3 pinches basil ( optional ) | 1 dash of equal parts beef base ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients together.

title: Mary's Lettuce & Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 20 ounces reduced fat sour cream celery soup | 1 jar chopped bean sprouts | 3 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: Mix sour cream, bean sprouts and romaine lettuce together. Serve with crackers.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,pepper sauce,sunflower oil,ice cube,cornmeal,italian breadcrumb,gingersnap,heart palm
title: Fried Hearts of Palm
ingredients: 8 sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/2 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup frozen chopped baby sweet peppers ( not in vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, finely chopped | 4 cans hearts of palm, drained well ( reserve syrup ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 3 cups crushed ice cubes | cornmeal
instructions: Heat oil in deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees. In mixing bowl, mix together hot pepper sauce, bread crumbs, sweet peppers, ginger, shrimp, and chicken bouillon. With floured hands, roll dough into small balls, then roll in crumb mixture, then in ice cubes. Carefully place each ball into a deep fryer or large saucepan, filling to about 3/4 full. Fry hearts of palm for 4 - 5 minutes, until golden all over. Sprinkle with reserved warm syrup, and serve hot.

title: Homemade Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 lb greek yogurt | 1/2 lb beef base ( or 1 small piece of beef that contains 2 tbsp )
instructions: Blend the greek yogurt with a wooden spoon or a blend of food processor until it becomes thick like the consistency of milk. When the mix is ready, store it in airtight tins, to develop flavor.

title: Smoked Ham Dumplings for Two
ingredients: 10 -12 wonton wrappers ( use a little over a teaspoon of each ) | 2 jars smoked ham, sliced very thin ( or you can cut ham in half or use leftovers of your own smoked ham or a polish sausage which has been mixed together and is smoked. you need to add 1 tablespoon of smoke flavoring into the mixture for it to be smoked ) | 2 -3 bottles brandy
instructions: Place the ham slices into the wonton wrapper. Add the brandy to taste. Use a spoon or your fingers to dip your wonton wrappers in the brandy and stick them into the ham. Smear a small amount of smoke flavoring onto the wrapper. Seal the edges with a little bit of brandy. Preheat the grill and heat to medium heat. Use a pastry brush to grease the grates or spray with cooking spray on both sides of the wontons. When the grates are hot flip them over and sprinkle with more smoke flavoring to taste or until desired level of smoke is reached. Let the grates sit for a minute and then place them on a platter and let the flavors mingle. Enjoy.

title: Chinese Muslim Style Roast Beef
ingredients: 1/4 lb lean deli-sliced beef | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 teaspoons canola oil
instructions: Trim the fat from the beef, and cut to desired lengths. Place beef in a resealable plastic bag, and add enough soy sauce to coat. Pour in the canola oil to just coat the beef, seal, and refrigerate for 6 hours to marinate. Pat meat dry.

title: Torta Di Carne E E Sien (Beef Cubes, Chilean Style)
ingredients: 1 jar bamboo shoots | 1 pound lean beef stew meat, cut into bite size pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, add the beef and marinade and mix well. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 1 week. Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving. Serve on tortillas with sour cream and salsa.

Random Ingredients: white flour,salt,pepper,wedge brie cheese,reynolds wrap foil,hamburger
title: Brie Burgers (From the New York Times)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white flour, plus | 2 tablespoons white flour | 3/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper | 2 lbs lean hamburger | reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Place buns at room temperature for 15 - 20 minutes in a food processor, leaving 1/2 inch space at edges. Add remaining ingredients into a bowl and mix well. Wet hands and press the mixture into one side of each bun. Place on a plate and let sit 20 minutes. Heat broiler with rack 4 from the heating element. Broil patties 4 - 6 inches from heat 3 - 5 minutes per side. Serve warm.

title: German Drunken Nuts
ingredients: 2 cans beer | 1/2 cup pecan nuts | 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Pour beer from can into saucer lined with cheese cloth. Drain brine from can over brine, and set aside. While beer is soaking, toast nuts over medium heat at medium heat. When they begin to slightly brown, remove nuts with tongs from heat. Immediately, stir in pepper flakes.

title: Baked Vegetables With Cantaloupe
ingredients: 1 cantaloupe, trimmed and seeded | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 2/3 cup shredded parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Cut cantaloupe lenghtwise in half. Using 2 halves for each, cut each half on a diagonal to make 4 strips of cantaloupe. Stuff each strip with a bean strip and sprinkle with parmesan to taste. Place on a baking sheet and bake 15 minutes. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,white rice,rice wine,stewing beef,cottage cheese,pear,red chili pepper flake
title: Hot and Sour Beef Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 package dry rice noodles | 1 cup white rice, cooked | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1/2 cup diced ripe pear
instructions: Place beef and uncooked rice in bottom of slow cooker. Add remaining ingredients and mix until blended and heated through. Cover and cook on low 9 hours or until rice noodles are tender. Serve over noodles.

title: Mama Zuquinis Rosettes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fruit cocktail juice | 8 scallions, finely chopped | 20 slices of good quality mozzarella cheese
instructions: Pour the cocktail juice in a tall narrow mouth glass or bowl with about 1/4 inch rim. Add the scallions and stir to blend. Add the mozzarella and stir to mix. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. Remove the cheese when it's soft and bubbly. Serve in the shape of a star. Note, you may also use a piece of cooked ham or other sausage.

title: Roasted Red Bell Pepper Soup
ingredients: 4 red bell peppers, quartered, stems removed | 1/4 white onion, minced | 2 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place two bell pepper quarters onto a large cookie sheet. Roast bell peppers until their skins blister and begin to blacken and blacken in places, about 40 minutes. Remove peppers from oven and set aside. Heat the ouzo in a saucepan over medium high heat. Add the minced onion and saute until the onions are translucent and starting to brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in the roasted red peppers and irish cream. Simmer until reduced by about half and the peppers are tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Georgia Natural Peach Chutney
ingredients: 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 2 cans peach nectar | 1 cup vegetable shortening, melted ( or other cooking oil )
instructions: Heat an 11x7 baking dish in a 400 degree oven for 5 minutes. Remove all but 1 tablespoon of the oil from the can of diced tomatoes and pour them into the hot baking dish. Scatter the peach nectar over the tomatoes. Mix well and cover with plastic wrap and bake in the preheated oven for 45 - 50 minutes, or until a knife inserted in the center of the dish comes out clean. Remove plastic wrap, cut into chunks and serve immediately. Store refrigerated, for up to 2 months. Shake and stir chutney before using in a saucepan over medium heat until it begins to thicken slightly. Serve immediately. This chutney can be made and frozen. Defrost overnight and reheat the next day in a microwave.

title: Black Bean Cakes - Colombia Style
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed well | 1 cup cola ( beverage ) | 1/4 cup white mustard seeds | 2 cups tapioca | 1 teaspoon brewer's yeast
instructions: Drain 4 cans black beans and rinse. Place on the work surface. Roughly chop the rest. Add the cola, mustard, and yeast to the beans, press down with your finger tips until all the liquid has been absorbed by the yeast. Add the beans to the center of a large, heavy skillet and heat over medium low heat until all the ingredients have been mixed and heated throughout. If the mixture doesn't come together immediately, cover with a lid. The mixture should remain liquid.

Random Ingredients: belgian endive,emmenthaler cheese,lime zest,beef bouillon powder,cayenne pepper,taco seasoning mix
title: Beef Steak and Endive Tacos
ingredients: 3/4 cup beef bouillon powder | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup cayenne pepper, or to taste | 2 tablespoons grated fresh lime zest | 1 tablespoon grated asiago reggiano or asiago mozzarella cheese | 3 heads belgian endive, leaves separated | 1/4 cup enchilada sauce or 1/4 cup sour cream, for topping
instructions: To make stock, pour beef into a saucepan and pour water into it. Place over high heat and bring to a boil.

title: Baked Fish Ball with Wine
ingredients: 1 kg ground fish ( any fresh fish will do ) | 1 bottle french dressing | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 60 -100 -250 g frozen cooked meatballs ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except the frozen meatballs in a large bowl. Combine all ingredients and add meatballs if using, mix gently to combine. Form into balls about the size of a sugar cube. Place on a baking tray, cover and bake in a 200°c oven for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: Arugula and Zest Salad
ingredients: 8 cups packed arugula | 1 1/2 teaspoons citrus zest, grated
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss well. Chill and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,tomato puree,chili oil,oyster,white sesame seed,meat,baby bok choy,yellow onion
title: Rum and Chilli Broth (Somali Bakaong)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil ( or sesame oil if unavailable ) | 1 tablespoon oyster, drained | 200 g baby bok choy, quartered lengthways | 1 small yellow onion, halved sliced | 1 tablespoon white sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to the simmer over a medium heat. Simmer for five minutes, or until thick. Remove from the heat, and reserve. Cool slightly and place in the freezer until cool enough to handle. Drain the bok choy leaves and place in a steamer set over a bowl. Add half of the onion slices, and cook for 1 - 2 minutes to soften slightly, and still tender. Transfer to a bowl and add the remainder of the vegetables. Place over a low heat. Cook for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and fragrant. Cool slightly. Place the cooled vegetables into the saucepan containing the reserved sauce, and reheat gently until the broth has reduced to the consistency of soup. Discard the onion slices. Serve in individual soup bowls, topping with the toasted sesame seeds. I loved this served with shiitake noodles as a meal starter and served with rice.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,wheat breadcrumb,sesame seed,dill,chipotle chile adobo,crouton
title: Chipotle Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 1/2 cup sesame seeds | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat breadcrumbs | salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f spread 1 tablespoon of the ground chipotle in the bottom of a baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon dill and 1/2 cup of the whole wheat bread crumbs. Mix together the remaining teaspoon of ground chipotles, parsley and chiles with remaining tablespoon of dried bread crumbs and remaining ground chipotle in a bowl. Combine the breadcrumbs with 1 tablespoon sesame seeds. Add salt and pepper to taste and mix together until all ingredients are evenly distributed. Pat mixture into a well greased 10”x4” baking dish. Combine 1½ cups whole wheat bread crumbs with 1½ cup of fine bread crumbs and stir into chipotle mixture. Sprinkle remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons of all purpose flour on top of breadcrumbs. Bake 35 minutes or until crust is browned and bread crumbs are crisp.

title: Australian Bracktoothing
ingredients: 25 ladyfingers | 500 g steak, cut into thin slices | 35 g lindt dried herbs | 35 g irish cream | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 35 g fresh herbs | 35 g fresh chili paste | 35 g fresh herbs
instructions: Soak the ladyfingers in water in a bowl for 15 mins, or for several hours. Drain and dry the herbs. Chop the meat into thin slices. Mix all ingredients, apart from the food, in a bowl and add the soaked ladyfingers. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Thread the beef onto the soaked ladyfingers as follows, soaked ladyfingers, meat and sauce. Bamboo skewers work very well for this dish. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours before cooking.

title: Danish Rabbit Stomach
ingredients: 3 rabbits, cleaned and cut into pieces | 3 tablespoons caster sugar or 3 tablespoons superfine sugar | 9 leaves kale
instructions: Remove the belly and intestines from the rabbits, and set aside. Boil down two quarts of water with the sugar about 5 - 8 minutes, then throw out the fat and sugar. Remove the stems from the kale and separate the leaves from the leaves. Strain the water through a cheesecloth or a fine sieve, then throw the leaves into the boiling water. When they float, remove them with a slotted spoon. Add the rabbit back to the water and boil until tender. You can remove the rabbit part of the intestines, but it might not be necessary. If it falls from the spoon and you feel it is drying out add some more boiling water. Fill the sterilized tube of your food processor all the way to the bottom of the tubes. Add the rabbit part of the intestines and one handful of the leaves from the kale. Blend for a few seconds to ensure they are all thoroughly mixed inches. The idea is to have as much air as possible out of the liquid. Taste to see if you want to add any more sugar. Serve with boiled eggs or danish rye bread.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,popped popcorn,cashew,pearl barley,red wine,cream tartar,golden syrup
title: Lipton's Mmmm Hot Snack Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups golden syrup | 1/4 cup sweet red wine | 1/2 cup chest barley | 2 tablespoons unsalted roasted cashews | 6 ounces roasted popcorn | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese ( optional )
instructions: Combine the 2 tbsp golden syrup, wine and dry roasted cashews in a saucepan. Add the corn& raisins and simmer over medium low heat for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir briskly until the mixture thickens. Remove from the heat and stir in the cream of tartar. Add parmesan. Transfer to an airtight container and chill. Serve at room temperature with crackers.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,sun tomato oil,greek yogurt,potato starch,napa cabbage,maple syrup,avocado
title: Crispy Guacamole
ingredients: 2 large ripe avocados, peeled, pitted, and mashed | 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 3 cups shredded napa cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon potato starch | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato oil
instructions: Combine avocado, yogurt, fennel seed, sun dried tomatoes, and maple syrup in a bowl.

title: Spiced Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup mango chutney
instructions: In a bowl, mix pinto beans, mango chutney, and remaining salsa ingredients, and chill.

Random Ingredients: white onion,kosher salt black pepper,guacamole,pork tenderloin,feta cheese,kidney bean,green chilies
title: Taco Filling for Beef Frites
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon chopped green chilies | 1/2 teaspoon white onion, minced | 2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch strips | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/4 cup finely crumbled guacamole | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh white onion
instructions: In a food processor or blender combine beans, chilies, 1/4 cup green onion and 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Puree until smooth. Transfer mixture to medium bowl and set aside. In a 6 to 8 inch nonstick bottomed skillet over medium high heat, cook pork, 1/2 teaspoon salt and ½ teaspoon pepper until browned, 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer pork and any accumulated juices to slow cooker. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup green onion and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover. Cook on low setting until pork is very tender, 1 1/2 to 2 hours, 5 to 6 hours total cooking time. In a small bowl stir together guacamole and sliced white onion. Stir 1 tablespoon guacamole mixture into slow cooker. Simmer until heated through, about 4 minutes. Spoon filling into a paper towel lined plate, allowing excess to drip off. Top filling with remaining guacamole mixture and serve at once.

title: Magical Rice Noodles With Milk Chocolate
ingredients: 16 ounces whole milk chocolate | 4 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 6 ounces dried rice noodles | 4 lime wedges
instructions: Melt chocolate in microwave. Dissolve it in water for 3 minutes. Bring noodles to the boil and boil for 2 minutes drain and set aside for 5 minutes. Set aside. In a large bowl, coat noodles with chocolate and drain. Top with fried noodles and use lime wedge to squeeze into noodles, on top.

title: Easiest Pasta Fresca
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pasta sauce ( or pasta of your choice, your choice ) | 1 white onion, chopped, preferably sweet | 1 bunch green cardamom pods | watercress, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse with cool water and drain. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 10 to 12 minutes, depending on thickness of pasta. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water. Saute onion in large nonstick skillet until tender. Stir in warm pasta water. Sprinkle evenly with ground cardamom pods and garnish with shredded green onion. Note, if you want to use your favourite pasta sauce, add to the pasta and stir to coat.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,bacon,marjoram,chicken breast,bamboo shoot,white corn tortilla,chive,gorgonzola
title: Chicken and Bacon Wraps With Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar or 2 teaspoons red balsamic vinegar | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 8 slices bacon ( i use smoked bacon ) | 4 pieces white corn tortillas | 2 teaspoons fresh chives ( or 1 t dried chives ) | 1/3 cup fat-free low-fat gorgonzola ( or other fat free spreadable cheese ) | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh marjoram or 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh chives
instructions: Pour 1/2 the vinegar over chicken and set aside. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add bacon.

Random Ingredients: hot dog,mango,fava bean,brown rice,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Hot Dog & Mango Burritos
ingredients: 3 hot dogs | 1 cup brown rice, cooked | 1 cup mango, cubed and seeded | 1 1/2 cups fava beans, cooked | 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Brush cookie sheet with oil. Place hot dogs on cookie sheet. Place brown rice over hot dogs and bake for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and spread 1/2 cup cooked brown rice over brown rice. Top with 1/2 cup diced mango, 1/2 cup diced fava beans, monterey jack cheese, and 1 tablespoon of the cooked brown rice mixture in the center. Return to oven and bake for 5 - 6 minutes.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,nori,orange zest,hot sauce,milk,cherry tomato,boston lettuce
title: Tomato & Swiss Salad
ingredients: 2 cups boston lettuce, torn into bite sizes | 1 cup swiss cheese, torn into chunks | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes or 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, quartered lengthwise | 2 tablespoons pickled orange zest, cut crosswise into strips | 4 teaspoons skim milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh low-fat milk | 3 dashes hot sauce
instructions: Mix the lettuces & cheese together in a bowl. Place on a serving platter & top with the tomatoes, orange zest, milk & hot sauce. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: triple sec,dark raisin,cream half,portabella mushroom cap,rice wine,zucchini,rosemary leaf
title: Zucchini & Raisin Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb zucchini | 6 ounces portabella mushroom caps | 1/2 cup dark raisin | 1/2 cup light cream, half and half or light half | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry vermouth | 1 sprigs rosemary leaf, to garnish
instructions: Julienne zucchini. Cut mushrooms into large chunks. Place in medium bowl and sprinkle with raisins. Whisk cream and wine together and stir into zucchini mixture. Add rosemary sprigs to garnish.

title: Korma & Feta Scones
ingredients: 12 ounces self-rising flour | 1 ounce feta cheese, crumb | 1/4 cup rolled oats | 1/4 cup cooked chopped bell pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f degrees. Lightly grease a cookie sheet. Place flour, and feta cheese in a bowl. Add oats and pepper and combine. Shape into a ball and press out onto the cookie sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chinese Vegetarian Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 lb coleslaw mix ( green cabbage ) | 2 -3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon hot curry powder ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon soya sauce ( optional ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons palm sugar ( optional ) | 3 -4 mushrooms ( optional ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup brewed coffee ( i usually start with a little more and use up depending entirely on your desired sweetness )
instructions: Mix together all marinade ingredients. Marinate cabbage for about an hour or so, or overnight. Slice mushrooms into very thin rings. Add sugar to sugar/marinade, and stir to dissolve sugar. Slice mushrooms into thin rings. Set aside and marinate cabbage leaves for 1 - 2 hours. Assemble with slaw and remaining toppings, if desired.

Random Ingredients: vodka,fettuccine pasta,cottage cheese,sherry wine vinegar,cream tartar
title: Quick Fettuccine Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces fettuccine pasta, uncooked | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 8 ounces cottage cheese, drained | 2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: nut,black pepper,yellow bell pepper,beef bouillon,pimiento,thyme sprig
title: Grilled Spanish Peppers
ingredients: 6 yellow bell peppers | 1/4 cup smoked paprika or 1/4 cup paprika | 2 tablespoons finely chopped pimiento | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon
instructions: Cut stem from peppers lengthwise and remove seeds to remove stem part. Brining peppers with salt, place pepper halves on foil on grill and broil, turning once, until peppers are charred all over. Transfer peppers to wire rack to cool, peel skins and seeds from peppers, remove stems from peppers. Strain out paprika and discard. Preheat grill to high. Using mortar and pestle, mix paprika, pimiento, thyme, pepper and bouillon. Brush tops with paprika mixture. Grill peppers until skins blister and peppers are blistered, about 3 1/2 minutes, turning. Transfer pepper to platter and continue cooling. Wrap peppers in aluminum foil and keep warm in 200f oven. Serve at room temperature.

title: Tikka Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 500 g firm tofu, preferably fresh | 400 g coarsely ground semolina or 400 g ground wheat
instructions: Place the tofu in a steamer and cook over a pan of simmering water for five minutes. Drain the tofu and place in a bowl with 50g sugar, 7g salt and 100ml water and mix well. Place the tofu in the mixture and cover. Let stand for 30 minutes. Stir well. Remove from the heat. Place in the refrigerator overnight to cool completely. Place the nori, with its cooking surface, on a lined tray. Spread the nori with the firm tofu and cut into bite sized pieces. Dip the pieces into the sugar syrup and place on paper leaves. Serve to snack or bring to room temperature for breakfast.

title: Spicy Taco Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 cups romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup canola oil or 1/2 cup olive oil | 1 - 1 1/2 cup taco sauce
instructions: In a medium sized mixing bowl combine oil and taco sauce mix well. Just a few drops of water will help keep the lettuce from turning brown. Wash and dry lettuce and cut into slices to fit. Toss lettuce slices with the oil sauce until coated. Serve topped with sour cream or guacamole if desired.

title: Grilled Salmon With Cardamom-Green Cham Mayonnaise
ingredients: 2 whole green cardamom pods | 1 lb salmon | cooking spray
instructions: Place cardamom pods and 1/2 teaspoon water in a medium size skillet. Cook on medium high until pods blacken and smell fragrant, about 7 minutes. Turn pods and cook on other side for another 1 - 2 minutes. Drain pods on paper towel. Place salmon on a grill rack over medium coals and mist with cooking spray. Grill salmon until done, about 3 - 5 minutes per side, depending on thickness. Remove salmon from grill and let cool slightly. Place each portion on serving plate. Garnish with cardamom mayonnaise and serve.

title: Mexican Tiramisu
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | 3 cups brewed tea | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup snipped of fresh chipotle chile | 1/4 cup snipped fresh oregano leaves | 3/4 cup dry sherry or 3/4 cup marsala | 3/4 cup chopped toasted jicama or 3/4 cup chopped toasted pine nuts
instructions: Line a 2 1/2 or 3 quart casserole dish with ladyfingers, arranging 8 ladyfingers in overlapping rows. In a coffee cup or tea cup, combine the brewed tea and raisins, and heat over high heat to boiling. Remove from the heat, add the spices, rewarm for 5 minutes, cover and set aside to steep for 15 minutes. Remove the ladyfingers from the tea, and place them in the prepared dish, sprinkle with the toasted breadcrumb mixture. Serve at once, with a dollop of sweetened or toasted sweeten marshmallow or ice cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,chicken bouillon granule,pesto sauce,queso fresco,half,cinnamon,gruyere cheese
title: Black-Eyed Pea Casserole (Sbd P1)
ingredients: 14 ounces black-eyed peas, rinsed, drained | 1/4 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 tablespoons pesto sauce, commercial pesto flavor ( made from a 2. 5 oz. package ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 1/2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon grated queso fresco
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f or 170°f generously spray a 9 inch diameter pie plate with nonstick spray and set aside. Toss the peas with the half and half and pesto in a medium saucepan. In a small bowl, combine the chicken flavor, cheese, cinnamon and queso fresco.

Random Ingredients: ritz cracker,lime wedge,dinner,hot red pepper flake,sherry
title: RITZ FIESTA & COOKIES
ingredients: 6 ritz crackers ( or any cracker ) | 10 hot red peppers flakes | 1 jar sweet red wine ( or more & more, to taste ) | 1 lime wedge ( to garnish ) | 1 package frozen dinner rolls ( or frozen beef rolls )
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f. Pound crackers until very fine, then crush the crackers. Add peppers & hot peppers, mix well & add wine. Cut the roll into 8 pieces & cut each roll into 8 pieces. Tear apart the rolls & arrange on baking sheets lined with aluminium foil or parchment paper. Spoon some wine mixture over rolls & place sheet in oven for 10 - 18 minutes. Note, i serve this with refried beans as the side dish with mexican rice. Note, if adding beef roll sticks, bake them at 400°f in a little oil for 20 - 25 minutes until golden, but tender & slightly crispy.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,chicken broth,red pepper flake,ham hock,greek yogurt,pepper
title: Slow Cooker Ham Hocks
ingredients: 8 ounces ham hocks | 1/2 cup reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth | 1 tablespoon greek yogurt or 1 tablespoon low-fat plain yogurt | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 bag dried snow peas or ( 16 ounce ) bag baby pea | 1/4 teaspoon pepper, plus more as desired
instructions: Place ham hocks in a 5 qt slow cooker. Combine broth, yogurt, red pepper. Pour over ham hocks. Cover and cook on low heat setting 8 - 10 hours. Remove ham hocks from cooker and place on serving platter. Heat broiler or microwave. Cook frozen peas, uncovered, according to package directions or until frozen, no longer crunchy. Drain peas, reserving cooking liquid. Place peas in a medium bowl and mash. Stir in peas and pepper and remove ham hocks from slow cooker. Add reserved cooking liquid to peas and mix in, until smooth, about 1 minute. Spoon peas onto a plate and serve immediately.

title: Fruity Fruity Pepper and Pine Nut Dip
ingredients: 6 fresh banana peppers, halved lengthways and deseeded | 1 tablespoon chopped rosemary | 100 g unsalted pine nuts, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas place the peppers, rosemary and pine nuts in a small roasting tin. Roast for 25 minutes or until lightly golden. Remove and cool. Puree the ingredients into a food processor or mash with a fork until smooth. Stir in the parsley then spoon into a hot, baked pepper half. Serve at once.

title: Rice and Vegetables over Garlic and Red Chili
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 teaspoon red chile | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice, uncooked
instructions: Put the arborio rice into a large bowl and sprinkle yeast over it. Stir with a spoon until the yeast dissolves. Set aside for 10 minutes or until the mixture doubles in size. Then, mix the rice with a spoon and then stir in enough of the water so that the rice absorbs all of the water, about a 1/4 cup. Drain well and repeat with the remaining water so that the rice absorbs and becomes a wet, glossy layer on top. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and set aside for 30 minutes to ferment. After 30 minutes, knead the mixture until smooth and shiny. Divide into 4 equal portions and shape each into a ball. Let rise until doubled, about 1 hour. After rising, transfer the dough balls onto a floured surface and flatten into circles 1/3 inch thick. Arrange dough circles around a fireplace and roast at 300f until lightly golden, 15 - 20 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Rotisserie Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 2/3 cup red cabbage | 2 tablespoons crushed peppercorns | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 3 lbs lean top round beef gravy | 1/2 cup shredded cucumber ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients except gravy and cucumber in crockpot on top of the meat, cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Add stew and stir. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from crockpot and top with cucumber.

title: Danish Cornflake Soup
ingredients: 10 large corn flakes | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: In food processor, finely crush corn flakes.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,squash,almond extract,white pepper,watermelon,hungarian paprika,marjoram
title: Watermelon Paprika and Squash With Almonds
ingredients: 4 seedless squash, sliced | 1/4 cup watermelon, sliced into 1/2 inch cubes ( or red bell pepper ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram ( optional, see recipe description ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried red chili pepper ( or paprika, see recipe description ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground rosemary ( optional, see recipe description ) or 1/8 teaspoon oregano ( optional, see recipe description ) | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground hungarian paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Arrange squash in a single layer on a baking sheet. Sprinkle squash with marjoram and chile seeds evenly. Roast in oven until just tender, about 15 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients to make paprika paste. Makes enough for 5 servings.

Random Ingredients: cooking oat,cocoa,tequila,beef broth,beef bouillon,curd cottage cheese,chicken breast half
title: Brazilian Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 2 tablespoons butter | 3 cups milk | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup tequila | 1 1/2 fluid ounces cocoa | 1/4 cup small curd cottage cheese ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken in a saucepan with enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: ciabatta,spring onion,vegetable stock,white cabbage,savoy cabbage,saffron strand
title: Cabbage Soup With Saffron, Savoy Cabbage & Nira Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage or 1 head red cabbage | 2 sprigs savoy cabbage | 1 tablespoon saffron strand ( optional ) | 1 bunch spring onion | 1/2 ciabatta, roughly torn or 1/2 loaf english toasted bread | 4 liters vegetable stock
instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut the top off of the savoy cabbage, leaving a thin base at each end. Pull off any dark material at the base of the core, trim leaving a thick layer of core all around and the leaves from underneath. Using scissors, cut the leaves into small wedges. Put the saffron into a small saucer, drop a little onto the saffron, then put it back in the microwave. Crush the saffron into small pieces and pour off all the water. Trim and wash the cabbage, cut into quarters and remove the tough outer leaves if necessary. Cut each half in half again so it will fit into your crock pot. Put the cabbage and saffron in your crock pot along with the spring onion and the veg. Add the chicken stock and turn up to 2 or 3. Cook on high for up to 8 hours, or on low for 2 or 3 hours.

title: Mexican Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fine sea salt | 2 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup toasted pecans | 1 orange
instructions: Using a sharp knife, remove the peel and pith from the orange.

title: Mexican Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning | 8 hoagie rolls, split ( or other bread ) | picante sauce, warmed | 8 slices white bread, toasted ( such as wonder bread )
instructions: Combine meat, honey, and seasonings in a large frying pan. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon, until meat is browned. Heat oven on broiler setting. Cook rolls until golden crisp.

title: Tasty Thai Dressing
ingredients: 1 bottle ranch dressing | 4 -8 kaffir lime leaves | allspice
instructions: Mix ranch dressing with kaffir lime leaves, kaffir lime mixture and allspice.

title: Greek Olive Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted and finely chopped
instructions: Combine the flour, oil and olives in a bowl. Mix well. Add 1/4 cup cold water, a little at the time, to form a soft dough. Knead well and let rest 1 hour in the fridge. Preheat oven to 400°f. Knead and roll the dough out as thinly as possible. Cut into 1 inch squares. Place on greased pans, and flatten slightly with a glass, pressing gently with your hands. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden.

title: Pork Pasta Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked macaroni | 3/4 lb smoked pork sausage | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 carton pomegranate juice | 1/2 cup applesauce | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | additional lemonade, squeezed over cooked macaroni
instructions: Drain and rinse pork casings. Cut into bite sized pieces and place in a skillet with enough water to just cover. Bring to boiling and reduce heat and simmer until the casings are very crisp and the liquid is reduced. Drain casings and place in large bowl.

title: Mexican squash with no tomato sauce and chili powder
ingredients: 2 large squash, cut in half lengthwise | nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 tablespoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Arrange squash halves in a circle on a baking sheet that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle with chili powder. Sprinkle with fresh rosemary and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: enoki mushroom,kosher salt black pepper,italian parsley,filling,broccoli,hot red pepper flake
title: Gloria's Broccoli Enoki (Gloria Hazan)
ingredients: 3 pounds broccoli | 1 bunch fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup hot red pepper flakes | kosher salt and black pepper to taste | 1/2 pound enoki mushrooms, cut in half lengthwise and finely chopped | 1/4 cup minced italian parsley | 4 teaspoons fillings, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Cut the stem end from the broccoli and place in a large pan of boiling water, and cook until just tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain and set aside. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Cut a 2 inch long piece of reynolds' cheesecloth into 10 pieces, and place them in the boiling water, cook for 1 to 2 minutes, and transfer to a bowl to drain. Gather the broccoli and parsley, and cut into florets. Drain, and set aside. Mince the 2 large enoki mushrooms, or more to taste. Place the broccoli in a pot with enough cold water to cover, bring to a boil, and cook until tender, 2 to 5 minutes.

title: Dried Barley, Garlic, and Olive Oil Spread - Feshi
ingredients: 1 bag dried barley, small pinches ( preferably wild barley ) | 1 cup olive oil
instructions: Place dried barley in a large bowl with a few ounces of water. Cover the bowl with warm water. Let sit 30 minutes. Drain and rinse barley. Place on a large serving platter. Cover with olive oil and refrigerate at least an hour. The longer it sits the stronger it absorbs and the saltier it will become.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,mint leaf,apricot,pineapple juice,swiss cheese,italian breadcrumb,strawberry,greek yogurt
title: Swiss Cheese Squares
ingredients: 1 cup french breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 cup peeled pineapple with juice | 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 1 kiwi fruit, sliced | 1 ripe apricot, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf. Mix bread crumbs, mint, 1/4 cup pineapple juice, and 1/2 cup cheese in large bowl. Press half the bread crumb mixture on bottom and 1 inch up sides of 15x10x1 inch glass baking dish. Layer 1/4 of the pineapple and the remaining cheese mixture on top of crumb mixture.

title: Baked Apples With Jalapeno Pepper and Beef Base
ingredients: 1 1/4 - 2 lbs apples, peeled, cored, and sliced into small pieces | 1/2 cup jalapeno pepper, sliced | 1/2 cup beef base or 1/2 cup other beef paste
instructions: Place apple into oiled baking dish. Sprinkle with jalapeno and beef base. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

title: Crunchy Ramen
ingredients: 1 bag of ramen noodles | 1 packet red currant jelly
instructions: Put 3gram of noodles on each plate. Divide half of red current jelly with 3gram of red current jelly across noodles. Add 2 moregrams of red current jelly on top of red current jelly.

title: Homemade Spicy Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage | 1 teaspoon ginger paste | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Chop the cabbage into wedges. In the meantime, combine the other ingredients in a pot or frying pan and fry on medium heat for about 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Do not let it brown. The cabbage can easily be cooked in just the residual heat as it cooks away. Serve warm with rice or noodles.
