The cabbage can also be cooked and processed in a blender or food processor. Some of the spiciness can be reduced by cooking more of the tomato paste in the water or broth. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,apple,apricot jam,vanilla sugar,chili garlic sauce,cremini mushroom,onion powder,breadcrumb
title: Czech Crunch
ingredients: 1 can cremini mushrooms, drained | 1 tablespoon chili flakes ( or equivalent, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon grated fresh onion powder | 2 tablespoons cremini dried apricot jam | 8 ounces breadcrumbs ( or more ) | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 2 tablespoons instant dried chili flakes | 2 tablespoons applesauce or 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 3 tablespoons cremini dried apricot jam | 2 tablespoons cremini dried apricot chili flakes | 1 tablespoon apple, grated | 2 tablespoons cremini dried mushrooms, drained | 1 dash onion powder | 2 tablespoons cremini dried mushrooms, drained
instructions: Make sure you have all ingredients prepped before you start. Combine all ingredients in food processor, then process until smooth. Pour into bag, add bread crumbs and shake to coat with crumbs. Chill till ready to use. To prepare crumble ~ mix dried fruit together and spread on crackers, then top with apricot jam and cremini dried mushrooms. Roll into walnut sized balls.

title: Grapefruit Burritos
ingredients: 10 flour tortillas | 3 cans chopped grapefruits, drained and juice squeezed ( juice reserved ) | 1 jar spaghetti, cooked | 2 1/2 cups raisins | 2 1/2 cups guacamole ( to taste ) | 3 large taco shells, broken up ( burrito size ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Bake burritos. Preheat oven 375 degrees. Spread a thin layer of reserved grapefruit juice in bottom of each tortilla. Spoon 1/4 cup of the cooked spaghetti on each burrito.

title: Chinese Noodles
ingredients: 2 packages top ramen noodles | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 2 teaspoons cornflour
instructions: Combine garlic and cornflour in a bowl. Bring water to the boil and add ramen noodles. Cook for 3 min. Drain noodles. Garnish with noodles then serve.

title: Niter Kofta
ingredients: 1/4 kg turmeric powder | 1/2 kg clear honey
instructions: Boil the turmeric powder with the honey for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, allow to cool and bottle. Serve cold with tea, snacks or rice.

title: Tahini Butter
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut milk powder | 1/4 cup bourbon ( try sambal oelek, or a good bourbon )
instructions: Blend the coconut milk powder and sambal oelek in a blender or small food processor and let sit for 5 minutes. Stir in the whiskey or rum. The tahini should have the consistency of a paste. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Bitter Spiced Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely grated | 3/4 teaspoon black cardamom pods, lightly crushed
instructions: Combine the grated cheese, cardamom pods and about a 1/4 cup of water in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir constantly until the mixture is a rich, dark brown color. Reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove cardamon pods from the pot. Slowly pour the parmigiano reggiano all over the warm cheese, and stir until the cheese has melted into the sauce. Continue cooking the cheese, stirring frequently, until the sauce is dark, dense and smooth to form a thick syrup, about 1 1/2 minutes. Keep warm over low heat while preparing the rest of the meal.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,star anise,dark sesame oil,pineapple juice,raisin,chili bean
title: Sweet and Savory Pineapple Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 cans chunk pineapple in juice | 1 can pineapple chunks in syrup | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 can chili beans, with liquid ( i sometimes use canned ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons raisins | 1/2 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Empty the all of the cans together and dump into a slow cooker. Add the pineapple chunks, sugar and raisins. Stir well. Cook on medium setting for 6 - 10 hours on low or high.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,picante sauce,sauce,canola oil,plain flour,wasabi paste,beef stock,champagne
title: Chaparri Beef Steak With Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 500 g sirloin steaks, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 cup chow mein noodles | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1/3 cup beef stock | 1 tablespoon wasabi paste | 2/3 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon hp steak sauce | 1 tablespoon champagne
instructions: Prepare your wok, heat oil on high. Stir fry beef in batches until nicely browned. Remove from wok and set aside. Heat the wok and stir fry the mushrooms for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring all the time. Return beef to wok with noodles and pour over the stock. Mix well over heat for about 15 minutes until noodles are cooked. Combine wasabi paste, picante sauce and HP sauce. Heat through. Serve beef with noodles. Note, if you don't have the champagne, then you can substitute the white wine.

title: Lettuce and Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup shredded lettuce leaf | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts | 1/2 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon dried minced garlic salt ( or to taste ) or 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon tahini | 1/4 cup canned tomato juice | 2 -4 teaspoons rinsed quinoa ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup chopped fresh spinach
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the first eight ingredients, except the spinach and quinoa, then gently mix with a fork. In a small bowl, combine the quinoa and spinach. Toss with the dressing, sprinkle with the quinoa mixture and toss gently. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili,pork chop,coconut milk,ancho chilies,pea,cornflour,heavy whipping cream,wine vinegar
title: Pork and Pea Curry
ingredients: 6 large pork chops, fat trimmed | fresh chili, to taste | 1 teaspoon cornflour, dissolved in | 4 ounces dry-roasted peas | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1 cup thick coconut milk | 2 ounces peas, shelled | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Mix cornflour with 2oz of the cream and set aside 1/3 cup of this cream to use as a topping for the curry. Cut pork into small cubes, season, then fry in oil, about 5 - 7 minutes until browned and cooked, remove from pan and set aside. Wipe out pan. Add to pan 1 2oz of the cream and fry the peas for 2 minutes or until they are a golden brown colour, add to the pan and stir to combine, cook for another 3 minutes. Stir in the cornflour cream mixture, rice flour and remaining cream and stir to combine well. Heat the mixture slightly, remove and discard chilli. Serve with rice.

title: Spicy Spinach Salad
ingredients: 10 -12 leaves of mixed salad greens | 1 leek, chopped | 150 g spinach | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1/2 lime, juiced | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper powder | 20 buns
instructions: Roughly chop the leaves or leave whole, then rinse them to get rid of sand or debris. Chop the leek well and chop the spinach roughly. Put the greens and leeks together in a bowl, with the spices, lime juice and a little of the chilli sauce. Add the rest of the chilli sauce to taste. Mix everything together, then garnish with the buns. Serve with any indian meal as is, rice, bread or anything else that you can think of.

title: Sausage, Chile & Garlic Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces fat-free refried beans | 12 ounces hot italian sausage | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cloves
instructions: To make it easier to prepare, heat refried beans. In skillet over medium high, brown sausage. Drain excess grease. Add cloves.

title: Garlicky Asparagus Rice With Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1/4 lb asparagus, cut in 1 inch pieces | 1 jar anchovies ( drained or oil-packed if your home brand doesn't sell anchovies ) | 2 long yellow peppers, cut julienne | 1/4 lb long grain rice
instructions: Cook the rice using the asparagus and anchovies as directed on the bag.. Add the peppers in a little water to loosen the skin. When done remove from water and set aside. When hot, toss the asparagus and pepper in the oil or water until all is well coated.

title: Zucchini & Grape Tomatoes -- Indian Zucchini With Parsley (Vegan No-Sugar)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons kasuri methi ( dried fenugreek leaves, available at indian markets ) | 1 lb zucchini, trimmed and cut diagonally 1/2-inch bias-wise into 1-inch slices | 14 large grape tomatoes, halved | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod, lightly crushed
instructions: Pour the kasuri and 3 cups water into a wide, shallow dish and set over medium high heat. Add the zucchini in batches and scatter the tomatoes over it. Sprinkle with the cardamom and toss to coat evenly with the zucchini. Cover and reduce the heat to lowest setting. Cook over low heat until the zucchini is beginning to brown around the edges and beginning to soften in spots, about 45 minutes. Raise the heat under the zucchini to medium. Cook until most of the water evaporates and the zucchini is golden, about 5 minutes. Drain the zucchini on paper towels. Cover and let stand 5 minutes to absorb some of the zucchini cooking liquid. Transfer the tomato slices to warmed large, shallow serving bowls. Sprinkle with salt to taste and serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,fish sauce,garlic powder,chicken leg quarter
title: Thyme Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 3 tablespoons low sodium fish sauce | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 6 chicken leg quarters
instructions: Combine fish sauce, garlic powder, thyme leaves, and chicken in a large bowl. Toss until coated.

Random Ingredients: natural peanut butter,pecan,shrimp,mushroom,wild rice mix,liquid smoke,caper
title: Wild Rice Shrimp Burgers
ingredients: 1 package wild rice mix ( wild rice ) | 1 cup raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 5 tablespoons light natural peanut butter ( not crunchy peanut butter ) | 1 -2 teaspoon capers | 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms ( button, oyster, or red endive ) | 4 tablespoons chopped pecans or 4 tablespoons walnuts | 8 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions. Let cool slightly, stir in shrimp and set aside. In small bowl, combine peanut butter, capers, chives, mushrooms, and pecans. Season to taste with liquid smoke. Use as you would regular hamburgers or as desired.

title: My Mexican Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 medium cucumber | 6 diced green chilies | 2 ounces sliced green olives | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni according to directions on box. Rinse under cold water, set aside. Slice cucumber on the bias and place into bowl. Slice green chillies lengthwise, slice on the diagonal, removing seeds, cutting into halves if desired. Add green olives to bowl. Add white pepper. Add cooked macaroni. Mix. Chill before serving.

title: Potato Pancakes for the BBQ (Zwt II)
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes | 1 medium eggplant | 1 leek | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 -2 tablespoon prepared miso | 2 lemons, juice of | 1 sprig fresh thyme ( optional )
instructions: For the potato pancakes, cut potato in half. Scrub off excess potato peel, then cut potato into 1/2 inch slices. For the eggplant pancakes, peel eggplant and cut into 1/2 inch slices. Trim leek.

title: Mrs. Somebody's Beans (From Pennypockets)
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto beans | kitchen bouquet ( or other flavor ) | 1/3 cup sugar ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup granulated sugar | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Soak the beans in plenty of water for about 4 hours, depending on weight of beans. Place beans in roaster or dutch oven and cover with water about 2/3 of the way up. Bake in 350°f oven for 6 to 8 hours. Add the kitchen bouquet, making sure they dissolve as this will insure the beans will be dry. Add the sugar and cook slowly about 30 to 35 minutes. You may need to add more water if the mixture becomes dry and looks too dry. Add more kitchen bouquet or kitchen bouquet about 1/3 cup at a time.. If you need to, taste and adjust sugar as necessary. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature with ice, or refrigerate until cold. Serve with guacamole.

title: Homemade Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 3 tablespoons taco seasoning ( i use mccormick's taco seasoning ) | 1 green pepper, cut into strips for stir-fry or 1/2 a red pepper, cut into strips for stir-fry
instructions: Tunge the strips of pepper into the hot taco seasoning and stir fry for a few seconds and then remove from teh skillet. Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

title: Coconut Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 2 packages cheese tortellini | 1 cup light sour cottage cheese | 1/2 cup chopped desiccated coconut | 1 -2 chopped cooked scallops | 1/2 cup chopped vegetables, of your choice | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water. Drain well. While tortellini is cooking, combine cottage cheese, coconut, scallops, and vegetables in a medium bowl. Stir in cheese. Add vinegar and mix well. Pour mixture over tortellini and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,double cream,green chili pepper,red chilies,rose water
title: Red Bellies
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 100 g green chili peppers | 4 small red chilies | 150 ml double cream | 2 tablespoons rose water
instructions: Heat oven to c and line oven trays with baking paper. Place all ingredients into a mixing bowl and mix well. Press 1/2 the dough onto tray and flatten in trays into a rectangle. Repeat with remaining dough. Place in oven and cook for about 10 to 15 minutes or until golden. Serve hot. Note, red chili peppers can be used if you prefer. Roast red chili in a heavy based frying pan over a high heat and cook, stirring as needed, for a few minutes for softer peppers to soften, or asparisiac is usually used in some recipes.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,chunky salsa,pear,italian bread,beer,ra el hanout spice mix,red chili powder
title: Pear and Raisin Chili
ingredients: 1 bottle dark beer | 5 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 pear | 1/2 cup raisins and raisins, in brine, drained | 2 loaves italian bread, toasted and cut into half-moons
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a large sauce pan. Cover, bring to a steady simmer and cook for about 25 minutes.

title: French Dip
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck roast ( or other cuts of meat as desired ) | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Place chuck roast in roasting pan. Combine dry ingredients and sprinkle them over the meat. Cover and bake at 375f for 8 - 10 hours or overnight remove cover and continue baking for an additional hour.

title: Tamarind Beans (Tamarind Beans)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried cannellini beans or 1 1/2 cups black beans | 1 large mild tomato, chopped | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Soak beans over night. Add tamarind paste, apple juice and cook with cover on low heat until tender.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,extra virgin olive oil,creole seasoning,red chilies,quinoa,corn,pineapple tidbit,japanese sushi rice
title: Japanese Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn, thawed | 4 fresh red chilies, minced ( or use your own canned ) | 1/4 lb velveeta cheese, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 1 can crushed pineapple tidbits, drained | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons montreal oriental sushi seasoning | 4 cups cooked japanese sushi rice
instructions: Cook the quinoa as per the package directions, when it is just about ready. Drain completely and set aside. Combine all ingredient except the olive oil in a large skillet or wok and cook over medium heat until cheese has melted. Stir in quinoa, tossing gently to coat. Place skillet over medium heat and cook mixture while shaking the skillet with tongs to separate the rice from the cheese, about 10 minutes. Serve with your favorite sushi condiments.

title: Wild Rice Soup - Microwave Style
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/4 cup wild rice, uncooked
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 3 quart or larger glass or other metal microwave safe dish. Place on the top rack of the microwave on the low setting, cover loosely and cook for 4 - 6 minutes until the cauliflower and beef are tender, stirring occasionally. Serve hot.

title: Pomfret Ct Dhania (Corn Dumplings)
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 2/3 cup orange juice ( juice from concentrate is best ) | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a mixing bowl, knead for approximately 10 - 15 minutes. The dough will be quite wetter than normal dough. Drop in water and coat your hands well. Let sit for at least 15 minutes prior to rolling out the batter to make small balls. Spray a fry pan with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Drop the balls individually into the fry pan, flattening them down into a circle about 1 1/2 inches thick. Don't let them touch or touch too heavily. Turn and cook until all sides are well browned. Serve warm with fresh yogurt.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,milk,rum extract,liquid honey,ricotta cheese,red curry paste,baby leek
title: Easy Ricotta (Vegan)
ingredients: 2 ounces red curry paste ( go taste test! ) | 2 1/2 ounces liquid honey | 3 1/2 ounces evaporated milk | 3/4 cup low-fat ricotta cheese | 3 baby leeks, cleaned ( or 2 large ) | 1/3 teaspoon rum extract | 1 1/2 ounces vegetable stock
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a non stick pan. Add the red curry paste. Fry for a couple of seconds so that it smells fragrant and fragrant, then add the honey and evaporated milk. Cook for a few minutes until the thickens and begins to thicken some. Add the leeks with a touch of sugar for a couple of minutes so they become translucent. Add the rum and cook for another couple minutes. Place the ricotta in a bowl or container, and stir in the dissolved sugar. The mixture will seem a little fluid, but it will slowly incorporate into the mixture. Add the dissolved sugar/cream/honey mixture to the ricotta, mix thoroughly. Garnish with sprigs of thyme and/or minced chives, if desired. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,duck breast,extra virgin olive oil,pineapple juice,veal,cremini mushroom,wonton wrapper,pasta
title: Veal Coconut Ravioli
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 package uncooked wonton wrappers | 6 ounces ground veal | 6 ounces cooked duck breast, finely chopped | 1 can tropical cremini mushrooms, drained diced | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 cup pasta sauce and pasta, of your choice
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add wonton wrappers.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,romaine lettuce,marinara sauce,worcestershire sauce,red chilies,orange juice concentrate
title: Mexican Beer Salad
ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce | 1/3 cup dark beer or 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 4 dry red chilies, finely chopped | 1 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: In mixing bowl, combine beer, worcestershire sauce, chilies, orange juice and marinara sauce.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,red wine,cake flour,sultana,chili pepper,cream chicken soup
title: Creamy Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 4 teaspoons cake flour | 2 teaspoons chili peppers | 440 g condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can coconut milk | 1 tablespoon red wine | 3/4 cup sultana
instructions: Place flour, chillies and sultanas in bowl and mix. Add condensed soup and mix. Add coconut milk and red wine and mix. Chill. Serve with your favourite meat dish.

title: Easy Microwave Rice & Onion
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice ( i like jasmine ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix
instructions: Measure in a casserole dish put in rice, mix and spices. Cover with lid. Put on hi for 3 minutes on high and turn on low. You will see some liquid form on the top. Stir it every 15 minutes or so. Cook for 15 - 20 minutes to finish.

title: Red Lentil Soup With Ham Hocks and Pita Bread
ingredients: 2 medium red lentils | 1 ham hock | corn oil, for frying | 4 pita breads
instructions: Rinse the lentils thoroughly under running water, removing any debris and rocks. Boil the lentils until tender. Remove the ham hock and set aside to cool down enough to handle. Cut the meat into chunks and set aside. Cut some slits in the top of the pita breads to allow steam to escape. Drop the lentils into the soup and place the pita on the top of them. Sprinkle liberally with salt. Heat the soup gently to the boil. Serve the soup warm on flat bread.

title: Green Fish in Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chutney | 1/2 cup minced green chilies | 1/2 cup shredded parmigiano | 1/4 cup minced garlic | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 lbs fresh fish fillets, in 1 `` | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: In a heavy medium saucepan, combine the chutney, green chilies, parmigiano cheese, garlic and the flour. Bring to a boil over moderate heat. Add fish, cover and simmer until fish is just cooked, about 6 minutes. Pour the fish mixture into a colander set over a bowl. Using a slotted spoon, put fish into the chutney mixture and let drain until cool to the touch. Transfer mixture to a small bowl and beat with whisk until blended. Place fish mixture in a shallow baking dish filled with a little vegetable oil. Cover and chill for up to a week, or store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cover baking dish with foil and bake fish for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork. Serve fish hot, garnished with grand marnier.

title: Pumpkin-Butternut Sprouts Fritters
ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cubed | 2 cups bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon potato starch
instructions: Boil squash in water for 3 minutes, remove.

title: Easy Beef Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 container plain yogurt | 1 beef heart, cooked and mashed ( i like the quick cuts type ) | lawry seasoning
instructions: In a large bowl combine the yogurt, onion, beef heart, seasoning and mix until all ingredients are mixed. Refrigerate in the refrigerator for 2 hours before serving to allow flavors to develop. Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,orange peel,black sesame seed,chocolate chip
title: Chocolate Chip Chip Chip Truffles
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh orange peel, finely chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons black sesame seeds, grated ( dark, white ) | 2 teaspoons orange-flavored adobo seasoning, adjust to taste ( mccormick ) | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate chips, melted
instructions: Stir orange peel, sesame seeds, and orange food coloring into a small bowl until well combined.

title: Corn Tortilla Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons butter | 2/3 cup apricot preserves | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix molasses and butter until soft. Combine preserves with remaining ingredients. Lay 4 tortillas in one layer on cookie sheet. Spread with half of the molasses/butter mixture, and sprinkle with 1/2 of the apricot preserve mix. Place other tortillas on top, and repeat with remaining tortillas. Press down on the tortillas with your hands, and place on the cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the tops are golden.

title: Quick Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup fresh blueberries, washed and dried | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the blueberries with the hoisin sauce and toss to coat. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Blueberry Lover's Lamb
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh blueberries | 1/3 cup strawberry preserves | 2 lbs boneless lamb, cut into 2-inch squares | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 12 corn tortilla chips, broken | 2 tablespoons butter
instructions: Put the blueberries, preserves & lamb in a large saucepan & barely cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat & simer for 1 hr to thicken the sauce, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat & put 2 tablespoons of the butter in a skillet & add the broken tortilla chips. Dip the tortilla pieces into the remaining butter then toss with the blueberries & strawberries.

title: Thai Baked Chocolate
ingredients: 3 ounces unsweetened chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped thai basil | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 4 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate or 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Grease a 9 inch square baking dish or a candy coated rimmed loaf pan. Heat oven to 325°f in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt chocolate, basil, lemon juice and sugar. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,colby monterey jack cheese
title: St. Patrick's Day Biscuits
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 cups shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a mixing bowl, blend the self rising flour and cheese. Add 1/2 cup of batter and mix to combine. Roll the mixture into balls, place onto the prepared baking sheet, and flatten slightly with the bottom of a glass. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: almond,rice vinegar,russet potato,phyllo pastry,apricot preserve,cannellini bean,onion
title: Baked Vegetable Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot preserves | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 cup chopped onion | 1 cup chopped almonds | 1 lb frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Boil potatoes for about 20 to 25 minutes or until tender, drain and set aside in a bowl. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine the beans, apricot preserves and vinegar and set aside. Brush a 13 x 9 casserole with oil. Layer half of the phyllo in the pan, brush generously with oil and cover with the remaining phyllo sheets. Bake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until top and golden, brushing once with remaining oil. Remove from oven.

title: Tasty Onion Dip
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 cooking onion, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill. Best made at least two hours before serving. Serve with crackers and/or vegetables. Serve with french bread, pumpernickel buns, etc.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 500 g chicken fillets | 1 teaspoon jamaican jerk spice ( the spice mix of your choice ) | 300 g fresh meat, chopped | 250 g swiss cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c. Score the top half of a chicken breast into 6 slices. Rub the spice mix into the breast and cut the chicken into small casseroles. Place the chicken on a baking tray and brush the chicken with olive oil. Cover and leave for 20 minutes. Turn the chicken and bake for 15 minutes or until cooked and brown. Place the chicken on a serving plate and top with ramekins, crumbled cheese and salad leaves. Serve with the sauce.

title: Shaking Coffee
ingredients: 2 cups kahlua | 3/4 cup sugar | 4 ounces curry
instructions: Pour the sugar into the bowl of a coffee filter. Pour 2 cups of the kahlua into the filter. Filter out the sugar. Mix 3/4 cup of the sugar into the coffee with the curry in it. Pour all of the coffee into the coffee filter and pour the sugar mixture evenly in the pan. Set the pan to medium heat and bring the mixture to a boil. When the mixture reaches 220f on a candy thermometer, it should be quite bubbly. Do not stir in the sugar to measure after a minute. Remove the pan from the heat. Remove from the heat and allow to sit for 10 minutes. Pour out into coffee cups for 2 cups.

title: Red Cabbage and Stilton Hash
ingredients: 1 medium head red cabbage, finely shredded | 3/4 cup red stilton cheese | 3/4 cup mashed potatoes ( about two large hash ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Place the cabbage in a large bowl and using a fork toss with the potato, seasoning salt or use the quick pulse on the side of the pot. Let sit for 10 minutes, then stir once more.

title: Easy Rice Noodle and Oats (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 package quick-cooking rolled oats ( not quick cooking ) | 1 package dry rice noodles, broken into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Place oats in a very small bowl. Place noodles in a very very large quantity of very rapidly boiling water. When they start to boil, add only about 1 cup of water. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 10 minutes. Drain, run under cold water then drain. Toss noodles around to coat evenly. Transfer to 4 serving dishes, cover and refrigerate overnight, tossing occasionally. Break into sections while that's still chilling.

title: Margarita Pie Filling
ingredients: 1 prepared pie pastry | 3/4 cup cold milk | 1 1/2 cups golden tequila, for rimming the pie | 3/4 cup margarita sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Roll out the puff pastry dough into a thin rectangle and place in the bottom of a 9 unbaked pie plate. Trim the edges and crimp them together. Brush with margarita mix, and pinch together. Place tequila and sweetened condensed milk in a cocktail shaker with some of the margarita mix. Shake vigorously for 2 to 3 seconds until the margarita dissolves. Pour filling into crust. Drape the edges of the dough over the filling and seal around the pie. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,bean sprout,egg noodle,cumin seed,french vanilla cake mix
title: Baked Beans and Noodles Baked
ingredients: 1 package french vanilla cake mix | 1 package egg noodles | 1 can baked beans with sprouts | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a 10x15 inch baking dish. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the 
    - 1 package of cake mix in the preheated oven until the top has a crumbly texture, about 25 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook egg noodles in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream corn,spice,ham,sesame seed oil,green bell pepper
title: Chinese Spiced Ham & Peppers(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 3/4 lb smoked ham or 3/4 lb spicy ham, cut into 1-1/2-inch squares | 4 -5 green bell peppers or 4 -5 red bell peppers, halved lengthwise sliced | 1 can condensed cream-style corn | 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil | spices, to taste
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300°f. Mix all ingredients, place in a baking pan with a cover, bake at 300°f for 45 - 50 minutes or so, until vegetables are tender and ham is crispy. Serve over noodles, rice or mashed potatoes as an appetizer. Goes well with other dishes as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,green cardamom pod,halibut,beef chuck,cumin powder,red cabbage
title: Moroccan Halibut and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh halibut, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 lbs beef chuck, cut into chunks | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 green cardamom pods | 2 medium sized red cabbage, quartered | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Wash and pat dry all the fish. Place fish in a large soup pot, preferably non stick, with the red cabbage quarters around the edges of the pot. Add salt and pepper to taste, as the fish will absorb all the flavor. Add the cumin, cardamom pods and enough water to come about halfway up the side of the vegetables. Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to keep the fish covered and simmer until the meat is just cooked through, anywhere from 15 to 40 minutes. Check the meat periodically to ensure that it is not drying out. If liquid is not evaporated, continue cooking at medium low until the meat is almost fully cooked, or until it is quite firm. If the water evaporates, continue cooking.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,asiago cheese,parmesan cheese,almond,radish,creme fraiche,onion soup mix,english muffin
title: Rice Vinegar French Bread Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 envelope onion soup mix ( dry ) | 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/4 cup dried parmesan cheese, grated | 1/4 cup toasted and shredded argana cheese ( italian cheese blend ) | 1 small onion, sliced thin, divided | 1/2 - 1 cup thinly sliced radish, divided | 1 -3 cup sliced almonds, divided ( whole, blanched, salted, salted, or sun dried )
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f grease 10 inch pizza pan with cooking spray. Combine vinegar, onion soup mix, creme fraiche, creme fraiche, parmesan cheese, and 1/4 cup parmesan cheese in medium bowl. Stir in argana cheese and 1/4 cup onion.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,dark brown sugar,cheese,turkey sausage,vodka,clove,egg noodle,fruit
title: The Daggoo (Smoked Turkey Sausage and Noodle Casserole)
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked turkey sausage | 4 cups cooked egg noodles | 6 cups cheese, grated ( i use a blend of mozzarella and parmesan ) | 12 small mixed fruit | 1/2 cup vodka | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons hot sauce | 1 drop clove ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Fry sausage until brown, remove from pan and set aside. Cook egg noodles, drain and set aside. Combine egg noodles and sausage in large casserole dish. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Place mixed fruit on top. Mix remaining ingredients in small bowl, pour on top with egg noodles and meat mixture. Cover with foil and bake 1 hour or until mixture is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,ancho chile powder,thai basil,vegetable oil,poppy seed,guacamole,brown sugar
title: Ganache-Spoon Batter for Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup brown sugar ( firmly packed ) | 3/4 cup thai basil ( chiffonade ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh jalapeno pepper | 2 1/2 teaspoons ancho chile powder | 1 1/3 teaspoons poppy seeds | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon guacamole, to finish
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in food processor until just mixed. Add fish and pulse once or twice to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Serve with toasted bagels over hot coals. If desired sprinkle additional basil on top of fish when serving.

Random Ingredients: cumin,mint,savoy cabbage,vegetable oil,coconut oil,maple syrup,lime juice,red cabbage
title: Coconut-Mint Cabbage Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons coconut oil, or to taste | 2 cups shredded savoy cabbage | 1/4 cup minced fresh mint | 2 large cups shredded red cabbage | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Whisk lime juice, maple syrup, and ground cumin together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: bacon,extra sharp cheddar cheese,cocoa powder,yukon gold potato
title: Creamy Potato Au Gratin
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into eighths ( about 3 medium ) | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 8 slices bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled | 6 ounces extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( about 1 cup )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 325°f. Cut unpeeled potatoes into 1 inch thick slices, place in a baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired. Scatter bacon over potatoes. Sprinkle top with cocoa. Sprinkle about half of grated cheese over the cheese. Pour remaining 2 t. Of cheese over the cheese. Cover tightly with foil, transfer to oven and bake until potatoes are tender, about 1 hour. Uncover and bake until top is golden and bubbling, about 15 - 20 minutes more. Cut into squares while still warm.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,tomato,brie cheese,hot red pepper flake,vanilla sugar,pea,red cabbage
title: Sweet & Savory Brie Salad With Scorching Peas and Sunflower Seeds
ingredients: 175 g sweet italian rolls | 175 g brie cheese, thinly sliced | 1 large tomatoes, thinly sliced | 1/4 red cabbage, shredded into long ribbons | 1/2 cup pea sprouts | 1/4 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1/4 teaspoon light-colored cooking tomato, diced | 2 teaspoons unsalted sunflower seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon low-spice light ( optional )
instructions: Wrap rolls in plastic wrap and refrigerate while preparing other salad ingredients. Cut rolls into thirds and arrange them cut side up in a serving dish, overlapping slightly if necessary to make them sandwich friendly. Layer brie, tomato, cabbage, pea sprouts, red pepper flakes, vanilla sugar and sunflower seeds on top of the brie. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve. This will make enough for a number of servings. Note, prep time does not include chill time.

title: Charcoal Balsamic
ingredients: 1/4 cup caster sugar | 1/4 cup light brown sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Balsamic vinegar, combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium low heat and warm to the tepid stage. Bring to a light boil. Using slotted spoon, remove from heat and pour over hot coals. Allow to cool slightly. Use as directed in balsamic recipe.

title: Smoked Beef and Apple Lettuce Bake
ingredients: 1 large russet potato | 2 medium cooking apples, pealed, cored, chopped coarsely | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped | 1 cup beef stock, unsalted | lettuce leaf | chives, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Scrub potato and prick with a fork. Place in a medium saucepan of boiling water, turn over and steam for about 30 minutes or until completely cooked.

title: Easy Spicy Cheese Spread
ingredients: 225 g shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 can premade guacamole | 2 tablespoons golden syrup ( or honey if you prefer ) | 400 g prepared marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c. Grease a 19cm x 29cm swiss roll tin. Combine all ingredients. Spread into the prepared tin and bake for 40 - 45 mins or until firm. Allow to cool & set. When cold, cut into 12 slices & serve.

title: The Real Easy Fajitas
ingredients: 1 package pancake mix | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1/4 cup hot paprika | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves, torn ( or 1 tablespoon fresh sage, chopped finely ) | 1 can capicola ( or more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Prepare pancake mix according to manufacturers directions using mustard and paprika. Spread onto large cookie sheet and bake for 20/30 minutes until golden brown and crisp looking. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to use. When ready to serve, drain off fat. Dice into small pieces and serve. May freeze up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,almond,veal,wheat flour,taco seasoning mix,sofrito sauce,irish cream,black eyed pea
title: Scallops and Black-Eyed Peas Tostados
ingredients: 1 pound shaved scallops | 1 pound shaved veal | 1 can sliced black-eyed peas, drained | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons ground almonds | 1 bottle sofrito sauce | 1/4 head whole wheat flour, or as needed | 1/4 package irish cream
instructions: Lay scallops flat at the bottom of a steamer basket fitted with a metal steamer basket or into rice bowls. Place a large, flat plate on top of scallops. Place the meat onto the plate. Place peas over the meat. Sprinkle taco seasoning mix over the peas. Place almonds in a small skillet over medium heat.

title: Tropical Red Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup red potatoes or 1 cup yellow potato, washed, peeled | 8 ounces picante sauce | 1/3 cup catsup | 0.5 package red curry paste ( i used trader joe's brand )
instructions: Wash potatoes. Cut lengthwise into 6 wedges. Put potato wedges and 1 cup of water in a pot, making sure they touch each other. Boil for 15 minute place potato wedges in crockpot. Add the picante sauce and catsup. Add curry paste. Cover and cook on low for about 5 hours. Serve alone or with rice, if preferred.

title: Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 kg beef | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs ( or other coarse but not grainy breadcrumbs ) | 1/4 cup sherry | 1 tablespoon vegemite | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate ( use sweetened cocoa for a vegan kick ) | 1 tablespoon corn | 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs ( or other coarse but not grainy breadcrumbs ) or 1/2 cup other coarse but not grainy breadcrumbs
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat and cut into 3/4 inch thick patties. Mix together panko crumbs, sherry and vegemite. Dip each pattie in panko mixture, then roll in panko to completely coat. Shallow fry in a medium hot pan over a medium heat for 6 - 8 minutes each side, keeping a close eye on them. Remove from pan and set aside. Add chocolate. When melted, mix together corn and panko. To serve, put meat on plate and spoon on sauce.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,bacon dripping,serrano pepper,pecorino cheese
title: Creamy Red Curry Bacon-Wrapped Peppers & Corks
ingredients: 1 -2 lb serrano pepper, stemmed and halved lengthwise | 3/4 cup red curry paste | 1/2 cup pecorino cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon bacon drippings or 1 -2 tablespoon butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange peppers on prepared baking sheet. Coarsely chop or slice the larger peppers and place in a bowl. Add red curry paste and stir until blended. Stir in remaining red pepper halves and stir to coat. Spread pepper mixture evenly on baking sheet and bake for 40 minutes to 1 hour. Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator tightly covered for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,black bean garlic sauce,saffron strand,cranberry
title: Cranberry-Saffron Beans
ingredients: 1 package saffron strand | 1 lb black bean and garlic sauce | 2 teaspoons saffron strands, fried | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries, chopped
instructions: Dissolve saffron in 1 cup water and bring to a boil. Add sugar and saffron solution and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes. Drain and set beans aside covered with a cloth. Preheat oven to 250°f. Coat two 9 by 2 inch pans with nonstick cooking spray. Add the drained beans and garlic sauce to your pan and mix well. Add the chile and fry for 1 minute then add the saffron mixture and cranberries. Stir gently. Bake covered for 5 - 12 minutes. Serve warm. For variety, substitute dried herbs for saffron and you may need to add a few pats of raw garlic powder or dried garlic powder.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,creme fraiche,rye bread,irish whiskey,pepperoni,nonstick cooking spray
title: Irish Whiskey Rye Appetizer
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 loaf fresh rye bread or 1 loaf sourdough bread | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1/4 lb pepperoni ( about 24 slices ) | nonstick cooking spray ( light mayo or margarine ok ) | 4 ounces creme fraiche
instructions: Prepare instant vanilla pudding according to package directions. Cut rye bread into 10 to 12 slices. Place rye bread slices into a medium bowl. Sprinkle with the whiskey and stir until well combined. Arrange pepperoni on top. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes before using. Lightly spray a grill pan with nonstick cooking spray. Grill the pepperoni slices, cut side down, over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until just beginning to turn slightly crisp. Place pepperoni slices on toasted rye side of each slice of bread. Top with the irish whiskey pudding. Spoon cream cheese over each slice of bread. Place on grill and grill the cream cheese over medium heat for about 3 to 5 minutes or until the cream cheese becomes melty and the bread is light tan in color.

title: Mama's Italian Beef and Pasta

instructions: Brown meat. Drain fat. Mix corn, pasta sauce, icing sugar and meat in shallow casserole. Cover and bake 350 for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 30 minutes. Serve on bed of rice. This is a good meal with spinach, tomatoes and red onion on top. Note, i just cook this in a crock pot for 30 minutes on low, then add a 28 oz bag of fresh spinach and cook for 2 hours it was great.

Random Ingredients: mustard,cream cheese,ancho chile,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green,cooking spray,white corn,hot red chili pepper
title: White Corn With Hot Red Chile and Cream Cheese
ingredients: 2 teaspoons snipped fresh ancho chiles | 1/2 cup cream cheese | 1 tablespoon grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 cans white corn, drained and sliced | 1 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot or 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 6 tablespoons thinly sliced green pitted green onions ( about 12 leaves ) | 2 -3 minutes prepared mustard ( to taste ) or 2 -3 minutes prepared mustard ( to taste ) | hot red chili pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place the chopped chiles in a small skillet over low heat and cook, stirring, until slightly charred and fragrant, about 4 minutes. Let cool. In a small bowl, stir the cream cheese, grated cheese and ground ginger until smooth. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons cream cheese mixture evenly in the base of a 9 in. Springform pan.

title: Easy Noodle Sauce for Shrimp - Zwt II

instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan until hot and stir in the multi grain flour and cook 1 - 2 minutes over moderately high heat until golden brown. Whisk in the all purpose and coconut milk and simmer 3 - 4 minutes. Mix the blended milk and sauce together. Mix into the hot sauce in a large bowl and stir in the savory. Cook noodles in boiling salted water until just tender. Drain and toss with sauce. To prepare topping, sprinkle topping over cooked noodles and toss. Serve with meatballs. Variation, instead of noodle, you can make this with frozen shrimp, and cook it for an additional 20 minutes. The prep time is for shrimp.

title: Black Russian Restaurant Style
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1/2 - 3/4 fluid ounce kahlua, depending on what percentage of fat you like | 1/4 - 1/2 fluid ounce tabasco sauce
instructions: Soak noodles until soft.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,chipotle chile,ancho chile powder,chipotle pepper,cinnamon sugar
title: Chipotle Adobo Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup roasted chipotle chiles | 1 1/2 ounces adobo chipotle chiles, canned chipotle peppers or 1 1/2 ounces ancho chile powder | 1 pinch ground cinnamon sugar | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder | 1 pinch ground cinnamon sugar | 1 3/4 pounds salmon fillets, trimmed of excess skin
instructions: Prepare a charcoal or wood grill for direct heat cooking over medium heat. Lightly oil grill grate. Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,sesame seed,pumpkin puree,mexican cheese,monterey jack cheese
title: Creamy Mexican Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground round | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 cans pumpkin puree | 1 cup grated mexican blend cheese | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese
instructions: Brown ground round and sesame seeds in a skillet over medium high heat. Drain well. Return to skillet. Stir in pumpkin and cheeses. Spread into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through and top is golden.

title: Gluten Free Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 200 g butter | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 200 g light cornflour | 200 g roasted unsalted peanuts ( or any dark roasted peanuts, shelled )
instructions: Blend the butter and the xanthan gum until light and fluffy. Slowly add the cornflour little by little mixing well. Add in the peanuts. Mix until you get a homogenous thick paste, like bread dough or chewy biscuit dough. Turn onto baking paper and press dough down a little. Let cool down a little. Cut in half and press out shapes with a star shaped cookie cutter. I like to roll all of the dough to about 6 cm or so and then cut again with star shapes. Cool on wire tray. Eat on the side.

Random Ingredients: honey,pearl barley,green olive,vegetable stock beef,white wine
title: The Big Dipper's Honey and Barley Risotto With Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces pearl barley | 2 1/4 cups veg stock ( or beef or vegetable ) | 2 1/4 cups dry white wine | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 cup finely sliced green olives ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Add the barley and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain the liquid through a sieve into a large bowl and reserve. Return the stock to the saucepan and add the wine and honey and stir the stock over moderate heat. Bring to a boil, then cook, stirring, for 2 minutes until the liquid reduces and the rice is al dente. Stir in the barley, then cover and remove from the heat. Serve immediately in shallow bowls. Garnish with the olives.

title: Salsa Delight
ingredients: 1 package dry rice noodles, broken into 2 pieces each | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon cracked peppercorns
instructions: Place rice noodles in a large bowl, and cover with boiling water. Remove from heat, and let stand for 15 minutes to soften, then drain, and let cool completely. In a separate bowl, mix the salsa, catsup, rum and cracked pepper. Place rice noodles in a large serving bowl, and stir in the salsa mixture. Cover, and refrigerate for several hours for flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,dark rum,nutritional yeast,pepper flake,corn kernel,salsa,cilantro,quinoa
title: Mexican Quinoa Bowl
ingredients: 3/4 cup quinoa, rinsed or 3/4 cup rice, rinsed dry | 3 1/4 cups water-packed light corn kernels ( or frozen if desired ) | 1 package prepared vanilla instant pudding mix | 1/3 cup low-salt-fat salsa | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro or 1/4 cup green onion, diced | 1/2 teaspoon dark rum
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the rinsed rice or quinoa and 3 cups of water.

title: Pork and Ham Gravy for Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean pork, cubed | 1 envelope spaghetti sauce mix | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | 1/8 teaspoon chile powder | 1 can pumpkin puree
instructions: Place meat in roasting pan and cover with enough water to reach halfway up the meat.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,cumin powder,salad green,tamarind paste,plum tomato,tortilla,onion powder
title: Tamarind-Tamarind-Tomato Snack Wrap and Lunch
ingredients: 2 large ripe plum tomatoes, unpeeled | 1 lb yellow squash, chopped | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 12 tortillas ( about 4-inch diameter ) | fresh salad green ( optional )
instructions: Slice the tomatoes into 12 wedges and set aside. Cut the squash in half lengthwise and then cut into 12 wedges crosswise. Set aside. In a small bowl whisk together tamarind paste, onion powder, ground cumin and cayenne pepper. Set aside. Place 2 tablespoons of the tomato wedges in a small frying pan, cover and cook until just softened, being careful not to overcook. Remove from pan and allow to cool. Slice the tomatoes into 12 wedges, remove seeds and fibers from the tomatoes. Coat a microwave safe bowl with cooking spray and place the tomatoes on top or cover tightly and cook on high for 3 minutes. Uncover the bowl and allow to cool slightly. Transfer the tofu cubes to a serving plate and cover with a dinner plate. Spoon the tamarind mixture into the center of each plate. Top with the squash wedges and serve with warm tortillas, salad greens or rice if desired.

title: Cottage Cheese With Cilantro Seeds
ingredients: 250 g cottage cheese | fresh cilantro leaves ( a handful )
instructions: The instructions below can be found in asian/asiago cheese shops. To make cilantro and cheese filling, mix the cilantro with 2 tbsp water in a small bowl and put in the fridge until needed. Drain and mash the cottage cheese, until it becomes thick and creamy but not too runny. Put a small amount of the cottage cheese into a pestle and mortar and grind it with a rolling pin until it forms a fine paste.

title: Auntie Lori's Easy Pea Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb yellow peas | garlic salt ( to taste )
instructions: Wash peas. Soak peas 30 minutes or longer. Drain. Bring 3 quarts water to a boil, add peas. When water returns to a boil, boil another 5 minutes of. Strain water and return to the empty pot. Cook peas over medium heat until tender, usually about 20 minutes. You may need to cook them long enough for the water to reduce. Place a towel between the pot and the lid so that they do not burn during cooking.

Random Ingredients: black olive,orange juice zest,asiago cheese,palm sugar,spice,lasagna noodle,ginger beer
title: Spiced Olives
ingredients: 1 lb fresh lasagna noodle | 1 cup grated fresh asiago cheese or 1 cup grated reg parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup grated orange juice ( zest of 1 orange ) | 1 tablespoon palm sugar or 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/2 cup chopped fresh black olives | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons ginger beer | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon mixed spice ( baharat aka middle east mixed spices - the real mix )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 and spray a 9 x 12 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain noodles and rinse with cool water. Immediately combine noodles, cheeses, orange juice, sugar, olives, ginger beer and mixed spice. Pour into baking dish and bake 45 - 50 minutes until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,mustard seed,chicken stock powder,bacon grease,ciclon,red wine vinegar,balsamic vinegar,jalapeno chile pepper
title: Jalapeno Chicken Bacon Glazed
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken stock powder | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 20 fresh jalapeno chile peppers | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup bacon grease | 2 cups shredded balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup fat-free chicken stock powder | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Rinse the jalapeno peppers. Remove seeds and white stuff, and place onto a cookie sheet. Brush peppers with bacon grease, and then sprinkle with 1/4 cup of balsamic vinegar. Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until peppers are soft and the skins are crispy. Reserve the juice in baking dish. When peppers are cool enough to handle, remove the stem, remove seeds but not too much skin. In a bowl, combine mustard seeds with the jalapeños, 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon of mustard powder, and 1/4 cup of bacon grease. Brush 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon of fat free chicken soup, 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon of chicken stock powder, and 1 tablespoon of nutmeg. Mix together well. Set aside until ready to use. When peppers are done, remove from oven, and coat with remaining 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon of chicken soup, 1 tablespoon of fat free chicken soup, 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon of mustard powder, and 1/4 cup of balsamic vinegar. Mix together with a fork. Pour this mixture into the peppers, and cover. Bake 1 hour in the preheated oven. You may add more balsamic vinegar if desired. You may also remove the skin of the roasted peppers, if desired. It will not be as pretty when it is turned, but it tastes great.

title: Citrus Spinach
ingredients: 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach | 1/2 cup wine, preferably white | 10 -12 orange peel, pith removed, sliced crosswise into thin strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f put spinach in a greased 8 x 8 inch baking dish with wine. Add orange peel slices, toss to coat well. Bake, uncovered for 25 minutes. Reduce oven to 300°f, uncovered, and bake for a further 1 1/2 hours, or until the liquid has reduced and spinach is tender.

Random Ingredients: spanish onion,irish whiskey,peppermint extract,consomme,coriander powder,white rice
title: Rice Pilaff (Crock Pot)

instructions: In a 6 - 5 quart crock pot, brown the onion and rice together. Stir in all remaining ingredients except whiskey. Cover and cook on low 2 - 3 hours or until liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,pumpkin puree,pigeon pea,pancetta,cherry tomato,green bean
title: Porotos Granados (Pumpkin Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 can pigeon peas, drained & rinsed | 1 can green beans, drained & rinsed | 2 tablespoons pancetta, chopped | 3 tablespoons cherry tomatoes | pita bread or pumpernickel bread
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pumpkin puree, pigeon peas, beans, pancetta, tomatoes & 1/2 cup water. Mix well. Heat in microwave on high, 10 minutes or till heated through. Serve over pumpernickel or pumpernickel bread.

Random Ingredients: mustard,pepitas,feta cheese,tomato puree,sharp cheddar cheese,ranch bean,italian seasoning
title: Cheesy Feta, Tomato and Corn Chowder

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Combine all ingredients except cheddar with mixer on slow speed. Cook 4 to 6 minutes or until thickened. Stir in cheese.

Random Ingredients: clear honey,golden raisin,picante sauce,vanilla essence,yukon gold potato,sesame seed,yellow squash,capellini
title: Baked Acapulco With Yellow Pumpkin Salad (A Memory from my mother in South Africa)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f. Cut the squash and potatoes into 1 inch cubes and place in a roasting tin with a little water.. Add the raisins, capellini and sesame seeds and stir through, season and serve with warmed dressing.

title: Chili & Ginger Kebecakes
ingredients: 1 cup bisquick baking mix | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 can green chili, drained ( i love the hot and spicy ones ) | 2 ounces louisiana hot sauce ( more if you like it hotter, or adjust quantity )
instructions: Mix dough ingredients thoroughly. With floured hands, roll out each piece on floured surface. Using a small cookie cutter, cut out 64 cookies, or less if desired. Place cookies on a parchment lined baking sheet. Brush with pam or sprinkle with 1 oz. Hot sauce if desired. Broil 3 - 4 inches from heat until edges just turn golden brown.

Random Ingredients: mussel,zucchini,red chile pepper,leek,button mushroom,lipton onion soup mix,cumin seed,wonton skin
title: Cumi-Fan Bap
ingredients: 2 pounds whole mussels, cleaned and debearded | 1 zucchini, diced | 1 leek, sliced | 4 button mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons lipton onion soup mix | 1 pinch cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons crushed red chile peppers | 5 ounces wonton skins | 1 teaspoon whole cumin seeds, crushed
instructions: Prepare the mussels and remove the beards and beards. Steam the zucchini and leek for about five minutes and set aside. Rinse with cold water to remove any sand that forms on the shells. Drain, place in a large bowl, and mix. Combine the onion soup mix, cumin seeds, chili peppers and crushed red chilies in a microwave safe bowl. Place plastic wrap over the bowl, and place in the microwave. Microwave on high power for 1 minute. Remove plastic wrap, and stir. To serve, spoon a few mussels into each plate, and top with some chopped zucchini and mushrooms and a generous amount of onion soup mix. Drizzle with a generous amount of crushed red chilies and a sprinkling of crushed cumin seeds.

title: Chipotle Leaf & Sizzling Adobo Lettuce
ingredients: 5 chipotle chiles in adobo | 1 head lettuce leaf | 1 small white onion, sliced thin | 1/4 cup tamari or 1/4 cup soy sauce
instructions: Remove seeds from chiles, and place in small saucepan containing 1 1/2 to 2 cups water. Simmer until just tender. Chop fine. Discard water from chiles and place in blender with chipotle, onion and 1/4 cup tamari. Blend until smooth. Transfer to serving bowl, and serve immedeatly.

Random Ingredients: parsnip,sirloin steak,chicken bouillon cube,asiago cheese,rose water,coriander leaf,pinto bean,clam

instructions: Place dates, turmeric, mushrooms and black beans into blender. Wash and dry hands thoroughly to avoid burning. Scoop out dates. Add herbs and mix. Serve.

title: Potato Cream Filling

instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

instructions: Line a baking tray with aluminum foil and line the sides with parchment paper. Place the rigatoni in a large serving bowl and mash with a potato masher. Spoon the mixture into the lined baking tray and bake, uncovered, in a preheated oven 200c for 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Newfoundland Macaroni Fish Cakes

instructions: Cook 3 1/2 cups fresh pasta until al dente drain, rinse and drain again. instructions: Preheat oven to 475°f. In a 9x9 inch baking dish alternate sardines, sour cream, nuts and cheese. Bake for 10 minutes, then sprinkle with rice, bake 5 minutes longer.

instructions: Place the cantaloupe on a baking tray and grill until cooked through, cut into long wedges. Whisk together the cream, peanut butter and sesame oil in a bowl. Spoon over the cantaloupe and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Potato, Smoked Salmon Pie (Veggie & Wheat Germ)

Remove the lid and place the pot of potatoes in a small oven safe platter. Add the flaked salmon and the wheat germ to the potatoes and mix. Spoon the mash on the platter and place in a preheated 325 degree oven for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: French Onion Steak Skewers (Dignets Frites) in Hot Mustard - Rachael Ray

instructions: For the beef skewers, trim ends from onions and trim off root ends too. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a serving bowl and pour reserved drippings over beef and onions. Toss to coat. Set aside. To serve, arrange on a serving platter, top with remaining beef drippings and sauce. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs and serve.

title: Grilled Coriander Limes

instructions: Mix the coriander powder with the lime or lemon juice. Cover with a tea towel and put in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours. When ready to serve, heat grill on medium and lightly mist with oil. Remove and brush with the coriander mixture on the grates. Close grill and cook until just lightly browned around the edges.

title: Spicy Cherry Clam Dip in a Hurry

instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl and mix well. Chill in fridge for at least an hour for flavors to blend. Serve with crackers.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees celsius. In a small bowl mix together the chili sauce and the orange juice. Dough should be sticky and a bit runny. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the sweet sweetened savory soy sauce onto each pizza round. Top with a few slices of jalapeno pepper, roll up, and place on a baking tray. Brush with remaining sweetened savory soy sauce. Bake in oven for 7 to 10 minutes. Cut in half and serve with your favourite garnishes, such as cilantro.

title: Bosc : Thyme Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 l. fresh thyme | 2 1/2 cups tapioca flour ( available at specialty specialty food stores )
instructions: Wash and trim thyme stems.

title: Curried Bacon Pie (Australia)

instructions: Filling. Place all ingredients in food processor and process. Topping. Spray a 9 inch pie dish with non stick spray or line pie plate with pie crust, leaving enough to cover pie. Spoon in filing. Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Place on rack and cool slightly, then refrigerate several hours, or overnight.

title: Simple Tamarind Ham Tender
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces tamarind paste | 3 -5 cups fat-free thickened whipped topping ( see my tamarind soup, recipe id # 25375 ) | 1 ham, cubed ( optional ) or 2 -3 ounces ham, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Soak tamarind in 1 cup boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain.

title: Carla's Okra Linguine
ingredients: 1/4 cup cake flour | 2 -3 tablespoons chopped garlic salt | 2 packages frozen cut okra | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 1 package dry linguine | 1 pie shell
instructions: In a medium bowl combine flour, garlic salt and lemon juice, mixing well. Set aside. Drain okra in colander until water runs clear. Place in a pot, and pour boiling water over okra. Drain okra, and place in bowl. Add lemon juice, apple juice and dry linguine into bowl. Mix together. Turn out onto floured board, and divide into thirds. Roll each section into a snake shape, approximately 2 inches long. Roll into one inch diameter pieces. Place on floured wax paper, and repeat with other thirds. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat, and add oil. Cook the uncooked pasta for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly. As pasta cooks, dip the rolls in the batter to coat evenly, and place into the skillet. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes per side. Serve right away.

title: Lemonade Dip

instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon. Stir remaining ingredients into drippings. Cook over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes until hot, stirring constantly.

instructions: Combine all ingredients. Set on pressure cooker. Over high heat, bring to high pressure. When it reaches high pressure, it will crackle.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Shiitake Mushroom Appetizers

instructions: Spray 2 heavy 12 cup oven proof skillet with cooking spray. Dissolve beef flavored gelatin in warm bisquick mixture. Spread 1/4 of tomato and green chilies in the bottom of skillet. Cook in 375 degree oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Rice Noodle Soup
ingredients: 500 g bread flour | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon anise seeds | 4 tablespoons rice flour | 3 tablespoons brandy | 120 g cooked bacon | 8 cups hot cooked rice noodles | 1 onion

title: Swedish Sausage Sandwich (Msekage Ächéta)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt | 500 g whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 pinches instant minced garlic cloves | 1 lb bulk boneless steak, thinly sliced | 150 g cheese, grated | 150 g smoked summer sausage, sliced | 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Pour boiling water over salt in a large bowl until it reaches half the depth of the bread crust. Mix in the flour, cardamom, garlic, salt and pepper and make a well in the center of the flour mixture with your hands. Add the steak and mix well with your hands. Add the cheese, mixing in gently by hand with a wooden spoon. Dump into the middle of the well and work the sides well with your hands until the dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Turn dough out onto a floured board and knead in the last of the flour until it forms a ball. Knead in the rest of the flour, kneading it in between hands as you go. Cover with a towel and set aside for 15 minutes. Divide the dough into 4 1/2 inch diameter cylinders and roll out into circles, about 25 inches in diameter and 12 inches in diameter. Heat a cast iron skillet until a bead of water vaporizes on contact. Fold the dough in half and, then the middle, over to form a half moon shape. Transfer to skillet, seam side down and cover until all the filling is used. Cook until the bottom is golden brown, about one minute, about 2 minutes on each side. Serve with grated swedish sausages.

title: Crockpot Spanish Green Beans & Pinto Beans

title: Beef Thai Beef Noodle Bowls
