If your pizzas have a bit of stretch, just press them on the top with your fingertips, just so that the crust is nice and flat. Slash the top with a pizza cutter or use a serrated knife. Put in a warm oven 450°f/180°c for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Prawns W-Carrots
ingredients: 1/2 cup smooth peanut oil | 10 thin slices white bread | 1 large carrot, peeled and julienne | 2 cups frozen strawberries, thawed | 1 canned strawberry pie filling or 1 canned cream-filled strawberry jam
instructions: Heat peanut oil in skillet to low heat. Cut bread into 1 inch chunks and place in oil. Cook one side only. Put shrimp in skillet and cook one more minute. Transfer to serving bowl. Sprinkle carrot with salt& pepper& drizzle with about 2 tbspn. Oil. Lay over medium heat until sizzling hot& brown. Turn, and add 1 c. Drain juices. Arrange in a circle on plate. Place remaining toppings around the edge of the circle, to resemble a wedge.

title: Gherkin-Anchovy Paste Spread
ingredients: 2 gherkins, chopped | 1/3 cup peanut oil | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/4 cup fresh basil, choped | 1 dash tabasco jalapeno sauce
instructions: Process all ingredients in a spice and pestle or blender. Serve as a dip with grilled fish or vegetables.

title: Tangy Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 jar roasted green grapes, drained | 1 jar pimientos, drained | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 -2 drop red food coloring
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Corn Beef With Corn.
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean beef | 1 can creamed corn
instructions: Trim rind from beef. Cut into 2 inch pieces. In large skillet, heat beef and corn over meduim heat. Cover.

title: Mustard and Orange Barley
ingredients: 3 cups pearl barley | 2 cups orange juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons english mustard powder | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: In a medium saucepan, stir together the barley, orange juice, and mustard powder. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and cook, stirring every 5 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed and the barley is tender, approximately 1 hour total.

title: Indian Gravlax
ingredients: 4 ounces salmon, trimmed of the bone and sliced thin | 1 teaspoon garam masala
instructions: Place the salmon in a ziploc freezer bag. Add the garam masala. Seal the bag and turn over so the salmon is thoroughly coated. Repeat to coat all sides of the fish. Place in the freezer for 20 to 30 minutes, or until cooked. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,spanish onion,dark chocolate,yoghurt,cornflour,deli ham,milk
title: The Incredible British Bacon & Tatties: Tatties
ingredients: 3 cups self rising flour | 4 ounces dark chocolate, melted | 1 large spanish onion, trimmed and finely chopped | 1 cup skim milk | 16 -20 slices deli ham, from a large deli ham roll | 4 2/3 ounces cornflour ( also called cornstarch ) or 4 2/3 ounces cornmeal | 1 tablespoon yoghurt, to glaze
instructions: The day before you need to bake, place the flour in a mixing bowl. Add melted chocolate and finely chopped garlic. Stir until the chocolate has melted. Add onion and stir until the onion is coated. Add a little milk at a time if your chocolate has thickened too quickly add more milk. Stir the mixture until it becomes soft and creamy. Turn the dough out onto a large board and knead lightly. The dough should be smooth and soft without ragged kneading. Add more milk if necessary. Wrap the dough into cling film, then leave in an airtight, free shape for 2 hours or until it has doubled in size. The dough should now look sticky and firm. If it's too wet to knead, add a little more flour a tablespoon at a time, then knead until it starts proving dry and pliable. Preheat the oven to 375°f mix together the cornflour, yoghurt and a little milk. Roll out the dough until it is thin. Cut into 3 x 3 inch rectangles. Place one slice of ham and one piece of bunnie all around the centre of 1 of the two squares. Roll up the dough starting at a short end. Place on a baking sheet lined with greaseproof baking paper. Use a fork to poke a few holes in the top of the pastry. Glaze the tops with the beaten egg/milk glaze. Bake in the centre of the hot oven until browned and springy when tapped, about 20 minutes. Leave to cool on a wire rack or baking tray for about 15 minutes. Serve hot or warm.

title: Italian Squash & Pesto Pizza
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash, cubed | 1 loaf pizza dough | 1 cup fresh mixed fruit, sliced or diced | pesto sauce from a jar with a twist, of your choice | 2 tablespoons basil, chopped | 4 peppercorns, cracked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f place squash, cubed, in an ovenproof pan. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove squash and spread pesto on top and return to oven for 5 minutes. Add fruit, stir and bake for 5 more minutes. Slice crust and top with pesto and top with basil and cracked peppercorns. Bake for another 4 - 5 minutes until crust is golden.

title: Quick Taco Sauce (The Best)
ingredients: 1 cup hot taco sauce | 1 tablespoon canola oil ( or olive oil )
instructions: Stir the taco sauce and canola oil together in small saucepan. Heat on low heat, stirring slowly for about 10 minutes, or until it is very thick.

title: The Brits Inspire
ingredients: 5 dried chicken legs | sea salt, to sprinkle | 500 ml fresh tomato juice | 75 ml creme fraiche
instructions:
Cut the legs into quarters and rub with salt. Cook over simmering water until tender and falling apart. Remove the legs and reserve the cooking juices. Place in a bowl and add the tomato juice. Mix well, season to taste and chill. To serve, split the legs open a little, place a spoonful and a half of the topping of the creme fraiche on it. Put your head on the table and let everyone vote 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Bite some creme fraiche into a small bowl and smear over a few slices of toast.

Random Ingredients: black tea,gingerroot,mexican cheese,cumin,prosciutto,thai chile,portobello mushroom,greek yogurt
title: Tea Smoked Provolone With Spicy Provolone Cheese
ingredients: 2 large portobello mushrooms, stemmed ( about 2 lb. ) | 1 ounce smoked greek yogurt, plus more for garnish | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot ( finely minced ) | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 1 thai chiles ( minced or julienned ) | 2 tablespoons mexican blend cheese | black tea, warmed to room temperature | 1/4 cup prosciutto, cut into thin strips
instructions: Pre heat your broiler. Remove mushrooms from the pouch, cut off stems and slice caps into chunks, leaving about 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick caps intact. Set aside. In a small bowl, mix the yogurt, ginger, cumin, chiles and half the cheese and season with salt and pepper. Pour the mushroom over the cheese and toss until the cheese is completely melted. Spoon a generous amount of the smoke over the top of the smoked provolone and garnish with a few slices of prosciutto. Use two slotted spoons to place the snipped provolone onto a baking sheet and broil in the top half of the oven for 5 - 5 minutes or until golden brown. Slice into thin wedges, season with salt and pepper. Serve hot with spiced black tea, additional mexican cheese, and remaining yogurt for a wonderful spiced hot beverage for a winter lunch.

title: Apple - Apple Marinated Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted peanuts | 1/3 cup dried tart apple, chopped | 1/4 cup dried coriander | 1 tablespoon dried parsley | 2 lbs chuck roast, with bone | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped italian parsley
instructions: Preparation, preheat oven to 300°f. In a large baking dish, combine the peanuts, fruit, coriander, 2 tablespoons of the parsley and the sugar. Place the beef on top, and bake, covered with foil, for 2 hours. Remove the beef from the oven, and stir the remaining 2 tablespoons parsley. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the beef to a warmed platter or plate, and set aside. Bring the juices to a boil in a saucepan, skimming off the surface. When the juices reduce in volume by about half and have thickened, remove from the heat and pour into a bowl. Set aside until completely cool. Strain the juices, discarding all the solids. Discard most of the solids. Chill, covered, at least overnight. Shred with forks, place in a freezer proof container, cover and refrigerate. Bring the juices to room temperature for at least 10 minutes before serving. Stir in the remaining 3 tablespoons parsley. If using a mortar and pestle, pound the reserved peanuts to a fine powder. Add them to the liquid, and continue to stir to blend. Serve.

title: Southern-Style Carnitas
ingredients: 5 pounds pork shoulder roast | 4 navel oranges
instructions: Place pork shoulder roast in a large roasting pan lined with several layers of plastic wrap. Peel oranges with a sharp knife, removing the peel sections as you go. Slice the sections into segments. Wash oranges in a colander and discard the peel and white pith in rind. Sprinkle orange rind and orange juice over the pork. Rub orange slices with salt. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate the pork and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove pork from the refrigerator, unwrap the plastic wrap, and set the meat on a cutting board or flat surface with the flat of a meat mallet to cut meat into 1 1/2 inch thick slices. Lay the meat slices into shallow casseroles, and put oranges and oranges in a large glass or ceramic dish with enough room to lay a few sheets of plastic wrap directly on top. Cover the dish with plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight so the rind and juices can absorb. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. Place 1/2 inch of water into the bottom of a roasting pan lined with several layers of paper towels. Insert slices of pork onto the paper towels. Place roasting pan onto the middle rack of the oven. Bake in the preheated oven until pork is browned and an instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the meat registers at least 145 degrees f, stirring every 10 minutes, about 1 1/2 hours. Transfer pan to a platter and remove any excess grease. Allow meat to rest, covered with plastic wrap, for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: squash,beef,dark brown sugar,coriander seed,taco,chocolate cookie crumb
title: Ww 7 Points - Beef and Squash Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef | 1/2 cup chopped zucchini or 1/2 cup squash | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1/4 cup grated bittersweet chocolate cookie crumbs | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup store-bought taco gravy mix ( or 1/4 cup any dry taco seasoning desired )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Heat a medium, nonstick large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add ground beef, zucchini, coriander and brown sugar, breaking up any lumps with a wooden spoon. Cook, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes until beef is cooked through and vegetables are tender. Stir in gravy mix until well combined.

title: Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 4 cups mustard seeds | 20 ounces apricot preserves ( such as hunt's )
instructions: Place the mustard seeds in a deep skillet. When the hear of the seeds recedes from the heat source, add 10 ounces of apricot preserves and stir continuously over low heat with a wooden spoon until the preserves have thickened and become syrupy. Allow the mustard seeds to cool fully. Scoop the mustard seed mixture into jars, leaving 1/4 inch on the top. Wipe the top with a damp cloth, seal, and store in the refrigerator. Makes 10 1/2 ounces of jam.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,veal cutlet,coffee,deli roast beef,tofu,spring onion
title: Veal Roll With Tofu and Coffee
ingredients: 100 g veal cutlets | 100 g thinly sliced deli roast beef | 2 spring onions | 80 g tofu ( or sprouted tofu ) | 4 teaspoons coffee | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Slice veal cutlets diagonally. Slice diagonally, making 8 equal size pieces. Mix together veal, beef, spring onions, tofu, egg and coffee. Marinate for 30 mins. Arrange on a plate. Serve rolled jelly roll fashion. For breakfast, you can serve a wrap with your favourite topping.

title: Chile Con Queso
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh spinach ( about 6 cups ) | 12 ounces corn tortilla chips
instructions: Wash, drain and remove stems from spinach. Cut spinach into thin slices. Break tortilla in half and arrange 1 row on a serving platter. Sprinkle 1/4 of each salad ingredient on and microwave one minute, flip, and microwave for 1 minute more or until cheese is melted.

title: Peanut Shrimps
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | salt and pepper
instructions: In a large stainless steel skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the shrimp and cook over high heat, just until they just change color, about 2 minutes with the shrimp. Reduce heat to low, sprinkle with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Crock Pot Chickpeas and Pineapples
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas | 1 package fontina cheese, grated | 2 cans diced pineapple in juice
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a 3 1/2 or 4 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle both sides with cheese. Pour pineapple with juice over all. Cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours. Serve over couscous.

title: Tiny Cabbage and Baked Beans (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 bag coleslaw mix | 2 cans great northern beans, drained and rinsed ( can sub white beans )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 3 quart or larger crockpot. Cook on high for 8 to 10 hours or low for 8 to 10 hours. Note, cooking time will vary depending on how deep the crockpot is. Note, cook time does not include 8 to 10 hours on high or 10 to 20 hours on low, depending on your crockpot.

title: Parmesan Jelly
ingredients: 2 kg rocket ( about 2 lbs, rocket leaves should be about 3 lbs ) | 1 packet onion soup mix | 60 g g grated parmesan cheese | 3/4 teaspoon black pepper ( or to taste )
instructions: Wash your rocket leaves, removing the hard stalks. Cut off the large stalks, leaving about 3/4 thick rind for the jelly. Halve the rocket leaves and arrange in layers on a large plate.. Cover with the onion soup mix. Sprinkle over the grated cheese and pepper.

title: Sweet N Easy Tofu and Chili-Tofu Breakfast
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared chili | 1 tablespoon hot black tea | 1 teaspoon chili sauce | 1 package firm tofu, drained and cubed | 5 corn on the cob, husked | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Place chili and hot black tea in a small skillet over med high heat, cook about 30 seconds. Place tofu cubes in skillet, cook for about 5 minutes, or until almost cooked through. Spread 1 cup half & half in a warm shallow serving dish. Top with tofu to make a sandwich. Serve with other veggies. Use your favorite chili sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: sumac powder,chicken bouillon powder,cream mushroom soup,corn flake,italian sausage,currant
title: Foolproof Casserole (Punjab)
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 cup corn flakes, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried currants or 1 teaspoon raisins | 1/2 teaspoon sumac powder
instructions: Place the sausage in a skillet and cook over moderately high heat, stirring, until brown. Drain and set aside. In a 1 1/2 quart casserole, combine the soup, reserved sausage, crushed corn flakes, currants or raisins and sumac. Pour over the sausage and sprinkle with the caju. Bake, uncovered, in a 350°f oven for 30 minutes, or until hot.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,pecorino romano cheese,purpose flour,honey,coleslaw mix,lettuce leaf
title: Arugal Goshtoss
ingredients: 2 packages coleslaw mix | 1/3 cup honey | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 package store-bought coleslaw mix | 2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix | 4 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Cook coleslaw at room temperature in a large skillet or dutch oven for 5 - 7 minutes, or until slightly limp. Remove from heat. Stir in honey and flour until evenly blended. Stir in cheese and ras el hanout, mix well, and spread on the coleslaw.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,pumpkin puree,leek,vanilla,basmati rice,chili seasoning mix,great northern bean,icing sugar
title: Pumpkin Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 box egg noodles | 300 g pumpkin puree | 1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed | 1 green leek, washed and chopped | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon chili seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/2 cup basmati rice ( i used jasmine )
instructions: Cook egg noodles in a large pot of boiling, slated water until al dente, and drain. Combine pumpkin, beans, leek and seasonings in a large bowl. Mix. Add cooked noodles to pan and toss with a large spoon to coat. Place in a lightly greased 30x10x1 inch jelly roll pan. Combine icing and sugar. Sprinkle over noodles and serve with hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,crabmeat,baby shrimp,kale,egg yolk,canning ring,pizza crust
title: Crabs, Chillies and Kale Salad
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat, drained | 1 dozen fresh crabmeat or 1 dozen cooked surimi shrimp, tails- off | 10 baby shrimp | 1 can pizza crust or 1 lb prepared pizza crust | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 canning jars prepared pizza crust, for a light lunch or cocktail topping ( optional ) | coriander powder, for an extra taste
instructions: Roll out pizza dough on you work surface and make a large circle from the center out to the edge. Mix all ingredients together except for dough. Divide mixture evenly into 4 portions and divide equally again. Take a small, sharp knife and cut from stem end to stem on the inside of one end of the crab meat crab and surimi shrimp. Spread one portion of the mixture into the center of the dough. Roll the dough up from the stem end and cut off ends and set aside. Repeat with remaining dough and filling until all the filling is used up. Cook on a lightly sprayed baking sheet in a 425f oven for 20 - 25 minutes. Serve with a light cocktail or cocktail topping, a sprinkle of grated or slivered fresh cilantro, and a piece of lettuce.

Random Ingredients: linguine,shallot,vegetable,cocoa powder,green chili pepper,chicken bouillon cube
title: Creamy & Chunky Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine ( uncooked ) | 1 -2 tablespoon green chili pepper, chopped ( i use red ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable | 1 medium shallot, chopped | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Meanwhile, chop green pepper and set to the side for cooking in a small skillet with vegetable oil, if desired. Sautee shallot in skillet with oil until slightly browned, but not crispy, then stir in the chicken soup base, cocoa, and green chili and stir well. Add green pepper to broth and serve over pasta. Cook's note, use chunky chicken soup base. If you don't like the chunky taste you can replace it by 3 tsps. Chili powder. Enjoy.

title: Kimmie's Corned Beef, Kumara Barley & Cabbage Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 quarts vegetable stock | 6 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced | 6 ounces kimchi, cut into wedges | 2 ounces provolone cheese, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce | 1 can corned beef ( drained and rinsed ) | water | sliced fresh kimchi
instructions: Boil the broth in a large pot for 30 minutes, until it has reduced to about 1 quart. Meanwhile, place the barley in a large bowl, add water to cover. Soak for 15 - 20 minutes. Once the barley is soft, drain and rinse with cold water, then put back into the pot. Add 1 tsp of adobo sauce and beef to the barley. Add the drained kimchi and cheese to the barley mixture and toss well. Transfer to a platter or plates and garnish with the remaining 1 tsp of adobo sauce, 2 to 3 kimchi wedges per serving.

title: Mashed Potatoes American Cheese
ingredients: 50 ml american cheese, sliced | 12 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Place cheese and tomatos onto hot frying pan with a lid and cook on medium flame until cheese is bubbly. Serve and enjoy.

title: Fennamosa(Mild Spice)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon fennamosa seeds
instructions: Toast all the ingredients over a pan or in a blender. If you notice the fennamosa seeds burning it will only take another two steps. Cool completely and store tightly sealed. The amount of powder you have to use will depend on the heat of your pan and the size of the container used. Keep stored in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Mushroom Rice Balls
ingredients: 3 cups leftover breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 3 fresh mushrooms, sliced | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 4 small shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 head cabbage, cored and chopped
instructions: Combine the breadcrumbs, barley, mushrooms and fenugreek seeks. Form the mixture into 1 inch balls, about the size of a ping pong ball or two smaller ones. Heat a large frying pan, add the rice balls and fry over high heat, turning constantly until cooked through, about 3 - 5 minutes. Place on a paper towel lined plate until cool, then refrigerate for up to 10 days, or up to 2 weeks. Heat the cabbage in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and cook until tender. Drain well, then place in a bowl and set aside. Return the rice balls to the pan, add the mushrooms, and cover. Cook over a medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes. Remove the lid and stir in the cabbage.

title: Low Fat Beef & Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 1 packet frozen spinach ( thawed ) | 1 lb lean ground beef round | 1/2 green capsicum ( diced finely ) | 10 ounces frozen chicken meat ( thawed ) | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 cup cooked rice or 1 cup spaghetti, cooked
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°f. Grease and cook your ground beef, add the capsicum and spinach. Cook until spinach is cooked. Fold in the chicken or beef and cook until heated through. Season with salt and pepper. Add cooked rice or spaghetti. Roll the mixture into 5 or 6 balls depending on how you want to make them. Place on a greased baking tray and bake for 15 - 20 minutes.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped in Oven Dutch Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 25 slices prosciutto | 25 peppercorns | 40 g cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 225c/495f, gas mark 7 - 8 minutes remove the prosciutto slices from the package. Roll each slice down, one at a time, in a packet of peppercorns to coat. Wrap each prosciutto slice with a slice of prosciutto, then place on a lined baking tray with 2 cm of oars hanging over each other. Combine cocoa and remaining peppercorns, pour over the tops of the rolls, then put in the oven. Bake for 12 - 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Fettuccine Tacos
ingredients: 8 fettuccine | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 2 tablespoons blue cheese, crumbled | 8 taco shells | 1/4 cup apricot preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Cook the fettuccine for 7 to 10 minutes in boiling salted water, or until al dente, and drain thoroughly. In a small saucepan, stir together malt vinegar, tarragon, and blue cheese. Place taco shells on a baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap, and heat in the oven until hot. Fill with the cooked fettuccine, cheese, and sauce.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,catsup,shallot,white flour,pea,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cayenne,soy sauce
title: Prawns With Peas
ingredients: 24 small squid, cleaned with tentacles left on | 1/2 cup shallot, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup fresh peas, frozen is ok ( or fresh shelled ) | 2 tablespoons catsup ( or rice vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon white flour | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cook the squid in a little water for just a few minutes. They don't need to be cooked completely or they'll cook fast. Set squid aside. Pour boiling water over the peas in a bowl and let sit for 15 minutes. Add all remaining ingredients to squid and toss together. Serve squid warm with sauce, or divide it into 4 portions. Place the portions of squid on a warm serving plate and spoon sauce over. Sprinkle lightly with a little cheese.

Random Ingredients: butter,cocoa,streaky bacon,liquid smoke,raisin,taco seasoning mix,taco seasoning,beef bouillon cube
title: Mexican Nachos
ingredients: 20 -24 ounces beef bouillon cubes | 2 -3 ounces taco seasoning ( mild, medium or hot ) | 2 tablespoons cocoa ( optional ) | 20 -24 ounces bacon, raw and diced | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup butter | 1/4 cup raisins ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Saute the beef in a non stick wok, set aside, season with salt and pepper then add the rest of the ingredients except the bacon, heat through, set aside, let cool slightly. When cool add in bacon. Serve with warm tortillas, warm corn chips, etc.

title: Spicy Curry Black Olive Dip
ingredients: 20 ounces black olives | 5 ounces red curry paste
instructions: Cut the olives in half and scoop out a little bit of the pit from the bottom. Mince the olives and blend them with the curry paste. Serve in a shallow serving bowl or other bowl with rice, lentils or noodles of your choice.

Random Ingredients: chili,active yeast,fish sauce,crabmeat,plain nonfat yogurt,wild rice
title: Crab and Wild Rice Pizza
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast or 2 2/3 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 1 teaspoon chili | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt | 1 can crabmeat, drained with juices reserved | 1 1/2 cups wild rice, cooked
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup of the yogurt. Let stand 5 min. Combine strained water and remaining yogurt in a large bowl and set aside. Combine fish sauce, chili, and remaining 3 cups yogurt and reserve 1/2 cup of yogurt. Stir well. Stir into yeast mixture just until ingredients are moistened. Spread crust with rest of the yogurt mixture. Scatter crabmeat over the top. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise 1 hour. In the meantime, preheat oven to 400°f place crabmeat and rice in an 8 inch round cake pan and bake 12 - 15 minutes or until golden. Serve pizza topped with crabmeat mixture, more yogurt or sour cream, if desired.

title: Raspberry Penne Pasta in Penne
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked penne pasta, or as needed | 15 fresh raspberries, drained and sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 13 minutes. Drain and discard any excess water. Return pasta to the pot, and allow to absorb as much water as needed. Mix in raspberries. Transfer to a serving dish, and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Peach Soup My Way
ingredients: 6 cups vegetable broth | 2 cans sliced peaches, drained | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a pot, and whisk in the ketchup. Return the vegetable broth to the pot, and whisk in the nutmeg. Remove peaches, and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes. Turn sauce into a food processor, and puree the soup until smooth.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,cumin powder,beef shank,linguine,cocoa powder,spinach,brown lentil
title: Beef and Lentil Soup
ingredients: 1/3 cup cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried brown lentils | 8 ounces ground beef shank | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 package linguine
instructions: In a soup pot, combine the cocoa powder and vinegar and stir in the brown lentils and ground beef. Bring to a rolling boil and lower the heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Add the cumin, garlic powder and cayenne. Simmer for another 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside. In a large pot of boiling water, blanch the linguine according to package directions. Drain and divide among a serving bowl. Serve the soup and spoon over the cooked linguine.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,extra sharp cheddar cheese,yeast,poblano chile,yellow bell pepper,ancho chile,peppercorn,thai red curry paste
title: Thai Red Curry Chicken With Poached Peppers & Ancho Chilies
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs extra-sharp cheddar cheese, sliced 1/4 inch thick ( about 12 slices ) | 1/4 cup thai red curry paste ( see thai red curry paste ) | 3/4 cup whole yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 tablespoon peppercorn, cracked | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile | 1/2 teaspoon instant yeast | 1/2 1/2 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese or 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded
instructions: Line a 10 1/2 inch jelly roll pan with parchment paper. Slice cheddar into 12 1/2 inch slices, and arrange on a platter. Sprinkle thai red curry paste on top of cheese. In a bowl, combine bell peppers, peppercorns, chile, ancho chili, yeast, and extra cheese together through a coarse sieve. Sprinkle over the cheddar in the pan, and place the platter in a roasting pan or dutch oven. Pour boiling water into pan until the water reaches halfway up the side of the casserole. Bake at 425f for 20 minutes, until the casserole is bubbling. This will give you a crunchier red crust. After 10 minutes, remove the cheeses to a serving platter.

title: Crispy Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 6 red chile, seeds removed | 1 head of shredded lettuce leaf | 12 red enchilada sauce or 12 tomatillo enchilada enchiladas
instructions: Heat about 12 cups of water in a heavy pot. Meanwhile, clean chilies clean and pull off stems with a knife. Break the stems from the chilies with your knife or the tip of a knife. Do not remove the seeds, then tear chilies into pieces about the size of small peas. You should have about 3 cups of chilies in all, with no germ or membrane remaining. When the water comes to a boil, put in the chilies, the drained water and about 3 tablespoons of the enchilada sauce. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. If you have an enchilada maker, pour enchilada sauce into it, and run the machine on medium setting. Strain the sauce through a fine mesh sieve if possible. Set aside. Fill a deep skillet with water. Heat 1/4 cup enchilada sauce at a simmer. Place each enchilada seam side down in the hot sauce. When you hear about 1/4 cup of bubbling over the bottoms and the bottoms of the enchiladas, the are cooked. Immediately remove them from the sauce and place them in a large bowl. Place remaining sauce into the pot and simmer for 5 minutes over medium heat or until it thickens a bit. Spoon a small amount of sauce over each of the enchiladas before serving.

title: Spiced Lamb With Tofu and Monterey Jack
ingredients: 8 ounces dried lean ground lamb | 2 ounces tofu, drained | 1 tablespoon plain french mustard | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 4 ounces monterey jack cheese or 4 ounces provolone cheese, grated
instructions: Soak the meat for 30 minutes, then drain. Preheat the oven to 450°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, stir together the lamb, tofu and mustard, then transfer to an 8 inch square pan with 3/4 inch high sides. Top with the vinegar and sprinkle with the cheese. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes, or until the cheese has just melted and the lamb is cooked through. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: polenta,canola oil,golden raisin,salt black pepper,greek yogurt,dipping sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Baked Polenta Wedges With Raisins and Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 3/4 cup polenta ( coarse cornmeal ) | 1 cup greek yogurt | canola oil cooking spray | 1 1/3 cups golden raisins ( about 6 ounces total ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | canola oil ( for brushing tops of assembled wedges ) | dipping sauce :
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.

Random Ingredients: red wine,wasabi powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon zest,worcestershire sauce
title: Wasabi Mustard
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons wasabi powder ( or 3 -4 drops wasabi powder mixed in 1 tbls. cold water ) | 2 -3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dry red wine | vegetable oil cooking spray | lemon zest
instructions: Mix wasabi and worcestershire sauce together. Stir in red wine. Cover and chill until ready to use. Heat non stick grill to medium heat. Coat pan with veg. Oil spray and cook mustard until mustard begins to turn golden. Spread mustard over greens. Sprinkle with lemon zest. Serve immediately.

title: Cape Cod Phyllo-Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs uncooked cantaloupe ( cut into bite-sized pieces or 2 small jicama ) | 1 bay leaf | capers or anchovy fillet | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 1 package phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place cantaloupe, bay leaf, capers, and savory in a large bowl and toss to coat. Lay phyllo on lightly floured surface and roll, placing a few sheets in the freezer, a few inches from each other. Cut phyllo in half. Brush each half with lightly beaten egg and top with a pinch or two of anchovy. Continue rolling and pressing until sheets are lightly coated with egg. Repeat procedure with remaining phyllo and anchovies. Cut phyllo into 5 rectangles. Lay 2 fillets in a row across the center of each strip and brush with beaten egg and brush with egg. Fold in the corners and pinch closed. Cut an x across the top of each pastry and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Repeat until all 8 fillets are filled and turned. Brush tops with remaining egg. Cut a few slits or diagonal slits for steam to escape. Bake for 45 minutes or until pastry is puffed and lightly browned.

title: Prosciutto Mussels
ingredients: 36 large mussels, scrubbed | 1 1/2 cups chopped prosciutto | 1 -2 cup shredded lettuce | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning
instructions: If using fresh mussels just make sure they are scrubbed. If using cleaned fresh mussels place in pot of cold water and bring to simmer or cover until shells open. Remove mussels and discard shells. If using fresh mussels just remove be careful not to overcook. Do not cook them. If using clean mussels cover them with cold water and bring to simmer. You want the head and tail off any large muscles that clump or open. If using fresh mussels remove with a slotted spoon and discard tail. You can also use just under 1 1/2 tsp italian seasoning. Shake off any mussels that are open and place in bowl with plenty of cold water. After 5 minutes or so of shaking off any remaining shells place in cold water. They will be done when they are all open, the shell will have the right amount of resistance. After 5 - 10 minutes. Rinse them under cold water and then drain. Take a bowl and place a small pile of mussels in it. They would do this in the bowl, so remove any muscle that may have broken. Place the pieces of proscuitto in the bowl and add a few shakes of italian seasoning.

title: Beet Breakfast
ingredients: 100 g oats | 50 g raisins ( or try sultanas ) | 50 g beetroots
instructions: Rinse and pat dry, then cut the beetroot into small strips. Place in a large bowl then top with oats and raisins or sultanas. Microwave on medium until vegetables are tender, then stir. Serve warm with crisp bread, crackers or crumblely biscuits to dip.

Random Ingredients: mango,apple,beef bouillon cube,cooking oat,turmeric,red pepper flake,ketchup,beef chuck
title: Sweet and Sour Diced Beef on the Och Hon Appetizer
ingredients: 1 fresh mango ( not frozen ) | 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes | 2 large apples | 20 ounces cooking oats | 4 beef bouillon cubes | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons ketchup
instructions: Cut the mango in half and remove the stone. Mash and mix together. Set aside. Prepare the stew beef. Cut the apple in half. Cut into 3 wedges. Insert the cut wedges of apple into the meat. You may need a large stew pot to hold all of the ingredients. Once the meat is cool enough, add all the ingredients except the meat and mix well. You should have about 10 minutes covered. You may need a bit of water if it starts to dry out. Place the meat in the prepared stew pot and cover. Cook at 250f for 4 - 5 hours. Once the meat is cool add the apple juice, ketchup, or apple cider and mix. Cook for about 1 additional hour on medium to low heat. Serve with a side dish of rice or cooked barley.

Random Ingredients: green olive,green cardamom pod,serrano ham,peach,manchego cheese,pepper sauce
title: Sweet and Hot Fondue
ingredients: 250 g manchego cheese, cut into cubes | 1/4 cup grated peach | 1/4 cup sliced green ripe olives, such as kalamata | 2 green cardamom pods, seeds only, bruised ( optional ) | fresh ground pepper sauce, to taste | 1 dash hot red pepper sauce, to taste
instructions: Place the cheese cubes in a bowl and pour over enough hot water to cover all of the cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight, allowing the cheese to soften slightly. Drain. Scoop out and discard the cheese pieces, reserving the liquid. Slice the cheese cubes into thin wedges. Add the peach, olives, and green cardamom to the cheese and stir. Season with black pepper and hot sauce. Drain the cheese and transfer to an attractive fondue pot. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,sharp cheddar cheese,pork tenderloin,green olive,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,salt pepper,iceberg lettuce,red lentil
title: Lentil Tacos W-Grilled Pork and Chipotle Peppers
ingredients: 2 lbs country-style pork tenderloin, cut into thin slices | salt & fresh ground pepper | 2 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 1/2 cup small red lentil, rinsed ( green or brown ) | 3/4 cup vertically sliced iceberg lettuce | 1/4 cup thinly sliced green olives | 2 tablespoons slivered pimiento-stuffed green olives | 2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Place one slice of pork on a plate and season with salt and pepper. Rub the pork with the chipoltes spice mix. Sprinkle the adobo on the cut side of each slice of pork, then set aside. Cover plates with a dishtowel, then pile the leeks and olives onto the plates. Place a second slice of pork on top of the olives. In a small skillet, heat the olive oil until very hot and lightly brown the meat and pork. Spoon about 3/4 cup of the lentils in the center of each plate and top with a slice of pork. Divide the cooked lentils and the olives between the plated plates, then spoon the remaining lentils around the tacos. Top with cheese. Place remaining slices of pork on top of the cheese and top each with a slice of cheese. Drizzle reserved chipotle oil over each plate, then sprinkle on both sides with more chipoltes and serve.

Random Ingredients: mace,grand marnier,cold water,chili sauce,red pepper,oyster,baking soda
title: Tropical Oysters
ingredients: 24 whole cold cooked oysters, in shells | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper | 1/4 teaspoon mace, crushed | 4 teaspoons oyster liquor or 4 teaspoons chili sauce | 1 cup cold water | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Place each oyster shell on a plate. In medium bowl beat together sweet chili sauce, crushed red pepper, mace, oyster liquor or chile sauce, hot water& baking soda. Pour sauce over oysters. Serve at once or refrigerate uncovered for up to two days.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,sharp cheddar cheese,orange blossom water,cracker crumb,chicken broth
title: Broiled Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen breaded phyllo pastry, thawed | 5 tablespoons chicken broth ( homemade okay! ) | 1 tablespoon orange blossom water | 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup cracker crumb
instructions: Preheat the broiler on high. Line a 9 x 13 casserole dish with thawed phyllo sheets. Brush the phyllo with half of the broth. Place 2 sheets of phyllo in the bottom of the casserole. Sprinkle with 2 tblsp. Broccoli cheese & 1/2 c. Broccoli. Repeat layers of five and five more sheets of phyllo, phyllo, cheese and broccoli. Finish with remaining 3 tblsp. Broccoli. Brush top with broth & sprinkle with crumbs. Place the casserole in a hot oven & broil 3 - 5 minites, until the cheese is bubbly. Serve immediately. Note, if you like a little extra zip/salt, you can also add a pinch of salt and/or lemon juice to the phyllo. Also if you make 2 rolls, cut crosswise to form 2 thin rectangles. Then cut the crosswise lengthwise into 2 strips. When broiling, place one strip of phyllo on a cutting board. Spread the chicken broth evenly over the phyllo. Roll and lay it lengthwise. Broil until golden brown.

title: Italian Meat Sauce with Celery
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef, or | 1/2 lb ground pork | 1/4 cup chopped celery leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed italian spices
instructions: Combine cooked ground beef, ground pork, mixed italian seasoning, and chopped celery leaves. Simmer for an hour. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Caramelized Mango Squash With Curried Banana
ingredients: 1 squash, sliced into eight pieces | 1/4 - 1/2 cup mango chunk | fish sauce, to taste | basil ( or your favorite herb, i use ) | 2 packages frozen puff pastry, thawed and patted dry | 1 -2 teaspoon curry ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray a baking tray with vegetable spray. Heat a nonstick pan and grill the squash until browned, about 6 minutes, turning the squash around regularly with tongs, just until it begins to soften. Remove from heat and add the mango chunks. Stir to coat and sprinkle with fish sauce and herbs. Spread mango mixture on the baked pastry to within 1 inch of the edges, then top with the bananas. Wrap the edges of the pastry in each of the pastry sheets and cut a slit into the centre.

title: Italian Green Sauce - Super Simple and Delicious
ingredients: 2 lbs broccoli | 3 plum sauce | 2 bell peppers | 1 can anchovies | 1/4 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Blanch broccoli and snap off ends. Dice into bite size pieces. Cook peppers in a pan with a little oil till slightly blackened. Remove from pan and throw away any seeds left in the pan. Add all the other ingrdients to large pan. Let simmer till peppers are soft. Stir occassionally and boil till thick and dark brown in color. Serve over noodles.

title: Easy Baked Ginger-Garlic Pork
ingredients: 2 pounds pork shoulder, cut into cubes | 1/4 cup ginger garlic paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Place the pork cubes into a large casserole dish. Cover the dish with a lid or aluminum foil. The fat in the dish is dangerously hot. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until meat is browned and tender. Drain the fat. Place the garlic ginger paste in a jar with a tight fitting lid, and shake to mix.

title: Cheesy Pear Rice
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup dried cherries | 1/2 cup harissa | 1/2 cup vanilla essence | 1 cup cheese, cubed ( grated, or a mix of cheeses ) | 1 pear | 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Start by heating up the rice on the stove top. Add harissa and cream of tartar, blend and heat over medium heat. Once you have heated through, add cheese cubes and stir so the cheese melts evenly. Place rice in a large serving bowl, top with cheese. Add pears and top with triple sec. Add a drizzle of vanilla essence and mix well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,cayenne pepper,celery salt,banana pepper,cheese,wheat germ,bread,purpose flour
title: Cajun Banana Pepper Bread
ingredients: 4 ripe bananas with peppers | 1 3/4 cups packed light and fluffy cheese | 1 cup shredded bread | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup wheat germ | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1 package pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Slice the bananas and place them in a colander over a bowl. Let drain in the sink for 20 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the bananas from the bowl and pat them dry. Place them in a lightly greased 2 quart casserole dish. Topping for topping, in a bowl, combine the cheese, bread, flour, wheat germ, celery salt. Sprinkle over bananas and top with cheese mixture. Sprinkle the cayenne pepper on top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until topping is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,dill weed,green pepper,fenugreek seed,puff pastry
title: Savoury Samosas
ingredients: 1 lb puff pastry, thawed | 2 cans diced green chili peppers | 1 green pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( optional )
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry sheets to 1 and a half inch thickness and cut into 6 pie plates. Preheat oven to 425°f. Place all green peppers and dill spice on the bottom of a baking pan. Sprinkle the green peppers over the top and continue by lining the pastry with the pepper slices, and then sprinkling the fenugreek seeds. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until pastry is puffed and golden.

title: Chicago Style French Bread
ingredients: 1 packet active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm brewed tea | 1 3/4 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Dissolve yeast in luke warm water in a mixing bowl. Stir in tea and place bowl over a pan of simmering water. Turn water to simmer and stir. When the surface of the foam starts to rise, cover, and allow to rise until it barely registers 120 f on an instant read thermometer. Pour the yeast into a 13 x9 pan. Add cheese and stir to blend. Bake at 475°f for 8 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool for 5 minutes on a wire rack. Cut into 3 inch squares or 6 inch squares and serve.

Random Ingredients: pecan,russet potato,kalamata olive,ginger garlic paste,self rising flour,bread dough,egg water,ice cube
title: Potato Kebabs
ingredients: 1 egg, beaten | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh ginger-garlic paste ( recipe calls for 1/2 tsp. ) | 2 tablespoons ice cube | 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 6 pieces each | 16 kalamata olives, pitted and finely chopped | 4 cups bread dough, defrosted and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Oil a baking sheet. Mix egg, flour, pecans, ginger garlic paste and ice cubes in shallow bowl. Add potatoes and mix to coat. Arrange potato mixture in a single layer on baking sheet. Sprinkle top of potato mixture evenly with olives. Wrap with bread dough and pierce with a fork. Bake until golden brown about 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Garnish if desired.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,spicy mustard,ra el hanout spice mix,pine nut,white bread,wine,green tea leaf,red potato
title: Warm Pork & Green Tea
ingredients: 2 lbs bone-in pork roast | 1/2 cup brewed green tea leaves | 2 red potatoes, chopped into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon spicy mustard | 1 tablespoon mixed spice island blend, chopped | 1 tablespoon ra el hanout spice mix | toasted pine nuts ( to garnish )
instructions: In a bowl, mix both dry ingredients into the lamb. Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat. Sprinkle both sides of the lamb with pinches of the seasoning mixture, and sear the lamb on all sides, about 10 minutes per side. Cover and set aside. In the same skillet, heat the remaining can of green tea at medium heat. Stir in the potatoes, and cook until tender and lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Spread the potato mixture over the top of the lamb, and cover with foil. Allow to simmer for about an hour to two hours, until the potatoes are tender and most of the liquid has reduced away. Allow to cool to room temp, then cut into thick strips.

title: Curd Crawfish Fritters
ingredients: 1 kg small crawfish | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 bunch cilantro, chopped | 250 g jalapeno peppers, diced
instructions: Blanch crawfish in a large pan of boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain crawfish and reserve liquid. Mash crawfish with a fork and mix the flour and soda in a large bowl. Stir the liquid reserved from the crawfish into the flour mixture to make a thick batter. Add crawfish and dices of jalapeño peppers to batter and mix well. Heat oil in a wok or deep fat fryer and fry fritters, a few at a time, for 1 to 2 minutes on each side until golden brown.

title: Rosemary Aioli
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 15 leaves fresh rosemary
instructions: Place the rosemary leaves and rosemary leaves in a food processor or mortar and pestle. Add the vinegar and process until combined. Spoon mixture onto cold bechamel, chocolate, or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,vidalia onion,black bean,red snapper,picante sauce
title: Baja Fish Ceviche
ingredients: 5 tablespoons picante sauce | 3/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon black beans ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon vidalia onion | 24 red snapper, fillets
instructions: First, rinse and drain the beans. Heat the picante, onion powder and black bean juice in a skillet over medium heat and simmer until the liquid has reduced and flavors are combined. Cover and cool until hot. Grill fish until done and drain the fish. Cut into six thick slices across the fish. Serve with warm pico de gallo, pico de gallo and pico de gallo.

title: Nordic Favourite French Fries
ingredients: 1 cup potato chips, crushed | 5 saffron threads ( or 10g sachet saffron threads, rinsed and softened with a teaspoon in a teaspoon of warm water )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, beat the potato chips, saffron and water until they are well blended. When ready to fry your french fries, heat one of the methods of high, non stick frying pan over a medium low heat. Drop in a few chips into the hot pan, spread out evenly, until browned on all sides. Remove with a slotted spoon, drain excess water. Serve immediately. Repeat for remaining fries according to the preparation instructions. Serve with butter, mustard and green salad.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,chocolate syrup,orange flower water,tarragon,sunflower oil,sirloin
title: Beef and Dark Yoghurt Spritz Burgers With Chocolate Syrup
ingredients: 500 g sirloin, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup plain yogurt, plain fat free | 1 1/4 cups sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons light chocolate syrup | 1/2 teaspoon orange flower water ( optional )
instructions: Place sirloin in a medium bowl with tarragon and mix to combine. In a separate bowl, combine yoghurt, oil, chocolate syrup, orange flower water and desired amount of salt and pepper. Add to beef mixture and ensure each piece is well coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Heat wok over medium high heat until hot. Add 1 tablespoon oil and swirl to coat. Add beef and stir fry until desired doneness. Serve on toasted sandwich rolls or bread slices, garnished with a dollop of chocolate syrup.

title: Sweet Mexican Cheese Foldovers
ingredients: 1 carton fat-free soymilk | 2 packages taco flavored spaghetti sauce ( found near jars of the meat and cheese sauces ) | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 -2 jalapeno or 2 -3 large red chili peppers, stemmed, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Using a food processor or blender, puree the soy milk and pasta sauce until smooth. The best way to do this is to pour the whole mixture into a large bowl and stir in the raisins and peppers. Using your hands, form 8 small rectangles of the pasta sauce on the top and spread them evenly over the sauce. Using your fingers, roll up each rectangle into a ball and place seam side down on a plastic covered cookie sheet. Chill for 30 minutes or until firm. Turn out onto a floured board and gently cut each in half. Place each piece, cut side up, onto a cookie sheet. Cook the filled rolls on a lightly greased griddle or a cast iron skillet over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Potato Cake With Strawberry-Mashed Caramel
ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, peeled | 1/2 lb very ripe strawberry, hulled | 1/4 cup strawberry jam or 1/4 cup strawberry yogurt | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 teaspoon szechwan pepper ( or other asian pepper ) | 1/2 lb unsalted frozen strawberries | 1 cup heavy whipped cream, for garnish ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Place potatoes in a large saucepan, cover potatoes with water. Bring water to boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer gently for 1 hour or until tender. Drain and cool to room temperature. Cut into wedges with a paring knife, then arrange half the potato and 1/2 lb strawberry pieces into a greased 9 inch square baking dish. Wash strawberries and hull well. Cut off top layer of berries and set aside. Blend jam or yogurt with coconut milk in a blender. Stir until mixed well. Pour over potato mixture.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,tomato puree,basil,goat cheese,beet,chinese chili sauce,butter
title: Chinese Hot Goat's Cheese With Beets
ingredients: 6 fresh beets, washed and shredded | 2 teaspoons chinese sweet chili sauce or 2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 1/2 teaspoons butter or 2 1/2 teaspoons margarine | 2 1/2 teaspoons tomato puree or 2 1/2 teaspoons tomato puree | 8 ounces soft fresh goat's cheese | fresh basil ( to garnish )
instructions: Spray a griddle or frypan with cooking spray and heat on medium.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,liquid smoke flavoring,chicken thigh,simple syrup,white pepper,kosher salt
title: Easy Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken thighs | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 3/4 cup kosher salt | 1 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1/2 teaspoon msg ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon powdered hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large resealable plastic baggie. Refrigerate 4 to 24 hours. Pat chicken dry and arrange on a greased baking sheet. Brush chicken with a little of the spice mixture. Bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes longer or until lightly browned and skin is crisp. Turn over while still warm and brush with remaining spice mixture.

title: Easy Peach and Onion Fritters!
ingredients: 2 cups peaches, pitted ( chopped or pureed canned peaches ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix ( such as mccormick's a1 ) | 1 egg | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 2 tablespoons beer
instructions: Beat 1 egg with a fork, mix with the celery salt in a small bowl and dip the peach slices in the egg. Place 1 1/2 teaspoons of mixture in a tortilla press. Roll up and fry at once, turning until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,italian parsley,sesame oil,bean,red chili pepper,gruyere cheese,onion,ginger root
title: Quinoa Cakes
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 red chili pepper, sliced | 2 small onions, chopped | 8 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley, or to taste | 1 piece fresh ginger root, grated | 1 can baked beans
instructions: Place the quinoa into a large bowl and pour in enough water to cover. Add the chile, onions, gruyere cheese, sesame oil, parsley, ginger, and baked beans, stirring to combine. Cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Pollo Alla Reggiano
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey peppersoni | 3 turnips, peeled and sliced into cubes | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 teaspoon dried lemon-lime beverage ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the turkey paste for about 10 minutes, adding the turnips, savory, lemon lime beverage and ginger to the skillet once cooked through. Cover and let simmer over low heat for 15 - 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Amarina's Favourite Cherry and Almond Salad
ingredients: 1 bag fresh cherries | 1 shallot, thinly sliced | 3 anaheim chilies, thinly sliced | 1 clove garlic paste | 1/4 cup currants or 1/4 cup raisins, soaked in warm water to cover | 2 tablespoons blanched slivered almonds | ice ( as desired )
instructions: Rinse and pit cherries, rinse and drain well. Cut in half horizontally. Set cherry halves aside. Cut shallot and chiles crosswise into thin slices. Place in a bowl. Add garlic paste and currants. Gently stir until currants are coated. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours, stirring every 2 hours. Before serving, sprinkle blanched almonds over cherry mixture. Chill well and serve to blend flavors.

title: Shrimp and Camote Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 large firm ripe cherry tomatoes | 3 -4 tablespoons shredded cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 2 ounces snow peas ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/8 teaspoon ground celery | 1 lb cooked medium shrimp ( shelled )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Lightly grease a large casserole dish with a little margarine or shortening. If you don't have a baking dish with high sides, line it with aluminum foil. Place the tomatoes on the foil, hollow side up. Mix together the cheeses, shrimps, celery, allspice, and salt and pepper to taste. Spoon most of the cheese mixture into the tomatoes, packing it tightly. Stuff the tomatoes with the cheese mixture. Drizzle with the remaining tbsp of margarine or shortening. Place them in the oven. Bake, uncovered for 45 to 50 minutes.

instructions: Drain the excess liquid out of the cheese, crumble the cheese & raisins and raisins into a bowl. Heat the liqueur and coffee liqueur. Stir to dissolve it. Sift the flour & salt into the bowl with the cheese & raisins. Make a well in the middle of the mixture & pour in the beer. Stir in the orange extract. Drop in mini spoonfuls of dough and fry them in a pan until golden & firm.

title: Mexican Slaw
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant coffee creamer | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 teaspoon pineapple juice | 1/2 teaspoon chopped peppercorn | 1/2 cup shredded red cabbage
instructions: Toss together the coffee creamer and salsa.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,mace,vegetarian bean,creme de cacao,poultry seasoning,green chili
title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can vegetarian refried beans | 1 can cream of celery soup | 1 can chopped green chili | 1 tablespoon creme de cacao | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Melt vegetable oil in a skillet and fry chopped chilies until soft. Stir in refried beans. Combine soups, creme de cacao, poultry seasoning, nutmeg. Pour into hot pan and stir well. Turn off heat. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir and serve.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,orange juice zest,cardamom,plain yogurt,lime wedge,port wine,mango chutney
title: Yogurt Mango Chutney Snap Snacks
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 1/2 cup orange juice ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice, to taste | 1/4 tablespoon port wine | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mango chutney, about 3 small | 1/2 cup snow peas, ends trimmed
instructions: Place all but snow peas in a blender or food processor with enough yogurt to make a smooth, thick paste. Divide the paste into four equal portions. Stir the yogurt mixture into each portion. Sprinkle mango chutney on top of yogurt mixture. Refrigerate in covered bowl at least one hour and up to 1 week.
