title: Delicious Ham and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 500 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 1/2 cups milk chutney | 2 tablespoons curry powder, divided | 200 g sliced deli ham, diced | 1/2 cup strawberries, diced | 4 fresh sage, leaves picked and washed
instructions: Using a food processor, process milk ricotta until it is creamy consistency. Add beef bouillon, chutney, 1 tbsp of the curry powder and the rest of the curry powder to the ricotta mixture. Add ham, strawberries and sage. Mix well.

title: Almond Gratin Appetizers
ingredients: 1 jar almond halves, drained | 1 pound sliced, peeled apples | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 2 cups toasted and shredded baguette, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place almonds, apples, and cream in a large bowl. Arrange baguette slices on a flat surface.

Random Ingredients: yellow mustard,snow pea,nori,meat,pizza dough,extra virgin olive oil,tortilla
title: Tortilla-Wrapped Meat Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 jar pizza dough | 12 ounces thinly sliced sirloin steak, thinly sliced ( beef round steak recommended ) | 12 small nori ( dry seaweed sheets ) | 1 package fresh snow peas ( may substitute frozen ) | 3 sheets very thin ( regular ) sheets nori ( optional ) | 7 2 teaspoons yellow mustard | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 ounces sliced meat
instructions: Slice your nori in half widthwise so you’ll have 14 equal squares. Lay the nori out over a work surface and lightly stretch. Using your fingers and the side of your hand, lightly brush the seaweed with a small drop of olive oil. Starting with the long side closest to you, lightly sprinkle the nori with some of the yellow mustard. On one side of your nori, lay the meat followed by the snow peas. Top the meat with the nori. Carefully roll the nori up. Brush the edges lightly with more of the yellow mustard. Cut the roll, making sure it doesn’t leak out and stick to the nori. Serve in one piece and arrange the meat on top of the nori and vegetables. Drizzle the remaining olive oil on top of the sandwich. Serve hot. May be accompanied by a chilled cocktail.

title: Chunky Mexi Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 300 g dark chocolate | 300 g grape tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1 - 1 1/2 cup mild salsa
instructions: Put the choclo in a heat proof bowl. Microwave the tomatoes in a little water for 2 minutes. Add the salsa to the tomatoes and microwave for 2 minutes longer, to ensure the mixture is evenly spread and slightly softened. Spread the choclo in a large, non stick frying pan and place over a medium heat. Melt the chocolate in the microwave for 1 - 2 minutes, or until completely blended and very smooth, stirring every now and then until smooth. Serve straight away with cream, drinks, chips or a green vegetable.

title: Saucy Roasted Salmon With Ladyfingers
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs skin-on salmon | 1 1/2 lbs ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f wash both sides of the salmon fillet. Spread the brown sugar over the fillet. Place fillet on rack of a large roasting pan and bake for 30 minutes, or until cooked through and well done.

title: Quick and Easy Japanese Pickled Celery
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice vinegar, white | 1 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the rice vinegar and celery seasoning. Cool.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,pineapple ring,marjoram,vidalia onion,pepper,hard egg,danish blue cheese,cornflour
title: Pineapple Beef Burgers
ingredients: 500 g chuck roast, finely grated | 1 vidalia onion, finely chopped ( use a large one if you like ) | 3 tablespoons lemon juice or 3 tablespoons lime juice | pepper | marjoram ( to taste ) | 8 canned pineapple rings, drained | 1/4 cup danish blue cheese or 1/4 cup any fresh blue cheese ( optional ) | 1 cup cornflour
instructions: Mix grated beef with onion, lemon juice and pepper until well combined. Form into four patties, each about 5cm thick. Grill patties on hot lightly greased barbecue plate for 20 minutes or until cooked through and juices run clear, turning once. Slice meat burgers into chunks and sprinkle with marjoram and sprinkle on top, grill for 3 - 4 minutes, turning once. Place the pineapple rings on a plate, place cheese on the centre, place the burger on top and serve immediately.

title: The Smoky Russian Tea for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange bitters | 1/4 cup kahlua or 1/4 cup other coffee liqueur | 6 drops liquid smoke | 4 slices pita bread
instructions: Combine bitters and kahlua to brew the tea. Add liquid smoke and top with bread. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,purple onion,pecorino romano cheese,beet,sharp cheddar cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Beet and Corn Relish
ingredients: 4 medium beets, cooked and peeled and sliced into thin slivers | 2 medium purple onions, diced | 1 jar whole kernel corn, drained | 3 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 8 tablespoons freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Place beets and onions in bowl of food processor. Scrape sides and pulse until finely chopped. Add in corn and 1 cup water. Process until well blended. Add 1/2 cup of cheese and process until mixture starts to melt. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Spray 8x8 pan with cooking spray. Spread relish over dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Cover and chill overnight. Heat oven to 400°. Cover and bake for about 1 hour or until relish is bubbly and slightly browned.

title: Creamy Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach | 2 -3 quarts chicken stock or 2 -3 quarts vegetable stock
instructions: Add about 6 - 8 cups of chicken or vegetable stock to a large soup pot. Add your favourite spinach leaves to the stock and bring to a simmer. Cook for approx 20 minutes or until the spinach has grown a little and has become tender. If you feel the need a little more liquid add a tbsp of water to the pot. Remove any large pieces of spinach from the stock and add them back into the pot. Place pot under a very lightly greased broiler until the spinach is soft. If you have a crockpot add it to the spinach for around 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,sage leaf,thai chili sauce,ladyfinger,tart green apple,oyster,milk
title: Smoked Oysters on the Barbie
ingredients: 2 large ladyfingers ( this is not strictly a bun ) | 4 slices smoked oily ( oyster on the shell, you can buy this at an oriental specialty store ) | 4 large mild chili peppers ( depending on the amount of heat from jar spice jar or canned chili pepper flakes ) | 8 -12 canned tart green apples, chopped ( a sweet chile will do, not sweet ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup milk | 2 tablespoons oyster liquor or 2 tablespoons heinz chili sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves
instructions: Place the ladyfingers in the bottom of a glass salad bowl. Layer the chilies, apples, chili flakes and sage on top. Pour over the milk and top with cheese. Chill. Cut the rest of the cheese into small pieces and serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,lime juice zest,vodka,steak,miracle whip,oyster sauce
title: Crispy Steak With Vodka
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | vegetable oil, for brushing | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lime zest | 1 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Cut steak into serving sized pieces. Pound lightly with a mallet. Dust steak with soy sauce and lime zest and roll in oyster sauce. In a heavy skillet, heat oil to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Add the steak, being careful not to crowd them. Fry over high heat only until lightly browned on both sides. Pour in the vodka, turning if needed. Serve immediately.

title: Roast Sirloin With a Pumpkin and Dill D
ingredients: 2 tablespoons plain flour | 125 g canned pumpkin | 250 g shredded sirloin | 1 1/2 tablespoons low fat buttermilk | 1 teaspoon dill | 1/4 cup low fat ricotta cheese | sweetened dried cherries ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. In a bowl, combine flour, pumpkin, beef, buttermilk, dill and ricotta. Gently mix to combine. Roll mixture into 1 inch balls. Arrange on a greased baking tray. Bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through and golden. Serve with a tossed salad.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,part mozzarella cheese,fruit,water chestnut
title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 cups water chestnuts, chopped | 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1/2 cup dried fruit, chopped ( strawberries, pineapple, raspberries, or applesauce ) | 120 g part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Bring water, rice, and dried fruit to boiling in a medium saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until all liquid is absorbed and rice is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Quick, Easy and Tasty Indian Chapati
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup unbleached flour, plus additional | 1/2 cup unbleached flour, for sprinkling on baking sheets | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon ice water
instructions: Whisk the flours and cardamom seeds together in a large bowl. Add the ice water.

Random Ingredients: rose water,lettuce leaf,chipotle chile pepper,grand marnier,peanut oil,champagne,epazote,beef roast
title: Smoked Sausage and Pepper Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs beef roast | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce or 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/4 cup minced fresh epazote | 3 3 tablespoons roasted and ground chipotle chile peppers | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed dried rose water | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 12 large lettuce leaves | 3/4 cup unsalted dry-roasted unsalted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Remove fat from meat and cut into 1 1/2 inch square pieces. In a large saucepan, combine hoisin sauce, minced epazote, ground chipotle chile peppers and rosewater. Place over high heat.

title: Irish Cream Sugar-Free Fudge
ingredients: 1 cup irish cream | 3/4 cup sugar ( to taste ) | 1 2/3 cups crisco
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, and place in an airtight container. When set, cut into blocks or triangles and store in freezer until completely cold.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,panir,canola cooking spray,water,lettuce leaf,cake,spinach leaf,cardamom seed
title: Panir-And-Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package manicotti ( farfalle, bow tie, or other small whole wheat pasta ) | 6 tablespoons canola cooking spray | 10 cups mixed spinach leaves, cleaned and trimmed ( about 5 cups ) | 1/4 cup water | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 8 slices panir ( deli-style cut into about 6 slices ) | 2 cups dry sandwich rolls, toasted | 4 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions and drain well, but do not rinse. In a large bowl, mix spinach leaves and water. Sprinkle cardamom over pasta. Add panir to pasta with spinach mixture and toss well to evenly distribute. Toast rolls and assemble salad. Place toasted roll on a board, lay out rolled and top with pasta mixture, cheese, etc. Cover with lettuce leaves and roll up. Cut in half and serve.

title: Port Wine Jelly
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups port wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili paste
instructions: Pour the port into a clean small saucepan and allow to sit warm until all of the liquid is gone, at least 20 minutes. Stir in the chili paste and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: chutney,tomato green chilies,cream milk,wasabi paste,hard egg,apricot jam
title: Deviled Eggs (Eggswana)
ingredients: 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1 can tomato and green chilies or ( 28 ounce ) can kidney beans, drained and mash well with a fork | 2 teaspoons chopped canned apricot jam | 2 -3 tablespoons cream, milk or 2 -3 tablespoons soymilk | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste or 1 teaspoon sesame oil | chopped hard-boiled egg, for garnish
instructions: Cut egg shells in half and place on cookie sheet, hollow side uppermost. Cut egg whites into halves. Using a small spoon or a spoon, scoop out some black centers. Place egg whites in a bowl of cold water, and refrigerate. In a small bowl, mix the remaining ingredients with a fork. Set aside. Spoon one egg half into each shell with a fork, and top with a dollop of jam followed by dollop of sour cream. Garnish with chopped hard boiled egg, if desired. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Sauerkraut Fajitas
ingredients: 2 lbs sauerkraut | 8 ounces chunky salsa | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1 package fajita seasoning mix
instructions: Place sauerkraut in dutch oven. In a medium bowl combine salsa, corn syrup and fajita seasoning mix, mix well. Pour mix over sauerkraut, bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook 5 - 10 minutes until done. Serve with corn chips.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,angel hair pasta,vegetable,pinto bean,red wine vinegar,buttermilk
title: Baked Orzo Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 3 teaspoons red wine vinegar | 3 cups canned pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups chopped assorted fresh vegetables ( such as bell peppers, cauliflower florets, zucchini slices ) | 1 1/2 cups cooked angel hair pasta, cooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. In a large bowl, whisk the buttermilk, garam masala, vinegar and pinto beans. Stir in the vegetables and pasta. Mix lightly until the pasta is coated. Place the pasta in a lightly oiled 2 quart round baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,pork tenderloin,hot paprika,coriander powder,pumpkin,hamburger,part mozzarella cheese
title: Pork Tenderloin "the Real"
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut in 4 pieces | 1 lb hamburger | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 cup canned pumpkin, drained | 1/4 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese or 1/4 cup reduced-fat mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup fresh maraschino cherry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place meat, onion, coriander and paprika in a large bowl.

title: Crab and Basil Rolls
ingredients: 300 g crabmeat | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 -2 fresh basil leaf, washed | 2 -3 fresh basil leaves, washed
instructions: Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place the crab meat, bicarbonate of soda and basil leaves on the tray. Lightly press each basil leaf on top. Roll up and pinch the ends together. Bake in oven on tray for 15 minutes at 180°c. Eat right away.

Random Ingredients: spice,poblano chile,meat,red potato,lemon wedge,active yeast,basil leaf,brandy
title: Spice Bread
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, peeled, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 1/2 lbs ground meat, preferably dark meat | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 2 large poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped lemons, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons rum | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: In a bowl, combine the salt and potato and mash well. Dump the potato mixture onto a clean dry surface, and knead with your hands, adding more flour as required to knead. The dough should be quite stiff, but not dry. Roll the dough out to about 1/4 inch thick. Fold the dough into 8 wedges. Place the slices of meat across the center of each wedge. Wrap the tortillas and place them on a rimmed baking sheet. In a bowl, combine the basil, chile peppers, lemons, brandy or rum, mixed spice and 2 tablespoons water and stir well. Spoon the chile mixture into a small bowl, pour over the bread to within 1/2 inch of the edges, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, turning once. Punch off any extra moisture from the bread with your hands, as much as necessary. Allow the mixture to set and rise, uncovered and at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Bake the bread for about 15 minutes, stirring once, until the top crust is browned and crisp and the cheese is melted and a little crusty around the edges. Remove from the heat and allow to sit for just a few minutes. Serve directly from the baking sheet.

title: Burgundi
ingredients: 500 g boneless veal loin | 60 ml grapefruit juice | 500 g puff pastry | 1 ounce dark chocolate, grated
instructions: Trim the veal from any visible fat, then slice into ½ inch thick slices. Place 1 slice of the veal between the sheets of pastry and use a flat knife to lightly pound them to an approximately ½ inch thickness. Drizzle half the grapefruit juice on the veal to stop it drying out. Lay on a double layer of pastry, cover with a double layer of dark chocolate and press all the edges together firmly, making sure that the pastry doesn't overhang. Roll out the pastry between 2 sheets of greaseproof paper until it reaches ½ inch thickness. Carefully lift the pastry with a metal spoon onto the surface of the pastry and ease it up a little on the table. Make sure the pastry sticks out enough to be seen from the sides. Cover loosely with foil and set aside. Repeat with the other piece of pastry and trim off any excess pastry. Place the parcels on a baking tray or pizza peel. Brush them with remaining grapefruit juice. Bake in the preheated oven, 230°c on a baking sheet for 25 to 30 minutes or until nicely browned on top. Serve warm.

title: Basmati Pudding
ingredients: 3 leeks | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1/3 lb deli ham | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 1/4 cup light soy sauce | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring water to boil. Trim ends from leeks and discard, cut leeks crosswise in 1/4 inch slices, then scrub under cold running water. Trim fat off ham and cut into 1/4 inch dice. Bring water back to boil, add rice and cook until just tender, about 4 minutes. Drain rice and set aside. In a small bowl, combine cream and soy sauce, add ham and stir to combine. In a small, dry skillet, heat the cream and soy sauce mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly, until heated through. Add leeks to cream mixture. Cook and stir until leeks are translucent, about 5 minutes, about 3 minutes. Add ham to lemon mixture. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Pour lemon mixture evenly into 4 individual bowls and top with peanuts. Serve at once.

title: Curried Beef over Cranberry Beans
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak or 1 lb top round steak, cut into thin strips | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 can berry and cranberry juice | 14 ounces baked beans, undrained | 1 teaspoon whole cloves | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon cranberry juice
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, cook steak, curry powder, and 1 can of berry juice over medium heat until meat is lightly browned. Stir in beans, cloves, and salt. Heat to boiling, cover, and cook 45 minutes or until meat and beans are tender.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,yoghurt,orange juice zest,prosciutto,phyllo pastry dough,thyme,bread flour
title: Muxi Roast Lamb
ingredients: 1200 g leg of lamb ( about 2.5kg ) | 300 g smoked prosciutto ( or ham ) | 100 g yoghurt ( natural reduced fat ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped | 2 teaspoons orange juice and zest of, finely grated | 3 cups bread flour | 4 sheets phyllo pastry dough, thawed after drying
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/ 400°f. Place lamb on a board. Using a sharp knife, slice along both sides of the joint to a cross 1 to2/3/4cm thick. Cut out some large trussing pieces of meat, from the rib bone if available, so you have 8 slices. Place the pieces of meat back together. Lay the pieces of prosciutto over the meat, along with 1/2 c yoghurt, and sprinkle with thyme. Roll out another piece of dough and lay over the top, pressing together. Repeat with remaining pieces of meat. Arrange the meat in an ovenproof dish, then pour over remaining yoghurt. Cover with foil and bake for 2 hours, or until the lamb is cooked to your liking. If you want to make the sauce for this dish, add a splash of balsamic vinegar to the juices of the pan, add half a bunch of thyme and a little orange zest to the juices and stir, then pour into the pan juices. Bring to the boil, then reduce to a low simmer. To make pastry, place bread flour into a bowl, and add the 1 tbs yoghurt. Add remaining thyme, orange zest, and 1 cup water. Stir. Cut pastry into 5 cm rounds with a well in the middle of each round. Brush with beaten egg, then roll on to floured pastry cloth. Pile on the top of the lamb and brush with beaten egg. Top with a little remaining thyme and orange zest and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until golden brown outside, but slightly crisp inside.

title: Pasta with Foie Gras and Caramelized Caramelized Caramelized Caramelized Caramelized Carrots
ingredients: 2 cups orecchiette or 2 cups rotini pasta | 10 slices foie gras | 12 caramelized caramelized carrots
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the orecchiette for 8 minutes or until tender. Using 2 forks, shred the orecchiette in a food processor or large heavy skillet. Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle with 2 tablespoons of the caramelized carrots. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, reheat the remaining 1 tablespoon of caramelized carrots in a small skillet over low heat until hot and deep golden brown, then transfer to a small bowl and keep warm. When you are ready to serve, drain the orecchiette from the water and divide among 4 dinner plates. Serve at once, garnish with the caramelized carrots.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,turkey breast tenderloin,pesto sauce,spinach leaf,coffee,cinnamon bark
title: Quick and Easy Individual Turkey-Spinach Tenderloins
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon prepared pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon instant coffee | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon bark | 1/4 teaspoon ground mustard or 1/4 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 4 ounces deli turkey breast tenderloins
instructions: Prepare grill pan and grill for 5 minutes on each side. Cool completely. Remove any membrane from spinach. Place in a mixing bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside. Combine pesto, coffee and cinnamon bark, stir until thoroughly blended. Slice turkey into four 1/2 inch thick slices and arrange on top of spinach mixture. Sprinkle cinnamon bark mixture on top of turkey. Grill turkey for 2 - 3 minutes per side, or until internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f.

title: Fig and Herb Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh fig, finely chopped | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh sage leaves, lightly crushed
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and toss with enough dressing to coat. Serve. Store leftovers in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,cake flour,fish fillet,green cardamom,kale,beef liver,fenugreek seed
title: Fish on Wheat Wraps
ingredients: 500 g fish fillets ( fillet weight ) | 1 cup chopped beef liver ( kale leaf ) | 100 g dried kelp ( about 200 grams chopped leaves ) | 2 tablespoons chopped green cardamoms | 1 cup flat meal flour | 1 tablespoon fenugreek seeds ( methi ) | 4 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients listed under fish filling together in a bowl. Set aside. Heat a pan/skillet to med/high. Coat the side of the tortillas with oil. title: Chicken With Swiss White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast half | cooking apple, diced or fresh grated apple | 1/2 cup cooked cannellini beans or 1/2 cup canned cannellini beans | 1/3 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup fontina cheese, shredded
instructions: Bake chicken breast as directed on package. Preheat oven broiler. Dice or shred chicken breast. Add to crockpot with apple, beans, green pepper and half of cheese.

title: Vermicelli in Sweet Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup vermicelli ( fideo ) | 1/2 bell pepper | 4 -5 tablespoons ice cubes | powdered cinnamon
instructions: Using a mortar and chitcho, smash vermicelli slightly until you have a paste. Slice bell pepper into thin strips. Fry vermicelli mixture until crisp but not browned. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Bread Au Vins
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn | 125 g white bread flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons cocoa | 1 -100 ml tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning, your favourite ( e.g, sage, sage powder, marjoram ) | 300 ml single cream
instructions: In a separate bowl mix the flour and spices. Set aside. Drain the tomato juice and combine throughly with the liquid and the spice mixture. Stir to combine. Pour this into a 5cm or 8cm ovenproof bowl and place in the fridge. This should go back into the freezer for 1 - 2 hours. When ready to bake cut 2 circles of butter paper, approximately 2 in diameter. Brush 1 side of each circle with flour and place on baking tray. Brush butter on top of the circle. Cover with remaining circle of butter, press lightly to flatten. Bake in oven for 15 - 20 minutes at 180 degrees c. Remove and keep warm until ready to serve.

title: Chipotle Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/3 cup minced chipotle peppers | 2/3 cup shredded cucumber
instructions: Fold the chipotle, cucumber, and cumin together in a bowl.

title: Mexican Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, very lean, in 2-inch cubes | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 6 ounces shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Mix cumin and beef in crock pot. Cook 7 - 8 hours on high.

title: Beef & Barley Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef | 6 -8 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning ( or a mild spanish adobo seasoning ) | 3/4 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese | 3/4 cup amaretto ( almond liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 1/3 cup thinly sliced red potato
instructions: Place meat and liquid in the slow cooker. Sprinkle the adobo and barley over, and stir. Add cheese, liqueur and chili powder. Turn the slow cooker to high, and cook for 6 hours or until meat is tender. Stir. Remove meat.

title: Napa Dave's Onions Poached
ingredients: 4 -6 white pearl onions, peeled ( see step 2 ) | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 3 drops vanilla extract | 3 -4 drops brandy ( optional ) | 1 -2 dijon mustard ( optional ) | 1 cup broth, if necessary ( see step 7 ) | chopped white pearl onion
instructions: In a very large pot, bring enough water to just cover the onions. If they are large, they should be about 2 inches larger than the pearl onions. Bring to a rapid boil and immediately remove from heat. Leave the onions on the stove until they are fully soft. Drain most of the water from the onions. Place the onions in a deep pot and cover with water. Don't use a tall bowl because the onions will release more liquid. If any water escapes from the onions when they are just soft enough, just add more water, about 1/2 cup at a time. If it's too thin for your tastes, you can put it back in the water until the onions are hard. Add the chili powder, adobo seasoning, vanilla, brandy, and mustard, if using. Bring to a slow boil, stirring occasionally. If the liquid just covers the onions, cook at a slower boil for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and creamy. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool. When cool, you can slice them right out of the pot and serve with white pearl onions. They taste even better the next day.

Random Ingredients: chinese eggplant,garlic,eggplant,chili powder,orange,liquid smoke flavoring,poblano pepper
title: Eggplant(Aubergine) With Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs eggplants, peeled and sliced on the diagnonal thick diagonal slice | 1 1/2 lbs chinese eggplants | 1/2 lb poblano pepper ( or a combination ) | 4 slices orange rind | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/2 cup minced garlic
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Place eggplant in a colander and sprinkle with salt. Let set for 15 minute drain well. Lay eggplant in a dry roasting pan and cover with foil. Let sit for 15 minutes. Rinse eggplant clean and pat dry with paper towels. Trim all browned bits, including the stem. Set aside. Place chinese eggplant and poblanos on rack in roasting pan in middle of oven. Turn eggplants and poblanos over and put another roasting pan on your oven shelf. Bake until eggplant is soft when pricked with a fork. This may take 25 - 30 minute or 45 minute to an hour depending on oven size. When eggplant is cool enough, peel off the skin of the chinese eggplant and slice off the hard part with a sharp knife. Do this with all the vegetables. Place all vegetables on a roasting pan, preferably one with a tight lid. Cover with foil. Bake in oven until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes. In a bowl, lightly beat the eggs with chili powder and liquid smoke. Pour over vegetables and stir. When eggplant is done, garnish with minced garlic and fresh pepper and serve. Eggplant is better served hot. The prep time does not include the 35 minute wait time. After the 25 minute take off oven and let sit 20 minute.

title: Creamy Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 package smoked chicken breasts ( can sub other types of cooked chicken ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half or 1/2 cup milk | 3 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Shred chicken into bite size pieces and place in a medium bowl. Mix in your favorite dressing. You can add more salad oil, if desired. I usually don't add anything else.

title: Spicy Garlic Pork Spareribs in Agrodolce

instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together half of the icing sugar, basil and citric acid. Dip each piece of spareribs into the icing sugar, then drain off any excess. instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package directions. Set aside, covered, until later. Heat rum in a medium nonstick skillet. Add bell pepper and green pepper.

instructions: Place rice noodles in a large bowl and cover with warm water.

title: The Perfect Easy Chilled Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons sherry or 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Blend together in a jar or glass jar with a tight fitting lid. Use as a dipping sauce for meats and vegetables.
