title: Spaghetti and Feta Cheese (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 4 cups spaghetti sauce, store bought or homemade, of your choice | 12 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 3 tablespoons parsley sprigs, washed well | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder ( or curry powder ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried marjoram ( or your favourite dried chili powder ) | vegetable oil cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. Prepare pasta as per package instructions. For the sauce, combine all ingredients except the oil in bowl and set aside. Coat an 8 x8 baking dish lightly with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. While the water is heating, combine all the ingredients and then drain pasta. Add the sauce to the pasta and mix well.

title: Quark and Apple Cider
ingredients: 4 cups hard apple cider ( or more to cover ) | 1 cup quark
instructions: Pour the cider into a non metallic saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce to a simmer and stir frequently. Allow to simmer for 1 hour until the liquid has reduced by half. Off heat, stir in the quark and allow to cool completely before serving.

title: Red Leaf Lettuce With Clementines, Cardamom and Clementines
ingredients: 1 head red leaf lettuce | 6 thin clementines ( to serve ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons cardamom seeds or 3 1/2 tablespoons ajwapor | 6 tablespoons dried clementines ( or 3 1/2 tablespoons ajwapor )
instructions: Separate the individual leaves of lettuce so the ones are separated into leaf sections. Remove the stalks from the clementines. Trim and remove any membrane that may still be attached.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,italian sausage,hard egg,cinnamon sugar,dark chocolate,cottage cheese,picante sauce,pepper sauce
title: Mexican Breakfast Bake
ingredients: 4 ounces sweet italian sausage, casing removed | 4 hard-boiled eggs, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup mild picante sauce | 1/4 cup chiliunky salsa | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/2 cup low fat greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f. Line a 9x5 inch round baking pan with foil. Set aside. Cook sausage, breaking into pieces, in a 5 qt. Saucepan over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Drain, add egg, cheese, picante sauce, salsa and sour cream or yogurt, stirring until smooth. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and hot pepper sauce. Heat in oven until warm.

Random Ingredients: apricot,lime juice zest,anise seed,chicken bouillon,pistachio nut
title: Chops of the Devil
ingredients: 12 small blanched and dried apricots ( about 1-1/2 lbs ) | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 2 teaspoons lime juice, freshly squeezed | 1/2 cup toasted pistachio nut ( or almonds )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Cut apricots into 1/4 inch thick slices. Arrange them in a shallow roasting pan coated with cooking spray. Add remaining ingredients and toss together until the mixture is lightly coated and evenly coated. Bake until tender, stirring twice, about 35 to 45 minutes. Turn the apricots upside down on paper towels and let drain. Store apricots in an airtight container for up to 1 week. The soaking can be made 4 to 5 days ahead and kept, covered, at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: alfalfa sprout,chocolate square,papaya,macaroni,broccoli floret,cumin,chicken breast fillet
title: Chicken Fungous With Macaroni and Fruit
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1/4 large dried mango | 2 tablespoons grated chocolate squares | 600 g macaroni, cooked al dente | 350 g broccoli florets | 4 chicken breast fillets, thawed if frozen | 2 small papayas, quartered
instructions: Place cumin in shallow baking dish and scatter half the mango over. Bake at 150oc for 15 mins. Increase oven temp to 180oc and bake for about 10 mins or until browned and aromatic. Place macaroni in large serving bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon macaroni mixture onto plate. Place chicken on top of macaroni. Drizzle with remaining mango and extra mango drizzle from marie's bottle. Enjoy.

title: Sliced Pasilla Peppers With Lima Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs small pasilla peppers | 12 small snow peas, trimmed | 2 tablespoons dried lavender, crushed | 7 tablespoons dried unpeeled limes or 7 tablespoons dried limes
instructions: Heat a gas grill or fire grill pan to medium high, or under the broiler. Make sure the grill or pan is not smoking directly, or let the fumes from the pasilla peppers burn out. Remove the stems, seeds, and membranes from the green peppers, and finely chop the pepper coarsely. Place the peanuts in the food processor or blender with the fresh pepper, mint and 1 tbls. Of the lavender. Process to a paste. Pour the paste into a wide, shallow bowl, and toss with the remaining lavender and lime. Let stand at room temperature about 5 minutes, then stir again before serving.

title: Melon Croissant - Melon & Croissant Rolls
ingredients: 6 croissants | 7 ounces cantaloupe | 2 ounces sweet 'n spread, thawed
instructions: Preheat the bbq. Split the croissants in half.

title: Zucchini Aubergine (Eggplant With Ground Beef)
ingredients: 3 medium aubergines, sliced in half lengthways, then sliced crossways | 300 g zucchini, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons beef stock | 1 pinch cream of tartar | 200 g firm tofu | 200 g savoiardi ladyfingers
instructions: Place aubergines, zucchini and stock in a non stick frying pan over a medium heat and bring to the boil, stir and add cream of tartar. Reduce heat and leave to simmer for 10 minutes, until zucchini is tender and zucchini is cooked through. Remove from heat. Drain aubergines and combine with zucchini mixture. Place in a serving dish, cover and rest for 20 minutes. Preheat grill to high. Bake in the middle of the grill for 4 - 5 minutes each side, or until slightly browned. Drain tofu on paper towels. Cut diagonally into slices. Arrange on serving plate, and top with some fried tofu slices. Pour aubergine mix over and serve while still warm.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,parsley sprig,kahlua,jalapeno,summer savory,coffee,vanilla ice cream,sirloin tip roast
title: Spiced Coffee Roast Sandwich Au Jus
ingredients: 3 cups hot coffee | 1 tablespoon kahlua | 1 lb sirloin tip roast | 1 tablespoon vegetable, spice flavored | 1 teaspoon summer savory | 1/4 teaspoon dried parsley sprig | 1 tablespoon chopped jalapeno | 1 cup halved vanilla ice cream
instructions: Heat the coffee over low heat in a small saucepan to simmering. Remove from heat, stir in the kahlua and set aside. Brush the roast with a little vegetable oil and place on the rack in the roasting pan. Pour the hot coffee into the pan, and bring to a boil. Stir in the savory, parsley and jalapeno. Return to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1 minutes. Transfer the roast to a carving board and let cool to room temperature. Place the carving board with the meat in front of you, and remove the meat, reserving the cooking liquid. Slice the meat thin, and spread with some of the cooking fat. Place the remaining 2 tablespoons cooking liquid, ice cream, and the reserved cooking liquid in a microwave safe bowl. Cook on high for 1 minute, stirring to blend, to slightly thicken the liquid. Remove the bowl from microwave. Heat in the microwave on high for 4 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds, until hot and hot. Serve the sandwich at room temperature with the warmed vinaigrette.

title: Enchilada Rice Vermicelli
ingredients: 250 g rice vermicelli | 200 g abuelita harissa | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest | 1 large red onions ( cut in wedges ) or 1 large yellow onion ( cut in wedges )
instructions: Place rice in a large bowl and cover with hot water. Let stand 3 minutes. Drain, rinse and place in a large bowl. Cut 2 cm from the top just below the bottom of the rice. Bring a medium pan of water to the boil. Place the rice, harissa and orange zest in a saucepan and reduce heat to low. Cook, uncovered, for 12 - 15 minutes. Cook rice for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Place onions in a large serving bowl. Cover with the rice and onions, then stir in 1/4 tsp of the salt. Let stand for 5 minutes or until onions become slightly soft.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,cornmeal,fenugreek seed,purpose flour,hot paprika,onion flake
title: Baked Polenta
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornmeal | 1 cup coarsely ground polenta or 1 cup polenta | 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped pitted kalamata olive | 1 teaspoon hot paprika or 1 teaspoon paprika powder | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds, crushed
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the cornmeal and polenta. Stir in onion, olives, paprika, fenugreek, and kosher salt and pepper to taste. Spread in a greased 8x4 baking pan.

title: Mandarin Scented Butter
ingredients: 1 jar mandarin oranges, drained and diced | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Combine orange, parsley, and honey in mixing bowl and beat until smooth. If using canned mandarin oranges, drain in a sieve and rinse well. Store in refrigerator in covered container. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Danish Turkey Dogs
ingredients: 2 cups chopped cooked turkey | 1 pound dates, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and arrange the turkey dogs on top. Sprinkle the dates over the top, and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven until all of the food is hot, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: oregano,green olive,fennel bulb,chicken breast fillet,sauce,beef tenderloin,chicken wing,irish cream
title: Beef Rolls With Spicy Chicken Sauce
ingredients: 350 g beef tenderloin or 350 g sirloin steaks | 2 chicken wings, split | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard greens ( optional ) | 1/4 cup a.1. original sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons sauerkraut spice mushrooms with garlic ( available at asian food shops or ethnic supermarkets ) | 12 green olives, halved | 2 teaspoons hot sauce ( or more )
instructions: Dry fry chicken wings in wok or fry pan until brown and cooked through. Remove and keep warm. Stir fry mushrooms, add extra oil. Add hot sauce and sauerkraut. Cook for 2 minutes. Add vegetables and heat through. Add cooked pork and cook for 1 minute. Serve with rice and salad.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,cumin powder,kamaboko,cayenne powder,navy bean,mango chutney,celery
title: Chutney Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans navy beans, rinsed and drained | 4 cups beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 1 cup nido chutney | 1/2 teaspoon yellow cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne powder | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1 medium mango chutney ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin powder
instructions: Place navy beans in a large pot with 4 cups water. Add 3 cups water, beef bouillon cubes, nido, cumin, cayenne, and celery. Cover and simmer over low heat with offset lid for 20 minutes. Uncover and cook over medium high heat for about 20 more minutes until thickened. Serve hot, with mango chutney and sliced ripe mango.

Random Ingredients: steak,coriander seed,cardamom seed,tapioca,onion soup mix,pinto bean,kosher salt
title: Beef and Bean Crock Pot Pilaf
ingredients: 2 lbs round steaks, cut into 1 x 1/2 in. size pieces | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed with water, drained | 1 can condensed onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon kosher salt ( to taste ) | 3 cups tapioca
instructions: Place roast and other ingredients in crock pot. Cook on low for 5 - 6 hours or on high for 3 1/2 hours. Stir in tapioca, and cook an additional 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Queso Dip
ingredients: 4 lbs hamburger | 1 can condensed tomato and green chilies
instructions: Cut hamburger into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Combine all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,coffee,cream tartar,beef tenderloin roast,tomato green chile pepper,italian breadcrumb,mexican corn,grain rice
title: Mexican-Style Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 lbs beef tenderloin roast | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, undrained | 3/4 cup mexican blend cheese with cheddar cheese blend, cubed | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup tamari | 1 tablespoon instant coffee or 1 tablespoon brewed tea | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 1/2 cups uncooked long grain rice or 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice | 1 small sweet green pepper, chopped
instructions: Place roast in slow cooker. Mix remaining ingredients together in large bowl. Pour over roast.

Random Ingredients: black olive,vegetable oil,chicken thigh,pimiento,white onion,beef tenderloin
title: Brazilian Chicken
ingredients: 6 beef tenderloin, pounded 1/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons sliced white onions | 1 jar pimentos, drained and chopped | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 1 can chicken thighs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Wrap chicken in aluminum foil. Place on rack in middle of oven. Bake, turning once, for 1 hour. Remove foil, increase oven temperature to 400 degrees f. Continue roasting 25 minutes more, or until chicken juices run clear when thigh is pierced with tip. Remove chicken from oven. Cool. When cool, slice into 1/4 inch strips. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in onions.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,paprika,soymilk,ice water,plum,yellow bell pepper,grain rice
title: Baked Rice Pilaf (21 Day Wonder Diet:day 1)
ingredients: 500 g long grain rice | 15 ml tomato sauce | 200 ml soymilk | 1/2 teaspoon paprika ( for color ) or 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika ( for color ) | 2 tablespoons light soymilk | 2 teaspoons ice water | 1 tablespoon plum ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon kalamata olive ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c. Place the rice, tomato sauce, soy milk, paprika/paprika mix and water into a blender and blend just until combined, about 30 seconds. Press rice onto a baking tray lined with paper to cool. Pour into an ovenproof dish and bake until a light crust has formed. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Uncover and scatter some olives over.

title: Mari's Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 lb rice, rinsed and shaken dry | 1/4 cup mexican oregano, crushed | 4 -5 fresh sage leaves, crushed | 5 -6 cardamom seeds, crushed | 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup real vanilla
instructions: Place rice in bowl with a good shake of spices, oregano, sage, parsley, and a little vanilla. Drain off excess liquid. If rice looks moist, add a little more of any dry herbs. Mix rice together, making sure to wash hands off each clumping. If rice has a lot of liquid, rinse in another bowl with lots of water. Heat a small pan and dry fry rice until crispy on either side. Do this until all of it is crispy.

title: Hawaiian Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing beef or 1 lb skirt steak | 1 can chicken or beef broth | 1 cup chunk pineapple chunks | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 4 -6 pepperoncini peppers, chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup chopped scallion ( optional )
instructions: Cut meat into 1 cubes.

title: Pears With Banana & Pear Slices
ingredients: 2 medium pears ( or 3 medium ) | 2 bananas, sliced
instructions: Preheat your grill. Brush one side of each slice with olive oil. Cut crosswise into slices about 2 inches thick and then slice crosswise again to create small, thin slices that can then be placed on grill over medium high heat. Cook for about five minutes on each side, or until they are a nice golden brown and crisp and look gorgeous on the outside.

title: Wild Mushroom Pinwheels
ingredients: 2 cups portabella mushrooms, shredded | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix the chopped mushrooms with the crumbs. Slice into thin strips and set aside. Lightly oil a baking sheet with cooking spray and lightly spray with cooking spray. Pour a small amount of the mushroom mixture into the middle of the tortilla. Roll up and place seam side down onto the baking sheet. Repeat until all the tortillas are stuffed and arranged in the baking pan. Spray tops with cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until browned and bubbly, about 20 minutes.

title: Jungle Rascals
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons red thai sweet chili peppers, diced | 400 g raspberries, sliced | 1 pears or 1 orange rind, peeled and sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat and stir fry the chiles and orange rind, stirring well, for 3 to 5 minutes, or until fragrant. Add the sliced pears and strawberries and cook for 2 minutes, or until the strawberries pop and the pears are tender. Serve with rice, noodles or as a main course with bread, custard or with sweet chutney.

title: Oriental Phyllo Bites
ingredients: 8 phyllo pastry sheets | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 cup minced apples ( optional ) | 1 package french baguettes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. To make filling, mix the soy sauce and minced apples then set aside. Slice the baguette into 8 equal squares. Cover each square of bread and fill with a little of the filling, pressing down to flatten. Cut a slit on each corner of the bread with a sharp knife and lay flat on a greased cookie sheet. Brush with soy sauce mixture. Bake for 20 minutes, then take phyllo off the foil and lay flat until gone. Top with your favorite oriental sauces and more.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,pistachio,cashew,tamari,brown lentil,extra sharp cheddar cheese,chili paste,white flour
title: Vegan Cheddar Lentil Spread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sambal chili paste ( i use a red hot chile ) | 4 teaspoons extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup cashews, roasted, lightly flaked | 1/4 cup unsalted pistachios or 1/4 cup unsalted peanuts, finely chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons light ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon tamari ( i use low-sodium soy sauce and it works great ) or 1 tablespoon vegan soy sauce ( i use low-sodium soy sauce and it works great ) | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 cup brown lentil, rinsed and picked
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking tray with silpat, parchment paper or baking parchment, which will be easier to work with if it is directly on you, if it is on the baking tray. In a bowl, stir together the sambal chili paste, cheddar cheese, nuts, ricotta, tamari or vegan soy sauce and flour until well combined. Firmly press two heaping tablespoons on the prepared baking tray, leaving space for spreading. Spread lentils over the top. Bake in center of oven for 25 minutes or until the lentils begin to turn dark brown, bubbling and starting to turn slightly crunchy. Let cool. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,worcestershire sauce,balsamic vinegar,serrano chilies,straw mushroom,oyster sauce,lamb
title: Spicy Lamb Satay
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb, lean | 2 tablespoons fresh minced garlic | 2 serrano chilies, sliced | 1 ounce fresh oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: In a bowl mix together the ground lamb, minced garlic, sliced serrano chili, oyster sauce, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar and worcestershire sauce. Soak in the fridge overnight. Drain and place on skewers. Broil for five minutes or until cooked through.

title: Hot Olive Bread
ingredients: 1 package fast rising yeast ( one package ) | 1 1/2 cups ice water | 1 can rotel ( drained ) | 12 pitted kalamata olives
instructions: Mix yeast with water. Let stand 5 minutes. Add rotel, olives, and rest of ingredients. Beat with mixer until smooth. Put into a lightly greased 9x5 inch loaf pan and place in freezer. When bread is almost frozen, thaw in fridge and remove from pan. Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Legs with Port Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans chicken leg quarters, drained | 2 cups dry port wine
instructions: Pat chicken dry. Cover chicken legs with port and place in a 12 inch saute pan. Bring the wine to boil, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until chicken is tender. Transfer chicken and any accumulated juices to a shallow baking pan.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,kielbasa,beef marrow,sun tomato oil,tomatillo,orange peel,pepperoncini pepper
title: Kielbasa - Polish Goulash
ingredients: 5 fresh tomatillos ( husks removed ) | 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 3/4 lb kielbasa, diced 1/2 inch slices | 1 orange peel, very small dice | 2 tablespoons hot pepperoncini peppers ( optional ) | sea salt or kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 1 pinch sea salt
instructions: First, prepare the tomatoes. Cut off and dry as much as possible of the stem ends. Cut out the tough stem with a vegetable peeler or other knife that has a dull appearance. Cut off the hard center, leaving just a little bit of the tapeiness to expose the seeds. Fill a pot with a 3/4 cup water and bring to a boil. Place the tomatillos and sun dried tomatoes in the boiling water for about 5 minutes. Drain and cool for a few minutes, then squeeze out any excess water. Cut the kielbasa into rounds and place in a medium bowl. Add the orange peel, hot peppers, and sun dried tomatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Mix well, adjust the seasoning, and set aside to marinate at least 30 minutes and up to 4 hours at room temperature. After making the goulash, bring the sauce back to a bubble and pour over the kielbasa mixture in a small slow stream. Stir gently to ensure the flavors meld.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,coconut,snow pea,provolone cheese
title: Coconut Snowed Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 cup snow peas | 2 1/2 ounces diced smoked provolone cheese or 2 1/2 ounces mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup grated coconut | extra virgin olive oil, for drizzling
instructions: Steam the peas and snow peas until crisp tender. Cool then cut in half or thirds and place in a salad bowl. Place cheese in a small bowl. Drain the peas and snow peas. Add the coconut and olive oil to the cooked peas and pepper and stir to blend. Serve warm.

title: Southern Sausage
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare a large skillet or baking sheet with vegetable oil spray. Heat skillet over medium high heat. Place sausage in the prepared pan. Cook and stir sausage and kielbasa in hot oil for 6 minutes, or until sausage and kielbasa are browned and the edges are slightly firm. Turn sausage and kielbasa with a spatula.

title: Italian-style Chopped Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch chicory lettuce, washed and dried
instructions: Chop chicory lettuce and place in a bowl. Sprinkle with dry red pepper flakes. Chill and serve.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,strawberry,sugar,wheat flour,spanish onion,saffron thread,orange zest,rice flour
title: Tortillas
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice flour | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1 teaspoon orange zest, zest grated | 1 cup mixed spanish onion, finely diced | 1 cup strawberry, sliced | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Combine flours, brown sugar, saffron thread, and orange zest in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: spiral pasta,granny smith apple,sirloin,date,cherry tomato,garam masala,vanilla extract
title: Spiral Mac and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 16 ounces spiral shaped pasta | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, cut in half ( optional ) | 2 stalks granny smith apples, thinly sliced | 8 ounces canned dates, drained and chopped | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
instructions: Prepare spiral, cook and drain beef to taste in a large skillet over medium high heat. Meanwhile, cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente. Drain pasta. In a large bowl, mix together beef, tomatoes, apples, and dates with warm cooked pasta, spices, and puree. Garnish with sesame seeds, if desired.

title: Salmon Frikadeller
ingredients: 300 g salmon fillets, skinned and diced small | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 25 g plain flour | 1 teaspoon ground celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 lime | 25 g ladyfingers, split in half
instructions: Put fish and tomato paste in a large bowl. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and leave to marinate for 30 minutes or up to 2 hours. Drain salmon and discard marinade. Place flour, celery seed and nutmeg into a grinder, and process to a paste. Squeeze lime juice into mixture. Preheat oven to 180°c. Place bread, cut side up, on a clean surface. Roll out the mixture into a 14cm circle. Transfer onto the bread, ensuring that it covers the whole surface. Arrange on a baking trays and bake 40 minutes until firm. Allow to rest 10 minutes before carefully unmolding onto serving plated plates.

title: Italian Scallops
ingredients: 4 links mild italian sausage | 32 sea scallops | bell pepper ( green or red ) | barbecue sauce
instructions: In a large cast iron skillet, brown the sausages over medium high heat, 3 - 4 minutes each side. Drain off. Cover a platter with foil and return skillet to stove. Add the scallops and cook over medium high heat 2 - 3 minutes per side or until just done and slightly toasted. Add the bell pepper and cook 1 minute longer. Serve with your favourite barbecue sauce.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,cumin,cream mushroom soup,button mushroom,walnut,cooking spray,baby carrot,heavy duty aluminum foil
title: Lumpia Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | cooking spray | 1 pound fresh baby carrots, shredded | 1/2 pound fresh button mushrooms, sliced | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup heavy-duty aluminum foil | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 tablespoons finely chopped walnuts, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Beat flour in a bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir shredded carrots, mushrooms, and soup into carrot mixture. Pour filling into prepared baking dish. Top filling with foil, and sprinkle cumin and nuts on top. Bake in the preheated oven until filling is hot and bubbling, 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Pesto Bruschetta
ingredients: 1/2 lb basil pesto | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: Mix all ingredients with a food processor until well blended. Form into round balls that are about 1/3 inches in diameter. Place on baking sheet and toast under broiler until golden.

title: Gran-Gran Crumbs With Gere Thicks (Gran Flour Mix)
ingredients: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 3/4 cup plain brandy
instructions: Mix the graham cracker crumbs and brandy together in a mixing bowl. Add the crumb mixture to the crumb mix and mix until dough is evenly smooth. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured board, cover and rest in a cool spot for one hour. Turn dough out onto floured board and fluff with a fork. Dust hands with graham cracker crumbs. Roll crumbs into balls a little larger than a golf ball and make sure you roll them all the way to the bowl you'll be coating them with cracker crumbs. Let the balls rest for a few minutes, then gently roll them in the graham cracker crumbs until coated all over. Heat a cast iron or griddle over medium high heat until a bead of water bounces off. Fry the graham crackers in batches until golden brown. Allow them to cool before eating.

title: Scotch Bonnet Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 -3 scotch bonnet peppers ( depending on the heat level of the fire ) | 2 ounces cheddar cheese | 1 pinch red hot chile or hot scotch bonnet pepper, minced to a paste
instructions: Cut the peppers in half lengthwise and then slice them lengthwise into about ¾ inch dice. Place the diced peppers in a frying pan and pour enough water to cover the peppers. Bring the water to a boil over medium heat and simmer for a couple of minutes. Drain the peppers and blot them dry with a paper towel. Transfer the peppers into a small bowl and mash them with a fork until they're all creamy. In a large non stick skillet over medium high heat, toss the peppers with the scotch bonnet pepper paste. When the peppers are about half cooked, add the cheddar cheese to the top. When the cheese is browned and bubbly, transfer to plates.

title: Homemade Quark
ingredients: 300 g quark | lemon juice, and zest of | pleman's mustard
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender. Blend, taste and adjust seasoning if desired and put in a freezer bag or container and allow to thaw overnight or for 8 to 12 hours.

title: Chipotle Mustard
ingredients: 100 g flour ( bread flour or baking powder ) | 1 teaspoon chipotle chile, ground and chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon coarse grain dijon mustard
instructions: Stir the flour with the chilies if using. Add mustard and mix well. Add water if needed. Turn to the side of the bowl, wrap in plastic wrap and leave in the fridge overnight to air dry. You can leave this overnight, or leave as is, but it's not necessary. The next day, heat oven to 400°f. Use a teaspoon to make small holes about 1/4cm deep. Spread mustard on top of dough and leave for 10 minutes. Take off foil and place bread on baking tray. Slash top of bread with a sharp knife and bake for about 15 - 20 minutes until crust darkens and is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tuna,onion soup mix,tomatillo,nonfat cream,lemon pepper seasoning,kumara
title: Low Fat Tomatillo, Onion-Tuna-Kumara Sausages
ingredients: 1 large kumara, peeled sliced into 20 slices ( sweet potato will also work, too ) | 1 can organic tuna ( drained and flaked ) | 1 package onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning | 4 large fresh tomatillos, stemmed and halved or ( 6 ounce ) package frozen chopped onions | 1/3 cup nonfat sour cream, for topping ( optional ) or 1/3 cup reduced fat sour cream ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray lightly with oil. In a small bowl, mash up the tuna and onion soup mix thoroughly. Spread the kumera on the baking sheet and bake at 350ºf for 25 minutes. While the kumera is baking, toast the tomatillo slices in a dry frying pan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the kumera is lightly browned and beginning to soften, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. When the kumera is cool enough to handle, roughly chop it. Stir in the tuna mixture, lemon pepper and the diced tomatillos. Spread the mixture on the kumera and serve.

title: Bread Machine Swedish Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups butter or margarine, melted | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 3 - 3 1/2 cups ( see note in description ) | 2 packages good strong turkey sausage ( can be bought from specialty italian foods shops )
instructions: Place ingredients in pan according to manufacturer's directions.

title: Beet & Mango Burger
ingredients: 1 beef oxtail | 1/4 mango, sliced | 1/4 red food coloring, your favourite colour ( optional to taste ) | 1/3 cup parmigiano, shaved | 3 -4 dried beets ( optional )
instructions: Cut the meat into 2 inch chunks and place in a saucepan. Pour over the mango, red food colouring and 2 tbsps of the shaved parmigiano. Cover and bring to the boil, then lower to simmer for about 1 1/2 hours or until the meat is very tender. Remove the meat to a cutting board or use a slotted spoon and shred meat with your fingers. Return the meat to the pan. Add more red food colouring if desired. Mash the beets coarsely. Add them to the beets with any extra liquid and give them a stir to heat them through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,red chile,balsamic vinegar,roast beef,breadcrumb,corn chip,bacon
title: Beef Balsamic Bites
ingredients: 3/4 cup fresh breadcrumb | 1 teaspoon peanut oil | 1 red chile, halved, deseeded and finely chopped | 100 g bacon, rind and fat removed, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups shredded roast beef | 3/4 cup corn chips, coarsely crushed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 °c or 170 °c if fan forced. Place the breadcrumbs in a shallow bowl. Add the peanut oil and chilli and toss to combine. Set aside. Heat the bacon fat to smoking point in a large frying pan, add the shredded beef, cover and cook over a moderately high heat for 3 - 5 minutes until the beef is tender. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the beef to a baking dish and leave to cool slightly. Whisk together the cornflour with 1/3 cup water and pour into the pan and cook over a high heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until the mixture boils and thickens. Turn off the heat and stir in the fried beef and chip crumbs to coat the well. Spoon mixture into paper lined trays and cool to room temperature.

title: Oriental Seasoning, Salt and Spice  (Soya Nuts)
ingredients: 150 g yellow onions | 1 teaspoon soya sauce | 1 teaspoon coarse kosher salt or 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt
instructions: Cut the ends off the onion and peel off the outer layer. Slice the white part very thinly. Place the onions in a bowl of salt and lime juice to cover. Place them in the refrigerator to cool for 24 hours, but do not remove them. The key to good sushi is in sealing them properly and tasting. You can also do this with a zester to make sure the slices have been ground and the juice is extracted. You can do this by pulsing a mortar and pestle in a pound of flour to obtain a fine paste. In a small bowl add 1 teaspoon of salt, 2 teaspoons of soy sauce. Coat a very fine saute pan with very little olive oil and add 1 tablespoon of the sesame oil. A heavy cast iron pan will work, especially if you are using a heavy saucepan. When the pan becomes dry add the other 1 teaspoon of soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Let it bubble for a few minutes and then add the white part of the onion. Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt to the onion, mix well. Add about 1 teaspoon of sesame oil to the onion mixture. It's important to mix well and not to mash the onions, but to add all of them well together. Serve with rice, or eat them as an appetizer.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,rye bread,walnut,five spice powder,tea,belgian endive
title: Roasted Endive with Apricot Whiskey Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared apricot preserves | 4 drops 100 % five-spice powder, or to taste | 8 cups chopped fresh endive | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons brewed brewed tea | 12 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line the bottom of a roasting pan with slices of rye bread, toasted side up. Place each slice of rye bread on a cookie sheet. Spread apricot preserves over the bread. Sprinkle five-spice powder over the preserves and herbs. Top with the endive and chopped nuts. Bake in the preheated oven until the filling is lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mango,sharp cheddar cheese,dijon mustard,lemon juice zest
title: The Best Cheddar and Mango Quesadilla - Really!
ingredients: 4 large mangoes, peeled and sliced into thin rounds ( i use sweet potatoes ) | 4 tablespoons dijon mustard ( can also use spicy if desired ) | 4 tablespoons lemon juice ( about one lemon ) | 1/4 lb sharp cheddar cheese, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat your quesadillas. Using a vegetable peeler or sharp paring knife, remove slices of mango from plastic wrap, then slice into bite sized chunks, then add to a small bowl. Drizzle 1 t of dijon mustard onto the mango chunks, and then top with 1 t more of dijon according to your choice. Toss the contents of the bowl together with your hands into a thinish paste. Spread the mixture onto one side of your quesadilla, then top with slices of cheese. Place the quesadilla on a cookie sheet or parchment lined tray and let dry at room temperature for 30min, then cut into 1 pieces and serve.

title: Chile-Lime Barley Bread
ingredients: 1 box pearl barley | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro | 1/2 orange, zest of | 1 lime, zest of | 8 eggs | lime wedge
instructions: Bake barley at 375 degrees for 30 minutes. Allow to cool, then break into manageable pieces. Place barley in blender or food processor until pulverized. Add cilantro, orange peel & lime zest. Add eggs & mix well. Pour into 8 x 4 x 2 inch cake tin or loaf pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Figs and Yogurt With Meat
ingredients: 1/2 cup skim milk | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon plain fat-free yogurt | 2 fresh figs, stems removed | freshly ground nut, of your choice ( optional )
instructions: Mix the yogurt with your grinder's pestle and serve with the figs.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,banana,catsup,sauce,greek olive,mace,green food coloring,garlic salt
title: Bananas Ghana BBQ
ingredients: 3 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons sauce | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 teaspoon a.1. original sauce | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1 package frozen banana, thawed and sliced | 2 green food coloring
instructions: Combine all sauce ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Place banana slices on a greased grill, and brush with sauce. Grill baste with reserved sauce for 3 - 5 minutes per side, or until golden and just tender. Sprinkle additional sauce on top if desired.

title: Cardamom Marmalade
ingredients: 2 cups orange marmalade | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 cup powdered sugar | 1 cup light cream or 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: In a large bowl stir the cardamom, sugar and cream together until well mixed. Slowly stir in the orange marmalade/orange juice. Let stand 10 minutes. Stir in the cardamom/ginger mixture. Will store for 3 days covered in a refrigerator. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,russet potato,ball mozzarella cheese bocconcini,chocolate syrup,tart apple,andouille sausage
title: Andouille Potato Pizza #5FIX
ingredients: 8 frozen balls of mozzarella cheese ( two 1-pound bocconcini rolls ) or 8 frozen cheese ravioli ( one 1-pound bocconcini rolls ) | 12 slices andouille sausages, cut diagonally into thick slices | 4 small russet potatoes, diced | 1 cup sliced andouille sausage, chopped | 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 2 medium tart apples, thickly sliced | 1 head romaine lettuce or 1 head napa cabbage, cored and cut into thin strips, separated into leaves
instructions: Place frozen dough on a work surface and stretch the dough, making each pizza 3 inches wide and 2 inches wide. Place 3 mozzarella cheese slices on each dough. Roll each dough wedge in cheese. Place, 1 from the center of each side, anouille sausage over each dough half, pressing the edges to make the mozzarella sandwiches. Place the potato slices on 2 ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes. Place 1/2 teaspoon of chopped sausage over each potato. Spoon equal amounts of chocolate syrup over sausage. Sprinkle with remaining sausage. Top each pizza with 2 slices of apples. Top with 2 strips of romaine. Cook at 375 degrees f for 5 to 7 minutes or until the potato topping is just starting to brown. Remove from the oven and serve.

title: Grilled Irish Sausages with Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bourbon whiskey | 1 package sausages | 2/3 cup light cream or 2/3 cup half-and-half | 2/3 cup half-and-half | 2 tablespoons chopped cremini mushrooms ( or 1 green or red mushrooms ) | 1 tablespoon chopped leeks | 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes, to coat casings
instructions: Heat grill to medium setting. Brush sausages with bourbon and grill for 8 to 10 minutes. Turn and brush tops with cream. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes longer or until browned and cooked through. Meanwhile, in large bowl, combine mushrooms, leeks, and crumbled cornflake. Toss with portabello and serve.

title: Linguine With Parsley
ingredients: 6 ounces linguine | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, about 8 minutes. Drain pasta in a colander, return to the pot, and toss with parsley. Serve.

title: Simple Vietnamese Fish Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate to allow flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,ginger root,wasabi powder,chicken drumstick,celery rib,chickpea
title: Wasabi Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken drumsticks, cut into bite-size pieces | 1 can chickpeas | 1/4 cup wasabi powder | 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger root | 2 celery ribs, chopped | garlic salt to taste
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source. Place the chicken drumsticks, cover with aluminum foil, and place under the broiler. Broil the drumsticks until their skin has puffed and turned black, 5 to 8 minutes. Move the chicken legs to a slow cooker, pour chickpeas into the slow cooker, and set aside. Scrape the browned skin off of the chicken legs and discard any loose skin fragments. Cut each chicken legs into 4 pieces, and set aside. Mix the wasabi powder and ginger in a separate bowl.

title: Baked Mushrooms on One-Pot Mac N Cheese
ingredients: 1 package button mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 - 3/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly butter a nonstick skillet or baking sheet. Place mushrooms on the cookie sheet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper, and then evenly distribute guacamole on them. Bake in preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until cheese is browned on the edges.

title: Spicy Coconut Water Chestnuts or Fish in Shell
ingredients: 1 bag frozen wood ears or ( 28 ounce ) bag sweet wood chestnut sticks, unwrapped
instructions: Place wood pieces in a deep skillet over medium heat, with enough water to cover the bottom only. Keep an eye on them. Turn often as water can suddenly boil over and cook for about 5 minutes, turning once to stir water to prevent burning. You want them to be well cooked but still brightly colored. Drain on paper towels. When done drain can on paper towels, keep warm in low oven until ready to serve. I prefer the oven set to 300 degrees f, while my mom uses the broiler setting, which will take 30 seconds to complete the boiling process. You may want to put the wood chestnuts under the broiler to toast them, because they'll get soggy. I like to put some on top of each piece, but you can broil them in the oven if you want.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,mango,red pepper flake,anise seed,dark sesame oil,kirsch
title: Sweet Onion and Mango Kremolade
ingredients: 1 large sweet onion | 3 large ripe mangoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons kirsch | 3 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 dash red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cut about a quarter and core mangoes. Scoop out the insides and discard any excess seeds. With a sharp knife, cut slits all around the edge of the mangoes to allow a 1/4 inch slit to open. Remove all seeds under broiler. You can use a melon baller or a mortar and pestle or knife to break the fruit into small pieces. If you have a peeler, peel off just the outer layer of peelment and set the fruit aside. Remove the membrane from the mangoes by scraping off all the pulp with a spoon. Cut onion into quarters and place them in a baking dish. Drizzle liberally with the sesame oil, a few drops of red pepper flakes and kosher salt. Bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until browned and caramelized. Remove from oven and pour mango chunks on top of mango. Place in a plastic freezer bag and close the bag.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,russet potato,potato gnocchi,shrimp meat,white vinegar,pancetta,tomato paste
title: Gnocchi With Shrimp
ingredients: 5 large russet potatoes, peeled and cubed 1 inch | 1 cup canned vegetable broth | 2 3/4 cups medium-sized russet potato gnocchi | 4 slices pancetta, minced | 1/4 lb shrimp meat | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Cook potatoes in vegetable broth 10 to 15 minutes or until tender. While potatoes are cooking, cook gnocchi according to package directions. Meanwhile, drain gnocchi and place in a large mixing bowl, add shrimp and mix lightly. Toss cooked gnocchi mixture with pancetta and shrimp and add to bowls. For garlic flavoring, combine in a small bowl the garlic, vinegar, and vegetable broth and blend into potato mixture. For extra spice, combine shrimp, tomato paste, and shrimp broth.

title: Spaghetti and Apple Fettuccine
ingredients: 8 ounces dry fettuccine pasta | 2 large tart apples - peeled, cored, and sliced | 1 teaspoon ginger root, minced | 1 can stewed tomatoes
instructions: In a saucepan bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente. Drain. Meanwhile, saute the apples in a skillet with a little water over medium heat, stirring often, until tender. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: margarine,whipping cream,grain mustard,green olive,yukon gold potato,salt pork,squid
title: Grilled Stuffed Squids (Bunuelos)
ingredients: 1 lb white or yellow yukon gold potato | 1 lb small squid, cleaned and tentacles cut out | 1 lb salt pork, diced ( can use ham ) | 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 1 bunch green olives, chopped | 1 cup whipping cream | margarine or butter ( for greasing cooking dish )
instructions: Wash and peel the potatoes, scrub them thoroughly, and cut them into 1/2 inch slices. Cook the potatoes in boiling water with salt pork for about 7 minutes. Drain thoroughly and then arrange in an 8 square pan. Add the olives. Cut the salt pork into 1/4 inch pieces. Add to the potato olives. Stir in the cream. Add the mustard, green olives. Spoon mixture on top of the squid so that it covers the inside. Cook in a 350f oven for 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Chipotle Ziti in a Snap
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta or 1 lb penne pasta | 2 cups cottage cheese or 2 cups other salad cheese | 1 can sliced blackberries or ( 10 ounce ) can lemon curd | 1 small cauliflower, broken into small florets | 1 medium seedless summer squash or 1 small zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced | 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo, drained and minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin | 3/4 cup water
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain in a colander over a bowl and immediately immerse in ice cold water until cold. Pat dry with paper towels, cover and set aside. Meanwhile, prepare ziti as instructed on package, omitting salt and fat. Drain well. Meanwhile, in food processor, combine cottage cheese with the blackberries, cauliflower, squash, chipotle and cumin. Pulse until smooth, about 10 seconds. In a 3 - 5 quart saucepan combine the vinaigrette ingredients and hot pepper sauce. Pour over the ziti and toss well. Cover and marinate at room temperature or refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Serve with additional vinaigrette.

title: Egg Drop Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups egg substitute | 1/2 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Mix egg substitute with peppers. Dip bread into egg mixture and fry in pan until crisp.

title: Rigatoni With Watermelon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh watermelon, cubed | 16 ounces rigatoni pasta, freshly cooked
instructions: Dice watermelon and place into a large bowl. Add rigatoni and toss to coat. Add extra water, 1/2 cup at a time, tossing gently in bowl. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.

title: Easy "raisin" English Peas
ingredients: 1 lb frozen peas ( or more ) or 1 lb defrosted frozen peas | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds, crushed | 1 garlic salt ( or 2 cloves crushed fresh garlic )
instructions: Fry frozen peas/mushrooms in a bit of oil. Add dried fenugreek seeds and garlic salt. Once peas are done, transfer to casserole dish and add cooked mushrooms/vegetables. Serve with rice.

title: Cranberry-Crushed Citrus Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 cup orange-flavored liqueur, such as cointreau | 1 cup fresh cranberry juice
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and cook and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add orange liqueur and cranberry juice. Bring the mixture to a boil.

title: Coconut Feta Yogurt
ingredients: 400 g walnuts | 600 ml coconut milk ( or a good quality full cream to ensure nut flavour ) | 15 g dried sage
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f. Place walnuts and coconut milk in a food processor and blend/blend well until the texture is of fine paste. Take walnut mixture out of the food processor and transfer to an oven dish with a baking tray measuring around 20x30cm. Top with sage and bake in centre of oven for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring now and then until golden. Cool slightly and serve as a spread after dinner, or with pitta bread triangles, fritters or any tasty breakfast nibbles for a heartier meal. This can be served chilled or warmed right away as the flavours improve together.

Random Ingredients: cooking wine,graham cracker crumb,lime wedge,methi seed,seasoning salt
title: Quick and Easy Lime Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking wine | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon maita seeds | 1 pinch maggi seasoning salt or 1 pinch regular salt | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients.

title: Swedish Smoked Haus
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger, ground round | 1 package frozen topping, thawed | salt and beef, if any
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°f. Combine all ingredients together to form 2 patties. Place patties into casserole dish. Spice with crackers, or sprinkle with grated cheese when cold.

Random Ingredients: single cream,crescent dinner,hard egg,rice noodle,coconut extract,corn oil
title: Rice Noodles with Coconut-Crurd Sauce
ingredients: 1 package crescent dinner rolls | corn oil | 1 tablespoon rice noodles | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 cup single cream | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 3 hard-cooked eggs, sliced
instructions: Heat one tablespoon of corn oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry and stir the rice noodles until golden, 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Homemade Vinegar
ingredients: 6 tablespoons vinegar or 6 tablespoons white vinegar | 3 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Whisk together in a small bowl the vinegar and lemon juice and let stand until coolened to the point of hot coffee or tea. Store in a cool, dry place.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,italian bread,sugar substitute,beef sirloin,lima bean,stew meat,margarine
title: Slow Cooker Beef With Lima Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, cubed | 1 cup lima beans ( fresh, frozen, or canned would be fine. ) | 1/2 cup margarine | 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar substitute | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 loaf crusty italian bread, cubed | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar substitute
instructions: Put everything in the crock pot except the bread. Mix well. Cover and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours. Remove the cover and stir in the bread. Cover and cook a few minutes longer. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Sausage and Vegetables Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb raw roast beef, chopped | 1 lb potato, diced | 1 lb carrot, diced | 1 lb turnip, diced | 1/2 lb russet potato, diced | nonfat plain yogurt, to serve | tostadas, to serve
instructions: Place the chopped meat in the slow cooker. Add the potatoes, carrots, turnips, parsnips, and russet potatoes. Pour any remaining water over the ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Top with yogurt just before serving, to serve.

title: Dills Ham Wrapped in
ingredients: 1/4 lb ham | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: Cut the ham into 1/4 inch slices, then slice the slices thickly. Place two slices of ham at one end of each piece of ham. Roll up each ham roll tightly and tie with kitchen string. Place in a shallow roasting pan. Bake at 325 for 45 minutes. Add chopped dill when serving.

Random Ingredients: green onion,butternut squash,graham cracker crumb,cannellini bean
title: Butternut Squash and Cannellini Bean Crumbs Rummil
ingredients: 1 package dried cannellini beans, rinsed and drained ( may use canned beans ) | 1 green onion, finely chopped | 1 cup butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, divided
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup of graham cracker crumbs in a large mixing bowl and mix thoroughly. Transfer to a greased 9 inch loaf pan and top with remaining 1/2 cup of graham cracker crumbs. Bake in a 350° oven for about 35 minutes, or until lightly browned. Cool and store in a tightly covered container for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: rum,kosher salt,cucumber,malt vinegar,tomato green chilies,chicken breast half,basil
title: Grilled Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup light rum | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 teaspoons malt vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil | 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into thin strips | 2 tomatoes, diced
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together cucumber, rum, salt, vinegar and basil. Grill chicken until no longer pink and juices run clear. Arrange chicken on top and drizzle with tomato.

title: Fancy Italian Grilled Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread crumbs | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix bread crumbs and frozen whipped topping together in a bowl. Separate 1 loaf of the frozen loaf from the loaf and roll the loaf in the crumb mixture to coat. Place loaf in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, checking to make sure it remains moist. You may insert foil into the loaf if it's getting too brown.

Random Ingredients: italian cheese,plum tomato,parsley,cocoa,french bread,fast rising yeast,squash,asafoetida powder
title: Calcutta Style Swiss Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 package fast rising yeast | 1 cup shredded italian cheese blend | 1 cup cubed french bread | 1 squash, diced | 4 plum tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Boil the squash in a small amount of salted water for about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, crumble the italian cheese blend into a bowl. Add the cubed bread, the cubed squash and the tomatoes. Mix to blend together. Sprinkle the asafoetida over the top and mix everything with a spoon. Add the parsley and unsweetened cocoa stir well. Stir in 3 cups of the cheese mixture. Dump the mixture into a greased loaf pan and let rise until doubled. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Chef John's Weeknight Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups couscous | 2 tablespoons marsala wine | 3 1/2 cups light-colored green olives, drained | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 orange peel, zested | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon
instructions: Place couscous in a large bowl and fill with cold water. Swirl to remove any excess moisture. Cover dish and set aside to let it sit at least 30 minutes. When the couscous is done, transfer the couscous, olives, corn, orange peel, and tarragon to a pot. Over medium heat, bring the liquid to a boil and reduce by 1/ stir in the couscous. Continue cooking until the liquid is hot to the top, about 5 minutes.

title: Pecan Mushrooms
ingredients: 25 cremini mushrooms, stems removed | 1 cup finely chopped pecans | 1/2 cup crumbled dried pecan cereal, flakes or 1/2 cup coarsely ground coarsely | 1 -2 tablespoon crema or 1 -2 tablespoon creme fraiche
instructions: Combine the cremini mushrooms, finely chopped pecans and 1/2 cup pecan flakes in a mixing bowl. Toast the coarsely ground cereal flakes or spread evenly on a large plate, and press the cereal into the mixture with your hands until evenly spread, about 1 tsp per cube of nut mixture. Dip the cremini mushrooms in the crumb/coffee mixture to coat, then place them on a plate. Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium high heat. When sufficiently hot, carefully add the mushrooms and saute for 2 - 3 minutes. Add a little more crumb or coffee if needed.

Random Ingredients: tubetti pasta,red pepper flake,curry leaf,coconut,pork loin,avocado
title: Soupy Carnitas
ingredients: 1 small pork loin, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/3 cup diced avocado | 1/4 cup fresh coconut, finely ground | 2 tablespoons dry roasted red pepper flakes | 5 fresh curry leaves | 3/4 lb tubetti pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Using a heavy skillet cook pork in hot oil over medium high heat till nicely browned and crispy, stirring often. Remove pork from skillet and place in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan. Mix avocado and coconut in skillet. Spread coconut mixture on pork. Sprinkle with pepper flakes and curry leaves on top and place in oven, uncovered, just til hot thru, about 15 to 20 minutes. Stir. Meanwhile, cook capellini in pot of boiling water, just til al dente, about 5 to 9 minutes. Drain and toss with the pork mixture and serve.

title: Grilled Fish With Orange Guacamole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs firm white fish fillets, of 1-2 inches-thick ( i prefer red snapper ) | 1/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1 tablespoon fish stock | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce | 3 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons finely chopped peeled corn | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Mix orange juice, fish stock, and adobo sauce. Pour over fish in a wide shallow nonreactive bowl or dish. Marinate, covered, in the refrigerator 10 minutes. Preheat grill to medium hot. Remove fish from the dish and lightly oil the grill grates. Discard marinade. Divide half of the fish evenly amongst the skewers. Grill fish 8 - 10 minutes, turning once or twice, until fish flakes when pierced with a fork. When fish is done, remove from grill and place on a platter. Top with orange guacamole.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,flour tortilla,lemon,chicken broth,nutmeg,beef rib eye roast,penne pasta,fig
title: Crock Pot Easy Beef and Penne Pasta
ingredients: 1 lemon | 1 beef rib eye roast | 1 meaty hamburger or 1 pork tenderloin | 8 ounces penne pasta | 6 -12 ounces chicken broth | 10 -12 ounces dried figs, drained | 12 flour tortillas | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh grated nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f. In a large plastic mixing bowl, squeeze the juice of the lemon into the meat. Slice the lemon. Cut the meat in 1/2 inch slices. Rub the slices well throughout the meat. Place it in a plastic food storage bag. Combine the chicken broth and figs in crock pot. Add the drained spaghetti strips to the crock pot and set them on high for 30 minute. Slice the beef into thin strips, about 1/2 inch wide. Cut each strip into 3 strips across. Drain the pasta and add with the broth and figs. Cover and cook on high for 3 - 10 minute depending on what type of meat your using. Add the meat strips to the crock pot to reheat. Serve with freshly grated nutmeg, if desired.

title: Spinach with Currants
ingredients: 3 bunches baby spinach | 1 cup dried currants | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Soak currants in hot water to plump up. Wash and coarsely chop spinach leaves. In a large skillet or wok, stir fry spinach, currants and red pepper flakes in oil for 2 minutes, until spinach wilts. Serve with warm bread.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,prawn,tarragon vinegar,italian breadcrumb,malt vinegar,cardamom pod,raisin,pasta
title: Prawn Balls  (Shrimp Appitour)
ingredients: 250 g cooked peeled prawns | 250 g italian style breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon vinegar ( or sherry vinegar ) | 60 g raisins ( or sultanas ) | 125 ml malt vinegar | 125 ml apple cider | 125 ml toasted italian breadcrumbs
instructions: In a large bowl, stir the prawns with the bread cumper and season with seasoning. Shape the mixture into balls about the size of a walnut and chill for approximately 20 - 30 minutes, or until needed. Mix together the raisins and vinegar in a saucepan and stir in the raisins/vinegar mix. Add the bread crumbs and simmer gently until thickened, about 5 minutes. Add the prawns and chill for a further 2 - 3 minutes, or until just cooked through. Serve on an attractive platter or with warmed fresh tomato wedges.

title: Mango Breaded Appams
ingredients: 1 green mango - peeled, seeded, and grated | 3/4 cup dry bread crumbs
instructions: Combine mango with bread crumbs and roll mixture into 1 inch balls. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes in a skillet, or until tender.

title: Prawns with Chili, Chile & Oregano
ingredients: 400 g raw prawns, prawns peeled | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1 red chilies, crushed with a mortar and pestle
instructions: Remove tails from prawns and remove the heads and shells. Heat oil in a large frying pan or saucepan and add prawn pieces. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes and then add oregano and chilli and stir fry for 2 - 3 minutes until fragrant. Serve with wedges of lime and chutney.

title: Cauliflower With Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb cauliflower, cut into florets | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup cilantro stem, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place cauliflower in a large roasting pan, and spread with the chopped sun dried tomatoes, tossing to combine. Sprinkle with cilantro, and roast until tender, about 25 minutes.

title: Citrus Tofu Scramble
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, thawed | 2 jalapenos, seeded | white pepper to taste | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Place the tofu in a microwave safe dish with enough water to cover by 2 inches.

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts W- Cherry Tomatoes, Apples and Fruits.
ingredients: 4 slices chicken breasts, halved | 6 cherry tomatoes | 6 small warm apples
instructions: Grill your choice of chicken for 4 minutes on each side or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,cardamom pod,apple cider,swiss chard,leg lamb,green mango
title: Lamb Stewed in Green Mango Cream
ingredients: 4 lbs leg of lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 lbs swiss chard | 5 large green mangoes, peeled, pitted, diced | 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1 cup apple cider | ground cardamom pod, to color green ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the lamb in slow cooker, cover and cook on high for about five hours or until lamb is very tender. Remove lamb and reserve the juices in skillet. Stir mixture and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: port wine,butter bean,green olive,garlic powder,cream cheese,seasoning
title: Garlic White-Hot Butter & Olive Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb butter beans ( soaked for 24 hours ) | 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 1 tablespoon port wine ( white if you can find it ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil ( melted ) | 1 package cream cheese, room temperature | 3 tablespoons green olives, drained ( with black stems )
instructions: Drain the beans and rinse them really well in a sieve. Combine all ingridients in a bowl and mix well as you would your beans so they are uniform. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Best if made 24hrs or overnight.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,apricot jam,corn oil,baby spinach,spring onion,allspice
title: South African Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb baby spinach, washed | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 cups cooked apricot jam | 4 spring onions, cut in half | cayenne pepper | 2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Place the spring onions, a tsp of salt and cayenne pepper in a large salad bowl. Add the cooked spinach leaves and toss. Arrange the chopped apricot jam on top of the spinach mixture. Sprinkle over the allspice. Refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Tip, i think it just tastes better after sitting overnight and then chilling.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,egg yolk,shrimp,cool whip,carrot juice,sherry wine,italian parsley
title: Faux Elephant's Eyes #2
ingredients: 2 lbs raw shrimp, cleaned | 1/4 cup shredded carrot | 1/2 cup italian parsley, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 egg yolks, beaten | 1 package cool whip | 1/4 cup sherry wine, heated
instructions: Coat shrimp with olive oil. Place shrimp in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Sprinkle over shrimp. Cover and cover.

title: Mexican Chicken with Ranch Gravy
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 package mixed spice ( emeril's makes a dry spice for this dish. i add 2 packets ) | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese, drained | 1/2 cup ranch dressing, divided | 1 ripe avocado, halved, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup celery, sliced
instructions: Cook chicken breasts for 10 - 15 min in a large skillet over medium heat or until juices run clear. Meanwhile, in a small bowl mix together the mixed spice, ricotta cheese and ranch dressing with a wire whip until well combined. Put the chicken breasts in the chicken mixture and marinate 15 minutes. Serve the chicken with the avocado sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,half cream,chinese five spice powder,pork tenderloin,tomato puree
title: Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon allspice berries
instructions: Place tenderloin in microwave safe dish. Microwave, covered, 3 to 5 minutes or until meat registers 115 degrees f. Remove from microwave and set aside on a cutting board to cool slightly. Using a sharp knife, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Whisk together half and half, tomato puree, and cinnamon.

title: Pepperoni Ladyfingers
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 package pepperoni, sliced or 1 package pepperoni
instructions: Lay out lady finger's. Spread pepperoni slices on top of lady finger's. Roll up jelly roll fashion and place in large freezer bag. Slice into half to make 2 rolls.

title: Potted Rabbit
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red table wine ( not cooking wine, use the cheap stuff ) | 10 -12 small thin duck loin ( or you can use one of the smaller loins )
instructions: Rinse the rabbit under cold water. Make sure it has soaked up the water. Pour off all the water. Add the red table wine and leave covered for an hour. Uncover the rabbit and let it dry out a bit. Heat a little oil in a frying pan. Slide the rabbit into the oil and brown it well on all sides, on all sides about 25 - 30 minutes at 325 degrees. Place in a colander in the sink and pour the excess oil out of it. Rinse the rabbit well under cold water, drain and place in a pan. Pour in the white wine, place on medium heat and reduce almost to a glaze. Serve with fresh bread.

title: Grilled Irish Turnips
ingredients: 6 medium turnips | 2 cups orange juice | 4 ounces hamburger
instructions: Cut ends off the turnips. Cut the peel off the hamburger. Put in a pan.

title: Praise Kiwi Cheese
ingredients: 1 vidalia onion | 3 -4 ounces sauerkraut, drained | 2 tablespoons mint
instructions: Cut the onion in half and finely slice it. Place 1 - 2 tablespoons of the grated grated sauerkraut into a medium pot. Heat for about 1 minute, until it's warm, but not browned. Set aside in a bowl, pour 1 - 2 tbsp of the warm sauerkraut over the surface and mash lightly. Stir in the remaining leaves and mix thoroughly. Enjoy with some warm breads or in a sandwich.

title: Spicy Sage Butter
ingredients: 6 cups sage ( i use 2 bunches fresh sage, leaves from the stalks of the leaves, chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups vanilla sugar ( or whatever is around 1 cup or it's equivalent to your tastes, please be careful ) or 1 1/2 cups almond extract ( or whatever is around 1 cup or it's equivalent to your tastes, please be careful ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla sugar, to taste ( this is optional ) or 1 -2 teaspoon almond extract ( this is optional )
instructions: Add the sage and vanilla sugar, stir well and chill, stir in almond extract. This makes about 1 1/2 cups. This is a thickening paste that can be used as a topping for cookies, stews, meats and poultry etc. It's a bit pricey. It adds a lovely flavor that i love. I love the flavor of the almond extract, so use according to your taste. I found that 1/4 cup of almond extract would been nice after smoothing it out on my cutting board.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,lemon peel,vinegar,prosciutto,ladyfinger,red pepper flake
title: Lamington's Faux Trampi Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 cup chopped onions or 1 cup shallots | 4 slices prosciutto or 4 slices swiss cheese, about 2 1/4 ounces | 1 tablespoon minced fresh lemon peel | 1/4 cup thinly sliced roasted sweet red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Cut open the ladyfingers lengthwise, brush with melted butter, and stack them on a large plate. Sprinkle with onions, prosciutto, and cheese. Sprinkle with lemon peel, red pepper flakes, and vinegar. Serve at once or cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,cherry pepper,rosemary leaf,green olive,lime wedge,greek yogurt,hazelnut,cream cheese
title: Grilled Cherry Peppers With Cream Cheese and Olive Hummus
ingredients: 6 large cherry peppers | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaf, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon extra virgin dark soy sauce | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped toasted hazelnuts or 1/4 cup walnuts, toasted | 4 tablespoons sour cream or 4 tablespoons greek yogurt | grated sweet lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Brush the cherry peppers with half of the rosemary and let stand for 15 minutes. Dry on paper towels, drain. Place the cream cheese and remaining rosemary in the bowl of a food processor and process until smooth. Add the greek yoghurt and process until smooth. Place the cherry peppers on a tray or tray lined with foil and grill for 10 - 15 minutes or until blackened. Meanwhile, mix the hazelnuts, remaining rosemary, sour cream, remaining rosemary and remaining olive oil. To serve, place the cherry peppers in a plate and top with the hazelnut cream cheese mixture. Garnish with a lemon wedge.

title: Danish Peas, Raspberry and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons raspberry jam ( or your favourite raspberry jam ) | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons frozen peas | 4 -6 slices mixed glazed fruit
instructions: Mix jam, vinegar, peas, and fruits and chill until needed.

title: Anchovy-Maple Glaze (For St. Louis Chicken)
ingredients: 1 packet unflavored gelatin | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon or 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon powder | 12 anchovies, drained | 4 medium mushrooms, washed, sliced | 3 cups rice flour
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle yeast on water to soften.

title: Cashew Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans ( tips removed ) | 1/2 cup roasted cashews ( in dry ) | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 1/2 inches piece fresh ginger, peeled and crushed | 1 stalk lemongrass, tough outer light green parts only, sliced thinly on the diagonal
instructions: Soak the green beans overnight, then rinse thoroughly in cold water. Cover the sprouted beans with a bowl of cold water, and place the sprouted beans in a steamer. Add the roasted cashews and bring to a boil. Cover and steam for 7 minutes. Mix the salad oil with sugar, and set aside. Wash and thinly slice the ginger. Drain the green beans and steam over high heat for 2 minutes. Toss the green beans with the dressing, and serve it hot.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,fennel bulb,salt black pepper,apple juice,balsamic vinegar,chili paste,bucatini pasta,pernod
title: Pasta With a Cheatfire Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb bucatini pasta | 2 tablespoons light pernod | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 pinch of crushed fennel bulb | salt and black pepper
instructions: Cook bucatini pasta in rapidly boiling water until almost al dente, according to package directions. Drain pasta completely. Heat Pernod in small skillet over medium low heat. Add the diced tomatoes, apple juice, vinegar, chili paste, fennel bulb, salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes to blend flavors. Toss bucatini with hot sauce and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oxtail,napa cabbage,yogurt,saffron thread,english cucumber,cream mushroom soup,cake flour
title: Tacook--Aka Shreaded Oxtail Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 3 lbs oxtails | 1 english cucumber, washed and sliced thin on the diagnonal | 6 pieces napa cabbage, thinly sliced ( leaves and tops ) | 2 containers sour cream ( low fat okay! ) | 1 package cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup cake flour, sifted ( cake flour is used for dusting ) | 2 large saffron threads ( optional )
instructions: Cook oxtail meat until no more blood will appear. Remove oxtail with a slotted spoon, but reserve 1 cup of this liquid. Place remaining liquid in a stock pot and bring to boil over medium heat. Add oxtails and simmer for 1 minute before removing from heat. Place peices of eel or white onion on each piece of oxtail. Place cabbage on top of layer of corned beef. Sliced cucumber and a little of the soured cream soup on top of onions. Combine flour and saffron, or a little of the reserved soaking liquid and pour over onions and cabbage. Bring to a boil, then simmer 1 hour in a covered pan. Serve with crusty bread. Yogurt sauce, place sour cream in food processor and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: dripping cooking oil,thyme,cardamom seed,pearl barley,egg substitute,spaghetti
title: Spaghetti and Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 cups pearl barley | 1/2 teaspoon thyme or 1/2 teaspoon sage | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fat free egg substitute | 3 -6 tablespoons drippings cooking oil | 1 package frozen spaghetti ( uncooked ) or ( 16 ounce ) package oatcakes ( oatcakes )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 300 degrees. If using dry pasta add 2 minutes to boiling water. Place pearl barley in fine mesh strainer or sieve and rinse under running water. Drain and run cold tap water over barley. Add all other ingredients including egg substitute to barley and stir gently. Spray 2 - 5 qt saucepan or 3 qt crock pot with nonstick spray and place over medium heat. Do not brown. Add egg substitute and stir constantly around for 5 minutes. Turn down heat, cover and cook on high until egg mixture thickens, stirring every so often. Add hot pasta or oatcakes and stir gently. Turn off heat, stir gently again. Garnish with fresh herbs if desired. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,bread,cremini mushroom,bay leaf,velveeta cheese,pearl barley,italian sausage
title: Italian Barley Stew
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 lb bulk mild italian sausage | 2 1/2 lbs portobello mushrooms, thickly sliced | 1 lb pearl barley | 1 bay leaf | 8 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into cubes | purchased rotelletta and assorted other accompaniment, such as spanish ciabatta
instructions: Brown the pork in a large heavy fry pan with the sausage. When the pork is browned well, stir in the mushrooms. Add the barley. Add the bay leaf and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and cover loosely. Simmer for about 1 hour. Add the cheese.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,pecorino cheese,bouillon cube,angel hair pasta,bulk italian sausage,phyllo dough,onion soup mix,coleslaw mix
title: Italian Sausage Cheese Cigars #A1

instructions: Brown sausage in large skillet. Add soup powder and dissolve. Stir in bouillon and dissolve. Remove sausage mixture from heat and cool slightly. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray. In mixing bowl, add sausage mixture and mix well. Spread sausage mixture evenly in baking dish. Cover with 5 sheets of phyllo dough to make 6 cigar shaped crescents. Brush remaining phyllo dough on all sides with cooking spray. Repeat with remaining dough, spraying with cooking spray. Sprinkle bottom of casserole with cheese. Pour sausage mixture evenly over cheese. Bake for 40 minutes or until top is brown.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,black olive,salt,red chili pepper,gruyere cheese,hamburger,lime zest
title: Crusty Cheese-Wrapped Calabrian Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 4 large anaheim chilies, stems and seeds removed ( about 4 ounces total ) | 1 -2 teaspoon salt ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon ground red chili peppers ( can use fresh chili peppers in place of the dried red chili pepper, if desired ) | 1 lime, zest of ( or orange peel ) | 3 -4 cups gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 can black olives, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Brown hamburger with the chilies, salt and ground chile peppers, just until thoroughly cooked, no pink remains. Combine cheese, black olives, and lime zest.

title: Winter Turnips

instructions: Peel turnips and slice into rounds. Sprinkle with mixed dried fruit and veggie or juice. Bake in 300f oven for 30 - 40 minutes or until fork tender.

title: Lamb Fingers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean lamb | 1 1/2 teaspoons peanut oil or 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 - 1 1/2 cup maple syrup | 4 polish sausage or 4 any other sausage
instructions: Cut lamb into fingers, about 3 by 2. Cut in half at joint. Heat oil in small skillet, fry meat several hours or overnight. Strain pan juice, reheat and add syrup. Remove meat. Brown in batches and put back on pan. Cook 3 - 3 minutes.

title: My Favorite Side Dish

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Brush seeds with a little butter, and add ketchup. Stir in white wine vinegar, then salt. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Italian Broccoli
