instructions: Heat ketchup, raisins, beans, and broccoli in large saucepan over medium heat until hot, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low.

title: Sopa De Lima
ingredients: 1 package bread | 1 tablespoon broth, for dipping
instructions: Cut the bread into 4 x 3 wide pieces place the bread pieces in microwave safe dish. Microwave for 4 minutes. Add the broth to the bread. Microwave on high for 5 minutes. Cover the bowl and let stand for another 5 minutes. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun hard,maraschino cherry,sirloin tip roast,rose petal,white bread,white flour,italian sausage,leg lamb
title: Italian Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless sirloin tip roast or 5 lbs rib eye steaks | 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage | 6 loaves day old white bread | 1/2 lb boneless leg of lamb, fat cut off | 2 cups dried rose petals or 2 cups mixed dried rose petals, well rinsed and dried | 14 lbs hamburger buns or 14 lbs hard rolls, split in half crosswise | 1 box maraschino cherries or ( 24 ounce ) box sunmaid cherries, well drained and patted dry
instructions: Cut meat into 1/2 inch chunks and place into a crock or glass bowl. Add rose petals and pour enough water over meat to cover. Stir together well, then let stand overnight. Remove meat and rinse with cool water. Slice lamb across grain 1/4 inch thick and arrange in rows across crock. Cut loaves lengthwise in half. Place split sides, bread and meat, on a greased cookie sheet or baking sheet and place meat, loaves and marinated rose petals in a large casserole dish. Cover tightly and bake in a slow oven for 1 hour. Remove cover and bake for 30 minutes longer. Meanwhile, make icing. Remove bread and meats from oven, reserving marinate. Cut meat from rolls then spread with icing. Spread with reserved gravy. Return to oven and bake for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tofu in Pineapple Sauce
ingredients: 6 ounces soft tofu, drained, rinsed | 1 can pineapple juice
instructions: Place tofu on a plate, cover with water, and set aside. Heat pineapple juice in a saucepan to boiling, over medium heat. Place tofu in the saucepan. Cover, and simmer for five minutes. Serve over rice, or noodles, and enjoy.

title: Artichoke and Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1 orange, juiced | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: walnut,hot italian sausage,chili paste,vegetable bouillon cube,cocoa,cooking spray
title: Quick Chocolate-Wrapped Sausages
ingredients: 16 ounces hot italian sausage | 1/2 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 4 teaspoons vegetable pasteurized instant coffee granules ( for coffee cups ) | 1/4 cup ground walnuts | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Place sausages in a medium size bowl. Sauté sausages over medium heat in a non stick skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray for 10 minutes or until well browned. Add 1/2 bouillon cube and cocoa. Stir until the cocoa is well blended and cocoa dissolves, remove from heat. Allow to cool. Place ground nuts into a small plastic container or bowl. Place remaining 2 bouillon cubes into a small bowl. Shake cocoa and coffee granules in the bowl with nuts, if desired, and pour the cocoa into the empty space in the bowl. Pour cocoa over the nuts.

title: Tamarind Masala (Indian Sauce for Dipping )
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garam masala | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
instructions: Mix garam masala and turmeric in a small bowl using your fingertips. Store in an airtight container.

title: Gran's Grilled Blueberry Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 2 tablespoons rum | 4 strawberries | 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 3 chipotle chiles | 1/4 cup dried fruit | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian paprika
instructions: Slice baguette in 1/4 thick slices. Toast both sides on griddle until golden brown. Meanwhile, place the sliced bread on baking sheet, brush the slices with a little bit of the rum. Set aside. Slice strawberries and arrange around the bread. In a food processor, blend the rum, chiles, dried fruit, thyme, paprika. Spread on the bread and sprinkle over the chile mixture. Place under the grill until browned. Serve at once. If you like, place a piece of the top slice of grilled bread on a slice of the grilled fruit, then a piece of the bread soaked in rum.

title: Carrot & Peanut Sauce Bars-Pockets
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 cup tasty margarine | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce | 1/2 cup carrot, finely grated | 1/2 cup coconut, shredded
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Press mixture into the prepared patty cups or muffin tin. Bake in a moderate oven for 20 - 25 mins or until lightly browned. Allow to cool. Cut into squares.

title: Easy Peasy Onion Rolls
ingredients: 4 -5 spring onions, chopped | 1/2 cup sour cream or 1/2 cup thickened cream | 1 teaspoon parsley flakes | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Mix sour cream with seasonings. You may want to add a touch of salt or nutmeg if you desire. Use the filling to form small oval rolls, or rolls of your choice. Roll the rolls in the sour cream mixture and put them in a pan of lightly salted water. Cover and simmer gently for about 20 minutes, or until crisp and golden. Serve immediately, or pack in a ziploc bag for a nice presentation later. This rolls are a bit more than refrigerate size. If refrigerating, you can save time if you wish. I've made these rolls a day or two ahead of time and kept in the refrigerator until i went to work with them.

title: Italian Chicken Salad (Crock Pot Recipe)
ingredients: 1 can chicken broth | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon garlic flakes | olive, sliced ( optional ) | cool whip, to serve
instructions: Pour the chicken broth into a crock pot over medium heat. While boiling, stir in the mayonnaise, and water. Stir in the garlic, and remove from heat. Stir into the mayonnaise mixture the olives. Cover and refrigerate the salad for atleast 2 hours in the refrigerator, but as long as overnight serve over your favorite veggies i enjoy these over cooked potatoes for a delicious twist.

title: Pizza for Two
ingredients: 2 cans rotel tomatoes | 2 cups salsa | 1/2 lb pepperoni, chopped | 2 tablespoons minced fresh thyme | 1 tablespoon grated fresh lemon rind | 1/2 cup ginger ale
instructions: Mix together. Use as much or little as you like.

title: South African Rice Pudding

instructions: Combine rice, cream, cardamom, and coffee in a medium saucepan. Cook and gently stir over low heat until mixture is hot, about 5 - 7 minutes. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup whipped topping.

title: Sizzling Meatballs and Chickpeas
ingredients: 600 g sirloin, in 1 inch cubes | 1 cinnamon stick | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed well | 1/4 teaspoon saffron strand, crushed | 2 cups vegetable stock | 12 precooked meatballs, such as those found in supermarkets
instructions: Place meat, cinnamon and chickpea in a pan with the saffron, vegetable and stock. Bring to the boil, then lower heat to medium and simmer uncovered until meat is tender, about 30 - 40 mins. Season if necessary. Add meatballs and cook, uncovered, another 25 - 30 mins.

title: Indian Spicy Tomato-Pistachio Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 lb chicken thighs, skinned | 14 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 ounces parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons shelled pistachios, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f rub the curry paste through the chicken thighs, making sure that the skin is well coated in the paste. Place on an oiled baking trays, and roast for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender. Place the tomatoes and parmesan on a tray. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes until evenly browned. Transfer roasted chicken to cutting board, cut into thin slices, and serve with roasted tomato purée and rice.

Random Ingredients: apple,kahlua,vegetable oil,button mushroom,foie gras,mexican cheese,pork shoulder,lemon juice zest
title: Spicy Roast Pork Mole With Apple Empanadas

instructions: For the empanadas. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. In a blender or food processor, combine first 5 ingredients until a smooth paste forms. Place on top side of the preheated oven and bake at 400 degrees for about 1 hour and 45 minutes. You will need to check it halfway through.

title: Pepperoni-Kielbasa Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, sliced | 3/4 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon sweet relish ( your choice ) | 1 tablespoon sweet relish | 1 tablespoon sweet relish | 1/4 teaspoon kielbasa | 2 teaspoons sweet relish | 1/2 teaspoon poppy seeds | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 1/8 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Cut sausage into slices that are about 2 inches long. Place in a mixing bowl. Add raisins and sweet and sour. Mix well, then stir in ¼ c. Hot mixture. Add ½ c. Butter. Add ¾ c. Butter. Mix well, then add remaining ingredients. Shape into balls that are ¾ inch thick. Place on a grill, sprayed with pam. Baste with remaining butter over the tops of the patties when they turn. These are best cooked immediately, but may also be reheated later and served on the grill.

Random Ingredients: white bread,thyme leaf,orange,pickle,black olive,great northern bean,red chili paste,kaffir lime leaf
title: Kaffee's Classic Bread and Bean Salad
ingredients: 12 ounces great northern beans | 1 orange, peeled and sectioned | 2 kaffir lime leaves | 8 slices thick white bread, toasted | 10 large black olives | 1 tablespoon red chili paste | 1 tablespoon thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon pickle, slices ( optional )
instructions: Cook the beans over medium high heat until almost tender, about 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and reserve 6 cups of the liquid. Set bean mixture aside to cool. Place remaining liquid and orange slices in a medium bowl and set aside. Crush the kaffir lime leaves and lemon leaves well in a mortar to release a chunky texture. Add to bean mixture and stir to mix. Taste and add more chile sauce if needed. Toast the bread. Cut to desired serving size slices and arrange on individual serving plates. Top with orange mixture and arrange pickle slices on top.

Random Ingredients: wheat pastry flour,quinoa,cooking sherry,plain flour,mace,corn tortilla chip
title: Real Simple and Delicious Qinoa Chips
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 2 tablespoons sweet quinoa | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 packet quick-cooking sherry | 50 g plain flour | 1 packet corn tortilla chips, roughly crushed
instructions: Place whole wheat pastry flour, quinoa and mace in a large bowl. Whisk together sherry and flour until just combined. Add to dry ingredients and mix using on pulse until ingredients are distributed throughout the flour and the dough is clearly visible. Divide dough between 2 shallow and 1/2 inch bowls, or place 2cm apart on your tray. Place crushed chips all over each bowl, and then sprinkle with a little extra flour. Place tray into oven for approx 15 minutes. Turn off oven and leave bread bowls in to cool for approx 5 - 10 minutes. Cut into triangles.

title: Broccolini Wrapped in Broccolini (Polish Broccolini Wrapped in Oatmeal)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs broccolini ( baby-broccolini ) | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons oatmeal | 1/2 cup all-purpose white flour | snipped parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Wash and trim broccolini. Cut in half lengthwise and remove stem. Place on steamer basket. Cover and steam 20 minutes, or until tender. Drain, and cool. Remove and discard the stalks and leaves.

title: Grilled Chile Roja (Poblano Chile Dip)
ingredients: 12 poblano chiles, roasted | 1/3 cup half-and-half, or as needed
instructions: Preheat a grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate. Mix roasted poblanos, half and half, and hot pepper sauce together in a bowl. Serve hot, or refrigerate.

title: Chipotle American Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb white american cheese, cut into cubes | 1/2 lb parmesan cheese, grated | 1/2 lb coffee, hot | 1 chipotle chile, chopped
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, place the remaining ingredients, except the chilies, and mix well until the cheese is thoroughly blended. Sprinkle with the chilies.

title: Cucumber Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 2 english seedless cucumbers, halved and thinly sliced | 2 cans sliced water chestnuts, drained and sliced | 1 cup freshly grated parmesan-romano cheese | 1 1/2 cups dry marinara sauce, heated | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Combine cucumbers, water chestnuts cheese and pasta sauce in a large bowl.

title: Lamb Chops with Sausage
ingredients: 4 pounds boneless lamb chops | 2 tablespoons mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning | 3 tablespoons pimentos | 1 jar prepared picante sauce | 1 jar crushed red peppers | 1 jar diced pimentos | 2 containers heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup minced onion
instructions: Sprinkle lamb chops with montreal steak seasoning, and place in large slow cooker. Layer picante sauce, red peppers, pimentos and pimentos into slow cooker. In a bowl, beat together cream and minced onion.

title: Mexican Ahi Tuna Steaks
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried ahi tuna steaks | 1 teaspoon instant bouillon | 1 teaspoon low-sodium taco sauce | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 cup plain nonfat milk | 1/3 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped | 1 medium orange bell pepper, halved and thinly sliced
instructions: Drain the arabian tuna and place on a plate. In a small bowl combine bouillon, taco sauce and brown sugar. Add milk and mix to blend. Pour mixture over tuna and sprinkle pine nuts and orange pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: butterscotch chip,scallion,pumpkin,red bell pepper,red chile,dill weed,shallot
title: Spicy Butterscotch Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup butterscotch chips | 1 1/2 cups chopped peeled pumpkin ( about 4 med. pumpkin ) | 4 scallions, thinly sliced | 2 shallots, minced | 4 medium red bell peppers, thinly sliced | 1 medium red chile, seeded, minced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill weed
instructions: In large bowl toss together the butterscotch chips, pumpkin and scallions, shallots, bell peppers, chile and dill weed. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup peanuts, pressing with a fork. In large, nonstick skillet cook mixture over medium heat until mixture becomes well browned, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Serve sprinkled with remaining 1/4 cup peanuts.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,cream mushroom soup,heavy cream,kidney bean,white wine vinegar,white vinegar,green chile pepper
title: Mexican Green Chili
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can condensed cream of condensed mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup white white wine vinegar | 1 small green chile pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon heavy cream
instructions: Blend kidney beans, soup, white wine vinegar, green chile pepper, white wine vinegar, thyme, and heavy cream together in a blender until smooth. Divide chili mixture among serving bowls.

title: Worcestershire and Horseradish Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup water chestnut, drained and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar or 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 pinch worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons horseradish, finely minced
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor. Process until smooth.

title: Quick Mix for Shrimp
ingredients: 1/3 cup seasoned mix | 1/4 cup bottled garlic
instructions: Rinse shrimp in a bowl of cold water.

Random Ingredients: mustard seed,gruyere cheese,heap ginger garlic paste,chinese mushroom
title: Gruyere Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb chinese mushroom | 12 large heap ginger-garlic paste | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds ( optional )
instructions: Slice off a corner of about 1 1/2 inches from the mushroom stems. Fill each caps with a little of the cheese. Close by bringing the stem end onto the cheese and secure a little bit of mustard seed inside.

title: Quick Beef Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs stew meat, cut into serving pieces | 1 quart beef chuck, cut into cooking pieces | 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Place stew meat into the crock pot.. In a non stick skillet, brown the stew meat on all sides in the fat. Add the beef broth & cream to the onion & brown together, then add the meat back inside. Cover & cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Use crockpot for lunch, rice, or noodles if desired.

title: Beef Filled Rounds(Oamc)
ingredients: 4 round steaks ( sirloin or sirlion, whatever your favorite is ) | 2 -4 tablespoons olive oil | 1 small leek, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon dried minced sage | 1/2 lb kielbasa, sliced or 1/2 lb bacon
instructions: Brush both sides of each steak with oil, sprinkle with salt and dried sage. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Lightly grease a large baking sheet or roasting pan. Place the steak on the baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until steak is cooked to your liking. While the steak is baking, prepare your filling. Saute chopped leeks and sliced meat in remaining olive oil. Remove from oven and stir in sautee mixture. Serve. These are great served over mashed potatoes or just plain with salad. You don't have to bake these, but they make a great meal.

title: Quick Oatcakes Ala Halva!
ingredients: 4 teaspoons oil | 4 cups oatmeal ( not instant ) | 2 cups calrose rice, washed
instructions: Heat oil in a large non stick skillet, add rice and oatmeal, cook for 3 - 4 minutes. Add more oatmeal if necessary and stir. Add calrose rice and stir well. When bottom becomes golden brown, flip over and cook until other side is completely browned. Spread into muffin cups. Cut in quarters or diamonds, or just use a cookie cutter, and pop into mini muffin cup holder, cool, they will last 2 to 3 days if stored in airtight containers.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,honey,white vinegar,tea,salt black pepper
title: Russian Sweet Tea
ingredients: 1 quart brewed tea | 1 tablespoon good quality honey | freshly ground salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar
instructions: Place a small pot over medium high heat. Stir the tea, honey, salt and pepper together in a mug. Using an emersion blender, emulsify the olive oil and vinegar while drizzling a small amount of hot tea into it before adding any extra. The tea may be enjoyed in warm puddings/salted breads or a coffee cup.

title: Laurie's Green Tea Splash
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces green tea leaves | 2 spring onions, chopped finely | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives, plus sprigs for garnish
instructions: Pour the spring onions, chopped chives and grenadine over ice in a glass. Fill the glass with hot tea and stir well. Top with chive sprigs and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: port wine,russet potato,toast,wheat pastry flour,red bell pepper,mayonnaise,baby spinach
title: Kellymac's Irish Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat pastry flour | 3 russet potatoes, unpeeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 red bell pepper, diced | 1 bag baby spinach | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup port wine | 1/4 cup mayonnaise, or more to taste
instructions: Place potato slices in a bowl and cover with hot water. Microwave on high until potato slices are tender and can be peeled.

title: Simple Kimchi
ingredients: 16 ounces napa cabbage ( kimchi ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder, heaping
instructions: Cut kimchi into large slices 1/3 inch thick.

title: Chocolate Ginger Beer
ingredients: 80 ml chocolat liqueur or 80 ml chocolate coffee beans | 1 slice gingerroot ( very thin slices )
instructions: Place chocolat in a mug and pour over the chocolat.

Random Ingredients: midori melon liqueur,peanut oil,tomato green chile pepper
title: Midori Shakes
ingredients: 1/2 cup tamarind pulp | 2 tablespoons midori melon liqueur | 1 green chile pepper, chopped
instructions: Combine tamarind pulp and midori in a bowl. Stir in chile. Mix to make an open space. Refrigerate until solid.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,mussel,kaffir lime leaf,beef steak,natural peanut butter,black olive
title: Kaffir Lime Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef flank steak | 2 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 2 teaspoons kaffir lime leaves ( or 2 teaspoons dried lime leaves ) | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 2/3 cup black olives | 12 medium mussels, scrubbed and debearded
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise in half. Remove top 1/2 inch of meat. Cut each half into thirds across the grain. Stir peanut butter, lime leaves, and fish sauce in small bowl to blend. Heat large nonstick skillet over high heat until very hot. Add steak and cook, turning once, about 2 minutes per side for medium rare, or until desired doneness. Transfer to platter and tent with foil, keep warm. Increase heat to high and add olives to remaining pan. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes until olives are browned. Transfer to serving platter. Sprinkle with lime mixture. Note, any remaining meat can be cooked and treated as above.

title: Spinach with Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup milk | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 can tamarind pulp | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Place spinach and tamarind pulp in large salad bowl. Combine bread crumbs and eggnog in a large shallow dish. Dip coated spinach in the eggnog, coating well, then roll in bread crumbs. Serve immediately.

title: Black Beans Soup
ingredients: 15 ounces black beans, black-eyed, rinsed | 3 cups chicken stock, homemade or 3 cups water
instructions: If using the free range method, rinse the beans thoroughly, then rinse the beans again. Place beans in a pan with enough water to cover them by 2 inches, and bring to the boil. Cover and cook over moderate heat for 1 minute. Cover and set aside at once, then continue to cook the beans over the lowest possible heat until tender, about 1 hour. If using the free range method, remove the black beans from the water and allow them to cool completely. Transfer to a blender, and add the chicken stock. Puree to a smooth soup consistency, adding water as needed to thin to desired consistency. Serve with warm tortillas, bread, or raw vegetables on the side.

title: Quick and Easy Tangy Peanut Butter Candy
ingredients: 1 cup salted peanuts | soda water, for dipping | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 5 cups confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Place peanuts in a heavy resealable plastic bag. Seal, and pour enough soda water into the bag into a large resealable container to cover peanuts. Seal the bag, and shake to loosen peanuts. Allow peanuts to dry on top of water, 8 to 12 hours. Rinse peanuts again with soda water every 2 days. Combine the peanut butter, liquid smoke, and confectioners' sugar in a large mixing bowl. Gradually mix in the peanuts until desired texture is achieved and the peanut butter mixture has turned into spreadable candy.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,cherry tomato,rump roast,veal,ginger root,asadero cheese,rigatoni pasta,caper
title: Cherry Tomato-Riggies
ingredients: 1 pound boneless veal, cut into strips | 5 pounds rump roast | 10 cherry tomatoes, sliced | 1/4 cup capers | 6 green cardamom pods | 4 slices asadero cheese | 2 tablespoons capers | 10 leaves fresh ginger root, finely chopped
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat. Arrange the roast pieces in the pot, cover, and cook until the pieces are no longer pink on the outside, about 20 minutes. Remove the roast slices and set aside. Place the reserved meat in a separate pot. Pour the water into the pot to cover meat. Bring to a boil, skim the foam, and reduce heat to medium low. Continue cooking about 1 hour, or until the pork is very tender. Remove and discard the meat, and set aside. Place the rump roast in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours or overnight. When ready to serve, remove the meat from the refrigerator and refrigerate. Slice the meat thinly against the grain. Arrange on a plate, and place sliced tomatoes and capers on top. Place the fresh ginger in a mortar and pestle, or grind them into a paste. Stir the paste into the meat and tomatoes. Wrap about 2 tablespoons of the capers into a cheese cloth, tie with a piece of cheese cloth, and place the cheese cloth in a bowl. Set aside until serving. When ready to serve, pour the wine into the pot, and add 4 or 5 whole cloves of ginger. Place the beef pieces, capers, cloves of garlic, green cardamom pods, and capers into the pot, and bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Cook about 2 hours. Remove 1/3 of the liquid from the pot, and simmer 1 more hour. Stir the entire mixture every 15 minutes with a spoon or slotted spoon so that it is well moistened and no pieces stick to the bottom of the pot. About 20 minutes before serving, reheat the sauce over medium low heat. Stir 3 or 4 tablespoons of water into the sauce, and cook about 5 minutes, or until slightly thickened.

title: Sausage Brats (Or Bratwurst)
ingredients: 12 bratwurst | 2/3 cup cake flour
instructions: Pre heat oven on gas mark 4 and grease a shallow pan or pie plate. Cut a slit into each brat, leaving about 1 teaspoon or approximately 1 tablespoon of each lengthwise. Place on your greased baking tray and lightly press the brats down to help them brown evenly. Sprinkle flour on the brats and sprinkle generously with turmeric powder. Bake in oven for 30 minutes. The brats will be crisp and delicious.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,dark chocolate,mandarin orange,edamame,garam masala,spanish onion,sirloin
title: Baked Beef (Or Chicken) Kabobs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry crushed spanish onion | 1 teaspoon red garam masala | 1 1/2 lbs sirloin or 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 jar pitted ripe edamame, drained | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | lime wedge, for serving
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f in bowl, combine crushed onion, garam masala. Cut sirloin into 1 inch cubes or slices and place in ungreased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Bake at 400°f for 12 - 15 minutes, or until cooked through and cubes are crisp and browned. Meanwhile, in bowl, combine drained mandarin oranges, edamame, chocolate, and lime juice. Stir half of mixture into skillet and cook over medium heat, stirring, until mixture boils and thickens. Stir in remaining onion mixture. Remove from heat. Serve with remaining mandarin orange mixture and serve with lime wedges.

title: Easy Low Fat Mexican Dip
ingredients: 3 cans v8 italian stewed tomatoes and chilies ( rotel & tomato chilies ) | 0.5 can rotel tomatoes with green chilies ( jalapeno, jalapeno jack cheese ) or ( 15 ounce ) can rotel tomatoes & chilies ( rotel & tomato chilies )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle extra cheese on top. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 30 minutes.

title: Simple Indian Pork
ingredients: 3 lbs lean lamb shoulder | 1 pint molasses
instructions: In a large bowl, rub meat with molasses. Place on foil, close the foil, and freeze overnight. The next day, remove meat from freezer and place meat in a pan. Cover with fresh water and simmer slowly for 2 - 3 hours over medium heat, or until meat tender. To freeze, place in a large, wide mouth container or plastic crockpot and freeze. Remove meat from refrigerator 15 - 20 minutes prior to cooking.

title: Saag (Spinach With Saffron and Garam Masala)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh spinach | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 2 teaspoons saffron
instructions: Wash the spinach well and cut off a small amount that leaves it. Keep the leaves whole and cut them into tiny pieces. In a large pot, put the garam masala powder and saffron in. Wash the spinach in a colander. Now, put the spinach in the pot. Stir over medium high heat for 10 minutes. Then, remove lid and stir for 5 more minutes. After 5 minutes, the spinach should be very slightly wilted which means it is ready. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,anise seed,butter,black pepper,baby carrot,chicken wing,tarragon
title: Roasted Tarragon Chicken
ingredients: 4 pounds chicken wings | 3/4 cup unsalted butter, melted | 3/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons minced fresh tarragon | 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 cup baby carrots, peeled
instructions: Place chicken wings in a large dish and cover with lightly salted water.

title: Sardine Chips (Cooked Pig Sticks)
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh sardines, trimmed of scales and heads | 1/4 cup sardine brandy ( or rum ) | 2 tablespoons light flavored liquid smoke
instructions: Cut the sardines crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices. Soak until the liquid runs into a pan, about 10 minutes. Drain the sardines, discarding any excess liquid, and arrange them on a plate. Spoon 1 tablespoon brandy onto each sardine, leaving a half inch border. Sprinkle with generous pinch of sardine paste. Roll up, jellyroll style, and tie with kitchen twine. Arrange the strips in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet, and place them in an oven set. Place under a broiler and broil 10 to 15 minutes, turning carefully all the while. Brush with more sardine sauce, if desired. Serve warm. Variation, instead of sardines, toast the sardines in a dry, hot skillet until golden brown and crispy on each side, about 3 minutes per side. Use as needed. Variation, serve with chips as a garnish.

title: Roasted Tahini Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce | 5 large russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan with enough water to cover and cook until tender. Drain. In a large skillet add the vinegar, tahini and chili sauce. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Place the rigatoni in a large bowl and coat with the sauce. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place the potatoes on a baking sheet and bake 25 - 30 minutes. Turn the potatoes over and baste with pan juices. Bake 15 to 20 minutes more.

title: The Best Beef and Shrimp Gumbo
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 lb cooked shrimp | 1 package kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 eggs, beaten | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder ( i sometimes add more ) | 2 lbs cooked chicken breast meat ( i use pork )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In large skillet, cook ground meat with sausage until browned. Drain. Add shrimp and kielbasa, breaking pieces into small pieces until ingredients are mixed. Season with chipotle powder. Heat through.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil peanut,chicken breast fillet,cream cheese,cashew,coconut milk,pear,dark chocolate,stout beer
title: Cashew Chicken With Guinness
ingredients: 1/4 cup coconut milk | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate | 1 lb chicken breast fillet, sliced into strips | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 4 tablespoons cashews, chopped | 250 g cream cheese, sliced into 2 cm thick rounds | 100 ml guinness stout beer | 1/4 - 1/2 cup thickened cream
instructions: Place coconut milk on to absorb liquid from coconut, heat on a heat proof plate until warm. Set aside. Place chicken slices in a heat proof bowl, pour coconut liquid over, cover and set aside to marinate. Heat oil and add cashews. Cook for 2 minutes to toast, stirring constantly. Remove cashews from pan and set aside. Mash cashew mixture with the cream cheese. Spread 1 tbs thickened cream on toasted cashew mixture. Arrange a layer of chicken over cream cheese mixture, top with a few slices of cashew nuts and add more cream. Continue to repeat layers in this way until all ingredients start to be used up. Top with guinness and remaining cream. Chill in fridge for a minimum of 8 hours until serving.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,flat leaf parsley,beef stew meat,prosciutto
title: Portuguese Prosciutto Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lean stew meat | 20 thin slices prosciutto | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley | 10 cups pre-sodium beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. On a medium size baking dish with raised sides, lay out the prosciutto slices. Place some of the beef cubes in the center of each slice of prosciutto, then some of the prosciutto meat on top of the beef. Roll up the prosciutto slices so that they overlap slightly. Repeat with the remaining beef and prosciutto slices. Place the roasting pan into the preheated oven. The beef stew can also be covered with foil if you want to be extra lean. Bake for 2 hours, or until the meat is very tender and the liquid has reduced by half.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,chicken thigh,almond,apple,rice,farfalle pasta,salt pepper
title: Farfalle and Chicken Toss
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs | 1 pound ground almonds | 1 large apple - peeled, cored and chopped | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | salt and pepper to taste | 3 cups shredded cooked almonds
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: scallion,roast,liquid smoke,hungarian paprika,kirsch,yellow pepper,crescent dinner,yellow onion
title: German Sausage Rolls With Sweet Paprika and Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1/2 cup kirsch or 1/2 cup red cherry wine | 1 large yellow sweet pepper, julienned | 1 small yellow sweet pepper, julienned | 1 finely chopped scallion | 2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 1/3 cup sliced thinly sliced raw roast | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Unroll cresent dinner dough and separate into 18 rectangles. Working for each, lay rectangles on foil coated baking sheet. Prick each rectangle in several places with a fork. Combine kirsch, peppers, scallion and paprika in a large bowl. Add beef, pork and onions, mixing to combine. Spread 1/2 cup paprika mixture evenly over each rectangle lengthwise. Fold rectangles over in 2 layers and pinch well to seal. Pour kirsch mixture evenly over sausages. Bake 20 - 25 minutes or until pastry is golden. Serve at once or refrigerate uncovered for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: water,white bread,spinach leaf,pea,beet,pork loin chop,radish,tomato puree
title: Ukrainian  (Beef-Pork)  Pot-Pork Stew
ingredients: 2 -3 large pork loin chops | 1 cup boiled peas ( or other frozen peas ) | 1 cup beet, diced | 2 -3 slices white bread ( cut into cubes approx ) | 4 -5 radishes, sliced thinly diagonally | 4 -5 leaves spinach leaves, chopped coarsely | 4 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 cups white bread or 2 cups vegetable broth | 4 cups water
instructions: First take each pork chop and slice across the grain in small chunks, making sure to overlap the cuts and do not overlap the cuts at all. Add a bit of oil to the pan for cooking if you need to. Fry the pork chops and place into a pot on the stove. Make sure the chops are fully browned on both sides. When the pork chops come out of the pot, deglaze the pan with a quarter cup of boiling water. This will help the pork to absorb any remaining fat. If needed, add a tablespoon of water to loosen the pork. Place into a separate covered pot and set aside. Saute the beet slices in a bit of oil using a wire strainer, or alternatively, a slotted spoon, and then drain on paper towels, blotting the liquid back into the pot, return to the pot. Place the sauteed beet, peas, diced beet, bread cubes, and radishes on top of the pork chop mixture in the pot. Place the white bread on top of the beet mixture and pour in some tomato puree on top. The puree mixture should cover everything well, or just barely covering everything. Also add the spinach and cook until it is just starting to wilt. Note do not add too much water to the pot or stew, otherwise the bread might not cook sufficiently. Now pour in two cups of water, and enough to nearly cover the pork. Place the lid on the pot and put the pot over a medium heat. If necessary, add water to the pan to just barely cover the pork and veg. Bring to a boil. Lower heat, cover pot, and continue cooking for about an hour, stirring every 20 - 30 minutes or so. While the stew simmers, heat up a 1/4 cup of water or milk or a cup of vegetable broth. Stir this into the stew. When it comes to a boil, reduce the heat so it gently simmers. Do not let it boil on high setting, but be sure to stir the pot every 15 minutes. After 20 to 25 minutes, check the meat, and if it is almost burned on the top, raise the heat slightly. The amount of time for the next stage is your call.. The water is sufficient to cover the meat and vegetable, which will cook almost perfectly. If needed, add water or milk to just barely cover the meat and vegetable. When the stew simmers, check for the heat, and if it is boiling too hard again, cover the soup. Be sure to skim any extra fat from the top if the pan is very hot. Once it is hot, remove the lid, and place on a platter. Let the soup bubble for a few minutes.. Check the vegetables, and if the sauce thickens, taste and adjust with salt if necessary. This soup is quite thick, and can be served with fresh vegetables, or the garnish to give as an appetizer. Note, add a little water or broth.

title: Ananas Guisado
ingredients: 12 precooked anaheim chili | 12 precooked polish sausage
instructions: Remove stems, seeds and veins from chiles. In a large covered saucepan over medium heat, pour enough oil to cover chiles. Add chiles and sausage. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sausage is tender and liquid is hot. Serve hot and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: salmon,chunky salsa,beef rib,roasting chicken,yoghurt,almond meal,island dressing,cherry tomato
title: Island Salmon B & Rice
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs roasting chickens | 6 ounces beef ribs or 6 ounces pork bones | 1 cup almond meal | 2 cans deli sliced salmon | 1 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1/4 cup thousand island dressing | 4 -8 cherry tomatoes or 4 -8 grape tomatoes ( optional ) | 1 -2 cup crispy almond meal
instructions: Place chickens in roaster over medium heat. While chicken is cooking combine almond meal, salmon & salsa, blend til combined. Pour over chicken & sprinkle with almonds. Cover, bake in 375 degrees f oven for 1 hour or till golden brown.

title: Coco - Vegan Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | chopped desiccated coconut | crisco, enough to make a coating consistency | chopped desiccated coconut
instructions: Drain beans then combine with desiccated coconut. Form bean into long thin cylinders about 12 inches long and 1 inch thick. Sprinkle coat of coating consistency into each roll, being careful not to tear the rolled up beans. Bake in a 180 degree celsius oven for 30 minutes. If the coating is crispy and a nice, dark golden color, remove from oven and allow to cool before sprinkling of desiccated coconut.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,rosemary,egg,xanthan gum,tzatziki,thai red curry paste,rice wine,corn
title: Thai Fish Cakes (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh fish fillet ( such as halibut, sole, snapper or cod ) | 3 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon corn | 2 teaspoons tzatziki | 2 teaspoons minced fresh rosemary or 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh basil | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 2 eggs | 1/2 cup chopped yellow onion, separated | 1 1/2 teaspoons xanthan gum
instructions: For cakes, preheat oven to 400f degrees. Cut fish fillets horizontally through centre of fish fillets, then crosswise across across grain about 1/3 thick. Arrange fish on well greased paper towel lined baking sheet. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Meanwhile, prepare tzatziki sauce. Place curry paste, corn, tzatziki, and rosemary in bowl of food processor fitted with metal blade and process until smooth. With machine running, add eggs and half of yellow onion and process until mixture begins to form smooth paste. Add wine and process until mixture is very smooth. Add remaining onion and pulse until onion is well incorporated. Scrape mixture into bowl. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature. Cut fish into 1 1/2” pieces. Place in bowl of fish with paste mixture and toss to coat. Cover with saran wrap. Taste for salt and season with black pepper. Serve fish cakes immediately while warm or warm. Yield, 4 - 5 servings. Tzatziki sauce, in small bowl combine 1 tzatziki sauce and 1/2 tsp xanthan gum.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,limeade concentrate,taco seasoning,allspice
title: Tacos-Large Taters!
ingredients: 8 cups limeade concentrate | 1 can frozen taco seasoning, thawed | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 teaspoons el hanout spice mix
instructions: Whisk limeade concentrate and taco seasoning together into a large glass salad bowl. Add allspice.

title: Noodle Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups chicken or 3 cups turkey thigh | 3 chicken breasts, cooked and sliced | 12 ounces egg noodles, cooked according to package | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded ( i like kraft deli cheesy mix for this dish to taste ) | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Line a 13x9 inch baking pan with foil. Layer the chicken, noodle, cheese and peanuts in the 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake, covered, for 30 minutes. Uncover and continue baking until all the ingredients are cooked and thoroughly heated.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,vegetable oil cooking,celery rib,curry powder,confectioner sugar
title: Curried Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil, or more as needed | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 20 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar, or as needed
instructions: Mash together curry powder and vegetable oil in a small bowl to make a paste. Place celery and phyllo pastry sheets on a flat work surface. Place a few tablespoons of curry paste in the center of each phyllo sheet. Brush one side of a phyllo sheet with curry paste, and carefully roll it up, enclosing paste. Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets and remaining curry paste.

title: Spiced Chicken and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders, in 1/2 | 1/2 lb snow peas, trimmed | 1 teaspoon ground sumac | 1 can sliced dry nuts ( optional ) or ( 15 ounce ) jar sun-dried tomatoes, in oil
instructions: Cut a slit in the thickest part of the chicken, 1/2 inch deep. Insert one skewer through the center of the chicken, but not through it. If using, skewer through a snowpea on the diagonal. Sprinkle with sumac and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,chili powder,wheat pasta,bread crumb,celery rib,mango,bacon dripping
title: Fried Fresh Mango-Creamy Chopsicles
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 medium mango ( or a cup mango, finely diced or 1 peach, finely diced ) | 2 fresh celery ribs, finely diced | 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup dried bread crumbs | 12 ounces whole wheat pasta such as penne or 12 ounces other short pasta, cooked
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. In a large frying pan, heat drippings until shimmering around the edge. Toss chopped mango in the drippings and cook over medium heat about 5 minutes. Stir in celery and cook until wilted, about 8 - 10 minutes. Stir in yogurt, chili powder, bread crumbs and pasta. Toss lightly to coat. Spoon into an ovenproof baking dish or small casserole dish, press down with a spatula or a large spoon and bake until golden brown at the edges, about 40 - 45 minutes. If baking in batches, transfer to a rack until ready to serve.

title: Rice With Watercress and Mint
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice | 1 1/4 cups watercress, stems trimmed and leaves washed | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Pour 3 cups water in a heavy medium saucepan. Add the rice and stir to coat with water. Allow to sit for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, tie a few stems from the cress with a piece of kitchen twine. Cut the top end off the mint leaves. Set aside. When the rice is done, add it to the watercress stems and remaining leaves and let sit for 5 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork and drain any excess water. Stir mint leaves into rice. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin steak,parmesan cheese,napa cabbage,daikon radish,red onion,peanut
title: Beef and Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 ounces beef tenderloin steaks, thinly sliced | 2 ounces napa cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup thinly sliced daikon radish | 1/4 cup thinly sliced red onion | 1/4 cup toasted peanuts, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine cheese and the beef in a large bowl. Toss with green salad dressing.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,yellow squash,wine vinegar,soymilk,tilapia fillet,pepper flake,chunky peanut butter,soya sauce
title: Low Fat Thai Tilapia
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin matchsticks | 6 cups light soymilk | 1 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/3 cup wine vinegar ( balsamic would be good ) | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 3 -4 teaspoons hot pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 -2 yellow squash, julienned
instructions: Cut up the tilapia into chunks and marinade with the wine vinegar, soy and pepper flakes. Mix all of the ingredients together and place in the fridge and marinade for 1 hour. Heat a pan with high heat, spray with oil and fry the tilapia until the fish turns a white golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and place in a roasting pan lined with aluminum foil. Add some more oil if needed. Pour in 1 cup of the soym with the peanut butter and white sauce. Cook on low heat stirring constantly until melted and blended. Pour over the tilapia and sprinkle with pepper flakes. The more you sprinkle, the hotter the dish will be. Garnish with a few chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.

title: Peanut Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups milk yogurt or 1 1/2 cups low fat greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons other vegetable oil
instructions: Pour yogurt into a bowl or a plastic container. Tightly cover dish with plastic wrap. The cheese should be completely covered by the cheese. Chill in refrigerator. Gently press cheese with fingers or a spoon into desired shape. Cover and refrigerate at least an hour. Spread on toast or fresh fruit. Note, you can also use non fat milk yogurt for some other recipes. You can even use low fat milk cream cheese for a variation.

title: Simple Feta Dip
ingredients: 1 container crumbled feta cheese | 3/4 cup plain yogurt
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the feta cheese and plain yogurt. Pour into a 2 quart casserole dish, and refrigerate overnight. Garnish with chopped scallions, and serve with pita bread.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,white cabbage,cumin seed,beef broth,lebanese cucumber,poblano chile,lime,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Mexican Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped | 200 g red anaheim chilies or 200 g green anaheim chilies, chopped | 350 g white cabbage | 200 ml beef broth | 300 ml vegetable broth | 400 g sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 250 g lebanese cucumbers, chopped or small cubes
instructions: Toast cumin and poblano chiles over medium heat, turning to keep seeds from burning. Place in a mortar and crush roughly. In a large soup pot, cook, uncovered, garlic and chiles over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes or until chiles are softened. Using slotted spoon, remove chiles and garlic. Cut cabbage into slices, about 5 minutes into each. Put cabbage in broth, beef and vegetable broth. Simmer until cabbage is tender, about 15 minutes. Discard chile. Sprinkle cheese over soup and simmer for a few minutes longer. If cheese is to hard, add a little water.

title: Vegetarian Pancakes
ingredients: 6 ounces firm organic goat cheese | 8 ounces organic mixed vegetables ( such as broccoli, cauliflower, corn, mushrooms, etc. ) | 6 ounces organic plain yogurt-free buttermilk | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricot | chopped green cabbage | diced tart apple | chopped chocolate
instructions: Slice the goats cheese into 4 serving pieces. Divide the cheese into 4 equal pieces and spread each piece over one side of a warm non stick griddle or large frying pan. Grill for 3 minutes or until the cheese has melted. Spread the mixed vegetables out over the cheese, leaving one side of the griddle empty. Place the other side to the griddle. When the vegetables are crisp and brown, spread them over the vegetables. When the cheese has melted, distribute the mixed vegetables evenly on the ganache slices on the griddle. Distribute the yogurt free yogurt and chopped apricots evenly across the cheese. When the pancake is almost done, arrange the slices of cheese on top of the yogurt, pouring the yogurt/apricots on top of them. Sprinkle chopped cabbage and chopped apples across them. When the pancake has cooked, flip the pancake over. Serve with chopped chocolate for garnish.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,cantaloupe,cotija cheese,basmati rice,ramen noodle,beef sirloin,crescent
title: Sizzlin' Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into bite-sized cubes | 1 package refrigerated crescent rolls | 12 ounces frozen fully cooked basmati rice | 5 cups frozen mixed delicately cut ears fresh corn tortilla chips, thawed ( not paper, but nachos ) | 1 1/2 cups grated cotija cheese, such as mexican blend | 1/3 cup crumbled sargento oaxaca cheese or 1/3 cup freshly grated feta cheese | nacho-flavored ramen noodles or crispy toasted tortilla chips
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f place beef in medium skillet. Cook over medium high heat until browned and just cooked through, about 6 minutes. Drain. Place beef on a rack in a roasting pan and place in oven to keep warm. To make rice, in medium saucepan, cover with water, covering. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes or until al dente. Remove from heat, keep covered, and set aside. Heat oven to 375°f. Split rolls lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: red radish,paprika,italian seasoning,orange peel,penne pasta,sherry wine
title: Penne With Radishes
ingredients: 4 teaspoons paprika, divided | 4 teaspoons dry sherry wine | 8 ounces penne pasta, uncooked | 2 medium oranges, zested and juiced | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1 medium red radish, halved and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat 3 teaspoons paprika and 1 teaspoons sherry in a 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add pasta and oranges and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in remaining paprika and sherry and cook 2 more minutes. Stir in remaining 1 teaspoon sherry. Spoon evenly over surface of pasta and cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the liquid is reduced to about 1/4 cup, about 1 minute longer. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,beef gravy,cocoa powder,corn tortilla,beet
title: Mader's Crock Pot Hot Beet Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beets | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon beef gravy | 16 ounces canned beef gravy | 3 cups corn tortillas
instructions: Cook beets in pot with bouillon. Remove beets. Pour beef gravy and beef gravy over beets. Cook for 30 minutes on low. Drain liquid from can. Cut tortillas in half. Place half the torn tortillas in the crock pot. Pour half the beef/sauce mixture over the torillas. Repeat the layering process until ingredients are used up. Turn crock pot to high on auto and let cook on high for 1 hour. Turn crock pot to low and wait for 1/2 hour or until tortillas and other ingredients are done.

title: Mexican Green Stew
ingredients: 14 ounces frozen okra | 14 ounces red enchilada sauce | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 1/2 cups kale ( leaves chopped ) ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add okra and return to boil. Cook, covered, until okra is very tender. Drain, saving cooking water. Add enchilada sauce and bring to a boil. Add turmeric and kale and cook 2 minutes.

title: Finnish Onion Soup
ingredients: 8 -10 large firm white onions | 1 cup white flour | bouquet garni ( consisting of fresh herbs, parsley, thyme and or dill, tied in a piece of cheesecloth | 1 1/4 - 2 1/4 cups prepared broth or 1 1/4-2 1/4-2 cups water
instructions: Peel & trim the onions & slice them almost in half leaving about an inch thick of root ends attached. Set aside. Place the flour in a plastic bag, add the onions & shake to coat. Heat 1/4 1/2 cup of broths or water. Drop the onions into this broth and stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until the onions are limp. Place soup into 2 greased 1 1/2 quart saucepan e. G. Skillet. Stick a piece of cheesecloth around the wall of the pan, secure it w/tie with a string 1 inch at the top + 2 inches in the bottom. Heat the remaining onions & broths, then simmer to flavor the soup. Continue adding broth or water, approx 1/2 cup at a time.. Add the garlic cloves, cover & simmer for 1 1/4 hr or until onions are tender. Remove the cheesecloth w/string, secure tightly with a string & serve at once.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding,ancho chili,meat,udon noodle,egg white,lemon peel
title: Astrich Noodle
ingredients: 8 ounces meat | 8 ounces instant udon noodles | 1 teaspoon ancho chili | 2 egg whites | grated lemon peel | pudding, as a garnish
instructions: Clean spaghetti or pasta. Cut meat into bite size pieces. Break udon noodles in half and place with meat in a large pot.

title: Braised Bok Choy
ingredients: 3 lbs bok choy | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Remove root ends from bok choy and trim away thick ends. Quarter bok choy and slice off hard leafy center. Cut the leaves into 4 - 4 pieces about 1/3 inch square. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Heat a non stick skillet over medium high heat. Add garlic paste and stir 1 to 2 minutes. Add bok choy leaves and stir 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to buttered oven safe casserole and place in top 1/2 of oven. Bake, uncovered, until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Tarragon Sauce
ingredients: 3 -5 teaspoons tarragon | 4 teaspoons tomato ketchup
instructions: Add ingredients and mix well. Allow to sit for several hours in the fridge so flavors can combine.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,olive oil,sourdough bread,celery seed,dijon mustard,israeli couscous,cream cheese,vegetable shortening
title: Israeli Couscous With Sage & Cheese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided use | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons non-fat sour cream | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 9 cups day old sourdough bread, cut into 1-inch cubes ( about 1 pound ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried celery seed | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 3/4 cups israeli couscous | softened olive oil
instructions: Set oven rack to middle position, in oven. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a 3 quart dutch oven over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking. Add 1 tablespoon sour cream, the mustard, celery seed, and sage and cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the bread, stirring to coat bread with oil and spices. Transfer mixture to a colander and let cool, shaking excess liquid. Place couscous in a sieve and rinse under running water to remove as much of the liquid as possible. Transfer to a lrg bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand 15 minutes at room temperature. Transfer the couscous to a lrg mixing bowl and stir in remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and let stand, tightly covered, at least 1 hr & up to 5 days.. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400°f. Remove the parchment or baking paper from the couscous. Dot couscous with softened olive oil and spread it out flat in a 13x9 baking pan. Using a 3 - 4 inch diameter round cookie cutter, cut out circles from the dough. Arrange rounds in a 5x1 x 1 inch rectangle in baking pan.

title: Shanghai Spicy Pepper Seasoning
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sichuan peppercorns, crushed | 5 stalks celery, chopped
instructions: Place the peppercorns in a mortar and crush them into a powder. Cover the sichuan peppercorns with about 2 tbls water. Grind the rest of the water into a fine powder. Blend again. Cover and keep refrigerated for 1 week.

Random Ingredients: oil,aubergine,ruby port,arugula leaf,mustard seed,cardamom seed,chicken bouillon,bamboo shoot
title: Oops: Al-Batata
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs aubergines | 5 stalks arugula leaves | 4 slices bamboo shoots | 6 tablespoons oil | 9 cardamom seeds | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 3 1/2 cups ruby port or 3 1/2 cups ruby port | 1 cube chicken bouillon. | 1 cup oil
instructions: Trim and discard hard stringy ends of aubergines.

title: Easy Mushrooms Bruschetta
ingredients: 2 slices tuscan bread | 1/2 teaspoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon fresh mushrooms, thinly sliced
instructions: Place tuscan bread on a tray or plate. Sprinkle both sides with cornflour. Sprinkle mushrooms over the bread. Heat in a non stick frying pan over a medium heat for 1 minute each side or until golden brown.

title: Easy Brazilian-Style Coconut Truffles
ingredients: 2 cans coconut cream, divided | 1 frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Stir 1 can coconut cream and whipped topping together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.

title: Spicy Beef and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, thin sliced, cut into thin strips | 1 teaspoon season salt | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 - 3/4 cup crushed pineapple | 4 sprigs fresh rosemary
instructions: Spray frying pan with nonstick spray. Add sirloin and brown until just browned. Add seasoned salt, stirring so everything sticks together. Stir in the pineapple and cook for 1 - 2 more minutes. Serve over cooked rice, and garnish with a sprig of fresh rosemary.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,plain flour,brown onion
title: Quick and Easy Samosas
ingredients: 1 brown onion ( chopped ) | 1 red chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon plain flour
instructions: Place all ingredients in a plastic bag. Shake to combine. The flavours will blend. Refrigerate to allow flavors to blend. Slightly fry or steam samosas. Store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: penne,cayenne pepper,chicken breast half,biscuit,button mushroom,artificial sweetener,lemon juice zest
title: Chicken and Mushroom Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked boneless skinless chicken breast half, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 packet splenda artificial sweetener | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper | 12 ounces refrigerated biscuit rolls | 1 package fresh button mushrooms ( i use baby portobello, which i'm allergic to mushrooms ) | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and halved
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Spray a 9 x 13 pan with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine chicken, splenda, lemon zest, and pepper.

title: Eggplant-Stuffed Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 large eggplants, halved lengthwise | 2 1/2 lbs beef brisket | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Wrap the entire piece of beef in a large roasting pan over med high heat and arrange it on the sheet. In a bowl, toss the ketchup, broth, parsley, and allspice. Spread mixture over the beef and rub the marinade into the beef. Roast the beef for 1 hour and 15 minutes for medium rare.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,brand rice,rigatoni pasta,tamari,grain mustard,pear,radish,cayenne
title: Pear, Radish, & Cayenne Pasta in Slow Cooker
ingredients: 1 jar multicolor brand rice | 8 cups radishes, sliced ( about 1 small bunch ) | 2 cans ready-to-use pears, chopped drained | 1 tablespoon crushed dried chili pepper flakes, such as sambal oelek | 2 teaspoons cayenne | 1 teaspoon whole grain mustard | 3 -4 tablespoons tamari | 2 teaspoons dried whole grain mustard | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb angel hair pasta
instructions: Place the contents of a slow cooker in the order listed. Set the cooker on high and cook until the rice is tender, about 8 hours. Stirring once or twice. Tada.

title: Crispy Cardamom Green Salad Appetizer
ingredients: 200 g lettuce or 200 g green lettuces | 200 g crisp dried rice sticks
instructions: If using fresh rice, wash and soak for about 20 minutes. Drain the rice and then cut into tiny sticks or long strips. Wash, pat dry and dry the crisp dried rice sticks. Set aside. Place cold water to boil. Place a strainer in a bowl and pour hot water over the rice. Turn frequently until water is evenly covered, around 10 minutes for each stick of rice and 40 - 50 minutes for dried rice. Remove the strainer and drain the rice. Place rice sticks in a tray. Cut into sticks or long strips and roll over rice sticks. Place in the refrigerator until you need them. Store in the fridge.

title: Guava Guac
ingredients: 4 large guavas, peeled, pitted and sliced lengthwise | 2 tablespoons dried parsley leaves
instructions: Arrange guava slices in a single layer on a cookie sheet. Sprinkle guava slices with dried parsley. Broil under the broiler for 3 minutes. Turn guavas and broil for 2 minutes more, until bubbly and puffed down. Serve warm.

title: Vietnamese Chilie: Sweet Heat
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar ( such as horlicks brand )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir thoroughly. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,vinegar,mexican tomato,white onion,chicken stock,almond,lentil,pearl barley
title: Mexican-Style Red Beans and Barley
ingredients: 2 cups white onions, finely chopped | 1 cup dried lentils | 1 lb hot red chili pepper, diced | 1/2 cup dried pearl barley | 2 cups chicken stock | 1/2 cup almonds, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes
instructions: Dissolve chili and barley in chicken stock. Add beans and onions. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Cover and simmer 25 minutes. Uncover and simmer a further 10 minutes. Just before serving, stir in almonds.

Random Ingredients: new potato,hot sauce,gingerroot,lime juice zest,peanut,sirloin,kosher salt
title: Steak and Potatoes in Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 large boneless sirloin, 1 to 1 1/2-inches thick | kosher salt or white salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, finely grated | 2/3 cup dry roasted salted peanuts, plus extra | aluminum-type foil, for greasing pan | 1 lime, juice and zest of | hot sauce | 7 lbs new potatoes, peeled, halved | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped peanuts
instructions: Cut beef across grain into 1/4 thick slices. Trim fat from beef, if necessary. Sprinkle with salt. Combine gingerroot, peanuts, lime zest, and hot sauce in food processor. Puree until fairly smooth. Tie with kitchen string, add beef and process very briefly, just until meat resembles coarse textured meat coating the beef. Wrap in foil tightly and refrigerate 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Heat oven to 425°f. Arrange meat, peanuts, and sliced vegetables in shallow glass baking dish. Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes, until potatoes are tender.

title: Ginger Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs peeled and deveined raw shrimp | 1/3 cup minced fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup minced fresh lemon zest | 2 tablespoons guacamole | 12 inches top sirloin, steak, sliced thin and lightly salted
instructions: Prepare shrimp and set aside. Prepare grill. Mix ginger, zest, and guacamole in a food processor or blender until well blended and well mixed, add shrimp a little at a time until mixture is easy to work with. Stir in meat. Thread 1/2 shrimp at a time onto greased foil or parchment covered grill. Brush with glaze. Grill 2 - 3 minutes or until cooked through or basting with any leftover glaze. Serve.

title: Kiss Me, Don't Like It  and Don't Go Naked!
ingredients: 1 cup greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons fat free sour cream
instructions: In a bowl put the first 5 ingredients. Mix till it resembles mashed potatoes. Keep in refrigerator till ready to serve. Can be eaten hot, warm, or cold enjoy.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,chile paste,double cream,chicken drumstick,greek yogurt,marinara sauce,plain flour
title: Greece Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 5 chicken drumsticks | 4 tablespoons plain flour | 2 tablespoons chile paste | 1/2 lb greek yogurt | 1/2 pint marinara sauce | 5 ounces marinara sauce | 10 artichoke hearts, chopped roughly
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c, 350f, gas mark put drumsticks, flour, chilli paste in a food bag and shake to coat. Rinse the pan and add yoghurt and mix well to combine. Place in oven for 40 - 50 minutes. Take off tin foil and add marinara sauce and artichoke hearts, cook for 15 mintues to reduce sauce a little. Stir through. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: baby clam,chicken,chicken bouillon,coriander,arborio rice,rice vinegar,gruyere cheese
title: Clam-Garlic Stuffed Chicken Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice vinegar, more to taste | 3/4 cup arborio rice | 1/2 cup uncooked baby clam, washed and chopped | 1/2 cup diced gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken or 1 1/2 lbs ground turkey | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon, more to taste
instructions: Bring a 2 1/2 inch depth of lightly salted water to a full boil in a large pot. Boil water and add rice. Cook, uncovered and stirring constantly, until rice is tender and water is slightly evaporated, 3 to 5 minutes. Meanwhile, drain shrimp or shells and set aside. Add shrimp to boiling water to cover and cook until they turn bright pink, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain shrimp and place in a bowl. Add shrimp/shells to rice and set aside. When the rice is tender, stir in chopped clams, cheese, coriander and bouillon. Check texture with rice. This should be somewhat moist but not soupy. Serve rissotto immediately or cool completely or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Green Sushi Roll - Sushi
ingredients: 1 sheet nori | 2 cups finely chopped green or red sesame seeds
instructions: Cut nori in half crosswise. Roll each half with a rolling pin, until it is about 3/4 inch square across all sides. Spread each half with sesame seeds and roll up to form sushi ball. Seal in a bamboo sushi mat with either hot water or rice wine vinegar. Serve when cold.

title: Cheater's Tomato Chili
ingredients: 1 loaf unsliced whole wheat bread | 2 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 1 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Slice bread in half. Cover whole loaf of bread with stewed tomatoes with chili sauce and brown sugar pour can of tomatoes over top. Place in crockpot and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: linguine,chili oil,white sugar,kidney bean,sage leaf,coffee,icing sugar
title: Linguini with Coffee, Sage and Chilli
ingredients: 200 g linguine | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 200 g white sugar | 250 ml strong coffee | 1/2 cup chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 can kidney beans, drained ( cannellini with liquid ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar, heaped
instructions: Cook linguini for 8 minutes or until al dente. Meanwhile heat the oil in a pan, add the sugar and cook until lightly browned. Drain the pasta and add to sugar, stirring through quickly. Add the coffee and leave to soak for 10 minutes. Add the herbs and stir through until heated through. Pour over the coffee mixture and stir until mixed. Sprinkle with icing sugar and serve.

title: Lettuce Rolls
ingredients: 1 packet dry yeast | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 5 cups lettuce
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a large quantity of warm water. Leave in a warm place, and stir in the five spice powder, cayenne and vanilla. Pour into a large bowl and add the lettuce. Mix thoroughly and cover with a clean cloth. Leave in a warm area to double in volume. Turn dough out onto a floured board and knead for about 10 minutes or until the dough is smooth and elastic. Shape the dough into two round or oval shapes and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled in size. Bake at 120c/400f/gas 4 for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and set on a kitchen towel to drain off any excess moisture.

Random Ingredients: german mustard,orange zest,vegetable oil,half cream,red chili pepper
title: Hot Orange Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/4 cup german mustard | 1 fresh red chili pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest
instructions: In a skillet on medium heat, warm the oil. Stir in the mustard.

title: Crispy Seed Crackers (Mexican Spice Mix)
ingredients: 1/2 cup toasted flax seed meal | 1 small minced serrano chilies or 1 small jalapeno chile, finely chopped | 2 celery ribs, finely chopped
instructions: In a medium bowl, make a dry spice mix by combining the toasted flax meal, chili and celery.

title: Persian Crunch Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked bulgar wheat | 1 cup watercress, washed and chopped | 1 cup lettuce, washed and sliced | 3/4 cup pickled pepperoncini peppers, minced | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, minced ( about 1 inch ) | 1/4 cup light cream or 1/4 cup light cream | 1/2 teaspoon salad dressing ( spicy )
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together bulgar wheat and watercress. Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or for up to 3 days. Drain, rinse and chop vegetables into 1 inch squares. Add lemon juice, gingerroot and cream. Toss to mix well, cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,asian fish sauce,basil,bicarbonate soda,pork loin,brussels sprout,cremini mushroom
title: Spicy Pork and Brussels Sprouts Soup
ingredients: 800 g brussels sprouts | 400 g sweet dried cremini mushrooms | 200 g smoked pork loin | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 tablespoons asian fish sauce | 1 tablespoon basil
instructions: Put it all in a large soup pot and bring slowly to the boil. While it's hot, put a piece of oil in a frying pan and fry the sprouts, using a medium low heat. The idea is that they won't be cooked at all once it boils. When they are cooked, place them in a bowl and pour in the soup and put the lid on it. The soup should boil after 30 minutes, so keep an eye on it. After an hour, remove the lid again, check the sprouts to make sure they are cooked. It should have a little crunch left at the top. You might think that they are. When you feel satisfied, add 1 to 2 tbs of asian fish sauce.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,sun tomato,grand marnier,nutmeg,wide rice noodle,savoy cabbage,salt pork,crabmeat
title: Crab Stuffed Cabbage Leaves in Shell
ingredients: 1/2 lb salt pork, diced | 1/4 lb unpeeled sun-dried tomato, chopped | 8 ounces uncooked wide rice noodles | 1 1/2 cups shredded savoy cabbage | 1 tablespoon minced fresh marjoram or 1 tablespoon oregano | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 teaspoons salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees/. Sprinkle a little salt on the ends of a cabbage leaf. Rinse under cold water. Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, stir in the rice sticks, and return to a boil. Cook the noodles for 10 to 12 minutes or until al dente. Drain well. Combine the sausage, sundried tomatoes, cabbage, marjoram and sun dried tomatoes in a bowl. Fill the cabbage leaves with the mixture to within 1/2 inch of the rim of the cabbage leaves and roll up the cabbage leaves tightly. Seal with toothpicks if necessary, and place on a baking sheet. Mix together the grand marnier and nutmeg, and sprinkle over the rolls. Bake for about 30 minutes or until the cabbage is tender and the garlic in the dish has a nice color.

Random Ingredients: sea scallop,bamboo shoot,sugar,jamaican jerk sauce,double cream,mango,salmon
title: Jerk Salmon With Mango Cream and Sea Scallops
ingredients: 1 tablespoon jamaican jerk sauce ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons double cream | 2 tablespoons mangoes or 2 tablespoons rindless, chopped peeled | 1 tablespoon canned sliced bamboo shoot, drained and chopped | 1 lb sea scallops | 3 tablespoons sugar, divided | 1 1/2 cups fresh mango, diced | 1 ripe apple, cored, diced
instructions: Dressing,. Place cream and mango in a small bowl and add remaining salad dressing ingredients. Mix well. Salad,. Line two plates with parchment or plastic wrap, and place scallops on top. Pour mango/cream mixture over scallops. Sprinkle with half the sugar. Sprinkle with remaining sugar. Serve immediately with apple slices.

title: Mexicana Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup shredded italian cheese blend | 1 can crushed tomatoes with juice | 1 cup crushed dried pineapple, chopped | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. In a bowl combine the cheese, tomatoes with juice, pineapple, coconut and parsley.

Random Ingredients: date,hard egg,egg,greek seasoning,chicken wing,chicken breast half,beef steak,wheat flour
title: Greek Spiced Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings, split lengthwise | 1 lb chicken breast half, cut into 1 x 1 inch pieces | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and cut into wedges | 12 ounces cooked ground beef round steak ( or other ground meat ) | 1 egg, beaten | 1/4 cup 1 % low-fat greek-style greek seasoning | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 2 teaspoons unprocessed goat or herb seasoning
instructions: Prepare chicken wings and allow to dry overnight at room temperature. In a large bowl mash together eggs, meat, egg and greek seasoning until well combined then add in the chicken and turn to coat. Marinate chicken covered with plastic wrap in the refrigerator at least 8 hours or overnight. Prepare grill. Drain chicken wings and discard marinade. Grill over hot coals about 5 minutes on each side until browned. Meanwhile combine egg and flour and mix well then spread mixture evenly over the chicken wings. Grill 6 to 8 minutes on each side until golden brown.

title: Pepperoni Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 beef sirloin | 1 package pepperoni | peppercorn, to taste
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Cut into thin bite size. Grill meat until browned on both sides and cooked through. While meat is heating, slice pepperoni into strips. When done, slice pepperoni into strips. Place sliced pepperoni strips on toasted buns and enjoy.

title: Homemade Almond Jelly  (No Margarita)
ingredients: 1 package almond extract | 3/4 lb lime gelatin or 3/4 lb almond paste
instructions: Pour almond extract into a large mixing bowl and add the powdered sugar. Stir until well blended. Add lime gelatin and use a candy/glaze/dip into mix. Wisk well. Transfer to a glass jar. Label and store in the fridge up to 12 months.

Random Ingredients: cheese,tiger shrimp,peanut,wheat germ,sea salt,lime wedge,sesame seed oil,filling
title: Rama Salata
ingredients: 1 lb frozen prawns or 1 lb prawns, shelled and deveined | sea salt | 1/2 cup peanut or 1/2 cup cashews | 16 ounces cheese | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds oil | 1/2 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 1/2 lime wedge | 1/4 cup wheat germ
instructions: Marinate, put prawns, salt, nuts and sesame seed oil into oven proof pita bread or other shallow bowl. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 45 minutes. Cool, remove prawns, and chill again. Sauce, mix in cheese, until melted, then stir in sesame seed oil. Serve warm either cold or room temperature. The dish can be made 1 day ahead, cover and refrigerate. Reheat prior to serving. Sprinkle prawns with sea salt.

title: Beef-Bamboo Balls from Good Burger

If the grains do not stick, raise the heat and stir, allowing any excess to drip off. Transfer the rice to a bowl. Do not stir. Allow excess to cool to room temperature. While the rice is cooking, prepare the syrup. Place 1/4 cup of the syrup over low heat and warm until it simmers, then add another 1/4 cup and warm for an additional minute or so. Remove from heat. Dissolve the other 1/4 cup of syrup in the remaining 1/4 cup of syrup and add to the cooked rice, stirring to blend. Set aside to cool to room temperature. Soak wooden skewers in water or a little cool water for 10 minutes before using, then thread onto skewers. Place under a preheated broiler for 1 - 2 minutes, turning so skewers cook evenly and ensure thorough cooking of the syrup and syrup. Note, i have found that it is best to leave 2 inch strips of each stick of rice on the table for extra interest. When the syrup is cool, cut it into bite sized pieces or chunks. Place in the refrigerator and store in airtight containers for up to 3 days.

title: German Gluten Free Mogs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 lb italian sausage, casings removed ( hot or sweet ) | 1 cup light rye flour | 1 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and fry sausages until golden. Drain on some absorbent paper. Wipe out the pan. Add the rye flour to the pan and mix through the sugar, slowly stirring as you go to avoid lumps. Add the sausages and the fat in the pan, stirring as you go. Reduce heat and cook over slow heat for about 20 minutes or until thickened. Remove from heat and leave to cool slightly. Cut into 1 inch pieces and serve.

title: Roast Beef and Cashews
ingredients: 1 lb roast beef, trimmed of fat and sinew | 5 whole kaffir lime leaves, broken in half | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place roast beef in a large ovenproof skillet, fat side down, and cover with foil. Place in preheated 400 degrees f oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove beef. Raise oven temperature to 425 degrees f, and roast for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Tear off a piece of kitchen twine, exposing meat and drippings. Hold over pan and twist the wooden skewer so that beef drippings run out of meat. Slide onto paper towels to drain. Shred beef. Return meat to oven for 3 to 4 minutes, scraping up browned bits left in skillet. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until meat is richly browned and tender. Transfer to serving platter and sprinkle with cashews. Serve with plain boiled rice.

Random Ingredients: red tomato,green chutney,meat,edamame,white bread,cardamom seed,salt pepper,parmesan cheese
title: Spicy Fried Edamame and Spicy Meat
ingredients: 1/2 lb meat | 2 eggs | 3 green chutney | 1 red tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese ( about 2 ounces ) | 1/4 teaspoon cumin or 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper, to taste | 1/2 tablespoon dried edamame ( optional )
instructions: Thoroughly mix meat with eggs, chutney, tomato, cheese, cumin/cardamom, salt and pepper. Heat oil in frying pan.

title: Orange Bell Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1 cup golden syrup | 3 tablespoons granulated sugar | 1 orange bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups celery, finely chopped
instructions: Heat golden syrup and sugar in a medium sized saucepan over low heat, stirring. Increase heat to medium and cook, stirring, until sugar dissolves. Remove pan from heat and stir in bell pepper and celery. Transfer mixture to a shallow serving dish and refrigerate until cooled completely, about 3 hours.

title: Mexican Restaurant Dipping Chutney
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mild diced green chilies or 4 tablespoons hot red chili pepper | 2 fresh red chili peppers | 1/2 cup sweet dill pickle ( such as cottees )
instructions: Cut off the chilies from the stems and rinse and remove the seeds from them by using a vegetable peeler or the edge of a vegetable peeler. Slice the chilies into 1/2 pieces. Place the chilies in a mixing bowl with all the other ingredients. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate the dip for 30 minutes. Serve with any vegetables and/or crackers.

title: Coconut Sambol
