ingredients: 4 slices sandwich bread | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt ( optional ) | 2 cans coconut milk
instructions: Grill or fry the bread slices until lightly browned, turning once. Remove bread from grill to a plate. Pour vinegar on bread slices and sprinkle with garlic salt. Pour coconut milk into a separate pan and heat over low heat until the milk is hot and the coconut is soft. Pour the heated milk mixture over the bread. Serve immediately, or refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: catsup,red lentil,lime leaf,cinnamon,broccoli floret,kaffir lime leaf
title: Sweet & Spicy Two Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 medium broccoli florets, cut into bite size pieces | 1 lime leaf ( not the lime part ) | 1 teaspoon catsup | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 cup red lentil | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, grated ( optional )
instructions: Soak red lentils in enough water to cover for 3 - 4 hours drain. Wash and drain any excess water. Mix the lentils, chili, garlic powder, catsup and lime leaf. Just before serving add some of the chopped kaffir if desired. Toss well to mix.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,active yeast,green enchilada sauce,yellow pepper
title: Simple Southwest Green Enchilada Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast | 1 cup green enchilada sauce | 1/3 cup yellow pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand in a warm place until creamy, about 10 minutes. Stir in green enchilada sauce, yellow pepper, and garlic salt.

title: Beef in Hot Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces top round steak | 3 cups fresh broccoli florets | 4 teaspoons white vinegar | 6 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips about 1 and 1/2 wide. Place in crockpot. Sprinkle with vinegar, sofrito, and chili oil. Cook on high for about 5 hours or crockpot on low for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Italian Vegetarian Condiment
ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 cup port wine | 1 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Drain, and save the juice. Pour the juice in a frying pan over medium high heat. When the juice bubbles up, add the bamboo shoots and let it simmer over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes. Stir through the port and basil and serve in warm pita bread. Use the reserved juice as a dipping sauce to warm pita and/or sandwich.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,extra virgin olive oil,vindaloo curry paste,milk,blackberry,ginger,cream cheese
title: Berry Cheese Spread
ingredients: 200 ml skim milk | 50 g reduced-fat cream cheese | 100 g cheddar cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 teaspoon ginger, grated | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon blackberry ( to garnish )
instructions: In a food processor combine all ingredients and process smooth. Transfer the mixture to an serving bowl. Garnish with blackberries.

title: The Russian Chef
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef | 1 packet italian seasoning | raspberries, to garnish
instructions: Brown the meat on both sides in a large frying pan. Place in a casserole dish. Sprinkle some italian seasoning on it. Cover it with half the raspberries. Pour the rest of the italian seasoning over all. Cover. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 1 hour or until the raspberries have burst open,. Serve over freshly cooked pasta, mashed potatoes or rice, with lots of italian dressing on top and some raspberries for garnish on top.

Random Ingredients: gravy,ginger garlic paste,lemon juice,white wine,malibu rum,heavy whipping cream,mineral water
title: Malibu Rum Ginger Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 liters mineral water | 125 ml malibu rum | 250 ml dry white wine | 25 ml ginger and garlic paste ( fresh or jar ) | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons gravy ( store bought or homemade ) | 200 ml heavy whipping cream
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth. Place in freezing tray and freeze overnight. Serve icy cold straight from freezer with a fresh fruit spoon.

Random Ingredients: pink grapefruit,red chili pepper,pistachio,chicken bouillon cube
title: Grapefruit Chicken With Pistachios and Chilli
ingredients: 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 small pink grapefruit, juice of | fresh red chili pepper | 1 tablespoon pistachios or 1 tablespoon walnut pieces, chopped
instructions: Place the chicken bullion in a roasting pan and cover with boiling water. Turn up the heat to medium and gently pour the grapefruit juice/water over the pieces of chicken. Cook for 45 mins to 1 hour depending on the size of the pieces of chicken. Remove the chicken and cool a little. Take off any excess fat and cut the chicken up into small pieces. Sprinkle with a little paprika and place on a tray. Serve with a mixed green salad and/or your favourite savoury dish. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,self raising flour,chili flake,beef tenderloin,nonfat milk powder
title: Pancetta Cutlets
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin ( trimmed, cut into 16 cubes ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon nonfat dry milk powder | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 3 bay leaves
instructions: Place beef cubes in a nonstick frying pan.

title: Sopa Seca (Portuguese Potato and Chile Salt Stew)
ingredients: 1 pound red potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 serrano chiles, chopped, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place potatoes in a pot and cover with water.

title: Namibian Breakfast Rolls
ingredients: 12 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons tea, warmed ( or any sweetener )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Lightly spray a cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Lay phyllo on cookie sheet. Spread 1/4 cup rice on phyllo sheets, leaving 1/2 inch of space at each edge. Sprinkle the rice with 1/4 cup rice and 1 teaspoon cardamom over rice. Layer half of the phyllo sheets with remaining rice, half of the rice, half of the teabag, half of the tea, teabag and half of the remaining phyllo sheets. Working with one layer at a time, carefully roll up phyllo in sheets beginning at the long side, then roll up and pinch to encase and shape filling. Transfer to baking sheet, and repeat until all eight sheets are used. Bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until phyllo is browned and filling is hot. Variation, to keep filling warm with a sauce, place a spoonful of filling in a small bowl and spoon 1 or 2 tbsp. Yogurt into the bowl with the filling. Note, alternatively you can roll up the phyllo pastry after rolling it. Place phyllo on a cookie sheet, but not touching, and bake 10 minutes. Remove, and let cool. Repeat these steps until phyllo is thawed and cooled.

title: Irish Pork loin
ingredients: 4 tablespoons irish cream | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 4 pounds boneless pork loin roast
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the irish cream and garlic powder. Pour half onto pork loin and place in a roasting pan that will fit inside the roasting pan. Cover with aluminum foil and turn meat over a few times. Roast in a preheated oven until it reaches 145 degrees f after 45 minutes. While meat is roasting, cook remaining 1 tablespoon of irish cream in sauce pan over medium high heat until it begins to thicken. Remove from heat. When meat is finished roasting, remove from pan and let rest 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Wasabi Sole
ingredients: 2 cans sole fillets ( white, white or fish ) | 1/3 cup buttermilk | 8 ounces cashews | 2 tablespoons wasabi | cooked rice ( or cooked noodles ) | 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dry sherry or 1 teaspoon red wine
instructions: Mix wasabi with margarine, thyme and wine. Add cheese, to taste and mix well. Rinse fish inside and out and pat dry with towel. Place into a lightly greased casserole dish in a single layer. Sprinkle on cashews. Mix wasabi mixture with enough buttermilk to just cover fish. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Do not overcook.

Random Ingredients: garlic,corn syrup,ancho chile powder,ice water,double cream,soymilk
title: Ancho Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup light soy milk | 1/2 cup double cream | 1 pinch dried ancho chile powder | 1 small piece garlic, pressed | ice water | 1/2 cup light corn syrup
instructions: Combine soy milk, cream and ground ancho chile in a small saucepan over medium heat. Heat, stirring frequently until mixture begins to thicken, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add garlic and enough ice water to reach a depth of 1 inch. Heat slowly until mixture boils, about 1 minute. Immediately remove from heat and stir well until mixture is well combined and cold. Cool to room temperature. Refrigerate until chilled. Add corn syrup or sugar to the cold mixture and stir well. Cover and chill in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: French Fried Egg Beaters
ingredients: 6 large eggs | 1 teaspoon thyme ( fresh or dried, not dried ) | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( or other hot pepper ) | 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Cut off any hard edges in the eggs. Use a potato peeler, or mandolin to grate the egg yolks into a medium bowl. Remove and discard the shells from the yolks.

title: Margaritas for the Holidays
ingredients: 5 plums, halved | 6 tablespoons fresh italian parsley | 1/2 cup tequila | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 large lemon
instructions: Cut off the tip of the lemons into 6 wedges and peel away both ends. In a bowl, combine the plums, parsley, tequila, sugar and lemon. Let sit for an hour. Serve with ice and garnish with lime wedges if desired.

title: Eggplant Chips
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, cut in half lengthwise | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the eggplant slices on a baking sheet or broiling rack coated with a nonstick cooking spray. Broil over low heat, with a little oil left in the bottom of each, until the eggplant has a crunchy surface, slightly soft peel and deseed the eggplant, and break into smaller pieces. Remove any skin that remains. Dry all the eggplant pieces thoroughly with a paper towel. Return to the broiler for about 10 to 15 minutes, so that they are warm. Remove from the heat. Place a clean paper towel over the tops of the eggplant chips to keep them soft and crisp. When cool, dip the chips in the lemon pepper dressing, letting any excess lemon peel peel sit on the eggplant chips. These are great cold.

title: Saffron Potato Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce | 1 cup finely diced potato starch ( not potato starch ) | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 3 scallions, sliced thick | 3 -4 saffron | 1 teaspoon mori nuisense instant powdered saffron | crushed ice cube ( optional )
instructions: Mix and melt saffron together in a microwaveable bowl. In a mixing bowl add potatoes flour, minced garlic, scallions and saffron mixture blend with your hands until smooth. Roll into 1 inch balls and place in a glass 9 pie dish. If baking in the oven mix the potato starch, powdered saffron and salt until smooth then coat the ball with the potato starch mixture coating. If baking the pie as a baking dish, simply add a few ice cubes. Let it cool then cover and refrigerate for at least an hour before serving.

title: Homemade Baked Dates
ingredients: 8 ounces chopped veal | 1 lb pitted dates | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup sweet sherry
instructions: Melt bacardi if using from recipe # in a heavy ovenproof skillet, cook veal in fat over high heat about 15 minutes, until golden brown. Stir in dates, baking soda, and stock. Scald sherry in remaining fat for 5 minutes. Serve. Garnish with pimento pieces.

Random Ingredients: rice krispies,ginger,orange bell pepper,lasagna noodle,grapeseed oil,spice,lemon juice zest
title: Crispy Parsley Orange Peppers & Rice Krispies Ramen
ingredients: 12 large orange bell peppers, halved lengthwise ( about 4 ounces total ) | 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 6 cups rice krispies | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 tablespoon mixed spice | 2 teaspoons ginger, freshly grated | 10 sheets fresh lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f toss the bell peppers with the oil in a large roasting pan and roast for 15 minutes until the skins start to wrinkle, but it will not blacken. Place the pan in your preheated oven. After 15 minutes, shake pan a few times to redistribute peppers evenly. Remove peppers, place in a baking dish and roast for 20 minutes more, until they are softened. Meanwhile, cook the rice krispies per package directions, then drain and set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a medium skillet over medium high heat. Add the cereal mixture and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Stir in the lemon zest and juice and cook, stirring, for 1 minute more. Spread the krispies over the noodles, using the broad edge of a plate to prevent noodles from sticking together. Arrange the noodles on top of the cereal mixture and cover with foil. Bake in the heated oven for 25 minutes, until noodles are cooked through and lightly colored. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before opening the oven door. Variation on a theme, serve with a dollop of melted reduced fat cream cheese or sour cream and a sprinkling of dijon mayo on top.

title: Kebabs
ingredients: 1 kg button mushrooms | 1 kg ham | 250 g cake flour | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 2 teaspoons allspice
instructions: Cut the mushrooms and ham in very thin pieces. Mix flour, spices and the turmeric in a bowl or plastic bag. Cut the ham and mushroom into 5cm cubes. Put the pieces in the mixture and mix thoroughly. Add the marinated mushrooms and ham. Shape the mixture into walnut sized balls. Chill for at least one hour, or overnight. Preheat your griller. Grill them on a hot oven, or open flame, until golden brown on all sides. Serve hot or cold. Variation, place in a dehydrator according to your preferences and press for 10 minutes. Variation, for a tasty kebab, place in a clay pot with a layer of greaseproof or wax paper between each layer of kebab. Add some honey on top and allow to steam for 2 hours or until meat is fully cooked through. Enjoy.

title: Simple Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 1 container frozen phyllo dough, thawed | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Place thawed phyllo dough into the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Line the phyllo dough with a damp cloth while you roll it out on a lightly floured board. Cut the phyllo dough into strips, and then cut those strips crosswise along the length of the phyllo dough to make strips about 4 inches long. Arrange one end of a pastry strip into the baking dish. Fold the ends of the phyllo dough over the ends to enclose the enclosed pastry. Season with salt and pepper. Repeat process with the remaining phyllo dough. When you have used all of the phyllo dough, spread the pastry dough over the top of the pastry. Bake in the preheated oven until the pastry is golden brown and the moisture has been absorbed, about 30 minutes.

title: Italian Penne
ingredients: 2 cups penne ( or rotini or fettucini ) | 1 cup italian salad dressing | 4 teaspoons orange rind, freshly grated | 2 teaspoons sage, fresh
instructions: Bring 6 quarts of water to a boil. Add your penne and stir until just cooked, about 3 minutes. Do not overcook or the pasta will be mushy. Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Stir in the dressing, orange peel and sage. Turn the heat on low to warm and simmer, covered, until the pasta is heated through. The pasta can be served right away, or cooled slightly before refrigerating for later use.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,beef rib,pistachio,tart apple,parmesan cheese,paprika,yellow pepper,ketchup
title: Quick Smothered Beef Ribs, Apples, and Chiles
ingredients: 3 medium tart apples, such as fuji or ancho, cored, cut into chunks | 4 yellow peppers, chopped | 1/4 cup ketchup | 3 tablespoons paprika | 2 cans beef country-style rib racks, well rinsed and patted dry | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese, or to taste ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons shaved white chocolate, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place apples and yellow peppers into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and set aside. Mix ketchup and paprika in a bowl, and pour into pan. Arrange beef rib racks across top, brush both sides with ketchup mixture, then pour remaining sauce mixture over top. Cover, and refrigerate 2 hours, brushing beef frequently as it marinates. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Bake uncovered 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until meat is done and sauce is bubbling.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,basmati rice,salsa,broccoli floret,white wine,sunflower seed,sumaq,saffron
title: Salisbury Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, prepared ( approx 3 cups ) | 1 lb broccoli floret ( approx 2 ) | 14 ounces mandarin oranges | 1 cup salsa | 2 tablespoons raisquillas or 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1 cup white wine ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon sumaq
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease 8 x3 inch loaf pan. Wash rice well and drain rice. Rinse broccoli florets well, remove stems, remove as much white surrounding white membrane as possible. Cut a small sliver from stem side. Cut squash in half lengthwise, remove seeds if desired add to mixture, then cut into small pieces. Place rice, broccoli, oranges in pan. Add salsa, raisquillas, oil and saffron, mix well. Pour mixture evenly over rice. Cover with foil large enough to enclose mixture tightly. Bake one hour or until rice is completely set. Place rice on large platter and garnish with sesame seeds and/or sunflower seeds.

title: Noodle Salad With Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups green olives, drained | 1/2 - 3/4 cup liquid smoke, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon dried chervil | 1/4 cup uncooked spaghetti ( preferably vermicelli or linguine, if available )
instructions: Cut the olives in half and then in half again until almost all of the flesh is cut away from the membranes. Place the cut sections in a large bowl and add the liquid smoke to keep it moist. Add the chervil and the uncooked pasta of your choice and toss all ingredients together. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,lasagna noodle,green chili pepper,caper,celery salt
title: Green Kiwi Lasagna
ingredients: 3 kiwi fruits, sliced | 2 stalks celery salt | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 4 1/2 teaspoons green chili peppers, seeded and chopped | lasagna noodle
instructions: Arrange the kiwis and celery salt in the bottom of a 12 x 7 baking dish. Sprinkle chopped chilies, 1 tablespoon capers and 1 to 1 1/4 teaspoons green chilies on kiwis. Arrange a sheet of lasagna noodles on top. Pour over a layer of kiwi sauce. Sprinkle with remaining tablespoon of capers and chilies. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours, or overnight, before cutting. This is also good topped with a few kiwi slices and a drizzle of olive oil. Note, i put a handful of noodles near the end of the cooking time and sprinkle with paprika, black bean, chili powder and chopped fresh cilantro when assembling.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,pineapple juice,cayenne,coriander seed,greek olive,rice powder,apple juice,beef chuck roast
title: Sweet and Sour Beef Kabobs With Curry
ingredients: 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons green curry paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat and cut into 1 inch cubes | 8 ounces greek olives, rinsed, drained, and coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine the pineapple juice, curry paste, rice powder, coriander, and cayenne in a wide, shallow dish and stir to blend. Add the beef and toss to coat. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour, turning the meat occasionally. Thread meat onto long metal skewers. Place skewers, cut side down, on a tray. Brush with the remaining marinade. Place on a rack of a broiler pan or on a rimmed baking sheet that has been lined with foil. Broil, turning from time to time, until a deep, richly browned crust forms, about 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer the beef and barbecue sauce to a platter and garnish with the greek olives, if using.

title: Tomato Bananee Smoothie
ingredients: 7 large ripe tomatoes with juice | 3 ripe bananas | 4 eggs, raw | 125 ml double cream | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Combine the bananas and eggs in a blender. Add remaining ingredients and blend on high until the desired consistency is achieved. Chill in the fridge for at least an hour or overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,white vinegar,pineapple juice,five spice powder,greek yogurt,rump steak,confectioner ' sugar
title: Caribbean Grilled Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup fat-free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1 chipotle pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 3 lbs beef skirt steak, cut into 16 medallions | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Note, for even more intense flavor, double marinade ingredients, and marinate meat for 1 hour at room temperature, or overnight. Make the marinade by whisking together the yogurt, pineapple juice, chipotle pepper, vinegar and five spice powder in a large resealable plastic bag. Add the meat and turn to coat well. Thread the sirloin onto 6 bamboo skewers, making sure that each skewer is soaked in the marinade. Brush the remaining marinade over the sirloin and barbecue over medium coals for 3 to 4 minutes, or until done to your liking. Transfer the skewers to a wire cooling rack and let cool a few minutes. Cut the skewers across the grain into thick slices. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar and serve.

title: Roast Pork and Okra
ingredients: 1 bone-in pork roast | 1 lb fresh okra, ends trimmed, cleaned | 1 large leek, cleaned, white part trimmed, washed, and cut into thin slices | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 4 fresh rosemary sprigs, crushed | 1/2 lb fresh okra, ends trimmed, washed, and cut into 2-inch segments
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place pork roast into a roasting pan.

title: Garlicky Vegetable Barley with Bari
ingredients: 1 lb pearl barley, rinsed well and drained | 2 cans vegetable broth or 2 cans vegetable stock
instructions: The night before you need to make the barley, pour the vegetable stock into a 9x13 inch square baking dish. Add the barley and stir well. Cover with water and bake, stirring occasionally, at 300 degrees for 1 hour. The next morning, uncover the dish, uncover and bake, stirring, for an additional 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Alla Checca
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 1 jar spaghetti sauce
instructions: Cook spaghetti acc to pack instructions. Drain well to cool. Combine spaghetti sauce in large bowl with spaghetti and enjoy.

title: Quick Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 26 ounces spaghetti sauce | 9 ounces molasses | 2 teaspoons thyme
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock pot. Stir well. Serve with warm, cooked noodles.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,leek,beef tenderloin steak,cheddar monterey jack cheese,mushroom,golden syrup
title: Tex Mex Beef Tenderloin and Mushroom
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steaks | 16 ounces picante sauce | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 lbs mushrooms, sliced | 1 leek, sliced | 3/4 cup shredded cheddar and monterey jack cheese blend
instructions: Arrange beef tenderloin steaks in a large roasting pan that has been sprayed with non stick cooking spray. In medium bowl, combine picante sauce, golden syrup, and mushrooms. Spread over steaks.

title: Molho de Bijolho
ingredients: 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 2 small red snapper, scaled and gutted | 3 ounces smoked salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f. In a bowl, combine flour, cocoa and salt. Slit the snapper horizontally with your fingers and place on a baking sheet with a lid. Mix the flaked snapper and salmon into flour mixture and shape into a ball. Repeat with other ingredients. Bake for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pasta,salmon,yellow cornmeal,italian herb seasoning,chili sauce,head cauliflower
title: Italian Cauliflower Fish Cakes With Gravy and Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower, cut into small florets | 2 cups coarse yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dry mixed italian herb seasoning | 20 ounces smoked salmon, cubed | pasta ( of your choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Coat with cooking spray. Bring large pot of water to a boil over high heat. While waiting for water to boil, coat 8 inch square pan with cooking spray. Remove cauliflower from pot and drop into boiling water.

title: Minted Pickles
ingredients: 1 cucumber, unpeeled | 10 cups pickling cucumbers | 5 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Wash the cucumber and cut into quarters. Using a small sharp peeling knife, slice lengthwise into 6 even pieces. Set aside. Using a colander in the sink, pickle each piece into a colander with a rounded edge. Put a spout of cucumbers in the sink so the cucumbers drain as much liquid as possible. Place each spout into a medium pot. Cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Let boil for about 5 minutes. Immediately remove from heat and set aside, in a strainer. Cover, and let sit in the strainer for an hour. To make the pickle syrup, remove any seeds from the cucumbers and cut away the stem. Gather the pieces together. Measure 2 cups and place in a large saucepan. Add the dark soy sauce, and stir to dissolve. Add the pickling cucumbers at one time. Cover, and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes to prevent sticking. Continue to stir occasionally until the vinegar has been reduced to a thick syrup consistency. The pickle will thicken and become crisp and slightly translucent. It will sink to the bottom of the pot as it simmers.

title: Vegetarian Arroz
ingredients: 1 bag rice milk | 1 can tomato soup | radish | pine nuts
instructions: You can make a rice porridge, but this step is not exact, just an adequate measurement.

title: Creamy Coriander Mix
ingredients: 1 packet dry chocolate drink mix | 3 teaspoons chopped fresh coriander powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container.

title: Low Fat Cream Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 3 tablespoons margarine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Combine the 2 cheeses in a mixer. Add margarine and mix until smooth. Roll into balls and place on a parchment lined sheet pan. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Allow to cool completely before cutting.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,sesame seed,sourdough bread,green salsa,tomato,red currant jelly,gingerroot
title: Green Sesame French Bread Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 slices sourdough bread | 1 -2 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, finely grated | lettuce leaf ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon green salsa | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly | 1 small tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Place bread slices in a medium bowl. Add sesame seeds, ginger, lettuce leaves and salsa. Stir to combine. Top with jelly and tomato. Variation, substitute sliced green beans or cucumbers for lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: parsley flake,cashew,kiwi fruit,kirsch,american cheese,salt pepper,baby spinach leaf,purpose flour
title: Spinach, Kiwi and Cashew Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cashews | 1 cup baby spinach | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and diced | 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon kirsch | 1 pinch salt and pepper | 4 slices american cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Combine cashews and spinach in a large bowl.

title: Succulent Pepper and Mozzarella Calzones
ingredients: 4 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ( about 1 standard container ) | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the yeast and 1/2 cup of the cheese. Let stand 1 hour. Line the bowl of a stand mixer with plastic wrap. Stir the yeast mixture and remaining cheese with a wooden spoon until the consistency of coarse crumbs. Stir in the pepper. If needed, add more cheese. Stir in the remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Turn the dough onto an oiled work surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, turning to grease the surface of the dough. Cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 45 minutes. With a sharp knife, cut six 1 inch thick rounds. Place about 1 tablespoon of pepper and 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture in the center of each round. Close the edges of the round with a toothpick. Let stand until the calzones are double, 20 to 30 minutes, on a greased baking sheet. Cut the calzones into wedges. Bake in a preheated 400°f oven until browned, about 3 minutes.

title: Spicy Sauteed Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable broth or 2 cups fish stock | 2 pieces bacon, sliced very thin | 1 cup bok choy, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons cognac or 3 tablespoons brandy | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek leaves ( optional )
instructions: Bring broth to boil over medium high heat. Add the bacon, cook, stirring frequently till the bacon just begins to crisp, about 3 minutes. Transfer the bacon to a serving bowl. In the same pan, fry the bok choy over medium heat for about a minute, till bright in color. Mix in the cognac and fry for another couple of minutes, then pour over the bacon. Remove from the heat, add cayenne powder, fenugreek leaves and allow to cool for 5 minutes, then spoon over the hot bok choy.

title: Tomato Swiss Cheese Damper
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese | 6 ounces self-raising flour
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f grease 4x2 cake tins with butter. Cut cheese into 10 squares. Roughly chop cheese and combine all ingredients. Spoon onto baking tray. Bake 40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Crock Pot Spiced Beef Brisket
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef brisket | 1 1/4 ounces ground chuck or 1 1/4 ounces ham fat | 3 roma tomatoes, seeded and sliced into eighths | 1 tablespoon fresh peppercorns ( or 1/2 t fresh ground fennel seed, or 3 t ground cloves ) | 6 slices of your favorite sweet onion ( your preference ) or 6 slices of lemons ( your preference ) | 3 pinches anise seeds, or ( to taste ) | ground pepper
instructions: First place the brisket fat side up on a cutting board. Take the blade and slice brisket across the grain on the thin side of the brisket. Be sure to slice slices about three quarters of the way through to allow space for slicing. If you slice the brisket thinly you will get a slice that is just about the thickness of your brisket. Then take the blade slice from the board and slice brisket across the grain. Repeat with other pieces of brisket. If you slice brisket thinly there is no need to slice or slice in that short time. You can slice them about the same size or smaller depending on what type or size of you have sliced. If you slice brisket thinly you will get a slice that is just about the thickness of your brisket. Make sure to slice at least three quarters of the way through to allow space for slicing. Lay your slices in a baking dish in that order, onions. Cut up tomatoes across the grain. Lay the slices out flat on paper towel to absorb grease. The more surface area you use for the sauce, the better the sauce will taste. Add 1 tbspns of water to baking dish. Spread a thin layer of the chopped onions over the onions. Pour 1 cup of sauce over the onions. Sprinkle 1 tspns of fresh ground pepper over that. Next place a layer of sliced brisket over the last layer of sliced tomatoes. Add another layer of sliced brisket. Spread 1/2 cup of sauce over, then sprinkle 1 1/2 tspns of fresh ground pepper over that. Repeat with last layer of sliced brisket and onions. Dip the end of a long slice of fresh lemon into hot water. Then drizzle lemon juice or water over the brisket mixture to help absorb the juice. Then place brisket mixture in baking dish. Cover with foil and refrigerate at least 3 hours. To serve, remove brisket mixture from oven. If serving on a platter or individual plates, use a slotted spoon to remove any fat and juices and place slices over individual portions of platter. This sauce can also be eaten over the broiled grated roma tomato on top of the brisket if desired.

title: Balsamic Vinegar(Gravlax Clone)
ingredients: 2 -3 cups balsamic vinegar | cold water
instructions: Combine vinegar and cold water in small saucepan and bring to boil. Remove 1/3 cup of the hot liquid and pour into blender. Add vinegar to remaining hot liquid and blend for 10 - 15 seconds or until thick and clear. Pour into glass bottle, seal and pour in cold water. Store in fridge for 1 week. This can also be frozen for 4 months.

title: Barbecue Glazed Pork (Sweet)
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork shoulder | 1 cup molasses | 1/3 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Combine molasses, pineapple and pork shoulder in the crock pot. Add enough water to cover meat. Cover and cook on high 7 - 9 hours or low 3 - 4 hours. You can do this the night before, but the longer they cook, the longer they get to the point where they are done.

title: Strawberry and Chive Dessert Filling
ingredients: 2 bunches strawberries | 1 sprig fresh chives
instructions: Place the strawberries and chives in the container of a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Add as much water or water as you need to make a medium thick paste. Taste for seasoning and adjust. For a creamier filling just add a little milk or cream more if you need to. For thickening, add small amounts of milk to thin it to the consistency of the creamed mixture.

title: Broccoli and Mint Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped broccoli florets | 2 teaspoons minced fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup fat-free beer or 1/2 cup non-alcoholic beer | 6 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Stir broccoli, mint and beer or liquid aminos in a small saucepan and cook over medium high heat until broccoli is tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Noodles - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and coarsely chopped, not oil packed | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, coarsely chopped, including stems
instructions: In large bowl, gently but thoroughly stir sun dried tomatoes, parsley, and sun dried tomato oil. Makes 2 - 3 cups. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Cashew Tamataris
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup cashews, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place masa harina in a large bowl and add 3/4 cup of water. Mix well, then add additional 1/2 cup water to achieve the consistency of a soft meal. Place thawed pastry sheets on a floured counter. Cut in half crosswise. Place 3 sheets in the center of each of two sheets. Using a 3x3, lightly coat half of one sheet with masa mixture, and roll into a sausage shape. Repeat with remaining sheets, placing two sheets on each of the other. Cut two stacks in half to make 36 tamaris. Place 2 sheets in a 9x13 inch baking dish or 2 larger pans, and brush or spray lightly with oil. Repeat with remaining masa mixture and nuts. Bake on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper for 50 to 60 minutes, until nicely browned. Remove from oven and set aside on wire rack to cool. Cut to desired size and store in air tight container.

title: Jamaican Beans & Rice With Breadcrumbs
ingredients: 400 g kidney beans | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 5 allspice berries, cracked | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice sticks ( dried ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup rice noodles, dry or | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, extra to coat
instructions: If using dried rice sticks, soak them overnight or at least 1 hour. Place 1 cup of soaked or fresh beans in a saucepan, add the water, then cover and bring to the boil over a medium heat. Cook for about 15 - 20 mins or until the beans are just starting to soften but still firm enough to fall apart. Drain and reserve the cooking water. When it's ready, mash the beans slightly with a fork or mortar & pestle. Set aside. Measure out half the breadcrumbs and use to coat half the beans in a bowl. Tear the remaining bread into bite size bits and divide among the beans in a bowl. Measure out the remaining breadcrumbs and use to coat the rest of the beans. To make the crumb topping, mix 1/2 cup extra breadcrumbs with 2 cups of drained cooking water. Stir until well combined. Put the remaining breadcrumbs onto a plate and set aside. Bring the bean water to the boil and stir in the rice noodles. Cover and return to the boil. Lower the heat and simmer for 15 - 20 mins until the liquid has been absorbed. Add the bread crumbs and 1/4 cup extra breadcrumbs, stir and remove from the heat. Divide among individual serving bowls and top with the crumb topping until the guests have eaten themselves. Store in fridge for up to a week or freeze for up to 1 month.

title: Pasta With Choy, Thyme and Bok Choy
ingredients: 400 g penne pasta | 1 bunch bok choy, finely diced | 1 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: In a large pan, boil the pasta in salted water following packet instructions. When cooked, drain, return to pan and toss with the rest of the ingredients. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: sherry,pizza sauce,chicken breast meat,thai basil,palm sugar
title: Chicken and Basil Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast meat | 1 tablespoon roasted palm sugar | 1/3 cup fresh thai basil, sliced ( i used regular basil, but basil is also okay in the th ) | 1 cup pizza sauce | 1/3 cup dry sweet sherry or 1/3 cup rice wine vinegar
instructions: Pour all ingredients in a large nonstick skillet or wok, except the chicken. Stir fry over medium heat until chicken cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Thai Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 1/2 package frozen ladyfingers | 1/4 cup bottled pizza soda water ( or sprite or water ) | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon curry | 1 teaspoon serranos ( optional optional ) | 1 container plain low-fat yogurt
instructions: Line a 14 pizza pan with plastic wrap. Unroll frozen ladyfingers and place on top of the pizza crust. Sprinkle with curry and cumin. Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 hours. Bake at 400 f for 8 - 10 minutes or until the ladyfingers are lightly golden. Cut into eight wedges. Garnish with yogurt.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,cardamom powder,bok choy,bacon bit,kahlua,red curry paste,nonfat milk powder,cremini mushroom
title: Coconut and Bacon Protein Shake
ingredients: 3 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon nonfat dry milk powder | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 cup orange juice | 3 tablespoons kahlua | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/2 cup red curry paste | 8 ounces sliced cremini mushrooms | grated kahlua | 1/2 bacon bits
instructions: Melt all ingredients in the microwave and blend well. Pour into a bowl and top with a little piece of bacon bits before serving.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,chicken breast half,port wine,pita bread,basmati rice
title: Fennel Chicken With Pita Pasta
ingredients: 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 2-inch thick strips | 1 fennel bulb, cut into thin strips | 1/2 cup port wine or 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed | pita bread, for serving
instructions: Heat skillet over medium high heat on rimmed baking sheet. Add chicken, stirring to separate pieces. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chicken to a plate. Discard pan used as a lid. Add fennel seeds and fennel to pan. Cook 2 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in port and bring to boil. Add rice to pan.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,grain rice,coriander,olive oil cooking spray,red onion
title: Baked Rice With Coriander Dressing
ingredients: 2 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 cup long-grain rice | 1 cup finely diced red onion | 1/2 cup finely crumbled coriander
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f mix broth, garlic, seasoning in a medium saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer over low heat until liquid is absorbed.. Add rice.

title: Moroccan Fish and Dates
ingredients: 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate | 3 cups shredded cod | 1/2 cup dates, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seeds
instructions: Place orange juice concentrate in a small saucepan, and bring to simmer over low heat. Cover, and cook until thickened, about 2 minutes. Cool, and reserve 1 cup for later. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Spread cod in a baking dish, and cover the fish evenly with orange juice concentrate. Sprinkle with dates and cumin seeds, and bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes. The timing can vary based on the thickness of the fillet.

title: The Best Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 jar mango chutney ( sweet mango pickle brand from asian aisle ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Pour chutney into a bowl. Stir in oyster sauce and mix thoroughly. Spoon into serving dish and enjoy.

title: Apricot Pork Roast With Hot Fruit Sauce
ingredients: 10 large dried apricots | 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork roast, fat trimmed | 4 dried chilies | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning | 2 medium onions, sliced | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Put apricots in a roasting pan and fill with about 3/4 inch of water. Cover and bake for about 1 hour. Drain apricots, reserving 1/2 cup of the liquid, and transfer to a saucepan. Place on stove top and bring to a boil. Simmer for 3 minutes. Transfer to a large roasting pan. Cover and return to the oven. Bake for 1 hour. While apricots are cooking, chop chiles. Remove stems, seeds and pith from chiles and place in a pan with reserved liquid and sherry. Scrape all but 1 tbsp of the liquid from the pan, reduce to 1/4 and stir in the old bay. Cover and bake in the oven for 30 to 45 minutes or until tender. Remove to a cutting board and tent with foil. Remove fat from the pork and discard fat. Increase the oven temperature to 350 degrees. Slice, arrange in a single layer, and cook about 15 minutes or until brown. While pork is cooking place onions, chilis and 1/4 cup of the water. Cook over high heat, uncovered, 3 to 5 minutes, or until the onions and chilis soften. Uncover and cook for about 5 to 10 minutes or until heated through. Spoon stuffing into a bowl and combine with cooked apricots. Top with whipped topping and serve.

title: Spicy Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head red cabbage, sliced | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Place cabbage in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then immediately remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes, or until leaves are pliable. Place cabbage in a colander, drain, and squeeze out excess water. Sprinkle with chile powder. Place in a serving bowl and serve with beer.

title: The Best Szechuan Noodle Recipe
ingredients: 1 package uncooked penne pasta | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/8 teaspoon onion salt | 1 whole sweet onion, peeled and cut into thin slices
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: jumbo pasta shell,italian sausage,cilantro,coleslaw mix,chicken tender
title: Quick, Easy and Delicious Italian Sausage & Cabbage Pasta Shells
ingredients: 1 box jumbo pasta shells | 1 lb sweet italian sausage, cooked & crumbled | 2 cups coleslaw mix, finely shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 package frozen chicken tenders, thawed
instructions: Cook shells according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, over medium heat, cook sausage until it is no longer pink and the fat has been rendered. Add coleslaw mix and cilantro.

title: Easy Basil Chutney
ingredients: 2 cups fresh basil leaves | 3/4 cup soy sauce ( or tamari if you can find it )
instructions: Add basil leaves to a food processor or blender.

Random Ingredients: cranberry jam,barley,hazelnut,olive oil mayonnaise,tomato,heavy whipping cream,salt pepper,lime juice zest
title: Chunky Tomato Salad
ingredients: 7 medium ripe tomatoes, sliced 1/8'' thick | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/2 cup dried cranberries or 1/2 cup chopped dates | 2 tablespoons lime juice, freshly squeezed | 4 tablespoons olive oil ( mayonnaise mayo mayo, we used light ) | 1 tablespoon hazelnut-roasted garlic paste or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | salt and pepper ( to taste )
instructions: In a salad bowl, combine the tomatoes and nuts. In a small bowl mix the lime juice, olive oil, hazelroate garlic paste and cream, mix well. Add seasonings to taste. Gently fold sauce mix into diced tomatoes and nuts, mix well. Chill. Serve cool garnished with slivered almonds or toasted cashews.

title: Easy Grilled Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb deli roast beef, thinly sliced | 1/2 pear, sliced | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: Layer all ingredients in an internalized sandwich size serving dish and serve. If desired, spread bread with canola oil.

title: Anchovy Sticks
ingredients: 1 jar anchovy fillets, drained and chopped | 1 fresh chestnuts, peeled, deveined and chopped
instructions: Place anchovies in a food processor with chestnuts and process until finely chopped, about 20 seconds. Spoon into a bowl.

title: Herbed Pate
ingredients: 2 cups country-style bread, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon zest, minced | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon
instructions: Line an 8 inch x 8 inch baking dish with plastic wrap or 2 parchment sheets. Combine bread and next 5 ingredients, stirring until well blended. Spoon mixture into prepared pan. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes. Cut each pate into 1 1/2 inch squares. Serve.

title: Italian Sausage With Crispy Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs italian sausages | 1 cup fresh coriander seed ( coarsely crushed ) | 1 lb roast beef
instructions: Toast coriander over low heat in a small, heavy skillet, stirring as necessary, until fragrant and beginning to brown, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Preheat oven to 450°f arrange sausages on a rack in a baking pan and spread evenly. Smear with a tablespoon of butter. Bake, stirring frequently, until well browned and cooked to your liking, 12 to 15 minutes, turning once. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausages to a shallow dish and let cool. Cut into 12 slices. Reheat sausages with 2 tablespoons butter. Transfer sausage slices to a work surface and sprinkle with coriander. Arrange beef on sugared surface and drizzle with remaining butter. Wrap beef slices around sausages and bake in 450f oven for 25 minutes or until beef and coriander is beginning to crisp about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: superfine sugar,black pepper,cremini mushroom,vanilla bean,garam masala
title: Mushroom and Vanilla Bean Curry
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 1/2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 1 pinch ground black pepper | 1 star of fresh vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/2 cup chopped cremini mushrooms | 1 pinch superfine sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium high heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Cool briefly, then chill. Serve with mango chutney.

title: Maple Roast Meat
ingredients: 1 kg fatty meat, ie leg, breast, thigh, leg hoagie | 2/3 cup maple syrup | 1 kg potato, diced
instructions: Wash your fatty meat well and pat dry with paper towels. Place pork in roasting tray. Bake in oven at 180c for 30 - 15 minutes, basting occasionally.

title: Lemon, Coriander and Parsley Pesto
ingredients: 12 -15 lemons | 1 bunch fresh coriander | 1 bunch fresh parsley
instructions: Wash the coriander, parsley and lemons and put them all in a jar. Add the parsley.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,corn tortilla chip,hard egg,udon noodle,grain rice,liquid smoke,pecorino romano cheese
title: Titaina (Pork Tenderloin and Rice Noodle Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1/4 cup liquid smoke | 4 ounces pecorino romano cheese or 4 ounces asiago cheese | 6 ounces dried udon noodles | 4 ounces corn tortilla chips ( optional ) | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced ( optional ) | 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cut tenderloins lengthwise and slice crosswise in 1/4 thick slices. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Combine pork with liquid smoke, pecorino romano cheese and salt and pepper to taste. Spread pork mixture over tortilla chips. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook rice for 12 minutes. Drain. Place rice in a salad bowl, add rice and cheese and toss gently. If serving warm, serve with crackers and sliced egg if desired. Garnish with hard boiled eggs.

title: Easy and Creamy Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Pour the soup into a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat until soup is hot, about 2 minutes. Pour soup into a bowl, setting aside in refrigerator for 10 minutes. Transfer soup to a serving bowl, pour into a bowl, and serve.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,graham cracker crust,beef stew meat,pistachio,bacon dripping,garam masala
title: Indian Spiced Beef Kebabs for Two
ingredients: 2 cups finely ground beef stew meat or 2 cups other lean meat | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings, or other oil that will allow oil to seep into the meat if there are any | 1/2 cup chopped dry unsalted pistachios | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 teaspoons garam masala, spice mix for kebabs ( korma spice mix includes goya basting spice blend ) | 1 tablespoon crushed graham cracker crust
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the ground meat with the bacon drippings. Add the pistachios, garlic, garam masala spice mix and ground beef. Mix until mixture is well combined, then cover and refrigerate for at least one hour or up to two hours. Preheat the grill or a large heavy frying pan, using about 2 tablespoons of drippings. Thread the meat onto skewers, then thread each on a toothpick if using. If using wooden skewers, soak in water about 10 minutes before using.

title: Korean Beef-Ganache (Korean Beef-Shanghai Style)
ingredients: 3 ounces tequila ( korean soyri keik ) | 8 pieces bok choy | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Peel and then slice into 3 inch lengths. Drain the beef, reserving the broth. In a medium size frying pan, heat the tequila. When the tequila reduces, add the bok choy and anise seeds. Cover and cook on moderate heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the beef to the pan and cook another ten minutes, or until the beef shrinks away from the sides of the pan and is tender.

title: Baked  Baba Raita
ingredients: 12 eggplants ( large ) | 1 large cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1 green chili pepper | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, to taste
instructions: Cut eggplants in pieces like a piecrumb. Place in a pot of salted boiling water/salt and bring to a boil. Let it sit for 5 minutes. Take it out and drain. Set aside. Cut cabbage into wedges. Mix together the saffron, chilli and oil. Brush both sides of the pieces of eggplant with this sauce. Bake the pieces on the lower rack for 2 hours in a 350 degree oven or for 40 minutes in a 325 degree oven. Remove pieces. Spread a little oil on a cookie sheet/lasagne pan to dry it a little bit on top. Drizzle with the remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,peanut oil,lemon juice zest,hard egg,almond extract
title: Mock Puffs
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups graham cracker crumbs | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 4 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 cup freshly ground blanched almond ( shabbob or almonds could be used instead ) | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon rind
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Prepare pastry,. Mix first 5 ingredients together in a bowl using a fork. Stir in almond. Roll dough to 1/4 cup in diameter. Place on a lightly floured surface, knead until smooth. Dough will be a little fluffier than normal for this tart. Cut dough into strips about 1/2 wide. Starting at the long end, roll each strip into a 3 inch long log. Repeat until all strips are rolled. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake for about 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,scallop,white vinegar,hot water,gingerroot,ale,active yeast,green pea
title: Sage and Lemon Dill Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups hot water | 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup scallops | 1/2 cup dried yellow pea | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1 package refrigerated pizza dough, room temperature
instructions: Place scallops and pea in a large bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Cover and let stand in a warm place for 20 minutes. Drain pea mixture. Mix vinegar, salt, and ginger in a small bowl. Add yeast mixture.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,lasagna noodle,lemon thyme,steak,egg yolk water
title: Beef & Bean Sprouts Ramen
ingredients: 2 cans fat-free refried beans ( i like fat-free ) | 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced | 1 jar lemon thyme, leaves well packed ( i have used fresh thyme leaves ) | 1 large egg yolk ( i use just a few teaspoons water when i've tried it ) | 12 lasagna noodles ( i always use the thin, wide rectangular shape the pasta is called for in some countries, they vary in their taste and width )
instructions: Mix all ingredients except noodles in a small bowl. Place a layer of noodles in the bottom of a greased baking pan. Spread 1/3 of the beans/dice mixture over the noodles. Spread evenly with 2 tablespoons of noodles. Cover with a layer of beef. Repeat layers in this manner, ending with a layer of noodles, then the rest of the beans/dice mixture & beef. Brush noodles with egg wash and sprinkle with paprika. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate 4 hrs to overnight. Bake in preheated 400f oven for 20 minutes or until noodles are tender.

Random Ingredients: wheat tortilla,red wine vinegar,white vinegar,semolina,beef bouillon cube
title: Crock Pot Whole Wheat Burritos
ingredients: 3/4 cup white vinegar | 2 beef bouillon cubes or 3/4 teaspoon beef base | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 cups fine ground semolina | 1 package whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Combine vinegar, boullion and 1/4 cup water in crock pot. Cover and cook on high setting 5 - 6 hours. Remove 1/2 cup water if soup appears dry, stir in semolina and keep on high setting. Allow to cool to room temperature. Wrap 1/4 cup of burrito mixture in tortilla. Cook on warm setting for 10 minutes or until burrito resembles a paste. Serve on tortillas with salsa, guacamole, sour cream, lettuce, tomato, jalapeno or other desired toppings. Yummy.

title: Tarte Flambee(Tarte Flambee)
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed | 1 tablespoon margarine ( i use butter and i have never used margarine. ) | 1 stalk celery, sliced | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar, packed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line a baking tray with baking paper. On a lightly floured work surface, roll out pastry to a 6 inch round about 6mm thick and 7inches in diameter. Using a 2½ inch round cookie cutter, cut out rounds from rounds. Gather scraps of pastry if necessary. On a floured surface, using a 2½ inch round cookie cutter, cut out 1 circles from pastry. Place rounds, 1cm apart, on prepared tray. Bake in middle of 200 degrees celsius oven for 12 minutes, or until bottoms are golden brown. Remove from oven and sprinkle lightly with sugar. Return to over and bake for 5 minutes, until golden and crisp and bubbling. Remove from oven and slice into wedges.

title: Warm Woolly <INPUT_START> nut Paste
ingredients: 450 g walnut pieces | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leave | 1 tablespoon walnut pieces finely chopped fresh edible herbs ( optional )
instructions: Place walnut pieces, 1/4 tsp of thyme, and 1 tbsp of fine dried edible herbs into the work bowl of a food processor. Cover the top surface with waxed paper. Pulse 10 times and check the texture is to your liking, adding a little water if necessary.

title: Perfect Easy Mini Cheese Empanadas
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed ( i use trader joe's mini-cheese pastry ) | 1 cup fine semolina | 1 cup ranch dressing
instructions: Unfold the puff pastry sheets on a lightly floured surface. Using a rolling pin, roll out each sheet to about 12x12, approximately 4x4 inches. To make the pastries, preheat oven at 350°f spread each sheet lightly with the ranch dressing. Evenly sprinkle the pastries with the fine semolina. Using your finger, press down the center of each pasty to slightly flatten the pastry. Cut the pastries into 1/2 inch slices. Place the slices on a non stick baking sheet, and bake on the middle rack for about 10 minutes or until light golden. Let cool on wire racks.

Random Ingredients: beef,rice noodle,mango,pineapple chunk,golden raisin,celery rib,tomato soup
title: American Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 mango - peeled, seeded, and diced | 1 can pineapple chunks | 1/3 pound ground beef, or as desired | 2 celery ribs, chopped | 1/3 cup golden raisins ( optional )
instructions: Place the noodles in a large pot, and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Stir the tomato soup and mango into the cooked noodles. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat, and cook and stir the ground beef until evenly browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,plain flour,tart apple,vermicelli pasta,limeade concentrate,phyllo pastry
title: Crispy Pizza Crackers
ingredients: 300 g frozen tart apple slices | 300 g vermicelli pasta | pepperoni, sliced | 50 g frozen limeade concentrate | 500 g plain flour | 250 g frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Bake pastry for 8 - 10 minutes. Remove and cool on a tray. Mix all ingredients and spread mixture onto the cooled pastry. Cut into strips. Sprinkle lightly with sifted plain flour. Bake on baking tray for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Apricot Jelly (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 125 g apricot jam | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c or 400f. In a small bowl combine jam and rice wine. Pour into greased jelly mould. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until centre is firm and jam is syrupy.

title: Italian Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons italian seasoning
instructions: Combine. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. This recipe makes approximately 1 1/2 tablespoons.

title: Baked Creamy Apricot Penne With Walnuts
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 4 ounces dried apricots | chicken or pork sauce | chopped walnuts, to serve
instructions: Cook the pasta per instructions on the packet and drain. Stir through the apricots, breaking up the apricots and mix with the pasta. Place in a baking dish. Brush onto the sauce, scatter with walnuts.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,thai chili sauce,sesame oil,chicken bouillon cube
title: Kama Shoyu Chicken Base, Chinese for Canapes (Ganeng Kook)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon canola oil | 3/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon thai sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a medium bowl combine all ingredients. Place a paper cutting board or pliable aluminum foil into a cookie sheet. Roll dough into 3/4 inch diameter log. Place logs on the foil and pinch off a small piece on top of each one. This will allow the steam inside the logs to escape. Do not use a food processor for this step, only a processor because it is not a preservative. Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until done.

title: Chilled Cherry Tomato Relish
ingredients: 4 cups pitted cherry tomatoes | 4 cups cooked chickpeas | 3 cups fine breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons finely grated orange peel | 1/3 cup irish whiskey
instructions: In a shallow bowl soak the tomatoes in boiling water for 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salad green,crawfish tail,sea salt,peanut oil,oil,fruit,green cardamom pod,chocolate syrup
title: Crawfish Salad with Chocolate Syrup Dressing
ingredients: 4 large ripe mixed salad greens | 6 tablespoons smooth peanut oil | 5 ounces chopped mixed candied fruit | 3 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 tablespoon good quality chocolate syrup | 1 1/2 lbs cleaned crawfish tails | sea salt | 1 teaspoon oil
instructions: For the salad, cut the mixed salad leaves into two or three pieces, and place them in a salad bowl. In a small bowl whisk together the peanut oil, candied fruit, green cardamom, chocolate syrup, and 1 1/4 cups of the cold water. Pour the peanut mixture over the salad and toss. Add the remaining cold water and stir until well coated. Let stand about 10 minutes. While the salad is standing, rinse the crawfish tails, separate them from shell. Split them into two portions, and coarsely chop together. Dip the crawfish tails into the peanut dressing and arrange them around the salad. Sprinkle with sea salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: pork rib,chuck roast,pecan,tequila,fine breadcrumb,vegetable oil,pepper,sea salt
title: Mexican Pork Ribs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons caribbean pepper ( can sub black pepper powder ) | 2 tablespoons pecans, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 2 lbs chuck roast or 2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed of any visible fat | 1 1/2 cups tequila, preferably a good one ( or less ) | 2 cups vegetable oil | 24 ounces loose-pack beer, such as corona or heineken
instructions: In shallow metal or plastic dish or plastic bag, combine the bread crumbs, pepper and 1/2 cup water.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 3/4 cup hot water | 1 cup salsa verde ( canned red salsa )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together hot water and salsa verde.

title: Potato Crumble
ingredients: 5 small russet potatoes, scrubbed | 1/2 cup cornflour ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 120c/300f or 180c if fan forced. Bake potatoes for 30 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon oil or 2 tablespoons cooking fat in a frying pan and fry potatoes over low heat, turning with a wooden spoon or a slotted spoon. Remove from the pan and spread the warm potatoes evenly over an ovenproof dish. Sprinkle over half a teaspoon of cornflour and then dot with the remaining fat or oil. Sprinkle with remaining cornflour, then bake for 20 minutes or until golden and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,arborio rice,chunky peanut butter,cumin seed,lemon grass,pernod,fish
title: Peanut Butter and Lemon Grass Pilaf
ingredients: 1 lb rice, such as arborio | 1/2 teaspoon fystium fish | 4 hot red chili peppers, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 bunches lemon grass, trimmed, white parts only, cut in 2 inch segments | 3 tablespoons chunky peanut butter, creamy smooth | 4 teaspoons parernod | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 whole hot red chili pepper, shredded
instructions: Cook rice according to pack instructions and set aside. Heat a heavy based saucepan over medium high heat. Add rice and fry for 3 - 4 minutes, or until the kernels start to change colour. Add chilies, lemon grass, peanut butter and spice mix. Simmer for 5 - 10 minutes or until fragrant. Serve pilaf topped with shredded red pepper, lemon grass and chopped coriander leaves.

title: Jalapeno Slaw
ingredients: 1 large jalapeno, seeded and cut into matchsticks | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 cups shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Place the jalapeno on a small plate and wrap loosely with a microwave safe paper towel to capture moisture. Microwave on high power for 1 minute. Carefully remove paper towel, and transfer jalapeno to a small bowl. Stir in the balsamic vinegar. Add lettuce, and gently toss to coat. Serve.

title: Fried Pepperoncini
ingredients: 12 small hot pepperoncini peppers | 3 1/3 cups cake flour
instructions: Cut peppers lengthwise in half, remove seeds and membrane. Dip peppers into bowl of cold water to soften. Place hot pepperoncini peppers and 1/3 cup cake flour into medium frying pan. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, or until slightly browned. Remove and cool. When cool enough to handle, use fingers to roll and press a small amount of hot pepperoncini mixture into desired shapes.

title: Venezuelan Munchy Nachos (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 6 poblano chiles ( about 3-inch in size ) or 6 any mild green chiles, seeded and sliced ( about 3-inch in size ) | 2 packages packages johnson frozen mixed vegetables ( thawed ) | 8 ounces smoked lite sausage, sliced into 1/3-inch slices | 1 package ramen noodles, seasoning mix per package directions ( broken into two parts per package contents ) | 1 tablespoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | corn tortilla, warmed | 1 hass avocado, sliced
instructions: Set 4 large oven racks to lowest temperature and set aside. Rinse the vegetables under cold water and pat dry. Place the chiles on a large rimmed baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, toss to coat, and place in the hot oven. Roast, turning frequently, until charred all over and just beginning to soften, about 20 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and let cool. Place the vegetables, sausage, noodles, seasoning per package directions, and allspice in a large bowl and mash. Stir in the roasted poblano chiles. Spray two baking sheets with cooking spray and spread the mashed vegetables onto the bottom of each lightly lightly sprinkled baking sheet. Cover the vegetables with 2 to 3 layers of tomato basil foil, to keep them from sticking. Bake in the oven until heated through and beginning to brown, about 20 minutes.. Top each serving with a slice of avocado and a toasted tortilla. Note, although johnson serves his own meal with this meal, it is their themselves to choose which ingredients to use.

title: Tepsi Phrik
ingredients: 1 egg yolk and 2 tsp sugar | 1 g asafoetida powder ( methi ) | 12 dried apricots, chopped and soaked in | 1/4 cup boiling hot water
instructions: In a small bowl mix egg yolk, sugar and asafoetida together well and set for 5 minutes. Wash and dry apricots. Drain soaked apricots well. Dry the apricots in the remaining oil. Keep aside. In a pressure cooker, pour the apricots and water in the mixture followed by the drained apricots. Close the cover and put on medium heat{100 degrees to 300°c, or if using the pressure cooker, 180 degrees to 300 degreesc and cook for 15 minutes. Serve hot with bread.

title: Meatballs in Sweet Wine
ingredients: 2 pounds ground meat | 3 cups dry bread crumbs | 1 cup molasses | 1 can or bottle dark sweet wine vinegar, chilled
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Mix meat, bread crumbs, molasses, and vinegar together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,vanilla pudding mix,cream celery soup,bragg liquid amino,cheese tortellini
title: Delicious Tostada Tricolor
ingredients: 1 package cheese tortellini | 2 cans cream of celery soup | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 2 cups cheese flavored tortellini | 1 1/2 cups vinegar | 1/2 cup liquid from refried beans or 1/2 cup apple jelly
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: turkey bacon,water chestnut,vinegar,season salt,cardamom seed,chicken stock cube,sea salt
title: Warm Bacon, Chestnut & Cardamom Dressing for Lamb
ingredients: 1 packet chicken stock cubes | 1/4 cup boiling water chestnut, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon fresh ground cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon turkish bacon or 1/2 teaspoon raki bacon | 1/2 teaspoon season-all salt
instructions: Put all ingredients into a blender and mix until the dressing is as smooth or smooth as you like it.

Random Ingredients: bacon bit,jalapeno jack cheese,rum,tahini paste,white potato,bamboo shoot
title: Roasted Green Potato and Pea Bites
ingredients: 6 medium white potatoes, scrubbed | 1 teaspoon tahini paste | 1/4 cup crushed fresh jalapeno jack cheese | 1 jar bacon bits | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 tablespoon rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Grease the bottom of a glass baking dish. Cut the potatoes in half lengthwise, and scoop out as many of the center with a spoon as possible. Cut each portion in half again, or cut through the halves again if you like. Toss the potatoes with the tahini paste in a large bowl. Stir jalapeno jack cheese into the potato mixture. Layer the bacon bits, bamboo shoots, and rum among the potato mixture. Cover the dish, and bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven. Uncover the dish, and bake for 15 more minutes, until the mixture is hot and bubbly.

title: Homemade Taco Seasoning
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons greek seasoning | 3/4 cup water, divided
instructions: In an 8 1/2 cup microwave safe cup, combine all ingredients.

title: Quinoa With Fenugreek and Vinegar (Mujadarah)
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 3 tablespoons quinoa or 3 tablespoons ground sago | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Wash the quinoa and quinoa in a strainer over a bowl, then spread out in a flat layer on a heavy flat surface or baking sheet. Allow the quinoa to steam for 40 to 45 minutes, or until all the grains are a little browned and the quinoa is cooked through.. Meanwhile, to make the dressing, heat a large, heavy frying pan over medium heat. Add the quinoa and salt. When it smells fragrant, about 3 minutes give the quinoa a quick stir, then pour in the vinegar, making sure it dissolves into the quinoa. Stir the quinoa around until it’s all coated in the dressing. When it’s done, about 45 to 60 minutes stir, then serve.

title: Pizzaria - Anchovy-Spooning Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust ( your own or homemade ) | 3 anchovies, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | chopped fresh chervil ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c. Arrange pizza on non stick baking tray. Mix the anchovies, brown sugar and cannellinni beans and spread evenly over the pizza crust, finishing with some of the chopped chervil. Bake about 20 - 30 minutes or until bubbling around the edges and cheese is melting. Serve hot, warm or room temperature. Variation, for a slightly heavier pizza, double the cannellini beans and mix the anchovy mixture with the olive oil and lemon juice to taste. For a thicker, more savory pizza, chill for 20 - 30 minutes, then stir the cannellini beans into the crust.

title: Snow Peas With Queso Content
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh snow peas | 1 tablespoon salt | 1 ounce fresh manchego cheese, cut into thin 2-inch cubes | 1 ounce fresh red onion, chopped
instructions: Wash snow peas and snap peas, removing any tough ends and strings. Put in a bowl with salt, cheese, red onion and enough froth to cover. Mix well. Put it back in the bowl for at least 2 hours stirring occasionally. Serve on warm kaiser rolls with pickled horseradish, garlic and pepper.

title: Apricot Soho Salmon & Aubergines, #10
ingredients: 200 g dried apricots | 250 g crispy noodles, any shape | 200 g good quality salmon, rinsed and patted dry | 150 g cremini mushrooms, sliced | 100 ml orange juice | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup golden syrup
instructions: In a large pan, add apricots, noodles and salmon. Cover and leave to marinate for 12 to 24 hours in the fridge, stir often to make sure the apricots are mixed throughout until all ingredients are fully cooked and plump. Drain, remove stems and discard. Remove rind from mushrooms. Slice and remove all woody parts then slice into long thin strips. Combine orange juice, malt vinegar and golden syrup. Add all dressing ingredients and toss together gently until it's well combined. Divide the pasta between 4 serving plates and top with salmon mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Sea Bass with Fresh Strawberry and Aaubergine Salad
ingredients: 1 large aubergine, quartered lengthways, ends scored off, peeled and cut into 4 slices | 1 lb sea bass fillet | 1 packet ready-made baked elbow macaroni | 1 bunch rocket, washed and tailed | 3 tablespoons honey
instructions: Lightly oil a grill. Cook the aubergine and sea bass for 6 minutes each side over a medium high heat, basting occasionally with water, until lightly cooked through. Set aside while you warm up the grill, making the salad. Cook the macaroni according to pack instructions. Drain and cool under running water, then tip in to a large bowl. Wash the rocket and tailed rocket. Arrange the salad on a serving platter. Drizzle over the honey with a splash of olive oil. Scatter over the sea bass and aubergine. To eat, cut a piece of garlic crouton.

title: Greek Lamb for Crockpot or Dinner
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs of lean leg of lamb | 1 can tomato paste ( or paste of your choice )
instructions: Cut lamb into serving portions removing fat. Add tomato paste. Place chicken in casserole dish. Add enough water to cover meat. Cover and cook on low setting for 6 - 8 hours. Remove cover. Remove lid. Increase heat to high setting and cook on high for 30 - 45 minutes or until meat is tender. Remove meat and skim off fat from cooking liquid. Serve with hot bread with mashed potatoes.

title: Beef Burgundy in Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, trim fat | 8 ounces bamboo shoots, chopped | 8 ounces red beans | 1 teaspoon savory
instructions: Cut steak into 1/2 inch cubes. Place them in bottom of crockpot, layer ingredients in the following order, fat, beef, red beans. Cook on high for 4 - 6 hours. Serve over hot rice.

title: Pecans- Pecans "Fried" (From R.l. Anderson)
ingredients: 12 ounces shelled pecan pieces, plus additional | panko breadcrumbs | pepperidge farm herb bread crumbs ( or regular cracker crumbs )
instructions: Place the pecans and as much bread crumbs as desired in a food processor and process until well mixed. Using a spatula, press the mixture into a well buttered pan and sprinkle evenly with pepperidge farm herb crumbs. Heat the crumb topping over low heat, shaking the pan often and watching carefully as it thickens.

title: Italian Chicken Meatball Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs skinless chicken meat | 10 ounces water chestnuts | 1/8 cup low sodium dark chocolate | 1/2 cup pizza pepperoni, julienned | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Boil water and salt in covered saucepan. Add meat. Cook over low heat for 3 hours. Add peppers, cheese, basil and oregano.

title: Easy Mushroom Cream Gravy
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup ghee ( optional ) or 1/4 cup butter, melted ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Pour condensed soup into a medium bowl. Add melted ghee or butter, and mustard. Mix well. Add creamy mushroom soup onto the mix. Blend well after mixing. Serve over hot basmati rice or as a light meal on a french bread.

title: Jamaican Hummus
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry cannellini beans or 1/2 cup great northern beans | 2 (.18 ounce ) packages active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f and line 2 2/3 cup sized loaf pans with parchment paper. Split open the beans and scrape the beans from the rinsed bean. Place the beans, bean side down, on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Stir the yeast and mace in a small bowl to blend. Let stand until a creamy foam begins to form, about 5 minutes. Add 3 tablespoons of warm water and 1 teaspoons of salt, and mix thoroughly. Stir in the beans and mix in the remaining water by spoonfuls until they resemble a thick, round brick of bean soup. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes. Bake in preheated oven until top is golden and sound hollow when nudged, about 25 minutes. Cool 5 minutes in pan. Remove from pan and turn onto a cutting board. Place on a cutting board and cut in slices to serve.

title: Roasted Veggies Salad
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 bunch radish, halved, ends trimmed | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Place the radishes cut side up in a roasting pan. Drizzle with light coat of spray. Sprinkle lightly with five spice powder. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, or until crisp and golden. Remove from oven and cool until cool enough to handle. Using a spoon, scoop out the inside. Carefully pull out the hard green center of the bunch. Break away any hard stem sections. Drizzle the mustard dressing over the greens, and mix well. Spoon onto a platter, and top with roasted radishes.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,adobo sauce,edamame,dill weed,ladyfinger,chili paste,canadian bacon,pecorino cheese
title: Smoky Edamame Sandwiches (Foodfit website)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh dill weed | 3 lbs round rye bread | 4 large smoked canadian bacon ( about 8 slices ) | 1 lb frozen shelled edamame | 5 tablespoons chili paste | 6 teaspoons adobo sauce | 4 packages small fresh ladyfingers | 8 cups grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Place dill in a blender, and process until finely chopped. Pour into a bowl, add bread and grind for 30 seconds. Let stand 5 min.. Meanwhile, fry bacon in a large non stick skillet until lightly crispy. Add dill paste, a couple pinches of adobo sauce, and chili paste. Stir until sauce is well mixed. Remove from heat. Toast bread, spread with a little mustard. Cut a piece of bread on a cutting board.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,black olive,extra beef,spinach,red bell pepper
title: Spanish Savory Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 bone-in pork roast | 14 ounces white pearl onions ( use one large, quartered, or use 1 large onion, sliced thinly ) | 1 can black olives, drained | 1 red bell pepper, sliced thin | 1 package frozen chopped spinach
instructions: Place the bone in the crock pot, reserving 1/2 cup for the topping. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well, cover, and cook on high for 4 hours, then switch to low and allow 10 hours to cook on low heat.. Ladle into large freezer bag and serve with your choice of side dish. This can also be made in a crock pot on high for 1 1/2 2 hours. Be sure to scrape the bottom of the crock pot with a wooden spoon to release the browned bits of food from the bottom. If the meat can't be picked up and cooked, then add the 1/2 cup broth. Let cool.

title: Chili Roast Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled and sliced into rounds | 1 can of chopped pumpkin seeds | 4 inch piece ginger, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons chili paste or 2 teaspoons anise extract | 3 -6 lbs beef brisket
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Place potatoes onto paper towels and shake out as much excess moisture as possible. Place the russet potatoes onto a rack in a roasting pan, and roast for 2 hours. Cool. Meanwhile, combine the pumpkin seeds, ginger and chili paste and spread over the brisket. Increase the heat under the roasting pan to 400 degrees f and roast for another hour, basting every 20 to 30 minutes. Remove brisket and allow to rest for 15 minutes before carving. Serve with gravy from the roasting pan.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,red pepper flake,orange bell pepper,pomegranate seed,green bell pepper,tomato paste,extra beef,orange flower water
title: Moroccan Spiced Baked Eggs With Oranges
