ingredients: 4 large eggs | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 tablespoon fresh orange flower water | 1 teaspoon orange flower water ( optional ) | 12 ounces frozen tiny whole chickpeas, thawed | 1 1/2 red bell peppers, stemmed, seeded & sliced | 1 1/2 green bell peppers, stemmed, seeded & sliced | 1 pinch crushed red pepper flakes | pomegranate seeds, garnish
instructions: Break the eggs into a large bowl, whisking constantly with a fork.

title: Easy Quick Taco Sauce
ingredients: 28 ounces tomato puree | 28 ounces maple syrup | 1 packet taco seasoning
instructions: Stir together in a non stick pan and heat to the boiling point. Add 1 packet of taco seasoning and leave to simmer for 2 mins on low. Tip, to make a thick and smooth texture put the sauce in a microwave safe bowl and heat on high 30 secs add 1/2 packet of taco seasoning and mix it inches.

title: Lima Bean Spread
ingredients: 3 cups lima beans ( about 100 grams/7oz. ) | 3 ounces dates or 3 ounces other dried fruit, chopped ( 1 1/4oz. ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leave | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground vanilla extract
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth. Spread in an oiled 1 1/2 quart jar or pan. Store in a cool, dark place for up to a year.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,confectioner ' sugar,chicken stock powder,turmeric
title: Tajine Murgh - Moroccan Yellow Cardamom Green Tea - Canning Recipe.
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups chicken stock powder | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 3 3/8 teaspoons ground turmeric | 1 teaspoon ground green cardamom pods ( optional )
instructions: Mix the chicken stock powder, 2 tablespoons of confectioners' sugar, 2 teaspoons of turmeric, and 1 teaspoon of green cardamom in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat. Cover and let rest for 5 minutes. Line a 3 cup capacity food storage plastic bag with cheese cloth and set aside. Place the remaining 1 teaspoon of confectioners' sugar and 1 teaspoon of turmeric in a small mortar and pestle. Grind to a powder that is fairly thin.

Random Ingredients: allspice,salad green,beef chuck roast,iceberg lettuce,velveeta cheese,baking powder,bread
title: Savory Sandwich for Two
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, fat and silverskin removed | 6 slices bread | 3 ounces velveeta cheese ( velveeta is not available in the mexican food section of your grocery store. ) | 5 leaves iceberg lettuce ( cleaned, washed and trimmed of excess moisture ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon allspice | salad greens, salad, salad, and tomato ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat grill to high and lightly oil the grates. Trim roast if desired. Slice meat into 1/4 inch thick strips over the grain. Place half of this strips on each slice of bread. Lightly coat one side of each piece of meat with olive oil and sprinkle with baking powder. On one piece of each piece of bread with the cheese, place one strip of meat and top with lettuce. Place the other slice of bread, oiled side down, on top of the lettuce. Place the roast on a lightly oiled grill directly over the hot coals. Close the lid tightly, and cook for 12 to 14 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees f. Cut the sandwich in 4 equal pieces, sprinkle with remaining baking powder, and serve.

title: Spicy Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 medium lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon oregano
instructions: Cook Ziti according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cool water. Combine ginger and garlic paste in a small bowl, and place in microwave for 1 minute or until warm. Microwave until garlic is light, 3 - 4 minutes. Arrange ziti in a large casserole dish, and place lettuce leaves around it. Sprinkle with oregano. Pour marinade over ziti, and cook covered on high for 2 minutes or until heated through and ziti is heated through. Turn off heat. Serve hot.

title: Amaretto Glazed Pork Roast!
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb center cut boneless pork shoulder | 15 ounces amaretto, warmed ( amaretto liqueur ) | pepper ( freshly ground or freshly grated, to taste )
instructions: Place pork shoulder in large dutch oven. Sprinkle with amaretto liqueur. Pour warm amaretto mixture over meat. Cover tightly and place in a 500 degree oven for two hours. Remove meat from oven and allow to cool for ten minutes. Score thickest part and discard fat. Dry meat with paper towels, and season with pepper when done. Transfer meat to cutting board or serving platter and slice very thin and serve.

title: Pasta Shells - Tapas
ingredients: 1 package frozen cannellini beans | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds, or more to taste | 2 pounds fresh tilapia fillets
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add cannellini beans, and cook until softened, 6 to 8 minutes. Dice or use a food processor to coarsely grind beans. Coarsely chop tilapia fillets into bite size pieces, about 2 tablespoons. Bring cooked cannellini beans to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to medium, and continue cooking and stirring until sauce reduces to about 2 tablespoons, about 5 minutes. Toss with remaining ingredients.

title: Eggless Black-Eyed Bean Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces italian bread or 8 ounces french bread, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 can black-eyed peas
instructions: Cut bread pieces into pieces and put in a microwave safe casserole dish with enough water to cover. Cover and cook in microwave on high 5 minutes or until bread is toasted and liquid has been absorbed. Break into pieces and put into serving bowl.

title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken drumsticks | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix
instructions: Preheat the oven's broiler. If you have a baking sheet, place the chicken drumsticks on the sheet. If not, place 3 cloves of garlic in the center of the baking sheet. Spread the taco seasoning over each drumstick, and carefully place them onto the sheet. Broil the chicken until the taco seasoning turns a rich golden brown, about 20 minutes, turning once.

title: Chess Strawberries
ingredients: 3 cups fresh strawberries | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 -3 tablespoons parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 4 tablespoons dried strawberries | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots
instructions: Cut strawberries in half lengthwise and remove the stem so that the strawberries will sit flat on the cutting board. Roughly chop and place strawberries, 1/2 teaspoon of garlic salt, parmigiano reggiano cheese and dried strawberries in a serving bowl. Using a mortar and pestle, pound lightly until combined. Add 2 tablespoons of parmigiano reggiano and dried strawberries and mix. Divide evenly between 4 dinner plates. Sprinkle with crushed garlic salt and slice crosswise into wedges. Note, i use fresh strawberries, cut in half and pitted and sliced crosswise. Note, if it looks more like you want to cut larger strawberries but have smaller pieces, use smaller pieces.

title: Guacamole-Cauliflower Salad-Salad
ingredients: 2 large heads cauliflower ( about 2 lbs. or 4 to 6 medium heads, depending on size of cauliflower ) | 3 large eggs, lightly beaten | 2 green cardamom pods, bruised in a mortar with a pestle, crushed ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 tablespoon fresh grated guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Core and chop cauliflower coarsely, then place in a large saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 30 minutes or until cauliflower is just tender enough to pierce with a fork. Drain all the oil from the pan, then cool cauliflower. Add eggs and gently beat with a fork, stirring to combine. Transfer cauliflower eggs to a medium bowl and toss with the green cardamom pods, red wine vinegar and paprika. Serve immediately with guacamole and cilantro.

Random Ingredients: double acting baking powder,cremini mushroom,basmati rice,paprika,canola oil,egg white,jalapeno chile,cream tartar
title: Mushroom and Creamy Rice Blush
ingredients: 4 ounces cremini mushrooms | 1/2 cup cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon double-acting baking powder | 2 large egg whites | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 jalapeno chile, minced | 1/2 cup basmati rice, uncooked | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Chop mushrooms using food processor or blender. Combine cream of tarter, paprika, and double acting baking powder in a small dish or saucepan. Set aside. With electric mixer, beat egg whites in small bowl with cream of tartar until soft peaks form just barely beginning to form peaks, about 2 minutes. Set aside. Heat 2 tbsps oil or canola oil in small skillet over medium high heat. Add half of mushroom mixture and stir, cooking until tender, 3 - 4 minutes. Remove to medium bowl. Repeat with second 1/2 of mushrooms. Blend mushroom mixture with cream of tarter mixture, then fold into mushroom mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Let rest 15 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 300 degrees. Line baking sheet with foil. Combine rice with cream of tartar in large bowl. Using hands, make holes in rice with a fork. Arrange rice in a single layer in prepared baking sheet, spacing apart. Sprinkle top half with jalapeno and remaining jalapeno. Stir mushroom mixture through rice and bake until golden brown, about 20 minutes if rice and mushroom mixture are not completely cooked. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sage,oregano,grainy mustard,bell pepper,thyme sprig,pork loin,lemon pepper,deli ham
title: Italian Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 lbs pork loin | 5 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon sage | 4 tablespoons thinly sliced deli ham | 4 tablespoons thinly sliced bell peppers, any color
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix the mustard, lemon pepper, thyme, oregano and sage. Remove the meat from the refrigerator, and place it on top of the mustard mixture. Top with the ham and bell peppers. Cover, and chill overnight. Preheat the oven to 350 f or 180 c. Bake for 75 - 80 minutes, or until the meat thermometer reaches 220°f.

title: Lentils and Soy
ingredients: 500 g lentils | soy sauce ( to taste ) | white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Rinse lentils in a colander and place in a saucepan using a heavy bottomed frying pan. Pour enough water in pan to cover lentils completely, about 1 1/2 inches. Cover pan and simmer lentils over medium heat for 15 minutes or until tender. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wide egg noodle,carrot,irish cream,baby onion,tabasco sauce,sage leaf,fish fillet,lemon
title: Yorkshire Style Fish & Noodles
ingredients: 4 fish fillets, cut in half and skinned | 2 ounces wide egg noodles, about | 4 tablespoons irish cream | 2 tablespoons carrots, grated | 1 tablespoon lemon rind, grated | 5 leaves fresh sage leaves | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | baby onion, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c. Put fish in baking dish and skin them if desired. Bake in oven for 10 minutes or until just cooked and turning once. Meanwhile, cook noodles as per packet instructions, drain and keep warm. Heat remaining ingredients, except onion, in pan and bring to the boil. Pour over fish, sprinkle with the onion.

title: Eggs Parmigiano--Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs | 250 g gorgonzola cheese or 250 g pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Finely grate the cheese on the large holes of a box grater into a large bowl. Cut a deep slit in each egg. Carefully crack the eggs one at a time into their cavities. Do not allow the yolks to reach the cavities. Leave to rest in the bowl until all of the cheese is used to fill them. Fill a hot pan half full of water and add a tablespoon of olive oil spray or lard. Place the stuffed eggs in the pan, leaving enough space around the whites so that they can lie flat on the top. Once the water has boiled, turn heat down. Using a fork, press a white or browned ramekin inside of each yolk, ensuring nothing sticks to it. Cover the pan tightly and cook for 5 minutes so that the oil can get to inside the shell. Scoop out the yolks and serve with your favorite garnishes.

title: Blackberry and Orange Soup (Sopa De Bolo Blanco)
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh blackberries ( about 20 ) | 8 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 orange, peeled, cut into eighths
instructions: Place the blackberries in a sieve and place over a bowl of cold water to drain. In a 5 quart pot, combine the blackberries, stock, sugar and orange juice. Bring just to a full boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer 15 minutes. Ladle into warm bowls and top with blackberries on top.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,yellow onion,yellow squash,wheat tortilla,orzo pasta,blue curacao,heavy cream,chipotle chile
title: Ww Core Italian Orzo Enchiladas
ingredients: 8 whole wheat tortillas | 1 1/4 cups orzo pasta, uncooked | 1 large yellow onion, thinly sliced | 1/2 yellow squash, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup blue curacao | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 3/4 teaspoon chipotle chiles, minced ( add more if desired ) | 1 romaine lettuce leaf
instructions: Place a large skillet over medium heat. Add tortillas, sprinkle with cheese and cook 1 or 3 minutes turning carefully until tortillas turn golden brown on both sides. Drain. Remove tortillas, place on foil lined baking sheet. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. In a large bowl, toss together the pasta, onion, squash, curacao, cream and chipotle. Spoon pasta mixture into tortillas, dividing evenly. Place a romaine leaf on top of the pasta mixture. Roll up and place seam side down in baking dish. Bake 10 minutes or until the top is lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,ginger ale,seitan,tomato sauce,apricot nectar juice
title: Spiced Baked Eggs With Apricots, Apricots and Ginger
ingredients: 4 tomatoes | 1/4 cup apricot nectar or 1/4 cup juice | 1/4 cup seitan | 1 quart stewed seitan or 1 quart other smoked salmon | 4 scoops vanilla ice cream | ginger ale or lager-flavored lima bean, and
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and position rack in center of oven. Cut 4 small slits in each tomato. Insert into each slit. Place tomatoes on a baking sheet and cook for 15 minutes. Cut 4 small slits into tops of the tops and then insert a serrated knife into the top of each tomato. Bake until tomatoes soften and start giving off liquid about 10 minutes. Remove tomatoes and let cool completely, about 20 minutes. Cut in half and arrange 1 peach half, cut side up, on each slice. Cut remaining peach into thin wedges and arrange on top of tomatoes, cut side down. Top peaches with seitan and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving. To serve, arrange steaks on plates or plates and spoon stewed apricots and juice over them. Garnish with slivers or slices of ginger ale or lager.

Random Ingredients: vodka,green chilies,pecan,chili pepper,cheddar cheese,basil leaf,romaine lettuce
title: Vodka-Smoked Chile Shreds
ingredients: 2 cans diced green chilies ( spicy if you like ) | 1/8 teaspoon crushed chili pepper | 1 1/4 lbs cheddar cheese | 10 large basil leaves | 1 small romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup chopped pecans | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: Slice chilies lengthwise 1/2 inch thick and arrange in single layer in shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with crushed pepper. Cut cheese 1 inch thick and arrange on chilies. Top with basil, romaine lettuce and pecans. Pour vodka around all and dot top with butter. Bake at 350 degrees 20 minutes, until golden.

title: Pasta With Cashews and Walnuts
ingredients: 2 boxes rigatoni pasta ( small pasta of your choice ) | 1/2 lb cashews | 2 serrano peppers, chopped | 1 cup walnuts, chopped | 1 jar roasted cashews, packed for garnish ( with liquid, like brandy ) | 1 box pasta shells
instructions: Cook the rigatoni in boiling water until al dente.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,chili pepper,poppy seed,sage,buckwheat noodle,chunky peanut butter
title: Lennie's Noodles
ingredients: 3 cups buckwheat noodles | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon poppy seed, dry roasted ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chili pepper, roasted ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon sage ( optional )
instructions: Boil noodles until tender drain. In a small saucepan, combine peanut butter, egg yolk, poppy seeds, chili peppers, and sage. Heat while stirring until mixture is warmed, about a minute.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,dark chocolate,cayenne pepper,baby spinach,ginger juice,water chestnut,orange zest,clove
title: Ww 5 Points - Curry in Your Face
ingredients: 2 lbs baby spinach | 12 whole cloves | 8 ounces dark chocolate | 1 tablespoon ginger juice ( from an orange ) | 3 ounces water chestnuts, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1/8 teaspoon curry powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil. Immerse about one third of the baby spinach into a large mixing bowl. Trim off remaining leaves as well. Cut the baby spinach into 1 inch lengths. Discard stems. Cut each piece in half crosswise. Immediately combine the spinach with the cloves in the bowl of a food processor and process to a paste.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,lemon peel,peach,rice bubble,sun tomato oil,fish sauce
title: Nam Sod (Spicy Rice Balls)
ingredients: 1 cup rice bubbles | 12 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 6 -8 dashes vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 teaspoons candied lemon peel | 2 -3 peaches
instructions: Soak rice bubbles in warm water for 20 minutes. Dry on paper towel. Heat wok, add oil and fry cakes for 2 - 3 minutes or until golden brown on all sides. Remove. Sprinkle with fish sauce, vanilla essence, candied peel and a few slices of pea shoots. Serve hot. Variation, use any amount of dried fruits or other nuts of your liking.

title: Fresh Herb and Garlic Dip
ingredients: 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon pepper
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine the parsley and lemon pepper and process until smooth. Transfer to a serving bowl and refrigerate until completely chilled, 1 to 2 hours.

title: Sambal Chili Paste
ingredients: 1/4 cup toasted slivered orange peel,, to garnish | 1 tablespoon chili paste
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the toasted slivered orange peel with the chili paste. Store the toasted slivered orange peel mixture in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,kernel corn,date,tomato green chilies,tea,dark rum,marjoram
title: Mexican-Style Spicy Corn
ingredients: 2 cans mild whole kernel corn, drained | 3/4 cup fine fresh breadcrumb | 3 tablespoons finely chopped marjoram | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumb | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies or ( 14 ounce ) cans diced tomatoes with red chilies, undrained | 1 can rotel-style diced tomatoes with mild green chilies, undrained ( optional )
instructions: If using a 16 ounce can of corn, drain and reserve juice and reserve. Drain the corn. In a small mixing bowl, combine 3/4 cup of the fine dry bread crumbs with the marjoram, rum, bread crumbs and 1/2 cup of the drained chilies. Taste, add more rum if needed. Set aside. Combine 3/4 cup of the chopped marjoram with the can of diced tomatoes with chilies or undrained diced tomatoes. Spoon 1/2 cup of this mixture into a 8x8 inch deep dish glass baking dish. Top with the corn mixture. Evenly spread the remaining 1/2 cup reserved tomato juice over the corn. Sprinkle with the remaining marjoram, bread crumbs and chilies. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate or freeze overnight. Bake at 375°f for 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Herd's Mango Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced jicama | 1 package shredded white american cheese | herms, optional ( optional )
instructions: Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Saute jicamas in skillet, about 2 minutes. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Sprinkle cheese in an ungreased 10 inch pie dish or deep casserole dish. Pour warm jicama over cheese. Top with a sprinkling of herbs. Optional, use an american cheese, if desired. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Goat Cheese Filled Easter Eggs
ingredients: 6 ounces goat cheese | 4 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons tomato paste
instructions: Chop goat cheese to 1/4 inch length. Using a hand held grater, grate goat cheese coarsely. Beat egg yolks well with the goat cheese and tomato. Fold 1/4 of the egg mixture until thoroughly blended. Using a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2 inch round tip, fill 2 to 3 dozen egg yolks from the remaining mixture.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,oatmeal,peanut oil vegetable,raisin,pear,cream mushroom garlic soup,chipotle chile
title: Quinoa Stuffed Fruity Pear Chops
ingredients: 4 large pears, peeled and halved and cores removed | 1 package quinoa | 1 can reduced-fat cream of mushroom and garlic soup | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon finely chopped chipotle chile | 1/2 cup quick oatmeal ( not instant )
instructions: Spray a grill rack with cooking spray. Grill each pear to your liking. Prepare your quinoa. Place the quinoa in a medium size bowl, cover with about 3 cups of boiling water, and set aside. Wipe out the skillet and heat the oil on medium high. In a large bowl, mix the soup, oil, raisins, chiles and oats. In a separate bowl, add the quinoa, quinoa mixture and the broth mixture along with the peanuts.

title: Simple and Easy Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup chili-garlic sauce | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup chunky salsa
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together chili garlic sauce and vineger. Slowly whisk in salsa. Serve with rice, pasta or veggies.

title: Almond-Cilantro Chunk
ingredients: 1/2 gallon fresh cilantro leaves | 1 pound lean beef chuck, cut into cubes | 1/2 cup almond extract, or more to taste
instructions: In large saucepan, toss cilantro and meat with almond extract. Cover.

title: Cannellini Beans, Sirloin and Pork Sandwich (Sbd P2)
ingredients: 4 cups cannellini beans, cooked | 1 lb sirloin, trimmed and cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb pork shoulder, trimmed, diced | 8 -10 slices white bread, toasted or 8 -10 slices pita bread | chopped parsnip ( to garnish )
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients in a large saucepan. Cover and simmer over just low heat for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in pork and beans. Preheat the oven to 350°f transfer ham to a baking dish with a tight fitting lid. Bake, covered for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until pork is lightly browned. Toast the pita if desired. Add the heated beans into the sandwich with pork and stir to coat. Serve with salad, french fries, grilled vegetables, etc.

Random Ingredients: banana blossom,part mozzarella cheese,mexican cheese,deli ham
title: Habanero Roulades
ingredients: 8 inches pieces part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/4 - 1/2 cup grated part-skim monterey jack cheese, or to taste ( optional ) | 4 bananas, sliced into 4 rounds ( optional ) | 3 slices deli ham, sliced into 4 rounds ( optional )
instructions: Place mozzarella cheese on a lightly floured work surface. Starting at one of the long sides, top with a layer of monterey jack cheese. Next add a layer or two of banana slices. Sprinkle each with a little bit of the optional cheese, if desired. Working quickly, roll up the cheese and slice into thin slices. Repeat until all of the cheese has been used. Preheat a griddle over medium heat and lightly oil the griddle, or use any non stick pan as a basting brush. When the griddle is hot, lightly brush the outside with some oil. Working quickly, place one piece of cheese in the center of a slice of ham, overlapping the cutlet over the top and bottom of the ham. Place the ham slice, still on a slice of cheese, on top of the ham. Raise the heat to medium and cook until the ham slices are browned on the sandwich, and the cheese is melted, about 5 to 10 minutes. Turn the heat up to medium high. Slice with browned side of spatula in half or quarters, and eat immediately, or let cool and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,monterey jack cheese,serrano pepper,flour,cream chicken soup
title: Spicy Curry Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can condensed monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup minced serrano peppers
instructions: Mix all together in a bowl. Serve with hot, toasted french rolls.

title: Greek Chickpea Flour Cookies
ingredients: 6 tablespoons chickpea flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon greek oregano or 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | oil ( for deep frying or frying )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl add the chickpea flour, oregano and lemon extract and mix. In a non stick frying pan add olive oil or spray with a bit of oil and heat to 300°f. Drop the tablespoonfuls of dough using spoon into the oil and when golden brown on the underside remove and place on plate with paper towel. When cool roll cookies in your favourite greek style sprinkle with powdered sugar or paprika, place on paper towel and store in clean tin.

title: Fruit Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup self raising flour | 1/2 cup lime juice ( from about 3 limes )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Using a small bowl, mix together the flour and lime juice until well blended. Spread equal amounts of the mixture onto parchment or waxed paper, making sure to distribute all the crumbs on each side. Bake for about 40 minutes or until golden brown, or bake in convection oven. Enjoy.

title: Penne With Broccoli Rabe
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli rabe, trimmed, stems removed | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | 4 cloves | 2 teaspoons crumbled dried penne
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, blanch the broccoli rabe stems until bright green and somewhat wilted, 2 to 3 minutes. Peel the broccoli rabe, retaining the tips of the rabe stalks, and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Roughly chop the stems and cut the broccoli rabe into 1/4 inch pieces. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: catsup,chinese five spice powder,red bean,pork rib,beef tenderloin
title: Easy Chinese-Style Pork Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 can red beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon catsup
instructions: Place tenderloins in crockpot. Combine catsup, five spice powder and beans. Pour over pork. Turn heat on and cook on high setting for about 3 1/2 hours, or until pork is tender, stirring often. Cut pork into strips.

title: Spanish Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons a.1. original sauce | 2 spanish-style onions, cut into wedges
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot and cook on high setting for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,cranberry,olive oil,tomato green chile pepper,soy sauce
title: Cranberry Chilies
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Soak the cranberries in some water for an hour and drain. In a large bowl, mix together the dried cranberries, diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, cake flour, soy sauce and olive oil. Mix and put into the refrigerator while making the batter. When the batter is cold, mix and serve.

title: Zucchini and Chilies
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, sliced | 2 small green chilies, finely chopped | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts | 3 fluid ounces irish whiskey | 4 fluid ounces chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with baking paper. Arrange zucchini slices in a single layer on the baking sheet. Bake 25 minutes. Remove zucchini from oven and leave in the oven uncovered for 15 minutes. Remove the zucchini from the baking sheet and place on the baking sheet again. Bake for an additional 15 minutes or until the top is nicely browned. Remove from oven and keep warm. In a medium pan combine the chilies, walnuts, whisky, chipotle chiles and marjoram. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Guar gum for Dogs
ingredients: 2 cups cornflour ( cornmeal ) | 150 g of diced tempeh | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon guar gum | 1 cup port wine | 3 tablespoons light corn syrup
instructions: In a pan fry diced tempeh in butter or oil until light tan. Pour cornflour into a measuring cup and mix with 1/4 of the water, add the tomato puree and guar gum. Mix in with the cornflour mixture and add port. Simmer for 7 - 10 minutes until thick and shiny.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,pappardelle pasta,italian flat leaf parsley,confectioner sugar
title: Apple Tarts
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds tart apples - peeled, cored, and minced | 1/2 teaspoon confectioners'sugar | 1 package dry pappardelle pasta | 1/3 cup chopped italian flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place apples in a mixing bowl, and stir in confectioners' sugar until thoroughly mixed. Fill a skillet with lightly salted water, and bring to a boil. Stir in pappardelle, cook until tender but still firm, and drain. Tear off a 1 inch square of aluminum foil. Fill each tart shell with 2 tablespoons of stuffing mixture. Arrange on foil, and sprinkle with parsley. Wrap each tart tightly in foil. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned. Serve warm.

title: WOW and PIEY PIE (Pepperoni and Mushroom Pie)
ingredients: 2 packages pepperoni | 30 canned oyster mushrooms, drained, rinsed | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla flavoring
instructions: Lay sliced pepperoni out on a greased cookie sheet. Top with mushroom slices spread side by side. Sprinkle with flavoring. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 10 minutes. Cut into slices and serve.

title: Spaghetti With Peanuts, Vodka and Wine
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 lb green or red snapper fillet, cut crosswise into strips | 2 3/4 cups boiling water or 2 3/4 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon vodka, divided ( or other alcohol-based liqueur like grand marnier ) | 1 tablespoon cumin or 1 tablespoon mexican paprika | 1 box polenta ( not the tube of cornmeal ) or ( 1 1/2 lb ) box cornmeal ( not the tube of cornmeal ) | spaghettini or spaghetti | cooked spaghetti, for serving
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the snapper fillets and sauté until well browned on both sides, about 3 - 4 minutes per side. Pour the boiling water over and simmer, uncovered, until the fish is cooked through, about 3 minutes. Stir in the vodka and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the cumin. Transfer the fish to plates and spoon the mixture over it. Cover and refrigerate till dinner time.. Bring the stock to a boil. Remove the fish and the sauce from the heat and pour over it. Keep the warm over very low heat. In a second skillet, bring 3/4 cup water or stock to a boil. Remove from the heat. Add the polenta or cornmeal and a little more than 1/4 cup water. Stir the mixture constantly over low heat until it looks thick. Continue stirring as this continues to cook until the polenta is tender and the liquid is thick and bubbling, about 5 - 10 minutes. Stir the mixture into the hot stock, increase the heat to high, and reduce until thick, about 5 minutes more. Taste and add more water if needed. Put the fish on a serving plate and drizzle with remaining tablespoon oil and season with salt and pepper. Scatter cooked spaghetti and serve immediately. Serves.

title: Fried Spice (Naneh - Qatari Recipe)
ingredients: 3/4 cup unbleached cake flour | 3/4 teaspoon garam masala ( i use my spice mix mix mix ) | 2 tablespoons cider or 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Place flour, garam masala and cider in a wide, shallow pan or bowl. Heat a deep skillet over high heat, stir well so that any flour that does not clump up, but is still slightly lumpy, about 2 minutes. Add a few drops of butter or oil, a few drops at a time, to the pan. If the mix seems a little dry, add a little more oil.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,almond,basmati rice,vegetable oil,balsamic vinegar,pork meat
title: Glazed Balsamic-Glazed Shanks
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup chopped almonds | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 12 bone-in pork shoulder or 12 rib bones with skin | 2 celery ribs, trimmed and cut into thick slices | 2 cups dry basmati rice
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place pork fat side up in casserole dish. Bring to a boil while scraping bottom of pan with wooden spoon. Remove pork, reserving fat. Brown bones on all sides in reserved fat, about 10 minutes. Transfer pork to bowl and pour off all but about 2 tablespoons fat. Pour balsamic gina over all. Cover and bake at 300 degrees f for 2 hours. Add vegetables and reserved fat in last 30 minutes of cooking. Cover and bake for 30 minutes more. Remove meat, bones and seeds from bones and spoon sauce over.

title: Mexican Pine Nut Salad
ingredients: 1 lb pine nuts | 1 small shallot ( or 1/8 cup minced shallots ) | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Place pine nuts on a baking sheet and toast in a 300°f oven for about five minutes or until golden brown. While the nuts are making the sauce, heat the enchilada sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the brandy and remove the saucepan from the heat. In a large bowl, toss the pine nuts with the shallot or minced shallots. Stir in the sauce and allow the salad to cool slightly. Pour the mixture over the nuts and serve warm.

title: Moroccan Wine & Oil
ingredients: 3 tablespoons parsley, freshly grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds, toasted & ground | 2 tablespoons dry white wine
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a shallow bowl & stir well. Cover & chill for 2 hours before serving.

title: Cajun Cashew Spread
ingredients: 1 box cashews ( broken into pieces ) | 0.667 taco seasoning mix
instructions: Brown cashews in a frying pan with taco seasoning. Sprinkle with taco seasoning. Spread on a hot plate and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,cream tartar,sriracha sauce,cornflour,yellow pepper,habanero pepper,cream
title: Colorful Spicy Asafoetida (Spiced Peppers in Sour Cream)
ingredients: 4 small yellow peppers | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( hing, available in packets ) | 1 teaspoon cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 habanero peppers | sriracha sauce | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Briefly blanch peppers in boiling water for 1 to 2 seconds and tap off excess water. Immediately immerse into cold water. Let sit for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove peppers from water. Dice peppers and place in a bowl with asafetida and cornflour. Mix thoroughly using a fork. Let sit for 1 to 2 minutes. Add cream of tarter, habanero peppers and sour cream, mix well. Divide into 12 equal portions, shaping each into a ball. Put on a tray lined with wax paper or foil and refrigerate until needed. To serve, take 1 to 2 balls and roll around a rounded sour cream, using the sour cream to roll it into a ball.

Random Ingredients: onion,chili bean,chili pepper,cream chicken soup,cumin powder,dove breast,pecan,salmon fillet
title: Hot Fish With Sausage, Nuts and Diced Peppers
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 lb haddock or 1 lb cod ( 1 1/2 kg ) | 10 ounces chili beans ( soaked and drained ) | 1 can diced chili peppers ( undrained ) | 1 large onion, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs skinless salmon fillets, bones removed | 4 teaspoons chili powder ( or to taste ) | 3/4 cup pecans, roughly chopped
instructions: Drain the beans, reserving the liquid. Combine the reserved liquid and soup and heat. In a large frying pan, brown the fish until just barely opaque. Add the beans, chillies and onion. Stir in the soup mixture. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the fish, season and cook for a further 5 minutes. Sprinkle the nuts on top of the fish and serve with the pecan nuts.

title: Simple Thai Red Sauce.
ingredients: 1 small onion, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 2 -3 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 lb carrot, peeled and cut into 2-inch long segments
instructions: Saute the onion in a little oil till translucent, then mix in the sliced carrots. Continue cooking till carrots seem to brown about 10 minutes. Add the curry paste. Cook a few minutes. Lower and simmer for a couple of minutes or till the sauce is slightly reduced and thick and the sauce has a rich, syrupy texture. This dish goes great with fish dishes. It makes for moist and slightly unpleasant dishes too. Note, you may use a lot of curry paste, depending on your tolerance of spice. This is what i used, 1/2 tsp of each, and the other half for my meal at barbecues. Enjoy the balance between salt and pepper. Note, if not eating right away now the sauce will not be as rich as the first time. Also, if you add oil and vinegar to the sauce, the flavour will increase.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,jumbo shrimp,baby spinach,garlic,brown basmati rice,green bean,baking soda
title: Ww 3 Points - Caribbean Ginger Shrimp and Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups packed baby spinach | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh spinach | 1/2 1/2 cup green beans or 1/2 cup arugula | 1/2 cup light brown basmati rice or 1/2 cup jasmine rice | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped fresh garlic ( depending on your taste, i like lots. ) | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f spray 2 9x5 inch loaf pans with nonstick cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine the garlic with the pineapple, vinegar, and pineapple in juice. In a large bowl, pour the wet ingredients into the dry, stirring well. Add the shrimp and toss to combine. Spoon the mixture into the prepared pans and bake for 3 hours or until golden brown and the shrimp are done. Let stand 5 minutes, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,pea,tortilla chip,chili garlic sauce,chicken,white vinegar,plain yogurt
title: Chili Dogs on Chip Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 cup diced canned chicken | 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons chili-garlic flavored chili-garlic sauce ( from k-jon's chili sauce mix ) | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar | 2 cups tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread peas evenly onto a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until thawed, stirring occasionally, 20 to 25 minutes. Mix chicken, 1 cup cheddar cheese, chili garlic sauce, yogurt, and vinegar together in a bowl. Spread about 1/2 teaspoon chili cheese mixture onto each tortilla chip and arrange on a baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until hot and crispy, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Almond Cauliflower Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower floret, chopped with | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 1 large eggplant, cut into 1/2-inch wedges | 1 cup blanched almond, chopped | 1/4 cup sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Cook cauliflower in hot water for 2 minutes. Drain and toss with rest of ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Pinchi -- Arabian Spiced Orange Peel
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange zest, in strips ( preferably a light colored pith ) | 3 cardamom, cracked, in a mortar
instructions: With a sharp knife, cut strips of peel in half horizontally. The peel should now be free of pith. If it does, tie strips together using a piece of kitchen twine. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to full rolling boil. Add about 2 cups of blanched peeled oranges, including any rind left on the peel. Stir and return the water to a boil. With a slotted spoon or spatula, remove peel pieces to a bowl of ice water. Drain orange peel very well.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,veal chop,beef rump roast,salmon steak,greek yogurt
title: Smoked Salmon & Gravy on a Bed of Salmon
ingredients: 4 boneless veal chops | 4 beef rump roast | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon greek yogurt ( or sour cream if you are vegan ) | fat free greek yogurt ( or sour cream, if you are vegan )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°f place the sauté pan on it's rack and place in the oven to preheat while you sleep. Put 1 tbs of brown sugar into a ziploc or plastic bag, cut open, add the veal chops, seal the bag and shake to coat them well. Repeat this with each chop. Place the pan in the preheated oven and cook them for 35 - 45 mins per side, until nicely browned and cooked through. Meanwhile, make the greek yogurt sauce by placing 3 tbsp olive oil onto the top of a double boiler on the stove, heat until warm, stir in the yogurt if using. As soon as the chops are cooked, remove them from the pan, place in a warm serving bowl and pour the sauce over them. Garnish with sliced prawns or mushrooms and serve with a fresh crisp salad and some crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: beef rib eye steak,cream mushroom soup,no boil lasagna noodle
title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 17 ounces frozen no-boil lasagna noodles ( about 12 uncooked noodles ) | 10 3/4 ounces reduced-sodium beef rib-eye steaks | 1 can condensed no-boil mushroom soup ( about 7 cups )
instructions: Cook noodles in a pot of boiling salted water until tender, about 2 minutes.

title: Moroccan Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, sliced lengthwise on the bias | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | salt and vinegar | 8 large lettuce leaves, washed
instructions: Place peeled eggplant on a plate, drizzle with oil and lightly salt. Cover, refrigerate, and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. When ready to serve, steam or microwave eggplant slices to desired doneness. Arrange on a bed of lettuce to serve, drizzle with mayonnaise, and salt. Serve with a side dish of couscous or rice.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,seasoning salt,currant,tomato basil pasta sauce,peach,parmesan cheese,italian parsley,farfalle pasta
title: Spicy Spinach and Peach Salad
ingredients: 2 -3 stalks fresh italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 1 can tomato basil pasta sauce | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 lb farfalle pasta, dried ( bow tie pasta ) | 4 medium firm ripe peaches | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon dried basil or 1 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano | freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Add pasta and cook according to directions. Drain pasta well and cool under running water. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together the jar of basil pasta sauce, chili powder, and seasoning salt. Peel the peaches and slice in half lengthwise. Cut each half in half and remove seeds and membrane. Slice peaches in half. Add peaches, 1/2 cup cheese, and 1/2 cup basil/oregano dressing to pasta. Toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: cod,italian plum tomato,blueberry,pinot noir wine,tomato juice,salmon fillet,savory
title: Savoury Salmon With Italian Plum Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet, skinned | 1/2 cup pinot noir wine | 1/4 cup freshly grated savory or 1 tablespoon dried savory | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 cup italian plum tomato, diced | 2/3 lb fresh blueberries or 2/3 lb frozen blueberries | 1 cup chilled seasonal diced tomato
instructions: Combine pinot noir and grated savory in small bowl.

title: Chinese Style  Bell Pepper Pickles
ingredients: 2 lbs green bell peppers, cut into squares | 4 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon pickling spice
instructions: Slit tops off of the peppers, do not remove seeds. Place the peppers in a pan with the soya sauce. Place a pan with boiling water over medium heat until water is boiling. Let this boil, then drain the peppers. Chop the pepper in half so they look like little bigger dice. Place the crushed peppers in one bowl and the other bowl in the other. Then put this mixture into the refrigerator to chill. After the 2 days the pepper will be somewhat hard, so you may need to add more water. You want it to cool so you can handle the peppers when you are eating them. The peppers are now ready to decorate on your salads or on hot toast.

Random Ingredients: french mustard,chicken part,red pepper,deli roast beef,onion powder
title: Grilled Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 dash red pepper, 1 pinch per side | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken parts, thinly sliced | 5 tablespoons french's prepared mustard | 1/2 cup deli roast beef, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine seasonings in a small bowl and brush the grill with them. Place chicken on grill rack over medium heat. Close lid and grill, turning, until meat is browned and cooked through, 10 - 15 minutes. While chicken is cooking, combine mustard and 1/2 cup dressing mixture in a small bowl. Spoon 1/4 to 1/2 mixture onto each bread piece. Top with roast beef and remaining mustard mixture.

title: Pasta Con Encebollado (Pasta Cheese With Bacon)
ingredients: 12 ounces linguine ( dried or fresh ) | 10 -12 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons cheddar cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Remove the thick slice of bacon from its package when partially cooked and set aside. Place the linguine on a flat surface, and, using scissors or a few slices of cheese, cut in smaller chunks, being careful to keep the strands as close to the bacon as you can get the rest of the cheese. Place a portion of bacon on top, then sprinkle with a little cheddar cheese and a few strips of cheddar on top of that. Fold all around the cheese, and set back in the microwave for about another two minutes, just long enough to reheat. Note, you may have to cook the pasta in the microwave for several minutes, depending on how old the package is and how hot the bacon gets. Scoop out onto a platter, and serve. It should also melt into the bacon fat a little bit.

title: Watermelon and Arugula Salad
ingredients: 2 cups watermelon, diced | 1 1/2 cups arugula, packed | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Chill.

title: Midori Jelly
ingredients: 500 g freshly made midori melon liqueur | 400 g roma tomatoes
instructions: In a saucepan mix midori and roma tomatoes with just enough cold water to make the jelly consistency. Bring to boil over low heat. Allow to cool to room temperature. When jelly is cold, pour into glass jars leaving 2 cm of head space at the top. Place lid on jar tightly and press all the air outwards. Leave a dent in the centre of top if using a glass. Once cooled, store in refrigerator. The jelly should last in the fridge for 6 months.

title: Japanese Spicy Oyster (Or Tuna
ingredients: 1/2 cup catsup ( japanese soup can sub kikkoman ) | 1/4 cup water chestnut, chopped ( optional ) | 1 can french bread, sliced | 1/2 cup carrot, grated | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 cup green olives, sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup cucumber, sliced ( optional ) | 1 -2 nori, sheets
instructions: Combine catsup, water chestnuts, onion, carrots, allspice, and olives. Add half the bread slices, and 1 - 2 tbsp vinegar, and stir to coat. Place in refrigerator and chill for 1 - 2 hours. Place remaining ingredients into small pot and simmer until vegetables are tender. Cut each roll in half horizontally, and fill with the vegetables mixture. Heat a nonstick pan at medium high, and lightly spray with non stick cooking spray. Place the rolls into the pan, and fry, shaking the pan so it browns evenly. When it is browned, remove rolls from pan and serve. Serve with your favorite pickled soy sauce. Note, if you do the filling and do not want to serve this in your recipe, you can also fill them, and the filling and fill is not necessary, just the filling is optional.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,masa harina,white balsamic vinegar,beef bouillon cube,purpose flour,banana,golden mushroom soup
title: Crispy Fried Fish
ingredients: 2 cans condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 can flaked coconut-flavored basa harina, chilled ( masa harina mix ) | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 2 lbs boneless cod fish fillets, cut into serving size pieces | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup white balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
instructions: Prepare gravy and keep hot. If using condensed soup, place the coconut bean mixture in a bowl and stir well then add the bisquick mix into the soup and whisk until blended. Coat the fish in the flour and shake off the excess. Heat a skillet on medium low heat. When hot use a fork and lightly push a piece of fish in the center of the plate. Put enough of the sauce mixture into the skillet to cover the fish. Cover and let boil until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Transfer the fish to a plate. Add water to the pan and heat over medium heat until the water boils. Add a bouillon cube and stir to dissolve the bouillon cube. Add the coconut milk, vinegar and flour. Mix well. Heat to boiling and serve.

title: Diva® Chocolate Fudge
ingredients: 1 ounce dark chocolate, finely chopped | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender, blend until smooth. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle top with icing sugar if desired.

title: Calabaza Soup
ingredients: 1 cup calabaza squash, peeled and cut into cubes | 3 cups beef broth | 2 tablespoons toasted hazelnuts, chopped
instructions: Bring the water to a boil, add the calabaza squash. Lower the heat, cover, and steam for about 30 minutes. Remove the lid, increase the heat, and mix in the broth. Simmer for 20 minutes, or until the calabaza is tender, but not mushy. Season with salt, and stir in the hazelnuts just before serving.

title: Swiss Chard Stuffed Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs swiss chard or 1 1/4 lbs beet leaves | 1 package frozen breadcrumbs | 2 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 lbs country-style veal medallions ( veal medallions ) | 1 1/2 cups shredded cabbage | 1 1/2 cups dry champagne
instructions: Trim the chard from the stems and discard the stems and leaves. Remove any leaves with large stems, cut from the ribs and the tenderloin into four 1/4 inch wide slices. Coarsely chop. Put one slice of bread crumb in a shallow dish with 1 heaping tablespoon of the chard mixture. Dip the bread crumbs in the chard and then evenly coat with the meat mixture. Sprinkle the beef slices evenly with the bread crumbs. Using a meat mallet, pound the meat until 1 inch thick and 1 1/2 inch wide. Place in a plastic plastic bag with 1 cup of the cabbage and the champagne. Freeze until set, at least 3 hours. Slice a slice of beef between the bone and the veal in 1/2 inch slices. Arrange on a serving platter alongside the stuffed beef. Remove the plastic bag.

title: Pistachio Chickpeas
ingredients: 3 cups dried garbanzo beans, soaked in water overnight | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio ( arrage ) | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Drain the chickpeas, place them in a large casserole dish and add several cups of cold water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, skimming off any scum that rises to the top. Once the chickpeas are well cooked, remove the lid, stir, cover and cook over low heat for at least one hour, until all the liquid is absorbed and the chickpeas are very soft. Remove from the heat, stir in the pistachios, onion and garlic powder and cover and allow to stand for 20 minutes. Uncover and allow to cool. Stir the sherry through the chickpeas and serve.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,pasta,green cardamom pod,salt black pepper,white bread
title: Pasta with Spiced Chiles and Crackers
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yellow dried chiles or 1/2 cup green cardamom pods, finely chopped | 16 ounces whole grain pasta, such as rotelle | 2 slices white bread, cut into 1/2 inch crumbs | coarse salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 1/2 tablespoons minced cilantro leaves
instructions: In a large skillet or saute pan, toast the chiles over medium heat, shaking the pan once or twice, until fragrant and softened, about 15 minutes. Transfer the chiles to a bowl.

Random Ingredients: turnip,phyllo pastry,zucchini,vegetable oil olive,italian parsley,spanish onion
title: Vegetable Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 3 spanish onions, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil ( canola or olive ) | 1/2 lb zucchini, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 lb turnip, coarsely chopped | 3 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook the onions in the oil in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the zucchini and parsley to the skillet and cook, stirring to coat with oil, until tender and beginning to brown, about 12 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and add the turnip. Toss gently to coat. Lay out the phyllo sheets on a cutting board and place one on top of the other at a 45 degree angle. Using a large sharp knife, cut each sheet crosswise into 8 pieces about 3 1/2 inches wide by 11 inches long. Working quickly, arrange a third sheet on top of the other until covered with a third sheet. Using a pastry brush, brush the sides of the phyllo with oil.

title: Mexican Lettuce and Lettuce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lime zest ( not the coarse side of orange colored ) | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking spray | 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed, dried | 1/2 cup freshly shaved iceberg lettuce, rinsed
instructions: Prepare a charcoal or gas grill for cooking. Toss lettuce with lime zest and set aside. Place racks 2 inches from heat, and heat grill. While grill heats up, lightly spray grill and spray with cooking oil. Grill lettuce until tender and slightly charred, about 10 minutes on each side. Transfer lettuce to a platter and top with shaved iceberg lettuce and lime zest.

Random Ingredients: mexican chili powder,baby spinach,tomato,bell pepper,gingerroot,parsley root,vegetable stock,tomato sauce
title: Thai Chili Soup
ingredients: 400 g fresh tomatoes, diced | 1 medium ripe tomatoes | 1 -2 teaspoon finely diced fresh gingerroot | 500 g vegetable stock | 1/2 large bell pepper, roughly chopped | 150 g fresh baby spinach | 1 teaspoon mexican chili powder ( optional ) | 10 -15 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley roots
instructions: Mix the diced tomatoes with the ginger in a large pan, on low heat, and cook, stirring, until it starts to become soft and translucent. Add the stock and tomatoes mix and bring to boil. Add the diced bell pepper, the baby spinach and the mexican chili powder if using. Bring back to boil, lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes, while you prepare the soup garnish with the fresh chopped parsley roots and serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,butter bean,ginger garlic paste,white vinegar,yellow pepper,red cherry
title: Sweet and Sour Butter Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can butter beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup red sweet cherry, quartered | 1/2 cup yellow sweet pepper, chopped 1/4-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons white distilled vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Blend the softened butter beans, ginger garlic paste, sweet cherry, yellow sweet pepper, vinegar, and chili powder in a food processor until smooth.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,fast rising yeast,plain nonfat yogurt,eggplant,chow mein noodle,milk ricotta cheese,chicken breast half,lime juice
title: Healthy Chicken Chow Mein
ingredients: 1/2 cup lukewarm skim milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt or 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup 2 % low-fat milk fat-free evaporated milk or 2 percent fat free evaporated milk | 1 large eggplant, peel cut into small rounds | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice | 1 package fast rising yeast ( recommended -- campbells ) | 1 can great northern beans, drained, rinsed ( recommended -- campbells ) | 8 ounces chow mein noodles, drained, per serving
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and set aside 3/4 cup for topping. Meanwhile, prepare yeast. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water and set aside until creamy, 5 - 10 minutes. Drain chow mein noodles and combine with drained beans in a large bowl. Set aside and keep warm. To serve, coat 1 small bowl with cooking spray. Top 1/2 chow mein noodles with mixture of chow mein, bean mixture and remaining 3/4 cup noodles. Season with more salt and freshly ground black pepper if desired.

title: Taco Seasoning and Rub for Soft Shells
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 4 pinches ground mace
instructions: Mix mace and taco seasoning mix together. Rub seasoning onto shells as desired.

title: Garlic Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon mixed epazote ( mexican seasoning also works ) | 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh garlic | 4 -6 garlic cloves, sliced | 2 -4 tablespoons icing sugar, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Slice the pork chops into rounds of 1/2 thick. In a shallow dish mix the icing sugar, oregano and 1 tbsp garlic. Dip the pork chops in the mixture then press with a fork to coat. Arrange on a non stick pan and bake in 350 degree oven for 10 minutes or until cooked through. Mix the 2 tbsp of icing sugar with 2 tbsp water if desired and sprinkle over the pork chops.

title: Ginger Pea Salad (Bamia Nuts)
ingredients: 500 g green peas ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 inch ginger | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Boil peas with ginger and vinegar until they are cooked. Chill. Garnish with coriander leaves.

title: Tomato Halvos
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes | 2 cups ice water
instructions: Blend the canned tomatoes and the water until very smooth.

title: Moroccan Spice Blend
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground tarragon | 1 tablespoon ground cayenne | 1 pinch of powdered saffron
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store or let dry for up to several days.

Random Ingredients: brown basmati rice,cooking oil,toothpick,wheat tortilla,extra virgin olive oil
title: Basil-Tofu Quesadilla
ingredients: 6 whole wheat tortillas ( like quesadillas ) | cooking oil, for brushing | 1 package sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and thinly sliced ( about 1 cup ) | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 12 toothpicks ( optional )
instructions: Brush 12 - 10 inch sticks with cooking oil. Cut tortillas crosswise in half crosswise and place on baking sheet. Bake at 400 degrees until crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove from sheet and cut each half into 4 wedges. Meanwhile, spoon 1/2 cup oil into a 10 inch fry pan and set over medium heat. When oil is hot, cook tortillas, cut sides down, until golden brown and crisp, about 2 minutes. Flip tortillas over to other side with tongs. Continue cooking until both sides are browned and crisp, about 40 seconds total. Drain on paper towel. Spread half of the sun dried tomatoes over tortillas. Top with half the rice and half the tomato slices. Fold tortillas in half and cut each into quarters. Repeat with remaining tortillas and tomato slices in same manner.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,guacamole,barbeque sauce,cooking brown rice,lime zest,green chili pepper
title: Lime Dipping Sauces and Rice
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking brown rice | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 1 can green chili peppers, drained | 8 drops barbeque sauce ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons garlic paste ( optional ) | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, using barbeque sauce, green chili peppers and garlic paste. Drain in a colander, then return rice to pan, tossing to coat well. Transfer to a serving dish and top with guacamole, if desired.

title: Apple Espresso Soup
ingredients: 2 teaspoons instant espresso | 1/2 cup apple juice | 1 cup hot water | 1 cup mushroom | 7 cups chicken broth
instructions: Add all ingredients except the mushrooms into the crock. Cover and place on low for 6 - 8 hours or high for 3 hours. Remove mushrooms from the broth and remove the stems, finely slice the mushrooms and serve.

title: Baked Ziti With Prosciutto, Spinach and Cranberries
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 2 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto ( or a slice of ham ) | 2 1/2 cups ziti pasta ( or penne ) | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/2 cup crumbled fontina cheese or 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese | white pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. On a lightly floured board, with a floured rolling pin, roll out each puff pastry sheet thin with a 2 round bladed cookie cutter, and cut out 12 squares, each 1 - ½ x 2 inches in diameter. In a bowl, combine the cranberries with the prosciutto. Arrange half the pastries on a baking sheet, and brush with some of the melted butter. Top the pastries with prosciutto cheese slices. Sprinkle with cranberries, then prosciutto cheese. Top with ziti pasta and spinach, then sprinkle with fontina or mozzarella. Add white pepper, to taste. Bake until the cheese has melted, about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,blackberry,squid,black cardamom pod,caster sugar,loaf french bread,allspice,french bread
title: Spiced Roast Spicy Vegetables
ingredients: 100 g blackberry jam or 100 g strawberry jam | 2 -3 tablespoons caster sugar or 1 tablespoon raw sugar | 50 g frozen baby carrots | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon allspice | 3 -4 tablespoons french bread, torn in chunks or 3 -4 tablespoons rye bread | 100 g sliced swiss rolls or 100 g swiss cheese ( optional )
instructions: Make the honey sauce with the jam or sugar and sugar, stirring well until the sugar has dissolved. Add all the vegetables and spices and marinate at least an hour or two so the spiced flavors infuse. Preheat the oven to 180c/160c fan/350f/gas line a 20 x 30cm slice tin with baking parchment. Place the bread in a single layer on top of each other on a flat surface. Spread the cheese on top. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until toasty and golden and soft and cooked through. To serve, place the sliced swiss roll or roll on toasted sandwich bread and pour over the honey and vegetables. Serve immediately.

title: Easiest Ever Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles, prepared | 1/3 cup chili sauce | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add egg noodles and cook until tender, about 6 minutes. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain. Meanwhile, heat canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in noodles. Cook and stir until heated through, about 3 minutes. Stir in oregano. Transfer noodle mixture to the baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until top is browned, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,self raising flour,white chocolate
title: Chef's Sesame Cookies
ingredients: 125 g self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon white chocolate, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius. In a large bowl, sift together all ingredients until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Roll into walnut sized balls and flatten each one with a rolling pin to a 2cm thick circle on a lined cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes and leave to cool on a wire rack. Once cooled, cut into circles with a sharp knife, place on a wire rack and store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,red wine,adobo seasoning,cake flour,thai basil,bamboo shoot
title: Red Wine Beef Patties
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles, cooked ( about 8 ounces ) | 6 ounces sweet bamboo shoots, sliced | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 cup sweet basil | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cake flour
instructions: Mix the red wine, 1/4 cup of basil, adobo and cake flour.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno,purpose flour,dijon mustard,beef brisket,sesame,orange zest,sunflower oil,green pea
title: Spicy Corned Beef With Mandarin Pancake and Green Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed and tied | 2 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 cups green peas, shelled | 1/2 cup jalapeno, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh dill, chopped ( i use frozen chopped )
instructions: Sprinkle brisket with the flour. In a large skillet or saute pan, heat the oil to moderate hot and sprinkle brisket with the orange peel and dijon. Cook brisket on all sides until just cooked through, 5 - 10 minutes per pound. Transfer to a serving platter and tent with foil. Drain any fat remaining in skillet and remove brisket from pan. Reduce the oil heat to moderate and heat the pan until very hot. Add the peas and stir fry over high heat until the peas are golden and the liquid is reduced by half for 2 - 3 minutes. Scatter the jalapenos over the peas and serve with the brisket.

title: Venison Stuffed Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, cooked al dente | 12 ounces ground venison steak ( or other ground meat of your choice ) | 1/2 cup cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs ( i use basil, oregano, dried, or rosemary ) | 3 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Brown meat, drain. Mix cheese and herbs and set aside. Cut off top of each lasagna noodle and stuff each with meat mixture. Place 3 noodles in a 9 x13 inch baking dish, top with meat and cheese mixture. Dot with raisins. Cover with foil and foil and bake 30 - 40 minutes or until hot and cheese melts.

Random Ingredients: vegetable bouillon granule,rom tomato,sun tomato oil,italian breadcrumb,mint,artichoke heart,black mustard seed,pepper
title: Artichoke and Tomato Spread
ingredients: 2 roma tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 6 ounces marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 2 -3 teaspoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons dried italian style breadcrumbs | fresh ground pepper | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint, to garnish
instructions: Place the chopped tomatoes and artichoke hearts in a bowl and toss to combine. Add the water, the vegetable bouillon granules, and the black mustard seeds and mix well. Add the breadcrumbs, pepper and mint. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to incorporate flavors.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,flour tortilla,chicken breast,marjoram,white vinegar
title: Chicken With Rice and Marjoram on a Bed of Tortillas
ingredients: 1 cooked boneless skinless chicken breast | 8 ounces long-grain white rice | 2 tablespoons flour tortillas | dried marjoram ( to garnish ) ( optional ) or oregano leaves ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | white vinegar ( or tomato juice to flavor )
instructions: Poke holes in the chicken breast with a chicken tenderizing brush to help it cook. Cover the chicken with water and simmer over low heat until tender. About 15 - 20 minutes or so. Drain and rinse chicken breast and cut into bite size pieces. Set aside. While the chicken is cooking prepare the rice. In a bowl mix the flour tortilla with your favorite seasoning. To serve, sprinkle some rice on a tortilla and place a small pat of chicken on top. Sprinkle some sliced marjoram on top of the chicken. Drizzle a dash of white vinegar on top of all. Garnish with a few sprigs of fresh or dried marjoram leaves. Enjoy.

title: Gourmet Bread and Butter
ingredients: 6 slices good quality white bread, crusts removed | 2 teaspoons mustard ( i like coleman's ) | lemon pepper, to taste
instructions: Spread mustard generously over each half slice of bread. Sprinkle salt and pepper to taste on each slice of bread. Cut each slice into 3 slices. Place on a large baking sheet and cook in a hot oven for 10 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: asian chili oil,beef sirloin steak,meat stock
title: Asian Beef Soup
ingredients: 4 beef sirloin steaks | 1/4 cup frozen meat stock | 1/2 teaspoon asian chili oil
instructions: Trim fat from steak and slice into thin strips. Bring stock to a boil in a saucepan over medium high heat. Add beef and chili oil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until meat is almost cooked through. Note, this freezes really well and can be warmed for a more elegant soup. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,onion soup mix,sea salt,double cream
title: Rosemary Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix ( such as oxo brand ) | 2 cups double cream | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped dried rosemary leaves | sea salt
instructions: Put the dried onion soup into a large bowl, add the double cream, dried rosemary leaves, and a couple of generous pinches of salt. Mix all the ingredients together and allow to sit on the counter approximately 15 - 20 minutes. This helps the flavours meld together. To serve, stir well and serve. I usually serve this with crusty bread and fresh fruit salad.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,miracle whip,chuck roast,green chili,kirsch,white vinegar
title: Beef and Yellow Squash Stew (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 3 lbs chuck roast, boneless and trimmed of all fat | 1/8 cup miracle whip | 1 1/2 tablespoons kirsch | 1 green chili, large, seeded and chopped | 1 yellow squash, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Place beef and a little water into crock pot.

title: Easy Fish Fillets
ingredients: 1 can of ready-to-use fish fillets, drained | 3/4 cup low-fat buttermilk | 2 teaspoons brown sugar
instructions: Drain fish and pat dry with absorbent paper towels. Combine the buttermilk, brown sugar and the fish, toss gently and place in shallow dish. Cover and refrigerate the fish and its juice from the can for up to 24 hours. Broil until the fish is golden brown.

title: Steak and Potato Pie
ingredients: 2 rump steak with bone ( i use topide or flank steaks ) | 1/2 small red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 small red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1 tablespoon semolina | 1 tablespoon black pepper | chocolate syrup | watercress ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c. Spray the inside of a large oven proof dish with oil. Slice the steak into thick slices. Arrange half of the beef and half of the red Slaw mixture in the dish. Sprinkle with semolina, pepper and chocolate mix. Repeat with the remaining beef and cheese. Bake in a preheated oven until meat and cheese are cooked, about 30 minutes. Serve with the remaining slaw mixture and watercress.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,hazelnut,oregano,vegetable oil,tomato green chile pepper,pepper,onion powder
title: Hazelnut & Chilli Griddle Bread
ingredients: 1 cup coarsely chopped hazelnuts | 4 cups self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 8 1/2 ounces chopped tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 1/2 - 2 cups vegetable oil | freshly-cracked pepper
instructions: Toast the hazelnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat, shaking to keep from burning. Toast for 3 - 5 minutes, or until slightly crispy. Set aside to cool. Preheat the griddle pan up to medium high heat. Stir together the flour and onion powder.

title: Spanish Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cut-up chicken | 1 jar diced pimientos, drained | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 tablespoon bread flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place chicken in greased 9x13 inch baking dish. In small bowl combine sliced pimentos with almond extract and sprinkle on top of chicken. Dot with bread flour. Bake for 40 minutes or until tender.

title: Blueberry and Capsicum Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 18)
ingredients: 200 g blueberries, to serve | 1/4 cup red capsicum, finely chopped | 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into pieces, serving size | black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil, and add the blueberries. Boil gently for 2 - 3 minutes, then drain. Meanwhile, toast the capsicum on a baking sheet in a hot oven for 3 - 4 minutes, or until just starting to soften. When the blueberries have cooked for 2 - 3 minutes, remove from the heat. Toss with the romaine, and season with plenty of pepper. Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,chicken breast meat,chicken stock,five spice powder,chive
title: Chinese Five-Spice Chicken
ingredients: 4 slices chicken breast meat | 1/4 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 cup chicken stock, or as needed | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chives, or more to taste
instructions: Mix black mustard seed and five spice powder in a shallow dish. Dip chicken in mustard seeds and arrange in a single layer on a plate. Pour hot chicken stock over chicken, and cover plate with plastic wrap. Refrigerate chicken at least 1 hour, or overnight. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Lightly grease a baking sheet. Bake chicken in the preheated oven until cooked through and slightly browned inside, 10 to 11 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pasta shell,herb,yellow onion,parsley flake,chipotle chile adobo,vodka,pistachio,pork shoulder
title: Pesto stuffed pasta shell with pork and chorizo
ingredients: 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, canned plus 2 chipotle chile puree | 8 ounces pistachios, chopped | 1 small yellow onion, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh parsley flakes ( or 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes, or 1/2 teaspoon dried parsley flakes ) | 4 tablespoons vodka | 1 lb dried pasta shells, cooked according to package directions | 2 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, trimmed of fat, chopped into 1/4 inch pieces | 1 pinch dried herbs ( or basil & oregano )
instructions: Drain the chilies of canned chipotles in a colander over the sink. Place in a skillet over medium heat, and toast them until they become fragrant and slightly translucent, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool. Toast 1 cup pistachios in a dry skillet over medium heat until they are fragrant and lightly colored, about 15 minutes and can be chopped into small pieces or pulsed in a food processor. Transfer to a bowl, and mix with the pistachios. Toast another 2 cups pistachios in a skillet over medium heat until they are fragrant and slightly colored, about 15 minutes and can be chopped into small pieces or pulsed in a food processor. Transfer to a bowl. Cook and stir onion and parsley in a large skillet over medium heat until tender, about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in the cooled pistachios & chiles, then add vodka & simmer until liquid is reduced to about 1/4 cup, about 10 minutes. Combine the pork, herbs, and nuts, then add pork mixture to skillet. Simmer until pork is heated through, but not falling apart, about 10 minutes and let sit 10 minutes before serving.

title: Bombay Beans and Rice from the 70's
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice ( approx ) | 2 cans fat-free refried beans ( approx ) | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 - 1/2 cup of natural dried fruit ( eg nectarines or strawberries ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dried mixed herbs ( eg nectarines or strawberries )
instructions: Rinse rice, drain. In a saucepan, add beans, raisins, vinegar, turmeric, dried fruit and 3 cups water. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes or until the rice is tender, adding more water if required. Add more water if it becomes dry. Garnish with herbs or serve over cooked rice.

title: Chunky Italian Beef With Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks, cut 3/4 to 1-inch thick
instructions: Place steak in a large, oven safe skillet, and drizzle with some cooking oil. Turn heat to high. Cook steak in hot oil until well browned on all sides. Transfer to an oven proof pan. Add a little bit of the drippings from the pan to the skillet. Arrange beans around steak. Add remaining drippings to skillet.

title: Chinese Pork and Napa cabbage
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 2 bunches napa cabbage, leaves separated | 2 teaspoons grapeseed oil
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Slice the pork in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1/4 inch thick chunks. Arrange pork on a roasting rack and broil 5 minutes, flipping once, until cooked through. To serve, place a napa leaf on each plate and cover with slices of pork using spines if you need to, and drizzle with the grapeseed oil.

title: Cheese Rounds With Capers and Olives
ingredients: 2 tablespoons liquid smoke ( or oil ) | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, shredded | 2 cups olives, sliced ( such as muscadet, pimento, grieven or nicoise ) | 1/4 cup capers, drained and minced ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a mixing bowl, combine the cheese, olives and capers. Add the liquid smoke if using. Gradually add the flour while beating till a soft dough is formed. Press the mixture into a greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 inch jelly roll pan. Bake till edges are golden brown, about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Orange Peel Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs beef roast | 2/3 cup plain flour | 1 limes or 1 lemon, limes or 1 lemon, juice of | 4 ounces shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup fresh orange peel | 1 1/2 - 2 cups flour
instructions: Cut the beef into 2 chunks and dredge with the flour. Place in a lrg non metal pan or roasting tin and make holes in the meat with your thumb. Squeeze the juice from half a lemon/lemon in and over the meat and the onions. Combine the mushrooms & orange peel with a bit of water and pour this over the meat. Cover and leave to marinade in a cool place for 2 - 4 hours. Put the flour on a plate and roll the meat. Slice the meat into fine strips and sprinkle with the sugar mixture. Pour 1tbsp of the oil or other flavouring into a frying pan and pan fry over moderate heat, turning until browned all over. Add the beef strips and stir fry for 2 or 3 minutes, or till browned all over. Remove roast and set aside. Use the onions as your gravy and serve with the onion & meat.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,panko breadcrumb,beef,pepper,white wine vinegar,button mushroom
title: Beef Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 lb ground beef | 3/4 cup fresh button mushrooms, sliced 1/8 inch thick | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon pepper | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the panko and beef. With your hands, mix the ground beef, mushrooms, vinegar and pepper until well blended. Place about half of the mixture in the middle of each mushroom. Brush the top of each mushroom with cheese, and fold the mushroom caps in half lengthwise. With a fork, poke a pocket in each mushroom, and transfer to a baking sheet. Bake 15 - 20 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Grilled Whitefish With Lime-Lime Butter
ingredients: 2 -4 tablespoons margarine, melted | 2 -4 tablespoons lime wedges ( or to taste ) | 12 small red snapper, about 1 lb. and 1 1/4 lbs
instructions: Heat a grill to high. Pour melted margarine or butter into a shallow dish. Dip fish first in melted margarine, then dredge in lime or red, then in flour. Grill fish, on the hottest part of the grill if necessary, until fish is just slightly charred and just slightly cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,tea,self rising flour,cardamom,celery
title: Tasty English Tea Bread
ingredients: 5 cups strong strong brewed tea ( we used tea with lots of cinnamon ) | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 cups self-rising flour | 4 cups finely-shredded celery
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f. In a small bowl, add the tea, cardamom, and salt. Blend well to combine. Stir in the flour. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Roll out 1/4 inch thick, cut with a 3 inch round cutter. Arrange in a greased 10 inch loaf pan. Cover tightly with foil, and bake for 45 minutes. Transfer bread to a wire rack to cool. After cooling, cut into 1 inch slices. Serve warm.
