title: Nigella's Famous Focaccia
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons dried oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon dried rosemary leaves | 3 cups all-purpose flour | 1 can ready-made stewed fish, drained | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, or as needed
instructions: Place coriander seeds and oregano leaves in the work bowl of a spice grinder.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,turnip,garlic powder,pumpkin seed,red chili pepper,white flour
title: Sally's Mashed Turnip
ingredients: 1/3 cup dried apricot jam | 1 -2 teaspoon dried red chili pepper | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 2 -3 teaspoons white flour | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh diced turnips
instructions: Soak apricot jam for several hours in boiling water. Meanwhile, toast or fry pumpkin seeds until golden in a medium skillet or fryer. Mix dry spices together in a mixing bowl with turnip. Spread out into the pan and allow mixture to cook approximately 15 - 20 minutes until turnip is tender and spices are lightly browned. Remove from heat and let cool until cool enough to handle. Serve with rice or pasta.

title: Adobo Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 -10 whole large fresh mushrooms | 2 cups cooked polenta ( or other egg shape like cornmeal ) | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 1 tablespoon sake | 5 drops saki or 5 drops any other light fish sauce ( go light and saki if you have it ) | 1 tablespoon chopped dried fruit, like kumara. ( optional )
instructions: Wipe the mushrooms clean with a damp cloth or paper towels. Set aside. Slice the mushrooms lengthwise to form long rectangular slices about about 1 1/4 inches wide. Remove the stems and discard the caps. Slice the mushrooms thinly again to obtain smaller pieces. Heat a non stick cooking pan on medium high heat. Stir the polenta thoroughly. When it starts to turn golden, lower heat to medium and add soya sauce, sake and saki. Stir until the polenta softens and is not grainy. Turn heat down to low and add the chopped mushrooms and kumara. Stir gently for about one minute being careful not to break up the slices. Remove from heat and serve at once.

title: Spicy Veggies
ingredients: 1/4 lb thinly sliced pepperoni | 1 medium yellow squash, cut into thin strips | 1 large banana, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 1/2 cups low fat cottage cheese or 1 1/2 cups sour cream | 2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Spray a non stick skillet with cooking spray. Over medium high heat, add pepperoni and cook 2 minutes or until crisp. Add squash, bananas, cottage cheese and garlic salt. Cover and cook 3 - 4 minutes, or until mixture is hot and cheese is melted. Stir 2 - 3 times, or until mixed evenly and veggies are slightly warmed through.

title: Basque Chicken Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup semolina | 1 red potato, cubed | 4 small hot banana peppers ( optional ) | 1/2 cup frozen meat, defrosted if desired
instructions: Place chicken thighs into an oiled 4 qt crock pot. Combine remaining ingredients in a medium bowl, add the chicken thighs, making sure that no pieces of meat remain. Cook on high for 1 hour or low for 8 - 10 hours. Turn crock pot to warm setting and cook for 20 - 30 minutes more, or until meat is cooked through.

title: Aji - Turkish Sesame Sauerkraut With Raisins
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut ( drain well, reserve liquid ) | 1/3 cup sesame seeds | 5 -6 serrano peppers, seeded and chopped ( wear gloves ) | 1/3 cup muesli ( to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain the sauerkraut thoroughly. Add sesame seeds and the serrano chilies to a large bowl and mix well. Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap and set aside while preparing the sauerkraut. Stir sauerkraut liquid through muesli into prepared sauerkraut. Cover bowl tightly and set aside for at least 15 minutes. Stir and refrigerate until the sauerkraut liquid is almost completely absorbed.

title: Indian Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken meat | 4 tablespoons ground white chocolate | 4 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 4 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed
instructions: Place chicken meat in a freezer bag and add 1 tbsp lime juice. Label bag. Put in fridge for at least 30 minutes to marinade. Grill chicken pieces or roast at 350°f for 20min or until done. Serve on a platter, garnished with remaining marinade. Garnish with ground cardamom or basil if desired.

title: Thai Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh rhubarb, trimmed | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled and finely grated ( cheeks ) | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons palm sugar ( or sugar substitute ) | 5 tablespoons sweet thai basil ( thai basil )
instructions: Place rhubarb, kiwifruit and vinegar in a large bowl. Toss to combine, and add sugar. Mix well. Season to taste with salt and fresh ground black pepper. Garnish with basil.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,black tea leaf,wheat flour,chocolate square,tomato puree,mozzarella cheese,macaroni
title: Irish Potato and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 100 g macaroni, uncooked | 175 g white pearl onions | 400 g tomato puree | 100 g grated mozzarella cheese | 10 white pearl onions | 100 g chopped chocolate squares | 5 -6 teaspoons black tea leaves | 2 -3 tablespoons shredded tasty cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f and grease a large baking dish with some of the oil. Mix the flour and sugar in a large bowl. Add macaroni, onions and tomato puree, stir to combine. Add about 1/4 1/3 cup cold water. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened, cover and set aside for 20 minutes or up to 3 hours in the refrigerator. Afterwards, stir in the mozzarella cheese. Add the pearl onions and chocolate and stir until combined. If too dry, add more water a teaspoon at a time until a soft, slightly sticky dough is formed. Grease a 6x27cm casserole dish. Add the dough. Sprinkle half of the grated cheese on top. Spread half the miced cheese over the cheese. Repeat layers, ending with cheese on top. Cover with aluminium foil and bake for 1 hour or until set. Remove tin foil, sprinkle with remaining grated cheese and return to oven for 10 - 15 minutes, depending on the thickness of the crust. Remove from oven and slice into squares.

Random Ingredients: apple cider,cold butter,garlic powder,water chestnut,hokkien noodle,mozzarella cheese,chinese cabbage,thyme sprig
title: Apple & Hokkien Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 16 ounces wien noodles | 16 ounces mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 1/4 cup water chestnut ( sliced ) | 1 head chinese cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 cup apple cider | 2 tablespoons cold butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Cook noodles. Drain. Mix with cheese, water chestnuts, cabbage and spices. Spread in casserole dish. Cook covered at 375 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes, remove cover and cook 10 - 15 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: bay seasoning,curry leaf,jalapeno,kosher salt,white vinegar,water chestnut,vanilla sugar
title: Jalapeno-Blackened Curry Leaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs jalapenos | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced | 1 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup kosher salt | 1/2 cup vanilla sugar | 4 bay leaves | 1/4 cup old bay seasoning
instructions: Pound the jalapenos and water chestnuts with a mallet until very fine. Remove skin and membrane and seeds from jalapenos and cut chilies into long, thin strips. Add jalapenos, water chestnuts, vinegar, salt, vanilla sugar, bay leaves and old bay leaves to blender and puree until smooth. Pour into small jars and refrigerate overnight to develop flavor. To use, wipe jar with a small dab of water then heat on stove top over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes or until hot. If using right away, seal tightly and refrigerate. Yields 20 - 30 gift jars depending on size.

Random Ingredients: table cream,watermelon,confectioner sugar,sherry wine,marshmallow,kidney bean,cornflour,beef broth
title: Watermelon, Kidney Bean and Cornflour Chowder
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole dried kidney beans | 4 cups water, divided | 4 cups beef broth | 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1/2 cup marshmallows | 1 cup table cream, whipped | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 4 cups cubed fresh watermelon | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Place dried kidney beans and 1 - 2 cups water in a large saucepan and bring to boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Cook for 10 minutes. Reserving liquid, combine with remaining water and stir in sherry. Place drained kidney beans and 1 1/2 cups water in slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 10 minutes. Remove cover, stir in marshmallows, cream, cornflour, and reserved kidney bean liquid. Cover and cook on high until mixture boils and thickens slightly. Turn off heat and stir in sliced watermelon. Cover and keep on low setting for 1 hour. In a medium bowl, combine whipped topping and confectioner's sugar. Remove about 1/2 cup of soup mixture from slow cooker and stir until smooth. Stir into remaining soup. Chill soup in refrigerator until flavors blend, about 30 minutes. Serve soup over sliced watermelon rind and top with whipped topping.

title: English Manchego Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb cream, room temperature | 3 ounces dark chocolate or 3 ounces bittersweet chocolate | 2 ounces fresh cranberries | 1/2 pint heavy cream | 1/4 cup shredded mexican cheese ( or cheddar or monterey jack )
instructions: In a heavy saucepan over low heat, melt the chocolate and cranberries, stirring constantly. Pour in the cream and allow the mixture to warm up for about 4, 10 minutes. Taste for sweetness, then add the shredded cheese. Chill for 5 to 10 minutes to soften the cheese.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,cardamom seed,beef bouillon cube,blood orange,red capsicum,chicken liver
title: Dried Blood Orange and Chicken Liver Salad in a Rice Cooker
ingredients: 1 cup blood oranges ( or any orange sized juice ) | 1 chicken liver, finely sliced or chopped | 1 red capsicum, finely sliced | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon boston black ras el hanout spice blend ( see note ) | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed
instructions: Press the blood oranges and livers through a rice cooker. Then, put the finely sliced capsicum & ras el hanout spice mix into the rice cooker along with all the other ingredients. Add 2 tbsp water & stir well to mix everything well. Keep on rice cooker for 2 hours. When ready to serve, let stand a few minutes before serving. Tip 1, if using a wine version of your cooking machine, remove the lid & cook for 15 - 20 mins at 150 degc /300 degc when you press the blood oranges and livers. It should then be very thick & creamy. Tip 2, if using a pan, leave the lid under pan to allow the steam to escape. Note, if using a bread machine, remove lid & add the blood orange and livers. If using the rice cooker, add 2 tbsp of water & 2 tbsp of water. When cooker stops automatically, press restart & stir once the timer goes off for 1 hour. Note 2, if using a crock pot, then press & stir the mix once it's done & serve. Note 3, if serving immediately, transfer contents of rice cooker to a bowl. Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: key lime juice,cream tartar,spanish onion,mayonnaise,self raising flour,bread flour,salmon,urad dal
title: Smoked Salmon Club
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked salmon, finely chopped | 2/3 cup salad dal | 1/2 cup finely chopped spanish onion | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon salad dal ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 100 g self raising flour | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: In a large bowl mix all the ingredients together until the mixture is well combined. Divide your mixture into 24 portions and roll each into a ball. Place the cakes on a lightly greased tray and allow to stand for 5 minutes to firm. Bake in a pre heated oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve immediately.

title: Faux French Tuna and Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon finely ground black pepper | 1 navel orange | 1 can tuna packed in oil, drained
instructions: Peel the navel orange and remove the membrane with a vegetable peeler. Cut the peel in half horizontally then slice across the top and discard rind using a flat bladed knife. Slice or tear the rind into small pieces. With a medium sized fork poke a series of holes randomly throughout tuna's rind to crack it up a bit. Put the orange sections in a bowl with the pepper. With the juice of the orange, add tuna and stir well to mix. Taste and add more pepper and/or more juice if desired. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: red chili,monterey jack cheese,ricotta cheese,nutmeg,serrano chilies,heavy whipping cream,creole seasoning,tomato puree
title: Ricotta En Chiladas With Tomato and Chile
ingredients: 12 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 cans tomato puree | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon finely chopped serrano chilies | 2 tablespoons ground red chili | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, grated
instructions: Combine ricotta cheese, tomato puree, heavy whipping cream, creole seasoning, nutmeg, chiles and red chili in a large bowl. Mix thoroughly. Spread 2 tortillas on a nonstick baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Spoon 1/4 of the ricotta mixture down on the tortillas. Roll tortillas tightly and place in an even layer. Spray tops of enchiladas with cooking spray and sprinkle with black pepper. Pour 1/2 cup of sauce over enchiladas and bake in a 350°f oven for 40 - 45 minutes or until bubbly and edges are golden brown. To make ahead and freeze for future use, remove and refrigerate until ready to use. Bring to room temperature before baking.

title: Green Tea Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup self-raising flour | 1/2 cup taco seasoning ( use 1/2 tbsp of your favorite taco seasoning ) | 1/2 cup artichoke heart | 8 -10 tortillas
instructions: Set oven to 400 f/200°c. Prick your bread a few times with a fork to vent steam. Mix the flour and taco seasoning in a bowl. Dip the bread into the flour mixture, then coat in the taco seasoning. Bake in the oven for 5 - 10 min, or until lightly browned on top. Serve with guacamole or salsa.

title: Fruit Tea
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups black tea | 4 slices good-quality black olives | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Brew your black tea or espresso. Place a slice of green olives in the center of each mug.

title: Roast Beef Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 cup cinnamon sugar | 4 -5 ounces deli roast beef, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Combine sugar and cinnamon. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Layer sliced beef on flour tortillas and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar mixture.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,cherry tomato,coriander leaf,red chilies,stock,mace,italian dressing,cinnamon
title: Coriander Chutney
ingredients: 1 bunch coriander leaves ( cilantro ) | 350 g cherry tomatoes | 3 small dried red chilies | 2 ounces canola oil | 3 tablespoons coriander dressing | 1 tablespoon fresh grated fat-free italian dressing | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place cleaned coriander and all the remaining ingredients in a large pestle or mortar. Mix well and add to the food processor/blender to combine. Blend until smooth and well combined. Store in a glass jar in the refridgerator. Note, i had not this problem before, so i had bought the basic dressing.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,romaine lettuce,thyme,broth,seasoning salt,corn,greek seasoning
title: Quick and Easy Broiled Corn
ingredients: 3 ears corn | 1/2 cup broth ( see tip ) | 1 tablespoon cornmeal, mixed with 4 tbs liquid | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek seasoning, < a href= '' https : //www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/greek-grapevinegar-salt-or-other-salt-curd-curd-tomato-and-black-mustard-sauce-9580 '' > greek dressing or other salad oil | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds
instructions: Trim and remove silk from corn on the cob. Remove the silk and trim any charred parts. Make sure it is not visible by being careful to remove silk and also holding the corn under running water. Place corn on a cutting board and using a knife and starting at one end of a corn, make an opening down the cob. With a sharp knife cut the corn kernels from the cob into quarters if you wish. The easiest way to do this is on the tweezers and remove each piece of corn to a cutting board. Continue to cut the kernels until there is no more corn left. In a glass bowl, mix together broth and cornmeal until well blended. Put in corn and stir to mix. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve immediately. If using dried thyme or or dried thyme, add this as a light sprinkle or to finish a meal with.

title: Italian Sausaces and Cucumber Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cucumber, halved lengthwise | 1 cup guacamole | 1 teaspoon crushed dried rose water | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 small chorizo sausage, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Prepare grill by heating coals to medium high heat. Cut halves of cucumber lengthwise, and scoop out seeds, about 1 tablespoon for each half. Rinse with cold water and drain on paper towels. Toss the cucumber, guacamole, rose water, salt, oregano, basil and chorizo together in a medium bowl until well combined. Place about 2 teaspoons of the mixture onto each kebab, and skewer, alternating as you go, onto 1 side of each slice of cucumber and chorizo. Grill until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,dipping sauce,saffron,black pepper,red kidney bean,self rising flour,spinach,duck
title: Beef Frikadeller (Duck Roller) With Saffron
ingredients: 1 lb ground duck | 9 saffron, threads | 8 ounces self rising flour, sifted ( see note in description ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons celery salt | 3 teaspoons black pepper, fine grind | 1/4 cup self rising flour | 10 ounces red or green beans, drained | 1 tablespoon roasted saffron | 1 tablespoon roasted salted spinach
instructions: Note, if using roasted salted spinach, add 2 tbsp of roasted saffron to sifted flour. Set aside. Fry the ground duck until browned evenly. Remove from pan, drain on paper towel, pat dry and season with celery salt, pepper and black pepper and set aside. Sift the flour. Rub in the ground duck and add half the saffron stregture, stirring constantly until a dough is formed. Remove any dough not completely binding the dough. Divide dough into 10 equal portions. Knead each portion on floured board until smooth and smooth, adding flour gradually and working through until dough is very firm and elastic. If mixing by hand, cover with towel and let rise until double. Meanwhile, rinse the beans. Bring 2 inches of salted water to boil and add the saffron, then drain the meat and rinse and dry. On floured surface, roll out the dough until it is a rectangle about 3/4 in diameter. Spread the beans and meat evenly over the dough, using lots of the cheese. Fold up bottom and top and cut several slits in the dough. Pinch sides closed making a pouch. Repeat steps 5 - 6 until all the dough is used. Steam for about 45 minutes. Note, as soon as the end of the steaming time, check for consistency of dough by inserting a toothpick in the dough, it should spring back immediately. If the bread is turning too pale, remove from microwave and quickly squeeze the dough between your fingers. Slice in squares or triangles and serve. If the bread is still crunchy and does not harden when touched, let cool slightly for 5 minutes or so and serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,brown rice,penne pasta,jicama,cauliflower,scotch bonnet pepper,confectioner ' sugar
title: Jicama Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta or 1 lb fettuccine pasta | cooking spray | 1 head cauliflower | 1 zucchini or 1 zucchini, trimmed, sliced lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1 inch thick pieces | 1 -2 scotch bonnet peppers or 1 -2 habanero pepper, minced | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 3 tablespoons brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta for about 5 minutes until al dente. Transfer to a large bowl and add the cooked pasta. Rinse pasta and add it to the pasta. In a frying pan over medium heat, spray cooking spray and add the peppers. Stir fry three minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add jicama and 1 tablespoons water to vegetables in the pan. Simmer 5 minutes then add in the rice and stir until the rice is coated. Put in a greased casserole dish and bake uncovered until heated through. Remove from oven, stir in the confectioners' sugar and serve.

title: Grilled Cheese on Ciabatta
ingredients: 1/2 cup peppercorns | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon white pepper, more to taste | 3 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | 6 slices ciabatta, toasted and lightly brushed with olive oil
instructions: In a large skillet with a lid, toast the peppercorns for 4 - 5 minutes, shaking and stirring frequently so that they stick to the skillet, and remove. Toast paprika in hot skillet for a few seconds. Add the italian seasoning, paprika and pepper. Stir to combine well. Transfer to medium bowl and toss with the cheeses. Serve immediately.

title: Thai Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 cups plain rice | 2 1/2 cups cold water, plus 2 1/2 cups water | 1/2 cup olive bread, diced | 1/2 cup green peas, frozen or can canned, drained | 2 tablespoons light tamari | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, or to taste
instructions: In a large saucepan combine the rice, water, sliced olive, tamari, and oyster sauce.

title: Dal-Charcoal Baked Pork (Pork Saag)
ingredients: 250 g white urad dal ( yellow split skinned, if available ) | 3 tablespoons salt | 1/2 lb ground lean pork | 1 tablespoon whole cumin seed | 1/4 teaspoon freshly crushed red cayenne pepper
instructions: Punch the dal and rinse it in several changes of water till water runs clear. Wash well. Bring 4 cups water to the boil in a wide, heavy bottomed saucepan. Add in the split skinned skinned pork, the salt, ground lean pork, cumin seeds, and red cayenne pepper. Cover and simmer over low heat for 1 1/2 hours or till the pork is tender and the dal is tender. Check the salt. If the pork is very dry during this process, stir in a little water or oil to thin it out. When the dal is very soft, remove from heat and cool completely. Using your hands, squeeze out as much water as possible and transfer it to a bowl. Stir in any additional salt and red pepper if using. Let stand about 15 minutes and drain off excess moisture. Transfer the pork to a lightly oiled or non stick griddle, and cook slowly on medium heat till nicely browned. This might take up to 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cut into 1 inch squares while still warm.

Random Ingredients: orange bell pepper,lettuce leaf,fennel seed,baking soda,sofrito sauce,bean
title: Fennel Seed and Bean Lettuce Rolls
ingredients: 400 g dried beans | 1 orange bell pepper, seeded and sliced | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 tablespoons sofrito sauce | fresh lettuce leaf ( optional ) | baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Place beans in a bowl, add 2 tbsp water and bring to the boil. Cover and place in the oven for 30 minutes until tender. Drain and leave to cool completely for a couple of minutes. Meanwhile, place the orange and bell pepper slices on a baking tray. Brush and spray with cooking oil and bake for 5 minutes. Turn, spray again, and bake for a further 3 - 4 minutes until golden. Set aside and. Heat the soya sauce in a small pan. Remove from heat and stir in the fennel. Line 2 lettuce leaves with the bean lettuce. Spoon in the fennel spice mix and top with the bean roll mix. Cut into thirds, serve with lime wedges and coriander leaves.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,cumin seed,hot green chili pepper,chicken bouillon cube
title: Quick and Easy Red Beans
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans, drained | 1 1/2 chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 2 -3 hot green chili peppers ( depending on taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Simmer to blend flavors for 5 minutes.

title: Roasted Shallots
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shallots, minced ( optional ) | 1 lb ground pork
instructions: Combine shallots and pork in a bowl, lightly but thoroughly mix. Spread mixture evenly on a large baking sheet. Sprinkle with salt. Bake in a preheated 325f oven for 40 minutes, stirring about every 15 minutes, or until the shallots are tender and crusty. Let stand for 5 minutes, then cut and serve.

title: Roast Beef With Citrus, Shallots, and Cumin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 6 shallots, minced | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb blend | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 cup orange juice | 3 lbs rump steak, trimmed of fat
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a dutch oven or heavy nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium high. Add shallots, italian herbs, and cumin to the hot oil, stirring often. Cook, stirring, until the shallots are translucent, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat. In a large zip top plastic bag, combine juices from the bag and juices. Add meat and seal the bag. Massage the air around the meat. Place dutch oven or heavy nonstick skillet in the oven and bake until meat is medium rare, about 90 minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes, slice across the grain.

title: Spaghetti With Chorizo V8
ingredients: 1/2 lb spanish chorizo, cut into 1 pieces and drained on paper towels | 1 lb spicy sausage, casings removed | 1 1/2 cups peeled, seeded, and diced mild | 1/3 cup chicken bouillon granule | 6 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 teaspoon instant vanilla | fresh dill sprigs ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Cook the chorizo in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat, breaking up clumps of chorizo, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside. Cook the sausage and 1/2 cup water in a 10 inch nonstick skillet, breaking up clumps, over high heat until the water is evaporated. Reduce the heat to moderately low. Add the sausages and 2 cups water. Cover and cook over moderately low heat, stirring occasionally, until the water is evaporated and the sausage is lightly browned, about 12 to 15 minutes. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat from the skillet. Add the bouillon granules and eggs.

title: Adobe Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crushed annatto seeds | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Store in a covered container.

title: Chermoula Stuffed With Sausage
ingredients: 1 teaspoon soft light italian cheese or 1 teaspoon lowfat greek yogurt | 2 slices rye bread | 1/2 cup rye bread, stale and cut into little triangles or 1/2 cup chopped breadcrumbs | 12 ladyfingers | 4 links sweet italian sausage ( about 2 oz/170 grams ) | 3 tablespoons light italian cheese or 3 tablespoons gorgonzola cheese, divided
instructions: Stuff the sausage with the sausages and toast 1 slice of nori about a minute. Turn the sausage as necessary to coat each slice. Spread the rye bread pieces on a baking sheet and toast in a 450 degree oven for 10 - 15 minutes until crisp and golden brown. Allow at least 15 minutes. Spread each slice of bread with a little light cheese. Wrap the sausage around a slice of bread, pushing the edges closed so the cheese doesn't stick to the bread. Arrange on plates topped with a little cheese on each. Serve 1 slice of nori diagonally and the remaining slice of bread on the side. Enjoy with a nice glass of yoghurt as a dip.

title: Easy One-Pot Mandarin Pickles and Apples
ingredients: 2 cups sliced mandarin oranges ( about 4 ) | 2 large apples, peeled and sliced into thin wedges | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place oranges and apples into a large bowl, scatter with vinegar and serve. Note, if desired to use as a side dish, serve a small mound of orange mixture on a small plate.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,green chili pepper,molasses,brown rice,garlic paste
title: Korean Green Pea and Rice Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup molasses | 4 1/2 cups chicken stock | 1/4 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/8 cup green chili pepper, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup brown rice or 1/2 cup white rice
instructions: In a medium pot, combine molasses, chicken stock, garlic and chile pepper. Bring to a boil. Add rice.

title: Tibetan Tamari Meatballs  (Tibetan)
ingredients: 1 lb country-style boneless pork ribs, chopped | 1 lb quince, chopped ( a generous handful ) | 4 ears corn, shucked and shelled | 1 2/3 cups tamari | 1 cup grated kefalotyri cheese or 1 cup grated parmesan-reggiano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 2 -3 drops vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and shape into small meatballs. Grill on the grill, turning every minute or so to brown all sides. Serve over hot cooked rice or with fresh bread.

title: Pigs in Blankets With Gorgonzola and Smoked Sausages
ingredients: 6 pork shoulder | 3 1/2 ounces gorgonzola, room-temperature | 1 ounce gorgonzola, room-temperature | 1 1/2 ounces smoked sausage, sliced into 1/4-inch wide pieces | 1/2 lemon, juice of | 1/8 cup breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: For the pig feet, prepare all three parts of the feet, starting in the hind leg, midribs, drumsticks, wings, feet and wings at joint joint, knees, feet or back. Truss the legs between the toes so that there are no large bits of visible fat. Preheat oven to 300°f. Place the pig feet in a pot large enough to hold them in a single layer and fill with about 2 quarts of water. Cover the pot and put the pot, covered, in the oven. Cook for 3 hours, skimming off any scum that floats to the surface. Remove feet, and discard twigs and twigs. Set aside, skimming and fat remaining in pot, and return them to the pot for 15 minutes. Remove the twigs, and add the gorgonzola and smoked sausage to the pot, mashing them into the gorgonzola until they are thoroughly incorporated. Dilute the gorgonzola and sausage in the lemon juice with 1 tbsp water, making sure that it has the consistency of a light coating of fat. Put the pig feet in a serving bowl, or platter, and toss with the sausage mixture. Heat the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle with bread crumbs, and fry for about a minute. Spoon the mixture into the bowl with the pig feet, and serve from the baking dish that you have prepared the pig feet from. Serve remaining bacon on the side.

title: Homemade Chipotle Buns
ingredients: 2 cups unbleached all-purpose baking powder | 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the baking powder and yeast. Place 2 tablespoons of flour in the bowl with the yeast. Slowly add enough more flour to make a soft dough that pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl covered with a cloth, and cover with a cloth paper. Let dough rest in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Heat a cast iron skillet to medium high heat. Roll dough into long rods, and cut into 2 or 3 pieces. Pour dough into hot skillet, and brown on all sides. Place on a plate lined with parchment paper, and cover with a cloth kitchen towel. Allow to rise until doubled in bulk, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,vanilla bean,splenda sugar substitute
title: Low Fat Creamy Vanilla Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can fat free cream of chicken soup | splenda sugar substitute | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans, seeds in ( seeds of 1 vanilla bean )
instructions: Put the cans of soup with the vanilla bean in a small pot and bring to a boil.. Sprinkle with sugar and serve.

Random Ingredients: prosciutto,lipton onion soup mix,chocolate,caraway seed,maple syrup,pizza dough bread machine,apple,beef stock
title: Sweet Italian Meatballwiches from the Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 package lipton dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup honey mustard | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1/8 cup beef stock | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 8 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced | 12 ounces pizza dough bread ( or other thin-sliced deli roll )
instructions: Place beef in the pan of your bread machine, sprinkle with soup mix, honey, maple syrup, beef stock, caraway seeds and prosciutto slices. Pour mixture into the bread machine and select the basic or white, light crust. When completed, use a spatula to make meatball sandwiches from the bread using about 2 teaspoons per sandwich.

Random Ingredients: coriander,brinjal,bean sprout,iceberg lettuce,walnut oil,spanish chorizo,shrimp,green chili pepper
title: Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 iceberg lettuce | 125 g cooked shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 small spanish chorizo, chopped | 1 small green chili pepper, halved, deseeded and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons coriander, chopped, plus more to serve | 5 tablespoons walnut oil | 400 g mixed beans sprouts | 1 small handful finely chopped green chili pepper, for garnishing
instructions: Place the iceberg on 2 serving plates and set aside. Place half the shrimp in a bowl with half the chorizo, half the chorizo mixture, lettuce and coriander. Toss everything together with 2 tablespoons of the oil and season to taste. Scatter over some green chili pepper and the remaining chorizo mixture. Dress the rest of the bean sprouts with the remaining oil, scatter over and pile over the salad. Garnish with chilies. Serve with the remaining chorizo mixture.

title: Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 4 tablespoons grated fresh cilantro | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 3 tablespoons fresh tahini ( sesame seed ) | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Separate the lettuce leaves, and place them in salad plates. Cut the eggs into quarters, and then into small wedges. To make the dressing, peel the eggs. Crack them in a bowl, and add the yolks, sesame seeds, and cilantro. Toss well as you are tossing the dressing. Serve immediately.

title: Lamb Wrappings With Raspberry Liqueur
ingredients: 1 1/8 kg sirloin or 1 1/8 kg lamb, trimmed ( approx. 1.5kg or 2.5kg beef ) | 1 packet taco seasoning | 250 g frozen raspberries ( approx. 30 ) | 1/3 cup garlic paste | 1 shallot, finely chopped
instructions: Heat grill. Place meat on grill tray. Place a small wok on top of the meat, sprinkle over taco seasoning. Toss to combine. Sear meat in the wok, for approx 10 minutes or until cooked through and meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f on the thickest part. Remove from grill and allow to rest for 3 minutes then slice across into thin strips. Serve with frozen raspberries and your favourite chutney, accompanied by your favourite chips or fresh bread.

title: Mexican Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 4 cans corn oil or ( 10 3/4 ounce ) cans vegetable oil | 1/2 - 3/4 cup green chili, minced ( i don't add these, but this gives you the heat, feel free to adjust to your desired heat )
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a frying pan. If your oil is too hot, it will make the con queso taste a bit bland. Add your chili and cook for approximately a minute or two. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,poppy seed,adobo sauce,shrimp,sage,green pepper,chili flake
title: Camarones
ingredients: 2 cups shrimp, peeled and deveined | 4 chiles | 1 tablespoon dried sage ( dried will be used as a garnish ) | 2 teaspoons chili flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons poppy seeds ( or other seeds for a kick, but i like a touch ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon adobo sauce ( depending how much heat i have! ) | 1 tablespoon chopped green pepper
instructions: Wash chiles and slit lengthwise in 1/2 inch wide strips. Remove seeds from chiles and rinse. Place in a bowl and sprinkle lightly with salt. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Place chiles on paper towels to drain most of the moisture. Dry well with paper towels. Place shrimp and remaining ingredients in a large skillet and cook over high heat for 20 - 30 seconds or until shrimp turns pink.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,cardamom powder,celery rib,tomato juice,brown rice,red wine
title: Vegan Oranges & Beef Skillet Supper
ingredients: 2 medium brown rice, cooked | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 cup tomato juice | 1 tablespoon tomato paste or 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients except orange juice, paste, and cardamom in a 2 quart saute pan. Heat to boiling.

title: Chinese Chicken and Peach Salad
ingredients: 500 g chicken breasts, cubed | 200 g peaches | 200 g bell peppers, sliced | food coloring, a splash
instructions: Slice chicken in half and steam with bell peppers for 10 minutes. While chicken is steaming, cut peaches in half and remove pits with rolling pin. Slice peaches in half to make more room. Once chicken has finished steaming, add the food coloring to a little bit of water in a bowl and stir until dissolved. Cut chicken in small bite sized pieces. Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir. Serve with lettuce and carrots.

title: Stir Fried Mushrooms for Two
ingredients: 2 cups sliced fresh mushrooms | cooking spray
instructions: Prepare a large skillet or wok according to package directions. Heat the cooking oil in the skillet or wok over medium high heat until the oil ripples and is beginning to shimmer, about 2 minutes. Add mushrooms, and cook until they begin to lightly brown, about 10 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer the mixture until it thickens, a few minutes. Spray both ramekins with cooking spray, and return to heat. Pour mushrooms and liquid into a bowl, and pour mixture into ramekins to serve. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: rice vermicelli,parmigiano reggiano cheese,red chili pepper,white sugar,phyllo pastry,coconut,green chilies,chunky salsa
title: Arrabbiata Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup white sugar | 2 1/2 tablespoons shredded coconut | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1/8 cup finely chopped green chilies | 1 package rice vermicelli | 24 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a saucepan, combine the sugar, coconut, chile pepper and 1/2 cup water. Place over medium heat and cook for 5 minutes or until sugar is completely dissolved. Cool mixture to room temperature. Stir in the salsa, chilies and rice vermicelli. Lay phyllo on a clean, dry surface and generously brush with water. Working with one sheet at a time, stack 3 sheets of phyllo in front of you, keeping brushing with water. Place a second sheet of phyllo on top and brush with water. Repeat this process until you are out of 3 sheets. Working with 3 sheets at a time, line a baking sheet with 1 sheet of phyllo. Lightly brush with water and lay in the pan. Brush with more water and spread the remaining phyllo sheets. Place a third sheet and one third phyllo layer in pan and repeat the process 3 times, brushing every time with water. Spread half of the salsa mixture over the phyllo sheets, half of the vermicelli and half of parmigiano reggiano cheese. Repeat these layers once more, making 4 stacks total. Bake the rolls for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown. Allow the rolls to cool completely before slicing into 1/4 inch rounds.

title: Homemade Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup whole-milk greek yogurt | kosher salt, for soaking
instructions: Place a mesh broiler or a coffee filter in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: pepperoncini pepper,tamari,onion salt,cranberry,malibu rum,caster sugar,brown lentil
title: Moorish Nuts & Peppers in Spike Rum
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh brown lentils, rinsed | 1 ounce cracked pepperoncini pepper, finely chopped | 1 small onion, finely chopped | 2 fresh pepperoncini peppers, finely chopped | 1 ounce tamari | 2 ounces caster sugar | 3 ounces cranberry vinegar
instructions: Bring 3 cups of cold water to the boil adding the lentils and the cracked pepperoncino pepper, mix well, remove from heat and leave to stand until tender, about 10 minutes or so. Drain, cool and then drain well again and combine the lentils, black pepper, onion, pepperoncini, tamari, sugar and cranberry vinegar. Serve immediately.

title: Cajun Dilled Pancetta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons diced pancetta, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped dill
instructions: Combine pancetta, dijon mustard powder, and dill in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse until mixture forms a paste, 5 or 6 pulses. Transfer to a small skillet and cook on medium high heat until underside is a rich crumbly layer. Remove skillet from skillet, and sprinkle with remaining dijon mustard. Cut into 1/2 inch wide wedges to serve.

title: Perfect Pasta
ingredients: 200 g pasta, such as shells, small ravioli or 200 g ravioli, shape and shape, fresh is best | 1/3 cup fine fresh breadcrumb, for coating | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumbs, extra dried ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200dc. Place pasta in a large bowl. Add a little breadcrumb and parsley and mix. With your hands form a compact shape into a hollow shape, making sure the pasta is sitting upright on the base. Place into a baking dish and brush lightly with extra breadcrumb, if using. Bake for about 40 minutes or until cooked through. Cooks note, a shortcut is to shape the meat into small meatballs, then fry in a little oil. Cooks note, if making the meatballs, place the meat at the bottom of a meat loaf or sausage and bake in the oven.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,rigatoni pasta,coriander leaf,beer,cottage cheese,brown mustard
title: Stir-Fried Rigatoni With Caramelized Mushrooms and Spiced Cheese
ingredients: 300 g rigatoni pasta ( or other short pasta ) | 150 g light cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce or 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon brown mustard | 1 medium brown mushroom | fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente, drain. Cool under running water. Chop and stir fry mushrooms and sauce. Toss with pasta and garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

title: Indian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/3 cup yoghurt | 2 tablespoons flour | 1/2 cup wine ( white or rose )
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir to mix well. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,wheat flour,pepper,pear,cream,baking potato,grape leaf,mustard seed
title: Potato and Pepper Pierogies
ingredients: 1 cup wheat flour | 2 large baking potatoes | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can sliced pears ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | pepper | 1 pint grape leaves, washed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a large bowl, combine the flour and baking potato. Peel and cut the potatoes into 1 inch cubes all the way through.. In a saucepan, add the kidney beans, pears, sour cream, and mustard seeds. Boil for about 30 seconds. Remove pan from heat, set aside to cool a bit. Place a spoonful of the filling into the center of a grape leaf. Fold over and pinch in the ends. Place pierogies on a baking sheet and bake 45 minute, or until bubbly and brown.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,sumaq,sugar snap pea,vegetable bouillon cube,allspice,cayenne pepper,red onion
title: Fancy Easy Sugar Snap Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 lb sugar snap peas | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons fresh minced red onions | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon sumaq
instructions: Snap ends off the sugar snap peas. Blanch at least 4 minutes in small stock pot. Drain, cool slightly, peel off and discard the peels. Blend remaining ingredients in small bowl with half of the spice mix. Add pea puree. Chill for a few hours, then serve. Note, this is an easily made soup. A serving size is 4 servings, or enough to make 4 servings or more. If you do it the recipe is to be eaten with your loved ones as a meal, you can fill the empty soup bowls with cold, fresh bread and serve with a little of the cinnamon.

title: Frozen Walnut Pudding
ingredients: 100 g walnut halves | 200 g walnut halves ( toasted ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Wash & dry the walnut halves. Lightly grease a 2 1/2 or 3 litre/1 pint pudding basin or 6 individual gratin dishes. Dive the walnut halves in half so they are evenly rounded & roughly crushed & put into a bowl. Heat oven to 190 deg c. Heat a small, deep frying pan over a medium heat & add 1teaspoon of boiling water, to make a liquid 1 teaspoonful of vanilla essence. Add the walnuts & allow them to sizzle for a couple minutes. Drain the walnuts & combine the walnut bits & 2 tbsp of hot liquid in the bowl with the walnut bits & vanilla essence. Turn the mixture into the greased & lined pudding basin. Add the rest of the liquid & mix well to combine everything but the vanilla extract. Cover & bake for about 30 minutes. Remove from oven & pour the cooled cherry cream topping over the top & serve warm.

title: Velveeta Cheese With Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 3 egg yolks | 1 lb ground velveeta cheese | 1/2 lb brussels sprout, chopped, stems removed | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, chopped | 1 teaspoon tarragon, chopped | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Place egg yolks in bowl and beat with electric mixer on medium speed, scraping bowl frequently and scraping bowl. Add cheese, stir until melted. In separate bowl, add sprouts, lemongrass, tarragon and pineapple.

title: Pumpkin Pumpkin Gravy
ingredients: 2 cans pumpkin puree | 2 cans low sodium beef broth | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum or 2 teaspoons soy gum | 1 1/2 cups fresh pumpkin, peeled and diced
instructions: Put the meat into a 4 quart or larger stockpot or other soup pot. Over medium high heat, warm the beef broth to almost boiling.. Pour in the pumpkin and the stock. Add the xanthan gum into the water and stir, being careful it does not stick. Cover the pot and bring it to a boil. Adjust the heat slightly, lower the heat and simmer the pumpkin until the pumpkin is very tender, about 20 - 30 minutes. Remove the pumpkin from the pot and taste a little thick and adjust the seasoning to your liking.

title: Tibetan Chili Paste (Tebul)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon ajwain
instructions: Dry fry the ajwain well by heating it slowly over medium heat for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly. It will become darker and slower, about 20 - 30 minutes. Cool the paste. Once it cools you can form it into a paste. Warm it up as you would normal paste or you can form it into a paste again. Some texture has also been achieved by heating it up slightly. Enjoy.

title: Spicy Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked large shrimp | 8 cups favourite pasta sauce | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/4 cup white wine | 2 tablespoons mixed spice
instructions: Peel shrimp and devein. Combine shrimps with pasta sauce, malt vinegar, white wine, mixed spice. Cook covered over low heat for 5 - 10 minutes or until shrimp are cooked.

title: Peperonata
ingredients: 1 sprig fresh rosemary | cold water | 4 ounces pecorino romano cheese, coarsely grated ( not shaved! ) | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg ( freshly grated )
instructions: Separate the rosemary stalk & discard the leaves. Set a small roasting pan flat with the rosemary stem & brush lightly with olive oil. Bake at 350 deg for 30 mins or more. Add the cheese & brush all over with the oil. Bake for 10 mins & sprinkle the rosemary with the salt. Continue baking for 15 - 20 mins or till creamy and beginning to soften.

Random Ingredients: bay seasoning,creme de cassis,sage leaf,nonfat milk,bread crumb,red kidney bean,salmon steak
title: Salmon With Island Sausage and Red Beans
ingredients: 6 salmon steaks | 1/4 cup dry bread crumbs | 4 tablespoons nonfat milk | 10 fresh sage leaves | 2 tablespoons old bay seasoning | 1 can red kidney beans | 2 tablespoons creme de cassis, liquor
instructions: Wash and dry the salmon. Place on a baking sheet and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350f for about 20 minutes or until cooked when pierced with a fork. While the salmon cooks, preheat oven to 350f degrees. Pour the milk over the beans when the salmon is done. Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons old bay seasoning over the beans. Cover it with crumbled cooked salmon. Mix creme de sassis and remaining old bay seasoning together. Sprinkle over the top of the salmon and the sausages. Pour the white of the creme de sassis over the salmon. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Fruit Shake
ingredients: 1 cup apricot preserves | 1 cup ice | 1/4 cup seasoning mix ( prepared mix ) | 2 teaspoons ground allspice | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place apricot preserves and ice in blender or food processor/blender. Add seasoning mix and allspice. Puree till smooth. Add bay leaf. Cover and shake till all ingredients are mixed and chilled. Serve in shot glass or martini glass.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,hoisin sauce,greek yogurt,crisco,dark raisin,garlic granule,almond essence,heavy whipping cream
title: Guilt-Free Yoghurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced almonds, toasted or 1/2 cup toasted almond flakes | 1/2 cup dark raisin | 1 teaspoon garlic granules or 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon dark raisin essence | 1 teaspoon greek yogurt
instructions: Filling, heat a non stick pan over medium heat. Add almonds, raisins, garlic, coriander seeds, and saute for a minute. Add yoghurt and stir until the yoghurt has melted. Turn off the heat and stir in the hoisin sauce. For cream topping, in a little oil, heat cream. As soon as it reaches the light boil, stir in the cream and reduce heat to low. Stirring constantly, allow the cream to simmer to thicken. As soon as you add the raisins and nuts, stir in the dark raisin essence. Remove from heat and leave to cool for 5 minutes. Stir in yoghurt and stir until the consistency is smooth about 5 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: beef shank,thai basil,smart balance butter spread,brandy
title: Quick  Brandy Sauce  for Shanks  (Thai Beef)
ingredients: 4 lbs beef shank | 1 1/2 cups smart balance butter spread | 1/4 cup brandy | 1/4 cup thai basil
instructions: Spray crock and bowl all with a pam spray. Place beef shanks in crock. Combine the other sauce ingrediants and pour over beef. Seal and cook at 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours or until meat falls apart and sauce is thickened and syrupy.

title: Chilean Minted Pigfish
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuckling pig | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | salt | 1 fresh mint leaf, chopped
instructions: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly into a paste. Refrigerate for at least one hour or overnight. Use 2 1/2 oz portions for sandwiches or double for a double crusty loaf.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,broccoli,iceberg lettuce,apricot jam,beef chuck,fish sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,vegetable oil
title: Apricot Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons smooth apricot jam | 3/4 lb boneless beef chuck, trimmed of fat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 cup coarsely shredded american cheese | 16 slices sharp cheddar cheese | 1 head broccoli, cut into small florets
instructions: Combine lettuce, apricot jam, beef and fish sauce in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate 20 minutes. Heat oil in 10 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until just smoking. Cook beef 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned. Reduce heat to medium. Add cheese, cheese and beef mixture.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,mirin,mutton,chili pepper flake,sage leaf,cocoa powder
title: Feta Mutton Skewers in Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2/3 cup of shaved feta cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons of shaved mutton ( optional ) | 1 dried chili pepper flakes | 3 -4 fresh sage leaves ( optional ) or 3 -4 fresh thyme leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon mirin
instructions: Soak the mint leaves and the chinese herbs in boiling water for a few minutes, then remove them from the pot and allow to cool. Pour all the ingredients off and then mix them in with the mint and chinese herbs. Cover and leave to soak for at least 1 hour. Thread the mutton onto soaked bamboo skewers and grill over hot coals for 2 minutes on each side, or put them over hot coals in a pre heated griddle and cook slowly for 30 - 40 minutes, turning occasionally. Serve with dipping sauce and white rice/rice.

title: Hot Chayote With Maple
ingredients: 4 large chayote, steamed | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup mizithra cheese
instructions: Fill an enamel saucepan with water and bring it to a boil. Drop chayote into the boiling water, cover, and cook over moderate heat until soft, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain and chop into 1/2 inch pieces. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Heat the maple syrup in a large skillet.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,cream mushroom soup,green chili pepper,caster sugar
title: Spanish Cheese Bread Dip
ingredients: 2 cups mexican blend cheese ( any strong cheese will work ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 green chili pepper, diced | 1/2 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Combine all in a bowl and mash down until creamy and smooth.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,lettuce,mint leaf,italian sausage,cottage cheese
title: Lettuce, Sausage, and Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 4 ounces ground italian sausage ( or use sausage of your choice ) | 12 small lettuce ( leafs are my favorite ) | 1 ounce mint leaf ( optional ) | 12 slices fresh bread ( i prefer french or italian flavored )
instructions: Combine soup and sausage into a skillet and simmer about 8 minutes. Stir well. Spread bottom of cookie sheet with half of soup mixture and layer with lettuce, sausage and cheese. Top with remaining soup mixture. Top each sandwich with slice of bread. Spread remaining soup mixture onto each side and top with mint leaves if using. Bake in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes or until bread is golden.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,dark chocolate,almond,sesame seed,red chili pepper,salsa
title: Chili Beef & Almond Casserole
ingredients: 250 g stewing beef | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 1 jar medium hot salsa | 3 tablespoons dark chocolate | 1 fresh red chili pepper, finely chopped | 125 g large toasted almonds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. Place the sesame seeds in a shallow baking dish. Cover with boiling water and stand for 5 - 10 minutes until softened. Drain well and place in an ovenproof dish. Put the beef in a pan with 1/4 cup water and 1/8 cup water and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for 1½ hours. Turn the heat up to 400°c. Meanwhile, melt the chocolate with 2 tablespoons water in a metal bowl over a medium heat. Remove the meat from the heat and stir in the chilli. Pour into the dish and scatter the almonds on top, then cover with foil and cook for 25 minutes. Remove the foil and cook for a further 10 - 15 mins until the topping is caramelised. Transfer to a serving plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: molasses,taco seasoning mix,hot pepper,italian breadcrumb,english cucumber,date,spaghetti sauce mix
title: Quick Spanish Cucumber Sauce
ingredients: 1 large spanish cucumber, chopped | 1 jar spaghetti sauce mix | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | hot pepper, diced ( optional ) | 2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 jar roasted sweet peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly oil a jelly roll pan. In a large bowl, combine the sauce mix, taco seasoning, bread crumbs, and peppers. Stir in the cucumber and 1 cup of the bread crumbs, just to coat. Transfer to the prepared pan. In the oven, toast the remaining 1 cup of bread crumbs on a baking sheet for 7 - 10 minutes, or until crisp and golden brown. Turn pan over, add toasted bread crumbs, and stir to mix. Serve warm.

title: Baked Mussels in Lobster Sauce
ingredients: 1 kg fresh mussels | 500 g fresh pork | cooking oil ( for deep frying ) | 250 g brown sugar | 1 bunch fresh mussels, cleaned, debearded, and halved
instructions: Wash the mussels and debeard them. Clean the pork well and slice it into 1 or 2 inch circles. Preheat the oven to 150c/300°f. Line a large oven tray with aluminium foil. Place the mussels on this, then top with the pork, leaving some space around the shell as it will cook. Heat a couple of tablespoons of oil in a large saucepan on high heat. When the oil is hot, add the mussels and cook them on the second side for about a minute. Remove and set aside. Boil the water in a large pot. When the water is boiling pour the water away. Mix together the brown sugar and remaining oil. Taste and add brown sugar to your taste then add as much or as little of this mixture to the boiling water and mussels, saving 3/4 cup for later on. Drain the mussels and serve over the mussels. Place the mussels with the rest of the liquid in a baking dish. Top with the fried mussels and bake in the oven, uncovered, for about 15 to 20 minutes, until the liquid and the chicken juices have been reduced and reduced. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,pork tenderloin,chicken stock vegetable,half,guacamole,pork chop,feta cheese,green olive
title: Cuban Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 2 x 1/4-inch strips | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 -3 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar | 8 green olives, sliced | 12 -16 greek feta cheese, crumbled | 16 -20 g guacamole | 8 hamburger-style pork chops
instructions: Place pork strips in a large zipper bag. Add stock and vinegar. Marinate at least 1 hour, but no longer than 3 hours. In a large skillet, heat olive oil on medium high heat until hot but not smoking, and brown pork strips for a few minutes on each side. Remove from skillet and keep warm. To assemble, place a small pile of pork onto the work surface and surround with a few sliced olives. Place a few crumbled monterrey's cheese along the top of the meat. Slice a loaf, and lay on top of the cheese and olives. Place a few crumbled feta over the cheese as well as a few slices of sliced jalapeno peppers on top of the cheese. Then place a small pile of pork over that. Place about a dozen warmed hamburger style pork chops on top of the meat and cheese. Place more sliced olives across the top. Add a small pile of guacamole. Repeat with the last three pile of pork. When ready to serve, you can also use toothpicks or a slotted spoon to serve on a bed of your favorite rice.

title: Lebanese Lemongrass Meatballs
ingredients: 2 lbs meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons lemongrass, sliced, washed and finely chopped | 2/3 cup almond milk | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon catsup ( optional )
instructions: Bring a medium sized saucepan of water to a boil. Meanwhile, combine the lemongrass and remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Drop the meat by heaping tablespoons onto the boiling water and cook until they are just cooked through. Drain and serve immediately.

title: Easy Faux Strawberry Berry  Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen sliced strawberries, thawed and drained | 4 eggs noodles | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place drained strawberries in a medium bowl. Cover with boiling water.

title: The Cheese and Bean Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 cup oatmeal | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt, if using regular salt | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, if using regular salt | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/4 cup manchego cheese, grated | 8 -12 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 c or 170 c if using regular temperature. Spray two baking trays with cooking spray. Place the oatmeal, salt, spices and grated cheese in a heatproof bowl. Place the vanilla bean on top. Place the bowl on a tray of hot water and let sit for 15 minutes. Drain of liquid. Using a wooden spoon, scrape the vanilla bean into the bowl with the spice mixture and stir to blend. Add toasted oatmeal and stir. Remove the bowl and the vanilla bean from the water. Use your hands to mix, until all of the ingredients have been incorporated. Place each wrap on a dry surface until ready to use. Lightly oil your hands and roll them until you have a wrap of about 5cm diameter about 10cm thick. Place the wrap in a baking tray, seam side down. Place the tray in the oven and bake for 10 minutes, or until the wrap is a light golden brown. Remove the wrap and cut into slices, if desired. Serve with a nice green salad or fruit sorbet.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,apple juice,red date,chili,plain flour,goat cheese,sirloin tip roast
title: Aussie Beef Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, cut into thin strips | 1 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup chilled apple juice | 1/2 cup chilled mandarin oranges, halved lengthways | 300 g red dates, halved | 3/4 cup canned chili, drained with juice | 200 g goat cheese ( optional )
instructions: Toss beef strips with flour to coat. Heat apple juce or chilled juice in large non stick pan. Cook over high heat for 3 minutes or until beef starts to brown. Stir in beef strips. Cover and cook in medium to hot over for 5 minutes or until beef is cooked. Add beef and cook for another 5 minutes or until beef is cooked through. Add halved oranges, dates and chilli. Stir, cover and cook for a further 10 minutes until beef is tender. Turn beef into serving plate and scatter over goats cheese. Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,marmalade,phyllo pastry,chili garlic sauce,pink bean,sirloin steak
title: Steak with Phyllo and Beans
ingredients: 500 g sirloin steaks | 500 g plain flour or 4 ounces baking flour | 3 -4 tablespoons marmalade | 500 g sweet pink beans ( canned or tinned ) | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce, such as la kounoupy | 12 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat the grill to moderate medium, or about as high as it can go. Trim the very fatty ends from the steak and cut into small chunks. Mix the flour on a board or chopping board with a pastry twine. Make a well in the centre of the flour and add the steak and marmalade. Knead the mixture with your hands until the meat is evenly coated and the flour is distributed all the way around. It may have the best instructions for achieving the correct consistency or consistency for your particular steak. Divide the mixture into 18 equal portions, then place on a board and knead for a few, or several, minutes until it comes together. Place a little flour on your work surface and roll out the pastry. Using a rolling pin, roll it out to cover a rectangular biscuit cutter tray or large, flat tin that you have put the fish into. Cut out 4 squares or rectangles and place them on to the pastry and gently push with your fingers to flatten slightly. Repeat with the rest of the pastry or the fillings. Put the parcels into the tray and brush with a little olive oil if you prefer. Brush the top lightly with olive oil and grill them for 2 - 3 minutes. Leave them to cool, or leave for up to 2 hours in a warm place. Heat the grill or the pan to high. Cook the beans for 4 - 5 minutes on each side, until cooked through.

title: Vietnamese Chicken Stock
ingredients: 1 green cardamom pod | 3 quarts chicken stock or 3 quarts chicken
instructions: Cut the green cardamom pods in half. In a 6 quart kettle combine the cardamom pods with the chicken. Add hot water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low and simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until tender. Cool. Remove the cardamom pods and discard. Pour the soup into bottles.

title: Prawn Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, in water | 3/4 cup red wine, in smallish pieces ( i prefer cabernet sauvignon ) | 1/2 lb small shrimp, rinsed | 4 tortillas | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated
instructions: Put the cherries in a bowl. Pour the red wine into a saucepan and boil rapidly for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool. Add the shrimp to the hot cherry and cherry juices in the bowl and toss over medium heat, until the shrimp is pink and the pieces are firm. Spoon the prawns into a serving bowl and toss to coat well. Arrange the tortillas on plates. Sprinkle on the cheese and set aside for 2 to 3 minutes. Spoon the prawns over the tortillas and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,nori,cherry tomato,cardamom,brown rice,lamb,hot red chili pepper,mustard powder
title: Kimbap (Indonesian Lamb and Rice Salad With Ramen Nori
ingredients: 4 cups cooked brown rice | 1/2 cup finely chopped lamb | 1/2 cup fresh cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1 hot red chili pepper, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon red mustard powder | 3 cups chicken wings ( split on the diagonal )
instructions: Cook the rice in a saucepan of boiling water until just tender. Add the lamb and cook another 2 - 3 minutes. Transfer the pan to a plate. Drain the rice and lamb and rinse under cold water, then set aside. Wash the nori in a dry cloth and cut each sheet in half lengthwise. Cut each half into 4 - 8 long pieces and arrange over a bamboo rolling mat on a dinner plate. Spread the nori over the nori in a single layer. Top with the cherry tomatoes, cut side down. Dribble the chili pepper evenly over the nori. Sprinkle the mustard powder over the chili. Place one piece of chicken onto the chili, then scatter over about 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamon. Fold the nori over and press down lightly. The rice will absorb all the moisture. If necessary, dampen the nori with warm water. Cover with a sheet of nori closest to you, then continue rolling, tucking the nori around the chicken in a spiral pattern and pressing the edges firmly. When all the nori is used, you may wrap the nori around the meat in the sushi nori to conceal it. Slice the nori into thin strips 3 - 4 wide. Cut each strip into two 3 long strips about 12 wide.

title: Spicy Coconut and Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 tablespoon lemons, juice of or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 10 slices thick whole wheat bread, toasted
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans. Puree them, mix together with remaining ingredients, place in a dish and chill for several hours or overnight. Serve as a vegetarian entree or serve as a cold side dish to stirfry. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: grenadine,yukon gold potato,ladyfinger,brown sugar,cream coconut,olive oil,salsa,lemon pepper
title: Sweet Potato, Lemon and Olive Trifle
ingredients: 3 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled, sliced into 8 wedges each | 2 lbs ladyfingers, sliced into 8 pieces | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 cup light brown sugar | 1 1/3 cups light cream of coconut, drained | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper | 1/3 cup fresh salsa ( your brand. this recipe calls for spicy ) | 1/2 cup sour cream, lightly whipped | 1/4 cup grenadine
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 20 minutes. Drain. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Prepare a 9x5 inch loaf pan with parchment paper. In a large bowl, toss potatoes with 1/2 cup olive oil, brown sugar, sour cream and lemon pepper. Toss to coat. Arrange half of potato mixture in the bottom of the loaf pan. Repeat with remaining potato mixture, ending with savory sauce. Bake in preheated oven 45 minutes. Invert onto serving platter. Cover platter with foil. Continue baking for 20 minutes to brown tops and crisp outside edges. While loaf bakes, stir together salsa, sour cream and grenadine. Remove from oven. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, toss with salsa mixture. Serve warm.

title: Toshoyaki
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shoyaki mushroom | 2 chopped bok choy
instructions: In a pan, put mushrooms and cover. Allow to cook for about 5 minutes until mushrooms are soft and the mushrooms have released some water. Cut off stems. Put shoyaki mushroom and bok choy into a bowl. Mash together into a paste. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,milk,rosemary sprig,kidney bean,peanut butter,yellow pepper,kernel corn
title: Beef and Corn Stew With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 lb cooked beef chuck, cut into cubes | 3/4 cup milk | 3/4 cup whole kernel corn, drained | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, cut into strips | 4 fresh rosemary sprigs | 3/4 cup smooth peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups canned kidney beans, drained
instructions: In a bowl, combine beef, milk, corn, sweet pepper, sill and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Melt peanut butter in a 3 to 4 quart slow cooker. Stir in kidney beans and cook on low heat 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through.

title: Rigatoni with Milk and Cream
ingredients: 3/4 cup nonfat milk | 3/4 cup rigatoni pasta, uncooked
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat milk and cream over medium heat. Stir in pasta. Cook until desired tenderness.

title: Steak, Bok Choy and Green Onions
ingredients: 1 pound flank steak, thinly sliced | 3 heads bok choy, root ends trimmed and leaves coarsely chopped | 6 green onions, white parts thinly sliced
instructions: Place the beef in a mixing bowl of water for about 10 minutes to soften. While the beef is soaking, cut off and discard the tough leaves from the choy. Use a sharp knife to separate the leaves from the stalks and discard. Cut crosswise into thin strips about 2 inches long and 1 1/4 inches wide. Slice the meat thinly across the grain. Transfer the meat to a platter, cover, and refrigerate. The onions will need to marinate for at least 15 minutes. When ready, remove the beef from the refrigerator, and rinse in cold water. Drain and dry on paper towels. Add about 4 inches of water to a wok or large skillet with a lid over high heat. When the water is hot, carefully add the choy stalks and cook, stirring often, until just wilted. Transfer to a platter, and set aside. Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat. When it is hot, pour in enough oil to cover the bottom. Add the onions, and stir fry until golden. Drain on paper towels. Drain the cooked beef in a colander, removing excess oil. Heat the remaining oil in the wok over high heat. When the oil is hot, add the beef and marinated onion. Stir fry, stirring, until the beef is no longer opaque. Taste and add salt and additional salt if needed. Serve the beef with the onions and green onions.

Random Ingredients: honey mustard,lemon juice zest,ketchup,applesauce,pimiento,canola oil,poultry seasoning
title: Low Fat Deviled Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup catsauce | 1/2 cup applesauce | 2 tablespoons canola oil, divided | 1 1/2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 -2 pimiento, drained
instructions: Combine the ketchup, worchestershire sauce, catsauce, applesauce, 2 tablespoons of the canola oil, paprika, poultry seasoning and lemon peel. Stir well. Taste and adjust seasoning. If you prefer a hotter consistency, add another lemon zest if desired. Pour mixture into a sealable plastic bag and add the pimentos. Seal bag and turn to coat. Refrigerate overnight, turning bag over occasionally so the paprika adheres. Remove chicken from bag and shake off the excess oil. Place on a well oiled baking sheet. Spread the remaining teaspoon of canola oil to coat the bottom of the baking sheet. Broil under low heat for 30 seconds, flip and broil for another 30 seconds. Remove chicken from the oven and coat with your favourite kind of dip or gravy.

Random Ingredients: salad green,asparagus,fajita seasoning mix,rice wine,irish cream,lemonade,grapefruit juice
title: Barbecue Glazed Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 package mixed salad greens, rinsed of excess moisture | 2 tablespoons chopped roasted asparagus ( from jar ) | 2 tablespoons lemonade ( chilled ) | 1 teaspoon lemonade ( chilled ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( chilled ) | 1 teaspoon fajita seasoning mix ( chilled ) | 1/4 cup grapefruit juice ( chilled ) | 3 tablespoons irish cream ( chilled ) ( optional )
instructions: Toss salad greens with asparagus, lemonade, lemonade, rice wine, fajita seasoning, grapefruit juice, and irish cream, if desired.

title: Hot Ssoya Sauce for Dogs or Broth
ingredients: 1 cup hot salsa | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/2 cup soya sauce | 1/3 cup hot ssoya sauce
instructions: Mix em up.

Random Ingredients: ginger,radish,onion powder,asparagus spear,bouillon cube,swiss cheese,chicken bouillon cube,cream tartar
title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 20 frozen asparagus spears | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 bouillon cube, dissolved in | 10 fresh asparagus spears, cut in 3/4s lengthwise to 1 `` x 1 '' | 6 slices swiss cheese ( thin slices ) | 4 tablespoons whipped cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 teaspoon asparagus spear, drained, rinsed, and drained
instructions: Cook asparagus by boiling in salted water for 2 minutes, or until crisp tender, drain and set aside. In a bowl, combine remaining ingredient except the asparagus. Set sauce aside. When ready to serve, place a slice of cheese on a piece of asparagus. Dip the asparagus spear into the sauce. Arrange asparagus on serving plate. Drizzle asparagus with sauce.

title: Cashew Fried Rice (Nigerian Riz)
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped peanuts | 2 cups white basmati rice | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper | 7 1/2 tablespoons wheat flour | 1 orange, skinned and chopped | 1 cup slivered cashews
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the peanuts in 1 cup of water until lightly browned. Remove with slotted spoon from skillet and remove excess oil with a slotted spoon. In the same skillet, cook the rice over low heat until a pale golden brown, stirring constantly to prevent sticking. Combine the peanuts, rice, chili pepper and flour in a small bowl and blend well. Transfer seasoned rice to the skillet and stir to coat well with the mixture. Add orange peel, cashews and peanuts and cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly, about 1 minute. The mixture should not brown. Serve warm with sour cream or yogurt.

title: Tandoori Barbecue
ingredients: 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 3 packets hidden valley & reg ; original ranch & reg ; dressing and seasoning mix | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup snipped chipotle salsa, drained of all fat | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: In a large bowl mix with a fork combine all ingredients and stir to blend. Pour dressing over oat mixture and stir well to coat. Chill until ready to use. For more intense flavor toss with your favorite hot sauces such as jalapeno pepper sauce or cilantro. The longer each soak and the hotter the salsa the hotter it will be serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,plain yogurt,baking powder,nutmeg,sherry wine vinegar,chicken meat,rice wine,thai basil
title: Thai Chicken Burgers (For Two)
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 6 slices rye bread | 1 cup finely chopped cooked chicken meat | 1/2 cup seeded chopped fresh thai basil | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thyme or 1/4 cup minced fresh thyme | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: Combine yogurt and stir until smooth. Stir in chicken, basil, thyme, vinegar, baking powder and nutmeg. Spoon mixture into four 4 ounce ramekins. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. Preheat grill to medium high or preheat broiler. Remove ramekins from refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: soba noodle,red cabbage,pepperoni,seasoning salt,chicken broth,egg noodle,agar
title: Noodles, Italian Style
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 2 cans chicken broth, low sodium | 1 package soba noodles | 1/2 lb red cabbage, shredded | 3 ounces pepperoni, diced ( italian style ) | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside. In a large pan, bring broth to a slow simmer in a separate pot. Add soba, cabbage, pepperoni, nutritional yeast and seasoning salt. Mix well and add noodles to broth. Cook over low heat for one hour. Serve warm with grated parmesan cheese.
