title: Chop Chilt
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 8 ounces chocolate morsels | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon dill | 1/2 jalapeno chile pepper | 2 ounces tortilla chips | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Drain all juice from beans into food processor. Pulse beans until finely chopped.

title: Spicy Green Salsa
ingredients: 1 can green salsa ( such as simply wonderful ) | 1 small carrot ( peeled and shredded ) | 1/3 cup diced yellow pepper | 1/3 cup diced sweet pickled sweet pickled yams ( such as terra ) or 1/3 cup diced sweet pickled yellow sweet pickle | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1 lime wedge, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f combine salsa, carrot, peppers, sweet pickles, thyme and lime. Toss until vegetables are coated. Transfer salsa mixture to an oven safe dish and bake for 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Relish
ingredients: 500 g sun-dried tomatoes, not packed in oil, drained | 3/4 cup malt vinegar | 3 tablespoons sherry wine or 3 tablespoons dry white wine, to taste
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly until smooth and chill to desired consistency.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,pork shoulder,currant,celery rib,bell pepper,beef brisket,brandy
title: Oven Roast Pork
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 lb beef brisket | 3 3/4 ounces soy sauce | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried currants | 1 1/2 - 2 celery ribs, with leaves, chopped | 1 2/3 lbs pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon dried currants ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons dried currants
instructions: Trim excess fat from meat, and cut into 8 slices. Marinate overnight with all the ingredients in a large plastic zipper lock bag. Remove meat from bag and place on rack in roasting pan. Place the 3/4 cups of roasting liquid that the meat has already been marinating in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer about 1 hour stirring occasionally. Remove meat from the pan and place on individual heated serving plates. Spoon more sauce over and serve with bread and fresh fruit chutney.

Random Ingredients: coconut rum,baby portabella mushroom,icing sugar,cream tartar,cucumber,sunflower seed
title: Capsicum Mushrooms With Coconut Rum and Strawberries
ingredients: 3 baby portabella mushrooms | 1 tablespoon icing sugar, confectioner's | 1/2 cup light cream of tartar | 8 ounces chopped cucumbers | 2 teaspoons sunflower seeds ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons coconut rum
instructions: Place egg beaters in a bowl. Sprinkle with icing sugar. Gradually add cream of tartar and mix. Wash and dry mushrooms, remove stems. Place on a foil lined baking sheet, drizzle with coconut rum and grill for 2 minutes, turning to brown on all sides. Serve mushrooms with strawberries and the soured cream, garnished with extra coconut rum if desired.

title: Mexican Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into strips | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 2 poblano chiles, cored and seeded | 2 1/2 cups frozen oriental-style vegetables
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add steak and stir fry until browned on one side, 3 to 4 minutes. Turn steak and add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil. Sprinkle the meat with the mace and remove from the skillet. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat in the skillet. Return the pan to medium high heat and add 2 tablespoons of the pan drippings. Add half of the chiles. Saute for 1 minute. Arrange all the vegetables on the side of the meat. Cover and cook for 15 minutes, stirring from time to time.

title: Canadian Bacon and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon | 6 -8 fresh spinach leaves | 2 ounces grapefruit juice | 3 ounces low-fat salsa
instructions: Cut the bacon into 1/2 inch thick slices. In a large bowl, toss with the sliced greens. In a blender, combine the grapefruit juice and salsa. Pour into bowl with the salsa.

title: Aubergines
ingredients: 2 large fuengines, peeled | 2/3 cup ice water | 3/4 cup fried chicken, finely chopped | 1 can pineapple in syrup, cut in pieces
instructions: Cut the fuengines into thin slices with a knife. Place into the ice water.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,sesame oil,garlic clove,linguine,tomato paste,onion powder,green food coloring
title: Chinese-Style Linguine
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine or 8 ounces other long pasta, uncooked | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 garlic cloves, minced | 1 can tomato paste | 2 tablespoons onion powder | 1 1/2 - 2 cups snow peas, trimmed | green food coloring
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package. When pasta is done, drain. While pasta is cooking, heat oil in a frying pan over medium high heat. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Stir in tomato paste and onion powder. When sauce starts bubbling, add snow peas. When sauce has reached desired color, stop adding food coloring. Mix the cooked spaghetti with the sauce and stir to combine. Turn off heat. Pour a thin layer of sauce over the pasta and toss well to coat.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,cocoa powder,sesame oil,balsamic vinegar,beef stew meat
title: Sesame Steak
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cubed | 2 teaspoons sesame oil | 3 3 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder
instructions: Heat oven to 325ºf. Place beef in 9x13 baking dish and drizzle with sesame oil. Cover tightly with foil and bake approximately 2 hours or until tender. Remove foil and bake another 15 minutes. Remove beef from oven. Stir sour cream.

title: Beef Tenderloin in Miso Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin | flour, for dusting | 1 teaspoon corn oil | 6 ounces white miso | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 ounce dried porcini mushrooms
instructions: Place the beef tenderloin between two sheets of heavy plastic on a solid, level surface.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,porcini mushroom,tomato sauce,self rising flour,sharp cheddar cheese,pimento olive
title: Porcini and Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 250 g porcini mushrooms, sliced 1/3 inch thick | 1/2 lb grated sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 cup pimento stuffed olive, sliced thinly into halves ( reserve 1 tablespoon stuffed olives ) | 3/4 cup self rising flour | 2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a mixing bowl, combine the cheese, mushrooms, tomato sauce and olives. In a separate bowl, combine flour and chilli oil and mix well. Dip the prawns into the flour to coat. Arrange on an oiled baking sheet and bake for about 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Easy Escarole With Mustard
ingredients: 1 head escarole ( or spinach ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 1 dash ginger powder | 1 dash cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Rinse escarole and bring to a boil in 2 cups of water. Boil a few minutes longer or until tender. Drain the escarole and set aside. Discard the liquid and cool completely with the chicken stock. Put the cooled escarole in a dutch oven, and toss with dijon mustard and ginger powder. Bring the sauce to a simmer, reduce heat, and simmer. When the mustard thickens, add the escarole and cook for an extra minute or two, or until it is heated through. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: ha avocado,fajita seasoning mix,chili oil,maple syrup,jasmine rice
title: Mexican Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 hass avocado, diced ( or other firm avocado, such as avocados ) | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, cooked according to package directions | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons maple syrup ( or honey if desired ) | 1/2 teaspoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 3/4 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients. Season to taste with more chili oil, if desired.

title: Halloween and Fall Garlicky Greens Tikka Kale Tacos
ingredients: 1 can baked kidney beans | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 2 cups shredded kale | 2 tablespoons dried sage | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1/2 teaspoon ground garam masala | 2 cups half-and-half cream | 12 corn tortillas, warmed | 1 package sliced fresh strawberries, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the kidney beans onto a baking sheet, and bake 8 minutes. Turn the beans over with tongs, and spread the spinach evenly over the beans. Roast 1 to 2 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned. Remove from hot oven, and cool. Place a spinach bean layer onto a corn tortilla. Top with a sprinkling of the kale, sage, garlic, garam masala, and half and half. Roll up, and place them seam side down onto a baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,green apple,tomato juice,nonstick cooking spray,water,beef,tomato green chilies,white wine

ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 cup water | 1 lb lean ground beef | 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1 1/2 cups water | 2 medium green apples, cored, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme sprigs | 1 can tomato juice, undiluted
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f spray 13 by 9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Heat 1 cup water and ground beef in large skillet to boiling.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,parsley leaf,bacon,green cardamom pod,chinese cabbage
title: Chinese Cabbage (Tongghi) Salad
ingredients: 6 green cardamom pods | 2 cups shredded chinese cabbage | 6 slices rindless bacon, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 3 cups light soya sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, chopped
instructions: Boil water, add cardom pods and cook 5 seconds. Remove from heat, drain and allow to cool. Remove seeds and membrane. Toss cabbage with cold water and bring to boil, drain the water, add the bacon, soya sauce and parsley. Chop into 3/4 inch dice, serve.

title: Homemade Lemon Stock
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups dried chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh lemon peel | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon extract
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix well, bouillon cubes, lemon peel, and lemon extract. Store in the refrigerator until ready to use. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: gherkin,cumin,milk ricotta cheese,red chile,saltine cracker,hazelnut,pepper flake,anise seed
title: Chilled Herbed Ricotta Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 250 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 125 g salted hazelnuts | 1 teaspoon chipotle peppers or 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon cumin | crushed red chile | 1 pinch crushed hot pepper flakes | saltines cracker | 2 tablespoons ground roasted ground hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon cumin | 3 tablespoons whole milk
instructions: Drain and coarsely chop the ricotta. Put the ricotta in a strainer and dry. Remove any excess liquid with a spoon and set aside. Chop the hazelnuts into coarse pieces and place in a clean bowl. Sprinkle on the anise seed, cumin and crushed red chillies and stir. Mix this with the cheese and spices until well combined and the mixture becomes a nice consistency. Chill for at least one hour. Scoop the ricotta into the crumbly mix and spread out onto a baking tray with saltines and crushed hazels. Put on the oven rack at 200°c for 15 minutes. After 15 minutes, take out and stir in remaining nuts. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,vegetable broth,baking soda,riesling wine,ham hock,grain white rice
title: Rieslings With Ham Hocks
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs riesling wine or 3 -3 1/2 lbs other mildly flavored dry white rice | 1 cup vegetable broth or 1 cup chicken broth | 1 ham hock ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 -3 heads cauliflower, separated into florets, about 5 pounds | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 head garlic
instructions: Place rice in a large bowl and pour in 2 cups water. Add riesling. Cover and refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours. Drain, reserving liquid. Preheat oven to 325°f place the ham hocks and 4 cups of water in an ovenproof casserole. Cover and roast on the middle rack of the oven for 2 hours. Stir and continue roasting until the ham hocks are beginning to brown on top. Remove from oven and set aside. Place 1 head of cauliflower in a colander and shake off excess water. In a small bowl, combine the baking soda with the reserved liquid. Drain the cauliflower and set aside. Place the remaining 1 lb head of cauliflower in a roasting pan. Add enough reserved water to cover and add 1 teaspoon of baking soda. Cover and roast on the middle rack of oven until tender, about 2 hours. To make the white rice. Peel and mince the remaining head of cauliflower. Place in a medium size bowl and pour on enough reserved pan liquid to cover. Cover, and let stand for 15 minutes. To make the roasted ham hocks. Remove the ham hocks from the casserole and set aside. Rinse and then drain the roasting pan. In a small saucepan, combine 6 cups of stock or water with enough reserved liquid to cover the cauliflower. Add the ham hocks, cover and let stand for 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 250°. Remove ham hocks from liquid. Place the remaining heads of cauliflower into a roasting pan. Stir in the baking soda, then place it on top of the ham hocks. Bake in preheated oven until cauliflower is tender, about 40 minutes. Remove and discard garlic cloves. Arrange ham hocks on a large platter. Slice remaining heads of cauliflower into 1/2-inch rings, then scatter cauliflower over the top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,cheddar cheese,fruit preserve,bulb garlic,mexican oregano,five spice powder,breadcrumb,baking soda
title: Garlic Sausage with Fruit Spread
ingredients: 1 bulb of garlic ( whole bulbs ), halved | 1 1/2 lbs broccoli, cut into florets ( about 14 medium heads ) | 4 tablespoons fruit preserves ( or other jam with fruit ) | 1/2 cup coarse breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 2 teaspoons ground ancho chili ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 cup cheddar cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Melt garlic and broccoli in 1 c. Water in large, heavy pot over medium high heat, stirring frequently.

title: Sirloin Medallions With Kirsch and Apple Cider
ingredients: 4 sirloin medallions | kirschwasser | extra virgin olive oil, for brushing | 3 tablespoons apple cider or 3 tablespoons dry white wine | 5 tablespoons heavy whipping cream or 5 tablespoons whipping cream, to serve | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot pepper flakes
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of the medallions with salt. Heat a heavy bottomed griddle over medium heat, then brush olive oil on both sides of medallions. In a bowl, whisk together the cider or wine, cream, cream pepper flakes, and hot pepper. Pour over the Medallions and serve at once.

title: Green Curry Paste for Vegetables
ingredients: 2 teaspoons green curry paste ( i use thai kitchen brand, or i use my own homemade recipe ) | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 2 teaspoons coriander powder
instructions: Place chopped bamboo shoots, green curry paste and coriander in a blender or food processor and process until well blended. Store in clean dry, dark, cool pantry bag or can. Use as directed in recipes.

title: Ajiaco II
ingredients: 1 pound shredded gouda cheese, divided | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese, divided
instructions: Place 1 pound shredded cheese in a large bowl. Drizzle with lime juice, add 2 tablespoons of reserved grated parmesan cheese. Mix until mixture is evenly blended. Chill for 30 minutes.

title: Faux Indian Tacos
ingredients: 500 g pork trotter | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Thoroughly wash and remove excess fat from pork trotter. Rinse pork trotter under running water and pat dry with paper towel. Sprinkle with salt and cumin, and let sit for 5 minutes. Pat dry with paper towel. Cut into serving sized portions. Enjoy with naan.

title: Mexican Borracho Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 3 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Blend the beans, stock, and salad oil in a blender until smooth. Refrigerate for at least 10 minutes. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,saffron thread,thai red chili pepper,farfalle pasta,tofu
title: Nif's Easy Fat Free Tofu With Baked Eggs

instructions: Slice the tofu into cubes about 1 1/2 cm thickness. Place the tofu, one egg and chopped chilies in a food processor and blitz to your desired texture. Heat up the oven to 400f/180c/gas mark grease an oven proof dish. Add the saffron to the noodles in a bowl and add about 15ml of water. Sprinkle the noodles with a little salt and pepper. Then toss the tofu evenly in the bowl, then pour over the water. Place in the oven and bake for about 20 mins or until the yolks are a thick, light golden colour.

title: Quick Pasta with Sizzling Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 9 jalapeno-pircent red bell peppers
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.

title: Red Hot Squash
ingredients: 3 lbs yellow squash, peeled, seeded, cut into quarters and lengthwise | 1 orange peel | 3 tablespoons dark molasses | 1/3 cup light molasses | 1 tablespoon dark rum or 1 tablespoon stout beer
instructions: The day before serving, combine all ingredients, cover and chill in the refrigerator up to 1 week. Serve in a wide mouth glass bowl of warm, hot tea or coffee.

title: Ajiaco Wrapped Ham Rollups
ingredients: 9 ounces frozen fully thawed deli ham | 4 ounces jar marzipan | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons ranch salad dressing | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1 package prepared aji amarillos | 20 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Using a kitchen scissors or cookie cutters, cut a slit lengthwise down each ham roll. Insert a stuffing funnel into each ham roll. Place a marzipan coated ham roll into a large shallow bowl. Add half the chicken stock, ranch dressing, ground coriander seeds and aji amarillos roll.

title: Sweet Macadamia Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup margarita mix | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1/3 cup macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped | 5/8 - 1/4 lb head red cabbage | 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a medium size bowl, whisk together the margarita mix, corn syrup, fish sauce, macadamia nuts and shredded red cabbage. Gradually whisk in olive oil to taste. Cover tightly and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Fanny C's Jersey Corn and Cabbage
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared mustard seeds | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 1/2 pounds fresh corn, husks removed | 1 whole pork tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes | 5 pounds white cabbage, cored and finely chopped
instructions: Fill a large stockpot with water, and add the mustard seed, brandy, and corn.

instructions: Bring lentils to a boil in ample water.

title: Chinese Style Sausage, Beans and Onions

instructions: Peel the sausages and remove the casings. Cut the pork sausage links into 1/2 inch long pieces or thirds depending on the size of the sausage. title: Noodle Soup (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 500 g noodles, small ( i prefer the type of medium noodles found online ) | 300 ml half-and-half | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate soda ( ensure gluten-free, preferably with no baking or sugar ) | 200 -200 g canned straw bamboo shoots, drained | 2 1/2 - 3 liters chicken broth ( depending on your taste )
instructions: Boil the noodles until they are soft and mushy. Add the broth to the noodle and add the soda. Add the frozen bamboo shoots and heat through. Eat and enjoy.

title: Apple and Basil Soup
ingredients: 8 large diced apples | 300 g fresh basil | 6 cups chicken stock | 2 tablespoons lime juice or 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Chop basil and mix with rest of ingredients. Simmer in water for about ten minutes.

title: Bread and Butter Pudding
ingredients: 6 cups cooked long-grain rice, cooled ( preferably mexican ) | 2 tablespoons active dry yeast | 1 egg | 6 tablespoons corn chips | 3 tablespoons cognac or 3 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Stir the warm rice with the yeast in a mixing bowl and let it sponge for 5 minutes. Add the egg and the 4 tablespoons of corn chips to the yeast sponge and let it sponge for 5 minutes. Stir into the rice mixture. Butter a square dish and cover with plastic wrap. Place dish in a warm place for about 2 hours or until doubled in volume. To serve, preheat the oven to 350°f remove the bowl, cover and place in the oven to bake for 40 - 45 min. It should be golden. Remove from the oven and let it rest for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Smoked American Cheese
ingredients: 6 ounces american cheese, grated ( or 1/2 of a 4 oz. package ) | 10 -12 slices smoked spanish smoked hot peppers ( or to taste ) | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, minced or 1 jalapeno-garlic powder
instructions: Using a brush and bowl, mix the american cheese with the pepper and the scotch bonnet pepper. Whip until it looks a bit like whipped cream or mayo. Store in the refrigerator for up to a month.

title: Mango Chilli and Peppered Parsnips (Sangria)
ingredients: 2 kg parsnips ( with skin ) | 120 g red curry paste | 125 ml brandy | 125 ml red wine vinegar | 1 kg papayas ( with skin on ) | 125 g pepperoni ( cut into 3cm pieces ) | 2 tablespoons minced parsley
instructions: Put the parsnips, curry paste, brandy and vinegars into a large saucepan and heat slowly. Bring to the boil and boil rapidly, uncovered, for about 20 minutes or until the vegetables are just tender. Meanwhile, drain the papayas and tear them into large pieces. Put the papayas, pepperoni and parsley into a bowl and mix well. Put into a hot serving dish and pour over the sauce. Eat it, or cool it and freeze it. To eat, take a few spoons of the mixture and dip into your favourite red wine.

title: Curry Ribs
ingredients: 1/4 cup curry leaves, crushed | 2 pounds flank steak
instructions: Sprinkle curry powder over steak. Sprinkle with salt and allow to marinate at room temperature for 1 hour. Preheat grill for high heat. Grill meat, turning once, until desired doneness has been attained.

ingredients: 8 -12 asparagus tips, woody parts | 6 small green chili peppers, sliced from jar to taste | 3/4 cup sweet potato starch ( potato starch will not work ) | 3 tablspoon cocoa | 1/4 cup white chocolate chips | fresh radish, for garnish
instructions: Place asparagus tips on cookie sheet. Cook until tender.

title: Pineapple Maple Syrup Bread Pudding(Australian)
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, lightly toasted | 250 ml double cream, whipped | 2 egg yolks | 1/3 cup maple syrup | 125 g crushed pineapple tidbits | 1/2 cup crushed parsley flakes | 1/3 cup crushed peanuts
instructions: Pour some water into a saucepan. Place the bread in a single layer in the pan. Pour over a little of the cream, then cover with more bread. Whisk together the egg yolks and remaining cream and set aside. Place the cream and egg yolks in a bowl and mix well until combined. Add the maple syrup, pineapple tidbits, parsley and pineapples. Pour evenly over the bread. Cover and chill overnight. To serve, remove the bread from the pan and cut into squares. Top with the maple syrup.

title: Aubergine Muffins
ingredients: 2 large auberge aubergines | 2 cups self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons new mexico chile powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c/350°f. Wash auberge aubergines and dry, cut each one into 1 cubes and roll it in flour. Make sure all the flour is removed before using to prevent sticking. Bake the auberge aubergines in a frying pan for about 25 - 30 mins until brown and soft. While the aubergines are roasting, mix the chilli with half a cup or so of boiling water. Place the flour in a mixing bowl and pour 2 tbsp of the chilli liquid into it, stir well. Gradually add the rest of the liquid, a little at a time, stirring and re working the flour until you have a smooth dough. Once your dough is a smooth consistency put it into an ovenproof dish and pour the rest of the chilli mixture over it. When the oven is ready, remove the dish from the oven and leave the aubergines in there for 10 minutes. Use half the chilli mix to mix the cheese mixture and spread on the aubergines at the top.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese

instructions: Drain excess water from container of ricotta cheese. Mix ricotta with water in a large bowl until just warm, about 10 minutes.

instructions: In a small bowl stir together the lemon pepper. Slice the tenderloin and season with salt and pepper. Tear away as much of the fat as possible from the beef. Cut the tenderloin into 1/2 thick slices. Sprinkle lemon pepper over the meat and wrap strips in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 450 degrees. Unwrap the pieces of meat and arrange on a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake for 14 to 18 minutes, or until very well browned and cooked through. About 5 minutes before the beef is finished, add the olive oil and noodles. Bake 5 minutes, or until the noodles are tender and the liquid is absorbed. Transfer to a serving platter and serve with the crisped lemon lemon pepper crabmeat.

instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Drain. Stir in currants and consume.

title: Italian Bread Crumb Balls
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 1/4 cups rice flour | salt & freshly ground black pepper | lime wedge
instructions: Place breadcrumbs in a large bowl or strainer and season with salt and pepper. Work in the rice flour with your hands to make fine crumbs. Form into a firm ball, add a little water if needed, then gently knead again. Place on a lightly floured surface and roll with your hands until it's the consistency of a dough. If it's too moist or too dry, knead in a little water a little at a time. It should hold a shape. Cover and refrigerate for one hour or up to two hours. Pre heat the oven to 400 degrees. Shape the dough into a ball then place on a lightly greased cookie sheet and flatten to about 3 inch diameter, about 1/3 inch thick. Use scissors or cookie cutters to cut pieces about 4 inch long. Bake for about 8 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool slightly before removing from the cookie sheet to a wire rack and placing on a plate.

title: Tamarind Oysters
ingredients: 1 cup tamarind paste | 1 cup ginger juice | 12 oysters
instructions: Combine tamarind paste, ginger juice and oysters in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil until syrupy, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and serve straight away.

instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the cheeses, yogurt, onion and watercress. Season with salt and pepper. If using immediately, refrigerate for up to 1 day. Ladle into parfait glasses and sprinkle with a bit of sugar to lightly season if desired.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,yellow,orange bell pepper,lemon,sultana,brown rice
title: Warm Orange and Sultana Rice With Grilled Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 3 large oranges or 3 large yellow bell peppers | 3 medium sultanas | 1 red currant jelly | 2 1/2 cups cooked brown rice | 1 lemon | 1/4 cup finely chopped crystallized ginger, finely chopped or 2 teaspoons powdered ginger
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium. Lightly oil/grease a baking dish and line the bottom with aluminium foil. Cut the peppers into strips and place them on the lined baking dish. Lift the redcurrant jelly from the pan with a large slotted spoon and place onto the peppers. Gently warm the rice and lemon for about 3 minutes. Stir in the crystallised ginger. Pour the hot cooked rice into the peppers and sultanas. Place the dish on the grates of the grill, top with the sweetened ginger and serve. Variation, alternatively, if the rice and peas have a vinaigrette, try other orange flavours like mint, jam and cranberry jam to the pepper jelly. Note, the peppers may also be added to the cooked rice, but do not add until the final half hour.

title: Herbs Sticks

instructions: Bring 1 - 2 inches of water to a boil in a medium size nonstick frying pan. Add cabbage and 1 cup water. Cook over medium heat until hot, stirring until hot, about 2 minutes. Drizzle with hot olive oil.

title: Roasted Vegables

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f in a covered casserole dish, toss the bell pepper pieces with a bit of olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Brush with white wine, and bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the peppers reach the desired consistency.

instructions: Cut pork in cubes marinating pork overnight. The next day remove pork and brown in frying pan. Pour off drippings and add rest of ingredients to bowl. Put in a covered container for 8 hours. Eat open up and top with your favorite toppings.

instructions: Mix the first three ingredients in a cocktail shaker with the ice. Shake or stir, and add a little juice, if necessary. Strain mixture in a collins glass, and stir again. Garnish with jalapeños. Serve on chilled soda pop sticks or trays with a straw.

title: Cheese Toast
ingredients: 4 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1/4 cup mexican cheese ( grated, or grated ) | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 5 drops hot sauce | 2 tablespoons dry white breadcrumbs | 1 -2 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: If using mexican cheese mix well and refrigerate. Slice bread into thin slices, sprinkle with dry mustard and hot sauce. Toss lightly with hands. title: Simple Spanish Tapas

instructions: Place bratwurst in a large, resealable plastic bag. Add vinegar to taste and marinate, covered, in the refrigerator for 8 - 12 hours. Just before serving, prepare fettuccine according to package directions and drain. Arrange bratwurst on a bed of fettuccine.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,ricotta cheese,salt pepper,white vinegar,paprika,soymilk,greek yogurt,icing sugar
title: Yogurt Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 -4 plums or 2 -4 honeydew plums, pitted and halved lengthwise | 500 g ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons greek-style yogurt | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | paprika, to sprinkle
instructions: Preheat your barbecue grill or grill pan and oil the grill. If using the honeydew, roast them in the oven to soften. Remove and set aside, leave the oven on. Place a platter with cut off stems in and around the outer edge of the tomatoes. Now with a fork, remove the hard core and discard the bottom pulp inside. Cut the flesh away from the pit, but do not remove with a spoon or knife. Place flesh in a food processor and add the remaining ingredients. Process until smooth. Place on a platter with a little olive oil on top. Garnish and serve with crusty bread.

title: Easy Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fish fillets, cut into serving portions | olive oil, for frying
instructions: Coat fish with olive oil. Put about 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet or dutch oven on the stove top. Coat the fish with flour, shaking off the excess. Brown the fish for only 2 - 3 minutes over medium high heat. Turn the fish over a few times, turn the heat down to medium and cook the fish in the oil until crisp on the outside, about 4 - 5 minutes. Turn the fish and continue cooking until browned on the outside and no longer translucent. Remove the fish to serving platter and serve with a salad. Note, if you want fish on a pooly top, you can sprinkle flour onto the fish before frying.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,cardamom pod,bicarbonate soda,kaffir lime leaf,berry,snow pea,achiote
title: Spa
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon achiote | 5 -6 cardamom pods, roughly torn | 200 g mixed berry, such as pepitas, nectarines, strawberries, savoy cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 200 g snow peas | 140 ml bicarbonate of soda | cayenne pepper
instructions: First prepare the achiote by heating 1 - 2 teaspoons in a saucepan with a pinch of salt dissolved in 50 ml boiling water. Do not remove from heat. Drain and plunge achiote into the hot water whilst still clinging to the base of pan. Keep the leaves and roughly torn fruit separate. Wash and deseed the berry, removing any tough outer leaves. Break the bicarb with your spoon into four pieces. Fry in another saucepan with 1 - 2 teaspoons of oil, stirring now and then, as needed and adding the cayenne pepper, as each piece of bicarb changes colour from vibrant yellow to dull black. After a few minutes, remove the cardamom pods from the frying pan, add them to the bicarb, with the leaves and fruit. Add the remaining oil, a little at a time, and fry again until coloured. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper. Once all the bicarb is cooked, add all the greens, along with a little water. Cover and simmer to soften the greens, then add the soda and a little water if necessary. Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Pizzaiola
ingredients: 1 cup warm marinara sauce | 1 package active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon cayenne | 2 cups cold cooked broccoli | 1 package dry instant ditalini | 2 tablespoons grated chocolate
instructions: Preheat grill. To make pizza dough, in medium bowl, dissolve yeast and cayenne in warm marinara sauce. Set aside in a warm place to blend flavors, about 10 minutes. Wash broccoli and remove tough leaves. Slice into 1/2 inch pieces and place in a bowl. Drain the marinara sauce and place the broccoli in a large bowl. Drain pasta and add to bowl of broccoli along with 1/2 cup more warm marinara sauce and 1/2 cup of cheese. Cover and let stand until ready to use. When ready to serve, in shallow bowl, heat remaining marinara sauce until warm. Turn off preheated grill and brush with olive oil. Remove and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Kimchi Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh fennel, chopped | 1 head cabbage kimchi, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups small broccoli | 1 package frozen green peas | 3 tablespoons white vinegar
instructions: Combine fennel, cabbage kimchi and broccoli in a large bowl, and toss to mix. Mix in green peas. Cover, and refrigerate 6 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: tequila,mango chutney,bread crumb,greek seasoning,black olive,dijon mustard,creole seasoning,salmon fillet
title: Smoked Salmon Burgers
ingredients: 1 cup seasoned bread crumbs | 2 tablespoons tequila | 2 tablespoons prepared dijon-style mustard | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 2 tablespoons greek seasoning | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce or 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped black olives | 2 tablespoons salmon fillets, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup mango chutney, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil grate. In a large bowl, mix the bread crumbs, tequila, mustard, creole seasoning, greek seasoning, hot sauce, black olives, salmon and mango chutney. Divide into 8 equal portions. Using hands, press each portion to form 8 patties. Place on the prepared grill, close lid, and grill 6 minutes, or until cooked through and no longer pink inside.

title: Cherry Clafouti
ingredients: 500 g good quality dark rum | cold water | 1 kg ripe fresh marsala cherries, pitted and washed | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Put the cherry halves and their liquid into a medium saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, and then lower the heat and leave to simmer for 10 minutes or until the cherries have softened. Drain and then stir the remaining cherries into the rum before serving. To make double cream, put the cream into a large bowl, whip the cream until stiff peaks form, and then fold the cream into the warmed rum mixture. Serve the clafoutis warm on toasted bread or savoy cabbage leaves.

title: Glazed Balsamic-Glazed Marinated Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/3 cup finely chopped candied lemon peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Use as directed in glaze over lettuce, salads and vegetables.

title: Pasta Salad II
ingredients: 1 package dry pasta | 1/2 lemon, juiced | 1 teaspoon seasoning, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon adobo seasoning, or more to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Cook pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain. In a medium bowl, mix pasta, lemon juice, seasoning, and adobo seasoning, if desired. Chill in the refrigerator 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,vanilla essence,caster sugar,white chocolate chip,pork tenderloin,yellow onion
title: Pepperjack Swiss Chard
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed fat removed | 1 medium yellow onion, thinly sliced into rings, caramelized | 1 packet white chocolate chips, divided ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/8 teaspoon onion powder ( if you don't have this use a tablespoon ) | 1/4 cup caster sugar ( superfine sugar )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c line a large baking tray with baking paper. Cut each pork tenderloin in half lengthways. Place pork, onion, chocolate chips and vanilla essence into a saucepan and heat until chocolate melts. Do not boil. Transfer mixture onto large plate. Pile onto baking tray and sprinkle with caster sugar. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until pork is cooked through. Remove from oven. Allow to rest in baking tray for 5 - 10 minutes. Serve with fruit salad and cream or icecream.

title: Aunt Alma's Grilled Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground hazelnuts | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon paprika | 3/4 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 1/2 pounds shaved lamb chops | 1 jar amaretti cookie | ice for grill
instructions: Grind the hazelnuts in a blender or food processor to a fine powder. Combine the ground hazelnut powder, oregano, paprika, white pepper, soy sauce, and lamb in a large resealable plastic bag. Squeeze out excess air.

title: Broccoli Side Dish
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, cut into florets | seasoning salt | 2 -3 cups barbecue sauce ( of your choice ) | parmigiano or ricotta cheese
instructions: Cook broccoli over medium heat with just enough water to cover for about 5 - 10 minutes, or until bright green and tender. Stir broccoli, salt and sauce together and cook for an additional 2 minutes to combine flavours.

title: Crispy Squash
ingredients: 1 large yellow squash, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place squash pieces in a colander in a single layer, and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar. Carefully push a piece of aluminum foil down the center, and spread lightly with butter and a sprinkling of sugar. Wrap foil around the squash to enclose the surface and keep it soft. Place on a cookie sheet or baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are golden brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Ketchup Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/3 cup heinz ketchup | 1/3 cup sour cream or 1/3 cup mayonnaise | grated nutmeg
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill till required.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,dark brown sugar,pasta,gruyere cheese,purpose flour
title: Creamy Gruyere Gratin Pasta
ingredients: 1 package dry pasta | 1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Cook pasta 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Vegtable Phirni (Fish in Spiced Pink Sauce)
ingredients: 2 lbs fish fillets ( firm white such as haddock or cod ) | 1 1/2 cups dry spaghetti ( long curly, or medium or thick ) | 2 cups thinly sliced white and tender green quarters ( from 1 large ) | 1 1/2 cups pickled mixed sprouts ( about 8 ounces total ) | 2 green cardamom pods, split in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper and set aside. Bake in oven for 10 minutes. Place fish in a medium size saucepan and add water to barely cover. Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium low. Partially cover, and simmer until the fish flakes easily with a fork and is just cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove fish from heat and cut into 1 serving size pieces. Return the saucepan to medium high heat and bring the spaghetti to the boil. Add the fish, stirring until each piece is opaque. Spread the cooked spaghetti on a clean, dry serving platter. Arrange the green quarters and the chopped brussels sprouts in a pattern over the spaghetti. Place the cardamom pods in each of the vegetables. Drizzle the vegtable syrup over the fish, and serve hot.

title: Crazy Okra for the BBQ
ingredients: 1 lb okra, cleaned and cut into 12 slices | 1/2 lb country-style sparerib, cut lengthwise into 2 pieces and cut crosswise into 2 pieces
instructions: Place okra in a medium sized bowl. Combine the spareribs and country style spare ribs and coat well with mixture. Place okra on grill grid and brown well on all sides.

Random Ingredients: margarine,fish sauce,black mustard seed,beef bouillon cube,vegetable stock,hot chili sauce,spaghetti sauce mix
title: Spaghetti Pomodoro
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce ( sriracha ) or 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon fish sauce | 1/2 2 cups prepared spaghetti sauce mix | 1/2 cup vegetable stock
instructions: In large heavy skillet with a tight fitting lid, heat oil over medium high heat. When hot, add mustard seeds and hot sauce and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add stock and stir until dissolved. Add sauce mix and stir until thoroughly mixed.

Random Ingredients: salmon,hot red pepper flake,chili pepper flake,yellow mustard seed
title: Mild English Mustard
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon hot chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup prepared yellow mustard seeds
instructions: Rinse and dry mustard seeds with paper towels. Place mustard seeds in a heavy frying pan or large, flat bottomed skillet that has a flat bottomed lid. Sprinkle with a few drops of prepared mustard seed and sprinkle with a few drops of red pepper flakes. Fry, shaking pan frequently, over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes until mustard seeds have darkened but are not burnt. Spread mustard seeds on a large slice of warm, dry potato or white toast. Turn over and fry other side for 3 minutes, until dark brown and crisp.

title: Rose Water Dough Wedges
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped dried rose petals | 1 packet dry ranch dressing mix | 1 cup warm water
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all the ingredients and mix well. Divide the dough into 1/2 inch balls and place in a quart size freezer bag. Place the freezer bag over the dough in the freezer and freezer for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove dough from bag and place on a lightly floured surface. Knead for 1 minute. Place in a greased bowl, turning once to coat. Place dough in a steamer or colander over boiling water, cover and steam for 20 minutes or until dough is tender and cooked. Allow to cool for 2 - 15 minutes in the bag. Remove dough from the bag and place on a lightly flour surface. Roll up into a 12 inch circle. Cut into 6 wedges. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: texas toast bread,iceberg lettuce,spaghetti sauce,strawberry ice cream,ranch dressing mix,espresso powder,anaheim chilies,cheddar cheese
title: Santa Fe Melt
ingredients: 1 package texas toast thick bread | 3 cans spaghetti sauce, chilled | 1 envelope dry ranch dressing mix | 2 2 cups iceberg lettuce or 2 cups iceberg lettuce | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 3/4 cup crushed strawberry ice cream | 1 anaheim chilies or 1 serrano chili, sliced
instructions: Remove top crust of texas toast bread. Cut bread into four even sized wedges. Set aside. Cut 2nd wedge into top and bottom and cut off bread. Remove bread wedge as garnish. Cut wedges from bread, and discard bread. Using a fork, mix remaining two cans of spaghetti sauce, dressing mix and the cooked wedge bread. Spread a small amount of spaghetti sauce onto the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Sprinkle a generous layer of cheese over the sauce. Spread half of remaining cheese on top of the cheese. Place 1 cup of lettuce around the cheese. Top with remaining two cans of spaghetti sauce and top with the remaining 1 cup of lettuce. Sprinkle with the sliced anaheim or chile. Dot with remaining cheese and crème fraîche. If desired, you can spread additional topping and/or topping over shredded lettuce and serve. Refrigerate leftover cheese sauce. Garnish with crushed strawberry ice cream just before serving, and if desired, serve with additional shredded cheese sauce. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: glutinous rice,white flour,toast,cold water,flat leaf parsley
title: Chilled Sticky Rice With Toasted Scallions and Toasted Bread (Pao de Chocolat)
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice | 2 tablespoons cold water | 6 thin slices toasted bread ( or fresh white bread, crusts removed and sliced into to 4 or 5 slices ) or 6 slices bread, sliced thinly ( or fresh white bread, crusts removed and sliced into to 4 or 5 slices ) | chopped flat leaf parsley ( to garnish ) or dried parsley ( to garnish ) | all purpose white flour
instructions: Rinse the glutinous rice in a colander under cold water, shaking the rice as you drain. Invert the rice over a mixing bowl or plate. Cut 2 - 3 thin slices of the toasted bread or 1 slice of fresh bread and moisten on the sides of the rice. Spread each slice with 1 1/2 tablespoons of the filling. Roll each slice up and secure well with a tooth pick. Cover and refrigerate while you assemble the rest of the meal. Place 4 rice cups on a tray, top each with 1 or 2 scallions and place the tray in the refrigerator. Heat the toaster oven or grill to about 350°f and bake until the scallions just begin to lightly brown. Remove the scallions to a serving platter. Place 5 scallions in each scallion, sprinkle with the parsley, and serve. Note, the toast may be sliced thinly, but the bread will have the best texture when sliced.

title: Strawberry and Kiwi Kielbasa Bread
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1-inch thick slices | 1 lb strawberry, quartered | 1/2 cup guacamole ( or more! ) | 3 tablespoons minced fresh fruit | 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 tablespoon minced fresh yeast or 1/2 teaspoon instant yeast | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice, cold | 1 teaspoon mortadella ( dry-roasted italian seasoning blend )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f spray loaf pan with cooking spray. Cut kielbasa into ¼” slices. Arrange slices in a single layer in a 10 inch square baking dish. Brush with cooking spray. Broil 2 - ½ to 3 minutes or until lightly brown, turning once. Turn slices and broil 3 minutes more. Remove kielbasa from oven and place on a plate. Reduce oven temperature to 250°f slice kielbasa crosswise into ½ inch slices. Arrange sausage slices overlapping in a single layer on top of the kielbasa, starting on the outer edge of the pan. Broil the slices 1 minute, then spread guacamole over kielbasa slices. Sprinkle fresh fruit with soy sauce, then top with a dollop of guacamole. Sprinkle with fresh minced fruit and a scattering of mortadella. Place in oven and bake, uncovered, about 1 hour or until crisp. If loaf is browning too quickly, cover loosely with aluminum foil. Let stand at room temperature 10 minutes. Cut into ½ inch slices.

title: Tamarind Dip or Salad
ingredients: 1 -2 red bell peppers | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste )
instructions: Dice peppers. Add all ingredients and mix. Serve with pita bread or bread pita chips.

title: Easy Tomato Chili
ingredients: 14 ounces italian stewed tomatoes ( about 13-14 cans ) | 1 can whole roasted chilies
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 3 1/2 quart crockpot.

title: Cabbage Slice
ingredients: 1 kg beef stew meat | 1 head cabbage | 2 tablespoons self raising flour | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Shred the beef into medium sized pieces. Cut large pieces into 1/2 inch pieces or smaller. Chop the cabbage into large pieces. Combine all ingredients into a casserole dish with the meat. Cover and bake slowly in a moderate oven for about 4 hours. Remove cover and bake for further 3 hours. Serve hot or cold with thick bread.

Random Ingredients: white rice flour,oregano,milk ricotta cheese,pork tenderloin,egg noodle,parsley leaf,plain flour,garam masala
title: Pork Kofte
ingredients: 500 g dried egg noodles | 150 g plain flour or 150 g gluten-free flour | 150 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon dried parsley leaves | 1/2 tablespoon dried basil ( or 2 tsp. dried ) | 250 g pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( or equivalent, of your personal favourite spice )
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water, or on medium heat for 8 - 10 minutes, until tender. Meanwhile, melt the fat or oil in a large frying pan and fry the garlic till fragrant. Add the pork and oregano, and fry over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes until the pork is cooked. Mix most of the flour with the milk and pour into the frying pan. Mix until smooth, then add some of the remaining flour and some water to loosen any lumps, and mix for 1 - 2 minutes. Add the noodles and stir through. Heat through. Place a small piece of aluminium foil over the pasta so it comes to room temperature before serving. Sprinkle a little salt onto the kofte and cook for 4 - 5 minutes or until golden and crispy. If the top looks done before the first five minutes, cover with aluminium foil.

Random Ingredients: red pepper ring,asafoetida powder,cheddar cheese,pepper,cucumber,rigatoni pasta,yellow squash,mint
title: Cheesy Rigatoni With Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1/2 medium red pepper ring | 3 medium yellow squash | 10 -12 ounces cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | pepper | 3/4 cucumber ( peeled and chopped )
instructions: Cook rigatoni in boiling salted water until it'mourries' start to soften. Meanwhile slice the red pepper into thin strips. Slice yellow squash into thin thin strips. Slice cheese into thin rounds. Dice onion into thin, matchstick sized sticks. Drain rigatoni. Add all ingredients to rigatoni and toss. Serve warm.

title: Oyster Sauce - Chinese Style Pepper Pepper and Pepper Appetizer
ingredients: 24 bell peppers, assorted colors, halved vertically | 16 ounces oyster sauce ( canned, or made from concentrate, with water and flavor )
instructions: Peel peppers and cut into pieces about 2 inches long. Place all the ingredients in a large sauce pan or wok, heat, stirring frequently, until the peppers are tender, but not mushy, and are mostly browned, 2 to 5 minutes. Serve hot in hot chinese soup dishes.

Random Ingredients: sugar cane,linguine,cornstarch,maple syrup,black cumin seed,poppy seed,coconut milk
title: Coconut Spiced Lemongrass
ingredients: 32 ounces coconut milk ( can use low sodium ) | 4 ounces cornstarch | 2/3 cup sugar cane | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon ground black cumin seeds | 2 ounces linguine, cooked
instructions: In a saucepan bring coconut milk to a boil and whisk in cornstarch. Cook, stirring constantly until blended and reduced by 1/ stir in sugar and next 3 ingredients and simmer until thickened and syrupy, then remove from heat and stir in cooked pasta. Pour mixture into a 9x13 baking dish and sprinkle top with additional cumin seeds. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Easy English Cucumber
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 english cucumber, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Unfold each puff pastry sheet into 4 even sheets, and cut each sheet into 5 even pieces. Layer the 4 dough sheets on a cooking sheet, and spray the tops with cooking spray. Cover with an additional sheet of pastry, and spray with more cooking spray. Bake in the preheated oven until the dvies are light brown, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,romano green bean,mint,lasagna noodle,pepperoni,worcestershire sauce,pasta shell
title: Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1/2 pound sliced pepperoni | 12 ounces sliced shiitake mushrooms | 1 package frozen romano-swam cheese flavored blocks, chopped | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons dried mint | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna, and cook for 10 to 12 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,corn oil,egg yolk,kaffir lime leaf,tomato green chile pepper,brie cheese,mustard,chicken stock vegetable
title: Tomato and Chilli Roulards
ingredients: 4 ounces brie cheese, halved | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tomatoes and green chile peppers, diced | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 egg yolks, beaten | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon chili sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f. Place the halved brie in a shallow baking dish. Bake in the oven for 8 minutes. Scoop the brie out of the pan and set aside. Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the tomatoes and green chiles. Stir fry for 5 minutes. Stir in the stock, egg yolks, salt, mustard and chili sauce. Bring to a slow boil, then pour over the brie. Cover and bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until the sauce has thickened. Serve with rice.

title: Mushroom and Barley Pilaf for 2
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 1 1/4 cups mushrooms, sliced | 1 ancho chile, chopped
instructions: Toast the ancho chile until fragrant. Add the mushrooms and barley. Turn down the heat to low and cover for about 30 minutes. After that, stir and turn off the heat and let sit for about 5 minutes. The mushrooms should be tender while they are soaking and still warm. Serve at room temperature with your favourite dip. Can be served hot at room temperature as a side dish.

title: Medley for Dogs or Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 0.5 can liquid smoke | 0.5 bottle strong coffee ( espresso or hot water ) | 1 bag frozen baby peas
instructions: Empty canned tomatoes into a medium saucepan and put on medium heat. Once the tomatoes begin to brown, add liquid smoke. Boil the liquid about 5 minutes, taking care not to let boil it. Add coffee and peas, then remove from heat. Let sit, covered, for 15 minutes. Serve with your favorite bread.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,pineapple ring,garlic powder,chili flake,italian parsley,rump roast,rhubarb
title: Rhubarb and Pineapple Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rump roast | 1 tablespoon chili flakes | 1 tablespoon garlic powder | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 6 canned pineapple rings | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley | 16 fresh rhubarb
instructions: Preheat oven to 275&deg.

title: Beef and Rice Lovers Pies
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 cup jasmine rice, washed | 1 cup shredded tasty cheese, low fat, grated ( i use edam ) | 150 g diced beef | 1 tablespoon unbleached cane sugar | 1 red snapper, finely diced ( optional ) | 200 g bean sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c or 400f. Stir cornflour into jasmine rice. Add other ingredients together. Divide rice mix and roll into 8 - 12 biscuits, placing each biscuit on a baking tray. If you have cooked the beef, dice it up and return to the pan. When heated through, place biscuits on top of beef. Bake for 20 minutes. Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning mix,ginger paste,puff pastry,lemon juice,custard,chicken leg
title: Chicken Empanadas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons prepared low-fat custard | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger paste | 1 cup shredded cooked chicken legs | 1/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 1 package frozen puff pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. In a small bowl, blend together the custard, lemon juice, ginger paste and chicken legs. Unroll the puff pastry onto a lightly floured surface. Using a 5 inch round biscuit cutter, cut circles from the pastry. Make an indentation in the center of each circle with your finger. Spoon the filling into the indentation. Fold the pastry over the filling to form a half circle. Press edges together and crimp with a fork, using a knife to help seal. Place the empanadas on a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes. While the dough is baking, place a large pot of lightly salted water over medium high heat. When it comes to a boil, stir in the taco seasoning and cover. Reduce heat to medium and cook 15 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the empanadas to a serving plate. Spoon taco seasoning on top of the empanadas.

title: Chipotle Adobo Chips
ingredients: 4 -6 chiles packed in adobo | 1/4 cup chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Grill or broil chipotle chiles until completely blackened and soft. Cool.. Arrange chips on a cookie sheet or large serving plate. Sprinkle with adobo sauce.

title: Thai Masala Dessert
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/8 teaspoon curry powder | 2 teaspoons dried parsley leaves | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 cup toasted walnuts, coarsely chopped | 2 cups sliced mixed fresh fruit
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl. Set aside, covered, for an hour. Stir well before serving.

title: Pork, Cabbage & Beef Cottage Filling for Pierogi
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork | 3 lbs cabbage, cored and finely shredded ( or shredded ) | 2 teaspoons nonfat dry milk powder | 4 tablespoons steak, shredded finely or 4 tablespoons other beef-seasoned stew meat, cooked diced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup irish stout beer ( coca-cola )
instructions: Combine the pork and cabbage in a large saucpan with plenty of water and bring to a boil. Lower the heat, cover, and simmer until very tender, about 25 minutes. Drain, remove core from cabbage and shred the cabbage. Return cabbage to the pan and stir in milk powder. Adjust seasonings to taste. Add meat if required. Simmer, uncovered, over low heat to blend flavors and flavors. Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers in a covered container.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,garam masala,creamy peanut butter,kalamata olive,masala,chicken thigh,wine vinegar
title: Slow-Cooked Chicken with Sweet Sausages
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs ( about 3 1/2 lbs per thigh ) | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 teaspoons dried masala | 1/4 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 1/2 cup sweet italian sausage, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to place thighs in 4 to 5 quart crockpot. Combine peanut butter, vinegar, garam masala and masala in shallow dish. Sprinkle chicken with 1/2 tblsps. Peanut and toss to coat. Add chicken and turn to coat well with peanut mixture. Cover and set aside in refrigerator 4 hours. Drain vegetables. Place 1/2 cup of vegetables in blender. Cover and blend until smooth. Spread remaining 1/3 cup peanut spread over chicken. Arrange chicken on top and cover. Cook on lo heat for 8 - 10 hours or on hi heat for 5 - 6 hours. Serve with plain or spiced rice and a green salad and steamed cauliflower for a wonderful meal immediately.

title: Baharat Aka Cashew Crumble Spread
ingredients: 1 cup cashews | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper
instructions: Toast, dry and grind cashews in a food processor until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,red cabbage,sea salt,iceberg lettuce,spanish peanut,sumac,chicken bouillon
title: Shredded Red Cabbage (Shrimp) Salad
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cos lettuce | 3 cups shredded red cabbage | 1/2 cup spanish peanuts, chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped walnuts or 1/4 cup toasted almond | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Mix lettuce, cabbage, peanuts, and macenuts together. Combine rest of the ingredients and pour over salad. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,pam cooking spray,onion soup mix
title: Simple Homemade Onion Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon pepper sauce | pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Prepare onion soup mix according to package directions. Add pepper sauce. Spray pam in baking dish. Turn stove on to high and put onion soup spoon inches allow the mixture to get real hot. Stir mixture constantly. Bake at 425 degrees for 15 minutes or until slightly bubbly. Take out of oven and pour into your favorite sauce recipe.

title: Pasta With Rice and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 3 1/2 cups rice
instructions: Boil spaghetti for 10 minutes, remove spaghetti and drain. While it is still hot, add all other ingredients and stir well. Cook on low, covered, about 30 minutes.

title: Tououse Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup triple sec | 3 teaspoons dried thyme | food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Mix triple sec, thyme and food coloring, if using. Use in recipes or on ice cream.

Random Ingredients: yoghurt,black olive,chicken bouillon,balsamic vinegar,chicken bouillon granule,rice vinegar,noodle,orange
title: Oriental Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces medium egg noodles ( about 3 cups ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 chicken bouillon granule ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 orange, zest and juice, finely grated | 2/3 cup finely snipped black olives | 3/4 cup plain low-fat yoghurt | 1/2 cup chilled low-fat natural yoghurt
instructions: Cook noodles in 1 - 2 cups of rapidly boiling, slated water for 3 minutes or until al dente. Remove from water.

title: Quick Cheese Danish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon margarine | 2 teaspoons cottage cheese
instructions: In a small dish, melt margarine with cottage cheese. Turn onto a piece of waxed paper, and spread mixture into a circle. Wrap the edge with a piece of waxed paper. Fold paper over the mixture, seal edges. Wrap individually in plastic wrap, or refrigerate for 30 minutes to firm up. Preheat oven with rack to 400 degrees f. Slice into wedges and serve warm, or if chilled, just before serving.

Random Ingredients: sunflower seed,ginger garlic paste,pineapple juice,fajita seasoning mix,peanut oil,cornflour,baking soda,lime
title: Lime and Sweet Chilli Fritters
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 1/2 teaspoons mango ginger-garlic paste | 1 lime, juice of | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda ( i use my own self-raising cooking soda ) | 1/2 teaspoon fajita seasoning mix | 1 1/2 cups peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated lime rind
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok over a medium heat and fry the pineapples, until they are golden. Remove on absorbent paper to drain. Mix all ingredients together until sticky, remove from the fire. You are now ready to shape your fritters. Use a teaspoon or two of mixture into a ball. Flatten this mixture using your rolling pin. I like to leave it a little chunkier so i roll it out. You will have a lot of dough. Skewer the fritters onto your chosen metal or bamboo skewer i like to put on the bamboo skewers that have been soaked in water for 15 minutes. I prefer to make these as a side dish, with the fritters they need to be left to soak in the water for 20 minutes or so, before cooking. These also taste really good with jasmine rice. I've had them served with mango chutney, soy sauce, sweet pickled red capsicum, or anything of your choice.

title: Tomatoes Again
ingredients: 1 can whole plum tomatoes | 1 small onion flakes, and 1/8-1/4 tsp onion powder | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed | 1 large poblano chile
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender or food processor. Puree. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour to blend flavors. This can also be made ahead of time, just place in the morning.

title: Chinese Sausage Rolls (Pigs or Loaf)
ingredients: 1 package fresh baby greens or packages frozen baby greens | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 2 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup sesame seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Wash greens thorughly using a cloth.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,salmon,chunky salsa,oyster sauce,cardamom seed,peach,green chili
title: Spicy Corned Salmon
ingredients: 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chunky salsa ( spicy ) | 1 -2 green chili, minced | 1 -2 pickled hot pickled arbol chiles, sliced thinly ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh orange blossom oil or 1 tablespoon ground turmeric | 1/2 lb salmon, cleaned and fillet | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds
instructions: Prepare barbecue. Place ingredients except salmon in large bowl and rub all over salmon. Allow salmon to marinate 15 minutes. Drain salmon and pat dry. Grill salmon 4 - 5 minutes on each side to get a little crispy on the outside and just the flesh. Serve with thick corn on the cob or with a nice salad on the side..

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,chicken drumstick,fast rising yeast,red chili pepper,vegetable
title: Korean Chicken and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 lbs chicken drumsticks, bone in and skin on | 10 -12 cups vegetable broth or 10 -12 cups chicken broth | 6 tablespoons fast rising yeast | 10 -12 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and drained | 1 small dried small dried red chili pepper
instructions: Place chicken breasts and the remaining ingredients in a large saucepan in the order directed. Stir to combine. Cover, and place in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 6 - 8 hours but no longer than 24 hours.

title: Red Lentil Burger
