Cook stirring constantly, until cheese has melted and starts to brown, about 2 minutes. Transfer skillet contents to baking sheet. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Bake, uncovered, until golden brown and bubbly, about 15 minutes.

title: Macaroni and Macaroon (Rice With Orange and Rosemary)
ingredients: 300 g uncooked macaroni or 300 g dry pasta | 500 g risotto rice ( about 1 cup, arborio will work too ) | 1 small orange, juice and oi frices | rosemary, to garnish
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil, add the rice and turn it on to a trivet over the heat. Cook for about 15minutes or until the rice is cooked. Drain the rice in a colander and set aside. Return the oil to a medium non stick pan, add the rice and cook on medium, shaking the pan around regularly to prevent the rice and oil from sticking and sticking. Add the orange or lemon juice, oi frices and rosemary, stir through carefully and remove from heat. Keep stirring until all of the rice is added and heated through. Keep stirring and set aside to cool to room temperature. Serve in small dishes and garnish with chopped parsley to serve the risotto from a bowl.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,honey mustard,linguine,ice water,radish,garlic clove,anise seed,almond extract
title: Linguine With a Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1/4 cup honey mustard | 1 -2 garlic clove, minced ( or more if you want ) | 5 medium radishes, sliced thin | 1 teaspoon anise seed, whole or 1 teaspoon black, whole | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, fresh | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 teaspoon ice water
instructions: Put the honey mustard, garlic, radishes, aniseed and lemon juice in a medium sized bowl and mix. Add the almond extract and mix well. Add the ice water, and mix a bit more. Cook linguine according to package instructions.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,serrano chilies,chicken thigh,oregano,chicken wing,soy sauce
title: Maurizio's Chicken Adobo
ingredients: 8 lbs chicken wings | 8 lbs chicken wings, tips discarded | 1 1/2 cups fresh soy sauce | 1/2 cup dried oregano | 1 large orange, zest of, shredded | 3 tablespoons serrano chilies, fresh, thinly sliced ( can sub jalapeno )
instructions: Put the chicken and wings in a large bowl of a very heavy pot in which the soy sauce is soaking. Toss the other ingredients, except for chiles and bring to a boil over a high heat for 15 minutes, stirring to separate the wings. Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside, trying not to dislodge any of the juices. Pour the sauce over the chicken, mixing and separating the pieces with back of a spoon. Return the chicken to the pot, cover, and simmer over very low heat until the chicken is tender, about 2 hours. If necessary, add more of the chile sauce, a few drops at a time, to cook the sauce. Taste and adjust the seasoning.

title: Mexican Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 1 box velveeta mexican cheese ( i use mexican style ) | 1 box confectioners'sugar, sifted
instructions: Combine the velveeta and confectioners' sugar in a saucepan and melt over low heat. Do not boil or the cheese will become hard. You should be able to spread it with your finger easily and with no sticking to the fingers. When the texture becomes smooth, stir in the mexican cheese and mix well. To make frosting, melt the chocolate on top of the cheese mixture, stirring until smooth, then pour over the frosting. If desired, spread frosting on dunchess or in a cake tin or on a cake stand.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,yukon gold potato,chicken stock,iceberg lettuce
title: Potato & Lettuce Soup
ingredients: 500 g yukon gold potatoes, peeled, roughly chopped ( about 250 ) | 1/2 cup low-sodium chicken stock | 1 head iceberg lettuce, leaves separated | 40 g frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Place the potato on to a trivet at the bottom of a large pan with an 8cm depth of water, adding a little salt. Cover and put on a high heat. When it boils, add half of the chicken stock and boil for a few minutes. Meanwhile, cook the rocket leaves in a pan of boiling water for 2 minutes, then place under a hot grill until golden and just wilted. When cool, drain and refresh in a large bowl. When cooled, place in the refrigerator to prevent further chilling. Heat a frying pan over a medium heat. Add the chicken and cook, stirring until cooked through. Divide the potato between four ovenproof soup crocks or bowls. Top with half the rocket and add a ladle of hot chicken stock. Cover and cook for 30 minutes at 170°c.

title: Lentils and Vegetables in Horseradish Dressing
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower floret | 2 medium button mushrooms, sliced | 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and diced small | 1 medium fresh lime, divided into wedges for garnish | 3 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat the broiler setting. Cut the cauliflower into florets and place in a baking dish. Top with sliced mushrooms. Combine the remaining horseradish, lime juice, horseradish, and cinnamon and drizzle over the vegetables. Broil the vegetables under the hot broiler for 7 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,garam masala,canola oil,radish,baby spinach leaf,olive oil,lamb shoulder
title: Lamb With Radishes in Garam Masala
ingredients: 350 g baby spinach leaves | 2 1/2 cm piece radishes or 2 1/2 cm lemons, rind removed | 5 g red chili powder | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 lbs cooked lamb shoulder, diced into 4 pieces | 4 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Prepare the cooking oil, in a large frying pan and on a high heat, add the oil and swirl it around the pan. Add the radish and chili powder and stir around the pan for about a minute, then add enough water to cover the pieces by an inch. Cover and let sit for about 5 minutes. Uncover, add the spinach leaves and cover again. Cook for about 2 minutes until just wilted. Remove from heat, transfer to cutting board and chop into bite sized pieces and set aside. Cook the lamb in the frying pan using the same oil as the spinach in step 2 until the lamb is cooked on all sides, this doesn't take very long. When meat is cooked, transfer it to the steamed spinach. Heat the oil for the stuffing to a high heat in the frying pan. Add the garam masala and when the spluttering noises ceased, add the sliced lamb and stir around until mixed and coated in the garam masala. Toss in the chopped radish and mix again. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with your favourite veggies.

title: Spanish Tapas - Pear Appetizer
ingredients: 1 small green pepper | 1 pear ( alder or other firm pear will do )
instructions: Slice the pears on a hot griddle. Serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,poblano chile,shrimp,milk ricotta cheese,neufchatel cheese,paprika,chicken bouillon cube
title: Crock Pot Mexican Shrimp and Ricotta
ingredients: 36 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 32 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 1/2 cups leek & poblano chiles, roasted & chopped | 4 teaspoons cajun smoked paprika | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 2 packages neufchatel cheese | 32 ounces beef brisket, cooked
instructions: Slice beef brisket across the grain and lay in a single layer. Sprinkle both sides with chiptoles, paprika, and chicken bouillon. Layer the entire ricotta cheese layer of chiptoles in a crock pot. Layer the second package of neufchatel cheese on top of the cheese. Place the brisket onto the cheese and pour the remaining 1/2 cup of milk over it. Cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours. Slice the brisket across the grain and serve with salsa, and a fresh salad.

Random Ingredients: almond meal,vegetable broth,rump roast,salt cayenne pepper
title: Shredded Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt-cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon almond meal | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs rump roast | 2 cans vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. In a small bowl combine salt, pepper and almond meal. Coat roast with mixture. Place roast in baking pan. Add 2 cans of broth.

title: Stuffed Beet (Appetizing on a Stick)
ingredients: 5 large beets | salt and freshly ground pepper | 8 slices bacon drippings | 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Wash, peel and slice beets into 1/2 inch thick slices. Using a 3 inch piece of kitchen shears, slice the slices widthwise into 1/5 inch thick slices, taking care not to slice too well. Using a little less than a tablespoon, scoop out the pulp, leaving a little raggedy at the center. Heat 3 tablespoons of the bacon drippings in a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Add the sliced beets without any juice and cook until soft and tender, about 10 to 15 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the beets to a bowl and mash with a fork. Heat the remaining bacon drippings in the skillet over medium heat. Add the beet and salt and pepper and cook until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Spoon the beet mash into a serving bowl. Top each beet with about 2 teaspoons of cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla essence,pizza sauce,panko breadcrumb,stout beer,poblano pepper,crescent,beef tenderloin,pine nut
title: Steak Stuffed Poblano-Stuffed Poblano
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper | 1 tablespoon unsalted butter | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons grated fresh parmesan cheese or 2 tablespoons grated aged parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon real vanilla essence | 1 cup homemade pizza sauce, or homemade store bought | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat and cut in 1/2-inch slices | 1 package refrigerated crescent rolls, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Place red poblano on foil or a baking sheet and roast at 425 f for 20 minutes. Remove poblano and let rest for 5 minutes. Cut off stem. Cut around the stem edge of the pepper with a serrated knife to form a cross. Pull out the seeds if desired, and scrape off the black membrane. Remove the stems from the pepper and discard. Cut in half, remove the seeds and ribs and set aside. Heat butter in a large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese and vanilla essence. Pour in tomato sauce and cook until slightly thickened, stirring often, about 5 to 10 minutes. Preheat oven to bake the beef slices, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and stir to separate the slices. Remove the beef slices and continue to cook, turning them, in the sauce. Remove the poblano seeds and membrane from the pepper and discard. Cut off the stem and set it aside, cut stem side up. Spoon an even 1/2 inch thickness of the dough around each pepper half with a meat tenderizer, then place 1/2 cup of the meat in the center of each dough half. Replace the ends of the dough, pinch sides together and make a small hole for the filling. Fill the hole with approximately 1/2 teaspoon of tomato sauce. Continue adding the pepper and stuffing. Replace the ends of the dough and pinch to seal. Arrange in an even layer on a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Press edges into the tops of each stuffed pepper to completely enclose the filling. Bake in the preheated oven until the puffed peppers start to brown and the dough turns golden, about 25 minutes. Transfer the stuffed peppers to a wire rack to cool to room temperature, 1 hour or more. Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,panir,stout beer,mint leaf,lemon,button mushroom,white wine vinegar
title: Champignons - Beer Canner
ingredients: 6 ounces panir, diced | 6 ounces button mushrooms, sliced | 1 lime, juice of | 6 ounces white wine vinegar | 3 teaspoons mint leaves | 3 tablespoons lime juice | 2/3 cup stout beer, chilled
instructions: Dice the paneer, mushrooms and lime into about 24 pieces. Combine cubed paneer mixture, 1/4 cup of reserved beer and the mint leaves in a blender and process until smooth. Add the remaining 2/3 cup beer and blend again until smooth, stopping occasionally to scrape down the sides. Pour into a glass jar, add lid and seal. Refrigerate for 2 - 3 days, stirring occasionally.

title: Pepper Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg minced chicken meat | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 teaspoon cognac | 1 teaspoon ground pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredient in a large bowl.

title: Sydney Style Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 cremini mushrooms | 8 ounces shredded cheddar cheese | 2 1/2 tablespoons crushed fried ginger root | 1 1/2 tablespoons soda water
instructions: Place a paper towel onto a cookie sheet. Place mushrooms on towel and cover with more paper towels to absorb excess moisture. Place a second sheet of paper towels onto the cookie sheet. Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Sprinkle crushed ginger over mushrooms. In a medium bowl, mix cheddar cheese and crushed mushroom mixture. Open a mushroom from skin, and place on cookie sheet. Pinch the top of the filled mushroom closed, and pinch closed. Place the stuffed mushrooms onto cookie sheet. Spray with non stick cooking spray. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until mushrooms are lightly browned.

title: Guayhos a la Huanchaina
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1 tablespoon garlic granules | 4 ripe hass avocadoes | 1 1/2 cups steamed rice, seasoned according to taste
instructions: Preheat your oven to 300 degrees. Dry fry the peanuts in a dry skillet over medium heat stirring often, until fragrant and a nutty smell develops, about 3 minutes. Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the garlic. When cool enough to handle, peel, pit, and dice the avocado. Stir the peanuts into the avocado with the cooked rice, toss to mix, and serve.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,white rice,allspice berry,honey,sage,garlic clove,orange peel,heavy cream
title: Cheesecake With Risotto Crust
ingredients: 2 cups white rice ( arborio, risciut, carnaroli, italian short grain is ideal ) | 6 tablespoons honey ( can substitute brown sugar or agave syrup ) | 1 1/2 - 4 lbs sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berry | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated | 1 teaspoon sage, crushed | 1 garlic clove, pressed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees. Butter an 8 spring form cake pan. Spray the sides and bottom of the pan and set in the oven to preheat. In a medium pan with a little of the oil and a little water, cook the rice with the honey until it's all fragrant and grains are well fluffed and sticky. Remove from heat, stir in the cheese a little at a time, and stir until smooth. Press into the prepared pan, and bake for 30 - 40 minutes, until firm and cracked on top. Serve immediately. Risotto crusts. In a small bowl, stir together the cream, allspice, orange peel, sage, garlic, and cream. Set aside. To serve, top the rissotto with the cream mixture and sprinkling with the grated cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Italian Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 1 jar sweet peppers | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Combine peppers and pimiento in a saucepan and add enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook 20 minutes. Place in a baking dish. Bake at 300 degrees f for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Serve in slices.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,feta,grape,rice wine,shallot,serrano pepper,bicarbonate soda
title: Rita's Ultimate Grape Raita
ingredients: 200 g grape ( i used green because it's seasonal fresh. but all i had is grapes. ) | 100 g feta ( crumbled ) | 1 -2 serrano pepper ( seeded and finely chopped ) | 3 shallots ( grated or finely chopped ) | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda ( or 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda and 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg in small pieces ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine ( optional, i sub red wine vinegar ) | 3 tablespoons monterey jack pepper cheese ( grated )
instructions: Get a large bowl and put in all the ingredients, except the cheese. Stir to mix well. If you need to add water add more or less, we love our raita. Set aside while preparing the salad. When salad is ready, put about 1 tbsp of cheese in the middle and then add about 1/2 cup of grape, and stir and toss the grape mix it in very gently. Garnish with more cheese to taste.

title: Mexican Style Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon rubbed dried sage | 1/4 cup port wine | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans and mix with the cumin, dried sage, port, and cilantro in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Remove the cover and bake for 20 to 30 minutes to let the flavors mix. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,phyllo dough,cannellini bean,cayenne pepper,beef gravy,beef stew meat,mozzarella string cheese
title: Beef & Bean Cheese Phyllo Pizza Bake
ingredients: 1 can beef gravy, undiluted | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat, removed from any fat | 1 can cannellini beans | 1 package frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 package shredded mozzarella string cheese | 1 teaspoon chili oil ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( optional, i do not use )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Drain and discard any liquid from meat. Mix beef gravy, cannellini beans, and 1 cup water in a large nonstick skillet.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,cheesecloth,wheat,cumin,cream cheese,ice cube,beef sirloin steak,hot water
title: Easy Philly Cheeseburger Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, trimmed of visible fat | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 2 tablespoons cumin | 4 cups ice cubes | 1 tablespoon hot water | 1 package cream cheese | 4 sheets cheesecloth | 6 cups shredded low-fat cheddar cheese or 6 cups shredded pepper cheese
instructions: Cut beef into 4 equal thin slices and place on a rack in broiler pan. Place garlic paste in a small bowl and put 2 teaspoons of cumin in bowl using the side of a meat tenderizing mallet. Crush ice with your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Spread about 2 teaspoons of cream cheese on one side of a 4 ounce slice of beef. Put 1/2 teaspoon of crumbs on the second slice of beef.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,button mushroom,canadian bacon,tomato juice,dark sesame oil,caraway seed,picante sauce,italian bread
title: Mushroom and Canadian Bacon Kebabs
ingredients: 10 slices canadian bacon, 1/2 inch thick slices | 8 ounces button mushrooms, trimmed, cut in half | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 whole green cardamom pod | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 4 slices crusty italian bread, sliced diagonally
instructions: Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer the bacon to paper towels. Add the mushrooms to the same skillet.

Random Ingredients: coriander,plain flour,mexican cheese,lime wedge,white mushroom,tea,self rising flour,chunky salsa
title: Mexican Party Tea Bread
ingredients: 4 ounces shredded white mushrooms | 3/4 cup strong tea | 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 1/4 cups self-rising flour | 3/4 cup chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | chopped fresh coriander | lime wedge ( to serve )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c or 400°f. Grease and line 24cm x 18cm loaf tin or 1 cup capacity texas muffin tin. Place mushrooms in a medium saucepan. Add the tea, bring to the boil. Cover and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes or until the mushrooms are tender. Place all purpose flour, salsa, cheese, and coriander in a large bowl, gradually adding the hot tea to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Scatter over half of the mixture in the prepared tin, then sprinkle over half of the reserved seasoned flour. Scatter over half the remaining mushrooms, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, then drizzle with the remaining tea mixture. To bake, bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until the top is golden brown and hollow sounding. Serve immediately, garnished with coriander.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Fajitas
ingredients: 3 -4 medium red bell peppers, cored and seeded ( or any green or red bell pepper ) | 1 tablespoon kosher salt, more if desired ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 fresh red chili pepper, stemmed, seeded, and sliced
instructions: Heat the oven to 425 degrees f. Line a baking pan with foil and lightly spray with nonstick cooking spray if desired. Wash and cut the peppers into 1 1/2 lengths. Place on your foil and bake 15 - 20 minutes until the peppers are soft and just beginning to become tender. When cool, combine the chopped peppers and salt in a small bowl. Remove the chilies, reserving the seeds if you want to use them in guacamole, or combine with the reserved seeds. Heat skillet, drizzle 1 - 2 tbs. Of oil on one side of your pan and turn the heat to medium. Arrange the peppers in a single layer in the hot pan. Roast the peppers over indirect heat about 4, stirring every 2 minutes, and turning every 3 - 4 minutes so the peppers are evenly coated with oil. Roast for about 12 - 15 minutes, or until the peppers are very dark and very crisp. When the peppers are well done, place them on paper towels to drain. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: bean,chicken thigh,orange juice,tomato green chilies,lobster tail
title: Quick & Easy Caribbean Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb cooked chicken thigh | 1 can whole canned tomatoes and green chilies | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 can lobster tails, drained | 1 can baked beans, drained
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot except baked beans, stir well. Cover and cook on lo heat for 7 - 8 hours, stirring and adding baked beans at the end of the cooking time.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,pork sausage,spring onion,kaffir lime leaf,corn muffin mix,ice,catsup,iceberg lettuce
title: Chinese Pork Sausage and Lettuce Cups
ingredients: 250 g pork sausage | 1/3 cup corn muffin mix | 1/3 cup chopped spring onion | 1/3 cup catsup | 4 kaffir lime leaves, shredded | 1 large iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Combine the pork sausage and 1/3 cup of the muffin mix in a bowl and shape into small balls. Place the remaining muffin mix, onions, catsup, lime leaves, lettuce and ice in a large bowl. Toss to coat and spoon into the lettuce cups. Serve immediately.

title: Pasta Fresca
ingredients: 1 lb dry pasta ( small whole wheat, penne, or a ziti ) | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3/4 cup yellow sweet pepper, sliced | 1/2 lb cod, cubed | pepper
instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender. Meanwhile, heat medium nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, in a 13x9 inch baking dish, combine sweet pepper, cod and cooked pepper mixture, and toss gently. Sprinkle with salt and pepper as needed. Sprinkle pasta with remaining pepper. Bake, covered, in a 300 oven until heated through, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lime,red cabbage,portobello mushroom,tahini,tabasco sauce,part mozzarella cheese,chicken wing,flour
title: Pigs & Jerks
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings, cut in thirds and tips discarded or 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, cut in 2 | 3/4 cup tahini | 1/2 - 3/4 cup flour | 8 ounces red cabbage, shredded | 4 ounces portobello mushrooms, coarsely chopped or 1/4 cup chopped mushroom stems | 2 -4 limes, juice and zest of | tabasco sauce, to taste | 1 1/2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Cut off the wing tips that come bundled with a length of kitchen twine or butcher's twine and attach it to a drumstick and attach it to a meat mallet. Rinse well, then pat dry with paper towels. If using chicken breast, sprinkle lightly with salt. In a bowl, combine the tahini with another 2 3/4 cups water and whisk until smooth. Dip chicken pieces first in the tahini batter, then in one piece of plastic wrap and finally across in strips of your choice. Lay on baking sheets lined with parchment paper or wax paper, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. Preheat your grill or broiler. Thread chicken pieces onto metal skewers. Brush with olive oil on both sides, if necessary. Broil in batches on the rack set 6 inches from heat for 8 - 10 minutes, or until juices are runny and meat is browned slightly. Slice or shred meat into thin strips and serve. Squeeze lime juice over meats and top with shredded cheese, if desired. Serve with crusty italian bread. Yield, serves 2 - 4 people.

title: Spicy Chilies Vinaigrette
ingredients: 16 fresh guajillo chilies | water | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/4 cup greek yogurt
instructions: Heat chiles in a small skillet over medium heat until browned and softened. Remove from skillet and puree with water until smooth. Stir in cream of tartar. Refrigerate before serving.

Random Ingredients: green apple,creme de cassis,kitchen bouquet,red shallot,milk chocolate
title: Normandy Hot Chocolate (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 10 tablespoons creme de cassis ( or other mildly sweet orange liquor, if preferred ) | 10 ounces milk chocolate, chopped | 1 small red shallot, peeled and finely chopped ( about 1/4 cup, or use 1/2 cup chopped shallots, with or without root ) | 2 medium green apples, peeled, cored, and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon kitchen bouquet
instructions: Place chopped apples and creme de cassis into 6 1/2 to 7 1/2-quart slow cooker. Stir chopped red shallots, chopped green apple chunks, and kitchen bouquet into warm chocolate mixture. Cook on high for 3 to 4 1/2 hours. Serve in 2 oz. Choco-flavored liqueur.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,kielbasa sausage,parsley,cheese,rice wine vinegar,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Sausage & Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 lb kielbasa sausage, cut crosswise into 3/8 -inch slices | 2 tablespoons white rice wine vinegar or 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley or 1 1/2 tablespoons thyme | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds, lightly toasted | fresh parsley, chopped ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil in a 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until a bead of water sizzles in it, then stir in the sausage and cook, turning once, until lightly browned but not cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add the vinegar and cook, stirring, until it is absorbed and the vinegar is reduced by half, about 1 minute. Stir in the parsley. Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with sesame seeds, if desired. Sausages can be made ahead. Bring to room temperature before serving, if using.

title: Cheddar Pear Truffles
ingredients: 1 mini chocolate chip | 1 package cottage cheese | 2 tablespoons pine nuts | 1/2 pear, peeled, cored and finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Grease a baking sheet. Pour miniature chocolate chips into a bowl, and stir in cottage cheese until well blended. Stir in pine nuts, pearly pear, and chocolate chips until thoroughly blended. Drop by rounded spoonsful onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Roasted Grape With Saffron and Goat Cheese - Chilled
ingredients: 12 ounces lean pork loin | 15 ounces red seedless grapes | 10 ounces greek yogurt ( to taste ) | 1 pinch saffron thread, crushed | 5 ounces goat cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°f. Trim fat from loin. Remove loin. Cut in 2 - 3 slabs about 1/2 by 3 inches thick. Coat meat with saffron. Place loin in roasting pan, fat side up and arrange grapes around loin. In medium mixing bowl combine yoghurt and crumbled saffron. Season and drizzle over meat. Cover tightly with foil. Bake, basting occasionally, 1 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,garlic clove,pepper sauce,half cream,white wine vinegar,ketchup
title: Coconut Atole
ingredients: 1 cup cream ( half and half or milk or egg milk ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream ( or just heavy whipping cream ) | 3 garlic cloves, minced ( or pressed ) | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 can light coconut milk
instructions: Place cream, vinegar, half & half, garlic and hot pepper sauce in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes. Strain the sauce through a medium mesh sieve. Return coconut milk to the pan, add to pan and heat through, a few minutes.

title: Easy Awesome Maple Syrup French Toast
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1/4 cup fat free catsup | 1 dash sazon goya | 1 pkt cool whip | maple syrup
instructions: Mix eggs, catsup and sugar. Soak in cool whip until fully absorbed. Grill until done.

title: Beef Tater With Fettuccine
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef tenderloin | 14 ounces beef ravioli or 14 ounces fettuccine | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/4 cup hoagie roll | 3 tablespoons torn fresh savory | 1/2 cup fresh blueberries | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh savory
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Cut beef tenderloin crosswise into 3/4 inch slices and arrange across surface of a 12 x 8 inch baking dish just large enough to contain the beef. Insert beef tenderloin slices into a 9 inch nonstick skillet and place on a foil lined baking sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tenderloin is no longer pink in centre. Meanwhile, in a large pot of boiling water, cook ravioli according to package directions, except do not overcook. Drain and set aside. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk together tahini and 1/2 cup water. Set aside. Add remaining 1/2 cup water to the pasta and toss. Spoon beef onto hot baking sheet and bake 15 to 18 minutes or until lightly browned. To serve, arrange ravioli on a platter, spoon beef, blueberries and savory on top of ravioli, and spoon some of the sauce on top. Serve remaining sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,liquid egg substitute,crouton,breakfast sausage link,stilton cheese,rice vinegar,pimento pepper,red onion
title: Stilton Breakfast Sausage Cakes
ingredients: 1 package breakfast sausage links | 8 slices red onions ( separated into rings and separated into rings ) | 2 cups shredded broccoli ( steamed ) | 1/2 cup diced pimento pepper | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon liquid egg substitute ( or egg beaters egg substitute ) | 9 ounces croutons | 6 ounces stilton cheese, crumbles
instructions: In a skillet, cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,yellow bell pepper,mustard seed,oil,honey,cannellini bean
title: Honeyed & Seed Cannellini Beans
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 2 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons oil | 3 tablespoons honey
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans, pat them dry with paper towels. Cut into 1/2 inch dice with a knife. Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds until they start to pop, and crackle a bit, taking care not to burn. Add the onions and pepper. When they are soft, add the beans and cook for 5 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,celery seed,cajun seasoning,red kidney bean,mussel,taco seasoning,white bread
title: Cajun-Style Pork and White Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 stalks celery seeds | 1/4 cup red kidney beans, drained | 1/4 cup taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 loaf white bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 8 whole mussels
instructions: Place pork, celery seeds, kidney beans, taco seasoning, cajun seasoning, and celery seed in a saucepan, cover, and bring to boil. Simmer over medium heat until pork is very tender, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 250 degrees f. Place bread cubes in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and cover with water. Place dish on a baking sheet. Place bayou blast onto bread cubes, and bake in preheated oven until bread is toasted and toasted, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Mock Refins Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup salad oil | 4 tablespoons coffee | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon dill | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Store in airtight container.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,salmon,spanish onion,beef stock,canola oil,ice water,walnut oil,rub
title: Smoked Salmon and Walnut Oil Stew
ingredients: 500 g smoked salmon | 2 tablespoons smoked streaky cured spanish onions ( i usually use vidalia ) | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 cup beef stock | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 1 cup ice water | 1/2 cup walnut oil | crushed ice water, for the stew
instructions: Cut the smoked salmon into large chunks, then combine with the onion and bicarb of soda. Add the stock, oil and ice water to a large pot. Bring to the boil, then turn the heat to low, leave in the pot for at least 30 minutes for the flavours to blend. When all the flavours are blended, season with a little water, remove the lid, leave for about 10 to 15 minutes to cool off. After cooking, heat the walnut oil to 180 c / 350 f – if the stew starts to burn it will take about 15 to 20 minutes to cook. To serve, place over a mound of cracked ice and spoon over some of the stew. Serve with a crouton on the side.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,soy sauce,poblano chile,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Mexican Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed | 1 lb mild cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 large poblano chile, peeled, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Snap the strings from the snow peas.

title: Salmon Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup watercress | 1/4 cup spring onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1/2 cup plum tomato, very thinly sliced | 1/4 cup blackberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 3 ounces salmon fillet, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup ritz crackers, crushed
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients.

title: Chorizo and Black Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 pound chorizo sausage, sliced | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups quick cooking oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Lightly grease a 2 quart casserole dish. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Place chorizo slices in skillet, and cook until browned, adding a little water if needed. Mix in the black beans, and continue cooking until heated through. Pour in the quick cooking oats, and stir to combine. Stir in the chorizo, and transfer mixture into the prepared casserole dish. Bake in the preheated oven until browned on the top, about 1 hour.

title: Cottage Cheese, Jelly and Juniper Marches
ingredients: 200 g fat-free cottage cheese | 15 fresh juniper berries | 10 fresh green olives | 250 g ladyfingers | splenda granular ( or sugar )
instructions: In a pot boil the water add marches and boil for 8 minutes. Drain and cool. Slice and spread into a small bowl. Fold in other ingredients until well blended. Sauce, in a non stick sauté pan, melt one pinch of sugar. Add the marches and stir. Remove from a burner and add splenda, stirring. Serve with your favourite ice cream or as a dessert.

title: Beef and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 3 packets instant espresso | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 cup instant rice | 1 1/2 cups beef stock, any flavor
instructions: Prepare instant rice according to package directions. Add cumin seeds. Set aside. Brown beef in skillet without draining. Place beef in a slow cooker and stir in beef stock. Cook on high in slow cooker for 35 - 40 minutes. Stir every 10 minutes on high. Remove beef from slow cooker to a serving platter.

title: The Best Indian Chutney Ever
ingredients: 5 large plum tomatoes | 5 tablespoons lard | 1 1/2 tablespoons salt | 1 teaspoon garlic granules
instructions: Finely dice 2 tomatoes and put them in a large heavy saucepan. Add salt, sugar and turmeric powder. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 20 minutes. Mash with a potato masher or a wooden spoon to a puree. Leave unground, if not using fresh tomatoes, and allow to cool before adding them, stirring well.

title: Spaetzle II
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh kale, rinsed and trimmed | 2 stalks celery leaves, chopped | 1 cup grated or crumbled cotija cheese | 8 red onion slices, for garnish
instructions: Using a large pot of lightly salted water, cook the kale and celery leaves until they become tender, about 5 minutes. Drain the greens in a colander. Place the kale and celery leaves in a bowl. Pour enough hot water over them to cover them. Let cool. Pour 3/4 of the cheese into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with grated cheese and the red onion slices. Repeat with the remaining cheese, onion and kale mixture. Dump the spaetzle back into the hot, salted water and cook over medium heat until it begins to brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Cashew Bread
ingredients: 2 french baguettes | 1/3 cup unsalted cashews
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut the baguettes into 3 pieces widthwise. Cut one piece lengthwise into 1/8 inch thick slices. Arrange a single layer of cashews on the parchment paper. Use the tips of your fingers to flatten it out into a large, even layer. Repeat with the second piece. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Cut into slices, and serve hot.

title: Dungeness Sea Bass
ingredients: 600 g sea bass fillets | 500 ml chicken stock | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon flour ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon minced chinese red chili peppers, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat the bbq or grill. Line a baking tray with aluminium foil or tin foil. Line the sea bass fillet lengthways with the fish, about an inch thick, and place on the foil. Combine the stock and cornflour in a pan, and heat slowly, stirring, until the sauce boils. Pour this over the fish, and spread the chillies over. Place in a pre heated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until just cooked.

Random Ingredients: red leaf lettuce,marjoram,ham hock,salt substitute,wonton skin,pizza sauce
title: Italian Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 3 cooked ham hocks | 1 small red leaf lettuce | 1/4 teaspoon marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute | 12 wonton skins | pizza sauce
instructions: Shred lettuce and mince marjoram. Remove bones and sinew from ham hocks if desired. Remove meat from any visible fat and discard. Thoroughly mix marjoram, salt substitute, and lettuce with meat. Place four wonton skins on each plate. Lettuce salad mixture on top of wraps. Serve pizza sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,jumbo pasta shell,beef sirloin steak,horseradish,rigatoni pasta
title: Beef Sirloin With Rigatoni
ingredients: 2 beef top sirloin steaks, trimmed | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons horseradish | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 1/2 cups lightly packed fresh horseradish
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high and prepare grill. Using a sharp knife, poke 3 - 4 deep slits in steaks all over. Place steaks on grill rack coated with a 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs in a single layer, and grill, covered, until steak is desired doneness, 3 - 6 minutes per side for medium rare. Meanwhile, cook rigatoni according to package directions. Drain rigatoni, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid and rinsing 1/2 cup cooking liquid. Place remaining ingredients except horseradish in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart baking dish of same size. Add 2 tablespoons hot cooking liquid and horseradish. Toss to combine. Spoon rigatoni onto plates, with steak pieces and horseradish flavored slather.

title: Drunken Beer Shrimp
ingredients: 20 jumbo shrimp | 2 fluid ounces beer
instructions: Rinse shrimp under running cold water to remove as much sand as possible. Using the back of a wooden spoon, push the shrimp along the shrimp's back just to get a little wider than the rim of the shrimps. Be careful not to push them too far apart. Pour the beer over the shrimp.

title: Greek Pasta Salad (No Meat Option)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh penne, cooked al dente ( about 6-7 servings ) | 2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup okra or 1/3 cup other soft-leaf textured vegetable protein, chopped | 2 tablespoons semolina flour | 2 tablespoons finely minced fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the cooked pasta with the fine bread crumbs, bread crumbs, and 1/3 cup of the okra or other soft textured vegetable protein. In a small bowl, combine the semolina flour and the mint leaves.

title: Homemade Wood Polish
ingredients: 1 can green chili peppers | 1 cup pine nuts
instructions: First put your chilis through a wood chip, and add the nuts. Take the chilis out of the can, and cut in half. Take the skins off the green chili peppers, and put the skins back on. You may put each chilis on the table for people to eat, and you can do any way you want.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,hot italian sausage,lime leaf,fruit cocktail,lime zest,garbanzo bean
title: Chocolate and Garbanzo Bean Hummus
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans | 2 cups fruit cocktail, drained | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 8 lime leaves | 1 1/2 cups cooked hot italian sausage, cut into strips
instructions: Combine the garbanzo beans, fruit cocktail, cocoa powder, zest, and lime juice in a food processor.

title: Amarretta Butter
ingredients: 2 tablespoons amaretto | 1 teaspoon accent seasoning
instructions: Put all ingredients in a small bowl and blend together. Store in an airtight container.

title: Chili Red Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 1 can diced red chilies | 10 ounces spaghetti sauce
instructions: In a large saute pan or skillet, heat the red chilies, sauce and peppers until warm.

title: Creamy Turkish Lentils
ingredients: 3 cups green lentils | 1 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill ( optional ) | vegetables, to coat
instructions: Wash lentils and drain. Place lentils in greased saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to boil and cook 7 - 10 minutes, until tender. Drain, reserving 1 3/4 cup water. Add remaining ingredients, stirring until well blended. Cover and simmer 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Tasty Cheese and Leafy  Vietnamese Wraps
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 inches-thick rolls ( i like the sandwich buns ) | 4 lettuce leaves | 1 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Heat the grill. Line the sandwich buns with the lettuce leaves. Sprinkle both sides of the rolls with allspice. Cut each roll in half and place half cut side down on the grill. As soon as the top starts to show grill marks, place the sandwich bun onto this part and close the lid. Grill until golden brown and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,poultry seasoning,mushroom soup
title: Italian Herbs and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 3/4 - 2 cups mushrooms, sliced | 2 -3 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray to prevent sticking. Combine mushrooms, parsley, and poultry seasoning. Bring to a boil. Cover and remove from heat. Let mushroom mixture stand for 1 minute before serving.

title: Lamb 'n' Goat' Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 tablespoons low-fat cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon low-fat red cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons low-fat plain yogurt or 2 tablespoons sour cream | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh thyme | 4 very thin slices of organic lamb | 8 very thin slices of organic goat's cheese, the kind sold to british dry choc puddings and crumpets, crumbled | 8 thin slices of organic beet, well scrubbed
instructions: Combine all the ingridients in a food processor. Mix until it's a smooth paste. Add the lamb, mix and divide into 6 equal portion, shaping each portion into a ball. Slightlyatten the balls in your hands if they are too tall. Then place about 6 thin slices of beet on each ball. Wrap each ball up with 8 slices of goat's cheese over the beet slices. Set on a plate to cool, then refrigerate for a day, to allow the flavours to develop.

Random Ingredients: crepe,active yeast,green bean,pico de gallo,puff pastry,apple juice
title: Apple Crepes
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 2 cups warm apple juice | 2 cups chopped fresh green beans | 1 cup torn dried pico de gallo | 1 cup shredded pie crust puff pastry, chilled | crepes
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over the warm apple juice in a small bowl, let stand 2 minutes. Stir in green beans, pico de gallo and 2 tablespoons water. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir into the yeast mixture and transfer to a large bowl. Roll out the chilled puff pastry onto a floured surface. Cut into 8 rounds using a 2 inch round cookie cutter or a drinking glass. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes. Fry the dough rounds in batches until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Serve warm with crepes.

title: Chickpea Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 jar chickpea flour ( garbanzo beans ) | 4 medium tomatoes, cut in wedges | 1/2 bunch cashews, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup corn kernels - toasted, skin-on | 1 tablespoon saffron | 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water til al dente according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water and set aside. In a large bowl combine the chickpea flour, tomatoes, cashews and corn kernels. Mix in saffron, soy sauce and pasta. Toss until well mixed. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,portobello mushroom,dark sesame oil,shrimp paste,beef bouillon cube,iceberg lettuce
title: Spicy Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 medium head iceberg lettuce | 4 portobello mushrooms, halved and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce, dark | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons shrimp paste | 1 beef bouillon cube
instructions: Cut the head of lettuce in half and line it with the lettuce. Preheat the oven to 450°f. Cut the mushrooms into small wedges and arrange them on top of the lettuce. Whisk together the soy sauce, dark sesame oil, shrimp paste and beef bouillon and spread this mixture over the mushrooms. Spread the dressing over the mushrooms, and stir to evenly coat. Drizzle the exposed dressing onto the mushrooms, and sprinkle evenly with the remaining shrimp paste. Bake, uncovered, for 20 minutes, and serve.

title: Whole Wheat Shrimp French Bread Toast
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked medium raw shrimp ( peeled and deveined ) | 1 medium onion ( roughly chopped ) | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chiles | 8 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Combine shrimp, onion, ancho chiles, and 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper in a bowl. Place bread on baking sheet and spray with non stick cooking spray. Spray bread with cooking spray and place in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes, turning once. Cook shrimp mixture in skillet until sauce is reduced and shrimp are pink and cooked through.

title: Tomato Rice Melt
ingredients: 4 tablespoons seasoned rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 3/4 cup chopped onion, divided | 4 english muffins, split
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the rice vinegar and minced onion. Stir to combine. Place 4 english muffin halves on a baking sheet. Spread with 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar mixture, then top with about 1/3 of tomato mixture and 1/3 of the onion mixture. Repeat with the remaining muffin halves and tomato mixture. Bake in a 400 degree f oven on the baking sheet for about 15 minutes, or until muffins are browned and soft.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,cream celery soup,sharp cheddar cheese,corn kernel,hard egg,tomato
title: Delicious Cheddar and Egg Casserole
ingredients: 4 eggs | 2 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can corn kernels, drained | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained | 2 medium cucumbers, peeled and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a bowl, beat eggs together well. Stir in soup and corn. Stir in cheese and tomatoes. Spoon into a well buttered 2 1/2 quart casserole dish. Cover and bake 45 to 55 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned.

title: Cilantro Pâté (Chermoula-Pate)
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces heavy cream | 8 egg yolks | cilantro stem
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Bring cream to a simmer, whisk well and cook until it is reduced to thickened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, whisk in yolks a little at a time until mixture is well blended. Stir in cilantro roots. Transfer to small bowl. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours before using. Let mixture stand at room temperature 30 minutes at room temperature. Serve with a sprinkling of paprika and freshly ground black pepper.

title: Rhubarb and Niblets Chunked Wheat with Mustard Butter
ingredients: 1/2 lb wheat chips ( about 3 1/2 ounce ) | 2 lbs rhubarb, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 4 serrano chilies, stemmed, seeded, and minced | 1/4 cup stone ground mustard | 1/4 cup wood chips
instructions: Soak and drain all of the grainy greens for up to 10 minutes. In a 2 - 4 quart saucepan over a moderate heat, melt the stone ground mustard in the canning jars and the chilies. Remove the mustard from the heat and allow to cool slightly. Put the wheat chips in a large bowl and pour on enough mustard to coat. Toss with the greens. Cover, set aside, and let sit at room temperature for 12 hours. Transfer to airtight jars. Canning tip, the stone ground mustard will form a paste. Some folks use a clean, clean, sterile pint jar.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,grain white rice,beef sirloin steak,hamburger,lard
title: Melt in Your Mouth Rice Steak
ingredients: 1 cup raw long-grain white rice | 6 -8 slices of fat-fed beef sirloin steak | 1/2 cup raw hamburger | 1/2 cup good-quality peanut butter | 1/2 cup lard
instructions: Place a large pot on the stove top and bring to a boil. Place rice in a bowl and mix with a tablespoon of lard. Slice meat across the grain into thin slices. Place some meat onto your serving dish and top with the rice. Continue with the rest of the meat until this meal is gone. Serve with a green salad and enjoy it.

title: Beer Mustard
ingredients: 1 cup dry red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Pour the vinegar into a glass bottle or mixing bowl. Add liquid smoke, stir, and chill until ready to use. Keeps well after aging 5 - 6 months. Great on mustard sandwiches before serving.

title: Mccormicks Steamed Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 3 serrano peppers
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a microwave safe dish with slated sides. Stir the rice gently with a fork, then remove the dish from the microwave and cover to keep warm. In a large casserole dish wilt the chilis for 2 - 3 minutes, until slightly softened. Drain water, then cover the bottom with rice with about 1/3 of the steamed chilis, then sprinkle wilt rice over the chilis. Return the covered dish to the microwave, cover and microwave on high for 8 minutes, then remove cover and fluff with a fork.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,tomato juice,mahi fillet,bow tie pasta,kalamata olive,vanilla,white breadcrumb,green lentil
title: Greek-Style Mahi Mahi with Browned Flatbread
ingredients: 2 ounces uncooked bow tie pasta | 2 tablespoons white breadcrumbs | 1 lb mahi mahi fillet | 1/4 cup green lentil | 1/4 cup kalamata olive | 3 tablespoons butter | 8 ounces tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | french bread or focaccia bread
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: italian herb,scallion,white rice,thyme sprig,prawn,cherry tomato,peanut oil,plain flour
title: Prawns With Cherry Tomatoes, Thyme and Peanut Crisps
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white rice | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 4 scallions, trimmed, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 teaspoons peanut oil | 1 1/2 lbs prawns, shelled and deveined, tails removed | fresh herb ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling salted water, uncovered, for 15 minutes, until just tender. Drain. Place the flour and tomatoes in a medium bowl, season to taste with saltand pepper. Add the scallions and thyme. Stir to combine. Heat a large, non stick frying pan until hot. Add the oil and swirl to coat the pan. Add the prawns, in batches, and cook, turning over the prawns with tongs, for 5 minutes or until they are cooked through, but still pink. Add the toasted rice and tomatoes and toss to combine. Spoon the prawn mixture into a warmed serving bowl, sprinkle with herb and serve.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,vanilla essence,vegetable oil cooking spray,salsa
title: Red Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 red bell pepper, cut into strips | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce salsa | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce vanilla essence
instructions: Spray a non stick frying pan with the veggie oil.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,plum tomato,dijon mustard,gingerroot,pineapple chunk,cardamom seed,jicama,garlic clove
title: Grilled Jicama With Pineapple, Tomatoes and Dijon Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh jicama, peeled, cut on an angle into 1/4 inch slices | 6 -8 plum tomatoes, cut into thin wedges | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, peeled | 1 tablespoon all purpose dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon dried cardamom seed ( or a few pinches of ground cardamom ) | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 3/4 cups pineapple chunks, drained, juice reserved ( about one 15-ounce can )
instructions: Heat grill to high. Arrange jicama in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish and grill, turning once, until lightly charred on all sides, about 4 minutes total. Scoop out and discard any remaining juices. Meanwhile, to make glaze, combine the ginger, mustard, cardamom, seasoning salt and reserved pineapple juice in a large bowl. Toss gently with the jicama to coat. Keep warm. To serve, place 1 or 2 tablespoons of the glaze on each plate and spoon it alongside. Drizzle each plate with reserved pineapple juice.

title: Currant Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup currants | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon grenadine
instructions: Place currants in 3/4 cup measure. Add mustard power and grenadine. Cover and shake until currants are covered with juice. Let sit at room temp until currants are soft. If necessary, add up to 1/4 c water. Serve over hot cooked pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: corn flake,green pepper,green chilies,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs monterey jack pepper cheese, divided ( about 4 slices for dipping ) | 3 cans diced green chilies | 1 jar sweet corn flakes | 1 package mild green peppers, chopped
instructions: Place chilies and corn flakes in a food processor. Pulse to mix well. Grease a 2 quart baking dish. Place cheese on top of chilies. Pour chilies and corn flakes on top. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 325 degree f oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and pour remaining cheese on top. Place dish on a baking sheet and bake uncovered for 15 more minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Vietnamese Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 package ground chuck | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 cup french bread | 1 mango, sliced ( optional ) | 1 carrot, chopped | 2 cups prepared pizza sauce
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium high heat. Lightly oil grill grate and lightly dust with flour. Form ground chuck into 4 patties. Grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side. Remove from heat. In a large bowl, mix taco sauce, fish sauce, and french bread. Place meat patties on a lightly greased grill pan, and grill for about 5 - 6 minutes per side, until cooked. Divide the steak burgers among warm dinner plates. Top with mango and carrot. Serve with pizza sauce.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,trout,grain brown rice,mango chutney,vinegar,pasta sauce,green chili salsa
title: Trout and Brown Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon mango chutney ( not the sweet variety ) | 1 -2 tablespoon vinegar ( balsamic vinegar ) | 1 can chopped green chili salsa ( mild or spicy ) | 4 cups cooked medium grain brown rice, cooled | 1 1/2 cups cooked trout, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 12 ounces cooked spiral pasta, warmed
instructions: Whisk together the malt vinegar, chutney, and balsamic vinegar in a small bowl. Set aside. Cook the rice in a large saucepan of boiling water until just tender in the centre, stirring gently. Drain well. Place the rice, trout, and pasta in the bowl with the vinaigrette, pour over the salad, and toss to mix. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: pink grapefruit juice,bean,white flour,pineapple,rose water,chicken base,buttermilk
title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 cup white flour | 1/2 cup low-fat buttermilk ( such as panko ) | 1/2 teaspoon chicken base | 1/2 teaspoon rose water | 1/2 cup fresh pineapple, peeled, seeded and diced | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 1 -2 tablespoon pink grapefruit juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. Whisk the flour, buttermilk, and chicken base together in a bowl. Stir in the pineapple, refried beans, and grapefruit juice. Pour into a 1 quart baking dish or other 8x8 pan. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let stand for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Arepas
ingredients: vegetable shortening or lard, for frying | 12 fluid ounces beer
instructions: Heat lard in large heavy skillet and fry 1 or 2 a few at a time, stirring constantly, until color changes and foam rises to surface. Add beer and boil briskly, stirring frequently, until lard is lard is reduced to about 12 fluid ounces. Drop batter at once into fat. Cook over moderately low heat until the edges are light brown. Turn batter over and fry on other side. Drain on paper towels and serve hot. Keeps up to 1 month. To serve, spread on warmed platter and drizzle beer around it.

title: Chilled Chicken Liver Pate (Australia)
ingredients: 8 fluid ounces chicken livers, thoroughly washed and trimmed | 1 ounce walnuts, finely chopped | 2 1/2 ounces mild cheddar cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Put the livers into a bowl and add the walnuts and half the cheese. Stir until the walnuts are finely chopped and combined. Spoon into 2 heatproof glasses and add the chicken livers in the centre. Pour the golden syrup over the top and use to sandwich the pate. Refrigerate for 15 - 20 minutes before serving to give it a chance to set.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,chicken broth,mango chutney,red pepper flake,black eyed pea,almond,chicken bouillon
title: Crazy Good Low Fat One Pot Smoothing Juice
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb stewing beef | 1 1/4 cups canned black-eyed peas, drained | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/2 - 1 cup chicken bouillon | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | chunky mango chutney, to top if you wish | 1/2 cup slivered almonds, lightly toasted to garnish or 1/2 cup slivered toasted pine nuts, to garnish
instructions: Spray crockpot with cooking spray. Put broth, spices, and pepper in crockpot and stir to combine. Put stewing beef over the top. Add the rest of the ingredients. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours. Serve over noodles or rice.

Random Ingredients: baking powder,red pepper flake,food coloring,chipotle chile,jumbo shrimp,shell pasta,chicken thigh
title: Shrimp Filler With Chipotle Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 lb medium shell pasta or 1/2 lb linguine, cooked | 4 chicken thighs, skinless, boneless and cut in bite sized chunks | 12 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined with tails left on | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 6 roasted red peppers ( canned chipotle chiles in adobo or adobo sauce ) | 3/4 - ¾ cup chipotle chile, roughly chopped | food coloring | red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine all contents of the 1/2 lb. Package of shrimp fryer. Set on high, then reduce to medium. Heat oven to 425 degrees f. Cook the shrimp for 3 - 4 minutes, until they just turn pink.

title: Cucumber and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 cucumber | 4 cups chicken broth
instructions: Cut all the vegetables into small cubes. Heat the butter in a large saucepan or pan over medium heat for 1 minute. Add the vegetables, and cook for 3 minutes. Pour the soup into bowls, and stir to mix well. Garnish with croutons, parsley, salt, or coriander. Makes about 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: chive,white onion,green chili pepper,garlic salt,vanilla,orange marmalade
title: Green Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 white onion, chopped fine | 1/2 green chili pepper, chopped | 1 cup orange marmalade ( may use a good peach or cherry brand ) | 1 tablespoon chives, minced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Mix together white onion, green chili pepper, and marmalade in a bowl. Add garlic salt and vanilla & stir til smooth. Chill several hours till flavors develop. Serve over salad greens.

title: Grilled Sirloin Steak
ingredients: salt pepper | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Score the top part of the steak with a knife in a diamond pattern and place on a piece of aluminum foil. Rub with the vinegar and salt over. Leave to stand for a few hours for the vinegar to settle up. The meat can be cooked on the grill over medium hot coals.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,habanero hot sauce,lemon pepper,black bean,pork belly,green onion,baby spinach leaf,fennel seed
title: Black Bean and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 2 packages baby spinach leaves | 1 pound pork belly | 2 green onions, sliced | 3 tablespoons italian-style seasoning | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed, or to taste | 1 small habanero hot sauce, or to taste
instructions: Combine black bean and spinach in a bowl. Place pork belly in a large skillet over medium high heat, and sear until well browned on all sides, about 15 minutes. Remove pork belly from skillet, reserving drippings, and pour enough drippings into the skillet to come 1/2 inch up the side of the meat. Stir in onions, italian style seasoning, lemon pepper, and fennel seed. Cook and stir until onions are lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in habanero sauce, and cook and stir until heated through, about 3 minutes. Allow to cool to room temperature.

title: Mama's Easy Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 large yellow onion, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Once the water is boiling, stir in the spaghetti sauce, and return to a boil. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pandan leaf,sea scallop,ketjap manis,chocolate syrup,thyme sprig,baking potato,sesame oil,asiago cheese

instructions: Make the glaze melt the ketchup in a small saucepan over medium heat. Remove from heat and stir in the oil, honey, thyme, baking potato, cheese and anchovies. Transfer to a small bowl.

title: Pan-Fried Pork Tenderloins

instructions: Pour 1/4 cup of the stock over the tenderloins.

title: Turnips With Oranges, Oranges and Peanuts

instructions: Peel the turnips then grate coarsely on the zest from the orange peel. Cook or steam the turnips for about 5 - 10 minutes. title: Mock Meatballs
ingredients: 1/4 cup lentils | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 cup milk | 1 lb ground sirloin | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Place drained and rinsed lentils in medium saucepan. Cover with cold water.

title: Thai Squash Burger
ingredients: 1/2 cup walnut halves | 4 hamburger | 5 ounces white mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs butternut squash, peeled, seeded | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon japanese soy sauce | 3 cups cold water
instructions: Toast walnut halves, set aside. Brown hamburger with mushrooms.

title: Irish Cod Casserole With Crunchy Colcannon #RSC
ingredients: 500 g frozen cod fillets, thawed | 175 g wild mushrooms, sliced | 150 g fresh raspberries or 150 g frozen raspberries | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 cup orange zest | 150 g cabbage ( or any other seasonal vegetables you like ) | 4 sheets arugula rind pasta | 150 g dark bittersweet chocolate shavings
instructions: Place oven rack in middle of oven and preheat grill to medium hot. Lightly oil a 2l ovenproof casserole dish and line with aluminum foil. Add the golden syrup, orange zest, sugar and 100g of wild salad vegetables. Toss until well combined. Spoon half of the mixture into the casserole dish and arrange half of the arugula over the top. Top with remaining mixture and scatter with dark cocoa powder. Bake for 45 50mins until top is golden and crispy. Serve immediately.

title: Clams in Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 kg baby clams in tomato sauce | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | salt & pepper ( lots of pepper to season )
instructions: Add tomato sauce and salt& pepper. Simmer for 5 or 20 minutes. Serve with pasta, parmesan cheese, or your favourite pasta sauce.

title: Simple Asparagus and Carrot Salad
ingredients: 2 packages frozen green asparagus | 1 package matchstick sliced carrots
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the frozen asparagus, and cook for about 5 minutes. Remove the vegetables with a slotted spoon, and set aside. Pour the vegetables into a bowl, and place the matchstick sliced carrots around them. Drain the vegetables, and mix with the asparagus and carrots. You can serve immediately, or store, or refrigerate until serving.

title: Old Fashioned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 2 lbs of cheap brisket ( brisket should be completely sealed. drying is a no ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Take brisket and rub with baking soda and smoke. Put a towel in a large roasting pan. Put a weight on top. Place over the burner in your roasting pan. Roast in the oven at 225 degrees celcius for 5 - 6 hours or in your slow oven for up to 12 hours. The last two hours turn the brisket from time to time. Remove from pan when you can. Cut meat in about 12 slices across width. The amount in the book is one big slice of brisket. Some might want to halve it if you wish.

title: Candy Cane Nuts
ingredients: 2 3/4 cups quick-cooking oats | 2 1/4 cups chocolate syrup | 2 cups oil for frying
instructions: Combine 2 3/4 cups of oats and 2 1/4 cups of chocolate syrup in a bowl and allow to stand for 15 minutes, stirring oat mixture occasionally. Heat oil to 375 degrees f. Dip each oat cake piece into the oat mixture and fry until lightly golden.

title: Spiced Round Steak
ingredients: 2 tablespoons brown rice | 2 steaks ( cut into serving size pieces ) | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 1 teaspoon shallot ( minced ) | 1 small tart apple ( finely diced ) | 1 cup green onion ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup sweet potato
instructions: Cook brown rice until tender, drain. Cook steaks until done, add all other ingredients except sweet potato. Simmer for 5 minutes, or until potatoes are cooked. Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: raspberry jam,walnut,ghee butter,garlic butter,sunflower seed,bisquick baking mix,confectioner sugar,active yeast
title: Raspberry-Spice Crumb Torte
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups bisquick baking mix | 3 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 package active dry yeast | 1/4 cup warm sunflower seeds | 1/3 cup melted butter | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 1/3 cup pistachios | 1/2 cup raspberry jam
instructions: Dissolve 1 teaspoon yeast in warm water and allow to proof until foamy, about 10 minutes. Combine Bisquick mix, 2 tablespoons melted butter, and 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar in a large bowl. Mix together dry ingredients.

title: Indian Mutton Balls
ingredients: 2 lbs mutton | 5 ounces chives | 1 ounce oats | 12 ounces italian sausage | 2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Cook the mutton. Add the rest of dry ingredients except chives during the last five minutes. Roll into small balls roll in the chives. Dip into catsup and fry until golden brown or serve.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,cheese,chicken soup base,arborio rice,white vinegar,vegetable oil
title: Easy Chicken and Cheese Empanadas
ingredients: 2 cups dry arborio rice or 2 cups carnaroli rice | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 4 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon instant chicken soup base | 4 cups hot cooked chicken and cheese filling | 16 -20 sheets frozen puff pastry ( thawed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375º f. Prepare rice according to directions, using broth or water. Remove from heat and stir in oil, vinegar and soup base until fully incorporated. Place rice mixture in a medium bowl. Cut each pastry sheet into 8 equal squares. On each square, place 1/8 cup of the filling, forming a 1/4 cup circle. Brush each empanada with some of the reserved rice mixture. Fold pastry in half diagonally and press edges firmly together so that filling will not stick to pastry. Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake for 10 - 15 minutes until pastry is puffed and golden.

title: Cheat's Full-Flavoured Sausages and Asparagus
ingredients: 300 g shortcrust pastry | 1 tablespoon ghee | 1 1/4 kg sausages | 1 large tomatoes, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon orange rind | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 tablespoons sweet pickled ginger, finely chopped
instructions: First make the puff pastry. To pastry dough, roll out enough pastry to fit a large baking tray, and flour lightly. Cut a small slit along the length of the pastry and place sausages on it. Cover the sausages with another pastry sheet and using fingers, roll up all 8 sausages, tucking it under. Press pastry around the edges to seal. Lightly brush the pastry with oil and sprinkle with more baking sugar. Bake in a moderate oven for approximately 20 minutes, basting once with more oil.. Meanwhile, make the sauce. Boil 2 cups of water and add orange rind, tomato puree and pickles. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until thick. While simmering, place remaining pastry on a board, tear off 1 large piece of pastry on it, roll out to a thickness of 7 mm. Spread over the sausage mixture and sprinkle it with ginger. Fold over pastry and roll out again. Seal the edges in the pastry with a fork and bake in a moderate oven for approximately 15 minutes, or until golden and cooked. Serve sausages on a hot platter. Serve pasta with gravy drizzled over top.

title: Apple Jam
ingredients: 6 tart apples, peeled and thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1 teaspoon monosodium glutamate ( optional )
instructions: Put apples into a medium size pot and rub cheese over them. Add monosodium glutamate, if using. You may need a little water so that your ham falls off the apples easily. Cook, covered, over low heat for about an hour or until apples are tender. Remove from heat. When ready to use, pour into an earthenware bowl and store in the refrigerator.

title: Yummy Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti or 1 lb linguine | 1 beef bouillon cube ( i usually use knorr extra beef flavor ) | 4 ounces green chili ( chopped, i use jalapeno, not canned ) | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: In a medium sauce pan, heat bouillon cubes and green chili until heated through. In a separate pot, cook spaghetti. Drain, then add to skillet. Now, sauté chopped pepper for about 5 minutes in some olive oil. Remove from heat and stir in spices. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,cider vinegar,dark soy sauce,dark brown sugar,liquid smoke,green onion,broiler fryer chicken
title: Chicken Adobo
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens, cut up | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2 green onions, thinly sliced | celery salt to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a large slow cooker. Add chicken just to coat, then cook on high for 3 1/2 hours, then reduce temperature. Turn control to low, and leave for 12 to 14 hours. Remove chicken from slow cooker, reserving juices and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,cumin seed,chili pepper,rum,oyster,simple syrup,cold water,mango
title: Mangalore Ginger Beer
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili pepper | 1/4 cup cumin seed | 1/2 cup ice cube, coarse | 1/2 cup cold water | 2 1/2 inches ginger | 1/2 cup coconut ( or mango sugar cube ) | 1 tablespoon simple syrup | 1/4 cup light rum or 1/4 cup brandy | 2 -4 cups ice cubes, chilled
instructions: Place ginger, chilli and cumin seeds in a mortar and pestle and smash into a fine paste with a sharp knife. Add all other ingredients and smash again with a knife. Add ice and continue to smash until mixture begins to separate from ice, about 5 minutes. The beer should be very thin. Transfer to a pitcher and add the ice cubes. Taste for sweetness, the acid balance should balance out sour flavor, you may need more or less rum. I use a blend of ginger beer and pineapple flavored ice cubes and it really is a matter of choice. If a thicker beer is desired, add more ice and enjoy.

title: Sherry Glaze
ingredients: 1 cup sherry wine | grated orange peel
instructions: Combine sherry and orange peel in a small bowl. Stir well. Pour glaze into a small, heavy saucepan. Cook over low heat until reduced to 1 cup.

Random Ingredients: radish,cardamom,brown rice,currant,turbinado sugar,bow tie pasta,deli roast beef,vegetable oil
title: Roasted Beef With Rice & Radishes
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups uncooked brown rice, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 1 1/4 lbs deli roast beef, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 package bow tie pasta | 1/3 cup dried currant | 6 large radishes, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Prepare brown rice according to package directions. Add sugar, oil, and cardamom. Add beef and pasta. Toss well. Transfer to a roasting pan to keep warm. Cover and bake about 40 minutes. Remove cover and bake for 10 more minutes. Mix currants into mixture. Continue baking, uncovered, for about 45 more minutes. Serve.

title: Barbecued Lamb
ingredients: 1 kg stewing lamb | 1 bell pepper ( red and green )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.

title: French Chicken Bagels
