instructions: Cut bagel in half lengthwise. Place one hand on breast and pound chicken breast into 1/4 inch thick slices. Place chicken in hot skillet. Sprinkle with seasoning salt. Cook 1 minute or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,pesto sauce,angostura bitter,plum tomato,sugar substitute,cayenne pepper sauce,kale
title: Easy Pesto Kale and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 3 bunches kale | 300 g plum tomatoes or 300 g cherry tomatoes | 1 teaspoon sugar substitute | 1 pinch cayenne pepper sauce | 1/8 teaspoon angostura bitters | 1 pinch plain flour | 50 g pesto sauce
instructions: Chop up the kale, and put into a large pot. Boil in water for only 3 - 4 minutes. Chop the tomatoes, and add to pan. Add seasonings, and cook for 6 - 7 minutes add the flour to thicken. Add pesto and cook for 2 - 3 minutes. Serve sprinkled with grated parmesan if desired.

Random Ingredients: half cream,chili sauce,farfalle pasta,lasagna noodle,tomato juice,sultana
title: Pasta with Sultanas and Cream
ingredients: 10 ounces lasagna noodles | 9 ounces frozen farfalle pasta | 2 cups half-and-half cream | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 2 tablespoons sultanas ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil over a medium heat. Add the farfalle and boil according to packet instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, heat half and half and chili sauce until hot. Add sultanas and tomato juice and mix together. Arrange half of the uncooked farfalle into the same pan and pour in the cream and sauce. Reduce heat to low and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, stirring until heated through.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,capsicum,chipotle chile adobo,white sesame seed,chili garlic sauce,garlic clove
title: Spicy Chilli Cabbage and Capsicum
ingredients: 1 medium cabbage | 1 teaspoon white sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped garlic clove | 1/4 cup cabbage, finely chopped | 1/4 cup mild chili-garlic sauce | 1 -3 chipotle chile in adobo, deseeded and finely chopped
instructions: Cut the end off of the cabbage and core it. Cut it into rounds about 2 and a half, removing the strong core. Separate the leaves from the stalks and then cut them into thin slices. Place all the ingredients in a microwaveable bowl and heat on full power for 1 minute and then microwave for 20 second or until the liquid has nearly evaporated, tossing the contents of the bowl occasionally. To serve, put a lid on the bowl and quickly place the bowl in a pile on a plate. Serve with sesame seeds, salsa or other condiments. Variation, this recipe can also be cooked in a very lightly oiled pan or on a foreman type grill. For a crunchier cabbage, heat 1 teaspoon of chili garlic sauce in a frying pan over very low heat, then stir in the chilli garlic paste. Continue to stir the mixture until it is heated throgh. This would actually taste better if the mixture was a little thinner. Alternatively, mix 1 clove of crushed garlic and 1/4 teaspoon of salt with the cabbage. If you are adding the chilli sauce, cook until the garlic begins to soften. This will take no longer than a couple of minutes.

title: Codfish Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces smoked fish fillet | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cracked salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 pinch cocoa | 2 ounces cheddar cheese, diced | 1 tablespoon unsweetened parmigiano, grated
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the fish, hot sauce, salt, ginger, cocoa, cheese and parmigiano.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,clove,parmesan cheese,irish whiskey,hot chili sauce,baby spinach,apricot
title: Sticky Apricot and Spinach Salad With Whiskey & Apricot Churros
ingredients: 350 g baby spinach, roughly chopped | 150 g apricots, roughly chopped | 50 g roasted pine nuts, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon dried clove | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey ( optional ) | hot chili sauce, to serve
instructions: Heat a small saucepan on the stove top, then add the chopped fresh apricots and pine nuts. Turn the heat to medium and toast the pine nuts on each side until light golden and beginning to crisp. Set aside when cool. Wash the spinach well under cold water and allow to stand for a few minutes. Drain well and put in a salad bowl. Add the chopped apricot and pine nuts to the chopped spinach and mix gently. Stir in the dried clove, then divide between 4 serving plates. Sprinkle the cheese over top and drizzle with whiskey, if using. Serve immediately with the hot chili sauce. This is lovely served the next day.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive oil,canola oil,teriyaki sauce,cachaca,broiler fryer chicken,molasses,wine vinegar
title: Beer Can Chicken Frites With Molasses
ingredients: 3 cups light red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup molasses | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce or 1/4 cup your favourite sauce, sauce | 1 cup spanish olives oil | 1 canola oil | 3 lbs broiler-fryer chickens, cut up ( preferably with legs attached ) | 1/2 cup canola oil ( for brushing ) | 1/4 cup canola oil ( for brushing ) | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 tablespoon dark-wine vinegar | 3/4 cup cayaca, sauce
instructions: Marinate the chicken,. Combine all the ingredients for the marinade, including the olives and oil. Arrange the chicken pieces on a large piece of greased aluminum foil. Spoon two tablespoons of the molasses mixture over each piece. Fold the ends of the foil together and crimp with a fork to secure. Bake the chicken,. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Line the canning jars with rings of paper, and put them in the oven. After 12 minutes, release each packet. Turn the oven off, open the jars and place on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes and carefully pour 3/4 cup water into a small pot in the oven. This will keep the oven warm. In a large frying pan, heat 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil over medium high heat. Add the chicken pieces and brown thoroughly. When done, transfer the chicken pieces into a bowl lined with paper towel and coat with the dark wine vinegar. Set aside. Remove all but 2 tablespoons of the oil from the pan before the chicken is done. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of canola oil and swirl to coat the pan. Add the olives and sauté 3 minutes. Drain the chicken, reserving the marinade. Add it back into the pan. Add the remaining marinade liquid, cover the pan and simmer for 20 minutes, or till chicken is soft and cooked through. The liquid will keep the chicken moist and will help the sauce permeate the chicken and prevent the pan from burning or sticking to the chicken. Turn off the heat. When the chicken is done, it can be placed on a platter and kept warm, covered. Remove the foil, wipe the jars clean with paper towels and heat them back to low heat. Place a small piece of chicken on each warmed paper towel. Spoon about 1/3 cup of the sauce over each chicken piece, then stir to incorporate. Put the finished chicken onto a platter, sprinkle both sides with the cayaca sauce, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Easy BBQ Bread Machine Beer Can
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 cup beer ( any brand ) | 1 teaspoon barbecue sauce, hot or your favourite
instructions: Add your favorite ingredients to the bread pan in the order listed in your yeast package. Use the bread pan, and place in the oven for 90 minutes. Remove bread from oven and allow to cool to room temperature. Serve warm with some barbeque sauce on the side.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,soba noodle buckwheat wheat spaghetti,marjoram,salt water,vinegar,almond paste,cold water,panko breadcrumb
title: Mae's Real Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces soba noodles or 8 ounces buckwheat wheat spaghetti | 3/4 cup cold water | 1 1/2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( don't use iodized salt ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram, crushed | 2 teaspoons almond paste | 3/4 cup ketchup | 1 1/4 cups panko breadcrumbs | salt water
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook soba for 8 to 10 minutes, drain and cool under cold running water. Break into bite sized pieces. In a large bowl, combine water, vinegar, salt, marjoram and almond paste, mix well. Stir in soba pieces until well mixed. Gradually stir in ketchup. Gradually stir in panko crumbs. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

title: Homemade Taco Meat
ingredients: 3/4 lb ground beef or 3/4 lb ground turkey | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 cups stock
instructions: Mix everything together well and let sit overnight. Cook on the grill with the lid on until browned. Serve over rice or burritos.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,red lentil,pizza sauce,pork chop,savory,irish cream,sage leaf,milk chocolate
title: Chocolate Braised Pork Chops
ingredients: 6 pork chops | 2 cups red lentils ( or green ) | 1 1/2 cups pizza sauce | 1 cup irish cream ( or other light dessert cream ) | 1 tablespoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon dried savory | 10 -15 rosemary branches ( or fresh sage leaves, or other herb of choice ) | 1 milk chocolate, shavings
instructions: Rinse the red lentils, and place in a large bowl. Add the pork chops in a single layer across the bottom of the dish. Add the pizza sauce mix, cinnamon, sage, and savory, and mix well. Cover the pork chops with sauce. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge. Allow to marinate for at least an hour or two. Remove the plastic wrap from the refrigerator, and remove the pork chops from the sauce, reserving the sauce. Rinse the pot from the sauce, and return the pork, dipping into the sauce, until covered. Sprinkle with shaved milk chocolate and set on the side. Cover and bake in a preheated 160f oven for 20 minutes.

title: Guisado De Beef Mole
ingredients: 1 flank steak | 8 serrano chilies, minced | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Place steak, chiles, and cocoa in a slow cooker. In a small bowl, dissolve beef bouillon cube in liqueur. Pour into slow cooker. Cook on high for 1 hour. Shred meat and serve.

Random Ingredients: shallot,white wine vinegar,chicken thigh,italian breadcrumb,asafoetida powder,vanilla,lemon zest
title: Spiced Vinegar Chicken

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Place chicken thighs on a plate, and coat with a bit of pincamole. Sprinkle 1t white wine vinegar over the chicken, then sprinkle with minced garlic, shallots, lemon zest, aioli, and vanilla. Marinate at least one hour. Roll chicken in bread crumbs, and arrange on a baking sheet, or in a roasting pan sprayed with oil. Bake until lightly browned throughout, 25 - 30 minutes.

title: Mujadarra
ingredients: 500 g long grain white rice | vegetable sticks ( kabocha )
instructions: Wash rice thoroughly in several changes of water. Place rice in a colander and rinse with cold water. Place rice on a wooden board covered with wetted water. Wrap kabocha around the rice, starting at the thicker end, and rolling into a cylinder. Place seam side down on a plate. Repeat until all of the kabocha has been rolled. Place the rice balls on steaming steamer tray in a thick layer, in a large saucepan half full of water. Cover, and bring to the boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Serve hot with chopped fresh vegetables or chopped nuts as an accompaniment.

title: Kaisersalat
ingredients: 350 g sauerkraut | 250 g farfalle pasta | 50 g walnuts | 1 pinch nutmeg
instructions: Fry the walnuts and nutmeg in 1 tbs butter with olive oil. Put the farfalle in with the walnuts and fry until slightly browned.

title: Nigella's French Dip Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/3 lbs ground chuck | 1/2 teaspooon nigella seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 4 teaspoons ground maggi seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon table salt | 3 ounces water chestnuts, drained and sliced | chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Preheat the broiler. In a large skillet over medium high heat add the ground beef. Cook, stirring until the beef is browned, about 5 minutes. Drain off grease. In a food processor process the cinnamon, nigella seeds, salt, maggi seasoning, and water chestnuts until fine crumbs form. Stir in the ground meat mixture and stir until mixture is mixed well. Scoop mixture onto a broiler pan and spread evenly. Broil in the preheated oven, about 12 minutes, until dip is bubbly and brown. Serve warm, garnished with chopped of fresh mint if desired.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,ketjap manis,pork loin chop,baking potato,caribbean jerk seasoning,onion powder,grape tomato,brown lentil
title: Sate Bread
ingredients: 3 sweet baking potatoes | 2 cups dry brown lentils, rinsed | 3 -4 cups cooked basmati rice, rinsed | 1 can pork loin chops, chopped | 1 tablespoon caribbean jerk seasoning | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 - 1 1/4 cup fresh grape tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Cut sweet potatoes into cubes and place in a dutch oven. Add 1 cup of water to cover. Place on high and bring to a boil. Turn heat to medium high and cook for about 40 minutes. Add lentils and rice and cover for another 20 minutes. Add chili powder, jerk seasoning and onion powder and cook another 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove bones from pork chops and chop into 1/2 cubes. Place meat and vegetables in a bread bowl with a dampened cloth to hold for later. Spoon meat mixture into bread bowl and top with tomatoes. This goes together making it lo chik. I use my hands for this process. It took me at least 20 minutes to reach a nice crispy crust.

title: Chocolate Fingers
ingredients: 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 1 jar chocolate melts | 2 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Stir butter or margarine, cocoa, and chocolate until smooth. Add graham cracker crumbs after melted. Spread onto an ungreased cookie. Press out into a thin, even circle, about 1/8. Cut with a serrated knife. Cook in a 300 degree f oven until the edges begin to brown. Let cool a few seconds, then cut diagonally into fingers.

title: Simple Steak Sauce
ingredients: vegetable oil | 1 cup beef stock ( or any type of stock ) or 1 cup stock ( or any type of stock )
instructions: Heat oil in heavy frying pan on medium, adding beef to pan. Brown both sides of the steaks. Remove steaks and keep warm in oven. If using stock add a little water, mix together and serve.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese (With Sage)
ingredients: 3 lbs ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons mixed herbs ( mixed herbs, fresh herb like rosemary, oregano and mint ) | 3 tablespoons flour | 2 ounces triple sec
instructions: Mix your choice of herbs, the herbs, the flour, the triple sec. Beat the cheese to form well mixed, smooth & creamy consistency. If using fresh herbs, make sure the herbs are fresh & well distributed. Place the cheese in a cloth lined colander and gently push the cheese through the cloth, then press out the air bubbles. Do not touch the cheese to make sure it is completely covered in flour. Let cheese drain for 12 hours or longer. The cheese needs to absorb the flavours of the herbs, but it does not need to lose its moisture. Use immediately or store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. To use, rinse the cheese well or use for bread filling. If using frozen cheeses, cover in plastic wrap before using. Bake on a pizza stone as you see fit or on a cookie sheet in oven.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,salsa,lemon zest,brown onion,red kidney bean,whipping cream
title: Spicy Red Beans
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced brown onion | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest ( or lemon zest finely grated ) | 1 can red kidney beans, drained ( cannellini beans ) | 1/4 cup thick & chunky salsa | 1/8 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: In a non stick skillet, cook the onion & zest over high heat until the onion is just softened. Do not brown them. Add the beans, salsa & ras el hanout. Reduce heat to medium, cover & simmer, stirring occasionally, until the onion is soft. Spoon the beans and mixture into an ovenproof bowl & bake, uncovered, at c for 20 minute. Remove & let stand 1 minute before serving with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: walnut,green cardamom pod,yellow squash,salt water,mint leaf,anise seed
title: Khichadi
ingredients: 4 green cardamom pods | 5 walnut pieces, chopped | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 1/2 yellow squash, peeled, halved and cubed | 1 tablespoon salt water | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Place the cardamom pods and walnuts in a medium saucepan and toast over medium high heat, stirring, until the nuts are lightly browned and slightly crisp. Remove the cardamom pods and walnut pieces from the heat and set aside. Toast anise pods in a dry small skillet over medium heat, shaking frequently, until fragrant and lightly carmelized. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. Heat the vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Toss the squash cubes with the salt into the oil, then cook, stirring frequently until golden brown on all sides and tender. Remove with a slotted spoon. Drain on paper towels and set aside. Reduce heat to low and stir in the mint leaves. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Tin Tofu
ingredients: 1 package noodles | 2 tablespoons ruby port ( or more ) | 1 cup watercress, finely chopped
instructions: Wash the noodles and cook in boiling water with the port and watercress over moderately low heat, stirring until cooked, about 2 minutes.

title: Saffron Scented Dressing
ingredients: 1 pinch saffron threads, crumbled | 1 teaspoon hot red wine vinegar | 1 small pinch of cumin | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Place saffron in a small bowl with warm water. Stir and set aside. Bring vinegar and cumin to a boil in a small saucepan. Remove from heat. Drain saffron, reserving 1/4 cup of the drippings. Add saffron to vinegar and stir. Stir in syrup. Pour back into pan and bring to a boil over low heat.

title: Asparagus and Mocha Burritos
ingredients: 3 bunches spring onions, chopped | 1 jar hot coffee | 8 ounces low-fat mexican cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh asparagus | 1 lettuce, shredded
instructions: Chop spring onion coarsely. Toast burritos on both sides on both sides in toaster oven until lightly browned. Set aside and keep warm. Toast beans, rice or pasta lightly. Combine all ingredients.

title: Fast and Easy Authentic Chinese Garlic Soup
ingredients: 6 -8 cloves garlic paste | 3 cups washed cold water | 3 lbs new potatoes, washed and chopped ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons uncooked long grain rice
instructions: Add the garlic paste and the cold water to a large pot.. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then turn down the heat. Leave the garlic paste covered, and simmer very slowly for 30 to 45 minutes to an hour, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 300 degrees and bring 4 cups water to the boil. Add the potatoes and reduce the heat to very low. Simmer slowly for 30 minutes. Do not stir the potatoes during the final 30 minutes. When all of the soup is cooked, remove the garlic paste from the soup and place it in a small bowl. Remove the garlic paste from the soup and stir in the rice. Return the reserved garlic paste to the soup and serve at once with bread.

title: Ethiopian Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cubed | 3 3/4 cups dried yeast or 3 3/4 cups white bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Prepare and bake meat and yeast as directed on package for 2 hours or until meat is tender. While still hot, place in a large bowl which has been covered with a towel and put in refrigerator until completely cooled or overnight. Pour off all the liquid that is left at bottom of bowl. Place meat into bowl, cover and put in refrigerator for 3 days or until all is cooled. After 3 days heat oven to 350°f. Remove meat from refrigerator and put into a large buttered roasting pan. Pour hot pan juices over meat. Cover tightly with foil. Cook in oven until meat is tender and crusty on top and meat is browned on top. About 1 - 2 hours. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cardamom if using. Let stand for 5 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: celery,black cumin seed,red chilies,prosciutto,pork shoulder,kidney bean,yoghurt,oregano
title: Ww 5 Points - Puerto Rican Pork and Kidney Bean Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yoghurt or 2 tablespoons sour cream, stirred before using | 1 can black beans | 1/2 teaspoon crushed black cumin seeds | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon celery, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red chilies ( to taste ) | 1 -2 small red chilies | 2 slices prosciutto or 2 slices monterey jack cheese, coarsely chopped | 1/4 lb boneless pork shoulder or 1/4 lb pork butt, thinly sliced
instructions: Soak beans in water over night. When ready to cook, boil in water with 1 tsp salt and other spices. Drain and place in bowl. Add yogurt and mix to coat. In a saucepan over medium high heat, saute chopped chilies, 1/2 tsp salt and the chopped garlic. Add pork slices and saute on both sides until crisp and dark. Place cooked beans in food processor with meat. Add sauted meat and any liquid. Blend till smooth. Serve hot.

title: Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup apricots, finely chopped | 1 cup tomato sauce, preferably home made or homemade
instructions: Fry apricots and let cool. Serve warm or refrigerate. Can be frozen for up to two months.

Random Ingredients: fish fillet,mustard powder,red pepper,chicken bouillon cube
title: Pickled Fish
ingredients: 32 ounces fish fillets, pieces | 3 1/2 tablespoons dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons dry crushed red pepper
instructions: Place fish in a bowl, coat with dry mustard powder and bouillon cube. Place pepper in center of the fish. Cover with plastic wrap or waxed paper and secure with toothpicks. Place in a shallow glass dish. Pour remaining ingredients around fish. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours, up to overnight.

title: Homemade Crumble
ingredients: 6 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 1/4 cup rosemary sprig | 2 1/2 cups fresh cranberries | 3/8 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Place the flour in a large bowl and make a well in the center. Add the rosemary, cranberries and cinnamon. Mix just until the ingredients are incorporated into a batter. Turn the batter out onto a pastry board, knead it a few times until it is pliable and can be seen from the edges. Return it to the work surface and divide it in half. Shape it into two balls, place on a sheet of waxed paper or plastic wrap and roll out to a 3/8 inch thickness. Cut into small 2 inch squares and place one on top of the other in a wide, shallow baking dish. Cover loosely and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Brush the croutons with about half of the melted butter and bake on the middle rack of the oven for 10 minutes. Immediately remove the croutons from the baking dish and place on a large serving platter.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,radish,taco seasoning mix,courgette,hamburger,chicken breast half,mirin,italian turkey sausage
title: Chicken, Avocado and Potato Tacos
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes, thinly sliced | 2 large courgettes, thinly sliced | 1 hamburger | 4 cooked turkey sausage | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 4 slices cooked hamburger | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet japanese cooking wine ) | radish, sliced
instructions: Heat 1 inch oil in a pan over medium high heat. Add potato, courgette and swiss meat. Fry for about 8 minutes or until almost crisp tender. Transfer to a bowl and let cool slightly. Meanwhile, heat remaining 1 inch oil to medium high heat. Add turkey sausage. Cook, stirring frequently until heated through. Add seasoning to skillet and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes to blend flavors. Add swiss meat mixture and cook about 1 minute or until heated through. Top with guacamole, diced tomatoes and pickled jalapenos. This goes well with chilled white rice or pasta.

title: Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, drained, reserving juice | 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Place pineapple slices in a bowl, reserving juice. Stir pineapple juice, pine nuts and basil into pineapple. Chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: mace,extra virgin olive oil,chicken meat,cognac,red chile pepper,yellow cake mix,sugar icing,shrimp
title: Chilli Prawns
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 2 pounds prawns, peeled and deveined | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 cup cognac | 1/8 cup chopped red chile pepper | 1 cup finely chopped and julienned fresh shrimp | 1/2 cup cold sugar icing, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with parchment paper. Spread the yellow cake mix into a large bowl. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the prawns and mace and saute for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until the prawns turn pink and opaque. Stir in cognac and chile and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and sprinkle with shrimp, sugar, and a few dabs of icing. Transfer to the prepared pan. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Chunky Pumpkin Seed Mash
ingredients: 2 medium green apples, diced ( about 1 lb ) | 1 large turnip, peeled and diced into 1 inch chunks ( about 8 oz ) | 1 medium leek, white part only, diced | 1 package shelled raw pumpkin seeds ( about 1 1/2 cups, with skins on ) | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil or 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 3/4 cup mayonnaise ( or a greek style mayo or miracle whip mayo ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup soy-free mayonnaise | 7 cups cooked rice or 7 cups cooked noodles
instructions: To make the Mash, bring a large pot of water to a boil, add the turnip, leek, pumpkin seeds and grapeseed oil and simmer until the turnip is barely tender, about 20 minutes. Add the mayonnaise and worcestershire sauce and simmer until reduced slightly, about 1 minute more. Add the soy/mayo and stir well. Remove the mash from the heat and let it cool slightly. Serve at once. To serve, transfer into a large bowl with some warm toast pieces for a complete meal. Add more bread pieces to suit your tastes. Variation, you can add a slice of tomato to the mash, and it is good to add sliced mushrooms.

title: Crunchy Lime Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Mix cream cheese, panko, and lime juice together with hands and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Roll parmesan mixture into 1 inch balls and place on a baking sheet that has been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake in the oven for 18 to 22 minutes or until slightly crispy. Serve warm or cool completely and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pepper sauce,hamburger,sherry wine vinegar,marshmallow,campbell tomato soup,galangal,lime wedge
title: Chinese Hamburgers and Gravy
ingredients: 500 g hamburger or 500 g steak | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 packet campbell tomato soup | 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated galangal | 5 teaspoons chili pepper sauce | 50 cm piece marshmallows | 3 lime wedges
instructions: Cut ham into cubes. Add to a pan with a splash of sherry vinegar and mix to combine. Add the condensed soup and galangal and stir fry until fragrant. Sieve mixture into a large bowl. Add marshmallows to soup and stir until creamy. Add to the soup and mix to coat. Add more water if necessary. Place meat under a hot grill and cook just until cooked through or you can leave the meat in if you can then grill it as desired.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,rum,bourbon whiskey,brown lentil,ice water,bell pepper,maple syrup,lemon juice zest
title: Lebanese Brown Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | ice water | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup bourbon whiskey | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( zest of one lemon ) | 1/4 teaspoon curry leaf ( dried ) | 2 teaspoons rum | bell pepper
instructions: Wash and drain lentils and rinse several times until water runs clear. Place in a medium pot and add ice water. Boil over medium high heat for approximately 20 minutes or until tender. Drain lentils and reserve liquid. In a bowl combine maple syrup, bourbon and maple syrup, lemon juice, curry leaves and rum. To serve, place lettuce leaves on plates and cover with desired amount of lentils and desired amount of sauce. Top with desired amount of bell pepper slices.

Random Ingredients: white wine,ritz cracker crumb,baby spinach leaf,cream,vidalia onion,pepper
title: Mashed Potatoes With Spinach and Onions
ingredients: 1 bag baby spinach leaves | 2 medium vidalia onions, sliced thin | 1/4 cup sour cream, lowfat is fine | 1/4 - 1/2 cup white wine ( optional ) | pepper, to taste | 2 cups ritz cracker crumbs
instructions: Blend everything together and press into a medium size saucepan. Cover and cook on high for about 10 minutes. Uncover and cook on medium high to medium high for about an additional 5 minutes or until potatoes are a toasted golden brown and liquid has evaporated. Take out of the heat and let sit for about 30 minutes. Serve and enjoy.

title: Tuscan Baked Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb cannellini beans | 3 tablespoons instant beef base | 8 ounces flounder fillets, cut into 2 inch lengths | orange zest, grated
instructions: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. Add the beans and cook for 8 minutes. Drain the beans, reserving some cooking liquid. Strain the beans, reserving the water, and add to the beans with the beef base. Simmer for 15 minutes, then add the fish. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until the fish flakes when tested with a fork. Arrange on a platter, sprinkle with orange zest and serve.

title: Korma (Home Made Ziti)
ingredients: 1 cup ziti pasta, medium | 2 bunches fresh thyme leaves or 2 bunches cilantro | 3 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano | 1 teaspoon anise | 1/2 teaspoon dried anise | 1/2 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves | 3 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Cook 1 1/2 cup ziti in a large pot of boiling salted water, stirring frequently until 'al dente'.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,orange juice zest,red wine vinegar,cream chicken soup,pre mozzarella cheese
title: Cavatelli Ala Doctaine
ingredients: 1 package pre-shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup orange juice or 1/4 cup juice, from the orange zest | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/3 cup whipping cream
instructions: Place the mozzarella in a 9x13 pan spread the cream on top sprinkle the cheese with the mozzarella salt and set aside. In a blender add all remaining ingredients until thoroughly mixed. Pour on top of cheese and stir gently. Cover with tin foil and bake 45 - 50 minutes in a 350 degree oven. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting and pouring the cream on top.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,red pepper flake,fish sauce,wooden skewer,white onion,yukon gold potato,saffron,italian seasoning
title: Faux Grilled Fish Kebabs
ingredients: 12 white onions | 2 pounds yukon gold potatoes, unpeeled and cubed | 1/2 cup watermelon, diced | 1/4 cup white onion, diced | 2 tablespoons dried italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons salt | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons fish sauce, or more to taste | 2 skewers, soaked in water, or more as needed
instructions: Place potato cubes and watermelon in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil.

title: Crunchy Breadsticks
ingredients: 2 - 3 1/2 ounces bread | peanut oil
instructions: Cut a 1 inch slice bread lengthwise and stretch a bit of the bread at a time around your finger to form a straight shape. Push the dough to your left and press a hole in each slice. Brush with a little oil or spread with a little peanut butter. Preheat a comal or griddle until very hot. Carefully lift the breadsticks out of the hot pan and cook one side for 1 minute until browned. Turn and cook about one side till done, then cook rest quickly and remove and repeat until all the breadsticks are cooked.

title: Easy Mexican Pork Ribs for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 8 -10 lbs country-style country-style pork ribs | 2 cans diced green chilies, drained, rinsed, and mashed | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a 4 or 5 quart slow cooker. Cover and cook on high for 3 1/2 hours or until pork is tender and well flavored. Remove pork from slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,cherry pie filling,green onion,sun tomato oil,catsup
title: Green Onion Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cherry pie filling, such as hunt's brand | 1 green onions or 3 scotch onions, sliced on the diagonal | 1 -2 teaspoon catsup | 2 green onions or 3 scallion tops, finely sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel, finely minced | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Serve at once.

title: Gramma's Homemade Tomato Cottage Cheese Crumble
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups graham wheat flour ( or whole-meal flour ) | 2 teaspoons tomato sauce | 1 1/4 cups chopped dried apricots or 1 1/4 cups canned apricots, drained | 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup dry parmesan-romano cheese, plus a little extra for sprinkling on top
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Mix the graham wheat flour, tomato sauce, apricots, crumbs and half of the parmesan cheese in a medium bowl. Transfer the mixture to a medium sized oven proof dish. Sprinkle the top with a little more parmesan cheese. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown and risen. Serve hot. Note, i like to mix and combine the ingredients for my cheese grinder, mixing until the texture resembles bread crumbs. You can also transfer dough to a large bowl, stirring, then press firmly with a spatula. It will sort of make a paste. If it's too dry, add more breadcrumbs. Let cool.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,almond extract,orange juice,chili oil,peel,shell pasta
title: Kiwifruit and Pear Macaroni
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked small shell pasta | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/3 cups kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1 -3 teaspoon orange extract | 1 kiwi fruit, sliced ( for garnishing )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. While it is still cooking, in a large serving bowl, combine orange juice, kiwifruit, almond extract, chili oil and orange extract. Stir to blend well and heat. Cook pasta in the boiling pasta water, stirring occasionally until it is al dente. Drain and divide into three portions. Toss with the syrup and top with sliced kiwifruit slices. Serve immediately.

title: Tangerines and Bean Snacks (Nigeria)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 300 g canned pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 6 tangerines | 4 tablespoons apple juice | 200 g cashews | 100 g roasted cashews
instructions: Wash and dry the tangerines thoroughly, removing all pith from the sides. Cut the ends off the tangerines, keeping them whole. Put the vanilla sugar into a mixing bowl and add the seeds and the tangerines. Toss to dissolve, then toss with the other ingredients. Cut the skins off the tangerines and put into the bowl. Juice the tangerines and then put aside for garnishing. Wash the beans and rinse well. Soak the cashews and put on a clean tea towel. Using a tea towel, pat dry the beans a little then transfer the bean water to the tea towel. Sprinkle the cashews in the bag once a day, shake a few times, then transfer back to the bag. After each day, shake the bag again then transfer back into the pot. On a clean tea towel, pat dry the beans once a day, shake a few times, then transfer to the tea towel. Sprinkle the cashews in a bag once a day, shake several times, then transfer back into the pot. Repeat these steps until all of the bean water is used up. Pour the bean juice into a pot and set it on a low heat. Let the liquid simmer for about 1 hour, then turn the heat down to its lowest setting and let the juice simmer for another 15 minutes, stirring often. When you hear the juice boiling, remove from heat and stir in the processed tangerines and the vanilla sugar. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,mandarin orange,edible flower,chunky salsa,beef stew meat,water,cumin,garlic tomato vinaigrette
title: Quick and Easy Southwestern Beef Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef stew meat, cut into thin strips | 8 ounces bottled chunky salsa | 1 package mandarin oranges | 8 cloves garlic tomato vinaigrette | 10 ounces water | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1/4 cup edible flower, chopped
instructions: Place beef and salsa in a crockpot and sprinkle with mandarin oranges. Slice the garlic into thin slices about the size of the mandarines and place on top of the beef. In a small bowl, whisk together vinaigrette and water. Spoon over beef and vegetables in crockpot. Sprinkle with cumin and white pepper. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: glutinous rice,aubergine,flat leaf parsley,bisquick mix,broccoli,sirloin,pineapple,almond extract
title: Beef Biscuits
ingredients: 350 g beef ( rib steak or sirloin ) | 2 tablespoons lard or 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 100 g raw sugar or 100 g raw raw honey | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 aubergines, sliced lengthways | 100 g broccoli, sliced | 350 g glutinous-rice | 375 g biscuits ( gluten-free mix ) | 1/2 cup chopped pineapple
instructions: Trim and cut beef into 2 1/2 3 slice each. Pound beef to a finely slice. Put beef, butter or lard in a large saucepan and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes. Add parsley, sugar, almond extract and aubergines and stir to combine. Stir over low heat for 3 minutes until beef is well coated. Remove from heat and set aside. Prepare rice by boiling it and adding 1 cup of water to it. Cook for 10 minutes or until rice is tender. Drain water from rice, add to beef mixture and mix evenly. Divide and shape beef mixture into rectangles, about 5 cm wide and 3 3/4 cm high each. Bake at 180°c/350°f/gas 6 for 15 minutes. When biscuits come out of the oven, cut each one into quarters. While still warm, pile rice on top and serve beef biscuit on top.

Random Ingredients: green olive,cake flour,yellow cake mix,clove,rice noodle,italian sausage,pinto bean,dark soy sauce
title: Sausage Pepperoni Stacks
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | 1 package yellow cake mix | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cinnamon | 1 cup chopped green olives | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 12 hot italian sausages, sliced thin, about 10 slices
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease 13x9 inch baking dish. Stir yellow cake mix, yellow cake mix, soy sauce, cloves and cinnamon together thoroughly. Stir pinto beans and olives into the mixture. Spoon mixture into the prepared baking dish. Arrange sausages over top of the cake mixture. Bake 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Asafoetida
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 ounce vodka | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon catsup | 1/8 teaspoon whole rock salt ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ginger, minced
instructions: Add all ingredients, mix well and pour into a small bottle. I have a few variations of this, for those who like more, use the krumkaker's base. Add more wine or a dash of honey. Add more ginger if desired. Pour into martini glasses.

Random Ingredients: nonfat yogurt,new potato,beef roast,celery,iceberg lettuce,mango chutney
title: Hot and Fresh Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 lb new potato, quartered and sliced | 1/2 lb fresh beef roast | 1/2 cup celery, diced | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/3 cup nonfat yogurt | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, julienned or shredded
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot except yogurt. Cover and cook on high 5 to 6 hours or on low 8 to 10 hours. Stir in yogurt just to warm and serve on a lettuce.

Random Ingredients: yeast,granny smith apple,steak,corn,red onion,chili paste,chicken breast
title: Finger Steak Gyros
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 cups of warm or warm homemade soy protein | 2 packages of quick-rising yeast | 1 medium sized steak | 4 -6 large granny smith apples ( or any sweet apples you like ) | 1 small red onion | 1 small green hot pepper | corn or hot red pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Heat a large skillet on the stove. Add 4 cups of the soy protein. Let it sit for a few minutes, then add your 2 - 3 cups of warm or warm. Add the yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes. Take out the krops. Add the remaining soy protein to the krops using 1/2 cup or 2 - 3 cups. Add the onions to the sauce. Cut the steak into bite sized pieces and add to soy mix. Add a few dashes of chili paste, if you wish. Add more chili. Add the peppers. Let it sit for 10 - 15 minutes. After 10 - 15 minutes, the sauce will have thickened and reduced. Turn up to 500°f and add all the krops to the krops. Stir until the sauce has started to coat them, then cover. After 5 - 7 minutes, the krops should be golden from the crust. Put the pan into a closed oven and let it cook for 15 minutes. Serve with rice, sour cream, guacamole, etc. If you like, try adding a little bit of cornbread crumbs into the bread. I like to add chopped up fresh cilantro.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,burrito flour tortilla,hot water,pistachio,pork loin
title: Pork Tortilla Bread
ingredients: 4 burrito-size flour tortillas | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 lb pork loin | 1 cup hot water | 1 package dry onion soup mix
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over moderate heat. Add 3 tablespoons of butter and spread it around the edges. Place the tortillas on an ungreased baking sheet, leaving them a few inches apart. Bake them in the hot skillet 3 minutes on each side, or until lightly browned. Turn them over and bake until a deep golden brown. Remove them from the heat. Cut the pork into slices that are 1/3 inch thick and place in a bowl. Add 1/3 cup hot water and 1 envelope of dry soup mix and toss well. Pour the pork mixture down the center of the tortillas. Roll up each tortilla. Secure with a tooth pick if desired. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Add the remaining 1/3 cup of hot water to the skillet. Place the 8 rolls on top of the hot water along with any slices from the loaf. Cook over moderately high heat until all the liquid in the skillet is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: thyme leaf,lamb,parsley flake,whipping cream,maple syrup,salad oil,mustard
title: Maple-Glazed Lamb
ingredients: 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes | 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon mustard | 1/2 teaspoon maple syrup | 1/2 cup lamb fat or 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, divided | 1 tablespoon salad oil
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a bowl and mix until mixed well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat until smoking. Drain the lamb pieces on paper towels. Meanwhile combine the maple glaze ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth and bubbly. Add lamb pieces, a little at a time, to the warm maple glaze and coat well. Place in a greased broiler pan and broil until cooked to your liking.

title: Tahini and Vegetables with a Hint of Russian
ingredients: 1 lb small fresh shiitake mushroom | 4 tablespoons vodka or 4 tablespoons vodka | 1 tablespoon tahini ( optional ) | 14 ounces courgettes, cut into small cubes
instructions: Rinse mushrooms and dry on paper towels, then remove the stems. Add all ingredients to a large saucepan, bring to a simmer. Cover and boil gently 7 minutes. Remove the cover and continue to boil until mushrooms are soft, about 10 minutes more. Taste and adjust seasoning. Divide among 4 plates, and serve. Note, vegetable juices can be frozen in resealable freezer bags for up to 5 months, resealable bags for up to a year.

title: Macaroni & Corn
ingredients: 32 ounces whole kernel corn | 16 ounces macaroni
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Rinse corn and drain, cook 3 - 4 minutes until almost fully cooked or until corn is crispy. While pasta is draining, combine corn, macaroni and sour cream in a microwavable bowl, microwave on high about 1 minute, stirring to mix. Serve in bowl.

title: Quick Pesto and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups mixed fresh vegetables | 1/3 cup pesto sauce, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Place mixed vegetables in a small saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until just crisp tender, about 10 minutes.

title: Smoked Salmon & Rice Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup low-fat rice | 2/3 cup water-packed artichoke heart | 1/3 cup smoked salmon | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Cook rice & artichokes until beginning to soften, about 2 minutes. Rinse rice with cold water until water runs clear.

Random Ingredients: mirin,coriander seed,soy sauce,liquid honey,dark rum,nonfat yogurt,parsley,celery rib
title: Creamy Dressing With Sweet Soy Sauce (Vegan)
ingredients: 3/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 3/4 cup mirin | 1/2 cup nonfat yogurt ( not fat-free ) | 2 tablespoons nonfat yogurt ( not fat-free ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh coriander seed | 1 tablespoon reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 tablespoon lime juice or 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 celery rib
instructions: Toss together all ingredients except the celery and celery in a medium bowl.

title: Cauliflower Pone
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, separated into small florets | 1 can of mincemeat | 1 can peas and beans | 3 tablespoons dry sherry or 3 tablespoons rice wine, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon chili without beans | 2 tablespoons irish cream or 2 tablespoons light cream | oil ( for shallow frying ) | cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Blanch cauliflower in boiling water for 3 minutes and then drain. In a large frying pan, heat oil over moderately low heat and add onion and meat. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, or until meat is nicely browned. Add mince, peas and beans. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Add sherry and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in cinnamon and if necessary, leave on a low heat or until mixture thickens slightly. Set aside to cool.

title: Simple Green Chile Fingers
ingredients: 1 large green chili, chopped very finely | 12 ladyfingers | 3 tablespoons fine dry breadcrumbs ( or 1 cup breadcrumbs mixed with 3 tbsp white breadcrumbs )
instructions: Mix the finely chopped chile and the ladyfingers in a shallow nonstick pan. Sprinkle the crumbs or bread crumbs over the top. Turn the fritters to coat them on all sides and press them lightly with a large spatula for about 2 minutess, or just till they are golden and moist, but not soggy. Serve immediately, or place in the freezer for later use and remove when needed.

title: Bengali Beetroot Salad
ingredients: 1 large aubergine | 5 medium dried cannellini beans ( or other large dried red beans ) | 1 tablespoon roasted fenugreek seeds | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated
instructions: Place the aubergines and beans in a steamer basket and simmer them until soft. Remove from the heat and let cool for 30 minutes. Remove the skin and devein them. Mix the cooked aubergines with the beans and fenugreek seeds. Mix in the grated lemon peel and serve.

Random Ingredients: double cream,zucchini,lemon extract,rose water,puff pastry,chili powder,pinto bean
title: Zucchini & Bean Tart (Mark Bittman)  (Bean Tarte Tarte Tatin)
ingredients: 8 ounces zucchini, about 1 2 inches in diameter | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rose water ( or 1 1/2 tsp. dried rosemary. ) | 2 tablespoons lemon extract ( can use fresh minced lemons for even sweeter flavor ) | 1/2 cup pinto beans, cooked and mashed ( can use vegetarian refried beans ) | 1/2 cup double cream, lightly whipped | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup puff pastry, defrosted for about 20 minutes to help thaw before rolling into 8 rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. Line the muffin tin cups with pastry rounds. Using the bottom of a glass, hollow out the pastry slightly. Remove all but a thin, approximately 2 inches of the bottom of the muffin tin, leaving in a 3 inch circle. Bake the pastry circles for 20 - 25 minutes or until the edges just begin to brown. Remove from oven and transfer the pastry rounds to wire rack to cool.. Meanwhile, start to make the sauce. If desired, mix the zucchini with the rosewater and lemon extract, stir well. Set aside. To assemble, put the bean mixture on top of the pastry circles and using a spoon, spread the bean mixture evenly over the bean mixture. In a small bowl, whisk together the cream, chili powder and a sprinkle of lemon juice. Spoon generous ammount of the cream mixture over the bean and zucchini mixture. Starting at the edge of the pastry sheet, roll up the pastry tightly around the filling. Using a sharp knife, cut into 12 slices. Serve warm. Note, prep and cooking times may vary according to different sizes and shape of puff pastry, so check for doneness before removing from muffin tin. This pie can be frozen at this point and stored in the refrigerator for up to 1 month. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,cranberry,rice wine,pistachio nut,cherry,grain white rice,cream tartar,lettuce
title: Cranberry Scented Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/8 cups quick-cooking medium grain white rice | 2 cups sour cream or 2 cups yogurt | 1/4 cup sour cream or 1/4 cup yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon rice wine | salt & freshly ground black pepper | lettuce | fresh cranberries or sultana
instructions: Bring 2 1/2 times the water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add rice and stir. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, covered, stirring often, until rice is just tender and opaque, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir sour cream, sour cream and tartar. Season with salt and pepper. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

title: Pan Fried Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin
instructions: Slice tenderloins crosswise 1/4 and open out the pocket. Trim away excess fat and any visible fat from the pork. Stuff the pork with the pork. Roll up the pockets tightly, securing with toothpicks. In a wok, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil over high heat. When a cube of bread browns in 50 seconds, toss the pork tenderloin into the oil. Remove, drain off all oil left in the pot, and pat it dry with paper towels. Cook about 5 minutes, turning over the pork halfway through to brown all sides. Drain on paper towels and keep warm. Slice thinly as possible and serve with the dipping sauce.

title: Wild Mushroom Spread
ingredients: 12 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced ( about 3/4 cup ) | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard
instructions: Spread the mustard onto the sliced mushrooms. Refrigerate for at least 10 minutes prior to serving.

title: Cocoa Corn
ingredients: 1 can baby corn, drained | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the corn, cocoa powder and a small amount of water. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, or until the corn is heated through.

title: Halibut Halibut and Vegetable Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/4 lb halibut | 2 tablespoons corn kernels | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley root | 1/4 teaspoon pepper, coarsely ground | 4 tablespoons tomatoes, peeled crushed with juice | 2 tablespoons harissa or 2 tablespoons chili powder | 4 ounces hokkien noodles
instructions: Cut halibut in half lengthwise, then in 1½ squares. Bruise sides with rolling pin on cutting board and gently pound with rolling pin, til 1/4. Drain halibut well. Set half aside. Coat cutlets with cornstarch and coat with cardamom and black olive oil if desired. Set aside. Wipe out frying pan using paper towels. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in frying pan over high heat. Add fish. Brown well inside. Remove pan from heat and set aside, covered. Heat remaining 2 teaspoons oil in pan over high. Add hokkeil and cook for 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and harissa. Toss well. Cover and simmer for 2 minutes or until fish is cooked through. Add halibut and vegetables. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: topping,cooking oil,jigger triple sec,dark brown sugar,almond,tahini,lemon wedge,chili pepper flake
title: Spicy Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 can or bottle beer | 1/3 cup tahini | 2 -3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons grated fresh lemon wedges | 3/4 cup slivered whole blanched almond | 1/4 cup sliced almonds | topping ( optional )
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients in 2 quart saucepan. Heat to boiling, stirring. Turn off heat. Whisk in oil, tilting to mix. Let cool to room temperature. Stir in remaining marinade. Store in small casserole dish. Sprinkle topping over sauce if desired.

title: Korean Beef Liver With Red Onion & Jalapeno Jelly
ingredients: 1 bunch jalapeno pepper, stem & seeds removed, finely chopped ( wear gloves ) | 1 bunch red onion, finely chopped | 12 slices beef liver
instructions: Combine all ingredients except liver in a plastic bag, and seal tightly. Marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight in the refrigerator,. Place liver in the bag with the marinade and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,scallion,garlic powder,catsup,chocolate powder,basil leaf,rye flour,chili paste
title: Acapulco Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup rye flour ( bob's red mill original recipe ) | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon basil leaves | 1 teaspoon scallion, chopped | 1 can of diced anaheim chilies, including oil, pureed | 1/4 teaspoon unsweetened chocolate powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for at least one hour or overnight. Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,grain white rice,lettuce,wasabi paste,button mushroom,mascarpone cheese
title: Mushroom Rice Bowl With Wasabi-Robust Mascarpone Cheese
ingredients: 5 ounces button mushrooms, quartered ( abura age ) | 1 roma tomato, seeded and finely diced | 1/4 lb mascarpone cheese, at room temperature | wasabi paste, to taste ( recommended ( san-jobo ) | 2 cups cooked long-grain white rice | lettuce, to line serving platter ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler. Microwave mushrooms lightly, unroasted, to warm through. Spread cooked rice on a baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,cocoa powder,thyme,tamarind juice,hazelnut,rosemary
title: Indian Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried chipotle chilies in adobo | 2 tablespoons sweet unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 cups dry roasted hazelnuts, chopped coarsely | 3 tablespoons tamarind juice
instructions: In saucepan, cook chipotle chilies in adobo over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 15 seconds. Remove saucepan from heat.

title: Grilled Swedish Lamb Shank With Short Rib Sauce
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 2 ounces short rib-eye steaks | 1 ounce cream of tartar | 7 ounces mixed cooked vegetables, drained flat
instructions: Wash the lamb shanks. Place the shanks, fat side up, in a large, lightly salted frying pan. Cover and cook over moderate heat for about 5 to 7 minutes per side, or until browned on the outside and cooked through. While the lamb is cooking, place the steaks in a saucepan of boiling water and bring rapidly to the boil. Cover and simmer for about 25 minutes, or until the meat is tender. Remove and keep warm. Meanwhile, make the sauce. When the lamb is nearly cooked, drain the fat, and skim off any fat. When the lamb has cooked, remove it to a warm serving platter. To serve, transfer the cooked lamb and sauce to a warmed serving dish, and garnish each portion with the vegetables.

title: LowCal Ricotta Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese ( about 3-1/2 cups ) or 1 cup skim fat-free cottage cheese ( about 3-1/2 cups )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the ricotta and the green pepper. Season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate until needed. Cover tightly in plastic wrap.. Refrigerate, tightly covered, 2 hours for texture and chilling the cheese. Refrigerate leftovers, or up to 8 days for freezing.

title: Caribbean Coconut Balls
ingredients: 1 cup desiccated coconut | 1 cup bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Heat oven to 180 degrees c / 350°f. Line baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, stir the coconut, soda and 1/4 cup of cold water to a thick paste. Stir in the remaining coconut. Drop spoonfuls of the coconut paste onto the hot baking trays, about 5 cm apart. Flatten with hands. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes until dry.

title: Beef and Pineapple Pizza With Shiitake Oil
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed corned beef chuck | 1 packet pizza crust ( make sure they are pre-made, or make your own ) | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine ( optional ) | 12 ounces muenster cheese, in cheese curds | 2 tablespoons sherry wine ( optional ) | 1 lb walnuts, roasted
instructions: Brown ground beef. Set aside to cool slightly. If using wine, set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray, then add shaoxing wine and sherry. Heat for 30 - 60 seconds then add corned beef, breaking up large pieces of meat. Cook over medium heat until heated through. Turn off heat. Line a large rimmed baking dish with pizza crusts, spreading evenly. Spoon filling, then top with cheese curds on top. Scatter walnuts over the top. Cover with additional pizza crusts, pressing down with fingers to fit. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, or until crust is golden and cheese has melted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,yellow pepper,peanut oil,dill,maraschino cherry,tabasco sauce,seville orange
title: Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups roasted salted pepper | 1 1/2 cups seville oranges or 1 1/2 cups other citrus peels, pith removed | 1 cup sirloin steak or 1 cup seville orange steak, fat trimmed | 1 small red capsicum, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 small yellow pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon dill | 1 tablespoon fresh maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f mix all ingredients for the marinade. Remove pepper from marinade and place in an ovenproof bowl large enough to accommodate all the beef. Toss with beef. Spread pepper mixture over beef, pressing into meat. Rub beef with pepper. Bake for 40 minutes. Remove beef from oven and let rest for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Parmigiano Reggiano Baked in Miso (Miso and Romano Dip)
ingredients: 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons white miso
instructions: Place half of the parmigiano into a small baking dish and dot with half of the reggiano cheese mixture. Continue to dot with miso. Sprinkle remaining cheese over the top and bake, basting frequently, in a 350f degrees oven about 5minutes or until golden. Serve immediately with toasted baguette or crisp bread.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,beef sirloin steak,chipotle pepper,soya sauce,lemon lime beverage,habanero pepper,vanilla bean,broth
title: Chipotle-Smoked Beef and Broth
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin steak, sliced very thin across the grain ( about 1 � thick, if making the sauce, remove as much fat as possible, if serving the dish! ) | 1 cup tomato sauce, if desired ( hunts ) | 2 -3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla bean, scraped | 2 -3 habanero peppers, seeds removed, finely chopped | 2 -3 chipotle peppers, finely chopped ( i remove the veins, stems, and seeds, but leave whole ) | 1 cup broth, if necessary, i use the broth to use as needed ( i use a reduced sodium variety, if you don't like the flavor, use 1/2 cup ) | lemon lime beverage ( optional ) or carbonated beverages ( optional )
instructions: In a large non reactive pan sprayed with pam, sear the steak until nicely browned on the outside. If you are using your broiler rack and your pan, be sure to preheat it on top rack. Add the tomato sauce, soya sauce, and puree, simmer and stir regularly for about 8 - 10 minutes or until the sauce is simmering. Add the habanero, chipotle, and garlic, simmer for 2 minutes. If necessary add a little broth or water, to keep the sauce from drying out. If you are serving with lemon flavored beverage/lemon, stir in some lemon juice. Serve alongside garlic mashed potatoes and steamed veggies.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,pineapple juice orange,sunflower oil,egg yolk,espresso coffee,cayenne
title: Tarragon and Sunflower Oil Omelette With Espresso Espresso
ingredients: 4 egg yolks | 2 teaspoons espresso coffee, hot | 1 1/4 cups unsweetened pineapple juice or 1 1/4 cups orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne ( to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon | sunflower oil
instructions: In a mixing bowl, beat the egg yolks. Add the hot coffee and mix to combine. Turn the mixture into a shallow heatproof, heated, dish. Sprinkle half each of the tarragon and sunflower oil over the surface of the omelette. Dot with remaining tarragon or sunflower oil and chill for at least 30 minutes. Cut the omelette into slices and dip into remaining oil. Heat a griddle or frying pan over a high heat.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,pearl barley,cilantro stem,golden raisin,salami,chicken breast
title: Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 whole chicken breast, halved | 1/2 lb salami, thinly sliced | 1 lebanese cucumber, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 2 cups pearl barley, cooked | 1/3 cup golden raisin | fresh cilantro stem, for garnish
instructions: Wash chicken under cold water until completely dry and then tear into bite sized pieces. Place in mixing bowl. Add salami, cucumber, and barley. Toss with raisins and cilantro. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Best if eaten at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: french green bean,goat cheese,tequila,cooking spray,oyster sauce,oatmeal,white pearl onion,chicken breast
title: St. Patrick's Day One Pot Wonder Bread Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups day old sliced french style green beans, unseasoned | 6 ounces white pearl onions, peeled | 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 2/3 cup oatmeal | 30 ounces microwavable oyster sauce | 1/4 cup sweet and sour sauce | 1/2 cup dry tequila | cooking spray
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Place all vegetables into large bowl. Mash well. Reserve any leftover pieces of veggies in an extra bowl. Spread 1/2 cup veggies onto baking sheet. Bake until veggies are lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Roasted Beef Heart Salad (Crock Pot or Oven)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs beef eye round, trimmed | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons green grapes, seeded for garnish
instructions: Place roast in a 5 litre slow cooker. Combine orange juice and remaining ingredients, stirring to blend. Pour over roast. Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours. Cut into 2 large rib serving sized sections. Serve topped with a sprinkling of grapes.

Random Ingredients: broiler fryer chicken,vanilla,chili pepper flake,pinto bean,gruyere cheese,tomato paste,green cardamom pod,cake
title: Chilled Cretian Chicken Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs broiler-fryer chickens | 1 1/2 cups pinto beans | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1 green cardamom pod | 2 dried chili peppers ( hot cherry peppers or pasilla green peppers ) | 1 pinch of crushed chili pepper flakes | 6 ounces gruyere cheese | punchy cake ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the chicken under hot water to remove the sand and grit inside. Rinse the chicken under cold running water to rinse off any excess moist coating. Trim excess fat from outside of the chicken, if desired. Rinse the chicken under running water to rinse off any excess sand and grit. Place the chicken in a shallow dish and pour 2 cups of water over it. Turn the chicken over to rinse thoroughly and drain the water. Place the soaked chicken on a flat surface. Combine the canned tomatoes and tomato paste in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 3 minutes to blend the flavors. Add the cardamom pods, chili peppers, 2 dried chili peppers and chili flakes. Mix well. Add 1/3 of the chicken juices and cheese to the tomato mixture. Taste, add more liquid if neccesary, seasoning with more chili and chili flakes if desired. Pour the rest of the chicken juices over the chicken. Cover and refrigerate for about 3 hours or up to 3 days. If you are freezing the dish for dinner, put the dish under a plastic container for the next day or freeze the dish for up to 3 months. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Transfer the dish in to a baking dish or roasting pan and place it in the oven. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour or so or until the chicken is cooked and tender. Serve immediately. If you have the time, refrigerate for up to two days. Serve with crusty bread, chopped fresh vegetables, or crackers.

title: Coconut Glazed Linguine
ingredients: 250 g linguine | 750 ml guinness stout | 1 tablespoon cayenne powder | 5 ml mexican oregano | 5 ml coconut liqueur | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 50 g ham, sliced thin
instructions: Cook linguini per package directions, keep covered in the fridge while you cook ham. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, heat guinness, cayenne, mexican oregano, coconut liqueur and soy milk on medium high heat. Stir occassionally until hot and slightly reduced about 5 minutes. Add ham. When linguine are done, drain and add to pan with ham and sauce.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,pea carrot,pillsbury crescent dinner,pimiento,plain flour,lemon peel,bitter chocolate,puff pastry
title: Christmas Meat Pie
ingredients: 2 packages pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 1/2 lbs ground meat | 1 jar chopped pimientos, drained | 1 can condensed beef broth | 2 teaspoons minced lemon peel | 2 tablespoons bittersweet chocolate | 2 packages frozen peas and carrots, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Grease 11 inch pie plate. Unroll dough onto lightly floured surface.

title: Beef and Noodle Dinner
ingredients: 2 large egg whites | 12 ounces ground sirloin | 3 1/2 cups dried navy beans
instructions: In one bowl place beef and 1 egg white and mix till combined well. On a wax paper or cloth pat beef mixture into an oblong shape about 12 x 13 inches. Using wax paper, fold in sides and ends and continue folding meat till mixture is twice its original height, place on cutting board and cut diagonally in about 2 inch pieces. In a large saucepan, mix together the beans with a little of the bean cooking water and bring to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and continue to cook over medium heat till desired tenderness, stirring often. Serve warm.

title: Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 2 oranges or 4 oranges | 1 kg baby carrots or 1 kg asian baby carrots | 200 g pepperoni | 1/3 cup orange marmalade | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Peel carrots & cut into big chunks. Cut the pepperoni into big pieces and add to the orange segments along with the marmade. Add the turmeric/salt as per taste. Chop the pineapple /banana mixture and mix in to the salad. Toss it all in a fridge for 10 - 15 minutes. Serve.

Random Ingredients: broth,mexican oregano,raspberry jam,bacon grease,chilies,irish cream,cucumber,cumin powder
title: Cucumber-Chili Raita
ingredients: 1 cup broth | 2 chilies, any color | 1 tablespoon bacon grease | 12 ounces frozen raspberries and jam | 1 cucumber | 4 ounces mexican chilies | 4 ounces mexican oregano | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder
instructions: Place the broth and chilies in a pan over medium low heat. Heat and simmer for 5 minutes. While stirring in the raspberry jam, peel, and dice the cucumber, rinsing after removing seeds if you don't want to. Place in a bowl and mash with a fork. Stir in the mexican chilies and oregano until well mixed. Strain soup and set aside 3 cups, and refrigerate remaining soup for future use, or serve warm in cups with a dollop of sour cream and garnish with whole berries or sliced green olives.

title: Tandoori Style Chickpea
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpeas, drained | 3 large curry leaves
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a medium size bowl with 3/4 cup water. Let sit, covered, over low heat. Let soak for 20 minutes. In a blender, using a slotted spoon, lift the chickpeas from the water. Rinse with cold water. Repeat with remaining water until all the water is used. Repeat as needed. Drain and rinse the chickpeas under warm water. Transfer to a serving bowl. Sprinkle with the curry leaves and serve.

title: Canned Avocados and Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs corn on the cob ( with kernels ) | 1/2 cup corn | 1/2 cup margarine, melted | 1/2 cup flour | 1 french baguette, split lengthwise into two 6 x 1/4 slices | french baguette, toasted on cookie sheet for 1 1/2 minutes per side and cut crosswise into halves ( 7 oz total ) | avocado, slices sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place the corn kernels in a colander and rinse well. Combine corn, margarine or butter and flour in a small saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened, 2 - 3 minutes. Divide the mixture among the bread slices. Top with avocado slices.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,yukon gold potato,applesauce,cream,extra virgin olive oil,ginger garlic paste,scallion,coriander
title: Mashed Potatoes With Applesauce
ingredients: 1 large yukon gold potato, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon whole coriander, chopped | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup applesauce, canned | 2 cups full-fat sour cream | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Fill a saucepan with water and add potatoes. Bring to a boil, then cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. Meanwhile, heat oil over medium heat and cook scallions for a few minutes, until fragrant. Then, add ginger garlic paste. When the garlic begins to sizzle, stir in applesauce, cream, applesauce, and coriander.

title: Simple Dirty Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups instant rice | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 1/2 tablespoons gelatin, powder
instructions: To make the rice, put the instant rice and condensed soup in a bowl. Sprinkle with grand marnier. Dissolve the gelatin in 1/4 cup water, then mix that in as well. Add more water if there's too much water. Add gelatin mixture to the rice in the bowl, or stir with a spoon while the rice is soaking up the flavors. Put the bowl on the couch.

title: Gougereux
ingredients: 7 1/4 ounces greek yogurt | 5 1/2 ounces dry marsala wine
instructions: Mix the greek yogurt and marsala together and set to the side. Serve over ice, garnished with a few finely chopped almonds, if desired.

title: Pecan Chicken
ingredients: 3 pounds whole chicken thighs | 1 pound pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Place the chicken legs into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake chicken legs for 2 to 3 hours in the preheated oven, until the juices run clear. Remove chicken thighs and let cool and thaw for a few hours before slicing. Serve chicken thighs with pecan halves alongside toasted together with butter, rice or beans.

title: Pear-honey Glazed Chips
ingredients: 1 can pears, with juice, chopped | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1 bag dry corn tortilla chips, broken into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Lightly grease a 9 inch square baking dish with non stick cooking spray. In a medium bowl mash pears with honey until no bits of pears are left. Place 1 or 2 chips in the baking dish, spreading the pear mixture over the chips and pressing down firmly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until crispy and golden.

title: Cottage Cheese and Chilies Pitas
ingredients: 16 ounces cottage cheese | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1/2 cup whole wheat pita bread
instructions: Combine cottage cheese into a mixing bowl. Spread cottage cheese/chilies onto pita breads. Sprinkle green chilies over half of the pita. Roll the pita and eat warm.

Random Ingredients: marsala wine,taco seasoning,dark brown sugar,baguette,browning sauce,cornstarch,russet potato,raspberry jam
title: Raspberry Potato Crostini
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes ( about 1 pound each ) | 1/2 tablespoon light browning sauce or 1/2 tablespoon other cooking oil | 1 baguette, cut into 24 slices | 1 jar russet potatoes, well-washed ( about 3 cups ) | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/4 cup light browning sauce or 1/4 cup other cooking oil | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup light raspberry jam
instructions: Place potatoes in large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer until tender. Drain and cool. Peel potatoes and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices and set aside. Heat 1/2 tablespoon of oil in a 6 inch nonstick skillet and cook bread until golden brown, turning once. Drain on paper towels and keep warm in 200°f oven. Heat light browning sauce or cooking oil along with taco seasoning and cornstarch in a medium saucepan over medium heat. In a large bowl, whisk together butter, brown sugar, preserves, potatoes, cornstarch and jam. Spoon potato mixture on toasted bread, add more warmed sauce to moisten and sprinkle with more brown sugar.

title: Champagne Beer With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 pint barley | 12 mushrooms
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together 1 pint barley with the mushrooms and pour into a punch bowl.

title: Apricot Glaze (Liqueur-Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried apricot, diced | 1/2 lb dried apricot, diced | 1 tablespoon ground dill | 1 tablespoon finely minced white vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Brush or brush on the apricots when ready to use to prevent drying out. Note, if you like the apricots glaze to be sweeter, add more honey or vinegar.

title: Fried Walnuts -Amy Kesey
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut pieces | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander leaves | 1/2 small tomatoes, diced | 1 teaspoon miracle whip | 1 ounce gorgonzola, crumbled
instructions: Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. Add walnuts and stir to coat. Stir once and add marjoram and coriander. Fry for 1 minute. Add tomato, then the Miracle whip. Stir until dissolved. Remove from heat and sprinkle gorgonzola cheese on top. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,orange zest,icing sugar,walnut half,heavy whipping cream,italian breadcrumb,deli ham,salsa
title: Baked Cauliflower Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 small cauliflower, separated into small florets | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons sifted icing sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 cup finely grated parmesean-reggiano-reggiano or 1/4-1/2 cup pecorino or 1/4-1/2 cup pecorino cheese | 3/4 1/2 cup sweet italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup toasted walnut halves | 8 slices deli ham, thin slices or 8 slices thin deli ham, cut into 1/4 dice
instructions: In a small pot of boiling salted water, cook cauliflower until just tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain and transfer to a medium bowl. In a medium bowl, whisk whipping cream with sugar, orange zest, cheese, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Stir in cauliflower and nuts. Cut a slit down one side of each capon and brush cavacchio with the cream mixture. Place on a baking sheet and lightly flour to prevent stickiness. Brush tops with olive oil. Bake in a 400º oven for 15 to 16 minutes or until the tops are lightly browned. Serve hot or cold with more grated cheese and salsa.

title: Spinach With Strawberrys and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 bag fresh baby spinach | 1 package fresh strawberries
instructions: Remove stems, and thinly slice fresh strawberries. Divide spinach between 4 large soup bowls, top with strawberries.

title: Tapioca Batter for Pasta Dinner
ingredients: 1 1/8 cups tapioca flour | 1 1/2 cups pineapple, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce
instructions: Note, if your tomatoes are very small, halve them.

Random Ingredients: white pearl onion,taco seasoning mix,extra virgin olive oil,carrot,banana pepper,granny smith apple,oil
title: Taco Apples With Pearl Onions and White Onions
ingredients: 8 white pearl onions | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( i use lawrys ) | 1 large carrot, diced | 1 granny smith apple, peeled and diced ( optional ) | 1 banana pepper, diced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 - 1/2 cup oil ( depending on how much oil your skillet has )
instructions: In medium size fry pan heat up the extra virgin olive oil to medium high heat, add in onions brown onions. Random Ingredients: fine salt,chili pepper flake,yellow onion,vegetable broth,pita bread,carrot,rosemary leaf
title: Lori's "real" Veggie Fajitas
ingredients: 1 pita bread, cut into 1 inch ( see below ) | 1 1/2 cups chopped yellow onions ( about 6 medium ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons fine salt | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon rosemary leaf | 6 cups vegetable broth ( from cooking vegetables ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely chopped carrots ( about 2 medium ) ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon minced dried rosemary ( about 2 medium ) ( optional )
instructions: Sauté onions in large skillet over medium heat, stirring often, 2 minutes. Add salt, chili pepper flakes, and rosemary leaves. Stir well and cook for 1 - 2 minutes longer. Add vegetable broth, carrots, and optional rosemary. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, 3 - 5 minutes. Season with salt to taste. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. In a baking dish or serving platter, toast pita on both sides until light golden brown, about 2 minutes in each side. Watch carefully do not burn tops of pitas. Use a spatula to scoop pita out and onto serving platter with a spatula. Note, the veggie broth may be used as a shortcut substitution for the vegetable broth.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,caesar salad dressing,tilapia fillet,five spice powder,bell pepper,dukkah
title: Asian Grilled Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck roast | 1 package ground dried sweet bell peppers or ( 1 lb ) package mixed color vegetables | 1 bottle caesar salad dressing | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried anchovies or 2 teaspoons dried anchovies | 7 1/2 ounces tilapia fillets, cut crosswise into thin slices
instructions: If you need a more intense flavor, use chili seasoning mix. Place beef in large freezer bag. Sprinkle beef with 5 spice powder to coat. Insert meat thermometer into center of meat. If you need more intense flavor, remove meat from freezer 1hour before baking. Remove brined beef from freezer, place in a shallow dish, and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight, turning over meat occasionally. Remove beef from refrigerator about 45 minutes before baking and let stand at room temperature. Brush beef generously with caesar dressing, sprinkle with dried anchovies, and place on a rack on tray. Preheat grill. If oven is too hot, you can roast or roast in your oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with cooked rice, perhaps with bread, crackers, and/or veggies for dipping.

title: Curried Fish (Cacut Yaks)
ingredients: 1 lb cod fillet | 1 large red potato, cut into cubes | 1 cup yellow squash or 1 cup orange squash, cubed | 1/4 cup turmeric | 1/4 cup brewed coffee
instructions: Place potatoes, squash and turmeric in a pot and cook, covered, over low heat until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. Place fish in a saucepan and cover with boiling water. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes. Scoop fish and potatoes with a slotted spoon onto a platter. Pour the coffee over the fish and serve.

title: Lebanese Bush Salad
ingredients: 2 cans refried beans | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/3 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Mix refried beans with lemon juice. Place walnuts on top.

title: Sherry-Crusted Crisp Fingers
