ingredients: 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons crushed corn flakes | 2 teaspoons bitter ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons sweet sweet-hot sauce
instructions: Using a pastry bag fitted with a medium star tip, pipe 2 1/2 inch lengths of fyi rind and 1/4 inch wide strips lengthwise down each side of the fyi rind into the bag. Place the bag in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water. When the bag begins to set, stir gently, then cover and keep warm in a fyi oven for up to 1 hour. Remove the bag from the water and discard contents of the bag. Combine the hot sauce with the 1 tbsp water, swirling to blend, and set aside. Arrange the fyi toasted crisps in a 1 quart baking dish, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with the sweet/hot sauce mixture and top with the reserved sauce. Return to a preheated 425°f oven until golden, about 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Peppered Beef Steak With Nectar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons agave nectar | 600 g boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into thin strips
instructions: Combine the agave nectar and beef in a small non metal bowl and stir to mix well. Cover and leave in the fridge overnight, shaking the bowl occasionally. Preheat the oven to 200c. Transfer the beef to baking paper and put in the oven and roast until the beef is cooked and browned, stirring or shaking the bowl, about 20 minutes for medium.

title: Strawberry Raisin Bread
ingredients: 2 cups raisins | 1 cup sliced fresh strawberries | 1 1/2 cups bread flour for coating
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Dust a board with flour. Stamp raisins out of their paper wrappers. Place raisins onto parchment paper lightly coated with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange raisins onto raisins, separating and sandling in the center. Spread sliced strawberries onto bread flour. Dredge tops of bread using flour. Bake for about 20 minutes in middle of oven.

Random Ingredients: almond,lemon peel,muenster cheese,golden raisin,picante sauce,brown onion,cumin powder
title: Spiced Cheese With Almonds
ingredients: 8 ounces muenster cheese or 8 ounces monterey jack cheese, sliced in 8 slices | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 cups almonds | 1/2 cup packed light brown onion | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Saute onions in 2 tbls. Oil over medium heat until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in cumin and cook 30 secs. Mix in raisins and cheese. Over medium heat, cook about 2 minutes until cheese is melted, stirring constantly. Spoon cheese mixture on platter. Sprinkle almonds on top and cook about 5 minutes, just until the almonds are golden and bubbly.

title: Potato, Hazelnut and Brie Appetizers
ingredients: 800 g potatoes | 200 g brie cheese | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 1 green onion, chopped | 2 drops tabasco sauce
instructions: Peel the potatoes, quarter them, boil them in salted water until tender. Drain and cool slightly. Cube the brie and coarsely chop the nuts. Mix all ingredients until well coated with mixture – spread a portion onto each potato half. Place on foil, bake at 200 for 20 minutes, turn over, bake 30 more minutes.

title: Oaxacan Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds | 2 cups corn oil | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Put a piece of bread in the freezer for about 20 minutes until firm.

title: Anchovies and Cream From Scratch (Creme Caramel)
ingredients: 1 bottle scalded vanilla-flavoured scalded vanilla-flavoured scalded vanilla-flavoured scalded vanilla-flavoured scalded scalded vanilla-flavoured scalded vanilla-flavoured scalded scalded scalded vanilla-flavoured scalded scalded scalded scalded scalded scalding scald. | 1 anchovy, cleaned with skin left on | 1 pinch ground anise extract, plus more for sprinkling
instructions: Remove scalded scalded scalded scalded scalded scalded scalded scavenings from bottle and set scalded scalded scavenings aside. Pour vanilla flavored scalded scalded scalded scavenings back into cleaned bottle. Cut the fresh scavenings into half cylinders. To serve, generously sprinkle a good pinch of anise extract onto a freshly cut scavened scavened scavened scavenings. Remove scavenings from bottle and pour the vanilla flavored scalded scalded scavenings into a serving dish, piling finely. Sprinkle scavenings with a pinch of anise extract and drizzle with a few drops of vanilla flavoring. Serve scavenings in wineglasses brushed with vanilla flavoring.

title: Raw Zucchini and Coriander Salad
ingredients: 3 -6 medium zucchini | 2 tablespoons shredded red peppers | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh mint leaves | 4 sheets nori | 2 teaspoons white balsamic vinegar or 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar ( or more to taste )
instructions: If your zucchini are big remove it from its peel and cut into 1/4 inch slices. Place in a colander and toss with 2 tablespoons of the white balsamic vinegar until well mixed. Set aside to marinate. Boil 1 1/2 cups water, add 1 - 2 teaspoons salt and the nori and let simmer 3 - 4 minutes. Drain well and let rest. Toss the chopped zucchini with remaining vinegar and set aside to cool. Arrange cooled zucchini in a bowl or onto a serving platter. Top with coriander and serve.

title: Chocloise
ingredients: 1 ounce unsweetened dark chocolate, chopped | 1 clove garlic, finely minced | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon grated gorgonzola | 2 tablespoons pepitas, ground | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt the chocolate with the garlic, tarragon and gorgonzola on low heat. Remove from the heat, and stir in the pepitas. Cover and chill for 2 hours. To serve, break apart into chunks and drizzle with melted chocolate.

title: Lime Chicken Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 8 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked and well drained | 2 large boneless chicken wings, separated into tips and tips discarded | 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 1/4 cup lime juice
instructions: Combine sauce mix, noodles and chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Set aside. Beat cream cheese and lime juice in a medium bowl together until well blended. Spread cream cheese mixture in an even layer over noodles in baking dish. Top with remaining noodles. Cover with foil and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 40 minutes. Remove foil and continue to bake for 10 minutes or until top is nicely browned.

title: Quick and Easy Portuguese Creole Sausage
ingredients: 1 linguica sausage | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1/4 cup molasses | 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Cook linguica in hot skillet until browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove linguica with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Mix creole seasoning, molasses, red pepper flakes, and cardamom in the skillet and heat until hot. Remove skillet from heat and pour mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Smooth sausage with back of spoon for 5 minutes, then pour hot sauce over. Cover and bake in the preheated oven until hot and bubbly, 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chili Sauce II
ingredients: 1 pound allspice | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 1/2 pounds chopped vegetables | 3 teaspoons chili sauce | 1/2 cup vegetable fat or 1/2 cup lard
instructions: Combine allspice, vinegar, vegetables & chili sauce and set aside. Heat fat or lard in a large frying pan, over medium high heat. When smoking, pour in enough sauce to cover, and simmer one minute. Drop in chopped vegetables & cook 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender crisp.

title: Watermelon and Mango Chutney Dip
ingredients: 500 g watermelon, chunks | 400 g mango chutney | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender and blend into a smooth paste. If you want to have it thicker, add more water.

Random Ingredients: crabmeat,lemon juice zest,rye flour,spinach leaf,ginger paste
title: Quick and Easy Kimchee Ravioli
ingredients: 1 pint fresh spinach leaves, well washed and roughly chopped | 1 lb cooked crabmeat | 1 teaspoon lemon juice and zest | ginger paste ( or as many seeds as you like ) | 6 ounces rye flour
instructions: Mash the spinach/spinach/spinach/scallop and make a mound in the center of the plate. Break up crabmeat with a fork. Mix with lemon juice. Add ginger paste to taste. Dip the dough in the ginger mixture on top. It should be slightly thicker than breadcrumbs, more like a coating than a dough. If they are in small clumps, make sure you have a little room between them. Poke holes with a fork on top, then cover well with a plate or another piece of plastic and set aside. Dip a teaspoon full of the dough in the ginger mixture, covering as much as possible. You can also line the top of the bowl with a piece of wax paper if you do and just wet your hands and the dough with it. Place on a plate with a good hole cut out of the dough. Repeat with the rest. This makes a nice sized amount of dough. When you have finished making your dough, fry in a skillet or korean style pan with oil until lightly browned on all sides, and drain on paper towels. Serve with sweet or spicy sriracha sauce and plain white bread, if desired.

title: Baked Rye Rounds With Egg Mayonnaise
ingredients: 2 egg yolks | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise ( hellmans is my favorite ) | 8 slices rye bread ( or other rye bread )
instructions: Beat the egg yolks, add the mayonnaise, and beat briskly. Spread half the mixture on both pieces of bread. Spread remaining mixture on one side and place on baking sheet, bake in a 350f oven for 15 minutes. Cut while still warm, in thin slices and serve.

title: Red Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 cup red lentil, rinsed | 1 cup sour cream ( light works too ) | 2 slices fresh ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 package cream cheese with herbs | 1 pint cherry tomatoes ( i like the ones with the jicama ones ) or 1 pint grape tomatoes, cut into quarters ( i like the ones with the jicama ones )
instructions: Cook lentils in boiling water until very tender, 20 to 30 minutes drain. Stir in sour cream, ginger and vanilla. Serve with fresh tomatoes with a garnish of mixed green and fruit.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,pear,nutmeg,jalapeno pepper,tart apple,broccoli floret,tomato juice
title: Broccoli & Pear Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup tomato juice | 3/4 cup low sodium vegetable cocktail or 3/4 cup canned low sodium pear nectar | 1 small tart apple, peeled, cored, and chopped | 2 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pickled jalapeno pepper ( such as the canned hot pepper ) | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh nutmeg | 1/2 head broccoli floret, cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Combine tomato juice and next 4 ingredients in large non reactive bowl, add broccoli.

Random Ingredients: basil,red kidney bean,onion powder,salmon fillet,swiss chard,green bean,corn kernel
title: Easy One-Pot Salmon Florentine
ingredients: 1/2 pound salmon fillet | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can green beans, drained and rinsed | 1 cup chopped swiss chard | 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1 tablespoon onion powder
instructions: Place salmon fillet, kidney beans, green beans, swiss chard, corn, and basil in food processor or blender. Blend to desired consistency and pour into a 2 quart baking dish. In a small bowl, stir together onion powder and remaining tablespoon of lemon juice.

Random Ingredients: apricot,garlic powder,chia seed,active yeast,salt cod fish
title: Apricots and Chia Chips
ingredients: 3 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups warm water | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 4 cups whole chia seeds | 1 teaspoon salt cod fish, cooked and diced | 1/2 cup dried apricots, chopped, or more to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand until foamy, 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in garlic powder, chia seeds, and salt. Add cod, apricots, and 1 teaspoon sugar.

title: French Lentils (Hondura) - Light Lentils!
ingredients: 150 g lentils | 2 tablespoons stock | 2 tablespoons french baguette, finely diced
instructions: Wash and thoroughly wash the lentils, then soak them in water for 10 - 15 hours. Bring 3 cups of water to a boil, then boil them, uncovered, for about ten minutes. Drain the lentils thoroughly in a colander. Place the lentils in a bowl & pour in enough boiling water to cover them. Allow the lentils to continue cooking till tender, about 40 - 50 minutes. When ready, drain the lentils. Place the french baguette into a pan, and allow it to brown slightly. Stir in the lentils & toss. Serve warm or cold.

title: Mexican Burger Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tabasco� mix slices | 1 1/2 cups tamari | 3/4 cup taco seasoning mix | 4 buns, cut in half
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and press into bun halves.

Random Ingredients: apple cider vinegar,baby spinach,liquid smoke flavoring,black eyed pea,white cornmeal,potato,vegetable shortening
title: Hot German Style
ingredients: 1/3 cup vegetable shortening | 4 cups frozen potato rounds | 2 packages baby spinach | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 cup white and black-eyed peas, cooked and drained | 3 tablespoons hot dutch-processed potato chutney
instructions: In a large bowl, cream together the shortening and mashed potatoes. Stir in the spinach, vinegar, and liquid smoke flavoring. Stir in the peas to coat. Transfer to a serving bowl, cover, and refrigerate until chilled, about 30 minutes or overnight. To serve, pour about 2 tablespoons chutney evenly over each serving.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,orange juice,syrup,shell pasta,beef mince,bow tie pasta,cornflour
title: Quick Beef Bake
ingredients: 250 g bow tie pasta | 250 g lean beef mince | 310 g kidney beans | 1 medium orange, juice and rind of | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 400 ml low-fat natural yoghurt or 400 ml reduced-fat sour cream | 310 g frozen miniature shell pasta
instructions: Boil 2 minutes so pasta is cooked and slightly tender. Meanwhile, cook the mince in a frypan for about 5 mins until browned. Add bean and orange rind, mix well and cook for 1 minute. Stir in 1 tbsp of cold water and bring to the boil. Lower heat to a simmer, add pasta and cook for 5 mins, drain. Put the yoghurt or sour cream in a bowl. Add the mince mixture, stir well and pour into an ovenproof dish sprayed with cooking spray. Add the mini pasta, mix well and bake in a moderate oven for about 20 mins or until golden and hot through.

Random Ingredients: milk,taco seasoning,spaghetti sauce,soba noodle,yellow bell pepper,tamari,wheat tortilla,beef tenderloin roast
title: Tacos in a Pan
ingredients: 2 pounds beef tenderloin roast, sliced into 1-inch strips | 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 package soba noodles | 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced into strips | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning, divided | 1 quart whole milk | 8 whole wheat tortillas, cut into 6 wedges
instructions: Combine steak strips, spaghetti sauce, tamari and 4 taco seasoning in large skillet. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer about 10 minutes. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add noodles and cook for 2 minutes less than the package instructions. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Cook meat in remaining salsa until meat is no longer pink. Serve with sauce and noodles.

title: Easy Fries
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled | nonstick cooking spray | coarse salt for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f. Cut potatoes lengthwise into quarters. Then cut each quarter in half again. Lay a quarter on a paper towel and pat dry. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Spray fries with nonstick cooking spray. Spray potatoes lightly with nonstick cooking spray and sprinkle with salt. Bake the fries uncovered for 12 to 15 minutes, or until tender.

Random Ingredients: beef,trout fillet,baking soda,apple juice,simple syrup,salmon,lemon zest
title: Smoked Trout Bites
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can smoked salmon, drained | 1 can smoked trout fillets, drained | 1 can apple juice | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, minced | 1/4 cup simple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a dutch oven combine the beer, trout, smoked salmon, apple juice, lemon zest, and simple syrup. Bring mixture to a boil, then remove from heat and stir in the baking soda. Pour into a small baking pan and cool completely. Chill for several hours.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,mushroom,thyme,meatball,wild rice,sherry wine,beef stew meat
title: Brown Stew With Wild Rice
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed beef stew meat | 1/3 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 10 ounces sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 lbs fresh meatballs | 2 cups cooked wild rice
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the sherry, golden syrup, mushrooms and thyme. Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,white vinegar,worcestershire sauce,hamburger,goat cheese,baking powder
title: Welsh Rarebit
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 300 g self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 250 g soft fresh goat cheese | 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220c/gas mark mix most of the ingredients together in a large bowl. Melt the butter in a fry pan. Pour in about 1/3 of the sticky mixture to coat the base of a round baking dish. Place the dish on a baking sheet and bake the Rarebit in the oven for about 20 minutes. Keep an eye on it as it burns easily remove from the oven and cool slightly. Cut into squares while still warm. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,flat leaf parsley,cornstarch,salsa,olive oil,green chili,no salt tomato
title: Tomato-Salsa Dipping Sauce for Beef and  Noodles
ingredients: 2 cans no-salt-added whole canned tomatoes, drained and quartered | 3/4 cup salsa or 3/4 cup picante sauce, mild | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon prepared green chili, chopped | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together the tomatoes, salsa, cornstarch, and olive. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Mix in green chiles and vinegar, and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Serve over your favorite cooked pasta just before serving. It will keep well for up to 1 week refrigerated.

title: Jelly and Sesame Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 medium jicama, peeled | 1/4 cup sesame seeds
instructions: Place seeds into a small bowl, and toss with sesame oil. Slice jicama across the grain, then slice diagonally into 1/4 inch slices. Place jelly onto serving plates, and top with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Penne All'è Pour Pour
ingredients: 1 lb penne | 2 sprigs fresh thyme
instructions: For the pasta you will need to cook it in advance so the flavors can blend together. Cooking the pasta however is the only way i like my pasta done. To cook it right away is best but a few minutes or so is fine. Cut the thyme sprigs into 3 or 4 sections and place them in boiling water. While the water is coming to a boil, in a big skillet you will want to have some oil or oil spray spray on a rack and place it on the rack of the oven. Turn on the oven to 375 f or 190 c and put the rack in the oven until it is time to throw everything together. When the pasta is done, drain and put it back into the pan. Add the thyme and toss until coated and warm. When ready to serve, top the pasta with the sauce, and add more thyme.

title: Oriental Marinade (Basic Recipe)
ingredients: 1/3 cup soy sauce | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Mix soy sauce, bay leaves, and sugar in a bowl.

title: Lek in Vinegar
ingredients: 1 lb leek, white part only, cut lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices, washed thoroughly, and cut into 1/8 inch slices, both ends clean
instructions: Prepare the leeks very thinly. Arrange in single layer on a heavy duty nonreactive dish. Cover with boiling water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 8 minutes or until the leeks have softened and are translucent. Remove from heat. Cool completely in water in a liquid measuring cup. Discard the water. Transfer the leeks to a colander placed over a bowl and let drain for 30 minutes. Discard the liquid. Place the leeks back on the stove over medium heat. Pour the vinegar over the leeks. Cook, stirring, over medium heat for 5 minutes or until the leeks are just heated through. Remove from heat. Remove the leeks from the heat as soon as they are cool enough to handle. Transfer the leeks to a serving bowl, cover loosely with a lid, and chill in the refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. Bring to room temperature before serving. Variation, you may add bacon, ham, or poultry for a stronger leeks flavor.

Random Ingredients: sea bass fillet,pesto sauce,italian breadcrumb,thyme leave,head cabbage,pork,chipotle pepper,limeade concentrate
title: Smoked Sea Bass With Cabbage Cabbage
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 cups fresh italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 2 links smoked sea bass fillets ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 can chipotle peppers | 1 envelope frozen limeade concentrate, thawed | 2 teaspoons pesto sauce, prepared | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave, crushed | 1/2 head of cabbage, cored and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place 2 cups bread crumbs in an ovenproof baking dish and rub into the fish. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until browned and crumbly. Meanwhile, place the chipotle pepper with the limeade concentrate according to package directions, stirring constantly. Spread pesto on one side of top of chipotle pepper with the other side of the fish slices. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Remove from oven and spread the remaining 1/2 cup bread crumbs onto a separate plate for dipping. Place the fish on top of the bread crumbs. Remove the chipotle pepper from the canning jar and crush using the flat side of a large heavy, sharp knife. Add the crushed pepper, limeade, thyme and cabbage to the saucepan with the chipotle and limeade mixture.

title: Almo's Easy Feta Cheese Toast
ingredients: 2 slices bread, crusts removed | 1/2 cup alfalfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 1 dash sea salt | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, shredded
instructions: Remove crusts from bread and cut into 3/4 inch cubes. Arrange on a serving platter and sprinkle with 1/2 cup alfredo sauce and coriander seed. Sprinkle with salt. Top with remaining mozzarella cheese slices and chopped fresh coriander. Serve with warm french rolls or breadsticks.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,seasoning mix,pumpkin puree,cumin seed,kidney bean,bacon
title: Pumpkin and Bacon Lasagna
ingredients: 12 fresh lasagna noodles, cooked | 3 slices bacon, chopped | 1/2 cup pumpkin puree, canned | 1 -2 packet maggi seasoning mix, seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 2/3 cups kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles, drain and run under rapidly boiling water for 5 - 7 minutes, drain and place 2 tbsp of the pumpkin puree on top of the noodles. Sprinkle the seasoning packet& cumin. Bake in oven on the middle shelf for approx 20 mins until the pumpkin is golden.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 12 slices processed american cheese | 10 fluid ounces cooking oil | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper
instructions: Heat oil over low flame. Place the processed cheeses in the hot oil with the black pepper. Saute on a medium hear for 4 or 5 minutes. Turn down the heat and let the cheese melt.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,chicken breast fillet,hard egg,provolone cheese,pasta,kosher salt,angel hair pasta,chipotle chile
title: Crock Pot Mexican Macaroni Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 2 chipotle chiles, minced | 1 egg, beaten | kosher salt | 2 ounces provolone cheese, diced | 12 ounces spiral shaped pasta | 1 cup fresh pasta or 1 cup baby green
instructions: Place chicken in crock pot. Pour tomatoes over chicken. Mix well. Pour beaten egg over all of the chicken. Season generously with salt.

Random Ingredients: bay seasoning,ketchup,cube steak,yellow pepper,self rising flour,veal
title: Quick Beef & Veal Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs cube steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon old bay seasoning | 1/2 cup self rising flour | 1 cup finely chopped yellow pepper | 1 cup finely chopped green or red peppers | 1 cup thawed drained steak marinade ( about 2 tablespoons meat marinade )
instructions: Sprinkle steaks with ketchup, old bay seasoning, and flour. Place vegetables in a greased shallow serving dish and top with steaks. Pour marinade over steaks and vegetables. Cover and chill 3 to 4 hours before baking. Heat oven to 400 degrees, and remove cover. Bake, uncovered, for 30 to 40 minutes or until meat is cooked.

Random Ingredients: jigger melon liqueur,chicken stock cube,garam masala,pumpkin
title: Chicken and Pumpkin in Jigger(Pumpkin) Liqueur-Piri
ingredients: 1 large canned pumpkin ( peeled ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 3 1/2 ounces jiggers melon liqueur
instructions: Rinse the pumpkin to remove as much excess juice as possible from it, then cut into chunks. Place into a deep pan, and add the stock cube, along with the garam masala and pumpkin flesh, and bring to the boil. Cover & simmer, shaking the pan occasionally for 30 minutes. Remove the pumpkin to serving bowls. Ladle in the remaining jiggers of melon liqueur, and serve with indian bread as a garnish.

title: Pepperoni Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese ( shredded ) | 1/2 tablespoon hot pepperoni ( ground ) | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 0.5 can sandwich without cheese sandwich pieces ( optional )
instructions: Combine cheese and pepperoni in a small bowl. Sprinkle over surface of hot pepperoni mixture. Sprinkle evenly with cocoa if using. Top with sandwich pieces. Using a brush, lightly or lightly butter each side of the sandwich. Grill on a hot griddle or in a skillet for 3 - 4 minutes per side until golden brown.

title: Homemade Tomatillos (Mexican Cottage Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 16 -21 tomatillos, husked | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 package cottage cheese
instructions: Roast tomatillos on a foil covered pan on the stove until a dent begins to dance. Drain on a paper towel. When cool, drain on paper towels and peel. Cut off the black ends of the tomatillos. Carefully scoop out the flesh and reserve. Place the tomatillos into a blender or food processor, add taco seasoning and mix. Put a small layer of cottage cheese on the bottom of a shallow glass baking dish. Spoon 1/4 of the tomatillo mixture on top of cottage cheese. Spread the remaining tomatillo mixture on top of cottage cheese. Sprinkle top with taco seasoning and top with remaining cottage cheese. Cook in a 400 degree f oven for 45 minutes.

title: Aarti's Beetroot Dip
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 pound ripe beets, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon sesame-seed paste | 1/4 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Coat a 9 inch round cake pan with cooking spray and line the bottom with parchment paper. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add beetroot and cook until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain beets, and mix with yogurt, sesame seed paste, and cheddar cheese in a medium bowl until blended.

title: Jalapeno Rellenos
ingredients: 12 jalapeno peppers | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f. Wash jalapenos with warm water. Brush peppers with a thin layer of olive oil. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper.

title: Honey Glazed Corned Beef
ingredients: 5 lbs corned beef brisket | 1 cup honey | 3 cups grand marnier
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Place the corned beef in a roasting pan large enough to hold the meat in a single layer. Pour the honey over the beef, leaving the top and sides open. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, brushing frequently with honey. Turn the meat every 10 minutes and add more honey, if necessary, to moisten. Sprinkle the top with the grand marnier. Place meat on another rack and turn over. Bake for 1 hour, or until tender. Remove from oven, remove the corned beef from the pan, and place on a carving board. Cover and let stand for about 10 minutes before carving the meat.

title: Tarragon-Tarragon Efiche
ingredients: 1/2 lb creme fraiche, at room temp | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon fresh tarragon
instructions: In a bowl, beat the egg white with the tarragon until thick and very stiff.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,beef chuck,cumin seed,chocolate,lemon myrtle,raspberry,flat leaf parsley
title: Shredded Beef, Mushroom & Raspberry Wrapped Buns
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 2 1/2 lbs lean beef chuck, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 16 fluid ounces raspberry, strained | 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate, chopped | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed dried lemon myrtle | 8 button mushrooms | grated parmesan cheese ( optional )
instructions: Toast cumin seeds in dry large skillet over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes. Grind 1/2 cup peppercorns in spice grinder or with mortar and pestle. Season beef with remaining pepper. Add parsley. Grind remaining peppercorns coarsely. Combine beef with remaining ingredients except mushrooms. Divide among 12 greased or paper lined jelly roll pans. Cover. Refrigerate at least 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Preheat broiler. Place beef, mushrooms and remaining marinade in small pan. Cover. Bake at 325 degrees on foil lined baking sheet 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from broiler. Serve with rice biscuits with grated parmesan.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,italian salad dressing mix,asafoetida powder,kaffir lime leaf
title: Italian Antipasto Skewers
ingredients: 1 package italian salad dressing mix | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 3 kaffir lime leaves, divided
instructions: Soak asafoetida powder in hot water for 30 minutes. Drain well and mix. Thread three artichoke pieces on each skewer. Add 1/2 lime to each skewer and skewer the skewered skewer in the skewer. Serve warm.

title: Holiday Cabbage Borscht
ingredients: 2 teaspoons ground hazelnuts | 2 bunches red cabbage, chopped
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. In a small bowl, combine the hazelnut oil and ground hazelnuts.

Random Ingredients: pearl barley,pork rib,greek yogurt,beef stew meat
title: Kurdish Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat or 1 lb lamb stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 lb pork ribs or 1/2 lb veal | 1 cup greek yogurt ( sour cream ) | 2 cups pearl barley ( fresh or frozen )
instructions: Soak pearl barley in several changes of water over night. Heat oven to 325°f. Place stew meat, meat and bones in a large roasting pan. Spread in greek yogurt, breaking up any lumps with fingers. Spoon some into meat and yogurt. Cook for about 1 hour or until meat is tender. Note,. This can be prepared in advance and frozen. Do not over cook the meat.

title: Broiled Blue Cheese and Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 pints light cream or 1 1/2 pints light sour cream | 3/4 cup finely chopped red onion | 1/2 cup very finely diced shallot | 1 medium green chile pepper, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf barley, such as shuck, or 6 tablespoons barley | 1 tablespoon coarsely crumbled blue cheese
instructions: Whisk together the cream or cream cheese, onion, shallot, chili and barley in large bowl.

title: Scrabble in Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium parsnip, medium size, peeled, and chopped | 1 small head of cabbage, shredded | 1 head arugula | 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped | 3 -4 tablespoons parsley leaves, chopped ( if using dried, you may use dried too ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | fresh parsley leaves, for garnish
instructions: Remove any large lumps in the outer leaves of the cabbage before chopping. Boil the 1 cup water and add all of the vegetables. If cooking the vegetables until they are crisp tender, you may need to drain the brine. Drain. Place the contents of the cabbage head, parsley, cilantro, and baking powder into a bowl and mix. Toss together. Sprinkle with parsley leaves. Enjoy as a garnish.

title: Pepperoni Pepperoni Calzone
ingredients: 2 lbs pepperoni | 2 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 loaf frozen dough, thawed
instructions: Cut the pepperoni in half lengthwise and then halve it lengthwise. Wrap each piece in plastic wrap and put in the freezer for at least one hour. Remove the pepperoni half from the freezer and thaw overnight in the refrigerator. Heat oven to 350°f. Wrap the dough in foil and lightly flour surface. Place on cookie sheet and place on middle rack. Roll and stretch dough into 16 inch circles. Place on cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand for five minutes and then remove. Serve warm.

title: Blueberry, Ginger and Cilantro Dessert Dessert
ingredients: 1 cup blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 cups fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 1/2 cup currants | 1 teaspoon dried ginger | 1 tablespoon real vanilla bean
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300f degrees. Place the berries in a bowl, add the cilantro, currants, ginger and puree together. Pour into a glass dish or shallow dish. Serve warm. Variation, omit the vanilla bean but add 1 teaspoon of real vanilla bean. Instead of the vanilla bean stir in 1/4 cup of rum for added flavor. You can add 1/8 teaspoon of ground cardamom and/or ground cloves to your taste.

title: Mexican Turkey Cutlets
ingredients: 1 container chunky salsa | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 8 ounces cooked turkey cutlets, cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Mix all ingrendients together in a small bowl for dipping.

title: Giovana's Basil Stir Fry Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup tapioca starch | 1/4 cup dried basil leaves, lightly packed, not packed | 1/4 cup rice wine, for dipping | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Mix ingredients together in a bowl, set aside. Microwave the basil in a glass container, covered with a kitchen towel, for 30 seconds on high 1 - 2 minutes. Rinse with cold water and drain well. Place basil in a shallow dish. Use the back of a spoon or spatula to coat the basil. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,shell pasta,napa cabbage,stone mustard,rigatoni pasta,radish,nutritional yeast
title: Vegan Macaroni Grill Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta, preferably large whole wheat | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 4 ounces chopped napa cabbage ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon stone ground mustard | 1/4 cup grated fresh nutritional yeast | additional radish, diced ( optional ) | shell pasta
instructions: Place the pasta in a large mixing bowl and rinse under cold water until the water is cool. Drain and cut into 2 inch pieces. Toss pasta, 1 tbs of the oil, the cabbage, nutritional yeast and mustard in a large serving bowl. If desired, add the nutritional yeast into the bowl to lightly stir it up. Mix in 1/4 cup of the cheese and/or the radishes and adjust the seasonings if necessary. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Serve at room temperature. Note, make sure you have your cheese very cold so it will be easier to slice when your salad components are done.

Random Ingredients: mackerel,hot chili pepper,pecan half,ice water,orange peel,onion,pepper jack cheese
title: Mexican Mackerel
ingredients: 4 mackerel ( each weighing approximately 2oz., i use king's but any would do ) | pepper jack cheese ( or any other preferred cheese ) | ice water | 1/2 cup mackerel, fresh ( or any other mild seafood ) | 1/2 cup pecan halves | 1/2 medium onion | 2 slices orange peel | 2 tablespoons pecan halves ( or other dried pecan halves ) | 3 tablespoons onions, coarsely chopped
instructions: Clean fish and cut fish into serving size chunks place a bed of mackerel, top with about 1 cup of cheese and enough ice water to just barely cover the fish and bring to the boil, then simmer over moderately low heat until just firm to the touch and the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, about 6 - 8 minutes. Garnish with orange peel and a little of the chopped onion. Serve with the remaining cheese and the pecans. To toast pecan halves place them on a baking sheet and toast in a pre heated oven at 450 f for 10 - 12 minutes or until lightly toasted and beginning to color. Remove toasted pecan halves and set aside to cool slightly. Toast pecan halves in a pre heated oven at 450 f for 10 - 12 minutes or until a light golden brown color, and remove to a plate as soon as pecans turn brown. These require some effort because they are quite dense. Place the remaining cup of cheese in a cheese cloth and squeeze the cheese, then break into small pieces. Drain water from fish and place on a serving platter. Chop onions and combine with the remaining cheese and minced orange peel in a small bowl. Drain soaked pecans and place in mortar with the dry pecan bread crumbs. Add 1 tablespoon pecan oil to a skillet and add the dried onion mixture and fry gently about 3 minutes until soft and fragrant, and then add half the garlic and all of the spice mixture. Fry for a few minutes and then add the remaining spice mixture. To serve, place the fish on a serving plate and surround with the onion bread mixture. Garnish with pecan halves and chopped onion.

title: Vanilla "vassilavian" Preserve
ingredients: 1 fresh ice | honey ( for topping ) | crushed ice ( for topping )
instructions: Combine ice & honey & drizzle over crushed ice.

title: Cheese Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups cubed sharp cheddar cheese | 2 cups fresh strawberries
instructions: Combine the cheese, strawberries and cheese cubes in a 2 cup microwave safe casserole dish. Pour mixture into the microwave. Place on medium, uncovered, until the cheese is melted and the casserole dish is hot and bubbling immediately.

title: Tortillas De Olla
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meat ( chicken, veal, chicken sausage, beef, pork, goat, pork, poultry... ) | 2 cups rolled oats ( about 3/4-inch diameter ) | 2 cups chopped prunes | 4 -6 tablespoons adobo sauce ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon black pepper ( try it with a whole cloves and a few pinches of oregano and basil and use as a powder ) | 1 -2 teaspoon cracked black peppercorns ( optional )
instructions: If you have a grill pan, heat oil, put in a few cloves and a whole black pepper in the pan and stir fry until you see bubbles. Put in meat, and continue stir frying until meat starts to brown. Put in a large bowl, then mix in rolled oats, chopped prunes, adobo, and spices. If the meat is very dry before the oats are ground, it may need to be moisten with a little milk or water. Serve with tortillas.

title: Poppy Seed and Olive Smashes
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu | 1/2 cup dried black olives | 1 can chicken-flavored crushed tomatoes | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant tea
instructions: Wrap the tofu in a double thickness of cheesecloth. Press cheesecloth into the bottom of a small microwave safe baking dish. Microwave on high until tofu is hot and has softened, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove tofu from microwave and press out excess moisture. Cut the tofu into chunks and combine with the dried black olives and 2 teaspoons of the crushed tomato, poppy seeds and instant tea. Sprinkle the remaining crushed tomatoes over the tofu mixture and drizzle with enough hot tap water to cover. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high until water is absorbed, about 20 minutes.

title: Chile and Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 5 poblano chiles, roasted, seeded, and finely chopped | 1/3 cup dark molasses | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 5 pita breads, warmed for serving
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and return to the pot. In a large bowl, stir together the pasta, poblanos, molasses and cornstarch. Serve hot with warm pitas.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,buttermilk,dietz watson santa fe turkey breast,rye bread,bay leaf
title: Smoked Turkey & Cabbage Tea Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread ( or 2 slices sandwich buns ) | 18 ounces dietz watson santa fe ( turkey mayo ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup low-fat buttermilk | 4 slices lemon peel ( for sprinkling ) | 1 small bay leaf, crushed ( for optional garnish )
instructions: Spread bread with buttermilk. Lay santa fe on one slice of bread. In the center of the swiss roll, place turkey, bacon slices on top o la faride/mayo. Place second slice of bread on top and place sliced lemon peel on top of turkey. Place second slice of bread on top. Cut in half diagonally and enjoy.

title: Tortillas in Almonds
ingredients: 3 tablespoons almonds ( or almonds of choice ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons instant turkey stock | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 2 -3 soft ladyfingers
instructions: Blend almonds with turkey stock and almond extract. Lay out one ladyfinger at a time on a clean flat surface. Spread 1 tablespoon of almond mixture on ladyfinger, and roll up towards the exposed end. Using a sharp knife, tie off the ends with twine. Spray nonstick griddle with cooking spray, or spread with oil. Place tortilla on hot griddle. Cook one side of the tortilla about 1 - 2 minutes, until lightly browned. Repeat process with remaining tortillas. Transfer to plates, and serve with a fruit salad.

title: Pear and Yogurt Sandwiches (21 Day Wonder Diet :day 1 )
ingredients: 2 thick slices white bread | 12 teaspoons fat free lowfat yogurt | 2 pears, thinly sliced lengthways ( about 2 cups ) | paprika
instructions: Place bread on oven tray. Using your fingers, press a large spoonful of the yogurt into each slice of bread. Place pears into yogurt on top. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Smoked Salmon Salad
ingredients: 16 ounces smoked salmon, cubed | 4 large tart apples, peeled, cored, and quartered | 16 ounces green chili salsa | 1/2 medium red chile | 1 pint mixed berries
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill for an hour.

title: Black Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 lb canned black-eyed peas | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Boil 3 cups of water and add 2 cups of sugar. Boil about 20 minutes, drain. Rinse beans and put in a bowl and then add the peas and mix. Let stand 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Pour into a small buttered baking dish and sprinkle with 1/2 cup of parmesan. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,anaheim chilies,prosciutto,chipotle chile,kahlua,celery,cinnamon,romaine lettuce heart
title: Mexican Chili Salad
ingredients: 4 teaspoons pureed chipotle chiles ( from a jar ) | 4 ounces sliced prosciutto | 1 head romaine lettuce hearts | 8 leaves fresh arugula or 8 leaves chard | 14 1/2 ounces kidney beans or 14 1/2 ounces black beans, rinsed and drained | 6 anaheim chilies ( i prefer red ) | 1 ounce kahlua | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Mix the spices together in a small bowl. Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet and set over medium heat. When the bacon has turned a bit crispy, add the chipotle mixture and stir. Then add the tomato salsa and stir until well combined. Add the greens, lettuce and beans and stir to combine. Finally, add the kahlua, stir and top with bacon.

title: Quick Beef Brisket
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket ( i use beef brisket ) | white pepper | 1/3 lb grated fontina cheese
instructions: Sprinkle brisket with pepper and top with cheese. Place in crock pot. Cook on low for 5 - 7 hours. Pull beef off of crock and serve.

title: Green Chile Sushi Rolls
ingredients: 1 piece nori, seaweed | 2 tablespoons walnut oil | 1 teaspoon coconut oil | 1/8 - 1/4 - 1/2 small fresh green chili pepper, coarsely chopped
instructions: Take a piece of nori and cut it into 4 squares. Remove the shiny membrane of the nori with a teaspoon, then cut the nori in half diagonally about 1/8 in thickness. Use a melon baller or melon baller, scoop out the center of each square and set one square on a damp towel. Roll the nori up into a cylinder then slice along the length of the nori with a long, thin sliceer to keep the nori in a single but tight piece. Repeat until all pieces have been used. Put the nori on a cutting board using a rolling pin or small plate to keep the roll from slipping. To make the walnut oil, in a small stainless steel or nonstick skillet, heat the oil to just below a simmer. Take a nori square and press down on it lightly with your fingers. With your finger, flatten out the circle with the palm of your hand to make a cone shape measuring about 6 inches long, but not so deep that it breaks. Be careful not to tear the nori apart. Then spread the nori with about 2 tablespoons of walnut oil, pressing with one of your fingers to make an even coating of oil. Place 2/3 of the green chili pepper slices evenly over half of the nori. Sprinkle half the remaining walnut oil over the green chili. Repeat the process until all 3 nori has been used. Spread half the vegetable oil over and around the filling. Arrange the nori evenly over the filling.

title: Polish Sausage With Broccoli & Apricot
ingredients: 1 small broccoli, about 12oz | 1/2 peach, peeled and sliced | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup cranberries | 8 slices kielbasa or 8 slices polish sausage | sliced shallots | 2 teaspoons coconut milk
instructions: Cut broccoli into florets and steam until tender crisp. Remove peel if necessary. Meanwhile toast jam until golden in a non stick pan and set aside. Heat curry saucepan and fry sausages until brown in a little oil. Add pineapple, apricot conserve and the broth. Add broccoli to saucepan and cook until heated through. Top with peach slices and swirl in jelly and serve with rice.

title: Quick Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread dough, thawed | 1 envelope orange juice concentrate, thawed
instructions: Turn over dough onto floured board. Roll out dough on floured board to a thickness of 1/4 inches. Cut out dough into two rounds, and place one round on cookie sheet. Spread one tablespoon of orange concentrate on top of dough, and spread other tablespoon of orange juice on top. Using a cookie cutter, cut dough rounds into quarters to fit loaf size pan.

title: Rice Noodles With Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces rice noodles | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 tablespoon superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons coarse grain mustard
instructions: Heat a wok until smoking. Add the noodles and stir fry for 2 minutes add the stock, sugar and mustard, bring to the boil. Cover, turn heat to medium and simmer until tender about 8 mins stir through the noodles before serving.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,cream,farfalle pasta,heavy whipping cream,golden raisin,olive
title: Spicy White Curry Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon red curry paste, or more to taste | 1 cup golden raisins | 1 teaspoon olive, or to taste, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook farfalle pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain.

title: Quick Mustard Seasoning Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red pepper | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Store in a jar with a tight fitting lid. This is the basic mustard mixture for dippers and sauces.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,ancho chili,cumin seed,orange juice concentrate,oatmeal,icing sugar,tzatziki,lamb
title: Moroccan Lamb Meatballs
ingredients: 4 teaspoons ground ancho chili | 1 1/4 lbs lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 orange, juice concentrate | 1/2 large green bell pepper, minced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped dried ancho chili or 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper | 2 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin seeds | 1/4 cup dried tzatziki, divided | 2/3 cup light tasting icing sugar | 1/2 cup oatmeal
instructions: In bowl, combine 1 teaspoons ground ancho chili, lamb, orange juice concentrate, bell pepper, ancho pepper, cumin and 1/4 cup tzatziki. Mix well and add remaining tzatziki. Cover and blend well. If using in a bowl, add 1 teaspoon ground ancho chili, 1 teaspoon chopped ancho pepper and 1/2 teaspoon cayenne.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,fennel seed,ziti pasta,italian sausage,red wine vinegar,bourbon,yellow squash,idaho potato
title: Texas Spiced Ziti
ingredients: 1 pound dry ziti pasta | 1 yellow squash, cut in half lengthwise and then sliced | 1 ziti pasta | 2 pounds sweet italian sausage | 2 large vidaho potatoes, cut into wedges | 1 teaspoon fennel seeds | 1 bottle bourbon | 1 cup red wine vinegar | 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook ziti in the boiling water until just tender but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes. Drain pasta. Meanwhile, place the squash in a large saucepan and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until the squash is tender, about 30 minutes. Drain. Cut the ziti into 1 1/2 inch pieces. Meanwhile, place the sausage in a large, deep skillet and brown over medium high heat, breaking it up as it cooks, until the meat is browned, about 10 minutes. Drain fat and discard. Return the meat and any accumulated juices to the skillet. Add the potatoes and ziti and stir to coat with the fat. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the ziti is completely coated with the meat mixture, about 10 minutes. Stir in the fennel seeds and bourbon. Stir in the red wine vinegar. Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar, and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Taco Buns Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 green capsicum, chopped | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients and form into a ball. Place on oiled baking tray and rise for 35 mins in a warm place. Allow to cool and cut into 3 slices.

title: Yukon Gold Potato & Parsnip Mash
ingredients: 300 g yukon gold potatoes | 200 g parsnips | 200 g black beans
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender. Drain and mash with the beans. Place in a bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hr, and up to 3 days.

title: Homemade Refried Beans (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Spread both cans beans in a paper or plastic container with an air tight lid. Microwave for 2 minutes. Turn and microwave another 2 minutes. Turn off. Stir and store in an air tight container.

title: Pimento Molcajete
ingredients: 14 pimento stuffed olives | 6 tablespoons unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Line a baking sheet with foil and put it on the oven rack. Cut open the olives a few times, scoop out the flesh with a spoon and put them in a bowl. Add the butter and cardamom pailament seeds to olives, stir and coat the olives with the mixture. Arrange them on the baking sheet. Cook for about 20 to 30 minutes, stirring once halfway through. When ready to serve, spread the butter on top and bake, until the butter is golden.

title: Mini Hot Steak Pies
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh lean ground beef | 1 lb fresh lean ground beef tenderloin | 2 teaspoons mild teapsoon crushed dried chilies | 4 teaspoons extra strength double strength ground beef and 1 teaspoon dried small red chilies | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container at room temperature up to 1 week.

title: Spinach Rolls With Toasted Yellow Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1/4 cup yellow diced roasted yellow sweet pepper | 1/2 tablespoon dried bay leaf | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 tablespoons crumbled cooked bacon | 1/3 teaspoon crushed dried bay leaf | 1 1/8 lbs spinach, cleaned, stemmed and cut in 1/2-inch pieces | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Using hands, mix 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/4 cup diced roasted yellow sweet pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of dried bay leaf. Roll mixture into 1 inch diameter log and secure with toothpicks. Place on a plate and cover with plastic wrap. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, combine the chopped toasted yellow pepper, 1/2 t. Sauce and 1/8 teaspoon each of salt and pepper and 1 tablespoon bacon. Cook over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until peppers are browned, about 4 minutes. Add the remaining 1/8 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper and the dried bay leaf. Toss well. Add spinach and cook over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until spinach is wilted, about 3 minutes. Spoon about 1 teaspoon of vegetable mixture, about 2 tablespoons, on each sheet of spinach. Roll up tightly and tie ends. Grill rolls, uncovered, over moderately high heat until bell peppers are lightly charred, about 3 minutes. Brush rolls with remaining 2 tablespoons of hot butter on all sides.

Random Ingredients: pomegranate juice,grain white rice,red chili pepper flake,nori,cooking oil,lettuce leaf
title: Easy Furikake
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried red chili pepper flakes, minced | 1/2 cup pomegranate juice | 2 pints cooked short-grain white rice | lettuce leaf ( optional ) | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | cooking oil or vegetable cooking spray
instructions: Drain the pomegranate juice well into a bowl. Add the chile flakes into the juice. Stir well to blend. Add the rice and stir, or just until the rice grains are coated, about 1 minute. Lay the nori seaweed on a flat surface, shiny side down. Carefully flip up the nori so it is shiny side up. Spread a thin layer of cooking oil or cooking spray across the nori, taking care not to let it spill. Place about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the rice mixture in the center of the nori. Wet your fingers a little with water, and pinch the edges of the seaweed to seal. Repeat with remaining rice and seaweed mixture, until all the ingredients are used. Using a sharp knife cut the seaweed into 2 or 3 slices. Arrange the nori around the rice and top with more rice if desired. Let stand 2 - 5 minutes before serving.

title: Beef Stewed in Butter
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 3 tablespoons butter | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1 medium white onion, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: In saucepan or dutch oven, put meat cubes in enough water to cover them. Bring to boil and add butter, mix well and boil for 15 - 20 minutes. Dredge cubes in the mixture and simmer over medium heat until meat is tender. While meat is cooking, in large skillet, heat ketchup, onion and cornstarch until boiling, stirring constantly. Add about 1/2 cup of the cooked meat and mix well to coat pieces with sauce. Cook on low until thickened.

title: Beetroot Arborio Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 8 cups homemade beets, trimmed and chopped | 1/2 package frozen baby beets in syrup, thawed, patted dry and chopped | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Cook rice according to pkg directions, omitting oil and fat. Serve beets and baby beetroot on the side.

Random Ingredients: white,sesame oil,rice,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Simple Lebanese Spice
ingredients: 500 g rice | 5 tablespoons shahtzatziki | 2 1/3 tablespoons sesame oil | 4 1/2 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Cook both the rice and ingredients in a pot until you start to see steam in the pot.

title: Chicken Breasts in Garam Masala
ingredients: 1 kg chicken breast, diced | 1/4 cup finely chopped parsley | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and leave to marinate overnight, ideally overnight. Bake in a hot oven for 45 minutes, turn and bake for 15 minutes, basting regularly.

title: Dried Fruit Salad (Kariyaki)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 cup dried fruit, such as apricots, apples, pears, applesauce, apple wedges
instructions: In a small serving bowl, stir together the rice wine vinegar, white vinegar, mixed candied fruits and dry fruit. Transfer to an airtight container and keep well covered.

Random Ingredients: spinach,beef broth,vinegar,jalapeno pepper,beef bouillon cube,cayenne powder
title: Spinach Soup
ingredients: 32 ounces frozen chopped spinach | 1 can condensed beef broth | 3 -4 jalapeno peppers, minced ( optional ) | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon vinegar or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne powder
instructions: Clean and dice spinach. Put in soup pot. Add rest of ingredients. Bring to a boil. Cover. Simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Sushi Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups prepared small shell pasta | 2 tablespoons toasted pine nuts | 2 sheets nori, divided | 2 ounces grated semisweet chocolate ( see note ) | 1/4 cup romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: Cook pasta in plenty of boiling water until al dente'. Drain and cool completely. Mix pasta, pine nuts, 1 nori sheet nori, chocolate and lettuce together in a large bowl. Serve with remaining nori sheet on side for garnish. Note, to toast the nori, use a 10 nonstick skillet over medium heat. Break each sheet into fourths and fry for a few seconds.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,cottage cheese,midori melon liqueur,cinnamon,maple syrup
title: Midori Beef Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin ( trimmed ) | 1 can condensed cottage cheese | 1/4 cup midori melon liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4maple syrup, to drizzle
instructions: Prepare baking dish. Place beef on baking sheet and drizzle with midori. Sprinkle with cinnamon and drizzle with maple syrup to cover beef mixture evenly. Bake at 450 for 35 minutes, until beef is medium rare. Serve.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,celery leaf,rice noodle,mozzarella cheese,baking powder,mustard powder,tahini,pine nut
title: Crock Pot Tahini Rice Noodle Bake
ingredients: 8 ounces dried rice noodle, broken into 3/4 inch pieces | 1 package chopped celery leaves | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup dry mustard powder | 1 cup shredded low-fat mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Rinse the noodles, and then drain. Spray the inside of the crock pot with cooking spray. Place the noodles in the bottom of the crock. In a large bowl, mix the celery leaves and tahini with the mustard and mix well. In the empty bowl, add the cheese, pine nuts, yogurt, and baking powder. Mix until the ingredients are well blended. Pour the tahini mixture over the noodles and mix well. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,butter,french bread,mix vegetable,green chili pepper,hot pepper,splenda granular,milk chocolate
title: French Bread  Snack Mix
ingredients: 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk chocolate | 1/4 cup butter, melted | 1/4 cup splenda granular ( or to taste ) | 1 medium hot pepper, finely chopped | 1 small green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar, sifted | 1 loaf french bread, loaf | 1 package mix-colored vegetables ( such as zucchini, celery, mushrooms )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 1 1/2 quart dish with no stick spray. Combine the sweetened condensed milk chocolate, butter, splenda granular, chilli, and confectioners' sugar in a small bowl. Cut a slit into the top of each french loaf loaf, 1 inch deep, with a long piece of the end attached. Place the loaves in the prepared dish and sprinkle with the melted chocolate mixture. Bake in a preheated oven 12 to 15 minutes, or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Serve with hot fruit spread and whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: hamburger bun,star anise,black bean sauce,baker yeast,fennel
title: Easy Chinese Black Bean-Manburger Barbecue
ingredients: 1 package star anise | 1/2 loaf unshelled baked ground or dried beef | 1/4 loaf unshelled baker's yeast | 1 can black-bean sauce | 4 -10 hamburger buns, split
instructions: Combine all ingredients except burgers and bun bottoms in pan, stirring to mix. Cook on medium heat for 30 minutes. Remove from heat, uncover, and cool to 38 degrees. Pour into freezer for 10 minutes. To do this, remove from freezer a slice of beef, keeping in a piece of meat and shred with two forks. Return shredded beef to pan and heat through. While beef is cooking, heat black bean sauce to simmer, stirring occasionally, and place a portion of the buns on each bottom half of the bun. To toast the bun, place a slice of beef against the bottom half and top with bean sauce to serve. Fold the burger over and enjoy.

title: Quick Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 medium beets | 4 cups napa cabbage, shredded | 1 bottle picante sauce
instructions: Boil beets. Remove from heat. Set beets aside until cool enough to handle, about 20 minutes. Peel and cut into 1/4 in thick slices crosswise. Place in a bowl. Briefly steam cabbage until just tender. Remove. Place cabbage in a colander or strainer and squeeze out excess moisture. Place on a platter. Add 1/4 cup picante sauce and remaining picante to beet beet mixture. Pour over cabbage. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,cooking apple,pine nut,beef broth,spice,taco seasoning,marsala,chipotle chile
title: Picadillo (Apple Chipotle Spread)
ingredients: 3 cups quick-cooking apples, peeled, cored and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted ( optional ) | 1/2 cup mushroom broth, low sodium | 1/2 cup light-colored port wine or 1/2 cup marsala | 2 tablespoons minced canned chipotle chiles ( or a combination of the two ) | spice | 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest | 1 teaspoon hot taco seasoning
instructions: Place the first seven ingredients in a food processor, pulsing until combined but not pureed. Spoon into a bowl and stir in the taco seasoning. Cover and put in the refrigerator to chill, about 2 hours.

title: Basil's Roasted Almonds
ingredients: 3 -5 cups roasted, salted almonds | 1 1/2 cups fresh breadcrumbs | 1 sprig fresh rosemary ( or 1/2 tsp dried ) ( optional )
instructions: Grind the almonds to a fine powder. Mix everything with a mortar and pestle until it's the consistancy of coarse meal. Use to stuff or bake your favorite christmas bread. Enjoy serves.

title: Käpkola (Cabbage Soup)
ingredients: 2 pinches fennel seeds | 1 napa cabbage ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 cup cream or 1 cup milk
instructions: Toast fennel seeds in a heavy skillet over medium high heat, stirring frequently, until golden, about 3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a bowl. Add cabbage and let it stand at room temperature, then drain to remove excess moisture.

title: Eggplant with Pepper
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 1 can chili peppers ( or your favorite pepper ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes
instructions: Cut ends off egg plant and peel skin off skin if desired. Place eggplant on paper towel and twist to remove excess moisture. Cut slits in egg plant. In large pan, saute eggplant and chili pepper in olive oil for about 10 minutes. Drain liquid from pan. Add water and boil the mixture until it is reduced to about 1 cup. Serve.

Random Ingredients: greek seasoning,barley,hot red chili pepper,graham cracker crumb,corn tortilla chip
title: Gerry's Mexican Cheesy Barley Nachos
ingredients: 32 ounces corn tortilla chips, crumpled on the bottom | 1 -2 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon hot red chili pepper | 2 cups barley, fresh, chopped ( or barley ) | 32 ounces greek-style tortilla chips
instructions: Place all of the ingrediants into a pot, except the gerry's seasoning. Stir over low heat, until desired thickness. Sprinkle gerry's seasoning over chips and eat.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,ketchup,honey mustard,green pepper,kahlua,wild mushroom,gluten flour,green bell pepper
title: Bacon Packets
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry sheet | 6 slices bacon, chopped | 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped | 6 tablespoons ketchup | 6 tablespoons kahlua | 6 tablespoons honey mustard | 1/2 cup wild mushroom, chopped, such as chestnut, shiitake, oyster, mushroom | 2 cups gluten flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until beginning to crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon, and cook green bell peppers in the drippings until tender, about 8 minutes. Stir in the ketchup, kahlua, and mustard until combined. Stir in green bell peppers and mushrooms, and set aside. Place a sheet of pastry in bottom of a 15x10x1 inch baking dish, and brush generously with a little water. Lay the phyllo sheets on top of each other in a line about 1/2 inch wide and 1/2 inch thick. Spoon on 1/4 cup bacon mixture, covering the entire length of the phyllo sheet. Place a second sheet of phyllo on top of the first one, brushing with melted butter. Spread the remaining filling over the phyllo sheets, and spread evenly. Brush the top with butter, and then cut a slit in the length of the phyllo crosswise for each bundle. Scoop up all the filing, and place the bundles on top of the bacon. Pour enough water into the baking dish to come 1 inch up the sides of the phyllo sheets. Bake in the preheated oven until phyllo is crisp, 30 to 35 minutes.

Random Ingredients: topping,rosemary leaf,turnip,tomato green chilies,red pepper,spaghetti,basmati rice
title: Spanish Rice and Turnips in Tomato Cream and Chilies
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup frozen turnip ( about 1 medium ) | 1 sweet red pepper ( about 1/3-4-1/2 lb ) | 1 sprig fresh rosemary leaf | 1/4 cup tostada ( optional ) | topped, if using ( optional )
instructions: Place rice in a large bowl and dump in the undrained tomatoes, turnips, and sweet red pepper. Sprinkle with rosemary and toss gently. Transfer to a 9x13 baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Top with tostada and fresh rosemary leaves. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,soymilk,tomato puree,broccoli stem,egg white,sesame seed,lime wedge
title: Cinnamon Broccoli Mousse
ingredients: 1/4 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted and finely ground | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 package frozen broccoli stems | 1 large egg white, whisked | 1 teaspoon pure ground cinnamon | 1 can tomato puree | glazed lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Place the soy milk, sesame seeds and cinnamon in a small saucepan over low heat and bring to a simmer. Set aside to cool. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Place the broccoli spears in the water and cook 2 minutes. Drain and plunge into ice water and drain again. Cut the stalks off of the broccoli, remove tips and set aside. Blanch the frozen broccoli in a large pot of boiling water until just tender. Drain, rinse under cold water, drain and set aside. In a small bowl, whisk the egg white with the cinnamon until just combined. Incorporate the soy milk with the beaten egg white. Drain the broccoli and then return it to the boiling water for about 1 minute. Remove and stir in the cinnamon mixture and tomato puree. Cook over low heat for about 3 to 5 minutes. Pour into serving dishes and top with the ginger marmalade. Garnish with lime wedges and a splash of sesame oil.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,golden syrup,lemon wedge,garlic clove,yogurt,onion powder,rice noodle,thyme
title: Yogurt Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 small onion, diced | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 4 cups rice noodles | 3 cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried thyme | 1 1/2 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the golden syrup, onion, garlic, and rice noodles. Fold in the diced tomatoes with chilies, lemon juice, thyme, and yogurt. Mix thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: salsa,irish whiskey,mint,red chile,beef stew meat,prosciutto,cooking spray
title: Irish Whiskey Beef Stew
ingredients: cooking spray | 1/4 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 jar salsa | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red chile | 1 sprig minced fresh mint | 4 slices thinly sliced prosciutto
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler. Spray the inside of a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Toss the beef cubes with 1/4 of the salsa, whiskey and crushed chile in a large bowl until evenly coated. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. When it shimmers, add the beef. Cook and stir until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Scatter the mint over the beef. Place the ham atop the mint. Serve with any remaining salsa on the side.

title: Bacon Wrapped Italian Sausages
ingredients: 4 thick-cut bacon, slices | 12 ounces bulk italian sausage | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/3 cup quick-cooking oil | 4 large beets, halved and sliced crosswise | 1 serrano pepper, diced ( or to taste ) | 12 ounces fresh arugula, cleaned and stemmed | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Wrap each sausage separately with 2 slices bacon.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,pizza crust,sesame seed oil,pineapple tidbit
title: Quick and Easy Pineapple Pizza
ingredients: 1 prebaked pizza crust | 1 cup pineapple tidbits ( drained ) | 4 teaspoons sesame seed oil | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste
instructions: Lay pizza crust flat. Spoon pineapple tidbits onto crust. Mix seaseme seeds oil and tamarind paste, pour over pineapple. Spread to the desired thickness. Place under hot grill, skin side down.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,maraschino cherry,serrano chilies,pigeon pea,salmon fillet,oregano,honey,egg white
title: Portuguese Marinated Salmon
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh oregano | 3 serrano chilies, cut into rounds | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/4 cup stone-ground dried apricot, soaked in | 2 teaspoons ice cold water for 30 minutes ( optional ) | 4 lbs salmon fillets, bone-in ( about 1.5 lbs ) | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley
instructions: Preheat broiler to medium. In a large bowl, combine oregano, chillies, honey and apricots. Drain salmon fillets, reserving marinade. Place on a broiler pan skin side down. Broil, flesh side down, for 3 to 5 minutes or till skin is lightly browned. Turn once, broil until fish flakes easily with fork. Cool. In another wide bowl, whisk together egg white and parsley. Roll each salmon fillet in toasted oregano mixture, coating evenly. Arrange fillets on serving platter, arranging fish on top, and spoon reserved marinade over. Serve with rice pilaf.

title: Perfect Orzo
ingredients: 1 pound dry orzo pasta | 2 teaspoons garlic powder, divided | 1 can orzo pasta, drained
instructions: In a large pot of lightly salted boiling water, cook orzo until tender, about 11 minutes.

title: Persian Style Traditional Kugel (Makrout)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 5 large eggs
instructions: Use a small oven proof skillet. Place 1 tablespoon of saffron in a cup or bowl and rub the surface with a little bit of oil. Place in the oven uncovered, and warm for 45 minutes. Crack the eggs into a large bowl for a creamy texture. Beat the eggs on a low medium speed until light and fluffy. Slowly start adding the remaining saffron. Add some or all of the powdered saffron. Blend until fluffy, then add the egg, mixing gently with a fork. Heat the kugel until it begins to set up, then cook on a pan in the oven for 45 minutes, or until a brownishish puffy top appears. This will take approximately 10 minutes.

title: Roasted Tomatoes With Balsamic
ingredients: 4 medium plum tomatoes | 6 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f peel plum tomatoes and discard the skin. Cut the top skin of each plum tomato and, using a vegetable peeler, scrape off the peel. Scrape off the tomato bottoms, leaving about 1/4 inch of flesh on the inside of the tomatoes. Cut away any tough stems which have begun to peel when oven is up to 200°f brush or spray olive oil on the tomatoes and set aside. Place the tomato cut side down on an oiled baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until very soft and beginning to brown. Turn the tomato's cut side down and sprinkle with a little sesame oil. Replace the baking sheet and sprinkle the tomatoes with sesame oil. Return the baking sheet to the oven for 10 minutes or until the tomatoes are roasted and the skins are crisping. Remove the tomato tops from the baking sheet with a metal spatula and let cool to room temperature. Peel the skin away from the tomato skins and discard all the pulp.

title: Killer Rice Linguine With Rum and Currants
ingredients: 4 cups cooked jasmine rice | 1/2 cup currants | 2 tablespoons fresh minced dill or 1 tablespoon dried dill | 1 tablespoon louisiana-style hot sauce ( to taste... i use `` creole-style hot '' ) | 1 1/2 cups sour cream ( low-fat is good ) | 1 teaspoon mulling spice ( or to taste, i like hungarian spice blend ) | 4 cups chilled steaming coleslaw blend ( such as coleslaw mix ) | 1 lb linguine, cooked and drained ( or use linguine of your choice )
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except for the coleslaw mix. To serve, arrange a few coleslaw mix on each plate. Spoon on prepared pasta and fluff with a fork.

title: Aussie Sticky Rice - Microwave
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice, rinsed dry | 2 cups orange juice | 3 tablespoons capers, rinsed | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Stir the rice into the orange juice. Scatter over the capers and vanilla. Cover and set timer for 20 minutes, then leave for 5 minutes on high and 30 minutes on low to leave a little wickiness. Stir once or twice during cooking or leave off for the final 2 minutes to steam. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,beef broth,ha avocadoes,provolone cheese,italian parsley,berry,egg white,chicken part
title: Baked Avocado Chicken
ingredients: 2 large hass avocadoes | 1 1/2 lbs lean boneless skinless chicken parts | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 lb thinly sliced provolone cheese, cut into 1/2 inch-thick rounds | 1/4 cup canned beef broth | 1/4 cup chopped fresh italian parsley | fresh french berry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Halve and pit avocadoes and set aside. Remove seeds from remaining avocados. Cut crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices and arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with nonstick cooking spray. Bake until slightly charred & soft, 8 - 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. Place chicken in a medium bowl & using a fork, poke holes all over chicken& turning to coat. Whisk egg white until stiff peaks form and add to remaining ingredients and whisk until well blended. Gradually whisk in cornstarch and set aside. Scatter both cheeses on bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Pour vegetable mixture over cheese. Spread avocado mixture evenly over top and sprinkle with parsley. Bake until cheese is melted, about 20 minutes.

title: Squash & Yellow Squash Salsa
ingredients: 1 squash, halved lengthwise and seeded | 4 ears fresh corn kernels or 4 ears fresh pumpkin, peeled and coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut squash in half from top to root end, then cut into thin julienne slices. Remove stalks from corn and cut in 1 inch pieces. Put squash in a bowl. Toss squash in same bowl with corn. Serve warm or let cool to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: alfalfa sprout,cilantro,extra sharp cheddar cheese,basil,broccoli,yellow squash,turmeric powder
title: Broccoli, Yellow Squash and Noodles With Cilantro
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, cut into florets, stems removed | 1 medium yellow squash, cut into medium chunks, seeds scraped out | 2 -3 ounces alfalfa sprouts | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, roughly chopped | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Boil the water and add the broccoli and squash just until tender, and drain. Place the vegetables in a serving bowl, and add the herbs. Sprinkle on the cheese and serve.

title: Lemon Macaroni Chips With Lemons
ingredients: 8 ounces shell pasta, such as macaroni | 6 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 cup packed grated peel from a lemons or 1 cup grated rind from 1/2 lemon
instructions: Bring 4 quarts of salted water to a boil over high heat.

title: Pesto Crusted Ham W-Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 3 lbs ham | marjoram | pepper | plain yogurt | plain yogurt
instructions: Brine. Rinse ham, remove netting from ends, and place ham in a dutch oven, and coat with marjoram. Add water to cover, and let marinate in fridge for 2 hours. Take out of dutch oven, and place into casserole dish. In medium bowl, combine 2 ozs. Yogurt and 1/2 cup chopped fresh pesto, and mix well until it's spreadable. Spread over ham. Bake at 350 for 35 - 45 minutes, or until ham is nicely browned and cooked through.

title: Mango Chapati
ingredients: 2 cups flour | 2 tablespoons sesame seed oil | 2 tablespoons mango chutney
instructions: Mix the flour and seeds. Use an electric mixer. Add the chutney to the flour and seeds. Make a well. Make a small ball. Put the dough in the well. Add the mango chutney. Work quickly to make a flat dough. Make round balls. Roll out between palms into thin circles. Cut rounds using a round cookie cutter. Serve plain or with your choice of sauces.

title: French Garlic Ice Cream
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon rind | 1/8 cup creme fraiche, chilled
instructions: In small saucepan, cover cream with water.

title: Beef and Beet Jerky
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steak | 1 lb mixed white beans | 4 frozen beet | 1 package ladyfingers | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning
instructions: Slice beef very thin. Wash, peel, dice. Prepare frozen beets and beans. Thaw and slice. Soak for 15 minutes at room temperature. Place beef between 2 sheets of wax paper and pound lightly with the flat side of a meat mallet. When beef is well pounded, spread thinly with a paper towel. Place a few beets on one side of the beef, and a few beet and beans around the beef. Close and enclose with a kitchen towel. Wrap tightly in aluminum foil and store in the refrigerator up to 3 days. To serve, remove wrap and remove beef from refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 1/2 hour. Remove and slice into thin strips. To serve, place strips on individual serving plates, and top with sliced beef.

Random Ingredients: broccoli stem,curly leaf parsley,golden syrup,anchovy,cucumber,shrimp paste,shallot,marjoram
title: Spiced Shrimp on Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 cup peeled cucumber, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup fresh curly-leaf parsley, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup shallot, chopped | 2 teaspoons anchovy, chopped | 1 teaspoon shrimp paste | 2 teaspoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed | 1/2 cup broccoli stems
instructions: Combine cucumber, parsley, shallots, anchovies, shrimp paste, golden syrup, marjoram, and broccoli in a bowl. Toss with 1/4 cup of the reserved marinade. Marinate shrimp 2 hours in the refrigerator, turning occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and beginning to turn pink.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,panko breadcrumb,sesame seed,tomato green chilies,baby spinach,graham cracker crust
title: Veggie Crumb Pie (Tossed Up)
ingredients: 1 graham cracker crust | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 4 -5 tablespoons cornmeal | 3 medium tomatoes with green chilies, chopped | baby spinach ( optional )
instructions: Spray pie plate with cooking spray. Put a large spoonful of crushed graham crackers in the pie plate.
