In another bowl, sprinkle sesame seeds over the crackers, then slowly stir in panko and cornmeal. Sprinkle a couple pinches of cornmeal on top of the panko. Pour mixture on top of the crackers in the pie plate. Sprinkle chopped tomatoes and sesame if desired over top. Cover and chill for 3 hours. If you need to, slice up the spinach into small pieces and then stir. Serve alongside a side of recipe #.

Random Ingredients: ham,stewing beef,granny smith apple,hot water,yellow pepper,currant,sage leaf,shortening
title: English Beef Stew With Apples and Sausages
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shortening | 6 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1. 5 inches cubes | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 large yellow pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 cup hot water | 2 lbs cooked peeled, chopped raw apples | 6 ounces dried currants | 1 cup chopped fresh sage leaf
instructions: Melt the shortening in a heavy 5 qt. Bowl over medium high heat and cook the meat until lightly browned and crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. Add the sage and yellow pepper, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove the meat and discard the spices and sage from the skillet. Pour the hot water into the skillet and bring to a simmer over high heat. Add the cooked meat to the simmering vegetables and cook until the meat is just tender, about 30 minutes. Stir in the apples and currants and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove the stew from the heat. Cover and keep hot at low simmer for 10 minutes. Ladle hot stew into 8 ovenproof serving bowls. Sprinkle the top with chopped fresh sage.

title: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 small turnip, peeled and finely chopped | 1 small red bell pepper, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Using oven mitts or a cookie scoop, transfer the turnip to a rack on the rack over a roasting pan. Drizzle the turnip evenly with the pesto, and sprinkle with chopped red pepper. Roast, stirring occasionally, in a 450f degree oven until the turnip and bell pepper are tender and beginning to brown, about 35 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Chocolate-Sultana Fudge
ingredients: 4 ounces milk chocolate | 1/4 cup sultana | fresh fresh cilantro stem, to garnish
instructions: Place chocolate, sultanas and cilantro in a microwave safe bowl, and heat on medium heat, stir constantly until melted and smooth. Pour into a cup, seal with a thin film of oil, and leave for 2 hours until set. If not serving immediately.

title: Fried Olives With Cheese and Thyme
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped mixed olives | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1/8 teaspoon thyme sprig | 1 small swiss cheese, sliced thinly | 1 tablespoon light cream | 2 tablespoons peanut oil
instructions: Place mixed olives and cornflour in a plastic bag and shake to combine. Shake off excess. Heat oil in a medium non stick saute pan over medium heat and add half the olives and cook until the liquid has almost evaporated, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Spread cooked mixture into a slice of swiss cheese. Top with remaining olives and sprinkle with thyme. Top with a sprinkle of cream.

Random Ingredients: cointreau liqueur,juniper berry,part mozzarella cheese,curry powder
title: Spicy Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur or 1 tablespoon orange-flavored liqueur | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 2 juniper berries
instructions: Cut cheese into 1/4 inch cubes. Place in a bowl with remaining ingredients. Toss to combine well.

title: Osh-Papadzak (Chicken with Soya Sauce)
ingredients: 12 chicken legs, attached ( thighs and drumsticks ) | sofrito sauce, to coat chicken | 2 cans pimientos, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 12 grape leaves, dried
instructions: Pour enough sofrito over chicken to coat or submerge chicken in sofrito. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Arrange chicken on a rack in a roasting pan. Arrange sliced pimientos over chicken. Place about 1/4 cup parmesan over pimientos. Roast chicken until browned with browned crust, about 1 hour. Remove from oven. Spread remaining sofrito over chicken, sprinkle with remaining parmesan, and roast in oven about 10 minutes. Serve chicken warm with reserved sofrito.

title: Yakisoba (Sushi) Roll (Futo)
ingredients: 1 cup sushi rice ( sushi rice, not short-grain rice ) | 1 lb eggs, beaten | fine dry breadcrumb
instructions: Mix rice and eggs together. Spread a layer of cooked rice on a bamboo roller. Spread one tablespoon of egg mixture on top of the soaked rice. Fold, then roll the sushi in the beaten egg, then roll again in egg mixture. Fold again and repeat until all of the ingredients are used. Place rolled luncheon meat or kebab on a bamboo mat. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at 360 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato, Cheddar and Apple Rice Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs cooked white rice | 1 large cucumber, thinly sliced | 3 medium apples, coarsely chopped | 3 1/4 cups low fat yogurt ( plain or flavored ) | 1/4 cup a.1. original sauce | 1/2 teaspoon hot sauce | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning ( tony chachere's special recipe creole seasoning mix )
instructions: Thoroughly mix everything together, add rice and mix well. Cover with cling film and refrigerate overnight. Remove rice from refrigerator 1 hour before serving.

title: Ham Stuffed Eggs
ingredients: 2 egg whites, slightly beaten | 3 slices cooked ham, cut into 1/4 inch pieces | 1/2 cup bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the egg whites, ham, and bread crumbs. Divide the mixture evenly among the eggs, and place the filled eggs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the eggs are firm and puffed. Serve hot.

title: Fruit Filled Veal
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 4 lbs ground veal | 1 teaspoon double cream or 1 teaspoon half-and-half | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 10 hazelnuts, chopped ( or coarsely chopped pistachios ) | 2 tablespoons dried figs, chopped up | 1 tablespoon vital wheat gluten ( optional ) | 2 -3 -4 tablespoons cannellini beans, liquid reserved
instructions: Pound the cardamom seeds. In a frying pan, cook the veal with the cardamom seeds over medium low heat, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes or until no longer pink. Set aside. In a medium bowl, mix the cream with the kahlua and mix until blended. Add the hazel nuts and figs and mix thoroughly. Add the meatballs a teaspoon at a time. The meatballs should be slightly flattened. Add the liquid from the cannellinni beans. Stir to combine the liquid and meat.

title: Saffron and Pecorino Cheese Stuffing
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons powdered saffron threads ( saffron oil ) | 3 -4 ounces pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Mix the saffron and cheese in your processor until the mixture becomes pasty and smooth.

title: South African Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon splenda sugar substitute, or
instructions: Prepare a grill / broiler with just enough coals to hold the meat for approximately 5 minutes on each side. If cooking on the grill, prepare the slurry / broiler as instructed above. Set the meat on the grill / broiler and broil for approximately 2 - 5 minutes per side for medium rare steak or 3 - 4 minutes per side for medium heat. Allow to rest for 3 - 4 minutes prior to serving so that the meat does not dry out. When ready to eat, slice into thin, very thin fingers. Serve on toasted french rolls or crostini / toasted pumpernickel bread.

title: Fig & Chilies Bark
ingredients: 100 g sliced dark chocolate, melted | 50 g chopped figs | 1/3 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/3 cup white vinegar
instructions: Spread chocolate on base of tray and place in oven to melt and mix. Let stand 5 minutes. Arrange figs around charisserie strips and sprinkle with chilli sauce and vinegar. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Apples
ingredients: 6 apples, such as granny smith apples | 2 cloves, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Put apples in an 8x8 inch baking dish or roasting pan. Toss apples with the cloves and parmesan cheese to coat. Bake until apples are tender and lightly browned, 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Fontina Cheese on a Pretzel
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fontinas | 1 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 6 sprigs fresh serrano peppers, washed
instructions: Dissolve yeast in large mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Beat on low speed on mixer for 10 minutes. Beat on high speed for 2 minutes. Transfer to a greased bowl or tray. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Form into 8 pretzel sized pretzels. Place on a greased baking sheet and flatten with floured fingers. Cover and let rise about 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 400 for 8 - 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,garlic salt,red bell pepper,lemon peel
title: Roasted Red Peppers
ingredients: 2 -4 red bell peppers ( depending on size ) | 1/4 cup roasted garlic salt | 1 lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Roast red bell peppers over open flame, gas burner, or in broiler until skins darken and blistered, approx 8 minutes per side. The skins will have charred skins and the peppers' interior interior should be charred. This won't take too long though. Peel skins off of peppers, discarding any skins that have occurred. Place peppers in a baking dish. Combine with roasted spices & salt/kirsch.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,cubanelle pepper,jicama,baby corn,tahini,meatball,rice wine,hard egg
title: Beef With Kabobs and Eggs
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, cut into 1-1/2x1/2-inch cubes | 1 lb jicama, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 lb baby corn, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh jicama | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 teaspoons tahini | 16 ounces meatballs, prepared for use in recipe | 4 hard-boiled eggs, sliced diagonally ( garnish )
instructions: Cut steak into strips and place in shallow bowl.

Random Ingredients: vanilla yogurt,white miso,savoy cabbage,green chili pepper,coconut milk,spicy brown mustard
title: Creamy Miso Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 cup white miso ( kelp ) | 6 cups savoy cabbage | 1 cup coconut milk | 1/3 cup spicy brown mustard | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, chopped | 1 cup plain vanilla yogurt
instructions: Blanch the cabbage in salted water for about 30 seconds, or until crisp tender. Drain. Meanwhile, combine and chill. Whisk together miso, coconut milk, mustard, chili and chilies in a small bowl.

title: Hungarian Cabbage Salad With Paprika
ingredients: 1 small cabbage, shredded | 12 fluid ounces buttermilk | 12 red food coloring, drops | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.

title: Asian Red Snapper
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 1/2 lbs red snapper
instructions: In a non reactive baking dish, combine soy sauce and soy sauce. Bake in a 350f degree oven until cooked through, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from oven, and let stand 5 minutes. Cut snapper into 1 inch pieces, and serve with soy sauce.

title: Hamburger Helper
ingredients: 1 fresh beef brisket | 2/3 cup lemon juice | 1/3 cup vanilla
instructions: Use your own judgement on salt. If you're not sure about how salty you want your sauce, you can always add a little more lemon juice to the sauce. Wash and dry the brisket. Place brisket in a slow cooker. Whisk the juice, lemon juice, and vanilla in a bowl. Pour sauce mixture over the brisket. Turn to low, cover, and cook 8 to 10 hours. Note, if you want a thicker sauce, you can add 1/3 to 1/2 cup of cream to the mix. Remove brisket from cooker and slice brisket into strips or ribbons using a serrated knife or whatever method you prefer. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,orange zest,chocolate syrup,garlic powder,water chestnut
title: Orange Peel Swiss Roll
ingredients: 1 package chocolate syrup | 6 tablespoons water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon orange zest, finely grated | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, finely grated | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Heat chocolate in microwave until melted. Stir in water chestnuts, orange peel, orange zest, and garlic powder. Spread onto wax paper for easy rolling while rolling.

Random Ingredients: cream,red wine,ice,yellow onion,cooking sherry,hollandaise sauce,beef flavor ramen noodle,seasoning sauce
title: Noodle Dish
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped yellow onion | 2 tablespoons chopped red wine | 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce or 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 lb ground beef-flavor ramen noodles | 1 cup grated yellow onion | 1/2 cup sour cream | 3/4 cup reduced-fat sour cream ( low-fat is fine ) | 3 -4 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1/4 - 1/2 cup hot horseradish sauce ( optional )
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees. Spray rectangular casserole dish with cooking spray. Place chopped onions in skillet over medium heat, cook until onions are transparent. Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,honey mustard,cashew,cumin powder,lemon peel,marshmallow creme,tomato sauce
title: Honey Mustard Spread for Noodles
ingredients: 3 tablespoons honey mustard | 1/8 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 package dried egg noodles ( preferably multi-grain variety ) | 1 can tomato sauce | 3/4 cup cashews, chopped | 3/4 cup miniature marshmallow creme | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Combine mustard and cumin in small bowl. Cook noodles in large pot of boiling water for 6 minutes or until slightly tender, still firm. Drain. Heat sauce, nuts and marshmallows over medium heat in saucepan, stirring constantly until warm. Add mustard mix and heat through.

title: Bok Choy (Sweet and Sour Vegetable)
ingredients: 3 bunches bok choy, trimmed ( about 2 bunches ) | 3 tablespoons dark corn syrup ( corn syrup will also be yummy ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Peel and dice bok choy. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add greens, tossing to soften. Add corn syrup. Cover and boil until bok choy is bright green and tender. Stir before serving.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 3 lbs flank steaks | 2 large spanish onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet paprika | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup sweet sherry wine | 1/2 tablespoon spicy hot sauce, such as franks chili hot ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, finely chopped | 1/8 teaspoon freshly cracked dried thyme
instructions: Trim fat from round steak.

title: Cabbage Patties
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cabbage | 1 package mccormick shredded whole wheat germ | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cover a small baking sheet with aluminum foil. In a medium bowl, combine the cabbage, wheat germ, and cumin. Add about ¾ cup marinara sauce. Form mixture into 16 patties. Place patties on the prepared baking sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until patties are cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Shiromaki Sauce
ingredients: 7 fluid ounces half-and-half cream | 1 2/3 fluid ounces mirin, plus more for dipping
instructions: Heat the oven to 250 degrees f. Place the double cream and mirin into a saucepan and heat slowly, without boiling, until thickened slightly. Stir constantly then pour the hot cream over the warm cream and add a pinch of mirin or a pinch of salt. Remove from the heat, cool slightly and pour into a chilled glass jar which has lid.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,corn,ramen noodle,olive oil,vanilla bean,bouillon cube,bacon dripping,dark soy sauce
title: Mock Hoisin Chicken Noodle Bake
ingredients: 6 ounces bacon drippings | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 8 ounces frozen corn, thawed | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 8 ounces ramen noodles, cooked and drained | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons chicken stock or 2 tablespoons low sodium beef stock | 1 ounce vanilla bean, split lengthways
instructions: Place bacon grease and garlic in a frypan and fry slowly, until golden. Add corn and simmer for a few mins, stirring occasionally. Stir through peanut butter until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Place pan in oven and bake 20 - 25 mins until the sauce is bubbling, and the noodles are tender.

title: The Easiest Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 jar milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 seedless golden raisin | 12 8 slices coriander or 12 12 slices white cabbage | 1/2 cup milk or 1/2 cup light cream, depending on how creamy you want it
instructions: Melt butter in a large saucepan. Once melted, add ricotta and raisins to the butter. Over medium heat, begin to stir the ricotta mix with a wooden spoon. Once the cheese has fully melted, begin layering it in the pan. Begin layering the beef, cheese mixture, and raisins on top of the cheese mixture. Add the milk or cream as needed, for the desired creaminess. Place sandwiches into the oven at 350 degrees f. Continue until all the cheese is used. I usually double the filling amount for about 2 sandwiches.

title: Thai Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 ounce bacon, chopped ( thai crunch bacon )
instructions: Place bacon into a frying pan and cook over medium heat until it has rendered all the fat. Turn down heat and add the chili pepper flakes and let it cook for 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Pork Broth - Smack
ingredients: 600 g pork loin, fat trimmed | 2 cups passion fruit pulp, pureed
instructions: Cut the pork into 5cm cubes. Mix the passionfruit pulp with the pork, making sure the pork is coated with the pulp completely. Cook your broths in a steamer set on top of a pot of simmering water, stirring occasionally until the pork is well cooked through. You should see pork cubes floating to the top of the water around you. Be careful not to overcook the pork.

Random Ingredients: salt cod fish,adobo seasoning,canadian bacon,white wine vinegar,parmesan cheese,worcestershire sauce
title: Bacon Wrapped Baked Cod (Coxinhas)
ingredients: 2 lbs salt cod fish, skinned | 8 slices canadian bacon | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon dried sage or 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Wrap the cod fillet with one piece of canadian bacon in each piece of fish, securing the bacon by tucking some bacon and a toothpick amongst the fish. Dry it all over with paper towels or cloth, and sprinkle salt on the outside. Bake for 45 minutes at 300°f degrees. Add a bit of cold water to the pan, if necessary. Mix the cheese, sage, worcestershire sauce, vinegar, and a drizzle of olive oil. Remove fish from oven and remove toothpicks. Tear off a piece of foil and place the cod on top. Spoon the cheese mixture onto the fish, wrap, and foil, and put back in the oven. Check the fish after 15 minutes and if is still slightly pink, tent it with foil. If it falls apart, let it cook for a few minutes longer. It will be done when the middle of the fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,whipping cream,tapioca flour,lamb loin chop,tomato puree,cooking oil
title: Lamb Chops and Cream
ingredients: 4 lamb loin chops | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 tablespoons tapioca flour, sifted | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 300 ml whipping cream | 150 g chocolate
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the chops. Toss with the tapioca flour and tomato purée. Preheat a shallow ovenproof pan and grease with cooking oil. Add the chops and brown lightly on all sides. Pour over the cream. Sprinkle with chocolate. Set in a roasting tin and bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour. Serve immediately.

title: French Loins
ingredients: 2 large pork loin chops | 2 -10 baby portobello mushroom caps
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit. Place pork loin chops in a 13 x 9 oven pan. Top with mushrooms. Bake 30 - 35 minutes. Turn over and bake 10 minutes more. Enjoy.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 1 package cream of chicken soup, condensed | 1/2 cup cognac | 30 ounces chopped black olives | 1/4 cup yogurt, low-fat is okay
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together cream of chicken soup, cognac, and olives until thoroughly blended. Slowly blend in yogurt until you have a smooth consistency. Serve over noodles, rice, or potatoes if desired.

Random Ingredients: rhubarb,mustard seed,thai red curry paste,cherry tomato,sumaq
title: Dry Tomato Curry for One
ingredients: 500 pints cherry tomatoes, halved | 500 g rhubarb, cut into long thin sticks | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons sumaq | 3 teaspoons thai red curry paste ( or more )
instructions: Mix the contents of the pan, stir in the mustard seeds, sumaq and curry paste. Put in the fridge for a couple of hours but be careful it will get very dark in there. This tastes best eaten with a bit of a kick.

title: Alfredo, Spinach & Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 -3 large ripe sun-dried tomatoes | 1 tablespoon oil | 2 cloves garlic, crushed | 1 bag baby spinach
instructions: Heat oil in saucepan add garlic cook briefly. Slice sun dried tomatoes in half, then cut each half into thirds remove stems and seeds. Add about 2 tablespoons of sun dried tomato sun dried tomato mixture into saucepan, toss and simmer for 1 - 2 minutes. Add baby spinach leaves tossing to combine. Transfer to serving dish & serve.

title: Schweizer Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1/2 cup sparkling water
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to about 1/2 thick, cutting in half with meat mallet. Mix together caraway seeds and the 1/2 cup of sparkling water.

Random Ingredients: corn,chipotle chile adobo,ham,horseradish,broiler fryer chicken,pea,lemon juice
title: Ranch Chicken and Peas
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 can peas | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo | 2 -3 tablespoons creamed horseradish | lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice | hot cooked ham ( i prefer smoked ) or bacon | fresh corn ( optional )
instructions: Turn oven on broil. In a small pot, bring water to a boil and place peppers in. Cook for about 10 minutes and remove from heat. Wash, remove skin and seeds from peppers and place them in a blender. Process until smooth.. Cut down the middle bone of the chicken and open up to expose thigh bone from thigh. Carefully place chicken in a roasting pan. Place in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Turn the temperature to 325 degrees and allow the chickens to continue to bake uncovered at least 1 hour. Remove the chicken from the baking pan and place in a large bowl. Add the peas, creamed horseradish and lemon or lime juice to the pan drippings from the chicken. Serve over rice and top with shredded ham or bacon. I like to add some hot peppers and hot paprika if i have them on hand.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,rotel tomato chilies,cream cheese spread,gold tequila,milk
title: Easy Microwave Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 package reduced-fat cream cheese spread | 1 1/4 cups 1 % low-fat milk | 1/4 cup tequila | 1/4 cup lemon juice
instructions: Cook the rotel tomatoes and chilies in a microwave safe bowl in the oven at high setting for about 5 minutes, or according to size and cooking time indicated on the can's packaging. Spread cream cheese in a microwave safe bowl with a removable bottom. Pour 1 cup of the drained rotel tomato mixture into the bowl with the cream cheese, leaving about 1 or 2 tablespoons of cream cheese showing in the microwave. Cover evenly with tequila. Microwave on high for 3 minutes. Remove the filled tortilla from the microwave. Microwave in high for an additional 2 to 3 minutes or so, until warm, or microwave on high for 10 to 15 seconds, or until heated through and cheese is melted, stirring after 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in 1/4 cup of the lemon juice. Serve immediately or refrigerate until serving.

title: Texas Tequila Ham & Prunes
ingredients: 5 pounds ham | 1 pound pitted prunes | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons tequila
instructions: Place ham in a large roasting pan on the counter. Add enough water to cover. Cover and let soak overnight. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. Remove ham from soaking water.

title: Apple Cider Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh chicken tenders | 24 ounces apple cider ( unfiltered apple cider is recommended )
instructions: Drain chicken tenders and rinse with cold water. Dry off excess liquid. Place tenders on rimmed baking sheet and place in preheated oven about 1 hour or until chicken is crispy. Serve with apple cider for dipping.

title: Easy Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain rice, uncooked | 3 -4 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring large amount of water to boil over high heat. While waiting for water to boil, peel rice and then place in a colander. Drain rice and set aside, then add rice to boiling water. Cook, stirring occasionally, on low heat for 5 - 8 minutes, until water is absorbed and rice is a golden brown color. Drain rice and add to the chili powder. Cook, stirring, just long enough to heat. Dump into bowls and serve. Note, use the chili powder or salt substitute if you find it too spicy. You can also add jalapeno or more of the chili powder.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,peanut butter,bean,irish cream,olive oil vegetable,black olive,creole seasoning,pineapple chunk
title: Crock Pot Indonesian Beach Sauce
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunk | 1 can refried beans | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 3 tablespoons olive oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning, i use tony chacheres'spice mix | 12 black olives | irish cream or coffee creamer
instructions: Pour pineapple, beans, peanut butter, creole seasoning, olive oil, and creole seasoning into the crock pot. Stir to mix well. Stir in black olives with the last 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce. Do not cook on low 3 to 4 hours to blend flavors and blend flavors. Serve over hot rice.

title: Winter Squash Medley - Low Fat
ingredients: 1 small winter squash, peeled | 8 ounces frozen shelled edamame, thawed | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 cup cannellini beans | 1/4 cup snow peas | 1/4 cup orange rind, cut into 1/2-inch matchsticks | 1 pinch white sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or spray with cooking spray. Cut the peeled squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds. Place the squash halves cut side down on the parchment paper and bake for 5 to 6 minutes. Remove from the oven and brush the peeled squash with some cooking spray. Remove the baking sheet from the oven and sprinkle with the edamame, tarragon, beans, snow peas, orange rind, and sugar if using. Return to the oven, spooning the hot vegetable mixture out evenly, and return to the oven. Bake until the beans are cooked, and the squash is tender and the liquid seems thickened, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,penne,pea,broccoli,mint leaf,whipping cream,yellow bell pepper,chickpea
title: Chickpea, Ricotta and Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 2 bags of your favourite pasta such as rotelle rigati or 2 bags cavatini pasta | 2 cups chopped broccoli | 2 medium yellow bell peppers, roughly chopped | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 2 packages fresh peas, defrosted | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves | 5 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Keep warm in a large bowl or a larger casserole dish. Meanwhile, cook broccoli, bell peppers and chick peas in a large saucepan of salted boiling water until tender crisp. Drain and add to pasta with cream and mint, stirring to coat with cream. Season to taste with salt. Pour pasta mixture into casserole dish and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 25 minutes or until hot and lightly browned.

title: Pears with Red Jelly
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups warm, luke warm water to 80 degrees f ( about 100 f. ) | 1 tablespoon active dry yeast ( or 2 tablespoons cake yeast ) | 2 medium pears, ripe, unpeeled, cored, and chopped ( or 1 cup tart dried pear, cut in half ) | 5 -6 tablespoons red food coloring
instructions: Pour warm water into a large bowl. Sprinkle the yeast over the water, and allow the yeast mixture to dissolve. Add the chopped fruit that you are using, stirring vigorously with a wooden spoon, and allow to stand until the water has absorbed the sugar, about 25 to 45 seconds. Pour the fruit and yeast mixture through a sieve lined with cheesecloth, reserving 3 cups of this mixture. Stir in the remaining 1/2 cup of reserved liquid. Add sugar, enough to coat the fruit and dissolve into the dough and allow to rise until almost doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. Knead the dough on a floured surface for 2 minutes, and form into 2 1/2 inch long balls. Place them on an oiled baking sheet, and flatten slightly with a glass and put 1 tablespoon of the reserved tomato cooking water in the bottom of a large skillet. Cover the pan, and allow the skillet to heat to 350°. Place 1 dough ball on the pan. Cover the skillet again, and let it heat, about 10 minutes, or until the underside has puffed a bit and is lightly browned. Flip the pears, and re spray them. Cover the skillet, and cook for 5 minutes so they become tender and have a crunchy crust on the bottom. The pears should also be juicy but not browned. Remove the pears, and turn them over, pressing and turning them gently. They should also look slightly crispy. Spread the fruit around the pears in the skillet. Sprinkle the food coloring evenly over the pears. Serve warm. This can be served warm or at room temperature. The pears can also be kept in the refrigerator, covered with plastic wrap, for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,vanilla,onion powder,sirloin,rose petal,maple syrup,zucchini,coconut flake
title: Zucchini with Maple Syrup (Or Caramelized Caramelized Oranges and Tofu)
ingredients: 2 large zucchini | 1 can tomato paste | 1 medium onion | 2 teaspoons maple syrup ( can sub honey, but is not recommended ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground rosemary or 1/2 teaspoon sage | 1/4 teaspoon dried rose petals ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon oregano ( optional ) | coconut flakes, for dusting | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f cut the zucchini lengthwise into 3 pieces lengthwise. Place in a shallow baking dish, preferably non stick or glass baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Set aside. Slice the onion thinly, then toss with the zucchini and tomato paste. In a saucepan, add the maple syrup, rosemary or sage or oregano, and the fresh or dried rose petals or leaves. Heat gently, stirring every so often, until the sugar dissolved. Turn the heat up to medium high. Add the zucchini to the pan, being careful not to break apart pieces of zucchini or tomatoes, and stir. Pour the mixture over the vegetables and bake, uncovered, for 45 - 50 minutes, or until the vegetables are lightly colored and are tender. Sprinkle with a little coconut flakes or shredded coconut, and remove to the side.

title: Cafe Rio Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 3/4 cup rice, uncooked | 10 chicken thighs, bone-in ( about 2-1/2 lbs ) | 1/4 cup mixed italian herbs, chopped ( i prefer italian seasoning blend )
instructions: Sprinkle coffee granules over chicken and toss to coat. In a small bowl, combine pineapple juice and rice.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,rose petal,wine,ancho chile powder,flour tortilla,snow pea
title: Pepper Pot-Au-Lien With Snow Peas
ingredients: 20 ounces snow peas, in pods | 1/8 cup pecorino cheese, freshly grated | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 4 large flour tortillas | 5 teaspoons dried rose petals
instructions: Blanch snow peas in boiling water for 2 minutes, then plunge into ice water to stop the cooking. Drain and rinse under cold water. Shake off the water, then immediately pat dry. Mix together all of the sauce ingredients except for the pecorino in a large bowl and set aside. Remove the peas from the boiling water and cook them over high heat, covered, for 4 minutes, or until tender, stirring occasionally, and adding the cheese towards the end of the cooking. Stir in the pecorino and serve at once with crusty bread.

title: Mexican Chocolate Corn Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow bell pepper | 4 cups defrosted frozen corn | 5 cups good quality chicken broth | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon coriander | 1/4 cup unsweetened chocolate, melted
instructions: Place the yellow pepper, corn, and chicken broth in a medium sauce pan. Bring to the boil and reduce heat to low. Simmer for about 20 minutes or until tender. Remove the yellow pepper and corn mixture from the heat and stir in the garlic powder and coriander. Pour the mixture into a blender and process until smooth. Blend in the chocolate and blend again until smooth. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Pepper Cream Sauce (Using Vanilla Sauce Paste)
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces double cream | 1 tablespoon cracked black pepper ( optional )
instructions: Pour cream into a small pan and add the pepper.

title: Maurice's Chipotle and Curry Powder Rub
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried chipotle chile | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 3/4 teaspoon garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons spices, or to taste ( poultry spice, nutmeg, cinnamon, chile, salt )
instructions: Place dried chipotle powder, curry powder, garlic, and spices in the bowl of food processor fitted with the metal blade.

title: Danish White Vinegar
ingredients: 2 cups white vinegar | 1 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Wash and dry the 3 - 4 cups of dry white vinegar. Mix the vinegar and flour together and gradually add to the vinegar. Mix in your hands until everything looks wet.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,habanero pepper,parsley,red chili pepper flake
title: Fresh Homemade Scotch Wood Dust
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 2 sprigs fresh parsley, leaves only, leaves picked from stems, discarded | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 habanero pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a small bowl, stir together chile flakes and the parsley. Spray a clean rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Sprinkle the chile mixture into the baking sheet. Sprinkle chile powder over the top. Insert pepper into the top piece of the pepper. Bake for 15 minutes, or until light tan in color. Cool for 20 minutes. Transfer scotch wood to a clean cutting board, and cut into pieces.

title: Pistachio-Pistachio Spice Bread Rounds -
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground pistachios | 1 1/4 cups coarsely chopped toasted rye bread, crusts removed ( rye bread may be used, also ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°. Spread the pistachios on a baking sheet, and toast in the oven until lightly golden and fragrant, about 5 minutes. Remove from the oven, and allow to cool. Meanwhile, in a medium dry skillet, toast the ground pistachios over low heat, stirring constantly for 3 to 5 minutes, or until golden. Watch them carefully, as they burn easily.

Random Ingredients: wheat penne,cumin seed,coriander seed,garbanzo bean,salmon fillet,italian salad dressing mix
title: Samoan Salmon Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cooked garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup reduced-fat italian salad dressing mix | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 teaspoon whole wheat penne | 1 tablespoon dried italian-style salad dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 lb salmon fillet, cut crosswise into thin slices
instructions: Combine beans, dressing mix, coriander, cumin and pasta in a large bowl. Add salmon and stir to combine. Sprinkle with salt.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,almond meal,ginger,anchovy paste,pumpkin,black lentil,tomato puree,rice noodle
title: Kathmandu's  (Japanese Casserole)
ingredients: 1 package pkg fresh rice noodles, cooked | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 2 cans crushed tomatoes in puree ( crushed ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1/4 cup lentil | 1 teaspoon almond meal | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese ( grated ) | fresh pumpkin, sliced
instructions: Spread the cooked rice noodles evenly over the bottom of a deep baking dish. Scatter the remaining ingredients over the noodles. Cover and bake at 350°f for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the top has a little crunch to it. Serve hot, either with pickles, celery, cucumber or spring onions or koshari.

title: Roast Poached Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken, cut up | 1/2 kg pearl onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 1/2 cups cake flour
instructions: Place the oil into a fry pan on moderately high heat. Fry the chicken pieces in batches on all sides to seal the skin and prevent them from sticking to the pan. Remove the chicken to a plate, and keep warm. Add the onions and sauté together for 3 minutes. Mix in the vanilla essence and remove from the heat. Sprinkle the flour over the onions, mix thoroughly then return the chicken to the pan. Cover with cling film and leave to stand for 20 minutes. Place in a preheated oven at 220 degrees centigrade for 45 minutes remove from the oven, drain off any excess oil and place on a warmed serving platter. Serve with boiled rice.

title: Souper (Soupy Meat)
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef ( sirloin ) | 1 cup beef fat ( or a mixture of both ) or 1 cup other fatty product ( or a mixture of both ) | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a large sauce pan and heat on low heat until simmering. Do not boil.

title: Lentils and Everything but the Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup minced olive | 1 -2 slice white bread | 8 ounces cooked brown lentils | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 2 -3 teaspoons dijon mustard
instructions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients. Add toasted bread to bind mixture together and mix thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,tabasco sauce,cherry tomato,vanilla extract,apple,baking powder
title: Harissa (Apple, Tomato, and Shell)
ingredients: 2 cups dried cherries tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 large apple, peeled, cored, cut into eighths | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Place the dried cherries in a colander. Stir in the baking powder, garam masala, and apple pieces. Cover, and sprinkle the tobasco over the top. Let stand to absorb the flavors until the cherries have soaked up the juice. The mixture can be stored in the fridge for up to 3 months. Bring water, and 1 teaspoon salt to a boil. Add the drained cherries, and cook 1 minute or until soft. Drain, and rinse in cold water. Place cherry mixture in a clean dish, and cover. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Stir the remaining 1 teaspoon salt into the hot cherry mixture. Just before serving, scrape off the excess cherries and serve.

title: Gingerbread - Sweet Indian Pizza Dough
ingredients: 2 cups crushed corn flakes | 1 tablespoon freshly grated ginger | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | 1/2 tablespoon yeast | 6 cups whole wheat bread flour | ice
instructions: Heat oven to 220°c mix all ingredients together. Place in well greased tin about 30cm thick. Add water 1/2 way up with bread flour and press flat. Cover and leave in warm place for about 1 hour or until bubbly. Bake in preheated oven for about 12 - 15 mins until golden. Leave to cool to room temperature. Use pizza cutter to cut. Place on serving platter and leave to firm up.

title: Chocolate-Peppercy Vodka Shots  (Vegan Friendly)
ingredients: 100 g chocolate, cut into squares | 400 g cream of celery soup ( i use lightlife gim me lean soup powder ) | 400 g canned bamboo shoots, drained ( i keep the tin in the fridge ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon ground rose coffee ground nutmeg ( or a combo of nutmeg and ground cloves ) ( optional ) | 150 ml vodka
instructions: Whip up cream of celery soup. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a container with a lid/shelf and store in fridge. To prepare shoots, remove the outer skin with a knife and slice off the base of each one using a sharp knife. If using a nutmeg, combine nutmeg with cloves of mace and place in a ziploc bag and mix into a fine powder, use as little or as much of the mace you can then add the powder mixture into the bowl. If you wish to use whipped topping instead of vodka, combine all ingredients and chill before serving.

title: Pork and Coconut Stew
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup currants | 8 ounces coconut, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons shredded sweetened | 1/4 cup shredded fresh spinach leaves
instructions: Trim fat from pork and cut into cubes. Place pork in a 5 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle kidney beans with currants and coconut over pork. Sprinkle with sweetened shredded spinach and cover. Cook on low 4 - 6 hours or on high for 2 1/2 3 hours.

title: Punchy Pea Snack Dog Topping
ingredients: 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1/3 cup bittersweet chocolate, melted | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. Microwave the thawed peas in an uncovered microwave safe bowl in the microwave on high power for 30 - 60 seconds to 1 minute, or until warm, and not hot. Add the chocolate and worcestershire sauce to the peas and stir to thoroughly blend. Transfer the mixture evenly into a pie plate. Using a pastry tip, cut into 12 squares, making 36 triangles. Allow each triangle to dip into melted chocolate and then roll in the reserved chocolate for garnish. Serve.

title: Jaggery Mini Spoons
ingredients: 20 sweet ladyfingers ( get them bought lady fingers ) | 4 teaspoons red curry paste ( or plain and indian paste like i do ) | 2 tablespoons kohlrabi, finely chopped | 4 teaspoons kohlrabi, finely chopped | 4 teaspoons kohlrabi, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon jaggery | 3 teaspoons cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Prep time, you will probably have to cook this in a microwave or pressure cooker. Mix all the ingredients besides the lady fingers in a bowl. Add a little water if necessary. Make 3 space in the middle of your microwave/spam/loaf microwave or grinder and spread it evenly into an upto ½ centimeter thick round. The mixture should be of a thick and even consistency, unlike traditional lady fingers. Add 1 - 2 tbls of the curry paste/sugar/jaggery mixture into the center of the rectangle and press evenly into a round disc. If desired, you can prepare more biscuits in the next step. Microwave it uncovered on medium to high power for 4 - 5 minutes.. Keep the microwave/spam mixture on medium high power. Allow it to stand for a minute or two to make sure that it cools. Open the microwaved lady fingers and spread them out all over the rectangular rectangle of rectangle for 1 - 2 minutes. Then, sprinkle the red curry paste inside the lady fingers. Microwave on medium high power, turning the lady fingers once after 5 - 6 minutes. Microwave for another 10 seconds. Remove from stove and cut biscuits in half, or you can slice them to smaller squares. Top with the red curry paste and garnish with sliced kohlrabi. Note, if serving this in a burrito, you can add a little lemon or ginger. Variation, you've found that it tastes better with a little lime to the lime for a stronger taste.

title: Watermelon and Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cashews | 6 cups watermelon, diced | 1 orange | 1 stalk celery, diced
instructions: Put cashews on a plate and microwave on high until golden brown. In a large bowl, combine cashews, watermelon and orange.

title: Green Split Pea & Broccoli (Chard) Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch spinach, washed, stems cut off | 1 piece cucumber | 1/2 frozen green peas
instructions: Place the spinach in a large salad bowl. Sprinkle over the cucumber with green peas then add the broccoli. Drain the spinach leaves and mix it with the spinach. Garnish with chopped parsley.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,chinese five spice powder,red chile,frangelico,cocoa powder
title: Four Spice Feta Truffles
ingredients: 200 g feta cheese | 3 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 -2 small dried red chile, crumbled | 1 tablespoon frangelico or 1 tablespoon brandy, to glaze
instructions: If it is very soft, break it up with your fingers to form fine pieces. Blend the cheese, five spice powder and cocoa until creamy. Add red chilli and mix well. Place the mixture in small plastic tubs, or a dish and chill for two hours. Dip the top of each tub using a teaspoon and use your finger to make the truffle into little crudles. Refrigerate for two hours. The truffle should be firm and glossy.

Random Ingredients: chocolate syrup,baby spinach leaf,pecorino romano cheese,dill pickle
title: Grilled Swiss Steak With a Coulis of Peppers & Pecorino Romano
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup or 2 tablespoons creme fraiche, to taste | 4 sprigs fresh dill pickles | 4 ounces baby spinach leaves | 1 ounce grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: In a small bowl, pour the chocolate syrup and sprinkle with the pickles. Let them sit 15 minutes. Divide the spinach leaves among 4 - 6 skewers. Put the grated cheese on top of the leaves, pressing it into the spinach. Grill for 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until the cheese turns light brown and the spinach is wilted and tender. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pastry crust pie,rump roast,salt black pepper,hard egg
title: Eggs Poached on Beef (Polska kielbasa -- Polish Beef Roast)
ingredients: 1 unbaked pastry for a 9-inch double crust pie or ( 9 ounce ) unbaked pie crust, for a 9-inch double crust pie | 1/4 lb uncooked rump roast, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1 hard-boiled egg, quartered | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Roll out one of your pie crusts to a 10 inch diameter round. Place it in a 9 inch skillet or dutch oven. Top it with meat cubes and cut up egg quarters. Season with salt and pepper. Roll out the second pie crust and cut in half, making it into two 8 by 8 inch squares. Place half of the squares on top of the first, pressing the edges down and tucking them underneath for added steam. Press together edges of the crusts to seal. Trim the edges and the bottom crusts as best you can, and cover the pan loosely with foil. Set the pan in a steamer set over boiling water and steam for 45 minutes. Do not overcook, but check for doneness before serving. To serve, cut a cross into the top crust, and spoon the gravy from the steamer into the center. Serve hot.

title: Maui Onion and Garlic Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 16 ounces muenster cheese | 3 -4 tablespoons melted shortening ( or olive oil ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup finely sliced fresh ginger ale | salt and pepper
instructions: Cut the loaf in half lengthwise, and then each half into quarters, making them about 1 inch thick. Then cut between them the quarters to form triangles, and cut into slices about 1 1/2 inches wide. Slice the muenster cheese very thinly, and coat each triangle with half the melted shortening. Arrange the slices on a baking sheet. Place in a 375f degrees oven the ham slices are heated, and will melt any cheese melted into the sandwich if the ham is a little hard. Add the ginger ale, and reduce until it has completely melted away, about 10 - 15 minutes. Add as much cheese as you like and add salt and pepper to taste. These sandwiches can easily be made 2 days in advance and reheated later. They can be served hot, warm or cold. The sandwich will keep in the refrigerator for a couple of weeks, wrapped well in wax paper, but you should keep plenty of it wrapped in wax paper for weeks. A piece of bread is a good addition to this when served with pickled cabbage added to the sandwich at the last minute.

title: Chipotle Oil (For Deep Fried Chips)
ingredients: parsley | 3 chipotle chiles | 1 tablespoon ginger ( minced )
instructions: Heat 1 t. Of the oil in a skillet. Using a mortar, pound the chipotle peppers using the blade of a knife into a powder. Heat the remaining oil over medium heat until it shimmers. Add the chipotle chiles and stir fry for 3 minutes or until the oil just barely begins to smoke. Turn the heat down and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Let them sit for 15 minutes and drain well. Store in an airtight container.

title: Oven Poached Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 roast beef, 2-4 lbs. ( i roast mine in a dutch oven, then place it in a freezer bag and cover it with plastic wrap to chill for up 30 min ) | 2 cans roasting chickens | 1 can hunts chunky tomato sauce | 2 1/2 cups pecans ( optional ) or 2 1/2 cups walnut pieces ( optional ) | 14 1/2 ounces italian-style tomatoes ( i use whole peeled tomatoes )
instructions: Brine method, remove plastic wrap. Place 1/2 of loaf in the center of a large dinner plate, with ends tucked under. Place 2 or 3 lbs of roast in the center. Spread 1/2 of tomato sauce on bottom of platter. Cover with remaining loaf. Dredge 1/2 of pecans and 1/2 of walnuts in italian crumbs if using. Place 3 platter on top of loaf. Dribble remainder of sauce evenly on platter around dish. Refrigerate, covered, overnight. Sauce method, bring to room temp before starting to cook. You may also choose to make these a day ahead so the flavors can marry. Cover tightly with a piece of foil if you wish, place in refrigerator overnight. When ready to cook, bring to room temp before starting to cook. Time will depend on oven, altitude, etc. Cover, place in a 300 degrees oven, and place in a 350 degree oven for 1 1/2 hours. Turn off oven and leave it in there for 5 more hour. To serve place meat on a cutting board and cut into 1 to 1 1/2 inch slices. Place on platter with sauce around it. Add optional ingredients for sauce.

title: Tomato Rice Crisp
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rice cereal | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice, from can | 1 teaspoon capers, drained | 1 cup crispy rye flour
instructions: Combine all ingredients except crumbs and rye flour in a saucepan.

title: Tikka Mango Pickles
ingredients: 400 g mangoes, grated | 50 g mustard powder | oil ( for deep frying ) or veg ( for deep frying )
instructions: Combine the grated mango, mustard powder and seasoning. Place in a bowl. Use wet hands to mix well. Cover and let stand in fridge for at least 2 hours. Drain. Pack into clean, sterilised jars with oil. Seal. Label and date. Keeps for 6 weeks.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,savory,red potato,dark chocolate,jalapeno pepper,spaghetti squash,basil leaf,strawberry
title: Vegetable Lasagne
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash, peeled and cubed | 4 red potatoes, cubed | 12 basil leaves | 2 cans diced jalapeno peppers, drained | 1 tablespoon dried basil leaves | 2 tablespoons dry savory | 8 ounces dark chocolate | 12 slices fresh strawberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spray a casserole dish with non stick cooking spray. Cover the bottom of the casserole dish with parchment paper. Put 1/2 of the vegetable cubes in the casserole dish, then add the remaining vegetables and sprinkle with salt. Add the basil, savory and chocolate and pour half of the sauce on top. Layer with about 1/3 of the sliced strawberries, followed by layers of pasta, chocolate sauce and remaining sauce. Top with remaining strawberries. Bake for about 1 hour.

title: Ener-Gnites
ingredients: 2 nectarines, flesh peeled and thinly sliced | 5 -6 tablespoons oregano leaves ( or about 10 leaves torn from fresh basil ) | 2 -4 tablespoons five-spice powder
instructions: Arrange nectarines on a plate. Sprinkle generously with 1 teaspoon oregano leaves or about 8 teaspoons basil leaves. Mix together oregano and 5 spice powder and then drizzle liberally over salad. If serving at room temperature, chill nectarines for 30 minutes.

title: Mushroom Tomato Cream
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes or 2 lbs red cherry tomatoes | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Core tomatoes and cut into small pieces. In a large heavy bottom saucepan heat whipping cream until hot, about 3 minutes. Add all spices, except tomatoes. Bring to boiling.

Random Ingredients: potato flake,italian salad dressing mix,cayenne,harissa,dark chocolate,italian breadcrumb
title: Sweet Potato Chips With Harissa #5FIX
ingredients: 14 ounces light sweet potato flakes | 2 tablespoons sweet italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 ounce dark chocolate piece | 1/2 cup italian seasoned dry breadcrumbs
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Mix sweet potato flakes, italian dressing mix, harissa, cayenne, and chocolate in 9 x 13 pan. Sprinke bread crumbs over the top. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,turmeric powder,pecorino romano cheese,chinese cabbage,cayenne,black sesame seed
title: Spiced Cabbage
ingredients: 8 ounces chinese cabbage ( small pieces ) | 3 tablespoons vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon black sesame seed | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( or more to taste ) | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon pecorino romano cheese or 1 teaspoon parmesan cheese, grated
instructions: Wash and dry the cabbage. Cut it into 1 inch square slices. Bring the vegetable stock to a boil and add the black sesame seeds. When hot, add the cabbage, cover and reduce the heat. After 5 minutes, the cabbage should still be slightly crisp. Add the cayenne, turmeric powder, and cheese and toss well. Serve hot. If you have any left over, simply reheat it in the microwave, serve it, or let it reheat in a separate pan.

title: Cawl (Taste and Eat)
ingredients: 1 cup peeled crawfish | 1 cup canned pinto beans | 1 tomatoes puree | 1 small cabbage, chopped | 1 small lemon, sliced | 1 artichoke, fresh, cleaned and chopped
instructions: Place the crawfish in a saucepan and add enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil and skim off the foam. Cover and simmer until the crawfish is very tender, about 5 to 7 minutes. Drain off the broth and skim off any scum that is floating on the surface. Transfer the crawfish and its broth to a bowl and set aside, discarding the cooked crawfish and onion. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Spread the pinto beans in the bottom of a baking dish. Combine the pinto beans and diced cabbage in a mixing bowl. Arrange the sliced lemon slices and artichoke in the center of the bed of beans. Spoon the crawfish mixture onto the lettuce. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese is bubbly and slightly browned, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: berbere,almond extract,corn oil,lemon juice,avocado,jumbo shrimp,lemon peel
title: Almond Baked Shrimp
ingredients: 3 large jumbo shrimp, peeled, deveined | 1 avocado, peeled, seeded | 1 tablespoon lemon peel | 1/4 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/3 cup corn oil | 1/4 cup berbere, spice
instructions: Spray a 9x12 baking dish with cooking spray. Cut the shrimp in half lengthwise and pound the shrimp by rolling them in your hands with the flat side of a cleaver. Remove the shrimp from the shells and set them aside. In a medium bowl, mash the avocado with the lemon peel and lemon juice. Spread the avocado mixture in the baking dish. In a large frying pan, warm the oil over medium heat. Sauté the bermere spice with 1/4 cup of water for about 1 minute over medium high heat. Add the shrimp. Saute, turning the shrimp over with a wooden spoon, until the shrimp turns pink, about 3 minutes per side. Add the remaining 1/4 cup water and cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens slightly, about 10 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,black coffee,arborio rice,pepperoncini pepper juice,chunky salsa,paprika,sage leaf,white bread
title: Award-Winning Cannellini and Risotto
ingredients: 2 cups hot black and red pepperoncini peppers or 2 cups jalapeno pepper juice | 5 1/4 cups arborio rice | 1 bag chunky salsa | 0.5 can cannellini beans, rinsed, drained and rinsed | 2 handfuls black beans, rinsed | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | paprika | 2 slices thick white bread, toasted, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat your broiler and place rack 4 inches from the heat. Meanwhile, in a skillet over medium heat, combine the pepperoncini or jalapeno juice and pepperoncini juice. Cook, stirring occasionally until it has reduced and turned syrupy but not blackened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the rice and 1 1/2 cups water, bring to a simmer, cover, and reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,brown basmati rice,mint sprig,celery seed,pie shell
title: Sweet and Sour Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups brown basmati rice | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 teaspoons celery seeds | 2 tablespoons dried mint sprigs | 1 pie shell
instructions: Place rice in a fine mesh strainer and rinse under warm water until water runs clear at least twice. Drain. Combine rice, tomato paste, celery seed and mint in the base of a greased 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Place in a larger dish, cover and set aside for at least 1 hour, until rice is tender. Preheat oven to 425°f. Press cooker, add cooked rice and tomato paste mixture through a colander. Cover and bake for 40 minutes. Garnish with more mint sprigs before serving if desired.

Random Ingredients: nonstick vegetable cooking spray,water,juniper berry,dill,red chile,mandarin orange syrup,cranberry juice,rice noodle
title: Chilled Mandarin and Citrus Rice Noodle Salad With Juniper Berry Compote
ingredients: 1 cup mandarin orange syrup, low sodium | 6 cups water | 1/4 cup dried cranberry juice | 1/4 cup rice noodles, uncooked | 1 teaspoon crushed juniper berries | 1/8 teaspoon crushed dried red chile | nonstick vegetable cooking spray | fresh dill, snipped, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Combine first 2 ingredients in a medium heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside for 20 minutes. Remove syrup from heat. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. Bring about 1/4 cup syrup to a boil in a large nonstick frying pan. Add rice noodles.

title: Swiss Cheese and Tomato Appetizers
ingredients: 1 lb swiss cheese | 1 lb beef flavored ground burger ( or any other spicy flavor )
instructions: Cut cheese into large pieces. In skillet, brown ground burger.. Add cheese & beef and heat until melted.

title: Hot and Spicy Strawberry Puree
ingredients: 150 g baked beans | 150 g hot paprika | 1 pinch saffron strand ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | fresh ginger, grated | 4 strawberries, halved
instructions: Put the baked beans on a plate. Mix together the paprika, saffron, mustard powder and ginger and spread over the sprouted beans. Top with the strawberries. Wrap up with aluminium foil and place on top of a non metallic tray. Stand this tray in a saucepan of barely simmering water for 5 minutes, then carefully remove the tray from the boiling water.

title: Crock Pot Caraway Onion Soup (Low-Carb)
ingredients: 3 lbs onions | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 4 cups beef stock | 1 tablespoon white pepper powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Slice the onions into half lengthwise. Then slice each half crosswise into thin slices. Bring chopped onions, caraway seeds, beef stock, white pepper, and ground nutmeg into crock pot, reserving some broth for color, and set cook on high for 4 hours. If you like a lighter soup, continue cooking on low until tender. Serve hot with bread.

Random Ingredients: flour tortilla,salt,buttermilk,almond extract,plain yogurt,parsley,cheese ravioli,celery seed
title: Ravioli With Yogurt Cheese and Almonds
ingredients: 10 ounces refrigerated cheese ravioli | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1/3 cup buttermilk ( or milk of choice ) | 4 ounces slivered almonds, slivered and toasted | 1/3 cup finely chopped celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | flour tortilla ( for serving )
instructions: In a medium size bowl mix together the yogurt, buttermilk, 3/4 cup of the almonds. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Spoon half of the cheese mixture onto each tortilla and roll up. Place on a cookie sheet that has been coated with cooking spray. Bake at 425°f for 15 - 20 minutes, until browned.

title: Baked French Fries or Wedges
ingredients: 4 medium french fries, or your favorite kind | 1/4 cup catsup | 3 beef bouillon cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place fries on an oven proof dish. In a small bowl, stir warm catsup and bouillon cubes together. Pour sauce over fries. Bake in preheated oven 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, broil 10 to 15 minutes, until edges are golden brown and bubbly.

title: Grilled Peppered Shrimp in Spicy Alfredo
ingredients: 1 large jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 cup bottled pepperoni, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander | 2 cups boiling water | 2 packages linguine
instructions: Combine shrimp, pepperoni, coriander and boiling water in bowl or large freezer bag.

title: Pumpkin Spice Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice | crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Grind red pepper flakes or use up to 2 tablespoons of crushed red pepper flakes in your spice cabinet. Sift together before and after grinding into your favorite snack and enjoy.

title: Barley Salad With Pepperoni
ingredients: 3 cups red cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup sauerkraisins ( can make with other sweet and sour peppers too ) | 3/4 3/4 cup pearl barley or 3/4 cup barley | 1 jalapeno, very finely chopped ( seeded and chopped or use an italian pepper ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( can make with other sweet and sour peppers too ) ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup hot pepper juice ( from pepperoni slices i havefound found the pepperoni should be a bit sweeter ) ( optional ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and serve warm or chilled with crackers.

title: Sauerkraut With Kielbasa and Apples (With Apple Wine Sauce)
ingredients: 14 ounces cream cheese ( preferably neufchatel ) | 4 ounces sauerkraut with apples ( with syrup, if you wish ) | 1/3 cup brandy ( if any ) | 1/2 cup double cream | 1/8 cup sliced kielbasa ( or other smoked sausage ) | 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint | 2 small tart apples (, such as granny smiths, braeburn, gala... and granny smith )
instructions: Cut the cream cheese into small pieces and place in a medium size, heavy skillet, over medium high heat. Using a rubber spatula or your wooden spoon, mix together with the cream cheese until the cream cheese is smooth and creamy and just starts to melt, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add the saurkraut and brandy. Add the cream, if necessary, to keep the mixture just creamy. Stir in the kielbasa, mint and apples. Adjust flavors as necessary with additional brandy, syrup, or alcohol. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for flavors to develop.

title: Baked Halibut in Wine and Marsala
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 1/2 cup vodka or 1/2 cup lemon juice | 1/4 cup coarse salt and pepper | 4 halibut, skin on ( i use the big fillet, and the smaller fish i can buy )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Combine marsala wine, vodka and lemon juice in a glass baking dish, and stir to combine. Place fish skin side up in baking dish and top with wine/liqueur mixture. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Cover pan with aluminum foil to protect yourself from drying. Bake 35 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve immediately.

title: Crock Pot Swiss Oat Stuffing
ingredients: 6 cups rolled oats ( not instant ) | 6 large white onions, quartered, thinly sliced and separated | 3 sprigs fresh rosemary ( or 2 t. dried, or 1 t. dried )
instructions: Empty 5 or 6 cups of rolled oats into crock pot. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours. Remove rosemary sprigs, allow stuffing to cool slightly. Serve with hot cooked sausage and sweet potato sticks.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,great northern bean,pork shoulder,vegetable,sandwich bun,beef broth
title: Country Diner Pulled Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of fat | 1 can beef broth | 1 fresh gingerroot, peeled and coarsely chopped | 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables | 1 bag frozen southern style mixed salad buns, split | 4 sandwich buns, split
instructions: Heat a dutch oven over medium high heat. Coat the bottom of the pan with cooking spray. Place the pork in the pan, browned side down. Brown on all sides. Add the beef broth and ginger and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until meat is very tender. Add mixed vegetables and return to a boil. Simmer for about 5 minutes or until juices begin to thicken. Remove to a platter. Place the split side of each bun, cut side up, on a work surface. Top with pork mixture and serve.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,cooking oat,belgian endive,baby spinach,margarine,ham
title: Belgian Endive and Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 1 package fresh belgian endive, halved lengthwise, rinsed, and thinly sliced | 12 -18 ounces fresh baby spinach, washed and well drained | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter, melted | 4 ounces cooked ham, chopped | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1.7 boxes quick cooking oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place a non stick dutch oven in the oven to warm up and melt the margarine or butter or margarine. Once the margarine is melted, add the endive, ham, cream of chicken soup, and oats. Mix well, and add the green part of the endive to the mixture. Then add the spinach. Cook over low heat for about 3 to 4 minutes, remove from heat. Place remaining ingredients in casserole dish, mix well, and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Peanut Crispy Rice
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 1 1/2 cups sauerkraut | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 medium yellow pepper, cut into chunks
instructions: Brown rice and sauerkraut in 1/2 cup peanut butter. Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle veggies with remaining peanut butter. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes covered.

title: Dried Beef Tenderloin and Raisins
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 tablespoon black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour, sifted
instructions: In a small bowl, combine beef and raisins. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine peppercorns and flour. Add meat and shake until evenly coated. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add enough oil to cover meat and pork. Cook, turning over once or twice, until well browned, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a plate and cover loosely. Let stand 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,basmati rice,alfredo sauce,lime,kahlua,lime wedge,chicken base
title: Santa Fe Style Spanish Rice Bowls
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup kahlúa ( almond spread ) | 1/3 cup thick and chunky salsa | 6 -8 fresh lime wedges | 1/2 cup reduced-fat alfredo sauce | 1/4 cup reduced-fat alfredo sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chicken base
instructions: Note, you can also prepare this rice in a bowl that has been well seasoned with chicken flavored crumbs and pestle. You might have to use your hands to work the rice thoroughly. Bring 4 - 5 cups of water to a boil in a small pot. Add rice, stir, cover, and cook on boiling for 9 - 11 minutes. Fluff rice with fork, remove from heat, and set aside. Stir both salsa and kahlúa together until well combined. Add kahlúa mixture to rice mixture in bowl, stir, and spoon into four 6 cup serving or serving dishes. Top with lime wedges, alfredo sauce, and additional salsa to serve.

title: Delicious Black-Eyed Pea Pies
ingredients: 1 bag frozen black-eyed peas | 1 package frozen dinner rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients and microwave on hi for 10 minutes, stirring after 3 - 5 minutes, until peas are slightly thawed. Cut each roll into 4 pieces and use a teaspoon to measure the frozen mixture into each roll. Close and microwave on low for 10 minutes, checking on it after 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mustard,monterey jack cheese,tomato juice,vinegar,garlic clove,olive oil,bulk italian sausage
title: Baked Italian Sausage Sauce (Copycat)
ingredients: 3/4 lb bulk italian sausage, cooked ( or links ) | 1 can tomato juice ( undiluted ) | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 2 teaspoons garlic cloves, minced ( from jar ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground mustard | 1/3 cup monterey jack cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet over medium head. Drain.

title: French Revolution Shooter
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Shake well to combine. Shake and store in a cool, dark, dry place.

title: Zesty Red Wine Sauce
ingredients: 4 lbs red italian plum tomatoes ( i prefer roma ) | 1 head chinese cabbage | 1 head celery | 4 -6 ounces button mushrooms | 2 teaspoons oregano | 4 tablespoons sesame
instructions: Remove cores from tomatoes and dice. Slice celery. In large covered roaster, place tomatoes on top of celery and mushrooms. Add oregano, salt and pepper. Cook at 150 to 220 degrees for 1 1/2 hours. Add sesame. Cover, reduce heat and let sit for 1/2 an hour, stirring every hour. Serve warm.

title: Homemade Rich Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 600 g milk chocolate, chopped | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 1 small lemon or 1 small lime, zested in half
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large heavy pan or pot on the stove and stir vigorously to break up lumps. Cover with a lid and keep on a low heat, stirring frequently. After about 15 minutes, the temperature will be around 140 150°c. When the temperature has reached this stage, remove the lid and continue stirring for about 10 minutes or until the chocolate has completely melted. Stir for about another 5 minutes, or until the mixture begins to thicken slightly, and remove the pan from the heat once more.. Leave the chocolate covered for 8 - 10 minutes, then transfer the mixture to a serving dish and leave to mellow. To store, use a funnel to pour it onto a clean dry surface, wipe off any remaining lumps and pour into a clean container. Store in the fridge until use. Note, you may also wish to add a dash of lemon juice or cinnamon to this recipe. It will help to heat the hot chocolate and help it release more flavour into the hot chocolate and melt the liqueur to a creamy consistency..

title: Steak With Lemon & Ginger Pasta
ingredients: 400 g rotini pasta | 1/2 ounce gingerroot, peeled & grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon-swirl bread or 1 1/2 teaspoons rye breadcrumbs | 12 ounces flank steaks | 2 teaspoons gingerroot, freshly grated | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water to following instructions on bag. Drain then return it to the pasta pot. In a frying pan, fry the gingerroot on a medium heat for a few minutes until you can smell the ginger through. Cool, mix in breadcrumbs then set aside. Grill steak until cooked to your liking. Cut steak into slices. Mix together the 3 tbsp lemon juice with 1 tsp lemon pepper. Toss pasta with lemon mixture. Serve topped with sliced steak.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,chicken broth,lime wedge,sriracha sauce,coconut oil
title: Quick and Easy Samosa
ingredients: 1 cup rye flour ( or white whole wheat flour ) | 1 tablespoon fresh grated coconut oil or 1 tablespoon unsweetened coconut oil | 1/8 - 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1 -2 teaspoon sriracha sauce | 1 lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Mix flour, coconut oil, and chili pepper together in a shallow dish. Dip chicken in seasoned flour and shake off excess. Arrange in a shallow pan. Pour heated broth over, cover, and let simmer 20 minutes. Turn chicken over, cover, and broil 2 - 3 minutes until fish is slightly charred on the underside, 1 minute. Turn over and broil again until golden brown, about 2 minutes longer. Remove fish to a platter, top with fresh cilantro, and serve with lime wedges.

title: Chickpea & Apple Jam
ingredients: 2 cans chickpea flour | 1/2 cup chopped dried mango ( or other dried fruit ) | 4 tart apples ( i used a 2-pounder ) | 1 can chickpea flour, or just use 1 cup of homemade flour
instructions: The jam maker recommends that you use fresh chippards as the stones will continue to work in the same way as flour, but i've never had folks say to use dried, which makes it difficult to get good tiny bits stuck to your fingers while jam is cooking. Put chickpea flour in medium heat in a blender or food processor. Cut apples into chunks and add to processor. Cut mango into chunk slices and add to processor. You may need to add more flour so the jam doesn't stick to the apples and mango. Blend until smooth. Turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead until smooth. Place the chie mixture in a large bowl and knead well until smooth and pliable.. Set aside 1/2 cup of the jam. I didn't want to use it all. You will have to add as much water as is necessary if the jam starts to stick to it. Add the remaining jam and 1/2 cup of the chick pea flour to the jam and mix well. Roll dough into 1 inch balls, and place in a well oiled baking dish. Push the center of the ball so that the jam will not fall away. Press out the middle using your hands so that it will release more air from the inside of the dish when you are baking it. Cover with damp cloth. Place in refrigerator for at least 45 minutes, but preferably 3 to 4 hours, to allow flavors to blend. Preheat the oven to 350 f. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven, and place on a rack to cool. The jam should be slightly oily and sticky, but not slimy.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,wheat bread,red chili powder,peach,couscous,oriental sesame oil
title: Red Peach-Soy French Toast Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 lb ripe peach | 2 tablespoons red chili powder | 8 slices whole wheat bread | 1 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 1 tablespoon vanilla bean | 2 teaspoons orange oriental sesame oil
instructions: Peel the peaches, then cut into thin wedges. Set aside. Place all remaining ingredients except for the orange sesame oil, in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Cook, stirring constantly until very hot. Serve with your choice of dippers.

title: Spinach & Breadcrumb Open Faced Breadcrumb Toasts
ingredients: 4 bread, cups ( baguette ) | 1 bunch baby spinach | 2 spring onions, finely chopped | 1/4 cup flour | 2 cups italian salad dressing, bottled or 2 cups homemade dressing | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees. Drain water from baby spinach leaves and place on a paper towel to dry. Place each slice of bread on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes or until lightly toasted, crisp and lightly browned. Remove from oven. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix together the salad dressing, crumbs and enough dressing/crumb water to make a thick paste. Set aside. When cool to the touch, split each slice of bread into two halves. Spread tops with the pesto/toast mixture evenly. Place on a serving platter. Top with chopped spinach leaves and spring onion. Serve immediately or wrap the sandwiches individually in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for up to 2 hours or until serving. To store, place bread in refrigerator for up to 2 days. Serve with dressing and a crisp salad.

title: Icelandic Pepper Crusted Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 small bottom round beef roast | 10 ounces icing sugar | 1 tablespoon pepper ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f. Cut small holes all around roast. Place meat in large roasting pan. Combine icing sugar and pepper in small bowl, stir well. Pour over roast. Roast for 1 1/2 hours, checking for doneness. Remove from oven and let stand for 1/2 hour before carving. Serve on a platter with butter and jam.

title: Fruit and Chilled Bean Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried black beans | 6 cups merlot | 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons chives, minced | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice, from canned pineapple chunk
instructions: Soak the beans overnight in the merlot. The next day, place the beans, 3 cups of water, beans and butter in a large pot, and bring to a boil. Cover, and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 3 hours. Stir often. Stir in the chives and continue cooking for 2 hours. Remove the lid. When soup is cooked, pour into a bowl. Serve hot.

title: Garam Masala Flavored Easy Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups rice, uncooked | 2 green onions | 2 tablespoons garam masala powder
instructions: Soak the rice in cold water for 30 - 50 minutes. Drain and set aside. Slice green onions thinly. Soak garam masala powder in enough water to cover it. Add garam masala powder and mix it into the rice mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 2 - 4 hours. Stir rice occasionally to avoid mixture sticking to the bottom of the pan. Keep the rice covered with a cloth in a pan.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,taco seasoning mix,egg white,green chilies,cumin powder,thyme sprig
title: Mexican Fried Olives
ingredients: 2 cups fresh green chilies ( canned or fresh ) | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 4 large egg whites | 1/3 cup fresh thyme sprig | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 cup spanish olives, drained
instructions: Preheat broiler. Using a 1 cup capacity non stick skillet, saute the olives in a skillet over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until they are golden brown.

title: Five-Spice Spiced Apples
ingredients: 1 apple, cut into 6 wedges | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 120 degrees f. Place apple wedges on baking sheets. Sprinkle with five spice powder. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.

title: Kidney Bean & Chestnut Farro
ingredients: 4 lbs skinless chicken wings | 1 cup fresh chestnuts, skinned | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 2 cans black beans, drained
instructions: Soak the wings in water for about 1/2 hour. Drain, dry off and chop the wings. Blend the garlic, ground chestnuts & haricot chestnut paste in a blender with the chickpeas. Place the flour in a large bowl, mix in the beans, add enough warm water to just mix it all. Stir with a fork to get what you need from there. The best way to do this is to pour into a well buttered ovenproof bowl and bake in a moderate oven for about 1 to 1 & 1/2 hrs or until dark brown. Cool to room temperature before storing away store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,egg yolk,chunky salsa,basmati rice,lime,beef chuck,zucchini
title: Grilled Mexican Meatballs (South Beach Diet Phase 1)
ingredients: 2 cups long grain basmati rice | 2 boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 large zucchini, diced | 1/3 cup store-bought chunky salsa | 1 large egg yolk, slightly beaten | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh basil | 1 teaspoon finely chopped orange peel ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon grated lime peel ( optional )
instructions: Prepare and cook the rice according to the package directions, omitting any oil. Meanwhile, heat a grill pan or grill pan on high. Thread the beef cubes and zucchini onto the skewers. Put the skewers on the grill and cook the beef and zucchini, turning once, 5 minutes total for medium. Meanwhile, whisk together the salsa, egg yolk, basil and orange peel, if using. Divide the meatballs among the 4 plates and spoon the salsa mixture onto the top. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,canola oil,oil,sesame oil,chicken breast half,cheese,bean sprout
title: Chinese Restaurant Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 3/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup oil for frying | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, diced | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1/3 cup shredded cheese
