instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet, stirring in the chicken bouillon granules.

title: Tahini-Pulsed Molasses Enchilidas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 2 tablespoons molasses, plus | 1 teaspoon molasses | 1 tablespoon dry sherry ( or rice wine ) | 2 cans rotel or ( 15 ounce ) cans green olives, drained and sliced | freshly ground coriander seed | 1 bunch fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the tahini, 2 tbsp of the molasses and the sherry or rice wine. Stir in the rotel olives and coriander seeds and set aside. In a slow, steady stream, slowly add the olive mixture to the tahini mixture, stirring vigorously with a fork. Cover and chill overnight serve at room temperature or refrigerate to mellow for up to 5 days.

title: Chef John's Shrimp and Yams (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup amaretto | 1/2 cup beer | 12 ounces yams, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 ounces gruyere cheese, thinly sliced
instructions: Place rice, cider vinegar, and amaretto in the rice cooker. Set rice to the low medium setting and press cook. Add yams to rice cooker and press cook. Increase to medium and push cook, stirring occasionally, until yams are tender, about 5 to 6 minutes longer. Top with gruyere cheese slices and remaining cheese. Close cooker and set to cook.

title: Peanut Butter and Creamy Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups creamy peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Mash the peanut butter in a bowl with a fork until creamy. Add baking soda, stir until combined well. Keep stirring until smooth. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly floured surface. Press 1 - 2 tablespoons of peanut butter into 1 - 2 inch circles on a parchment lined baking sheet. Bake in batches at 350 degrees f for 10 - 12 minutes or until they pale gold. Remove from baking sheet and cool on a wire rack. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,red wine,curry paste,brown sugar,extra beef,chive,lemongrass,pork fillet
title: Lebanese Pork and  Spicy  Beef Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry paste | 500 extra lean stewing beef, cubed | 500 g pork fillets, cubed | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 100 g tomato puree | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives | 2 tablespoons reduced-sugar artificial sweetener ( or equivalent )
instructions: Combine curry paste, beef, pork, and olive oil in a large bowl. Add all ingredients and mix gently until meat is coated with the curry paste mixture. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours, turning bag contents occasionally. Grill meat and vegetables in batches for 5 minutes, until cooked, stirring frequently. Serve warm with rice, as an accompaniment.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,bulgar wheat,tomato juice,fish fillet,campbell cream celery soup,chickpea,sugar
title: Tomato Vegetable Fish Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed campbell's cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 can v8 vegetable juice ( i used v8 with chicken ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 can chopped mixed vegetables ( i used a mix of celery, onions, and green chilies ) | 2 cups cooked peeled crawfish fillets ( optional ) | 1/2 cup bulgar wheat ( uncooked ) ( optional ) | sugar, for sprinkling
instructions: Combine the soup, veggie juice, chickpeas, mixed vegetables, crawfish, and bulgur in a large deep saucepan. Heat over medium high heat to boiling. Boil, stirring occasionally, for 6 minutes. Sprinkle with sugar.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,burgundy wine,peanut oil,pam cooking spray,green cabbage,black pepper,oregano
title: Crispy Pepper Rings (Shredded Vegetables) With Burgundy Wine
ingredients: 1 lb red cabbage ( chopped or shredded ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons red curry paste ( i prefer tofu ) | 1 bottle burgundy wine ( or madeira, or other sweet white wine ) | pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Coat a wide mouth casserole dish with pam or coat with pam. Place the vegetable in a bowl and toss with the olive oil, oregano, and pepper. Toss lightly to combine. Transfer to the casserole dish. Cover and bake 30 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 15 - 20 minutes or until tender, stirring every 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,cottage cheese,red bell pepper,pork tenderloin,chili sauce
title: Cheesy Pork Tenderloin with Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds pork tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 3/4 cup kalamata olives, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/3 cup shredded cottage cheese | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into thin strips
instructions: Cook pork in a skillet with enough water to cover over high heat until meat is cooked through, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,pork,chickpea flour,pork butt roast,irish cream,mint sprig,egg noodle,pepper
title: Creamy Coriander Pork Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork butt roast, fat trimmed | 1 1/4 lbs fresh extra lean ground pepper | 6 fluid ounces irish cream ( or brandy ) | 12 fluid ounces chickpea flour ( available at asian markets ) | 6 fluid ounces peanut oil or 6 fluid ounces lard | 1 1/4 teaspoons curry powder | 12 fresh mint sprigs | 15 ounces egg noodles
instructions: Trim the pork butt of any visible fat before discarding skin and excess fat. Cut into 1 inch cubes and place in a bowl with remaining ingredients. Mix well with hands to thoroughly coat meat. Cover and refrigerate overnight before proceeding. Bring to room temperature and bring to room temperature for cooking the noodles. Simmer covered over low heat for 2 hours, skimming the scum off the top as it rises to the top. Serve with fresh mint leaves if desired.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,tea,yellow pepper,french onion soup mix
title: Hot & Easy French Onion Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons french onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon tea | 1/2 yellow pepper | 1/2 bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a soup pot & cook over med high heat until peppers become soft, or slightly soft. Serve while hot.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,sake,cheese,red potato,triple sec,cooking sherry,wooden skewer,phyllo dough
title: Potato Triangles
ingredients: 1 lb red potatoes, cut into 1/4 inch dice | 1 lb phyllo dough, thawed | sake, sauce ( i used kikkoman ) | 1 cup cooking sherry | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1/4 cup sesame seeds, divided | 3/4 lb cheese, cut into chunks | wooden skewer, soaked in water
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl, combine the potatoes and sherry, triple sec, sesame seeds and half the cheese. Add half of the phyllo dough and mix well. Cut the phyllo sheets into 3x3 inch rectangles. Wet each piece of phyllo dough in water before brushing with a wet pastry brush, ensuring each gets moistened with a wet pastry brush. Place about 2 tablespoon of the potato mixture in the center of one of the rectangles. Fold the bottom corner of the phyllo over the potato mixture and, folding the corners in, over the potato mixture. Continue making all the phyllo sheets, brushing each with the last brush and letting the filling fillings set up in the center of the phyllo dough. With a knife or pastry brush, spread 2 tablespoons cooking sherry across the top of each stack of filled dough. Bake for about 30 minutes or until the top of the stack is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,orange peel,lemon juice zest,cornstarch,red chili paste,yellow onion,rigatoni pasta
title: Elegant Baked Rigatoni-Parmesan
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 3 tablespoons red chili paste | 3/4 cup yellow onion, minced | 1 teaspoon orange peel, minced | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice, fresh
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cook rigatoni as directed. Drain. Set aside. In a bowl, combine cornstarch with 3 tablespoons green chili paste. Add to rigatoni. Stir in onion, orange peel, worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Stir until well mixed. Pour into lightly oiled 12 inch baking pan. Bake, uncovered, 40 to 45 minutes, until browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,buttermilk,garlic salt,mexican cheese,chocolate chip,orange liqueur,chunky salsa
title: Mexican Mice Nests
ingredients: 1 bag mexican cheese | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate chips or ( 4 ounce ) package chopped chocolate | 2 tablespoons orange-flavored liqueur or 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: In a microwave safe bowl combine the mexican cheese and vinegar. Microwave, uncovered, on high approximately 3 minutes, stirring every two minutes or until melted. Stir in the salsa and chocolate chips. Stir buttermilk and garlic salt in a medium bowl until well combined. Add buttermilk mixture and stir to mix. Cover and refrigerate for two to twelve hours or until the cheese mixture is firm. If you don't have time to serve the mexican mexican mexican mexican mexican mixture, place the mexican mixture in a fine mesh strainer, draining the excess liquid off. Shake or stir the mexican mixture until thoroughly drained and well mixed. Place the mexican mexican mixture in to a small bowl. Serve with corn chips or crackers.

title: Scallops Marinated With Banana and Balsamic Oats #83506
ingredients: 1/2 lb sirloin steak | 1 head fresh sea scallops | 1/2 cup oatmeal | 2 tablespoons aged balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon olive oil or 1 teaspoon butter
instructions: Combine oatmeal and vinegar in a shallow pan, add sirloin steak and cook on high heat for 2 minutes. Turn and cook another 2 to 3 minutes. Scoop oatmeal mixture into a bowl, add sirloin steak and toss, coating. Serve on top of warmed oatmeal and sprinkle with cheese.

title: A Simple Homemade Beef or Turkey Gravy for Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef or 1 lb turkey | 1 tablespoon dried savory, crushed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly using a fork, patting the turkey dry. Store in a covered dish for several days in the fridge.

title: Lamb Cutlets With Rum (Kalalangollo M'estre)
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg lamb cutlets, pounded to a thin 1/4-cm thick | kitchen string, to decorate | 1 tablespoon dark rum
instructions: Put lamb cutlets into a resealable glass or ceramic dish. Sprinkle with kitchen string. Pour rum over the top of the cutlets and marinate overnight in the fridge. Preheat oven to 180°c. Remove the lamb from the marinade and place the cutlets in a roasting tin. Make a paste with the kitchen string placed on the top of the cutlets, then spoon a little of the marinade over them. Cover the dish tightly and cook for 2½ - 3 hours or until the meat is done. To serve, turn the meat over gently and leave to stand for 15 minutes to set the meat if necessary. Cut into 3cm slices and serve immediately.

title: Homemade Tomato Gravy
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh parsley, finely minced | 2 tablespoons tomato juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Enjoy with meat, poultry or seafood.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,green bean,tarragon leaf,ginger powder,marshmallow,chicken bouillon cube
title: Tandoori Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs green beans, trimmed | 1 chicken bouillon cubes ( optional ) or 1 vegetable bouillon cube ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons garam masala ( available in indian stores ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger powder | 1/8 teaspoon dried tarragon leaves | 0.5 package miniature marshmallows (, not instant )
instructions: Cut green beans diagonally into two lengths. Slice vegetarian chicken breast into thin strips, if desired. Arrange on the bottom of a 6 - 6 pint dish lined with a few of the dried tarragon leaves. Sprinkle top of green beans with garam masala and ginger powder. Pour chicken on top of green beans. Grate the remainder of the dry tarragon leaves. Sprinkle top of green beans with shredded ginger and tarragon. Place in a microwave proof bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes, depending on your microwave and desired moisture content. Stir halfway through cooking time. Serve immediately or chilled.

title: TEX Beef Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs round steaks | 2 teaspoons ginger and garlic powder | 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 1 pinch fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon parsley leaves | 1 tablespoon jalapeno seasoning salt
instructions: Place meat in a mixing bowl or zipper lock bag. Mix in the spices. Let sit for a few hours with the bags. Remove meat from bag and brown in a skillet on all sides in a small amount of oil. Once done, put meat in a roasting pan. Roast at 375 degrees f & cook for 30 - 45 minutes depending on preference. Once done, remove meat & tent loosely with foil and allow to rest 15 minutes before slicing into thin strips.

title: Doughnuts
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons herbs, mixed ( sorrel, lemon balm, etc ) | 1 teaspoon lemon extract ( orange, lemon or or lemon flavoured )
instructions: Mix the herbs & lemon or lemon flavoured zest together w/gr. Spray a frying pan w/pam or any oil. Heat the pan until oil shimmers. Sprinkle the herbs over & fry for 1 minute, coating the surface w/little oil. Turn the nuts in the pan & fry for 1 - 2 minutes, until golden brown & tender. Leave on paper towels to dry slightly. Spray tops of w/pam while still slightly warm if desired. Variation, instead of pistachios, i would add finely chopped almonds.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,yellow bell pepper,cabbage,cream,chickpea,wheat flour,taco seasoning mix
title: Pressed-Up Wheat-Hole Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, about 12 ounces | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 can garbanzo beans, drained | 1 cup canned chickpeas, drained | 1/4 cup fat free sour cream | 3 tablespoons wheat flour or 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together cabbage, bell pepper and chickpeas. Dissolve the taco seasoning in cream. Blend in the cornstarch, add to veggies and stir until moistened. Chill 30 minutes to 1 hour. Serve.

title: Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dry fettuccine pasta | 1 cup snow peas, sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Roasted Veggie and Nut Rabbit
ingredients: 8 -10 medium rabbits | 1/2 cup besan | 1 cup soymilk ( use half cream and half milk to make 4 servings ) | 1/2 medium yellow pepper, roasted, deseeded & sliced into rounds | 2 teaspoons mixed spice ( can add or subtract flavours to taste, i used baharat aka middle east spice mix ) | 1 cup margarine or 1 cup butter
instructions: Put the vegies in a casserole dish. Mix the ingredients and pour over the vegies. Bake in a hot oven for about 40 - 45 mins, or until cooked.

title: Real English Cumberland Ham Hock for the Clay Cook
ingredients: 4 smoked ham hocks | 300 ml dry white wine ( not sweet wine ) | 125 g caster sugar
instructions: Lay the ham hocks over a large, preferably heavy bottomed pan and cover with thickly with the wine, leaving about 1/2 inch of space at the top. Leave the space so the ham can circulate during cooking. If possible, put the lid on the pan so you don't touch any air bubbles, and cook for 30 to 45 minutes to 2 hours depending on the thickness of the ham hocks. During the last 15 minutes of cooking, make the sauce through to remove the fat and impurities floating to the surface. Remove the bone and skin from the ham hocks and cut off the top fat from the ham. Slice off the thin, fatty layer at the bottom of the ham hocks. Spoon the sauce over the ham and serve, with the butter and pickles for dipping, or with just plain boiled potatoes for lunch or tea.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,plain flour,ginger,chili paste,guinness stout,extra virgin olive oil,mace,bay leaf
title: Faux Guinness Spiced Oil
ingredients: 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons plain flour | 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/4 teaspoon chili paste | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 3 ounces guinness stout | 2 sprigs fresh ginger, leaves picked | 2 bay leaves, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 325f. Warm a small, heavy based saucepan over a high heat. Add olive oil and flour. Stir well and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Add a third of the remaining ingredients.

title: Aussie Barley Crunch Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 2 cups icing sugar | 3/4 cup tamari | 3 cups blueberries or 3 cups grapeberries, thawed
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss lightly to mix. Pour into greased square loaf pan. Bake at 160c for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cooked. Allow to cool to room temperature, then slice and serve or store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

title: Baked Fettuccine With Sweet and Sour Sauce
ingredients: 3 boxes fettuccine pasta | 1 jar sweet and sour sauce, divided ( sweet and sour sauce ) | 3/4 cup barbecue sauce | 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes ( in juice ) | 2 tablespoons cinnamon sugar | 1 jar sliced pimientos, drained ( may substitute with black olive )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In large bowl, cook fettuccine according to package directions. Drain. Meanwhile, in medium bowl, combine sweet and sour sauce, 1/2 cup barbecue sauce and cinnamon sugar. In separate bowl, spread reserved 1/2 cup barbecue sauce mixture on each serving plate. Spoon 1/4 cup sweet sour sauce mixture over each plate of pasta. Spoon remaining sweet sour sauce mixture over each serving. Top with tomatoes and pimentos. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,red bell pepper,pasta sauce,ancho chile powder,black coffee,chicken bouillon,sauce
title: Low Fat Chicken Cottage Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon achi chile powder | 1/8 teaspoon black ancho chile powder | 1 -3 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 -3 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 cup low fat cottage cheese | 1 cup pasta sauce | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Heat pasta sauce in a small saucepan or crockpot. If there is less than 2 - 3 tblsp.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Pate
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups frozen peas and carrots, thawed | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix peas and carrots with half of the cheese. Spread onto a greased 9 inch square baking dish. Cover and bake at 400 degrees f for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Simple Shredded Cheese
ingredients: 2 sheets shortcrust pastry | 420 g chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Take out your pastry sheets of pastry and using your biscuit cutter or your rolling pin roll them out into circles 3mm thick. Place the cheese along one edge of your shortcrust pastry circles. Use your thumb to fold the pastry over and over the filling to make a double layer until all the cheese is used up. Wash your hands and press down the pastry with your hands. Use a fork to crimp the edges of the pastry if any, or brush with a little bit of oil if the pastry doesn't stick to them. Repeat until the pastry is used up. You can do this with all the cheese and pastry, or even with the salsa. Place on to a tray and cook in oven for 5 - 10 minutes or until the cheese has melted and turned golden. Serve hot, room temperature. This freezes very well.

title: Creamy Apple Lettuce Tea
ingredients: 1 liter organic low fat milk | 8 leaves lettuce ( shredded fresh or dry ) | 3 fresh tea leaves | 1 chopped apple ( optional ) | 1 chopped green chili pepper | chickpea salt ( for coating ) or berry salt ( for coating )
instructions: Put the milk in a pan and turn on to simmer while you place the shredded lettuce leaves in the pot. After 5 minutes, put a tea towel on top and put the teil in the fridge for another 5 minutes. Strain the milk into a tea towel lined basin. Once the tea leaves are ready, heat the milk with an electric hand held whisk or two for 7 - 10 minutes depending on your taste, if you need to. The soup is ready to serve and can be stored in an airtight container for up to two weeks.

title: Garlicky Barley with Cheese & Pepper
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup water | 3 tablespoons curry powder ( the more the better! ) | 2 -3 drops pepper | 2 tablespoons dried parsley or 2 tablespoons fresh parsley | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( or pecorino romano grana padano ) ( optional )
instructions: Bring the stock or water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Drop the barley into the boiling stock, cover and simmer until the barley is tender. Add the curry powder, pepper, parsley and parmesan and stir. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: sugar,cheddar monterey jack cheese,hot red chili pepper,coriander powder,garlic powder,splenda granular,mayonnaise
title: Hot Chili Sauce 2007
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed biscuit mix for pizza | 2 1/2 cups shredded cheddar and monterey jack cheese blend ( divided ) or 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese ( divided ) | 1 tablespoon splenda granular or 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground corianderiander powder | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 hot red chili pepper, chopped and seeded ( i don't add ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise, light preferably ( i prefer hellmans )
instructions: Bake, 1/2 cup of grated cheese per half of a 9” x 9” glass pie pan at 350°f for about 10 minutes, or until cheese has melted and mixture is starting to color. Watch the first few times as it can burn. Sprinkle the last ¼ cup of grated cheese over the top of the brownie. After the cheese has melted and turned a light golden brown, let cool at least 10 minutes before cutting. Prepare the sauce, combine the ingredients, except mayo. Mix well. Store any leftover sauce in the refrigerator. This can be reheated on the stove top or on the burner. I find that when i am serving this with steamed veggies, i always have a microwave safe dish or saucepan that is just on the stove top on the stove. I then put the mayo mixture in the microwave and heat on high for about 10 minutes or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: pork roast,ham hock,jalapeno pepper,pecan,miso paste,poultry seasoning
title: Caribbean Pork Roast
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried pecans | 3 tablespoons jalapeno pepper, finely diced | 3 tablespoons dried ham hocks | 1/4 cup light miso paste | 2 1/2 tablespoons poultry seasoning | 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork roast, fat trimmed and tied
instructions: Place the dried pecans on a cookie sheet and set aside. Rinse the ham hocks under warm water and pat dry with paper towels, and place on the cookie sheet. Combine the jalapeno, ham hocks and miso paste in a small bowl. Sprinkle the poultry seasoning over the pork and add any excess juices from the ham hock. Dredge the pork in the miso paste, cover and let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit. Transfer the remaining marinade to a shallow roasting pan, add the pork, and marinate at room temperature for about 1 hour or refrigerate overnight. Bake the pork for 1 hour, basting occasionally with the pan juices. When done, the internal temperature will be 200 degrees fahrenheit. Let rest for 10 minutes, slice and serve with hoisin sauce.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,dill,sirloin steak,kernel corn,lime peel,shrimp paste
title: Shrimp and Corn Stuffed Beef
ingredients: 6 lbs sirloin steaks, about 1/3 inch thick | 1 lb shrimp paste | 2 cans whole kernel corn, do not drain | 2 lbs ground chuck roast | 1 lb lime peel | 4 teaspoons dill
instructions: Slice each of the beef 3/4 inch thick and 1/2 inch long. Lay on a flat surface, lay 2 pieces of shrimp paste on top and roll tightly like a jelly roll. Use any leftover stuffing of your choice, for dipping the beef. Chop corn from cobbler or corn syrup. Mix shrimp paste, corn, beef, lime peel and dillweed, using your discretion. Line a large baking pan with aluminum foil with several layers of reynolds wrap aluminum foil, making sure foil has a lot of space over the top. Fill each packet with the beef mixture. Lay each packet on its side of aluminum foil. Dip each of the beef packets in the shrimp/corn mixture and lay next to each other on their tops. Seal the foil and bake at 325 for 2 hours and 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Short Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef short ribs | 1/2 cup reduced-fat mayonnaise | 1/2 cup reduced-fat peanut butter | 1/4 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 2 tablespoons canned diced tomatoes with no seasoning, undrained
instructions: Place beef ribs in a 1 1/2 quart slow cooker. Combine remaining ingredients in a medium bowl.

title: Aussie Salmon Parcel
ingredients: 500 g blueberries, drained | 1/2 cup mixed herbs, chopped | 1/2 cup mixed salad, chopped | 1/2 cup mango chutney ( major grey preferred ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 150 g cooked salmon | 0.5 packet phyllo dough | 1/4 cup plum sauce
instructions: Place blueberries, mixed herbs and chutney in a bowl and mix. Place salmon and phyllo on greased baking tray. Brush with plum sauce. Bake at c for 15 minutes until golden.

title: Chutney Mix (Or Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup mixed italian herbs
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a small bowl or container with a lid. Mix well. Store in an airtight container.

title: Dill Salad
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise ( preferably light ) | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/3 cup dry red wine | 3 -4 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill ( or about 5 t. ) | 3 -4 tablespoons finely chopped green peppers ( or any green chiles specified ) | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh dill ( or about 1/4 cup )
instructions: To make the dressing,. In a small bowl whisk together the mayonnaise with the sugar. If the mayo and sugar are combined, mix in the 1/3 cup wine, the chopped dill, green chilies, mayonnaise and dill. Place the dressing in a jar in which you can tightly pack the mayonnaise and sugar. Seal the jar and shake to mix. If the dressing is too thick, add a bit of water. You may want to refrigerate the dressing for up to 2 days for flavours to develop.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,fine breadcrumb,red chili,artichoke heart,italian sausage,tomato green chilies,lettuce,thai red curry paste
title: Sausage and Artichoke Wraps
ingredients: 15 burrito-size flour tortillas ( see separate recipe ) | 8 1/2 ounces cooked hot italian sausage, diced | 8 ounces rotel diced stewed tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped ( reserve liquid ) | 8 1/2 ounces thai red curry paste | 4 1/2 cups mixed lettuce, shredded | 4 1/2 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs | 1/4 dried red chili, crushed
instructions: Heat skillet to very hot. Add sausage.

title: Baked Olives
ingredients: 3 cans sliced ripe olives | 3 tablespoons olive | 3 tablespoons mild hickory smoke salt | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place olives, olive salt, hot sauce and olive oil in a bowl. Stir to combine and place in an ungreased 8 x4 inch baking dish. Bake for about 20 to 22 minutes, stirring the olives every 5 to 10 minutes to make sure the olives are evenly coating them with the sauce.

title: Sauteed Spanish Onions
ingredients: 4 large spanish onions | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Wash and cut each onion in half lengthwise. Cut away the root ends. Slice the onions lengthwide. Place a large saute pan or wok over high heat. When it starts to smoke, stir in the onions, lower heat. Cover the pan and allow the onions to steam for about 5 minutes. Remove lid and reduce heat to medium. Let the onions soften a bit. Sprinkle dark soy sauce on top and increase heat. Cook for about 5 minutes more, or until the onions are tender and glazed with dark. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: raspberry vinegar,milk ricotta cheese,mandarin orange,cayenne pepper
title: Pancakes With Mandarin Orange
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 cups whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup mandarin oranges ( drained ) | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper ( more or less to taste ) | 1 teaspoon raspberry vinegar
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender in batches until smooth. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend. Keeps up to 2 days in the refrigerator.

title: Gorgonzola and Green Chilies on a Bed of Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup sliced black olives | 1 package gorgonzola
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the drained tomatoes and olives.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,chicken bouillon,stewing beef,pork bean,chive,apple cider vinegar,raspberry
title: Beef Stew With Raspberry and Apple Vinegar
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef or 4 lbs top round steak, trimmed and cubed | 4 lbs russet potatoes, peeled, cut into 2-inch cubes | 10 teaspoons chives, chopped | 4 cups chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 cans pork and beans | 2 cups fresh raspberry rounds
instructions: Place meat and potatoes in 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. Sprinkle with chives and pour bouillon over all. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 to 8 hours or high setting for 5 hours. Remove meat and potatoes to warm platter. Remove fat from cooker. Add vinegar, undrained pork and beans to cooker. Cover and cook on high setting 10 minutes or until mixture boils. Serve immediately with raspberries.

title: Straw Hats (Mushroom and Stuffed Potato W- Shiitake Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1 cup chopped straw mushroom ( shiitake mushrooms ) | 1 1/2 cups small red potatoes | 1/4 lb fresh scallops or 1/4 lb sea scallops | 1/4 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and well drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Place mushrooms, potatoes, scallops, chick peas and liquid smoke in mixing bowl. Set aside. Wrap the mushrooms around the scallops in the stuffing, securing with toothpicks or string. Place in a shallow roasting pan. Sprinkle with walnuts. Bake 20 minutes. Remove from oven, cover and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Easiest Meat Ragu
ingredients: 1 package tortellini | 1 package cheddar cheese, shredded ( or mozzarella ) | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 cup beef sausage | 5 eggs, beaten
instructions: Start cooking your noodles for 3 - 3 hours at high heat. Cook for 5 - 6 minutes at medium heat. Drain meat well and set aside. Dice 1/2 cup cheddar cheese and melt in the microwave on low in a microwave proof dish. Add 1/2 cup of cheddar and melt in the microwave on high in the microwave. Add the 1 cup of cheddar to the meat and put in refrigerator. Dip tortellini in beaten egg and put inside meat and sprinkle 1/4 cup of the cheddar to the top of the meat. Bake covered with aluminum foil at 200 degrees for 30mins or until cheese is melted. You can even put under the grill until golden, if you turn up the heat a little and you get crisp on the outside. Take out and put on plate, sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup of the cheddar and enjoy. Tip, the prep time includes 3 hours.

title: Bulgogi
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless lamb, cut in 1 1/2- inch cubes | 1/2 lb stew meat, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup light buttermilk | 1 tablespoon mirin or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 small bulb of garlic ( about 10 cloves ) | 1 can plum tomatoes, drained and crushed | pepper
instructions: Place lamb and stew meat into a large saucepan. Add buttermilk and mirin.

title: Easy Avocado Rice Bowl for One
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice or 2 cups cooked white rice ( 16 ounces ) | 4 small plums, sliced in half, pitted, seeded, and sliced to 1/4 inch | 1 ripe avocado, peeled, pit removed, and sliced ( 1/2 cup ) | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet paprika, to taste ( optional, or to taste ) | 1 -2 drop tabasco sauce ( optional but highly recommended! ) | paprika, to taste ( optional, or to taste )
instructions: Put the rice in a bowl and add a handful of the plums, avocado, paprika, and tabasco sauce. Sprinkle the rest of the plums over and serve with additional paprika.

title: Hot and Easy Date Broth
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 pound chopped dates | 2 cups quinoa
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the soup and dates. Stir in quinoa. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes, or until quinoa is tender and soup is heated through.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,lemon zest,basil leaf,celery seed,hot chili powder
title: Guinness-Lemon Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf | 1/4 cup fresh lemon zest | 1/4 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon hot chili powder | 1 can guinness stout
instructions: Puree the basil, lemon zest, celery seed, and chile powder in a blender or food processor until the mixture is the consistency of a smooth paste. Pour the guinness into a wide bowl to be marinated in later use. Add the pureed herb mixture and gently mix to blend.

title: Tamarind-Spice - Vietnamese Oven Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons allspice | 4 lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f. Mix allspice and oil in a small bowl. Add lettuce to a 9x9 baking dish in a single layer. Spread mixture evenly over lettuce. Wrap the salad tightly with aluminium foil, sealing well. Bake in 375f oven for 20 minutes. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tamarind extract,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spinach leaf,apple juice
title: Tamarind Ice Blocks
ingredients: 4 -5 fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup tamarind extract ( i used the bottled extract ) | 2 ounces grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/4 cup apple juice or 1/4 cup apple juice
instructions: Place the spinach in a strainer and run it over a saucepan to remove as much of the excess liquid as possible. Use a large knife to scrape the spinach in the running liquid until all the spinach has been squeezed out. Place the spinach in a large bowl and add the tamarind extract, chopped parmigiano reggiano, apple juice and cheese. Toss until the cheese is thoroughly incorporated, then refrigerate in an ice block tray for at least 15 minutes for the flavors to develop. Transfer the block directly into the freezer.

title: Chile-Lentil Bites (Grilled)
ingredients: 1 bag lentils ( red or yellow ) | 1 lb ground beef sirloin | 1 poblano chile, peeled and left unpeeled | 2 -3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro or 2 -3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley
instructions: Rinse lentils in a fine stream under cold water. Place lentils in a large bowl. Wash hands and shake of any excess liquid from the lentils. Drain. Transfer lentils and poblano to the bowl with the lentils and stir. Set aside. In a medium sized skillet with a tight lid, over medium high heat, brown ground beef with finely chopped pepperoncini, salt and pepper. Drain meat of excess grease if necessary. Add cooked ground beef mixture and cook until browned and no longer pink, drain fat. Mix into the bowl with lentils and poblano. Mix in enough fresh cilantro to blend. Let sit 5 minutes before serving. Serve with warm crusty bread, crackers, sour cream or as a side dish.

title: Hogao Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans herring fillets, drained | 3 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 ripe avocado, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place herring in a large, deep baking pan. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake in the preheated oven until herring are tender and beginning to brown, 40 to 45 minutes. Shake herring occasionally to ensure it cooks evenly.

title: Chick Peas Salad With Dressing
ingredients: 15 ounces chickpeas, drained & rinsed | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 3 tablespoons chopped coconut | 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the chickpeas with all the dressing ingredients except the mayonnaise. Chill, stir well& serve.

Random Ingredients: parsley,lamb meat,oat,beef roast,mexican cheese,tuna water,cabbage,black bean
title: Taco Pie II
ingredients: 1 pound cubed lamb stew meat | 1 can tuna in water, drained and flaked | 1 can black beans | 1 can tuna in water, drained | 1 package shredded mexican cheese blend | 1 package frozen chopped cabbage | 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley | 1 cup rolled oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place lamb in a large, deep skillet. Layer the diced lamb, tuna, black beans, tuna, and processed cheese into a deep baking dish. Top with shredded cabbage, chopped parsley, and crushed dried red pepper flakes. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly, 45 to 60 minutes.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,flat rice noodle,chicken bouillon cube,red snapper fillet,hot pepper sauce,mint leaf
title: Spicy Vietnamese Snapper (Pad Kee)
ingredients: 1/4 lb cooked flat rice noodles | 14 ounces hot chicken bouillon cubes | 3 cups hot pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons hot chicken bouillon paste or 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 3 -4 fresh hot red snapper fillets | hot hot pepper sauce
instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil. Add rice noodles and cook according to package directions. Drain and set aside. In a small bowl, blend hot sauce, chicken bouillon, hot pepper sauce, 2 tblsps. Of mint leaves, and 2 teaspoons of minced fresh hot pepper sauce or hot pepper sauce. Place snapper fillets in a shallow glass or plastic dish. Top with half the sauce mix and top with remaining sauce. Grill fillets over high heat 3 - 5 minutes per side. Serve with remaining mint leaves sprinkled on top.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,lettuce leaf,tart apple,purpose flour,pineapple juice,pimiento,snow pea
title: Apple, Pineapple and Tuna Salad
ingredients: 2 cups chopped peeled tart apples or 2 cups other tart apples | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 can pineapple in juice, undrained | 2 cups snow peas, ends and strings removed | salt pork ( optional ) | lettuce leaf or lettuce leaf ( optional ) | pimiento, slices ( optional )
instructions: Place apples in a bowl, sprinkle with flour and toss to coat. Heat 1/2 can of the pineapples with juice in a saucepan, covered. Bring to boil and reduce heat to medium low. Cover and cook until apples are just tender. Drain. Add remaining pineapple, snow peas and salt pork if using. Cover and stir. Let stand about 5 minutes. Combine warm apple mixture with lettuce or lettuce leaves to serve.

title: Cod Salad With Crunchy French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh cod, cooked ( if your recipe calls for mackerel, use fresh ) | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 cup shell pasta ( i like to use small flake ) | 1/4 cup salad oil | 1 tablespoon sugar | 3 slices french bread ( thinly sliced crusty or rustic )
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the cod with the salt. Cook the pasta according to package directions.

title: Dressing for Shakers
ingredients: 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix together. Store in airtight container. Keeps several months.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,edible silver foil,ginger,greek yogurt,pepper,orange juice,coriander seed,salt
title: Spiced Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice | 1 tablespoon dried coriander seeds or 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup edible silver foil, rinsed
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except the silver foil in a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Add in the silver foil and blend until well combined – a few chunks remain. Serve immediately.

title: Pizza Sauce III
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: In a medium size bowl, combine the tomato sauce and flour. Add the ground mace. Slowly mix into a sauce, then simmer over medium heat for 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,turnip,vegetarian bean,sunflower seed,orange liqueur,safflower oil,coriander
title: Coriander-Safflower Spiced Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 300 g turnips or 300 g green turnips | 1 can vegetarian refried beans | 2 cups coriander ( cilantro ) | 1/4 cup sunflower seeds ( shelled ) | spanish safflower oil ( for deep frying ) ( optional ) | 1/4 cup orange flavored liqueur | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco sauce
instructions: Peel turnips and cut into sticks 1 cm in diameter. Set aside. Wash coriander and dry well. Drain well and place in a tea towel. Toss with oil in a wok to dry. Chop and mix with turnip sticks or green turnips. Chop coriander, mix with beans in a bowl. Stir in spice and add liqueur if using. Serve warm or cold.

title: Ancho Chile Salt
ingredients: 2 teaspoons grated ancho chiles ( dry crushed chile ) | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1 cup cornflour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and leave to ferment in the refrigerator until needed. Makes about 1 cup.

title: Dynamite
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Mix well and pour into an old fashioned glass.

title: Greek Green Olive Dip
ingredients: 1 carton green olives ( pitted if you want ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( more if you wish ) | 4 tablespoons freshly grated romano cheese
instructions: Grate romano and stir in with olives. Add cinnamon and stir. Cover and refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours before serving. Serve with bread, crackers or fresh vegetables.

title: Pasta E Fagioli
ingredients: 1 package dry pasta | 1 cup finely chopped swiss chard | 1 can drained green beans | 1 tablespoon hot sauce, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente.

title: Sauce Rice Wraps (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 cup rice flour ( to be gluten free if desired ) | 6 ounces hamburger | 1 red onion ( diced ) | 1 tablespoon a.1. original sauce ( a.1 ) | 300 -400 g whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain. Add red onion with tomato sauce to meat. Mix well. Let simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with your favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,chambord raspberry liquor,red pepper flake,vanilla bean,salmon fillet
title: Cod Cod With Chambord and Smoked Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 1 lb cod fish fillets | 1/2 vanilla bean | 1/4 cup chambord raspberry liquor | 1 lb smoked salmon fillet, sliced thin | 1 dash red pepper flakes
instructions: Pour chambord into a small saucer. Slice vanilla bean in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and white seeds and set aside. Slice open vanilla bean lengthwise. Place fish in saucer. Insert vanilla bean slice in center of fish. Place chambord and pepper flakes in center of fish. Wrap the fish around the fish, securing with toothpicks. Place fish in a small baking dish. Pour chambord over fish. Cover and marinate fish and chambord in the refrigerator for about 2 to 3 hours, turning a few times.

title: Tuna With Smoked Provolone Cheese on Endive
ingredients: 2 cans tuna | 1 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup vodka | 1/4 cup chopped hazelnuts | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Drain tuna, reserving juices, and cut tuna into small chunks with hands. Toss with flour. In large bowl, stir tuna with vodka. Toss in hazelnuts and provolone cheese with hands until evenly coated.

title: Croustades
ingredients: 1 fresh oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon finely chopped white onion
instructions: Mix together oyster sauce and white onion and marinate the oysters for at least an hour.

title: Lima (Greek Bean Cheese Fritters)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes ( finely chopped ) | 2 tablespoons chopped lima beans ( or frozen lima beans ) | 1/4 - 1/3 cup soymilk ( or 2 tbsp. plain soymilk ) | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped sun-dried tomatoes | shredded sharp cheddar cheese or your favorite cheese, to cover
instructions: Combine the sun dried tomatoes, lima beans and soymilk in a small bowl. Stir in the sun dried tomatoes. Add the shredded cheese, mix well and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend. Stir once or twice at serving time. Serve immediately with crudites, as an appetizer or light breakfast.

title: Sweet and Sour Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup flour ( can use 1 c more ) | 1 cup quick oats | 3/4 cup flour | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 can pineapple slices, cut into chunks
instructions: Blend all ingredients well and chill for 1 hour to let flavors mingle. If refrigerated, let veggies steam while you cook rice.

Random Ingredients: rib beef,orange juice,chicken bouillon,bacon dripping,thai basil,black bean sauce
title: Easy Vietnamese Glazed Short Ribs
ingredients: 3 lbs short rib of beef ( about 2-1/2 inches long ) | 1 1 cup chicken bouillon | 3/4 cup fresh orange juice | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh thai basil ( can sub 1/2 tsp dried basil ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai black bean sauce | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings, warmed
instructions: In 3 3/4 - 6 quart slow cooker, place ribs. In small bowl combine bouillon and orange juice.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,chicken broth,chinese duck sauce,egg white,salmon,apple cider,cocoa,pastry
title: Smoke and Apple Pastry Creamy Smoked Salmon & Egg White Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons pumpkin pie spice paste ( magic sausage spice powder recommended ) | 1 lb top quality smoked salmon, sliced thinly ( or your favourite smoked salmon ) | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa | 2 egg whites | 2 tablespoons cider | 2 tablespoons low sodium chicken broth | 4 ounces thinly brushed smoked salmon | 2 ounces thinly thinly sliced pimientos | 1 teaspoon chinese duck sauce ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl add all ingredients except for salmon, pimentos, duck sauce and pate. Whisk egg whites until blended and then add to salmon mixture in a jive. This will make enough to make one 9 x13. If using smoked salmon, remove skin and cut into thin strips using 2 pieces of salmon at a time. Sprinkle pate evenly on top, then layer pate, then salmon on top, sprinkle pate on top and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pepper,lemon juice,cream cheese,garbanzo bean,banana liqueur,gluten flour,tomato green chilies,broccoli
title: Smothered Banana Bean Spread (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 15 1/2 ounces garbanzo beans ( chick peas ) | 14 3/4 ounces diced tomatoes and green chilies | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 cup gluten-free flour, gluten-free blend for bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon granulated garlic | 1/2 cup garbanzo beans ( chick peas )
instructions: Boil & drain garbanzo beans, reserving liquid. Cool & stir into mashed garbanzo beans, tomatoes in puree & cream cheese.

title: Deviled Scallions
ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups shredded cajun radish ( i use the fresh version ) | 1 1/2 dozen scallions, sliced | 1 1/2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Combine mayonnaise, cajun radishes, and scallions in a bowl. Cover and chill in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes or up to 4 hours. Serve with crushed ice.

Random Ingredients: white flour,corn tortilla,serrano pepper,portabella mushroom,monterey jack cheese,herb,black eyed pea,sticky rice
title: Mexican Fried Rice With Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 ounces serrano peppers, stemmed ( from a jar ) | 1/2 cup portabella mushroom, thinly sliced | 2 ounces cooked black-eyed peas ( from the jar ) | 2 medium portabella mushrooms, sliced | 1/3 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup white flour, blend | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried herb ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon corn tortilla, cut into small pieces, for serving
instructions: Set oven to 325°f heat an ungreased 13x9x2 inch baking dish in the oven. In a 10 inch nonstick frying pan, heat serrano peppers and portobello mushrooms over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly to separate the mushrooms, until the mushrooms are browned, about 3 minutes. Add black eyed peas to pan and cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until the peas are no longer bright green, about 3 minutes longer. In the now empty frying pan, lightly brown the flour on high heat for 4 minutes. Stir in the herbs, mixed spice and tortilla pieces. Stir into the vegetables. Spoon into the prepared dish.

Random Ingredients: steak,pork sausage,head escarole,apricot preserve,salt pepper,russet potato,romano cheese
title: Potato and Sausage Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb round steak, trimmed with all fat cut into 3/4 inch thick ( i use chuck sirloin ) | 1 lb pork sausage, removed from casing, sliced 1/4 inch thick and 1/4 inch thick ( i use maple flavored ) | 4 russet potatoes | 1 head escarole, washed and sliced | 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese ( to taste ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Boil the two large russet potatoes until the potatoes are fork tender, about 45 or 50 minutes. Drain off the water, cool, and then shred the potatoes in a food processor. In a large dutch oven, brown the ground meat and sliced sausage together over medium heat until cooked all the way through.

Random Ingredients: chile powder,fine salt,tilapia fillet,cauliflower,lamb fillet,chickpea,mirin,pork shoulder
title: Faux Japanese Spicy Lamb With Cauliflower and Shredded Lamb
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fine salt | 1 teaspoon chile powder | 1 1/4 lbs lamb fillets, cubed | 1 lb tilapia fillet, cubed | 1/2 lb beef jerky ( sliced jerky ) or 1/2 lb pork shoulder, sliced | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 package cauliflower, florets and stems | 3 tablespoons mirin ( rice wine vinegar )
instructions: Rinse and drain chickpeas. Cover bottom of 4 x12 pan with foil on all sides. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove meat from refridgerator and bring to room temperature. Arrange meat in pan and top with sauce. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 1 hour, or until meat is tender. Serve over rice or noodles. You can make this in a pot instead.

title: Homemade Cheese (Italian Style)
ingredients: 150 gr. fat free mozzarella cheese | 1/3 cup olive
instructions: First take your cheese. Then take a piece of cheese cutting motion and form it into a ball. Then, using the cheese as your starting with, place it in a bowl with a plate. Next take a plate and then, using a rolling pin, peel off a thin layer of mozzarella cheese on top of the mozzarella cheese. After all your cheese is cut, you can start to roll your cheese and place it on a plate. After that, you will roll your mozzarella cheese, using a rolling pin to flatten it out, into a rectangle, about 1/8 inch thick, onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet. Use a brush to apply olive oil to the cheese so it will stick to the paper when it is finished spreading the olive on the cheese. Bake at 350°f stirring every 10 minutes until lightly browned and bubbly on top. Once the cheese has cooked, it will be ready to slice. Please note that since you are using mozzarella cheese as your starting, it does not taste the same as regular cheese.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,green pepper,garlic olive oil,kosher salt,fenugreek,celery,grapefruit,jalapeno
title: Picnic Beef Kebabs, West African style
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless beef sirloin | 1/8 green pepper, halved, seeded and cut into 3 `` chunks | 1/3 cup dried minced fenugreek | 2 tablespoons garlic-flavored olive oil | 2 tablespoons minced garlic and olive oil | 2 tablespoons minced celery | 1/2 teaspoon dried minced jalapeno | 1 1/4 cups grapefruit or 1 1/4 cups canned grapefruits, cut into segments
instructions: Cut beef lengthwise into 2 1/2 thick slices. Combine all other ingredients except the grapefruit or grapefruits in a large ziploc bag. Add the beef in batches to the bag and marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours. Prepare a rack in a broiler pan and preheat broiler. Broil, uncovered, 1 inch from heat for 5 minutes. Turn and broil again for 5 to 7 minutes or until nicely browned all over. Serve.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,romano cheese,red cherry,worcestershire sauce
title: Italian Fish With Red Cherry and Romano Cheese
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon finely grated romano cheese | 1 1/4 lbs red candied cherries
instructions: Spray fish filets with cooking spray and sprinkle with worcestershire sauce. In a small bowl combine the romano cheese and the cherries. On a large platter arrange the fish on top of the cheese. Place a small mound of the romano cheese onto the top. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,sherry wine,pepper,mung bean sprout,chive,tortilla chip,molasses,hot pepper sauce
title: Mongo Bean Sprouts - Microwaved
ingredients: 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons dry sherry wine or 2 tablespoons rice wine | 2 teaspoons orange zest, minced | 5 -6 cups mung bean sprouts, rinsed | 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chives | tortilla chips, for serving
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients except for the bean sprouts and hot pepper sauce.

Random Ingredients: rosemary,leek,lemon juice zest,grain dijon mustard,purpose flour,camembert cheese,cardamom seed,brussels sprout
title: Baked French Herb Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 kg brussels sprouts, cleaned, washed well & trimmed | 3 tablespoons coarse grain dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 lemon, juice and zest of, grated | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 600 -800 g thick ripe camembert cheese or 600 -800 g mild gouda cheese, rind removed & cut into 16 chunks | rosemary
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas wash the brussels sprouts & pat dry with kitchen paper. Place in an ovenproof dish. Stir together the mustard, flour, lemon peel, lemon zest, flour & cardamon in a bowl. Spread the mustard & crushed cardamom in the botton or cheese chunks & top with the brussels sprouts. Bake for 20 - 25 approx or until thoroughly heated & golden brown. Serve piping hot with fresh herbs & plenty of freshly baked bread.

title: Carrot-Cranberry Soup
ingredients: 2 cans reduced-sodium vegetable broth | 2 carrots, peeled and sliced | 1 cup frozen cranberries, thawed | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1/4 cup chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Combine vegetable broth, carrots, cranberries, fennel seed and peanuts in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then lower heat. Simmer until carrots are tender, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,ice cube,alfredo sauce,passion fruit juice,nutritional yeast,porcini mushroom
title: Mushroom Alfredo
ingredients: 10 teaspoons passion fruit juice | 12 ounces alfredo sauce, can | 1 package frozen portobello mushrooms | 6 ounces oyster mushrooms | 4 ice cubes | 1 teaspoon nutritional yeast
instructions: Place ice cubes in a med. Magro dish with the passion fruit juice and pour on alfredo sauce. Add mushrooms with any extras. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least one hour. Slice oysters and mix with nutritional yeast to aid in the absorption process. Serve over chilled alfredo sauce.

title: Grape Tomato With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs grape tomatoes | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon minced anise seed | powdered sugar ( optional )
instructions: Cut each tomato almost in half and scoop out the pulp completely. Discard the skin and seeds, cut into halves, and cut each half in half again. In a bowl, combine the pulp, vinegar, and anise. Add sugar if desired. Spoon into a serving dish and serve.

title: Rigatoni With Rigatoni in Microwave
ingredients: 2 boxes rigatoni pasta | 5 eggs | 2 sheets pastry
instructions: Cook rigatoni in microwave then set aside. Beat eggs in a bowl with a whisk and add some water so that you get an egg mixture like consistency. Pour the egg mixture over the rigatoni and mix until all of the rigatoni is covered. Put the sheet of pastry on your cutting board and sprinkle some flour on it. Roll the sheet of pastry until it looks like pancake paper. Place some of the rigatoni on top, fold in half and press the edges until the mixture fills and then roll up like a burrito. Put on a paper towel to collect excess juices. Place in oven preheated to 160 f for 45 min or until golden brown. Take out and enjoy.

title: Broiled Radish Marinated in Wine - Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 red radish | 1/2 jar red wine, chilled
instructions: Trim the radish, removing as many as possible and discarding the leaves and stems. Slice the radish crosswise 1/8 inch thick. Arrange the radishes in a serving plate. Drizzle the chilled wine over the radishes. Broil the radishes until beginning to brown, 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Transfer the radishes to a serving plate, serve right away.

Random Ingredients: enchilada sauce,romaine lettuce,corn syrup,horseradish,self raising flour
title: Horseradish Enchilada Salad
ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 1/2 cup mild enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon horseradish
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Spoon into large salad bowls and top with extra horseradish if desired.

Random Ingredients: olive,shrimp,black bean sauce,lard,thai fish sauce,maple syrup,granny smith apple,chicken breast fillet
title: Crispy Shrimp with Black Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp, cleaned and devained | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon olive oil or 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon black bean sauce | 1 teaspoon thai fish sauce | 1 teaspoon lard | 1 lb chicken breast fillet, cooked, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f degrees. Place the shrimp in a dish large enough to hold them in a single layer and cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for five minutes. Remove the shrimp from the plastic wrap and transfer them to a shallow ovenproof dish. Place the shrimp and apples in the dish and sprinkle the maple syrup over them. Combine the olive oil, bean sauce, fish sauce and lard in a bowl and stir to combine. Pour this mix over the shrimp and apples and stir to combine. Place in the oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes. Serve hot and garnish with the shrimp and apple slices.

title: St. Joseph's Day Lunchbox Asafetida Loaf
ingredients: 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 cup warm slightly warm room temperature but not hot, 110 degrees f | 1/2 cup finely shredded gruyere cheese or 1/2 cup regular swiss cheese | 1/2 cup smooth unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 24 frozen meatballs ( defrosted if frozen )
instructions: Combine the yeast, 1 cup hot broth, and 3/4 cup of the cheese in a large bowl. Stir to combine. Pour 3/4 cup of the cheese and the remaining broth in a small bowl, and stir to combine, stirring to blend. Add in the asafetida and peanuts, and mix into a paste. Stir the paste into the yeast mixture along with the remaining cheese in a small bowl. Add the meatballs, and mix to combine. Add to a large buttered 8x2 inch loaf pan, and cover with an inverted bowl or baking sheet. Let rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. Bake for 45 - 60 minutes, until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from the pan.

title: Honey Peanut Butter Dessert
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey | 250 g chunky peanut butter | clementine, cut into small chunks
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, pound the honey and peanut butter into fine paste. Add the clementines, mix thoroughly and serve.

title: Braised Red Cabbage With Apples
ingredients: 5 tablespoons lemon zest or 1 tablespoon lemon juice, plus | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 5 tablespoons sweet golden delicious apples or 5 tablespoons chablis ( 4-5 medium apples ) | 1 lb red cabbage, preferably a medium-small head, leaves separated
instructions: In a large nonreactive bowl, combine 1 tablespoon lemon rind with 1 tablespoon zest, 1 tablespoon sweet golden apples or chablis and 1 cup cabbage. Place the cabbage on a large sheet of plastic wrap and cover with the remaining 2 tablespoon lemon zest. Gently toss the cabbage to combine, then let sit while you work with the remaining portions of the recipe. Wrap in foil and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, or overnight. About 30 minutes before serving, remove the cabbage from the refrigerator and let rest for a few minutes then slice diagonally across the grain. Arrange on a platter, drizzle with remaining tablespoon lemon zest, sprinkle with remaining tablespoon sugar and more salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Baked Salmon
ingredients: 300 g salmon ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons goat cheese | 3 red chilies | 1 teaspoon gingerroot ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon
instructions: Preheat oven 150 degrees celsius. Coat a small casserole dish with cooking spray. Cut salmon pieces into 1 inch pieces. Place all ingredients into casserole dish, stir well. Cover with lid or aluminium foil. Place in oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until fish flakes and is well cooked.

Random Ingredients: shallot,fennel seed,shrimp,fish sauce,plain flour,cooking wine,beef broth
title: Napa Goat Sauce
ingredients: 10 fluid ounces low sodium beef broth | 10 fluid ounces reduced-sodium beef broth | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 1 tablespoon cooking wine | 2 shallots, finely sliced | 16 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a saucepan simmer the chunky beef stock and beef broth over medium heat until reduced slightly, about 10 minutes. Mix in the fish sauce and fennel seeds. Cook over medium heat, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Place a steamer insert into a saucepan, and steam the steamed chunky beef broth mixture over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat, and set aside to cool slightly. Transfer the chunky beef broth mixture to a blender, and process until smooth. Stir in the shallots. Set aside 1/2 cup of chunky beef broth liquid. Stir in the shrimp, and process until just cooked through. Cool the chunky beef broth mixture to room temperature, then add to the chunky beef broth mixture in the blender, and process until smooth. Transfer the paste to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or overnight.

title: Couscous Pot Chicken With Olives
ingredients: olive oil | 2 tablespoons cooking sherry | 1 1/2 lbs chicken legs ( or wings ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground black peppercorns
instructions: Heat oil in a large heavy skillet over high heat. Add wings, salt and pepper. Cover and cook over moderate heat for 5 minutes. Stir in sherry. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Remove chicken, sprinkling with black pepper. Cover and continue cooking, shaking skillet frequently, for 25 minutes or until chicken is tender.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,serrano pepper,juice from one lime,kidney bean,red onion
title: Easy Low-Fat Habanero Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, drained & rinsed | 2 tablespoons finely chopped red onions | 1 tablespoon minced pimiento | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon lime juice
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients and stir until mixed.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,ranch dressing mix,thyme sprig,chicken,ramen noodle
title: Crock Pot Oriental Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 jar chicken quarters, drained | 1 package refrigerated original ranch dressing mix | 1 package instant ramen noodles or ( 7 ounce ) package oriental-style noodles, broken into thirds | 6 tablespoons fresh thyme sprigs, finely chopped | 4 lbs beef stew meat
instructions: Line 10 cup or larger baking dish with aluminum foil. Place beef in 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker. In medium bowl combine with dry ranch dressing mix and noodles.

title: Beef and Banana Casserole
ingredients: 2 beef flank steak | 2 tablespoons olive oil, about | 1 1/2 cups canned white beans | 1/4 cup mirin | 2 bananas, sliced thin
instructions: Trim fat from flank steak.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,purpose flour,dijon mustard,wedge lemon,dark cooking chocolate,soda water
title: Beef With Chocolate Ganache
ingredients: 3 -5 pounds coarsely ground beef chuck | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 -3 ounces dark cooking chocolate, melted ( i use baker's ) | 1 teaspoon soda water | 2 -3 wedges lemon, rind of, only
instructions: Place the ground chuck in a large, heavy, deep fryer or heavy duty plastic bucket. Sprinkle the flour over the ground chuck. Using a fork, stir the flour into the beef until it is combined thoroughly into a rough dough. Shake off any excess flour. If necessary, lightly press the dough away from the sides and bottom of the bucket. The dough is to be worked into the beef as quickly as possible using your hands.

title: Fajita Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the liquid smoke and seasoning mix.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,cherry tomato,kalamata olive,tart shell,green bean,beef bouillon cube,cranberry sauce
title: Beef With Tomatoes, Mixed Greens and Feta Crust Tarts
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 can cut green beans, drained | 1 package tart shells | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup dried cranberry sauce | 1 jar cherry tomatoes, drained | 1/3 cup chopped kalamata olive
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Place eggplant on sheet of parchment paper. Bake until blackened, about 45 minutes. Cut in half lengthwise and hollow out to remove pulp. Chop into 1/4 inch pieces. Place in a colander over a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and put on plate to drain for 1 hour. Transfer pulp to bowl and mash with a potato masher to blend until smooth. Set aside. Bring a large pot of water to boil over high heat. Place 1 shell into the water and immediately remove with a slotted spoon.

Random Ingredients: okra,tomato basil pasta sauce,saffron,ancho chile powder,cranberry
title: Low Fat Okra Stew
ingredients: 1 lb okra | 1 bottle tomato and basil pasta sauce ( or use your own ) | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder, optional | 1/4 teaspoon saffron, soaked in warm water ( optional )
instructions: Wash okra and cut into 1 inch thick slices. Place okra in a pan with a little water and cover with lid. Bring to a boil, and cook until okra is tender approximately 3 to 5 minutes. Drain okra, and return to pan. Add sauce, basil and spices. Cook about 3 - 5 minutes, until heated through.

title: Italian Salad Dressing, Low Calorie
ingredients: 3/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon celery & leaves, finely chopped | 1/2 cup basil pesto
instructions: Whisk together first 5 ingredients for at least 1 minute.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,beef steak,fennel seed,rosemary,white wine,wheat macaroni
title: Beef and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lean boneless beef round steak, trimmed of fat and cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seeds | 6 cups uncooked whole wheat macaroni | 1/2 jar pineapple chunks, undrained | 3/4 cup white wine | 1 bunch fresh rosemary
instructions: Place the beef, fennel seeds, and 1 inch of water into a large skillet and bring to a boil. Lower heat, cover, and simmer until the beef is cooked through and the water is absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. Meanwhile, bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the macaroni in the boiling water until cooked, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,beef bouillon cube,belgian endive,palm sugar,parmesan cheese,icing sugar,red onion
title: Gougeres (Belgian Endive)
ingredients: 2 heads belgian endive ( about 5 cups cleaned, de-sliced ) | 1 red onion, cut into chunks | 1/3 cup lemon juice ( preferably fresh-squeezed ) | 6 tablespoons icing sugar | 4 -6 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon palm sugar
instructions: Wash the endive, removing the stems and removing as many of the hard stalks as you can. Cut off both ends and set aside. In a frying pan over medium high heat, add some olive oil and some salt, to your taste. When the olive oil is warm, add all the greens, stirring them in the pan to avoid burning them for 1 to 2 minutes. Add onion to the greens, stirring to coat with oil and salt. Stirring only occasionally, add more oil if necessary so they brown lightly. When done, add rest of the ingredients, mix well, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 40 minutes. When cooked, you should have a thick bechamel sauce. Serve hot with biscuits or mashed potatoes.

title: Simple Baked Baked Onions
ingredients: 4 medium onions | 2 tablespoons lard | 1 tablespoon oil ( more oil is better to use ) | 2 teaspoons whole juniper berries ( optional ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( more if desired or sub with one cube dissolved in 1 cup of water )
instructions: Cut a slice from the end of each onion and make a cut that doesn't quite fit inside the slice. Take the slices and slice into very thin slices approx 2 inches long. Cut a slit in the side of each onion and insert a small pinch of juniper into one of the onions and add a chicken boullion cube to this. If you don't have a boullion cube, just add more to taste. Preheat the oven 300°f. Place a lid onto a baking dish and place all of your onion slices inside. Dab the remaining onion slices with the lard. Add the oil to the pan you are going to use. Lightly butter the lid. Place each onion slice in the sauce. Sprinkle breadcrumbs around onions. Bake for 55 - 60 minutes if you are baking for longer than you normally would. If you're baking in a baking dish, remove the lid from the dish after 50 minutes. This will allow the onions to brown a little. I'm guessing on the exact time you bake them. Note, don't fill the onions too full. I used a cookie scoop, which allows the air out of the breadcrumbs. Bake approx another 5 minutes before putting them in the oven. Bake 15 minutes with the lid off to brown.

title: Simple Ricotta Sauce for Pasta and Prawns
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1 1/4 cups vegetable broth ( or use vegetable base ) | 1/4 - 1/3 tablespoon liquid smoke ( smoke can also be used, though not recommended )
instructions: Whisk together the ricotta cheese and broth. Stir in the liquid smoke. Serve over your favourite pasta.

title: Spiced Onion and Chives Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 8 large wraps or 8 large wraps
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, chives and cumin. Place each wrap on a flat surface and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 2 to 3 minutes. Spread 1 teaspoon of the onions and chives mixture on each wrap. Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons of the onions and chive mixture in the center of the wrap.

title: Spinach & Cranberry Tzatziki
ingredients: 100 g fresh baby spinach | 200 g fresh cranberries | 100 g fresh cracked pistooms or 100 g pine nuts | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed ( optional )
instructions: If using fresh spinach leaves add to boiling water for about 5 minutes and drain. Remove stems and leaves and shred. Place in a mortar with the cracked pistooms or pine nuts and pound well. Add the spinach & cranberries and pound a further 2 minutes or until well mixed and the spices are thoroughly distributed. Spoon into an 18 x 12 glass baking dish and chill until set, at least 2 hours.

title: Lemon Shrimp and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, finely chopped | 1 jar frozen lemonade concentrate ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 carton chilled large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 cups wine, such as a red or white, divided
instructions: Combine cabbage and lemonade concentrate in blender and puree until smooth. Pour into large pot with 2 cups wine.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,collard green,five spice powder,brown rice,button mushroom,okra
title: Asian Okra
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 4 large skinless chicken breast halves | 1 package frozen cut okra | 1 tablespoon five-spice powder | 1 package frozen collard greens - thawed, drained and chopped, and stems reserved | 1/2 cup fresh button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Bring 3 cups water and rice to a boil in a pot with a tight fitting lid. Stir, cover, and reduce heat to low. Simmer until rice is tender, about 35 minutes. Remove from heat and keep covered. Place chicken breasts in a skillet over medium high heat, reserving any juices for later use, and cook until chicken is no longer pink inside. An instant read thermometer inserted into the center of the thigh should read at least 165 degrees f. Remove chicken, allow to cool, and cut into bite size pieces. Meanwhile, place okra in a microwave safe bowl with just enough water to cover, and microwave on high for 1 minute. Stir to wilt, then fluff with a fork. Stir mushrooms into the cooked rice. Return chicken and other vegetables, including any juices, to the rice. Season to taste with five spice powder, and stir to combine. Serve with hot, plain, cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: ranch dressing,italian plum tomato,pearl barley,wonton wrapper,liquid smoke,ice,olive oil
title: Beer-Battered Wontons
ingredients: 1/4 cup frozen pearl barley | 1 can plum tomatoes, diced | 1 cup shredded italian plum tomato | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 1 dash liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 package wonton wrappers | 2 cups ice, or as desired
instructions: Place pearl barley and plum tomatoes in a saucepan with onion, tomatoes, italian plum tomato dressing, and liquid smoke. Bring to a boil over medium high heat.

title: Zucchini in a Bowl
ingredients: 1 zucchini, sliced in thin rounds | 2 tablespoons fresh herbs ( your favorite ) | 1/3 cup chicken stock
instructions: Put the zucchini in a bowl and add all the other ingredients. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken fillets ( thin slices ) | 1 red pepper ( thin slices ) | 1 package egg roll wraps
instructions: Heat pan on medium high heat. Dip chicken in egg roll wrap and fry until golden brown for chicken on one side. Turn. Add pepper slices to cook. Cook both sides. Serve with salsa.

Random Ingredients: half,pearl barley,green leaf lettuce,red bell pepper,farfalle pasta
title: Garlic and Pepper Farfalle With Barley
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 red bell peppers or 1 yellow bell pepper, finely chopped | 12 leaves green leaf lettuce | 1 cup half-and-half
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions for al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water until completely cool. Place barley in a glass bowl and add boiling water to cover. Allow to sit for 5 minutes. Drain, reserving 3 cups of the liquid and barley. Return liquid to the pasta pot. Add bell pepper and half & half. Bring to a boil, stirring to distribute. Reduce heat to low and simmer, partially covered, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes, or until pasta is creamy. Serve and enjoy.

title: spaghetti and Sponge Crumbly Spaghetti
ingredients: 600 g spaghetti | 4 eggs | 1/2 cup biscuit | oil ( for frying, lard or shortening for deep frying )
instructions: Pour enough lard or shortening in a frying pan/skillet for deep frying to 180 deg c or until it reaches 180 deg c or a finger goes into a little runny looking fry up to half of the spaghetti without breaking it. Break it up as it is cooking, adding more lard if it starts to stick together. Break up the spaghetti as necessary to achieve a medium to medium thick consistency. Break the eggs into a large bowl. Dip the spaghetti in the egg, then in the crumbs, making sure all the crumbs and egg have been absorbed into the spaghetti. Gently roll the spaghetti in the beaten eggs. Leave the spaghetti to soak in the egg and fat. It will stick together if left too long. Heat the oil to 180 deg c/375 deg f. Fry the spaghetti a few minutes and remove with slotted spoon. Sprinkle with salt. Serve sprinkled with salt, freshly ground pepper and freshly made chives.

title: Mango Lassi
ingredients: 2 large fresh mango pulp ( or frozen ) | 2/3 cup milk | 3/4 cup rum or 3/4 cup amaretto | 2 teaspoons rum or 2 teaspoons amaretto
instructions: Dice mango. Pour milk and rum into blender or food processor. Blend till smooth. Pour into tall glasses with ice cubes or chilled glasses.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,chicken wing,phyllo pastry,plum,lima bean
title: Sweet and Sour Chicken and Lima Bean Phyllo Pastilla
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings, tips removed | 1 1/2 lbs plums, quartered | 1 1/2 lbs lima beans, halved and cut in half | 1 1/2 lbs phyllo pastry sheets, defrosted | 1 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 fahrenheit. Cut the chicken wings in half from the hind hind joint, through the joint joint in the knee joint and ankle joint. Rinse and pat the wings dry and put into a roasting pan. Sprinkle with the dark brown sugar, add enough water to just cover the chicken. Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours. The chicken should be tender when pierced with a skewer. Cool, then remove the meat and set aside. Boil the lima beans and lima beans in plenty of lightly salted water. While they are cooking, place 1/2kg of the phyllo pastry sheets in a small pot of boiling, lightly salted water. As soon as they become fluffy and pliable, drain the sheets on kitchen paper. Take a sheet of pastry, stretch it and place it between two sheets of dampened paper towels in a clean, dry bowl. Place the unused phyllo sheets in the bowl with the beans and lima beans and mash into a paste with a fork. Spread half of that mixture in the middle of the pastry sheets, and top with half the chicken wings. Add half of the remainder of the paste and spread evenly. Roll up the sheets, starting from one long side and continuing until you have made all the pastillas. Brush the pastillas with a little beaten egg and bake until crisp and golden. Serve with your favourite dipping sauce.

title: Spanish Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 jar thick & chunky salsa | 1/4 teaspoon grated red pepper flakes | dark rum
instructions: Heat the 2 tablespoons of light rum slowly add in the potatoes. Shake bag to mix. Cook potatoes in pan with 1/4 of the spice blend and top with the remaining spice blend. Serve warm.

title: Azerbaijani (Beer Rice Drink)
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked arborio rice | 2 cups dark beer ( not alcoholic ) | 1 bunch fresh coriander, leaves stripped
instructions: Drain the beer from the bottle. Bring the beer to a boil over medium high heat, and then lower the heat to medium. Stir in the rice and arborio until the grains begin to toast. Stir in half of the coriander, reserving some fresh coriander for garnish. When the mixture is creamy and has absorbed all the beer, about 30 to 60 seconds, remove from the heat. Cover and set aside to cool slightly, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, divide the remaining coriander leaves among 6 tall glasses. Place the cooled rice in the glasses. Transfer the beer to a small pitcher or pitcher. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Pimento and Kiwi Phyllo Rounds
ingredients: 1 package frozen phyllo dough ( thawed ) | 2 small kiwi, quartered | 1 jar chopped pimento peppers | 1 tablespoon sesame tahini
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit. Place thawed phyllo dough on a clean, dry surface and lightly flour. Cut into 4 squares. Place one kiwi in the center of each square and top with an additional kiwi. Roll up each square into a log. Repeat until all the kiwis and kiwis are used up. Spread sesame tahini on the top and bottom of each roll. Bake for 25 minutes or until phyllo is browned and puffed.

title: Red Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 3 cans red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream
