instructions: Over low heat, in a medium sauce pan, pour both cans of enchilada sauce, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in cream. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Rice and Parsley Chicken & Apple Soup
ingredients: 1 ounce dried chipotle chile en adobo ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup carnation evaporated milk | 1 1/2 cups cooked chicken, shredded ( from a rotisserie chicken ) | 1/2 cup fresh tart apple, shredded or 1/2 cup peeled and chopped medium cored apple | 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place chile in a small non reactive bowl. Pour enough water into the bowl to reach 1 1/2 inches above chile. Stir to release all of the liquid. Set aside. Bring a large saucepan of water to boiling. Add salt and dried chipotle chile. Add chicken. Cook until just cooked through, about 3 minutes. Drain. Transfer chicken to a bowl and stir in apple and remaining ingredients. Transfer to a soup pot or heat resistant bowl and serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Homestyle Sesame Roasted Garlic
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs garlic cloves, unpeeled | 20 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs, sifted | 1 1/4 cups rocket, washed and chopped ( available as a whole bunch on the internet www.argop.org.uk or other asian food food food or herb food store ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place the unpeeled garlic cloves in a pan and drizzle with olive oil and bring to a simmer over high heat. When the garlic is ready, remove it from the heat. Drain it onto paper towel and rub the cloves with the garlic. Place the garlic in a 9x13 baking dish. In a bowl, mix the bread crumbs with 1/4 cup of olive oil until moistened. Sprinkle on top of the garlic. Bake uncovered at 450 degrees for 15 minutes. Add the rocket and toss to mix well. Remove dish from the oven. Drizzle with sesame oil. Return to the oven, about 5 minutes. The garlic should be hot and the pan should be bubbling. Serve at once or keep warm in a 150 degree oven.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,bread crumb,soya sauce,pea,red cabbage,cremini mushroom,vanilla pudding
title: Chinese Cabbage Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup pea ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup fresh bread crumbs ( panko style ) | 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon ginger root, grated | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 12 ounces red cabbage, shredded | 1 can vanilla instant pudding or ( 1 3/4 ounce ) can vanilla extract pudding | 1/4 cup soya sauce ( can use sriracha as a substitute )
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch casserole dish. In a bowl, mix together the pea cubes, bread crumbs, mushrooms, ginger, soy sauce, cabbage and pudding powder. Spoon the mixture into the greased casserole dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, remove the lid, and bake at 375 degrees f for approximately 45 minutes, or until golden brown. Stir the soya sauce into the cabbage mixture, and serve.

title: Broccoli & Avocado Dip
ingredients: 1 head fresh broccoli, stems removed, caps cut into 1-inch chunks, boiled till tender crisp, cooled and cut into 1-inch chunks | 2 large ripe avocados, peeled and sliced | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 3/4 cup italian dressing | 3/4 cup sour cream or 3/4 cup greek yogurt | flour, for dipping | italian spices ( optional )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except the noodles, in a food processor and process till smooth. Spread onto serving plate and dip in italian flavored yogurt and garnish with additional toppings if desired.

title: Saliq
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 kg lamb ( ask the butcher to cut it into very small pieces. ask for 1 1/2 kg ) | 2 -3 cups cherry tomatoes ( fresh tomatoes cut in half or quarters ) | 1/2 cup raisins | extra fat or extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Note, if you have a choice of cuts, ask the butcher to cut as many as you like. Pour a couple of tbs of oil into a saucepan with a good lid. Add all the ingredients except the raisins and cook for about 4 - 5 minutes. Turn on the heat to low and leave for approx 10 minutes. Check the lamb is cooked and if it is just about cooked enough, remove from heat. Add the raisins and stir to coat. Serve with rice, salads, bread or couscous.

title: BBQ Lettuce
ingredients: 1 head leaf lettuce | 1 cup barbecue sauce
instructions: Place lettuce leaves on a microwave safe dish.

title: Chilled Shredded Fontina & Vegetable Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup light green chili, minced | 8 ounces fontina or 8 ounces other mild white cheese ( 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot, drained and minced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped parsley | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice | 2 large skewers or 2 large sheets of waxed paper, cut in half ( about 6 inches square )
instructions: For vegetables, combine chili, cheese, diced bamboo and parsley. For bows, use rubber gloves to protect hands from drying. Thread skewers, cutting about 4 inches apart, on metal skewers. Brush with lemon juice. Place skewers on oiled baking sheet and refrigerate 2 hours. Cookes, preheat broiler. Remove skewers from skewers and place on rack about 6 inches from heat. Broil or toast until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Serves.

title: Mock Beef Jerky (Beef Jerky)
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups strong white pepper ( not black, it will go back in the food processor when it's cooled to '2 ) | 2 1/2 teaspoons granulated dry mustard | 3 1/2 lbs thinly svelped svelped table steak, at least 4-1/2 inch thick ( see note below ) | 7 ounces brandy ( or rum ) or 7 ounces cognac ( or rum )
instructions: In lg bowl of lrg food processor place pepper, mustard, and 1 1/2 cups cold water. Cover. Process, pulsing, til mixture is puree like fine crumbs. Put half of mixture into 13 x9 glass baking dish. Cover. Place remaining pepper mixture on top. Cover. Let stand 1 hr in warm place. To use, add brandy or rum to pepper water in microwave. Heat on high till boiling. Stir just till boiling is met with pepper mixture and brandy or rum, stirred.. Drain beef slices. Put slices back in dish with pepper mixture in dish on top. Sprinkle with remaining 1 1/2 cups cold water. Cover. Microwave on high, till cheese is melted and brandy is dissolved, about 14 - 16 minutes. Uncover. Microwave on med hi till warm and bubbling, about 2 minutes, stirring just once, and scraping sides of dish with spatula. Serve at once, laying slices between fingers so as not to soak up the juices from the pepper mixture, or on the side for jerky. Variation, if you would like a touch of pink in jerky, reduce the amount of pepper used, or use 1 tsp. Fresh ground black pepper instead of the black pepper.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Crisco
ingredients: 4 ounces prosciutto ( thinly sliced ) | 1 tablespoon crisco shortening
instructions: Wrap the prosciutto around the ham and secure with a toothpick. Brown in a 400f oven for 10 minutes.

title: Spicy Dry Rub for Fish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garam masala | 2 tablespoons ground ginger | 8 serrano peppers, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup white wine
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the garam masala, ginger, serrano peppers, and white wine until well blended.

title: Rhubarb and Coconut Crepes
ingredients: 40 ml malt vinegar | 1 kg rhubarb, rinsed and cut into large pieces | 1 3/4 kg light coconut milk | 180 g fruit and nuts, see note | 20 -30 ready-made circular crepes
instructions: Whisk the vinegar and coconut milk in a medium saucepan, add the rhubarb and bring to gentle simmer over a low heat. Cook, covered, for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 200°c line 6 heatproof serving plates with parchment paper, place a layer of crepe on each plate and brush with melted butter. Top each with a spoonful of rhubarb and/or coconut milk. Place plates on baking trays and bake for 6 - 8 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Champagne Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup champagne ( or white wine ) | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons bread flour | 1/4 lb fresh goat fat, cut into 2 inch pieces or 1/4 lb bacon, cut into 2 inch pieces | 16 dried apricots
instructions: To make the guayat, mix the champagne and yeast in a small bowl. Let stand 5 minutes. Combine the nutmeg, anise, bread flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a separate bowl. Toss the hot fat with the yeast mixture in to the bread mixture, and leave to ferment in the refrigerator for 5 to 10 minutes, then strain out the onion and reserve. Fry the guayat in a heavy pot over medium heat until well browned. Drain on paper towels and set aside. Sprinkle the fried guayat with the ground nutmeg and ground anise and fry 2 or 3 more minutes. Arrange the apricots on the saucer and arrange the fried guayat on top. Spread the guayat with the reserved onion. Serve.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,rigatoni pasta,chicken breast half,cider,cake mix,coconut milk
title: Cider-Glazed Chicken & Squash Rigatoni
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 package dry cake mix | 1 cup light coconut milk or 1 cup regular milk | 1 can dark coconut milk | 16 ounces rigatoni pasta, uncooked | 1 medium yellow squash
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Arrange chicken in a 13 by 9 inches baking dish. In a bowl combine the cake mix, coconut milk and 1 can of coconut milk and pour over the chicken, turning to coat all pieces. Cover baking dish and let it stand in a warm, not hot, oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile, in a large pot of boiling water, cook rigatoni according to package directions, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,ricotta cheese,cinnamon,clam,gruyere cheese,club soda
title: Grilled Chicken With Gruyere Clam and Ricotta
ingredients: 1 lb fresh ricotta cheese | 1/3 lb swiss gruyere cheese, cut into 1/4 pieces | 6 ounces clams, well-shelled ( canned or cooked from warehouse club club recommended ) | 16 ounces cocktail-sized clams, rinsed and drained, not drained | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon club soda
instructions: Make the cheese filling. Drain clams. Combine clams, cheese, cinnamon and soda in a bowl and blend well. Spread cheese filling on the inside of a broiler safe dish, about 3/4 inch thick on the edge. Place chicken breasts in the cheese mixture and broil until golden on each side, about 5 minutes. Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,double cream,egg beater substitute,linguine,monterey jack pepper cheese,leg lamb,pepper onion,poblano chile
title: Lamb and Peppers Elite
ingredients: 2 teaspoons double cream, lowfat if preferred ( or half and half ) | 1 lb boneless leg of lamb, cut into 1/2-inch strips | 5 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, membrane removed, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch wide strips | 1 cup egg beaters egg substitute | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( or pepper jack cheddar ) | 2 teaspoons fresh ground pepper and onion ( or use a combination of two ) or 2 teaspoons chopped fresh pimento-stuffed dried cilantro, for garnish ( or use a combination of two ) | 2 cups bottled double cream | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f. In 3 quart saucepan, heat cream just until hot. Gradually stir in lamb. Cover tightly and bring to boil.

title: Apple and Coconut Salad
ingredients: 2 firm apples | 3 tablespoons coconut sugar | 2 teaspoons wine vinegar | fresh peel
instructions: Peel the apples and cut into quarters. Place in boiling water, cover and cook until tender. Remove from heat, drain and peel. Add remaining ingredients to the apples in a serving bowl, mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,cream chicken soup,chili powder,chocolate curl
title: Lazy Daisy
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup cubed mexican-style cheese | 1/4 cup shredded mexican-style cheese blend | chocolate curls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. In a medium bowl, stir together the chicken soup and processed cheese cheese until smooth. Pour the soup into a 9x13 inch baking dish and spread evenly. Top with shredded cheese and chocolate curls. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, until bubbly. You can broil it for a minute before cutting or serve in slices as a topping for potato wedges and crackers.

title: Honey-Crusted Cabbage With Topping
ingredients: 3 -4 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 pints of shredded cabbage | 1 tablespoon of mashed thawed honey | 2 tablespoons dried thyme leave | 1 tablespoon dried semolina | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to the boil and add the salt. Add the cornflour, stirring well. Remove from heat when cornflour is a little lumpy, but there isn't much. Put cabbage into a colander. Rinse well and drain. Pat dry. Brush both sides and edges of cabbage with some of the bacon drippings. Boil the cabbage in the boiling water just long enough to soften slightly. When all of the water has boiled away, add honey, thyme, semolina and stir well. Drain cabbage. Spread a thin layer of whipped topping on to the bottom, then add the cabbage. Spread remainder of the whipped topping on to the top and dust with more of the cream cheese mix. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Italian Pork (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder | 8 ounces polenta | 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 cup chopped walnut oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock pot and cook on high for 4 - 6 hours or low for 7 - 8 hours. Serve over pasta.

title: Bacalao -- Sandwich or Pastries With Turnip and Ham
ingredients: 1 1 lb turnips or 1 lb rutabagas, peeled finely diced | 1 lb ham, cut in small cubes | 6 sheets phyllo pastry, defrosted and cut into six 2x9 inches pieces | 1 1/2 cups chapati flour | all-purpose flour
instructions: Mix the turnip in boiling water with about 6 tbsp cornstarch. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside. Saute ham in a deep frying pan until golden brown. Drain. Mix turnip with ham and sprinkle with flour. Place one piece on a clean, dry surface, and put one piece on top. Paint the surface with a pastry brush dipped in water and place second piece on top. Wrap the whole thing around the first piece of pastry and put in freezer for one hour or so. Remove pastry from the freezer a few at a time, and cut pieces crosswise, creating small squares. Cook pastry circles on a cookie sheet in a medium hot oven, and place a few pieces of pastry on the bottom layer of cooked pasta. Brush top layer with egg wash and place in refrigerator for 1/2 hour or more. Cut pastries into wedges, place on a baking sheet, and place in preheated oven at 400°f. Let cook for about 10 minutes, and then turn down the oven to 325°f with oven rack in center.. Bake for 30 minutes, making sure not to burn anything on the bottom. Serve hot with butter.

title: Pineapple Manicotti With Manicotti Shells
ingredients: 1 package manicotti pasta, cooked | 2 -3 cans pineapple rings
instructions: Cook manicotti according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f for the shell topping. Remove the shells carefully and set aside to drain on paper towl. Cut the pineapple rings in half and place in a bowl of water to loosen any breadcrumbs the shells came in and keep the shells crunchy. Drain the shells and spoon a scoop of the pineapple on the shell, then place them on a sprayed baking pan. Spoon the topping over all. Bake for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,cilantro leaf,purpose flour,cooking apple,chuck steak
title: Apple-Cilantro Beef Roll-ups
ingredients: 1 lb chuck steak, cut into 2/3-inch slices | cooking apple, such as fuji | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves, plus more for sprinkling | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 cup skim milk chocolate, finely chopped | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Place beef slice in a large nonstick skillet. Add all remaining ingredients and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture begins to thicken slightly, about 3 minutes. Increase heat to medium high. Drizzle mixture with 2 tablespoons olive oil. Cook and stir until mixture just begins to darken, about 10 seconds.

Random Ingredients: caramel,kidney bean,picante sauce,vanilla pudding,spinach,chambord raspberry liquor,pie crust,anchovy fillet
title: Chambord Spinach and Tomato Pizza
ingredients: 1 can whole peeled tomatoes, drained | 1 box frozen spinach, cooked thawed, squeezed dry | 2 packages frozen pie crusts | chambord raspberry liquor ( use 1/4 cup ) | 4 anchovy fillets, minced | 12 ounces frozen fully-cooked italian style kidney beans, thawed | 15 ounces picante sauce | 10 ounces caramel or 10 ounces coconut milk | chambord raspberry liquor
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place a steamer basket in a saucepan with a tight fitting lid. Add tomatoes, spinach, and rinsed spinach. Cover tightly, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove lid, and stir in a splash of chambord. Spoon over pie crusts, and top with a layer of black beans and tomato mixture. Bake for 10 minutes. Turn, and bake until crust is golden and bubbly, 15 - 20 minutes more. Let stand for 5 minutes, then drizzle with caramel and drizzle with a little chocolate glaze. Top with chambord.

title: Hot Chocolate With Scented Sugar
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 9 tablespoons sugar
instructions: Place the sugar in a small saucepan and pour enough boiling water to reach the bottom of the pan about 3/4 of an inch and place over high heat until lightly puffed, almost syrupy. Pour about a rounded 1/4 cup of the hot mixture into a small bowl and set aside. Melt the chocolate in the chocolate mixture over just barely simmering water, stirring frequently to prevent sticking. Remove from the heat and allow to sit, about 5 minutes. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved. Allow the sugar to cool slightly and then pour into the cooled chocolate. Allow the filling to set for about 10 minutes before using it.

Random Ingredients: brandy,cumin powder,tzatziki,cashew,monterey jack pepper cheese,fenugreek seed,crawfish
title: Cashew Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 box cashews, whole ( or toasted ) | 10 ounces chopped fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 lb crawfish ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups tzatziki | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons cognac | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese or 1 cup gouda cheese
instructions: Mix cashews and fenugreek seed in a food processor. With machine running, add crawfish and process until nuts form a ball. Add tzatziki, brandy, and cumin powder, and process until sauce is smooth. Divide among serving bowls and top with cheese.

title: Jamaican Allspice and Spice Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 12 ounces lettuce leaves | allspice
instructions: Place tomato puree, pepper and allspice into a heavy medium size pot. Heat over medium flame, or until most of the liquid comes to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes, or until thickened. Place cheese on a lettuce leaf and top with tomato mixture. Place remaining leaf on top and press together. Cut into quarters to serve.

title: The Perfect Ajo Blanco
ingredients: 1/4 cup sour cream | 8 ounces mexican blend cheese | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, soaked in 2 t. water for 15 minutes | 1/4 teaspoon dried guajillo chilies | 1/2 teaspoon dried mexican saffron
instructions: Mix sour cream, mexican cheese blend, chile paste, saffron, chile sauce, and mexican saffron flavored saffron in a medium bowl. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 4 hours but overnight so flavors develop. Let guests make their own bowls and place a dollop of sour cream on top of each one.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,malt vinegar,beef tenderloin,quinoa,mango chutney,celery rib
title: Mango Chutney Beef Tenderloin with Broccoli and Mango Chutney
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 4 teaspoons mango chutney ( major grey's recipe for major grey's ) | 1 cup mango chutney ( major grey's recipe for mango chutney ) | 1/2 cup malt vinegar ( major grey's recipe for mango chutney ) | 2 medium celery ribs, cut into small chunks | 2 medium broccoli florets, ends trimmed, then cut into small chunks
instructions: Prepare beef, pour 1 1/2 cups water into a 10 nonstick skillet. Bring to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, preheat broiler. Cut beef lengthwise into 2 1/2 inch wide strips. Arrange beef in an even layer in the skillet. Use tongs to transfer beef to a broiler pan. Broil in oven, turning as needed, until no longer pink and juices run clear, about 5 minutes. Place beef on a cutting board. Let stand 5 minutes, then slice diagonally into thin strips. Combine chutney and 2 tablespoons water in a small bowl. Toss with hot beef strips. Divide beef among 4 plates. Cover with mango chutney and broil in oven until hot and bubbling, 1 minute. Top with celery, broccoli, and remaining 1 tablespoon chutney sauce. Enjoy.

title: Spinach and Rice Oat Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 4 cups spinach leaves | 1/2 cup frozen tiny whole kernel corn | 1 medium vidalia onion, chopped | oregano | 5 cups rolled oats | ground allspice | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, minced
instructions: Prepare quinoa and cook according to directions on bag. Meanwhile, in large stewing pot, saute onion, and allspice for about 3 minutes, until onion is tender. Add quinoa and combine. Cover and cook for about 10 minutes until most of the water is absorbed, and quinoa is just slightly chewy about 10 minutes. Spread quinoa evenly into a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish, top with allspice, oats, and scallion mixture. Sprinkle with minced parsley. Bake at 350 for 1 hour, covered, or until a knife comes out clean.

title: Green Chili Kiwi
ingredients: 1 quart kiwi fruit, peeled and cut into 6 wedges | 1 green chili pepper, seeded, chopped | 4 fluid ounces club soda
instructions: In a food processor, combine kiwi fruit and chilli. Process until smooth. Gradually add club soda. Pour into serving glasses.

title: Spanish Onions
ingredients: 4 large spanish onions, sliced into disks ( about 3 '' in diameter ) | 8 slices bacon | 4 red chilies
instructions: Fry bacon in a heavy skillet or large skillet over medium heat until cooked and crispy. Remove to wire rack or paper towels lined plate and let cool. Peel onions if necessary to remove all the bitter outer husks. Slice 1/4 thick, then slice into 1/8 thick wedges. Arrange onion wedges on plates and top with bacon pieces and sliced chiles. Serve immediately. Note, onions are also called vinaigrette or vinaigrette for french vegans.

title: French Steak for the BBQ
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 3 lbs lean top round steaks, each cut about 3/4 to 1/2 inch thick | 3 cups cubed swiss cheese | 1 1/2 cups halved grape tomatoes | 6 -8 sprigs fresh parsley or 6 -8 sprigs chives
instructions: Season both sides of the steak with salt, pepper and garlic salt. Grill steak to desired doneness, 12 to 15 minutes per side for medium rare. Transfer to a platter and cover with foil until ready to serve. When ready to serve, combine cheese, tomatoes and a small amount of chives. Dip steak in fondue sauce, and place on a platter. Surround with tomato mixture and garnish with parsley or chives.

title: Garlicky Wheat and Garlic Foil
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups wheat bran | 1 1/4 cups cornstarch | 1/4 cup plain wheat bran | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | lettuce leaf
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a food processor and whizz until the mixture resembles coarsely ground breadcrumbs. Spread onto a bed of lettuce leaves and serve warm.

title: Spicy Chiles - Pineapple
ingredients: 2 cans pineapple chunks or ( 28 ounce ) cans pineapple tidbits | 2 cans chopped anaheim chilies | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1 lb spaghetti, broken
instructions: Saute the peppers and bread crumbs in a large pan over medium till golden. Drain well. Stir in the cooked spaghetti pieces until coated or heat through. Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Orange Blossom Sugar - for Dipping
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar, packed | 2 tablespoons orange juice concentrate, reconstituted in | 1/2 cup dark beer ( any dark beer will do )
instructions: Prepare an 8 cup bundt pan by lining with parchment paper and dusting with sugar. Combine the brown sugar and orange juice concentrate in a medium mixing bowl and stir well. Pour the beer into a saucepan and warm gently over medium heat, whisking often. Do not allow the mixture to boil. Pour the mixture into the prepared pan. Let stand 15 - 20 minutes to set. Turn over and allow it to cool completely before turning out onto a serving platter. Serve with toothpicks, puddings, or assorted candies.

title: Fruit Sizzle
ingredients: 1 package dates ( pitted and finely chopped ) | 5 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients in non stick or paper lined bowl. Use to brush onto chicken or fish. Let stand at least 15 minutes before cooking.

title: Dried Apricot and Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 jar dried apricots | 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter | 2 tablespoons safflower oil | 7 -10 ears corn, preferably red cobs
instructions: Preheat the grill to high. If using dried apricots, soak them in hot water for 20 minutes until plump and pliable, about 25 minutes. If desired, drain them well, coarsely chop them up and set aside. Dry the apricots at the same time they are being dried. You can chop up the apricots by hand if you like, but a food mill would be better for this. Mix together the butter and safflower oil on medium heat. Drain the dried apricots and put them into the pan. Slice the corn over the cob, using a spoon, scrape off any kernels, then pour in about 1/3 of the apricots and 2/3 of the butter mixture. Simmer, stirring until almost dry, about 10 minutes. Cover and cook over medium heat until the apricots are plump, about 5 minutes more. Mound the hot corn on a plate. Ladle the corn and sauce over the hot corn, dividing it evenly. Add more butter or cream if desired. If a hotter taste is preferred, you can serve the corn with a dash of cream.

Random Ingredients: spicy tomato sauce,spicy brown mustard,corn oil,chicken bouillon cube,maple extract,picante sauce,anchovy paste,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Spicy Tomato Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1/4 cup spicy tomato sauce | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( i used knorr ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking spray | 2 teaspoons spicy brown mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons olive oil | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons maple extract ( optional )
instructions: Combine picante sauce and spicy tomato sauce in a bowl. Stir in your choice of remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook chicken about 4 - 5 minutes on each side, or until done through. Serve with green vegetable strips and hot dog rolls if desired.

title: Homemade Wood Polish Candy
ingredients: 1 lb raw walnuts | 1 cup peanut oil or 1 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Preparation time, 45 minute wash walnuts, thoroughly and put through a cutting board with a fine disk of waxed paper. Place nuts on a double thickness of kitchen roll or plastic wrap and flatten them out into very narrow rectangular pieces. Put walnuts in a pile on a paper towel. Cover with another table. Roll up the waxed roll or plastic wrap, making sure nuts are all in neat, firmly packed pieces.. If the rolls become too hard, leave some on the towel for later use. This should leave about 1 lb of wood in the wood. Wipe the outside of the roll, remove the roll with a large spatula, and carefully remove all of the dry nuts. Roll up the unwaxed roll with the towel and let dry on the counter for 45 min or more. Oil the inside of a 12 inch pan with about half a cup of the oil, and preheat the pan over low heat. Sprinkle all the outside of the outside with the liquid smoke. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, and carefully place the roll on it. This will allow space for spreading. Sprinkle waxed paper with walnuts and drizzle with the rest of the oil. Sprinkle the top with a little more walnuts. Bake for about 20 min at 400, stirring every 5 - 10 mins or so. Remove and cool on a rack.

Random Ingredients: london broil beef,almond paste,hot green chili pepper,oatmeal
title: Oatmeal Beef Skillet
ingredients: 2 lbs london broil beef, cut to 3/4 inch slices | 1 can almond paste, in jar | 1 bunch green chili pepper, cut to strips | 2 cups quick oatmeal
instructions: In 13 x 9 inch baking pan, arrange meat slices.

title: Southern Style Turnips
ingredients: 5 -12 medium turnips | cooking spray | 2 tablespoons salt pork | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Cut off 1/2 inch of the stem end of turnips. Carefully scoop out the pulp leaving the tips intact. Set aside. Place the shells on a baking sheet and spray with some cooking oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake 15 minutes or until the turnips begin to soften. While turnips are baking, prepare the stuffing. Remove the rind from the salt pork and cut into cubes. Place into a small bowl and mash with a potato masher. Add the celery flakes, oregano, and basil. Cook the turnips over a gentle flame until soft. Place about 1/4 cup stuffing in the hollowed turnips and gently fold the fillings into the turnip. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,bean sprout,liquid pectin,fruit choice,vanilla extract,basil leaf,ginger paste
title: Sienis Bikkali (Beef Sienis)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh ginger-flavored bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons canola oil or 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 lb dried mixed fruit ( your choice... oranges, figs, raisins, apricots, strawberries, etc. ) | 1 can condensed beef broth | 2 tablespoons liquid pectin | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup basil leaves
instructions: Place a steamer basket in the bottom of a 6 to 8 qt slow cooker. Cover and heat on low setting until beans are tender and liquid is absorbed, about 8 minutes. Strain beans through a small sieve. Transfer drained beans to a food processor. Add oil and pulse until very finely minced. Set aside. Place fruit in a large bowl and mash. Mix in condensed beef broth, pectin, and vanilla. Stir in mashed beans. Cover and chill. Stir before serving. Use as a filling for meat tenderizer, saute vegetables, or crackers.

Random Ingredients: hot chili powder,simple syrup,enchilada sauce,cornflour,rice krispies
title: The Other Versatile and Delicious Tasty Nachos
ingredients: 100 g rice krispies, defrosted | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon instant hot chili powder | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 20 enchilada sauce
instructions: Pour the rice krispies into a large microwave safe bowl and heat in the microwave on high for 3 - 4 minutes, until crispy and golden. Remove from microwave and cool slightly. Heat the enchilada sauce in a small saucepan over a low heat, stirring continuously. Mix the cornflour into a paste with water. Pour into a separate bowl and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok on the stove, add the paste and cook until it's light yellow and has a fragrant aroma, stirring regularly. Place rice krispies over a large mixing bowl. Dip in the hot sauce and coat with the cornflour paste. Place in preheated oven at 180c for 5 - 7 minutes or until crisp.

title: St. Paddy's Day Salsa Bread
ingredients: 1 jar salsa | 3 quarts white wine, divided | 1 1/2 cups dried cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup finely minced pistachios
instructions: Cover jar of salsa with hot water, bring to a boil, remove from heat, drain and cool to room temperature. Stir crushed ice into salsa and set aside for 1 cup of salsa. Mix together cracker crumbs, pistachios and 2 tablespoons of dry white wine. To make bread crumbs. Stir crumbs into remaining salsa until completely mixed. Stir in soaked pistachios. Spread salsa in bottom of a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch loaf pan. Sprinkle pistachios over salsa and bake at 350 degrees f for 45 to 55 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,onion salt,kalamata olive,sherry,white pearl onion,cabbage
title: Armenian Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white rice, rinsed | 2 tablespoons uncooked long-grain white rice | 2 teaspoons onion salt | 1 cup chopped cabbage | 1/2 cup sliced pitted kalamata olives | 1/2 cup thinly sliced white pearl onion
instructions: Combine rice and remaining ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.

title: Sweet and Sour Turnips or Au Vergon
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes | 20 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 100 g whole milk chocolate or 100 g semisweet chocolate | 4 tablespoons vinegar | 1 cup marsala wine or 1 cup sweet sherry | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into bite sized pieces. Place in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and then simmer until tender. Drain and add the sweet chili sauce. Place the chocolate and vinegar in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave until melted. Set aside. In a large non metallic bowl, mix the sweet potato and vinegar mixture together. Add the chocolate to the bowl, making sure the chocolate is melted. Transfer to a container. Sprinkle with salt and then pour the sweet potato/vinegar mixture over. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour. Drain, serve and enjoy.

title: Peaches, Filling and Dipping Samsausages
ingredients: 3 large fresh peaches, sliced | 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie, partially thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Spread the pastry in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Stir the peach slices into the pastry. Pour the peach mixture over the top. Bake in preheated oven until the pastry is bubbling and beginning to brown and crunchy, about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,peach preserve,gingerroot,spanish onion,orange,veggie burger,mayonnaise,turmeric powder
title: Spicy Fried Green Chilies
ingredients: vegetarian bean burgers, of your choice | 1 spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, freshly grated | 2 tablespoons lowfat mayonnaise | 1 orange, juice of | 2 -3 green chilies, finely chopped ( depending on heat of chilli ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | vegetable burger, of your choice
instructions: Mix everything together and chill. Cook on med. Heat until desired crispiness and colour and sauce forms. Serve with a burger & vegetables.

title: Gingerbread - Bread Crumb-Crumbed Chicken
ingredients: 5 lbs bread cubes, cubed 1-inch | 1 tablespoon ginger, minced | 1 orange, juice of
instructions: Place bread cubes in a large bowl of ice cold water until dry. Place ginger into the water and bring to a boil. Drain. Add orange juice, stirring to combine, and cook for 5 minutes. Drain off ginger. Place bread crumbs into a plastic bag. Pour into the bag and shake so bread crumbs don't break apart. Chill, covered, for up to three hours.. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Put chicken in the oven and bake for 1 hour, or until cooked.

title: Baby Lima Beans W- Feta & Apricot Stuffing
ingredients: 4 -5 fresh baby lima beans ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 canned apricots, chopped ( or 1/4 cup dried apricots ) | 1/4 cup feta, finely crumbled, divided
instructions: Cook 3 cups water and 3/4 cup finely chopped baby lima beans until very small tender crisp drain and rinse under cold running water rinse under cold running water drain and pat dry with paper towel. Cook undrained undrained undrained undrained chopped apricots in 1/2 cup water for 4 minutes or until very small tender crisp drain and pat dry with paper towel. Transfer to a large bowl and add feta and toss to combine, breaking up clumps. Spoon into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/4 inch plain tip and snip a small opening, then pipe or pipe stuffing into a 6 inch circle, going 8 to 10 inches in diameter, pressing edges with your fingers. Arrange on a baking sheet.

title: Green Beans and Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cans enchilada sauce, divided | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed and drained | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Heat 1 can enchilada sauce in a large saucepan over medium heat. Stir the green beans and 1 can enchilada sauce together in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Orange Rice
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups short-grain rice ( not instant ) | 8 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup dried orange peel, crushed
instructions: Wash the rice and set it aside. Dissolve the graham cracker crumbs in 1/2 cup cold water. When the rice is cool enough to handle, mix in the crumbs. Shape the rice into a ball, take the excess water, and place the ball in your hands. Roll the ball until completely coated completely. Set onto aluminum foil or parchment paper, and refrigerate until ready to use. Slice into thin rounds, about 3/4 inch wide, and place in a shallow baking pan. Sprinkle the orange peel over half of the rices, then sprinkle the remaining orange peel over. Bake the rices at 325 for about 30 minutes, or until the centers look dry and crisp.

Random Ingredients: macadamia nut,italian herb seasoning,london broil beef
title: Italian Beef in Macadamia Nut Crusted London Broil
ingredients: 1 lb lean london broil beef, trimmed at 2-inches | 1 cup macadamia nuts, chopped | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f. On large rimmed baking sheet, place beef. Sprinkle with macadamia nuts. Bake 25 minutes or until thermometer reads 140f. Sprinkle with italian herb mixture. Serve.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,bread,chocolate chip,self rising flour,cucumber,pasta,green bell pepper,yellow onion
title: Italian Chocolate Chip Crunchy Bread Salad
ingredients: 3 cups plain dried spiral shaped bread, sliced into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 1/3 cup chopped yellow onion | 1/3 cup chopped green bell pepper | 2 tablespoons self-rising flour | 3 tablespoons dry aged parmesan-reggiano cheese, finely grated ( about 6 ounces ) | 36 miniature semidough bags | 1 cup finely shredded cucumber
instructions: Place bread in large bowl. In medium bowl, combine cheeses and chopped onions. Sprinkle cheese mixture over bread and toss lightly to coat evenly. Place bread bag in large bowl.

title: Sopa De Frijoles (Aniseed Chicken)
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless chicken thighs, bone in | 3 1/2 cups spinach, washed, trimmed and cleaned
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into smaller than bite size pieces. Preheat oven to about 400° and set a baking sheet with a rack in the middle of the oven. Place chicken pieces into a roasting pan. Sprinkle a little salt over the chicken pieces, if desired. Pour 1 cup water into a medium size bowl. Dump the spinach on it. Cover with foil and place on the oven rack. Bake until chicken is nicely browned and tender, usually 35 minutes or so for breasts. Serve immediately. Note, the anise seed also works well. If you want to freeze it for future use, thaw it in the fridge after freezing.

title: Coconut Lime Seasoning (Raw Foods)
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups desiccated coconut | 1 lime, zest of, grated
instructions: Squeeze lime zest from the lime and set aside. Combine coconut and lime zest in a large bowl and sprinkle with seasoning, tossing well. Serve. Note, store unused portions.

title: Lard and Tapioca Chips
ingredients: 1 cup lard | 1/2 cup tapioca starch | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Heat the lard in a skillet over medium high heat until very hot, but not smoking. This can take 15 minutes, depending on the length of your pan. Sprinkle with tapioca starch and a pinch of cayenne pepper.

title: Guinness Pastry Twists
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups guinness stout ( or other stout ) | 1/3 cup white flour, plus additional for dusting ( or a mix of both flour and a little of the white wine powder ) | 1/4 cup prepared puff pastry
instructions: Pour the guinness into a small saucepan and heat on the stovetop for about 5 minutes, or until bubbles form around the edge. Remove from heat. Stir the flour and white wine for 3 - 4 minutes or so to form a thick paste. Turn the stovetop down to medium and add the flour butter mixture. Stir with a wooden spoon for 5 minutes or so. The dough should be pliable but not sticky. Wrap the pastry in foil and place on the foil. On a lightly floured surface, roll the pastry out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,spring onion,chipotle chile,white cheddar cheese
title: Santa Fe Tilapia
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 1 large white cheddar cheese, grated | 1 small spring onion, sliced thinly | 1 chipotle chile, diced
instructions: Spray oven proof skillet with cooking spray. Place fish in skillet and top with the cheese. Spoon chipotle chilies over the cheese. Bake in preheated oven 15 minutes or til fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,dark brown sugar,russet potato,spaghetti,tahini,king prawn,icing sugar,oyster
title: Tahini Prawn and Potato Stir-fry
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti, broken in half | 1 russet potato, halved lengthways and thinly sliced | 6 -8 large king prawns, shelled | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 1/2 cups dark brown sugar | lime wedge | 1 dozen icing sugar, sifted | oyster, sliced to serve
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in a pan of salted boiling water until tender. Drain well. Meanwhile, lightly fry the potato in a little oil until lightly browned and tender. Drain. Slice the prawns in half lengthways. In a large bowl, combine the tahini, brown sugar and lime juice. Toss all together. Add the noodles. To serve, pile the prawns and potatoes on top and scatter with sifted icing sugar.

Random Ingredients: red wine,green lentil,cherry juice,italian seasoning,summer squash,french dressing,pimento,horseradish
title: Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen french dressing | 1 cup red wine | 1/3 cup grape-shaped sweet potato, diced | 4 cups green lentils | 1/3 cup pimentos, drained and chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup cherry juice
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together french dressing, red wine, sweet potato, lentils, pimentos, italian seasoning, horseradish, and cherry juice. Chill, covered, in the refrigerator 4 hours, or overnight. Garnish with additional cherry juice.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,grand marnier,rice vinegar,salmon,double cream,angel hair pasta
title: Smoked Salmon Pasta Pasta With Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 2 ounces angel hair pasta ( about one box ) | 2 cups double cream, divided | 4 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 lb fresh salmon, cooked | 1 teaspoon fresh minced garlic
instructions: Cook linguine in salted water until al dente following manufacturer's directions. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, bring 2 cups of the cream with the rind to a simmer over medium high heat. Add the vinegar and turn off heat. Add the grand marnier to the cream and mix well to dissolve. Drain pasta and return to pot, and toss with the sauce. Add the salmon and garlic, and toss until coated. Serve warm.

title: Moroccan Olive Paste
ingredients: 12 olives | 1 pinch mace, ground
instructions: Finely chop the olives and combine with ground mace.

title: Indian Pie
ingredients: 1/2 inch gingerroot ( peeled and minced ) | 1/2 tablespoon garlicam masala | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( fenugreek leaves ) | 1/2 tablespoon garam masala | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( fenugreek leaves ) | 1/2 tablespoon gingerroot ( peeled fresh ginger root peeled and minced ) | 2 tablespoons unseasoned ice water | 2 unbaked pie shells, unbaked
instructions: Prepare the ginger and garlicam masala marinade, in a small bowl combine the spices and water. Use your hands to mix well to remove the lumps.. Place the ginger root and garlicam masala in a medium bowl, add the ginger mixture and stir to coat. Add the ice water and mix well well to distribute.

title: Greek Vanilla Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs ripe organic vanilla beans | 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, leaves only, minced | 1/4 cup fresh horseradish, minced | grated fresh dill to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, add the vanilla beans and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 4 minutes. Drain the vanilla bean mixture and return to clean saucepan. Remove the vanilla bean pods from the hot water. Cover and let stand, stirring once or twice, for 1 hour. Drain the vanilla bean reserving 4 cups of the cooking liquid. Return the vanilla bean to the cooking pot. Stir in the olive oil, parsley, horseradish, and reserved cooking liquid. Simmer over medium heat until warmed, about 10 minutes.

title: Easy Curry and Curry Dengu
ingredients: 10 baby portabella mushrooms | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 14 ounces apricots | 1/2 cup chicken stock or 1/2 cup broth | 5 tablespoons fresh coriander roots, shredded
instructions: Separate the caps from the stems. Slice the caps into quarters. If necessary rinse the mushroom caps in cold water to remove all sand, then drain. Slice the stems into slivers. Peel and discard the stems of the mushroom stalks. Slice the caps in half or quarters if necessary. Slice the apricots into slivers. Combine the onion and curry powder into a large pot of boiling water. Add the mushrooms and continue boiling until the mixture is tender, about 5 to 10 minutes. Drain, then stir in the apricots and broth. Stir in the coriander roots. If the soup is too thick, add a little more broth. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: mustard green,chili oil,lettuce leaf,baby carrot,salt pepper,almond milk
title: Baby Carrots Wrapped in Mustard Greens and Almonds
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb mustard greens, rinsed | 1 -2 bunches lettuce leaf | 1 bag baby carrots | 2/3 cup almond milk | 1 tablespoon chili oil ( can use canola oil, peanut oil or sesame oil ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Wash and dry mustard greens. Cut diagonally in 1/2 slices. Place in a large skillet. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer until greens soften. Drain. Cut greens diagonally in 1 1/2 lengths. Wash lettuce, pick them well and remove any tough parts. Cut in half crosswise. Place bottom leaf on a flat surface. Place a couple pieces of greens on top of lettuce leaf, top with carrots about 1 1/2 tbsp of greens and sprinkle with salt and pepper.

title: Risi E Bisi (Apple Rice Casserole)
ingredients: 1 cup risotto rice | 1/2 cup apple cider ( can be replaced with other types of apple juice too )
instructions: Combine rice and the apple cider in a large pot. Place over medium heat, and stir until rice is well covered with liquid. Cover, and cook 20 minutes. Remove from heat, and let sit 5 minutes. Serve.

title: Homemade Sweet Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce, kikkoman brand | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Place the whipping cream and dark soy sauce in a heavy skillet. Heat slowly over medium low heat until steam appears at the surface, about 15 minutes. Do not allow the mixture to boil. Place a wide bowl over the skillet and quickly stir in the hot cream.

title: Panacoff
ingredients: 6 lbs beef brisket | 12 lemons, zest of, large | white wine vinegar or red wine
instructions: Score the fat on the meat and rub it with a whole lemon. Rub the lemon zest into the fat. Place the meat in an oven proof dish. Pour boiling water over it, and cover. Let rise for 1 hour. When time is up, add enough vinegar or wine to cover. Cover and return to oven. Cook very slowly in a slow oven for 6 hours at 250 degrees f. When the meat has turned a rich, reddish brown color. When nearly done remove the meat from the oven, remove the zest, and refrigerate overnight. Drain the fat from the roasting dish. Return the meat to the pan, adding water until it reaches the consistency of gravy.

title: Chipotle-Smoked Ahi
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 1 can tomato sauce
instructions: Place ingredients in blender and blend until smooth. Use a funnel as a guide for smoke. Serve with rice.

title: Curried Mustard
ingredients: 3 tablespoons stone ground mustard | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon reduced-calorie margarine
instructions: Stir mustard with curry powder and margarine, if using, until well combined.

Random Ingredients: butter,sharp cheddar cheese,banana pepper,roast beef,herb,green chilies,lime wedge,lentil
title: Lentil Burgers With Beef and Chiles
ingredients: 6 ounces green chilies, chopped coarsely | 1 lb roast beef, thinly sliced | 8 ounces dried lentils, washed, soaked in cold water for 30 minutes and drained | 2 tablespoons mild herb ( marjoram, basil, thyme or any combo of these ) | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 - 3/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese | lime wedge, fresh, to serve
instructions: To make the filling, combine the chiles, roast beef, lentils, herbs and butter. Season well with salt and pepper. Divide into four portions and roll in balls. Melt the cheese in a pan, add the balls and brown on all sides. Serve in bowls with lime wedges.

title: Ouzo French Toast
ingredients: 2 cups marinara sauce | 1/4 teaspoon ouzo | 2 slices of good quality bread | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/2 cup light ouzo | 30 -35 crushed tortilla chips
instructions: Heat up a heavy frying pan and add 1/4 teaspoon ouzo. Add 2 slices of good quality bread and lightly brown each side. Remove from pan and keep warm. Combine the marinara sauce, 1/4 teaspoon ouzo and vanilla and slowly heat it through. Warm up another skillet and add the rest of the ouzo. Add the soaked bread on it and coat both sides. When heated through, it should feel somewhat dry. Place the toast on the plate seam side down. Arrange the soaked pieces of toast evenly over a heated plate. Drizzle extra ouzo on toast and serve immediately.

title: Kosher White Flour Crusted Meat
ingredients: 8 ounces ground meat | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons black peppercorns ( whole, toasted, freshly ground or coarsely crushed ) | 3 1/2 cups all-purpose white flour
instructions: In a mixing bowl, add all the ingredients and mix well. If the mixture is too dry, add up to 1 tablespoons of water. Lightly coat your hands with a good coating of vegetable oil and shape the dough into a ball. You may cover, cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. You could also wrap the meat in plastic wrap and then pound it out with a meat mallet. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. You want it to be slightly less than 1/4. Roll the meat on a lightly floured surface into about 15 to 20 inch long, 1 inch diameter thick pieces. Transfer it to an ice cream scoop or other baking sheet lined with parchment paper and coat with nonstick spray. If any moisture has formed on your hands, gently pinch off a piece of the parchment paper with your fingers. Arrange the meat on a well floured baking sheet. Brush the top of the meat with vegetable oil and sprinkle the top with a little coarse sugar.. If you like your meat very crusty, you may sprinkle more coarse sugar or sprinkles on top of the meat to get it flatter or more like a pastel color for the crust. Bake the meat in the preheated oven for about 3 to 5 minutes, until it starts to brown and starts turning slightly darker in color. Turn the meat over, turn up the oven to 500 degrees and bake for another 2 to 3 minutes, or until it has lost its shininess. If you notice the crust cracking, remove it by shaking the pan so the sides don't crack. Remove your meat from the oven, transfer it to a serving dish, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,salt pepper,chinese five spice powder,chicken thigh fillet,black pepper,white rum,celery seed,grape
title: BBQ Honeymoon Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons black pepper | 2 teaspoons ground black pepper | 2 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons chinese five spice powder | 450 g chicken thigh fillets, fat trimmed, fat cut into 2cm chunks | 1 tablespoon grape, halved | 3 tablespoons good-quality dry white rum | 1 stalk celery seed | salt and pepper
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and leave to marinate for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, pat chicken dry before using, and season with black pepper and salt. Grill or fry chicken, brushing with glaze, until cooked and browned, about 15 minutes. Add grapes and dry sherry to chicken.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,red pepper chili powder,cream mushroom soup,sunflower oil,golden syrup,cooking apple,basil leaf
title: Easy Baked Apples
ingredients: 6 large cooking apples ( i like to also use a large bramette, i have never used it ) | 1 teaspoon sweet red pepper chili powder | 1 packet onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil ( or other cooking oil ) | 1 1/2 cups light cream of mushroom soup, warmed ( or light cream ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon sweet basil leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f. Core apples, if needed. Place in a bowl with chili powder, salt & pepper, and toss to coat. Place in a large roasting pan & bake for 20 min or until tender and slightly wrinkled. Remove from oven and turn apples over in oven for about 15 min more. Allow apples to cool in oven for 30 minute. Whisk together soup powder, oil and warmed cream of mushroom until combined, add to soup base, whisking to combine thoroughly. Pour over apples and return to the oven, and cook for a further 15 minute. Stir in basil before serving.

title: Coconut and Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons salad oil | 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut, toasted | 1/2 cup chunky salsa, any brand | 1/4 cup red bell peppers, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss well.

title: French Onion Ring Dip
ingredients: 1 cup onion flakes, finely chopped | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 7/8 cup whipping cream | 1/4 - 1/3 cup half-and-half
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Stir until well mixed. Chill thoroughly. Serve with crackers, fresh rye cookies, assorted fresh vegetables whatever your favourite dip is.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,red chili pepper,wild mushroom,fennel,vidalia onion,baking soda
title: Mushroom Catsup
ingredients: 1 lb fresh wild mushroom | 1 small vidalia onion | 1 red chili pepper | 6 whole chipotle chiles | 1 teaspoon fresh fennel | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Clean mushrooms under running water, removing tough stems. Chop onion, red chili, chipotle chiles, and fennel. Seed all the pinches of coked spice. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Spoon mixture onto parchment lined cookie sheet. Bake for 1 hour or until golden brown.

title: Salsa for Steak Fajitas
ingredients: 2 pounds skirt steak, trimmed of fat | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | 1/4 teaspoon red onion, minced
instructions: Coat grill with no stick spray. Grill steak on direct heat for 6 to 8 minutes. Sprinkle with cayenne powder. Sprinkle with onion. Serve on large flour tortillas with fresh tomato salsa on the side.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,chicken bouillon,white sugar,great northern bean,apple
title: Apple and Great Northern Beans
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans | 1 can yellow peas | 1 medium apple, chopped | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 3 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Prepare the peas according to package directions. While the peas are cooking, combine bouillon, sugar and apple in medium saucepan. Cook until bubbly. Add beans to the saucepan and stir well. Pour the sauce into a bowl. Serve.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,strawberry,soymilk,bicarbonate soda,salmon fillet,rump steak,chipotle chile
title: Smoked Salmon With Smoked Chile and Strawberry Milk
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets, 4oz each | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 2 cups soymilk | 4 strawberries, hulled and quartered, about 20g total weight | 1 green chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 medium green chili pepper, finely chopped | 3 -4 chipotle chiles, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350°f. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Cut each salmon fillet into four equal pieces. Place on baking tray and spray with oil. Use a skewer to poke holes into the salmon with a sharp knife. Sprinkle with half the bicarb of soda. Bake salmon for about 15 minutes.

title: Beef Barley Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 cup instant pearl barley | 1 cup red onion, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh dill, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh pistachio nut, chopped
instructions: Combine barley, onion, dill and pistachio nuts in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on high power setting for 5 minutes until boiling. Stir to blend, then cover and cook on high power for 20 more minutes, stirring several times during cooking.

title: Ciabatta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, minced | 2 teaspoons lemon grass, minced | 1 cup vegetable or 1 cup rotini pasta | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Cut rotini in half crosswise and drain. Place in mixing bowl and mix with ginger, lemon grass, salt and juice, taco sauce, liquid smoke & liquid smoke. Stuff into shape of ciabatta.

title: Jim's Portuguese Pork Stew and Beans
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, boneless, skinless cut into 1-inch-thick slices | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained | 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 sausage, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Arrange pork in a roasting pan. Evenly distribute amongst pork, then add kidney beans, artichokes, quinoa and sausage.

title: Perfect Rice for One!
ingredients: 4 ounces brown basmati rice | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons light coconut, grated ( desiccated desiccated coconut is best ) | 2 tablespoons ghee
instructions: Soak the rice in water for 20 mins, then rinse until the water runs clear. Drain. Put in a bowl and put the rice on the middle rack in the oven. Cook the rice, stir, then put in the oven for 45 mins, stirring every 10 - 15 mins as it starts to turn golden. You can also turn up the heat on your grill if you need to cook for a longer time. When done, drain and leave on one side. Ghee is the good stuff in my book that comes in almost any form, so i add 1 tbs to the mixture when cooking the rice.

Random Ingredients: ciabatta,oyster sauce,burghul,nonfat milk powder,garlic powder,tarragon,annatto seed,chili powder
title: Nori Kebabs (Stir-Fry Garlic Burgers), Vegan
ingredients: 4 ciabatta, patties | 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder ( soy ) | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried tarragon ( minced ) | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 teaspoon cannatto seeds | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon ( minced ) | 1 dash garlic powder | 1 dash salt and chili powder
instructions: Prepare grill as follows, place patties on skewers and season with 1/2 tsps. Cornmeal. Coat with remaining spices. Grill the patties, turning several times, until browned and cooked through, about 12 minutes.

title: Garitos de Camarones (Shrimp Tacos)
ingredients: 6 ounces uncooked small shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 cups shredded spanish onions | 8 whole wheat tortillas, warmed | 1/2 cup packed brown rice
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat, pour olive oil into pan, swirl to coat.

title: Kosher Kebabs
ingredients: 3/4 - 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 lemon, juiced | 1/2 lemon, juiced | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 3/4 cup toasted sliced almonds or 3/4 cup sliced pitted whole almonds | 1/4 teaspoon ground almond extract
instructions: Combine ingredients well and shape into walnut sized balls. Sprinkle on toasted almond slices. Grill or broil until they lightly brown.

title: Italian Sausage and Pork
ingredients: 1 pork shoulder, trimmed with bone | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place pork shoulder in a large, deep baking dish. Spread spaghetti sauce over the pork shoulder, cover, and bake 30 minutes. While the pork is baking, place oranges, aniseed, cinnamon, and oregano in a blender and blend until smooth. Remove pork from oven and arrange in a single layer over the orange mixture. Bake, covered, in preheated oven. Bake 30 minutes. Stir contents of pan and continue baking until it reaches desired thickness.

Random Ingredients: creamy peanut butter,tilapia fillet,wild rice,garlic paste,bisquick,clove,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Tilapia With a Tahb & Raisin Crust
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 packet ras el hanout spice mix | ra el hanout spice mix | 1/2 teaspoon garlic paste | 2 cups bisquick | 3/4 cup creamy peanut butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place tilapia fillets in a pan with lightly salted cold water to cover then bring to a boil. Cook until the fish flakes easily. Remove fish from water and set aside. Heat pan with peanut butter until melted then stir in the 2 pkgs of ras el hanout & 1/4 tsp of a garlic per packet of spices. Cook for 3 minutes. Remove from heat, cover then set aside in the pan for 8 - 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine 1/2 cup of soured cream with 1 cup of cream & mix well to loosen the mix. Set aside in the pan & keep warm. Strain cooked fish and make slits & place the fish in the bottom of an oiled baking dish. Mix together the 2 pkgs of spices. Pour this cream mixture over the tilapia, and bake in oven approximately 20 mins or until it bubbles & is bubbling again. This is tasty served with roasted garlic & salad vegetables.

title: Mock Devonshire Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar bacon bits | 1 -2 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1/2 - 2/3 cup grated romano cheese, to taste | 1 jar champagne ( optional )
instructions: Heat bacon bits in a large stock pot until you can see the fat floating on top, then pour bacon bits into hot stock pot. Sprinkle with the parmesan cheese, to taste. I like to have some leftover for dunking into your noodles while my mom uses it in the crockpot or maybe over a cold waffle.

title: Clam Spread
ingredients: 24 cooked clams, drained | 8 ounces fontina cheese, grated | 1 pinch white pepper | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Serve chilled on a flatbread or as desired.

title: Kielbasa and Potato With Spicy Yogurt
ingredients: 3/4 lb kielbasa, cut in 1/4-inch slices from the butcher | 2 medium zucchini ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 1 small red bell pepper, seeded and diced | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup old fashioned oats | whole-milk jam ( to drizzle )
instructions: In a large skillet, saute sausage until just cooked. Drain. Meanwhile, cut zucchini into 1/4 slices. Cook zucchini slices in boiling water 5 minutes, or until tender. Drain and return zucchini to skillet. Add red pepper, vinegar, and oatmeal.

Random Ingredients: stew meat,french,veggie burger,paprika,juniper berry,napa cabbage,sauerkraut,head cauliflower
title: German Beef Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 can sauerkraut ( drain liquid ) | 2 cups fresh mushrooms ( sliced and stewed ) | 2 cups fresh french rolls ( sliced ) | 1 large head cauliflower, cut into small florets | 3 juniper berries, crushed | 1 1/2 tablespoons paprika
instructions: In a dutch oven over medium heat, add all ingredients except paprika. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer for at least one hour. Ladle into soup bowls. Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,cooking oil,extra virgin olive oil,red potato,veal
title: Povite (Ethiopian Version of Vegetarian Pancakes)
ingredients: 5 red potatoes | 3 lbs ground veal | 2 cups soymilk | olive oil, for cooking | cooking oil ( for sauteing )
instructions: Cube potatoes into large cubes, about 1/2 inch in size, and boil until well done. Chop the veal very finely. Put potatoes in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,pork tenderloin,beef brisket,green cardamom pod,dark corn syrup
title: Roast Pork With Cherry-Merlot Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark corn syrup | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, cracked | 1 fresh beef brisket | 2 tablespoons dark corn syrup | 2 tablespoons maraschino cherries, stems and pits removed | 4 large whole green cardamom pods
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons dark corn syrup and 1 teaspoon cracked cardamom pods in a small saucepan over medium high heat.

title: Hawaiian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in the rigatoni and return to a boil. Cook pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well and toss with the pineapple, olive oil and pineapple juice. Season to taste and top with shaved cheddar cheese, if desired.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,pearl barley,baby spinach leaf
title: Simple Beef Barley & Spinach
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 jar baby spinach leaves | 2 cups quick-cooking pearl barley, such as calrose or 2 cups brown rice and barley
instructions: Put the beef in a dutch oven pot. Add just enough water to cover, except for 1 tablespoon, and 1 1/2 cups cold water, and bring to a boil. Add the baby spinach. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer until the meat is tender, 8 to 10 hours. About 10 minutes before the beef is done, add the barley and stir. The barley should be tender and the liquid should have thickened. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Apricot Ham Roll-Ups
ingredients: 12 marinated apricots, cut from the stems | 1 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil | 8 slices ham | 1 quart heavy whipping cream | 4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup chopped peanuts
instructions: Rinse apricots and dry on absorbent paper. Spread each layer with 1 teaspoons of the sesame oil. Place ham slices in a jellyroll pan, overlapping slightly. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoons flour. Pour whipping cream evenly over ham. Sprinkle with the peanuts. Roll up jellyroll style jellyroll fashion and refrigerate overnight if desired. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Unwrap ham roll ups and place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: pecorino cheese,pizza crust,coriander seed,chicken bouillon granule,broccoli floret,red delicious apple
title: Spiced Broccoli Pizza
ingredients: 1 refrigerated pizza crust | 3 cups broccoli florets | 1 medium tomatoes, cut into 8 slices ( about 3 ounces ) | 2 tablespoons dried coriander seeds | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon granules | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino cheese
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Place the pizza crust on a pizza screen, and spread with 1/2 cup water and bake until brown and bubbling, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and transfer to a baking sheet, placing the broccoli spears between sheets of plastic wrap. Cover the pizza with another piece of plastic wrap and continue to cut away the plastic until all of the crusts are used, about 20 minutes. Meanwhile, place the broccoli in a small bowl. Sprinkle with the coriander seeds and set aside to plump up for about 10 minutes meanwhile, place the tomatoes in a small pot. Scrape out the seeds with a spoon and set aside. Dissolve the chicken bouillon in 1/4 cup of freshly grated pecorino cheese. Drain the broccoli pieces and place in a colander.

title: Mexican Zuppa
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta ( italian zuppa ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 -3 medium red chilies, diced | 1 bunch fresh kale
instructions: Put the rigatoni in a pot of boiling water and cook it for about 8 minutes or until the pasta is tender but firm. Drain it but leave some for zuppa. When the pasta is done, drain it and add the cumin. Stir to combine. Dice up the chilies if desired. Take the zuppa from the water and add the zest as well. Stir it gently around so that the zest doesn't burn and then take it off the heat. Toss it with the cilantro and serve.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,red chili pepper flake,oven cooking,honey
title: Olive Oil Free
ingredients: 1 lb oven smoked mozzarella cheese ( about 3 cups ) | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons chili oil or 2 tablespoons honey | 2 teaspoons crushed red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in medium bowl. Cut mozzarella in half, place one half on small tray in a flat dish that will fit into your microwave. Cover with oil and then top with remaining cheese. Spray olive oil on top of mozzarella. Microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes, or until cheese is melted, and starting to brown on the edges, stirring halfway through. Slide out of microwave and let cool. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,dark red kidney bean,caster sugar,garlic powder
title: Low Fat Spicy Beef and Beans
ingredients: 1 can dark red kidney beans | 4 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes | 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder | 2 teaspoons caster sugar
instructions: Drain the beans and rinse well. Discard the liquid. Put everything into a large saucepan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 3 hours stirring often. Taste and add sugar if needed.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,tilapia fillet,red chili pepper,pecorino romano cheese,green onion,vanilla,corn
title: Spicy Tilapia
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecorino romano cheese | 2 ounces corn | 1/4 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg | 4 ounces tilapia fillets | 2 -2 teaspoons finely chopped green onions | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red chili pepper | 2 teaspoons finely chopped green onions | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red chili pepper
instructions: Pound pecorino romano chees with a pestle or the edge of a small glass until well crumbly. Mix pecorino romano, corn, chili, nutmeg and 2 ounces of the green onions together in a medium bowl. Arrange fish in a single layer in a shallow baking dish, and sprinkle evenly with the cheese mixture. Bake on top shelf of a preheated 350f oven until fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork, about 35 minutes. Serve hot, with the remaining green onions, fresh chopped red chilies, or hot sauce.

title: Easy Red Peppered Vegetables for Microwave
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding, english-style | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 jar chopped pimiento | 1/4 cup rose water | 2 -3 juniper berries | 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Mince vegetables. Cook in microwave, covered.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped in Caramelized Carrots
ingredients: 1/2 pound thinly sliced prosciutto | 1 carrot, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces | 3 tablespoons white sugar, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Cut the prosciutto into 1/8 inch wide strips. Arrange the carrots onto a baking sheet. Cut a slit down one side, without the paper ends, down to about 1/4 inch beyond the rim of the carrot. Insert the prosciutto strips into the center of each carrot, leaving a hole in each hole. Mix sugar into the hole.

Random Ingredients: almond flour,avocado,mozzarella cheese,garam masala,monterey jack cheese
title: Guacamole Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese ( grated or shredded ) | 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese ( grated or shredded ) | 1/3 cup almond flour ( unbleached flour or almond powder ) | 1 avocado ( ripe ) | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( or a little more )
instructions: Note, the quantity of ingredients will vary depending on the size of your avocado. Mix all ingredients together. Place in refrigerator to cool and firm. Serve with pita chips, crackers, pita bread, crackers, whatever you want.

title: Green Rice - Spanish Rice Mix
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked spanish rice mix ( i like the quick and easy method of rice cookers, but you can mix in your favorite box ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 bag frozen chopped spinach | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon or 1/4 cup dried tarragon | 1/2 head red cabbage, cored
instructions: Prepare package of rice as directed on package about 2 hours ahead of time. Heat oil or margarine in medium sized saucepan. Stir in rice, spinach, cilantro, and tarragon. Continue to stir over medium heat until rice is hot throughout, about 2 more minutes. Cut and discard leaves from cabbage, leaving small pieces of cabbage and greens whole around the inside of the pot. Place on large platter and pour hot vegetable and rice mixture over. Serve.

Random Ingredients: green capsicum,worcestershire sauce,italian sausage,butternut pumpkin,red salmon,brown mustard seed
title: Sweet Chilli Sausage & Pumpkin Roasted
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg butternut pumpkin ( cut into 2cm cubes ) | 1 green capsicum ( cut into 2cm pieces ) | 1 red salmon ( or 1 lrg can of flake salmon ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons mixed brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon dried italian sausage
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced. Place pumpkin, capsicum, salmon, worcestershire sauce, italian mustard seeds, worcestershire sauce/sausage and brown mustard seeds in a roasting pan. Roast in oven for 25 - 30 mins or until pumpkin and capsicum are tender crisp and golden.

title: Chilled Steak With Shrimp and Mascarpone Cheese
ingredients: 1 flank steak | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 cup tapioca flour | 1/2 lb medium raw shrimp, peeled and deveined | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh garlic | 1 can small chunk watermelon, drained | 1/4 cup drained bottled mascarpone cheese | 1/2 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 1/2 teaspoon turbinado sea salt
instructions: Prepare steaks,. Place rack in center of oven and preheat to 450~f degrees. Cut steak crosswise into 1/4 slices and sprinkle with 1 teaspoons sea salt. Place steak in baking dish, fat side down. Bake, uncovered, 10 minutes. Turn steak and transfer to cutting board. Thoroughly mix tapioca flour with 3/4 cup water in large bowl and stir in shrimp, garlic, 1/2 c watermelon and 1/4 cups cheese. Pour half of mixture over steak and transfer steak to cutting board, using a knife to cut into 1/4 slices. Slice across the grain of the steak and place steaks, shrimp and cheese mixture, mascarpone cheese, 1/2 teaspoon sea salt and turbinado sea salt in 13x9x2 glass baking dish. Bake, uncovered, about 15 minutes, or until cheese melts.

Random Ingredients: soy mozzarella cheese,white sugar,chicken breast fillet,red pepper flake,red hot pepper
title: Kurdish Chicken
ingredients: 16 chicken breast fillets | 1/2 cup soy mozzarella cheese, sliced | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 2 large fresh red hot peppers ( optional )
instructions: Coat bottom of a baking dish with cooking oil. Place chicken strips in dish. Arrange hot peppers over chicken. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over peppers. Sprinkle sugar evenly over cheese and chicken. Bake in preheated 375f oven for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,heavy whipping cream,anaheim chilies
title: Anaheim Cream Fritters
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 12 medium fresh anaheim chilies | 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Preheat grill on high. Place chilies on a paper towel lined plate to dry. Cut a slit down the center of each chile. With a small spoon, make shallow slits into each chile to remove the seeds. Place chilies on hot grill. Cook, turning often, until blackened and tender, about 8 minutes. Transfer chilies to a medium bowl and cover with plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: sage,shallot,red pepper flake,baby carrot,flour tortilla,sea bass fillet,kosher salt,cashew
title: Blackened Sea Bass Wraps
ingredients: 4 sea bass fillets, each 1 inch thick, skinned | 4 -6 shallots, minced | 1 tablespoon kosher salt ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup roasted cashews, coarsely chopped | 8 small baby carrots, peeled | 12 soft flour tortillas, warmed ( optional )
instructions: In a shallow dish, or pie plate, stir together the sea bass with the shallots, kosher salt, crushed red pepper, cashews, baby carrots, and red pepper flakes. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or up to 3 days. Preheat a grill or broiler to high heat. Lightly oil grill grate. Sprinkle tortillas with kosher salt and allow to warm. When ready to cook, heat tortillas on grill or broiler. Fold in sides and roll and enjoy.

title: Frijoles Borrachitos (Frijoles Borrachitos)
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans, cooked | 4 -8 tablespoons chopped chives
instructions: Mix beans with chives and salt and serve in a large glass bowl. Can be served over tacos, rice, salad, or alone.

title: Rice Krispies Cakes
ingredients: 2 cups rice krispies | 1 cup capers, drained
instructions: Roll rice krispies into 1 balls and fry in non stick pan until slightly browned. Drain on paper towel and serve.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,iceberg lettuce,coriander,celery rib,lime wedge,bisquick baking mix,worcestershire sauce,sweetcorn
title: Sweetcorn Crunch Bake
ingredients: 500 g sweetcorn, canned drained | 1 medium celery rib, chopped finely ( reserve the celery leaves for the topping ) | 1/2 cup coriander, chopped ( reserve the coriander leaves for the topping ) | 250 g all-purpose baking mix, sifted | 1 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 1/4 cup fresh coriander or 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1 lime wedge, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c. Place the corn kernels, celery, coriander and the reserved chopped celery leaves in a bowl, mix well. In a seperate bowl, place the baking mix, worcestershire sauce, seasoned salt and half the coriander leaves and mix gently to combine. Lightly spoon the dry ingredients evenly over the corn mixture and bake the cake for 30 - 35 minutes or until a skewer or toothpick comes out clean when inserted into the centre of the baking. Allow to cool slightly before serving. Serve with lime wedges mixed with a drizzle of lime juice.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,tarragon,rice noodle,sumac,icing sugar,onion soup mix,orange zest,chicken wing
title: Orange Chicken
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces stewing beef | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 8 -10 chicken wings, split | 1 1/2 tablespoons rice noodles | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1/2 teaspoon orange zest | 1/4 cup orange juice ( optional )
instructions: Cut meat and vegetables into bite sized pieces, place in crock pot and stir in the onion soup mix. Cover and cook on low for 7 hours. Serve on rice noodles and decorate with orange zest and icing sugar.

title: Mustard Seeds(Pesce)
ingredients: 2 cans mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons crushed chives
instructions: Heat mustard seeds in a skillet and bring to a simmer while stirring to avoid splattering. Cook 10 minutes then remove from heat and cool. Combine mustard seeds with crushed chives and cool before storing in airtight containers. Variation, if you are unable to can anoint the mustard seeds you can substitute with whole wheat or brown rice. Spread on raw or brown or white wheat bread with a dry rub made by the blender or by combining mustard seeds with chopped up vegetables. Note, i have never tried this in the bread before.

title: Homemade Pecan Salad Dressing
ingredients: 4 cups of flake, dry | 1 1/2 cups of dry onion flakes | 1/2 cup pecans, finely chopped ( can use walnuts ) | 1/3 cup rice vinegar
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a jar and shake well. Add to salad and stir. Serve with salad vegetables.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,chickpea,floury potato,stewing beef,tarragon,fish sauce,corn syrup,white onion
title: Beef and Potato Stirfry With Crunchy Potatoes
