ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, thinly sliced | 1 white onion, chopped | 1/2 cup sweet corn syrup | 4 tablespoons fish sauce | 12 corn flakes, crushed ( corn, yellow corn if you can find it ) | 1 cup chickpeas, microwaved | 5 floury potatoes, peeled and sliced | shredded lettuce
instructions: Brown beef with onions in a very hot fry pan and drain. Add sweetcorn syrup and fish sauce and bring to bubbly. Sift crushed corn flakes over beef and bring to boil. Stir and lower heat. Cover and simmer on low for about 20 mins or until thickened. Stir in the beans. Cook the potatoes, covered, in a microwave for about 5 mins or until tender crisp, shaking the pan as required to prevent sticking. Sprinkle potatoes with lettuce and serve immediately so no overcooked bits are left.

Random Ingredients: clove,sambal chili paste,garlic butter,epazote leaf,cumin seed,parsnip,sea salt black pepper,cremini mushroom
title: Spicy Herb Mushrooms With Brisket & Chiles
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried epazote leaves | 10 cloves | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds, crushed | 12 ounces coriander and a small bunch of cremini mushrooms | 1 teaspoon sambal chili paste ( sambal kecap manis ) | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 large parsnips, peeled | 1 teaspoon garlic butter, melted
instructions: Place the epazote, cloves and cumin in a pan with a small knob of butter and bring to a boil for 2 - 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool completely. Cut the mushrooms in half and place in a bowl. Add the sambal chile and coriander and toss to coat. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Grate the parsnips using a vegetable peeler into the same bowl and toss with the herb mixture. Drizzle the melted garlic butter over and toss to coat evenly. Serve, topped with the herb mixture.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,parsnip,veal,mint leaf,jasmine rice
title: Veal Patties With Coriander Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander-mint rice | vegetable oil from cooking rice | 2 slices veal, diced | 1 1/2 cups chopped parsnips | 1 1/2 cups chopped cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Combine coriander and mint. Add rice. Set aside. Heat oil in skillet. Fry veal and parsnips until just beginning to brown. Remove veal and parsnip from skillet and serve over rice.

title: Chorizo & Pineapple Smoothie
ingredients: 1 green chili pepper, deseeded, chopped | 8 ounces chorizo sausage, chopped | 1/2 cup pineapple juice, fresh
instructions: Place chilies, sausage, pineapple if using, juice and pineapple to a blender. Blend until smooth or serve immediately.

title: Corned Beef and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 1 cup corned beef steak, chopped | 1 package baby spinach, chopped | 12 cups broth, your choice
instructions: Throw all ingredients in a crock pot. Cook on low setting until ready to serve.

title: Wheat Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 500 g whole wheat flour | 600 ml wheat flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°c. Use a cookie cutter, cut out 24 circles. Warm your flour in a large bowl. You should have a mixture of fine breadcrumbs and coarse grain cereal crumbs. Once the dough has rested for about 10 minutes, take it out onto a floured surface and knead lightly until smooth. Roll out the dough to about 1/2 inch thickness. Fold in half and make a round. Repeat with all the others. Place onto greased oven trays. Glaze between each pizza and bake for about 20 - 25 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,salmon fillet,lime zest,chicken bouillon cube,yellow pea,english muffin
title: Maple Salmon on English Muffins
ingredients: 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 2 salmon fillets, skin removed | 4 english muffins, split | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1/3 cup frozen yellow split yellow peas | 1/2 lime, zest of
instructions: Preheat broiler. In a small saucepan, bring maple syrup to a boil and then set aside. Trim any large bones from salmon. Cut fish in half lengthwise, then cut diagonally across the grain into 1/2 inch thick slices. Place the salmon, muffins, and bouillon cube in the broiler and broil for 8 to 10 minutes or until the bread gets lightly toasted. Remove from heat, and top with peas and grilled salmon slices. Serve with lime vinaigrette.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,black pepper,cardamom pod,clove,flat leaf parsley,cognac,dill pickle relish
title: Danish Stuffed Pork Loin
ingredients: 6 -7 lbs pork loin | 1 cup flat leaf parsley ( chopped ) | 1 cup dill pickle relish ( miracle whip works well ) | 1/4 cup cognac | 6 whole cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon black pepper | 2 teaspoons ground cloves
instructions: Place pork loin on cutting board and open very gently. Using scissors, make 3 slits in the center of the loin through the meat. Insert a knife into the slits. Stuff the meat using a 1/2 teaspoon of the pickle relish. Mix parsley, dill pickles, cognac, cloves and cardamom. Spread the relish on both sides of meat. Place loin in a shallow roasting pan, cover and roast at 350 degrees for about 1 hour. Check in the last 20 minutes to see that meat is well done. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before carving.

title: Pan Fried Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons pan fried anchovy fillets | 1/2 cup arugula leaf, washed well | 1/2 cup deli roast beef, sliced thin ( or thinly sliced )
instructions: Place the anchovy on a cutting board and cut across the grain into slanted sections.

title: Swiss Cheese and Herb Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup fresh thyme ( or 1 t dry ) | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, shredded ( about 4 oz. ) | 1 1/2 cups radishes, sliced | 1 jar small curd beans sprouts, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup capers | 3 packages arugula, torn into bite sized pieces | 1/3 cup seltzer water
instructions: In mixing bowl, stir together bread crumbs and thyme. Add cheese, radishes, beansprouts, capers and water. Toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Just before serving, stir in arugula. Sprinkle with seltzer.

title: Canned Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 tart apples ( i use golden delicious ) | 1/2 small bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 small mild flavored goat cheese
instructions: Core and chop apples, dice peppers, mix in dry ingredients, and stuff in cheese. Fill in caps with whatever kind of filling you like. Cook in oil sprayed pan for one hour. Let cool down a bit, then stuff with whatever stuffing you like i have made a huge batch of these so there is lots of extras besides cheese.

title: Bulgur and Currants
ingredients: 1 cup bulgur | 2 cups dried currants
instructions: Rinse the bulgur. If a sieve placed on the sieve it will drip out right away. Place the sieve in a large bowl, add a big pinch of salt, and pour in enough water to cover the bulgur by an inch or so. Add a handful of currants and leave the sieve until you have a thin, damp, clean cloth that is pliable like a colander. Rinse the bulgur in a sieve and squeeze out excess moisture. Place the bulgur in an 8 1/2 to 10 quart pan and add about 1 1/2 cups boiling hot water. It will take about a half an hour to get the bulgur to a thick, sticky consistency. It should take around 60 minutes to reach the desired consistency, adding a little more water if necessary but not too much as the currants will release too much water.

Random Ingredients: fennel,flour,green curry paste,black bean,reynolds wrap foil,white sugar
title: Quick and Easy Black Bean Filling for Vegetables #RSC
ingredients: 1 can black beans, liquid reserved | 1/2 teaspoon whole fennel | 1/8 teaspoon fenel | 1/8 teaspoon green curry paste | 1/8 teaspoon white sugar | 4 -5 reynolds wraps or 4 -5 aluminum foil packets
instructions: Drain liquid from beans into a measuring cup. Stir beans, fennel, curry paste, green curry paste, and sugar in pan. Stir, simmer, stirring occasionally, 5 - 7 minutes. Add enough liquid so mixture is thick enough to coat spoon. Remove pan from heat. Arrange 1 packet over beans, fold, enclosing each packet.

title: Yellow Peas "Ragu" With Yellow Rice or " Ener-Galin " on the Side
ingredients: 1 lb yellow split peas | 1/2 - 1 cup sweet italian-style cut vegetables or 1/2-1 cup other quick-cooking soup | italian, bread ( optional ) or other crusty bread ( optional )
instructions: Note, to thaw the peas, you could, like, run them under warm water. The warmth of your hands will do the trick to get them to bend easily. Soak the peas overnight, then drain. When you are ready to eat, put a large pot on the stove or in the microwave, with your soup and a drizzle of olive oil,. Heat the pot or oil, but watch for splattering. As soon as you see a light haze coming up, add enough fresh bread or a few dabs of breadcrumbs, if desired. If one side starts to brown at one side, add the peas. When they are tender, turn with a slotted spoon and let them brown all over. If the pan is not big enough, cut bread into cubes and add them to the soup before serving. Serve immediately on the side with lots of butter to crush the breadcrumbs and bread crumbs.

title: Spicy Mushroom Crisps
ingredients: 1 can mushroom stems and pieces ( undrained ) | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/4 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 lb tortillas | 8 -12 ounces frozen tortillas
instructions: Mix ingredients. Add tortillas for crisps on a baking sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Bake in a 400° or 350° oven 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp and golden. Cool. Store in an airtight container.

title: Honey Mustard
ingredients: 1/4 cup honey | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: Pour honey into bowl and stir to blend. Add hot pepper sauce.

title: Slow Cooker Mild Portuguese Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 1/2 pounds pork tenderloin | 4 teaspoons paprika | 6 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar
instructions: Put the pork tenderloins into the crock of a large crock with the paprika, tomato paste, pepper, vinegar, and cayenne pepper. Cook on high until the pork is cooked through and no longer pink inside, 7 to 10 hours. Transfer the pork to a cutting board, and let cool.

title: Ribbons
ingredients: 1 can bean sprouts | 2 teaspoons lemon rind, grated | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 2 drops red food coloring
instructions: Place all ingredients into a large, shallow bowl. Mix well using a fork until well blended using a fork. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and flatten into a thick rectangle. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

title: Green Beans with Peas
ingredients: 1 quart fresh green beans ( optional ) | 2 large pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into pieces | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook the green beans until tender but still firm, about 4 minutes.

title: Guatemalan Green cardamoms
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 4 green cardamoms | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Grind the cumin seeds into a fine powder. Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium low heat and add the oil. When the oil begins to shimmer, add the cardamom pods, and stir fry for about 5 minutes, or until brown. Add the cumin powder and stir until well mixed. Stir in the guacamole, cover the pan, lower the heat to low, and simmer until the guatemalan mixture is thick and smooth. Store in an airtight container.

title: Super Easy Low Fat Whole Wheat Chickpeas & Barley Rellenos
ingredients: 1 package pearl barley or ( 16 ounce ) package zucchini & barley | 1 can chickpeas or ( 16 ounce ) can navy beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Put barley & whole chickpeas in a 9x13 pan and cover with enough cold water to cover. Cook on high heat until water boils and barley is tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Apple Refried Bean Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon apple cider | 1 canned refried beans | 1/2 tablespoon chili pepper, minced | 1 1/2 tablespoons liquid pectin
instructions: Combine ingredients in a small saucepan. Place over low heat and stir until evenly distributed. Set aside to cool. To serve, stir bean mixture into refried beans with a spatula. Serve with chips.

title: Nolan's Smoked Salmon and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1/2 pound smoked salmon, chopped into 1/2 inch pieces | 1/4 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place salmon pieces in a bowl. Place cauliflower florets on top and scatter with remaining ingredients. Place on top rack of oven, and bake 25 minutes, until cauliflower is tender.

Random Ingredients: water,strawberry,red cooking wine,chive,basil pesto,coriander seed,green onion
title: Red Wine and Chilli Pesto W- Strawberries
ingredients: 6 green onions, chopped | 3/4 cup basil pesto | 2 cups water | 1/2 cup red cooking wine | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/2 cup strawberry, sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 180 degrees celsius. Toss all ingredients in a large bowl and place in a large baking tin. Bake for 30 mins. Serve warm with strawberries.

title: Champagne Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 packet lady finger cookies, softened | 1/2 cup chilled dark sweet champagne, divided | 2 tablespoons black coffee, cooled
instructions: Stir together 1/2 the cooled champagne and lady finger biscuits, then spread in a 9 inch clear glass pie dish or clear sponge cake dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 the chilled champagne. Sprinkle with coffee. Refrigerate, covered, for 4 hours or overnight. Run knife along edge of dish and remove from dish. Remove and discard paper towels.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,orange zest,chili pepper flake,wheat bread,vegetable oil,corn chip
title: Chili Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | corn chips | sliced black olives and chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Slice steak diagonally into 1/2 inch thick slices. Combine pepper flakes, zest, mustard and oil. Sprinkle on both sides of steak. Place over boiling water in a bowl. Let stand 45 minutes. Spray grill with nonstick cooking spray, or lightly oil grate. Place steaks on rack, cook 5 minutes, turning once.

Random Ingredients: basil,maraschino cherry,dark rye bread,cream cheese,yellow curry paste,broccoli,basmati rice
title: Thai Curry Rice With Broccoli
ingredients: 1 can sliced ripe broccoli, drained ( reserve liquid ) | 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1/3 cup packed fresh basil, cut into julienne strips ( reserve liquid ) | 1 teaspoon yellow curry paste ( plus additional, if desired, for color ) | 1 small loaf dark rye bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes ( or other firm, crusty, whole wheat bread ) | 3/4 cup prepared maraschino cherry ( drained or not )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Divide broccoli between four small ovenproof dishes, spreading to cover. In mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth. Add reserved liquid and basil, then stir until just mixed. Spread evenly over half the bread cubes. Place 1/2 to 3/4 cup of the cream cheese mixture on top of each layer. Top evenly with the remaining bread cubes. Place baking dish in oven for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with reserved basil. Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Fiesta - Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups long-grain rice | 1 1/4 teaspoons tarragon
instructions: Combine all the ingredients, except rice. Microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring and fluffing before serving.

title: Pork, Capsicum & Eggplant
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 300 ml cream of tartar | 200 ml thickened cream, half and half, half light cream or 200 ml heavy cream | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence ( optional ) | 200 g cooked pork, finely diced ( may substitute with vegetables ) | 1 large red capsicum, finely diced ( bell pepper ), finely diced
instructions: Cut the eggplants into strips about 3 x' x 2. Sprinkle with the cream of tartar on a baking tray, then bake them in a hot oven about 15 minutes, or until slightly darker in colour and tender. Remove them from the oven, then allow them to cool slightly. Cut them into long strips about 3 x' x 2 about 3 x'. Combine the cream with the cream, vanilla and pepper in a bowl and add the eggplants. Mix thoroughly with a metal spoon. Stir the contents of the bowl into the eggplants, cover and leave to stand for 20 mins, or until the flavours have infused into the cream. Serve the pork on top of the eggplants in alternate rows with the peppers and vegetables as an accompaniment.

title: Blueberry Mustard Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups blueberries | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 teaspoon dried chinese basil | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill at least 1 hour. Serve over the warm blueberry mustard.

title: Easy Coconut Truffles
ingredients: 1 cup coconut ( unsweetened ) | 2 cups white truffle oil ( mazola recommended ) | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Heat oil over high heat. Fry coconut till brown and dry. Drain oil. Mix with red pepper flakes, cumin powder and coconut mixture and mix well. Drop in to wet sandwhich, or roll in popcorn kernels. Serve with plain rice, breads, cookies, or for dipping your truffles inches.

title: Molho (Stir-Fry Chile and Serrano Chile Drink)
ingredients: 1 -2 serrano pepper, seeded and chopped, about 1 tbsp | ice
instructions: Combine the chilies and serrano in a blender or food processor with a little water to help smooth them. Blend until finely chopped. Pour drink into pitcher or glass. Garnish with a sprinkling of cilantre and 1 tbsp chopped fresh coriander.

title: Drunk Guinness Stuffed Dates
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dark chocolate | 250 g pitted dates | 250 g guinness stout | 250 g goat cheese | 50 g palm sugar ( optional )
instructions: Chop the dates and goat cheese together. Cut a small hole on each date and hollow out the centre. Remove any pit the dates might have created by taking them out of the fridge. Fill the space with a little guinness then stuff your godmas with the chopped dates and goat cheese mix together. Place a piece of parchment paper along the outer edge of the dates and secure with a tooth pick using a small skewer. Melt the chocolate and pour it over the dates and goat cheese, and set aside. Stuff the dates with the chocolate then put the godmas in the rear of the preheated charcoals at 200f for 15 minutes. When finished, put them in a bowl.

title: Pineapple Banana
ingredients: 2 bananas, sliced | 1 can pineapple chunks in heavy syrup
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Place the bananas in a medium size baking dish. Pour pineapple over bananas. Sprinkle top with paprika and drizzle with reserved syrup. Bake in 375°f oven uncovered for 40 minutes or until golden.

title: Mexican Pizza Rounds (Appetizer Skewers)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons taco sauce, or as desired | 1 tablespoon chopped pistachios ( optional )
instructions: Pour taco sauce into a resealable gallon plastic bag.

title: Sun Dried Tomato Roll
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato | 1 pastry dough, ready rolled | 1 cup broth
instructions: Mix roasting tin into the roasting tin and spread evenly with tomatoes. Roll out pastry into a rectangle and lay across the roasting tin. Spread roasting tin mixture evenly over the pastry and leave to rest for 20 minutes. Spread the broth evenly onto pastry and cut slits across the roll with a sharp knife. Bake in oven at 220 degrees c / 375 degrees f for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and cut. Serve warm with tomato sauce or fresh green herbs.

title: Fresh Peach Salad
ingredients: 1 peach | 1 iceberg lettuce
instructions: Peel the peach and split it carefully in half. Wash lettuce and tear into bite size pieces. Wash, dry and tear the chickelett into bite size pieces. Put all the leaves in a large bowl and dress with olive oil or any other vegitable choice. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Then top with whipped cream and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: jumbo shrimp,vanilla sugar,mustard,turmeric powder,baby spinach,ramen noodle,nut
title: Chinese Spinach Noodle Salad
ingredients: 3 packages ramen noodles | 200 g baby spinach | 1 jumbo shrimp | 1 cup mustard | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar ( to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 2 tablespoons nuts, peanuts, chopped, as desired ( optional )
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of water to boil. Add the ramen noodles and cook until broken down, approximately 2 minutes or until broken up throughly. Drain well and toss with the remaining salad ingredients. Top with nuts. Serve immediately.

title: Kalonji Sweet and Sour Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg pork spareribs | 1 liter vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons kalonji | 1 large yellow onion, finely chopped | 20 g canned pimientos, finely chopped ( or fresh ) | 2 drops vanilla essence
instructions: Cut ribs into smaller size pieces or larger if desired. Put beef stock on slow cooker / crockpot. Add all ingredients. Stir to mix well. Add ribs. Turn to low. Leave for 3 hours. Stir & serve hot. Variation, to increase heat.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,yellow pea,molasses,italian seasoning,ancho chili,chili pepper flake,flour,fish sauce
title: Thai Spicy Peas (Cambodian Peas) With Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 12 ounces red lentils | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ancho chili | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses | 1 small dried chipotle pepper ( or 2 small dried ancho chiles ) | 1/4 cup flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish sauce ( or to taste )
instructions: For dressing, in medium saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Add the beans, chili, pepper flakes, molasses and dried peppers. Saute until the beans are soft and have a slight color of red. Stir in the flour and fish sauce. Keep warm over low heat. Adjust seasonings, if necessary.

title: Nigerian Bamya (Lebanese-Style Okra)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh okra, trimmed | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Wash the okra until you can easily pierce the stem with a sharp knife. Place the ends of the okra on the counter or on the cutting board. Slice off the tips and discard. Lay the okra lengthwise on a clean cutting board. Cut lengthwise into 1/3 inch wide slices. Using a sharp knife, cut a pocket for each slice, cutting into 4 or 5 lengths, resulting in 24 pieces. Squeeze some lemon juice into the pocket to relieve pressure. Place the okra in the center of a large, heavy saucepan or dutch oven. Add enough water to just cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cover, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Do not stir the vegetables. Simmer for 15 minutes longer. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,baby portabella mushroom,russet potato,mutton mince
title: Lamb and Mince Stew
ingredients: 600 g baby portabella mushrooms, sliced | 3 russet potatoes, chopped | 500 g mutton mince | 400 g pinto beans
instructions: Put the mushrooms, potatoes, mince and beans in a pan with a lid. Add water as much as you need to cover. Allow to simmer over a low heat for at least 45 minutes. Stir the stew through it's broth with a fork. You may need to add the beef or lamb at this stage.

title: Brine Rabbit
ingredients: 1 head garlic, with just peeled and sliced paper thin ( this can be done by using a jar ) | 10 tablespoons olive oil | 10 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f and place cleaned garlic on a piece of wax paper lined cake rack. Drizzle olive oil and white wine vinegar over the garlic, then cover, place in preheated oven and bake until a light golden brown, about 50 minutes.

title: Green Phyllo Leaves
ingredients: 32 fresh seedless grapes leaves ) | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 3/4 cup coarsely chopped fresh cilantro ( optional )
instructions: Place whole grapes leaves, aniseed, and cilantro in a food processor.

title: Roasted Sausage and Potato Rounds
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dry mustard seed | 1 1/4 cups cumin seeds | 1 1/8 lbs red potatoes | 1 lb small sausage, cooked and cut in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Place dry mustard seeds, ground cumin seeds, potatoes, and sausage in a large, heavy baking dish, breaking up clumps, stirring to combine. Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle with salt. Bake about 20 minutes or until potatoes are golden and well browned. Enjoy.

title: Quinoa and Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup chopped green olives | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and toss until coated. Serve immediately.

title: Mom's Salad
ingredients: 4 ripe plum tomatoes, seeded and cut into thirds | 2 hard-cooked eggs, peeled and sliced | 1 pinch mustard powder | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tortillas, or as needed
instructions: Arrange tomatoes, eggs, and a pinch of mustard powder in a salad bowl. Sprinkle almond extract and prepared mustard over the salad. Cover with a cloth towel and refrigerate for about 20 minutes to marinate. Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,green pepper,cauliflower floret,coriander powder,beef chuck,turkey
title: Danish Beef With Cauliflower (Kibbegrot) Corn Chips & Coriander (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 2-inch chunks ( or ground turkey ) | 1 medium cauliflower floret | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 green pepper, sliced | 1/4 lb ground turkey | 1/4 cup corn chips, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Mix together coriander, chili powder and beef. Place meat in a large bowl with cauliflower. Add half of spices and half of green pepper slices. Toss everything together and coat all sides with it. Arrange them in 11 x 7 baking dish. Top with 1/2 c ground turkey and top with remaining spices. Sprinkle with corn chips, if desired. Bake in preheated oven for about 25 minutes, until meat and cauliflower are cooked.

title: Fabulously Easy Pizza
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated pizza crust | 1 package frozen peas | 1 package frozen green beans, thawed and drained | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Place frozen peas and green beans in a microwave safe bowl, and microwave on high for 3 minutes, stirring half way through the cooking. Drain, but do not rinse. Spread the peas to within 1/2 inch of the edges of the pizza crust. Distribute the green beans evenly over the peas, then sprinkle the flour over all of the greenbeans. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, remove from the oven, and immediately sprinkle the top of the pizza with the cooked green beans. Return to the oven, and return to the oven for 5 more minutes, or just until the crust is browned.

title: Pita Chips
ingredients: 2 pita bread rounds, or as needed, cut into wedges | 1 slice thinly sliced prosciutto, or as needed
instructions: Place pita bread wedges in a dry skillet. Cook and flip about 3 seconds per side, turning once. Drain on paper towels. Spread each wedge with prosciutto slices, and sandwich with bread wedges.

title: Lebanese Burger
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts | 1/2 cup wheat germ | 1/4 cup pomegranate seeds | 1/4 lb ground sirloin
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except pomegranate seeds. Divide among 8 patties. Spread with pomegranate seeds. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit, covered, for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Homemade Honey
ingredients: 3 quarts honey | 2 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: Warm honey in a small saucepan over medium heat. When almost to the boiling point, stir in fennel seeds. Allow to simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Transfer to sterile containers and cool.

title: Cappuccino Macaroni With a Spicy Kick - Copycat Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb penne ( i used barilla brand ) | 1/4 cup hot espresso | 1 cup sprite | 1 package taco seasoning mix ( 1 cup or more ) | 12 ounces macaroni | 1 -2 serrano pepper | 3 tablespoons pickles, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cook penne according to package directions. Drain pasta, rinse in cool water and reserve 4 cups cooking liquid. In a large mixing bowl, add hot espresso. Mix thoroughly. Add sprite, taco seasoning mix, and drained pasta. Stir well. Drain pasta into serving bowl, add desired amount of reserved liquid, and stir. Divide and sprinkle on top of the spicy mix. Add chopped serrano peppers on top, if desired. Chill for at least an hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,dill,fine breadcrumb,beef chuck,greek seasoning,coconut flake
title: Coconut Balls the Real One
ingredients: 6 lbs ground beef chuck | 1 1/2 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup desiccated coconut flakes | 4 tablespoons all purpose greek seasoning | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds
instructions: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix chuck, dry crumbs, coconut, greek seasoning, dill and sesame seeds. Heat a dutch oven or other very large pot over low heat. Shape 2 tablespoons of the mince mixture into 3/4 inch balls and roll in coconut crumbs. Brown meat balls on all sides at medium heat, about 10 minutes in all. Do not add any oil. Remove meatball from the oil to a baking dish. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: egg,ice water,tahini,coriander seed,mexican cheese,heavy whipping cream
title: Gourmet Mexican Inspired Egg Tarts
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1/4 cup crushed coriander seed | 1 can crushed mexican cheese blend | 4 cups ice water | 2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Mix the eggs, tahini, coriander seeds and cheese until blended and foamy. Pour in the ice water and stir until smooth. Pour 2 tbsp on each tart shell. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes until just set and beginning to brown. Let stand 2 - 3 minutes before removing from the oven. Serve with cream.

title: Spinach Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 lb spinach leaves, cleaned and coarsely chopped | 1/2 lb floury potato, peeled, washed and cut into chunks | 2 -3 ounces horseradish, grated ( see note )
instructions: Bring 8 quarts of salted water to a boil in a large pot. When the water comes to a boil, add the potatoes and cook them gently over medium high heat for about 5 - 7 minutes, until they are tender but not mushy. Drain the gnocchi and stir them into the boiling water. Cook them over medium heat for about 10 minutes. Ladle into warmed soup bowls, sprinkle with horseradish and serve.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,arborio rice,prosciutto,italian tomato,cayenne,savoy cabbage,cajun seasoning,vegetable stock
title: Spinach Soup
ingredients: 250 milliliters vegetable stock | 1/2 kg savoy cabbage, shredded | 6 tablespoons arborio rice | 1 pinch cayenne | 1 pinch cajun seasoning | 200 g prosciutto, cut into small pieces | 2 cans italian-style tomatoes | 3 -5 slices italian bread, toasted and cut into cubes ( optional )
instructions: In a large pan over medium heat, bring the vegetable stock and cabbage to the boil. Reduce the heat to low, and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Add the rice and seasonings. Cover, and continue cooking 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Do not allow the liquid to come to a boil. Stir in the prosciutto pieces and tomatoes. If it is too thick, add a little of the hot vegetable stock. Continue cooking 10 minutes, stirring regularly.

Random Ingredients: marsala,sherry wine vinegar,beef brisket,red pepper flake,yoghurt,filling,soymilk,onion
title: Beez's Beef Brisket
ingredients: 10 pounds beef brisket | 8 cups plain soymilk | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1/3 cup sweet onion, sliced | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or to taste ( optional ) | 1/3 can or bottle greek style clarified butter, or to taste
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate. Place brisket on the grill, close lid, and cook for 1 hour. Turn meat, close lid, and continue cooking until meat temperature reaches 145 degrees f when pierced with a knife, about 1 hour more. Remove meat from heat and cover with foil. Let meat rest for 15 minutes. Reserve remaining cooking liquid. Using 2 forks, shred meat and return to cooking liquid. In a bowl, mix the soy milk, sherry vinegar, and yogurt. Season with onion, red pepper flakes, and red pepper flakes. Heat clarified butter in a skillet over low heat. Slowly add mixture, and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Ladle some of the sauce over meat, and serve on a platter. Repeat with remaining sauce and meat.

title: French Peanut Soup With Peanuts
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups green beans, trimmed and cut into thirds ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 cup nonfat beef broth | 2 teaspoons vanilla beans, split ( or 1 teaspoon sugar ) | 4 tablespoons dry roasted salted peanut, chopped coarsely
instructions: Over medium heat, put the green beans into a pot and add the broth, the vanilla beans. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for about 30 minutes. Just before you're ready to serve the soup, add the peanuts. Serve immediately.

title: Halloumi and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 3 cups short-grain rice, rinsed and drained | 2/3 cup halloumi cheese or 2/3 cup baccala cheese
instructions: Add the seasoning to the drained rice and place into a large non stick frying pan. Place the pan into the oven and cook for 10 minutes or until the cheese has melted and appears bubbly. Turn off the oven and quickly spread the rice on the pan. Spread the cheese on top and leave for a further 15 - 20 minutes. Serve with a green salad or mixed vegetables.

title: Cheesy Mexican Meat Dip
ingredients: 1 lb ground meat | 1/2 red onion, diced | 1 package mexican cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Brown meat.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,italian seasoning,golden brown sugar,fish fillet,red chile,tomato paste
title: Grilled Fish With Spicy Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups peeled plum tomatoes, finely chopped | 1 cup tomato paste | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1/3 cup golden brown sugar | 1/4 cup red chile, finely chopped | 2 lbs fish fillets, cut into chunks
instructions: Combine tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, chiles, and seasoning in a large non reactive bowl. Cover and marinate overnight at room temperature or up to 24 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat grill. Drain fish and pat dry with paper towels. Spray broiler rack with cooking oil. Grill fillets for 5 to 7 minutes on each side, or until fish is firm and opaque. Turn and grill 10 minutes or until fish is just cooked through, basting fish with remaining tomato mixture. Serve fish hot with spicy tomato sauce.

title: Sausage for Grilled Pork and Biscuit
ingredients: 600 g pork ( streaky or lean ground ) | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Heat grill to medium. Line barbecue plate with tin foil or paper towel and place pork on foil or parchment paper lined tray, fat side down. Sprinkle with parsley and press over the surface of the sausages. Grill sausages, turning occasionally, for about 8 minutes, or until cooked through. Remove pork from heat. Grill biscuit.

title: Smoked Mackerel and Pear Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked mackerel | 1/2 lb pork | 1/2 ripe pear, peeled and coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley coarsley | 1 package of chopped fresh pears, with some juice | 1 tablespoon corn oil or 1 tablespoon melted butter | 1 tablespoon hungarian sweet paprika | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Mix the ingredients for the marinade and allow them to marinade in the refrigerator overnight. Remove the pears and cut them into 3 to 4 pieces lengthwise. Remove the membrane from the mackerel, clean well, remove pin fins and bones. Cut into 2 to 3 inch pieces. Slice the smoked mackerel into 2 inch square pieces. Heat the pork and pears over high heat. Add the chopped pears and smoked mackerel and stir fry. Add the cayenne and paprika. Mix well. Add the marinade and pears. Add the corn oil or butter if you have it and bring to a boil. Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,onion powder,swiss cheese,celery salt,red lentil,ginger,green chilies
title: Lentil & Swiss Dip
ingredients: 1 cup yellow onion | 1 cup sour red lentil | 1 cup swiss cheese | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon ginger
instructions: Mince onion, slice swiss cheese and place in crock pot. Mince celery salt, add into mixture. Add can of green chilies, onion powder, ginger. Put crock pot on high for a couple of hours and then turn to low for 4 hours. Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,horseradish,rosemary,green bean,gruyere cheese,sage leaf,red cherry
title: Green Beans With Smothered Pork and Rosemary
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary, minced | 8 ounces green beans, trimmed | 8 ounces pork shoulder, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup gruyere cheese, shredded | 1 tablespoon horseradish, prepared, drained | 24 small dried red cherries | 1 sprig fresh rosemary | 2 tablespoons fresh sage leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh horseradish, prepared
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f. Spread the rosemary on a baking sheet and place on the oven rack. Roast until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Remove rosemary. Toss the green beans and the pork in a large plastic bag and toss with the cheese, horseradish and dried cherries. Arrange the green bean mixture on a large platter and place the sage leaves around the green bean mixture. Serve.

title: Veggies Saganaki
ingredients: 1 bag kohlrabi | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 1/4 cups sliced spanish onions or 1 1/4 cups other sweet onions | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 50 -75 g crumbled blue cheese ( to garnish )
instructions: Slice kohlrabi lengthwise in 1/4 inch slices. Stack slices, then trim to fit into a casserole dish. Microwave honey with onions in a small bowl on high power for 1 - 2 minutes. Add maple syrup and stir to mix thoroughly. Dip slice into honey mixture, then coat with crumbled blue cheese. Pour remaining half of honey mixture over slice and bake, uncovered, in 375 degree f oven for 20 minutes or until lightly toasted. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: vegetable shortening,corn bread mix,polish sausage,cocoa powder
title: Polish Chocolate Bread Mix
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons vegetable shortening | 2 packages polish sausage | 1 package corn bread mix | 1 tablespoon unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Prepare a large loaf pan using the following instructions on package. While the loaf pans are preheating, in a medium size saucepan, melt the butter and shortening over heat. Remove from heat when melted and stir in the sausage. Cool for 30 minutes or until it is room temperature. Stir in the corn bread mix. Mix well. Roll out between two sheets of wax paper and cut into pieces about 3/4 to 1 inch square. Place on prepared pan. Sprinkle cocoa on top. Set aside in refrigerator until set. Cut into slices.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,cream cheese,snow pea,zucchini,beef rib,rice wine
title: Stir Fried Beef Rib Tacos With Snowpeas and Chipotle Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef short rib, cut in 6-7 pieces | 1 teaspoon minced chipotle chile | 8 ounces cream cheese, cubed | 1 teaspoon rice wine | 1/2 lb zucchini, sliced | 12 ounces snow peas
instructions: Prepare grill for high heat. In medium bowl, place the beef with all marinade ingredients. Using a fork or potato masher, mash the ingredients until blended. Transfer to bowl with the beef. Thread the beef onto the bamboo skewers, accordion style or using toothpicks. Set aside marinade. Prepare grill for direct high heat. Remove twine and grill the beef until just cooked through. Serve with snowpeas and sour cream. Servings should be served at least 3 diners. Time does not include soaking time.

Random Ingredients: lamb,bourbon,white vinegar,liquid seasoning,green bean,mandarin orange peel,cardamom
title: Lamb Salad With Sour Cream Vinaigrette
ingredients: 12 mandarin oranges or 12 mandarin orange peels | 1 lb lamb, cut into thin bite size pieces | 1/2 lb of fresh green beans | 1/2 lb fresh green beans | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup liquid seasoning | 3 tablespoons bourbon
instructions: Chop the mandarin oranges up into bite sized pieces. Soak them in hot water for 1/3 an hour until pliable and remove from water. Skewer the beef and green beans. Add the orange, lamb, green beans, cardamom and vinegar to the pan. Bring it to a boil and cook until meat juices run clear. About 4 minutes. Drain off the fat. Stir in liquid spice, bourbon and mix well.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,beef chuck,pork butt,wide egg noodle
title: Beef and Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 1 pound fresh wide egg noodles, uncooked | 1 pound lean beef chuck, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, oil reserved | 2 pounds boneless pork butt, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Cook egg noodles in a pot of boiling salted water until cooked through but firm, about 5 minutes. Drain and cool in cold water. Set aside. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat with a lid. Stir in beef, and cook until pork has turned dark brown. Stir in sun dried tomato. Cut noodles into halves, and heat in skillet with reserved sun dried tomato oil. Stir meat into contents of skillet.

title: Potatoes and Snow Peas with Noodles
ingredients: 4 potatoes, thinly sliced | 8 ounces fresh snow peas, trimmed | 1 head romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1 cup thousand island salad dressing
instructions: In a large bowl, make a bed of potatoes. Rinse and pat dry. Arrange the snow peas in an even layer on the bed of potatoes. Place the romaine onto the bed of snow peas. Drizzle the salad dressing on top. Use only enough to cover and not cover. If planning on serving cold, cover and store in the refrigerator for several hours to develop the flavors before serving.

title: Pumpkin Buttermilk Dressing
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Blend pumpkin puree with buttermilk with a blender or food processor. Pour into a container and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,rom tomato,herb,pork roast,guinness stout,chickpea,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Chana's Savoury Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs roma tomatoes, depending on how large and thick you want them to be | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 lb ground pork roast or 1 lb ground beef | 1 can guinness stout ( optional ) | chopped herbs | parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Take one tomato and cut to about 1/8 inch thick slices then cut off and reserve the next 4. Use a small knife or knife a little to scrape out the stem and seeds of the tomatoes. If you are using a can of guinness, it will be easier to loosen the tomato from the end of cooking so a spoon can remove easily if it begins to float. Slice the tomato and the inside of the tomato, cutting about 1/8 inch off the top and bottom. Remove the pulp from the rind and any remaining pith. Place the tomato shells in a bowl containing the icing sugar. Brown the meat in a pan in the leftover juice from the tomatoes. Once browned, place the meat and juices in the bowl, as well as the guinness. Strain and place in the fridge to chill. When the shells are cool, stuff with meat and garnish with the chopped herbs and a little generous parmigiano reggiano. These are delicious with mashed potatoes, pasta or bread.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,chinese cabbage,red pepper,jalapeno serrano pepper,pear,yellow pea,garlic clove
title: Lagout (Peas and Pear Stew)
ingredients: 1 lb dried yellow pea | 2 lbs chinese cabbage, shredded | 1 large red pepper, cut into 1 inch dice | 2 jalapeno serrano peppers, sliced | 2 large garlic cloves, minced | 3 fresh limes, juice of or 3 lemons, juice of, divided | 1/2 teaspoon ground red pepper | 1 fresh pear, peeled cored and quartered
instructions: Combine peas with enough water to cover.

title: Coconut and Sun-Dried Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato, diced | 1/2 brown onion, diced | 1/2 cup chopped dates
instructions: Combine coconut milk, vegetable broth, sun dried tomatoes, onion and dates in a pot. Cook, stirring frequently, over medium heat for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Ragu Peppers Con Porcini
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated ditalini pasta | 1 tablespoon ground porcini mushrooms | 1 yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Welsh Cider Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Gently fry the onions in a small amount of olive oil. Combine worcestershire sauce and chopped onions. Serve with hot cooked, buttered noodles or your favorite hot dinner rolls.

Random Ingredients: honey,chicken stock cube,garam masala powder,pink lemonade concentrate,green enchilada sauce
title: Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 250 ml fresh pink lemonade concentrate | 2 green enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon honey | 3 -4 cups of your favorite chicken stock cube | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder
instructions: Add honey, garlic& chicken cubes to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Heat up the green enchilada sauce to desired consistency. Once hot pour sauce into a blender and pulse until combined. Add some green enchilada sauce to a saucepan and cook for a few minutes, until the sauce thickens up a bit. Season with a bit more garam masala if wanted.

Random Ingredients: corn,ricotta cheese,chicken,lemongrass,coco lopez,black olive,apple cider vinegar
title: Lemongrass Chicken Salad (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 11 )
ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass, halved lenghtways | 1/4 cup light coconut milk or 1/4 cup fat-free coconut cream | 3 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons shredded coconut, toasted | 1 1/2 cups chopped roasted chicken | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese | 1 apple cider vinegar | 400 g canned mixed corn, drained ( about 3 cups ) | 1/2 cup black olives, halved ( about 4 ounces )
instructions: Place lemon grass and 2 tbsp coconut milk in a non metal bowl and season with salt and pepper. Leave for 10 minutes to soften. Using the tip of a sharp knife, gently loosen the base of the lemongrass stalk and gently separate the stalks from its meat. Then cut the lemon grass into long thin strips. Drain the chicken. Place chicken into a large bowl and add the remaining 1/4 cup coconut milk or fat free coconut cream, 1 tbsp grated cheddar or 1 tbsp grated coconut, remaining shredded coconut, lemongrass, and coconut. Add vinegar and mix well. Add the remaining 3/4 cup coconut vinegar and mix well. Add the olives and mix gently. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 2 days.

title: Pumpkin Sandwich Rollups
ingredients: 2 cans pumpkin | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 cans fusilli | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 4 ounces gorgonzola | iceberg lettuce
instructions: First you have to boil the pumpkin and boil until easily pierced with a fork. This should take around 25 minutes. While you are waiting for the pumpkin to boil, slice the iceberg lettuce into little shreds. I like to use a mandolin. Once both the pumpkin and the iceberg lettuce are done, pour 1/4 cup of cold water in a pan, add the cocoa powder and mix well. Once the pumpkin has boiled, remove from heat. You should now have something which you can place in your hand. It's your hand, the dough should now be sticking out and your hand getting messy. Take another bowl and a plate and a bowl. Fill a bowl with ice, water and some oil, your hands, your palms, and anything else you'll throw up. This mixture is important for making this tasty and healthy sandwich. Divide and place into your hands the mixture of pumpkin and iceberg lettuce and coat in the mixture of cocoa and water. This is important with practice, the more the less messy you will be able to handle. It's even better after a few hours. Once the pumpkin has boiled, remove from heat. Dip your hands in cocoa and water, you should now have a nice rectangle of pizza, approx 8 x you should now have a nice plate going out to take the mixture out of the bowl and onto the plate. Once you've gotten both pizzas out of the bowl and out of the bowl, lay them out and place on top of each other in the order listed,. Take a bowl and wrap your palm around the outside of the plate, squeezing your hands a bit to prevent your mixture from sticking and turning. The thinner the circle it will be, the easier it will look. Take your plate from the pizza and place in the centre of the plate. This allows for spreading out the mixture a bit easier. Then take your spoon and use your fingers to roll up one hand and then your hands, rolling it a bit thicker so it'll stick and the lighter it is. After a couple minutes, take your plate from the pizza and take some forks and dip your fist in cocoa powder and water and roll up the entire plate, now it's going to go in the centre of the plate and tuck in the ends. Take your plate to the table, slice up some good quality olives for garnish and eat it plain. You can also slice it as you wish if you like. Enjoy.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Sherry Wine Marinade for Lamb or Beef
ingredients: 1 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 2 tablespoons sherry wine ( preferably an aromatic dry red wine )
instructions: Place sun dried tomatoes on a serving plate and top with sherry. Use sauce for pork, beef and chicken.

title: Easy Pea Mornay
ingredients: 2 cups frozen frozen green peas | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 tablespoon powdered feta ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons wine ( or more to taste )
instructions: Place frozen peas in a pot with cold water. Bring water to a boil over medium high heat. Boil 2 - 3 minutes. Add chili powder, stir, and cover. Reduce heat and simmer for 8 - 10 minutes or until peas are tender. Stir in feta and stir to coat peas. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: cod fish fillet,leek,pecorino romano cheese,hard egg,olive,agave nectar,orange bell pepper,turnip
title: Mediterranean Cod With Turnips, Olives and Agave
ingredients: 1 bunch olive | 1 cup olive oil or 1 cup ghee | 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2 medium turnips, grated ( or 1 large yellow pepper ) | 2 large leeks, washed and chopped | 2 orange bell peppers, stemmed, seeded and sliced | 2 medium cod fish fillets, cut in to 2 equal pieces | 6 hard-boiled eggs, sliced horizontally
instructions: Place the olives in a glass bowl and pour the olive oil and cold water over them.

title: Mom's Slow Cooker Sausage Stew
ingredients: 1/2 pound ground sirloin or hot italian sausage | 1 can stewed mexican-style tomatoes | 1 can no-salt-added diced tomatoes with jalapenos, undrained
instructions: Place sausage and stewed tomatoes into the bottom of a 5 quart slow cooker. Cover, and cook on low for 7 - 8 hours. With 3 1/2 cups water if needed. Drain juice into a measuring cup if mixture seems dry.

title: Vegetable Packets
ingredients: 16 new potatoes, scrubbed, boiled until just soft, about 6 minutes | 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated nutmeg | lettuce leaf
instructions: Heat grill. Place potatoes in a large bowl and sprinkle with salt and nutmeg. Place on the grill rack and cook turning once, until just tender and crisp around the edges, about 12 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a large, warmed serving dish, drizzle with olive oil and fold in lettuce leaves. Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,tomato soup,chicken broth,green apple,lettuce leaf
title: Green Apple Soup
ingredients: 15 ounces condensed tomato soup ( i like amy's ) | 20 ounces tomato sauce ( i use hunts ) | 4 small green apples ( peeled, cored, quartered and cut in half ) | 3/4 cup chicken broth | 4 shredded lettuce leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a sauce pan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until apples are softened and soup reduced some of its volume. Serve hot, topped with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: sriracha sauce,white bread,pumpkin seed,tomato juice,bacon,cilantro,tapioca flour,cardamom pod
title: Thai Sweet Bacon and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 500 g firm bacon | 15 cardamom pods | 75 ml tomato juice ( about ) | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour ( i like corn starch ) | 75 g fresh cilantro, leaves picked | 3 slices white bread, toasted ( i use greek bread ) | 1/2 teaspoon tapioca flour ( i like to use corn starch ) | 1/2 teaspoon sriracha sauce ( i like to use thai sweet chili paste ) | 1/2 - 1 cup pumpkin seeds
instructions: In a pot fry bacon. I cook it on medium high until the bacon starts to crisp and is browned, about 12 minutes depending on the bacon you are using. Remove to paper towel lined plate and drain all the bacon fat and set aside. Toast bread. Place toast in microwavable container. Heat on high until golden, about 1 minute. Remove to bowl. Add broth to the toast and let stand for 2 minutes. Add tapioca and sriracha to soup. Stir frequently. Pork should be cooked and bacon nice and crispy. Add tomato juice to the soup and heat up. If you have an immersion blender, you can do this with the blade. Garnish soup with cilantro and a drizzle of sriracha. Top with pumpkin seeds. I use a little of each of the above. Enjoy this is such a good lunch, that you will use all your favourite things at the end.

title: Easy Beef Tenderloin for Crock Pot
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef tenderloin steaks | creole seasoning | garlic chives
instructions: Trim fat from tenderloin. Cut slits on all sides of tenderloin. Combine creole seasoning and about a 1/2 cup water that can be added to mixture. Place tenderloin in crock pot. Sprinkle with salt and garlic chives. Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours or on high 4 - 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,orange juice,grape tomato,pine nut,liquid smoke flavoring,pearl barley,nonfat plain yogurt
title: Barley With Orange, Grape Tomatoes and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1/3 cup pearl barley, uncooked ( about 1/3 cup pearl barley and 1/3 cup pearl barley ) | 1 1/2 cups reduced-sodium vegetable stock ( or any stock ) | 1/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt ( optional ) or 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 can diced grape tomatoes, drained well ( reserve juice ) | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, lightly toasted and chopped
instructions: Combine the bulgur and the stock in a medium saucepan, bring to a boil.

title: Dark Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 3 ounces dark chocolate, chopped | 300 ml white wine
instructions: Melt chocolate by stirring it with a fork. Add white wine, stirring and allow to reduce for 4 - 5 minutes. Serve on your favourite pasta.

title: Potato Salad With Pine Nuts, Smoked Tomato & Pepperoni
ingredients: 6 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled, scrubbed, washed | 1/4 lb smoked provolone cheese | 3 medium tomatoes | 6 tablespoons pine nuts, lightly toasted ( dry or toasted, see illustration below ) | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/2 cup salad oil | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cut the potatoes lengthwise in half and scoop out the center. Spread them out flat and cut them into 6 wedges each. Cut the cheese into 1/2 inch cubes. Top with the potato wedges and serve immediately.

title: Beef Brisket and Pita Sandwiches
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef brisket ( or beef roast ) | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | dry sherry | 3 pita bread, rounds | sour cream | 8 ounces chow mein noodles
instructions: Put brisket in a large crockpot. Pour both cans of creamy mushroom soup over. Slice brisket against grain. Layer beef and sauce in pita rounds. Top with sour cream and chow mein noodles. Serve immediately. Enjoy.

title: Chicken Enchilada
ingredients: 1 can chicken meat | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( chili powder con carne )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium sauce pan. Place over medium heat and continue cooking until chicken is cooked through. Enjoy.

title: Pork Chops and Chocolate
ingredients: 4 pork chops, 3/4 inch thick | 2 eggs | 3/4 cup apricot preserves ( i like to use raspberry jam ) or 3/4 cup melted semi-sweet chocolate chips ( i like to use raspberry jam ) | 1/3 cup marmalade | 1 whole chocolate chip | 2 tablespoons canned tomato soup, undiluted ( campbell's ) | 1 large ladyfinger ( optional ) | 1 cup coarsely chopped mixed dried fruit
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients together in large bowl. Dip pork chops in mixture and arrange in pan in a single layer.
