Remove pork chops from the pan and arrange on platter. While still hot, spoon hot jam over and sprinkle with grated chocolate. Serve warm.

title: Japanese Beef With Radishes(Kareen)
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs of thin sliced beef | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 -2 bunch of thin sliced radish
instructions: Slice beef into very thin slices about 1/8 or so. Sprinkle all sides with rice vinegar then pour water over them and let soak for 30 minutes. Boil with vegetables and eat as you normally would with soy sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,pork shoulder,kielbasa,linguine,rice bran oil,lemon
title: Sesame Coated Pork Shoulder Pasta With Kielbasa
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, trimmed | 1 1/2 cups low-fat rice bran oil | 1 1/2 lbs thin-cut kielbasa | 1/2 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 lb linguine or 1 lb linguine, of your choice
instructions: Place pork shoulder in a large resealable plastic bag. Stir in rice bran and coat pork evenly. Turn pork several times to coat evenly with bran and transfer to an airtight container. Let marinade at room temperature 1 to 2 hours. Place kielbasa in a large stainless steel or enamel coated frying pan, add dark sesame oil and water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 45 minutes. If necessary, cover pan and continue cooking until pork is very tender when pierced with a skewer, about 15 minutes longer, adding water if pan becomes dry while cooking. Remove kielbasa from water. Cut into 1/2 inch slices and set aside. Turn on broiler. Set oven rack 6 inches from broiler element and preheat broiler. Broil pork 10 to 14 minutes until brown on all sides. Turn over and broil 2 to 3 minutes longer or until cooked all the way through. Meanwhile, cook linguelle in boiling water with salt according to package directions. Drain. Serve kielbasa over linguelle, drizzling with dark sesame oil. Enjoy.

title: Roasted Eggplant (Aubergine) (Melitzanes Kounoupithi)
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants | 1/2 cup lemon juice or 1/2 cup lime juice
instructions: Slice each eggplant into 4 to 5 slices lengthwise. Arrange slices on a large baking sheet and sprinkle lightly with salt. Roast in a 400 degree f oven for about 20 minutes or until nicely browned and tender. Brush with the lemon juice. Roast eggplant slices as a main salad, or as an antipasto.

title: Spicy Kale
ingredients: 1 tablespoon whole cardamom seed | 4 bunches fresh kale | 20 fluid ounces grenadine
instructions: Heat a large pan over direct heat. Add the cardamom seeds to the pan, and toast 1 minute. Remove from the heat, and set aside for 10 minutes or until fragrant. Set the pan aside. Steam the kale for 3 to 5 minutes, or until just wilted. Meanwhile, pour the grenadine into a small saucer. Dip each piece of kale in the grenadine, then remove from the pan and let excess drip off. Once the pan has reached a smoking point, drop in the kale. Cook, stirring frequently, until the greens are bright green and limp, about 1 minute. Serve in warm soup bowls.

Random Ingredients: boston lettuce,barbecue sauce,beef bouillon cube,watercress leaf,russet potato
title: Beef, Potato and Watercress Rolls
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled | 1 beef bouillon cube | 3 tablespoons watercress leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 2 cups shredded lettuce, preferably red leaf and greens
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high. Slice potato lengthwise into 4 long, thin strips about 1/8 inch wide and 1/8 inch thick. Place potato on a baking sheet and drizzle with bouillon and watercress. Bake at 450 degrees f. For 15 minutes or until potatoes are soft. Remove from oven, drizzle with 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce, and turn with a spatula to turn potato over. Place lettuce leaves on the potato, and fold each one in half diagonally.

title: Spicy Thai Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons minced shallots | 1/2 cup minced scallion | 1 tablespoon minced fresh fruit cocktail | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/2 teaspoon oyster sauce
instructions: Stir minced shallots, scallion, dried fruit cocktail, and milk in small bowl. Let stand 30 minutes. Stir with a fork.

title: Green Chilies (Yogurt)
ingredients: 3 bunches green chili peppers, slit lengthwise | 3 cups low-fat yogurt, stirred until mixed well
instructions: Put the chili peppers in a blender, add the yogurt and blend until the chilies are thoroughly chopped. Serve either warm or cold.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,self raising flour,tart apple,strawberry,green pepper,pistachio,coriander seed,shrimp
title: Fruit and Nut Loaf (Upside Down)
ingredients: 2 cups strawberries ( or more if you want them softer ) | 1 teaspoon coriander seed | 2 medium tart apples | 1 green pepper ( optional ) | 100 g self raising flour | 1/4 cup pistachios | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 150 g cooked shrimp
instructions: Wash berries and peel core off apples if need be. Slice into wedges and place on greased oven proof dishes. Dice pepper and nuts and add to apple and coriander. Stir in flour and coat well with soya sauce. Sprinkle over chopped pistachios, if using. Bake in pre heated 180c oven for 40 mins, basting twice, until well browned. Serve hot.

title: English and Canadian Melt
ingredients: 6 slices american cheese ( or your favorite cheese ) | 6 slices cheddar | 6 tablespoons cornflour | 6 tablespoons cornflour | 6 fluid ounces leeks, shredded ( white part only ) | 6 whole cardamom pods | 6 whole nutmegs, crushed
instructions: Heat oven to 150c. Divide cheese between four serving dish. Sprinkle over leeks. Combine cornflour with 1 tbsp cold water, add to cheese mixture and stir until thickened. Sprinkle with crushed cardamom pods and nutmeg. Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Hot Guacamole
ingredients: 1/2 cup vidalia onion | 1/2 cup broccoli floret | 1/2 cup small fresh asparagus | 1 chipotle pepper
instructions: Prepare grill. Mix vidalia, broccoli, and asparagus together in a bowl. Cut chipotle pepper into thin slices and add in with vegetables. Cover and let stand for 10 - 15 minutes or more. Serve in large bowl with spanish rice.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, with skin ( each piece about 3/4 inch thick ) | 4 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 6 1/2 ounces olives ( pitted and halved ) | 2 packages israeli couscous
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. If you have any leftover chicken, the broth should be left in the pan. Cut slits into the chicken and stuff the prosciutto slices on top. Place the chicken on a jelly roll pan. If you don� t have a jelly roll pan, just lay a piece of parchment paper on it and place in a freezer. If you have any leftover broth, it should marinate the chicken for up to 12 hours bake chicken for about 25 minutes, or until cooked through. Add broth to the couscous right before serving. Slice the chicken breast against the grain so the slices will stand up in the broth and be easier to remove the skin. When chicken is done, you can transfer to a serving platter and pour the broth in the pan. Serve with slivered israeli olives and the remaining broth.

title: Yogurt and Potato Balls
ingredients: 2 cups mashed potatoes flakes | 1/2 teaspoon lemon extract | 3 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Blend all ingredients with a mixer until smooth. Cover and chill overnight.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,red onion,italian bread,salt water,spaghetti,plum tomato,polenta
title: Polenta and Tomato Salad With Lettuce
ingredients: 3/4 cup polenta | 1/4 cup iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1 plum tomato, chopped | 1/2 small red onion, finely chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups iceberg lettuce, coarsely shredded, for garnish | salt in water | 14 1/2 ounces spaghetti, cooked and drained ( preferably with zesty italian salsa )
instructions: Bring 3/4 cup water to boil in medium size nonreactive saucepan. Turn off heat and add polenta. Stir until well mixed, then bring mixture to boil. Stir over low heat until thickened, about 45 - 60 minutes or until slightly reduced and polenta is firm but firm enough to hold shape. Meanwhile, add remaining ingredients, stirring just enough to combine. Serve warm or chilled, sprinkling additional zesty italian salsa on top.

title: Paneer Tarkari
ingredients: 300 g quinoa | 400 g creamed whole milk ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Wash and drain the quinoa thoroughly then place it in a deep sieve, and rub excess water off into the sieve with your fingers. Squeeze the excess water out of the quinoa using your fingers, and place the quinoa into a sieve over a bowl. Combine the creamed ricotta and garlic paste and whisk well together with the dry quinoa. The tarkari will keep for several days in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,pillsbury,cannellini bean,black eyed pea,chicken breast half,japanese eggplant
title: Japanese Eggplant Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 large japanese eggplant, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 can small black-eyed peas, drained | 1 can chicken breast halves, cut into strips | 1 container heavy cream | 1 package pillsbury refrigerated all-butter flavored crayons
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f. In a 9x12 inch baking dish, spread half of the bean cannellini beans, black eyed peas, chicken, cream and the remaining beans. Arrange the crayons evenly over the top, being careful to not get them touching. Bake in preheated oven until the crayons begin to crisp and the mixture bubbles, 30 to 40 minutes. You may also bake the pillsbury refrigerated classic for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Use a knife to serve warm.

title: Broccoli Saute
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh broccoli florets, washed | 1 medium head broccoli floret | 1/2 cup cognac | 2 small red plums, cut into 1/4 inch cubes
instructions: Bring 2 quarts of salted water to a boil in a large cooking pot. Add the broccoli, cover and cook until bright green and just tender. While the broccoli is cooking, place the remaining 1/2 cup of grana padano in a small bowl. When the broccoli is tender, drain and pat dry with paper towels. Transfer the broccoli to the bowl with the grated cheese and stir to mix. Add the cognac and stir to mix. Serve at once, or serve the saute right away.

title: Cauliflower with Asparagus and Queso Fresco
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1 medium fresh asparagus | 3 ounces queso fresco | 3 teaspoons ground anise seed
instructions: Break the cauliflower into small slivers, discarding the stem, and coarsely chop. Wash and cook the asparagus over a gentle heat, covered, in salted water until cooked, but still firm. Rinse and pat dry. Cut a cross in the base of the asparagus, then cut into 3 lengths. Set aside. Blanch the asparagus in boiling water for 1 minute, then drain, then plunge into cold water. The asparagus should still be bright green in color, and not cook through at this point. Drain the cauliflower. Blanch the asparagus in boiling water for 2 minutes, then remove to colander, then drain. Place the queso fresco in a small bowl. Cut off the tips around the cauliflower stalk, then peel off the stalk. Set aside. Crush the anise seed into small pieces with a mortar and pestle or in a spice mill. Place the unchopped cauliflower on a plate. Fill the bowl with asparagus, then sprinkle the crumbled aniseed over the top. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese, then sprinkle with the crushed aniseed. Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cherry,clear honey,pork shoulder,tomato sauce,turnip,golden delicious apple,fennel bulb
title: Cherry Braised Pork
ingredients: 100 g dried cherries | 400 g canned tomato sauce | 100 g golden delicious apples | 50 g turnips or 50 g swedes | 1 fennel bulb | 60 g clear honey | 3 tablespoons clear honey
instructions: First roast apples, turnips and fennel bulb, then roast papery skin on. Dice onions and fry it up at high heat in a cast iron pot, on the stovetop, until they release some juices, but do not brown the onions. Remove and add to the pot with 2 tbsp of clear honey, the tomatoes and the rest of the clear honey. Cover and let marinate overnight. To serve, put a piece of bread on a plate in the oven, in a pre heated oven it took me about 20 minutes, my oven took about 25 minutes, my oven took about 180°c, but check that the bread isn't burning. To make honeycomb pieces, place 1/2 cup clear honey that has been mixed with 2 tbsp of clear honey, mix in the honey, and add small pieces of beef or pork shoulder from the braiser stewing pot. Wrap and tie the pork up with cotton string, it would be better if you had it for at least 4 hours, longer, for a good flavour. It does not need to be braised after a longer time. If, afterwards, it looks as if the pork is too lean, you can put in a plastic bag, and tie it for at least 2 weeks. It doesn't matter if the pork seems to be browning too much, or if it seems as dry and crumbly, the last 1/2 hour, you can add a little oil, and continue with in steps 5, 6, 7 and 8, or 8 but leave the last one off, and check that your oven is hot, and set it to 150 °c, or close to 150 °c, if it has too much liquid, let it cook a little, then turn your oven back up a little and add 150 °c, or close to 150 °c, and let it cook for another hour after that, checking and stirring every 10 - 15 minutes, until it has a nice, dark colour, and starts to dry out around the edges. At this point, you can add a little more honey, a little more if you like, and turn the heat off. Let it cool a little before cutting it into little pieces. Enjoy the smell this rich smells and makes is so great, its been over and over, and i loved this dish with potatoes.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,white chocolate chip,couscous,cider vinegar,mace,almond,fenugreek seed
title: Tagine of Almonds and Cheese in Phyllo
ingredients: 400 g couscous, cooked until just soft, about 10 minutes | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds, spice ( found at middle eastern or eastern shops ) | 500 g white chocolate chips, melted, about 100g | 200 g chopped almonds | 100 g chopped almonds | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Combine the cooked couscous, fenugreek, white chocolate in a mixing bowl. Stir in melted semisweet chocolate. Add the chopped, roasted almonds, ground mace and cider vinegar, mixing until smooth.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,hot red chili pepper,serrano pepper,zucchini,hard egg
title: Mexican Style Sauteed Zucchini
ingredients: 2 lbs zucchini, trimmed ( medium ) | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 bunch fresh hot red chili pepper, stemmed, chopped ( or 2 -3 tablespoons hot sauce ) | 1 serrano pepper, stemmed, minced | 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Trim ends and cut zucchini into 1 1/2 inch slices. Sprinkle both sides of zucchini slices with mustard powder then arrange in an 11x4x2 inch baking dish. Top with chiles, lightly pressing them into the zucchini,. Cover tightly with plastic wrap then overwrap tightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Preheat broiler. Remove plastic wrap and slice zucchini into 1 1/2 inch pieces.

title: Stewed Beef for a Heart
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 - 2 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Place everything in a plastic crock. Pour in boiling water and let simmer, stewing on low about 6 hours. This recipe may also be used in mashed potatoes, but it is not used in this recipe. This recipe can also be made into a delicious and tasty gravy. You may want to cook the meat in the crock during that time. You may use it at the end of the cooking process, but it is not recommended.

title: Cheesy White Beans on the Half Shell
ingredients: 16 ounces white beans, drained | 1/2 cup frozen grated asiago cheese | 1 tablespoon ghee ( clarified butter ) | 9 lasagna noodles, cooked and rinsed | cooking spray
instructions: Spray a 9x12 inch baking dish with cooking spray. Combine half of the beans and one cup of the asiago in slow cooker. Add the remaining beans and cheese. Cover and cook on low for 5 hours or on high 4 hours. Sprinkle remaining asiago over top and turn off cooker. Let stand until it gets warm. Heat a heavy skillet with a low flame. Coat the bottom of the skillet with cooking spray. When the pan is hot, add the remaining asiago. Stir until the asiago is golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup asiago. Cut into wedges. Serve with hot noodles.

title: Spicy Fruit Salad
ingredients: 6 kiwi fruits, peeled & cut into 1-inch chunks | 4 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1/2 cup pineapple chunks | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne | 2 tablespoons diced green chilies
instructions: Toss kiwifruit & jam in a bowl. Place in refrigerator & chill for 2 hours. Just before serving whisk together remaining ingredients. Pour over kiwifruit mixture & serve.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,lime,chicken bouillon powder,beef chuck roast
title: Quick and Easy Moroccan Beef and Roasted Onions With Preserved Lime-Lime Juice
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice mix | 2 tablespoons finely diced preserved limes ( i use key limes ) | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: Place pot over medium high heat. Brown the roast on all sides in oil. Stir in 1/2 t. Ras el hanout spice and chopped preserved limes. Turn heat to low and add the lime juice. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Remove and pour juice mixture into crockpot. Place the roast onto a plate. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Cilantro Soup
ingredients: 1/2 head cilantro | 4 1 cup vegetable stock
instructions: Finely chopped cilantro leaves and stems. In a blender or food processer add 1 cup of the chopped cilantro and process until leaves are chopped. Then, add 8 cups of vegetable stock and process again until a smooth soup consistency. This soup can also be served with sauteed cooked vegetables.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,extra large bun,sea salt black pepper
title: Easy Bun Bread
ingredients: 500 g self rising flour | 1 teaspoon sea salt and black pepper, coarsely ground | extra large bun, to cook
instructions: Sieve the flour into a large bowl. Add the salt and pepper and stir to combine. Make a well in the centre, add the ground pepper and mix well. Use your hands or a strong wooden spoon to knead it until everything is combined well. Place the kneaded dough on to a floured surface and knead lightly until it's smooth and pliable. Cover with a slightly damp cloth, then return to the bowl and lightly knead again. Divide the dough into 8 and roll out onto a floured surface into an 8 and 2 1/2 wide log. Repeat with each of the remaining dough. Place the bun on a baking tray and cover with a cloth, then allow to rest for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200c. Place the baking tray on your foreman grill, then lower the temperature to 200c. Use a sharp knife to slash a cross on the top of each bun about 5cm deep. Place the bun on the preheated tray of tomatoes and bake for 30 minutes, or until golden and cooked all the way through.

title: Cucumber In-Ahead
ingredients: cucumber sticks | 3 cups puree | 1 cucumber, sliced into thin rounds
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place the sliced cucumber sticks into the boiling water. Remove from heat. After 10 seconds, take the water to a boil, then immediately remove the cucumbers with a slotted spoon, leaving just enough water in the pot to thicken the sauce. Mix the drained cucumbers into the hot sauce. When serving, spread cucumber and sauce in a bowl, and sprinkle with sliced cucumber rounds.

title: Mock Beef Gibblets (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, small whole wheat or 1 lb gluten-free goat's cheese, cut into cubes and softened | 1/2 teaspoon ginger | cheesecloth, large enough to stuff cubes in your freezer | 1/2 teaspoon walnut oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f with oven rack in center. Grease a 3 - 5 qt baking dish with oil. Toss all ingredients together in pan, starting with cheese. Drain pasta and add to pan when cheese begins to melt, tossing with spatula just until heated through. Transfer to oven and bake about ½ hour or until bubbly. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: chinese rice wine,swiss cheese,vegetable protein,cumin,saffron,veal cutlet,beet
title: Beet and Saffron Veggie Skillet
ingredients: 2 lbs veal cutlets | 1 tablespoon chinese rice wine | 1 tablespoon vegetable protein ( for marinade ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 4 ounces swiss cheese, in 1/4 inch cubes | 1 can diced beets
instructions: Marinade, combine rice wine, chinese vegetable protein, cumin, saffron. Rinse meat under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Cut meat into thin slices about 1/8 to 1/4 thick. Spray skillet with nonstick cooking spray and add veal. Cook over medium heat, turning, until lightly browned. Remove meat from skillet and set aside. Add cheese cubes and beets and marinade and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Curried Tomato Jam
ingredients: 6 slices thick bacon | 1 pint thickened tomato puree | 1 bunch fresh fruit, such as strawberries, peeled | 1 cup finely chopped dried mixed fruit | 1 tablespoon ground cumin, or more if needed | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper, or more if needed
instructions: Place bacon in a large pot, and cook over medium high heat until evenly brown. Drain, crumble, and set aside. Pour the tomato puree into a container with a lid, and stir in the dried fruit, cumin, and cayenne pepper. Pour in enough water to cover the surface of the tomatoes. Cover, and simmer over low heat for about 35 minutes, or until the sauce is thickened. This should take 15 to 20 minutes, depending on the thickness of your tomatoes. Remove the lid. Stir in the bacon, and allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Pasta With Beans
ingredients: 8 ounces rotini pasta or 8 ounces rotini pasta | 1/3 cup elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and transfer to a large serving bowl. Add macaroni into drained pasta and toss. Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white onion,orange juice concentrate,arbol chile,tartar sauce
title: Spicy Oranges
ingredients: 1/2 white onion | 2 arbol chiles | 1 1/2 tablespoons canned orange juice concentrate ( i like contadina brand ) | 1/3 cup tartar sauce
instructions: Peel and chop the onion, or mince the chiles. Heat olive oil in a medium pan on medium low, sautee onion until translucent. Add chiles and stir. Stir in orange juice concentrate, stir. Taste and add tartar sauce. Cover and simmer 1 minutes, or until you have reached desired level of desired sweetness. Remove lid and simmer another 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,rye flour,spinach leaf,turmeric,flat leaf parsley,rye bread
title: Spinach and Rye Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 12 large fresh spinach leaves - washed | 1 1/2 tablespoons curds or 1 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 6 slices rye bread | 7 tablespoons rye flour | confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Place a tea towel in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,green onion,black vinegar,liquid honey,yeast,butter,vanilla extract
title: Greek Sticky Buns
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups cold unsalted butter | 1/2 cup very soft light-colored green onion, chopped | 3 1/4 teaspoons instant yeast | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup golden raisins, soaked in hot water for 10 minutes, rinsed | 1/2 cup fresh green-leafed greek oregano or 1/2 cup fresh oregano, chopped | 1 tablespoon dark-colored honey ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon black vinegar
instructions: Melt the butter in a small pot over medium low heat, then stir in the green onion and let stand for 5 minutes. Stir in the yeast and salt.

title: Mustard Salmon
ingredients: 32 ounces can salmon, preferably white | 1/8 cup dijon mustard | 1/4 cup shortening
instructions: Turn 1/4 cup shortening in fry pan. Brown salmon until light brown in color and flaky. Turn salmon and brown the other side. Drain the can of salmon on absorbent paper and set aside. Place the salmon in a large bowl and add about 1/2 cup of mustard, 2 - 3 tbsps water and 2 tsp of salt and mix well. Spread the cooked mustard on top of the salmon and allow the mustard to soak in the fat. Serve warm or refrigerate for upto 2 days. The mustard should not be sticky and not hard.

Random Ingredients: paprika,chicken broth,clear honey,pizza dough,oyster sauce,cream corn,picante sauce
title: Tiny Crawfish Corn Calzones
ingredients: 6 ounces plain pizza dough | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1/2 cup light cream-style corn | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon paprika | 2 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons picante sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f. Grease and flour a baking sheet. Beat the pizza dough, honey, corn, oyster sauce, paprika, and chicken broth together in a bowl with a mixer until smooth.

title: Lebanese Pea and Walnut Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces dried split peas | 3 ounces walnuts, toasted
instructions: Combine the split peas and walnuts in a bowl. Toss together. Serve, cold or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: great northern bean,onion soup mix,ginger powder,chocolate chip,breadcrumb
title: Chinese Chocolate Bean Stuffed French Loaf
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans or ( 19 ounce ) can navy beans | 1 can onion soup mix | 1 cup shredded fresh breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons melted chocolate chips | 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder
instructions: Drain beans well and mash lightly, add soup mix, crumbs, coconut and ginger powder to taste and mix well. Split each french loaf in half and sprinkle each loaf generously with remaining mixture. Sprinkle tops with more shredded coconut and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for about 40 minutes.

title: Vegan Cracker Mix
ingredients: 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1 cup white beans | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 cup papaya, cubed | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats
instructions: Place 3 cups cold water in a blender, add 2 cups quick cooking oats and 1 cup beans. Blend mix until the mixture has the texture of cottage cheese. Add the cumin and 1/2 cup oats, blend until mix is thoroughly combined. Stir in papaya, remove from heat and chill until ready to use.

title: Crusty Mushroom and Fresh Mushroom Pie
ingredients: 1 sheet ready rolled puff pastry | 500 g button mushrooms | 2 chicken stock cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius. Line pie dish with 1 pastry sheet or use ready cut frozen puff pastry sheet. Cut mushrooms in half and place over pastry. Add a pinch of salt and sprinkle pepper across top. Pour stock into pie dish. Cover with pastry. Place on 200 degrees celsius oven for about 15 minutes or until pastry is golden.

title: Simple Saltine Crackers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups saltine crackers | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning ( i use mccormick's ) | 1 large bunch fresh basil leaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees for the crackers, and lightly spray a 2 cup baking dish with nonstick spray. Using a large slotted spoon, scoop out the crackers and place them on the baking dish lined with the basil. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients and add to the cracker mixture. Stir to combine. Scrape the cracker mixture into the hot baking dish. Bake for 1 hour or until crumbs are golden brown and crackers are tender. Serve hot or warm.

title: Mexican Green Pepper Casserole
ingredients: 28 ounces marinara sauce, divided | 1/4 cup green pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon honey or 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1 teaspoon garlic, chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 cup salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Heat half of marinara sauce into small saucepan to just warm up. Once all marinara sauce is warm, mix together with rest of ingredients except for 1/2 cup of salsa.

Random Ingredients: sazon goya,chicken bouillon cube,double cream,vanilla,barley,sugar,white vinegar,radish
title: Creamy Rice
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon goya soft sazon goya | 1/4 cup sugar | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 3 cups warm double cream | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup barley | 10 radishes ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar
instructions: Boil the rice according to package directions, then immediately remove from heat. Dissolve the sazon in the 1/4 cup sugar and set aside for later. Pour the cornstarch into the cream and boil until a thick consistency does form, then whisk the cream back into the wok or pot, and add the sazon, stirring quickly. Add the liquid sazon sazon mixture and the bouillon that's set aside. Strain the rice through a sieve. Return the rice to the pot in a circular motion, leaving it a little chunky if necessary. Do not stir too much. Re cover and lower the heat to medium. Allow to boil rapidly, without stirring for about a minute. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature, about 45 minutes. When cold, fold in the radish greens and vinegar. Stir again to blend completely.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,taco seasoning mix,mustard,white sugar,red chilies,seasoning,grain white rice
title: Baked Rice Mexican Style
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 package taco seasoning mix, such as mccormick original | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 teaspoon dry crushed red chilies | 1/4 teaspoon ground red chili pepper, or to taste | 1/2 teaspoon maggi seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Lightly grease a medium baking dish and set aside. Combine rice, taco seasoning mix, sugar, dry mustard, ground red chilies, ground red chili pepper, and maggi seasoning in a microwave safe bowl. Cover, and microwave on high until the margarita mixture is hot and the seasoning is hot, about 30 seconds per side. Let cool for 5 minutes, then stir into rice mixture. Place in oven. Bake in preheated oven for 50 to 55 minutes, until heated thoroughly and rice is lightly browned. Remove from oven, and let sit for 10 minutes. Fluff with fork.

title: Swiss Apple and Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 thick slices rye bread, sliced | 4 granny smith apples
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450 degrees. Place the rye bread on a baking sheet and top with granny smith apples, cut side down. Bake until golden.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,chicken stock,cherry,feta cheese,beef bouillon cube,pork sausage link
title: Polish Sausage With Feta Cheese or Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb pork sausage link, sliced or 1 lb kielbasa, left whole without any fat | 1 cup chicken stock, homemade or canned | 4 -5 cups thinly sliced white cabbage | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 1/2 cup sour cherry or 1/2 cup sliced cherry, garnish
instructions: Prick sausages in several places with tooth picks. Place sausage on the rack of an ovenproof frying pan over a high heat.

title: Hot Chinese Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 lbs unaged american cheese, cut into 1/2x2. 75/8x2 inch pieces | 1 cup dry sherry or 1 cup chinese rice wine vinegar | 1 cup chinese chili, sliced thin | 1 small bay leaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, cover and chill. Remove meat from refrigerator 30 minutes prior to making this recipe. When meat is cold, break ball in half lengthwise. Scoop out and discard cheese balls. Wet your hands with cold water, and form ball into 1 inch balls. Repeat with remaining cheese balls and balls. Let cool before serving. Serve as an appetizer for a meal.

title: Faux Moussaka
ingredients: 6 eggplants, trimmed | 6 tablespoons ground cardamom pod
instructions: In a covered griddle or skillet of your choice, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat. Test a cube of eggplant with one slice, the eggplant should not break. Fold the slice around before it breaks apart. Reduce heat to low. Spread cardamom pods in a thin layer onto the eggplant. Cook until puffed and lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Easy Tasty Vegan French Silk Frosting
ingredients: 4 tablespoons shortening | 1 cup vanilla ice cream or 1 cup fresh vanilla ice cream | 1/2 teaspoon gelatin | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt butter or shortening. Place over medium heat. Whisk in ice cream, vanilla and cumin. Pour mixture into a bowl and let stand until partially softened about 20 minutes. Cool then break into pieces. Chill in the freezer until hard.

title: Potato and Berry Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup potato, peeled and diced | 1 small cabbage, finely chopped ( i use a combo of purple cabbage and green cabbage ) | 5 cups blackberries, whole in 1 inch lengths
instructions: Place the potato in a pan big enough to hold all the ingredients and add enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,chervil,green cardamom pod,bread yeast,chicken thigh,cantaloupe,paper
title: Cantaloupe With Chicken and Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 8 ounces plain bread yeast | 3/4 lb cantaloupe | 3 green cardamom pods | 12 small pitted chervil, leaves ( approx ) | 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into 2-inch pieces | 6 cups heavy whipping cream | 12 thin slices stale bread, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Soak the cantaloupe in a bowl of warm water 5 minutes. Drain and cut into 1 1/2 inch cubes. Place the cardamon on a cutting board and grind to a fine powder. Stir the powdered cardamon thru the cantaloupe. If the cantaloupe is very soft add a little warm water. Put the ground mixture in a large bowl and mix in the cardamon mixture. Place in a warm place, about 105 inches. Cover and proof the mixture for 5 minutes. Cover and place in a warm place. Farm up the cream until it begins to thicken and you can stick your pointer finger in it. Drain the chicken. Place chicken pieces in a roasting tin. Arrange around the top and pour in the cream. Cover and heat in a warm oven until the chicken is cooked through and the cantaloupe is soft and tender, about 2 hours. Sprinkle the bread with chervil and toast in the oven for approximately 3 minutes or until the topping is lightly browned.

title: Dijon Italian Style Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup dijon style mustard | 1 tablespoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Combine the mustard and italian seasoning in a small bowl or food processor. Blend until the mixture forms a spreadable paste.

title: Charred Poblano
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles or 3 anaheim chilies, seeded and finely chopped | 4 tablespoons minced fresh thyme | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 32 ounces drained bottled garbanzo beans
instructions: Prepare grill. Place chiles on rack of medium hot grill and grill 2 to 3 minutes or until blackened. Remove chiles from grill and place on towel lined plate for 15 minutes or until cool enough to handle. Peel and coarsely chop. Set aside. Place poblano peppers in a medium nonstick skillet and add remaining ingredients and 1 cup water, seasoning with salt and pepper, if using. Cook over low heat, stirring frequently until peppers are crisp tender, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,pizza crust,lentil,marshmallow,ice cube,yellow bell pepper
title: Sweet Lentil and Pepper Pizza
ingredients: 1 medium yellow bell pepper | 1 can sweet lentils | 2 tablespoons taco-flavored instant pizza crust | 1 cup cold cereal | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup marshmallows
instructions: Slice the bell pepper in 1/4 inch strips. You should have 8 to 12 strips. Cook pepper strips in a frying pan with 2 tablespoons shortening for 20 to 25 minutes over medium low heat. Remove peppers, add taco seasoning, red pepper flakes, and milk. Set aside. Spread 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes into the pizza crust, then spread on 1/2 cup of the cold cereal. Top cereal with the lentils. Spread remaining red pepper flakes over lentils. Top with remaining 1/4 cup of cold cereal. Top with the marshmallows before putting the pizza on the cookie sheet. Bake in a preheated oven 375 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes, depending on the pizza texture.

title: Rosemary Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons dried rosemary
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together vinegar and rosemary. Let stand 1 hour until cooled to room temperature. Slowly beat cold dressing into salad. Cover and refrigerate.

title: Sous Vide Plc Sweet Rice With Currants
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup jasmine rice | 2 teaspoons brown sugar ( optional ) | 1 cup currants | 1 teaspoon toasted almonds
instructions: Place rice in a 5 to 6 quart microwave safe dish. Sprinkle brown sugar over the rice and stir to combine. Increase microwave temperature to hi. Microwave rice for 8 minutes. Turn heat down to low and cover the pot. Microwave on high for 20 minutes. Stir once halfway through cooking time. Sprinkle toasted almonds over rice and fluff with a fork. Serve warm without stirring. Tips. Cooking time does not include time for soaking the currants. Fluff before adding other ingredients.

title: Ancho Chile Tots With Apples
ingredients: 1 teaspoon crushed dried ancho chilies | 1/4 cup tart apple ( peeled, cored and diced ) | 1 tablespoon chutney | 1 adobo sauce, from the can
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Put apples, chutney, and adobo sauce in a baking dish. Bake uncovered for 15 - 20 minutes or until apples are just soft. Serve.

title: Corn With Paprika, Corn Chips and Spices
ingredients: 2 -6 lbs whole kernel corn ( use fresh, clean or frozen corn with which 1 2 tsps salt is added ) or 2 -6 lbs frozen corn ( use fresh, clean or frozen corn with which 1 2 tsps salt is added )
instructions: Trim the kernels from a whole corn if using a whole corn. Put into a large mixing bowl and stir in the salt with the paprika and mix well. Line a shallow baking pan with parchment paper. Spread the corn evenly over the baking pan or in a roasting pan with at least 1 - 2 tbsp of oil. Sprinkle the chips on top and bake about 15 minutes at 400 °f then turn over and bake the other side for 3 - 4 minutes. Allow 10 minutes for the chips to dry out before removing from the oven or toaster oven.

Random Ingredients: bragg liquid amino,southwest chipotle seasoning,watermelon,vegetable oil
title: Watermelon Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 teaspoon southwest chipotle seasoning | 1/4 cup braggs liquid aminos | 2 cups watermelon, cut in 1/2 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons water
instructions: Stir oil, chipotle seasoning and braggs liquid aminos together in a small bowl, keeping the braggs liquid aminos. Add water and allow to mixture to stand for about 5 minutes. Stir again and serve.

title: Grilled Rigatoni with Italian Dressing
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 cup italian dressing
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Maraschino and Lettuce Baked Potatoes and Lett
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded | 1 cup maraschino cherry, sliced | 1 cup of fresh parsley leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix all the ingredients except the lettuce in a 9 x 13 pyrex baking pan. Sprinkle with the chopped lettuce and bake for 20 minutes or until the lettuce is done and the potatoes are tender. Serve warm with the warm maraschino. Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,bean black,heavy whipping cream,bonito flake,maraschino cherry,veal scallopini
title: Veal Scallops With Corn-Salted Refried Beans
ingredients: 16 veal scallopini ( about 2 inches thick ) | 16 bonito flakes, roughly chopped ( about 1 tablespoon ) | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 ounce maraschino cherry, finely chopped ( about 1 1/2 ounces ) | 1/2 tablespoon coriander powder | 16 ounces refried beans, preferably black ( or any black bean )
instructions: Heat a large ridged grill pan over medium high heat until just hot. Add veal and cook turning occasionally until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. Raise heat to medium high until hot. Add cream, cherries and coriander. Heat until very hot, then cook, stirring, until mixture is very hot again. Return veal to skillet and heat through, 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer to a platter and cover to reserve. Heat refried beans until warmed through, 3 to 5 minutes. Spoon beans over meat and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,basmati rice,serrano pepper,basil,halibut fillet,white pearl onion,sun tomato,mozzarella cheese
title: Canyon Ranch Halibut With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed under cold water | 6 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil, patted dry | 12 white pearl onions, peeled | 1 habut fillet, about 1 lb., patted dry | 1/4 cup corn oil | 1/3 cup crumbly pulled fresh basil | 1 small serrano pepper, seeded and chopped | 4 ounces shredded lowfat mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine the rice and sun dried tomatos in the bottom of a large glass or ceramic baking dish. Arrange the onion rings on top. Place the halibut on top, then sprinkle over the tomato mixture. Cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours. Remove the plastic wrap from the dish. Heat 1 t oil in a frying pan. Working quickly to avoid smoke, add the salmon fillet, and fry until cooked through, about 2 - 3 minutes per side. Transfer the fish to a platter and keep warm. Pour off any excess oil before returning the pan to medium heat. Pour in the remaining 2 t oil and sun dried tomatos. When it's very hot, add the basil, serrano pepper and reserved garlic. Lower the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes. Remove the cover, increase the heat a little, then stir in the shredded cheese. Spoon the cheese mixture onto plates and serve with the rice.

title: Tropical Lasagna
ingredients: 250 g extra lean ground beef | 10 1/2 ounces instant malted oats | 1 packet frozen mixed fruit pulp | 1 packet low sodium roasted vegetables ( like banana, zucchini and mushrooms ) | 500 g grated low-fat 2 % fat mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°c line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Cook the ground beef in a medium frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes until browned, breaking up any lumps as it cooks, then set aside. Place the malted oats in a large bowl. Heat the remaining olive oil in a small pan over medium heat before tipping in the oatmeal. Cook for 1 minute and stir to combine. Spread the cooked ground beef mixture evenly onto the prepared trays. Bake the lasagna for 35 minutes, or until golden and firm. Add the mixed fruit and mix evenly. Spoon the grated reduced fat mozzarella onto the top of the lasagna, followed by the mashed mixed vegetables, and return to the oven. Cook for 20 more minutes. Serve right away.

title: Easy and Quick Linguine
ingredients: 1 package linguine | 1 package seasoning salt ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon chili pepper, from a jar of chili peppers
instructions: Cook linguine as directed on package. While the linguine cooks, mix all ingredients together except linguine. When cooked according to package instructions and mix with cooked linguine. Serve immediately. Note, can add diced tomatoes, fresh basil or a small amount of jalapeno peppers.

title: Mexican Style Broccoli and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 head fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 2 cups cooked rice | 1 cup guiness mexican style beer | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Steam the broccoli and rice together on a microwave safe dish in the microwave on high for 6 - 8 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,filling,pork chop,madeira wine,mint sprig,rotini pasta
title: Orange Pork
ingredients: 1/2/2 lb pork chop, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons madeira wine | 1 teaspoon grated orange zest | 1 cup rotini pasta | 4 teaspoons dried mint sprigs | filling ( optional )
instructions: Cook pork and madeira in boiling, slated water for 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. Mix together. Sprinkle with orange zest. Serve with a spoonful of mint over the pork. Garnish with mint sprig.

title: Saffron Spinach French Bread
ingredients: 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 1 pinch saffron | 1/2 lb fresh baby spinach ( cleaned, trimmed ) | 2/3 cup spaghetti sauce ( use the tomato basil flavor ) | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 cups homemade buttermilk ( not skim ) | 1 loaf bread cube
instructions: Place 2 large scoop ice cubes into freezer for 20 - 25 minutes.. Place saffron in a cup with 1/2 cup boiling water and place a dinner plate in freezer. In a bowl wisk buttermilk w/balsamic/water and let sit while the water is coming up to temperature. In another mixing bowl add spinach and stir in 1/4 c. Olive oil. Pour remaining 2/3 c olive oil into 13x9 glass baking dish with lid, and set aside. Break bread one at a time into pieces and place into baking dish w/dough chop. Stir spaghetti sauce into the buttermilk mixture. Spoon spinach and sauce over bread in the baking dish, pressing down to submerge as much of the bread in the sauce as possible. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Bake covered at 425 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 5 - 10 minutes or until bread is brown. Serve with more sauce and additional sauce as needed to moisten.

title: Danish Hot Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons paprika
instructions: Blend in a blender. Add hot peppers or to taste, and serve. Note the vinegar is used to drizzle over fish, vegetables, etc i have done this with spinach, carrots, potatoes and peppers.

title: Baked Zones
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemons juice and zest of | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Line a baking tray with aluminium foil. In a small bowl stir together the lemon zest, cumin and lemon juice. Place the zest and juice in a bowl, pour over the cumin and lemon juice and mix to combine. Leave to sit in fridge for 10 minutes minimum to allow flavours to develop. Line a baking tray with aluminium foil and put the zest mixture in the centre of the foil. Roast for 25 minutes or until golden. Enjoy with your favourite salsa.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,corn kernel,gruyere cheese,cherry,lemon juice zest,orange juice zest
title: Gruyere Corn Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons gruyere cheese, finely grated | 5 tablespoons orange juice, freshly squeezed | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 4 ears fresh corn kernels, boiled or 3 cups frozen corn kernels, thawed | 4 cups baby lettuces leaves ( lettuces or mixed lettuces )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except greens, in a large bowl. Toss gently to combine. Cover with plastic wrap and chill thoroughly. Arrange lettuce leaves on a serving platter and place on top of the greens. Spoon over the dressing and serve immediately.

title: Beef in Sherry
ingredients: 1 kg stew meat ( i used a cut up stew meat, like a loin ) | 1 banana | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier or 1 1/2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 tablespoon ground pepper
instructions: Take a large piece of bread or plastic wrap. Using a sharp knife, puncture the bread with 3 - 4 cuts on the bread surface. The bread is for soaking up juices and to help remove the graininess. Cut the stew meat in half or into bite sized pieces. Cut up the banana into thin slices. Sprinkle coriander seed over the top of the meat and add a few drops of grand marnier or orange juice. Sprinkle pepper over everything and leave in fridge for at least 4 - 5 hours or overnight. The meat and vegetables should be covered well with the marinade and the meat on the table. Do not use tooth pick or skewers. The meat will not be completely submerged in the juice. You can also leave pieces to cook on a grill for a few minutes or a frying pan for a couple of minutes to brown the meat. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Baked Brisket with Dry Chimichurri - Chimichurri
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket, boned | 1/4 cup chili powder | 5 teaspoons dried oregano leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 300°f. Trim any excess fat from the brisket. Score the fat and prick the meat several times with a fork. Place on a rack in a roasting pan. Place in the oven and cook for 5 hours. Remove brisket from the oven and rub in chili powder and oregano to taste. Transfer beef to a platter and let rest 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with the reserved chimichurri.

Random Ingredients: cream,orange marmalade,white grape juice,chickpea,seasoning salt,saffron,dijon mustard,cumin
title: Moroccan Style Three Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 cans canned chickpeas ( do not drain ) | 3 tablespoons orange marmalade | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 package saffron | 3 tablespoons white grape juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or more to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup cream ( optional )
instructions: Drain the chickpeas. Rinse with cool water and drain again. Dry the chickpeas well. Set aside 3 cans drained chickpeas in a large salad bowl and mix with the remaining ingredients. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

title: Basic Key Limeade
ingredients: 1 limes, juice of ( the best kind to use is fresh squeezed juice ) or 1 lemon, juice of ( the best kind to use fresh squeezed juice ) | 1 cup lime juice ( a good rule of thumb is 1 cup of lime, can also use fresh squeezed juice, if preferred ) or 1 cup lemon juice ( a good rule of thumb is 1 cup of lime, can also use fresh squeezed juice, if preferred ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( or to taste )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and process till smooth. Pour into a glass container and store in the refrigerator till ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: crawfish tail,chicken thigh,flat leaf italian parsley,cake flour,green bean,cardamom pod,manchego cheese,guacamole
title: Guacamole and Crawfish Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons guacamole | 6 large boneless skinless chicken thighs | 8 ounces sliced manchego cheese | 8 ounces green beans, ends snipped and beans cut short | 8 ounces flat-leaf italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon whole cardamom pod | 8 large flat-leaf italian parsley, root ends removed, leaves separated | cake flour, for dredging
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f. Place oil in oven proof skillet and heat at 325 degrees f. Place chicken in skillet and sauté until juices run clear. Transfer to platter, drippings from skillet, and let cool. Arrange cheese in a shallow bowl. Place green beans on a bed of parsley. In same skillet, add cardamom, meat juices, and sauté, stirring occasionally, until meat is no longer pink. Remove from heat, add cheese and stir until melted. Place meat mixture on flour, roll into a cylinder shaped patty, and tie with kitchen string to prevent sticking. Place in a shallow baking dish, bake, turning several times, until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Serve with salsa and guacamole.

title: Grilled Peach and Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground summer squash | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 teaspoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken breast halves, 4-oz | 2 large fresh peaches
instructions: In a medium bowl blend squash, 1 t. Honey, and 1/2 teaspoons honey thoroughly. Arrange chicken breasts in a shallow pan sprayed with cooking spray. Pour 1/3 cup marinade over chicken. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least for up to 2 hours, turning occasionally. Discard marinade. Meanwhile, remove any peaches from refrigerator. Halve peaches lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,italian seasoning,green apple,red onion,white wine vinegar,orange peel
title: Apple and Sage Salad
ingredients: 1 green apple, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/3 cup minced red onion | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons minced fresh sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon dried orange peel | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning
instructions: Arrange apple slices in a serving dish. Stir together onion, vinegar, sage, orange peel, and italian seasoning.

title: Beef Tender Ground Beef With Black Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 package lean ground veal | 1 can black beans, drained | 1/3 cup white chocolate chips
instructions: Heat peanut butter in 10 inch sauté pan over medium heat until melted. Add veal.

title: Mushroom Catsup
ingredients: 4 lbs mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Combine the salt, salt/salt mix, mushrooms and mushrooms in a plastic bag. Heat a cast iron skillet on medium high 3 - 4 minutes, until hot and slightly browning. Turn mushrooms over, close lid and cook for 15 - 20 minutes, until mushroom pieces are tender. Serve warm and enjoy.

title: White Bean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces white beans, drained and rinsed | 15 ounces dark raisins | 14 ounces small shell pasta | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 1/2 cup triple sec
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain. Put cooked pasta, raisins, drained beans and marjoram in a bowl. Pour triple sec and triple sec over. Mix together. Cover and refridgerate until chilled, about 6 hours.

Random Ingredients: splenda brown sugar,beef stock,grain white rice,brown sugar,nutmeg
title: Rice in a Mug
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white rice or 1 cup medium grain white rice | 1 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons splenda brown sugar blend or 1 1/2 tablespoons other artificial sweetener | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | sugar or brown sugar, to serve
instructions: Wash the rice in a fine mesh sieve to remove any traces of the starch. Place the rice in a large, microwave safe bowl. Add the bouillon, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high power for 5 minutes. Remove the wrap. Microwave rice again, uncovered, for 3 - 5 minutes or until it begins to swell. Do not stir. Continue to microwave rice on high power, covered, for 30 - 35 minutes, stirring twice. Do not rinse the rice further or the steam will get all of it. Stir once while you cook the rice. It may take 5 - 10 minutes or so. Turn onto a plate, sprinkle with sugar, and serve hot. Note, any type of rice will work. However, most flavor combinations are equally present. To sweeten, add about 1 tsp of brown sugar.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,half cream,brown onion,chicken breast,pearl onion
title: Easy Slow Cooker Chicken and Onions
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into small pieces | 1 medium brown onion, chopped | 1/2 cup sliced fresh parsley sprig | 3 cups half-and-half cream | fresh parsley sprig, for garnish
instructions: Place the chicken, onion, and 3 cups water in a 6 to 8 quart slow cooker. Cover cooker, and cook on low for 10 to 15 hours, or until the chicken is just cooked through. Drain the liquid. Discard the chicken and onion. Return the chicken to the slow cooker, and stir to coat the chicken with the onion mixture. Top with 3 cups of the cream, scraping any browned bits from the slow cooker. Continue to cook for an additional 5 minutes. Garnish with additional parsley sprigs.

title: Grilled Cuban Macaroni With Spiced Ham and Oranges
ingredients: 1 cup elbow macaroni or 1 cup fettuccine pasta | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 lb smoked ham, cut into 1/4-inch strips | 1/2 cup lemon or 1/2 cup orange sweet pickled ginger | 1/3 cup diced garlic | confectioners'sugar, for dusting
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions using only a little water, but only if necessary to keep the ingredients from sticking and to the bottom of the pan. When the pasta is finished cooking, drain well and immediately toss with the corn oil to coat well. Transfer to a nonstick or lightly oiled grill pan. Place the cumin into a small criss cross pan toasted over medium heat and toast until aromatic, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. Meanwhile, grill the ham on both sides for 5 - 7 minutes, depending on size, until crisp and light brown. While heating, whisk together lemon and orange juice until combined, then set aside. Heat grill pan over high heat until just hot to the touch and then set aside. Brush the orzo with some of the corn oil and then sprinkle with cumin, tossing to coat. Grill the orzo quickly, until it begins to brown and the fat rises to the surface, about 1 1/2 minutes. Spoon some of the orzo onto 6 warmed plates. Spoon a few slices of ham over the hot ham and sprinkle with some lemon or orange zest. Place another large mound of orzo on top, dust with confectioner's sugar and serve immediately. Repeat with the remaining orzo in the same manner.

title: Spiced Red Capsicum and Coriander Salad
ingredients: 2 medium red capsicums | 1/2 bunch coriander, leaves only, chopped fine
instructions: Cut the top off the very stem end of the capsicums and remove the pit. Remove the eyes and most part of the membrane. Wash the capsicums and dry well with kitchen paper towel. Halve the cooled capsicums lengthwise. Place the capsicums, stem side down, in a bowl and sprinkle the chopped coriander over, then squeeze over any remaining water to moisten the pulp. Serve either room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,grape tomato,red wine,curd cottage cheese,brandy,graham cracker crumb,half
title: Maggie Mcdonald's Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 box graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup cocoa | 1/2 cup chopped red wine ( your prefrence brand, i used pisco ) | 1 jar grape tomatoes ( or a few tomatoes of your choice, for garnish ) | 3 tablespoons sour cream or 3 tablespoons mascarpone cheese | 1 -2 tablespoon brandy ( your prefrence brand, i used just as much ) or 1 -2 tablespoon rum ( your prefrence brand, i used just as much ) | 1 cup small curd cottage cheese
instructions: Mix together crumbs and half and half until crumb forms. Fold in cocoa. Add wine and tomatoes. Press into a 9 springform pan.. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes at 350 degrees, or until edges are lightly browned. Remove from oven and spread cottage cheese evenly over bottom of crust. Return to oven and cook another 5 minutes till bubbly, then spread sour cream over cottage cheese to cover cottage cheese. Return to oven and bake for 10 minutes more. Turn oven off and let cool 5 minutes then remove rim of springform pan and allow to sit for about 20 - 30 minutes before serving. Serve with a slice of sour cream. Serve with ice cream, if preferred. Sour cream is actually very good with strawberry purée, or just a little cream and vanilla.

title: Darda
ingredients: 14 ounces navy beans ( small tin ) | 11 ounces salt-free hot tap water | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Empty the can of navy beans and water into a pot. Add the mustard seeds. Bring to the boil. Cover and simmer on the stovetop for 30 minutes, or until the beans are very tender.

title: Cajun-Style Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cayenne powder, or to taste | 2 pounds pork tenderloins, trimmed | 1/4 cup chicken, minced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. Mix cayenne pepper, pork tenderloins, and meat tenderloins together in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Rub cayenne pepper mixture onto both sides of meat, and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven until meat is tender, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: leg lamb,puff pastry,pepperoni,chicken breast half,bean sprout,poblano chile,onion powder
title: Slow-Cooker Roast Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 chuck roast | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 2 teaspoons pepperoni powder | 2 medium poblano chiles, chopped | 2 cups bean sprouts | 1 cup baked chicken breast half | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Sprinkle meat with onion powder, pepperoni powder, poblano chiles and bean sprouts. Place meat on bottom rack of a slow cooker. Layer roasted pieces of chicken on top if desired. Cover and set on low heat and cook for 8 to 10 hours. Stir vegetables and chicken pieces into slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: carrot,caster sugar,fenugreek seed,baking powder,dark sesame oil,chicken broth
title: Easy Nasiag (Ethiopian Carrot Soup)
ingredients: 3 medium carrots, peeled, then roughly chopped | 600 ml chicken broth | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 2 teaspoons caster sugar
instructions: Place the carrots, chicken stock, nut sesame oil, mustard seeds and baking powder in a pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until carrots are tender. Stir regularly to make sure the stock does not stick to the bottom of the pan and to ensure the carrots get a smooth soup. Stir in the sugar and leave to cool before ladling into warmed sterilised jars. To store, leave at least an inch of space between the hot soup and the hot water in the pan. Allow the soup to cool, then refrigerate for 6 months.

title: Chickpea  and  Chili Powder   (Pebre)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried garbanzo beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1 tablespoon red chili powder | 1 3/4 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°f. Place the soaked chickpeas, chili powder, and dried oregano in a mixing bowl and stir together. Coat the bottom of a non stick baking pan with oil and place the soaked chickpeas on the pan, and roast uncovered for 1 hour.

title: Quinoa Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 quarts spanish onions, peeled | 2 quarts quinoa
instructions: Wash quinoa.

title: A Simple Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh curry leaves or 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Cook and stir green beans in boiling water until crisp tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, and rinse under cold water until no longer hot. Drain well and return to pot. Add remaining ingredients and toss to combine. Chill several hours before serving.

title: Quick and Easy Brazilian Lime Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable bouillon | 1 1/2 ounces fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Put everything into a blender and process just enough so that the juice flows out of the solids, but not so long that the soup gets a lot of bits. Enjoy.

title: Lengua Batata (Banana Buck With Anchovies in Beer)
ingredients: 1 banana, ripe | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, chopped | 6 stalks asparagus, cut into about 4-6 sections | 3 tablespoons fresh capers | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder ( or to taste ) | 12 toothpicks | 8 ounces light beer
instructions: Cut the banana into small pieces and remove all the outer layer, about a 1/2 inch wide piece, then cut through the slices with a very sharp paring knife, starting about the thickness of a match. Place the pieces on the counter, cut side up, and bring them to room temperature. Place the pieces of banana along with the ginger and asparagus in a non reactive bowl and add the capers and turmeric, mix well, crushing the pieces of banana with your hands, and taste for spice. To serve, place the pieces of banana on a plate, add the beer, and sprinkle the top with paprika. Serve immediately.

title: Spring Rolls
ingredients: 350 g spring roll wrappers | 400 g sweetened condensed milk | 200 g brown rice or 200 g basmati rice, rinsed and well drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Line the base of a 17x21cm slice tin with greaseproof paper. Take one spring roll wrapper on it and spread it with a thin layer of milk, leaving a 3cm strip of dough all the way around the outside of the tin. Lay the rice on top of the milk. Lay the spring roll wrapper on top of the rice and spread it out in rows. Bring the edges together, making a pleat at the top. Brush the spring roll wrapper with milk and bake for 40 minutes, brushing and spraying the spring roll wrapper with the milk, before serving. Store in an airtight container up to 2 months.

title: Cake and Mushroom Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup cake, grated | 1/2 cup sifted self raising flour | 1 can cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. Mix grated cake with sifted flour. Make a well in the center of the cake. Add soup. Fold in half cup more flour just until the mixture resembles rice cakes. Spoon out into paper lined muffin tin. Bake 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Low Fat Cardamom Milk
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Pour dry milk into freezer. Place cardamom pods in milk with a generous amount of water and freeze for one hour. Remove cardamom pods before serving. Note. If desired, you may cook this mixture over low heat in a medium saucepan until it thickens to about 1 1/2 cups.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,dark sesame oil,chocolate syrup,garlic,basil leaf,picante sauce,sunflower oil
title: Easy Basic Chocolate & Basil Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour ( or equivalent amount of all purpose flour ) | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 -3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves ( or fresh basil ) | 3/4 teaspoon dried minced garlic | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon bakers'sugar mixed with 1 t sesame oil
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c and prepare 12 muffin pan. Line a baking tray with muffin papers. Lightly grease with canola oil spray. In a large mixing bowl, combine dry ingredients and then add the oils, basil, garlic and salsa blend together. If mixture seems to dry add a tsp of water. Using 3 tbsp measuring and mixing, add more salsa and salsa, according to your taste. Add the nuts and mix into muffins, as for a nutella, or spread on toasted bread, etc. This is good with biscuits or other filling.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,serrano pepper,grain white rice,herbes de provence,beef base,pink peppercorn,pineapple chunk juice
title: Pesto-Seared Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, pounded thin | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 2 teaspoons pink peppercorns | 1 tablespoon coarsely crushed pink peppercorns | 1 tablespoon herbes de provence | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 1 1/2 cups pineapple chunks with juice | 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1 -2 tablespoon beef base
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of the meat with the herbs & allow to rest for at least 2 hours. Heat a deep, large pan over medium heat. Drain the meat& add the pesto sauce. Add the pineapples with their juice, meat, rice and sugar. Mix well. Cover w/foil & cook over medium heat for 45 minutes. Turn meat & cook for 15 minutes or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,white pepper,ice water,brussels sprout,pizza sauce,chinese cabbage
title: Chinese Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 teaspoon white pepper, or to taste | 1 pound brussels sprouts, sliced | 5 cups shredded chinese cabbage | 1/2 yellow onion, minced | 2 cups prepared pizza sauce, or as needed | 1/2 cup ice water, or as needed
instructions: Place brussels sprouts in a steamer basket over boiling water, and cover. Cook until just tender, about 10 minutes. Drain, and set aside. Place cabbage and onion in a separate steamer basket over boiling water. Reduce heat to low, and steam until cabbage and onion are tender, about 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f, and spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Combine brussels sprouts, cabbage, onion, pizza sauce, and ice water in a bowl, and mix until thoroughly combined. Transfer mixture to a baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven until brussels sprouts are golden brown and bubbly, about 45 minutes.

title: Dairy-Free Chicken and Corn Soup
ingredients: 2 cups of chopped chicken legs ( skin on for easy removal ) | 2 cups of chopped vegetables ( fresh or frozen ) | 2 cups of chopped fresh cherries ( or frozen, but not in juice ) | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 ounce self-raising powdered milk or 1 ounce dairy free sour cream | 1 dash salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan and bring to boil to thicken.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,tomato ketchup,pork tenderloin,carrot,white sugar,baking powder,white pepper
title: Crock Pot Carrots & Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin | 4 large carrots, peeled & cut into 3-inch rounds | 1 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup dry patted dry tomatoes with ketchup | 1/2 cup light vanilla sugar ( i used half-fruit brand ) | 2 tablespoons tomato ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Place the pork tenderloin in a large crock pot. Add the carrots, white sugar, pats of tomatoes on top of the meat. Sprinkle the vanilla sugar over pork. Pour tomato ketchup over the pork evenly. Do not stir. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 hours. Remove top layer of fat and discard. Slice pork across grain into thin pieces. To serve, put pork slices on a platter and drizzle sauce around.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,plain flour,mirin,white flour,chicken breast,pork tenderloin
title: Pork Skewers With Spicy Chicken & Chile
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast, cut into 4 equal pieces | 500 g pork tenderloins | plain flour | all purpose white flour | mirin | 0.5 can sliced white chile peppers
instructions: Prepare a day of making the skewers by starting to mix the wet and dry with a wooden or metal sieve for a couple of minutes. Mix with white bread flour and ensure all surfaces have the right dusting mixture on them. Pour a little oil into a metal tin to just coat the surface of the mixture. Toss the chicken, pork and dried vegetables in the flour to coat all over and place on a pre greased tray. Drain off excess flour and leave to rest for approx 15 - 25 minutes. Prepare a little oven at 200 degrees celcius. Brush the hot grill with a little of the left over flour and cook for 5 minutes on each side. Cut into 4 equal sized pieces. Serve over rice and top with spiced green chilies.

title: Capellini Di Dione Di Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 1/2 tablespoons capers | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup blanched slivered pistachio nuts
instructions: Rinse quinoa under running water, then drain. In a large pot of salted boiling water, cover quinoa and soak for 30 minutes, or until creamy. Drain quinoa and let cool. Drain excess water from quinoa into a skillet with 1/4 cup of the capers, the ground red chile, pistachios and remaining capers. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until hot, about 8 minutes. Fluff quinoa with a fork and stir through the hot ingredients.

title: Moroccan Breakfast
ingredients: 2 mavocados, peeled, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons finely shredded orange zest | 1 1/4 tablespoons coffe | 1/2 cup warm coffee
instructions: Spray a non stick pan or skillet with olive oil and bring to medium heat. Add orange zest. When the zest starts to brown, add mushrooms. Cook until mushrooms are soft, but not mushy. Add coffee or rum and mix. Remove from heat. Stir occasionally until most of the liquid is absorbed. Serve.

title: Peperonata
ingredients: 2 green onions, sliced | 1 small vidalia onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to in a small bowl, combine the green onion, vidalia onion, and salt. Spread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 25 minutes.

title: Grap Tomatoes & Rice Noodles With Pimmiento and Vinegar
ingredients: 500 g grape tomatoes, sliced | 8 small pimientos | 4 tablespoons parsley sprigs, chopped | 300 g rice noodles | 1 1 cup beef broth
instructions: In a small bowl, rinse grape tomatoes under hot water for a few seconds until water begins to run clear. Slice the tomatoes in half and place in a baking dish with the sliced pimentos. Set aside. Add beef broth to frying pan and heat on high heat until boiling. Add beef broth to tomatoes. Add rice noodles to pan. Cook until the noodles soften. Add pimento slices to noodles. Serve with parsley on top.

title: Cherry Bombs
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh chervil | 4 ounces black peppercorns
instructions: Remove stems and tough outer leaves from thyme sprigs. Trim sprigs, reserving about 2 sprigs for garnish. Gather stems and root ends from cherry. Cut stems into 1 inch lengths. Drop cherry pods, a few at a time, into boiling water. Cook until puffed and just beginning to curl on the bottom. Drain immediately and store in airtight container.

title: Mixed Greens and Apples
ingredients: 5 teaspoons green lentils | 2 teaspoons tart apples, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon tarragon | 2 spring onions, chopped ( optional ) or 1 large fresh chives, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Soak green lentils over night. Drain. Bring to boiling water, stir, then simmer. Drain. Mix with lentils, apple, and tarragon into a dressing. Sprinkle with green onions. Garnish with finely chopped herbs.

title: Sydney Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork belly | 1 cup mango chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place the pork belly into two large roasting pans.

title: Sailors' Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato and clam juice cocktail | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Mix together in a blender and serve with ice cream or coffee.

title: Mexican Potatoes Sticker Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups mashed potatoes ( you can use regular, but the starch will not mix right ) | 2 teaspoons half-and-half ( to be corn starch flavor ) | 1 teaspoon potato starch | 2 cans tomatillos
instructions: Mix the cooked mashed potato with the salt and half and half. Heat in microwave until desired temperature, usually about 35 - 40 seconds. Mix in all the tomatillos in with the tomatillo mixture, and mix thoroughly. Serve as a dipping sauce for the table.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,gingerroot,jumbo shrimp,rump steak,cream,pineapple tidbit,cider vinegar,green onion
title: Thai Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lbs lean rump steak, cut into bite size pieces | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, grated | 1 bunch green onion, chopped | 16 jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined
instructions: Place the steak and pineapple tidbits into a saucepan. Pour on enough water to cover the shrimp, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a low simmer, and cook for 20 minutes. Remove from heat, transfer to a large casserole dish, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight. Drain the pork from the pan, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid. Slice the remaining meat to strips about 2 inches long. In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining ingredients, and pour over the meat. Cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Bring the shrimp and reserved cooking liquid to the boil in a 4 quart pan, boil 5 minutes or until the shrimp turns pink. Immediately transfer to the casserole dish, and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or overnight. Serve over rice.

title: Rutabaga and Endive Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg rutabagas, peeled and coarsely chopped | 150 g belgian endive, leaves picked | 1 celery rib, chopped | 150 g bananas, quartered lengthways, cut in 2. 3 cm slices lengthways ( firm and ripe ) | 4 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon mustard dressing vinegar | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Grind rutabaga with endive, celery and bananas in a blender or food processor until coarsely chopped. Whisk together yogurt, mustard and vinegar and stir into mixture. Mix together cornflour with a small amount of water to make a thin paste and brush over fruit. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight, stirring a few times. Serve with salad garnished with mustard.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,sea salt,fiddlehead,italian salad dressing mix,baking soda,vidalia onion,genoa salami
title: Italian Fiddlehead Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 jar chili-garlic sauce | 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 2 1/2 pounds fresh fiddlehead, rinsed | 1 large vidalia onions or sweet onion, diced | 1 pound genoa salami, diced | 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Heat chili garlic sauce in a small saucepan over medium low heat. Stir in the salad dressing mix and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f. Place fiddleheads in separate shallow pan. Pierce holes with a fork several times in the hot onion mixture, but do not cook. Cover fiddleheads with boiling water and spread in a layer over the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Bake fiddleheads for 30 minutes. Remove cover and turn fiddleheads over. Sprinkle with onions, salami and baking soda. Dissolve baking soda in the hot chili garlic sauce. Cover and continue baking 20 to 30 minutes, until fiddleheads are tender and liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chilies,tea,cream chicken soup,dark chocolate,white,cherry,shrimp paste,baby spinach
title: Spinach & Shrimp Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 5 canned cream of chicken soup | 1 box frozen miniature peppers, chopped in half | 4 anaheim chilies | 1 package baby spinach, defrosted | 1/2 lb shrimp paste | 2 ounces white chocolate, melts, cooled | 2 teaspoons instant tea | 5 ounces dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until chicken is cooked and sauce thickens. Remove from heat.

title: French Wrapped Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless duck breast | 4 slices bread | 4 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 4 fat free egg-free rolls
instructions: Pound duck breasts between plastic wrap to 1/4 inch thickness, then season with paprika and salt. Coat pan with cooking spray using cooking spray. Lay half of sliced bread on work surface. Lay rolled chicken breasts on top of bread, then spread pesto onto chicken as evenly as possible. Roll each breast up, and wrap each breast in the bread slices. In a small bowl, heat buttermilk on low heat until the milk is absorbed. Lay the roll up, and top with remaining sliced bread until well covered. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least an hour. Preheat grill to high. Lightly sprinkle oil on one side of each roll, and season with salt, if desired. Grill rolled breasts until lightly browned, 10 - 12 minutes per side.

title: Chocolate Egg Rollups
ingredients: 12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and cut lengthwise into halves | 6 squares bittersweet chocolate
instructions: Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with waxed paper or parchment paper. Fill each egg roll half with 1 egg.

title: Thai Red Chili Paste
ingredients: 1 tablespoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon tamarind soup base
instructions: Measure out the baking soda into a large, flat bowl. Dissolve the baking soda into 1/4 cup of warm water until the soda is mostly clear. Stir in the tamarind soup base until dissolved. Pour the mixture into a plastic bag, and store in the refrigerator for at least 1 week. Bring to room temperature before using, or serve over rice.

title: Russian Salad Spray
ingredients: 1/4 cup russian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon instant coffee granules | 8 cups fresh bean sprouts
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a large bowl for a crisp look.

Random Ingredients: paprika,garlic,cardamom seed,pork roast,green pepper,brown lentil,dark brown sugar
title: Faux Rasame
ingredients: 1 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons paprika | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed ( khus ) | 1 green pepper or 1 red pepper, chopped | 1 lb pork roast, fat removed | 3 -6 cloves garlic, diced | 1/2 cup brown lentils, rinsed and drained
instructions: Bring first 6 ingredients. Cut pork into bite size pieces. Brown meat in olive oil. Add to sauce. Simmer until meat and vegies are soft. Add more spice to taste. Serve with rice and a green vegetable.
